15. Slice on a diagonal into 1 / 2 inch slices
16. Bake again at 300f for another 20-25 minutes
17. The easiest way to bake is to place sliced biscotti directly on the oven rack
18. Alternatively , you can place biscotti on two baking sheets
19. After 5-6 minutes , rotate the pans from top to bottom and front to back
20. After another 5-6 minutes , flip all the biscotti over
21. Then , after another 5-6 minutes , rotate pans again
22. Cool biscotti completely on racks
23. Biscotti may be stored in an airtight tin for several weeks at room temperature

title: ukrainian country babka
steps:
1. Dissolve the sugar in the lukewarm water , sprinkle the yeast over it , and let stand until softened
2. For the sponge: combine dissolved yeast with the lukewarm milk and 1 cup of flour
3. Beat well , cover , and allow the sponge to rise in a warm place until light and bubbly
4. Beat the eggs with the salt , add the sugar gradually , and continue beating
5. Beat in the butter and lemon rind
6. Combine this mixture with the sponge
7. Stir in the flour and knead in the bowl for about 10 minutes
8. This dough should be slightly thicker than for the usual babka mixture
9. Knead in the raisins
10. Cover and let rise in a warm place until double in bulk
11. Punch down , knead a few times , and let it rise again
12. Butter tall , round baking pans with soft butter sprinkling them lightly with fine bread crumbs and fill them one-third full
13. I like to use greased parchment paper on the bottom and sides of pan
14. For this recipe you will need about 2 or 3 large coffee cans
15. If you are going to use smaller cans , you will need more of them and use your judgment to how many you will need
16. Adjust baking time for the smaller cans
17. Cover and let rise in a warm place until the dough reaches the brim of the pan
18. Brush the loaves with a beaten egg diluted with 2 tablespoons of milk or water
19. Bake in a moderately hot oven for about 15 minutes , then lower the temperature to 350 degrees f
20. , and continue baking for 40 minutes longer , or until done
21. Avoid browning the top too deeply
22. If necessary , cover with aluminum foil
23. Remove the baked loaves from the oven and let them stand in the pans for 5 to 10 minutes
24. Do not cool the loaves on a hard surface
25. This is extremely important
26. Careless handling of the baked babka may cause it to fall or settle
27. As the loaves are cooling , change their position very gently a few times to prevent settling
28. If desired , the cooled loaves may be iced or glazed and decorated with bakers' confetti
29. This is the custom in the old country
30. Babka is always sliced in rounds across the loaf
31. The sliced bottom crust serves as a protective cover , and it is put back to prevent the loaf from drying
32. Babka with pumpkin: this is a very old recipe , but it is worth preserving
33. Mashed pumpkin imparts a mellow , yellow color to babka and keeps it fresh and soft for days
34. A fewer number of eggs is required when pumpkin is used
35. Follow the preceding recipe for country babka
36. Add 1 / 2 to 2 / 3 cup of cooked , mashed pumpkin , 2 teaspoons vanilla , and 1 / 2 cup of orange juice and about 4 eggs
37. Add enough flour to give a soft dough

title: baked ham in a blanket
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Make a spice dough , combining the flour , sugar , and spices in a large mixing bowl
3. Add enough water or cider to make a stiff dough
4. Roll until it is 1 / 4" thick and forms a 10x12" rectangle
5. Place the ham , fat side up , in a foil-lined open roasting pan
6. Cover top and sides of ham with "blanket" of dough
7. Bake at 350f for 3 hours
8. Remove ham
9. Discard "blanket" crust
10. Let rest for 15 minutes
11. Slice ham
12. Serve warm or cold

title: asian american confetti
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients
2. May be eaten as is , but tastes best chilled overnight

title: deep fried broccoli
steps:
1. Heat oil in deep fryer or large pot on stove to 350 fahrenheit
2. Beat eggs and milk together in a bowl
3. Pour milk and egg wash in a ziplock bag
4. Combine remaining ingredients in a separate ziplock bag
5. Close the bag and shake thoroughly to mix
6. Shake and soak broccoli pieces in egg wash bag for 5 minutes , then place them in flour and seasoning ziplock bag
7. Shake to coat
8. Place each coated broccoli piece in hot oil and cook until golden brown
9. Drain on paper towel
10. Best served hot out of the fryer
11. Serve with condiments of your choice , catsup , hot sauce , or cocktail sauce are my favorite choices

title: sugar free fat free  cinnamon hot chocolate mix
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together and place in an airtight container
2. To make hot chocolate , use 1 / 4 c mix and 1 c hot water
3. Number of servings: 18

title: apple cinnamon steel cut oats
steps:
1. Dice apple and throw everything in rice cooker , stir
2. Set on porridge option for rice cooker
3. Alternate ingredients:
4. Oat or nut milk

title: creamy curry zucchini soup
steps:
1. Fry onions , leak and curry in the oil , about 3 minutes
2. In another pan , cook potatoes and zucchini in 2 cups of the vegetable broth for 15-20 minutes
3. Add onionmix and cook another 5 minutes
4. Puree the soup either by hand or in a blender
5. Add the rest of the vegetable broth and heat the soup to boiling point
6. Add salt to taste

title: savoury cheese   walnut sables for cocktails and parties
steps:
1. Sift the flours , salt , pepper & chillies into a bowl together & mix
2. Rub in the butter until it resembles breadcrumbs
3. Add the cheese & walnuts - mix well
4. Add the beer or milk - mix into a dough
5. Chill for 30 minutes
6. Roll out on a floured board and cut into small rounds
7. Place on a greased baking tray and bake in pre-heated oven 180c / 360f for about 15 minutes or until golden brown & crisp
8. Sprinkle with seasoning salt or cayenne pepper if you wish
9. Cool on a wire rack and store in airtight tins
10. Serve with cheese , cream cheese & savoury fillings & dips , or just by themselves !

title: easy breezy refrigerator pickles
steps:
1. Add the vinegar , water , sugar , salt and garlic to a saucepan and stir well
2. Make sure the sugar is totally dissolved
3. Bring to a boil , remove from the heat , and add the dill
4. Let the pickling mixture completely cool
5. Add in the bay leaves
6. While your pickling mixture is cooling , fill a clean one-quart mason jar with the cut cucumbers and gently pour in the cooled pickling mixture , covering the cucumbers
7. Cover , and let sit in the refrigerator at least overnight
8. Serve to your loved ones , and they will thank you
9. Share and enjoy:

title: marinated feta with kalamata olives
steps:
1. Combine the peppers , feta and olives in a large bowl
2. Add the olive oil and toss gently
3. Add the remaining ingredients and toss gently again
4. Adjust seasonings , cover and chill atleast 5 hours before serving

title: pumpkin cranberry nut bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f & grease two 8"x4" loaf pans
2. In a large bowl , cream butter & sugar until light & fluffy , then add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
3. Beat in the pumpkin & zest
4. In another bowl , whisk together the flour , cinnamon , salt , baking soda & baking powder , then add it to the pumpkin mixture , mixing until just moistened
5. Fold in the nuts & berries , then pour into the prepared loaf pans
6. Bake for 65-75 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
7. Cool for 10 minutes before removing from the pans to a wire rack
8. Loaves can be frozen for later use

title: pork and bean minestrone soup
steps:
1. Combine beef broth , cooked ham or other cooked meat , onion , carrot , celery , thyme and oregano in a large saucepan
2. Bring to a boil
3. Stir in raw macaroni
4. Reduce heat to a simmer
5. Simmer , uncovered , for 20 minutes , stirring occasionally , until macaroni is tender
6. Add pork and beans and heat thoroughly
7. Add additional liquid if necessary

title: prawns peri peri mozambique
steps:
1. Prepare peri peri sauce first , by sauteeing onion and garlic in peri peri oil until soft , then add diced tomatoes , stir to combine and simmer for 20 minutes on low heat , covered
2. After 20 minutes adjust seasoning with salt and pepper
3. Remove from heat and keep warm
4. Reheat rice over a colander of boiling water , adding frozen sweet green peas 5 minutes before service
5. Bring olive oil to a hot smoke temperature and in batches fry the prawns until crisp , but not over done , about 4 minutes
6. Remove batches to paper towel and keep hot
7. Serve 6 prawns over savory rice per person and pass bowl of peri peri sauce to spoon over prawns
8. Prawns traditionally eaten shell on with fingers , and crispy heads sucked for flavor

title: continental frankfurt bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c lightly grease an 8-cup capacity heatproof baking dish
2. Heat oil in a frying pan over medium heat
3. Add onion
4. Cook for 2 minutes
5. Add garlic
6. Cook for a further 2 minutes or until soft
7. Add frankfurts
8. Cook for 5 minutes or until light golden
9. Add tomatoes , tomato paste , potatoes , capsicum , parsley and water
10. Bring to the boil
11. Remove from heat
12. Season with salt and pepper
13. Spoon mixture into dish
14. Sprinkle with cheese
15. Bake for 20 minutes or until golden
16. Spoon into bowls
17. Serve

title: swiss potato sausage bake
steps:
1. Set oven to 400 degrees
2. Grease or butter a 13x9-in casserole dish
3. In a skillet over medium heat
4. Saute onions , garlic , mushrooms , seasoning salt and pepper for about 5 minutes , or until liquid is evaporated
5. Let cool slightly
6. Layer half of the potatoes in prepared baking dish
7. Sprinkle with all the grated parmesan cheese
8. Top with sausage , onion , mushroom and garlic mixture , then half of the cheese
9. Top with remaining potatoes
10. Sprinkle with remaining cheese
11. Pour the half and half cream and whipping cream over top
12. You can top with more shredded cheese or parmesan cheese if desired before baking
13. Cover , and bake for 30 minutes
14. Remove from oven and uncover , using spatula , gently press potatoes down into the cream
15. Return to oven and bake for another 25-35 minutes pressing potatoes down once , or until the potatoes are tender and golden brown and bubbly
16. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving

title: pennsylvania dutch shoofly pie
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , stir together the flour and sugar
2. Cut in butter til crumbly
3. I just add it cut up , then use my fingers , pinching and tossing to keep coated
4. In seperate bowl , add molasses , soda and cinnamon , and slowly pour in boiling water
5. Beat til mixture is foamy
6. Stir half of the crumb mixture into the molasses mixture
7. Pour into pie shell
8. Sprinkle top with remaining crumb mixture
9. Bake in 350 oven 30-40 minutes til pie is set / firm , bubbly and lightly browned
10. Cool til warm , and serve topped with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream if desired

title: dark cocoa buttermilk cake with chocolate cream cheese frosting
steps:
1. Cake:
2. Lightly grease bottoms of two 8x1-1 / 2-inch round cake pans
3. Line bottoms of pans with waxed paper
4. Grease and lightly flour bottoms and sides of pans
5. Set pans aside
6. Preheat oven to 350 degree f
7. In a medium mixing bowl , stir together the flour , cocoa powder , baking soda , baking powder , and salt
8. Set aside
9. In a large mixing bowl , beat butter with an electric mixer on medium to high speed for 30 seconds
10. In a small bowl , combine granulated and brown sugar
11. Gradually add sugar mixture , about 1 / 4 cup at a time , beating on medium speed until well combined
12. Scrape sides of bowl
13. Continue beating on medium speed for 2 minutes
14. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
15. Beat in vanilla
16. Add flour mixture and buttermilk alternately to beaten mixture , beating on low speed just until combined after each addition
17. Beat on medium to high speed for 20 seconds more
18. Spread batter evenly into the prepared pans
19. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until a wooden toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
20. Cool cake layers in pans for 10 minutes on wire rack
21. Remove from pans
22. Peel off waxed paper
23. Cool thoroughly on wire racks
24. Frosting:
25. Place the cream cheese and butter in a large mixing bowl
26. Blend with an electric mixer on low speed until combined , 30 seconds
27. Stop the machine
28. Add the cocoa powder , extract , and confectioners' sugar and blend with the mixer on low speed until the ingredients are moistened , 30 seconds
29. Increase the speed to medium and beat until the frosting is fluffy , 2 minutes more
30. Use at once to frost your cake or cover and keep refrigerated till you are ready to frost
31. Enjoy !

title: khmer beef
steps:
1. Slice the beef as thinly as possible
2. I recommend freezing briefly before slicing
3. The colder the easier to thin slice
4. Heat oil on med-hi heat
5. Brown beef in wok for 1 minute
6. Slice 4 very thin pieces of the fresh pear and set aside for garnish
7. Add pear , scallions , garlic , soy sauce , honey , curry , and sesame seeds
8. Stir-fry until golden , about 2-3 minutes or until fresh pear is soft
9. Garnish with pear and serve with steamed basmati rice

title: mom s tater tots casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In medium skillet over medium heat , saut celery and onion in butter
3. Pour into large bowl and set aside
4. In skillet , brown the beef
5. Add salt and pepper to taste
6. Combine meat with celery and onion mixture
7. Place 1 layer of tater tots in the bottom of a round casserole dish
8. Top with meat mixture
9. Add another layer of tater tots on top of the meat
10. In separate bowl , combine soup and milk
11. Pour soup mixture evenly over top of casserole
12. Bake at 350 for 1 hour
13. Cover with foil if tater tots get too brown

title: bunkhouse beef and pork stew
steps:
1. Cut steaks in 1 inches
2. Pieces
3. Mix flour , salt , and pepper
4. Toss steak in flour mix
5. Heat oil in lg dutch oven
6. Brown meat
7. Add remaining ingredients
8. Cover and simmer for about 2 hours , or until meat is tender and vegetables are done

title: grilled beef salad w corn salsa and chipotle dressing
steps:
1. For dressing:
2. Whisk first 4 ingredients in medium bowl in blend
3. Gradually whisk in oil
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. (can be made 1 day ahead
6. Cover and refrigerate
7. For salsa:
8. Blanch corn in large pot of boiling salted water 2 minutes
9. Drain
10. Cool
11. Cut corn from cob
12. Transfer corn kernels to large bowl
13. Add tomatoes , jicama , onion and cilantro and mix
14. For steak:
15. Combine first 4 ingredients in small bowl
16. Spread spice paste over both sides of steaks
17. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours or up to 6 hours
18. For assembly:
19. Prepare barbecue
20. Grill steaks to desired doneness , about 5 minutes per side for medium-rare
21. Transfer steaks to cutting board and let stand 5 minutes
22. Meanwhile , add avocado and 2 tablespoons dressing to salsa and mix
23. Season to taste with salt and pepper
24. Place greens in large bowl and toss with enough dressing to coat
25. Divide greens equally among 6 plates
26. Fan some mango slices on 1 side of each salad
27. Top each salad with 1 / 2 cup salsa
28. Thinly slice steaks crosswise
29. Arrange atop greens
30. Serve , passing remaining dressing separately

title: roast chicken chipotle nachos with cilantro avocado crema
steps:
1. In a 2 1 / 2 to 3 quart pan over medium high heat frequently stir onion in olive oil until onion begins to brown 4 to 7 minutes
2. Add cumin and oregano stir until fragrant bout 30 seconds
3. Add chiles , tomato paste , white wine , and 1 / 2 cup water , bring to a boil , then reduce heat and simmer gently , stirring often , to blend favors about 5 minutes
4. Add chicken and stir until hot
5. Meanwhile arrange tortilla chips in a single layer in a 12 by 17 inch pan
6. Sprinkle equal portions of cheese on each chip and spoon chicken mixture on top
7. Bake in a 450 degree regular oven until cheese begins to bubble about 3 minutes
8. With a spatula , carefully transfer tortilla chips to a platter
9. Top each with cilantro avocado crema
10. Mix all left over ingredients to make the cilantro avocado crema , except the sour cream / yogurt
11. Add last to chips and top each with a cilantro leaf

title: pecan blondies with browned butter frosting
steps:
1. Bars: heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a 13x9" baking pan
3. In large bowl , combine sugar , brown sugar and butter
4. Beat until light and fluffy
5. Add vanilla and eggs
6. Blend well
7. Add flour , baking powder , and salt
8. Mix well
9. Stir in pecans
10. Spread in greased pan
11. Bake for 23-33 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
12. Cool one hour or until completely cooled
13. Frosting: heat butter in medium saucepan over medium heat until light golden brown
14. Remove from heat
15. Stir in powdered sugar , vanilla , and enough milk for desired spreading consistency
16. Blend until smooth
17. Spread over cooled bars
18. Arrange pecan halves over frosting
19. Cut into bars

title: bread stuffing with mushrooms and bacon
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Spread bread cubes on 2 baking sheets
3. Bake until bread cubes are dry and crisp , stirring occasionally , about 25 minutes
4. Transfer bread to large bowl
5. Saute bacon in heavy skillet over medium-high heat until brown and crisp
6. Using slotted spoon , transfer bacon to paper towels and drain
7. Pour off all but 1 / 4 cup drippings from skillet
8. Add chopped leeks and celery to skillet and saute until tender and beginning to brown , about 10 minutes
9. Add mushrooms , sage , thyme , salt and pepper and saute until tender , about 10 minutes
10. Pour mushroom mixture over bread cubes
11. Add bacon and toss to blend
12. Mix in 2 cups broth
13. (stuffing can be prepared 1 day ahead
14. Cover and refrigerate
15. Preheat oven to 350f
16. Butter 13x9x2" glass baking dish
17. Beat eggs and baking powder in small bowl to blend
18. Mix eggs into stuffing
19. Moisten stuffing with more broth if stuffing is dry
20. Transfer to prepared baking dish
21. Bake stuffing until cooked through and golden brown on top , about 1 hour

title: caribbean banana treat
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 300f
2. Oil a 1 1 / 2 quart mold
3. Combine the lemon and orange zests , lemon and orange juices , ginger , and banana
4. Set aside
5. Place the eggs , brown sugar and pineapple juice in a food processor and pulse until blended
6. Add the milk and ground nuts and pulse a few more times
7. Spoon the nut mixture over the banana mixture
8. Add the melted margarine and mix well
9. Pour into the prepared mold
10. Place the mold in a large pan , and pour enough boiling water into the pan to reach halfway up the sides of the mold
11. Bake until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean , about 80 minutes
12. Cool 20 to 30 minutes
13. Unmold
14. Refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving

title: homesteader cider brined pork chops w  pan gravy forevermama
steps:
1. Brine:
2. Place black peppercorns in a plastic zip-top bag and seal
3. With a meat mallet , crush peppercorns slightly
4. In a large bowl , whisk together the cider and salt until the salt dissolves
5. Place the brine in a large zip-top bag
6. If using 2 bags , add to each bag half the peppercorns , 1 bay leaf , and 3 garlic cloves
7. If using 1 large bag add the full amount of the peppercorns , bay leaf and garlic
8. Mix to incorporate seasonings evenly
9. Place chops evenly in bag , seal and place in the refrigerator for 4 hours or brine overnight
10. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
11. Set oven rack to the middle position
12. Drain the chops well and discard brine , blot dry if desired
13. Remove the whole peppercorns that are stuck to chops and discard
14. In a large skillet over medium-high heat , melt the butter and depending on the size of your skillet , add 2 to 3 pork chops
15. Cook until browned on each side , 3 - 5 minutes
16. Turn the chops and cook until browned on the other side , 3 - 4 minutes more
17. Repeat with remaining chops
18. Set the skillet aside and do not drain off butter and brown bits in the skillet
19. Layer the chops in a 9 x 13 inch baking dish and bake until pale pink in the center for 15 - 20 minutes , being careful not to overcook to prevent them from drying
20. While pork chops are in the oven or before placing chops in oven , prepare your sauce:
21. Return skillet to medium-high heat and add the cider
22. As it bubbles , use a wooden spoon to scrape up brown bits on the bottom of skillet
23. Add the chicken broth , turn the heat to high , and boil until the liquid is reduced to about 1 cup , 8 - 10 minutes
24. Remove from heat and stir in cream and mustard
25. Season with salt and freshly grated black pepper to taste
26. Once chops have completed cooking , remove from oven and place in serving tray
27. Pour sauce over the chops and serve immediately
28. Also depending on the thickness of your chops , keep a close eye on the cooking time

title: south african ginger cookies
steps:
1. Mix the golden syrup , butter , eggs , vinegar , ginger , cinnamon and cloves in a large mixing bowl
2. Stir in the sugar
3. Sift the flour , baking soda and salt into a bowl
4. Mix into the syrup-sugar mixture to make a dough or batter
5. Cover and put in fridge for a few hours
6. Heat oven to 200 deg c / 400 deg f
7. Grease baking tins
8. Roll the dough between your palms into little balls the size of walnuts
9. Place these balls with space between them on greased baking tins
10. Press each cookie just slightly flatter with the tines of a fork
11. Bake about 12 - 15 mins or until nicely browned , in centre of oven
12. Cool slightly in the tins , then cool completely on wire racks
13. Keep in airtight tins
14. About 15 doz cookies

title: sicily knows best  eggplant stew with honey   golden raisin
steps:
1. Place the dried mushrooms and 2 cups of the stock in a small pot over medium-low heat
2. Heat the evoo in a dutch oven or high-sided skillet over medium to medium-high heat
3. Add the garlic , red pepper flakes , onions , carrots , cubanelle and bell peppers , and eggplant to the pot as you chop them
4. Season with salt and pepper and cover the pot
5. Sweat the vegetables for 10-12 minutes , stirring occasionally , then uncover and stir in the balsamic vinegar
6. Use a slotted spoon to scoop the reconstituted dried mushrooms out of the soaking water , and add them to the pot
7. Pour in all but the last few tablespoons of mushroom stock , which may have a little loose grit from the dried mushrooms
8. Add the tomatoes to the pot and break up with a wooden spoon
9. Simmer over low heat for a few more minutes
10. Adjust with salt and pepper
11. While the veggies are sweating down , in a medium saucepan slowly heat the remaining 2 cups of stock with the milk , raisins , and rosemary over medium-high heat
12. When it just simmers , whisk in the polenta and stir for 3 minutes , or until thickened
13. Remove from the heat and stir in the honey , butter , and cheese
14. Pile some polenta in shallow bowls and spoon the stew around the polenta

title: chocolate andes mint cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine flour , cocoa , baking soda , and salt in a small bowl
3. Set aside
4. Cream butter , shortening , granulated sugar , and brown sugar in a large mixing bowl
5. Add vanilla extract and eggs , beating well
6. Switch from an electric mixer to a sturdy spoon , and gradually mix in the flour mixture
7. Stir in mint chips
8. The dough will be very stiff
9. Drop by well-rounded teaspoons onto parchment-lined baking sheets
10. Bake for 10 minutes , until centers are set
11. Remove immediately to wire racks to cool completely

title: crisp romaine with parmesan dressing
steps:
1. Whisk together the cheese , lemon juice , oregano , garlic , salt and pepper in a bowl
2. Add the oil slowly while whisking until blended
3. Drizzle the dressing over the lettuce and toss to coat

title: beer barbecue sauce
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , except garlic , in saucepan and simmer 30 minutes over medium heat
2. Add minced garlic before using
3. Baste meat during last 15 minutes of grilling time

title: champurrado  mexican hot chocolate
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , combine 8 cups of the water and cinnamon
2. Bring to a boil
3. Place the remaining water and masa harina in a blender
4. Cover and blend until smooth
5. Pour the mixture through a fine mesh sieve into the cinnamon-water mixture
6. Bring to a boil , reduce heat to low
7. Cook , stirring constantly with wire whisk for 6 to 7 minutes or until thickened
8. Stir in sugar , chocolate and vanilla extract
9. Cook , stirring frequently , for 4 to 5 minutes or until chocolate is melted and flavors well blended

title: beany melts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200
2. C
3. Combine beans , vegetables & sweet chilli sauce in a bowl
4. Arrange muffin halves on a baking tray & spoon bean mixture evenly on top of muffins
5. Sprinkle each muffin with some cheese and a little black pepper
6. Bake for approx 15 mins or until heated through & cheese is golden
7. Alternatively you could do this under the griller just toast your muffins or foccaccias first , top with ingredients & grill on low

title: asian prawn omelette
steps:
1. Lightly combine eggs , sesame oil , soy sauce , garlic and ginger
2. Heat a medium frypan to hot and add the vegetable oil
3. Add the egg mixture and give it a few good stirs to move the set mixture of the base
4. When almost set , arrange the prawns down the middle
5. Remove from the heat and then add the herbs and the sprouts
6. Fold the omelette and slide on to a serving plate
7. Combine the oyster and the soy sauce and drizzle it over the omelette

title: chocolate chip blond brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Melt butter , add brown sugar , egg and vanilla
3. Mix well
4. Add remaining'dry' ingredients
5. Spread in a well-greased an 8 or 9 inch pan
6. Bake at 350 for 30- 40 minutes

title: sour cream substitute for tacos
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in food processor until smooth
2. Serve over tacos or any other mexican type dish
3. Probably would be good over baked potatoes or chili also

title: clam pasta with garlic   white wine   australia
steps:
1. Boil some water in a large pot for the pasta and cook the pasta according to instructions on package
2. Have it ready around the same time as the clams or just a bit before
3. Soak the clams in a bowl of cold water for about 10 minutes , drain and rinse under cold running water
4. Heat the oil and butter over a medium heat in a large , heavy-based pot and add the onion and fry for 2-3 minutes , stirring occasionally , until translucent
5. Next add the garlic , chili flakes and salt and stir for about 20 seconds
6. Now add the chopped tomatoes and fry for about 7 minutes until their juice starts to evaporate
7. Turn the heat up to medium-high and add the clams to the pot and cover with a lid , after 2 - 3 minutes add the wine to the pot , cover again and shake the pot from side to side
8. Cook the clams for a further 5 minutes or until they open , then add the parsley and stir with a wooden spoon , cover and shake pot again
9. Drain the pasta and then pour the clam mixture on top , stir well and serve immediately

title: cheese borags  armenia
steps:
1. Mix the three cheeses with the egg
2. Set aside
3. Cover the phyllo dough with a piece of plastic wrap , then put a damp towel over the plastic wrap
4. This helps prevent drying
5. Take one sheet of phyllo and fold it in half
6. Brush the folded sheet with melted butter
7. Put a spoonful of the filling onto the lower right corner of the sheet
8. Now fold the sheet over the filling , from corner to corner , as if you were folding a flag
9. You should have a triangle
10. Fold again , and one more time
11. Trim off any excess dough
12. Repeat until you have used all the filling
13. Brush the top of each borag with melted butter , then bake at 350 degrees for 15 to 20 minutes , or until the borags turn a golden brown color
14. Serve hot

title: golfer s stew
steps:
1. Cut meat and vegetables in 1 1 / 2 inch chunks
2. Blend salt , sugar , tapioca and tomato juice
3. Pour tomato mixture over meat and vegetables in pan
4. Cover tightly in foil and bake 4-5 hours at 250

title: bryan s chocolate lamb chili
steps:
1. In a large pot , cook onions and ground lamb in olive oil over medium heat
2. When onions are soft and meat browned , season with red pepper flakes , basil , cumin , cinnamon , garlic , chili powder , dried oregano , cocoa powder , sugar , and bay leaf , and salt and pepper to taste
3. Saute for 1 or 2 minutes to allow flavors to blend and blossom
4. Stir in tomatoes and beans
5. Increase heat to bring soup to a boil
6. Reduce heat , and simmer for 15 minutes
7. Load into large bowls and garnish with your choice of toppings

title: apple streusel cheddar muffins
steps:
1. Cream together the butter , sugar , vanilla , cinnamon , nutmeg , salt , and baking powder
2. Beat in the eggs
3. Stir in the apple , cheese , and walnuts , then the flour until just combined
4. Mix streusel ingredients together in a small bowl
5. Preheat oven to 350f
6. Grease the cups of a 12-cup muffin tin
7. Fill each cup about half-full
8. Sprinkle about one tbs of streusel mixture on top of each muffin
9. Fill the cups with the remaining batter
10. Sprinkle the remaining streusel atop the muffins
11. The streusel will spill off the muffins onto the pan
12. Dont be too finicky about trying to make it stick
13. Bake for 30 minutes , or until theyre golden brown
14. After removing from oven , cool breifly in the tins then finish cooling on a cooling rack

title: bed and breakfast  cottage cheese pancakes
steps:
1. Separate eggs
2. Beat whites till you have stiff peaks
3. Mix cottage cheese , flour , melted butter , and egg yolks into a slightly lumpy batter in a bowl
4. Fold in egg whites until incorporated
5. Pour in and coat pan with 1 tbls
6. Oil
7. Pour batter with 1 / 4 cup measuring cup onto a very hot greased griddle
8. Cook several minutes , until golden , then turn over and cook several more minutes until golden brown
9. Serve with maple syrup
10. Enjoy !
11. To make for a larger crowd , work in batches
12. They will keep warm on a platter in a 200 degree oven

title: prawn salad  pla gung
steps:
1. Bring water to a boil and add lemon grass , lime leaves and coriander
2. Boil for five minutes
3. Drop in prawns and cook 1 minute
4. Remove and rinse under cold water
5. Combine lime juice , palm sugar , garlic , ginger and black pepper in a bowl
6. Mix to dissolve sugar
7. Pour dressing over prawns and toss to coat
8. Add green onions and mint leaves , toss to mix

title: baked ham with pineapple
steps:
1. Place ham in roasting pan
2. Score the surface with shallow diagonal cuts , making diamond shapes
3. Insert cloves into diamonds
4. I like to use quite a few
5. Cover and bake at 325f for 1 1 / 2 hours
6. Longer if using an uncooked ham
7. Go according to package directions
8. Combine brown sugar and pineapple juice , pour over ham
9. Arrange pineapple and cherries on ham and secure with toothpicks
10. Bake , uncovered an additional 30-45 minutes or until a meat thermometer reads 140f

title: korma paste  jamie oliver
steps:
1. Place a frying pan on medium to high heat and add the cumin and coriander seeds to the dry pan
2. Lightly toast them for a few minutes until golden brown and fragrant
3. Remove pan from heat
4. Add toasted spices to a mortar and pestle and grind until fine , or put them into a food processor and whiz to a powder
5. Add ground spices to a food processor , if you havent done so already , with the remaining ingredients and process until you have a smooth paste

title: sugar free homemade lemonade
steps:
1. Stir together sugar and 1 / 2 cup boiling water until sugar dissolves
2. Stir in lemon rind , lemon juice , and 5 cups cold water
3. Pour into a 2 quart pitcher
4. Chill 8 hours
5. Serve over ice

title: the meatloaf with the sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees and grease a 9x12 pyrex dish
2. Place the eggs , tomato sauce , onion , celery , worcestershire , salt and pepper in blender and blend until smooth
3. Put meat , bread crumbs and blender mixture in a large bowl
4. Combine by hand until well incorporated
5. Press into baking dish , leaving a 1 / 2" moat around the meatloaf for the sauce
6. Combine sauce ingredients in the blender and pour over all over meatloaf
7. Bake for 50 minutes or until done

title: mimz s french onion soup
steps:
1. In a large saute' pan melt butter with olive oil and saute' onions until golden brown
2. Combine both broths and sherry in a large pot and bring to a boil
3. Combine sugar and flour and sprinkle over onions stirring to combine
4. Add onions to broth and simmer covered for 1 hour stirring occasionally salt and pepper to taste
5. Ladle soup into crocks and place a slice of bread and cheese on top
6. Bake in 350 oven for about 5 minutes until cheese is melted

title: turkey  bacon pasta salad with lemon basil dressing
steps:
1. Cook pasta as directed on package
2. Omitting salt
3. Rinse pasta in cold water
4. Drain
5. Mix together mayonnaise , basil , lemon peel and lemon juice in a large bowl to form dressing
6. Add pasta , bacon , turkey , lettuce , cheese and tomato to dressing
7. Mix well
8. Cover and refrigerate 1-2 hours to blend flavors
9. Sprinkle with reserved bacon
10. Serve

title: carmelized maple brussel sprouts and mushrooms
steps:
1. 1
2. ) saut mushrooms in skillet with olive oil , garlic , and himalayan salt over medium heat , about 3 minutes
3. 2
4. ) add the cashews and 3 tablespoons maple syrup
5. Continue to saut , about 3-5 minutes
6. 3
7. ) remove the mushroom and cashew toss from skillet and set aside
8. 4
9. ) in the same skillet , add tablespoons maple syrup and turn up to medium / high heat , and add in the brussels sprouts with himalayan salt to taste
10. 5
11. ) cook brussels sprouts for about 7 minutes , until they reach a golden brown
12. Stir occasionally , but be sure to allow them to golden by not stirring too often
13. 6
14. ) when brussels are finished , add them to the mushroom mixture and toss
15. 7
16. ) for a heartier meal , serve with quinoa

title: egg casserole
steps:
1. Saute mushrooms in butter and drain
2. Heat and stir until smooth:soup , cheese , mushrooms , scallions , sherry
3. Add sliced eggs
4. Bake for 45 minutes-1 hour
5. This can be put together the day before
6. Stays micely on a warming tray for a long time
7. Can be served by itself or put on toast
8. This has been served as christmas brunch in my family for many years

title: the mayflower inn shepherd s pie
steps:
1. In a large saucepan or casserole , cook the sirloin in the oil over moderate heat , stirring occasionally , until browned
2. Add the onions , carrots , and leek , and cook , stirring occasionally , for 5 minutes
3. Add the wine and simmer for 10 minutes
4. Add the mushrooms , herbs , and garlic and continue to cook for 5 minutes more
5. Add the veal stock , bring to a boil , and simmer , stirring occasionally , for 30 minutes
6. Correct seasoning , adding salt and pepper to taste
7. Add one can or jar of beef gravy to mixture
8. Meanwhile , in a saucepan , combine the potatoes with water to cover by 2 inches and salt to taste
9. Bring to a boil and simmer , covered , for 20 to 25 minutes , or until tender
10. Drain the potatoes and put them through a ricer or food mill
11. Add the sour cream , butter , and salt and pepper and stir until combined well
12. Preheat the oven to 350f
13. Transfer the meat mixture to a shallow baking dish
14. Transfer potatoes to a pastry bag fitted with a large
15. Bake for 30 minutes , or until potatoes are golden

title: creamy taco casserole
steps:
1. Brown the ground beef with the onions and garlic
2. When all the pink is out of the meat add the seasoning mix , water , cream cheese , corn , 1 / 2 the olives and taco sauce
3. Let this simmer for 3 to 4 minutes
4. Crush the fritos chips
5. In an 8x12 casserole dish , layer 1 / 2 of the fritos , then 1 / 2 the meat filling , and then 1 / 2 the cheese
6. Repeat the layers and top with the remaining olives
7. Bake at 375 for 20-25 minutes , or until it is warmed completely and the cheese is melted
8. To serve , you can top with shredded lettuce , the diced green onions , diced tomatoes and a shot of the sour cream

title: icebox dinner rolls
steps:
1. Combine shortening , sugar , and 1 cup of the water in a medium saucepan
2. Put over low heat , just until shortening and sugar are dissolved
3. Remove from stove , and allow to cool to at least 110 degrees
4. Combine second cup of water - heated to about 110 degrees - with yeast in a small bowl , and stir until dissolved
5. Combine flour and salt in medium bowl
6. In a large bowl , beat eggs slightly , then add cooled shortening mixture , yeast mixture , and flour mixture , beating well after each addition
7. Do not add more flour
8. Cover bowl tightly and set into refrigerator overnight
9. Take out rolls as needed - but dough may be stored in refrigerator for 2 weeks
10. When ready to bake rolls , spray muffin tins with cooking oil
11. Take dough out of refrigerator
12. Flour your hands , and make small balls of dough by rolling in your hands
13. Balls should be about 1 inch in diameter or slightly larger
14. Place 3 balls of dough into each muffin tin space
15. Then cover entire pan with a lightweight dish towel , and place in a warm place for 1 hour to rise
16. Then , turn off , and keep door closed with oven light on
17. Then place covered roll pans into oven for 1 hour
18. Remove risen rolls from oven
19. Turn oven to 350 , and when at temperature , bake rolls for about 15 minutes , or until golden brown
20. When rolls are done , take out of muffin tins and place on baking rack to cool
21. Brush tops with melted butter or margarine
22. Serve immediately , or freeze until needed
23. These can be stored in ziploc bags and frozen , but be sure that rolls have cooled completely before placing in bags
24. When ready to serve frozen rolls , let them come to room temperature , and then microwave to warm up

title: round steak on foil
steps:
1. Place 1 / 2 package soup mix on foil
2. Place round steak on top of this
3. Sprinkle rest of soup mix on top of round steak
4. Seal foil completely over round steak , all around the edges too
5. Bake in 350 degree oven for 2 hours
6. Add mushrooms over top when serving if desired

title: 7 up chicken in crock pot
steps:
1. Place chicken in bottom of crock pot
2. Add butter
3. Mix 7-up with salt and parsley
4. Pour over top
5. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours

title: super spritz cookies
steps:
1. 1
2. With an electric mixer at high speed cream butter until soft
3. 2
4. Add sugar gradually , continuing to cream about 5 minutes until light and fluffy
5. 3
6. Add egg yolks one at a time
7. Add vanilla
8. Beat well
9. 4
10. Add flour in three additions
11. Mix well after each addition
12. Dough will be stiff
13. 5
14. Shape dough into 2 rolls
15. Wrap in plastic wrap
16. Refrigerate at least one hour
17. 6
18. Assemble gun
19. Fill with cookie dough
20. 7
21. Bake 7-10 minutes until just starting to turn light brown around the edges , being careful not to overbake

title: baked scallops with mushrooms
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. In a large heavy bottom frying pan , melt 1 / 4 cup of butter
3. Add green pepper and onion and saut over medium heat for 3 minutes
4. Add sliced mushrooms and cook for 3 minutes
5. Add 2 tablespoons butter to pan and sprinkle in flour , salt and lemon pepper
6. Mix well and cook on low heat for 3 more minutes , stirring constantly
7. Remove from heat , add half and half cream , cheese , paprika and nutmeg and stir to mix
8. Return to heat and on medium-high heat return to boiling , stirring constantly
9. Reduce heat to low and cook until mixture is thick and smooth stirring frequently
10. Remove from heat , stir in scallops and wine
11. Spoon mixture into buttered scallop shells or buttered baking dishes , about 1 cup size
12. In a small bowl , mix together bread crumbs with italian seasoning mix and 2 tablespoons of melted butter
13. Sprinkle bread crumb mixture over scallop mixture in each dish
14. Bake in preheated 450f oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until bubbling and lightly browned on top
15. Serve immediately
16. If scallops are large , cut into smaller chunks before adding to mixture

title: moroccan lamb tagine
steps:
1. Preheat oven to gas mark 7
2. Cut meat from lamb shoulder in 4cm cubes
3. Mix together marsala , tumeric , coriander , ginger , salt
4. Rub half of this mixture into the meat
5. Put meat in pot to brown
6. Add sliced onions , tomatoes and garlic and some more spice
7. Allow to brown
8. Add saffron and water , stir for 3 4 min , add remaining spice
9. Add dices sweet potato and 1 tin plum tomatoes in sauce , break up tomatoes slightly in pot
10. Leave to simmer for 3 - 4 min
11. Add 2 tsp cinnamon , nuts and a generous squeeze of honey , stir together
12. Transfer to oven proof dish no lid
13. Place in oven for 15 min then drop temperature to gas mark 3
14. Cook for another 1hr
15. Add sliced green beans and return to oven for another 30 minute
16. To serve:
17. 1 cup of cous cous pour into bowl and just cover with boiling water , cover bowl with sideplate and allow to stand 3 4 minute
18. Sweet nutty butternut - 1 butternut , diced and boiled
19. Chop up more of the nuts you used in the tagine , add butter , salt , pepper and cinnamon to small frying pan cook for 2 - 3 min , add tsp cinnamon and generous squeeze of honey , stir until it boils
20. Pour over cooked butternut and serve immediately
21. 2 tbsp greek yoghurt per person , mixed with finely chopped mint
22. Roughly chopped coriander leaves to finish

title: moms pizza spaghetti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Beat milk and eggs together , and toss with the spaghetti
3. Spread spaghetti mixture in the bottom of a greased high-sided jelly roll pan or 11x18 roasting pan
4. Top with spaghetti sauce
5. Arrange pepperoni in rows over the sauce , and sprinkle with the cheese
6. Bake for 30 minutes
7. Let stand for 5 minutes before cutting into squares with a sharp knife or pizza cutter

title: braised red onions
steps:
1. Cut the onions in half through the root then into slices cutting through the root again
2. Put them into a pan with the oil and cook gently for 7 minutes stirring occasionally , until they start to soften
3. Pour in the wine add the fennel seeds sugar salt and pepper
4. Partially cover with a lid and cook gently for approx 10 minutes
5. They should be tender and most of the liquid evaporated
6. Serve hot

title: creamless mushroom soup
steps:
1. Melt butter over medium-high heat in a large soup pot
2. Add carrots , onion , leek , and celery , and cook until tender , but not browned , about 10 minutes
3. Stir in the mushrooms and thyme , and cook until mushrooms have softened , about 5 minutes
4. Add stock and salt and pepper to taste and simmer , covered , for 30 minutes
5. Puree the soup in small batches in a food processor , or with an upright blender
6. Adjust seasonings , and serve in bowls with a sprinkle of parsley

title: easy no fail perfect fluffy basmati   texmati rice
steps:
1. If not using the texmati brand , then rinse rice , in colander under cold running water , until the water runs clear
2. In non-stick pot , place rice and water together
3. Let soak at least 30 minutes
4. Bring to a boil and then turn heat to lowest level
5. Cover pot with tight-fitting foil
6. Cook for 30 minutes
7. Turn off heat and let set for at least 20 minutes
8. Take off foil and enjoy

title: spicy soba noodles with chicken and peanut sauce
steps:
1. Shave carrot lengthwise into thin strips using a vegetable peeler
2. Combine 1 / 3 cup broth , peanut butter , ginger , soy sauce , honey , pepper , and garlic
3. Stir with a whisk until smooth
4. Place chicken in a large saucepan
5. Add 1 2 / 3 cups broth
6. Bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat , and simmer 4 minutes or until chicken is done
8. Remove from heat
9. Let stand 20 minutes
10. Drain
11. Cut chicken into 2-inch pieces
12. Combine carrot , peanut sauce , chicken , and noodles in a large bowl
13. Toss to coat
14. Sprinkle with onions and peanuts

title: raspberry lemonade coolers
steps:
1. Mash berries in large bowl
2. Add vodka
3. Cover and cihll overnight
4. Strain , pressing on solids to relase liquid
5. Place lemon pieces and sugar in large pitcher
6. Mash lemons with large wooden spoon to release juices
7. Add lemonade and raspberry vodka
8. Stir to blend
9. Add ice cubes to pitcher and stir well
10. Divide lemonade , mashed lemons , and ice among 8 glasses
11. Serve

title: crispy potato and carrot casserole
steps:
1. Mix grated potatoes , carrots and onions in a large bowl
2. Stir in skim milk powder , oats , eggs , oil , garlic powder , salt and pepper
3. Heat oven to 350f
4. Lightly grease a 13x9 pan
5. Spread mixture evenly into the pan
6. Bake about 30-40 minutes or until potatoes are done
7. Sprinkle with cheese
8. Return to oven for a few minutes to melt cheese
9. 6

title: german pancake with buttermilk sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Grease a 9x13 inch baking pan with the melted butter
3. Place eggs , milk and flour in a blender and whip until smooth
4. Pour into prepared pan
5. Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes , or until golden
6. In a small saucepan , combine sugar , buttermilk , butter , corn syrup , baking soda
7. Boil for 7 minutes
8. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla
9. Spoon over slices of pancake

title: sarah s fabulous summer pasta salad
steps:
1. Put pasta on to boil
2. Halve tomatoes
3. Place tomatoes in large bowl with all other remaining ingredients , stir well , cover and leave
4. When pasta is al dente , drain , and then add to tomato mixture
5. The warm pasta will semi-cook the basil and garlic , releasing its flavour
6. Serve immediately , with crusty italian bread and a nice glass of red wine

title: apple bread pudding  pampered chef
steps:
1. Cube bread and toss with melted butter
2. Set aside
3. Preheat oven to 350 and spray 9x9 baking dish with non-stick cooking spray
4. Slice apples thinly and evenly layer 1 / 2 of the apples in bottom of prepared dish
5. Top apples with 1 / 2 of the bread cubes , making sure to layer as evenly as possible
6. Pour 1 / 2 of the jar of caramel sauce over the bread and repeat the layers with remaining ingredients
7. Bake for 30 minutes
8. Serve warm

title: southwestern pinwheels
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine cream cheese , shredded cheese , scallion , salsa , cilantro and cumin and mix well
2. Spread mixture evenly over the two flour tortillas- be sure to reach to the ends
3. Place a single layer of the baby spinach leaves evenly over the crem cheese mixture
4. Roll the tortillas tightly
5. This step is important and will give the"pinwheel" look to your appetizers
6. Wrap each roll in plastic wrap , and chill for at least an hour , or up to 8 hours
7. After rolls are chilled , unwrap and cut each one in half
8. Begin from the smooth half , and cut roll into 1 inch circles
9. You should get 4 to 5 circles from each tortilla half depending on how well you tortilla"ends" hold together
10. Arrange your pinwheels cut side up on your serving platter
11. Cover and chill for up to one hour before serving

title: seared lemon chicken
steps:
1. Place the chicken breasts side by side in a shallow dish
2. Mix together the lemon juice , garlic , honey , balsamic vinegar , 1 tablespoon olive oil and 1 tablespoon chopped parsley and pour over the chicken
3. Turn the breasts over until well coated and the marinate in the fridge for 30 minutes
4. Brush a non stick griddle or skillet / fry pan with the remaining oil and heat until very hot
5. Lift the chicken breasts from the dish and and put them in the pan / griddle and sear quickly for 1 to 2 minutes on each side until the chicken browns , lower the heat and add the reserved marinade cook for about 10 minutes or until the chicken is done , turning the breasts once or twice
6. Once cooked transfer to serving plate and cover each with an equal amount of the zest and the remaining parsley
7. Cut the lemon into wedges and serve with the chicken
8. Suggested you accompany with rice and steam vegetables

title: hot   creamy swiss almond spread
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine all ingredients
3. Mix well
4. Spoon mixture into a deep 2 cup oven proof casserole dish
5. Bake 15 minutes , stirring after 8 minutes
6. Garnish with toasted sliced alomnds if desired
7. Serve warm with vegetables , crackers , breadsticks

title: dump it in rhubarb cake
steps:
1. Spread rhubarb in an 9x13 pan
2. Sprinkle with sugar and dry jello powder
3. Sprinkle dry cake mix over sugar
4. Pour a cup of water evenly over mixture
5. Cover tightly with foil
6. Bake 350 f for 30 minutes or so until cake is done

title: turkey jambalaya
steps:
1. In a saut or frying pan , saut diced turkey meat in salt , black pepper and cayenne pepper until just warmed through
2. In a large pot , saut the onions , garlic , peppers and celery in oil until onions begin to turn transparent
3. In the same pot , add the tomato paste and let it brown a little
4. Once the vegetables are translucent deglaze the pan with the about 2 cups of the stock , scraping the bottom of the pan to mix up any browned bits , and stir until smooth , making sure the sauted vegetables , paste and stock are combined thoroughly
5. Add the remaining seasonings , tomatoes and salt to taste
6. Cook over low-medium heat for about 10 minutes
7. Add the turkey and cook another 10 minutes
8. Add the rest of the stock , and stir in the rice , combining thoroughly
9. Cook for about 20-25 minutes , or until the rice has absorbed all the liquid and is cooked through
10. Turn the heat down to low-medium and let the sauce thicken up a bit , with the pot uncovered , stirring frequently , for about 10 minutes
11. Stir thoroughly to combine all ingredients

title: baked polenta carrot casserole
steps:
1. In a pot combine vegetable broth and milk and bring to a boil
2. Turn off heat , stir in polenta and cook until thickened
3. Set aside to thicken further
4. Clean , wash and peel the carrots
5. Slice lenghtwise
6. Heat butter in a skillet and add carrots
7. Saute for some minutes , then add 5 tbs of water and cook covered on medium heat for another ten minutes until soft
8. Season with sugar , salt and pepper
9. Add sour cream or yoghurt , sage and half of the cheese to the polenta and stir to combine
10. Season with salt and pepper to taste
11. Pour into a casserole dish and top with the carrots
12. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and bake in the preheated oven at 200c for 20 minutes
13. Let stand for about 5 minutes until polenta has set and can be sliced

title: banana coconut pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven at 180c
2. Bake pie shell for 5-10 minute
3. Meanwhile , mix all other ingredients together
4. Pour into pie shell and bake for another 30-40 minutes , until filling has set
5. Enjoy !

title: cory schreiber s applesauce
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , combine the apple juice , orange juice , sugar , cloves , star anise , cinnamon and fennel
2. Bring to a boil , immediately reduce heat , and simmer for approximately 20 minutes to reduce the liquid by half
3. Strain the liquid into a heatproof bowl to remove the spices
4. Return the liquid to the pan and add the apples
5. Bring back to a boil then simmer for 15 minutes , or until the apples are tender
6. Remove from the heat and stir in the vanilla extract
7. Let cool
8. In a food processor , process the applesauce until smooth
9. Serve warm , or let cool and store in a covered container in the refrigerator for up to a week
10. For long-term storage , pack into freezer containers leaving 1" head space and freeze

title: shallot custard
steps:
1. Place oven rack in the middle position
2. Preheat oven to 350
3. Spray four 6-ounce ramekins with cooking spray
4. In a skillet , melt butter over medium heat
5. Add in shallots
6. Stir / saute until they are nicely browned
7. Set aside
8. In a bowl , light whisk the eggs with salt , pepper , and baking powder
9. Stir in cream and parmesan cheese
10. Fold in shallots
11. Set the prepared ramekins in a large baking pan lined with a dish towel
12. Ladle the mixture into ramekins and place the pan on the oven rack
13. Bake for about 30 minutes or until firm to touch and slightly browned
14. Remove from oven and serve at once

title: chinese orange almond cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Lightly butter 2 cookie sheets
3. Place butter and sugar in mixter bowl and beat until light and fluffy
4. Add 1 egg and continue beating until completely blended
5. Sift flour , baking soda and salt onto sheet of waxed paper and gradually mix in butter mixture
6. Add chopped almonds , orange zest , and vanill and mix just until blended
7. Drop dough by rounded teaspoon 1 inch apart onto prepared cookie sheets
8. Dip thumb in flour and make indentation in center of each cookie
9. Beat remaining egg and lightly brush over each cookie , using pastry brush
10. Place whole almond in each indentation
11. Bake until cookies are puffed and edges are golden brown , about 12 minutes
12. Let cool slightly on cookie sheets , then remove to wire racks to cool completely
13. Store in airtight container

title: mom s cole slaw dressing
steps:
1. Mix the dressing - and let it sit a while
2. Keep separate from the cabbage and mix as you need it
3. Mixes with 4c shredded cabbage

title: chicken noodle chicken
steps:
1. Place chicken pieces in a casserole pot
2. Sprinkle over the top the chicken noodle soup
3. Add whatever vegies are handy
4. Pour over enough water to cover the chicken pieces
5. Bake until the chicken noodle soup has reduced and the chicken pieces are cooked
6. Usually about 45mins- 1 hour depending on the size of the pieces

title: chicken  basil  prosciutto and goat cheese roulade with a lemon
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Place the chicken between plastic sheets or preferably silpats and pound with a heavy skillet to 1 / 4 inch thickness
3. I like to do this with a large value pack and freeze the extras , individually , after sealing with the foodsaver
4. This way i have this done for the next few times i want this recipe or a chicken cordon blue
5. Place the chicken breasts on a sheet pan laid out flat
6. Have toothpicks ready on the pan to hold them shut
7. On a separate plate , lay out the 4 pieces of prosciutto , basil leaves and with a small ice cream scoop dish out 4-1 oz scoops of goat cheese
8. First place the prosciutto on each breast , then put the goat cheese on the prosciutto then put the basil leaves on the cheese and press down to spread out evenly
9. Roll the chicken breasts up and put a tooth pick in to hold
10. In a heavy sauce pan , melt 2 tbs butter
11. Add the garlic and cook until soft
12. Add the white wine and 1-1 / 4 cup chicken broth
13. Bring to a boil and reduce until half
14. While the sauce is reducing , heat on medium high 1 tbs olive oil and 1 tbs butter in an oven proof skillet
15. Add the chicken rolls
16. Braise the chicken on all sides , then add 1 / 2 cup chicken broth to the pan and place in the oven
17. The extra broth helps to keep the chicken moist while it is cooking through in the oven
18. Once the chicken is cooked though , remove from the oven and place on a plate and cover loosely with aluminum foil
19. Pour the contents of the skillet into the sauce and sauce and stir
20. Add the creme fraiche and the the tarragon and lemon and stir
21. Place a small ladle full of sauce on a plate and put the chicken roll in it
22. Serve with a rice dish and steamed vegetables

title: the weizenheimer
steps:
1. Preheat a countertop griddle or frying pan to medium-high heat
2. Butter one side of all slices of bread and place on the grill , butter side down
3. Put an even amount of tillamook muenster on the slices of bread and place a pot lid over both slices to help the cheese melt
4. On the other side of the griddle , mix the kraut and onions and begin heating them
5. At the same time , grill the slices of ham
6. Once hot , transfer the ham onto half of the bread slices , and scoop the kraut and onions on top of the ham
7. If mustard is in a squirt bottle , squirt your desired amount over the kraut and onions
8. Once the cheese is melted and bread is browned , close the sandwich
9. Flip it over a few times , allowing the cheese to melt into the ingredients
10. When its done , pull it from the griddle , cut , and enjoy

title: irish potatoes  candy
steps:
1. Mix cream cheese , sugar , and butter
2. Mix in salt and vanilla
3. Add coconut and gradually add milk until is in rolling consistency
4. Form into balls
5. Put a small amount of cinnamon in the plastic bag and put 2 or 3 balls into the bag
6. Close the bag and shake a few times , make sure that he balls get covered with cinnamon
7. Add more cinnamon to the bag if needed
8. Take them out of the bag and add 2 ot 3 more , and repeat by shaking the bag until all the balls are done
9. Enjoy !

title: venison speedie marinade
steps:
1. Mix first nine ingredients together
2. Pour over venison
3. Marinate overnight
4. Grill , broil or fry

title: blushing apple cake
steps:
1. Mix and sift flour 2 tablespoons sugar , baking powder and salt
2. Cream butter , add sifted ingredients and mix
3. Combine slightly beaten egg and milk and add to creamed mixture
4. Mix well
5. Press mixture onto bottom of greased 7" x 11" x 1-1 / 2" pan
6. Press apple slices into dough so they overlap
7. Prepare topping:
8. Place cherry gelatin in 8 ounce cup and fill cup with sugar
9. Cut butter into flour to make coarse crumbs
10. Combine crumb mix with gelatin mix
11. Sprinkle over apples
12. Bake in 350 degree f
13. Oven about 50 minutes

title: tarragon sauce
steps: 1. Blend mayonnaise , yogurt , shallot , tarragon , parsley , chives , dijon mustard , salt , pepper and lemon juice together

title: new england maple mustard scallops
steps:
1. Saut the bacon and pour off the fat
2. Cool and crumble
3. Set aside
4. Melt the butter in the same skillet over medium high heat
5. Briefly saut the scallops until heated through , about 3 minutes
6. Remove with a slotted spoon to a warm bowl
7. Add the half and half to the scallop liquid and boil the cream , stirring occasionally , until reduced to about cup
8. Keep an eye on the heat and lower to medium , maintaining a steady reduction
9. Add the mustard , maple syrup and pour in any juices collected in scallop bowl
10. Boil for another 3 to 4 minutes until reduced again to sauce consistency
11. Add the scallops and crumbled bacon to the sauce , toss quickly and serve immediately

title: potatoes and carrots baked in gravy
steps:
1. Mix gravy with water
2. Add cream of mushroom soup
3. Spray roasting pan with non stick spray
4. Place potatoes , carrots and onions on pan
5. Pour gravy mix over the above
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Bake covered 350 for 1 hour

title: paula deen s mexican pizza
steps:
1. Position the oven rack at the lowest level
2. If you have a pizza stone , place it in the oven on the rack
3. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees
4. Heat the oil in a small saucepan and cook the green pepper and mushrooms over medium heat until crisp-tender , about 2 minutes
5. Cut the crusts into biscuit sized pieces using a biscuit cutter
6. Distribute the vegetables evenly over the crusts
7. Reserve 1 cup of the salsa and spoon the remaining salsa evenly over the pizzas
8. If you don't have a pizza stone , place the pizzas on a baking sheet
9. They won't be as crisp this way , but this is a lot less messy than placing them directly on the rack
10. Bake the pizzas for 10 to 12 minutes in the preheated oven , then sprinkle with the cheese
11. Bake 7 minutes more
12. Serve the pizza slices topped with the reserved salsa , olives , cooked ham , shredded lettuce and sour cream
13. An italian style pizza uses tomato sauce and provolone cheese
14. A vegetarian style pizza simply omits the meat

title: mali lemon grass tea
steps:
1. Gently bruise - by pounding with a meat melt or rolling pin - the lemongrass
2. Bring the water to a boil and use to rinse and heat-up a teapot
3. Add the lemongrass and cover with the water
4. Allow to seep for a while then pour the tea into small cups and add a little sugar if desired

title: delicious dinner buns
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine 1 / 2 cup of warm milk with sugar and yeast
2. Let stand for about 10 minutes until frothy
3. In another bowl , combine the egg and remaining 1 / 2 cup of warm milk and the melted butter
4. In the bowl of a stand mixer with a dough hook , combine flour and salt
5. Add the yeast mixture and egg mixture to the flour
6. With the mixer on low speed , start mixing , then increase the speed as flour is incorporated
7. Continue to mix for another 2 minutes or until the dough comes together
8. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead for about 5 minutes , until the dough is smooth and elastic
9. Form dough into a ball and place into a lightly greased large bowl
10. Cover with plastic wrap
11. Leave overnight in the refrigerator or alternatley , let proof in a warm area until doubled in size for about 45 minutes
12. Punch dough down and turn out onto a very lightly floured surface
13. Tear off pieces of dough and form 14 to 16 - 1 1 / 2 inch balls
14. Roll them between your hands to make a smooth ball
15. Place the dough balls in a buttered 8" x 8" pan or an 8" round pan , so the dough balls are touching each other
16. Cover with plastic wrap and then with a damp cloth or towel and let rest in a warm area for about 40 minute or until doubled
17. Preheat oven to 350f
18. In a small bowl , whisk together the egg and milk to make an egg wash
19. Using a pastry brush , generously coat the top of the dough buns with the egg wash
20. Bake in preheated 350 f oven for about 18 to 20 minutes or until the top is golden brown
21. Pull apart at the dinner table and serve with butter

title: green beans german style
steps:
1. Place beans in saucepan and cover with water , bring to a boil
2. Cook , uncovered for 8 to 10 minutes , drain and set aside
3. In a skillet , cook bacon over medium heat until crisp
4. Remove to paper towel
5. Drain , reserving 1 tablespoon drippings
6. In the same skillet , saute onion on drippings until tender
7. In a small bowl , combine the cornstarch , mustard , and water until smooth
8. Stir in onion
9. Bring to a boil cook and stir for 1 to 2 minutes or until thickened
10. Stir in brown sugar and vinegar
11. Add the beans , heat through , top with bacon

title: mocha garlic chicken
steps:
1. Dust chicken pieces with garlic powder and place in a pan or cooking bag
2. Mix all other ingredients in a pot and bring to a boil
3. Pour this sauce over chicken pieces
4. Bake for 1-2 hours

title: pork chops smothered in cream of mushroom
steps:
1. Brown your pork chops in a skillet
2. Peel and slice the onion thinly
3. Preheat oven to 350f
4. Place browned pork chops in a baking dish , layer with the sliced onions
5. Top with mushrooms
6. Mix cream of mushroom soup with the evaporated milk
7. Pour over the top of the pork chops and onions
8. Bake in the oven for about 45 minutes
9. Serve hot

title: cajun shrimp and sausage gravy over biscuits
steps:
1. Sausage -- in a large saute pan cook the diced andouille on medium heat until cooked through
2. Don't cook it at too high of a temperature
3. You want to slowly saute it
4. Once it is done , remove to a plate lined with a paper towel to drain
5. Sauce -- in the same pan , pour out the drippings from the andouille and add the fresh olive oil and bring to medium high heat
6. Add in the onion , celery , red pepper and garlic and saute 3-4 minutes
7. Deglaze -- originally i used chicken broth because that is all i had
8. Now , i like to deglaze with white wine just to get all the bits up off the pan
9. Add the wine and scrape up the bits from the pan and cook just a minute , then remove from the heat and slowly add in the cream , hot sauce and the cajun seasoning and return to the heat on medium low cook until it reduces about 20-30 minutes
10. The cream will naturally thicken on it's own
11. Shrimp and sausage -- after the sauce has thickened , add the sausage back in as well as the shrimp and cook on medium heat until the shrimp begin to curl and turn pink
12. Add salt and pepper if needed according to your taste
13. Biscuits -- now i just used a canned biscuit , so i baked them according to directions , but if you want to make your own , by all means please do
14. Serving -- right before serving , add in the scallions and serve this decadent sauce over sliced biscuits
15. Cook up some of your favorite eggs and serve with some bloody mary's for a perfect brunch
16. This also would make a great lunch or dinner

title: pumpkin gingerbread bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Spray a 9" square pan with nonstick coating spray
3. Beat eggs with electric mixer at high speed 2 minutes
4. Add brown sugar 1 t at a time , beating well after each addition
5. Add pumpkin , molasses and vanilla
6. Beat at medium speed 12 minutes
7. Combine flour , baking powder , cinnamon and ginger , stir to blend
8. Add to pumpkin mixture
9. Stir well
10. Pour into prepared pan
11. Bake 20 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
12. Let cool 10 minutes in pan
13. Invert onto platter
14. Sprinkle with confectioner's sugar
15. Serve warm

title: zesty italian peasant bread appetizer
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Place bread shell on lightly greased baking sheet
3. Mix together oil , garlic and pepper
4. Brush over bread shell
5. Sprinkle with tomato , cheese and snipped fresh or crushed dried herb
6. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes or till warm and cheese softens "slightly"
7. Cut bread into 12 wedges
8. If desired garnish with fresh herb sprigs
9. Serve hot

title: lemon pistachio biscotti
steps:
1. For the cookie ~ preheat oven to 375 degrees f & lightly grease several cookie sheets or 1 large one
2. In large mixing bowl , beat butter with electric mixer on medium-high speed for 30 seconds
3. Add sugar , baking powder & salt , beating to cimbine & scraping sides of bowl occasionally
4. Beat in eggs & vanilla until combined
5. Beat in lemon zest & as much of the flour as you can with the mixer
6. Using a wooden spoon or your hands , stir or knead in remaining flour & pistachio nuts
7. On lightly floured surface , divide dough into 3 equal portions
8. Shape each portion into an 8-inch-long loaf
9. Flatten loaves to about 2 1 / 2 inches wide , & place them at least 3 inches apart on prepared cookie sheet
10. Bake 20-25 minutes or until golden brown & tops are cracked
11. Cool on cookie sheet for 30 minutes ,
12. When cooled , preheat oven to 325 degrees f , then transfer loaves to a cutting board to cut each loaf into 1 / 2-inch-thick slices
13. Place slices , cut sides down on previously used cookie sheet , & bake 8 minutes
14. Turn slices over & bake 8-10 minutes more or until dry & crisp
15. Transfer to wire rack & cool
16. For the icing ~ in a small mixing bowl , stir together sifted powdered sugar & 1 teaspoon lemon zest
17. Stir in enough lemon juice to make icing of drizzling consistency
18. Either dip 1 / 4 of one end of each cookie into icing or drizzle each with icing

title: french silk fudge
steps:
1. Butter an 8-by-11-inch baking pan and set aside
2. In a 2-quart glass bowl , mix the sugar and the evaporated milk
3. Microwave on high , uncovered , for 3 minutes
4. Remove from the microwave oven and stir
5. Microwave an additional 2 minutes , watching closely so that the mixture doesn't boil over
6. Meanwhile , cut the butter into four pieces and set aside
7. Remove the sugar mixture from the microwave and stir in the butter and marshmallows until both are melted
8. Add the chocolate chips , vanilla and nuts , and mix well
9. Spread into the buttered pan and chill for at least an hour , or until firm
10. Cut into small squares and store in tins or plastic storage bags in the refrigerator for up to five days

title: easy orange cherry marmalade
steps:
1. Drain and chop cherries , set aside
2. In a saucepan over low heat , combine all other ingredients
3. Heat gently until mixture comes to a boil , approximately 10 - 15 minutes
4. Stir in cherries
5. Return to boil , then remove from heat and pour into prepared jars
6. If your jars do not seal , store in refrigerator

title: vegan truffles
steps:
1. Put cashews and cold water in a blender and blend at high speed for 1-2 minutes
2. Scrape the sides down and blend again until the mixture is the consistency of heavy cream
3. Meanwhile , in a double boiler heat the chocolate until it's all melted
4. Cool the chocolate until it's comfortable to work with and fold in the cashew cream
5. Cool in the fridge for 2 hours
6. Take out a small ball , roll in cocoa powder and store in fridge / freezer
7. Repeat until done

title: mushroom fondue sauce
steps:
1. Melt butter in saucepan
2. Add flour , mixing well
3. Add remaining ingredients and cook over medium heat until thick

title: food safari s tandoori chicken
steps:
1. In a large bowl , add yoghurt , ginger , garlic , tandoori paste , food colour , cumin , coriander , garam masala , salt , chilli and turmeric bowl and mix well
2. Once completely mixed , rub mixture into chicken covering all the chicken
3. Seal chicken in the bowl with cling wrap or zip lock bag and marinate in the fridge for at least 2 hours or up to two days
4. Pre-heat the oven to it's highest setting and bake chicken for 20 minutes
5. After 20 minutes reduce the oven heat to 120oc / 248of and cook until tender
6. Serve with steam rice , salad and plain yoghurt

title: halloween or bonfire toffee
steps:
1. Heat the sugar and water in a saucepan until sugar is dissolved
2. Don't let it boil
3. Add all the other ingredients and stir until it bubbles and boils
4. Test to see if it's ready by dripping a teaspoon full into a cup of cold water
5. If it sets , it's ready !
6. Grease a flat tin with a thin layer of butter and pour in the mixture
7. Leave to set
8. When it's rock hard , shatter and enjoy !

title: wheat berry salad with red peppers  eggplant and zucchini
steps:
1. Place wheat berries in a medium bowl and fill with water
2. Cover and soak , in refrigerator overnight
3. Drain and place in a medium saucepan
4. Cover with water , and heat to a boil
5. Simmer , uncovered , until wheat berries are tender , about 1 hour
6. Meanwhile , preheat oven to 400f
7. Arrange eggplant , onion , zucchini , squash , and bell peppers in a single layer on a large baking sheet
8. Lightly brush vegetables with 1 tbls
9. Of the oil
10. Roast 20 minutes , turn over , and roast 10 minutes longer
11. Remove eggplant , zucchini , and squash and set aside
12. Continue to roast remaining vegetables until browned , about 15 minutes
13. Cool vegetables
14. Season with 1 / 8 teaspoons of the salt and pepper
15. Cut half of the vegetables into 1 / 2" pieces
16. In a large bowl , whisk vinegar , parsley , oregano , garlic , remaining 3 tbls
17. Oil , and remaining 1 / 8 teaspoons salt and pepper
18. Add wheat berries and cut up veggies
19. Toss to coat
20. Spoon onto serving platter
21. Arrange remaining vegetables around edges
22. Garnish with parsley and oregano
23. Enjoy !

title: crispy chicken fingers
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , mix dry ingredients
2. In a medium bowl beat egg and buttermilk
3. Coat chicken with flour mixture , dip into egg mixture and coat again with the flour mixture
4. In a large skillet , heat oil over medium heat
5. Add chicken
6. Cook uncovered for 5 minutes
7. Turn chicken
8. And cook 3 minutes longer or until no longer pink in the center and golden brown

title: roasted chicken with blueberry peppercorn sauce
steps:
1. Cut the roasted chicken into quarters
2. In a warmed saucepan , add the sugar and stir until it melts
3. Add the wine , chicken stock , vinegar , peppercorns and blueberries
4. Increase the heat to medium high and reduce the sauce by half
5. Whisk in the butter to thicken the sauce , taking care not to let it come to the boil
6. Season with salt to taste
7. Arrange quartered chicken on serving plates and top with sauce

title: homegirls special oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Mix shortening and sugar
2. Mix eggs , salt , vanilla , and beat until fluffy
3. Dissolve soda in boiling water , then mix into egg mixture
4. Add flour and oats
5. Mix in raisins
6. Drop onto greased cookie sheet
7. Bake at 350 10 minutes , do not over bake

title: strawberries and melon in plum wine
steps:
1. If the strawberries are large , cut in half lengthwise
2. Add the sugar and let them sit for 1 hour at room temperature
3. If your berries are particularly sweet , reduce the sugar by half
4. Place the strawberries in a serving bowl and add the melon
5. Add the plum wine and stir gently to mix
6. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour
7. Spoon fruit and sauce into bowls and serve

title: instant pudding biscuits  cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar , add egg and instant pudding
2. Beat well , add sifted flour and baking powder
3. Roll into small balls , flatten with fork on a cold greased tray
4. Bake 180c degrees for 15-20 minutes
5. You may add sultanas , cherries or nuts if wished
6. Ice if desired

title: tangy cranberry bbq sauce
steps:
1. Combine wet ingredients in a sauce pan over med-high heat
2. Add the garlic , rosemary , white pepper
3. Bring to a boil
4. Simmer 20 minutes
5. Remove from stove and add to blender
6. Blend until smooth
7. Good to use immediately but the flavors settle wonderfully overnight , can keep covered in the refrigerator for a week

title: hearty carrot casserole
steps:
1. Boil 1 / 4" chopped carrot pieces for 5-6 minutes and drain
2. Place evenly in an 8x10" oblong baking dish sprayed with pam
3. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
4. Over medium low heat saute onion in butter until the onion becomes softened
5. Pour evenly over carrots in dish
6. Work the carrots until coated well on all sides
7. Chop velveeta into small cubes and sprinkle over carrots
8. I've tried shredded cheddar and cheese whiz , velveeta works best
9. Crush potato chips in a plastic bag and sprinkle over the top
10. Bake for 25-30 minutes until done

title: steak n shake chili
steps:
1. Brown ground beef along with salt in oil
2. Drain meat and return to crockpot
3. Put soup in blender and blend for 1 minute
4. Add all other ingredients , including soup , to crockpot
5. Let simmer on low for 6 hours or on high for 2 hours

title: creamy lemon asparagus risotto
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large skillet on medium heat
2. Add onion
3. Cook and stir 2 minute or until tender
4. Stir in rice , asparagus and broth
5. Bring to boil
6. Reduce heat to low
7. Simmer 5 minute
8. Add cream cheese spread , lemon peel and juice
9. Stir until well blended

title: rocky road
steps:
1. Line a 30cm square tin with baking paper
2. Melt chocolate and copha in a heatproof bowl over gently boiling water and stir until smooth
3. Combine all other ingredients in another large bowl leaving aside 2 tblsp of coconut
4. Pour in melted chocolate and mix well
5. Pour completed mixture into the lined tin and spread
6. Sprinkle on the remaining coconut
7. Refrigerate then cut into chunky squares
8. Enjoy

title: dannygirl s parisienne potatoes
steps:
1. Combine potatoes and spices with half cup oil
2. Shake so all potatoes are coated
3. Let marinate in the fridge 4 hours
4. Heat oven to 350 degrees f
5. In glass baking dish , pour 2 tbsp olive and spread around bottom of dish
6. Spread marinated potatoes on bottom of dish in a single row
7. Bake 1 hour , flip potatoes half way through cooking

title: cumin   tahini yogurt dip
steps:
1. Pound the garlic and 1 tsp sea salt in a pestle and mortar until smooth
2. Transfer to a bowl and mix with the yoghurt , tahini , lemon juice and cumin
3. Add 30ml of water and stir till smooth then chill until required
4. Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with a little more cumin
5. Serve with pita bread

title: my mom s soft apple cake
steps:
1. Peel and slice apples
2. Toss with lemon juice so they don't turn brown
3. Beat eggs and sugar
4. Add oil and beat till smooth
5. Add dry ingredients and mix well
6. Spray a 9" x 13" pan , and pour in 1 / 2 the batter
7. Top with apples and cinnamon
8. Pour remaining batter on top
9. Spread it with a fork
10. Bake at 350-375f for 45 minutes , till light brown on top

title: platte county fair kraut burgers
steps:
1. Divide chuck into thirds
2. Then divide each third into half , and flatten them out into 6 patties
3. Place 1 / 3 cup sauerkraut on each of 3 patties
4. Top with the other 3 patties , being sure to seal well around the edges
5. Sprinkle with steak seasoning
6. Grill until done
7. Place each burger on a bun and top with mustard or your favorite topping

title: blueberries and pears for baby
steps:
1. Peel core and chop the pear
2. Put the fruit in a saucepan simmer for about 5 minutes
3. Puree in a blender , add the infant cereal at this point
4. Cool slightly and serve

title: stir soap
steps:
1. Dissolve 2 cans lye and 1 cup borax in 12 cups warm water
2. Let stand 1 hour until lukewarm
3. Pour 18 cups grease melted to lukewarm
4. Pour lard into lye solution slowly , stirring constantly
5. Add 1 / 2 cup ammonia
6. Stir until thoroughly mixed
7. Let stand
8. Cut while hard

title: roasted red pepper dressing
steps: 1. Blend all ingredients in blender or food processor till smooth

title: peasant pizza with goat cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Place italian bread shell on an ungreased baking sheet
3. Stir together the cream cheese , goat cheese or feta , garlic and black pepper in a small mixing bow
4. Spread mixture over the bread shell
5. Place the tomato slices and sweet pepper strips over the cheese mixture
6. Bake in the preheated oven about 12 minutes or till heated through
7. Sprinkle with fresh basil

title: chicken christopher
steps:
1. To make bread crumb mixture:
2. Combine all ingredients and set aside
3. To prepare the chicken:
4. Halve chicken breasts , pound each piece thin , less than 1 / 2 inch thick
5. Season pieces with salt and pepper
6. Beat eggs in a shallow bowl
7. Place alexander bread crumbs in another shallow plate or dish
8. Dip each chicken piece in flour , covering it completely , then in the egg , then in the alexander bread crumbs
9. Set aside on a platter
10. Time to start the sauce
11. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a large saut pan set over medium-high heat
12. Heat until butter foams
13. Lay 2 or 3 chicken pieces flat in the pan and cook until browned on both sides set aside cooked chicken while you brown the other pieces
14. Add remaining tablespoon butter , and more if needed
15. Keep butter in the pan as it gets soaked up per piece , so you do not want it to go dry
16. To make garlic butter sauce:
17. In a large saucepan set over medium heat , melt 1 tablespoon butter
18. Add shallots and garlic and cook until soft
19. Add wine
20. Increase heat to medium-high , bring wine to a boil and allow it to cook until only about 2 tablespoons of liquid remain in the pan
21. Add cream , lower heat to medium , and cook until liquid steams
22. Cook , stirring , for about 3 minutes
23. Do not let liquid boil
24. Set aside at this point if chicken is not quite done
