25. Reduce heat to low , and add the remaining butter , a little at a time
26. Use a wire whisk to whip the sauce and keep it smooth , making sure mixture is well-blended before adding more butter
27. When butter has been whipped in , add lemon juice , parsley , salt and pepper
28. Serve at once
29. To serve:
30. Set 2 pieces of chicken at one side of a plate
31. Place 1 serving pasta on the other side
32. Pour garlic butter sauce over all

title: chai spiced vanilla sugar
steps:
1. Combine all of the spices in a cast iron pan
2. Turn the heat to medium and stir the spices until you smell their beautiful oils filling the air
3. Remove spices from pan just as they start to crackle
4. Transfer to a mortar and pestle
5. Grind spices roughly , not worrying about getting it perfect , just break open the toasted spices
6. This will release an overwhelming smell of wonderfullness
7. Put the sugar in a large bowl and spritz / sprinkle the vanilla , stirring until the sugar is evenly light brown from the vanilla
8. It will combine if you stir it enough
9. Mix the spices with the vanilla sugar and leave the bowl uncovered overnight
10. The next day , the vanilla will be dry and sugar will have become like a hardened sand castle
11. Scrap at it and break it up until it is smooth
12. Cover the sugar bowl and leave overnight
13. The next day , sieve through a screen
14. Store your delicious chai vanilla spiced sugar in an airtight container
15. It will keep for several weeks
16. Great in earl gray tea , cinnamon buns , on toast with butter , you name it , it's great
17. Please enjoy !

title: martha stewart s cowboy cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray baking sheets with cooking spray , line with parchment , and spray parchment
3. Sift flour , baking soda , salt , and baking powder into medium bowl
4. Beat butter and sugars with mixer on medium-high until creamy , about 3 minutes
5. Reduce speed to medium and mix in the eggs , 1 at a time , beating well after each addition
6. Beat in vanilla
7. Reduce speed to low and gradually add the flour mixture
8. Beat until just incorporated
9. Beat in oats , chocolate , pecans and coconut
10. Drop dough onto baking sheets 3" apart
11. A 1 1 / 2" cookie scoop works well
12. Bake until edges of cookies begin to brown , 11-13 minutes
13. Transfer baking sheets to wire rack and cool 5 minutes
14. Transfer cookies to racks
15. Cool

title: pampered chef microwave white chicken chili
steps:
1. Using santoku knife , slice about 1 / 4 inches off the pointed top of garlic heads to expose cloves
2. Place garlic cut side up in classic batter bowl
3. Sprinkle garlic with 1 / 4 tsp of the salt and drizzle with 2 tbsp of the oil
4. Cover batter bowl with lid
5. Microwave on high 3 minutes or until garlic is soft
6. Set aside to cool
7. Meanwhile , finely dice peppers using santoku knife
8. Chop onion using food chopper
9. Combine peppers and onion in deep covered baker
10. Trim and finely dice chicken using boning knife
11. Add chicken , seasoning mix , remaining 1 tbsp oil and remaining 1 / 2 tsp salt to baker
12. Mix well using master scraper
13. Microwave , covered , on high 4 minutes
14. Stir to separate chicken
15. Cover
16. Microwave an additional 4-6 minutes or until chicken is cooked through
17. Meanwhile , gently squeeze cooled garlic from heads into batter bowl
18. Mash using mix n masher
19. Add beans and salsa to batter bowl
20. Transfer bean mixture to baker
21. Mix well
22. Microwave , covered , on high 5-7 minutes or until chili is heated through

title: chicken kathi roll
steps:
1. Marinate the chicken cubes with ginger , garlic and the green chilli pastes and salt for 30 minutes
2. Heat oil in a pan
3. Saute chicken cubes in it till done
4. Add cumin powder , chaat masala and check to see if the seasoning is right
5. Mix onion and carrot
6. Now start making the kathi rolls
7. For this , put 1 tsp
8. Of oil on a flat bottomed pan and lightly heat the rotis
9. Smear each roti with 1 tbsp
10. Of green chutney
11. Place 6-8 pieces of cooked chicken , sprinkle chopped green chillies and chopped corriander leaves
12. Spread a spoonful of onion and carrot mixture on the roti
13. Sprinkle salt
14. Roll the roti tightly over the stuffing
15. Serve

title: macadamia pesto
steps:
1. In a food processor , using a pulse action , chop the macadamias , basil , garlic and parmigiano until very finely minced
2. Pulse in the lemon juice , olive oil and add salt to taste
3. The mixture should be pureed , but retain some texture
4. Toss your favourite cooked pasta with the pesto
5. Top bruschetta with it
6. Dip crostini into it --

title: native grains hotcakes gift mix
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , stir together dry ingredients
2. In a separate bowl combine eggs , buttermilk , honey , and oil
3. Add egg mixture to flour mixture all at once
4. Stir just until blended but still slightly lumpy
5. For each hotcake , pour about 1 / 3 cup batter onto a hot , lightly greased griddle or heavy skillet
6. Cook over medium heat for 1 to 2 minutes on each side , until golden brown , flipping to cook the second side when suraace is bubbly and edges dry
7. Makes 6-8 5" hotcakes

title: chili s fajitas for two by todd wilbur
steps:
1. 1
2. Combine all of the ingredients for the marinade in a small bowl
3. Soak your choice of meat in the marinade for at least 2 hours
4. If you are using the sirloin , let it marinate overnight , if possible
5. 2
6. When the meat has marinated , preheat your barbecue or stove top grill to high
7. 3
8. Preheat a skillet over medium / high heat
9. Saute the onion slices in the oil for 5 minutes
10. Combine the soy sauce , water , and lime juice in a small bowl and pour it over the onions
11. Add the black pepper and continue to saute untill the onions are tanslucent and dark on the edges
12. Salt to taste
13. 4
14. While the onions are sauteing , grill the meat for 4 to 5 minutes per side until done
15. 5
16. While the meat and onions are cooking , heat up another skillet over high heat
17. This will be your sizzle serving pan
18. 6
19. When the meat is done remove it from the grill and slice it into this strips
20. 7
21. Remove the extra pan from the heat and dump the onions and any liquid into it
22. If you've made it hot enought the onions should sizzle
23. Add the meat to the pan and serve immediately with pico de gallo , ceddar cheese , sour cream and sour cream arranged on a seperate plate on a bed of shredded lettuce
24. Steam the tortillas in a moist towel in the microwave for 30 seconds and serve on the side
25. Serve salso also , if desired
26. Tidbits: at chili's , bell peppers are optional with the dish
27. If you like peppers , combine a small slice of green or red bell pepper with the onion , and saute the vegetables together
28. Follow the rest of steps as described

title: rose park north stake s relief society casserole
steps:
1. Brown beef , celery and onion
2. Add remaining ingredients
3. Place in 9"x13" casserole dish
4. Bake at 350f for 40 minutes , stirring every 10 minutes
5. Top with chow mein noodles
6. Bake for 5 minutes

title: luscious layer bars  cookie mix
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Spray bottom of 13x9-inch pan with cooking spray
3. In large bowl , stir cookie mix , butter and egg until soft dough forms
4. Press dough in bottom of pan using floured fingers
5. Bake 15 minutes
6. Sprinkle with butterscotch chips , chocolate chips , coconut and walnuts
7. Drizzle evenly with condensed milk
8. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until light golden brown
9. Cool completely , about 2 hours
10. For bars , cut into 9 rows by 4 rows

title: curry crusted bananas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Halve the bananas lenthwise and then again crosswise
3. In a bowl mix butter and curry powder
4. Dip bananas into mixture
5. Coat well
6. Next roll bananas in cornflakes
7. Sprinkle with sugar if desired
8. Place in greased casserole dish and bake for 10 minutes

title: california casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In a saucepan over high heat , bring chicken stock to a boil
3. Add in rice
4. Lower heat to low and cook , covered , about 20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed
5. Set aside
6. In a bowl , mix the sour cream , chiles , onions , oregano , salt , pepper , and parsley together
7. In a 4-quart casserole dish that has been coated lightly with cooking spray , add half of each of the following in layers: rice , sour cream mixture , zucchini , tomatoes , and cheese
8. Repeat the layers ending with cheese
9. Bake , uncovered , 45-50 minutes or until bubbly
10. Let stand 5-10 minutes before serving

title: buttermilk spice cake
steps:
1. Cream shortening and brown sugar
2. I would do 1 / 4 cup shortening and 1 / 4 cup butter
3. Add eggs
4. Sift flour , baking powder , baking soda , cinnamon , nutmeg , cloves , and allspice together
5. Add wet and dry ingredients alternately
6. Stir in raisins and walnuts
7. Place batter in lightly greased and floured pan
8. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 25 minutes in a 13x9 pan
9. I think this cake would do better in a smaller , taller cake pan but you would have to bake it longer
10. Bundt pan takes 45 minutes or thereabouts

title: vanilla kissable cookies
steps:
1. Beat the first 6 ingredients until fluffy
2. Add the next 3 ingredients , and mix well
3. Then stir in kissables
4. Drop tsps of dough onto cookie sheet , and flatten with clean fingers or a fork
5. Bake at 350 for 12-14 minutes
6. Remove and cool on wire rack

title: honey spice cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Cream together brown sugar and butter
3. Slowly add the honey , then the egg and mix well
4. Sift dry ingredients together and add to the creamed mixture
5. Make sure the batter is mixed well then form balls and dip in white sugar and place on greased cookie sheet sugar side up
6. Bake for 7 minutes
7. Let cool or eat warm

title: chipotle chicken pasta  bake
steps:
1. In the 1 / 2 cup hot water soak the sundried tomatoes until soft , discard water and chop the tomatoes
2. Chop all other ingredients and shred the cheese
3. Cook elbow pasta , drain and set aside
4. While pasta is cooking heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet and brown chicken until no longer pink and it has a golden colour , remove from pan add extra oil if needed and saute the celery , garlic and onion
5. Once these are softened remove from pan
6. Melt butter in same pan , scraping up any brown bits , wisk in flour and cumin and cook until it bubbles and gets a bit foamy , slowly wisk in the milk , cook until it thickens add the cheeses except the 1 / 2 cup listed at the bottom of the recipe
7. Stir until melted over a low heat add the sundried tomatoes and chilpotles cook for a couple minutes for the flavours to meld
8. Add the liquid from the canned chilpotles a couple teaspoons at a time to suit your taste
9. Add pasta , chicken , corn and cooked veggies
10. Mix well
11. Pour into a large casserole
12. I used a 2 quart oval casserole
13. Top with the crushed nachos and cheese
14. Bake at 350 for 25 minutes or until bubbly and cheese is melted

title: barbara s creamy carrot bisque
steps:
1. Chop all ingredients until fine in a food processor
2. In saucepan , combine first six ingredients , simmer until tender
3. Do not overcook as vegetables should retain texture
4. Put thru food processor
5. Warm cream but do not boil until it thickens
6. Slowly add broth and vegetables with seasonings and cheese
7. Makes four servings

title: easy tortilla soup
steps:
1. In 2-quart saucepan , mix broth , salsa , dried tomatoes corn and cumin
2. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer gently , 8 to 10 minutes , until dried tomatoes are tender
3. Mix in 2 tablespoons of the cilantro and the lime juice
4. Ladle hot soup into 4 bowls
5. Divide the remaining cilantro , the tortilla chips , avocado and cheese among the 4 bowls

title: spicy beef with potatoes
steps:
1. Heat the oil over medium heat then add the onion & beef
2. Fry until the beef is no longer pink
3. Turn the heat onto medium-low then add the spices , parsley , & worcestershire
4. Continue to fry for 10 minutes , make sure to stir frequently
5. Stir in the potatoes then continue to cook for 7 minutes
6. Serve with thick bread

title: apricot plum sauce
steps:
1. In a food processor fitted with s steel blade , process the onion , garlic , ginger , limes , apricots , and plums until pureed
2. In a medium nonaluminum dutch oven or heavy saucepan , combine the pureed ingredients and all the remaining ingredients except the cilantro and bring to a boil over medium-high heat
3. Lower the heat and simmer until slightly thickened , about 45 minutes
4. Stir frequently to avoid burning
5. Remove from the heat and cool
6. Add the cilantro and taste for seasoning
7. Pour the sauce into a large glass container and refrigerate
8. Make sure the cilantro is totally submerged before storing , or omit and add at service
9. Makes 4 cups
10. Recipe may be doubled
11. Makes a good gift
12. Uses: particularly good with pork , chicken , quail , and game hens
13. Dilute it with wine or nectar to use it as a marinade

title: jello chocolate pudding fudge
steps:
1. Microwave 4 of the chocolate squares , 6 tbsp of the butter and water in large microwaveable bowl on high for 2 minutes or until butter is melted , stir
2. Add dry pudding mix
3. Stir until well blended
4. Add powered sugar , 1 cup at a time , stirring until well blended after each addition
5. Press into foil lined 8 inch square pan
6. Microwave remaining 4 chocolate squares and 2 tbsp butter in large microwaveable bowl on high 1 1 / 2 minutes or until butter is melted
7. Stir until chocolate is completely melted
8. Spread over pudding mixture
9. Refrigerate 2 hours or until firm
10. Store cut-up fudge between sheets of wax paper in airtight container in refrigerator up to 2 weeks
11. Yields 24 servings , 2 inch squares each

title: thin and crispy chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Roast the pecans on a baking sheet until fragrant and toasted , about 10 minutes
3. Place in a bowl and stir in 2 tablespoons of the butter to coat pecans , set aside
4. Increase oven heat to 375
5. Sift together flour , salt and baking soda in a bowl
6. Set aside
7. Place remaining butter and the sugars in the bowl of an electric mixer
8. Beat on medium speed until fluffy , about 3 minutes
9. Mix in corn syrup and milk until smooth
10. Reduce speed to low
11. Blend in flour mixture just to combine , add pecans and chocolate chips
12. Mix with a rubber spatula
13. Drop by rounded tablespoon about 2 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheets
14. Bake in batches until the edges just begin to brown , about 12 minutes
15. Cool cookies on the sheets on a wire rack for 3 minutes then remove cookies to a wire rack to cool completely

title: crispy parm  crusted filet of fish
steps:
1. Set up 3 dishes for breading the filets: in the first , combine the flour with the old bay seasoning
2. In the second , beat the eggs with a splash of water
3. In the third , combine the breadcrumbs with the parmigiano , thyme and lemon zest
4. Preheat a large skillet with with the olive oil in it
5. Dip each fish filet first in the flour , then the egg and finally the breadcrumbs
6. Saute the first 2 fish filets until golden brown , about 2 mintues per side
7. When they are done place them on a cooling rack placed on a cookie sheet and keep them warm in a hot oven , while you cook the other 2 filets
8. Serve with lemon wedges

title: indian yam fritters   classic crunch patties
steps:
1. Wash and peel the yams
2. Boil until tender , about 20 minutes
3. Drain the yams thoroughly and puree in the food processor with the flour
4. A thick and sticky mixture should result
5. Add the seasonings and pulse again
6. Form little discs with your hands about the size of half-dollars
7. Shallow pan fry in olive oil , blot on paper towels
8. Serve with tamarind date sauce or a good chutney

title: spice market sweet potato and lentil packets
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f place 4 16-inch lengths of foil on work surface
2. Fold foil in half from short side
3. Unfold
4. Shape corners and edges of one half into semicircular "bowl' with 1 / 2-inch sides
5. Coat insides of foil with cooking spray
6. Combine sweet potato , bell pepper , green beans , and raisins in medium bowl
7. Add oil , and toss to coat
8. Season with salt and pepper , if desired
9. Whisk together broth , ginger , garlic , and curry powder in small bowl
10. Divide sweet potato mixture among packets
11. Top with 1 / 3 cup lentils
12. Pour 1 / 4 cup broth mixture over lentils , and season with salt and pepper , if desired
13. Fold ther half of foil over ingredients , and crimp edges in overlapping folds until packets are sealed
14. Transfer packets to baking sheet
15. Bake 25 minutes
16. Transfer to plates
17. Let each person open packet carefully - escaping air will be hot
18. Top with chutney , if using

title: sandy s baked beans
steps:
1. Wash the beans and soak overnight
2. On the stove , simmer 6 cups of water , beans , salt , and onion for 20 minutes
3. Remove from stove and add the remaining ingredients
4. Bake in covered casserole at 325 , or in crockpot on low , for 6-8 hours
5. Check periodically and add liquid if necessary
6. These are good served either hot or cold

title: spinach and parmesan rustic bread   bread machine
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a frying pan
2. Add the chopped onion and saut until a light golden color
3. Add the spinach , stir well to combine and cover tightly
4. Remove from the heat and let stand for 5 minutes
5. Then stir again and let the pan , uncovered , to cool
6. Place the spinach mixture in the bread machine pan
7. Add the water and egg
8. Sprinkle the bread flour , ensuring that it completely covers the liquid mixture
9. Now sprinkle the cheese inside
10. Place the salt and sugar in separate corners of the bread pan
11. Make a shallow indention in the center of the flour , add the yeast
12. Set the bread machine to the dough setting
13. Press start
14. Lightly flour 2 baking sheets
15. When the dough cycle has finished , remove the dough from the machine and place on a lightly floured surface , gently punch the dough down , then carefully roll it out to a rectangle about 1 inch thick
16. Roll up the dough from one long side to form a thick baton shape with a square end
17. Place the baton on the prepared baking sheet , seam side up , cover it with lightly oiled plastic wrap
18. Set aside to rest 15 minutes
19. Turn the bread over and place on the second baking sheet
20. Plump up the dough by tucking the ends and sides under
21. Cover with the oiled wrap and let rest in a warm place for 30 minutes
22. Preheat the oven to 425f
23. Using a sharp knife , slash the top of the bread with 5 diagonal slashes
24. Bake for 28 minutes , or until it is golden
25. Turn unto a wire rack to cool

title: mexican chicken bake  easy chilaquiles
steps:
1. In a skillet , heat oil , then add onion bell pepper and garlic , saute until onions are almost translucent
2. Set aside
3. In a bowl combine , soups , onion
4. Bell pepper , chicken , salsa , chili powder , cayenne , couple dashes of hot sauce & 1 1 / 2 cups of cheese
5. Mix well
6. In a baking dish , grease with a little cooking spray , then lay out four tortillas overlapping
7. Pour 1 / 3 of mixture from bowl on top of tortillas
8. Repeat steps , finally ending with putting the last 1 / 2 cup of cheese on top
9. Bake at 350 for 30-45 minutes or until bubbly
10. This is a great "freezer-meal" , just wrap it up in a freezer dish , pop it in the freezer and thaw before you want to cook it , use the same cooking temp and time

title: spicy chicken stir fry    3
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients for marinade
2. Reserve about 1 / 4 of mixture in separate container
3. Add chicken and let sit for at least an hour
4. Put pan or wok over medium-high heat
5. Add fire oil / olive oil combo until sizzling
6. Add green onions and garlic
7. Add chicken mixture and simmer until chicken is no longer pink
8. Add eggplant , zucchini and onion
9. Add reserved marinade as necessary
10. Simmer for about 10 minutes , until vegetables are crisp-tender
11. Cook soba noodles in boiling water 2- 3 minutes
12. Remove and drain
13. Add noodles to vegetable-chicken mixture and cook 2 minutes longer

title: boerewors   south african sausage
steps:
1. Mix everything very well together
2. Stuff casings if used or shape into patties for the best hamburgers in the world !
3. Barbecue or pan-fry 4 minutes on each side

title: see jane run tofu smoothie
steps:
1. Use a blender to combine the frozen strawberries and by adding enough soy milk to blend
2. Then , add tofu , soy milk alternately
3. Add splenda sweetener to taste

title: peach plum jam
steps:
1. In a large pot combine peaches , plums , lemon juice and sugar
2. Cook , stiring , over med-high heat until sugar is melted
3. Bring to a rolling boil
4. Boil , stirring constantly , for 1 minute
5. Add 2 pouches of certo , stirring constantly
6. Return to a rolling boil
7. Boil , stirring constantly for 1 minute
8. Remove from heat
9. Skim off any foam with a metal spoon
10. Fill hot sterile jars leaving 1 / 4 inch headspace
11. Wipe off jar rims with damp cloth
12. Top with 2 piece seal and ring
13. Hot water bath jars for 10 minutes

title: snack mix
steps:
1. Put all ingredients listed prior to the popcorn oil into a white kitchen wastebasket size garbage bag and shake gently
2. Mix together the last four ingredients and pour over the dry ingredients in the bag
3. Store and shake occasionally for 48 hours before serving
4. Supposedly can be frozen in freezer ziploc bags
5. I have never done that

title: balsamic grilled chicken  oamc
steps:
1. Mix marinade together and reserve 1 / 4 cup to baste after grilling if desired
2. Marinate chicken minimum 4 hours but for best results , overnight
3. Or freeze for later ! just thaw in fridge and grill !
4. Grill chicken over indirect flame , medium heat , until done
5. Add wood chips for a smoky flavor if desired
6. Brush with any reserved marinade if so desired

title: kicked up hanky panky
steps:
1. Brown hamburger , sausage and onion in a large skillet
2. Drain well
3. Add velveeta cheese , stir until melted
4. Add well drained rotel
5. Mix well
6. Place rye bread slices on two cookie sheets
7. Top with a heaping tbl
8. Of mixture
9. Place cookie sheets in the freezer for an hour or two
10. Remove from freezer and place hanky pankies in ziplock freezer bags
11. When ready to use , take directly from freezer and bake at 350 for 10 to 15 minutes

title: peanut butter chocolate clusters
steps:
1. Mix chocolate chips , butterscotch chips , butter and peanut butter in a large microwaveable bowl
2. Microwave on medium for 3 to 4 minutes or until completely melted and mixture is well blended , stirring after one minute
3. Add remaining ingredients , mix well
4. Drop tablespoonfuls of mixture in 1-inch mounds onto wax paper-covered baking sheets
5. Refrigerate 30 minutes or until firm
6. Store in airtight container in refrigerator

title: aussie tuna summer salad
steps:
1. Place olive oil , herbs salt , salt , pepper and garlic into a microwave proof jug / container and microwave for 10-20 seconds after heating the oil mix , place in the refrigerator for a short while , until cool
2. This ensures flavours are fully infused into the dressing
3. Break up lettuce and place in a salad bowl
4. Place onion , mushrooms , potato / pasta and avacodo into bowl and toss gently and thoroughly
5. Place tossed salad ingredients into serving bowls and add the remaining salad ingredients
6. Get the cold oil mix from the fridge and add the lemon juice and vinegar , and stir thoroughly
7. Your dressing is done
8. Drizzle the dressing over the salad , and hey presto , you're done !

title: pea and cheese salad
steps:
1. Mix miracle whip , mustard , sugar , and pepper
2. Add cheese , peas , celery and onions: toss
3. Stir in eggs
4. Cover and refrigerate at least one hour

title: citrus cilantro chicken
steps:
1. Take citrus and roll it on counter
2. Smash it to loosen up the inside and help the juices break out , this is the fun part ! squeeze out as much juice as possible into a marinating dish or large plastic bag
3. I scooped out the flesh from the peel and put in my dish , too , but if you prefer not to have the pulpy part you can leave it out
4. A little zest would be nice , too
5. Add soy sauce and margarita mix
6. Add chicken , chopped onion , cilantro , and mix it up
7. Allow to marinate in refrigerator 1-2 hours , but not too much longer because the citrus will start breaking down the meat
8. Heat large pan and add the mixture
9. Let it start to simmer
10. Add in garlic and greenbeans and let cook about another 7 minutes or until chicken and green beans are cooked through
11. You could add some red pepper flakes to give it some heat in this step if you like a little more spice
12. Pile ingredients on one side of the pan and add in the cornstarch
13. Let it start to simmer and watch it start to bubble
14. It'll take about two minutes
15. Mix it through and heat about another minute then remove from heat
16. The longer it sits the thicker the sauce will be
17. I like to serve it over white basmati rice

title: simple macaroni   cheese beef skillet bake
steps:
1. Prepare box of macaroni and cheese as directed on box with 1 / 2 tsp salt added to boiling water
2. Preheat oven to 350f
3. Spray oil an 8 x 8 casserole dish
4. While macaroni is boiling , brown ground beef in a large skillet and add chopped onion the last few minutes lowering heat and cooking until onion is clear in color
5. Drain any fat off the meat
6. In the prepared mac & cheese , fold in 1 / 4 cup cheese , mushroom soup , milk and worcestershire sauce , remaining 1 / 2 tsp salt and pepper to taste
7. Add ground meat mixture and drained mushrooms and mix well
8. Transfer mixture into the spray oiled casserole dish and top with the remaining 1 / 2 cup cheese
9. Bake for 30 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly
10. Quick version: keep the mixture in the large skillet , sprinkle top with 1 / 2 cup cheddar cheese , lower heat to a very slow simmer and cook until cheese is melted and mixture is heated throughout

title: russian pickled mushrooms
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , combine all ingredients , except for the mushrooms
2. Bring to a boil over medium heat and cook for 3 minutes
3. Add mushrooms and when mixture boils again continue to cook and stir , 1 minute more
4. Chill several hours or overnight to blend flavors
5. Serve cold
6. Preparation and cooking time does not include flavor blending time

title: roasted garlic crostini
steps:
1. Trim
2. Drizzle oil over top
3. Wrap in foil
4. Bake in 400f oven until cloves are softened and caramelized , about 1 hour
5. Meanwhile , toast baguette slices on baking sheet in 400f oven until golden , about 8 minutes
6. Spread pine nuts on small baking sheet
7. Toast alongside baguette slices until lightly browned , about 5 minutes
8. To serve , arrange baguette slices , garlic , pine nuts , goat cheese and parsley on serving plate
9. Using small fork , remove 2 roasted cloves from garlic bulb
10. Spread on baguette slice
11. Top with goat cheese round , pine nuts and parsley

title: louisiana garlic shrimp
steps:
1. Place shrimp in a 10x6 baking dish
2. Combine butter , garlic , and hot sauce in a small mixing bowl , stirring well
3. Pour over shrimp
4. Bake at 450 degrees for 10 minutes or until shrimp are opaque
5. Spoon shrimp mixture over toasted french bread
6. Sprinkle with chopped parsley

title: lemon pound cake muffins
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , cream butter and sugar
2. Add the eggs and extracts
3. Beat well
4. Combine the flour , salt , and baking soda
5. Add to creamed mixture alternately with sour cream
6. Fill greased or paper-lined muffin cups 3 / 4s full
7. Bake at 400 for 18-20 minutes
8. Cool for 5 minutes and move to a wire rack to cool
9. Combine glaze ingredients
10. Drizzle over muffins
11. Serve warm

title: kohl slaw
steps:
1. Put vinegar , sugar and butter in a good sized pot
2. Add cabbage , salt and pepper
3. Cook on top of stove abou 3 / 4 of an hour until cabbage is tender

title: pressure cooker vietnamese pho bo
steps:
1. Peel the ginger and the onion , and char them on an open flame or under a broiler until well blackened
2. Set aside
3. In the pressure cooking , brown the meat slowly in batches to give it a good colour
4. Set aside
5. Clean the pot , return the meat , ginger , onion , star anise , cloves , cinnamon and water
6. Set on high heat
7. Bring back to the boil then skim the scum that will have risen at the top
8. Close the pressure cooker
9. When your pressure cooker is 'steaming' , reduce the heat to low and cook for 50 minute
10. When time is up - release the pressure , keep the piece of brisket warm - discard the rest
11. But keep the stock !
12. Skim as much fat as you can from he stock - then return to the pot and add the fish sauce , salt , sugar and black pepper
13. Bring back to the boil and add the noodles
14. Cook the noodles in the broth until ready
15. Serve steaming hot with the rest of the condinments on the side
16. Enjoy !

title: roast beef sour cream enchiladas
steps:
1. Heat 1 / 2 inch oil in skillet and briefly fry corn tortillas to soften
2. Drain well
3. Shred canned or left over roast beef and any juices with fork and heat in small saucepan
4. Place 1 to 2 tablespoons roast beef in center of each tortilla and sprinkle with diced onion and small amount of each kind of cheese
5. Place in 9x13 baking dish and repeat until all 12 tortillas have been stuffed
6. Sprinkle any remaining onion and beef over tops of enchiladas
7. Mix sour cream with undrained green chiles and spread over enchiladas
8. Top enchiladas with remaining cheeses
9. Bake at 350 for 20-25 minutes or until warmed through and bubbly
10. Do not over bake or tortillas will be tough on the bottom

title: frozen chicken one dish supper  crock pot
steps:
1. If using , put mushrooms and onion in bottom of crock pot
2. Place frozen chicken in crock pot
3. Combine soup and milk and pour over chicken
4. Combine the stuffing mix , seasoning packet and water and spoon mixture over chicken
5. Cover and cook on low 8- 10 hours
6. Enjoy !

title: fudge cupcakes   gluten free
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200c or 180c if using fan forced oven
2. Line a 12 hole muffin tin with paper cases
3. Melt chocolate and butter , until smooth
4. Can use the microwave if wished
5. Cool
6. Stir in the egg yolks , then gradually add the milk and vanilla
7. In another large bowl- combine the almond meal , sifted cocoa and baking powder , sugar and chocolate bits
8. Stir this mixture into the chocolate mixture
9. Beat the egg whites with an electric mixer , until soft peaks form
10. Fold 1 / 3 of the egg whites into the chocolate mixture
11. Fold in the remaining egg whites
12. Spoon the mixture into the paper cases
13. Bake for about 20 minutes , or until cooked
14. Transfer to wire racks to cool
15. Dust with sifted cocoa or pure icing sugar , if desired
16. These cakes are suitable to freeze

title: dry adobo seasoning  adobo seco
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a jar with a tight fitting lid
2. You can use any or all of the optional ingredients
3. Shake well and store for up to 2 months in a cool dry place

title: another cranberry apple relish
steps:
1. Chop cranberries roughly
2. Put in medium saucepan with 1 / 2 cup water and the currants
3. Let stand for 20 minutes
4. Cook cranberries , covered , over medium heat for 5 minutes
5. Stir in apples
6. Cook , covered , over low heat for 5 minutes to soften apples
7. When soft , raise heat to medium high , add sugar , and cook for 4- 5 minutes more , or until apples are very soft
8. Remove from heat
9. Lightly mash apple and cranberry mix with a pastry cutter
10. Stir in walnuts

title: sauerkraut with bacon  potato and caraway
steps:
1. Saute bacon until crisp
2. Remove bacon to drain , reserving fat in pan
3. Saute onion in bacon fat until browned
4. Add sauerkraut and saute for 5 minutes
5. Add potato , chicken stock , reserved bacon , black pepper and caraway
6. Bring to a boil and simmer on lowest heat for 20 minutes- stirring frequently , then cover and simmer for an additional 30 minutes- stirring every 10 minutes

title: homemade saika  buns
steps:
1. Dilute yeast in warm milk , add salt , sugar , egg , sifted flour and knead not very stiff dough
2. By the end of kneading , pour in melted margarine , stir carefully and leave in a warm place to rise
3. Make a sausage from the dough and slice
4. Roll every slice into a ball and shape a finger 10-12 cm long with pointed ends
5. Sink fingers in melted butter and put on a greased sheet tightly to each other
6. Then leave to rise for 60 minutes
7. Bake in a preheated oven for 20 minutes 220-250 c

title: crispy crusted tilapia
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Combine first four ingredients in a bowl
3. Spread on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray
4. Arrange fillets on top of vegetables
5. Season with salt and pepper to taste
6. Combine crumbs and next four ingredients
7. Toss with melted butter
8. Divide crumb mixture evenly over each fillet , pressing into the fish
9. Bake 20 minutes , or until fillets flake easily when tested with a fork
10. Sprinkle with scallion and serve with lemon wedges

title: wild rice   artichoke hearts
steps:
1. Wash and drain wild rice
2. Place rice , consomme , water and salt in saucepan
3. Heat to boiling
4. Reduce heat and simmer , covered , until tender , about 45 minutes
5. In a large frying pan , melt butter and saute onion and garlic until soft
6. Drain and cut artichokes into quarters
7. Add to frying pan with cooked rice , parsley and oregano
8. Stir until heated through

title: feta  sweet potato and spinach crustless quiche  gluten free
steps:
1. Grease a large flan dish , approximately 25-27cm in diamater
2. Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick frying pan , add onion and garlic and cook 1 minute
3. Add sweet potato and cook over moderate heat , stirring occasionally until golden brown , this should take about 10 minutes
4. Add spinach and cook , stirring 1 minute until spinach is wilted
5. Cool
6. Add feta cheese , stir to combine and place into prepared flan dish
7. Beat the 6 eggs in a large jug with milk , nutmeg and pepper and pour over vegetables in flan dish
8. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese and pinenuts and bake in a moderate oven 180c 35-40 minutes until puffed and golden
9. Allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before slicing
10. Serve cut into wedges with a salad on the side , veges , chips or crusty bread rolls

title: greek style chicken pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook pasta as directed until al dente , careful not to overcook the pasta , just until chewy and firm , but cooked
2. Drain well
3. Rinse in cold water
4. Mix together all pasta ingredients in a bowl
5. Mix all dressing ingredients
6. Add to pasta mixture
7. Toss well to coat
8. Let sit in refrigerator for 2 or more hours before serving , to blend the flavours
9. Sprinkle more feta cheese on top to garnish
10. The bacon is optional , i rarely add it

title: homemade gnocchi
steps:
1. Boil potato and mash
2. Combine potato with eggs and salt and whip until fluffy
3. Add ricotta cheese , butter , romano cheese and flour
4. Knead until smooth
5. Shape into 1 / 2" rolls and cut into 1" lengths
6. Make impression with thumb in each piece , then lightly dust with flour
7. Drop into boiling salted water and cook only until they rise to the surface
8. Drain and serve with tomato sauce and grated cheese

title: rice pudding smoothie
steps:
1. Using a blender , mix the milk , cream cheese , vanilla and cinnamon and blend until smooth
2. Add the ice cubes and blend on high speed until slushy , about 15 seconds
3. Add the rice and pulse for 5 seconds
4. Sprinkle with nutmeg
5. Garnish with the cinnamon stick

title: yucatecan grilled pork
steps:
1. Whisk together the lime juice , garlic , and salt in a large pan or bowl
2. Add pork slices and toss to evenly coat
3. Cover and refrigerate 2 to 8 hours
4. Preheat the grill or broiler
5. Grill or broil the pork over medium flames about 15 minutes , turning frequently to avoid scorching
6. Serve with warm tortillas , cucumbers , and tomato salsa

title: asparagi alla parmigiana  italian asparagus gratin
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Butter a shallow gratin or baking dish that is just large enough to hold the asparagus
3. Place a layer of asparagus in the dish , with the
4. Sprinkle with a little salt and pepper and some of the cheese keep adding layers until all asparagus and all cheese is used , finishing with the cheese
5. Dot the top of the dish with the pieces of butter and place the dish on the top rack of the oven
6. Bake for about 15-20 minutes , or until the asparagus is cooked through and beginning to brown and the cheese is melted
7. Variations
8. Instead of the butter use olive oil or half butter and half olive oil
9. Use half parmesan and half shredded fontina cheese for a creamier gratin
10. Layer a couple of slices of prosciutto in with the asparagus if you like
11. Sprinkle with a little lemon zest for added zing

title: quinoa vegetarian chili
steps:
1. In a large , deep saucepan , heat oil over medium heat
2. Add onion , celery , carrots , pepper & garlic
3. Cook , stirring until vegetables are softened , about 7 minutes
4. Add chili powder and cumin and stir for 1 minute
5. Add tomatoes with juices and stock
6. Bring to a boil and add sugar and vinegar
7. Season with salt and pepper
8. Add quinoa , beans and corn
9. Cook , stirring until mixture returns to a boil
10. Reduce heat to low
11. Cover and simmer until quinoa is tender about 25 minutes

title: iced fruit salad  chozhaffe
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , cover dried fruits with cold water
2. Cover and refrigerate 24 hours
3. Drain well
4. In a large bowl , combine drained fruit and nuts
5. In a small bowl , combine cardamom , cinnamon , grenadine and rose water
6. Pour over fruit and nuts
7. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours
8. To serve , stir in ice cubes

title: pasta with shrimp in garlic sauce fideos con gambas
steps:
1. Bring pot of water to boil with 1 tablespoon oil and salt
2. Add the spaghetti and stir occasionally with fork
3. Cook until tender , but still firm
4. Drain , return to pot , mix in another tablespoon oil , and keep warm
5. Heat the last tablespoon of oil in skillet and add the garlic
6. Just as the garlic starts to turn color , add the shrimp
7. Stir for about 2 minutes until the shrimps turn pink
8. Add the lemon juice , broth , red pepper , parsley and dash of salt
9. Cook for one more minute
10. Mix in noodles and serve once noddles are hot

title: beef pesto panini
steps:
1. Spread 1 side of each slice of bread with butter
2. Place 4 slices of bread butter side down on 12-inch skillet
3. Top bread with beef , pesto and cheese
4. Top with remaining bread slice butter side up
5. Cook sandwiches on skillet or grill over medium heat 4-5 minutes , turning once , until bread is crisp and cheese has melted
6. Serve with spaghetti sauce if desired

title: whole trout amandine
steps:
1. Use fresh or frozen trout make sure the fish is fully defrosted
2. Make sure the broiler is on and is very hot
3. Tost the almond in about 1 tbs of butter , keep warm
4. Cut the lemon into 3 or 6 slices
5. Place 1 / 3 of the lemon in the cavity of each fish
6. Line a broiler tray with buttered foil
7. Smear a little butter on each side of the fish
8. Broil trout for abou 5 minutes
9. Turn the fish carefully smear a little more butter and broil for about 5 minutes more
10. Ganish the trout with the toasted almods
11. If you are deboning add the almonds after the deboning has been done

title: herb steamed chilean sea bass
steps:
1. Cut the sea bass in half horizontally
2. Season the inside with salt and pepper and fill the center with the chopped herbs
3. Reassemble the sea bass and season the outside with salt and pepper to taste
4. Wrap in plastic wrap
5. Steam the sea bass in an 8-inch , flat-bottomed steamer , covered , for 6 minutes , or until it is barely opaque
6. To assemble: remove the plastic wrap
7. Use a very sharp knife to cut the fish into eight 2-inch wedges
8. Choose a flat , colorful plate to set off the dramatic form of the fish
9. Stand one wedge on its end and show the herb filling of the other
10. Garnish with fresh herbs

title: homemade creme fraiche
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine the cream and buttermilk or lemon juice
2. Cover with a clean kitchen cloth in a warm , draft free place and let sit until thickened , but still pourable consistency , 12 to 16 hours
3. Stir and refrigerate until ready to use

title: bacony beans
steps:
1. Brown bacon in skillet till crispy
2. Set aside
3. Pour off all but a thin layer of the bacon fat and cook onion till soft
4. In large casserole dish , combine remaining ingredients and then add bacon , onion and the fat left in the skillet
5. Mix thoroughly and bake in a 375 oven for 45 minutes

title: horiatiko psomi  crusty country bread
steps:
1. In a small bowl , dissolve the yeast in lukewarm water
2. Slowly add the 1 / 2 cup of flour and mix until all lumps of flour have dissolved , to form a thick liquid
3. Allow to rise about 15-20 minutes
4. Sift the remaining flour with the salt , put in a large mixing bowl , and make a well in the center
5. Add oil , honey , milk , yeast mixture , and 2 cups of the water in the well
6. Pulling in the flour slowly , mix with hands until it's a cohesive mass
7. Turn out onto a floured surface and continue kneading until the dough is nice and smooth and no longer sticks to the hands
8. Place the dough in a lightly oiled mixing bowl and roll until all sides of the dough are lightly oiled
9. Cover the bowl with 3 dishtowels: one dry , one dampened with warm water , and the other dry
10. Place in a warm place and allow to rise until doubled , about 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours
11. Punch down and knead for 5-6 minutes on a floured surface
12. Divide the dough into the number of loaves you want to make , and form into round or oblong or baguette shaped loaves
13. Place several inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets and cover with 3 clean dishtowels
14. In a warm place , allow the loaves to rise for 1 hour
15. Preheat oven to 450f
16. For a thicker crust , score the tops of the loaves in 3 or 4 places
17. Otherwise , bake as is on the rack just below the middle of the oven for 30-35 minutes until browned
18. When tapped on the bottom , bread will sound hollow
19. When the loaves are done , remove from oven and cool on racks

title: chunky pear and applesauce
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a heavy saucepan
2. Bring to a boil over medium heat , then reduce heat to a simmer
3. Cover and cook , stirring occasionally , until reduced to a chunky sauce , about 10 minutes
4. Remove from the heat , cool , and refrigerate until needed
5. You can also freeze in ice cube trays
6. Keep frozen cubes in a plastic bag so you can remove one portion at a time

title: fresh orange pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Prepare dough for a 1-crust pie , adding grated orange zest
3. Line pie plate with pastry
4. Prick pastry with fork to prevent puffing during baking
5. Bake in preheated oven until golden , about 12 minutes
6. Cool
7. Meanwhile , peel oranges and section into segments
8. Squeeze membrane and reserve juice
9. You should have about 1 cup
10. Pour sugar over segments and let stand 1 hour
11. Drain liquid from segments , add to reserved juice to make 1-1 / 2 cups
12. Place juice in a double boiler with salt and cornstarch
13. Cook until thickened
14. Add vanilla
15. Cool to room temperature
16. Spread apricot jam on baked pie shell
17. Add orange segments , spreading over jam
18. Pour cooled sauce over orange segments
19. Chill at least 1 hour before serving
20. To serve: garnish with toasted coconut

title: heathier banana pumpkin spice bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease a large loaf pan (approx
3. 8 1 / 2 x 2 1 / 2 x 2 1 / 2
4. In a large bowl , whisk together mashed bananas , pumpkin puree , oil , eggs and vanilla until combined well
5. In a medium bowl , whisk together flour , erythritol , baking powder , baking soda , cinnamon , ginger , allspice and salt
6. Add flour mixture to wet ingredients in large bowl and stir until just combined
7. Pour batter into prepared loaf pan
8. Bake until top is deeply browned and springs back when touched gently , about 70 to 85 minutes

title: fridge ready angel biscuits
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast in 1 / 2 cup warm water
2. Let sit until bubbly
3. Sift all dry ingredients into large mixing bowl
4. Cut in the shortening with a pastry blender
5. Add in the yeast / water mixture with the buttermilk , then gently work into the dough
6. Spray a ziploc bag with pam or other vegetable spray
7. Transfer the dough into bag , zip up bag , and keep in fridge for a minumum of overnight or up to a week
8. The dough will last about a week in the fridge , just pinch off what you need
9. Roll and shape into 1 / 2-inch biscuits and bake for 12 minutes at 350 degrees , or until golden brown

title: orecchiette with white beans   pesto from health magazine
steps:
1. 1
2. Cook pasta according to package directions , omitting salt and fat

4. While pasta cooks , heat olive oil and garlic in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until garlic is fragrant
5. Add beans and tomatoes
6. Reduce heat to low , and cook , stirring occasionally , until tomatoes release their liquid , about 5 to 7 minutes
7. 3
8. Drain pasta and add to bean mixture
9. Add pesto
10. Toss to combine
11. Divide into 4 equal servings
12. Top each serving with 1 tablespoon parmesan cheese

title: hot broccoli cheese dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix cream cheese , sour cream and salad dressing mix with electric mixer on medium speed until well blended
3. Stir in broccoli and 1 cups of the cheddar cheese
4. Spoon into 9 inch pie plate or ovenproof crock
5. Bake 20 minutes
6. Sprinkle with remaining cheddar cheese
7. Bake an additional 5 minutes or until cheddar cheese is melted
8. Serve with crackers

title: low fat english rice pudding
steps:
1. In dutch oven combine 1 cup water and 1 cup rice
2. Bring to a boil
3. Add 5 cups milk and raisins
4. Cover and lower heat to simmering
5. Simmer for about 1 1 / 2 hours until all liquid has been absorbed
6. Remove from heat
7. Add all other ingredients
8. Best eaten chilled

title: fillet of venison with a wild thyme and blueberry sauce
steps:
1. Slice the venison into 1 inch discs
2. Heat oil in a fry pan and fry each slice of meat for about 2-3 mins till browned but still pink inside
3. Remove from pan with slotted spoon and keep warm
4. Place shallots , thyme and garlic into the pan and fry gently for 2-3 mins until translucent , add wine and jelly , stir well , reduce by half
5. Mix in the blueberries and simmer for a few mins until the berries have burst , add the butter , take off heat and allow to melt
6. Season with salt and pepper to taste
7. Serve venison with sauce drizzled over the top and garnish with thyme flowers if available
8. Cheers !

title: mama lane s sweet potato pudding
steps:
1. Put all ingredients together in a 5 by 2 inch baking dish
2. Bake in a pre-heated 350 degree oven
3. 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours
4. Stir 2 to 3 times to keep from burning
5. Bake until top brown

title: ham   cheese salad sandwich spread
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a food processor and pulse until blended
2. You may need to stir a little more by hand to make sure that the mayo and mustard are blended in thoroughly
3. Serve on bread or crackers

title: sourdough chocolate malt dessert waffles
steps:
1. Night before:
2. Proof your starter by adding one cup of flour and one cup of water to 1 / 4 cup of starter
3. Next morning :
4. Pour 1 cup proofed starter into a medium size mixing bowl
5. Stir in the water and whole wheat flour and mix until thoroughly combined
6. Cover bowl and set aside for 6 - 8 hours
7. To make batter:
8. Whisk together the dry ingredients , sifting if necessary to remove all lumps
9. To the sourdough sponge , stir in the eggs , flour mixture , melted butter , vanilla and chocolate chips
10. Mix thoroughly
11. To bake waffles:
12. Pour about 1 / 2 cup of batter into greased , preheated waffle iron
13. Bake until the steam stops coming out of the sides of the iron
14. The waffles will be soft and tender when removing from the iron , however they will crisp up as they cool
15. To serve:
16. Top with ice cream , fruit and sauce and whipped cream

title: homemade cream cheese
steps:
1. Bring milk and salt very slowly to the boil
2. Remove from heat and stir in white vinegar
3. Leave to cool
4. When cool pour mixture into a muslin bag and allow to drip

title: spicy chicken  orgasm  wraps
steps:
1. Cut chicken into bite size strips
2. Sprinkle chicken with creole seasoning and pepper
3. Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large skillet
4. Add chicken and saute until chicken is mostly cooked on med-high heat
5. Remove chicken and set aside in a bowl or dish
6. Add the last tablespoon of olive oil and add onion , garlic , zucchini , summer squash , and red bell pepper
7. Saute for 3-4 minutes or until onion just starts to turn translucent
8. Return chicken to skillet and add thyme
9. Let cook on med-high until most of the liquid in pan has dissipated
10. Add your lemon juice and hot sauce
11. Turn to med heat and cook for another 2 minutes
12. Turn off heat
13. Cook couscous as directed on back of box
14. I usually use "far east" brand
15. You can use olive oil and herb , chicken and herb or parmesan flavors
16. In a small bowl combined sour cream , creole seasoning , lemon juice and worcestershire sauce
17. Mix until fully incorperated
18. Pretty much buy the largest flour tortillas you can find
19. Or buy wrap
20. Any flavor will work
21. Just make sure to warm them to make them easier to work with
22. Build your wrap as follows , couscous , chicken and veggies , cheese and sauce
23. I can't say i know the exact proportions , but you want at least 1 / 4 cup cous cous , 1 / 2 - 3 / 4 cup chicken mixture , 1 oz cheese and at least 2 tablespoons sauce
24. I also like to put some fresh baby spinach in there too
25. It gives it a nice fresh flavor

title: fresh tomato and cucumber salad
steps:
1. Mix all vegetables in bowl
2. Combine dressing and sugar substitute
3. Pour over vegetables
4. Chill

title: mrs  fast pickles
steps:
1. For brine: mix all ingredients in large pot and bring to a boil
2. Set aside
3. For pickles: slice cukes into a large mixing bowl to make 7 quarts
4. Pour scant cup of pickling salt over cukes and cover with boiling water
5. Let stand for 2 hours and drain well
6. Put cucumbers into sealing jars , cover with brine , add some fresh dill , seal , and place in canner
7. Bring to a boil and turn off heat
8. Let stand for 20 minutes before removing jars

title: stir fried sausage and veggies
steps:
1. 1
2. Heat oil in wok or large skillet over mediumhigh heat
3. Add broccoli , pepper and carrots
4. Stir-fry 2-3 minutes
5. 2
6. Add garlic
7. Stir-fry 1-2 minutes
8. Add sausage , water chestnuts and teriyaki sause
9. Increase heat to high
10. Cook until sausage us heated through
11. Serve over rice

title: chocolate layered no bake cheesecake bars
steps:
1. Line 13"x9" pan with foil , extending ends of foil over sides of pan to use later to lift out of pan
2. Mix graham crumbs , butter & 2 tablespoons sugar
3. Press firmly onto bottom of prepared pan , then refrigerate while preparing filling
4. Microwave 6 of the chocolate squares in microwaveable bowl on high 1 minute , then stir until chocolate is completely melted
5. Set aside to cool slightly
6. With electric mixer on medium , beat cream cheese , 1 / 2 cup sugar & vanilla in large bowl until well blended
7. Gently stir in whipped topping
8. Pour half of batter into medium bowl , & stir into it the melted chocolate
9. Pour this mixture over crust , then cover that with the remaining plain batter
10. Melt remaining 2 chocolate squares as directed on package , then drizzle over batter
11. Refrigerate 3 hours or until firm
12. Using foil handles , remove cheesecake from pan , then cut into bars
13. Store tightly covered in refrigerator

title: lazy greek chicken
steps:
1. Preheat the over 425
2. Heat 1 t

5. Add the onion and 2 / 3 of the garlic and cook until softened , 3 to 4 minutes
6. Transfer to a bowl to cool , and then add spinach and season with salt , pepper and nutmeg
7. Melt the butter in same pan , turn off the heat and add the panko , oregano and remaining garlic , toss
8. Drizzle a baking dish with the remaining 1 t
9. Evoo
10. Split each chicken breast across open like a book
11. Stuff with the spinach and feta
12. Letting the stuffing overflow the edges
13. Place the chicken pieces in the baking dish and top with the breadcrumbs
14. Bake until the juices run clear , about 20 minutes

title: old fashioned macaroni
steps:
1. Place water in a large microwave-safe bowl
2. Microwave , covered , at high for 10 minutes to bring to boil
3. Add the macaroni , stir and cover
4. Microwave 7 to 8 minutes at high
5. Stir , cover and let stand 3 minutes
6. Drain
7. Place half the cooked macaroni in a buttered 6-cup microwave-safe baking dish
8. Sprinkle with half the cheese , top with half the sour cream and dot with half the butter
9. Repeat with remaining ingredients
10. Sprinkle with paprika
11. Microwave , uncovered at high for 8 to 10 minutes
12. My
13. My microwave is so old it takes forever to boil water
14. I also will mix up the cheese sometimes using different cheddars but it's really great if you use some freshly grated pecorini cheese as well in the mix

title: tahini substitution
steps: 1. Mix well

title: chuck wagon chili soup
steps:
1. Saute beef in a 5-quart pot over medium heat 4 minutes or until brown
2. Discard fat
3. Saute onions and garlic in pot 4 minutes or until soft
4. Stir in chili powder and cumin , then squash , broth and 1 extra cup water
5. Cover and gently boil 15 minutes until squash is almost tender
6. Add tomatoes and beans
7. Bring to a boil , reduce heat , cover and simmer 15 minutes
8. Top serving with cheddar cheese and scallions

title: chicken  leek and parsley pie
steps:
1. Poach chicken breasts in water seasoned with salt and pepper
2. Cool in the liquid , then cut in strips
3. Cut 1 / 4 cup margarine into flour and salt till it resembles coarse meal
4. Stir in yogurt just until dry ingredients are moistened
5. Cover with plastic wrap and chill for 30-40 minutes
6. Fry the leeks in margarine until soft
7. Stir in cheeses and parsley
8. Layer chicken and leek mixture in 9x11 inch pan
9. Mix mustard , flour , milk , salt and pepper
10. Pour over pie
11. Roll out dough and place on top of pie
12. Cut a slit for steam to escape
13. Bake at 400 for 30-40 minutes

title: mum s monday macaroni
steps:
1. Heat butter , saute onions until transparent
2. Place in 2 quart casserole
3. Add remaining ingredients
4. Stir well , breaking the tomatoes into small pieces
5. Bake at 350f for 65 mins or til macaroni is tender
6. Top with buttered crumbs during last 10 mins of baking if desired
7. Excellent meal with sausages and a salad

title: mexican pork pot pie with black beans and cornbread crust
steps:
1. Grease a 4-quart baking dish
2. For the filling: in a large skillet cook the onion , garlic , jalapeo pepper and green bell pepper in oil until the onion is softened
3. Add in ground pork
4. Cook until the pork is no longer pink , stirring and breaking the mixture up with a wooden spoon
5. Stir in tomato paste , thawed corn , black beans , cumin , allspice , chili powder , worcestershire sauce , tabasco sauce , cornmeal , salt and pepper
6. Mix well to combine , and bring to a simmer , stirring occasionally for about 35 minutes (adding in more tabasco sauce to taste
7. Spoon the mixture into prepared baking dish
8. To make the cornmeal crust: in a bowl sift together flour , cornmeal , sugar , baking powder and salt
9. Add in melted butter , milk and egg
10. Stir until just combined
11. Add in grated cheese and chili peppers
12. Spread or drop the batter by large spoonfuls around the edge of the casserole , or you can spread completely over the pork filling
13. If you are spreading the batter around the edge of the dish , you can sprinkle grated cheddar on top of the pork mixture in the middle of the dish , but that is optional
14. Bake in the second-lowest oven rack at 350 degrees for 35-40 minutes or until the cornmeal crust is baked and the filling is bubbly

title: yams and apples casserole
steps:
1. Toss apples with the brown sugar , cinnamon , nutmeg , allspice , and pecans
2. Layer with the yams that have been sliced smaller and rolled in melted butter
3. Cover
4. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 20 minutes
5. Uncover
6. Sprinkle with miniature marshmallows
7. Bake 20 minutes more , uncovered , until marshmallows are toasted , hot and bubbly

title: tortillas de harina   flour tortillas
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients
2. Make a hole in the middle of your mountain of flour
3. Add oil and water and start mixing
4. When the dough is firm enough , knead it a bit on a flat surface
5. Break pieces off the dough by squeezing it with your thumb and index finger
6. Make several round balls , and placed them on a floured surface
7. Let the testales rest for about 30 minutes covered with a damp towel
8. Place a testal on a floured surface
9. Flour your rolling pin and roll
10. Whatever technique you use for rolling just spread them enough so they are bout 6 inches in diameter
11. Cook your tortillas on a comal , flat griddle or skillet at medium heat
12. You dont need to oil the skillet
13. Just like with pancakes , the 1st one is never good , but the rest are delicious
14. You can pile up the uncooked tortillas , they wont stick
15. My process is usually: flatten , place in comal , flatten another one , turn the one in the comal , flatten another one , remove the one from the comal and repeat !
16. It takes about 1 minute to cook on the 1st side , then you turn and it takes about 30 seconds on the second side
17. Eat them warm , but to freeze or refrigerate , make sure you cool them spread out on a flat surface before bagging them

title: tasty banana bread
steps:
1. Set oven to 350
2. Spray loaf pan with cooking spray in a bowl stir together flour , baking powder , baking soda , cinnamon and salt
3. In another bowl stir together egg whites , banana , sugar , and oil
4. Pour dry ingredients into wet ingredients until mixture is just moistened
5. Pour into into prepared loaf pan
6. Bake for 45-50 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
7. Cool in pan for about 10 minutes
8. Remove and cool on wire rack
9. Wrap bread in plastic wrap and store overnight

title: mango cobbler
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Combine mangoes , lime juice , and nutmeg in a mixing bowl
3. Stir until mango is coated with lime and nutmeg
4. Spoom fruit into a greased 8 inch square pan
5. In another bowl combine flour , baking powder , salt and brown sugar
6. Mix well
7. Using a pastry cutter , cut the butter into the dry mix until it resembles a course meal
8. Stir in milk , mix until smooth
9. Spread batter evenly over fruit
10. Bake at 375f for 20-25 minutes or until lightly browned on top

title: one love marinade
steps: 1. Whisk all ingredients together and marinate as desired

title: cracked wheat buttermilk bread with sunflower seeds
steps:
1. Put cracked wheat into a small pot with 1 to 2 cups of water
2. Bring to a boil , reduce heat to medium and boil for 6 minutes
3. Remove from heat and drain well
4. Let cool about 15 minutes
5. Put cooked wheat into bread machine
6. Add all other ingredients as listed except for the sunflower seeds
7. If you don't have buttermilk , you can make a substitute by adding 1 tbsp lemon juice to one cup of whole milk
8. Stir and let sit for 5 minutes
9. Use amount called for in the recipe
10. Set bread machine for whole wheat bread
11. Press start
12. Add sunflower seeds at'addition' beep

title: all meat casserole
steps:
1. Put diced meat into casserole dish
2. Mix plain flour , sugar , tomatoe sauce , malt vinegar , pepper , salt , ground ginger , dry mustard , curry powder and mixed spice in a bowl and mix well to combine , slowly add stock and whisk till smooth
3. Pour over meat and leave overnight in the refrigerator if possible or at least 4 hours
4. Put in a 160 degree celsius fan forced oven and cook for 2 hours , stirring occasionally

title: vidalia onion bake
steps:
1. Slightly hollow out each onion
2. Arrange onions in small baking dish
3. Place 1 bouillon cube in each onion , top with butter and 1 tsp brown sugar
4. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes
5. These can also be made on the grill
6. Just double wrap in aluminum foil and grill until tender

title: ww stuffed strawberries  1 ww point
steps:
1. Cut an "x" in the
2. Place cream cheese and next 3 ingredients in a medium bowl , and beat with a mixer at medium speed until smooth
3. Place mixture in a small zip top plastic bag
4. Seal bag
5. Snip a small hole in one corner of bag
6. Pipe about 2 teaspoons cream cheese mixture into each strawberry
7. Serving size=1 strawberry

title: fruit   cheese tarts
steps:
1. Beat the cream cheese till soft and creamy , gradually add in the condensed milk
2. Blend until smooth and stir in lemon juice , lemon rind , vanilla and almond extracts
3. Add a little toasted coconut to the bottom of each tart shell
4. Cover with cream cheese mixture and chill for 2 hours , until mixture has set
5. Before serving add a strawberry slice , pineapple chunk and a large blackberry to each tart
6. Brush lightly with melted crab apple jelly
7. Any leftovers must be refrigerated

title: pound cake banana pudding
steps:
1. Whisk together 4 cups half-and-half , 4 egg yolks , 1 1 / 2 cup sugar , 1 / 4 cup cornstarch , and 1 / 4 tsp salt in a saucepan over medium-low heat
2. Cook , whisking constantly , 13 to 15 minutes or until thickened
3. Remove from heat
4. Stir in 3 tbsp butter and 2 tsp vanilla until butter melts
5. Layer half of pound cake cubes , half of bananas , and half of pudding mixture in 1 3-qt round baking dish
6. Repeat layers
7. Cover pudding , and chill for 6 hours
8. Remove pudding mixture from the refrigerator
9. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
10. Combine 1 / 4 cup sugar and 1 / 8 tsp salt
11. Beat 4 egg whites and 1 / 4 tsp vanilla at high speed with an electric mixer until foamy
12. Add sugar mixture , 1 tbsp at a time , and beat 2 to 3 minutes or until stiff peaks form and sugar dissolves
13. Spread meringue over pudding
14. Bake at 375 degrees for 15 minutes or until golden brown

title: not around  for long    peanut butter chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , cream butter , peanut butter and sugars
2. Beat in egg , milk and vanilla
3. Combine the flour , baking soda and salt
4. Add to creamed mixture and mix well
5. Stir in chocolate chips
6. Roll into 1-inch balls
7. Roll in additional sugar
8. Place 2 inches apart on baking stone
9. Flatten if desired
10. Bake at 375f for 7-9 minutes or until golden brown
11. Remove to wire racks to cool

title: sexy chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Toast pecans: spread pecans in shallow pan and toast at 350 degrees until fragrant and lightly toasted , about 10 minutes
2. Toast oatmeal: spread oatmeal in shallow pan and toast at 350 degrees , just until oatmeal begins to change color , 5-10 minutes
3. Watch closely
4. Let pecans and oatmeal completely cool
5. Turn oven to 325 degrees
6. Cream butter and both sugars until very light and fluffy
7. Add egg and vanilla and beat until smooth
8. In separate bowl , combine flour , baking soda , salt and toasted oatmeal
9. Fold into butter mixture by hand just until incorporated
10. Do not overmix
11. Lightly fold in both chocolates and pecans , if using
12. Use cookie scoop , place onto parchment-lined cookie sheets and press down with back of spoon to lightly flatten
13. Bake at 325x for 20 minutes until an even light golden color
14. Remove from baking sheet and let cool on rack
15. Makes 1 dozen big or 2 dozen small cookies

title: beefed up spanish orzo
steps:
1. Cook orzo according to package directions
2. Drain , and set aside
3. Meanwhile , in a large skillet , heat oil over high heat
4. Add beef , mushrooms , onion , garlic powder , and black pepper
5. Cook for 8-10 minutes , or until vegetables are tender and beef is no longer pink , stirring frequently
6. Add cooked orzo , spaghetti sauce , and salsa
7. Reduce heat to low and cook 3 to 5 minutes , or until heated through , stirring frequently
8. Garnish with olives and serve

title: jenna j
steps:
1. Pour all the ingredients on ice in a highball glass
2. Squeeze lime above the glass , then put them in the drink
3. Serve with long straws

title: marbled eggs with crabmeat filling
steps:
1. Bring water to boil , turn off heat , add tea and steep for 5 min
2. Roll eggs on counter to crack shells all over
3. Do not peel
4. Place eggs in tea , simmer 10 min
5. Remove from heat , let eggs cool in tea
6. Refrigerate eggs in cooled liquid at least 1 hour
7. Drain eggs , peel and blot dry
8. Cut in half , scoop out yolks
9. Mash and mix with remaining ingredients
10. Refill egg halves with yolk mixture

title: easy pizza dip
steps:
1. Blend all four ingredients together in a mixing bowl
2. Spread mixture in a pie pan and garnish top with a few whole slices of pepperoni
3. Bake at 350 degrees for about 45 minutes or until hot
4. Serve warm with tortilla chips

title: kraut topped mashed potato casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Lightly spray / grease a 13 x 9 baking dish
3. Set aside
4. Cut the potatoes into chunks and boil in salted water until tender
5. Drain the potatoes
6. Return to the pot and mash with the 1 tbsp butter , reduced-fat sour cream , milk , salt and pepper until mashed and fluffy
7. Spread mashed potatoes into bottom of prepared 13 x 9 baking pan
8. While potatoes boil , melt the 4 tbsp butter in a medium saucepan
9. Add the chopped onion and saute for about 5 minutes
10. Add the 2 packed tbsp of brown sugar
11. Stir to dissolve
12. Add the drained sauerkraut and pepper
13. Stir and cook for about 2 - 3 more minutes
14. Evenly spread the sauerkraut mixture over the mashed potatoes
15. Sprinkle with the caraway seeds
16. Bake uncovered at 375 for 25-30 minutes or until sauerkraut topping begins to slightly brown

title: leg of lamb stuffed with mushrooms and chevre
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Pound lamb out to about 1 1 / 2 inches thick
3. In a large saute pan heat butter over med heat and saute mushrooms until soft
4. Set mushrooms aside until later
5. Season lamb liberally with salt and pepper
6. Layer lamb with shallots , chevre and criminis
7. Roll the lamb into a log and tie with butchers twine
8. In a large saute pan , heat oil over med-high heat and sear lamb on all sides
9. Place lamb on wire rack with baking sheet underneath
10. Roast for about an hour until internal temp is reached
11. Let the lamb rest about 10 minute to prevent juice from running and it drying out

title: cookie pizza with peanut butter
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Lightly grease a 12 - 14 inch pizza pan
3. Combine flour , soda and salt
4. Set aside
5. Combine butter and sugars , mix together
6. Beat in egg , vanilla and add the flour mix
7. Stir in one-half of the chocolate chip package
8. Spread on the pan
9. Do not spread to the edges , leave a one inch space as the cookie will spread to the edge as it bakes
10. Bake 18 to 24 minutes or until lightly browned
11. Immediately add the rest of the chocolate chips from the package on top of the baked pizza
12. Drop spoonfuls of peanut butter on top
13. Let it rest for 5 minutes or until shiny and soft
14. Smooth out the melted chocolate and peanut butter and add the chopped candy pieces on top

title: christmas snow dessert
steps:
1. Mix above ingredients together
2. Put in dish and freeze

title: catfish tacos with tomato and avocado salsa
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Mix tomatoes , avocado , 2 tablespoons lime juice , onion , cilantro , and 2 teaspoons jalapeos in small bowl
3. Season with salt and pepper
4. Place fish in single layer on small rimmed baking sheet
5. Mix garlic , 3 tablespoons lime juice , and 1 teaspoon jalapeos in another small bowl
6. Drizzle half of lime juice mixture over fish
7. Reserve remainder
8. Sprinkle fish with salt and pepper
9. Let stand 15 minutes
10. Meanwhile , wrap tortillas in foil , enclosing completely
11. Place in oven until heated through , about 15 minutes
12. Preheat broiler
13. Broil fish just until opaque in center , about 6 minutes
14. Cut fish into 1-inch pieces
15. Top each tortilla with 1 / 2 cup lettuce , then fish pieces
16. Drizzle with reserved lime juice mixture
17. Spoon salsa over
18. Sprinkle with cheese

title: chicken   shiitake  mushroom basil pesto
steps:
1. Heat oil and butter over med high heat
2. Add chicken and cook till golden brown on both sides
3. Remove from heat and cut into bite size pieces
4. Set aside
5. Heat oil over med high heat
6. Add garlic
7. Saute till garlic starts to turn golden
8. Add mushrooms and saute till mushrooms are nice and soft
9. Add chicken and let flavors blend 3-4 minute
10. Add basil pesto and saute 3-4 min more
11. Toss with pasta and serve immediately !

title: peach cobbler chicken
steps:
1. Heat oil on medium - medium / high heat
2. Brown the chicken on both sides 4-5 mins per side
3. Remove chicken & set aside
4. Deglaze pan with chicken broth
5. Stir in frozen peaches
6. Let peaches simmer 3-5 mins to slightly defrost
7. Stir in peach butter / preserves
8. Return chicken to pan
9. Let simmer until chicken is completely done
10. Stir together water & enough cornstarch to make a slurry
11. Stir slurry into pan
12. Simmer for another 3-5 mins to thicken
13. Remove from heat & serve

title: pecan tassies
steps:
1. Beat flour , butter and cream cheese in bowl
2. Refrigerate 1 hour
3. Roll into 1" balls
4. Press each ball into greased wells of small muffin tin , forming cups
5. Set aside
6. Bring remaining ingredients to a boil
7. Pour hot mixture , 1 tbsp at a time , into cups
8. Bake in 400 oven for 12-15 minutes

title: flamenco eggs ii
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Warm 4 individual baking dishes
3. Heat oil in a large frying pan and fry the bacon and chorizo , to give off fat
4. Add onion and garlic and cook gently till softened , stirring
5. Add the peppers and tomatoes and cook and reduce , stirring occasionally
6. Add some paprika and sherry - mixture must not be too dry
7. Divide the vegetable mixture evenly among the baking dishes
8. Sprinkle with parsley
9. Swirl the eggs together with a fork , without overmixing and season with slat and cayenne
10. Pour over the vegetable mixture
11. Bake the eggs and vegetables for 8 minutes or till the eggs are just set
12. Meanwhile , make fried breadcrumbs: cut the crusts off the bread and reduce to crumbs in a food processor , or use a hand grater
13. Heat plenty of oil in a large frying pan over high heat , add the garlic cloves for a few moments to flavor it , then remove and discard
14. Throw in the crumbs and brown quickly , scooping them on to a paper towel with a slotted spoon
15. Season with a little salt and paprika , then sprinkle around the edge of the eggs when ready

title: chicken and sweet potato croquettes
steps:
1. Boil both potatoes together until tender , drain into large bowl and mash
2. Stir in onions , seasoning , cheese , butter and chicken
3. Mix well
4. Shape mixture into 18 croquettes
5. Cover
6. Refrigerate 30 minutes
7. Toss croquettes in flour , shake away excess
8. Dip croquettes in eggs , then crumbs
9. Shallow-fry croquettes in batches , in hot oil until browned
10. Drain on absorbent paper

title: easy iraqi green beans with meat
steps:
1. Saute the lamb in the oil until lightlly browned
2. Add the onion and water and cook for 35 minutes over medium heat
3. Add the green beans and cook for 10 minutes
4. Add the tomato sauce , salt and arabic spice mixture and cook for 10-15 more minutes
5. Serve with rice
6. You can also make this with other vegetables , such as cauliflower and / or potatoes
7. With cauliflower the cooking time would probably be a little less
8. Arabic spice mixture :
9. 1 table
10. Ground black pepper , 2 table
11. Ground allspice , 2 table
12. Ground cinnamon , 1 / 4 table
13. Ground cloves , 1 / 4 table
14. Ground cardamom , 1 / 4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
15. Mix together and store in the freezer
16. Use as needed

title: mustard sauce for corned beef
steps:
1. Mix the egg , mustard and sugar together
2. Add the vinegar and beef liquor
3. Heat gently without boiling
4. Serve hot or cold with hot or cold corned beef

title: rainy day mocha malt  hot drink
steps:
1. Place instant breakfast mix and instant coffee in mug
2. Add hot milk and stir until mix is dissolved

title: chicken monterey
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees
2. Lightly grease a medium baking dish
3. Melt 1 / 4 cup butter in medium skillet over medium heat
4. Stir in onion , mushrooms and garlic
5. Cook until tender , about 10 minutes
6. Stir in 2 tablespoons flour
7. Saut a few minutes more
8. Stir in stock , celery salt , white pepper and white wine
9. Reduce heat to low , and cook , stirring frequently , until thickened and well blended , about 10 minutes
10. Mix 1 / 2 cup monterey jack cheese into the thickened sauce mixture and stir until melted
11. Set aside
12. In a shallow bowl mix flour , salt & pepper
13. Dredge chicken in flour mixture to coat
14. Melt 1 / 4 cup butter in a large skillet
15. Have butter very hot--you just want to slightly brown
16. Arrange chicken in baking dish and cover with sauce
17. Top chicken and sauce with remaining 1 cup cheese
18. Bake in preheated oven 25 minutes , or until chicken is no longer pink
19. I put the pepper flakes in the broth
20. Hope you enjoy as much as we did

title: linguine with asparagus and goat cheese
steps:
1. Put water for linguine or spaghetti on to boil
2. Snap off tough ends of asparagus
3. Remove scales from stalks with a knife or vegetable peeler , if desired
4. Cut asparagus into 1-inch pieces
5. Set aside
6. Combine chicken broth , white wine , chopped shallots , pepper , and bell pepper in a saucepan
7. Bring to a boil
8. Add asparagus
9. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes
10. Add cheeses and lemon juice
11. Cook over low heat , stirring constantly , until cheeses melt
12. Set aside
13. Keep warm
14. Cook pasta according to package directions , omitting salt and fat
15. Drain
16. Place pasta in a serving bowl
17. Add asparagus mixture and sweet red pepper
18. Toss gently
19. Serve immediately

title: spaghetti with herb sauce
steps:
1. Saute garlic in olive oil in large sauce pan over medium heat for 3 minutes
2. Add broth and simmer for about 15 minutes
3. Meanwhile , start boiling water for pasta , cook according to instructions on package and drain
4. Add tomatoes , onion , bell pepper and herbs to broth and simmer for 10 minutes more
5. Pour sauce over pasta and serve

title: awesome rice pilaf
steps:
1. Melt butter in dutch oven
2. Add rice , onion , and celery
3. Cook on medium heat till rice is light brown with a nutty aroma stirring often
4. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
5. Add rest of ingredients , almost over season to taste
6. Bring to boil on medium heat
7. Turn off heat
8. Cover tightly with foil then put lid on top
9. Bake for 45 minutes then remove from oven and let rest for 15 minutes
10. Take lid and foil off , fluff with fork and serve

title: heavy metal filet steak sandwich
steps:
1. Slice filets through the middle , horizontally , to end up with 4 thinner filets about 1 / 2 inch thick each
2. Cook filets on a hot grill for 2-4 minutes per side , or until cooked to your preference
3. Salt and pepper both sides of each filet
4. Slice rolls in half horizontally
5. Spread the mayonnaise on the cut side of the top halves
6. Spread the mustard on the cut side of the bottom halves
7. When the filets are done , slice them into 1 / 2-inch-thick strips
8. Arrange the sliced filets evenly over the mustard on each bottom roll
9. Place the tomato slices over the filets
10. Put the shredded lettuce on top of the tomatoes
11. Place the top buns on the lettuce and slice the sandwiches diagonally into two even halves
12. Hold each sandwich half together with toothpicks to serve

title: apple mango salsa
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a bowl
2. Chill before serving

title: strawberry jell o cake
steps:
1. Stir together the strawberry jell-o and hot water until dissolved
2. Add the frozen strawberries
3. Stir into the jell-o mixture and chill until just starting to thicken
4. Add the angel food cake and marshmallows
5. Mix well
6. Pour into nonstick sprayed tube pan with a removable center
7. Press the mixture down firmly with a spoon
8. Refrigerate until set
9. Just before serving , unmold and use cool whip as icing
10. Garnish with fresh strawberries

title: hot sweet and creamy cocoa
steps:
1. Whisk sugar , cocoa , and 3 tablespoons milk together in a small saucepan over low heat until smooth
2. Stir in 1 / 2 cup each of milk and cream and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat
3. For extra richness , stir in 1 tablespoon bittersweet chocolate
4. Or add spice with a tiny sprinkle of cayenne pepper
5. Top with marshmallows
6. Enjoy !

title: citrus marinated feta and olives
steps:
1. Whisk together first 5 ingredients in a medium glass bowl
2. Gently stir in olives and cheese
3. Cover and chill 24 hours

title: beet greens with bacon and onion
steps:
1. Heat the oil on medium-high heat
2. Saute the garlic and onion until they are translucent
3. Reduce heat to medium and add the beet greens
4. Stir until all the greens are wilted and heated
5. Add the white wine and bacon
6. Cook for another 2-3 minutes
7. Serve with salt and fresh ground black pepper

title: hawaiian flanken short ribs made in clay pot
steps:
1. Soak unglazed clay pot ( top and bottom
2. In water for 20 minutes - use a medium size one
3. Combine 1st 8 ingredients into a paste
4. Rub paste all over and on all sides of short ribs
5. Put into soaked pot and pour broth over
6. Put cover over and place into a cold oven
7. Turn up to 400f cook for 3 hours

title: chipotle hummus  spicy
steps:
1. Puree all ingredients in a food processor or blender until mostly smooth
2. Add more peppers and salt for additional heat , if desired
3. Serve chilled
4. Store refrigerated wtih olive oil drizzled on top

title: grated carrots with cumin orange dressing
steps:
1. Place cumin in a small skillet
2. Cook over medium heat 2 minutes or until toasted and fragrant , stirring frequently
3. Combine cumin and remaining ingredients in a bowl
4. Cover and chill
5. Serve cold 1 / 2 cup servings

title: nadav s delicious challah
steps:
1. Place all the ingredients in a bowl and knead until a good smooth dough has been achieved
2. You can either do this by hand or in a counter-top mixer with a dough hook
3. Place the dough in a bowl and let rise for one hour
4. During this one hour , punch down and knead the dough every 15 minutes
5. Divide the dough into the amount of loaves you want , then divide each piece into 3 and start braiding
6. Place the braids on a baking sheet covered with parchment paper
7. Brush with egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds
8. Let rise for another 1 / 2 an hour
