9. In the meantime , preheat the oven to 150 degrees c
10. Bake the braids for 1 / 2 an hours
11. The dough is almost idiot-proof
12. It comes out smooth and gorgeous and the challahs are amazing
13. Very addictive

title: macaroni and chicken casserole
steps:
1. In large pan , melt butter
2. Stir in flour
3. Add milk and broth
4. Stir until smooth
5. Cook and stir for 3 minutes
6. Remove from heat and add the cheese
7. Stir until melted
8. Add macaroni and next 4 ingredients
9. Pour into 3 quart baking dish
10. Bake , uncovered at 350f for 40 minutes
11. Remove from oven and let sit for 5 minutes before serving

title: awesome crock pot lasagna
steps:
1. Brown meat and onion in large skillet , drain off excess fat
2. Add garlic , mushrooms , salt , wine , spaghetti sauce , paste , and tomato sauce to the meat mixture
3. Mix well
4. Set aside
5. In a medium bowl , combine egg , ricotta cheese , parmesan cheese and parsley flakes , set aside
6. Spray crock pot with cooking oil
7. Layer the bottom of a 5 to 6 quart crock pot with 4 noodles , broken into pieces to fit
8. Spread half of the ricotta cheese mixture over the noodles
9. Top with 1 / 4 of the meat mixture and 1 / 4 of the shredded cheese
10. Top with 4 noodles , remaining cheese mixture , 1 / 4 of the meat mixture and 1 / 4 shredded cheese
11. Top with remaining 4 noodles and remaining meat mixture
12. Cover
13. Cook on low setting for 6 to 8 hours
14. About 10 minutes before serving , sprinkle top of lasagna with remaining shredded cheese
15. Cover
16. Let stand 10 minutes or until cheese is melted

title: rib eye steaks w  mushrooms  brandy and blue cheese
steps:
1. Place steaks in shallow dish , drizzle with olive oil and rub the oil all over the steaks
2. Sprinkle steaks with salt and pepper and let stand at room temperature for one hour
3. Melt butter in heavy medium skillet over medium-high heat
4. Add onion and saute until beginning to soften , about 3 minutes
5. Add mushrooms and garlic
6. Saute until mushrooms are just tender , about 4 minutes
7. Heat heavy large skillet over medium-high heat
8. Add steaks to skillet
9. Fry until cooked to desired doneness
10. Transfer steaks to plates
11. Tent loosely with tin foil to keep warm
12. Add broth , then brandy and rosemary to same large skillet
13. Bring to boil , scraping up browned bits
14. Add mushroom mixture
15. Boil until liquid is thick enough to coat spoon lightly , about 5 minutes
16. Add 1 cup blue cheese
17. Stir just until cheese melts , about 1 minute
18. Season sauce to taste with salt and pepper
19. Spoon sauce over steaks
20. Sprinkle with remaining blue cheese
21. Garnish with rosemary sprigs if desired

title: pork chops in mustard mushroom sauce
steps:
1. In a small saucepan cook shallot in 1 tablespoon oil over moderate heat , stirring until softened
2. Add mushrooms and saute over moderately high heat , stirring , until liquid mushrooms give off is evaporated
3. Add wine or vermouth and boil until liquid is reduced to about 2 tablespoons
4. Stir in cream , thyme , and salt and pepper to taste and simmer just until sauce is thickened
5. Stir in mustard and keep sauce warm over very low heat
6. Pat pork chops dry with paper towels and season with salt and pepper
7. Heat remaining 1 teaspoon oil in a 10-inch skillet until hot but not smoking and saute chops until golden and just cooked through , 2-3 minutes on each side
8. Divide chops between 2 plates and spoon sauce over them

title: baked spaghetti by paula deen
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a stockpot , combine the tomatoes , tomato sauce , water , onions , peppers , garlic , parsley , seasoning mixtures , sugar , and bay leaves
3. Bring to a boil over high heat , and then reduce the heat and let simmer , covered , for 1 hour
4. Crumble the ground beef in a large skillet
5. Cook over medium-high heat until fully cooked , with no pink color remaining
6. Drain the fat from the meat , and then add the ground beef to the stockpot
7. Simmer for 20 more minutes
8. Cook the pasta according to the package directions
9. Cover the bottom of a 13 by 9 by 2-inch pan with sauce
10. Add a layer of pasta and then a little less than 1 / 2 of each cheese
11. Repeat the layers , ending with the sauce
12. Bake in the oven for 30 minutes
13. Top the casserole with the remaining cheese , return it to the oven , and continue to cook until the cheese is melted and bubbly , about 5 more minutes
14. Cut into squares before serving
15. House seasoning: mix ingredients together and store in an airtight container for up to 6 months

title: mom s pizza subs with ham
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 500 degrees f
2. Mix melted butter and garlic powder
3. Brush onto sub rolls
4. Bake in preheated oven about 3-5 minutes , or until rolls are crispy around the edges
5. Remove from oven
6. Top bottom halves of rolls with equal amounts of ham , sauce and cheese , in that order
7. Top with top halves of rolls and return to the oven
8. Bake another 3-5 minutes , but watch very closely
9. The cheese should melt , but don't burn the bread !

title: chuck roast
steps:
1. Put chuck roast into the crock pot and add water and the dry ingredient
2. Let it sit on low overnight for 8 hours
3. Then add chopped celery , carrots , and potatoes for another 10-12 hours

title: stamp  mold butter cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Cream butter and sugar
3. Beat in egg and vanilla
4. Add flour one cup at a time
5. The dough will be stiff
6. Make 1 1 / 2" balls
7. Flatten with a cookie stamp
8. Bake for 12-15 minute

title: sweet potato and peanut soup
steps:
1. Heat oil , and saute onions in a heavy-based stockpot
2. Add garlic and cumin , and stir-fry 30 seconds over medium heat
3. Add chopped sweet potato , cover and cook for 10 minutes over low heat , stirring occasionally to prevent sticking
4. Add chicken stock , bring to boil , then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes
5. Add peanut butter and chili sauce , and mix into the soup thoroughly
6. Simmer uncovered for 20 to 30 minutes , stirring occasionally , until vegetables are tender
7. Puree with a hand-held blender , such as a bamix , until the sweet potato is almost smooth
8. Serve immediately , garnished with chopped peanuts and chives or cilantro

title: carrot salad  old school
steps:
1. Grind first three ingredients -- as in that old iron one that you attach to the table and grind by hand
2. I guess you could use a food processor shredd attachment
3. Add miracle whip
4. Can it be easier than that ?

title: fruit yogurt swirl
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in container of an electric blender
2. Cover and process until smooth
3. Pour into glasses , and serve immediately

title: sliwka naleczowska w czekoladzie    polish chocolate plums
steps:
1. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil or waxed paper
2. Microwave the chocolate until melted , stirring after every 45 seconds to prevent overheating
3. Stir until the chocolate is smooth , and allow it to sit and cool slightly while you prepare the prunes
4. Insert the almonds into the centers of the prunes , one nut per prune
5. Dip each of the prunes into the chocolate , submerging it completely
6. Remove from the chocolate , dragging the bottom along the lip of the bowl to remove the excess chocolate
7. Place candy on the prepared baking sheet and , if desired , sprinkle the top with crushed nuts while the chocolate is still wet
8. Once all of the prunes are on the baking sheet , refrigerate it for 30 minutes to set the chocolate , then serve
9. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to one week

title: grandma helen s struffoli
steps:
1. Mix all dry ingredients together in a large bowl
2. Add all liquid ingredients to dry to form a dough
3. Knead dough well to incorporate all ingredients
4. For balls roll dough out in 1 / 4 inch round strips like pencils
5. Cut the pieces at small intervals with an angle cut
6. How far apart you make the cut is your judgment call , as the smaller the spacing the smaller the balls and vice versa
7. Mom likes the look leaving them as is with the angle cut giving a unique shape to the balls as they fry
8. If you prefer perfectly rounded balls , you can roll the pieces in the palms of your hands like miniature meatballs before frying
9. For ribbons cut some of the dough in flat strips about 1 / 2 inch wide preferably using a crimped edge cutting wheel as it gives a fancy serrated edge to them
10. Form loops or bow shapes with the ribbons and deep fry balls and ribbons separately until golden brown
11. Drain on absorbent paper
12. Heat honey in a deep pot until it starts to thin out and become pourable
13. Remove from heat
14. Dip bows and ribbons in warm honey and set aside
15. Add balls to the honey and toss to coat
16. Transfer balls to holiday platter and top with the ribbons and bows
17. Or you can mound the balls to look like a christmas tree and decorate with bows on the sides
18. Sprinkle with multi colored sprinkles

title: chili mango salad
steps:
1. Rinse , drain and boil the shirataki for five minutes
2. Drain and rinse well with cold water
3. Cut the noodles into bite size pieces
4. Toss the noodles with the cabbage and coleslaw mix
5. Combine vinegar , soy sauce , sesame oil , galangal , sriracha hot chili sauce , yeo's sweet chili sauce and splenda
6. Pour liquid mixture over veggie mixture and toss to coat
7. Slice mango into cubed chunks and add to the mixture
8. If any juice gathers on the cutting board , pour it inches toss
9. Refrigerate at least an hour before serving

title: hawaiian glazed veggies stir fry
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a wok over high heat just until smoking point , about 1 minute
2. Add red pepper and red onion
3. Stir-fry 2 minutes
4. Add bamboo shoots and cook 1 minute , stirring
5. Add water to prevent sticking
6. Add pineapple wedges and cook 1 minute
7. Stir in broccoli
8. Cook 4 minutes or until bright green
9. Combine tamari and juice in a small cup
10. Add tamari / juice mixture to veggies
11. Cook 1 to 2 minutes , stirring to coat

title: stir fried beef  n green beans
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine cornstarch , soy sauce , water , ginger , garlic and 2 t oil until smooth
2. Set aside 1 / 2 cup of this mixture
3. Pour the remaining marinade into a large resealable plastic bag and add the beef
4. Seal bag and turn to coat , then refrigerate for 30 minutes
5. Drain and discard marinade from beef
6. In wok or skillet , stir fry beef in remaining oil for about 5 minutes or until no longer pink
7. Remove and keep warm
8. In same skillet , stir fry the beans , sugar and salt for 15 minutes or until crisp tender
9. Stir in the beef and reserved marinade
10. Bring to a boil
11. Cook and stir for 2 minutes until thickened

title: real simple s spring pea salad
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine the mint , capers , shallot , zest , oil , salt , and pepper
2. Add the peas and goat cheese and toss gently
3. Serve at room temperature

title: irish italian spaghetti
steps:
1. Fry hamburger and onion until hamburger is browned
2. Drain and add mushrooms
3. Add rest ingredients and simer 20 minutes
4. Boil spaghetti noodles and drain
5. Pour sauce onto noodles

title: roasted chili and portabello quesadillas
steps:
1. Roast chilis in the oven or on the grill , seed , chop and set aside
2. Saute mushrooms in olive oil till tender
3. You can brush them with oil and grill them whole , then chop
4. On a skillet over medium high heat , sprinkle 1 tortilla with cheese
5. Top cheese with mushrooms and chilis
6. Top with another tortilla
7. Heat both sides til crisp
8. Cut into triangles and serve warm
9. We like to dunk into sour cream , guacamole or salsa

title: tuna with pineapple and peppers
steps:
1. In small bowl stir together the soy sauce , garlic , pineapple juice and ginger
2. Place the tune steaks in a shallow dish and pour half the marinade over them
3. Flip to coat both sides
4. Place the peppers and pineapple in another dish and cover with remaining marinade
5. Toss lightly to coat
6. Cover both dishes and marinate in refrigerator for at least an hour
7. Coat broiler pan with non-stick cooking spray
8. Place the tuna steaks , pineapple and peppers on pan and broil for approximately 4-5 minutes per side
9. You may use the marinade from the pineapple and peppers to baste while cooking
10. Do not use the marinade from the tuna

title: grandma geldner s famous inhalers
steps:
1. Melt white chocolate and peanut butter together in a double boiler
2. Add remaining ingredients and mix well
3. Drop by tablesponfuls onto parchment lined cookie sheets and let cool

title: kahlua crystallized nuts
steps:
1. Place nuts in shallow pan and toast in 300 degree oven for 20 mins
2. , stirring once
3. Turn into a lightly buttered hot metal bowl or large saucepan
4. In 1 qt
5. Saucepan , combine remaining ingredients and bring to a boil , stirring until sugar dissolves
6. Insert candy thermometer
7. Bring to hard crack stage
8. Pour over toasted nuts , stir with a buttered metal spoon to coat evenly
9. Spread in a single layer , on buttered jelly roll pan
10. Cool
11. Separate into small chunks
12. Store in airtight container
13. Makes about 5 cups

title: nutella pear panini
steps:
1. Spread one side of each slice of bread with butter and the other side with nutella
2. Top with pear slices
3. Depending on the size of your bread , you may only need half the pear
4. Cook in sandwich press or in a skillet with another heavy skillet or foil-wrapped brick as a weight
5. This would probably be equally good with bananas , and i've also thought a little cream cheese might work well with this

title: cacciatore pizza
steps:
1. Chicken cacciatore:
2. Slice mushrooms and onion , crush garlic
3. Heat oil in pan , fry chicken pieces until golden brown
4. Remove from pan , drain well
5. Add onion , mushrooms and garlic to pan , saute until onion is tender
6. Return chicken to the pan , add ndrained , mashed tomatoes , bayleaf and wine
7. Cook slowly , covered , for 45 minutes , or until chicken is tender
8. Remove bay leaf and leave cacciatore to cool
9. Remove chicken from the bones and shred
10. Stir back into the sauce
11. Spread 2 cups of chicken cacciatore over the pizza base
12. Sprinkle cheeses over the top
13. Bake at 180c for 20 minutes

title: peanut butter melt  away cake
steps:
1. Combine margarine , baking cocoa , water , eggs , and buttermilk in sauce pan mix well
2. Bring to a boil , stirring often , remove from heat
3. Add sugar , flour , vanilla , baking soda and salt , beat well
4. Pour into greased and floured 9 by 13 cake pan
5. Bake at 350 for 30 ninutes , cool
6. Spread with melted peanut butter
7. Chill until firm
8. Combine margarine and baking cocoa in sauce pan , bring to a boil
9. Add confectioners sugar , buttermilk , vanilla and peanut butter
10. Beat until smooth , pour over cake
11. Chill until ready to serve

title: white castle turkey stuffing
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , tear the burgers into pieces and add diced celery and seasonings
2. Toss and add chicken broth
3. Toss well
4. Stuff cavity of turkey just before roasting
5. Makes about 9 cups

title: nannan s potato salad
steps:
1. To hasten cooking time in a busy holiday kitchen i boil the potatoes in their skin in a pressure cooker
2. You can boil them in a large pot with a lid if you don't have one
3. Chill potatoes in the refrigerator , skin , and cube into large bowl
4. Pour entire contents of the jar of olives , chopped onions and mayonnaise in with the potatoes
5. Stir until the olive juice and mayo are well blended and the olives have begun breaking apart
6. Cover and chill for 1 hour
7. As nannan was orating this recipe to me i was shocked at how much mayonnaise she used -- but here in texas i should have known that most of the old timers seldom consider cholesterol
8. Unfortunately they usually make the best food so i'll keep using a "tub" of mayo when i make this , and you can feel free to use less if you like
9. She does swear the secret is hellman's brand mayonnaise or a cheap brand which lends more creaminess to the recipe then flavor

title: chunky chile cornbread
steps:
1. 1
2. Beat together sour cream , milk , egg whites and oil
3. 2
4. Combine in separate bowl , brown sugar , flour , cornmeal , baking powder and salt
5. 3
6. Drain corn and green chiles
7. 4
8. Combine wet ingredients with the dry ingredients and fold in corn and green chiles
9. 5
10. Transfer into a greased 8 x 8 baking pan
11. 6
12. Bake for 30-35 minutes at 350 degree
13. Make sure you let the cornbread rest for 10 minutes before enjoying

title: four bean salad
steps:
1. Drain the beans and mix beans , onion , green pepper , celery and cauliflower together
2. In a separate bowl , mix all the dressing ingredients stirring well to dissolve the sugar and salt
3. Pour the dressing over the salad mixture - stir to coat
4. Cover and chill several hours stirring occasionally

title: mais soep   corn soup
steps:
1. Chop the corn , add boiling water and minced onion
2. Cook for 15 minutes
3. Strain
4. Melt the butter and stir in the flour
5. Blend well
6. Add milk and seasonings
7. Cook , stirring constantly for five minutes
8. Stir in strained corn pulp and continue cooking for ten minutes
9. Serve hot

title: potato cheese pierogies
steps:
1. Bring water to boil and cook the potatoes until they are tender
2. Drain and mash in a medium bowl
3. Add the cheeses and lemon juice , mustard , dill and pepper
4. Mix well and set aside
5. Combine flour , salt and nutmeg in a mixing bowl
6. Cut the butter into the flour until well blended
7. Add eggs and knead until smooth
8. Divide into 16 balls
9. Meanwhile , bring water to a boil
10. Roll out each ball into a circle
11. Place 1 tablespoons filling on one side , leaving a border
12. Fold in half and press edges with a fork to seal
13. Cook in the boiling water until they rise to the top
14. Serve with sour cream , butter and paprika

title: creamy pineapple pie
steps:
1. In a bowl , mix milk , pineapple , and lemon juice
2. Fold in whipped topping
3. Pour into the crust
4. Chill or freeze until firm
5. Let sit at room temperature to soften just slightly before slicing to serve

title: swordfish  or halibut  with a cumin crust
steps:
1. Preheat the broiler to medium or prepare the barbecue
2. To make the spice rub , roughly crush all the spices together in a pestle and mortar or in a bowl using the end of a rolling pin
3. Add a little salt if desired
4. Cook under the broiler or on the barbecue for 8-10 minutes on each side , or until the fish flakes and is just cooked and the outside is golden and crisp
5. Combine all the salsa ingredients in a bowl , cover and chill until needed
6. Serve the fish with a spoonful of salsa , a green salad , and lime wedges for squeezing over

title: almond cigar
steps: 1. Shake ingredients well and pour into a daiquiri glass , garnish with a stick of cinnamon wrapped with a lime peel

title: italian pizza bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Spray 8" x 4" loaf pan
3. Mix together bisquick , egg white , water and garlic powder
4. Spread in pan
5. Cook pepper and onion in nonstick skillet over medium-high heat , stirring frequently , until onion is tender
6. Stir in chicken , tomatoes and seasoning
7. Heat through
8. Spoon over batter in pan
9. Sprinkle with cheese
10. Bake 20-23 minutes or until golden brown
11. Loosen from sides of pan

title: lemon streusel pull aparts
steps:
1. Mix grated lemon rind with sugar
2. Cut rolls in half and place in a 12 inch deep dish pizza pan or a 9x13 inch baking pan sprayed with non-stick cooking spray
3. Drizzle 1 / 4 cup melted butter over bread dough rolls
4. Sprinkle with lemon rind / sugar mixture , reserving 1 / 2 of the mixture to sprinkle on just before baking
5. Cover with sprayed plastic wrap and let rise until double in size
6. Remove wrap
7. Sprinkle on the remaining mixture
8. Bake at 350 degree oven for 20-25 minutes
9. Remove immediately from the pan and place on cooling rack
10. Combine powdered sugar , butter and lemon juice
11. Mix well
12. Drizzle glaze over pull-aparts and serve !

title: sugar  n  spice pork tenderloin from the james beard house
steps:
1. To brine the pork , combine all of the ingredients for the brine in deep bowl
2. Trim the pork tenderloin of all silverskin and place in the bowl
3. Cover and refrigerate for 12 hours
4. To finish the pork , combine the brown sugar , cinnamon , star anise , szechuan peppercorns , salt , and pepper in a spice or coffee grinder and process until ground to a powder
5. Preheat the own to 350f
6. Remove the pork from the brine and pat dry
7. Coat the pork with the spice mixture , pressing it on to form an even crust
8. Heat the olive oil in an ovenproof pan and sear the pork on all sides
9. Place the pan in the oven and roast pork for about 20 minutes , or until the pork has reached the desired doneness
10. To serve , carve the pork into 1 / 2-inch-thick slices

title: sesame soy salad dressing
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a 2 cup jar and shake well to dissolve
2. Store in refrigerator for up to 3 weeks

title: mom s simple   sweet strawberry sauce
steps:
1. Slice strawberries and put into a saucepan on medium heat along with the sugar
2. Keep heating until the sugar is gone , the strawberries are a little softer , and the syrup is at the bottom
3. Now you can use this delicious sauce for almost anything , it's even good warm off the stove plain !

title: clean eating sunomono salad
steps:
1. Cook quinoa according to package directions
2. Set aside to cool slightly
3. Finely slice cucumbers into 1 / 8-inch or thinner pieces and place in medium mixing bowl
4. In a small bowl , combine soy sauce , vinegar and oil
5. Pour over cucumber slices and toss together
6. Divide quinoa among 4 salad plates and place cucumber slices on top
7. In a small mixing bowl , combine crab meat with lemon juice
8. Divide evenly on top of cucumber slices
9. Refrigerate for 2-3 hours for best flavor
10. Can be kept in the refrigerator for up to 4 days
11. Garnish with cilantro immediately before serving

title: sarasota s minnesota turkey  mushroom and wild rice soup
steps:
1. Soup base -- in a large pot , melt the butter and add the leeks , onions , celery , fennel and garlic and cook on medium heat until slightly translucent and soft
2. About 5 minutes
3. Rice -- add the rice right to the vegetable mixture and stir until well combined - then add the broth , thyme , rosemary , worcestershire and bay leaf
4. Cover and cook on low heat approximately 30 minutes until the rice is somewhat tender
5. Once again , taste for seasoning and add more broth if necessary
6. It depends on how thin or thick you like your soup
7. The soup still has a bit more time to cook which will allow the rice to finish cooking
8. Mushrooms -- at this point , add the sherry wine and mushrooms and continue to cook another 15-20 minutes until the rice is tender and the mushrooms are soft
9. Finish -- everything is done - now to finish off the soup
10. First , add in the turkey or chicken
11. And add the heavy cream to the soup
12. Increase the heat to medium and bring to a light boil and then reduce to a simmer for 5 minutes
13. Stir and add in any additional seasoning if necessary and the fresh parsley
14. Serve -- my favorite way to serve this is with a toasted baguette with melted gruyere cheese
15. Now , if you happen to have truffle oil -- drizzle a little on top , it is heaven
16. Can't get much better than that ! enjoy !

title: fruity frozen lemonade
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients in a blender
2. Pour into a tall glass , pop in a straw and enjoy !

title: mexican style rice  sopa seca
steps:
1. In a large heatproof bowl , pour boiling water over the rice enough to cover
2. Stir only once , and let stand 10 minutes
3. Transfer to a colander over the sink and rinse rice under cold water
4. Drain again
5. Set rice aside , spread out on a cookie sheet to dry slightly
6. In the meantime , put the tomatoes , onion , garlic and half of chili pepper into a food processor or blender
7. Process until smooth like salsa
8. Set tomato mixture aside
9. Heat the olive oil over medium heat in a large , heavy saute pan and cook rice until a light golden brown color
10. Stir constantly so that rice does not burn , scraping bottom of pan with spatula because the rice grains will stick
11. Next add the pureed tomato mixture and keep stirring over medium heat until all the liquid is absorbed , about 10 minutes
12. If mixture starts to boil , reduce heat
13. Stir in the stock , salt , and green peas
14. Continue to cook the mixture on low-medium heat stirring occasionally until all liquid is absorbed and rice is tender , another 10-15 minutes
15. Be careful not to burn
16. The original directions say to remove pan from heat , cover with tight-fitting lid
17. Letting stand in a warm place 10 minutes or so
18. I remove pan from heat , cover and place pan in low oven , at approximately 150-200 degrees
19. Sometimes i'll let the rice set in the oven for a good hour or longer , as long as the rice grains are tender and rice doesn't dry out too much
20. Transfer the cooked rice to a serving platter , fluff with fork and serve sprinkled with freshly ground black pepper
21. Garnish with thinly sliced chilis or serve on side

title: pureed asparagus soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan combine the asparagus , shallot , potatoes , vegetable broth , mint and lemon zest
2. Bring them to a boil over medium-high heat
3. Cover , reduce the heat to medium-low , and simmer until the potatoes are tender enough to puree , about 20 minutes
4. Puree the soup with an immersion blender , or in a food processor
5. If using a food processor , transfer the soup back to the saucepan
6. Heat the soup to warm it through
7. Season with salt and pepper and garnish each serving with a sprinkle of chives and scallion greens

title: potato and garlic soup with herbs
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in heavy large saucepan over medium heat
2. Add onion , saut until golden , about 10 minutes
3. Add broth , potatoes , garlic and bay leaf
4. Bring to boil
5. Reduce heat to medium-low
6. Cover and simmer until potatoes are very tender , about 20 minutes
7. Cool slightly
8. Discard bay leaf
9. Coarsely puree soup in blender 1 cup at a time , about 20 seconds per batch
10. Return soup to same saucepan
11. Season to taste with salt and pepper
12. Simmer until heated through
13. Ladle soup into bowls
14. Sprinkle with chives and thyme and serve

title: my kfc coleslaw re make
steps:
1. Mix 1 / 4 cup of the divided milk with the vinegar and lemon juice in a glass
2. "stir well" and let sit , "undisturbed" , for 5 minutes
3. Meanwhile , in a large glass or plastic bowl , thoroughly mix together the remaining 1 / 4 cup milk with the miracle whip , sugar , salt , pepper , celery seed and dried onion
4. Now your butter milk should be ready , so mix that in well , also
5. Now for the veggies
6. You can either put the bag of coleslaw mix into a food processor to dice it up very tiny , or leave it shredded the way it is packaged
7. Your choice
8. Gently stir the slaw mix into the dressing until completely coated
9. It will look very dry , and you will probably not like it if you eat it right away
10. Cover the glass or plastic bowl tightly with plastic wrap and leave it sit for a full 24 hours
11. Stir at least once overnight
12. Next day , remove from the fridge , stir to moisten and serve
13. Enjoy !

title: cucumber basil egg salad
steps:
1. Gently combine the eggs , cucumbers , shallots , green onions , and basil in a medium bowl
2. Stir in the mayonnaise , salt , and pepper

title: crab boil potatoes
steps:
1. Place the potatoes in a pot and add just enough water to cover the potatoes
2. Add the crab boil
3. Bring the water to a rolling boil then add tony chacheres and the hot sauce
4. Allow the potatoes to boil until they are fork-tender
5. Drain the potatoes and allow them to sit for 5 minutes or so
6. You can serve these hot , or allow them to cool and serve them at room temperature

title: hungarian pancakes  palacsinta
steps:
1. Beat eggs well
2. Add milk , salt , sugar , and vanilla , gradually add sifted flour beating until smooth a a thin batter
3. Heat small frying pan
4. Spray lightly with pam
5. Pour in enough batter to cover pan with very thin layer
6. Tilt pan with circular motion with wrist so mixture spreads eveny
7. Pancakes cook very quicly , about 30 secs on each side
8. Spread cheese filling , or grape jelly , or lekvar , or any jelly you like on the pancake and roll
9. You can also eat plain with a little powdered sugar sifted on top
10. Cheese filling: mix all ingredients well , adding sugar to taste

title: south georgia   caviar
steps:
1. Combine all of the ingredients in a large bowl and stir gently
2. Refrigerate mixture overnight
3. Serve with corn chips

title: orecchiette with chicken  caramelized onions  and blue cheese
steps:
1. In a large nonstick frying pan , melt the butter with 2 tablespoons of oil over moderately high heat
2. Add the onions and 1 / 2 teaspoon of the salt and cook , stirring frequently , until well browned , about 25 minutes
3. Remove
4. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon oil to the pan and reduce the heat to moderate
5. Season the chicken with 1 / 4 teaspoon of the salt and 1 / 8 teaspoon of the pepper and add to the pan along with the rosemary
6. Cook the chicken until brown , about 5 minutes
7. Turn and cook until almost done , about 3 minutes longer
8. Add the garlic
9. Cook , stirring , for 30 seconds
10. Cover the pan , remove from the heat , and let steam for 5 minutes
11. Cut the chicken into 1 / 4-inch slices
12. Meanwhile , in a large pot of boiling , salted water , cook the orecchiette until just done , about 15 minutes
13. Reserve about 1 / 4 cup of the pasta water
14. Drain the pasta and toss with 2 tablespoons of the pasta water , the onions , the chicken with pan juices , the blue cheese , and the remaining 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and 1 / 8 teaspoon pepper
15. If the pasta seems dry , add more of the reserved pasta water

title: blue strawberry salad
steps:
1. Arrange on 4 to 6 plates equal amounts of the mixed salad greens , crumbled blue cheese , orange slices and berries
2. Sprinkle with nut pieces or halves
3. In a blender pulse all ingredients except olive oil
4. Slowly add the oil , blending well
5. Offer dressing at the table-makes around 1 2 / 3 cups

title: deviled deviled eggs
steps:
1. Toast peppercorns in a small nonstick skillet over low heat , shaking the pan occasionally , until golden and fragrant , 3 to 5 minutes , and then crush
2. Shell the eggs and cut 1 / 4-inch off the ends of each one
3. Reserve these trimmings
4. Halve the eggs crosswise , and remove the yolks
5. Set the whites aside
6. Place the yolks and the trimmings in a bowl
7. Add the remaining ingredients to the bowl , and mash with a fork until just smooth but not mushy
8. Spoon the mixture into the reserved whites , or pipe it in with a pastry tube
9. Sprinkle with the remaining chopped green onions

title: surprise chocolate chip muffins
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f grease bottoms only of 12 regular-size muffin cups with spray , or line with paper baking cups
2. In small bowl , mix all filling ingredients until smooth
3. Set aside
4. In large bowl , beat milk , oil and egg with fork or wire whisk
5. Stir in remaining muffin ingredients just until flour is moistened
6. Divide batter evenly among muffin cups
7. Place about 1 rounded teaspoon filling on batter in each muffin cup
8. Top with remaining batter
9. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown
10. Immediately remove from pan to cooling rack
11. Cool 5 minutes
12. Serve warm or cool

title: healthy blueberry muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. If making streusal topping , combine brown sugar , rolled oats and cinnamon and set aside
3. Combine buttermilk , egg , oil , vanilla and honey in a small mixing bowl
4. In separate bowl , mix dry ingredients until well combined
5. Add blueberries and stir to coat with flour
6. Add wet ingredients to dry and stir gently until just combined
7. Immediately pour into greased or papered muffin tins
8. Sprinkle tops with streusal , if using
9. Bake 30-35 minutes

title: summer tomato corn salsa cruda  raw sauce  for pasta
steps:
1. Crush garlic in garlic press or mortar and mash with salt to create a paste
2. Add the olive oil and mix well
3. Chop tomatoes in 1 / 2-inch cubes
4. Add them with juices to garlic mixture in large bowl
5. Use a small , sharp knife to cut the corn kernels from the cob
6. Add to the bowl
7. Finely chop basil and parsley
8. Add to bowl , along with lots of pepper
9. Add chopped jalapenos , if desired
10. Mix well , cover , and let stand at room temperature while cooking pasta
11. For the most flavor , let the sauce stand longer , but do not refrigerate
12. Cook 1 pound of your favorite pasta , drain , and toss with sauce
13. Serve with freshly grated parmesan or your favorite cheese or cheese substitute , if desired

title: chicken casserole for dogs
steps:
1. Begin by steaming all the main vegetables until they are all soft enough to nearly mash or poke through with a fork
2. Please do not forget to rinse your vegetables thoroughly before steaming them
3. When the vegetables are steamed , set them aside
4. While your vegetables are steaming , place all your chicken in a pot and cover the chicken with enough water so that the water is about 1 inch about all the chicken
5. Bring the water to a slow boil and let the chicken slowly boil until the meat is cooked and a aromatic chicken broth presents itself
6. When the chicken is ready , remove and set aside the chicken and use the chicken broth you have just created to cook the brown rice
7. In a rice cooker , you will need 3 cups of chicken broth to cook the 1 1 / 2 cups of brown rice
8. If you use a regular pot and lid to cook the rice , keep an eye on the level of the broth as it cooks because you may or may not need to add a little broth as the rice cooks to keep from burning or drying out the rice
9. Better that the rice is a little moist than too dry
10. While the rice is cooking , chop your chicken and all your steamed vegetables into small bite-sized pieces
11. When the rice is done , combine your chopped chicken , vegetables and brown rice into a large bowl and mix it together adding the olive oil and a little more of the leftover chicken broth as you see fit
12. Now the meal is ready but you probably want to let it cool down a little bit before serving it to your dog
13. It can be refridgerated in a sealed container for up to 3 days
14. Simply placing a small amount in the microwave will melt all the fats and oils in it again and leave your dog's tastebuds jumping !

title: canadian maple syrup pie
steps:
1. Beat together the syrup , sugar , cream , butter , and eggs
2. Pour into pie shells
3. Bake 40 minutes at 350 degrees until knife comes out clean
4. Serve with additional warmed cream or ice cream

title: rhubarb pineapple pie
steps:
1. Makes one 9" pie
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
3. Mix pie crust , roll it out and place in pie pan
4. Slice rhubarb and place in the pie crust
5. Sprinkle sugar over the rhubarb and pour spread the pineapple over the sugar
6. Roll out the top crust and cover the pie
7. Bake at 350 degrees until the top is golden brown in color , approx
8. 50 min
9. Let cool and serve with whip cream if desired

title: nickie s meatloaf burgers
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine ground beef , egg , bread crumbs , 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce , onion powder , garlic powder , ketchup , salt and pepper
2. Mix well and form patties
3. Heat oil and remaining worcestershire sauce to below smoking point in a skillet and fry to desired doneness
4. You may also broil these to desired doneness

title: sauteed chicken with oven dried grapes
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 275f
2. Wash grapes and remove from stems
3. Set aside half of each the red and green grapes
4. Place remaining grapes on a baking sheet and bake for 1-1 / 2 hours , shaking pan frequently: remove from the oven and set aside
5. Place uncooked grapes in a blender and pure until very smooth
6. Strain through a coarse-mesh sieve , pressing down hard on the skins: it will yield about 3 / 4 cup juice
7. In a large nonstick skillet , melt 2 tbsp butter
8. Season the chicken with salt and black pepper
9. Add to pan and cook over medium-high heat for 5 min on each side , until golden
10. Add grape juice and cook for 5 min longer , or until chicken is done , and is just firm to the touch: be careful not to overcook
11. The grape juices will darken into a mahogany-colored sauce
12. Transfer breasts to a platter
13. Add remaining 1-1 / 2 tbsp butter to pan and cook over high heat for 1 minute
14. Add oven-dried grapes and cook for 1 min longer
15. Add salt and pepper to taste and pour sauce over chicken
16. Serve immediately

title: cast iron skillet fillet mignon
steps:
1. Generously salt , pepper filets , add garlic powder
2. Refrigerate until 30 minutes before cooking
3. Allow filets to come to room temperature , about 30 minutes , before cooking
4. This is an important step !
5. Place enough evoo in cast iron skillet to sear 2 steaks
6. Heat oil to high
7. Place steaks in oil and sear on both sides on high for 2 minutes each side
8. Once seared , add 2t butter , minced garlic and thyme to pan
9. Transfer skillet to oven preheated to 450 degrees
10. Cook , without turning for 3 minutes , or until rare / med-rare
11. Remove skillet from oven , return to stove top on medium heat
12. Add more butter , thyme , garlic and some red wine
13. Just enough time to baste
14. Place on plate and allow to rest 5 minutes

title: sweet and salty honey cheese spread
steps:
1. Spread the sunflower seeds on a piece of wax paper
2. Roll the goat cheese log in the sunflower seeds on all sides and on the ends
3. You will need to firmly press the seeds into the cheese to make them stick
4. Place cheese on serving platter and drizzle honey all over the top
5. Garnish with any leftover seeds , mint , and the nicest looking berries you can find
6. Serve with crackers

title: lemon thyme cookies
steps:
1. Sift together the dry ingredients
2. Cream the butter and sugar
3. Add eggs , one at a time , and mix well after each addition
4. Stir in the crumbled lemon thyme
5. Form into a ball , place in a zip lock type plastic bag and refrigerate several hours or overnight
6. Preheat oven to 350
7. Roll into 1" balls and place on a lightly greased cookie sheet
8. Flatten slightly
9. Bake in a 350 oven for 10 minutes
10. Watch closely

title: spinach feta pizza  6 ww points
steps:
1. Dough: in a bread machine pan , place the first six ingredients in order suggested by manufacturer
2. Select dough setting
3. When cycle is completed , turn dough onto a lightly floured surface
4. Knead for 1 minute
5. Cover and let rest for 15 minutes
6. Roll into a 12-in circle
7. Transfer to a lightly greased 12-in pizza pan
8. Cover and let rise in a warm place until puffed , about 20 minutes
9. Toppings: sprinkle with garlic and garlic salt
10. Top with the spinach , onion , mushrooms , cheeses and basil
11. Bake at 400 degrees for 30 to 35 minutes or until gold and cheese is melted
12. Let stand 5 minutes before slicing
13. Cut pizza into 6 slices

title: chocolate covered rocha
steps:
1. Line a 15x10x1 inch baking sheet with foil , extending foil over the edges for easy removal
2. Set pan aside
3. Melt butter in a heavy 3 quart saucepan
4. Stir in sugar , water and cornsyrup
5. Cook over med-high heat to boiling , stirring until sugar is dissolved
6. Avoid splashing the sides
7. Clip a candy thermometer to the side of the of the pan
8. Cook over med heat , stirring often , until thermometer reaches 290 degrees
9. Mixture should boil at a moderate , steady rate over entire surface
10. Remove from heat and remove thermometer
11. Pour mixture into prepared pan
12. Spread evenly
13. Cool for about 5 minutes or until the top is set
14. Sprinkle chocolate pieces over the top
15. Let set for 2 minutes
16. Spread chocolate over candy
17. Sprinkle with nuts , pressing into the chocolate
18. Cool several hours to set
19. Lift set candy out of pan , using the foil edges
20. Break into pieces
21. Store in a tighly covered container in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks

title: baked quesadilla squares
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Spray a 13x9-inch glass baking dish with nonstick cooking spray
3. Sprinkle cheeses in bottom
4. Top with chilies
5. Combine milk , baking mix and eggs in large bowl and beat until smooth
6. Carefully pour over chilies and cheese
7. Top with 1 / 4 cup salsa
8. Bake until puffed and golden , 25-30 minutes
9. Cool 10 minutes
10. Cut into squares and serve

title: breakfast sandwiches   oamc
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Whisk together the eggs and stir in salt , pepper , onion , and bell pepper
3. Pour into a casserole dish that has been sprayed with non-stick cooking spray
4. Bake in preheated over for 15 minutes
5. Stir
6. Bake for 15 more minutes
7. Remove from oven and let cool slightly
8. Cut out 12 "egg circles" with a cookie cutter
9. Place on bottom halves of the english muffins
10. Top with ham , cheese , and top of english muffin
11. Wrap sandwiches in foil , then freeze
12. To serve , allow to defrost in the fridge overnight
13. Alternatively , you can defrost for a few minutes in the microwave
14. Microwave on high for about a minute , or until heated through and cheese is melted

title: chocolate buttercream frosting    shots
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the butter , marshmallow cream , salt and vanilla
2. Using an electric mixer , beat on high until well mixed
3. Beat in the cocoa powder on low speed just until incorporated
4. Add the powdered sugar and mix on low just until incorporated , scraping the sides of bowl as needed
5. If frosting is too thick you can add in milk or cream a teaspoon at a time until desired consistency
6. Frosting can be refrigerated , but bring to room temperature for about 10-15 minutes before using

title: flatbread tacos with ranch cream sauce
steps:
1. In small bowl , combine sour cream , dressing mix and lemon juice
2. Chill till serving
3. In large skillet cook beef over med
4. Heat till no longer pink
5. Drain
6. Add the beans , tomatoes , taco seasoning and pepper sauce
7. Heat through
8. Meanwhile , roll out each biscuit into a 6" circle
9. In a small non-stick skillet over med
10. Heat , cook each biscuit for 30-60 seconds on each sideor till golden brown
11. Keep warm
12. To serve , spread each flatbread with 2 tbs ranch sour cream
13. Top each with 2 / 3 c meat mixture
14. Top with lettuce , tomato and cheese

title: easy pimento cheese
steps:
1. Put cream cheese in mixer and beat till cream cheese is fluffy
2. Add remaining ingredients and mix until well incorporated
3. Put in storage bowl and refrigerate for at least 2 hours , before serving
4. (to allow flavors to "meld" together
5. Serve with your favorite cracker or breads

title: you have to try this rice pudding
steps:
1. Put cooked rice in the top of a double boiler
2. Set over simmering water
3. Stir in milk , butter and raisins
4. Cook stirring frequently until pudding thickens slightly , about 20 minutes
5. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla and nutmeg
6. Refrigerate or eat warm

title: pita salad sandwiches with tahini sauce
steps:
1. In a small bowl , mix all sauce ingredients until blended
2. Slice an edge from each pita bread , and carefully open pockets
3. In a medium bowl , combine feta , tomatoes , and spinach
4. Add 1 / 4 cup of sauce , and toss gently to mix
5. Spoon the mixture into each pocket
6. Divide sprouts , cucumber , and avocado among the sandwiches
7. Drizzle each with about 1 tbsp of tahini sauce
8. Serve right away

title: shrimp scampi with snap peas
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add garlic and saute 2 minutes , until soft
3. Add shrimp and peas and saute 1 minute
4. Toss in oregano , salt and pepper and stir to coat
5. Add vermouth or dry white wine and simmer 1 minute
6. In a separate bowl , dissolve cornstarch into chicken broth until smooth
7. Add mixture to skillet
8. Simmer 2 minutes , stirring frequently until sauce thickens and shrimp are bright pink and cooked through
9. Serve scampi over rice

title: oven roasted pulled pork sandwiches
steps:
1. Mix the paprika , garlic power , brown sugar , dry mustard , and 3 t salt together in a small bowl
2. Rub the spice blend all over the pork and marinate , covered , in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour or up to overnight
3. Preheat the oven to 300
4. Put the pork in a roasting pan and bake for about 6 hoursuntil the inside temperature reaches 170 and the roast is falling apart
5. Meanwhile , for barbecue sauce , combine the vinegar , mustard , ketchup , brown sugar , garlic , salt , cayenne , and pepper in a saucepan over medium heat
6. Simmer gently , stirring , for 10 minutes until the sugar dissolves
7. Allow the meat to rest for about 10 minutes after removing from oven
8. While still warm , take 2 forks and "pull" the meat to form shreds
9. Place the shredded pork in a bowl and pour 1 / 2 of the sauce on the shredded pork and mix well to coat
10. Serve on hamburger buns with remaining sauce on the side
11. It does not specify , but cover the roasting pan before putting in the oven
12. Also , pour a little water in the bottom of the roasting pan and check periodically to make sure it does not dry up completely
13. I found the drippings in the bottom of the pan burned if i didn't do this
14. I use all of the sauce to mix in the meat
15. I don't think half is enough
16. If you want more sauce on the side , i would suggest making more

title: chicken rice for christmas
steps:
1. Wash rice
2. Boil water and mix with butter , chicken boulivon
3. Add watery butter mix to rice , in rice cooker
4. Add in peppers
5. Press down on cook button , and wait for rice

title: diner s wine  mojito
steps:
1. In the bottom of a tall glass , muddle the basil , lemon , lime , grated ginger , 5-spice powder , and honey
2. Fill glass with ice cubes
3. Pour in wine
4. Garnish with fresh or dried chives and fresh basil sprig
5. Enjoy with a pretty colored straw

title: oops     italian   ranch  crock pot pork
steps:
1. Place your pork in a crock pot
2. Sprinkle the ranch over the pork
3. Pour in the jar of pepperocinis and juice
4. Cover with water
5. Cook on low over night or 6-8 hours or on high 3-5 hours depending on your crock pot
6. Enjoy on a hoagie
7. Top with provolone or swiss and broil until bubbly
8. My husband loves a1 on this too !
9. Thank my mom again for her many mistakes in the kitchen

title: spinach tea sandwiches
steps:
1. Combine green onions through sour cream
2. Spread thinly on bread to make sandwiches
3. Cut off crusts and cut into squares or use a cookie cutter
4. Optional - sprinkle with paprika

title: basic cookie mix
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine all the ingredients
2. Sift the mixture twice
3. Store in a tightly covered , labeled container for up to 3 months in a cool , dry place
4. For sugar cookies use: preheat the oven to 350f
5. In a large bowl , combine all ingredients
6. With lightly floured hands , shape the dough into 1" balls
7. Arrange them about 2" apart on 2 lightly greased 13" x 9" baking sheets bake for 12-15 minutes or until golden
8. Let cool for 1-2 minutes on the baking sheets
9. Using a spatula , transfer to wire racks to cool completely
10. The cookies can be stored in a tightly covered container at room temperature for up to 1 wk
11. For chocolate chip cookies use: preheat the oven to 350f
12. In a large bowl , combine the basic cookie mix , butter , egg , and vanilla
13. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts , distributing them well
14. With lightly floured hands , shape the dough into 1" balls
15. Arrange them about 2" apart on 2 lightly greased 13" x 9" baking sheets bake for 12-15 minutes or until golden
16. Let cool for 1-2 minutes on the baking sheets
17. Using a spatula , transfer to wire racks to cool completely
18. The cookies can be stored in a tightly covered container at room temperature for up to 1 wk

title: simple homemade peaunut butter cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Beat egg until light and well-beat
3. Cream together peanut butter and sugar
4. Add egg and vanilla extract to peanut butter / sugar mix and beat together until well blended
5. Drop on lightly greased cookie sheet by tablespoons
6. Flatten with a fork leaving the crosshatching design
7. Lightly sprinkle sugar over unbaked cookies
8. Bake 8-10 minutes or until light and fluffy
9. Enjoy

title: no salt seasoning shake
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients together in a small bowl
2. Store in a glass jar fitted with a lid with a tight seal

title: creamy fruit dressing
steps:
1. Combine cream cheese , honey , orange juice , lemon juice and salt
2. Mix well
3. Gradually add oil , beating after each addition
4. Chill
5. Serve over fruit salad of your choice

title: strawberry shag
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine the strawberries and sugar , toss well
2. Let sit for 15 minutes
3. In a cocktail shaker , combine the basil and strawberries and any juice collected in the bowl
4. Gently crush using a muddler or wooden spoon
5. Fill the shaker with ice , then add the vodka and lemon juice
6. Cap the shaker
7. Shake vigorously
8. Pour into a large glass , then top with soda water
9. Stir
10. Garnish with a strawberry and fresh basil

title: dutch grilled cheese
steps:
1. In a large nonstick skillet , melt 1 tablespoon butter over low heat
2. Add in the onions
3. Cook very slowly , stirring occasionally , until the onions turn a dark golden color
4. About 30-40 minutes
5. If the onions start to scorch , add about 1 tablespoon water
6. Remove the onions from the pan and set aside
7. Wipe skillet using a paper towel
8. Do not wash skillet
9. Heat the same skillet over med-high heat
10. Add in the cumin seeds and toast just until they become fragrant , approx 3 minutes
11. Watch carefully because they burn easily
12. Remove the seeds and let cool briefly
13. Do not wash the skillet
14. When the seeds are cool , crush them using a mortar / pestle
15. In a bowl , toss the crushed seeds with the cheese
16. To make the sandwiches: butter one side of each bread slice
17. Place 4 slices on a work surface , buttered side down
18. Distribute the cheese evenly over the 4 slices , then do the same with the onions
19. Place the remaining 4 slices on top , buttered side up
20. Heat the same skillet over med-high heat for 2 minutes
21. Put the sandwiches in the skillet , cover , and cook for 2 minutes or until the underside is golden brown and the cheese has begun to melt
22. Uncover and turn the sandwich using an spatula , pressing firmly to flatten the sandwich slightly
23. Cook for 1 minute or until underside is golden
24. Turn the sandwich again , press with spatula , and cook for 30 seconds or until the cheese has melted completely
25. Serve

title: best meatloaf recipe ever  and easiest
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Put meat , french fried onions , and stuffing in bowl
3. Mix eggs , ketchup , and ranch dressing together separately , then dump over other ingredients
4. Mix all together
5. Shape into loaf and put on a cookie sheet
6. Cover loosely with tin foil and bake 50-60 minutes
7. Remove foil and top with ketchup , or any topping sauce you like , for the last ten minutes
8. Let cool for at least 10 minutes before cutting
9. I just want to
10. I don't know why , i've tried and tried to keep it from happening to no avail
11. However , it doesn't matter , i just cut burnt part off , doesn't effect the rest of the loaf
12. Also , i don't use a loaf pan for this one , because it will be too greasy

title: fruit salad or dessert
steps:
1. Combine salad ingredients in a medium bowl , tossing gently to combine
2. Cover and chill 1 hour
3. Sprinkle with toasted coconut

title: marinated artichoke hearts  shrimp  and mushrooms
steps:
1. Put artichoke hearts , shrimp , and mushrooms in a bowl
2. Mix dressing according to package directions
3. Pour dressing over all and marinate for 8 hours

title: coffee spice rub for steak
steps:
1. Store in airtight container , until ready to use
2. Rub well into meat and cook

title: lemon sambuca cheesecake
steps:
1. Line a 10" springform pan bottom with aluminum foil and attach sides
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
3. In a food processor , crush and combine the cookie crumbs and butter
4. Line bottom of pan , pressing the crumbs about one-third of the way up the sides of the pan
5. In a food processor , combine all cream cheese layer ingredients except the eggs and blend until totally smooth and mixture is a thick liquid
6. Pulse in eggs and yolk 4 or 5 times until blended
7. Pour into pan
8. Bake for 45-50 minutes
9. Top immediately with --
10. Mix sour cream , vanilla and sugar
11. Spread over top of cheesecake layer and return to the oven for 10 minutes
12. In a saucepan heat lemon juice , water , egg yolk , sugar and cornstarch in a saucepan until mixture becomes clear and thick enough to coat the back of a spoon
13. Spread this mixture over the top of the cheesecake / sour cream layer
14. Cover with plastic wrap , pressing plastic wrap directly onto lemon layer
15. This will prevent a skin forming on the top
16. Cool until just warm on a wire rack and then place in refrigerator to chill well
17. Cut with a very sharp , long knife dipped into hot water
18. Rinse knife and wipe down with a dry towel before each new cut to keep each cut clean

title: thyme marinated grilled asparagus
steps:
1. Bring 2 quarts of salted water to a boil in a large stockpot
2. Add asparagus and cook until it is crisp tender , 3 or 4 minutes , depending on the size
3. Drain and dip in icy cold water
4. Set aside
5. In a bowl combine vinegar , shallots , garlic , thyme , orange juice concentrate , and mustard
6. Slowly whisk in the oil to blend well
7. Season with salt and pepper
8. Pour mixture over asparagus
9. Let marinate while you light the coals or start the grill
10. To make the grilling easier , you can place the asparagus on skewers , running a skewer through each end of the spear and fitting about 5 spears on each pair of skewers
11. Grill the asparagus on each side just to mark it , 1 or 2 minutes per side
12. Remove from the grill
13. Serve warm or at room temperature
14. Or , you can just broil them till they start to brown , 3 to 4 minutes

title: california roll salad
steps:
1. Into a large saucepan of salted boiling water stir rice and boil 10 minutes
2. Drain rice in a colander and rinse
3. Set colander over a kettle of boiling water and steam rice , covered with a kitchen towel and lid , until fluffy and dry , 10 to 15 minutes
4. While rice is steaming , in a small saucepan bring 1 / 4 cup vinegar to a boil with sugar and salt , stirring until sugar is dissolved , and remove from heat
5. In a dry small skillet toast sesame seeds over moderate heat , stirring , until golden and fragrant and transfer to a small bowl
6. Transfer rice to a large bowl and stir in vinegar mixture
7. Cool rice and stir in sesame seeds , remaining 3 tablespoons vinegar , oil , ginger , scallions , carrot , and cucumber
8. Salad may be prepared up to this point 1 day ahead and chilled , covered
9. Bring salad to room temperature before proceeding
10. Dry-roast nori , 1 sheet at a time , directly above moderate heat , holding it at opposite corners and moving it back and forth , until it turns bright green , 30 seconds to 1 minute
11. With scissors cut nori into thin 2-inch-long strips
12. Peel and pit avocado
13. Quarter avocado and cut crosswise into thin slices
14. Add avocado to salad with surmimi if using and two thirds of nori strips and toss well
15. Make dressing: in a small bowl stir wasabi powder into hot water and stir in cold water , soy sauce , and ginger juice
16. Serve salad sprinkled with remaining nori strips and drizzled with dressing

title: vegetable beef barley soup
steps:
1. Brown beef , onion , and garlic in large pot
2. Drain grease
3. Add remaining ingredients , except barley , salt & pepper
4. Bring to boil , then reduce to simmer
5. Simmer for at least 20 minutes
6. Stirring occasionally
7. Add barley and simmer for at least 20-30 more minutes
8. Stirring occasionally
9. Simmer until veggies and barley are tender and flavors have blended
10. The longer it cooks , the better
11. Keep an eye on the liquid , adding more broth or water , if necessary
12. Season with salt & pepper to taste

title: easy creamy fruit salad
steps:
1. With a wire whisk , combine and mix pudding and buttermilk
2. Fold in the cool whip
3. Fold in the fruits
4. Add the nuts , and refrigerate
5. The fruit salad keeps well in the refrigerator for several days
6. You may try other fruits if you like such as cherries , pineapple , and coconut--they are also delicious

title: sausage stuffed mushrooms   barefoot contessa
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f
2. Remove the stems from the mushrooms and chop them finely
3. Set aside
4. Place the mushroom caps in a shallow bowl and toss with 3 tablespoons of the olive oil and marsala
5. Set aside
6. Heat the remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil in a medium skillet over medium heat
7. Add the sausage , crumbling it with the back of a wooden spoon
8. Cook the sausage for 8 to 10 minutes , stirring frequently , until it's completely browned
9. Add the chopped mushroom stems and cook for 3 more minutes
10. Stir in the scallions and garlic and cook for another 2 to 3 minutes , stirring occasionally
11. Add the panko crumbs , stirring to combine evenly with all the other ingredients
12. Finally , swirl in the mascarpone and continue cooking until the mascarpone has melted and made the sausage mixture creamy
13. Off the heat , stir in the parmesan , parsley , and season with salt and pepper , to taste , cool slightly
14. Fill each mushroom generously with the sausage mixture
15. Arrange the mushrooms in a baking dish large enough to hold all the mushrooms in a snug single layer
16. Bake until the stuffing is browned and crusty about , 50 minutes
17. Enjoy !

title: baked oatmeal  wisconsin style
steps:
1. Butter 1 1 / 2 quart casserole
2. In medium saucepan , bring water to boiling
3. Slowly stir in oats
4. Return to boiling
5. Reduce heat
6. Simmer , uncovered , 2 to 3 minutes for quick cooking oats or 5 to 7 minutes for regular oats , or until most water is absorbed and the oats are tender , stirring occasionally
7. In a small bowl , whisk milk and eggs
8. In another small bowl , combine brown sugar , baking powder , cinnamon and 1 / 4 tsp salt
9. Stir into oatmeal
10. Fold egg mixture into oatmeal mixture
11. Pour oatmeal mixture into prepared casserole
12. Bake , uncovered , in 350 degree oven 30 to 40 minutes , or until center is just set and sugar crust forms on top
13. Cool 30 minutes
14. Serve warm with fresh fruit , if you like

title: the best banana bundt cake  dorie greenspan
steps:
1. Center a rack in the oven and preheat to 350f generously butter a 9- to 10-inch bundt pan
2. Don't place the pan on a baking sheet - you want the oven's heat to circulate through the bundt's inner tube
3. Whisk the flour , baking soda and salt together
4. Working with a stand mixer , preferably fitted with a paddle attachment , or with a hand mixer in a large bowl , beat the butter until creamy
5. Add the sugar and beat at medium speed until pale and fluffy
6. Beat in the vanilla , then add the eggs one at a time , beating for about 1 minute after each egg goes inches reduce the mixer speed to low and mix in the bananas
7. Finally , mix in half the dry ingredients , all the sour cream and then the rest of the flour mixture
8. Scrape the batter into the pan , rap the pan on the counter to debubble the batter and smooth the top
9. Bake for 65-75 minutes , or until a thin knife inserted deep into the center of the cake comes out clean
10. Check the cake after about 30 minutes - if it is browning too quickly , cover it loosely with a foil tent
11. Transfer the cake to a rack and cool for 10 minutes before unmolding onto the rack to cool to room temperature
12. If you have time , wrap the cooled cake in plastic and allow it to sit overnight before serving - it's even better the next day
13. Optional lemony white icing: sift 3 / 4 cup confectioners' sugar into a bowl and squeeze in enough fresh lemon juice to make an icing thin enough to drizzle down the bundt's curves
14. Muffin option: halve the recipe
15. You can add nuts or chocolate chips
16. Bake 28-32 minutes
17. Yields 12 muffins

title: summer mango salsa canning recipe
steps:
1. Peel , seed , and chop all fruits and veggies
2. Place in large bowl and mix together
3. Add zest and juice of limes
4. Heat vinegar and add coriander , mustard , bay , salt and sugar
5. Do not boil
6. Turn off heat and cover pan to let spices steep a few minutes for flavors to meld
7. Strain vinegar into fruits and veggies mix , discarding the spices
8. Mix well and pack into sterilized pint jars
9. Process in hot water bath for 35 minutes
10. Beautiful in the jars and delicious !
11. Can also substitute fresh cilantro in the veggies mix for the coriander seed in the vinegar mix

title: chinese smoky ribs
steps:
1. Rub ribs thoroughly with the chinese dry marinade
2. Let stand at room temperature for 1 to 2 hours
3. Arrange ribs ends down on cooking grill or place bones upright in rib rack
4. Smoke-cook until done
5. Brush ribs with chinese barbecue sauce during the last few minutes of cooking , then serve with remaining sauce

title: tex mex pineapple pork chops
steps:
1. Heat oil in large nonstick skillet or dutch oven over medium-high heat until hot
2. Add pork chops and cook 1 to 2 minutes or just until they begin to brown , turning once
3. Add garlic
4. Cook and stir 30 to 45 seconds
5. Add water , pineapple and rice
6. Mix well and bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat to medium-low
8. Cover and simmer 20 minutes or until pork is no longer pink in center , rice is tender and liquid is absorbed
9. To serve , arrange pork chops on serving platter
10. Add salsa and sour cream to rice mixture and mix well
11. Cook 1 minute or until thoroughly heated
12. Spoon rice mixture around pork chops
13. Sprinkle with cilantro
14. Serve with additional salsa or sour cream

title: hutspot  orange mashed potatoes and sausage dinner
steps:
1. Place the carrots in the bottom of a 3 quart pan with about 2 cups of water and put on high to boil
2. Let cook for about 3-5 minutes
3. Add the potatoes and onion
4. Put the sausage on top
5. Cover
6. Let cook over medium heat for about 10 min until the vegetables are tender and easy to mash
7. Remove the sausage to a plate to keep warm
8. Drain the vegetables , reserving at least 1 / 2 c of the water if you prefer to use water to cream or milk
9. Put through a potato ricer or use a potato masher to mash all the vegetables together
10. Use the back of a spoon to smoosh it all together with the remaining ingredients
11. You can use a mixer for this , but you risk the vegetables becoming gummy if you over-mix
12. Go for power at your own risk !
13. Season to taste
14. Serve with a salad and dinner is ready !

title: muffin frittatas
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f beat eggs , milk , salt and pepper in a medium bowl until blended
2. Add cheese , zucchini , sweet pepper and onion
3. Mix well
4. Spoon evenly into 12 greased muffin cups , about 1 / 4 cup each
5. Bake in 350f oven until just set , about 20 to 22 minutes
6. Cool on rack 5 minutes
7. Remove from cups
8. Serve warm

title: the best leftover turkey gumbo
steps:
1. Make the roux
2. In a large dutch oven , over medium heat , combine the oil and flour
3. Cook , stirring constantly until dark brown for 20-30 minutes
4. Add all the chopped veggies to the roux , along with the chopped sausage
5. Cook , stirring occasionally , until the veggies are very soft , about 10 minutes
6. Add the salt and cayenne pepper
7. Add the broth and water , combining well
8. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat to medium-low and cook , uncovered , stirring occasionally , for 1 1 / 2 hrs
9. Add the turkey and sliced sausage to the gumbo
10. Cook 15 minutes more
11. Remove from heat , let sit for 5 minutes , then skim any fat that has risen to the surface
12. Stir in green onions and parsley
13. Serve over rice , with hot french bread !

title: tomato salad
steps:
1. In your serving bowl , put the cucumbers and salt and toss
2. Set it to the side for 10 minutes
3. Cucumbers will"sweat"
4. Do not toss the water !
5. This is part of your salad dressing
6. Add the tomatoes , scallions and olive oil and toss
7. Put it in the fridge until you are ready to eat
8. The longer it sits , the better it tastes

title: cream cheese turtle cake
steps:
1. For cake: preheat oven to 350
2. Butter and flour 13x9x2-inch metal cake pan
3. Sprinkle 1 / 2 cup almonds and 1 / 2 cup pecans over bottom of pan
4. Combine cake mix , 1 1 / 4 cups water , oil , and eggs in large bowl
5. Using electic mixer , beat at low speed until mixture is moistened , about 30 seconds
6. Beat at medium speed 2 minutes
7. Pour batter into pan
8. Melt buttter in medium saucepan over medium-low heat
9. Gradually stir in powdered sugar
10. Stir in cream cheese
11. Whisk until smooth , about 1 miute
12. Pour cream cheese mixture in large ribbons atop cake batter in pan
13. Using knife , swirl mixture into batter
14. Bake cake until tester inserted into center comes out clean , about 50 minutes
15. Cool cake in pan on rack
16. Sprinkle remaining 1 / 2 cup almonds and 1 / 2 cup pecans over cake
17. For icing: mix sugar and cocoa in medium bowl
18. Bring milk and buter to simmer in heavy medium saucepan
19. Reduce heat to medium-low
20. Add powdered sugar mixture and whisk until melted
21. Add chocolate chips and whisk until smooth
22. Mix in vailla
23. Drizzle warm icing over cake
24. Let stand until set , about 2 hours
25. Drizzle caramel topping over

title: hg s watermelon frojito   ww pts 3
steps:
1. Place mint leaves , half the lime wedges and the sweetener in a tall glass
2. Squeeze the juice from the remaining lime wedges into the glass and throw them away
3. Crush and "muddle" the mixture until the juice has been released from the lime wedges , the mint leaves are thoroughly bruised , and the sweetener has dissolved
4. Set aside
5. Place the watermelon , rum and ice into a blender and blend until smooth
6. Pour into the glass with lime-mint mixture and stir well
7. Drink up and be refreshed !

title: potato and spinach enchiladas
steps:
1. Simmer pasta sauce with spices and herbs on very low heat while preparing the enchiladas
2. Peel and dice the potatoes and boil them until tenders - about 20 minutes
3. Drain and set aside
4. Cook the oil and garlic over medium low heat , stirring occasionally
5. Add the kale , sprinkle with a little salt , and raise the heat to medium , stirring constantly to cover the kale with oil and garlic
6. Partially cover the pot to steam the kale until it has wilted - 4-6 minutes
7. Mix in the potatoes , stock , lime juice , pumpkin seeds , and salt
8. Use the back of a wooden spoon to mash some of the potatoes and cook another five minutes
9. Taste and season
10. Ladle some of the tomato sauce into the bottom of a casserole dish and spread it around
11. Take a warmed tortilla , run the potato mixture down the middle and roll up
12. Pack the tortillas into the casserole dish
13. Pour about a cup of sauce over the top when finished all the tortillas
14. Sprinkle with pumpkin seeds
15. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 375f for 25 minutes , remove foil and bake for another 10 minutes , until edges of tortillas look a little browned
16. Top individual servings with extra sauce
17. Serve with a green salad and some vegan guacamole

title: fantastic creamy layered banana dessert
steps:
1. Prepare a large fancy glass bowl , trifle dish , or this can be made in dessert dishes as well
2. In a large mixing bowl , beat together the pudding mix and half and half cream for about 3 minutes
3. Add in the condensed milk and vanilla
4. Mix until smooth
5. Fold in the thawed whipped topping
6. Layer the wafers on the bottom of the bowl
7. Then top with sliced bananas
8. Then top with pudding mixture
9. If desired , top or dollup with whipped topping , then sprinkle with crushed vanilla wafers
10. Delicious !

title: bo ling s long life noodle soup
steps:
1. Soak rice noodles in cold water
2. Boil 3 quarts of water
3. When boiling remove noodles from cold water put in boiling water
4. Cool 3 minutes
5. Remove from heat , rinse , drain
6. Set aside
7. Pan fry eggs
8. Set aside
9. Heat oils in wok
10. Add finely chopped garlic , chicken breast - when meat turns white add shrimp
11. Add stock , soy sauce and spinach
12. Turn off heat
13. Put noodles divided into two bowls
14. Add stock mixture
15. Top with egg

title: dinner in a squash shell
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 degrees
2. Bake halved and seeded acorn squash face down on a baking sheet for 30 minutes
3. While squash is cooking mix filling and put in refrigerator until squash is ready
4. Mix basting ingredients and set aside
5. When squash done cooking , fill with meat mixture , mounding extra on top
6. Cover with basting sauce
7. There should be plenty leftover
8. Return to oven for 40 minutes , basting with extra sauce every 10 minutes
9. I usually have extra filling which i cook seperately and extra sauce which i heat in a small pan for safety sake and serve on the side

title: pierogi quesadilla
steps:
1. Heat oil in skillet on medium high heat
2. Peel and slice potato into 1 / 8 inch slices
3. Mix basil , salt and pepper with pototo slices
4. Cook potatoes in skillet until they start to soften
5. Remove pototoes from the skillet and place the tortilla in the hot oil
6. Mix cheeses together and evenly distribute over the entire tortilla
7. Place potatoes , crushed red peppers and italian dressing on one half of the tortilla
8. When the cheese has started to melt , fold the cheese only half on top of the half with the toppings
9. Cook until both sides are a light golden brown
10. Place on a plate , cut into quarters and garnish with salsa , sour cream and guacamole
11. Enjoy !

title: 30 minute baked potato
steps:
1. Stab the potato with a fork several times and wrap in a paper towel
2. Place in a microwave on high for 8 minutes , turning half way through
3. Remove from microwave and brush with olive oil
4. Then place in a pre-heated 200 c oven for 15 minutes
5. Remove from oven and slice with a cross
6. Add butter or other toppings as desired

title: old fashioned oatmeal with apples  raisins and honey toasted wal
steps:
1. Stir chopped walnuts in small nonstick skillet over medium heat until lightly toasted , about 3 minutes
2. Drizzle honey over and stir until honey thickens and coats nuts , about 2 minutes
3. Remove skillet from heat
4. Stir to loosen nuts from skillet and cool
5. Bring 3 cups water to boil in heavy medium saucepan
6. Add oats and salt and stir over medium heat until oats are softened and very thick , about 5 minutes
7. Stir in apple juice , chopped apple , brown sugar , raisins and cinnamon
8. Reduce heat to low , cover and cook until apples are tender , about 3-5 minutes
9. Divide cereal among 4 bowls
10. Top with vanilla yogurt and honey-toasted walnuts and serve

title: horseradish steak sauce
steps:
1. Mix all together and blend with a hand blender until smooth
2. Serve with your favorite steak

title: pesto cheese tarts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a small bowl , combine all ingredients except tart shells
3. Spoon by heaping teaspoonfuls into shells
4. Place on an ungreased baking sheet and bake at 375f for 8-12 minutes or until lightly browned

title: simple roasted carrots
steps:
1. Heat oven to 475 degrees
2. In shallow baking dish , toss carrots with oil and salt
3. Roast 12 minutes , then shake pan to toss
4. Roast another 8 minutes , shaking pan once or twice , until brown and tender
5. Serve hot

title: molasses wake up
steps:
1. Bring water to boil
2. Put the molasses inches
3. Stir until dissolved
4. Squeeze in lemon
5. Drink

title: breast of chicken relleno
steps:
1. Cut a pocket in to the middle of each chicken breast
2. Pack in 1 / 3 cup of grated cheese into the opening of each breast
3. Pin opening closed with wooden skewers or strong toothpicks
4. Beat the eggs and milk together in a small bowl
5. Dip the stuffed chicken breasts in the flour and then in the egg batter
6. Roll them in the cornmeal
7. Heat a large skillet on the stove , add oil and heat to 350f
8. Add the chicken breasts and saute them on both sides until golden brown
9. While the breasts are browning , preheat the oven to 450f and spritz a baking dish with cooking spray
10. Place the sauteed , stuffed chicken breasts in prepared baking dish
11. Cover them with the green chile sauce and the remaining 1 / 2 cup of monterey jack cheese

title: carrot and butternut squash soup
steps:

5. Bring to boil
6. Reduce heat , cover and simmer 25 minutes or until vegetables are very tender

9. Bring to simmer

11. Heat through

title: oven fried chicken and black bean chimichangas  oamc
steps:
1. Cook chicken until tender
2. Shred
3. Drain beans in colander and rinse thoroughly
4. Combine salsa and spices

6. Heat 10 tortillas in microwave until soft and pliable
7. Put one tortilla on a plate , put cup of the chicken / bean mixture on tortilla , about an inch from one edge

18. These make great lunches ! microwave for approximately one minute

title: beef   kidney bean fajitas
steps:
1. Slice meat into thin strips
2. Slice onions
3. Slice bell pepper

title: truck stop pancakes
steps:

title: beef wellington    wonderful
steps:
1. For the chicken liver pate: in a skillet , place 2 tablespoons butter and 1 small thinly sliced onion and saute until golden brown

3. This is called schmaltz with grieven

6. When ready to make the pate , in a skillet saute the onions in the vegetable oil over a medium flame until golden brown and add the schmaltz with grieven

22. On a floured surface , roll the 1 lb
23. Of puff pastry into a rectangle large enough to enclose the filet completely , which should be about 20 x 12 inches

title: super easy beef and pasta bake
steps:

5. Transfer to an oven proof dish , sprinkle cheese , bread crumbs and mustard powder over top

title: mixed berry cornmeal cobbler
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Berries: toss together blueberries , raspberries , strawberries , sugar and cornstarch in large bowl until well mixed spoon berry mixture into ungreased 882-inch square baking pan , spreading mixture evenly

9. Serve warm

title: dad s favorite steak sauce
steps:

2. Reduce heat and simmer until thickened

4. Stir frequently

steps:
