title: yum  yum  pear muffins
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda , salt and nutmeg
2. Cut in butter
3. In separate bowl mix eggs , buttermilk , vanilla and pears
4. Stir into flour mixture until just moistened
5. Spoon into lined or greased muffin tins
6. Bake at 350 for 20 min , or until toothpick comes out clean

title: chinese restaurant fried rice
steps:
1. Cook your rice
2. You want it a bit on the crunchy side , so even though you might want to add more water , don't
3. Let your rice cool completely
4. You can even cook your rice the night before and let cool in the fridge
5. Heat a wok over high heat with 1 tbs
6. Of oil
7. Add eggs and scramble until cooked
8. Add ham and peas and fry for about a minute
9. Remove omelet from wok
10. Clean the wok out a bit so the leftover egg doesn't burn while you're heating up your wok and oil again
11. Add remaining oil to the wok and heat over high heat until it is very hot
12. Add your cold rice to the wok and stir to coat every grain
13. Add your chicken stock to the rice
14. Do it a little bit at a time to give the rice a chance to soak up the liquid
15. I'm not sure exactly the amount of stock to be added
16. I eyeball it because it seems to change every time
17. Basically , you want the rice to soak up the flavor , but you don't want to put in too much as it will end up quite sticky
18. Stir fry for a while , stirring constantly until there is no liquid left , then chop up your omelet and add it , along with the soy sauce and salt
19. Stir
20. You can add more or less soy sauce and salt according to your taste
21. And remember that soy sauce is salty in itself--unless you use the salt-free or low-salt type
22. Enjoy ! it's the best homemade fried rice you'll ever make !

title: organic zesty corn relish
steps:
1. Juice the lime
2. Combine all ingredients into a medium sized bowl , toss well
3. Refrigerate until chilled through
4. Serve

title: potato and bacon casserole
steps:
1. Pre heat oven to 350
2. Grease 8 inch square dish
3. Layer 1 / 2 potatoes , 1 / 2 onion , 1 / 2 bacon and 1 / 2 cheese in prepared dish
4. Repeat layers
5. Combine evaporated milk , egg and season salt in small bowl
6. Pour evenly over potato mixture
7. Cover
8. Bake for 55-60 min
9. Uncover and bake for an additional 5 min
10. Let stand for 10-15 min before serving

title: daytona wings    baked teriyaki style chicken wings
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except the wings in a large pitcher
2. Mix well
3. Place chicken wings in single layer in a 9" x 13" pan
4. Pour the liquid mixture over the wings
5. Marinate at least 2 hours , flipping wings once
6. Keep wings refrigerated while marinating
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 1 / 2 hours
8. Flip once during baking

title: roasted chicken  artichoke  feta and  orzo salad
steps:
1. Whisk dressing ingredients together
2. Boil orzo pasta in salted water until al dente
3. Drain reserving some pasta water
4. Place orzo and shredded chicken in a large bowl
5. Add 4 tb of dressing and toss to coat
6. Add 2 tb pasta water to remaining dressing
7. Add remaining ingredients to orzo and chicken
8. Toss and refrigerate from 1 hour to overnight
9. Toss with remaining dressing before serving

title: matzo brei with creamed spinach and crispy onions
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a medium skillet over high heat until hot
2. Reduce the heat to medium
3. Add the onions and cook , stirring occasionally , until golden , about 8-10 minutes
4. Season with salt and pepper , to taste , and transfer to a bowl with a slotted spoon
5. Reserve the skillet and oil in which the onions were cooked
6. Meanwhile squeeze the spinach well , a handful at a time to remove all the water and set aside
7. Break up the matzos slightly and soak them in a bowl of cold water for 1-3 minutes
8. Don't let them get too soggy !
9. Drain the matzos and combine them with the eggs , 3 / 4 teaspoon salt , and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper
10. Reheat the oil remaining in the reserved skillet with the butter over medium-high heat until hot
11. Add the matzo mixture and cook , stirring constantly , until eggs are scrambled and the matzo has begun to crisp , about 5 minutes
12. Stir in the spinach and cheese and cook until just heated through
13. Top each portion with a mound of the onions

title: maple oat nut scones
steps:
1. Scones:
2. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
3. Mix flour , oats , 2 t
4. Brown sugar , baking powder , baking soda and salt in a large bowl
5. Add butter and rub in with finger
6. Stir in the nuts
7. Stir together 1 / 2 cup whipping cream and 1 / 2 cup maple syrup to blend and gradually add this mixture to the dry mixture , stirring just until the dough comes together
8. Add more cream if needed , if the dough seems dry
9. Turn dough onto lightly floured surface and knead gently , about 5 turns
10. Pat dough into an 8 inch circle and cut into 8 wedges
11. Transfer wedges to baking sheet , spacing 2 inches apart
12. Bake until golden , about 20 minutes
13. Remove and let cool slightly
14. Glaze:
15. Whisk together 2 t
16. Brown sugar , 6 t
17. Whipping cream and 2 t maple syrup
18. Gradually whisk in enough powdered sugar to make a thick glaze
19. Drizzle glaze over warm scones
20. Allow to stand until glaze sets
21. Also , the scones spread out a lot while baking , so i might try patting the dough into a smaller circle the next time

title: multi berry spread
steps:
1. Crush berries in large kettle
2. Stir in the pectin and over high heat bring to a full rolling boil
3. Stir constantly add in sugar
4. Return to a full rolling boil for 1 minute , stirring constantly
5. Remove from heat
6. Skim off foam
7. Pour while hot into hot jars , leaving 1 / 4-inch head space
8. Adjust the caps
9. Process for 10 minutes in a boiling-water bath

title: sublime scrambled eggs by gordon ramsay
steps:
1. Break the eggs into a cold , heavy-based pan , place on the lowest heat possible , and add half the butter
2. Using a spatula , stir the eggs frequently to combine the yolks with the whites
3. As the mixture begins to set , add the remaining butter
4. The eggs will take about 4-5 minutes to scramble they should still be soft and quite lumpy
5. Dont let them get too hot keep moving the pan off and back on the heat
6. Meanwhile , toast the bread
7. He used sourdough bread
8. Add the crme frache and season the eggs at the last minute , then add the snipped chives
9. Put the toast on warm plates , pile the softly scrambled eggs on top and serve immediately

title: hearty homemade chicken noodle soup
steps:
1. In large stew pot place 8 ingredients
2. Bring to a boil and cook until vegetables are tender
3. While soup is still boiling , add egg noodles and boil until noodles are tender
4. Enjoy !

title: tomato salad with fried feta
steps:
1. Whisk together 3 tbsp olive oil , lemon juice , oregano , sugar , and pepper in a small bowl
2. Set aside
3. Divide and arrange the tomatoes , onion , arugula , and olives on four plates
4. Cut the feta cheese into 1" cubes
5. Beat egg in a small bowl and put the flour on a plate
6. Toss the cheese into the egg and shake off excess
7. Toss the egg coated cheese in the flour on the plate
8. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet
9. Add the cheese and fry over medium heat , turning until all sides are golden brown
10. Scatter the fried feta over the salad
11. Whisk the dressing again and spoon over the salad
12. Serve while the feta cheese is still warm

title: smoothies  with 10 different variations
steps:
1. Blend yogurt with your choice of smoothie ingredients
2. Pour into a glass
3. Add toppings or stir-ins
4. Orange power: carror juice , sliced celery , grated fresh gingerroot

12. Purple haze: blueberries , pomegranate seeds

title: applesauce doughnuts donuts
steps:
1. Beat 1-1 / 3 cups of the flour and remaining ingredients with an electric mixer on low speed , until just blended
2. Stir in remaining flour and beat on medium speed for an additional 2 minutes
3. Cover dough and refrigerate for about 1 hour
4. Heat 2 to 3 inches of vegetable oil in a fryer or heavy saucepan to 375f
5. Divide dough in half and roll each half out on a well floured pastry board to 3 / 8" thick

11. If desired , sprinkle with cinnamon / sugar mixture while still hot

title: tasty breakfast granola
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. In a large saucepan set over medium heat , combine the oil , honey , brown sugar , vanilla and salt
3. Stir until the sugar dissolves , about 3 minutes
4. In a large bowl , combine the oats , sunflower seeds , coconut , and nuts
5. Pour the warm oil and honey mixture into the oat mixture and stir well until combined
6. Spray two 12 by 17 inch rimmed baking sheets with non-stick cooking spray
7. Spread the mixture evenly between the two pans
8. Bake for 30 minutes , stirring several times , until the granola is a deep golden brown
9. Cool completely before adding the dried fruit
10. Store in an airtight container up to 3 weeks
11. I often halve this recipe as i would rather make it up fresh every two weeks
12. It truly is delicious

title: parmesan butternut squash gratin
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 and spray a 9x13 baking dish with cooking spray
2. Peel , halve lengthwise and seed squash
3. Cut into 1 / 2 inch thick slices
4. Arrange with slices overlapping slightly in bottom of baking dish
5. Melt butter in saucepan over medium heat
6. Reduce heat to low
7. Add garlic and cook 2-3 minutes stirring frequently - do not let garlic or butter brown
8. In a small bowl , mix bread crumbs , cheese and 1 t
9. Of the butter-garlic mixture
10. Brush squash slices with remaining butter-garlic mixture
11. Sprinkle with salt , pepper and bread crumb mixture
12. Bake , uncovered , 30-40 minutes or until squash is tender when pierced with fork
13. Increase oven temperature to 425 and bake 5-10 minutes longer until browned
14. Sprinkle with parsley

title: gish s amazing chili for the crock pot
steps:

6. Serves 6 hungry people

3. Meanwhile , set slow cooker to high
4. Add butter , cover , and cook until melted

6. Stir flour , apple butter , sherry , and soy sauce together in small bowl until smooth
7. Pour over onions and toss to coat

title: spinach and cannellini beans
steps:
1. Simmer the beans in water until tender , about an hour , and drain
2. Fry the bread in 2 t of oil until golden brown , set aside
3. Saute the onion in 2 t of oil until soft , add tomatoes and continue cooking over low heat
4. Add the paprika and spinach and cook until the spinach has wilted
5. Stir in the cannellini beans and season with salt and pepper
6. Using a food processor , mince up the garlic and fried bread
7. Add to the spinach mixture , along with the water
8. Cover and simmer gently for 20-30 minutes
9. Serve with chunks of crusty bread

title: zucchini  meatballs  vegetarian curry   madhur jaffrey
steps:
1. 'meatballs'
2. Wash , trim and grate the zucchini - use the regular grate size on your grater , grating too fine may make it too soggy
3. Put into a bowl and sprinkle with the 1 / 2 tsp salt
4. Set aside for about 1 / 2 an hour
5. Once the zucchini has sat for about 1 / 2 an hour , squeeze out as much liquid as you can , using your hands or pressing through a fine mesh colander
6. Reserve the liquid you press out , it will be used in the gravy
7. Dry out the bowl and put the zucchini back in , add the minced chili , onion , ginger and 2 tbsp of the cilantro
8. Sift the chickpea flour over the zucchini mixture
9. Mix well and form into about 20 balls
10. If they're too large , they won't cook well in the middle unless you fully immerse them in oil
11. I prefer to use as little oil as possible for frying , so i flatten them out a bit to make frying easier
12. In a skillet or wok heat about 1 1 / 2 inches of oil over medium heat
13. When the oil is hot , put in about 5 or 6 of the balls - or as many will fit in one layer with room around each of them
14. Fry for about 2 minutes , turning them until you get a nice even brown coat
15. I suggest you test one to get a feel for how long it will take to fully cook inside since it really depends on how large you make them , and how much oil is in your pan
16. Remove with a slotted spoon and leave to drain on paper towel
17. Continue with the rest of the 'meatballs' , then set aside
18. 'gravy'
19. Use about 5 tbsp of the oil from the frying and put into a skillet or saute pan
20. Heat the oil over medium heat and add onion once the oil is hot
21. Fry the onion for about 7 or 8 minutes , or until the onion begins to brown and become translucent
22. Take care not to burn the onion
23. Once cooked , take the pan off the heat for a moment and add the turmeric , cayenne , ground cumin and coriander
24. Stir and then return to the heat
25. Add the tomatoes and let that cook for about 5 minutes to combine flavours
26. Add 1 cup of the zucchini 'juice' -- if you are short , top up with water to reach 1 cup
27. Bring to a boil the lower the heat and let the sauce simmer gently for about 15 minutes
28. Up to this point , you could prepare the recipe in advance
29. To finish , , add the cream , garam masala , roasted cumin and salt
30. Mix sauce well and bring to a simmer
31. Add the 'meatballs' and gently spoon the sauce over them , trying not to break any of them
32. The meatballs turn soft in the sauce , so only cook enough to warm them through and then serve immediately with basmati rice and / or roti or naan bread
33. Garnish with the reserved fresh cilantro and cashews if using

title: simple chocolate brownies
steps:
1. Sieve all dry ingredients together
2. In a separate bowl , cream butter n sugar till light
3. Add eggs one at a time , beating well between each addition
4. Fold dry ingredients in this mixture
5. Add vanilla and milk

7. Pour into a greased pan
8. Bake at 160c for 25-30 minute
9. Cool in pan for 10 min then invert and cool on a rack

title: honey glazed chicken
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. In a shallow dish combine the flower and seasonings , plus salt and pepper to taste
3. Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces
4. Dip each piece of chicken in flour mixture and coat evenly
5. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a shallow baking dish , large enough to accommodate chicken in a single layer

7. Meanwhile , in a small saucepan , melt remaining butter and add honey , lemon juice , soy sauce and ginger

steps:
1. Bake cake in a 9 inch pan per box instructions

3. Cool cake completely

11. Cut paper into strips to resemble corn stocks and add to cake
12. Tie twin or yarn around corn stocks

steps:
1. For filling , in a food processor bowl combine cranberries , pecans , and brown sugar
2. Cover
3. Process until cranberries and nuts are finely chopped
4. Set aside
5. In a large mixing bowl cream butter and sugar
6. Add baking powder , and salt

16. Pinch to seal

title: beef   pork meatloaf   onion gravy

1. Preheat oven to 350 f
2. Mix all ingredients together
3. Shape into a loaf pan

3. Add the eggs and vanilla , beat until combined
4. Sift together the flour , soda and salt
5. Add to creamed mixture along with oats and blend
6. Fold in any extras you wish
7. Drop by teaspoons full , or however large you like your cookie , on a parchment-lined baking sheet
8. Bake for 12 minutes

title: super fast salisbury steak
steps:
1. Combine ground turkey , ground round , breadcrumbs or oats , eggs , carrots , onions , green pepper , salt and pepper
2. Divide meat mixture into 6 equal portions , shaping each into a 1 / 2-inch-thick patty
3. Heat a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium-high heat
4. Add patties
5. Cook 6 minutes or until browned , turning after 3 minutes
6. Remove patties from pan
7. Keep warm
8. Stir in water , tomato paste , wine or sherry , worcestershire sauce , pepper , and french onion soup
9. Bring to a boil
10. Add patties and fresh sliced mushrooms if using
11. Cover
12. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes
13. Uncover and cook until wine mixture is reduced to 3 / 4 cup

2. Grease a 9x13 inch pan
3. For crust , mix cake mix , egg , and 1 stick of melted butter with a large spoon and pat into the bottom and up the sides of pan

5. Add powdered sugar and vanilla
6. Mix until smooth
7. Slowly add melted butter to filling and mix until smooth
8. Pour the filling over the crust and bake 25 - 30 minutes
9. Check after 25 minutes
10. When it is done , the edges will pull away from the sides of pan and the filling will have browned , but middle should be very gooey
11. It will still jiggle

title: judy s ribs
steps:
1. In a large non-aluminum pot , combine spareribs , water to cover , onion , vinegar , brown sugar , herbs and salt
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for about 45 minutes
4. Combine marinade ingredients
5. Drain ribs , arrange in a 13 x 9 inch baking dish , pour marinade over hot ribs
6. Cover and refrigerate up to 24 hours
7. Preheat oven to 425 for 5 minutes
8. Uncover ribs , turn to coat well with sauce , bake 25 minutes and baste before serving

title: thai style chicken salad
steps:
1. Combine chicken with garlic , ginger , and soy
2. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hrs
3. Heat oil to medium heat and cook chicken in small batches
4. Set aside
5. Combine chicken with prepared onions , capsicums , peas and parsley on serving plate
6. Place chilli sauce , oil and vinegar in jar , shake well and pour over salad
7. Toss lightly to combine all ingredients
8. Serve straight away

title: the best marinara sauce   meatballs
steps:
1. Marinara sauce: combine onion , chicken broth , garlic , paprika , basil , salt , oregano , pepper and fennel seeds
2. Cook over medium heat 10 minutes or until broth is reduced by half
3. Add crushed and whole tomatoes with their liquid , worcestershire sauce and parsley
4. Simmer partially covered over low heat for 30 minutes or until thicken
5. Add sugar
6. Meatballs: combine all ingrediants
7. Lightly shape into 1" balls
8. Use a non-stick skillet and brown 8 at a time for 2-3 minutes
9. Add all meatballs to skillet and cook until the inside is done

title: crantastic baked chicken breast
steps:
1. Combine the cranberry sauce , thousand island salad dressing and the onion soup mix
2. Layer half the cranberry mixture in a 13x9 baking dish that has been sprayed with vegetable cooking spray
3. Place the chicken over the mixture in pan
4. Spread the remaining cranberry mixture on top of the chicken
5. Bake in a 325f oven for approximately 35 minutes or until chicken is cooked through
6. Serve with baked potatoes or buttered noodles

title: maggie s lethal kumquat liqueur
steps:
1. Put the pricked kumquats , sugar and brandy in a jar that can be tightly sealed
2. Store jar away from sunlight
3. Every day for the next 14 days , turn the jar over and back to distribute the sugar
4. You don't need to shake the jar
5. After the 14 days are up , keep turning the jar over and back at least once a week until the sugar has completely dissolved
6. When the sugar has dissolved , use tongs or a slotted spoon to gently remove the kumquats
7. Leave the liqueur to age in the jar
8. Dip these boozy kumquats in melted chocolate for a delicious treat with after-dinner coffee
9. Store in the freezer
10. Six months later , the liqueur is ready to be bottled and enjoyed
11. Maggie saves interesting-looking smaller bottles to use for gifts
12. The well-aged liqueur is thicker , sweeter and more syrupy

title: pumpernickel onion bread   breadmaker 1 1 2 lb  loaf
steps:
1. Measure all ingredients into bread machine pan in the order suggested by manufacturer
2. Process on basic / white bread cycle
3. Use medium / normal crust color setting
4. Remove bread from pan
5. Cool on wire rack

title: oyster crackin s  ranch crackers snack
steps:
1. Mix oil , dressing mix and cheese in a large bowl , add crackers and mix well
2. Let stand a couple hours , stirring occasionally
3. Will store a couple of weeks covered

title: oven roasted potato balls
steps:
1. In a 4 quart pan boil 10 c water
2. Meanwhile take a melon baller , and scoop balls from potatoes
3. Place in a bowl of cold water
4. Pre-heat oven to 450
5. Add balls to water , reduce heat to low , cover and simmer 2 min
6. Drain well
7. Toss potatoes with oil , onion and salt and pepper
8. Roast for 30 min , stir and roast for 20 minutes more

title: dirt pudding
steps:
1. Break up cookies , put 1 / 2 on bottom of preferred dish and save other 1 / 2 for topping
2. Mix pudding and milk together , set aside
3. Mix sugar , cream cheese and butter
4. Add sugar mixture to pudding
5. Fold in cool whip
6. Pour onto cookies , top with remaining cokies
7. I like to let it cool for atleast a half hour if i have time
8. Let's it all meld together and it tastes better cool

title: bacon  spinach and feta muffin loaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c
2. Grease a 21cm x 10cm loaf pan
3. Remove rind and most of the at from bacon and chop
4. Add bacon and onion to a medium non-stick frying pan
5. Cook and stir for 5 minutes or until bacon is crisp and onion is soft
6. Remove from pan reserving a 1 / 4 of the bacon mixture
7. Add spinach and oregano to pan
8. Cook and stir until just wilted and remove from pan and cool slightly
9. Sift flour and salt into a large bowl and make a well at the centre and add oil , egg and milk and stir until just combined
10. Gently fold in spinach mixture and feta until just combined
11. Spoon mixture into prepared pan and top with reserved bacon mixture and extra feta
12. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until a skewer inserted at centre comes out clean
13. Stand pan for 5 minutes and then turn out onto a wire rack to cool slightly and then serve with butter

title: hot german buttered noodles
steps:
1. Add 1 bullion cubes to gallon water in a medium pot , bring to a boil
2. Add noodles and set timer for 1 min longer than the longest time listed on the package , stir a couple of times while cooking
3. While noodles are boiling add 1 / 2 cup water , 1 / 2 chicken bullion cube and butter to glass measuring cup
4. Microwave for 45 seconds on high , stir
5. If the butter is not melted all the way microwave again for 30 seconds and mix well until bullion is dissolved
6. When noodles are done drain water from pot but do not rinse , add butter mixture and parsley
7. Mix well until most liquid is absorbed , about a minute
8. Serve immediately with crushed ritz crackers on top

title: curried carrot bisque
steps:
1. Heat butter over medium heat in pot
2. Stir in carrots , leeks , ginger , garlic
3. And curry powder
4. Saute for about 5 minutes or until leeks soften slightly
5. Pour in chicken stock , bring to a boil , lower heat and simmer , covered , 20 ~ 25 minutes or until vegetables are tender
6. Puree in a blender or food processor
7. Return to heat , add whipping cream , salt and pepper and simmer for 5 minutes
8. Garnish with grated carrot
9. Serves 4 to 6
10. The globe and mail -----

title: blueberry lemon crunch
steps:
1. Place fruit in a small baking dish
2. Combine sugar , flour , oats , lemon rind and margarine
3. Sprinkle mixture over fruit
4. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes

title: dad s iced tea
steps:
1. Warm your teapot or glass or ceramic saucepan by rinsing it with boiling water
2. Place place tea bag in pot
3. Pour boling water over bags
4. Cover and steep 3-5 minutes
5. Remove tea bags , add sugar , stir until sugar dissolves
6. Stir in 2 cups of water

title: easy zucchini bake casserole
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Make in a greased 9x12 pan at 350 for 25-30 minutes

title: brunswick stew from caswell county  nc
steps:
1. Use tight-fitting cookware to hold in the flavor as the ingredients are boiled separately
2. Cook everything in separate pots and put them together at the end
3. Start out by slowly boiling the meats until they are tender
4. Remove the bones and skins from the chickens
5. Re-use the broths to boil potatoes and butter beans
6. Then cook the onions and corn in reserved broth
7. Do not add any of the tomato products during the initial cooking process
8. When all of the ingredients are cooked , add them together in one big pot
9. Add all of the remaining ingredients and mix them well
10. Bring the pot to a boil and continue stirring with a wooden spoon or a boat oar to keep it from sticking to the pot and burning
11. An appetizing presentation is made to the general public with someone stirring a large cauldron mounted to a tripod over an open fire
12. Stir the stew for approximately one hour over the fire as it continues to get thicker with the water boiling off of it
13. This step is very important , the stew must be boiled down until it is quite thick
14. Serve stew with a mayonnaise based slaw and saltine crackers
15. It is best during the colder months of the year
16. Brunswick stew freezes well
17. Enjoy !

title: browned butter cream cheese frosting
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , over medium heat , cook 1 / 2 cup butter until browned and nutty fragranced
2. Watch carefully , stir occasionally and do not let burn
3. This should take about 15-20 minutes
4. Cube the other 1 / 4 cup of butter and place in a mixing bowl with softened cream cheese
5. Pour browned butter over top and allow to sit for about 3 minutes
6. Add the vanilla extract or vanilla bean seeds
7. With an electric mixer , beat until the butter and cream cheese are smooth
8. Gradually add the confectioners' sugar until the proper consistency is reached
9. Add 1-3 tablespoon heavy cream , if needed , to thin to a spreading consistency
10. If the frosting is too soft for decorating , refrigerate for about half an hour before using

title: pressured country kitchen swiss steak
steps:
1. Peel the onion and cut into wedges
2. Scrub two of the carrots and cut into 2" pieces heat the oil in the pressure cooker
3. Add the pot roast and brown well on both sides
4. Add the onion and the 2 cut carrots
5. Pour the vinegar into the bottom of the pan and add the stock or broth and bay leaf
6. Cover pressure cooker and bring up to full pressure
7. Reduce heat to stabilizer pressure and cook for 30 minutes while the roast is cooking , peel the remaining two carrots
8. Cut the carrots , celery and parsnips , if used , into 3 / 4" pieces
9. Cut the potatoes in half
10. When the roast has cooked 30 minutes , release pressure
11. Remove the meat , set aside , and cover to keep warm whil you finish the sauce
12. Skim the fat from the cooking liquid and remove the bay leaf
13. Spoon the carrots and onions into a blender and puree
14. Stir the puree into the cooking liquid
15. Return to the pressure cooker and add the tomato paste , vegetables , and salt and pepper to taste , mixing well
16. Cover pressure cooker and bring up to full pressure
17. Reduce heat to stabilize pressure and cook for 5 minutes
18. Transfer the roast to a platter and pour the sauce and vegetables over it

title: tofu pot pie
steps:
1. Cook potato and carrot in a pot of boiling salted water until tender , about 10 minutes , drain , rinse and set aside
2. Put stock and tamari in a small saucepan and bring to a boil over medium-high heat , reduce to low and whisk in the cornstarch-water mixture , simmer 2-3 minutes , stirring until thickened , remove from heat and set aside
3. Heat the olive oil in a medium-size skillet over medium heat
4. Add the onion , cover and cook until softened , about 5 minutes
5. Add the onion to the potatoes and carrots and mix in the tofu , corn and peas
6. Preheat oven to 350f
7. For the crust , incorporate the salt into the flour , add the corn oil and with 2 butter knives cut the oil into the flour until crumbly and well incorporated
8. Add the water and mix until it forms a ball
9. Divide the crust in two and on a lightly floured surface , roll out each ball until it is slightly larger than a 2-quart casserole dish
10. Place one half into the casserole dish , and put the vegetables on top
11. Place the second crust over the vegetables and crimp the edges
12. Bake until the filling is hot and bubbly and the crust is browned , about 45 minutes
13. Let rest for 5 minutes before serving
14. P
15. S
16. Someone asked a question whether to use silken or waterpacked
17. Waterpacked / chinese-style is ideal , but it may still work if all you have is silken
18. Or go ahead and omit the tofu altogether
19. It's an adaptable recipe

title: low fat foil parcel for one
steps:
1. Heat oven to 250c
2. Slice the mushrooms and place on a foil sheet
3. Sprinkle the oregano and leek over the mushrooms
4. Place the tomato slices on top
5. Sprinkle the salt , pepper , parsley and the soya sauce on top
6. Fold the foil to secure the filling and bake for 15 minutes
7. Serve over the noodles and sprinkle the cheese over

title: rumrunner s pecan pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In large bowl beat eggs with wire whisk
3. Add flour and continue to whisk until it has been incorporated
4. Add corn syrup , sugar , rum , butter and vanilla
5. Stir in pecans
6. Evenly divide mixture between frozen pie crusts
7. Bake 50-55 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean
8. Let cool at room temp on wire rack

title: caramelized cranberry chicken
steps:
1. Combine the first 4 ingredients in a large zip lock bag and add the chicken
2. Seal and chill at least 1 hour
3. Cook brown sugar and sesame oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat , stirring constantly , for 4 minutes
4. Remove chicken from marinade , but save it for making the sauce
5. Add chicken to the sesame oil and brown sugar mixure in the skillet , cooking 3 minutes on each side
6. Add marinade to the skillet , onion and cranberries
7. Cook , stirring and turning the chicken often for about 10 more minutes
8. Remove the chicken and let it sit for 5 minutes
9. Slice and serve with the cranberry mixture , sprinkling with sesame seeds and green onions

title: norwegian parsley potatoes
steps:
1. Put the water , salt and potatoes in a pot and cook until the potatoes are just tender
2. Drain well
3. Pour the melted butter over the potatoes
4. Sprinkle the chopped parsley over the potatoes and toss lightly
5. Serve hot

title: pork  nut   vegetable noodles
steps:
1. Cut the pork into 1 / 2 slices & place in a shallow dish
2. Mix the soy sauce & cornflour together & pour over the pork mixing evenly
3. Cover with clingfilm & leave to marinate in the refrigerator for at least 6 hours
4. Stir fry the cashew & peanuts in a dry wok until toasted
5. Reserve
6. Combine all the vegetables , garlic & ginger
7. Heat a wok with 1 / 2 of the frying oil & stir fry the vegetables until the celery & peppers have softened
8. Remove from wok & keep warm
9. Drain the pork reserving the remaining marinade
10. Using the remaining oil heat in the wok until nearly smoking & stir fry the pork for around 5 minutes or until browned
11. Add the chicken stock & remaining marinade to the wok & simmer hard until the sauce has reduced by around 2 thirds as you don't want the pork too wet when adding the noodles
12. Add the vegetables , cashew & peanuts , freshly cooked noodles & chopped coriander
13. Stir fry for 3 minutes & serve immediately with fresh crusty white bread

title: holiday hash browns casserole
steps:
1. Mix sour cream , cheese , onion , and soup
2. Add hash browns to mixture and combine
3. Place in 13x9 pan
4. Melt butter and mix with cereal
5. Spread on top of potatoes
6. Bake 350 for 55 minutes

title: melt in  your mouth chocolate drop cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f cream butter and sugar ina large bowl blend in vanilla and egg in a cup , mix milk with sour cream until smoooth sift in dry ingredients a little at a time alternating with the sour cream / milk mixture
2. Drop by teaspoonsful 2 in
3. Apart onto a greased baking sheet bake for 7-9 minutes
4. Remove from cookie cheet and cool on wire racks
5. These cookies will be very soft and will firm up when cooled
6. Be careful not to overcook

title: crown and coke
steps:
1. Pour crown royal whisky over ice cubes in highball glass
2. Add cola and stir

title: lemon chiffon cake with strawberry sauce
steps:
1. Cake: preheat oven to 350f
2. From cake mix , empty bag containing the powdered egg whites into a large mixing bowl
3. Add water and mix on low until egg whites are dissolved , then slowly increase the speed
4. When soft peaks begin to form , slowly add the sugar , a little at a time
5. Beat on high 1-2 minutes or until soft peaks form and then set aside
6. In another large bowl , beat oil and eggs 1-2 minutes until mixed and light in color
7. Add vanilla , lemon juice and zest and mix well
8. To the oil and egg mixture , add second bag from cake mix along with matzo cake meal
9. Mix on low until blended
10. Fold into beaten egg whites
11. Pour into ungreased angel food cake pan or 9-inch tube pan
12. Bake 35 minutes
13. Remove from oven and allow to cool completely before removing the cake
14. Serve with the sauce of your choice
15. Sauce: place strawberry preserves in a small saucepan
16. In small bowl , mix together the potato starch and wine , then add to the preserves
17. Heat on medium-high until it begins to boil
18. Reduce to low and stir until thickened
19. Remove from heat
20. Fold in the pineapple preserves and strawberries
21. Pour some over the cake or cake slices , sprinkling with almonds

title: chicken breasts with mushroom cream sauce
steps:
1. Season chicken with pepper and salt on both sides
2. Heat oil in a medium skillet over medium heat
3. Add the chicken and cook , turning once or twice and adjusting the heat to prevent burning , until brown and an instant-read thermometer inserted into the thickest part registers 165f , 12 to 16 minutes
4. Transfer to a plate and tent with foil to keep warm
5. Add shallot to the pan and cook , stirring , until fragrant , about 30 seconds
6. Add mushrooms
7. Cook , stirring occasionally , until tender , about 2 minutes
8. Pour in vermouth
9. Simmer until almost evaporated , scraping up any browned bits , about 1 minute
10. Pour in broth and cook until reduced by half , 1 to 2 minutes
11. Stir in cream and chives
12. Return to a simmer
13. Return the chicken to the pan , turn to coat with sauce and cook until heated through , about 1 minute

title: blueberry swirl cheesecake
steps:
1. Process berries in a food processor and press through a sieve
2. Place the puree & sugar in a saucepan over medium heat , stir until sugar is dissolved , rapidly simmer for 8 minutes or until thick
3. Set aside to cool
4. Base
5. Process the biscuits in a food processor until crushed and the almond meal & butter , process until combined
6. Grease a 22cm springform tin and line the base with non-stick baking paper
7. Press the crumb mixture over the base and refrigerate
8. Preheat over to 140 deg
9. Filling
10. To make the filling , process the cream cheese in a food processor until smooth , add the sour cream , eggs , sugar and vanilla , process until combined & smooth
11. Pour cream cheese mixture over the base
12. Drizzle the blueberry mixture over and using a butter knife gently swirl the mixture just through the top of the cream cheese mixture
13. Bake for 1 hour or until set
14. Refrigerate and serve cold

title: french toast strata  sherry and jim rougeux
steps:
1. Bring brown sugar , butter and cinnamon to boil
2. In a separate bowl , mix together milk , eggs surgar and vanilla
3. Lay one layer of bread in a greased 9x13 inch baking dish
4. Spread brown sugar mixture over top
5. Repeat with additional layers until loaf of bread is use up
6. Pour milk mixture over top
7. Cover with foil and bake at 350 for one hour
8. Remove foil and bake an additional 15 minutes , until golden brown

title: pacific fire shrimp
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Mash the butter with the creole seasoning , lemon pepper , rosemary , tabasco sauce and lemon juice
3. Arrange shrimp in a baking dish and brush on the seasoned butter
4. Bake for 5 to 6 minutes
5. Serve hot
6. French bread goes well with this on the side
7. This can be made in advance , spread on the butter seasoning , refrigerate up to 8 hours
8. Heat and serve

title: christmas cheese ball
steps:
1. Combine the first seven ingredients in a bowl and mix well
2. Shape into 2 balls
3. Roll in the pecans
4. Cover and chill
5. Remove from refrigerator 15 minutes before serving
6. Serve with crackers

title: strawberry banana cheesecake  light or full fat versions
steps:
1. For crust:
2. Put crumbs , melted butter , and honey in food processor and process until smooth
3. Spray 9-inch spring-form pan with cooking spray and press crumbs in pan
4. Bake at 350 for 10 minutes or until edges feel firm and dry
5. Set aside until cool to the touch
6. For strawberries / bananas:
7. In a food processor , combine strawberries , sugar , and cornstarch
8. Cover and process until smooth
9. Pour into a saucepan
10. Bring to a boil on medium-low
11. Boil and stir for 2 minutes
12. Cover sauce and refridgerate until needed
13. Cut two bananas into even slices , and set aside
14. For cheescake:
15. In a mixing bowl , beat cream cheese until light and fluffy
16. Gradually beat in condensed milk
17. Add lemon juice
18. Mix well
19. Add eggs , beat on low until just combined
20. For assembaly:
21. Pour half of the cream cheese mixture over crust
22. Using 1 / 2 teaspoonfulls , carefully drop a thin layer of strawberry sause over the first layer of cream cheese
23. Cover with an ever layer of slices bananas
24. Carefully spoon remaining cream cheese mixture over sauce
25. Drop more strawberry sauce by 1 / 2 teaspoonfuls on top
26. With a butter knife , cut through top layer only to swirl strawberry sauce
27. Cover remaining strawberry sauce and refrigerate
28. Come serving , warm sauce in the microwave
29. If it has thickened excessively , add some water to make it pourable
30. Bake cheesecake at 300 degrees f for 45-50 minutes or until center is almost set
31. You may need to bake a touch if using the lower-fat ingrediants
32. Cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes
33. Carefully run a knife around edge of pan to loosen
34. Cool 1 hour longer
35. Refrigerate overnight
36. Remove side of pan and serve with strawberry sauce

title: fluffy strawberry  lime pie
steps:
1. In a bowl mix the strawberry gelatin with boiling water until the gelatin and sugar are completely dissolved
2. Stir in the lime peel and lime juice
3. Refrigerate for about 1 hour or until very thick but not set
4. In a medium bowl beat the gelatin mixture using an electric mixer on high speed for about 4 minutes , scraping the bowl occasionally until thick and fluffy
5. Set aside
6. In another chilled bowl beat the whipping cream and 3 / 4 cup powdered sugar on high speed until stiff
7. Using a spatula gently stir in the whipping cream mixture with the crushed strawberries into the gelatin / lime mixture
8. Pour into prepared baked crust
9. Refrigerate for a minumum of 3 hours or until set
10. Garnish with whipped cream and sliced strawberries
11. Refrigerate and leftovers

title: smoked salmon and goat cheese pizza
steps:
1. Brush pizza crust with olive oil
2. Spread goat cheese and diced or crushed garlic on pizza crust
3. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes at 400 or until goat cheese starts to brown
4. Remove pizza from oven
5. Cover pizza with smoked salmon , fresh dill and olives
6. Bake an additional couple of minutes

title: christmas cranberry nut tassies  mini
steps:
1. Beat 1 / 2 cup butter and cream cheese at medium speed with an electric mixer until creamy
2. Gradually add flour , beating well
3. Cover and chill dough 1 hour
4. Shape dough into 24 balls
5. Press 1 dough ball into each lightly greased cup of miniature muffin pans , shaping each into a shell
6. Combine egg and next 3 ingredients
7. Stir in cranberries and pecans
8. Spoon 1 tablespoon mixture into each shell
9. Bake at 325 degrees f for 25 minutes or until filling is set
10. Remove from pans immediately , and let cool completely on wire racks

title: sesame vegetable salad
steps:
1. Dressing:
2. Put first seven ingredients for dressing in a blender or food processor
3. Process until ginger and garlic finely chopped
4. Add oil slowly processing until well blended
5. Put into a jar and refrigerate
6. Salad:
7. Slice cucumbers and radishes thinly , put into bowl
8. Shred carrots into bowl
9. Add quartered mushrooms and chopped scallions
10. Mix vegetables
11. May refrigerate until ready to serve
12. Over medium heat toast sesame seeds for 2 to 3 minutes
13. To serve:
14. Add dressing to vegetables , mix and sprinkle sesame seeds on top

title: avocado   jalapeno salad
steps:
1. Arrange avocado slices on a serving dish
2. Sprinkle with lime juice and season with salt and pepper
3. Sprinkle with cilantro leaves and jalapeos
4. Serve

title: easy moroccan vegetarian stew
steps:
1. Cook rice according to package directions
2. Saute the onion , pepper , and garlic until soft and slightly brown
3. Dump in your other canned ingredients , and seasonings
4. Seasonings may be adjusted to personal preference
5. Simmer
6. Serve
7. Over rice

title: roasted curried cauliflower
steps:
1. Place cauliflower and onions in roasting dish in single layer
2. Whisk remaining ingredients together and pour over vegetables
3. Toss well
4. Roast in 210 degrees c oven for 35 minutes

title: awesome banana pudding
steps:
1. In a large bow , beat cream cheese until fluffy
2. Beat in condensed milk , pudding mix , cold milk and vanilla until smooth
3. Fold in half the whipped topping
4. In 9 x 13 dish layer vanilla wafers with bananas and pudding mixture
5. Top with remaining whipped topping
6. Chill well
7. Cook time is the chill time
8. There is no cooking involved

title: sito s lebanese cabbage salad
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl
2. Taste and add more lemon juice and seasonings , if desired

title: openfaced mushroom sandwich
steps:
1. Rinse and thoroughly dry the mushrooms
2. Leave smaller mushrooms whole , and slice the larger mushrooms
3. Heat a non-stick skillet and add mushrooms to the dry skillet
4. The mushrooms will release liquid as they fry
5. When all the liquid is gone , add 1 tbsp butter
6. Continue to fry until they brown and crisp around the edges
7. Season with salt and pepper and set aside
8. Grill the bread in a pan , using the remaining butter
9. Place two slices of grilled bread on each plate
10. Top the slices with 1 / 4 of the mushrooms and sprinkle 1 / 2 tbsp of the parsley on top
11. Excellent served with a cold beer !

title: bavarian  pulled  apple strudel  gezogene strudel
steps:
1. Work the flour , eggs , oil , water , and salt into a dough
2. Divide into three parts
3. Form a ball of each piece , brush each piece of dough with oil and let it rest for 45 min
4. Place a old clean tablecloth on the table , roll out a ball a thin as you can
5. Here comes the tricky part
6. Make sure you are wearing no rings-- go under the dough like you are making your hands into claws with your fingers pointing down at the table and the soft part of your knuckles is what is going to pull the dough toward you
7. You will do this all around in a circle until the dough is paper thin and you can see through it
8. Brush generously with melted butter during this process
9. Trim off the heavy edges
10. Sprinkle on the apples , some sugar , cinnamon to taste , nuts if you like and drizzle a little melted butter over all
11. Now take the tablecloth and fold about 5" over toward the center on each side forming a frame around the dough
12. From the long side , lift one side of the tablecloth and roll up completely
13. Fold it as long as your pan is
14. Seal edges
15. Gently put rolled strudel into the pan bake at 350 for about 45-55 min
16. Until golden brown
17. There are other fillings like cheese , cabbage , sweet or sour cherries , raisins / nuts can be added to the apples , even meats have been done with this dough
18. I prefer the apple and cheese myself

title: skillet biscuits
steps:
1. Mix together dry ingredients in a large bowl
2. Cut in shortening or butter
3. Add and lightly mix buttermilk
4. Turn dough onto a floured surface and knead gently for 1 / 2 minute
5. Pat the dough to a thickness of 1 / 4 inch
6. Cut with a biscuit cutter
7. If you want to bake the biscuits , bake 10-12 minutes at 450
8. For skillet biscuits:
9. Cook the biscuits on a lightly greased hot skillet / griddle about 1 inch apart
10. Use your best judgement as to the heat - i generally use a more moderate flame and brown biscuits 3 to 4 minutes each side , though the original recipe says to brown them for 5-7 minutes each side over high heat
11. As mentioned above - the biscuits will not be light and fluffy like with baked biscuits - so don't wait for them to rise and be puffy
12. They will be more dense
13. The best approach is to keep an eye on them and turn them when they are browned and dry-looking on one side before turning them over

title: tortellini veggie fest
steps:
1. Cook tortellini according to package directions
2. Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat
3. Add green onions and garlic
4. Saute 2 minutes
5. Add carrots and mushrooms and cook 3 minutes more
6. Stir in spinach and wine and cook 2-3 minutes or until spinach wilts
7. Stir in tomatoes , beans , and italian seasoning
8. Cook 3-4 minutes or until heated through
9. Fold in tortellini and serve with grated cheese on top

title: brownie pudding dessert
steps:
1. Make the brownies according to package directions add in the walnuts to the batter
2. Bake in a greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan
3. Cool completely
4. In a bowl using an electric mixer at low speed beat the chocolate pudding mix with 1 cup half and half cream until smooth
5. Let rest for 5 minutes , then spread on top of the cooled brownies
6. Spread the whipped cream or thawed cool whip on top of the pudding , then sprinkle with crushed cookies or grated chocolate
7. Chill for 2 hours before serving
8. Delicious !

title: wilted spinach with orange   ginger
steps:
1. In a large nonstick skillet , pile the spinach and turn the heat to high
2. Using tongs , gently and continuously toss the spinach over the heat until it's all wilted , 2 to 3 min
3. Don't overcook
4. They should collapse but still have some body
5. Transfer them to a colander and let any excess liquid drip away
6. Wipe the skillet clean if necessary
7. In the same skillet , heat the butter and oil over medium-low heat
8. When the butter is melted , add the garlic and ginger and saut until softened and fragrant , about 2 min
9. Add the orange juice , turn the heat to high , and reduce the liquid to a glazy consistency , no more than 1 min
10. You'll have 1-1 / 2 to 2 tbs
11. Left in the pan
12. Turn the heat down to low , immediately add the drained spinach and the salt , and toss thoroughly to coat
13. Remove the pan from the heat
14. Serve hot from the pan or slightly cooled

title: sarah s swedish apple pie
steps:
1. Place the peeled and chopped apples in the bottom of a standard pie plate
2. Sprinkle sugar and cinnamon on top
3. In a small bowl mix topping ingredients and pat down on top of the apples
4. Bake at 350 for 45 min or until lightly brown

title: spicy thai noodles
steps:
1. Combine peanut butter , sesame sauce , salt , sugar , soy , vinegar , sesame oil , cayenne , 1 / 4 cup green onions & garlic in a bowl , mix well
2. Pour over well drained spaghetti , toss to coat
3. Garnish each individual serving with carrots , water chestnuts & remaining green onions
4. You can also garnish with cucumber , bean sprouts , bamboo shoots , peppers , peas or green beans

title: pecan crunch pumpkin cheesecake pie
steps:
1. In a medium mixing bowl beat cream cheese with an electric mixer on medium to high speed until smooth
2. With mixer on low to medium speed , beat in granulated sugar , vanilla , and 1 egg until smooth
3. Stir in lemon peel
4. Cover and chill for 30 minutes
5. Meanwhile , prepare pastry for deep-dish pie
6. On a lightly floured surface , roll dough to a 13-inch circle
7. Ease pastry into a 9-inch deep-dish pie plate
8. Trim pastry to 1 / 2 inch beyond edge of plate
9. Fold extra pastry under until even with the plates rim and crimp edges
10. Spoon cream-cheese mixture into the pastry-lined pie plate , spreading evenly
11. In a medium mixing bowl stir together pumpkin , half-and-half or light cream , 1 / 2 cup brown sugar , 2 eggs , pumpkin pie spice , and salt
12. Carefully pour over cream cheese mixture
13. Bake , loosely covered with foil , in a 350 oven for 30 minutes
14. Uncover
15. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes more or until center is just set
16. In a small bowl combine 3 tablespoons brown sugar , flour , and butter
17. Stir in pecans
18. Sprinkle pecan mixture evenly over pie filling
19. Bake 10 to 15 minutes more or until topping starts to brown
20. Cool 1 hour on a wire rack
21. Chill at least 2 hours before serving
22. Serve with sweetened whipped cream
23. For longer storage , cover and keep refrigerated
24. Makes 8 to 10 servings
25. Pastry for deep-dish pie: in a medium bowl stir together 1 1 / 2 cups all-purpose flour and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt
26. Using a pastry blender , cut in 6 tablespoons shortening until the pieces are pea size
27. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon cold water over part of the flour mixture
28. Gently toss with a fork
29. Push moistened dough to the side of bowl
30. Repeat , using 1 tablespoon water at a time , until all the flour is moistened
31. Form into a ball

title: 7 up cake
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy
2. Add eggs one at a time , beating well after each addition
3. Stir in flour
4. Beat in lemon extract and 7up
5. Pour batter into well greased and floured 12 cup fluted mold
6. Bake at 325 degrees for 60 minutes to an hour and 25 minutes
7. Cool
8. Dust with conf
9. Sugar if desired

title: honey almond granola
steps:
1. Position racks in the upper and lower thirds of the oven and heat oven to 325
2. Spray two baking sheets with vegetable oil spray
3. In a large bowl mix the oats , bran , and almonds
4. In a smaller bowl , whisk the oil , honey vanilla , almond extract , dry milk powder , and salt
5. Pour the mixture over the oats and stir , with your hands or a spoon , until well combined
6. Divide the mixture between the two oiled baking sheets and spread in an even layer
7. Bake for twenty minutes , stir the granola and switch the positions of the pans
8. Bake until the the oats are golden brown and almonds look well toasted another 10 to 20 minutes
9. Don't overcook
10. Let cool completely in the pans
11. The oats may feel soft but will get crisp as they cool
12. When completely cool , stir in raisins

title: traditional tres leches cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Butter and flour bottom of a 9 inch springform pan
3. Beat the egg yolks with 3 / 4 cup sugar until light in color and doubled in volume
4. Stir in milk , vanilla , flour and baking powder
5. In a small bowl , beat egg whites until soft peaks form
6. Gradually add remaining 1 / 4 cup sugar
7. Beat until firm but not dry
8. Fold egg whites into yolk mixture
9. Pour into prepared pan
10. Bake at 350 degrees f for 45 to 50 minutes or until cake tester inserted into the middle comes out clean
11. Allow to cool 10 minutes
12. Loosen edge of cake with knife before removing side of pan
13. Cool cake completely
14. Place on a deep serving plate
15. Use a two prong meat fork or cake tester to pierce surface of cake
16. Mix together condensed milk , evaporated milk and 1 / 4 cup of the whipping cream
17. Discard 1 cup of the measured milk mixture or cover and refrigerate
18. Pour remaining milk mixture over cake slowly until absorbed
19. Whip the remaining whipping cream until it thickens and reaches spreading consistency
20. Stir in almond extract
21. Frost cake with whipped cream and garnish with cherries

title: snickerdoodle bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Grease a 9x13 inch pan
3. Mix together first 4 ingredients in a small bowl
4. In a large mixing bowl , beat brown sugar and butter til fluffy
5. Add eggs and beat til well blended then beat in vanilla
6. Stir in flour mixture til well combined
7. Spead mixture in pan
8. Combine granulated sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over the dough
9. Bake for 20-23 minutes
10. Do not overcook
11. The center surface of the bars should stay very slightly depressed when done

title: dynasty corn pudding
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f generously butter a 2 quart rectangular casserole dish
2. In a blender or food processor , puree 1 cup corn kernels with melted butter and eggs
3. In a large bowl , combine all remaining ingredients , except parmesan cheese
4. Add pureed corn and mix well
5. Pour into casserole dish , sprinkle with parmesan and baked for 30 minutes , or until puffed and golden

title: wild rice with pecans
steps:
1. I use uncle ben's wild rice and long grain
2. I'm not certain about the oz
3. , but it is the regular size box
4. Prepare rice as directed on the package
5. It usually takes mine about 25 minutes
6. Lightly toast pecans in butter
7. Add celery and onions and saute for 5 minutes
8. Add cooked rice , stirring occasionally until heated through
9. This is also good with a small can of mushrooms added

title: cuppa cuppa cuppa onion dip
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Put into a small ovenproof dish
3. Sprinkle with some paprika for garnish , if desired
4. Bake 350 degrees until bubbly , usually 20 to 30 minutes
5. Serve with triscuit crackers

title: creamy pumpkin soup   for weight watching people
steps:
1. Melt margarine in a dutch oven over medium heat
2. Add onion: saute 3 minutes
3. Add sage , curry powder , and nutmeg
4. Cook 30 seconds
5. Stir in flour
6. Cook 30 seconds
7. Add broth tomato paste , and salt , stirring well with a whisk
8. Stir in pumpkin and apple
9. Bring to a boil
10. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 25 minutes or until pumpkin is tender , stirring occasionally
11. Remove from heat
12. Cool slightly
13. Place mixture in a blender or food processor
14. Process until smooth
15. Return mixture to dutch oven
16. Add milk
17. Cook until thoroughly heated
18. Garnish with sage sprigs if desired

title: walnut brewery asiago cheese dip
steps:
1. Reconstitute sun-dried tomatoes in hot water
2. Clean , rinse and slice green onions and mushrooms
3. Squeeze all the water out of the tomatoes , then julieene into fine strips
4. Combine all ingredients except tomatoes , then add the sun-dried toimatoes
5. Place into an oven-proof container
6. Top with remaining 1 t
7. Of asiago cheese
8. Bake at 350 for about 15 minutes or until bubbly
9. Serve immediately with toasted beer bread

title: swirled cheesecake nibbles
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f place 36 2 inch foil baking cups on baking sheets with sides
2. Place one vanilla wafer , flat side down , on bottom of each cup
3. Place 5 to 6 swirled morsels on top of each wafer
4. Beat cream cheese , sugar and flour in large mixer bowl until creamy
5. Add eggs and vanilla
6. Beat well
7. Spoon heaping tablespoon of cream cheese mixture into each cup
8. Bake for 15-17 minutes or until just set and not browned
9. Remove from oven to wire rack
10. While still warm , top with remaining swirled morsels
11. Morsels will soften , but will retain shape
12. Cool completely
13. Cover and refrigerate

title: diabetic sunshine orange cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Lightly coat an 8x8x2-inch baking pan with cooking spray
3. In a mixing bowl , combine margarine , sweeteners and egg
4. Beat on medium speed 2-3 minutes
5. Scraping sides of bowl as necessary
6. In medium bowl , sift together flour , baking powder , baking soda and cinnamon
7. Stir in raisins or apples and orange zest
8. Add to first mixture , alternating with the orange juice , beginning and ending with the flour mixture
9. Pour the batter into the prepared pan
10. Bake 18-20 minutes ,
11. Or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
12. Cool cake in pan on wire rack

title: super easy   delicious fudge
steps:
1. Spray a large bread pan with a non-stick spray
2. Also , prepare a double boiler by getting the water boiling
3. Also , this is a recipe which requires constant stirring , so have a spoon handy !
4. In the double boiler , add the butter , vanilla and sweetened condensed milk and melt together
5. It keeps you from burning the chocolate by providing an even heat source
6. Once the mixture is blended and easy to stir , add the chocolate chips , stirring constantly
7. Stir until the mixture is glossy and well blended with no chunks
8. Pour into the prepared bread pan
9. If desired , insert andes chocolate mints throughout the fudge by pushing it into the top
10. Let cool completely before serving
11. Enjoy !

title: rice  krispies bars loaded
steps:
1. In a double boiler melt butter
2. Add all the chips , stir in the peanut butter and marshmallows
3. Melt completely
4. Mix the melted mixture with rice krispies and put into a 9 x 13 pan
5. Smooth top until level
6. Refrigerate until cold
7. Cut into bars

title: savory corn and bacon bread pudding  rsc
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large skillet over medium heat , heat 2 tablespoons oil
3. Add bread cubes
4. Stir to coat
5. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoons of hidden valley original ranch seasoning
6. Cook and stir until bread begins to lightly brown
7. Remove from heat
8. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside
9. To the same skillet , heat the remainingoil over medium heat
10. Add shallot
11. Cook and stir for 3-4 minutes or until crisp-tender
12. Add corn and bacon
13. Cook 3 minutes longer
14. Remove to a small bowl to cool
15. In a large bowl , whisk eggs , cream and 1 tablespoons hidden valley original ranch seasoning until combined
16. Stir in cheese , hot sauce , salt and pepper
17. Gently fold in corn mixture and reserved bread cubes
18. Let stand for 3 minutes
19. Spoon into a 1-1 / 2 quart greased baking dish
20. In a small bowl , combine remaining topping ingredients
21. Panko , parmesan cheese , remaining 1 t
22. Of hidden valley original ranch seasoning , lemon zest and thyme
23. Set aside
24. Bake , uncovered , for 20 minutes
25. Sprinkle with topping
26. Bake 25 minutes longer or until puffed , golden and a knife inserted near the center comes out clean
27. Serve warm

title: honey mustard dressed green bean salad
steps:
1. Steam the green beans in a covered pot with half an inch of boiling water for 3-5 minutes
2. Shock them by running them under cold water and drain well
3. In a large mixing bowl , mix the mustard , honey , vinegar , salt and black pepper with a whisk
4. When the ingredients are well combined , drizzle the olive oil in a slow and steady stream while continuously whisking
5. Add the green beans to the bowl with the dressing along with the scallions and radishes , and toss to coat
6. Serve and enjoy !

title: new sweet potato cobbler
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. In a dutch oven , cook sweet potatoes in boiling water until almost tender
3. Remove the sweet potatoes from the water and place in a deep baking dish
4. Pour the remaining liquid from the dutch oven over the sweet potatoes in the baking dish
5. Combine sugar , nutmeg , cinnamon , orange zest and orange juice
6. Pour over the sweet potatoes
7. Dot top of potatoes with butter
8. Cover potatoes with the pie crust and pinch all edges
9. Cut slits in the top of the crust
10. Bake at 450 degrees for 10 minutes
11. Reduce heat to 375 degrees and bake 15-20 additional minutes
12. Serve warm

title: thai chicken with basil stir fry
steps:
1. Bring rice and water to a boil in a pot
2. Cover , reduce heat to low , and simmer 15-20 minutes , or according to package instructions
3. In a bowl , mix the coconut milk , soy sauce , rice wine vinegar , fish sauce , and red pepper flakes
4. In a skillet or wok , heat the oil over medium-high heat
5. Stir in the onion , ginger , mushrooms , and garlic , and cook until lightly browned - about 8 minutes
6. Mix in ground turkey , and cook until browned
7. Stir in the coconut milk sauce
8. Continue cooking until sauce is reduced be about 1 / 3
9. Mix in green onions , and basil , and cook until heated through
10. Serve over the cooked rice

title: slow cooked madras chicken curry  crock pot
steps:
1. Lightly spray the interior of your crock pot with a light coating of cooking spray for easier clean up later
2. Cover the bottom of pot with the onions , garlic and jalapeos
3. Top with the chicken breasts
4. Combine the curry powder , chutney , tomato paste and ginger together and pour over the chicken
5. Place the apples on top
6. Cook for 4-5 hours on high until the chicken is cooked and tender but not falling apart
7. Mix the sauce together so that all elements are blended
8. If you want a thicker sauce , remove the chicken from the crock pot and stir in a teaspoon or two of cornstarch and cook until the sauce is glossy

title: pasta with sun dried tomatoes  snap peas  and feta
steps:
1. Boil spaghetti in salted water according to package directions
2. It is very important to cook the pasta al dente because you are going to add it to the heat later
3. If you do not cook it al dente , the noodles may become overcooked and soggy
4. Season chicken breasts according to taste
5. Brown and cook on the stove using olive oil
6. Set aside
7. Using the same pot you cooked the chicken in , add 1 / 2 cup of olive oil
8. Add 5-6 cloves of minced garlic
9. Keep the heat somewhat low so you do not burn the garlic
10. Add red pepper flakes
11. It is very important to not skimp on the garlic and red pepper flakes
12. This will give the sauce flavor , and without it the sauce will be bland
13. It is hard to be sure of the exact measurements , since it is according to taste
14. I used about a tablespoon or more of red pepper flakes , but we like it a bit spicy
15. I suggest you add a teaspoon at a time , tasting the sauce as you go , to see what heat level you prefer
16. Some might like more garlic and red pepper flakes , some might like less , so be sure to taste it as you go
17. Drain pasta and stir in oil mixture
18. Optional step: i add about a little bit of chicken broth to make it more liquidy and add flavor
19. Again , you just have to wing it here , and see what suits your taste
20. Add sun-dried tomatoes and snap peas
21. Cook on moderate low heat until snap peas are heated
22. Snap peas should not be soggy , but have a little bite to them
23. Add feta cheese and toss
24. Optional step: add fresh parsley
25. Place sliced chicken breast on top
26. Enjoy !

title: lemon bran muffins
steps:
1. In a medium-size bowl , combine the bran cereal and buttermilk
2. Let stand until the cereal is soft ,
3. About 10 minutes
4. Add lightly beaten egg whites , molasses , oil , lemon juice and vanilla
5. Use a hand
6. Mixer to combine well
7. In another medium-size bowl , combine the flour , oat bran and baking powder
8. Stir in lemon rind and raisins
9. Pour the milk mixture into the flour mixture
10. Use a large spoon to
11. Combine quickly
12. Don't over mix
13. Spoon the batter into non-stick muffin cups
14. Bake at 375f for
15. About 15 - 20 minutes
16. Cool the muffins for 10 minutes before serving or freezing

title: gisella s amatriciana pasta with pancetta
steps:
1. In a deep , large skillet , cook the pancetta in the olive oil until lightly crisp
2. Remove the pancetta from the pan onto paper towels to drain and set aside
3. In the same pan , add the chopped onion and cook until golden over a low heat and then add the tomatoes and any optional ingredients
4. Simmer 10-15 minutes
5. Meanwhile , cook the pasta according to the box , to just "al dente" , and drain
6. Add the pasta to the tomatoes
7. Now add the cheese and the pancetta to the tomatoes and blend it all in the skillet
8. Serve immediately

title: black bean and soyrizo chili
steps:
1. Remove 2 chiles from can
2. Finely chop , reserving remaining chiles and sauce for another use
3. Heat a large dutch oven coated with cooking spray over medium-high heat
4. Add chiles , 1 3 / 4 cups onion , bell peppers , garlic , and soyrizo
5. Saut 5 minutes or until tender
6. Add chili powder and next 7 ingredients , stirring to combine
7. Bring to a boil
8. Reduce heat , and simmer , covered , 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
9. Remove from heat
10. Stir in chocolate , salt , and black pepper
11. Ladle 1 cup chili into each of 12 bowls
12. Top each serving with 1 tablespoon sour cream and 1 tablespoon onion
13. Serve with tortilla chips

title: maple spice nuts
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Heat oil in large skillet over high heat
3. Add almonds
4. Saute , stirring 2 to 3 minutes , until almonds begin to brown
5. Add pecans
6. Saute 1 minute
7. Add peanuts
8. Saute 1 minute more
9. Lower heat to medium-high
10. Sprinkle nuts with salt , coriander , black pepper and cayenne pepper
11. Toss to coat nuts
12. Pour maple syrup over nuts , saute until syrup is evaporated and nuts are lightly caramelized , 1 minute
13. Spoon into 15 x 10 x 1 inch baking pan or cookie sheet
14. Bake in 350 degree oven , tossing occasionally , for 30 minutes or until no longer sticky
15. Cool completely

title: spicy fried celery
steps:
1. Cut the celery sticks into 4cm lengths , then finely shred these vertically
2. Slice the chilli thinly
3. Heat the oil in a fry pan , and add the celery , chilli and sugar
4. Stir-fry over a moderate heat for 1 minute , then add the soy sauce and continue stir frying for a further minute or two and until all the liquid has evaporated
5. To keep the celery crisp , evaporate the liquid quickly

title: lemon cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Beat 1 / 2 cup of butter , shortening and sugar until light and fluffy
3. Add eggs one at a time
4. Shift flour , baking soda and salt together and add alternately with buttermilk
5. Stir in 1 tablespoon lemon juice
6. Pour into a greased and floured tube pan , bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until cake tests done
7. Mix remaining butter with confectioners' sugar until creamy
8. Add remaining lemon rind and enough lemon juice to give pouring consistency
9. Pour over warm cake

title: eggplant bruschetta with pita chips
steps:
1. For the pita:
2. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
3. Cut flatbreads into 8 wedges
4. Place wedges into a large bowl and drizzle with 4 tablespoons olive oil
5. Sprinkle with black pepper and toss to coat
6. Place on an ungreased baking sheet and lightly top with feta cheese
7. Bake for 5 to 8 minutes
8. Remove from oven and set aside
9. For the bruschetta:
10. Preheat grill to medium-high heat
11. Brush eggplant with 4 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil and season with salt and pepper
12. Place on grill and cook for 2 minutes on each side or until tender
13. Remove from grill and dice
14. Add the eggplant to a bowl , stir in remaining ingredients , including 4 tablespoons of olive oil , and toss to combine
15. Serve with toasted pita chips

title: baked hoisin chicken buns
steps:
1. Add yeast to water
2. Stir in 1 / 4 cup of sugar
3. Allow to sit for 10 minutes until foamy
4. Beat egg with 2 tbsp of butter and add to yeast mixture
5. With mixer on low , add salt and slowly add in 31 / 2 cups of flour , one cup at a time
6. Knead in mixer on low for 10 minutes or until dough is pliable
7. Remove and shape as rolls , placing them on a pan lined with wax or parchment paper
8. Allow to rise for 30 minutes
9. While dough rises , heat a skillet over medium-high heat
10. Coat pan with cooking spray
11. Add chicken
12. Cook 4 minutes on each side or until done
13. Cool slightly
14. Shred meat with 2 forks
15. Place chicken in a medium bowl
16. Add green onions , hoisin sauce , oyster sauce , and vinegar
17. Toss well to combine
18. Roll each dough piece into a 4-inch circle on a lightly floured surface
19. Spoon about 2 tablespoons chicken mixture into center of each dough circle
20. Gather edges of dough over filling
21. Pinch to seal
22. Place the filled dough , seam sides down , on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray
23. Lightly coat filled dough with cooking spray
24. Cover and let rise 20 minutes
25. Beat together egg and water , set aside
26. Preheat oven to 375
27. Uncover filled dough
28. Gently brush with egg wash
29. Sprinkle evenly with sesame seeds
30. Bake at 375 for 15 minutes or until golden brown
31. Serve warm

title: radish   scallion salad
steps:
1. Rinse and dry the vegetables
2. Slice the scallions and place in a bowl
3. Add some salt and all of the sugar this salad is supposed to taste sweet mix gently
4. Cut the radishes in thin slices
5. Mix in the radish slices
6. Add the creme fraiche , one tablespoon at a time , until you get a mixture resembling a creamy potato salad in consistency
7. Serve immediately , as both the sugar and salt draw out liquid from the vegetables , making the salad soggy

title: crock pot oriental chicken thighs
steps:
1. Stack chicken thighs in crock pot sprayed with nonstick cooking spray
2. Combine olive oil , water , brown sugar , orange juice , ketchup , vinegar , garlic , red pepper , and five spice powder
3. Pour over chicken thighs
4. Cover and cook on low 5-6 hours
5. Combine cornstarch and water
6. Add to crock pot and stir
7. Cook on high 30 minutes or until thickened
8. Serve over rice and top with green onions

title: chocolate marmalade crumb cake bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Lightly spoon flour into dry measuring cups , and level with a knife
3. Combine flour , sugar , and salt in a bowl
4. Cut in butter with a pastry blender or 2 knives until mixture resembles coarse meal
5. Combine 1 / 3 cup flour mixture and candy bar for topping
6. Set aside
7. Stir baking powder and baking soda into remaining flour mixture in bowl
8. Add yogurt , milk , rind , vanilla , and egg whites
9. Beat at medium speed of a mixer until blended
10. Spoon batter into an 8-inch round cake pan coated with cooking spray
11. Drop marmalade by teaspoonfuls onto batter
12. Swirl together using the
13. Sprinkle topping over batter
14. Bake at 350 for 35 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
15. Cool in pan on a wire rack

title: ganache filled chocolate cookies   from scratch
steps:
1. Ganache:
2. Bring the cream and sugar to a light boil , being careful not to burn it
3. Add butter , vanilla , and chocolate chips
4. Stir constantly until all chocolate is melted and mixture is completely smooth
5. Be careful not to burn it
6. Place in a covered container and refrigerate overnight
7. Cookie dough:
8. In large mixer bowl
9. Cream together butter and sugar until light and fluffy
10. Add eggs and vanilla
11. Beat well
12. In a separate bowl , combine 2 cups flour , cocoa , baking powder & soda , and salt
13. Gradually blend into creamed butter mixture
14. Continue adding flour , 1 tbs at a time , until the dough becomes a smooth , well combined ball
15. Allow dough to chill at least 3 hours , but overnight is preferred
16. Once dough and ganache have chilled overnight , start by prepping the ganache balls
17. Create 1 / 2 inch balls of chocolate
18. If desired , roll balls of chocolate in powdered sugar , finely ground coffee , or a 50 / 50 mixture of the two
19. Now , create a 1 inch ball of cookie dough , then flatten it out to a 1 / 4 thick , palm sized pancake
20. Place a ganache ball in the center of the cookie dough , and wrap it up so the ganache is surrounded in dough
21. Place dough balls 2 inches apart on a parchment lined baking sheet , and bake at 375 for 10 minutes
22. Allow to cool at least 10 minutes , and be careful of hot ganache when eating warm from the oven

title: quick roasted chicken with mustard and garlic  jacques style
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f
2. Rinse chicken beneath cold running water and blot dry
3. Using poultry shears , cut along each side of the backbone and remove it
4. Jacques suggests cutting partway through both sides of the joint between the thighs and the drumsticks and also cutting the joint between the wings and the breast
5. Mix the remaining ingredients in a small bowl
6. Turn the chicken breast side down and slather it with half of the mixture
7. Place chicken in a large oven-safe skillet , skin side up and slather with the remaining mixture
8. Set the skillet over high heat and cook the chicken until it starts to brown , about 10 minutes
9. Transfer the skillet to the oven and , according to jacques , continue roasting another 30 minutes
10. Roast until brown and internal temperature reaches 165 degrees f , which took my bird 50 minutes
11. Transfer to a cutting board and let rest for 10 minutes
12. Cut into 8 pieces and serve
13. This can be prepared through step 2 and refrigerated overnight

title: marshmallow coffee torte
steps:
1. In a medium bowl combine cookie crumbs and butter
2. Press into the bottom and about 1 1 / 2 inches up the sides of a 9 inch springform pan
3. Set aside
4. In a small saucepan combine hot fudge topping and coffee crystals
5. Heat and stir until smooth
6. Cool slightly
7. Spread fudge topping over the crumb mix in the springform pan
8. In a large bowl fold marshmallow creme into cool-whip until combined
9. Set aside
10. In a chilled large bowl , stir ice cream with a wooden spoon until softened
11. Fold in whipped topping mixture
12. Spoon into crust
13. Sprinkle with chopped pecans and half of the grated chocolate
14. Cover and freeze for 6 hours or until firm
15. Before serving , let stand at room temperature 10 minutes
16. Drizzle with caramel topping and sprinkle with remaining grated chocolate
17. If desired garnish with pecan halves

title: huey s irish stew with a touch of paris
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 200c
2. Place the cubed lamb necks in a large pot and cover with water
3. Add all the vegetables to the pot , and season to taste
4. Tie the spices in muslin and add to the pot
5. Bring the pot to the boil , then tightly cover with both foil and a lid , and place in the oven
6. Cook for 50-60 minutes , or until the lamb is tender
7. Meanwhile , place the potatoes on a baking tray in the bottom of the oven , and cook until they are tender
8. Remove and allow them to cool enough that they are easy to handle , then peel and roughly mash them
9. Add the mash to the pot and mix thoroughly
10. Serve the stew sprinkled with parsley and with plenty of crusty bread

title: mascarpone brownies with frosting
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray a 9 x 9-inch pan with non-stick cooking spray
3. Combine the flour , baking powder and salt in a small bowl
4. Melt 1 / 2 cup of butter with the chocolate
5. Meanwhile , in the bowl of a mixer using a paddle attachment , beat the mascarpone , 6 tablespoons of softened butter , and the sugar until light and smooth
6. Add the eggs to the cheese mixture one at a time and thoroughly scrape the bowl after each egg is added
7. Add the vanilla and mix
8. Add the melted chocolate and mix just until combined
9. Finally , add the dry ingredients and nuts and mix slowly just until combined
10. Pour into the prepared pan and bake approximately 45 minutes or until a toothpick is inserted and comes out clean
11. The brownies will rise during the baking process , but after being removed from the oven will collapse to a normal height
12. Remove from oven and allow to cool
13. For the frosting , melt chocolate with butter and milk in saucepan
14. Allow to cool
15. Beat mascarpone until well combined
16. Beat in vanilla and melted chocolate mixture
17. Add in confectioners sugar , scraping down the bowl as you go
18. When it has all been incorporated , beat on high speed for 1-2 minutes , until icing is smooth
19. Frost brownies with icing

title: palestinian chicken
steps:
1. Rinse chicken under cold running water , drain and blot dry with paper towels
2. Arrange breasts in a non-reactive baking dish large enough to hold them in one layer and set aside
3. Combine the yogurt , lemon juice , garlic , salt , cinnamon , pepper , cardamom , and cloves in a small bowl and whisk to blend
4. Pour over chicken and spread over breasts to cover completely
5. Cover and let marinate , refrigerated , 4-12 hours
6. Preheat the grill using indirect heat
7. When ready to cook , oil the grill grate
8. Remove the chicken from the marinade and arrange , skin side down , on the hotter section of the grill
9. Cook until the skin starts to brown
10. Move to the cooler section of the grill and continue grilling until the skin is thoroughly browned
11. Watch carefully and use tongs to move pieces away from flare-ups
12. Turn the breasts and move them back to the hotter section of the grill
13. Brown the second side well , then move them back to the cooler side of the grill to finish cooking
14. The juices will run clear when the meat is pierced

title: cranberry orange smoothie  raw food
steps:
1. Place 1st six ingredients in blender & blend on high until smooth
2. Add & blend in as many ice cubes as needed , until desired constency is reached

title: pork   beans   cheese open face sandwiches
steps:
1. Spread margarine on bread or buns
2. Spread pork & beans on the bread
3. Place a slice of cheese on top
4. Broil until cheese starts to melt

title: maryellen s better broccoli soup
steps:
1. Trim off the tough stem ends of broccoli and remove the tough outer layer of the stems with a peeler
2. Cut stems into small pieces
3. Cut the heads into florets , setting aside the smallest
4. In a heavy pot , heat the butter and oil over low heat
5. Add leaks and carrots
6. Cook stirring until wilted add garlic and cook stirring 2 minutes
7. Add bouillon
8. Add broth and bring to boil
9. Stir in broccoli , tomatoes and lemon zest , and return to boil
10. Cover , reduce to medium , and simmer until broccoli is tender
11. Meanwhile , bring a small pot of water to a boil and blanch the reserved broccoli florets for 2 minutes
12. Rinse under cold water , drain and pat dry
13. Set aside
14. Remove soup from heat
15. Stir in basil , parsley , cover and let rest 5 minutes
16. Careful: hot
17. Then , puree the soup in batches
18. Return soup to the pot and reheat
19. Season with pepper
20. Serve piping hot , garnish with reserved florets
21. When making this for oamc you can a) not bother with the garnish , b) mix it in , or c) freeze the garnish in a smaller baggie , and then tape it to the soup bag
22. To freeze , place in freezer baggies trying to remove excess air , label and pop in freezer
23. Smile because you will be able to enjoy basil after it is no longer seasonal
24. To defrost , put in fridge overnight or use defrost setting in microwave
25. To serve , remove from plastic baggie , warm up in a saucepan on medium or warm in a covered casserole dish in microwave

title: chicken pesto pizza
steps:
1. Place the ingredients for the dough in the bread machine in the order given
2. Set to the dough cycle
3. When done , remove to floured board , if using immediately
4. Or place in a bowl greased with olive oil , turn to coat it , cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to use
5. Shape pizza dough into a crust , roughly 15 inches , and place on a lightly floured cookie sheet
6. Bake in the preheated 400 degree oven for about 8 minutes until mostly baked
7. Let crust cool for a few minutes before adding toppings
8. Starting in the middle of the crust , spread out the pesto sauce in a circular motion until the pizza dough is covered
9. Sprinkle with one cup of cheese
10. Spread out remaining ingredients , holding the cheese back for last
11. Sprinkle the remaining cheese over the toppings
12. Bake in a 400 degree oven until cheese is a light golden brown

title: easy halloween worm cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven according to cake mix package directions
2. Grease and flour a 12-cup cupcake pan
3. Prepare cake mix according to package directions
