4. Pour batter into cupcake pans and bake as directed on cake mix box
5. Let cupcakes cool thoroughly before frosting
6. Spread cupcakes lightly with chocolate icing
7. Sprinkle cookie crumbs on top
8. Cut gummy worms in half
9. Put icing onto cut end of the worms and stick to the top of cupcakes
10. You can use as few or as many as will fit on each cupcake
11. Let icing set for 10 minutes and then enjoy

title: sea breeze scrambled eggs
steps:
1. Mix eggs with milk , tarragon , salt and pepper
2. In a skillet , melt butter over medium high heat
3. Add crab and warm while stirring
4. Add egg mixture and scramble until about 80% done
5. Stir in cream cheese and continue cooking until eggs are set and cream cheese is melted

title: rommagrout
steps:
1. Melt 1 cup butter
2. Add flour and let bubble over low heat for 2 minutes stirring constantly
3. Add unpasteurized milk , boiling gradually
4. Add salt
5. Beat until mixture is smooth
6. Serve hot with melted butter , sugar and cinnamon

title: strawberry lemon crush
steps:
1. In a 2 cup measuring cup , combine the sugar , lemon juice , and water and stir to dissolve the sugar
2. In the bender , combine the strawberries and sweetened water
3. Puree on high speed until smooth
4. Add the sparkling water and pulse to incorporate
5. Taste and add more sugar if desired , and pulse to incorporate
6. Place cracked ice in 2 tall collins glasses
7. Pour the strawberry crush over the ice , garnish with mint sprigs , and serve

title: jenn s sugar free dark chocolate orange faux chai latte coffee
steps:
1. Heat milk in microwave safe cup for 1 min
2. In a separate microwave safe coffee mug , mix dry ingredients
3. Pour warmed milk into mug and stir
4. Add orange extract or oj
5. Stir then heat mug in microwave for another 1 min or until desired temp is reached
6. Stir and enjoy !

title: open chicken and egg sandwich
steps:
1. Cook wedges in accordance with package directions
2. Heat half the oil in a large frying pan over moderate heat and add chicken and bacon and cook and turn for 4 to 6 minutes or until chicken is cooked and then transfer to a heatproof plate
3. Cut each piece of chicken in half
4. Add remaining oil to the pan and pan fry eggs for 2-3 minutes or until cooked to your liking and remove from heat
5. Cut bread in half horizontally and cut each piece in half so you have a total of 4 equal portions and toast pieces
6. Place toasted bread on serving plates and top with lettuce , drizzle with dressing and top with bacon , chicken and egg and then top with parmesan and serve sandwich with wedges

title: butter coconut pie
steps:
1. Line piecrust with parchment paper
2. Fill with pie weights or dried beans
3. Bake at 400 degrees for 10 minutes or until crust is lightly browned
4. Remove paper and weights
5. Combine sugar and flour in a large bowl
6. Stir in eggs , blending well
7. Stir in coconut and next 3 ingredients , blending well
8. Pour filling into prepared piecrust
9. Bake at 325 for 35 to 40 minutes or until pie is set

title: shrimp wontons with sweet sauce
steps:
1. Wontons: mix filling ingredients together thoroughly
2. Refrigerate mixture for 1 hour
3. Sauce: in a small saucepan , heat pineapple juice with the green onion
4. Simmer until green onion is tender
5. Run the peaches and marmalade through a food processor till chopped very fine
6. Add to saucepan
7. Add remaining ingredients and simmer , stirring occasionally , until heated through and reduced to your desired thickness
8. Meanwhile , remove filling from fridge and place a spoonful into the center of each wonton wrapper
9. Lightly wet half of the edges of the wrappers with water
10. Fold the wrapper over the filling , forming a half moon and seal completely
11. Over low to medium heat 2 tablespoons oil into a skillet
12. Fry wontons until golden brown , about 1-2 minutes per side
13. Remove and drain on paper towels
14. Season with salt if desired
15. Serve with dipping sauce
16. If freezing , thaw to room temperature before frying

title: seafood creole
steps:
1. 1
2. Mix together oregano , salt , white pepper , black pepper , cayenne pepper , thyme , and basil in a small bowl
3. Set aside
4. 2
5. Melt butter in a large dutch oven over medium heat
6. Stir in tomato , onion , celery , green bell pepper , and garlic
7. Cook and stir until the onion is translucent , about 5 minutes
8. 3
9. Stir in chicken stock , tomato sauce , sugar , hot pepper sauce , and bay leaves
10. Reduce heat to low and bring sauce to a simmer
11. Stir in seasoning mix and simmer until the flavors have blended , about 20 minutes
12. 4
13. Gently stir in rock shrimp , bay scallops , and haddock
14. Bring sauce back to a simmer and cook until the shellfish and fish are opaque , about 20 more minutes
15. Remove bay leaves to serve

title: ultimate sugar cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375
2. Place sheets of foil on countertop for cooling cookies
3. Combine sugar and butter flavor crisco in large bowl
4. Beat at medium speed of electric mixer until well blended
5. Add eggs , syrup , and vanilla
6. Beat until well blended and fluffy
7. Combine 3 cups flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
8. Add gradually to creamed mixture at low speed
9. Mix until well blended
10. Divide dough into 4 quarters
11. Refrigerate at least 1 hour
12. Spread 1 t of flour onto large sheet of waxed paper
13. Place one-fourth of dough on floured paper
14. Flatten slightly with hands
15. Turn dough over and cover with another large sheet of waxed paper
16. Roll dough to 1 / 4 inch thickness
17. Cut out with floured cutter
18. Transfer to ungreased baking sheet
19. Place 2 inches apart
20. Sprinkle with granulated sugar or colored sugar crystals , or leave plain to frost when cooled
21. Sprinkle with granulated sugar or colored sugar crystals , or leave plain to frost when cooled
22. Bake one baking sheet at a time at 375 for 5-9 minutes , depending on the size of your cookies[bake smaller , thinner cookies closer to 5 minutes
23. Larger cookies closer to 9 minutes]
24. Do not overbake
25. Cool 2 minutes on baking sheet
26. Remove cookies to foil to cool completely , then frost if desired

title: nick s famous fluffy rice and chicken casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix soup and milk , reserving one cup
3. Pour remainder into ungreased 13x9 cake or casserole pan
4. Add rice , mushrooms and minced onion to the soup-milk , mixing well
5. Lay chicken pieces over rice-soup-milk mixture , pour reserved milk over the top of the chicken
6. Cover with foil , sealing edges tightly
7. Bake for one hour
8. Uncover and bake until golden & bubbly

title: israeli shakshuka
steps:
1. You need a large nonstick deep saut pan that has a cover
2. Saut onions in olive oil until opaque and tender
3. Add red bell pepper and continue sauteeing until it softens up
4. Reduce heat to low
5. Add the fresh chopped tomatoes , cook until they are breaking apart
6. With a slotted spoon , add the chunkiest parts of the contents of the "pomi" - the majority of the sauce should remain in the carton
7. Add the jalapeno now also
8. Cook for 30-40 minutes , partially cover , and stir every once in a while
9. If it starts to look dry , add some of the sauce from the carton , slowly , as you need it
10. Add the salt and pepper - i like a lot because i love salt on tomatoes
11. The final product should be a thick sauce that just looks like a whole lot of tomatoes stuck together - with very little to no juice , that is about 1-1 1 / 2 inches high
12. Crack open the eggs on top of the shakshuka , one by one , giving each their own space
13. The whites should overlap , but the yolk should be spaced about 4 fingerwidths from each other
14. My pan can fit 6-8 eggs very comfortably
15. Cover tightly with a lid and simmer for 20 minutes

title: poached salmon
steps:
1. Put water in a poaching dish or pan -- add enough to partially cover the salmon
2. Add lemon juice , black peppercorns , and salt , then mix
3. Bring to boil , reduce to simmer , and add salmon
4. Cover and cook for 10 minutes
5. Remove salmon and drain

title: just plain luscious cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. For the crust , combine the graham crackers , 1 / 2 cup of the sugar and the melted butter in a food processor
3. Process until very fine and evenly moistened
4. Press crust mixture evenly into a springform pan
5. Put pan into the fridge for 10 minutes to firm
6. While this is firming work on the filling
7. For the filling , combine the cream cheese , 1 cup of the sugar , the egg , and 2 tablespoons of the vanilla into the food processor and cream together until very smooth
8. Pour the filling mixture into the crust and bake in a 375 degree oven for 35-40 minutes
9. When done baking , remove cheesecake from the oven and cool for 15 minutes
10. Raise the oven temperature to 450 degrees
11. While the cheesecake is cooling , make the topping
12. In a small bowl , combine the sour cream with the remaining 2 tablespoons of vanilla and the remaining 2 tablespoons of sugar
13. Spread topping over the cooled filling
14. Bake in a 450 degree oven for 10 minutes
15. Let cool and enjoy !

title: persimmon meringue pie
steps:
1. For the meringue:
2. Mix together cornstarch and cold water
3. Add to 1 / 2 cup boiling water
4. Cook over low heat until it thickens
5. Set aside to cool
6. Beat egg whites , dash of salt , and sugar until stiff
7. Add cooled cornstarch mixture to beaten egg white mixture
8. To make pulp: peel persimmons and press through colander
9. Add sugar , mace , lemon rind and salt
10. Cook over low heat
11. Add a small amount of pulp to butter and well beaten egg yolks
12. Return to persimmon mixture and stir until slightly thickened
13. Pour into baked pie shell
14. Cool
15. Preheat oven to 350f
16. Spread meringue on pie , making sure it covers the edges well
17. Bake in oven until very lightly browned , about 20 minutes
18. Serve pie very cold

title: low fat strawberry banana bread
steps:
1. Mash bananas in large bowl
2. Add hulled strawberries and mash as well
3. Combine with eggs , applesauce , oil , vanilla and sugar
4. Combine dry ingredients in a separate bowl , add to banana strawberry mixture
5. Mix in chopped walnuts last
6. Spoon batter into 2 standard sized loaf pans , or three medium-sized pans which have been lightly sprayed with non-stick cooking spray
7. Bake in 350 degree oven for 50-60 minutes or until toothpick stuck in center of pans comes out clean

title: spicy mint beef
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat the oil over medium-high heat
2. Add the garlic and chiles and cook until aromatic , about 30 seconds
3. Add the steak and cook , stirring frequently , for 2 minutes
4. Add the shallots and bell pepper and cook for 1 minute
5. Add the fish sauce , sweet soy sauce , black soy sauce and chili paste
6. Bring the mixture to a low simmer and cook , stirring frequently until the meat is cooked through and the vegetables are tender , about 3 minutes
7. Remove the skillet from the heat and stir in the basil and mint until wilted
8. Transfer to a serving dish and serve over steamed white rice

title: budget stretcher crock pot ground turkey stew
steps:
1. Place olive oil , garlic , and chopped leek in bottom of large crock pot
2. Crumble raw ground turkey over leeks
3. Layer carrots , then celery over turkey
4. Spread undiluted cream of mushroom and cream of chicken over vegetables
5. Spread sliced mushrooms over all
6. Finally pour 1 cup water over all
7. Set crock pot to cook for 4 hours
8. For best results , go back and stir halfway through cooking time
9. Season with salt and pepper before serving

title: mexican banana splits
steps:
1. To make cinnamon-choc
2. Sauce: whisk together sugar , cocoa , butter , cinnamon and water in saucepan
3. Bring to a boil , reduce heat to medium and simmer 3 minutes
4. Remove from heat and set aside
5. To make banana splits: preheat oven to 400f coat 8 muffin cups with cooking spray
6. Combine sugar and cinnamon in bowl
7. Brush tortillas with butter , and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar
8. Flip and repeat on opposite side
9. Press tortillas into muffin tins to make cups
10. Bake 5 to 7 minutes or until brown and crispy
11. Cool in pans
12. Place 2 or 3 banana slices in bottom of each tortilla cup
13. Top with scoop of ice cream and drizzle with cinnamon-choc
14. Sauce
15. Sprinkle with remaining banana slices and almonds , and serve

title: agave nectar margarita
steps:
1. Fill a margarita glass with crushed ice
2. Add the tequila , lime and lemon juices , agave nectar , triple sec and tangerine juice to a cocktail shaker filled with ice
3. Shake vigorously and strain into the prepared glass
4. Garnish with a lime and orange wheel

title: tomato cucumber salad
steps:
1. Sprinkle salt over cucumber
2. Toss gently and let stand 30 minutes
3. Drain cucumber slices and press dry between paper towels
4. Combine cucumber , green pepper , onions& tomatoes
5. Combine vinegar and next 6 ingredients in a jar
6. Shake vigorously
7. Drizzle over vegetables
8. Toss gently

title: mom s holiday fruit salad
steps: 1. Mix all ingredients and refrigerate 5-6 hours before serving

title: overnight egg casserole
steps:
1. Spray an 8-inch square baking dish with non-stick cooking spray
2. Layer the hash browns , ham and cheeses
3. In a large bowl , whisk together the eggs , egg substitute , milk , pepper and dijon mustard
4. Pour over the casserole , cover and refrigerate overnight
5. Remove the casserole from the refrigerator 30 minutes before baking
6. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
7. Uncover the casserole and bake for 1 hour or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean
8. Allow to stand for 5 to 10 minutes before cutting into squares
9. Serve with salsa on top

title: thermomix peanut butter
steps:
1. Place peanuts into tm bowl
2. Mix 10 seconds / speed six
3. Use spatula to push peanuts down
4. Add oil
5. Mix again 10 seconds / speed six
6. Place in an airtight jar in the fridge

title: pesto feta burger
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in large mixing bowl , cover and let rest for at least 15mins
2. Separate into 4-6 equal parts depending on how large you want your burgers
3. Roll each part into a ball then form into patties
4. Heat grill to 275-350f internal air temperature
5. Using a silicone brush lightly coat grill with olive oil to keep burgers from sticking
6. Cook burgers to desired doneness and let rest for at least 5 minutes before serving

title: light chocolate carrot cake with chocolate cream cheese icing
steps:
1. Cake: in a bowl , combine flours , cocoa , baking powder , baking soda and spices
2. Stir in walnuts , raisins and coconut
3. In a large bowl , beat together the egg substitute and sugars
4. Add pudding mix and sour cream
5. Stir in carrots
6. Add flour mixture all at once , mixing just until evenly combined
7. Spray a 13 x 9-inch cake pan with non-fat cooking spray , and line with parchment paper or waxed paper
8. Then spray the paper with non-fat cooking spray
9. Pour the batter into the pan and bake in a 325 degree f oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until the top springs back when lightly touched and cake begins to pull away from the sides of the pan
10. Let cool
11. To make icing: meanwhile , in a bowl , beat cream cheese and neufchatel cheese until light
12. Gradually beat in the cocoa powder and sugar
13. Cover and chill in the refrigerator for 30 to 60 minutes or until spreadable
14. Spread over the cooled cake

title: iced almonds
steps:
1. Melt butter over medium-high heat
2. Add sugar and almonds and cinnamon if using
3. Stir constantly for around 10 minutes or till the sugar turns golden brown
4. Remove from heat
5. Add extract
6. Immediately drop in clusters or separately nuts on greased baking pan
7. Cool
8. Enjoy

title: golden puffs
steps:
1. Heat oil to 375f in deep fryer or 3-qt
2. Saucepan
3. Mix flour , 1 / 4 cup sugar , baking powder , salt and nutmeg
4. Add 1 / 4 cup oil , milk and egg
5. Beat until smooth
6. Drop batter by teaspoonfuls into hot oil
7. Fry four or five at a time until golden brown on both sides , about 3 minutes
8. Drain
9. Mix 1 / 2 cup sugar and the1 teaspoon cinnamon
10. Roll warm puffs in sugar-cinnamon mixture

title: kittencal s fresh rhubarb pie
steps:
1. Set oven to 450 degrees f
2. Set oven rack to lowest position
3. Line 1 pastry into the bottom of a 9-inch deep-dish glass pie plate
4. In a small bowl combine the sugar with cinnamon , nutmeg and flour
5. Sprinkle about 1 / 4 cup of the mixture over the pastry in the pie plate
6. Place the chopped rhubarb over the sugar mixture
7. Sprinkle the remaining sugar mixture over the rhubarb
8. Dot with the chopped cold butter pieces
9. Cover with remaining crust
10. Seal and flute the edges
11. Using a small sharp knife slice two 1-inch slits in the top crust to allow steam to escape
12. Using a pastry brush , spread the cream over the top crust then sprinkle with 1 tablespoon sugar
13. Place the pie plate on a baking sheet
14. Bake at 450 degrees f for 15 minutes
15. Reduce the oven temperature to 350 degrees f and continue to bake for another 40-45 minutes
16. Serve warm or cold with ice cream:)

title: macadamia nut pina colada bars
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Grease bottom and sides of 8x8 or 9x9 inch square pan with shortening
3. Drain pineapple well , reserving 3 teaspoons juice for pineapple glaze
4. Mix 1 cup flour , the butter and powdered sugar with spoon until flour is moistened
5. Press in pan
6. Bake 10 minutes
7. Beat eggs in medium bowl with wire whisk until blended
8. Stir in pineapple and remaining ingredients except pineapple glaze
9. Spread over partially baked crust
10. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown
11. Cool completely , about 1 hour
12. Make pineapple glaze by mixing the powdered sugar and reserved pineapple juice until smooth and thin enough to drizzle
13. Drizzle glaze over bars

title: jam tartlets
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f , and in a large bowl , stir together flour and salt
2. Rub in butter until mixture resembles breadcrumbs
3. Stir in the sugar
4. Add egg yolks and water , and mix to a firm dough
5. Knead dough a few times while still inside bowl
6. Break off pieces of dough , and form into 1 / 2-inch balls
7. Press into bottom and sides of mini-muffin trays
8. Fill each pastry case with about 1 / 2 teaspoon of jam , and bake for 7-9 minutes

title: filipino roast leg of lamb with sarsa
steps:
1. Lamb:
2. Trim fat from lamb
3. Cut slits all over lamb
4. Insert garlic slivers in each
5. Sprinkle all over with salt and pepper
6. Lay bay leaves in centre of roasting pan
7. Place lamb on top
8. Drizzle with 1 tbsp of lime juice
9. Roast in 400f oven for 30 minutes
10. Reduce temperature to 325f whisk together the remaining lime juice and oil
11. Spoon over lamb
12. Baste with pan juices for 15 minutes until lamb reaches desired doneness , about 1 hour for medium rare or internal temperature of 150f
13. Sarsa:
14. In a small skillet , toast rice over medium heat until nutty brown , 5 to 7 minutes
15. Place in spice grinder or blender and process into fine powder
16. Transfer to bowl
17. Set aside
18. Add oil to skillet
19. Increase heat to medium- high
20. Add shallots and garlic saut until lightly browned
21. Add liver
22. Saut until seared
23. Reduce heat to low
24. Add paprika , turmeric , pepper , cayenne and cloves
25. Cook , stirring for 30 seconds
26. Add stock and bring to a boil
27. Remove from heat and let cool slightly
28. Scrape mixture into blender
29. Puree and transfer to saucepan
30. Stir in soy sauce , sugar , vinegar and 1 / 2 cup water
31. Add bay leaf
32. Bring to a simmer
33. Stir in the rice powder
34. Simmer over low heat , stirring often , until thick and smooth , 15 to 20 minutes
35. Remove bay leaf and transfer to a bowl
36. Carve lamb
37. Serve with sarsa

title: apple and pork stir fry with ginger
steps:
1. In small bowl , combine jam , soy sauce , water and cornstarch
2. Set aside
3. In large non-stick skillet , heat sesame oil over medium high heat
4. Add pork and ginger and stir-fry until pork is browned and just cooked through , about 3-5 minutes
5. Transfer pork and ginger to bowl with slotted spoon
6. Add canola oil to skillet
7. Stir-fry peppers , water chestnuts , and apples until peppers are crisp tender , about 3 minutes
8. Add pork back to skillet along with green onions
9. Stir-fry 30 seconds
10. Add jam mixture
11. Continue to stir-fry 30 seconds to one minute , or until sauce thickens
12. Season to taste with black pepper

title: easy raisin sauce for ham
steps:
1. In a saucepan , combine first three ingredients
2. Stir in water , raisins , vinegar , lemon juice until blended
3. Bring to a boil
4. Cook and stir for 2 mins or until thickened
5. Stir in butter until melted
6. Serve warm over sliced ham

title: simple italian meat sauce
steps:
1. In large pan heat 1 tablespoons olive oil , add garlic and saut , tilt the olive oil in pan to cover the garlic , saut until opaque
2. Immediately add tomato juice , sugar , salt , pepper , sweet basil , and bay leaves
3. Simmer for about 45 minutes
4. Smash the garlic cloves with a fork , add the tomato paste in sauce and a can of water
5. In large skillet cook ground beef , drain well
6. Add beef in sauce , and simmer at least 2 hours until sauce turns dark red
7. Serve with 1 lb
8. Pasta and fresh grated asiago cheese

title: beef and lettuce wraps
steps:
1. In a large skillet cook the beef and onion , breaking up large pieces until browned
2. Drain off all the fat
3. Add peanut and soy sauce , cucumber and mint , stir well , season with salt& pepper
4. Place a large spoonful into each lettuce leaf , roll up , serve

title: vanilla cake batter ice cream
steps:
1. In a large saucepot , over medium heat place in vanilla bean pod , whipping cream , dash salt , sugar , and egg yolks , and cook until a custard has formed and ribbons with the finger on the back of a spoon
2. This should be done on medium to low heat and slowly , as not to curdle or scorch
3. Remove from heat , and strain into a large bowl or measuring cup
4. Remove the vanilla pod and scrape out the seeds into the mixture
5. Rinse off the empty pod , and wipe dry
6. Place empty pod into your sugar bowl to flavour your coffee sugar or other uses
7. Into the large bowl of cooked milk and eggs add the half and half cream and stir well
8. Place covered into the fridge overnight to get cold
9. This is done so that when the mixture hits your ice cream maker bowl , a warm mixture will not liquidize the cold gel , and helps with the freezing process
10. Pour the measured amount of dry cake mix into a small bowl , and whisk out or sieve out any lumps
11. The amount here in this recipe is 2 / 3 of a cup dry mix
12. Some people like a little less some like more , this is the amount our family enjoys
13. Pour the cold custard into the already running ice cream maker
14. Sprinkle on the dry cake mix a few spoons at a time through the feed tube
15. Continue until dry mix is incorporated in custard
16. This gives you smooth texture
17. Let your maker continue as manufacturers directions , takes usually 20 minutes or more
18. If you like some cake batter lumps in the ice cream then put in as unwhisked dry mix later half way or ten minutes before the freezing is complete
19. Also at the very end of the freezing when you are ready to remove , and before pouring into your freezer storage container you may add -- another 2 tablespoons dry mix and swirl through with a spatula , if you like lumps of dry mix -- also fold in quartered strawberries and fold through -- or even swirl in your favourite fudge sauce
20. Pour into a covered storage container and place in your upright home freezer to freeze solid
21. A
22. Also for every quart of ice cream you should have 1 / 2 cup dry mix for flavour incorporated
23. When i make this with lemon supreme cake mix i always fold in the strawberries , and some toasted coconut at the very end
24. Makes a nice lemon strawberry almost cheesecaky ice cream

title: cheesecake squares
steps:
1. Crust: preheat oven to 350f degrees
2. Combine crumbs and sugar
3. Add butter and mix until all is well absorbed by the butter
4. Place into a greased 13 x 9-inch cake pan , and bake for 10 minutes
5. Filling: cream cheese , and add sugar gradually
6. Add eggs , vanilla and sour cream
7. Mix until well blended
8. Pour onto prepared crust , and bake at 350f for approx
9. 45 minutes , or when the whole surface of the cake has risen , remove from oven immediately and let sit at room temperature for an hour
10. Pour fruit topping or pie filling overtop and refrigerate overnight
11. Cut into squares and serve

title: steak and potato salad
steps:
1. Peel and slice potatoes
2. In a large bowl , combine potatoes , celery , green onions , and beef
3. Pour dressing over and toss gently to coat
4. Dressing:
5. In a bowl , whisk together oil , vinegar , mustard , horseradish , salt and pepper
6. This may be kept for up to a day ahead of time , and refrigerated
7. To serve , separate lettuce leaves , arrange on a plate , spoon salad over top
8. Garnish with tomatoes and cucumbers

title: cool noodles with vietnamese garnishes
steps:
1. Sauce:
2. In a mortar , with a pestle , pound the sea salt and garlic into a paste
3. Add the chiles and pound to a paste
4. Transfer the mixture to a small mixing bowl and set aside
5. In a small saucepan , combine the sugar , palm sugar , vinegar and fish sauce and cook , stirring , over medium low heat until the sugar is dissolved , about 2 minutes
6. Cool , then add to the pounded paste , mix well and set aside
7. Turkey:
8. In a 12 inch skillet , heat th eoil over high heat for 1-2 minutes or until very hot
9. Add the ground turkey and cook , stirring to separate and crumble the meat , until evenly browned
10. Add the lemongrass , curry powder and sea salt , mix well , and cook , stirring , for another 2 minutes
11. Transfer to a serving bowl and cover until ready to serve
12. Noodle nests:
13. In a 6 qt saucepan , bring 5 cups water to a boil
14. Drop the noodeles into the boiling water and stir to separate the strands
15. Let boil vigorously for 2 mintues
16. Drain and rinse with several changes of cold water
17. Then fill saucepan with water and return noodles to pan
18. With your middle or index finger , scoop up a 1 inch bundle of noodles
19. Squeeze out excess water with your other hand
20. Twist the noodles into a figure 8 bundle then fold over to make a circular nest and place on a large serving platter
21. Repeat with rest of noodles
22. To serve:
23. Place a bowl of the chile sauce in the center of a large platter
24. Arrange the nests of noodles on one side and mounds of the bean sprouts , green beans , fennel and cilantro on the other
25. Set a bowl of the turkey topping nearby
26. Have each guest put 3 or 4 nests on his or her plate , top with a couple spoonfuls of turkey , as well as the vegetable garnishes , then drizzle several spoonfuls of the sauce over the noodles , separating an loosening he strands so the noodles absorb the sauce

title: quick and easy crock pot burrito meat
steps:
1. Cut fat off medium pot roast
2. Rub with taco seasoning
3. Place roast in crock pot , fat side up
4. Top with chiles and onion
5. Cook all day on low - 8-10 hours
6. Turn to high first or last few hours of cooking
7. In pot , shred meat with fork and mix into juice

title: bacon fried carrots
steps:
1. Peel carrots , cut in half and slice lengthwise
2. Chop onion into small pieces
3. Cook bacon until crisp
4. Remove and blot
5. Using all the bacon grease , add carrots , onions and seasonings
6. Mix well and cook covered on low heat for 15-20 minutes
7. Cook uncovered about 45 minutes or until lightly browned
8. Stir occasionally
9. Crumble bacon and add to carrots

title: goan avocado salad
steps:
1. Place all ingredients except olive oil in bowl and toss gently to combine
2. Taste and add more cayenne or salt and pepper if required
3. Add olive oil and toss again
4. Refrigerate for 2-3 hours to allow the flavours to develop

title: peppered cheddar muffine
steps:
1. Stir together first 6 ingredients in a large bowl
2. Make a well in center of mixture
3. Stir together milk , egg , and vegetable oil until blended
4. Add to dry ingredients , stirring just until moistened
5. Spoon batter into greased muffin pans , filling 2 / 3 full
6. Bake at 400 f
7. For 18 - 20 min
8. Or until tops are golden brown
9. Cool muffins in pans 2 min
10. Remove from pans , and serve
11. Yield: 1 doz

title: amarula spicy fish
steps:
1. Divide each fishtail fillet in half along the length
2. Just follow the natural dividing line
3. Slice each into three even-sized strips , again working lengthways
4. Leave about 2cm at the widest part uncut
5. Plait each fillet
6. Secure the ends with a strip of chive
7. Season , cover and chill in the refrigerator
8. Toss the fruit with the amarula cream in a large ovenproof dish
9. Dip the fish fillets in a mixture of flour , curry powder and cayenne
10. Lay on the fruit
11. Brush the fish with a mixture of melted butter and crushed garlic
12. Pour the spicy curry basting sauce evenly over the dish
13. Rub the coconut and turmeric together on a piece of greaseproof paper until the coconut is golden , sprinkle over the fish
14. May be pre-prepared to this stage , covered and refrigerated
15. Bake at 180 deg c = 350 deg f for 25-30 minutes or until fish is done
16. Garnish with fresh dhunia
17. Suggested to serve with rice pilaf , hardboiled saffron eggs and salad sambals

title: reuben pizza
steps:
1. Spread each pizza crust with 1 tablespoon of mustard
2. Sprinkle half of the cheese evenly over the pizza crusts
3. Place corned beef slices evenly over the pizza crusts , folding as needed
4. Spread the remainder of the mustard evenly over the corned beef slices on each pizza
5. Add sauerkraut evenly onto each pizza
6. Sprinkle remainder of cheese evenly over each pizza
7. Sprinkle with caraway seeds
8. Place pizzas on a pre-heated baking sheet
9. Bake at 450 for 10-12 minutes or until pizzas are well heated and cheese is melted

title: hot truck p m p   poor man s pizza
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees
2. Cut the french bread loaf in half crosswise and then slice them completely open , horizontally
3. Place the four pieces of bread on a baking sheet
4. Using a ladle or spoon , spread the pizza sauce on all pieces of bread , being sure to cover out to the edges and sprinkle with oregano
5. Spread mushrooms across each bottom half of the bread
6. Generously cover the mushrooms with mozzarella
7. Bake 8-10 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the french bread is golden brown
8. Lay the top halves of the french bread on the bottom halves to make sandwiches
9. I also tried it in the panini maker which was faster and tasted the same , but the cheese didn't melt quite like the original
10. Enjoy !

title: chicken   mushrooms  greek style
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in heavy large skillet over medium-high heat
2. Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper
3. Dust with flour
4. Add chicken to skillet
5. Saut until brown , about 2 minutes per side
6. Using tongs , transfer chicken to plate
7. Add mushrooms , garlic and oregano to same skillet
8. Saut until mushrooms brown , about 10 minutes
9. Add broth , lemon juice and wine and boil until sauce is slightly reduced , about 5 minutes
10. Add chicken to sauce
11. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered until chicken is cooked through , about 2 minutes per side
12. Season with salt and pepper
13. Transfer chicken and mushroom sauce to platter
14. Sprinkle with parsley

title: mark bittman s autumn millet bake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375f and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish with olive oil
2. Put 2 tablespoons of oil in a small skillet over medium-high heat
3. When hot , add the millet and cook , stirring frequently , until fragrant and golden , about 2-3 minutes
4. Do not overcook
5. Spread in the bottom of the prepared baking dish
6. Scatter the squash or pumpkin cubes and the cranberries on top of the millet
7. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and the sage and drizzle with syrup
8. Mix together the stock and cream then carefully pour the warmed stock over all
9. Cover with foil and bake without disturbing , for 45 minutes
10. Carefully uncover and turn the oven to 400f adjust the seasoning if necessary
11. If it looks too dry , add more water or stock until moist
12. Sprinkle the pumpkin seeds on top , and return the dish to the oven
13. Bake until the mixture bubbles and the top is browned and the millet is cooked through , another 10 minutes or so
14. Serve

title: seafood chicken
steps:
1. Place lettuce leaves on a serving platter and arrange the chicken pieces and chunks of tuna on top of the lettuce leaves
2. Add the lemon quarters to the platter
3. And the olives , boiled egg slices and artichoke hearts
4. Top with mayonnaise or serve the mayonnaise separately in a bowl or jug
5. Garnish with the chopped parsley

title: gluten free granola
steps:
1. In a saucepan bring butter , honey , fructose , vanilla and salt to a simmer to disolve honey and fructose
2. Pour over oats and cinnamon mixture , mixing thoroughly
3. Spread out on a sheet pan
4. Bake at 325 degrees for 30 minutes , stirring after 15 minutes
5. Allow to cool completely then store in an air tight container
6. Can be served with dried fruit and / or nuts , coconut , with milk or yogurt

title: baileys fudge
steps:
1. Line a 12x6 bar pan or slice pan with baking paper
2. Heat the condensed milk carefully
3. Melt the chocolate in a microwave 30 second bursts , stirring after each burst so it doesn't burn
4. Add to the condensed milk and then mix in baileys
5. Pour into your lined bar pan and set--leave to cool at room temp or if very warm were you live pop into the fridge to set
6. Cut into pieces and watch it disappear
7. We serve at the cafe with hot chocolate and moccachino--great gift wrapped and given for presents

title: black pepper and bacon drop biscuits
steps:
1. Cut bacon in half lengthwise and then crosswise into 1 / 4-inch pieces
2. Fry in a skillet over medium heat until crisp , 5-7 minutes
3. Transfer pieces to a paper towel and cool
4. Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 475f
5. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper
6. Whisk flour , baking powder , baking soda , sugar , salt and pepper in a large bowl
7. Stir in bacon pieces
8. In a medium bowl , combine cold buttermilk and 8 tablespoons melted butter , stirring until butter forms small clumps
9. This may look like a mistake , but it's one of the secrets of this recipe
10. The clumps of butter are similar to small bits of cold butter in biscuits prepared by the traditional method
11. As the butter melts during baking , the steam helps the biscuits rise and gives them a light and fluffy interior
12. Add buttermilk mixture to dry ingredients and stir until just incorporated and batter pulls away from sides of bowl
13. Using a 1 / 4-cup dry measure , scoop level amounts of batter and drop onto baking sheet
14. Space biscuits 1 1 / 2-inces apart
15. Bake until the tops are golden brown and crisp , 12-14 minutes
16. Remove from oven and brush tops with melted butter
17. Let cool 5 minutes before serving
18. Bring on the gravy !
19. ### other variations - omit the bacon and pepper and add:
20. Cheddar scallion - 1 / 2 cup grated cheddar cheese and 1 / 4 cup thinly sliced scallions
21. Parmesan rosemary- 3 / 4 cup grated parmesan cheese and 1 / 2 teaspoons finely minced rosemary

title: buffalo turkey burgers with blue cheese
steps:
1. Combine meat with breadcrumbs , egg , hot sauce , salt & pepper
2. Mix well , and form into eight patties of the same size
3. Divide the blue cheese into four equal portions
4. Place a portion of the cheese atop one patty , then top with another patty
5. Fold the patty's edges together so the cheese is hidden in the center
6. Seal well so nothing leaks out when cooking
7. Repeat three more times to make four burgers in total
8. Heat the butter in a skillet of medium-high heat
9. Cook patties , flipping once , for about 15 minutes
10. Serve inside buns and top with more hot sauce , if desired
11. Maybe some sliced red onions , tomato and lettuce as well
12. I served mine in pitas and topped with baby arugula and hot sauce

title: tyrolean bacon dumpling soup  speckknodelsuppe
steps:
1. Whisk together milk , 2 tablespoons of the parsley and eggs in a large bowl
2. Add bacon and bread
3. Toss to combine
4. Let moisten for 30 minutes
5. Heat butter in a skillet over medium heat
6. Add onions
7. Cook until softened , 8-10 minutes
8. Transfer to bread mixture
9. Mix in flour and salt to taste
10. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over medium-high heat
11. Using your hands , form bread mixture into 8 large dumplings
12. Drop into water
13. Simmer until cooked through , about 20 minutes
14. Meanwhile , bring broth to a boil in a large pot over high heat
15. Using a slotted spoon , divide dumplings between bowls , ladle broth into bowls and garnish generously with remaining parsley

title: ham with rhubarb sauce
steps:
1. Put ham on a rack in a shallow roasting pan
2. Add water and cover with foil
3. Roast at 325 degrees until meat thermometer registers 135 degrees
4. In the meantime combine remaining ingredients and bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat to medium and cook , uncovered , about 15 minutes
6. Stir occasionally
7. Remove cinnamon stick
8. The last 15 minutes of baking time , remove foil from ham and spoon small amount of sauce over the ham
9. Remove and allow ham to stand , covered , about 10 minutes
10. Serve remaining sauce with ham

title: savory potato waffles  5fix
steps:
1. Melt butter in large skillet over medium-low heat
2. Add onion
3. Cook 10 minutes or until tender
4. Heat waffle iron according to manufacturer's instructions
5. Whisk eggs in large bowl
6. Stir in mashed potatoes and flour until evenly blended
7. Stir in onion and butter until blended
8. Spoon about 1 / 2 cup batter into center of waffle iron
9. Close lid and cook 4 minutes or until deep golden brown
10. Repeat to cook remaining waffles

title: italian chicken sausage and peppers skillet
steps:
1. Heat large skillet and add olive oil
2. Add sausage and brown on all sides
3. Remove sausage to cutting board
4. Add onion to pan and cook about 3 minutes
5. Add garlic and cook another 2 minutes
6. Then add peppers , italian seasoning and salt and pepper
7. Cook until crisp tender
8. While pepper mixture is cooking
9. Cut sausage into bite sized pieces
10. Then add back to skillet when peppers are just about done
11. Add tomatoes and wine and let come to boil
12. Turn down to simmer for 5 minutes , uncovered
13. Stir in cooked and drained pasta
14. Sprinkle with cheese and serve

title: kentucky style fried chicken
steps:
1. Steam or poach chicken until tender
2. Dry and keep cool until time to fry
3. Just before frying , make a batter of the remaining ingredients
4. Preheat fat or oil to 380f
5. Dip each piece of steamed chicken in batter and fry until a beautiful golden brown

title: southern shrimp and grits
steps:
1. To make the marinara sauce: blanch organic tomatoes
2. Remove skin and seeds and roughly chop
3. Set aside
4. In a large saute pot , add oil
5. Saute garlic and shallots until translucent
6. Add reserved fresh tomatoes and canned tomatoes
7. Bring to a simmer and cook for 30 minutes over low heat
8. Remove from heat and season with salt and pepper
9. Add parsley and basil and stir to combine
10. While the marinara sauce is simmering , prepare the grits:
11. In a large pot , combine half and half and cream and bring to a boil
12. Add grits , garlic and salt
13. Reduce heat and slowly cook , stirring frequently , scraping the bottom of the pan , until grits liquid is absorbed and grits are cooked and tender , about 45 minutes
14. Add cheese and stir until combined
15. To make the shrimp and sausage: in a saute pan over medium-high heat , add oil
16. Add shrimp and cook until translucent
17. Season with salt and pepper
18. Reduce heat to medium , add sausage and cook for 1 minute
19. Add marinara sauce and cook for 3 minutes
20. On individual bowls or plates , place 1 / 2 cup cooked grits
21. Divide shrimp and marinara between plates and place beside grits
22. Drizzle basil oil on shrimp and top with chopped chives

title: leftover surprise recipe
steps:
1. In a bit of oil saut onion , celery & garlic
2. Cook carrots in a bit of water in the microwave
3. Combine cubed pork chop , vegetables including water from carrots and 1 / 2 cup chicken broth
4. Cover and simmer on low heat for 30 minutes to combine flavours
5. Add gravy and bbq sauce , salt& pepper if necessary
6. Simmer another 5 minutes
7. Your meal is almost ready
8. You can serve this with cooked rice , pasta mashed potates on top or with it , on toast , in patty shell , bread crumbs and cheese to make it au gratin , pastry crust to make a pie
9. Anything goes
10. It's your meal
11. This casserole is for 2 but depending on what you have leftover the fridge you can add and reduce the amounts
12. If you have leftover vegetables , use those instead of having to cook some
13. Give this a try and let me know what other ideas you came up with

title: eastern european stuffed eggs
steps:
1. Optional step:
2. Saute finely chopped onion in the optional oil until tender and soft
3. Main directions:
4. Carefully remove egg yolks and place in a small bowl
5. Mash yolk well and add remaining ingredients , mixing thoroughly
6. Stuff each egg white with mixture and chill

title: garlic veggie pizza
steps:
1. Prepare pizza dough according to package instructions or recipe
2. While dough is rising , sprinkle cornmeal onto pizza pan
3. Spread out pizza dough onto pizza pan
4. Place crust into oven and bake for 2-5 minutes
5. While crust is baking , mix together olive oil and garlic in small bowl
6. Remove crust from oven and spread oil and garlic mixture over warm crust to within one half an inch of edge
7. Sprinkle lightly with parmesan cheese
8. Place a layer of tomatoes , onion , mushrooms , peppers , and squash
9. The juice from the tomatoes mixes with the garlic and olive oil to make a wonderful"sauce"
10. Cover the veggies with a generous layer of mozzarella cheese and sprinkle with some more of the parmesan
11. Bake the pizza according to the dough recommendations
12. Let pizza set for a couple of minutes before slicing
13. Enjoy !

title: james  chili mac
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Drain
3. In a dutch oven or large skillet , brown beef in oil , stirring frequently
4. Add undrained tomatoes , tomato juice , onions , garlic , salt and remaining seasonings
5. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes
6. Stir in kidney beans
7. Cook for an additional 30 minutes
8. Remove bay leaf
9. Add cooked pasta to the chili

title: copycat mccormick montreal steak seasoning
steps: 1. Mix together and store in a shaker

title: harvest pumpkin torte
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Line 15-1 / 2x10-1 / 2x1-inch jelly roll pan with foil
3. Generously grease foil
4. Beat egg yolks in large bowl on medium speed 3 minutes
5. Gradually add 1 / 2 cup sugar , beating 2 additional minutes
6. Stir together flour , cocoa , 1 / 4 cup sugar , baking soda and salt
7. Add to egg yolk mixture alternately with water , beating on low speed just until batter is smooth
8. Stir in vanilla
9. Set aside
10. Beat egg whites in medium bowl until soft peaks form
11. Gradually add remaining 1 tablespoon sugar , beating until stiff peaks form
12. Gradually fold beaten egg whites into chocolate mixture until well blended
13. Spread batter evenly into prepared pan
14. Bake 14 to 16 minutes or until top springs back when touched lightly
15. Immediately loosen cake from edges of pan
16. Invert onto clean , slightly dampened towel
17. Carefully peel off foil
18. Cool completely
19. Meanwhile , prepare pumpkin filling
20. Cut cake crosswise into four equal pieces
21. Place one piece on serving plate
22. Spread about 3 / 4 cup filling over top
23. Repeat layering with remaining cake and filling , ending with cake layer
24. Spread chocolate glaze over top
25. Garnish with almonds , if desired
26. Refrigerate until serving time
27. Refrigerate leftover torte
28. 8 to 10 servings
29. Pumpkin filling
30. 1 cup canned pumpkin
31. 1 / 4 cup all-purpose flour
32. 1 / 3 cup butter or margarine , softened
33. 3 tablespoons shortening
34. 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
35. 1 / 4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
36. 1-3 / 4 cups powdered sugar
37. Combine pumpkin and flour in small saucepan
38. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until mixture boils
39. Remove from heat
40. Set aside
41. Cool completely
42. Beat butter and shortening in small bowl until creamy
43. Add spices
44. Gradually add powdered sugar , beating until light and fluffy
45. Slowly blend in pumpkin mixture
46. Refrigerate until mixture ready to use
47. About 2-1 / 4 cups filling
48. Chocolate glaze
49. 1 tablespoon butter or margarine
50. 2 tablespoons hershey's cocoa
51. 1 tablespoon water
52. 1 / 4 teaspoon vanilla extract
53. 2 / 3 cup powdered sugar
54. Melt butter in small saucepan over low heat
55. Add cocoa and water
56. Cook , stiring constantly , until mixture thickens
57. Do not boil
58. Remove from heat
59. Stir in vanilla
60. Gradually add powdered sugar , beating with whisk until smooth and thickened

title: libby s jules dip
steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together and chill

title: tasty chile relleno bake
steps:
1. Grease 9x9 pan
2. Tear each chili so it lies flat and spread into pan
3. Sprinkle cheese over chilis
4. Mix together remaining ingredients and pour over cheese
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes

title: pork loin with roasted garlic vinaigrette
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 475
2. Cut the tops off of each garlic head , place each garlic on a sheet of aluminum foil , drizzle with olive oil and salt and pepper , wrap foil so that the garlic is completely enclosed
3. Roast the garlic for 1 hour
4. Place the pork in a medium-sized heavy saucepan
5. Season on all sides with salt and pepper
6. Place the pork in the oven after the garlic has been roasting for 30 minutes
7. Roast the pork for 30-40 minutes , or until cooked through
8. Remove for the roasting pan , tent with foil , and let sit for 15 minutes
9. Remove the garlic from the oven after it has been in for 1 hour , let cool to the touch
10. Squeeze the cloves out of the skin
11. Place in a blender with the parsley and balsamic vinegar
12. Pulse until blended
13. Drizzle in the 3 / 4 cup olive oil while the machine is blending
14. Add the sugar , salt , pepper , and water and blend to incorporate
15. Serve the dressing over the pork

title: pumpkin maple dreams
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a cookie sheet
3. In a bowl , combine flour , pumpkin pie spice , baking powder , baking soda and salt
4. Set aside
5. In another bowl , beat butter , shortening and sugar with an electric mixer until light and fluffy , add in the egg
6. Mix well
7. Add in the pumpkin puree and vanilla
8. Mix very well
9. Slowly mix in the flour mixture until combined
10. Stir in raisins
11. Drop by tablespoonfuls onto greased baking sheet
12. Bake until set
13. Cool on wire racks
14. For frosting: in a bowl , cream butter and both extracts using an electric mixer
15. Gradually add in the icing sugar , alternating with milk , beating well after each addition , until smooth and fluffy , and the desired consistancy for spreading on cookies is achieved
16. Spread or pipe with a star-
17. Sprinkle with nuts
18. Enjoy !

title: orange pineapple deluxe
steps:
1. Sprinkle pudding into yougart
2. Stir until smooth
3. Add mandarin oranges and pineapples
4. Fold in cool whip
5. Chill for an hour
6. The preparation time includes the chill time

title: savory nutty crescents
steps:
1. In a small bowl , add the butter and sage
2. Stir to combine
3. Reserve 1 tablespoon butter mixture for topping
4. Separate the crescent roll dough into 8 triangles
5. Spread remaining butter mixture onto triangles
6. Sprinkle evenly with pecans
7. Roll up dough , starting at the shortest side of the triangle , rolling to opposite point
8. Place on an ungreased baking sheet and curve the roll into a crescent shape
9. Spread reserved butter mixture on the tops of the rolls
10. Bake at 375 for 11 to 13 minutes , or until golden
11. Serve warm

title: classic aunt sally  or sally ann  cookies
steps:
1. Cream shortening and sugar , add molasses and eggs and buttermilk
2. Mix dry ingredients thoroughly , then add to creamed mixture
3. Refrigerate for an hour or so , until slightly firm
4. Roll out at about 1 / 4"
5. Cut out
6. Bake at 325 for about 12-15 minutes
7. When cookies are cool , whip up the icing
8. In saucepan , dissolve gelatin in cold water
9. Bring to a boil and simmer for about 10 minutes
10. While simmering , add 3 c powdered sugar to a large straight-sided bowl and measure in soda
11. Stir
12. Pour hot liquid into sugar mixture and whisk
13. Add vanilla
14. Lumps are not good
15. If 3 c of powdered sugar is enough to produce a almost-set pudding-like icing , it is read
16. If it seems thin , add another cup and whisk inches
17. Take cooled cookies and dip the tops into the icing , wiping off excess on side of bowl
18. Set on wax paper until icing is hard

title: japanese tonkatsu  pork chops
steps:
1. Whisk first four ingredients in small measure until combined
2. Set sauce aside
3. Season pork chops with salt and pepper mixture
4. Dredge each chop in flour , until coated , then dip chops in eggs and then in breadcrumbs , pressing crumbs to adhere
5. Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
6. When oil is hot , add pork
7. Cook first side 3 to 4 minutes , or until golden brown
8. Turn pork , and cook second side 3 to 4 minutes , adjusting heat , if necessary , so chops cook rapidly but coating does not burn , or until golden brown and cooked through
9. Make a mound of cabbage on each of 4 plates
10. Drizzle cabbage with a bit of sauce , then top with a chop
11. Serve with lemon wedges and remaining sauce

title: injera  ethiopian flatbread
steps:
1. Teff flour is available from a whole foods store or northern african markets
2. Nancy's yogurt is best because of its tartness
3. You want not-sweet yogurt
4. Whisk the flours , salt & baking soda in a large bowl
5. In a separate bowl whisk the yogurt into the club soda , then stir this in the flour mix making a thin , smooth batter
6. Strain to make sure there a no lumps
7. Pam your largest skillet & heat over medium high heat
8. Pour about 1 / 2 cup of batter into the skillet starting in the center & spiraling out
9. Cook for 20 seconds
10. Cover for 30 more seconds
11. Remove it to a warm platter & cover with a cloth to keep it warm while you cook the rest of the flat breads
12. Lay a piece of the flat bread on the hugest plate you have
13. In the center of it put a dipper of your finest , zestiest , most mouthwatering thick stew
14. Now , eat the stew , tearing off pieces of the bread from the sides & scooping up the stew
15. Need another piece of injera ? ! sure you do ! it could take 2 or 3 pieces to scoop up all that wonderful stew
16. Once you have gained confidence with this & know your mama isn't going to come make you use a fork , add 2 or 3 more dippers of food
17. Veggies
18. Green beans & carrots & maybe a wilted spinach salad
19. Of course , you'll need more injera to scoop all that up
20. But what the heck --

title: italian ground beef dinner
steps:
1. Mix the first 7 ingredients
2. Add ground beef , and 3 t parmesan and mix well
3. Shape into 6 patties
4. Brown patties for 2 minutes per side
5. Mix tomato sauce and italian seasoning , pour over patties
6. Reduce heat , cover and simmer for 15 minutes
7. Place spaghetti on plate
8. Add pattie , and spoon sauce over
9. Sprinkle with remaining parmesan cheese

title: banana nut bread  healthy  low fat  low sugar
steps:
1. In a big bowl combine flour , baking powder , sugar and cinnamon
2. In a second bowl puree the banana and mix with the applesauce and egg
3. Add wet ingredients to the dry and stir until just combined
4. Fold in the nuts
5. Fill dough into a prepared mini loaf pan and bake in the preheated oven at 180c / 350f for 30-45 minutes or until skewer inserted in the centre comes out clean
6. You might need to cover the bread in order to prevent overbrowning
7. Check for this after 25 minutes

title: zip sauce  from a very popular restaurant in michigan  excellent
steps:
1. Melt the butter , the restaurant clarifies it , but i don't take the time--excellent either way
2. I don't measure the maggi's out exactly , i do it by color and my taste preference , should be about 2 tablespoons
3. Then add mushrooms
4. Simmer on low until mushrooms are done
5. This can be a bit salty so you may want to taste as you add the maggi's
6. This is one of my specialties--everyone asks for the recipe

title: non dairy caramel sauce
steps:
1. In a saucepan , combine brown sugar , sugar , creamer and margarine
2. Bring to a boil over moderate heat while stirring constantly until sugar is dissolved
3. Use in place of your favorite caramel sauce

title: beef stroganoff   topped potatoes
steps:
1. Scrub potatoes and prick them in several places with the
2. Place potatoes on a paper towel in a microwave oven and cook on high for 7 minutes
3. Turn potatoes over and continue to cook on high for 8-9 minutes or until tender
4. Meanwhile , melt butter in a large skillet
5. Add onion and cook over medium- high heat for 2 minutes
6. Add mushrooms and cook for 3 minutes , stirring occasionally
7. Add beef and sprinkle with salt , paprika and pepper
8. Cook for 5 minutes , stirring frequently
9. Add broth and bring to a boil
10. Combine sour cream and flour , mixing well
11. Stir into the beef mixture
12. Cook for 1 minute or until sauce thickens , stirring constantly
13. Split hot potatoes with a fork and squeeze ends inward to fluff
14. If desired , sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste
15. Spoon beef mixture over the potatoes
16. Sprinkle with chives or parsley

title: easy  festive chocolate holiday pretzels
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 170 degrees
2. Open the bags of pretzels and remove all the unbroken pretzels
3. Place them on waxed paper-lined cookie sheets in a single layer
4. Unwrap hugs , place one on each pretzel , repeat for an entire cookie sheet
5. Do only one type of candy per sheet , as the hugs melt much quicker than the kisses
6. Repeat using the hershey kisses
7. Place cookie sheet / s in the preheated oven , bake for 4 minutes for the sheet of pretzels and hugs , 5-6 minutes for the pretzels and kisses
8. Immediately upon removing from the oven , place one m-n-m on top of each pretzel / chocolate
9. Place cookie sheet in freezer for 8-10 minutes , to allow chocolate to re-set

title: chicken or turkey meatballs  moroccan style
steps:
1. Mix parsley , onion , & spices with the ground chicken
2. Make sure it is well blended so that the spices are evenly distributed throughout the mixture
3. Make 1 inch balls flattened to about 1 / 2 inch thickness
4. Optional: dip the balls into the flour until coated
5. Pour enough oil to just cover the bottom of the frying pan , heat on medium heat
6. Place the balls into the heated oil
7. Turn frequently so they do not burn on the sides
8. Cook until they are done all the way through
9. Optional: to eat moroccan style , use pieces of a thick bread to break off chunks of meatball
10. Pop into mouth & enjoy

title: feta dip spread with fresh dill
steps:
1. In a food processor , combine feta and ricotta cheese
2. Process until smooth
3. Add remaining ingredients and pulse until blended but still chunky

title: chicken malabar
steps:
1. Combine all except brown sugar and white wine & marinate overnight
2. Next day:
3. Dissolve 1 cup brown sugar in 1 cup white wine
4. Gently mix into marinated chicken and bake in preheated 350f oven 1 hour or until done
5. Garnish with chopped cilantro ~1 / 4 cup or so
6. Serve with white rrice

title: ham steaks with pineapple rice
steps:
1. Cut ham into cubes
2. Put oil into non stick fry pan and gently fry ham cubes and onion
3. Add the pineapple and the juice , the stock , rice and the water
4. Bring to boil
5. Cover and cook for about 15 minutes or until rice is tender and most of the liquid is absorbed
6. Add more boiling water during cooking if necessary
7. Stir in peas , red pepper and soy sauce and season to taste
8. Heat through and serve immediately

title: maple glazed squash and green beans with walnuts
steps:
1. Peel and cut squash into 3 x 1 / 2 x 1 / 2 inch strips to make about 5 cups , set aside
2. In a large saucepan of boiling salted water , blanch the green beans until tender crisp , about 3 to 6 minutes
3. Drain and chill under cold water
4. Drain well
5. In a large nonstick frypan , heat oil and butter over medium high heat until foaming
6. Add squash
7. Cover and cook , turning twice , until tender crisp , about 5 minutes
8. Add green beans , maple syrup , soy sauce , salt and pepper
9. Cook turning gently , until heated through and evenly coated
10. Mix in walnuts
11. Scrape into warmed serving dish

title: crab and broccoli alfredo
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti according to package instructions
2. Meanwhile , heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat
3. Add onion and red pepper
4. Cook 3 minutes
5. Add broccoli and garlic
6. Cook , stirring occasionally , 5 minutes or until tender
7. Heat half-and-half and butter in small saucepan until butter is melted
8. Stir in cheese , salt , and hot pepper sauce
9. Add cream mixture and crabmeat to skillet
10. Heat through over medium heat
11. Toss with cooked , drained pasta in large bowl
12. Garnish with lemon

title: persian grapes
steps:
1. Divide grapes evenly into six cups
2. Divide yogurt evenly
3. Using 1 / 3 cup for each dessert , spoon over grapes
4. Using 1 tablespoon of brown sugar for each dessert , sprinkle evenly over yogurt
5. Chill for several hours

title: ravioli   zucchini lasagna
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f line cookie sheet with paper towels
2. Grease 2-quart ceramic baking dish
3. Heat large covered saucepot of water to boiling over high heat
4. Add zucchini and cook 5 minutes
5. With tongs or slotted spoon , remove zucchini to prepared cookie sheet to drain
6. Return water to boiling
7. Add ravioli and cook until ravioli rise to the top
8. Meanwhile , in 3-quart saucepan , heat 2 teaspoons oil over medium heat
9. Add onion and cook 8 to 10 minutes or until tender and lightly browned
10. Transfer to small bowl
11. In same saucepan , in remaining 1 teaspoon oil , cook beef over medium-high heat 3 to 4 minutes or until browned , breaking up beef with side of spoon
12. Stir in tomato sauce and onion
13. Heat to boiling
14. Drain ravioli
15. Return to saucepot
16. Add meat sauce to ravioli in saucepot and stir until combined
17. In prepared baking dish , arrange half of zucchini
18. Top with half of ravioli , then half of mozzarella and half of parmesan
19. Repeat layering all ingredients
20. Bake 20 minutes or until hot in the center and golden and bubbly on top

title: paula deen s mama s pound cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease & flour a 10" tube pan or bundt pan
3. Sift dry ingredients
4. Cream butter & shortening together
5. Add sugar a little at a time
6. Cream until fluffy
7. Add eggs one at a time , beating after each addition to fully incorporate the eggs into the batter
8. Add dry ingredients and milk to mixture alternating
9. Starting and ending with flour
10. Mix in vanilla
11. Pour into prepared pan
12. Bake 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours , or until it passes the toothpick test

title: persimmon   raisin cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter , gradually add sugar , beating well
2. Add eggs and beat well
3. Combine flour , spices and salt-add to creamed mixture
4. Mix well
5. Combine persimmon pulp and baking soda
6. Stir well and add to creamed mixture
7. Stir in raisins and pecans
8. Drop dough by tablespoons onto greased cookie sheets
9. Bake at 350f for 12 to 15 minutes or until done
10. Usually yields about 3 dozen

title: bird s easy cheesy shepherd s pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f mix potatoes , cream cheese , half of the cheddar cheese , and garlic until well blended
2. Set aside
3. Brown meat , onion , italian seasoning , and ground mace in large skillet and drain
4. Return meat back to pan and stir in vegetables and sour cream
5. Heat to warm
6. Pour meat mixture into a deep 9" pie crust
7. Cover with potato mixture
8. Sprinkle with remaining cheddar cheese and paprika
9. Bake for 25 minutes or till heated through

title: cauliflower cheese  415cals per serve
steps:
1. Prepare the cauliflower , removing outside leaves and thick stalk
2. Boil in salted water until tender
3. Drain and arrange in a warmed heatproof dish
4. Make the sauce , adding the mustard and three quarters of the grated cheese
5. Pour the sauce over the cauliflower and sprinkle the remaining cheese on top
6. Brown under a hot grill

title: herbed whole grain bread or rolls
steps:
1. Warm milk , water , shortening , sugar , and salt together in either a pan on the stove or a food processor in the microwave until it is very warm to the touch , but not hot
2. Stir in or process wheat flour and rye flour until well mixed and let stand five minutes to absorb moisture
3. Blend in egg
4. Stir in or process gently the yeast and allow it to sit for ten minutes to soften
5. Add small batches of white flour and process well until well incorporated until a manageable 'non-clinging' dough is formed
6. Do not add until stiff or dry
7. Knead gently until semi-smooth and it holds its shape together
8. Grease large 2 quart bowl with butter or shortening , press dough down into the greased bowl , then turn right side up and cover with a warm damp towel and let rise 20 minutes
9. Knock air out of risen dough and shape into 4 small to medium loaves or two large loaves
10. Grease four medium bread or two large bread pans
11. Press loaves down into greased pans , turn right side up , and cover again with warm damp towel
12. Let rise until double in bulk
13. Bake large loaves or baguettes for 30 minutes at 350 degrees
14. Bake medium loaves at 375 degrees for 30 minutes
15. Bake bread rolls at 400 degrees for 25-30 minutes
16. Bake french rolls at 375 degrees for 30 minutes
17. When bread is browned on top and crust is browned , remove from pans , brush immediately with butter , and let cool
18. Brush again with butter when cool enough to handle with hands

title: brillant sunset
steps:
1. Add ice to four glasses
2. Pour 1 tablespoon grenadine over ice in each glass
3. Slowly add 1 cup orange juice to produce sunset affect
4. Garnish with an orange slice and a cherry
5. Stir if desired before drinking

title: simple japanese white rice
steps:
1. Put rice in a bowl and wash in several changes of cold water until water is clear
2. Drain in a sieve 15 minutes
3. Soak rice in water in a 4-quart heavy pot 30 minutes
4. Cover pot with lid and bring rice just to a boil over medium-high heat
5. Reduce heat to low and cook , covered , until water is absorbed , 15 to 20 minutes
6. Remove from heat
7. Let stand , covered , 10 minutes
8. Stir gently with a heatproof rubber spatula , folding from top to bottom of pot
9. Rice can be kept warm in a bowl , covered , set over 1 to 2 inches of simmering water up to 45 minutes

title: chocolate chia seed pudding
steps:
1. Whisk milk , splenda , cocoa powder and extract until smooth
2. Stir in chia seeds
3. Divide evenly between 4 dishes
4. Let sit at room temperature for 2 hours

title: pork tenderloin with mango chutney
steps:
1. Chutney: peel , halve and seed mango , cut into 1 / 2 inch cubes
2. Combine mango with all the other ingredients in a deep heavy sauce pot
3. Cook , uncovered until it begins to simmer gently
4. Continue cooking for about 10 minutes , simmering until thickened
5. Cool , cover tightly and refrigerate
6. It will keep for about 1 week in the refrigerator
7. Bring to room temperature or warm for serving
8. Tederloins: season lightly with salt and pepper
9. Roast pork on a rack in a shallow roasting pan
10. Insert meat thermometer
11. Roast uncovered in a 350 degree oven for 25-35 minutes or until the thermometer registers 145-155 degrees
12. Slice and top with chutney

title: hearts of romaine  palm   artichoke w  citrus dijon dressing
steps:
1. Arrange romaine lettuce , hearts of palm and artichokes on a large platter or bowl
2. Combine the marmalade with lemon juice , mustard , season with salt and pepper
3. Wisk the olive oil in slowly
4. Pour dressing over salad evenly and toss
5. Garnish with almonds

title: peaches   cream muffins
steps:
1. Dice the drained peaches to about the size of peas
2. Set aside
3. In a large bowl , mix flour , sugar , baking powder and salt
4. In separate bowl combine eggs and oil
5. Then whisk in the milk
6. Combine egg and flour mixtures
7. Then fold in diced peaches
8. For filling , beat cream cheese , sugar , peach juice and almond extract
9. Fill greased muffin tins half full of batter
10. Drop 1 teaspoon of the filling into each muffin cup of the batter and top with 1 1 / 2 tablespoons more batter
11. For topping , mix cinnamon and sugar
12. Sprinkle over muffins
13. Bake in a preheated oven at 350 for 20 minutes
14. Serve warm

title: crock pot sauerkraut and sausage
steps:
1. Layer carrots and potatoes in crock pot , set aside
2. In a skillet , brown sausage on all sides and transfer to cooker
3. Reserving drippings from sausage , saut onion and garlic till translucent and add broth
4. Bring to a boil and stir in pepper and caraway
5. Pour over sausage in cooker
6. Place sauerkraut over all
7. Cover and cook on low till veggies are tender , about 8 hours

title: butter and jelly sushi rolls
steps:
1. Remove the crusts from the bread and with a rolling pin or large soup can , completely flatten the bread
2. Spread 1 tbls
3. Of the butteron each slice bread , all the way to the edges
4. Then spread 1 tbls
5. Of the jam or preserves over butter
6. Roll each slice into a tight spiral
7. Cut each spiral into 4 pieces
8. To make it easier to cut , you could make this the day before serving and put in the fridge overnight
9. They are easier to slice cold
10. Makes 8 sushi rolls

title: creamy pumpkin fettuccine
steps:
1. Over low heat , bring just to a simmer pumpkin , cream , 1 / 2 cup cheese and nutmeg
2. Add butter to fettuccine tossing until butter melts
3. Mix in pumpkin mixture
4. Sprinkle with remaining cheese
5. Grind pepper on top

title: ricotta gnocchi
steps:
1. In a bowl , place the ricotta , grated cheese , egg , and salt
2. Add 1 cup of the flour and mix
3. Add only as much more flour as you need to create a workable dough
4. Be careful not to overwork
5. Divide the dough into fist size pieces , and roll into long logs as thick as your thumb
6. Cut into 1 inch slices and gently place on a lightly floured baking sheet
7. Continue with the rest of the dough in this manner
8. If not using immediately , place in the refrigerator
9. To prepare the sauce , heat the oil in a sauce pan and add the garlic cooking only until fragrant - do not brown
10. Add the tomatoes , basil , and seasonings and bring to a boil
11. Turn down to a simmer and cook for about 10 minutes
12. To cook the gnocchi , drop into lightly salted water and remove as soon as they float to the top , after 1 or 2 minutes
13. Place in a warmed bowl , top with some of the tomato sauce and the mozzarella cubes and gently mix
14. Serve with additional sauce if desired

title: five a day vegetable tagine
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f
2. Scatter the veg over a couple of baking trays , drizzle with half the oil , season , then rub the oil over the veg with your hands to coat
3. Roast for 30 mins until tender and beginning to brown
4. Meanwhile , fry the spices in the remaining oil for 1 min - they should sizzle and start to smell aromatic
5. Simmer for 5 mins until the sauce is slightly reduced and the apricots plump , then stir in the veg and some seasoning
6. Serve with couscous or jacket potatoes

title: escalloped potatoes
steps:
1. For sauce , melt butter in a saucepan , then blend in flour
2. Cook over moderate heat and slowly stir in milk
3. Season with salt & pepper and continue cooking until sauce is smooth and boiling
4. Reduce heat and add cheese , stirring , until cheese is blended , then add green pepper / pimento mixture , stir , and remove from heat
5. Grease a baking dish and fill with alternate layers of potatoes and sauce
6. Bake in moderate oven , 350 degrees , until potatoes are done , about 1 to 1-1 / 2 hours
7. Potatoes may be turned with a spoon to ensure even cooking

title: chinese sesame salad
steps:
1. Combine cabbage and onions
2. Refrigerate until ready to toss
3. Brown noodles , almonds and sesame seeds lightly in butter
4. Set aside
5. Bring to a boil in a pan the vinegar , oil , sugar and soy sauce , just enough to dissolve the sugar
6. Cool dressing completely
7. Combine all ingredients and toss just before serving

title: lemon courgette  zucchini  cake
steps:
1. Pre-heat the oven to 160c
2. Beat the egg and oil together , then mix in the courgette and sugar
3. In another bowl , mix together the remaining ingredients until well distributed
4. Add the flour mixture to the courgette and mix together well
5. Pour into a lined cake tin and bake for 45 minutes , or until a skewer poked into the cake comes out clean

title: tweety bird
steps:
1. Serve in unusually shaped glasses
2. Give your glasses a frosted edge by dipping the rim into lemon juice and then dipping it into sugar
3. Simple but effective ! add colorful decorations - drink umbrellas , swizzle sticks , paper flowers , straws and even sparklers ! these decorations are all cheap and easy to obtain from your local grocery store
4. Add some straws - colored straws are great - just cut them up for small glasses or use cocktail sticks or toothpicks to twist or skewer fruits
5. In other words , have fun , make the tweety bird your own !

title: rice krispies cookies  deyo
steps:
1. Cream together oleo , egg , sugars , and vanilla
2. Add baking soda , baking powder , oatmeal and flour
3. Add rice krispies and coconut
4. Mix well
5. Drop by teaspoonful on greased cookie sheet
6. Bake at 350f for 10 minutes

title: beef and mac skillet
steps:
1. Brown hamburger and onion
2. Drain
3. Add tomatoes with liquid , water and macaroni into the skillet
4. Bring to a boil then simmer 25 minutes
5. Stir occasionally
6. The last 5 minutes add grated cheese on top then cover with a lid

title: easy  spicy  veggie grilled cheese
steps:
1. Turn oven on to about medium high
2. Spray pan with cooking spray
3. Put motzzerella cheese on bread
4. Then add onions , carrots , basil and crushed red pepper
5. Put the other slice of bread on top
6. Cook each side until golden brown

title: delicious easy spinach and strawberry salad with feta
steps:
1. In a large bowl toss the spinach with the strawberries and toasted almonds
2. In another small bowl whisk together all dressing ingredients , starting with 1 / 4 cup sugar and adding in more to taste , then pour over the spinach
3. Toss to combine
4. Sprinkle the feta over the top of salad
5. Serve immediately

title: apple cheese crisp ii
steps:
1. Preheat over to 325 degrees
2. Peel , core and slice apples
3. Place apples into buttered 8 x 8 baking dish
4. Combine sugar , brown sugar , lemon peel , cinnamon and coriander
5. Sprinkle over apples
6. Mix well with your hands
7. Combine water / cider and lemon juice
8. Sprinkle mixture over apples
9. In medium bowl combine ingredients for topping
10. Mix unt il crumbly
11. Put topping over apples , patting down with your hands
12. Bake for 55-60 minutes until mixture is golden brown and bubbles up in the center
13. Serve warm with cream , whipped topping or ice cream

title: xocoalt
steps:
1. Mix the chocolate milk , milk and ice-cream in a blender
2. Stir in the vanilla sugar
3. Pour into glasses and decorate with white chocolate gratings

title: mom s homemade potato salad
steps:
1. Peel , chop , and boil potatoes
2. Hard boils the eggs
3. In a large bowl combine mustard , mayo , and relish
4. Add the potatoes and mix with a wooden spoon
5. Cut up the eggs or crumble them
6. Add the eggs to the large bowl and you should have potato salad
7. Let the mixture stand in the fridge for a few hours or until cold
8. Enjoy !

title: bacon mushroom baked potato topping
steps:
1. Microwave bacon in a microwave-safe dish on high for 2 minutes
2. Drain on a paper towel
3. Add shallot to bacon fat and microwave 1 minute
4. Stir in mushrooms and butter
5. Microwave 1 minute longer
6. Crumble bacon
7. Stir into mushrooms
8. Spoon over a hot , split baked potato

title: jamaica me crazy chili
steps:
1. Brown ground beef over medium high heat in a large , deep frying pan
2. Drain off fat and set aside
3. Coat a large dutch oven with cooking spray and place over medium high heat
4. When pan is hot add the olive oil and cook the onion and garlic until the onion is tender , then add the peppers and cook until tender
5. Season with the cumin , paprika , chili powder , sugar , salt and cloves
6. Stir in the canned diced tomatoes , and the drained cans of beans
7. Add water to cover all
8. Bring to a boil and then stir in the meat and tomato paste
9. Bring to a boil and then simmer 30 minutes
10. Remove from the heat and stir in the vinegar
11. May serve with chopped fresh cilantro as decorative topping

title: bbq pork chops and roasted potatoes
steps:
1. Place pork chops in a single layer in a casserole dish
2. Layer potatoes and onion rings over meat
3. Pour barbecue sauce over vegetables and bake at 350 degrees until done , about 1 1 / 2 hours

title: chocolate peanut butter whoopie puffs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Cream together the sugar and butter until light and fluffy using an electric mixer on medium speed for 1-2 minutes
3. Add the egg and vanilla
4. Blend 1-2 minutes more
5. Reduce mixer speed to low
6. Add the flour , cocoa powder , baking soda , and baking powder alternately with the milk , blending well after each addition
7. Drop dough by slightly rounded teaspoons 2" apart onto lightly greased cookie sheets
8. Bake for 6-8 minutes , or until tops of cookies spring back when lightly touched
9. Cool completely on wire racks
10. Combine all the filling ingredients in a small bowl
11. Blend with an electric mixer on low speed until creamy , 1-2 minutes
12. Spread 1 level teaspoons filling on the flat side of half the cookies
13. Sandwich with remaining cookies , flat side down
14. Dust with powdered sugar , if desired

title: tuna sandwiches  nicoise style
steps:
1. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and add the green beans
2. When the water comes back to a boil , take the green beans out and add to a bowl of ice water
3. Once they are cooled , drain them , pat dry and chop
4. Combine the mayo , olives and lemon juice in a food processor and process until just about smooth
5. Transfer this mixture to a bowl
6. Drain the tuna and stir it into the mayo mixture
7. Add the eggs , tomatoes , green beans , dill , and the salt and pepper and mix together
8. Toast the bread slices
9. Divide the tuna onto 4 slices of the bread , top with lettuce and remaining bread slices

title: cranberry sauce extraordinaire
steps:
1. Boil the water and sugar in a medium saucepan until dissolved
2. Reduce heat
3. Add the rest of the ingredients and simmer for 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Remove from heat and allow to cool to room temperature before serving or storing

title: cape malay chicken curry by zurie
steps:
1. Gather your spices together , and peel and chop the ginger
2. Put the 10 spices -- from the coriander seeds down to the garam masala -- in a mortar and pestle or even in a coffee bean grinder
3. Mash them together so the cardamom pods burst and the whole thing becomes a mess of spices
4. Then heat the oil in a pot , add the onion over fairly high heat , and stir now and then , for a few minutes
5. Add the spices you mashed or grinded , and stir
6. You might need to add more oil: spices slurp up oil as they fry
7. Don't worry , you will be able to skim it off again later
8. Stir and fry spices and onion for about 2 minutes
9. Add the can of chopped tomatoes and stir
10. The heat should be high enough so everything bubbles together
11. Add the chicken pieces , and stir to coat well , keeping heat high until everything is bubbling away
12. Turn heat way down until it just simmers , put on a lid , and cook for about 20 minutes
13. Sprinkle over the garlic , sugar , lemon juice and salt
14. Simmer with lid at a small angle , for about 15 minutes more
15. Stir through , taste the sauce , and adjust seasoning to taste
16. Please
17. On my photos you can see there isn't much oil or fat on the dish
18. Serve this with rice
19. Tonight i served this with green vegetables and what you might call "grits and beans"

title: easy  asian chicken lettuce wraps
steps:
1. Whisk together water and cornstarch in large mixing bowl until smooth
2. Stir in teriyaki sauce
3. Add chicken and water chestnuts
4. Mix to coat
5. Marinate for 30 minutes
6. Cook and stir in small batches in hot oil in a wok or large skillet until no longer pink
7. Serve with rice noodles , shredded carrots and lettuce leaves or flour tortillas

title: turkish chicken
steps:
1. 1) mix all seasoning with oil in a bowl
2. 2) place chicken pieces in bowl and toss to coat
3. 3) place in fridge for 10 min
4. 4) preheat oven to 450
5. 5) place chicken on one layer on a pan
6. Roast for 10 minute
7. 6) pour 1 / 4 cup of fruit juice on top
8. 7) roast for another 10 minute
9. 8) test that chicken is done by cutting one of the thickest pieces
10. Enjoy !

title: yummy cream cheese rolls
steps:
1. Beat the cream cheese , lemon juice and caster
2. Sugar together until smooth
3. Lightly stir in the sifted flour and sultanas
4. Cut a sheet of pastry in half and lay in the unit , pushing down gently to show the hollows
5. Place filling in each hollow and top with remaining half of pastry
6. Close the unit and cook for 8-10 minutes or until golden
7. Repeat procedure with remaining ingredients
8. Serve rolls hot or cold , dusted with icing sugar

title: toni s garden salad
steps:
1. Clean all the veggies and cut up as desired
2. Use the amounts you'd like in your salad
3. Variations:
4. Avocado , peeled and sliced
5. Provolone cheese , sliced and cut up
6. Monterey and cheddar cheese , sliced and cut up
7. Broccoli , cut up into bite size pieces
8. Green peppers , sliced
9. Green onions , chopped
10. White onions , diced
11. Turkey breast , sliced and cut up
12. Honey ham , sliced and cut up
13. Top with croutons and your favorite dressing !

title: chocolate and peanut butter chunk cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a small bowl , combine the first three ingredients
3. In a large bowl , mix the next six ingredients until evenly distributed
4. Slowly incorporate the ingredients from the small bowl into the large bowl
5. Add chocolate and peanut butter chips and stir well
6. Spoon 12 balls of dough onto two ungreased cookie sheets and bake for 17 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean

title: wasabi vinaigrette
steps:
1. In a jar , combine wasabi powder and water
2. Let stand 5 minutes
3. Add vinegars and whisk to combine
4. Stir in oil and shake well to combine
5. Add parsley and salt and shake well before serving

title: indian fry bread   midwest
steps:
1. Mix flour , baking powder & salt
