2. Gradually stir in oil & water to make a soft dough
3. Stir until dough is smooth & shiny
4. Cover , set aside 30 minutes
5. Shape dough into 16 balls the size of an egg
6. Roll out on lightly floured board 1 / 2 inch thick
7. Heat oil 3 inches deep until hot
8. Fry dough one at a time , turning with a fork until puffy & golden brown
9. Drain on paper towels

title: virgin party margarita
steps:
1. In a 5-gallon sports cooler combine all ingredients except reserve some water
2. Stir or shake container to chill
3. If ice all melts add more
4. If too strong add water , but leave on the strong side because ice will continue to dilute over the next few hours
5. Makes about 2 1 / 2 gallons
6. Just like party margarita recipe , you should serve with lime wedges , a saucer of kosher salt , and 6-oz plastic cups like airlines use
7. Lime the rim , touch the rim to the salt , drop the lime into the cup , and dispense

title: orange fruit salad with cinnamon
steps:
1. Using a small , sharp knife , peel the oranges , removing all the bitter , white pith
2. Slice the oranges crosswise about 1 / 3 inch thick
3. Arrange them in a shallow serving dish and sprinkle with the sugar , cinnamon and orange flower water
4. Garnish with the chopped nuts and mint leaves

title: savoury apple stuffed bbq pork sirloin
steps:
1. Cut your roast in half lengthwise and unfold it open like a book
2. Put it in a roasting pan and pour the apple cider over it
3. Inject some of the cider into the roast at 1" intervals
4. Set aside
5. Prepare the stuffing: mix all ingredients together in a large bowl , making sure all bread is moistened with the apple cider
6. Spoon approximately half of the stuffing onto the center of the pork , wrap the remaining in a foil packet
7. Fold over one side of the pork so that the stuffing is now in the middle of the meat
8. Tie with butcher twine
9. Put the roast back into the pan and let marinate for a few hours or overnight
10. Cooking instructions: preheat your coals , or gas bbq if that's what you have
11. If using coals: separate coals to either side of bbq leaving a space in the middle
12. Put roast directly over coals on one side , fat side down
13. Let roast this way until seared , then turn over and place roast in center of bbq , over the space , between the 2 beds of coals
14. Let roast until internal temperature reaches 170 with meat thermometer
15. If using gas bbq: after preheating bbq , put roast on fat side down until seared
16. Turn off one burner and turn the roast over placing over top of side with burner "off" turn other burner down to "low"
17. Put foil stuffing packet on bbq with roast
18. Roast until internal temperature reaches 170 with a meat thermometer
19. Cut strings , scoop out stuffing and slice roast into 3 / 4" thick slices
20. Mix stuffing with stuffing from packet and serve separately

title: skillet beef helper
steps:
1. Brown the ground beef in a skillet
2. Drain fat from pan
3. Add all the other ingredients
4. Bring to a boil
5. Lower heat and simmer for 15-20 minutes , stirring often

title: garlicky french bread
steps:
1. Pour water and oil into bread machine pan
2. Add flour
3. Add other ingredients , with the yeast being the final addition
4. Set bread machine for "basic white bread , 2 lb loaf" or your model's equivalent

title: moe s turkey bone soup
steps:
1. Place the turkey carcass and whole onion in a soup kettle and cover with cold water
2. Bring to a boil and simmer , covered 2 hours or until carcass is falling apart
3. Stir in the bouillon cubes the last 1 / 2 hours of cooking
4. Remove from heat and cool
5. Pour everything from the soup kettle into a colander , discarding the onion
6. When cool enough to handle , reserve only the pieces of turkey meat , discarding bones , skin and gristle
7. Refrigerate the meat at once
8. Chill the strained broth
9. Discard fat and return the broth to the soup kettle and bring to a boil
10. Add rice and chopped vegetables
11. Season to taste and simmer until rice is done
12. Stir in reserve meat
13. Heat thoroughly
14. Do not freeze

title: sweet and spicy chicken meatballs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 mix all meatball ingredients in a large bowl
2. Roll into 1 inch balls and place on non stick baking sheet
3. Place baking sheet in oven for 15 minutes
4. Place peppers , olives , oregano , basil , balsamic and garlic in food processor and puree
5. Mix this mixture with tomato products in a medium saucepan
6. Heat on medium high for 5 minutes or until simmering
7. Place chicken meatballs into sauce and let simmer uncovered for 30 minutes
8. Serve as side , appetizer or on a bun as a sandwich

title: chef joey s vegan cornmeal thyme cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350'f
2. Put the oven racks in upper and lower thirds
3. Line two baking sheets with unbleached parchment paper
4. Set aside
5. Whisk together flour , baking soda , cornmeal , and salt in a medium bowl
6. Put margarine and sugar in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a paddle and cream on medium speed until pale and fluffy for about 3 minutes
7. Mix in the egg replacer
8. Add the flour mixture into this on low speed until just combined
9. Do not over mix
10. Hand mix in the currants and thyme
11. Using a tablespoon or a 1 1 / 2 inch ice-cream scoop drop rounded balls of dough onto the parchment lined cookie sheets , spacing about 2 inches apart
12. Bake rotating and switching positions of sheets about 1 / 2 way through the cooking process
13. The cookies should be a pale golden shade
14. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes
15. Transfer cookies on parchment to a wire rack and cool completely
16. Bon apetit !

title: buttermilk brined pork chops
steps:
1. Combine the first 6 ingredients in a large heavy duty zip-lock plastic bag
2. Shake well to dissolve salt and sugar
3. Add in pork chops
4. Seal and refrigerate overnight , turning bag occasionally
5. Remove pork from bag and throw away the brine
6. Pat pork dry with a paper towel
7. Sprinkle chops with pepper
8. Heat a large non-stick grill pan over medium-high heat
9. Coat pan with cooking spray
10. Add pork
11. Cook 3 1 / 2 minutes per side or until desired doneness

title: st  tropez salad
steps:
1. Place the mixed greens and spinach on a chilled salad plate
2. Arrange the hearts of palm on the chilled greens
3. Cut the artichoke hearts into pieces and place on the greens
4. Arrange the orange pieces on the salad
5. Sprinkle the feta cheese on top
6. Dress the salad with the lemon oil dressing and the champagne dressing
7. Garnish with the alfa sprouts and the parsley sprigs

title: ww 3 points   iced chocolate brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray a 9x13 inch baking pan with cooking spray
3. In a large saucepan over low heat , combine sweetened condensed milk , cocoa , and chips
4. Stir until chips are melted
5. Remove from heat
6. Stir in egg whites , flour , baking powder , and vanilla
7. Mix well
8. Turn into prepared pan
9. Bake 20 minutes or until center is set
10. Cool
11. Make icing: combine icing ingredients and mix until well blended
12. Spread on cooled brownies

title: lynda s deviled eggs
steps:
1. Slice eggs lengthwise , slipping yolks into a separate bowl
2. Add onion , turmeric , dill weed , salt / pepper , about half of the paprika
3. Use a fork to loosen the egg yolks and blend with other ingredients before adding any moisture
4. This helps avoid those lumps of unmixed yolk you sometimes find
5. Add gherkins and juice
6. Add moisture: 1 / 4 cup mayo and approximately 2 tablespoons mustard to start
7. Mix well
8. Taste
9. Adjust moisture to your preference , using mayo , mustard or pickle juice- whichever is most needed
10. Scoop into egg white halves , top with paprika , chill before serving

title: fruit dream
steps:
1. Combine marshmallow cream , sour cream and whipped topping in a medium bowl
2. Mixture will be lumpy , but become smooth as marshmallow cream dissolves
3. Set aside
4. Layer fruit in a 3-1 / 2 quart trifle bowl in the order listed
5. Stir topping mixture until smooth
6. Spoon over fruit and sprinkle with pecans

title: banana lemonade
steps:
1. Add the first 4 ingredients to the container of an electric blender
2. Cover and process on high speed until mixture is smooth
3. Pour into chilled glass
4. Add ice cubes garnish with lemon slice
5. Alternative: banana limeade--substitute fresh lime juice for lemon juice
6. Garnish with a lime slice

title: old world spiced pancakes
steps:
1. In a small bowl , beat eggs and add milk
2. In large mixing bowl
3. Combine flour , sugar , baking powder , spices , and salt
4. Pour egg / milk mixture into center of dry ingredients
5. Stir quickly
6. Heat oil or fat in a deep skillet or deep fat fryer
7. If you have an electric griddle , set temperature to 375f
8. Test heat by dropping a pinch of batter into fat
9. If it immediately rises to the surface , then it is ready to fry with
10. Drop batter into fat with a tablespoon
11. Brown for 5 minutes on one side , then flip
12. Drain over paper towels
13. Serve hot with maple syrup and butter

title: ukranian peasant borscht
steps:
1. In a large dutch oven or stock pot , brown bacon and render fat
2. Add beef and brown
3. Cut the onion , carrot and celery in half cross-wise and add to pot with beef
4. Also add beets whole with skin , shredded cabbage and water
5. Add pepper corns and bay leaves
6. Bring to boil , then turn heat to medium low , cover and simmer 1 1 / 2 hours
7. After an hour of cooking start boiling potatoes whole in a separate pot until soft
8. When soup is ready turn off heat , with a slotted spoon remove the celery carrot and beets
9. Discard celery and carrots or use for something else
10. Leave beets on a separate plate or bowl until cool enough to handle
11. Peel and grate beets back into the soup pot
12. Add grated carrot
13. Bring soup back to boil
14. Add vinegar and lemon juice
15. Cook 5 minutes longer
16. To serve place a boiled potato in bowl and ladle soup on top
17. Add a dollop of sour cream to each bowl
18. Enjoy

title: soft coconut macaroons
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Combine flour , sugar , salt and coconut in mixing bowl
3. Stir in egg whites and almond extract
4. Stir in almonds , mix well
5. Drop teaspoon fulls onto a greased cookie sheet
6. Bake 20 minutes or until golden brown

title: mexican rice and bean casserole
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large skillet or dutch oven , heat the oil with water over medium heat
3. Add in the sliced mushrooms , green bell peppers , onion and garlic
4. Simmer stirring often until onion is tender
5. Add in the tomatoes , beans , rice , chili powder , cumin and cayenne
6. Mix to combine
7. Simmer covered for about 25 minutes , or until rice is tender , and the liquid is absorbed
8. Transfer to a large greased baking dish
9. Sprinkle with mozza cheese over top
10. Bake in oven for 15 minutes , or until the cheese is melted

title: ramen noodle pancakes
steps:
1. Break the package of noodles into 4 sections
2. Cook as package directs , then drain
3. Reserve seasoning packet
4. Put noodles in a bowl
5. Stir in zucchinik , scallions , carrot , eggs , flour and 1 / 2 teaspoons seasoning from mix
6. Heat 1 tbls
7. Oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat
8. Using 1 / 2 of the mixure , make 4 pancakes
9. Fry 2-3 minutes on each side
10. Repeat , using remaining oil
11. Mix soy sauce and lemon juice
12. Serve with pancakes
13. Or serve with whatever sauce you enjoy

title: flourless crepes
steps:
1. Wisk all ingredients together till frothy
2. Heat a small non-stick skillet or crepe pan coated with cooking spray over medium heat
3. Pour 1 / 3 of batter into pan and swirl to coat
4. You want the entire bottom of the pan evenly covered
5. Cook about 1 min until nicely set and slightly browned - the top will look cooked
6. Flip to brown the second side
7. Remove from pan onto waiting plate and repeat until batter is gone
8. Fill with your choice of toppings - fruit , ricotta cheese , etc --

title: hash browns potato casserole
steps:
1. Mix first 6 ingredients and mix well
2. Spoon into greased casserole dish and top with sharp cheese
3. Bake for 50 minutes at 350 degrees

title: wake up casserole
steps:
1. Place hash brown patties in 13x9 greased casserole
2. Sprinkle with cheese , and ham
3. In a bowl , beat eggs , half-and-half , salt and mustard well
4. Pour over ham
5. Sprinkle with pepper and bacon if desired
6. Cover
7. At this point it can be refrigerated and baked in the morning
8. Bake at 350f for 45 minutes covered ,
9. Uncover and bake additional 15 minutes or longer until edges are golden brown and knife inserted in center comes out clean
10. Cool slightly and cut around the hash brown patties to serve

title: hot feta artichoke dip
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients
2. Spoon into a 9 inch pie plate or 3 cup baking dish
3. Bake at 350' for 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned
4. Serve with toasted sliced baguette pieces
5. Make ahead directions: prepare as directed above except for baking
6. Cover and refrigerate overnight
7. Bake uncovered at 350' for 30 to 35 minutes or until lightly browned

title: soft and fudgy peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Place peanut butter and sugar in a large bowl and beat until thoroughly combined
2. Mix in the eggs and vanilla
3. Combine the flour , cocoa , baking soda and salt in a small bowl
4. Alternately add with the milk to the peanut butter mixture , mixing thoroughly
5. Roll into one inch balls and place on an ungreased cookie sheet about 2 inches apart
6. Use a fork to flatten with the traditional crisscross pattern of a peanut butter cookie
7. Bake at 350 for 8 minutes
8. Allow to cool on cookie sheet slightly before removing to a cooling rack

title: sour cream coffee cake
steps:
1. Mix cake , pudding mix , oil , sour cream , eggs and vanilla
2. Put half in greased bundt pan
3. Then mix rest
4. Add on top of above mixture then add the remaining batter and bake at 350 for 40-45 minutes

title: sausage stuffed round zucchini or eggplant
steps:
1. Scoop out the round zucchini , reserving the tops
2. Or scoop out the eggplant
3. Chop the vegetable centers you've scooped out and set aside
4. Cut the mozarella into cubes - about 1 / 3 inch
5. Chop the onion
6. Mince the garlic
7. Dice the bread into 1 / 4 inch cubes
8. Brown the sausage along with the garlic and onion in the olive oil , crumbling the sasuage as you stir
9. When browned a bit , add the chopped vegetable centers and spices and stir until it softens and some of the liquid has evaporated if the vegetables are watery
10. Add the tomato sauce and bread cubes and stir until the cubes are softened
11. Remove the filling from the heat and add the mozarella cubes
12. Scoop the filling into the hollowed vegetables , top with the reserved tops and bake in a deep baking dish at 350 for about 45-60 minutes or until the filling is hot and the vegetable bowls are tender
13. I find the vegetable bowls cook better if i cover the baking dish with foil for about half of the baking time

title: granny s pound cake
steps:
1. In large bowl , cream butter and sugar
2. Add eggs , one at a time , and beat well
3. Slowly add flour and flavoring beat for 5 minutes
4. Pour into greased and floured tube or bundt pan
5. Bake at 300 for 1 hour and 45 minutes

title: baked sweet potato and chile wedges
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f cut each unpeeled potato into 1-inch-thick wedges
2. Place in a large self-sealing plastic bag
3. Toss with oil , sea salt , and pepper
4. Arrange in two 13x9x2-inch disposable foil pans
5. Meanwhile , in small bowl combine orange juice , 3 teaspoons of the chili powder , and honey
6. Set aside
7. Bake potatoes , uncovered , 25 to 30 minutes or until tender , brushing three times with orange juice mixture , and shaking pan occasionally
8. Meanwhile , in a small bowl combine sour cream , remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon chili powder , and 1 / 3 cup cilantro
9. Transfer potatoes to a serving dish
10. Serve with sour cream mixture
11. Serve immediately or at room temperature

title: kingsbys  no yeast biscuits
steps:
1. Grease a muffin pan and pre-heat the oven at 350
2. Combine all of the dry ingredients in a medium-large bowl
3. Add the milk , mayo , and egg
4. Mix well
5. Fill the greased muffin tins 1 / 4-1 / 2 full and bake for 12-25 minutes at 350 until they are golden-brown on the outside and a toothpick comes out clean
6. Serve with butter or jam

title: singapore chile crabs
steps:
1. Blend garlic , ginger , dried chile , dried shrimp in a blender to form a smooth paste
2. Stir-fry the paste in 30 tbsp of hot corn oil til fragrant
3. Transfer to a deep bowl
4. Clean crabs and cut each into 4-6 pieces
5. Crack the claws with a pestle
6. Stir-fy 10 tsp of minced garlic in 20 tbsp of hot corn oil till fragrant
7. Add crabs and stir-fry for about 10 minute
8. Cover and cook for another minute
9. Uncover and stir briskly once more
10. Add in 1 / 2 cup of water , light soya sauce and 20 tbsp of the paste
11. Stir well and cover for 10 minutes
12. Thicken the gravy with 10 tbsp of cornflour solution
13. Whip egg and stir into the chilli crabs and bring to a boil
14. Serve with rice or bread

title: sexy greek   cocktail
steps:
1. Just mix together ouzo and orange juice and pour over ice in a collins glass
2. Garnish with an orange slice and get friendly

title: make ahead meatballs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Spray a broiler pan with pam
3. Heat a sillet over medium high heat and add oil
4. Add the onion and cook onion in the oil until softened
5. Stir in garlic and cook another minute
6. In a bowl combine ground beef , onion mixture , and spices
7. Stir in egg
8. For into 1-inch meatballs and place on broiler pand and bake for 10 minutes or until meatballs are fully cooked
9. Freeze meatballs on cookie sheet and then place in an airtight container until ready to use

title: ranchburger meatballs   rice
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients and shape into meatballs
2. Brown in oil
3. Drain
4. Add envelope of onion soup mix and 1 c
5. Water
6. Simmer 45 minutes
7. If needed , thicken with tablespoon of flour and 1 t
8. Water , mixed together
9. Serve over rice

title: easy   delicious orange slice cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Stir all ingredients together until well-blended
3. Drop by tablespoon onto ungreased baking sheets
4. Bake for 8-10 minutes or until edges begin to brown
5. Remove from oven and transfer to wire racks to cool
6. Enjoy ! :)

title: new england fish chowder
steps:
1. Heat a 4- to 6-quart heavy pot over low heat and add the diced salt pork
2. Once it has rendered a few tablespoons of fat , increase the heat to medium and cook until the pork is a crisp golden brown
3. Use a slotted spoon to transfer the cracklings to a small ovenproof dish , leaving the fat in the pot , and reserve until later
4. Add the butter , onions , savory or thyme , and bay leaves to the pot and saut , stirring occasionally with a wooden spoon , for about 8 minutes , until the onions and softened but not browned
5. Add the potatoes and stock
6. If the stock doesnt cover the potatoes , add just enough water to cover them
7. Turn up the heat and bring to a boil , cover , and cook the potatoes vigorously for about 10 minutes , until they are soft on the outside but still firm in the center
8. If the stock hasn4hickened lightly , smash a few of the potato slices against the side of the pot and cook for a minute or two longer to release their starch
9. Reduce the heat to low and season assertively with salt and pepper
10. Add the fish fillets and cook over low heat for 5 minutes , then remove the pot from the heat and allow the chowder to sit for 10 minutes
11. Gently stir in the cream and taste for salt and pepper
12. If you are not serving the chowder within the hour , let it cool a bit , then refrigerate
13. Cover the chowder after it has chilled completely
14. Otherwise , let it sit for up to an hour at room temperature , allowing the flavors to meld
15. When ready to serve , reheat the chowder over low heat
16. Don , et it boil
17. Warm the cracklings in a low oven for a few minutes
18. Use a slotted spoon to mound the chunks of fish , the onions , and potatoes in the center of large soup plates or shallow bowls , and ladle the creamy broth around
19. Scatter the cracklings over the individual servings and finish each with a sprinkling of chopped parsley and minced chives

title: john s cucumber sweet onion salad with lime pepper dressing
steps:
1. Run a fork down the cucumbers , all over , making slight indentations
2. Cut the cucumber in half , lengthwise
3. Scoop out all the seeds
4. Cut the cucumber halves into 1 / 8" strips
5. Peel the onion and cut lengthwise into quarters
6. Slice the quarters crosswise into thin strips
7. In a large bowl , combine cucumber and onions with lime juice , salt and sugar
8. Toss well
9. Add hot pepper flakes , olive oil , vinegar and water , toss well
10. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours

title: mini milk chocolate sandwich cookies
steps:
1. For the cookies: mix together the flour , baking powder , and salt
2. In a small pan , heat chocolate over low heat to melt , stirring constantly , let cool slightly
3. Cream butter using an electric mixer , then beat in sugar until fluffy
4. Beat in the melted chocolate , the vanilla , and the egg until well combined
5. Using a wooden spoon , stir in the flour mixture until combined
6. Divide dough into 4 balls , wrap in plastic wrap andpop into the freezer for 30 minutes
7. Preheat the oven to 350f and have ready parchment paper-lined baking sheets
8. Shape one ball of dough at a time into a 10" long rope on wax paper
9. Cut off 1 / 4" thick rounds , place rounds 1" apart on the baking sheets and bake 9-10 minutes per batch
10. Carefully remove to wire racks to cool
11. To prepare filling , melt chocolate and butter over low heat in a small pan , stirring often
12. Cool 5 minutes , then add the sour cream and stir to combine
13. Gradually add the powdered sugar , stirring until mixture is spreadable
14. Spread 1 / 2 tsp of the filling on a cooled cookie , then top with another cookie , making a sandwich

title: the bomb  pumpkin soup
steps:
1. Melt butter in large , leavy pot over medium-high heat
2. Add carrots and next 6 ingredients and saut until vegetables are softened , about 10 minutes
3. Discard bay leaf
4. Transfer mixture to processor and blend until smooth
5. Return mixture to pot
6. Add stock and all remaining ingredients
7. Boil soup over medium-high head to blend flavours , about 15 minutes
8. Cool slightly
9. Working in batches , puree soup in blender until smooth
10. Return soup to pot
11. Season to taste with salt and pepper
12. Bring soup to simmer
13. Divide among serving bowls , and sprinkle with roasted pumpkin seeds that have been hulled or roasted peanuts
14. This is so very yummy !

title: decadent chocolate frosting or mousse  vegan
steps:
1. Line a sieve with paper towels and place the tofu inside
2. Pull the paper towels up to cover the tofu and place a can or other heavy object on top
3. Drain for 15 minutes
4. Blend the tofu in a food processor until smooth
5. Melt the chocolate chips in a microwave or double boiler
6. Add the chocolate , vanilla , and salt to the tofu in the food processor
7. Process until creamy , scraping the sides once or twice
8. Transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate for an hour or until set

title: devil s steak
steps:
1. Cut meat into small pieces
2. Trim all fat and membranes from pieces
3. Pound each piece until 1 / 4-inch or less
4. Mix mustard and spices and dredge meat on both sides in mixture
5. Have large frying pan medium hot with oil
6. Fry a few pices at a time 1 to 1 / 12 minutes on each side , until golden brown
7. Keep warm
8. Drain mushrooms , reserving liquid , set aside
9. Add mushroom liquid and worcestershire sauce to pan
10. Simmer and scrape off pan drippings
11. Add mushrooms and wine to liquid , heat , you may thicken the liquid with flour or cornstarch if desired , and serve over meat
12. Refrigerate in single layers or dry slightly before dredging as this will make it brown more quickly

title: royal orchid noodle salad
steps:
1. Mix the dressing ingredients together in jar and shake
2. In large bowl , combine noodles , bell pepper , green onions , snow peas , water chestnuts , shrimp and pork or chicken
3. Add dressing and toss well
4. Refrigerate for 30 minutes before serving
5. Sprinkle sesame seeds on top before serving

title: turkey and mandarin orange rolls
steps:
1. In bowl , mix cream cheese , oranges and red pepper
2. Layer each of the tortillas with a quarter of all the ingredients , leaving a 1-2 inch strip around edges without toppings
3. First spread cream cheese mix on tortillas , sprinkle with green onions , then layer with turkey and spinach leaves
4. Roll tightly
5. Slice ends off and discard , and then slice each tortilla in 6 pieces
6. Refrigerate for up to 8 hours before eating

title: refrigerator pickled zucchini ribbons
steps:
1. Combine first nine ingredients in a medium saucepan
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered 15 minutes
4. Combine zucchini and onion in a large bowl and pour hot vinegar mixture over vegetables
5. Cover and let stand at room temperature for 3 hours
6. Refrigerate for a minimum of 8 hours before using
7. Store covered in refrigerator for up to 4 weeks

title: underground chicken stew
steps:
1. Brown chicken on all sides in a non-stick skillet
2. Put into slow cooker , along with all other ingredients except cabbage
3. Cook on low for 6 hours or so , until vegetables are tender
4. Add cabbage and cook on low until softened to your liking

title: breakfast mock cinnabon  low carb
steps:
1. Combine cottage cheese and sugar substitute
2. Sprinkle with cinnamon and top with pecan halves

title: white chocolate chunk  almond cookies
steps:
1. With an electric mixer cream the butter & sugar in a large bowl
2. Add the eggs one at a time until well blended
3. Add the almond extract
4. In a separate bowl combine the flour , baking soda , & salt
5. Gradually beat flour mixture into the butter mixture until well blended
6. Stir in white chocolate chips & almonds
7. Drop cookies in heaping tablespoonfuls about 1-inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet & bake at 375 degrees for 10 minutes or until cookies are lightly browned
8. Let cookies cool on cookie sheet for 2 minutes then transfer them to a wire rack to cool completely
9. These cookies freeze well

title: garlic and herb tomatoes
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a saute pan large enough to hold all the tomatoes in one layer
2. Add the garlic to the oil and cook over medium heat for 30 seconds
3. Add the tomatoes , basil , parsley , thyme , salt , and pepper
4. Reduce the heat to low and cook for 5 to 7 minutes , tossing occasionally , until the tomatoes begin to loose their firm round shape
5. Sprinkle with a little fresh chopped basil and parsley and serve hot or at room temperature

title: slow cooker braised provencal short ribs
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan set at medium high heat , saute the onions , carrots and garlic in one tablespoons olive oil until soft
2. Transfer to a slow cooker
3. Add remaining olive oil to the skillet and brown the ribs on both sides
4. Place the ribs in the slow cooker
5. Add the 1 can of plum tomatoes into the slow cooker
6. In a small bowl , stir together the broth , wine , flour , thyme , and bay leaf
7. Pour into the hot skillet , stir to scrape up any brown bits from the bottom and then pour into the slow cooker , cover and cook on high for 5 hours or until ribs are very tender
8. Discard the bay leaf
9. Serve with rice or mashed potatoes

title: family favorite taco salad
steps:
1. Brown ground beef and drain off any grease
2. Meanwhile , in very large salad bowl combine salad , tomatoes , green onions and kidney beans
3. Toss well
4. Add slightly cooled beef and catalina dressing
5. Mix well
6. Add cheese and toss again
7. Lightly smash chips and add to salad
8. Toss and serve immediately

title: hash browns cheese omelet
steps:
1. In a large skillet coated with non-stick cooking spray , saute onions and green pepper
2. Add potatoes and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes
3. Beat thoroughly in a bowl the egg substitute , water and pepper
4. Pour over vegetables in skillet
5. As egg sets , lift edges , letting uncooked portion flow underneath
6. Just before eggs are completely set , place cheese slices over half of the omelet
7. Fold in half and transfer to a warm serving platter

title: korean seasoned spinach
steps:
1. Remove roots from spinach and wash well
2. I soak in a solution of vinegar and water and then rinse
3. In bowl , combine soy sauce , sugar , sesame seeds , sesame oil , and green onions
4. In a large pot bring water to boil
5. Add spinach and immerse only until leaves turn bright green
6. Do not over boil
7. Spinach will not taste right
8. Drain and rinse with cold water
9. Squeeze out as much water as possible
10. Add the spinach to the sauce and mix well
11. This can be served warm or even refrigerated for another time

title: jicama mango salad with mozzarella   chilies
steps:
1. In a bowl whisk together the sugar and lime juice until sugar disolves
2. Slowly pour in the oil as you continue whisking in a large bowl mix remaining ingredients , toss pour oil mixture over& toss- the salad may rest in the fridge for a couple of hours divide salad among 6-8 plates , decorate with a sprig of cilantro& serve

title: gondi  iranian meatballs
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients together
2. Form balls
3. Cook in boiling water or chicken soup for 45 minutes

title: banana bread latte
steps:
1. Combine in a warm mug and stir
2. Top with whipped cream
3. Dust with cinnamon and sprinkle with chopped walnuts

title: mom s fresh apple cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease and flour a 13x9 baking pan
3. In a large bowl , blend together the sugar , eggs , oil and vanilla
4. Blend the dry ingredients into the sugar mixture
5. Stir in chopped apples
6. Pour into prepared pan
7. Bake for about 45 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
8. Serve warm with butter or cooled with whipped cream

title: berry barbecue sauce
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil
2. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes
3. Use to brush on any chicken or meat when it is 15 minutes from completion of cook time

title: candied dill pickles
steps:
1. Drain pickles discarding liquid
2. Cut the pickles into 1 / 4-inch slices
3. Place cut pickles back into the jar
4. Tie the pickling spices into a piece of muslin and place into the jar
5. Heat vinegar and sugar just until sugar dissolves
6. Pour over pickles
7. Refrigerate pickles for four days , shaking the jar each day
8. At the end of one week , remove the bag of spices
9. Pickles are ready to use after four days and keep indefinitely in the refrigerator

title: chicken in cream sauce  volaille a la crme
steps:
1. Season the chicken with the salt and pepper
2. In a large dutch oven over high heat , saut the chicken in the butter , turning once , until it is brown
3. The process will take about 3-4 minutes for each side
4. Transfer the chicken to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm
5. Turn the heat to medium and saut the onions for 5 minutes
6. Add the mushrooms , shallots , and sugar to the pan
7. Saut the mixture for 6-8 minutes , until the shallots turn soft and the mixture is caramelized
8. Transfer the vegetables to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm
9. Turn the heat to high , and deglaze the dutch oven by bring the white wine to a simmer , scraping the browned bits from the bottom of the pan
10. Add the chicken stock , browned chicken , and thyme to the wine , cover , and lower the heat to low-medium
11. Braise the chicken for 10 minutes
12. Turn the heat to medium high , add the crme fraiche to the dutch oven , and simmer , uncovered , for an additional 10 minutes
13. The dish is ready when the sauce has reduced and thickened and the chicken is cooked through
14. Serve it hot with the caramelized vegetable garnish

title: portobello porcini cacciatore vegetarian
steps:
1. Place the dried mushrooms in a pot and cover with a couple of cups of water , bring to a boil over medium heat , then reduce heat and simmer until the mushrooms soften
2. Meanwhile , in a dutch oven heat the extra-virgin olive oil over medium high heat
3. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook , stirring occasionally , until dark and tender , 12 to 15 minutes
4. Add the thyme , chile , garlic , peppers and onions and season with salt and pepper , to taste
5. Cook for 8 to 10 minutes , then add the wine and stir
6. Remove the reconstituted mushrooms from the liquid , chop and then add them to the pot
7. Pour in all but last the few spoonfuls of the mushroom liquid stock into sauce pot , the grit will settle at the bottom of the pan
8. Stir in the tomatoes , breaking them up with a spoon then add the basil leaves and simmer the sauce 20 minutes
9. Cool and store for a make-ahead meal and reheat over medium flame , stirring occasionally
10. Boil a large pot of water to a boil over medium heat
11. Add the pasta and cook until al dente , about 8-9 minutes
12. Drain the pasta and return it to the hot pot
13. Add the butter and stir to melt
14. Pour in half of the sauce and toss
15. Serve in shallow bowls with more mushroom cacciatore on top
16. Garnish with lots of grated romano
17. Enjoy !

title: scrumptious vegan chocolate maple cookies recipe
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degres
2. Put white flour , wheat flour , chocolate powder , baking soda , baking powder and salt into food processor
3. Whir til mixed
4. Put maple syrup , jam , veg oil , and vanilla into food processor with the flour mix , and process til mixed
5. Stir in pecans and chips with a spoon
6. Spray oil on baking sheets to lightly mist surface , and drop teaspoonfuls of batter onto tray , about 15 cookies per tray
7. Bake each tray for 10 minutes
8. Should make about 45 cookies
9. Enjoy !

title: wilted spinach and cherry tomatoes
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat the olive oil over medium heat
2. Add the spinach and cook , tossing often , just until wilted , about 2-3 minute
3. Stir in the tomatoes and vinegar
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Serve immediately

title: chicken casablanca
steps:
1. Saute onions , ginger , and garlic in oil in skillet
2. , and transfer to a slow cooker
3. Add carrots , and potatoes
4. Brown chicken over medium heat in reserved oil , and transfer to slow cooker
5. Mix gently with vegetables
6. Combine seasonings in a seperate bowl , and sprinkle over chicken and vegetables
7. Add`raisins , and tomatoes
8. Cover , and cook on high for 4-6 hours
9. Add sliced zucchini , beans , and parsley 30 minutes before serving

title: thai chicken
steps:
1. Place chicken in crock pot
2. Mix remaining ingredients except peanuts and cilantro
3. Pour over chicken
4. Cover and cook on low heat setting 8 to 9 hours or until juice of chicken is no longer pink in the thickest places
5. My crock pot usually does the job in about 6 hours
6. Remove chicken from pot and using a slotted spoon , place on serving platter
7. Remove fat from sauce
8. Pour remaining sauce over chicken
9. Sprinkle with peanuts and cilantro

title: twice baked  potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 500 degrees
2. Microwave potatoes on high for 10 minutes , to speed up cooking time
3. This can come in handy , especially on a hot summer day
4. They can also be completely cooking in the microwave
5. Then , bake in oven until tender , about 30 minutes
6. When done , cut 1 / 3 of top off each potato
7. Scoop flesh from potatoes , being careful not to pierce the sking , into a medium bowl
8. Reserve shells
9. Add cream cheese , sour cream and butter to potato flesh
10. Beat potato mixture with an electric mixer set at medium speed until smooth and creamy , about 3 minutes
11. Add onion salt , salt , and pepper , stir
12. Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees
13. Spoon potato mixture into potato shells
14. Sprinkle with cheddar
15. Bake until cheese melts and potatoes are heated through , about 15 minutes
16. The hard part comes into play here - enjoy !

title: inspired vegetable stew
steps:
1. In a large soup pan , brown the onions in the olive oil , if they start to burn add a splah of water
2. Cook them until lovely and caramelised
3. Add the mustard , thyme and garlic and fry for a further few minutes
4. Do not burn the garlic
5. Add the carrots , turnip to the pot and fill with water
6. Bring to the boil , add the vegetable boullian , marmite , bay leaves and cayenne pepper
7. Cover and allow to simmer heavily for about 45 minutes until the turnip is soft and the broth has reduced
8. Add the leeks and potatoes and cook until the potatoes are well cooked and the stew has taken on all the flavours
9. Usually about 20 to 30 minutes
10. Add the turmeric and balsamic vinegar and cook for a further 10 minutes
11. Season to taste

title: southern lemon chess pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. In small bowl , beat egg whites until stiff
3. Set aside
4. In large bowl , cream together sugar , cornmeal , lemon juice , butter and egg yolks for 5 minutes or more until creamy
5. Gently fold beaten egg whites into this lemon mixture
6. Gently pour filling into pie crust
7. Bake about 15 minutes or until top of pie begins to brown
8. Reduce oven temperature to 300 degrees and bake an additional 25 to 30 minutes or more until pie is just set in the middle
9. It should be a little jiggly , not runny , in the middle
10. Remove from oven and cool
11. It can be refrigerated , but is best served at room temperature
12. Covered , this pie will keep unrefrigerated for up to 4 days

title: country lane pork chops casserole
steps:
1. Season pork chops with salt and pepper
2. Brown in heavy skillet , remove and keep warm
3. Combine applesauce , raisins , salt , spices in skillet and simmer 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Meanwhile , cook noodles in boiling salted water until tender
5. Drain
6. Add fruit mixture to noodles
7. Mixing well
8. Arrange noodles in a large greased 2 quart casserole
9. Top with browned chops , cover and bake at 325f for 45 minutes to 1 hour , or until chops are tender

title: brown rice in the rice cooker
steps:
1. Spray your rice cooker pot with a non-stick cooking spray
2. This works wonders at keeping your rice from sticking and burning
3. Add your brown rice and water
4. While the typical rice-to-water ratio for white rice is one part rice to two parts water , brown rice works better if you go with one part rice to two and a half parts water
5. Add salt to taste
6. On a cutting board , press the flat edge of a knife on the cloves of garlic to squash them
7. Remove and discard the papery skin and drop the smashed cloves into the cooker
8. Add olive oil
9. Cover the pot and turn on the cooker
10. Expect brown rice to take a little longer to cook than white rice

title: turkey burgers my way
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl
2. Heat a skillet to medium high
3. Make burgers with your hands and place on skillet
4. Cook on each side for about 5 minutes each until done
5. I serve mine plain jane on bread with mayo and ketchup on one slice and mustard on the other
6. Yummo !

title: mango chicken stir fry
steps:
1. Placed chicken brother and next 4 ingredients in a small bowl and stir to combine and set aside
2. Spray wok with non stick spray or a few drops of oil , preheated over medium heat
3. Add onion and garlic and stir fry for 3 minutes or until slightly tender
4. Remove from wok and set aside
5. Add oil & add chicken and stir fry until no longer pink
6. Push chicken to one side of the pan and stir the sauce and pour in to the center of the wok
7. Cook , stirring until bubbling and thick
8. Return onion and garlic back to the wok , add the mango
9. Stir to coat all ingredients , cook for an additional 2 minutes or until thoroughly heated
10. Serve with rice
11. Garnish with pieces of citrus peels , if desired !

title: caramel roasted pineapple
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f
2. Cut the pineapple in half lengthwise , then half each piece so you have quartered the pineapple lengthwise
3. Add sugar , water , cinnamon , cloves , and star anise to a medium skillet with ovenproof handles
4. Bring to a boil over medium high heat
5. Boil until syrup starts to caramelize , about 5 to 8 minutes
6. The caramelized syrup is very hot
7. Carefully and slowly add the orange juice and pineapple so the syrup doesnt splatter
8. Transfer to the oven and roast for 10 minutes , turning at the half waypoint
9. Let cool to room temperature before slicing
10. Slice the pineapple thinly and arrange it on a platter in a decorative pattern
11. Drizzle lemon juice and sprinkle with mint

title: southwestern braised beef
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine the chili powder , cumin , coriander , oregano , ancho chili powder , allspice and cinnamon
2. Stir in 2 tablespoons of the oil to make a paste
3. Set aside
4. In a dutch oven or large saucepan , heat the remaining oil over medium-high heat
5. Brown the beef in batches
6. Remove to a plate and drain the fat from the pan
7. Fry the onions and garlic over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until golden , about 5 minutes
8. Add the chili powder mixture and fry until fragrant , about 30 seconds
9. Add the beef and stir for about 1 minute
10. Add the beans , 2 cups of water , tomatoes , salt and sugar
11. Bring to a boil
12. Reduce the heat , cover and simmer for 1 hour
13. Uncover and simmer until slightly thickened and the meat is tender , about 30 minutes

title: fresh minnesotan coleslaw
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl until well saturated throughout
2. Cover with plastic wrap and chill 3-5 hours or overnight
3. Toss once more before serving
4. Enjoy !

title: light fettuccine carbonara
steps:
1. Slice bacon into 1 inch long and 1 / 4inch thick strips
2. In a medium skillet , cook the bacon over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until light brown
3. Transfer to a plate and set aside
4. In a blender process the cottage cheese , milk , egg substitute and salt until smooth
5. In a large pot of salted boiling water , cook the pasta until just barely tender
6. Drain well and return to the pot
7. Add the cheese mixture , bacon and pepper to the pasta and cook over med-low heat , stirring continually until sauce is heated through--do not boil--about 1 minute
8. Transfer to a warmed serving bowl , and serve immediately , sprinkling with the parmesan cheese

title: shrimp and cream cheese soup
steps:
1. In a heavy 5-quart soup pot , slowly melt the cream cheese and butter over low heat
2. Then add the green onions and gently simmer them for about 10-12 minutes
3. Next , stir in the potato soup and both cans of corn and continue the simmering process for an additional 15 minutes
4. Then begin stirring in the milk in order to reach the desired consistency--start off with a half of cup , then add more if you desire
5. At this point the soup should be nice and thick , having the texture of light pancake batter
6. Finally , just before you are ready to eat , fold in the shrimp , stir in the seafood seasoning , and heat pot to hot and bubbly

title: those pretzel things   pecan rollo bites
steps:
1. Place pretzel pieces on a baking sheet
2. Top with one rollo candy
3. Place in a warm oven to just let the rollo candy melt on top of the pretzel to hold it in place
4. Remove from oven and place a pecan piece on top
5. Let cool and harden

title: peach almond cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In mixing bowl , blend flour , 3 / 4 cup sugar , baking powder , baking soda and salt
3. In another bowl , beat eggs , yogurt , melted butter , and almond extract until smooth
4. Stir into dry ingredients to make smooth , thick batter
5. Spoon batter into greased 9-inch springform pan or other round cake pan
6. Arrange peach slices on top in circular fashion
7. In small bowl , combine almond slices , 2 tablespoons sugar , and cinnamon
8. Sprinkle over peaches
9. Bake in preheated 350f oven 45 to 50 minutes or until done
10. This recipe also works well using 1 / 2 sugar and 1 / 2 splenda

title: fattoush salad
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Arrange torn up pieces of pita bread on baking pan and toast for 5 minutes
3. While pitas toast , cut up cucumber , bell pepper , celery , red onion , tomatoes , olives , and hot peppers into bite-sized pieces
4. Through all veggies into a big bowl and add garlic , parsley , and feta cheese to the pile
5. Squeeze the lemons to spread juice over entire bowl
6. Drizzle the 2 tablespoons of extra-virgin olive oil onto salad
7. Toss the salad in bowl to coat everything !
8. Add the toasted pita pieces to the salad and toss everything again !
9. Suggest pairing with the mediterranean burgers for a healthy dinner !

title: mascarpone mini cupcakes with strawberry glaze
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Line 4 mini muffin tins with paper liners
3. In a large bowl , combine the mascarpone , egg whites , & vegetable oil
4. Using a hand mixer , beat the ingredients until combined and creamy
5. Add the cake mix and 1 cup water and mix until smooth
6. Fill the muffin liners to just below the rim and bake until puffed and golden , 18-20 minutes
7. Remove from the oven , let cool slightly in the tins , then transfer the cupcakes to a wire rack to cool completely
8. Meanwhile , puree the strawberries in a blender or food processor
9. Place the confectioners sugar in a medium bowl
10. Pour in the strawberry puree and whisk until smooth
11. Dip the tops of the cooled cupcakes into the strawberry glaze
12. Let the cupcakes sit for a few minutes for the glaze to firm up
13. Serve and enjoy the compliments

title: salmon trilogy  part i   potato baked salmon
steps:
1. For fish: grease form
2. If necessary , cut fish into large pieces so that fish can be evenly put into casserole form
3. Salt and pepper to taste
4. Sprinkle 2 tbs parsley over salmon
5. Set aside
6. Preheat oven to 375 f
7. For onions: cook chopped onions in olive oil until soft
8. Peel and cook potatoes in salted water for about 20 minutes until tender
9. Drain and mash potatoes
10. Add olive oil and add so much of the milk to have a spreadable consistency
11. Add onions , garlic and nutmeg
12. Salt to taste
13. Spread potatoes over fish
14. Mix bread crumbs and parmesan
15. Add enough olive oil to moisten the crumbs
16. Sprinkle over the potatoes
17. Bake in the middle of the oven for about 20 minutes until crust is golden brown
18. If it is getting to brown , cover it with aluminium foil
19. Directly before serving sprinkle with chopped parsley
20. Serve immediately

title: jamaican golden split pea soup
steps:
1. Bring the broth and split peas to a boil in a large pot over med-high heat
2. Cover , reduce the heat to a simmer and cook until the peas are soft , about 45 minutes
3. Add all remaining ingredients
4. Cover and cook over medium-low heat until the vegetables are tender , about 45 minutes
5. Pick out and discard the thyme
6. Puree the soup in batches in a food mill , food processor or blender
7. Taste and adjust the seasonings with additional allspice , salt and pepper if needed
8. This soup can be refrigerated for up to 5 days or frozen for several weeks
9. Stir well after reheating

title: lobster salad with curried mango dressing
steps:
1. Place first 5 ingredients in blender
2. Blend until smooth --
3. Stir in chives and shallots
4. Season to taste with salt and white pepper
5. Can be prepared 1 day ahead
6. Cover and refrigerate
7. Bring heavy large saucepan of water to boil
8. Add beans and cook until tender , about 4 minutes
9. Using slotted spoon , transfer to bowl of cold water
10. Drain
11. Repeat process with asparagus
12. Cut asparagus , beans , bell pepper , greens and cilantro in large bowl
13. Drizzle some dressing over and toss lightly
14. Season with salt and white pepper to taste
15. Arrange salad on plates
16. Fan lobster decoratively
17. Garnish with tomatoes and drizzle remaining dressing over

title: mini stuffed pizza balls
steps:
1. Prepare all your fillings -- i just make sure everything is diced fine
2. Pizza -- on a floured counter top or you can use corn meal roll out the dough in a large rectangle , about 12"x10"
3. Then cut in 24 squares
4. Top each square with some of the filling and some of the cheese and then just pick up each square and enclose the dough around the filling and roll lightly into a ball
5. Baking -- place the pizza balls seam side down in a pie dish sprayed well with pam
6. Don't worry about them being right next to one another
7. When they are finished , you can pull them about like "cinnimon rolls
8. " i think i got 12 in each pie plate
9. Topping -- mix the olive oil with the garlic and dried seasoning and brush over the pizza balls and then top with a light dusting of the parmesan cheese
10. Bake -- 15-20 minutes at 400 degrees
11. I just follow the directions for my pizza dough , usually 4 , 00 for about 15-20 minutes
12. They will be golden brown , crusty and just serve with marinara
13. They are small bite size tear away pizza balls which are just great
14. And like i said , fillings are whatever you like
15. I like pepperoni , onion , green pepper and mozzarella , but you can use anything , ham mushroom and swiss would be great , sausage , onion , sundried tomatoes , you name it
16. Just make sure the filling are already pre cooked
17. Marinara -- heat up the marinara in a small bowl just in the microwave and serve with the pizza

title: mixed tempura
steps:
1. Peel and devein the prawns , leaving the tails intact
2. Cut a slit in the underside of each prawn
3. Sift the flour into a bowl , make a well in the center and add the iced water and egg yolk
4. Stir with chopsticks until just combined
5. The batter should be slightly lumpy
6. Fill a deep heavy-based pan one third full of oil and heat to 350 degrees f , or until a cube of bread dropped into the oil turns golden in 15 seconds
7. Dip the prawns in flour to coat , shake off any excess , then dip in the batter
8. Cook the prawns in batches until crisp and light golden
9. Drain on crumpled paper towels
10. Repeat with the vegetables
11. Serve the tempura immediately with tempura dipping sauce or soy sauce
12. Be sure that the water is ice cold as this helps to lighten the batter
13. If you are unsure , add a few ice cubes
14. If you use plain flour , add a little extra water to help thin the batter

title: citrus cumin salad dressing
steps:
1. Mince garlic and mash to a paste with 1 / 4 tsp salt , then whisk together with orange and lime juices , shallot , honey cumin and remaining 1 / 4 tsp salt
2. Add oil in a slow stream , whisking until well blended
3. Whisk in pepper

title: oatmeal bars
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugars together
2. Mix in the eggs and vanilla
3. Combine the flour , salt , cinnamon & baking soda
4. Mix into creamed mixture
5. Stir in the oatmeal
6. Press into 9x13 " ungreased pan and cook @350 for 30-35 minute

title: stuffed pizza bites
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400
2. Spray 13x9 pan with non-stick cooking spray
3. Remove dough from cans and unroll
4. Press out each dough rectangle to form 12x8 rectangle
5. Cut each rectangle into 24 squares
6. Top each square with cheese cube and pepperoni
7. Wrap dough around filling completely
8. Press edges to seal and place seam side down with sides touching in pan
9. Combine oil and seasoning in a small bowl and drizzle over dough in pans
10. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese
11. Bake at 400 for 15 to 25 minutes or until golden brown
12. Serve with warm pizza sauce

title: chunky apple spice cake with vanilla butter sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f degrees
2. Beat butter and brown sugar for 5 minutes in a mixer bowl
3. Beat in eggs and vanilla just until blended
4. Set aside
5. Mix flour , pumpkin pie spice , baking powder , allspice and salt
6. Gradually add to sugar mixture
7. Beating until well blended
8. Stir in apples , nuts , and raisins , if desired
9. Pour into one greased 9-inch baking pan
10. Bake 35-40 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
11. Cool on wire rack 10 minutes
12. Serve warm with vanilla butter sauce
13. Vanilla butter sauce:
14. Combine butter and whipping cream with brown sugar
15. Bring to boil over medium heat
16. Reduce heat
17. Simmer 10 minutes or until slightly thickened
18. Remove from heat
19. Stir in vanilla
20. Serve warm
21. Do-ahead suggestion: the cake and sauce can be prepared and refrigerated separately the day before
22. Warm the cake , in the oven , and the sauce , on top of the stove , before serving

title: coconut red curry soup with butternut squash and lime
steps:
1. Peel squash with a vegetable peeler , halve and scoop out the seeds , then dice into 1 / 2-inch cubes
2. You should have 3-4 cups
3. Warm oil in wide soup pot
4. Add onion , squash , garlic , ginger , lime zest , and turmeric
5. Cook over medium-high heat , stirring frequently , for 15 minutes
6. Add chili paste
7. Add 1 / 2 cup water and scrape pot to dilute paste , then add broth and 1 / 2 tsp salt
8. Bring to boil , then reduce heat to low , cover pot , and simmer for 20 minutes
9. Meanwhile , dice tofu into small cubes and prepare cilantro and basil
10. Add coconut milk , followed by tofu
11. Simmer until soup is hot again and tofu is heated , about 5 minutes
12. Taste for salt , and add more if desired
13. Add cilantro and basil , and squeeze juice from lime
14. Serve immediately

title: ginger pork with peanuts elephant walk
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and fry the garlic and shallots until crisp and brown but not burned , about 30 seconds
2. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside
3. In the same pan , brown the pork , breaking it apart as it cooks , about 3 minutes
4. Stir in the tamarind juice , sugar and salt
5. Stir in the fried garlic and shallots and the ginger
6. Lower the heat to medium and cook for 3 minutes more , or until the liquid has almost evaporated
7. Stir in the peanuts
8. Remove from the heat and set aside
9. If you want to make little packets , dip the spinach leaves in boiling water to blanch and lay out on a towel to drain
10. Place a teaspoonful of the pork mixture in the center of each leaf , and fold over both sides of the leaf and then fold the top and bottom over
11. Arrange seam side down on a platter
12. If you decide to forgo the packets , put the pork mixture in a serving bowl and garnish with cilantro and red peppers
13. Serve warm or at room temperature with crispy rice

title: pat preaw waan
steps:
1. Cut chicken , vegetables , and pineapple into mouth sized pieces
2. Pour oil in a work , fry garlic until it becomes golden color
3. Add sliced chicken and stir , then add oyster sauce , fish sauce , sugar and stir contantly
4. Pour pineapple , cucumber , tomatoes , large onion and baby corn in the wok then add tomato sauce
5. Stir until fresh vegetable are all dente , add spring onion
6. Flavour to taste and serve with rice

title: cabbage jambayala
steps:
1. In large stock pot over medium high heat cook beef , sausage , celery , onion , and garlic until beef is no longer pink
2. Add cabbage , water , stewed tomatoes , and rice
3. Bring to a boil , reduce heat to low
4. Cover and simmer 35 to 40 minutes or until rice is done

title: tangy texas bbq brisket
steps:
1. Combine first 6 ingredients , garlic salt through liquid smoke
2. Rub brisket in spice mixture and put in a greased baking dish
3. Cover dish and refrigerate overnight
4. Preheat oven to 275 degrees
5. Bring brisket to room temperature and pour 1 / 3 cup of worcestershire sauce over brisket
6. Wrap in foil and cook about 4 hours at 275 degrees
7. Pour barbeque sauce over brisket and cook for 1 more hour

title: lemony garlic butter
steps:
1. Let butter soften to room temperature
2. Beat in other ingredients
3. Pack butter into molds or crocks or form balls with a melon baller
4. Chill for at least 3 hours before serving
5. Can be stored for upto 1 month in the refrigerator or 3 months in the freezer

title: pesto and goat cheese quesadillas
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a skillet over med / med high heat
2. Meanwhile , spread one side of one tortilla with goat cheese
3. Spread one side of the other tortilla with pesto
4. Sandwich tortillas together with the filling on the inside
5. When oil is hot , add the quesadilla to the pan
6. Cook until the bottom side is crispy and golden brown
7. Flip quesadilla and continue cooking on the remaining side
8. If necessary , you may add a splash more olive oil at this step
9. When quesadilla is golden brown and crispy on both sides , remove from pan and drain on a paper towel
10. Slice into 6-8 servings and serve hot

title: super  veggie salad with creamy almond dressing
steps:
1. Dressing:
2. Place the almonds and water into a blender or food proccesor and turn on high speed to pure
3. Add remaining ingredients , except for oil , and run to blend and whip thoroughly
4. With the motor running , slowly pour in oil and run until the dressing is thick and creamy
5. As stated in the description , you may use 3 / 4 cup oil and 1 / 4 cup water or apple juice and get a little thinner dressing
6. Let sit for a few minutes to thicken up
7. Salad:
8. Put 1 / 2 cup of the dressing in the bottom of your salad bowl
9. Add all ingredients , except lettuce , and toss to coat
10. Serve:
11. Put several lettuce leaves on each plate and add dressed salad
12. Serve extra dressing on the side
13. Enjoy !

title: persian basmati rice
steps:
1. For a perfect rice , place your rice in a colander or a large pot and rinse it in cold water at least 3 times- using your hand to swish the rice about
2. Place the colander in a bowl of cold water , enough to cover the rice and allow it to set for 30 minutes
3. This will rid the rice of the extra starch that rubs off in the packaging and makes your rice stick together
4. It also reduces the cooking time
5. Place the chicken stock in a pot with a tight fitting lid
6. Add in all of your spices and olive oil
7. Set aside the almonds , tomatoes and scallions for later
8. Stir well to combine
9. Drain all the water you can off the rice , add to chicken stock mixture
10. Cover and bring the rice to a full boil
11. From here on , do not remove the lid ! reduce heat to a low simmer until all the liquid has been absorbed
12. This can take 10 to 15 minutes
13. Do not remove the lid ! turn off the heat and drape the pot / lid with a towel and allow to sit for 15 minutes
14. After 15 minutes , remove the towel and the lid
15. Add in the almonds , tomatoes , peas and scallions
16. Taste for seasoning and do not be afraid to add more salt , advieh and / or koubideh spice
17. The amount you add will depend on your taste
18. Very gently fold everything into the rice and cover until serving time
19. This rice is fantastic served at room temperature and it is great for potlucks , picnics and get togethers
20. Since this dish contains no meat , you can safely allow it to cool to room temperature , cover tightly and leave on your counter top over night
21. So , this dish can be made the day before an event , as i have done so many , many times
22. The key is let it reach room temperature before covering it

title: texas signature steak rub
steps:
1. Thoroghly mix all ingredients
2. Rub on steaks
3. Cover and refrigerate steaks overnight

title: fiesta fritters
steps:
1. In a large bowl , fold together potatoes , corn , black beans , eggs , green onions , taco seasoning , corn meal , salt and pepper until well combined
2. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil
3. Form fritter mixture into golf-ball sized fritters and set on lined baking sheet
4. Chill fritters in refrigerator for at least 30 minutes
5. In a large skillet or cast-iron pan , heat oil until hot enough for frying , about 375 degrees
6. Fry fritters in batches until golden brown and cooked through , and drain on paper towels
7. Serve as a side dish , or with salsa as an appetizer

title: herbed goat cheese sauce
steps:
1. Combine olive oil , wine , and chicken broth in a saucepan
2. Simmer over medium heat until reduced by about 1 / 2
3. Add the parsley , goat cheese , salt and pepper , and garlic
4. Continue simmering , stirring frequently , until sauce is creamy and thickened to your liking

title: ranch burgers with zesty ranch sauce
steps:
1. In a small skillet , heat olive oil over medium heat
2. Add onion , mushrooms and garlic
3. Cook 4 to 6 minutes , or until tender
4. Let cool 10 minutes
5. While cooling , make the ranch sauce by combining the mayonnaise , sour cream and dressing mix
6. Cover and chill
7. In a large bowl , combine ground chuck , onion mixture , blue cheese , salt and pepper until well blended
8. Shape mixture into 4 patties
9. Grill , covered with grill lid , over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes per side or until desired degree of doneness
10. Serve on toasted buns with zesty ranch sauce and desired toppings

title: no bake butterscotch and cream cheesecake  low fat
steps:
1. Crust:
2. Combine crumbs , margarine , and sugar in a mixing bowl
3. Press mixture firmly in a 9" pie pan
4. Chill one hour , or until firm
5. Or , bake in a 350 oven for ten minutes or until lightly browned
6. Cool on rack before filling
7. Filling:
8. Combine cream cheese , sugar , whipped topping , yogurt , sour cream , vanilla extract , and lemon juice
9. Mix until smooth
10. In a small bowl , combine gelatin and water
11. Mix until gelatin is dissolved
12. Fold into cream cheese mixture
13. Divide batter in half
14. Fold butterscotch topping into one half and leave the other one plain
15. Pour butterscotch batter into a prepared 8" pie crust
16. Spoon plain batter over top
17. Cover and refrigerate for two hours , or until set
18. Cut into wedges and serve

title: spirited fruit
steps:
1. Combine sugar and water in a large stainless or enamel pot
2. Bring to a boil
3. Add fruit and return to a boil , boil for 5 minutes
4. Pack hot fruit in hot jars
5. Add 1 tablespoon of the rum or brandy and 1 1 / 2 tsp of kahlua , cognac or creme de menthe to each jar
6. Add the hot syrup leaving 1 / 4 inch head space
7. Seal and process 20 minutes at altitudes up to 1000 feet

title: mexican style  spicy  corn on the cob
steps:
1. Roast the corn on a charcoal grill just until tender and you have nice grill marks
2. Liberally spread mayo on piece of bread
3. Roll hot ears on the bread
4. Sprinkle parmesan cheese on
5. Sprinkle cayenne pepper on

title: apple   cinnamon cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Beat dry cake mix , pie filling , and eggs in large bowl on low for 2 minutes
3. Spread half of batter in prepared pan
4. Mix sugar and cinnamon
5. Sprinkle half of the mixture over the batter in the pan
6. Spread remaining batter in the pan
7. Sprinkle with remaining sugar-cinnamon mixture
8. Bake for 30-35 minues or until done
9. I use a few tablespoons of canned vanilla frosting- heat it in the microwave a few seconds and drizzle over the top of the cake
10. This is a great cake- and so easy to make !

title: healthy cucumber tomato salad
steps:
1. Add cucumber , tomato and onion to a bowl with a cover
2. Add garlic salt , pepper and basil to taste
3. Seal bowl and shake
4. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour

title: yet   another tater tot casserole
steps:
1. Mix ground beef with the dry onion soup mix and press into a 9x13 pan
2. Mix the soup , milk , salt , and pepper
3. Pour over the ground beef mixture
4. Add a layer of cheddar cheese
5. Arrange frozen tater tots over the top of the casserole
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour

title: sweet lemon yogurt sauce
steps:
1. Stir ingredients together
2. Serve chilled or warm
3. To serve warmed , heat in microwave 3 minutes on medium power level , until heated through

title: ham potato soup
steps:
1. Get a nice sized ham hock or slice of ham
2. If using slice of ham , cut down into bite sized pieces
3. Leave the fat on the pieces or cut it off into 1 large piece and put in to cook too
4. Adds to the flavor
5. Remove fat when cooked and discard
6. Ham hock , put in whole
7. Put water in large pot with ham
8. Cook until meat comes off hock easily
9. Pull hock from broth and reserve broth
10. Let hock cool enough to pull meat off and either shred or cut into small pieces
11. Add back into broth
12. Add rest of ingredients and cook until potatoes and celery are done
13. It sometimes thickens up a bit , but if brothy or a little thicker , it is still good
14. Serve with cornbread or salad
15. Warms you up real good !

title: authentic homemade flour tortillas
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , whisk together flour , salt , and baking powder
2. Mix in the lard / margarine with your fingers until the flour resembles cornmeal
3. Add the water and mix until the dough comes together
4. Place on a lightly floured surface and knead a few minutes until smooth and elastic
5. Divide the dough into 24 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball
6. Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat
7. Use a well-floured rolling pin to roll a dough ball into a very thin , round tortilla
8. Place into the hot skillet , and cook until bubbly and golden
9. Flip and continue cooking until golden on the other side
10. Place the cooked tortilla in a tortilla warmer
11. Continue rolling and cooking the remaining dough
12. Store in ziplock bag and re-warm in microwave or oven
13. If using microwave , wrap tortillas in moist paper towel to steam them back to life

title: chili cornbread bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 - grease a 2 quart casserole
2. In large pan over medium heat cook ground beef , onions , pepper and garlic until meat is browned - drain
3. Stir in beans , tomato sauce and taco seasoning
4. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes
5. In medium bowl: combine flour , cornmeal , sugar , baking powder and salt
6. Mix well
7. In small bowl: combine corn , milk and egg - beat well and add to dry ingredients
8. Spoon half of the cornbread mixture into greased casserole
9. Sprinkle with half the cheese
10. Spoon chili over cheese
11. Sprinkle with remaining half of the cheese
12. Spoon remaining corn bread mixture evenly over the cheese spreading gently to cover
13. Bake at 350 for 30 to 40 minutes or until top is golden brown

title: steak tataki with citrus ponzu
steps:
1. For the steak: in a large bowl , marinate sirloin steak in minced garlic , minced shallots , soy sauce , ginger , and the juice from the limes& lemons
2. This should marinate for at least 2 hours in the refrigerator
3. Over a high using a saute pan or cast iron pan , sear the sirloin on all sides until charred but not overcooked
4. Place pan in a 400 degree oven until cooked
5. Steak should be rare to medium rare
6. Steak can be grilled also for the garnish: in a small bowl , marinate red onions in rice vinegar , soy sauce , and the juice from the limes& lemons , then set aside
7. Remove steak from refrigerator , slice very thin using a very sharp knife
8. To serve: on a flat plate or platter , spread out the marinated red onions evenly
9. Layer sliced sirloin over the red onions
10. Garnish with chopped green onions this should be served slightly chilled

title: cheap hamburger potato casserole
steps:
1. Brown ground beef in a medium-sized skillet
2. Meanwhile , boil egg noodles in pot
3. Drain excess grease from meat
4. Drain egg noodles , return to pot
5. Add hamburger to egg noodles and empty both cans of potato soup into the pot
6. Stir
7. Serve hot

title: family favorite cinnamon rolls
steps:
1. In bread machine , add all dough ingredients and select white bread button
2. When the bread machine cycle is over , roll dough out on floured board to a 22x14 inch rectangle
3. Brush the dough with melted butter
4. Combine filling ingredients and sprinkle on top of dough
5. Roll dough in a jellyroll fashion , starting with long edge
6. Seal edges , and cut into 10-20 rolls
7. Place cut side down , side by side , in greased and sugared 8 inch round pan , or glass baking dish
8. Cover and let rise in warm place until doubled , about 45 minutes
9. Bake at 350 for 20-25 minutes
10. Drizzle with icing , and serve warm
11. (this dough can be refrigerated after it has risen twice
12. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight
13. Let dough come to room temperature before baking
14. )

title: eggs and sausage omelet with tomatoes and peppers
steps:
1. Heat 1 / 2 teaspoon of oil in a medium nonstick pan over medium high heat
2. Add pepper , onion , kielbasa , and garlic and cook , stirring occasionally , until onion and kielbasa start to brown
3. Add tomato and cook until wilted
4. Remove from heat
5. Stir in 1 teaspoon of basil and transfer to a bowl
6. Return skillet to heat and add remaining oil
7. Combine egg substitute , salt and pepper in a small bowl
8. Add to skillet and cook until almost set
9. Top with bell pepper and cook for one minute , or until egg is cooked through
10. Fold omelet in half and slide onto a plate
11. Top with remaining basil
12. Serve with toast and blueberries

title: cherry pecan apricot bread
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350
2. Grease a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan , line the bottom with wax paper and grease the paper
3. Beat the butter with sugar until fluffy
4. Blend in the egg
5. Sift the flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt together
6. Combine the apricots , sourcream and almond extract
7. Stir the flour mixture into the sugar mixture alternately with apricot mixture
8. Fold in the nuts and cherries
9. Turn into the loaf pan and bake 50 minutes or until crust springs back when lightly poked with finger
10. Cool in pan on wire rack 10 minutes , turn out and cool completely

title: thai prawn and pineapple curry   kaeng khua saparot
steps:
1. Peel , devein , and behead the shrimp , leaving only the small tail shells on
2. Drop two tomatoes into boiling water for about a minute , then remove to cold water , peel , quarter , discard the seed pulp , and chop the flesh
3. You want 2 tablespoons of chopped tomatoes
4. In a little oil in a medium hot wok , briefly saute the garlic and basil , removing it and reserving it when the aroma is fully developed
5. Cook the curry paste briefly to develop the aroma , then add half the coconut milk , the fish sauce , tomatoes , pineapple , lime juice and sugar
6. Stir to combine fully
7. Add the prawns and cook until they turn slightly pink and opaque
8. Add the remainder of the coconut milk , the lime leaves and slivered chili , at the same time returning the sauted garlic and basil to the pan
9. Transfer to a serving dish and serve with steamed thai jasmine rice

title: chuck wagon sandwich
steps:
1. Heat beef patty by pan frying in shallow oil or baking in oven at 350f 10-12 minutes or until crispy , whichever is directed for your patty or whichever you prefer
2. Assemble ingredients on warmed or toasted bun and serve with chips , fries , onion rings , etc

title: voodoo   calamari ink  pasta
steps:
1. Separate tentacls and the body of the calamri , then gut them , setting aside the ink sak
2. Wash calamari under cold water , dice the body into rings , and chop the tentacles
3. Heat garlic in oil without browning
4. Add parsley , ground pepper
5. Cover and let it simmer for 45min
6. Check from time to time
7. If it's sticking , add some hot water
8. Once it has simmered , mix the tomato sauce with the white wine and add it to the pot
9. Simmer for 20 minutes more , uncovered , then dilute the sauce with a little hot water and simmer for a half hour more , covered
10. 30 minutes before meal , cook pasta al dante
11. Now you can add the ink to the sauce , as much as you like
12. Serve sauce over pasta with the rest of the white wine

title: tikka spice mix
steps:
1. The idea is you mix all these together and then keep the powder mixture for when you need it
2. If you couldn't get garlic powder you could replace it with fresh garlic when you added the required amount of mix to a dish
3. I've left the mint out too and it was perfectly ok :)

title: best hooters hot wing sauce  and breading
steps:
1. For breading & frying
2. In large mixing bowl mix flours , salt , paprika and cayenne pepper together , blend well
3. Cut chicken wings into drumettes and flappers
4. Wash and drain chicken
5. Coat chicken in flour mixture , refrigerate chicken wings for 90 minutes
6. When ready to deep fry chicken wings heat oil to 375
7. Place chicken pieces in hot oil , do not crowd
8. Fry chicken wings until golden brown , remove from oil and drain
9. When all wings have been fried , place in a large bowl
10. Add hot sauce mixture and mix completely
11. Use a fork or tongs to place chicken pieces on a serving platter
12. Serve immediately and with lots of paper towels
13. For sauce
14. Melt butter over low , stir in the rest of the ingredients until dissolved
15. Pour in bowl over cooked chicken

title: traditional egg and bacon pie   or what you will
steps:
1. Line a 27cm x 18cm oblong pan with baking paper
2. Overlap sheets of pastry and line the base and sides of the pan
3. Trim the excess pastry
4. Cook the bacon , onions and garlic until the onions and garlic have just begun to soften , and allow to cool
5. Spoon the cooled mixture into prepared pastry case
6. Gently break 6 eggs onto the onion base and top with parsley , capers and cheese , and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper , to taste
7. Bake in a preheated oven at 190c for 30 minutes
8. Serve hot or at room temperature with crispy rolls and salad greens such as baby spinach leaves

title: paula s green bean casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Melt butter in large skillet
3. Saute onions and mushrooms in butter
4. Boil green beans in chicken broth for 10 minutes and drain
5. Add green beans , mushroom soup , onion rings , and seasoning salt to onion mixture
6. Stir well
7. Pour into a greased 1 1 / 2 quart baking dish
8. Bake for 20 minutes , then top with cheddar cheese and bake for 10 minutes longer , or until casserole is hot and cheese is melted and bubbly

title: cajun shrimp and crab jambalaya
steps:
1. Lightly coar a large geavy skilled with nonstick cooking spray and set over medium heat
2. Add oil and flour and stir consistantly until roux turns deep mahogany brown , about 5 minutes
3. Add onions , green pepper , celery and bacon
4. Saute until vegetables are soft , about 5 minutes longer
5. Stir in tomatoes in puree , broth , rice and old bay seasoning
6. Bring to a boil over high heat
7. Reduce heat to medium-low , cover and simmer until most of liquid is absorbed and rice is almost tender , about 20 minutes
8. Fold in shrimp and cook just until shrimp are pink and firm , about 5 minutes
9. Gently fold in crab
10. Cover and cook 1 minute
11. Remove from heat and let stand 3 minutes
12. Sprinkle with cilantro

title: spicy minced beef kebabs with hot chickpea puree
steps:
1. Mix all of the first 8 ingredients together , knead well then place into food processor and process until smooth
2. Place into a dish , cover and leave to stand for 1 hour
3. Preheat the oven to 200c 400f
4. In a food processor , process the chickpeas , olive oil , lemon , garlic , cumin , tahini and yoghurt , season and put into ovenproof dish , cover with foil and heat through for 20 mins in the oven
5. Divide the meat mix into 6 portions and mould each onto metal skewer so that the meat resembles a fat sausage , cook 4-5 mins each side
6. Pour melted butter over the hot chickpea puree and serve with salad and crusty bread

title: ham meatballs in brown sugar sauce
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine the pork ham , eggs , milk and cereal
2. Mix well
3. Shape into 1-1 / 2 inch to 2 inch meatballs
4. Place in a greast 13x9 baking dish
5. In a saucepan , combine remaining ingredients
6. Bring to a boil over medium heat
7. Reduce heat
8. Simmer , uncovered for 4 minutes
9. Pour over meatballs
10. Bake , uncovered , at 350 for 60-70 minutes or until browned

title: creamy fresh tomato summer soup
steps:
1. Peel the tomatoes by dipping them in boiling water for about 30 seconds
2. This loosens the skin and makes it easy to remove
3. Cut the peeled tomatoes in half crosswise and squeeze out the seeds , carefully removing any remaining seeds with a small spoon
4. Dice the tomatoes and set aside
5. Melt the butter in a heavy saucepan over medium heat
6. Add the onion and cook , stirring frequently , until soft and translucent , about 3 minutes
7. Add the diced tomatoes , cover and cook , stirring occasionally , until the tomatoes are very soft , for about 20 minutes
8. Remove from the heat and spoon the tomato mixture into a blender and puree
9. Add the soy milk and all of the remaining ingredients to the blender and puree
10. At this point you can pour the soup back into the saucepan and heat it to the desired temperature
11. Or you can serve it at room temperature or refrigerate it and serve it cold

title: st  patrick s day cottage cheese salad
steps:
1. Spoon cottage cheese into large bowl
2. Sprinkle jello powder onto cottage cheese , and mix well
3. Gently fold in well-drained mandarin oranges and cool whip
4. Place in serving dish , and top with flaked coconut
5. Chill overnight

title: crock pot corn
steps:
1. Put butter and cream cheese in bottom of crock pot
2. Sprinkle sugar top
3. Put all 3 bags of corn on top
4. Cover and cook 6 hours on low
5. If you are home , stir after about an hour
6. If you are not home , it will be fine , just stir before serving

title: poor man s dinner party
steps:
1. Brown ground been in shortening until all red color disappears
2. Drain all but 1 1 / 2 tsp grease from the skillet
3. Add the onion , tomatoes , catsup , steak sauce , green pepper , and parsley
4. Simmer for 30 minutes
5. Meanwhile , cook the macaroni according to package directions
6. Combine macaroni and ground beef mixture in a 2 quart baking dish
7. Season with salt and pepper to taste , keeping in mind that you will be adding a cream of soup
8. Gently spoon mushroom soup into mixture
9. Mix lightly , lifting from the bottom
10. Sprinkle 1 / 2 cup cheese into the mix and stir
11. Add the other 1 cup of cheese on the top
12. Bake at 350f for 30 minutes , or until top is bubbly and browned

title: super easy mediterranean dip
steps:
1. In a blender or a food processor , puree all ingredients until smooth
2. Serve as a spread or dip with warm pita bread or sesame crispbread

title: honey mustard chicken with apples
steps:
1. Pound chicken thin between sheets of waxed paper
2. Brown in oil for 3 minutes on each side
3. Add all ingredients except mustard and simmer for 6-8 minutes
4. Remove chicken and boil sauce for 3 minutes or until slightly reduced
5. Whisk in mustard and serve over chicken and rice

title: bahraini sweet rice  muhammar
steps:
1. In a small bowl or arabian coffee cup put saffron , rose water and the cardamom
2. Wash the white basmati rice until the water runs clear
3. In a large heavy pot boil the water
4. Stir in salt and rice and return water to a boil stirring occasionally
5. Boil uncovered for 8 minutes
6. Drain
7. Melt the butter or ghee in the same pan the rice was cooked
8. Add the rice back in with sugar and or honey
9. Sprinkle the rose water and spices on top of the rice
10. Using the end of a wooden spoon , make 3 small holes in the rice
11. Cover the pan with a paper towel and place lid tightly on top
12. Cook over low heat about 20 minutes , until done
13. Please try this dish with recipe #372093 because they go extremely well together
14. Enjoy
