title: whole wheat quick pizza dough
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. Mix yeast in water until foamy
3. Stir in oil and flours until it forms a ball
4. Cover the bowl with a towel and place the bowl on your stove while the oven is preheating
5. Let rise for 15 minutes
6. Roll onto baking pan
7. Cover with toppings
8. Bake for 20 minutes until crust is golden brown and the cheese is bubbly and browning on top

title: chilled green soup
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in your food processor
2. Process until smooth
3. Serve with a spoonful of sour cream or plain yogurt on each bowl , or chill for later

title: apple wrap sandwich
steps:
1. Core apples , but do not peel
2. Cut apples into thin slices and place in a bowl with water and lemon juice to prevent browning
3. In a small bowl , mix mayonnaise and mustard
4. Remove apples from bowl and pat dry
5. Spread each tortilla with mayonnaise mixture , layer with 2 slices of ham , 2 slices of cheese , apple slices and lettuce
6. Roll tortillas tightly and cut in half diagonally

title: classic hot chocolate souffle w  chocolate cream sauce
steps:
1. Chocolate souffle
2. Preheat the oven to 200c
3. Brush the souffle dishes with butter and dust with sugar
4. Beat the egg yolks , sugar and salt together until the mixture is thick , pale and makes a ribbon when drizzled around the bowl
5. Melt the chocolate over a double boiler with the cream , coffee and cognac
6. Blend this mixture into the creamed yolks and sugar
7. Whip the egg whites in another bowl until they hold soft peaks then fold into the chocolate / egg yolk mixture gently and carefully so as not to lose any volume
8. Divide the mixture among 6 souffle dishes & bake for about 12-14 minutes
9. Serve the souffle immediately with the chocolate sauce on the side
10. Rich chocolate cream sauce
11. Melt the chocolate and butter in the cream over a double boiler and stir until smooth and creamy

title: spring dijon chicken
steps:
1. Spray 9x13 pan with cooking spray
2. Combine pasta , asparagus , chicken , mushrooms , onion , lemon juice , salt , and pepper into a large bowl
3. Combine milk , wine , alfredo sauce , and mustard into another bowl , stir til smooth
4. Add to the chicken and pasta mixture and toss to coat
5. Pour into baking dish
6. Cover with foil and freeze
7. To serve: thaw , bake in 350 degree oven covered for about 45 minutes

title: grilled argentinean chimichurri chicken with green beans
steps:
1. Brush chicken with 1 tablespoon of the oil
2. Sprinkle 1 / 4 teaspoon each salt and black pepper
3. Grill chicken on rack directly over medium heat for 12 to 15 minutes or until no longer pink , turning once halfway through grilling time
4. Place beans in microwave-safe 1-1 / 2-quart dish
5. Add 1 tablespoon water
6. Cover with vented plastic wrap
7. Cook on high 3 minutes
8. Drain
9. For chimichurri sauce , in small food processor bowl combine parsley , the remaining oil , the vinegar , garlic , 1 / 4 teaspoon salt , and red pepper
10. Process until nearly smooth
11. Serve chicken and beans topped with chimichurri sauce , lemon peel , and juice

title: braised pork loin with sage
steps:
1. Trim excess fat from pork
2. Tie with butchers string
3. Put 3 sage leaves on top and 3 on the bottom of roast under string
4. Rub the meat with salt & pepper
5. In a dutch oven , on med-high heat , melt butter and oil , when hot add the pork and sear quickly on all sides , 5 minutes or so
6. The sear is very important
7. Reduce heat to med-low and add garlic 1-2 minutes transfer meat and garlic to plate , pour off fat
8. Return meat to pan and bay leaf
9. Add 1 / 2 cup wine , vinegar , and 2 more sage leaves
10. Cover tightly , reduce to low , simmer for 2 hours turning 1 / 2 way through cooking , add more wine if needed
11. Let meat rest covered in foil
12. Meanwhile , discard bay , garlic , and sage from pan
13. Skim fat off (you need about 1 cup of liquid , add water if needed
14. Melt 1 tbsp butter into separate pan add flour and cook 1-2 minutes add pan juices whisking constantly until thick and smooth
15. Arrange meat on platter , spoon sauce over top and garnish with sage leaves

title: frozen christmas pudding
steps:
1. Crush biscuits finely and place in a bowl
2. Melt butter and add to the crumbs
3. Mix well grease a 7 cup pudding bowl , and line completely with the crumbs
4. Refrigerate till firm
5. Whip cream with the brandy until thick but not stiff
6. Fold in the fruit mince
7. Spoon the mix into the biscuit lined bowl
8. Use a spatula to smooth the mixture evenly up the sides of the bowl , so that there is a hollow centre
9. Freeze for an hour
10. Soften the ice cream but do not melt
11. Stir in the chocolate chips annd cherries
12. Fill the centre cavity with this mix
13. Cover with plastic wrap and return to the freezer for 24 hours
14. To serve invert bowl on a platter , place a hot tea towel around bowl , and pudding will soon leave the sides of the bowl

title: pizza alla vodka
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 500
2. Place a pizza stone on a rack in the lowest level of the oven
3. Make the sauce: melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat
4. Add in the garlic
5. Cook 30 seconds or until lightly golden
6. Add in the vodka
7. Cook about 1 minute more until the alcohol evaporates
8. Add in the tomatoes , crushed red pepper , and salt to taste
9. Simmer 10 minutes
10. Add in the cream and peas
11. Cook until the sauce is reduced and thickened , about 5 minutes
12. Let cool
13. Place 1 ball of dough on a floured surface
14. Holding you hands flat , pat the ball out evenly with your fingers , lifting it and turning it over several times , until it reaches a 12-inch circle (dont knead the dough or handle it any more than is necessary
15. If the dough seems sticky , dust it lightly with flour
16. Dust a pizza peel or rimless cookie sheet with flour
17. Carefully transfer the circle of dough to the peel , reshaping it as needed
18. Shake the peel once or twice to make sure the dough does not stick
19. If it does , sprinkle the peel with more flour
20. Quickly top the dough with the sauce , spreading it to within inch of the edge with the back of a spoon
21. Layer with half the mozzarella , mushrooms , and a sprinkling of pecorino
22. To slide the pizza onto the baking stone , line up the edge of the pizza peel with the back edge of the stone , then tilt the peel , jerking it gently to start the pizza moving
23. Once the edge of the pizza touches the stone , carefully pull back on the peel until the pizza is completely off
24. After the pizza is on the stone , do not attempt to move it until it firms up in 2-3 minutes
25. Bake the pizza 6-7 minutes , or until the cheese is melted and the crust is browned
26. Just before serving , sprinkle with the prosciutto and basil

title: best chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven 350 degrees
2. Cream together the butter , white sugar , and brown sugar until smooth
3. Beat in the eggs one at a time
4. Then stir in the vanilla
5. Dissolve baking soda in hot water
6. Add to batter along with salt
7. Stir in flour , chocolate chips and nuts
8. Drop by large spoonfulls onto ungreased pans
9. Bake for 10-12 minutes in the preheated oven

title: cheese manicotti with spinach
steps:
1. Cook manicotti shells in boiling , salted water until barely tender
2. Rinse with cold water
3. Drain
4. Combine cheeses , parsley , egg , onion and salt
5. Mixing well
6. Fill shells with cheese mixture
7. Arrange in lightly oiled baking dish
8. Cover with marinara sauce
9. Sprinkle with additional 1 / 4 cup parmesan
10. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 - 30 minutes
11. Meanwhile , cook spinach according to package directions
12. Drain well
13. Spoon down center of baked manicotti just before serving
14. Garnish with parsley

title: risi e bisi  italian rice and peas   rice cooker
steps:
1. Set rice cooker for the quick cook or regular cycle
2. Place the olive oil and butter in the rice cooker bowl
3. When the butter melts , add the shallots and celery
4. Cook , stirring a few times , until the shallots are softened but not browned , 2 to 3 minutes
5. Add the wine and cook for a couple of minutes
6. Add the rice and stir to coat the grains with the hot butter
7. Cook , stirring occasionally , until the grains of rice are transparent except for a white spot on each , 3-5 minutes
8. Add the stock and peas , if you are using fresh , mature peas
9. Stir to combine
10. Close the cover and reset for the porridge cycle , or for the regular cycle and set a timer for 20 minutes
11. When the machine switches to the keep warm cycle or the timer sounds , stir the rice with a wooden or plastic rice paddle or wooden spoon
12. The rice should be only a bit liquid and the rice should be al dente , tender with just touch of tooth resistance
13. If needed , cook for a few minutes longer
14. This rice will hold on the keep warm cycle for up to 1 hour
15. When ready to serve , add the peas , if you are using frozen or very tender fresh ones
16. Stir just to combine
17. Add the butter and close the lid or 2-3 minutes to allow to melt and the peas to heat through
18. Stir in the cream , cheese and salt to taste
19. Serve immediately

title: naked tater all the way
steps:
1. Peel , slice and cook potatoes until tender or use an equal amount of leftover potatoes
2. Mash potatoes by hand with a potato masher just to break them up
3. Add remaining ingredients and stir to mix
4. Bake in oven at 350f until hot and bubbly
5. Turn broiler on to brown top if desired

title: applesauce  oatmeal quick bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine all dry ingredients mix well
3. Then thoroughly mix wet and combine them with the dry just until mixed
4. Be careful not to over mix because this will cause your bread to tough
5. Spray a 9x5 loaf pan with your choice of cooking spray
6. Bake for 50 minutes or just until a tooth pick comes out clean

title: linda s chunky potato soup
steps:
1. Peel potatoes , and cut into 1" cubes
2. Bring water to a boil in a lg
3. Saucepan
4. Add potatoes , and cook until tender , 15-20 minutes drain well , reserving liquid
5. Set aside
6. Measure 1 cup cooking liquid from the pan , adding water if necessary to make 1 cup
7. Peel and finely chop onion
8. Melt butter in saucepan over med
9. Heat
10. Add onion and stir frequently , until onion is opague and tender , but not brown
11. Add flour , and season with fresh ground black pepper
12. Cook 3-4 minutes
13. Gradually add potatoes , reserved cup of liquid , evaporated milk , and half and half
14. Stir well
15. Add cheese and chopped ham
16. Simmer over low heat for 30 minutes , stirring frequently until piping hot
17. When ready to serve , sprinkle crumbled bacon over the top of soup , and add more pepper if you like

title: minty yogurt chicken
steps:
1. Slash the chicken flesh at regular intervals with a sharp knife and place in a bowl
2. Mix together the honey , lemon juice , yogurt , salt and pepper and half the mint
3. Spoon the marinade over the chicken and leave to marinate for 30 minutes
4. Line the broiler pan with foil and cook the chicken under a medium-hot broiler until thoroughly cooked and golden brown , turning the chicken occasionally during cooking
5. Sprinkle with the remaining mint and serve

title: the best peanut butter oatmeal chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix dry ingredients
3. Cream shortening , peanut butter , and sugars in seperate bowl
4. Beat eggs and vanilla into shortening and sugar mix
5. Add dry mix
6. Blend chocolate chip in
7. Bake 11-13 minute

title: garden vinaigrette salad
steps:
1. In large bowl , add ingredients in order
2. Dice tomato
3. Cut peppers into rings
4. Cut onion into rings
5. Slice cucumbers into thin slices
6. Salt / pepper to taste
7. Add thyme and basil , red wine vinegar , olive oil
8. Toss to coat vegetables in oil and vinegar
9. Allow to marinate at least 30 minutes
10. Can serve cold or at room temperature
11. I like my room temperature
12. Add pasta for a tasty pasta salad

title: wok seared chicken with asparagus and pistachos
steps:
1. Heat oil in wok or large skillet over high heat
2. Add asparagus and cook , stirring , for 2 minutes
3. Add chicken and cook , stirring , for 4 minutes
4. Stir in scallions , ginger powder , oyster sauce , and chili-garlic sauce
5. Cook , stirring , until the chicken is juicy and just cooked through , about 1-2 minutes
6. Stir in pistachios and serve over rice

title: greek pasta with meatballs and feta cheese
steps:
1. Cook orzo according to package directions
2. Drain
3. Keep warm
4. Combine breadcrumbs , oregano , salt , cinnamon , black pepper , lamb and garlic in a medium bowl
5. Stir in 1 1 / 2 tablespoons parsley
6. Add egg white , stirring mixture until just combined
7. Shape mixture into 12 meatballs
8. Cover and chill meatballs 5 minutes
9. Preheat oven to 375
10. Bake the meatballs on a roaster pan for 20 minutes
11. Drain the fat , if necessary
12. Place the meatballs in a new baking dish and spoon the marinara sauce over meatballs
13. Sprinkle with cheese
14. Bake at 375 for 20 minutes or until meatballs are done
15. Sprinkle with remaining 1 1 / 2 teaspoons parsley
16. Serve over orzo

title: crock pot beef and broccoli
steps:
1. Add liquid and spices to crockpot
2. Slice meat into thin strips
3. Toss meat in crockpot mixture
4. Cook on low for 6-8 hours
5. One hour before serving add broccoli
6. Cover and cook on high for another hour
7. Serve over rice

title: yogurt spiced chicken with rice weight watchers
steps:
1. Mix the yogurt and curry powder together in a glass or plastic bowl and add the first t of chopped coriander
2. Place the chicken breasts between sheets of cling film , then use a meat mallet or rolling pin to beat them out until slightly flattened
3. Add them to the yogurt mixture , stirring to coat
4. Cover , chill and leave to marinate for at least 30 minutes or overnight
5. Cook the rice with the stock cube until tender
6. Drain and rinse with cold water to cool quickly
7. Add the carrot , red pepper , chilli , mint and remaining t of coriander
8. Grill the chicken breasts for about 6 minutes on each side until thoroughly cooked
9. Serve chicken with rice salad

title: toasted couscous with almonds and raisins
steps:
1. Heat a large nonstick skillet over moderate heat
2. Add the couscous and toast the grains , stirring or shaking the pan frequently , until the grains become brown and fragrant
3. Transfer to a plate
4. Add the almonds to the hot skillet and toast them in the same way , stirring frequently
5. Transfer them to another plate
6. Bring the stock to a boil with the celery , salt , pepper , cumin , and cayenne
7. Simmer about 3 minutes or until the celery is slightly softened
8. Add the couscous and raisins to the saucepan and stir gently just to mix
9. Cover the pan , remove from the heat , and allow to stand about 5 minutes or until the couscous is tender
10. Add the almonds to the couscous and , with a fork , stir the mixture lightly to fluff up the grains

title: sicilian pizza sauce   noble roman copycat
steps:
1. Heat oil in heavy medium saucepan over medium heat
2. Add onion , basil and oregano
3. Cook until onion softens slightly , stirring occasionally , about 6 minutes
4. Mix in garlic and cook 2 minutes
5. Add tomato paste and cook 3 minutes , stirring occasionally
6. Add tomatoes and bring to a simmer
7. Cook until sauce is of desired thickness
8. Season with salt and pepper
9. Cover and refrigerate 1 week or freeze up to 1 month

title: baked macaroni and gouda cheese with italian sausage
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350
2. In a large pot of boiling salted water , cook the pasta until al dente , about 11 minutes
3. Meanwhile , heat a large , heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium-high heat
4. Add the sausage and cook , stirring and breaking up the meat with a wooden spoon , until no longer pink , 3 to 4 minutes
5. Transfer the sausage to a large bowl and wipe the saucepan clean
6. Add the pasta and 1 cup caramelized onions to the sausage and stir to combine
7. In a medium saucepan or a microwave oven , heat the milk until steaming
8. Return the large saucepan to the stove , add the butter and melt over medium heat
9. Add the flour and cook , whisking constantly , for 3 minutes
10. Whisk in the hot milk , 1 / 4 cup at a time , and continue whisking until the sauce is smooth and thick and comes to a simmer
11. Add 2 1 / 2 cups cheese , remove from the heat and whisk until the cheese is melted , about 2 minutes
12. Season to taste with salt and pepper
13. Add the cheese sauce to the pasta mixture and stir to combine
14. Butter a 9-by-13-inch baking dish and add the pasta mixture in an even layer
15. Sprinkle the remaining 1 / 2 cup caramelized onions and 1 1 / 2 cups cheese on top
16. Bake until golden and bubbling , about 40 minutes
17. Remove from the oven and let rest for 10 minutes before serving

title: lemon easy cookies
steps:
1. Mix cake mix , egg , jello and cool whip
2. Roll by teaspoon full in powered sugar
3. Bake on cookie sheet lined with parchment
4. 10 minutes or till nice and golden
5. 12 to 14 cookies

title: balsamic honey glazed chicken breasts
steps:
1. Preheat an electric grill for high heat
2. When hot , brush the cooking surfaces with olive oil or use nonstick cooking spray
3. Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper , add to grill and cook until lightly browned , in two batches , if necessary
4. Remove chicken from grill and set aside
5. In a large skillet , add the onions and garlic , and cook on low heat until wilted , about 6 to 7 minutes
6. Add the tomato puree and broth and bring to a boil
7. Transfer the chicken breasts to the skillet
8. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes , or until the chicken is tender
9. Remove the chicken breasts to a platter and tent with aluminum foil to keep warm
10. Whisk together the vinegar and honey in a small bowl and pour into the pan , stirring
11. Simmer for 5 to 10 minutes , until the sauce is reduced to about 1 / 2 cup
12. Drizzle the sauce over the chicken and garnish with chopped parsley

title: paprika buttered cauliflower
steps:
1. Cut off the tough stem ends of each cauliflower and remove most of the outer leaves
2. Leave the cauliflowers intact
3. Place th cauliflowers in a pot filled with about 1 1 / 2 inches of boiling salted water , flower side down
4. Cover , steam about 15 minute until tender-crisp
5. Meanwhile , saute the onions in heated butter until soft
6. Add paprika
7. Drain the cauliflowers
8. Arange on serving dish
9. Top with the onion mixture
10. Serve immediately
11. Good served with marinated flank steak , baked or shoestring potatoes and rainbow sherbert for dessert

title: irish coffee cream pie
steps:
1. Crust: pre heat oven to 375 f degrees
2. Mix butter and crumbs , press into 9" pie pan , bake until set approx
3. 8 mins
4. Cool completely filling:combine all ingredients in a chilled bowl
5. Beat on medium speed until mixture hold peaks
6. Pour into crust and garnish
7. Chill 4 hours or overnight

title: white chocolate fresh cranberry coffee cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Grease an 8" square pan , metal or glass
3. Using an electric beater or strong whisk , beat the butter and 1 cup of the brown sugar together in a large bowl until the mixture is light and fluffy
4. Beat in one egg until thoroughly incorporated
5. Repeat with the second egg
6. In another bowl , mix the flour , baking soda , baking powder , and salt together
7. Alternate adding the dry mixture and buttermilk in this way: add a third of the dry mixture then half the buttermilk followed by a third of the dry mixture and the rest of the buttermilk
8. Add the remaining flour mixture and gently stir until you have a rich looking batter
9. Add the cranberries and 3 / 4 cup of white chocolate chips
10. Pour the batter into the pan , smoothing it out
11. Sprinkle 1 / 2 cup brown sugar and 1 / 4 cup white chocolate chips on top
12. Bake in the center of oven for 1 1 / 4 hours until the center is firm when you gently press it
13. Allow the pan to cool on a rack for at least 20 minutes before removing the cake from the pan

title: pumpkin pie granola bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Whisk together the oats , pumpkin pie spice , cinnamon and salt in a large mixing bowl
3. In a separate bowl , whisk together the honey , brown sugar , pumpkin , applesauce and vanilla extract until smooth
4. Pour the wet mixture over the oats and mix with a wooden spoon
5. Stir in the cranberries and pecans
6. Pour and evenly press the mixture into a coated 8 x 8 pan
7. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until golden brown
8. Allow to cool , then cut into bars and serve
9. Store at room temperature in an airtight container

title: gluten free flour mixture  number one
steps:
1. Mungbean flour is available at oriental grocery stores and is a wonderful addition to the light-textured dessert recipes
2. Chickpea flour is also"light"
3. Xanthangum is a white powder that is sold in pouches at health food stores
4. It helps to bind the pastry and keep it from crumbling
5. Ifxanthan gum is unavailable to you , you may substitute it with double the amount of unflavored gelatin
6. Mix all
7. Gluten-free flours contain no preservatives--keep refrigerated or frozen
8. Additional baking
9. Bake gluten-free products longer and at a lower temperature than conventional recipes
10. You may want to substitute the liquid called for in a conventional wheat recipe
11. Adding carbonated drinks tend to make baked products lighter
12. Fruit juices add flavor and quality

title: i have no idea  chicken with rotini pasta
steps:
1. Combine first six ingredients in medium bowl
2. Add sliced chicken breasts and toss to coat
3. Refrigerate until ready to cook
4. Begin cooking pasta according to the package directions
5. In large saute pan , add olive oil and heat until almost smoking
6. Add seasoned chicken to olive oil and cook over medium heat until no longer pink
7. Add chicken stock and diced red pepper
8. Cook until peppers are crisply tender
9. Add unsalted butter and garlic and toss gently to coat
10. Add cooked pasta and toss with chicken
11. Top with chopped fresh tomatoes and parmesan cheese
12. Add pepper to taste

title: stir fry asparagus
steps:
1. Skin asparagus , remove bottom woody parts and cut into 2cm pieces
2. Heat oil in wok till hot , add sliced garlic and fry till golden , remove from wok and keep aside for later use
3. Add in the crushed black pepper , fry for 1 minute
4. Now add asparagus and crab meat , stir fry for another 1 minute
5. Add soy sauce , oyster sauce , cayenne pepper and water and cornstarch mixture , stir and let simmer for 2 minutes or until gravy start to thicken
6. Check seasoning and add more salt if necessary
7. Add 2 to 3 dashes of sesame oil , stir and dish out into serving dish
8. Garnish with roasted peanut and fried garlic

title: lemony salmon patties
steps:
1. Combine the first nine ingredients
2. Mix well
3. Spoon into eight greased muffin cups , using 1 / 4 cup in each
4. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes or until browned
5. Meanwhile , melt butter in a saucepan
6. Stir in the flour to form a smooth paste
7. Gradually stir in milk
8. Bring to a boil over medium heat , stirring constantly
9. Cook for 2 minutes or until thickened
10. Remove from the heat
11. Stir in lemon juice , salt and cayenne
12. Serve over patties

title: cashew crusted chicken breast
steps:
1. Slice chicken into thin strips
2. Dredge in flour seasoned with salt and pepper
3. Dip in beaten egg
4. Crush nuts in food processor with bread crumbs until finely chopped , but not mushy
5. Dredge chicken in nut mixture
6. Fry in hot oil until browned on both sides
7. Add cognac and butter to pan drippings and boil for a minute
8. Pour over chicken

title: dairy free potato leek soup
steps:
1. Please
2. Bring vegetable broth to a boil in a 4 quart pot
3. Add diced potatoes and cover the pot
4. Allow to simmer until tender
5. Chop the bacon into 1 / 2 inch chunks and cook in a large pan
6. Slice the leeks thinly , using only the bulb and the lighter green parts of the leaves
7. Once the bacon is crispy , remove the bacon pieces , leaving the grease
8. Set bacon aside
9. Saut the leeks in the bacon grease until the darkest slices yield slightly to a spoon or spatula
10. Cover and allow to steam for 2-3 minutes until the dark slices cut easily with the edge of your stirring utensil
11. Add the cooked leeks to your potatoes
12. Using a hand blender or food processor , blend the potatoes and the leeks , slowly adding the soy cream and the spices
13. Gently fold in bacon pieces
14. Serve hot , or chill for a great summer cool down

title: vietnamese lemongrass porkabobs   thit lui
steps:
1. Slice pork into long thin slices , less than 1 / 4" thick
2. Place pork into marinade ingredients and allow to rest at least 2 hours , up to overnight
3. Thread the pork onto bamboo skewers that have soaked in warm water for at least 20-30 minutes
4. Grill over medium-hot coals or heat for about 5 minutes , or until done
5. Alternatively , meat can be cooked in the broiler
6. Serve with nuac mam

title: donut balls  healthy  yes healthy
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray a 12 hole mini muffin pan with butter flavored cooking spray
3. In a medium bowl , combine baking mix , 1 / 4 cup splenda and 1 / 2 teaspoon cinnamon
4. Add egg , skim milk and vanilla extract
5. Mix well to combine
6. Drop by spoonfuls into prepared muffin pan
7. Bake for 14 to 16 minutes
8. Place muffin pan on a wire rack and cool for 10 minutes
9. Remove balls from pan
10. In a ziploc plastic bag , combine sugar coating ingredients and place warm donut balls in 2 or 3 at a time and shake to coat

title: spiced poached pears
steps:
1. Combine the water , red wine , lemon juice , sugar and spices in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil
2. Reduce heat and simmer gently for 5 minutes
3. Place the pears in an ovenproof dish and pour the syrup over them
4. Poach at 150c for 20 - 25 minutes or until tender
5. Pour a small amount of the syrup in the bottom of dessert dishes and place the pears on top
6. Serve with whipped cream

title: butterbeer  alcoholic
steps:
1. Add ice cubes to tall glass
2. Add vodka
3. Add schnapps
4. Add soda
5. Enjoy and drink responsibly
6. I used ounce measurement because this site doesn't accept "parts" as a valid measure
7. But basically , it's equal parts vodka and schnapps to half as much soda
8. You can adjust the soda for a less strong version

title: pineapple cream cheese pudding  no sugar added
steps:
1. Mix splenda and cream cheese together
2. Add cool whip and pineapple

title: penne with tomato  black olives and feta
steps:
1. In a large pot of boiling water , cook pasta until tender but firm , drain and return to pot to keep warm
2. Meanwhile , in a large non-stick skillet , heat oil & chili pepper flakes over medium heat
3. Stir in garlic
4. Add tomatoes and cook , stirring , for 3 minutes or until heated through
5. Transfer to pot with drained pasta
6. Add olives , feta cheese and basil
7. Toss gently to mix
8. Sprinkle each serving with parmesan

title: sweet potato pone aka potato pound of belize
steps:
1. Grease a 9x13 pyrex dish
2. Preheat oven to 450
3. Wash , peel , and grate sweet potatoes
4. In large bowl , combine sweet potatoes , ginger , raisins , cinnamon , sugar and vanilla
5. Mix well
6. Add milk and butter
7. Stirring to incorporate throughout mixture
8. Pour into pyrex dish
9. Bake on the bottom shelf of your oven for 30 minutes
10. Lower oven temperature to 350
11. Move dish to top shelf
12. Cook for an additional hour until top is brown , knife comes out clean
13. The top will look very sticky

title: so easy sticky apricot garlic glazed chicken
steps:
1. In a small saucepan combine the apricot preserves , white wine vinegar , hot mustard and garlic , whisk over medium heat until the preserves melt
2. Set aside
3. Set oven to broil heat , or heat outdoor grill to medium-high heat
4. Season the chicken pieces with seasoning salt and pepper
5. Place the chicken skin-side down on a broiler rack
6. Broil chicken for 20 minutes , turn over the chicken and continue to broil or grill for about another 15-20 minutes brushing with glaze and turning occasionally

title: filet of beef with mustard cream sauce
steps:
1. Melt butter in heavy , cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add steaks and cook to desired doneness , about 4 minutes per side for rare
3. Add mustard , worcestershire sauce and shallot to skillet
4. Season with pepper
5. Add brandy and ignite
6. When flames subside , return to heat
7. Transfer steaks to plates
8. Add cream to skillet and boil until reduced to thin sauce consistency , about 2 minutes
9. Pour over steaks and serve

title: mom s almond cookies
steps:
1. Blend criscoe and butter together
2. Mix in remaining ingrediants , blending well
3. Chill
4. I often make the dough one day , bake them the next
5. Just wrap dough in saran and put in the fridge
6. Take dough out of fridge
7. Let warm slightly , and then roll into shape-- round and crescents
8. Do not make them too large or they won't bake well
9. Bake on an ungreased cookie sheet at 350 degrees , until just lightly coloured
10. Take out of oven
11. Roll in icing sugar x 2
12. I use 2 9x13 pans for this
13. Place on board to cool
14. These freeze very well and can be served right from the freezer

title: rock bun
steps:
1. Combine butter and sugar , mix well
2. Add egg and vanilla
3. Stir in flour , baking powder , raisins , and spices
4. Roll into buns
5. Bake at 350f till done , about 30 minutes

title: big mac salad
steps:
1. Toast all eight pieces of bread until just lightly golden-brown
2. Let cool and cut into cubes
3. Set aside
4. Brown and drain the extra lean ground beef
5. Let cool
6. In a large bowl , combine the cooked and cooled ground beef , toasted bread cubes , finely chopped onions , shredded lettuce and cheese
7. Toss well
8. Place in a large salad / serving bowl
9. In a seperate small bowl , stir together the mayonnaise , ketchup , relish , salt and pepper
10. Drizzle the dressing over the salad
11. You can either leave it drizzled or toss everything to evenly coat salad
12. Sprinkle with sesame seeds

title: panko crusted fish served over kale
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 ? f
2. Spray a small baking dish with cooking spray
3. In a small dish , whisk melted earth balance , lemon juice , garlic powder , and salt well
4. In a separate dish , make an even layer of panko breadcrumbs
5. Take one fish filet , and dip it in earth balance mixture
6. Flip the filet and dip again so both sides are covered
7. Press the skinless side of the filet into panko crumbs , then place the fish skin side down on prepared baking dish
8. Repeat with other filet , then sprinkle both with fresh parsley
9. Place baking dish into the oven and cook for 13 to 15 minutes
10. While that's cooking , start the salad
11. Lightly drizzle chopped
12. Kale with extra-virgin olive oil , and massage kale with your hands
13. Keep massaging for one minute , and allow kale to sit for about three minutes
14. To make the dressing , mix dijon , lemon juice , and 1 / 2 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil
15. Add the dressing to kale and toss evenly
16. To serve , prepare a small bed of half the kale salad and place fish right on top
17. Enjoy immediately

title: mini linzer cookies from barefoot conessa  ina garten
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. In the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the paddle attachment , mix together the butter and sugar until they are just combined
3. Add the vanilla
4. In a medium bowl , sift together the flour and salt , then add them to the butter-and-sugar mixture
5. Mix on low speed until the dough starts to come together
6. Dump onto a surface dusted with flour and shape into a flat disk
7. Wrap in plastic and chill for 30 minutes
8. Roll the dough 1 / 4-inch thick and cut 2 3 / 4-inch rounds with a plain or fluted cutter
9. With 1 / 2 of the rounds , cut a hole from the middle of each round with a heart or spade shaped cutter
10. Place all the cookies on an ungreased baking sheet and chill for 15 minutes
11. Bake the cookies for 20 to 25 minutes , until the edges begin to brown
12. Allow to cool to room temperature
13. Spread raspberry preserves on the flat side of each solid cookie
14. Dust the top of the cut-out cookies with confectioners' sugar and press the flat sides together , with the raspberry preserves in the middle and the confectioners' sugar on the top

title: feta and tomato spread dip
steps:
1. Break the feta into small chunks , add the olive oil , tomato paste and garlic and using a stick blender or a fork mix everything until you get a paste
2. Now add the herbs and the tomato cubes and stir with a spoon until well mixed , but without breaking up the tomato cubes too much

title: easy chocolate pancakes
steps:
1. Sift the flour into a bowl , add the sugar and salt , make a well in the centre and add the egg and egg yolk
2. Beat together until the flour is mixed in , gradually add the milk , then strain through a fine sieve
3. Melt half the butter and stir it into the batter
4. Add the orange liqueur or rum and leave the batter to stand for 1 hour
5. Melt a little of the remaining butter into a non-stick pan and spoon 1 / 8 of the batter into the pan , cook for 2-3 minutes on each side , or until almost cooked
6. Sprinkle a few chocolate chips over the pancake
7. When the pancake starts to melt , fold the pancake into quarters , and transfer it to a warm serving plate and keep warm while you cook the remaining pancakes
8. Dust the pancakes with icing sugar and serve with cream , yoghurt or icecream and your choice of berries or other fruit

title: orange barbecued ham
steps:
1. Mix orange juice , honey , chives , and oil
2. Score the ham in a diamond pattern
3. Pour the orange mixture over the ham and marinate 4-24 hours
4. Grill on low heat for 75-90 minutes , brushing with marinade
5. Mix the barbecue sauce , marmalade , and mustard
6. Cook 5-10 minutes until blended
7. Brush the glaze on the ham and grill 10-15 minutes more

title: asparagus and tomato skillet
steps:
1. Saute onion in bacon drippings until tender
2. Add bacon vinegar water sugar and salt
3. Bring to a boil over medium high heat
4. Add asparagus
5. Reduce heat to medium
6. Cover and cook 5 minutes
7. Cut tomatoes into eight wedges
8. Add to skillet and cook , covered for 3 to 5 minutes

title: perfect basic dinner rolls
steps:
1. Add water , yeast and sugar in mixing bowl , allow to bubble
2. Add salt and flour slowly , checking for consistency
3. You may need to use as much as 1 / 2 a cup extra flour- dough should be firm but slightly sticky
4. Place in greased bowl and allow to double
5. Flour your hands and separate into 12 rolls on greased pan
6. Allow to rise 15 minutes more
7. Bake at 350f for 15 minutes

title: garlic ginger beef appetizers
steps:
1. Slice the steak into very thin strips against the grain
2. Put strips in a bowl and add beaten eggs , salt and cornstarch and mix well until the meat is well coated
3. In a heavy skillet add cooking oil and heat on medium-high heat until oil reaches 360 degrees f
4. Carefully lay strips in a single layer in the hot oil- not too many as it will cause the oil to cool and the meat will end up absorbing too much oil
5. Fry until crisp which should only take about 60 to 90 seconds
6. Remove and drain on a rack
7. Repeat until all the meat strips are done
8. In a saucepan , add water and sugar and bring to a boil over medium heat
9. Gently swirl the pan to dissolve the sugar- do not stir
10. Boil until the mixture begins to caramelize to a light golden brown
11. Remove from the heat and gently stir in the garlic , ginger and chili flakes for 10 seconds then add the ketchup , vinegar , soy sauce and hoisin sauce
12. Return the pot to the heat and bring to a boil then gently simmer for 10 minutes
13. Add the drained meat slices and warm through
14. Serve the warm strips on a platter sprinkled with the slice green onion

title: mango sorbet with strawberry daiquiri sauce
steps:
1. For daiquiri sauce , in a blender container combine strawberries , sugar , rum , and lime juice
2. Cover and blend until smooth
3. Divide sorbet among 6 dishes
4. Pour daiquiri sauce around sorbet
5. Garnish with lime zest
6. Makes 6 servings

title: pumpkin walnut pie
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425
2. Mix crumbs with butter and sugar
3. Press into 10 inch pie plate
4. In lg bowl , mix pumpkin , milk , egg , and spices
5. Pour over crust
6. Bake for 15 minutes
7. Remove from oven
8. Reduce oven to 350
9. Combine brown sugar , flour , and cinnamon
10. Cut in butter until crumbly
11. Stir in walnuts
12. Sprinkle over pie
13. Bake 40 minutes , or until a knife comes out clean

title: 2 bean soup  crock pot
steps:
1. In a small skillet over medium heat , add fennel seeds and cook stirring for a few minutes or until seeds are toasted and fragrant
2. Remove from heat and transfer to a mortar and pestal and crush seeds
3. Set aside
4. In a skillet , heat oil over medium heat for 30 seconds or so
5. Add onions and carrots , stirring until vegetables are softened
6. Stir in toasted fennel seeds and cook stirring another minute
7. Add tomatoes with juice and bring to a boil
8. Transfer mixture to crock pot
9. Add broth , potatoes , white beans and green beans
10. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours
11. Season with salt and pepper
12. To make pistou -- in a food processor or blender combine basil , garlic and parmesan - process until smooth
13. Slowly add the olive oil through the food tube until combined
14. Ladle soup into bowls and top with the pistou

title: vegetable rice with vermicelli
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. First you will need to get out a 3 or 4 quart casserole or baking dish that has a lid
3. Take 1 of the 3 tablespoons of butter , and rub it along the inside of your dish
4. Add uncooked rice and set aside
5. In a pan , melt 2 tablespoons of butter , and add spaghetti pieces and toss occasionally until nice and brown
6. Do not burn them !
7. But allow them to get nice and brown
8. Add to rice
9. In same pan , add olive oil , and heat over medium high heat
10. Add onion , carrot , and celery to pan and saute for approx 7-8 minutes until all are slightly tender
11. Add mixture to dish with rice and vermicelli
12. Put vegetable broth and water in a saucepan and heat until slightly boiling
13. Add bouillon cubes and turn down heat , stirring until cubes dissolve completely
14. Pour broth mixture over rice and vegetables and stir through
15. Add bay leaf
16. Cover with lid , and put in your preheated oven
17. You will need to cook this approximately 40-55 minutes , depending on your oven
18. Please watch after 40 minutes
19. Broth will absorb and rice should be soft
20. Remove from oven and let sit , covered for 15 minutes
21. Remove lid , and remove bay leaves
22. Serve !

title: fiesta zucchini corn salsa
steps:
1. Saute zucchini and onions in oil for 5 minutes
2. Stir in corn and salsa
3. Cook for 2 minutes or until all veggies are tender
4. Serve with chicken or pork

title: mexican crock pot roast
steps:
1. Combine salsa , paste , water , seasoning mix and chilis
2. Spoon 1 / 2 the mixture into the bottom of a crock pot
3. Add the roast and top with the remaining mixture
4. Cover and cook 8-10 hours on low

title: fruited barbecue chicken
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except chicken and oranges in slow cooker
2. Stir well , then add chicken breast pieces
3. Cover and cook on high for 4 hours
4. When you have 10-15 minutes before it is done , stir in oranges , and serve

title: old fashioned crumb cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f and grease an 8" baking pan
2. Line pan with parchment paper and lightly oil
3. Mix shortening , sugar , and 2 cups of flours until it is crumbly and fine
4. Reserve 3 / 4 of this mixture and set off to side
5. Sift the rest of the flour and add to it the baking powder , cinnamon , and salt
6. Combine the crumb mixture
7. Add the egg and milk , mixing well
8. Pour into prepared pan
9. Take the reserved crumbs and sprinkle it on top of the cake
10. Bake in oven for 35 - 40 minutes

title: german style eiskaffee  iced coffee drink
steps:
1. Place ice cream scoop into a decorative wine goblet or tall clear drinking glass
2. Add coffee to fill glass 1 / 2-3 / 4 full
3. Completely cover with a mountain of sweetened whipped cream - the whipped cream should be plentiful and just start to peak over the top of the glass rim
4. Sprinkle with freshly grated good quality chocolate
5. Stick a wafer cookie into the whipped cream off to the side
6. Serve with some sugar on the side , a long spoon , and a straw

title: cheddar biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Mix flour and baking powder
3. Cut in cream cheese to form crumbly mixture
4. Stir in milk until dough holds together
5. Knead dough on lightly floured surface and pat or roll in 1 / 2 inch thick circle
6. Cut biscuits out with a 2 inch cutter and place on cookie sheet
7. Brush each biscuit lightly with beaten egg
8. Bake for 12- 15 minutes or until lightly browned

title: penne with tuna  peppers and tomato sauce
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large , deep skillet
2. Add garlic and red pepper flakes and cook 1-2 minutes , not browning
3. Add sweet peppers , tomatoes and tuna
4. Simmer 10 minutes , until sauce thickens
5. Add olives , capers , vinegar and pepper
6. While sauce simmers , cook pasta according to package directions
7. Drain
8. Toss pasta with the sauce and sprinkle with parsley
9. Top with croutons or parmesan cheese if desired

title: cilantro serrano chile rice
steps:
1. Use a one-quart saucepan over high heat
2. Combine chicken stock , salt and rice
3. Bring the mixture to a boil and stir well
4. Cover the pan and reduce heat to very low
5. Simmer until all the water is absorbed , 15-18 minutes
6. Combine the butter , onion , chile , and cilantro in a small bowl
7. Stir this mixture into the hot rice until butter melts
8. Cover the pan and let it stand for five minutes
9. Serve

title: serbian gjuwetsch  a one pot dinner
steps:
1. Chop onion fine and fry in oil with meat until golden brown
2. Sprinkle with paprika
3. Add tomatoes , quartered , and peppers cut in long strips
4. Season with salt and pepper and cook 5 minutes
5. Add water and rice
6. Simmer for about 25 minutes or until rice is tender

title: apple and carrot salad  ww   2 pts
steps:
1. Place apples in a large bowl and toss with lemon juice
2. Add carrots , chives , oil , sugar , salt , pepper and cheese
3. Toss to mix thoroughly

title: italian spinach bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a medium bowl , combine spinach , ricotta , garlic , salt and pepper
3. Spread 1 / 2 the spinach mixture in the bottom of 8x8 inch baking dish and top with 1 sliced tomato
4. Repeat layers and top with shredded cheeses
5. Bake 20 minutes

title: olive garden seafood portofino   lower fat
steps:
1. Portofino sauce:
2. Start by getting your ingredients ready
3. Dice the onion
4. Melt butter on medium heat
5. Add diced onion and garlic , stirring frequently , about 5 minutes until onion is soft
6. Add white wine
7. Turn up heat to high until boiling then back down to medium
8. Cook 5 minutes on medium
9. Stir in clam juice , shrimp stock , and old bay seasoning
10. Stir together milk and half-and-half
11. Add cornstarch to this mixture , 1 tablespoon at first
12. Stir milk mixture in slowly , allowing the sauce to thicken
13. Add about half at first , slowly , while stirring
14. If you'd like a thicker sauce , add more cornstarch to milk mixture
15. Continue to add milk mixture slowly , making sure that sauce is the desired thickness
16. The sauce is now ready ! it can be store for up to one week in the refrigerator
17. I like to freeze it in ice cube trays and use whenever i like
18. Seafood portofino:
19. Heat oil in saute pan over medium flame
20. Put mushrooms inches cook 2 minutes
21. Add mussels , and cook 30 seconds
22. Add shrimp , crawfish , and scallops
23. Cook until heated through , stirring
24. Add portofino sauce
25. Cook until bubbling throughout
26. Move mushrooms and seafood to one side of pan
27. Add linguine to other side
28. Using tongs , coat pasta with sauce

title: butter biscuits
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a medium glass bowl
2. Mix in flour , baking soda , and sour cream
3. Divide batter evenly into the cups of an 8-cup muffin pan
4. Bake at 350 degrees for 25-30 minutes

title: cheesy pork  rice and black bean casserole
steps:
1. Season the pork cubes with salt and black pepper
2. Heat oil in a skillet
3. Add in the pork and brown on all sides or until cooked through
4. Add in the onions , garlic and dried chili flakes the last 3 minutes of cooking
5. Transfer mixture to a greased 2 or 3-quart casserole dish
6. Add in all remaining ingredients mix with wooden spoon to combine
7. Bake in a 375 degree oven uncovered for 25-30 minutes or until the rice is tender
8. Sprinkle with shredded cheese
9. Return to oven for 4-5 minutes or until the cheese is bubbley
10. Serve with sour cream on the side

title: chocolate espresso mini souffles
steps:
1. Lightly butter two 6-oz
2. Ramekins and dust with granulated sugar , tapping out excess
3. Set the ramekins on a small baking sheet
4. Stir together the liquor or water and the espresso powder
5. Set aside and stir occasionally until the coffee is dissolved
6. Melt the chocolate and butter in a medium metal bowl over a pan of simmering water or in a microwave
7. Remove from the heat and whisk until glossy and smooth
8. Stir in the coffee mixture and the salt
9. Whisk in the egg yolks , one at a time
10. Add about one-third of the confectioners' sugar and whisk until well blended and smooth
11. Set aside
12. In a medium bowl , beat the egg whites with an electric mixer on medium-high speed until they're very foamy and they're just beginning to hold soft peaks
13. Increase the speed to high and gradually sprinkle in the remaining confectioners' sugar
14. Continue beating until the peaks are firm and glossy
15. Spoon about one-quarter of the beaten whites into the chocolate mixture and whisk until blended
16. Add the remaining whites and gently fold them in until just blended
17. Pour evenly into prepared ramekins
18. If you want to bake the souffls within 24 hours , refrigerate them
19. If you want to hold them for longer , freeze them according to the make-ahead
20. Heat the oven to 400f unwrap the ramekins , set them on a baking sheet , and bake until they're puffed and risen about 1 inch above the ramekin , 15 minute the top will still be slightly sunken in the center
21. Consider it a place to pop in a few berries or a dollop of whipped cream
22. Remove the souffls from the oven and serve immediately
23. Make ahead
24. To bake straight from the freezer , unwrap the ramekins and set on a small baking sheet or jellyroll pan
25. Let them sit for 20 minute while heating the oven to 400f bake on the baking sheet until puffed and risen about 1 inch above the ramekin , 18 minute remove from the oven and serve immediately

title: greek chicken pita salad
steps:
1. Combine the first 5 ingredients in a large bowl
2. Combine the yogurt or sour cream , mayo , oregano and the mimced garlic in a small bowl
3. Pour the yogurt mixture over the chicken mixture
4. Toss well
5. Cover , and chill in the refrigerator for 2 or more hours
6. Line each pita half with a lettuce leaf , and top with 1 / 2 cup chicken mixture

title: smothered chicken and green bean skillet
steps:
1. Heat large nonstick skillet on med-high heat
2. Add chicken
3. Cover
4. Cook 5-7 minutes per side until done
5. Remove from skillet
6. Add green beans , soup , water , and thyme to skillet and cover
7. Cook 6 minutes , stirring often
8. Return chicken to skillet
9. Cook 1 minute or until hot
10. Top with cheese and serve

title: vegetarian lasagne rolls
steps:
1. Combine ricotta , spinach , egg
2. Spread each noodle with mixture
3. Roll up
4. Place in greased 13 x 9 inch pan
5. Cover with spaghetti sauce
6. Cover loosely with foil
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes
8. Remove foil
9. Sprinkle with parmesan
10. Cook an additional 10 minutes
11. To make ahead assemble as directed and refrigerate before cooking
12. You will need to add additional cooking time , however

title: noodles and tomatoes
steps:
1. Prepare the pasta according to pacakge directions and drain well
2. While the pasta is draining , melt the butter in the pasta pot
3. Add the pasta back to the pot , mix well
4. Add the crushed tomatoes , mix well and serve

title: strawberry pretzel jell o
steps:
1. Crust: combine pretzels , butter , and 1 / 4 cup sugar
2. Press into 9" x 13" baking dish and bake at 350 for 10 minutes
3. Cool to room temperature
4. White layer: cream together cream cheese and 1 cup sugar
5. Fold in cool whip
6. Spread over pretzel crust
7. Red layer: dissolve gelatin in boiling water
8. Stir in frozen strawberries , chill until partially set and spread over white layer
9. Chill until set and serve

title: italian sausage meatballs
steps:
1. Put all ingredients in a large mixing bowl
2. Mix together throughly
3. Using the palm of your hands
4. Roll into a ball shape
5. About one inch diameter
6. Place oil in a frying pan over medium heat
7. Place meatballs in hot oils
8. Move them around continuously to ensure that they do not burn , and are throughly cooked
9. Cook for 5 to 7 minutes
10. Remove from oil and sit on paper towel to absorb any oil
11. Add to your favorite sauce

title: buffalo chicken soup or dip
steps:
1. In 2-qt saucepan over medium-high heat , saute onions and celery in butter until tender
2. Stir flour into pan
3. Slowly whisk in milk , broth , and beer
4. Add more or less liquid depending on how thick you want it
5. Stir in remaining ingredients and simmer over medium-high heat , stirring occasionally , until cheese melts
6. For the buffalo wing sauce , i use 1 / 2 jar of hooter's sauce but you can use whatever you prefer
7. Serve with celery sticks & ranch or bleu cheese dressing on the side , and crusty bread for dipping
8. Can also be served thick out of a bread bowl

title: chicpea salad sandwiches
steps:
1. Smash the chickpeas to how thin you want the spread
2. Mix in the celery stalk , onion , mayonnaise , salt , pepper , parsley , dill seed , chopped celery , and lemon juice into the spread
3. Make sure the spread is mixed well
4. Spread the spread onto a slice of bread and then place another slice of bread ontop to create a sandwich
5. Serve and enjoy !

title: pop s half sour pickles
steps:
1. Scrub cucumbers under cold water
2. Pack whole tightly in jar
3. In a seperate bowl , mix water , garlic , pickling salt , and pickling spice
4. Stir well and pour over cucumbers
5. Add additional warm water , if needed , to fill the jar
6. Cover and refrigerate 4-5 days for maximum flavor

title: gluten free chocolate molten lava cake
steps:
1. 4- 6 ounce ramekins or creme brulee dishes
2. Melt the chocolate & butter together in a double boiler
3. In the meantime , whisk together the rest of the ingredients in a separate bowl
4. Prepare the ramekins by covering the insides with a thin film of butter , then add enough white sugar to coat the film of butter
5. Remove excess sugar
6. When the chocolate and butter have melted , pour them into the egg mixture and whisk together
7. The batter will thicken as you whisk it together
8. Fill the ramekins 3 / 4 full , leaving enough room for the cake to raise
9. Because this desert is served straight out of the oven , refrigerate until just before you need them
10. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f and then put them in on a cookie sheet or tray
11. You'll want to under bake them so that the center stays soft
12. If you've refrigerated them beforehand , it will take a little longer , about 15 to 20 minutes
13. If you are baking them right away , 10 to 15 minutes should do it
14. Check them every 5 minutes or so , and more often near the end
15. You don't want to overdo it , because then the center isn't soft and runny
16. To serve , gently invert the ramekin onto a plate and dust with powdered sugar
17. Vanila ice cream goes really well with this rich chocolate dessert
18. You can use any 6 ounce oven ware containers to make these if you don't have ramkins

title: delfina s insalata del campo
steps:
1. Whisk together the oil , vinegar , shallot , salt and pepper
2. Core the radicchio and cut crosswise into thin ribbons
3. Tear the frisee into small pieces
4. Combine the radicchio , frisee and arugula in a salad bowl
5. Add the walnuts
6. Render the pancetta slowly in a skillet until almost crisp
7. Drain briefly on paper towels , then cut into 1 / 4-inch-wide slices
8. Add to the salad
9. Toss the greens with the vinaigrette
10. Taste and adjust seasoning
11. Using a vegetable peeler , shave as much parmesan as you like into the salad
12. Toss again gently
13. Shave a little more parmesan on top
14. If pancetta isn't available , you can use bacon instead

title: asian turkey burger
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the turkey , applesauce , hoisin and soy sauces , sesame oil , ginger , garlic , scallions and salt and pepper to taste
2. Form the meat into 6 patties
3. Lightly brush a grill pan or skillet with the sesame oil and place over medium-high heat
4. Add the patties and fry until golden , about 4 minutes
5. Turn and cook until the other side is golden and the turkey is cooked through , about 5 minutes
6. Transfer to a bun
7. Serve immediately

title: frosted banana bars
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , cream butter and sugar
2. Add eggs , sour cream and vanilla
3. Combine flour , baking soda and salt
4. Gradually add to the creamed mixture
5. Stir in bananas
6. Spread into a greased 15x10x-inch baking pan
7. Bake at 350 for 20-25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
8. Cool
9. For frosting , in a mixing bowl , beat cream cheese , butter and vanilla
10. Gradually beat in enough confectioners' sugar to achieve desired consistency
11. Frost bars
12. Store in the refrigerator

title: chicken in cilantro sauce
steps:
1. Marinate chicken in mixture of oregano , garlic salt , pepper and vinegar
2. Meanwhile , combine cilantro , onion , tomatoes , green pepper and chile in blender and blend until smooth
3. Set aside
4. Heat oil in skillet , add onion and season to taste with paprika
5. Cook until onion is tender and golden
6. Add cilantro sauce and cook 2 minutes
7. Add chicken pieces and water to cover and cook until chicken is tender , about 45 to 55 minutes

title: walnut pie crust recipe
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. You will need one buttered , nine-inch deep-dish pie pan either a light-colored or glass pan
3. Place the flour , sugar , cinnamon , and salt in a small bowl and stir to combine
4. Place the nuts in a food processor or blender and pulse just long enough to chop the nuts finely , not into a paste
5. Scrape the nuts into the flour mixture and stir to combine
6. Add the melted butter and combine well
7. Press the mixture into the buttered pie pan making certain that the crust is of even thickness
8. Bake for 15 to 18 minutes or until it just starts to brown on the edges
9. Do not over bake
10. A light-colored or glass pan will absorb less heat than a dark one and help ensure against over baking

title: bacon ranch corn salad
steps:
1. Add all ingredients together in mixing bowl and stir gently until well blended
2. Chill for a few hours or overnight
3. Serve cold

title: granny s special sloppy joes
steps:
1. Mix together ground beef , and onion , and fry til done
2. Add rest of ingredients
3. Simmer til hot
4. Serve on hamburger buns

title: beef sirloin stir fry with orange garlic sauce
steps:
1. Cut beef across grain into thin strips
2. Mix with 1 tbsp of the soy sauce , cornstarch and 1 / 2 tsp pepper
3. Cut carrots into thirds
4. Thinly slice lengthwise
5. Grate 1 / 4 tsp of the orange rind
6. Place in small bowl
7. Juice orange , discarding pulp
8. Add juice to bowl with remaining soy sauce , rice vinegar and sesame oil
9. Stir in generous pinch of sugar until dissolved
10. Set aside
11. In wok or skillet , heat 1 cup oil over high heat
12. Fry half of the beef until lightly browned , 30 to 60 seconds
13. Using slotted spoon , transfer to sieve set over bowl to drain any remaining oil
14. Repeat with remaining beef
15. Fry carrots until edges are browned , 4 to 5 minutes
16. Using slotted spoon , transfer to sieve
17. Pour out all but 1 tbsp of the oil
18. Add garlic and pinch of salt
19. Stir-fry until golden , about 20 seconds
20. Add orange mixture
21. When boiling , add beef and carrots
22. Stir-fry until sauce is thickened , about 30 seconds
23. Transfer to serving plate and sprinkle with onion

title: roast turkey with cornbread stuffing
steps:
1. To make cornbread:
2. In large bowl , stir together flour , cornmeal , sugar , baking powder , baking soda and salt
3. In separate bowl , whisk together eggs , buttermilk and butter , pour over dry ingredients , stirring just until moistened
4. Spoon into greased 13-x 9-inch cake pan
5. Baking this corn bread in a 13- x 9-inch cake pan makes it easy to cut into cubes for turkey s tuffing
6. Bake in center of 375f oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until bread is golden brown on top and tester inserted in center comes out clean
7. Let bread cool in pan on rack for 5 minutes
8. Turn out onto rack and let cool completely
9. To make roast turkey with cornbread stuffing:
10. In large skillet , melt butter over medium-high heat
11. Cook celery , onions , red and green peppers , garlic , sage , oregano , coriander , chili powder and salt , stirring often , for 10 minutes or until onions are softened
12. Meanwhile , cut corn bread into small cubes
13. Place in large bowl
14. Add vegetable mixture
15. Toss to combine
16. Drizzle with stock , tossing to moisten
17. Remove giblets and neck from turkey
18. Rinse turkey under cold water
19. Pat dry inside and out
20. Fill body cavity loosely with stuffing
21. Skewer opening closed
22. Repeat with neck cavity
23. Fold neck skin over stuffing and skewer to back
24. Tie legs together with kitchen string
25. Twist wings backward under back
26. Place turkey , breast side up , on greased rack in roasting pan
27. Blend together butter , sage , oregano and pepper
28. Rub over turkey
29. Tent loosely with foil , dull side out , leaving sides open
30. Roast turkey in 325f oven , basting every 30 minutes , for 3-1 / 2 hours
31. Remove foil
32. Place reserved wrapped stuffing in oven alongside pan
33. Roast , basting turkey once or twice and opening packet of stuffing for last 10 minutes of cooking , for 45 to 60 minutes longer or until meat thermometer inserted into thickest part of thigh registers 180f and juices run clear when turkey is pierced
34. Transfer to large warmed platter
35. Tent with foil and let stand for 20 minutes before carving
36. To make gravy:
37. Meanwhile , skim off fat in roasting pan
38. Using wooden spoon , stir flour into pan
39. Cook , stirring , over medium heat for 1 minute
40. Gradually whisk in stock and wine
41. Add salt and pepper
42. Bring to boil , stirring to scrape up brown bits from bottom of pan
43. Reduce heat and simmer , stirring often , for about 5 minutes
44. Strain into warmed gravy boat
45. Akes 8 servings
46. Or cover turkey with cold water , changing water occasionally , for 1 hour per pound
47. Contributor: canadian living yield: 8 servings

title: jamaican coffee soda
steps:
1. Into each of two tall 14-ounce glasses , measure 2 tablespoons coffee-flavored liqueur , 1 1 / 2 teaspoons instant-coffee granules or powder , and 1 teaspoon sugar
2. Stir mixture until coffee dissolves
3. Pour about 1 / 4 cup club soda into each glass and stir with coffee mixture
4. Spoon ice cream into glasses
5. Slowly pour remaining club soda over ice cream
6. Serve with iced-tea spoons and straws

title: rosemary cheese with fig preserves
steps:
1. Cheese -- add all the ingredients except the fig preserves and fresh figs and blend well in a food processor until well combined
2. You could also use a mixer if you don't have a food processor
3. Mold -- no i just use a small glass bowl or cereal or salad bowl which works great for this
4. Just line the bowl with plastic wrap and add the cheese and press into the bowl
5. Then top with another piece of the plastic wrap to cover well
6. Just chill 2-4 hours
7. Presentation -- un-mold the cheese onto a plate and top the the preserves
8. I will sometimes heat up the preserves for just a few seconds in the microwave to get a smooth consistency
9. Then garnish with the fresh figs

title: shrimp and sausage jambalaya
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat
2. Add sausage and cook for 2 minutes
3. Add onions , bell peppers and celery
4. Season with salt and cayenne and saute for 6 to 8 minutes or until golden , wilted and soft
5. Add rice and stir to coat evenly
6. Add tomatoes with juice , garlic , bay leaves , water and thyme
7. Cover and cook over medium heat for about 20 minutes
8. Season shrimp with salt and cayenne
9. Add to mixture and cook for 10 more minutes
10. Cook until rice is tender , liquid is absorbed and shrimp is pink
11. Remove from heat and let stand covered for about 5 minutes
12. Remove bay leaves and stir in green onions and serve

title: sylet red chicken curry
steps:
1. Puree the garlic , ginger , tomatoes , cumin , with the tomato puree in a blender
2. In a large pan heat the oil and fry the onions till soft
3. Add the chili powder and 1 / 4 cup of water , stir and bring to the boil
4. Add the coriander and turmeric cook for 1 min , add the garam masala , cook 1 minute add a little water if the paste becomes too thick
5. Add the chicken and a little salt , fry for 3 minutes
6. Add the tomato mixture , cook for 2 minutes
7. Add 3 cups of water and the stock cube , cook till meat falls from the bones
8. Add the vinegar , stir and serve

title: fuzzy navel shake
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in container of blender
2. Cover and process till smooth
3. Serve immediately

title: caramel pecan pull aparts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Cut rolls in half and roll in dry pudding mix
3. Grease an 10 inch fluted tube pan and alternate rolls with pecans
4. Sprinkle remaining pudding over rolls
5. Combine sugar and margarine in bowl
6. Microwave for 30 seconds or until margarine is melted
7. Stir and pour over rolls
8. Cover and let rise until rolls have nearly doubled in size
9. Uncover and bake at 350 for 15 minutes
10. Remove from oven , cover with foil and bake for 15 minutes more
11. Remove and invert onto a plate
12. Eat while warm !

title: weight watchers cornmeal pancakes
steps:
1. Lightly spoon flour into a dry measuring cup , level with a knife
2. Combine flour and next five ingredients in a large bowel , stir with whisk
3. Combine egg and next three ingredients in a bowl
4. Add egg mixture to flour mixture , stirring until well blended
5. Spoon 1 / 4 cup batter for each pancake onto a hot nonstick skillet
6. Turn pancakes when tops are covered with bubbles and edges look cooked

title: lemon bar cookies
steps:
1. Mix flour and powdered sugar together
2. Cut butter into flour mixture
3. Spray 9 x 13" baking dish with pam nonstick spray
4. Spread crust into bottom of pan and pat lightly
5. Bake at 350 for 20 minutes
6. Beat all of the topping ingredients together lightly
7. Pour over the toasted crust and bake an additional 25 minutes at 350
8. Cut into small squares
9. Be careful not to overcook or they get very crumbly
10. The crust should be slightly crumbly when you bite into it , but not fall apart in your hands
11. The topping should be the consistency of lemon meringue pie filling

title: frozen berry meringue  adapted for diabetic diet
steps:
1. Line a square serving dish with the graham crackers
2. (optional crust:
3. Preheat oven to 325 degrees fahrenheit
4. Combine cracker crumbs , sugar , butter and pecans
5. Press into the bottom of a 10" spring for pan
6. Bake for 10 minutes
7. Cool)
8. Filling: combine 2 cups of berries , splenda white and brown , egg whites , lemon juice , vanilla and salt in large bowl of mixer
9. Beat on low speed to blend , then on high speed until peaks form , about 15 minutes
10. In another bowl , beat cream until soft peaks form
11. Fold cool whip into berry mixture
12. Pour over graham crackers
13. Cover , and freeze overnight
14. To serve , carefully remove sides of pan and garnish if desired

title: fried twinkies
steps:
1. Freeze the twinkies for at least 2 hours
2. Can freeze overnight
3. Heat your oil in fryer to 375 degrees
4. Mix your batter as such: milk , vinegar , oil
5. In another bowl blend flour , baking powder and salt
6. Whisk wet ingredients into dry , mix until smooth
7. Refrigerate until oil reaches temperature
8. Insert sticks into twinkies , leaving enough of a end to hold
9. Dust with flour and dip into batter be sure batter covers the entire twinkie place twinkie in hot oil with utensil being sure the twinkie browns evenly about 3- 4 minutes
10. Remove to paper towel- cool 5 minutes
11. Serve with a berry sauce raspberries or mixed berry preserves heated until warm
12. Use for dipping

title: crockery pot delight
steps:
1. Coat beef cubes with the 1 / 2 cup flour
2. Brown in melted butter
3. Drain off excess fat
4. In crockery pot , combine all browned meat with onion , salt , pepper , garlic and beer
5. Cover and cook on low 5-7 hours or all day until meat is tender
6. Turn crockery pot to high
7. Dissolve remaining 1 / 4 cup flour in small amount of water
8. Stir into meat mixture , cook on high 30-40 minutes
9. Serve with rice and salad for a complete meal

title: sweet pastry dough
steps:
1. Mix flour , salt and sugar
2. Cut in butter until crumbly
3. Mix beaten egg yolks , ice water and vanilla together
4. Mix into flour mixture until pastry just holds together
5. Knead in plastic wrap until smooth
6. Flatten
7. Chill 1 hour
8. To partially blind bake: set oven at 400 degrees fahrenheit
9. Bake 15 to20 minutes , weighing pastry down with a layer of foil and dried beans

title: mashed garlicky potatoes with portabello gravy
steps:
1. Make portobello gravy:
2. Heat oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat
3. Add onion and garlic
4. Cook , stirring often , until softened , about 5 minutes
5. Add mushrooms and cook , stirring often , until they begin to release their juices , about 10 minutes
6. Add broth , tamari , thyme and sage
7. Simmer for 10 minutes
8. Mix cornstarch and water in a small bowl
9. Stir into the sauce and simmer , stirring often , until slightly thickened , about 10 minutes more
10. Season with pepper
11. If you prefer a smooth gravy , pass it through a fine sieve
12. Make potatoes:
13. Place potatoes and garlic in a large pot , cover with lightly salted water and bring to a boil
14. Cover and cook over medium heat until the potatoes are tender , about 20 minutes
15. Drain , reserving cooking liquid
16. Return the potatoes and garlic to the pot
17. Add butter
18. Mash the potatoes with a potato masher , adding 1 / 2 to 1 cup of the reserved liquid to make a creamy consistency
19. Season with salt and pepper
20. Transfer the mashed potatoes to a warmed serving bowl and serve with portobello gravy
21. Make ahead
22. Keep the potatoes hot , covered with parchment or wax paper , over a pan of barely simmering water for up to 1 hour

title: tarragon syrup
steps:
1. In saucepan combine water and sugar
2. Bring to boiling over medium heat and stir until sugar is dissolved
3. Add the tarragon
4. Boil gently , uncovered , 2 minutes more
5. Remove from heat , cover
6. Strain
7. Discard tarragon
8. Move the syrup to a covered storage container
9. Recfigerate up to 2 weeks
10. Makes 2 cups

title: fire roasted stuffed poblano peppers  sp5
steps:
1. Roast poblanos over open flame
2. Put peppers in plastic bag and let peppers steam about 10 minutes
3. Remove charred skin , slit peppers and remove veins and seeds
4. Set aside
5. Grill chorrizo in pan , breaking it up as it cooks
6. When almost ready , remove chorrizo and then add the potatoes to chorrizo lard
7. Coat potatoes and and cook until lightly brown , add chorrizo and mix together
8. Add a cup enchilada sauce , lower temperature , cover and cook about 10 minutes till potatoes are done
9. Fill poblanos with potato mixture and set in a baking dish
10. Pour rest of enchilada sauce at bottom of dish and top poblanos with the cheese
11. Bake in oven at 325 degrees for about 20 minutes until cheese melted

title: quick and easy spinach bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray a baking sheet with non-stick cooking spray
3. In a large skillet heat olive oil over medium heat
4. Cook garlic until soft , do not brown
5. Add spinach and cook for 1 minute
6. Stir in salt , pepper , and parmesean
7. Remove from heat and cool
8. On a lightly floured surface roll out pizza dough to a 10 x 14"rectangle
9. Evenlly spread out spinach mixture and sprinkle with mozzarella or mozzarella / feta mixture
10. Roll up the crust to make one large loaf
11. Pinch seam to seal place loaf on baking sheet
12. Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden brown

title: marshall field s chicken salad  with sandwich variations
steps:
1. Mix all dressing ingredients together in large bowl
2. Add chicken , green onion , pecans , and grapes if you are using them
3. Mix well
4. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours
5. Arrange lettuce leaves on plates and top each with a scoop of salad
6. Chef's
7. I shred my chicken the easy way using the plastic blade in my food processor and just giving it a few short pulses

title: bamieh  sephardic style okra
steps:
1. Saute the onion in olive oil until it begins to get soft
2. Add the garlic , okra , tomatoes , lemon juice , tomato sauce , salt , & pepper
3. Stir thoroughly
4. Cover
5. Cook over low heat for about 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
6. If mixture becomes too thick , add a bit of water

title: sour cream cherry pie
steps:
1. For crust: sift together flour , orange zest and salt
2. Using a pastry blender or two knives , cut in the shortening until the mixture looks crumbly , with most of the pieces the size of small peas
3. Sprinkle with some of the water , no more than 1 tbsp at a time , mixing gently with a fork to incorparate wenough water to form a dough ball- it will just start to stick together
4. Press into a ball
5. Wrap dough and chill for 20-30 minutes
6. Roll out on a floured board to 1 / 8" thickness
7. Place ungreased pie plate upside down onto the pastry and cut a circle of dough out , leaving at least a 1 inch border
8. Remove pie plate , flip right side up and carefully place pastry into the pie plate
9. Trim and flute the edges decoratively
10. Press the nuts into the bottom of the crust
11. For filling: in a small bowl , mix pie filling , lemon juice , and orange zest
12. Spoon over the crust
13. Beat eggs , sugar , vanilla , and almond extract until thick and lemony , approximately 10 minutes using an electric mixer
14. Stir in sour cream to the egg mixture , then pour over the cherry layer in the pie plate
15. Bake in a preheated 350 f oven on the lowest rack for 45 minutes , or until crust is brown
16. Let cool on rack , then chill well before serving

title: zucchini and summer squash casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease a 9 x 13 inch baking dish or casserole and set aside
3. In a large skillet , heat 2 tablespoons butter
4. Add onions and cook until tender
5. Add zucchini and yellow squash and cook , stirring until just tender
6. Season to taste with salt and pepper
7. Add the condensed soup , sour cream , and mushrooms , mixing well
8. In a large bowl , combine the melted butter with the stuffing mix
9. Pour half the stuffing mix into the baking dish
10. Layer the squash mixture over the stuffing mix
11. Cover with the remaining stuffing mix
12. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees f for 30-35 minutes , or until topping is golden brown and casserole is bubbly

title: shortbread lemon bars
steps:
1. In a food processor , combine flour , powdered sugar and lemon and orange peel
2. Cut in butter until crumbly
3. Process until mixture forms a ball
4. Pat into a greased 13x9 baking pan
5. Bake at 350 for 12-14 minutes or until set and the edges are lightly browned
6. Meanwhile , in a mixing bowl , combine the filling ingredients
7. Mix well
8. Pour over hot crust
9. Bake for 14-16 minutes or until set and lightly browned
10. Meanwhile , in a bowl , combine topping ingredients
11. Spread over filling
12. Bake 7-9 minutes longer or until topping is set
13. Cool on a wire rack
14. Refrigerate overnight
15. Cut into bars just before serving

title: french onion scallop
steps:
1. Heat oven to 325f degrees
2. Melt butter in a medium saucepan
3. Stir in flour , salt and pepper until a paste is made
4. Slowly add milk and whisk until smooth and thick
5. Add cheese and worcestershire sauce
6. Whisk until cheese is melted
7. Remove from heat
8. Place drained cooked onions in a casserole dish and pour cheese sauce over them
9. Sprinkle w / buttered crumbs
10. Bake until bubbly

title: shelly s chicken and zucchini couscous
steps:
1. In large pot , heat oil , add 1 / 4 tsp of salt and chopped onion
2. Cook until translucent , about 5 minutes
3. Add garlic , ginger , paprika , cumin , oregano , cayenne and turmeric and cook , stirring for 1 minute
4. Add broth , tomatoes and remaining 1 1 / 4 tsp salt
5. Bring to a simmer and cook , covered for 10 minutes
6. Add chicken , chickpeas , zucchini and bring back to a simmer
7. Cook , covered , until chicken and zucchini are just done , about 12 minutes longer
8. Add parsley and lemon juice and just let it"hang out" for several minutes or more-- does it good in my opinion
9. Serve over couscous

title: thai potato stir fry
steps:
1. Using a sharp knife , cut the potatoes into small cubes
2. Bring a large pan of water to a boil and cook the diced potatoes for 5 minutes
3. Drain thoroughly
4. Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet , swirling the oil around the bottom of the wok until it is really hot
5. Add the potatoes , diced bell peppers , strips of carrot and zucchini , and the garlic and chile to the wok , and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes
6. Stir in the scallions , coconut milk , chopped lemongrass , and the lime juice , and stir-fry the mixture for another 5 minutes
7. Add the lime zest and cilantro and stir-fry for 1 minute
8. Serve hot

title: dave s seitan po  boys with brown gravy  vegan
steps:
1. Saute the seitan , onion and garlic in oil until the onions soften and the seitan begins to brown
2. Add the soy sauce and balsamic vinegar and saute a little longer until all the ingredients mix together well and the vinegar cooks off a little
3. Remove from heat and set aside
4. Make a roux: whisk the flour in 1 / 4 cup oil over medium heat , be careful not to burn the flour
5. When the roux is brown , add 1 cup vegetable broth and stir or whisk until the texture is smooth
6. Whisk in more broth until the texture of the gravy is somewhere between thick and thin
7. Add the remaining ingredients and continue to stir to blend well
8. Add a little more kitchen bouquet and soy sauce if it's not dark enough , but don't go overboard
9. To assemble: add the seitan mixture to the gravy and stir everything up good
10. Slather your favorite vegan mayo and yellow mustard on some laterally sliced french bread , and pile on the seitan and gravy
11. While you're at it , add some sliced tomatoes and shredded lettuce and bite into that "dressed" po' boy sandwich !

title: lentil and tomato pie
steps:
1. Peel and chop the onion and fry it in the butter or margarine in a good sized saucepan until it's golden and beginning to soften , ,
2. Add the split red lentils and garlic and stir for a moment or two before adding the stock or water
3. Bring the mixture to the boil , half-cover with a lid and simmer for about 20 minutes , until the lentils are soft and pale golden
4. Remove the pan from the heat and add the tomatoes , cheese , basil , lemon juice , egg and salt and pepper
5. Leave the mixture to cool
6. Roll out about two thirds of the pastry and use to line an 8 inch flan dish or sandwich tin
7. Roll the remainder into a circle to fit the top of the dish
8. Preheat the oven to 400f , gas mark 6 ,
9. Spread the lentil mixture into the pastry case
10. Dampen the edges of the pastry with a little cold water , then put the pastry top on and press down lightly , crimping the edges
11. Prick the top and brush with a little beaten egg if you want a shiny finish
12. Bake in the preheated oven for about 40 minutes until the pastry is golden brown and crisp

title: kapusta
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil and melt the margarine in a large skillet
2. Cook the chopped onion until translucent
3. You can brown it if you like
4. Add the drained and rinsed sauerkraut and fry over medium high heat until slightly browned
5. Sprinkle liberally with paprika and not-so-liberally with garlic salt - i don't measure either so the quantities listed are approximate
6. Add the pork and beans to the pan and heat through
7. Then eat ! i usually serve this with ham steaks or kielbasa

title: matcha  green tea  shortbread cookies
steps:
1. Sift the flour , powdered tea and salt into a bowl
2. In a mixer bowl , beat butter and powdered sugar until fluffy
3. Add flour mixture to mixer bowl and mix slowly until dough just comes together
4. Pull dough together carefully in a log , approximately 2 inches in diameter
5. Wrap dough log and place in freezer for 30 minutes or until dough has firmed to the touch
6. Slice dough into 1 / 4 inch rounds and place on a parchment or silpat lined cookie sheet , approximately 1 inch apart
7. Bake in a preheated 325 degree f oven for 16 to 18 minutes , turning the pan halfway through the baking time
8. Remove cookies immediately from the cookie sheet and cool on a wire rack
9. Store in an airtight container or wrap well and freeze
10. The well-chilled cookie dough can also be rolled out and cut into desired shapes before baking

title: ladybug c o   tasty dish
steps:
1. On lettuce leaf , place the half cored apple red peel side facing up
2. Place dried fruit on apple with small dabs of peanut butter
3. Use one whole grape for the ladybug's head
4. Slice a small slit off the end of the grape so it stands up straight
5. Cut up the remaining grapes into thin pieces to make the ladybug's feet and antennae

title: baked steak
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Pound steak to tenderize
3. Dredge both sides in flour , salt and pepper
4. In heavy oven proof skillet heat oil , add steak and brown on both sides , remove add stock , bring to boil , scraping bits off pan
5. Add worcestershire sauce , more salt and pepper to taste
6. Remove from heat
7. Layer half the onions in pan , add steak , layer rest of onions , broth , spoon some broth on top
8. Bake for 2 hours , covered , basting steak after 1 hour
9. Remove to cutting board and slice
10. Serve with the gravy

title: southern party potatoes
steps:
1. Defrost potatoes and place into a 3-quart casserole dish
2. Combine butter , salt , pepper , onion , soup , sour cream and cheese
3. Mix thoroughly
4. Pour over potatoes
5. Mix 1 / 4 cup melted butter with corn flakes
6. Sprinkle over top
7. Cover and bake at 450f for 45 minutes

title: sicilian orange and basil salad
steps:
1. Peel and section oranges , cut each section in half
2. Peel red onion and slice it thinly
3. Tear basil leaves into bite size pieces
4. Drizzle with red wine vinegar
5. Salt and pepper
