6. Serve immediately

title: 2 by 4 soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan brown beef and drain excess fat
2. Add all other ingredients and stir together
3. Let cook , covered partially , on low until ready to eat and heated through
4. Serve with fritos and cheddar cheese :)
5. The cooking / preparation time is just approximate because you can make this recipe to fit your schedule

title: cajun fish patties
steps:
1. In a food processor , combine fish fillets , green shallots , garlic , fish sauce , coriander , lemon juice and cajun spice
2. Process until smooth
3. Form into 8 patties
4. Toss lightly in flour
5. Heat a non-stick frypan to medium heat and spray with cooking oil
6. Fry patties for 3-4 mins each side , in batches , till golden and cooked through
7. Enjoy

title: the best macaroni salad
steps:
1. Mix ingredients until well blended
2. Refrigerate
3. I usually make this a day ahead so that the flavors meld
4. Before serving , i usually add more miracle whip

title: creamy and healthy quick potato soup
steps:
1. Start -- in a large pot on medium heat , add the butter and melt , then add the garlic and cook just a minute
2. Next , add the onions , carrots and potatoes and cook another minute until mixed well
3. Add the broth , bay leaf and thyme and cook on medium until all the vegetables are soft
4. About 15 minutes
5. Puree -- first remove the bay leaf -- then just use an immersion blender
6. Or you can add the soup to a regular blender and blend until everything is a smooth texture
7. I love the immersion blender right in the pot , but both will work just fine
8. If using a regular blender return the soup to the pot
9. Then add the fresh parsley , heavy cream , salt and pepper to taste
10. Now this soup is thin , it is not meant to be thick
11. But if you want , mix a little water with the cornstarch to make a "slurry" and add to the soup and bring to a medium boil and it will thicken if you prefer it that way
12. Finish -- i like to top with a baguette with melted gruyere and put it right on top of the soup and then some crumbled bacon
13. You can really top it anyway you like
14. The soup is healthy and quick and just very light and easy

title: coconut soup  st  kitts
steps:
1. Combine coconut and chicken stock in a heavy saucepan
2. Cover and cook on simmer for 30 minutes
3. Strain through a sieve
4. Discard the coconut after pressing down to extract all liquid
5. Cream the the flour and butter together and stir into stock with the heavy cream , stirring over low heat , until soup is
6. Thickened
7. Season to taste with salt and pepper

title: grape tomato and avocado salad
steps:
1. Whisk together olive oil and vinegar in a salad bowl
2. Add salt and pepper to taste
3. Put the remaining ingredients in the bowl
4. Toss to combine
5. Season again to taste

title: saffron and leek mash
steps:
1. Cut the potatoes into chunks and boil in salted water until very soft
2. Meanwhile , heat half the butter in a small frying pan and add the leek , saffron and a little of the stock
3. Stir the leeks , adding more stock as it is absorbed until leeks are soft
4. A little stock should remain in the pan
5. Drain potatoes and roughly mash with the remaining butter
6. Add leek mixture and mix well
7. Warm the milk into the saucepan used for the leeks , blending with any sauce left around the edges of the pan
8. Mix milk with potatoes , mashing further until the leeks , saffron colouring and milk are evenly distributed

title: baked potato slices with two cheeses
steps:
1. Wash potatoes well and cut into thin slices , leaving the skin on
2. Place potatoes in a baking dish that has been sprayed with pam
3. Sprinkle with garlic salt , drizzle with butter and sprinkle with parsley
4. Bake at 425 for about 50 minutes
5. Remove from oven and top with cheeses
6. Bake an additional 10 to 15 minutes until lightly brown and cheeses are melted

title: bacon  cheese   scallion scones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Lightly grease a baking sheet or line it with parchment
3. Wisk together the flour , salt , baking powder and sugar
4. Work the butter into the flour until the mixture is unevenly crumbly
5. Mix in the cheese , chives and bacon until evenly distributed
6. Add 3 / 4 cup of the cream , stirring to combine
7. Try squeezing the dough together
8. If it's crumbly and won't hang together , or if there are crumbs remaining in the bottom of the bowl , add cream until the dough comes together
9. Transfer the shaggy dough to a well-floured work surface
10. Pat the dough into a smooth 7" disk about 3 / 4 inch thick
11. Transfer the dish to the prepared baking sheet
12. Use a knife or bench knife to cut the disk into 8 wedges , spreading the wedges apart a bit on the pan
13. Brush the scones with a bit of cream
14. This will help their crust brown
15. Bake the scones for 22-24 minutes , until they are golden brown
16. Remove them from the oven , and cool right onthe pan
17. Serve sarm or at room temperature

title: creamy orange bon bons
steps:
1. With a small ice cream scoop or melon baller , scoop balls of vanilla ice cream onto a cold cookie sheet lined with waxed paper
2. Place in freezer to refreeze the ice cream balls to firm
3. Put the chocolate in a microwave safe bowl and microwave at medium until liquid , about 1 1 / 2 minutes
4. Stop and stir every 30 seconds until melted , be careful not to burn it
5. Spread the orange drink powder onto a large plate
6. Roll the ice cream balls in the powder and put them back on the cookie sheet
7. Drizzle the melted chocolate over the ice cream balls
8. Return to the freezer until ready to serve
9. Enjoy !

title: frozen mocha almond shake
steps:
1. Combine all of the ingredients except for the frozen yogurt in blender
2. Blend until well combined
3. Add the frozen yogurt
4. Blend until just combined
5. Serve at once
6. Makes 2 servings

title: gang bao chicken
steps:
1. Coat wok or pan in chilli oil
2. Add chicken pieces and stir until just cooked and set aside
3. Into wok or pan add chilli , green onion , ginger , garlic , vinegar , stock or water and stir
4. Add sugar , cooking wine and light soy sauce and stir
5. It's really important here to make sure that everything reduces and caramelises
6. The restaurants green onions and dried chilli's are quite well cooked
7. Return chicken to the pan and mix ingredients together
8. When juice becomes slightly sticky add the nuts
9. Place in serving dish

title: dill pickle dip
steps:
1. Use a wooden spoon to press into the cream cheese then stir until loosened up and smooth
2. Stir in all of the remaining ingredients until evenly distributed
3. Transfer to a serving dish and cover with plastic wrap
4. Refrigerate for at least an hour before serving

title: tuna pasta florentine
steps:
1. Add the pasta to a pot of boiling water and cook for 8-10 minutes , until al dente , put aside
2. Fry the mushrooms until they stop giving off liquid , put aside
3. Heat the sour cream and pesto sauce in a pan until smooth
4. Add the spinach and cook for 5 minutes , until spinach is wilted
5. Add the pasta , mushrooms , tomatoes , tuna , oregano and lemon juice
6. Add salt , pepper and oregano to taste
7. Stir and cook gently for 5 minutes , until warmed through

title: bona fide barbecue sauce
steps:
1. Saut onion and garlic in butter until limp
2. Add remaining ingredients and simmer on low heat for 2 hours uncovered while stirring occasionally
3. After reading a review , i made this today by chopping my onion in the food processor quite fine before sauting
4. Wonderful , and less chunky
5. 10-21-07

title: world s best chocolate sour cream cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 345 degrees
2. Lightly grease 2 8" layer cake pans melt the chocolate- set aside sift sugar , flour , baking soda and salt togather into a large mixing bowl in a separate bowl , blend the hot coffee , sour cream , and vegetable oil with a whisk with the mixer on low speed , add the coffee mixture in a stream to the dry ingredients and mix until blended
3. Add the eggs one at a time and beat just until smooth add the chocolate and mix until until the batter in a uniform color
4. Divide the batter evenly and pour into prepared pans bake until the cake springs back to the touch
5. Do not wait for a crust to form
6. 35-38 minutes
7. Cool , frost , enjoy !

title: quick vegetarian wontons
steps:
1. Heat a teaspoon of oil in a wok on high heat
2. Add ginger and garlic
3. Stir fry for 10 seconds
4. Add coleslaw mix and stir fry for about a minute until cabbage is crisp tender
5. Add soysauce , chili oil , salt and pepper
6. Let filling cool
7. Keep wonton wrappers covered with a paper towel
8. Working with one wrapper at a time , place a heaping teaspoon of filling in the center
9. Brush sides with water and form a triangle
10. Press sides to seal
11. Bring the two opposite corners of the triangle together
12. Keep the filled wontons on a plate dusted with cornstarch , such that they do not touch each other
13. Steam for 15 minutes until done
14. Serve hot with soy sauce

title: standing rib roast
steps:
1. Place roast fat side up on rack in roasting pan
2. Mix spices , and rub into roast
3. Bake uncovered at 325f degrees for 2 1 / 2 hours for medium
4. Remove from oven and let stand for 15 minutes
5. Carve into slices

title: crustless country  quiche   omelete
steps:
1. Whip eggs and milk
2. Add butter and flour , whip some more
3. Stir in cheese , bacon , potato and onion
4. Add salt , pepper , basil
5. Spray some non-stick spray into a pie dish , pour in egg mix and bake at 375f for 45 minute

title: banana orange ice cream
steps:
1. Peel and mash bananas
2. Combine with lemon juice , salt , sugar and fresh orange juice
3. Fold confectioners' sugar into lightly whipped heavy cream
4. Add to banana mixture
5. Churn-freeze

title: athens linguine
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to directions and drain
2. Heat alfredo sauce and toss with pasta
3. Top with tomatoes , artichoke , feta and olives

title: chicken with white beans and escarole
steps:
1. - boil water and cook pasta noodles
2. After you drain them add a little butter to the noodles to keep them from getting sticky
3. - wash chicken and pat dry
4. Salt and pepper chicken on both sides
5. - heat olive oil in large saute pan until shimmering
6. - add chicken and brown for five minutes on each side
7. Remove chicken to plate and let rest
8. - drain pan of most of the chicken fat and return to med-low heat
9. Add diced onion
10. After onions turns opaque , add garlic
11. Cook until fragrant , about one minute
12. - add chopped escarole to onion mixture and saute until wilted , about three minutes
13. - add white beans , wine and chicken stock
14. Also add sage and red pepper flakes
15. Up heat and simmer five minutes until slightly reduced
16. - return chicken thighs to pan
17. Put lid on pan and turn heat to med-low
18. If you need to you may add more broth or wine
19. You want there to be a sauce for the noodles
20. - after about ten minutes flip chiken thighs and put lid back on
21. Simmer ten more minutes
22. - remove lid and add sherry
23. Simmer on low five more minutes and check thighs for doneness
24. May take a few minutes more depending on their size
25. Serve over buttered bow-tie pasta with grated parmesan to garnish

title: breed  oatcakes from the far northeast corner of scotland
steps:
1. Sprinkle a baking board with medium oatmeal
2. Mix together the ingredients and form into a ball
3. Place the mixture onto a baking board that has been sprinkled with a little medium oatmeal and roll out the mix to form a round about 1 / 8 inch thick
4. Cut into four triangles
5. Work quickly since the mixture becomes difficult to work with if it becomes cold
6. Put the oatcakes on a hot griddle and bake on one side only
7. Once the edges curl they are cooked and now must be placed on a rack or tea towel and allowed to dry off in a warm room
8. Store in an airtight cookie tin at room temperature
9. For the vegetarian / vegan option use vegetable oil

title: kathy s curried shrimp
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large skillet , med
2. To med
3. High heat
4. Add the green onions , green peppers , red peppers and mushrooms
5. Saute for approximately 4 minutes
6. Add 1 / 2 can of soup , curry , salt and pepper
7. Let sauce cook and thicken
8. Add shrimp
9. Add heavy cream
10. If it's too thick , you can add a little more heavy cream
11. Simmer for about 8 minutes , or until the shrimp is cooked through
12. Serve atop cooked wild rice
13. Enjoy !

title: pear granola with lemon cream
steps:
1. Slice the top off each pear and discard
2. Scoop out the pulp , leaving a 1 / 2-inch shell
3. Discard core and reserve pulp
4. Combine reserved pulp , granola , raisins , brown sugar , peanut butter , nutmeg , and cinnamon in a bowl and mix well
5. Fill each pear shell with some of the granola mixture
6. Place pears , bottom side down , in a baking dish
7. Add water to a depth of 1 inch
8. Bake at 400 degrees for 10 minutes
9. While pears are baking , combine yogurt , cream cheese , and lemon juice in a small bowl
10. Beat with mixer at medium speed until smooth
11. To serve , top each cooked pear with about 2 tablespoons of lemon cream

title: fish fillet with honey lemon sauce
steps:
1. Marinate fish fillets for at least 1 hour
2. Drain
3. Grease the non-stick frying pan with the cooking spray
4. Heat and grill the fish fillet until lightly brown , turn and grill the other side
5. Continue grilling until done
6. Transfer to a dish and set aside
7. Combine all the remaining ingredients except the green onions
8. Heat the mixture in a skillet for 1 minute
9. Stir in the green onions
10. Turn off the heat
11. Pour the mixture over the grilled fishes and serve

title: maple butter cream crepes
steps:
1. Combine ingredients for the crepes in blender container in order given
2. Blend for 1 minute
3. Scrape down sides of container with rubber spatula and blend for another 15 seconds or until smooth
4. Refrigerate batter for at least 1 hour
5. Cook crepes on crepe griddle as per manufacturers suggestion using 2 to 3 tablespoons of batter per crepe or in traditional pan
6. For the maple cream cut the butter into cubes and allow to reach room temperature
7. Blend 2 cups of the butter with the maple syrup and extract
8. Whip until light
9. Microwave serving plates until warm or place in prehated oven on low heat to warm
10. Melt the remaining 1 / 2 cup of butter and set aside
11. Spread cooked , warm crepes with the whipped butter mixture and quickly roll crepes up , drizzle lightly with melted butter
12. In desired sprinkle with powdered sugar and serve any left over whipped butter on the side
13. Please

title: paula deen s french onion soup
steps:
1. Saute onions and garlic in oil over low heat until tender and golden yellow
2. Sprinkle flour over onions , cook a few minutes more , browning the flour well
3. Add stock and wine and bring to a boil , add thyme and bay leaf
4. Reduce heat , cover , and simmer gently for 20 minutes or so
5. Add salt and pepper , to taste
6. Meanwhile , slice french bread into 3 / 4-inch slices and butter both sides
7. Toast slices on griddle until golden brown
8. Ladle soup into an ovenproof bowl , add toasted bread and cover with cheese
9. Place ovenproof bowl on a baking sheet lined with tin foil
10. Bake at 350 degrees 4 or 5 minutes under a hot broiler

title: luby s cafeteria chicken fried steak
steps:
1. In shallow bowl , whisk together eggs , milk , salt , seasoned salt , and pepper until well blended
2. Place flour in separate shallow bowl
3. Pound meat with meat mallet to thickness
4. Coat with flour , shaking off excess
5. Dip into egg mixture , then again into flour , coating evenly
6. Heat about 1 / 8 oil in large skillet over medium heat
7. Add meat and cook 3 to 4 minutes on each side or until browned and cooked through

title: cranberry cornbread
steps:
1. Beat melted butter , brown sugar and egg together in mixing bowl
2. Mix in buttermilk
3. Add cranberries and stir
4. Add cornmeal , flour baking powder and salt
5. Stir to moisten
6. Turn into greased 9x9 inch pan
7. Sprinkle with walnuts
8. Bake in 400f oven for about 25 minutes until an inserted wooden pick comes out clean
9. Best served warm

title: pineapple strawberry smoothie  2 pt  ww
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a blender and cover
2. Blend

title: slow cooker chicken with olives
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except chicken in a 4-1 / 2 quart crock pot
2. Mix well
3. Add chicken , stir until well mixed
4. Cover and cook on high heat setting for 5 hours or low heat setting for 8 hours or until chicken is cooked through and tender and potatoes can be easily pierced
5. Discard bay leaf
6. Remove excess fat on the chicken before adding to the post
7. I made 1 / 2 the recipe with success

title: butterfly cakes
steps:
1. Cream butter , vanilla and sugar until light and fluffy
2. Add eggs one at a time , beating well after each addition
3. Sift flour and baking powder together
4. Fold into the creamed mixture
5. Stir in milk
6. Place 18 cupcake cases in a cupcake tin
7. Spoon mixture evenly into paper cases
8. Bake at 190c for 15 minutes or until cakes spring back when lightly touched
9. Transfer to wire rack and allow them to cool completely
10. While cooling , mix all icing ingredients together and beat together until creamy
11. Cut a slice from the top of each cup cake
12. Cut this in half
13. Place a teaspoonful of the icing in each cavity
14. Arrange wings on cake

title: zucchini joe  ground beef or turkey with zucchini and egg
steps:
1. Crumble meat into large skillet , add onion and brown the two together
2. You shouldn't need any oil because the onion will cook in the fat of the meat but if you think it is really dry , add a very small amount of olive oil
3. Add zucchini and cook briefly
4. Add garlic , salt and seasonings to taste
5. Add eggs and stir gently while cooking over low heat until done
6. Serve with parmesan cheese

title: blueberry peach crumble
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
2. In a bowl , mix together peaches , blueberries , orange juice and zest
3. Place fruit in buttered 9" pie pan or 8" square baking pan
4. Set aside
5. Combine flour and brown sugar , then cut in 2 tbsp butter with pastry blender until mixture resembles small crumbs the size of peas
6. Sprinkle the flour mixture over fruit and dot with remaining 1 tbsp butter
7. Bake until peaches are cooked through and top is lightly browned and bubbling , about 30 minutes
8. Serve either hot or cold , topped with a drizzle of heavy cream , if desired
9. Also good with vanilla ice cream

title: spaghetti ai frutti di mare
steps:
1. Prepare the octopus:
2. Put octopus in a pressure cooker with water , bay leaf , and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and seal pressure cooker with lid , then cook at high pressure according to manufacturer's instructions 10 minutes
3. Put pressure cooker in sink and run cold water over lid until pressure goes down completely
4. Remove lid
5. Transfer octopus to a cutting board , reserving 1 / 2 cup cooking liquid
6. Cut off and discard head , then cut tentacles into 1-inch pieces
7. Prepare the tomato sauce:
8. Simmer tomatoes with their juice , basil , and olive oil in a heavy medium saucepan over medium heat , uncovered , stirring and mashing tomatoes occasionally , until thick and reduced to about 3 / 4 cup , 20 to 25 minutes
9. Prepare the basil puree:
10. Puree basil , olive oil , butter , and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt in a blender , scraping down side as necessary , until smooth
11. Transfer to a small bowl
12. Prepare the pasta and seafood:
13. Cook spaghetti in a pasta pot of boiling salted water until 'al dente'
14. Meanwhile , puree garlic and olive oil in cleaned blender until smooth
15. Heat a dry 12-inch heavy skillet over high heat until hot , 2 to 3 minutes
16. Add olive oil mixture , then immediately add octopus , shrimp , and mussels and saute , stirring occasionally , until shrimp are browned on edges and mussels begin to open , 2 to 3 minutes
17. Add tomato sauce and reserved octopus-cooking liquid and cook , stirring , until mussels just open wide and shrimp are just cooked through , about 2 minutes more
18. Season with salt and pepper
19. Drain pasta and return to pot
20. Add squid to hot seafood in skillet , stirring to combine , then add to hot pasta and toss to combine
21. Serve drizzled with all of basil puree
22. Octopus can be cooked 1 day ahead and chilled , uncovered , until cool , then covered
23. Tomato sauce can be made 1 day ahead and chilled , covered

title: butter rum ham and pineapple
steps:
1. Preheat 2-sided tabletop grill
2. Cut four 1 / 2-inch thick slices from ham
3. Place butter , brown sugar and rum extract in small microwave-safe bowl
4. Microwave on high 30&#8211
5. 45 seconds or until butter melts
6. Brush one side of ham with glaze and place on grill with glazed side down
7. Brush glaze on top of ham slices
8. Close grill lid , pressing down firmly to sear ham
9. Grill 4&#8211
10. 5 minutes , brushing once with remaining glaze , until internal temperature reaches 140f remove ham from grill and cover to keep warm
11. Cut pineapple into four 1 / 2- to 1-inch thick slices and place on grill
12. Close lid
13. Grill 1&#8211
14. 2 minutes until warm
15. Serve with ham

title: beef  n noodle casserole
steps:
1. In a fry pan brown the beef with the garlic , approximately
2. 10 min remove and put aside in a large mixing bowl spray the pan with veggie oil and add the onions& mushrooms cook until they are beginning to brown , approx 10 minutes
3. Add the fresh tomato and the zucchini , stir and add the tomato sauce & kernel corn
4. Sprinkle in the spices and jalapeo
5. Add pan contents to the meat and mix well
6. Meanwhile heat oven to 350f
7. Cook the raman noodles drain and add to the casserole
8. Turn the entire contents into an oven proof dish
9. Sprinkle with the can of fried onion and parmesan cheese
10. Heat through and until the cheese ad onions are browned
11. Serve

title: carrot layer cake with cream cheese frosting
steps:
1. For cake: preheat oven to 325f
2. Lightly grease two 9-inch-diameter cake pans with 1 1 / 2-inch-high sides
3. Line bottom of pans with waxed paper or parchment
4. Lightly grease waxed paper
5. Using electric mixer , beat sugar , vegetable oil , juice , vanilla extract and zest in bowl until combined
6. Add eggs 1 at a time , beating well after each addition
7. Sift flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt , cinnamon and nutmeg into sugar and oil mixture
8. Stir in carrots , chopped pecans and raisins
9. Pour batter into prepared pans , dividing equally
10. Bake until toothpick inserted into center comes out clean and cakes begin to pull away from sides of pans , about 45 minutes
11. Cool in pans on racks 15 minutes
12. Turn out cakes onto racks and cool completely
13. For frosting: using electric mixer , beat all ingredients in medium bowl until smooth and creamy
14. Place 1 cake layer on platter
15. Spread with a bit less than 1 / 2 the frosting
16. Top with the remaining cake layer
17. Using icing spatula , spread remaining frosting in decorative swirls over sides and top of cake
18. Serve cake cold or at room temperature

title: vegetable lo mein
steps:
1. Heat a large skillet over low heat while preparing onion , vegetables , garlic , and ginger and the flavoring sauce
2. Three to four minutes before stirfrying , turn on the exhaust fan and increase the heat to high
3. Put 1 t
4. Of oil and the onion in the skillet
5. Stir-fry until the onion is still crisp but starts to turn brown , about 1 minute
6. Add the mushroom , sir fry until tender crisp , about 1 minute
7. Add the cabbage , stir-fry about 1 minute or so longer
8. Stir in garlic and ginger
9. Transfer vegetable mixture to a plate and set aside
10. Put the remaining 1 t
11. Of oil in the skillet
12. Heat until shimmering
13. Add the spaghetti
14. Stir fry until heated through , about 2 minutes
15. Return the vegetable mixture to the pan , along with the lo mein flavoring sauce
16. Stir fry to combine and heat through
17. Serve immediately

title: strawberries and cream cheesecake tarts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Place 2 1 / 2" foil liners in 24 muffin cups
3. For crust:
4. Combine cake mix and melted butter in large bowl
5. Beat at low speed with electric mixer for 1 minute
6. Divide mixture evenly in muffin cups
7. Level , but do not press
8. For filling:
9. Combine cream cheese , eggs , 3 / 4 cup sugar and vanilla extract in medium bowl ,
10. Beat at medium speed with electric mixer until smooth
11. Spoon evenly into muffin cups
12. Bake at 350f for 20 minutes or until mixture is set
13. For topping:
14. Combine sour cream and 1 / 4 cup sugar in small bowl
15. Spoon evenly over cheesecakes
16. Return to oven
17. Bake for 5 minutes longer
18. Cool completely
19. Garnish each cheesecake with strawberry half
20. Refrigerate until ready to serve

title: red wine mushrooms the easy way
steps:
1. Allow butter to melt into the olive oil in a frying pan
2. Meanwhile slice the mushrooms to whatever thickness is your preference
3. Add mushrooms to pan and toss well in the oil and butter mix
4. Add garlic and season with salt and pepper
5. Add wine and stir well , allow to cook for 4-5 mins until mushrooms have taken up all the wine and are glazed with the oil and butter mix

title: easy butternut squash soup
steps:
1. Wash and dice the butternut squash
2. Deseed the chili
3. Peel the garlic
4. Place all 3 on a baking tray
5. Sprinkle olive oil over
6. Place in the oven at 180 for about 40 minutes or until the squash is cooked
7. Bring the stock to the boil
8. Add the baked ingredients
9. Blend with a stick blender
10. Season to taste

title: victoryred s redeye marinade for steak and chops
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in medium bowl whisk till well blended and smooth
2. Add your favorite steak or chops marinade for 5-10 hours in refidgerator

title: raspberry spritzers
steps:
1. At serving time , combine wine , soda and raspberry concentrate in a large pitcher or bowl
2. Garnish each drink with fresh raspberries

title: xifias souvlaki  grilled swordfish kebabs with vegetables
steps:
1. Whisk together olive oil and lemon juice until thick and creamy
2. Whisk in remaining marinade ingredients
3. Place swordfish cubes in a plastic bag and pour in marinade
4. Mix it around to make sure all the pieces get good and covered
5. Marinate for 2-3 hours , turning the bag occasionally
6. To make skewers , thread on a piece of swordfish , a bay leaf , a cherry tomato , a piece of pepper and a piece of onion
7. Repeat order
8. Grill over hot coals for 8-9 minutes , turning to cook evenly
9. Swordfish is done when juices bubble up

title: greek chicken with capers  raisins and feta
steps:
1. Place each chicken breast half between 2 sheets of plastic wrap
2. Flatten to 1 / 4 inch thickness using a meat mallet or rolling pin
3. Combine the flour and oregano in a shallow dish , dredge chicken in flour mixture
4. Heat oil in a large nonstick fry pan over medium high heat
5. Add chicken and cook for 4 minutes on each side
6. Remove chicken from pan , keep warm
7. Add onions to pan , saut 2 minutes
8. Stir in broth , raisins , and juice , cook 3 minutes , scraping pan to loosen browned bits
9. Return chicken to pan
10. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer for 8 minutes or until chicken is done
11. Place chicken on individual plates and keep warm
12. Stir capers into sauce , and top each chicken breast with 1 / 3 cup sauce and 1 tablespoon cheese
13. Garnish with lemon slices if desired

title: chewy chocolate peanut butter bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven 350 degrees
2. Beat brown sugar and butter in large mixer until creamy
3. Beat in corn syrup and vanilla
4. Stir in oats then press into greased 13 x 9 in baking pan
5. Bake for 15 minutes and cool slightly
6. Melt 1 cup chocolate chip morsels and peanut butter in small , heavy saucepan over lowest heat possible
7. Stirring until smooth
8. Spread over base then sprinkle with peanuts and remaining chocolate chips
9. Press down slightly
10. Chill 1 hour or until firm

title: thai chicken patties
steps:
1. Combine the mince , sauce , cilantro , garlic and rind in a small bowl and mix well
2. Wet your hands and shape the mixture into 24 patties
3. Place onto a tray and refrigerate patties for 30 minutes , or longer
4. Heat a small amount of oil in a non-stick pan and cook the patties in batches , until browned on both sides and cooked through
5. To make the sauce , combine sour cream , chili sauce and cilantro in a small bowl
6. Serve the patties alongside the sauce

title: littlemafia s mom pilaf
steps:
1. Chop the onion and fry it in the oil
2. Add the chicken and keep stirring
3. Add the rice and fry a little more
4. Add the rest of the ingredients and simmer
5. Enjoy

title: cheese and chicken enchiladas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray large non-stick skillet with cooking spray
3. Add onion , cook over medium heat for 4-5 minutes or until tender
4. Add chicken , 1 / 2 cup cheese , 3 / 4 cup salsa and cream cheese
5. Heat and stir for 2-3 minutes or until cheese is melted
6. Spooon 1 / 3 cup chicken mixture down center of each tortilla
7. Roll up
8. Place in 13 x 9 inch baking dish
9. Drizzle with remaining 1 1 / 4 cups of salsa
10. Sprinkle with remaining cheese
11. Cover and bake for 15 minutes or until heated through and cheese on top is melted
12. Enjoy !

title: black bean   andouille sausage soup   slow cooker
steps:
1. In slow cooker , combine all ingredients except salt , pepper , cilantro and sour cream
2. Mix well , cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours or on high for 3-4 hours
3. Season to taste with salt and pepper
4. Ladle into bowls and garnish with cilantro and sour cream if desired

title: bailey s fudge cake
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease 1 9-in round cake pan
3. Cream the butter and sugar
4. Mix in the eggs
5. Add in the chocolate syrup , bailey's , coffee granules and the flour
6. Mix until well blended
7. Fold in chopped nuts
8. Pour into prepared baking pan
9. Bake 55-60 mins , or until cake tests done
10. This is optional: dip one end of pecan halves halfway into melted chocolate to coat
11. Place on waxed paper , chill to set
12. Use later to garnish the cake
13. For the glaze: to the remaining melted chocolate , add the sour cream , 1 tablespoon at a time , add the bailey's
14. Mix well
15. Spread over the top of cooled cake that has been placed on a serving platter , letting some of the chocolate glaze drizzle down the sides of the cake
16. Garnish the cake all around the sides with the chocolate-dipped nuts

title: banana chocolate chip   daylight in the swamp  breakfast muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Grease or paper 12 standard size muffin / cupcake cups
3. Melt butter in a small mixing bowl , set aside to cool
4. In a large mixing bowl , measure & mix flour , sugar , baking powder & soda , and salt
5. Add first half-cup of chocolate chips
6. Make well in center
7. Set aside
8. In butter bowl , break & lightly beat the eggs , milk and bananas
9. Pour egg-banana mixture into dry ingredients
10. Stir with fork just until moistened --batter will be a bit lumpy
11. Spoon batter into prepared muffin cups , filling 2 / 3's full
12. Sprinkle with remaining half-cup of chocolate chips
13. Bake 15-20 minutes until golden-brown and a wooden pick comes out clean
14. Remove from oven , cool in pan for 5 minutes , remove from pan to serving plate
15. Serve with whipped honey , butter , raspberry jam or just eat 'em plain !

title: penne with creamy bacon sauce
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large saucepan
2. Add leek , bacon and garlic
3. Cook , stirring , until the leek is soft and the bacon is browned
4. Add mushrooms and zucchini to pan and cook just until zucchini is softened
5. Stir in the mustard , sour cream , vegeta and milk
6. Continue stirring until sauce is heated through
7. Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper
8. Toss pasta with sauce and serve

title: double coated chicken supreme
steps:
1. Measure rice krispies cereal
2. Crush to 2 cups
3. Place in shallow dish or pan
4. Stir in paprika
5. Set aside
6. In a seasoned shallow dish or pan , beat egg and milk until foamy
7. Add flour , salt , pepper , poultry seasoning mix until smooth
8. Dip chicken in batter
9. Coat with crushed cereal
10. Place in single layer , skin side up , in well-greased or foil lined shallow baking pan
11. Drizzle with melted butter
12. Bake at 350f about 1 hour
13. Do not cover pan or turn chicken

title: honey whole wheat bread abm or traditional
steps:
1. If using kitchenaid mixer , add whole wheat , yeast , salt , and gluten , mix with spoon
2. Then add oil and honey , turn to speed two and slowly add water until ball forms
3. Once ball cleans sides of bowl , turn mixer off and pinch dough , too stiff add a bit more water , to wet add 1t flour at a time
4. If new to bread making this takes practice , your dough should feel like a new ball of play-doe , but warm
5. Once your dough ball is right , knead for 5-6 minutes in you ka mixer
6. Don't skimp on this , it gives the bread a nice tight crumb texture
7. If using bread machine add ingredients in opposite order but , add yeast last
8. Set to dough cycle and remove after kneading or it will over flow your bread pan during rise time
9. Once kneaded , turn into a 4 quart greased bowl , cover loosely with saran wrap and allow to double in a warm , draft free place , 1-2 hours approximately
10. Turn out onto counter , cut in half , roll each half out and shape , place into lightly greased 8x4 pan or 9x5 pan works in both
11. Cover loosely again with saran wrap and allow to almost double , 30 mins to 1 hour
12. Place into 350 degree preheated oven
13. I use non-stick metal @ 350 for 30 minutes , until the top crust is browned
14. If top browns too quickly , cover with a sheet of aluminium foil to help avoid over browning and move bread down one rack in oven next time
15. Remove from pans immediately after cooking onto a cooling rack
16. Rub tops of loaves with a stick of butter for a real treat !

title: buttery apples and cabbage
steps:
1. In a pot stir in 1 cup water add cabbage , cover and cook until cabbage is crisp but tender , drain
2. In a pan add the butter , salt , nutmeg stir until butter is melted
3. Add the apples , cover and stir occasionally until apples are crisp tender
4. Sprinkle with parsley and serve while hot

title: delicious oven pot roast
steps:
1. Season the roast with seasoned salt , black pepper and garlic powder
2. Heat oil in a dutch oven
3. Add in the roast and brown on all sides
4. Drain fat
5. In a large bowl combine the 2 cans mushroom soup , worcestershire sauce , fresh garlic , sliced onion , dry onion soup mix and 1 cup low-sodium beef broth add to the roast
6. Bring to a boil and cook stirring a couple of times for about 20 minutes
7. Add in the fresh mushrooms , whole potatoes and carrot chunks
8. Reduce the heat to medium-low then cover and cook until the roast is tender or you may cook in the oven at 350 degrees f
9. Check the veggies after 1 hour of cooking if they are done then remove to a large bowl and continue to cook the roast
10. Remove the roast from the dutch oven
11. Stir together the flour and 1 / 4 cup water until smooth
12. Stir the flour / water mixture in with the simmering liquid in the pot
13. Cook stirring until mixture boils and thickens
14. Serve the roast with veggies and gravy

title: horseradish mustard sauce for ham
steps:
1. Mix until well blended
2. Makes about 1 1 / 2 cups

title: chicken suitcases perugina
steps:
1. Pound chicken between plastic wrap to thin
2. Top each piece of chicken with a slice of prosciutto and a piece of cheese
3. Fold the chicken over to completely enclose the prosciutto and cheese and secure with toothpicks
4. Sprinkle both sides with salt and pepper
5. Dredge chicken packages in flour
6. Heat butter and oil in a large skillet and brown chicken packages on both sides until golden
7. Transfer chicken to a plate
8. Add the marsala or broth to the skillet and stir to release the browned bits on the bottom of the pan
9. Add lemon juice and parsley
10. Increase heat and cook sauce for 1 minute until slightly thickened
11. Remove toothpicks from chicken and return to skillet and heat through
12. Serve

title: shabnam curry
steps:
1. Cut mushrooms into quarters
2. Heat oil and add onions
3. Saute till brown
4. Mix ginger and garlic pastes in water
5. Add it to the onions
6. Let water evaporate
7. Add turmeric powder , red chilli powder and dhaniya powder
8. Saute well
9. Add grated tomatoes and saute till oil separates
10. Add fresh mushrooms and greenpeas
11. Mix with the masala and add salt
12. Fry well
13. Add 3 / 4th cup water and cook by covering with a lid
14. When done , add garam masala and cashew paste
15. Cook covered for 5 minutes on low heat
16. Garnish with chopped corriander and serve hot with roti

title: beeferoni mac
steps:
1. Brown meat in large nonstick skillet on medium-high heat
2. Drain
3. Add macaroni , water and barbecue sauce
4. Bring to boil
5. Reduce heat to medium
6. Cover
7. Simmer 8 min , stirring twice
8. Stir in cheese sauce mix and tomato sauce
9. Cook until heated through adding onions just before the end
10. Sprinkle with lettuce and tomatoes
11. Serve immediately

title: richard anderson s special scrambled eggs
steps:
1. Melt 4 tablespoons butter in medium skillet
2. Add onions and cook over medium heat until very brown , 20-25 minutes
3. Beat eggs and milk together
4. Stir in salami , cheese , and onions
5. Melt remaining butter in skillet
6. Add egg mixture and scramble until set
7. Garnish with tomatoes and watercress

title: sopa de fideo con pollo   mexican chicken noodle soup
steps:
1. Combine first five ingredients in a large stockpot with enough water to cover
2. Boil until done , about 30 minutes
3. Drain and reserve broth
4. While the chicken is cooking , heat the oil in a large skillet
5. Saut the fideo in oil a few minutes until lightly browned over medium heat
6. Add onion and bell pepper pieces and cook until onion is translucent
7. Add cooked vegetables and noodles to the cooked chicken pieces
8. Pour in some broth and tomato sauce , enough to cover everything , then cover and simmer until noodles are cooked through
9. Finish with more seasonings
10. Can be garnished with cilantro and / or jalapeo

title: vanessa s sweet potato salad
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Toss peeled , diced sweet potato chunks in canola oil , sesame oil , cumin , coriander , paprika , curry powder and salt until thoroughly coated
3. Spread evenly in jelly roll pan or large baking stone and roast in oven until lightly browned , around 20 minutes
4. Set aside to cool
5. While sweet potatoes roast:
6. --prepare bell peppers , scallions , sesame seeds and cilantro , set aside
7. --combine extra-virgin olive oil , lime juice , salt , cumin and pepper in jar or dressing cruet
8. Shake well to combine
9. Set aside
10. When sweet potatoes are room temperature , combine them in large bowl with bell peppers , scallions , sesame seeds and cilantro
11. Add dressing and mix thoroughly
12. Can be served at room temperature or chilled

title: beef and pork burgers
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. In skillet , cook bacon , onion , and garlic until bacon is crisp
3. Drain
4. Put into lg bowl
5. Add all remaining ingredients
6. Mix well
7. Shape into 8 patties
8. Broil , 6 inches from the heat , 7-8 minutes per side , or until done

title: seared spiced salmon steaks with black bean salsa
steps:
1. Salsa:
2. To make the salsa , rinse the beans in plenty of cold water , put them in a saucepan with enough water to cover , bring to the boil and boil rapidly for 10 minutes
3. Then reduce the heat and simmer the beans for 30 minutes until tender
4. Drain and allow them to cool completely before adding all the other ingredients
5. Then leave them covered for several hours to allow the flavours to develop
6. Salmon:
7. A few hours before you want to cook the salmon , wipe each of the steaks with damp kitchen paper and remove any visible bones using tweezers
8. Place the salmon on a plate , then , with a pestle and mortar , crush the garlic cloves and rock salt together until you have a creamy pure
9. Now add the grated ginger , lime zest , cinnamon and cumin , 1 tbsp of olive oil and the chopped coriander , and a good grind of black pepper
10. Mix everything together and spread a little of this mixture on each salmon steak
11. Cover with clingfilm and set aside for the flavours to develop and permeate the salmon
12. When you're ready to cook the salmon , pre-heat the grill to its highest setting
13. Brush the baking sheet with olive oil and put it under the grill to heat up
14. When the grill is really hot , remove the baking sheet using an oven glove , and place the salmon pieces on it
15. They will sear and sizzle as they touch the hot metal
16. Position the tray 3 inches from the heat and grill them for 7 minutes exactly
17. Use a kitchen timer as the timing is vital
18. Remove them when the time is up and use a sharp knife to ease the skins off
19. Transfer to warm plates and garnish with sprigs of coriander
20. Serve immediately with the black bean salsa

title: rustic white bread
steps:
1. Dissolve the yeast in 1 cup warm water in a large bowl , and let stand for 5 minutes
2. Lightly spoon flour into dry measuring cups
3. Level with a knife
4. Add 2 3 / 4 cups flour and salt to yeast mixture
5. Stir until a soft dough forms
6. Turn dough out onto a floured surface
7. Knead until smooth and elastic
8. Add enough of remaining flour , 1 tablespoon at a time , to prevent dough from sticking to hands
9. Place dough in a large bowl coated with cooking spray , turning to coat top
10. Cover and let rise in a warm place , free from drafts , 45 minutes or until doubled in size
11. Punch dough down
12. Cover and let rest 5 minutes
13. Shape dough into a 6-inch round
14. Place on a baking sheet sprinkled with cornmeal
15. Lightly coat surface of dough with cooking spray
16. Cover and let rise 45 minutes or until doubled in size
17. Preheat oven to 450
18. Uncover dough
19. Combine 1 teaspoon water and egg white , stirring with a whisk
20. Brush over dough
21. Make 3 cuts 1 / 4 inch deep across top of dough using a sharp knife
22. Bake at 450 for 20 minutes or until bread is browned on bottom and sounds hollow when tapped
23. Remove from pan
24. Cool on a wire rack

title: cajun spice blend
steps:
1. Blend thoroughly
2. Good in soup stews or to spicy up the barbecue , veggies and meat

title: spelt pizza crust
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast in warm water
2. Add 1 1 / 2 cups flour and mix with large spoon
3. Add oil , rosemary and salt , mixing well
4. Mix in the rest of the flour and turn out onto a well-floured surface
5. Knead for 5 minutes
6. Add more flour until dough is no longer sticky
7. Rinse and dry the bowl and lubricate with olive oil
8. Return dough to bowl , turning once to cover in oil
9. Cover dough with clean kitchen towel and let rise for 1 hour in a warm place in the kitchen
10. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f and divide dough into two or three pieces , depending upon pan size and crust preference
11. On flat , floured surface roll out each piece to approximate pan size
12. Sprinkle each pan with a light dusting of cornmeal and lay dough in the pans
13. Oil your finger
14. Lightly precook the crust before adding sauce and toppings
15. You want the dough to rise enough in the oven to form bubbles but remove before it begins to brown , less than 5 minutes
16. Add your own toppings and bake for 15-20 minutes depending on your own toppings

title: mike s special seasoning
steps: 1. Combine all and use on any meat to add flavor and spice !

title: mum s special scones
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425of , 220oc or gas mark 7
2. In a bowl put self raising flour , baking powder and butter
3. Rub in until mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs
4. Stir in sugar
5. In a measuring jug beat the egg and mix in milk
6. Stir egg / milk mixture into the flour and mix until it becomes like a soft dough
7. Turn on to a floured table
8. Knead lightly and roll out to 1
9. 5 cm thickness
10. Cut into rounds and put onto greased or floured baking tray / sheet
11. Brush tops with a little beaten egg
12. Bake for 10 minutes or until pale golden brown
13. Remove from oven and put on a wire cooling rack to cool

title: beef curry with spinach  palak ghost
steps:
1. Put cloves , peppercorns , bay leaves , and cardamom capsules in a metal tea filter
2. Heat 3 tb oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and sear the meat in 3 batches until browned
3. Remove the meat and salt it
4. Add another 3 tb oil in the pot and saut the onions , chile , garlic , and ginger until onions are translucent
5. Add the meat and sprinkle with the chile powder , curcuma , garam masala , and cumin
6. Stir well until all is coated with the powdered spices
7. Add enough chicken broth until meat is covered , add the tea filter with the spices , cover and bring to a boil
8. Reduce heat and simmer for 90 minutes
9. Remove spice filter , and add the heavy cream , let simmer for 30 minutes more , do not let it boil ! adjust seasonings
10. Clean and wash the spinach
11. Add the fresh spinach to the pot right before serving , and incorporate it , stirring it into the curry just until it becomes soft , about 1 minute
12. Serve immediately , with rice

title: thai sweet potato with crab soup
steps:
1. Heat oil over medium-high heat in a large pot
2. Saute onion until translucent , about 3 minutes
3. Add garlic& saute for 30 seconds
4. Add curry , coriander& cumin and saute for 30 seconds longer
5. Add sweet potato& saute for another 30 seconds
6. Pour in stock& milk , bring to a boil , lower heat and simmer until the sweet potato is cooked- 20 to 30 minutes
7. Remove from the heat , let cool slightly& ladle into a food processor
8. Whirl until well blended , pour back into the pot , add crab& roasted red pepper and reheat

title: carrot   potato soup
steps:
1. Saute onions& garlic in margarine until tender
2. Add chicken broth , carrots , potatoes , italian seasoning and bay leaf
3. Simmer , uncovered , until vegetables are tender , about 20-25 minutes
4. Discard bay leaf and puree soup
5. Season with salt& pepper

title: really easy baked sole fish with mozzarella and tomato
steps:
1. Set oven to 375 degrees
2. Butter a 13 x 9-inch baking dish
3. Rinse fish fillets with cold water and pat dry with a paper towel
4. Arrange fillets in a single layer in dish
5. Sprinkle with shredded mozza cheese
6. Top with tomato slices
7. Sprinkle seasonings over top
8. Bake for 15 minutes , or until fish is "flakey" and cooked
9. Serve immediately

title: sangria  fruit cups  non alcoholic
steps:
1. Bring orange juice to a boil
2. Add to jelly powders in a medium bowl
3. Stir at least 2 minutes until jelly is completely dissolved
4. Add cold water
5. Spoon fruit into 12 clear cups and pour jelly mixture over fruit
6. Refrigerate at least 4 hours or until set
7. Top with whipped topping just before serving
8. Store leftovers in refrigerator

title: a better borscht  beet  soup
steps:
1. Place pork hocks in a stock pot and cover with 6 cups cold water (or enough to really cover them
2. Cover and place over fire until the hocks come to a boil
3. While this is coming to a boil , chop your onions , celery , carrots and beans
4. When the pot has boiled there will be a lot of foam at the top of the pot , pour everything out and rinse the pot and meat well , then move to step 4
5. This is so that you don't have floaty things in the soup later
6. If you decide to miss cleaning everything just move straight to step 4 right away
7. Otherwise , you need to add 6 cups clean cold water before step 4
8. Add the garlic , seasonings and the chopped vegetables
9. Bring the pot back to a boil , turn down and simmer 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours or until the pork hock is loosened and tender
10. Remove the pork hock from the pot and cool
11. Return the stock to the fire and continue simmering until you've moved to the next step
12. While the pork hock is cooling , chop the potato and prepare the first four beets
13. To prepare the beets , peel them , cut them lengthwise in half , turn cut side down and slice into 1 / 8" thin slices across the width of the beet
14. Lay the slices down and cut these into 1'8" slices across the width of the beet
15. This method gives the prettiest presentation
16. Add the potato to the pot and return the soup to a slow boil , then add the beet slices
17. Do not let the soup boil once the beets are added or it will lose it's color
18. While this is coming up to heat , clean the pork hock and return them to the pot
19. Make sure to get all the ugly bits and fat , but leave the meat as whole as you can , better to shred it in you bowl ! trust me !
20. Leave this to simmer very slowly until the potato is cooked and the beets are tender
21. Meanwhile , chop the beet stalks and the leaves
22. And peel and grate the final 2 beets
23. Add the peas and tops / leaves to the pot
24. When the peas are cooked add the grated beets
25. Continue to cook very slowly
26. Once everything is tender you can finally add the dill and 1 / 2 teaspoon of sour salt
27. Tasting is important here , i usually add about 1 1 / 2 teaspoons of sour salt myself , but i prefer it a bit sour
28. I taste all the way through because i love the way the flavor builds , but it is very important at the end
29. Adjust the dill , salt and sour salt carefully , with some practice you'll find a soup that everyone loves
30. Add more water if this soup begins looking dry , but it is a thick soup so doesn't require a lot of broth - cream will be added at the table
31. You can park the soup overnight in the fridge and remove all the fat that rises the next day
32. This soup is excellent on day 1 but even better day 2 , and healthier when the fat is removed
33. The broth shouldn't be sweet and it should have a bit of a sour tang and a taste of dill
34. The soup should never be salty because the meat may call for some seasoning in the bowl
35. This soup is better the next day , and may be put in jars and canned or frozen
36. Add sour cream or whipped cream at the table as a garnish
37. More fresh dill is pretty and tasty as well
38. Ask my friend katlin - he loves this soup !

title: spinach artichoke stuffed pecan crusted chicken breasts
steps:
1. Squeeze the excess liquid from the spinach
2. Mix in a medium size bowl the spinach , artichoke hearts , sun dried tomatoes , and the asiago , ricotta and mozzarella cheese
3. Set aside
4. Combine the chopped pecans , corn flake crumbs and garlic powder in a shallow bowl
5. Whisk together the 2 eggs with the milk in another shallow bowl
6. Mix the flour , cayenne pepper , salt and italian seasoning in a third shallow bowl
7. Pound chicken breasts to approximately 1 / 4 inch thickness
8. Bread each chicken breast by coating each with flour mixture , then dipping into egg mixture
9. Coat one side of the chicken breast with the pecan mixture
10. Put equal amounts of spinach / artichoke mixture on each chicken breast on the side that does not have the pecan coating
11. Roll up the chicken breast and secure with a toothpick
12. Place in casserole dish that has been drizzled with olive oil
13. Bake in oven preheated to 350f for 40 minutes or until chicken is thoroughly cooked
14. Let set for 5 minutes before serving

title: bibb lettuce salad with blueberry vinaigrette
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine lettuce , onion , blueberries , and walnuts
2. Drizzle with half of the blueberry vinaigrette , tossing to coat
3. Serve remaining vinaigrette on the side
4. To prepare blueberry vinaigrette:
5. In the work bowl of a food processor , combine all ingredients
6. Pulse until smooth
7. Refrigerate until serving time

title: lemon pepper shrimp with snow peas and wild rice
steps:
1. Melt butter and oil in a large skillet or saute pan
2. Saute garlic , ginger , onion and celery until tender
3. Add the shrimp and snow peas , stirring frequently to avoid over cooking and ensure even cooking
4. Cook until shrimp are pink
5. Add lemon and pepper to taste , stir and enjoy
6. This dish is great served warm over a bed of rice or bread

title: easy healthy whole wheat flax pizza crust
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. In a large bowl , stir together first 4 ingredients
3. Pour warm water into first 4 ingredients , mixing strongly
4. Add flaxseed first , then add additional flour and stir until dough forms a ball , noting that not all the flour will likely be picked up by the dough ball
5. Gently knead dough on floured surface until smooth
6. Cover and let rise for 5 minutes
7. Grease 9inch pie plate , and spread dough in it
8. Put on tomato sauce , toppings , then cheese , and put in oven for 15-20 minutes

title: scallops alfredo
steps:
1. Thaw scallops , if frozen
2. Cut any large scallops in half
3. Set aside
4. For sauce , in a small bowl stir together half and half , light cream , or milk
5. Parsley
6. Cornstarch
7. And pepper
8. Set aside
9. Pour cooking oil into a wok or large skillet
10. Preheat over medium-high heat
11. Stir-fry garlic in hot oil for 15 seconds
12. Add scallops to the hot wok
13. Stir-fry about 2 minutes or till scallops turn opaque
14. Push scallops from the center of the wok
15. Stir sauce
16. Add sauce to center of wok
17. Cook and stir till thickened and bubbly
18. Cook and stir 2 minutes more
19. Add cooked fettuccine , tomato , and 1 / 2 cup parmesan cheese
20. Stir all ingredients together to coat with sauce
21. Cook and stir for 1 to 2 minutes more or till heated through
22. Serve immediately
23. Sprinkle with additional parmesan cheese and garnish with parsley sprigs , if desired
24. Nutrition information per serving: 416 calories , 25 g protein , 40 g carbohydrate , 18 g fat , 65 mg cholesterol , 341 mg sodium , 496 mg potassium

title: callaloo  creamy spinach and okra
steps:
1. Wash and stem spinach and rip or chop leaves into medium sized pieces
2. Wash okra de-stem and chop into smaller chunks
3. Mince up your onion , garlic , hot pepper and sweet pepper
4. Heat a medium sized pot on med-high add in some oil
5. When oil is hot add in onion and cook until it starts to become translucent , now add in your garlic and chili , cook until a golden brown
6. Add in your coconut milk starting with half a can and stir everything together
7. Add in your spinach , okra and sweet pepper
8. Turn down heat and mix well letting the spinach welt
9. Add more coconut milk if needed , you want to keep the coconut milk just below the food line
10. Cook for about 15 to 20 minutes until the okra and spinach are soft , and mash easily
11. Remove from heat and blend or mash everything together
12. Return to heat on low and add salt as needed
13. Serve on rice with lemon wedges and enjoy !
14. It makes a great side dish or a meal on it's own

title: almond snack mix
steps:
1. Place cereal and almonds in a bowl
2. In a saucepan , combine the sugar , corn syrup and butter
3. Bring to a boil over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until a candy thermometer reads 250 to 266
4. Remove from the heat and stir in extract
5. Pour over cereal mixture and mix well
6. Spread onto waxed paper-lined baking sheets and cool
7. Break apart
8. Store in an airtight container

title: cheese crostini with anchovy herb butter
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Melt butter in heavy small skillet over medium heat
3. Add anchovies and stir until they dissolve , about 3 minutes
4. Stir in herbs , garlic , lemon zest , and red pepper
5. Arrange bread slices on a large baking sheet
6. Brush with anchovy mixture
7. Sprinkle with cheese
8. Bake until cheese melts and bread is golden , about 10 minutes
9. Cut bread slices in halves and serve

title: diet soda floats
steps:
1. Pour diet soda in glass
2. Scoop ice cream into glass

title: potato   chickpea curry with rice  dutch oven
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f
2. Generously spray inside of 5 1 / 2 or 6-quart dutch oven with cooking spray
3. Stir together rice and 2 1 / 4 cups broth in pot
4. Top with potatoes , season with salt and pepper , then add chickpeas
5. Combine tomatoes , onion , garlic , curry powder , and remaining 3 / 4 cup broth in bowl
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Spread tomato mixture over chickpeas , then top with spinach
8. Cover pot , and bake 53 minutes , or about 3 minutes after aroma wafts from oven

title: jewish coffee cake
steps:
1. Cream shortening and gradually add sugar
2. Add eggs individually and beat well after each addition
3. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk
4. Add vanilla and pour into greased tube or bundt pan
5. Combine cinnamon and sugar and pour on top of batter
6. Take a fork and swirl into batter with up and down motions
7. Bake for 50 minutes at 350 degrees
8. It freezes very well

title: white chip chocolate cookies  toll house
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Combine flour , cocoa , baking soda , and salt in a small bowl
3. Beat butter , granulated sugar , brown sugar , and vanilla extract in large mixing bowl with an electric mixer
4. Add eggs one at a time , beating well after each addition
5. Gradually beat in flour mixture
6. Stir in white chocolate chips
7. Drop by well-rounded teaspoons onto ungreased baking sheets
8. Bake for 9-11 minutes
9. Let cool on baking sheets for 2 minutes
10. Transfer to wire racks and let cool completely

title: savory salsa
steps:
1. Place tomatoes into boiling water for 1 minute or until skin cracks then immediately place in cold water , peel and core tomatoes and cut into chunks
2. Cut up rest of fresh ingredients
3. Juice limes
4. Drain and rinse black beans
5. Simply put all ingredients into a large pot , 1 1 / 2 gal or bigger and bring to a slow boil
6. Slow boil for 10 minutes uncovered
7. Place in pint jars , put on lids and boil in canner for 10 minutes
8. Makes about 15-16 pints
9. Variations -
10. If you want it hotter you can use more jalapenos , hotter peppers or add red pepper flakes / crushed red pepper to your taste
11. Soak 7-8 ears of sweet corn in water for 30 minutes and then roast corn in the husks on the grill until done , de-husk corn and cut off cob
12. Add corn to salsa for a black bean - roasted corn salsa or eliminate beans for a roasted corn salsa
13. No beans and no corn for a very tasty "regular" salsa
14. Use 2 more limes and no vinegar

title: orange balsamic cornish hens
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Line 2 rimmed baking sheets with foil
3. Set a baking rack in each pan
4. Using poultry shears or a sharp chef's knife , cut along both sides of each hen's backbone and discard
5. Open the birds up and turn skin side up , pressing lightly on the breastbones to flatten them a bit
6. Arrange 3 hens on each baking rack , skin side up , and season liberally with salt and pepper
7. Mix the orange juice concentrate , balsamic vinegar , and oil together
8. Pour evenly over the hens , and sprinkle with rosemary
9. Roast hens for 15 minutes at 425 , then decrease heat to 375 and roast for 30 minutes more , or until the juices run clear
10. Let the hens rest for 5 minutes before serving

title: strawberry lime shake
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a vita-mix and puree on high speed until smooth
2. Serve

title: rosemary and pepper standing rib roast with two mushroom pan sau
steps:
1. Place rib roast , fat side up , in heavy roasting pan
2. Mix 4 teaspoons crushed rosemary , salt , and pepper in small bowl
3. Stir in 1 / 2 cup oil
4. Rub mixture all over roast
5. Do ahead can be made 1 day ahead
6. Cover and chill
7. Let stand at room temperature 45 minutes before roasting
8. Combine 2 cups boiling water and porcini
9. Let soak until mushrooms soften , about 20 minutes
10. Strain soaking liquid through fine strainer set over measuring cup
11. Reserve porcini
12. If needed , add enough water to soaking liquid to measure 1 cup
13. Coarsely chop porcini
14. Melt 2 tablespoons butter with remaining 2 tablespoons oil in large skillet over medium-high heat
15. Add fresh mushrooms
16. Saut until browned , about 6 minutes
17. Add porcini and garlic
18. Stir 1 minute
19. Remove from heat
20. Combine flour , remaining 2 tablespoons butter , and remaining 2 1 / 2 teaspoons crushed rosemary in small bowl
21. Mash with fork to smooth paste
22. Do ahead porcini soaking liquid , mushroom mixture , and flour-butter mixture can be made 1 day ahead
23. Cover separately
24. Chill
25. Place rack in bottom third of oven and preheat to 350f cook roast until instant-read thermometer inserted straight down into top center of roast registers 125f to 130f for medium-rare , about 2 hours 30 minutes
26. Transfer roast to platter
27. Cover loosely with foil and let rest 35 to 40 minutes
28. Skim any fat from top of pan juices
29. Reserve juices in pan
30. Set roasting pan atop 2 burners over medium-high heat
31. Add reserved 1 cup porcini soaking liquid , broth , and wine
32. Bring to boil , scraping up any browned bits
33. Add mushroom mixture , then butter-flour mixture
34. Whisk constantly over medium-high heat until sauce thickens , about 2 minutes
35. Season sauce to taste with salt and pepper
36. Garnish roast on platter with fresh rosemary sprigs
37. Slice roast and serve , passing mushroom sauce separately

title: swift swordfish
steps:
1. Heat a large skillet over high heat and add the oil until it starts to smoke
2. Place the swordfish into pan and cook until light brown on the bottom- about two minutes
3. Turn and sear the other side of the fish- about another two minutes
4. Add the wine , mushrooms , tomatoes , basil and olives
5. Stir gently to coat the veggies with the sauce
6. Cover and cook for five minutes
7. Uncover and cook for an additional 3 to 4 minutes or just until the fish is opaque throughout
8. Season with salt and pepper and garnish with parsley
9. Serve and enjoy !

title: blackberry iced tea with cinnamon and ginger
steps:
1. Heat water in a large saucepan to just before boiling
2. Add tea bags , cinnamon sticks and ginger
3. Remove from heat , cover and let steep for about 15 minutes
4. Add juice and sweetener to taste
5. Strain tea into a pitcher
6. Cover and chill
7. Pour tea over crushed ice and serve garnished with cinnamon sticks

title: chef lyles homemade spaghetti sauce
steps:
1. In a sieve over a medium non-reactive saucepot , strain the tomatoes of their juice into the sauce pot
2. Add the sherry vinegar , sugar , red pepper flakes , oregano , and basil to the tomato juice
3. Stir and cook over high heat
4. Once bubbles begin to form on the surface , reduce to a simmer
5. Allow liquid to reduce by 1 / 2 or until liquid has thickened to a loose syrup consistency
6. Squeeze each tomato thoroughly to ensure most seeds are removed
7. Cut carrot , onion , and celery into uniform sizes and combine with olive oil and garlic in a non-reactive roasting pan over low heat
8. Sweat the mirepoix until the carrots are tender and the onion becomes translucent , 15 to 20 minutes
9. Add the tomatoes and capers to the roasting pan
10. Place roasting pan on the middle rack of the oven and broil for 15 to 20 minutes , stirring every 5 minutes
11. Tomatoes should start to brown slightly on edges with light caramelization
12. Remove the pan from the broiler
13. Place the pan over 2 burners on the stove
14. Add 1 / 2 cup of the wine to the tomatoes and cook for 2 to 3 more minutes over medium heat , and set aside
15. In a large 10 quart saucepan over medium heat , saut the ground beef , pork and sausage until browned
16. Remove from pan and set aside
17. Drain off excess fat reserving approximately 2 tablespoons
18. Add back the meat , tomatoes and remaining ingredients and reserved fat and stir until smooth
19. Simmer for 3 to 4 hours on low heat , stirring often to prevent scorching
20. Add more water as needed to thin sauce and adjust seasonings to taste
21. Meat is used mostly to flavor the sauce so if desired you will need more for future meals

title: marinated cucumbers  onions  and tomatoes
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl
2. Toss well to mix
3. Refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving

title: strawberry tea slush
steps:
1. Pour boiling water over tea bags
2. Cover and steep 5 minutes
3. Remove tea bags
4. Cover and chill at least 1 hour
5. Process chilled tea , frozen strawberries , and remaining ingredients in blender until smooth and slushy

title: no noodles tuna casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. In a large bowl combine the soup , peas , pimento and onion
3. Fold in the tuna and cheese
4. Pour the mixture into a greased 1 1 / 2 quart casserole dish
5. Place in the oven and cook for 15 minutes
6. Crush the potato chips and remove casserole from oven
7. Pour crushed chips on top of casserole
8. Bake for 10 more minutes

title: guacamole refined
steps:
1. Scoop out 3 of the avocados and put into a food processor
2. Add the onion , garlic , cilantro , lime juice , mayo , hot sauce and salt
3. Combine ingredients in the food processor
4. Empty food processor
5. I am able to split the amount into two cereal-sized serving bowls
6. Rough chop the 4th avocado and along with the seeded , chopped tomato , mix equal amounts into guacamole removed from the food processor
7. If chilling in the refrigerator , cover with plastic wrap and push plastic wrap into the top of the guacamole to prevent it from turning brown
8. Tastes vary , so i encourage poetic license with the ingredient amounts
9. I am many times found increasing the amount of garlic and think the hot sauce and salt should also be added to taste

title: fish and chips pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Warm up the fish and potatoes per directions
3. I used the same skillet that i used to start the crust
4. I'm sure the microwave or oven would produce the same result
5. Place them off to the side
6. Prepare a large skillet to start your crust
7. Turn the stove on to med-high , place your pizza dough into the skillet and spread it out to the sides to form a little edge
8. I used a flat plate to press it down and shape it
9. Fry the crust until the bottom is slightly browned , about 5 minutes , and slide it onto a preheated pizza stone or baking sheet
10. Top with the tartar sauce , then the fish and potatoes , and finally the cheese
11. Bake 12-15 minutes until golden brown

title: jane fonda s blackened catfish
steps:
1. In a large shallow dish , combine the paprika , cayenne , garlic powder , thyme , salt and lemon zest
2. Add the catfish fillets and turn to coat both sides , pressing the herb-and-spice rub into the fish
3. In a large non stick frying pan over medium-high heat , heat the oil
4. Add the fish and cook for 4 minutes
5. Pour the lemon juice over the fillets , turn and cook until the fish just separates when pressed with a fork , about 4 minutes

title: kasha salad  good hot or cold
steps:
1. Heat water , 2 tbs margarine , salt & pepper , onion , & veggies
2. Keep at a boil on med
3. High
4. Beat egg in a bowl
5. Add buckwheat to the egg and stir to coat evenly
6. In a large skilet , add egg-coated buckwheat and cook on high for 3 min
7. , stirring constantly , until egg is dried and buckwheat groats are separated
8. Reduce heat to low and quickly stir in the boiling liquid and veggies
9. Cover tightly and simmer for 5 minute
10. Stir in the remaining 2 tbs margarine and any additional spices you may want to add
11. Eat now , or put in fridge to chill

title: chocolate gooey bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Pour melted butter into cookie sheet or jelly roll pan
3. Press chocolate cake mix into melted butter
4. Add marshmallows , chocolate chips and oatmeal
5. Drizzle condensed milk over all
6. Bake 20-25 minutes

title: barbecue recipes basting sauce for grilled fish
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and simmer for a few minutes
2. Especially good for basting grilled fish

title: tomato cucumber salad with wishbone italian dressing
steps:
1. Toss all ingredients and refrigerate for one hour before serving
2. Serve with warm bread and dip it in the bottom of the bowl
3. Yum !

title: pastelito de guayaba  cuban guava pastry
steps:
1. In a blender or food processor , add all guava shells and half the syrup from one can
2. Process until it reaches a smooth consistency
3. Put puree in a medium saucepan and cook at low heat until reduced to a very thick consistency
4. Let guava cool and then fill into pastry bag
5. In a medium mixing bowl , add 4 ounces of water , 2 ounces of butter , and salt and mix until smooth
6. Then add flour and work well until all ingredients are incorporated
7. Continue to add water , a little at a time , working the dough until a medium-hard consistency is reached
8. Form dough into a ball and let rest for 15 minutes
9. Roll the dough into a flat square , about 1 / 2-inch thick
10. Place the remaining butter in the middle of square and pat down by hand to form a square about one-half the size of the dough square
11. Fold over the 4 corners of the dough , 1 at a time , overlapping each other so that a sealed envelope is formed enclosing the butter
12. Dust with flour and roll out to form a rectangle about 1 / 4-inch thick
13. Now fold 1 / 3 of the rectangle dough towards the middle and the remaining 1 / 3 over those 2
14. Let dough rest for 15 minutes
15. Now repeat process above of rolling out and folding in 3 , 2 more times , resting 15 minutes between each
16. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
17. Roll out a final time into a rectangle and fold of the dough on each side to the middle and then fold 1 more time down the middle to form 4 flaps in the fold
18. Let rest for 15 minutes
19. Roll out to a rectangle to about 1 / 8-inch thick
20. With a knife , cut the flattened dough into a 4-inch wide strip by length of your baking sheet
21. Lay strip on sheet pan lined with waxed paper and put filling lengthwise in the middle in continuous stream about 3 / 4-inch in diameter
22. Spray edges of strips with water and cover with another 4-inch strip of dough the same size as bottom
23. Press the edges together by hand very softly all the way around
24. Brush top with egg wash and bake for 35 minutes
25. Remove from oven and brush with a simple syrup over the top and bake for another 5 to 7 minutes
26. Remove from oven and cut crosswise into 16 pieces

title: harvest soup
steps:
1. Place water and harvest soup mix in a heavy pot and simmer 1 hour
2. Add all other ingredients and simmer another hour
3. Options: make with smoked sausage and add 1 cup of each fresh diced apples and sweet potatoes , instead of tomatoes
4. Other spices that can be added: savory , garlic and tarragon

title: american indian fry bread
steps:
1. Mix all dry ingredients well
2. Add enough water to make biscuit like dough
3. Take about 3 tablespoons of dough , make into ball and roll in flour
4. Using hands stretch to thin flat rounds
5. Make two 1 inch slits in the center of the round
6. Fry in oil at 365 degrees until lightly browned , turning once
7. The oil should be about 2 inches deep in pan , keeping oil hot

title: baked orzo with peppers and cheese
steps:
1. Boil orzo in boiling , salted water 10 to 12 minutes until tender
2. Drain
3. Mix orzo peppers , chiles and mozzarella cheese
4. Place in buttered casserole dish
5. Spread sour cream evenly over top , sprinkle with parmesan and dot with butter
6. Bake at 450 for 15 mintues until golden and puffed
7. Cool slightly

title: gingerbread made with tofu
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray a nonstick 8-inch square pan with nonstick spray
3. Beat tofu , molasses , sugar and margarine / butter in a blender till smooth
4. Combine flours , baking powder , baking soda , salt , ginger , cinnamon and cloves in a medium bowl
5. Add flour mixture to tofu mixture and beat until combined
6. Pour mixture into prepared pan
7. Bake about 35 minutes or until top springs back when lightly pressed
8. Cool in pan 10 minutes
9. Remove from pan and cut in 16 squares
10. The other kind comes out lumpy
11. Drain the tofu , but don't squeeze it
12. I put everything in my blender -- first blending the tofu and adding the ingredients in step 2
13. Then i transfer it into the bowl of dry ingredients and use an electric mixer
14. Do not blend everything together in the blender or it comes out too runny
15. The batter should not be thick and heavy , but more like pudding
16. Enjoy the delectable fragrance while this cooks !

title: lima bean puree or green mashed potatoes
steps:
1. In a small sauce pan heat the lima beans , chicken broth , rosemary , salt and pepper to boiling
2. Reduce heat and let simmer for a few minutes until limas are heated through , approx 5 minutes
3. Remove from heat and drain the lima beans reserving approximately 1 / 2 cup of liquid
4. Place hot lima beans back into the sauce pan
5. Add butter and chicken broth in 1 tablespoon increments as needed
6. Either with a masher or with an emersion blender puree the lima bean / butter / broth mixture until silky smooth and they resemble "green mashed potatoes"
7. If they seem too dry , add some more of the reserved chicken broth until the consistency is to your liking
8. These are a healthy alternative in our house and everyone loves them
9. Even the veggie haters always leave raving about these lima's !

title: caviar spread
steps:
1. Beat together cream cheese , lemon juice , mustard and worcestershire sauce
2. Fold in 3 tblsps caviar and transfer to a small glass bowl
3. Garnish with remaining 1 tblsp caviar , parsley sprigs and lemon slices

title: pulled bbq chicken   slow cooker
steps:
1. Place chicken in slow cooker
2. In a separate bowl , mix bbq sauce , italian dressing , brown sugar , and worchestersire sauce
3. Pour over chicken
4. Cover and cook 3-4 hrs on high or 6-8hrs on low
5. Open crockpot and pull chicken breasts apart using 2 forks
6. Chicken should shred easily
7. Serve !

title: 5 cup slice
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200c / 400f
2. Grease and line a 20 x 30 cm lamington / sponge roll tin with baking paper
3. Make sure the paper extends up and over the sides
4. Sprinkle the pan evenly with sultana , chocolate bits , peanuts and coconut
5. Drizzle the condensed milk over the top
6. Cover with a piece of greased foil and bake in the oven for 20 minutes
7. Reduce heat to 180c / 350f , remove the foil and bake for about 15 minutes until golden and firm
8. Remove from oven and cool completely in the pan
9. Drizzle with the melted chocolate and allow to set
10. Remove and slice to serve

title: low fat gingerbread
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees
2. Spray two eight inch square pans with cooking spray
3. Measure out dry ingredients , mix together , and set aside
4. In another bowl , whisk molasses , applesauce , buttermilk , egg substitute , and splenda until smooth
5. Gradually fold in all of the dry ingredients into the wet batter
6. Batter will be very thick and viscous
7. In a small saucepan , bring the 1 / 2 cup of water to a boil and add to the batter
8. Stir until incorporated
9. Batter will obviously have thinned out
10. Pour the batter into the two pans , and bake from about 30 to 40 minutes , or until an inserted knife comes out clean
11. Do not overbake
12. Invert onto a plate or other surface and cool at least half an hour before cutting

title: arayes  mini meat calzones
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to gas mark 4 / 350f / 180c
2. In a large bowl , add in the minced lamb , with the chopped onion and tomato , crushed garlic , salt , spice mix , parsley , lemon juice and toasted pine nuts and mix well
3. Cut bread into quarters
4. Open up the quartered bread pieces and spread a heaped tablespoonful of meat mixture in a thin layer into one side of the bread and press down to close
5. Brush both sides of the bread with oil
6. Place on a baking tray and bake in the centre shelf of the oven for half an hour , turning once after 15 minutes
7. Serve warm with hummus

title: simple turkey soup
steps:
1. Combine turkey tomatoes with juice , broth , vegetables , barley , salt , thyme , coriander and peper in the crock pot add water to cover
2. Cover cook on high for 3 to 4 hours or until barley and vegetables are tender

title: nut and seed milk shakes
steps:
1. Place brazil nuts and 1 cup cold water into blender container
2. Blend on low a few secons , then turn it to high speed
3. Blend until the mixture is smooth , scraping sides of the container with a spatula , if necessary
4. Add frozen bananas and carob
5. Blend until smooth and creamy and serve
6. Nuts variations: other "smooth" nuts , such as cashews , pecans and walnuts can be made directly into milk shakes
7. Place about 2 tablespoons of nuts into blender and proceed as above
8. "grainy" seeds and nuts , such as almonds or quinoa seeds , may need to be strained before adding the bananas and carob
9. Fruits variations: fruits , fresh and frozen , can be blended with nut milks
10. Try peaches , strawberries , dates , figs , or mango in additional to the banana
11. Add a teaspoon of maple syrup , agave nectar or honey for sweetness , if necessary

title: gyro
steps:
1. In small bowl combine the salt , oregano , pepper , cumin , cayenne and cinnamon and mix thoroughly
2. In large bowl combine meat , onions and spice mix
3. Add garlic and vegetable oil , mix thoroughly with hands until spices are evenly distributed
4. Refrigerate covered several hours
5. In a small skillet , fry a small amount of the meat mixture in a little butter
6. Taste for seasoning and adjust , if desired
7. Blanch bacon by simmering in hot water about 3 minutes
8. Drain on paper towels
9. Line loaf pan with bacon covering sides and bottom
10. Pack gyros meat into pan , filling to the top of the pan
11. Cover with remaining slices of bacon
12. Place filled pan in hot water bath , reaching 3 / 4 of the way up the loaf pan
13. Bake at 375f for 20-30 minutes
14. Reduce heat to 325f and continue baking 30 minutes longer
15. Remove pan from oven
16. Remove loaf pan from hot water bath and place on wire rack to cool
17. Cover with aluminum foil and weigh down with about 2 lbs
18. Weight to compress loaf
19. Cool to room temperature , refrigerate meat , covered with weight 12 hours or overnight to ripen and increase flavor
20. Meat will keep for up to 4 days refrigerated
21. Slice very thin and serve in pita bread with sliced onions , tomatoes and tzatziki sauce

title: broccoli slaw salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix broccoli slaw , chicken , fruits and nuts
2. In another small bowl mix mayonnaise , milk , honey , lemon juice , salt and celery seed , then pour over the broccoli mixture and toss until blended
3. Serve it chilled

title: spinach feta stuffed mushrooms caps  vegetarian
steps:
1. Set oven to 400 degrees
2. Place the mushroom caps onto a baking sheet stem-side down
3. Bake for about 6-8 minutes or long enough to release their moisture and dry out
4. Reduce oven temperature to 350 degree f
5. Turn the caps stem-side up then brush each cap with olive oil
6. Season each cap with coarse black pepper and a little salt
7. Place the spinach in a microwave-safe bowl and cover with a little water
8. Microwave on high allowing the water to boil with the spinach for about 5 minutes
9. Drain in a strainer and cool the spinach
10. Hand-squeeze out all the moisture in the cooled spinach then place into a bowl
11. Add in feta cheese , onion , garlic , chopped fresh parsley and chopped walnuts
12. Mix to combine well
13. Season with fresh coarse black pepper
14. Divide the mixture between the caps
15. Bake uncovered for about 15 minutes

title: oven baked split pea and lentil soup
