steps:
1. Rinse and drain split peas and lentils
2. In a dutch oven , combine peas , lentils , broth , carrot , celery , red pepper , onion , bay leaf , cumin , and pepper
3. Bake uncovered , in a 350 degree oven , about 2 hours or until lentils and split peas are tender
4. Check seasoning and add salt& pepper if necessary remove bay leaf
5. Place in soup bowls and top each serving with yogurt and cucumber
6. Serves four

title: really great pumpkin cookies
steps:
1. Mix flour , oats , baking soda , and cinnamon
2. Cream together butter , brown sugar , egg , vanilla , and pumpkin
3. Stir in dry ingredients and raisins
4. Drop by tablespoons onto greased cookie sheet
5. Bake at 350 for 20-25 minutes

title: absolutely the best amish beef stew
steps:
1. Melt shortening over high heat in a large pot or dutch oven
2. Add beef cubes and brown over medium heat , stirring occasionally , about 15-20 minutes
3. Add onions , boiling water , salt , lemon juice , sugar , worcestershire sauce , pepper , paprika , allspice and cloves
4. Simmer , tightly covered , for about 2 hours , stirring occasionally
5. Add vegetables and simmer another 30 minutes , or until tender
6. If this is the case , add more water to barely cover ingredients
7. Mix cold water and flour together and blend until smooth
8. Push meat and veggies to the side of the pot and add flour mixture slowly , incorporating into liquid
9. When gravy thickens , stir all ingredients gently to distribute gravy evenly
10. Simmer another 5 or 10 minutes and enjoy !

title: joan s  crock pot  lima bean soup with chicken
steps:
1. In a crock pot place all ingredients expect salt , pepper and olive oil
2. Cover and cook low until a boil , this may be several hours
3. Turn to high and cook until beans are very soft which may be 1 or 2 hours more
4. When done , discard bay leaf
5. Carefully remove chicken from the bone and shred and return meat into the pot
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Drizzle olive oil over soup in each serving bowl
8. Tastes better with age

title: mock cheesy hash brown casserole  low carb
steps:
1. Wash the spaghetti squash
2. Pierce the rind 4-5 times with a sharp knife
3. Place in oven-proof pan
4. Bake in preheated 375 degree oven until soft , 1 - 1 1 / 2 hours
5. Remove from oven and reduce heat to 350 degrees
6. When the squash is cool enough to handle , slice lengthwise
7. Scoop out seeds and discard
8. Fork the squash into strands and place in buttered casserole dish
9. While squash is baking , mix together soup , sour cream , chopped onion , garlic , and 1 / 4 cup of cheese
10. When strands of squash have been placed into casserole dish , toss with melted butter and sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste
11. Pour soup mixture over squash and stir well
12. Top with remaining cheese
13. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until cheese is browned

title: coconut dark chocolate chip scones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Combine flours , sugar , baking powder and salt
3. Cut in butter with a pastry blender
4. Add buttermilk and egg substitute , mix just until moistened
5. Mix in the coconut , chocolate chips and nuts , if desired
6. Divide dough in half
7. Pat each half into a flat circle and cut into eight wedges each
8. Place on parchment paper on a baking sheet
9. Bake 15 minutes

title: chicken divan
steps:
1. Boil chicken , then flake off bone , or if no bone , shred into pieces
2. Mix all ingredients and place in casserole dish
3. Top with a little more grated cheddar and croutons
4. Bake 350f bake 25-30 minutes , uncovered

title: spinach dip a lighter version
steps:
1. Combine above ingredients except bread and chill
2. Cut out center of bread into cube size pieces for dipping
3. Fill center with dip and serve

title: incredible butterscotch brownies
steps:
1. Melt shortening
2. Add in brown sugar and mix
3. Add in eggs , dry ingredients , vanilla , and peanuts
4. Spread into a greased pan
5. Bake at 350f for 25 minutes
6. Let cool , then cut !

title: bacon meatballs
steps:
1. Thoroughly combine all ingredients
2. Form into 24-30 meatballs
3. Place in a 9 x 13 pan
4. Bake at 350 degrees for 20-30 minutes until browned and cook through
5. Yummy on meatball sandwiches with hawaiian barbecue sauce

title: chicken coleslaw pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook the pasta according to package directions , drain then rinse under cold water
2. Transfer to a large bowl and allow to cool
3. Add the cabbage , chicken , capsicum onion , carrot , celery and cucumber to the pasta and mix well
4. Combine the mayonnaise , mustard and vinegar seasoning with salt and pepper to taste
5. Add to the salad tossing well
6. Chill

title: kittencal s crispy garlic baked chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Set oven rack to lowest position
3. Grease a small baking sheet
4. In a shallow bowl combine melted butter with 1-1 / 2 teaspoons garlic powder and 2 teaspoons dijon mustard
5. In another bowl combine all breading ingredients
6. Dip the breast into the melted butter turning a few times to coat generously , then coat in the breading mixture pressing down firmly with hands to adhere the coating to the breast
7. Place on baking sheet
8. Continue with remaining chicken adding in more breading to the bowl as needed to coat the chicken
9. Bake for about 35-40 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through

title: hershey s s mores clusters
steps:
1. Break and heat 6 milk-chocolate bars in the microwave
2. Stir in 2 cups of mini-marshmallows and 8 coarsely chopped graham crackers
3. Drop spoonfuls of the mix into miniature paper muffin cups
4. Cover and refrigerate until firm

title: irish flag layered shot
steps:
1. Layer in a pony glass or shot glass in the order given
2. The secret is to pour slowly , barely dribble the liqueurs into your glass
3. Start with your first liqueur and pour it into your glass , now take your spoon and place the

title: don t faint  drink me  quick
steps: 1. Mix all in a glass and drink rightaway !

title: chipotle barbecued shrimp with goat cheese cream
steps:
1. In a blender , combine the chilies , adobo , lime , juice , orange juice , tequila , ketchup , sugar , molasses , salt and pepper
2. In a shallow nonreactive dish , combine the chipotle mixture and the shrimp
3. Cover and let stand at room temperature , stirring once or twice , for 30 minutes
4. Combine the rest of the ingredients to make the goat cheese cream
5. Light the grill to medium hot
6. Position the rack to about 6 inches above the heat source
7. Lift the shrimp from the marinade and reserve the liquid
8. Put them on 4 large metal skewers and lay them on the rack after oiling it
9. Baste with some of the marinade , cover and grill , turning 3 times and basting at each turn with some of the marinade , for a total of 6 minutes
10. The shrimp should be pink , curled and moist
11. Slide the shrimp off their skewers and onto a platter or individual appetizer plates
12. Drizzle with the goat cheese cream and serve immediately

title: smoked salmon wraps pinwheels
steps:
1. Mix cream cheese and roasted garlic-squeezed from skins and chives
2. I usually do this a day ahead of time to save time the day that i'm making these
3. Spread about 1 / 4 cup of the cream cheese mixture over each tortilla
4. Sprinkle each with a little dill
5. Place 3 or 4 spinach leaves and 4 bell pepper strips evenly spaced on each tortilla
6. Sprinkle with about 1 / 4 cup smoked salmon
7. Roll up tortillas tightly
8. Seal edge of each tortilla by spreading with additional cream cheese mixture
9. Wrap securely with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 2 hours but no longer than 24 hours
10. To serve , cut into 1-inch pieces
11. Place cut side up on serving platter

title: cranky egg sandwich
steps:
1. Split english muffin into two and put in toaster , till desired crispness
2. Meanwhile , in heated buttered skillet cook beaten egg omelet style
3. Sprinkle garlic salt on top and flip over to cook both sides
4. Put cheese in middle of egg and fold edges of egg over cheese , like an envelope
5. On other side of pan cook the meat
6. If using precooked sandwich meat , just need to heat up
7. Slide cooked meat on top of egg & cheese to help seal in the melting cheese
8. English muffin should be toasted by now and can be prepared by spreading on butter
9. Slide egg , cheese and meat stack on to one side of english muffin and top with second side
10. Also can change taste by omitting one ingredient or adding more
11. Try croissants , bread or biscuits
12. Or different cheeses , spices and meats
13. Most ingredients can be prepared the night before too
14. Enjoy !

title: chicken of dumpling soup
steps:
1. Place chicken in a large soup pot and cover completely with water
2. Bring to boil and simmer for 1 1 / 2 hours
3. Remove chicken from water , skin and bone
4. Trim off excess fat
5. Set aside
6. Put the carrots , celery and potatoes into the water that you cooked the chicken inches
7. Add the barley and rice
8. Bring the water back to a boil
9. Turn down heat and simmer uncovered until the carrots are tender
10. Season to taste with the bouillon granules
11. To make the dumplings:
12. Mix the egg , milk and enough flour to make the dumplings hang together
13. Scoop a spoonful of the dumpling mixture and drop it into the hot soup
14. Simmer for 20 minutes or until the dumplings are done
15. Add the chicken back into the soup and heat until desired temperature

title: sage and cheddar potato gratin
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f mix sage , salt and pepper in small bowl
2. Layer 1 / 3 of the potatoes and 1 / 2 of the onion in lightly greased 13x9-inch baking dish
3. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon of the sage mixture and 1 / 3 of the cheese
4. Repeat layers
5. Top with remaining potatoes , sage mixture and cheese
6. Stir broth and cream in medium bowl with wire whisk until well blended
7. Pour evenly over potatoes
8. Bake 1 hour or until potatoes are tender and top is golden
9. Let stand 5 minutes before serving

title: christmas clementine  carrot and coriander soup w  citrus twists
steps:
1. Sweat the finely diced carrots and onion in large saucepan with the butter - keep the lid on and keep stirring them until soft , for about 10 minutes
2. Add the crushed coriander and heat through for about 2 minutes to release the fragrance , and then add the hot stock , ground cumin and ground ginger
3. Bring to the boil and then cover the pan and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes
4. Add the ground rice , clementine juice and zest - stirring well , and continue to simmer for a further 30 minutes
5. Remove from the heat and allow to cool slightly , then liquidise in a food processor or with an immersion blender
6. Adjust the consistency by adding extra clementine juice or stock if the soup is too thick
7. Return the soup to the pan and reheat for 5 minutes or until piping hot but not boiling
8. Remove from the heat and season with salt and pepper to taste
9. Serve in pre-heated soup bowls with twists of clementine zest on top of the soup , as well as an assortment of dinner rolls and flavoured butters

title: healthy brown sugar mustard glazed carrots
steps:
1. Steam carrots until tender
2. In a separate saucepan heat brown sugar mustard and water until warm and dissolved
3. Drain carrots and place in bowl
4. Spritz with butter spray and toss
5. Pour glaze on top of carrots and toss again
6. Enjoy !

title: low fat poppy seed chicken
steps:
1. Combine chicken , soup , sour cream , diced onion and poultry seasoning in a baking dish
2. Crush ritz crackers and combine with poppy seeds
3. Sprinkle evenly over the top of the casserole
4. Bake in preheated 350f oven 15-20 minutes until heated through

title: peach and ginger salsa
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and mix gently
2. Serve immediately

title: western skillet rice
steps:
1. In a medium skillet brown ground beef
2. Stir in onion soup mix , water , rice , tomatoes and peas
3. Simmer about 30 minutes , stir in cheese cubes and continue simmering until they are soft and partially melted

title: pork loin with green chiles
steps:
1. Cut pork loin into 1 inch slices
2. Pound slightly
3. Mix together the flour with cayenne pepper , cumin , seasoned salt and the pepper
4. Roll pork pieces in seasoned flour
5. In a large skillet , saute pork , red onion and green or red pepper in butter until golden
6. Add rd wine to skillet along with chopped green chiles
7. Cover skilled and simmer for 30 minutes
8. Add pinto beans and continue cooking for 15 more minutes
9. Before serving , top hot pork with grated cheese

title: herbed garlic butter
steps:
1. Place all the ingredients into a food processor or mixing bowl and blend together
2. Store in an airtight container
3. Makes 1 pound

title: low fat packet italian chicken and vegetables
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Place one chicken breast in each packet topped with italian dressing
3. Sprinkle basil and parmesan cheese on top of dressing
4. Arrange vegetables on top of chicken
5. Secure end of packet
6. Leaving room for the heat to circulate
7. Bake 20 to 25 minutes on a cookie sheet
8. While chicken is cooking , cook pasta according to package direction
9. Cut a slit in packet to let heat escape before removing chicken
10. Place chicken and vegetables on top of pasta
11. Can sprinkle more parmesan cheese on top

title: brown sugar oatmeal
steps:
1. In a saucepan over medium-high heat , add the oats , salt , and water
2. Stir to combine
3. Bring to a boil
4. Lower heat and simmer until the oats are tender
5. Stir in the cream and simmer until the mixture is creamy and thick
6. Add in the brown sugar and dried fruits
7. Stir until heated through
8. Ladle into individual bowls and top with toasted walnuts

title: pork and lentil cassoulet
steps:
1. Trim fat from pork and cut meat into 3 / 4-inch cubes
2. In a large nonstick skillet brown pork , onion , and garlic in hot oil
3. Transfer mixture to a 3-1 / 2- to 4-quart electric crockery cooker , add water , undrained tomatoes , carrots or parsnips , celery , lentils , rosemary , bouillon granules , salt , and pepper
4. Cover and cook on high-heat setting for 4-1 / 2 to 5-1 / 2 hours
5. Garnish with a fresh rosemary sprig , if desired
6. Make-ahead
7. Cover and chill until ready to assemble in crockery cooker

title: bev s fiesta meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Mix all ingredients except 1 / 4 cup of the salsa and the cheese
3. Shape into oval loaf in 13x9-inch baking dish
4. Top with remaining 1 / 4 cup salsa
5. Bake 1 hour or until cooked through
6. Sprinkle evenly with cheese and continue baking an additional 5 minutes before cutting into slices

title: vegetable vermicelli upuma
steps:
1. Boil water in a pot
2. Add a little salt
3. Boil the carrots , beans and cauliflower in it for 10 minutes
4. Drain
5. Keep aside
6. Boil vermicelli in 5 cups of water with salt to taste and 2 tbsps
7. Of oil till slightly underdone
8. Drain
9. Refresh under cold water
10. Keep aside
11. Heat the rest of the oil
12. Add mustard seeds and curry leaves
13. Once the mustard seeds stop spluttering , add black urad dal , chopped ginger and onion
14. Saute until the onion turns light brown
15. Add green chillies
16. Add the cooked peas , carrots , beans , cauliflower , capsicum and salt
17. Saute for 5 minutes
18. Add the cooked vermicelli
19. Stir gently
20. Cook for 5 minutes
21. Remove from heat
22. Squeeze lemon juice over it
23. Serve hot for breakfast !

title: caramelized broccoli
steps:
1. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat and add the oil
2. Add the broccoli and stir well to coat with the oil
3. Season to taste with s / p
4. Fry until the broccoli turns brown from the sugars caramelizing
5. Just leave it alone until it starts to brown on the bottom before turning it
6. The result is crispy , sweet , almost candy-like
7. No , it's not burnt - it's caramelized
8. Lol

title: chickpea orzo salad
steps:
1. In a saucepan , place the pasta in boiling water and cook for 9 to 11 minutes , until al dente
2. Drain and cool under cold running water
3. In a small bowl , whisk together the oil , vinegar , mustard , mint , and seasonings , forming a vinaigrette
4. In a large mixing bowl , combine the orzo , tomatoes , scallions , cucumber , garlic and olives
5. Blend in the vinaigrette , feta , and if desired , chickpeas
6. Chill for 1 hour before serving
7. Place over a bed of lettuce

title: mexican skillet spaghetti
steps:
1. In a dutch oven or 12" skillet , brown ground meat
2. Add salt , tomato sauce , water , taco mix & onion
3. Bring to a boil , add spaghetti
4. Simmer covered for 25 to 30 minutes or until spaghetti is tender , stirring frequently
5. Sprinkle with cheese & serve

title: ricciarelli   traditional italian almond cookies
steps:
1. Place the blanched almonds into a nut grinder or food processor fitted with a steel blade
2. Process to a fine powder
3. Transfer to a mixer bowl and mix in the almond paste with an electric mixer
4. Add the egg white and mix at the lowest speed until thoroughly blended
5. Add the baking powder and the almond extract , and mix until well blended
6. Use a small cookie scoop to portion the dough into roughly 1-heaping tablespoonful sized balls
7. Dust your hands with icing sugar and then roll these balls to form little finger sized logs
8. Place the ricciarelli logs 1 inch apart on parchment-lined baking sheets and then flatten slightly
9. Let stand uncovered at room temperature at least 1 hour or overnight
10. When you are ready to bake , pre-heat the oven to 300f degrees
11. Place cookie sheet on the middle rack of the oven and bake until the cookies are a very light tan , 20 to 30 minutes
12. Take care not to bake until brown or crisp , as it is the softness that makes the ricciarelli so delicious !
13. Generously dust cookies with additional icing sugar while still warm , then carefully transfer to racks to finish cooling
14. Ricciarelli cookies keep for several weeks in an airtight container

title: brussels sprouts   love them or leave them
steps:
1. Cook the bacon until brown and crisp
2. Drain on paper towel , set aside
3. Saute the shallots in the bacon drippings about 4 minutes or until golden brown
4. Add the chicken broth , thyme , sherry , salt and pepper
5. Add the brussels sprouts cut side down , cover and cook 15 minutes until soft , but , not mushy , serve with bacon and topped with parmesan cheese , enjoy

title: cold and spicy sesame noodles
steps:
1. Whisk soy , peanut butter , vinegar , optional hot sauce , and sesame oil
2. Add the spaghetti and toss to coat well
3. Sprinkle green onion and sesame seeds throughout and serve

title: chicken penne casserole
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , saute the chicken , onion , peppers , garlic , and seasonings in oil until chicken is no longer pink
2. Stir in broth
3. Bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat
5. Cover and simmer for 10-15 minutes or until slightly thickened
6. Preheat oven to 350
7. Cook pasta according to package directions , and drain
8. Toss with chicken mixture
9. Spoon half of the mixture into a greased 2-qt
10. Baking dish
11. Sprinkle with half of the cheese
12. Repeat layer
13. Cover and bake at 350 for 25 minutes
14. Uncover
15. Bake 5-10 minutes longer

title: crock pot meatballs and gravy
steps:
1. Place the meatballs in the crock pot
2. In a bowl , combine remaining ingredients and pour over the meatballs
3. Cook on lo 6 to 8 hours

title: creamy penne with prosciutto  pimiento and peas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. In a small heavy saucepan over medium heat , bring cream , 1-1 / 2 cups cheese , pepper and salt just to a boil , stirring occasionally
3. Remove from heat
4. Meanwhile , cook pasta according to package directions until al dente
5. Drain
6. Return pasta to pot , stir in prosciutto , peas , pimiento and cream sauce , mixing well and making sure pasta is well-coated
7. Transfer to a 2-quart shallow baking dish and bake 15 minutes
8. Stir pasta well to redistribute sauce , then sprinkle with additional parmesan cheese
9. Turn on broiler and broiler about 2-4 minutes , until top is lightly browned

title: my type  non alcoholic mai tai
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except crushed ice in a shaker half filled with ice
2. Shake well
3. Strain into an old-fashioned glass half filled with crushed ice
4. Garnish with a slice of fruit and a drink umbrella

title: protein bran muffins
steps:
1. Set oven to 375 degrees
2. Line or grease muffin cups
3. In a large bowl , combine first 7 ingredients
4. In another bowl beat together the egg whites , brown sugar , oil , milk and molasses
5. Stir in fruit
6. Add liquid ingredients to dry mixture
7. Stir just ubtil moistened
8. Fill muffin cups
9. Top with crumble topping - include 3tbsp of brown sugar , flour and oats each + 2 tbs of soft butter)
10. Bake for 18 to 23 mins , until tops spring back

title: whole baked ham
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f if necessary , remove all skin , leaving a thin covering of fat
2. With a sharp knife , score a diamond pattern into fat and insert cloves to decorate
3. Place ham in a shallow roasting pan , fattest side up , with 2-3 cups water
4. Cook for about 15 minutes per lb
5. , or until meat thermometer registers 140f
6. Meanwhile , mix remaining ingredients for the glaze
7. During last half hour of cooking , raise temperature to 350f and brush ham liberally with glaze
8. Add more water if bottom of pan starts to burn
9. Repeat glazing after 15 minutes
10. When cooked , allow ham to rest 15 minutes before carving
11. Use leftovers for salads , sandwiches , or in a pasta dish
12. , it can also be frozen for future meals

title: scandinavian chicken soup
steps:
1. Cook chicken in a kettle until done
2. Cool , debone , and chop into pieces
3. Strain the cooking liquid and return chicken broth to a boil over high heat
4. Add diced potatoes , onion , and dillweed
5. After the soup returns to a boil , reduce the temperature and simmer the potatoes until tender , about 12 minutes
6. Add the chicken , salt , and pepper
7. Simmer about 5 minutes
8. Sprinkle with chopped red onions and dillweed just before serving

title: cool lime pie
steps:
1. From limes , finely grate 4 teaspoons peel and squeeze 2 / 3 cup lime juice
2. In large bowl , with wire whisk , stir undiluted condensed milk , lime peel , and lime juice until well blended
3. Whisk ice cream into condensed milk mixture and evenly blend
4. Pour ice cream mixture into pie crust
5. Freeze at least 6 hours or until firm
6. If not serving pie same day , wrap and freeze up to 1 week
7. To serve , uncover pie and let stand at room temperature 10 minutes to soften for easier slicing
8. May serve with whipped cream and additional lime peel slivers for garnish

title: steamed thai chicken balls
steps:
1. Place a steamer or colander coated with cooking spray over a pan of boiling water and cover with the lid or firmly sealed with foil
2. In a large bowl , combing the egg , chicken mince , breadcrumbs , ginger , lemongrass and coriander
3. Mix well using your hands
4. Form spoonfuls of the mixture into 24 balls
5. Place in the steamer , cover and cook for 10 mins or until cooked though
6. While chicken balls are cooking , combine the fish sauce , lime juice , garlic , chili and sugar
7. Place in small bowls for dipping
8. Remove the balls from the steamer and serve accompanied by the dipping sauce
9. Enjoy

title: zeppole
steps:
1. Beat eggs
2. Set aside
3. Put yeast in warm water and dissolve according to the package's instructions
4. Mix the yeast with the beaten eggs
5. Set aside
6. Mix together the dry ingredients: flour , baking powder , salt , and sugar
7. Combine the egg / yeast mixture with the dry mixture
8. Mix well
9. Batter should be thicker than pancake batter
10. Put batter in a bowl and let it rise for 1 hour
11. Place in a warm spot and cover with a towel
12. Warm the oil
13. To test if the oil is hot enough , drop in a small amount of batter
14. If it sizzles the oil is ready
15. Take a spoonful of batter and carefully drop into the oil
16. The zeppole do not have to be perfectly smooth and round
17. Be sure not to touch the spoon to the oil , as this will cool the temperature of the oil
18. Cook until brown
19. It will rise to the top
20. When the zeppole rises to the top , turn over to cook the other side of it to cook evenly
21. Once it is brown take out and drain on paper towels
22. While they are still warm sprinkle with confectioner's sugar
23. Makezeppole's in batches
24. Between batches , check the oil temperature to make sure it is still hot enough
25. It will cool down as you make the zeppole

title: overnight butter rolls
steps:
1. Sprinkle yeast into 1 / 4 cup very warm water
2. Stir and set aside
3. In a large bowl beat eggs and blend in dissolved yeast
4. Add 2 1 / 2 cups flour alternating with 1 cup very warm water
5. Mix in sugar and 1 / 2 cup melted butter and salt
6. Mix until smooth
7. Beat in remaining flour to make a soft dough
8. Cover with a tea towel and let rise in a warm draft free place until doubled in bulk
9. Punch dough down and cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight
10. When ready to bake rolls , punch down refrigerated dough and divide into 2 pieces of dough
11. Roll each half into pieced 8 inches by 15 inches
12. Spread lavishly with softened butter
13. Starting with the long edge , roll jelly roll fashion
14. Cut with a very sharp knife of piece or thread into 1 inch slices
15. Place slices into muffin tin with cut side up
16. Let rise to double
17. Bake 8- 10 minutes in a 400 degree oven to golden brown
18. Brush with melted butter and cool on a rack

title: cavatappi and goat cheese
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Drain
3. Heat oil in saucepan
4. Add onions and cook slowly until golden and caramelized , about 20-25 minutes
5. Stir occasionally
6. To toast walnuts , place in a separate preheated skillet and saute for a few minutes
7. Combine goat cheese and milk in a small bowl and mix until well blended
8. Set aside
9. Add garlic to onion in skillet , cook until softened , about 3 minutes
10. Add wine , sage , salt and black pepper
11. Cook until liquid has evaporated
12. Remove from heat
13. Add pasta and goat cheese mixture , stirring to melt cheese
14. Sprinkle with walnuts
15. Enjoy !
16. Refrigerate any leftovers

title: tuna orzo salad
steps:
1. To serve cold
2. Mix all ingredients together in large bowl and chill
3. 1 hour
4. Serve on lettuce leaves
5. To serve hot
6. Mix all together and place in
7. Casserole
8. Bake 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until heated through
9. Serve with parmessan toast or bread of choice

title: crabby jacks
steps:
1. In a bowl , mix crab , cheese , and onions with mayonnaise
2. Place 5 tortillas in a single layer on two 14"x17" baking sheets
3. Evenly cover tortillas with crab mixture to within 3 / 4" of edges
4. Top each with one of the remaining tortillas
5. Bake in a 450 oven until cheese melts , and tortillas are lightly browned , 7-9 minutes
6. Slide quesadillas onto a board and cut each into 6 wedges
7. Arrange on a platter and garnish with cilantro sprigs

title: devil s food cupcakes w  cream cheese frosting  low cal fat
steps:
1. Stir together the cake mix , egg whites , carrots , water , and coffee
2. Using an electric mixer , beat on low speed for 30 seconds to blend slightly
3. Increase the speed to medium and beat for 2 minutes
4. Spoon the batter into 24 muffin cups that have been sprayed with nonstick spray
5. Bake for 20 minutes at 325 or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
6. Put the pans on cooling racks and let stand for 15 minutes
7. Remove cupcakes from pans and allow to cool
8. In a medium mixing bowl , combine cream cheese , confectioner's sugar , milk , and vanilla
9. Using an electric mixer , beat on medium speed until smooth
10. Using a rubber spatula , fold in the cool whip
11. Cover and refrigerate until needed
12. Top each cupcake with 1 tablespoon topping

title: besan ladoos for lynda clark
steps:
1. Mix the milk and 1 / 4 cup ghee with the gram flour in a mixing bowl
2. Use your fingers to mix
3. Cover and set aside for half an hour
4. Chop nuts or break them to fine pieces
5. Heat the rest of the ghee in a wok
6. Now , fry the gramflour in the ghee for 5-7 minutes
7. Break the whole lump of gramflour into smaller pieces
8. Keep stirring continuously
9. Add sugar , nuts and cardamom powder
10. Mix well
11. Switch off flame
12. Transfer mixture to a plate and spread out mixture so as to allow it to cool faster
13. After 10 minutes when the mixture is still warm but has cooled down a bit , make into even sized balls
14. Store in an airtight container

title: sloppy joe in the crock pot
steps:
1. Saute onions and garlic in skillet until onions are clear
2. Add ground beef and cook until no longer pink
3. Drain fat
4. Add to crock pot with chili sauce , water , mustard , salt and pepper
5. Stir well , cook on low 4-6 hours
6. Place one slice of cheese on a slice of bread and cover with sloppy joe mix then cover with another slice of bread to create a sandwich , repeat until all bread is used up
7. Enjoy

title: grilled trout with cashew and garlic butter
steps:
1. Preheat hot grill or barbecue
2. Slash skins of fish deeply three times on each side to let the heat permeate the flesh
3. Remove the heads if you like
4. Brush the fish lightly with oil , and season with salt and pepper both inside and out
5. Cook under grill or on barbecue for 4 minutes on each side , or until the skin is browned and the flesh feels firm
6. Melt the butter in a wide shallow pan , and fry the nuts quickly until toasted
7. Add the garlic and parsley , and fry the mixture briefly until the parsley darkens slightly
8. Add the lemon juice with more salt and pepper to taste and heat through
9. Put each trout on a warm serving plate , and spoon over cashew and garlic butter

title: oregano   chilli haloumi   hellim
steps:
1. Whisk all dressing ingredients together in a small bowl
2. Taste and season with pepper
3. Set aside until haloumi is cooked
4. To cook the haloumi , heat a large non-stick frying pan over a high heat , with one tablespoon of olive oil or spray the pan with olive oil cooking spray
5. Once the pan was hot add haloumi and cook for one minute each side or until brown and heated through
6. Place the haloumi on a serving platter
7. Spoon over the dressing and sprinkle with oregano leaves and sliced lemon wedges
8. Serve immediately with crusty bread
9. Enjoy

title: mushroom and leek sauce
steps:
1. Heat oil in a non stick frying pan over medium heat
2. Add garlic , chili and leek
3. Cook , stirring for 3 to 4 minutes or until soft
4. Add flour and cook for 1 minute
5. Increase heat to high and add mushrooms
6. Cook , stirring for 3 minutes or until tender
7. Add evaporated milk gradually , stirring
8. Bring to the boil
9. Reduce heat to medium and simmer for 4 minutes or until thickened
10. Stir in parsley
11. Season with salt and pepper
12. Enjoy !

title: beer braised beef and onions
steps:
1. Pat beef dry and season all over with 2 1 / 2 teaspoons salt and 1 teaspoon pepper
2. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wide 5-to 6-quart heavy pot over medium-high heat until it shimmers
3. Brown beef on all sides , about 15 minutes , then transfer to a plate
4. Cook onions with bay leaves and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt in remaining tablespoon oil in pot , scraping up brown bits from bottom and stirring occasionally , until onions are well browned , about 25 minutes
5. Meanwhile , preheat oven to 350f with rack in middle
6. Cut a round of parchment paper the diameter of the inside of pot
7. Set parchment round aside
8. Add beer and vinegar to onions and bring to a boil , stirring and scraping up brown bits
9. Add beef and meat juices from plate and return to a boil
10. Cover with parchment round and lid and braise in oven until meat is very tender when pierced in several places with a meat fork , about 3 1 / 2 hours
11. Transfer beef to a cutting board and let stand , loosely covered , 20 minutes
12. Cut off string , then slice meat
13. Skim off fat from sauce and discard bay leaves
14. Reheat if necessary
15. Serve braised beef with onions and sauce

title: salsa tuna melts
steps:
1. Toast your bread until it is light golden brown
2. Drain excess liquid from the salsa if it is very juicy
3. Otherwise , the tuna mixture will be too runny , and the toast will become soggy
4. While the bread is toasting , mix the tuna , mayonnaise and salsa in a small bowl
5. Spread some of the tuna mixture on each piece of toast
6. Place slices on a foil-lined pan in the toaster oven and heat until tuna mixture is warmed through , about 3-5 minutes
7. Top each piece with a slice of cheese , and put back in oven until cheese is melted
8. Enjoy !

title: strawberry and raspberry multi beneficial juice
steps:
1. Liquify the raspberries and strawberries in a blender
2. Pour over crushed ice
3. Enjoy under the afternoon sun !

title: bread pudding with blueberries
steps:
1. With a whisk , combine half and half , eggs , sugar , cinnamon , salt , vanilla and almond extract in a large bowl
2. Add bread cubes and stir until well coated
3. Fold in blueberries
4. Pour mixture into a greased 8x8 pan
5. Sprinkle 1 / 4 cup cinnamon sugar evenly over the top
6. Bake at 350 for 35-40 minutes or until a knife inserted into the center comes out clean
7. Serve with cinnamon syrup or vanilla sauce

title: baked salmon fish sticks
steps:
1. Spray a baking sheet with non-stick cooking spray and set aside
2. In a shallow dish , combine the corn meal , black pepper and garlic powder
3. Dip the salmon slices into the milk and then dredge in the corn meal mixture , coating completely
4. Place the coated salmon on the prepared baking sheet , allow to rest 10 to 15 minutes
5. While the salmon rests , preheat oven to 375 degree
6. Place the salmon sticks in oven and bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until the sticks flake easily

title: fruit dip
steps:
1. Beat all ingredients
2. Serve with favorite fruit

title: fresh corn salsa frittata with hash brown crust
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 375 degrees
2. Start by making the corn salsa
3. Place the sweet corn in a strainer and let it thaw over a large bowl
4. Once thawed , discard the liquid in the bowl
5. Dice the onion , red pepper , jalapeno pepper and roughly chop the cilantro
6. Combine the corn , onion , red pepper , jalapeo pepper , cilantro and lime in a medium-sized bowl
7. Sprinkle in the salt and stir
8. Set the salsa aside
9. Liberally spray a baking dish with cooking spray
10. Place the simply potatoes shredded hash browns into the pan
11. Press the potatoes onto the bottom and up on the sides to create a crust
12. Spray the potatoes again with cooking spray
13. Once the oven is preheated , place this into the oven for 15 minutes
14. Whisk the eggs in a large bowl
15. Add the 1 cup of the salsa , the ham and cheese into the eggs
16. Stir until combined
17. When the potato crust is done cooking , pour the egg mixture into the pan on top of the crust
18. Place back in the oven for 35-40 minutes or until the eggs are fully cooked
19. Test this by placing a toothpick in the middle , if it comes out clean the eggs are fully cooked
20. Top with additional corn salsa and squeeze of lime juice
21. Enjoy !

title: calico skillet potatoes ala silver dollar city
steps:
1. Add the bacon drippings or olive oil to a large skillet
2. Preheat over medium heat until the drippings or oil is just hot
3. Add the diced onion and diced green sweet pepper
4. Cook the onion and pepper until they're tender
5. Add the unpeeled , sliced russet potatoes , the sliced sweet potatoes and water to the vegetables in the skillet
6. If adding sausage , stir it in now
7. Sprinkle the mixture with the seasoning or seasoned salt
8. Cover and cook over medium heat for 12 to 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender , turning potatoes once or twice

title: profiteroles with coffee ice cream
steps:
1. Profiteroles
2. Chill a small metal baking pan in freezer
3. Form 18 ice cream balls with scoop and freeze in chilled pan at least 1 hour
4. Preheat oven to 425f with rack in middle
5. Grease a large baking sheet
6. Bring butter , water , and salt to a boil in a small heavy saucepan , stirring until butter is melted
7. Reduce heat to medium , then add flour right away and cook , beating with a wooden spoon , until mixture pulls away from side of pan and forms a ball , about 30 seconds
8. Transfer mixture to a bowl and let cool slightly , 2 to 3 minutes
9. Add eggs 1 at a time , beating well with an electric mixer after each addition
10. Transfer warm mixture to pastry bag and pipe 18 mounds 1 inch apart on baking sheet
11. Try to keep them of equal size at least for appearance purposes and balance
12. Bake until puffed and golden brown , 20 to 25 minutes total
13. Prick each profiterole once with a toothpick , then return to oven to dry , propping oven door slightly ajar , 3 minutes
14. Chocolate sauce
15. Heat sugar in a heavy saucepan over medium heat , stirring with a fork to heat sugar evenly , until it starts to melt , then stop stirring and cook , swirling pan occasionally so sugar melts evenly , until it is dark amber
16. Remove from heat , then add cream and a pinch of salt
17. Remove from heat and add chocolate , whisking until melted , then whisk in vanilla
18. Keep warm and covered
19. Serving them
20. Halve profiteroles horizontally , then fill each with a ball of ice cream
21. Put 3 profiteroles on each plate and drizzle generously with warm chocolate sauce
22. Ice cream and profiteroles can be made up to 1 day ahead
23. Then recrisp the profiteroles on a baking sheet at 375 degrees and cook for about 5 minutes

title: best ever and most popular garlic chips with hummus
steps:
1. Cut pita bread in wedges
2. Separate the triangles from the original piece of bread , and peel each apart so that you have an outside and inside
3. Lay triangles , inside face up , on a baking sheet , brush tops with olive oil , and sprinkle with garlic salt
4. Bake at 350 for 5 minutes or until slightly brown and let cool
5. Serve with room temperature hummus and watch it disappear !
6. However , don't overdo the olive oil , either
7. Best way is to brush several times across the bread lightly
8. Serving suggestion: scoop out hummus and lay each"mound" in the center of a an interesting tray
9. Surround by homemade chips , voila !

title: pound cake s mores
steps:
1. Place pound cake slices on a baking sheet
2. I line the sheet with foil for easy clean-up
3. Sprinkle each slice with marshmallows and chocolate chips
4. Above measurements are approximate for these toppings
5. I make sure each slice is covered but not heaping
6. Broil 4-6 inches from the heat for 1-2 minutes or til marshmallows are lightly browned
7. Transfer to a plate
8. Drizzle with caramel ice cream topping and sprinkle on nuts if desired

title: an australian white christmas
steps:
1. Line a slice tin with silicone paper
2. In a large bowl combine the powdered milk , rice bubbles , cherries , sultanas , icing sugar & coconut
3. Make a well in the dry ingredients
4. Melt copha over a low heat , cool slightly & then mix into the dry ingredients until well combined
5. Spoon into the lined tin
6. Cut another piece of silicon paper the length of the tin & place on top of the white christmas mixture
7. Smooth the surface by pressing your hands over the silicone paper
8. Refrigerate for at least 1 / 2 hour to set
9. Cut into 1 inch squares or triangles
10. Store in the refrigerator
11. Merry christmas

title: beer braised pot roast and vegetables with polenta
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f
2. Heat a large dutch oven or roasting pan over medium heat
3. Add the bacon and cook until the bacon is brown and the fat is rendered , 7 to 8 minutes
4. Remove the bacon with a slotted spoon and set aside to drain on a paper towel-lined plate
5. Set aside
6. Leave the pot on the heat
7. Season the roast on all sides with the salt and pepper
8. Add the roast to the bacon fat remaining in the pan and sear on all sides until well browned , 8 to 10 minutes
9. Remove the roast from the pan and set aside
10. Add the onions to the pan and cook until wilted and fragrant , 2 1 / 2 to 3 minutes
11. Add the mushrooms and cook stirring occasionally until the mushrooms are soft and are beginning to color , about 4 minutes
12. Add the garlic , thyme , and bay leaf and cook , stirring , until fragrant , 45 seconds
13. Add the beer , beef stock , tomatoes and their juices , and the roast to the pan and bring to a simmer
14. Cover the pot tightly , place in the oven , and bake for 1 1 / 2 hours
15. Carefully remove the roast from the oven and add the carrots , parsnips and turnips
16. Turn the meat , basting with the pan juices
17. Cover tightly and return to the oven
18. Bake until the meat shreds easily and the vegetables are tender , 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours , depending upon the size of the meat
19. Remove and discard the bay leaf
20. Remove the roast from the pan and let sit on a cutting board until cool enough to handle
21. Using two forks or a knife and form , shred the meat
22. Skim the fat from the pan juices and discard
23. Return the meat to the pan , add the parsley , and stir well
24. To serve , spoon the polenta into wide entree bowls and spoon the pot roast , vegetables , and gravy on top

title: strawberry dressing
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a blender or food processor and blend until pureed
2. Refridgerate in a sealed bowl until ready to use

title: butter shot
steps:
1. Shake the ingredients together with ice in a cocktail shaker
2. Strain into a cordial glass

title: grammie bea s double raisin cake
steps:
1. Put raisins in water in pan , and boil for 5 minutes
2. Let cool , then pour liquid from raisins into cup , and set aside to put in cake
3. Cream sugar , crisco , and add spices
4. Dissolve baking soda in the raisin liquid that was set aside
5. Add flour and raisins
6. Beat by hand , until creamy
7. Grease and flour a large cake pan
8. Bake at 350 , until cake springs back in the middle , about 45-60 minutes , checking often
9. Cool , and frost with vanilla frosting

title: peanut butter power balls
steps:
1. Mix peanut butter , milk powder , honey and wheat germ
2. Place the graham cracker crumbs in a shallow bowl
3. Shape teaspoonfuls of the peanut butter mixture into balls , then roll in the graham cracker crumbs
4. Place on cookie sheet or pizza pan , freeze for several hours , then move to resealable plastic bag
5. Store in freezer until ready to use , and thaw bfore eating

title: chinese chicken pasta salad
steps:
1. Mix miracle whip , soy sauce , and seasonings in a large bowl
2. Add remaining ingredients
3. Mix lightly
4. Refrigerate

title: peanut vegetable harvest casserole  stove top
steps:
1. Saute onions , garlic and peppers in oil
2. Stir in carrots , potato , sweet potato and tomatoes
3. Simmer over low heat till just tender
4. Add beans , spinach and corn and simmer for another 10 minutes
5. Stir in salt , peanut butter and crushed red pepper
6. Serve over cooked rice , topped with chopped peanuts

title: chicken drumsticks with garlic   herb
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180 degrees celcius
2. Marinate the drumsticks in oil , garlic and herbs / salt for about 1 / 2 hour
3. Place on a baking tray lined with baking paper and cook for 40 minutes , turn and cook for a further 20 minutes
4. Wrap the drumsticks in individual foil , and freeze the portions
5. Whenever you want them , put them in the oven to warm or allow to thaw in the fridge over night to eat cold

title: mom s chicken and dumplings  chicken paprika
steps:
1. In a stock pot or dutch oven saute onions in butter until tender
2. Add water until pot is about 1 / 3 full
3. Add chicken thighs , garlic powder , salt , pepper and paprika
4. Make sure water is covering the chicken , if not add more until it just covers
5. Bring to a boil and then simmer for 90 minutes , covered , stirring occasionally
6. In the meantime , make the dumplings: mix the flour , salt , pepper and paprika in a medium bowl until combined
7. Make a well in the center and drop in the egg and about 1 / 2 cup water
8. Stir and add more water by the tablespoon until you have a sticky dough that just leaves the side of the bowl
9. In a different large pot from chicken , boil water
10. Drop dumpling mixture by the teaspoon into the boiling water
11. If dumpling mix is too sticky to drop from spoon , then dip the spoon into the boiling water , the dumpling should slide right off
12. When dumplings start floating on top , remove them with a slotted spoon or drain them
13. You may have to reduce the heat to see when they are floating
14. About 30 minutes before chicken should be done , add the dumplings to the pot with the chicken
15. After 30 minutes , you should have a delicious dish: the chicken should be tender enough that it is falling off of the bone and the dumplings should have made a thicker sauce out of the liquid the chicken was cooking inches

title: dairy free meatballs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Place all ingredients except olive oil into a large bowl and mix together using your hands
3. Once it looks like the onions are well distributed throughout , you can probably stop
4. Place a layer of aluminum foil on a rimmed baking sheet
5. Thinly coat with the olive oil
6. Begin to shape the meatballs using a small handful of the mixture , placing each one on the oiled sheet pan
7. Bake in preheated oven for about 20 to 25 minutes , until cooked through
8. Drain on a towel
9. Serve hot or in marinara sauce over noodles

title: starlight  caffe
steps:
1. Combine coffee , coffee liqueur and southern comfort in medium bowl
2. Flavor mixture with sugar to taste
3. Divide between 2 cups
4. Whisk whipping cream in heavy small saucepan over medium heat until hot and frothy , about 2 minutes
5. Spoon hot cream over coffees , dividing evenly
6. Sprinkle grated chocolate over and serve

title: heather s tropical bean salsa
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine the onion , mango , avacado , red pepper , corn , beans , olives , carrotes , lime juice , salt and pepper
2. Let stand 10 - 15 minutes to allow the flavors to blend
3. Stir in cilantro and enjoy with your favorite chips

title: gluten free peanut butter chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Put on non stick cookie sheet sprayed with in cookie balls shapes as large or small as you want
3. Smash cookies with spoon till flat
4. Bake at 325f for 20 minutes

title: coffee shop fudge
steps:
1. Line an 8" square pan with foil
2. Butter the foil and set aside
3. Place pecans in a microwave-safe pie plate
4. Microwave , uncovered , on high for 4 minutes , stirring every minute
5. Set aside
6. In a 2 quart microwave safe bowl , combine chocolate chips , milk , coffee , cinnamon , and salt
7. Microwave , uncovered , on high for 1 1 / 2 minutes , and stir until smooth
8. Stir in vanilla and pecans
9. Immediately spread into the prepared pan
10. Cover and refrigerate until firm , about 2 hours
11. Remove from pan
12. Cut into 1" squares
13. Cover and store at room temperature

title: corn muffin casserole
steps:
1. In large bowl , combine first four ingredients well
2. Stir in corn muffin mix
3. Pour into 9x13-inch pan
4. Drizzle melted margarine over top and sprinkle with sugar
5. Bake in preheated 350f oven for 55-60 minutes

title: grilled sirloin steak  colombian churrasco
steps:
1. Prepare the chimichurri
2. Combine the parsley and garlic in a food processor and process until finely chopped
3. Add the oil , 1 / 4 cup vinegar , water , 1 1 / 2 teaspoons salt , and 1 teaspoon pepper and process to make a thick sauce
4. Correct the seasoning , adding salt , pepper , or vinegar as necessary
5. The mixture should be highly seasoned
6. Place half the chimichurri in a bowl or crock for serving
7. Pour the remainder over the meat
8. Cover and let marinate in the refrigerator , 30 minutes , turning several times
9. Preheat the grill to high
10. When ready to cook , oil the grill grate
11. Drain the beef and place it on the hot grate
12. Grill , turning with tongs , until cooked to taste , about 10 minutes per side for medium-rare
13. Serve with the remaining chimichurri sauce
14. It is normally served on a wooden cutting board
15. I cut it like london broil in thin slices across the grain

title: giant peanut butter cup cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Beat butter , sugar and peanut butter in medium bowl until creamy
3. Add egg and vanilla
4. Beat well
5. Stir together flour , baking soda and salt
6. Add to butter mixture , blending well
7. Drop dough by level 1 / 4 cup measurements onto ungreased cookie sheets , 3 cookies per sheet
8. Cookies will spread while baking
9. Push about 7 pieces of peanut butter cup into each cookies , flattening cookie slightly
10. Bake 15 to 17 minutes or until ligh golden brown around the edges
11. Centers will be pale and slightly soft
12. Cool 1 minute on cookie sheet
13. Remove to wire rack
14. Cool completely

title: sweet potato pecan pie
steps:
1. Prepare pie shell , set aside
2. Make sweet potato filling: in medium bowl , with electric mixer , beat 1 egg until frothy
3. Add mashed cooked sweet potatoes , sugar , butter , vanilla extract , salt , cinnamon , allspice , and nutmeg
4. Beat at medium speed until the mixture is smooth , about 2 minutes
5. Make pecan topping: in medium bowl , with mixer , beat eggs until frothy
6. Add sugar , corn syrup , melted butter , vanilla and cinnamon
7. Beat at low speed just until mixture is well blended , about 1 minute
8. Stir in pecans
9. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
10. To assemble: turn sweet potato filling into unbaked pie shell , spreading evenly
11. Pour pecan topping over top
12. Bake 60 to 70 minutes until set , and knife inserted in center comes out clean
13. Remove pie to rack to cool
14. Just before serving decorate with whipped cream

title: south beach balsamic chicken
steps:
1. Rinse the chicken and pat dry
2. Combine the rosemary , garlic , pepper , and salt in a small bowl and mix well
3. Place chicken in a large bowl
4. Drizzle with the oil , and rub with the spice mixture
5. Cover and refrigerate overnight
6. Preheat oven to 450
7. Spray a heavy roasting pan or iron skillet with cooking spray
8. Place chicken in pan and bake for 10 minute turn chicken over
9. If drippings begin to stick to the pan , stir in 3-4 tbs water or wine if using
10. Bake about 10 min til thermometer registers 160 and juices run clear
11. If the pan is dry , stir in another 1-2 tbs of water or wine to loosen the drippings
12. Drizzle the vinegar over the chicken in the pan
13. Transfer the chicken to plates
14. Stir the liquid in the pan and drizzle over the chicken

title: hash brown cheddar bake
steps:
1. Cook bacon in large pan until desired firmness is reached
2. Set aside and break up into small pieces
3. In the same pan , add your garlic and onion , saute for about 10 minutes , or until onions are clear
4. Add the tater tots or hash browns to the onions and garlic
5. Cover for 10 minutes or so , stirring a couple times
6. Meanwhile , in a large bowl , combine condensed soup , sour cream , 1 / 4 c cheddar cheese , bacon , salt , and pepper
7. Add the taters to the soup mixture and gently stir
8. Grease a 9x13 baking pan and spoon the mixture into it
9. Add the remaining 3 / 4 c of cheddar cheese to the top
10. Bake in the oven at 350 degrees for 30 minutes covered , and then another 30 minutes uncovered , or until cheese is lightly brown and sides are bubbly

title: spicy catfish tenders with cajun tartar sauce
steps:
1. Make tartar sauce: stir together all ingredients in a bowl and chill , until ready to serve
2. Prepare fish: whisk together egg and hot sauce in a wide shallow dish
3. Stir in fish strips and let stand at room temperature at least 10 and up to 30 minutes
4. Pour enough oil into a 4 to 5 quart heavy pot to measure 2 inches and heat over medium heat until thermometer registers 350f stir flour , cornmeal , salt and cajun seasoning in another wide shallow dish
5. Fry fish
6. Drain fish well in a colander
7. Dredge one fourth of fish in flour mixture shaking off excess flour , then fry in oil , stirring occasionally with a slotted spoon , until golden brown and just cooked through , 1 1 / 2 to 2 minutes , remove with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels
8. Repeat until all fish is fried
9. Serve hot with tartar sauce and lemon wedges

title: big john s stampede chicken
steps:
1. Put chicken in a shallow bowl and add onion , thyme , parsley , bell peppers , tomatoes , rosemary , garlic , salt and peppers , soy sauce and lime juice
2. Let stand at least 2 hours , turning to coat
3. Heat oil in a heavy skillet
4. Add sugar and let it brown and bubble
5. Add chicken and let it brown thoroughly , about 10 minutes , turning to brown evenly
6. Add marinade and cook on low heat , covered , until tender: about 45 minutes

title: creamy italian pasta
steps:
1. Boil pasta as directed on package and drain
2. Meanwhile , brown meat with garlic powder and italian seasoning
3. Mix all very well in pasta pot over low heat until cream cheese melts
4. Top evenly with mozarella
5. Cover and let sit on low for about 15 min , or until mozarella melted
6. Enjoy !

title: midwest chowder
steps:
1. In a saucepan , add first 6 ingredients
2. Bring to a boil
3. Cover and reduce heat
4. Simmer for 10-15 minutes
5. Remove from heat but don't drain
6. In a large saucepan , melt butter
7. Stir in flour , salt , and pepper
8. Cook 2 minutes or until bubbly , stirring constantly
9. Gradually add milk and stir until well blended
10. Cook over medium heat until mixture boils and gets thick , stirring constantly
11. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes
12. Add cheese , stirring until melted
13. Add undrained vegetables and corn
14. Stirring occasionally , cook until thoroughly heated , but do not boil

title: fasolia piaz  bean salad
steps:
1. Cook the navy beans until tender
2. Drain
3. Combine the beans with the remaining vegetables and parsley
4. Season with salt
5. Shake up the oil with oregano and 2 tblsps of vinegar in a small bottle
6. Taste
7. If not sharp enough , add more vinegar
8. Dress the bean salad and stir gently to combine
9. Add eggs and stir even more gently not to break them up
10. Serve on 4 lettuce-lined plates

title: broccoli with lemon  kalamata olives and capers
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan fitted with a steamer basket , bring a 1 inch of water to a bowl
2. Steam the broccoli until tender-crisp , 4 to 5 minutes
3. Transfer the broccoli to a serving bowl , cover and set aside
4. While the vegetables are steaming , in a small saucepan over medium heat , melt the butter
5. Add the oil and garlic and cook , stirring , for 1 minute just until the garlic begins to become fragrant
6. Stir in the olives , lemon juice and capers and cook until heated through , approximately 1 minute
7. Pour the sauce over the steamed broccoli and season with black pepper
8. Toss well to coat
9. Garnish with a sprig or two of fresh parsley , if desired

title: betty s crunchy brownie bars
steps:
1. For crunchy layer , combine flour , soda and salt
2. Stir in oats and brown sugar
3. Add the 3 / 4 cups melted butter and pat mixture in bottom of an ungreased 13 x 9-inch baking pan
4. Bake at 350f for 5 minutes
5. At this time it will not be completely baked
6. While bottom layer is in the oven , prepare brownies as directed on package
7. Spread batter in pan over crunchy layer
8. Return to oven and bake for approximately 25-30 minutes until done
9. Prepare frosting when brownies are cool
10. In a small saucepan melt together chocolate and the 3 tablespoons butter
11. Remove from heat
12. Immediately add confectioners' sugar , vanilla and 2 tablespoons hot water
13. Stir until smooth
14. Add remaining tablespoon hot water to make a soft , pourable consistency
15. Spread over brownies while frosting is still hot
16. Let set until firm
17. Cut into bars

title: chicken fried rice   oamc
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the peas and carrots , rice , onion , parsley flakes and chicken
2. Mix well
3. Pour into 4 bags or less for family size
4. Seal , lable and freeze
5. Thaw bag of rice mixture
6. Heat 1 tbs oil in a large skillet
7. Dump rice mixture into the skillet
8. Cook and stir over medium heat , breaking up any chunks of rice , until hot , about 5 minutes
9. Push rice mixture to the side of the skillet
10. Add 1 tbs oil to the empty side of the skillet and add the eggs
11. Cook and stir until eggs are thickened but still moist
12. Combine eggs with the rice mixture
13. Turn off heat
14. Stir in soy sauce and pepper
15. Serve

title: easy meatballs topped with guacamole
steps:
1. Remove the pork sausage meat from the skins , and mix with the ground beef with a fork or your hands , but do not compress too much
2. Set oven at 180 deg c or 350 deg f , while you prepare the onion , zest , etc
3. Add the finely-chopped onion , thyme , lemon zest , chopped garlic , hot sauce
4. Worcestershire sauce , seasoned salt and pepper
5. Break in the egg
6. Mix in well , until ingredients are well incorporated
7. Use a utensil which can go on both your hob and also into the oven
8. Heat the pan well and add the olive oil
9. Form 6 - 8 fat , generous meatballs , and fry on both sides until nicely browned but not done
10. Put the pan or dish with the meatballs in the pre-heated oven , and bake for about 15 to 20 minutes longer
11. Serve with large blobs of guacamole , and salad ingredients
12. Or use as a main meat dish with veggies and salad

title: choose your crust creamy cheesecake
steps:
1. Choose a crust-
2. New york style crust:
3. Combine first two ingredients , cut in butter until mixture is crumbly
4. Add egg yolk and vanilla
5. Blend thoroughly
6. Pat dough on sides and bottom of 10 inch springform pan
7. Bake at 350 degrees about 8 minutes or until golden brown
8. Let cool
9. Graham cracker crust:
10. In a medium bowl , mix together graham cracker crumbs , melted butter , and sugar
11. Press remaining mixture firmly into bottom and sides of a 10 inch pie pan
12. Bake at 350 degrees oven 10 minutes , until lightly browned
13. Filling:
14. Combine flour and sugar and set aside
15. Beat 1 egg at a times , very slowly , into the softened cream cheese
16. Very slowly , add the flour / sugar , then the vanilla , and cream
17. If necessary , speed up the beating until very creamy
18. Pour batter into a 10 inch springform pan
19. Bake at 500 degrees for exactly 10 minutes
20. Then reduce oven to 200 degrees
21. Bake for 1 hour
22. Turn off oven
23. Let sit for at least 6 hours , or overnight
24. Then , refrigerate for at least 2-3 hours
25. This is a time temperature sensitive recipe
26. The cheesecake may crack when cooling , but this is easily concealed with a fresh whipped cream topping or strawberries / blueberries
27. This will last in fridge for well over a week , if kept airtight

title: red  white and blue shooter
steps:
1. Pour the grenadine into a shot glass
2. Very slowly pour the peach schnapps over the back of a small spoon into the shot glass
3. Very slowly pour the blue curaao over the back of a small spoon into the shot glass

title: strawberry oatmeal cream cheese bread  bread machine
steps:
1. Add ingredients according to your manufacturers instructions
2. Bake on sweet bread cycle

title: weight watcher tuna noodle casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cook noodles according to directions without fat or salt
3. Transfer to a large bowl
4. Fold in tuna , mushrooms and peas
5. Mix together sour cream , mayo , mustard , thyme , salt and pepper
6. Fold into noodle mixture
7. Transfer to a casserole dish
8. Top with cheese
9. Bake about 30 minutes , until top is golden and casserole is warm

title: bacon tomato cups
steps:
1. Combine bacon , tomato , onion , swiss cheese , mayonnaise and basil in a bowl and mix well
2. Separate each dough round into 3 layers
3. Press one layer into each greased miniature muffin cup
4. Spoon the filling into each cup
5. Bake at 375f for 10 to 12 minutes or until edges are brown

title: slow cooker cajun chicken pasta
steps:
1. In the slow-cooker , stir together chicken , alfredo sauce , tomatoes and juices , chicken broth , peppers and cajun seasoning
2. Cover and cook on high 3-4 hours , or low 6-8 hours
3. Cook pasta according to directions on package , serve chicken and sauce over cooked pasta and garnish with chives if desired

title: pumpkin pie waffles
steps:
1. Preheat waffle iron
2. In a mixing bowl , combine flours , oat bran , brown sugar , baking powder , spices , and salt
3. Separately , mix together milk , pumpkin , oil , and honey until smooth
4. Add pumpkin mixture to dry ingredients , mixing well
5. In another bowl , beat egg whites until stiff but not dry
6. Gently fold into batter
7. Pour 1 1 / 4 cups batter onto greased waffle iron and cook until waffle is golden and cooked through

title: mini ham   cheese calzones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Unroll dough
3. Separate into 12 breadsticks
4. Cut each breadstick crosswise in half
5. Flatten dough to 2-inch width
6. Spoon 1 teaspoon mozzarella cheese onto center of a ham piece
7. Fold ham piece over cheese to create a tight roll
8. Place ham roll near the end of a piece of breadstick dough , leaving a border
9. Fold dough over ham , pinching edges to seal
10. Repeat process for all ham pieces
11. Place calzones on baking sheet
12. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese
13. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown
14. Serve warm

title: broccoli tofu and peppers in orange sauce
steps:
1. Saut onion , broccoli , tofu and bell pepper in oil
2. In a bowl , combine the sauce ingredients
3. Add to the veggies
4. Cook until thickened and bubbly
5. Serve with rice

title: lite ham egg and potato salad
steps:
1. Bring a pot of water to the boil and boil potatoes for 15 minutes
2. Add eggs to the pot
3. Continue to boil the eggs and potatoes for another 15 minutes or until the potatoes are nicely cooked through
4. A skewer should pass easily through the centre of the potatoes
5. Allow to cool
6. The above can be done the night before and the eggs and potatoes refrigerated overnight
7. Start your char-grill or pan heating up , spray lightly with oil
8. A grill with a bit of charcoal or character is best , as it adds a more "barbequed" flavour to the ham
9. Meanwhile , dice the cooled boiled potatoes into 1cm cubes
10. Peel the boiled eggs and chop them lengthways in half and then cut each half across into slices
11. Add to potatoes
12. Finely chop and add the spring onions / scallions
13. Once the grill or pan is heated , add the ham steak and cook until heated through and a little charred
14. Remove the steak from heat and allow to cool , slightly
15. Dice into even cubes and add
16. In a small bowl mix together lemon juice , mayonnaise , mustard and vinegar
17. Add water until the dressing reaches the desirable consistency
18. Pour dressing over other ingredients , season with salt / pepper , toss and divide evenly onto plates
19. Serve with a lighter side salad such as cherry tomatoes , baby spinach and cucumber

title: south  street tortilla roll ups
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , stir the cream cheese , onion , sour cream , and taco seasoning until well blended and smooth
2. Fold in cheddar cheese , chiles , tomatoes , and hot sauce
3. Spread mixture on tortillas
4. Roll up tortillas
5. For easier cutting , refrigerate roll-ups until cream cheese mixture is firm
6. Slice and serve cold with salsa and guacamole , if desired

title: vegetarian stuffed acorn squash
steps:
1. Cut squash in half , remove seeds , and bake , cut side down , at 350 degrees for 30 minutes
2. Meanwhile , saute onions , celery , and carrot in butter or oil until soft and translucent
3. Add garlic and mushrooms , and continue cooking until they are soft and have released their juices
4. Add sherry to "deglaze" the pan , and allow to simmer briefly
5. Add bread cubes , raisins , sunflower seeds , sun-dried tomatoes , and walnuts , stir to combine
6. Add sage and salt / pepper to taste , then enough broth to soften
7. Remove from heat
8. Once cooled slightly , stir in shredded cheese
9. Add stuffing to interior of squash , mounding as needed , and bake covered another 20-30 minutes
10. For a crunchier top , remove cover for the last 10 minutes

title: easy dill dip for veggies  vegan
steps:
1. Mix together all ingredients in bowl
2. Place in fridge for 2 hours to let the flavors blend
3. Enjoy !

title: tasty peas
steps:
1. In a skillet over med
2. Heat , saute the garlic and onion in the olive oil
3. Mix the water and chicken stock , then add to the skillet
4. Stir in the peas and simmer until tender
5. Season with pepper as desired

title: garlic shrimp stacks
steps:
1. In a 10- to 12-inch nonstick skillet frying pan over medium-high heat , stir garlic in olive oil until limp , about 1 minute
2. Add shrimp and stir often until pink on the outside , 2 to 3 minutes
3. Add lime juice and stir occasionally until most of the liquid has evaporated and shrimp are opaque but still moist-looking in center of thickest part , about 3 to 5 minutes
4. Stir all but 2 tablespoons of the green onions and the cilantro
5. Add salt and pepper to taste
6. Lay 2 tortillas flat on a 14-by-17-inch nonstick baking sheet
7. Divide half of the shrimp mixture between tortillas and spread to within 1 / 2 inch of edges
8. Sprinkle a third of the cheese over shrimp
9. Lay another tortilla on each stack and top equally with remaining shrimp mixture and another third of cheese , cover with remaining tortillas and sprinkle with remaining cheese over the top
10. Bake in a 400f oven until cheese is melted around edges of stacks and beginning to brown on top , 10 to 12 minutes
11. With a wide spatula , transfer stacks to plates
12. Sprinkle with reserved green onions , serve with salsa and lime wedges , enjoy

title: lemon garlic shrimp skewers
steps:
1. Mix salt and sugar and toss shrimp
2. Chill for one hour
3. Rinse and drain
4. Mix remaining ingredients with the shrimp
5. Put on skewers and grill just until pink

title: quick cider vinegar dressing
steps:
1. Add all items to a shaker
2. Shake vigorously
3. Pour on desired item and serve
4. Enjoy !
5. I use a dressing shaker that i can mix and store in and keep it in the fridge until i use it up
6. :)

title: autumn leaves
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350
2. Saut the squash , onion and tomatoes in 2 t butter until tender
3. Melt 1 / 4 cup butter in saucepan and stir in the flour
4. Gradually add the bouillon , stirring until thickened
5. Stir in the cream , basil , parsley and pepper
6. Remove from the heat and stir in the vegetables and rice
7. Put in a greased 2-quart casserole and sprinkle with parmesan
8. Bake in oven until bubbly and heated through

title: yummy tuna wraps
steps:
1. Open your can of tuna and drain well
2. Empty contents of can into a bowl , and add mayo and ricotta
3. Shred your carrots into the bowl , and stir well
4. Add all spices , and stir thoroughly
5. Add celery and mix through
6. Heat your tortilla in a heated skillet until warm and slightly crispy , or toast your pita
7. Add grapes to tuna mixture and stir lightly
8. Spread desired amount of tuna on tortilla or in pita , and serve !
9. I like to serve with some sliced pears on the side
10. It adds a nice touch !

title: crock pot waikiki chicken
steps:
1. Dump all in crock pot cook on high for 1 hour
2. Cook on low for 7 hours
3. Serve over rice
4. Enjoy

title: passover charoset
steps:
1. Chop apple into very small pieces and mix with pecans
2. Add cinnamon and wine
3. Mix well and refrigerate

title: pork chops and rice
steps:
1. Place uncooked rice in bottom of a greased dish
2. Cover rice with sliced onion
3. Lay pork chops over onion and rice
4. Salt and pepper
5. Pour beef consomme and water over all
6. Bake in covered dish for 1 hour at 450 degrees f
7. I always decrease the rice it calls for because , we are not big rice eaters

title: cheesy barbecued corn on the cob
steps:
1. Preheat outdoor grill or preheat oven to 400f
2. Shuck corn
3. If desired , leave husks attached to cob to use as holders
4. In a small bowl , combine softened butter , chili powder , and powdered cheese packet or creamy cheese sauce
5. Spread butter on corn and wrap each ear individually in foil
6. Place on the grill and close the lid or place in the oven
7. Cook 25 to 30 minutes , turning every 5 minutes , or until corn is tender
8. Remove foil and serve

title: bakery oatmeal chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Mix first four ingredients until combined , mix by hand
2. Add the dry ingredients , then the oats , then the chocolate chips , mixing each time
3. Refrigerate dough for taller / chunkier cookies for 1 hr or more
4. Drop them on a greased pan in tablespoonfuls
5. 350 for 10 mins (i usually find that 12 is good- though recipe said 10
6. It's a little too gooey for me
7. Just start checking them after 10

title: welsh raisin date nut cake bara brith
steps:
1. In a saucepan , heat together first 6 ingredients and allow mixture to simmer for a minute or 2 , or until nicely blended and raisins are plumped
2. Allow to cool for 30 minutes
3. Mix together and stir in the next 8 ingredients until dry ingredients are just moistened
4. Do not overmix
5. Stir in the apricot jam
6. Scrape batter into a greased 10-inch springform pan and bake in a 325f
7. Oven for about 1 hour and 20 minutes or until a cake tester , inserted in center , comes out clean
8. Allow to cool in pan , and then cover tightly with plastic wrap and store cake in the refrigerator
9. Easiest& best !
10. Coffee cakes and quick breads

title: carrot or zucchini muffins
steps:
1. Blend flour , salt , baking soda , cinnamon , nutmeg , and bran together in food processor , 4 to 5 seconds
2. Pour into large mixing bowl
3. Process carrots until pureed and add to dry ingredients
4. Process the eggs and oil for 2 - 3 seconds and add to bowl along with the milk , vinegar , honey , molasses , and raisins
5. Stir with a wooden spoon until just blended
6. Do not overmix
7. Spoon the batter into paper-lined muffin tins and bake at 375f for 20 to 25 minute

title: roasted brussels sprouts with dijon  walnuts and crisp crumbs
steps:
1. Position racks in the top and bottom thirds of the oven and heat oven to 400f line two rimmed baking sheets with parchment
2. In a large bowl , whisk 1 / 4 cup of olive oil with the mustard , worcestershire , caraway seeds , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and about 10 grinds of pepper
3. Add the sprouts and toss to distribute the mustard mixture
4. Spread the sprouts in an even layer on the two baking sheets
5. Roast until cores of the sprouts are just barely tender and the leaves are browning and crisping a bit , 20 to 25 minutes
6. While the sprouts are roasting , make the topping
7. Line a plate with two layers of paper towels
8. Heat the remaining 1 tbsp of oil with the mutter in a medium skillet over medium-high heat
9. When the butter has stopped foaming add the breadcrumbs all at once
10. Toss to coat with butter mixture
11. Reduce heat to medium , add the walnuts and 1 / 4 tsp , salt and cook , stirring constantly until the crumbs are browned and slightly crisp and the nuts are golden , 4 to 6 minutes
12. Dump the breadcrumb mixture onto the paper towels to drain the excess fat
13. Transfer the sprouts to a serving bowl and season to taste with salt and pepper if necessary
14. Sprinkle the crumbs over the sprouts just before serving

title: pudding filled biscuit triangle
steps:
1. Put a double folded length of aluminium foil on the kitchen bench , around 60 cm
2. Dip the biscuits in milk and arrange three lengths down the foil to make a fairly long and narrow rectangle
3. Beat the chocolate pudding mix with 2 cups milk in a small bowl and whip the cream with the icing sugar in a separate bowl
4. Carefully spoon the chocolate pudding on the middle length of biscuits and cover it with the whipped cream
5. Let the pudding set a little to make it easier to handle as it shouldn't be runny
6. You might also want to decrease the amount of milk if your pudding doesn't thicken quickly
7. Then carefully lift up the sides of the foil and press gently together to form a triangle
8. It should be full completely with the mixture
9. Melt the couverture in the microwave or in a baine-marie and carefully cover the biscuits with the melted chocolate
10. Before the chocolate sets sprinkle with sliced almonds or chocolate sprinkles
11. Then cover carefully with the sides of the foil when the chocolate has set and keep in the freezer until serving
12. Allow the cake to set in the freezer for at least 3 hours

title: milk marinated pork chops with applesauce
steps:
1. In a dish mix together milk and 2 teaspoons salt
2. Add in pork chops
3. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour or up to 4 hours
4. To make the applesauce: peel , core and chop the apples
5. Place into a saucepan and add in the remaining ingredients
6. Bring to a simmer , stirring occasionally
7. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer covered , stirring occasionally until apples are very soft and falling apart
8. Mash the apples with a fork
9. Set aside
10. For the pork chops: in a bowl mix together bread crumbs , garlic , rosemary , thyme and 1 teaspoon seasoning salt or white salt and pepper
11. Lift the pork chops from the milk one at a time
12. Dredge in the pork chops , lightly , patting down with hands to adhere the crumbs to the chops
13. Arrange onto a plate or tray
14. Heat oil and butter in a skillet
15. Saut the pork chops until golden brown , adding more butter to the pan if needed
16. Serve the pork chops with applesauce
17. Delicious !

title: mix   match pudding pie  low fat
steps:
1. Pour milk into medium bowl
2. Add pie filling mix
3. Beat with wire whisk 2 min until well blended
4. Spoon 1-1 / 2 cups of pudding mix into pie crust
5. Top with special topping
6. Gently stir in cool whip into remaining pudding
7. Spoon over pie
8. Refridgerate for 3 hours
9. Top with cool whip before serving

title: apple pie  the french way
steps:
1. Have the pie crust dough ready
2. Roll out 2 / 3 of the pastry to form a 12 inch circle and line a 9 inch pie plate with it
3. Refrigerate with remaining pastry
4. To make custard: in a small saucepan , combine 1 / 3 cup sugar and the flour
5. Mix well
6. Stir in milk
7. Bring to a boil , stirring
8. Reduce heat
9. Simmer , stirring until slightly thickened , approx
10. 1 min
11. Or so
12. In a bowl , beat 3 egg yolks slightly
13. Beat some of the hot mixture into yolks
14. Pour back into the saucepan , stirring
15. Add 1 tablespoon butter and the vanilla
16. Turn into a bowl to cool
17. Apple filling: core , pare and slice the apples , sprinkle with lemon juice
18. In a skillet , heat the butter with the sugar and nutmeg
19. Add the apples
20. Saute , stirring occasionally
21. Cook until almost tender- about 5 minutes
22. Remove from heat
23. Melt apricot preserves in a little saucepan and set aside
24. Preheat oven to 425f
25. Assembly: pour the custard into the pie shell , spreading evenly
26. Arrange the apple slices on top , mounding slightly in the center and only adding a little of the juices released from cooking them
27. Spread with the melted apricot preserves
28. Roll out the rest of the pastry dough to make a 10 inch circle
29. Cut into 12 strips , 1 / 2 inch wide
30. Moisten the edge of the pastry shell with a little water
31. Arrange six pastry strips across the filling
32. Press ends to rim of pie shell
33. Trim ends if necessary
34. Arrange rest of strips at a right angle to the first strips , to form a lattice
35. Bring overhang of the pastry up over ends of strips
36. Crimp edge
37. Mix egg yolk with 1 tablespoon of water and brush on pastry
38. Bake 40 minutes , or until golden

title: smoked bacon   onion sweet cornbread
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , combine the cornmeal , flour , baking soda , salt and sugar
2. Sift together until thoroughly mixed
3. In a 12 inch cast iron skillet , fry up your 4 strips of thick cut bacon
4. Chop them up into small pieces and put them into separate mixing bowl
5. Chop the green onions and add them to the mixing bowl with the bacon
6. Now add in the milk , eggs and 2 tablespoons of the bacon grease
7. Now pour the wet ingredients into the larger mixing bowl with the dry ingredients and thoroughly mix these together
8. Set the batter aside
9. Get your smoker going
10. Youll want to get this hotter than you usually do
11. Well need it up to about 375
12. Put your cast iron skillet in right away , so its good and hot when you pour the batter inches i used apple wood for this cornbread , but you can use what ever wood you prefer
13. I also had to open the side door on my webber smoky mountain vertical smoker a couple of times to get it hot enough
14. It would start dropping back down towards 350 , then i would open the door again for about 1 minute to get it moving back up
15. Once its up to temperature , pour the batter into the skillet , close it up , and maintain this temperature as best as possible
16. This should take about a half hour to cook
17. Stick a toothpick into the center of the cornbread
18. If it comes out clean , its done
19. Another indicator of it being done is that the sides should start pulling away from the pan
20. Take it off and serve it up in the skillet
21. It will stay nice and warm sitting in the skillet !

title: balsamic egg  bruschetta   salad
steps:
1. Peel hard boiled eggs and dice as small as possible
2. Dice onion , roasted peppers basil and tomatoes into very small pieces
3. Place all diced foods into bowel
4. Add oil , vinegar and spices to taste
5. Let sit for 1 / 2 hour
6. Spoon on top of toasted crostini bread rounds or eat alone , or atop of some good dark leafy greens
7. Top with good shaved parmesan cheese if desired

title: janie s fruit salad
steps:
1. Make the jello according to package directions and add the other ingredients inches
2. Pour into rectangular casserole dish and chill according to package directions
3. Mean while add the first 5 topping ingredients together in a small sauce pan and cook slowly until you get a custard like consistency
4. Add the 1 cup of cool whip
5. Pour over the chilled jello mixture and chill an additional hour
6. Cut in squares and place on individual lettuce leaves for serving

title: awesome angus roast beef wraps
steps:
1. Spread onion and chive cream cheese on one side of tortilla
2. Lay out slices of roast beef evenly on tortilla
3. Dribble a little ranch dressing in a thin line down the middle
4. Spread a small thin line of horseradish down the middle
5. Spread out the torn romaine lettuce evenly on tortilla but make sure all ingredients are a little away from the edges so you can fold it easier
6. Put strips of tomato in a line down middle
7. Spread monterey pepper jack cheese evenly on tortilla
8. Fold the ends of the tortilla to the stuffing , then starting at one side , roll up the tortilla
9. Makes one wrap

title: stromboli wraps
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Lightly spread one side of each tortilla with butter
3. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon parmesan
4. Arrange 1 / 4 each of provolone , salami , ham and bell peppers over center of tortillas , leaving a border around edges
5. Sprinkle each tortilla with 1 / 4 of the mozzarella
6. Fold up wrap style
7. Place seam side down on non-stick baking sheet
8. Brush with remaining butter
9. Sprinkle with remaining parmesan
10. Bake 12-15 minutes or until golden brown
