11. Slice each stromboli on the diagonal
12. Serve with heated sauce

title: pupusas con curtido  masa cakes with spicy slaw
steps:
1. Combine vinegar , sugar , oregano , chiles , carrots , onions , and cabbage in a bowl
2. Season with salt
3. Toss
4. Let chill
5. Put masa harina and 1 34 cups water into a bowl
6. Stir to form a dough
7. Pinch off a 1 12 oz piece of dough
8. Roll it into a ball
9. Pat dough into a thin disk
10. Squeeze 1 14 oz cheese into a ball
11. Press cheese into center of dough
12. Cupping dough , stretch edges of dough around cheese and seal
13. Pat dough to form a 3 12" wide disk
14. Repeat to make 12 pupusas in all
15. Heat a 12" nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
16. Working in 3 batches , cook pupusas , turning , until golden , 1012 minutes
17. Serve hot with slaw

title: spaghetti with truffle oil  garlic and rosemary
steps:
1. Saute onion-garlic and rosemary in olive oil
2. Make sure onion is golden-and garlic is not burnt
3. Boil spaghetti in 3 quarts salted water with a touch of milk in the water , as well as a tablespoon of oil
4. When al dente , drain pasta , toss with onion , garlic and rosemary
5. Add parmesan and toss again
6. Drizzle the truffle oil on top of each individual serving
7. Garnish with fresh chopped rosemary--just a pinch

title: goat s cheese  avocado   smoked salmon cups
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 190c , and grease 2 x 12-hole mini muffin pans
2. Roll out the bread slices to flatten them slightly and , using a biscuit cutter , cut 1 x 7 cm circles from each slice
3. Brush the bread rounds with olive oil and gently press them into the lightly greased muffin pans
4. And bake them for 6-8 minutes , until they are crisp and golden
5. Then cool them on wire racks
6. Lightly mash the goat's cheese in a bowl and fold through the salmon , avocado , juice and pepper to taste
7. And spoon into the bread cups just before serving

title: potatoes with a mushroom puree    garnished with truffles
steps:
1. Rinse potatoes place in pot and cover with cold water
2. Bring to a boil and cook over medium heat till tender about 20 minutes
3. Meanwhile in a pan place 2 tablespoons olive oil and saute mushrooms for 5 minutes season with salt and pepper and add thyme , shallots and garlic cook till translucent
4. Remove a couple of the cooked mushrooms for garnish and set aside
5. Add 3 / 4- 1 cup of the cooked potatoes and 2 tablespoons butter to the mushrooms , puree with a hand blender adding potato water to make a smooth puree
6. Slice potatoes in half lengthwise
7. Stir truffle oil , salt and pepper to taste into potatoes
8. Spread 3 / 4 of the pureed mushroom mixture on a serving platter top with sliced and seasoned potatoes topping with 1 / 4 of the mushroom mixture
9. Garnish with the mushrooms that were set aside , sliced truffles and thyme sprig
10. Enjoy !

title: bread pudding with rum
steps:
1. Cube bread and place , crust side down , into a casserole dish
2. Scald 1 1 / 2 cups milk and pour over bread
3. Let sit 15 mins
4. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
5. Whisk eggs with spices and salt
6. Add sugar and whisk until dissolved
7. Add remaining ingredients
8. Scald remaining 1 1 / 2 cups milk
9. Add milk to egg mixture in 1 / 2 cup increments and whisk thoroughly after each addition
10. Pour mixture over bread
11. Bake for 45-50 minutes , or until top browns and a fork inserted near the center comes out clean
12. Meanwhile , mix together rum and brown sugar
13. Add just enough water to obtain a molasses-like consistency
14. About 7 minutes before the end of baking , spoon topping mixture on
15. Serve warm
16. Reheats well

title: real italian tomato sauce
steps:
1. Mix together the cooking oil , garlic , ground beef , ground italian sausage and brown
2. Add the tomatoes , tomato paste , tomato sauce , oregano , sugar , water , salt , pepper& crushed red pepper
3. Bring to boil then lower heat
4. Simmer 2-3 hours , stirring often
5. Can be frozen for future meals

title: frozen patio punch
steps:
1. Combine ingredients and beat until fluffy in blender
2. Freeze in ice cube trays
3. Pour room temperature ginger ale over punch cubes
4. Hint: for variation , use 2 cubes per 8 oz glass
5. Pour ginger ale over cubes and add 1 oz rum

title: honey lemonade with raspberry cubes
steps:
1. Combine lemon juice and honey in a large pitcher
2. Stir until honey is dissolved
3. Stir in water
4. Place 1 to 2 pieces of raspberry fruits in each compartment of two ice trays
5. Fill each compartment with honey lemonade anf freeze until firm
6. Chill remaining lemonade
7. To serve , divide frozen fruit cubes between tall glasses and fill with remainiing honey lemonade

title: spareribs sweet and tender  crock pot
steps:
1. Rub ribs with salt , pepper dried garlic and ginger
2. In a crock pot on low heat add rest of ingredients stir to blend
3. Add seasoned ribs coat and place top on pot and cook for 6-8 hours on low heat
4. Till the meat almost falls off the bones
5. Remove ribs and place on a cookie sheet pan line with foil
6. Brown ribs just a couple minutes each side under broiler
7. Meanwhile mix cornstarch with a small amount of the sauce from the crock pot
8. Skim fat if necessary
9. Put into a microwave safe dish with rest of sauce with cornstarch mixture and heat in micro to thicken
10. Pour over browned ribs or serve on the side
11. Garnish with fresh cilantro , sesame seeds , and or parsley

title: pasta and tomato casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Cook pasta according to package directions
3. Spread 1 / 2 of pasta on the bottom of a 2l casserole dish , top with 1 / 2 of cheese
4. Mix seasonings into tomatoes and pour over pasta
5. Top with remaining pasta and cheese
6. Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes

title: spinach stuffed mushrooms
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400f lightly coat an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan with the cooking spray and set aside
2. Wash the spinach , and place in a medium-size heavy saucepan with just the water that clings to the leaves
3. Cook , covered , over moderate heat for 2 to 3 minutes or until wilted
4. Drain and cool the spinach
5. Squeeze out the liquid with your hands , finely chop , and set aside
6. Remove the mushroom stems , and chop them fine
7. Set aside mushroom caps
8. In a heavy 7-inch skillet , melt the butter and olive oil over moderate heat
9. Add the garlic , and cook for 30 seconds
10. Stir in the chopped mushroom stems , and cook for 5 minutes or until golden
11. Mix in the spinach and the oregano , and cook , stirring , 1 minute longer
12. Stir in the lemon juice , and remove from the heat
13. Fill the mushroom caps with the spinach mixture , sprinkle with the breadcrumbs , and transfer to the baking pan
14. Bake uncovered for 10 to 15 minutes or until the breadcrumbs are lightly browned
15. Serve immediately

title: dottie s zucchini  chicken  and rice casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Heat 3 tablespoons of the oil in a large sautee pan and saute 1 cup of the onions with the garlic for 2 minutes
3. Add the zucchini and mushrooms and saute for 3 minutes more
4. Combine the vegtables with the cooked chicken , rice , broth , spices , and cheese
5. Mix and season to taste with salt and pepper
6. Place mixture in a greased 9 x 13 baking dish
7. Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil and saute the remaining cup of onions for 3 minutes , then add the tomatoes and chili powder
8. Season to taste with salt and pepper
9. Spoon the topping over the rice and chicken mixture
10. Bake for 1 hour

title: bean curd szechuan style  ma po dofu
steps:
1. Cut bean curd into
2. 5-inch cubes , place in a colander and leave to drain for 15 minutes
3. Meanwhile , in a small bowl blend the marinade: 1 tsp of soy sauce , sherry , and sweet bean or hoisin sauce
4. Add pork and stir to coat
5. Stir in 1 tsp of the oil and marinate for 15 minutes
6. Heat a wok or wide frying pan over high heat
7. When pan is hot , add remaining veg oil
8. When oil begins to heat add ginger and garlic
9. Stir once , then add pork and stir-fry until meat isn't pink any more , about 2 minutes
10. Stir in hot bean sauce
11. Add drained beancurd , the water and the 2 tbsp soy sauce
12. Simmer for 3 minutes , then add green onion
13. Re-mix cornstarch and water with a fork , add to pan and cook , stirring , until sauce bubbles and thickens
14. Sprinkle with crushed szechuan peppercorns just before serving
15. Serve over large mounds of hot white rice
16. I have served this along with some stir-fried chinese broccoli seasoned with a little oyster sauce , or some baby bok choy stir fried with a little sesame oil
17. For a vegetarian version , this recipe also works if you omit the meat
18. You could also try using some kind of veggie sausage , like morningstar crumbles , in place of the pork

title: easy ham carbonara
steps:
1. Cook pasta
2. In a skillet , saute the onion in oil
3. Add the ham , broth and margarine and heat through
4. Add drained pasta to ham mixture
5. Pour in egg yolks and cook until the eggs are completely set
6. Sprinkle with parsley and parmesan cheese and toss to coat

title: baked chicken and stuffing casserole
steps:
1. In a baking pan: place chicken & add slice of cheese to each breast
2. In seperate bowl combine chicken soup and 1 / 4 water
3. Place soup mixture on top of chicken and cheese
4. Then crunch up stuffing into small bits , add to chicken
5. The last step is to add the butter over the top
6. This way the stuffing gets moist and crunchy
7. Bake at 350 for 1 hour

title: buddha s pizza pie crust
steps:
1. Combine water and sugar in small bowl
2. Stir to dissolve sugar
3. Sprinkle yeast on top
4. Stir to combine
5. Let stand about 8 minutes or until foamy
6. Combine flour , italian seasoning , garlic , salt , and 1 tbsp of the olive oil in your kitchenaid
7. Stir in yeast mixture
8. Knead 1-2 minutes or until dough is smooth and elastic , and cleans the sides of the bowl , adding additional flour , , as needed
9. Pour the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil on your hands , and pick up the dough and rub your hands over it to coat
10. Place the ball of dough into a plastic grocery bag and let it rise in warm place 30 minutes or until doubled in bulk
11. Punch down dough
12. Determine the size pie you would like
13. If you like a thick crust , go for a smaller size , a thin crust , a larger pie
14. Or make small individual pies
15. Place baking stone on the bottom rack of oven and preheat to 500f sprinkle your work surface with flour
16. Place the dough in the center and using a rolling pin , roll out dough until it reaches your desired thickness
17. Sprinkle the peel with cornmeal
18. Carefully place the dough onto the peel
19. Follow directions for your individual recipe
20. Or if you have a stone , invert the baking sheet , and place the parchment paper onto the backside of the baking sheet
21. Load it with toppings then slide the pie and parchment paper carefully onto the baking stone using the baking sheet as a peel
22. Uncover , place in oven , and bake at 375f for 25-30 minutes

title: sour cream coffee cake with brown sugar pecan streusel atk
steps:
1. Adjust the oven rack to the lowest position and heat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease the inside of a 10 inch pan
3. For the steusel - place the flour , granulated sugar , 1 / 4 cup dark brown sugar , and the cinnamon in a food processor and pulse a few times to combine
4. Transfer 1 1 / 4 cups of the mixture to small bowl and stir in remaining 1 / 4 cup brown sugar
5. Set aside
6. Add the butter and pecans to the remaining dry ingredients in the food processor bowl
7. Pulse the mixture about 3-4 times until the nuts and butter have been broken down into small pebbly pieces
8. Set aside
9. If you do not have a food process , you could also do this with a pastry cutter but
10. For the cake - in a small bowl , combine the eggs , 1 cup of the sour cream and vanilla and set aside
11. In the bowl of a standing mixer , combine the flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda , and salt at low speed , about 30 seconds
12. Add the butter and remaining 1 / 2 cup of sour cream and mix at low speed until the dry ingredients are moistened
13. Increase to medium speed and beat 30 seconds
14. Scrape down the sides of the bowl with a rubber spatula
15. Decrease the mixer speed to low and slowly incorporate the egg mixture in 3 additions , beating for 20 seconds after each and scraping the sides of bowl as necessary
16. Increase speed to medium-high and beat for 1 minute
17. Add 2 cups of the batter to the prepared pan
18. With an offset metal spatula or rubber spatula , smooth the surface of the batter
19. Sprinkle with 3 / 4 cup streusel filling
20. Drop 2 more cups of the batter over the streusel and spread evenly
21. Then add the remaining streusel filling
22. Top with remaining batter and then the streusel topping
23. Bakes until the cake feels firm to the touch and a toothpick comes inserted into the center comes out clean , about 60 minutes
24. Cool the cake in the pan for about 30 minutes
25. Then release the clasps of the springform pan and cool completely and serve

title: crockpot pork pot roast
steps:
1. Season roast well with salt and pepper
2. Brown all over in hot oil , then place in crockpot
3. Sprinkle with dry onion soup mix
4. Deglaze pan with water or broth
5. Add remaining ingredients
6. Pour over roast in crockpot
7. Cover , cook on low 8-10 hours
8. If desired , thicken broth into gravy
9. In my crockpot , this is done after 9 hours
10. Pork should reach an internal temp of 71-76 celcius for medium / well , or higher for well done

title: caramel pear pudding cake
steps:
1. Set oven to 375 degrees
2. Lightly spray a 2-quart casserole dish with cooking spray
3. In a large mixing bowl , mix together flour , white sugar , baking powder , cinnamon and salt
4. Add in the milk
5. Beat until smooth
6. Stir in the chopped pears and pecans
7. Transfer to the prepared casserole dish
8. In a bowl , combine the brown sugar , butter and boiling water
9. Mix well , pour evenly over the batter
10. Bake for 35-40 minutes
11. Serve hot with ice cream or cool whip topping

title: burgundy meatballs
steps:
1. In large saucepan over medium high heat , heat oil
2. Add half of the meat balls and cook until browned on all sides
3. Repeat with remaining meatballs
4. Set meatballs aside
5. To drippings in the saucepan , add onion , carrots , mushrooms
6. Cook until lightly browned
7. Return meatballs to the pan
8. Add 1 / 2 cup water , wine , thyme , and remaining 1 / 8 tsp of pepper
9. Heat to boiling over high heat
10. Reduce heat to low and simmer 15 minutes
11. Cook until meatballs are cooked through and vegetables are tender
12. In a cup , combine flour and remaining 2 tbsp water
13. Stir into meatball mixture
14. Cook
15. Stirring constantly , until it thickens
16. Cook orzo according to package directions , toss with butter and parsley
17. Arrange orzo on serving platter
18. Top with meatball mixture

title: shrimp hominy dip     no kidding
steps:
1. Melt cream cheese on low heat , mash hominy slightly , and add with the rest of the ingredients
2. Simmer a few minutes to blend

title: stir fry beef with cauliflower and peas
steps:
1. Combine beef with 1 / 2 tsp of salt , cornstach , and 1 t
2. Of the oil
3. Mix well with your hands
4. Cook cauliflower and carrot in boiling water for 8 minutes
5. Drain well
6. Plunge peas into boiling water for 5 seconds: rinse with cold water and drain
7. Heat 2 t
8. Of oil over medium-high heat in wok
9. Stir-fry beef 1 minute: add sherry and cook 1 minute
10. Remove and set aside
11. Combine sauce ingredients in a bowl
12. Heat 1 t
13. Oil to medium-high heat in wok
14. Stir-fry carrots , cauliflower and peas for 1 minute , adding the peas last
15. Add beef
16. Quickly pour in sauce mixture
17. Stir-fry 2 minutes
18. Serve immediately , over steamed rice

title: herbed goat cheese spread
steps:
1. Process all of the ingredients in a food processor until smooth , about 1 minute
2. Season with salt and pepper to taste and transfer to a serving bowl
3. Serve with crackers or a thinly sliced baguette

title: raspberry vinaigrette
steps:
1. Heat the jam in a small saucepan over low heat , stirring , until melted
2. Add the vinegar , salt , and pepper
3. Whisk until well combined
4. Add the oil slowly in a thin , steady stream , whisking constantly until thoroughly blended in
5. Serve immediately , or cover and refrigerate until ready to serve

title: carrot   squash roasted vegetable medley
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Melt butter in 1-quart saucepan over medium heat
3. Stir in sage and garlic
4. Place remaining ingredients in ungreased rectangular pan , 13x9x2 inches
5. Pour butter mixture over vegetables
6. Stir to coat
7. Cover and bake 25 to 30 minutes , stirring occasionally , until vegetables are crisp-tender

title: vanilla ice cream flavored frosting
steps:
1. Begin whipping the egg whites with an electric stand mixer on high
2. While egg whites are whipping , mix sugar and water in a thick-bottomed pot and heat to 220f or the "soft ball" state
3. The boiling mixture should have large glassy bubbles
4. When egg whites are fluffy and close to stiff , slowly drizzle the sugar mixture into the mixer while the mixer is still on high
5. Reduce the speed of the mixer to medium or low and allow it to cool off
6. The sugar / egg white mixture must be cool before the next step ! if need be , refrigerate until room temp or lower
7. Break the butter into approximately one half to one inch cubes
8. Turn mixer on high and add the vanilla and optional color
9. Then add the butter pieces one by one
10. If the mixture collapses , it means the mixture was too warm and you have to start over
11. Once all of the butter has been incorporated , you are done
12. Taste it , and it will remind you of vanilla ice cream

title: broiled lamb chops with onions and sherry sauce
steps:
1. Rub lamb chops with garlic and season with salt and pepper , set aside
2. Melt butter in a fry pan saute onions in butter until caramelized
3. Broil chops while sauteing onions , about 3 inches from heat for about 4-8 minutes each side or until done to your liking , place on platter and cover with sauted onions
4. Serve at once with sherry sauce
5. If you prefer , you can fry the chops in the onion pan , put onions aside and keep warm , after frying chops , put under onions on platter and keep warm while deglazing pan with sherry , sprinkle pan with a little flour , salt and pepper , add sherry and whisk up bits , boil to thicken and pour over chops and onions
6. ---------sherry sauce-------------
7. Combine 1 1 / 2 cups tomato juice , worcestershire sauce , bacon bits , and butter in the top of a double boiler over direct heat
8. Simmer for 10 minutes
9. In a small bowl whisk together 2 1 / 2 tablespoons flour and 1 / 4 cup tomato juice , whisk slowly into the simmering sauce
10. Season with salt and pepper and simmer until thickened
11. Place pot over hot water and add sherry , bring to simmer , just until hot

title: good morning   muffins
steps:
1. Mix the first 5 ingredients together in a large bowl
2. In another bowl , combine the eggs , apple sauce , oil and vanilla
3. In another bowl mix carrots , apple , pineapple , raisins , walnuts and coconut
4. Add egg mixture to dry ingredients and mix until partially incorporated , using as few strokes as possible
5. Add fruit mixture to egg-flour mixture and mix , using as few strokes as possible , until batter is just moistened and fruit is incorporated
6. Don't over mix if you want light , fluffy muffins
7. Fill greased muffin cups two-thirds full
8. Bake at 350 for 20-24 minutes or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean

title: hot buttered rum for one
steps:
1. Mix together the rum , sugar , and lemon juice in a heatproof mug
2. Add the boiling water
3. Top with butter
4. Stir with the cinnamon stick

title: pineapple daiquiri
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients together in a blender
2. Pour into large wine glasses and serve
3. Paper umbrellas optional !

title: tsr version of carrabba s bread dipping spice by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Combine all of the ingredients , except oil and lemon
2. Put in a small food processor
3. Chop briefly until all ingredients are about the same
4. Stir in oil and lemon juice
5. To serve: combine about 1 1 / 2 teaspoons spice blend to 3 to 4 tablespoons olive oil on a small dish
6. Dip sliced bread in mixture
7. French bread is good
8. Enjoy

title: turkeef meatloaf
steps:
1. Heat oil and cook onion until soft , about 5 minutes
2. Add garlic and thyme and cook 1 minute more
3. Set aside
4. Combine soy milk , egg , and ketchup
5. Stir in bread crumbs , salt , and pepper
6. Crumble in meats and add onion mixture
7. Stir until well combined
8. Form into loaf and place in baking dish
9. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 1 / 2 hours
10. Reduce 1 / 2 cup ketchup , orange juice , soy sauce , ginger and brown sugar
11. Pour over meatloaf during the last half hour of baking

title: calabacitas con chile verde
steps:
1. Heat oil over low heat in a non-stick skillet
2. Saut onion in oil
3. Add zucchini and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Add garlic to green chile and add to zucchini mixture
5. Cook for 3 minutes , stirring occasionally
6. Add corn , salt and pepper
7. Cover and cook over low heat for 8 minutes or until squash is tender
8. Enjoy !
9. )

title: summer yogurt pie
steps:
1. In large bowl stir together the yogurt and cool whip
2. Spoon mixture into graham cracker crust
3. Freeze several hours until firm
4. There is no baking required

title: macaroni and cheese pizza
steps:
1. Prepare macaroni and cheese according to package directions , gradually stir in eggs
2. Spread onto a greased 12 in pizza pan
3. Bake at 375 for 10 minutes
4. Meanwhile in a large skillet , cook beef and onion over medium heat until meat is no longer pink , drain
5. Stir in pizza sauce
6. Spread meat mixture over macaroni crust
7. Sprinkle with the mushrooms , pepperoni and cheese
8. Bale for 10-15 minutes or until a thermometer inserted in the crust reads 160 degrees and the cheese is melted

title: kittencal s creamy chicken gravy
steps:
1. In a heavy saucepan melt butter over medium-high heat
2. Whisk in flour and stir constantly for 1 minute
3. Slowly add in broth , chicken bouillon powder , half and half or milk , pinch garlic powder and dryed onions
4. Stir / whisk over medium heat until smooth and thickened
5. Add in lots black pepper and salt if desired
6. Delicious !

title: baked tomatoes
steps:
1. Cut each tomato in half and arrange cut side up on a baking dish
2. Sprinkle each half lightly with bread crumbs , parmesan cheese and thyme
3. Bake for 15 to 20 min at 375 degrees

title: crab bisque chincoteague
steps:
1. Melt butter in a heavy 4-quart saucepan over medium heat
2. Stir in flour to make a roux
3. Slowly add milk until it is well blended
4. Stirring constantly , add cheese and cook until mixture thickens
5. Reduce heat and add seasonings , sherry , cream , and parsley
6. When mixture is thoroughly heated , add crab meat , stirring gently to keep lumps intact
7. Serve immediately in warm bowls and garnish with parsley

title: indian satay vegetables   made with applesauce   vegetarian too
steps:
1. Combine first 6 items and heat , stirring until mixture comes to a boil
2. Simmer 5 minutes
3. In the meantime , prepare vegetables and steam or microwave to desired crispness
4. Mix sauce throughout veggies and enjoy !
5. It couldn't be any easier than this !

title: homemade five spice powder
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine 1 teaspoons ground cinnamon
2. 1 tsp aniseed , crushed
3. 1 / 4 tsp fennel seed , crushed
4. 1 / 4 tsp szechwan pepper , crushed
5. And 1 / 8 tsp ground cloves
6. Store in a covered container

title: pineapple leap
steps:
1. Fill a cocktail shaker with ice
2. Add all ingredients
3. Shake 'til chilled
4. Serve in tall glass

title: easy lemon chicken with rice
steps:
1. Season chicken breasts generously with garlic powder , parsley , pepper , and if desired lemon pepper
2. Sprinkle a light amount of salt of the chicken
3. Heat up a skillet on high heat , and add butter and olive oil
4. Once hot , add seasoned chicken breasts
5. Sear chicken on both sides until lightly browned , then remove the chicken from the skillet to a plate
6. Add lemon juice to the hot skillet and swirl it around to loosen all the chicken juices and flavor from the pan , but do not discard
7. Add water quickly after lemon juice has picked up the spices
8. Add bouillon cubes and bring to a boil
9. Stir in corn starch that has been dissolved in 1 / 2 celsius cold water
10. Wait for a reboil , and then add the chicken breasts back into the gravy mixture
11. Wait for another reboil and then cover the skillet , and turn the heat to low
12. Let chicken simmer for 15-20 minutes
13. Serve chicken over rice

title: bacon  tomato  camembert sandwich   smorrebrod
steps:
1. Spread bread with soft butter
2. Cover with severaly layers of very crisp bacon slices
3. Top with alternating rows of thin tomato slices and slices of ripe camambert cheese

title: summertime cottage cheese salad
steps:
1. Drain excess fluid from cottage cheese
2. Gently fold together shredded carrot , green pepper , onions , tomato and cottage cheese
3. Place in serving dish , and refrigerate until ready to serve

title: thirty minute muesli
steps:
1. Stir together oatmeal , oat bran , and yogurt
2. Cover and refrigerate mixture for thirty minutes
3. Add apple , pear , almonds , raisins , honey , and spices to oatmeal mixture
4. Mix well and serve

title: real southern cornbread
steps:
1. Put the skillet in the oven and preheat to 375 degrees
2. Combine the dry ingredients except for the baking soda in a bowl
3. In another bowl , mix the buttermilk and the baking soda
4. Set aside
5. In a small bowl , beat the egg with the sugar until combined
6. Add the oil and mix until combined
7. Pour this mixture into the buttermilk / baking soda , and mix
8. When the oven is preheated , toss the butter into the skillet and let it melt
9. Meanwhile , pour the wet ingredients into the dry , and mix in as few strokes as it takes to just make the dough come together
10. Pull the skillet out of the oven , swirling to get the butter covering the bottom and up the sides of the skillet
11. Pour the batter immediately into the pan , smoothing the top , then back into the oven for about 25 minutes , or until golden brown and pulled away from the sides of the pan
12. Turn out onto a cutting board , cut into wedges and serve
13. It may just be my upbringing , but it tastes better somehow
14. And please do not add the baking soda to the dry ingredients
15. I can't explain why , but adding it to the buttermilk makes a big difference in the texture

title: stir fried spicy cabbage
steps:
1. In a large hot pan or wok add oils to coat bottom
2. Add pepper flakes , sesame seeds , ginger and garlic stir to coat and mis together
3. Add cabbage cook 5 minutes over medium high heat stirring all the while
4. The cabbage will release water so no need to add liquids
5. Add bell pepper and scallions cover and cook for 5 minutes on medium heat
6. Sprinkle with brown sugar and stir in soy sauce cook for 4 more minutes or till your desired tenderness
7. Place on a serving platter sprinkle with hoisin sauce , scallions , and sesame seeds

title: my dad s exceptional giblet gravy
steps:
1. Boil the giblets until tender
2. Strip meat from neck and finely chop giblets in food processor or blender
3. Melt butter or shortening in sauce pan and add flour
4. Brown it to a light to medium brown then add broth and wisk to desired consistency
5. Add chopped eggs , giblets , salt and pepper and finally
6. Add the kitchen bouquet seasoning sauce , which is the key to making my "dad's" gravy

title: pancake roll ups
steps:
1. Mix the 1 / 2 cup sugar with the lemon peel , set aside
2. Mix flour , salt , and remaining sugar
3. Beat eggs , milk and butter
4. Stir into dry ingredients
5. Pour batter by 1 / 3 cupfulls on lightly greased hot griddle
6. Cook on each side until light brown
7. Sprinkle with reserved sugar mixture
8. Roll up and keep warm
9. Serve with your favorite topping

title: five spice biscotti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f & grease two baking sheets
2. In a large bowl , whisk together eggs , sugar & spices , then add melted butter & stir well
3. In another bowl , mix together 3 1 / 3 cups of flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt & almonds
4. Add half of this flour mixture to egg mixture , stirring well with a wooden spoon
5. Add 2nd half of flour mixture & stir until a smooth dough forms , adding a tablespoon or two of flour if the dough seems too tacky
6. With floured hands , you should be able to form a small piece of dough into a ball
7. Form half of the dough into a large log & place it on one of the greased baking sheets , then flatten the log until it is 5-6 inches wide & 10 inches long
8. Do the same with the 2nd half of the dough , using the second baking sheet
9. Bake the logs for 35 minutes , until logs are firm but give slightly when pressed with a finger
10. Remove baking sheets from the oven & reduce oven temperature to 325 degrees f
11. While logs are still warm , use a large spatula to carefully transfer them to a cutting board , & cut them crosswise on a slight diagonal , into 1 / 2-inch-thick slices
12. Lay the cookies on their sides on the baking sheets & bake them 15 minutes more
13. Remove from the oven & let cookies cool on a wire rack
14. Store in an airtight container , up to 2 weeks

title: traditional eggnog
steps:
1. You will need 3 medium to large bowls
2. In the first bowl beat egg whites until they start to thicken
3. Add 1 cup sugar , beat until thick
4. In the second bowl: beat egg yolks and salt until thick
5. Combine beaten egg whites with yolks and beat until mixed and thick
6. In a third large bowl beat cream until it starts to thicken
7. Add 2 tbsp sugar & vanilla to the beaten cream
8. Add milk , rum & whiskey beating continually
9. Combine all the ingredients , and chill
10. Serve with a garnish of a sprinkle of nutmeg on top of each glass

title: lee s focaccia bread
steps:
1. Grease a cookie sheet and set aside
2. In a large bowl combine flour mixture with yeast , stir in hot water , butter and egg
3. Combine until the dough pulls away from the sides of bowl
4. Turn dough onto a floured board and kneed for 5 minutes until smooth , place dough into the bowl and let rise for 5 minutes
5. Place the dough onto the greased cookie sheet and mold into a circle , cover loosely with greased plastic wrap and let rise for 30 minutes or until doubled in size
6. Heat oven to 375 degrees , uncover dough and with the handle of a wooden spoon poke holes in the dough
7. Dribble with olive oil and sprinkle with the rosemary leaves
8. Bake for 30-35 minutes or until golden brown
9. When the bread is completley cooled cut in half and begin to assemble the filling above or of your choice , replace bread lid
10. Cut into 6 or 8 portions
11. Serve with soup , salad or chips

title: morning rice bowl
steps:
1. Firstly ,
2. Other cooked grain will also work , of course
3. I have tried and liked with millet
4. The flavor of the dates is so delicious i can't imagine using anything else , but again , whatever you like :-)
5. Combine rice and soymilk in a microwave-safe bowl
6. Nuke for 40-60 sec
7. , depending on how hot your microwave is
8. Stir the chopped dates into the rice and microwave again , until the milk starts to bubble
9. Quickly stir in the nuts / seeds and diced apple , and cover the whole bowl , with a plate or lid
10. Let sit covered for 5-8 minutes
11. This will allow the flavors to blend , and the apple will get slightly soft as though baked

title: spice muffins   bad as you wanna be
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease 12 muffin cups
3. Combine water and raisins in a saucepan
4. Simmer 10 minutes
5. Set aside
6. Do not drain
7. Cream shortening and sugar
8. Add egg and raisins and reserved liquid
9. Combine dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture
10. Mix well
11. Stir in walnuts , using
12. Divide batter among prepared muffin cups
13. Bake 20-25 minutes or until muffins test done by inserting a toothpick that comes out clean
14. Cool 10 minutes , remove from pan and cool completely on a rack
15. To make frosting:
16. Combine brown sugar , half and half and salt in a sauce pan
17. Bring to a boil over low heat and stir until smooth ,
18. Stir in butter and vanilla
19. Remove from heat , cool slightly
20. Stir in confectioners' sugar
21. Frost muffins
22. Top with nuts , if desired

title: spaghetti squash stuffed bell peppers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Pan spray a shallow baking dish& set aside
3. Bring stock to a boil in a large skillet
4. Add zucchini , shiitakes , green onions , basil , thyme , garlic& pepper
5. Simmer until the vegetables are tender , no longer than 5 minutes
6. Remove from heat& mix in the squash , set aside
7. Slice off& reserve the tops of the peppers
8. Remove& discard the seeds
9. Place the peppers on the pan sprayed baking sheet
10. Spoon the filling into the peppers
11. Replace the tops , cover& bake for about 30 minutes

title: coconut cream pie with pineapple
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. To prepare crust , lightly spoon flour into dry measuring cups , and level with a knife
3. Combine 1 / 4 cup flour and water
4. Stir with a whisk until well-blended
5. Combine 3 / 4 cup flour , 2 tablespoons sugar , and 1 / 8 teaspoon salt in a bowl
6. Cut in shortening with a pastry blender or 2 knives until the mixture resembles coarse meal
7. Add slurry
8. Mix with a fork until flour mixture is moist
9. Press mixture gently into a 4-inch circle on heavy-duty plastic wrap , and cover with additional plastic wrap
10. Roll dough , still covered , into a 12-inch circle
11. Freeze for 10 minutes
12. Remove 1 sheet of plastic wrap , and fit the dough into a 9-inch pie plate coated with cooking spray
13. Remove the top sheet of plastic wrap
14. Fold edges under , and flute
15. Line the dough with a piece of foil , and arrange pie weights or dried beans on foil
16. Bake at 425 degrees for 20 minutes or until the edge is lightly browned
17. Remove pie weights and foil
18. Cool crust on a wire rack
19. To prepare filling , drain pineapple in a colander , and spoon into the prepared crust
20. Combine 3 / 4 cup sugar , cornstarch , and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt in a saucepan , and stir in milk
21. Bring to a boil
22. Cook for 1 minute , stirring with a whisk
23. Gradually add about 1 / 3 cup hot custard to beaten eggs
24. Stir constantly with a whisk
25. Return egg mixture to pan
26. Cook for 2 minutes or until thick , stirring constantly
27. Remove mixture from heat
28. Stir in cream of coconut and extracts
29. Spoon mixture into the prepared crust
30. Cover surface of filling with plastic wrap
31. Chill until set
32. Remove plastic wrap , and spread whipped topping evenly over filling
33. Sprinkle with coconut

title: chicken popeyes  bott boi
steps:
1. Make the dough first
2. Mix 2 cups flour with the eggs , salt , and water , then work in enough of the remaining 1 / 2 cup of flour to make a stiff dough
3. Roll out on lightly floured surface as thin as you can get
4. Cut into 1 inch squares , and set aside until needed
5. Heat the oil in a deep saute pan and cook chicken breasts until browned on both sides and almost done in the center
6. Remove from pan and set aside
7. While the chicken is cooking dice your carrots and celery , slice the potatoes into 1 / 4 inch slices , and slice the onion very thin
8. After removing the chicken from the pan , add the carrot and celery and saute over med-high heat for 8-10 minutes
9. Slice the chicken and add it back to the pan
10. Add the poultry seasoning and the 9 cups of water and bring to a boil
11. Add the dough pieces one at a time layering with the potatoes and onions , gently pushing down after everything is in so that it is covered with broth
12. Bring to a simmer and cover and reduce heat
13. Simmer about 15 mins stirring gently every 5 mins or so
14. Mix the 3 tbsp flour with the 3 / 4 cup water mashing all the lumps , then stir into the pot
15. This with slightly thicken the broth to make it more like a stew
16. Enjoy !

title: coconut sour cream cake
steps:
1. Approximately 8 hours prior to making cake , combine sour cream , thawed coconut and sugar
2. Refrigerate 8 hours and let flavors blend
3. Mix cake mix , butter , eggs and water per instructions on box and pour batter into two 8" greased baking cake pans
4. Bake as per instructions and allow to cool
5. Cut cake layers in half making a total of four layers
6. Frost with sour cream mixture and stack layers
7. Spread cool whip evenly on outer cake edges and on top
8. Sprinkle top with coconut flakes
9. Keep refrigerated at least one day before cutting cake
10. Better if you can wait two or three days , but it's very hard to do that !
11. Enjoy this very moist cake !

title: new york hot  dog cart onion sauce
steps:
1. In a small sauce pan place vegetable oil , and onions
2. Cook over medium heat
3. Saute until onion is soft
4. Don't burn it
5. Quickly add ketchup , water , stir
6. Stir for at least 20 minutes or until the water is reduced about 1 / 2
7. The truth is to use a pinch of cinnamon and a pinch of salt
8. This is the true recipe for onion sauce for new york hot dogs
9. When i use the sauerkraut i boil it with added water to make it softer

title: egg and cress sandwiches
steps:
1. Mix the finely chopped and mashed eggs and mayonnaise together and season to taste
2. Spread half of the slices of bread with the egg mixture , sprinkle some mustard and cress on top of each one , reserving some for garnishing , place the remaining slices of bread on top , and cut each sandwich into 4 triangles
3. To serve: arrange the sandwiches on a platter , garnish with the remaining mustard and cressand and serve with cucumber sandwiches

title: erna s apple pie muffins
steps:
1. Topping-mix all together , until mixture forms crumbs
2. Batter- whisk together egg , buttermilk , butter , and vanilla
3. Stir in sugar
4. Without mixing , add flour , baking soda , salt and apples
5. Stir just until combined
6. Do not over mix
7. Spoon into muffin cups
8. Sprinkle with the topping
9. Bake at 375 degrees f for 20 minutes or until firm to the touch

title: easier than you think strawberry shake  a k a  the mistake
steps:
1. Get all of the ingredients into a blender
2. Blend until consistency of choice is acquired
3. 15 seconds suggested
4. Serve , sip , and smile [tm]

title: parsley carrots
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan cook carrots in chicken stock until almost tender
2. Add butter and parsley
3. May add salt and pepper if needed

title: korean scallion pancakes    pa jun
steps:
1. In a medium-sized bowl , whisk the flour , eggs and 1 tablespoon of the oil with the water until a smooth batter is formed
2. Stir in the scallions , carrot , and zucchini and mix to combine
3. Chill in the refrigerator for 30 minutes to allow the rice flour to swell
4. Coat the bottom of an 8-inch nonstick skillet with the remaining oil
5. Set over medium heat
6. When the pan is hot , ladle in about a quarter of the batter and spread it out into a circle , tilting the pan slightly to spread it evenly
7. Cook for about 8 minutes , or until the bottom is browned and you see holes in the pancake
8. With a spatula , flip the pancake and press firmly on the top to squeeze out any remaining batter that is not cooked
9. Cook for another 8 minutes , or until the batter is cooked thoroughly and the pancake is browned
10. Repeat with the remaining batter
11. In a small bowl , whisk together the soy sauce , water , vinegar , ginger , red pepper flakes and sugar
12. Cut the pancakes into small triangles and serve with the dipping sauce

title: low carb crock pot jambalaya
steps:
1. Add all ingredients , except shrimp , and stir well
2. Cook on low for 6-8 hours
3. If shrimp is uncooked , add to crock pot for last hour or last 1 / 2 hour
4. If shrimp is cooked , add to crock pot for last 15 mins of cooking time

title: beer pizza crust
steps:
1. If using a bread machine , simply add all the ingredients in the order given
2. Make sure that the salt and yeast do not touch , and that the yeast does not touch the liquid , especially if you have a bread machine that preheats the ingredients
3. If making by hand:
4. Pour beer into a cup and sprinkle the yeast on top
5. Let sit for about 5 minutes or until yeast starts bubbling and foaming
6. Mix all dry ingredients
7. Slowly add in beer and yeast mixture
8. Combine all ingredients
9. Kneed dough on a cutting board or countertop for approximatley 8-10 minutes
10. Use flour on the counter top and your hands to ensure it doesn't stick
11. The dough is ready when it's elastic and you can see little bubbles in it
12. Place dough in a bowl and cover with a dish towel
13. Place somewhere warm
14. Let rise for about 30-40 minutes , or until doubled in size
15. Roll out dough using a rolling pin
16. Top with whatever you like !
17. Bake in 475f preheated oven for 8-10 minutes
18. If using a pizza stone , make sure you preheat the stone in the oven
19. When the crust is brown and the cheese is browning , remove from the oven and let pizza stand for a few minutes
20. This will allow the cheese to solidify and make it easier to cut

title: crunch and munch
steps:
1. Spread popcorn and peanuts on a baking sheet and keep warm in your oven set to 300 degrees while you prepare the butter toffee
2. You don't need to preheat the oven
3. Melt the butter in a medium saucepan over medium / low heat
4. Add sugar and corn syrup and simmer , stirring occasionally
5. Pop a candy thermometer into the mixture and watch it closely
6. When the thermometer reaches 300 degrees pour the candy over the warm popcorn and peanuts
7. Stir well so that the candy coats the popcorn
8. Put the popcorn back into the oven for 5 minutes , then stir it again to coat the popcorn
9. Repeat if necessary to thoroughly coat all of the popcorn
10. Pour coated popcorn and peanuts onto wax paper
11. When cool , break up the chunks into bite-size pieces and store it all in a covered container

title: garlic chicken melt
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. In 13" x 9" casserole dish arrange chicken
3. Blend soup mix with tomatoes and oil and pour over chicken
4. Bake covered for 1 hour or until chicken is thoroughly cooked , it depends on how thick the chicken breast are
5. Serve on top of hot pasta , sprinkle with cheese

title: western salad dressing
steps:
1. Shake all well in a jar
2. Do not refrigerate
3. Good on any salad

title: cranberry spinach salad
steps:
1. Wash and dry spinach
2. Divide evenly among four salad plates
3. Top each with approximately 2 tablespoons craisins and onion slices
4. Combine dressing ingredients in a small glass mixing bowl using a wire whisk
5. Heat in the microwave on high for 1 minute or until warm

title: caribbean mist   cocktail
steps:
1. Fill a cocktail shaker half full of ice cubes , add coconut rum , melon liqueur , blue curacao liqueur , pineapple juice , and sweet and sour mix
2. Shake well and strain in a highball glass
3. Garnish with a maraschino cherry and pineapple wedge flag

title: asparagus with garlic and basil  diabetic
steps:
1. In a non-stick large skillet , or dutch oven , heat 1 / 3 cup of water until it boils
2. Add asparagus , cover and cook over medium heat about 5 minutes or until asparagus is crisp-tender
3. Uncover and continue to boil about 1-2 minutes until water evaporates
4. Do not overcook
5. Remove asparagus and keep warm
6. Spray dry skillet with cooking oil and add garlic and basil
7. Cook and stir 1-2 minutes
8. Stir in soy sauce and season to taste with pepper
9. Pour sauce over asparagus and serve immediately

title: vegan alfredo sauce
steps:
1. Add all ingredients except soy milk in a blender and mix until smooth
2. Add milk as needed to create the right consistency for the sauce
3. Pour contents into a saucepan and heat thoroughly
4. Mix in spinach and add salt and pepper
5. Pour over your favorite noodles !

title: cajun pork braid
steps:
1. Preheat oven 350 degrees
2. In large skillet , brown pork and drain
3. Add onions , celery , green bell pepper , garlic , salt and pepper
4. Cook over low heat for 5 minutes
5. Add cream cheese , green onion , and parsley
6. Stir until cream cheese is melted and blended
7. Cool completely
8. Unroll dough onto lightly greased cookie sheet and firmly press perforations to seal
9. This can be done on a greased piece of foil to fit cookie sheet
10. With floured rolling pin , roll dough into a 12"x10" rectangle
11. Spoon pork down center , leaving 1" on both ends and 3" on both sides
12. Cut dough on each long side of filling into fourteen 3 / 4" diagonal strips , 2" long
13. This can be done with kitchen shears
14. Brush beaten egg over dough strips
15. Fold ends of dough over filling
16. Lay dough strips alternately over filling , forming a roll resembling a braid
17. Brush exterior dough with remaining egg
18. Bake 350 degrees for 25 minutes or until golden brown

title: brazilian chicken curry
steps:
1. In a 5- to 6-qt slow cooker , whisk together the coconut milk , tomato paste , garlic , ginger , 12 tsp salt and 14 tsp pepper
2. Add the bell peppers , onion and potatoes and mix to combine
3. Rub the curry powder all over the chicken legs
4. Nestle them among the vegetables
5. Cook , covered , until the chicken is cooked through , on low for 6 to 8 hours or on high for 4 to 5 hours
6. Sprinkle with the cilantro before serving

title: cranberry banana oat muffins
steps:
1. Combine the first six ingredients in a mixing bowl
2. Mix well
3. Beat together egg , bananas and melted butter or margarine until smooth
4. Add to dry ingredients
5. Stir to blend
6. Stir in cranberries just until combined
7. Spoon batter into prepared muffin pan , filling almost to the top
8. Bake at 375 degrees f for 20 to 25 minutes or until the top springs back when lightly touched

title: spicy ginger and green pepper chicken
steps:
1. In a saucepan combine tomato sauce , corn starch , ginger , pepper and garlic salt in a sauce pan
2. Bring to a simmer and reduce heat and cook down until slightly thick
3. Cook chicken breasts in olive oil over medium high heat
4. After removing chicken add peppers and onions to pan
5. Saut until caramelized
6. Add to ginger sauce
7. Serve over chicken breasts

title: a duet of pasta and cheese
steps:
1. Cook the spaghetti in boiling , salted water until al dente
2. Save about a quarter cup of the water when you drain the pasta
3. Meanwhile , saut the garlic in the oil and butter until the garlic is soft
4. Add salt and pepper
5. Add the cooked pasta and the reserved cooking water to the pan
6. Cook for 1 or 2 minutes
7. You want the pasta to be golden and a little crispy
8. Add the cheese
9. Scramble the eggs lightly in a separate pan and add them to the pasta
10. Cook for another minute or so until the eggs are set to your comfort level
11. Sprinkle with parsley

title: gingerbread cake with caramelized pears
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease and flour a 10 inch bundt pan
3. Combine the flour , soda , 1 tsp cinnamon , ginger , allspice , cloves and salt in a bowl and mix well
4. Combine the pear puree and buttermilk in a bowl and mix well
5. Beat the butter and brown sugar in a mixing bowl until creamy , scraping the bowl occasionally
6. Add the molasses and beat until blended
7. Add the eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
8. The batter will appear curdled
9. Add the flour alternately with the pear mixture , beating well after each addition and scraping the sides of the bowl frequently to make sure all the ingredients are incorporated
10. Pour the batter into the prepared pan
11. Bake for 40 to 50 minutes or untila wooden pick inserted in the center comes out clean and the cake begins to pull away from the side of the pan
12. Cool in the pan for 10 minutes
13. Remove to a wire rack
14. Serve warm or at room temperature
15. Beat the whipping cream , sugar , vanilla and 1 / 2 tsp cinnamon in a mixing bowl until soft peaks form
16. Slice the cake and arranges on individual dessert plates , topped with the whipped cream and caramelized pears
17. For the pears: heat the butter in a large heavy skillet until sizzling
18. Add the pears and toss to coat
19. Sprinkle with the sugar and stir
20. Cook for 10 minutes until the pears are caramelized and tender , stirring gently
21. Remove and let stand until room temperature

title: yoghurt spaghetti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Place spaghetti in boiling water
3. Cook until tender but not too soft , drain
4. Return spaghetti to pot , add butter , and stir until noodles are covered
5. In another pot , heat olive oil and cook garlic and onion 1-2 minutes
6. Add tomato pure , tomatoes , and seasoning , mix well
7. Pour sauce onto warm spaghetti and place into oven-safe pan
8. Cover with cheese and bake 20 minutes

title: garden  sloppy joes   cooking light
steps:
1. Heat oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat
2. Add onion , celery , carrot , and tempeh , and saut 5 minutes
3. Stir in tomatoes and next 6 ingredients
4. Bring to a boil
5. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
6. Uncover and cook an additional 3 minutes or until mixture is slightly thick
7. Serve on hamburger buns

title: spiced turkey empanada
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400
2. Sprinkle turkey with salt , pepper , cumin and chili powder
3. Heat oil in a large skillet over high heat
4. Cook turkey , breaking up with a spoon , until brown , 3 to 4 minutes
5. Stir in tomatoes , olives and jalapeos
6. Cover
7. Reduce heat to low
8. Simmer until turkey is cooked through and tomatoes are soft , 3 to 4 minutes
9. Coat a large cookie sheet with cooking spray
10. Cut dough into 4 equal portions
11. Pull dough into 4 flat disks , each 8 inches in diameter
12. Top each round with 1 / 2 cup turkey filling
13. Fold dough in half and fold bottom edge over top
14. Press closed
15. Transfer to cookie sheet and coat empanadas with cooking spray
16. Bake until dough is firm and golden brown , 10 to 15 minutes

title: potato soup with whole wheat butter dumplings
steps:
1. Boil potatoes in water until able to press with a fork
2. Do not drain
3. In a second pan , melt butter over low heat and add flour , salt , & pepper
4. Stir until smooth& thick
5. Add milk and continue to heat the sauce , mixing constantly until it is fairly thick and hot
6. Add sauce to potatoes and bring to a boil
7. While waiting for potatoes to boil , make the dumpling mixture
8. Cream butter with eggs
9. Stir in whole wheat flour and salt
10. When soup boils , spoon in dumpling batter
11. Cover kettle , and let simmer for 8 to 10 minutes

title: japanese style one pot supper
steps:
1. In a small bowl , soak bean-thread noodles in boiling water until soft , about 5 minutes
2. Drain and cut into 6- to 10-in
3. Lengths
4. In a 5- to 6-qt
5. Pot or a 12-in
6. Frying pan , bring broth , mirin , soy sauce , sugar , and ginger to a boil over high heat
7. Reduce heat and simmer , covered , 5 minutes
8. Arrange noodles , chicken , bell pepper , peas , mushrooms , tofu , and green onions in separate piles in the pot
9. Cover and simmer , without stirring , until chicken chunks are no longer pink in the center , about 5 minutes
10. Set pot on the table so people can serve themselves , with sriracha on the side

title: pulled chicken sandwiches  crock pot
steps:
1. Cut the onion in half and slice into thin half rings
2. Line the bottom of the crock pot with the onions
3. Trim the chicken breasts and place on top of the bed of onions
4. Mix all of the sauce ingredients together and pour on top of the chicken covering completely
5. Cook for 6 hours on low setting
6. The sauce thickens and turns into a dark rich brown during cooking
7. At the same time the onions dissolve into the sauce
8. When the chicken is falling apart tender , take two forks and shred the chicken
9. Serve on top of split buns
10. I like mine toasted so they hold up better to the weight of the shredded chicken
11. Suggested sides include baked beans , corn on the cob , coleslaw or cucumber salad

title: coconut carrot salad
steps:
1. Combine first four ingredients
2. Mix together yogurt , honey and juice add to carrot mixture and stir well
3. Refrigerate until serving
4. Variations: you can add extra yogurt if needed
5. I have also used sour cream when i ran out of yogurt and it was very good
6. Another alternative to plain yogurt is pina colada yogurt
7. Yum !

title: high holidays kugel
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a large bowl , combine sugar , raisins , pineapple , finely chopped almonds , chopped apples , vanilla , and cinnamon
3. Boil noodles for approximately 10 minutes
4. Drain noodles and add butter while still hot
5. Add other ingredients and one slightly beaten egg
6. Pour into very well greased 9"x13" pan dot with butter and bake for 1 hour
7. Wait until the next day to cut or it will fall apart
8. After it has cooled completely , refrigerate
9. Serve hot or cold
10. Reheats well in oven or microwave

title: meat curry
steps:
1. Grind to a paste the garlic , cumin , coriander , chilli powder , turmeric and salt
2. Heat the oil in a vessel
3. Add the onions and saute till golden brown
4. Add the ground paste and saute till the raw smell goes add the tomatoes and cook till they are totally incorporated into the mixture
5. Add the meat pcs
6. Mix well and then add the water
7. Put a heavy lid on the vessel and cook for half an hour
8. I just cooked it normally
9. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve with wedges of lime

title: chicken stew ole with corn dumplings
steps:
1. Bring the chicken broth to a boil in a 5-quart pan
2. Add chicken , onion , celery , salt , garlic , and pepper
3. Cover and cook over medium-low heat 45 minutes , or until the chicken is tender
4. Remove the chicken with a slotted spoon
5. Let
6. The chicken cool
7. Add potatoes , carrots , corn , tomato sauce , salsa , and the undrained chilies to the pan
8. Cover and cook 20 minutes or until the vegetables are almost tender
9. Meanwhile , mix flour and water in a small bowl until well blended
10. Stir this into the stew
11. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces , add to the stew
12. Now mix all the corn dumpling ingredients
13. Together , in a bowl
14. Drop dumpling batter a tablespoon at a time on top of the stew in pan
15. Cover and cook 20 minutes , until dumplings are cooked through

title: coffee diabolique
steps:
1. Heat orange and lemon rinds , spices , sugar and brandy , muddling with the bottom of a ladle
2. When hot , light the brandy , burn off and add the coffee
3. Serve in demitasse cups

title: banana lettuce salad
steps:
1. Combine chopped lettuce and sliced bananas in a large bowl
2. In another bowl combine mayo , miracle whip , milk and sugar , using whisk to get out any lumps
3. Combine mayo mixture to lettuce mixture and toss to coat-- serve and enjoy !

title: pepper jelly glazed chicken with corn and zucchini
steps:
1. Prepare grill
2. Seed and chop tomatoes and cut zucchini into 1 / 2-inch pieces
3. Finely chop coriander
4. In a heavy skillet cook onion in oil over moderately low heat , stirring , until softened
5. Add tomatoes , zucchini , garlic , corn , and salt and pepper to taste and simmer , covered , stirring occasionally , until zucchini is tender , 25 to 30 minutes
6. While corn mixture is simmering , prepare chicken
7. In a small saucepan melt jelly over moderate heat , stirring , and remove pan from heat
8. Stir in lemon juice and chili powder and divide jelly mixture between 2 small bowls
9. Pat chicken dry and brush with jelly mixture from 1 bowl
10. Season chicken with salt and grill on an oiled rack set 5 to 6 inches over glowing coals until just cooked through , about 4 minutes on each side
11. With a clean brush , coat chicken with jelly mixture from other bowl
12. Stir cream cheese into corn mixture until melted and stir in coriander and salt and pepper to taste
13. Serve corn mixture topped with chicken

title: extra meaty baked ziti
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Meanwhile , in a skillet , cook beef , onion , and garlic over medium heat until no longer pink
3. Drain
4. Stir in spaghetti sauce
5. In a bowl , combine the eggs , ricotta , italian seasoning or parsley if desired , 1 1 / 2 cups mozzarella and parmesan
6. Drain pasta
7. Add to cheese mixture and stir to coat evenly
8. Spoon a third of the meat sauce into a greased 9x13 pan
9. Top with half of the pasta mixture
10. Repeat layers , ending with meat sauce
11. Cover and bake at 350 for 40 minutes
12. Uncover
13. Sprinkle with remaining mozzarella cheese
14. Bake 5-10 minutes longer or until cheese is melted
15. Let stand for 15 minutes before serving

title: cilantro and coriander chicken
steps:
1. Place a large skillet over medium heat and add the oil
2. When oil is hot , add the garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute
3. Add the coriander , garam masala and salt and pepper , and cook for 30 seconds
4. Stir in the tomato paste , and then add the chicken legs
5. Sprinkle with salt and let them cook for 5 minutes
6. Add the chicken broth , cilantro and crushed tomatoes , and let it simmer until the chicken is fully cooked , about 30 minutes
7. Serve with plenty of sauce

title: good morning breakfast casserole
steps:
1. Cook & drain bacon
2. Set aside to cool
3. If using the onion and pepper: drizzle some oil or put a dab of butter in a skillet & saute the onion & pepper until softened
4. Set aside to cool
5. Tear bread into small pieces & place in a greased 9x13 pan
6. In a medium bowl , beat the eggs
7. Then add the milk & the desired amount of salt & pepper
8. Mix until combined
9. Pour the egg mix over the bread
10. Break apart bacon with hands into bite sized pieces or smaller
11. Sprinkle cheese & crumbled bacon evenly across the top
12. Refrigerate overnight or a minimum of 4 hours
13. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes to 1 hour
14. It's done when the center is puffed up

title: cool summer veggie salad
steps:
1. Chop cilantro , cucumber , onion , pepper
2. Cut grape tomatoes in half
3. Combine everything in bowl
4. Squeeze half the lemon in bowl
5. Squeeze the whole lime in bowl
6. Mix everything together

title: lemon soymilk pudding
steps:
1. In a large pot mix the cornstarch , the grated lemon zest , salt and sugar
2. Slowly mix in enough soymilk to make a smooth paste
3. Then mix in the rest , keeping it smooth
4. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly until thickened
5. Stir in as much lemon juice as you like- i recommend 2 large ones but it may be more or less according to taste and how juicy the lemons are
6. If making in the microwave , microwave on high for 2 or 3 minutes at a time , stirring well in between times , until thickened and then add the lemon juice
7. If you object to bits of lemon zest it should be strained before you chill it
8. Anyone who likes lemon desserts goes nuts for this

title: company s coming mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees , and greased a baking dish
2. Peel the film at the corner of the simply potatoes package to vent and heat on high for 3 minutes in the microwave
3. Carefully remove the film and stir
4. Microwave on high for 1 more minute
5. In a large bowl , mix the potatoes , goat cheese , cream cheese , and butter
6. Stir together until well-blended
7. Carefully stir in the crumbled bacon , bell pepper , green onions , and pepper
8. Taste at this point and see if you want to add the salt
9. Stir in 1 / 3 cup of the cheddar and parmesan cheese until well combined
10. Transfer to a prepared baking dish and sprinkle with the remaining cheese
11. Bake , uncovered , for 20 to 25 minutes or until heated through

title: oven fried parmesan chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. In a shallow dish , combine egg and milk
3. In another dish , combine parmesan cheese and bread crumbs
4. Dip chicken into egg mixture
5. Coat with bread crumbs
6. Arrange in a greased baking dish , so that pieces are not touching
7. Drizzle chicken with melted butter
8. Bake for 45 to 55 mins or until chicken is no longer pink

title: low carb salmon au gratin
steps:
1. Put cream cheese and margarine in glass bowl and put in microwave about 30-40 seconds to soften
2. Add salmon , green onions , garlic powder , salt & pepper
3. Mix these ingredients well
4. Pour mixture into a ramikin sprayed with vegetable spray
5. Top with cheese
6. Bake at 350 about 10 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the ingredients are bubbly

title: chicken  artichokes  roasted peppers and olives
steps:
1. Cook pasta
2. While pasta cooks
3. Add the pepper to the flour
4. Coat the chicken with the flour and pepper mixture
5. Cook garlic about 2 minutes in oil over medium low heat
6. Add chicken and cook until lightly browned
7. Add the peppers and olives , cook until just heated though
8. Add artichokes with liquid and cooked until everything is heated through
9. Serve over the pasta

title: sea salt caramels
steps:
1. Prepare an 8-inch baking pan by lining it with aluminum foil and spraying the foil with nonstick cooking spray
2. Place the cream in a large saucepan over medium-high heat and bring it to a boil
3. Stir in the sugar , corn syrup and honey and stir until it begins to boil
4. Periodically wipe down the sides of the pan with a pastry brush dipped in water to prevent sugar crystals from forming
5. Cook the candy , stirring occasionally , until it reaches 257 degrees on a candy thermometer
6. Remove the pan from the heat immediately and stir in the butter , vanilla , and 2 teaspoons of salt
7. Pour into prepared pan and let set at room temperature until firm enough to cut
8. Cut the caramel into small squares or strips with a chefs knife
9. Temper the chocolate and dip the caramels in the chocolate one at a time
10. Place them on a baking sheet covered with waxed paper or foil to set
11. While chocolate is still wet , sprinkle on the remaining salt and allow to set completely

title: potato mushroom saute
steps:
1. In large skillet , saute potatoes in butter of olive oil , or a combination , for about 12 minutes or until done and nicely browned
2. Stir gently while cooking to prevent sticking
3. Add remaining ingredients except parsley
4. Cook , stirring occasionallly , until vegetables are soft
5. Transfer to a serving dish , and garnish with parsley

title: beer   honey  marinade for spareribs
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and place in large ziploc bag
2. Marinate in fridge for 24 hours
3. Turn bag over several times
4. Drain the ribs , but reserve marinade for use while ribs are cooking
5. Cook ribs your favourite way , these are good baked in the oven or bbq on the grill
6. Enjoy

title: easy chicken and pasta parmesan
steps:
1. In 10 inch skillet over medium-high heat , melt butter
2. Add chicken
3. Cook , stirring occasionally , until no longer pink , about 3 minutes
4. Add chicken broth , spaghetti sauce and seasonings
5. Heat to boiling
6. Add uncooked pasta , stirring to coat with liquid
7. Cover
8. Reduce heat
9. Simmer 15 minutes , stirring every 2 minutes or until most liquid is absorbed
10. Remove from heat
11. Stir in parmesan cheese
12. 5 servings

title: tofu creme topping
steps:
1. In a blender container , combine all ingredients
2. Blend until smooth
3. Chill several hours , or overnight , to blend flavors

title: chorizo  potato  and mushroom tacos
steps:
1. Crumble chorizo in a large nonstick skillet and place over medium heat
2. Cook , stirring frequently , for about 5 minutes or until sausage is half cooked
3. Increase heat to medium-high
4. Add onion and mushrooms
5. Continue to cook , stirring almost constantly , for about 3 minutes or until vegetables begin to soften
6. Sprinkle potatoes into skillet
7. Cook , stirring frequently , for 10 to 15 minutes or until potatoes are soft
8. Season to taste with salt
9. Transfer mixture into a bowl and top with cilantro
10. Serve in tortillas with roasted tomatillo salsa

title: cracker barrel baked apple dumplin
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Lightly grease a baking sheet
3. Roll out each sheet of pastry to measure 12x12 inches
4. Cut into quarters , to make 8 - 6 inch squares
5. In a small bowl , combine sugar , bread crumbs , cinnamon and nutmeg
6. Brush a pastry square with beaten egg
7. Place 1 tablespoon bread crumb mixture in center
8. Place one apple half , core side down , over bread crumbs
9. Top with another tablespoon of mixture
10. Pull up four corners of pastry and pinch sides together to seal seams completely
11. Repeat with remaining apples
12. Brush each dumpling with beaten egg
13. Top with pecan streusel
14. Place in preheated oven for 15 minutes , then reduce heat to 350f and continue baking 25 minutes more , until lightly browned
15. Drizzle with icing
16. Let cool completely at room temperature
17. Pecan streusel: in a small bowl , combine 2 / 3 cup chopped toasted pecans , 2 / 3 cup packed brown sugar , 2 / 3 cup all-purpose flour and 5 tablespoons melted butter
18. Mix with a fork until mixture resembles moist crumbs
19. Use as directed in recipe
20. Make more or less as desired
21. To make icing , combine confectioners' sugar and vanilla and enough milk to make a drizzling consistency
22. Drizzle over cooled dumplings
23. Serve the same day

title: canadian bacon stuffed mushrooms
steps:
1. Remove stems from mushrooms and finely chop
2. Set caps aside
3. In large skillet , saute the mushroom stems , bacon , red pepper , onion , garlic , salt and pepper in oil until vegetables are crisp-tender
4. Remove from the heat
5. Stir in cheeses
6. Fill each mushroom cap with about 1 t of filling
7. Place on foil-lined baking sheets
8. Bake at 400 degrees for 16-20 minutes or until mushrooms are tender

title: our favorite pie crust recipe how to make a tender pie crust
steps:
1. For a flaky , tender crust , the following works well
2. Whisk together all of the dry ingredients , reserving a few tablespoons of the flour
3. Cut in half of the fat , working the mixture until its mealy and crumbly
4. Place the reserved flour on your work surface , and coat the remaining fat with the flour
5. Use a rolling pin or the heel of your hand to flatten the fat till its about 1 / 2-inch thick
6. Break this flour-coated fat into 1-inch pieces , and mix it into the dough , just till its evenly distributed
7. Some of the pieces of flour-coated fat should break into smaller pieces
8. Sprinkle the liquid over the dough while tossing with a fork
9. Just as soon as the dough becomes cohesive , stop mixing
10. There should still be visible pieces of fat in the dough
11. Flatten the dough into a disk and wrap it in plastic wrap or waxed paper
12. Refrigerate for 30 minutes or longer
13. This resting period allows the flour to absorb the water , making the dough easier to roll out
14. Flour your work surface and roll the dough into a 12 x 9-inch rectangle
15. (if it isnt holding together well , sprinkle it lightly with a couple of teaspoons of water
16. Fold the dough into thirds , then fold it into thirds the opposite way , to form a rough square
17. Wrap it well and refrigerate again
18. )
19. When youre "ready to roll , " remove the dough from the fridge
20. If the dough is made with all lard and / or vegetable shortening , youll be able to work with it directly from the refrigerator
21. A dough made with all butter will need to warm slightly before rolling , as butter becomes brittle when its refrigerated
22. Dough made with a combination of butter and shortening should rest for about 5 minutes at room temperature before rolling
23. Roll the dough to the size needed
24. Fill and bake as directed in your recipe

title: creamy basil dressing or dip
steps:
1. In a food processor or blender , combine the lemon juice , basil , mustard , and garlic
2. Process until smooth
3. Then , with machine running , gradually ad oil
4. When oil has been completely blended in , add tofu
5. If using yogurt , remove the dressing from the food processor and place in small bowl and gently stir in yogurt
6. Season to taste with salt
7. Cover and refrigerate
8. Stir well before each serving
9. The tofu version will especially thicken when chilled
10. Thin with a teaspoon or so of water if needed

title: potato casserole with fried onions
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 375 degrees
2. Make a thick white sauce of butter , flour and milk and add the italian seasoning packet
3. Dice or slice the potatoes into the cream sauce
4. Add in the parsley and mix to combine
5. Turn into large well-greased casserole dish
6. Sprinkle with grated cheese and french fried onions
7. Bake 30 minutes or until bubbling

title: shoarma spice mix
steps:
1. If you have whole spices and the time , dry roast the cumin and coriander seeds in a frying pan for several minutes , let them cool and grind as fine as possible mix everything together and put in a small jar shoarma idea for 4: approx 1lb pork , lamb or chicken , cut meat in strips , add 1 tablespoon oil and lemon juice , 1 or 2 teaspoons of the spice mix , add salt to taste , mix and leave for a few hours or overnight
2. If you like add some chopped onion , crushed garlic , chopped chili pepper and a chopped sweet pepper to the meat mix
3. Fry or grill this until done
4. Serve in a wrap or pita bread with a mayonnaise sauce , tzatziki or try my yoghurt chutney and add some finely chopped cucumber to it
5. Use for barbecues , marinades and so on

title: seven layer rigatoni
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375
2. Spray rectangular baking dish , 13x9x2 inches , with cooking spray
3. Cook and drain pasta as directed on package
4. While pasta is cooking , cook sausage in 10-inch skillet over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until no longer pink , drain
5. Mix tomatoes , garlic and basil
6. Layer half each of the pasta , sausage , mushrooms , bell peppers , parmesan cheese , tomato mixture and mozzarella cheese in baking dish
7. Repeat layers
8. Bake uncovered 35 to 40 minutes or until hot and cheese is golden brown

title: taco mac and cheese
steps:
1. In a large skillet , cook beef and taco seasoning mix over medium high heat stirring often , until beef is browned and crumbly
2. Drain well
3. Stir in diced tomatoes and chiles , and keep warm
4. Cook macaroni noodles according to box directions
5. Drain well
6. Return to pan
7. Stir in cheese packets and beef mixture
8. Serve immediately

title: rosemary potatoes   microwave
steps:
1. Place the butter and garlic in an 8 inch square baking dish
2. Microwave at medium high 45 seconds or until butter melts
3. Add rosemary , salt , 1 / 4 teaspoon black pepper and potatoes , toss well
4. Cover and microwave at high 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender

title: summer squash crock
steps:
1. In skillet , cook the sausage crumbling it into small pieces
2. Drain grease and place in crockpot
3. Add onions and garlic on top of meat
4. In same skillet add olive oil
5. Heat over medium heat
6. Add chopped squashes and saute for about 2 minutes
7. Place this layer next in the crock
8. In same skillet add broth and bring to a boil
9. Make sure to get up any bits of meat and veggies from bottom of skillet
10. Boil for one minute
11. Pour over squashes
12. Finally in the skillet add the can of tomatoes , cumin and red pepper
13. Bring to just a boil
14. Pour over every thing else in crockpot
15. Cover and cook in crockpot on low for 8 hours

title: hearty vinaigrette
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients into a bowl
2. Whisk until well mixed together
3. Toss into your favorite salad
4. Enjoy !

title: mmm  tender and sweet brisket and tzimmes
steps:
1. Spray pot with cooking spray and brown brisket turning to cook through
2. Simmer 2 hours , brisket will render own juices
3. Keep checking , respray as necessary or add water as necessary
4. Add carrots and potatoes , cook 30 minutes
5. In separate small saucepan add 2 cups water , cornstarch , splenda , and 2 tbsp of juice from the cooked meat and veggies , simmer to make gravy
6. Spray roast pan and place meat and veggies , cover with gravy and bake about 1 hour
7. Serve brisket on a platter surrounded by vegetables
8. Goes great with cranberry sauce , or anything ! everyone will love it and it is definitely worth the effort !

title: one pan whiskey pork chops
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees
2. Combine the first 6 ingredients in a small bowl
3. Sprinkle pork with 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and 1 / 8 teaspoon pepper
4. Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
5. Add pork
6. Saute 5 minutes on each side or until golden
7. Remove pork from pan
8. Add onion and mushrooms to pan
9. Saute for 3 minutes
10. Carefully add whiskey to pan
11. Cook for 1 minute or until liquid almost evaporates
12. Stir sour cream mixture into pan
13. Return pork to pan
14. Spoon sauce over pork
15. Wrap handle of skillet with foil
16. Cover and bake at 300 degrees for 1 hour
17. Serve immediately
18. Yield: 4 servings

title: danish caraway potatoes
steps:
1. Boil potatoes until tender in salted water
2. Drain and peel potatoes
3. Garnish with parsley and dill
4. Serve with melted butter mixed with the caraway seeds

title: apple cranberry maple syrup crisp
steps:
1. Butter an 11 x 7-inch baking dish
2. For the topping: mix together flour , cinnamon , oats , brown sugar , cinnamon and salt in a medium bowl
3. Add in cold butter and rub in with finger
4. To make filling: set oven to 375 degrees
5. Mix together the sliced apples , cranberries , maple syrup , brown sugar and flour
6. Transfer to prepared baking dish
7. Bake the apple mixture for 20 minutes
8. Remove from oven and sprinkle the topping over the hot apple mixture
9. Return to oven and bake for about 35-40 minutes more , until the juices are bubbly and the topping is golden brown
10. Let stand 15 minutes before serving
11. Serve with ice cream or whipped cream

title: swedish dried fruit cream
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , simmer fruit in water until tender , about 15 minutes
2. Stir in sugar & mace
3. Mix cornstarch with cold water , then add it to the fruit mixture
4. Cook over medium heat until thickened , stirring constantly , but carefully to avoid breaking up the fruit
5. Chill for at least 1 hour before serving cold , as is
6. With cream
7. Or over a custard or pudding

title: easy cheesy mexican casserole
steps:
1. Brown ground beef and onions
2. Add chili powder , cumin , tomatoes and jalapenos
3. Heat through
4. Meanwhile line bottom and sides of a 13 x 9" pan with tortillas
5. Line bottom with refried beans
6. Add of ground beef mixture
7. Cover with of the cheese
8. Top with beans
9. Add the rest of the ground beef mixture
10. Top with the rest of the cheese
11. Mix bisquick , milk and egg together
12. Add chilies
13. Pour over casserole
14. Top with crushed doritos
15. Bake in 350 oven for 50 - 60 minutes until top is browned and toothpick inserted in crust comes out dry
16. Let stand for 10 minutes before cutting

title: sausage and black lentil stew
steps:
1. Brown sausage over medium heat with onions and celery breaking them into small pieces
2. Pour in the water , add pepper and lentils
3. Stir all the ingredients , bring to a boil over medium heat , stirring occasionally
4. Reduce heat , cover and simmer for 1 1 / 2 hours , stirring from time to time to prevent the lentils from sticking or burning
5. Remove lid for the last 1 / 2 hour while simmering
6. Serve in bowls with crusty bread

title: dad s   our favorite meatloaf
steps:
1. For the tomato relish , chop tomatoes , peppers , and onions into a medium dice
2. Saute over high heat
3. Finish with ketchup
4. Lower heat
5. Reduce to a simmer
6. For the meatloaf , in a large mixing bowl , using a fork , combine 1 / 2 cup of the tomato relish , the ground meats , egg and egg white , bread crumbs , garlic and skim milk
7. Finish with olive oil , and then lightly pack into a 9-inch loaf pan
8. Cover with half the remaining relish and place in the middle of a preheated 350 degree oven
9. Bake for 45 minutes to one hour or until the center of the meat loaf reaches 170 degrees
10. Allow meatloaf to cool 15 minutes before slicing
11. Serve with additional relish

title: italian christmas cookies
steps:
1. Firstly , sift the flour and baking powder together into a bowl
2. Then , in a larger bowl , cream butter and sugar
3. Beat in eggs and add vanilla , then pour the dry ingredients into the wet and mix
4. Knead and add flour as needed to keep dough from sticking to hands
5. Pinch off dough , roll in your hands to form a log and then twirl into shape
6. Place on greased cookie sheets
7. Bake at 375 for 10 minutes
8. Combine the next 3 ingredients until creamy
9. Dip cookies into icing and sprinkle with trim
10. Place on wire rack with wax paper on counter to collect the dripping icing and sprinkles

title: armenian choereg  breadsticks
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast in warm water
2. Heat milk and turn off heat
3. Add butter and crisco to melt and cool milk
4. If you have a large kitchen aid mixer , add all ingredients except beaten egg and sesame seeds
5. If not , you will need to mix all in a large bowl and knead by hand
6. Add enough flour to make a soft slightly sticky dough
7. Knead 10 minutes in mixer or with oiled hands
8. Allow to rise until double in bulk
9. Around 2 hours
10. Oil hands and punch down
11. Pull off a hunk of dough and roll out with your hands to a long rope
12. Slice on the diagonal in 5 inch pieces
13. Make sticks or circles or braid three pieces together , if desired
14. Place on a cookie sheet an inch apart
15. Brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds
16. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes until light brown

title: mango chili salsa
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine all ingredients except the coriander leaves
2. Season well and chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes
3. Add the coriander leaves just before serving

title: hot chocolatier shots with spicy foam
steps:
1. Pour 1 / 2 cup evaporated milk into medium mixer bowl
2. Place beaters into mixture
3. Freeze for about 30 minutes or until ice crystals form around edge of bowl
4. Heat remaining evaporated milk , water , chunks , 1 teaspoon vanilla extract , 1 / 2 teaspoon cinnamon and a pinch of cayenne pepper in medium saucepan over low heat , stirring frequently , until melted
5. Do not boil
6. Set aside
7. Remove chilled evaporated milk from freezer
8. Beat on high speed for 1 minute or until very frothy
9. Add remaining vanilla extract , remaining cinnamon and a pinch of cayenne pepper
10. Continue beating for 3 to 4 minutes or until mixture forms soft peaks
11. Pour hot chocolate into eight 4-ounce demitasse cups and immediately dollop with foam topping

title: sweet potatoes in tangy sauce
steps:
1. Place sweet potatoes in a large kettle and add water to cover
2. Cook over medium heat until barely tender
3. Drain
4. Peel and cut potatoes into fourths
5. Arrange in a medium size casserole
6. Preheat oven to 350f
7. While potatoes are cooking , combine sugars , ginger and cornstarch in a small saucepan
8. Add pineapple juice and lemon juice
9. Stir over medium heat until sugars are dissolved and mixture starts to bubble
10. Stir in butter
11. Pour sauce over potatoes
12. Bake uncovered 50 to 60 min or until sauce is thickened

title: mom s mediterranean steak sauce
steps:
1. 1
2. Heat some olive oil in a saucepan on medium heat
3. 2
