4. Add the chopped garlic and onion and fry until slightly browned
5. 3
6. Add the tomato sauce , red wine , olives , and oregano
7. 4
8. Add salt and pepper if desired
9. 5
10. Simmer on low heat for approximately 15 minutes
11. 6
12. Serve over steak or any meat you like !

title: fresh pico de gallo
steps:
1. After washing vegetables , dice / chop / mince and place in a steel or glass bowl
2. Add seasonings , oil and vinegar and gently mix
3. Do not over mix , as this will bruise the tomatoes
4. Store leftover pico de gallo cold to add to your favorite dishes for up to 36 hours

title: sweet spiced rice
steps:
1. Wash rice three to four times in cold water , until the water you drain from it runs almost clear
2. Drain well and put in a large microwave safe bowl
3. Cover with the boiling water
4. Add all the other ingredients , except the garnish , and stir well
5. Microwave uncovered on full power for 17 minutes
6. Don't disturb during cooking time
7. If rice seems undercooked add a little more water and cook for a further 1 or 2 minutes
8. Cover tightly and leave to stand for 5 minutes
9. Stir and fluff lightly with a fork
10. Garnish and serve !

title: mom s chuckwagon beans
steps:
1. Cook bacon
2. Brown ground beef with the diced onion
3. Place first 3 items in a large oven roaster
4. To this , add the 3 cans of beans
5. Do not drain beans
6. Mix all other ingredients together in a medium bowl
7. Pour over meat and beans and stir well
8. Bake at 350 for 1 hour covered
9. Remove lid or foil and bake for 20 more minutes

title: dramatically seared green beans
steps:
1. Heat wok or deep skillet
2. When hot , add oil and swirl to coat the pan
3. Raise heat to high and wait about 30 seconds
4. Add the green beans and season with salt to taste
5. Cook 3 minutes , using tongs or shake to turn and move beans to cook them quickly and evenly
6. Continue to cook till desired doneness
7. Season with garlic and red pepper flakes to taste and continue to cook for another minute
8. Serve hot , warm or at room temperature

title: sweet and sour pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Drain and rinse with cold water
3. Place in large serving bowl , add onion , tomato , cucumber , green pepper and parsley , set aside
4. In a saucepan combine the dressing ingredients , cook over medium-low heat for 10 minutes or until sugar is dissolved
5. Pour over salad and toss
6. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours
7. Serve with slotted spoon

title: sommer s chicken spaghetti
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in large skillet
2. Add chicken pieces and garlic and saute on medium-high to infuse garlic into the oil and until chicken is no longer pink
3. Do not drain
4. Dump in the half jar of spaghetti sauce over the chicken and olive oil / garlic
5. Stir and bring to a boil
6. Turn heat down to low and cover and simmer , stirring occasionally
7. While spaghetti sauce is simmering , prepare your favorite pasta
8. I used thin spaghetti
9. Bring a large pot of water to boil , add a bit of salt , add pasta and return to a boil , stirring occasionally until al dente , or preferred tenderness
10. After pasta is cooked to desired tenderness , drain
11. Serve spaghetti sauce over hot , cooked spaghetti

title: crock pot colorful chicken stew
steps:
1. In a 5-quart crock pot , combine the first 12 ingredients
2. In a small bowl , combine cornstarch and water until smooth
3. Stir into chicken mixture
4. Cover and cook on low for 8-10 hours or until vegetables are tender

title: super simple  super quick chicken curry and rice
steps:
1. Dissolve chicken base in hot water
2. Pour dissolved base / stock in 2" deep pan
3. Add chicken to pan and place on medium-high heat
4. Add remaining ingredients except rice
5. Cook chicken uncovered , stirring often to coat with spices
6. Remove chicken from heat and cover to keep warm
7. You will use the liquid from the pan in the next step
8. Add rice to separate pan and prepare as directed , but instead of using water to cook , add the drippings from the chicken pan
9. I usually get about 1 / 2 cup of drippings and then top that off with the water necessary to cook the rice
10. The rice i use needs 1 1 / 3 cup of water for 1 / 2 cup uncooked rice
11. This will yield 2 cups of cooked rice
12. When rice is finished cooking , spoon rice back into chicken pan and place on medium-high heat for 3 minutes , stirring frequently

title: baked tilapia iowa cajun style
steps:
1. Rinse and drain the fish
2. Arrange skin side down and overlapping slightly in 9x12 or larger casserole if using more
3. Heat oven to 400f
4. If using glass or nonstick , i don't bother to grease the pan
5. Melt the butter and margarine in small saucepan and pour over fish
6. The margarine dilutes the butter which causes burning easily but the butter imparts flavor
7. Rub the butter mixture over the top of the fish with your hands or spatula
8. With frozen filets the mixture will solidify
9. Don't worry about it
10. The spices and herbs will not adhere well without moisture or the butter mixture but too much isn't good for you now so i try to drain it off when i serve
11. Most spices have plastic sprinkling inserts with holes so i don't measure but sprinkle to taste trying to get the right balance
12. Watch the parsley as sometimes it's easy to get too much
13. Same goes for other spices you're not familiar with amounts , better too little than too much if you're not used to cooking with them
14. Sprinkle on the seasoned salt , paprika , onion powder , pepper blend , fines herbes , thyme and parsley last
15. Put in oven and bake for 10 minutes
16. With a turkey baster or spoon , scoop up the butter and juices and drizzle back over the fish
17. Continue baking for 10 more minutes
18. It may be done or thicker pieces of fish take about another 5 or 10 minutes
19. You can tell it's done when you pierce with a fork or sharp knife
20. It will be tender and flaky with clear juices
21. Remove from oven and baste one more time , may have to tilt the dish so it will all pool at an end
22. Serve while hot with a spatula , draining off the excess melted butter mixture
23. It's not good for us
24. You can substitute an oil and less of it and it should be essentially the same
25. Squeeze some fresh lemon juice over the fish at the table if desired

title: zucre coco    moroccan coconut fudge cakes
steps:
1. Line an 8x8 pan or similar sized round pan with foil or waxed paper
2. In a heavy bottomed 2qt
3. Saucepan combine coconut , evaporated milk and sugar
4. Simmer gently to soft ball stage
5. 238 degrees
6. Here we test in cold water and do not use a thermometer
7. The cooking time is my best guess as i have never made this using a western stove
8. Stir in the butter and lemon rind and allow to cool to room temperature
9. Beat until thick and glossy as you would for fudge but beating to glossy not until it loses it's gloss
10. Pour into prepared pan and chill 2 hours
11. Cut into 1 / 2" to 1" squares

title: cucumber sancwiches
steps:
1. Cream philadelphia cream cheese with package of good season's italian dressing
2. Let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes
3. Cut cucumber into very thin slides
4. Spread onto cocktail bread
5. Place cucumber slices on top , and garnish with spice of choice
6. Refrigerate on wax paper to separate
7. Nice presentation circles on squares

title: pesto and tomato angel hair pasta
steps:
1. Cook angel hair pasta according to package directions
2. Turn on food processor and drop garlic down feed tube
3. Stop the processor and add basil , nuts , cheese and salt and pepper
4. Pulse until finely chopped , then with motor running , add oil gradually through tube until blended
5. Drain pasta and reserve some of cooking water
6. Toss pasta with the pesto , then add tomatoes
7. If mixture is too thick , add a little cooking water
8. Can be served hot or cold

title: hazelnut fig twists
steps:
1. To make fig preserve:
2. Saut the chopped shallots in butter until softened , but not browned
3. Add chopped dried mission figs , port and dried thyme
4. Simmer for 5 to 7 minutes or until figs are tender and most of liquid is absorbed
5. Cool
6. Pure in food processor to a rough paste
7. To prepare twists:
8. Preheat oven to 400f
9. Place pastry sheets on lightly floured work surface
10. Beat egg and water , set aside
11. Spread fig preserve evenly over one pastry sheet
12. Sprinkle blue cheese and 3 / 4 cup hazelnuts over preserve
13. Place second pastry sheet over hazelnuts
14. Brush top of pastry with beaten egg
15. Sprinkle with 1 / 4 cup chopped hazelnuts , gently pressing nuts into pastry
16. Turn pastry over and repeat with beaten egg and remaining hazelnuts
17. Pastry should measure 9x12"
18. Cut pastry across shortest width into 1 / 2-inch strips
19. Twist and arrange on greased baking sheet
20. Bake at 400f for 15 minutes or until risen and golden
21. Cool on wire rack

title: grilled goats cheese with fresh figs
steps:
1. Use two 100g goats cheese rounds for this recipe
2. Place the goats cheese on a lightly oiled baking tray
3. Drizzle a little olive oil on top of each cheese
4. Cut the stem part off each fig and discard
5. Now slice each fig into about 3 slices
6. Place on the baking tray with the goats cheese and drizzle a little balsamic vinegar onto the figs
7. Place under a hot grill for just a couple of minutes until the cheese starts to bubble
8. Serve as a starter
9. Yum yum !
10. Ps: if i manage to get my photo on here for this recipes you will see i've slightly cooked the cheese too long
11. Not that it matters but it doesn't look as nice on the plate as it should do
12. Ooops !

title: marchwangan korma
steps:
1. Soak whole , dry chilies in water for 15 to 20 minutes
2. Puree to a fine paste with little water
3. Heat oil in a heavy bottom pan
4. Once oil is hot , saute cardamom pods and cloves until fragrant
5. Add bay leaves , onions and fry till brown
6. Add chicken and salt
7. Saute until chicken is nicely browned
8. Add fennel , ginger powder and the prepared red chilli paste
9. Saute for 1 to 2 minutes
10. Add 1 cup of water
11. Lower heat , cover and simmer for about 15 minutes or until the chicken turns tender and a thick gravy remains
12. Right before serving , add garam masala and stir
13. Serve hot over rice

title: nut tarts
steps:
1. Make shells by mixing the butter , cream cheese and flour until dough is formed
2. Roll dough into balls , approximately 1" , and press into ungreased mini muffin tins
3. Be sure to bring dough up sides of each muffin cup or filling will stick to pan
4. Make filling by mixing the eggs , brown sugar , vanilla , and walnuts
5. Place 1 tbs
6. Of filling into each muffin cup
7. Bake at 375f for 30 minutes or until golden brown
8. Cool in pan 10 minutes , then remove tarts and cool completely on wire rack
9. Dust with powered sugar before serving

title: beer braised chicken
steps:
1. In a 12-inch skillet , heat oil over medium-high heat until very hot
2. Add chicken pieces and cook until browned on all sides
3. Transfer chicken to a large plate , using a slotted spoon
4. Add onions to skillet and cook over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until tender and lightly browned
5. Transfer onions to plate with chicken , using a slotted spoon
6. Stir flour into drippings in the skillet until blended
7. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until flour is dark brown
8. Gradually stir in beer , and cook until sauce boils and thickens slightly , stirring constantly
9. Stir in bay leaf , brown sugar , salt , thyme , and pepper
10. Return chicken and onions to skillet
11. Heat to boiling over high heat
12. Reduce heat to low
13. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender
14. Skim fat from sauce in skillet
15. Discard bay leaf
16. Stir in wine vinegar

title: koolaid pie
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine cool whip , koolaid& condensed milk
2. Stir with spoon until mixture is well mix pour into pie shell
3. Smooth out top of pie with back side of spoon
4. Place in frig
5. For 1-2 hours
6. Serve chilled

title: vicki f s bacon corn salad
steps:
1. Toss salad ingredients in a large bowl
2. Prepare dressing: mix all ingredients in a saucepan
3. Heat until blended and sugar is dissolved
4. Pour hot dressing over salad ingredients just before serving

title: teddy bear fruit salad
steps:
1. Mix pudding , and buttermilk together and let stand 10 minutes
2. Add the rest of ingredients and refridgerate for 2-3 hours
3. Garnish with additional teddy grahams
4. Enjoy !

title: cherry chicken salad sandwich
steps:
1. Combine chicken , cherries , pecans , and onion in a bowl
2. Mix mayo , yogurt , and lemon juice
3. Pour over chicken mixture
4. Toss to mix
5. Refrigerate salad for 1-2 hours
6. Split croissants and divide chicken evenly
7. Sprinkle with black pepper before serving

title: tunisian style roasted beet salad with harissa
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. In small non-reactive bowl combine the salad dressing ingredients and whisk well
3. Set aside
4. In a large shallow pan , toss the cut up beets lightly with the olive oil to coat
5. Transfer the beets to a large baking sheet and cover the baking sheet tightly with aluminum foil
6. Bake the beets for about 30 minutes or until the beets are very tender when pierced with a fork
7. Remove from oven , set aside to cool for 5 minutes
8. Then cut beets into 1 / 2" cubes
9. Place the prepared beets into a large salad bowl and toss lightly but thoroughly with the salad dressing to combine

title: zucchini skillet dinner with tomatoes and mushrooms  low fat
steps:
1. Spray a large skillet with nonstick spray and heat over medium heat
2. Add the zucchini , the onions , and the mushrooms
3. Spray with a little extra spray , if desired
4. Let cook until the zucchini is starting to soften
5. Add the tomatoes and juice , the italian seasoning , and the meat
6. Let it simmer until hot and the flavors are melded , betweeen 5-10 minutes

title: kamish bread   cookies
steps:
1. Add sugar to beaten eggs and add vanilla to eggs
2. Sift flour and baking powder and put aside
3. Add dry ingredients and oil a little at a time , alternately , then add nuts and chocolate chips
4. Make 4 loaves
5. Put on 2 greased cookie sheets
6. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350 degrees
7. Cool 7 minutes and cut into 1 / 2 inch slices
8. Toast in oven for 10 minutes until crispy at low temperature

title: jamaican peas and rice
steps:
1. Bring beans , garlic , coconut milk , and 2 cups water to a boil in a medium saucepan
2. Reduce heat to low
3. Cover , and cook until beans are tender but not mushy , 1 hour and 50 minutes to 2 hours
4. Stir in 2 1 / 2 cups water , the rice , scallions , thyme , and 1 tablespoon salt
5. Season with pepper
6. Bring to a boil
7. Stir once , then reduce heat to low
8. Cook , covered , without stirring , until all liquid has been absorbed , about 20 minutes
9. Let stand , covered , 15 minutes
10. Fluff mixture with a fork , and season with salt and pepper

title: healthy  sort of  delicious butternut squash soup
steps:
1. Fry bacon in large skillet
2. Leave fat in pan and save bacon
3. Cut onion and cook in bacon fat
4. Cut squash in half and scoop out seeds
5. Peel squash
6. Cut squash in 1 inch chunks
7. Saute squash with onions for about 10 minutes
8. Add chicken or vegetable broth , bring to boil , then simmer for about 20 minutes
9. Add salt to taste
10. Puree soup in blender or food processor till smooth
11. Garnish with chopped bacon and sour cream

title: orange pork stir fry with broccoli in lime butter
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large skillet
2. Add the pork strips in a single layer and brown on one side and flip over
3. Cook 5 minutes
4. Meanwhile , in a medium pot bring 3 cups of water to a boil
5. Add the broccoli florets and cook until crisp-tender
6. Drain
7. Add the lime zest , butter and salt and toss to combine
8. Keep warm
9. To pork in skillet , add the green onions and cook for 2 minutes
10. Add the grated carrots and season with the soy sauce and salt if desired
11. Cook 5 minutes
12. Add the orange juice and cook for a few minutes to blend the flavors
13. Serve with steamed rice

title: sourdough mushroom sausage strata
steps:
1. Spray a 9x13 pan with pam
2. Cube and cook sausages
3. Drain and set aside
4. Cube sourdough bread and spread in pan
5. Spread sausage and cheese over bread
6. In a medium bowl , beat eggs
7. Mix eggs and soup on high speed of electric mixer until well combined
8. Add milk and mix on low till combined
9. Pour mixture over cheese
10. Cover and chill overnight
11. Uncover and bake in a 350 oven for 1 hour

title: mini maple syrup pancake cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Cream shortening and brown sugar until smooth
3. Add egg to combine
4. Add maple syrup and vanilla , mix well
5. Combine flour , baking powder , salt , tartar , and cinnamon in separate bowl
6. Gradually stir into wet mixture until smooth and well combined
7. Drop by spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet , bake 10-12 minutes or until golden brown and puffed up
8. Store in air tight container , best the day after baking

title: penne nicoise
steps:
1. Bring large pot of salted water to boil and add green beans and potatoes
2. Return to boil and add pasta
3. Cook , stirring occasionally , until the pasta is al dente , about 11 minutes or according to package directions
4. Meanwhile , in small skillet heat the olive oil over medium heat
5. Add onion and garlic and cook , stirring often , until onion is soft , about 5 minutes
6. Remove from heat and stir in tomatoes and olives and set aside
7. Drain the pasta , beans and potatoes , reserving 1 / 2 cup of pasta water
8. Transfer to serving bowl
9. Add the tomato mixture , vinegar , pepper and salt and toss to mix
10. If pasta seems too dry add reserved pasta water as needed , a little at a time

title: cracked tapas patatas braves
steps:
1. Place the baby potatoes in a clean tea towel and hit with a wooden mallet or rolling pin to crack them lightly
2. Flatten each garlic clove with the mallet or the blade of a heavy knife
3. Heat the oil in a large saute pan and cook the onion , potatoes and garlic for 10-12 minutes , stirring until golden
4. Add the chili flakes , paprika , tomatoes , brown sugar and some salt and pepper
5. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes until the potatoes are tender
6. Stir through the parsley and serve warm

title: grilled artichokes with sesame dipping sauce
steps:
1. For dipping sauce:
2. Whisk mayonnaise , worcestershire sauce , olive oil , sesame oil , honey , lemon juice , and seasoned salt in small bowl to blend well
3. Cover and refrigerate until cold
4. For artichokes:
5. Fill large bowl with cold water
6. Add lemon juice
7. Cut off stem and top quarter of 1 artichoke
8. Bend back dark green outer leaves and snap off at artichoke base until only pale green and yellow leaves remain
9. Cut any dark green areas off base
10. Cut artichoke lengthwise into 6 wedges
11. Place artichoke wedges in lemon water
12. Repeat with remaining artichokes
13. Steam artichokes until tender , about 30 minutes
14. Cool
15. Remove choke and any purple-
16. Dipping sauce and artichokes can be prepared 1 day ahead
17. Keep sauce refrigerated
18. Cover artichokes and refrigerate
19. Prepare barbecue
20. Stir olive oil and minced garlic in small bowl to blend
21. Brush garlic oil over artichokes
22. Sprinkle artichokes with salt and pepper
23. Grill artichokes until slightly charred , turning occasionally , about 8 minutes
24. Transfer artichokes to platter and serve with dipping sauce

title: blood pressure smoothie shake
steps:
1. In a blender , process the bananas , milk , yogurt , juice , honey and blueberries until smooth
2. Serve immediately

title: grilled pork chops with shallot butter
steps:
1. Prepare grill to medium-high heat
2. Sprinkle both sides of pork evenly with 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and pepper
3. Combine oil , chives , thyme , rosemary , and garlic , stirring well
4. Rub oil mixture evenly over both sides of pork
5. Place pork on grill rack
6. Grill 6 minutes on each side or until a thermometer inserted in the thickest part of pork registers 155
7. Remove pork from grill
8. Let stand 5 minutes
9. Sprinkle with remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon salt
10. Combine butter , shallots , and lemon rind , stirring well
11. Spread about 1 teaspoon butter mixture over each pork chop
12. Let the pork stand an additional 5 minutes

title: wannabe eggs benedict
steps:
1. Lightly fry egg on both sides , about 2-3 minutes each side , in a nonstick skillet
2. The yolk should be somewhat runny , or to your taste
3. Warm canadian bacon in microwave about 5 seconds on each side
4. Toast the english muffin
5. Spread the cheese on the english muffin
6. Top with canadian bacon and egg
7. Season with salt , if desired

title: mother s bavarian pot roast
steps:
1. Dust the meat with flour , salt and pepper
2. Brown the meat on all sides in the oil in a dutch oven or any large pot
3. Combine the remaining ingredients and pour over the meat , cover and simmer for 3 hours or until tender
4. If you have the luxury to let it simmer for 6-8 hours , even better
5. Thicken the gravy with flour
6. Sliced mushrooms may be added to gravy
7. I is nice served over wide egg noodles

title: ww 6 points   chinese sesame chicken
steps:
1. To toast sesame seeds , bake at 350f for 10 minutes
2. Spray a 5 quart saucepan or dutch oven with nonstick spray
3. Set over medium heat
4. Add chicken parts and cook , turning when necessary , until chicken is browned on all sides , 4-6 minutes
5. Transfer chicken to a platter and set aside
6. In 2-cup measure or small mixing bowl , combine 1 / 2 cup water with the juice , soy sauce , scallion , ketchup , sugar , garlic , and red pepper
7. Mix well
8. Pour into pot and cook over medium heat for 1-2 minutes , stirring constantly to scrape up any browned particles from bottom of pan
9. Reduce heat to low and return chicken to pot
10. Cover and cook until chicken is tender , 20-25 minutes
11. Transfer chicken to platter and keep warm , reserving liquid in pot
12. Dissolve cornstarch in remaining tablespoon water and add liquid to pot
13. Cook , stirring frequently , until sauce is thickened , 3-4 minutes
14. Pour sauce evenly over chicken and sprinle with toasted sesame seeds
15. 6 points per serving

title: cranberry rice krispies bars
steps:
1. Butter a 13 x 9-inch baking pan
2. In a large skillet over medium heat stir sesame seeds , sunflower seeds , pecans and almonds until pale golden brown
3. Add in coconut and stir until the sesame seeds and coconut are golden
4. Stir in cereal and cranberries
5. Remove from heat
6. Meanwhile in a 5-6-quart pan combine the peanut butter with butter and mini marshmallows
7. Stir over low heat until the marshmallows melt and the mixture is smooth then add in the cereal / cranberry mixture and mix quickly using a wooden spoon to coat evenly
8. Pour the mixture into prepared baking pan , using a spoon press firmly to make an even layer
9. Cool at room temperature or refrigerate until the mixture is set
10. Cut into 24 bars
11. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 4 days

title: ricotta stuffed potatoes
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 degrees
2. Bake potatoes about 1 hour , until tender
3. Cut thin lengthwise slice from each potato
4. Scoop out inside , leaving a thin shell
5. Mash potatoes in a large bowl until no lumps remain
6. Mix in remaining ingredients and blend well
7. Increase oven temperature to 400 degrees
8. Place potato shells on ungreased cookie sheet
9. Fill shells with potato mixture
10. Bake uncovered 20 minutes until filling is hot

title: chicken wings or ribs habanero hot sauce
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large , heavy pot over medium heat and saut onion and garlic until soft
2. Add habanero peppers with cinnamon and apricot brandy and saut
3. Lower heat , add sugar , syrup , vinegar , spices , and ginger , and reduce for 5 to 10 minutes
4. And salt to taste
5. Add fruit and cook slowly for 1 hour , covered , stirring occasionally and add barbecue sauce for 5 - 10 min and stir / pulse in processor / blender until smooth
6. Add water / more brandy if the sauce becomes thicker than ketchup / barbecue sauce
7. When sauce has cooled refrigerated , the sauce will keep for months

title: easy pralines
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingredients in a medium sized saucepan
2. Cook over medium low heat stirring and bring to a rolling boil
3. Cook slowly over low heat for 3-5 minutes
4. Remove from heat and stir in pecan halves
5. Beat until thickened
6. I use a wooden spoon
7. If the mixture gets too thick while beating add drops of evaporated milk
8. If the mixture is too thin just beat a little longer
9. Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed papeeer
10. Let cool
11. Wrap each praline in plastic wrap

title: christmas candles centerpiece
steps:
1. Put one pineapple slice each onto 2 small plates
2. Put the cut ends of the bananas in hole of pineapple
3. Place 2 mint leaves on side of each candle
4. Place 3 cherries at stem ends of mint leaves

title: crock pot wild rice with cranberries
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except almonds and cranberries in a crock pot
2. Cover and cook on low for 4 to 5 hours or until wild rice is tender
3. Meanwhile , cook almonds in ungreased heavy skillet over medium-low heat for 5 to 7 minutes , stirring frequently until they start to brown , then stir constantly until golden brown
4. Set aside
5. When rice is tender , stir almonds and cranberries into rice mixture in crock pot
6. Cover and continue cooking on low for 15 minutes

title: deb s beefy mac
steps:
1. Brown beef , onion and garlic
2. Add macaroni , tomato sauce and brown sugar
3. Stir well
4. Serve to hungry family

title: crock pot bar b que beef
steps:
1. Trim beef to remove fat
2. Cut meat into large cubes about 2" x 2"
3. Coat the bottom of a large crock-pot cooker with a little olive or canola oil to prevent sticking , then place meat in the cooker with the onion , cajun spice , and garlic
4. Mix together remaining ingredients and pour over meat
5. Cover and cook on high for 4 to 5 hours , or until meat shreds easily - stir once or twice during cooking if you can
6. Remove the meat & onion from cooker with a slotted spoon and shred the meat with a potato masher or 2 forks , then pour about 1 / 2 cup of the sauce over the meat - serve with the remaining sauce on the side for those people that would like more sauce
7. If you not afraid of a few extra calories , boil the trimmed off meat & fat with a cup of water in the microwave and then add just the "liquid" from that to the crock-pot
8. I like to trim the fat off the meat because not everyone likes fat in their sandwich , but the fat is full of flavor :)

title: hot swiss chard salad
steps:
1. Marinate garlic clove in oil for 1 hour
2. Remove garlic
3. Wash , dry and tear chard into bite-size pieces
4. Just before serving , heat oil , vinegar , salt and pepper , stirring occasionally
5. Pour over chard
6. Toss until well coated
7. Sprinkle with eggs and bacon
8. Toss lightly
9. Garnish with hard-cooked egg slices , if desired
10. Makes 4 to 6 servings

title: chicken scampi from the farmer s henhouse
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 450
2. Grease a 13x9 pan
3. In the pan , combine everything except the pasta and cheese
4. Bake for 12-14 minutes
5. Serve over pasta , sprinkle with cheese

title: herbed marinated cheese balls
steps:
1. Mix cheeses , onion , and garlic well , chill for 1 hour until firm enough to form into bite-sized balls
2. Blend marinade ingredients , pour over cheese balls , and marinate for several hours or overnight

title: baked onion and cheese dip
steps:
1. In a food processor , combine the cheddar cheese , pepper jack cheese , cream cheese , mayonnaise , thyme , and 1 cup of the onions
2. Cover and process until blended
3. Stir in remaining onion
4. Transfer to a greased baking dish
5. Bake , uncovered , at 375 degrees fahrenheit for 20-25 minutes or until bubbly
6. Serve with crackers , day old baguette or french bread

title: crab cakes with lime sauce
steps:
1. Grate the peel from the lime and squeeze the juice
2. Mix 1 / 2 of the lime juice you squeezed , 1 / 2 cup of the mayo , the salad dressing mix and the mustard in a medium bowl until well blended
3. Add the crabmeat , 1 / 2 cup of the cracker crumbs and the onion
4. Mix lightly but thoroughly
5. Shape into 16 patties
6. Coat with remaining cracker crumbs
7. Cook patties , in batches of three or four , in a large nonstick skillet , about two minutes on each side or until lightly browned and heated through
8. Mix remaining 1 / 2 cup mayo , remaining lime juice and peel , the sour cream and salt to taste until well blended
9. Serve with the crab cakes

title: spiced whole wheat pancakes
steps:
1. To make honey-cinnamon topping: place a small saucepan on low heat
2. Add honey and cinnamon
3. Stir for 1 minute
4. Add in butter and stir until melted
5. Keep warm
6. To make pancakes: in a big mixing bowl , combine flour , baking powder , spices , and salt
7. Set aside
8. In another bowl , whisk the eggs , milk , oil , and honey together
9. Add to the dry ingredients and mix well
10. Fold in nuts
11. Heat a nonstick griddle or skillet over medium-high heat
12. Lightly brush with vegetable oil
13. Pour 1 / 4 cup batter onto griddle for each pancake
14. Cook until bubbles form on the surface
15. Flip pancake over and cook until the other side is golden
16. Serve warm pancakes with honey-cinnamon topping

title: golden harvest bread  bread machine
steps:
1. Place the water and squash into the bread machine bowl following with the rest of the ingredients being sure to keep the salt sugar and yeast in separate corners
2. Set bread machine to dough cycle
3. Press start
4. At the dried fruit cycle , the machine will beep you can add optional seeds
5. When cycle is done remove to floured surface punch down and shape into a round mound then gently press the center in
6. Cover with oiled plastic wrap and let rise 45 minutes
7. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
8. Mix egg and turmeric together
9. Remove wrap
10. Slash along sides of bread up and down to form the look of a pumpkin
11. Brush with glaze
12. Place in preheat oven for 35-40 minutes

title: south of the border cheesy potato soup
steps:
1. Saute onion and celery in butter in large pot until tender
2. Add potatoes , broth and spices
3. Bring to a boil , cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender
4. Mash potatoes to desired consistency with a masher or fork
5. Or puree in food processor to desired consistency
6. Stir in milk , and gradually stir in cheese until it is all melted
7. Add corn , chilies , pimentos and salt and pepper until all is hot
8. Can be frozen and heated up in a low crockpot later

title: beef burgundy aka boeuf bourguignon a la ivo
steps:
1. In a large pot , cook the bacon pieces at medium-low heat , stirring occasionally until the pieces are completely crispy and are swimming in bacon fat
2. Scoop out the bacon and set aside
3. Put the flour into a large zip lock bag with about a tsp of salt and ditto of pepper
4. Mix well
5. Coat the meat cubes in this mixture in 4 batches , removing each batch as its coated
6. Increase the heat under the pot to high , and brown the meat in batches
7. If the bacon fat mysteriously disappears , replace with olive oil , or vegetable oil if you want
8. I know you're not supposed to heat olive oil but it didn't do me any harm , and vegetable oil sometimes forms a nasty-tasting slick on the surface of this dish -- set the browned meat aside in a bowl
9. Once all the meat is browned , add oil if needed and put the onion , carrot and celery in the pan
10. Stir over medium-high heat until thoroughly softened
11. Season to taste with salt and pepper if you like , then add the minced garlic and the meat back in along with its juices
12. Stir , then add the whole bottle of wine to the pan
13. A word about spices
14. Before you start simmering , i like adding the herbs at this stage
15. Lots of fine herbs , definitely some fresh , chopped rosemary , but the truth is , i sort of make it up as i go along at this point
16. Cover and simmer over low heat for at least 4-5 hours
17. During the final half-hour of simmering , sprinkle the mushrooms with garlic powder and fry until crispy
18. Set aside
19. Taste the stew
20. Add salt , pepper and spices where needed
21. Another flying-by-ear operation ! guilty secret: last time i made this , i added 2 tbsp of emeril's essence to the stew and that worked beautifully !
22. Serve in a big bowl and sprinkle with the fried mushrooms and parsley
23. Serve with potatoes or pasta

title: quick and easy pancit
steps:
1. Place the rice noodles in a large bowl , and cover with warm water
2. When soft , drain , and set aside
3. Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium heat
4. Saute onion and garlic until soft
5. Stir in chicken , cabbage , carrots and soy sauce
6. Cook until cabbage begins to soften
7. Toss in noodles , and cook until heated through , stirring constantly
8. Transfer pancit to a serving dish and garnish with quartered lemons

title: scandinavian cucumber salad
steps:
1. Put the cucumberslices in layers in a strainer and sprinkle some salt on each layer
2. Leave for 2 hours
3. Mix the cucumber with the herbs , cream cheese and lots of black pepper
4. Serve immediately & enjoy !

title: lamb stew with chili sauce
steps:
1. Tear the dried chiles into large pieces and soak in hot water for 30 min , then transfer the contents into a blender , add garlic and spices , process until smooth
2. Heat the oil in a large sauce pan and stir fry lamb cubes over high heat until browned
3. Cover the lamb with a layer of potato slices , season with salt , cook covered over medium heat for 10 minute
4. Pour over the chili mixture and mix well , simmer covered over low heat for 1 hr or until meat and potatoes are tender
5. Garnish with red pepper strips and fresh oregano , serve with a rice dish

title: cranberry and orange cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter , sugar and salt in electric mixer
2. Beat in egg yolks one at a time
3. Add vanilla
4. Gradually add flour to mixture
5. Mix cranberries , oats and zest into dough
6. Form 1 inch balls and flatten onto lightly greased cookie sheet
7. Cook for approximately 10 minutes at 350f

title: gluten free trail mix
steps:
1. Combine ingredients
2. Serve

title: christmas bubble bread
steps:
1. Pour your milk into a medium size saucepan
2. Add the soft butter and heat till the butter is melted
3. Pour the milk and the melted butter into a large bowl
4. Check the temperature of the milk
5. You want it to be between 100 and 110
6. Take your room temperature egg and brake it into a small bowl
7. With a fork , beat the egg and add it to the milk mixture
8. Add about 1 cup of flour and mix together with a wooden spoon
9. Add in the instant dry yeast and the ground cinnamon to the mixture
10. Using the wooden spoon beat till well blended
11. Add in the sugar and salt
12. Mix together
13. Add the rest of the flour and mix
14. Place dough onto a lightly floured surface and knead the dough
15. Using the palm of your hands , push the dough away with a rolling motion
16. Fold the dough back toward yourself
17. Then give the dough a quarter turn
18. Continue this sequence of pushing , folding and turning
19. Knead the dough for about 6-8 minutes
20. Adding flour as you need it
21. After pour a little oil into a clean bowl
22. Place the kneaded dough into the bowl and give it a turn to coat all sides of the dough
23. Cover with plastic wrap and allow to bulk up to double it's size
24. This will take about 1 hour
25. After the dough has doubled in bulk , pour out onto a lightly floured surface
26. Flatten the dough and add the cranberries and the golden raisins
27. Knead the dough till the dried fruit is evenly spread throughout the dough
28. Shape the dough into a rectangle
29. Cut the dough with a sharp knife into three equal sizes
30. After you cut the dough into three equal parts
31. Cut each piece of dough in half again
32. Then cut each piece again in half
33. You should end up with 12 equal size pieces
34. Grease a 9 x 9 square pan
35. Roll each dough into a ball and place them into the pan 4 down 3 across
36. Cover the dough with plastic wrap once again
37. Allow to double in size
38. This will take about 1 hour
39. Place pan into a preheated 350f oven for 25 to 30 minutes
40. Or , till a thermometer is placed into the center of the bread in the middle and the temperature reads between 190 - 200
41. Remove from pan
42. While the bread is still hot brush with melted butter
43. As soon as you brush the melted butter on the top of the bread
44. Immediately tap a layer of powder sugar over the top with a sieve or sifter
45. Enjoy this wonderful bread

title: italian pumpkin strata
steps:
1. In a large skillet , cook sausage , onion , peppers , and garlic in oil
2. Crumble sausage into pieces
3. Cook until sausage is no longer pink
4. Drain
5. Combine bread , cheese , and sausage mixture in a large bowl
6. Mix together milk , pumpkin , eggs , salt , pepper , and seasonings
7. Pour over bread mixture and stir gently until bread is moistened
8. Pour into a greased 13x9 inch baking dish
9. Bake at 350 degrees for 30-35 minutes or until set
10. Serve warm

title: cajun sweet potato ice cream
steps:
1. Place cream , milk , and brown sugar in a medium saucepan thats set to low-medium heat
2. Stir until sugar has dissolved and the mixture is hot , but not boiling
3. Whisk the egg yolks in a bowl
4. Continue whisking and slowly add in one cup of the hot mixture
5. Pour the mixture back into the saucepan , whisking constantly
6. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until the mixture thickens enough that it coats the back of a spoon , about 6 minutes
7. Do not boil
8. Pour the mixture back into the bowl and whisk in the sweet potato puree , nutmeg , cinnamon , cayenne pepper and rosemary
9. Cover and refrigerate until it has chilled about 2 - 3 hours
10. Follow the manufacturers directions for the ice cream maker to freeze
11. Once the ice cream is ready to your liking , scoop into bowls and top with pecans

title: cherry carnival
steps:
1. Sift together the flour , baking powder and salt
2. Add the shortening , sugar , egg and milk
3. Beat until smooth
4. Add the cherries and pour into greased 9 x 13 pan
5. Bake at 350 for 30-40 minutes
6. For the cherry sauce , mix together the sugar and cornstarch in a small saucepan
7. Gradually stir in 1 cup of boiling water and cherry juice
8. Boil for 1 minute stirring constantly
9. Remove from heat and add almond extract
10. To serve , slice the cherry cake and spoon the cherry sauce over individual slices
11. Serve warm

title: spicy chicken asiago soup
steps:
1. Heat 1t olive oil in large stock pot
2. Add chicken , removed from the sausage casings
3. Brown then set aside
4. Add chopped onions to remaining oil in pot: saute
5. Add chopped garlic
6. Add chicken broth , slowly
7. Add peeled , chopped potatoes to broth mixture
8. Add oregano , basil and salt
9. Add chopped parsley
10. Add crushed red pepper to taste
11. Simmer for about 30 minutes until potatoes are done
12. Add some of the hot broth mixture to the milk , then slowly pour back into stock pot broth mixture , or heat milk in microwave before adding to broth mixture
13. Add sliced or chopped kale and sausage
14. Reheat and cook about 5 more minutes
15. Serve

title: kohlrabi   carrots
steps:
1. Cover the kohlrabi and carrots with lightly salted water and boil until quite tender
2. Drain
3. Lightly mash , leave a lot of texture don't try to make them smooth like mashed potatoes
4. Add nutmeg and butter
5. Serve

title: chiles rellenos in tomato broth
steps:
1. Brown onions in lard
2. Add tomatoes , cinnamon and pepper
3. Cook briskly until sauce becomes the consistency of a thick tomato sauce
4. Add stock , simmer partially covered for 45 minutes
5. Stuff chiles with cheese and hold together with skewers
6. Batter: beat whites to stiff peaks with 1 / 2 tsp salt
7. Beat in yolks 2 at a time until well incorporated
8. Beat in flour
9. Dust chiles with flour and dip quickly into batter then lay in 350 degree oil
10. Baste tops with hot oil
11. When they are golden on bottom , turn over and cook other side
12. Drain
13. Once all chiles have cooled at least 5 minutes , put on sheet pan with parchment , slip out the skewer , and bake at 400 for 15 minutes
14. To serve , place a pool of sauce in a bowl and top with a chile
15. The oil can then be used to cook the chiles

title: vanilla texas sheet cake w cream cheese frosting
steps:
1. Mix flour and sugar together in bowl , bring to boil , margarine , oil and water , pour over flour and sugar mixture
2. Beat well
3. Then add eggs , baking soda , vanilla and buttermilk , mix well
4. Pour into greased and floured 15x10 jelly roll pan
5. Bake in a preheated oven at 350 degrees for 15-20 minutes or until cake tests done with toothpick
6. Remove from oven while still warm frost with cream cheese frosting
7. Cream together margarine , cream cheese , the add vanilla , coconut , nuts and powdered sugar
8. Mix well , spread warm cake

title: apricot jello salad
steps:
1. Bottom:
2. Drain appricots and pineapple , reserve liquid
3. Dissolve jello in 2 cups hot water
4. Add marshmellows and stir until melted
5. Add 1 cup of reserved liquid
6. Combine remaining ingredients and put in a 9x13inch pan
7. Refrigerate until set
8. Topping:
9. Put 1 cup reserved liquid in a sauce pan , heat
10. Mix the sugar and flour , add to liquid
11. Add 1 beaten egg
12. Cook to boiling until thickened
13. Remove from heat and add the butter
14. Cool then add 2 cups cool whip
15. Cover the bottom with the topping & refrigerate
16. Sprinkle with cheese

title: new york style pizza crust
steps:
1. Combine water and sugar in small bowl
2. Stir to dissolve sugar
3. Sprinkle yeast on top
4. Stir to combine
5. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes or until foamy
6. Combine flour and salt in medium bowl
7. Stir in yeast mixture
8. Mix until mixture forms soft dough
9. Remove dough to lightly floured surface
10. Knead 5 minutes or until dough is smooth and elastic , adding additional flour , 1 tablespoon at a time , as needed
11. Place dough in medium bowl coated with nonstick cooking spray
12. Turn dough in bowl so top is coated with cooking spray
13. Cover with towel or plastic wrap
14. Let rise in warm place 30 minutes or until doubled in bulk
15. Punch dough down
16. Place on lightly floured surface and knead about 2 minutes or until smooth
17. Pat dough into flat disc about 7 inches in diameter
18. Let rest 2 to 3 minutes
19. Pat and gently stretch dough from edges until dough seems to not stretch anymore
20. Let rest 2 to 3 minutes
21. Continue patting and stretching until dough is 12 to 14 inches in diameter
22. Spray 12- to 14-inch pizza pan with nonstick spray
23. Sprinkle with commeal , if desired
24. Press dough into pan
25. Preheat oven to 5oof
26. Follow directions for individual recipes , baking pizza on bottom rack of oven

title: banana soy smoothie
steps:
1. Peel the banana , break it into pieces and put it in the blender with the soy milk and orange juice
2. Blend until smooth and serve
3. If you like , use frozen banana chunks or add a couple of ice cubes

title: vegan tofu berry custard
steps:
1. Put berries in a saucepan with the water and sweetener , bring to the boil , and then lower the heat , and simmer until tender and a syrup forms
2. Cool
3. Put everything in your blender with the berries , and puree until smooth and creamy
4. Add in more lemon juice and sweetener to taste if desired
5. Chill in the fridge , and serve topped with more fresh berries and vegan cream

title: almond cream with fruit
steps:
1. In lg bowl , combine pudding mix and milk
2. Beat on low for 2 minutes
3. In sm bowl , beat cream with extract until stiff
4. Fold into the pudding
5. Spoon into a 2 qt serving dish
6. Chill
7. Top with fruit before serving

title: abaranger dino curry
steps:
1. Cut potatoes , carrots , and choosen meat into small pieces
2. Slice onions
3. Heat a deep pan and saute the onions until brown
4. Add choosen meat , potatoes , carrots and garlic in the pan and saute together
5. Add water in the pan and bring to a boil
6. Turn heat down to low and cook for 40-50 minute
7. Add potatostarch and water mixture in the soup to thicken
8. Add curry roux and simmer for 10 minute serve the curry over steamed rice

title: strawberry pasta
steps:
1. Pure strawberries in blender
2. Drain to remove seeds
3. Cook spaghetti according to package
4. Drain and toss with cheese
5. Heat butter and cream in a small saucepan
6. Place pasta in a sealable container , then add strawberries , followed by the butter sauce
7. Serve with additional cheese and garnish with mint , if desired

title: fruity cottage cheese snack
steps:
1. Add the peach cubes to the cottage cheese and blend thoroughly
2. Top with almonds
3. Chill and eat

title: alli s oriental salad
steps:
1. In large bowl , mix vinegar , olive oil , pepper , sugar , & ramen noodle seasoning well , set aside or in fridge while preparing rest
2. In another large bowl mix cabbage & green onions
3. Mix both of the above together well & then add sunflower seeds & almonds
4. Cool in fridge for about 20 mins to 1 / 2 hour
5. Before serving , take out & pour crunched up ramen noodles to top & mix well
6. Enjoy !

title: pork roast with apple
steps:
1. Cut apple in half
2. Slice one half fairly thin and put on the bottom of a roaster
3. Place the pork roast on top of the sliced apples
4. Slice second half of apple thinly and put on top of the pork roast
5. Slice onion into rings and put on top and around the roast
6. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over the pork roast
7. Put pork roast into the oven at 325f
8. Every half hour or so baste the roast with the juices
9. Cook for as long as the roast is big
10. Take out and let rest approximately 15 minutes before cutting

title: best shepherd s pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Peel potatoes , wash , cube and boil them until soft for mashing
3. Mash potatoes and mix in butter , milk , cream , salt and pepper
4. Cook ground beef , drain and add worcestershire sauce , simmer
5. Saute all veggies , except the corn , in olive oil until slightly tender , but not cooked through
6. Mix the sauteed veggies in with the ground beef , heap into casserole dish
7. Layer the corn on top of the ground beef mixture in casserole dish
8. Spoon and smooth out the mashed potatoes on top of the corn
9. Bake for 15-20 minutes
10. Top with cheddar cheese and broil until cheese is melted

title: cheese  n chicken enchiladas
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Cook and stir onion in butter in a large skillet until tender
3. Stir in chicken , 1 / 4 cup picante sauce , cream cheese and taco seasoning cook until thoroughly heated
4. Stir in 1 cup of shredded cheese
5. Spoon about 1 / 3 cup chicken mixture in the center of each tortilla
6. Roll up and place seam side down in baking dish
7. Top with remaining picante sauce and cheese
8. Bake 15 minutes till cheese is melted and heated through

title: jamaican  grits rice cooker optional
steps:
1. Drain liquid out of hominy into measuring cup fill the rest with water until it measures 2 cups
2. Add grits to water in saucepan
3. Bring to a boil
4. Cook
5. When done add pimento juice and all spices
6. ( when done add to cooked grits allow to be on warm until cheese melts
7. And 1 / 2 cup cheese stir
8. Add hominy
9. Pour in buttered casserole
10. Top with rest of cheese
11. Bake350 for 25 minutes

title: corn lemon salad
steps:
1. If using frozen corn kernels , cook them in a medium bowl in the microwave for 3 minutes on medium power
2. If using fresh corn kernels , cook them for about 1 to 1 1 / 2 minutes
3. Set aside to cool
4. Season the chopped onions with the salt and pepper
5. Add the seasoned onions to the bowl of corn and mix well
6. Pour the lemon juice over the corn-onion mixture and toss to coat
7. Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve , or refrigerate for 1-2 hours and serve cold

title: ukrainian pyrizhky with meat filling  stuffed buns
steps:
1. Pyrizhky dough: dissolve the sugar and ginger in the lukewarm water , sprinkle the yeast over it , and let it stand for 10 minutes
2. To the hot scalded milk , add the butter , and cool to lukewarm
3. Add the eggs , salt , sugar , and yeast
4. Mix in enough flour to make a medium soft dough as for bread
5. Knead on a floured board until smooth and satiny
6. Return to the bowl , cover , and let it rise until double in bulk
7. Punch down , knead a few times in the bowl , and let it rise again
8. Use any favorite filling in the recipes that follow
9. To make the pyrizhky , cut off small egg-sized pieces of dough , flatten each or roll 1 / 4 inch thick
10. Place a generous portion of the filling in the center , bring the edges together , and press to seal securely
11. All edges must be free of filling
12. Shape into an oblong with a plump center and tapering ends
13. This is the traditional shape of pyrizhky
14. As an alternative method , the dough may be rolled 1 / 4 inch thick , cut into squares , filled , and sealed as directed
15. Place , sealed side down , on a greased baking sheet , spacing them 1 to 1 1 / 2 inches apart
16. Cover and let them rise in a warm place until light , for about 1 hour
17. Brush them with a beaten egg diluted with 2 tablespoons of water or milk
18. Bake in a moderate oven for 30 to 35 minutes depending on their size
19. Meat filling: cook the onion in half of the butter until it is tender
20. Add the remaining butter and the meat
21. Brown the meat lightly
22. Season with salt and pepper
23. Cover and cook over a low heat until done
24. Remove the meat
25. Stir the flour into the drippings
26. Add the soup stock or water , then cook , until the sauce comes to a boil
27. Combine with the meat and cool
28. Mix in the parsley and chopped eggs
29. I like to use left-over cooked roast put through a meat grinder or food processor , is more flavourful

title: crispy pata   deep fried leg of pork
steps:
1. Clean pata and slit skin without cutting bone
2. Place in a deep pan with a tight cover
3. Add water , 7 up and salt
4. Bring to a boil after 15 minutes , add baking soda
5. Baking soda will hasten the softening of the patas skin
6. Continue cooking for another hour or until tender
7. If water dries up and pata is not yet done , add another cup of water
8. Drain when done
9. Hang for 1 day or place in refrigerator overnight to make skin dry
10. Before frying , brush with patis and sprinkle with flour generously
11. Deep fry until crispy and golden brown
12. Put off heat and pour 1 / 4 cup water
13. This will make the skin more crispy
14. Enjoy !
15. Prep and cooking time doesnt include drying the leg all day or overnight

title: mimi s cafe carrot raisin bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray three small loaf pans with cooking spray
3. Set aside
4. In a large bowl , stir together flour , sugar , cinnamon , baking soda , baking powder and salt
5. In a medium bowl , whisk together milk , oil , egg and vanilla
6. Stir milk mixture into dry ingredients until well-blended
7. Sprinkle carrot and raisins over batter and blend until evenly distributed
8. Divide batter evenly among pans and bake 35 minutes or until a tester inserted in center of loaf comes out clean
9. Cool in pans 5 minutes on cooling rack , remove from pans
10. Cool on rack an additional 15 minutes before slicing
11. Serve warm

title: tennessee whiskey glazed pork chops
steps:
1. In a bowl , whisk together the sauce base ingredients
2. Transfer 1 / 4 cup of mixture to a zip top bag and add pork chops
3. Press out as much air as possible and seal the bag
4. Marinate no more than one hour
5. Remove chops from bag
6. Pat dry with paper towels
7. Season both sides with salt and pepper
8. Heat a 12" skillet over medium-high flame
9. Add oil
10. When oil shimmers , add chops
11. Sear both sides until golden brown , 3-4 minutes per side
12. Transfer to a clean plate
13. Tent with foil to keep warm
14. Pour remaining sauce mixture into hot skillet
15. Scrape up browned bits from the bottom of the pan
16. Reduce over medium-high heat until thickened , about 5 minutes
17. Whisk in remaining vinegar and juices from pork chops
18. Whisk in cold butter
19. Return chops to pan , presentation side down
20. Turn chops over to glaze them fully
21. Turn off heat
22. Cover for 5 minutes to finish cooking

title: leek soup
steps:
1. Heat a 4-quart soup pot over medium heat and add the oil
2. When oil is hot , ad the leeks , onion , and salt
3. Saut for about 5 minutes , stirring often , until the onion begins to turn translucent
4. Add the garlic and stir well
5. Cook for another minute or so
6. Add the potatoes and vegetable stock
7. Cover and bring to a boil
8. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes

title: asparagus cheese soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , melt butter
2. Add flour , salt , and pepper
3. Stir until smooth
4. Gradually add milk and stirring constantly , bring to a boil
5. Boil and stir 2 minutes
6. Add asparagus and stir until heated thoroughly
7. Add cheese , thyme and nutmeg
8. Heat until cheese is melted , stirring frequently
9. Ladle into individual serving bowls
10. Sprinkle with extra cheese is desired

title: fancy green beans
steps:
1. Teriyaki-honey sauce:
2. In a small bowl , stir together the teriyaki suace , honey and melted butter
3. Bring a large pot of water to a boil
4. Drop in the beans and cook for 4-5 minutes , or until the beans are bright green
5. Drain the beans in a colander , then plunge them into ice water
6. Drain again and set aside
7. In a skillet , cook the bacon until very crisp
8. Crumble and set aside
9. Saute the peppers , onion and garlic in the hot bacon fat for 2-3 minutes
10. Add the beans , cashews and bacon to the skillet and heat through
11. Add the teriyaki-honey sauce and toss gently
12. Add the lemon juice and toss again
13. Enjoy

title: soft tacos     easy and very yummy
steps:
1. Cook meat on medium heat , when almost all of the pink is gone season the meat with the salt , pepper , chili powder , garlic powder and lime juice and a few leaves of cilantro
2. As meat is cooking chop up onions , avacados tomatoes , and lettuce
3. Pluck leaves of cilantro or chop them as well
4. Shred chedder cheese
5. Cut limes in half
6. When the meat is done strain or soak up extra grease , put the meat back in pan if you take it out
7. Flour tortilas can be cooked on a cast iron tortilla pan
8. Top your soft taco with cheese , lettuce , onion , tomato , cilantro , a squeeze of lime , avacado , sour cream , and your favorite hot sauce(la victoria salsa brava is very good)
9. Enjoy !

title: smothered okra
steps:
1. Pour oil in bottom of pan
2. Add the remaining ingredients
3. Cover pot and simmer 1 1 / 2 hours on low , stirring often
4. Remove the cover the last 10 minutes

title: steamed and roasted whole duck
steps:
1. To reduce the fat and produce a crispy skin , begin by trimming the excess fat from the neck and body
2. Rinse the duck , inside and out , and pat dry thoroughly with paper towels
3. Combine the chinese five-spice , sugar , and salt in a small bowl
4. Rub the spice mixture all over the duck , inside and out
5. Salt and five-spice powder makes a fragrant dry marinade , which draws some of the moisture from the duck so that the spices penetrate
6. Stuff the duck cavity with the aromatics: the ginger , garlic , green onions , and tangerine peel
7. Fold the wing
8. Poke the duck breast a few times , piercing the skin
9. Place a roasting pan on the stovetop over 2 burners and fill with 2-inches of water , turn the heat to medium
10. Set a v-rack insert inside the pan and lay the duck on the rack , breast-side up
11. Cover tightly with aluminum foil
12. Steam the duck for 45 minutes , checking the water level periodically
13. Steaming the duck first melts away some of the fat and shrinks the skin
14. In a small saucepan combine the vinegar , honey , and soy sauce over low heat
15. Bring to a boil and simmer and stir for 15 minutes until sauce thickens
16. The duck will be lacquered with the sweet glaze , which caramelizes during roasting , making the skin crisp and brown
17. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f
18. Take the foil off the duck , remove the rack with the duck , and pour out the water and all the fat that has rendered out
19. Put the rack with the duck back inside the roasting pan
20. Baste the duck with the vinegar mixture , until all the skin is completely coated in the glaze
21. Stick the whole thing in the oven
22. Roast the duck for 1 hour , basting periodically with any remaining glaze to set in a deep mahogany color
23. Tent the breast with some foil if it gets too dark
24. The legs will wiggle easily when it's done
25. Carve and serve

title: broccoli dip
steps:
1. Microwave broccoli in a covered dish on high about three minutes or until thawed
2. Drain any excess water
3. Add velveeta and garlic powder
4. Microwave 2 to 3 minutes or until velveeta is melted
5. Serve hot
6. If desired , remove the bread from the center of the bread loaf and pour broccoli dip in and serve

title: versatile cheese ball
steps:
1. Combine cheeses , horseradish , worcestershire , and mustard
2. Shape into a ball
3. Roll in chopped nuts
4. Serve with crackers and fruit

title: salsa roja mexicana
steps:
1. Place the whole tomatoes in a saucepan with the peppers
2. Cover with water and bring to a boil
3. Simmer gently until the tomatoes are fairly soft but not falling apart - about 5 minutes
4. Drain , but reserve 1 / 3 cup of the cooking liquid
5. Mix the bouillon into the 1 / 3 cup reserved cooking liquid and pour into the jar of a blender
6. Add garlic
7. Blend until the garlic is finely dispersed throughout the liquid
8. Add the tomatoes and peppers to the blender jar , and blend for a few seconds
9. Do not over blend
10. It should have a rough texture
11. Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a sauce pan
12. Add the chopped onion and saute a couple of minutes
13. Add the sauce from the blender
14. Cook on high heat , stirring from time to time scraping the bottom of the pan until the sauce is reduced - about 6 - 8 minutes
15. Taste , and add salt if necessary

title: spiced zucchini muffins
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Grease and paper muffin tins
3. Mix the eggs , oil , sugar , sour cream , and zucchini together in a large bowl
4. Do not overmix
5. Add the two flours , baking powder , baking soda , salt , cinnamon , nutmeg , cloves , fruit and walnuts , if using
6. Do not overmix , but make sure that all the batter is mixed together
7. Pour into muffins tins and bake approximately 20 minutes

title: caf baileys
steps:
1. Combine the ingredients together in a mug glass
2. Top with whip cream if desired

title: ruby tuesday s shrimp fondue copycat
steps:
1. Put sauce into sauce pan and add shredded cheese
2. Stir until all the cheese is melted
3. Add shrimp and stir until warm
4. Add pico de gallo just before serving
5. The shrimp and pico de gallo really add a lot of moisture , but if it is too thick , add a little milk , half & half or heavy cream
6. If you don't have pico de gallo , finely diced tomatoes and onions can be used instead

title: wasabi crusted scallops w  ginger mango coulis
steps:
1. To make the coulis: heat the canola oil over medium heat in a medium saucepan
2. Add the shallots , ginger , and garlic and cook , stirring frequently until the shallots are translucent , about 5 minutes
3. Add the sesame oil , plum wine , lobster stock , coconut milk , sweet chili sauce , and simmer until the flavors blend and the mixture reduces by about one-quarter , about 8 minutes
4. Add the mango puree and season with lime juice and salt
5. Simmer for another 3 to 5 minutes then strain and set aside in a warm place
6. To make the crust: in a spice grinder or mortar , grind the mustard and coriander seeds with the peppercorns and wasabi peas
7. Adjust the seasoning with wasabi powder and salt
8. Shortly before serving roll the scallops in the crust
9. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
10. Add the scallops and cook until they begin to crisp then flip
11. Cook the scallops until they are crisp on all sides
12. Spoon the scallops onto warm plates
13. Spoon coulis around the scallops and serve

title: grilled japanese eggplant with an asian vinaigrette
steps:
1. Wash eggplants and pat dry with paper towels , set aside
2. In a small mixing bowl combine the chinese 5-spice powder , onion powder , garlic salt , and black pepper
3. Set aside
4. Slice the eggplants in half lengthwise , brush with olive oil and rub the mixed spices on both sides
5. Grill over low heat for about 5 minutes on each side , or until tender
6. Arrange cabbage on serving plates and top with grilled eggplant
7. Drizzle with the asian vinaigrette
8. Top with the fresh mint , feta , and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds
9. Asian vinaigrette:
10. In a blender or food processor , combine all the ingredients except the vegetable and sesame oils
11. With the blender / processor running , slowly pour in the vegetalbe oil followed by the sesame oil
12. Process for 10 to 15 seconds longer
13. Refrigerate until ready to serve
14. Cook's

title: spanish rice pudding
steps:
1. Bring water to a boil with 1 / 4 teaspoon salt in a large heavy saucepan
2. Stir in rice and return to a boil
3. Cook , covered , over low heat until water is absorbed , about 18 minutes
4. Stir in milk , sugar , zest , and cinnamon stick and simmer , uncovered , stirring often , until thickened and rice is tender , 40 minutes to 1 hour
5. Stir in vanilla
6. Cool to lukewarm in a large shallow bowl , surface covered with a piece of buttered wax paper

title: versatile brownies
steps:
1. Melt chocolate and butter together in 3-qt saucepan over low heat , stirring occasionally , until smooth
2. Remove from heat
3. Stir in sugar and vanilla
4. Add eggs , one at a time , mixing well after each addition
5. Stir in dry ingredients until well mixed
6. Spread into a lightly greased 8x8 pan
7. Bake at 350 for 33-38 minutes -- until brownies just begin to pull away from sides of pan
8. Brownie
9. Mine are usually done by the 30 minute mark , but every oven is different

title: hoisin marinated pork chops
steps:
1. Combine soy sauce thru garlic in a large zip-top plastic bag
2. Add pork chops
3. Seal and marinate in refrigerator 8 hours or overnight
4. Heat grill to medium high
5. Remove pork from bag
6. Discard marinade
7. Place pork on grill rack coated with cooking spray
8. Grill 3 minutes on each side or until cooked thru
9. Left overs can be kept int the fridge for up to 2 days , freeze for longer storage

title: soothing southern comfort
steps:
1. In a shaker filled with ice shake southern comfort and lime juice till well frosty cold
2. Pour into highball glasses that are filled with ice
3. Top with soda and garnish with lime and cherry !

title: strawberry jello pie
steps:
1. Place strawberries in the pie shell
2. Set aside
3. Mix jello and pudding with water
4. Heat to a full boil , then remove from heat
5. Pour over berries and chill
6. Top with 1 t
7. Cool whip , if desired

title: warm tuna rolls
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Remove some of the soft bread in the center of top and bottom of rolls
3. In a bowl , mix together the tuna , celery , green onion , pickle , mayonnaise , dijon mustard , dill , and fresh lemon juice
4. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper
5. Divide tuna filling among bottoms of rolls
6. Add cheese on top of filling and top with roll tops
7. Wrap in foil and bake about 15 minutes or until heated through

title: mom s apple tart
steps:
1. Crust: blend 1 cup flour , salt , sugar and butter , then add vinegar and combine well
2. Pat evenly into 8x8 or 9x9 pan and 1 inch up the sides
3. Set aside
4. Topping: place grated apples in a collander and press out extra juice
5. Then place in bowl and add rest of topping ingredients , mix well
6. Spread evenly over crust
7. Bake in 400 degree f oven for 1 hour
8. Cool in pan on wire rack
9. Serve with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream

title: magical egg salad
steps:
1. Place eggs in a saucepan and cover with water
2. Bring to a boil , remove from heat , and let eggs stand in hot water for 15 minutes
3. Remove eggs from hot water , cool under cold running water , and peel
4. Chop eggs and transfer to a large bowl
5. Stir mayonnaise , dijon mustard , sweet pickle relish , steak sauce , paprika , and dill into eggs until well mixed
6. Season with salt and black pepper
7. Cover and refrigerate until chilled , if desired
8. Sprinkle with cayenne pepper before serving

title: prose s protein packed power porridge
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients in a bowl
2. Pour in boiling water
3. Let sit for 5 minutes
4. Stir in almonds , fruit , soy milk , and maple syrup , to taste

title: chicken wellington  puff pastry wrapped chicken
steps:
1. Season the chicken breast with seasoning salt and pepper on all sides
2. Heat butter and oil in a skillet
3. Brown the breasts on all sides until almost completely cooked through
4. Transfer to a plate
5. To the same skillet add in onions , garlic and sliced mushrooms
6. Saute until the mushrooms lose their moisture and the onions are tender
7. Stir in parsley
8. On a floured surface , roll out each puff pastry sheet to a 14-inch square
9. Cut into four even 7-inch squares
10. Place each breast over each puff pastry square
11. Set oven to 375 degrees
12. In a small bowl combine the softened cream cheese with mustard , then spread over each breast
13. Then top with about 2-3 tablespoons mushroom / onion mixture
14. Brush the edges of each pastry square with water
15. Wrap pastry around the chicken breast , pressing edges to seal tightly
16. Place seam-side down on greased baking sheets
17. Brush the tops with egg wash
18. Bake for about 20 minutes , or until puffed and golden brown
19. Serve with mushroom sauce over the wellington or on the side of the plate
20. Delicious !

title: layered citrus chocolate squares
steps:
1. Make crust: combine 1 cup flour and 1 / 2 tsp baking powder , and then cut in butter with pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
2. Mix in 1 / 4 cup icing sugar and 1 tbsp orange peel
3. Press mixture into an 8 inch square pan
4. Bake crust at 350 f for 7 minutes
5. For filling: as soon as you take the crust out of the oven , sprinkle chocolate chips evenly over it
6. Let chocolate chips melt and then spread the melted chocolate over the crust
7. Make topping: combine remaining ingredients
8. Mix well
9. Pour topping over chocolate in pan
10. Bake at 350 f until top is lightly browned , about 25 minutes
11. When cool , dust with icing sugar and then cut into squares

title: red snapper italian style red snapper
steps:
1. In a large frying pan saute' the julienned onions in the olive oil on medium to medium high heat 1 minute
2. Add the snapper and cook 2 minutes or until slightly browned
3. Turn and brown the other side 2 minutes
4. Add the wine , tomatoesand half of the pepper flakes
5. Slice the olives in half and add to the skillet
6. Season with salt to taste and simmer 10 minutes basting the fish as it cooks
7. Chop the parsley and add it
8. Squeezing the halfed lemon over the fish and simmer 1 minute , spoon sauce over the red snapper and serve

title: curry and yogurt braised chicken thighs
steps:
1. In a large , deep skillet , heat oil
2. Season chicken with salt and pepper and lightly dust with flour
3. Add chicken to skillet and cook over high heat , turning once , for 6 minutes
4. Transfer chicken to a plate
5. Add ginger , garlic , chile and bell pepper to skillet and cook over high heat until slightly softened , about 2 minutes
6. Stir in curry powder and cook 1 minute
7. Add tomatoes , corn , yogurt and water
8. Stir until smooth
9. Season with salt and pepper
10. Return chicken and any accumulated juices to skillet and bring to a boil
11. Cover and simmer over very low heat until chicken is tender and juices are slightly thickened , about 15 minutes
12. Sprinkle with cilantro and serve over cooked rice

title: i don t believe it s      lemon tofu cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. In a medium bowl , combine graham cracker crumbs , maple syrup and almond extract
3. Mix until the graham cracker crumbs are moistened
4. Prep a 9 inch springform pan by spraying the bottom and sides with nonstick oil spray , or by oiling with a paper towel
5. Bake the crust for 5 minutes , then remove it from the oven and set it aside to cool while you prepare the filling
6. Blend all the filling ingredients in a food processor for about 30 seconds , or until smooth
7. Pour filling into the springform pan over the cooled crust
8. Bake for about 30 minutes or until the top of the cheesecake is lightly browned
9. Remove the cheesecake from the oven and allow it to cool
10. Place the cooled cheesecake in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours until it is thoroughly chilled and firm
11. To serve , take a long knife and heat the blade in hot hot water
12. Slide the blade of the knife along the edge of the cooled cheesecake to ensure that it will separate from the pan
13. Release the springform ring , slice , sprinkle with slivered almonds if desired and serve cold

title: coconut meringue cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Grease the bottom and side of a 9-inch springform pan
3. Combine coconut and 1 / 4 cup pecans
4. Stir in butter
5. Press onto bottom of pan
6. Bake about 15 minutes or until lightly browned
7. Remove from oven
8. Increase oven temperature to 350
9. Meanwhile , for filling: in a large bowl , combine cream cheese , sugar , cocoa powder , the water , and vanilla
10. Beat with an electric mixer on low speed until smooth
11. Beat in yolks just until combined
12. Pour into crust-lined pan
13. Place pan in a shallow baking pan
14. Bake about 25 minutes or until center appears nearly set when shaken
15. Remove from oven
16. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 cup pecans
17. Meanwhile , for meringue: let egg whites stand at room temperature for 30 minutes
18. In a large bowl , combine egg whites and salt
19. Beat on medium speed about 1 minute or until soft-peaks form
20. Slowly add marshmallow creme , beating on high speed about 4 minutes more or until stiff , glossy peaks form
21. When cheesecake comes out of oven , immediately spread meringue over hot cheesecake , carefully sealing to edge of pan
22. Return to oven
23. Bake for 15 minutes more
24. Cool cheesecake in pan on a wire rack for 1 hour
25. Remove side of pan
26. Cover and chill for at least 3 hours before serving
27. If desired , garnish with milk chocolate curls

title: asian shrimp bowl with rice
steps:
1. In a large microwave-safe bowl , combine the shrimp and vegetables
2. Microwave until thawed , 3-5 minutes , stirring half way through the cooking time
3. Stir in dressing and soy sauce and microwave on medium heat , stirring occasionally , until heated through , about 3-5 minutes
4. Cover to keep warm
5. Heat the rice according to package directions
6. Portion into 4 serving bowls
7. Add the cilantro to the shrimp mixture
8. Portion and place on top of the rice

title: quesadillas with poblano chiles
steps:
1. Tortillas: mix masa harina with warm water
2. Using your hands squish water and flour together until a cohesive mass is formed
3. Dough should be smooth and pliable
4. Cover the bowl with a barely damp kitchen towel
5. Let sit 5-10 minutes
6. Add salt
7. Knead gently in bowl for another minute
8. Divide dough into 12 equal portions
9. Use your palms to form each portion into a ball
10. Cover with the damp towel
11. Filling: in a frying pan over medium heat , warm the oil
12. Add onion and saut until golden brown about 5 minutes
13. Stir in garlic and oregano and cook for 1 more minute add chiles and sea salt , toss until all is thoroughly heated
14. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt
15. Assembly of quesadillas: put two sheets of plastic cut from a plastic storage bag inside a tortilla press or use rolling pin on 2 sheets of wax paper with the dough ball between the 2 sheets
16. Put a dough ball between the sheets and gently press down the top plate of the press or roll the dough ball using the rolling pin into a circular shape between sheets of wax paper
17. Remove top piece of plastic or wax paper and place a generous tablespoon of the shredded cheese on half of the tortilla keeping the edges free
18. Top with a couple of chile strips and a few onion slices
19. Lift the lower piece of plastic or wax paper to fold the uncovered side of the tortilla over the filling
20. Press the edges together with your fingers
21. Remove from the press or the wax paper and set aside covered with the damp towel
22. Repeat until all quesadillas are made
23. Cooking of quesadillas: preheat oven to 200 deg f
24. Pour oil to a depth of 1 inch into a deep heavy frying pan and place over medium high heat until the oil shimmers
25. Fry the quesadillas one at a time until golden 1-2 minutes
26. Using a slotted spatula , transfer to paper towels
27. Let drain briefly then transfer to a heat proof platter and keep warm in the oven
28. Serve as soon as possible
29. I had an extra amount of onion , cheese , and chiles so i dumped it on a store-bought corn tortilla , place another corn tortilla on top and then heated it on a dry frying pan until the cheese melted

title: armadillo eggs  not really
steps:
1. Place the olives in a bowl
2. In a lidded jar , put remaining ingredients and shake
3. Pour the marinade over the olives
4. Let the mixture marinate for at least 2 days , stirring occasionally
5. These olives get better with age , and please , let set at room temperature at least one hour before serving

title: salami tartlet canape bites
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Line base and sides of two 12-hole , 1 / 3-cup capacity muffin pans with salami
3. Pour 1 tablespoon egg into each salami case
4. Sprinkle with cheese
5. Bake for 6 to 8 minutes or until egg is set and cheese has melted
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Serve

title: oooey gooey incredibly yummy banana cinnamon toast
steps:
1. First , you got to slice the muffins into round slices and toast them lightly
2. Remove onto a plate melt butter in a pan
3. Add banana slices and saute till they brown a little and are soft
4. Stir in maple syrup , powdered cinnamon and the almonds
5. Mix lightly
6. Pour this mixture over the muffin slices
7. Remove onto a serving plate
8. Serve hot
9. Enjoy with full joy !

title: spicy steak quesadillas
steps:
1. Place 2 of the flour tortillas on a work surface
2. Evenly spread 1 / 4 cup of the cheese on top of each tortilla
3. Divide the steak evenly between the 2 tortillas
4. Sprinkle with jalapeno to taste
5. Spoon 1 / 4 cup of the salsa over each
6. Top with the remaining cheese
7. Place another tortilla on top of each quesadilla
8. Press down firmly with your hands to seal
9. Heat a large skillet over high heat
10. Add 1 1 / 2 teaspoon of the oil
11. Lower heat to medium
12. Transfer one of the quesadillas to the pan
13. Cook until bottom tortilla is golden brown , about 2 minutes
14. Slide quesadilla to a dinner plate
15. Invert another plate over it
16. Hold them together
17. Flip plates to leave the quesadilla browned side up
18. Slide tortilla back into the hot pan to cook the other side until golden brown , about 2-3 minutes
19. Repeat with remaining quesadilla

title: sweet curry chicken
steps:
1. Cut the chicken into strips or chunks
2. Mix flour , salt , and cayenne in a big ziploc bag , add chicken and toss until fully coated
3. Melt half of the butter and spread it in a 13 by 9 casserole dish
4. Add chicken and coat with the butter as much as you can
5. Cook , uncovered at 350 degrees for 20 minutes
6. While it cooks , mix the brown sugar , honey , soy sauce , curry , and remaining butter with a whisk
7. After it cooks for 20 minutes , take it out and pour the sauce over the chicken
8. Cook an additional 30 minutes
9. Enjoy !

title: cajun fried turkey injection  sauce
steps:
1. Mix all and let dissolve to blend
2. Inject your turkey at least 24 hours before cooking
3. Bake , fry , smoke , or grill your bird

title: baked jalapenos
steps:
1. Cut jalapenos in half and seed
2. Cook peppers in boiling water for about 5 minutes
3. Combine cream cheese , shredded cheese , bacon , and worcestereshire sauce
4. Stir well
5. Place heaping teaspoons into each pepper
6. Place on baking sheet and bake at 400 degrees f
7. For 5 minutes
8. Until cheese is melted
9. Let sit to room temperature

title: special day lemon bars
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. For the crust , cream the butter and sugar until light in the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the paddle attachment
3. Combine the flour and salt and , with the mixer on low , add to the butter until just mixed
4. Dump the dough onto a well-floured surface and gather into a ball
5. Flatten the dough with floured hands and press it into a 9 x 13 x 2" baking sheet , building up a 1 / 2" edge on all sides
6. Chill
7. Bake the crust for 15 to 20 minutes , until very lightly browned
8. Let cool on a wire rack , leaving the oven on
9. For the filling , whisk together the eggs , sugar , lemon juice , and flour , and pour into the crust
10. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes more , until the filling is set
11. Let cool to room temperature
12. Cut into triangles and dust with confectioners' sugar

title: peanut  bacon and avocado sandwich
steps:
1. Spread the peanut butter on four slices of bread and mayonnaise on the other four
2. Place the bacon , avocado , lettuce and pepper on the peanut butter spread slices and top with the mayonnaise spread slices
3. Slice in half and enjoy !

title: blue ribbon stuffed mushrooms
steps:
1. Brown pork sausage and crumble well
2. Drain sausage from skillet leaving a thin coating of oil behind and saut chopped onions until slightly wilted
3. Return sausage to pan with onions and add cream cheese
4. Over low heat stir sausage , onions , and cream cheese until well blended
5. Remove stems from mushrooms and stuff each mushroom cap with the mixture
6. Top with parmesan if desired
7. Bake at 350f for 20-25 minutes until heated through and the mushrooms are beginning to leak their water

title: shirley s no bake cheesecake  aka cheese pie
steps:
1. Cream together cream cheese and sugar with electric mixer
2. Add sour cream and vanilla and mix until well combined
3. Gently fold in cool whip until incorporated
4. Spoon into graham cracker crust and smooth top
5. Sprinkle top lightly with cinnamon
6. Refrigerate for about 3 hours to firm up before serving

title: ben s chocolate
steps:
1. Melt chocolate in top of double boiler over hot , not boiling water
2. Gradually whisk in the milk and heat , stirring constantly , until smooth
3. Remove from the heat and let cool
4. Whisk the eggs in a mixing bowl until light a fluffly , 1-2 minutes
5. Whisk in the sugar , a little at a time , then continue whisking until completely blended , about 1 minute more
6. Add the cream , vanilla , and salt and whisk to blend
7. Pour the chocolate mixture into the cream mixture and blend
8. Cover and refrigerate until cold , about 1 to 3 hours , depending upon your refrigerator
9. Transfer the mixture to you ice cream maker and freeze according to the manufacturer's directions
10. I heated the cream to almost-boiling and then poured over the chopped chocolate- much easier than the double boiler

title: poor man s pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
