2. Line a large 9-inch pie plate with rolled out pastry dough , prick with a fork and bake for 10 minutes
3. Remove from oven and reduce heat to 350f
4. In a small bowl , combine sugar , flour and salt
5. Mix well and spread evenly over the bottom of the crust
6. Warm cream in the microwave , and then carefully pour the warmed cream over the sugar mixture , completely covering it
7. In bits , dab butter over the cream
8. Bake at 350f for 45 minutes to an hour , or until golden spots form on the top
9. The filling will seem liquid but will become firmer as it cools

title: avocados banderas
steps:
1. Peel and slice each avocado in half
2. Remove seeds
3. Using a small pasty brush , coat each avocado with lemon juice
4. Lay each avocado half on small salad plates
5. Then , using the brush or a small spatula , paint a wide band of sour cream down the middle
6. Paint a narrow band of picante sauce down the center of the sour cream
7. Serve immediately

title: liquid oreos
steps:
1. Fill a cocktail shaker halfway with ice cubes
2. Add the vodka , kahla , crme de cacao and baileys and shake well
3. Strain into 2 martini glasses
4. Slip an oreo onto the side of each glass

title: rice and sausage casserole
steps:
1. Combine flour , margarine , milk , evaporated milk , oregano , parsley , garlic and soy sauce in blender
2. Blend until well mixed
3. Pour into medium pot and heat until thick and bubbly
4. If using cheese add to sauce and stir until melted
5. Put rest of ingredients into medium casserole dish
6. Pour sauce over veggies and meat and stir to coat
7. Add more milk if necessary , mixture should be fairly liquidy but not overly runny and should cover all ingredients
8. Cover and bake at 375 for 45 minutes to an hour
9. Remove and let cool for 10-15 minutes before serving

title: lil  luau smokies  a k a  lil  pineapple smokies
steps:
1. In a pan , heat oil over medium heat
2. Saute onion until tender , about 5 minutes
3. Remove from heat
4. In a large saucepan , combine onions , brown sugar , flour and mustard
5. Gradually stir in pineapple juice and chunks , vinegar and soy sauce
6. Bring to a boil over medium heat , stirring frequently
7. Boil for 2 minutes , stirring constantly
8. Add lil' smokies and stir to coat
9. Serve in a crock pot set on warm

title: roasted spiced carrots
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400 f
2. Combine the oil , garlic , sugar , cumin , salt , cinnamon , and carrots in a shallow baking pan
3. Roast 20 minutes or until fork-tender
4. Remove from oven and add the raisins , lemon juice , and parsley
5. Toss well

title: turkey spinach soup
steps:
1. Spray a large dutch oven with cooking spray
2. Brown turkey , onions , and garlic over medium heat until no longer pink
3. Add remaining ingredients and stir well
4. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer about 20 minutes

title: scott s chili
steps:
1. Heat oil in heavy saucepan
2. Add onions , green pepper , jalapeos and garlic and saut until onions are translucent
3. Add ground beef to the pot and cook until meat is evenly browned
4. Add the cumin , oregano , 1 / 4 cup chili powder , 2 tablespoons chili powder , ground cayenne , salt and mix well
5. Add crushed tomatoes , tomato paste , beer and water
6. Bring to boil , turn down heat and simmer covered
7. After 1 hour of simmering taste and add more chili powder if you want
8. Simmer for 1 hour more
9. Serve topped with chopped onions , cheddar cheese and sour cream if you like
10. Corn bread on the side

title: pasta mozzarella bake with ground turkey
steps:
1. In a skillet brown ground turkey with seasonings (black pepper , basil , oregano , and garlic
2. Meanwhile cook pasta to a little under el dente
3. In a 2 quart oblong casserole dish add ground turkey , 1 cup of mozzarella , water and soup
4. For the soup i use low sodium or low fat
5. Sir together to mix
6. Add pasta and stir to incorporate
7. Sprinkle with remaining 1 / 2 cup of mozzarella cheese
8. Bake at 400f for 25 minute or until bubbly
9. Let sit 5 minutes and then serve

title: penne with vodka sauce
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat corn oil over medium-low heat
2. Add garlic , stirring constantly , cook one minute
3. Stir in tomato sauce , cream , vodka , basil and oregano
4. Cook 8 minutes
5. Stir in shrimp and parmesan cheese
6. Heat through
7. Toss with penne
8. Serve

title: velvety squash soup
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Cut each squash in half lengthwise
3. Discard seed and membranes
4. Place squash , cut sides down , on a jelly roll pan coated with cooking spray
5. Combine onion and oil , tossing to coat
6. Spread onion mixture onto pan around squash
7. Bake at 425 degrees for 45 minutes or until squash and onion are tender
8. Cool slightly
9. Scoop out squash pulp from skins
10. Discard skins
11. Place onion and squash in a dutch oven
12. Stir in broth and the next 5 ingredients
13. Bring to a boil
14. Reduce heat
15. Simmer 5 minutes
16. Place half of squash mixture in a blender
17. Remove center piece of blender lid
18. Secure blender lid on blender
19. Place a clean towel over opening in blender lid
20. Pour into a large bowl
21. Repeat procedure with remaining squash mixture
22. Return pureed mixture to pan
23. Stir in half and half
24. Cook over medium heat 5 minutes or until thoroughly heated
25. Garnish with thyme , if desired

title: guava mojito
steps:
1. Muddle mint springs and sugar together in a measuring cup
2. Use this cup to measure the rum and juices so you rinse out all the yummy goodness
3. Place muddled mint and sugar in cocktail shaker half filled with ice , add rum and juices and shake 15 times
4. Strain into glass filled with ice
5. Dilute to desired strength with club soda
6. Optional
7. Garnish with mint

title: cherry angel cream cake
steps:
1. Cut cake into 1 / 4 inches slices
2. Arrange half the slices on bottom of 13 x 9 inch baking dish
3. In large bowl , combine sweetened condensed milk , water and extract
4. Mix well
5. Add pudding mix
6. Beat well
7. Chill 5 minutes fold in whipped cream
8. Spread half the cream mixture over cake slices
9. Top evenly with one can pie filling
10. Top with remaining cake slices , cream mixture and pie filling
11. Chill 4 hours or until set
12. Cut into squares to serve
13. Store leftovers covered in refrigerator

title: granny s bran biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f and lightly grease a baking sheet
2. Combine dry ingredients and mix together thoroughly
3. Cut in butter or other shortening with a pastry blender
4. Add enough milk to make a soft dough
5. Roll out 1 / 2 inch thick on a floured board , cut into rounds and place on prepared baking sheet
6. Bake for 15 minutes or until golden

title: yellow mustard bbq sauce
steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together and simmer over a low heat for 30 minutes

title: chicken lo mein
steps:
1. Start cooking linguine
2. Soak cut up breast with soy sauce and cornstarch , set aside
3. In hot oil over medium-high heat , cook mushrooms , pea pods , green onions and peppers about 3 to 5 minutes
4. Remove vegetables
5. Cook chicken strips about 2 to 3 minutes
6. Return vegetables to pan and add bouillon and 1 / 2 cup water
7. Heat to boiling
8. Add cooked linguine and mix well

title: cuban lechon asado  roasted fresh ham
steps:
1. The day before you plan to serve this dish , trim the excess fat off the pork leg
2. Make shallow slits all over the pork , using the
3. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
4. Drain the roast , and pat dry , reserving the marinade
5. Place it in a lightly oiled , nonreactive , heavy roasting pan
6. Cook the roast for 1 hour , turning once or twice to brown it on all sides
7. Reduce the heat to 325 degrees
8. Pour the marinade and onions over the pork
9. Tent the pan with heavy-duty aluminum foil
10. Continue roasting the pork , basting from time to time with the pan juices , until almost cooked , about 1 hour
11. Add a little water or sherry if the pan dries out
12. Uncover the roast and continue cooking until the internal temp readsat least 150 degrees f on a meat thermometer , about 30 minutes more
13. Let the roast stand for 10 minutes before carving

title: b   o cornbread pie
steps:
1. Brown the beef and onion in a skillet
2. Add the soup , water , seasonings , corn , and green pepper
3. Mix well and allow to simmer for 15 minutes
4. Then fill either a greased large pie pan or a greased casserole dish 3 / 4 full , leaving room for the topping
5. Now prepare the topping
6. Sift together all of the topping ingredients except the egg , then add the egg and the milk
7. Cover the meat mixture with the topping mixture and bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven for 18 to 20 minutes
8. Don't be surprised when the topping disappears into the meat mixture
9. It will rise during the baking and form a good layer of corn bread

title: green chile sliders with tomatillo lime sauce
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. Place the poblanos on a baking sheet and broil , turning once , until blackened
3. Transfer to a bowl & cover
4. Let stand until cool enough to handle
5. Peel off the skins & remove the seeds , discard
6. Chop into 1 / 2" pieces
7. Using a food processor , mix the tomatillos , jalapeno , onion , cilantro , lime peel , lime juice and honey until smooth-season with sdalt
8. In a large bowl , season the sirloin with the cumin , salt & pepper , combine
9. Mix in the poblanos
10. Halve the meat mixture & form into 3 inch patties
11. In a cast iron skillet or grill pan , heat the oil over high heat
12. Cook the patties , turning nce , about 5 minute for med-rare
13. During the last minute of cooking top with cheese and tent with foil
14. Dot the roll tops with tomatillo sauce and assemble the sliders
15. Serve with the extra sauce

title: whipped shortbread cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Stir all ingredients gently until mixed
3. Using electric beaters , beat dough on high for 10 minutes- no less- this is very important !
4. Drop by teaspoon full on ungreased cookie sheet
5. Bake for 10 minutes , just until edges are light brown
6. Decorate if you like , i prefer not
7. Slivers of red or green candied cherries pressed on before baking make a nice holiday garnish

title: marzetta
steps:
1. Bring soups and water to a boil
2. Add noodles and cook until tender
3. Brown and crumble hamburger
4. Add hamburger to noodles and soup
5. Add cheese and let melt
6. Bake in greased casserole for 30 min at 350

title: mustardy pheasant breasts
steps:
1. Place breasts on foil and dot with 1 oz of butter
2. Season with salt and pepper and wrap well
3. Bake at 400f / 200c for about 15-20 minutes
4. Meanwhile make the sauce by melting remaining butter in a bowl sitting in boiling water
5. Stir in the mustard and then the vinegars
6. Cook for 8 minutes and then add the cream and season with salt and pepper
7. Place breasts in a warm serving dish and pour over the sauce
8. Sprinkle with cayenne pepper
9. Serve with rice or couscous maybe

title: penne with shrimp  asparagus  and parmesan
steps:
1. Cut the asparagus on the diagonal into 1" pieces
2. Discard the woody end
3. Bring a large salted pot of water to a boil
4. Cook the penne according to package directions
5. Drain and keep warm in the pot
6. While the penne is cooking , heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-low heat
7. Add the garlic
8. Cook until it begins to turn golden
9. Add the diced tomatoes in their juice and the broth and bring to a boil
10. Reduce the heat and simmer , uncovered , 10 minutes
11. Add the asparagus
12. Cover and simmer until tender , about 10 minutes longer
13. Add the cooked shrimp and simmer 2 - 3 minutes until warm
14. Pour the mixture over the penne
15. Add the basil and parmesan cheese and toss to coat

title: chicken breasts supreme
steps:
1. Season the chicken with the salt and pepper , and paprika
2. In large skillet melt the butter and brown the chicken
3. Place chicken in baking dish
4. In a saucepan combine the mushroom soup , mushrooms , milk , cheese , onion , and worcestershire sauce
5. Cook over low heat until the cheese melts
6. Remove from the heat and stir in the sour cream , blending well
7. Pour over the chicken and cover tightly with foil
8. Bake in a 350 dregee oven for 45 minutes
9. Uncover and bake 30 minutes more , basting occasionally with the sauce
10. Serve with rice , using the sauce as a gravy

title: spicy chicken jambalaya
steps:
1. Brown cubed chicken in heated oil over medium heat in skillet for ten minutes
2. Add sausage links and cook until browned
3. Remove meat , set inside a dutch oven
4. Place peppers , onions , zucchini , squash , garlic powder , crushed red pepper , chili powder and creole seasoning in same skillet until tender
5. Add pepper mix to meat
6. Add rice , broth and stewed tomatoes
7. Bring to a boil , simmer on medium heat for 30 minutes
8. Serve with fresh lime wedges on the side , if desired

title: creamy tarragon chicken with celeriac mash
steps:
1. Method for chicken
2. Heat a small amount of oil in a large fry pan add onion , garlic and celery cook until soft
3. Add water , wine , stock powder and lemon juice stir until heated
4. Mix a little water with the cornflour and add stir until mixture thickens
5. I add the cornflour at this point , before the cream , so the cream does not curdle from all the acidity of the lemon juice and wine
6. So the mixture will be quite thick , this is fine as it balances out when the cream is added
7. Add both creams and dijon stir to combine
8. Boil or microwave chopped carrot until tender
9. Add spinach to cream mixture and stir until soft , add the carrots and the tarragon and stir until heated through
10. Serve immediately
11. For the chicken breasts heat an oiled pan add chicken and cook until browned on both sides and cooked through
12. This can be cooking while your making the tarragon sauce so everything is ready to go at the same time
13. For the celeriac mash
14. Peel and chop celeriac into cubes place in a saucepan covered with water , add some lemon juice to the water this helps to stop the browning of the vegetable
15. Cook until tender and drain
16. Place celeriac in a large bowl add butter , chicken stock and cream blend until smooth with no lumps
17. Add parmesan in 2 lots blending as you add
18. If the cheese doesn't melt all the way through you can finish off in the microwave
19. Cream can be adjusted if the mixture seems a little thick just add a touch more cream
20. The end result should have a smooth creamy consistency that similar to creamy mash potato
21. To serve place a few spoonfuls of the creamy vegetable , tarragon mixture onto a plate , place chicken on top , pour a little more sauce over the top and sprinkle with parmesan cheese
22. Place mash to the side , i like to pipe my mash out of a bag with a nice piping head in three small mounds , not necessary it just looks nicer
23. For a photo visit

title: merry mountain trail mix
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees farenheit
2. Combine all ingredients except condensed milk in a large bowl
3. Pour the milk over the mixture , stirring until well coated
4. Spread the mix out on a shallow baking pan and bake 45-50 minutes or until the mix is golden brown and has begun drying , stirring every 10 minutes
5. Remove the pan from the oven and transfer the mix onto aluminum foil to cool
6. Break the mix up into pieces and store in an airtight container in the fridge

title: peanut butter temptations
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large bowl , combine butter , peanut butter , sugars , egg and vanilla
3. Stir in flour , baking soda , and salt until blended
4. Roll dough into 1 inch balls
5. Press each ball into 1-1 / 2 inch miniature muffin tins until slightly flattened
6. Bake 10 to 12 minutes until set
7. Remove from oven and immediately press one miniature peanut butter cup into each cookie
8. Allow to cool and remove from muffin tin

title: berry patch brownie pizza
steps:
1. Prepare brownies according to package directions for fudge-like brownies , adding almonds and extract
2. Spread into a greased 14 inch pizza pan
3. Bake at 375 degrees for 15 to 18 minutes until toothpick inserted new center comes out clean
4. Cool on a wire rack
5. In a large mixing bowl , beat the cream cheese , sugar , vanilla and lemon peel until smooth
6. Fold in whipped topping
7. Spread over crust to within 1 / 2 inch of edges
8. Top with berries
9. Refridgerate for 2-3 hours before serving

title: spicy oriental orzo
steps:
1. Boil orzo pasta in salted water until just done
2. Drain , rinse , and toss with remaining ingredients in bowl
3. Serve at room temperature or cold

title: e z roast chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Remove giblets / neck from chicken cavities
3. Rinse chicken and pat dry
4. Rub softened butter all over chicken
5. Sprinkle outside of chicken with salt and pepper
6. Sprinkle 1 / 4 tsp salt and 1 / 2 tsp of sage inside the chicken
7. Place onion inside chicken
8. Place chicken in roasting pan breast side up
9. Add 1 / 2 cup water to pan
10. Loosely tent breast with aluminum foil
11. Cook for 25 minutes per pound
12. Remove chicken to a warm platter and let rest for 15 min to distribute the juices

title: healthy apple energy loaf
steps:
1. In a small saucepan heat the dates , honey , bicarbonate soda , apple juice and the reserved apple juice
2. Bring to the boil whilst stirring then allow to simmer for 2-3 minutes
3. Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly
4. In a large mixing bowl mix togther the apple , walnuts , flour and baking powder
5. Make a little well in the centre and pour in the contents of the saucepan
6. Mix well until all combined
7. Pour the mixture into a lined 14 x 21 loaf tin and bake in a moderate oven for 40 minutes , or until the centre is cooked
8. Allow to cool before cutting into slices

title: and the beet goes on
steps:
1. Wash and trim vegetables
2. Juice carrots and celery first , then juice beet
3. Stir and drink ! enjoy !

title: crab shrimp mold
steps:
1. Heat soup until hot , not boiling
2. Add cream cheese , stir until blended
3. Dissolve gelatin in 3 tbsp hot water
4. Combine gelatin with soup mix
5. Add remaining ingredients
6. Pour into oiled mold
7. Refrigerate overnight
8. Serve with fresh bagels cut into wedges

title: mocha dark chocolate cake with cappuccino frosting
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease one 9x13 or two 9" round cake pans
3. Cake: combine the flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda , salt , and cocoa
4. Add the molasses , mayonnaise , and vegetable oil
5. Mix well
6. While mixing , pour in the hot coffee
7. Add the vanilla and chocolate chips , stir until combined
8. Batter will be thinner than normal cake batters
9. Pour the batter into the pan
10. Bake for the 35 minutes , or until a toothpick comes out clean
11. 9x13 pans usually need to go for a few more minutes
12. If you are layering the round cakes , cool them for ten minutes on a wire rack , run a knife gently around the edges , flip pans over , rest for 10 minutes , then remove cakes from pans
13. Don't worry if they break apart a little bit
14. You can "glue" them back together with glaze and frosting !
15. Allow cakes to cool completely , even overnight , before glazing / frosting
16. Espresso / coffee glaze:
17. In a saucepan over medium heat , combine sugar and coffee / espresso
18. Stir until sugar is dissolved
19. Allow to cool to body temperature or lower
20. Cappuccino frosting
21. Combine dry ingredients in a medium bowl
22. Combine butter and shortening in a seperate , large bowl or mixer
23. Beat until fluffy
24. Add vanilla to the butter / shortening mixture
25. To the butter mixture , add half of the dry ingredients , beat , then half of the espresso / coffee , beat some more , then the other half of the dry ingredients , beat again
26. Add the remaining coffee slowly , only until desired consistency is reached
27. For a frosted layer cake , you want it to be a bit thick , but still smooth and fluffy
28. Assembly:
29. Set up desired cake board with one of the round cakes
30. Brush the ckae entirely with the semi-cool coffee glaze
31. Allow the glaze about 5 minutes to set
32. Spread a generous layer of frosting on top and place the second cake
33. Glaze the second cake
34. If you have any leftover glaze , just keep brushing it on
35. Frost the sides and top of the cake with remaining frosting
36. Store cake in the refrigerator until you need it , as that will set the frosting properly
37. Because of the shortening , it will sit out well in normal temperatures , once it's been chilled
38. Enjoy !

title: cream puffs
steps:
1. Add shortening and salt to boiling water , stir over medium heat until mixture boils again
2. Lower heat add flour all at once and stir vigorously until mixture leaves the sides of the pan
3. Remove from heat add 1 egg at a time beating in vigorously after each addition
4. Drop by tablespoonful onto ungreased baking pan
5. Bake 450'degrees f for 20 minutes reduce temperature to 350' degrees f
6. Bake about 20 minutes longer
7. Remove and place on rack to cool
8. Pastry cream: place all ingredients in a saucepan
9. Over medium high beat , bring to a boil stirring constantly until thick
10. Allow to cool completely
11. Stirring often to keep skin from forming
12. Cut top off cream puff and fill and refrigerate

title: awesome breaded turkey cutlets
steps:
1. Season turkey with salt and pepper
2. Mix eggs in a shallow dish
3. Place bread crumbs in another shallow dish
4. Dip both sides of turkey in egg and then into crumbs
5. Heat 2 tablespoons oil and 2 tablespoons butter in a large skillet over medium high heat
6. Add slices , not crowding , and cook until golden brown on bottom , about 3-5 minutes
7. Turn and cook other side until golden , about 2 minutes
8. Remove to plate and repeat with remaining slices , adding more butter and oil as needed
9. Serve with lemon

title: quesadillas breakfast style
steps:
1. Lay out 6 tortillas on 2 cookie sheets
2. Evenly distribute the scrambled eggs , then sausage , the fried onion / pepper mixture , cheese and top with remaining tortillas
3. Bake in a hot oven-450 is good , for 5 minutes-you want the tortillas crisp and the cheese all melty
4. Remove and plate up with salsa , sour cream and cilantro

title: perfect sunday breakfast
steps:
1. Put the bacon in one frying pan and fry until cooked to your liking
2. If you are using canadian bacon , you may need to add a little oil but otherwise render the fat out of the bacon
3. Meanwhile , make the pancakes
4. Put the flour , baking powder and sugar into a bowl
5. Make a well in the centre and add one of the eggs
6. Pour in 1 / 4 a cup of milk and beat the egg into the milk , incorporating some of the flour as you stir
7. Add another 1 / 4 cup of milk and stir the rest of the flour , beating well to make a smooth batter
8. Add the last tablespoon of milk if needed to make the batter the consistency of thick cream
9. Add a little butter to the other frying pan and add large spoonfuls of the batter to make small pancakes
10. When bubbles appear on the surface , flip over and cook the other side
11. Repeat with the rest of the batter
12. Makes about 16 pancakes
13. When the bacon is cooked , remove and keep warm
14. Drain off most of the fat from the frying pan and add the sliced mushrooms
15. All the bits in the pan will add good flavour to the mushrooms
16. When you have made all the pancakes , add the oil to that pan
17. Break the eggs into the pan
18. Add the hot water and put a lid on the pan
19. This creates a steamy atmosphere in the pan and you end up with steamed fried eggs with runny yolks
20. Serve with maple syrup on the side and a big pot of tea or coffee
21. I prefer maple syrup on my pancakes after i've eaten my bacon and eggs but my daughter eats it all together

title: strawberry omelet with sour cream
steps:
1. Add cream and salt to eggs and beat with a fork 30 seconds
2. Heat butter in medium to large sized skillet until it sizzles
3. Pour in eggs , stir once or twice with fork
4. Lift edges as eggs begin to cook and let liquid part run underneath , shaking pan back and forth to keep omelet moving free
5. When cooked but still soft on top , put 1 / 8 cup sour cream and 1 / 4 cup berries along the left side of the pan
6. Slide / pour omelet onto serving plate off the left side of the pan
7. As carefully place the portion of the omelet with the berries on it on the plate , fold the right side of the omelet over the top of the berry side ,
8. Pour remaining sour cream and berries on top
9. Sprinkle lightly with powdered sugar
10. Place under hot broiler for about 10-20 seconds
11. Serve immediately

title: bulgur pilaf with tomato and zucchini
steps:
1. Rinse bulgur thoroughly in colander under cold water removing any debris
2. Set aside
3. Heat oil in large saucepan over medium heat
4. Add onion and garlic
5. Saute 3 minutes or until onion is tender
6. Stir in zucchini and tomatoes , reduce heat to medium-low
7. Cook , covered 15 minutes or until zucchini is almost tender , stirring occasionally
8. Stir chicken broth , bulgur , basil and pepper into veggie mixture
9. Bring to a boil over high heat
10. Recude heat to low
11. Cook , covered over low heat 15 minutes or until bulgur is tender and liquid is almost completely absorbed , stirring occasionally
12. Remove from heat , let stand covered for 10 minutes

title: calzones provencal
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Place beans , garlic , lemon juice , salt , fennel seeds , rosemary , pepper and olive oil in a food processor and process until smooth
3. Transfer to a bowl
4. Grease or spray 1 large or 2 small cookie sheets
5. Unroll pizza dough on a lightly floured work surface and press each into a 12 inch square
6. Cut each into 4 , 6-inch squares
7. Combine spinach , provolone and olives
8. Spread bean mixture over half of each dough square , dividing evenly , and then top with spinach mixture
9. Fold other half of dough over filling , stretching slightly to fit
10. Press edges with fork to seal well
11. Cut a slit in top of each and place on cookie sheet
12. Bake until golden brown , 10 to 15 minutes

title: francis ray hot buttery sweet milk toast
steps:
1. Please read all the way through first:
2. The first step is to have a serving bowl that will contain the majority of the 1 3 / 4th cup of milk and only be approximately 3 / 4th full or close to that quantity / consequently , i usually pour enough milk into my serving bowl to fill it 3 / 4th full and use that amount of milk to boil
3. Then pour that amount of milk into a small pan and place on stove and turn heat to high at first and adjust as you go but we need milk to boil
4. Add 1 tsp of butter into the stove pan of milk immediately
5. Add 1 / 4 tsp of salt to the stove pan of milk and stir
6. Add 2 tbsp of sugar , stir until dissolved
7. Have the last tbsp available for preference at end
8. You should understand that the milk will scorch if you don't stir when it gets close to boiling
9. Toast the three slices of white bread to the darker setting without burning
10. If toast becomes burnt , replace and try again / it's very important to get this part exactly right , the toast must be darker than regular breakfast toast but never burnt-- but very close / it must still look and taste good at this finished point / if you hate darker toast then don't toast it this dark but as far as you can take it , is best
11. Add another 1 tsp of butter to your not yet boiling milk while continuing to stir slowly /
12. Butter the toasted bread lightly but into all area's of the darkened but not burnt toast / if you like pepper , add just a small touch on each slice or leave off
13. Lightly salt the buttered toast on the buttered side into all area's of the toast & this is necessary
14. Bring milk to a boil where it will rise in the pan and require your blowing it down / this is normal and will happen at a flash point , be ready to take milk off of heat / then pour into your serving bowl where you will still have about 1 / 4th of it still free or unfilled / taste to test if more sugar is needed
15. Pull apart your toast by hand and drop 'gently' into the top of your served hot milk without forcing it down to much
16. What your striving for is an even mixture of milk and toast / you don't want to much toast that it dries up the hot milk and you do want a bit more milk than toast
17. Lastly , you must again lightly salt your bowl of hot milk and toast
18. It takes less than a 40 seconds to cool down but do eat while hot / you should be tasting a hot buttery sweet milk of nicely salted bread that draws you back each time / adjust salt , sugar and butter to taste
19. Again , the boiling milk will froth and rise quickly , be ready and have a hot pan holder ready to pick up pan and blow down the rising froth , it means , it's ready

title: apple pies for the freezer
steps:
1. Make the crust recipe in 2 separate bowls
2. Using an electric mixer , mix first three ingredients until the texture resembles course meal
3. Beat one egg in a 1 cup measuring cup
4. Fill cup with water to make 1 full cup
5. Add to flour mixture
6. Mix well , chill for 15 minutes
7. For each batch , divide dough 5 ways
8. Roll out 5 crusts on a floured surface
9. Place bottom crusts in 5 pie tins
10. Filling: add apples , sugar , cinnamon nutmeg
11. Roll out 5 more crusts on floured surface
12. Top pies with crusts
13. Crimp to seal
14. Place in ziplock bags
15. Seal and freeze
16. To bake: place frozen pie on a baking sheet in a 350 degree f preheated oven
17. Bake 1 hour

title: cauliflower with lime and hot pepper vinaigrette
steps:
1. Blanch the cauliflower in the boiling water and then plunge into ice cold water to stop the cooking process , then drain well
2. Heat the lime juice , vinegar and red pepper flakes over low heat for just a few minutes , to soften the pepper flakes
3. Don't boil it
4. Pour lime juice mixture over the cauliflower then add the garlic , cumin and cilantro and toss well
5. Let marinate in fridge or at room temp for 1 hour before serving

title: mandarin orange chicken stir fry
steps:
1. Cut the chicken breasts into 1-inch cubes
2. Marinate the chicken and veggies overnight in the teriyaki marinade , soy sauce and the juice from the can of oranges
3. Saut the chicken and veggies in the marinade in a wok
4. Add the oranges at the end

title: t dawg turkey chili
steps:
1. Add oil to large pot and saut onion and garlic on medium-low
2. Once translucent add ground turkey , cured turkey or breast meat and 1 tbsp of chili powder
3. Saut until ground turkey is almost fully cooked
4. Add chicken stock , beans , chilies and another tbsp of chili seasoning and cook for 15 minutes on medium high
5. Add stewed tomatoes , tomato paste , tomato sauce , diced tomatoes and last of chili seasoning
6. Bring to slow boil and then simmer uncovered on low for 45 minutes stirring occasionally
7. Add cilantro , cook for additional 5 minutes and serve hot !

title: orange julius with  the secret ingredient
steps:
1. Add ice and water to blender and turn on high for a few seconds
2. Add orange sections about 5 at a time , blending a little as you go
3. Add the other ingredients in whatever order and blend until smooth
4. Taste
5. Add more creamer or sugar if necessary
6. I use small to medium size seedless , sweet oranges

title: salad
steps:
1. Rinse lettuce and dry
2. Chop into bite size pieces , put into large serving bowl
3. Chop tomato , peel and chop cucmber into bite size pieces
4. Toss together
5. Top with sunflowers seeds and croutons
6. Serve with meals topped with your favorite dressing

title: hill country potato salad
steps:
1. Cook potatoes , in boiling water and 1 teaspoon salt , until tender , about 35 minutes
2. Drain potatoes , then peel and dice or partially mash
3. Fry bacon in a skillet until crisp
4. Add onions and saute until softened , but not browned
5. In a bowl , combine cornstarch or flour , sugar , 1 teaspoon salt and pepper
6. Stir in the vinegar and water until smooth
7. Add mixture to bacon and simmer and stir until thickened
8. Pour the hot dressing over the potatoes and add 1 / 4 cup minced onion , parsley , celery seeds , and radishes
9. Lightly toss
10. Garnish with celery leaves

title: my very favorite pizza dough
steps:
1. Mix yeast and sugar and dissolve in warm water
2. Let stand for about 5 minutes
3. Add in salt , oil and oat bran , if desired
4. Mix in 4 1 / 2 cups of flour
5. Then continue to add additional flour and knead until dough is smooth and elastic
6. Place into a greased bowl , turning once , cover and allow to rise until dough is doubled in bulk
7. Prepare 2 large pizza pans by coating them with cooking spray and sprinkling lightly with cornmeal
8. Punch down and roll dough to fit 2 large pizza pans
9. Top as desired
10. For a crust that is crispy on the bottom , place pizza on the bottom rack in a cold oven , set the oven for 500 and bake for about 20 minutes or if the oven is already hot , bake at 500 for 10-15 minutes

title: potatoes anna
steps:
1. Heat a greased 10-inch cast-iron skillet in a 350 degree fahrenheit oven 8 minutes or until hot
2. Arrange one-third of potato slices in skillet , and drizzle with one-third of butter
3. Sprinkle with 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper
4. Repeat layering procedure twice with remaining ingredients
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour
6. Increase heat to 500 degrees , and bake 5 to 10 minutes more or until browned
7. Invert onto a serving plate
8. Garnish , if desired

title: grilled jalapeno peppers
steps:
1. Wash peppers and remove stems
2. Cut a slit along one side of each pepper
3. Remove seeds
4. Rinse and dry peppers
5. In a skillet , cook sausage over medium heat until no longer pink
6. Drain
7. Stuff peppers with sausage and wrap with bacon
8. Secure with a toothpick
9. Grill peppers , uncovered , over medium heat for about 15 minutes or until tender and bacon is crisp , turning frequently

title: zesty italian dressing spice mix
steps:
1. In a small bowl , whisk together the garlic salt , onion powder , sugar , oregano , pepper , thyme , basil , parsley , celery salt , and cajun seasoning
2. Store the spice mix in a tightly sealed container , and use as needed
3. To make dressing , whisk together the vinegar , oil , water and 2 tbls
4. Of the spice mix
5. Enjoy !

title: green tea panna cotta
steps:
1. Add green tea , milk , cream and sugar in a pan and heat slowly till sugar is completely dissolved and the mixture is about to boil
2. Remove from the heat and allow the mixture to"brew" for 10 minutes
3. Strain the infusion back into a clean pan
4. Soak the gelatine in 3 tablespoons of warm water until it is spongy
5. Whisk into the cream mixture and heat gently until the gelatine has dissolved
6. Pour into 4 lightly greased 150ml moulds or chinese teacups
7. Refrigerate till they are set
8. Serve them in the pretty teacups when ready , or turn them out onto individual plates

title: chocolate drizzled shortbread
steps:
1. In small mixing bowl cream butter and confectioners sugar
2. Beat in vanilla
3. Mix well
4. Combine flour and salt
5. Gradually add to creamed mixture and mix well
6. Shape into 1-in balls
7. Place 2- in apart on ungreased baking sheet
8. Flatten slightly with glass dipped in sugar
9. Bake at 350 for 10-12 minutes or until edges are lightly golden brown
10. Immediately remove to wire racks to cool
11. For drizzle , in a heavy saucepan or microwave , melt the chips and shortening , stir until smooth
12. Remove from heat and drizzle over cookies

title: koomis  fermented horse milk from kazakhstan
steps:
1. Pour milk into a goat-skin bag
2. Add horse fat and fermenting agent
3. Leave in at room temperature , stirring once a day , for six weeks
4. Serve chilled
5. Better yet , don't serve it

title: diet orange freeze
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in blender
2. Process until smooth

title: taste of summer sandwiches
steps:
1. Orange ginger marinade: in bowl , whisk together orange rind and juice , green onions , garlic , ginger , soy sauce and salt
2. Add chicken breasts
3. Turn to coat
4. Let stand for 10 minutes or cover and refrigerate for up to 8 hours
5. Place chicken on greased grill over medium heat
6. Spoon any remaining marinade over chicken
7. Close lid and grill , turning once , until no longer pink inside , about 10 minutes
8. Cut buns in half
9. Spread cut sides with mayonnaise
10. Sandwich lettuce , chicken , sweet pepper , red onion and green onion in buns

title: philly cheesesteak casserole  low carb
steps:
1. Saute mushrooms in olive oil until softened and light brown , about 5 minutes
2. Add to crockpot along with the rest of the ingredients , except the provolone
3. Cook on low for 6 hours
4. Stir well , add to 6 bowls
5. Cover with provolone and add some cooking juices to each bowl to melt the cheese

title: real mexican cajeta  goat s milk caramel or dulce de leche
steps:
1. In a large , heavy pot , combine the milk , sugar , and vanilla , and place over medium heat
2. Stir regularly until the milk comes to a simmer and sugar is dissolved
3. Remove the pot from the heat and add dissolved baking soda
4. It will bubble up at this point , especially with goat's milk
5. When the bubbles have subsided , return it to the heat
6. Adjust heat so that the mixture is simmering briskly but not boiling
7. Cook , stirring regularly , until the mixture turns pale golden , about one hour
8. You will now need to stir the milk more regularly as it begins to thicken and turns a caramel-brown color
9. Don't allow the milk to stick to the bottom of the pot
10. You can drop a few drops into a small glass of water
11. If a soft ball forms , the cajeta is ready
12. If you take the pot off the heat and allow the cajeta to cool , it should be a medium-thick sauce
13. If it's too thick , add hot water , 1 tablespoon at a time until it is the proper consistency
14. If it is too thin , return to the heat until it thickens
15. When the cajeta is cool , remove the vanilla bean
16. Strain the cajeta through a fine mesh strainer into a bowl or wide-mouthed jar , then scrape the seeds from the vanilla bean into the cajeta
17. Refrigerate until ready to use
18. Cajeta is best served warm

title: twice  baked potatoes
steps:
1. Cut potatoes in half lengthwise and scoop potato out of the skins and into a bowl
2. Add remaining ingredients to bowl and beat until fluffy
3. Bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes

title: onion bhaji
steps:
1. Peel the onions and slice them so they form rings
2. Slices should be as thin as possible
3. Cut the rings to form strands about 1-2" long
4. Put onion in a large mixing bowl , add spices and salt and mix thoroughlly
5. Put about half of the vinegar in and gradually stir in the flour until it is possible to form 1 1 / 2 to 2" balls with the mixture
6. Use flour and remaining vinegar to adjust consistency
7. Heat the oil in a suitable deep fryer or pan
8. Heat to 350f
9. Form the onion / flour mixture into 1 1 / 2 to 2" balls and carefully place them in the oil using a metal spoon or suitable tool
10. Only fry enough at one time such that they don't stick to eachother
11. Fry to dark golden brown
12. Remove cooked bhajis from oil and drain as with other fried foods
13. Serve on absorbent towel to soak up excess oil

title: new zealand lolly log cake
steps:
1. Melt butter , stir in condensed milk , cool
2. Stir in fruit puffs and crushed biscuits
3. Shape into log and cover with coconut
4. Refrigerate

title: italian hot   spicy oven fried chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Combine 1 packet of the shake and bake seasoning , cajun seasoning and rotisserie seasoning in a bag or shallow dish
3. Put italian dressing in shallow bowl
4. Dip chicken into dressing , then shake in bag with seasoning mixes
5. Bake for about 20 to 25 minutes

title: parsnips with almonds
steps:
1. Cook parsnips in boiling salted water until almost tender
2. Drain well
3. When they are cool enough to handle , cut each one in half across its width , then quarter these halves lengthways
4. Heat butter in a frying pan and cook the parsnips and almonds gently , stirring and turning carefully until they are lightly flecked with brown
5. Mix together the sugar and spice , sprinkle over the parsnips and stir to mix , then trickle over the lemon juice
6. Season to taste with salt and pepper and heat for 1 minute
7. Serve sprinkled with chopped parsley

title: mexican style lime and cilantro whole chicken  slow cooker
steps:
1. Wash and dry the chicken
2. Reserve the giblets and neck for another use
3. Season the chicken inside and out with salt and pepper
4. Place in the slow cooker breast side up
5. Squeeze the juice of the lime over the chicken
6. Put the remains of the lime , cilantro and garlic inside the cavity
7. Cover and cook on the low setting for 6-7 hours or until an instant read thermometer reads 180 degrees fahrenheit in the thickest part of the thigh
8. Transfer the chicken to a platter
9. Pour the liquid from the cooker into a separate container and refrigerate for another use

title: crema catalana  catalan burnt cream
steps:
1. Place the milk , scraped vanilla bean , cinnamon stick and lemon and orange zests in a saucepan and bring to the boil
2. Simmer for 5 minutes , then strain and set aside
3. Whisk the egg yolds with the caster sugar in a bowl for about 5 minutes , until pale and creamy
4. Add the cornflour and mix well
5. Slowly add the warm milk mixture to the egg and whisk continuously
6. Return to the saucepan and cook over low to medium heat , stirring constantly , for 5-10 minutes , or until the mixture is thick and creamy
7. Do not boil as it will curdle
8. Pour into six 1 cup ramekins and refrigerate for 6 hours or overnight
9. When ready to serve , sprinkle evenly with brown sugar and grill for 3 minutes or until it caramelises

title: smoked sausage and potatoes
steps:
1. Cut potatoes into chunks and leave the skin on
2. Cut peppers into strips
3. Toss potatoes , peppers , garlic , rosemary and olive oil together and place in a microwave safe bowl
4. Cover and microwave on high 5 minutes , stir , re-cover , then microwave 5 more minutes on high
5. Add cut up sausage and microwave for another 5 minutes
6. Check potatoes for doneness and sprinkle with parmesan cheese if you'd like
7. Serve

title: new england spice cake
steps:
1. Butter two 9" round cake pans and line with parchment paper or waxed paper
2. Preheat oven to 350f
3. Sift dry ingredients together
4. Cream butter and sugar thoroughly and add eggs one at a time , beating well after each addition
5. Blend in molasses and add the sifted ingredients alternately with the milk
6. Beat well
7. Pour into prepared cake pans and bake for about 25 minutes or until cakes test done

title: zucchini base aka z b for cakes  cookies    pie
steps:
1. Prepare hot , sterilized jars for canning: either 6 pints or 3 quarts
2. Set aside
3. Over medium heat in a large pot combine all ingredients
4. Bring to a bubbling boil , stirring occasionally , and skim off foam
5. Continue to cook , stirring occasionally , for 20 minutes more
6. Pour immediately into prepared hot sterile jars and seal
7. The recipezaar page for the lunch cake , cookies , and pie is at:

title: tuppakaka
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Grease cake pan and coat with breadcrumbs
3. Mix wet ingredients
4. Slowly fold in all dry ingredients except for almonds
5. Pour batter into pan and sprinkle with almonds on top
6. Bake for about 25 minutes
7. Allow to cool completely on a wire rack
8. You can make a simple sugar syrup glaze to coat the top if you desire

title: pear bars with pear sauce
steps:
1. Combine flour , sugar , baking powder , cinnamon , soda , salt , and cloves
2. Mix well
3. Stir in eggs , oil , and pear sauce till well mixed
4. Spread batter in sprayed 9 by 13
5. Bake at 350 for 25-30 minutes or till center tests clean
6. Sprinkle with powdered sugar , cut into bars and serve with ice cream or whipped cream and extra pear sauce
7. For pear sauce:
8. Mix all ingredients together in a sauce pan over medium heat
9. Bring to a boil
10. Cook for 10-15 minutes till pears are tender
11. Puree in blender

title: easy peach sorbet   sugar free
steps:
1. Instructions: place unopened can of peaches in freezer until solid
2. Submerge unopened frozen can in very hot tap water for 1 minute
3. Open bottom side of can with can opener
4. Pour any thawed syrup into food processor bowl
5. Remove fruit from can
6. Carefully cut into 10 chunks
7. Place into food processor with sweetener , lemon juice , vanilla extract and almond extract
8. Process until smooth , scraping blade as needed
9. Serve immediately or freeze until ready to serve
10. Garnish with fresh mint , if desired

title: tennessee banana black walnut cake with caramel frosting
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease and flour 2 cake pans
3. For the cake: in a medium bowl , stir together flour and baking soda
4. Set aside
5. Using an electric mixer , cream together shortening and sugar in a bowl until light and fluffy , about 2 to 3 minutes
6. Add eggs 1 at a time , mixing well after each addition
7. Mix in mashed bananas , buttermilk , and vanilla
8. Add flour mixture and mix until just combined
9. Stir in walnuts
10. Pour into prepared pans , bake until a toothpick inserted comes out clean , about 35 minutes
11. Cool in pans on a cooling rack , remove from pans and cool completely
12. While cake is baking , prepare frosting
13. Melt butter in a small saucepan
14. Add brown sugar and 1 / 3 cup cream
15. Cook over medium-low heat until sugar is dissolved , about 2 minutes
16. Remove from heat and add vanilla
17. Transfer to a large bowl
18. Using a hand mixer , beat in confectioners sugar a little at a time until smooth
19. Sandwich 2 layers of cake with frosting
20. Frost outside of the cake
21. Press chopped walnuts on sides of cake , if desired

title: italian tuna panini
steps:
1. In bowl , mix together tuna , red pepper , celery , green onions , artichokes pepper , mayonnaise , plain yogurt salt and pepper
2. Cut buns in half horizontally
3. Spread tuna mixture evenly over bottom half of each
4. Sprinkle each evenly with cheese
5. Replace bun top
6. In nonstick skillet or grill pan or on grill , cook sandwiches over medium heat , pressing often to flatten and turning once , for about 5 minutes or until crusty and cheese is melted
7. Makes 4 servings

title: goat cheese  lemon  and chive turnovers
steps:
1. Position rack in the center of the oven and heat to 400 degrees
2. In a medium bowl , mash goat cheese with a fork
3. Add chives , onion , lemon zest , 1 / 2 teaspoons kosher salt , and 1 / 4 teaspoons pepper
4. Stir until well combined
5. On a lightly floured surface , unfold the pastry sheet and lightly dust with flour
6. Use a rolling pin to roll the sheet into a 12" square
7. Cut the dough into 9 squares
8. Put equal of the filling onto the center of each square moisten the edges of a square with a finger
9. Fold the dough over to form a triangle , gently pressing to remove air pockets around the filling and pressing the edges of the dough together
10. Use the tines of a fork to crump and seal the edges of the turnover
11. , repeat this process with the other dough squares
12. Arrange the turnovers on a cookie sheet and bake until the turnovers are puffed and golden all over
13. Let them cool on a rack for a few minutes and serve warm
14. May be filled and shaped up to 2 hours ahead
15. Cover tightly with plastic wrap or brush with melted butter before refrigerating

title: potato rolled tacos
steps:
1. Chop jalapeo peppers finely
2. Chop cilantro
3. Boil potatoes till easy to mash but still a little firm
4. Mash potatoes and add jalapeos , taco seasoning , cilantro and cheese together
5. Prepare tortillas by fast steaming so they are easy to roll
6. I usually boil water in a small pot a little smaller than the tortilla's then place a double paper towel on top and place one tortilla at a time for 2 or 3 seconds till steamed , then remove and replace as you go
7. Take a steamed tortilla and spoon about 1 tablespoon of potato mixture in and roll gently
8. Place in baking dish with the rolled side down
9. Continue doing this lining them up in dish as you go
10. Place in freezer for 15 minutes or until they become slightly stiff
11. I like this method better than toothpicks
12. Heat oil on medium heat
13. When oil is ready , place 4 tacos at a time with the rolled side down in pan
14. Flip to other side when brown
15. Remove and drain on paper towels
16. Garnish as desired
17. I use sour cream mixed with taco sauce drizzled over the top

title: curried chicken wraps a la barefoot contessa   ina garten
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Place the chicken breasts on a sheet pan and rub the skin with olive oil
3. Sprinkle liberally with salt and pepper
4. Roast for 35 to 40 minutes , until the chicken is just cooked
5. Set aside until cool enough to handle
6. Remove the meat from the bones , discard the skin , and shred the chicken in pieces
7. For the dressing , combine the mayonnaise , wine , chutney , curry powder , and 1 1 / 2 teaspoons salt in the bowl of a food processor fitted with the steel blade
8. Process until smooth
9. Combine the chicken with enough dressing to moisten well
10. Add the celery , scallions , and raisins , and mix well
11. Refrigerate for a few hours to allow the flavors to blend
12. Add the cashews to the chicken
13. Fill the center of each tortilla with the chicken mixture
14. Fold the 2 sides of the tortilla over the filling so that the sides overlap
15. Roll the tortilla from bottom to top , and cut in half diagonally
16. Enjoy !

title: salmon fillets with orange basil butter
steps:
1. Heat gas grill on medium-high or charcoal grill until coals are ash white
2. Combine butter , orange juice , basil and orange peel in small bowl
3. Reserve 2 tablespoons butter mixture
4. Brush remaining butter mixture onto fish
5. Sprinkle with garlic pepper
6. Place fish onto grill
7. Grill , turning once , until fish reaches at least 145 or edges flake easily with fork
8. To serve , drizzle fish with reserved butter mixture
9. Sprinkle with almonds and basil leaves if desired

title: green chile and chicken enchilada casserole
steps:
1. Microwave chicken until cooked through and shred
2. Combine green chile enchilada sauce , diced green chiles , soup , yogurt , coriander , garlic powder and salt and pepper to taste for gravy
3. Roast tortillas over open flame to prevent tortillas from going to mush
4. Layer gravy , tortilla , chicken and cheese
5. Finish with tortillas , gravy and cheese on top
6. Bake at 375f for 45 minutes covered with foil
7. Uncover for the last 10 minute
8. Enjoy and feel free to change to your liking !

title: rainbow garlic soup
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a large pot
2. Saute tomatoes , onion , and garlic about 10 minutes
3. Add flour and mix in well
4. Add the broth and bring to a boil , stirring occassionally
5. Add carrots , potatoes , and red pepper flakes
6. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes
7. Add zucchini and squash
8. Simmer 10 minutes
9. Add pepper and salt to taste
10. Puree in blender or with a hand blender
11. Adjust seasonings and serve

title: soy and ginger fish
steps:
1. Heat the oils in a skillet over med-high heat
2. Add ginger and chillies and cook for 2 mins , until crisp
3. Add soy sauce , wine and sugar to skillet and simmer 1 min , until sauce has thickened slightly
4. Add the fish , cook in the sauce for approx 3 mins each side or until cooked
5. Serve immediately on top of steamed rice with steamed greens
6. Optional: sometimes i add some garlic too , together with the ginger and chillies

title: kathy s strawberry bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Grease and sugar two 9 x 5 loaf pans
3. Set aside
4. Beat eggs in small bowl
5. Set aside
6. Mix oil and sugar
7. Add eggs
8. Add flour , soda and salt
9. Add thawed strawberries and mix
10. Pour into loaf pans
11. Bake for 1 hour or until tests clean

title: clay pot chicken
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 180 degrees celcius
2. Dry fry the coconut in a large wok until evenly browned
3. Add the vegetable oil , shallots or onion , garlic , lemon grass , ginger , chillies and tamarind paste
4. Fry for 2 - 4 minutes to release the flavours
5. Add the chicken pieces to the wok and brown evenly with the spices for 2 - 3 minutes
6. Strain the coconut milk , and add the thin part with the chicken stock , lime leaves , if using , sugar and vinegar
7. Transfer to a glazed clay pot , cover and bake in the centre of the oven for 50 minutes or until the chicken is tender
8. Stir in the thick part of the coconut milk and return to the oven for 5-10 minutes
9. Place the tomatoes in a bowl and cover with boiling water to loosen and remove the skins
10. Halve the tomatoes , then remove the seeds and chop into large dice
11. Add the chopped tomatoes to the finished dish , sprinkle with the chopped coriander and serve
12. Plain rice is the usual accompaniment , but i normally serve with naan bread

title: easy broiled scallops
steps:
1. Preheat oven for broiling
2. Melt butter , add olive oil , lemon juice and seasonings
3. Add scallops , stir to coat
4. Place in broiler , i use a small cake pan
5. Broil for 3 to 4 minutes , stir and cook for 3 to 4 minutes more or until done
6. Depending on size of scallops , may take a little longer , mine were dime sized
7. You may sprinkle a little parmesan after you take out for a little different taste
8. Serve hot , maybe with some crusty bread for dipping

title: dante s kitchen pickled green beans
steps:
1. Combine sugar , vinegar and water in a large saucepan and bring to a boil
2. Mix all the spices and salt together
3. Pack green beans tightly into clean sterilized jars
4. Divide the spices into the jars
5. Pour boiling pickle base into jars to cover beans and spices , leaving 1 / 2 inch head space
6. Cover with lids and bands
7. Process in a boiling water bath for 20
8. Minutes
9. Adjust time according to your altitude
10. Carefully remove hot
11. Jars
12. Let cool at room temperature for a day

title: creamy  broccoli soup
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat
2. Add carrots , onion , garlic and celery
3. Add chicken broth and water
4. Bring to a boil
5. Stir in broccoli and rice and reduce heat to medium low
6. Simmer 10-15 minutes or until veggies are tender
7. Stir frequently
8. Take small batches of soup and put in a food processor or blender
9. Blend until pureed
10. Return all blended soup back to pot
11. Add salt and pepper if you're going to
12. Add milk and cheese and cook until heated through

title: south american cooked masa
steps:
1. Mix the stock and masa harina in a large bowl with a heavy wooden spoon
2. Add the melted butter and the salt , mixing well
3. Transfer the mixture to a large , heavy-bottomed saucepan , and place over medium-high heat
4. Stir constantly , bringing mixture to a low boil
5. Keep stirring for 3 to 4 minutes , or until the mixture becomes heavy and dense
6. Use for your preferred tamal recipe

title: tomato soup for the crock pot
steps:
1. Stir all ingredients together in crock pot
2. Cover and cook on low heat setting for 5 to 10 hours
3. Strain before serving

title: libbie s oatmeal coconut cookies
steps:
1. Mix ingredients together
2. Form into balls
3. Flatten balls
4. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for about 10 minutes

title: portabella mushroom panini
steps:
1. Heat large saut pan over medium-high heat
2. Drizzle olive oil over the mushroom cap
3. Season with salt and pepper
4. Slice mushroom into 1 / 4 inch strips
5. Sear slices 5 minutes , do not move them during this time
6. Flip slices over and sear for another 5 minutes
7. Meanwhile , toast the bread
8. Remove portabella slices and place , along with one slice of provolone cheese , between the sourdough bread slices
9. Place sandwich on panini press
10. Enjoy !

title: quick and easy chicken and vegetable casserole
steps:
1. In a large pot with a lid , pour in liquid , add the rice , and give it a little stir
2. Layer the frozen vegetables on top of the rice , and the raw chicken pieces on top of the vegetables
3. Sprinkle the chicken with onion powder , garlic powder , salt and pepper
4. Cover , and bring to a boil let boil for 3-5 minutes
5. Stir , then reduce to med-high heat , and cook for 10-15 minutes , or until rice is tender

title: baja fried fish tacos with spicy cabbage slaw
steps:
1. In a small bowl , mix salsa and mayonnaise
2. Set aside
3. In a dutch oven or deep skillet , heat oil over medium high heat until it reaches 375 degrees f
4. While the oil heats up , whisk beer , flour and salt in a medium bowl until smooth
5. Using a fork , coat fish pieces in batter
6. Working in 2 batches , slide coated fish into hot oil
7. Fry until golden , about 4 minutes per batch
8. Lift out with a slotted spoon and drain briefly on paper towels
9. Keep warm
10. In a dry hot skillet , warm corn tortillas individually for 1-2 minutes per side
11. Stack on top of each other and keep warm in the oven
12. To assemble , place 2 corn tortillas each on 4 individual plates
13. Put 1 / 2 cup of cabbage on each tortilla
14. Drizzle 2 tablespoons of the salsa mixture over each one
15. Evenly distribute fish pieces over the salsa and cabbage
16. Serve with lime wedges

title: edible jewelry
steps:
1. Use the licorice as your"string" and thread the other ingredients onto it
2. Use various lengths to create necklaces , bracelets , & rings
3. Wear your creations with pride , then eat them when the mood strikes

title: star anise poached pears
steps:
1. Combine sugar 2 tablespoons water , star anise , cloves , cinnamon stick and vanilla bean in a heavy large saucepan
2. Stir over low heat until sugar dissolves
3. Increase heat and boil with out stirring until syrup turns a deep amber color , occasionally brushing down the sides of the pan with a wet pastry brush and swirling pan , about 9 minutes
4. Remove from heat add 1 1 / 4 cups of water
5. Bring to a simmer , stirring until pieces of caramel dissolve
6. Add pears , cover and simmer until tender , turning pears once about 5 minutes
7. Using a slotted spoon , transfer pears to bowl
8. Boil liquid in sauce pan until thick and syrupy , about 5 minutes
9. Pour syrup over pears toss gently to coat
10. Chill until cold
11. Serve cold

title: british bacon butty  sandwich
steps:
1. Preheat the oven grill to medium-high and cook the bacon until done- crisp but not dry
2. This should take 5-10 minutes
3. Spread a thin layer of mayonnaise over one side of each slice of bread
4. Top the mayonnaise with a thin layer of ketchup
5. Place the bacon on one slice of bread and top with the other slice of bread
6. Cut in half diagonally and serve hot !
7. Nb best served with a hot cup of tea !

title: chicken cheeseburgers with lemon mayonnaise
steps:
1. Process chicken in a food processor until it is the consistency of ground beef
2. Spoon into a large bowl
3. Add egg and next 6 ingredients to ground chicken in bowl
4. Stir until blended
5. Shape chicken mixture into 8 patties
6. Chill 30 minutes until firm
7. Cook chicken patties , in batches , in a lightly greased nonstick skillet over medium high heat 5 to 7 minutes on each side or until done
8. Top each patty with a cheese slice
9. Cover and cook 1 minute until cheese melts
10. Top bottom halves of buns with tomato slices
11. Spread lemon mayonnaise evenly on tomato slices
12. Top with chicken patties and lettuce , and cover with tops of buns
13. Enjoy !
14. Lemon mayonnaise:
15. Stir together all ingredients
16. Cover and chill until ready to serve
17. Enjoy !

title: chili cheese macaroni dinner
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. In a large skillet , brown together the ground turkey and the onion in the oil
3. Then drain
4. Once you've drain the meat / onion mixture , stir in the contents of the hamburger helper box , water , kidney beans and chili powder
5. Heat to boiling only
6. Do not cook
7. Pour into a 2 quart casserole dish
8. Cover and bake in the preheated 375 oven for 35 min , stirring every 10 minute

title: the kim family korean beef recipe
steps:
1. Slice beef thinly , if using beef
2. Mix all other ingredients together in a large baggie , or sealable container
3. Marinate meat for 3-48 hours
4. If you can't marinate it too long , pierce the meat , to help the marinade permeate the meat better
5. Skewer the meat , and grill to desired doneness
6. I've also cooked it in a "grill basket , " but it has better flavor when the meat can get kind of crispy on the edges , and the skewers allow for more surface area to become crispy

title: orzo pasta with shrimp
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions until al dente
2. Drain
3. Toss with 1 / 2 teaspoon olive oil
4. Set aside
5. Heat remaining 3 tablespoons olive oil in large skillet over medium heat until hot
6. Add garlic
7. Cook and stir 2 to 3 minutes or until golden
8. Add shrimp
9. Cook and stir 3 to 5 minutes or until shrimp are opaque
10. Stir in pasta , tomatoes , cilantro , parsley and lemon juice continue to cook until all is heated through
11. Sprinkle with feta cheese
12. Season to taste and serve

title: soy balsamic ginger sauce
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients thoroughly
2. Spoon over baby bok choy or any other food that seems appealing

title: chicken with basil cream sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Place milk in a shallow bowl
3. Place the bread crumbs and garlic powder in another shallow bowl
4. Dip the chicken in the milk , then coat the chicken well with the bread crumbs
5. Place the butter and olive oil in a skillet and heat till butter melts over medium heat
6. Brown the chicken over medium heat in the butter and olive oil mixture
7. Keep chicken warm in preheated oven
8. Add broth to skillet and bring to a boil over medium heat , scraping up the browned bits from skillet
9. Stir in cream and pimentos , boil and stir for 1 minute
10. Reduce heat and while stirring constantly add the cheese , basil , salt and pepper
11. Cook until heated through
12. Mix cornstarch with a bit of water and stir into sauce if sauce needs thickening
13. Place chicken on platter , and pour sauce over chicken before serving

title: low fat oven fried scallops
steps:
1. Rinse the scallops & pat dry
2. Set aside
3. Place the egg substitute in a shallow dish
4. Place bread crumbs in another shallow dish
5. Dip scallops in the egg substitute and then roll them in the bread crumbs
6. Coat a 9 x 13 inch pan with the olive oil cooking spray and arrange the scallops in a single layer in the pan
7. Spray the tops lightly with the spray
8. Bake at 500 degrees f for about 8-10 minutes or until the scallops turn opaque and nicely browned
9. Remove pan from oven and sprinkle with parsley
10. Squeeze the lemon over the scallops and serve

title: ham  n noodles hot dish
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a greased 13x9x2 inch baking dish , layer 1 / 3 of noodles , ham and cheese
3. In a bowl , combine soup , sour cream , onions , and green pepper
4. Spread half the mixture over top
5. Repeat layers
6. Bake uncovered about 45 minutes or until very hot

title: caramel chocolate bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Cream brown sugar and margarine
3. Add dry ingredients reserving 3 tbsp of flour and stir in the oatmeal
4. Press 1 / 2 of the mixture in the bottom of a greased 9 x 13 pan and bake for 10 minutes
5. Sprinkle chocolate chips over crust
6. Mix caramel topping with the reserved flour
7. Drizzle this over the chips
8. Sprinkle the top with the remaining crumb mixture
9. Bake for an additional 15 minutes

title: aztec lasagna
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Brown meat and drain
3. In same pan , stir in salsa , tomato sauce & taco seasoning
4. Simmer , stirring often for 5 minute
5. In seperate bowl , combine eggs , cottage cheese & oregano
6. Line bottom of greased 13 x 9 pan with half of tortillas , overlapping edges
7. Top with half of meat mixture
8. Spoon cottage chees mixture over meat
9. Arrange remaining tortillas over cottage cheese
10. Spread rest of meat mixture over top
11. Place shredded cheese over all
12. Bake 30 - 35 minutes or until bubbly
13. Let stand 10 minute before cutting

title: spicy vegetable egg noodles
steps:
1. Start boiling some water to cook your noodles in a pot
2. Heat oil in a wok or large skillet and saute your garlic , leek , green chile and ginger for 3 minutes
3. Meanwhile start cooking your noodles in boiling water you have prepared and strain them when they are a little more than 1 / 2 cooked
4. Then , add corn to the wok , followed by your vegetable stock
5. Bring stock to a boil and then add , carrots , white and black pepper , and salt , and stir
6. Add partially cooked pasta and cook until pasta is "al dente"
7. Add celery , green bell pepper and stir again
8. In a bowl take your cornstarch and add just enough water to make a thin paste
9. Add thin paste to the stock mixture and stir completely
10. Turn off the heat and stir in green onions , and vinegar
11. Garnish with red pepper flakes and bean sprouts
12. Drizzle with a little bit of sesame oil
13. Serve & enjoy !

title: fruit cocktail deluxe
steps:
1. Combine four fruts and the marshmallows
2. Chill
3. Pour cold ginger ale over the top just before serving
4. Garnish with a sprig of fresh mint and a sprinkle with powdered sugar

title: i guess i ll add my favorite potato salad
steps:
1. Combine potatoes , eggs , and vegetables in a large bowl
2. Blend remaining ingredients in another small bowl , and mix lightly with potato mixture
3. Top with reserved egg slices and a dash of paprika
4. Chill before serving

title: wild mushroom pancakes
steps:
1. Make the batter with the flour , seasoning to taste , eggs , and milk
2. Leave to stand for at least one hour
3. In large frying pan , melt the butter and saut the mushrooms until they are wilted and all the liquid has evaporated
4. Set aside to cool
5. Combine the batter and mushrooms
6. Heat a frying pan with a small amount of oil , and fry pancakes about 2 inches in diameter
7. Eat

title: paula deen s chicken nuggets
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Spread the crushed potato chips in a shallow dish
3. Beat together the egg and milk in a shallow bowl
4. Dip the chicken cubes into the egg mixture and then dredge them in the chips
5. Place the chicken nuggets on a baking sheet and drizzle with melted butter
6. Bake for 15 to 18 minutes , or until golden brown

title: kofte kebabs with cucumber mint sauce
steps:
1. Mix together yogurt , cucumber , mint , salt , and garlic for the cucumber-mint sauce in a small bowl and keep chilled while preparing kebabs
2. Combine ingredients for kebabs in a bowl and mix together , squeezing with fingers to incorporate until smooth
3. Shape the meat into 8 flat torpedo shapes , about 5-inches long by 2-inches wide
4. Prepare grill or heat skillet
5. Cook kebabs for 6-8 minutes , turning to cook all sides
6. Serve 2 kebabs on each pita or lavash with cucumber-mint sauce

title: fast  delicious and easy broiled ham dinner
steps:
1. Mix together the first five ingredients
2. Slash the fat edge of the ham , if present
3. Place ham on the rack in a broiler pan
4. Spread 1 / 2 of the apricot glaze on the ham
5. Broil 3" from heat for 6 minutes
6. Turn ham and spread with remaining glaze
7. Broil 6 minutes more
8. Serve
9. Enjoy !

title: rhubarb buckle
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Toss the rhubarb , sugar , gingerale , cornstarch and ginger together in a large bowl , moistening all the ingredients and making sure the cornstarch is dissolved
3. Place in a buttered 8 by 11 inch baking pan
4. Blend all of the topping ingredients together in a bowl and spoon over the rhubarb mixture , completely covering it
5. Bake for 1 hour and 10 minutes , or until the topping is golden and the edges are quite bubbly
6. Serve warm in bowls with ginger ice cream if desired , or pouring cream
7. Yumm !

title: ginger cole slaw with mandarin oranges
steps:
1. Mix cabbage and carrots in a large bowl
2. In a small bowl combine mayonnaise , sour cream , mustard , ginger , celery seed , salt and pepper
3. Pour over cabbage and carrots and mix well
4. Lightly fold in mandarin oranges
5. Cover and chill at least 4 hours for flavors to blend

title: japanese grilled tuna
steps:
1. Combine oils , ginger and pepper
2. Brush on steaks
3. Sprinkle with kosher salt
4. Marinate for 30 minutes
5. Combine sugar , water , rice vinegar , soy sauce and ginger
6. Stir to dissolve
7. Bring to boil on high heat and reduce until syrupy , about 15 minutes
8. Make a apste of the wasabi powder and the water
9. Whisk in wasabi paste
10. The glaze should be used at room temperature
11. Grill tuna 2 minutes per side with lid closed for very rare - 3 to 4 minutes per side for medium-rare
12. Use either a squeeze bottle or a fork to streak glaze over fish

title: sandra s chicken
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Place the chicken in a shallow baking dish
3. Mix the rest of the ingredients to make a sauce
4. Pour the sauce over the chicken
5. Bake for about 11 / 2 hours , basting every 15-20 minutes until no longer pink
6. Enjoy !

title: valentine cookie pops
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f on ungreased cookie sheets , place cookie dough pieces 2 inches apart
2. Into side of each piece of dough , insert wooden stick 1 inch , overlapping wooden sticks as necessary
3. Bake 12 to 16 minutes or until edges are light golden brown
4. Cool 2 minutes
5. Remove from cookie sheets
6. Cool completely , about 10 minutes
7. Spread frosting on one side of each cookie
8. Decorate with candies
9. Tie 18 inches of red ribbon into bow around each stick next to cookie

title: irish whiskey   honey remedy
steps:
1. Prepare the tea
2. I use regular tea , but my grandmother always used irish tea
3. Add the whiskey to the mug , then the honey , then the lemon
4. Stir thoroughly , add the cinnamon stick , then drink
5. Hot drinks are great for a dry cough

title: emeril s manly man stuffed cornbread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Place 10 inch cast-iron skillet in the oven to get hot
3. In a large skillet , fry bacon over medium / high heat until browned
4. Remove bacon with a slotted spoon and drain off all but 2 teaspoons of the fat
5. Add corn and cook until tender , about 5 minutes
6. Add cream , butter , 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and water
7. Cook until creamy , about 10 minutes
8. Remove from the heat and mash with a potato masher to crush some of the corn
9. Allow to cool
10. In a large bowl , combine cornmeal , flour , baking powder , baking soda , remaining salt and cayenne pepper
11. In a different bowl , combine eggs , buttermilk , and 2 tablespoons of the melted butter
12. Add the wet mixture to the dry ingredients and mix well
13. In another bowl , combine corn mixture , bacon , jalapenos and 1 1 / 2 cups cheese
14. Mix well
15. Remove the skillet from the oven and add the remaining tablespoon melted butter , tilting the skillet to coat the bottom and sides
16. Pour half of the batter into the skillet
17. Top with the corn mixture
18. Pour remaining half of the batter over corn and bake until golden brown and set , about 30 minutes
19. Remove from oven , top with remaining 1 / 4 cup cheese and serve hot

title: green beans in dill walnut sauce
steps:
1. Heat a large pot of water to boiling
2. Add the green beans and cook until crisp-tender
3. Drain immediately , then immerse in a large bowl of ice water to prevent further cooking and to retain the bright green color
4. Meanwhile , make the sauce: place the scallions , dill , parsley , walnuts , and lemon juice in a blender or food processor fitted with the steel blade
5. Process until smooth
6. With the machine running , pour the olive oil in a t hin , steady stream through the feed tube to make a thick green sauce
7. Add salt and pepper to taste
8. Drain the beans and dry wit h a towel
9. Toss the beans with the dressing
10. Serve slightly chilled or at room temperature

title: glazed strawberry tart
steps:
1. Stir together flour , almonds , sugar , lemon peel and salt in a large bowl
2. Cut butter into flour mixture with a pastry blender or 2 knives until coarse crumbs form
3. Whisk together eggs and vanilla in a small bowl
4. Stir into flour mixture until dough forms
5. Shape into disk
6. Wrap in plastic and chill for at least 1 hour or overnight
7. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
8. Grease and flour a baking sheet
9. Place dough on baking sheet
10. Pat into a 10-inch circle forming a high edge
11. Pierce bottom of dough all over with a fork
12. Bake until slightly browned about 25 minutes
13. Place baking sheet on a wire rack and cook for 10 minutes
14. Transfer shell to rack to cool completely
15. Melt jam with lemon juice in a small saucepan over low heat until spreadable
16. Spread 1 / 2 cup jam mixture over bottom of the shell
17. Arrange berries on top , cut sides down
18. Brush with remaining jam mixture
19. Serve with whipped cream if desired

title: georgia peach grilled pork kabobs
steps:
1. Make marinade by combining all ingredients in a bowl
2. Glaze: combine peaches , lemon juice , sugar , soy sauce , cornstarch , and garlic , ginger in saucepan
3. Simmer until thickened about 4 minutes
4. Refrigerate pork with marinade for 4 hours or overnight
5. Drain pork and discard the marinade
6. Cut 3 firm fresh peaches into pieces
7. Thread pork with peaches on 6 metal or bamboo skewers
8. Grill for 10-15 minutes or until pork is no longer pink in center and peach is tender
9. Brush with glaze during the last 5 minutes of cooking
10. Boil any leftover glaze in saucepan for 1 minute
11. Serve glaze on the side

title: chocolate glaze
steps:
1. Heat all ingredients in 1 quart saucepan over low heat
2. Stirring occasionally until well blended

title: bbq d beef ribs
steps:
1. Run tomatoes through blender or food processor until smooth
2. Combine tomatoes and all ingredients except the beef ribs in 2 quart non-reactive pot such as stainless steel
3. Bring tomato mixture to a boil , reduce heat and simmer until thickened , approximately 1 1 / 2 hours
4. Pour contents through sieve to strain out seeds and chunks
5. Allow to cool to room temperature
6. Place beef ribs in marinade and marinate for at least four hours , but over-night is better
7. If you are limited on time and have an injector , you can inject the beef ribs rather than marinating
8. Place on pre-heated gas grill , or prepared charcoal grill and cook until desired doneness , basting frequently with marinade

title: pecan crispies
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugars until light
2. Beat in egg and vanilla
3. Sift dry ingredients and stir into batter
4. Blend until creamy
5. Stir in pecans
6. Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet
7. Bake at 350 f for 10-12 minutes

title: tamale bites
steps:
1. Heat a skillet over mediumhigh heat
2. Add the shredded meat , and following seven ingredients
3. Stir well and add 1 cup of water
4. Bring to a boil and lower heat to simmer
5. Simmer until all the liquid in rendered out--approximately 10 minutes
6. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
7. Meanwhile , mix 2 cups of masa with the baking powder , salt and cumin
8. Add the beef stock and mix to a crumbly consistency
9. Pour in the melted shortening and mix by hand until smooth
10. Spray your mini-muffin tins with non-stick spray
11. Roll the masa mixture into small ballsabout 2 teaspoons each
12. Place one ball in each muffin cup and press with your fingersor the back of a rounded measuring spoonto make little shells
13. Once the beef mixture has rendered out the liquid , stir in the sour cream and lime juice
14. Salt and pepper to taste
15. Fill each masa shell with beef mixture
16. Bake for 15-20 minutes
17. Allow the tamale bites to cool 3-5 minutes before extracting them from the muffin tins
18. Use a small sharp knife to lift one side , then gently lift them out with your fingers
19. Garnish with crumbled queso fresco and thyme leaves
20. Serve warm !

title: bacon and noodles
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 degrees
2. Fry the bacon until it's crispy , drain on paper towels and crumble
3. Cook egg noodles as directed on package , drain and toss with the 2 tablespoons butter
4. In a 2 quart casserole layer as follows: 1 / 4 of the noodles , 1 / 4 of the sour cream , 1 / 4 of the cheddar cheese , 1 / 4 of the bacon and 1 / 4 of the onion
5. Repeat these layers 3 more times
6. Bake the casserole in preheated oven , uncovered for 30 minutes

title: root vegetables with garlic and beef tenderloin
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. To make the garlic: toss the unpeeled garlic cloves in melted butter and place on a small baking sheet
3. Bake for about 15-20 minutes , or until beginning to brown
4. Set aside to cool
5. When cool enough to remove the skins , peel the skins from the cloves
6. In a large pot over medium-high heat melt about 2 tablespoon butter with olive oil
7. Sprinkle the beef with seasoning salt and pepper then dust / sprinkle with about 2-3 tablespoons flour
8. Add to the pot and saute about 6 minutes
9. Transfer the beef to a bowl or plate
10. Add in more oil if needed and saute the chopped onions with the thyme and sage
11. Add in all veggies including the peeled garlic cloves with beef broth and wine
12. Cover and simmer until firm-tender
13. Return the beef to the pot with any juices from the plate or bowl
14. Simmer for 15 minutes
15. Season with salt and pepper to taste
16. In a small bowl , whisk together 2 tablespoons water with 2 tablespoon flour , and pour into simmering juice
17. Stir with wooden spoon
18. Delicious !

title: tzatziki   homemade
steps:
1. Set yogurt in a cheesecloth lined sieve over a bowl
2. Let drain in refrigerator until reduced to 1 cup
3. Stir in cucumber , olive oil , lemon juice , garlic , salt and pepper
4. At least 4 hours

title: best black beans
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , combine beans , onion , and garlic , and bring to a boil
2. Reduce heat to medium-low
3. Season with cumin , cilantro , cayenne , and salt
4. Simmer for 5 minutes , and serve

title: crispy glazed corn cereal snack mix
steps:
1. Heat oven to 250 degrees
2. Spray a roasting pan with non-stick cooking spray
3. Place the cereal into the pan
4. In a 3-quart saucepan combine brown sugar , butter and light corn syrup
5. Cook over medium heat until the mixture comes to a boil continue cooking stirring constantly for 1 minute
6. Remove from heat , then add in baking soda and mix well
7. Pour the syrup mixture over the cereal in the pan
8. Toss gently until well coated
9. Bake at 250 degrees for 40-50 minutes stirring every 15 minutes or until the coating is set
10. Spread the mixture onto waxed paper
11. Cool for 10 minutes then break apart
12. Store in an airtight container

title: shrimp stuffed with shrimp
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. Peel and devein shrimp
3. Set aside 16 shrimps
4. Chop the remaining shrimps coarsely
5. There should be about 1 / 2 cup
6. Finely chop the mushrooms
7. There should be about 1 cup
8. Set aside
9. Heat 2 tablespoons butter in a saucepan
10. Add onion , celery and garlic
11. Saute until wilted , about 5 minutes , then add the mushrooms , salt and pepper
12. Cook an additional 3 minutes or so
13. Remove from heat and add the chopped shrimp
14. Stir
15. Add the bread crumbs , parsley , and egg
16. Blend well and add salt and pepper to taste
17. Butterfly the reserved shrimp by cutting part way through the backs until they lay flat
18. Grease a baking dish with 1 tablespoon of butter
19. Arrange butterflied shrimp , cut side down in baking dish
