20. Spoon an equal amount of stuffing onto each shrimp
21. Sprinkle the shrimps with the reserved bread crumbs and dot with 1 tablespoon of butter
22. Heat baking dish on the stovetop until the butter melts and the shrimps start to cook
23. Then place under the broiler and cook until the shrimp is done and the stuffing starts to brown

title: herb garden pasta
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , cook beef , onion and garlic until meat is browned
2. Drain
3. Add the next 12 ingredients
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat
6. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes
7. Add macaroni
8. Cover and simmer 10 minutes more
9. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese
10. Serve

title: mike s potatoes
steps:
1. Melt butter in large heavy skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add diced potatoes and cook until browned and crisp , stirring frequently
3. Add cheeses , tomato , onion and green onion and stir until cheese melts
4. Season to taste with salt and pepper
5. Gently mix in avocado
6. Spoon onto plates and top with a dollop of sour cream
7. Serve immediately

title: crunchy lime swordfish
steps:
1. Marinade fish in juice of 1 / 2 lime and 2 tbs olive oil for 1 / 2 to 3 / 4 hours mix flour , corn meal and old bay seasoning
2. Dredge swordfish in mix and shake off excess
3. Heat 1 tbs of butter and 1 tbs olive oil in fry pan
4. Fry swordfish approx 4 minutes per side or until done
5. Squeeze addition lime juice on swordfish if desired

title: banana oatmeal breakfast brule
steps:
1. Combine milk , rolled oats , salt and 2 tablespoons of the brown sugar in a large saucepan and mix well
2. Bring to a boil over medium heat
3. Continue to cook , stirring constantly for 1 minute
4. Spoon 1 cup of the oatmeal into each of oven-proof bowls spreading evenly
5. Spread 1 / 4 cup of yogurt over each bowl
6. Arrange sliced banana over yogurt , then sprinkle each remaining brown sugar
7. Arrange the dishes on a baking sheet or in a large baking pan and place under a preheated broiler until the sugar starts to bubble and turn dark , about 1 to 2 minutes
8. Serve immediately
9. Alternately , you may use a kitchen torch to melt the sugar

title: cranberry cinnamon nut bars
steps:
1. Crust:
2. Combine all ingredients , mixing until crumbly
3. Press firmly into greased 13"x9" cake pan
4. Bake at 350f for 15-18 minutes , or until light golden
5. Topping:
6. Beat eggs , sugar , corn syrup and melted butter together until blended
7. Stir in cinnamon chips , cranberries and walnuts
8. Pour evenly over crust
9. Bake for about 30-35 minutes longer , or until set and golden
10. Cool completely , then cut into bars

title: mediterranean broccoli salad
steps:
1. Combine dressing ingredients in jar or bowl and set aside
2. In salad bowl , combine broccoli with all other ingredients
3. Whisk together the dressing ingredients and pour over the vegetables
4. Gently stir to combine
5. Refrigerate until ready to serve

title: ospidillo cafe cincinnati chili no  2
steps:
1. In a large cooking pot , over medium-high heat , break up the burger into the chicken stock
2. Add all the remaining ingredients except for the bell pepper and the kidney beans , bring to a boil , and then lower the heat to a simmer
3. Cover , and allow the chili to simmer for three hours , stirring often
4. At the end of three hours , remove the garlic clove and the bay leaves and drop in the red bell pepper
5. Simmer for two more hours , again stirring often
6. At the end of the two hours , remove the whole pepper and add the drained / rinsed kidney beans
7. Simmer for one additional hour , covered , and continue frequent stirring
8. Also , this is a very old recipe and any "tweaking" will probably not serve to improve it
9. Finally , make sure that your spices are fresh -- i prefer ancho chili powder but any variety will do
10. Condiments for the spaghetti dish version include diced sweet onion , sharp cheddar cheese and tabasco sauce
11. Servings are based on spaghetti , not hot dogs

title: beef tips over noodles
steps:
1. In a large bowl , coat beef
2. Add mushrooms , onion , bell pepper , ketchup , beef broth , worcestershire sauce , and salt and pepper to taste if desired
3. Cover and cook on low for 8-9 hours , about 1 hour before serving , turn heat to high
4. In a small bowl , combine remaining flour with 1 / 4 cup water , stir in slow cooker an cook until liquid thickens
5. Serve over hot buttered noodles

title: crustless gluten free pumpkin pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Prepare pie pan by lightly buttering
3. Combine sugar , salt , and pie spices in a small bowl
4. Beat eggs lightly in large bowl
5. Stir in pumpkin and sugar / spice mix
6. Slowly stir in evaporated milk blending well
7. Stir in gluten free flour
8. Bake for 15 minutes at 425 degrees
9. Reduce temperature to 350 degrees f
10. Bake for 40 to 50 minutes
11. When knife inserted near center comes out clean it is done
12. Cool on rack for 2 hours and serve
13. Serve immediatedly or refridgerate

title: christmas walnut snowballs
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine all ingredients together just until blended
2. If it seems a bit dry , add the 1 tablespoon of milk
3. Roll into approximately 1 inch balls and place on an ungreased baking sheet
4. Bake at 375f for 20 minutes
5. Oven times may vary so checking your cookies after about 12 minutes or so may be necessary so your cookies do not overbake / this is the temp and time my grandmother had on the recipe but seeing as the temp is a bit high i would check them periodically
6. When cookies are lukewarm , roll in powdered sugar
7. When completely cooled , you can roll again in the powdered sugar for even sweeter and"snowier" cookies , if you like

title: east indian inspired potatoes with mint
steps:
1. Soak raisins in 1 cup very hot water for 10 minutes until plump
2. Drain and set aside
3. Cook the potatoes in a large pot of salted boiling water for 10-12 minutes or just until fork tender
4. Do not overcook
5. Drain potatoes and set aside
6. Heat olive oil or ghee over medium heat in large saute pan
7. Add the red onions , drained raisins , chili peppers , ginger , turmeric , garlic , cumin seeds and fennel seeds
8. Cook for 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
9. Stir in the potatoes and most of the spearmint stir to coat the potatoes
10. Toss with lemon juice
11. Season with salt and pepper
12. Transfer to a serving bowl or platter and garnish with lemon wedges and fresh cilantro

title: planked salmon with honey balsamic glaze
steps:
1. Presoak cedar plank for 8 hours
2. Preheat grill to 400 degrees
3. Cut a few slits in the side of the salmon , but don't go all the way through , halfway
4. Do the same if using portions
5. The slits allow the glaze to absorb into the fillet
6. In a bowl mix salt , pepper and dry mustard
7. In a glass bowl , microwave the honey for about 30 seconds to liquefy
8. Remove bowl and blend in balsamic vinegar
9. With a basting brush , baste the salmon with butter
10. Apply dry seasoning mix on flesh side of salmon and lightly rub it into the salmon
11. I just pat the dry seasoning on
12. With the basting brush baste the salmon with the honey balsamic mixture
13. Reserve liquid for later
14. Heat the planks on the grill over medium heat for 3-5 minutes to brown them
15. Watch so they don't catch on fire
16. Remove from grill and rub olive oil on the browned side of plank
17. Lay salmon on the oiled side of the plank with skin side down and baste with remaining reserved liquid
18. Cook for 15 to 20 minutes or until done
19. A thicker cut may take a little longer
20. If cooking in an oven use a cookie sheet to prevent a mess

title: easy madeleines with gluten free option
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 180c or 160c if you have a fan-forced oven
2. Melt the butter in a saucepan over a medium heat
3. Brush your madeleine mold with a little of the melted butter using a pastry brush and dust the mold lightly with some extra flour
4. Shake off any excess flour and set aside
5. Cook the rest of the butter for about 5 minutes , until the butter turns a golden brown and gives off a nutty aroma
6. Be careful not too burn the butter !
7. Remove the butter from heat and transfer to ceramic bowl to prevent butter cooking further
8. Set aside to cool
9. Sift the icing sugar and flour into a medium sized bowl
10. Then stir in the ground almonds / almond meal
11. In another bowl , whisk the eggwhites until frothy
12. Add the almond and sugar mixture to the eggwhites and whisk to combine
13. Whisk in the brown butter and honey
14. Spoon the batter into the prepared moulds , filling almost to the top
15. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until madeleines are light golden and springy to touch
16. If using gluten-free flour , they may be a very light colour when cooked- really depends on the blend of flours that is in your vlended flour mixture
17. Allow to cool slightly- about ten minutes and remove from the mould by tapping on hard surface
18. Then cool them on a wire rack
19. Serve with some whipped cream and fresh strawberries for a special treat or 1 / 2 of each madeleine can be dipped in melted chocolate
20. For a simple presentation- dust lightly with some extra icing sugar

title: curried carrot  sweet potato  or yam    ginger soup
steps:
1. Heat oil in saucepan
2. Add shallots , saut for 3 minutes until tender
3. Add potato , carrots , ginger & curry
4. Cook 2 minutes
5. Add broth
6. Bring to boil then simmer for 25-30 minutes until tender
7. Puree soup at a time in blender or food processor

title: baby  pie  or  cobbler
steps: 1. Mash the fruit and add in the graham cracker crumbs until it is the consistency you like

title: lemon egg soup
steps:
1. Bring broth to boil and add rice or orzo
2. Cook until rice is done
3. Add egg whites to blender and blend until frothy
4. While egg whites are blending , slowly add egg yolks
5. After egg yolks are completely mixed with egg whites , add lemon slowly while mixture is still blending
6. Slowly add 2 cups of chicken broth to blender
7. After everything is well mixed , slowly add contents of blender to remaining broth and rice , stirring constantly
8. Serve hot

title: easy applesauce
steps:
1. Place apples and cider into a large saucepan and bring to a boil
2. Lower heat , cover and simmer for 30 minutes or until apples are tender
3. Allow to cool
4. Run cooked apples through a food mill
5. Add any sweeteners or spices at this time
6. Serve chilled for best flavor

title: lower fat macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Cook macaroni noodles
3. Drain
4. Mix macaroni , cottage cheese , and cheddar cheese together in oven-proof bowl
5. Bake for 15 - 20 minutes
6. Makes 2 servings
7. Enjoy !

title: delicious party cheese potatoes
steps:
1. Thaw potatoes overnight in refrigerator
2. Preheat oven to 350
3. Melt butter
4. Add soup , cheese , and sour cream to butter
5. Mix well
6. Add potatoes , salt and pepper
7. Mix well
8. Spray 9x13 glass pan with non stick cooking spray
9. Add potatoe mixture
10. Cook uncovered for 30 to 45 minutes

title: htapodi me makaronaki kofto  stewed octopus with macaroni
steps:
1. Rinse the octopus under cold , running water and place in pot dripping wet
2. Add the red wine , garlic , onion , bay leaf and cinnamon and cover the pot
3. Bring to the boil over low heat
4. It is tender when pierced easily with a fork
5. Remove the octopus and let cool until cool enough to handle and cut into bite-size pieces
6. Meanwhile , in pot you have cooked the octopus in , add tomatoes and olive oil
7. Boil for 8-10 minutes to bind the sauce
8. Stir in the cut octopus and nearly-cooked macaroni and simmer for the remaining 3-4 minutes required to cook your macaroni
9. Stir in butter
10. Remove bay leaf and cinnamon stick
11. Bon appetit

title: grilled thai sirloin with tangy lime sauce
steps:
1. In small bowl , combine 3 tablespoons soy sauce , olive oil and hot chili oil
2. Whisk until blended
3. In second small bowl , combine garlic powder and 3 / 4 teaspoon pepper
4. Place beef steak in large shallow dish
5. Pour 1 / 2 of soy sauce mixture over one side of steak
6. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 of garlic powder mixture and 1 / 2 of chopped cilantro
7. Rub mixture firmly into beef
8. Turn steak over and repeat on second side
9. Cover and marinate in refrigerator 20 minutes
10. Place steak on grid over medium , ash-covered coals
11. Grill , uncovered , 17 to 21 minutes for medium rare to medium doneness , turning once
12. When steak is almost done , in small saucepan , combine sauce ingredients
13. Place on grid near edge of grill to heat until hot
14. Carve steak crosswise into thin slices
15. Arrange on heated platter
16. Spoon sauce over beef
17. Garnish with lime slices and cilantro sprigs
18. Serve immediately
19. Broil 16 to 21 minutes , turning once

title: tuna stroganoff
steps:
1. Melt butter in skillet
2. Saut onion until tender
3. Combine soup , sour cream and pepper
4. Add to onion and peas if using
5. Add tuna
6. Heat through
7. Serve tuna stroganoff over hot cooked noodles or rice

title: dijon broccoli
steps:
1. Steam the broccoli until it is barely tender
2. Combine all other ingredients and heat until butter melts
3. Stir to blend
4. Pour over the hot broccoli

title: grandma g s baked thanksgiving turkey
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Remove giblets and neck
3. For those of you who have never cooked a turkey before , check inside the body cavity , and inside the neck chest cavity
4. Rinse turkey and pat dry
5. Mix melted butter and salad dressing
6. Draw up mixture into injector and inject bird in several locations in the brest , thighs and leg
7. Place in roaster pan and add all vegetables inside the body cavity
8. Cut 4 , 1 / 2 inch slices from the butter and insert under the breast skin , and push up as far as it will go
9. Place the remaining stick of butter in the cavity
10. Cover with heavy foil , making sure the foil does not touch the turkey
11. Bake for 2 hours 30 minutes in 450 degree oven
12. If meat thermometer reads 185 degrees , it's time to uncover and baste using all of basting liquid
13. If it has not reached 180 degrees return to oven for additional 30 minutes
14. Check therometer
15. Bake another 45 minutes , until golden brown
16. Remove from oven and cover with foil again and let stand for 15 minutes before slicing

title: tilapia with lime butter
steps:
1. Heat a little oil in a fry pan
2. Mix butter w / shallot , red pepper , lime peel or oil , then mix in juice
3. When it's mixed , add salt to taste
4. When oil is hot , add your tilapia
5. I put the side w / dark stripe up--that makes the top the pretty white side
6. Sometimes i add a tsp or 2 of the lime butter while tilapia is cooking
7. Probably only need about 5 minutes each side
8. When you flip the tilapia to put the dark side down , spoon a tsp or so of the butter on the fish
9. Then when you take it off the stove to serve , put a dab on top
10. Sometimes i use orange peel to add a different color

title: onion in custard
steps:
1. Saute onions in butter until transparent , 6-8 minutes
2. Place in a baking dish
3. Beat eggs until they are light , mix in cream and seasonings
4. Pour mixture over onions
5. Sprinkle on parmesan cheese
6. Bake at 425 , uncovered , for 15 minutes

title: starbucks peppermint mocha  copycat
steps:
1. Pour syrup into a twelve-ounce mug , add a shot of espresso , and peppermint syrup
2. Fill the remainder of the cup with steamed or heated milk
3. Garnish with whipped cream and red sugar sprinkles
4. Top with whipped cream
5. Red sugar sprinkles

title: hearty osso bucco
steps:
1. Deglaze your dutch oven with the wine and pre-heat the oven to 180c
2. Salt and pepper both sides of your osso bucco with salt and pepper and dredge it with flour
3. Heat the butter in a pan on high until it becomes frothy , then fry each side of the meat for around 3 minutes , until both sides are brown and have a golden crust
4. Set the meat aside in the dutch oven to rest
5. In the same pan on a medium heat saut the pancetta , onion , celery and carrot for a few minutes until the onion becomes clear and then add the mushrooms and the chopped sage and rosemary stirring for a couple more minutes
6. Add 2 tablespoons of flour to the mix and stir through
7. Pour in the beef stock and bring to boil before adding the tomato paste and the chopped tomato , and transfer the entire contents of the pan into the dutch oven , and place that in the oven for 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours
8. Serve the osso bucco with mashed potatoes and bread for dipping if you're feeling indulgent !

title: chunky chocolate and oat cookies
steps:
1. Beat butter , condensed milk and sugar together until light and creamy
2. Add flour , oats , baking powder and chocolate chunks
3. Flatten spoonfuls of mixture on to a well greased oven tray and bake for 15-20 minutes at 180c or until golden brown
4. Cool on a wire rack and store in an airtight container

title: jumble cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a bowl , beat butter and sugars until light and fluffy
3. Add egg
4. Combine flour and baking soda
5. Blend into creamed mixture
6. Stir in m & m's baking bits , raisins and nuts
7. Drop rounded tablespoonfuls about 2 inches apart onto greased cookie sheets
8. Bake 13 to 15 minutes
9. Cool 2 to 3 minutes on cookie sheet before transferring to wire racks to cool thouroughly
10. Store in tightly covered container

title: polpette napoletane  neapolitan meatballs
steps:
1. In a small bowl , place the bread
2. Cover with milk and leave to soak
3. Chop parsley and garlic together
4. Squeeze milk out of the bread and add to meat along with parsley and garlic in a large mixing bowl
5. Mix ingredients together , then add eggs and mix again
6. Add parmesan cheese and season with salt and pepper to taste
7. Shape meatballs , make a hole in the top and insert a small piece of mozarella
8. Cover over mozzarella , then roll meatballs in bread crumbs
9. Fry in heated olive oil for 5 minutes , then turn over
10. When golden brown and crusty on both sides , remove from pan and drain on paper towels
11. Add meatballs to your favorite tomato sauce and cook very slowly for 45 minutes on low heat

title: orange ginger spread
steps: 1. In a small bowl stir together all ingredients

title: sweet cream corn
steps: 1. Put all ingredients in a crock pot and cook on low overnight or all day

title: sour cream spice cake with orange clove cream cheese icing
steps:
1. Cake:
2. Sift cake mix and spices into a mixing bowl
3. Add sour cream , milk , eggs and oil
4. Beat at low speed until dry ingredients are incorporated
5. Beat at high speed for 3 minute
6. Pour batter into appropriate sized pans
7. Bake according to cake mix package instructions
8. Cool before icing
9. Icing:
10. Put the zest of two oranges into a mixing bowl
11. Mix the cream cheese , zest , and 1 tbsp juice until smooth
12. Gradually add pwd sugar until you reach desired consistency and sweetness

title: thanksgiving stuffing muffins
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 375
2. Saute onions , carrots and celery in 10"skillet until tender
3. Mix all ingredients in a large mixing bowl
4. Spray muffin tins with pam
5. Fill muffin tins with stuffing mix until just overflowing
6. Bake for 25 minute or until crisp on top

title: broccoli  rice   ground beef casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray a 9x13 casserole dish with cooking spray
3. Set aside
4. Brown ground beef until no longer pink , adding salt and pepper to taste
5. Drain fat from cooked ground beef
6. In a large bowl , stir ground beef together with all remaining ingredients
7. Dump the entire mixture into the casserole dish
8. Bake for 45 minutes until casserole is bubbly and rice is tender

title: roasted garlic grilled cheese sandwich
steps:
1. Spread both sides of bread with roasted garlic
2. Place cheese in between the two slices
3. Place on health grill or fry with butter until cheese is melted

title: pastitsio   greek macaroni
steps:
1. For meat layer
2. Saute onions in butter till soft
3. Add meat breaking up with spoon & cook till no pink remains
4. Drain off fat in a strainer & return meat in pan
5. Add remaining ingredients
6. Bring to a boil , lower heat and simmer uncovered 15 minutes
7. For cream sauce
8. Melt butter in large pot
9. Stir in flour and cook 1 minute
10. Lower heat and add cream and stock till smooth
11. Cook stirring constantly till sauce is thick & bubbly
12. Stir in cheese , salt and pepper and stir till cheese is melted & blended into sauce
13. Remove from heat , cover and set aside
14. Cook pasta according to directions on box
15. Beat eggs , 1 / 2 cup cheese and soft butter
16. Add to pasta , blending well
17. Assembly:
18. Spoon 1 / 2 of pasta into buttered 13x9x2 dish
19. Pour 1 cup sauce over pasta
20. Spoon on all of the meat mixture
21. Pour another 1 cup sauce over meat
22. Add other 1 / 2 of pasta
23. Pour rest of sauce
24. Sprinkle 1 / 4 c cheese on top
25. Bake uncovered 350 f for 35 minutes

title: very good and yummy chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease cookie sheets
3. In a large bowl , cream together the butter , splenda and brown sugar until light and fluffy
4. Add the eggs one at a time , beating well with each addition , then stir in the vanilla
5. Combine the flour , baking soda and salt
6. Gradually stir into the creamed mixture
7. Finally , fold in the chocolate chips
8. Drop by rounded spoonfuls onto the prepared cookie sheets
9. Bake for 8-10 minutes or until light brown
10. Allow cookies to cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely

title: kittencal s four cheese  lasagna
steps:
1. Prepare this sauce a day ahead
2. For the meat sauce
3. In a large heavy pot cook the sausage meat with crushed chili flakes and onion until the meat is lightly browned breaking up the meat while cooking
4. Drain any fat from the sausage meat
5. Add in garlic , basil and oregano
6. Cook stirring for about 3 minutes
7. Add in tomato paste
8. Cook stirring with a wooden spoon for 2 minutes
9. Add in crushed tomatoes , tomato sauce , water , 1 tablespoon salt , black pepper and 1 tablespoon sugar
10. Bring to a boil over medium heat , stirring constantly
11. Reduce the heat to low and simmer uncovered for about 2 hours stirring occasionally and adjusting the salt and sugar to taste
12. Cool sauce to room temperature and refrigerate overnight or up to 5 days
13. For the cheese filling
14. Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat
15. Add in onion with dried italian seasoning and saute until just lightly browned , about 4-5 minutes (adding in the fresh garlic after the last 2 minutes
16. To the bowl add in ricotta cheese , parmesan cheese , mozzarella cheese , soft cream cheese , eggs , seasoned salt and black pepper
17. Mix well to combine
18. In a large pot of boiling salted water cook the lasagna noodles until they are just al dente
19. Carefully remove the noodles then place into a large bowl of very cold water , shake off any excess water before layering in the dish
20. Grease a large pan with high sides or a lasagna pan
21. To assemble
22. Spread about 2-1 / 2 to 3 cups meat sauce evenly to cover the bottom of the pan
23. Over the meat sauce , going lengthwise down the dish arrange 6 noodles overlapping slightly , then place 2 noodles at the end of the dish going the other way cutting off one end to fit in the dish
24. Spread half of the ricotta mixture over the noodles
25. Top the ricotta with a third of the mozzarella slices , then spoon about 3 cups sauce over the slices
26. Repeat the layers using 8 noodles , remaining half of ricotta mixture , 1 / 3 of the mozzarella cheese slices and 3 cups sauce on the top of the cheese slices
27. If your pan is very full then i advise to place onto a large baking sheet to catch any spills
28. Cover with foil and bake at 375f for 1-1 / 2 hours or until the ricotta cheese mixture is set and firm and the lasagna is bubbling hot
29. Remove from oven and top with remaining mozzarella slices then 1 / 2 cup parmesan cheese
30. Return to oven and bake uncovered until the cheese is melted and bubbly
31. For easier slicing allow the lasagna to sit for about at 30 minutes even more

title: family style enchilada dinner
steps:
1. Brown chuck , onion and garlic in large pot
2. Add sauces and cheese
3. After cheese is melted , add tortillas
4. Sopapillas:
5. Pat each biscuit down as flat as possible
6. Cut in half and drop into boiling shortening / oilfor about 45-60 seconds
7. Serve with butter and honey

title: gluten free zucchini bread muffin recipe
steps:
1. Mix all the dry ingredients together first in a large mixing bowl , then add the wet ingredients and mix well
2. Lastly add the heaping 3 cups of grated zucchini
3. The way i grate zucchini is on a cheese grater over a plate and it usually takes about 1 large zucchini to get about 3 heaping cups
4. Use the juices and all the grated parts
5. Mix all together and it is ready for putting in pans
6. Some baking options:
7. This recipe will make either 24 muffin cups , or 2 loaf pans
8. You could also use 2 8x8 pans for this recipe , or even 1 9x13 pan
9. It makes a beautiful cake , bread , and muffin , so use for what you desire most
10. The muffins should be baked at 350 degrees for 20-25 minutes , the bread loaves should be baked at around 35-40 minutes , and a cake in a 9x13 should be around 30-40 minutes
11. Just check on it and pull from the oven when it is a golden brown color and after tested with a pick comes out clean with nothing gooey
12. The best baking temp is at 350 degrees
13. After pulled from the oven , make sure you cool for at least 10-15 minutes before cutting into
14. And , let it be fully cooled before bagging up to freeze for best results
15. Other option:
16. If you only want to make one loaf , then half this recipe and make just one loaf or 12 muffins

title: new england blueberry pie
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , combine 2 cups of the blueberries with the sugars , flour , butter , lemon juice spices and salt
2. Cook over low heat until the mixture comes to a boil
3. Reduce heat and simmer five minutes , stirring constantly
4. Stir in the remaining blueberries
5. Turn into the pie shell
6. Chill thoroughly
7. Serve with whipped cream

title: japanese marinated chicken
steps:
1. Sprinkle chicken generously with pepper
2. Combine all marinade ingredients and stir to blend well
3. Sprinkle cornstarch on a plate and toss chicken pieces to coat , shaking off any excess
4. Transfer the coated pieces of chicken to the marinade and let marinate for at least 4 hours , turning occasionally
5. Heat oven to 325f
6. Arrange chicken in a shallow baking dish and sprinkle with oil and bake uncovered , basting occasionally , for 1 1 / 4 hours , or until the chicken is cooked and juices run clear

title: kugel
steps:
1. Cook noodles and drain
2. Combine with melted butter
3. Add remaining ingredients
4. Top with crumb mixture , if desired
5. Bake in buttered pan at 350f for about one hour , starting to check at 20 minutes

title: sweetened condensed milk   sugar free substitute
steps:
1. In a 2 cup glass measuring cup , combine cold water and carnation nonfat dry milk powder , stirring to make a paste
2. Cover and microwave on high for 45 to 60 seconds or until mixture is hot but not boiling
3. Stir in splenda
4. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before using
5. Will keep up to 2 weeks in the refrigerator
6. Use in any recipe that calls for sweetened condensed milk
7. Makes equivalent of a 12-fluid-ounce can of commercial brand

title: perfect garden salad
steps:
1. Tear lettuce into bite sized pieces and wash and dry thoroughly
2. Place in large salad bowl
3. Top with prepared vegetables
4. Sprinkle with salt , pepper , garlic powder , and cheese
5. Go lightly until you learn how much is "to taste" for you
6. Pour oil over salad , then vinegar
7. It is important that the oil be first
8. Quantity requires a bit of practice - go light on the vinegar at first
9. You can add more if needed
10. Aim to coat the top layer of vegetables
11. Toss until well mixed
12. Taste - add vinegar or oil if needed , and toss again
13. Do not add dry ingredients
14. Serve immediately
15. If you find that you didn't add enough salt or pepper , let diners add more as served - you can't get it well dispersed if you add to the salad bowl after the oil and vinegar have been added if you find that you added too much vinegar , a little salt can counteract - again , add as served

title: black and white angel food cake
steps:
1. Cake:
2. Preheat the oven to 350f
3. Combine 1 / 2 cup of the sugar with the flour and sift them together 4 times
4. Set aside
5. Place the egg whites , salt , and cream of tartar in the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the whisk attachment and beat on high speed until the eggs form medium-firm peaks , about 1 minute
6. With the mixer on medium speed , add the remaining 1 1 / 2 cups of sugar by sprinkling it over the beaten egg whites
7. Beat on high speed for a few minutes until thick and shiny
8. Add the vanilla and continue to whisk until very thick , about 1 more minute
9. Scrape the beaten egg whites into a large bowl
10. Sift 1 / 4 of the flour mixture over the egg whites and fold it very carefully into the batter with a rubber spatula
11. Continue adding the flour in 3 equal additions , sifting and folding until it's all incorporated
12. Fold in the grated chocolate
13. Pour the batter into an ungreased 10-inch tube pan , smooth the top , and bake it for 35 to 45 minutes , until it springs back to the touch
14. Remove the cake from the oven and invert the pan on a cooling rack
15. When cool , run a thin , flexible knife around the cake to remove it from the pan
16. For chocolate glaze:
17. Place the chocolate chips and the heavy cream in a heat-proof bowl over a pan of simmering water and stir until the chocolate melts
18. Pour the chocolate over the top of the cooled cake to cover the top completely and allow it to drizzle down the sides
19. If you have chocolate glaze left over , you can serve it on the side with the cake
20. Enjoy !

title: bbq lentils
steps:
1. Heat oil in 2 qt pan on med heat
2. Add onion and cook 3 minutes or until softened
3. Add garlic , chili powder and mustard powder
4. Cook 1 minute or until fragrant
5. Do not brown the garlic
6. Add broth , sauce , vinegar , mustard , honey , and lentils
7. Stir well and bring to boil
8. Reduce heat to low
9. Cover and simmer 30 minutes until lentils are tender but intact
10. Cook times will vary if needed add 1 / 4 cup water and simmer five more minutes
11. Season with salt and pepper

title: terra cream of leek soup
steps:
1. Heat butter in large saucepan and add leeks and onion
2. Lower heat , cover and let cook 10 minutes
3. Add potato , salt , pepper and stock
4. Cook 20 minutes more
5. Remove from stove , with blender puree until smooth
6. Stir in milk , serve hot or cold , garnish with chives

title: low carb   garlic parmesan flax seed crackers
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f
2. Mix all ingredients together
3. Spoon onto sheet pan which is covered with a silicone mat or greased parchment paper
4. Cover the mixture with a piece of parchment or waxed paper
5. Even out the mixture to about 1 / 8 inch
6. I find a straight edge , like a ruler , works well , though you can use a rolling pin or wine bottle too
7. The important thing is not to let it be too thin around the edges or that part will overcook before the center firms up
8. So after you spread it out , remove the paper and go around the edges with your finger and push the thin part inwards to even it up
9. Bake until the center is no longer soft , about 15-18 minutes
10. If it starts to get more than a little brown around the edges , remove from oven
11. Let cool completely - it will continue to crisp up
12. Break into pieces
13. The whole recipe is 6 grams of effective carbohydrate plus 35 grams of fiber

title: nat s thai chicken basil
steps:
1. In a mortar and pestle add: red chilli , garlic , 1 cup of basil and the sugar
2. Pound until you get a nice smooth paste
3. Add fish sauce , soya and lime juice
4. Stir
5. Taste and adjust
6. I like mine kind of sweet with lots of basil flavour
7. Heat wok , add chicken
8. Stir fry on high
9. Add broccoli and toss for a minute
10. Add onion and peppers , toss for about 2 minutes
11. Add sauce from mortar and pestle
12. Toss 1 minute
13. Add remaining 1 / 2 cup of basil until barely wilted
14. Serve with rice

title: lela s banana nut bread
steps:
1. Cream sugar and shortening
2. Add eggs one at a time and beat
3. Sift flour , baking powder , soda and salt together
4. Add mashed bananas and buttermilk to creamed mixture , then add flour
5. Add the vanilla and the nuts , stir well
6. Cook in well greased and floured loaf pans for one hour at 350 degrees
7. Watch to see that they don't get too brown
8. This is delicious with softened cream cheese spread on the slices when served
9. My mother loved to make these loaves and give to friends at christmas

title: freezing eggs
steps:
1. Items needed:
2. Eggs
3. Ziplock bags , various sizes
4. Permanent markers
5. Freezing eggs will allow you to keep them for up to 1 yr
6. But they must be taken out of the shell
7. When freezing the eggs they will no longer work for a fried egg - seems to take away the "pretty" shape
8. Results are best when the eggs are beaten before freezing , allowing for a smoother product when thawed before use
9. Personal recommendations of freezing in groups of 2 - 3 - 6 & 12 eggs per bag
10. Instructions for freezing individually below
11. Pre-made mixes such as cakes often call for 2 - 3 eggs
12. Batters such as for pancakes , french toast , scrambled eggs , baked egg dishes often need 6 or more eggs
13. The packages of 12 eggs would be for large families
14. Label ziplock bags prior to filling , making sure to mark the number of eggs in the bag along with the date
15. Fill the bags with the number required , and carefully press out all the excess air possible
16. Lay filled bags flat in deep tray and place in freezer
17. When frozen place individual bags of same amount into gallon size or huge ziplock bags , to keep the amounts more organized
18. Once the bags are frozen they will be easy to stand up side by side with zippers upright
19. To freeze 1 egg at time - beat egg lightly and place in ice-cube trays sprayed slightly with non-stick spray
20. When frozen , pop out cube and place in ziplock bag
21. To use:
22. Place the amount of eggs needed in the refrigerator 24-48 hours prior to use
23. Never thaw eggs on counter top !
24. If there still appears to be thick "globs" in the egg , a quick spin in the blender will smooth them out , or a good whisk
25. Use as you would normally from the shell
26. I have seen instructions stating that salt or sugar must be added when freezing eggs
27. I personally have never done that , and after 15 yrs of using the above system monthly , i have safely raised 7 children , not to mention several "strays" that chose to live with us for months at a time
28. There has never been a problem at all !
29. Servings & time to make:
30. This will vary on how much you decide to put up
31. Once you have a smooth system , very little time is involved
32. I have learned to use my magic bullet - to give them a quick beat , and find the little spout great when pouring
33. I also place my ziplock bags upright in a big coffee cup so that it does not
34. --------- for those suffering from s e y f e w s
35. Just mark the bags accordingly
36. Perhaps a good meringue is just around the corner -- maybe you want a really extra rich yellow cake or toss the extra "whites" or "yolks" into the next giant omelette or pancake mix
37. I have not tried it yet -- but i stumbled across recipe # 376260 toasted meringue almond clouds by chef mariajane tonight , and that will be my next egg white usage !

title: veal piccata
steps:
1. Heat skillet over medium heat , add oil and 2 tble butter
2. Salt , pepper and flour the veal on both sides , shake off excess
3. When oil shimmers , add veal to pan and lightly brown on both sides
4. Set veal on warm plate in oven
5. Melt remaining butter in pan and add lemon juice and capers scraping the bottom of pan
6. Pour this sauce over the veal and sprinkle with parsley

title: grilled stuffed portabella mushrooms  vegetarian
steps:
1. In a bowl mix all stuffing ingredients together adjusting hot sauce , salt and pepper to taste
2. Cover and chill until ready to use if not using right away
3. Place the mushroom caps on large baking sheet or platter and brush all over with with olive oil
4. Sprinkle with tops of the caps lightly with salt and pepper
5. Using a large spoon or spatula divide / spread the stuffing mixture between the mushroom caps
6. Arrange and spread out the tomato slices in a "spiral-like" fashion on top of the stuffing
7. Carefully brush the tomatoes with olive oil then season with a pinch of salt and black pepper , then sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese or mozza cheese
8. Grill at 250f or medium-low heat for about 7-8 minutes , or until the mushrooms are soft and the topping is hot

title: stir fried shrimp with spicy orange sauce
steps:
1. Place shrimp in medium bowl , sprinkle with cornstarch , toss well to coat and set aside
2. Combine juice , soy sauce , honey , vinegar , and sambal , stirring until well mixed
3. Set aside
4. Heat canola oil in large nonstick skillet over med-hi heat
5. Add minced ginger and garlic , stir fry for 15 seconds or until fragrant
6. Add shrimp mixture , stir-fry for 3 minutes
7. Add juice mixture and onions , cook 2 minutes or until sauce thickens and shrimp are done , stirring frequently
8. Serve immediately

title: delicious whole wheat sandwich bread
steps:
1. Proof yeast by mixing with 1 tablespoon honey and 1 / 4 cup warm water in a glass measuring cup
2. Set aside and allow to stand until it bubbles up - 5-10 minutes
3. If using instant yeast , skip this step and mix yeast in with dry ingredients
4. In a large mixing bowl blend together water , salt , honey , oil and vitamin c powder
5. Add 3 cups of the flour and the yeast mixture
6. Mix thoroughly
7. Add in as much of the remaining flour as you can stir in
8. Then turn out onto a board and knead for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic
9. Try not to add too much more than the 6 cups called for in the recipe
10. Place dough in a lightly oiled bowl , cover and let rise until doubled in size , about 1-1 / 2 hours
11. Punch down , divide in half and shape into two loaves
12. Place in oiled pans , cover and let rise until doubled
13. Bake in a 350f oven for 35 to 45 minutes until golden brown

title: hawaiian beets
steps:
1. In saucepan combine sugar , cornstarch & salt
2. Stir in pineapple , cooking & stirring until mixture thickens & bubbles
3. Add butter , lemon juice & beets
4. Cook over medium heat about 5 minutes , until heated through

title: icy rhubarb  scandinavian
steps:
1. Add the water , sugar , wine , vanilla bean , cardamom zest and juice of 1 lemon in a pan
2. Bring to boil
3. Cut the rhubarb thinly in a bowl
4. Pour the boiling mixture over the rhubarb
5. Put the mixture in the freezer or the fridge to just cool it off
6. Then take the mixture and put in severing dishes
7. In a bowl add the yogurt , powdered sugar , zest and juice of 1 lime mix well
8. Sever over the rhubarb
9. Enjoy the cool fun

title: cheesy zucchini and chicken pasta
steps:
1. I usually have the chicken already cooked , but if you don't , cook three breasts of chicken
2. Put water on for the pasta
3. While those two things are cooking , put the oil in a large skillet , shred the carrots and zucchini
4. Toss them along with the garlic into the pan and saute
5. By the time the carrots and zucchini are done , your pasta and chicken should be done as well
6. Toss it all together in the skillet along with the sour cream , mozzarella , parmesan , and romano cheeses
7. Let it sit for a few minutes to let the cheese melt and serve !

title: bolinhos de arroz
steps:
1. Mix together the egg , onion , scallion , parsley , flour , milk and salt
2. Add rice
3. Fry rounded teaspoons of batter in hot oil until golden brown
4. Drain on paper towel

title: danish dumplings
steps:
1. Heat the milk and butter in a medium sized saucepan and on medium heat , bring to a boil
2. Once at a boil turn off heat and add the nutmeg , salt and flour
3. Stir until thick and the mixture leaves the sides of the pan and forms a compact mass
4. Set aside and let cool for around a half an hour you don't want to cook the eggs
5. When it is cool beat the eggs in one at a time
6. Drop into hot soup and cover for ten to fifteen minutes
7. They are done when they've risen to the top and doubled in size

title: strawberries and cream coffee
steps:
1. Pour the hot coffee into a blender
2. Add the strawberries , jam , and ice cream and blend together
3. With the blender motor running at the highest speed , drop in the ice cubes , one at a time , and mix until mixture is very cold and frothy
4. Pour into one large or two medium-sized glasses and serve immediately

title: breakfast cookies w fruit
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Mix all ingredients together in large mixing bowl
3. Work with batter and form into 2-3 inch balls
4. Place on cookie sheets about 2 inches apart
5. Use the bottom of a glass dipped in water to flatten
6. Bake about 8 minutes for soft cookies
7. Cool

title: gingerbread cheesecake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 300f
2. Combine all crust ingredients in medium bowl
3. Press into bottom and halfway up sides of 9-inch springform pan
4. Wrap outside of pan with piece of heavy-duty foil
5. Refrigerate at least 30 minutes
6. Process cream cheese , brown sugar and 1 / 2 cup sugar in food processor 30 seconds or until smooth and creamy
7. Add eggs one at time , processing after each addition
8. Add all remaining filling ingredients
9. Pulse to combine
10. Pour into crust
11. Place pan in large baking or broiler pan
12. Add enough hot water to baking pan to come halfway up sides of springform pan
13. Bake 1 hour 15 minutes to 1 hour 25 minutes or until edges are puffed and top is dry to the touch
14. Center should move slightly when pan is tapped but should not ripple as if liquid
15. Remove cake from water bath
16. Remove foil
17. Cool on wire rack 1 hour
18. Refrigerate , uncovered , overnight
19. Beat whipping cream and powdered sugar in large bowl at medium-high speed until soft peaks form
20. Beat in rum until firm but not stiff peaks form
21. Spread over top of cake

title: grilled brats
steps:
1. Grill brats over hot coals browning on all sides
2. Remove from grill and place in large kettle or dutch oven ,
3. Cover with beer , onions and pepper
4. Simmer at least 1 hour not over direct heat
5. The heat removes the alcohol from the beer
6. Brats may be simmered for several hours just add more beer if it gets too low
7. Serve hot on toasted buns , with the peppers and onion or the toppings of your choice

title: potatoes riojanas with or without cheese
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large , deep saucepan over medium-high heat
2. Add the onion and garlic and saute for 2 to 3 minutes
3. Add potatoes , wine and rosemary
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste
5. Bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat , stirring occasionally , for 40 minutes , or until potatoes are tender and wine is almost gone
7. Add some water if the wine is evaporating too rapidly
8. Stir in cheese , if using
9. If not using cheese , stir in butter

title: my favorite comfort food egg sandwich
steps:
1. Spread mayonnaise on bread
2. Scramble eggs in butter
3. Pile cooked eggs on bread
4. Liberally salt and pepper
5. While skillet is still hot , place cheese slice in skillet
6. Let it start to melt , then scoop it up and place on eggs
7. Of course , put other slice of bread on and oh my it is good

title: roasted baby artichokes
steps:
1. Cut off the top quarter of each artichoke and snap off the fibrous outer leaves until you reach the yellow leaves
2. With a paring knife , trim the dark green exterior from the base of the artichoke as well as the exterior of the stem
3. Trim a thin slice from the end of the stem , then cut the artichoke in half , slicing from
4. Drop the trimmed artichoke into a bowl of acidulated water until ready to cook
5. Drain the trimmed artichokes and toss with enough olive oil to coat lightly
6. Season with salt and pepper to taste and place cut-side down on a rimmed baking sheet
7. Roast in a 400f oven , turning after 15 minutes , until artichokes can be easily pierced with a skewer , about 25 minutes total
8. While still hot , sprinkle with lemon juice and more salt to taste

title: salmon stuffed siljans
steps:
1. Soften cream cheese and mix till smooth with electric mixer
2. Add the salmon , lemon juice , tabasco and worcestershire
3. Beat slowly with mixer till well blended
4. Add the green onion and mix in with spoon
5. Refrigerate
6. Take out of fridge one hour before serving
7. Fill siljans with the salmon mixture
8. Serve immediately
9. If they sit the siljans go soggy
10. You can also use this as a spread on crackers

title: easy oven baked pancake
steps:
1. Set oven to 400 degrees
2. Melt the butter in a 9-inch square baking dish in the oven
3. In a medium bowl beat together eggs and 1 / 4 cup milk
4. In another bowl sift together flour , sugar , baking powder and salt
5. Add to the egg / milk mixture
6. Mix until combined
7. Slowly whisk in the remaining 1 cup milk
8. Pour into the hot baking dish over the melted butter
9. Bake for about 18-20 minutes

title: cajun fish with spinach
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f
2. Spray inside of 4-quart cast iron dutch oven and underside of lid with olive oil or canola oil spray
3. Scrub sweet potato well and cut out any bad spots or eyes
4. Slice into 1 / 2" rounds
5. Line base of pot with onions
6. Wash fish and pat dry with paper towels
7. Lay the fish over the onions in the bottom of the pot
8. Sprinkle the top side liberally with cajun seasoning mix according to taste
9. Layer potatoes , garlic , onions , and tomatoes , interspersing sprinkles of spices as desired
10. Top with spinach
11. Pack in as many vegetables as possible without compromising the seal when the lid is closed
12. Cover and bake for 35-45 minutes , or until fish flakes easily
13. You should smell the aroma wafting from the oven that tells you everything is done
14. Wait 3 minutes until it is more of a full-bodied , finished meal aroma
15. Serve immediately
16. Per serving:
17. Cal 240
18. Prot 25g
19. Carb 32g
20. Fat 3g
21. Chol 54 mg
22. Sod 114 mg
23. Fiber 7g

title: grilled chipotle shrimp
steps:
1. Preheat grill
2. Soak bamboo skewers in cold water for 30 minutes , or use metal skewers
3. In a blender whisk the first 8 ingredients
4. Pour into a large bowl and add shrimp , mix well
5. Grill 2-3 minutes per side
6. If you don't want to use skewers you can just add the shrimp to a grill basket

title: jim n nicks cheese biscuits
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Pour into greased muffin pan and bake at 400 for 15 - 20 minutes
3. This recipe make about 12 muffins

title: nigerian beef spinach stew
steps:
1. Brown beef cubes in oven
2. Add giner ale , red pepper
3. Black pepper , and the chopped tomato
4. Cover and simmer 1 1 / 2 hours or until meat is tender
5. Meanwhile , wash the spinach , and remove any tough stems
6. Tear the leaves into small pieces
7. Slice the onions thinly and separate the slices into rings
8. Slice the whole tomatoes
9. Mix the cornstarch with 1 tablespoons cold water
10. Stir into the stew and cook 1 minute until slightly thickened
11. Add onion rings , tomato slices and spinach
12. Return to simmer
13. Cover and simmer until the vegetables are just tender-about 5 minutes
14. Serve with rice

title: spinach and bacon noodle toss
steps:
1. Cook noodles according to package directions
2. Meanwhile in a large skillet cook diced bacon and onion over medium heat until bacon is crisp
3. Use a slotted spoon to remove from pan and drain on paper towels
4. Stir the flour , seasoning blend , and salt & pepper into the pan drippings until blended
5. Gradually add the milk , whisking well
6. Bring to a boil , cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
7. Add spinach and cook and stir until spinach is wilted
8. Drain noodles and transfer to a serving dish
9. Add spinach mixture and top with grated parmesan cheese , tossing to combine
10. Sprinkle with bacon and onion mixture
11. Serve immediately

title: torrijas saladas con ajo  garlic  french  toast
steps:
1. In a small bowl , beat the eggs with a few drops of very hot water
2. Add the minced garlic , salt , pepper and mix well
3. Heat oil in a frying pan
4. Dip a bread slice in the egg mixture , covering both sides well
5. Fry the bread until golden brown on both sides
6. Important: its necessary for the oil to be very hot so that the eggs cook immediately upon contact
7. Be careful to turn bread before the garlic burns

title: mom s marinated cucumbers
steps:
1. Peel the cucumber and slice it thin
2. Mix together the remaining ingredients in a container , then add the sliced cucumber
3. Stir to coat the veggie well , cover , and refrigerate for at least 3 hours before serving

title: spicy stir fried shrimp and peppers
steps:
1. On medium high heat add oil to a large skillet
2. When oil is hot add next 7 ingredients and saute for 3-5 minutes or until shrimp is pink and vegetables are tender
3. Add remaining ingredients , stirring well until hot

title: cheese tomato bread
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Line a medium loaf pan with greased wax paper
3. In a large bowl mix flour , baking powder , baking soda , spices and cheeses
4. In another bowl drain the tomatoes , saving juice
5. Add milk to the juice to make 1 cup of liquid
6. Stir in the eggs , oil and honey
7. Pour this and the tomatoes into the flour mixture and stir until it becomes a moist thick batter
8. Pour or spoon the batter into the prepared loaf pan
9. Bake for 60 -70 minutes

title: paskha  russian cheesecake
steps:
1. Press the cheese through a sieve
2. Combine the cheese with the egg yolks , beating in 1 yolk at a time
3. Add the sugar and blend well
4. Heat the cream in a large saucepan until it almost boils , then add the cheese mixture and cook over low heat , stirring constantly , until the mixture thickens
5. Remove from the heat before it begins to boil
6. Stir in the fruits , almonds , and lemon rind
7. Cool
8. Cream together the butter and the vanilla , then stir into the cooled cheese mixture
9. Line the flower pot with several layers of moistened cheesecloth , leaving enough cloth at the top to form a flap that will cover the pot
10. Fill the pot with the cheese mixture and cover with the flap
11. Put a weight on the top and place in the refrigerator for 2 to 3 days
12. The whey will drip out the bottom of the pot , so be sure to place a pan under it
13. When drained , carefully unmold the cake with a knife
14. Remove the cheesecloth and smooth the sides with a hot knife
15. Prepare the sauce
16. Beat together the egg yolks , sugar , madeira , and lemon rind in the top of a double boiler
17. Cook and continue beating until the mixture thickens
18. Stir in the lemon juice and the rum , then chill briefly
19. Pour the sauce over the cheesecake and serve
20. In the old days , the custom was to decorate it with paper flowers or religious emblems and have the priest come by and bless it
21. Back then , it was made in a special pyramid-shaped form , but you can make it in an ordinary red clay flower pot
22. Visually , the effect is quite striking , and the drainage hole allows the excess whey to escape
23. To make paskha , you will need a large flower pot and some cheesecloth
24. The paskha will keep in the refrigerator for several weeks , but be sure to make it at least three days in advance

title: puffy taco shells
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix thoroughly
2. When the dough is consistent begin rolling dough balls about the size of a ping pong ball
3. Using a tortilla press that is lined in a thick plastic , press out the dough
4. You use the plastic so that the dough does not stick to the tortilla press
5. Meanwhile have a deep pot filled with cooking oil approximately 2 inches high and heated to 250 degrees
6. Drop the flat tortilla in the hot oil and using a metal spatula repeatedly douse with the oil
7. You will see that it will begin to puff up
8. Flip it over and using the spatula make an indention in the middle of the tortilla to forma taco shape
9. Remove from oil and allow to drain
10. Fill with ground meat , shredded chicken , guacamole , bean and cheese or your favorite filling
11. Top with shredded lettuce and diced tomato
12. Caution: be very careful when making these
13. Make sure there is proper ventilation and do not allow the oil to get too hot
14. Also , if you can't get your hands on a tortilla press then use a clean counter
15. You will still need the plastic so that the dough does not stick to the counter
16. Place your dough ball on the plastic and cover with more plastic and then using something heavy to press it out

title: egyptian greens and chicken stew
steps:
1. Combine the first 5 ingredients in an 8-quart dutch oven or stockpot , and bring to a boil
2. Reduce heat to medium , and cook , uncovered , for 1 hour
3. Remove from heat
4. Remove the chicken from the pan , and place in a bowl
5. Cool
6. Strain the chicken broth through a cheesecloth-lined colander or fine sieve into a bowl , reserving onion
7. Discard the remaining solids
8. Return the broth to the pan
9. Remove the chicken from the bones , discarding bones
10. Shred the chicken into bite-size pieces
11. Keep warm
12. Place onion in a bowl , and mash with a fork or potato masher
13. Add onion to broth
14. Bring to a boil
15. Add spinach to broth in batches , cooking until wilted
16. Heat the oil in a small nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
17. Add coriander , salt , and garlic
18. Saut 30 seconds or until garlic begins to brown
19. Add to spinach mixture , and stir in lemon juice
20. Serve chicken and spinach mixture over rice

title: salmon with irish lemon butter
steps:
1. Generously salt and pepper salmon fillets
2. Lightly grease grill with cooking spray or oil
3. Place the egg yolks in a saucepan
4. Cut the butter into pieces and add to the saucepan
5. Heat over medium-low heat while whisking the melted butter and egg yolks together
6. Continue whisking until the mixture turns lemony-colored and thick
7. Remove from the heat and stir in lemon juice
8. Place in a container and refrigerate until firm or serve immediately as a sauce
9. Grill the salmon about 5 minutes on each side or until done
10. Spoon sauce over fish and serve , garnished with lemon wedges and parsley

title: mom s new england baked beans
steps:
1. Soak beans in a pan of water overnight then drain before cooking
2. Boil the soaked beans until the skins crack when you blow on them
3. This step is important because the beans don't soften up any more while baking , and you don't want them to be too hard
4. Drain the beans and place them in your bean pot
5. Add uncooked bacon and chopped onion
6. In a sauce pan , bring the rest of the ingredients to a boil
7. Once everything is melted and combined , pour the mixture over the beans in the pot
8. Make sure the liquid covers the beans
9. If not , then add more water
10. Bake in covered pot at 250 degrees for about 4 hours
11. Check periodically to make sure the liquid level does not get too low
12. They will thicken as they bake , but you should have a little juice so they are not too dry
13. The beans will be dark brown , and thick when they are done

title: easy praline pear pudding
steps:
1. Set oven to 375 degrees
2. Butter a 2-quart casserole dish
3. In a mixing bowl combine first 6 ingredients
4. Add in milk and beat until smooth
5. Stir in chopped pears and pecans
6. Toss to combine
7. Spoon into baking dish
8. In another bowl combine brown sugar , butter and water
9. Pour over the batter in the dish
10. Bake , uncovered for about 45 minutes

title: lemonade slushie
steps:
1. Put pan in freezer
2. Blend lemon juice , water and sugar till dissolved
3. Pour into cold pan and stick in freezer
4. When frozen run a fork through it till it's slushi
5. Eat and enjoy !

title: debbie claire s cheesy crock pot macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Cook noodles , drain
2. Add butter , salt , cheese soup , evaporated milk , and eggs
3. Mix well
4. Grate cheese
5. Save 3 / 4 cup and add the rest to the macaroni mixture
6. Mix well and pour into the crock pot
7. Put 3 / 4 cheese on top
8. Cover and cook on low for 2-2 1 / 2 hours

title: buttered potatoes
steps:
1. Wash potatoes , peel , and quarter
2. To cook heat 1 inch of salted water to boiling , and add potatoes
3. Cover and reduce heat to medium and cook potatoes until tender , 20 to 25 minutes
4. In small saucepan , heat the rest of the ingredients to boiling and keep warmed on low heat to wait for potatoes to cook
5. Drain potatoes in colander and put into a serving dish
6. Stir in lemon butter and mix throughly with potatoes

title: pop pop potatoes
steps:
1. Ok -- dad's directions go like this -- cut , nuke , slash , oil , season
2. Which for the rest of us really means: wash the spuds and halve them , then cook them in the microwave until almost fully done
3. Pull them out , slash cross-hatches in them and oil with a brush , then season them as liberally as you like
4. Put them out on the grill on the top rack for "two beers worth" of time until nicely browned and kinda crusty on the bottom
5. If you like you can also do them in the oven like me along with the casserole or meat that is already in there at 350 or higher
6. They might not get as brown , but are still very yummy !

title: finger licking chicken wings
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients except chicken wings , marinate wings in this overnight --
2. Bake wings in a 350 oven for 1 hour
3. Baste wings after 30 minutes -- with marinade
4. Discard remaining marinade

title: bacon swiss tossed salad
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine mayonnaise , sugar , salt and pepper
2. In a large salad bowl , layer a third of the greens and a third of the mayonnaise mixture , onion , peas and cheese
3. Repeat the layers twice
4. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours
5. Just before serving , add the bacon and toss

title: ground beef casserole with almonds
steps:
1. Brown ground beef
2. Add salt , celery , green pepper , onion , mushrooms with liquid , mushroom soup , soy sauce and water
3. Cover tightly and simmer until vegetables are tender
4. Combine cooked noodles and sour cream with meat mixture
5. Put in greased 2 1 / 2 quart casserole
6. 9" x 13" dish is just the right size
7. Top with almonds
8. Bake at 325 degrees for 30 minutes

title: super quick moroccan chicken couscous
steps:
1. Stir pine nuts and cumin seeds in a small skillet over low heat until just fragrant
2. Bring stock to a boil in large saucepan , remove from heat
3. Stir in couscous , cover , stand about 5 minutes or until stock is absorbed , fluff with a fork
4. Stir in onion , chicken , apricots , sultanas and mint
5. Add pine nuts and cumin seeds
6. Add dressing , toss gently to combine

title: italian sugar cookies
steps:
1. Cream shortening and sugar with electric mixer
2. Add eggs one at a time and beat well
3. Add buttermilk , flavor extracts , baking soda and cream of tarter and blend well
4. Now by hand with a wooden spoon , add flour 1 cup at a time until the mixture is stiff
5. Drop from heaping tablespoons onto a lightly greased cookie sheet 2 to 3 inches apart
6. If not icing you may press on the nuts or sprinkles now
7. Bake in a preheated 375f oven , center oven rack , 10 to 13 minutes or until cookie edges are slightly brown and tops look set
8. Do not overbake
9. Overbaking cause dry , hard cookies
10. Carefully remove to rack to cool
11. Frost or decorate as desired
12. Store airtight

title: shelly s baked ricotta
steps:
1. Mix ricotta cheese , parmesan , beaten egg , seasonings together and place in a oven proof dish
2. Pour marinara on top and top with mozzarella cheese
3. Bake it in the oven @ 450 for about 20-25 minutes or nuke it till hot and bubbly
4. Shelly suggests to first make it in the oven and heat the leftovers in the microwave

title: chinese apricot duck on the grill bbq
steps:
1. Preheat the barbeque
2. Using a sharp knife , cut a long slit in the leshy side of each duck breast to make a pocket
3. Divide the apricots and shallots between the pockets and secure with skewers
4. Mix the honey , soy sauce and sesame oil together in a small bowl and brush all over the duck
5. Sprinkle with the chinese five-spice powder
6. To make the garnish , make a few cuts lengthways down the stem of each scallion
7. Place in iced water and leave until the stems start to curl
8. Drain before using
9. Cook the duck over medium hot coals for 6-8 minutes on each side
10. Remove the skewers , set on a bed of cous cous and garnish with the scallion curls
11. Serve immediately

title: amish rivel soup
steps:
1. Combine flour , salt and beaten egg and mix with fingers until mixture is crumbly
2. Heat broth
3. Add corn and bring back to a simmer
4. Drop rivels slowly into broth
5. Cook for about 10 minutes
6. Rivels will look like boiled rice when cooked

title: st  patricks day grasshopper fudge cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f for shiny metal or glass 13x9 pan
2. Spray bottom only of pan with baking spray with flour
3. Make cake mix as directed on box , using water , oil , 1 1 / 2 tsp mint extract and the egg whites
4. Reserve 1 cup batter
5. Stir 3 drops of the green food coloring into the reserved batter and set aside
6. Pour remaining batter into pan
7. Drop green batter by generous tablespoonfuls randomly in 12-14 mounds onto the batter in pan
8. Cut through batters with a metal spatula or knife in s-shaped curves in one continuous motion
9. Turn pan 1 / 4 turn
10. Repeat cutting for swirled design
11. Bake 28-33 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
12. Run knife around side of pan to loosen cake
13. Cool completely , about 1 hour
14. Carefully spread fudge topping evenly over the cake
15. In medium bowl , stir whipped topping , remaining 1 / 2 tsp extract , remaining 9 drops of green food coloring and the yellow food coloring until blended
16. Spread whipped topping mixture evenly over fudge
17. Garnish with candy pieces
18. Store covered in refrigerator

title: bailey s milkshake
steps:
1. Crush ice cubes in blender
2. Add baileys irish cream , ice-cream and milk , process until foamy and well-combined
3. Pour into 2 tall glasses , top with a cherry and some mint leaves
4. If you like , drizzle chocolate sauce on top and serve immediately

title: pagogae
steps:
1. 1
2. Toast sesame seeds , cool
3. 2
4. Cut steak into very thin 1-1 1 / 2 inch strips
5. 3
6. Put all other ingredients in bowl
7. Mix , toss in steak
8. 4
9. Massage sauce into meat with your hands
10. 5
11. Cover bowl and let marinate at least 2 hrs , the longer the better
12. 6
13. Uncover meat and stir
14. Stir-fry or bar-b-que cook quickly
15. 7
16. Let sit five minutes after cooking , sauce will thicken serve over steamed rice

title: healthy blueberry shake
steps:
1. Dump everything together in the blender
2. You may need to add a little more milk to make it blend - i just splash a little in as needed , using the minimal amount because i like my shakes thick
3. Blend until smooth
4. Enjoy !

title: lolabuster creamy veggie rice
steps:
1. In a large saut pan melt your butter then add the evoo and all the veggies and saut until translucent and all veggies are soft
2. Add the rice and saut with veggies for 3 minutes stirring constantly
3. Add the cream and water , and bouillon cubes
4. Bring to a boil then reduce heat and cover cook till rice is cooked , 20 minutes approximately

title: momma s fried venison
steps:
1. Mix salt and pepper with flour and coat meat with it
2. Heat bacon grease in heavy skillet
3. Brown meat on both sides
4. Cut up celery and add to skillet along with onions
5. Brown lightly
6. Add worcestershire sauce and the 2 cup tomatoes
7. Cover and simmer 1 to 2 hours until tender
8. Serve over cooked noodles

title: indi s devilishly good eggs
steps:
1. Boil eggs
2. Peel
3. Split in half and plate , cover and chill while making filling
4. Put the yolks in a mixing bowl
5. Combine remaining ingredients in the yolk bowl mix well , until creamy consistency
6. Either cover and refrigerate , or place in ziploc baggie and refrigerate for about 2 hours
7. Spoon filling into eggs , or if you want to get fancy :) snip a hole in the corner of your baggie , and pipe into eggs
8. Serve chilled !

title: very easy hash brown
steps:
1. Peel the skin of potatoes if they are dirty , otherwise you can also leave them on
2. Fine julienne cut the potatoes
3. Try to squeeze all the juice from the potatoes with a towel
4. Flavor with salt and pepper according to taste
5. Heat oil on a skillet pan
6. Be generous on the oil , it will make your hash brown very crispy
7. On medium-high heat , pour the potatoes on the pan and try to make it flat and round
8. Do not stir it
9. Turn it over when golden brown and it's done when both sides are golden and crispy

title: hot moroccan chicken salad
steps:
1. Prepare grill or preheat broiler and broiler pan
2. Bring water to boil in saucepan
3. Stir in couscous and teaspoon salt
4. Remove from heat and cover
5. Rub oil over chicken
6. Mix garlic with teaspoon salt and press with side of knife to form a paste
7. Set aside teaspoon paste in a large bowl for dressing
8. Rub remaining paste over chicken
9. Grill chicken until cooked through , about 6-7 minutes
10. Dressing: combine remaining garlic paste and all ingredients except oil and red onion in a bowl
11. Gradually whisk in oil , and then stir in onion
12. Toss dressing in yellow pepper , tomatoes and olives
13. Fluff couscous with fork and spoon onto serving plates
14. Arrange grilled chicken on couscous
15. Spoon vegetables and dressing around chicken

title: strudel  dough
steps:
1. Mix eggs , oil and milk very well together
2. Add flour bit by bit
3. Put onto a floured surface and knead till dough shows little air pockets when cut
4. Put in bowl , cover and leave in warm place for 1 / 2hr
5. Roll out , put on clean , floured cloth and pull the dough with your hands to all sides till very thin
6. Filling: vienna apple strudel - 1 kg apple , sugar , cinnamon , 100 gm sultanas or raisins , 60 gm leaf almonds , oil , soft butter , icing sugar
7. Cut apples finely , add sugar , cinnamon , sultanas , almonds
8. Brush rolled out dough with oil , spread apple mix evenly , roll dough with help of towel , put on oiled tray , brush with oil
9. Bake at 230 c for 1 / 2 - 3 / 4 hr till light brown
10. Brush with melted butter , dust with icing sugar

title: strawberry sour cream scones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Combine and mix together flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt and sugar in bowl
3. Use a pastry blender or fork to cut cold butter into flour mixture until well combined and it looks like coarse crumbs
4. Gently mix in sour cream and chopped strawberries until combined
5. Knead slightly on work surface if needed
6. Divide dough in half and shape into two balls
7. Flatten ball and cut into four sections making triangles
8. Place on prepared baking sheet
9. Bake 18-22 minutes until scones are brown and don't give too much when touched
10. Let cool on wire rack
11. While cooling , cream together softened butter , cream cheese , and confectioners sugar
12. Add lemon juice to make a soft but still firm frosting
13. Use the corner of a zip top bag to make a pastry bag , cutting off a very tiny piece of the corner to "pipe" frosting onto cooled scones
14. Enjoy !

title: suya  meat on stick
steps:
1. Cut meat into thin flat slices about 1 / 2 inch thick
2. Mix the ground peanut , ginger , pepper , cloves and bouillon in a small bowl
3. Thread meat on 4 large wide skewers
4. Coat meat with mixture and brush with oil
5. Grill until meat is brown on both sides and cooked to desired degree

title: orzo with chicken  red pepper  and shiitakes
steps:
1. In a large nonsstick frying pan , heat 1 tablespoon oil over moderate heat
2. Season the chicken with 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and 1 / 8 teaspoon black pepper
3. Put the chicken in the pan and cook for 5 minutes
4. Turn and cook until just done , about 5 minutes longer
5. Remove
6. When the chicken is cool enough to handle , cut the breasts crosswise into 1 / 4 inch slices
7. Heat 2 tablespoon oil in the same pan over moderately high heat
8. Put in the bell pepper , shiitakes , thyme , and 1 / 8 teaspoon salt
9. Cook , stirring frequently until the mushrooms are golden brown , about 5 minutes
10. Add the garlic and cook , stirring for 30 seconds longer
11. Remiove from the heat
12. In a large pot of boiling water , cook orzo according to package directions
13. Drain , reserving 1 / 2 cup of pasta water
14. In the frying pan , combine the reserved pasta water with the goat cheese , milk , 3 / 4 teaspoon salt , and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper
15. Bring almost to a simmer over moderate heat , stirring until smooth , about 2 minutes
16. Add the orzo , chicken and 3 tablespoons of the parsley
17. Serve topped with remaining tablespoon parsley

title: rib rub
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Rub into meat at least one hour prior to grilling

title: yorkshire fat rascals
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Sift flour and baking powder in medium bowl
3. Mix in the pinch of salt and brown sugar , then rub in the butter
4. Add the currants , milk and enough water to make a soft dough
5. On a floured surface , roll out dough to about 1 / 2-inch thickness , and cut into 2-inch rounds
6. Dust the rounds with sugar , and place on a well-greased baking pan
7. Bake for 15-20 minutes , or until the rascals are lightly browned
8. Cool on a rack

title: gingerbread with warm cinnamon bananas and rum
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Butter and flour an 8 inch square dish and set aside
3. Whisk together the spices , flour , baking powder and salt
4. Set aside
5. Stir together the molasses , soda and hot water and set aside to cool to room temperature
6. Cream together the butter and brown sugar until light and fluffy
7. Beat the egg into the creamed mixture
8. Add the cooled molasses mixture , then the dry ingredients , mixing only until blended
9. Pour into the prepared pan and bake in the oven until tests done , 30 to 40 minutes
10. In the meantime do the banana sauce
11. In a medium saute pan , combine the butter , cream , brown sugar , cinnamon and rum
12. Bring to a boil , then reduce the heat and cook for several minutes longer , stirring constantly until the sauce thickens slightly , about 2 minutes longer
13. Gently stir in the bananas and heat until heated through
14. To serve , cut the gingerbread into rectangles and place on dessert plates
15. Top each portion with some of the banana sauce and then a dollop of freshly whipped cream

title: creole smokey breakfast potatoes
steps:
1. Wash potatoes , put the whole , scrubbed , pricked potatoes into the microwave for about three minutes wrapped in paper towel
2. The idea is to get the cooking process started , but not to actually cook them in the microwave
3. Potatoes should still be hot
4. Meanwhile , heat the olive oil over medium-high heat in a large frying pan
5. Carefully remove hot potatoes from microwave and slice into small cubes , leaving the peel on
6. Potatoes should not be cooked enough for the skin to slide around or slip off the potato
7. Add potatoes , spices , salt and pepper to the oil , toss , and fry on medium-high heat , covered , about ten to fifteen minutes , tossing occasionally
8. When potatoes begin to look cooked through , remove lid and allow them to brown , tossing occasionally , for about five to ten more minutes
9. Serve hot

title: guacamole pasta
steps:
1. Prepare pasta according to package directions
2. In the meantime , add avocado , lemon or lime juice , salt , pepper , garlic powder , cheese , chili powder to a food processor
3. Blend until smooth
4. Adjust seasonings to taste
5. You may need a few tablespoons water to get it to blend smoothly
6. Stir sauce into hot pasta
7. Mix until cheese melts and everything is warmed through
8. Serve with a margarita !

title: sriracha popcorn
steps:
1. Pop corn
2. Melt butter , whisk in sriracha and garlic
3. Pour over popcorn

title: new england style hot dog rolls buns  for lobster rolls etc
steps:
1. Combine the yeast and sugar with 1 / 4 cup of the warm water in a large bowl , or in the bowl of an electric mixer
2. Let stand for 5-10 minutes until the mixture becomes frothy
3. This allows the yeast to "bloom
4. "
5. Add the salt and flour
6. Lightly beat 2 of the eggs with the milk and add this mixture to the bowl
7. Melt 3 tablespoons of the butter , and add this as well
8. Have the remaining 1 / 4 cup warm water ready
9. If you are mixing by hand , add some of the water and begin to mix , adding the water as needed
10. If using an electric mixer , attach the dough hook and jog the machine until the dough begins to form
11. This prevents the flour from jumping out of the mixing bowl
12. Add the remaining warm water as needed
13. The dough usually takes the full amount
14. When a soft dough has formed , knead for 5 minutes by machine , or about 8 minutes by hand
15. This is a soft bread and does not require as much kneading as chewier types
16. The finished dough should be soft but dense , and should not be sticky
17. Shape the dough into a ball and lightly oil it with the salad oil
18. Place it in a large bowl
19. Cover with plastic wrap or a slightly damp towel , and let rise in a warm place for about 1 hour , until doubled in bulk
20. Punch the dough down and move to a work surface
21. Lightly dust the work surface with flour
22. Shape the dough into a square
23. Using a knife , cut the dough into 13 equal pieces
24. This is best done by cutting 12 pieces and using scraps to make the thirteenth
25. If there is not enough dough for the thirteenth piece steal a little pinch off the others
26. With the remaining 1 tablespoon butter , lightly grease a baking sheet that is at least 15" long
27. Shape the dough into uniform 7" long tubular pieces ,
28. It is important that all the pieces be the same length
29. Place the tube in a line , side by side , down the center of the baking sheet , leaving a 1 / 2" gap between them
30. Put the pan in a warm place , and let rise a second time
31. Prepare a thick egg wash by mixing the remaining egg with 2 tablespoons water
32. After 15-20 minutes , the tubes of dough will have risen enough that they will be touching
33. Generously brush the tubes with egg wash , return the pan to the warm spot , and let the dough rise until almost doubled in size , 10-15 minutes
34. Preheat the oven to 350f
35. Place the buns in the oven , and bake for about 30 minutes , until deep golden brown
36. Let the buns cool on the baking sheet for at least 15 minutes , then run a spatula under them to make sure they are not sticking to the pan
37. Using 1 or 2 spatulas , carefully lift the baked dough in one piece onto a rack to cool
38. It is crucial that you not let the buns break or tear apart
39. After 1 hour , when the baked dough is completely cooled , move it in one piece to a cutting board
40. Using a serrated knife , slice down the center of each tube
41. You will lose half a tube on each end
42. The place where the tubes met is now the center of each bun
43. They will open naturally when it comes time to stuff them , but you can make a small incision to ensure that this happens
44. Wrap the buns in plastic wrap until ready to use
45. If you do not intend to use all 12 buns , freeze the extras , and defrost when needed
46. To infuse the dough with the delicate flavor of saffron , chop 1 teaspoon saffron threads and add to 1 / 4 cup water in a small pan
47. Bring the mixture to a boil over med-high heat , then remove from the heat
48. Let cool to lukewarm , and substitute for the 1 / 4 cup water added for mixing
49. Since the dough will be golden to start with , look for a dark brown top before removing from the oven

title: orange poppy seed cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f grease 10-inch bundt pan
2. Cream butter and sugar together in a mixing bowl until light and fluffy
3. Add eggs one at a time , beating well after each addition
4. Sift flour , baking powder and salt together
5. Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk
6. Mix well after each addition
7. Fold in poppy seeds , vanilla and grated orange zest
8. Pour batter into the prepared pan
9. Set on middle rack of oven and bake for 50-60 minutes , or until edges shrink away slightly from sides of pan and cake tester inserted into center comes out clean
10. Let cake cool in the pan for 30 minutes before turning it out onto a cake rack
11. When cake has slightly cooled , prick holes in it 1 1 / 2 inches apart with a long toothpick and pour the orange glaze evenly over top
12. Serve warm
13. Disposable loaf pans work great for this , as the pans hold all the glaze and keep the cake moist
14. Orange glaze
15. 1 / 2 cup fresh orange juice
16. 1 / 2 cup granulated sugar
17. Combine orange juice and sugar in a small saucepan and simmer gently for 5 minutes , stirring occasionally , until a light syrup forms

title: herbed apple jelly
steps:
1. Prepare home canning jars and lids according to manufacturer's instructions
2. Combine apple juice and pectin is a large saucepan
3. Tie herbs in a cheesecloth bag and add to juice mixture
4. Bring mixture to a boil over high heat
5. Add sugar until dissolved
6. Return to a rolling boil
7. Boil hard for 1 minute , stirring constantly
8. Discard cheesecloth bag
9. Remove from heat
10. Skim foam , if necessary
11. Ladle hot jelly into hot sterilized jars , leaving 1 / 4 inch headspace
12. Wipe jar rim clean
13. Place lid on jar with sealing compound next to glass
14. Screw band down evenly and firmly
15. Process 5 minutes in a boiling water canner

title: crispy kale
steps:
1. Toss ingrediants together
2. Spread in an even layer on a large wire rack on top of a large baking pan
3. Bake 350 degrees for 15 min

title: rhubarb bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Spoon 1-1 / 2 cups flour into a dry measuring cup
3. Combine flour and 1 / 4 cup sugar in a bowl
4. Cut in butter or margarine until it resembles coarse meal
5. Press mixture into a 13x9 pan that has been lightly sprayed with non-stick cooking spray
6. Bake at 350 for 15 minutes or until lightly browned
7. While that is baking , combine 1 / 3 cup flour and 1-1 / 2 cups sugar into a large bowl
8. Add milk and eggs , stirring until well blended
9. Stir in rhubarb
10. Pour over crust , bake for 40 minutes at 350 or until set
11. Cool completely at room temperature
12. Combine 1 / 2 cup sugar , cream cheese and vanilla in a bowl
13. Beat at medium speed until smooth
14. Glently fold in whipped topping , spread evenly over custard
15. Cover and chill at least one hour
16. Refrigerate leftovers

title: sommer s chocolate peanut butter caramel crisps  no bake cookies
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan combine first 4 ingredients over medium , stirring constantly until sugar is dissolved and mixture is boiling
2. Turn off heat
3. Mixture will continue to boil , stir often
4. When caramel sauce has stopped boiling , remove pan from heat and pour sauce into a glass pyrex measuring cup
5. Let sit to thicken a few minutes
