6. You might want to stir occasionally with a fork , but the sauce should be fine
7. Meanwhile , in a large saucepan combine next four ingredients over medium-high heat
8. As soon as mixture begins to boil , stir in peanut butter and vanilla
9. Turn off heat and continue stirring to melt peanut butter
10. Stir in crisp rice cereal
11. Stir in caramel sauce
12. Combine all well
13. I have no idea how much this yields
14. I thought about adding some marshmallows , but decided not to
15. I had run out of crisp rice cereal
16. I had planned to drop the mixture from tablespoons onto wax paper lightly sprayed with non-stick cooking spray and then let cool
17. But the loose consistency demanded that i just spread out the mixture on the wax-paper covered baking sheet
18. It was a lopsided effort but i spread it out as evenly as possible , making for a thin layer , which i could just cut apart after cooling
19. Careful , the mix doesn't stay binded very well but i refridgerated the results for 30 mins and cut off a piece with the edge of a spatula
20. I thought the taste was very good , sweet and rich
21. Tastes nothing much like what i was going for but tastes good imo
22. The 'cookie' completely falls apart so eat carefully , lol ! just have to experiment with the ratios more when i can buy more cereal
23. Well , hope no one is too disappointed or frustrrated by my poor efforts
24. :d have fun !

title: tomato  lettuce and olive salad tossed with parsley vinaigrette
steps:
1. Put olive oil , vinegar , grated cheese , parsley and mustard in a glass jar and shake well to combine
2. Season with salt and pepper to taste and set aside
3. Combine lettuce , tomatoes and olives in large salad bowl
4. Toss
5. Add dressing to salad and toss again

title: the monkey
steps:
1. Fill a blender 1 / 3 full of ice
2. Add ingredients and blend until creamy
3. Pour into a glass and garnish with pineapple

title: sauted chicken breasts with creamy chive sauce
steps:
1. Place chicken between sheets of plastic wrap and pound with a meat mallet or heavy skillet until flattened
2. Season both sides with teaspoon salt
3. Place cup flour in a small glass baking dish and drag the chicken in it
4. Discard excess flour
5. Heat 2 teaspoons oil in large skillet over medium-high heat
6. Add the chicken and cook until golden brown
7. Transfer to a plate , cover and keep warm
8. Heat remaining 1 teaspoon oil in the pan over medium-high heat
9. Sprinkle with the remaining 1 tablespoon flour
10. Stir to coat
11. Add wine , broth , and the remaining teaspoon salt
12. Bring to a boil , stirring often
13. Return chicken and any accumulated juices to the pan , reduce heat to a simmer , and cook until heated through , about 6 minutes
14. Stir in sour cream and mustard until smooth
15. Turn the chicken to coat with the sauce
16. Stir in chives and serve immediately

title: strawberry s mores
steps:
1. Break graham crackers crosswise into squares
2. Roast marshmallows until lightly brown and melted inside
3. Spread strawberry jam onto 4 graham cracker squares
4. Top with marshmallow
5. Top with strawberry slices
6. Top with remaining graham cracker squares and press lightly
7. Serve warm

title: light fantastic pizza sandwich
steps:
1. Butter the outside of the bread slices , and fill the inside sides of the sandwich as follows:
2. Tablespoon of tomato sauce , spread on one slice of each sandwich
3. Top with chicken generously , then sliced pineapple , and cheese
4. Finish off with upper slice of bread , then press and toast
5. Enjoy : ))

title: baked tater soup for mystergirl and the sa s
steps:
1. Cook onion til nearly carmelized bake taters until tender
2. Cool onion and taters , mash or run through food processor- i use the processor
3. Melt butter whisk in flour and cook over med heat
4. Heat milk in separate pan then slowly stir warm milk into flour mixture , whisking
5. Heat through over medium burner but do not boil
6. Add tater / onion mixture , grated cheese , and sour cream
7. Start adding broth until you get the consistency you like heat until cheese is melted and potatoes are warmed through
8. Stir in bacon garnish with a bit more sour cream and some shredded cheese

title: easy asparagus side dish
steps:
1. Cut bottoms off asparagus , then cut remainder of stalks into 2-inch pieces
2. Melt butter in pan over medium heat- do not burn
3. Add garlic for about 30 seconds , then add asparagus
4. Stir fry until asparagus is tender

title: never fail bread dressing
steps:
1. Melt butter over low medium heat
2. Add celery and onions and saute until vegetables are soft , but not browned
3. Add pecans , pepper , sage and marjoram
4. Stir to combine and remove from heat
5. Beat egg with chicken broth and pour over bread cubes
6. Stir to combine and add butter mixture
7. Fold together gently until well mixed
8. Spoon dressing into a buttered casserole pan , cover , and bake at 375f for 35 minutes
9. Uncover for last 10 minutes if you like a crisp top

title: spinach pasta rolls
steps:
1. Grease an 8 x 8-inch baking dish
2. Boil lasagna noodles in a large pot of boiling water
3. Drain and toss liberally with oil , then place noodles flat on a large oiled sheet
4. Heat oil in a medium skillet over medium-high heat
5. Add in the drained spinach and garlic
6. Cook until tender (about 4-5 minutes
7. Cool
8. In a bowl combine cooled spinach / garlic mixture , ricotta cheese , parmesan , egg , mozzarella cheese , parsley , salt and pepper
9. Mix well to combine
10. Spread about 1 cup pasta sauce in the bottom of the dish
11. Spread about 1 / 3-cup ricotta filling over the complete noodle
12. Carefully roll up starting at the short end
13. Arrange seam-side down in the prepared baking dish
14. Repeat with all remaining noodles
15. Top with more sauce
16. At this point you can cover and refrigerate up to 24 hours in advance , just bring down to almost room temperature before baking
17. Sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese
18. Bake in for 25 minutes , remove from oven and sprinkle with mozzarella cheese , then place back in the oven for another 20 minutes

title: crunchy pecan bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 275f
2. Butter a 15 x 10 jelly-roll pan
3. In a large bowl , cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy
4. Add egg yolk and vanilla
5. Mix well
6. In a medium-size bowl , mix flour and cinnamon
7. Sfir flour mixture into creamed mixture , using hands to mix stiff dough , if necessary
8. Spread evenly in buttered jelly-roll pan
9. In a small bowl , beat egg white just until well mixed
10. Spread over dough
11. Sprinkle pecans evenly over top , then sprinkie lightly with sugar
12. Bake in preheated oven about 1 hour or until set
13. Cut in 2 x 1" bars or diamond shapes while still very warm
14. Remove cookies from baking sheet to wire racks and cool
15. Cookies become crisp as they cool

title: black bean chicken stew oamc
steps:
1. In oil saute the bell peppers , onions , garlic , chili powder , and cumin until the onion is soft and the chili powder is fragrant
2. Add the beans and tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes
3. Remove from heat , stir in the chicken and corn
4. Refrigerate in covered containers up to three days or freeze up to 2 months
5. To serve: thaw first , then heat up until simmering
6. If serving immediately , add chicken and corn at the same time as tomatoes and beans

title: griddled marinated aubergine  eggplant  with feta
steps:
1. Heat a frying pan until very hot
2. Brush the eggplant with a little oil and fry in batches until soft and cooked through
3. Arrange on a platter
4. Mix the lemon juice and garlic together with 5 tbsp of the olive oil and some salt and pepper , to taste
5. Drizzle over the eggplant
6. Let the dish sit for 5 minutes , then scatter the cheese and herbs over and serve

title: green beans oamc
steps:
1. Steam green beans until just underdone
2. Plunge into cold water , cool and drain
3. Place scallions in the hot water to soften a couple minutes remove
4. Combine lemon juice , mustard , oil , parsley , chives , garlic , salt & pepper
5. Tie green beans with green part of scallion
6. Place in container , pour dressing over it
7. Freeze
8. To cook: thaw in fridge overnight
9. Heat in microwave at 50%
10. Check every two minutes until heated throughout

title: quick pickled cucumber and ginger
steps:
1. Mix water , vinegar and sugar in a bowl until the sugar has dissolved
2. Mix in the cucumber , ginger and onion
3. Refrigerate for several hours until ready to serve

title: jolly cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350
2. Cream butter , sugar , lemon zest , and eggs
3. Fold in 1 / 2 the flour , then the whisky & lastly remaining flour
4. Spoon into two greased 18 cm round tins
5. Bake 25mins
6. Allow to cool on a rack
7. For icing & filling
8. Beat together all ingredients
9. Sandwich cake together with 1 / 2 butter cream & swirl the rest over the top

title: dango  sweet japanese dumplings
steps:
1. Combine the mochiko slowly and gradually with the water in the mixing bowl , trying to get a solid-but-squishy dough
2. Knead the dough well
3. Make small round dumplings with the dough , roughly 1 inch in diameter at the most
4. Steam the dango for 10-15 mins in the steamer on medium or high heat , depending on your steamer
5. When they are done take them off and let the cool on a wire rack
6. Mix the sugar , water and soysauce in the small pan over a medium heat
7. Combine the katakuriko with the small tablespoon and a half of water
8. When the sauce starts to boil , add the mixture in the cup to it , mix and remove from heat
9. Grill the dango slightly and add the sauce to taste
10. Yum ! anime-licous !

title: apache cheese bread
steps:
1. Cut the top of the bread off reserving the top
2. Hollow out the inside
3. Combine remaining ingredients and mix well
4. Fill the bread with the cheese mixture
5. Replace the top
6. Place on a cookie sheet and bake in a 350 degree oven for one hour and 10 minutes
7. Serve with tortilla chips

title: marinated brisket
steps:
1. Mix the lemon juice , pepper , parsley and marjoram together
2. Coat the brisket with the mixture and let marinate overnight in the refrigerator
3. It's best to do this in the baking dish that you will be using
4. The next day brown the meat on all sides and return to the marinade
5. Add the onion and red wine over the top of the brisket and cover with foil
6. Roast in oven at 325 degrees f for 2 1 / 2 to 3 hours

title: applebee s blonde brownies
steps:
1. Brownies: combine flour , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
2. Add nuts , mix well , and set aside
3. Melt butter , add brown sugar , and mix well
4. Add egg and vanilla and mix well
5. Gradually combine with flour mixture , mixing well
6. Stir in white chocolate chips
7. Pour into a 9-inch square pan and bake at 350 for 20-25 minutes
8. Sauce: combine syrup and butter , cook over low heat until butter is melted
9. Stir in brown sugar until dissolved and remove from heat
10. Beat in cream cheese and maple extract until smooth
11. Heat again in the microwave until it reaches desired consistency

title: creamy espresso milkshake
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , combine the sugar , espresso powder , cocoa powder , and 1 / 4 cup of water
2. Bring to a boil over low heat
3. Set aside to cool to room temperature
4. Pour half of the espresso mixture into a blender
5. Add 2 cups of the milk , 4 of the ice cubes and 1 / 4 teaspoon of the vanilla
6. Blend until thick and foamy
7. Pour into 2 tall glasses
8. Repeat with the remaining espresso mixture , milk , ice and vanilla

title: tropical fruit cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix cake mix , oranges with juice and eggs
3. Beat till well mix around 2 minutes
4. Pour into prepared pan 13 by 9 and spread
5. Bake 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted into center comes out clean
6. Let cool completely
7. Mix cool whip , pudding and pineapple
8. Spread on cooled cake and refridgerate till ready to serve and any leftovers
9. Can use sugar free coolwhip and sugar free pudding
10. You might try to mix a ripe banana in with the oranges in the cake and about 1 / 2 cup coconut in with the frosting
11. Sounds yummy to me

title: nicks pressure cooker bowl of red   traditional texas chili
steps:
1. Steps:
2. Break off stems of the chiles and remove the seeds
3. Place chiles in pressure cooker
4. Add beef stock , chicken stock and enough water to cover
5. Cover the cooker securely , place the weight on the port and pressure cook for 10 minutes
6. While this is cooking , dice your meat and measure out your spices
7. Release pressure by running under cold tap water until safe to open cooker
8. After the pressure has been released , put the chiles into a blender with a small amount of the liquid and puree to make a smooth , thin paste
9. Reserve the remaining liquid
10. Add shortening to pressure cooker pan and brown meat
11. Sprinkle the flour over the meat and stir
12. The meat will release some moisture during browning and the flour will absorb the oil and help to thicken the juice
13. Stir in the chile puree
14. Add enough of the reserved liquid so that the meat is covered to a depth of about 2 inches
15. Reserve any remaining liquid to use if you want to thin down the chili after it is cooked
16. Add the tomato sauce , paprika , onion powder , garlic powder , chili powder , black pepper , white pepper , cayenne , oregano , and cumin
17. Bring mixture to a boil and cover the pressure cooker
18. Cover and pressure cook for 30 minutes
19. Release the pressure , taste , adjust seasoning and add the masa harina
20. Return to a boil
21. Serve hot over cornbread , on chili dogs , omelets , hamburgers , fries , or chips
22. The pressure cooker will meld the flavors and tenderize the meat
23. Refrigerate any remaining servings

title: virginia s excellent greek spanakopita
steps:
1. Defrost , drain , and squeeze the spinach dry as possible and set aside
2. Heat a large skillet and add oil
3. Saute onion for a few minutes , just until they begin to get translucent , not brown
4. Add scallions and saute a few minutes longer
5. Add parsley and dill and saute for a few seconds
6. Season with pepper
7. Combine lightly beaten eggs , spinach , feta , parmesan cheese , and the onions mixture in a large bowl , mixing gently until combined
8. Using a pastry brush , very lightly butter a large jelly roll pan - it should be a large rectangular shape with fairly low sides
9. Set a sheet or two of phyllo pastry into the pan to evenly cover the bottom , and then brush very lightly with butter
10. Repeat until you have 10 layers of pastry in the pan
11. Spread spinach mixture evenly in the pan
12. Preheat oven to 300f
13. Meanwhile , layer another 10 layers of phyllo pastry on top , as before , folding and tucking in edges at the corners as you go
14. Using a clean spray bottle filled with some cold water , lightly mist surface- this will produce a crispy top layer
15. Using a sharp knife , cut into 24 squares
16. Bake in the preheated oven for about 1 hour

title: chicken stew with dumplings
steps:
1. Heat oil in 4-quart dutch oven over medium heat until hot
2. Add carrots , onion , green pepper and celery
3. Cook and stir 5 minutes or until onion is tender
4. Stir in chicken broth , reserving 1 / 3 cup
5. Bring to a boil
6. Mix reserved 1 / 3 cup broth and flour
7. Stir into boiling mixture
8. Boil , stirring constantly , for 1 minute or until thickened
9. Stir chicken , potatoes , mushrooms , peas and herbs into mixture
10. Reduce heat to low
11. Simmer , covered , 18 to 20 minutes or until vegetables are almost tender and chicken is no longer pink in center
12. Add salt and pepper
13. For herb dumplings , combine biscuit mix and herbs in small bowl
14. Stir in milk to form soft dough
15. Spoon dumpling mixture on top of stew in 8 large spoonfuls
16. Reduce heat to low
17. Cook , uncovered , 10 minutes
18. Cover and cook 10 minutes or until biscuits are tender and toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
19. Serve in shallow bowls

title: banana walnut buttermilk bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a large bowl cream together the sugar and the butter
3. Add eggs one at a time , beating after each addition
4. Beat in mashed bananas and vanilla and continue beating until mixture is smooth
5. In a large measuring cup stir baking soda into the buttermilk and add it to the banana mixture along with the flour and chopped nuts
6. Stir the batter until it is just combined
7. Pour batter into a greased and floured 9x5 inch loaf pan and bake for one hour or until tooth pick inserted in the center comes out clean
8. Transfer the bread to a rack and let it cool in the pan for 10 minutes
9. Turn it out onto a rack and let it cool completely

title: holiday eggnog
steps:
1. Whisk eggs , yolks , sugar , and salt in heavy sauce pan
2. Stir in milk , 1 / 2 cup at a time , blending well after each addition
3. Heat slowly over lowest possible heat until custard registers 160 degrees on instant read thermometer , thickens , and coats back of spoon
4. 25-30 minutes
5. Pour custard through sieve into a large bowl
6. Stir in liquor , vanilla , grated nutmeg
7. Cover with plastic and refrigerate until well chilled
8. Just before serving whip cream in medium bowl to very soft peaks and gently fold into custard mixture until incorporated
9. Serve in chilled cups and garnish with nutmeg

title: avery island deviled shrimp
steps:
1. Cook breaded shrimp in 3 tablespoons butter until browned
2. Remove from heat and keep warm
3. For the sauce: saute onion and garlic in the 2 tablespoons butter
4. Add remaining ingredients except lemon juice
5. Heat to boiling
6. Reduce heat and simer for 15 minutes or until liquid is reduced to about 1 cup
7. Add the lemon juice
8. Add shrimp and toss to coat a bit
9. Serve as an appetizer

title: mom s ice cream pie
steps:
1. Crust:
2. Crush the sugared cereal with a rolling pin or use your processor , and mix it with the butter
3. Chill in the fridge for about 10 minutes
4. Using a medium sized pie plate , spread the crumb mixture evenly in the bottom and up the sides , and press down firmly to form a crust
5. Neaten the edges , and place in freezer to firm
6. Filling:
7. Mix milk and cream in a mixing bowl and add the almond essence
8. Sprinkle over the instant pudding mix and whisk well
9. Pour this mixture into the prepared crust
10. Freeze the pie for about 4 hours or longer , until firm
11. Before serving , take it out and let defrost somewhat
12. Scatter the toasted almonds on top

title: banana crush punch
steps:
1. Combine the sugar and water in a large pot and bring to a boil
2. Cool
3. Add the fruit juices and bananas and mix well
4. Place in a container and freeze
5. When ready to serve , plae the fruit mixture in a punch bowl
6. Allow to soften slightly
7. Break into slush
8. Add the soda , raspberries if using , and tint with food coloring if desired

title: nummy namma choc oat chip cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease and lightly flour a 9 x 13-inch baking pan
3. In a large mixing bowl combine sugar , margarine and eggs , then stir in buttermilk , bananas and vanilla extract
4. In another bowl combine flour , oats , soda and salt , and then mix into the banana mixture
5. Gently stir in chocolate morsels and spread in prepared baking pan
6. Sprinkle with walnuts
7. Bake 30-35 minutes
8. Cool completely on wire rack
9. Keeps quite awhile in the refrigerator

title: chinese cabbage  snow pea and mushroom stir fry
steps:
1. Combine soy sauce , kecap manis , sesame oil and sugar
2. Heat peanut oil in wok over high heat
3. Add onion and almonds stir-fry 1 minute
4. Add ginger , mushrooms and stir fry 2 minutes
5. Add snow peas , cabbage and sauce mixture
6. Stir-fry 2 minutes
7. Serve with steamed rice

title: mom s turkey chicken hash
steps:
1. Pick the meat off the carcass and shred with your fingers
2. If you do this while the bird is still warm , it is so much easier than when it's cold
3. Also: the best broth comes from the drippings in the pan , so if you have to use canned , heat the broth up with your chicken meat stirred in to make a better flavored stock
4. In a very large skillet , crumble the stuffing and cornbread
5. Stir in the celery , onion , and meat
6. Pour on the giblet gravy and start with 2 cups of chicken stock
7. Heat over low heat
8. Mash with a potato masher to break up the cornbread and dressing
9. It should be moist , but not soupy
10. Cover loosely and simmer until heated through
11. Add more chicken stock if it gets dry
12. This can be served with or without side dishes

title: stewed prunes
steps:
1. Place prunes in a saucepan and cover with cold water and lemon juice
2. Cover and simmer on the lowest heat for 20-30 minutes or until soft and much of the water has been absorbed
3. Serve
4. The other option is to combine all ingredients and place in the refrigerator overnight and serve cold

title: goat cheese stuffed eggs
steps:
1. Halve eggs lengthwise
2. Remove yolks and place in a small bowl
3. Mash yolks with fork and stir in goat cheese , mayonnaise , chutney , pecans and celery
4. Add salt and pepper , to taste
5. Fill egg whites evenly with yolk mixture
6. Garnish with parsley , goat cheese and pecans , if desired

title: best in town crock pot spaghetti sauce
steps:
1. I used 1 1 / 2 pounds of johnsonville spicy hot sausage , removed from casing
2. You can use mild sausage if your prefer
3. Brown sausage , drain and crumble into small pieces
4. Saute onions and garlic in margarine
5. Add to crock pot all ingredients
6. Mix well
7. Simmer for 6-8 hours

title: best ever fresh apple cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease or spray 10 inch tube pan and flour
3. For cake , combine cake mix , flour , eggs , apple juice , oil and cinnamon in large bowl
4. Fold apples and pecans into batter
5. Pour into prepared pan
6. Bake 45 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
7. Cool in pan for 25 minutes
8. Invert onto serving plate
9. Cool completely
10. For frosting , combine margarine , brown sugar , white sugar , and whipping cream in saucepan
11. Bring to a boil over medium heat
12. Boil one minute
13. Remove from heat
14. Cool for 20 minutes
15. Add confectioner sugar and vanilla extract
16. Blend with wooden spoon until smooth and thick
17. Spread frosting on cake
18. Garnish with pecans , if desired
19. Enjoy !

title: supper time cheese bread
steps:
1. Beat eggs in bowl
2. Stir in water , biscuit mix , mustard , minced onion , cheese , salt and cayenne pepper
3. Mix thoroughly
4. Pour into greased 9 x 5 loaf pan
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes
6. Let bread cool in pan before removing and slicing

title: banana cupcakes with amaretto buttercream
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Place 12 muffin cup liners in muffin cups
3. Coat liners with cooking spray
4. Set aside
5. Place granulated sugar and 1 / 4 cup butter in a large bowl
6. Beat with a mixer at medium speed until well blended
7. Add eggs , 1 at a time , beating well after each addition
8. Combine flour , baking soda , and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt
9. Combine banana , yogurt , and 1 1 / 4 teaspoons vanilla , stirring well
10. Beating at low speed , add flour mixture and banana mixture alternately to sugar mixture , beginning and ending with flour mixture
11. Spoon batter into prepared muffin cups
12. Bake for 20 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted into center of 1 cupcake comes out clean
13. Remove cupcakes from pan
14. Cool completely on a wire rack
15. Frosting: place 1 / 3 cup butter , liqueur , and 1 / 4 teaspoon vanilla in a large bowl
16. Beat with a mixer at medium speed until smooth
17. Gradually add powdered sugar and 1 / 8 teaspoon salt , beating just until smooth
18. Spread frosting evenly over cupcakes
19. Sprinkle evenly with almonds

title: strawberry melon spinach salad
steps:
1. In a large salad serving bowl , toss together the spinach , strawberries , and cantaloupe
2. In a smaller mixing bowl , mix together the jam , vinegar , honey , and oil
3. Drizzle dressing over salad
4. Toss
5. Sprinkle chopped nuts over the top

title: bacon cheese pinwheels
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 degrees
2. In small bowl , combine cream cheese , sour cream , mushrooms , green onion , bacon , garlic powder and seasoned salt
3. Separate crescent dinner rolls into 4 rectangles
4. Firmly press preforations to seal
5. Spoon 1 / 4 of the mixture onto the rectangle and spread to the end , evenly
6. Roll the rectangle in a jelly roll fashion and slice into 6 slices
7. Repeat with rest of mixture and dough
8. Place pinwheels onto a lightly greased cookie sheet and bake for 11 to 15 minutes
9. Let cool slightly before removing to a serving platter

title: slow cooker beef shanks with mushrooms and potatoes
steps:
1. Cut up the potatoes , mushrooms an onions
2. Place them in the slow cooker with beef shanks on top
3. Combine the rest of the ingredients in a bowl
4. Mix and pour over the beef
5. Cook on high for 2 hours and then low for 6-8 hours

title: universal muffins mix
steps:
1. Combine ingredients and break up any lumps
2. Store in a large airtight container labeled with the date and contents
3. Store in a cool , dry place
4. Shelf life: 6 to 8 months
5. Makes enough for about 5 batches of 24 muffins each
6. To make 24 regular-sized muffins:
7. Preheat oven to 400
8. Coat muffin tins with cooking spray
9. In a large bowl , beat:
10. 3 to 4 eggs
11. 3 teaspoons vanilla
12. 2 cups water
13. Up to 1 cup oil or butter
14. Stir in 5-1 / 2 cups muffin mix and any additional ingredients just until moistened
15. The batter should be lumpy
16. Fill muffin tins full
17. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes , or until muffins are golden brown
18. Applesauce muffins: 1 cup applesauce omit oil
19. Apple muffins: 3 cups raw grated apple 1 teaspoons gr
20. Cloves 1 cup nuts or raisins , sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar mixture before baking
21. Apricot muffins: 1 cup chopped dried apricots
22. Banana muffins: 2 mashed bananas 1 cup walnuts
23. Blueberry muffins: 2 cups fresh or frozen rinsed blueberries
24. Bran-molasses muffins: use only 3 cups of muffin mix
25. Stir in: 4 cups bran cereal 1 / 2 cup molasses 1 cup raisins
26. Butterscotch muffins: 2 bags butterscotch chips 1 cup chopped nuts
27. Carrot muffins: 2 cups grated carrots 1 cup raisins 1-1 / 2 teaspoons allspice
28. Cashew muffins: 2 cups unsalted coarsely chopped cashews
29. Cherry muffins: 2 cups fresh or dried pitted cherries
30. Chocolate chip-fudge muffins: 1-1 / 2 cups cocoa 1 / 2 cup sugar 3 cups mini chocolate chips
31. Coconut muffins: 3 cups toasted flaked coconut
32. Cranberry-orange muffins: 2 cups chopped fresh or frozen cranberries 1 cup nuts 1 / 2 cup orange juice 2 tb
33. Orange peel
34. Currant muffins: 1-1 / 2 cups currants 1 cup chopped nuts
35. Date nut muffins: 1 cup chopped dates 1 cup chopped nuts
36. Eggnog muffins: 4 teaspoons rum extract 2 cups eggnog before baking , top with mixture of: 2 tb
37. Sugar 1 teaspoons nutmeg 1 / 2 teaspoons cinnamon
38. Fig muffins: 2 cups dried chopped figs 1 cup chopped walnuts
39. Fruit muffins: 2 cups dried diced fruit

41. Gingerbread muffins: 2 tb
42. Ground ginger 1 / 2 cup molasses 2 cups raisins
43. Granola muffins: reduce muffin mix to 4 cups and add: 1-1 / 2 cups granola
44. Top with additional granola before baking
45. Grape nuts muffins: reduce muffin mix to 4 cups and add: 2-1 / 2 cups grape nuts and 1 teaspoons allspice
46. Hazelnut muffins: 2 teaspoons ground cardamom 2 cups chopped hazelnuts
47. Incredible cream cheese muffins: combine: 2 packages cream cheese 1 / 2 cup sugar 2 eggs
48. Drop this mix by tb
49. Onto top of muffins before baking
50. Jam muffins: 1-1 / 2 cups jam or preserves 1 cup chopped nuts
51. Kisses and hugs muffins: 1-1 / 2 cups cocoa 1 / 2 cup sugar after filling muffin tins 3 / 4 full , drop one hersheys kiss into the center of each muffin , pushing down slightly until kiss is covered
52. Ice cooled muffins with confectioners sugar and water glaze
53. Lemon muffins: omit 1 cup water and replace with 1 cup lemon juice use 4 eggs , 1 / 2 cup chopped nuts
54. Lemon-poppy seed: 2 packages instant lemon pudding mix 2 t poppy seeds , use 4 eggs , omit 1 cup water and replace with 1 cup lemon juice
55. Mandarin muffins: 2 cans crushed mandarin oranges reduce water to 1 cup 1-1 / 2 cups shredded carrots
56. Maple muffins: 6 tb
57. Maple syrup , reduce water to 1-1 / 2 cups
58. Marmalade muffins: 1-1 / 2 cups orange marmalade , 1 cup chopped nuts , 1 cup orange juice
59. Mincemeat muffins: 1-1 / 2 cups mincemeat
60. Nutty muffins: 3 cups peanut butter chips 1 / 2 cup chopped peanuts
61. Oatmeal muffins: reduce muffin mix to 4 cups and add 1 cup oats
62. Use 4 eggs and up to 2 cups raisins or grated apples
63. Orange muffins: 2 cups sour cream , 1 cup nuts or coconut , 2 cans mandarin oranges , drain
64. Use 4 eggs
65. Peach muffins: 2 cups fresh or one large can chopped peaches
66. Pear muffins: 2 cups fresh or one large can chopped pears
67. Peanut-butter banana muffins: 1 cup peanut butter 1 / 2 cup chopped peanuts 3 mashed bananas
68. Peanut-butter & jelly muffins: 1 cup peanut butter , 1 / 2 cup chopped peanuts
69. Drop 1 tb
70. Jam into each muffin before baking
71. Pecan muffins: 2 cups chopped toasted pecans , 1 teaspoons maple extract
72. Pineapple muffins: 1 teaspoons ground cloves , 1 large can crushed pineapple , drained 1 jar macadamia nuts , chopped
73. Pineapple carrot raisin muffins: 1 cup each: grated carrots , crushed pineapple , drained and raisins 1 cup walnuts , chopped
74. Prune muffins: 1 to 2 cups chopped prunes 1 / 3 cup poppy seeds
75. Pumpkin muffins: 2 cups or 1 can solid pack pumpkin 1 tb
76. Pumpkin pie spice 1 / 2 cup each chopped nuts and raisins
77. Raspberry muffins: 2 cups fresh or frozen whole , unsweetened raspberries
78. Rum raisin muffins: 3 teaspoons rum extract or 3 tablespoons rum before baking , top with mix of: 2 teaspoons sugar 1 / 2 teaspoons cinnamon and 1 / 2 teaspoons nutmeg
79. Sesame seed muffins: 1 cup toasted sesame seeds before baking , top with mix of: 1 / 2 cup nuts 4 tb
80. Brown sugar 4 tb
81. Sesame seeds 2 tb
82. Flour 1 / 2 teaspoons each cinnamon / nutmeg
83. Sour cream muffins: omit one cup of the water and add: 1 cup sour cream 2 cups nuts 2 teaspoons grated lemon peel
84. Strawberry muffins: 2 cups fresh or frozen strawberries , chopped
85. Sweet potato muffins: 1 tb
86. Allspice 4 tb
87. Dry orange peel 2 cans sweet potatoes , mashed , well drained
88. Tropical treat muffins: 1 cup dried mango or papaya , chopped 1 cup chopped banana chips or 2 fresh mashed , 1 cup macadamia nuts , chopped 1 / 2 cup coconut 1 / 2 cup sour cream 2 teaspoons lemon peel , grated
89. Vanilla muffins: 2 packages vanilla chips
90. Walnut muffins 1-1 / 2 cups chopped walnuts
91. Wheat germ muffins: 2-2 / 3 cup wheat germ use 4 eggs 1 / 2 cup extra water before baking , top muffins with mix of: 1 / 2 cup wheat germ 2 tb
92. Sugar
93. Yogurt muffins: reduce water to 1-1 / 2 cups and add: 2 cartons yogurt -- plain or flavored
94. Zucchini muffins: 2 cups grated zucchini 2 tb
95. Cinnamon 1 cup chopped nuts
96. Plum muffins: 2 cups fresh or canned plums
97. Chopped

title: fajita chicken wings
steps:
1. Cut chicken wings in half at the joint
2. Wash and dry chicken pieces thoroughly
3. Place all remaining ingredients for the marinade in a small bowl and mix to combine
4. Place pieces of chicken in a gallon size ziploc bag and add marinade
5. Place bag in refrigerator for 4-24 hours
6. Turn bag occasionally
7. Heat oven to 375 degrees
8. Remove chicken pieces from bag and place on a shallow baking pan
9. Bake for 45-60 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and no longer pink inside , and brush every 10-15 minutes with marinade
10. Discard any remaining marinade you have left

title: brown sugar rubbed chicken
steps:
1. Preheat grill to medium-high heat
2. Combine sugar and spices in a resealable plastic bag
3. Wash hands
4. Add chicken to bag , one piece at a time , shaking to coat
5. Transfer to plate
6. Spray on both sides with nonstick cooking spray
7. Wash hands
8. Grill chicken , turning frequently to avoid burning sugar , 10 to 12 minutes or until done
9. Serving suggestion: serve chicken with corn bread , coleslaw and barbecue sauce for dipping
10. Refrigerate leftovers

title: avocado  black bean and pineapple salad
steps:
1. Roast onion and garlic at 450 for 25 minutes
2. Cured red onions- place the two thinly sliced onions in a small container and pour 2 cups of fresh squeezed lime juice on top of onions
3. Add the habanero chile
4. Then add in salt and pepper to taste
5. Mix
6. Cover tight and let sit in the refrigerator for three days , if you are that patient
7. Otherwise , just set it to cure first
8. Cilantro puree- in a blender puree everything but the oil
9. While the blades are moving , add the oil slow stream
10. Pour into a squirt bottle if you want to do so
11. You will , most likely , have some left over and that is a good thing
12. Salad - in a stainless steel bowl combine all the black beans , hass avocado , pineapple , cured red onions , cilantro puree , chipotle sauce , coarse salt and pepper to aste , and 1 1 / 2 tbsp fresh squeezed lime juice
13. Serving suggestions- presentation with a squirt bottle , drizzle a line or two of the chipotle pepper sauce and the cilantro puree on to a plate
14. Place two tablespoons of the salad in the center of the plate
15. Top the salad with one tortilla chip
16. Fill the tortilla chip with one large teaspoon of salad and serve
17. For a delicious and nutritious alternative , use the avocado , black bean and pineapple salad as a topping on chicken or fish
18. The sauce is just amazing and could be used with other things
19. Go ahead and roast more onion than you need
20. It is always handy to have in the fridge
21. Serves 2 as a meal or 4 as an appetizer , accompaniment or salad

title: vegan banana pancakes
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend till smooth
2. Pour onto oiled skillet at medium heat
3. Bubbles will form and pop
4. Brown both sides and serve
5. You may have to thin batter with water to get it to spread easily

title: soft chocolate pikes
steps:
1. Mix butter and sugar until creamy
2. Add flour and cacao
3. Roll little balls and press them onto your baking sheet
4. Bake at 150c for 10

title: vanilla eggless and dairy free vegan cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Prepare cake pan: line 8-inch round or square cake pan with parchment paper and grease bottom and sides of the pan
3. Then flour the pan
4. Whisk together flour , sugar , baking soda , and salt
5. Add vegetable oil , soy milk , and vanilla extract
6. Whisk until no lumps appear and batter is smooth
7. Add vinegar , stir about seven times , and quickly pour into pan
8. Bake around 30 minutes , until cake begins to pull away from sides and / or toothpick inserted in the center pulls out clean
9. Let sit for ten to fifteen minutes , invert , and cool on rack

title: buffalo chicken meatball subs  slow cooker
steps:
1. Heat oven to 450
2. Coat bottom of a baking dish with oil
3. In a large bowl , combine ground chicken , bread crumbs , carrot , celery , egg , and 2 tablespoons buffalo sauce
4. Mix until just incorporated
5. Firmly roll the mixture into 12 balls , about 2 inches each
6. Place in prepared dish
7. Bake 15 minutes , or until lightly browned and cooked through
8. Transfer meatballs to slow cooker
9. Pour remaining 1 cup buffalo sauce on top
10. Cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours
11. Keep warm until ready to eat
12. Combine the blue cheese and yogurt in a small dish
13. Use the back of a spoon to mash it into a smooth paste
14. To serve , spread cut rolls with blue cheese spread
15. Top with meatballs
16. Spoon on additional sauce from bottom of slow cooker , as desired

title: pralines   cream dream
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , combine brown sugar , corn syrup , and half-and-half
2. Place over medium heat and cook for 7-8 minutes
3. Stir in butter , pecans , and vanilla
4. Remove and cool completely
5. To serve , spoon alternate layers of ice cream and pralines sauce in a wine glass or parfait glass

title: chicken egg pie
steps:
1. Unroll crescent dough
2. Separate into triangles
3. Arrange in a greased 9 inch pie plate , forming crust
4. Seal seams and perforations
5. Sprinkle with 1 cup cheese , bacon and ham
6. In a bowl , beat eggs , milk , salt and pepper
7. Pour over the ham
8. Sprinkle with remaining cheese
9. Cover edges of crust loosely with foil
10. Bake at 350 for 20 to 25 minutes
11. Remove foil
12. Bake 20 minutes longer or until a knife inserted comes out clean

title: heinz 57 cheddar meatloaf
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together well and place into a loaf pan
2. Bake @ 350 degrees for 1 hour
3. Drain grease
4. Let stand 5 minutes before serving !

title: peanut butter date balls
steps:
1. Combine the 3 ingredients
2. Shape into balls
3. Refrigerate until firm or eat immedietly !

title: maple baked beans  crockpot
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat
2. Add the onions , cover , and cook until softened , about 5 minutes
3. Add onions , and all remaining ingredients to crockpot , cover , and cook on low for 6-8 hours

title: cranberry sausage tartlettes
steps:
1. Combine cranberries , sugar , and juice in a saucepan
2. Bring to a boil , simmer until cranberries are soft and some have popped , about 15 minutes
3. Remove from heat and set aside
4. Meanwhile , saute sausage - keep breaking it apart into crumbled sausage
5. Add scallions / onions to sausage for about 1 - 2 minutes
6. Drain off fat , stir in cranberry mix
7. Fill precooked shells
8. Serve !
9. You can make the filling the day before , just don't fill the shells until just before serving so they don't get soggy

title: cheese pennies
steps:
1. Cream butter and cheese
2. Add salt , mustard , and pepper
3. Add flour a little at a time , then rice cereal
4. Form into small balls and flatten
5. Bake at 375 degrees for 10 minutes

title: banana paletas
steps:
1. Pure all ingredients together in a blender until smooth
2. Pour into 4 to 6 molds and freeze until solid
3. Unmold by first running a little cold water over outside of molds , then gently pulling the sticks

title: sweet cinnamon biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400f lightly grease a 9-inch round baking pan
2. Combine flour , baking powder , salt and baking soda in a medium bowl and mix well
3. Stir in vegetable oil
4. Add buttermilk and stir just until blended
5. Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface until smooth
6. Roll dough into a 15 x 8-inch rectangle
7. Spread butter over the dough
8. Combine sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl and mix well
9. Sprinkle over butter
10. Roll up rectangle , jelly-roll fashion , starting from one long side
11. Pinch seam to seal
12. Cut the roll into 1 1 / 2-inch slices
13. Arrange the slices , cut side up , in prepared baking pan
14. Bake until lightly browned , 15 to 20 minutes
15. Remove from oven
16. Pour milk over the top , if desired
17. Serve hot

title: pitcher of frozen margarita s
steps:
1. Add first 5 ingredients to a blender and liquify
2. Add extra water if needed to keep blender moving
3. Dip rims of glasses in lime juice then salt
4. Place a lime wedge on glass rim
5. Serve

title: colorful pasta with ham
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Drain
3. In a greased shallow 3 quart baking dish , combine the pasta , ham , corn , 1 cup cheese and 3 / 4 cup french fried onions
4. In a bowl , combine the broth , soup , milk and seasonings
5. Pour over pasta mixture
6. Mix well
7. Bake , uncovered , at 350 degrees for 30 minutes
8. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and french fried onions
9. Bake 5 minutes longer or until heated through

title: yummy chicken casserole
steps:
1. Place the chicken breast in a dish , sprinkle with a bit of pepper
2. Top each breast with a piece of cheese
3. Pour stuffing mix over chicken and cheese- spreading to cover
4. Mix the soup and wine and pour over the chicken mixture
5. Place in a 350 oven for 1 hour to 1 1 / 2 hours
6. Serve with rice and baby carrots or green beans

title: buck em off chili con carne
steps:
1. Cut rib steaks or roast into 3 / 8" cubes
2. Place into a large bowl and sprinkle with flour , mixing well to coat
3. In a large frying pan , heat olive oil on medium high heat
4. Add coated meat cubes and fry until lightly browned , about 5 minutes , stirring frequently
5. Transfer meat cubes to a large cooking pot
6. Add chopped garlic , chopped onions , red kidney beans including liquid , plum tomatoes including liquid , tomato paste , beef broth , mushrooms including liquid , chili powder , ground cumin , sugar , italian seasoning , cayenne pepper , dried oregano leaves , black pepper , salt , sweet red pepper , green pepper and celery and simmer covered , for at least 1 1 / 2 hours , stirring occasionally
7. Add beer and red wine and continue to simmer covered , for 15 minutes
8. At this time , adjust seasonings to taste
9. In a small bowl , mix together tapioca starch with 1 / 4 cup of water
10. While chili is simmering add tapioca mixture to thicken slightly
11. When serving , add some grated sharp cheddar cheese and finely chopped onions for garnish
12. You can substitute and use 2 pounds of lean ground round instead of chuck steaks
13. Dredge ground round in flour and fry until lightly browned
14. Continue with the recipe

title: sweet   tart pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook noodles , drain and coat with oil
2. Mix sugar , vinegar , salt , pepper , accent , garlic powder and mustard
3. Pour over noodles
4. Add veggies and toss to evenly coat
5. Refrigerate
6. Best if marinated atleast 1 day , if not 2
7. "cooking time" on recipe reflects marinating time

title: salmon and asparagus wraps
steps:
1. In a covered 10 inch skillet cook asparagus in a small amount of boiling lightly salted water for 2 to 3 minutes or until crisp-tender
2. Drain and plunge into ice water
3. Drain again: pat dry with paper towels
4. In a bowl combine cream cheese , lemon peel , lemon juice , and cayenne pepper
5. Fold in salmon
6. Spread on tortillas
7. Arrange one-fourth of the spinach over salmon mixture on each tortilla
8. Then to one end of each tortilla arrange 3 asparagus spears , and one-fourth of the pepper s
9. Roll tortillas startin from the edge with the filling
10. Wrap in plastic wrap
11. Serve immediately or chill for up to 4 hours

title: mile high all butter pound cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Grease and lightly flour bottom of tube pan
3. Sift together flour , baking powder and salt
4. Cream butter
5. Gradually add sugar , beating all the time
6. Beat in eggs , 1 at a time
7. Add dry ingredients
8. Beat
9. Add lemon juice
10. Pour batter into prepared pan
11. Bake for 1 hour and 45 minutes , or until done
12. Cool on a wire rack

title: hot and spicy chex mix
steps:
1. Heat oven to 250 degrees
2. In an ungreased large roasting pan , melt butter in oven
3. Stir in worcestershire sauce , seasoned salt , and pepper sauce
4. Gradually stir in remaining ingredients until evenly coated
5. Bake uncovered 1 hour , stirring every 15 minutes
6. Spread on paper towels to cool , about 15 minutes
7. Store in an airtight container
8. Microwave directions:
9. In a large microwavable bowl , microwave butter uncovered on high about 40 seconds or until melted
10. Stir in worcestershire sauce , seasoned salt and pepper sauce
11. Gradually stir in remaining ingredients until evenly coated
12. Microwave uncovered on high 5-6 minutes , thoroughly stirring every 2 minutes
13. Spread on paper towels to cool , about 15 minutes
14. Store in airtight container

title: pumpkin cornbread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f lightly grease a 10-inch round pie pan or a 9-inch square baking pan
2. In a large bowl , whisk together the flour , baking powder , salt , and cornmeal
3. In a seprate bowl , whisk together pumpkin , oil , syrup , and eggs
4. Make a well in the dry ingredients and pour the wet ingredients inches mix together until just incorporated , taking care not to overmix
5. Fold in the corn
6. Pour the batter into the prepared pan
7. Bake for 25-30 minutes until lightly browned and slightly firm to the touch

title: yogi bhajan s onion soup
steps:
1. Heat ghee in a 4-quart pot over a medium-high flame
2. Add onions , garlic and ginger and allowing this mixture to soften and lightly brown
3. Add the balance of the spices: garlic , pepper , turmeric , caraway seeds and red chilies and cook until well done
4. Add water and bring to a boil , cover and simmer for 30 minutes
5. Add kelp and tamari to taste

title: delicious pineapple sweet n  sour sauce
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , combine pineapple with juice , sugar , vinegar and soy sauce
2. Heat to boiling , simmer on a low boil
3. In a small cup mix together the cornstarch with water , stir into hot pineapple mixture
4. Continue to boil for 1 minute , stirring occasionally
5. Stir in plum sauce and remove from heat
6. Bring to room temperature
7. Cover and refrigerate

title: greek style garlic lemon potatoes
steps:
1. Cut each potato lengthwise into 8 wedges
2. You should have 32 potato pieces
3. Heat vegetable oil and butter in heavy-bottomed 12 inch nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until butter melts and foaming subsides , swirling pan occasionally
4. Add potatoes in single layer
5. Cook until golden brown , about 6 minutes
6. Using tongs , turn potatoes so second cut sides are down
7. Combine garlic , olive oil , lemon juice , zest and oregano in a small bowl , pour over potatoes and stir well
8. Cook on second side , about 5 minutes longer
9. Stirring once more , add ground black pepper and reduce heat to medium-low , cover tightly , and cook until potatoes are tender when pierced with
10. Sprinkle with parsley , stir gently to distribute
11. Serve immediately
12. (optional - add 3 oz crumbled feta and 8 kalamata olives and add in with the parsley

title: hamburger pudding
steps:
1. Cook ground beef in skillet , stirring to crumble , and drain well
2. Add salt and worc sauce
3. Place biscuit mix in bowl and add onion gravy , the cooked hamburger and milk
4. Spread dough over bottom of well-greased 9x9x2 inch glass pan
5. Press down firmly to all the edges
6. Sprinkle the dry brown gravy mix on top , then add the hot water
7. Bake at 375 for 20 to 25 minutes
8. Cut in squares and serve with the bottom up so the gravy is on top

title: cheesy fish
steps:
1. Place fish in greased oven proof dish
2. Combine remaining ingredients and spread over fish
3. Bake at 190c for 20 minutes

title: chocolate crazy paving
steps:
1. Melt butter , syrup , cocoa and sugar together gently
2. Stir in crushed cookies , mix well
3. Spoon into greased 7 inch square tin
4. Press down firmly
5. Melt chocolate and spread over top
6. Leave to set before cutting into slices

title: breakfast smoothy
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in blender and blend until smooth
2. If you want thicker add crushed ice until desired consistency
3. Pour into 2 tall glasses and serve
4. Enjoy your day

title: protein bar
steps:
1. Put oatmeal in a blender , pulse several times , until it resembles a course flour
2. In a bowl , mix peanut butter , honey , protein powder , and oatmeal
3. Press into a 8x8 pan
4. Chill overnight
5. Cut into 9 pieces and wrap in plastic wrap

title: st  patrick s linguine
steps:
1. In a large saute pan over medium-high heat , add the butter and 1 tablespoon canola oil
2. Add the carrots and cabbage and saute until they are just tender and the cabbage is starting to caramelize , about 20 minutes
3. Stir in the shallots and garlic and saute 3 to 4 minutes longer
4. Add the corned beef and black pepper and cook until the beef is starting to crisp , about 10 minutes
5. Stir occasionally during this process
6. Deglaze the pan with the white wine
7. Add in the cream , half- and-half , the mustards and the horseradish
8. Let simmer until the sauce has tightened up a bit , about 5 minutes
9. Stir in the shredded cheese and adjust seasonings , as needed
10. Stir in the peas and the pasta , then transfer into a serving dish
11. Serve immediately garnished with the parmesan

title: budget biscuits
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a pot
2. Take off the heat and add golden syrup
3. Stir until golden syrup is dissolved
4. Stir in sugar , rolled oats and flour
5. In a small bowl or cup , dissolve baking soda in water and add to mixture
6. Mix evenly
7. Put teaspoon lots onto a greased oven tray
8. Bake at 170 degrees celcius for 8-15 minutes or until golden
9. Store in an airtight container

title: must love cheese  chicken   wild rice soup
steps:
1. Cut the tenderloins into bite size pieces then sprinkle with salt & pepper
2. Spray a large pot with cooking spray & cook the chicken until no longer pink
3. Pour the broth & water in the pot then add the rice & seasoning packet
4. Bring to a boil then lower heat & simmer for 20 minutes , covered
5. Mix the salt , pepper , & half-and-half in with the broth
6. Then add the velveeta & shredded cheese to the pot
7. Stir until the cheese is melted
8. Mix the cornstarch & a small amount of water in a cup to form a running paste
9. Pour this into the broth , stirring until it thickens

title: fried dill pickles
steps:
1. Slice dill pickles to approximately 1 / 8" thickness
2. Mix remaining ingredients
3. Dip pickle slices in batter and quick fry at 375 degrees in oil until the pickle slices float to the top , or about 4 minutes

title: sbd veggie moussaka
steps:
1. Heat the oven to 425 degrees f
2. Lightly coat eggplant slices with olive oil and arrange on a baking sheet
3. Bake until softened and golden turning once , 15 to 20 minutes
4. Reduce oven to 350 degrees f
5. In a large saucepan , heat oil over medium heat
6. Add onion and garlic
7. Cook , stirring occasionally , until onion is translucent , about 5 minutes
8. Add lentils , tomatoes , and their juices , parsley , oregano , cinnamon , salt , and a pinch of pepper
9. Bring to a simmer and cook until thickened , about 20 minutes
10. While eggplant and lentils are cooking , in a medium bowl , whisk together half-and-half , egg beaters 1 / 8 cup of the cheese , and nutmeg
11. Lightly coat an 8- by 8-inch baking dish with cooking spray
12. Arrange one-third of the eggplant slices in a single layer in the dish
13. Spread half of the lentil mixture over the top
14. Repeat with remaining eggplant and lentil mixture , ending with a layer of eggplant
15. Pour half-and-half mixture over vegetables and sprinkle with remaining 2 tbsp cheese
16. Cover with aluminum foil
17. Bake moussaka , covered , 20 minutes , then remove foil and bake for 10 to 15 minutes longer , or until heated through and golden on top
18. Let stand for 15 minutes before cutting
19. Serve warm
20. Reheats beautifully

title: moroccan beef stew tagine tajine
steps:
1. Combine flour , salt and pepper
2. Coat the meat with the flour in a large bowl or large plastic bag
3. In a large skillet or dutch oven brown the meat in very hot oil about 10 minutes or until browned
4. Remove from heat
5. Stir into the pan the undrained tomatoes , water , cinnamon sticks , orange peel , garlic , cumin and sugar
6. Simmer covered about 1 hour 15 minutes or until meat is almost tender
7. Add carrots and cook covered until tender
8. Add the chick peas and cook until heated through
9. Serve over couscous

title: kaccy s crock pot enchilada casserole
steps:
1. Blend tomatoes with onion and garlic in blender
2. Pour in medium saucepan
3. Add pepper , salt and tomato paste
4. Heat until boiling , then simmer 5 to10 minutes
5. Place 3 tortillas in bottom of crock pot
6. Layer on tortillas 1 / 3 of ground beef , 1 / 3 tomato sauce and 1 / 3 cheddar cheese , then 3 more tortillas
7. Repeat each layer 2 more times , ending with cheese
8. Cover and cook on low 5 to 6 hours

title: tecumseh sunrise
steps:
1. In a 12-ounce glass , pour in the orange juice , amaretto , and southern comfort -- stir
2. Add the ice cubes
3. Slowly pour in the grenadine
4. Do not stir
5. Serve

title: almond vanilla cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 and cover 2 cookie sheets with parchment paper
2. In a medium bowl , mix together chopped almonds , flour , baking powder and salt , set aside
3. In a large mixing bowl cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy
4. Mix in extracts mix in flour mixture until well blended beat until thoroughly combined
5. Form dough into 36 balls and place a whole almond in center of each ball
6. Bake for about 20 minutes , or until golden brown , check after 15 minutes as i found i needed to turn the temperature down for the second batch

title: roasted butternut squash soup with crispy croutons
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Cut butternut squash in half from top to bottom and remove seeds from both halves
3. Place cut side down on baking sheet
4. Bake for 30-40 minutes or until flesh of squash is fully softened
5. On a low heat , saute onion in butter and oil until soft and browning
6. Add garlic and saute until fragrant and soft
7. Remove roasted squash from skin and put into soup pot
8. Add stock and bring soup to a boil
9. Reduce heat to a simmer and add seasoning and herbs
10. Simmer for 15-20 minutes and then add sour cream and blend until smooth using a hand blender or blender
11. While soup is simmering , toss bread cubes with oil and seasoning and toast in oven until golden brown
12. Serve with chopped green onion and / or croutons

title: lemon cucumbers
steps:
1. Place cucumbers and onion in a bowl
2. Combine rest of the ingredients in a measuring cup
3. Stir well
4. Pour over cucumbers and onions
5. Chill for 4 hours

title: no diet peanut butter pie
steps:
1. For the crust:
2. Melt butter or margarine in saucepan along with the chips
3. Add the rice cereal and mix to coat
4. Press in a 11" spring form pan which has been sprayed with release coating
5. Chill until firm
6. Meanwhile:
7. In a large mixing bowl , whip cream cheese until fluffy
8. Beat in peanut butter and condensed milk until smooth
9. Stir in vanilla and lemon juice
10. Fold in whipped cream
11. Turn into crust and chill until set , approximately 4 hours
12. Refrigerate any leftovers

title: blue tarantula margarita
steps:
1. Pour the lime juice onto a saucer pour salt onto another saucer
2. Dip the rim of a glass into the lime juice and then into the salt
3. Put desired amount of ice into the glass
4. Pour the last 4 ingredients into the glass and stir well
5. Enjoy !

title: aloo matar ka pulao   indian rice with potatoes and peas
steps:
1. Wash rice and soak in 2 cups of water for an hour
2. Drain well
3. In a heavy pan , heat the butter and add the cumin and the ginger
4. When the ginger becomes a light brown , add the peas and potatoes , coriander , garam masala , salt and turmeric
5. Stir-fry till well mixed
6. Add the drained rice & 4 cups of water , bring to a boil uncovered , then lower the heat to simmer and cover
7. The rice should be done in 10 minutes
8. Serve hot

title: popeye split pea soup
steps:
1. Soak peas 8 hours or overnight
2. Drain and rinse
3. Combine with the rest in a pot
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce
6. Cover partially
7. Simmer 4-5 hours or until thick and creamy
8. Yum !

title: chicken in tomato mushroom sauce
steps:
1. Brown chicken in oil over medium-high heat 10 minutes
2. Remove chicken add bacon to pan and cook until crisp add onion , garlic , mushrooms , thyme , s& p and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes
3. Add stock to pan and cook 2 minutes
4. Add tomatoes and hot sauce
5. Bring to boil , reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes
6. Return chicken and simmer another 10 minutes or until chicken is cooked through

title: ruglah
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Combine flour , butter , and cream cheese to make a dough
3. Wrap in wax paper and refrigerate overnight
4. Roll out dough on floured board to inch thickness
5. Cut into small triangles
6. Combine sugar , cinnamon , walnuts and raisins and fill triangles in center
7. Roll up from the broad side to the pointed end to make into crescent shaped rolls
8. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet until light golden brown about 20 to 25 minutes
9. You will have to watch the first batch closely to gauge baking time as every oven is a little different as well as how closely you came to the correct thickness when rolling the dough
10. Allow to cool and sprinkle with powdered sugar
11. The raisin and walnut filling is traditional , but you can substitute any fruit jam or marmalade too

title: simple chicken biryani
steps:
1. Preheat oven too 200c
2. Place chicken in bowl with , cumin , garam masala & tumeric and toss to coat
3. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in dutch oven add the chicken in batches and cook 3-4 minutes or until browned all over , adding a little more oil if necessary
4. Remove and set aside
5. Add the remaining oil , onion , ginger and garlic to the casserole and cook over medium heat until the onions are soft and golden
6. Add the rice and cook for 2 minutes
7. Return the chicken in a single layer and pour over the stock
8. Put the lid on and place in oven
9. Cook for 30-40 minutes , or until the rice is tender and has absorbed all the stock
10. Top with coriander before serving
11. I like to serve mine with cumin and mint yogurt

title: pasta fagioli  bean  soup with smoked ham
steps:
1. In a large stock pot , saute' onions , carrots and pepper in olive oil until tender
2. Add garlic , basil , oregano and ham cook for 2 minutes
3. Add diced tomatoes , crushing them until they have a thick consistency
4. Add chicken stock and kidney beans , bring to a boil and stir in rotini , boil until pasta is done
5. Scoop off excess fat
6. Remove from heat
7. Add salt and pepper to taste
8. Add mushrooms , cover and set aside for about 5 minutes
9. Top with parmesan cheese and scallions before serving

title: grilled fresh mozzarella  prosciutto  and fig jam sandwich
steps:
1. Split each roll , and layer with the mozzarella and prosciutto
2. Spread the top slices with the fig jam , then close up to form sandwiches
3. Lightly butter the outside of each sandwich
4. Heat a heavy nonstick skillet or panini press over med-high heat
5. Place the sandwiches in the pan , working in two batches depending on the size of the pan
6. Press the sandwiches or close the grill and brown , turning once or twice , until the bread is crisp and the cheese is melted
7. You can press the sandwiches by weighting them with something heavysuch as a skillet or wide-bottomed saucepan
8. Though the rolls start off as round , once pressed they are considerably flatter and can easily be turned , if careful
9. Serve right away , cut on the diagonal

title: baba  marion  s perogy dough
steps:
1. Combine everything except flour
2. Gradually add this mixture to the flour until well mixed
3. Divide into 3 batches
4. Knead each until well worked
5. Wrap each batch in plastic& let rest for 1hr
6. Ready to roll& fill

title: crunchy low fat oven fried flounder
steps:
1. Heat oven to 500 degrees and spray a baking pan with non-stick spray
2. Thaw the fish in microwave until the fish is tender
3. In med
4. Bowl mix together the sour cream , lemon juice and chili powder
5. Dip the fish sour cream mixture then coat the fish with the corn flake crumbs
6. Place in a baking dish and drizzle the margarine over the fish
7. Bake uncovered for 10-12 minutes or until fish flakes easily w / a fork
8. I suggest to prevent the fish sticking to the pan , spray the baking pan a little before the fish goes in
9. I didn't spray it and the fish ended up sticking a little

title: hot licks chicken  cooking light
steps:
1. Combine first 7 ingredients in a small bowl
2. Stir well
3. Rub chicken with spice mixture
4. Let stand 5 minutes
5. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium-high heat
6. Add chicken
7. Cook 1 minute on each side or until lightly browned
8. Add water and wine to skillet
9. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 6 minutes or until chicken is done
10. Remove chicken from skillet
11. Set aside
12. Keep warm
13. Add lemon juice and 1 / 8 teaspoon salt to skillet
14. Bring to a boil
15. Cook 4 minutes or until reduced to 3 tablespoons
16. Remove from heat
17. Stir in marmalade
18. Spoon sauce over chicken

title: pony s neck
steps:
1. Shake all ingredients together with ice
2. Strain into a glass and serve , or you may serve with the ice
3. Garnish with lime peel if desired
4. Enjoy !

title: pinchitos morunos
steps:
1. Using a mortar and pestle , mash garlic , cilantro , cumin , paprika , thyme , salt and pepper
2. Add olive oil and lemon juice or vinegar and mix well
3. Place 4-5 pieces of meat on each skewer
4. Put skewer in a container and top with marinade
5. Let marinate for 2-3 hours , turning every once in a while
6. Grill over medium heat until cooked through-- about 10-15 minutes , turning as needed
7. Serve with lemon wedges and cilantro

title: meyer s fire
steps:
1. Place the mustard powder in a small bowl and stir in enough tabasco sauce to obtain a thick paste
2. Let stand 3 minutes
3. Combine cream cheese and mayonnaise in a bowl and whisk until smooth
4. Whisk in as much mustard mixture as you dare
5. Refrigerate , covered , till serving time
6. The leftover sauce will keep chilled 1 week

title: maggiano s little italy italian trifle with seasonal fruit
steps:
1. Pastry cream:
2. In a stainless steel pot , scald milk by heating until skin forms on top
3. Meanwhile , whisk together yolks and sugar well
4. Add cornstarch and whisk
5. Once milk is scalded , slowly pour into egg mixture while whisking
6. Once incorporated , pour back into pot and put over low heat while whisking
7. Cook mixture just until it gets thick and comes to a boil
8. Remove from heat immediately and pour into metal bowl
9. Whisk vanilla extract and cover directly with plastic wrap
10. Let cool several hours or overnight
11. In a small mixer , whip cream and sugar until stiff
12. Fold into cooled pastry cream mixture
13. Assembly:
14. Mix all fruit together in a bowl
15. In a sundae glass , place one cake cube on the bottom
16. Top with two ounces of cream mixture
17. Top with two ounces of fruit plus place for more cubes of cake on top of cream mixture and press slightly
18. Top with three ounces of cream mixture
19. Reserve remainder of fruit as a garnish

title: homemade pickling spice
steps: 1. Combine all ingredients , and store in a airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 10 days

title: onion cheese dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Drain and squeeze onions dry
3. Mix all ingredients together and place in an oven proof baking dish
4. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes or until bubbly and lightly browned

title: brownie fingers
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f line a 13x9x2 inch baking pan with foil , grease foil
2. Set aside
3. Melt butter and chocolate in a large saucepan over low heat till smooth
4. Do not cook , you are only melting the chocolate and butter together , this is very very important
5. Remove from heat
6. Stir in eggs , granulated sugar , and vanilla
7. Stir in flour and the cup cocoa powder
8. Spread batter in prepared pan
9. Bake for 22 to 25 minutes or till a wooden toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
10. Cool in pan on a wire rack
11. Lift brownies from pan with foil
12. Cut into bars , wiping knife between cuts
13. Roll in powdered sugar or , in a mixture of equal parts powdered sugar and cocoa powder
14. I usually serve them plain , and i think they are just fine , but my husband like them rolled in the cocoa sugar the best
15. Makes 64
16. To store: place in layers separated by waxed paper in an airtight container
17. Cover
18. Store at room temperature up to 3 days or freeze up to 3 months

title: thai basil vegetables
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine the fish sauce , soy sauce , lime juice , ginger , garlic , sugar , and sambal oelek for the sauce
2. Set aside
3. The sauce in this is thin from the veggies
4. If you like a thicker sauce , add 1 tbsp
5. Cornstarch to your sauce , but it won't affect the flavor either way
6. Heat oil in wok or large skillet over medium-high heat
7. Add zucchini , mushrooms , and carrots to pan
8. Stir-fry for 3 minutes
9. Add sauce in bowl to pan
10. Stir to mix well , and continue cooking for 5 minutes , until vegetables are crisp-tender
11. Stir in herbs and serve

title: the neely s grilled potato wedges
steps:
1. Barbeque rub:
2. Stir together all the ingredients in a bowl
3. If stored in an airtight container in a cool , dry place , this seasoning will last for up to 6 months
4. Makes 2 1 / 2 cups
5. Potato wedges:
6. Preheat the grill to medium heat
7. Put the potatoes into a large pot of cold salted water and bring to a boil
8. Reduce the heat , and simmer for about 15 minutes , until the potatoes are just slightly tender but not cooked all the way through
9. Drain the potatoes , and dry well
10. Slice them into thick wedges , six wedges per potato
11. Whisk together the olive oil , barbecue rub , salt and pepper in a large bowl
12. Toss the potato wedges with the oil and seasoning
13. Grill the wedges , turning , for about 10-15 minutes , or until golden brown and crisp all over
14. Season with more salt and pepper before serving
15. Be careful not to overboil your potatoes ! leaving some resistance in the boiled potatoes is a good idea
16. You don't want them to fall apart on the grill

title: drunken chicken
steps:
1. Pound chicken breasts to 1 / 2" thickness and pierce several times with a fork
2. Place in a single layer in a shallow glass dish and set aside
3. Combine rum , nutmeg , soy sauce , lime juice , brown sugar , bon appetit seasoning , crushed red pepper and ginger and mix well
4. Pour over chicken and marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes , turning once
5. Melt the butter over a medium heat in a skillet with a cover
6. Remove the chicken from the marinate and saute in the butter until cooked through
7. When done , remove the chicken from the pan and keep warm
8. Add the mushrooms to the pan and sautee until cooked
9. Reduce the heat to low , add the marinade , and then gradually add the sour cream , stirring well , until the mixture is well-blended
10. Cover and simmer for about 5 minutes
11. You might want to check and stir it once or twice during the cooking time to keep it from separating
12. Serve the sauce over the chicken
13. Sprinkle with additional nutmeg if desired
14. If you don't have bon appetit seasoning , you can substitute a mixture of celery salt and onion powder in equal amounts
15. If you would rather use celery seed and / or dried onion flakes , try to crush them up as much as possible , and add about 1 / 4 teaspoons of salt
16. Also , if you find the sauce getting too thick , you can always thin it just a bit with a little milk or cream

title: pressure cooker peas or butter beans
steps:
1. Add all ingredients to 4 or 6 quart pressure cooker
2. Cover and bring to pressure , reducing heat when control starts to jiggle
3. Cook for 6 minutes , turn off heat and allow cooker to depressurize naturally

title: gingersnap pumpkin cream tart
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Stir together all crust ingredients in medium bowl
3. Reserve 3 tablespoons for topping
4. Press mixture onto bottom and up sides of 10-inch tart pan or pie plate
5. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned
6. Cool completely
7. Meanwhile , combine all filling ingredients except whipping cream in large mixer bowl
8. Beat at medium speed , until creamy
9. Continue beating , gradually add whipping cream , beating until mixture is thick and fluffy
10. Spread filling over cooled crust
11. Sprinkle with reserved 3 tablespoons crust mixture
12. Refrigerate until set

title: lightened zucchini bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray 10-by-14-inch pan with nonstick cooking spray
3. Set aside
4. In medium-largish bowl , beat egg substitute or whites for about a minute
5. Add sugars and oil and beat again
6. Beat in vanilla , buttermilk , and zucchini
7. Set aside
8. In medium bowl , combine flours , cinnamon , baking soda , baking powder , salt , and walnuts , mix well
9. Add flour mixture to egg mixture and mix quickly , just until moistened
10. Do not over-mix
11. Spoon mixture into prepared pan and bake about 20 minutes , or until light brown around edges and top springs back when pressed lightly with a finger
12. For frosting: mix cream cheese , butter , vanilla , and powdered sugar until smooth
13. Spread on zucchini bars when cool or slightly warm

title: depression crab salad
steps:
1. In large bowl add shredded lettuce in 1 / 4-inch strips the thiner the better , but not too thin
2. Dice onion and add to bowl
3. You can use less or more onion , but it has to have onion
4. I often add more depending on the hotness of the onion
5. Chop crab and add to bowl , sometimes i add more crab
6. Rule that i generally use is for every head of lettuce , i use at least 4 oz of crab and 1 / 2 of an onion
7. Add 1 cup mayonnaise to bowl toss , add rest of mayonnaise by 1 / 2 cup tossing well after each
8. You may not need it all depending on the size of your heads of lettuce
9. Salt and pepper to taste
10. This requires a lot of pepper you should be able to see the little black dots
11. Left over this is good it seems to marinate and become even better

title: cointreau sunset
steps:
1. Fill a cocktail glass with crushed ice
2. Add cointreau
3. Top with a dash of grenadine , and fill up carefully with orange juice
4. Add a dash of bitters , to taste

title: basic doughnut holes
steps:
1. Combine well the oil , egg substitute and milk
2. In a separate bowl combine well the sugar , flour , baking powder , salt and nutmeg
3. Then add the egg mixture to the dry mixture and combine well
4. Drop by spoonful into hot oil in deep pan on stovetop or in deep fryer
5. Fry until golden brown
6. Remove from oil , draining carefully but while still damp from frying , roll hot doughnut holes in the granulated sugar or confectioner's sugar or you may simply leave them plain
7. A terrific companion to your favorite coffee , tea or hot chocolate !

title: rotisserie chicken   veggie stew
steps:
1. Separate chicken from the bone , disarding the skin and bones , retaining only the white meat
2. Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil
3. Simmer for 2 hrs , or crockpot it
4. Add cornstarch and water for thickening as needed

title: buttermilk scones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Butter a baking sheet
3. Make the dough: in a small bowl , combine the currants with warm water to cover
4. Set aside for about 10 minutes until the currants are plumped
5. Drain well
6. Sift the flour , baking powder , and baking soda in a big mixing bowl or into a large bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment
7. Add the sugar and salt
8. And stir to mix with a wooden spoon
9. Cut the butter into -inch cubes and scatter the cubes over the dry ingredients
10. If you are mixing by hand , use a pastry blender to cut the butter into the dry ingredients
11. If you are using the mixer , pulse on and off so that you dont break down the butter too much
12. You want to end up with a coarse mixture with pea-size lumps of butter visible
13. Add the buttermilk all at once along with the lemon zest and currants
14. Mix gently with a wooden spoon by hand or on low speed if using a mixer
15. Continue to mix just until you have a dough that holds together
16. If the mixture seems dry , add a little more buttermilk
17. You still want to see some of the butter pieces at this point
18. Dust your work surface with flour , and turn the dough out onto it
19. Using your hands , pat the dough into a rectangle about 18 inches long , 5 inches wide , and 1 inches thick
20. Brush the top with melted butter and sprinkle with sugar
21. Using a chefs knife , cut the dough into 12 triangles
22. Transfer the triangles to the prepared baking sheet
23. Bake for 24-35 minutes , until the tops are lightly browned
24. Remove from oven and serve immediately

title: carrot pistachio pesto with bulgur and chickpeas
steps:
1. Place bulgur in a heatproof bowl and add boiling water
2. Season with a pinch of salt and cover with a plate until water is absorbed and bulgur is tender , about 30 minutes
3. Fluff with a fork
4. Stir in chickpeas , scallion , dried fruit , and mint
5. Meanwhile , pulse carrots , garlic , and pistachios in a food processor until coarsely chopped
6. Drizzle in oil and process until combined
7. Season with salt and pepper
8. Stir pesto into bulgur mixture
9. Squeeze with lemon and adjust seasoning , if necessary

title: mexican chicken wings
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In a small bowl whisk together the oil , chili powder , oregano and cumin to blend well
3. Pulverize the tortilla chips in a food processor or blender
4. Pour into a shallow bowl
5. Dip the chicken pieces in the seasoned oil , then dredge in the ground chips until coated
6. Place on a foil lined baking sheet and bake for 45 minutes , until browned and crips

title: maple granola
steps:
1. In a very large bowl , combine the oats , coconut , wheat germ , nuts , and seeds
2. Mix well
3. In a separate bowl , whisk together the oil , salt , maple syrup , and vanilla
4. Pour over the dry mixture in the bowl , stirring and tossing till everything is very well combined
5. A spoonula or large stirring spoon work well here
6. Spread granola on a couple of large lightly greased baking sheets
7. A half-sheet pan is ideal
8. Bake in a preheated 250f oven for 2 hours , stirring the mixture with a heatproof spatula , spoonula , or turner every 15 minutes or so
9. You want to bring the granola at the edge in towards the middle , so it all browns evenly
10. When the granola is a light golden brown , remove it from the oven and cool completely on the pans
11. Transfer the granola to a large bowl , and mix in the raisins and any additional dried fruit desireddates , figs , currants , cranberries , cherries , apricots , blueberries , etc
12. Store in a tightly closed container at room temperature for several weeks
13. Freeze for extended storage

title: spring orzo salad
steps:
1. Whisk lemon zest , juice , water , oil , sugar , salt and pepper in a large bowl until blended
2. Add onions and let stand while pasta cooks
3. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil
4. Add pasta , return to a boil and cook as package directs
5. Stir in asparagus and carrots 3 minutes before pasta will be done
6. Cook until pasta and vegetables are just firm-tender
7. Drain and rinse under cold running water
8. Drain again
9. Put in a bowl with dressing
10. Add mint or dill or parsley to mix and coat

title: x rated  nectar martini
steps:
1. Mix in a shaker with plenty of ice , strain into a martini glass -- and enjoy !
2. If you want to get creative , try using other nectars too

title: agave julep
steps:
1. Muddle the mint leaves with the sugar syrup in a highball glass
2. Add the tequila and lime juice , fill the glass with crushed ice , and stir vigorously to mix
3. Decorate with a lime wedge and a mint sprig

title: smoked holiday turkey
steps:
1. In a bowl mix minced onion , garlic , rosemary , pepper , 1 tsp paprika , salt and enough olive oil to create a thick paste consistency
2. Clean turkey and prepare for smoker breast up
3. With a paring knife or other small knife , make incisions straight down into the meat and to the bone , about 1 to 1
4. 5 inches long
5. You can gouge the holes out deeper below the surface by wiggling the knife to make a larger cavity if you wish
6. Do this all over the turkey , in any place that you can make a hole and pack some of the mix into the cut , about 1
7. 5 to 2 inches apart
8. Use a spoon and fingers to pack all of the holes with your mix , stuffing them to the top of the hole
9. Quarter onions and pack them with the rosemary sprigs inside the turkey cavity
10. With your hands , coat the turkey on the outside completely with olive oil , and then dust down fairly heavily with paprika
11. Tie the legs together with string
12. Place on smoker and smoke as you usually would , about 4 to 5 hours in my particular smoker

title: how to seed a pomegranate
steps:
1. Cut:with a sharp paring knife cut off the top about 1 / 2 inch below the crown
2. Loosen:over a bowl of water , use your fingers to loosen the arils {the flesh-covered seeds} and drop them into the bowl
3. The arils will sink to the bottom
4. Score:once the top is off , you'll see four to six sections
5. With your knife point , score the skin at each section
6. Scoop:use a spoon to scoop out the pieces of whit membrane that have floated to the top
7. Open:separate the pomegranate at each score , so that you have individual sections
8. Strain:pour the remaining liquid through a strainer place the arils in your favourite dish and enjoy
9. Use them to brighten up a green salad
10. Sprinkle on yogurt or stir them into a dry cereal or oatmeal
11. Sprinkle them over your main dish for a lively , appetizing garnish

title: red potato and tomato salad
steps:
1. Add the potatoes to a medium saucepan with enough cold water to cover by at least 2 inches
2. Set the saucepan over medium heat
3. Bring the water to a boil and continue boiling until the potatoes are tender , about 15 to 20 minutes
4. Drain the potatoes in a colander and allow them to dry for 5 minutes
5. In a serving bowl , add the potatoes , tomatoes , scallions , olives , parsley , capers , thyme , olive oil , and lemon zest
6. Toss gently until all the ingredients are coated and season with salt and pepper , to taste
7. Refrigerate for 1 hour and gently toss again before serving

title: chili rice plate
steps:
1. Cook rice according to directions
2. Heat up chili
3. Spread rice out on plate
4. Salt and pepper
5. Layer with the heated up chili
6. Then with the cheese
7. Then onions and chips
8. I`ve noticed sometimes that it all cools
9. Too quickly so i microwave the plate first and even microwave the completed dish a lttle to make sure it is served hot

title: condensed milk chicken parmesan
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Wash chicken and pat dry
3. Mix crushed saltines , parmesan cheese , paprika , pepper in paper bag
4. Dip chicken in eagle brand shake with cracker mixture until coated thoroughly
5. In 9x13 inch baking dish melt butter place chicken in butter
6. Bake 30 minutes turn chicken and bake 30 minutes more

title: irish lamb stew with goat cheese dumplings
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 300f place the roast in a roasting pan and season with salt and pepper then rub all over with olive oil
2. Make 10 small slits all over the roast
3. Insert the garlic cloves into the slits
4. Add the bacon into the pot then gently add the stock over and around the roast
5. Place rosemary and thyme sprigs on top of roast
6. Cover and slow roast for 3 hours , or until very tender
7. Remove from oven and let cool slightly
8. Remove roast and wrap tightly in foil then refrigerate
9. To the stock , strain into a pyrex bowl , cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight
10. Remove the fat from the stock
11. Discard fat solids and set the stock aside
12. Remove the veal from the foil , cut it into 2" cubes , and set aside
13. In a large pot or dutch oven over medium heat , add the butter and melt
14. Stir in the flour and let cook for 3 minutes
15. Add the celery and carrots and saut about 5 minutes
16. Add the onion and saut for another 10 minutes
17. Slowly whisk in the stock that the lamb was cooked inches add the cooked lamb , reduce heat to low , cover and let simmer 20-30 minutes until carrots are tender
