18. Dumplings: in a 2 qt pot , heat beef broth to a simmer
19. Meanwhile , in a large bowl , add remaining dumpling ingredients and mix well
20. Drop the dumplings by tablespoonfuls into the simmering broth
21. Let simmer , turning occasionally , for 10-15 minutes or until the dumplings float to the surface and are cooked through
22. As the dumplings cook , remove them from the broth and add to the stew
23. When the last batch of dumplings are cooked , add them and the remaining broth to the stew

title: spiced hot dark chocolate
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , combine all ingredients and whisk over medium-low heat until the chocolate has melted completely and the mixture is steaming hot , about 5 minutes
2. Serve

title: mexican queso dip
steps:
1. Brown sausage , drain well and set aside
2. Cut velveeta cheese into 1 inch cubes
3. Add cooked sausage , cubed cheese , picante sauce and milk into slow cooker on medium heat
4. Stir occasionally until melted
5. Enjoy

title: apple oatmeal  crock pot
steps:
1. In a slow cooker , combine oats , wheat berries , apples , cinnamon and vanilla
2. Stir in water and juice
3. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours or overnight
4. Stir well
5. Top with walnuts and / or wheatgerm or your favorite toppings

title: colcannon ala western new york
steps:
1. Prepare vegetables
2. Leek
3. Remove stem , and all of the dark green part
4. Cut lengthwise almost all of the way through and rinse between the layers to remove any sand , then thin slice crosswise
5. Garlic
6. Mince fine
7. Cabbage
8. Cut into thin strips and chop into 1" to 2" pieces
9. Dissolve bouillon in 1c boiling water and set aside
10. Over medium heat , melt butter and oil in small dutch oven , add all vegetables
11. Cook until translucent and soft , stirring often and adding 1t of reserved veg bouillon at a time to keep vegetables from burning
12. As vegetables near doneness , boil the remaining 1&1 / 2c water
13. All at once add boiling water and remaining bouillon , heat to boil
14. Turn off burner and add package of instant mashed potatoes and any salt / pepper to taste
15. Stir well , cover and let sit for 5 minutes
16. Remove cover , stir well to blend and serve hot
17. There are many possibilities for what to serve with this
18. Suggestions: tossed salad , sourdough bread and butter , top with grated cheese of your choice or sour cream
19. I've seen many colcannon recipes that call for diced ham , etc
20. We love it plain

title: perogies calypso
steps:
1. Arrange perogies in a 9" x 13" pan so they are touching
2. Sprinkle bacon bits over top
3. Sprinkle sauted onions over top of bacon bits
4. Top with any remaining perogies
5. Mix the soups and milk together and pour evenly over top
6. Sprinkle grated cheese over all
7. Bake , covered , for 1 hour at 350 degrees fahrenheit

title: grouse carbonara
steps:
1. Dice bacon and brown over medium heat
2. Drain and remove , leaving 3-4 tablespoons of grease
3. Brown grouse breast in bacon grease , adding spices and minced garlic as it cooks
4. Once browned , add cream , peas , mushrooms , and cooked bacon
5. Simmer until cream begins to thicken
6. Add parmesan cheese to further thicken sauce , and serve over linguini

title: roasted beet and wilted greens salad w  orange vinaigrette
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Rinse and peel beets and slice into wedges
3. Drizzle with oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper
4. Wrap the beets in aluminum foil
5. Place them directly on the center rack and bake about 25-30 until tender when pierced and slightly carmelized
6. Reserve the juices in the bottom of the foil
7. Rinse and dry the arugula
8. Cut the leaves into strips
9. Make the vinaigrette:
10. Add the olive oil , vinegar , orange zest , salt and pepper to the beet juice and whisk well
11. Place the arugula in a frying pan , on medium heat with the additional olive oil
12. Stir in the warm oil till just wilted
13. Combine the beets , onion , arugula and dressing in a large bowl and toss

title: eggplant   goat cheese pasta
steps:
1. Boil the pasta according to pack instructions
2. Heat the oil in a pan , then gently fry the onion and garlic for about 5 mins until softened
3. Add the eggplant , cook for 3 mins more , then
4. Add a few drops of tabasco if desired
5. Bring to the boil , simmer for 5 mins , then stir through the basil and goat cheese
6. Toss with the drained pasta and serve

title: tequila mojitos
steps:
1. Bring sugar and water to a boil in med saucepan
2. Boil , stirring often , till sugar dissolves
3. Remove from heat
4. Add mint and let stand 2 hours or till cool
5. Pour mixture through a wire mesh strainer into a pitcher , discarding mint
6. Stir in soda , juice , and tequila
7. Serve over ice

title: wasabi ginger sauce
steps:
1. Mirin or rice wine , and wasabi paste are available in asian markets or gourmet / ethnic foods section of grocery stores
2. Place ginger , shallot and garlic in blender jar
3. Cover blender jar
4. Set on low
5. Pulse 5 times
6. Scrape sides of jar
7. Pulse 5 times
8. Add remaining ingredients in order given
9. Blend for 20 seconds
10. Transfer to a resealable container and let stand for 30 minutes before using , to allow flavors to develop
11. Unused portions may be refrigerated for up to a week - stir before using
12. As a marinade , use about 1 tablespoon of marinade per portion
13. Meats such as boneless , skinless chicken parts , pork chops , or steaks can be placed in a resealable freezer-weight bag , coated with marinade and frozen
14. When thawed , they will be fully marinated and ready to cook

title: egg stuffed tomatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Line a 9 inch baking dish with parchment paper
3. With a serrated knife , cut off the top 1 / 2 inch from each tomato
4. With a spoon , gently remove the seed and inner membrane being careful not to break through flesh of tomato
5. Place tomato in baking dish and season with salt and pepper
6. Divide corn and chives among tomatoes
7. Break an egg into each tomato and top with cheese and red pepper flakes
8. Bake until egg is set , about 45 to 50 minutes
9. Serve

title: spinach sausage soup
steps:
1. Brown the sausage in a skillet , over medium heat
2. Drain well
3. In a large soup pot , add the broth , potatoes , and salad dressing mix
4. Stir well
5. Bring to a boil
6. Cover and simmer for 10-12 minutes or until potatoes are tender
7. Add in the sausage and spinach
8. Cook until well heated

title: ground pork with carrots and peppers
steps:
1. In a wok combine pork , onion and carrots
2. Cook until no pink remains in the pork and carrots are tender crisp
3. Drain off any fat
4. To pork mixture add pasta , soya , worcestershire and water
5. Stir to coat
6. Add approx 1 / 2 of the peppers
7. Cover and simmer 10 minutes
8. Toss and add remaining peppers
9. Cover again and simmer an additional 5 minutes until sauce thickens and vegetables are tender
10. Serve over rice

title: greek burgers
steps:
1. Divide meat into four portions and form into half-moon-shapedpatties to fit on half a pita bread
2. Use a fork to mash the garlic with butter in small bowl
3. Set aside
4. Heat olive oil in skillet over medium-high heat
5. Add mushrooms , onion , salt and pepper
6. Cook until tender , about 5 minutes
7. Keep warm
8. Prepare a charcoal or gas grill for cooking
9. Spray grill rack withnon-stick cooking spray
10. Cook patties to desired doneness
11. During the last few minutes of cooking , brush one side of each pita with the garlic butter and place , buttered side down , on the outer edges of the grill to toast lightly
12. Place a pita , toasted side up , on a serving plate
13. Place a patty on one half
14. Top patty with 1 tablespoon feta cheese
15. Place part of the mushroom mixture on the other half of pita
16. Repeat to make4 sandwiches

title: teriyaki marinade or sauce
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients and pour over meat to marinade
2. Or let it sit for several hours and strain the solids and use as a dipping sauce

title: chicken fried steak strips
steps:
1. In a shallow pan or plate , sift together flour , salt , and pepper
2. In another shallow pan , combine egg and water
3. In still another shallow pan , place baking mix
4. Coat steak pieces in flour mixture , dip in egg mixture , and then coat with baking mix
5. In a large frying pan over medium-high heat , add vegetable oil and heat until a drop of water sizzles
6. Add coated steak pieces , in batches , and fry 4 to 5 minutes per side or until golden brown and thoroughly cooked , add additional vegetable oil if needed
7. Remove from pan and keep cooked steaks warm in preheated oven
8. Pour off all but 2 tablespoons of the cooking oil
9. Put the frying pan back over the heat and make the gravy
10. In the same frying pan with 2 tablespoons pan drippings , over medium heat , sprinkle flour over the oil and blend with a wooden spoon or whisk until smooth
11. Whisking or stirring constantly , slowly pour in milk , cream or evaporated milk
12. Continue stirring , scraping loose browned bits from the bottom and sides of skillet , until the gravy begins to boil and thicken
13. Season with salt and pepper to taste
14. Reduce heat to low and simmer , stirring occasionally , 5 to 8 minutes or until gravy is thickened to the desired consistency and the flour has lost its raw , pasty taste
15. Remove from pan and serve hot with the steak strips

title: easy apricot pastries
steps:
1. Pat rolls out flat in a greased 9 x 13-inch dish
2. Spread with jam
3. Bake at 425f
4. For 15 minutes
5. While baking , mix sour cream , sugar , egg , and vanilla
6. Remove rolls and jam from oven
7. Reduce heat to 325f
8. Spread sour cream / egg mixture over jam
9. Bake 5 to 6 minutes longer

title: lentils with spinach
steps:
1. Cut onion in half lengthwise and then cut the halves into fine half rings
2. Heat oil over medium flame
3. When hot , put in onion and garlic
4. Stir and saute for 2 minutes
5. Put in lentils and 3 cups of water
6. Bring to a boil
7. Cover , lower heat , and simmer about 25 minutes or until lentils are just tender
8. Defrost spinach and add spinach , salt , and cumin to the lentils
9. Simmer 10 minutes
10. Add pepper
11. Serve

title: tasty bean soup
steps:
1. Soak beans overnight in about 3 quarts of water
2. Drain and either set aside or if you are using a crockpot put on the lowest setting and add chicken stock with the beans
3. Heat olive oil in a large pan
4. Score smoked turkey legs or thighs and place in hot pan
5. Allow the turkey to heat and release flavor into the oil while prepping the other ingredients
6. Remove turkey from the pan and place into crockpot or set aside
7. Put onions , garlic , carrots , and celery in pan and cook until just tender
8. Add all spices and allow to cook for 3-5 minutes to allow dry spices to open up
9. Add vegetable mixture into crockpot or put the turkey , beans , and stock into the large pan
10. If you are using a pan bring to a boil then reduce to a simmer and allow to cook for as long you can stand ! i recommend at least 4-6 hours
11. Enjoy !

title: sour cream   dill chicken
steps:
1. Lightly spray a 9x13 baking dish with pam cooking spray
2. Place chicken in a single layer in baking dish
3. Sprinkle with pepper
4. Combine cream soup , soup mix , sour cream , lemon juice and dill weed
5. Pour over chicken
6. Sprinkle with paprika
7. Bake , uncovered , at 350f for 1 hour or until chicken is tender

title: battery creek chicken
steps:
1. Roll chicken in seasoned flour and brown in butter
2. Add onion , chicken broth , lemon juice and mushrooms
3. Simmer 20 minutes
4. Add noodles , cover and cook until noodles are done
5. Most liquid should be absorbed
6. Fold in sour cream and sprinkle with paprika

title: easy tropical beef skillet
steps:
1. In a large skillet , toast the coconut over medium heat , until golden and crisp
2. Set aside
3. Brown ground beef and garlic in the same skillet
4. Drain well
5. Add salt , pepper lemon juice and soy sauce
6. In a small bowl combine the cornstarch with reserved pineapple and mandarin orange liquids
7. Stir well until smooth then add to ground beef and cook over medium heat for 5 mins , stirring constantly , until mixture is thickened
8. Stir in the pineapple and mandarin oranges
9. Cook 2-3 mins , or until thoroughly heated
10. Serve over noodles or rice , and sprinkle with more toasted coconut and cashew nuts

title: german chocolate bunt cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. To prepare streusel , lightly spoon 1 / 4 cup flour into a dry measuring cup
3. Level with a knife
4. Combine 1 / 4 cup flour and brown sugar in a small bowl
5. Cut in 2 tablespoons butter with a pastry blender or 2 knives until mixture resembles coarse meal
6. Stir in coconut and pecans
7. To prepare cake , coat a 12-cup bundt pan with cooking spray
8. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon granulated sugar
9. Set aside
10. Combine cocoa and baking chocolate in a small bowl
11. Add boiling water , stirring until chocolate melts
12. Set aside
13. Combine 1 1 / 2 cups granulated sugar and 1 / 3 cup butter at medium speed of a mixer until well-blended
14. Add vanilla and egg whites , 1 at a time , beating well after each addition
15. Lightly spoon 2 cups flour into dry measuring cups
16. Level with a knife
17. Combine 2 cups flour , baking powder , baking soda , and salt , stirring well with a whisk
18. Add flour mixture to sugar mixture alternately with buttermilk , beginning and ending with flour mixture
19. Stir in cocoa mixture
20. Spoon half of batter into prepared pan
21. Top with streusel
22. Spoon remaining batter over streusel
23. Bake at 325 for 1 hour or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
24. Cool in pan on a wire rack 10 minutes
25. Remove from pan
26. Cool completely
27. To prepare glaze
28. Combine powdered sugar and butter in a small bowl
29. Add milk
30. Stir with a whisk
31. Drizzle over cake

title: green beans southern style
steps:
1. Brown bacon in medium skillet
2. When the fat begins to render , add onions and cook until tender
3. Add the beans , vinegar and sugar
4. Continue cooking until most of vinegar has reduced and sugar is melted
5. Stir frequently

title: pesto chicken puff pasties
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f or 180c
2. Dice the chicken into half-inch cubes
3. Heat the oil in a skillet
4. Add the chicken and garlic
5. Cook , stirring frequently , for about 10 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked
6. Remove from the heat
7. Roll out the puff pastry sheets and cut each in half
8. Add the pesto sauce and tomatoes to the chicken and stir to mix
9. Spoon equal amounts of the chicken mixture onto the pastry sheets , covering half of each sheet but leaving a gap at the edge to seal the pastry
10. Top the chicken mixture with the grated mozzarella cheese
11. Beat the egg
12. Brush egg around the inside edge of each pasty then fold the pastry over to seal
13. Crimp with a fork to reinforce the seal
14. Brush each pasty with the beaten egg
15. Bake in the oven for 15-20 minutes until the pastry is golden
16. Serve hot and enjoy !

title: warm quinoa   broccoli salad with carrot ginger dressing
steps:
1. In sieve , rinse quinoa with cold running water
2. In 3-quart saucepan , combine quinoa , 3 cups water , and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt
3. Heat to boiling over high heat
4. Reduce heat to low
5. Cover and simmer 20 minutes or until water is absorbed
6. Transfer quinoa to large bowl
7. Meanwhile , place broccoli and 1 / 4 cup water in microwave-safe medium bowl
8. Cover and cook in microwave oven on high 4 to 5 minutes or until tender-crisp
9. Drain
10. Add to quinoa in bowl
11. In blender , combine carrot , ginger , vegetable oil , vinegar , soy sauce , sesame oil , remaining 3 tablespoons water , and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt
12. Blend until pureed
13. Add to quinoa and broccoli and toss to combine
14. Serve salad warm or at room temperature

title: tarragon marinated lamb chops with pineapple pecan salsa
steps:
1. Salsa: makes 2 - 2 1 / 2 cups
2. Combine the pineapple , onion , vinegar , olive oil and herbs in a bowl and season with salt and pepper
3. Just before serving , fold in the toasted pecans
4. May be refrigerated , covered for 1 day
5. Serve at room temperature
6. Lamb chops:
7. Combine olive oil , tarragon and garlic in a large shallow baking dish
8. Add the lamb chops and turn to coat very well
9. Refrigerate , covered for about 2 - 4 hours
10. Preheat your grill to medium high
11. Remove the chops from the marinade , shaking off excess
12. Discard the used marinade
13. Season the chops on both sides with salt and pepper
14. Grill the lamb chops until medium doneness , about 3-4 minutes per side
15. Place on a serving platter and serve the pineapple pecan salsa alongside

title: algerian vegetable couscous
steps:
1. Slice the mushrooms , chop the onions and grate the carrots
2. Heat the oil in a large pain and saute until the vegetables soften
3. Add the spices , the couscous , the lemon zest and the raisins
4. Stir until everything is well incorporated , then add the stock and the lemon juice
5. Simmer for three minutes , then cover and remove from the heat source
6. Let stand for five minutes

title: pudding cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease and flour tube or 10" bundt pan
3. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl
4. Beat at medium speed with electic mixer for 2 minutes
5. Pour into pan and bake for 50 to 60 minutes or until toothpick or knife comes out clean when inserted in the middle
6. Cool in pan for 25 to 30 minutes
7. Invert onto serving plate , cool completely

title: bacon wrapped fingerling potatoes  spuds in a blanket
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350
2. Wrap each potato with a bacon strip and secure at each end with a toothpick
3. This is really easy to do with a fingeling potato as the long shape is ideal
4. Place the bacon wrapped potatoes in a roasting dish uncovered
5. Cook uncovered in the oven for 75-90 minutes or until desired crispness of the bacon
6. Turning over one time about half way through
7. Serve

title: kalua pork loin
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 225 degrees
2. Cut pork loin in half
3. Lay out two large sheets of aluminum foil
4. Lay two large sheets of plastic wrap on top of foil
5. Place half of pork loin on the plastic wrap )
6. Sprinkle generously with kosher salt and liquid smoke , rub all over pork loin
7. Wrap up plastic wrap tightly around pork loin and then wrap with aluminum foil
8. Place in large roasting pan
9. Repeat with other loin half
10. Bake at 225 degrees 7-10 hours until done
11. Serve with soft rolls , cheese , bbq sauce , whatever your family likes
12. Yum !
13. Divide leftovers into zip topped bags and freeze for future meals

title: sweet yellow rice
steps:
1. Rinse rice well
2. Soak it in cold water for about 30 minutes and drain
3. In a large , heavy skillet bring plenty of water to boil
4. Add washed rice , cardamom seeds and yellow color , bring it back to boil , reduce heat and cook for about 12-15 minutes until the rice are almost cooked , drain and keep aside
5. Heat oil in a heavy saucepan
6. Add cloves and cardamom seeds
7. Stirring all the time , fry them for a couple of minutes
8. Add sugar and water
9. Bring to boil and simmer for few minutes or until sugar is dissolved
10. Add rice , stir gently , cook for 3-5 minutes on medium heat
11. Add almond , raisins , pistachio nuts and milk
12. Stir gently and cover with a tight fitting lid
13. Reduce heat and cook for 12-15 minutes or until all the moisture has evaporated
14. Transfer to a serving dish and decorate with silver leaf , if desired

title: suzanne s best pecan pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In a saucepan , combine syrups , brown sugar , butter and vanilla
3. While stirring , bring to a boil so the butter and sugar dissolve
4. Remove from heat and add cream and brandy
5. Set aside
6. While mixture is cooling , grind pecans in a food processor
7. In a mixing bowl , beat eggs with an electric hand mixer or fork
8. Add pecans and syrup mixture to the eggs and stir well with a fork
9. Pour into frozen , unbaked pie shell and place on a cookie sheet
10. Bake for 45 minutes
11. After removing from the oven , brush the top of the pie and the crust with heavy cream
12. Cool completely ! serve with fresh whipped cream if desired
13. This can be made a day or 2 in advance and keeps very well covered in foil

title: mini cheesecake cheesecakes dessert
steps:
1. Beat first 4 ingredients together till smooth and fluffy
2. Use paper liners , place wafer in each , in muffin pans
3. Preheat oven 350f
4. Fill 2 / 3rd full with cheese mixture
5. Bake 20-25 minutes
6. Cool
7. Freeze leftovers
8. Serve with fruit pie filling such as raspberry , blueberry or cherry and a dollop of cool whip
9. Alternative crusts: graham cracker follow directions for pie crust use one heaping tbsp per cup pressed down well
10. Same directions as making graham crust , but using cake mix-2 cups pecan flavor cake mix or any flavor you would like , but omit sugar
11. Turtle-melted caramel 1 tsp per cup over base and when baked and cooling drizzle more caramel over
12. May also drizzle melted milk chocolate over cheesecakes
13. Nuts are optional --

title: channa chaat
steps:
1. Rinse chickpeas and place in a large bowl
2. Place onionslices in a separate bowl and sprinkle some salt over them
3. Let stand 15 minutes or so
4. Squeeze the onion pieces with your hands and then rinse off under tap water
5. Peel and quarter the potatoes and place in a pot of water
6. Bring to boil and cook until they are firm but cooked through , being careful not to let them get mushy
7. Soak tamarind pulp in 1 / 4 cup water until soft , then rub pulp with fingers until it is dissolved in the water
8. Strain and pour the runny part into the chickpeas , discarding any seeds or lumpy parts that are left in the strainer
9. Place potatoes , tomatoes and onion in the bowl with the chickpeas
10. If using the cucumber , chiles or spring onion , add them as well
11. Finally , add the chaat masala , mix well , and serve
12. The canned chickpeas already have some salt in them

title: five fruit salad
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in medium bowl
2. Serve at once or chill up to an hour and serve

title: popover pizza casserole
steps:
1. In a large skillet cook ground meat , onion , and sweet pepper until meat is brown and vegetables are tender
2. Drain off fat
3. Stir in pizza sauce , pepperoni , mushrooms , fennel seeds , oregano and basil
4. Bring to boiling , reduce heat
5. Simmer , uncovered , for 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
6. Meanwhile , for topping: in a small bowl combine eggs , milk and oil
7. Beat with an electric mixer on medium-speed for 1 minute
8. Add flour
9. Beat about 1 minute more or until smooth
10. Preheat oven to 400
11. Grease the sides of a 3-quart rectangular baking dish
12. Spoon meat mixture into prepared dish
13. Arrange mozzarella cheese over meat mixture
14. Pour topping over mozzarella cheese , covering completely
15. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese
16. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until topping is puffed and golden brown
17. Serve immediately

title: edinburgh fog
steps:
1. The cream should be whipped until it is stiff and the sugar added to your own preference
2. Crush the macaroon biscuits and mix well with the cream
3. Add a few drops of almond essence and drambuie liqueur to taste
4. Serve well chilled as a luxury dessert

title: tammy s pineapple fluff dessert
steps:
1. Combine the first two ingredients
2. Put 1 / 2 cup aside for use later
3. Spread the rest over the bottom of a 9x13 casserole dish and bake at 300 degrees for about 15 minutes
4. Remove from the oven and let cool
5. Beat the butter , powdered sugar , and eggs together and layer on top of the cooled crust
6. Whip the whipping cream and fold the crushed pineapple into it , and layer this on top of everything else
7. Sprinkle the remaining 1 / 2 cup graham cracker mixture on top
8. Refrigerate for at least 2-3 hours before serving

title: ernie s fruity drink
steps:
1. Puree strawberries in a blender until smooth
2. Divide strawberry puree evenly among 4 tall glasses
3. Place ice in blender
4. Add blueberries and next 4 ingredients
5. Process until smooth
6. Pour blueberry mixture evenly over strawberry puree in glasses
7. For a peach brandy cooler:
8. Substitute the peaches for the blueberries and banana
9. Substitute the brandy for the vodka
10. Proceed as directed

title: halloumi mango salad
steps:
1. Cut the halloumi into eight slices and then cut each in half
2. Coat in the seasoned flour and put aside
3. Arrange the salad leaves on two or four serving plates and place slices of mango on top
4. To make the dressing , mix the chopped mint , yoghurt and lemon juice together in a bowl and season to taste
5. Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan or griddle and quickly fry the halloumi for about 2 minutes on each side , until golden
6. Arrange the pieces of halloumi on each bed of leaves and drizzle with a little of the dressing
7. Garnish with cherry tomatoes and mint sprigs and serve immediately with extra dressing on the side

title: foolproof deviled eggs
steps:
1. Place the eggs in a medium saucepan
2. Add water to cover by 1 inch , and bring to a boil over high heat
3. Remove the pan from the heat , cover , and let stand 10 minutes
4. Meanwhile , fill a medium bowl with 1 quart water and 1 dozen ice cubes
5. Pour off the water from the saucepan and gently shake the pan back and forth to crack the shells
6. Transfer the eggs to the ice water with a slotted spoon and let cool 5 minutes
7. Peel the eggs and slice in half lengthwise
8. Transfer the yolks to a fine-mesh sieve
9. Use a spatula to press the egg yolks through the sieve and into a bowl
10. Add the remaining ingredients , mashing the mixture against the side of the bowl until smooth
11. Arrange the whites on a serving platter
12. Add the egg yolk mixture to one corner of a large plastic storage bag and twist the bag to keep the filling in the corner
13. Snip off about 1 / 2 inch of the corner of the bag and squeeze the filling into the egg whites , mounding the filling just above the whites
14. Serve immediately

title: frozen fudge fun day sundae
steps:
1. In large bowl , combine crushed cookies and margarine
2. Mix well
3. Press lightly in bottom of ungreased 13x9-inch pan
4. Cut ice cream into 1-inch thick slices
5. Place over crushed cookies
6. Spread ice cream with spatula to cover completely
7. Sprinkle with peanuts
8. Cover and freeze
9. In medium saucepan , combine powdered sugar , chocolate chips , evaporated milk and margarine
10. Bring to a boil over medium heat
11. Cook for 8 minutes , stirring constantly
12. Remove from heat
13. Stir in vanilla
14. Cool for 1 hour
15. Pour topping over ice cream filling
16. Cover and freeze
17. Let stand at room temperature a few minutes before serving

title: m   m popcorn cake
steps:
1. Butter a 9x9 inch square baking dish
2. Line with plastic wrap , allowing it to overlap on the ends
3. Melt butter in a saucepan
4. Add marshmallows and melt over low heat , stirring occasionally with a wooden spoon
5. Remove from heat
6. Stir in popcorn very quickly and mix well
7. Fold in m&ms using a spatula , again working quickly to prevent the candy from melting
8. Pour into pan , pressing the mixture firmly into the pan with the back of a wooden spoon
9. Cool completely
10. Lift plastic wrap out of the pan and invert onto a plate
11. Peel the plastic wrap off the cake
12. Cut cake into desired number of pieces

title: buttermilk   black pepper dip
steps:
1. For the dressing: combine all ingredients in a medium sized bowl and whisk well
2. Taste , and adjust salt and pepper accordingly

title: monique s macaroons  healthy version and vegan
steps:
1. In a large bowl: mix together oats , coconut , protein powder
2. Set aside
3. In a large pot / saucepan: mix together sugar , splenda , margarine , milk , cocoa , and vanilla
4. While whisking , bring to a boil over high heat
5. Do not overboil
6. Once boiling , remove from heat and immediately fold in the dry ingredients
7. Fold until well mixed
8. While the mixture is still warm , roll into about a 1 to 1
9. 5" balls
10. Squish semi-flat onto a waxpaper-lined cookie sheet
11. Alternatively , one could just spoon out and drop , but i find in warm weather they don't "set" as well as when rolled
12. Allow to firm up in the fridge or freezer
13. Enjoy !

title: nutty caramel corn
steps:
1. In saucepan , combine brown sugar , margarine , corn syrup , and salt
2. Boil for 6 minutes , stirring constantly
3. Add flavorings , cream of tartar , and soda
4. Pour over popped corn and nuts , mixing thoroughly
5. Spread glazed mixture out on a large baking sheet
6. Bake in 200 oven for one hour

title: shrimps with bell peppers and cheese sauce
steps:
1. Start with the shrimps: depending on how you bought them , they might need picking over or peeling
2. Try to keep tails on
3. Rinse well
4. Remove seeds and ribs from bell peppers and cut flesh into bite-sized pieces
5. Peel and chop the onion
6. Use a wok over a high flame: it's easiest
7. Fry the onions and peppers in oil , stirring often , until they are soft and "reduced" and threatening to burn - about 20 minutes
8. During the frying , sprinkle in the dried hot pepper flakes
9. The wok should be quite hot at this stage , so add all the cleaned shrimps in one go
10. You might have to add more oil
11. Stir , moving the shrimps around , until they have all become pinky white and curled up
12. Don't overcook the shrimps
13. While they're cooking , add the fish and oyster sauce , and the lime or lemon juice
14. When shrimps are cooked , take wok off heat
15. If you removed the pepper-onion mixture , stir back into shrimps
16. In another medium pot , whisk the flour into the milk , put over a high heat , and keep whisking until milk boils and thickens a little
17. Remove from heat , and stir in the cheese until it melts and the sauce is smooth
18. Stir in the nutmeg , garlic and salt
19. Add this cheese sauce to the shrimp mixture and fold in well
20. Remove to an oven dish , cover , and keep warm until needed
21. You could garnish it with snipped spring onions or chives
22. Nice served with brown basmati rice
23. I also cooked chopped green beans to which i added 1 wheel , crumbled , of feta cheese
24. The cheese: i used two mild cheeses
25. Felt as if cheddar would be too strong
26. Use whatever you have , or cheese bits you need to use up

title: jalfrezi
steps:
1. Heat the mustard oil in a large , heavy-bottomed skillet over high heat for 1 minute , or until it begins to smoke
2. Add the vegetable oil , reduce the heat , and add the onion and garlic
3. Cook for 10 minutes , or until golden
4. Add the tomato paste , chopped tomatoes , turmeric , chili powder , tikka masala , and vinegar to the skillet
5. Stir the mixture until fragrant
6. Add the bell pepper and stir for an additional 2 minutes or until the bell pepper is softened
7. Stir in the chicken
8. Simmer gently for 8 minutes until the chicken is heated through
9. Serve with rice if desired

title: sausage and roasted tomatoes on pasta
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti according to package directions
2. Drain
3. Meanwhile , cook sausage in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat 4 to 5 minutes or until lightly browned
4. Reduce heat to medium
5. Stir in onion
6. Cook about 5 minutes or until onion is browned on edges
7. Stir in garlic
8. Cook 1 minute or until onion is nicely browned and caramelized
9. Stir in tomatoes
10. Simmer 5 minutes or until thick and chunky , stirring occasionally
11. Stir in paprika and sugar
12. Simmer 2 minutes
13. Toss spaghetti with sauce
14. Serve with cheese

title: cheesy meatballs with basil tomato sauce
steps:
1. For meatballs , in large mixing bowl , gently break apart the beef with a fork
2. Add the onion , breadcrumbs , parmesan , pecorino-romano , ketchup , parsley , basil , salt , worcestershire sauce and garlic powder and stir gently to combine
3. Stir in the egg until just incorporated
4. Using your hands , shape the meat into 1-inch balls , to make about 60 meatballs
5. In a large nonstick skillet , heat 2 t olive oil over medium-high heat
6. Working in batches , add the meatballs and cook , turning , until lightly browned , about 10 minutes , adding more oil when necessary
7. Drain on paper towels
8. For sauce ,
9. In large saucepan , heat the olive oil over medium heat
10. Add the onions , season with 1 1 / 2 t salt and cook until softened , about 10 minutes
11. Add the tomatoes , the remaining 1 1 / 2 t salt and the basil and bring to a simmer over high heat
12. Lower the heat , cover and simmer for 45 minutes more
13. Add the meatballs to the simmering sauce during the last 10 minutes of cooking
14. Serve over cooked pasta
15. The amount of sauce will serve 6 people
16. I listed the servings as 60 for 60 meatballs

title: top secret recipes version of cadbury cream eggs by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Combine the corn syrup , butter , vanilla and salt in a large bowl
2. Beat well with an electric mixer until smooth
3. Add powdered sugar , a little bit at at time and mix by hand after each addition
4. Mix until creamy
5. Remove about 1 / 3 of the sugar mixture and place in a small bowl
6. Add the food coloring and mix well
7. Cover both mixtures and chill for at least 2 hours or until firm
8. When mixtures are still firm roll a small , marble size from the orange filling
9. Wrap a small amount of the white filling around the orange
10. Form into the shape of eggs and place on a lightly greased cookie sheet
11. Repeat until done and chill for at least 4 hours
12. You want them "set"
13. Combine the chocolate chips and shortening in a double boiler or ceramic bowl
14. Melt down and mix well
15. Take each egg filling , dip into the melted chocolate mixture and return to baking sheet
16. Repeat and chill again for 2 hours
17. Repeat the dipping process , chill again and you're good to go !

title: lobster salad
steps:
1. In a med bowl , combine the vinegar , mustard and sugar
2. Whisk in the oil in a slow , steady stream until the dressing is smooth
3. Season to taste with salt and pepper
4. Add the lobster and toss gently to mix
5. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour
6. Drain the lobster
7. Mix in the shallot , celery , bell pepper , mayo , and coral , if using
8. Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed
9. Line a platter with the lettuce , spoon the lobster mixture on top , and serve

title: beets and cranberries
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , combine the beets , cranberry sauce and orange juice concentrate
2. Cook and stir over low heat until heated through
3. Serve with a slotted spoon

title: lisa s fruit salad with caramelized pretzel topping
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Line a jelly roll pan with foil
3. Break up pretzels on pan
4. Melt butter in microwave , add brown sugar , stir together , and dump onto pretzels
5. Stir until well coated
6. Bake for 5 minutes
7. Cool and break apart pretzels
8. For the fruit salad put into large bowl: mix pudding and buttermilk together
9. Fold in the whipped cream , crushed pineapple , and mandarin orange pulp
10. Cover top of salad with caramelized pretzel topping right before serving

title: warm grilled veggie sandwiches
steps:
1. Heat grill
2. In 8 inch baking dish , mix zucchini , bell pepper and onion
3. Drizzle with oil , toss to coat
4. With tongs , place veggies in grill basket
5. Place grill basket over medium heat , cover grill
6. Cook 15 to 20 minutes , stirring occasionally
7. Remove from grill and place veggies in 8 inch dish
8. Stir in oregano and garlic
9. Cut 18x18 inch sheet heavy duty foil , lightly spray with cooking spray
10. Cut loaf in half lengthwise
11. Spread cut sides of bread with dressing
12. Top bottom half with grilled veggies
13. Place cheese slices diagonally over veggies , overlapping slightly
14. Cover with top half of bread
15. Place on foil , wrap securely using double fold seals , allowing room for heat expansion
16. Reduce grill to low heat
17. Place wrapped loaf on grill and cook 7 to 10 minutes or until warm
18. Carefully unwrap loaf to allow steam to escape
19. Cut loaf into 4 sandwiches

title: easy microwave potatoes
steps:
1. Cut potatoes into wedges
2. Melt margarine
3. Stir in herbs and salt
4. Add potatoes and stir to coat
5. Cover and cook 8-10 min in microwave or until soft

title: omelette  pancakes crepes
steps:
1. Sift flours into a bowl or wide jug
2. Add lightly beaten eggs and half the milk-water
3. Whisk with an electric whisk until mixed , add the remaining milk-water
4. Whisk some more , for about 1 minute
5. Add oil and salt , whisk for 1 more minute until smooth and frothy
6. Refrigerate for 1 / 2 hour
7. Take out of the fridge and lightly whisk again , check consistency- it may need a little extra liquid at this stage but you probably wont be able to tell until you start making them
8. Spray a nonstick pan with oil and heat it up
9. Lift the pan off the heat
10. Ladle or pour a small amount of omlette mix into the pan
11. Rotate the pan so the omlette mix covers the bottom of the pan thinly and is even
12. Put the pan back on the heat and cook the underside until it is browned
13. Flip
14. Cook until ready
15. Remove the omlette from the pan and put on a plate , cover with another plate to keep them warm
16. Whilst you are making the others you can keep them like this in a warm oven
17. Don't worry if they look a little stiff , once they are stored like this , the steam will soften them so that they roll nicely when you fill them

title: knob hill chicken
steps:
1. In a ziplock bag place the 3 chicken breast
2. Add dressing and lemon juice let marate for at least 30 minutes
3. Place on grill turn only once
4. Is done when no longer pink
5. Place canadian bacon and cheese on top
6. Let cheese soften and brown lightly
7. Serve hot

title: hot cold chocolate  yummy
steps:
1. Get a small cereal bowl or a coffee mug and pour hot chocolate packet into the bowl or mug
2. Add milk and hot water and mix then enjoy

title: betty crocker s spicy mexicali drumsticks
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400
2. Grease rectangular pan , 13x9x2
3. Mix buttermilk and pepper sauce in medium bowl
4. Mix cornmeal and seasoning mix in large plastic bag
5. Dip chicken into buttermilk mixture , then shake in bag to coat with cornbread mixture
6. Place in pan & drizzle with oil
7. Bake uncovered 40 to 45 minutes , turning once , until juice of chicken is no longer pink when centers of thickest pieces are cut
8. Serve with salsa

title: mom s marinated flank steak
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in ziplock bag or possibly glass dish
2. Marinate steak overnight for best flavor
3. Grill on barbecue or possibly broil to taste - i usually eat steaks med rare but i find this tastes best med / med well
4. Slice thin against grain

title: smooth   creamy macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees , coat an 8 inch square baking dish with nonstick cooking spray ,
2. Cook the macaroni according to the package directions , omitting the salt
3. Drain
4. Meanwhile , in a large saucepan , melt the butter over high heat
5. Add the flour , salt , and pepper ,
6. Slowly whisk in the evaporated milk and continue cooking for 3-4 minutes , or until the mixture begins to thicken
7. Remove the saucepan from the heat and add the macaroni and the cheese
8. Mix well ,
9. Then pour into the baking dish ,
10. Bake for 20-22 minutes , or until bubbly and heated through

title: potatoes in blankets
steps:
1. Scrub potatoes
2. Cut lengthwise in 4-5 slices almost to bottom , but not through
3. Insert a slice of butter and sprinkle with garlic salt into each slice
4. Wrap each potato in foil
5. Bake over hot coals for 1 hour until soft , turning every 15 minutes

title: intense black bean soup
steps:
1. Mix 7 cups of water and black beans and set to boil on medium heat
2. Sautee onions , garlic , cayenne , and crushed red pepper in olive oil until onions are soft
3. Add onion mixture to the beans and water and stir
4. Boil for 15 minutes
5. Add chopped green bell pepper and lower heat to simmer for 20 minutes
6. Allow to cool for 15-20 minutes
7. Pour half of the mixture into a blender and puree
8. Add to pot and reheat until ready to serve
9. Good with crackers , whole wheat toast , and pitas

title: family favorite burgers
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Shape mixture into 6 patties , each about 3 / 4-inch thick
3. Broil or grill patties , 4-inches from the heat , turning once , until the desired doneness is reached , about 10 to 15 minutes

title: polish sausage  kielbasa   soup
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large skillet , add sausage , onions and celery , and cook over medium heat until sausage are lightly browned
2. Pour mixture into a soup pot and add remaining ingredients except for potatoes
3. Bring to a boil , reduce heat , cover and simmer for 1 hour
4. Add potatoes and cook until potatoes are tender
5. Season with salt and pepper and garnish with dill , if desired

title: open   face bay shrimp sandwich
steps:
1. Combine first 4 ingredients in medium bowl and season with salt and pepper
2. Spread 1 tablespoon dressing over each bread slice
3. Mix shrimp into remaining dressing
4. Place 1 lettuce leaf on each bread slice
5. Arrange 6 cucumber slices on top of lettuce
6. Arrange shrimp mixture on top of cucumbers
7. Garnish each sandwich with tomato wedge , lemon slice and dill sprig

title: cranberry chocolate shortbread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Beat butter and sugar in large bowl with electric mixer on medium speed until light and fluffy
3. Add flour mix well
4. Stir in chocolate and cranberries
5. Drop by rounded tablespoons of dough , 2 inches apart , onto ungreased baking sheets
6. Flatten each ball of dough slightly
7. Bake 10-14 minutes or until lightly browned
8. Cool 5 minutes on baking sheets
9. Remove to wire rack , cool completely

title: the best spicy tuna melt
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix tuna , miracle whip , mustard , green onion , celery and spices
3. Let stand 5 minutes
4. Spread tuna mixture on 2 slices of bread , top with 1 / 4 cup of cheese each
5. Bake for 5 minutes , turn oven to broil and melt the cheese

title: hot toddy
steps:
1. Place a silver spoon in a heavy old fashion glass or heat-proof mug to prevent cracking
2. Add rum , sugar , cloves and lemon slice
3. Fill with boiling water
4. Stir and serve

title: persian chicken
steps:
1. Wash 4 half chicken breasts and put them in a good-sized pot
2. Add celery rib , thyme , parsley sprigs , bay leaf , cracked peppercorns , and juniper berries
3. Barely cover the breasts with cold water , cover the pot , and bring to a gentle simmer
4. Hold it there for 20 minutes
5. Turn off the heat
6. Let the breasts rest in the hot water for 10 minutes
7. Transfer chicken to a strainer
8. Let it rest until cool enough to handle and then cut or pull the meat into bite-sized pieces
9. Use the skin , bones , and broth to make stock for some other dish
10. Grind six or so handfuls of walnuts fine in a food processor to produce three cups
11. You want to end up with about three cups
12. Heat 5t unsalted butter in a large , heavy saucepan , and add onions , chopped fine
13. Cook onions until they are golden , 8 minutes or so
14. Add ground walnuts and stir constantly for about five minutes
15. They will stick if you don't stir
16. Add the lemon juice , salt , cinnamon , sugar , pomegranate juice , and two cups water
17. Cover pot and let mixture simmer for up to 40 minutes
18. Five minutes before you're ready to serve , add the chicken
19. Keep the heat low so it doesn't toughen up and cook it only until everything is heated through
20. Turn off the heat and let it rest if you must
21. It will stay hot for quite a while

title: california corn dogs
steps:
1. Preheat oil to 375 degrees
2. Combine flour , corn meal , sugar , salt and baking soda in a large bowl
3. Combine the milk and egg yolks and add to dry ingredients
4. Mix on high until batter is smooth
5. Pat dry the hot dogs and stick the thin end of a chopstick half way into the hot dog
6. Repeat with the remaining 9
7. When oil has reached 375 dip the dogs , one at a time into the batter , turning slowly to get a nice even coat
8. Hold the hot dog up by the stick and let some batter drip off
9. Quickly submerge the hot dog in the oil and spin it slowly so that the coating cooks evenly
10. If using a pot cook 3 or 4 dogs at a time , turning with forks to evenly brown-around 5 minutes
11. If using a deep fryer use the lid to weigh down the dogs
12. Drain on paper towels or a rack
13. Repeat with remaining dogs

title: sunset s chocolate cream pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a food processor , pulse cookies until finely ground
3. Transfer to a medium bowl
4. Set aside
5. To processor , add almonds and 3 tbsp sugar and pulse until almonds have the texture of coarse meal
6. Add ground nuts to cookies and stir in 6 tbsp melted butter
7. Press into bottom and sides of a 9-inch deep-dish pie plate
8. Bake on center rack 15 minutes
9. Let cool
10. Put egg yolks in a medium bowl and beat to blend
11. Set aside
12. In a medium saucepan over medium-high heat , stir together milk , 3 / 4 cup sugar , cornstarch , and salt
13. Bring to a gentle simmer , stirring constantly
14. Reduce heat to medium
15. Whisking constantly , pour 1 / 2 cup hot milk mixture into egg yolks , then pour egg-milk mixture into saucepan
16. Bring to a simmer , stirring constantly with a wooden spoon
17. Remove from heat and stir in chocolate , vanilla , and 2 tbsp butter
18. Pour chocolate filling into a medium metal bowl , then set bowl in a larger bowl of ice and cold water and let cool 5 minutes , stirring constantly , until filling reaches room temperature
19. Pour filling into prepared crust and cover with plastic wrap , pressing it directly onto surface
20. Chill until cold , at least 3 hours and up to 1 day
21. Just before serving , combine cream and remaining 1 tbsp sugar in a chilled bowl
22. With an electric mixer on high speed , beat cream until medium peaks form
23. Spread whipped cream in a thick dome over chocolate filling
24. Grate chocolate over pie
25. "

title: christmas dinner soup   modified by twissis
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 190c
2. Roll the stuffing into 24 balls & cook in the oven for approx 20 min , till golden brown
3. Remove & set aside
4. While the stuffing balls are cooking , soak the dried cranberries in boiling water for 15 min , drain & set aside
5. Melt the butter in a pan
6. Add the leek , celery & onion
7. Cook for 5 min or till softened
8. Add the stock , bay leaf & thyme
9. Cover & simmer for 20 min till the veggies are tender
10. Remove the herbs & discard
11. Use your stick blender or food processor to blend the stock mixture till smooth
12. Return the blended mixture to the pan
13. Add the cream , turkey & cranberries & season w / salt & pepper to your taste preferences
14. Reheat gently for 10 min , stirring occ
15. To serve: place 3-4 stuffing "meatballs" in ea of 6-8 soup bowls , ladle the soup over them & serve immediately
16. I actually added more than the recipe suggested & was glad i did

title: pineapple orange upside down cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Place 3 t butter in a 9 inch round cake pan
3. Place pan in oven until butter is melted
4. Drain oranges and pineapple slices on paper towels
5. Arrange in bottom of pan
6. Sprinkle with brown sugar
7. In medium bowl , beat remaining cup butter and sugar until creamy
8. Add eggs and vanilla
9. Stir in flour , baking powder and salt
10. Stir in buttermilk
11. Spread batter over fruit
12. Bake 35 to 40 minutes , or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean
13. Let stand 5 minutes
14. Run a knife around edge of cake
15. Place a plate over cake and pan and invert
16. Remove pan

title: chicken tuscan vegetable pasta
steps:
1. In a large pan , add olive oil and warm on high heat
2. Add the chunked chicken , salt and garlic powder
3. Cook chicken until light brown in color , then add vegetables and tuscan herb sauce
4. Cook on low
5. Boil your pasta for 5 minutes , drain , and add to pan with chicken and vegetables
6. Cover and cook for 15 minutes
7. Be sure to stir a few times during cooking

title: mudah s fresh peach cobbler
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. In mixing bowl , combine flour , salt and shortening
3. Mix until the mixture becomes mealy
4. Add water and mix well
5. Form into a ball and cover with plastic wrap
6. Refrigerate until ready to use
7. For the filling: melt the butter in a large saucepan , over medium heat
8. Add peaches and mix well
9. In a small bowl , combine sugar , flour , cinnamon and nutmeg
10. Add to the peaches and mix well
11. Reduce the heat to low and continue to cook for 8 to 10 minutes
12. Remove from the heat and cool completely
13. Stir in the vanilla and set aside
14. Remove the dough from the refrigerator and divide in half
15. On a floured surface , roll out half of the dough into a rectangle , 12 by 10 inches
16. Using a knife , cut the dough to fit the pan , reserving the excess trim
17. Place the dough in an 11 by 9 x 4 inch pan and press down to mold
18. Pour half of the filling over the crust
19. Cut reserved dough into nickel-size pieces
20. Dot peach filling with dough
21. Pour remaining filling over the dough pieces
22. Roll out remaining ball of dough and place on top of the peaches , pinching the edges to seal in the juices
23. Make 3 slits in the top crust and place in oven
24. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown
25. Remove from oven and rest for 10 minutes before serving
26. Spoon cobbler into individual bowls and serve with a scoop of ice cream

title: miss kitty s organic skillet cornbread
steps:
1. Coat bottom and sides of 10-inch cast iron skillet with oil
2. Heat in a 450 degree oven for 10 minutes
3. Whisk together buttermilk and egg
4. Add cornmeal , stirring well to blend
5. Stir in baking powder , baking soda , salt , and sugar
6. Pour batter into hot skillet
7. Return skillet to oven and bake at 450 degrees for 15 minutes , or until lightly browned
8. Serve with organic butter

title: curried vegetable stew
steps:
1. In deep 12-inch skillet , heat oil over medium heat
2. Add sweet potato , onion , zucchini and green pepper
3. Cook , stirring till vegetable are tender , 8 to 10 minutes
4. Add curry powder and cumin , cook 1 minute
5. Add garbanzo beans , tomatoes with their juice , broth and salt and pepper
6. Heat to boiling over high heat
7. Reduce heat to medium low
8. Cover skillet and simmer till vegetables are very tender but still hold their shape , about 10 minutes longer

title: emeril s creamed spinach
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees
2. Lightly grease a 6 cup casserole
3. In a large saute pan , melt the remaining butter
4. Add the onions and season with salt and pepper
5. Saute for about 2 minutes , or until the onions are soft
6. Add the spinach
7. Season with salt and pepper
8. Saute for 3 to 4 minutes
9. Add the garlic and cream
10. Mix well
11. Season the mixture with salt and pepper
12. Bring the liquid to a boil and reduce to a simmer
13. Simmer the mixture for 6 minutes
14. Remove the pan from the heat and turn into the prepared pan
15. Add 1 / 2 of cheese to casserole and stir
16. Sprinkle the top with the remainder of the grated cheese and place in the oven
17. Bake for about 4 to 6 minutes or until the cheese is slightly brown and bubbly

title: fassolatha
steps:
1. Rinse beans , soak for 24 hours and drain
2. Place drained beans and bay leaves in a large soup pot with 8 cups of water
3. Bring to a boil , reduce heat to low and simmer for 2 hours
4. Remove bay leaves
5. Add carrots , onion , celery , and simmer for 30 minutes longer
6. Add tomatoes , salt , pepper , and olive oil , and cook for 30 minutes
7. The beans should be soft and creamy , but not to the point of disintegrating
8. Remove from heat , season to taste , and serve in bowls , drizzled with olive oil and sprinkled with chopped parsley
9. Fassolatha bean soup is served warm or at room temperature

title: bavarian beef with red cabbage
steps:
1. In dutch oven , heat oil over medium high heat
2. Brown beef , in batches
3. Transfer to plate
4. Add onions , caraway seeds , pepper and bay leaf
5. Cook , stirring , for 1 minutes
6. Pour in beef stock
7. Bring to boil , stirring to scrape up brown bits
8. Return beef and any accumulated juices to pan
9. Reduce heat , cover and simmer for 2 hours or until beef is tender
10. Stir in vinegar , sugar and rind
11. Cook uncovered , stirring often , for 30 minutes
12. In small bowl , stir together molasses , flour , ginger , cinnamon and cloves to make paste
13. Stir in 2 tablespoons of the stew juices
14. Gradually whisk back into stew over medium high heat until thickened , 3 to 5 minutes
15. Discard bay leaf ,
16. Red cabbage: meanwhile , in large saucepan , toss together cabbage , 1 / 2 cup water , vinegar , apples , brown sugar , butter and salt
17. Chop 1 of the onions and add to pan
18. Toss well
19. Stick cloves into remaining onion
20. Bury in cabbage mixture
21. Cover and bring to boil
22. Reduce heat and simmer , stirring often , for 1 1 / 2 hours or until cabbage is tender and most of the liquid is absorbed
23. Discard clove studded onion
24. Serve with stew
25. Makes 6 serving
26. Canadian living

title: bakery style lemon crumb muffins
steps:
1. For the muffins: grease or line 24 regular-size muffin cups with paper wrappers
2. Place the pastry flour , sugar , baking powder , salt , lemon zest , and lemon extract in a large bowl
3. Stir together well
4. Add the eggs and melted butter
5. Blend just until combined , making sure to scrape down the sides of the bowl so that all ingredients are mixed
6. Using an electric mixer on low speed , slowly blend in the milk
7. Mix for about 5 minutes
8. Use an ice-cream scoop to measure out the batter into the prepared muffin tins
9. Make the crumbs: using your hands , blend together all crumb ingredients until crumbly
10. Sprinkle on top of each muffin
11. Bake at 400f for about 20 minutes , until the tops spring back and a toothpick tests done
12. Cool 10 minutes in pans before removing
13. Cool slightly
14. Dust with powdered sugar , if desired , and serve warm or cool

title: spanish chorizo carbonara
steps:
1. In a large frying pan , heat olive oil until hot
2. Add leeks and saute them for 6-8 minutes , until soft
3. Lower heat and add chorizo
4. Fry over very low heat , turning occasionally until crisp
5. Cook the pasta in a large saucepan of salted boiling water until al dente
6. Meanwhile , crack the eggs into a bowl , add the parmesan cheese and paprika , season well with salt and black pepper
7. Mix together with a fork
8. Just before the pasta is ready , increase the heat under the drying pan so that the oil and melted fat start to sizzle
9. Drain the pasta thoroughly , return to the pan and immediately stir in the egg mixture and the sizzling hot contents of the frying pan
10. Stir vigorously so that the eggs cook evenly
11. Serve immediately with a scattering of grated parmesan cheese

title: gnochhi in 3 cheese sauce  from chef fabio on chow ciao
steps:
1. Cold potatoes are critical to making good gnocchi ! bake them the night before
2. 375 for a minimum of 60 minutes , make sure they are done- poke with a fork , before and after !
3. Scoop out the flesh of the potatoes once they are cool
4. [not necessary to the recipe , but save potato skins to fill with cheee and chili to bake and serve with sour cream , onions and hot sauce- awesome ! ]
5. Refrigerate the baked potato flesh overnight
6. Next is to mix the dry ingredients in a stand mixer
7. This is the dating stage , let those dry ingredients blend together --
8. Stop the mixer and add all of the cold potato at once
9. Mix on low for 5 minutes
10. At first this will look very dry and you will be tempted to add liquid
11. Do not do it !
12. After 5 minutes , you have a dough
13. They are married now and we all honor the bond :)
14. While doing this , brown the italian sausage in a pan
15. Make sure it is done because it will only be warmed through after this stage
16. As you are making the dough , prepare the cheese sauce:
17. Start a small pot of water to a boil and place a glass bowl over it
18. Keep the water boiling at a low temp , barely boiling- small bubbles
19. This is a double boiler , most people know what it is , but if you did not , just cook in the clean bowl and let the boiling water do the heating !
20. To the bowl on top , add the three cheeses
21. Add the cream
22. The cream will absorb the heat and allow the cheeses to melt together
23. The dough is now looking like dough , bring it out and punch it down and knead it a few times- you don't want air bubbles in the dough or they will absorb water
24. Cut the dough into fist sized balls
25. Roll them out with your palms to make long , cigar-shaped cylinders
26. Line them all up and chop at 1 / 2-3 / 4" intervals
27. This makes the pillow shpaed gnocchi
28. The cheese sauce should be melted so mix it up with the sausage in a serving bowl
29. Turn the water up to a boil to cook the gnocchi in the boiling water
30. Once a few of them float to the top , all of them are done
31. Don't pick the floaters only , when a few float , get them all
32. Put the gnocchi into the sauce / sausage mix and let stand for a minute or two so the gnocchi can absorb the awesomesauce
33. Serve with shaved parm

title: mrs  shores homemade chocolate pudding
steps:
1. In a saucepan , blend sugar , cornstarch , and salt
2. Add milk , and chocolate
3. Cook and stir over medium heat till thickened and bubbly
4. Cook and stir 2 minutes more , then remove from heat
5. Stir small amount of mixture into bowl with beaten egg
6. Return to hot mixture
7. Cook and stir 2 minutes more , then remove from heat
8. Add butter and vanilla , mix then pour into bowl and chill

title: croustade aux pommes et erable
steps:
1. In a pan that goes in oven , put the cut apples
2. Pour the maple syrup on the apples
3. In a separate bowl , mix together the flour , oatmeal , brown sugar , butter and salt
4. Add this mixture on the apples
5. Cook in the oven for about 35 minutes at 375f
6. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream is amazing !

title: sun dried tomato vinaigrette
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in blender and blend until creamy
2. Serve on tossed green salad , garden fresh vegetables , or other salad of your choice

title: max s grilled top sirloin steak
steps:
1. In a small bowl , mix together the pepper , garlic , salt , horseradish , and olive oil
2. Place the steaks on a shallow dish and rub the mixture all over the meat
3. Marinate at room temperature for 1 to 2 hours or , better still , covered in the refrigerator for up to 2 days
4. Turn the meat from time to time to coat both sides evenly
5. Remove the steaks from the refrigerator an hour before cooking
6. When your are ready to grill , preheat barbecue grill
7. Heat broiler
8. Broil steak approximately 3 to 4 minutes per side or until done to your preference using a meat thermometer
9. Rare - 120f
10. Medium rare - 125f
11. Medium - 130f
12. When the steaks are done to your liking , remove from oven , let sit 15 minutes before serving
13. Slice steak across grain into 1 / 4-inch slices
14. Place on a platter or individual dinner plates

title: steak au poivre  classic
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200
2. Pat steaks dry and season both sides with kosher salt
3. Coarsely crush peppercorns in a sealed plastic bag with a meat pounder or bottom of a heavy skillet , then press pepper evenly onto both sides of steaks
4. Heat a 12-inch heavy skillet over medium high heat until hot , about 3 min , then add oil
5. Swirl skillet to lightly coat the entire skillet
6. Saute steaks in batches
7. Do not touch - this lets them brown nicely and makes all the difference
8. Cook for 6 min and flip and cook for another 6 minute for medium rare steaks
9. Repeat with remaining 2 steaks
10. Transfer cooked steaks to a heatprook platter and keep warm in the oven
11. After all 4 steaks are cooked pour off fat from skillet if any , then add shallots and half of the butter
12. Cook over medium low heat , stirring and scraping up any brown bits from bottom of the pan until the shallots are well browned all over , 3-5 minute
13. Remove skillet from heat and add cognac
14. Boil , stirring until liquid is reduced to a glaze , 2-3 minute
15. Add cream and any meat juices that have accumulated on the platter in the oven
16. Boil sauce , stirring occasionally , until reduced by half , 3-5 minute
17. Add the other half of the butter and cook over low heat swirling the skillet to melt and incorporate the butter
18. Serve sauce with steaks

title: golden crab puff
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
2. Cut the crusts from bread , then cube the slices
3. In a large bowl , beat together the eggs , milk , and seasonings
4. Stir in the bread cubes , cheese , and crab
5. Pour into a lightly greased or pan-sprayed 9" x 13" baking dish
6. Bake uncovered at 325 degrees f for 1 hour or until center is set

title: honey baked lentils
steps:
1. In a dutch oven or saucepan combine lentils , bay leaf , 5 cups water and salt
2. Bring to a boil
3. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer for 30 minutes
4. Discard bay leaf
5. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
6. In a bowl combine dry mustard , ginger , soy sauce , onions and 1 cup water
7. Add to lentils
8. Pour honey on top
9. Cover tightly
10. Bake for 1 hour
11. Serve over rice

title: paprika huhn  chicken in paprika sauce
steps:
1. Cut up chicken and rub with salt and pepper
2. Melt better in a large pan
3. Brown chicken on all sides in butter with the onion
4. Remove chicken , sprinkle paprika in the fat , heat briefly , then add the flour and stock
5. Put the chicken back in and gently steam in a well covered pan for 25 minutes or so
6. Remove chicken and keep warm
7. Add cream , salt , and paprika to taste to pan juices and pour over chicken
8. Goes well with spaetzle , mashed potatoes , beets , or anything western european , especially a good liebfraumilch wine
9. Enjoy !

title: bourbon baked beans
steps:
1. Bring the beans and water to a boil
2. Turn off the heat , cover and let sit for one hour
3. Drain
4. Add enough water to cover the beans by about four inches
5. Bring back to a boil
6. Reduce the heat to a simmer and cook for about 30 to 40 minutes or until the beans are almost cooked
7. Drain , reserving three to four cups of the cooking liquid
8. In a large stovetop and overproof dutch oven , cook the bacon until crispy
9. Add the onion and cook until soft
10. Stir in the tomato paste , molasses , mustard , ketchup , bourbon and brown sugar
11. Add the beans and three cups of the reserved cooking liquid
12. Place in a 300 f oven for two and a half to three hours , stirring occasionally
13. Add salt and pepper to taste
14. Serve

title: watermelon gazpacho with dungeness crab salad
steps:
1. Chill six wide soup bowls
2. Combine all the gazpacho ingredients in a blender and puree until smooth
3. Reserve in the refrigerator
4. Combine the crab , lemon zest and olive oil , and toss gently
5. Reserve in the refrigerator
6. When ready to serve , pour 1 cup of gazpacho into each bowl , place four watermelon balls into each bowl , then add the diced cucumber and peppers
7. Place a pile of the crab in the center of each bowl , top with the cilantro and drizzle the olive oil around

title: risotto with zucchini and parmesan
steps:
1. Melt 1 t
2. Butter in heavy medium saucepan over medium saucepan over medium-high heat
3. Add zucchini , and cook until beginning to soften , stirring frequently , about 3 minutes
4. Transfer to bowl
5. Reserve saucepan
6. Bring 3 cups broth to simmer in small saucepan
7. Reduce heat to lwo and keep warm
8. Melt remaining 2 t
9. Butter in reserved medium saucepan over medium-low heat
10. Add onion and cook until tender , stirring occasionally , about 6 minutes
11. Add rice and stir until opaque , about 2 minutes
12. Add 1 / 2 cup broth
13. Adjust heat so liquid simmers slowly and cook rice until broth is absorbed , stirring occasionally
14. Continue adding broth , 1 / 2 cup at a time , until rice is just tender and creamy , stirring occasionally , about 25 minutes
15. Season with salt and pepper
16. Add zucchini and stir until heated through
17. Mix in cheese

title: beans and rice with cumin   crock pot
steps:
1. Combine beans , onion , water , jalapenos , garlic , bay leaves , cumin , salt and pepper in slow cooker
2. Cover
3. Cook on high for 4-5 hours
4. Remove and discard bay leaves
5. Stir in instant rice
6. Cover and cook 15 more minutes
7. Garnish soup with cilantro , additional jalapenos and lemon wedges , if desired

title: jam mazurkas  inspired by mean chef
steps:
1. Preaheat oven to 350f
2. Combine all dry ingredients in a large bowl
3. Break up any clumps of sugar with your finger
4. Add melted butter and egg and work with fingers to combine well
5. Press half of dough in a foil-lined 15 x 10 inch pan , working well into edges and pressing down to compact
6. Spread out jam of your choosing to within 1 / 2 inch of edges of pan - do not be tempted to use more jam than called for , the bars will be too sweet
7. Take handfuls of remaining dough mixture and crumble it over pan , distributing evenly
8. Press down with palms of hand to compact - but not too hard
9. Bake until golden-brown
10. 50 minutes in my oven
11. Cool completely before cutting
12. Cut lengthwise into 4 even rows and crosswise into 6

title: extremely easy creamy  kool aid pie
steps:
1. In a medium bowl mix the kool-aid powder with the sweetened condensed milk until well combined
2. Fold in the cool whip topping
3. Transfer into prepared crust
4. If desired you can spread cool whip or whipped cream on top of the pie
5. Chill for a minimum of 4 hours

title: orange and soy chicken
steps:
1. In a resealable ziploc storage or freezer bag add chicken , orange soda and soy sauce , blend well
2. Place in refrigerator and turn occasionally
3. Marinate several hours or overnight
4. When ready to bake , pour chicken and sauce in a 13x9x2 baking pan
5. Bake 350' 1 1 / 2 hours

title: bavarian braunschweiger dip
steps:
1. Saute the onion for about 10 minutes , stirring frequently
2. Then remove from heat and drain
3. Mix braunschweiger with cream cheese , then mix in the onion and pepper
4. Serve as a spread on crackers or as a dip for raw veggies

title: triple  p  salad
steps:
1. Mix mayo and catalina dressing first , then add dill
2. Add sauce to noodles , mix thoroughly , then add the rest and mix till all is well coated

title: rosemary potato wedges with pearl onions
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Place all ingredients into a large bowl
3. Mix to coat everything well
4. Place bowl's contents in single layer on non-stick spray-coated baking sheet and bake for 30-40 minutes , turning once half-way through cooking
5. Check for doneness at 30 minutes

title: mustard chicken salad
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Place the chicken breasts on a sheet pan and rub the skin with olive oil
3. Sprinkle liberally with salt and pepper
4. Roast for 35 to 40 minutes , until the chicken is just cooked
5. Set aside until cool enough to handle
6. Remove the meat from the bones , discard the skin , and dice the chicken in large bite-size pieces
7. Meanwhile , add the broccoli florets to a large pot of salted boiling water
8. Cook for 1 minute , until crisp tender , drain , and place into a bowl of ice water until cool
9. This will stop the cooking and set the bright green color
10. For the dressing , whisk together the mayonnaise , wine , mustards , and 1 / 2 teaspoon pepper
11. Add enough sauce to the warm chicken to moisten well
12. Add the tarragon , broccoli , and tomatoes and mix gently to combine
13. Season with salt to taste
14. Refrigerate for a few hours to allow the flavors to blend
15. Serve at room temperature

title: steak tampiquena  mexican steak
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in pan
2. Sautee onion , garlic and tomato for 3 minutes or until tender
3. Set mixture aside
4. Preheat oven to broil
5. Cut green chile into long strips and set aside
6. Sprinkle seasoning salt on both sides of steak
7. Broil steaks on one side
8. Remove from oven and place mixture of tomato , onion and garlic evenly on unbroiled side of steaks
9. Top with 2-3 strips of green chile
10. Next , place a slice of cheese on top of each steak broil until steak is done and cheese is melted
11. Serve and enjoy !

title: extreme lemon bundt cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven as directed
2. Mix all ingredients and bake as directed
3. I use a bundt pan or you may also use 2 large loaf pans
4. These cakes can be frozen for 30 days and still taste like you just baked them !

title: old fashioned shortcake
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Place in oven at 350f and cook until golden brown on top and a tooth pick comes out clean

title: shrimp creole
steps:
1. In a large skillet , cook onions , bell pepper , celery , and garlic in the oil , until vegetables are tender , 5-6 minutes
2. Stir in the tomato paste and cook for a minute , then add 1 cup of the chicken broth and mix well
3. Then add the diced tomatoes , tomato sauce , bay leaves , cayenne pepper , worcestershire sauce , and salt , stirring to mix
4. Bring mixture to a boil , then reduce heat , and simmer , stirring occasionally , for about 20 minutes
5. Mix the remaining chicken broth with the flour until it is smooth
6. Whisk it into the sauce and stir constantly for 5 minutes
7. Add the shrimp and cook just till shrimp turn pink and curl
8. Remove bay leaves before serving
9. Serve with steamed rice and tabasco sauce , if desired

title: black eyed pea salsa
steps:
1. Chop all the vegatables
2. Add the rest of ingredients to a bowl , deep enough to mix the ingredients together
3. If served cold , refrigerate for at least an hour before serving
4. If served warm , heat up in the microwave or on the stove-top

title: roti canai
steps:
1. Mix salt with flour and sieve into a bowl
2. Add sugar if necessary
3. Add water and knead into dough no longer sticks to hand
4. Knead till it feels 'elastic'
5. Divide into 8 portion , return to bowl , brush it with ghee and cover with damp cloth leaving for 1 / 2 hour
6. Take 1 portion , spread a little ghee on top and flatten with hands
7. Pick up flattened dough by the edges and swirl in circular motion until dough thins out
8. Fold dough to form a square and flatten out again
9. Repeat process to trap air in layers of dough
10. Flatten once again and fry on heated flat pan or iron griddle till cooked
11. Remove and serve hot with dhal or any curry of your choice

title: italian style salmon fillets with vodka sauce
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large saute pan over medium heat , until almost smoking
2. Add the salmon fillets and sear to brown , about 3 minutes a side
3. Add the onion , plum tomatoes , chives , asparagus
4. Add vodka ,
5. Continue cooking until the flame goes out and the alcohol is burned off
6. Stir in the crushed tomatoes , grated cheese and enough heavy cream to create a pink sauce
7. Cook an additional 1-2 minutes , or until fish is cooked through
8. Season with salt and pepper
9. Remove the fish to serving plates and continue cooking and stirring the sauce to thicken if desired
10. Pour sauce over the fish and garnish with fresh parsley

title: hungarian beef stew with dumplings
steps:
1. Cut steak into 2-inch cubes , removing fat and any tough sinews
2. In a large skillet , heat oil
3. Add meat and brown thoroughly on all sides
4. Remove meat to plate with slotted spoon and set aside
5. To oil in skillet , add onions , garlic , paprika , salt and pepper
6. Cook until onions are translucent
7. Return meat and plate juices to pan and sprinkle mixture with flour
8. Cook , stirring frequently , over low heat until flour is browned
9. Add green pepper , celery and carrots
10. Add enough beef stock to cover mixture and simmer 1 hour or until meat is tender
11. Ten minutes before stew is done , add dumplings and cover skillet
12. To make dumplings , in a large bowl , combine all dumpling ingredients and blend thoroughly
13. Drop by spoonfuls into large pot of boiling salted water
14. When dumplings double in size and rise to the surface , remove with slotted spoon and cool in colander
15. Add to stew during the last 10 minutes
16. The dumplings can be made ahead , refrigerated and reheated

title: yummy sour cream cinnamon loaf
steps:
1. To begin: prehat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease and flour a 9 x 5" loaf pan
3. Batter:
4. First , in a small bowl stir together the flour , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
5. Set aside
6. In a medium size bowl , cream the softened butter and 1 celsius sugar until fluffy
7. Add the eggs and vanilla flavoring and mix until blended
8. Add the sour cream and the milk
9. Blend at low speed and mix well
10. Add the flour mixture and mix well until all is incorporated
11. Cinnamon mixture:
12. In a small bowl , mix together the sugars , cinnamon , and allspice
13. Set aside 1 / 4 of this to go on top of the loaf
14. Spoon half of the batter into the prepared loaf pan
15. Spoon 3 / 4's of the cinnamon mixture over the batter in the pan
16. Spoon the remainder of the batter over top
17. Take a small spatula and cut through the batter and cinnamon mixture to form swirls
18. Sprinkle the remaining cinnamon mixture over the top of the loaf
19. Bake 50-60 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean
20. Cool 10 minutes before turning out of the pan
21. Enjoy !

title: pork stew with green chiles
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. Place the tomatillos in a shallow pan and broil 2 inches from the heat source until charred on all sides , turning occasionally , about 5 minutes
3. Cool slightly
4. Coarsley chop the tomatillos
5. Set aside
6. Sprinkle pork with salt and black pepper
7. Spread some flour on a plate and dust the pork with the flour , shaking off excess
8. Heat oil in heavy large pot over medium-high heat
9. Working in small batches , add the pork and brown on all sides , about 5 minutes
10. Using a slotted spoon , transfer the pork to a bowl
11. Discard oil from the pot
12. Place the pot over medium heat
13. Add the onions and saut until soft , about 5 minutes
14. Add the chiles and bell peppers
15. Saut until fragrant , about 4 minutes
16. Add the garlic and saut 2 minutes longer
17. Return the pork to the pot
18. Add the tomatillos , oregano , and all remaining ingredients
19. Bring to a boil
20. Reduce the heat to low
21. Simmer gently , uncovered , until the pork is tender when pierced with a fork , about 2 hours
22. Season the stew to taste with salt and black pepper
23. Ladle the stew into warm bowls and serve hot

title: home corned beef brisket   cabbage  new england style
steps:
1. Mix salt and seasonings in a small bowl
2. Spear brisket about 30 times per side with meat fork or metal skewers
3. Rub each side evenly with salt mixture
4. Place in a 2-gallon-size zipper-lock bag , forcing out as much air as possible
5. Place in a pan large enough to hold it , cover with second or similar sized pan , and weight with two bricks or heavy cans of similar weight
6. Refrigerate 5 to 7 days , turning once a day
7. Rinse meat and pat dry
8. Bring brisket to a boil with water to cover by 1 / 2 to 1 inch in a large soup kettle or stockpot , skimming any scum that rises to surface
9. Cover and simmer until skewer inserted in thickest part of briskest slides out with ease , 2 to 3 hours
10. Heat oven to 200 degrees f
11. Transfer meat to a large platter , ladling about 1 cup cooking liquid over it to keep it moist
12. Cover with foil and set in oven
13. Add vegetables from category 1 to kettle and bring to a boil
14. Cover and simmer until vegetables begin to soften , about 10 minutes
15. Add vegetables from category 2 and bring to a boil
16. Cover and simmer until all vegetables are tender , 10 to 15 minutes longer
17. Meanwhile , remove the meat from oven and cut across the grain into 1 / 4-inch thick slices
18. Transfer vegetables to meat platter , moisten with additional broth and serve
19. Vegetables-category 1: carrots-peeled& halved crosswise
20. Thin end halved lengthwise
21. Rutabagas-peeled& halved crosswise
22. Each half cut into 6 chunks
23. White turnips-peeled and quartered
24. New potatoes-scrubbed and left whole
25. Vegetables-category 2: boiling onions-peeled and left whole
26. Green cabbage-uncored , blemished leaves removed& cut into 6 to 8 wedges
27. Parsnips-peeled& halved crosswise
28. Thin ends halved lengthwise , thick end quartered lengthwise
29. Brussel sprouts-blemished leaves removed , stems trimmed and left whole

title: mediterranean tuna salad on grilled tomato herb bread
steps:
1. In medium mixing bowl combine diced tomato , 1 tablespoon oil , lemon juice , mustard , 2 large cloves of garlic finely chopped , and dried basil
2. Mix well and let stand for five minutes
3. Add tuna , celery , and fresh basil to tomato mixture and combine well
4. Cover and refrigerate for one to two hours or overnight
5. Stir before serving
6. In another medium bowl , add remaining fresh basil , fresh oregano , and vinegar
7. Mix well and let stand for 10 minutes
8. Add onion and remaining garlic
9. Set aside
10. Rinse fresh green beans well and snap ends off
11. Drop beans into medium pot of boiling water just until they begin to get tender
12. Drain green beans
13. Add drained beans , red pepper strips and cherry tomatoes to herb vinegar mixture
14. Mix well and refrigerate for one hour
15. When ready to serve , drizzle olive oil on bread slices , grill lightly , and than arrange of large platter
16. Stir tuna salad and mound on top of grilled bread slices
17. Add remaining olive oil , salt and pepper to green bean mixture
18. Combine well and spoon green bean mixture around grilled bread slices with tuna
19. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese if desired

title: libba s peach cobbler
steps:
1. Mix sugar , flour , milk& baking powder--set aside
2. Melt one stick of butter or oleo and place in a 13 x 9 casserole dish
3. Put peaches on bottom of dish
4. Pour batter over the peaches
5. Do not stir
6. Sprinkle ground cinnamon , ground allspice , and a little sugar to taste over top of batter if desired
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 40-50 minutes until desired browness is reached

title: creamy butternut squash and spinach gratin
steps:
1. If using fresh spinach , bring 1 inch water to a boil in a 6- to 8-quart pot over high heat
2. Add spinach , a few handfuls at a time , and cook , turning with tongs , until wilted , about 3 to 5 minutes
3. Drain in a colander and rinse under cold water
4. You may skip this step if you like , i don't think it's really necessary
5. Thoroughly squeeze cooked fresh or thawed frozen spinach in small handfuls to remove excess moisture , then coarsely chop and transfer to a bowl
6. Melt 3 tablespoons butter in an 8-inch heavy skillet over medium low heat , then cook onion and garlic , stirring , until softened , 3 to 5 minutes
7. Add onion mixture to spinach along with salt , pepper , nutmeg , and cream and stir to combine
8. Put oven rack in upper third of oven and preheat oven to 400f butter a 3-quart shallow baking dish
9. Cut squash to separate bulb section from solid neck section , then cut pieces lengthwise into 1 / 8-inch-thick slices with slicer or food processor
10. To make the squash easier to cut , microwave for 3-5 minutes
