11. Layer squash and spinach mixture in baking dish , using about one fifth of squash and one fourth of spinach for each layer , beginning and ending with squash
12. Sprinkle each layer of squash evenly with cheeses and dot with remaining 2 tablespoons butter , then cover directly with a sheet of parchment or wax paper
13. Bake until squash is tender and filling is bubbling , 35 to 45 minutes
14. If you like , you can use individual baking dishes , just
15. I haven't tried baking it individually so cook times are estimated
16. Remove paper and bake gratin until browned in spots , 10 to 15 minutes , or broil 3 inches from heat , 2 to 3 minutes
17. Enjoy !
18. If making individual gratins , bake 20-30 minutes
19. Also , for a shortcut , use 3 packages of creamed spinach and skip the cream
20. Some reviewers added a little jalapeno(or chipotle peppers and sliced almonds on top

title: cran raspberry vinaigrette
steps:
1. Place raspberries in sieve over bowl
2. Press with spoon to remove seeds , discard seeds
3. Blend berries in blender or food processor with remaining ingredients

title: breaded beef
steps:
1. Have your butcher slice the rump roast on the lunch meat slicer
2. This recipe is nice because it's sliced thin , it's always tender so you can get away with using a little cheaper piece of meat
3. If you can't get it sliced this way , freezer meat for a few hours and slice thin slices
4. Mix the eggs and water in a large bowl
5. On a large sheet of foil--mix bread crumbs , garlic powder , salt and grated cheese
6. Dip raw sliced beef in egg and than bread crumbs
7. If you run out of egg or bread crumb mixture just make a little more
8. Heat oil in large frying pan , put 2-3 slices in pan and fry until just browned
9. Drain on paper towels
10. Add more oil to the pan as needed
11. Serve with a squeeze of sliced lemon
12. Fantastic hot or room temperature

title: soya  sauce and balsamic vinegar chicken
steps:
1. Fry the cubes of chicken in oil until raw look gone /
2. Then add your vineager and soya sauce
3. Fry for about 10 miutes
4. Serve on a bed of rice

title: low carb chops in bourbon mustard sauce
steps:
1. Salt and pepper the chops
2. Saute chops in 2 tablespoons butter and olive oil over medium-high heat
3. Pour bourbon and swirl around until a thin glaze
4. Add scallions and mushroom and cover pan for 5 minutes
5. Crush thyme and sprinkle over chops
6. Add mustard and cream cover the pan and simmer for 25 minutes
7. Take chops out of pan and set on plates
8. Add remaining butter to mustard sauce
9. Pour the sauce and mushroom over chops and serve
10. Optional sprinkle with parsley

title: baked potato with rosemary
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Scrub potatoes and slice 1 / 2" thick slices from end to end
3. Keep each potato together
4. I use individual ramekins to bake them in , but you can use a caserole dish that will hold the potatoes so they don't fall apart
5. Brush some of the oil in the bottom of the ramekins and put one potato in each
6. Spread the slices a little so they are kind of loose
7. Brush the rest of the oil on the potatoes
8. Sprinkle rosemary and salt on top and top with butter
9. Bake 1 hour or until fork tender
10. The whole thing should come right out together and can be served on plates
11. Drizzle remaining oil and butter over top

title: gingerbread christmas tree
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 180 deg celsius
2. Sift flour , baking powder and soda , spices and a pinch of salt into a bowl
3. Using an electric mixer , beat butter and brown sugar until fluffy
4. Add honey and egg
5. Beat until combined
6. On low speed , beat in sifted dry ingredients until mixture comes together
7. Divide the dough in half
8. Wrap separately in plastic
9. Refrigerate for 30 minutes
10. Trace 19 cm , 15 cm , 10 cm , 7
11. 5 cm and 4
12. 5 cm stars on to cardboard and cut out
13. For the 2 smaller sizes cutters may able to used
14. Roll out dough halves until 4 mm thick
15. Using star templates and 7
16. 5 cm cutter , cut out 3 stars of each size from dough
17. Using the 4
18. 5 cm star , cut out as many stars as possible from the remaining dough
19. Place same sized stars together , 3 cm apart , on baking paper-lined oven trays
20. Bake larger stars for 8-10 minutes
21. Smaller stars for 5-7 minutes or until deep golden
22. Stand biscuits for 5 minutes
23. Transfer to wire racks to cool
24. Place eggwhite in a bowl
25. Stir in icing sugar , 2 tablespoons at a time , until combined
26. Stack the largest stars at offset angles , placing 2-3 , 4
27. 5 cm stars in between
28. Glue each layer with icing
29. Continue stacking in decreasing size until all 7
30. 5 cm stars are used
31. Finish with one 4
32. 5 cm star flat and a second one upright
33. Use icing as 'glue' to decorate tree with cachous
34. Tie up remaining small stars to look like gifts
35. Leave tree to set for one hour
36. Serve dusted with icing sugar

title: herb rub  great for pork or chicken
steps:
1. Rub meat with olive oil
2. Combine all herbs and rub into meat

title: baba ghannouj    baba ghanoush   baba gannoujh
steps:
1. Steam eggplant until tender , about 8 minutes
2. Place cooked eggplant in food processor
3. Add tahini , lemon juice , and garlic
4. Puree
5. Stir in remaining ingredients
6. Spoon into serving bowl
7. Garnish with parsley sprig
8. Serve warm or chill
9. Hints: - smaller eggplants have thinner peels and a sweeter flavor
10. Select

title: singapore teochew duck
steps:
1. For chili sauce: blend all ingredients in a blender or m& p , season to taste with sugar and salt and add a little water to dilute if necessary
2. The taste will vary considerably depending on the chiles
3. I use sambal oelek instead
4. Combine sugar and 1 t water in small saucepan and stir over low heat until sugar dissolves
5. Increase heat and boil without stirring until medium caramel colour
6. Remove from heat and carefully add 1 cup water
7. Stir over heat until smooth
8. Transfer mixture to heavy pan large enough to hold duck , as close as possible to a single layer , add 5-spice powder , garlic , galangal , sugar syrup , soy sauces , star anise and cinnamon
9. Add enough water to come about half way up the duck pieces
10. Bring to simmer and skim any scum that comes to the surface
11. Braise duck on low simmer for about 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours
12. Remove duck from liquid and refrigerate
13. Defat the liquid
14. Return sauce to heat and reduce until syrupy
15. Take all the skin off duck , reserve
16. Take meat off the duck , chop into bite size pieces , add it to the reheated sauce , and serve the whole lot on a platter
17. Chili sauce is served alongside , with steamed rice
18. Recipe works fine with breasts too
19. Leave the duck in the pot with the liquid while refrigerating overnight
20. Then defat
21. Add duck meat to sauce while reducing
22. If you wait until syrupy , there is very little liquid left

title: pan browned potatoes with red pepper and whole garlic
steps:
1. Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-low heat
2. Add garlic
3. Saut until pale golden , 10 minutes
4. Increase heat to medium
5. Add potatoes
6. Cook until pale golden , stirring every 5 minutes , about 15 minutes
7. Stir in bell pepper
8. Cook until potatoes are tender and golden , stirring every 5 minutes , about 15 minutes
9. Season with salt and pepper
10. Transfer to bowl

title: sweet potato apple galette
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Melt 2t butter in a 10" skillet over med-high heat
3. Add apples
4. Cook stirring often until caramelized , about 7 minutes
5. Meanwhile butter the tart pan
6. Place the sweet potatoes in a mixing bowl
7. Season with cinnamon , salt and white pepper
8. Drizzle with 1 / 4 cup of melted butter and mix to coat potatoes
9. Arrange a layer of sweet potatoes in the tart pan , overlapping in circles , using about half the potatoes in all
10. Arrange apples evenly over the potatoes
11. Top with remaining sweet potatoes
12. Drizzle with remaining 2t melted butter
13. Place the tart pan on a baking sheet to catch any drips
14. Bake until the potatoes are crispy and tender , about 35 minutes
15. Heat broiler
16. Place potatoes under broiler until edges are crispy and begin to brown , about 5 minutes
17. Cut into wedges to serve
18. My
19. Do not assemble too far ahead of time before baking or the potatoes will turn dark & ugly
20. Very important to slice potatoes thinly

title: king arthur flour s recipe for shortbread
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 300f lightly grease two round 9" cake pans
2. If you worry about the shortbread possibly sticking in your particular pans , line them with parchment , and grease the parchment
3. In a medium-sized bowl , beat together the butter , sugar , vanilla and almond extract , then beat in the flour
4. The mixture may seem a little dry at first
5. Keep beating until it comes together
6. If it absolutely won't come together , dribble in up to 1 tablespoon of water , until it does
7. This is a stiff dough
8. Divide the dough in half , and press each half into one of the prepared pans , smoothing the surface with your fingers , or with a mini rolling pin
9. Use a fork to prick the dough all over
10. This allows any steam to escape , and prevents the shortbread from bubbling as it bakes
11. Prick the dough in a random pattern , but it looks nicer pricked with some kind of symmetry
12. Bake the shortbread until it's a light golden brown across the top surface , and a deeper golden brown around the edges , about 35 minutes
13. Remove it from the oven , and immediately turn each shortbread round out onto a clean work surface
14. Using a pizza wheel or sharp knife , cut each round into 12 wedges
15. Transfer the shortbread wedges to a rack to cool
16. Serve as is , or decorate
17. Here are a few suggestions: drizzle with melted caramel
18. Spread with melted chocolate , and sprinkle with nuts
19. Set aside two shortbread cookies , and spread the remainder of the cookies with a thick layer of jam or preserves
20. Crumble the reserved cookies , and sprinkle the crumbs lightly over the jam

title: hot chicken casserole
steps:
1. In large bowl , combine first 4 ingredients
2. Stir until smooth , then mix in the remainder of the ingredients
3. Put mixture into a baking dish
4. Top with a thick layer of either crumbled potato chips or chow mien noodles
5. Bake at 350f for 45 minutes or until hot and bubbly

title: apple  beef brisket
steps:
1. Place brisket in the crockpot
2. Place onion slices over top
3. In a small bowl , whisk together all remaining ingredients
4. Pour over the brisket and onions in the crockpot
5. Cover and cook on low for about 8 hours or until desired doneness

title: mexican salsa
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and mix well
2. Let stand for 3 hours
3. Excellent with tacos or as a dip for tortilla chips

title: ranch broiled chicken
steps:
1. Place all ingredients except chicken in a 1-gallon plastic zipper bag , and mix together
2. Add the chicken to the bag , seal , and massage dressing mixture into chicken
3. Marinate in refrigerator about 1 hour
4. Remove chicken from bag and broil 5-7 minutes on each side , or until juices run clear

title: sang choy baw  lettuce rolls
steps:
1. Chop spring onions very finely , same with mushrooms , chestnuts and bamboo shoots
2. In a wok or deep frying pan , heat oil and fry chicken mince till golden , add onion , chestnut , bamboo shoots and mushrooms , cook for another 5 minutes , add sauce and cook for another 2 minutes
3. Keep stirring while adding ingredients
4. Place in a bowl and take to table , same with lettuce leafs
5. Place some filling into leaf , roll or fold leaf and enjoy
6. Options: can be used pork mince , beef mince , finely chopped fresh shrimp or combination of meats , it's up to you
7. ---sauce---
8. Combine all and mix well

title: slow cooker chicken burrito bowls
steps:
1. Combine the chicken breasts , diced tomatoes , 1 / 2 cup of chicken stock , chili powder , salt , and cumin in the bowl of a 2 1 / 2- to 3 1 / 2-quart slow cooker
2. Make sure the chicken is covered , and add additional stock if needed
3. Cover with the lid and cook on low for 3 to 4 hours
4. Remove the lid and add the rice , black beans , frozen corn , and the remaining chicken broth
5. Replace the lid and continue cooking on low for another 3 to 4 hours
6. Check the rice periodically in the last hour of cooking , stirring once or twice to make sure the rice cooks evenly and adding more chicken broth if the mixture seems dry
7. Cooking is done when the rice is tender if the rice is done while there is still liquid left in the slow cooker , remove the lid and cook on high to let the liquid evaporate
8. Total cooking time from start to finish is 6 to 8 hours
9. Use two forks to shred the chicken into bite-sized pieces
10. You can do this either in the slow cooker itself and then mix it into the rice , or you can transfer the chicken to a cutting board if you prefer to keep it separate
11. Taste the burrito mix and stir in more salt or other seasonings to taste
12. Serve burrito bowls with a selection of toppings
13. The burrito mixture will keep for 1 week refrigerated or for 3 months in the freezer
14. This recipe makes about 7 total cups of burrito mix

title: tim horton s style lemon cranberry muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Mix oats , flour , baking powder , salt and chopped cranberries in one bowl
3. Set aside
4. In second bowl mix yogurt , oil , brown sugar , egg beaters , lemon peel , cinnamon and vanilla together
5. Fold all ingredients together in one bowl
6. Place batter into muffin tins
7. Bake at 350 degrees f for 35 minutes
8. Allow to cool on wire rack out of the tins

title: overnight orange french toast
steps:
1. Whisk together zest , juice , sugar , vanilla , triple sec , eggs , half-and-half , and a pinch of salt
2. Arrange bread slices in one layer in a 13 x 9 inch glass baking dish
3. Pour mixture over bread , turning slices to coat , and chill , covered , overnight
4. Preheat oven to 400f and brush a large baking pan with butter
5. Using a slotted spatula arrange bread in one layer on baking pan , leaving atleast 2 inches between each slice and bake in middle of oven 5 minutes
6. Rotate pan and bake 5 minutes more
7. Rotate pan again and bake until bread is puffed and golden , about 5 minutes more
8. Make sauce while bread is baking: cook butter , marmalade and triple sec over low heat , stirring , until butter is melted
9. Drizzle french toast with sauce and serve with syrup , if desired

title: new england lobster rolls
steps:
1. -whisk mayonnaise , lemon juice , mustard , oil , tarragon hot sauce , salt & pepper in medium bowl
2. Gently toss in lobster meat and cover with plastic wrap or foil and refrigerate for at least 1hr
3. Or until chilled
4. -place hoagie rolls under broiler for just a few seconds or until lightly toasted
5. Fill each hoagie roll with lobster meat

title: amarula drumsticks
steps:
1. Prepare the drumsticks by cutting the skin loose around the bone and pushing in down with a scraping movement , using a small sharp knife
2. Cover exposed bone with foil
3. Dust meat lightly with seasoned flour
4. Mix the chives , marmalade , lemon , amarula cream and salt together
5. Coat the drumsticks in this mixture and arrange in an ovenproof dish
6. Bake at 200 degrees for 45 minutes until crispy
7. Remove the foil
8. May be served warm or at room temperature
9. For serving:
10. Wrap a bayleaf around each exposed bone-
11. Secure the leaf with a toothpick
12. Cooking time is approximate since i have not made this yet

title: mushroom and barley casserole
steps:
1. Heat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Heat the butter in a heavy frying pan over medium-high heat
3. Saut the mushrooms and until soft , 3 to 4 minutes
4. Transfer to an casserole dish
5. Fry the onions in the same pan until light golden , about 5 minutes
6. Add the barley and stir-fry until the kernels turn golden brown
7. Transfer the onion-barley mixture to the casserole , and add the stock
8. Cover and bake 1 hour
9. Check once or twice and add more stock , if necessary
10. Season to taste with salt and pepper
11. Serve garnished with dill

title: soda cracker torte
steps:
1. Process crackers and nuts in blender until finely ground
2. Beat egg whites until soft peaks form
3. Mix in vinegar
4. Gradually add sugar , beating well after each addition
5. Add vanilla and baking powder and beat until stiff
6. Fold in cracker mixture
7. Put into greased 8-inch square pan and bake at 300 about 25-30 minutes , or until cake tester in center comes out clean
8. Cool in pan
9. Cut in pieces to serve
10. Be careful removing from pan , especially the first piece , as this is pretty crumbly

title: sweet and savory baked chicken with pineapple and tarragon
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Chop 2 sprigs of fresh tarragon and combine in bowl with 1 tsp salt , and 1 / 4 tsp ground pepper
3. Rub mixture all over chicken
4. Transfer to larger roasting pan , you can refrigerate this up to 24 hours before baking
5. Put pineapple , chopped shallots , rice wine vinegar , sugar , and 1 / 2 tsp salt into food processor
6. Mix until slightly chunky
7. Spread pineapple mixture over chicken and then add remaining tarragon sprigs and sliced shallots to roasting pan
8. Bake chicken , basting with pan juices occasionally , until skin is golden , about 50 minutes

title: peggy s peach bread pudding
steps:
1. With 1 tablespoon of butter , grease a 9-by-13-inch glass baking dish
2. Cut or tear bread into cubes and place in the baking dish , prepare peaches by peeling & slicing
3. Set aside
4. In a large bowl , combine egg yolks and sugar with a whisk
5. Do not whip
6. Melt remaining 2 tablespoons butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat
7. Add the peaches and cook until soft , about 20 minutes , stirring occasionally with a rubber spatula
8. Add the cream and bring mixture to a boil
9. Gradually pour hot peach mixture into egg mixture while stirring constantly
10. Add vanilla & salt
11. Pour the peach-and-egg mixture over the bread cubes
12. There won't be much room in the baking dish , but gently move contents around with rubber spatula until all the bread cubes are coated
13. Cover with wax paper and let stand in the refrigerator for 2 hours
14. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
15. Put pudding , covered in the wax paper , into oven on middle rack and bake 30 minutes
16. Then uncover and bake another 30 minutes or until golden brown
17. Allow pudding to cool about 5 to 10 minutes , then slice and serve warm with a scoop of ice cream on top
18. Enjoy

title: fiery grilled asparagus
steps:
1. Rinse asparagus and trim off bottom of stalks
2. Place on grill over high heat and cook , turning frequently , until crisp tender and lightly charred
3. Remove from grill and place in a bowl
4. In a small bowl , whisk together the oil , vinegar and sugar
5. Pour over asparagus and toss to coat well
6. Season to taste with salt and pepper and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds
7. Serve hot , cold or at room temperature

title: yummy pork fajitas
steps:
1. Slice pork into thin strips
2. Marinate strips in garlic , oregano , cumin , salt , orange juice , vinegar and hot sauce for 30 minutes
3. Heat heavy skillet or griddle until hot
4. Add the oil , and when it is hot , and pork strips
5. Stir-fry until pork is no longer pink
6. Add bell pepper and onion and cook until vegetables are limp
7. Serve on flour tortillas
8. Garnish with green onions , salsa , cheese and lettuce

title: baked cut okra
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Mix okra , corn meal , salt and pepper in a baking dish until the okra is thoroughly coated with the corn meal
3. Slice the butter on top of the okra
4. Bake for 45 minutes , turning half-way through with a spatula so the okra will brown evenly
5. Remove from oven and drain on a paper towel

title: delectable vegan brownies
steps:
1. Boil water and 1 / 2 cup of the flour over low heat , stirring constantly , until it reaches the consistency of a thin gluey paste
2. Remove from heat and let cool completely
3. Mix vegan sugar , salt , vanilla , cocoa and oil
4. Then add the rest flour-water mixture
5. Mix well
6. Add the remaining 1 1 / 2 cups of flour , baking powder and the nuts or chocolate chips , if you choose to add those
7. Spread mixture into a greased 11 x 7 pan
8. Bake at 350f for 25 minutes , or until a knife can be inserted and come out clean

title: easy pulled chicken barbecue sandwiches
steps:
1. Remove the skin and pull the meat off the bones , then pull apart the chunks of meat discarding any hard over cooked parts
2. The meat should look like pulled pork
3. If you are not serving within 30 minutes , refrigerate
4. When ready to serve , put enough meat for one sandwich in a small microwave proof bowl
5. Make up one bowl for each sandwich you are making
6. Heat the meat in the microwave until it reaches serving temperature
7. Heating can be done before putting meat in the bowls if you are making more then a few sandwiches
8. Serve each person a bowl of meat and a bun
9. Each person can then pick their own favorite bbq sauce or mix a witches brew of different sauces with their meat and then spoon onto their bun

title: old fashion butter pound cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees fahrenheit
2. Grease and flour a 9x5 loaf pan
3. Important - allow all ingredients to reach room temperature
4. With mixer on low speed , cream the butter until soft
5. Slowly add sugar while mixer is running
6. Once all the sugar has been added , beat until the mixture is fluffy
7. Slowly add eggs , one at a time , mixing each egg well into the creamed mixture
8. Add the flour and salt , mix until smooth
9. Add vanilla extract and milk
10. Mix until smooth
11. Pour into the loaf pan
12. Bake for 75 to 90 minutes or until golden brown

title: grapefruit and pineapple marmalade
steps:
1. Pare pineapple and shred
2. Cut grapefruit and lemon into quarters , then thin slices
3. Measure fruit and add 3 pints of water for each pint of fruit
4. Set aside until the next day
5. Cook approximately 3 hours , or until rind is tender
6. Set aside until the next day
7. Measure and add an equal amount of sugar
8. Bring to the boil and cook until 223f or jelly "sheets" off the spoon
9. Fill in sterilized jars and seal

title: mexican baked potatoes
steps:
1. Bake potatoes until done
2. Slice open the potatoes lengthwise
3. Remove pulp from potatoes and mash
4. Reserve potato skins
5. Mix mashed potatoes , chilies , chopped eggs , butter , sour cream , salt and pepper
6. Fill potato skins with the potato mixture
7. Top potatoes with cheese
8. Heat potatoes at 400f for 15 minutes

title: lisa s french toast
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except bread until smooth
2. Slice bread into 1" thick slices
3. Soak in batter until aturated
4. Fry over medium heat in 1 / 4" oil until done

title: curried shrimp and cheddar soup
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large saucepat and saute onion , chives , celery and mushrooms until onion is translucent
2. Add flour and stir to mix
3. Slowly add the chicken broth so flour does not lump
4. Stir in the cream of chicken soup
5. Allow the soup to come to a slow boil over low heat
6. Add the cheese , stirring until completely melted
7. Next add the seasonings and mustard
8. Finally , add the shrimp and simmer until heated through
9. Salt and pepper to taste before serving

title: fresh bing cherry jam
steps:
1. Add the cherries , lemon juice , and salt to a slow cooker
2. Stir gently
3. Let stand for 15 minutes to dissolve the sugar
4. Sprinkle with pectin
5. Cover and cook on low for 2 1 / 2 hours , stirring twice during cooking
6. Remove the lid , turn the cooker to high and cook for 2-3 hours more , until the jam reaches your desired consistency
7. Ladle the warm jam into clean spring-top glass jars
8. Let stand to cool
9. Store , covered , in the refrigerator for up to 2 months
10. Or spoon into small plastic storage containers and freeze for up to 2 months

title: carrot  orange   cumin soup
steps:
1. Heat butter in a large , heavy-based saucepan until foaming
2. Add carrots , orange peel , cumin and remaining vegetables
3. Stir-fry for 2-5 minutes , then cover and cook very gently over low heat until all the vegetables are soft
4. 15-30 minutes , depending on size of chunks
5. Stir with a wooden spoon from time to time
6. Season with a little salt , pepper and nutmeg
7. Sprinkle with cornflour and stir thoroughly
8. Gradually add first the chicken stock and then the milk , stirring constantly
9. Continue cooking , stirring , until the soup comes to the boil
10. Remove the saucepan from the stove , transfer the soup to a food processor or blender and puree until smooth
11. Return it to the saucepan and heat through
12. Stir in the cream and serve in heated soup bowls

title: pork medallions in apple mustard sauce
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine chicken broth , apple juice concentrate , and mustard
2. Set aside
3. Sprinkle pork chops with salt and pepper
4. In a large nonstick skillet , heat oil
5. Brown chops in the oil
6. Remove and set aside
7. Add the garlic to the pan
8. Saute 1 minute
9. Add reserved broth mixture , stirring to loosen the browned bits from the pan
10. Bring to a boil
11. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 6-8 minutes or until liquid is reduced to about 1 / 3 cup
12. Return pork to pan
13. Cover and let cook over low heat for 3-4 minutes or till meat is cooked through
14. Combine cornstarch and cold water and mix until smooth
15. Add to the pan
16. Bring to a boil
17. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or til thickened
18. Sprinkle with parsley and serve

title: saucy hamburger supper
steps:
1. In a medium bowl combine the beef , bread crumbs , salt and pepper
2. Form into 4 patties
3. In a skillet brown the patties and pour off the excess fat
4. In a medium bowl combine the remaining ingredients
5. Pour over the patties in the skillet
6. Simmer for 10-20 minutes
7. Serve over rice or noodles

title: kelly s rich and creamy key lime pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. In medium bowl , gently whisk eggs
3. Slowly whisk in sweetened condensed milk
4. Slowly whisk in key lime juice
5. Do not over mix , this will create bubbles
6. Just stir gently til all ingredients are mixed together well
7. Pop into oven for 40-45 minutes
8. My oven takes 44 minutes exactly
9. The edge of pie will just start to slightly poof up and the edge of pie will also be very slightly a pale golden brown
10. Just very lightly browned
11. The pie also will no longer jiggle
12. Let cool
13. Pie will set up perfectly as it cools
14. Refrigerate at least 4-6 hours or overnight
15. Pie gets even better the next day ! :)
16. Serve with whipped cream topping
17. Garnish with slices of key limes , kiwi and / or fanned strawberries if desired
18. Very rich and creamy !
19. You can save the egg whites and make a meringue top if preffered
20. But we like the cool , smooth creaminess of sweetened whipped cream much better than meringue
21. )
22. The only other thing i do , is i do add 2 drops green food coloring to the pie for a bit of green color
23. But this is totally up to you !
24. If preferred , you can also bake this pie in a 9" deep dish pastry crust

title: pesto pizza with artichokes and prosciutto
steps:
1. Make up the pizza mix according to instructions and roll out quite thinly to fit the base of a shallow square or round baking pan
2. Heat oven to 425f
3. Mix the tomatoes with 2 tbs of the pesto and spread over the pizza , leaving a bare rim around the edge
4. Scatter the artichokes and prosciutto on top
5. Cover with mozzarella and sprinkle with the parmean and some freshly ground pepper
6. Drizzle with the rest of the pesto , which has been mixed with the artichoke oil
7. Bake for 20 minutes until the base is cooked through and the cheese has melted
8. Serve hot !

title: creamy leek risotto
steps:
1. Put chicken broth in sauce pan and bring to a slow simmer
2. In thick bottomed 2 quart pan melt 1 tablespoons butter , saute chopped leeks , till softened
3. Add 1 / 2 cup light cream
4. Salt and pepper to taste
5. Continue cooking until most of the liquid is gone
6. Set aside
7. In another pan or the same one that has been cleaned , add 2 tablespoons butter and 1 tbsp of olive oil
8. Saute the minced onions , when softened , add the arborio rice , stir until the grains turn opaque
9. Add the dry white wine , stir until no liquid is left
10. Add broth to rice 1 / 2 cup at a time stirring until incorparated
11. 5 minutes before finished add the leeks and the parmesan cheese
12. Continue cooking until thickened to desired level , stirring constantly
13. Garnish with parsley or stir in before serving

title: cherry berry pie
steps:
1. For crust: combine flour , salt and baking powder in a bowl
2. Cut in shortening and butter flavor shortening with a pastry blender until the flour is just blended in to form pea size chunks
3. Combine water and vinegar
4. Sprinkle over flour mixture , 1 tbsp
5. At a time
6. Toss lightly with a fork until dough forms a ball
7. Divide dough in half
8. Press between hands to form two 5 to 6" pancakes
9. Flour rolling surface and pin lightly
10. Roll dough for bottom crust into a circle
11. Trim 1" larger than upside down 9" pie plate
12. Loosen dough carefully
13. Fold in quarters
14. Unfold
15. Press into pie plate
16. Trim edge even with pie plate
17. For cherry layer: thaw and drain enough berries to yield 2 to 2 1 / 2 cups fruit and 1 / 2 cup juice
18. Combine cherries , 1 / 3 cup granulated sugar , 1 tbsp
19. Tapioca , 1 1 / 2 tsp
20. Cornstarch , almond extract and vanilla extract in a large bowl
21. Combine 1 / 2 cup cherry juice , 1 tbsp
22. Granulated sugar , 1 1 / 2 tsp
23. Tapioca and 1 1 / 2 tsp
24. Cornstarch in a small saucepan
25. Place on medium heat
26. Cook stirring constantly , 3 or 4 minutes
27. Cool slightly
28. Pour over cherries
29. Mix gently until cherries are coated
30. Set aside
31. For cream cheese layer: combine cream cheese , confectioners sugar , almonds , almond extract and vanilla extract in a medium bowl
32. Beat at medium speed of electric mixer until well blended
33. Spread on bottom of unbaked pie shell
34. For raspberry layer: combine raspberries , granulated sugar and cornstarch
35. Mix carefully
36. Spoon over cream cheese layer
37. If desired place raspberry mixture in a saucepan
38. Cook , briefly , until thickened
39. Cool until slightly warm before spooning over cream cheese layer
40. Heat oven to 400 degrees
41. Spoon cherry mixture over raspberries
42. Moisten pastry edge with water
43. Roll top crust same as the bottom
44. Cut into 10 - 1 / 2" strips
45. Place 5 strips evenly across filling
46. Fold every other strip back
47. Lay first strip across in opposite direction
48. Continue in this pattern , folding back every other strip each time you add cross strip
49. Trim ends of lattice strips even with crust
50. Press together
51. Fold edge under
52. Flute
53. For topping: brush pastry with egg white
54. Sprinkle lightly with granulated sugar
55. Bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes
56. Reduce temperature to 350 degrees
57. Bake 40 minutes
58. Sprinkle with chopped almonds and flaked coconut 5 minutes before end of baking time , if desired
59. Cool until barely warm or to room temperature before serving
60. Mash and press additional cherries through a sieve or colander to obtain 1 / 2 cup of juice

title: aunt kathi s fresh apple cake
steps:
1. Peel apples and cut into small chunks
2. Pour sugar over them and let stand 10 minutes
3. Meanwhile , melt margarine
4. Add to apple mixture with egg
5. Stir
6. Add dry ingredients and stir until moistened
7. Add optional ingredients
8. Bake in greased and floured 8" square pan
9. Bake at 350 degrees for 50-55 minutes
10. Serve warm or cold , alone or topped with whipped cream

title: veggie breakfast casserole
steps:
1. Mix together the potatoes , tofu , and soy sauce
2. Saute the onion and garlic in the oil until translucent
3. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f
4. Mix the onion and garlic into the potato mixture , and add the parsley , basil , and black pepper
5. Spread into an oiled 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish
6. Sprinkle with paprika and bake for 35 minutes

title: oat cookies with walnuts
steps:
1. Mix oats , flours , baking powder and salt in a bowl
2. Whip butter and sugar together until creamy , add eggs and blend throughly
3. Blend with oats and fold almost all nuts under but save some for decorating
4. Put little amounts of dough on a baking tray , i use 2 teaspoons to do so
5. Decorate with remaining nuts
6. Press down and bake at 330 for 10 to 15 minutes
7. Let them cool down on a a baking rack

title: cumin flatbread
steps:
1. Place warm water in bowl of heavy-duty mixer
2. Sprinkle yeast over and stir to combine
3. Let stand 10 minutes
4. Add oil , lemon peel , salt and ground cumin
5. Using dough hook attachment , gradually beat in flour
6. Continue beating 5 minutes
7. Turn out dough onto lightly floured work surface and knead until smooth dough forms , about 2 minutes
8. Lightly oil large bowl
9. Add dough
10. Turn to coat
11. Cover with plastic and let rise in warm draft-free area until doubled in volume , about 1 hour
12. Preheat the oven to 400f line 12x18-inch baking sheet with heavy-duty foil
13. Brush foil with oil
14. Place dough in pan
15. Using finger
16. Sprinkle with cumin seeds and sesame seeds
17. Bake until golden , about 30 minutes
18. Loosen bread from foil
19. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: sloppy joes  crock pot
steps:
1. In a large skillet cook ground beef , onion , and garlic until meat is brown and onion is tender
2. Drain off fat
3. Meanwhile , in your crockpot combine the remaining ingredients
4. Stir in meat mixture
5. Cover
6. Cook on low heat for 6 to 8 hours or on high heat setting for 3 to 4 hours

title: quick berry popsicles
steps:
1. Puree in blender all ingredients
2. Pour mixture into 8 plastic tupperware popsicle makers
3. Freeze for at least three hours

title: potato onion rolls
steps:
1. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup
2. Level off
3. In a large bowl combine 1 1 / 2 cup flour , potato flakes , sugar , salt and yeast
4. Mix well
5. In a medium saucepan heat milk , butter and onions until very warm
6. Add warm liquid and eggs to flour mixture
7. Blend at slow speed until moistened
8. Beat 3 minutes at medium speed
9. By hand , stir in 2 to 2 1 / 2 cups flour until dough pulls cleanly away from sides of bowl
10. On floured surface , knead in 1 cup flour until dough is smooth and elastic , about 5 minutes
11. Place dough in a greased bowl
12. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and cloth towel
13. Let rise in a warm place until light and doubled on size , 30 to 45 minutes
14. Grease 13x9-inch pan or two 9-inch round cake pans
15. Punch down dough several times to remove all air bubbles
16. Divide dough into 24 equal pieces
17. Shape into balls
18. Place in greased pan
19. Cover , let rise in warm place until light and doubled in size , 15 to 30 minutes
20. Heat oven to 375f uncover dough
21. Bake at 375 for 25 to 35 minutes or until golden brown
22. Immediately remove from pan
23. Cool on wire rack

title: asparagus and mushroom saute
steps:
1. Place asparagus spears in a 10" skillet
2. Add enough water to cover
3. Bring to a boil over medium heat and cook until spears are crisp tender
4. Drain and return to skillet
5. Add remaining ingredients , stir well , and heat over medium heat until mushrooms are cooked through

title: polish italian pasta soup  no beans
steps:
1. If using kielbasa , slice into 1 / 4 inch rounds
2. If using sausage , remove casings
3. In a large dutch oven , cook and stir sausages over medium heat for about 10 minutes , or until done
4. Meanwhile , boil water for pasta
5. Cook pasta and drain
6. Remove sausage with a slotted spoon
7. Reserve drippings in pot
8. Cook celery , onion and garlic in the same pot for about 5 minutes or until tender
9. Drain off excess fat from pan
10. Add chicken broth , herbs and red pepper to pot
11. Bring to a boil and simmer for 10 minutes
12. Add undrained tomatoes and sausage
13. Heat through
14. Ladle soup into bowls , add pasta to bowl of soup

title: split pea soup with fresh peas and potatoes
steps:
1. Saute chopped onion in oil until they begin to soften
2. Add celery , carrot , potatoes , cumin , and pepper
3. Saute 5-7 minutes
4. Add split peas , water , and bay leaf
5. Bring to a boil , lower heat , and simmer for 1 1 / 2 hours
6. Add remaining ingredients
7. Stir
8. Cook for a few more minutes until peas are tender
9. Enjoy !

title: bulgur with leeks and swiss chard
steps:
1. Heat oil in large pot over medium-high heat
2. Add leeks and chard stems , and cook 4 minutes , or until softened , stirring often
3. Add mushrooms , and cook 5 minutes , or until softened , stirring occasionally
4. Add garlic and chard leaves
5. Cover , and cook 5 minutes , or until leaves are wilted , stirring occasionally
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Stir in broth and bulgur
8. Bring to a boil , reduce heat to medium low , cover , and simmer 10 minutes , or until liquid is absorbed and bulgur is tender
9. Remove pan from heat , and serve

title: chocolate cut out cookies
steps:
1. Sift together the flour , cocoa , baking powder and salt until well blended
2. Cream butter and sugar until smooth in a eparate bowl , then beat in the egg and yolk
3. Mix the sifted ingredients into the creamed butter slowly
4. Divide dough and refrigerate for at least 3 hours
5. Heat the oven to 375 degrees f and on a lightly floured surface roll out the chilled dough to about 1 / 6 inch thickness and cut dough into shapes
6. Be careful its sticky !
7. Bake cookies 8 to 10 then let cool on sheets for a few minutes before removing them to a rack

title: rhubarb crunch cake
steps:
1. In a bowl , mix the rhubarb and gelatin and set aside
2. Prepare the cake mix according to the directions on the box
3. Spread half of the cake batter into a 9x13 cake pan sprayed with nonstick cooking spray
4. Spread the rhubarb and gelatin mixture over the batter
5. Sprinkle with two-thirds of the topping mixture
6. Spread the remaining cake batter over the top
7. Sprinkle with the remaining topping mixture
8. Bake at 350f for 40-50 minutes

title: goat nachos
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Layer 1 / 2 chips on large cookie sheet
3. Place spoonfuls of 1 / 2 beans on chips
4. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 cheese
5. Layer the rest of chips on top of this and repeat toppings
6. Bake for approximately 5-7 minutes until cheese is melted
7. Broil for 2-3 minutes until cheese is bubbly and chips are golden
8. Serve with sour cream and salsa

title: topsy turvy apple pie
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425
2. In 9 inch glass pie pan , mix brown sugar , butter and corn syrup and spread evenly in bottom of pan
3. Arrange pecan halves on top
4. Make pie crusts as directed on box for two-crust pie , placing bottom crust over mixture in pie pan
5. In small bowl , mix sugar , flour and cinnamon
6. Arrange half of the apple slices in cust-lined pan and sprinkle with half of the sugar mixture
7. Repeat with remaining apple slices and sugar mixture
8. Top with second crust , seal edge and flute
9. Cut slits in several places on top of crust
10. Place pie on sheet of foil on middle rack in oven and bake 8 minutes
11. Reduce oven temperature to 350 and bake an additional 35-45 minutes or until apples are tender and crust is golden brown
12. After removing from oven , immediately run knife around edge of pie to loosen
13. Place serving plate upside down over pie , turn plate and pan over
14. Remove pan
15. Serve warm or cool with whipped cream

title: white and dark chocolate spiral cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 200 degrees celsius
2. To make the base:
3. Mix the cookie crumbs with the melted butter and pat into the bottom of a 26 cm diameter springform pan
4. Place in the oven to "set" for about 7 minutes
5. Remove and set aside to cool
6. To make the filling base:
7. Beat all the ingredients together until well blended
8. Pour half into a large , 4 cup measure cup , pour the other half into another 4 cup measuring cup
9. Alternatively , you can use jugs , pitchers , whatever is available , as long as it has a handle and a spout
10. Melt the white chocolate chips together with the cream and stir to blend
11. Add the cornflour and stir again
12. Add this mixture into one of the cheese filling jugs
13. Stir to blend
14. Melt the dark chocolate chips together with the cream and stir to blend
15. Add this mixture into the other of the cheese filling jugs
16. Stir to blend
17. Okay , here comes the fun part --
18. Carefully pour a portion of the white chocolate filling into the middle of the crust
19. Now carefully pour a portion of the dark chocolate filling into the middle of the white filling
20. Now carefully pour some of the white chocolate filling into the dark chocolate filling
21. Now carefully pour some of the dark chocolate filling -- okay you get the picture ?
22. Keep this up until you have a series of concentric circles
23. Again , i cannot mention it enough , do this carefully so you don't mess up the circles
24. Very carefully transfer this to the oven
25. Bake at 200 degrees c for 10 minutes
26. Turn the oven down to 120 degrees c and bake for a further 60 minutes
27. Turn the oven off and let the cheesecake hang out in the cooling oven for another 2 hours
28. Transfer to the refrigerator and let it hang out there for another 24 hours
29. When you cut slices you will have the most gorgeous white and dark "zebra-ed" portions

title: easy saturday morning crescent caramel rolls
steps:
1. Set oven to 375 degrees
2. Butter a 9 or 10-inch round cake pan or pie plate
3. Soften the caramel dip in the microwave for a few seconds , then spread in the bottom of the baking pan
4. Separate the dough into 4 rectangle pieces , then seal the perforations with fingers
5. Spread each rectangle with 1 tablespoon soft butter
6. In a small bowl combine the sugar with cinnamon
7. Sprinkle the cinnamon / sugar mixture over the butter , then sprinkle with about 1 / 4 cup chopped nuts
8. Roll each rectangle pinwheel-style beginning at the short end
9. Slice the roll into thirds
10. Place cut side down into the pan with the caramel in it
11. Bake for about 20-22 minutes or until golden
12. Immediately invert onto a serving plate , spooning any caramel in the pan over the rolls

title: margee s deviled eggs
steps:
1. Cut eggs in half and scoop out yolks
2. Place yolks in a bowl
3. Add remaining ingredients to yolks and mash well
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste
5. Stuff the whites and arrange on a platter or serving dish
6. Sprinkle lightly with paprika

title: atkins broccoli parmigiano
steps:
1. In a large , deep skillet , heat oil over medium-high heat
2. Add garlic and red pepper flakes
3. Saute 30 seconds
4. Add broccoli , water , lemon juice and lemon zest
5. Mix well
6. Cover skillet and cook over medium heat 8 minutes , until broccoli is crisp-tender
7. Season to taste with salt and pepper
8. Transfer broccoli to a serving dish and sprinkle with parmesan

title: chicken and broccoli mornay
steps:
1. For sauce , combine first 4 ingredients in saucepan
2. Heat over low heat until hot and cheeses are melted , stirring frequently
3. Meanwhile , flatten chicken breasts slightly
4. Saute in butter until golden brown and cooked , about 8 to 10 minutes
5. Arrange chicken and broccoli on serving plate and spoon sauce over all

title: stove top tamale pie
steps:
1. In a large skillet , brown ground beef over medium-high heat
2. Drain
3. Stir in tomato sauce , beans , water and taco seasoning mix
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat , cover and simmer 5 minutes
6. Prepare corn muffin mix according to package directions
7. Drop small spoonfuls of muffin batter over meat mixture in a skillet
8. Cover and cook over medium-low heat 15-17 minutes or until corn bread is done
9. Top with cheese and green onion
10. Cover and cook over low heat until cheese melts

title: spicy crab mornay
steps:
1. Clean the crabs and remove all the flesh from the body , legs and claws
2. Thoroughly clean the backs of the crabs and reserve for use as a serving dish
3. Melt butter in a frypan / skillet and fry the shallots and capsicum for 2 to 3 minutes and then add the remaining ingredients except the parmesan cheese and combine well
4. Heat through but do not bring to the boil
5. Fill the crab shells or individual ramekins with the mixture
6. Sprinkle a tablespoon parmesan cheese over each serve and bake in a hot oven until golden brown

title: draino    drain cleaner
steps:
1. Pour baking soda down drain
2. Then pour the vinegar
3. Wait 20 minutes and pour down hot water
4. Worked for me :)

title: curried poached eggs
steps:
1. Fill medium saucepan with about 3 inches of water
2. Stir in coriander , curry powder , cumin , turmeric , salt and pepper
3. Bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat to a gentle simmer
5. Break one egg into a small dish
6. Gently slip egg into water
7. Repeat with remaining eggs
8. Cook in barely simmering water for 3 to 5 minutes
9. Remove eggs with a slotted spoon and drain well
10. Serve immediately on crisp buttered toast

title: fresh peach pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Line a 9-inch pie pan with pastry
3. Combine the 1 cup of sugar , flour and cinnamon , mixing well
4. Lightly mix in the fresh peaches and pour into the pie shell
5. Dot with butter and cover with a top crust
6. Prick the top crust and sprinkle with sugar
7. Put the pie into a 400 degree oven and bake for 40 to 50 minutes

title: easy no cook carob fudge
steps:
1. Cream together the butter , honey , and vanilla
2. Add the powders , mix all ingredients well , and form into balls
3. You can form the balls around a cashew or other nut
4. This must be kept refrigerated because of the butter

title: elegant chicken roulades with mushroom sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f butterfly each chicken breast with a sharp knife
2. Press open like a book
3. Season both sides with poultry seasoning and pepper and pound 1 / 4-inch thick between 2 sheets of plastic wrap with a meat mallet
4. Remove plastic wrap
5. Place equal amounts of prosciutto , cheese and mushrooms on each chicken breast
6. Press down on cheese to compress
7. Starting from the long side , roll up chicken tightly , then roll each in a piece of parchment paper
8. Twist edges of parchment to seal chicken inside
9. Place seam-side down on a baking sheet
10. Bake for 30 minutes
11. While chicken is cooking , prepare sauce by melting 4 tablespoons butter in a medium saucepan
12. Stir in flour and cook over medium heat for about 2 minutes
13. Slowly whisk in chicken broth until smooth
14. Simmer mixture until reduced by half , stirring occasionally
15. Remove from heat
16. Grind porcini mushrooms in a blender or food processor until they form a fine powder
17. Set aside 1 / 4 cup
18. Save remaining for another use
19. Whisk 1 / 4 cup mushrooms , sherry , sour cream and remaining 2 tablespoons butter into sauce
20. Simmer over low heat for a few minutes more
21. Season to taste with salt and pepper
22. Remove chicken from parchment and slice 1 / 2-inch thick
23. Arrange on 4 serving plates and drizzle with some of the sauce
24. Serve remaining sauce on the side

title: baked mashed idaho potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Spray a 1 1 / 2-quart casserole with cooking spray
3. In a bowl with an electric mixer , combine potatoes , egg , sour cream , cottage cheese and onions at medium speed
4. Spoon potato mixture into casserole dish
5. Sprinkle with crushed crackers and bake 30 minutes

title: no fat chocolate zucchini cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Combine and beat egg whites , applesauce , sugar and vanilla extract
3. Stir in the zucchini
4. Mix all of the dry ingredients and add to wet mixture and mix very well
5. Pour into a sprayed 9 x 13 pan or into 2 sprayed loaf pans
6. Bake 9 x 13 for about 35 minutes in preheated oven until done , or 2 loaves about an hour
7. Sift over powdered sugar , if desired

title: cinnamon orange popovers recipe
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425 f
2. Grease 6 popover molds
3. In a mixing bowl , combine all the dry ingredients
4. Whisk in remaining wet ingredients and stir until the batter is smooth
5. Fill the prepared molds halfway full and bake for 15 minutes
6. Lower the heat to 350 degrees and continue baking for an additional 20-30 minutes , until the popovers puff-up and turn golden-brown
7. Serve immediately

title: red beans and brown rice
steps:
1. Drain the beans , discarding the water , and set them aside in a pot
2. Place the onion , celery , garlic and bay leaves in a medium mixing bowl
3. Drizzle the olive oil over them and let the mixture sit at room temperature for at least 30 minutes
4. Dont skip it !
5. Pour the oil and veggie mixture over the beans and let that mix sit at room temp for 10 to 15 minutes
6. Add enough of the water to cover the beans and bring to a boil
7. Lower the temp to a simmer , add s & p , cover and cook for 3 to 4 hours
8. Remove the bay leaves and add final seasonings to taste
9. Serve the hot beans over the rice
10. I add plenty of red hot at the end , as well

title: curry chicken pot pie
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350 degrees f
2. I a saute pan heat 2 tablespoons of butter and sweat the onion , celery and pepper
3. In the microwave heat the milk and chicken broth
4. Add 2 remaining pats of butter to the pan
5. Add the flour and curry and cook 1 - 2 minutes
6. Wisk in the hot milk mixture and cook until thickened
7. Add the parsely
8. Toss the vegetables and chicken
9. Pour into a 9x13 pan sprayed with pam
10. Separate the biscuits in halves and slightly flatten with your hands over the pan
11. Cut remaining biscuits to "fill in" the little areas
12. Cook in oven until biscuits are browned and the mixture is hot and bubbly , about 25 - 30 minutes

title: red pepper vichyssoise
steps:
1. Cut the peppers into thirds
2. Remove seeds and membranes
3. Place the peppers in a large saucepan
4. Add water to cover
5. Bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat and simmer , uncovered for 6 minutes
7. Drain and let cool
8. This will make it easy to remove the skins of the peppers
9. Remove and discard the skin from the peppers
10. Place the peppers in a blender , and cover and process until smooth
11. Make sure you stop at least once to scrape down the sides of the blender
12. Cover and chill thoroughly
13. Saute leeks in the butter in a dutch oven over medium high heat , stirring constantly , until tender
14. Add broth and potato
15. Bring to a boil
16. Reduce heat , and simmer partially covered for 30 minutes or until the potato is tender
17. Place half of the potato-leek mixture in the container of a blender
18. Cover and process until smooth , stopping once to scrape down the sides
19. Repeat the procedure with the remaining potato mixure
20. Stir in the whipping cream , salt , and pepper
21. Cover and chill thoroughly
22. Combine the pepper mixture and the potato mixture
23. Stir well
24. To serve , ladle cold soup into individual bowls
25. Top each serving with a dollop of creme fraiche and garnish with chopped chives

title: quickie chicken biscuit pot pie
steps:
1. Combine vegetables , chicken , soup , salt , pepper and thyme
2. Pour into a 9 inch deep-dish pie pan or a 2 quart casserole dish
3. Combine biscuit mix , milk and egg
4. Pour over top
5. Line oven rack with foil just in case of overflow
6. Bake at 400 for 25-30 minutes

title: indian lentil soup
steps:
1. Combine the lentils , 2 boxes of chicken stock and turmeric in a heavy pot and bring to a boil
2. Cover , leaving the lid slightly ajar , turn heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes
3. While soup simmers , peel potatoes and cut into 1 / 2-inch cubes
4. When soup has cooked for 30 minutes , add cut potato
5. Cover , leaving the lid slightly ajar again , and continue simmering for another 30 minutes
6. During the second simmering period , put the garlic and ginger into an electric blender
7. Add 4 1 / 2 t water and blend until you have a smooth paste
8. Once the soup base has finished cooking it needs to be pureed
9. Blender 3 batches
10. Put pureed soup in a large bowl and set aside
11. Rinse and wipe out your soup pot
12. Place cooked and cubed chicken in a separate bowl and sprinkle with salt and pepper
13. Toss to mix
14. Next , pour oil into soup pot and set over medium heat
15. When oil is hot , put in the garlic / ginger paste , cumin , coriander and cayenne
16. Fry , stirring continuously , until the spice mixture is slightly browned and separates from the oil
17. Put in chicken pieces and fry for 1-2 minutes
18. Add 14 1 / 2 oz
19. Chicken stock and bring to boil
20. Cover and turn heat to low
21. Simmer for 5 minutes
22. Pour in pureed soup and lemon juice
23. Bring to a simmer and serve

title: spinach artichoke feta ball
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine all the ingredients
2. Mix together withclean hands until well blended
3. Form into a ball or log and set on swerving plate

title: citrusy walnut crusted rainbow trout
steps:
1. Grind walnuts , flour and 1 / 4 teaspoons each of salt and pepper in a food processor
2. Coat nonskin side of trout with mixture and set aside
3. In a large cast iron or nonstick skillet , saute garlic and shallot in 2 teaspoons of olive oil over medium heat for 3-4 minutes
4. Transfer to a blender and add broth , cilantro , lemon juice and remaining salt and pepper
5. Puree until smooth
6. Heat remaining oil in the same skillet over medium heat
7. Cook trout fillets for 1 minute per side
8. Pour cilantro broth over fillets and cook until fork tender
9. Serve on plates with remaining cilantro broth spooned over fillets

title: lane s stewed yellow squash stuff
steps:
1. Cut up about 4 or 5 medium yellow squash-slices
2. Cut up about 3-5 new potatoes in cubes
3. One medium onion sliced
4. Cut up in little squares several pieces of sharp cheddar cheese
5. Now relax and let us go to the stove
6. In a boiler or big frying pan , heat a couple of big blobs of butter on high until it melts
7. Afterward , cut the heat down a little bit
8. Now pour all of the vegetables you have prepared into pan / pot with melted butter
9. Season with several sprinkles of celery salt , pepper , seasoned salt , mrs
10. Dash , and this is the kicker , pour about a half cup of low-sodium v-8 juice into the pot / pan
11. I use a wooden stirring implement
12. It is the best thing to use for this recipe
13. Mix up the ingredients as it cooks on high , then put the lid on for a while
14. Pick up lid a little later and stir some more
15. Add another glob of butter
16. After stirring mixture several times and cooking for a while , eyeball the squash stuff cooking and look at it carefully
17. Does it seem to be browning and cooking properly ?
18. Does it smell good ?
19. If your answer is yes , you are doing everything right
20. Take lid off , cut the heat down low and let it simmer a bit
21. Bon appetit !

title: macaroon cookie bars
steps:
1. Combine cake mix , butter or margarine and 1 egg on high speed of mixer until crumbly
2. Press into greased 13x9 pan
3. Set aside
4. Mix together , milk , vanilla and remaining egg well
5. Stir in 1 cup coconut and nuts
6. Pour over chocolate crust
7. Spread evenly
8. Top with 1 / 4 cup coconut
9. Bake 350 for 30-40 minutes
10. Middle of pan may still be loose but will settle on cooling

title: swiss chard with beets  goat cheese and raisins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Wrap beets individually in foil
3. Roast until beets are tender , about 1 hour
4. Cool
5. Peel beets and cut into 1 / 2-inch cubes
6. Fold swiss chard leaves in half lengthwise and cut stalks away from leaves
7. Cut leaves coarsely into 1-inch pieces
8. Slice stalks thinly crosswise
9. Reserve stalks and leaves separately
10. Cook chopped leaves in large pot of boiled salted water until just tender , about 1 minute
11. Drain and reserve
12. In a small pan , toast pine nuts
13. Set aside
14. Heat oil in heavy large pot over high heat
15. Add sliced stalks
16. Saute until starting to soften , about 8 minutes
17. Add onion and next 3 ingredients
18. Saute 3 minutes
19. Add drained tomatoes and 1 cup raisins
20. Reduce heat to medium and simmer until vegetables are soft , stirring occasionally , about 15 minutes
21. Add chard leaves to pot
22. Stir to heat through
23. Remove from heat
24. Add lime juice and stir to blend
25. Season to taste with salt and pepper
26. Transfer chard mixture to large platter
27. Sprinkle with beets , goat cheese , toasted pine nuts , and remaining 2 tablespoons raisins
28. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: gado gado  indonesian salad
steps:
1. Bring the water to a boil
2. Add salt , cabbage , bean sprouts , and green beans
3. Boil vegetables for 5 minutes
4. Drain
5. Boil potatoes in a separate pot until tender then peel them
6. Cut potatoes , eggs and cucumber into slices
7. Heat peanut sauce on low heat
8. Arrange the green vegetables on a very large platter
9. Cover them with the sliced potatoes , eggs and cucumbers
10. Pour the peanut sauce over the entire platter and serve
11. Serving ideas : serve with white rice and a meat dish
12. We put the gado gado in a large casserole dish

title: layered cashew and mushroom nut roast
steps:
1. Pre-heat the oven at 180 celsius
2. Heat the oil and fry the onion and garlic until soft
3. Grind the cashew nuts in a nut mill , blender or mincer until they are in small pieces
4. Don't go too far
5. You don't want them in a powder
6. Mix the cashew nuts with the breadcrumbs
7. Beat the egg and add to the dry ingredients
8. Mix in the mashed parsnips and herbs
9. Add the fried , be sure to scrape the pan so that all the juices go in as this will help keep the nut roast moist
10. Dissolve the vegemite in the hot water or stock and add to the other ingredients
11. Season well
12. Melt the butter in a frying pan and saute the chopped mushrooms until soft
13. Grease a 900g loaf tin with butter and put in half the nut mixture
14. Cover with a layer of mushrooms and add the rest of the nut mixture
15. Cover with foil and bake for one hour
16. When cooked , remove from the oven and let it stand for 10 minutes before turning it out
17. Serve hot or cold

title: braised rabbit
steps:
1. Combine the flour , salt and pepper
2. Dredge the rabbit pieces in the seasoned flour
3. Combine the egg and 1 t water
4. Dip the rabbit pieces in the egg
5. Coat the pieces well with bread crumbs
6. Brown on all sides in the hot lard or bacon drippings
7. Slowly add 1 c water to the skillet and cover tightly
8. Simmer 1 hour or more until tender

title: creamy tomato basil tortellini soup
steps:
1. Coat soup pan with olive oil
2. Add onion and garlic and saute till soft
3. Add canned diced tomatoes , basil , tomato soup and two cans milk
4. Stir till blended
5. Add chicken broth and stir in tomato paste till blended
6. Simmer for 20 minutes
7. Add light cream and parmesan cheese
8. Add tortellini and cook till tender

title: ziti with portobello mushrooms  caramelized onions  goat cheese
steps:
1. 1
2. In a large frying pan , melt 1 tablespoon butter with 2 tablespoons olive oil over moderate heat
3. Add the onions , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and sugar , then cook , stirring frequently , until onions are well browned , about 20 minutes
4. Remove from pan
5. 2
6. In the same pan , melt remaining 1 tablespoon butter with 1 tablespoon oil over moderate heat
7. Add the mushrooms and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and cook , stirring occasionally , until tender and brown , about 8 minutes
8. Add the reserved onions , parsley , and the remaining 1 / 4 teaspoon salt , and the pepper
9. 3
10. In a large pot of boiling , salted water , cook the ziti until just done , about 13 minutes
11. Reserve 3 / 4 cup of the pasta water and drain
12. Toss the ziti and 1 / 2 cup of reserved pasta water with the mushroom mixture , remaining tablespoon of oil , the goat cheese , and the parmesan
13. If pasta seems dry , add more of pasta water
14. Serve with additional parmesan

title: onion  mushroom and spinach saute  for two
steps:
1. Preheat a medium saute pan on medium heat
2. Add olive oil
3. Add onions and mushrooms , stirring for 5-10 minutes , until golden brown , adding garlic halfway through
4. Add spinach and stir a minute or two , until spinach is just wilted
5. Remove from heat and add balsamic vinegar , salt and pepper to taste

title: corny snack mix
steps:
1. In several large bowls , combine the popcorn , corn pops and corn chips
2. In a saucepan over medium-low heat , melt chips
3. Stir until smooth
4. Pour over popcorn mixture and toss to coat
5. Spread in two 15 x 10 x 1 inch pans
6. Cool
7. Store in airtight containers

title: best ever banana bread  honestly
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Cream butter and sugar
3. Mash bananas , beat 2 eggs and add to the bananas with vanilla and buttermilk
4. Mix well and add to creamed butter and sugar
5. Sift together flour , soda and salt
6. Add to banana mixture , beat well
7. Pour into 2 greased and floured 9x5x3-inch loaf pans
8. Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until bread pulls away from sides of pan
9. Add topping
10. To prepare topping: melt butter in saucepan
11. Add sugar and milk
12. Cook until syrupy
13. Remove from heat and add chopped pecans
14. Pour over bread spreading to all the corners and place under broiler until bubbly and brown
15. Watch closely

title: hilltop s baked haddock
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 500 degrees f
2. In a small bowl , combine the milk and salt
3. In a separate bowl , mix together the bread crumbs , parmesan cheese , and thyme
4. Dip the haddock fillets in the milk , then press into the crumb mixture to coat
5. Place haddock fillets in a glass baking dish , and drizzle with melted butter
6. Bake on the top rack of the preheated oven until the fish flakes easily , about 15 minutes

title: bolo prestigio amarelinho  yellow cake  brazilian
steps:
1. In blender put carrots , oil and eggs and blend until creamy
2. Sift flour and baking powder
3. Add sugar and mix well
4. Blend in the carrot cream
5. Put in a greased pan and bake in 350 f oven for 40-45 minutes
6. Filling: in small pan put the sweetened condensed milk
7. Add two measures of the can with water and the coconut
8. Cook it on low , mixing constantly , until it boils
9. Cut cooled cake in half and spread filling on one half
10. Cover with other half
11. Icing: put can in pressure cooker and cover with water
12. Pressure cook 50 minutes
13. Let pressure subside and remove can from pan
14. Wait until completely cool to open can
15. Spread icing on top and sides of cake and sprinkle chocolate
16. I personally like it more liquid , so it will permeate the cake when you pour it
17. The leftover filling can be used in another cake or on top of ice cream

title: coffee turkish style
steps:
1. Place coffee , water , and sugar into a 4-cup jezve[a long handled coffee pot]
2. Brew over very low heat , stirring occasionally , until the froth on the surface begins to rise
3. Do not boil
4. Pour a small amount of froth into demitasse cups
5. Return the pot to the heat until the coffee just begins to boil
6. Remove from the heat immediately , and pour the remaining coffee into the demitasse cups
7. Do not drink the residue at the bottom of the cup
8. For a special flavor , several cardamom seeds may be added to the pot while the coffee is brewing

title: soy dream nog  dairy free eggnog
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a blender until smooth and frothy
2. Refrigerate before serving

title: balsamic chicken with mushrooms  8 weight watchers points
steps:
1. Place chicken in a bowl with dressing to marinate
2. Stem , clean and cut mushrooms into quarters
3. Place chicken and dressing into a saute pan or skillet
4. Pour mushrooms around the chicken
5. Cook over medium high heat , covered for 5 minutes
6. Remove lid and cook over medium high heat until chicken is browned and cooked through

title: kellogg s raisin bran cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Stir cereal , flours and baking soda together and set aside
3. In a large bowl , beat margarine and both sugars together until light and fluffy
4. Add eggs and beat well
5. Stir in the dry ingredients , mixing thoroughly
6. Drop by level 1 / 4 cup measure onto ungreased cookie sheet
7. Bake at 325 for 12-14 minutes , until lightly brown
8. Cool and wrap individaully

title: the best burgers
steps:
1. Mix altogether
2. Grill or broil
3. Top with cheese slices
4. Serve on onion buns or buns of choice

title: oatmeal granola cookie balls
steps:
1. Mix wet ingredients
2. Mix dry ingredients
3. Combine until well incorporated
4. Use a cookie scoop to form dough into balls
5. Arrange on cookie sheet
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 9 minutes

title: sauteed chicken with capers and lemon butter
steps:
1. Season cutlets with salt and pepper
2. Grate 1 / 2 tsp lemon zest and squeeze 2 t juice from the lemon
3. Set aside
4. Heat butter and olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat
5. Add the chicken and cook , turning once , until golden brown and cooked through
6. Remove chicken to serving plates , leaving drippings in the pan
7. Add 3 t water , lemon juice , lemon zest and capers to the pan and cook , stirring up browned bits from bottom of pan , for about 1 minute
8. Mash a few of the capers into the sauce with the back of a spoon
9. Pour the sauce over the chicken and serve

title: greek flounder
steps:
1. Combine first 6 ingredients in a small bowl
2. Place fish in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish coated with cooking spray
3. Pour lemon juice mixture over fish
4. Bake at 350 degrees for 13 to 15 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork
5. Sprinkle with parsley

title: april s baked chicken parmesan
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Pour bread crumbs onto plate and combine with parmesan cheese
3. Coat chicken with bread crumb mixture and then placed onto greased baking sheet and cook for 25 minutes
4. Pour a bit of prego sauce into 13x9" baking pan
5. Place chicken into pan and then cover with remaining prego sauce , then spread mozzarella cheese on top
6. Sprinkle parmesan cheese on top
7. Return to oven and cook uncovered for a further 25 minutes
8. Remove from oven and serve over cooked spaghetti

title: mushroom linguini
steps:
1. Linguini: cook as per package directions
2. Drain before adding sauce
3. In a large saucepan melt 2 tbls
4. Butter
5. Add garlic and cook until tender
6. Add mushrooms , basil and a dash of salt
7. Saute until tender
8. Add rest of the butter , olive oil and pepper to mushrooms
9. Add mushrooms to pasta and toss
10. Garnish w / parsley
11. Serve w / fresh parmesan cheese

title: spicy salmon salad
steps:
1. With a sharp knife , cut the salmon filet into 8 equal strips
2. Pat dry with paper towel and lay in a large glass rectangular baking dish
3. In a small bowl combine ginger , garlic powder & cayenne pepper
4. Stir to mix
5. Add soy sauce , hot sauce and sesame oil
6. Mix well
7. Brush all the sauce onto each side of each strip of salmon
8. Cover with plastic wrap and leave in fridge for 30 minutes
9. Heat oven to 375f remove plastic wrap and recover with tinfoil
10. Cook salmon for 30 minutes or until opaque and flakes with fork
11. Right before salmon is done , slice cherry tomatoes in half and mix in large bowl with salad greens
12. Toss all vinaigrette ingredients in a jar and shake well
13. You can use more olive oil if you like
14. Drizzle small amounts of vinaigrette over salad and toss well until satisfied with covering
15. Set aside remaining dressing
16. Divide salad among 4 plates and top each serving with 2 strips of salmon
17. Drizzle with a little bit of remaining vinaigrette just before serving
18. Serve with an 8 or 12 grain baguette and a nice pinot grigio
19. Preparation time does not include marinating time

title: maple dijon grilled chicken
steps:
1. Marinate the chicken in the maple syrup , dijon mustard , olive oil , salt and pepper for at least 30 minutes
2. Grill the chicken until it is cooked , about 4-5 minutes per side

title: cantaloupe bruschetta
steps:
1. Slice cantaloupe into thin chunks about 2 inches square
2. Spread bread rounds with pesto
3. Using a vegetable peeler , slice cheese into 6 thick slices
4. Assemble bruschetta as follows: bread round , prosciutto slice , cheese slice , melon slice
5. Secure with wooden skewers or long toothpicks
6. Serve immediately

title: cantaloupe banana slush
steps:
1. Arrange cantaloupe and banana in a single layer on a baking sheet
2. Freeze until firm
3. Place frozen fruit in a food processor
4. Process until chunky
5. With processor on , slowly add remaining ingredients
6. Process until smooth
7. Serve immediately

title: ginger chai glazed bundt cake
steps:
1. Set a rack in the lower third of the oven and preheat to 350
2. Prepare a bundt pan by brushing with melted butter and sprinkling with flour , tapping out the excess flour
3. Sift the flour , baking powder and salt together
4. Set aside
5. Cream the butter and sugar till creamy
6. Add the eggs one at a time , mix thoroughly , stop and scrape as you go to ensure even mixing
7. Add the flour mixture and chai alternately , beginning and ending with the flour in three parts and the chai in two parts
8. Mix thoroughly after each addition
9. Pour the batter into the prepared pan , smooth the top and bake for about 40 45 minutes , until the top springs back when pressed gently with a finger
10. Cool on a rack for about 20 30 minutes , depan and cool completely
11. To make the glaze , sift the powdered sugar with the spices and stir in the chai extract , 1 / 2 tablespoon at a time , to form a smooth , thick yet pourable glaze
12. It should be thick and ropy to cling to the cake
13. Set the cake on a rack over a plate and spoon the glaze in a circular fashion over the cake
14. Let it fall in place or smooth with an offset spatula , as you like
15. After a few minutes , spoon the dripped glaze from the plate back over the cake
16. Press the crystallized ginger onto the glaze as it sets , if using

title: croissants and puff pastry
steps:
1. Mix the dough ingredients until well mixed , place in greased , covered bowl and refrigerate overnight
2. It's not necessary to knead the dough unless for a few times to mix the dough
3. Wrap 2 sticks of butter touching in plastic wrap
4. Pound with a rolling pin until the butter block is 5 by 6 inches
5. The butter should be cold but pliable
6. Test by poking a finger to see if an indention is easily left
7. Lightly flour the counter and dough and roll dough out to a 5
8. 5" by 12
9. 5" rectangle
10. Brush off the flour and place the butter block on half the dough and fold the other half over
11. Seal the dough around the butter
12. Adding a little flour and tapping the top of the package with the rolling pin , roll the dough out into an 8" x 18" rectangle
13. Brushing off the flour , fold the dough over letter-style to make 3 layers in an 8" x 6" bundle
14. Wrap the package and chill for 30 minutes in the fridge
15. Roll the dough stretching the longer side out until the rectangle is 8 by 18" again
16. Triple fold again , wrap and chill for 30 minutes
17. Repeat this one more time , chilling the package for 30 minutes
18. Take the dough our and roll it into an 8" wide , 28" long rectangle , trimming off excess
19. Divide this dough into 7 rectangles , 4" wide and 8" long
20. Divide each rectangle diagonally so that there are 14 triangles , 4" at the base and 8" to the
21. Take each triangle and make a 3 / 4" slit half-way along the base
22. Stretch the triangle from base to
23. Rolling from the base , roll each croissant up and place on cookie sheets or baking pans lined with parchment
24. Spray the parchment lightly with oil first
25. Preheat the oven to 450f , but drop to 375f when croissants go into the oven
26. Cover the croissants with oiled plastic wrap and let rise for 60 to 90 minutes until it's risen 1
27. 5 times its volume
28. If a shiny surface is desired , brush lightly with an egg wash
29. Bake at 375f in the upper portion of the oven for 12 minutes
30. Rotate the pan and bake for 12 to 15 minutes more or until browned and 205 f internally

title: chicken quiche with potato crust
steps:
1. Pat hash browns with paper towels to remove excess moisture
2. Press into a well-greased 9-in pie plate
3. Brush with butter
4. Bake at 425 for 20-25 minutes or until lightly browned
5. Reduce heat to 350
6. Sprinkle cheese and chicken into the crust
7. In a bowl , beat the eggs , cream and salt
8. Pour over chicken
9. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean
10. Let stand for 5 minutes before cutting

title: stove top cookies   fry pan cookies
steps:
1. Sprinkle powdered sugar or coconut evenly onto a parchment or wax paper-lined 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan
2. Set aside
3. Combine sugar and eggs in a large saucepan
4. Stir well
5. Add dates and butter
6. Cook over low heat , stirring constantly , 8 minutes or until mixture is thickened and bubbly
7. Remove from heat
8. Stir in cereal , pecans and vanilla , mixing well
9. Spread cereal mixture evenly onto prepared pan
10. Let stand for 15 minutes
11. Roll the mixture into a 15-inch log , beginning at long side
12. Let cool completely
13. Cut into 1 / 2-inch thick slices

title: raspberry meringue cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 250
2. Beat egg whites with salt
3. Add gelatin and sugar gradually
4. Beat until soft peaks form and sugar is dissolved
5. Beat in vinegar
6. Fold in white chocolate chips
7. Drop one teaspoons worth of meringue onto an un-greased cookie sheet lined with parchment or brown paper
8. [if you make them too big , they wont cook all of the way through
9. Also , i have found that it works best if you use a non-stick cookie sheet
10. ]
11. Bake 25 minutes
12. Turn oven off and leave the cookies in the oven 20 minutes longer

title: mint basting sauce  for grilling meats
steps:
1. Measure mint leaves loosely: i am not sure how much i use
2. Chop them very finely
3. Mix all the ingredients and whisk well
4. Pour into a glass or ceramic jug , or into a canning bottle , cover , and let stand for several hours or overnight
5. Whisk again before use
6. Brush over chops , steaks or chicken while grilling

title: all purpose hawaiian marinade
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix all ingredients together
2. Allow meat to marinate in zip top baggies for 12 to 48 hours
3. Remove meat from bags and pour marinade into sauce pan
4. Bring to boil over medium high heat and for 10 minutes
5. Baste meat with marinade in between flips on the grill

title: pasta with broccoli  cheese and bacon
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Drain and set aside
3. Trim tough ends from broccoli stalks
4. Separate florets from stalks
5. Lightly peel stalks
6. Slice into 1 / 2-inch pieces
7. Bring a large pot of water to boil
8. Add broccoli and cook until crisp-tender , 3 to 5 minutes
9. Drain well
10. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat
11. Stir in broccoli , bacon , pasta and parmesan
12. Heat through
13. Add salt and pepper to taste and serve hot

title: mediterranean style vegetables
steps:
1. In a dutch oven or large kettle combine zucchini , sweet peppers , broccoli , chicken broth , garlic , basil or oregano , and pepper
2. Bring to boiling
3. Reduce heat
4. Simmer , covered , for 6-8 minutes or until crisp-tender , stirring occasionally
5. Stir in tomatoes

title: pasta salad with mozzarella  sun dried tomatoes and olives
steps:
1. Blend first 5 ingredients in processor till tomatoes are coarsely chopped and set dressing aside
2. Cook pasta till tender but still firm to bite , drain , transfer to large bowl
3. Add dressing to hot pasta , toss to coat
4. Cool pasta , stirring occasionally
5. Add fresh tomatoes , mozzarella , basil , parmesan and olives , toss
6. Season to taste with salt and pepper
7. Can be made 6 hours ahead
8. Cover , chill
9. Bring to room temp
10. Before serving

title: french country chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Rub each chicken breast with butter , then coat with breadcrumbs
3. Place in greased 8x8 baking dish
4. Cook for 15 minutes
5. Remove from oven , and top each breast with a slice of muenster
6. Pour wine evenly on top of the chicken
7. Return to oven and bake an additional 15 minutes

title: thai fish curry   kaeng ped pla   or tofu
steps:
1. The marinade , prepare at least 1-2 hours before , or even overnight:
2. Combine the lime juice , half of the fish sauce , and the soy sauce in a shallow non-metallic dish
3. Add the chile and the fish , stir or use your hands to coat
4. Cover and let chill for 1-2 hours , or overnight
5. Ready to cook:
6. Start your rice as per package directions
7. Depending on the sort you are using , the cooking time will vary
8. Add the curry paste to a med hot pan , warm it up a bit and then add the coconut milk , the lime leaves , the remaining fish sauce and the lemon grass
9. Simmer gently for 10-15 minutes
10. Add the fish , the marinade and red bell pepper or other veg if you're using one
11. Let it all simmer together for about 5 minutes , until the fish and veg are cooked
12. If you need to have this sit for longer , be sure not to add the veg too early or they will be over cooked
13. At this point you may want to add a pinch of brown sugar if it tastes too sour or salty
14. Stir the chopped fresh cilantro through the hot boiled rice
15. Serve the curry with the rice , garnish the curry with pistachio nuts and / or chopped mango if you like -- it adds a nice touch

title: pumpkin chess pie
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Defrost pie crust or make your own and put into a 10" pan preferably
3. If using a 9" pan you will have some leftover filling
4. Beat pumpkin , sugar and butter in a large bowl at medium speed until smooth , about 5 minutes
5. Add eggs one at a time , beating after each addition
6. Add remaining ingredients and beat until everything is well blended
7. Pour into pie shell
8. Bake for 1 hour 10 min
9. , or until center is almost set
10. Cool completely before chilling or eating ! enjoy !

title: lemon cream stuffed french toast with streusel topper and fresh
steps:
1. 1
2. Preheat oven to 350f lightly grease a 3-quart rectangular baking dish
3. Set aside
4. In a large bowl beat cream cheese with an electric mixer on medium speed until smooth
5. Beat in powdered sugar and vanilla
6. Add pie filling
7. Beat until well combined
8. In a large bowl whisk together eggs and milk until combined
9. 2
10. Trim ends off french bread and discard or save for another use
11. Cut loaf into 16 slices
12. Arrange half the slices in the prepared baking dish , overlapping slices if necessary
13. Evenly pour on 1 / 2 of the egg mixture
14. Spoon lemon filling atop bread slices in dish , spreading evenly
15. Top with remaining bread slices
16. Dish will be very full
17. Slowly pour remaining egg mixture evenly over bread slices in dish
18. 3
19. In a medium bowl combine oats , brown sugar , cinnamon , and salt
20. Using a pastry blender , cut in butter until mixture is crumbly
21. Sprinkle oat mixture over bread slices in dish
22. 4
23. Bake , uncovered , for 40 to 45 minutes or until set in the center
24. Let stand on a wire rack for 20 to 30 minutes before serving
25. Serve with berries

title: best ever bbq ribs
steps:
1. Heat oven to 325f
2. Wash ribs and pat dry with paper towels
3. Set on rimmed baking sheet or in a large roasted pan
