4. Place mustard , onion powder , garlic powder , allspice powder , chili powder , cayenne , lowry's seasoned salt , salt and pepper in a gallon-sized re-closable plastic bag , or a pizza spice shaker container , and shake vigorously to mix well
5. Pour half seasoned rub mixture onto one side of the ribs and massage into flesh
6. Turn ribs over and pour the remaining rub mixture onto other side of ribs and massage into flesh
7. Cover ribs fully with a large sheet of heavy duty tin foil , rolling edges of foil under and into baking sheet to make an air proof seal
8. I leave them in the frige overnight to merinate well
9. I don't know if this is what makes them so tender , but they are ! place in oven and cook for 3 hours
10. Remove from oven , carefully unseal foil - keep your hands and face a way from the hot steam
11. Heat grill to high
12. Place barbecue sauces , brown sugar , garlic , liquid smoke and cider vinegar into a medium-sized sauce pan , stir to combine
13. Using a large pastry brush , baste generously with sauce
14. Place sauce over medium-high heat , bring to a boil , then lower heat to medium and cook for 5 minutes
15. Remove from heat and set aside
16. Place ribs on grill and cook , about 4-6 minutes a side , 8-12 minutes total
17. Remove to a cutting board , cut into 2-3 rib portions , place on serving platter and serve with remaining barbecue sauce on the side

title: portabella mushrooms stuffed with chicken
steps:
1. Clean portabello mushrooms , remove stem and scrape inside to remove brown part
2. Put mushrooms in a greased 13inch x 11 inch pan , i use cooking spray
3. Brush inside mushroom caps with 1 tablespoon of olive oil
4. Brown ground chicken in 1 tablespoon of olive oil , add spices , remove from pan and cool
5. In the same frying pan add white wine , spinach and garlic scraping up the bits left from the chicken
6. Cook over medium heat for about 5 minutes til spinach is wilted
7. Cool and add to chicken
8. Mix well and put a heaping spoonful onto each mushroom cap
9. Pour tomato sauce over the mushrooms
10. Sprinkle cheese on top
11. Bake uncovered for 25 minutes in 350 degree oven

title: shoepeg corn with green chile casserole
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients into a casserole dish
2. Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes
3. Stir before serving

title: pressure cooker pot roast with mushroom gravy   easy
steps:
1. Brown meat on all sides in oil in cooker
2. Mix all other ingredients and add to cooker , coating meat
3. Cover and cook 50-60 minutes after control jiggles
4. Cool cooker normally for 5 minutes , then place under faucet to depressurize
5. The gravy came out perfect for us -- thin with beef stock or thicken to your own taste

title: antoine s shrimp creole
steps:
1. Saut green pepper and onion in 2 tbsps
2. Butter
3. Add tomatoes and juice and other seasoniongs
4. Blend in the cornstarch using a wire whip
5. Simmer covered 1 hour
6. Saut the shrimp in 3 tbsps
7. Butter that has been seasoned with salt and pepper
8. Add shrimp to the sauce
9. Remove bay leaves and serve with cooked white rice
10. It can also be frozen

title: favorite spinach casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray 2-9x13 casserole pans
3. Thaw spinach and drain well
4. Drain artichoke hearts and rough chop
5. Drain mushrooms
6. Mix all ingredients well
7. Bake uncovered for 25-30 minutes

title: black forest dessert 1st place winner
steps:
1. Mix cake as directed
2. Pour into 2 greased and floured 13x9 inch pans
3. Bake 20 minutes at 350f cool
4. Beat pudding and milk until creamy
5. Set aside
6. Beat cream cheese
7. Blend pudding into cream cheese , a little at a time
8. Pour over cakes
9. Pour pie filling on this , and then spread cool whip on top
10. Top with hershey bar , that has been grated
11. Refrigerate
12. Freezes well
13. Wonderful to make ahead of time , and take out of freezer on the morning you plan to serve
14. Keep leftovers refrigerated
15. Can cut each cake into 8 or 12 pieces , depending on amount of guests
16. A crowd pleaser ! they will ask for more !

title: artichoke parmesan canapes
steps:
1. Combine artichoke hearts , mayo , onion , and 1 / 3 of cheese
2. Combine until well mixed
3. Spread mixture on untoasted sides of bread cutouts
4. Sprinkle lightly with remaining cheese
5. Broil until bubbly

title: my momma s meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix ground beef , onion , egg , salt , pepper , and 1 / 2 can tomato sauce
3. Put in pan
4. Set aside
5. In small bowl , mix 1 / 2 can tomato sauce , mustard , vinegar , and brown sugar
6. Pour over meatloaf
7. Bake 2 hours at 350 degrees

title: pink greyhound cocktail
steps:
1. Pour all the ingredients into a tall glass
2. Stir to blend
3. Fill glass with ice

title: fairway market macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Butter a 13x9 inch baking pan generously
3. Bring a large pot of salted water to boiling over high heat
4. Cook the macaroni until al dente
5. Drain , then transfer to a large bowl
6. In a large saucepan over medium heat , melt the 2 tablespoons butter
7. Whisk in the flour , mixing well so there are no lumps
8. Slowly whisk in the half-and-half
9. Increase heat to med-high , and bring the mixture to a boil
10. Add in the cheeses , lower heat to medium , and whisk well to incorporate
11. Season with salt and pepper
12. Add the sauce to the macaroni
13. Mix well to combine
14. Transfer mixture to the baking pan
15. Sprinkle with bread crumbs
16. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until bubbly and golden

title: sausage stuffed hash browns  5fix
steps:
1. Fill a large pot with 3 inches of oil
2. Heat oil to 325 degrees
3. In a large bowl , combine potatoes , eggs and flour
4. Stir to combine well
5. Put a golf ball amount of potato mixture in the palm of your hand
6. Take one sausage and carefully form the potato mixture around the sausage
7. Carefully drop the potato ball in the hot grease
8. Don't cook no more than 4-5 at a time
9. Cook for 2-3 minutes or until golden brown
10. Remove with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel
11. Repeat until all potato mixture is used
12. Served immediately with your favorite dipping sauce
13. Be careful , the potatoes will be hot
14. Makes 15

title: chicken pot pie with buttermilk biscuit crust
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray a 2 quart casserole dish with cooking spray
3. In medium saucepan combine chicken breasts and water
4. Bring to a gentle boil and simmer til done
5. Remove chicken from pan
6. Saving broth for later
7. Shred chicken when cool enough to handle , set aside
8. Add potatoes , celery and bouillon cube to reserved broth , bring to a boil and simmer for 12 mins or until veggies are tender
9. Set aside in heavy saucepan
10. Melt butter over low heat , add 2 tbsp flour , stirring until smooth
11. Cook for 1 min stirring constantly
12. Gradually add milk and cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until mixture is thick
13. Remove from heat and stir in poultry seasoning
14. In large bowl combine shredded chicken , frozen veggies , sauce and mushrooms
15. Spoon into prepared casserole dish and set aside
16. In small bowl combine 1 cup flour , baking powder and salt
17. Cut in remaining 2 tbsp butter with a pastry blender until the mixture resembles coarse meal
18. Stir in buttermilk until just mixed
19. Spoon the biscuit dough in lumps over the chicken mixture
20. Bake for 1 hour , or until biscuits are golden and mixture is hot and bubbly

title: danish pork burgers
steps:
1. Combine the pork , onion , saltines , milk , eggs , salt , and pepper in a large bowl
2. Use your hands to mix well together
3. Lightly brush a large , nonstick skillet with vegetable oil
4. Heat on medium high heat
5. Divide the pork mixture into 8 equal portions
6. Working in batches , drop them from a spoon into the hot pan , spacing them evenly
7. Pat down with the back of a spoon to form into patties
8. Cook each patty , turning once , for 4 to 5 minutes per side , until golden brown
9. Serve the burgers hot with a dollop of dijon mustard

title: paula deen s crab cakes
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix together all ingredients , except for the flour and peanut oil
2. Shape into patties and dust with flour
3. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat
4. When oil is hot , carefully place crab cakes , in batches , in pan and fry until browned , about 4 to 5 minutes
5. Carefully flip crab cakes and fry on other side until golden brown , about 4 minutes
6. Serve warm with preferred sauce

title: rutabaga  yellow turnip or swede  apple gratin
steps:
1. When you have peeled the rutabaga cut it in half lengthwise , then into quarters
2. Thinly slice each quarter crosswise and place in boiling water
3. Cover and cook apprx 10 minutes or until almost tender
4. Drain& set aside
5. In a large bowl whisk the cornstarch and water until smooth
6. Add apples , salt , pepper& savory
7. Toss to coat the apples
8. Add rutabagas& gently toss to mix all the ingredients
9. Pour into an 8" oven proof dish , cover and bake at 350f for 20 minutes meanwhile in a bowl toss the bread crumbs , parsley& butter
10. Sprinkle the crumbs over the rutabagas , return to the oven uncovered for a further 20 minutes or until the rutabagas are tender
11. Broil for a couple of minutes to allow the gratin to get golden
12. Serve hot

title: baked acorn squash with sherry  thanksgiving
steps:
1. Cut squash in half and scrape the cavities clean
2. Melt the butter and mix with the brown sugar and sherry
3. Pile this mixture into each cavity and bake at 375 degrees for 45 minutes to an hour

title: mesquite steak fries
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 435f
2. Place the potato wedges , salt , pepper , and tsp
3. Of the mesquite seasoning into a large zip-lock bag
4. Seal and shake to coat
5. Place the potatoes in a roasting pan coated with butter or a little bit of olive oil
6. Bake for 30 minutes , turning occasionally , until golden
7. Serve hot , with disired dip

title: vegetable stuffed pork chops  crock pot
steps:
1. Cut pocket into each pork chop , cutting from edge nearest bone
2. Lightly season pockets with salt and pepper to taste
3. Combine corn , onion , bell pepper , bread crumbs and rice in a large bowl
4. Stuff pork chops with vegetable-rice mixture
5. Secure along fat side with wooden toothpicks
6. Pour any remaining vegetable-rice mixture into slow cooker
7. Add stuffed pork chops to slow cooker
8. Moisten top of each pork chop with tomato sauce
9. Pour any remaining tomato sauce on top
10. Cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours or until done

title: flax berry smoothie  w spinach   shhh they won t know
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a blender
2. Pulse on the ice crush option until the berries are mostly blended , then put on puree for about 2 minutes or until smooth

title: super easy lo mein
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil
2. Add angel hair pasta and mixed veggies to pot
3. Continue to cook for 5 minutes
4. While the pasta is cooking , prepare the sauce
5. Combine the hoisin sauce , broth , soy sauce , cornstarch , and ginger in a small bowl
6. When pasta is done , drain well
7. Transfer back into the pot , or into a serving dish
8. Combine with the sauce mixture
9. Serve and enjoy !

title: honey apple butter
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in your crock pot
2. Cook on high for 1 hour and then on low for 11-12 hours till thick
3. Stir occasionally
4. Transfer to 4 pint jars and invert to seal
5. Apple butter should be hot enough to not have to can in a water bath
6. You may also cook the mixture on low on your stovetop for approximately 3-4 hours

title: micheles crock pot chicken tortilla soup
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients to the corn in the large crock pot
2. Cook for 6 to 8 hours on low
3. If using whole chicken breast remove before serving and shred with forks , then return to pot and stir
4. The others items on list are for garnish after this bad boy is cooked
5. Serve in your favorite soup bowls with chips and garnish of choice -- oh i added some more raw onions and would use green onions next time for some other green color

title: spaghetti with bean and chestnut sauce
steps:
1. Cook the spaghetti according to pack instructions
2. Meanwhile heat the oil and gently fry the chilli for 2 minutes
3. Add the puree , stock and sherry to the pan and heat gently to make a sauce
4. Stir in thyme , beans , chestnut and seasoning if desired
5. Warm over a gentle heat for 5 minutes stir in cream
6. Drain pasta and toss in sauce
7. Serve garnished with parsley and black pepper

title: parsley red potatoes
steps:
1. Cut a strip of peel around the middle of each potato if desired
2. Set aside
3. In large skillet , saute onion and garlic in oil until tender
4. Stir in broth and 3 / 4 cup parsley , bring to a boil
5. Add potatoes
6. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender
7. Sprinkle with salt , pepper and remaining parsley

title: teriyaki edamame
steps:
1. Combine teriyaki sauce , sesame oil , rice vinegar and dark brown sugar
2. Set aside
3. In a skillet bring water to a simmer and add the frozen edamame
4. Stirring often , cook until the edamame is thawed , and almost all of the water evaporated
5. Add the teriyaki mixture and bring to a boil
6. Cook over high heat until mixture is thick and syrupy
7. Toss with sesame seeds and serve immediately

title: green chile chicken casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray bottom of large saucepan with cooking spray and saute garlic and onion until onions are soft
3. Add chicken broth , green chiles , sour cream , salt , cumin black pepper and soup stirring with a whisk
4. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly
5. Remove from heat
6. Spread 1 cup of soup mixture in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish coated with cooking spray
7. Arrange 4 tortillas over the top of soup mixture
8. Repeat layers (3 tortilla layers topped with 1 / 4 of remaining soup mixure , 1 cup chicken and 1 / 2 cup cheese
9. Bake at 350f for 30 minutes or until bubbly

title: no meat chili
steps:
1. Chop the green pepper
2. Heat the oil in a medium saucepan and saute the pepper until tender-crisp
3. Add the chili powder and saute 1 minute more
4. Drain the 3 cans of beans
5. Add the beans , picante sauce , and tomatoes to the peppers and mix well
6. Season with salt , black pepper , and cayenne pepper to taste
7. Add the corn and simmer , covered , until the corn is done and mixture is heated through , about 10-15 minutes

title: steamed fish and vegetables for one
steps:
1. Place fish in a 15-inch x 12-inch piece of heavy-duty foil
2. Add the vegetables and sprinkle with lemon juice , parsley , lemon pepper and dill
3. Fold foil over and fold in edges twice , forming a pouch
4. Place on a baking sheet
5. Bake at 450 degrees for 15-20 minutes or until vegetables are tender and fish flakes easily with a fork
6. Carefully open pouch to allow steam to escape

title: potato salad  no mayonnaise
steps:
1. Fry bacon until well done , drain , and crumble
2. Set aside
3. In a saucepan , place potatoes in salted cold water and cover
4. Bring potatoes to a boil and cook 20 to 25 minutes or until tender
5. Drain and cool
6. Peel potatoes , cut into 1 / 4-inch slices , and place in a mixing bowl
7. Add onions , parsley , and half of the bacon crumbles to the potatoes
8. In a small bowl , combine vinegar , oil , hot sauce , sour cream , salt , and pepper
9. Add the vinegar mixture to potato mixture and toss
10. Cover and chill for at least 4 hours
11. Garnish with the remaining bacon and serve

title: thai red pepper dipping sauce   hot
steps:
1. Crush red peppers and garlic in morter
2. Transfer to a bowl , add everything
3. Mix well
4. Add small lime chunks
5. Enjoy

title: cracker barrel like hash browns casserole   copycat
steps:
1. Combine soup , margarine , butter , onion , cheese , salt and pepper in bowl , mix well
2. Break up potatoes with fork
3. Add to soup mixture , mix gently
4. Spoon into 12x12-inch baking dish sprayed with nonstick cooking spray
5. Bake at 350f for 35 minutes

title: slow cooker baked beans
steps:
1. In a large pot over high heat , combine the beans with water to cover and bring to a boil for 10 minutes
2. Remove from heat , but let sit for 1 hour
3. Drain beans and place them in a slow cooker
4. Add the onion , brown sugar , maple syrup , salt and water
5. Mix well , cover and cook on high setting for 4-5 hours , stirring occasionally
6. During the final hour of cooking , add the ketchup and mustard
7. Mix well and serve

title: grandma addie s fried corn
steps:
1. Sizzle everything in a pan until the butter and cream cheese melt together and the corn is hot
2. Salt and pepper to taste

title: great canadian potato salad
steps:
1. Combine salad dressing , mustard , celery seed , salt and pepper
2. Add remaining ingredients
3. Mix lightly
4. Refrigerate until ready to serve
5. Best if potato salad is stored in the fridge for at least a couple of hours before serving to let the flavours combine

title: coconut jalapeno red snapper with banana black bean puree
steps:
1. Puree: heat oil in skillet over medium heat
2. Add shallots and garlic
3. Cook 2 minutes
4. Add banana
5. Cook 2 minutes , stirring occasionally
6. Stir in beans , 1 / 4 c broth , juice , cumin , and salt
7. Cover and simmer 5 minutes
8. Place banana mixture and remaining 1 / 4 c broth in a food processor
9. Process until smooth
10. Snapper: combine carrot , milk , chili powder , salt , and jalapeos in a large skillet over medium-high heat
11. Bring to a simmer
12. Add fish to pan
13. Cover and simmer 7 minutes on each side

title: hunter s lullaby
steps:
1. Heat oil in deep frying pan
2. Fry garlic until golden , and then remove from pan
3. Add chicken , rosemary and salt and brown chicken , turning until the chicken is deep brown
4. Add wine vinegar and quickly cover pan until the sizzling stops
5. Add wine and cook on high heat until the liquid is reduced
6. Reduce heat and simmer about 15 minutes
7. Add the sliced mushrooms and artichoke hearts , and cook until the chicken and mushrooms are tender
8. Remove chicken to platter
9. Add about a tbsp of water to the juices in the pan , turn up the heat and with a wooden spoon scrape clean the sides and bottom to get all the bits that are there- the sauce will turn amber
10. Pour over chicken and serve with good italian bread

title: mexican pumpkin in brown sugar
steps:
1. Scrape the seeds out of the pumpkin wedges
2. Pack the wedges together in a heavy-based flameproof casserole
3. Divide the sugar among the pumpkin pieces , packing it into the hollows which contained the seeds
4. Pour the water carefully into the casserole , to cover the bottom and prevent the pumpkin from burning
5. Take care not to dislodge the sugar when pouring in the water
6. Cover and cook over a low heat , checking the water level frequently , until the pumpkin is tender and the sugar has dissolved in the liquid to form a sauce
7. Using a slotted spoon , transfer the pumpkin to a serving dish
8. Pour the sugary liquid from the pan over the pumpkin , and serve at once with natural yoghurt , sweetened with a little brown sugar if you like

title: texas bbq sauce
steps:
1. Mix together all ingredients and simmer for 15 minutes
2. If too thick , add small amount of water
3. Sufficient for two medium fryers , pieced

title: fluffy bisquick waffles
steps:
1. Mix mix , water , milk powder and egg yolk with beaters until well mixed
2. In a separate bowl , beat egg whites with clean beaters until stiff
3. Fold egg whites into batter
4. Pour batter onto a preheated waffle griddle / iron / baker and bake
5. These can be frozen when cooled
6. Best if heated in microwave briefly but can be toasted if you like them crispy

title: fresh blackberry bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine flour and brown sugar , cut in butter with a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal
3. Press 1 1 / 3 cups of mixture in bottom of an ungreased 8x8 inch square pan
4. Combine remaining crumb mixture , sour cream , and next five ingredients
5. Blend well
6. Stir in blackberries
7. Spoon over crust , spreading evenly
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes
9. Let cool
10. Cut into bars
11. Sprinkle with powdered sugar

title: tender beef pot pie w thyme and pepper pastry
steps:
1. Pastry:
2. In food processor , place flour , butter , salt , thyme and pepper
3. Mix for a few seconds
4. Then slowly add ice water , pulsing , til mixture forms into a ball
5. Divide dough in half , wrap each tightly in plastic wrap , and chill in fridge
6. For filling:
7. Place first 9 ingredients into pressure cooker
8. Place on lid
9. Heat over medium heat til regulator starts rocking
10. Adjust heat to a gentle rock , and cook for 15 minutes
11. Let pressure drop on it's own accord
12. Meanwhile , cut up potatoes and carrots and boil til tender , about 10 minutes
13. Drain
14. Make 2 cups brown gravy and pour into large bowl
15. Add potatoes , carrots and rest of vegetables
16. Carefully open pressure cooker when safe , drain meat and onion , and add to gravy / veggie mixture
17. Stir in a 1 / 4 teaspoons each of garlic powder and pepper or to taste
18. Roll out 1 ball of chilled pastry to fit a 9" deepdish pie shell and place into dish
19. Fill with meat mixture
20. Roll out other ball of dough and cover pie , sealing edges well
21. You can do a lattice top , or cut slits to vent in solid top
22. Brush top and edge with milk , sprinkle with pepper and dried thyme
23. Just a light sprinkling of each
24. Bake in 400 oven for 35-40 minutes
25. Let cool 20-30 minutes before slicing

title: beef or pork liver  with bacon and onions  for 2
steps:
1. In a 12-inch skillet , cook the bacon slices
2. This should take about 20 minutes
3. Remove bacon slices from skillet , and set aside , but do not drain off the bacon grease
4. To the bacon grease in skillet , add the sliced onions
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Cook onion slices over medium to medium-high heat , for about 15 minutes
7. Stirring often
8. Remove onions from the skillet , and set aside , but do not drain off any of the bacon grease
9. To the skillet , add a couple tablespoons of the buttered flavored crisco
10. In a shallow bowl , add the flour
11. Sprinkle in some of the salt and pepper
12. Lightly dust liver in the flour , add to the skillet , and cook liver over medium heat
13. Till lightly browned on both sides
14. This doesn't take very long , so watch and turn liver quickly , so it doesn't burn in skillet
15. Remove cooked liver from the skillet , and set aside on a plate
16. Add the sliced onions back to the skillet
17. Place liver ontop of the cooked onions , then top the liver with the bacon slices
18. Cover skillet with a lid
19. Cook the liver , bacon and onions over low heat for exactly 15 minutes
20. Turn off heat
21. Remove the liver , bacon , and onions , and place on a serving platter or plate to serve
22. The onions do cook down quite a bit

title: ranch dressing and seasoning mix
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a blender
2. Blend at high speed until smooth
3. If you want to use this to make salad dressing combine 1 tablespoon mix with 1 cup mayonnaise and 1 cup milk
4. Otherwise use 1 tablespoon in any recipe calling for an envelope of ranch dressing mix

title: baked rib eye steaks with mushrooms
steps:
1. Steak preparation:
2. Take out steaks from freezer , unwrap
3. You might have to dip in cold water to loosen the tray and packing from meat
4. Do not leave the meat in the water , dip only and pull off
5. Spray pam in non stick baking pans
6. Put two steaks in each pan
7. Season each steak
8. Preheat oven 400
9. Drizzle 1 / 2 teaspoons olive oil over each steak
10. Mushroom preparation:
11. Spray pam in non-stick pan and add mushrooms
12. Salt as desired
13. Drizzle 1 teaspoons olive oil over the mushrooms , toss with spatula to mix
14. Place the steak pans and the mushrooms pans in the oven
15. Cook 20 minutes for medium rare , 25 minutes for medium to well
16. Do not turn the steaks
17. Do not cover
18. Turn the mushrooms once during the cooking process
19. I have done this with buffalo steaks i have also cooked elk steak in this way
20. I can have supper on the table in 30 minutes
21. This recipe gives me time to make a salad and potatoes or pasta

title: baked shrimp scampi
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f
2. Peel , devein , and butterfly the shrimp , leaving the tails on
3. Place the shrimp in a mixing bowl and toss gently with the olive oil , wine , 2 teaspoons salt , and 1 teaspoon pepper
4. Allow to sit at room temperature while you make the butter and garlic mixture
5. In a small bowl , mash the softened butter with the garlic , shallots , parsley , rosemary , red pepper flakes , lemon zest , lemon juice , egg yolk , panko , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , and 1 / 4 teaspoon of pepper until combined
6. Starting from the outer edge of a 14-inch oval gratin dish , arrange the shrimp in a single layer cut side down with the tails curling up and towards the center of the dish
7. Pour the remaining marinade over the shrimp
8. Spread the butter mixture evenly over the shrimp
9. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes until hot and bubbly
10. If you like the top browned , place under a broiler for 1 minute
11. Serve with lemon wedges

title: chocolate chocolate chip cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Lightly butter or line muffin pan with papers
3. Set aside
4. In bowl , combine flour , cocoa powder , baking powder , baking soda and salt
5. In separate bowl , beat egg
6. Mix in milk , brown sugar , butter , corn syrup , lemon juice and vanilla
7. Pour wet ingredients over dry
8. Mix until smooth
9. Stir in chocolate chips
10. Spoon into prepared muffin pan
11. Bake for 15 to 20 min or until cake tester inserted in centre comes out clean
12. Transfer to rack to cool
13. Add sprinkles or candies if you like

title: delicious green beans
steps:
1. Cook bacon , remove to drain on paper towel lined plate
2. Add green beans and onions to hot bacon grease
3. Let the beans cook until they start to become tender
4. Add mushroom slices , salt , pepper , thyme , oregano , sugar , and balsamic to taste
5. Cook until mushrooms become tender
6. It's ok if the beans are shriveled and brown in spots
7. Enjoy !

title: summer asparagus
steps:
1. In a small bowl , whisk balsamic and red wine vinegars , dijon mustard , salt and pepper
2. Slowly whisk in oil in a thin stream
3. Stir in chervil and shallots
4. Cover and set aside until ready to use
5. Steam asparagus until tender , about 6 minutes
6. Arrange asparagus and tomatoes on a large platter
7. Sprinkle with feta cheese
8. Drizzle with half of the dressing
9. Serve the remaining dressing on the side

title: custard drink
steps:
1. In a mug , combine custard powder and sugar
2. Add a few tablespoons of the milk until it becomes a paste
3. Boil water , and add , topping off with milk to taste
4. Let it stand for a few minutes , for thickness- you can also serve with a dollop of ice-cream on the top !

title: basic buttermilk cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 with rack in the middle of the oven
2. Butter cake pans and line the bottoms with wax paper or parchment paper cut to fit
3. Butter the paper
4. If making cupcakes , use paper liners or butter the cupcake pan
5. Beat the butter and sugar at medium speed with electric mixer until light and fluffy in a large mixing bowl
6. Beat in eggs one at a time
7. Scrape bowl and beaters to incorporate
8. Sift the flour with the baking powder and baking soda
9. Add one quarter of the dry mixture to the butter-egg mixture and then add the vanilla and a third of the buttermilk
10. Repeat beginning and ending with the flour mixture and scraping well after each addition
11. Pour the batter into the prepared pans and spread to the edges with a spatula
12. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into center comes out clean
13. Cool in pans of a rack for 5 minutes
14. Turn pans onto the rack , remove parchment paper or was paper and cool completely before frosting

title: niku jaga  japanese beef stew in the crock pot
steps:
1. Put all into crock pot and cook on low 10-12 hours or on high 4-6 hours
2. Stir before serving

title: baby spinach cobb salad
steps:
1. In a medium skillet , cook chicken in olive oil until brown
2. Remove from skillet and cut into 1 / 2-inch strips
3. Add bacon cubes to skillet and cook over medium heat for 2 minutes or until crisp
4. Reduce heat to low and add vinaigrette dressing to bacon , cook , stirring for 30 seconds
5. Place baby spinach in a large bowl
6. Pour dressing over the baby spinach and toss well
7. Add the chicken strips and cooked egg
8. Serve immediately

title: valentine drink
steps:
1. Shake banana liqueur , vodka , and cranberry juice with ice cubes
2. Strain into a red wine glass

title: disney s canadian cheddar soup
steps:
1. In large deep pot , cook bacon over medium heat for 5 minutes , stirring , until lightly browned
2. Add onion , celery and butter
3. Saute until onion has softened , about 5 minutes
4. Add flour and cook , stirring constantly , for about 4 minutes over medium heat
5. Whisk in chicken broth and bring to a boil for 1 minute
6. Reduce heat to a simmer
7. Cook 15 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. Add milk
9. Continue to simmer 15 minutes
10. Do not bring to a boil
11. Remove from heat
12. Stir in cheese , hot pepper sauce , worcestershire sauce , salt and pepper until cheese is melted and the soup is smooth
13. Stir in warm beer
14. If soup is too thick , add some warm milk
15. Serve soup hot , garnished with scallions

title: brown sugar glazed pork loin chops
steps:
1. Combine brown sugar , garlic , and montreal steak seasoning
2. Divide mixture amongst the pork loin chops and press on both sides of each chop to season
3. Place 1 tbsp of the butter in a saute' pan and melt on medium heat
4. After butter is melted , put chops in pan and brown slowly on both sides
5. Remove meat from heat
6. Add remaining 1 tbsp of butter to pan and let melt
7. Mix with remaining garlic and brown sugar bits left from browning meat
8. Add wine
9. Bring to a boil and let simmer down to make a nice glaze
10. You can add meat back and keep spooning liquid mixture over meat or leave meat out of the pan and pour finished glaze over to serve
11. This can easily be doubled
12. I use 2 tbsp of butter to brown the chops , but only 1 tbsp of butter to make sauce

title: beer steamed sausages
steps:
1. Prick each sausage in several places with
2. Pour beer into bottom of pan fitted with steaming rack or basket , making sure beer doesn't cover rack , and heat beer to boiling
3. Adjust heat to maintain gentle boil and place sausages on rack
4. Steam covered until sausages are firm to the touch and just cooked through , 6-8 minutes
5. Remove from heat and transfer to paper towels
6. About 10 minutes before serving , heat butter and oil in large heavy skillet
7. Pat sausages dry and place in skillet
8. Saute , turning with tongs , until well browned on all sides , about 10 minutes
9. Cut sausages diagonally into 3 or 4 pieces each
10. Serve hot with cornichons , onions , and mustard

title: swedish kroppkakor
steps:
1. Mash the potatoes
2. Stir in egg and flour making a smooth dough
3. Fry onion and bacon in some butter
4. Add allspice or white pepper to taste , set aside
5. Shape the dough into a log with floured hands cut into 12 pieces
6. Make a little pocket and fill with about 1 tablespoon of filling
7. Close and shape into a ball
8. Put about 4-5 at a time in simmering salted water , big pot , and let simmer for 5 minutes
9. Kakorna will sink and when they have floated to the top they are ready
10. Serve with a thin bchamel sauce or melted butter
11. A must is lingonsylt

title: blushing peach jam
steps:
1. To peeled , pitted , and crushed peaches add 2 t
2. Lemon juice
3. Let stand while preparing raspberries
4. Crush raspberries and add remaining 2 t
5. Lemon juice
6. Combine peaches and raspberries with sugar in a heavy kettle
7. Mix well and bring to a boil
8. Boil hard for 1 minute
9. Remove from heat and add pectin
10. Stir well and skim off foam
11. Add the almond extract and stir well again
12. Pour into clean , hot , sterile jars
13. Process in boiling water bath for 10 minutes at altitudes up to 1000 feet sea level

title: chicken soup with fennel and orzo
steps:
1. In a soup kettle , saute fennel bulb and onion in oil until fennel is softened
2. Add the next seven ingredients
3. Bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat
5. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes
6. Stir in chicken , orzo and wine
7. Cover and cook for 20 minutes or until orzo is tender
8. Stir in fennel fronds

title: can can potato corn chowder
steps:
1. Chop vegetables and fry in butter& olive oil until crisp tender
2. Add chicken broth and cook covered to desired tenderness
3. Add creamed corn& evaporated milk
4. Add seasonings

title: sun dried tomato and provolone bread
steps:
1. Drain the tomatoes , reserving 2 tsp of the oil
2. Chop the tomatoes and set aside
3. Cook the garlic in a small amount of boiling water for 15 minutes
4. Drain , peel and mash the garlic
5. Set aside
6. Combine the flour , and the next 3 ingredients stir well
7. Add the tomatoes , cheese and next 4 ingredients stir well
8. Combine the reserved oil , shorting and sugar then beat with a wire wisk until smooth
9. Add the garlic mixture and pine nuts to the flour mixture , stirring just until blended
10. Spread the batter into a greased 8 1 / 2x4 1 / 2 inch loaf pan
11. Smooth out the top
12. Bake 350f for 45 to 50 minutes or until golden
13. Cool in pan on wire rack for 5 minutes
14. Remove and cool completely on wire rack

title: skillet tarragon country potatoes
steps:
1. In a large skillet over medium heat , melt butter
2. Add the remaining ingredients to the skillet
3. Stir until potatoes are evenly coated with spice mixture and onion slices are evenly distributed
4. Cook covered on medium heat for 15 minutes , tossing and turning the potatoes every few minutes
5. Potatoes will be done when slightly browned and fork-tender
6. Enjoy !

title: qwik coffee cake
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar till fluffy
2. Add egg , beat until smooth
3. Add , alternately , milk and flour , beat after each addition till smooth
4. Pour into greased and floured cake pan
5. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon
6. Do not preheat oven
7. Place pan in cold oven , and bake at 350 for 45-50 minute

title: pumpkin pecan cheesecake
steps:
1. For topping: place sugar in small bowl
2. Add butter and cut in until mixture resembles coarse meal
3. Stir in pecans and set aside
4. For cheesecake: blend crumbs , cup sugarand butter in bowl
5. Press into bottom and up sides of 9 inch diameter springform pan
6. Chill
7. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
8. Beat cream cheese until smooth
9. Mix in white and brown sugars
10. Add eggs , one at a time , and beat until fluffy
11. Blend in pumpkin , cream and spices
12. Pour into crust
13. Bake until centre no longer moves when pan is shaken , about 1 hours
14. Sprinkle topping over cheesecake
15. Bake 15 minutes longer
16. Cool
17. Cover and refrigerate overnight

title: slow roasted tomato sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees
2. Whisk together the olive oil , vinegar , garlic , and basil
3. Pour half of this mixture onto a cookie sheet and spread it around
4. Place tomatoes cut-side down on cookie sheet on top of the oil blend
5. Drizzle tomatoes with remaining oil , then sprinkle with the maple sugar and salt
6. Bake slowly in oven at 300 degrees for 3 hours
7. Blend or process when done
8. Serve hot over pasta , rice , or white beans

title: ukrainian lokshyna  egg noodles
steps:
1. Beat the egg slightly and combine with the remaining ingredients to make a stiff dough
2. Knead on a lightly floured board until the dough is smooth
3. Cover and let it stand for 30 minutes
4. Roll to almost paper-thinness and allow it to dry partially
5. Turn the dough over in order to dry the other side slightly
6. It must neither be sticky nor dry and brittle
7. Fold into a roll or cut into 3 inch strips
8. Stack the strips on top of each other
9. Cut the roll or the strips crosswise into fine shreds
10. Separate the shreds by tossing them lightly with the fingers
11. Spread them out to dry
12. The noodles may be used at once or dried thoroughly , and then stored in a covered container for future use
13. When ready to use , drop the noodles into a large quantity of boiling salted water , stir , and cook for about 8 minutes
14. The cooking period will depend on the size of the noodles
15. Strain over a colander or sieve , and then rinse with cold water to prevent sticking
16. Use as desired
17. Broad or square lokshna: follow the preceding recipe for lokshyna
18. Cut the dough into broad shreds or tiny squares
19. These may be used in various lokshyna dishes
20. Lokshyna with cottage cheese: here is a nutritious dish which is very simple to make
21. Prepare a desired amount of lokshyna
22. Cook as directed
23. Drain , but do not rinse the lokshyna with cold water
24. Add some melted butter or bacon fat and mix lightly
25. Mix in some fresh cottage cheese and season to taste with salt
26. Top with chopped crisp bacon or salt pork
27. Keep it hot until ready to serve
28. Lokshyna with eggs: follow the preceding recipe , but instead of the cheese use lightly beaten eggs
29. To 1 cup of cooked lokshyna allow about 1 tablespoon of butter and 1 egg
30. Melt the butter in a frying pan and add the cooked lokshyna mixed with the eggs and seasoned with salt
31. Cook and stir as for scrambled eggs
32. Serve immediately

title: no knead cheddar rolls
steps:
1. Place the grated cheese in a small bowl and cover to prevent drying then set aside
2. Combine 1 1 / 2 cups unsifted flour , yeast , sugar , and salt in a large mixer bowl , blending thoroughly
3. Measure 3 / 4 c of milk , water , and butter into a saucepan and heat until the liquids are warm , 115 to 120 degrees f
4. Gradually add the liquids to the dry ingredients in the mixer bowl , beating for 2 minutes at medium speed of the electric mixer , scraping the bowl occasionally
5. Add and beat in 1 cup of unsifted flour at high speed
6. Beat for 2 minutes , scraping the bowl occasionally
7. Mix in enough additional flour to make a soft dough
8. Put the dough into a greased deep bowl
9. Cover with waxed paper and a clean towel and let stand in a warm place until the dough has doubled , 45 to 60 minutes
10. Generously grease several baking sheets
11. Melt the butter and set aside
12. Punch the dough down wit a fist and turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface
13. Divide the dough into two equal portions
14. Set one portion aside
15. Roll the dough into a rectangle 16 x 8-inches
16. Brush with about one-half of the melted butter
17. Sprinkle with about one half of the grated cheddar cheese
18. Cut crosswise into 8 equal portions
19. Cut into halves lengthwise
20. Fold each strip into thirds , lapping each side portion over the center third
21. Place the rolls on a baking sheet
22. Repeat for the other half of the dough
23. Beat the egg yolk with the tbls of milk , slightly
24. Brush the tops of the rolls with the egg yolk mixture
25. Let rise until doubled , about 30 minutes
26. Bake at 425 degrees f
27. For about 8 minutes or until rolls are golden brown
28. Serve rolls hot

title: grilled banana bread ham steak sandwiches
steps:
1. In frying pan , melt butter
2. Fry ham steak for a few minutes on each side til lightly browned
3. Remove from pan and drizzle each side with a little maple syrup to lightly coat
4. Cut into 4 equal portions
5. Place pieces on 4 slices banana bread
6. Top with slices of bananas
7. If bananas start to brown , just sprinkle them with a little lemon juice as needed
8. Top each with another slice of banana bread
9. Butter tops with very soft butter and place buttered side down back into heated frying pan
10. Butter top sides
11. Cook over medium-low heat
12. When golden on bottoms , carefully flip over and lightly brown other side

title: bacon refried beans
steps:
1. In a heavy saucepan , cook the chopped bacon until almost crisp
2. Remove to a plate
3. To the same saucepan add in the onion , garlic , 1 teaspoon sugar and jalapeno peppers
4. Cook stirring until transparent
5. Reduce the heat to low and continue to cook until the onions have caramalized and are a deep brown
6. Add the cooked bacon back to the saucepan along with the undrained black beans
7. Roughly mash using a potato masher
8. Add in 1 cup broth and bring to a simmer stirring
9. Simmer uncovered over low heat for 1 hour stirring occasionally adding in more broth if needed to achieve desired consistancy
10. Season with the seasoned salt and black pepper to taste

title: almond celery bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f & grease a 2-quart baking dish
2. Place celery in the prepared baking dish & sprinkle with cheese , paprika & pepper
3. Top that with the soup & sprinkle everything with the bread crumbs
4. Cover & bake for 45 minutes , then uncover , sprinkle with the almonds & bake for another 10 to 15 minutes or until golden brown

title: harvest tomato crumble
steps:
1. Core and cut tomatoes in half lengthwise
2. Arrange , cut sides up and without touching , on large foil lined rimmed baking sheet
3. Brush with oil , sprinkle with thyme , rosemary , salt and pepper
4. Roast in 350f degree oven until tops are shriveled and bottoms are browned , about 2 hours
5. Arrange tomatoes , overlapping , in 8 inch square glass baking dish
6. In a bowl , stir together , bread crumbs , parmesan cheese and flour
7. Drizzle with butter and toss until crumbly
8. Sprinkle over tomatoes
9. Bake in 400f oven until golden and bubbly , about 25 minutes

title: bunnylovingcook s  daddy style  ramen noodles
steps:
1. Boil or microwave the noodles
2. Strain them
3. Add the flavor packet
4. Enjoy !

title: hot dog onion sauce
steps:
1. In a medium skillet , heat oil over medium heat
2. Add onion slices
3. Saute about 7-10 minutes until golden& limp
4. Mix in the ketchup
5. Add the cinnamon , chili powder , garlic powder , hot pepper sauce& salt
6. Pour in water
7. Stir
8. Bring to a boil
9. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered about 10 minutes

title: creamed chipped beef  sos
steps:
1. Heat large skillet over medium heat
2. Add butter and melt till foamy
3. Remove pan from heat and whisk in flour and continue stirring until no lumps are left
4. Return to heat and continue stirring about 5 minutes to remove raw flour taste
5. Slowly pour milk in while whisking
6. About a quart will do depending on how thick you like it
7. Continue stirring over heat until desired thickness
8. Add dried beef and heat through , add pepper and serve hot over toast

title: thai inspired turkey burgers  low fat
steps:
1. Put the lemongrass , garlic , ginger , green onions , cilantro , chili flakes and lime zest into a food processor or chopper along with the water and blitz them until they are finely chopped and combined
2. Add the mixture to the turkey and also put in the egg white
3. Mix the turkey and the other ingredients together by hand until they are well combined
4. Put into the fridge to chill for about 30 minutes for them to firm up a bit
5. Take out of the fridge and shape into four equal sized burger patties
6. Then either fry them off in a pan as you would normally do or do as i do and brush them very lightly with a bit of extra virgin olive oil and cook them on a foreman type grill
7. It takes about 8 minutes or so for them to be fully cooked
8. Serve

title: quick gnocchi by sandy metzler
steps:
1. Place potato flakes in a medium-size bowl
2. Pour in boiling water
3. Stir until blended
4. Let cool
5. Beat egg and stir in salt and pepper
6. Blend in enough flour to make fairly stiff dough
7. Turn dough out on a well floured board
8. Knead lightly
9. Divide dough in half
10. Shape each half into a long thin roll , the thickness of a breadstick
11. With a knife dipped in flour , cut into bite size pieces
12. For a more authentic shape , roll against a fork tine and pinch a bit
13. Place a few gnocchi in boiling water
14. As the gnocchi rise to the top of the pot , remove them with a slotted spoon
15. Repeat until all are cooked
16. Top with tomato sauce
17. These can be made ahead and frozen

title: mini blueberry bundt cakes
steps:
1. In a small mixing bowl , cream butter and sugar
2. Beat in the egg , milk and vanilla
3. Combine the flour , baking powder and salt
4. Stir into creamed mixture
5. Fold in blueberries
6. Pour into three 4 inch fluted tube pans coated with nonstick cooking spray
7. Bake at 350 for 25 to 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
8. Cool for 10 minutes before removing from pans to wire racks to cool completely
9. For icing , in a small bowl , combine the confectioners' sugar , milk and lemon juice
10. Drizzle over cakes
11. Garnish with additional blueberries if desired

title: savory meatloaf
steps:
1. Soak bread crumbs in 1 1 / 4 cups milk for 5 minutes
2. Add remaining ingredients
3. Place in 9x5 loaf dish
4. Cover with bbq sauce & add 2 slices of bacon
5. To top of meatloaf
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour or until done

title: 1 2 3 hot chocolate
steps:
1. Pour milk into a medium saucepan
2. Add dry pudding mix
3. Beat with wire whisk for 1 minute
4. Bring to a simmer on medium heat , stirring frequently with wire whisk
5. Pour evenly into 6 mugs , top with whipped topping

title: dates and olives wrapped in bacon
steps:
1. Slice each olive length wise
2. Stuff one date into each olive
3. Wrap each pairing with 1 / 2 slice bacon and hold in place with toothpick
4. Bake on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper in 350 degree oven until bacon is cooked to your liking
5. Serve and bask in the praise !

title: whipped potatoes paprika
steps:
1. Boil peeled , cubed potatoes in salted water until tender
2. Drain water from potatoes
3. Mash potatoes
4. Add cream cheese and butter
5. Stir to mix
6. Add milk to make desired consistency
7. Add salt and pepper to taste
8. Using hand mixer on low / medium setting , whip potato mixture until fluffy
9. Put whipped potatoes in serving bowl and sprinkle with paprika to taste
10. Serve hot

title: warm garlicky blue cheese sauce
steps:
1. Sauce -- in a small saucepan on medium low heat , add the cream , cheese , garlic and shallot , and let simmer for about 7-10 minutes until it slightly reduces
2. Finishing -- once it has reduced slightly and the sauce thickens on it's own , add a pinch of hot sauce , pepper , and the parsley
3. I don't add any salt as the cheese is salty enough
4. Stir well to combine
5. Serve -- done ! i love to drizzle over steak , roasts , pork chops and tenderloins , veggies , anything you want
6. Just enjoy !

title: cauliflower fritters
steps:
1. In the microwave , cook the cauliflower in a covered dish with two tablespoon of water until soft
2. Drain the cauliflower and mash with the back of a fork or potato masher
3. Add the egg , salt and pepper , and enough flour until you can form patties
4. About 1 / 4 cup
5. Add enough oil to coat the bottom of a skillet
6. Over medium high heat , brown the caulflower patties
7. Eat !

title: cream cheese garlic dip
steps:
1. Open packages of cream cheese and place in large mixing bowl
2. Let soften at room temperature for several hours
3. Crush garlic and add to blocks of softened cream cheese
4. With electric mixer , slowly add milk or half& half thinning mixture and mixing all ingredients together until a desired dipping consistency is reached
5. Stir in chives , if desired
6. Refrigerate covered
7. Let dip sit out about 5 minutes before serving
8. Not to worry , if you get it a little too thin , just add another package of cream cheese

title: bless rock buns
steps:
1. Use rubbing in method
2. Bake 20 minutes

title: 911 salmon
steps:
1. In ziploc bag combine all ingredients
2. Place in fridge for one hour
3. Remove fish from bag and discard marinade
4. Place salmon skin side down on preheated barbeque grill at medium high heat
5. Cook for 10 to 12 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork

title: no fault pumpkin pie
steps:
1. Mix in order given
2. Pour into whole wheat pie shell and bake 10 minutes at 450 , then 40 minutes at 350 , or till set
3. Variation: for a delicious pmpkin pudding , omit pie shell
4. Bake filling in buttered baking dish and serve with vanilla ice cream or heavy cream

title: ground beef slop
steps:
1. Brown hamburger
2. Drain
3. Cook corn
4. Drain
5. Cook macaroni and cheese according to package
6. After making up macaroni and cheese mix in hamburger and corn
7. Mix well
8. Season with salt and pepper
9. Serve with bread if desired

title: dorito rotel chicken casserole
steps:
1. Saute onions in butter
2. Add soups & tomatoes
3. Cube velveeta , add & simmer until it melts
4. Add chicken
5. Crumble doritos in bottom of casserole
6. Add chicken mixture and top with remaining doritos
7. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes

title: heath bits peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 degrees
2. Beat shortening , peanut butter , brown sugar , milk and vanilla in large bowl until well blended
3. Add egg
4. Beat just until blended
5. Combine flour , baking soda and salt
6. Graduallt beat into peanut butter mixture
7. Stir in 1 cup toffee bits
8. Reserve remainder for topping
9. Drop by heaping teaspoons about 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet
10. Top each with reserved toffee bits
11. Bake 7 to 8 minutes or until set
12. Do not overbake
13. Cool 2 minutes
14. Remove to wire rack
15. Cool completely

title: quick   simple curry wurst  currywurst  sauce for brats
steps:
1. Slice grilled brats onto a plate
2. Pour ketchup over the top of the brats
3. Sprinkle with the curry powder
4. Enjoy !

title: wicker s sloshing sauce
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and cook for about ten minutes to dissolve spices
2. Can be used as a marinade for beef briskets or shoulder clods or it can be used on the table as a"sloshing sauce" for chopped or pulled pork

title: herbed rissoles with mushroom sauce
steps:
1. Combine ground beef thru egg in medium bowl , mix well with spoon
2. Divide and roll mixture into 8 equal balls , flatten slightly into rissole shapes
3. Place flour in bowl , toss rissoles in flour , shake off excess flour
4. Heat butter and oil in frying pan over medium heat , add rissoles , cook for about 10 min on each side
5. Drain on absorbent paper
6. Mushroom sauce
7. Measure approx 4 tbsp of pan drippings into small saucepan , stir in flour , stir constantly for 1 min until flour browns slightly
8. Gradually stir in combined wine and stock , stir constantly until sauce boils and thickens
9. Add green onions and mushrooms to sauce , simmer for 2 minutes
10. Place rissoles on serving plates , pour sauce over rissoles and serve with vegetables of your choice

title: mom s homemade white bread rolls  or loaves
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast and 2 tablespoons sugar in 1 / 4 cup warm water , set aside
2. Microwave 2 cups water , shortening and salt , until the shortening melts
3. Stir this mixture until it completely dissolves
4. Start adding flour about 2 cups to start to this mixture , just a little at a time so that it stays smooth and doesn't get lumpy
5. Then add yeast mixture , mix well
6. Continue adding flour and then turn out on floured surface and knead in remaining flour , until no longer tacky
7. Grease a large bowl or pan with vegetable oil
8. Put the bread in this bowl cover and let it rise
9. If you use a fast acting yeast it should take about 45 minutes
10. Turn out on the counter and fold in sides , put back in bowl and let rise again
11. After the second rising it is time to turn it out and make the rolls or bread and place it in a pan
12. Make sure the pan is well oiled with vegetable oil
13. Place them in the pan and let rise one last time and then bake them at 375f oven until done , about 20 minutes or so

title: jerry s meatloaf
steps:
1. Crumble ground chuck into a large bowl
2. Sprinkle onion soup mix over meat
3. Mix together with wooden spoon
4. Add remaining meatloaf ingredients and mix well
5. Using your hands , while messy , works the best !
6. Add a little water if the mixture seems too dry
7. This depends on the moisture content of the ground chuck & your own personal preference
8. If possible , refrigerate for at least an hour , or overnight , before baking , to allow the flavors to blend
9. Shape meat into a wide , flat loaf , and place in a 9 x 13 pan sprayed with cooking spray
10. Bake at 350 for 1 / 2 hour
11. Meanwhile , combine sauce ingredients and mix well
12. Spread a thin layer of the sauce over the meatloaf after baking 1 / 2 hour
13. Return meatloaf to oven for about 1 / 2 hour , or until done
14. The loaf will be more firm when done
15. If in doubt , cut in half and check to make sure it isn't pink in the center
16. Serve hot , topped with more of the ketchup sauce , if desired

title: baked  ziti with hot italian sausage   fresh mozzarella
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cook ziti until it is al dente
3. Rinse in cold water , drain and pour into a 7"x11" glass baking dish
4. Meanwhile , begin cooking sausage
5. Puree san marzano tomatoes , crushed red pepper flakes and salt in a blender until smooth
6. When sausage is done , remove from pan and add 1 / 2 cup wine to reserved drippings from sausage and bring to a simmer scraping any bits from the bottom of the pan and stirring with wine
7. While wine is simmering , slice sausage at a slight diagonal about 1 / 2" thick
8. Add pureed sauce and sliced sausage to wine and stir
9. Bring to a boil and simmer gently for 10 minutes
10. Meanwhile thinly slice and chop the fresh mozarella balls
11. When sauce is done simmering , pour everything over pasta
12. Sprinkle 1 cup of the fresh mozzarella throughout and sprinkle the rest on top
13. Top with a few shakes of crushed red pepper
14. Bake for approximately 45 minutes or until you see it getting a little bubbly
15. You can even cook it longer it you want it to get a little crisp on top , not too crisp as it will get dry
16. Serve with a bottle of wine and some nice italian music

title: greek pecan baklava
steps:
1. In a saucepan combine 2 cups sugar , 1 cup water , liquid honey , brandy , lemon juice and cinnamon stick
2. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly , boil for about 1 minute then remove from heat
3. Cool syrup completely
4. In another bowl toss the chopped pecans with 1 cup sugar , cinnamon and cloves
5. Brush 2 baking pans with melted butter
6. Place 8 phyllo sheets in 1 pan , brushing each sheet with melted butter , then top with 2 cups pecan mixture
7. Place 3 phyllo sheets over the pecan mixture , brushing each sheet with melted butter , then top with 2 cups of pecan mixture
8. Repeat with 3 more phyllo sheets and then 2 cups pecan mixture
9. Top with 6 phyllo sheets , brushing all but the top sheet with melted butter
10. Repeat the procedure with remaining phyllo sheets and the pecan mixture for the second pan
11. Using a sharp knife cut layers diagonally into 3 / 4-inch diamonds
12. Gently brush with remaining butter
13. Insert a clove in the center of each diamond
14. Bake in a 300f oven for 1 hour
15. Remove from the oven and pour the prepared reserved syrup evenly over the baked baklava
16. Cool completely in the pans on wire racks
17. When cooled cut again diagonally
18. Remove from pans and store in airtight containers at room temperature

title: cannoli cream dip with strawberries
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Spread pistachios on a baking sheet
3. Bake for 7 minutes or until crisp
4. Rub pistachios in a towel to remove skins
5. Chop nuts coarsely in a food processor
6. Set aside
7. Whisk together ricotta , sugar , and orange zest until smooth
8. Fold in nuts and chocolate chips
9. Serve with strawberries

title: swill
steps:
1. In a large dutch oven brown the meat
2. Add onions and saute until translucent
3. Recklessly toss in all the rest of the ingredients
4. Add any others that appeal to you
5. This recipe is subject to interpretation
6. Simmer at least three hours , the longer the better
7. It's even better reheated the next day or two

title: beef stroganov  stroganoff
steps:
1. Melt 2-4 tablespoons of butter in a large pan
2. Then add the onions , mushrooms and garlic , and saute for a few minutes
3. Then cover pan , lower heat and simmer until tender
4. Remove this mixture from the pan , including all juices , and set aside
5. Melt the remaining butter in the same pan
6. Then add the beef strips , and saute until browned
7. This takes 5-10 minutes
8. Add the water , stock cubes , salt and pepper , and bring to a boil
9. Once this boils , cover the pan again , lower heat and simmer 10-15 minutes
10. Remove lid and add onion-mushroom mixture
11. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat and stir in sour cream and mustard
12. Heat until everything is warmed through , but do not boil
13. Garnish with parsley

title: lentil walnut burgers
steps:
1. Combine walnuts , breadcrumbs , garlic , cumin , corander , pepper flakes , 1 1 / 2 teaspoons salt , and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper in a food processor
2. Process until finely ground
3. Add the lentils and 1 tablespoon oil
4. Pluse until coarsely chopped
5. Some of the lentils should remain whole
6. In a large bowl , whisk egg
7. Add lentil mixture and stir well
8. Divide the lentil mixture into 4 equal size parts , and roll into balls
9. Flatten them into 3 / 4 inch patties
10. Heat remaining 3 tablespoons oil in a large skillet
11. Add burgers and cook over medium low heat until crisp and browned , turning gently after 8 to 10 minutes
12. Cook another 8-10 minutes
13. Serve on buns as a sandwich , adding your favorite garnishes: tomatoes , pickles , lettuce , etc
14. Or , serve as a main dish with your favorite sauce

title: veggies and egg in a bread roll
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c
2. Line a baking tray with baking paper
3. Cut tops from rolls
4. Scoop out centres , leaving a shell
5. Combine veggies and mayonnaise and spoon into rolls and shape a hollow
6. Carefully break an egg into each roll
7. Season with black pepper and sprinkle with chives , then cheese
8. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the eggs are set
9. Sprinkle with extra chives and serve

title: garlic tarragon chicken
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven 450 degrees f
2. Combine oil , garlic and tarragon in small bowl
3. Coat chicken in oil mixture
4. Arrange chicken on baking sheet , season with salt and pepper
5. Bake 10 minutes on 450
6. Reduce heat to 375 and bake additional 30 min

title: peanut butter porridge
steps:
1. Cook oats as insturcted on packet with milk
2. Serve with peanut butter
3. Uterly divine

title: apricot mist punch
steps:
1. Combine apricot nector , pineapple juice , and concentrate in punch bowl
2. Stir in ginger ale
3. Add ice ring with lime slices etc

title: terrific taco soup   ww
steps:
1. Chop onion , combine with ground beef
2. Brown and drain the ground beef
3. Dump all of the cans , undrained into a 3 quart pan along with the taco and dressing packets and ground beef and onion
4. Stir to combine and heat on medium heat until a low boil has been achieved
5. At this point , it is ready to serve
6. Additionally , you may let the mixture simmer until reduced and you may enjoy this dish as more of a chili instead of a soup
7. For a real dump and go , this is a real hit with our family
8. Enjoy !

title: koulourakia kanelas  greek cinnamon biscuits
steps:
1. Beat the eggs the sugar until light and fluffy , about 5-6 minutes
2. Sift flour and spices into a large bowl
3. Make a well in the centre and add butter and rub into flour with your hands
4. Add the milk , into which you've already dissolved the baking ammonia , and the egg mixture
5. Knead well until a soft and pliable dough forms
6. Shape the koulourakia as you wish
7. It is traditional to make 's' shapes , snails and braids here
8. Place on a greased cookie sheet , or parchment or silpat and brush with egg-white wash
9. Bake in a preheated 350f oven for 20-25 minutes
10. Store in an air-tight container

title: dixon gang s dirty rice
steps:
1. Cook rice in pan according to directions , adding only the water and swanson veggie broth packet
2. Meanwhile , in large skillet brown the meat , along with the finely chopped onion , green pepper , and garlic
3. Once cooked through , add the seasonings and pintos
4. Stir to mix and remove from heat
5. Place the cooked rice in a 13x9 casserole dish sprayed with pam
6. Pour the tomato sauce on top of the rice
7. Refill the tomato sauce can with water
8. Pour this on top of the rice as well
9. Stir well
10. Add the meat mixture to the rice in the casserole dish
11. Mix to combine
12. Taste to see if you'd like more chili powder , pepper , etc
13. Cover with foil & bake at 350 for 20-30 minutes , until rice is completely cooked and casserole is heated through
14. Serve with shredded cheese and / or sour cream if desired

title: hot tamale pie
steps:
1. Brown ground beef , onion and green pepper
2. Drain grease
3. Add salt , pepper , chili powder , tomatoes and kidney beans to meat mixture
4. Let simmer while preparing the corn muffin mix
5. Mix muffin mix per package instructions omitting any egg and using the 1 cup of milk
6. Pour meat mixture into casserole , top with muffin mix
7. Bake in 400 degree oven 20-25 minutes , or until muffin mix is cooked through
8. Sprinkle cheese on top and bake for another 5 minutes until cheese is melted

title: yogurt tomato sauce for gyros
steps:
1. Stir ingredients in medium bowl to blend , season sauce with salt and pepper to taste
2. Cover and chill until ready to use

title: tofu and green peas
steps:
1. Heat 2 teaspoon vegetable oil in pan
2. Add onion and saute until onion is translucent
3. Add garlic , ginger , jalapeno , turmeric and curry powder , cook for 2 minutes , then add coconut milk , spices , cilantro , and salt
4. Lower heat and simmer
5. Cut drained , pressed tofu into 1 / 2 inch cubes
6. Add gently to sauce and continue simmering until tofu is heated through
7. Add peas and cook until peas are heated through
8. Served over rice with yogurt and chutney

title: 2 ingredient pumpkin muffins
steps:
1. Simply mix the pumpkin and the spice cake mix together with electric mixer until well combined
2. Spoon into paper lined small muffin / cupcake tins , 2 / 3 full
3. Bake at 350 18-22 minutes or until a knife comes out clean

title: govenors mansion summer peach punch
steps:
1. To make simple syrupbring 2 cups water and 1 cup water to a boil
2. Boil , stirring occasionally until sugar is dissolved
3. Cool to room temperature
4. To make punch: bring 4 cups water to a boil in a saucepan
5. Add tea bags and mint leaves
6. Boil 1 minute
7. Remove from heat
8. Cover and steep 10 minutes
9. Remove and discard tea bags and mint
10. Pour into a 1 gallon container
11. Add peach nectar , lemonade concentrate , and simple syrup
12. Stir to combine
13. Cover and chill 8 hours or overnight
14. Pour chilled tea mixture into a punch bowl
15. Stir in ginger ale and club soda just before serving
16. Garnish with fresh mint sprigs

title: ultimate white chili
steps:
1. Cook chicken for about 30-45 minutes drain
2. Heat broth , add onion and garlic , low boil for about 10 minutes
3. Add spices and simmer another 10 minutes
4. Add beans and simmer for another 45 minutes
5. Add chicken and 1 cup cheese and simmer for another 10 minutes
6. Serve with cheese , sour creme , salsa , and fritos or mexican corn bread

title: purple cauliflower soup with walnut oil
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , melt butter over medium-low heat , add leeks and cook until soft , about 5 minutes
2. Add cauliflower , potatoes , milk and salt and bring to a simmer
3. Cover and simmer on low heat until vegetables are soft , about 25 minutes
4. Do not boil
5. Remove the vegetables from the heat , let cool slightly and pure them in a blender , with an immersion blender or in a food mill
6. If serving warm , reheat gently and serve with a drizzle of walnut oil
7. If serving cold , chill in the refrigerator before serving

title: easy candied sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Layer the sweet potato slices in a buttered microwave and oven proof casserole dish with a lid
2. Add the zest , juice , sugar , butter and salt , stir and cover and microwave for about 5 or 6 minutes or until the potatoes test done
3. Just before serving top with marshmallows and bake in a 400 oven until the marshmallows are the color you like

title: bethal s sugar cookies aka cut out cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425 degrees
2. Add 1 tsp of vinegar to the milk
3. Sift together the flour , baking powder & baking soda
4. Cream together brown sugar , sugar , crisco & egg
5. Now add the lemon extract and the vanilla to the milk
6. Add the flour and the milk to the creamed ingredients
7. Mix the ingredients until a firm ball forms
8. Chill cookie dough at least one hour
9. Roll out chilled dough and cut into the desired shapes with your favorite cookie cutters
10. Bake at 425 degrees for 10-15 minutes
11. Let cool
12. Ice and decorate
13. The amount of cookies varies pending the size cookie cutter you choose to use

title: lettuce salad with bacon dressing
steps:
1. Cook bacon until crisp and brown
2. Measure bacon fat
3. Leave about 1 1 / 4 tablespoons bacon fat in skillet with the bacon
4. Add vinegar , sugar , salt and pepper
5. Bring to a boil
6. Pour hot dressing over lettuce in a bowl and toss

title: favorite vanilla buttercream frosting
steps:
1. Beat the butter , milk , vanilla and salt in a medium bowl
2. Slowly add the confectioners' sugar
3. Mix until thick and creamy
4. Beat on high until fluffy and of good spreading consistency
5. Melt the chocolate in a double boiler and drizzle over the iced cake

title: orange chicken stir fry oamc
steps:
1. Put the cornstarch in a medium bowl and slowly whisk in the orange juice
2. Add the soy sauce , vinegar , honey and garlic cloves
3. Whisk again and set aside
4. In a 5 qt dutch oven or pot heat the oil over medium-high heat
5. Cook the chicken in batches on one side until lightly browned
6. Set aside
7. It will be cooked more later
8. Add the broccoli , carrots and 1 / 2 cup of water to the pot
9. Cook , partially covered until the water has evaporated and the broccoli is bright green
10. Add the chicken and cornstarch to the pot and bring to a boil
11. Cook until chicken is done and the sauce is thickened
12. Cool to room temp and put into 2 or more freezer containers
13. I use freezer bags
14. To use: thaw and place into a saucepan
15. Add 1 / 2 cup of water for each serving
16. Cover and heat over medium high heat until heated through

title: portuguese shrimp and scallops
steps:
1. Melt butter and oil in a large skillet over medium heat
2. Add garlic and saute for one minute
3. Increase heat to high and add mushrooms
4. Saute until done
5. Add tomato paste and stir
6. Add wine and lemon juice and bring to a boil
7. Add shrimp and green onions
8. Cook one minute , stirring constantly
9. Add scallops and cook 3 minutes or until scallops are opaque
10. Season with salt and pepper and garnish with parsley

title: chocolate almond dream smoothie
steps:
1. If using frozen banana , you can skip the ice if you wish
2. Combine all of the ingredients in a blender and process at top speed for about 1 minute or until smooth
3. Pour into a glass and serve
4. Enjoy !

title: moms  gg  s chicken
steps:
1. Place oil in fry pan large enough to hold chicken parts and vegetables
2. Heat to medium-high
3. Meanwhile , combine flour , salt and pepper in a large bowl or ziploc bag
4. Shake off excess
5. Place chicken parts in fry pan and turn until golden on all sides , about 8-10 minutes
6. Add all vegetables stirring to coat and mix with residual oil
7. Place chicken pieces on top of vegetables
8. Lower heat to medium
9. Cover and cook for an additional 30-45 minutes
10. Do not lift the lid
11. You can shake the pan to redistribute the contents , if desired
12. Serve with rice or mashed potatoes

title: chicken kneidlach  chicken matzo balls
steps:
1. Combine the ground chicken , egg whites , egg yolks , matzo meal , cold water and sugar in a large bowl
2. The best way to get it all mixed up is to use your hands
3. Add salt and pepper to taste
4. Chill , covered , for 15 minutes
5. Fill a large pot with water
6. Bring the water to a rolling boil
7. If you like , you can toss a bouillon cube into the pot for flavoring , or add any spices you might like
8. I usually toss in some paprika and salt
9. Remove the bowl from the fridge
10. Wet your hands with water
11. Form the knedilach mixture into 36 balls about 1 1 / 2 inch in diameter
12. Always make sure your hands are wet so the dough doesn't stick
13. Drop the kneidlach into the boiling water
14. Half cover the pot and turn the flame down so the kneidlach are simmering in the water
15. Let them simmer for about 45 minutes
16. Turn off the heat
17. With a slotted spoon , remove the kneidlach
18. They are now ready to be added to your soup

title: lorna sass s 15 minute pressure cooker chili
steps:
1. Heat the oil in the cooker , stir in cumin seeds and toast 20 seconds
2. Add the ground meat in small batches , stirring vigorously after you add each batch
3. Use a long-handled fork or spoon to break up and crumble the meat
4. Continue cooking over high heat until the meat is brown
5. Stir in the onions and water , taking care to scrape up any browned bits sticking to the bottom of the cooker
6. Blend in the chile powder and the cocoa , then add the chorizo and bell pepper
7. Pour the tomatoes on top
8. Do not stir after adding tomatoes
9. Lock the lid in place , bring pan to high pressure over high heat
10. Reduce the heat just enough to maintain high pressure and cook for four minutes , then turn off heat
11. Quick release the pressure and remove lid , tilting it away from you to allow steam to escape
12. Stir in the garlic , oregano , salt and pepper , and extra chile powder to taste
13. Simmer the chili , uncovered , stirring occasionally , until the flavors are integrated , 3 to 5 minutes
14. Add some cooked beans , if desired , and heat through
15. Adding beans will increase the number the recipe will serve
16. Serve with garnishes of your choice

title: old fashioned peach preserves
steps:
1. Slice , peel , ripe hard peaches
2. Combine fruit and sugar
3. Let stand about 12 to 18 hours in a cool place
4. Sterilize canning jars
5. Bring fruit and sugar mixture slowly to bowling , stirring frequently
6. Boil gently until fruit become clear and syrup thick , about 40 minutes
7. As mixture thickens , stir frequently to prevent sticking
8. Skim
9. Pour hot preserves into jars , leaving 1 / 4-inch head space
10. Wipe jar rims and adjust lids
11. Process 5 minutes in a boiling water bath
12. Makes about 7 half-pints jars

title: date   fig salad dressing
steps:
1. Slightly roast or soften garlic first , otherwise too bitter
2. Whirl all the ingredients using a hand held electric blender
3. Mine is a cuisinart 200 watts smart stick that comes with a cup for the ingredients
4. Very thick
5. Experiment with different vinegars

title: pineapple passion milkshake
steps:
1. Mix ice cubes , crushed pineapple , milks , sugar and vanilla in blender until smooth
2. Add ice cream and sherbet and blend till just smooth
3. Serve with a fresh pineapple wedge if desired

title: reindeer tears
steps:
1. Place cranberries into a 2 ounce cordial or liqueur glass
2. Fill with vodka and say kippis and drink up !

title: couscous with mushrooms
steps:
1. In a large sauce pan , bring water , butter , bouillon , salt , and pepper to a boil
2. Stir in couscous and mushrooms
3. Cover and remove from the heat
4. Let stand for 5 minutes
5. Fluff with a fork

title: lemon pastry
steps:
1. In a bowl , stir flour and salt together
2. Cut the butter into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs
3. With a fork , stir the egg , lemon juice , and 2 tablespoons ice water together
4. Sprinkle the liquid over the flour mixture and mix just until the pastry holds together , adding more water if needed
5. Knead the dough in the bowl for 2 or 3 strokes , just until the dough makes a smooth ball
6. Cover and chill for 30 minutes or until firm
7. Then ready to roll out

title: grilled marinated shrimp skewers
steps:
1. In a bowl whisk together all marinade ingredients until well blended
2. Pour the marinade into a large resealable plastic bag
3. Add in the shrimp , seal bag and toss to coat the marinade with the shrimp
4. Refrigerate for 2 hours
5. Soak the wooden skewers in cold water 30 minutes before threading
6. Set grill heat to medium-low
7. Thread the shrimp onto the skewers piercing once near the tail and once near the head
8. Discard the marinade
9. Grease the grill grate
10. Cook shrimp for about 5 minutes per side or until opaque , brushing frequently with the reserved marinade

title: iceberg lettuce wedges w creamy blue cheese dressing
steps:
1. Cut the lettuce into 4 wedges and place on chilled plates
2. In a medium bowl , whisk together remaining ingredients , until the dressing is creamy but still slightly lumpy from the blue cheese
3. Spoon a generous amount of dressing over each wedge of lettuce
4. Garnish with the extra chives and serve

title: brined and roasted pork loin w caramelized onions
steps:
1. Brine- mix all ingredients and put pork loin in brine
2. Refrigerate up to 24 hours
3. Heat oven to 400 degrees
4. Remove from brine and pat dry with paper towels
5. Place in roasting pan
6. Smear crushed garlic over top of pork , sprinkle black pepper and 1 sliced white onion on top
7. Place in oven for 1-1 / 2 hours , check for for doneness at 1 hour
8. Put butter and oil in skillet , heat on medium heat
9. Add 4 sliced onions and stir
10. Carmelize for about 30-45 minutes , until brown and sweet
11. Remove pork
12. Allow to rest
13. Slice and serve with carmelized onions on top

title: sour cream chicken enchiladas  no canned soup
steps:
1. Place chicken in a large saucepan and cover with water
2. Season to taste
3. Boil chicken until cooked through and tender
4. Remove chicken , saving broth
5. Shred or chop the chicken into small pieces
6. I often grind it in my food processor as we like the pieces very small
7. Place chicken in a large bowl and add 3 cups cheese and the onions
8. Add salt to taste
9. Mix well
10. Place a small amount of chicken mixture onto each tortilla and roll
11. Place in a casserole dish
12. Try not to crowd too many into one pan
13. In a saucepan , melt the butter
14. Stir in the green chilies and then the flour
15. Slowly stir in 4 cups of reserved chicken broth
16. Cook until the mixture becomes slightly thick , like gravy
17. Remove from heat and stir in sour cream
18. Pour the sauce over the enchiladas
19. Cover and cook at 350 degrees for 30 minutes
20. Uncover , top with remaining cheese and return to oven for another 5 minutes to melt the cheese

title: almond crunch
steps:
1. Line bottom and sides of an 8 or 9-inch pan with aluminum foil
2. Spray lightly with non stick spray
3. Set aside
4. Combine all ingredients in a 10-inch skillet
5. Over medium heat , bring to a boil , stirring constantly
6. Boil until mixture turn golden brown , 5-6 minutes
7. Quickly spread in prepared pan
8. Cool 15 minutes and break into bite sized pieces

title: holiday appetizer puffs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Roll pastry on lightly floured surgace to 13x13 square
3. Cut into shapes with cookie cutters
4. Place on ungreased baking sheets
5. Brush cut-outs lightly with oil
6. Decorate with desired toppings
7. Bake 6-8 minutes or until golden
8. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: shrimp starter salad
steps:
1. Distribute the lettuce to cover the bottom of 4 individual bowls or plates
2. Arrange the chopped tomato on top of the lettuce
3. Sprinkle on the peas
4. Chop the cheese to 1 / 4" size and spread it evenly over the salads
5. Arrange shrimp on top
6. Place slices of avocado on one side on the edge of the salad
7. Serve dressing of your choice at the table

title: gelatin dessert squares
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine the flour , pecans and brown sugar
2. Stir in butter
3. Press into an ungreased 13x9x2 inch baking dish
4. Bake at 350 for 10-13 minutes or until lightly browned
5. Cool on a wire rack
6. In a large mixing bowl , beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth
7. Fold in whipped topping
8. Spread over crust
9. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour
10. In a bowl , dissolve the gelatin in boiling water
11. Stir in cold water
12. Spoon over the cream cheese layer
13. Refrigerate until firm
14. Cut into squares

title: chicken vegetable casserole
steps:
1. Steam broccoli & cauliflower for 25 minutes
2. Boil carrots until tender , then cut diagonally
3. Stir onions into olive oil in saute pan
4. Heat until translucent
5. Chop broccoli & cauliflower coarsely with knife and place in 9x13 baking dish
6. Add carrots and cooked shredded chicken , salt & pepper to taste
7. Add onions to vegetables
8. In a separate pan , cook cream of chicken and cream of celery soups , with milk to boiling point
9. Remove from heat immediately
10. Add cheese and stir until slightly melted
11. Pour soup mixture over chicken & vegetables
12. Mix well and bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes or until bubbly

title: smoked salmon salad  nicoise style
steps:
1. Cook beans , hard-boil eggs & potatoes
2. Set aside & allow to completely cool
3. While they are cooling , prepare & slice onion & bell pepper
4. Line a lrg platter w / lettuce & mound smoked salmon in the centre
5. Arrange beans , tomatoes , pepper rings , onion rings , egg wedges , potatoes & olives over the lettuce & around the salmon
6. Cover platter & chill at least 2 hours just b4 serving , drizzle w / salad dressing & sprinkle w / capers
7. Hint: to easily slice smoked salmon , put it in the freezer
8. When nearly frozen , remove from the freezer & use your sharpest knife to shave very thin slices

title: spaghetti squash saute
steps:
1. Place whole spaghetti squash in baking dish
2. Prick all over with fork
3. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 to 60 minutes or until tender
4. Cool
5. Cut squash in half lengthwise
6. Remove seeds
7. With fork , scoop out flesh into medium bowl , separating into spaghetti-like strands
8. In large skillet , heat oil over medium-high heat
9. Cook green onions and garlic in oil about 3 minutes , stirring constantly
10. Add squash and stir-fry 3 to 5 minutes more until heated through
11. Stir in parsley and lemon juice
12. Mix well
13. Add cheese and toss to coat

title: blackberry almond bruschetta
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Bake french bread as directed on can
3. Cool 5 minutes
4. Cut ends of loaf
5. Cut loaf crosswise in slices , about 1 / 2" thick
6. Arrange on ungreased cookie sheet
7. Spray each slice with cooking spray until lightly coated
8. Cover with granulated sugar
9. Return to oven 8-10 minutes longer or until lightly golden
10. Meanwhile , in small bowl , beat cheese , almond extract and 1 / 4 cup powdered sugar with electric mixer on low speed until well combined
11. Spread cheese mixture evenly on bread slices
12. Top each with 3-4 blackberries
13. Sprinkle with almond pieces
14. With small strainer , sprinkle the 3 tablespoons powedered sugar over bruschetta
15. Enjoy !

title: beefy green bean and walnut stir fry
steps:
1. In large skillet , heat oil and garlic over medium heat , about 30 seconds
2. Add beef and beans
3. Sprinkle with salt
4. Mix well
5. Cook 5 minutes or until beef is well browned , stirring occasionally
6. Stir in walnuts
7. Cook 2 minutes more
8. Serve over hot cooked egg noodles
