title: miss daisy s lemon icebox pie
steps:
1. Beat together whipped topping , lemonade concentrate and condensed milk
2. Pour into pie shell and freeze at least 1 hour before serving
3. Variation: frozen limeade concentrate may be used in place of lemonade
4. Store in freezer and serve frozen

title: fudgy whole wheat yogurt cake
steps:
1. Grease an 8x8 pan and preheat oven to 375
2. Blend all ingredients together in a medium bowl
3. Pour batter into prepared pan and bake for 30 minutes , or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean
4. Serve as is , frosted , or dusted with powdered sugar

title: easy awesome guacamole
steps:
1. Cut avocados in half and take out the seed , scoop out meat with a spoon and place in bowl
2. Mash the avocado with a fork
3. Add the salsa , mayonnaise , sour cream , salt , pepper , garlic and onion powder
4. Mix together well
5. Add lemon juice , mix and serve
6. Garnish with fresh chives

title: medaglioni di vitello funghi   veal with mushrooms   cognac
steps:
1. Preheat saut pan over medium high heat
2. Dredge each medallion in flour and shake off excess
3. Add butter to pan
4. When the butter is melted and begins to foam , add the medallions and sear on both sides
5. Remove to drain on paper toweling
6. Drain the butter from pan and add shallots , cooking until translucent
7. Add the shiitake mushrooms , stirring to incorporate with shallots
8. Cook about 2 minutes
9. Remove pan from heat and add cognac
10. Return to the heat carefully to avoid flare-up
11. Reduce cognac until almost dry
12. Add veal stock and reduce by half
13. Season with salt and pepper
14. Add cream and reduce by half , stirring occasionally to blend flavors
15. Return medallions to pan and coat well with sauce
16. Place on plates and spoon sauce on top
17. Garnish with sprigs of fresh parsley
18. Suggested wine - 2000 mondavi / frescobaldi lucente or a favorite medium- to full-bodied red of your choice

title: cream of brussels sprouts soup
steps:
1. Trim tough outer leaves if sprouts and put and x in each stem
2. Drop sprouts into boiling chicken broth and simmer until tender , about 10-15 minutes
3. Blend sprouts in a food processor , reserving cooking liquid
4. Melt 3 tbs of the butter in a saucepan and stir in flour
5. Blend well
6. Add reserved liquid , stir rapidly with a whisk , and simmer for about 5 minutes
7. Add pureed sprouts , milk , and nutmeg
8. Simmer 5 minutes
9. Add cream and tabasco , and salt and pepper to taste
10. Heat just to a simmer
11. Swirl in remaining butter and serve hot

title: brownie chip cookies
steps:
1. Combine brownie mix , eggs , and oil
2. Mix with electric mixer until well blended
3. Stir in chocolate morsels and pecans
4. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets
5. Bake at 350 for 10-12 minutes
6. Cool slightly on cookie sheets
7. Remove to wire racks , and let cool completely

title: fabulous crusty italian loaf
steps:
1. In a small bowl , dissolve yeast with a quarter cup of the lukewarm water
2. Pour yeast into a large bowl
3. Mix in flour , sugar , salt , and remaining lukewarm water and mix in until dough starts to form
4. If too sticky , add a bit more flour
5. Turn out onto flat surface and knead for 6-8 minutes or until smooth and elastic
6. Put dough into an oiled bowl , turn to coat , cover with a thick towel , and let rise in a warm place , free from draft , until doubled in size , or about 1
7. 5-2 hours
8. For bread machine , just use to mix and do the first rising of the dough , then remove to shape into loaves and do second rise , following instructions below
9. Preheat oven to 425f
10. Remove dough onto a floured surface
11. Punch down and shape into 2 oblong loaves about a foot long each
12. If you own a baking stone or unglazed ceramic tiles , dust lightly with cornmeal and put into preheated oven
13. Put loaves on a peel , also lightly dusted with cornmeal , or on a cookie sheet sprinkled with cornmeal
14. Cover and let rise again for 40 minutes
15. Loaves will about double in width
16. In a small dish , add egg yolk and 1 tablespoon of water
17. Slit tops of risen bread 3 or 4 times , making slits that are a quarter of an inch deep
18. With a brush , paint tops with egg wash
19. If on a peel , slide loaves onto stone or tile
20. Otherwise put cookie sheet in oven
21. Bake for 10 minutes at 425f then lower heat to 400f and bake for an additional 30-35 minutes , until golden and baked through
22. To check if it's done , thump the bottom of each loaf
23. If it sounds hollow , it's done
24. I am including both here so that you can decide , depending on your oven
25. Don't wait to let it cool
26. Eat it when it's hot ! delicious !
27. Variation: to make rolls , preheat oven to 400f after dough rises , remove to a floured surface
28. Punch down dough and shape into 12-14 rolls
29. Place on cookie sheet sprinkled with cornmeal
30. Let rise for 20 minutes
31. Slit each roll once and paint tops with egg wash
32. Bake for 18-22 minutes or until golden and baked through

title: broccoli cheese and potato soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , saute onion and celery in butter over medium heat until tender
2. Add flour , pepper , salt , and paprika and stir until smooth
3. Add broth , milk , and potatoes , stirring constantly until it boils and thickens
4. Reduce heat
5. Cover and simmer for 10-15 minutes or until potatoes are tender
6. Stir in cheese and cooked broccoli and cook over low until cheese is melted and soup is heated through
7. Sprinkle individual servings with parsley if desired

title: mum s spaghetti bolognese
steps:
1. You also need 1 big jar of dolmio sauce
2. Put oil , garlic and onion in bottom of saucepan
3. Gently fry until the onion goes clear
4. Put mince in and brown it
5. Once browned add dolmio sauce , pinch of mixed herbs or oregano if you don't have any
6. Add a good splash of worcestershire sauce
7. Let bubble away for about 1 hour
8. Stir occasionally
9. While cooking add grated carrot
10. Spaghetti:
11. Get a deep pot of water
12. Add a pinch of salt
13. Boil
14. Add spaghetti and cook as directed on packet
15. Drain out leaving a tsp water in the bottom
16. Add a splash of olive oil to stop it from sticking and toss
17. Place spaghetti in bowls and top with sauce and sprinkle with parmesan cheese , and if your like me , you will like it with grated cheese

title: asian style barbecue pork loin sirloin chops
steps:
1. Mix the marinade together
2. For lower sodium , use reduced sodium soy sauce , or light soy sauce
3. Trim all fat from boneless pork loin sirloin chops and cut into 1 / 3 to 2 inch pieces
4. Place meat in a baking dish and pour marinade over top
5. Cover and refrigerate for up to 2 hours
6. Heat a grill or a george foreman
7. Coat with cooking spray
8. Remove pork from marinade
9. Place on grill
10. Reduce heat to medium
11. Cook , turning occasionally , until pork is no longer pink and internal temperature is 160f 10 to 18 minutes
12. Serve over hot rice with steamed broccoli

title: chocolaty and gooey brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. In a large bowl combine the 1 cup softened butter , 2 cups sugar , 1 / 3 cup cocoa and the 4 eggs
3. Stir in the flour , vanilla , salt and nuts
4. Pour into greased 1-inch deep baking sheet
5. Bake for 20 minutes
6. Cover with marshmallows
7. Bake 3 to 5 minutes so marshmallows can melt
8. To make frosting: mix together remaining ingredients using an electric mixer
9. Frost brownies when brownies are cool

title: beet and carrot cake
steps:
1. After the cake is cooked , they become cooked , but they have to be added raw in the cake preparation
2. Preheat oven at 350f
3. Butter a bundt cake pan or use pam
4. In a bowl , mix oil , sugar , egg yokes , vanilla extract and water
5. Set aside
6. In another bowl , pass through a sieve the flour , baking powder , salt , cinnamon powder
7. Incorporate to the first mix
8. Add the raw carrots , the raw beets and the nuts and mix well
9. With the electric mixer , whip the egg whites until they are fluffy
10. Fold delicately into the cake preparation
11. Pour into the greased cake pan
12. Bake approximately 50 minutes
13. Serve with my cream cheese and applesauce frosting

title: laura s version of white chili
steps:
1. Add all ingredients to stock pot , except for the lime juice and cilantro-- stir those in just before serving
2. Cook on medium high heat until heated through
3. When i am making a big batch for the freezer , i usually quadruple the recipe
4. Great to serve buffet style , with bowls of the extra chopped jalapenos , shredded cheese and tortilla chips for everyone to create their own bowl of chili
5. Prep time does not include cooking the chicken breasts

title: maria s best crock pot roast
steps:
1. Using a sharp , thin knife , create deep holes in the meat , inserting the quartered pieces of garlic and bacon
2. Using a mortar and pestle , mash garlic and salt first , then add paprika , parsley , olive oil and vinegar
3. Rub this mixture all over the roast
4. Put the roast into the crockpot and cook on low 7-10 hours , or until done
5. You can substitute a pork sirloin roast for the beef too , mmmmm

title: barb s gumbo
steps:
1. Add oil to skillet , heat over medium heat add the flour , to make a roux
2. This may take about 15 minutes
3. Stir in onion , celery , bell pepper , garlic , and black pepper
4. Cook over medium heat about 3 minutes or till vegetables are crisp tender
5. Gradually stir in chicken broth , tomatoes , salt , worcestershire sauce , pepper sauce , corn , okra , basil , thyme , cumin and bay leaf
6. Bring to boiling point
7. Reduce heat
8. Cover and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes
9. Add shrimp during the last 5 minutes
10. Serve over rice
11. This can also be made with chicken , if using chicken
12. Use chicken breast cut in chunks add during the last 20 to 30 minute cooking time
13. Smoked sausage is also good added with the chicken
14. I have added a can of crabmeat to the shrimp version

title: cucumber sauce for fish   seafood
steps: 1. Mix the cuke with the sour cream , miracle whip , chives , lemon juice , salt& pepper mix well and chill until serving with hot or cold seafood

title: mexican lasagna with black beans and corn
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 f
2. Spray a 13-by-9-inch baking pan with cooking oil spray
3. Set aside
4. Stack the tortillas on a cutting board , and slice through them lengthwise into 3 strips each set aside
5. Pour the corn and black beans into a colander , and rinse with warm tap water to begin defrosting the corn and rinse the beans
6. Set aside to drain
7. In a small bowl , stir together the tomatoes with their juice , the tomato sauce , chili powder , cumin , garlic powder and sugar
8. Spoon about half of the sauce into the bottom of the dish
9. Cover the sauce with 5 of the tortilla strips
10. Break the egg into a medium-size mixing bowl , and beat with a whisk or fork until foamy
11. Add the sour cream and 1 cup of the cheese
12. Stir to mix well
13. Spoon half of the sour cream mixture evenly over the tortilla layer and spread it out with the back of a spoon
14. Scatter half of the corn and black beans over the sour cream mixture
15. Place 5 more tortilla strips evenly over the corn and black bean layer
16. Top with the remaining sour cream mixture , and the remaining black beans and corn
17. Place the remaining tortilla strips over the dish
18. Pour the remaining tomato sauce mixture over the tortillas , and spread it evenly with the back of a spoon to moisten all of the tortilla strips
19. Cover the dish with foil , and bake for 30 minutes , or until hot and bubbly
20. While the dish bakes , rinse and trim the green onions
21. Slice the green onions thinly , using all of the whites and enough of the tender green tops to make 1 / 2 cup
22. Set aside
23. If using the black olives , drain them well , and set aside
24. After baking lasagna , scatter the green onions and olives , if using , evenly over the dish
25. Return the dish to the oven , uncovered , for 5 more minutes
26. Remove the dish from the oven , and scatter the remaining cup of mexican cheese evenly over the dish
27. Return the dish , uncovered , to the oven , and bake until the cheese melts , about 3 minutes
28. Remove the lasagna from the oven , and let it stand 10 minutes
29. Slice into squares and serve

title: easy beef green chili burros
steps:
1. Put all ingredients except the flour in a 3 quart pot and bring to boil
2. After it boils reduce heat cover and simmer for 2 hrs stirring occasionally making sure you don't run out of liquid
3. Remove from heat add the flour and mix well add more if you want it thicker

title: breakfast sausage bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Pam a 9x13
3. Layer 1: line it with one tube of crescent rolls
4. Layer 2: brown & drain sausage
5. Add on top of crescent rolls
6. Layer 3: drain cottage cheese very well
7. Add egg , garlic salt , onion powder & parmesan
8. Add on top of sausage
9. Layer 4: add mozzarella cheese
10. Layer 5: top with crescent rolls
11. Bake for approximately 45 mins

title: sesame lamb chops
steps:
1. In bowl , beat the eggs , mustard , salt and pepper together
2. On another plate , mix the breadcrumbs and sesame seeds
3. Place the flour on a third plate
4. Coat each chop with flour , shaking off any excess
5. Dip in the egg and mustard mixture and then coat with the breadcrumbs , pressing on firmly
6. Refrigerate for 15 minutes
7. Heat the butter and oil in a frying pan and cook the chops over medium heat until crispy and golden and cooked to taste , about 5 minutes on each side

title: mom s homemade vegetable soup
steps:
1. Put first 4 ingredients into large soup pot and bring to boil
2. Turn down and simmer for 2 hours
3. Add veggies and simmer another 2 hours

title: grandma s chewy molasses cookies
steps:
1. Using a strong mixer , mix butter and sugar until sugar has aerated the butter and it is light and fluffy
2. Blend in molasses and egg gently
3. While butter / sugar is mixing , blend all dry ingredients in a separate bowl
4. Add to creamed mixture in thirds until fully blended
5. Refrigerate 1 hour
6. Form into balls a little smaller than a golf ball and roll in sugar
7. Place on parchment paper or greased sheet
8. Bake 350 degrees for 12-13 minutes
9. Hint - when the cookies are done baking , they puff up in the center and crack , but wait until the inside of the crack turns from shiny dark brown to medium brown

title: zesty polynesian scallops
steps:
1. Broil the scallops for 4 minutes , then turn and broil 2 more minutes
2. In a large saucepan , saut the chopped onion in the olive oil until tender
3. Add the sliced mushrooms , bell pepper strips , and chopped tomato
4. Cook until all the vegetables are heated through
5. Arranged the sauted vegetables on a platter
6. Top with the broiled scallops
7. Layer the avacado slices on top of the scallops , then spread mango salsa over the the avacado slices
8. Top with sour cream , and garnish with green onion slices

title: francesca s turkey ham rolls
steps:
1. Chop only the whitest part of the celery in very small pieces , add to the cheese and work it with a fork to make it smoother
2. Then add the spices and the peeled pistachos
3. Spread this cheese cream on one slice of smoked turkey ham and roll it
4. Place the rolls in the refrigerator for 20-30 minutes and serve cold
5. Buon appetito !

title: zucchini tomato gratin
steps:
1. Drape tomato slices over colander , sprinkle with salt , and let drain for 45 minutes
2. Spread zucchini on baking sheet , and sprinkle with salt
3. Let stand 30 minutes to sweat out excess moisture
4. Rinse well and pat dry
5. Preheat oven to 375
6. Heat 1 t oil in nonstick skilled over medium-high heat
7. Saute' zucchini 3 to 4 minutes , or until golden
8. Transfer to plate
9. Do this in 2 batches , if necessary and add more oil between batches
10. Layer half of zucchini slices in 8-inch square baking dish
11. Top with half of the tomatoes
12. Sprinkle with half the garlic , 1 t olives , half of basil , and 1 / 4 cup of parmesan cheese
13. Season with pepper
14. Repeat with remaining zucchini slices , tomatoes , garlic , olives and basil
15. Drizzle top with 3 t oil and sprinkle with remaining cheese
16. Cover with foil and bake 10 minutes
17. Remove foil and bake 20 minutes more or until cheese is melted and gratin is bubbling
18. Let stand 5 minutes before serving

title: macaroni and cheese with a kick   rsc
steps:
1. Cook your macaroni following package directions to al dente , drain
2. In a large heavy saucepan , heat butter on medium
3. Add garlic and cook for about one minute , add flour , mustard , salt and pepper
4. Gradually whisk in the milk , beer and yogurt until smooth , add dip mix and stir
5. Bring to a boil and turn down to low
6. Stir in 1 1 / 2 c cheddar , all the fontina and 1 / 2 the parmesan
7. Stir until melted
8. Add chives
9. To a large baking dish
10. Spray with cooking spray
11. Add macaroni , cover with the sauce
12. Stir to distribute the sauce
13. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 c cheddar and the remaining parmesan
14. Bake uncovered at 400 f for about 20 minutes until golden and melt-y
15. Top with bacon bits
16. Let stand for 5-8 minutes
17. Serve
18. Enjoy !

title: barbs salad
steps:
1. Combine first 6 ingredients to make dressing and set aside to let flavors blend
2. Make salad with greens and rest of vegetables
3. Serve desired amount of dressing over salad

title: java beef stew
steps:
1. Season beef with salt and pepper
2. Heat oil in large dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown beef in batches , without crowding
3. Transfer browned beef to bowl or platter
4. Add more oil to pot if needed
5. Cook onions until soft , about 6 minutes
6. Add garlic and cook one minute more
7. Add wine and coffee
8. Bring to a boil over high heat
9. Scrape up browned bits in bottom of pot with a wooden spatula
10. Return beef to pot and add thyme and bay leaf
11. Bring to a boil
12. Reduce heat to low , cover the pot , and simmer until beef is almost tender , about an hour and a half
13. Add veggies to the pot
14. Continue cooking until beef and veggies are tender , another 30 minutes
15. Mix butter and flour together to form a paste
16. Stir in to simmering stew a pinch at a time until desired thickness is achieved
17. Discard any remaining butter and flour paste

title: pear salad with spinach  blue cheese  and walnuts
steps:
1. Place pear on bed of fresh spinach
2. Mix blue cheese with heavy cream , and fill the center of the pear
3. Sprinkle with roasted walnuts

title: four cheese dip
steps:
1. Blend cheeses , milk , and garlic in a blender or container of a food processor until smooth
2. Stir in scallions
3. Cover and chill until serving time
4. Garnish as desired
5. Serve with various dippers

title: oh my d lux chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Cream butter and add sugar , beating at low speed until light and fluffy
3. Add eggs and vanilla and beat well
4. Combine flour and baking powder and add to creamed mixture until well combined
5. Stir in remaining ingredients
6. Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls onto baking sheets
7. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until lightly browned
8. Cool on wire racks

title: carrie s rhubarb butter crunch
steps:
1. Combine rhubarb , white sugar , and flour
2. Place in greased 6x10 inch baking dish
3. Combine remaining ingredients and sprinkle over rhubarb
4. Mixture
5. Bake at 350 for 40 minutes or until done
6. Serve warm or cold

title: bullet express denver omelet
steps:
1. Before you begin
2. Melt butte in a large skillet over med heat
3. Place meal mixer on base
4. Insert shopper / mixer blade
5. Add eggs to meal mixer and pulse for 2-3 times , remove eggs and set aside
6. Remove meal mixer assembly from base
7. Place meal maker assembly with shredder disc
8. On base
9. Lock on slicer / shredder cover , placing a bowl underneath short
10. Turn on bullet express and and onion
11. Pepper , ham and cheese through feed tube
12. Finally pour mixture into skillet and cook until omelet ins halfway set , flip omlet in half and continue cooking through

title: creamy no egg potato salad
steps:
1. Boil potatoes in water for 25 minutes , drain and set aside to cool
2. Combine remaining ingredients in large covered container and place in refrigerator while potatoes are cooling
3. When potatoes are cool enough to handle , peel and cube them
4. Add to vegetable mayonnaise mixture and toss
5. Cover and chill at least 6 hours or overnight
6. Delicious !

title: the big daddy caddy margarita
steps:
1. Shake tequila , triple sec , sweet and sour mix , and lime juice with ice
2. Take margarita glass or any preferred glass and dip in lime juice to coat rim
3. Next dip into kosher salt or margarita salt until coated
4. Pour cocktail in dropping a few ice cubes to have an "on-the-rocks" feel
5. Float grand marnier on top
6. Add straw and garnish with lime

title: kimchi fried rice
steps:
1. Start with cooking 1 cup of rice with 2 cups of water over high heat until it reaches a boil
2. Then reduce the heat and cover
3. Do not touch rice until 20 minutes
4. Then fluff with a fork
5. If using leftover rice , you can just add it after sauting the kimchee
6. Fry the bacon in a pan until nice and crispy
7. Remove from pan and drain grease
8. Afterwords , chop up the bacon into little pieces and reserve to the side
9. In a wok , saut the kimchee in oil over medium-high heat
10. You want the kimchee to be cooked until it turns lucid
11. Maybe 3-5 minutes
12. Add the rice , 1 teaspoons of sesame oil , 1 tablespoons of kochujang , 1 tbsp of dashida , and bacon , and incorporate thorougly
13. Add more seasoning to taste
14. Cook for a couple of minutes until you think that everything has incorporated
15. If you feel as if the fried rice is a little dry , you can always add some kimchee juice from the kimchee jar
16. Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and or green onions

title: peaches in brandy
steps:
1. Prepare peaches
2. Make a syrup with the sugar & water in a large sauce-pan
3. Stir mixture until it boils
4. To the boiling syrup , add peach halves and extract
5. When fruit is cooked , remove pan from heat , drain
6. Cool fruits and spoon carefully into prepared jars
7. Half fill jars with reserved syrup , run a butter knife down the jar to remove air bubbles
8. Fill jars to the top with brandy
9. Seal jars with lids , shake gently to mix syrup and brandy
10. Store in a cool dark place--use within six months
11. I've also added a pinch of cinnamon and cloves with very good results

title: emeril s cajun water
steps:
1. Place water in saucepan- very simple
2. This ain't rocket science , folks
3. Use your knob to heat the water on low
4. Relax and get one of those cold frozen things- it will make you happy , happy , happy
5. Don't jack the fire up to high unless you are on good terms with the fire department
6. That's what those lines are on there for
7. Heat to a boil- oh yeah babe
8. Season with salt , pepper , and essence
9. Fork a lemon if it turns you on
10. Add a pinch of cinnaminnamom to kick it up a notch
11. You could put in 30-40 cloves of garlic , or a ham hock , because pork fat rules !
12. Add a teaspoon of heavy cream if it thrills you , because somebody has to keep the dairy farmers of america in business
13. And there you have it- use water where called for in cajun recipes

title: chicken  beets  apple and walnut salad
steps:
1. Grill chicken breast from frozen , seasoning with salt and pepper to taste
2. Cool and slice each breast into 4 or 5 slices
3. Wash beets and wrap in heavy-duty aluminum foil , bake on cookie sheets at 350 for 45 minutes or until done
4. Peel beets , cut julienne
5. Mix vinegar , honey , dijon , salt and pepper
6. Gradually whisk in olive and walnut oil until blended
7. Arrange endive and radicchio on individual plates , top with chicken slices , apple slices and beet slices
8. Sprinkle with cheese
9. Drizzle evenly with dressing

title: deluxe potato casserole
steps:
1. In lagre mixing bowl add ingredients listed
2. Mix well
3. Put into a casserole dish and bake for 1 hour at 350 degrees

title: pear  n pop cocktail
steps:
1. In your serving glass , place vodka and soda
2. Give it a stir , then toss in some ice
3. Serve with a lemon or lime wedge as a garnish

title: homestyle macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit
2. Cook macaroni until just al dente
3. You can use elbows for a traditional look , but try scoobi-doo-- it works well in this recipe
4. Drain pasta well
5. While the mac is boiling , melt the 1 / 4-cup butter in a large pot
6. Whisk in the flour
7. Over med heat , whisk until smooth and bubbly
8. Stir in milk , cream cheese , salt , pepper& mustard
9. Keep cooking and stirring until sauce is thickened-- about three or four minutes
10. Cut the block of cheddar into half-inch cubes
11. Add drained macaroni and cubed cheddar& combine well
12. Pour into a casserole sprayed with pam
13. In a small bowl , combine the remaining ingredients and sprinkle over top
14. Dust with paprika if desired
15. Bake for 15-20 minutes , or until top is golden brown and casserole is heated through

title: creamy cauliflower puree
steps:
1. Cook cauliflower & garlic until very tender
2. Place the cooked cauliflower and garlic in a food processor
3. Add yogurt , 2 teaspoons oil , salt and pepper
4. Pulse several times , then process until smooth and creamy
5. Garnish with chives , if desired drizzle 2 more teaspoons of olive oil
6. Serve hot

title: frozen watermelon lemonade
steps:
1. Place watermelon cubes and raspberries in blender
2. Process until smooth
3. Pour juice through a sieve
4. Discard pulp
5. Combine sugar and water in small saucepan
6. Heat , stirring constantly , just until sugar dissolves
7. Set syrup aside and allow to cool slightly
8. Stir syrup and lemon juice into watermelon juice mixture
9. Pour into freezer container , cover and freeze until firm
10. Using ice cream scoop , spoon mixture into tall glasses
11. Pour 3 to 4 tablespoons strawberry-flavored water over frozen juice in each glass
12. Serve immediately
13. Variation: to serve as sorbet , freeze juice mixture in 8 inch square dish
14. Omit strawberry-flavored carbonated water
15. Using a small scoop , shape frozen juice mixture into balls and arrange in individual serving dishes

title: gluten free peach crisp
steps:
1. Place peach slices in a large bowl , sprinkle with lemon juice , vanilla and arrowroot
2. Toss to incorporate all ingredients
3. In a smaller bowl , combine almond flour , salt , baking soda , grapeseed oil and agave for topping
4. Place peach mixture in a 3 quart baking dish
5. Crumble topping over peaches
6. Bake covered at 350 for 1 hour , until peach juice is bubbling
7. Remove cover and bake a few more minutes until topping is golden brown
8. Serve

title: riceless pilaf
steps:
1. Combine oil and orzo in small saucepan
2. Stir frequently over medium-high heat until pasta is browned
3. Add liquid and seasonings
4. Bring back to a boil
5. Reduce heat to low
6. Simmer 5-10 minutes until just slightly saucy

title: peach fuzz big buzz
steps:
1. Slice peaches and remove pit , leaving skin on
2. Place pink lemonade concentrate , vodka , and peaches in blender
3. Fill blender up with ice and blend until smooth and slushy
4. Add more ice if you prefer

title: hot dog onions
steps:
1. Heat oil in a med
2. Size skillet on med / high heat
3. Add onions and cook til onions are very limp and all fluid is evaporated
4. Add all the remaining ingredients except for the tomato paste and water
5. And simmer uncovered for a few minutes
6. Then add the tomato paste and water
7. And simmer uncovered again til it reduces in half
8. Serve ontop of cooked hot dogs

title: cinnamon topped banana bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Grease and flour 9x5" loaf pan
3. Cream butter with sugar in a large bowl until light and fluffy
4. Add egg and beat well
5. Sift together flour , baking soda , baking powder , salt , cinnamon and cardamom in a medium bowl
6. Mix banana with yogurt and vanilla in small bowl
7. Gradually dry and banana mixes to butter mix alternately , stirring till smooth
8. Pour batter into pan , then top with sprinkle stuff and bake 45min
9. -1hr
10. Remove from pan to wire rack to cool

title: slow cooked    crock pot pulled pork
steps:
1. Switch on the crockpot to the low setting
2. Combine all ingredients in a medium mixing bowl
3. Place pork shoulder in crock pot
4. Pour sauce over pork to coat
5. Cover and cook with lid on for approximately 8-10 hours on low or overnight
6. Cook until very tender and falling apart
7. I often do this overnight
8. Remove pork from crock and cool enough for handling
9. When cooled , pull apart with fingers or forks
10. Put back in crock , keep warm until ready to serve
11. For a thicker sauce , add 1 / 2 c ketchup and 1 / 2 c your favorite bbq sauce
12. Serve on soft buns and smother with a creamy coleslaw recipe#421991

title: grilled chicken marinade
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl and marinaide chicken for at least 15 minutes or as long as you like
2. Grill

title: pumpkin breakfast bread
steps:
1. First up , cream together your butter and brown sugar
2. Add in your egg , vanilla , and evaporated milk
3. Mix well and then add in your pudding mix and flour
4. Finally , you'll add in your pumpkin , cinnamon , nutmeg , salt , baking powder , and baking soda
5. Mix up your streusel ingredients
6. The brown sugar , pecans , cinnamon , and nutmeg
7. Pour about half the batter into a 9x11 pan
8. Sprinkle half your streusel mixture over the batter
9. Pour the rest of your batter in the pan and sprinkle the rest of the streusel mixture over the top
10. Pop it in the oven at 350 for 45-50 minutes
11. And let me tell ya , be flexible with the time ! this is a really moist bread so it's imperative that it's cooked all the way through
12. If you need an extra five minutes , by all means take it
13. Just make sure that toothpick comes out clean !

title: beans  beans  beans  beans  beans  beans  onions and beans
steps:
1. Fry the onion in the oil with the garlic , spices and seasoning
2. Stir in the beans and mix thoroughly
3. Reheat and serve

title: chicken ala turk
steps:
1. Remove the skin from chicken pieces
2. Season chicken with salt and pepper
3. Cook in oil
4. Remove pieces as they brown
5. They should be almost cooked at this point
6. Add onions to the oil left in the pan and cook until soft
7. Add garlic , bay leaf and ground coriander
8. Stir in rice until well coated with the oil
9. Add bell peppers and cook a few minutes
10. Stir in tomatoes , cumin and saffron
11. Return chicken pieces to pan
12. Pour 2 cups boiling chicken stock
13. Cover pan
14. Turn down heat and simmer 10 minutes
15. Add olives and continue simmering 10 to 15 minutes until rice is cooked
16. Serve hot

title: roast loin of pork with five vegetables
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 180c / 350f / gas 4
2. Taking a sharp knife , score the skin of the pork 12 to 15 times
3. Rub the vinegar over the skin , mix together the salt and thyme and rub into the skin
4. Place on a roasting tray and roast for 1 hours basting every 15 minutes or so
5. After about an hour , pour some of the fat juices into another tray and heat until smoking hot
6. Season the potatoes with salt and add them to the hot fat , spooning it over to make sure each piece is covered
7. Cook until crisp and brown , which will take about 40 minutes , turning occasionally
8. Whilst the meat is in the oven , pre-cook the vegetables separately in plenty of boiling salted water
9. Begin with the cauliflower , remove and plunge into cold water
10. Do the same with the carrots , beans and broccoli - in this order
11. Once they are all cooked and cooled , set aside until needed
12. Once the meat is cooked , remove from the tray and leave to stand
13. Pour off the excess fat
14. Place the oven tray on the stove , add the marmite , red wine and stock
15. Reduce , add half the butter and seasoning before passing through a sieve
16. Keep warm until needed
17. To serve , remove the roast potatoes and transfer to a serving dish
18. Reheat the vegetables in boiling salted water ,
19. Remove the crackling , break into pieces and carve the meat
20. Pour the gravy into a jug

title: peanut butter brownie cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Beat brownie mix , melted butter , cream cheese and egg with spoon until well blended
3. Drop dough by tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet to make 24 cookies
4. Place approximately 2 inches apart
5. In another bowl mix peanut butter and powdered sugar with spoon until mixture forms a ball
6. With hands , roll teaspoonfuls peanut butter mixture into 24 balls
7. Lightly press 1 ball into center of each ball of dough
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 10 to 14 minutes or until edges are set
9. Cool 1 minute
10. Remove from cookie sheets
11. Cool at least 30 minutes
12. Spread thin layer of frosting over peanut butter portion of each cooled cookie

title: easy eggplant  aubergine  sandwich
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f
2. Slice the eggplant into 15 pieces , brush with olive oil , place on cookie sheet , and sprinkle with salt
3. Bake for 25 minutes and let cool
4. Cut the baguette into thirds and slice in 1 / 2 for sandwiches
5. Slice green and red peppers , discarding stems and seeds
6. Slice the tomatoes and red onion and set aside
7. Mix goat and feta cheese together , set aside
8. In separate bowls place oregano , salt , pepper and olive oil
9. Spread goat and feta cheese mix on one side of baguette and brush other side lightly with olive oil
10. Spread 5 pieces of eggplant on baguette , generous amounts of red and green peppers , tomatoes , red onion , and cilantro
11. Lastly , sprinkle with oregano , salt , and pepper
12. Enjoy !

title: wonderful mushroom barley soup
steps:
1. Cut bacon into 1 / 4 in pieces
2. In a 6 oz or larger pot , put bacon , onion , and garlic
3. Stir once and a while , cooking for about 3 minute
4. Meanwhile , cut mushrooms in half
5. Add mushrooms and cook until the pot is almost dry , 5 min or so
6. Then add tomato paste and cook for 1 more minute
7. Now add broth , barley , oregano , and water
8. Bring everything to a boil , then reduce heat and simmer for 10 or 15 minutes , until barley is tender
9. If you wish , add more water to thin soup
10. At this time , add vinegar and salt and pepper
11. Serve

title: tomato  lemon  green olive   onion salad
steps:
1. Layer the sliced tomatoes with the onions , sprinkling with sugar , salt and cayenne pepper as you do
2. Grate the lemon zest and scatter over the tomatoes and onions , then squeeze the juice over the top
3. Garnish with the olives and drizzle with the olive oil
4. Chill until ready to serve

title: mediterranean veggie full soup
steps:
1. Heat oil in large soup pot over medium-high heat
2. Fry onions , stirring occasionally , until golden , 4 to 5 minutes
3. Meanwhile , blend tomatoes , turmeric , ginger , cinnamon , cilantro , parsley and saffron in blender
4. Add to onions , cover and bring to rolling boil over high heat
5. Lower heat to medium , add wheat berries and broth and cover tightly
6. Cook until wheat berries are fairly tender , 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours
7. Add lentils and garbanzo beans with liquid
8. Cover and cook until lentils are tender , 20 to 25 minutes
9. Ten minutes before serving , lower heat to simmer and season with salt and pepper to taste
10. Just before serving , beat egg with lemon juice in small bowl and add to soup , stirring with long wooden spoon until mixture forms strands
11. Ladle soup into individual soup bowls
12. Top with cilantro and serve immediately with lemon wedges and crusty bread

title: light chocolate mousse
steps:
1. Combine water and the gelatine in a jug
2. Whisk with a fork until the gelatine has been dissolved
3. Stir the cocoa into the gelatine mix
4. Set aside to cool for 10 minutes
5. In a large mixer bowl , beat the egg whites and cream of tartar until soft-peaks form
6. Slowly add the sugar and beat until thick and glossy
7. With the mixer on high speed add the egg yolks
8. Slowly pour the gelatine mix into the egg mixture
9. Beat constantly until well combined
10. Pour mixture into 6 serving cups and refrigerate for 4 hours or until set
11. Dust with some extra cocoa to serve or use some chocolate shavings if desired

title: cheese frittata with mushrooms and dill
steps:
1. In a medium bowl beat together eggs , cheese , water , salt , and pepper
2. In a 10-inch nonstick skillet melt margarine over medium-high heat
3. Add mushrooms and cook for 4 to 5 minutes or until liquid evaporates
4. Stir in green onions , parsley , and dill
5. Pour egg mixture over mushroom mixture
6. Cook uncovered over medium heat
7. As the egg mixture begins to set , run a spatula around edge of skillet , lifting egg mixture so uncooked portion flows underneath
8. Continue cooking and lifting edge until egg mixture is almost set
9. Remove from heat
10. Cover and let stand for 3 to 4 minutes or until top is set
11. Cut into wedges

title: four cheese baked ziti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Butter a 2 quart ovenproof casserole dish
3. Set aside
4. Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente
5. Drain
6. Meanwhile , bring half-and-half , basil , and crushed red pepper to a simmer in a heavy , large saucepan over medium high heat
7. Add cheeses 1 handful at a time , stirring constantly until cheeses are melted and smooth
8. Remove from heat , and stir in egg yolks
9. Season with salt and black pepper to taste
10. Mix in pasta
11. Spoon into prepared dish
12. Bake until heated through , approximately 10 minutes
13. Serve hot

title: stuffed lemon feta chicken breasts with tomatoes and spinach
steps:
1. Pound chicken breasts thin
2. Combine feta cheese , lemon juice and oregano and spread over chicken
3. Fold chicken to enclose filling and secure with a toothpick
4. Heat oil in a skillet until hot
5. Add chicken and cook until golden brown
6. Mix together chicken broth , tomato and spinach and add to skillet
7. Heat to boiling , reduce heat , cover and simmer for 8 to 10 minutes

title: east side new york half sour pickles
steps:
1. Fill a 1-gallon jar with cucumbers
2. Set aside
3. In a separate container , mix together water , salt , pickling spices , and garlic
4. Pour over cucumbers and then cover with waxed paper to keep cucumbers in the solution
5. Leave out for 2 weeks without refrigeration !

title: fillet of red snapper with coconut sauce
steps:
1. Sprinkle fillets with lime juice
2. In deep skillet , heat oil on medium
3. Stir in garlic , onion , celery , and cook for 10 minutes , stirring often
4. Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes
5. Stir in coconut milk , bouillon , and bay leaves
6. Bring to boil and simmer on low for 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
7. Stir in sliced tomatoes
8. Add fillets , skin side up , gently pushing them into the sauce
9. Simmer 5 minutes or until fish is cooked and flakes easily with a fork
10. Transfer to warm serving tray and keep warm
11. Continue to simmer sauce until it reaches the desired consistency
12. Ladle some sauce over fillets and serve remainder on the side accompanied with rice

title: spinach pakoras
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except oil and chutney together until well combined
2. Form into small balls that are about half the size of a golf ball
3. Put oil in a non stick skillet over medium high heat
4. Load the pan up with the pakoras , they can touch- but dont overcrowd !
5. Brown on all sides
6. Serve with mango chutney

title: cornish game hens with orange sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 500f
2. Prepare hens by rubbing mixture of salt and pepper into skin liberally
3. Place on cookie sheet , breast side up
4. Roast for 15 minutes at 500f
5. Remove from oven and turn breast down
6. Pour 1 1 / 2 cups water over hens
7. Turn oven down to 425f and continue to cook for 1 / 2 hour
8. Meanwhile , use a zester to obtain orange peel without cutting into pith of fruit
9. Slice oranges in half and squeeze juice
10. Place juice in saucepan with zest and heat thoroughly
11. Remove hens from oven and turn breast-side up and continue cooking for additional 1 / 2 hour
12. Blend cornstarch with orange juice / zest mixture and heat to thicken , stirring constantly
13. To serve: place hen on plate and pour sauce over
14. Sprinkle with additional orange zest and parsley

title: fruit salad with vanilla dressing
steps:
1. In a small mixing bowl whisk together the yogurt , mayonnaise , lemon juice , honey , vanilla extract and salt
2. Season with pepper , to taste
3. Set aside
4. Place all of the fruit and the nuts into a large mixing bowl and toss to combine
5. Add the dressing , toss and serve

title: one dish meal
steps:
1. In heavy teflon or non-stick sprayed skillet , brown meat and onion- drain well
2. Add potatoes , tomatoes and salt- cook 15 minutes
3. Add zucchini and simmer until potatoes and zucchini are tender- add water if needed
4. Serve sprinkled with parmesan , if desired

title: rotisserie rub
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a small bowl
2. This should be enough to cover one large roasting chicken
3. To use: spread evenly over chicken
4. For best results , allow the chicken to sit in the fridge overnight to absorb the flavors
5. Rotisserie or roast your chicken as needed based upon the size of the bird

title: chicken thighs with spicy orange sauce
steps:
1. To make the sauce: in a saucepan over medium heat , stir the sauce ingredients together until the sugar dissolves and the flavors are blended , about 1 minute
2. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
3. Place the chicken in a lightly sprayed or oiled 11 x 7 inch glass baking dish
4. Pour the sauce over the chicken
5. Cover and bake for 15 minutes
6. Uncover , baste with the sauce , and continue to bake , uncovered , until the chicken is cooked through , about 15 minutes longer
7. Pour the sauce into a small pan over medium heat
8. Blend the cornstarch and water and stir into the sauce
9. Stir until thickened , about 1 minute
10. Transfer the chicken to a plate and pour the sauce over it
11. Garnish with orange slices and parsley

title: shoulder of lamb with yoghurt and cardamom
steps:
1. Season the lamb with salt and fresh ground black pepper and make some deep cuts into it with a small sharp knife
2. Insert the garlic slivers into the cuts
3. Lightly crush the cardamom pods and remove the seeds , sprinkle over lamb and rub inches
4. Leave at room temp for at least 5 hours or overnight in the fridge
5. Preheat oven to 400f
6. Heat oil in a heavy based roasting tin add lamb and brown on all sides
7. Transfer to oven and roast for about 30 mins until well coloured
8. Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly , reduce oven temp to 325f
9. Put lemon juice and saffron in a small pan and heat gently , leave to cool
10. Mix with lemon zest , yoghurt and sugar and pour half this mix over the lamb
11. Return lamb to oven and cook , adding more lemon yoghurt every 30 mins or so , for about 21 / 2 to 3 hours until lamb is very tender and topped with a golden yoghurt crust
12. Allow to cool slightly before serving

title: three cheese pasta
steps:
1. In a large heavy skillet cook garlic and herbs in butter and oil over moderate heat , stirring , until garlic is softened but not browned
2. Remove skillet from heat
3. Add brandy and ignite , being careful as flames shoot up
4. Shake skillet gently until flames die out
5. Return skillet to moderate heat and stir in cream
6. Add cheeses , 1 at a time , stirring until each cheese melts before adding the next
7. Cook sauce at a bare simmer until thickened slightly , about 8 minutes
8. Keep sauce warm
9. In a kettle of boiling salted water cook pasta until al dente and reserve about 1 / 2 cup cooking water
10. Drain pasta well and in a bowl toss pasta with sauce and enough reserved cooking water to reach desired consistency

title: pork with pineapple salsa
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Drain pineapple , reserving 1 / 4 cup of juice
3. Set aside 1 cup of pineapple , save remaining pineapple for another use
4. Place tenderloin on rack in shallow roasting pan
5. Combine 2 tablespoons brown sugar , mustard , paprika , and ginger
6. Spread half of this over pork
7. Bake uncovered at 450f for 15 minutes
8. Spread with remaining brown sugar mixture after cooking for 15 minutes
9. Bake 15-20 minutes longer , or if you have a meat thermometer , until it reads 160 degrees
10. For the salsa , in a small bowl , combine red pepper , onion , and pepper flakes , and brown sugar
11. , and the 1 / 4 cup pineapple juice
12. , you may use the rest for another time
13. Let pork stand for 5 minutes before slicing

title: spicy white castle dip
steps:
1. Mix cream cheese and mustard together and spread on bottom of large , shallow serving dish
2. Spread onions evenly on top of mixture
3. Put burgers in food processor until blended and spread evenly over onions
4. Cut cheese into chunks , add milk and melt in microwave for 1-2 minutes
5. Stir until creamy
6. Pour cheese mixture over burgers
7. Sprinkle parsley flakes on top
8. Heat for 3-4 minutes on high in microwave or 20 minutes in oven
9. Serve with a large bag of tortilla chips

title: roasted citrus soy chicken wings
steps:
1. Combine the orange juice , soy sauce , garlic , sriracha , rice wine vinegar and sesame oil in a small bowl
2. Place the chicken wings in a self-sealing freezer bag and add the marinade
3. Press out all the air , seal and refrigerate for 6 to 24 hours , turning once or twice to ensure even flavor
4. Preheat the oven to 450f line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with nonstick spray
5. Arrange the chicken wings in a single layer , skin side down
6. Discard the remaining marinade
7. Roast the wings for 15 minutes , then turn skin side up
8. Baste with any juices that may have accumulated in the pan and roast for an additional 10 to 15 minutes , until the skin is golden and crisp and the chicken is cooked through
9. Serve with sweet chili sauce for dipping

title: delicious zucchini   rice
steps:
1. Cook rice according to package
2. In a separate saucepan , heat oil over medium heat
3. Saut onion , red pepper and garlic until tender
4. Add tomatoes and zucchini and season with salt , pepper and oregano
5. Reduce heat , cover and simmer 20 minutes , stirring occasionally
6. Serve zucchini mixture over the rice

title: jiffy cookies
steps:
1. Boil group 1 ingredients hard for 1 minute
2. Pour in group 2 ingredients stir well
3. Drop on wax paper and let cool completely
4. Enjoy !

title: chicken and sweet potato soup
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f / 200c
2. Rinse the chicken and pat dry
3. Season with salt and pepper and place skin side down in a roasting pan
4. Cook 30 to 35 minutes or until just done
5. Juices should run clear
6. Remove from the pan and cool until easy to handle
7. Remove the skin and discard
8. Pull the meat from the bones and shred into bite sized pieces
9. Melt the butter and olive oil together and add the onions and shallots
10. Cook and stir about 15 minutes until softened
11. Add the bell pepper and red chilli and continue to cook and stir about 5 minutes longer
12. Add the garlic and cook for another 2 to 3 minutes , stirring
13. Add the chicken broth , shredded chicken , sweet potatoes , tomatoes , dried marjoram leaves , bay leaves , salt and pepper and stir until combines
14. Bring to a low boil , then reduce the heat and simmer , uncovered , about 1 hour , until the potatoes are tender and flavours have developed
15. Skim any fat off the top as it cooks
16. Discard the bay leaves
17. Taste for seasoning , adding additional salt and pepper if needed
18. Serve in hot bowls with a dollop of sour cream on top of each
19. Sprinkle fresh herbs on top

title: banana crumble
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Evenly distribute bananas among 4 ramekins , lightly sprayed with pam
3. Place all dry ingredients in a medium mixing bowl , add the butter and work mixture with your hands till crumbly
4. Sprinkle over bananas , crumbling further with your fingers , enough to cover
5. Bake till crumble get firm and golden in color , about 10-12 minutes
6. Serve warm

title: lemon sugar cookie
steps:
1. Heat oven to 385 degrees fahrenheit
2. Blend together shortening , salt , lemon rind and sugar
3. Beat in egg and milk
4. Stir in all other ingredients
5. Squish a roughly teaspoon-to-tablespoon-size amount of the dough , which is coarse until squished , and place in rows on a greased baking sheet
6. For pizzazz , dust cookies with nutmeg or colored sugar
7. Bake 6-10 minute until light golden

title: pat s okie potato salad
steps:
1. Mix all the above prepared ingredients together
2. Place in casserole dish and sprinkle with paprika

title: freezer spaghetti sauce
steps:
1. Combine onion , garlic , green pepper and vegetable oil in pan
2. Cook until onion is transparent
3. In large pot add the chopped tomatoes , oregano , basil , parsley , sugar , salt , pepper and tomato paste
4. Cook for 2-3 hours on low heat stirring frequently
5. Let sauce cool
6. Pour sauce into quart size containers or freezer bags
7. Store in freezer
8. When preparing the sauce to eat

title: mushroom   rice bake
steps:
1. Bring water and 1 tsp salt to boil in a medium pan
2. Add rice and stir
3. Cover , reduce heat and let rice cook for 20 to 25 minutes till done and liquid is absorbed
4. Set aside
5. Saut onion and mushrooms in butter in a small skillet until tender
6. Remove from heat and set aside
7. Beat cream cheese in a small bowl with an electric mixer
8. Add eggs , beating well after each addition
9. Add rice , mushroom mixture , evaporated milk and salt
10. Stir well to combine

title: no oil carrot cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Beat sugar and eggs together in a large bowl until thick and pale
3. Stir flour , baking powder , baking soda and cinnamon together
4. Fold flour mixture into the egg mixture
5. Add carrots and nuts
6. Spoon batter into a greased tube or bundt pan and bake for 45 minutes or until tester comes out clean

title: layered pasta bake
steps:
1. Cook pasta in boiling salted water according to package directions
2. Drain
3. Toss pasta with oil
4. Spoon into a lightly greased 13x9 inch baking dish
5. Set aside
6. In a skillet over med-high heat , cook the beef , onion , and garlic for 5-6 minutes or until beef is browned , stirring to crumble beef
7. Drain and return to skillet
8. Add wine , spaghetti sauce , and next 3 ingredients to skillet
9. Bring to a boil
10. Decrease heat and simmer 10 minutes
11. Stir in teaspoon pepper
12. In a bowl , combine cottage cheese , cup parmesan cheese , cup mozzarella cheese , remaining teaspoon pepper , and eggs
13. Spoon mixture over the pasta
14. Spread beef mixture over the top
15. Sprinkle with remaining cup parmesan and cup mozzarella
16. Top with bread crumbs
17. Bake , uncovered , at 350 for 30 minutes or until bubbly

title: queen puff s vegetable beef soup
steps:
1. Cut stew beef meat into small pieces and brown in a large pot
2. Add tomato sauce and then use tomato sauce can to fill 4 cans full of water and add to pot to cover beef
3. Cook slowly at least 1 hour
4. Add veg-all , succotash , tomato soup and potatoes
5. Using tomato sauce or tomato soup can , fill can with water 4 times and add to pot
6. Add parsley , beef boullion cubes , onion powder , garlic powder , pepper , salt and bayleaf
7. Although not listed in ingredients , i also like to add 1 tablespoon of paula deen's house seasoning mix
8. Simmer 30 minutes
9. Remove bayleaf
10. Add noodles and cook 8 to 10 minutes

title: make your own instant cocoa mix   homemade substitute
steps:
1. Sift all ingredients together 3 times
2. Place in a tightly covered container and store in a cool place
3. Combine 1 / 3 cup mix with about 1 cup hot water to make one serving , or 1&1 / 3 cup of mix with 1 quart hot water to serve four

title: sassy southwest cheesecake
steps:
1. Combine crushed tortilla chips and 1 / 4 cup softened butter , and press into bottom of a lightly greased 9-inch springform pan
2. Bake at 350 for 12 minutes
3. Cool in pan on a wire rack
4. Beat cream cheese , shredded cheese , and salt at medium speed with an electric mixer 3 minutes or until fluffy
5. Add 1 container sour cream , beating until blended
6. Add eggs , 1 at a time , beating until blended after each addition
7. Stir in salsa and chiles
8. Pour over prepared crust
9. Bake at 350 for 40 minutes or until center is almost set
10. Remove pan from oven
11. Let stand 10 minutes on a wire rack
12. Gently run a knife around edge of pan to loosen sides
13. Remove sides of pan
14. Let cheesecake cool completely
15. Stir together remaining 2 containers sour cream until smooth
16. Spread evenly over top of cooled cheesecake
17. Cover and chill at least 3 hours or up to 1 day
18. Spread evenly with guacamole
19. Sprinkle with diced tomatoes before serving
20. Serve with tortilla chips

title: red  white and blue parfait
steps:
1. Cap strawberries , cut into bite-size pieces and place them in small mixing bowl
2. Sprinkle sugar over berries and stir
3. Use spoon to crush berries slightly so they will release juice
4. Set aside
5. Place cookies in zipper-top plastic bag and use rolling pin to crush them finely
6. Set aside
7. In small bowl or 2-cup measure , stir together 1 / 2 c of whipped topping and yogurt until well blended
8. Set aside
9. Divide cookie crumbs evenly in bottom of 4 parfait glasses or other dessert dishes
10. Spoon strawberry mixture evenly over crumbs
11. Spoon yogurt mixture evenly over strawberries
12. Divide blueberries evenly , and scatter them over yogurt mixture in each dish
13. The dishes may be served at once or covered with plastic wrap and refrigerated until ready to serve , up to 3 hours
14. Just before serving , dollop 1 tsp of whipped topping on top of each dish as a garnish

title: quick bread pizza
steps:
1. Combine tomatoes , basil , garlic , pepper and salt
2. Reserve
3. For the crust: combine flours with cornmeal , sugar , rosemary , salt , baking powder and baking soda
4. Stir together well
5. Combine yogurt with oil
6. Pour over dry ingredients and knead dough lightly into ball
7. Brush 15 x 10-inch baking dish lightly with oil
8. Press dough evenly into pan
9. Sprinkle half of mozzarella over dough
10. Drain tomato mixture and spread over cheese
11. Sprinkle with remaining mozzarella and parmesan
12. Bake in preheated 400f oven for 20 to 25 minutes , or until pizza is puffed and cheese is lightly browned
13. Cut into squares
14. Makes 8 servings
15. Bonnie stern simply heartsmart cooking

title: oven roasted pot roast with vegetables
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees
2. Heat oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat
3. Season roast with salt and pepper and add to the skillet
4. Brown on all sides before transferring it to a large roasting pan
5. Add the onions and mushrooms to the skillet , cook until softened and mushrooms are browned , scrapping up browned bits
6. Toss in the garlic and cook until fragrant , 15 30 seconds
7. Pour the tomato sauce and broth into the skillet , stir well , and allow bring to a boil
8. Stir in the salt and pepper
9. Add the rosemary , thyme , and bay leaves to the roasting pan with the roast
10. Arrange the potatoes , carrots , and celery around the meat in the pan
11. Pour the contents of the skillet over the roast and vegetables
12. Cover the roasting pan and transfer into the oven
13. Cook until a fork easily slides into the meat , about 3 to 3 hours
14. Remove sprigs and bay leaves before serving

title: kathie s zucchini muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Combine first 7 ingredients in large bowl
3. Stir with whisk
4. Combine zucchini , milk , oil , honey and egg in a small bowl
5. Stir until blended
6. Make a well in the center of dry ingredients
7. Add milk mixture , stirring until just moist
8. Spoon batter into 12 muffin cups that are coated with cooking spray or lined with paper liners
9. Combine 1 tablespoon sugar and 1 / 4 teaspoon cinnamon
10. Sprinkle over tops of muffins
11. Bake at 400 for 15 minutes
12. Remove from pans immediately
13. Cool on a wire rack
14. Enjoy !

title: smoked salmon spread  barefoot contessa  ina garten
steps:
1. Cream the cheese in an electric mixer fitted with a paddle attachment until just smooth
2. Add the sour cream , lemon juice , dill , horseradish , salt , and pepper , and mix
3. Add the smoked salmon and mix well
4. Chill and serve with crudites or crackers

title: chicken liver postej
steps:
1. Blend everything except the milk in a food processor
2. Pour into bowl and add the milk
3. Bake in ramekins in bain marie for 1-1 1 / 2 hour at 300f convection until set as a loaf
4. Serve warm
5. Can be frozen

title: spiced peach and blueberry jam
steps:
1. Peel and pit peaches
2. Force through coarse blade of food chopper
3. Wash and pick over berries
4. Combine with peaches in kettle , add water , and bring to boil
5. Cover , and simmer for 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
6. Add sugar and salt
7. Tie spices in a cheesecloth bag and add
8. Bring to boil slowly , stirring until sugar dissolves
9. Boil rapidly for 10 minutes , or until fruit is clear
10. Remove spice bag
11. Ladle into hot sterilized jars , and seal
12. Makes six 8-oz
13. Jars

title: grilled rib eyes and fried onion rings
steps:
1. Pour the buttermilk into a large bowl
2. Add onion rings , toss to coat
3. Let stand one hour , tossing occassionally
4. Drain
5. Mix flour , onion powder , garlic salt and pepper in a large bowl
6. Add onion rings and toss to coat
7. Preheat oven to 350-degrees f
8. Prepare grill
9. Brush steaks with oil and sprinkle with garlic salt , onion powder and pepper
10. Pour oil in cast iron skillet to a depth of 2-3 inches and heat oil over medium high heat until oil is about 350-degrees f
11. Working with a few onion rings at a time , fry onion rings for 2-3 minutes
12. Drain on paper towels and then put on cookie sheet to keep warm in the preheated oven
13. Repeat until all are fried and drained and kept warm in oven
14. While cooking onion rings grill steaks to desired doneness

title: szechuan tuna steaks for the george foreman grill
steps:
1. Place tuna in single layer in large shallow glass dish
2. Combine soy sauce , vineger , sugar , water , sesame oil , hot chili oil and garlic in small bowl
3. Reserve 1 / 4 cup mixture and keep at room temperature
4. Pour remaining sauce over tuna steaks , cover and refrigerate 40 minutes , turning once
5. Preheat grill 5 minutes
6. Drain tuna and discard marinade
7. Spray both sides of grill with cooking spray
8. Grill 7 minutes , or until tuna is opaque , but still feels somewhat soft in center
9. Cut each tuna steak into thin slices and fan out onto serving platter
10. Drizzle tuna slices with reserved sauce and sprinkle with cilantro

title: creamy pumpkin coffee
steps:
1. Combine the milk , sugar , pumpkin puree , vanilla , nutmeg , cinnamon and ginger in a blender on high speed , creating a frothy consistency
2. Pour into a saucepan and heat until just hot but not boiling
3. Pour hot coffee into mug and top with hot spiced milk

title: golden sunflower seed wheat bread
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , add warm water and yeast
2. Cover and let activate for 10 minutes
3. Add bread flour , canola oil , agave , salt and 4 cups of whole wheat flour to the yeast mixture
4. Mix thoroughly
5. Mix in sunflower seeds
6. Slowly add whole wheat flour one cup at a time until you reach a firm dough
7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and knead for 5-8 minutes until smooth and elastic
8. Place in a greased bowl , turning once to grease the top
9. Cover and let rise in a lightly warmed oven for 1 hour or until doubled in size
10. Punch down the dough and divide into either two greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pans , or three greased 8 x 4-inch loaf pans
11. I like to put parchment on the very bottom of my pans for ease of turning out the loaves
12. Cover the loaves and let rise in a warm place for an additional 30 mins or until doubled in size
13. Bake at 350f degrees for 35 minutes , then brush on melted butter and continue to bake for 5 minutes more or until lightly browned
14. Remove from oven and brush on remaining melted butter
15. Turn out from pans and place on a wire rack to cool completely before cutting and serving

title: achari chicken
steps:
1. Heat oil in a wok and gently saute onion until tender
2. Turn down the heat , add garlic and ginger and briefly saute , continually stirring
3. Add turmeric , chilli powder , ground cumin , coriander and pepper
4. Cook to toast
5. Then toss in tomato and briefly cook
6. Add chicken and cook
7. When chicken is almost ready , stir in yoghurt and briefly cook
8. Then add green chillies , mango powder , salt , mustard oil and fenugreek
9. Serve with steamed rice and your favourite indian bread on the side

title: cool kiss
steps:
1. Combine schnapps , liqueur , and juice in a mixing glass
2. Add ice , shake , and pour contents into a collins or highball glass
3. Top with club soda and stir gently

title: sangria con tequila
steps:
1. Boil the sugar and water together in a small saucepan until the sugar dissolves and the liquid is clear
2. Set the syrup aside to cool
3. In a large pitcher or punch bowl , mix together the sugar syrup , wine , juices , and liquors
4. Just before serving time , stir in the sparkling water
5. Add the fruit slices and a lot of ice either to the sangria or to the individual glasses or cups
6. Serve chilled

title: man burgers  half pound hamburgers
steps:
1. In large bowl , combine ground beef , liquid smoke and barbecue seasoning
2. Mix well
3. Divide the mixture into 8 equally sized balls
4. With your hands , flatten the ball and gradually mold into patties
5. Form into large patties , slightly larger in diameter than the buns
6. As the hamburgers cook , they will shrink to the right diameter for the buns
7. Grill until done
8. Top with cheese slices
9. Toast hamburger buns on grill until golden brown
10. Build hamburgers with preferred toppings
11. Enjoy !

title: southwestern breakfast casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Follow the directions on the muffin mix box for the corn bread
3. Let the corn bread cool completely and once cooled cut the bread into 1 cubes and place on the bottom of a greased 9x13 baking dish
4. Sprinkle the bacon , diced tomatoes , corn and green onions on top of the cubed bread
5. With a electric mixer , beat the eggs and milk at medium speed for 3 minutes until frothy and stir in the spices
6. Pour egg mixture on top of other ingredients
7. Cook hash browns on stove top just until browned
8. Add on top of egg mixture and top with shredded pepper jack cheese
9. Bake for 45 minutes

title: candie s bakery style crumb coffee cake
steps:
1. Mix together in a large bowl flour , sugar , baking powder , salt
2. And set aside 2 cups of this mixture for the topping
3. Add butter , eggs and milk and mix well
4. Grease and flour a 13-inch rectangle baking pan
5. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
6. For topping: take the 2 cups of reserved flour mixture and add to the butter , brown sugar , cinnamon and salt
7. Mix together with your fingers until blended and lumps begin to form when you squeeze the mixture making small pea-sized crumbs
8. We love huge crumbs on ours , so i squeeze handfuls of the mixture and let the big pieces drop off onto the cake batter and cover the surface with smaller ones as i empty the bowl
9. Cover the entire cake with crumbly mixture
10. Bake for 30 minutes
11. When cooled , dust with confectioner's sugar

title: green curry chicken meatballs
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix all ingredients except oil together using your hands
2. With damp hands , roll about 2 teaspoons of mix into a bowl
3. Place on a large plate , cover and refrigerate 30 minutes
4. Fill a wok or saucepan 1 / 3 full with oil: heat over medium heat until hot
5. Cook chicken balls 4-5 minutes or until golden and cooked through
6. Drain on kitchen paper
7. Allow the oil to come back to temperature before continuing with another batch

title: shrimp wheels
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 f degrees
2. Combine the first 5 ingredients
3. Unroll and separate crescents into 4 rectangles
4. Spread 1 / 4 of the shrimp mix on each rectangle
5. Roll up jelly role fashion
6. Using a sharp knife , cut each roll into 10 slices
7. Place on a greased baking sheet and bake 10-12 minutes or until golden brown
8. Serve hot

title: beer can chicken with memphis rub
steps:
1. Remove and discard the fat just inside the body cavities of the chicken
2. Remove the package of giblets , and set aside for another use
3. Rinse the chicken , inside and out , under cold running water , then drain and blot dry , inside and out , with paper towels
4. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of the rub inside the body and neck cavities , then rub another 1 tablespoon all over the skin of the bird
5. If you wish , rub another 1 / 2 tablespoon of the mixture between the flesh and the skin
6. Cover and refrigerate the chicken while you preheat the grill
7. Set up the grill for indirect grilling placing a drip pan in the center
8. If using a charcoal grill , preheat it to medium
9. If using a gas grill , place all the wood chips in the smoker box and preheat the grill to high
10. Then , when smoke appears , lower the heat to medium
11. Pop the tab on the beer can
12. Using a "church key" style can opener , make 6 or 7 holes in the top of the can
13. Pour out the top inch of beer , then spoon the remaining dry rub through the holes into the beer
14. Holding the chicken upright , with the opening of the body cavity down , insert the beer can into the cavity
15. When ready to cook , if using charcoal , toss half the wood chips on the coals
16. Oil the grill grate
17. Stand the chicken up in the center of the hot grate , over the drip pan
18. Spread out the legs to form a sort of tripod , to support the bird
19. Cover the grill and cook the chicken until fall-off-the-bone tender , 2 hours
20. If using charcoal , add 10 to 12 fresh coals per side and the remaining wood chips after 1 hour
21. Using tongs , lift the bird to a cutting board or platter , holding the metal spatula underneath the beer can for support
22. Let stand for 5 minutes before carving the meat off the upright carcass
23. Memphis rub:
24. Combine all the ingredients in a jar , twist the lid on airtight , and shake to mix
25. Store away from heat or light for up to six months
26. Makes about 1 / 2 cup
27. Enough for 4 to 6 racks of ribs
28. Indirect grilling on a charcoal grill:
29. To set up you grill for indirect grilling , light the coals
30. When they are blazing red , use tongs to transfer them to opposite sides of the grill , arranging them in two piles
31. Some grills have special half-moon-shaped baskets to hold the coals at the sides
32. Others have wire fences that hook onto the bottom gate
33. Let the coals burn until they are covered with a thin layer of gray ash
34. Set the drip pan in the center of the grill , between the mounds of coals
35. Place the food on the grate over the drip pan , and cover the grill
36. You'll need to add about 10 to 12 fresh briquettes to each side after an hour of cooking
37. If you want to add a smoke flavor , add 1 to 2 cups of presoaked wood chips , or 2 to 4 chunks , to the coals just before you start to cook , and again whenever you replenish the coals

title: lemon crumb bars  extraordinaire
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray 9x12 baking dish with cooking spray
3. In mixing bowl combine cake mix , sliced butter , egg and lemon zest
4. Use pastry cutter or 2 knifes to combine until crumbly
5. Work in the cracker crumbs
6. Remove 2 cups for topping
7. Press remainder over the bottom of prepared pan
8. Bake for 18-20 minutes until edges are lightly browned
9. Remove from oven , but do not turn the oven off
10. In small mixing bowl combine condensed milk , lemon juice and egg yolks
11. Pour over the crust and sprinkle with reserved crumbs
12. Return to oven
13. Bake 20-25 more minutes until lightly brown around the edges
14. Cool on wire rack
15. Cut into 24 bars
16. Store in refrigerator

title: chorizo with dates and bacon
steps:
1. Layout the bacon and par cook in the oven for about 5 minutes
2. Do not allow to brown
3. Remove and allow to cool
4. Slice the sausage into 16 slices about 3 / 8 inch thick
5. Near the top of each slice of bacon place a slice of sausage and top with of a date
6. Roll the bacon around the sausage and date , secure with a toothpick and cut off any excess bacon
7. Place on jellyroll pan and bake at 375 degrees until the bacon is fully cooked , about 10 minutes

title: bread machine coconut bread
steps:
1. Measure into your bread machine as per it's instructions
2. Cook on the sweet , white timer
3. This makes a 1 1 / 2 lb loaf

title: banana mandarin cream cheese pie
steps:
1. In large mixer bowl , beat cream cheese until fluffy
2. Gradually beat in condensed milk until smooth
3. Stir in 1 / 3 cup lemon juice and vanilla
4. Slice 2 bananas
5. Dip in lemon juice and drain
6. Line crust with bananas and about two-thirds of the orange segments
7. Pour filling over fruit
8. Chill 3 hours or until set
9. Before serving , slice remaining banana
10. Dip in lemon juice and drain
11. Garnish top with banana slices and remaining orange segments

title: ham and cheese arancini  italian fried rice balls
steps:
1. Saute onion in 1 t butter over medium heat until translucent and beginning to brown
2. Remove from heat and allow to cool
3. In a bowl lightly beat 2 eggs
4. Stir in cooked rice , ham , melted butter , parmesan cheese , sauteed onion , seasoned salt , garlic salt , parsley and pepper
5. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes
6. Roll into 1-1 / 2-inch balls
7. And press a cheese cube into each ball , reshaping around the cheese
8. Place the flour into a small bowl
9. Whisk 2 eggs in a second small bowl
10. Place the dry breadcrumbs in a third small bowl
11. Dip each ball into flour , then into the egg and then into the breadcrumbs
12. Heat oil to 375 degrees , then fry rice balls until golden brown
13. You can also shallow fry them in oil , turning to brown
14. Drain on paper towels and enjoy ! they are nice dipped in french onion dip , ranch dip or all on their own

title: american style vanilla biscotti
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f lightly grease one large baking sheet
2. In a medium-sized bowl , beat the butter , sugar , salt , vanilla , and baking powder until the mixture is smooth and creamy
3. Beat in the eggs
4. The batter may look slightly curdled
5. At low speed of your mixer , add the flour , stirring until smooth
6. The dough will be sticky
7. Plop the dough onto the prepared baking sheet
8. Shape it into a log thats about 14" long x 2 " wide x " thick
9. Straighten the log , and smooth its top and sides
10. A wet spatula or wet bowl scraper works well here
11. Bake the dough for 25 minutes
12. Remove it from the oven , and allow it to cool on the pan anywhere from 10 to 25 minutes
13. Just work it into the schedule of whatever else youre doing in the kitchen
14. Using a spray bottle filled with room-temperature water , lightly but thoroughly spritz the log , making sure to cover the sides as well as the top
15. Softening the crust just this little bit will make slicing the biscotti much easier
16. Reduce the oven temperature to 325f wait another 5 minutes , then use a serrated knife to cut the log crosswise into 1&#8260
17. 2" to 3&#8260
18. 4" slices
19. Or cut the biscotti on the diagonalfor fewer , longer biscotti
20. As youre slicing , be sure to cut straight up and down , perpendicular to the pan
21. If you cut unevenly , biscotti may be thicker at the top than the bottom , and theyll topple over during their second bake
22. Set the biscotti on edge on the prepared baking sheet
23. Return the biscotti to the oven , and bake them for 25 to 30 minutes , till they feel very dry and are beginning to turn golden
24. Theyll still feel a tiny bit moist in the very center , if you break off a piece
25. But theyll continue to dry out as they cool
26. Remove the biscotti from the oven , and transfer them to a rack to cool
27. Variations: add up to 2 cups nuts , dried fruit , or chips to the dough , along with the flour
28. Adjust the spice to suit the add-in , if desired
29. E
30. G
31. , add 1 teaspoon cinnamon with 1 cup chopped dried apple and 1 cup diced pecans
32. Or substitute hazelnut , butter-rum , or your favorite flavor for the vanilla
33. A classic italian anise biscotti is made with 1 / 2 teaspoon anise extract , and 1 tablespoon fennel seeds

title: saucy green beans and potatoes  crock pot
steps:
1. In a 3-1 / 2- or 4-quart slow cooker combine potatoes and green beans
2. In a medium bowl stir together soup , water , mustard , and dillweed
3. Pour over vegetables in cooker
4. Stir gently to combine
5. Cover and cook on low-heat setting for 6 to 8 hours or on high-heat setting for 3 to 4 hours
6. Stir gently before serving

title: sukiyaki   one pot recipe
steps:
1. Wipe konbu with a damp cloth
2. Place water in a saucepan and soak the konbu for 30 minutes then heat
3. As soon as the water begins to bubble and just before boiling , remove the konbu
4. Do not over cook
5. Add dried bonito flakes
6. As soon as the water comes to a boil turn off the heat
7. Allow the bonito flakes to settle to the bottom of the pan
8. Strain broth through a cheese cloth
9. Discard konbu and bonito flakes
10. Preparation mix all ingredients for the cooking broth and bring to a boil
11. Pour into a container and set on the dining table along with the platter of vegetables and meat
12. Heat a tablespoon of vegetable oil in the skillet
13. Add the beef , chicken and / or shrimp spreading the thin slices , lightly brown
14. Mix in a small of amount of cooking broth
15. Push beef , chicken and / or shrimp to one side of the pan
16. Add a portion of the other ingredients from the platter in the pan in a decorative bundled manner
17. The key to cooking this dish is to keep 1 / 4" broth in the pan at all times
18. Add cooking broth as it boils off
19. Cook for 5 to 10 minutes until done , stir well
20. Serve immediately over noodles or rice

title: garlic crusted pork loin with mashed acorn squash
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. Lightly oil a rimmed baking sheet
3. Set aside
4. Finely chop garlic
5. Sprinkle with coarse salt
6. Holding a chef's knife almost parallel to cutting board , repeatedly smear garlic with blade until a paste forms
7. Place pork in center of baking sheet
8. Rub all over with olive oil and garlic paste
9. Season with salt and pepper
10. Arrange squash halves , cut side down around pork
11. Roast pork until instant read thermometer reads 145 when inserted into thickest part of meat
12. Around 35-40 minutes
13. Transfer to cooling rack and let sit for 10 minutes
14. Meanwhile , holding hot squash with a kitchen towel , scrape out flesh into medium bowl
15. Add sour cream and brown sugar
16. Season with salt and pepper , and mash with fork to combine
17. Thinly slice pork , and serve with mashed squash , sprinkled with brown sugar

title: rosemary s creamy low fat chicken soup
steps:
1. Fill large soup pot 2 / 3 full of water , should be around 12 cups
2. Add chicken , cover and bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat to a slow simmer
4. Add garlic cloves & carrots , 1 cup onion , 1 / 4 cup fresh rosemary , 1 tbsp dried italian herb blend , 2 tsp dried thyme , 2 tsp garlic powder , 2 tsp onion powder , bay leaves , salt and white pepper
5. Cover pot and slowly simmer for 1-2 hours , stirring occasionally
6. Remove cooked chicken breasts quickly slice lengthwise with a knife , and then shred the meat with a fork
7. Return meat and juices to pot
8. Add potatoes , corn , and rest of herbs & seasonings
9. Cover pot and slowly simmer until potatoes are cooked through and soft , about 15 minutes
10. Wisk together milk , sour cream and cornstarch in a separate bowl
11. Make sure cornstarch is dissolved fully
12. Add milk mixture to soup pot , along with the last pinch of fresh rosemary
13. Stir slowly but continuously , uncovered , over low heat just until it reaches a boil
14. Turn heat off and recover pot , allow to stand for 10 minutes
15. Serve and enjoy the goodness !

title: tangy roast pepper   walnut dip
steps:
1. In a pan , heat the ground cumin and paprika in the olive oil until fragrant
2. Combine the rest of the ingredients in a food processor , then season with salt and pepper
3. With the motor running , slowly pour in the spiced olive oil until incorporated
4. Add a tbsp of water if it's too thick
5. Scoop into a bowl and serve with freshly ground black pepper and paprika on top

title: fettuccine with vegetable ribbons
steps:
1. Make the cilantro sauce: put the cilantro , olive oil , pine nuts , garlic , and salt and pepper to taste into a food processor and work until smooth
2. Fold in the grated cheese
3. Cut the zucchini and carrots into wide ribbons
4. Cook the fettucine in a large saucepan of boiling salted water for 8 minutes
5. Add the zucchini and carrots to the pan of fettucine and cook for 1-2 minutes , until the pasta and vegetables are just tender
6. Drain the fettucine and vegetables thoroughly and return to the saucepan
7. Add the cilantro sauce and toss over high heat to warm through completely
8. Taste for seasoning and serve
9. Enjoy !

title: peanutty noodles  cooking light
steps:
1. Shave carrots lengthwise into strips using a vegetable peeler
2. Heat 1 teaspoon oil in a small saucepan over medium heat
3. Add ginger and garlic , saute for 30 seconds
4. Add broth and next 5 ingredients , and stir until well blended
5. Reduce heat , and simmer for 7 minutes , stirring occasionally
6. Remove from heat and keep warm
7. Heat 2 teaspoons oil in a large non-stick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium heat
8. Add bell peppers and snow peas , saute 5 minutes or until tender
9. Remove from heat
10. Combine carrot , peanut butter mixture , bell pepper mixture in a large bowl , and toss well
11. Sprinkle with cilantro
12. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: z  best two faced jerk
steps:
1. Day or afternoon before:
2. Mix up jerk
3. Make all three to give your family a choice of mild , spicy / hot or spicy / sweet
4. Important
5. To mix , just combine all ingredients and blend well
6. Whisk the ones with liquid ingredients with a fork
7. Up to 4 hours ahead:
8. Marinade chicken:
9. In a large glass baking dish , pour lime juice over chicken pieces
10. Turn to coat
11. Add a bit salt & pepper to taste
12. Coat chicken pieces on both sides with jerk of choice
13. Cover dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 2 to 4 hours
14. Prepare zesty salad dressing:
15. In a blender , add yogurt , dijon mustard , cilantro , garlic , lime juice , white wine vinegar , black pepper and chopped jalapeo pepper
16. Blend until mixed well
17. Put into a jar , cover and refrigerate
18. Shake before using
19. Prepare creamy chutney dressing:
20. Combine all ingredients in a small bowl and mix well
21. Cover and refrigerate
22. Up to 2 hours ahead:
23. Soak wooden skewers at least one hour before using
24. Up to one hour ahead:
25. Skewers:
26. Thread each skewer with half slice pineapple , 1 half jalapeo pepper , 1 wedge of sweet onion , 1 half jalapeo pepper , 1 chunk of mango , 1 wedge green pepper
27. Lay on a plate , cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until cooking time
