28. Turn on grill to heat up
29. Prepare green salad:
30. Toss together baby greens , grape tomatoes , chopped mango , green onions and cashews
31. Mix with zesty dressing just before serving
32. Grilling time:
33. Arrange chicken breasts on grill , basic first , then spicy , then sweet - so you don't forget which is which ! leave room for your six skewers
34. Cook chicken 7 to 8 minutes on each side , until cooked through
35. After flipping , place skewers on grill and cook those about 4 minutes each side
36. To serve - place chicken on plate alongside dressed green salad
37. Place skewers on top
38. Drizzle chicken and skewers with a bit of recipe #233518
39. Serve with crusty bread and a crisp & fruity dry white wine

title: steak with red peppers and sun dried tomatoes
steps:
1. Broil red pepper 6-inches from heat until skin blisters and blackens
2. Steam in plastic bag for 10 minutes
3. Peel off skin , discarding stem and seeds
4. Rinse and pat dry
5. Dice and set aside or use one 4-oz jar roasted peppers , diced
6. In a food processor puree ricotta , cream and garlic until smooth
7. In a saucepan over low heat cook the diced sun-dried tomatoes and red pepper for 3-5 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. Blend in ricotta mixture
9. Cook 5 more minutes , stirring occasionally
10. Stir 1 1 / 2 tablespoons into ricotta sauce
11. Meanwhile while sauce is cooking , grill steaks to desired doneness
12. Transfer steaks to a plates and serve sauce with steaks
13. Top with whole sun-dried tomato and basil

title: parmezano sprinkles vegan
steps:
1. Grind almonds or sesame seeds to a fine powder in a coffee grinder
2. Move to a food processor and add remaining ingredients and pulse until all is well incorporated
3. I sometimes use red miso , it's good too
4. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator
5. Will keep for a month or longer in the fridge
6. Also may be frozen
7. This can easily be doubled or quadrupled

title: gluten free bannock
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine flour , molasses , powder , and salt
2. Cut in butter until it is in tiny pieces
3. Add potatoes and stir well
4. Pour in milk and stir with a fork to form a ball
5. Turn out onto working surface and knead 10 times
6. Divide into 4 equal portions and pat down to 1" thickness
7. Bake in a preheated 400 oven for about 25-30 minutes until brown
8. Cut into wedges , slices , or simply pull off pieces of the round
9. Enjoy !

title: cherry cider
steps:
1. Combine cider and cinnamon stick in a saucepan and bring to a boil
2. Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes
3. Add gelatin
4. Cook , stirring constantly , 2 minutes or until gelatin is dossolved
5. Serve warm

title: spicy red rice with chicken and vegetables
steps:
1. Heat oil in heavy large pot , over medium-high heat
2. Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper
3. Add chicken , bell peppers , onion , garlic and oregano to pot
4. Saute 5 minutes , then mix in paprika and cayenne pepper
5. Add rice and stir to coat
6. Mix in broth and tomatoes , and bring to a boil
7. Cover pot
8. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until chicken and rice are tender and liquids are absorbed , adding more liquid by 1 / 4 cupfuls if dry , about 25 minutes
9. Season to taste with salt and pepper and serve

title: german potato dumplings
steps:
1. Mix the mashed potatoes together with the flour
2. Don't knead , because the dumplings will "sink"
3. Shape the dough into small balls
4. Place in a kettle of boiling salted water
5. Once they rise to the surface , let them cook for 10 minutes
6. Drain and sprinkle with fresh parsley
7. Serve as side dish

title: braised broccoli with garlic  anchovies   wine
steps:
1. Put oil into a skillet that has a lid , turn heat to medium and saute the garlic& anchovies , stir occasionally 3-5 minutes or until the anchovies begin to break up and the garlic begins to color add broccoli , stirring for 3-4 minutes , add wine and let it simmer for about a minute cover , turn heat to medium low and cook for 2-3 minutes
2. Uncover turn heat to medium and continue cooking until the wine has evaporated apprx 5 minutes season
3. Serve hot or at room temperature

title: no bake honey   oat peanut butter bars
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients , except chocolate chips , until well mixed
2. Spread evenly on a cookie sheet
3. Sprinkle with chocolate chips or seeds
4. Cut into squares
5. Freeze for 20 minutes , then store in airtight container in the refrigerator

title: chilled cucumber  avocado and shrimp soup
steps:
1. Cut the avocado in half and remove the pit
2. Wrap half the avocado in plastic wrap and set aside
3. Peel the other half of the avocado , then cut it into chunks
4. Place the avocado , cucumber , broth , yogurt , lime juice and salt in the bowl of a blender
5. Process until smooth and creamy
6. Transfer the mixture to a bowl and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or until very cold
7. To serve , peel and dice the remaining avocado half
8. Stir the avocado into the soup along with the diced shrimp
9. Ladle the soup into 4 bowls , sprinkle with green onions and float a single shrimp on top of each

title: awesome lasagna  no boil  easy
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. In large pan , brown italian sausage
3. Drain
4. Add spaghetti sauce , diced tomatoes , water , garlic and italian seasoning
5. Cover and simmer for 10-15 minutes
6. In medium bowl , combine ricotta , 2 cups of the mozzarella , parmesan , eggs , parsley and pepper
7. Mix well
8. Pour about 1 cup of the sauce on bottom of 9x13 pan
9. Arrange 3 uncooked lasagna noodles over sauce
10. Cover with about 1 cup sauce
11. Spread 1 / 2 the cheese filling over sauce
12. Repeat layers of lasagna , sauce and cheese filling
13. Top with layer of lasagna and remaining sauce
14. Sprinkle with remaining 1 cup mozzarella cheese
15. Cover with foil and bake at 350 for 45 minutes
16. Remove foil
17. Bake an additional 15 minutes
18. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting

title: easy gyro pizza
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425f spray 13x9-inch pan with cooking spray
2. Press pizza dough in bottom and slightly up sides of pan to form crust
3. Bake about 7 minutes or until crust just begins to turn brown on edges
4. Meanwhile , in 6-inch skillet , cook turkey and garlic over medium-high heat 5 to 7 minutes , stirring occasionally , until turkey is no longer pink
5. Stir in oregano and salt
6. Spread sour cream over warm crust
7. Sprinkle with 1 cup of the mozzarella cheese
8. Evenly top cheese with cooked turkey
9. Sprinkle with cucumber and tomato
10. Separate red onion into rings
11. Arrange over tomato
12. Sprinkle with remaining 1 / 2 cup mozzarella cheese and the feta cheese
13. Bake 13 to 14 minutes or until edges of crust are golden brown and cheese is melted

title: no cook chocolate fudge
steps:
1. Melt chocolate in top of double boiler over hot water
2. Beat the cream cheese until smooth
3. Add powdered sugar gradually , creaming well
4. Add melted chocolate
5. Blend
6. Add vanilla , salt and nuts
7. Mix well
8. Press into a buttered 9x13" pan or line pan with waxed paper
9. Chill in refrigerator until firm , about 15 minutes
10. Cut into pieces

title: mexican cheese grits souffle
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Stir grits into boiling water
3. Add salt
4. Cook 10 to 20 minutes , stirring frequently , until grits are thickened
5. Remove from heat
6. Add cheese , stirring until melted
7. Saute' onion and garlic in butter
8. Add to grits
9. Stir in peppers
10. Add a small amount of hot grits to egg yolks , stirring well
11. Add egg yolk mixture to grits , mixing well
12. Beat egg whites until stiff
13. Fold into grits
14. Spoon mixture into a greased 2-qt
15. Casserole
16. Bake at 350 for 45-50 minutes

title: fragrant cinnamon pork with sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Cut the pork into 1-1 / 2-inch cubes
2. Heat the oil until very hot in a 4-quart casserole or a dutch oven with a lid
3. Add half the pork pieces
4. Sear the outside of half the pork over high heat until brown , turning once
5. Remove and sear the remaining meat
6. Set aside
7. Reheat the pan and oil , add the seasonings
8. Stir-fry until fragrant , about 15 seconds , then add the braising mixture
9. Reduce the heat to low , cover , and let simmer for 20 minutes
10. Add the pork , bring the liquid to a boil , and reduce the heat to low
11. Let simmer , covered , for 35 to 40 minutes
12. Add the sweet potatoes , stir , cover , and continue cooking for about 25 minutes , or until the potatoes are tender
13. Serve the pork and potatoes atop a bed of blanched or steamed greens , with some of the braising mixture spooned on top and accompanied by steamed rice
14. It is considered to be especially soothing to the stomach

title: shrimp and artichokes over parmesan grits
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add onion and artichoke hearts and saute 5 minutes
3. Add one cup chicken broth , shrimp and garlic and saute 6 minutes
4. Add oregano , zest , juice , salt and pepper
5. Remove from heat
6. Cover and keep warm
7. Bring 2 1 / 2 cups chicken broth to a boil in a medium saucepan
8. Slowly stir in grits
9. Reduce heat to low
10. Cook 7 minutes or until thick and creamy , stirring occasionally
11. Stir in cheese
12. Spoon 1 / 2 cup grits into each of 4 bowls
13. Top each with 1 cup shrimp mixture

title: white bean  tuna and tomato salad
steps:
1. Flake tuna into a medium-size bowl
2. Add next six ingredients
3. Drizzle dressing over all and toss gently to mix
4. Spoon onto lettuce leaves and top with chopped egg , if desired
5. Serves 4

title: jazzed up ham noodle  and swiss cheese casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Prepare egg noodles , as directed on package , in a large dutch oven
3. Drain when done
4. While the noodles are boiling , melt margarine in a skillet , over medium high heat
5. Stir in flour until thickened
6. Slowly add half-n-half and chicken broth
7. Stir to prevent lumps
8. Add swiss cheese , dry mustard , salt , and pepper
9. Stir constantly
10. When the sauce thickens , turn heat to low
11. To the dutch oven containing the cooked noodles , add the ham , bacon , cooked sauce , and ranch dressing mix
12. Mix well and pour into a large rectangular baking dish
13. Cover with french fried onions
14. Bake for 20 minutes

title: lime and mint chicken
steps:
1. Bring a medium sized saucepan of water to the boil
2. Drop the beans into the boiling water with a pinch of salt
3. Boil for 2-3 minutes until the beans are just tender
4. Discard the chicken skin and any fat and tear bite-size pieces off the bone
5. Season the shredded chicken , with salt and pepper
6. Pour the lime juice into a bowl and whisk with olive oil until thick
7. Stir the beans into the dressing and then add the tomatoes , chicken , mint and chives
8. Toss and leave to sit for a few minutes , until the flavours meld together
9. Toss again and eat

title: harry s zucchini ginger marmalade
steps:
1. Squeeze the juice from the fruit then shred the peels , remove the pith from peel before shredding put all the ingredients , including juice into a large pot , sprinkle in the gelatin
2. Bring to a boil and simmer for at least an hour
3. Ladle into sterilized pint jars
4. Seal , if not sealed water bath for 10 minutes

title: brown sugar squares
steps:
1. Beat crust ingredients together until crumbly
2. Press mixture into a 9x13 baking pan
3. Bake for 20 minutes at 350 degrees
4. In a separate bowl , combine eggs , brown sugar , vanilla and chopped nuts
5. Pour over baked crust base and bake another 20 minutes
6. Cut into squares when cool

title: strawberries and nutella
steps:
1. Wash strawberries and pat dry
2. Remove caps and center 'stem'
3. Pipe 1 teaspoon of nutella into each strawberry

title: orange cinnamon biscuits
steps:
1. Combine flour , baking powder and salt
2. Cut in shortening
3. Add 1-2 teaspoons orange zest to milk , stir
4. Stir milk mixture into flour mixture with fork just until dough leaves sides of bowl , dough might be slightly sticky
5. Roll dough out , on lightly floured surface , into a 1 / 4 inch thick rectangle
6. Brush top with butter
7. Combine 1 teaspoons orange zest and sugar , stir to distribute the zest , mix in cinnamon
8. Sprinkle evenly over dough
9. Roll up , starting on long side
10. Cut into 1 / 2 inch thick rounds
11. Place rounds , with sides just touching , in greased 9" round pan
12. Bake at 425f for 18-20 minutes or until golden brown
13. Remove from oven , cool for about 10 minutes and drizzle with glaze , serve warm

title: citrus marinated chicken
steps:
1. Place the chicken in a nonmetallic dish
2. Mix the remaining ingredients together in a bowl and season to taste
3. Pour over the chicken and turn to coat well , then cover and let marinate at room temperature for at least 1 hour
4. If possible , let marinate in the refrigerator for 24 hours
5. Preheat the broiler to medium
6. Remove the chicken from the marinade and pat dry with paper towels
7. Place the chicken on a broiler rack and cook under the hot broiler for 20-25 minutes , turning once , until the chicken is tender and the juices run clear when a skewer is inserted into the thickest part of the meat
8. Brush with the marinade occasionally , but not for the last few minutes of the cooking time
9. Garnish with cilantro springs

title: geri halliwell s weight loss express
steps: 1. Blend all together and have immediately

title: goat cheese salad with raspberry dressing
steps:
1. Toss all ingredients together
2. Drizzle on dressing and enjoy

title: oreo bon bons
steps:
1. Grind all the cookies in a food processor
2. Mix in the softened cream cheese
3. Roll out small balls of the cookie and cream cheese mixture and set in the refrigerator for a couple hours
4. Dip them in melted white chocolate , then chill in the frig again until chocolate is firm

title: fruit ricotta mousse
steps:
1. For a smoother , mousse like texture , blend the ricotta cheese a couple minutes in the blender
2. Fold in the fruit and jam
3. If you plan to serve it all right away , fold in the whipped cream
4. Let it set 20 minutes in the fridge
5. If you only plan to use a portion now and the rest hours later , save out the whipped cream
6. Let the ricotta fruit mixture rest to let the flavors "marry"
7. Spoon out whatever portions you pneed and add the whipped cream
8. Obviously you could use full fat or non fat for the cheese and whipped cream

title: cherry cardamom cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 f
2. Toss chopped cherries and 2 tbsp flour: set aside
3. Beat butter , sugar and cream cheese in large bowl with electric mixer on medium speed until fluffy
4. Beat in egg , buttermilk and vanilla
5. Beat in 2 1 / 3 cups flour , the cardamom , baking powder and baking soda on low speed just until flour is moistened
6. Stir in cherries
7. Shape dough into 1 inch balls and place 1 1 / 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet
8. Bake 12 to 14 min or until bottoms are light golden
9. Remove from cookie sheet to wire rack
10. Cool
11. Sprinkle with powdered sugar

title: grilled chicken with sweet carolina barbecue sauce
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , combine all of the sauce ingredients and bring to a simmer
2. Stir well and remove from heat
3. Let cool to room temperature , then pour into a glass jar with lid and refrigerate
4. In a large bowl or extra large ziplock , add the first 9 ingredients and mix well
5. Let sit at room temperature for 30 minutes
6. Then , add the chicken pieces and turn to coat
7. Refrigerate overnight
8. Light your grill or preheat broiler
9. Remove the chicken from the marinade and arrange the pieces on a baking sheet / s
10. Brush the chicken pieces with the barbecue sauce and grill over a medium-hot fire or broil 12 inches from the heat , turning often and rotating , until cooked through and nicely glazed , 8 to 10 minutes per side
11. Serve hot or at room temperature

title: roast chicken with rice and fruit stuffing
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
2. Toast the cashews lightly in the oven for 5 minutes
3. Heat 4 tablespoons of oil in a saute pan
4. Add the onion and the celery
5. Cook over low heat for 5 minutes , or until tender
6. Add the rice , saute over medium heat for 2 minutes
7. Add the hot soup , orange juice , salt and pepper , and bring to a boil
8. Cover and cook over low heat for 10 minutes
9. Add the apricots and raisins to the rice , stir gently with a fork
10. Cover and cook for 5 more minutes , until the rice is nearly tender
11. Stir in the cinnamon , lemon rind and cashews
12. Taste for seasoning and correct if necessary
13. Set aside to cool
14. Sprinkle the chicken with salt and pepper on all sides and in the cavity as well
15. Spoon enough of the stuffing into the chicken to fill it , packing lightly
16. Keep the extra stuffing at room temperature
17. Place the chicken in a roasting pan and roast in the oven for 1 hour
18. When a fork stuck into the thickest part of the chicken causes the juices to run clear , the chicken is ready
19. If the juices are still pink , add a few more minutes until you get the clear juices
20. Let the bird rest for about 5-10 minutes
21. Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil in a skillet and saute the leftover stuffing until hot , about 3 minutes
22. Serve the stuff chicken on a platter , with the sauteed stuffing on the side
23. You can also serve the roasting juices in a sauceboat

title: ella s cream filled chocolate cupcakes
steps:
1. Sift together flour , sugar , cocoa , baking soda and salt
2. Stir in water , cooking oil , vinegar and vanilla- batter will be thin
3. Line muffin tins with paper cups
4. Fill each half full of batter
5. On the top of each , put one teaspoon of the cream filling
6. For the cream filling , combine softened cream cheese and egg
7. Stir in sugar , salt and chocolate
8. Bake for 30-35 minutes at 350 degrees

title: lettuce and chive salad  korean style  mark bittman
steps:
1. Make dressing by combining sesame oil , red pepper flakes , soy sauce , vinegar , garlic , sugar , and about 1 tablespoons water
2. Wash and dry chives , then cut into 1-2 inch links
3. Toss with the lettuce , then pour the dressing over all and toss again
4. Garnish with sesame seeds and serve immediately

title: cauliflower with ginger and mustard seeds
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat the oil over moderate heat until it is hot but not smoking
2. Cook the mustard seeds , covered , stirring occasionally , until the popping subsides
3. Add the gingerroot and the turmeric and cook the mixture , stirring , for 30 seconds
4. Add the cauliflower , stirring to coat it with the oil , and 1 / 2 cup water and steam the mixture , covered , adding more water a few tablespoons at a time if it evaporates , until the cauliflower is just tender , about 6 to 10 minutes
5. Season the cauliflower mixture with the lemon juice , salt , and pepper and stir in the coriander , if using
6. Enjoy !

title: wing king s bbq buffalo wings
steps:
1. Chop up and saut the shallot & garlic cloves with the butter
2. Add the dark beer , chili sauce , and bbq sauce , and stir for 1 minute
3. Add the ancho chili peppers , brown sugar , honey , and cayenne pepper sauce , and stir for 2 minutes
4. While you are creating the sauce , drop 50 chicken wings in a deep fryer until fully cooked
5. Once wings are fully cooked , add the wings to a large mixing bowl
6. Add the sauce , and flip gently to be sure the wings are thoroughly coated with the sauce
7. Serve with a side of blue cheese dressing

title: kicked up french fries
steps:
1. Pour frozen french fries in bowl
2. Toss with oil and smoked paprika
3. Bake according to package directions or until desired crispiness
4. Enjoy

title: jamies chilli con carne
steps:
1. In a large pot , fry onions and garlic in a little olive oil until soft
2. Add chilli powder , fresh chilli , cumin and a little seasoning
3. Then add the meat and continue to cook , stirring , until it has browned
4. Process the sun-dried tomatoes in your food processor , with a little oil from the jar , enough to loosen into a paste
5. Add these to the beef with the tomatoes , cinnamon stick , and the water
6. Check the seasoning , and add more if you prefer
7. Bring to the boil , cover , turn the heat down and simmer for about 1 and a half hours
8. Add the kidney beans about 1 / 2 an hour before serving , they are already cooked and only need to be warmed through
9. Serving suggestions , steamed rice , crusty bread , a tossed salad , some guacamole or / and sour cream / yoghurt

title: easy beer bread
steps:
1. Sift the flour and sugar into a bowl
2. Stir in the beer
3. The batter will be thick
4. Pour into a lightly greased 5x9-inch loaf pan
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted into the center comes out clean
6. Remove to a platter to cool and pour the butter over the top

title: country beef patties
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine beef , bacon , onion , salt and pepper
2. Shape into four oval patties
3. Brown in a skillet over medium heat
4. Remove patties and keep warm
5. Drain all but 1 tbl drippings
6. Saute green pepper and onion in drippings until tender
7. Add tomatoes , bay leaves , sugar , celery salt , salt and pepper
8. Combine water and flour until smooth
9. Add to tomato mixture , stirring constantly
10. Bring to a boil
11. Cook and stir for 2 minutes
12. Return patties to gravy
13. Reduce heat
14. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes
15. Uncover and simmer 10 minutes longer
16. Remove the bay leaves

title: e z lasagna
steps:
1. In a large skillet over medium heat cook the italian sausage , onion , and garlic until brown
2. Add the tomato sauce , tomato paste , salt , and oregano and stir until well incorporated
3. Cook until heated through
4. In a large bowl mix together the cottage cheese , grated parmesan cheese , and shredded mozzarella cheese
5. Spoon a layer of the meat mixture onto the bottom of a 9x13 pan
6. Add a double layer of the uncooked lasagna noodles
7. Top noodles with a portion of the cheese mixture
8. Repeat the layering of sauce , noodles , and cheese until all the ingredients are used
9. Sprinkle additional parmesan cheese on top
10. Cover and cook at 350 degrees for 1 hour

title: broiled mahi mahi with parsleyed tomatoes and feta
steps:
1. Heat olive oil over medium heat in saute pan
2. Saute sliced onions in the oil for about 8 minutes or until tender
3. Add tomatoes , parsley , white wine , tomato paste , garlic , 1 / 4 tsp salt , and 1 / 4 tsp pepper
4. Simmer for 5 minutes
5. Set mixture aside
6. Lightly grease a rack , and line a broiler pan with aluminum foil
7. Place rack in broiler pan
8. Place fish , in a single layer , on the rack
9. Sprinkle with the remaining salt and pepper
10. Broil fish about 5 inches from heat for about 8 minutes , or until the fish flakes easily with a fork
11. Spoon the onion-tomato mixture evenly onto a platter
12. Place the broiled fish on top of the onion-tomato mixture
13. Sprinkle with crumbled feta , and garnish with lemon slices

title: mediterranean chicken breasts with tomatoes and olives
steps:
1. In a large cast-iron or nonstick skillet , heat the tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat
2. Add the chicken and saute until it is browned on all sides and just cooked through
3. Remove chicken and place on a plate
4. Add the teaspoons of olive oil and the onions to the pan , and cook for 2 minutes
5. Add the garlic and cook for another minute
6. Add the tomatoes olives , oregano and basil and cook the sauce for 5-8 more minutes
7. Add the chicken and cook until it is heated through
8. Put the chicken on plates , and spoon the sauce equally over the chicken

title: creole black eyes and rice for the crock pot
steps:
1. Sort and wash peas
2. Place in a large pan , cover with warm water and allow to soak overnight
3. Drain the peas and place in large 4 quart crock pot
4. Add ham or ham bone to peas along with 3 cups of water
5. Stir in rest of ingredients except the cooked rice and green onion fans
6. Turn crock pot to low and allow to cook for 6 to 8 hours
7. Stir after 5 to 6 hours and check to see if additional water may be needed
8. If peas are to thick , add warm water to crock pot until desired consistency
9. Serve over cooked rice and garnished with green onion fans

title: peanut chicken over rice
steps:
1. In a large frying pan , heat oil over medium-high heat
2. Add onions , scallions , and garlic and cook until onion is tender
3. Reduce heat to medium and add peanut butter , brown sugar , fish sauce , paprika , juice of limes , and cayenne pepper
4. Stir into a smooth sauce , then add coconut milk in 4 parts , stirring into a smooth sauce again
5. Heat sauce to boiling , then reduce heat to low and allow to simmer stirring occasionally
6. In a large pot , heat enough water to completely submerge chicken to boiling
7. While water is heating , trim chicken of fat and slice into 1 / 2 inch wide by 2 inch long pieces
8. Add chicken to boiling water and allow to cook just long enough to completely cook chicken
9. Remove chicken from water and add to peanut sauce , also adding steamed spinach and bell pepper
10. Mix thoroughly , and increase heat to medium
11. Allow this to cook 10-15 minutes
12. Remove from heat and ladle over plenty of white rice

title: big pasta stuffed shells
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Boil shells for no longer that 6 minutes , remove from heat and drain , let cool to handle
3. In a large bowl beat egg , stir in ricotta or cottage cheese
4. Add 3 / 4 of the mozzarella and 1 / 3 of the paremesan cheese along with the chopped parsley , chop the bacon up in small pieces and add
5. Mix well together
6. Spread 4-5 tablespoons of sauce on the bottom of glass dish
7. Stuff shells with filling sprinkel with remaining cheese , add remainder of the sauce
8. Cover with aluminum foil about 30 minutes
9. Uncover and bake another 5 minutes without foil
10. Let stand 5 minutes and serve

title: kielbasa and sauerkraut soup  borsch  borscht
steps:
1. Pan fry garlic , and kielbasa until kielbasa is golden brown
2. In a 5-qt
3. Slow cooker , combine all ingredients
4. Cover and cook on low for 5-6 hours or until vegetables are tender
5. High altitude -- cook 6-8 hours
6. Just add all ingredients to a large pot and bring to a boil
7. Simmer for an hour or so to blend flavors
8. Can double recipe and freeze extra in a zip-loc for a quick future meal

title: sourdough onion rye bread
steps:
1. To proof your starter , feed it with equal parts of flour and water , cover loosely and let it sit overnight or up to 12 hours
2. At this point , measure out your 2 cups of starter into mixing bowl and proceed with recipe
3. Saute onions in olive oil until they become translucent
4. Remove from heat and add butter , water and salt
5. Cool to lukewarm and stir into starter
6. Add the rye flour and mix well
7. Add the white flour gradually , until it is too stiff to mix by hand
8. Turn onto a floured surface and knead in enough remaining flour until dough is satiny
9. Shape into an elongate loaf
10. Place on baking sheet and let rise , covered , in a warm place for 1 to 2 hours , or until about doubled in bulk
11. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
12. Make diagonal slashes in top of loaf with a razor blade or very sharp knife
13. Bake for 40 to 50 minutes
14. Remove from baking sheet and cool on wire rack
15. This bread could also be made using the dough cycle of your bread machine

title: potato potsticker casserole  sp5
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Peel film at corners of both containers to vent
3. Heat both containers in microwave for 4 minutes
4. Place warmed potatoes in a large bowl and stir in the sour cream
5. Spread half of the potato / sour cream mixture in a 9x13 non-stick baking dish
6. Top with 1 cup of the cheese and sprinkle the bacon pieces on top
7. Top with a single layer of 12 wonton wrappers
8. Spread the remaining half of the potato mixture on top of the wonton layer
9. Finish with a second , single layer of the wonton wrappers
10. Sprinkle wontons with the remaining cheese
11. Cover with foil and bake 30 minutes
12. Remove foil and bake uncovered for the final 10 minutes

title: fish in beer sauce
steps:
1. In a very large skillet , melt together the olive oil and butter , then saut diced onion over medium-low heat until it is translucent , about 5 to 7 minutes
2. Stir in the garlic and sprinkle the flour over it all then cook for 2 minutes , stirring constantly to coat
3. Add the beer , brown sugar , mustard , pepper , and worcestershire sauce to skillet and heat until sauce thickens , stirring constantly
4. Season with salt to taste
5. Place fish pieces in the skillet and cook until fish flakes easily with a fork
6. Serve and enjoy !

title: cocoa glazed carrots and onions
steps:
1. Place onions in a bowl and cover with boiling water
2. Let stand for 2 to 3 minutes
3. Meanwhile , place carrots in a nonstick frying pan
4. Brely cover with water and bring to a boil over high heat
5. Reduce heat , cover and simmer gently until carrots are just tender when pierced
6. Drain carrots and set aside
7. While carrots are cooking , drain onions , then peel skins off and discard them
8. Also trim root and stem ends of onions
9. Once carrots are cooked and drained , place onions in pan used for carrots , barely cover with water , and bring to a boil over high heat
10. Reduce heat , cover and simmer gently until onions are tender when pierced
11. Drain onions
12. Set aside
13. In pan , combine 1 tablespoon water , butter , lemon juice , honey , cocoa and ginger
14. Stir over meidum-high heat until well blended
15. Add carrots and onions
16. Stir gently over high heat until sauce is thick enough to cling to vegetables

title: shrimp in spicy coconut milk
steps:
1. For paste: to a food processor with motor running , add paste ingredients , one at a time , through feed tube , and puree mixture to a paste
2. Shell shrimp , leaving tail segment intact , and devein
3. In a colander , rinse shrimp and drain well
4. Heat a large skillet over moderately low heat until hot
5. Cook paste in oil , stirring until fragrant , about 5 minutes
6. Add onions and cook , stirring , until softened
7. Stir in coconut milk , brown sugar and salt and bring to a boil
8. Add shrimp and lime juice and cook over moderate heat , stirring occasionally , until shrimp are just cooked through , about 5 minutes
9. Serve shrimp with rice

title: chocolate malted brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Melt chocolate in a saucepan or a double boiler over simmering water
3. Remove from heat and set aside
4. Cream butter
5. Add the sugar and the vanilla
6. Beat in the eggs
7. Blend in melted chocolate
8. Sift flour , baking powder , salt , and malted milk powder
9. Add to chocolate mixture , stirring well
10. Fold in nuts
11. Pour batter into a greased and floured 8 inch square pan
12. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes
13. Remove from oven while brownies are still moist
14. Spread malted-milk glaze over brownies
15. Malted milk glaze:
16. Cream together butter , malted milk powder , salt , sugar and 1 t
17. Of milk
18. Stir in remaining milk , as necessary , for spreading consistency

title: dessert charosets
steps:
1. Blend or process the dates , raisins , coarsely chopped nuts and wine / juice until the mixture forms a smooth paste
2. Using wet hands , roll level teaspoons of mixture into balls
3. Place them on a lined tray
4. Cover and refrigerate overnight
5. Dip half of the balls into melted chocolate , place on foil lined tray , leave to set at room temperature
6. Roll remaining balls in finely chopped walnuts

title: grandma s german kolaches
steps:
1. Mix 2 cups of flour , 1 / 2 cup of sugar , yeast , and salt
2. Add 1
3. 5 cups of hot water
4. Beat this and then add eggs , mixing
5. Add the other 3 cups of flour
6. Knead until smooth and satiny , about 8 to 10 minutes
7. Form into a ball
8. Lightly grease a large bowl
9. Put the dough round side down in the greased bowl , then turn over so that the greased side is up
10. Cover with a slightly damp towel
11. Put in a warm place
12. Let it rise until doubled , about 75 minutes
13. You don't want to leave the dough too long , however
14. Dough can actually over-rise
15. Punch down the dough
16. Reshape into a ball
17. Recover bowl
18. Let rise till double
19. It should take less time this time around , but it varies -- maybe 45 - 60 minutes
20. All of these rises can take longer if your house is cold
21. If using a prune filling , simmer them with some water until soft
22. Mash thoroughly
23. Let cool
24. If desiring an apricot filling but not having access to canned solo filling , you can make it out of dried apricots
25. Snip 3 / 4 cups of dried apricots into small pieces
26. Simmer , covered , with 1-1 / 2 cups water for 10 minutes
27. Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes more
28. Stir in 2 tablespoons of sugar
29. Let cool before using
30. Pinch off balls of dough about 1
31. 5 inches in diameter
32. Pat out into a circle
33. Put a spoonful of filling inside
34. Fold over and seal
35. Put in pan
36. Parchment-lined cookie sheets work well
37. The recipe doesn't say it , but i'd leave some room between them because they'll grow during the next rise -- yep , let rise again
38. This rise should be 45 - 60 minutes
39. Make topping: crumble together 1
40. 25 cups flour , sugar and butter
41. Make a groove in the center of each and put on a big pinch of topping
42. Bake at 350f until nicely golden brown , about 15-20 minutes
43. Pinch off the ball of dough
44. Make an indentation in it
45. Fill with a spoonful of the filling
46. Sprinkle topping on it before baking

title: shrimp egg spring roll with sweet hot and sour sauce   gluten fr
steps:
1. In a wok or large pan heat 2 tbs oil over high heat
2. Reduce to medium high and lightly brown pork with onion , garlic , and shrimp
3. Stir in carrot and stir fry a minute or two
4. Add in the cabbage and fry unti it is wilted and soft
5. Season with pepper flakes , sesame oil , soy sauce , salt and pepper to taste
6. Remove from heat and spread on a lage open pan or tray to cool before putting into the wrappers
7. Soak each wrap in water for about 30 to 60 seconds until soft and pliable
8. Place the wrapper on a clean surface so that you have one corner pointing toward you
9. Take 1 heaping table spoon of the cooled filling mixture and place about 1 1 / 2 " from the corner closest to you
10. Pick up corner an place over filling rolling one turn away from you
11. Pick up each corner on the lateral sides and fold in , then continue to roll the wrap away from you
12. Let the rolls rest for about 20 minutes before frying
13. They fry up better if they have rested a while
14. For spring rolls these are not fried- your choice
15. For egg rolls fry in 1" of oil about 1 1 / 2 to 2 minutes on each side
16. If ou have a deep fryer you wont need to turn them
17. Be aware tapioca wrappers done cook up gold brown , they stay pretty white looking and then suddenly blacken if over cooked
18. Drain on paper towel and serve with sweet , hot , and sour sauce
19. Sweet / hot and sour sauce
20. Mix all ingredients and adjust to your taste
21. Also be aware that this sauce gets hotter as it melds
22. Enjoy
23. For the sauce , the measurements are approximate
24. It really depends on your own taste
25. So please feel free to make adjustments
26. I usually use this ratio and then add honey or vinegar then dilute with a little water

title: butterfly cupcakes
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar together in a bowl until light and fluffy
2. Add eggs one at a time , beating each in until combined
3. Add sifted flour , milk and vanilla essence
4. Spoon mixture into patty tins lined with paper patty cups
5. Bake in moderate oven towards the top of the oven for about 20 minutes or until golden brown
6. Slice tops off cooled cakes , and fill cakes with freshly whipped cream
7. Carefully cut tops in half lengthways and arrange these 'butterfly wings' on the cream
8. Place a strawberry half in the centre of the wings
9. Dust with icing sugar before serving
10. And eat ! :d

title: chocolate chip cookies   better than nestle s premade dough
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven 350
2. Cream together shortening , all sugar , egg & vanilla
3. In separate bowl wisk flour , salt , & baking soda
4. Add flour little by little until mixed
5. Finally stir in chocolate chips
6. Drop on lightly greased pan 2 inches apart
7. Bake for 10 to 12 min or until golden brown
8. The amount it makes all depends on the size of the dough !

title: fish burgers  low fat
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine all ingredients except the crushed croutons
2. Mix well to combine
3. Shape into about 10-12 patties
4. Coat each patty with the crushed croutons or crushed cornflakes
5. Place the patties on a baking sheet and chill for 2 hours
6. Pour oil to a depth of about 1 / 2-inch into a large heavy skillet , heat to medium heat
7. Fry the patties about 2 minutes on each side , or until golden
8. Drain on paper towels

title: deep dish taco salad
steps:
1. Brown ground beef according to taco seasoning directions
2. In bottom of 9x9 baking dish , make 2 rectangles with 4 of the 8 crescents rolls
3. Cover bottom layer of crescent rolls with well drained ground beef mixture
4. Layer with half of the cheese
5. Top cheese with remaining 4 crescent rolls in 2 more rectangles
6. Top with remaining cheese
7. Bake in 350 oven until golden brown , roughly 30 minutes
8. Top with lettuce , tomato and sour cream
9. Serve with taco chips

title: firecracker sesame chicken
steps:
1. Heat canola oil in a large skillet over medium high heat
2. In a small bowl , whisk together soy sauce , chili garlic sauce , sesame oil , and orange marmalade
3. Set aside
4. Season chicken with salt and pepper
5. Add chicken to the skillet and saute until golden brown , about 5 7 minutes
6. Remove chicken from the skillet
7. Add carrots , snow peas and red pepper to the skillet
8. Saute for about 5 minutes or until vegetables are crisp tender
9. Add chicken back to
10. The skillet , along with the garlic
11. Saute for 1 minute
12. Add sauce to the skillet and cook for another 5 minutes or until sauce is thickened
13. Serve over white rice

title: caribbean game hens
steps:
1. To make marinade , combine rum , honey , lime rind , lime juice , garlic , and ginger
2. Place birds in a shallow glass or ceramic dish and pour over marinade
3. Turn to coat , cover , and marinate at room temperature for 1 hour
4. Drain birds , reserving marinade
5. Thread a skewer through wings and legs of each bird half
6. Brush with reserved marinade
7. Combine black pepper and coriander
8. Rub over skin of birds
9. Cook , turning frequently , on a light oiled preheated medium grill or under a broiler for 15-20 minutes or until birds are cooked through

title: tuscan pasta crock pot
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a crock pot , except the spaghetti
2. Cover and cook on low for 4-5 hours
3. Stir in the spaghetti , cover and cook on high for 45-50 minutes , or until pasta is tender
4. If desired , the spaghetti can be cooked separately if desired , and added to mixture before serving , just cook the mixture in the crock pot an extra 40 minutes , or to suit taste
5. Ladle into bowls and top with parmesan cheese

title: kid friendly fondue regards    tasty
steps:
1. Heat the milk and the garlic in a saucepan over medium-low heat until simmering , 2 to 3 minutes
2. Toss the cheese and flour together in a bowl until the shreds are nicely floured
3. Whisk the cheese mixture into the milk a handful at a time , waiting until each handful melts before adding more
4. Whisk until cheese is completely melted and mixture is smooth and velvety
5. Holding the food with fingers , a fondue fork or a regular fork , dip one or several of the options into the pot and swirl to coat with the cheese
6. I added a light sprinkle of dried parsley to the top of the fondue
7. Warning ! : [[[careful ! don't want the children to burn their fingers ! ]]]
8. Preparing and serving the fondue requires adult supervision

title: mediterranean tilapia pockets  rsc
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Rub filets with 1 / 2 of the olive oil and 1 / 2 of the greek seasoning
3. Wrap 1 slice of prosciutto around each filet
4. Place 1 filet on 1 sheet of aluminum foil
5. Combine tomatoes , zucchini , olives , capers , parsley , mint , lemon juice & zest and remaining spice blend in a small mixing bowl
6. Toss
7. Place equal amounts of tomato mixture on top of each filet
8. Top with goat cheese and black pepper
9. Take the 2 opposite ends of foil , bring them together over filet and fold edges 2-3 times down and seal
10. Fold in 2 remaining open ends and seal
11. Place aluminum pockets on a large oven proof sheet pan
12. Bake for 15-20 minutes
13. Allow to rest for 5 minutes
14. Unseal and serve

title: veal sabrosa
steps:
1. Combine cheese , flour , salt , and pepper
2. Stir well
3. Dredge the veal in the flour mixture
4. Set aside
5. Saute garlic in olive oil in a large skillet for 1 minute -- do not over cook or burn ! add veal , and cook until browned
6. Remove and discard the garlic halves
7. Add the wine , consomme , and lemon juice
8. Bring to a boil
9. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer for 30 minutes
10. Transfer veal to a serving platter and sprinkle with freshly chopped parsley

title: chinese custart tarts
steps:
1. To make the pastry , sift flour and salt into bowl
2. Rub lard into flour until mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs
3. Mix in hot water to form a firm dough
4. Knead lightly on lightly floured surface
5. Roll out 3mm thickness
6. Cut out with an 8cm fluted cutter
7. Put into greased patty tins
8. Beat together eggs and sugar
9. Gradually add milk
10. Mix in food colouring
11. Mix well
12. Pour custart carefully into prepared pastry cases
13. Bake in hot oven for 10 minutes , reduce heat to moderately hot , cook further 10-15 minutes , until set
14. Keep an eye on these while cooking , as mine only needed the first 10 minutes

title: campbells chicken verde soup   substitute   copycat
steps: 1. Mix all together

title: carrabba s chicken gratella
steps:
1. Place the basil , garlic , mint , salt , pepper , and oregano in a mortar and pulverize until mixture turns into a paste
2. Place the paste in a glass jar and add the olive oil , lemon juice , and vinegar
3. Refrigerate
4. Before using , bring to room temperature and shake well
5. The sauce will hold in the refrigerator for two weeks
6. Lightly coat the chicken breasts with herb garlic sauce on both sides , season with sal and pepper to taste and place on hot grill
7. Cook until done , coat whit herb garlic sauce mixture
8. Serve

title: spinach cheese bundles
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Mix spreadable cheese , spinach and pepper in a small bowl
3. Roll out one sheet of pastry dough onto a floured surface , rolling into a 12 inch square
4. Cut pastry into 16 squares
5. Place about 1 teaspoons of cheese mixture in the center of each square
6. Brush edges each square with water
7. Bring edges together up over filling and twist tightly to seal
8. Fan out corners of pastry for a nice look
9. Place bundles about 2 inches apart on a baking sheet
10. Bake approximately 13 minutes or until golden brown
11. Repeat procedure with the remaining sheet of pastry dough and cheese mixture
12. Serve warm with dipping sauces

title: abby s ultimate chocolate chocolate  chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In large bowl , beat butter , sugar , eggs , and vanilla until light and fluffy
3. Combine the flour , cocoa , baking soda , and salt
4. Stir into the butter mixture until well blended
5. Mix in the chocolate chips
6. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets
7. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes in the preheated oven , or just until set
8. Cool slightly on the cookie sheets before transferring to wire racks to cool completely

title: french madeleines
steps:
1. Beat eggs until light yellow in color
2. Add sugar , butter , vanilla , zest and continue mixing
3. Sift flour and baking powder and add to wet ingredients and mix well
4. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
5. Place a tablespoon of batter into each well-greased , madeline mold
6. Bake for 8- 12 minutes or until light golden in color
7. Turn out madelines and cool
8. Dust with confectionery sugar
9. Serve

title: mozzarella en carrozza
steps:
1. Cut the mozzarella into enough 1 / 4-inch thick slices to cover 2 slices of the bread
2. Reserve the remaining mozzarella for another use
3. Top the cheese with the remaining 2 slices of bread , to make 2 sandwiches , and press down to compact
4. In a bowl , whisk together the eggs , garlic , and parsley and season with salt and pepper
5. Put the bread crumbs on a plate
6. In a large skillet over medium-high heat , pour the in oil to a depth of 1 / 4-inch
7. When the oil is hot , dip each sandwich into the egg mixture , dredge in the bread crumbs , and fry , turning once , until crisp and the cheese has melted
8. Cut each sandwich in 1 / 2 and serve , while still hot , with the marinara sauce on the side for dipping
9. Marinara sauce: heat the oil in a saucepan over medium-high heat
10. Add the garlic and cook , stirring , until fragrant
11. Add the tomatoes and sugar and season with salt and pepper , to taste
12. Bring to a boil , lower the heat , and simmer for 30 minutes
13. Remove the sauce from the heat and stir in the basil and parsley

title: smoothie king banana boat smoothie
steps:
1. Pour milk , yogurt and sugar into blender
2. Add bananas and flax seed
3. Blend well
4. To add more volume and make it ice cold , add 6 ice cubes and blend some more

title: maple mustard pork chops
steps:
1. Preheat a nonstick skillet on stove with the butter and oil on medium heat
2. The oil will help keep the butter from burning
3. Combine the flour , salt and pepper in a ziptop bag
4. Add pork slices and shake to cover lightly
5. Shake off any excess
6. Add pork to oil / butter in skillet
7. Lightly brown in batches
8. It will finish cooking in the sauce so don't worry about cooking through
9. Remove from skillet as it browns
10. Combine water , maple syrup , mustard , salt and pepper in skillet and whisk till hot and bubbley
11. Add pork back in to sauce and cook over med-low heat for 20 minutes or till cooked through
12. The flour from the pork will thicken the sauce
13. We like to serve it with rice-a-roni and a veggie

title: swiss tobleronemousse
steps:
1. Chop the chocolate up coarsely and put into a bowl or double boiler
2. Set bowl over boiling water to melt the chocolate
3. Stir in the sugar and eggs until the until the sugar has desolved and chocolate is melted and is lighter in color
4. Remove from heat
5. Whip the cream and fold into the chocolate mixture
6. Pour into 4 individual serving dishes or leave in bowl
7. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours before serving

title: deanna s baked pork chops
steps:
1. Brown pork chops with small amount of shortening or vegetable oil
2. Season with salt and pepper to taste
3. Drain and place in 9x13 inch pan
4. Set aside
5. Add onion to pan and cook over medium heat for 3-5 minutes until soft
6. Add the rest of the ingredients
7. Stir together until combined and cook over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until heated through and bubbly
8. Pour over chops , cover pan with foil , and bake at 350 degrees for 1
9. 5 hours

title: mocha mousse
steps:
1. For 10 seconds in blender , blend gelatin , instant coffee , and cold water
2. Then add boiling water , cocoa , and honey and blend another 10 seconds
3. Blend remaining ingredients for a final 10 seconds
4. Blend until dissolved and refrigerate for 5minutes

title: onion potato gratin
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Spray an oval baker with cooking spray
3. Add 1 layer of potatoes , top with 1 layer onions , top with cheese
4. Salt and pepper repeat layers until you end up with final layer of potatoes , top with cheese
5. Pour in half and half to equal height of layers
6. Dot with butter
7. Bake covered 45 minutes , then uncover and bake 15 minutes more

title: san francisco deviled crab
steps:
1. In a 10 - 12" skillet combine 3 tablespoons butter and the oil and saute the onion and celery over low heat for 4- 6 minutes or until soft
2. Add the flour , a little at a time and cook stirring for 3 - 4 minutes
3. Meanwhile , heat milk and cream in a small saucepan
4. Add the heated milk gradually to the onion mixture , stirring constantly
5. In a small bowl combine the dry mustard , tabasco , worcestershire , sherry , lemon juice , and parsley
6. Add this mixture to the onion mixture in the skillet , stirring well
7. Bring to a simmer and stir until the sauce thickens , about 3 - 4 minutes
8. Add the chopped eggs and crab
9. Taste for seasoning , adding salt and pepper to taste
10. Divide the mixture between 6 scallop shells or ramekins
11. Dot them with the remaining butter and cover with the cheese
12. Place them in a pre-heated 375 f oven for 15 minutes or until they are lightly browned and bubbling
13. Serve as a first course

title: coconut pecan snack cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Lightly grease and flour 1 13x9 sheet cake pan
3. Add boxed cake mix to large mixing bowl , make a well in the center
4. Add eggs , oil and water to the well
5. Mix on low speed 30 seconds , then medium speed for 1 minute
6. Add entire contents of tub of frosting to the batter
7. Mix frosting into batter on medium speed for 1 additional minute
8. Pour batter evenly into prepared pan
9. Bake for approximately 40-45 minutes or until edges of the cake have begun to pull away from the pan and the center is set
10. Cool in and serve from pan

title: chocolate cookie crust
steps:
1. Put the cookies in the container of a food processor
2. Process them until they are finely ground
3. Transfer crumbs to a mixing bowl
4. Combine crumbs , butter , salt , and vanilla
5. Stir until the crumbs are moistened
6. Press mixture evenly across the bottom of a 9-inch pie plate and all the way up the sides of the pan
7. Pack tightly so crust is even and compacted
8. Bake in a 350 oven for 6-8 minutes or until crisp
9. Let cool completely before filling
10. May wrap crust in plastic wrap and freeze for 1 month

title: ranch gratin potatoes
steps:
1. In a large bowl , toss the potatoes with ranch dressing , milk and cheese
2. Place in a greased 9 x 12-inch baking dish
3. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour and 15 minutes , stirring once or twice

title: quick   easy teriyaki meatballs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix all ingredients in a bowl- making sure teriyaki sauce spreads evenly
3. Form balls & place in baking dish
4. Bake for approximately 20-30 minutes

title: garlicky buttered shrimp
steps:
1. In large skillet , on med-hi , saute garlic in butter for 1 minute
2. Add shrimp
3. Saute 3 minutes
4. Stir in basil , cilantro , and red pepper flakes
5. Cook and stir for 1 minute
6. Add milk , flour , and parmesan , bring to a boil , stirring
7. Boil 1 minute
8. Remove from heat and stir until smooth

title: apple cider vinegar marinade for chicken barbaja w
steps:
1. Remove chicken from package (or if living in a country where chicken is really fresh , remove feathers , entrails head , feet and wing
2. In a large bowl or clean sink put the chicken or cut up pieces of meat then pour on cold water until covered then add 1 / 2 cup of table salt or use less and 1 / 2 cup of apple cider vinegar
3. Move the chicken around gently in this mixture for 10 to 15 minutes
4. Less time is ok if you see that the skin hangs loose on the meat
5. You can add sugar or brown sugar , molasses , honey , karo syrup , pancake syrup or artificial sweetner to the soak , but that and the salt are a matter of taste
6. Rinse gently with more clean cold water
7. Now you are ready to cook stovetop , oven , crock pot , campfire or whatever
8. Even an old elderly bird will usually be tenderized
9. My grandma also used this on game to make it tender and moist
10. Remember to use a sink cleanser that contains bleach on the sink , because chicken is a funny meat
11. You need to be careful with utensils after they were touched by any raw meat
12. I mention the clean up , because when i was a new cook i did not know

title: sunday roast chicken
steps:
1. Combine seasoning mix ingredients in small bowl
2. Melt butter over high heat in skillet
3. When butter starts to sizzle , add chopped onions and peppers , and 3 tablespoons seasoning mix
4. Cook until onions are golden brown
5. Cool
6. Stuff cavity of chicken with cooled vegetables
7. Sprinkle outside of chicken with 1 tablespoon seasoning mix
8. Rub well
9. Place chicken in large slow cooker
10. Cover
11. Cook on low 6 hours
12. Empty vegetable stuffing and juices into saucepan
13. Whisk in flour and 1 cup stock
14. Cook over high heat until thickened
15. Add more stock if you prefer a thinner gravy

title: leftover turkey and leek pot pie with instant gravy
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 190c / 375f / gas 5
2. You will need a deep baking dish roughly 26cm x 20cm , i use an enamelled dish as jamie does , it conducts the heat perfectly
3. Put your lardons or ham in a large sauce pan over a medium heat and add your thyme leaves
4. Add a glug of olive oil and the butter and let it all fry off a few minutes
5. Add all of your prepared leeks and fry them off for about 3 minutes so they are well-coated in the butter
6. Add a pinch of sea salt and freshly ground black pepper then pop the lid on , turn the heat down to low to medium and let them cook away gently for 30 minutes , stirring every 5 to 10 minutes to make sure they dont catch
7. When your leeks are ready , add the turkey meat and stir
8. Add your stuffing mix now if you have any , then add the flour , mix it in well and then pour in your stock and stir again
9. Add the crme frache then turn the heat up and bring everything back up to the boil
10. Have a taste and add a bit more sea salt and freshly ground black pepper if it needs it , then turn the heat off
11. Pour the mixture through a sieve over another large empty pan and let the wonderful gravy from the mixture drip into the pan while you roll out your pastry
12. Dust a clean surface and a rolling pin with a bit of flour and roll your pastry to the size of your dish
13. Spoon that thick leek and turkey mixture from your sieve into the pie dish and spread it out evenly
14. Lay your pastry on top , tuck the ends under then gently score the pastry diagonally with your knife
15. Add a pinch of salt to your beaten egg then paint this egg wash over the top of your pastry
16. Pop your pie in the oven for about 35 to 40 minutes or until the pastry is puffed up and golden brown
17. When the pie is ready , re-heat the lovely gravy and serve with your pie , along with mashed potatoes and seasonal greens

title: fresh spinach and couscous salad feta cheese
steps:
1. Heat water in a microwave bowl until boiling
2. Remove from microwave and stir in couscous
3. Cover with plastic wrap and let stand for 5 minutes
4. Place couscous in fine mesh strainer and rinse under cold water until cooled
5. Drain well
6. Combine remaining ingredients , except feta , in a large bowl
7. Add couscous to spinach mixture and stir until blended
8. Add cheese
9. Toss gently

title: two tone biscotti
steps:
1. Combine flour , sugar and baking powder into a mixing bowl
2. Cut butter or shortening into dry mixture until it resembles coarse cornmeal
3. Make a well in the flour mixture
4. With a fork , beat together eggs , vanilla , orange juice and orange extract until well blended
5. Pour mixture into flour well and knead 5 minutes until smooth
6. Divide dough into two parts
7. Into one part , add 10 drops of green food coloring
8. Add 10 drops of red food coloring to the other dough , mixing each well to blend in colors
9. Pinch off a piece of the green dough about the size of an egg
10. Roll out to 12 inches long , and about as thick as your finger
11. Repeat with both doughs until all is used up
12. Place one roll of red dough and one roll of green dough close together on a cookie sheet
13. Repeat with double rolls 2 inches apart
14. Dough will rise when it bakes
15. Bake at 325 degrees for 10 minutes
16. Remove from oven and cool slightly
17. While still warm , pour glaze on and , if desired , finely chopped nuts
18. Cut into 1 inch slices
19. Glaze: combine 3 cups confectionary sugar , 3 tablespoons melted butter , 1 tablespoon grand marnier liquer , and 3 tablespoons boiling water

title: fagiole pasta  not pasta fagiole soup
steps:
1. Sautee onion and garlic in olive oil until soft
2. Add beans , tomato sauce and broth
3. Simmer for 20-minutes , stirring frequently
4. Cook pasta and drain
5. Add beans and sauce and mix thoroughly
6. Serve right away

title: instant pot vegetarian stew
steps:
1. Saute leek and mushroom in oil in instant pot using the lower saute setting (can change it by hitting the adjust button a few times
2. Add carrots , potatoes , celery , water , herbs , worcestershire sauce and salt and pepper
3. Stir well , then add water and stir again
4. Set instant pot to 13 minutes on stew function
5. Meanwhile , saute seitan in a skillet on the stove and set aside
6. Do a 15 minute natural release then release the pressure , putting a towel over the valve if you want to contain the steam
7. Open lid , add seitan , peas , and flour slurry , set to saute and cook down a minute or two to thicken it a bit

title: berry tunnel cake
steps:
1. Slice the top 1 / 4 of the cake off and set aside
2. Hollow out a tunnel in the cake leaving 1 / 2 inch walls on either side
3. In a large bowl , beat the cream cheese until fluffy
4. Beat in the milk and lemon juice until smooth
5. Stir in the food coloring and extract
6. Cube the cake removed from the tunnel and add them and the berries into the bowl
7. Fold in 1 cup whipped topping
8. Spoon into the tunnel and replace cake top
9. Spread the cake with the remaining whipped topping
10. Refrigerate 4 hours or overnight

title: black forest ice cream shake
steps:
1. Place the pint of chocolate ice cream on the counter to soften
2. Place the softened ice cream , cherries , milk , and chocolate chips in a blender
3. Blend on high speed until very smooth

title: the ultimate flank steak   the original recipe
steps:
1. This steak is best served with the center red / pink , it is at it's most tender state at that point
2. Place steak in sealable plastic bag
3. Add remaining ingredients , except butter , and place in refrigerator for 6 to 12 hours to marinate
4. Turn bag over at least four times during marination
5. Grill over hot hardwood coals , basting frequently with marinade , for about 8-10 minutes a side
6. Check for doneness
7. When done cut steak on diagonal across the grain
8. Serve with remaining marinade that has been heated to a boil with butter added
9. The flavors can be intensified by using your favorite smoking chips on the cooking coals
10. Leftovers make excellent sandwiches when topped with bacon , tomato and melted cheese and remaining marinade drizzled on top
11. I store the leftovers in the marinade to keep the steak moist and flavorful

title: chicken berbere
steps:
1. Brown the chicken thoroughly on high heat in a skillet in some of the fat
2. Set aside
3. Don't put too much meat into the skillet at once , or they won't brown
4. Fry the onion and garlic in additional fat in a pot on medium heat until it is transparent
5. Add berbere pepper and tomato paste and more fat if necessary in order not to burn the berbere
6. Stir for a moment , then add chicken , tomatoes , stock and lemon peel
7. Let simmer , covered , until the chicken is tender but not over-cooked
8. Add salt and pepper to taste
9. Garnish with cilantro stems and serve immediately with rice or on flat bread

title: greek bulgur salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl cover the 2 cups of bulgur with 2 cups of cold water and let stand for an hour
2. Drain well with a fine holed seive
3. Add all of the chopped vegetables
4. Lightly mix with a fork
5. Add the fresh dill , salt and pepper
6. Next , add the zest of one whole lemon and the juice of the lemon
7. Add the red wine vinegar and toss thoroughly
8. Finally add the olive oil and feta cheese

title: bob hope s lemon meringue pie
steps:
1. Start with a nicely cooked pie crust
2. Preheat oven to 350
3. Mix sugar , cornstarch and water over medium low heat stirring constantly until thick
4. Stir in the butter until melted
5. Remove from stove and whisk in the egg yolks , one at a time
6. Then the lemon juice , salt and lemon peel
7. Reheat gently on low for 2-3 minutes while stirring
8. Do not boil
9. Pour into pie shell and cool
10. Meringue - start with a very clean , dry glass bowl and beat the egg whites , salt and cream of tartar to stiff peak on high
11. Fold in the sugar and vanilla by hand , carefully
12. Spread over the pie to the edge
13. Bake 15 minutes until the meringue is lightly browned
14. Cool to room temp , then refrigerate until time to serve

title: brisket with apricot nectar
steps:
1. Season meat and put in a heavy dutch oven , uncovered and broil 10 minutes per side until browned
2. Remove from oven
3. Add the onion soup mix and nectar and cover and put back in oven at 300 degrees f
4. For about 2 1 / 2 to 3 hours , according to tenderness desired
5. Remove and allow to cool
6. Slice meat and reheat slowly

title: chocolate mousse chiffon pie
steps:
1. Prebake store-bought crust according to package directions
2. Let it cool
3. Refrigerate until ready to use
4. Over very low heat , combine cup of the coffee and 2 tablespoons butter in a medium saucepan , preferably nonstick
5. As the butter starts to melt , add the chocolate
6. Let the mixture stand on the heat for 3-4 minutes , stirring a few times
7. When the chocolate has melted , remove from the heat , whisking to smooth
8. Whisk the remaining 2 tablespoons butter into the mixture , adding about tablespoon at a time
9. Transfer the pan to a wire rack and let cool , whisking occasionally
10. While the mixture is still warm , whisk in the egg yolks
11. Put the saucepan back over very low heat and heat the mixture , whisking virtually nonstop , for 3-4 minutes to cook the yolks
12. Remove pan from heat and stir in the vanilla
13. Let cool to room temperature , then refrigerate , whisking occasionally
14. Pour the remaining cup coffee into a small saucepan and sprinkle the gelatin over it
15. Set aside for 5 minutes to soften
16. Gently heat the mixture , whisking , until the gelatin is dissolved , 1-2 minutes
17. Whisk this into the chocolate mixture and return the mixture to the refrigerator , whisking occasionally , 30-60 minutes , until it has the consistency of a very thick fudge sauce
18. Using an electric mixer , beat the egg whites until they hold soft peaks
19. Beat in the cream of tartar and salt
20. Gradually add the sugar , beating on high speed until the whites are thick , glossy , and firm but not dry
21. Transfer the chocolate mixture to a large bowl and fold in 1 / 3 of the egg whites
22. Add the rest of the egg whites and continue to fold , until no white streaks remain
23. Wash and dry beaters
24. Using a chilled bowl and chilled beaters , beat the heavy cream with the mixer until stiff but not grainy
25. Fold the whipped cream into the chocolate mixture until evenly combined
26. Scrape filling into the chilled pie shell , smoothing the top with a spoon
27. Cover loosely with tented foil and refrigerate for at least 4 hours , preferably 6
28. Serve garnished whipped cream , if desired

title: caramelized onions
steps:
1. Place in saucepan , put the lid on and cook over very low heat for 15-20 minutes , stirring often
2. Done when onions are soft and clear

title: quick peanut cabbage
steps:
1. Put all the ingredients in a bowl
2. Cover and microwave on high for 4 minutes , or until the cabbage is limp and the peanut butter is melted
3. Stir to cover the cabbage with sauce , and serve

title: smoked salmon cheese ball
steps:
1. Drain well all liquid from salmon
2. In a medium bowl cream cream cheese
3. Mix in drained salmon and liquid smoke , mix until well blended
4. Place a large piece of plastic wrap on your counter and pour parsley over a 10 x 10 square of the plastic wrap
5. Place salmon mix on the parsley and form into a ball
6. Refrigerate
7. Serve with sliced baguettes or crackers

title: tamarind glazed salmon
steps:
1. Puree all sauce ingredients in a blender
2. Preheat broiler
3. Line a broiler pan with aluminum foil
4. Brush fillets with olive oil , them brush with tamarind sauce
5. Season with salt& pepper
6. Broil salmon for 6-8 minutes , adding more sauce halfway through
7. Serve extra sauce alongside

title: lightly spiced citrus wonder cake
steps:
1. Beat the eggs , sugar , zest & ground ginger into the margarine
2. Add the flour & mix , then add the water , mixing again
3. Pour into a well greased microwave safe dish
4. Cook on full power for 5 minutes
5. Brush the cake with the melted marmalade & return to the microwave to cook on full power for another minute
6. Decorate with the chocolate sprinkles or the preserved ginger & cut into slices or squares & serve
7. If you wish to save any cake , cover it with plastic wrap or place in an airtight container for upto 3 days - it will stay soft & moist like this

title: triple chocolate coconut macaroons
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees , generously grease cookie sheets
2. In a large bowl , whisk together egg whites and salt
3. Until foamy
4. Whisk in condensed milk and vanilla
5. Fold in coconut and 1 cup of semisweet chips and 1 cup white chocolate chips
6. Drop batter by heaping tablespoonfuls onto prepared cookie sheets and bake at 300 degrees for 20 minutes
7. Cool on pans 2 minutes , remove from pans and let cool completely
8. Melt remaining chocolate chips in microwave and dip bottom of each cookie in melted chocolate to coat
9. Allow to harden on waxed paper

title: zucchini ribbons with basil butter
steps:
1. Bring pot of water to boil
2. Mean-while , with vegetable peeler-slice zucchini lengthwise into ribbons
3. Add zucchini to boiling water
4. Cook until tender , 30-60 seconds
5. Drain and transfer zucchini to serving bowl
6. Add butter , oil , parmesan , basil , and red pepper flakes
7. Gently toss until butter is melted and zucchini are coated
8. I also added 1 / 2 tsp of garlic powder to this !

title: mexican creation
steps:
1. Brown the hamburger , and onion
2. Add the refried beans , and salsa
3. Simmer off any extra liquid
4. Serve with tortillas , rice , flatbread , tacos --

title: white bean   bacon soup
steps:
1. Quick soak dried beans by placing them in a dutch oven covered with 4 cups of cold water -- bring to a boil for 2 minutes , then remove from heat , cover and let sit for about 1 hour
2. While waiting prepare vegetables and bacon
3. Drain beans in a colander
4. Using the same pot , saute bacon in olive oil at medium high heat until lightly carmelized
5. Add celery , carrots , onion and garlic and cook for about 5 minutes
6. Add wine and reduce until wine is practically gone , then stir in salt , peppercorns , pepper , chili , sage , herbs , stock , water and beans
7. Bring to a gentle boil then reduce heat to light simmer , cover and cook for about 2 hours
8. Check that beans are completely soft , then slurry with a wand mixer for 30 seconds , leaving about half of the beans in tact
9. Stir in the parsley , remove from heat and let stand , covered until cooled

title: grilled chicken breasts with chimichurri sauce
steps:
1. To make chimichurri sauce: in food processor fitted with metal blade , puree garlic
2. Add parsley and process until finely chopped
3. Add 3 / 4 cup oil , vinegar , water or chicken broth , and seasonings , and process
4. Taste for seasoning and adjust if necessary
5. It should be very flavorful and spicy
6. For marinade: in small mixing bowl , combine 3 tablespoons of the chimichurri sauce , with remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil and mix until smooth
7. Taste for seasoning
8. Place chicken breasts in a sealable bag and pour in marinade , making sure marinade is evenly distributed
9. Zip bag and refrigerate 1 / 2 hour to 4 hours
10. Prepare barbecue for medium-heat grilling
11. Remove chicken from marinade and grill about 3 inches from flame , 7 to 10 minutes on each side or until no pink color is showing
12. Place on platter and serve with sauce on the side
13. Advance prep
14. Remove from fridge half an hour before serving

title: chewy nutella cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Sift together flour , cocoa , cinnamon , baking powder , baking soda and salt
3. Set aside dry ingredients
4. Cream together butter , granulated sugar and brown sugar until light and fluffy
5. Mix in nutella and vanilla extract
6. Mix in egg
7. Add flour mixture and mix until just incorporated
8. Add chocolate chips and hazelnuts
9. Refridgerate dough for about 15 minutes
10. Either drop small balls of dough or use hands to roll 1-inch diameter balls of dough and place on a cookie sheet
11. Bake for 10-11 minutes until the edges look set
12. Cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes then remove to cooling racks

title: beef with broccoli
steps:
1. Cut broccoli spears , then split into 2 or 4 sections
2. Slice stalk into thin slices
3. Mix cornstarch , soy sauce , sesame oil , sherry and beef
4. Heat 3 tblsp
5. Oil in frying pan until hot
6. Stir-fry broccoli 1 minute
7. Add 2 tblsp
8. Water
9. Cook 2 more minutes
10. Remove from pan
11. Set aside
12. Heat 3 more tblsp
13. Oil in frying pan until hot
14. Stir-fry beef mixture 2 minutes
15. Add broccoli to beef and stir well 2 more minutes
16. Serve hot

title: dracula s bones with raspberry sauce
steps:
1. Whisk the egg whites until stiff but not dry
2. Gradually whisk in the sugar and essence until the mixture stands in soft peaks
3. Spoon the meringue into a large piping bag fitted with a plain nozzle
4. Pipe bone shapes onto baking sheets lined with baking parchment
5. Bake in a pre-heated oven at 110c degrees for 1 1 / 2 hours till dry
6. Cool on a wire rack
7. Press raspberries and syrup through a fine sieve into a pan
8. Add jam and heat gently until it melts , stirring regularly
9. Serve sauce as a dip or pour over bones just before serving

title: oven meatball dinner
steps:
1. Put beef in large bowl
2. Saute onion and green pepper in 1 tbsp of oil until onion is tender
3. Add to meat
4. Mix lightly but throughly meat mixture , crumbs , salt , mustard , chili powder , eggs and 1 / 3 cup wine
5. Shape in 8 even balls
6. Roll in flour
7. Brown meat balls in 2 tbsp
8. Oil in large skillet
9. Remove to 3-quarter casserole
10. Stir reserved flour into drippings
11. Add remaining wine , tomato sauce , water and pepper
12. Cook , stirring until thickened
13. Put vegetables in casserole with meatballs
14. Pour gravy over top
15. Cover
16. Bake at 350f for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until all is tender

title: double decker tacos
steps:
1. Brown ground beef
2. Drain
3. Add taco seasoning according to packet directions
4. While beef is simmering put refried beans in a small sauce pan to warm over low heat
5. May need to add 1-2 tablespoons of water to the beans to thin them out a bit
6. Warm soft tortillas in a dry skillet over low to medium heat
7. You don't want to brown or crisp them at all
8. Just warm them on both sides so that they are pliable
9. Keep tortillas warm in foil
10. These can be placed in a warm oven if needed
11. Assemble the tacos:
12. Spread warm beans on a warm flour tortilla
13. Sprinkle beans with shredded cheese
14. Stand a taco shell in the center of tortilla spread with beans and cheese
15. Gently press the soft tortilla onto the sides of the taco shell
16. Fill taco shell with beef , more shredded cheese , shredded lettuce and salsa
17. Variation if you prefer not to use refried beans just use all cheese to "glue the soft tortilla to the taco shell
18. If you choose this option just cover the tortilla with a layer of shredded cheese while warming in skillet
19. As soon as the cheese is melted remove from skillet and place your taco shell in the middle , quickly folding up the sides so they stick to the taco shell
20. Fill taco and enjoy !

title: orange you glad i made crispy tofu
steps:
1. In a small bowl , mix orange juice through coriander
2. Set aside
3. Fill a large , heavy-bottomed skillet with 1 / 2 inch of oil , heat over medium-high heat
4. While oil is heating , whisk together the cornstarch and salt in a small bowl
5. Dredge the tofu in the cornstarch mixture by tossing a few cubes at a time in the bowl and removing them onto a plate
6. Be sure to shake off extra cornstarch before frying
7. The oil is hot enough when bubbles form around the handle of a wooden spoon inserted in the oil
8. Carefully place tofu in the oil and let fry until the bottom is golden and crisp
9. Flip tofu using a spatula or tongs and fry until the other side is golden and crisp
10. Remove and drain on paper towels
11. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add fried tofu and orange mixture
12. Let cook until the sauce bubbles down to a thick syrupy sauce
13. Turn off heat and mix in cilantro
14. Serve over rice

title: weight watchers smart ones banana muffins by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine sugar , banana , milk , buttermilk , egg substitute , oil or applesauce , vanilla , banana flavoring , and lemon extract in a large bowl
3. Mix well with electric mixer on high speed
4. In a medium bowl , combine flour , baking soda , baking powder , salt , and walnuts
5. Mix the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients with the electric mixer
6. Pour batter into muffin cups about 2 / 3 full
7. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until muffins turn light brown on top

title: cincinnati turkey chili  cooking light
steps:
1. 1
2. Cook pasta according to package directions , omitting salt and fat
3. Drain
4. Set aside
5. 2
6. Heat a dutch oven over medium-high heat
7. Coat pan with cooking spray
8. Add turkey
9. Cook 3 minutes , stirring to crumble
10. Add 1 cup onion , bell pepper , and garlic
11. Saut 3 minutes
12. Stir in chili powder and next 5 ingredients
13. Cook 1 minute
14. Add broth , beans , and tomatoes
15. Bring to a boil
16. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 20 minutes , stirring occasionally
17. Remove from heat
18. Stir in chocolate and salt

title: microwave creamy apple cinnamon oatmeal
steps:
1. Place half and half cream , water , apple juice , chopped apples , rolled oats , brown sugar and cinnamon in a large microwave-safe bowl stir with a spoon
2. Microwave on high and cook until thickened and bubbly removing one or two times to stir
3. Divide into two bowls
4. Serve hot or warm then topped with milk or light cream and sprinkled with more brown sugar if desired

title: simple spinach dip  raw vegan
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients in food processor until smooth !
2. Enjoy with whatever you can get your hands on !

title: strawberry blush punch
steps:
1. Dissolve 1 1 / 2 cups sugar in 1 cup boiling water
2. Mix all other ingredients into sugar / water mixture
3. Freeze
4. To serve , scoop slush into glasses to about 2 / 3rds full
5. Top off with 7-up and serve immediately

title: risotto con parmigiano reggiano
steps:
1. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in heavy medium saucepan over medium-low heat
2. Add onion
3. Saut until very tender but not brown , about 15 minutes
4. Increase heat to medium
5. Add rice and stir 1 minute
6. Add 1 1 / 2 cups warm broth
7. Boil gently until broth is absorbed , stirring frequently
8. Add another 1 cup broth
9. Stir until broth is absorbed
10. Add remaining 2 1 / 2 cups broth , 1 / 2 cup at a time , allowing broth to be absorbed before adding more and stirring frequently until rice is tender and mixture is creamy , about 25 minutes
11. Stir in 2 tablespoons butter and 1 cup grated cheese
12. Season with freshly ground pepper
13. Transfer to bowl
14. Sprinkle with shaved parmesan

title: strawberry amaretto ice cream cocktail
steps:
1. Wash and hull the strawberries
2. Put them in a blender with the ice cream , milk , powdered sugar and amaretto
3. Blend until smooth
4. Taste and add more amaretto if desired- i like a hint of amaretto but you may prefer it stronger
5. Strain through a sieve to remove the strawberry seeds
6. Serve ice cold and enjoy !

title: chocolate gooey butter cookies   paula deen
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a large bowl cream the cream cheese and butter until smooth
3. Beat in egg
4. Then add in the vanilla
5. Add in the cake mix mixing in well
6. Dough will be very stiff
7. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours until firm enough to roll into balls
8. Roll the chilled dough into tablespoon sized balls
9. Roll in confectioner's sugar
10. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet , 2 inches apart
11. Bake 12 minutes
12. Allow to slightly cool and very carefully remove to wire racks to cool
13. Cool completely
14. Sprinkle with more confectioners sugar if desired

title: reese s peanut butter cups  copycat
steps:
1. In a small bowl , mix the salt , peanut butter and powdered sugar until firm
2. Melt the chocolate chips in a double boiler over hot , not boiling water
3. Grease muffin-tin cups and spoon some chocolate into each , filling halfway
4. With the back of a spoon , draw the chocolate up the edges of each cup until all sides are coated
5. Cool in the refrigerator until firm
6. Spread about a teaspoon of peanut butter mixture onto the chocolate in each cup , leaving room for the final chocolate layer
7. Pour some chocolate onto the top of each candy and spread it to the edges
8. Let sit at room temperature or covered in the refrigerator
9. Turn out of pan when firm

title: 15 minute stove top macaroni  n cheese
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of heavily salted water to a boil over high heat
2. Once boiling , add pasta , and cook according to manufacturers instructions
3. Drain pasta and return to the pot over very low heat
4. Add remaining ingredients and stir until cheese is melted
5. Season with additional salt and freshly ground black pepper as needed and serve

title: mama mac s very moist sage  dressing
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f mix all ingredients and place into greased 9x13 pan
2. Bake for 35-40 minutes until browned
3. Great served with roast chicken

title: pesto chili peanuts
steps:
1. In a small bowl , whisk the pesto mix , oil , chili powder and cayenne
2. Pour into a large resealable plastic bag
3. Add peanuts
4. Seal bag and shake to coat
5. Transfer to a greased 13-in
6. X 9-in
7. X 2-in
8. Baking pan
9. Bake , uncovered , at 350f for 15-20 minutes , stirring once
10. Spread on waxed paper to cool
11. Store in an airtight container

title: baked fresh mushroom patties
steps:
1. In bowl add mushrooms , onions , garlic , peppers and crumbs
2. Mix
3. In another mixing bowl , add egg , milk , oil , basil , salt , paprika
4. Add black pepper if you do not use hot peppers
5. Wisk until blended
6. Slowly add the egg mixture to the vegetables and crumbs
7. Mix with spoon
8. Preheat oven 400
9. Pack into a 1 / 3 cup measuring cup , press lightly
10. Turn over and tap lightly
11. Unmold on non-stick baking sheet
12. Based on a reviewer's comments which were helpful , spray pam or oil a baking sheet
13. Mine do not stick on a non-stick sheet put perhaps there are other brands that still stick
14. Bake 15 minutes
15. Use spatula and turn over
16. Bake another 15 minutes
17. Serve with coleslaw dressing or any sweet spicy dressing
18. Great with fish

title: aunt debbies cherry dessert
steps:
1. Soften gelatin in cold water
2. Heat milk , stir in gelatin
3. Beat until gelatin melts , set aside
