4. Beat cream cheese with powdered sugar until smooth
5. Add gelatin mixture
6. Beat until well blended
7. Prepare dream whip as directed
8. Mix well
9. Fold into cream cheese mixture
10. Place in serving bowl
11. Top with canned cherry pie filling
12. Refrigerate until completely chilled

title: bryan adams  pineapple ginger juice
steps:
1. Using a juicer , juice the pineapple and ginger together
2. Refrigerate until chilled
3. Using a blender and working in 2 batches , puree the pineapple juice with the peaches

title: white bean soup
steps:
1. Cover beans with water in large pot or soup kettle and soak overnight
2. Rinse beans well and return to pot with ham bone and 3 quarts of water
3. Simmer , uncovered , for 2 hours
4. Add parsley , onions , garlic , celery and tops , salt and pepper
5. Simmer , uncovered , for 1 hour or until vegetables are tender
6. Remove ham bone , dice the meat , and add meat to soup
7. Serve hot

title: classic crab and artichoke dip
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400
2. Pick over crab meat , removing shells
3. Set aside
4. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-low heat
5. Add onion , cook until golden , 3 minutes
6. Whisk in cream cheese , worcestershire sauce , horseradish , seafood seasoning and pepper sauce until combined completely , fold in artichoke hearts and crab meat
7. Pour mixture into a shallow , ungreased 3-cup oven-proof bowl or 8-inch square baking dish
8. Sprinkle cheese evenly over the top and bake until bubbling and golden , 30 minutes
9. Serve with crackers

title: easy mexican pizza
steps:
1. Spread pizza sauce evenly on tortilla
2. Add as many tomato slices that you would like
3. Sprinkle mozzerella cheese on top
4. Bake at 350 for 8-10 minutes
5. Fold in half or cut into slices

title: bev s classic french vanilla ice cream
steps:
1. In a saucepan , beat egg yolks with whisk
2. Add sugar and continue beating until thick
3. Stir in half and half
4. Heat and stir until thickened
5. Remove from heat and cool
6. Stir in heavy cream and vanilla extract
7. Cover and chill in refrigerator an hour until needed
8. Pour into ice cream maker and process according to your machine's direction
9. Makes about 1 quart

title: pimento cheese  no mayonnaise
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients very well
2. Store pimento cheese in an airtight container in the refrigerator
3. To make this into a hot dip , simply heat in a crock pot until bubbly

title: green tea truffles
steps:
1. Place chocolate in medium bowl
2. In small saucepan , bring half-and-half to a simmer over medium heat
3. Remove from heat and add tea bags
4. Allow to steep 5 minutes
5. Gently squeeze tea bags over half-and-half to extract extra flavor and discard
6. Return to a simmer and then pour over chocolate
7. Stir to combine
8. Place bowl in freezer and chill until set , about 10 minutes , stirring every 2 minutes
9. When mixture hardens , scoop out 2 teaspoons and roll in palms to form 1-inch ball
10. Repeat with remaining chocolate mixture
11. Place cocoa in shallow dish
12. Roll balls in cocoa to coat
13. Shake off excess
14. Serve or store in airtight container in refrigerator up to 2 weeks

title: tarragon   green bean potato salad
steps:
1. Combine mayonnaise , dijon , vinegar , shallots , tarragon and lemon juice in a large bowl for the dressing
2. Set aside
3. Boil potatoes in salted water for 10 minutes
4. Add green beans
5. Cook until potatoes are tender when pierced , 3-4 minutes
6. Remove potatoes and beans
7. Plunge the vegetables in ice water to cool
8. Drain , then quarter potatoes
9. Toss potatoes and green beans with dressing to coat
10. Season with salt and pepper
11. Serve salad chilled or at room temperature

title: tilapia kali kali
steps:
1. Coat tilapia fillets in slight oil and grill till softly cooked
2. Whilst fish is cooking , heat some butter in a pan
3. Add chilli powder to the butter
4. Continue to stir well
5. Add black pepper and continue to stir
6. Add lime / lemon to the sauce
7. Remove from heat , place fish in a flat holding dish and pour sauce over the fish
8. Waah-la

title: quick potatoes
steps:
1. Peel potatoes , if desired
2. Cut into 1 / 2" thick slices
3. Melt butter and stir soup mix inches
4. Layer potatoes in casserole dish and cover each layer with onion butter mixture , ending with butter mix
5. Bake covered for 1 hour

title: eggplant parmesan with garlic and white beans
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In a flat bottom bowl , whisk egg whites , salt , 2 cloves garlic
3. In another bowl , mix bread crumbs , basil , and parmesean / romano mixture
4. Lightly spray two baking sheets with olive oil and drizzle a small amount on the whole garlic head
5. Cut eggplant into 1 / 2 inch rounds and dip into egg mixture then batter in bread crumbs
6. Place eggplant and garlic head on baking sheets
7. Cook until tender
8. Drain and rinse white beans
9. In 2 8x11 baking dishes , put a thin layer of tomato sauce
10. When garlic head is finished and cool enough to touch , peel out the cloves and mash them into the white beans to make a paste
11. Put a layer of eggplant rounds on top of the tomato sauce
12. Spread bean / garlic paste evenly on rounds
13. Add half the cheese and a cup of sauce
14. Place the rest of the eggplant in a second layer
15. Add any leftover bread crumbs , sauce and cheese
16. Bake 25 min until cheese is bubbly

title: ramen noodle frittata
steps:
1. Place noodles in a saucepan filled with boiling water , reserving the seasoning packet

4. Mix in noodles

7. Cut into fourths , and turn over to brown the other side for 1 to 2 minutes
8. Sprinkle cheese over the top , and serve

title: christmas cranberry punch
steps:
1. Mix the orange and cranberry juices in a bowl
2. Slowly pour in the lemon-lime pop into the bowl trying not to
3. Make too many bubbles
4. Float the whole cranberries on the top of the punch

title: mango malai
steps:
1. Put mango , yogurt , sugar , lemon juice , nutmeg and salt into blender & process until smooth
2. Spoon into 4 serving dishes , if desired , garnish with grapes cut in 1 / 2 , seeds removed
3. Enjoy !

title: granny s chocolate icing
steps:
1. Put all ingredients , except the vanilla , in a large pot
2. Bring to a boil over low to medium-low heat , stirring constantly
3. Let the mixture boil for 1 minute
4. Remove from heat and add the vanilla

title: milk and honey  yeast free  brown and serve rolls
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f butter a 8 1 / 2 x 4 1 / 2 x 2 1 / 2 inch loaf pan or if you want them in traditional brown and serve roll style then butter as many cupcake pans as you have or will need

4. Stir in melted butter , set aside to cool

7. Set aside
8. Whisk egg into cooled milk mixture until blended
9. Add to flour mixture in mixer bowl
10. Beat at medium speed of electric mixer just until blended
11. Pour mixture into buttered pan and smooth the top
12. Or using a teaspoon spoon out spoonfuls of batter and place them in the cupcake pans
13. If you put in four spoonfuls they will come out kind of clover leaf shaped
14. Bake at 350f for 15 minutes
15. Bake on a high rack in the oven for 10-12 minutes or until the rolls are firm but not golden
16. Let rolls cool in pan until they are cool enough to touch comfortably

title: yorkshire beef pie
steps:
1. In a large skillet , cook beef and onion until beef is browned
2. Drain
3. Add vegetables and 1 / 4 cup gravy
4. Stir water and worcestershire sauce into remaining gravy
5. Set aside
6. In a 10-inch pie plate , place butter and put into a 425f oven
7. In a small bowl combine milk and eggs , add flour salt and pepper
8. Beat until smooth
9. When butter is melted remove from the oven add the egg mixture into the hot dish
10. Spoon meat mixture evenly over bottom , keeping 1 inch from the edge
11. Return to oven and bake for 25-30 minutes or until browned and puffed
12. Heat gravy and pass with the pie

title: california stand by salsa dip
steps:
1. Put cream cheese in a low sided bowl
2. Pour salsa on top of cheese
3. Allow to come to room temperature
4. Serve with tortilla chips

title: baked sweet potatoes with cinnamon butter
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400

title: tomatoes provencales
steps:
1. Preheat broiler in oven

4. Put tomato halves , cut side up , in baking pan just large enough to hold them
5. Pour 1 tblsp olive oil over minced parsley and stir to coat

7. Drizzle a teaspoon of olive oil over each tomato half and cook under the grill until tomatoes have softened and are slightly charred on cut surface
8. Serve with grilled or roasted meats

title: dairy free low fat pumpkin pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f degrees

title: green bean and walnut salad  mtsvani lobios pkhali
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine the walnuts , garlic , vinegar , lemon juice , water , and oil

11. Serve either chilled or at room temperature

title: carrots and raisins  healthy snack
steps:
1. Place raisins in a small amount of water , so they plump up a little
2. Grate carrots on a smallest part of your grater
3. Combine grated carrots , sour cream , raisins and then add sugar
4. We love it just the way it is and my l'il one gets his nutrition

title: chocolate chunk coffee cake
steps:
1. Oven 350 degrees

3. Combine for topping: chocolate , nuts , 2 / 3 cup sugar and set aside
4. Beat sugar and butter till light and fluffy

title: strawberries and cream trifle
steps:
1. In a chilled bowl with chilled beaters , whip the cream until thickened
2. Beat in the sugar and the vanilla , continue beating until stiff peaks form

steps:

4. Place in a slightly greased pan and bake on 400 for 10-14 minutes

title: strawberry lemonade concentrate  bottled
steps:
1. Rinse and drain the strawberries quickly

3. Squeeze the lemon juice and measure
4. You will probably need about 16 lemons , or 24 limes , but buy a few extra as they can vary quite a bit in juiciness

title: bay ridge empanadas
steps:

title: risotto alla milanese
steps:
1. Put 30 g of the butter in a large pan and melt it
2. Add the finely chopped onion
3. Sweat over a medium heat for about 2 minutes
4. Add the bone marrow and continue cooking for another 3 minutes , breaking it with the spoon while stirring
5. Once the onion is soft , add the rice and and stir until the rice is completely coated with the fat
6. You can see that the rice will start to become translucent , keep stirring and sweat the rice for a minute or two
7. Then , add the white wine , keep stirring and let the wine evaporate
8. Now , add the stock and turn the heat to medium / low , the stock , which is kept simmering in order to stay hot , should be added at the rate of a couple of ladlefuls at a time and when this is absorbed , add more stock
9. Carry on in this way for about 15 minutes , during this stage , do not leave the pan alone and stir regularly
10. After 15 minutes , you will probably need an extra 3 to 5 minutes to complete the final stage of cooking
11. From now on , taste the rice every minute until the rice is cooked al dente
12. At the same time , the tasting will tell you if you need to adjust seasoning with salt
13. Regular but gentle stirring is required for the last minutes in order to avoid the risotto sticking to the bottom of the pan
14. In these last minutes , if the stock is completely absorbed , you can gradually add a bit more because at this final stage you do not want the risotto becoming too watery
15. Now , at about the 15th minute , put the saffron powder into a glass
16. Add half a ladle of stock and dissolve the saffron stirring with a small spoon and then add the saffron into the pan
17. Stir until all the rice is uniformly coloured
18. Continue cooking and adding stock as required
19. When the rice is perfectly cooked "al dente" , add the parmesan cheese and stir for few seconds until the parmesan has melted
20. Then , put the cooker off , add all the remaining butter and stir until completely melted
21. Cover the pan with a lid for about 1 minute and allow the risotto to rest before serving it
22. Risotto should be served "all'onda"
23. This means that when you serve it onto the plate , it should still flow a little
24. Buon appetito !

steps:
1. - dissolve the beef bouillon cube in about 3 tbs of hot water

title: ribbon cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter until light and fluffy
2. Add sugar gradually
3. Add egg and vanilla , mixing well after each addition
4. In another bowl , mix together the flour , salt , and baking powder
5. Slowly add to the butter mixture , making sure all ingredients are incorporated
6. Divide dough into three equal parts
7. Add a few drops of red food coloring to one third , mixing until the color is even
8. Add cocoa and pecans to one third , mixing well
9. Leave the other third plain
10. Line a loaf pan with wax paper or foil
11. Press the chocolate layer into the bottom of the pan , pressing firmly to make the dough as flat and even as possible on top
12. Add the plain dough to the pan , again making an even layer on top of the chocolate
13. On top of the plain dough , add the red , pressing down flat on top
14. Wrap the dough completely , leave it in the loaf pan , and chill over night , or until firm enough to slice
15. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
16. Remove dough from loaf pan and place on cutting board
17. Cut the dough lenghth-wise , down the middle , so you have two long "bars" of dough
18. Put one bar back in the refrigerator , to keep chilled while you work with the other
19. Slice into about 1 / 8" slices , or thicker if you like them a little softer
20. The thinner they are sliced , the crispier they will be
21. Bake for about 10 minutes at 325 degrees
22. Take them out when the bottoms are just browned
23. Try not to overbake , or they will lose their pretty color
24. Cool on wire rack

title: apricot and brandy jam
steps:
1. Combine apricots and water in a bowl , cover , and let stand overnight , or until soft and well plumped
2. Combine apricots and their soaking water in saucepan with the orange peel and juice and simmer for 5 minutes
3. Add the sugar and bring to boil , while stirring
4. Boil gently , stirring often , until the mixture is thick and shiny and begins to clear the sides of the pan when stirred
5. While mixture thickens , be sure to stir it continually but gently , so that the fruit does not burn or get squashed
6. Do not allow the mixture to cook down to a puree
7. It should retain good-sized bits of apricot
8. Remove the preserve from heat and stir in almond extract and brandy
9. Ladle into 3 half-pint canning jars , prepared in usual manner and seal with sterilized 2 piece screw-on lids
10. Cool and let mellow several weeks or more before serving

9. Reduce heat to low

steps:

2. In a large bowl , mix cottage cheese , mozzarella cheese , eggs , parsley , onion powder , basil and pepper until well blended
3. Set aside

4. Transfer soup to a blender

6. Serve hot

title: cashew truffles
steps:
1. In a food processor with a steel blade , process cashews until finely ground
2. Add confectioners sugar and powdered milk and continue processing until completely combined
3. Add egg white product , lemon juice and madeira , and process until stiff dough forms
4. Scrape into a bowl , cover airtight and refrigerate at least 8 hours or up to 2 days
5. When ready to make the truffles , form the dough into 1-inch balls and put on waxed paper
6. Refrigerate while melting the chocolate
7. Bring about 1 inch of water to just below simmering in a small skillet
8. Put semisweet chocolate chips in a 2-cup heatproof glass measure
9. Place glass measure in the water and stir the chips until melted
10. Leave glass measure in the simmering water while dipping
11. Remove dough balls from the refrigerator , and using a toothpick or small skewer , quickly swirl a ball in chocolate until completely coated
12. Let excess chocolate drip back into the glass measure
13. Put ball into a 1-inch paper petit four cup and gently remove toothpick
14. Repeat for remaining balls
15. If undipped balls get sticky , return them to fridge for a few minutes
16. Use a toothpick dipped in melted chocolate to fill in any toothpick holes
17. Refrigerate truffles until chocolate hardens
18. Put white chocolate chips in a small zip-lock bag and seal
19. Microwave until melted , checking after 30 seconds and then again every 15 seconds
20. Knead the chips in the bag until smooth
21. Snip a tiny hole in one corner of the bag and squeeze decorative squiggles on truffles
22. Refrigerate until serving

title: ken s chili

title: everyday cake

steps:
1. Remove tenders from packaging and rinse
2. Add the mustard , mayo , dressing , onion , garlic powder and mix well
3. Allow the chicken to marinate for at least 20 minute i like to poke the tenders with a fork at this time to ensure thorough frying
4. In a large flat serving plate combine flour , bread crumbs , cheez-its , essence
5. Get your skillet ready by adding veg oil and set on high
6. Take each tender and take off excess marinade
7. Roll around in the cheez-it coating
8. Start frying
9. You want it to be nice and golden in color
10. After your second batch , you may want to turn down the stove slightly
11. You dont want a burnt coating
12. These are the only chicken tender , nugget , whatever--that my kids dont need to drench it in ketchup or bbq sauce
13. I do serve it with a honey mustard sauce for those who desire
14. Honey mustard sauce:
15. 2 tblsp honey
16. 1 / 4 cup spicy brown mustard
17. 2 tblsp mayo

title: comfort and cream
steps:
1. Combine ingredients with ice in a shaker
2. Shake well and strain into a short glass or leave over ice
3. Optional garnish: sprinkle with shaved chocolate or chocolate sprinkles
4. Also great rimmed with chocolate syrup !

title: almond macaroon cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix butter , sugar , extract and eggs till everything is well blended
3. Mix in flour till well incorporated
4. Pour into a non-stick 8" x 10" pan that has been sprayed with a non stick spray
5. Sprinkle top with almonds
6. Bake till golden brown , approximately 30-40 minute

title: bacon cheddar chicken fillet melt
steps:
1. Cook bacon in large skillet over medium heat until crisp
2. Remove bacon
3. Drain on paper towels
4. Reserve 1 tablespoon drippings in skillet
5. Add onion
6. Cook and stir 2 to 4 minutes or until tender
7. Remove onion from skillet
8. Add chicken to skillet
9. Cook 6 to 8 minutes on each side or until browned and no longer pink
10. Place toasted bread slices on cookie sheet
11. Spread each slice with 1 teaspoon steak sauce
12. Top with chicken , bacon slices , onion and cheese
13. Broil 4 to 6 inches from heat for 1 to 2 minutes or until cheese is melted

title: downeaster
steps:
1. Fill an old fashioned glass with ice
2. Fill half with cranberry juice and half with pineapple juice
3. Add vodka
4. Stir and garnish with lime

title: houston ham and cheese kolaches
steps:
1. Sponge: mix together yeast and 2 cups of flour
2. Add the rest of the sponge ingredients
3. Mix with spoon until thoroughly combined and then put in your refrigerator overnight
4. The next morning , stir the sponge lightly and add the salt
5. Begin adding flour until it forms into a dough ball
6. If there is little humidity , this could be as little as one cup
7. If you are here in houston , i usually end up putting in a couple and then kneading another half cup
8. Once you have a doughball , let it rest for 20 minutes
9. Knead for 10 minutes on a lightly floured surface , adding flour as needed
10. The dough should be very easy to knead , fairly loose
11. Place kneaded dough into a bowl , lightly oiled and turn dough so that it is covered with oil
12. Let it rise until doubled in size , about an hour
13. Meanwhile , mix together ham and cheese
14. Punch down dough
15. Divide into 32 small balls
16. Take each ball and flatten with your hand to a 3" circle
17. Place one tablespoon ham and cheese mixture into the center of each circle and close into a ball , twisting the opening closed
18. Make sure the opening is well sealed , or the kolaches will burst open in the oven
19. Place filled balls seam side down onto greased cookie sheets
20. Cover and let rise again for half an hour
21. Meanwhile , preheat your oven to 375 degrees f
22. Brush kolaches with melted butter
23. Bake for 12-15 minutes , or until golden colored
24. You don't want these to get brown , or they will be too dry
25. Just golden , like biscuits or dinner rolls
26. Baked kolaches can be frozen , thawed , and reheated in the microwave

title: low fat  sugar free tapioca pudding
steps:
1. Soak tapioca over night in 2 1 / 2 cups cold water
2. Drain tapioca and place in crock pot with milk and cook on high for 2 hours
3. Mix yolks and agave
4. Temper and add into crock
5. Cook for 15 more

title: turkey spinach mealoaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Heat a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over med-high
3. Add onion and saute 4 min , add garlic and saute 30 seconds
4. Remove from heat
5. Combine onion mixture , crumbs , and next 8 ingredients , mixing well
6. Shape meat into a 12x5 inch loaf on a broiler pan coated with cooking spray
7. Brush ketchup over the top
8. Bake at 350 for 45-60 min or til a thermometer registers 160 degrees
9. Let stand 10 min before slicing

title: pudin de pan chocolate
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease 1
3. 5 qt pan
4. Combine 2 c milk , sugar , chocolate chips , butter and heat to melt chocolate and butter on stove or in microwave
5. Remove from heat and stir in bread cubes , cinnamon , vanilla , and remaining 1 cup of milk
6. Stir in eggs
7. Let sit 5 minutes
8. Pour into greased pan
9. Bake 45-55 minutes , until knife comes out clean
10. Serve warm with whipped cream

title: instant magic white sauce mix
steps:
1. Put flour , milk , and salt in a bowl and mix well
2. Add butter and mix well with pastry cutter until crumbly
3. Put in a glass jar , cover tightly and store in refrigerator
4. Makes 7 cups
5. To make sauce: combine mix with 1 cup milk in a small deep heavy saucepan
6. Cook over medium heat , stirring frequently , for about 2 minutes
7. Remove from heat and use as desired

title: linzer bar
steps:
1. In a large bowl stir together flour , sugar , brown sugar , baking powder , salt and cinnamon
2. With a pastry blender or two knives use scissor style , cut in butter or margarine until coarse crumbs form
3. With a fork stir in corn syrup and egg just until mixed
4. Reserve 1 / 2 cup batter
5. Press remaining batter into a 9x9x2-inch baking pan
6. Spread with jam
7. Stir 2 tablespoons flour into the reserved batter
8. If preparing a lattice add a couple tablespoons of water - one at a time - to make the dough easy to roll out
9. If you are dropping the dough by spoonfulls then just evenly scatter the top "crust" over the jam for a "spotty" look and bake
10. On a floured surface roll out to 1 / 4-inch thickness
11. Cut into 1 / 4-inch wide strips
12. Lattice strips over jam
13. Bake in 375-degree oven 30 minutes , or until set
14. Cool
15. Cut into bars
16. Serving size is really up to you - cut into as many bars as you want

title: seared swordfish with artichoke and olive  tetsuya
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 275 dgrees f
2. In an oven-safe non-stick frying pan over high heat , add the grapeseed oil and then sear the swordfish fillets on both sides
3. Transfer the frying pan and fillets to the oven for a few minutes only to help the fillets cook through -- ideally , you will remove the fish when they are medium-rare
4. Trim the artichoke , cut in half and remove the choke
5. Cut each half into half again , put into a pan containing water , the lemon juice and salt
6. And cook until tender
7. To make the sauce , put the soy sauce , mirin , olive oil , black olive paste , garlic and chicken stock into a saucepan , stir , and gently heat
8. Just before serving , wilt the rocket in the sauce and then remove with a slotted spoon onto a plate
9. To serve , warm 4 plates
10. Place the wakame in the center , with the swordfish on top of it
11. Place an artichoke quarter by the side of the fillet
12. Garnish with parsley , scallions , rocket and tomato
13. You may dress the fillet with sauce or pass the sauce separately

title: peach raspberry cobbler gob
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Toss peaches with 1 / 3 cup sugar and arrange in a buttered , 11x14 inch glass baking dish
3. Sprinkle raspberries evenly over the top
4. In a small bowl , mix flour , 1 cup sugar , baking powder , milk , egg and butter
5. Pour mixture over fruit in a striped pattern , so some fruit shows through
6. Sprinkle with cinnamon and a little sugar
7. Bake 45 minutes at 350f , until topping is golden

title: cream cheese cutout cookies
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , beat together butter , cream cheese and sugar until fluffy
2. Add egg , vanilla and almond extracts
3. Beat well
4. In a small bowl , combine flour and baking powder- gradually mix into cream cheese mixture
5. Beat until well-mixed
6. Divide dough in half
7. Wrap each half in plastic wrap and chill for at least 1 1 / 2 hours
8. When dough is done chilling , preheat oven to 375
9. Roll dough on to lightly floured surface to about 1 / 8"-1 / 4" thickness
10. Cut with cookie cutters
11. Place on ungreased cookie sheets
12. Bake at 375 for 8-10 minutes or until edges just slightly golden
13. Allow to cool 2 minutes before removing to wire racks to cool
14. If desired , decorate with icing or glaze

title: beef stuffing bake
steps:
1. In a skillet , cook beef and onion over medium heat until meat is no longer pink
2. Drain
3. Transfer to an ungreased 13-in
4. X 9-in
5. Baking dish
6. In a large bowl , combine contents of stuffing seasoning packet , soups , mushrooms , water and vegetables
7. Sprinkle stuffing over beef mixture
8. Top with soup mixture
9. Bake , uncovered , at 350 for 30 minutes or until heated through

title: butterscotch mousse
steps:
1. In a food processor , grind the cashews approximately 2 minutes until they are the consistency of ground meal
2. Add the dates and process 1 minute or until you reach a pasty consistency
3. Gradually add the water and blend until smooth and creamy
4. Add the nutmeg , cinnamon , and butterscotch extract and process a couple more seconds until completely blended
5. Serve in chilled glasses layered with slices of kiwi

title: baba ghannouji hummus
steps:
1. Preheat oven at 350 degrees f
2. Slice , then roast eggplant in oven with olive oil drizzled over it on a jelly roll pan lined with parchment paper for 45 minutes
3. In a blender combine sesame tahini , lemon juice , garlic , salt , black pepper , onion powder , coriander , parsley , cumin
4. Peel roasted eggplant slices and add them to the blender
5. Blend until smooth and serve with pita
6. Enjoy !

title: beef stew  with roasted root vegetables
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350
2. Heat a large dutch oven , with a lid , over medium-high heat
3. In a large bowl or ziplock bag , add the meat: generously sprinkle with salt and pepper , and lightly coat with the flour
4. Add the oil to the pot , lay the meat in the pan and sear on all sides until a deep mahogany brown , about 10 minutes
5. Transfer the meat to a plate
6. Pour all but about 2 tablespoons of the oil from the pan , add more oil if necessary
7. Add the onion and garlic to the pan , and cook until fragrant and soft , about 5 minutes
8. Add the diced tomatoes w / liquid to the pot , and cook until a deep brick red , about 2 minutes more
9. Add the wine , and with a wooden spoon scrape up any browned bits that cling to the bottom of the pot
10. Add the beef broth , thyme , and bay leaves , and bring to a boil
11. Return stew meat to the pot , nestle it in the liquid , cover and transfer pot to the oven
12. Cook until the meat is just tender , about 1 1 / 2 hours
13. Meanwhile , in a large bowl or zip lock bag: toss the onions , carrots , parsnips , and potatoes with the olive oil , salt , and pepper
14. Spread out on a oil sprayed baking sheet in 1 layer
15. You may have to use 2 baking sheets
16. Cut to similar size
17. The veggies can be roasted in a 350 oven for about 45 -60 minutes while stew / roast is cooking
18. Once the meat comes out of the oven , raise the temperature to 450 degrees f
19. Roast the vegetables , turning about halfway through cooking , until caramelized and tender , about 30 to 45 minutes
20. While roasting the root veggies , keep the stew meat warm in the sauce on the stove top until ready to serve
21. Place the veggies in the pot before serving
22. Stir gently to combine

title: lavender sugar
steps: 1. Mix together and keep in a tightly lidded jar for about 2 weeks before use

title: greek style roasted chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Brush chicken with oil
3. Combine oregano , parsley , garlic powder , and garlic salt
4. Rub onto chicken
5. Combine spinach , feta , ham , bread , pine nuts , chives , butter , and pepper
6. Slip fingers in between skin and breast , and lightly stuff the pockets on both sides
7. Lightly spoon stuffing into main cavity and neck , if desired
8. Place in broiling pan , breast side up
9. Roast for approximately 1 1 / 2 hours , or until meat thermometer reads 180 when inserted into thigh , and juices run clear
10. Serve with greek-style rice and veggies !

title: zabaglione sauce
steps:
1. Combine the egg yolks , sugar and sweet wine in the top of a double saucepan , over hot water
2. If you're a sure-handed cook , you could try using a small saucepan with a heavy bottom
3. Whisk this mixture , preferably with a wire whisk , all the time until the mixture coats the back of a spoon
4. Stir in the 1 1 / 2 tablespoons hard liquor
5. Serve immediately , or keep warm for as briefly as possible , covered , over hot water

title: sweet and nutty raisin bran muffins
steps:
1. Sift together dry ingredients except for the cereal
2. Mix applesauce , sugar , & syrup together
3. Add the flour mixture to the syrup mixture
4. Next add cereal
5. Last fold in the egg whites
6. Spoon batter into a lightly greased or sprayed muffin pan
7. Mix together the sugar and the pecans
8. Sprinkle topping on to the batter
9. Bake muffins in a 400 preheated oven for 15- 20 minutes
10. Let cool or serve hot with sweet honey butter , or just plain , their great !

title: cheddar cornmeal muffins
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425 degrees
2. Grease 12 muffin cups
3. Blend flour , cornmeal , baking powder , salt , and cayenne
4. Beat egg with milk and butter
5. Add to dry ingredients
6. Stir until thoroughly moistened
7. Stir in 1 cup of the cheese and spoon into muffin cups
8. Sprinkle 1 tsp of cheese over each muffin
9. Bake 15 to 20 minutes
10. Serve hot with butter or freeze and reheat right before serving

title: the easiest bisquick banana  nut   bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease bottom only of loaf pan , 9x5x3 inches
3. In large mixing bowl , combine all ingredients except bisquick and nuts
4. Stir until blended
5. Stir in bisquick and nuts
6. Pour into prepared loaf pan
7. Bake banana bread for 50-60 minutes , or until toothpick in center comes out clean
8. Cool 10 minutes loosen sides of loaf from pan and remove to wire rack to cool completely

title: chicken cacciatore  pressure cooker
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a 4-quart or larger cooker
2. Add the shallots and bell pepper and cook over medium-high heat , stirring frequently , until the shallots soften slightly , about 2 minutes
3. Stir in the wine and boil until about half evaporates
4. Scrape up any browned bits sticking to the bottom of the cooker
5. Stir in the mushrooms and garlic
6. Set the chicken on top
7. Cover the chicken with crushed tomatoes
8. Do not stir
9. Plop the tomato paste on top
10. Lock the lid in place
11. Over high heat bring to high pressure
12. Reduce the heat just enough to maintain high pressure and cook for 8 minutes
13. Turn off the heat
14. Allow the pressure to come down naturally
15. Remove the lid , tilting it away from you to allow steam to escape
16. Stir in the olives , parsley , red pepper flakes , cheese , and salt and pepper , to taste

title: sausage brown rice casserole
steps:
1. Cook& stir sausage in dutch oven until brown
2. Drain
3. Stir in rice , milk , celery , green pepper , onion , soup and mushrooms
4. Pour into ungreased 2 quart casserole and sprinkle with cheese
5. Cook uncovered in 350f oven until center is bubbly , about 45 minutes

title: lentil casserole with white wine
steps:
1. Combine all of the ingredients in a large bowl
2. Pour the mixture into a 1-1 / 2 quart casserole
3. Place the casserole into the oven and bake for 1-1 / 2 to 2 hours
4. Remove when the casserole is moist but not runny
5. Sprinkle with cheese and bake for another five minutes

title: poached halibut with tomato and basil
steps:
1. Season fish with salt and pepper
2. In a large skillet add the oil
3. Arrange fish in the pan and turn to coat in oil , then add garlic , shallots and wine
4. Top each fillet of fish with 1 / 4 of the tomatoes
5. Place the pan on the stove top and bring the liquid to a boil over medium high heat
6. Top the pan with a tight fitting lid and reduce heat to moderate
7. Cook fish 8 to 10 minutes until opaque and flaky , but not dry
8. Carefully transfer fish topped with tomatoes to dinner plates or serving plate with a thin spatula
9. Spoon pan juices over the fish
10. Squeeze the wedge of lemon over the cooked fish and top each fillet with lots of torn or shredded basil
11. Serve immediately

title: spicey peanut dip
steps:
1. Position knife blade in a food processor bowl
2. Add the first three ingredients
3. Process for 2 minutes , stopping once to scrape down the sides
4. Add the water and the remaining ingredients
5. Process until blended
6. Serve with veggies !

title: mexicali marinade
steps:
1. Mix together all the ingredients except the meat
2. Pour the marinade over the meat
3. Turn the meat so that each piece is covered
4. Refrigerate for 2-3 hours
5. Grill the meat or bake it at 350 degrees until it is no longer pink in the center
6. 20-30 minutes
7. Baste with the remaining marinade occasionally during cooking

title: crunchy noodle salad
steps:
1. Remove heavy , thick veins from cabbage
2. Shred cabbage and combine with scallions
3. Break noodles , discarding flavor packages
4. Melt butter in medium frying pan
5. Add noodles , almonds and sesame seeds
6. Brown mixture , stirring occasionally
7. Mix all ingredients for salad dressing
8. Add dressing just before serving
9. Do not mix with cabbage until you are ready to serve

title: sour cream and horseradish sauce
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients in a small bowl
2. Cover and let stand at room temperature for 1 hour for the flavors to blend
3. Refrigerate any leftovers

title: garlic soup gratin  cream of garlic soup
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. In a pot , cover garlic and bay leaves with 2 cups cold water
3. Bring to a boil , then drain
4. Repeat process 3 times
5. In a large dutch oven , over medium heat , fry bacon until crisp
6. Remove bacon from pan and set aside
7. Discard all but 1 tablespoon grease
8. Add the onions and leeks and season with salt and pepper
9. Cook , covered , over medium-low heat , stirring occasionally , until onions are tender
10. Add garlic , broth , cream , bacon , and thyme to onion / leek mixture and simmer , uncovered , for 8-10 minutes
11. On a baking sheet , bake the bread slices until crisp but not golden
12. Remove bay leaves from soup
13. Discard
14. In a food processor or blender , pure the soup until smooth
15. Pour soup into serving bowls
16. Rub each slice of toast on both sides with the cut sides of a garlic clove
17. Top each bowl with toast and sprinkle with cheese
18. Heat under broiler until golden brown
19. Sprinkle with chives
20. Serve hot

title: french scrambled eggs  adapted from julia child
steps:
1. Place eggs , salt and pepper , and liquid in a mixing bowl and beat for 20-30 seconds
2. Smear bottom and sides of pan with butter
3. Pour in the eggs
4. Cook over moderately low heat , stirring slowly and continuously , reaching all over bottom of pan
5. Nothing will seem to happen for the first 2-3 minutes
6. Suddenly the eggs will begin to thicken into a custard
7. Stir rapidly , moving pan on and off heat , until they have almost thickened to your desired consistency
8. Remove from heat immediately the eggs will continue to cook slightly
9. As soon as they have reached the desired consistency , add the enrichment , which will stop the cooking
10. Season to taste , arrange on plates and garnish with parsley
11. Variations:
12. Aux fines herbes: beat a tablespoon of minced fresh herbs such as parsley , chervil , chives and tarragon into eggs at the beginning
13. Sprinkle on more herbs just before serving
14. Au fromage: stir 4-6 t
15. Grated swiss cheese into eggs along with the enrichment butter at the end
16. Aux truffes: stir 1 or 2 diced truffles into eggs before scrambling
17. Sprinkle a bit of chopped truffle over eggs before serving
18. Garnishings: ham , bacon , sausages , broiled or sauteed mushrooms , kidneys , chicken livers , sauteed eggplant or zucchini , broiled tomatoes , piperade , diced sauteed potatoes , buttered peas , asparagus

title: calico beans   baked beans w  3 kinds of beans
steps:
1. Fry bacon until crisp
2. Drain
3. Fry ground beef in fat until tender
4. Combine onion , ketchup , salt , mustard , vinegar , brown sugar , and partly drain beans in a 3 quart oven container
5. Mix well
6. Add hamburger and crumbled bacon
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes

title: west african s finest  mafe
steps:
1. In a large pot over medium heat , heat the peanut oil
2. Add the carrots , garlic , potatoes , sweet potatoes and onions and mix well
3. Stir in the tomato paste , paprika , cayenne , cumin , thyme sprigs , chickpeas , salt and black pepper and mix well
4. Add the stock , making sure the level of the stock is above the veggies in the pot
5. Add additional salt and pepper to taste
6. Cover and bring to boil
7. Reduce the heat and simmer until the veggies are tender , 20 to 25 minutes
8. Turn off the heat but leave the pot on the stove
9. Stir in the creamy peanut butter , mix well and let sit for 5 minutes before serving
10. Serve with basmati rice , quinoa , couscous or fufu

title: sauce for chicken cordon bleu
steps:
1. Combine last 5 ingredients in a large glass measuring cup
2. Heat to just warm in microwave to help dissolve bouillon
3. Melt butter in saucepan on low
4. Add flour and stir until smooth and bubbly
5. Add milk mixture and heat

title: cucumbers in sour cream   low fat or non fat
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , except cucumber , in a bowl and mix to combine
2. Then add cucumber and mix together
3. Refrigerate 1 / 2 hr or more to combine flavors

title: gourmet rosemary sea salt blend
steps: 1. Combine and store in an airtight container until ready to use

title: healthy morning cookies
steps:
1. Preheat 350 degrees
2. Mix wet
3. Combine dry
4. Then carefully combine together
5. Put 1 / 4 cup batter on baking sheet with parchment paper
6. Sprinkle with sugar in raw
7. Bake 12 minutes and let cool

title: quick and easy black bean soup
steps:
1. Place bacon pieces , onion , vegetables and broth into a shallow glass dish and cover with paper towel
2. Microwave on high 2-3 minutes or until vegetables are soft
3. Using a blender , blend 1 can of black beans with the vegetables and bacon
4. Transfer the mixture to a saucepan
5. Blend 1 / 2 of the second can in the blender
6. Pour the blended beans and the remaining whole beans into the saucepan and add tomato sauce and seasonings
7. Bring to a simmer , stirring constantly
8. Taste and add salt if desired
9. Stir the milk into the sour cream and mix well
10. Pour into a squirt bottle or small zip-top bag and snip the corner
11. Ladle the soup into the serving bowls and garnish with sour cream-milk mixture and pico de gallo

title: roasted garlic herb gravy
steps:
1. In the last hour of turkey roasting , scatter the carrots , celery , and garlic in the bottom of the roasting pan
2. In a 3-quart saucepan , bring the stock to a boil over medium heat
3. Reduce by half
4. When the turkey comes out of the oven , remove the carrots and celery stalks and place them in a blender or food processor
5. Add the stock and puree until smooth
6. Add half the garlic cloves , puree , and taste
7. Add more garlic to taste , if desired
8. Stir in the salt and pepper , and just before serving , add the parsley , chives , and savory

title: noodle heaven  oamc
steps:
1. Brown beef in skillet
2. Add garlic , salt , sugar , and tomato sauce
3. Simmer 10 minutes until meat is lightly browned
4. In a small bowl , blend cream cheese , sour cream , and onions
5. Boil noodles , undercooking a minute or two
6. Drain
7. In a 9x13 inch pan , layer noodles , cream cheese mixture , and meat sauce
8. Repeat
9. Sprinkle cheddar on top
10. To freeze: cover with foil
11. And freeze
12. To serve: transfer to refrigerator the night before
13. Bake in 350 degree oven for 40 minutes or until heated through and cheese is melted and bubbly

title: liquid green fire hot sauce
steps:
1. Boil tomatillos and peppers in water for about 10 minutes , or until the green color of the tomatillos and jalapenos turn from a slick green to a dull green
2. Remove tomatillos and peppers from water
3. Cut off stem caps from peppers , but do not remove seeds
4. Place tomatillos , peppers , garlic , cilantro , and a couple pinches of salt into a food processor
5. Blend in the food processor for 20-30 seconds , depending upon desired consistency
6. Taste the sauce , and if necessary , add more salt
7. Pour into a re-sealable container or jar , let it rest in the fridge for about 30 minutes , then enjoy with chips or use as a condiment
8. This sauce seems to keep well in the fridge for at least 10 days

title: onion and garlic pork roast
steps:
1. Brown roast in heavy skillet with a little oil
2. Place sliced onions in bottom of crockpot
3. Put roast on top of onions
4. Scatter garlic over top
5. Pour in chicken broth
6. Cook 6-8 hours on low

title: old school cinnamon rolls   easy and yummy
steps:
1. Defrost bread dough per package instructions
2. Roll dough into a 6-inch-by-15-inch rectangle
3. Spread butter evenly over dough
4. Combine sugars and cinnamon in a bowl , and sprinkle evenly over butter
5. Roll dough into a log
6. Slice roll into approximately 12 pieces
7. Place slices on 2 greased pie plates and let them rise 3 to 4 hours
8. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
9. Bake rolls until dough is brown and sugar is bubbly , about 10 minutes
10. Let rolls cool slightly before spreading on the icing
11. To make icing , cream butter until fluffy
12. Add sugar , then vanilla
13. Add enough milk to make mixture fluffy
14. Serve rolls warm

title: acadia s pork chop marinade
steps:
1. Place thawed pork chops in a resealing plastic bag , and then add all of the ingredients
2. Marinate pork chops for 4-6 hours in refrigerator
3. Turn pork chops over every hour
4. Discard marinade before grilling
5. Grill until pork chop temperature reads 145 degrees f or until desired doneness
6. Enjoy !

title: tomato topped fish and potato bake
steps:
1. Spread 2 tablespoons of the oil in a large cast iron or ovenproof frypan
2. Layer potatoes , onion and half each of the salt and pepper in pan
3. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of the remaining oil
4. Heat over high heat until sizzling , about 2 minutes
5. Reduce heat to medium
6. Cover and cook for 12 minutes
7. Meanwhile , in bowl , mix together tomatoes , garlic , parsley and remaining oil , salt and pepper
8. Set aside
9. Remove pan from heat
10. Arrange fish over potatoes
11. Top with tomato mixture
12. Sprinkle with fennel seeds or oregano
13. Bake in 450f degree oven until fish flakes easily when tested , about 12 minutes

title: hoisin bbq steak on a stick with pineapple salsa
steps:
1. Combine pineapple salsa ingredients in small bowl
2. Set aside
3. Combine ketchup and hoisin sauce in another small bowl
4. Divide and reserve a couple of tablespoons for later use
5. Set aside
6. Cut beef steak into 1-inch pieces
7. Thread beef pieces evenly onto four 10 to 12-inch metal skewers
8. Season kabobs evenly with pepper
9. Place kabobs on rack in broiler pan so surface of beef is 3 to 4 inches from heat
10. Brush beef generously with some of reserved sauce mixture
11. Broil 7 to 9 minutes for medium rare to medium doneness , turning once and brushing with remaining sauce mixture
12. Season beef with salt
13. Serve kabobs topped with pineapple salsa

title: greek cookies with confectioners  sugar  kourabiedes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Whip butter until white
3. Slowly add sugar , vanilla , and brandy
4. Gradually add flour , 1 cup at a time
5. Shape cookies by rolling into balls , then gently press your thumb into the top of the cookie and twist slightly
6. This will help flatten the cookie just a bit
7. Place cookies on a cookie sheet and bake for 20 minutes or until the cookies are sand colored
8. Sift confectioner's sugar onto a large sheet of wax paper
9. Upon removing cookies from oven , carefully place on sugar and sift additional sugar to cover the tops and sides of cookies

title: bacon   tomato presto pasta
steps:
1. Cook bacon in skillet 5 minute or until bacon is crisp , stirring occasionally
2. Drain skillet , leaving bacon in skillet
3. Stir in cherry tomatoes
4. Add cream cheese spread , milk and parmesan cheese
5. Mix well
6. Cook until hot and bubbly , stirring frequently
7. Stir in pasta

title: chicken cordon bleu ii
steps:
1. Place chicken breasts between 2 pieces of plastic wrap
2. Using flat side of meat mallet , pound chicken lightly into a rectangle about 1 / 4 inch thick
3. Remove wrap and repeat with other breast
4. Place 2 slices of ham on each chicken piece
5. Cut a cheese wedge into 3 or 4 pieces and lay along center of ham slice
6. Fold in bottom and sides
7. Secure with toothpicks
8. Coat rolls with flour
9. Dip into bowl with egg and water mixture
10. Coat with bread crumbs
11. Dip in egg mixture again , coat with more bread crumbs
12. Heat butter and oil in 10 inch skillet
13. Cook rolls until browned on each side and no longer pink for about 15-20 minutes
14. Bake in preheated 400 degree oven for an additional 15 minutes

title: gluten free shortbread
steps:
1. Mix butter , both sugars , and flour together
2. Work well with hands until it will hold together
3. Make 4 rolls about 1 1 / 2" in diameter , wrap , and chill for at least 6 hours
4. Slice 1 / 4" thick and arrange on a parchment paper lined cookie sheet
5. Sprinkle cookies with sugar , if desired
6. Bake cookies in a preheated 350 oven for 10-15 minutes until very lightly burned around the edges
7. Remove to wire rack to cool
8. Enjoy !

title: crock pot black eyed peas
steps:
1. Pre-soak black-eyed peas according to the instructions on the bag
2. Combine all ingredients and cook on low for 9-10 hours

title: bird of paradise chicken salad
steps:
1. Put the chicken in a large bowl
2. Add in pineapple , grapes , and mango
3. To make the dressing: whisk the mayonnaise , orange juice , and zest together in a small bowl
4. Stir in 1 / 4 cup nuts
5. Pour the dressing over the chicken mixture
6. Toss gently but thoroughly
7. Peel the papaya , using a vegetable peeler
8. Cut it in half , remove the seeds , and the cut it vertically into even slices
9. Line individual plates with lettuce leaves
10. Mound the chicken salad in the middle of the plate
11. Arrange papaya slices around the salad along with a cluster of grapes
12. Sprinkle with remaining nuts
13. Serve immediately

title: pumpkin coconut cheesecake
steps:
1. Crust: preheat oven to 325f
2. Lightly grease bottom of a 10in springform pan
3. In a bowl , stir crumbs with 1 cup coconut , sugar and butter until evenly moist
4. Press over bottom and partway up sides of pan
5. Bake in oven until edges are golden , about 10 mins , cool
6. Filling: meanwhile , whisk eggs in a large bowl
7. Whisk in pumpkin , brown sugar and seasonings
8. Cut cheese into cubes and place in a large bowl
9. Using an electric mixer , beat in sugar , then cream , scraping side of bowl as needed until well mixed
10. Pour over warm crust
11. Bake in oven until filling is almost set , 55-60 minutes
12. Run a knife around edges to loosen crust and prevent cracking
13. Cool to room temp , then chill in fridge at least 4 hrs or overnight
14. Remove from pan and sprinkle with remaining 1 / 2 cup of toasted coconut

title: absolutely yummy vegetable pizza
steps:
1. In a bowl , mix the sour cream , ranch dressing , and cream cheese together until mixture is smooth
2. Spread mixture evenly on top of pizza crust
3. Spread vegetables evenly across pizza
4. Cover pizza with cheese
5. Bake at 500 degrees for five minutes or follow your pizza crust instructions

title: mrs  fields coconut mud bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Lightly butter a 9x13-inch baking pan
3. To make the bottom layer , stir together 1 1 / 3 cups flour , 1 / 2 tsp baking powder , pinch salt and the brown sugar
4. Use a pastry blender to add the 1 / 2 cup of butter , until the mixture is crumbly and coarse
5. Press into the bottom of the baking pan
6. Bake at 350f for 10 minutes , then place pan on rack to cool
7. Leave oven on
8. Next prepare the chocolate ganache
9. After the chopped chocolate is placed in a medium bowl , bring the cream to a simmer in a small saucepan
10. Pour the cream over the ganache , and wait 5 minutes before stirring
11. The ganache will be smooth when ready to refrigerate and set
12. To prepare the topping , cream the remaining butter in a bowl
13. Add the granulated sugar , and extracts
14. Beat until blended , then beat in the eggs
15. Then stir in coconut and nuts
16. Drop the topping by spoonfuls evenly over the ganache and spread with a spatula or a knife
17. Bake at 350f for 25-30 minutes , until golden brown
18. Set pan on rack to cool before cutting into bars

title: spicy rum black pepper glazed filet mignon
steps:
1. Melt butter in medium saucepan over medium heat and sweat onions and garlic
2. Add rum , bring to a boil and reduce to 1 / 4 cup
3. Add stock , bring to a boil and reduce heat
4. Whisk in ancho puree , molasses and pepper and simmer until reduced to 1 cup
5. Preheat grill
6. Season steaks on both sides with salt
7. Cook for 2-3 minutes on each side until medium-rare
8. Spoon / drizzle sauce on steaks and serve with a nice salad and a glass of wine , etc
9. Enjoy !
10. )

title: easy peanut butter balls
steps:
1. In a medium bowl knead peanut butter , margarine , vanilla and sugar , with your hands , until smooth dough is formed
2. Shape into half-inch balls , place on tray lined with wax paper and freeze for at least one hour
3. Melt chocolate in the microwave
4. Use 20-second zaps and mix in between each zap until smooth
5. Insert a toothpick into each peanut butter ball and dip ball into melted chocolate
6. Return to wax paper and refreeze
7. Store in airtight container and serve from frozen

title: steamin  vegetable medley
steps:
1. In a large skillet , bring the water to a boil over medium-high heat
2. Add the carrots , cover , and cook for 3 to 4 minutes
3. Add the zucchini and yellow squash
4. Cook , uncovered , for 5 minutes , or until the water evaporates
5. Reduce the heat to low and add the remaining ingredients
6. Stir until well combined
7. Cook for 5 to 8 minutes , or until the vegetables are tender

title: reuben strudel
steps:
1. Cut corned beef into 1 / 2-inch strips
2. Set aside
3. Saute cabbage and next 3 ingredients in a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray 4 minutes or until cabbage wilts
4. Remove from heat
5. Stir in dressing
6. Cool
7. Stir together butter and mustard
8. Set aside
9. Unfold phyllo , and cover with a damp towel to prevent pastry from drying out
10. Stack 8 sheets on a flat surface covered with wax paper , brushing every other sheet with the butter mixture
11. Spoon half of the cabbage mixture lengthwise down half of phyllo stack , spreading to within 2 inches of edges
12. Top with half of corned beef and half of cheese
13. Fold in short edges 2 inches
14. Roll up , staring a long edge nearest filling
15. Place , seam side down , on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray
16. Cut 1 / 4-inch deep diagonal slit , 1 inch apart , across top
17. Coat strudel with cooking spray
18. Repeat with remaining phyllo , butter mixture , and filling
19. Bake at 425 degrees fahrenheit for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden
20. Cut diagonally into 3- to 4-inch pieces
21. Serve immediately

title: pancake cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Generously coat the bottom & sides of a 12-muffin tin with butter
3. Mix together bisquick , milk , and eggs
4. Fill each cup in the muffin tin half-way
5. Add 1 tbsp of cream cheese to the middle of each muffin , then cover with the remaining pancake mix
6. Bake 20 minutes
7. Remove from oven , place on serving dish & use a flour sifter to sprinkle with sugar
8. Serve with warm syrup

title: sun dried tomato breaded chicken with cream sauce
steps:
1. Defrost chicken breasts and cut in half making four equal pieces
2. I used large chicken breasts for this
3. Next use meat tenderizer and pound to desired thickness
4. Mix breadcrumbs , romano cheese , mozzarella cheese , diced sun dried tomatoes , and enough oil or melted butter to moisten mixture
5. I used both oil and butter for this
6. Coat chicken in breadcrumb mixture and put in a 9x13inch baking dish
7. Heat in medium saucepan over medium heat until throughly combined and warmed through 1 / 2 cup of milk , cream of chicken soup , swiss cheese , red hot pepper flakes
8. Pour over chicken and bake in 350 degree oven for 40-45 minutes

title: clementine tarts
steps:
1. Pastry: in large bowl , stir together flour , sugar , rind and salt
2. Cut in butter and shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
3. Stir together egg yolk and water
4. Gradually pour into dry ingredients , stirring briskly
5. Add more water if necessary to form dough that holds together
6. Press into ball and flatten slightly
7. On lightly floured pastry cloth and using stockinette-covered rolling pin , roll out dough to slightly less than 1 / 4-inch thickness
8. Cut out sixteen 3-1 / 2-inch rounds
9. Ease into muffin tins , allowing 1 / 2 inch to come up sides
10. Prick bottom and sides
11. Bake in 400f oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden
12. Remove from tins
13. Let cool on racks
14. Clementine pastry cream: meanwhile , in heavy saucepan , whisk together egg yolks , milk , sugar and salt
15. Blend in flour and bring to simmer over medium heat , whisking constantiv , until thickened and smooth
16. Blend in clementine juice and rind
17. Reduce heat to low and simmer gently , whisking constantly , for 3 minutes
18. Remove from heat and stir in butter , liqueur and vanilla
19. Transfer to heatproof bowl and cover surface with buttered waxed paper
20. Refrigerate until chilled , about i hour , or up to 1 day
21. Topping and glaze: spoon cream into pastry shells
22. Refrigerate for up to 2 hours
23. Peel clementines
24. With sharp knife , remove thin outer membrane and cut out segments
25. Transfer to sieve and let drain until serving time
26. Pat dry and divide among tarts
27. Heat marmalade until melted
28. Strain and brush lightly over tarts

title: toffee apple cake
steps:
1. Cream together the butter and sugar , add the egg , milk and dry ingredients
2. Butter or spray a pie dish and spread half the cake mixture in the dish
3. Layer the pie apple over the cake mix
4. Sprinkle with cinnamon and raisins and spread rest of cake mix over the top
5. Bake at 180 c for 45 minutes
6. In the mean time , boil together the syrup and butter until toffee coloured and thickened
7. Pour over hot pie , and serve hot or cold

title: chicken  cabbage   apple casserole
steps:
1. Wash chicken and pat dry , using paper towels
2. Blend spices , salt and ginger together
3. Peel back skin of drumsticks , pat flesh with spice mixture and replace skin
4. Line casserole dish with potatoes , then cover with drumsticks
5. Intersperse with rows of cabbage , apples , onions and carrots
6. Sprinkle extra spices and bay leaves over , tuck cinnamon chards in between vegetables and sprinkle with vinegar , orange juice and olive oil
7. Cover tightly and braise at 160c for 1 hour
8. Remove lid or aluminum foil and continue braising until golden brown

title: refreshing pina colada cake
steps:
1. Bake cake as suggested on box in a large sheet-cake pan
2. Cool
3. Combine puddings , milk , and cream cheese and beat with electric mixer
4. Refrigerate pudding mixture for an hour
5. Spread pudding mixture on cake then add a layer of drained pineapple
6. Top with a layer of cool whip
7. Store in fridge

title: best israeli hummus
steps:
1. Blend garbanzo beans , tahini , garlic , salt and lemon juice in food processor until smooth and fluffy
2. Spoon onto small plate , flatten and add garnish per serving
3. Serve with warm pita bread , pickles and cherry peppers

title: grand marnier french toast marianted overnight
steps:
1. Arrange the bread in a large baking dish
2. Mix all the ingredients and pour slowly over the bread
3. Let it sit overnight in the refrigerator
4. Brown each slice in butter on a griddle

title: light   fluffy banana bundt cake
steps:
1. Grease and flour bundt pan
2. Cream together sugar and shortening
3. Add eggs , vanilla and oil
4. Beat on high speed 2-3 minutes
5. Add jiffy mix and mashed bananas
6. Beat until well blended
7. Pour into bundt pan
8. Bake 350 degree oven for 35-45 minutes until toothpick test comes out clean

title: jewel s swedish hamburgers
steps:
1. Put ground beef in bowl
2. Add salt and pepper
3. Add egg yolks and mix
4. Add beet juice and water , a small amount at a time
5. Mixture will be very moist
6. Stir in beets , pickles , onion , capers
7. Shape into 4 patties
8. Score tops of patties
9. With spatula , slide patties into hot butter in a large frying pan
10. Use medium heat to cook to desired doneness
11. Serve with mashed potatoes and green salad

title: italian pattie sandwich
steps:
1. If meat is in casing remove
2. Add garilc powder , basil and oregano
3. Shape meat into 4 patties whatever shape your buns are
4. Spray skillet with nonstick spray and place meat into skillet over med high heat
5. Cook 20 mins or until done
6. Spoon tomato sauce over patties and sprinkle on mozzarella cover and let cook another 1 minute place on buns and enjoy

title: mocha espresso parfaits
steps:
1. Place cottage cheese , sugar , cocoa and instant coffee in food processor container
2. Cover
3. Process until well blended , stopping occasionally to scrape down side of food processor container
4. Spoon half of the cottage cheese mixture evenly into 4 parfait glasses
5. Top with half of the strawberries
6. Repeat layers
7. Top with the whipped topping and almonds
8. Serve immediately
9. Or , cover and refrigerate until ready to serve

title: fresh tomato bruchetta
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a bowl with a lid
2. Marinate at least 4 hours or overnight
3. For garlic bread or pita , spread garlic butter on bread / pita
4. Spread bruchetta mix over top
5. Sprinkle with shredded cheese if desired
6. Bake at 400 or grill on bbq until hot

title: italian sausage sweet  2
steps:
1. Put everything except minced meat into a big bowl
2. Stir to mix evenly
3. Put in minced meat and mix well
4. Shape into patties or stuff into casing
5. Freeze if you want to

title: frozen chocolate  souffls
steps:
1. Pour milk into medium bowl , add dry pudding mix , and beat with wire whisk 2 minutes
2. Gently stir in whipped topping
3. Spoon 2 tablespoons of the chopped cookies into each of eight 8- to 9-oz
4. Paper drinking cups
5. Cover evenly with half of the pudding mixture
6. Repeat layers
7. Cover with foil
8. Freeze 5 hours or until firm
9. Remove from freezer about 15 minutes before serving and let stand at room temperature to soften slightly
10. Peel away paper to unmold onto dessert plates
11. Top each with a cherry
12. Store leftovers in freezer

title: mariane s gingersnaps
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar
2. Add egg , syrup and molasses
3. Mix in sifted dry ingredients
4. Cool dough overnight or at least 4 hours
5. Roll small balls and roll in sugar
6. Place on greased cookie sheet
7. Bake 350 degrees 10-12 minutes
8. Don't overbake
9. Makes them chewier

title: spicy mac n cheese
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray a 2 quart baking dish with cooking spray
3. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil
4. Add macaroni and cook about 9 minutes
5. While macaroni is cooking , toss together cheddar and parmesan in a bowl , and set aside and then begin your roux by melting 3 tbs of butter in a saucepan over medium heat
6. Add 3 tbs of flour and whisk until smooth and bubbly
7. Add milk slowly continuing to whisk
8. Add your onion powder , salt , cayenne pepper
9. Then add the cubes of velvetta to melt
10. Bring to a boil , and allow to simmer for about 2-3 minutes
11. Remove from heat and add you bowl of cheddar and parmesan cheese , mix until smooth and melted
12. After pasta is cooked , drain and add to cheese mixture
13. Pour into 2 quart dish , top with extra cheese
14. Bake at 350 for 20 miunutes
15. If you like a crispy top , increase oven temp to broil and cook 3 additional minutes until top is slightly brown and crispy

title: veggie bacon quiche
steps:
1. Precook piecrust in preheated 350-degree oven
2. In a large skillet , fry the bacon pieces until they are crisp
3. Set bacon aside to drain on paper towel , but do not discard bacon drippings
4. Saut the onions , zucchini and peppers in the bacon drippings
5. Drain the vegetables well and put them in the precooked crust followed by cheese
6. Blend eggs , mustard , flour , and evaporated milk and pour the mixture into piecrust over other ingredients
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 50 minutes
8. After about 35 minutes of baking time , spread the cooked bacon pieces over the pie and sprinkle some more shredded cheese on top
9. Pie is cooked when knife comes out clean when inserted in pie
10. Let set for 5 minutes or so before cutting
11. Garnish as desired and serve hot , warm , or cold

title: crunchy parsley pesto
steps: 1. Put everything in a blender and blend until mixture is creamy

title: passover vegetable cups
steps:
1. Cook broccoli until defrosted and drain well
2. Add all ingredients and mix well
3. Put mixture into greased muffin tins
4. Bake 40-50 minutes in a preheated 350f oven

title: chicken mole for crock pot
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine the almonds , cinnamon stick , coriander , aniseed , sesame seed and cloves on a baking sheet
3. Toast in the oven for 10 minutes or until fragrant and lightly browned
4. Remove and set aside
5. Place chiles on another baking sheet and toast at 350 degrees for 10 minutes
6. Check and stir as needed to prevent burning
7. Remove the chiles from the oven and allow to cool
8. When cool , break chiles lightly , and place in in a large glass bowl
9. Pour 2 cups of hot chicken stock over the chiles and allow to sit for about 30 minutes to 1 hour
10. Preheat broiler and place the 2 tomatoes on a cookie sheet and broil for 5 to 7 minutes or until skin cracks and blisters lightly , turning about every 2 minutes
11. Remove tomatoes from oven and set aside to cool before removing the skin and chopping
12. Pour the chiles and stock into a blender and puree in batches until smooth
13. Add the toasted almonds and spices , peeled and chopped tomato , chocolate , garlic , onion , raisins and salt to taste
14. Blend until smooth , adding remaining stock as needed to make sauce proper consistency
15. The sauce should be just thick enough to coat the back of a spoon
16. Strain the sauce through a medium-meshed sieve to remove seeds and pieces of chile
17. Arrange the chicken pieces in the crock pot and pour sauce over
18. Cook on low for 3 to 4 hours or 6 to 8 hours
19. At 3 to 4 hours the chicken will be firm and retain its shape
20. At 6 to 8 hours , the meat will be falling off the bone
21. Transfer to dinner plates and serve immediately with rice , salad and crusty bread
22. Please

title: fennel and orange salad
steps:
1. Toss fennel with orange segments in large bowl
2. Add oil and lemon juice , and carefully mix without crushing orange segments
3. Season with salt and pepper , and sprinkle with fresh mint

title: pineapple en salsa chocolate de ron
steps:
1. Slice the pineapple and cut into chunks
2. In a small saucepan , heat the chocolate and cream gently until the chocolate has melted
3. Stir in the rum
4. Serve at once , dipping the pineapple into the warm sauce

title: three bean and broccoli pasta salad
steps:
1. Bring 3 qts water to boil
2. While bringing water to a boil , set frozen broccoli pkg in microwave to defrost for approximately 6-7 minutes
3. Open , drain , and rinse canned 3 bean salad in colander
4. When water is boiling , add pasta> boil pasta for 8-9 minutes to al dente
5. As noodles are cooking , prepare the broccoli> cut stems away from broccoli flowerettes> cut flowerettes into bite-sized pieces> use the stem portion as well if you prefer
6. Place broccoli pieces and rinsed / drained bean salad in mixing bowl
7. Once noodles are cooked , remove and strain in colander while running cold water over noodles to stop cooking , and cool down the pasta> with a sharp knife or kitchen scissors cut up pasta slightly
8. Once cooled and drained place pasta in mixing bowl with bean salad and broccoli
9. In measuring cup pour dressing of choice to 1 / 2 cup measure> blend if using mul
10. Pour dressing over salad and add fresh cracked pepper and salt to your liking>i use about 1 1 / 2 tbs of salt to cut the sweetness of the bean salad
11. Mix gently and well> nice if chilled , but if time does not allow , it can be eaten immediately
12. Some add-in ideas: diced cucumber , tomato , black olives , onion , chicken / ham , sunflower seeds

title: spinach mushroom cheesy quiche
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a saute pan , toss spinach until it cooks down
2. Combine fresh garlic , onions , milk , eggs & grated cheese
3. Mix parmesan and garlic powder together
4. Spread spinach out in the pie crust
5. Pour egg mixture into crust
6. Arrange mushrooms and feta over the top
7. Sprinkle with parmesan / garlic mixture
8. Bake for one hour at 350

title: chicken potato slice
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 190c
2. Cook potatoes in boiling water until almost done , drain well
3. Layer potatoes in a greased casserole dish
4. Top with chicken and spring onions
5. Melt butter in a medium saucepan
6. Briefly saute the garlic
7. Stir in flour , water , crumbled stock cube , wine and cream and cook , whisking until thickened slightly
8. Stir in mustard and mayonnaise , pour over chicken
9. Sprinkle with cheese and paprika
10. Bake until golden
11. Sprinkle with parsley before serving

title: my timballo
steps:
1. Heat oven 350
2. Combine the meats
3. Soak bread in half and half for 5 minutes
4. Squeeze dry
5. Add to meat
6. Stir in the eggs , parsley , basil , parmesan , salt and pepper
7. Mix well
8. Set aside
9. Combine the macaroni , mozzarella , parmesan and 1 cup of the sauce
10. Set aside
11. Spray a 9 inch springform pan with non-stick spray and olive oil
12. Line with waxed paper
13. Line with prosciutto
14. Press 2 / 3 of the meat mixture on top , spreading to come up sides
15. Fill with macaroni
16. Roll out remaining meat mixture between plastic wrap to form a 9 inch circle
17. Place on top , sealing edges
18. Cover with foil
19. Place on a baking sheet
20. Bake 30 minutes
21. Uncover
22. Bake 15 more minutes
23. Remove from oven
24. Let stand 5 minutes
25. Run a knife around edges
26. Place a platter on top
27. Invert
28. Cut in wedges
29. Heat remaining sauce
30. Place on plates
31. Top with timballo
32. Yum !

title: carrot cumin soup with toasted pecans
steps:
1. In a saucepan , melt 2 tablespoons butter over medium heat
2. Saute onions until tender
3. Add carrots , cumin , and salt
4. Cook , stirring 1 minute
5. Add vegetable broth and bring to a boil
6. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer for 25 minutes or until carrots are tender
7. Spread out pecans on a baking sheet
8. Toast in oven at 350f for 8 minutes or until 1 shade darker
9. Toss pecans with 1 teaspoon butter and add salt to taste
10. Set aside
11. Pour soup into a blender container
12. Puree until smooth
13. Pour soup into bowls and sprinkle with pecans on top

title: oyster and spaghetti casserole
steps:
1. Cook spagetti til almost done
2. Drain
3. Mince onions saute in butter
4. Mix into drained spagetti
5. Add oysters dont drain
6. Add 1 / 2 and 1 / 2
7. Add soup
8. Add spices
9. Put in greased casserole
10. Top with crushed crackers can use soda crackers then with grated cheddar cheese
11. Bake 325 degree oven for 30 minutes i think a hotter oven would be better

title: spaghettini with burst cherry tomatoes
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil
2. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until very hot but not smoking
3. Add half of the tomatoes and the salt
4. Cook , tossing occasionally , until tomatoes start to blister and collapse , about 3 minutes
5. Add remaining tomatoes
6. Cook , tossing once , 2 minutes
7. Push tomatoes to one side of pan
8. Add garlic
9. Cook until fragrant , 3 to 4 minutes
10. Stir garlic and tomatoes together gently
11. Cook , stirring occasionally and gently pressing tomatoes to release juices , until all tomatoes have collapsed and sauce is juicy and thick , about 4 minutes
12. Remove from heat
13. Add pasta to boiling water
14. Cook until al dente , about 8 minutes
15. Meanwhile , gently reheat sauce
16. Drain pasta
17. Place in serving bowl
18. Add sauce and basil
19. Toss
20. Add 3 / 4 cup of the cheese
21. Toss
22. Add remaining cup cheese
23. Toss
24. Season with pepper

title: quick   dirty chocolate orange microwave fudge
steps:
1. Line an 8x8 inch pan with wax paper
2. I tape it in to make it easier
3. In a medium bowl combine milk chocolate chips , 2 / 3 can of sweetened condensed milk , and vanilla extract
4. Microwave 45 seconds to 1 minute at a time , stirring in between heating
5. Continue until smooth
6. Spread of the mixture evenly across the bottom of the pan
7. Reserved other of mixture
8. Chill 10-15 minutes
9. In a small bowl combine white chocolate chips , remaining sweetened condensed milk , and orange extract
10. Microwave 45 seconds to 1 minute at a time , stirring in between heating
11. Continue until smooth
12. Stir in red and yellow food coloring until you achieve an orange color you like
13. Spread the mixture evenly across the first chocolate layer
14. Chill 10-15 minutes
15. Reheat reserved chocolate mixture
16. Spread the mixture evenly across the orange layer
17. Chill for an hour
18. Remove from pan and cut into squares
19. It costs about twice as much but i've often been disappointed with the consistency of cheaper brands

title: safari steak for the hunter
steps:
1. Heat oil and butter in a 10 to 12 inch skillet until almost smoking
2. Fry steaks in pan , a few at a time , for about 3 minutes on each side , adding more oil and butter as needed
3. Season each steak with salt and pepper and set aside , keeping warm
4. Lower heat and add red wine and dessert wine
5. Stir with residue left in pan
6. Add garlic and cook for 2 minutes
7. Add tomato paste and water
8. Cook until sauce is quite thick
9. Combine mashed potatoes and yams ina 2 qt saucepan and beat thoroughly
10. Season the potato mixture to taste
11. Spread the potato mixture on a large platter
12. Arrange the steaks on the potatoes
13. Pour the sauce over the steaks
14. Sprinkle with chopped parsley

title: heath bar muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Line 12 standard-size muffin cups with paper wrappers
3. Set aside
4. Whisk together the flour , brown sugar , baking powder , and salt
5. In another bowl , stir together the milk , melted butter , egg , and vanilla
6. Make a well in the center of the flour mixture
7. Add the milk mixture and stir just until combined
8. Do not overmix
9. Gently fold in the heath bar bits
10. Spoon batter into the prepared muffin cups
11. Bake for 15-20 minutes , or until a toothpick tests out clean
12. Cool 5 minutes in tins before removing to wire racks and cool completely
13. Store airtight at room temperature

title: tangy vanilla frozen yogurt
steps:
1. Mix all three ingredients until sugar is dissolved
2. Refrigerate mixture for 1 hour
3. Freeze using an ice cream maker according to the manufacturer's instructions

title: creamy crock pot chicken  low fat
steps:
1. Put chicken in bottom of crock pot
2. Mix together all other ingredients and pour over chicken
3. Cook on low 6-8 hours , or on high 3-4 hours
4. I usually serve this over brown rice

title: creamy bean soup
steps:
1. Heat vegetable oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat
2. Add onion and garlic
3. Cook , stirring occasionally , for 2-3 minutes or until onion is tender
4. Stir in beans , salsa , broth , lime juice , and cumin
5. Bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat to low
7. Cook , stirring occasionally , for 10-12 minutes
8. Remove from heat and enjoy
9. This is good with shredded mild cheddar cheese sprinkled on top

title: tony roma s carolina honey barbecue sauce by todd wilbur
steps:
1. For sauce: combine all ingredients for sauce in saucepan
2. Blend ingredients with whisk until smooth over high heat
3. When mixtures come to a boil , reduce head simmer uncovered 30-40 minutes until mixtures thickens
4. Ribs: cut each rack of ribs into sections of 4-6 rib each
5. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f
6. Tear off 4 pieces of aluminum foil 6-7 inches larger than the ribs
7. Coat front and back of ribs with sauce
8. Place each rack of ribs onto a piece of foil and wrap tightly
9. Place the foil packets in the oven , seam side facing up and bake for 2-21 / 2 hours
10. Remove ribs from oven when done and coat both sides of ribs with sauce
11. Place ribs on preheated grill and grill for 2-4 minutes
12. Serve with additional sauce

title: sesame noodles w scallions   snow peas
steps:
1. Combine the first 5 ingredients in a blender
2. While the blender is on , add the oils in a slow and steady stream
3. Cook the pasta according to package instructions
4. Drain well and put into a large bowl
5. Dress the hot pasta with the sesame mayo
6. Add the chili oil , green onions and snow peas
7. Toss to combine

title: party size barbecued albacore  tuna  with shrimp stuffing
steps:
1. To prepare the heavy foil for cooking fish:
2. Butter one side of the foil along the area where the tuna will be placed for cooking
3. Lay one half of the pepper slices on the buttered foil
4. Lay citrus slices within the pepper-slice ring ,
5. Set prepared foil aside until ready to use
6. Prepare the tuna
7. Place the albacore tuna onto its back
8. Prop it up if you have to , but it should be on its back until ready to cook
9. With a sharp chef's knife , make small incisions in the internal flesh , being careful not to puncture through the skin
10. Insert capers in the incisions , using all , but a few capers in your "measure"
11. Pour all of the lime juice into the fish cavity
12. With your basting brush , paint the inside of the albacore tuna well with fresh lime juice , forcing the juice into the incisions
13. Set the tuna aside , on its back , to allow lime juice to penetrate the tuna flesh , while you are preparing the stuffing
14. At this point , you should start your barbecue on high setting
15. If you are accustomed to using a charcoal barbecue , then use plenty of coals , keeping them to one side when fish is set on the grill , in its foil pouch
16. Prepare the stuffing
17. Melt one half of the butter in large skillet
18. Add 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil to skillet
19. To the skillet: add chopped green onion , and saute lightly , to clarify
20. Remove onion and set aside
21. To the skillet: add chopped garlic and saute lightly , stirring all the while
22. Remove garlic and set aside
23. To the skillet: add chopped toasted bread , and stir until all of the butter has been absorbed
24. Remove bread and set aside in a large mixing bowl
25. To the skillet , add a little olive oil if needed , ouzo , fennel seed , dill , lemon basil , oregano , cooked onion , garlic
26. Mix well , to blend all flavours
27. Stir continuously until all the oil has been absorbed
28. It will only take a minute or two
29. Remove from skillet and add to the cooked bread in the mixing bowl
30. Add well-beaten egg and chopped shrimp
31. Mix well , blending all of the ingredients
32. Scoop stuffing mixture into the fish cavity , pack it well
33. Seal the opening with poultry needle and string and pat the tuna dry
34. Lay stuffed tuna carefully onto the peppers and citrus , buttered foil
35. With the remaining butter , slather the upper side of the fish body
36. Place pepper and citrus slices on fish , along the fish's body , alternating with slices of orange , lime , lemon as you did with foil preparation
37. Wrap fish , loosely , crimping and folding the foil ends , up to keep in juices
38. At this point it is time to reduce the barbecue heat to low setting
39. For charcoal method , move your coals to one side , and cook with lid on bbq
40. Place foil package on barbecue -- lower the lid and allow to cook , for 10-12 minutes per pound
41. During last 10 minutes of cooking , open foil bag , and continue cooking , with lid open , basting frequently with accumulated juices
42. Sprinkle the remaining capers over the cooked tuna
43. Serve with sides of your choosing , and plenty of dry white wine
44. Once again , of your choosing
45. Serves 10-12 people , comfortably
46. Times: prep time - 40 minutes , includes cutting , chopping , preparation of albacore tuna
47. Cook time -1-1 / 2 - 2 hours

title: mango lassi   simplest   quickest
steps:
1. Mix all in a blender
2. Keep in refrigerator to serve cold
3. Shake before pouring

title: cashew sour cream   non dairy sour cream alternative substitute
steps:
1. Cover cashews with water and soak for a few hours , or overnight
2. Pour off all water , and place nuts in food processor
3. Add 1 / 4 cup cold water , salt , vinegar and lemon juice
4. Puree for 3-4 minutes or until completely smooth and creamy in consistency
5. Use in any recipe that calls for sour cream
6. Refrigerate in an airtight container for up to a week

title: the best  and easiest  baked beans ever
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. In a large dutch oven , combine the baked beans , onion , bell pepper , and the bacon
3. Season with chili powder , worcestershire , vinegar , brown sugar , ketchup , garlic powder and salt
4. Add cayenne if using
5. Cover and bake for one hour in the oven
6. You can uncover the second 1 / 2 hour if you like your beans on the thick side
7. I have also made these in the crock pot on high for 2-3 hours depending on how thick you like them

title: teresa s chicken brandy
steps:
1. Recipe doubles by increasing only the amount of chicken used
2. No need to increase other ingredients
3. Preheat water for pasta or begin cooking rice
4. Heat oil in skillet or electric fry pan on medium-high heat
5. Season chicken with salt / pepper
6. Dredge chicken in flour , shake off excess
7. Brown chicken on both sides in pan
8. Do not cook all the way through
9. Remove chicken from pan and set aside
10. Add shallots , cook 2 minutes
11. Add mushrooms , cook additional 2 minutes
12. Add brandy , cook on high heat to evaporate alcohol
13. Lower heat to simmer , add cream , crumbled boullion cube and paprika
14. Add chicken back to pan
