15. Cover and simmer until chicken is cooked through serve over rice or egg noodles
16. I prefer rice because it holds the sauce better
17. If sauce is too thin at end of cooking time , remove chicken and raise heat to reduce sauce to desired consistency
18. Add chicken back , coat with sauce and serve

title: potato kielbasa skillet
steps:
1. In dutch oven , brown potatoes , kielbasa , onion and peppers in oil
2. Add seasonings and water
3. Bring to a boil
4. Cover tightly and cook for 20 minutes on low , stirring occasionally
5. Uncover and put cheese on top
6. Simmer until cheese is melted

title: italian sausage stromboli  aka sausage bread
steps:
1. Lay pizza dough on a lightly floured surface so it can rest
2. Slice italian sausage into 1 / 2 inch slices
3. Fry in a 10" skillet over medium heat until browned , about 10 minutes
4. Add 1 / 2 cup water , peppers and onions
5. Bring to boil and cover
6. Reduce heat to low and cook about 5-10 minutes more , or until veggies are tender and sausage is heated through
7. Drain liquid from skillet and sprinkle sausage mixture with italian seasoning
8. Set aside
9. If you have leftover sausage , onions and peppers , like i did , you just need to warm it up
10. Preheat oven to 375 degrees and spray a baking sheet with cooking spray
11. Roll pizza dough into a rectangle , approximately 11 x 17
12. Sprinkle with sausage mixture , then the cheeses
13. Start at the bottom of the long side and roll jellyroll fashion , stopping occasionally to stuff sides it
14. When you get to the end , pinch seam together , trying to squeeze air out as you go
15. Place seam side down on baking sheet
16. Bake for about 25 minutes at 375 degrees
17. Remove from oven and lay a clean dish towel on top of loaf
18. This will allow the crust to soften up and it will be easier to slice and eat
19. After about 10 minutes or so , slice into 1 inch slices
20. Serve with warmed sauce for dipping , if desired
21. Enjoy !

title: butternut squash risotto with spinach and toasted pine nuts
steps:
1. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in 12-inch nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering but not smoking
2. Add about 3 1 / 2 cups squash in even layer and cook without stirring until golden brown , 4 to 5 minutes
3. Stir in 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper
4. Continue to cook , stirring occasionally , until squash is tender and browned , about 5 minutes longer
5. Transfer squash to bowl and set aside
6. Return skillet to medium heat
7. Add reserved squash fibers and seeds and any leftover diced squash
8. Cook , stirring frequently to break up fibers , until lightly browned , about 4 minutes
9. Transfer to large saucepan and add vegetable broth and water
10. Cover saucepan and bring mixture to simmer over high heat , then reduce heat to medium-low to maintain bare simmer
11. While broth mixture is simmering , add 1 teaspoon olive oil to now-empty skillet and swirl to coat
12. Add 4 ounces baby spinach and cook , covered , over medium heat , until leaves begin to wilt , about 2 minutes
13. Uncover and cook , stirring constantly , until fully wilted , about 30 seconds
14. Set aside
15. Melt 3 tablespoons butter in now-empty skillet over medium heat
16. When foaming subsides , add onions , garlic , remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , and remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon pepper
17. Cook , stirring occasionally , until onions are softened , 4 to 5 minutes
18. Add rice to skillet and cook , stirring frequently , until grains are translucent around edges , about 3 minutes
19. Add wine and cook , stirring frequently , until fully absorbed , 4 to 5 minutes
20. Meanwhile , strain hot broth through fine-mesh strainer into medium bowl , pressing on solids to extract as much liquid as possible
21. Return strained broth to saucepan and discard solids in strainer
22. Cover saucepan and set over low heat to keep broth hot
23. When wine is fully absorbed , add 3 cups hot broth and half of reserved squash to rice
24. Simmer , stirring every 3 to 4 minutes , until liquid is absorbed and bottom of pan is almost dry , about 12 minutes
25. Stir in about 1 / 2 cup hot broth and cook , stirring constantly , until absorbed , about 3 minutes
26. Repeat with additional broth 2 or 3 more times , until rice is al dente
27. Turn off the heat , stir in remaining 1 tablespoon butter / margarine , parmesan , sage , and nutmeg
28. Drain excess liquid from spinach and gently fold in spinach and remaining cooked squash
29. If desired , add up to 1 / 4 cup additional hot broth to loosen texture of risotto
30. Top individual servings of risotto with toasted pine nuts
31. Serve immediately

title: andorran cunillo  rabbit in tomato sauce
steps:
1. Wash the rabbit and rub with a little vinegar then joint and cut into about 15 serving pieces
2. Add olive oil to the base of a large cast iron casserole dish and fry the rabbit in this until nicely browned
3. Remove the meat with a slotted spoon and set aside
4. Add the garlic , onion and tomatoes to the pan and fry gently for about 5 minutes
5. Add the bay leaf , thyme and oregano
6. Now add the white wine and water and increase the heat so the mixture comes to a boil
7. Reduce the volume by about half then add the rabbit and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
8. Reduce to a simmer , cover securely and cook gently for about 90 minutes , or until the rabbit is tender

title: vodka cream sauce
steps:
1. Saut garlic in olive oil , add tomatoe puree and bring to a boil
2. Reduce heat to low and simmer for about 20 minutes
3. Add heavy cream and crushed red pepper to tomato sauce and simmer for 5 more minutes
4. Add vodka and basil to sauce and simmer for 2 more minutes

title: algerian stuffed dates
steps:
1. Cut a lengthwise slit down the center , but not through , each date
2. Remove seeds
3. Sprinkle food coloring over marzipan , if desired
4. Gently knead 4 to 5 times or until color is incorporated into marzipan
5. Divide marzipan mixture evenly among dates
6. Stuff into slits
7. Sprinkle with powdered sugar

title: roasted cauliflower   mashed potato bites  sp5
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 375f and line a baking sheet with parchment paper
2. Cut cauliflower in small florets and place in a bowl
3. Add olive oil to cauliflower and mix well until all the florets are well coated
4. Bake cauliflower florets for 25 minutes
5. Place warm cauliflower in a food processor and pulse about 20 times creamy
6. Transfer cauliflower into a bowl add mashed potatoes , parmesan cheese and beaten eggs and mix well until well combined
7. Grease a 12 muffin , muffin tin with olive oil and spoon the cauliflower potato mixture into it
8. Sprinkle the top with parmesan cheese
9. Bake at 375 for 20 minutes , let them cool before taking bites out of muffin mold

title: lemon lime country style pork ribs
steps:
1. Combine ingrediets for your marinade and pour over meat or veggies
2. Refrigerate for 1 hour or overnight
3. Heat small saucepan over medium
4. Add olive oil , garlic , and chili powder
5. Saute for about one minute
6. Add remaining ingrediets and combine
7. Simmer until your desired consistancy is reached
8. It is up to you how you bring the marinated ingredients and bbq sauce together
9. You can use the grill , oven , or stove-top
10. I personally like to brown my country ribs on all sides then add the finished bbq sauce to the ribs
11. I simmer with a lid on until the ribs are done
12. Enjoy !

title: rum french toast crunch
steps:
1. Whisk together evaporated milk , rum , eggs , and salt , and pour into a long dish good for dipping
2. Set aside
3. Prepare topping -- preheat oven to 325f combine macadamia nuts , coconut , butter and honey , and mix well
4. Sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon
5. Bake until lightly golden , about 12-15 minutes
6. Be aware that macadamia nuts will go from toasted to burned quickly , so keep a close eye on them if keeping them in longer
7. Remove from oven and stir in raisins
8. Set aside
9. While the topping is baking , heat 1 tablespoon butter over medium heat in a large skillet that can contain two slices of bread
10. Dip two pieces of bread into the milk mixture and let soak for a few seconds
11. Flip over and let the second side soak for a few seconds
12. When butter is melted , add both slices of bread and let cook until golden brown , about 2-3 minutes
13. Flip and cook the other side for another 2-3 minutes
14. Repeat until all 8 pieces are cooked
15. For the drizzle , combine syrup and rum and mix well
16. If desired , warm through in a small saucepan on the stove
17. To serve , cut each piece of toast in half diagonally
18. Place four halves on each plate
19. Sprinkle with the crunch mixture and add a small drizzle of rum syrup
20. Serve with any extra crunch and maple syrup on the table to add as desired

title: zurie s pork tenderloin with yoghurt  mustard and prunes
steps:
1. Fry the pork cubes and bacon in a little oil over medium heat , add the prunes
2. Red wine and sugar , and simmer for 15 minutes , open , so that some of the wine cooks away
3. Stir now and then
4. Mix the yoghurt , cream , mustard and cornstarch in a bowl , and whisk well
5. Add salt and pepper to your taste to the yoghurt mixture
6. Add the mixture to the meats in the pot , and stir well
7. Simmer lightly for a couple of minutes
8. Taste for seasoning
9. If you want more sauce , add more yoghurt or cream

title: fiesta chicken
steps:
1. Coat the chicken with the seasoning , by shaking in a bag
2. Cook in oven , in casserole dish , 350 degrees for 45 minutes
3. After 30 minutes , top chicken with salsa and continue baking
4. Serve with sour cream
5. You can also bbq the chicken , but skip the salsa step and just serve with salsa and sour cream

title: 2 step pumpkin cheesecake
steps:
1. Beat cream cheese , pumpkin , sugar and pumpkin pie spice in large bowl with wire whisk or electric mixer until smooth
2. Gently stir in whipped topping
3. Spoon into crust
4. Refrigerate three hours or until set
5. Garnish as desired
6. Store leftover cheesecake in refrigerator

title: green beans with sour cream
steps:
1. Drain beans and save liquid
2. Brown onion in butter
3. Blend in flour
4. Add liquid from beans and cook until thick , stirring constantly
5. Add salt , pepper , vinegar , sugar and sour cream
6. Add beans and heat thoroughly
7. Serve immediately , garnished with chopped parsley

title: crispy rice for sizzling rice soup
steps:
1. Combine rice and water in a large pot
2. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and cover
3. Simmer for 30 minutes
4. Remove from heat and allow to cool
5. Preheat oven to 300f
6. Spread the rice over an ungreased baking sheet , no more than 1 / 4 inch thick
7. Bake rice for 50-55 minutes until dry
8. Cool rice and cut into 2" squares
9. Store in a canister until needed , but do not freeze

title: mrs  cribbs s chicken and dumplings
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , combine the chicken legs with the large chunks of carrot and celery , half of the chopped onions and the water
2. Simmer over moderate heat until the chicken legs are cooked through , about 15 minutes
3. Transfer the chicken to a plate
4. Let cool slightly , then remove the meat from the bones and let cool
5. Strain the chicken broth and discard the vegetables
6. In a medium bowl , combine the flour with 1 cup of the chicken broth , adding a little of the fat from the broth
7. Stir to form a stiff dough
8. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured board and knead until smooth
9. Wrap the dumpling dough in plastic wrap and let rest at room temperature for 30 minutes
10. 3
11. Cut the dough into quarters
12. Working with 1 piece at a time , roll out the dough a scant 1 / 4 inch thick on a very lightly floured work surface
13. Cut the dough into 3-inch-wide strips and transfer to a sheet of wax paper
14. Working on the paper , cut each strip crosswise into 1-inch-thick dumplings and transfer the paper to a baking sheet
15. Do not separate the dumplings
16. Repeat with the remaining dough , stacking each layer on the baking sheet
17. Freeze the dumplings until solid , at least 4 hours and preferably overnight
18. In a large enameled cast-iron casserole , combine the sliced carrots and celery and the remaining chopped onion with 4 cups of the broth and bring to a boil
19. Season well with salt and pepper and cook until the vegetables are just tender , 7 to 8 minutes
20. Add the cooked chicken and return to a boil
21. Separate the frozen dumplings and add them to the simmering broth a few at a time , submerging them in the broth
22. Bring the broth to a simmer and cook until the dumplings are tender , about 15 minutes
23. Tuck the dumplings into the broth occasionally
24. Spoon the chicken and dumplings into bowls and serve
25. Make ahead the recipe can be prepared through step 3 up to 3 days ahead
26. Refrigerate the broth and the chicken
27. Keep the dumplings frozen

title: rainbow bright cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a stand or electric mixer , beat the cake mix , eggs , oil , water , sour cream and pudding on medium until well combined
3. Batter will be nice and thick
4. Divide batter evenly between 5 white or glass bowls
5. Drop 5 different colors of food coloring into each cake batter bowl until you reach your desired colors
6. Stir well
7. Spoon each color into paper lined cupcake tins until all are filled
8. Bake for 22-25 minutes or until cooked through
9. Remove and let cool completely
10. Frost with frosting of choice

title: full flavored steak
steps:
1. Combine the sugars , ginger , garlic , soy sauce and vinegar together in a bowl
2. Place meat in shallow dish for marinating
3. Pour soy sauce mixture over meat
4. Allow steak to marinate at least 30 minutes , basting frequently and turning once or twice
5. The longer you are able to marinate it , the better
6. When ready to grill remove meat from marinade , reserving liquid
7. Place steak on grill about 3" from coals
8. Grill about 6 minutes or until one side is browned , basting frequently with reserved marinade
9. Turn and grill the other side about 6 minutes , or until done as desired
10. Enjoy !

title: strawberry banana freeze
steps:
1. Freeze banana until firm
2. Cut frozen banana into chunks
3. In a blender combine the banana , evaporated milk , sugar and vanilla
4. Cover and blend until smooth
5. With blender running , slowly add the frozen berries one or two at a time through opening in lid
6. Blend until smooth
7. Serve immediately

title: green lime shrimp   mexico
steps:
1. Clean and devein the shrimp
2. Melt the butter with the onion , chile , salt and pepper over a medium heat
3. Add the shrimp and cook one minute
4. Add the lime slices , fry for other few minutes and take them off the flame
5. Add the sour cream and serve with rice

title: almost another dump cake  just better
steps:
1. Dump all ingredients in a bowl and mix well
2. Dump into a greased 9" bundt pan and place in pre-heated 350 degree oven for around 50- 55 minutes

title: italian potatoes and spinach
steps:
1. Cook potatoes in boiling salted water until tender and drain in a colander reserving 1 / 4 cup of liquid
2. Let potatoes steam 3 minutes , shaking once , then remove to a serving dish
3. While potatoes are cooking , place oil , garlic and red pepper flakes in a small skillet and cook slowly over low heat until garlic is lightly browned
4. When potatoes are ready , cook spinach according to package directions
5. Add spinach , garlic-pepper oil to potatoes , toss , season with salt and pepper and serve at once

title: beefy vegetable casserole
steps:
1. Brown beef and remove from pan
2. Brown onions in beef drippings and drain
3. Put all ingredients into medium casserole
4. Cover casserole with foil
5. Bake at 350 for 1 hour
6. After 30 minutes remove foil and bake uncovered

title: pudding pumpkin pie
steps:
1. Brush egg white over crust
2. Bake at 375f for 5 minutes or until lightly browned
3. Cool on wire reck
4. In a large bowl , whisk milk and pudding mix
5. Stir in pumpkin and spices
6. Fold in 1 cup whipped topping
7. Pour into crust
8. Refrigerate 4 hours or overnight
9. Cut into slices and dollp with remaining whipped topping
10. Refrigerate left overs
11. Chilling time is not included

title: beef and cabbage stew
steps:
1. In a large soup pot over medium heat , let the oil get warm
2. Brown the stew meat on all sides for about 6 minutes
3. Add in the next 8 ingredients
4. Stir to combine
5. Cover and simmer over medium-low heat for 1 hour or until meat is tender
6. Add in the cabbage and raisins and let simmer , uncovered , for 30 more minutes

title: grilled baby cheeseburgers
steps:
1. Heat gas or charcoal grill
2. Mix together the beef , onion , parsley and salt
3. Divide into 16 portions
4. Shape each portion into a ball and flatten to a 1 / 2 inch thick patty about 1 1 / 2 inches in diameter
5. Thread 4 patties horizontally on metal skewers , leaving space between each one
6. Place patties on the grill
7. Cover and cook 8 to 10 minutes or until no longer pink in the middle
8. Top each patty with a piece of cheese
9. Place each patty on a quarter piece of the toasted bread
10. Top the burgers with a pickle slice , a tomato slice and another toast square
11. Spear burgers with a toothpick to hold all the layers together
12. Serve with ketchup , mustard , mayo and thousand island salad dressing for dipping

title: crock pot coke brisket
steps: 1. Throw everything in your crock pot and cook all day !

title: oriental style one dish dinner
steps:
1. Lightly oil wok or skillet
2. Add pork and stir-fry until meat is no longer pink
3. Stir in cabbage , carrots , onion , mushrooms , water chestnuts and ginger
4. Stir-fry for 2 minutes
5. Mix in soy sauce , then rice
6. Stir gently
7. Pour in stock
8. Cover tightly and simmer about 20 to 25 minutes until liquid is almost absorbed
9. Stir in zucchini and asparagus
10. Continue to cook about 5 minutes longer
11. Season with salt , and pepper to taste
12. Serve garnished with green onions

title: my thai sesame noodles
steps:
1. Heat peanut butter in microwave for 20 seconds to soften
2. In a large bowl whisk together softened peanut butter , soy sauce , vinegar , sesame oil , sambal oelek and honey
3. Add spaghetti , green onions and sesame seeds
4. Toss well
5. Chill until ready to serve - or serve at room temperature

title: easy yellow chicken curry
steps:
1. Before cooking: tenderize and cube chicken , chop onion and mince garlic , and combine curry powder , cinnamon , paprika , ginger root , and sugar in a small cereal-sized bowl
2. Heat olive oil in a large pan on medium heat
3. Once oil is hot , add onion and garlic
4. Saute onion and garlic until onion is browned
5. Add curry spices to the pan
6. Saute combination until the spices have soaked up all of the remaining olive oil
7. Add coconut milk , tomato paste , and chicken
8. Simmer for 20-25 minutes
9. Remove bay leaf
10. Add lemon juice
11. Simmer for 5 more minutes
12. Serve over white rice
13. Allow guests to add sriracha sauce to their tastes

title: gramps spaghetti sauce
steps:
1. In a stockpot , combine whole tomatoes and juice , puree , dice tomatoes , tomato sauce , paste , and water , stir
2. Add bay leaves , sugar , garlic , red pepper , basil , parsley , oregano and salt and pepper to taste
3. Brown your meatballs or sausage and add to sauce
4. Cook on simmer or warm for 3 hours , stirring occasionlly

title: rye popovers
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees
2. Combine the flours with the salt in a medium bowl
3. Add the milk , butter and eggs and whisk to combine thoroughly
4. Pour into well-greased muffin cups or a popover pan
5. Bake at 450 for 20 minutes , turn oven to 350 degrees and bake 15 minutes longer

title: kentucky country saltimbocca
steps:
1. Melt butter in skillet over medium heat
2. Add olive oil
3. Season chicken with salt and pepper
4. Dust with flour
5. Saute in skillet for approximately 5 minutes per side
6. Top each chicken breast with a sage leaf , 2 ounces of country ham , then cheese
7. Pour white wine into the skillet
8. Simmer until cheese is melted
9. Serve immediately

title: rich brown vegetable stock
steps:
1. Saute leeks , carrots , celery , potato and garlic until slightly browned
2. Add 5 cups water and remaining ingredients
3. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat and simmer uncovered for one hour
4. Strain and cool
5. Can easily be frozen and recipe is easily doubled

title: blender pancakes
steps:
1. Put the water , whole grain wheat berries and milk powder in the blender and blend on high 3 minutes
2. Add egg , oil , honey and salt and blend on high for another minute
3. Add the baking powder and pulse 3 times , just enough to mix
4. Mixture should foam up and get very light
5. Cook immediately on a hot skillet
6. Serve with maple syrup , cinnamon sugar , powdered sugar , or whatever you desire !

title: baked catfish fillets
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Whisk wet ingredients together in a bowl and combine dry ingredients on a piece of wax paper
3. Spray a glass baking dish with pam or olive oil
4. Rinse catfish in cool water and dry thoroughly with paper towels
5. Dip each catfish fillet in wet ingredients and dredge in breading to coat
6. Just a nice , light covering is enough
7. Don't try to completely cover in breading
8. Place catfish fillets in glass baking dish & refrigerate for 10 minutes
9. This step , plus making sure the fillets are very dry before dipping in the egg will help the breading stick to the fish and not the pan !
10. Bake at 425 for 10 to 12 minutes per side
11. Serve with lemon wedges for garnish

title: saintly stoved potatoes
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large deep frying pan
2. Add the paprika and rosemary and then the potatoes
3. Take to a high heat and stir the potatoes for 2 or 3 minutes to make sure they are coated with the spices
4. Add the stock and the whole garlic and bring to the boil
5. Cover the pan and simmer for 20 minutes
6. Take off the cover and boil rapidly until the liquid has evaporated , stirring the potatoes occasionally to ensure they dont stick
7. Once cooked they will have an almost roasted appearance , similar to patatas bravas minus the fat !

title: mexican taco dip
steps:
1. Mix cream cheese and picante sauce together and spread on bottom of 9x13 pan
2. Place lettuce , green peppers , tomatoes and onions on top in layers
3. Sprinkle with cheddar cheese
4. Serve with tortilla chips

title: garlic asparagus
steps:
1. Heat the oven for @ 400 degrees
2. Clean and cut off the thick ends of the asparagus and place in a deep baking dish
3. With a pastry brush , brush on the crushed garlic in both vertical and horizontal directions to coat the vegetable
4. Drizzle the olive oil in a horizontal direction from left to right
5. Finish off the asparagus by lightly dusting the top with the sea salt and fresh ground pepper
6. Bake in the oven uncovered for @ 15-20 minutes
7. When the asparagus looks tender , change the oven temperature setting to broil for @ 5 minutes to deepen and crisp the
8. Serve immediately !

title: american bacon  lettuce  tomato salad
steps:
1. Layer tomatoes , bacon , salad greens , dressing and cheese in large serving bowl
2. Toss just before serving

title: fruit shaped cookies
steps:
1. Mix margarine and sugar in medium bowl
2. Stir in flour and almond extract until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
3. Divide dough into 3 equal parts
4. Tint and shape each portion as desired
5. See below for fruit options
6. Place on ungreased cookie sheet
7. Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes
8. Preheat oven to 300f degrees
9. Bake cookies for about 30 minutes , until they're set but not browned
10. Apples: mix red or green food colour into part of dough
11. Shape into small balls
12. Insert small piece of cinnamon stick in top of each stem end and whole clove into bottom of each for blossom end
13. Dilute red or green food colour with water and brush over apples
14. Apricots: mix red and yellow food colours into part of dough
15. Shape into small balls
16. Make crease down 1 side of each with a wooden pick
17. Insert whole clove in each for stem end
18. Dilute red food colour with water and brush over apricots
19. Oranges: mix red and yellow food colours into part of dough
20. Shape into small balls
21. Insert whole clove in each for blossom end
22. Prick balls with blunt end of wooden pick to resemble texture of orange peel
23. Pears: mix yellow food colour into part of dough
24. Shape into small balls , then into cone shapes , rounding narrow end of each
25. Insert small piece of stick cinnamon in narrow end for stem
26. Dilute red food colour with water and brush on"cheeks" of pears
27. Bananas: mix yellow food colour into part of dough
28. Shape into 3-inch rolls , tapering end to resemble bananas
29. Flatten tops slightly to show planes of banana
30. Curve each slightly
31. Paint on characteristic markings with mixture of red , yellow and blue food colours diluted with water
32. Strawberries: mix red food colour into part of dough
33. Shape into small balls , then into heart shapes
34. Prick with blunt end of wooden pick for texture
35. Roll each in red sugar
36. Insert small piece of green-coloured wooden pick or green dough into top of each for stem

title: cream cheese cinnamon crescents
steps:
1. Roll out one can of crescent rolls in bottom of 9x13 pan
2. I sprayed pan with cooking spray
3. Cream together: 2 8oz
4. Cream cheese
5. 1 cup sugar
6. 1 teaspoon vanilla
7. Spread this mixture over crescent rolls
8. Lay second tube of crescent rolls over mixture
9. Melt 1 / 2 cup butter , mix in 3 / 4 cup sugar ,
10. 1 teaspoon cinnamon , and pour over top
11. Bake at 350 for 30-35 minutes

title: spaetzle noodles
steps:
1. Follow package directions for noodles
2. When done , dump the spaetzle into a colander and quickly rinse with cool water
3. Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat and add the spaetzle , tossing to coat
4. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes to give the noodles some color , then sprinkle with chives and season with salt and pepper

title: ham   cheese casserole
steps:
1. Prepare your casserole dish by buttering with the butter or spray with pam
2. Cook noodles as per package
3. While noodles are cooking , chunk up the ham and add to your casserole dish
4. Drain noodles and place in casserole dish
5. Add 2 cups of shredded cheddar cheese
6. Using 2 forks , kinda toss / mix together the noodles cheese and ham
7. Put a little extra cheese on top
8. Cover and pop in microwave 8 to 10 minutes , just until the cheese is nice and melted and the chunked ham is heated
9. You could put it in the oven too at 350f for the same time , but i always just nuke it

title: portabella mushroom with spinach and feta lasagna  vegetarian
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking dish
3. Cook the lasagna noodles until soft
4. Meanwhile in a saucepan , stir together the tomatoes , tomato sauce , tomato paste , vinegar and seasonings
5. Heat till a medium boil
6. Reduce the heat , cover , and simmer for 20-25 minutes
7. In a medium bowl , stir together 1-1 / 2 cups mozzarella cheese , feta cheese , spinach and the egg
8. In the bottom of the prepared baking dish , spread 1 / 3 of the sauce on the bottom
9. Layer 3 pieces of cooked lasagna noodles on top of the sauce
10. Then 1 / 2 of the cheese mixture
11. Then 1 / 2 of the sliced mushrooms
12. Then another 1 / 3 of the sauce
13. Repeat
14. Top with the remaining pasta , then the balance of the sauce and then mozzarella cheese
15. Cover with foil
16. Bake for 25 minutes , uncover , and bake for 5-7 minutes longer , or until the cheese melts

title: jiffy mix fajita pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Grease 12" pizza pan
3. Cut chicken into strips
4. Heat skillet and add oil
5. Saute chicken for 5 minutes
6. Add green pepper and onion
7. Continue cooking until tender
8. Remove from heat and add salsa
9. Set aside
10. For crust , blend baking mix with water
11. Turn dough on surface dusted with baking mix or flour
12. Knead until dough is not sticky
13. Press on prepared pan
14. Spread 1 / 2 cup cheese on crust and top with chicken mixture
15. Sprinkle remaining cheese on top
16. Bake 15-20 minutes

title: red beans and rice with smoked sausage  new orleans style
steps:
1. Place beans in dutch oven and cover generously with water
2. Let soak 30 minutes
3. Add all remaining ingredients to beans except salt , rice , and hot sauce
4. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat
5. Reduce heat to medium-low , cover and simmer until beans are tender , adding more water if necessary , about 2 1 / 2 hours
6. Add salt to taste
7. Discard ham bones after cutting any meat from them into bite-sized pieces
8. Return meat to pot
9. Remove about 1 / 2 cup of beans from mixture and mash to a paste
10. Return mashed beans to pot and stir through
11. Simmer 15 more minutes
12. Serve hot over rice: pass hot sauce , if desired

title: prosciutto spirals with balsamic glaze
steps:
1. Prepare glaze by simmering vinegar in a small saucepan over medium-high heat until reduced by half
2. Set aside
3. According to the recipe , this should take 7-9 minutes but i found it took quite a bit longer
4. Now i use the balsamic glaze mentioned in the description
5. Prepare the filling by whisking the cream cheese until smooth
6. Add artichokes , onion and basil to cream cheese and mix well
7. To assemble rolls , lay a sheet of plastic wrap on work surface
8. Arrange four slices of prosciutto vertically on plastic wrap , overlapping slightly to form a 9 inch square
9. Spread 1 / 3 cup of artichoke filling over prosciutto
10. Top with 1 / 2 cup of arugula
11. Starting at the side closest to you , tightly roll up prosciutto and fillings like a jelly-roll or a sushi roll
12. Wrap up in the plastic wrap
13. Refrigerate until ready to serve
14. Repeat 3 more times for a total of 4 rolls
15. To serve , remove each roll from plastic wrap and slice into 12 spirals for a total of 48 rolls
16. Place on serving platter and drizzle with glaze

title: carnivore s lasagna
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a heavy pan , heat the olive oil over medium heat
3. Add the onion , garlic , half of the ground meat , and the italian sausage
4. Brown for 10 minutes
5. Drain the meat mixture , if needed
6. Add the tomato sauce , brown sugar , 1 tablespoon parsley , and 1 / 2 teaspoon each of the fennel seed , basil , thyme , oregano , black pepper and salt
7. Gently stir , cover , and let simmer over low heat for 1 hour
8. While the sauce is cooking , prepare the meatballs , ricotta cheese mixture , and lasagna noodles
9. First , beat 1 egg in a large bowl
10. Add the oatmeal , 1 / 2 cup of parmasan , and the rest of the ground meat , black pepper , fennel seed , basil , thyme , oregano , and salt
11. Combine well
12. Roll the meat into balls that are about 1 inch in diameter
13. Place them on a sprayed pan and bake for 20 minutes , turning the meatballs over halfway through the cooking time
14. Put the ricotta cheese in another bowl
15. Add the other egg , nutmeg , and rest of parsley
16. Combine well and set aside
17. Now just soak the lasagna noodles in a large pan filled with very hot water for at least 15 minutes
18. Once the sauce is cooked , construct the lasagna in a deep 9x3-inch pan
19. First , spread 2 cups of the sauce on the bottom of the pan
20. Lay 6 noodles down
21. Spread half of the ricotta over the noodles , then sprinkle that with 1 / 3 of the mozzeralla and parmasan
22. Top that with half of the pepperoni
23. Make another layer in the same way , starting with 2 cups of sauce
24. After that , lay down the rest of the lasagna noodles on top
25. Mix in the cooked meatballs with the rest of the sauce , and spread on top of the lasagna
26. Top with rest of cheese
27. Cover with foil , and bake at 350f for 25 minutes
28. Remove the foil , then bake for 25 minutes
29. Remove , then let cool for at least 15 minutes before serving

title: oat and walnut pancakes
steps:
1. In large bowl , mix the flours , walnuts , oats , sugar , allspice , cinnamon , salt , and baking powder together well
2. In a medium bowl , mix the soy milk and vinegar together
3. Add the liquid ingredients to the dry ingredients and whisk until well incorporated
4. The resulting batter should be a little thicker than heavy cream
5. Pour about 1 / 2 cup batter into a lightly oiled nonstick saute pan or skillet and cook until lightly browned on each side
6. Lightly spread with good vegetable margarine and drizzle with pure maple syrup

title: green salad with dried figs and nuts
steps:
1. Cut greens into large pieces and place in a bowl
2. Add the shallots and mix
3. Add half the figs and walnuts
4. Put all the dressing ingredients in a glass jar , close the jar tightly and shake until well blended
5. Pour the dressing over the salad , mix well and transfer to a platter
6. Sprinkle the rest of the figs and walnuts on top and serve immediately

title: evil chocolate cherry pie
steps:
1. Combine cream cheese , chocolate syrup , vanilla , half of the cool whip , and 1 / 4 cup of curled chocolate in a mixer on medium speed until smooth
2. Spoon into pie crust and smooth with a spatula or rubber scraper
3. Chill in refrigerator for 1-2 hours
4. Pour pie filling on top and garnish with chocolate curls
5. Return to refrigerator until ready to serve

title: cordon croquettes   rachael ray
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine the turkey , celery , thyme and paprika
2. In a small bowl , combine the ground bread and milk and then squeeze the crumbs as you transfer them to the meat mixture
3. Mix in the egg , parmigiano-reggiano and parsley and season with salt and pepper
4. Spread a foot-long piece of wax paper on a work surface
5. Using a rubber spatula , spread half the meat mixture on the wax paper to form an 8-inch-square
6. Top with the ham and swiss cheese , then the remaining meat mixture , forming the same square shape
7. Seal the edges to enclose
8. Cut into 4 square patties and coat each in the bread crumbs
9. In a large skillet , heat 1 inch olive oil over medium-high heat
10. Add the patties and fry turning once , until browned , about 10 minutes
11. Drain on paper towels and sprinkle with salt

title: bruschetta abruzzese
steps:
1. Dice onions and tomatoes in small pices , add salt pepper , oregano , olive oil chop basil
2. Mix well refridgerate for 10 minutes
3. Slice bread in 1 / 2inch slices toast lightly
4. One tablespoon of bruscetta mix per slice

title: garlic tomato soup
steps:
1. In the bottom of a large soup pot , heat the olive oil
2. Add the minced garlic and sautee until the oil is infused , taking care not to burn the garlic
3. Add the paprika , and remove the pot from the flame when it begins to sizzle
4. Let sit for fifteen seconds or so , then return the pot to the flame
5. Add the canned chopped tomatoes , water , and bullion
6. Stir occasionally and allow to simmer
7. Make the croutons: butter the bread generously , and press the buttered side into the grated parmesan
8. Place bread cheese-side-up on a baking sheet and place in a 350 degree oven until cheese is melted and the croutons are beginning to look toasty
9. Finish the soup by adding a few dashes of tobasco sauce to taste , and salt& pepper if needed
10. To serve place a crouton in the bottom of each bowl and cover with generous ladle or two of soup

title: raspberry  nectarine and mango crumble
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. With an electric mixer , combine 1 cup flour , brown sugar , cinnamon , salt , and oats
3. Mix on low for 30 seconds , add butter , and mix until clumps form
4. Transfer to a bowl , cover , and refrigerate until ready to use
5. Peel and pit nectarines , and cut into 1-inch chunks
6. Place in a large bowl
7. Halve mangoes lengthwise , angling the knife slightly to cut around the pit
8. Remove and discard pit and peel
9. Cut flesh into 1-inch chunks and add to nectarines
10. Add raspberries
11. Add remaining 1 1 / 2 tablespoons flour , granulated sugar , and lime juice
12. Toss gently to combine
13. Transfer fruit to a shallow 12-inch round gratin dish
14. Distribute topping evenly over fruit
15. Bake until topping is golden brown and juices bubble remove from oven and let cool slightly
16. Serve warm with ice cream

title: making a bulgarian  greek style yogurt
steps:
1. Using a large pot , heat the milk to about 195-200 f
2. This is for two reasons:
3. One: it kills any other bacteria that might be in the milk that would compete against the bacteria that convert milk to yogurt
4. Two: it changes the milk protein in a way that allows it to culture and firm up
5. Let it cool down to 110-115f
6. Wisk in the yogurt culture into the milk gently
7. Transfer into the yogurt jars and close the lids
8. Wrap jars in a thick blanket or put in a ice cooler isolated with a blanket over night
9. After 6-8 hours the yogurt should be firm
10. Test by gently turning it to see if it keeps its shape
11. Transfer jars to the refrigerator

title: french roast pork
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f
2. Wipe pork roast with damp paper towel and rub the outside of the pork with the slices of garlic
3. Combine 1 1 / 2 teaspoons salt and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper and rub over pork to coat well and insert garlic slivers where possible in crevices in bone
4. Place the pork , fat side up , in a large shallow roasting pan on top of 1 / 2 cup chopped onion , 1 / 2 cup chopped carrots and 2 parsley sprigs and roast uncovered for 1 hour
5. Remove from the pan and pour off most of the fat , leaving about 1 tablespoon in pan , stir 2 tablespoons flour into pan and gradually stir in 1 1 / 2 cup of chicken stock into flour mixture until well combined and smooth
6. Bring to the boil then reduce heat to a simmer , stirring to dissolve browned bits for about 2 minutes , strain gravy through strainer into saucepan , discarding vegetables
7. Set gravy aside to reheat later and return pork to roasting tray
8. Gently toss sliced potatoes with 1 cup chopped onion and 1 tablespoon chopped parsley , 1 tablespoon salt and 1 / 8 teaspoon pepper to mix well , arrange around roast and heat remaining chicken stock to boiling and pour over potatoes , brush potatoes with melted butter
9. Reduce oven temperature to 400 degrees f , then roast pork 45 minutes to 1 hour longer , reheat the gravy and serve with pork and potatoes

title: rosemary grilled chicken
steps:
1. Place each chicken breast between two pieces of wax paper and pound to an even thickness
2. Place in a resealable bag
3. Place bag in a small bowl
4. In a small bowl combine lime peel , lime juice , rosemary , olive oil , sugar , garlic , and salt
5. Seal bag , turning to coat chicken
6. Refrigerate for 1 to 4 hours , turning occasionally
7. Remove chicken from marinade
8. Discard marinade
9. Season chicken with black pepper
10. Grill over medium coals uncovered , turning once for 12 to 15 minutes or until tender and no longer pink

title: louisiana crawfish casserole
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except cheeses and pour into a large greased casserole
2. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes
3. Uncover and sprinkle cheeses over casserole
4. Return to oven and bake for 15 minutes more

title: oh my cod
steps:
1. Rub oil all over fillets
2. Place in greased baking dish
3. Combine , thyme , parsley , paprika , lemon zest , salt , pepper , olive oil , brown sugar and garlic
4. Place mixture on top of fillets
5. Sprinkle panko over cod
6. Leave at room temperature while the oven preheats to 450 degrees
7. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until cod flakes easily when tested with a fork
8. Or until until the fish reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees
9. Serve with lemon wedges

title: simple oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In a large bowl beat eggs until frothy , beat in sugars
3. Add oil and vanilla
4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water and stir into egg mixture
5. In a seperate bowl mix oats , flour , salt and cinnamon
6. Stir oats mixture into egg mixture , mix well
7. Drop by teaspoons onto greased baking sheet
8. Let cool for a few minutes before removing
9. Bake for 8 minutes

title: goat cheese   tomato dressing
steps:
1. Put the cheese , vinegar , basil and garlic in a blender and pulse to combine
2. Add the tomato
3. Puree
4. With the blender running gradually add the oil through lid until the mixture is smooth
5. Season with the salt and pepper
6. Store in airtight jar in reridgerator for up to 2 weeks
7. Shake well before using

title: chili taco   burrito   fajita sauce
steps:
1. In a large pot , ground the beef over medium low heat till all the pink is gone ,
2. Season with salt , pepper
3. Add diced onions and garlic and saut till translucent
4. Add chili powder , beans , tomato juice and diced tomatoes
5. Mix well
6. Bring to a boil over medium-lo , stirring occasionally to prevent scorching
7. Take 1 or 2 cups of the mixture and puree it
8. This will give a thicker sauce and it will give a nice full bodied taste to the sauce as well
9. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 hour , stirring occasionally
10. Serve hot and enjoy !

title: cinnamon cereal crunchies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 325 degrees and grease a cookie sheet
2. Beat egg white in a large bowl on high speed until foamy
3. Beat in cinnamon and salt
4. Gradually beat in brown sugar on med speed until thick and glossy
5. Fold in cereal until completely coated
6. Spread as thinly as possible on the cookie sheet
7. Bake 12-15 minutes or until set
8. Immediately remove from cookie sheet using spatula
9. Cool and then break into pieces
10. Store in airtight container

title: berries artesia
steps:
1. Rinse berries well and put aside
2. In a heavy saucepan , add the wine , apple juice , bay leaf , sugar and vanilla bean , making sure to add the pod as well as the scraped-out seeds
3. Turn heat to medium and bring to a boil
4. Remove from heat , then add arrowroot to thicken
5. Return to the heat and simmer for two minutes
6. Add berries and allow to cool
7. Serve over ice cream

title: malibu mango mojito
steps:
1. Muddle mint leaves and 1 lime wedge in the bottom of tall glass
2. Add rum , club soda , ice , and lime wedges
3. Garnish with mint and enjoy this tasty treat !

title: greek chicken easy delicious
steps:
1. Combine first 3 ingredients
2. Sprinkle evenly over chicken
3. Cook chicken in hot oil in a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat 5 minutes on each side or until browned
4. Remove chicken
5. Add bell pepper and onion to skillet
6. Saut 5 minutes or until tender
7. Stir in wine and broth , stirring to loosen particles from bottom of pan
8. Stir in olives
9. Return chicken to skillet
10. Bring to a boil
11. Remove skillet from heat
12. Bake , covered , at 350 for 30 minutes or until chicken is done
13. Combine rice and chopped parsley
14. Serve chicken over rice

title: polish delights
steps:
1. Brown hamburger and sausage in separate skillets
2. Drain both
3. In a pot , add hamburger , sausage , and rest of ingredients and stir until cheese is melted
4. Put 1 teaspoons of mixture on each bread slice and freeze on cookie sheets for 10 minute or until set
5. Remove from sheets and place in plastic bags
6. Freeze
7. Take out as many as you want to use and place on cookie sheet
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 10-15 minutes or until hot

title: grilled vietnamese chicken
steps:
1. Heat grill
2. Place all the ingredients except the chicken in a shallow glass baking dish and stir them together
3. Make shallow slits across the chicken breast , going a little deeper in the thick end
4. Make shallow slits long ways , resulting in a slight diamond pattern in the meat
5. Put the chicken in the marinade and make sure some gets in the slits
6. This only needs to marinade for 10 or 15 minutes to pick up the flavor , i believe this is because of the slits
7. Place on grill and cook for 8 to 10 minutes , until no longer pink
8. Turn once during cooking

title: zucchini parmesan
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Wash zucchini , remove ends , and slice into 1 / 3 inch coins
3. Slice the onion very thinly
4. Peel garlic
5. Beat eggs in shallow bowl
6. In a separate shallow bowl , combine flour , onion powder , garlic powder , paprika , basil , oregano , seasoning salt , and bread crumbs
7. Stir to mix well
8. Dip sliced zucchini into egg mixture , then into flour mixture
9. Heat olive oil in skillet and add whole garlic cloves
10. As the garlic cloves become golden , crush them into the oil using a fork
11. Remove garlic before it becomes brown
12. Place zucchini in hot oil
13. Don't overload the skillet as they should cook separated in the oil
14. Sprinkle a few slices of sliced onion over them
15. Turn zucchini over as they become golden brown and cook the other side
16. Remove zucchini and onions to a paper towel to drain
17. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste
18. Arrange zucchini on the bottom of a greased 8x8 baking dish
19. Sprinkle a layer of parmesan cheese and a layer of mozzarella , then with a layer of tomato sauce
20. Continue to make layers of zucchini , cheeses , and sauce until all ingredients are used , ending with mozzarella
21. Sprinkle with buttered bread crumbs , if desired
22. Bake uncovered at 350f for 25 minutes or until bubbly
23. Let cool for a couple minutes before serving

title: date  walnut and blue cheese ball
steps:
1. Place first 4 ingredients in a large bowl
2. Beat with a mixer at medium speed for 2 minutes or until smooth and creamy
3. Add dates , shallots , lemon rind , salt and pepper , beat at medium speed until well blended , scraping sides of bowl as necessary
4. Spoon cheese mixture onto a large sheet of plastic wrap
5. Form into a ball
6. Using a rubber spatula
7. Wrap cheese ball in plastic wrap
8. Chill overnight
9. Combine parsley and walnuts in a shallow dish
10. Unwrap cheese ball
11. Gently roll ball in nut mixture , coating well
12. Place on a serving plate
13. Serve immediately , or cover and refrigerate until ready to serve

title: tomato soup   shells
steps:
1. Place the shells on to boil
2. Remove from the heat once al dente
3. Mix the rest of the ingredients together in a small sauce pan
4. Simmer over low heat while the shells are boiling
5. Drain the water from the shells then add the soup , stir to coat

title: luau sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Place yams in an ovenproof dish and add bananas
3. Combine remaining ingredients , except nuts
4. Pour over yams and bananas
5. Sprinkle with nuts
6. Bake at 350 for 25-30 minutes until bubbly

title: my best new england clam chowder
steps:
1. Cover salt pork with water and bring to boil over med-hi heat
2. Cook 5 minutes
3. With slotted spoon , transfer pork to dutch oven and cook over med-hi heat until crisp
4. Remove and discard pork and all but a little bit of the drippings
5. Add butter and when melted , add the onions and saute until golden
6. Stir in flour and cook over low heat 5 minutes , stirring constantly
7. Stir in the pepper and thyme
8. Add potatoes , 1 / 2 & 1 / 2 and chicken broth
9. Bring to a boil
10. Reduce heat and simmer , stirring frequently , about 5 minutes
11. Add clams , clam juice , parsley
12. Simmer another 5 min
13. Stirring occasionally
14. Add lemon juice and pepper sauce and salt to taste
15. Serve with oyster crackers

title: quinoa stuffed kabocha squash
steps:
1. In a sauce pan , place quinoa , 1 cup of water and a vegetable stock cube
2. Bring into a boil , reduce heat and cover , and cook until all the water is gone , for about 15 minutes
3. Cut onion , pepper , and mushrooms
4. Cut the top off of the squash and scoop out seeds
5. Preheat oven to 350f / 180c degrees
6. In a saut pan , heat olive oil , and saut chopped onion and pepper until the onion becomes translucent
7. Add mushrooms and saut a little longer
8. Season with salt and pepper
9. Add cooked vegetables and raisins to the cooked quinoa and mix
10. Stuff the squash with the quinoa mixture and cover with the squash top
11. Bake in the oven for about 60 minutes or until the squash is soft
12. Remove the top for the last 10 minutes
13. Infuse love and serve !

title: baked caramelized parmesan tomatoes
steps:
1. Butter a large baking dish , large enough to hold the tomato halves side by side without overlapping
2. Slice the tomatoes in half , horizontally
3. Scoop out the insides and place in a strainer
4. Turn the tomato shells upside down on paper towels to drain
5. Chop the flesh of the tomatoes and drain or squeeze most of the liquid out
6. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
7. In a large mixing bowl , mix the breadcrumbs , 3 / 4 cup of the parmesan , parsley , oregano , garlic , chopped tomatoes , and green onions
8. Incorporate half of the olive oil into the mixture
9. Salt and pepper to taste , add more olive oil as needed , it should stick together but not be wet
10. You may need to use all of the olive oil or just some of it , all depends on how much liquid remains in the tomatoes
11. Place the tomato shells in the baking dish and evenly distribute the mozzarella slices in the bottom of each then fill with the breadcrumb mixture
12. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour
13. Remove from oven and top tomatoes with the remaining parmesan and return to oven to bake for another 15 or 30 minutes , until the cheese creates a nice caramel crusty top

title: hot chipotle chicken wings
steps:
1. Remove the
2. Separate the wings at the joints
3. Wash wings and pat dry with paper towels
4. Place wings in container with a lid or sealable plastic bag
5. Remove the peppers from the adobo and chop fine
6. Mix chopped peppers with the adobo and other ingredients
7. Pour over wings , stir around till they are coated and allow to marinate for 1 to 24 hours
8. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
9. Place wings on foil lined cookie sheet
10. Bake for 30 to 45 minutes till wings are done

title: chinese steamed buns  mantou
steps:
1. In a small bowl , sprinkle yeast and sugar over 4 tablespoons of the warm water and leave it for 15 minutes
2. Place the flour in a bowl and make a well in the center
3. Pour in the yeast mixture and the remaining water
4. Mix everything to form a dough
5. Turn it onto a floured board and knead until smooth
6. Return dough to the bowl , cover and let it stand in a warm place for about an hour or until doubled in size
7. Punch down , cover again and let it stand for 20 minutes longer
8. Knead the dough again and shape into rolls
9. Bring the water in the bottom of a steamer to a boil
10. Place the rolls in the steamer , leaving a 1- inch gap between them
11. Cook for 10 minutes or until firm and cooked through
12. Serve them hot

title: cranberry breakfast pretzels
steps:
1. In a food processor combine cranberries , applesauce and 1 tbs sugar
2. Process until finely chopped
3. Set aside
4. In a mixing bowl , dissolve yeast in warm milk
5. Add 1 tbs sugar
6. Let stand 5 minutes
7. Add the cranberry mixture , oil , salt , and enough flour to form a soft dough
8. Turn onto a lightly floured surface
9. Knead until smooth and elastic , 6-8 minutes
10. Place in a bowl coated with nonstick spray , turning once to coat the top
11. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled in size , about 90 minutes
12. Punch down dough
13. Turn onto a floured surface
14. Divide into 15 balls
15. Roll each ball into a 14-inch rope and form in pretzel shape
16. In a large saucepan , bring water to a boil
17. Drop pretzels , one at a time into water
18. Boil for 10 seconds on each side
19. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels
20. Place pretzels on baking sheets coated with nonstick spray
21. Cover and let rise in a warm place until puffy , about 25 minutes
22. Brush with egg white
23. Combine cinnamon and sugar
24. Sprinkle over tops
25. Bake at 375 degrees 12-14 minutes , until golden brown

title: cream cheese rhubarb bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine butter , flour , oats and brown sugar until crumbly
3. Press 1 / 2 the mixture into bottom of 9x13 baking pan
4. Beat cream cheese , white sugar , eggs , cinnamon and nutmeg in a large mixing bowl
5. Stir in rhubarb
6. Pour over prepared crust
7. Sprinkle with remaining reserved topping
8. Bake for 40-45 minutes
9. Cool and refrigerate
10. Serve cool

title: nigella lawson cupcakes
steps:
1. Nigella offers a very important
2. This will give a lightness to the cupcakes later - and preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
3. For those on a schedule , put all of the ingredients for the cupcakes except for the milk into a food processor and blitz until smooth
4. Pulse while adding the milk down the funnel , to make a smooth dropping consistency
5. Or if you're a bit more old fashioned using a bowl and wooden spoon , cream the butter and sugar , beat in the eggs one at a time with a little of the flour
6. Then add the vanilla extract and fold in the rest of the flour , adding the milk to get the dropping consistency as before
7. Divide the mixture between a 12-bun muffin tin lined with muffin papers , and bake in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes
8. They should have risen and be golden on top
9. Let them cool a little in their tins on a rack , and then take them carefully out of the tin to cool in their papers , still on the wire rack
10. Ice with royal icing
11. Royal icing: 2 large egg whites (or substitute powdered egg whites , 3 cups confectioners' sugar(known to australians as icing sugar
12. 1 teaspoon lemon juice
13. Combine the egg whites and confectioners' sugar in a medium-size mixing bowl and whip with an electric mixer on medium speed until opaque and shiny , about 5 minutes
14. Whisk in the lemon juice , this will thin out the icing
15. Beat for another couple of minutes until you reach the right spreading consistency for the cupcakes
16. Must use self rising flour
17. Substituting all purpose will result in cakes that do not rise , as no other levening agents are used in this recipe

title: buttered noodles with garlic and sun dried tomatoes
steps:
1. Melt butter in small sauce pan
2. Add garlic and cook under low heat for about five minutes
3. Add tomatoes and tomato paste and stir until well blended
4. Combine noodles , sauce and chopped parsley in a large bowl
5. Toss until well mixed
6. Salt and pepper to taste
7. Serve immediately

title: balsamic glazed cracked pepper salmon   clean eating
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
2. Season both sides of salmon with salt and cracked pepper
3. Add salmon to skillet and cook 1 to 2 minutes per side , until golden brown and fork-tender
4. Meanwhile , in a small bowl , whisk together vinegar and honey
5. Add vinegar mixture to skillet , watch carefully for the sauce will thicken almost immediately
6. Serve and enjoy

title: 7 layer ham casserole
steps:
1. In 2 quart casserole dish layer ham , rice , broccoli and onion
2. Mix soup , milk and cheese in bowl , pour over layers
3. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes , or until hot and bubbly
4. I sometimes add buttered bread crumbs to the top before baking

title: sausage stuffed manicotti with sun dried tomato sauce
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Spray 13x9-inch glass baking dish with cooking spray
3. Spread 1 cup of the pasta sauce in dish
4. To remaining sauce in jar , add water and mix well
5. Cut sausage links in half lengthwise
6. Remove casing
7. Shape each piece of sausage into roll
8. Stuff into uncooked pasta shell
9. Place stuffed shells on sauce in dish
10. Pour remaining sauce mixture over shells
11. Cover tightly with foil
12. Bake 1 hour 20 minutes
13. Sprinkle with mozzarella and parmesan cheese
14. Bake uncovered 10 minutes longer or until cheeses are melted and pasta is tender
15. Let stand 10 minutes before serving

title: mexican goulash
steps:
1. In a large skillet , brown together sausage , onion and green pepper
2. Add tomatoes , sour cream , macaroni and seasonings
3. Cover and simmer 20 minutes

title: healthier spinach balls
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine stuffing , onion , egg substitute , egg , parmesan , butter , broth , garlic , thyme , salt and pepper
2. Stir in spinach until well combined
3. Roll into 1-inch balls
4. Place in a 15x10x1-inch baking dish coated with nonstick spray
5. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees until golden brown , about 15-20 minutes

title: cranberry and raisin bread pudding with caramel sauce
steps:
1. Place the cranberrys , raisins and nuts in a small bowl with just enough boiling water to cover
2. Let stand a few minutes until they are plumped out and then drain
3. In a large bowl blend the bread , cranberrys , raisins and nuts
4. In a medium bowl mix the remaining ingredients together and pour it over the bread mixture and blend
5. Pour the mixture into a lightly oiled 8x12 baking dish and allow to stand for 10 minutes before placing in oven
6. Bake in a hot 350 degrees oven for 40-45 minutes
7. Cool before cutting into serving size portions
8. The carmamel sauce
9. It is so simple - you make the choice in how much you want to make up at a time
10. Place ingredients in a microwave safe dish and just slightly warm up until the caramel is slightly melted
11. Blend well and pour over the bread pudding servings

title: baked yams with cinnamon chili butter
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Using electric mixer , beat first 5 ingredients in a medium bowl until fluffy
3. Line large baking sheet with foil
4. Place yams on sheet , bake until tender , 1 hour 10 minutes
5. Slit each lengthwise
6. Spoon 1 tbs of butter into each
7. Pass remaining butter separately

title: grilled tuna steak with worcestershire
steps:
1. Combine all sauce ingredients together
2. Set aside
3. Season the tuna steaks with salt
4. Coat with ground black pepper
5. Grill the tuna over a hot charcoal grill , cooking each side for 2 minutes
6. Arrange on serving plates
7. Serve with the sauce on the side
8. Serve with steamed potatoes , and garnish with a sprig of parsley

title: fluffy milnot cheesecake
steps:
1. Crust: mix graham crackers and melted butter together
2. Reserve 1 / 2 cup and set aside , then press the rest into 13 x 9" cake pan
3. Bake at 350 for 8- 10 minutes and cool
4. Dissolve 2 pkgs jello in water and set aside to cool
5. Beat together cream cheese and sugar and set aside
6. Whip chilled milnot and sugar together until stiff
7. Add jello to cream cheese mixture and blend thoroughly
8. Add all to whipped milnot and beat until well mixed
9. Pour over cooled crust , sprinkle reserved crumb mixture on top and chill at least 2 hours

title: irish scrambler and irish bangers
steps:
1. In a large bowl whisk eggs , heavy cream , salt and pepper until combined
2. In a large non-stick skillet melt 2-tablespoons butter
3. Add irish bangers and cook 5 minutes or until done
4. Remove bangers place on a paper towels and remove excess grease
5. Hold bangers warm for service
6. In the same skillet add mushrooms , 1-teaspoon cajun seasoning and saut 3-4 minutes
7. Remove mushrooms and hold warm for service
8. Add 1-tablespoon butter , cajun seasoning , bell peppers , serrano peppers , green onions and saut 4-5 minutes
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste
10. Stir in fresh parsley
11. Add remaining butter and melt
12. Fold in eggs and scramble until almost done
13. Fold in irish farmhouse cheese and finish scrambling eggs
14. Divide scrambled eggs , irish bangers , mushrooms on warm plates and serve
15. Garnish plates with fresh strawberries and fresh parsley sprigs

title: murag on mondays
steps:
1. Place everything except the potatoes and coriander in the largest pot you have
2. Cover generously with water and cook for 3 / 4 hour
3. Add the potatoes and cook for a further 15-20 minutes , or until done
4. When nearly ready add the coriander
5. Serve over boiled rice , with large helpings of togetherness

title: grilled steak with crisp gorgonzola crust   scallions
steps:
1. Combine frist 5 ingredients
2. Stir well
3. Brush mixture evenly over both sides of steaks
4. Cook , covered with grill lid , over medium-hot coals 6-8 minutes each side or till desired doneness
5. Remove steaks from grill and place on rack in a broiler pan
6. Crumble cheese evenly over steaks
7. Sprinkle breadcrumbs evenly over cheese
8. Place green onions around steak on rack
9. Combine olive oil , 1 / 2 tsp kosher salt , and 1 / 4 tsp white pepper
10. Brush over green onions
11. Broil 5 1 / 2 " from heat 3 minutes till cheese is light brown and green onions are heated

title: chili macaroni    crock pot
steps:
1. In slow cooker , combine first 8 ingredients and mix well
2. Cover and cook on low heat for 6 hours or til heated through
3. Stir in macaroni and mix well
4. Season to taste

title: cachumbar  tomato  onion and ginger salad
steps:
1. Combine tomatoes , onions , cilantro , lemon juice ginger and salt , and mix well
2. Sprinkle the chili peppers on top
3. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving

title: easy southwestern stroganoff
steps:
1. Cook beef in a 10-inch skillet over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until brown , drain
2. Stir in water , salsa , salt and pasta
3. Heat to boiling , reduce heat
4. Cover and simmer about 15 min
5. , stirring occasionally , until pasta is tender
6. Stir in sour cream , cook until just hot

title: heavenly chocolate chunk cookies
steps:
1. Cream together butter , sugars , and chocolate syrup
2. Beat in eggs
3. Add in remaining ingredients
4. Drop by 1 / 4 cup on cookie sheet until no mix remains
5. Bake at 350 for 12-14 minutes
6. Do not over bake

title: cherry and tangerine oatmeal
steps:
1. In a nonmetal bowl combine oates , cherries , tangerine peel , cinnamon , salt and nutmeg
2. Stir in milk
3. Cover and chill for 8-24 hours
4. To serve , transfer oatmeal mixture to a saucepan
5. Heat just to boiling
6. Reduce heat
7. Simmer uncovered 5 mins or until oatmeal is done , stirring occasionally
8. Remove from heat
9. Stir in butter until melted
10. If desired , top with warmed milk , sugar and nuts

title: my mama s garlic spaghetti
steps:
1. Boil spaghetti to taste
2. In a separate pot on low heat combine all ingrediants until butter is melted and sauce is warm
3. Stir frequently so sauce does not burn
4. Combine sauce and spaghetti and your done ! combine with a side salad and french bread

title: turkey noodle soup  crock pot
steps:
1. Combine turkey carcass and water in crock pot
2. Add salt , pepper , onion , celery , carrots , parsley , marjoram , and bay leaf
3. Cover
4. Cook on low 5-6 hours
5. Remove carcass and bay leaf from cooker
6. Take meat off bones and return meat to broth
7. Discard bones
8. Add cooked noodles to crock pot
9. Cover and cook high 20-30 minutes
10. Discard bay leaf
11. Serve hot
12. Variation:
13. This recipe is designed for 4 1 / 2 quart crock pot
14. For 3 1 / 2 quart or smaller crock pot use chunks of turkey meat cut off the bones

title: green bean bake
steps:
1. In a 1 1 / 2 qt casserole mix soup , milk , soy& pepper
2. Stir in beans and 1 / 2 can fried onions
3. Bake 350 for 25 minutes
4. Top with remaining 1 / 2 can of fried onions
5. Brown for 5 minutes more

title: cheesy sausage and rice
steps:
1. Boil the rice
2. In the meantime , brown up the sausage , drain and add the can of cream of chicken
3. Put rice in a bowl scoop a spoonful or two of the sausage mixture over the rice
4. Add cheese to your desire !
5. Eat !

title: basil burgers
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the basil , onion , bread crumbs , wine and garlic salt
2. Crumble beef over mixture and mix well
3. Shape into eight patties
4. Grill , covered , over medium heat for 5-7 minutes on each side or until a meat thermometer reads 160 and juices run clear
5. Top with cheese if desired
6. Serve on buns
7. Yield: 8 servings

title: thai chicken appetizer skewers
steps:
1. Rinse chicken
2. Pat dry with paper towels
3. Slice chicken crosswise into 3-inch-wide strips , 1 / 4-inch to 3 / 8-inch thick
4. Place in a shallow glass dish
5. In a small bowl , combine the marinade ingredients
6. Pour over the chicken and toss well to coat
7. Cover and marinate in refrigerator for at least 30 minutes , but no more than 2 hours
8. Stir mixture occasionally
9. Prepare grill for direct cooking
10. Brush rack with vegetable or peanut oil
11. Meanwhile , combine the dipping sauce ingredients in a small saucepan
12. Cook and stir over medium heat - bring to a boil
13. Reduce heat and simmer , uncovered , 2 to 4 minutes or until slightly thickened , smooth and bubbly
14. Keep warm in a small serving bowl
15. Garnish with chopped peanuts just before serving
16. Drain chicken
17. Reserve the marinade
18. Thread the chicken strips , accordion-style , onto twelve 6-inch metal skewers
19. Transfer skewered chicken to prepared rack of uncovered grill
20. Grill directly over medium coals 8 to 10 minutes or until the chicken is tender and no longer pink
21. Turn once , halfway through grilling time , and brush often with the reserved marinade during the last 5 minutes of cooking
22. Discard remaining marinade
23. Serve immediately on skewers with the warm peanut sauce for dipping

title: old fashioned southern cornbread dressing
steps:
1. Put chicken in a dutch oven
2. Cover with water
3. Bring to a boil and cook over medium heat
4. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 45 minutes or until the chicken is tender
5. Remove chicken from heat , reserving the broth
6. Let cool and debone the chicken
7. Cut chicken into bite size pieces
8. Discard sking and bones
9. Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat on stovetop
10. Add onion and celery and cook about 6 minutes until veggies are tender
11. Preheat oven to 350
12. Lightly grease a 13-x-9-x-2-inch baking dish
13. Set aside
14. In a large bowl , combine chicken , onion-and-celery mixture , cornbread , and remaining ingredients
15. Spoon mixture into prepared baking dish
16. Bake , uncovered , for 1 hour , or until set

title: carrots glazed with balsamic vinegar and butter
steps:
1. Melt butter in heavy large pot over medium heat
2. Add carrots and saut 5 minutes
3. Cover and cook until carrots are crisp-tender , stirring occasionally , about 7 minutes
4. Stir in sugar and vinegar
5. Cook uncovered until carrots are tender and glazed , stirring frequently , about 12 minutes longer
6. Season to taste with salt and pepper
7. Add parsley or cilantro and toss to blend
8. Transfer to bowl and serve

title: vineterta
steps:
1. First , prepare the prune filling :
2. Cover 20-24 ounces of pitted prunes with boiling water in a saucepan
3. Once the prunes are softened , drain the water and put it aside for later
4. Puree prunes in a food processor and put them back into the saucepan
5. Add half cup of the reserved prune water to the puree and bring it to a boil over medium heat
6. Mix in 1 cup sugar and 2 tspn cinnamon
7. Boil off excess water until the mixture has the texture of jam
8. If the mixture is too thick , add in more reserved prune water
9. Remove from heat
10. Mix in 1 tspn vanilla extract
11. Set aside to cool
12. Next we do the second major section , preparing the layers:
13. Mix the following wet ingredients together in a mixer: 1 cup butter , 1
14. 5 cups sugar , 2 eggs , 1 tspn almond extract , 2 tbsp light cream
15. Mix dry ingredients in another mixing bowl: 4 cups flour , 1 pinch of salt , 1 tspn baking powder , 1 / 2 cup ground almonds , 1 tspn cardamom
16. Add dry ingredients into the wet ingredients and mix well in the mixer
17. Remove the doughy mixture from the mixer and knead it around 10 times on countertop until it binds together
18. You will barely need to knead this , as it is not leavened
19. Chill dough for 20 minutes in refrigerator
20. Spread the dough into six 9" ungreased circular pans with palms until spread evenly across the bottom
21. If you don not have 6 pans , you can repeat this process 6 times with 1 pan , it will just take longer
22. Bake at 350f for 20 minutes
23. Pop the layers out of the pans and cool on cooling racks
24. When all 6 layers are complete , assemble layers and prune filling by starting with a layer for the bottom
25. Spread on 1 / 5th of your filling onto the base layer , then add another layer cake , add another 1 / 5th - etc
26. Repeat until your vineterta is complete
27. Prepare your icing by mixing the following with a beater in a mixing bowl: 3 tbsp softened butter , 3 / 4 cup powdered icing sugar , 2 tspn light cream , 1 / 4 cup ground almonds , 1 / 8 tspn almond extract
28. Spread the icing on top of the vineterta
29. Decorate with icing with the sliced almonds
30. Chill everything and let it set
31. This torte may be kept in the fridge for extended length of time and is better for having been aged in the fridge for at least a couple of weeks to a month
32. When serving slice into small rectangular pieces and serve cold

title: cava sorbet  spanish
steps:
1. Allow the tub of sorbet to soften
2. In a large bowl , beat the sorbet , lemon juice and cava until creamy
3. Either serve straight away as a drink , or pour into dessert bowls and freeze

title: crock pot sweet potato   black bean stew
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a slow cooker
2. Cover and cook on low for 5 to 6 hours or until vegetables are tender
3. Add more salt if necessary and serve

title: mashed potatoes with sage and white cheddar cheese
steps:
1. Butter 8- to 10-cup baking dish
2. Cook potatoes in large pot of boiling salted water until tender , about 12 minutes
3. Meanwhile , melt butter in medium saucepan over medium-high heat
4. Add 2 tablespoons sage
5. Stir until butter begins to brown , about 3 minutes
6. Add cream and milk
7. Bring to simmer
8. Drain potatoes
9. Return to pot
10. Stir over medium heat until excess moisture evaporates
11. Add cream mixture
12. Mash potatoes
13. Stir in 1 3 / 4 cups cheese
14. Season potatoes with salt and pepper
15. Transfer to prepared dish
16. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 cup cheese and 1 teaspoon sage
17. Preheat oven to 375f bake potatoes uncovered until heated through and golden brown , about 45 minutes

title: chocolate brownie torte
steps:
1. Prepare brownies according to box , however pour the mix into two round 8 by 8 cake pans
2. Make sure you grease the pans , and bake according to box
3. The mix isn't supposed to fill the pans completely , just about halfway
4. After taking out the brownies , and letting them cool completely , you can start the whipped filling
5. Begin by setting a large bowl and the beaters into your freezer for a couple of minutes
6. Pour heavy cream into the chilled bowl and beat on high untill it begins to thicken
7. Add the sugar , the vanilla , and the peppermint extract if desired
8. Beat the mixture untll , light and fluffy , and resembles whipped cream
9. Remove one brownie from pan , and set on a platter
10. Thickly cover it with whipped filling , then but the other brownie on top , cover that one too
11. Decorate top with shavened chocolate or mint leaves
12. Enjoy !

title: smoked turkey pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook the pasta according to package directions and drain
2. Rinse under cold water and drain again
3. In a large bowl , stir together the pasta turkey , celery , grapes and onions
4. In a small bowl , stir together the other ingredients
5. Toss the pasta with the dressing
6. Add salt and pepper , if desired
7. Serve chilled

title: baked potatoes with cheddar sour cream
steps:
1. In a small bowl , stir together sour cream and cheese
2. Season with salt and pepper
3. Set aside
4. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
5. On a large rimmed baking sheet , rub potatoes with oil
6. Bake on upper rack until tender , about 65 minutes
7. To serve , cut a deep cross in each potato
8. Push ends together to open
9. Season with salt and pepper
10. Top with sour-cream mixture , and if desired , scallions

title: mango coconut muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Line muffin tins with cupcake liners or butter
3. In a large bowl mix together the flour , baking soda and salt
4. In a medium bowl beat together the butter and sugar
5. Beat in egg , buttermilk and vanilla
6. Gently stir in mango , coconut , and lime zest
7. Pour over dry mixture , stirring until dry ingredients are just moistened
8. Do not over mix
9. Spoon into prepared muffin tin , each cup 3 / 4 full
10. Bake for 30 minutes
11. Brush tops with honey , remove from muffin tin and cool on wire rack

title: cinnamon rhubarb muffins
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine flour , 1 / 2 cup sugar , baking powder , 1 teaspoon cinnamon and salt
2. Combine egg , buttermilk and butter
3. Stir into dry ingredients just until moistened
4. Spoon 1 tablespoon of batter into nine greased or paper lined muffin cups
5. Combine rhubarb and preserves
6. Place 1 tablespoon in the center of each cup
7. Top with remaining batter
8. Combine remaining sugar and cinnamon
9. Sprinkle over batter
10. Bake at 400 f for 20 minutes or until top of muffin springs back when lightly touched in centre

title: kickin  blue cheese prime rib sauce
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients at least an hour before serving for best flavor
2. Enjoy

title: calves  liver in fresh orange juice
steps:
1. Working over a large plate or bowl to catch the juice , remove the peel and pith from 2 of the oranges with a sharp knife , cutting down to the pulp in one operation
2. Cut out each section from between the membrane and set aside
3. Reserve the juice and add it to the juice of the third orange
4. Strain and set aside heat a large cast iron frying pan , dry , over a medium low heat for a few moments add 3 oz butter and as soon as it starts to foam add the slices of liver , reduce the heat to minimum and cook very gently for no more than 2 minutes on each side , do not overcook , it must remain soft with no outer crust , and pink inside
5. Liver continues cooking by its own heat when removed from the pan
6. Arrange on a heated serving dish and keep hot covered with a plate
7. Increase the heat to medium , deglaze the pan with the orange juice , incorporating the meat residue by scraping it up with a fork , season with salt and allspice , allow to bubble , then add the orange sections
8. Remove the sections with a fork and place them around the meat
9. Remove the pan from the heat , whisk in the remaining 1 oz of butter , cut into small pieces and pour over the liver
10. Serve right away with small new potatoes , parselied and buttered or with garlic mashed potatoes and green peas

title: graham chocolate nut chewies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Line a greased 10 x 15 cookie sheet evenly with graham crackers
3. Combine brown sugar and butter and bring to a boil in microwave or on stovetop
4. Pour mixture over crackers and sprinkle with nuts and chips
5. Bake for 10 minutes
6. Cool in refrigerator
7. Cut or separate into bars

title: super easy chicken and noodles
steps:
1. Combine soup , milk , parmesan cheese , and pepper in large pot
2. Add noodles and chicken and heat through

title: healthy marinara sauce
steps:
1. Puree tomatoes and tomato paste in a blender or food processor
2. In a medium saucepan , heat oil briefly , and add garlic
3. Saute 15 seconds , being careful not to let it brown
4. Add pureed tomatoes , oregano , salt , pepper , and wine
5. Bring sauce to a boil , reduce heat , and simmer for 20 minutes
6. Remove from heat and stir in parsley
7. Makes 13 servings

title: country fried minute steaks
steps:
1. Do not defrost the steaks , they must be frozen when cooked , otherwise they become a bit tough
2. Melt the shortening
3. Lower heat to medium or medium high
4. Dip frozen steaks in the italian dressing , next into the crumbs until meat is completely covered
5. Pan fry meat in hot shortening over medium-high heat , long enough to brown both sides , no more than 2 minutes per side , and if the steak is very thin , that would be too long !

title: spinach pasta salad   taste of home
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the first eight ingredients
2. In a small bowl , whisk together dressing ingredients
3. Pour dressing over salad and serve immediately

title: chocolate eclairs
steps:
1. Pastry cream : pour milk into saucepan , add scraped vanilla bean including pod
2. Sift cornstarch , flour and sugar into a bowl
3. Whisk egg yolks in another bowl
4. Add dry ingredients to egg yolk and whisk until smooth
5. Take yolk mixture , milk and butter to stove
6. Heat milk until just simmering , stir about 1 / 2 cup of milk into yolk mixture , pour yolk mixture into pan with milk and heat on med low until it comes to a boil
7. Stir constantly with wooden spoon
8. Let boil , stirring , for 1 minute
9. Turn off heat and stir in butter until completely melted and incorporated
10. Pour entire contents of pan thru a strainer into a shallow stainless bowl
11. Cover with plastic wrap , pressing directly on to cream
12. Chill until cold and firm
13. Pate a choux: preheat oven to 375
14. Place water , butter , sugar and salt in heavy saucepan and bring to boil
15. Add flour all at once and stir until mixture comes away from sides and forms a ball
16. Remove from heat
17. Put mixture in mixer with a paddle and mix on low to cool to warm , not hot
18. Add eggs one at a time , beating well to incorporate each before adding the next
19. After last egg is added , beat until smooth
20. With a piping bag and round
21. You can make as big or as long as you want
22. They will about double in size when cooked
23. Bake at 375 until they become , brown , light and hollow
24. Cool
25. Dark chocolate ganache: bring cream to a simmer
26. Pour over chopped chocolate , let sit for 2 minutes , stir until melted and smooth
27. Assembly: take finished pate a choux and punch a hole in one end with something like a chop stick
28. Put pastry cream into a piping bag with a narrow round
29. When ganache has cooled enough to leave tracks in itself when drizzled back into the bowl it is ready to use
30. Dip filled pate a choux into ganache to coat

title: tsr version of tgi friday s fried mac and cheese by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Place flour in a small sauce pan over medium low heat
2. Whisk in milk till smooth , then add cheeses , olive oil and salt , stirring until cheese starts to melt
3. Reduce heat to low , simmer 30 minutes
4. Using whisk , stir sauce every few minutes to make sure the sauce becomes thick and smooth
5. Now place the 3 / 4 cup uncooked macaroni in a pot of boiling water
6. Boil for 10 minutes , or till tender
7. Drain
8. You should have about 1 3 / 4 cups cooked macaroni
9. When sauce is done cooking , reserve 2 tbs of the sauce for later
10. Pour pasta into a medium bowl and pour in remaining cheese sauce
11. Pour the mixture into an 8x8-inch pan that has been greased with oil
12. Cover and chill in fridge
13. When the macaroni and cheese is cold , slice into 16 squares
14. Put each square on a piece of wax paper , place in covered container , and freeze 2 hours
15. When the mac and cheese has frozen solid , mix milk and egg in a bowl
16. In another bowl place flour
17. In a third bowl , mix breadcrumbs and 3 / 4 teaspoons salt
18. Heat the oil to 350f
19. Bread the mac and cheese one piece at a time , coating a piece with flour , then placing it in the egg and milk mixture , then coating it with breadcrumbs
20. Place each piece back into the egg and milk , then in the breadcrumbs again
21. Repeat this process with all of the pieces , then place on a large plate
22. Let them sit about 15 minutes to defrost
23. Fry 4 to 6 at a time in hot oil for 3 minutes or until golden brown
24. Drain on paper towels a few minutes , then place on a serving platter
25. Heat the remaining 2 tbs of cheese sauce for about 15 seconds in the microwave
26. Drizzle the hot sauce over the mac and cheese squares
27. Sprinkle parsley over the top and serve
28. Enjoy !
