title: good morning breakfast pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Place ingredients on boboli shell in this order: 1 c cheese
3. Meat
4. Potatoes
5. Eggs
6. Salt and pepper
7. Remaining cup of cheese
8. Bake for 15 minutes
9. Let stand5 minutes and then cut in slices and serve with garnish of salsa and sour cream

title: tropical fruit salsa
steps:
1. Prepare all the fruit and combine in a bowl except the avocado
2. In a separate bowl , toss avocado with lime juice and then add it to the rest of the fruit
3. Refrigerate until ready to serve so flavors meld

title: mjuk kaka danish cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Sift flour , baking soda and cardamon together
3. Cream butter and sugar until fluffy
4. Add eggs , beat well
5. Add flour mixture and sour cream alternately and beat well
6. Pour into well greased bundt pan
7. Bake one hour
8. Cool 5 minutes
9. Remove cake from pan and cool on wire rack
10. Dust cake lightly with powdered sugar

title: mashed potatoes with roasted garlic and shallots
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Rub shallots and whole garlic heads with oil
3. Place on baking sheet
4. Bake 30 minutes
5. Remove shallots and continue to roast garlic until very soft , 20-25 minutes longer
6. Let cool
7. Squeeze garlic and shallots from skins and mince
8. Meanwhile , boil potatoes in large pot of lightly salted water until tender , 15-20 minutes
9. Drain potatoes well and return to pot
10. Add shallots and garlic , sour cream , butter , and salt and pepper to taste and mash with potato masher
11. Transfer to serving dish and serve hot

title: out of africa salsa
steps:
1. Preheat overn to 350
2. Cut bell peppers into large flat pieces , discarding the seeds and membranes
3. Broil skin side up , until the skin is black
4. Peel and cut into 1 / 2 inch squares
5. Make a small slit in the skin of the tomatoes , and plunge into boiling water
6. Dip into cold water then peel away the skin
7. Cut in half lengthways , seed , and cut into 1 / 2 inch dices
8. Cut the squash into 1 / 2 cubes
9. Coat in honey and put into a shallow roasting dish
10. Roast for 10-15 minutes until golden , then take out to cool
11. Peel the grapefruit , making sure to remove all the white pith as well
12. Cut into 1 / 2 inch cubes
13. Combine the bell pepper , tomatoes , squash , and grapefruit in a glass bolw and gnetly mix together
14. Chop the herbs and add just before serving
15. Whisk the oil and vinegar with salt and pepper , and drizzle the salsa on the top

title: smoked salmon  cream cheese and cilantro stuffed eggs
steps:
1. Halve eggs lengthwise
2. Combine egg yolks and all ingredients except cilantro in food processor and blend until smooth
3. Add chopped cilantro and blend just to combine
4. Fill egg whites with mixture using your favorite method
5. Pastry bag with
6. Garnish with cilantro leaves

title: lettuce wraps
steps:
1. Brown ground turkey & it in a smig sesame oil & a little hot chili oil
2. Added some light soy sauce , pepper , garlic , 1 / 2 pkg of stir fry seasoning & 2 tbs of teriayaki sauce
3. After it browned about halfway i added 1 bunch chopped green onions & about a half a bag of coleslaw mix and finished browning
4. While it continued to cook wash a head of iceberg lettuce & carefully peel off the leaves leaving whole
5. When turkey mixture is done & good & hot you just put some in the middle of the lettuce leaf wrap it up & enjoy
6. The hot mixture with the crisp cold lettuce is a wonderful combination

title: very easy baked tilapia fillets
steps:
1. Spray or coat 8x8 glass baking dish
2. Add fillets and season
3. Mix other ingredients and pour over fillets
4. Preheat oven to 400
5. Bake15-20 minutes

title: carrots provencale
steps:
1. Slice carrots in half diagonally
2. Heat olive oil in a pan , add carrots and sprinkle with salt
3. Cover pan and cook over a low heat for 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Add garlic , water , sugar and pepper
5. Cover pan and continue cooking for 20 minutes , stirring occasionally
6. Remove from heat and toss with parsley

title: green bean casserole by tyler florence
steps:
1. Bring large pot of boiling water to a boil
2. Add a big pincg of salt and all the green beans
3. Cook for about 5 minutes , the beans should still be crisp , they will be cooked more in the oven
4. Drain them , spread out on paper towel to dry , and set aside
5. Butter a baking dish large enough to hold the green beans with 1 tablespoons butter and set aside
6. Heat oven to 375 degrees
7. Tear bread into 2" pieces , put ina bowl and add t tablespoons chives , 1 tablespoons thyme , 1 tablespoons rosemary , 2 tablespoons parmesan , and 3 tablespoons olive oil
8. Stir well to coat and spread onto a baking sheet
9. Bake just until the bread starts to turn golden , about 10 minutes
10. Remove from the oven and set aside
11. Meanwhile , melt the remaining butter and olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat
12. Add the mushrooms and shallots , season with salt and pepper , and cook until the mushrooms have released their liquid , about 10 minutes
13. Pour in the heavy cream , add the remaining thym and chives , and cook for another 5 minutes
14. Add the green beans and stir well
15. Put the green beans mixture into the prepared baking dish , top with the croutons , and sprinkle on the remaining parmesan
16. Bake until everything is hot and bubbling , about 20-25 minutes

title: papaya fritters
steps:
1. Combine flour , milk , egg and sugar
2. Then stir in papaya
3. Drop by teaspoonfuls into hot oil
4. Cook 1 to 2 minutes on each side or until golden brown
5. Drain on paper towels
6. Fritters can also be cooked on a griddle , like a pancake
7. Serve hot as a snack or side dish

title: great aunt lola s  dang good pie
steps:
1. Melt butter and mix with remaining ingredients
2. Pour filling into unbaked pie shell
3. Bake in 350 oven for 1 hour or until set and browned

title: uncle bill s chicken barbecued on a rotissiere
steps:
1. Remove any parts from cavity and set aside for other use
2. Wash cavity and the whole chicken with cold water , then dry with paper towelling
3. Boil a large kettle of water to scalding hot
4. Place the chicken in a large pot and pour the scalding water over the entire bird including the cavities
5. The skin will shrink against the chicken meat and help keep the chicken moist
6. Dry the chicken with paper towels
7. Weigh the chicken to determine the weight for cooking
8. Sprinkle inside body cavity with dried dill weed , granulated garlic powder and coarse black pepper
9. Now stuff the cavity with the cut oranges , squeezing them slightly to release some orange juices
10. Insert the rosemary sprig
11. Tie the wings and legs with butcher string to keep them from flopping around when barbecueing
12. Place the chicken over the rotissiere spikes and attach the holder
13. Place the chicken in the centre of the holder
14. Rub or brush olive oil generously over the entire chicken and then sprinkle the five spice powder generoulsy over the chicken
15. Place the chicken in the rotissiere and close the door
16. Set your timer for 15 minutes per pound of chicken
17. Therefore , a 3 pound chicken will take 45 minutes to barbecue
18. It is not necessary to baste the chicken while it is barbeceuing
19. You may wish to test for doneness
20. Insert a meat thermometre into the breast of the chicken and it should read between 175 - 180f do not overcook
21. When the chicken is done , remove onto a plate and remove from the spit
22. Cover with aluminum foil and let rest for about 20 minutes before slicing
23. The skin of the chicken will be nice and brown and so tasty , that's if you wish to eat the skin
24. You can also use 2 large lemons instead of oranges to give the chicken a nice lemony taste
25. You can use a larger chicken , up to 5 pounds
26. I prefer to use the ron popiel barbecue rotissiere or the baby george foreman rotissiere
27. Serve with a curry / onion sauce
28. You may wish to rub the entire outside of the chicken with plenty of butter , instead of olive oil
29. Sprinkle with dried bread crumbs or panko crumbs and pat down into the butter
30. You will get a nicely browned and crispy skin

title: pumpkin figs pie
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Place the pie crust into a pie plate , and arrange pear slices in the bottom
3. Bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven
4. While the pears are baking , combine the pumpkin , soaked figs , and sugar in a blender or food processor
5. Process until smooth
6. Pour over the pears
7. Bake for an additional 15 minutes in the preheated oven , or until crust is golden and pears are tender
8. Serve warm or cold , with whipped topping if you wish

title: amish peanut brittle
steps:
1. Combine sugar , molasses , water and salt in a heavy saucepan
2. Cook slowly , stirring occasionally , to 280 degrees f
3. Stir in butter and immediately remove from heat
4. Stir in peanuts
5. Pour onto greased marble slab or stoneware platter and let cool
6. Break into pieces

title: chicken salad with raspberry vinaigrette
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients
2. Store in fridge
3. It's great made the night before you serve
4. Enjoy !

title: passover cottage cheese pancakes
steps:
1. Lightly oil griddle or frying pan and heat the pan
2. Mix all ingredients together in a bowl
3. Adjust thickness of batter by adding liquid
4. Pour batter into hot pan and cook the pancakes on each side
5. These are great with strawberries and yogurt
6. For non-passover use , you can substitute regular flour for the matzo meal

title: kittencal s creamy tomato pasta sauce  vegetarian or meat option
steps:
1. Heat oil in a medium pot over medium-high heat
2. Add in onion , bell pepper and chopped sun-dried tomatoes
3. Cook stirring for about 5-6 minutes or until softened
4. Add in garlic , chili flakes and basil
5. Cook stirring for 2 minutes ,
6. Add in tomato paste
7. Stir for 2 minutes
8. Add in crushed and plum tomatoes with juice
9. Bring to a simmer over medium heat stirring and breaking up the whole tomatoes with a fork
10. Reduce heat to low cover with a lid and simmer for 30 minutes
11. Uncover and continue to simmer over low heat for another 2 hours stirring frequently
12. Season with salt and black pepper about halfway through cooking
13. At this point and before the addition of the cream you may cool the sauce and refrigerate up to 3 days
14. At the end of cooking mix in the cream starting with 1 / 3 cup and adding in more until you reach your desired creaminess
15. Stir until heated through
16. Delicious !

20. Cook stirring until the meat is browned
21. Add in the tomato paste and continue with the recipe as stated from step# 5

title: yummy tex mex waffles
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , cook red pepper , green pepper , and green onion in hot oil over medium heat about 5 minutes or until crisp tender , stirring frequently
2. Set aside
3. In a large mixing bowl stir together flours , cornmeal , baking powder , and salt
4. In another bowl , beat eggs slightly with a whisk or fork
5. Beat in yogurt , milk , and melted margarine or butter
6. Add egg mixutre to flour mixture all at once
7. Stir just until combined but still slightly lumpy
8. Gently fold in pepper mixutre
9. Pour 1-1 1 / 4 cups of batter onto grids of a preheated , lightly greased waffle maker
10. Close lid quickly
11. Do not open during baking
12. Bake according to manufacturer's directions
13. When waffle is done , use a fork to lift it off the grid
14. Keep warm
15. Repeat with remaining batter , making sure you grease the griddle again
16. If the batter thickens on standing , you may need to thin it with a little milk
17. To serve , top with melted jalapeno jelly and shredded cheddar cheese , if desired
18. Enjoy !

title: a feel good meal
steps:
1. In a large fry pan heat oil
2. Add veggies and stir fry for a couple minutes till desired tenderness
3. Add herbs and stir to combine
4. Add pasta and 1 / 2 cup pasta water
5. Adjust taste with salt and pepper if desired
6. If not watching your fat go ahead and drizzle olive oil over and or top with grated cheese

title: mother in law s rice pudding  arroz con leche
steps:
1. In a large kettle , boil the rice , cinnamon , and cloves in about 3 liters of water for 40 minutes or until cooked and very soft
2. Remove from stove
3. Stir in all the remaining ingredients , mixing well
4. Taste to test for sweetness
5. This tastes sweeter warm than it will cold , so allow for that
6. Pour into individual dessert dishes or disposable cups
7. Eat while still warm , or refrigerate and eat cold
8. This dessert keeps well , refrigerated , for a few days , though some liquid will separate out on the top after a day or two
9. Just stir it back into the rice before eating
10. If you have picky or allergic eaters who don't do raisins and / or coconut but you don't want to omit these ingredients , just leave them out at first , when you are mixing the remaining ingredients into the cooked rice
11. Pour out portions for the special people , then mix in the "offending" ingredients with the remaining rice and serve the rest
12. If you are sure to mark which portions are "with" and which are "without , " you can make everyone happy
13. :-)

title: cinnamon apple chex mix
steps:
1. In large microwavable bowl , mix cereal and almonds
2. In 2-cup microwavable measuring cup , microwave butter , brown sugar , corn syrup and cinnamon uncovered on high about 2 minutes , stirring after 1 minute , until mixture is boiling
3. Stir
4. Pour over cereal mixture , stirring until evenly coated
5. Microwave uncovered on high 3 minutes , stirring and scraping bowl after every minute
6. Stir in apples
7. Microwave uncovered on high about 2 minutes or until apples just begin to brown on edges
8. Spread on waxed paper or foil to cool , about 5 minutes
9. Place in serving bowl
10. Stir in raisins
11. Store in airtight container

title: kielbasa bean slow cooker soup
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients , in a 5-6quart slow cooker
2. Cover and cook on low-heat setting at least 6 hours or until beans are tender

title: the nagroni
steps:
1. Fill a highball glass with ice cubes
2. Add equal parts of gin , sweet vermouth and campari
3. Garnish the glass with an orange slice
4. Enjoy !

title: man made meat sauce
steps:
1. In a large pot heat olive oil
2. Add onions and simmer on medium heat
3. Stir in garlic
4. Add red wine and saute
5. In a seperate frying pan cook ground beef until no longer pink
6. Drain
7. Add ground beef to pot
8. Add rest of ingredients , bring to a boil and then reduce heat to low and simmer for 2 hours

title: ground lamb and lentil chili
steps:
1. In a medium pot , heat oil over medium heat
2. Add garlic and onions and saute until onions are transparent , 2 to 3 minutes
3. Add chile powder , paprika , chile flakes , cayenne , cumin and coriander
4. Saute , stirring constantly , about 2 minutes more
5. Add lamb and stir and mash constantly with a wooden spoon to break it up into very fine particles , until evenly browned , 5 to 7 minutes
6. Stir in lentils , broth , tomatoes , oregano , rosemary , salt , sugar , and pepper
7. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat to low and simmer , stirring occasionally , until lentils are tender and chili is thick , about 30 minutes , adding some water to pot if lentils absorb all liquid before chili is done
8. Garnish with cilantro before serving

title: danielle s shepperd s pie
steps:
1. Brown ground beef , onion , and garlic
2. Reduce heat and add seasoning
3. Drain fat and crumble beef into a casserole or baking dish and pat down firmly
4. Set aside
5. Spoon cooked , drained corn in a thin , even layer on top of beef
6. Set aside
7. Meanwhile , boil potatoes
8. When potatoes are done drain water , add butter , sour cream , cream cheese and salt and pepper
9. Mash together , add milk if necessary
10. Carefully dollop spoonfuls of the mashed potatoes evenly over evenly over the beef and smooth down with a buttered spoon
11. Place in preheated 350 degree oven and bake for about 40 minutes or until mashed potatoes are light golden brown
12. Sometimes i add a little bit of shredded cheese on top about 5 minutes before it comes out of the oven to give it a different taste

title: crispy herb coated pork chops
steps:
1. In a shallow bowl , melt butter
2. In a large resealable plastic bag , combine the potato flakes , cheese , and garlic powder
3. Dip chops , one at a time , in butter , then place in bag
4. Seal and shake to coat
5. In a large skillet , cook chops in oil over medium heat for 7-8 minutes on each side

title: grilled asparagus and quinoa salad with goat cheese and black ol
steps:
1. Heat grill
2. Brush asparagus with olive oil and season with salt and pepper , to taste
3. Grill on both sides until just cooked through , about 2 minutes on each side
4. Remove from grill and cut in half
5. Bring 8 cups of salted water to a boil
6. Add quinoa and cook until soft
7. Drain and rinse with cold water and drain again
8. Place the quinoa in a medium bowl and add red wine vinegar , olive oil , parsley and 1 / 4 cup of olive vinaigrette
9. Stir to combine
10. Place on plate and top with goat cheese , asparagus , whole nicoise olives , sliced tomato and parsley sprigs

title: herby garlic parmesan baked chicken wings
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 200c
2. Split the chicken wings at the knuckle
3. Cut off the
4. Mix the dried herbs , cumin and salt in a bowl
5. Put the wings into the bowl and coat well in the mixture
6. Arrange on a baking tray and bake in the oven for 20-25 minutes , until cooked through
7. Meanwhile , heat the butter and garlic in a bowl over a pan of gently simmering water , until the butter has melted
8. Once the wings have cooked , dunk them in the butter and garlic mixture then sprinkle with parmesan
9. Serve immediately

title: rich chocolate baked custard
steps:
1. Lightly grease a 1 quart baking dish or 4 ramekins
2. Preaheat oven to 325 degrees f
3. Fill a 9x13 pan with 1 inch hot water and put it in the oven
4. Beat the eggs just enough to blend
5. Stir in the sugar , cocoa , and salt
6. Slowly add the hot milk , stirring constantly
7. Stir in the vanilla
8. Pour into the baking dish or ramekins and place in the pan with hot water
9. Bake 55-60 minutes until a knife comes out clean
10. It will firm up as it cools

title: miracle whip  homemade
steps:
1. With mixer blend egg yolks , 1 t

3. , 2 t
4. Sugar , and 2 t

6. Very slowly add 1 cup oil , a few drops at a time , and mix thoroughly

8. When all oil has been added , add 4 t
9. Vinegar

11. Add this hot mixture to the mayonnaise and blend well

title: salmon mousse
steps:
1. Sprinkle gelatine over water in a small saucepan
2. Soak 2 minutes
3. Add salt , sugar , mustard and vinegar
4. Stir constanly over low heat until gelatine in dissolved
5. Remove from heat and chill till the consistency of egg white , don't over chill !
6. Add to salmon , capers and celery , mix well
7. Fold in the whipped cream
8. Turn into wetted mould , or individual moulds , and chill till set
9. Unmould and serve with salad greens and sour cream dressing
10. Mix all dressing ingredients together and chill

title: kittencal s perfect cooked white rice  soft  medium or firm
steps:
1. Place the uncooked rice in a fine strainer and rinse thoroughly under cold water
2. Drain very well
3. Place the rice into a 2-quart saucepan then spread out to cover the bottom
4. Pour the water over the rice , then sprinkle the salt over the top bring to a full boil uncovered on medium-high heat
5. When rice is at a full boil immediately reduce heat to medium-low and simmer uncovered for 20 minutes or until the water has evaporated and the rice looks dry
6. Turn off the heat and cover with a lid and let the rice stand on the element for 20 minutes
7. Fluff the rice with a fork before serving

title: fresh tomato basil vinaigrette
steps:
1. Place everything but oil in food processor
2. Pulse while adding oil slowly until well blended

title: herb batter bread
steps:
1. Put the milk , water and butter in a small saucepan over low heat to warm
2. Butter or margarine does not need to melt
3. In a large bowl , combine 1 cup flour , the sugar , salt , basil , oregano , thyme and dry yeast
4. Stir dry ingredients to mix well
5. Add warm liquid ingredients and beat until well blended
6. Add flour , 1 / 2 to 1 cup at a time , and continue beating until well blended
7. Cover bowl with a towel and set in a warm place to rise for about 40 minutes , or until doubled
8. Grease a 9 x 3 x 5 inch loaf pan with butter or margarine
9. Stir batter down and beat for about one minute , then pour into the loaf pan
10. Let rise , uncovered , for about 30 minutes , or until doubled
11. Bake at 375 degrees for 40 to 50 minutes
12. When done , remove from pan , cool and slice to serve

title: chicken paste or chicken tea sandwich filling
steps:
1. In a large pot of water , place the chicken breasts
2. Add bay leaf , pepper corns and salt and even a stalk of celery and a carrot if handy
3. Bring to a boil and simer for about 45 minutes until chicken is cooked but not rubber
4. Drain , rinse and cool
5. If you are fortunate enough to have a splendid kitchen aid , use the meat grinder attachment
6. An old fashoind meat grinder works just as well and adds 'character' to your work
7. Lol break the cooled chicken into pieces and run through the meat grinder
8. Put the onion and celery through as well
9. Mix evenly
10. It should be very crumbley
11. Add enough mayonaise to bind and mix well , you want the paste to be moist but not wet
12. Add the rest of the ingredients to taste
13. Chill and enjoy on your choice of bread
14. Add a little more mayonaise and perhaps some cripsy bacon if you want to use it as spread for crackers
15. Enjoy !

title: creole oven bake chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven at 400 degrees
2. Spray the bottom of a large glass baking dish with butter flavor cooking spray
3. Add some creole seasoning to bottom of dish
4. Arrange chicken pieces in dish , add freshly ground black pepper to taste and sprinkle on top with more creole seasoning
5. Bake at 400 degrees for 30 minutes
6. Lower oven to 350 degrees and keep baking chicken for 40 minutes longer
7. Remove from oven and let sit on wire rack for 10 minutes before serving

title: day after the holiday turkey soup
steps:
1. In a heavy saucepan , heat olive oil over medium-high heat
2. Reduce heat and add finely diced onions , carrots , and celery
3. Cook until soft and golden brown , about 5 to 6 minutes
4. Add corn , turkey , salt and pepper and the chicken stock then bring to a boil
5. Let the soup simmer uncovered for 10 to 15 minutes
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Before serving squeeze in the juice of a lemon
8. Leftover rice may be substituted for the corn

title: teresa s olive chicken
steps:
1. Season chicken with salt and pepper
2. Heat oil and butter in skillet-brown chicken on both sides
3. Remove and set aside
4. Add onion and garlic to pan and cook to soften
5. Add peppers and mushrooms and cook for 2 minutes
6. Add tomatoes and season with salt and pepper
7. Transfer vegetables to an ovenproof casserole with lid
8. Put chicken on top of veggies
9. Add wine to pan that was used to cook chicken / vegetables and deglaze
10. Bring to boil and pour over chicken
11. Put lid on casserole and bake at 350 for 50 minutes
12. Add olives and cream to casserole
13. Mix in and cover-bake for an additional 10-20 minutes or until chicken is tender and cooked through
14. Adjust seasoning before serving with pasta-garnish with fresh parsley if desired

title: jazzbow cookies
steps:
1. Cream together butter and sugar
2. Mix in the other ingredients until a tender dough is formed
3. Coat the cookie mold with granulated sugar
4. Tap out the cookie and place on a cookie sheet
5. If dough is too soft , chill it for about 30 minutes then try to mold these again
6. Bake at 375 degrees f for about 15 minutes

title: california rollwich for kids
steps:
1. Avocado spread:
2. Scoop the flesh from the avocado and mash , mixing with a dash of lemon or lime juice
3. Mix in diced tomatoes and optional vegetables
4. Set aside
5. Rollwich:
6. Spread the tortilla or pita with mayonnaise , leaving at least 1 / 2 inch around the outside
7. Spread avocado spread over mayonnaise
8. Top spread with shredded lettuce
9. Carefully place turkey or ham slices on top of topping
10. Add cheese strips down the middle
11. Carefully roll the tortilla into a wrap
12. Cut into two pieces

title: easy cream of sweet potato soup
steps:
1. Vegetables should be finely cut
2. Combine chicken broth , sweet potatoes , carrots and onion in a large pan
3. Bring to boil
4. Reduce heat to low
5. Cover and simmer 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender
6. Add butter and garlic over medium heat
7. Stirring constantly , cook 8 minutes
8. Stir in orange juice , cream and salt and peppers
9. Return to low heat , cook 10 minutes or until heated through

title: braised cabbage  chou a l ardennaise
steps:
1. Quarter and core the cabbage , cook for 3 minutes , in boiling salted water
2. Drain , pressing out all water , shred
3. Peel , core and dice the apples
4. Heat the oil in a large dutch oven , stir in the apples and cabbage
5. Season and stir in wine and berries
6. Bring to a boil , cover and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes , turn occasionally to prevent sticking , adding more liquid if necessary
7. When the cabbage seems almost ready , check the liquid , if it seems watery , remove lid to evaporate excess
8. For red cabbage , mash the jelly into the vinegar , stir into the cabbage and cook for an extra few minutes
9. Check seasoning and serve hot

title: curried pumpkin and mushroom soup
steps:
1. Use a large saucepan to saut the mushrooms , onion and butter until onions are clear
2. Add flour and curry powder and blend , stirring for five minutes
3. Add stock , pumpkin , brown sugar and nutmeg , stirring until blended
4. Transfer to a blender and pure until smooth
5. Add milk or whipping cream
6. Reheat until hot
7. For vegetarian use the vegetable stock

title: cajun okra stew
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a large stew pot
2. Add chopped onions and garlic and saute for 2-3 minutes
3. Add chopped tomatoes , lima beans , blackeye peas and cajun seasoning
4. Bring to a boil , stir well
5. Reduce heat and simmer on low 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
6. If the stew gets too thick add water as needed
7. Add chopped okra , stir well
8. Simmer another 15 minutes
9. Serve over rice

title: meatball sub sandwich casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. In a bowl , combine onions , crumbs & cheese
3. Add beef and mix well
4. Shape beef into 1-inch balls
5. Place on rimmed cookie sheet
6. Bake for 15-20 minutes
7. Turn oven down to 350
8. Meanwhile , arrange bread cubes in an ungreased 13x9 pan
9. Combine cream cheese , mayo , seasonings , and s&p
10. Spread over bread
11. Sprinkle one cup mozzarella cheese over the cream-cheese mixture layer
12. Combine sauce , water & garlic
13. Add meatballs and gently mix
14. Pour this over the cheese layer
15. Sprinkle remaining mozzarella
16. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes
17. Options: use half cheddar and half mozzarella
18. Try some sliced black olives
19. Sprinkle some grated zucchini in for added nutritional value

title: crock pot chick  n peppers
steps:
1. Put the water in the bottom of crockpot
2. Lay down a layer of red peppers
3. Rub olive oil on the chicken breasts , sprinkle with garlic powder , rosemary and salt and pepper
4. Place the chicken on top of red peppers
5. Add another layer of peppers
6. Cook low for 6 hours
7. Your crockpot may vary in the length of time to cook

title: gebhardt s chili gravy
steps:
1. Over medium heat , saut the onion and garlic in the oil until the onion is softened , but not browned
2. Stir in the bacon drippings , chili powder , cumin , oregano
3. Then add the beef stock , a little at a time , stirring well
4. Simmer , uncovered , for 30 minutes until mixture is slightly reduced and thickened
5. Mix the masa harina with a few tablespoons of water or the gravy , itself , and stir back into the gravy
6. Simmer for 10 minutes more
7. Taste the gravy and add salt only if you think it necessary

title: georgia on my mind peach pecan crisp
steps:
1. Servings: 6 prepare fruit
2. Heat oven to 350 degrees
3. Spray a 2- to 3-quart baking dish with nonstick cooking spray
4. Set aside
5. In a large bowl , toss peaches and apples with apricot nectar , orange juice , vanilla , sugar , flour , nutmeg , ginger and cinnamon
6. Spoon into prepared baking dish
7. Set aside
8. Make a topping by combining pecans , oatmeal , flour and brown sugar
9. Slowly drizzle in butter , tossing mixture with a fork to make a mealy topping
10. Sprinkle mixture over fruit
11. Bake until juices of fruit start to bubble , around 30-40 minutes
12. Cool for about 15 minutes before serving

title: fat free flax salad dressing

2. Then add remaining ingredients
3. Enjoy !

5. Layer potato , onions and mushrooms on meat crust

8. Cover and cook in microwave , on medium , for 2-3 minutes
9. Let stand for 2-3 minutes before cutting

title: overnight pumpkin pecan waffles
steps:
1. Combine warm water and yeast in a large bowel
2. Let stand until slightly foamy , about 15 minutes
3. In a small saucepan , heat milk and butter over medium heat until butter melts
4. Remove from heat and stir in sugar , pumpkin pie spce , salt and pumpkin puree
5. Add pumpkin mixture to bowel with yeast , then whisk in the flour until combined
6. Cover and let stand overnight at room temperature
7. Preheat waffle iron
8. Whisk eggs into risen batter , then fold in pecans
9. Make waffles according to manufacturer's instructions
10. Serve with syrup

title: coconut red lentils with spinach  cashews   lime  vegan
steps:
1. In a large pot saute the onion in the olive oil over medium heat for about 5 minutes
2. While the onion cooks get the rest of the ingredients ready to go
3. Add in the curry powder , mustard seeds , turmeric and red lentils - cook for another 5 minutes
4. Watch the lentils don't stick by stirring frequently and / or adding more oil if necessary
5. Mix in the coconut milk , salt , lime juice and water
6. Bring to a boil then reduce heat to medium low , cover the pot and let simmer for about 20-25 minutes
7. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking
8. Unlikely , but if you find the lentils have absorbed all of the liquid and are still not cooked , add a bit more water
9. Once the lentils are cooked they will break down quite a bit and you'll have a reasonably thick dahl like consistency
10. Stir in the cashews and spinach , along with cilantro if using
11. Give those ingredients about 3 or 4 minutes to warm through and then you're ready to serve
12. Garnish with additional cilantro , lime wedges and / or cashews

title: orzo   pignoli   pasta   pine nuts
steps:
1. Bring a large kettle of water to a boil and cook orzo until al dente
2. 3 minutes
3. Drain in a colander
4. Meanwhile , in a small , non-stick skillet , heat oil and stir in pine nuts
5. Cook until golden , about 5 minutes
6. Add basil
7. Toss with orzo , season with salt and pepper to taste
8. Heat through and serve

title: chocolate taffy
steps:
1. Line a heavy baking sheet , not a cookie sheet it should have sides , with a heat proof silicone mat or grease generously with butter
2. Lay the sheet on a heatproof surface
3. In a medium bowl , whisk together the cocoa powder and water until the mixture thickens , then pour through a mesh strainer into a heavy 6 quart non stick pot
4. Add the sugar , corn syrup , butter , vinegar , baking soda , and salt and whisk to combine
5. The mixture should not fill more than half the pot as it will boil and rise during cooking
6. Boil over moderate heat , stirring occasionally during the first 5 to 10 minutes , then do not stir
7. Continue cooking until an instant read thermometer registers 250 degrees , stir in 2 tablespoons of butter until combined , and carefully pour into prepared pan without scraping the pot
8. Using a lightly buttered metal pastry scraper or wooden spoon , begin to fold the cooler edges of taffy onto the center
9. Taffy will be very soft initially and seem like a thick liquid
10. Avoid scraping the bottom of the pan
11. When taffy is still hot but cool enough to handle , butter your gloved palms generously and gather taffy mass in your hands
12. Begin to "pull" taffy in an even thickness by stretching the mass about 1 foot apart in both hands
13. Bring both ends of taffy back to each other to form a loop and pull , stretching your arms slightly
14. Twist the end if you like and bring it back to the top
15. Taffy may feel very soft at first , but it will begin to get harder to pull
16. Continue pulling until the taffy is lighter in color and has a satin-matte sheen but remains soft and pliable , about 10 minutes
17. When it cools to room temperature , transfer to a clean cutting board and divide into quarters using a heavy knife
18. Dust lightly with confectioners sugar , roll or stretch the taffy into a log about 3 / 4 inch wide , and cut into 3 / 4 inch long pieces
19. If knife becomes sticky grease knife with butter
20. Wrap each piece of taffy in waxed paper and store in air tight container
21. Taffy will stay fresh for 1 week in a container

title: caramel shortcake or millionaire s shortbread
steps:
1. Base :
2. Cream butter and sugar
3. Add the flour and stir to make a mixture that is soft and will go together when squashed
4. Lightly knead and then roll out or place into a deep swiss roll tin
5. Press into place with the palm of your hand until even
6. Prick all over with a fork
7. Bake in the oven for 25 minutes gas 4
8. Cool in the tin
9. Filling :
10. Place the butter , sugar , syrup , and condensed milk into a pan and bring slowly to a boil
11. Stir until the sugar is dissolved
12. Once boiling keep on a slow boil stirring all the time for about 5 to 7 minutes
13. Caramel should be thick and golden
14. Allow to cool
15. When cool pour over the biscuit mixture and leave to set
16. Topping :
17. Melt the chocolate and butter over a pan of simmering water
18. Spread over top of the caramel layer
19. Cut into squares or fingers once set
20. Do not be put off by the stages
21. Very easy and worth the wait
22. It looks like you have been in the kitchen and slaving over the cooker for hours
23. You will get compliments with this one

title: chili con carne texas style   with venison
steps:
1. Cube the venison steak
2. Dice the onions and green peppers
3. Mince the garlic
4. Shred the monterey jack cheese
5. In a large pot , over medium high heat , in the vegetable oil , cook the venison cubes , stirring frequently until browned on all sides , removing venison to a bowl as it browns
6. Set aside
7. Reserve 1 / 2 cup diced onions for sprinkling over chili later
8. In the pan drippings in the large pot , over medium heat , cook the green peppers , garlic , crushed red pepper , and remaining onions until the vegetables are tender , stirring occasionally , and adding more oil if necessary
9. Return the meat to the pot
10. Add tomatoes with their liquid and the remaining ingredients except the shredded cheese
11. Over high heat , heat to boiling
12. Reduce the heat to low , cover the pot and simmer for 1 hour or until the venison is fork tender , stirring occasionally
13. Serve the chili in bowls and pass the shredded cheese and remaining onions to sprinkle
14. I always like to make some garlic bread and a salad to go with this
15. It's really good - especially when the weather is cold

title: cheesy roasted corn and chicken with green chilies soup
steps:
1. 1 in medium pot , bring seasoned chicken stock and chicken to a boil -- turn down and let simmer covered for about 15 minute remove from heat
2. 2 in crock-pot
3. Add onions , peppers , tomatoes , spices , and dry roasted corn
4. Add cubed chicken and broth
5. Cook on high setting for about 3 1 / 2 - 5 hours until corn is tender
6. 3 combine margarine and flour to make a roux
7. Stir into soup
8. Slowly add milk and sour cream , stirring to incorporate
9. Cook on high until soup thickens slightly
10. Reduce heat and let cook for a about another half hour on low
11. 4 stir in cheese
12. 6 serve with chopped cilantro and tortilla chips , tabasco , rice etc
13. Texture of the soup should be velvety
14. Not thick

title: sugar free pumpkin pie
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 425 degrees
2. Combine ingredients
3. Pour into pie crust
4. Bake 15 minute at 425
5. Reduce heat to 350 degrees and bake 45 minutes
6. Cool and garnish with whipped cream

title: makoto style japanese salad dressing
steps:
1. Combine ingredients in a blender and process until fairly smooth
2. Store in the refrigerator

title: spiced beef empanadas with lime sour cream
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 f
2. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat
3. Add the onion and cook , stirring occasionally , until soft , 5 to 6 minutes
4. Add the beef and cook , breaking it up with a spoon , until no longer pink , 3 to 4 minutes
5. Stir in the raisins , ketchup , cinnamon , teaspoon salt , and teaspoon pepper
6. Using a 2-inch round cookie cutter , cut out circles from the piecrusts
7. Divide the beef mixture among the circles , brush the edges with water , fold in half , and press with a fork to seal
8. Transfer to a baking sheet and brush with the egg
9. Bake until golden , 20 to 25 minutes
10. Put the sour cream in a small bowl and sprinkle with the lime zest
11. Serve with the empanadas

title: pesto tuna
steps:
1. Make sure the tuna is as well drained as possible , i squeeze mine in a sieve
2. Mix with pesto and pepper to taste
3. If you want a more"spreadable" consistency , mix in the mayonnaise
4. A little lemon juice adds some zing if you like a more tangy flavour
5. Refrigerate for at least 20minutes to allow flavours to meld
6. Serve either as a sandwich or on crackers

title: southwest spinach dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Heat oil in large skillet
3. Add onions and jalapenos and saute until tender , about 5 minutes
4. Add chopped baby spinach and continue to cook until wilted
5. Add 2 / 3 of tomatoes and cook 3 minutes more
6. Remove skillet from heat
7. Stir in monterey jack cheese , cream cheese , half and half , olives , vinegar , salt and pepper
8. Spoon into 1 1 / 2 quart baking dish
9. Bake 35 minutes or until hot and bubbly
10. Top with sharp cheddar cheese
11. Sprinkle with remaining chopped tomato
12. Serve immediately with tortilla chips

title: sweet potato and corn fritters
steps:
1. In a bowl mix together the corn , ginger , herbs , flour , milk and egg yolk
2. In a clean bowl beat the egg white until stiff
3. Fold the egg white and potato into the mixture
4. Heat the butter or oil in a non-stick frying pan and cook large spoonfuls over a low to moderate heat for about 3 minutes each side
5. Serve with some grilled bacon
6. Delicious

title: snickers bar salad
steps:
1. Mix cool whip with pudding
2. Fold in apples and snicker bars
3. Chill about 1 hour

title: southwestern slow cooker chicken and potato soup
steps:
1. Mix chicken , sweet potatoes , onion , tomatoes , broth , oregano , and cumin in a 4-quart or larger slow cooker
2. Cover and cook on low heat setting for at least 6 hours
3. Stir in corn
4. Cover and cook on high setting , about 30 minutes , serve

title: berry berry frozen yogurt  healthy  for ice cream machine
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , mix the milk and sugar until the sugar is dissolved
2. Stir in the yogurt , berry puree and extract
3. Freeze according to manufacturers instructions
4. I put it in a plastic bowl
5. I had to defrost it in the microwave for a little while before i could dig into it
6. Anyone know a better container i could put it in ? i was thinking an empty ice cream container that i'd already used all the ice cream from ?

title: recycled salad
steps:
1. Mix everything together and serve !
2. Or , chill in the frig for 30 minutes or more to let the flavors blend

title: fish fromage
steps:
1. Pour the french dressing into a medium bowl
2. Dip each fillet into dressing , then place in a shallow baking pan
3. Top the fillets with tomato and cheese slices , then any dressing remaining in bowl
4. Sprinkle with oregano and parmesan cheese
5. Bake in a preheated 450 oven for 20 minutes or until top is golden and fish flakes easily

title: thimbles
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Lightly grease baking sheets
3. In a large bowl , cream the shortening and brown sugar
4. Beat in the egg yolks and vanilla extract
5. Gradually blend in the flour
6. In a small bowl , beat the egg whites until stiff but not dry
7. Pinch off small pieces of dough and roll into balls
8. Roll the balls in the beaten egg white , then in the ground almonds , and placed 1 inch apart on the prepared baking sheets
9. With your fingers , press and indentation into the center of each ball
10. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes , until lightly browned in color
11. Fill each cookie with a dab of preserves / jelly the transfer to wire rack to cool

title: noodle pudding with farmer cheese and lingonberries
steps:
1. Cook and drain noodles according to package directions
2. Set noodles aside
3. Heat the oven to 350 degrees f , and butter an 8 inch square baking dish
4. In a large bowl , whisk the eggs until frothy
5. Whisk in the cheese , brown sugar , sour cream , milk , salt , vanilla , cinnamon , nutmeg , and apple juice concentrate
6. Then stir in the noodles , lingonberry preserves , and butter pieces
7. Pour mixture into prepared pan , sprinkle with the cinnamon sugar mixture , and bake until pudding is set and butter is bubbling around the edges , about 30-40 minutes
8. Let cool 10 minutes before serving
9. Serve warm or at room temperature , cut into squares and topped with a dollop of sour cream if desired

title: tilapia with garlic lime butter
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat
2. Add tilapia fillets to the pan
3. Sprinkle the fish with garlic powder
4. Pour lime juice over fish
5. Saute the tilapia until the fillets are opaque and easily flake with a fork
6. Serve while hot
7. I like to serve this with a side of rice pilaf and california blend veggies

title: manicotti cum laude
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In a large skillet , over medium heat , brown sausage , drain fat
3. Add onion and garlic , cooking till onion is slightly transparent
4. Stir in tomatoes , tomato paste , basil , sugar , salt and pepper
5. Bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat and simmer , uncovered , 15 minutes
7. In a medium bowl , comine cheeses and egg
8. Mix well
9. Store , covered , in refrigerator while manicotti noodles are cooking
10. Cook manicotti as directed on package
11. Drain
12. Stuff manicotti shells with cheese mixture
13. Spread half of the tomato based sauce on bottom of a greased 13 x 9" baking dish
14. Place stuffed manicotti over sauce
15. Spoon remaining sauce over manicotti
16. Cover& bake 35 minutes or until hot and bubbly
17. Remove from oven , top with remaining 1 cup mozarella cheese
18. Bake 5 minutes longer

title: fettuccine with asparagus pesto
steps:
1. Steam or boil asparagus until just barely tender to bite , 4 to 5 minutes , drain
2. Cook pasta according to directions on package
3. Place the cooked pasta and the
4. Place the asparagus stems in a food processor along with the hot water , lemon juice , olive oil , garlic , and basil
5. Whirl until smooth
6. Pour asparagus pure over pasta , add salt , pepper , and parmesan cheese
7. Mix well to combine

title: speedy veggie stew
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients of choice in a small pot
2. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes or longer
3. Adjust flavors and serve

title: biram ruz   egyptian rice casserole
steps:
1. Heat milk and heavy cream to a light boil
2. Put rice in casserole dish , adding hot milk and cream
3. Stir in salt
4. Bake at 400f for 35 minutes
5. Just before done baking , cut butter in very small pats , spreading it on top of the rice
6. Allow to cook for an additional 20 minutes or until the rice has browned on the top
7. Serving suggestions:
8. Biram ruz is served with chicken or lamb
9. Chicken is served over the rice or mixed in with it

title: honey oatmeal bread   2 lb  loaf
steps:
1. Place ingredients in manufacturer's suggested order
2. Select basic bread cycle
3. Ta da !

title: sopa de cenoura   carrot soup   portugal
steps:
1. Heat 2 tbsp of the oil in a 4-quart stock pot over medium-high heat
2. Add and saut the onion until a light golden color , then stir in the tomato and garlic
3. Reduce the heat to medium-low , cover and continue cooking until the tomato is soft and partially dissolved , about 15 minutes
4. Add in the carrots , sweet potato , and turnip , pour in the water , cover , and bring to a boil over medium-high heat
5. Reduce the heat and simmer until the vegetables are very tender , about 30 to 40 minutes
6. Remove the pot from the heat and pure the soup
7. Stir in the remaining oil and season with salt and pepper
8. Bring the soup back to a boil , reduce the heat , and simmer for 2 more minutes , then serve

title: luby s cafeteria s chocolate icebox pie
steps:
1. In medium saucepan , combine 2 cups milk , sugar , cocoa , and butter
2. Bring to a boil over medium heat
3. In a medium mixing bowl , mix cornstarch and water until cornstarch is completely dissolved
4. Stir in remaining 1 / 2 cup milk
5. Whisk in egg yolks and vanilla until well blended
6. Gradually add cornstarch mixture to mixture in saucepan , stirring constantly with a whisk
7. Cook , stirring constantly , for about 2 minutes or until mixture is thickened and smooth
8. Add mashmallows and stir until marshmallows are melted and mixture is smooth
9. Pour into pie shell
10. Press plastic wrap diretly onto filling
11. Refrigerate at least 2 hours
12. Remove plastic wrap and top with whipped cream
13. Garnish with chocolate curls
14. ~

title: farmhouse vegetable soup
steps:
1. In a stockpot over medium heat , melt the butter
2. Add the onion and leeks , cover , and cook , stirring once or twice , for 5-7 minutes , or until vegetables are soft but not browned
3. Add the parsnips , potatoes , carrots and recipe #476612 or broth , cover and cook for 25 to 30 minutes , or until the vegetables are tender
4. Remove from the heat and let cool for 10 minutes
5. Working in batches , transfer the soup to a food processor or blender and puree until smooth
6. Your immersion blender can also be used
7. Return soup to the pot , whisk in the half and half , and season with the parsley , salt and pepper
8. Simmer until heated through
9. Ladle the soup into swallow bowls and enjoy

title: taco seasoning  salt free
steps:
1. Place all spices in a zip top bag or jar with a tight fitting lid
2. Shake well
3. Use 1-2 t
4. Per pound of meat

title: spicy pan seared salmon
steps:
1. Drizzle olive oil into a medium skillet over medium-high heat
2. In a small bowl , combine spices
3. Season all sides of salmon filets
4. Add to skillet when oil is glistening hot
5. Cook for 5-7 minutes on each side or until a crispy , thin brown outside layer forms and fish flakes easily when fork-tested
6. Do not over-cook , or salmon will be tough

title: goan chicken curry
steps:
1. Mix together all the marinade ingredients to give you a loose , smooth paste
2. Add the chicken pieces and coat them in the paste
3. They are best left to marinate for around 30 minutes to 1 hour , but if you're in a hurry a few minutes will do
4. Heat the oil in a deep frying pan and add the mustard seeds
5. When they start to pop and jump about in the pan , add the onion and garlic
6. Cook until they're golden brown before adding the chicken and any extra paste from the marinade
7. Fry over a gentle heat for about 8 minutes before adding the coconut milk
8. Increase the heat slightly and bring to a simmer
9. Cook for a further 10-12 minutes until the sauce has thickened slightly before seasoning with salt if necessary and serving with rice or naan bread

title: ginger rhubarb crumble
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Put the rhubarb into a medium sized pot along with half the brown sugar , 1 tabespoon of each of the gingers and the orange juice and zest
3. Bring to a boil and turn down and simmer for a few minutes to soften the rhubarb
4. Spoon the cooked rhubarb into an ovenproof casserole dish
5. To make the crumble topping put the oats , the remaining brown sugar , the flour , and the rest of the ginger pieces in a bowl
6. Add the cold butter and blend the butter into the rest of the ingredients with your fingers to create crumbs
7. Sprinkle the crumb topping over the cooked rhubarb in the casserole
8. Bake at 350f for about 40 minutes , until the topping is golden brown
9. Cool sligthly before serving
10. Great with ice cream , whipped cream or custard !

title: carrot cake cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees
2. Whisk together the sugar , oil , and vanilla together in a large bowl
3. Whisk in the eggs , 1 at a time
4. In another bowl , sift together the flour , spices , baking soda , and salt
5. Add 1 / 2 of the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and stir gently
6. Add the grated carrots to the remaining flour , mix well , and add to the batter
7. Stir until just combined
8. Line muffin tins with paper liners
9. Scoop the batter into 24 muffin cups until each is 3 / 4 full
10. Bake at 400 degrees for 10 minutes then reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees and bake for about 25 minutes more , or until a toothpick comes out clean
11. Set aside to cool

title: beef rye snacks
steps:
1. Mix beef with shredded cheese , salt , pepper , and onion
2. Toast one side of bread slices
3. Turn and spread beef mixture over untoasted side of bread
4. With oven door ajar ,
5. Broil 3" from electric broiler unit until meat is done , about 4 to 5 minutes
6. Top each one with a triangle slice
7. Broil again just until cheese is melting
8. Serve hot

title: pumpkin apple pie
steps:
1. Prepare and roll pastry for single-crust pie , line a 9" pie plate with pastry
2. Trim
3. Crimp edge as desired
4. In a large bowl stir together eggs , pumpkin , and half-and-half
5. Stir in sugar , flour , vanilla , salt cinnamon , nutmeg , and allspice
6. Lay apple slices in pie pastry and pour pumpkin mixture into pastry-lined pie plate , to prevent over-browning , cover edge of pie with foil
7. Bake in 375 f oven for 25 minutes
8. Remove foil
9. Bake for 40 minutes more or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean and topping is golden and bubbly
10. Cool on a wire rack
11. Cover and refrigerate within 2 hours

title: 30 minute shepherd s pie
steps:
1. Boil potatoes in salted water until tender , about 12 minutes
2. Drain potatoes and pour them into a bowl
3. Combine sour cream , egg yolk and cream
4. Add the cream mixture into potatoes and mash until potatoes are almost smooth
5. While potatoes boil , preheat a large skillet over medium high heat
6. Add oil to hot pan with beef or lamb
7. Season meat with salt and pepper
8. Brown and crumble meat for 3 or 4 minutes
9. If you are using lamb and the pan is fatty , spoon away some of the drippings
10. Add chopped carrot and onion to the meat
11. Cook veggies with meat 5 minutes , stirring frequently
12. In a second small skillet over medium heat cook butter and flour together 2 minutes
13. Whisk in broth and worcestershire sauce
14. Thicken gravy 1 minute
15. Add gravy to meat and vegetables
16. Stir in peas
17. Preheat broiler to high
18. Fill a small rectangular casserole with meat and vegetable mixture
19. Spoon potatoes over meat evenly
20. Top potatoes with paprika and broil 6 to 8 inches from the heat until potatoes are evenly browned
21. Top casserole dish with chopped parsley and serve

title: fresh homemade kielbasa
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix all ingredients until well blended
2. Soak casings in 6 cups warm water
3. Using about one foot of casing for one pound of meat mixture , stuff the casings
4. Keep unused casings wet while working , if they start to dry out , they will tear
5. Use in your favorite kielbasa recipes
6. Kielbasa can be frozen for later use

title: warm cabbage salad by sam zien
steps:
1. Place cabbage in a large bowl with cheese on top
2. Cook mushrooms in about a tablespoon of olive oil until quite soft
3. Add bacon
4. Continue to cook both about 3 more minutes until bacon just begins to get a little crispy
5. Add dressing to pan , being careful as it will splatter , heat through
6. Pour mushroon-bacon dressing on the cabbage and mix well
7. Season with a little kosher salt and fresh ground black pepper

title: zucchini   onions with mozzarella
steps:
1. In a skillet , melt butter over medium heat
2. Add all ingredients , except cheese and tomato wedges
3. Continue cooking , stirring occasionally , until zucchini is crisp-tender
4. Add tomato wedges
5. Sprinkle with cheese
6. Cover and let stand 2 minutes , or until cheese is melted
7. Serve

title: salt   pepper dirty potato chips
steps:
1. Wash potatoes making sure skin is free of dirt
2. If you prefer "clean" chips , peel the potatoes
3. Mix together all spices in a small dish and set aside
4. Slice on a mandolin and drop into cold , salted water
5. You can try to slice by hand , but it's very difficult to get them thin enough
6. In deep iron skillet pour oil about 1 1 / 2 " deep and heat to 365f as oil is heating pour water off potatoes and gently pat dry
7. Drop slices 1 at a time into hot oil until a single layer is cooking
8. Let cook until golden brown
9. Remove into paper bag to soak up excess oil
10. When potatoes are all done , sprinkle spiced salt mix to taste over chips and shake bag to evenly coat
11. Add a little at a time , you can always add more , but it's darn difficult to pick off those grains of salt if there are to many

title: leg of lamb  crusted herbed with roasted garlic sauce
steps:
1. In a roasting pan with very hot extra-virgin olive oil , sear the lamb , fat side down first , until golden
2. Then turn lamb over and sear the other side
3. Remove from heat and allow to rest for 5 minutes
4. Brush the mustard onto both sides of the seared lamb
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Mix all of the herbs together
7. Dredge both sides of the lamb in the herbs , pressing lightly so that the herbs adhere
8. In the same roasting pan , add the 10 cloves of garlic and place the lamb on top of the garlic
9. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
10. Cook in oven 15 to 20 minutes or until medium-rare
11. Remove from oven and from roasting pan and wrap the lamb in aluminum foil to rest
12. Place roasting pan on top of stove over medium heat
13. Remove garlic& set aside
14. Discard all of the fat
15. Add the wine and broth and reduce by half
16. Place the roasted garlic into a blender or food processor
17. Add the reduced stock and wine mixture& puree until smooth
18. Add the tablespoon of butter and pulse to incorporate
19. Season well with salt and pepper
20. Serve

title: vegetable samosa pie
steps:
1. Cook the new potatoes in boiling water for 2-3 minutes , add the sweet potatoes and continue cooking until just tender
2. Drain and leave to cool
3. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan and fry the onion over a medium heat for about 5 minutes until they start to brown
4. Add the cumin seeds , ground cumin , ground coriander , turmeric and drops of hot pepper sauce
5. Stir well then mix in the garlic , chilies and ginger
6. Add the peas and water to the pan and simmer for 5 minutes
7. Add the new and sweet potatoes , crushing them slightly as you mix them in
8. Stir in the fresh coriander and lemon juice , check seasoning and add salt if required
9. Remove pan from the heat , leave to cool slightly then mix in all but 1 tbsp of beaten egg
10. Preheat the oven to 190c / 375f / gas mark 5
11. Melt the butter and mix in the remaining 1 / 2 tbsp of oil
12. Brush a 9inch deep sided loose-bottomed tin with a little of the butter / oil mixture
13. Reserving enough phyllo pastry to cover the top of the pie when filled , line the bottom and sides of the tin with sheets of phyllo pastry , brushing each one with the butter mixture and arranging them at different angles across the base of the tin to create a leak proof shell
14. Spoon in the samosa filling , packing it down evenly
15. Cover the pie with remaining phyllo , sealing over all edges of the phyllo shell
16. Brush the top of the pie with any remaining butter mixture and beaten egg , sprinkle over the sesame seeds
17. Bake for 40-50 minutes until well browned
18. Allow the pie to cool slightly in its tin before serving
19. This is good served with cucumber raita , mango chutney and salad

title: curried pork bites
steps:
1. Combine garam masala , onion , ginger , oil , and cayenne pepper in a medium mixing bowl
2. Stir in pork , working spice mixture into meat with fingers
3. Thread the meat onto metal skewers , leaving 1 / 4 inch between pieces , cover and refrigerate for 1 to 24 hours
4. Place pork skewer on the lightly oiled rack of the grill directly over medium heat
5. Grill for 12 to 15 minutes or until the juices run clear , turning once
6. Meanwhile , stir together yogurt and cilantro in a small serving dish
7. Cover and chill until serving
8. To serve , use a fork to remove grilled pork cubes from skewers
9. Arrange on a tray around yogurt mixture
10. Serve pork cubes with toothpicks

title: crusty fried chicken
steps:
1. Combine flour , garlic salt , salt , celery saltpepper and paprika in paper or plastic bag
2. Add a few pieces of chicken at a time
3. Shake to coat
4. Heat oil to 365f in electric skillet or on medium-high heat in large heavy skillet fry chicken 30 to 40 minutes without lowering heat turn once for even browning
5. Drain on paper towels

title: lebanese carrot and orange salad
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine carrots , oranges and raisins
2. Toss to combine
3. In a small bowl , combine remaining ingredients
4. Spoon over carrot mixture
5. Mix well
6. Chill several hours or overnight
7. Mix before serving

title: very chocolate pudding
steps:
1. In a saucepan , whisk together sugar , cornstarch and sugar
2. In a separate bowl mix together milk , cream , half & half , and vanilla
3. Whisk 1 c of milk mixture into sugar mixture until dissolved
4. Whisk in rest of milk mixture
5. Cook over medium heat until thick
6. Stir in chocolate chips until melted , about 1 minute
7. Remove from heat , stir in butter until melted
8. Pour into serving cups to cool

title: chicken breasts stuffed with goat cheese and arugula
steps:
1. Combine cheese and garlic in a small cup
2. Trim excess fat from chicken
3. Season with salt and pepper
4. Using a sharp knife , cut a horizontal slit through thickest portion of each breast to form a deep pocket
5. Stuff each pocket with an equal amount of cheese mixture and arugula
6. Press edges of chicken together to seal
7. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
8. Brown chicken , 4 minutes per side
9. Reduce heat to medium
10. Add broth to pan
11. Cover and simmer , about 6 minutes , or until chicken is cooked through
12. Serve immediately , discarding any remaining broth

title: onion phyllo tart
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat
2. Add onions , garlic and sugar and saute 20-30 minutes , stirring occasionally , until onions are very brown and very soft
3. Mix beaten eggs , sour cream , dill , flour , swiss and 2 tbs of the parmesan in a large bowl
4. Add the caramelized onions to the egg mixture and mix until well combined
5. Take two sheets of phyllo dough and lay them into the bottom of a greased 8-10 inch springform pan
6. Brush with butter or spray with oil
7. Take another two sheets and lay them over the pan in the other direction
8. Spray with oil or brush with butter
9. Be sure that the bottom and sides of pan are covered with phyllo
10. When phyllo is laid in pan , pour in egg and onion mixture
11. Pull phyllo dough over mixture to cover
12. Brush top with 2 tsp butter and sprinkle with remaining parmesan cheese
13. Bake at 375 for 45 minutes or until golden brown
14. Allow to sit for 5 minutes , then release springform and let sit for 5 more minutes before slicing
15. Serve hot or at room temperature

title: crock pot beanie weenies
steps:
1. In a crock pot , combine all ingredients
2. Mix well
3. Cover and cook on low for 7-8 hours

title: north state s plate s tofu roast
steps:
1. Use a blender to make bread crumbs
2. Steam spinach until soft
3. Drain tofu by pressing with a plate and then mash
4. Saute onion and celery in oil
5. Mix all ingredients and place in a loaf pan coated with pam
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 40-45 minutes
7. For the italian sauce , bring all ingredients to a boil at medium heat , then simmer for 20 minutes
8. Serve sauce over tofu roast

title: frozen harlequin pie
steps:
1. Several days ahead , preheat oven to 375
2. Greases a 9" pie pan , lining the bottom with waxed paper
3. Butter paper also
4. In a small bowl , mix nuts , sugar and salt
5. In another bowl , beat egg white to soft peaks
6. Add to nut mixture , mixing well to moisten nuts
7. Press nut mixture onto the bottom and up the sides of the prepared pie pan
8. Bake 12-15 minutes , or until light brown
9. With a small spatula , loosten the sides and let the crust cool for 10 minutes
10. Gently lift crust and pull the waxed paper out
11. Meanwhile , in a medium saucepan , combine coffee granules , 1 / 2 cup milk and marshmallows and stir over low heat until marshmallows melt
12. Beat egg yolk lightly
13. Stir in a little hot mixture then whisk egg into hot liquid
14. Cook one additional minute , stirring
15. Refrigerate marshmallow mixture , stirring occasionally , until almost set
16. Fold in whipped heavy cream , and almond extract , mixing until all the cream is incorporated
17. Turn this mixture into the cooled pie shell
18. Melt the chocolate and 1 tablespoon milk together and drop small spoonsful all over the top of the pie
19. Make a marble effect by cutting through the chocolate with a cold knife
20. Freeze until firm , then serve

title: leek patties
steps:
1. Peel and boil potatoes
2. Wash the leeks carefully
3. Dice the white base and part of green base
4. Parboil in salted water for 5 minutes
5. Drain
6. Mash the potatoes
7. Add the leeks
8. Blend in well
9. Add eggs , salt and pepper
10. Add cheese
11. Heat oil
12. When sizzling , drop leeks by tablespoonful
13. Fry till golden on each side
14. Drain

title: fruit plate with marshmallow sauce
steps:
1. Combine sugar , corn syrup , and hot water
2. Heat , stirring until sugar dissolves
3. Then boil without stirring to firm ball stage
4. Beat egg whites stiff
5. Slowly add hot syrup , beating at high speed until thick and fluffy
6. Add salt and vanilla
7. Gently fold in mayonnaise and orange rind
8. If thicker then disred , fold in 1 or 2 tablespoons more mayonnaise , or 1 or 2 teaspoons water

title: hot bacon cole slaw casserole
steps:
1. Lay bacon on pan
2. Mix equal parts of dry mustard and brown sugar and generously sprinkle over bacon
3. Bake in hot oven until bacon is cooked
4. Put shredded cabbage in large dish and add a couple of tablespoons of vinegar and 1-1 1 / 2 tsp of garlic
5. Mix well
6. Crumble bacon into this with drippings and mix again
7. Bake in oven until all is hot

title: mom s crusty white potato bread
steps:
1. Mix warm water , yeast , sugar , potato flakes and gluten in a small bowl
2. Let sit till foamy
3. Transfer yeast mixture to a mixing bowl
4. Add salt , 1 cup of oil , eggs and 4 cups of the flour to the yeast mixture and mix with a wire wisk till all is throroughly combined and smooth
5. Change to your kneading attachment and slowly add the remaining 8 cups of flour
6. Mix on low for 15 minutes or knead by hand until smooth
7. Put the remaining 2 t oil into a large bowl , greasing the sides where the dough will touch
8. Place dough in greased bowl and let rise till double
9. About one hour
10. Heat oven to 400 degrees
11. Punch down and divide into 4 loaf pans , let rise till double
12. About 30 minutes
13. Brush risen loaves with egg yolk and sprinkle with the sesame seeds
14. Place in oven for 15 minutes
15. Reduce temperature to 350 degrees , keeping the loaves in the oven , set the timer for 45 minutes
16. Remove from oven and let cool 5 minutes
17. Remove loaves from pan and place on a wire rack to cool
18. Slice and spread with butter
19. Yummy !

title: apple beef stew
steps:
1. Brown beef in butter over medium heat
2. Add onions
3. Cook until lightly browned
4. Sprinkle with flour and salt
5. Gradually add water and apple juice
6. Bring to a boil
7. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
8. Place the bay leaf , allspice , and clove in a cheesecloth bag
9. Add to pot
10. Reduce heat , cover and simmer for 1-1 1 / 2 hours or until meat is almost tender
11. Add carrots and apples
12. Cover and simmer 15 minutes or until meat , carrots , and apples are tender
13. Discard spice bag and thicken with additional flour if desired
14. Enjoy !

title: chinese roast chicken
steps:
1. Mix together soy sauce , lemon juice , honey , sesamme oil , dry mustard , ginger , garlic and ground black pepper to make the marinade
2. Place chicken in a bowl or zip lock plastic bag
3. Pour marinade over it
4. Marinate in refrigerator for at least one hour , i marinate it for at least 12 hours
5. Turn the chicken over in marinade occasionally
6. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
7. Roast chicken on rack until chicken is dark brown and a fork can be inserted with ease , at least 1 1 / 4 to 1 1 / 2 hours
8. Bring marinade to full boil and use to baste chicken every 15 minutes

title: swedish meatballs  kottbullar
steps:
1. Fry the onion light yellow in a little butter
2. Soak the breadcrumbs in the liquid
3. Mix everything well and add spices to taste
4. Make 1- to 1 1 / 2-inch meatballs with the help of two wet spoons
5. Put them on a plate coated with a little flour and fry them slowly on all sides in lots of butter
6. Place the meatballs on a hot plate , fry the flour in the remaining fat and pour in the stock and the cream
7. Boil for a few minutes
8. Add soy , salt and pepper to taste and pour the hot sauce over the meatballs
9. Serve hot with mashed potates , pickled cucumber and preserved lingonberry or cranberry

title: nana s heavenly hash
steps:
1. Stirring constantly , toast pecans in a dry medium-hot iron skillet until fragrant ! be careful not to scorch them ! set aside to cool , then chop !
2. Add water to saved fruit juices to make 2 cups
3. Bring to boil and dissolve gelatin
4. Add 2 cups cold water and cool until partially set
5. Add all ingredients except cool whip
6. When thickened but not completely set , fold sour cream into cool whip , then into jello-fruit mixture until well combined
7. Pour into a pretty clear glass bowl , or trifle bowl ~ this makes a large amount !
8. Chill for several hours before serving

title: buttery   spicy lemon corn
steps:
1. In a square metal bread pan add corn , lemon juice , garlic and cayenne
2. Slice butter into pats and place over the top of each corn
3. Sprinkle with garlic salt and a little more cayenne
4. Heat on the bbq or oven at 350f until simmering and cook for 20 minutes or until tender , turning 3 times

title: chicken soup tete style
steps:
1. Place chicken , celery , carrots , onions , garlic , cloves , cinnamon , cilantro , peppercorns , and bay leave in a good sized stock pot and fill with cold water to cover chicken by 3 to 4 inches , using low heat cook for 4 hours after boiling begins
2. Using a colander drain broth into another pot
3. Reserve chicken meat and discard the rest
4. In a bowl put rice and 1 cup of water to soak
5. While it is soaking skim fat off the top of broth and remove usable meat from chicken
6. Add rice to chicken broth and salt and pepper to taste
7. Boil at least 20 minutes and then add shredded chicken
8. Remove from heat and let sit until soup thickens
9. Once soup has reached desired thickness heat through and serve

title: sopa de ajo   castilian garlic soup
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a heavy frying pan
2. Add not-too-thinly sliced garlic
3. Before the garlic turns brown , add the cubed ham and the slices of bread
4. Saut for a few minutes on medium heat
5. Add the sweet paprika , followed by the water and salt
6. Bring to a slow boil
7. Boil for 5-10 minutes
8. To poach the eggs , carefully add eggs to the soup one at a time
9. Scoop out poached eggs one at a time into soup bowls
10. Then , slowly ladle the soup into each bowl

title: dark   stormy cupcakes
steps: 1. I have been instructed by the owner of the originating blog to remove this recipe

title: grecian quiche
steps:
1. Press pie crust into a 9 inch pie pan
2. Press into sides and bottom
3. Trim edges if needed
4. Line with a double thickness of foil
5. Bake in a 450 oven for 8 minutes
6. Remove foil and bake for 10 more minutes
7. Cool
8. Reduce oven temperature to 375
9. In a large skillet melt butter over medium-high heat
10. Add mushrooms
11. Cook and stir for 4-5 minutes or until tender
12. Remove from heat
13. Stir in pimiento , shallots and olives
14. Spoon the mixture evenly into pre-baked tart shell and set aside
15. In a small bowl beat together eggs , milk , dry mustard , salt and pepper
16. Carefully pour over mushroom mixture
17. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until just set and a knife inserted into the center comes out clean
18. Sprinkle with cheese before serving

title: skillet sauteed corn
steps:
1. Melt butter in skillet and saute garlic over low heat just until it begins to sizzle
2. Add corn and heat through , stirring occasionally
3. Add thyme and salt and pepper to taste
4. Serve immediately

title: frankly peppered potato bake
steps:
1. Cook the onion in the butter until tender
2. Add the rest of ingredients and pour into 11 x 7" baking dish
3. Cover w / aluminum foil
4. Bake at 350f 1 hours

title: turkish rice a roni
steps:
1. Heat up 3 tablespoons of butter on medium heat until the butter smells nutty but not burnt
2. Saut the rice with the orzo , leek , cinnamon stick and allspice until rice grains and pasta glisten and are lightly browned , about 5 minutes
3. Stir in the tomato and broth
4. Bring to a boil
5. Lower heat to simmer , cover and cook for 18-20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed
6. Meanwhile , heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter on low-medium heat and lightly toast the almonds
7. Stir in the raisins and dried apricots , stirring until dried fruit is very slightly plump
8. This will only take a minute
9. Set the almond / dried fruit mixture aside
10. Once the rice is done cooking , stir in the almond / dried fruit , parsley and mint
11. Season with salt and pepper , to taste
12. Remove cinnamon stick before serving

title: easy as 1 2 3 deviled eggs
steps:
1. Hard boil eggs
2. Once cool , peel and slice lengthwise
3. Pop yolks out into a bowl and mash up a bit
4. Set whites aside
5. Add next 3 ingredients
6. The easy way to remember proper amounts is 1 , 2 , 3 tablespoons in alphabetical order
7. So it will be 1 of mustard , 2 of sugar and 3 of vinegar
8. Mix together well and add mayo or miracle whip just enough to make it a little creamy
9. Spoon mixture back into your empty egg whites

title: onion bread pudding
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Melt 4 tablespoons butter with the corn or vegetable oil in a heavy pot
3. Toss in the onions , cover and steam over low heat for 15 minutes
4. Uncover the pot raise the heat to medium , and cook , stirring occasionally , until the onions re deeply browned and caramelized
5. Pour in the vermouth and boil until the liquid cooks away , scraping the bottom of the pot with a wooden spoon all the while
6. Choose a shallow round 1 1 / 2-quart casserole dish rub it thoroughly with the cut sides of the garlic clove
7. Discard the garlic
8. Toss the bread and onions together
9. Spread them in the casserole dish
10. Melt the remaining butter and pour over the bread
11. Sprinkle on the cheese
12. Beat the eggs slightly and beat in the half and half and salt and pepper
13. Pour the mixture evenly over the bread and cheese
14. Press the bread into the liquid with a spatula
15. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes until puffed and golden
16. Serve at once

title: soft   chewy chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180 degrees c
2. In a small bowl sift together flour and baking soda , set aside
3. In a large bowl , combine butter and both sugars
4. Beat on medium speed until light and fluffy , about 3 minutes
5. Reduce speed to low , add salt , vanilla , and eggs
6. Beat until well mixed , about 1 minute
7. Add flour mixture , mix until just combined
8. Stir in chocolate chips
9. Drop heaping spoonfuls about 2 inches apart onto baking trays lined with parchment paper
10. Bake until golden around the edges and soft in the middle , about 8-10 minutes

title: raw  not peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. For the ground almonds take 1 / 3 cup raw almonds and process in a food processor fitted with the s blade until finely ground
2. Place the almond butter , maple syrup , vanilla , and salt in a food processor fitted with the s blade and process until smooth
3. Transfer to a small bowl and freeze for 30 minutes
4. Form into 1-inch balls and flatten slightly
5. Roll each cookie in the ground almonds
6. Freeze for at least 2 hours before serving
7. Stored in a sealed container in the freezer , these cookies will keep for up to one month

title: mocha cupcake with frosting
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Put 20 paper baking cases in 2 muffin pans
3. Put the coffee granules , butter , sugar , honey , and water in a pan and heat gently , stirring , until the sugar has dissolved
4. Bring to a boil , then reduce the heat and let simmer for 5 minutes
5. Pour into a large heatproof bowl and let cool
6. When the mixture has cooled , add flour and cocoa
7. Dissolve baking soda in the milk , then add to the mixture with the egg and beat together until smooth
8. Spoon the batter into paper cases
9. Bake the cupcakes in the preheated over for 15-20 minutes , or until well risen and firm to the touch
10. Transfer to a wire rack to cool
11. For frosting , beat all ingredients , except nuts with a mixer until fluffy
12. Spread frosting to each cooled cake , and top with nuts

title: balsamic soy glazed chicken wings
steps:
1. Put oven racks in upper and lower thirds of oven
2. Line 2 large shallow baking pans with foil
3. Put pans in oven and preheat oven to 500f
4. Pat wings dry , then toss with oil , salt , and pepper in a large bowl and divide between preheated pans , spreading wings in 1 layer
5. Roast , without turning , until golden and tender , about 35 minutes
6. While wings roast , simmer vinegar , soy sauce , and sugar in a 1- to 1 1 / 2-quart heavy saucepan , stirring occasionally , until reduced to about 1 / 3 cup , 12 to 14 minutes
7. Remove from heat and stir in butter until melted
8. Remove roasted wings from oven and let stand in pans 1 minute , then transfer with tongs to a clean large bowl
9. Pour balsamic mixture over wings and toss to coat well
10. Let stand 5 minutes , then toss again

title: bruschetta salad
steps:
1. Toss all ingredients in large salad bowl
2. Serve immediately

title: scandinavian potato salad
steps:
1. Boil the potatoes and cut into bite-sized pieces
2. Crush the garlic and finely chop the herbs
3. Rinse and chop the herrings
4. While the potatoes are still warm , mix with the garlic , herbs , olive oil , lemon juice and zest
5. Leave covered for 10 minutes
6. Taste and add more oil or lemon juice as required
7. Season to taste , remembering that the herring has been in salted water
8. Add the herring to the mix and serve in a large bowl

title: sesame onion potatoes
steps:
1. Heat sesame oil in large frypan on a low flame
2. Add a few dashes of soy sauce
3. Onion soup mix and stir
4. Evenly distribute mixture in the bottom of the pan
5. Slice potatoes into 1 / 4-inch slices , rinse and place flat in frypan
6. Sprinkle the rest of the onion soup mix on top of the potatoes and add pepper and garlic powder
7. Cover and let sit for approximately 5 minutes
8. Add a few dashes of soy sauce and using a spatula , gently lift and stir potatoes to mix seasonings
9. Remove from heat and cover for approximately 2 minutes
10. Serve hot
11. The desired texture for the potatoes is fork tender
12. You can filter the onion soup mix by shaking it in a strainer to separate dehydrated onion from the powder
13. This way you can control the amount of seasonings you desire to add to your rice , sauces , onion dip , etc
14. To reduce sodium , use a ratio of 1 tablespoon of onion soup mix and 1 teaspoon of onion powder
15. Try this recipe with fresh baby spinach leaves added in step 4

title: oh so easy turkey breast  3 steps  3 ingredients
steps:
1. Rub turkey with olive oil and season heavily with spices
2. Place breast side down in roasting pan
3. Cook in pre heated 350 degree oven for 2hr turning once

title: mamaw s scalloped potatoes
steps:
1. Peel and slice potatoes and boil in water till tender , put into a casserole dish
2. Melt butter and stir in flour until combined
3. Add milk and stir till smooth and thick
4. Add cheese and stir till melted
5. Pour over potatoes , cover with foil and cook for 40 minutes at 350f

title: the anzac biscuit
steps:
1. Heat the oven to 350f
2. Line a baking tray with baking paper
3. Set aside
4. In a small saucepan , melt the butter over a medium heat
5. Add the golden syrup and baking soda to the butter and stir well
6. Remove from heat and set aside
7. Mix together the flour , oats , sugar , desiccated coconut and salt in a mixing bowl
8. Add the melted butter to the dry ingredients and stir with a wooden spoon to combine ingredients
9. Roll about 1 1 / 2 tablespoons of dough into small balls and flatten between the palms of your hands
10. Place dough on baking tray about 4 cm apart to allow room for spreading
11. Bake the biscuits for about 10-12 minutes or until golden brown
12. Remove the biscuits from the oven and let them sit on the baking tray for 5 minutes
13. Remove the biscuits from the tray and cool on a wire rack
14. Yield: 10-15 biscuits

title: goji berry smoothie
steps:
1. Combine ingredients in blender
2. Blend for 1 minute & serve

title: easy cabbage beef bake
steps:
1. Chop cabbage
2. Brown ground beef and onion in skillet on medium heat
3. Drain
4. Season with salt and pepper to your liking
5. Cover bottom of greased medium size casserole dish with half the cabbage
6. Add beef and onion
7. Put remaining cabbage on top of beef layer
8. Mix tomato soup and water
9. Pour over beef / cabbage mixture
10. Cover and bake @ 375 for about one hour

title: man catcher brownies
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat
2. Remove from the heat and add the cocoa powder , stirring to combine
3. Let cool slightly
4. In a large bowl , whisk the eggs together , then add the sugars and vanilla , stirring to combine
5. Add the cooled butter-chocolate mixture , then fold in the flour and salt until just combined
6. Do not overmix
7. Spread the batter evenly in a 9x13-inch pan that has been lined with parchment paper and sprayed with nonstick cooking spray , making sure the corners are filled
8. Bake for 40-45 minutes at 350 degrees or until a crust forms on the surface and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out mostly clean

title: red ruby strawberry sauce
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , combine the sugar and cornstarch
2. Stir in orange juice concentrate until smooth
3. Add strawberries
4. Bring to a boil
