5. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
6. Remove from the heat
7. Stir in vanilla
8. Cool
9. Store in the refrigerator

title: bbq shrimp  blt  sandwich
steps:
1. Make the sauce: in a medium saucepan , heat the oil
2. Sweat the shallots for about 2 minutes
3. Do not brown
4. Deglaze the pan with the wine and vinegar and reduce slightly
5. Pour in the cream and reduce the sauce by half
6. Whisk in the butter and strain into a clean pan
7. Season with lemon juice and salt and pepper to taste
8. Keep warm
9. Cook the shrimp: sprinkle the vegetable oil over the shrimp
10. Grill the shrimp , about 1 1 / 2 minutes on each side
11. Do not overcook
12. Drain and cut each shrimp in half lengthwise
13. Prepare the sandwich: for each sandwich , spread a little mayonnaise on one slice of bread and arrange a little lettuce on the bread
14. Top with 3 slices of tomatoes , season lightly with salt and pepper , and arrange the bacon on the tomatoes
15. Top with the second slice of bread , a thin layer of mayonnaise and a little lettuce
16. Heat the shrimp in the lemon butter and arrange on the lettuce
17. Top with the third slice of bread and cut in half
18. Serve immediately

title: rainbow popcorn balls
steps:
1. Melt butter and marshmallows over low heat
2. Add jello and stir well to combine
3. Put popcorn in a large bowl and pour this mixture over , mixing well to be sure to coat all popcorn
4. When cool enough to handle , butter your hands and form into balls
5. Wrap balls in plastic wrap to show off the color

title: a w root beer copycat
steps:
1. Dissolve sugar in hot water
2. Add root beer flavoring
3. Slowly add to seltzer water and serve over ice

title: pineapple curry rice
steps:
1. Heat sauce pan over medium high heat and add oil
2. Saute 1 cup rice in oil until slightly toasted
3. Drain pineapple juice into measuring cup , add evaporated milk and water to equal 2 cups total liquid
4. Crumble bullion cube into liquid
5. Add 1 / 2 can pineapple chunks to rice
6. Add 1 / 4 tsp salt and pinch curry powder to rice
7. If using , add mushrooms
8. Pour liquid over rice and bring to boil
9. Cover , reduce heat and simmer 20 minute
10. Fluff and serve

title: carrabba s spicy sicilian chicken soup
steps:
1. In a large stockpot heat olive oil under fairly low to medium heat
2. "sweat" onion , celery , green pepper and some salt for perhaps 30 minutes -- this is lower than browning , and makes the veggies somewhat translucent
3. I covered , and mixed every few minutes to prevent browning
4. Add carrots , garlic , some white pepper and some black pepper , and continue to heat under "sweat" conditions while mixing now and then
5. Add chicken stock , chicken breasts , tomatoes and potatoes -- and of course some more white pepper and black pepper
6. Cover and simmer on low heat for 1
7. 5 to 2 hours
8. Remove chicken and let cool and stand to shred
9. Add chopped parsley and return the shredded chicken to the soup
10. Salt to taste at this point , and add more white and black pepper if your tongue is not twitching a bit when you sample
11. -)
12. Simmer while cooking ditalini
13. Serve soup over cooked pasta to taste
14. We will freeze some for ready-made meals and i think it will work out well

title: cooking light s flaky buttermilk biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Combine flour , baking powder , and salt in a large bowl
3. Cut in butter with a pastry blender or 2 knives until mixture resembles coarse meal
4. Chill 10 minutes
5. Combine buttermilk and honey , stirring with a whisk until well blended
6. Add buttermilk mixture to flour mixture
7. Stir just until moist
8. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface
9. Knead lightly 4 times
10. Roll dough into a 9 x 5inch rectangle
11. Dust top of dough with flour
12. Fold dough crosswise into thirds
13. Reroll dough into a 9 x 5inch rectangle
14. Dust top of dough with flour
15. Fold dough crosswise into thirds
16. Gently roll or pat to a 3 / 4-inch thickness
17. Cut dough with a 1 3 / 4-inch biscuit cutter to form 14 dough rounds
18. Place dough rounds , 1 inch apart , on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper
19. Bake at 400 for 12 minutes or until golden
20. Remove from pan
21. Cool 2 minutes on wire racks
22. Serve warm

title: strawberry cream cheese pound cake
steps:
1. Cream the butter , cheese and sugar together until light and fluffy
2. Add a pinch of salt and the butter flavoring and beat well
3. Add the eggs , one at a time
4. Beat thoroughly after each egg
5. Stir in the flour and fold in the strawberries
6. Spoon the batter into 2 buttered and floured cake pans
7. Bake in a preheated 325 degree oven for 1-1 1 / 2 hours-this depends on your oven-and until the cake beging to shrink from the sides of the pan-so the toothpick test
8. Place pans on cooking racks until cooled and then turn cakes gently onto wire racks to finish cooling
9. For the frosting blend the butter and cheese together
10. Add the sugar and blend well
11. Frost cake

title: seafood chili
steps:
1. Partially thaw fillets and cut into 1 inch pieces
2. Saute onions , celery , green pepper , garlic in butter or oil , just until tender
3. Add remaining ingredients , except fish
4. Cover and slow simmer gently for 30 minutes or until thick , stirring occasionally
5. Add fish
6. Cover and simmer 7 minutes or until fish is opaque and flakes easily
7. We like it served over brown rice

title: simple  delicious chicken dinner
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Thaw chicken breasts prior to preparation for easier handling and faster cooking time
3. Use non-stick cooking spray to coat baking dish
4. Rinse chicken breasts well with cold water
5. Then place chicken breasts on bottom of the baking dish
6. Lightly season chicken breasts with seasoning salt for taste
7. Toss onions & peppers on and around chicken breasts
8. Place on middle rack in oven for 20 minutes
9. Flip chicken over and cook for another 15 minutes
10. Take shredded cheese and sprinkle over each chicken breast as much as you desire
11. Cook for an additional 5 minutes
12. Serve immediately and enjoy

title: spicy roasted potatoes
steps:
1. Combine mustard , oil , garlic , tarragon , paprika , and pepper flakes
2. Wash potato pieces and pat dry with paper towels
3. Add to spice mixture and toss to coat well
4. Very lightly grease a baking sheet
5. Add potatoes in a single layer
6. Bake in a preheated 350f oven for approximately 35 minutes or until potatoes are tender
7. Sprinkle with salt , if desired

title: peanut coconut chicken curry  lower fat
steps:
1. Cube chicken and brown , add onions and garlic , and saute until onion is tender
2. In large pan , combine chicken broth , peanut butter , curry seasonings and sambal
3. When well combined , add chciken mixture to the pan
4. Simmer uncovered , stirring occasionally , for about 30 minutes , until chicken is cooked through and sauce has reduced slightly
5. Thoroughly combine half-and-half , cornstarch , coconut extract and sugar , and add to the chicken mixture
6. Simmer , stirring , until sauce has thickened to desired consistency , 10 minutes or so
7. Serve over pasta or rice and top with grated coconut

title: rice dressing
steps:
1. Brown meat in a skillet
2. Add diced vegetables and cook for a few minutes until slightly softened
3. Whisk both soups together in a small saucepan and heat until they are well blended and warm
4. Combine all ingredients in a large roaster
5. Add pats of butter on top and cover with foil
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 1 / 2 hours
7. Try using 1 1 / 2 cups regular and 1 / 2 cup wild rice
8. I like to use 1 / 2 lb
9. Ground pork sausage and 1 / 2lb andouille
10. Try spicing with greek seasoning blend , paprika , cayenne , sage , etc
11. - use whatever you like !

title: baked onion   mushroom rice
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a baking dish or 3 quart casserole dish
2. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes

title: tomato and onion sandwich
steps:
1. Spread both sides of the white bread with mayonnaise
2. On one slice of bread , place the onion and tomato slices in layers , starting with the onion
3. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste
4. Top with the remaining slice of bread
5. Cut sandwich in half if desired and enjoy !

title: peanut butter and jelly cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Using an electric mixer , cream the butter and sugar in a medium bowl
3. Beat in the peanut butter , egg yolk and vanilla
4. Stir in the flour and salt
5. Form the dough into 1-inch balls
6. Roll them in peanuts and place about 2 inches apart on a large cookie sheet
7. Bake the cookies for 5 minutes
8. Using a small melon baller or your thumb , make a deep indentation in the center of each cookie so that it will flatten slightly
9. With the melon baller , spoon about 1 teaspoon of the preserves into each cookie
10. Do not overfill or you'll be sorry !
11. Bake for about 15 minutes longer , until the cookies are golden and cracked
12. Transfer to a rack to cool completely

title: grilled antipasto
steps:
1. In a bowl , whisk together the oil , vinegar , lemon juice , garlic , basil , parsley , oregano , thyme , salt , and pepper flakes to make the marinade
2. Place the zucchini , asparagus , onions , and bell peppers in a large bowl and toss with the marinade , to coat
3. Let marinate for at least 1 hour and up to 2 hours
4. Preheat the grill to very high heat
5. Remove the vegetables from the marinade and lay on the grill , in batches if necessary
6. Grill over very high heat until marked , about 1 minute per side
7. Remove with tongs and place on a platter to cool slightly
8. Sprinkle the vegetables with the cheese , pine nuts , and basil
9. Serve with the bruschetta or as a salad
10. Use whatever vegetables you prefer

title: sugarplum cookie pizza
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 mix sugars , butter , vanilla and egg in large bowl with spoon
2. Stir in flour and baking soda spread or pat dough in ungreased 12 inch pizza pan or in 12 inch circle on ungreased cookie sheet bake 10 minutes
3. Sprinkle gumdrops over partially baked crust
4. Bake about 5 minutes longer or until curst is golden brown
5. Cool in pan 30 minutes
6. Melt baking chips and shortening in small heavy saucepan over low heat , stirring frequently
7. Drizzle over cookie and let stand 15 to 20 minutes or until set
8. To serve , cut into wedges

title: jim s blueberry hotcakes
steps:
1. Stir in a bowl the yoghurt , honey and cinnamon
2. For the hotcakes , sift flour and baking powder into large bowl
3. Stir in sugar and make a well in the centre
4. In a jug , whisk eggs , milk and vanilla
5. Add to dry ingredients , stir till just combined , mixture maybe slightly lumpy
6. Gently stir in blueberries
7. Spray non stick pan with canola spray and place on medium heat
8. Pour 1 / 2 cup batter into pan , cook for about1 1 / 2 minutes till bubbles appear on surface , turn over and cook further 1 1 / 2 minutes till golden
9. Serve with yoghurt , honey and cinnamon mixture on top

title: basic olive oil and vinegar vinaigrette  weight watchers
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Shake and refrigerate
3. Variations: choose one of the following or mix , to you taste
4. 4 cloves garlic , crushed
5. Squirt of lemon or lime juice
6. 2 teaspoons of one of the following:
7. Fresh chopped basil
8. Minced scallion
9. Fresh thyme
10. Fresh marjoram

title: italian herb dressing
steps:
1. Combine ingredients in jar
2. Cover and shake well
3. Chill to blend flavors
4. Remove garlic
5. Shake again before serving

title: pumpkin   gingerbread streusel cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f combine all streusel ingredients except butter in small bowl
2. Cut in 2 tablespoons butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
3. Set aside
4. Combine sugar and 1 / 2 cup butter in large bowl
5. Beat at low speed , scraping bowl often , until creamy
6. Reduce speed to low
7. Add all remaining cake ingredients
8. Beat until well mixed
9. Pour cake batter into greased 13x9-inch baking pan
10. Sprinkle evenly with streusel
11. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
12. Serve cake warm or cool with ice cream topping
13. Pumpkin pie spice
14. 1 1 / 2 teaspoon ground cinnamon plus 3 / 4 teaspoon ground ginger and 1 / 2 teaspoon each ground nutmeg and ground cloves can be substituted for 1 tablespoon pumpkin pie spice

title: italian approved pressure cooker risotto in 7 minutes
steps:
1. Soften the onion in your pressure cooker , add salt and pepper
2. When onions are softened add the rice and lightly toast it to release the starch
3. When you add the arborio rice to the onions first it will turn it from white to translucent as it absorbs the oil , then in about a minute back to white
4. Wait until just a couple of grains look golden and your rice is toasted ! then , add a swig of white wine and stir until it has evaporated
5. Add the broth , mix and close the top immediately
6. Close and lock the lid of the pressure cooker and turn the heat to high
7. When the pan reaches pressure , lower the flame to minimum heat and begin counting 7 minutes cooking time under pressure for al dente risotto , 9 for well done
8. Near the end of the cooking time , i like to pick up the whole cooker off the flame and swirl it around to feel if it is still very liquid inside
9. It should feel a little dense but not soupy
10. When the time is up , open the pressure cooker with the quick-release cold water method by bringing it to the sink , giving it a little jiggle to settle the contents inside , and running cold water on the top until the pressure subsides and you can open the top
11. If the risotto inside is just a little wet , it is perfect the risotto will absorb the liquid by the time you serve it to your guests
12. If it is still very wet , put the open pressure cooker back on a medium flame to bring to the right consistency

title: italian sauced chicken over pasta
steps:
1. Stovetop method: in a large pot , heat olive oil
2. Add chicken pieces , onion , bell pepper , celery and garlic
3. Cook over medium-high heat , stirring often for about 10 minutes
4. Add all remaining ingredients except pasta
5. Bring to a soft boil
6. Reduce heat , cover and simmer for 30-40 minutes
7. Remove the bay leaf
8. Meanwhile , cook pasta in boiling water according to package
9. Drain
10. Place pasta in 1 large plate or individual plates and serve saucy chicke mixture over top
11. Sprinkle w / parmesan cheese , if desired
12. Slowcooker method: place cut-up raw chicken in slowcooker
13. No olive oil necessary
14. Mix together all reamining ingredients except pasta
15. Pour over the chicken
16. Cover and cook on low for about 6 hours or until chicken is done
17. Remove the bay leaf
18. When done , boil pasta in salted water per package directions
19. Drain
20. Follow serving directions as written under "stovetop" directions

title: emeril s chicken etouffee
steps:
1. Season chicken pieces with salt and cayenne pepper to taste
2. Heat oil in a large dutch oven over medium-high heat and sear chicken pieces on both sides until golden brown
3. Remove to a platter and reserve
4. Add butter to pan and when melted , add flour and stir to combine well
5. Continue to cook roux , stirring constantly , about 12 to 15 minutes or until chocolate brown
6. Immediately add onion , celery , bell pepper and bay leaves and cook 2 to 3 minutes or until soft
7. Add garlic and cook 2 minutes
8. Add beer and stir well to loosen any brown bits from pan bottom
9. Add stock , brown sugar , hot sauce , and worcestershire sauce , stirring to combine
10. Bring to a boil , return chicken pieces to the pot and simmer 1 hour and 15 minutes until chicken is very tinder
11. Remove chicken pieces to a platter and when cool enough to handle , remove chicken meat from bones
12. Return chicken meat to etouffee and continue cooking 30 minutes , until sauce is thickened and flavorful and chicken is beginning to fall apart
13. Add chopped parsley , stirring to combine
14. Taste and adjust seasoning , if necessary
15. Serve immediately over hot cooked rice

title: swirled peanut butter chocolate cheesecake bars
steps:
1. For crust: combine graham cracker crumbs , butter and sugar in medium bowl
2. Press onto bottom of ungreased 13x9-inch baking pan
3. For filling: in a large bowl , beat cream cheese , sugar and flour until smooth , then gradually beat in evaporated milk , eggs and vanilla extract
4. Microwave the morsels in microwave-safe bowl on medium-high power for 1 minute
5. Stir
6. Microwave at additional 10- to 20-second intervals , stirring until smooth
7. Stir 1 cup cream cheese mixture into melted morsels , then pour remaining cream cheese mixture over crust
8. Pour chocolate mixture over plain mixture and swirl with spoon , pulling plain cream cheese mixture up to surface
9. Bake in a preheated oven at 325f for 40 to 45 minutes or until set
10. Cool completely in pan on wire rack
11. Refrigerate until firm before cutting into bars

title: fried fresh smelts
steps:
1. Clean fish , and remove the heads
2. Rinse fish well , and drain
3. Salt the fish , lightly coat in the breadcrumbs , then fry in the butter until golden brown on both sides
4. Serve immediately

title: hamburger baskets
steps:
1. In a wok or skillet brown the meat in the oil
2. Drain
3. Add the herbs , tomato paste and pasta sauce
4. Simmer gently for 20-30 minutes until thick
5. Line a large greased muffin tin with slices of the bread and fill with meat mixture top with a slice of tomato and some grated cheese
6. Bake at 350f for 10-15 minutes until golden brown
7. Nice served with salad and potato wedges

title: baked apple dumplings
steps:
1. Sift flour , baking powder and salt together
2. Add shortening and mix lightly with a fork
3. Combine beaten egg yolk and milk
4. Add to flour mixture
5. Place dough on a floured board and roll out to about 1 / 4 inch thick
6. Cut into 6 inch squares
7. Place an apple in the center of each square
8. Fill center of apple with sugar , sprinkle with cinnamon and add a small piece of butter pinch edges of dough together on top
9. Place in a well greased pan
10. Sprinkle with lemon juice
11. Bake in a preheated 450 oven for ten minutes
12. Combine the last five ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil
13. Cook for five minutes when dumplings have baked for ten minutes , pour syrup over them and reduce heat to 350 bake 25 more minutes , basting occasionally with syrup
14. Serve with ice cream , whipped cream , or cream if desired

title: cranberries  walnuts  and crumbled cheese over greens
steps:
1. Combine oil , vinegar , mustard , garlic , and soy sauce
2. Mix well
3. Season to taste with salt and pepper
4. Toss greens with dressing , cranberries , and walnuts
5. Arrange on serving plates
6. Top with cheese

title: beef gyoza with black vinegar dipping sauce
steps:
1. Mix the sauce ingredients with 2 tablespoons of hot water and set aside
2. Mix beef , tamari , oils , ginger , chives and cabbage
3. Place 1 heaped teaspoon on each wrapper , brush the edges with water and fold over
4. Use your fingers to crimp the edges and stand - crimped edge up - on a lined tray
5. Heat a thin layer of oil in a pan until nearly smoking , then take off heat and arrange gyoza , touching , in a circular pattern
6. Cook over med heat for 1-2 minutes until base is browned , drizzle with 125ml hot water , cover and cook another 3-4 minutes - not letting the pan cook dry
7. Remove from heat , uncover and let stand for a couple of minutes so gyoza come away from pan
8. Invert them onto a plate and serve topped with shredded spring onion and ginger alonside the dipping sauce

title: party pretzels
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200 degrees
2. In small bowl , mix together oil , dressing mix , garlic power and cayenne pepper
3. Use a wire whisk or fork to mix throughly
4. Dump pretzels out on a large baking sheet that has a raised edge
5. Spread pretzels into a single layer
6. Drizzle oil mix over pretzels
7. Toss the pretzels with hands to be sure all are coated
8. Bake in 200 degree oven for 90 minutes
9. Stir with spatula every 30 minutes

title: strawberry  crepes
steps:
1. Filling:
2. Hull , rinse and slice strawberries into a bowl
3. Add brown sugar and toss until well coated
4. Set aside
5. In a separate bowl whip whipping cream and refrigerate
6. Crepes:
7. In a medium bowl whisk all ingredients together until there are no more lumps
8. Over medium heat , heat crepe pan or non-stick frying pan
9. When heated remove from heat and spray with cooking oil
10. Pour a 1 / 3 cup of the batter in the pan
11. Quickly lift pan and tilt and turn until batter evenly covers the bottom
12. Cook over medium heat for 30 - 45 seconds until the edges are dry enough to get a spatula under to flip
13. Cook for another 30 seconds on the other side
14. Should not be totally browned
15. Remove from pan onto a plate
16. Spray pan with cooking spray and repeat for the rest of the batter
17. Stack crepes with wax paper between so they can be easily separated
18. Crepes can be made ahead of time
19. Can also be frozen wrap first in wax paper then put into plastic bag and then foil
20. They stay moist if this is done when still slightly warm
21. Assembly:
22. Down the middle 1 / 3 of the crepe spread one or 2 heaping spoons of whipped cream
23. On top of the whipped cream spoon some of the berry sugar mixture
24. Fold one side of the crepe over the mixture and then the other side over first side
25. Top with a spoon of berry sugar mixture , whipped cream
26. Drizzle chocolate syrup or sprinkle shaved chocolate and sliced almond optional
27. Enjoy

title: strawberry and celery salad with honey dressing
steps:
1. Cut the strawberries in half , lengthwise , and set aside
2. Use half the amount of celery as strawberries , and measure by slicing the celery thing , short strips
3. Honey dressing: combine the olive oil , salt , lemon juice , honey , and paprika and beat until frothy
4. Drain the strawberries and add them along with the celery in a salad bowl
5. Serve with the honey dressing

title: apple butter oatmeal
steps:
1. Bring milk and oatmeal to a boil
2. Turn down heat and simmer for 5 minutes , stirring often
3. Transfer to bowl and add apple butter
4. Stir and enjoy

title: banana pudding nut bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Blend all ingredients in large bowl
3. Bake in loaf pan for 30 minutes

title: georgia peach cobbler
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f lightly grease an 8x8x2-inch baking pan
2. Prepare the filling by combining the sugar , cornstarch and syrup in a saucepan
3. Cook over medium heat , stirring , until the mixture boils and is thick
4. Add the canned peaches and almond extract
5. Keep the filling warm while you prepare the topping
6. To prepare the topping , mix the flour , sugar , baking powder and cinnamon
7. Cut in the margarine until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs
8. Combine the egg and milk in a small bowl , and stir into flour mixture just until moistened
9. Pour the filling into the prepared pan
10. Drop the topping into 6 mounds on top of the hot filling
11. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into topping comes out clean
12. Serve warm with whipped topping or ice cream , if desired
13. Nutritional information per serving: calories 340
14. Total fat 7g
15. Saturated fat 1
16. 5g
17. Cholesterol 35 mg
18. Sodium 180mg
19. Carbohydrate 66g
20. Fiber 2g
21. Protein 4g
22. Vitamin a 15%dv
23. Vitamin c 10%dv
24. Calcium 6%dv
25. Iron 10%dv
26. % daily value

title: aunt rebecca s creamed potatoes   peas
steps:
1. In 2-qt
2. Saucepan place potatoes
3. Add enough water to cover
4. Bring to a full boil
5. Cook over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until potatoes are tender
6. Meanwhile , in 10" skillet , cook bacon over medium high heat , stirring occasionally , until partially cooked
7. Add onion
8. Continue cooking until browned
9. Drain off fat except for 2 tablespoons
10. Set bacon and onion aside
11. Stir flour , thyme leaves , salt and pepper into reserved 2 tablespoons of fat
12. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly until smooth and bubbly
13. Stir in whipping cream , peas , bacon , onion and potatoes
14. Continue cooking , stirring occasionally , until mixture thickens and is heated through

title: tandoori indian grilled vegetables
steps:
1. Toss your selection of vegetables with the marinade in the bowl
2. Refrigerate for 1 hour
3. Have coals to the stage where they are coated with gray ash
4. Lift vegetables from the marinade and place on the grill without touching each other
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Grill slowly , turning with tongs , until lightly browned and cooked through
7. Test by piercing with a knife
8. Serve hot or at room temperature
9. Enjoy !

title: corn nuggets
steps:
1. Preheat oil to 400 degrees
2. Mix the dry ingredients
3. Toss in the shucked corn
4. Using a fork , stir in the egg
5. A little bit at a time , mix in the liquid until the dough forms a ball
6. Let sit for 10 min , then check to see if it needs a bit more liquid
7. You are aiming for a very stiff , but not at all dry , dough
8. Shape into balls , and drop a few at a time into the oil
9. Fry until golden brown

title: triple peanut pizza
steps:
1. Press cookie dough onto a greased 14" pizza pan
2. Bake @ 350 for 12-15 min or until golden brown
3. Sprinkle with chocolate chips and let stand for 4-5 minute spread melted chips over crust
4. Freeze 10 minutes or until firm
5. Meanwhile , in a small mixing bowl beat the cream cheese , peanut butter , brown sugar and vanilla until creamy
6. Spread over the chocolate
7. Sprinkle with peanut butter cups
8. Chill until serving
9. Store leftovers in fridge

title: crushed new potatoes
steps:
1. Scrub and wash the new potatoes and place into a saucepan
2. Cover with the water and then add the rest of the ingredients , except the butter and final seasoning
3. Bring to the boil and reduce to a simmer
4. Cook for approximately 20 minutes
5. Once cooked , drain and using a fork or a potato masher , crush the potatoes lightly ,
6. Add the butter and season with salt and pepper

title: party roll ups   an american  an englishman  and an italian
steps:
1. For each roll-up , spread the cream cheese as evenly as possible across the slice of meat
2. Then spread or sprinkle the other filling on top
3. Roll it up
4. Make as many as you want
5. Eat or serve as is or cut on the horizontal into pinwheels
6. Optional: garnish with toothpicks securing a cranberry for each american , a dried apricot for each englishman , and an olive for each italian
7. Feel free to add additional seasonings: some like the american with a little mayo in it , some like the englishman with a touch of dijon mustard , and some like the italian with garlic powder -- horseradish might go in there somewhere !

title: very healthy salmon cakes patties
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. If the mixture is too soft , add more oats
3. If the mixture is too dry add another egg white
4. Shape into cakes
5. Spray non-stick frying pan and cook until golden on each side
6. These are delicious hot or cold

title: gingerbread with hot caramel sauce
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix molasses , baking soda , cinnamon , ginger and nutmeg
2. Add sugar , butter , flour and boiling water
3. Stir in beaten egg yolks
4. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into batter
5. Pour into a greased ring mold or bundt pan
6. Bake in a 350f oven for 40 minutes or until done
7. Cool
8. Turn gingerbread out onto a cake stand and sift powdered sugar over the top
9. Serve with hot caramel sauce and whipped cream for sauce
10. In a medium saucepan , combine sugars to melted butter and stir until sugars are dissolved
11. Add flour , stirring constantly over medium heat
12. Add vanilla , salt and nutmeg
13. Add boiling water
14. Cook for 10 to 15 minutes , stirring sauce until thickened
15. Serve over gingerbread , or pool underneath

title: hidden valley original ranch dressing clone
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl and whisk until smooth
2. Cover and chill for several hours before using

title: tore s piled high quesadilla
steps:
1. Spread out one tortilla and cover to the edges with chicken
2. Layer each of the veggies on top of the chicken , ending with the tomato
3. Spread cheese on top of the filling
4. Take the second tortilla and spread with sour cream
5. Place , sour cream side down , on top of the quesadilla
6. Place in the oven at 375 degrees for about 5 minutes or until tortillas start to brown
7. Alternatively , fry both sides in a frying pan with a small amount of canola oil
8. Cut in quarters and enjoy with salsa !

title: southwestern cheesy chicken skillet
steps:
1. Cook chicken in a large non-stick skillet over medium high heat for 5 to 7 minutes or until cooked through
2. Stir in 2 cups water
3. Bring to a boil
4. Stir in macaroni
5. Cover reduce heat to medium
6. Simmer 15 minutes , or until water is almost absorbed
7. Add velveeta and ro-tel
8. Cook until velveeta is melted , stirring often
9. Remove from heat
10. Stir in sour cream
11. Sprinkle each serving with desired amount of dried parsley

title: lemon extract
steps:
1. Peel lemon with no white
2. Bring vodka and lemon peel to a boil
3. Pour into a bottle and seal
4. Let stand 2 weeks or more before using

title: tarragon cream chicken
steps:
1. Coat chicken with flour , salt& pepper
2. Heat oil in skillet , add chicken , saute until brown on both sides , 5-7 minutes , remove to plate
3. Add mushrooms and proscuitto to pan , saute 2-3 minutes until mushrooms soften add wine to pan , scrape bottom
4. Add cream
5. Add chicken back to pan , cook about 10 minutes until sauce thickens
6. Stir in tarragon and vinegar , cook 1 minute
7. Garnish and serve

title: valentine berries and cream
steps:
1. Line a 9-in
2. Heart-shaped or square baking pan with foil
3. Set aside
4. In a large heavy saucepan over low heat , melt chocolate and shortening
5. Stir until smooth
6. Pour into prepared pan , swirling to coat the bottom and 1-1 / 2 inches up the sides
7. Refrigerate for 1 minute , then swirl the chocolate to reinforce sides of heart or box
8. Refrigerate for 30 minutes or until firm
9. Using foil , lift from pan
10. Remove foil and place chocolate heart on a serving plate
11. In a large mixing bowl , beat the cream cheese and butter until smooth
12. Combine confectioners' sugar and cocoa
13. Add to creamed mixture with milk and vanilla
14. Beat until smooth
15. Add 1 drop of red food coloring if you want a pink tint to the top
16. Gently fold two-thirds of the whipped cream into cream cheese mixture
17. Spoon into heart
18. Insert star
19. Pipe around the edge of heart
20. Garnish with strawberries

title: bourbon pecan pie
steps:
1. Toast the pecans in the oven at 375 degrees
2. Finely chop the 1 / 2 cup pieces , but leave the halves
3. In a medium bowl , stir together the sugar and melted butter
4. Add the corn syrup , eggs , bourbon and chopped pecans
5. Stir well
6. Pour half the liquid into the pie shell , then lay out the pecan halves , and top with remaining liquid
7. Bake 10 minutes at 375 degrees , then lower the temperature to 350 degrees and continue baking for an additional 25 minutes
8. Remove from over and cool on wire rack

title: veloute  used for  lobster enchiladas w white wine sauce
steps:
1. ---------basicroux-----------
2. Heat the clarified butter or oil in a pan over moderate heat
3. Add the flour all at once
4. Stirring constantly , cook over low heat until the roux is very pale ivory , about 8 minutes
5. ---------whitemirepoix--------
6. Cut the vegetables into an appropriate size , based on the cooking time of the dish
7. Add mirepoix to the recipe as directed
8. -----------sachetd'espices----------
9. Place all ingredients on a piece of cheesecloth approximately 4 inches square
10. Gather up the edges and tie with butcher's twine , leaving a long tail of string to tie to the stockpot handle
11. A standard sachet d'epices , french for"bag of spices , " as with the bouquet garni , should be removed and discarded after enough flavor has been released into the stock or other preparation
12. ----------veloute-----------
13. Thicken your stock with just enough roux for the proper texture

title: pork tenderloin with fennel seed and onions
steps:
1. In skillet , heat 1 tbsp oil over medium heat
2. Cook onions , stirring often , until tender and golden brown , about 20 minutes
3. Transfer to bowl
4. Meanwhile , cut pork into 1-inch thick medallions
5. Season with 1 / 2 tsp salt and 1 / 4 tsp pepper
6. Set aside
7. In same skillet , heat 1 tbsp oil over medium-high heat
8. Fry fennel seeds for 10 seconds
9. Add pork
10. Brown on both sides , about 4 minutes
11. Pour in wine and increase heat to high
12. Cover and cook for 3 minutes
13. Turn over pork and cook , uncovered , until wine is reduced to about 2 tbsp , 2 to 3 minutes
14. Transfer pork to warm serving plate
15. Set aside
16. Add onions and parsley to skillet and heat through , about 1 minute
17. Serve over pork
18. Makes 4 servings
19. Serving suggestion - nice with garlic spaghetti , and a tomato and lettuce leaf salad dressed with olive oil and lemon juice and sprinkled with chopped fresh mint

title: oven fried sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Cut the potatoes into thin wedges
2. Pile them in a bowl and cover them with cold water
3. Let rest 15 minutes
4. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
5. Coat a baking sheet with vegetable spray
6. Set aside
7. Drain the potatoes and dry them with paper towels
8. Press the potatoes with paper towels to remove all water
9. Transfer the potatoes to a large bowl
10. Sprinkle the potatoes with oil , tossing the potatoes to disburse it
11. Then sprinkle with pepper , salt , paprika and cayenne pepper
12. Bake the potatoes at 375 degrees f for 20 minutes
13. Turn over the potatoes
14. Sprinkle potatoes with garlic and continue cooking for another 15-20 minutes or until crisp and brown
15. Serve immediately

title: meatloaf tropicale
steps:
1. Heat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Mix all of the ingredients , except the bacon and marmalade , together
3. Spread the mixture in an ungreased loaf pan , 9 x 5 x 3-inches
4. Crisscross the bacon slices on the top of the meat mixture and spread the marmalade over the whole thing
5. Bake , uncovered for 1 to 1 1 / 4 hours
6. Drain off the excess fat and let stand for 5 to 10 minutes before slicing

title: real shepherd s pie
steps:
1. Brown meat and chopped onion together for about 5 minutes , add stock and simmer slowly , occasionally stirring until cooked , about 20 minutes
2. Mix 2-3 teaspoons of flour or cornflour to a smooth cream with water and slowly add to meat mixture over a low heat stirring continuously until thickened
3. Pour into ovenproof dish and set aside , allowing to cool , depending on the quality of the meat used you should not need to skim the fat , however , this is to personal taste
4. Peel , boil and mash potatoes with salt , pepper , freshly chopped mint if required , and a generous knob of butter
5. Cover the meat mixture with the potato and bake in a medium oven for 30-40 minutes
6. If required dish can be browned under a grill
7. Serve with fresh vegetables
8. I also like thickly sliced fresh bread and butter with my real shepherds pie

title: turkey scaloppine
steps:
1. Coat cutlets with flour
2. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
3. Heat 1 1 / 2 teaspoons olive oil in large , nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
4. Add half of cutlets
5. Cook on each side for 1 to 2 minutes or until no longer pink in center
6. Remove from skillet
7. Keep warm
8. Repeat with remaining olive oil and cutlets
9. Add water , wine , butter , garlic , sage , and bouillon to skillet
10. Bring to a boil
11. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes
12. Add cutlets to skillet
13. Reduce heat to low
14. Cook , stirring and turning cutlets over to coat , for 1 to 2 minutes

title: george foreman awesome chicken sandwich
steps:
1. Pre-heat george foreman grill
2. Wash & dry chicken breasts
3. Dip in olive both sides
4. Salt & pepper
5. Place chicken on grill and grill for 5 minute on one side then flip and grill another 5 minute
6. Take chicken off then slice each chicken in half lenghtwise and place on bun
7. Top with swiss cheese
8. Then guacamole
9. Then tomato & lettuce
10. Enjoy !

title: chopped veggie salad
steps:
1. Cut tomatoes in half
2. Hold over sink and squeeze to remove excess liquid--chop into 1 / 2 inch pieces
3. Combine tomatoes , onions , and chedder in large bowl
4. Slice hearts of palm in half lengthwise , then chop and add to bowl
5. Chop artichoke hearts and add to bowl
6. Add cranberries , raisins , and whole pistachios to bowl: toss to combine
7. Whisk balsamic vinegar and olive oil together and add to bowl and toss well
8. Just before serving , place 1 1 / 2 cups of the tomato mixture over chopped lettuce on each plate and sprinkle each salad with 1 / 2 tablespoon of chopped pistachios
9. Top with crab meat , if desired

title: english sausage upside down pie
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400
2. Form sausage meat into 6 patties
3. Simmer in frying pan with 2 tbsp water , keeping it covered
4. Remove the cover , and brown both sides of the patties
5. Put patties in casserole dish or 8x8x2 cakepan
6. Brown the onions in the sausage fat
7. Then put onions over sausage
8. Combine the tomato soup & 1 tbsp water
9. Pour the soup over the patties & onions
10. In a bowl , blend the biscuit mix and milk , creating a soft dough
11. Roll to fit the baking dish , and put over the layered sausage , onion , soup
12. Lightly brush the dough with milk
13. Bake 20 minutes or until done

title: oven fried chicken nuggets
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees
2. Line jelly roll pan with foil
3. Trim fat from chicken
4. Cut chicken into 2-inch pieces
5. Place cornflakes , flour , paprika , salt and pepper in blender
6. Cover and blend on medium speed until cornflakes are reduced to crumbs
7. Pour into a bowl
8. Place chicken and buttermilk in a plastic bag with a zipper top
9. Seal and refrigerate 5 minutes , turning once
10. Dip chicken into cornflake mixture to coat
11. Place in pan
12. Spray chicken with nonstick cooking spray
13. Bake about 30 minutes or until crisp and chicken is no longer pink in center
14. Serve with your favorite dipping sauce

title: the houstonian s southwest caesar salad
steps:
1. Prepare dressing first
2. In the bowl of a food processor , combine yolk , garlic , mustard , anchovies , pepper , salt , coriander , cumin , worcestershire and water
3. Process all until smooth
4. With motor running , pour oils in a slow , steady stream into egg mixture
5. When all oil has been incorporated , add chili paste , lemon and lime juices and parmesan
6. Process until smooth
7. Prepare salad next
8. Spin or pat lettuce dry
9. Place in large salad bowl
10. Add dressing
11. Toss lightly
12. Add beans and corn
13. Toss again
14. Divide mixture among 4 chilled plates
15. Sprinkle with pumpkin seeds and cheese
16. Garnish with tortilla chips

title: strawberry ricotta porridge
steps:
1. Heat strawberries mashed in pot with splenda , stir until heated
2. Add oats and salt and boil
3. If the contents become too dry , add some hot water and keep stirring until the oats are cooked
4. When the oats are cooked , add ricotta and stir until heated through
5. For extra protein add one egg here that has been lightly beaten
6. Serve with skim milk or soy milk and add some honey if you'd like this a little sweeter

title: vegetarian corn chowder
steps:
1. Heat butter in large , heavy-based pan
2. Add onions& cook over med-high heat for about 5 minutes , or until golden
3. Add garlic& cumin seeds , & cook for one minute , stirring constantly
4. Add stock& bring to a boil
5. Add potatoes , & reduce heat to simmer 10 minutes
6. Add all the corn , & parsley
7. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat to simmer for 10 minutes more
8. Stir in cheese , salt& pepper to taste , & heat gently , over a low heat , until cheese melts
9. Serve with snipped chives
10. You can make this recipe without the cheese , if you want less fat
11. Or if you're like me , you can use a really old nippy cheddar , for a nice nippy flavour !

title: pineapple cashew quinoa stir fry
steps:
1. Prepare the quinoa first: combine the quinoa , juice , water , and soy sauce in a medium-sized pot
2. Cover , place over high heat , and bring to a boil
3. Stir a few times , lower the heat to medium-low , cover , and cook for 12 to 14 minutes , until all the liquid has been absorbed and the quinoa appears plumped and slightly translucent
4. Uncover , fluff , and let cool
5. For best results , place the quinoa in an airtight container and refrigerate overnight
6. If you're in a hurry , chill the covered quinoa for at least an hour
7. When ready to use , break up any chunks of the cold quinoa with a fork
8. Prepare the stir-fry
9. Use the largest nonstick skillet you have or a wok
10. Have all of your ingredients chopped and easily within reach
11. Place the cashews in the dry pan and heat over low heat , stirring them , until lightly toasted , about 4 minutes
12. Remove the cashews from the pan , raise the heat to medium , and add the peanut oil , scallions , and garlic
13. When the garlic starts to sizzle , add the sliced chile pepper and ginger
14. Stir-fry for about 2 minutes , then add the red bell pepper and edamame
15. Stir-fry for about 3 minutes , until the bell pepper is softened and edamame is bright green
16. Add the basil and mint , and stir for another minute before adding the pineapple and quinoa
17. In a measuring cup , combine the soy sauce , vegetable stock , and mirin
18. Pour over the quinoa mixture
19. Stir to incorporate completely and coat the quinoa
20. Continue to stir-fry for 10 to 14 minutes , until the quinoa is very hot
21. Serve with lime wedges and additional soy sauce , to season individual servings to taste

title: grilled baby new potato salad with french green beans and mint
steps:
1. In large saucepan bring salted water to a boil
2. Add potatoes and cook until just soft , about 3-5 minutes
3. Drain in colander and let dry on paper towels
4. While potatoes are boiling bring a small pot of water to a boil
5. Cook beans until just done but still crisp , about 4-5 minutes
6. Drain immediately and rinse in cold water
7. Set aside
8. Light an outdoor grill or a stovetop grill pan
9. Cut cooked potatoes in half or , if tiny , leave whole
10. Spray cut side with olive oil and grill cut side down until marks appear
11. Meanwhile , prepare dressing by mixing garlic , mustard , vinegar , parsley and mint in a small bowl
12. Slowly whisk in olive oil
13. When potatoes are grilled but still hot , toss in dressing and season to taste with salt and pepper
14. Add green beans and olives and tomatoes , if desired , and mix well
15. Serve at room temperature

title: pineapple tarts
steps:
1. For filling: drain crushed pineapple in a colander , pressing to render as much of the juice as possible
2. Place pineapple in a large pot with granulated sugar and cinnamon sticks and stir over medium-low heat about 1 hour , until sugar begins crystallizing against the sides of the pan
3. Remove cinnamon sticks and let pineapple filling cool
4. For pastry: using a mixer , beat together cream cheese , butter and confectioners' sugar at medium-high speed
5. Add 2 eggs , baking soda and vanilla and beat until incorporated
6. Reduce speed to low , add flour and salt until mixed well and dough begins to form ball
7. Refrigerate dough for 30 to 60 minutes before assembling tarts
8. Preheat oven to 350f
9. Lightly spray 2 mini-muffin tins with cooking spray
10. Mix yolk and water together to make a wash
11. Press 1-inch ball round of dough into mini-muffin tin and fill with pineapple
12. Take remaining dough and roll thin , cutting narrow strips , less than 1 / 8 inch wide
13. Use strips to create a double lattice top over each tart
14. Brush with egg wash and bake 25 minutes

title: peel and eat shrimp with spicy creole sauce
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine paprika , salt , pepper , garlic powder , oregano , onion powder , cayenne and thyme
2. Mix to combine
3. Add in the unpeeled , uncooked shrimp and toss to coat
4. In a large skillet melt 4 tablespoons butter over medium heat
5. Add in worcestershire sauce , lemon juice and garlic
6. Saute until garlic is tender
7. Add in the seasoned shrimp and saute until opaque in the center
8. Add in remaining 4 tablespoon butter and stir until melted
9. Transfer the shrimp to a large bowl
10. Pour sauce from skillet over the shrimp and serve

title: grilled salmon with citrus dill marinade
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together and put into large ziploc bag
2. Add salmon and toss well to coat
3. Marinate about 30 minutes
4. Grill salmon over med
5. Heat about 7-8 minute per done or until salmon flakes with fork

title: steak and shake special sauce
steps:
1. Mix catsup and worcestershire sauce together in a bowl
2. Refrigerate
3. Serve on top on of cooked spaghetti topped with recipe #27171 , shredded cheese , chopped onion
4. Use about 2 tablespoons per serving

title: very berry licious smoothies
steps:
1. In a blender combine half the ingredients , cover and process until blended
2. Pour into chilled glasses
3. Repeat with remaining ingredients
4. Serve immediately

title: master brine recipe for meats
steps:
1. Bring all ingredients to a boil in a large saucepan , reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes
2. Allow to cool completely before using
3. Large heavy duty sealable plastic bags work the best

title: raspberry turnover cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Sift the dry ingredients together
3. Using a pastry blender , cut the margarine and cream cheese into the dry ingredients
4. Sprinkle the milk onto this mixture , mix and gather into a ball
5. On a lightly a floured surface , roll to 1 / 8" thickness
6. Use a 2" or 3" cutter to make 16-18 rounds
7. Spoon 1 to 1 1 / 2 teaspoons jelly onto the center of each round
8. Fold the cookie over and bake on an ungreased cookie sheet for 12-14 minutes

title: baked tomatoes sicilian style
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Lightly grease a shallow baking dish just large enough to hold the tomatoes
3. Turn the seeded tomato halves upside down on several layers of paper towels and drain for about 10 minutes
4. Arrange the drained tomato halves , cut side up , in the prepared dish
5. In a small bowl , mix together the bread crumbs , oregano , and pepper
6. Fill the tomato halves with the bread crumb mixture
7. Season with coarse salt
8. Drizzle each half with 1 tsp of the oil
9. Bake , uncovered , for 1 1 / 2 hours , or until the tops are nicely browned and caramelized
10. Let cool slightly before serving , or serve at room temperature
11. For best results , do not refrigerate

title: brown rice florentine
steps:
1. Heat butter in saucepan over medium-high heat until just beginning to sizzle
2. Add onion , and saute until softened
3. Add rice and cook over low heat , stirring constantly , until rice is lightly browned in places and beginning to get translucent
4. Remove from heat , and gradually stir in chicken stock or water
5. Season to taste with salt and pepper , return to heat , and bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat to low , cover , and simmer for about 40 minutes
7. Add spinach , stir thoroughly and continue cooking for another 10 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed
8. Serve hot

title: grilled pacific rim pork tenderloin
steps:
1. In a 1-cup glass measuring cup , combine soy sauce , sherry , garlic and ginger
2. Root
3. Place tenderloins in a resealable plastic bag
4. Pour soy sauce mixture into
5. Bag
6. Seal bag securely
7. Refrigerate at least 30 minutes or up to 4 hours ,
8. Turning bag occasionally
9. Drain marinade into small saucepan
10. Sprinkle five spice powder on tenderloins
11. Grill tenderloins , covered over medium
12. Coals , turning occasionally , 15 to 20 minutes or until instant read thermometer
13. Inserted in center of meat registers 160 degrees
14. Tenderloins will be barely
15. Pink in center
16. While tenderloins are cooking , add hoisin sauce to marinade in
17. Saucepan
18. Bring to a boil
19. Simmer uncovered until thickened , about 3 minutes
20. Brush mixture evenly over tenderloins during last 5 minutes of grilling , turning once
21. Carve tenderloins crosswise into 1 / 4-inch thick slices

title: easy  deliciously cheesy sauteed corn  mexican style
steps:
1. Dump the first 5 ingredients in a medium saucepan , stir well , and saute on a high flame for about 5 minutes or until most of the liquid has been absorbed or evaporated
2. Now reduce the flame to low and add the cheese spread , and swirl it around with the sauteed corn with a wooden spoon until melted and well mixed
3. Serve hot , on bread , or over mashed potatoes , or with just about anything else !
4. It's so yummy , you eat it straight

title: persian tahdeeg  rice and potatoes
steps:
1. For best results , soak the rice for a few hours in hot water and some salt before cooking
2. Peel the potatoes and slice them in a round shape
3. You could use the potatoes unpeeled as well since they add lots of fiber to your diet
4. In a medium size pot , half-way filled with water , bring the water to a boil
5. Add the rice , and let it cook for a few minutes until it starts boiling
6. Occasionally pick a few of the rice grains with a spoon and chew on them to see if they have softened
7. When the rice is half-crunchy half-soft , take it out and drain it in a kitchen strainer
8. Run tap water on top of it to wash out some of the salt
9. Pour the oil in the pot , add 4 oz of water
10. Lay the potatoes in the bottom of the pot , add a bit of salt , then pile up the rice loosely in the shape of a mountain , on top of the potatoes
11. With the back of a spoon , make five holes , one in the center and four around it so that the rice can breath in the cooking process
12. Spread a little water on top and close the lid
13. Let it cook for a couple of minutes on high heat
14. When the rice starts to steam , change the setting to medium heat and let it cook for about 15 minutes
15. Then turn the heat to medium-low , sprinkle some cooking oil to stop it from drying , and let it cook for another 10 minutes
16. Most likely by this time the smell of the potatoes has filled the kitchen , and the dish is ready to eat

title: simple mocha frappe
steps:
1. Then freeze in ice cube tray
2. Blend coffee cubes and milk in blender until large chunks are gone
3. Add ice cream and blend til combined and still fairly thick
4. Enjoy !

title: ricebubble crunch
steps:
1. Melt butter , sugar and honey in a large saucepan
2. Boil fast for 4 minutes , it will turn a golden colour
3. Mix in the puffed rice , then press into a 8inch square tin lined with foil
4. Cut into squares while still warm , then allow to cool
5. Make your own imaginative additions , like chopped nuts etc
6. Kids love these for a snack or in their lunchbox

title: tamale cheese dinner
steps:
1. Unwrap tamales and break into pieces
2. Lay in skillet
3. Top tamales with corn and top with grated cheddar cheese
4. Cover skillet with a lid and cook on low heat about 5 min or until hot and cheese is melted
5. Enjoy !
6. Update: i've adjusted the amount of grated cheese
7. You can actually use any amount you prefer

title: south beach meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350
2. Combine the tomato paste , wine , water , garlic , basil , oregano , and salt in a small saucepan
3. Bring to a boil , then reduce the heat to low
4. Simmer , uncovered for 15 minute set aside
5. Combine the turkey , oatmeal , egg substitute , zucchini , and 1 / 2 cup of the tomato mixture ina large bowl
6. Mix well
7. Shape into a loaf and place into an ungreased 8"x4" loaf pan
8. Bake for 45 minute discard any drippings
9. Pour 1 / 2 cup of the remaining tomato mixture on top of the loaf
10. Bake for an additional 15 minute
11. Place on a serving platter
12. Cool for 10 min before slicing
13. Serve the remaining tomato sauce on the side

title: eggplant  aubergine   spinach curry
steps:
1. Put eggplant cubes in colander over large bowl , sprinkle with kosher salt , and let stand for 30 minutes to sweat
2. Pat dry and remove excess salt with paper towels or clean dishcloth
3. Toast mustard seeds in a small dry non-stick pan over medium-low heat until they turn grey and begin to pop
4. Remove from heat and reserve in a small bowl
5. Place eggplant in a mid-sized steamer and cook for about 10 minutes , until eggplant is soft and tender but not mushy
6. Remove from heat and reserve
7. Heat canola oil in large pot over medium heat
8. Add onion and saut until golden
9. Stir in garlic , ginger , and all other spices , being careful to avoid scorching
10. After 1 minute , add spinach and tomatoes
11. Raise heat to high and boil for 2 minutes , stirring often
12. Turn heat down to low and simmer with lid on for 20 minutes to allow flavours to blend
13. Stir in reserved mustard seeds and eggplant
14. Once eggplant is hot , stir in yogurt and chopped cilantro
15. Remove from heat
16. Serve alone on a bed of rice , or with a beef curry and naan bread

title: homemade egg noodles by geraldine
steps:
1. Beat egg , water and salt together
2. Add baking powder and 1 / 4 cup flour
3. Add more flour and turn on floured board
4. Knead a few times until smooth
5. Keep board and rolling pin well floured and roll dough thin
6. Let dough dry out then roll dough into a jelly roll & with a sharp knife cut dough into 1 / 8-1 / 4" slices
7. Carefully unroll dough and allow noodles to finish drying
8. Cook in 1 quart or more of boiling chicken or beef broth , cook 25 minutes or until tender
9. Noodles can be frozen for future use

title: melanie s moussaka
steps:
1. Slice the eggplant in 1 / 3 inch slices
2. Do not peel , do not salt
3. Just sliceyou have enough to do in a day
4. I use the japanese eggplant because the slices are smaller and easier to layer in the baking pan
5. Line a large cookie sheet with foil and spray with non-stick spray
6. Lay the eggplant slices on the sheet in a single layer and spray them with non-stick spray
7. Sprinkle 2-3 t grated parmesan over them , some salt and pepper , and roast at 350 until fork-tender , while you make the sauce
8. Chop the onion and garlic and saute the onions , garlic , mushrooms and ground beef together
9. Add the tomato paste and ground tomatoes , wine , rosemary , cinnamon , and lemon pepper and simmer until meat is cooked and flavors melded
10. In a large baking dish sprayed with non-stick spray and layer a little sauce , the eggplant , sauce , etc
11. And end with a layer of sauce
12. Over this pour the following mixture: the larger amount of parmesan , mozarella , eggs and yogurt , plus a little garlic salt
13. Pour the sauce over the eggplant / meat mixture and cover pan with foil
14. Bake 350 for 30 minutes , then uncover and bake until the moussaka is hot and bubbly
15. Time will vary according to how deep your baking pan is

title: alcudia
steps:
1. Shake with ice cubes , strain into a martini glass
2. Garnish with the twist

title: shrimp papaya   avocado salad
steps:
1. Whisk together dressing ingredients in a small bowl , chil until ready to serve
2. On individual salad plates , place salad greens , cooled shrimp , avocado & papaya on top ,
3. Sprinkle with chopped onions , salt and pepper and drizzle dressing over top

title: mock chicken marbella
steps:
1. Add olives and capers to the container of a food processor
2. Process until fairly smooth
3. Set aside
4. Position oven rack so that it is in the center of the oven
5. Preheat to 400
6. Add balsamic vinaigrette , olive / caper mixture , garlic , oregano , bay leaves , and prunes in a mixing bowl
7. Stir well to combine
8. Add in chicken tenders
9. Fold in
10. Transfer mixture to a 13x9 inch glass or ceramic casserole dish
11. Make sure chicken tenders are in one layer and not on top of one another
12. Sprinkle the brown sugar evenly over the chicken
13. Pour the wine around the tenders bake for 25-30 minutes or until the chicken has carmelized on top and juices run clear
14. Discard bay leaves
15. Good served warm with rice or couscous
16. Also good served cold

title: rosy sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Combine all the ingredients in a large bowl
2. Pour into slow cooker or casserole dish sprayed with non-fat cooking spray
3. Cover , and cook on low 3-4 hours , or in oven until done

title: cold asian brown rice salad
steps:
1. Cook the brown rice according to package
2. Or try it the way my friend says she makes it- boil it like pasta in a couple quarts of water and drain ! i haven't tried this yet- let me know how it works
3. Meanwhile , prepare dressing and veggies
4. Toss rice with dressing and cool in fridge
5. Once cooled , add veggies and toss
6. If not serving right away , reserve peanuts until just before serving so they will not get soggy
7. Serve cold

title: tuna garbanzo salad
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. Bring 2 quarts water and salt to a boil
3. Add green beans
4. Cook 4 minutes or until beans are crisp-tender
5. Drain and rinse with cold water
6. Drain
7. Combine green beans , shallots , peppers , chickpeas , and garlic in a large bowl
8. Combine mayonnaise , vinegar , and paprika in a small bowl , stirring well
9. Add mayonnaise mixture to bean mixture
10. Toss gently to combine
11. Arrange 1 cup arugula on each of 4 plates
12. Top each serving with about 1 cup bean mixture
13. Divide tuna evenly among plates
14. Sprinkle cheese evenly over bread slices
15. Place bread on a baking sheet
16. Broil 2 minutes or until lightly toasted
17. Serve toasts with salad

title: kossuth kifli  hungarian cakey cookie aka half moons
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Butter and flour bottom and sides of a 9-by 13-inch cake pan
3. In a large bowl , using an electric mixer on medium speed , cream together butter and granulated sugar
4. Add egg yolks , one at a time , and beat until fluffy
5. Add vanilla , lemon rind and lemon juice and beat to combine
6. Gradually add in baking powder and flour
7. In a medium bowl using electric mixer on high speed , beat egg whites until stiff
8. Fold egg whites into batter
9. Gently spread batter into prepared pan
10. Evenly sprinkle top with finely chopped walnuts and bake 25 to 30 minutes
11. Remove to a wire rack
12. Cool until cake shrinks away from sides of pan
13. With a small round biscuit cutter , periodically dipped in powdered sugar , cut one circle , then cut another circle halfway down the first one , making two crescents and one oval scrap
14. Remove from pan and repeat
15. Cool crescents completely and dust with powdered sugar
16. Store in a tightly covered container for up to 2 days

title: traditional wheat bread
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , combine 2 cups bread flour , 1 cup whole wheat flour , yeast and salt
2. In a saucepan , heat the milk , water , honey and butter to 120-130 degrees
3. Stir into dry ingredients just until moistened
4. Beat in egg until smooth
5. Stir in the remaining whole wheat flour and enough remaining bread flour to form a stiff dough
6. Turn onto a surface lightly dusted with all-purpose flour
7. Knead until smooth and elastic , about 8-10 minutes
8. Place in a greased bowl , turning once to grease top
9. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled , about 1 hour
10. Punch dough down
11. Let rest for 10 minutes
12. Divide into thirds
13. Shape into loaves
14. Place in three greased 9-in
15. X 5-in
16. X 3-in
17. Loaf pans
18. Cover and let rise until doubled , about 45 minutes
19. Bake at 350 degrees for 35-40 minutes or until golden brown
20. Cover loosely with foil if tops brown too quickly
21. Remove from pans to wire racks to cool

title: vietnamese ginger chicken  ga kho
steps:
1. Heat a heavy saucepan on medium high for about a minute until pan is hot , add sugar and turn heat down to medium
2. Caramelize sugar for about 1 minute
3. Keep a close watch to make sure sugar is brown , but not burnt
4. Add ginger and stir for about 10 seconds
5. Add remaining ingredients except scallions
6. Turn the pieces and brown the chicken for about 2 minutes
7. Reduce heat to a simmer
8. Cook until liquid in the pan is reduced to half
9. Sauce should be brown and thick
10. About 10 minutes if you're using boned in whole thighs
11. If you're using boneless , skinless chicken the cooking time is reduced to about 6 minutes
12. Over cooking will make the meat tough
13. Garnish with scallion and serve with steamed rice

title: hungarian potato paprikas
steps:
1. Saute the onion in the oil in a heavy bottomed pot
2. Salt it so the layers separate
3. When onion is translucent , lower the heat and push onions to the side
4. Add the paprika , and saute in oil for 2 minutes , stirring vigorously
5. Don't let the paprika burn !
6. Mix in the onion , add the potatoes and cook for 10 minutes on medium high , stirring frequently
7. Mix the water and flour , add to the pot and stir
8. Add pepper and parsley , taste and add salt as necessary
9. Cover , stirring occasionally , cook on medium high for 20 minutes
10. Add cabbage and carrot , cook on medium low for 10 minutes
11. Serve over broad egg noodles with a dollop of sour cream to garnish

title: mini pizza appetizer
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f
2. Place crust on large pizza pan or baking sheet
3. Spread olive oil evenly over pizza crust , add the grated fontina cheese
4. Arrange leeks or onions atop the cheese
5. Add the chopped tomatoes and thyme
6. Season with salt to taste and add the pepper
7. Bake pizza until crust is golden and cheese melts , about 15 minutes
8. Remove from the oven and cool in pan for 5 minutes
9. Cut into triangles or squares or diamonds or wedges and serve

title: white bean soup with ham
steps:
1. Put smoked ham hock , beans , and liquid together in large saucepan
2. Turn heat on to medium high
3. Add onions
4. Bring mixture to a boil
5. Turn heat down to medium low and cover with tilted lid to only cover partially
6. Cook , stirring occasionally until beans are very soft and meat is falling apart at least one hour
7. Turn off heat
8. Remove meat and chop it up if desired and return to pot
9. Serve with cornbread
10. Yummy !

title: spicy apricot baby food cake
steps:
1. Beat sugar and oil
2. Add eggs one at a time
3. Add baby food , one jar at a time
4. Add flour - half of it with spices , then beat in remainder
5. Bake at 350 1 hour in greased , floured tube or bundt pan
6. Cool right side up awhile before turning over
7. Sprinkle with sifted confectioners' sugar
8. Stays moist days and days and days - if you hide it

title: cranberry sweet potatoes
steps:
1. In crockpot dish , mix orange juice , butter , oil , brown sugar , cinnamon and salt
2. Cover and cook on high while preparing potatoes
3. Stir potatoes , and dried cranberries into warm mixture , cover and cook on high for 3 - 4 hours
4. Shortcut
5. Reduce cooking temperature to medium

title: easy chicken mushroom and rice casserole
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Butter a 13 x 9-inch baking dish
3. In a large bowl stir all ingredients together mix well to combine , then season with salt and black pepper and a pinch of cayenne pepper
4. Transfer to the prepared baking dish
5. Sprinkle with about 1 / 3 cup parmesan cheese then cornflake crumbs
6. Bake for about 25-30 minutes or until hot and bubbly

title: vanilla chai coffee cooler
steps:
1. Place coffee , sweetener , vanilla , cinnamon and allspice in pitcher
2. Add water
3. Stir until coffee granules are completely dissolved
4. Stir in milk and ice cubes
5. Pour evenly into 4 tall glasses
6. Serve immediately

title: currant   lemon cake
steps:
1. Place currants , lemon juice , and butter in a pan and heat to melt butter
2. Cool slightly
3. Beat in eggs with a wooden spoon
4. Add sugar , rind , flour and milk
5. Mix well
6. Bake in a lined roasting dish at 160 c for about 1 hour

title: quick pierogies casserole
steps:
1. About 45 minutes before serving prepare pierogies as label directs
2. If boiled drain
3. Dice tomatoes , thinly slice onions and mushrooms
4. In a 12 inch skillet over med heat saut onion mushrooms and garlic in oil until soft and golden
5. Add tomatoes parsley salt and pepper and 1 / 2 cup water
6. Heat to boiling
7. Cook 5 minutes
8. Preheat oven to 350f
9. In a 2-quart casserole arrange pierogies and onion mixture
10. Cover and bake 30 minutes or until heated through
11. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese if desired

title: whole wheat popovers
steps:
1. Heat oven to 450 degree f
2. Generously grease 12 muffin cups
3. Place in oven to heat 2 minutes
4. Meanwhile , combine eggs , milk , flours , melted butter , and salt in blender container
5. Blend just until smooth , scraping side of container as needed
6. Pour into hot muffin cups
7. Bake 25 minutes
8. Remove from pan and serve immediately

title: unbaked chocolate chip oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Put first 4 ingredients into a 2 quart saucepan and bring to a full , rolling boil
2. Remove from heat and add vanilla and peanut butter
3. Add oatmeal and stir well
4. Drop teaspoonfuls onto a well greased cookie sheet
5. Chill for 1 hour

title: oaty banana mini muffins  oamc
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f line a mini muffin tray with 24 cases
2. Place the flour , oats and baking powder into a bowl
3. In a separate bowl , beat the eggs , sugar and oil together until pale and fluffy
4. Fold into the dry ingredients with the bananas
5. Spoon into the muffin cases and sprinkle with the remaining oats
6. Bake for 15 minutes until risen and golden
7. Cool and serve

title: purple hull peas   heart healthy
steps:
1. Well rinse the purple hull peas -i put mine in a colander in a bowl and fill with cold water and rinse several times until i can see when the water is clear
2. Fill a three quart sauce pan half way with water - about 6 cups
3. Place on high heat
4. Add salt , olive oil , and sugar
5. Bring to a rolling boil
6. Add peas
7. Bring the water back to a rolling boil
8. Then turn the heat down med-low
9. Wait until they simmer
10. Then cover and simmer for 90 minutes

title: wicklewood wench s pregnant pasta
steps:
1. Cook the pasta according to manufacturer's instructions , drain and set aside
2. Cook the broccoli in boiling salted water for 15 mins , drain and set aside
3. Meanwhile , in a large pan , gently melt the butter and remove from heat
4. Add the flour and blend together until a smooth paste is formed
5. Return to the heat , gradually adding the milk and beat into a smooth consistency
6. Stir in the cheese and prepared mustard
7. Season to taste
8. Add the cooked pasta , broccoli and all other ingredients to the cheese sauce , coat well
9. Adjust seasoning to taste
10. Garnish with remaining spring onion and serve with some focaccia bread or a crusty roll

title: ted s famous chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. In a large frying pan , melt butter over medium heat
3. Add mushrooms and cook until tender , 3 to 5 minutes
4. Add white wine and lemon juice
5. Cook until liquid evaporates in a large mixing bowl , combine chicken , mushrooms
6. Soup and sour cream
7. Add spaghetti and mix well
8. Season with salt and white pepper to taste
9. Arrange in a 9x13 inch baking dish
10. Top with parmesan cheese
11. Bake 30 minutes , until hot and bubbly

title: apple pie with no apples
steps:
1. In a saucepan mix water , sugar and cream of tartar
2. Cook over medium heat until sugar dissolves
3. Add ritz crackers
4. Bring to a hard boil for 2 minutes
5. Do not stir
6. Remove from heat and pour into pie crust
7. Sprinkle with nutmeg and cinnamon and place butter pats on top
8. Put pie crust strips on top to form a lattice
9. Bake at 450 degrees for 10 minutes , then at 350 degrees for 20 minutes

title: clams and pasta in white wine sauce
steps:
1. In a large deep heavy skillet , melt butter over med-high heat
2. Stir fry pancetta until it turns golden , about 5 minutes
3. Remove from pan , drain off all fat except 1 tablespoon
4. Add garlic 2 tablespoons of the parsley and hot pepper flakes , stir fry for 1 minute
5. Pour in clam juice and wine , bring to a boil , add clams , cover and steam until open , about 5 minutes , discard any that do not open
6. Meanwhile in a large pot of boiling salted water , cook linguine until tender but firm
7. Drain and add to pan along with pancetta , toss to coat well
8. Sprinkle with remaining parsley and serve

title: raspberry crisp
steps:
1. Crush 1 cup berries
2. Add enough water to measure 1 cup
3. In saucepan , mix sugar and cornstarch
4. Stir in raspberry mixture
5. Bring to a boil
6. Cook and stir for 2 minutes
7. Remove from heat , stir in remaining berries
8. Cool
9. In bowl , combine oats , flour , brown sugar and baking soda
10. Cut in butter to make crumbs
11. Press half into a greased 9x9 baking dish
12. Spread with berries
13. Sprinkle with remaining crumbs
14. Bake at 350 for 25 minutes

title: sour cream cheesecake fit for the gods
steps:
1. Mix ingredients for crust and press on bottom and sides of greased springform pan
2. Bake for 10 minutes at 350 degrees and cool on wire rack
3. In blender , combine first five ingredients for filling until smooth
4. Add eggs and egg white , and process until smooth
5. Add sugar a little bit at a time combine just until blended
6. Pour filling into prepared crust and bake at 350 degrees for 50 minutes
7. Remove to wire rack and let sit for ten minutes
8. Increase oven temperature to 450 degrees during this time
9. Whisk together topping ingredients and spread over cake
10. Bake for 5 minutes at 450 degrees
11. Remove cake to wire rack , cool completely , cover and refrigerate for 8 hours

title: briscoe s irish brown bread  bread machine
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in bread pan , select light crust setting , and press start
2. After the baking cycle ends , remove bread from pan , place on cake rack , and allow to cool 1 hour before slicing

title: braised whiskey onions
steps:
1. Combine oil and butter in a heavy saucepan
2. Heat together over high heat until butter is melted
3. Add onions and cook for about 2 minutes
4. Add salt , pepper , and broth
5. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer about 10 minutes
6. Add bourbon and cook until the sauce is slightly reduced

title: camper s special casserole
steps:
1. Brown ground meat in a skillet w / onion
2. Drain fat
3. Stir in ketchup , beans& mustard
4. Cook until hot& bubbly
5. Stir in the potatoes& heat thoroughly
6. Add salt& pepper

title: green eyed monster burgers
steps:
1. Mix pickle juice and onion soup mix
2. Add ground beef and mix thoroughly
3. Divide into 12 thin patties
4. Arrange 5 to 7 dill pickle chips in the center of six patties
5. Cover with remaining patties and seal edges well
6. Pan fry in non-stick fry pan or broil 5 to 6 minutes on each side

title: marbled chocolate tea bread
steps:
1. Grease an 8 by 4 loaf tin and line the base and sides with greaseproof paper
2. Cream the butter and sugar together until pale and fluffy , then gradually add the eggs , beating well after each addition
3. Fold in the flour
4. Transfer half the mixture to another bowl and beat in the orange zest , juice and orange extract , if using
5. Break the chocolate into pieces , put into a small bowl and place over a pan of simmering water
6. Stir until the chocolate melts
7. Stir into the remaining cake mixture with the cocoa powder
8. Put alternate spoonfuls of the two mixtures into the prepared tin , and use a knife to swirl through the mixture to make a marbled effect , then level the surface
9. Bake at 350f for about 1- 1 hours , until well risen and firm to the touch
10. Turn out onto a wire rack to cool
11. Serve cut into slices

title: spelt bread  bread machine
steps:
1. Place ingredients in pan of bread machine in order recommended by manufacturer
2. I used the cycle for white bread , quick or rapid , & light crust
3. My bread machine is a breadman , so i used rapid cycle

title: chicken breasts with vinegar sauce  guyana    caribbean
steps:
1. Season chicken breasts with salt & pepper , to taste
2. Heat a large skillet over medium heat then add oil & butter
3. Add chicken & brown on one side , about 8 minutes , then turn over , reduce the heat & cook , covered , at least 10 minutes
4. Then remove breasts to a serving platter , & keep warm
5. To the skillet add the chopped onion & cook until transluscent , about 5 minutes , then add the wine vinegar & turn heat to medium-low
6. In a small container mix cornstarch with the tablespoon of water & mix thoroughly before adding it to the skillet , stirring to combine
7. Continue cooking & stirring until slightly thickened , then pour the onion mixture over the chicken breasts & serve

title: mom s easy crock pot scalloped potatos
steps:
1. Thinly slice the potatoes into chips
2. Combine butter , flour , salt and pepper together in saucepan over medium low heat
3. Whisk in milk gradually until no lumps remain
4. Heat and stir until bubbly and thickened
5. Stir in cheese to melt
6. Put sliced potatoes in crock pot
7. Pour cheese sauce over
8. Cover and cook on low 5 to 7 hours
9. Depending on how tender you want your potatoes

title: the best enchiladas
steps:
1. In a large saucepan lightly brown the ground beef with the minced onion and garlic add in salt , pepper , ground cumin , and some jalapeo juice
2. When meat is light brown , drain fat from beef
3. Put meat back on stove and add both cans of diced tomato with green chilies and cilantro simmer until tomatoes are soft
4. At this point you may add some diced jalapeos , or just add more jalapeo juice add tomato sauce and enchilada sauce
5. Simmer on med-low heat with saucepan covered
6. While meat is simmering , you can start to cook the tortillas
7. Heat up canola oil in a pan on med-high heat
8. Add one tortilla at a time , sprinkling both sides with chili powder
9. Cook until outer ring is harder and the middle part of the tortilla is a bit softer continue until all 30 tortillas are cooked
10. You may want to wipe off the oil after you remove them from the stove
11. Also , if the heat is too high , the chili powder may turn black , but this will not really affect it's taste , so don't worry , just turn down the heat a lil' !
12. By the time all the tortillas are done , the meat should be perfect !
13. In a large square pan scoop a bit of the meat sauce and spread all over lay a tortilla down and fill with meat and cheese carefully roll up tortilla and place against the side of the pan
14. Start at the end of the pan and work your way across
15. After you can no longer fit any more rolled up tortillas in the pan , use the remainder of the meat sauce and cheese for the topping heat up oven to 400f
16. Place in oven for about 20-30 mins or until cheese is melted and light brown and the tortilla edges that stick up from the sauce are a bit hard turn off your oven
17. For those that like onions on top of your enchiladas , you may add them at this time and place pan back into the oven if you have any meat sauce left , you may enjoy it over some home made mexican rice !
18. Tabasco sauce , salsa , and / or sour cream is perfect for the topping
19. Enjoy with some saltines !

title: meatballs libanaise
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large mixing bowl combine all ingredients and refrigerate until chilled
3. Shape into 18 meatballs and arrange on a parchment lined
4. Bake for about 15-20 minutes or until browned and no longer pink inside
5. Serve with your favorite yogurt dip

title: banoffee smoothie
steps:
1. Place all in blender
2. Mix for 10 seconds then smooth for 20 seconds or if you don't have a fancy blender , just blend until smooth
3. Serve imediately

title: traditional tourtiere
steps:
1. The night before , combine the first 13 ingredients in a large bowl
2. Cover and let rest overnight in the refrigerator
3. The next day , prepare potatoes and then prepare pastry
4. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f
5. Use 2 / 3 of pastry to line the bottom of a 4 to 4-1 / 2 quart coverable pot
6. Add potatoes to the meat mixture
7. Pour mixture into pastry lined pot
8. Add boiling water
9. Roll remaining 1 / 3 pastry and cover mixture
10. Make slits to allow steam to escape
11. Bake , uncovered , until top is golden brown , about 20-25 minutes
12. Cover , reduce oven to 300 degree f , and continue baking for another 5 hours , until meats are tender
13. Uncover and let rest about 5 minutes
14. Serve hot

title: no melt sundae pie
steps:
1. Mix crumbs and butter
2. Press onto bottom and up side of 9-inch pie plate
3. Reserve 1 / 2 cup whipped topping
4. Refrigerate
5. Pour milk into large bowl
6. Add dry pudding mix
7. Beat with wire whisk 2 minutes or until well blended
8. Gently stir in remaining whipped topping
9. Spoon into crust
10. Mix melted chocolate and condensed milk until well blended
11. Spoon over pie
12. Cut through chocolate mixture several times with knife for marble effect
13. Freeze 6 hours or until firm
14. Remove pie from freezer 15 minutes before serving
15. Top with reserve whipped topping
16. Garnish with maraschino cherry , if desired

title: split pea and rice soup
steps:
1. Rinse the peas
2. Put them in a soup pot with 3 cups of water and bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat , cover , and simmer for 45-60 minutes
4. Meanwhile , saute the onions and garlic in olive oil until onions are translucent
5. Mix in the spices and saute for 5-10 minutes , stirring frequently to prevent burning
6. Set aside
7. When peas are cooked , stir in the onion mixture along with the stock
8. Add the lemon juice and cooked rice and season with salt and pepper
9. Stir in the parsley and gently reheat

title: feta   oregano quinoa salad
steps:
1. Rinse and strain the quinoa to remove the bitter coating
2. Most quinoa today are pre-rinsed , so check the package , but even so , i prefer to give it one more rinse
3. Bring the quinoa and water to a boil in a medium saucepan
4. Cover , reduce to a simmer , and cook for 10 minutes
5. Turn the heat off and leave the covered saucepan on the burner for another 4 minutes
6. Remove the lid and fluff the cooked quinoa with a fork
7. Set aside to cool
8. Whisk the vinegar , olive oil , mustard , oregano , garlic , salt , and pepper together in a small bowl
9. Combine the salad ingredients in a large bowl
10. Pour the dressing over the vegetables and thoroughly mix
11. Add the quinoa , and mix until evenly combined
12. Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 3 days

title: pasta with gorgonzola and sweet onion
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil
2. Add pasta , and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente
3. Drain
4. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat
5. Saute onions until golden brown , about 10 minutes
6. Stir in garlic , and cook for 2 minutes
7. Remove from heat , and stir in balsamic vinegar
8. In a large bowl , combine pasta , onion mixture , and gorgonzola
9. Toss until evenly coated , and cheese is melted

title: irish steel cut oatmeal
steps:
1. Pour the cinnamon and oats into boiling water until and stir until it begins to thicken
2. Lower the heat until it begins to simmer and cook for 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
3. It's important not to overcook the oats so that you get a nice nutty flavour
4. Add the remaining ingredients and enjoy !

title: chocolate pistachio cherries
steps:
1. Line a baking tray with non-stick baking paper
2. Chop chocolate to bite size pieces
3. Place in to a heat-proof bowl over a saucepan of simmering water
4. Stir until melted
5. Or
6. In a microwave safe bowl , microwave on medium for 1 minute bursts , stirring every minute until melted
