7. Place finely chopped nuts in a bowl
8. Holding the cherries by their stalk , dip into the chocolate and then into the pistachios
9. Place onto the prepared trays
10. Allow to set at room temperature
11. Serve

title: christina s chicken
steps:
1. Marinate chicken in wine , salt , pepper and garlic overnight
2. Fry chicken in frying pan until cooked
3. Pat off excess grease and place breasts on a cookie sheet
4. Place two slices of bacon on each breast and then top with two slices of cheese on each
5. Place finished breasts in oven at 350 until cheese melts
6. Yumm !

title: beef short ribs in cinnamon   red wine sauce
steps:
1. In a large , heavy saucepan with fitted lid , melt the ghee on medium to high heat
2. Add the cooking oil and the cumin seeds
3. Let the seeds sizzle for 30 seconds
4. Smell the cinnamon bark before adding to the pot
5. If it's very strong , break the bark in and only use half
6. If it's not strong enough , add bark
7. Add the onions& saut until the onions are medium brown in colour
8. Smell for the cinnamon throughout the cooking process
9. You should smell a mild cinnamon flavour instead of a strong one
10. If cinnamon is the only spice you smell , take out the bark and continue cooking the curry
11. Add the garlic and continue to saut until garlic is golden brown and onions are a darker brown
12. The darker you saut the onions without letting them burn , the richer the onion flavour will be in this dish
13. Temporarily lower the heat and add the tomatoes and all of the remaining spices
14. Once you stir the powdered spices in the tomatoes , increase the heat back to medium
15. Stir regularly and continue cooking the spices until the oil / ghee separates from the tomatoes
16. This will take about 10 to 15 minutes
17. If at any time the onions or tomato spice mixture begins to stick to the bottom of the pan or looks like its about to burn , either lower the heat or add 1 tablespoon of oil or ghee
18. Do not add water
19. This is meant to be a rich curry
20. Stir in the stock and red wine and bring to a boil
21. Reduce heat to low
22. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until the oil / ghee separates from the stock and rises to the top , stirring occasionally
23. Add the short ribs and stir well
24. Bring back to a boil
25. Reduce heat to low
26. Cover and simmer the short ribs until the meat completely separates from the bone
27. This will take approximately 4 hours and you will need to stir occasionally

title: golden vanilla pound cake   king arthur flour
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f lightly grease a 9" x 5" x 2 3 / 4" loaf pan , or a 12" x 4" x 4" tea loaf pan
2. To avoid overflow , be sure to use the correct size pan !
3. In a medium-sized mixing bowl , beat together the butter , cream cheese , salt , sugar , baking powder , vanilla extract , and almond extract until well combined
4. Add the eggs one at a time , beating well after each addition
5. The mixture may look slightly curdled / grainy
6. After you've added the final egg , beat at high speed for 3 minutes
7. The batter will still look a little curdled , but will have gained a bit of volume
8. Sprinkle in the flour gradually , with the mixer going at low speed
9. Mix just until combined
10. The batter will be smooth and thick
11. Spoon the batter into the prepared pan
12. To make the topping , combine the sugar , vanilla , and water
13. Stir till the mixture is syrupy
14. At first it'll seem very stiff , but will become "drizzlable" as you stir
15. Drizzle the topping over the batter
16. Set the cake on a baking sheet , for easiest handling and as a precaution against potential overflow
17. Bake it for 60 to 70 minutes , until the cake is golden brown , and a cake tester inserted into the center comes out clean
18. The center should register at least 200f on an instant-read thermometer
19. If you prefer a lighter crust , tent the cake with aluminum foil for the final 10 minutes or so of baking
20. Remove the cake from the oven , and after 15 minutes loosen the edges , and turn it out of the pan to cool on a rack

title: mexican appetizer
steps:
1. With an electric mixer , whip up cream cheese and mayonnaise
2. Spread cream cheese mixture onto a platter , about 18 inches in diameter
3. Add on the salsa , spread with a spoon
4. Sprinkle tomatoes , green onions and shrimp onto of the salsa
5. Cover the tomatoes , green onions , and shrimp with grated cheese
6. Keep it refrigerated until serving time
7. Put out a bowl of chips , just dip your chip right in !

title: beer braised pot roast
steps:
1. Coat a nonstick skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium-high heat
2. Add the beef , and cook , stirring occasionally , until brown , 5 to 10 minutes
3. Remove to the crock pot and add the onions , garlic , mushrooms , beer and bay leaf
4. Cover and cook on low until the beef is very tender and a meat thermometer register 160f , 8 to 10 hours
5. Remove beef to a platter , reserving the beer-onion mixture
6. Keep the beef warm
7. Discard the bay leaf and pour the beer-onion mixture into a saucepan
8. In a small measuring cup , combine the water , turmeric , cinnamon , browning sauce , and flour
9. Pour into the beer-onion mixture and cook , stirring , over medium heat until thickened
10. Meanwhile , cook the noodles according to package directions
11. Drain well
12. Slice the beef and serve with the beer-onion mixture and noodles

title: lemony acorn squash
steps:
1. Wash the squash
2. Cut in half lengthwise
3. Remove and discard the seeds and membrane
4. Cut each half crosswise into 1 / 2 inch slices , discarding ends
5. Place slices in a large skillet
6. Add 1 cup water
7. Bring to boil
8. Reduce heat
9. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until or until tender
10. Meanwhile , in a small saucepan , combine sugar and remaining 2 tablespoons water
11. Cook over medium heat until sugar melts and syrup is golden , stirring occasionally
12. Remove from heat
13. Carefully add lemon juice , butter , salt and pepper
14. Cook and stir over low heat until butter melts
15. Place , squash on a serving plate and top with syrup

title: cubano chicken rice bowls with bananas
steps:
1. Steam rice until tender and set aside
2. Dredge banana pieces in flour and slightly sautee in a small amount of butter
3. Cube cooked chicken breasts
4. Heat black beans
5. Layer into bowls with rice on bottom mixed with the black beans , next chicken pieces , and top with the sauteed bananas , sprinkling the fresh cilantro , chopped onions , and salsa to garnish on top
6. Varying amounts according to your own taste preference is allowable

title: chicken patties
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine the chicken , cracker crumbs , mayonnaise , onions , lemon juice and pepper
2. Shape into six patties
3. Heat oil in a large skillet
4. Fry patties over medium heat for 2-3 minutes on each side or until golden brown and heated through

title: asparagus cigars
steps:
1. Trim asparagus to 6-inch lengths
2. Beat egg with pinch of salt
3. Halve tortillas
4. Brush 1 half with some of egg mixture and place 1 piece asparagus along cut side
5. Tightly roll up tortilla
6. Insert 1 pick crosswise to secure
7. Brush outside of roll with more of egg mixture and sprinkle with sesame seeds
8. Roll remainder of asparagus is same manner
9. Heat 1 / 2 inch of oil in a 10-inch heavy duty skillet to 350f
10. Fry rolls in batches of 3 , turning over once , until golden brown , about 3 minutes per batch , returning oil to 350f between batches
11. Transfer to paper towels to drain
12. Stir together remaining ingredients until sugar is dissolved
13. Serve with rolls

title: high altitude pumpkin spice cupcake w  cinnamon vanilla buttercr
steps:
1. Cupcake directions
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
3. Line your cupcake pans with liners
4. In a large bowl , sift together the flour , spices , salt , baking powder and baking soda and set aside
5. In the mixing bowl , beat the melted butter , sugar and brown sugar until light and fluffy
6. Add the eggs , mixing well after each
7. Stir in milk and pumpkin , continuing to mix
8. Slowly stir in flour & spice mix and mix well
9. Pour batter into cupcake liners until they are 3 / 4 full
10. Bake for about 20 minutes
11. You may need to adjust your baking time - test with a toothpick for doneness
12. Remove from oven & cool on a wire rack
13. Frosting directions
14. Beat softened butter with electric mixer until light and fluffy
15. Add confectioners sugar , 3 teaspoons milk and vanilla
16. Blend until mixed well
17. Add cinnamon
18. Beat on medium about 1 more minute
19. If frosting seems too stiff , add in 1-2 tables spoons of milk
20. Add additional or use less cinnamon or vanilla for taste if desired
21. This recipe is to my taste but could be a bit strong for some
22. My best advice would be to experiment with what tastes best for you

title: avocado n philly cheese dip
steps:
1. Warm the cheese in the microwave for 15-20 seconds
2. Skin the avocado and finely chop
3. Combine all ingredients
4. Chill and serve !

title: megan s amazing buffalo garlic chili
steps:
1. Chop onion and crush and chop garlic and saute in butter until tender , browning and the smell is overwhelmingly garlicy , turn heat to low and let cool while you do step 2
2. If you use meat cook down the beef in a separate pan and when its browned and crumbly add the taco seasoning as directed by the packet
3. Add to the chili along with beans
4. Drain the appropriate items and add all beans , both drained and undrained along with the corn and the chopped tomatoes to the pot
5. Add large can of whole tomatoes
6. Crush with your hands or cut into quarters with paring knife
7. I generally dump the tomatoes on top and then slice them up over the pot , just dropping them back
8. This is very messy and you'll want to wear an apron
9. Whole stewed tomatoes never fail to squirt when you crush or cut them
10. Stir all ingredients and turn heat back up to begin cooking
11. Add seasoning while stirring and taste testing
12. I generally add the wing sauce and the lemon juice first
13. Chili powder makes the chili a nice dark red and tends to be hot in the back of the mouth for a nice kick after the flavor
14. I also use season pepper , and pepper flakes
15. Basically you season it with what you like until it tastes good to you
16. It will always be different
17. Simmer on medium stirring occasionally
18. If it's too soupy you can add 1 / 2 cup of white rice which will also make your chili even more filling
19. Eat some and let cool on the stove top
20. I find letting it sit sets the flavor before you put it away
21. Also not apian vegetarian due to honey in the anchor bay buffalo wing sauce

title: cauliflower mash with caramelized onions and roasted garlic
steps:
1. Preheat oven or toaster oven to 425
2. Wrap the garlic in aluminum foil
3. Bake for 25 minutes or just until tender
4. Cool then squeeze out the garlic
5. Set aside
6. In a skillet , heat the oil over medium high heat and cook the onions for 5 minutes
7. Stir in the brown sugar , vinegar and cinnamon
8. Reduce the heat to medium low and cook until the onions are golden , about 10 minutes
9. Steam or broil the cauliflower just until tender about 5 - 7 minutes
10. Drain and place in a food processor with the stock , olive oil , salt and pepper
11. Puree until smooth
12. Stir in the onions and garlic until combined
13. Garnish with parsley

title: poblano chile rellenos
steps:
1. Combine 1 cup of the flour , baking powder , and 1 / 2 teaspoon of salt in a large bowl
2. Gradually add the beer , whisking until the batter is smooth
3. Cover with plastic wrap , and refrigerate for 1 hour
4. Heat oil in a medium skillet over medium heat
5. Add the scallions and garlic , and cook until soft , 4 to 5 minutes
6. Add the corn and cook for 2 to 3 minutes
7. Season , to taste , with salt and pepper
8. Allow to cool , add cheese , and set aside
9. Make an incision the length of each chile and remove the stems and seeds
10. Stuff corn filling into chilies , and close with a toothpick
11. In a large deep skillet , pour oil until half full
12. Heat over medium heat until hot
13. Dredge chilies in remaining flour , shake off excess , dip in batter , and fry until golden , approximately 1 minute per side
14. Drain on paper towels and season with salt
15. To serve place on large dish and serve with sour cream and lime wedges

title: cheddar and mango chutney sandwich
steps:
1. Not like they are really needed but , take two thick slices of bread , a tablespoon of softened butter and the filling combo
2. Spread butter on one side of both slices of bread , lay the bread on a work surface , butter-side down , and put the fillings inside
3. Place sandwich in an already hot nonstick pan on medium heat
4. Cook 5 minutes , flip , then cook 2 more minutes
5. Cut sandwich in half and eat

title: jello fluff
steps:
1. Mix cottage cheese and dry jello mix until cottage cheese is thoroughly colored by jello
2. Add pineapple and mix well
3. Fold in cool whip
4. Refrigerate 4-6 hours

title: creamy pasta with spring vegetables
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Cut asparagus into 1 1 / 2 inch pieces discarding the tough ends
3. Cut mushrooms in half or quarters
4. Cut bell pepper into 1 inch squares or strips
5. Combine vegetables in a bowl
6. Add olive oil and toss lightly
7. Add garlic , salt and pepper
8. Gently mix well
9. Pour into bar pan and bake for 10-12 minutes until crisp tender
10. Snip basil with kitchen scissors
11. Prepare pasta according to pakage instructions
12. In a small saucepan , simmer whipping cream for 6-8 minutes , on medium low heat to slightly thicken
13. Stir constantly so it doesn't burn to the bottom of the pan
14. Drain pasta and transfer to large bowl
15. Add veggies , heated cream and basil
16. Toss lightly
17. Mix 1 / 4 c of parmesan cheese into the pasta
18. Spoon onto serving plates or dishes
19. Sprinkle with remaining paremesan and some additonal black pepper

title: instant beef tenderloin stew
steps:
1. Heat 1 tablespoon butter and the oil in a large nonstick skillet- add potatoes , carrots and mushrooms
2. Cook , partially covered and stirring occasionally , 8 minutes or until vegetables are soft when pierced and lightly browned
3. Add onion
4. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes
5. Add garlic , peas and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt
6. Cook 1 minute until fragrant- cover and set aside
7. Heat remaining butter in another large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until very hot and foaming
8. Sprinkle meat with remaining 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and the pepper
9. Add to skilet and cook 2 to 4 minutes , turning meat until browned on all sides
10. Add to vegetables
11. Stir to mix- transfer to a platter
12. Add wine and broth to skillet and boil 10 seconds- pour over stew and serve

title: shredded beef taco meat
steps:
1. Heat oil in a heavy large pot over medium high heat
2. Brown roast , letting it sit undisturbed on each side until it is more easily removed from the pan , creating a nice golden crust on the exposed edges
3. Remove to crock pot large enough to hold the roast
4. Deglaze pan , turn off heat of pan but while still hot , add the broth to the pan and stir until the bits on the bottom of the pan are cleaned off
5. Add broth and browned bits to crock pot
6. Add salsa , garlic , brown sugar and soy sauce to crock pot
7. Cook until meat falls apart , about 4-6 hours on high or 8-10 hours on low , depending on your crock pot
8. When meat falls apart , remove from the crock pot in batches , shred using two forks and put in a container , discarding fat
9. Skim fat from the juices left in the crock pot , then pour the juices over the shredded meat in the container
10. Refrigerate overnight or freeze
11. When ready to eat , reheat in a pan on the stove and add lime juice and cilantro
12. If frozen , thaw in refrigerator or microwave
13. Can serve with tortillas and traditional fixings like lettuce , tomato , cheese , salsa , avocado , sour cream and additional salsa , or it's really good with salad greens and black beans

title: ravioli with a wild mushroom creamy alfredo sauce
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large skillet and cook until golden
2. Add mushrooms
3. Cover the pan and cook the mushrooms for 5-10 minutes or until the juices are released
4. Add the shallots and garlic
5. Saute for 5 more minutes
6. Add the tarragon and white wine
7. Simmer for 5 minutes
8. Pour in the heavy cream
9. Cook and stir on medium heat until the sauce begins to thicken
10. When the sauce begins to thicken , add in the alfredo sauce and nutmeg
11. Simmer until heated through and then gently stir in the chicken and white pepper
12. Cook for 5 minutes
13. Taste and adjust spices
14. Simmer over low heat while cooking the ravioli
15. Cook the ravioli according to the package directions
16. Drain well and transfer to either a serving dish or you can go ahead and plate the ravioli
17. Pour sauce over the top of the ravioli
18. Garnish with freshly grated parmesan before serving

title: crunchy snickerdoodle french toast
steps:
1. Grease 15x10x1 -inch jelly-roll pan
2. Combine half & half , eggs , sugar , cinnamon and vanilla
3. In shallow bowl
4. Mix well
5. Place crushed cereal in another shallow bowl
6. Dip bread slices in egg mixture then into cereal crumbs
7. Place into prepared pan
8. Cover
9. Freeze until firm
10. Heat oven to 425f bake uncovered , turning once , for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown
11. Serve with butter and maple syrup , if desired
12. Substitute any cinnamon-flavored cereal or plain flake cereal
13. The amount of egg mixture absorbed when making french toast depends upon the bread being used
14. Soft bread with an open , porous texture will absorb more liquid and absorb it more quickly than drier bread with a fine texture , once you've dipped the first 1 or 2 slices , you can determine how long to keep the bread in the egg mixture , so you don't run out of the egg mixture

title: texas teriyaki pork stew
steps:
1. Combine barbecue sauce , teriyaki sauce , mustard , asian chili garlic sauce , and 1 / 2 cup dry sherry in a large bowl
2. Add pork ribs and mix well
3. Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours or overnight
4. Drain meat , reserving marinade
5. Place marinade in a large , heavy pot over medium high heat and bring to a boil
6. Add tomato sauce , reduce heat to low , and simmer
7. Heat oil in large skillet
8. Brown meat on both sides , sprinkling brown sugar over meat while it is browning
9. Remove meat and add to sauce
10. In same skillet , melt butter and add mushrooms and onion
11. Cook until onion begins to soften and become translucent
12. Remove and add to meat and sauce
13. Add smoked paprika , savory , thyme , garlic , ginger , stock and remaining 1 / 4 cup sherry to pot
14. Stir well , cover , and simmer for 3 hours
15. Check pot every 30 minutes , skim excess fat , and stir well
16. Remove meat from pot
17. Remove bones and discard
18. Return meat to pot , add bell pepper , and simmer for an additional 30 minutes

title: butterscotch salted peanut bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Line a 15 x 10-inch baking sheet with parchment paper
3. Combine all crust ingredients , and press into bottom of the pan
4. Bake for 10-12 minutes
5. Remove from oven then sprinkle the peanuts evenly over crust
6. In a saucepan combine the topping ingredients
7. Bring to a boil then cook for about 2 minutes until smooth
8. Pour the hot mixture over the nuts , and return to oven
9. Bake for 15 minutes or until until golden
10. Cool completely before cutting into bars

title: bbq sauce  sweet and spicy
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except red pepper flakes in a small size sauce pan
2. Whisk while heating over a medium-low flame
3. Once sugar is dissolved , add in red pepper flakes
4. Simmer 5 minutes , whisking often
5. Once everything is incorporated , and you've adjusted the taste to your liking , let cool completely and store in an air tight jar for up to 3 weeks in the refrigerator
6. If not using right away , mix sauce well , before using
7. Keep this in mind while tasting during the preparation
8. A little bit hot will get hotter -- a little bit sweet will get sweeter
9. Enjoy !

title: pre cooked grilled chicken
steps:
1. Place the chicken in a large dutch oven
2. Add enough water to cover
3. Bring to a boil
4. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 15 minutes
5. Drain the chicken and place in a large shallow container
6. Combine the remaining ingredients , stirring well
7. Pour the marinade over the chicken
8. Cover and refrigerate 4 hours , turning frequently
9. Remove the chicken from the marinade
10. Grill over medium coals for 10 minutes or until done , turning once

title: new potato and mince curry
steps:
1. Dry the mince thoroughly with kitchen paper
2. Dust it with the flour and mix well
3. Heat a frying pan and add the mince
4. Brown it all over , stirring to break it up
5. Remove from pan and set aside
6. Add oil and onion to the pan and cook on a medium heat for 5 minutes
7. Stir in the garlic , spices and curry paste
8. Stir fry for 1 minute
9. Add the mince , potatoes and 600ml / 1pint water , bring to the boil and cover if desired
10. I personally like to cook it uncovered
11. Simmer for 30 minutes or until potatoes are cooked
12. Season with salt to taste
13. Stir in the spinach and simmer for 1 minute , uncovered , until wilted
14. Ladle into bowls , top with the yogurt and serve with indian bread

title: famous cottage cheese dip
steps:
1. Mix all above ingredients together in a medium sized bowl
2. For best results , use regular cottage cheese and sour cream , rather than reduced fat
3. This will help form a thicker dip
4. Enjoy !

title: tunisia  beef meatballs  kefta de boeuf
steps:
1. Directions mix everything together , except the oil
2. Form into 10 meatballs
3. Heat oil in a skillet and brown the balls on all sides for about 5 minutes
4. Drain on paper towels
5. Serve over rice or couscous or can be served as an appetizer

title: peter s pork belly
steps:
1. Combine in a large mixing bowl the oil , soy , mustard and pepper and whisk vigorously
2. Add the pork and allow to marinade for at least 24 hours , turning occasionally , ensuring that the marinade has not settled
3. After the 24 hours has passed you may then begin to cook
4. To do this you can either cook the pork in the oven or on the bbq , but i prefer using a fry-pan to seal in the juices and then place them in the oven for about 1 hour
5. This will render the pork melt in the mouth
6. To serve , simply slice the pork into bite sized pieces and place on top of a bed of rice , garnish with the spring onion and a squeeze of lemon juice

title: maple barbecued chicken
steps:
1. Soak apple chips in water for 30 minutes
2. Preheat grill
3. Combine syrup , chili sauce , vinegar and mustard together in a saucepan
4. Let simmer for 5 minutes
5. Brush chicken with the oil and season with salt and pepper
6. Add wood chips to coals
7. Place chicken on grill and cook for 10-15 minutes or done all the way through
8. Turn occasionally and brush generously with sauce in the last few minutes before they are done

title: grilled artichoke and spinach dip with pita wedges
steps:
1. To make the dip:
2. Drain artichoke hearts and place on skewers
3. Brush with olive oil and season with salt and pepper
4. Grill over direct medium heat until golden brown , about 6 minutes , turning once halfway through grilling time
5. In a large saut pan , saut garlic , shallot , and onion in remaining olive oil
6. Rough chop the artichokes and add to garlic mixture
7. Add the spinach
8. Fold in cream , sour cream , and 1 cup of the cheese
9. Season to taste with salt and pepper
10. Place in fireproof dish or heavy-duty aluminum pan and sprinkle with the remaining 2 tablespoons of parmesan cheese
11. Heat over medium to low heat for 20 to 25 minutes until dip is heated through
12. For the pita:
13. 8 pita rounds
14. Olive oil
15. Salt and pepper
16. To make the pita:
17. Brush pita rounds with olive oil and season with salt and pepper
18. Grill briefly over direct heat to warm , about 1 to 2 minutes
19. Cut into wedges
20. Garnish the dip with sour cream and chopped fresh tomato , if desired
21. Serve with the pita wedges

title: sweet potato chowder
steps:
1. In a 4-quart dutch oven , heat oil over medium heat
2. Add onion
3. Cook for 3 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Add curry paste and garlic
5. Cook for 3 to 5 minutes or until onion is tender , stirring occasionally
6. Stir in sweet potato , chicken broth , coconut milk , lemongrass , and , ginger
7. Bring mixture to a boil
8. Reduce heat
9. Cover and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes or until sweet potato is tender
10. Cool slightly
11. Discard lemongrass
12. Transfer half of the potato mixture in small batches to a blender or food processor
13. Cover and blend or process until smooth
14. Return pureed mixture to the remaining mixture in dutch oven
15. Stir in white pepper and salt
16. Heat through
17. Serve with a dolop of creme fraiche

title: potato salad with green beans   sun dried tomatoes
steps:
1. Cook potatoes until they poke easily with a fork
2. Cut in half
3. Drizzle with olive oil and toss with garlic
4. Add sundried tomatoes
5. Steam the green beans until crisp-tender
6. Cut green beans in half or bite size pieces and mix with potatoes
7. Add seasoning , dressing , basil and some salt & pepper
8. Add more salt / pepper as if necessary and add pinenuts
9. Can be served chilled or room temperature !

title: my never fail sponge
steps:
1. Grease and flour 2 deep 8" sponge tins
2. Separate the eggs
3. Boil together the sugar and water until sugar has dissolved
4. Beat egg whites until they are stiff with an electric beater then add the water and sugar mixture
5. Beat well and then add egg yolks one at a time beating each in well
6. Sift together the cornflour , flour and baking powder
7. Fold into the egg mixture with a metal spoon as lightly as possible
8. Divide mixture equally between the tins and bake at 375'f for 20 minutes approximately
9. Remove from oven when sponges spring back when pressed lightly with finger
10. Cool in tins 5mins before turning onto racks to cool completely
11. Join together with freshly whipped cream which has been flavoured with vanilla essence and a little sugar
12. Sift a little icing sugar on top & serve
13. Or leave as 2 halves and spread whipped cream on top of each and sprinkle with jelly crystals or decorate with some fresh fruit or shavings of chocolate

title: vegan peach cobbler  made with rice flour
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Crust: combine rice flour , butter , stevia , baking powder , xantan gum , salt , and nutmeg in a medium sized bowl
3. In a small bowl , beat egg replacer , rice milk , and vanilla
4. Slowly mix wet ingredients into the dry
5. Set aside
6. Filling: in a medium sized bowl combine all ingredients except vegan butter plus 2 tbs water
7. Place filling in a baking dish and dot with vegan butter
8. Spoon crust on top layer of peaches
9. Bake for 35 minutes or until crust is goldenish

title: sarasota s chinese chicken salad
steps:
1. Dressing -- i make the day before
2. Just add everything to a small tupperware container and shake
3. Set in the fridge until you are ready to make the salad
4. Almonds -- i also make these the day ahead , so all you have to worry about if the chicken and putting the salad together
5. Simply melt the butter in a small non stick saute pan and cook on medium heat until golden brown
6. Then add in the brown sugar and stir until melted
7. Remove to a piece of parchment paper or foil to let cool
8. Make sure to spread out the almonds out , otherwise they will stick together
9. Just let them cool and store in a small baggie
10. Chicken -- i marinade the chicken in just buttermilk
11. One hour up to 4 or 5
12. The smaller pieces don't take as long
13. In a large baggie , or you can use a small bowl if you want , add the flour , cornstarch , sesame seeds , paprika and salt and mix well
14. Shake or just lightly wipe off some of the buttermilk from the chicken and then dredge the flour mixture
15. Heat a large (non stick or cast iron for me works best for this pan to medium high heat and add the oil
16. When the oil gets hot , add the chicken and cook until golden brown
17. Remove to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm
18. Salad -- add the chopped iceberg lettuce , the chow mein noodles , red onion and the shredded carrots and toss well in a large salad bowl
19. Add the dressing and mix to combine
20. Top with the warm chicken and the caramelized almonds and enjoy !

title: soupe joumou  haitian pumpkin soup  soupe au giramoun
steps:
1. In a medium pot , cook pumpkin and 1 scotch bonnet pepper over medium heat in 6 cups water for 30 minutes
2. Discard the pepper
3. Pure pumpkin in the water
4. While pumpkin is cooking , clean meat with lime or sour oranges , rinse with cold water and drain
5. Make a meat rub by grinding 4 garlic cloves , 1 teaspoon thyme , 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper , 2 sliced scallions into 2 teaspoons salt
6. Rub meat with spice mixture
7. Let it rest for at least 1 hour
8. Marinate meat with scallions , onion , garlic , shallot , chives , green pepper , pikliz , salt and black pepper
9. You can marinate meat from 1 hour up to one day in advance for flavor enhancement
10. In stockpot , add the meat with 1 cup water and cook covered over medium heat for 40 minutes
11. Add 3 cups water and pured pumpkin and bring to a boil for 40 minutes
12. Add celery , cabbage , leek , carrots and whole cloves
13. Cook , uncovered , for 20 minutes
14. Make dumplings: boulettes de pate or donmbwey:
15. In a bowl , mix flour , salt and 1 cup water , making sure there are no lumps
16. Using a tablespoon , mold dumplings into desired shape in your hand and add to boiling water
17. They usually take on the shape of spaetzels
18. Add pasta , potatoes , hot pepper , and butter and spoon in dumplings
19. Cook , uncovered , for 20 minutes
20. Taste it
21. If it needs more salt and / or pepper , add to taste
22. Enjoy !

title: skat s monday pizza loaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Place pepperonis on tinfoil in oven and bake for about 5 minutes , or until grease begins to come up
3. Remove , drain , and pat dry
4. Roll out dough into a rectangular shape
5. Brush gently with egg
6. Layer fresh tomato sauce , garlic , mozzarella , pepperoni , and basil onto dough
7. Roll dough jelly-roll style , place onto baking stone and bake 35-40 minutes
8. Remove and let cool 5 minutes
9. Slice and serve
10. Variations: saute onions or scallions on stove top and add to filling
11. Additionally , add mushrooms , pepperoncinis , tomatoes , or kalamata olives

title: curry beef
steps:
1. Mix the curry powder , turmeric and salt in a small dish
2. Place the cubed beef in a large bowl and cover with - 2 / 3 of the seasoning mix and set aside
3. Cook onions , ginger and jalapenos in a dutch oven until onions are brown and soft
4. Add the two cans of drained diced tomatoes and the remainder of the seasoning blend , allow to come to a slow boil
5. Add the meat to the tomato and onion blend and allow to cook for 10 minutes at medium heat until all ingredients are well blended
6. Pour the can of coconut milk into the meat mixture
7. Blend together until a uniform mixture has been created
8. Turn the stove to simmer an allow to simmer for an hour to and hour and a half
9. Towards the end of cooking taste the gravy to see if more salt is needed
10. Serve over rice

title: pinto bean soup with fresh salsa
steps:
1. Sort through the beans and discard any misshapen beans or stones
2. Rinse well
3. Place the beans in a saucepan and add the water
4. Bring to a boil , reduce the heat to medium low , cover and simmer until the smallest bean is cooked through and creamy inside , about 1 hours
5. Remove from the heat and set aside
6. In a large saucepan over medium heat , warm the vegetable oil
7. Add the onions , salt and pepper and saut until the onions are lightly browned , about 10 minutes
8. Add the garlic and saut for 1 to 2 minutes longer
9. Add the beans and their liquid and the stock or water
10. Bring to a boil , reduce the heat to medium and simmer uncovered , stirring occasionally , until the beans start to break apart , 20 to 30 minutes
11. Remove the beans from the heat and let cool slightly
12. For the salsa:
13. In a bowl , stir together the tomatoes , onion , cilantro , lime juice and salt and pepper to taste
14. Cover and refrigerate until you are ready to serve
15. Working in batches , transfer the bean mixture to a blender and puree until smooth
16. Transfer the puree to a clean saucepan and reheat over reheat over low heat , stirring frequently , until hot
17. Ladle the soup into warmed shallow bowls and top each serving with a spoonful of salsa and a dollop of crema or sour cream

title: low carb chicken piccata
steps:
1. Grease the slow cooker crock with the butter
2. In a liquid measuring cup , combine the wine , tabasco sauce , and tapioca
3. Stir and add to the slow cooker crock
4. Add the chicken pieces and remaining ingredients , except for the parsley
5. Cover and cook on low for 4 hours
6. When done cooking , remove lemon halves , stir in parsley , and serve

title: wikked queen s milk punch
steps: 1. Mix together and serve chilled

title: taco shrimp filling
steps:
1. Heat a skillet over medium heat
2. Add shrimp and all the rest of the ingredients to skillet and cook until shrimp are pink
3. Served over couscous but would be good served in tortilla's

title: dilly sole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 f
2. Spray an eight-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray and set aside
3. With paper towel , pat fish dry
4. Spread mayo on the broad half of each fillet and season with the salt and pepper
5. Tear toast into pieces and place in a food processor
6. Whirl toast until it is in crumbs
7. With processor running , drop garlic clove down chute and let process until chopped
8. Add butter , dill and lemon zest to processor and process until combined
9. Sprinkle this crumb mixture evenly over the fillets where you spread the mayo , then fold the narrow end of the fillets over the crumb mixture to form a roll
10. Place in prepared pan and bake in preheated oven for 10 minutes , or until the sole flakes when tested with a fork
11. Serve with steamed rice , broccoli , and fresh lemon wedges

title: raspberry almond shortbread thumbprints
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. In large mixer bowl combine sugar , butter , and almond extract
3. Beat at medium speed , scraping bowl often , until creamy
4. Reduce speed to low
5. Add flour
6. Continue beating until well mixed
7. Shape dough into 1-inch balls
8. Place 2 inches apart on cookie sheets
9. With thumb , make indentation in center of each cookie
10. Fill each indentation with about t
11. Jam
12. Bake for 14 to 18 minutes or until edges are lightly browned
13. Let stand 1 minute
14. Remove from cookie sheet
15. Glaze:
16. In small bowl stir together powdered sugar and 1 t
17. Almond extract
18. Gradually stir in enough water for a thin glaze
19. Drizzle over cooled cookies
20. Flour

title: creamy smothered ground beef burritos
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a large skillet over medium heat , cook the ground beef , until the beef browned
3. While beef is browning , mix together in a small bowl , the chili powder , garlic powder , onion powder , oregano , paprika , cumin , salt pepper and cornstarch
4. After beef is browned , sprinkle the seasoning mix over the beef and mix well
5. Stir in water and simmer until water has evaporated , about 10 minutes
6. In a medium bowl , mix together sour cream , cream of chicken soup , green chilies and cheese
7. Mix about half of the cheese mixture with the ground beef
8. Divide the meat mixture evenly between tortillas and roll up
9. Place in a 9 x 13 inch baking dish
10. Repeat for each tortilla
11. Spoon remaining cheese mixture over the top of the tortillas
12. Bake in preheated oven for 20 to 30 minutes
13. Allow to cool for about 5 minutes then serve with desired garnish

title: gluten free potato bread rolls
steps:
1. Combine warm water , yeast and half the sugar
2. Allow to stand for 10 minutes
3. Add oil and potatoes to yeast mixture
4. Stir in 1 cup potato flour along with salt
5. Add 2 beaten eggs
6. Beat 1 minute with wooden spoon
7. Stand in warm place until mixture forms a sponge
8. It willrise and look foamy
9. Add rest of flour to make a firm dough
10. Stand in warm place until doubled in bulk
11. Using extra potato flour , shape dough into rolls
12. Place on lightly oiled oven trays
13. Cover with plastic wrap
14. Stand in warm place and let rise
15. Uncover and glaze with beaten egg
16. Bake at 190 deg c for 10-12 minutes

title: monterey spaghetti crock pot
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti until al dente
2. Drain
3. In large bowl mix together sour cream , parmesan , and garlic
4. After beating the egg separately , add to above mixture
5. Transfer to a greased slow cooker
6. Mix cooked spaghetti , 2 cups jack cheese , thawed spinach , and half of the fried onions to the crock pot
7. Stir contents of cooker until blended
8. Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours or high for 3-4 hours
9. In last 30 minute
10. Of cooking , turn to high if cooking on low and add rest of cheese and onions on top
11. Serve when cheese is melted

title: korean sauerkraut   kimchi
steps:
1. Place vegetables , ginger , red chile flakes , sea salt and whey in a bowl and press with your hands or a wooden pounder or a meat hammer to release juices
2. Place in a quart sized , wide mouth mason jars and press down firmly with a pounder or meat hammer until juices come to the top of the cabbage
3. The top of the vegetables should be at least 1 inch below the top of the jar
4. Cover tightly and keep at room temperature for about 3 days before transferring to cold storage
5. Ready to eat in about a week or two

title: southwest pork   green chili casserole
steps:
1. In a large skillet over medium heat , cook pork in oil until no longer pink
2. Drain
3. In same skillet with pork , add the beans , soup , tomatoes , chilies , rice , broth , salsa , cumin and corn
4. Cook and stir until bubbly
5. Pour mixture into an ungreased 2-quart baking dish
6. Bake , uncovered , at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until bubbly
7. Remove from oven and sprinkle with cheese
8. Let stand a few minutes before serving

title: chicken noodle potato bake with bacon    low fat
steps:
1. Peel and slice potatoes
2. Layer into a baking dish
3. Mix soup mix , onion , bacon , crushed garlic and cream over low heat for 5 minutes
4. Pour heated cream mix over potatoes
5. Bake in a moderate oven for 1 - 1
6. 5 hours or until potatoes are soft
7. Garnish with grated cheese and chives if desired

title: honey roasted nuts and fruit
steps:
1. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or foil and coat with cooking spray
2. In a large nonstick skillet , heat butter over medium-high heat
3. Stir in honey and cook 2 minutes or until mixture bubbles around edges of pan
4. Add nuts and next 5 ingredients , and cook over medium heat until nuts are golden , about 8 minutes , stirring frequently
5. Stir in raisins
6. Immediately spread onto prepared baking sheet
7. Cool completely

title: rich fudgy brownies
steps:
1. Melt butter in a sauce pan on low heat
2. Add cocoa and oil and remove from heat
3. Stir in sugar till completly mixed
4. Cool slightly
5. Add eggs , one at a time , mixing throughly after each addition
6. Stir in flour , salt , vanilla and nuts and mix completly
7. Pour into greased 9x9 pan and bake at 350 degrees for 30-35 minutes cool and cut into squares

title: criss cross potatoes
steps:
1. Scrub the potatoes and cut in half lengthwise
2. Make diagonal slashes about 1 / 8 inch deep in cut side of potatoes , forming a crisscross pattern
3. Brush cut surface with melted butter
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Arrange in a baking dish
6. Bake at 350f for 1 hour
7. Brush with a little more butter and sprinkle with paprika
8. Continue baking 15 minutes more
9. Serve plain or with sour cream and chives

title: frosted fudge brownies
steps:
1. In a saucepan , melt butter
2. Remove from the heat
3. Stir in cocoa and cool
4. While cooling , beat eggs and sugar in mixing bowl
5. Combine the flour , baking powder and salt
6. Gradually add to the egg mixture
7. Stir in the vanilla and cooled chocolate mixture and mix well
8. Spread into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-in
9. Pan
10. Bake at 350 for 25-28 minutes of until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
11. Cool on a wire rack
12. For frosting , in a mixing bowl , cream the butter , confectioners' sugar , cocoa and vanilla
13. Add enough milk until it achieves spreading consistency
14. Spread over brownies
15. Cut into bars and enjoy

title: hubby s chicken
steps:
1. Wrap each chicken breast in a slice of bacon
2. Line a baking dish with the jar of dried beef and place the breasts on top
3. Mix together the sour cream and soup and"seal" the top of the chicken with it
4. Cover in foil and bake on 275 for 3 hours
5. Do not uncover during baking

title: good morning green smoothie
steps:
1. Layer ingredients in a blender in this pattern: pineapple , 1 handful spinach , yogurt , 1 handful spinach , bananas , 1 handful spinach , water
2. Blend well and serve over ice

title: crusty cauliflower and ricotta casserole
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat
2. Cook garlic for 30 seconds , do not brown
3. Add in tomatoes and cook another 5 minutes , stirring often
4. Stir in cauliflower and toss to coat with the tomato mixture
5. Pour in several tbsp of water and cover pan
6. Cook for 7 minutes , or until cauliflower is tender
7. Take pan off heat and let cool to room temperature or warm
8. Preheat oven to 375
9. Butter a casserole dish
10. Beat eggs in a large bowl , beat in ricotta cheese , milk , parmesan , parsley , nutmeg , cayenne , pepper , and muenster
11. Stir in cauliflower mixture
12. Spread into casserole dish and top with breadcrumbs
13. Bake 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly

title: chocolate kiss
steps:
1. Pour all ingredients into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes
2. Shake and strain into a martini glass , and serve

title: chocolate cheesecake brownies
steps:
1. Brownie batter - preheat oven to 350~
2. Butter 13"x9"x2" baking pan
3. Combine chocolate , butter , and coffee powder in heavy small saucepan
4. Stir over low heat until melted and smooth
5. Remove from heat
6. Cool slightly
7. In lg
8. Bowl , beat eggs until frothy
9. Gradually add sugar and beat until mixture is pale yellow and slightly thickened
10. Stir in flour , cocoa , and salt
11. Add vanilla , liqueur , and melted chocolate mixture
12. Stir until well blended
13. Cream cheese mixture - using electric mixer , beat cream cheese and butter in lg
14. Bowl until smooth
15. Add sugar and beat until fluffy
16. Beat in eggs , flour , and coffee liqueur
17. Set aside 1 / 2 cup brownie batter for topping
18. Pour remaining batter into prepared pan
19. Carefully spoon cream cheese mixture over batter , covering completely
20. Sprinkle chocolate chips evenly over cream cheese layer
21. Drop reserved batter by spoonfuls over cream cheese layer
22. Using small knife , swirl batter into cream cheese mixture to resemble marble pattern
23. Bake brownies until edges are light golden and toothpick inserted into center comes out with some crumbs still attached
24. About 30 mins
25. Cool completely in pan on rack
26. Cut into squares

title: banana bread muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Line cupcake tin with papers & spray with vanilla pam
3. In large bowl , combine flour soda & salt
4. In a separate bowl , cream together butter & sugar
5. Stir in eggs & mashed bananas until well blended
6. Stir banana mixture into flour mixture
7. Fill muffin tins with generous amount of banana batter
8. Bake 20 min or untill toothpic comes out clean

title: chicken with tomato sauce and bacon  pollo alla campagna
steps:
1. Pat the chicken completely dry with paper towels
2. Sprinkle the pieces on all sides with the salt and a few grindings of pepper
3. Then coat the chicken with flour and shake each piece vigorously to remove any excess
4. In a heavy 10- to 12-inch skillet , melt 3 tblsp
5. Of the butter with 2 tblsp
6. Of the olive oil over high heat
7. When the foam begins to subside , brown the chicken in the hot fat , 4 pieces at a time
8. Start the pieces skin side down and turn them frequently with tongs or a slotted spoon until they are richly and evenly colored
9. As they brown , transfer the pieces to a plate and brown the rest of the chicken similarly , adding the remaing butter and oil to the pan if necessary
10. Pour off the fat remaining in the skillet and in its place add the bacon
11. Stirring frequently , cook over moderate heat until the bacon is crisp and brown and has rendered all its fat
12. With a slotted spoon , remove the bacon to paper towels to drain
13. Pour off all but 2 tblsp
14. Of the bacon fat remaining in the pan
15. Add the shallots to the fat and , stirring constantly , cook for about 3 minutes , or until they are soft , transparent and lightly brown
16. Add the tomatoes and wine and , stirring from time to time , cook briskly , uncovered , over high heat until most of the liquid has evaporated and the mixture is thick enough to hold its shape lightly in a spoon
17. Return the chicken and bacon to the skillet and turn them about with a spoon until they are well coated with the tomato sauce
18. Bring to a boil , reduce heat to low , and simmer partially covered for 35 to 40 minutes
19. When the chicken is done it should show no resistance when a thigh is pierced with a small , sharp knife
20. Taste the sauce for seasoning
21. With tongs , remove the chicken from the skillet and arrange the pieces skin side up on a large heated platter
22. Pour the sauce over the chicken and serve at once

title: bourbon pecan chicken
steps:
1. For chicken: preheat oven to 400f
2. Wash inside cavity and outside of chicken and pat dry
3. Rub cavity with cut side of half a lemon and sprinkle with salt and pepper
4. Fill cavity with tarragon , rosemary , garlic cloves and onions
5. Truss and tie chicken
6. Pull up skin , press pecan bits into chicken breast and pull skin back into place
7. Make sure not to break skin
8. Pour 1 / 4 cup of bourbon over chicken and place it on its side in oven
9. Roast for 20 minutes , turn to other side , add remaining bourbon , baste and roast another 20 minutes
10. Turn again , baste and roast for another 20 minutes check to see if it is done
11. If not , cook to your liking , continue cooking but do not overcook

title: easy crockpot beef vegetable soup
steps:
1. In a large skillet , cook beef over medium heat until no longer pink
2. Drain
3. Transfer to a 5-quart crockpot
4. Stir in the tomato juice , mixed vegetables , potatoes and soup mix
5. Cover and cook on lo for 8-10 hours or until heated through

title: anne s colourful pasta salad
steps:
1. Prepare pasta according to package directions
2. Make sure to splash it with cold water after draining it , so that the cooking process stops and your pasta wont get soggy
3. To make the salad:
4. Combine all the veggies and mix with the pasta in a big serving bowl
5. For the dressing:
6. Mix all ingredients and stir until well blended
7. Season to taste
8. Pour over pasta and veggies and toss to coat
9. Allow flavours to blend some hours prior to serving
10. Serve sprinkeld with some fresh herbs and some nice crusty bread

title: moroccan spiced carrot salad
steps:
1. Mix the grated carrots with the orange juice and cumin
2. Season with sugar , salt and pepper
3. Drizzle with the olive oil and sprinkle over a couple tablespoons each of chopped coriander and parsley , if desired

title: banana lemon poppy seed muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a small bowl , mix together the powdered sugar and just enough lemon juice to make it slightly runny
3. Set this glaze aside
4. In a medium bowl whisk together the flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
5. In a large bowl mash bananas
6. Add eggs , sugar , buttermilk , lemon juice , canola oil , and poppy seeds
7. Mix liquid ingredients
8. Add dry ingredients and mix just until moistened
9. Lumps are ok
10. Spray muffin tins by with spray-release and fill each tin a little more than half-way full
11. Bake regular sized muffins for about 24 minutes and mini muffins for about 15 minutes
12. Turn out muffins onto cooling rack and brush with glaze while still hot

title: country living egg in a hole
steps:
1. Set the broiler to low
2. Punch out a 2 1 / 2-inch hole from the center of each bread slice
3. Stir the melted butter , salt , and pepper together and brush the mixture on both sides of the bread slices and cutouts , including the inside of the hole
4. Toast the slices and cutouts in a large nonstick skillet over medium-low heat until golden , 1 1 / 2 to 2 minutes
5. Flip the bread and crack an egg into each hole
6. Cover and cook until egg sets , 1 1 / 2 to 2 minutes
7. Place the skillet under broiler just until the white is fully cooked
8. Serve immediately
9. Enjoy !
10. If desired , just put the egg in the hole when you first put the bread in the pan , flip it and cook the other side of the egg instead of putting it under the broiler

title: crab cucumber salad in tomato cups
steps:
1. Gently mix together all ingredients
2. Except tomatoes and chill
3. Serve in tomato cups
4. If you can't make the cups
5. Put salad on a bed of sliced tomatoes

title: hash brown ham quiche
steps:
1. Press hash brown between paper towels to remove excess moisture
2. Grease a 9":pie plate with 2 teaspoons butter
3. Press hash browns onto the bottom and up the sides of plate
4. Drizzle with remaining butter
5. Bake , uncovered , at 425 for 20 to 25 minutes or until edges are browned
6. Combine cheeses and ham and spread on top of hash browns
7. Whisk eggs , whipping cream , and seasoning salt until combined and pour over ham and hashbrown mixture
8. Reduce heat to 350
9. Bake uncovered for 20 to 25 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean
10. Let stand 10 minutes before serving

title: hearty tomato and sausage stew
steps:
1. You may want to cook sausage ahead of time
2. Brown and drain sausage
3. Set aside
4. Saute onion and garlic in butter untill onion is translucent
5. Stir in sausage
6. Heat breifly
7. Add tomatoes , oregano , basil , and water
8. Heat through and serve

title: the perfect sandwich
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Line a sheet pan with foil
3. Slice the tomatoes and onion to about 1 / 4-1 / 6 of an inch thick
4. Wrap the garlic in foil and place on the sheet pan along with the onions and tomatoes
5. Drizzle the onions and tomatoes with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper
6. Place in the oven and roast for 1 hour
7. When done remove from the oven and unwrap the garlic , cut it in half and squeeze all the cloves out of it into a small bowl
8. Stir in the butter
9. Take the ciabatta and cut them in halves
10. Evenly spread on the garlic butter mixture on both sides of the bread then begin to layer the bottom half with cheese , then pastrami , then beef , then onion , tomato , more cheese and then the top half of the bread
11. Wrap the sandwiches in foil and place on a clean sheet pan
12. Place another sheet place on top , and weight it down with a big iron skillet
13. Place in the 325f oven and 15-20 minutes
14. These sandwiches are great to make ahead of time too !

title: awesome no bake cookies
steps:
1. In a saucepan over medium heat , combine the sugar , cocoa , milk and margarine
2. Bring to a boil , stirring occasionally
3. Let go on rolling boil for 3 minute , then remove from heat and stir in the vanilla , salt , peanut butter and oats
4. Drop by rounded spoonfuls onto waxed paper
5. Allow cookies to cool for at least 1 hour
6. Store in an airtight container

title: lamb shanks w  white beans   sun dried tomatoes
steps:
1. Soak beans overnight in water to cover by 3 inches
2. Drain and pick over beans and rinse
3. Place the beans in the slow cooker
4. Trim the lamb shanks of as much visible fat and silver skin as possible
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat
7. When hot , add the seasoned lamb shanks and brown well on all sides
8. Remove and reserve
9. Pour off excess fat from the pan
10. Reduce heat to low and add chopped onions and garlic
11. Cook over low heat until onions are softened and translucent , about 3 to 4 minutes
12. Stir onion mixture into slow cooker with the beans
13. Add sun-dried tomatoes , sun-dried tomato oil , and rosemary
14. Tuck the browned lamb shanks into the bean mixture
15. Add the stock and wine
16. Set to cook on low setting for 6 hours
17. Remove lamb shanks , degrease using a fat mop
18. Mash some of the beans if desired

title: thom kah gai
steps:
1. Cut chicken into thin strips and boil in chicken stock with chili paste and thin soy sauce for to 2 to 3 minutes until the chicken turns white
2. Add coconut milk and bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat
4. Add remaining ingredients
5. Simmer until the chicken is done , 10 to 15 minutes
6. Sprinkle with fresh cilantro and serve steaming hot

title: traditional barbecue sauce
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a medium saucepan , add the onion and garlic and cook gently for 10 minutes
2. Add the ketchup , vinegar , worcestershire sauce , brown sugar , chili powder and red pepper sauce
3. Let the mixture simmer for about 20 minutes , stirring occasionally , until it is slightly thickened
4. Let cool , then refrigerate , tightly covered

title: chicken  sweet potato  and quinoa stir fry
steps:
1. Chop up all the vegetables
2. But don't combine them , keep each separate
3. Combine water and quinoa in a small saucepan over medium-high heat
4. Bring to a boil , reduce heat to medium , cover , and simmer until liquid has been absorbed
5. About 12-15 minutes
6. Meanwhile , add the sweet potato into another small saucepan with enough cold water to cover by 2 inches
7. Bring to a boil over high heat and cook until just tender , about 5 minutes
8. Drain and keep warm
9. I add them to the cooked quinoa , and cover the pot to keep warm
10. Heat a large nonstick frying pan or wok over medium high heat
11. Spray with nonstick cooking spray or use 2 teaspoons canola oil
12. Add chicken and cook until it starts to brown , about 4 minutes
13. Remove to a bowl and keep warm
14. Return frying pan to heat and add more nonstick spray or another 2 teaspoons canola oil or chicken broth
15. Add onion and jalapeno pepper
16. Cook , stirring occasionally for about 1 minute
17. Add bell pepper , garlic and cumin
18. Continue cooking until veggies soften , about 2-3 minutes
19. If desired , add 1 / 2 cup chicken broth to make the dish more moist
20. Stir in peas and chicken and cook 2 minutes
21. Add quinoa and sweet potato
22. Cook , stirring often , until heated through , 1-2 minutes
23. Remove from heat
24. Stir in cilantro , salt , black pepper
25. Serve with a squeeze of lime juice if desired

title: creamy microwave cheesecake
steps:
1. Combine cream cheese , sugar , egg , and vanilla until smooth
2. Stir in sour cream
3. Put the prepared pie crust in a glass pie dish
4. Pour mixture into crust and place in microwave
5. Cook on medium-high power for 8-10 minutes or until center is almost set
6. Chill for at least 3 hours
7. Top with your favorite topping

title: maple cashew goodies
steps:
1. Place mini baking cups onto large baking sheet or jelly-roll pan
2. Set aside
3. Microwave marshmallow creme and butter in large microwave-safe bowl on high , stirring once , until melted
4. Stir in maple flavoring until well mixed
5. Stir in powdered sugar until well mixed
6. Place mixture onto waxed paper
7. Knead by hand until smooth dough forms
8. Shape dough into 36 [about 1 / 2 inch] balls
9. Place onto waxed paper
10. Combine chocolate chips and shortening in medium microwave-safe bowl
11. Microwave on high , stirring occasionally , until melted and smooth
12. Place one ball on small spoon
13. Dip each maple ball into chocolate mixture
14. Place coated ball into each paper cup
15. Stir chopped cashews into remaining chocolate in bowl
16. Spoon about 1 rounded teaspoon cashew mixture over each ball , covering entire ball
17. Let stand until chocolate is set
18. Store between sheets of waxed paper in container with tight-fitting lid at room temperature up to 5 days

title: instant oven fried eggplant
steps:
1. Spread each slice of eggplant on both sides with mayonnaise
2. Dip each slice into a mixture of crumbs and cheese so that they are well coated on both sides
3. Place the eggplant slices on a greased cookie sheet and bake at 400 degrees until golden brown , about 20 minutes
4. Carefully turn and brown the other side

title: spicy black bean soup for the crock pot
steps:
1. Soak beans in three times their volume of water over night
2. Drain and rinse
3. In crockpot , combine soaked beans and 1 1 / 2 quarts fresh water
4. Cook for 3 hours on high
5. Stir in carrot , celery , onion , garlic , bell pepper , jalapeno , lentils , tomatoes , chili powder , cumin , oregano , black pepper , red wine vinegar and salt
6. Cook on low for 2-3 hours
7. Stir the rice into crockpot in the last hour
8. Puree half the soup in a blender , then pour back into the pot before serving
9. Serve with lime wedge , plain yogurt , and cilantro

title: mark bittman s qunioa salad with tempeh
steps:
1. Cook the quinoa
2. Rinse and drain in a fine strainer
3. Meanwhile , put the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat
4. When hot , add the tempeh and cook , stirring occasionally , until crisp , about 10 minutes
5. Stir in the ginger and garlic
6. Cook for another minute or two
7. Stir in the tomato , if using them
8. Stir and turn off the heat
9. Stir in the vinegar , sesame oil , and soy sauce
10. Transfer to a serving bowl
11. When the quinoa is dry and cool , toss with the tempeh mixture and mung beans
12. Taste and add salt , if necessary , and add a healthy dose of black pepper
13. Garnish with scallions and cilantro

title: chicken cheese  enchilada soup
steps:
1. In a large pot , bring the chicken broth to a light boil
2. Add in chopped tomatoes
3. Simmer on low
4. Meanwhile , in a skillet , heat the butter , and saute the onion , add in the chiles
5. Cook 2-3 minutes
6. Stir in cumin and chili powder , then flour , blending well
7. Gradually add in the half and half
8. Stir to combine
9. Transfer the mixture into the pot with the broth
10. Cook at a bare simmer over very low heat for 15 minutes , stirring often
11. Add in the cheese and sour cream carefully , stirring often
12. Add in the cooked chicken
13. Mix until combined
14. Top with crushed tortilla chips , and grated cheddar sprinkled on top

title: cheese  broccoli  potato  chicken soup
steps:
1. In large pot or dutch oven , melt butter over med
2. Heat
3. Mix in flour , stirring constantly until a thick paste forms
4. Remove from pot , and set aside
5. In same pot , combine water , bouillon cubes , chicken , broccoli , potato , green onions , salt and pepper
6. Bring to a boil over high heat
7. Reduce heat to medium low , and simmer for 45 minutes
8. Stir in flour mixture a little bit at a time until soup thickens
9. Simmer 5 minutes
10. Reduce heat and stir in cream and sour cream
11. Mix in cheese , one cup at a time and stir until melted
12. 2 heads fresh broccoli , cut into florets can be used instead of the frozen broccoli
13. But add another potato in its place

title: chicken stewed with olives and onions
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large skillet on high heat
2. Sprinkle chicken with cinnamon , salt , and pepper , brown on all sides , and set aside
3. Turn the heat to medium-high , add the onions , minced garlic , and cook for 3 minutes , stirring continuously
4. Add the wine to remove the particles from the bottom of pan and reduce until almost dry
5. Add water , tomato paste , chopped olives and whole garlic cloves
6. Add chicken , cover , and simmer for 1 hour or until chicken is cooked through
7. Add broth as needed
8. Top with cheese , parsley and serve over rice

title: roasted carrots with lemon and olives
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Combine the carrots , garlic , olive oil , and lemon in a shallow baking dish
3. Stir to blend
4. Bake , stirring occasionally , until carrots are tender and lightly browned , about 45 minutes
5. Add the olives
6. Bake 10 minutes longer
7. Make sure carrots are cooked through , and remove from oven
8. Voila !

title: chili sausage supper
steps:
1. Brown sausage and onion in a large dutch oven
2. Drain well
3. Add all of the remaining except for noodles and cheese
4. Stir to mix well
5. Add noodles to pot and make sure that they are covered in liquid
6. Add more water or wine if necessary
7. Bring to a boil
8. Reduce heat and simmer at medium heat for 30 minutes
9. Add more water if noodles appear to be drying
10. Stir in cheese and serve

title: mike s candy apple martini
steps:
1. Add ice , vodka , butterscotch schnapps , dekuyper sour apple pucker schnapps , and cranberry juice to a cocktail shaker
2. Shake well for 4 seconds
3. Pour into a martini glass

title: vidalia onion risotto
steps:
1. Heat oil in saucepan over medium heat
2. Add onion and garlic , saute 1 minutes
3. Stir in rice
4. Add 1 / 2 cup broth , cook until liquid is nearly absorbed , stirring constantly
5. Add remaining broth 1 / 2 cup at a time , stirring constantly until each portion of broth is nearly absorbed before adding the next
6. Remove from heat , stir in 1 / 3 cup feta , parsley and parmesan
7. Spoon into serving bowl and top with 1 / 3 cup feta and pepper

title: chicken potato patties
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add the salt and chicken
2. Cook 5-10 minutes until done , then remove , let cool , and dice finely
3. In a bowl put the mashed potatoes , garlic , onion , egg , chicken , parsley , cinnamon , turmeric , cayenne and salt and pepper to taste
4. Mix well , if mixture is too dry add a little of the cooking liquid and then add enough flour , if needed , to easily form them into patties
5. Wet or flour your hands and form mixture into patties
6. In a heavy skillet heat 1 / 2 inch of oil to 350 degrees
7. Slide in the patties and cook until golden brown , 3-5 minutes per side
8. Do not crowd the pan , work in batches if necessary
9. Drain on paper towels and serve garnished with cilantro

title: seasoned mung bean sprouts  sukju namul muchim
steps:
1. Bring a pot of water to a boil , then blanch the mung bean sprouts by adding them to the water and leaving them for a minute or two , until they begin to soften
2. Immediately drain them but do not rinse ! let them to cool in the colander , occasionally giving them a toss
3. While they cool , slice the green onion on the bias into pieces about 2-3mm thick
4. Add these to the blanched bean sprouts , along with the garlic , salt , sesame seeds and sesame oil , then lightly toss until they are evenly coated
5. Once completely cooled , store in an airtight container

title: hummus with chipotles   a hint of orange
steps:
1. Place all the dip ingredients in a food processor except for zest
2. Process until smooth
3. Pour additional olive oil into feed tube over the garbanzo bean mixture to make a smooth mixture if needed
4. Taste then add zest if more orange flavor is desired
5. Transfer mixture to a serving bowl
6. Drizzle with olive oil
7. Sprinkle with paprika and parsley or cilantro

title: mushroom and rice bake
steps:
1. In microwave safe container place rice and broth , cover and cook on high 5 minutes
2. Saute mushrooms , onions , garlic for 5 minutes in butter on medium heat until onions are completely done
3. Mix canned soup with rice and broth and mix well until soup is blended
4. Add salt and pepper to taste , pinch of cayenne , parsley to color and add definition
5. Add in mushrooms and onions to dish and blend well
6. Pour into sprayed casserole cover with foil dish and bake 350 about 30-45 mintues

title: zucchini sauce for koftas oman
steps:
1. Saute the pepper , garlic , and red chili pepper in oil for 3 minutes
2. Add vinegar
3. Add chopped tomatoes and bay leaves
4. When it starts to boil , cover , turn to low
5. Cut zucchini in small pieces
6. Fry in same pan as cooked kofta
7. Saute for 5 minutes
8. Add zucchini , parsley , and mint to tomato sauce
9. Cover and cook until zucchini is soft
10. Pour over the kofta

title: strawberries lola
steps:
1. Wash , hull and drain strawberries and place in four dessert dishes
2. Top each dish with 1 tbsp sour cream and 1 tsp brown sugar

title: orange banana cream smoothie
steps:
1. Pour all liquid ingredients into smoothie maker or blender
2. Add all frozen ingredients
3. Blend at low setting for 30 seconds then high setting until smooth
4. Serve immediately

title: poached egg and toast salad
steps:
1. Whisk all the dressing ingredients together and set aside
2. Poach eggs to desired doneness
3. Toss greens with salad dressing
4. Toast the bread , tear it into pieces and toss it with the salad
5. Place the salad on four plates and top each with an egg
6. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste and garnish with sprouts

title: pumpkin chorizo paella
steps:
1. For roasted tomatoes:
2. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
3. Toss together chopped tomatoes , honey , olive oil , and salt and pepper to taste
4. Place on a lightly greased baking sheet
5. Roast in oven approximately 20 minutes
6. For saffron rice:
7. Bring chicken broth to boil
8. Add saffron and arborio rice
9. Bring back up to boil , then reduce to simmer
10. Simmer , covered , about 20 minute do not drain rice before adding to paella mixture
11. For paella:
12. Brown sausage , onion and garlic in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
13. Break sausage up into small chunks using the back of a wooden spoon
14. When brown , stir in saffron rice , roasted tomatoes , pumpkin , peas and spices
15. Simmer over medium-low heat until thickened , 5-10 minutes
16. Serve warm , garnished with fresh parsley and chives

title: mouthwatering meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix together hamburger , crumbs , egg , onion , salt , pepper , and half of tomato sauce
3. Form into a loaf in center of a 9x13 cake pan
4. In a bowl mix together rest of tomato sauce and all other ingredients
5. Pour over meatloaf and bake for 1 1 / 2 hours , be sure to baste meatloaf halfway through bake time

title: danish brovst dream coffee cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f and place rack in middle of oven
2. Place a large saucepan on the stove half filled with water and bring to a boil
3. Place a large bowl on top of the saucepan , be careful not to burn yourself on the steam from the boiling water
4. Add eggs and sugar and whisk till it is thick
5. Remove bowl from saucepan
6. Turn of burner
7. Sift flour and baking powder together , and carefully fold into the egg and sugar mixture
8. Melt butter and add milk either in a sauce pan on the stove or in a glass dish in the microwave
9. Carefully add the milk and butter mixture to the dough
10. Grease or line with parchment paper a 9x13 inch baking dish and pour the dough into it
11. Place in preheated oven on the middle rack ca
12. 20 minutes or till a toothpick comes out clean
13. Prepare filling while cake is baking
14. Mix filling ingredients in a saucepan or in a glass dish and heat through , set aside till cake is baked
15. Turn oven op till 225 c or 450 f
16. Pour filling on top of the baked cake , and place back in the oven and bake ca
17. 5 minutes
18. Cool and serve

title: avocado  tomato and jack cheese salsa
steps:
1. In large bowl , mix all ingredients
2. Cover and chill until ready to serve

title: all american hamburgers
steps:
1. Combine the hamburger mix ingredients
2. Store in airtight container in fridge
3. In a medium bowl , mix ground beef and 1 / 2 cup hamburger mix until well combined
4. Divide the beef mixture into 5 equal parts and form each into 1 / 2-inch patties
5. Grill until the internal temperature reaches 160 , about 5 to 7 minutes per side
6. Or you can cook on top of the stove
7. Serve on buns with your favorite burger toppings

title: healthy peanut butter dip
steps:
1. Whisk all the ingredients together in a large bowl
2. Serve chilled with fruit , pretzels , cookies , or whatever sounds good to you

title: claire robinson s rosemary pork tenderloin
steps:
1. Mix together the dijon mustard , fresh ground black pepper , chopped rosemary , and minced garlic
2. Take a 1 gallon bag and empty marinade inches add pork tenderloins , seal bag , and mix around until covered
3. Marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour
4. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
5. Place the rosemary sprigs and smashed garlic in the center of a roasting pan
6. Remove the tenderloins from the bag and top each with 2 slices of maple bacon
7. Tie three pieces of kitchen twine around each of the tenderloins and bacon and place into your roasting pan
8. Place the roasting pan in the oven and bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until an instant-read thermometer registers 160f when inserted into the tenderloin
9. Remove from oven and let sit for 5 to 10 minutes on a cutting board
10. Remove kitchen twine and slice
11. Garnish with the rosemary sprigs and garlic

title: maple syrup banana muffins
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400f
2. Sift together the dry ingredients
3. Set aside
4. Whisk together the wet ingredients until well-blended
5. Stir in the bananas
6. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until just combined
7. Bake for 25-30 minutes or until cake tester comes out clean

title: vegan raw chocolate cherry  ice cream
steps:
1. Peel and chop the banana , then freeze solid
2. Process all ingredients in a blender or food processor until combined into a smooth consistency , similar to soft-serve ice cream
3. Either enjoy right away or allow to set in freezer until firm

title: curried fish
steps:
1. Melt butter in a pan , and cook diced fish until just cooked through
2. Remove fish , and set aside
3. Add the onions and capsicum to the pan , and cook until tender
4. Melt butter in microwave
5. Add flour & curry powder , microwave for 30 seconds
6. Slowly add milk , whisking to keep it smooth
7. Add mayonnaise
8. Microwave for 3 minutes , whisk , and microwave for a further 2 minutes
9. Add lemon juice & parsley
10. Microwave 1 minute
11. If sauce hasn't thickened , cook in 30 second intervals , until thick and creamy
12. Add eggs , stirring well
13. Add fish , onion , and capsicumto sauce , stirring gently to combine
14. Enjoy !

title: coconut pudding with raspberry sauce
steps:
1. In medium saucepan , stir together the sugar , gelatin , salt and milk
2. Cook over medium heat until the gelatin dissolves and the mixture is clear
3. Chill till partially set
4. Stir once and add the vanilla
5. Fold in the coconut and heavy cream
6. Pour into a pudding mold and chill till firm , about 4 hours
7. To make raspberry sauce: cook raspberries with juice , and sugar , over medium heat until boiling
8. Mix the water and cornstarch
9. Stir into the raspberries
10. Boil rapidly for 1 minute , stirring constantly
11. Cool and serve with pudding

title: saucy citrus garlic chicken breasts  microwaved   easy
steps:
1. Place frozen chicken breasts in a ziplock baggie
2. Juice your lemon and lime
3. You should have 1 / 4 cup of juice
4. Whisk the juice , oil and garlic and pour mixture into the baggie over top the chicken
5. Seal and place in fridge to marinate for approximately 24-30 hours
6. 1 hour prior to cooking , remove chicken from the fridge and let it come to room temperature
7. Remove chicken from marinade , season both sides with salt and pepper , and place in a baking dish
8. Discard your marinade
9. Cover the dish lightly with wax paper
10. Cook in microwave on power level 7 for 10-12 minutes , turning the chicken over half way through cooking
11. I recommend checking the chicken for doneness after 10 minutes so as not to overcook , then just do 1 extra minute at a time from there
12. When you poke with a fork , the juices should run clear
13. When chicken is cooked , remove it from the drippings and place on a plate
14. Pour the drippings into a small sauce pan , add butter and place on med-high heat
15. Mix the cornstarch and water
16. Add it to the sauce pan and bring to a boil , then turn down and simmer 2 minutes or until desired thickness
17. Add capers to sauce
18. Serve chicken with a small amount of sauce poured over top and a side of rice and some asparagus spears for a wonderful meal

title: la junta jalapeno steaks
steps:
1. Heat olive oil and 2 tablespoons of butter in a heavy skillet
2. Brown the steaks on both sides
3. Reduce the heat and cook gently until they are medium rare or desired doneness
4. Remove from the pan and keep warm
5. Pour off the fat only
6. Add the remaining butter to the remaining pan juices
7. Add the onion and chopped jalapenos and simmer , stirring constantly until softened
8. Add the red wine , bring to a boil and deglaze the pan , scraping up any browned bits
9. Add the black pepper , stock , and cream and bring to a boil
10. Reduce the heat and simmer until the sauce is smooth and thick
11. Place the steaks on a plate , pour the sauce over top , and garnish with jalapeno slivers and cilantro

title: macaroni and cheese for grownups
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a heavy skillet
2. Add the onion and saute on medium heat until softened and mostly cooked-about 10 minutes
3. Add the garlic and cook for one more minute-be careful not to brown the garlic
4. Whisk the flour in
5. Cook while stirring for three minutes
6. Uncooked flour tastes bad !
7. Whisk in the milk
8. Continue to stir until the mixture barely begins to boil
9. It should be a little bubbly and beginning to thicken
10. Add the vinegar while whisking-if the milk is hot it won't curdle and the vinegar brightens up the sauce
11. Add salt and pepper to taste
12. If you don't want black flecks use white pepper instead
13. Add a dash of tobasco
14. Taste then add more if you like
15. Stir in the pepperoncinis or jalapenos
16. You need to experiment-make this a few times and decide exactly how much of which pepper you like
17. Stir in your favorite cheeses
18. I like to combine sharp cheddar with a little crumbled bleu
19. Swiss is good for flavor but not texture so blend with something creamy like fontina
20. Monterey jack is very creamy but without a lot of flavor so add something sharp and flavorful
21. Pour the macaroni into a large baking pan
22. Pour the sauce over and gently mix
23. Sprinkle the parmesan and bread crumbs on top
24. Bake at 350 degrees until browned on top-about 25 minutes or so
25. Let sit for 10 minutes then serve
26. You may never even consider boxed mac-n-cheese again

title: rustic honey baked nectarines
steps:
1. Set oven temp to 350 degrees
2. Remove stones and place cut nectarines on the parchment paper in an oven proof dish or pan facing up
3. Drizzle honey , vanilla and sprinkle brown sugar over the top
4. Bake for 15 minutess , scoop up the juices from the bottom of the pan and coat nectarines and bake for an additional 15 minutes or until golden and sticky
5. Serve with yoghurt , drizzled with honey

title: meatless elk roast
steps:
1. Sautee first 3 ingredients together
2. In large bowl , combine the rest on the ingredients
3. Add sauteed to ingredients in large bowl and mix
4. Press into baking pan or 9x12 casserole
5. Mix together first 4 topping ingredients , then add water
6. Spread on topping
7. Bake@ 350 for 30-45 minute !
8. Yum !

title: no cook tomato pizza sauce
steps:
1. Mix ingredients in a bowl , cover with plastic wrap , and refrigerate overnight
2. Use about 1 / 2 cup to sauce a 13" crust

title: subway sweet onion sauce
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a small microwave-safe bowl
2. Heat mixture uncovered in the microwave for 1 to 1 1 / 2 minutes on high until mixture boils rapidly
3. Whisk well , cover and cool
4. Alternatively , bring to a boil on top of stove

title: creamy corn scallop
steps:
1. Butter a 1-quart casserole and set aside
2. In a medium bowl , combine your choice of cream soup , onion , and pepper
3. In the casserole , arrange alternate layers of the soup mixture , drained corn , and crumbled crackers
4. Dot top with butter
5. Bake in 400 degree oven for 25 minutes

title: pasta for the kids
steps:
1. Cook pasta al dente in salted water
2. Add peas 1 minute before end of cook time
3. Drain and return pasta and peas to pot
4. Meanwhile , combine cream and broth in a large skillet , simmer until slightly thickened , about 7 minutes
5. Stir in parmesan cheese , stirring until melted
6. Add sauce to pasta and peas and toss to combine
7. Season with salt and pepper and garnish with extra parmesan cheese

title: my easy go to breakfast sandwich
steps:
1. Put bread in the toaster
2. Cook the eggs whites via skillet or covered in the microwave for about 2-2:30 minutes
3. Once the toast is done , sprinkle the balsamic vinegar on one slice
4. Top that slice with the tomato slices , cooked egg whites , and the final slice of bread
5. Enjoy !

title: sweet turkey and herb roll ups
steps:
1. Mix softened cream cheese , applesauce , and thyme together until blended smooth
2. Spread evenly onto tortillas
3. Layer turkey on top of cream cheese , covering half of the tortilla from edge to edge
4. Roll from covered side of tortilla towards side with only cheese mixture
5. Wrap in plastic and refrigerate at least two hours to firm up
6. Slice into 1 inch slices and serve
7. :)

title: 2bleu s spinach and artichoke dip with bacon
steps:
1. Oven: preheat oven to 350f combine all ingredients and bake in an ovenproof casserole dish for 25-30 minutes until bubbly
2. Microwave: combine all ingredients except bacon in microwaveable bowl
3. Microwave on high for 2 minutes then stir well
4. Repeat this step 3 more times or until cheese is completely melted and mixture is well blended
5. Stir in the crumbled bacon during the final heating or sprinkle on top
6. Bread bowl: heat as directed for microwave till dip is warm
7. Place dip into the center of a hollowed out bread loaf
8. Bake at 350f for 20 minutes

title: homemade sourdough croutons
steps:
1. Cut the loaf in half lengthwise and scoop out all the soft bread do not use the crust
2. Tear the bread into to chunks
3. Whisk or blend together the oil , salt , pepper , garlic and mixed spices
4. Toss the bread chunks in the oil mixture , making sure that they are all coated
5. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees
6. Place them on a large baking sheet and place in a 300-degree oven for 15- 20 minutes , turning them ever 5 minutes , until they are golden brown

title: pizza toast   university student style
steps:
1. If using conventional oven , preheat to"hot"
2. Chop / slice / grate toppings
3. Spread ketcup or pasta sauce on bread slices
4. If desired add salt , pepper , garlic poweder to taste if ketchup is too sweet
5. I'm lazy , so i just use ketchup
6. Residence means that i don't have all the spices
7. Place toppings on bread
8. Put more on-- c'mon , it's all good
9. Sprinkle on grated cheese , again to preference
10. I like lots and lots of cheese
11. Put more cheese-- c'mon , you know you want it to be gooey
12. Put in oven until cheese melts and / or it's heated through
13. Ifyou took my advice and heaped on the cheese , then it might be wise to lower the temperature and heat it through slowly
