14. I usually just use the middle setting on my toaster oven and it's done in less than 5 minutes

title: crock pot honeyed lamb
steps:
1. Preheat crock pot on high
2. Heat butter in large skillet and brown lamb on all sides
3. Season with salt and pepper
4. Transfer to crock pot
5. Stir the cornstarch and ginger into the butter mixing well
6. Add cider and honey and bring to the boil , stirring continuously
7. Pour the mixture over the lamb
8. Sprinkle with rosemary
9. Cook on high for 5-7 hours or until cooked through depending on your crock pot
10. Baste once or twice during cooking

title: greek tuna
steps:
1. Drain tuna
2. Mix with celery , tzatziki , and feta in small bowl
3. Microwave pita bread for 10 - 20 seconds to increase pliability
4. Either slice one end off and open into a pocket , or use as flat bread
5. If using lettuce , tomato , and / or pickle , layer on / in pita bread , then spoon tuna mix into pita and enjoy !

title: cardamom cookies   kardemommekager
steps:
1. Mix ingredients in order given
2. Roll into balls
3. Flatten down to the size of a fifty-cent piece
4. Bake on a greased and floured cookie sheet in a preheated 350 oven until lightly browned on the edges

title: steak  spinach sesame salad
steps:
1. Boil the beef broth with the chopped steak-umms until cooked and reduced to 1 / 4 cup
2. If using roast beef , you don't need to cook it , just chop and add it to the cooked broth
3. Whisk sesame oil , lemon juice , tahini , and soy sauce together
4. Add ginger and stock
5. Put spinach , red onion , and mushrooms in a bowl
6. Add tomatoes
7. Pour dressing on
8. Grind in pepper
9. Toss
10. Sprinkle sesame seeds on top

title: pasta tomato carbonara
steps:
1. Cook bacon in large skillet until crisp
2. Drain on paper towels , reserving drippings
3. Drain off part of the drippings , leaving enough to saute the garlic and onion
4. Crumble bacon
5. Set aside
6. Stir the onion and garlic into the bacon drippings
7. Cook until onion is tender but not brown
8. Add tomatoes with liquid , basil , and salt
9. Bring to a boil over medium heat
10. Reduce heat
11. Simmer 20 minutes , stirring occasionally
12. Cook pasta according to package directions
13. Add tomato mixture and reserved crumbled bacon to pasta
14. Toss lightly and enjoy !

title: four cheese mini penne bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Cook pasta in boiling salted water according to package directions
3. Drain and rinse
4. Set aside
5. Grease a 2-quart casserole
6. In a large saucepan , melt 2 tablespoons of the butter over medium heat
7. Add flour and cook , stirring , until bubbly
8. Gradually stir in the milk and continue cooking , stirring , until thickened
9. Add the cheddar , gruyere , havarti cheeses , and half of the parmesan cheese
10. Continue cooking , stirring , until cheeses have melted
11. Add salt , pepper , and nutmeg
12. Stir the drained pasta and cheese mixture together
13. Spoon pasta and cheese mixture into the prepared casserole
14. Put bread crumbs in a small bowl with the remaining parmesan cheese and paprika
15. Melt the remaining tablespoon of butter and drizzle over the bread crumb mixture
16. Toss to blend
17. Sprinkle the bread crumb mixture over the pasta
18. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes , until bubbly
19. Increase temperature to 400 and bake for about 8 to 10 minutes longer , until topping is browned

title: stuffed eggs
steps:
1. Cut the eggs in half lengthwise and set aside the egg whites
2. Scoop out the yolks into a fine strainer and rub the yolks into a bowl
3. Mash the sardines with a fork
4. Mix in the egg yolks
5. Add lemon juice and tabasco
6. Add enough mayonnaise to made a past and season with salt and pepper
7. Spoon the filling into the egg whites mounding it slightly
8. Dip each egg half in the flour , then in the beaten egg , then in the bread crumbs
9. Heat the vegetable oil for deep-frying to 350-375
10. Deep fry the egg halves for 2 minutes or until golden brown
11. Drain on paper toweling and serve hot , garnished with parsley sprigs

title: chili lover s chili
steps:
1. Brown beef and pork
2. Drain
3. Steam or boil the browned meat to remove the fat
4. Drain meat again and place back in pan and add onion , celery , green pepper , and some of the dry seasonings above to season the meat mixture
5. Add all ingredients except beans to a large pot
6. Simmer on low for 2-3 hours , adding beans the last half hour of cooking time

title: white bean and tofu stuffed shells
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Place sundried tomatoes in a small bowl , cover with hot water
3. Cover and let stand 10 minutes
4. Drain well and chop
5. Place tofu in a food processor , and process until smooth
6. Spoon tofu onto several layers of heavy duty paper towels , and spread to 1 / 2" thickeness
7. Cover with additional paper towels , and let stand 5 minutes
8. Scrape pureed tofu into food processor using a rubber spatula
9. Add chopped sundried tomatoes , beans , mozzarella cheese , basil , italian seasoning , pepper , and garlic
10. Pulse until beans are coarsely chopped
11. Spread 1 cup of pasta sauce on bottom of a 13x9" baking dish coated with cooking spray
12. Spoon 1 / 4 cup tofu mixture into each pasta shell , and arrange shells in baking dish
13. Spoon remaining pasta sauce over shells , and sprinkle 1 / 2 cup mozzarella cheese and paramesan cheese evenly over shells
14. Bake ate 375f for 30 minutes or until mozzarella cheese begins to brown
15. Garnish with fresh basil , if desired
16. Yield: 7 servings enjoy !
17. Points-9

title: ground beef and sausage pie  pastry or potato topped
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a round or oval baking dish
3. In a large skillet brown the ground beef and italian sausages with dried chili flakes , onion , garlic , celery , worcestershire sauce and carrots until the ground beef is no longer pink drain fat
4. Add in grated parmesan cheese , sliced mushrooms and corn
5. Mix to combine
6. Add in the broth or consomme
7. Simmer for 15 minutes
8. Season with salt and black pepper to taste
9. In a small cup whisk together 2 tablespoons soft butter with the flour and add into the simmering mixture
10. Stir with a wooden spoon until thickened
11. Transfer the mixture to prepared baking dish
12. Top with prepared pastry leaving 1-inch overhang , turn the edges under and press firmly to the inside of the dish , then flute
13. Cut slits in the top to allow steam to escape
14. Bake for about 35-40 minutes or until the pastry is browned and the pie is bubbley
15. Let sit 15 minutes before serving

title: fried leeks  garnish
steps:
1. In a medium sauce pot heat oil to 350 degrees f
2. Sift cornstarch and flour together
3. Dust leeks in flour / cornstarch and fry until golden brown , about 30 seconds
4. Drain on a paper towel , season with sea salt

title: steak pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Spread crust with garlic butter
3. In a large non-stick skillet , heat oil and add onion , mushroom , peppers
4. Cook until vegetables are soft , about 10 minutes
5. Push veges to one side of the pan and add steak-ums and cook until done , about 5 minutes
6. Mix with veges
7. Add salt and pepper
8. If using sliced roast beef , add to pan with veges and heat through
9. Add salt and pepper
10. Place onto pizza crust
11. Add cheese
12. Bake for 10-12 minutes

title: ham and macaroni casserole
steps:
1. Cook macaroni , add the broccoli to the water the last 3 minutes of cooking
2. Drain
3. Add all other ingredients except parmesan cheese
4. Mix well
5. Put in casserole dish
6. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes
7. Sprinkle with parmesan and bake 5 more minutes

title: coconut shrimp
steps:
1. You will need a ziptop plastic baggie , 2 shallow bowls and a platter set out before you begin
2. Preheat a large skillet over medium-ish heat and heat enough oil to coat the bottom of the pan plus a bit extra
3. In one bowl , whisk together a batter using the egg , beer , baking powder , 3 / 4 cup flour and some salt & pepper to taste , whisking until there are no more big lumps
4. Place some extra flour into a ziptop plastic baggie
5. Place coconut in a separate shallow bowl
6. :drop all your shrimp into the baggie , seal bag , and shake until all are lightly dusted with flour
7. :remove from bag and shake off excess flour
8. Grab 1 shrimp at a time and dip into the beer mixture , holding the tail , and letting excess drip off
9. :next , drop the wet shrimp into the coconut and roll it around , pressing so the coconut sticks
10. Set onto a platter and repeat until all the shrimp are coated
11. Once all of your shrimp are coated with coconut , fry them in batches of about 6-8 in the heated oil just a few minutes , flipping once to brown & crisp both sides
12. Drain on paper towels and serve with sweet & sour dip

title: zucchini boats on the grill
steps:
1. Prepare the grill for indirect heat
2. Place the zucchini in a pot with enough water to cover
3. Bring to a boil , and cook 5 - 10 minutes
4. Drain , cool , and cut in half lengthwise
5. Scoop out the pulp to about 1 / 4 inch from the skin
6. Chop pulp
7. In a bowl , mix the zucchini pulp with all of the other ingredients
8. Stuff the zucchini halves with the pulp mixture
9. Seal each zucchini half in aluminum foil
10. Place the foil packets on the prepared grill over indirect heat
11. Cook 15 - 25 minutes
12. Use your imagination , you could "clean-out-the-fridge" and make endless combinations of stuffed zucchini !

title: liptoi cheese spread
steps:
1. Mix butter with cottage cheese to blend well
2. Add remaining ingredients
3. Mix well again
4. Refrigerate for a minimum of 3 hours so that it becomes firm
5. Serve as a mound with dark bread

title: easy raspberry cream tart
steps:
1. Press cookie dough slices into bottom and fluted sides of a greased 11" tart pan with removable bottom , do not prick
2. Bake 20 minute at 350
3. In a small mixing bowl , beat cream cheese on high for 30 seconds , add 1 / 4 celsius sugar , egg , lemon zest , juice and vanilla , beat until combined
4. Pour cheese mixture over warm crust , spread evenly
5. Place raspberries in a single layer on top of cheese mixture , sprinkle with 2 teaspoons sugar
6. Bake 15-17 min or until cheese mixture is set
7. Transfer to a wire rack , let cool 30 minute before serving
8. Just before serving sprinkle with powdered sugar & garnish with additional fresh berries , if you like

title: sophisticated steak
steps:
1. Saute steak in oil until brown
2. Add onions , carrots , broth , mushrooms , salt , garlic powder , pepper , and celery
3. Cook until tender
4. Stir together cornstarch and water
5. Add to steak mixture , stirring constantly until thickened

title: no raw egg caesar salad dressing
steps:
1. You can prepare this dressing by hand with a whisk and some elbow grease , but it's easier to use a blender or food processor
2. Put all ingredients except oils and parmesan in bowl of food processor or blender and combine well
3. With food processor running , slowly dribble in oils--or slowly whisk in oils , if making by hand
4. You could use either all olive oil or all canola oil , but i prefer to use both
5. Lastly , blend in the parmesan
6. Taste
7. Adjust seasonings as you wish
8. Either use right away , or refrigerate
9. It thickens when chilled , however , so you may have to give it a little whisk to loosen it up if you've stashed it in the fridge
10. This dressing makes enough to dress one large caesar salad

title: 5 layer bars
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine the graham cracker crumbs and melted butter in a bowl
3. Press into the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish
4. Sprinkle pecans , coconut flakes , butterscotch chips and chocolate chips on top in layers
5. Pour can of sweetened condensed milk over mixture and bake for 30 minutes
6. Let cool and cut into bars

title: grandma vera s german potato salad recipe
steps:
1. Boil potatoes and drain , set aside to cool
2. Fry bacon , reserve 4 tbsp of the drippings
3. Fry diced onion in drippings until soft
4. Stir into the dripping the flour and stir well until brown
5. Add to browned mixture your water , vinegar and sugar
6. Stir fast so it does not lump up on you
7. It should get bubbly and thicken up
8. Pour hot mixture over potatoes
9. Add crumbled cooled bacon
10. Stir in celery seed and salt and pepper
11. You can add sliced up green onions on top if you would like
12. The sauce is easily doubled if you like it saucier
13. I use splenda instead of sugar and it works great

title: cool caesar tortellini salad
steps:
1. Cook tortellini according to package directions
2. Drain
3. Rinse with cold water
4. Drain again
5. Combine pasta , tomato halves and next 6 ingredients
6. Toss well
7. Cover and chill thoroughly
8. Serve over shredded lettuce

title: slow cooker moroccan spiced chicken
steps:
1. In a gallon-size resealable plastic bag , combine chicken thighs with cumin , coriander , pumpkin pie spice , salt , and pepper
2. Refrigerate overnight
3. In a 6- to 7-quart slow cooker bowl , combine chicken broth with tomatoes , beans , sweet potato , onion , and apricots
4. Place chicken in slow cooker on top of vegetables
5. Cover and cook on low setting for 5 hours or until chicken is cooked through
6. Transfer chicken to cutting board
7. Skim and discard fat from cooking liquid
8. Stir in 1 / 4 t
9. Salt into cooking liquid , if necessary

title: home baked macaroni   cheese
steps:
1. Prepare macaroni per package instructions
2. Drain macaroni well , return to pot while still warm
3. Add velveeta , cream cheese , salt & pepper
4. Stir until cheeses are melted , then add cream and stir until a creamy sauce has formed
5. Pour 1 / 2 the macaroni into a non-stick or greased casserole dish
6. Sprinkle 8 oz of the shredded cheese on top
7. Add the rest of the macaroni and sprinkle another 4 oz of the cheese on top
8. Cover casserole
9. Bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes
10. Remove cover , sprinkle remainder of shredded cheese on top and bake an additional 10-15 minutes , until cheese is bubbly and just beginning to brown around the edges

title: drake hogestyn s salad pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Cover crust with mozzarella cheese and bake about 15 minutes , until crust is lightly browned and cheese is bubbling
3. Remove from oven and quickly spread crust with sour cream
4. Mix remaining ingredients in a bowl , adding hot sauce to taste
5. Spread mixture over sour cream and it's ready

title: cauliflower casserole with stuffing topping
steps:
1. Cook and drain cauliflower
2. Place in a 2-quart casserole
3. Melt butter , stir in flour and cook a few minutes , stirring constantly
4. Remove from heat and blend in milk
5. Return to stove and bring to a boil , stirring constantly
6. Simmer until thickened
7. Add salt and pepper
8. Pour over cauliflower in casserole
9. Topping: combine stuffing mix , water and butter
10. Spoon on top of casserole , pressing down
11. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes

title: chicken cauliflower curry
steps:
1. Cut chicken crosswise into strips
2. In large skillet , heat 1 tbsp of the oil over medium-high heat
3. Brown chicken , in batches and adding more oil as necessary
4. Transfer to bowl
5. Drain fat from skillet
6. In same skillet , fry onion , jalapeno pepper and salt , stirring occasionally , until softened , about 3 minutes
7. Add curry paste
8. Cook , stirring , until fragrant , about 1 minute
9. Drain tomatoes and add to skillet
10. Return chicken to pan
11. Stir in cauliflower florets , diced apple and raisins
12. Cover and simmer until cauliflower is tender , about 10 minutes
13. Add peas and half of the cilantro
14. Simmer , covered , until steaming , about 5 minutes
15. Sprinkle with remaining cilantro

title: watermelon shirley temple
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a blender
2. Blend , then pour over crushed ice and strain into glass
3. Enjoy !

title: fast and easy tangerine sauce
steps:
1. Put 1 cup of tangerine juice in sauce pan along with lemon juice , butter , and salt
2. Put pan on low heat
3. You want to heat up the mixture without boiling it
4. The butter should be completely melted and sauce steaming
5. While the main ingredients are heating up , mix the remaining 1 / 2 cup of tangerine juice with the corn starch and mix until smooth
6. Once the sauce is steaming slowly whisk the corn starch mixture into the pan
7. Keep whisking until sauce thickens
8. Once sauce has thickened , remove from heat and serve over you favorite steamed vegetables , fish , or chicken

title: bulgur stuffed cabbage
steps:
1. Remove core from cabbage , place cabbage head in steamer and steam until all leaves are soft and separate easily
2. Saute parsley , onions , celery , seasoning , and garlic in olive oil until onions are soft
3. Add 2 15-ounce cans of tomato sauce , 4 cups water and bulgur
4. Cook about 1 / 2 hour over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until bulgur is tender
5. Remove from heat
6. To stuff cabbage leaves , place a spoonful of mixture in center of each leaf
7. Starting at one side , roll leaf up and fold ends under
8. Place in a deep baking pan
9. Mix the 8-ounce can of tomato sauce with 1 / 2 cup water and pour over stuffed cabbage leaves so they remain moist during baking
10. Bake at 375f for about 30 minutes until cabbage is hot

title: butter rum baked apples
steps:
1. Preheat dutch oven to 450f
2. Cut off top third of each apple and reserve
3. Scoop out seeds and some of flesh from apples using a melon-ball cutter or round teaspoon measure to form a cavity
4. Stand apples in dutch oven tightly
5. Heat remaining ingredients in a small saucepan over moderate heat , stirring , until sugar is dissolved
6. Pour some of syrup into cavity of each apple and remainder into dutch oven
7. Return apple tops to apples and cover oven
8. Bake in oven until apples are tender , 25 to 30 minutes
9. Makes 8 servings

title: mango ginger marmalade
steps:
1. Peel the rind from the lemon , and cut into thin strips
2. Squeeze lemon , reserving the juice
3. Chop the pulp , placing the pulp and ginger on a square of cheesecloth
4. Tie cheesecloth with a string
5. Cook lemon zest , spice bag and mango in saucepan over medium heat , stirring now and then , for 30 minutes
6. Add sugar and lemon juice
7. Bring it to a boil over medium heat , continue to boil , stirring often , for 10 minutes or until thickened
8. Discard your spice bag
9. Pour into hot jars , filling to 1 / 2 inch from the top of the jar
10. Remove the air bubbles carefully
11. Wipe all the jar rims
12. Cover at once with metal lids , and screw on bands
13. Process in boiling water bath for 10 minutes
14. Store in dark , cool space

title: grilled sirloin in bourbon marinade
steps:
1. Prepare marinade ingredients: pour water , bourbon , soy sauce , honey , dry mustard , and garlic powder into a large zip top bag
2. Seal bag and lay flat on the counter
3. Massage the bag with your fingers to dissolve any mustard and garlic powder granules and mix the ingredients
4. Add steak to the bag
5. Refrigerate overnight , or for at least six hours , turning occasionally
6. Place bag on counter about an hour before grilling
7. Turn after 30 minutes
8. Remove steak and discard marinade
9. For 1" steaks , grill about 10 minutes per side , or until about 140-145 degrees
10. Remove from grill , and cover steaks for about 10 minutes before serving
11. Can serve as steaks , or slice thinly across the grain before serving

title: easy breakfast nacho bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine sausage , eggs and green onions in medium bowl
3. Pour butter in medium baking dish
4. Add sausage mixture
5. Top with chips
6. Sprinkle with cheese
7. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes , or until eggs are set and cheese is melted
8. Top with salsa
9. Serve immediately

title: italian tartufo
steps:
1. Soak cherries in rum
2. Sift sugar
3. Cocoa , and instant coffee together and place in a heavy sauce pan
4. Add the water and mix well
5. Bring to a boil and cook until everything is well mixed
6. While syrup is cooking , whip the egg yolks until light and fluffy
7. Reduce the speed of the beaters to the lowest level and add the hot syrup in a continuous fine stream
8. Continue beating until the mixture is thick and forms a ribbon pattern when the beater is pulled away
9. Chill well
10. Whip the cream with the 2 tablespoons of rum until stiff
11. Fold into the chocolate mixture
12. Fold in the chopped chocolate
13. Arrange foil lined paper cups in a muffin pan
14. Fill each cup 1 / 3 of the way full
15. Place a cherry in each cup then fill the rest of the way
16. Freeze at least 4 hours
17. Before serving pipe whipping cream on top if desired
18. It will keep in the freezer for about a month wrapped tightly in aluminum foil

title: potato leek soup in bread bowls
steps:
1. Cut tops form bread about 3 / 4" thick to make "lids"
2. Using a sharp knife , cut around inside of loaf leaving 3 / 4" edge for the "bowl"
3. Hollow out the center
4. Rub the inside of the bread b owls and "lids" with garlic and brush with olive oil
5. Bake lids and bowls on cookie sheet at 350 degrees until slightly toasted
6. Serve soup in bowls
7. In large pot , combine potatoes , leeks , chicken broth , salt and pepper
8. Bring to a boil
9. Reduce heat to low
10. Cover and simmer 15-20 minutes or until vegetables are tender
11. Strain soup into another pan
12. Place cooked potatoes and leeks in blender or food processor with about 1 / 4 cup broth and process until smooth
13. Return to pan
14. Stir in cream and nutmeg
15. Spoon into hot prepared bread bowls
16. Sprinkle with parsley

title: french lace cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375
2. Sift flour and blend with nuts
3. Bring corn syrup , shortening , and sugar to boil in saucepan over medium heat , stirring constantly
4. Remove from heat
5. Gradually stir in flour and nuts
6. Drop batter by level teaspoonfuls about 3 inches apart on baking sheet covered with wax paper
7. Bake 5-6 min
8. Allow to stand 5 minutes before removing

title: big biscuit barbecues
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 degrees
2. Lightly grease cookie sheet
3. Brown ground beef and onion
4. Drain
5. Stir in barbecue sauce
6. Cool while preparing biscuits
7. Separate biscuit dough into 10 biscuits
8. On waxed paper , pat or roll out 5 biscuits to 4 1 / 2-inch circles
9. Place 5 flattened biscuits on greased cookie sheet
10. Top each with rounded tablespoon of cheese
11. Spread to within 1 / 4-inch of edges
12. Arrange 3 pickles slices over each
13. Spoon 1 / 2 cup meat mixture over pickles
14. Flatten meat slightly
15. On waxed paper , press or roll remaining 5 biscuits to 5-inch circles
16. Place over meat
17. Press edges with fork to seal
18. Brush with margarine
19. Sprinkle with sesame seed
20. Bake at 375 degrees for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown

title: diabetic friendly blueberry muffins
steps:
1. Combine first 6 ingredients in a medium bowl
2. Add blueberries , and toss to coat
3. Make a well in center of flour mixture
4. Combine milk and next 5 ingredients
5. Add to flour mixture , stirring just until dry ingredients are moistened
6. Spoon batter into muffin pans coated with cooking spray , filling two-thirds full
7. Bake at 400 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden
8. Remove muffins from pans immediately , and cool on wire racks

title: make ahead ham and cheddar egg dish
steps:
1. Trim crusts from bread
2. Spray a rectangular 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish with cooking spray
3. Arrange 6 slices of bread in the dish
4. Layer ham , cheese and onions on top of the bread
5. Cut remaining bread slices diagonally into halves
6. Place along the outer rim of the dish , points facing inward
7. Beat milk , mustard , pepper sauce and eggs until smooth
8. Pour evenly over bread
9. Sprinkle with paprika
10. You can either bake immediately , or cover and refrigerate up to 24 hours
11. Heat oven to 300 degrees
12. Bake uncovered for about 60 to 70 minutes , until center is set and bread is golden brown
13. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting

title: zesty pork roast
steps:
1. In small bowl , mix cranberry sauce , apricots , orange zest and juice , shallot , vinegar , mustard , salt and ginger , then add to slow cooker
2. Add pork , and spoon some of the cranberry sauce on top
3. Cover and cook on low 7-9 hours or until pork is tender
4. Spoon off fat from top of cranberry mixture in slow cooker , then place pork on a cutting board
5. Slice into thick slices and serve topped with sauce

title: crunchy floret salad
steps:
1. Whisk together the mayonnaise , sugar , cider vinegar , and salt in a small bowl
2. Pour over veggies
3. Add cheese and bacon , tossing to coat
4. Serve chilled

title: buttery breakfast biscuits
steps:
1. In a bowl stir together flour , sugar , baking powder , cream of tartar , and salt
2. Using a pastry blender , cut in margarine till mixture resembles coarse crumbs
3. Make a well in center
4. Add cream all at once
5. Using a fork , stir just till moistened
6. On a lightly floured surface , knead dough for 10 to 12 strokes or till nearly smooth
7. Pat or lightly roll dough to 1 / 2-inch thickness
8. Cut dough with a 2 1 / 2" biscuit cutter , dipping the cutter into flour between cuts
9. Place biscuits on an ungreased baking sheet
10. Bake in a 450 oven for 10 to 12 minutes or till golden brown
11. Serve warm
12. Makes 10 to 12

title: pecan crusted chicken salad with tangy maple dressing
steps:
1. Heat 1 1 / 2 to 2 inches of oil over medium high heat
2. Season chicken tenders with salt and pepper
3. Set out 3 shallow dishes
4. Place flour in 1 dish , eggs beaten with a splash of water in a second
5. In the third dish , combine bread crumbs with ground pecans , nutmeg and orange zest
6. Coat tenders in batches in flour , then egg , then bread crumb mixture
7. Fry tenders in small batches 6 to 7 minutes
8. Drain tenders on paper towels
9. Dressing:
10. Combine maple syrup , barbecue sauce and orange juice in a bowl
11. Whisk in oil and season with salt and pepper
12. Combine salad ingredients in a large salad bowl or on a serving platter
13. Toss with 3 / 4 of the dressing
14. Top salad with pecan crusted chicken tenders and drizzle remaining dressing over top

title: lemon chicken ring
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Chop parsley using a pizza cutter
3. Zest lemon to measure 1 teaspoon
4. Combine chicken , bell pepper , 2 tablespoons of parsley , lemon zest , garlic , mayo , italian seasoning , mozzarella cheese and 1 / 4 cup parmesan cheese
5. Mix well
6. Unroll cresent dough and septerate into 16 triangles
7. Arrange triangles , slightly overlapping , in a circle on a large round baking stone with wide ends 4 inches from edge of stone
8. Spoon chicken mix evenly over dough in a continuous circle
9. Bring points of triangle up over filling and tuck under dough at center to form a ring
10. Sprinkle remaining parmesian cheese over ring
11. Bake 28-30 minutes or until golden brown
12. Squeeze 1 / 2 of a fresh lemon over ring and garnish with lemon slices and remaining parsley

title: fresh fruit salad with honey vanilla yogurt
steps:
1. Combine the yogurt , honey , vanilla extract , and vanilla bean seeds in a bowl and set aside
2. Combine the orange juice and banana slices in a separate bowl
3. Add the berries and grapes and gently mix the fruit mixture together
4. Spoon the fruit into serving bowls and top with the yogurt

title: baked rice mexicana
steps:
1. Saut the onion and garlic in hot olive oil until just soft
2. Add the rice and seasonings and brown lightly
3. Add the mushrooms and sausage and enough boiling stock to come 1" above the rice
4. Cover with a tight lid and bake in a 350f
5. Oven until the liquid is completely absorbed , about 35 minutes
6. Sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese and serve

title: the realtor s spicy baked shrimp
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. In the food processor with the metal blade , combine the egg , mustard , garlic , chili sauce and lemon juice
3. Process until smooth
4. Season with a little salt and pepper
5. With machine running , add 1 cup of olive oil in a steady stream
6. Process until mixture is thick
7. Heat remaining oil in skillet over medium- high heat
8. Season shrimp with salt , pepper and granulated garlic powder
9. Add shrimp to hot oil and sear for about 1 minute on each side
10. Place 3 shrimp on each of 6 scallop shells
11. Spoon a heaping tablespoon of the chili / oil mixture over the shrimp in each shell and sprinkle with parmesan cheese , a tiny bit of paprika and parsley
12. Place shells on cookie sheet
13. Bake until the top is golden brown and bubbly , around 1 to 2 minutes for the shells and 3 to 4 minutes for the casserole
14. Sometimes this takes a little longer- just watch them and pull them out whern they brown
15. Don't over-cook them or your shrimp will be rubbery

title: baked spaghetti
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti according to pkg directions
2. Drain
3. Place in lightly greased 8x8-inch baking dish
4. Top with grated cheese
5. In dutch oven , brown meat , onion , and garlic until meat is cooked , stirring to crumble
6. Drain
7. Stir in tomato sauce , ketchup , worcestershire , mushrooms , and seasonings
8. Simmer 5 minutes , stirring often
9. Pour over spaghetti , spreading evenly
10. Cover tightly with foil and refrigerate overnight
11. Bake uncovered at 350 for 25-30 minutes
12. Recipe is easily doubled

title: impossible tuna pie
steps:
1. Grease 9 in pie plate
2. Mix tuna , cheese , and onion into plate
3. Blend milk , bisquick , eggs , and salt together for 15 seconds in blender
4. Pour over tuna mixture and bake at 400 for 35-40 minutes

title: pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook the rotini noodles , drain them , and set aside in large bowl
2. Chop up the green bell pepper , red bell pepper , zucchini , summer squash , and purple onion
3. Put all the chopped ingredients in the bowl with the noodles
4. Add the black olives and mix everything well
5. Pour parmesan dressing all over the pasta salad and mix

title: chili s copycat salsa recipe by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Combine tomatoes , jalapenos , lime juice and spices in food processor
2. Run on high speed until tomatoes are nearly pureed , yet still chunky
3. Pour into bowl and add onions
4. Stir well , cover & store overnight for flavors to properly develop

title: turkey bacon melt
steps:
1. Heat broiler
2. Combine mayonnaise and adobo sauce in small bowl
3. Evenly spread on 1 side of each toast slice
4. To assemble sandwiches , layer 4 slices toast , spread-side up , divide the turkey between the 4 slices toast and top with 2 slices tomato each
5. Sprinkle with black pepper
6. Top each with 2 slices bacon and 2 slices cheese
7. Place sandwiches onto ungreased baking sheet
8. Broil 5 to 6 inches from heat until cheese begins to melt
9. Top sandwiches with lettuce leaves and remaining toast slices , spread-side down
10. Slice each sandwich in half and serve

title: caramelized turnip and apple soup with tarragon sour cream
steps:
1. In a heavy stock pot over low heat , slowly cook the onion , turnips and apples in the olive oil , until they are soft and browned , stirring occasionally , about 35 to 45 minutes
2. Add the thyme and enough water to cover the vegetables just barely
3. Simmer covered over low heat for about 1 hour
4. If the soup is too thick you can add a little more water or stock
5. Let the soup cool a little , thenpuree in a blender or food processor
6. Reheat , adding salt and pepper to taste
7. In a small bowl , combine the sour cream , tarragon and lemon zest
8. Serve the hot soup garnished with the sour cream mixture and thyme sprigs

title: lamb shish kebab
steps:
1. Mix all marinade ingredients in a large bowl
2. Add lamb cubes and marinate for 1 hour or overnight
3. Preheat broiler or light the barbecue
4. Divide the meat and vegetables evenly into 4 parts , and skewer the pieces on 4 skewers
5. Place 4 to 5 inches from flame
6. Grill , turning to cook evenly , for approximately 10 minutes

title: zucchini  potato and herb fritters
steps:
1. Squeeze all the excess liquid from the potato , zucchini , onion and garlic , and use paper kitchen towelling to further pat dry the potatoes , zucchini and onion
2. One method is to put the vegetables into a small colandar or sieve , place this on or over the sink and press down on the vegetables several times
3. Combine the potato , zucchini , onion , garlic , flour , egg , mint , basil , pepper and salt in a large bowl
4. Pre-heat the oven to hot
5. 220c or 425-450f or gas mark 7-8
6. Heat oil in a large , preferably non-stick pan , and shallow-fry level tablespoons of the mixture , until the fritters are browned on both sides , place on paper kitchen towelling to absorb excess oil then transfer the fritters to oven trays and bake uncovered for about 10 minutes or until they are crisped and cooked right through
7. Combine the yoghurt and extra mint
8. Serve the fritters immediately with the yoghurt and mint topping

title: michael s steak sauce
steps:
1. Soak raisins in hot water until very soft
2. Set aside
3. Saute onions over medium heat until golden brown
4. Add tomato paste , and cook for 1 minute
5. Increase heat to high , add remaining ingredients , but not salt and pepper yet
6. Bring sauce to a boil , then reduce heat to medium and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes
7. Remove pan from heat , and allow to cool completely
8. Pour cooled sauce into blender no more than halfway , and puree until smooth
9. Puree in batches if needed
10. Season with salt and pepper , adjusting amount to taste
11. If mixture is not smooth enough , add a few teaspoons of water at a time and puree until it becomes smooth to your liking

title: indian spiced cashews
steps:
1. On parchment paper-lined or greased rimmed baking sheet , toast cashews in 350f oven until fragrant and golden , about 10 minutes
2. Meanwhile , in large bowl , combine 2 tbsp of the sugar , salt , curry powder and cumin
3. Set aside
4. In saucepan , bring water , remaining brown sugar and butter to boil , stirring constantly
5. Add cashews , stirring to coat
6. Simmer until no liquid remains , about 3 minutes
7. Add to spice mixture
8. Toss to coat well
9. Spread nuts on same baking sheet
10. Roast until coating is dry and slightly golden , about 10 minutes
11. Let cool on pan on rack

title: saag aloo
steps:
1. Fry the cumin seeds in a heavy bottomed pan in a bit of oil and butter until just starting to brown
2. Add the onion and fry until it too starts to brown
3. Add the potato , garlic , turmeric , ginger and garam masala and fry until the potato starts to soften
4. Unless you are using a non-stick pan , you may need to add water and cover to keep the potato from sticking and to help it cook
5. The first time i did this 1 / 2 cup at a time and it took about 20-30 minutes but i now prefer to parboil the potatoes , which means you add less water and it only takes about 10 minutes to finish off from this point
6. Add the spinach or chard and cook until it collapses over the potato
7. Salt to taste

title: creamy wild mushroom and wild rice casserole
steps:
1. Make the bread crumbs -- in a small food processor , take a couple slices of bread and process till you get fine crumbs
2. Measure out 1 1 / 2 cups
3. Then you can either buy ground or chopped fine pecans or you can grind your own
4. I like to buy the small 1 / 2 cup packages when i only need a small amount
5. In a large saute pan , add the the butter and melt on medium high , add the bread crumbs and nuts and cook until lightly browned , 3-4 minutes is all it takes
6. Remove and let cool
7. Rice -- make the rice according to directions
8. Any time i cook with rice , couscous , etc
9. , i try to use chicken or vegetable broth rather than water to cook the grains
10. It just adds so much flavor with little work , but that is optional
11. Cook the rice and add to a 13x9 greased casserole dish
12. Vegetables -- in that same pan we made the bread crumbs in , heat the olive oil and butter on medium heat and add the fennel , onions and mushrooms and cook on medium until they have become translucent and the mushrooms tender , about 7-10 minutes
13. Then add the thyme , parsley salt and pepper and mix well
14. Add this to the rice in the casserole dish and lightly mix
15. Sauce -- once again in that same pan , add the butter and melt on medium , then add the flour and mix to make a roux
16. Let it cook just a minute
17. Now add the milk and stir well
18. Add in the sherry and then the seasoning
19. Bring to a medium boil just until it slightly thickens and then add in the shredded cheese and stir
20. Cook until nice a creamy and thick
21. Should resemble a nice cheese sauce
22. Pour this mixture over the rice and vegetables
23. Lightly toss to combine
24. Topping -- top with those bread crumbs and bake at 350 for 20 minutes until bubbly and the bread crumbs are golden brown

title: ensaladilla tasca
steps:
1. Remove the white pith from the oranges and cut the fruit crosswise into 1 / 4 inch slices
2. Arrange on a serving platter and scatter over the sliced red onion
3. In a small bowl , whisk together the vinegar , olive oil , salt , and pepper
4. Spoon this dressing over the onion and oranges
5. Sprinkle with the raisins , olives , sunflower seeds , and almonds
6. Garnish with parsley and serve chilled

title: cranberry mustard pork tenderloin
steps:
1. In a small bowl , whisk together the cranberry sauce , lemon juice , mustard & brown sugar , then pour 1 / 3 of the mixture in the bottom of a 5-quart crock pot
2. Place tenderloins on top of the sauce , then pour the remaining sauce over the meat
3. Cover & cook on high for 1 hour , then turn the temperature to low & cook another 4 to 6 hours or until meat is tender
4. Allow meat to stand 10 minutes before slicing & serving

title: japanese golden curry
steps:
1. In a medium / large pot , heat oil and saute onions and protein until lightly browned
2. Add 2 3 / 4 cups water and potatoes
3. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer for 5-10 minutes until potatoes and protein is tender
4. Break sauce mix into pieces and crumble into pot
5. Stir until it it melted inches simmer for 2 minutes
6. Add broccoli and corn and cook for 3-5 minutes more , or until cooked through
7. Serve hot over rice or noodles

title: southern chicken parmegian
steps:
1. I am remembering this recipe straight from my head , so bare w / me !
2. Preheat your oven to 350 degrees
3. In two shallow dishes mix the cornmeal , dry italian mix & bread crumbs together
4. In the other shallow dish , lightly beat both eggs
5. In a frying pan , pour 1 / 2 cup of olive oil
6. Dip each piece of chicken into the egg mixture then continue to the cornmeal / breadcrumb / italian seasoning mixture and put in the frying pan
7. After you have repeated that step w / each piece of chicken , let each piece fry for about 2-3 min on each side , or until both sides are golden brown
8. Place your golden brown chicken in a 13 x 9 baking dish & pop it in the over for 15 minutes
9. After 15 minutes is up , pour the entire jar of marinara on chicken and pop back in over for another 15 minutes
10. After 15 minutes , pour both mozzarella & parmesan cheese mixture over chicken and pop in over for another 15 minutes
11. The total baking time is 45 minutes and this dish goes great with fettuccine alfredo

title: filipino adobo  pork or chicken  with slow cooker variation
steps:
1. I use apple cider vinegar - just use what you have
2. Some reviewers have used rice vinegar and been pleased
3. Rice vinegar seems to have a touch of sweetness
4. Do what pleases you - experiment and have fun in the kitchen
5. Stove top instructions
6. Combine all of the ingredients in a large pot
7. Allow everything sit at room temperature for at least 15 minutes
8. Bring to a boil then reduce heat to low
9. Simmer for 1 1 / 2 - 2 hours
10. Remove lid and cook 10 minutes more
11. Serve with rice
12. Slow cooker instructions
13. Combine all of the ingredients in a slow cooker
14. Allow meat to sit at room temperature for at least 15 minutes
15. Cook on high for 3 hours or on low for 6 hours until pork or chicken is done
16. Serve with rice
17. To freeze: combine all ingredients in a ziptop bag
18. Freeze
19. To serve: thaw overnight in the refridgerator
20. Allow to sit at room temperature for 15 minutes
21. Cook as directed

title: green pea ravioli with truffle butter sauce
steps:
1. Force peas through the fine disk of a food mill into a bowl to remove skins
2. Cook shallot in oil in a small skillet over moderately low heat , stirring occasionally , until softened
3. Remove from heat and stir into pea puree with cheese and crumbs
4. Season filling with salt and pepper
5. Fill ravioli with a level teaspoon of filling in each
6. Transfer to a baking sheet lined with a dry kitchen towel
7. Ravioli may be made up to this point 1 day ahead , covered and refrigerated or they can be frozen
8. To make the sauce: simmer the vinegar and wine over medium heat and reduce until it forms a light syrup
9. Add the cream and reduce heat to low
10. Whisk in butter pieces one at a time , until emulsified
11. Add truffle oil , if using
12. Salt to taste
13. Set aside and keep warm until ravioli are cooked
14. Cook ravioli in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente , 2 to 3 minutes , then drain
15. Toss with sauce then serve immediately

title: highlight cake
steps:
1. Put into a food processor the flour , eggs , custard powder , milk and sugar
2. Add softened butter
3. Beat for 10 mins - i know it sounds a long time !
4. Pour into greased 10 inch tin
5. Bake at 180 degrees celsius
6. Bake for 1 hour

title: spicy cherry glazed chicken
steps:
1. Place oil in bottom of 13x9" baking pan
2. Spread to coat bottom
3. Arrange chicken in pan
4. Set aside
5. In small saucepan , combine apple cherry juice concentrate , honey , salt , cinnamon , red pepper and all spice
6. Mix well
7. Bring just to a boil over medium-high heat
8. Remove 1 / 2 cup sauce from pan
9. Set aside
10. Pour remaining sauce evenly over chicken in baking pan
11. Bake at 350 for 40 to 50 minutes , or until chicken is cooked through , turning once
12. Remove chicken to serving dish
13. Keep warm
14. Pour pan drippings into reserved sauce
15. Stir in dried cherries , water and cornstarch
16. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat
17. Cook 1 to 2 minutes , or until sauce is thickened , stirring frequently
18. To serve , pour sauce evenly over chicken

title: paistetut sienet  finnish fried mushrooms
steps:
1. Saut mushrooms and onion in butter , stirring constantly , until lightly browned
2. Stir in rest of ingredients and simmer over medium low heat long enough to heat through and thicken a bit , but do not allow to come to a boil

title: smelly bachelor pasta
steps:
1. While cooking the spaghetti , saute' the pressed garlic , anchovies and red pepper flakes in half the olive oil until the anchovies melt
2. Toss the spaghetti with the sauce , adding the remaining oil , ground pepper and grated parmigiano
3. It's a bit much for one person , but hey , if you're making this dish , that means no one's around to see you take that second portion !

title: crispy pork cutlets
steps:
1. Blend eggs and mustard together in a shallow pie pan
2. Dip pork in egg mixture , coat with potato flakes
3. Heat oil in a skillet , add pork , heating on both sides until done

title: roasted pork tenderloin with apricot mustard glaze
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Place a rack over a foil lined baking sheet
3. Combine first 4 ingredients in a small bowl
4. Sprinkle pork loin with salt and pepper
5. Reserve half of the glaze and spread the remaining over pork loin
6. Bake in preheated oven 50-60 minutes , or until the pork reaches an internal temperature of 160f
7. Remove from oven and cover with foil for 10 minutes
8. Slice and serve with reserved glaze

title: the phoenician s chicken salad
steps:
1. Cut chicken into 1 " cubes , place into glass bowl and toss with oil , lime juice , salt and peppers
2. Spoon mixture into baking pan , bake 15 minutes at 375 , or until chicken is done
3. Cool chicken in fridge , stir in remaining ingredients and toss well

title: turtle cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f
2. Grease 9-inch springform pan
3. Combine crumbs and butter in medium bowl
4. Press onto bottom and 1 inch up side of prepared pan
5. Beat cream cheese and sweetened condensed milk in large mixer bowl until smooth
6. Add sugar , eggs , lime juice and vanilla extract
7. Beat until combined
8. Microwave morsels in medium , microwave-safe bowl on high power for 1 minute
9. Stir
10. Morsels may retain some of their shape
11. If necessary , microwave at additional 10- to 15-second intervals , stirring just until morsels are melted
12. Stir 2 cups of cheesecake batter into melted morsels
13. Mix well
14. Alternately spoon batters into crust , beginning and ending with yellow batter
15. Bake for 1 hour 10 to 15 minutes or until edge is set and center moves slightly
16. Cool in pan on wire rack for 10 minutes
17. Run knife around edge of cheesecake
18. Cool completely
19. Drizzle nesquik and caramel syrup over cheesecake
20. Sprinkle with pecans and mini morsels
21. Refrigerate for several hours or overnight
22. Remove side of pan

title: apple bites
steps:
1. Cut up apple into bite sized chunks
2. Put the chopped apple into a container with a lid
3. Sprinkle on the cinnamon , put the lid on the container , and gently shake so cinnamon covers apple
4. Eat and enjoy immediately

title: merry meatballs
steps:
1. 2-inch diameter meat balls work well
2. Place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan
3. Combine sauerkraut , cranberry sauce , chili sauce , brown sugar and water in medium sauce pan
4. Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes
5. Pour sauerkraut mixture over meatballs and bake , uncovered , at 350f for 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours

title: heather s apple cranberry bread pudding
steps:
1. Beat eggs and add spices , sugar , vanilla , milk
2. Combine bread and fruit and toss
3. Pour egg mixture over bread
4. Let sit 30 minutes
5. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes

title: sassy burgers
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , combine beef , taco seasoning , and 1 / 4 cup salsa , and shape into 8 patties
2. Grill patties 12 minutes , or until cooked thoroughly , if broiling place patties on broiler pan 4-5 inches from heat and broil until cooked thoroughly , turning once during cooking
3. When patties are almost done , place rolls cut-side down on grill and heat 1-2 minutes
4. Place 8 patties on bottom half of bun , to with cheese and cook an additional 1 minute or until cheese melts
5. Top with 1 tablespoon salsa , and top with remaining bun half

title: eat til you bust chicken tortilla soup
steps:
1. In a large stockpot , over med hi heat , boil chicken , carrots , celery , onion , garlic , salt , and peppers in water for 1 to 2 hours , or until chicken is very tender , and easy to de-bone
2. Remove chicken and let cool
3. Reduce heat to simmer
4. Add rotel , cilantro , corn , and cumin to the pot , stir well
5. Remove chicken from the bone , and chunk
6. Add to the pot
7. Simmer 30 minutes
8. Add cream
9. Stir in bullion paste to taste
10. Cut tortillas in thin strips , and fry in heated oil until golden brown , drain on paper towels
11. Place tortilla strips in bottom of bowl , ladle soup over top
12. Sprinkle with cheese

title: chocolate cream cheese cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f
2. Generously grease a 10 inch bundt or tube pan
3. Combine sugar , oil and eggs
4. Beat for one minute until smooth
5. Add remaining cake ingredients and beat for two to three minutes
6. Set batter aside
7. For filling , cream sugar with cream cheese
8. Add vanilla , egg and chocolate chips
9. Blend until smooth
10. Ladle half of batter into pan
11. Spoon filling evenly over this layer
12. Cover with remaining batter
13. Bake for 70 minutes or until cake tests done
14. Top should spring back when touched
15. Let cake cool at least 30 minutes before removing from pan
16. If cake sticks , place on a warm burner to loosen up and help release cake
17. Cake will firm up as it comes to room temperature
18. For glaze , combine all ingredients to form a pourable liquid
19. Thin with hot water if necessary
20. Pour over cooled cake
21. This cake freezes well and keeps for several days covered at room temperature

title: peaches and cream dessert casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Butter an 8-inch square baking dish
3. Combine the rolled oats and sugar in a small bowl
4. Set aside
5. Distribute the peaches evenly in the pan
6. Mix the eggs , vanilla , and cream in a bowl
7. Pour over the peaches
8. Top with the rolled oat mixture
9. Bake for 35-40 minutes , or until the oats are browned and the peaches bubble up around the edges of the pan
10. Serve hot or at room temperature

title: pesto cream cheese spread
steps:
1. Line a 5-3 / 4x3" loaf pan with plastic wrap
2. In a small bowl , combine cream cheese and garlic powder until well blended
3. Set aside
4. In a bowl , combine parmesan cheese , butter and pesto sauce until blended
5. Gradually stir in olive oil
6. Spread about 1 / 4 cup cream cheese mixture into prepared pan
7. Carefully spread with 1 / 3 pesto mixture
8. Repeat layers twice
9. Top with remaining cream cheese mixture
10. Cover and refrigerate at least 5 hours
11. Un-mold
12. Serve with crackers and veggies
13. Refrigerate after each layer

title: harvest chicken salad
steps:
1. For dressing zest oranges to get about 2 teaspoons
2. Juice oranges to get about a 1 / 2 cup of juice combine zest , mayonnaise , mustard , sugar , salt , pepper and garlic in bowl
3. Whisk until smooth
4. Whisk continuously and add orange juice in a thin , steady stream
5. Set aside
6. Combine all salad ingredients and toss with dressing

title: rich s chicken gorgonzola
steps:
1. Salt and pepper each side of chicken
2. Dredge seasoned chicken in flour
3. Dip floured chicken into egg mixture shaking off excess
4. Coat with breadcrumbs
5. Fry each piece of chicken in oil until cooked and golden brown--about 5 minutes each side depending on thickness
6. Combine cheese and mayo
7. Spread each piece of chicken with cheese mixture leaving a 1 / 8" border all around
8. Place chicken on cookie sheet and run under broiler until cheese is bubbly about one minute
9. Enjoy !

title: kelly s moo shu pork  or beef  pockets
steps:
1. In large bowl , combine pork , 1 1 / 2 cups of cabbage , garlic , gingersnap crumbs , soy sauce , scallions and cayenne
2. Mix well with your hands
3. Form into 6 small , thick patties
4. In fry pan , heat oil over med-high heat and cook patties for about 5 minutes on each side , will be pretty well browned on both sides
5. While patties are cooking , mix 2 cups shredded lettuce with 1 / 2 cup cabbage and a bit more sliced green onions if desired
6. Warm tortillas in microwave , and thinly spread one side all over with a nice spoonful of hoisin sauce to thinly coat whole tortilla
7. Place a small handful of lettuce mixture in center of each tortilla
8. Place a cooked patty on top , fold over sides , then far side and close side , overlapping and sealing with a dab of hoisin if needed , sealing making a nice"package"
9. Place seam-side down , continue til all are wrapped
10. Slice in half with sharp knife going down through non-folded side and serve with white or fried rice !
11. These are to die for , and even better the next day !
12. Only assemble what is going to be eaten , reheat patties the next day for leftovers

title: corn muffins by ina
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Line 12 muffin cups with paper liners
3. In the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with a paddle attachment , mix the flour , sugar , cornmeal , baking powder , and salt
4. In a separate bowl , combine the milk , melted butter , and eggs
5. With the mixer on the lowest speed , pour the wet ingredients into the dry ones and stir until they are just blended
6. Spoon the batter into the paper liners , filling each one to the top
7. Bake for 30 minutes , until the tops are crisp and a toothpick comes out clean
8. Cool slightly and remove from the pan

title: super simple two ingredient glaze
steps: 1. Combine ingredients and pour over meat

title: marinated flank steaks
steps:
1. Make shallow cuts in steaks diagonally across grain at 1-inch intervals
2. Brush both sides of steaks with mustard
3. Place steaks in a large shallow dish
4. Combine wine and next 3 ingredients
5. Pour over steaks
6. Cover and marinade in refrigerator 8 to 12 hours or overnight , turning steaks occasionally
7. Remove steaks from marinade , reserving marinade
8. Place reserved marinade in a small saucepan
9. Bring to a boil
10. Remove from heat and set aside
11. Place steaks on a rack in a broiler pan coated with cooking spray
12. Broil 5 1 / 2 inches from heat 5 to 7 minutes on each side or to desired doneness , basting with reserved marinade
13. To serve , cut steaks diagonally across grain into thin slices

title: elmer s mustard fried venison
steps:
1. Serves 4-6 , prep time 30 minutes season steaks with your own blend of salt and pepper
2. Combine mustard and horseradish
3. Spread mixture on each side of steaks so that the steaks are fully covered on both sides
4. Fry in hot olive oil , being careful to avoid being splattered
5. Poke with fork and as soon as juices run clear , steaks are done and ready to be served with whatever garnishment you prefer
6. A baked potato and a green dinner salad rounds out a delicious meal

title: lentils du puy and bacon salad
steps:
1. Cook 6 slices bacon in heavy large saucepan over medium heat until brown and crisp
2. Transfer bacon to paper towels , crumble
3. Drain off all but about three tablespoons of bacon fat
4. Add onion to drippings
5. Saut until tender , about 10 minutes
6. Add 6 cups water , lentils , remaining 2 slices of bacon , and thyme to the bacon fat and onion
7. Bring to boil , then cover and reduce to a simmer
8. After about 20 minutes , add carrots and continue to cook until lentils are tender , about 10 more minutes
9. Drain lentils , let cool
10. Whisk oil , red wine vinegar , and dijon mustard in bowl to blend
11. Add lentils , red onion , celery , bacon , and parsley
12. Toss to combine
13. Season to taste with salt and pepper and serve at room temperature or slightly chilled

title: scropino  cocktail
steps:
1. In a blender , combine gelato , vodka and lemoncello
2. Blend until smooth
3. Divide between 2 glasses , then add sparkling wine to fill glasses
4. Garnish with lemon slices if desired

title: horseradish jelly
steps:
1. In a large saucepan add all ingredients , except pectin , and over low heat cook until sugar is dissolved
2. Over high heat bring to a boil
3. Immediately stir in pectin and bring to a rolling boil
4. Remove from heat and ladle into clean hot jars
5. Seal and process in a boiling water bath for 5 minutes

title: creamy tuna casserole
steps:
1. Cook pasta and drain
2. Preheat oven to 350
3. Set aside 1 cup of the cheddar for topping
4. Mix all other ingredients well and put into covered casserole dish
5. Top with the reserved cheddar prior to baking
6. Bake for 45 minutes

title: home style scrambled eggs
steps:
1. Beat eggs , salt and water
2. Melt butter in 10-inch skillet over medium heat
3. Cook potatoes , zucchini and tomato in butter , stirring occasionally , until hot
4. Pour egg mixture over vegetable mixture
5. As mixture begins to set at bottom and side , gently lift cooked portions with spatula so that thin uncooked portion can flow to bottom
6. Do not stir
7. Cook 3 to 5 minutes or until eggs are thickened throughout , but still moist
8. Serve

title: red wine herb marinated beef steak
steps:
1. Combine marinade ingredients in small bowl
2. Place beef steaks and marinade in food-safe plastic bag
3. Turn steak to coat
4. Close bag securely and marinate in refrigerator 6 hours or as long as overnight , turning occasionally
5. Heat large nonstick skillet over medium heat until hot
6. Remove steaks from marinade
7. Discard marinade
8. Place steaks in skillet
9. Cook 16 to 17 minutes for medium rare doneness , turning twice
10. Carve steaks into thin slices

title: brown sugar angel food cake
steps:
1. Beat egg whites , vanilla , cream of tarter and salt until soft peaks form
2. Gradually sift 1 cup brown sugar over egg whites and beat again until stiff peaks form
3. Sift remaining cup of sugar with flour
4. Fold into egg white mixture
5. Bake in an ungreased tube pan for 45-50 minutes at 350

title: chocolate chip cookie truffles
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Prepare cookies following package directions
3. However , bake for 14 to 18 minutes until crisp and golden brown but not burnt
4. Let cookies cool completely on wire racks
5. Line baking sheet with wax paper
6. Crumble cookies into food processor container
7. Cover
8. Process until mixture resembles coarse meal
9. Add cream cheese
10. Process until mixture begins to hold together
11. Mixture will be dark in color
12. Roll or scoop mixture into 1-inch balls and place on prepared baking sheet
13. Refrigerate for 1 hour
14. Microwave morsels and vegetable shortening in small , uncovered , microwave-safe bowl on high power for 1 minute
15. Stir
16. Morsels may retain some of their original shape
17. If necessary , microwave at additional 10- to 15-second intervals , stirring just until morsels are melted
18. Dip balls completely into melted chocolate with fork
19. Use side of bowl or shake gently to remove excess chocolate
20. Return to baking sheet
21. Dust truffles with cocoa
22. Refrigerate for 30 minutes or until set
23. Store in tightly covered container in refrigerator
24. This will result in a less ground cookie truffle
25. To dust the truffles , place cocoa in a small , fine mesh strainer and tap over the dipped truffles

title: spaghetti with bacon and onion
steps:
1. Cut bacon into matchsticks and cook over medium-high heat for 5 minutes
2. Add diced onion and cook till tender
3. Meanwhile , fill pot with water for spaghetti and set on high
4. Drain 3 / 4 - 7 / 8 of the fat
5. How much you drain is up to you
6. The more you drain , the healthier it is
7. The more you leave in , the better it tastes
8. Add the white wine and raise the temperature
9. Cook off most of the liquid
10. Lower temperature to moderate heat , add tomatoes , thyme , salt and pepper
11. Cook for 10 - 15 minutes
12. By now , water should be boiling
13. Cook spaghetti according to package directions
14. Drain spaghetti , toss with sauce
15. Enjoy !

title: steamed artichokes
steps:
1. Cut off stem end as well as 1 inch of the top , remove outermost leaves of artichokes and snip off pointy
2. Steam , covered in a rack over boiling water about 1 / 2 hour until base of an artichoke is soft enough to pierce easily
3. Microwave lemon 15 seconds and then juice lemon--you should end up with 3-4 tbs juice
4. Discard peel
5. In a small skillet , saut garlic and thyme in oil about 1 minute
6. With a fork or tiny whisk , whisk in lemon juice , butter and pepper and remove from heat
7. To eat , dip individual leaves in lemon-butter and scrape the "meat" of the artichokes into your mouth with your front teeth
8. Yum !

title: raisin stuffed tomatoes
steps:
1. Soak raisins to plump in warm water 5 to 10 minutes
2. Drain
3. Cut garlic cloves in half
4. Chop red pepper
5. Drizzle olive oil over peppers , raisins , garlic and coconut and stir to cover
6. Add a dash of salt and roast in 375 degree oven for 30 minutes , till well roasted
7. Cut tomato tops off and scoop out centers
8. Stuff tomatoes with roasted raisin stuffing
9. Bake in 350 degree oven for 15 minutes
10. Grate ginger over each tomato just before serving

title: spaghetti bake
steps:
1. In a large pot , cook sausage over medium-high heat , breaking up as it cooks with a spatula
2. Cook until it is no longer pink
3. Drain off fat
4. Add onions , garlic and basil and cook for another 5 minutes to soften onions
5. Add mushrooms and cook until liquid is evaporated , about 5 minutes
6. Add tomatoes , tomato paste and pepper
7. Bring to a boil
8. Reduce heat and simmer for about 15 minutes until most of liquid is evaporated
9. Stir in spinach
10. Meanwhile , for topping: in saucepan , melt butter over medium heat
11. Whisk in the flour and cook , whisking constantly for 1 minute
12. Whisk in the milk
13. Cook , whisking constantly for 12 to 15 minutes until sauce is thickened
14. Add mozzarella cheese , salt and pepper
15. Meanwhile , for noodles: cook spaghetti in large pot of boiling salted water for 5 minutes or until tender but firm
16. Drain and add to meat sauce
17. Toss to coat
18. Spread in 2 greased 8-inch square glass baking dishes
19. Pour topping over and then sprinkle with parmesan cheese
20. Bake in 375f oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until bubbly and golden

title: grilled salmon with chipotle herb butter
steps:
1. In medium bowl , combine butter , chives , parsley , chervil , lemon juice , chilies , and adobo sauce
2. Season with salt and pepper to taste
3. With electric mixer , beat together until well incorporated
4. Adjust the seasoning if necessary
5. Shape butter into a long log and cover with plastic wrap
6. Refrigerate until ready to use
7. Season salmon with salt and pepper
8. Lay skin side up over a solid bed of coals or high heat on a gas grill
9. Close lid on gas grill
10. Cook fish , turning once , until opaque but still moist-looking in center of thickest part , 7 to 10 minutes
11. Place a 1 / 8-inch thick slice of chipotle butter on top of each fillet

title: maryland steamed shrimp
steps:
1. In a large pot pour in the beer , vinegar , salt , and lemon and bring to a rapid boil
2. Place a steamer rack in the bottom of the pot and cover with a layer of shrimp
3. Sprinkle the old bay seasoning over the layer and repeat until all of the shrimp are in the pot
4. Cover tightly and let steam for 10 minutes until all of the shrimp have turned a bright red
5. Remove the shrimp and allow to cool slightly

title: double chocolate  chocolate shake
steps:
1. Get out your blender and all needed ingredients
2. First add milk
3. Then continue with ice , chocolate ice cream , and chocolate syrup
4. Now blend
5. First start off by grinding the ice , then puree , and finally blend
6. Continue blending until milk shake is completely mixed
7. Pour in cup or glass
8. Optional: if you wish , you can add a topping of whipped cream , and a single seedless cherry
9. Enjoy !

title: paula s easy lasagna
steps:
1. Cook noodles
2. In the meantime
3. To cottage cheese add
4. Parmesan , basil , oregano , salt and pepper in a casserole layer: 1 / 4 c sauce , noodles , cottage cheese mixture , mozzarella
5. End with a little sauce on top and a little extra parmesan cheese
6. Bake at 350 for about 25-30 minutes or until center is bubbly
7. Serve with hot garlic bread and a small salad

title: raspberry bread   butter pudding
steps:
1. Grease a 6 cup capacity ovenproof dish
2. Preheat oven to 180c / 350 degrees f
3. Combine milk , cream& sugar in pan- stir over heat , without boiling , until sugar is dissolved
4. Once sugar has dissolved , bring to the boil , remove from heat
5. Stir in essence
6. Cover , stand 10 minutes
7. Meanwhile , cut crusts from bread
8. Butter slices on one side
9. Cut each slices into four triangles
10. Overlap triangles in prepared dish
11. Top with raspberries
12. Whisk eggs until combined
13. Gradually whisk in milk mixture
14. Strain mixture , then pour over bread
15. Place dish in a large baking dish , add enough boiling water to come halfway up sides of baking dish
16. Sprinkle on almonds and dust with icing sugar
17. Bake uncovered in oven about 45 minutes or until just set
18. Serve warm with extra raspberries
19. Bestmade just before serving

title: pad thai with banana flower
steps:
1. By far , the trickiest part is the soaked noodles
2. Noodles should be somewhat flexible and solid , not completely expanded and soft
3. When in doubt , undersoak
4. You can always add more water in the pan , but you can't take it out
5. In this recipe , pre-ground pepper , particularly pre-ground white pepper is better than fresh ground pepper
6. Tamarind adds some flavor and acidity , but you can substitute white vinegar
7. If you decided to include banana flower , cut lengthwise into sections
8. Rub any open cut with lime or lemon juice to prevent it from turning dark
9. The original pad thai recipe calls for crushed roasted peanuts
10. Many people in thailand avoid eating peanuts because of its link to cancer
11. Soak the dry noodles in lukewarm water while preparing the other ingredients , for 5-10 minutes
12. Julienne tofu and cut into 1 inch long matchsticks
13. When cut , the extra firm tofu should have a mozzarella cheese consistency
14. Cut up chinese chives into 1 inch long pieces
15. Set aside a few fresh chives for a garnish
16. Rinse the bean sprouts and save half for serving fresh
17. Mince shallot and garlic together
18. Use a wok
19. If you do not have a wok , any big pot will do
20. Heat it up on high heat and pour oil in the wok
21. Fry the peanuts until toasted and remove them from the wok
22. Add shallot , garlic and tofu and stir them until they start to brown
23. The noodles should be flexible but not expanded at this point
24. Drain the noodles and add to the wok
25. Stir quickly to keep things from sticking
26. Add tamarind , sugar , fish sauce , chili pepper and preserved turnip
27. Stir
28. The heat should remain high
29. If your wok is not hot enough , you will see a lot of juice in the wok at this point
30. Turn up the heat , if it is the case
31. Make room for the egg by pushing all noodles to the side of the wok
32. Crack the egg onto the wok and scramble it until it is almost all cooked
33. Fold the egg into the noodles
34. Add shrimp and stir
35. Add bean sprouts , chives
36. Stir a few more times
37. The noodles should be soft and very tangled
38. Pour onto the serving plate and sprinkle with peanuts
39. Serve hot with the banana flower slice and a wedge of lime on the side and raw chinese chives and raw bean sprouts on top
40. In thailand , condiments such as sugar , chili pepper , vinegar and fish sauce are available at your table for your personal taste
41. Some people add more pepper or sugar at this point

title: spaghetti with tomato and feta sauce
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add oregano , mushrooms , green onions and garlic
3. Saute 3 minutes
4. Add tomatoes , tomato sauce , sugar , olives and pepper to taste
5. Simmer 15 minutes
6. Add parsley and red wine vinegar
7. Cook 5 minutes or until thoroughly heated
8. Place sauce on pasta
9. Top with cheese and serve

title: chicken bistro cakes
steps:
1. Melt the butter is a medium saute pan
2. Saute onion and celery until tender
3. Transfer to a large bowl and cool
4. Add chicken , bread crumbs and seasonings
5. Stir in the eggs
6. Form cakes , uising a packed 1 / 3 cup measuring cup , lightly pressing to make a 3" cake
7. Transfer to cookie sheet or plate
8. Chill 15 minutes
9. Heat 2 t
10. Oil in a nonstick pan over medium-high heat
11. Saute 1 / 2 the cakes
12. Add remaining oil and saute remaining cakes

title: cranberry sweet potato quick bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine first 7 ingredients in a large bowl
3. Make a well in the center of the mixture
4. Combine mashed sweet potato , egg substitute , orange juice and margarine in a bowl
5. Add to dry ingredients
6. Stir just until moist
7. Fold in cranberries
8. Spoon batter into a 9 by 5-inch loaf pan coated with cooking spray
9. Sprinkle almonds over batter
10. Press lightly into top of batter
11. Bake at 350f for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in the center comes out clean
12. Let cool ten minutes in pan on a wire rack
13. Remove from pan
14. Let cool completely on wire rack

title: date pinwheel cookies by grammie mae
steps:
1. In a saucepan , combine dates , water , and sugar bring date mixture to a boil then reduce and let simmer for about 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
2. When the dates are completely soft , stir in flour and vanilla
3. Stir well and remove from heat
4. Cookies: in a mixing bowl , cream butter , brown sugar , and eggs until light and fluffy
5. Stir in vanilla in a separate bowl , sift in flour , baking soda , salt and cream of tartar
6. Gradually add dry ingredients to creamed mixture
7. Beat until just blended
8. Divide dough into three equal portions
9. Wrap in waxed paper and chill until easy to handle
10. Between sheets of waxed paper , roll each portion into a ractangle , about 12 x 8 inches
11. Remove top piece of waxed paper and spread each rectangle with about 2 / 3 cup of the date mixture
12. Starting with the 12 inch side , lift edge of waxed paper
13. Peel paper off as dough is rolled , jelly-roll fashion
14. Repeat with remaining portions and filling
15. Wrap rolls in waxed paper and refrigerate for several hours or overnight
16. Preheat oven to 350
17. Cut each roll into 1 / 4 inch slices and place about 1 inch apart on greased cookie sheets
18. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes
19. Cool on racks

title: mary s oat bran muffins
steps:
1. Stir all ingredients together
2. Bake at 350 about 20 minutes or until they spring back to touch

title: caribbean lime onion rings with spicy dipping sauce
steps:
1. Peel onion and cut into 1 / 4-inch slices , separating rings
2. In a medium-size bowl , combine flour , cornmeal , lime zest , baking powder , baking soda , salt and cayenne pepper
3. In a large bowl , combine the egg and buttermilk and stir
4. Add the flour mixture , and whisk until blended
5. Heat oil over medium-high heat in a heavy fry pan until temperature reaches 375f
6. Dip onion rings into batter and carefully put into hot oil
7. Fry until golden brown , about 2 minutes , turning after one minute
8. Remove with fork and place on paper towels to absorb oil
9. Serve with lime dipping sauce
10. Lime dipping sauce: blend ingredients well
11. Make at least 30 minutes before serving

title: cabbage   corned beef soup
steps:
1. In a heavy , stock sized pot over medium head , heat olive oil , then add onions
2. Sautee onions until almost tender
3. Add cabbage , sautee with onions , stirring frequently , 10 minutes until onions and cabbage are tender
4. Add garlic , basil , oregano , sautee 1 minute longer
5. Add corned beef , tomato paste , and beef stock
6. Stir until tomato paste is dissolved , heat over low heat for 15-20 minutes
7. Salt and pepper to taste

title: jayne s sugar free  fat free  creamy fruit salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine the fruit and set aside
2. In another bowl whisk milk , orange juice concentrate and pudding mix for 2 minutes or until smooth
3. Add sour cream and mix well
4. Fold mixture into fruit and cover and refrigerate until serving

title: hearty vegetable stew
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large , heavy saucepan over medium heat
2. Add onions , garlic , carrots , celery , and mushrooms
3. Cook 10 minutes , stirring frequently
4. Add small amounts of water , if necessary , to prevent sticking
5. Add remaining ingredients , except flour , 1 / 4 cup water , and wine
6. Cover , reduce heat to low , and simmer 30 minutes , or until vegetables are tender
7. Stir occasionally while cooking
8. In a small bowl , gradually stir flour into 1 / 4 cup water until smooth
9. Add to stew , along with wine
10. Cook , stirring , 5 more minutes
11. Remove and discard bay leaf before serving

title: zesty citrus salad
steps:
1. To make dressing:mix orange juice , vinegars , honey , oil , ginger , salt and pepper flakes in blender
2. Blend 30 seconds
3. In medium bowl:combine orange slices , bell pepper , onion , and dressing
4. Marinate for at least 15 minutes
5. Toss spinach with dressing mixture and sprinkle roasted almonds on top

title: barbara bush s mushroom quiche
steps:
1. Position rack in lower 1 / 3 of oven and preheat to 375 degrees
2. Melt butter in large skillet over medium-high heat
3. Saute the mushrooms , onions , garlic , and shallots together
4. Stir in seasonings and cook 2 minutes until liquid is evaporated
5. Let cool 5 minutes
6. In a medium bowl combine eggs with milk or cream and beat well
7. Stir in mushroom mixture and pour into pie crust
8. Bake until filling is puffed , set and starting to brownabout 35 to 45 minutes

title: brigadeiros   chocolate fudge truffles
steps:
1. Pour the condensed milk into a heavy based saucepan
2. Stir in the cocoa powder and the salt
3. Cook , stirring constantly , over a low heat
4. Keep the mixture at a slow simmer to prevent burning and sticking
5. Do not leave unattended
6. Cook for 10-15 minutes , stirring , until mixture becomes very thick and shiny and starts to pull away from the bottom and sides of the pan
7. Remove from heat and stir in the butter and the vanilla
8. Chill in the refrigerator for 30 minutes
9. Using buttered hands , roll the mixture into 1 inch balls
10. Roll each ball in the chocolate sprinkles , and place in a paper liner
11. Chill until ready to serve
12. Store in the refrigerator

title: melt in your mouth baked chicken
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven 325
2. For the most flavor , leave skin on until the end
3. Place chicken with bone down , in baking dish
4. Shake bottle dressing , until mixed well
5. Pour the entire bottle over the chicken
6. Cover with foil
7. It should cover most of the chicken
8. Bake for about 1 1 / 2
9. Turn chicken every 1 / 2 hour
10. Remove the foil the last 15 mins , for browning
11. Different ovens vary
12. Chicken is done when it is very tender and falling off the bone
13. Do not add water to the recipe
14. At the end of cooking , i always remove the skin , this chicken will melt in your mouth ,

title: pesto  fried  chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Brush pesto over chicken breast fillets , coating both sides
3. Coat with corn flake crumbs
4. Bake on non-stick cookie sheet for 15-20 minutes or until cooked through

title: sun dried tomato pate
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a food processor
2. Blend well , pausing frequently to scrape sides of bowl
3. Refrigerate at least 4 hours before serving

title: sour cream peach muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f line 12 muffin cups
2. Prepare topping by mixing almonds , sugar , cinnamon and butter in a small bowl until crumbly
3. Set aside
4. In a large bowl , stir together melted butter , oil and brown sugar
5. Stir in eggs , vanilla and sour cream
6. Fold in flour , oatmeal , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
7. Fold in chopped peaches
8. Using an ice cream scoop , deposit equal portions of batter into muffin cups
9. Distribute topping on muffins
10. Bake until muffins test done by springing back when lightly touched with finger
11. Cool well , then remove from pan to finish cooling on wire cake rack
12. 9 - 12 large muffins

title: cream cheese apple pie quesadilla
steps:
1. Spread cream cheese on one side of the tortilla , completely covering it , using more around the edges , as this will help seal in the pie filling
2. Pour the filling on top of the cream cheese layer and cut apple slices into 1 / 2 inch pieces with a spoon or butterknife
3. Sprinkle pie filling with cinnamon , if desired
4. Fold tortilla over , gently pressing the edges to seal
5. Brush one side with the melted butter , and put the tortilla , butter side down , into a skillet pre-heated to medium
6. While that side is grilling , brush the unbuttered side with the remaining butter
7. Grill until golden , flip , and grill the other side until golden
8. Remove from skillet and serve with powdered sugar , whipped cream , ice cream , and additional cinnamon , if desired

title: baked bacon wrapped sea scallops
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Melt butter and wine together , when melted add paprika , seasoned salt , and lemon juice
3. Drop scallops into melted wine and butter sauce
4. Allow scallops to marinade for about 30 minutes
5. Wrap each scallop with half piece of bacon , and fasten bacon with a toothpick
6. Place wrapped scallops onto a baking sheet , and bake in the oven for about 8 minutes , then turn over and bake for another 8 minutes or until the scallops are opaque

title: bombay lamb curry
steps:
1. Peel onion and slice and mince garlic
2. Heat oil in a medium size saucepan
3. Fry onion and garlic over low heat until soft
4. Add diced lamb and cook , stirring until sealed on all sides
5. Remove meat from the saucepan and set to one side
6. Add the coriander , turmeric , black pepper and 1 tablespoon garam masala
7. Stir together for 1 minute
8. Top and tail green chilies--remove seeds first for a milder heat
9. Chop small and add to the saucepan stirring for a further minute or two
10. Add bay leaves and cinnamon
11. Stir in the yoghurt
12. Add the chopped tomatoes and bring to the boil
13. Add the lamb and simmer for 40 minutes
14. Five minutes from the end of cooking , add the remaining 2 teaspoons of garam masala and salt
15. Thicken slightly if necessary
16. Remove whole spices
17. Serve with basmati rice and accompaniments

title: susan s all grain muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven 400 degrees
2. Mash the bananas
3. Add all the wet ingredients to the bananas and mix thoroughly
4. Add the dry ingredients , except the raisins , to the wet ingredients and mix with electric mixer 2-3 minutes
5. Add the raisins last and mix thoroughly
6. Spray muffin tins with a grease release and fill to the top of muffin tin
7. Tap muffin tins on counter a couple of times to settle any bubbles in mixture
8. Bake
9. Enjoy

title: garlic buttered green beans  n carrots with bacon
steps:
1. In a large skillet , cook bacon just until crisp , turning occasionally
2. Remove bacon and reserve 2 tablespoons of drippings in skillet
3. Drain bacon on paper towels
4. Add carrots to skillet along with butter and stir fry over medium heat for about 3 minutes
5. Add green beans and garlic and continue stir frying until vegetables are done
6. Stir black pepper into vegetables and remove from heat
7. Transfer to a serving dish , crumble bacon and sprinkle over top of vegetables

title: coconut macaroon filled chocolate cookies  better than mounds
steps:
1. First , make the coconut macaroon filling:
2. With two racks in the middle of your oven , preheat the oven to 325
3. Spray two baking sheets or parchment paper with non-stick cooking spray
4. Beat egg whites and salt together until soft peaks form
5. Slowly add in sugar and beat until stiff , glossy peaks are present
6. Beat in vanilla
7. Add half the coconut and sprinkle with the flour
8. Add the rest of the coconut and gently fold into the egg white meringue
9. Using a 3 / 4 ounce scoop , drop onto baking sheets , spaced about 2 inches apart
10. Bake about 8-9 minutes , until just set
11. These will be under-baked and not brown at all
12. It's okay , because will be the filling and will finish baking inside the chocolate cookie
13. Now , it's time to make the chocolate cookie dough , while the macaroons are cooling:
14. Increase the oven temperature to 350
15. In a mixer , cream together the butter and sugars
16. Add the eggs , one at a time
17. Now add the vanilla
18. Blend in the cocoa , 1 / 2 cup at a time
19. In a separate bowl , whisk together the flour , baking soda , and salt
20. Mix in the flour mixture to the dough about a cup at a time , until well combined
21. Place fresh sheets of parchment paper on your cookie sheets
22. Using a 1 ounce scoop , drop 6 mounds of dough onto each cookie sheet , spaced widely apart
23. These will be very big cookies
24. Spray the back of a teaspoon with non-stick cooking spray and use the back of that spoon to make a nest out of the dough for each macaroon
