25. Set a macaroon on top of each chocolate cookie "nest"
26. Place another 1 ounce scoop of chocolate cookie dough on top of the macaroon layer
27. Now there are three cookie layers
28. Spread and flatten the dough , so that the macaroon is completely covered
29. Bake in the upper half of the oven for 13 minutes
30. Cookies may look a little under-baked when you remove them from the oven , but they will set up and dry , as they cool
31. Immediately , slide the parchment paper with the hot cookies onto a cooling rack
32. Cool for at least 5 minutes

title: pine nut  alfredo    veggie noodles
steps:
1. Combine all sauce ingredients in a blender or food processor , and blend until smooth
2. Combine all pasta ingredients in a medium bowl and mix carefully , but thoroughly
3. Place pasta on two individual plates and top each with half of the sauce , or toss the sauce with the pasta in a bowl and garnish with macadamia nuts , cashews , or pine nuts

title: black bing cherry chicken
steps:
1. Marinate chicken in italian dressing 2-4 hours and drain , reserving the marinade
2. Place chicken in a shallow baking pan , skin side up and bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350 degrees , basting occasionally early on , until brown
3. Melt the jelly in a saucepan over low heat and blend in the orange juice concentrate and cherries
4. Pour the sauce over the chicken in the baking dish and bake for another 15 minutes
5. Serve over brown rice

title: cream curry chicken
steps:
1. Melt margarine in nonstick frying pan
2. Add chicken to pan , cover , cook for 15 minutes over low heat
3. Combine whipping cream with curry powder in small bowl , set aside
4. Turn chicken over , pour curry mix over chicken
5. Cover and cook an additional 20 minutes
6. Serve over cooked brown rice

title: not your usual chile  mole based
steps:
1. Brown hamburger in stock pot
2. Add garlic and onions and cook until translucent
3. Stir in cocoa , cumin , hot sauce and salt and stir until well dispersed
4. Add tomato sauce and beans and mix thoroughly
5. Add coffee
6. To cut bitterness of coffee , add 1 t of sugar or more depending on how strong you make your coffee
7. Check flavor of chili
8. I like mine spicy , so i usually forgo measuring and just dump in as much cumin as possible
9. Makes a very meaty , manly chili

title: bohemian nut roll filling
steps:
1. Heat sugar
2. Nuts , milk , eggs and salt in edium saucepan
3. Sirring constanly , cook over moderate heat for 10 minutes , or until it thickens
4. Remove from heat , add vanilla and lemon
5. Chill until cool
6. Spread thinly over dough
7. Enough for 2 nut rolls

title: rachael ray s long live the chicken a la king
steps:
1. In a medium skillet over high heat , bring wine , chicken broth and bay leaf to a boil
2. Slide in chicken breasts
3. When liquid returns to a boil , lower to a simmer
4. Gently poach chicken until cooked through , 10 to 12 minutes
5. Preheat a second skillet over high heat
6. Add oil and butter
7. When butter has melted into oil , add mushrooms , onions , salt and pepper , and cook until tender , 5 minutes
8. Whisk in flour and cook another minute , stirring
9. Remove chicken from broth and set on a cutting board
10. Ladle 2 to 2 and 1 / 2 cups cooking liquid into the mushrooms , whisking it in
11. Discard bay leaf
12. Add pimentos and peas to the sauce
13. Dice chicken into bite-sized pieces and slideinto the bubbling sauce
14. Adjust salt and pepper to taste
15. Split large , warm biscuits and place bottoms on dinner plates and cover with ladles of chicken a la king , then top cap with biscuit tops and garnish with chopped parsley

title: rum flan cake
steps:
1. Caramelize sugar in 9-inch heart-shaped or round pan
2. Beat together egg yolks , eggs , sugar , evaporated milk , orange peel and rum
3. Set aside
4. To make cake batter , sift flour with sugar , baking powder and salt
5. Place in small bowl and make well in center
6. Place yolks , oil , 1 rum and orange juice in well
7. Stir until blended , starting from center
8. Beat egg whites with cream of tartar until foamy
9. Gradually add remaining sugar , beating until stiff but not dry
10. Gently fold batter into whites
11. Pour custard mixture into caramel-lined pan
12. Gently spoon cake batter over flan mixture
13. Place pan in larger pan and pour hot water into larger pan until it reaches half depth of cake pan
14. Bake at 325f 50 to 60 minutes , or until cake is done
15. Cool on rack or chill until ready to serve
16. Invert onto serving platter and pipe whipped cream rosettes around edges of flan

title: iced creamy chai
steps:
1. Steep both tea bags in boiling water for about 4 minutes to brew 1 cup double-strength tea
2. Remove tea bags
3. Refrigerate tea to cool
4. To serve , pour 1 / 2 the chilled tea over ice in each of 2 tall glasses
5. Add 1 / 4 cup cream , 1 cup cool water , and sugar to taste in each glass
6. Stir to combine
7. Sprinkle with cinnamon and / or nutmeg before serving , if desired

title: seafood platter for two
steps:
1. To prepare: cut the lobster tails and bend back in butterfly style
2. Shell and devein the scampis , prawn and shrimps
3. Extract the meat from the crab claws
4. If not already done , remove the oysters and scallops from the shell and coat with breadcrumbs
5. Finally , wash the lobster , scampi , prawns and shrimps under cold running water and dry thoroughly
6. Proceed with the following cooking methods , simultaneously: crabmeat: place the crabmeat in a small ovenproof dish , add 1 / 3 tsp garlic , 1 tsp lemon juice and half the white wine and bake in a moderate oven for 10-15 minutes
7. Lobster tails: place in an oven pan
8. Add 1 oz butter and 1 tsp lemon juice and bake in moderate oven 8- 10 minutes
9. Melt 1 oz butter in a frying pan
10. Add 1 / 3 tsp garlic and the remaining wine
11. Saut scampi , prawns and shrimp for 2 minutes , stirring continuously
12. Heat the oil and deep fry the scallops until golden
13. Transfer to a small ovenproof dish
14. Add the remaining butter , garlic and lemon juice and place in a broiler for 5 minutes
15. Reheat the oil and deep fry the oysters until golden
16. Cut the whole lemon in half and remove the seeds
17. Cut the tomato into wedges
18. Steam asparagus spears for 5 minutes and plunge immediately into ice water
19. To serve: arrange attractively on a bed of lettuce on a silver platter
20. Garnish with lemon halves and tomato wedges
21. Drape asparagus spears across the top of the tray
22. Pour over the cognac , set aflame and serve immediately

title: crab filled mushrooms
steps:
1. Remove mushroom stems , and discard , set caps aside
2. Combine next 5 ingredients in a bowl , stir well
3. Gently fold in crabmeat , bell pepper and green onion
4. Spoon 1 tbsp crabmeat mixture into each mushroom cap
5. Place stuffed mushrooms in a 13x9x2-inch baking dish
6. Bake at 350 for 20 minutes
7. Serve warm

title: moroccan spiced lamb chops
steps:
1. In a small bowl combine spices
2. Sprinkle on both sides of lamb chops , save the rest for another dish
3. Heat oil in skillet , add lamb and cook 5-10 minutes per side for med rare to medium

title: roasted potatoes  peppers and onions with rosemary
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees
2. Arrange the potatoes and the red and green peppers alternately in a spoke pattern in a shallow , 12-inch round baking dish
3. Pile the onions in the center
4. Scatter the garlic over the top
5. Drizzle with oil , and sprinkle with rosemary , salt and black pepper
6. Bake in the preheated oven until the vegetables are lightly golden and tender , or about 45 minutes
7. Garnish with fresh rosemary sprigs

title: gingery carrot soup
steps:
1. Heat oil and butter in a large saucepan
2. Add onions and soften for 2-3 minutes
3. Add ginger and garlic and continue to saute
4. Add carrots and grated lemon peel and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes
5. Pour in stock and bring soup to a boil
6. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes or until carrots are soft
7. Puree the soup in batches in a blender or food processor
8. Handle carefully- it will be hot
9. Return to the saucepan and stir in lemon juice
10. If soup is thicker than desired , add a small amount to thin
11. Serve and garnish with a thin slice of lemon or slivers of pink , pickled ginger

title: brownie cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Spray pam a 9 inch springform pan
3. In a large bowl , prepare brownie mix
4. Spread into the bottom of the pan
5. Bake 30-35 minutes
6. Turn down to 325
7. In a large bowl , beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth and creamy
8. Beat in sour cream and eggs
9. Add extracts
10. Pour over cooled crust
11. Place cheesecake in the middle of the oven
12. Filla large pan with hot water and place on rack underneath cheesecake
13. Bake 1 hour 25 minutes
14. Turn off oven but leave cheesecake in closed oven 30 minutes
15. Remove the cheesecake and cool 1 hour
16. Refrigerate covered at least 4 hours

title: northern omelet bagel sandwich
steps:
1. Slice bagels , toast and set aside
2. Place sausage patties in a skillet and cook them on medium head until hot all the way through but not burnt
3. Take off heat and set to the side
4. Chop tomato and green pepper , place inside a medium sized bowl
5. In same bowl , crack the eggs and empty their insides into it
6. With a fork , whip until everything is mixed and eggs are fluffy
7. Melt a little butter on the bottom of the skillet and dump the eggs , tomatos , and peppers into it
8. Cook on medium heat , scraping the bottom occasionally so as not to burn the eggs
9. When the eggs are done they'll be firm but still a little moist
10. Place the bottom of one bagel on a plate and set a sausage patty on top of it
11. Take as many eggs as you want and place them on top of the sausage
12. While the eggs are still hot , place a piece of cheese on it to melt
13. Put the top of the bagel on the sandwich and enjoy !

title: honeyed fig topping with vanilla and cinnamon
steps:
1. Bring figs , honey , 1 tablespoons water , vanilla , and cinnamon to simmer in small saucepan over medium-high heat
2. Cook until liquid reduces to glaze , about 4 minutes
3. Spoon a portion over individual bowls of hot oatmeal
4. Serve immediately

title: green bean medley
steps:
1. Steam or cook carrots and green beans in boiling water
2. Cook until tender , but still firm
3. Melt butter over medium heat
4. Saute onions and mushrooms until almost tender
5. Reduce heat , cover , and simmer for 3 minutes
6. Stir in green beans , carrots , seasoned salt , garlic , and white pepper
7. Cover and cook five minutes on low heat

title: baked artichoke squares
steps:
1. Heat 3 tbs oil in medium skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add mushrooms , celery and garlic and sautee till celery is tender
3. Remove from heat , stir in artichoke hearts , onion , marjoram , oregano and ground red pepper add cheeses and eggs , mix well and set aside
4. Combine flour and salt in a medium bowl
5. Combine 1 / 2 cup vegetable oil and the milk in a small bowl
6. Add to flour mixture , stir until mixture forms a ball
7. Press dough in bottom and 1 1 / 2 inches up sides of 13x9x2 inch pan
8. Bake in preheated 350 degree oven for 10 minutes
9. Spread artichoke mixture on baked crust
10. Continue baking about 20 minutes more or until center is set
11. Cool slightly , cut into 24 squares
12. Serve warm

title: asparagus casserole crock pot
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine all ingredients well
2. Pour into lightly greased crock pot
3. Cover and cook on high for 3 to 3 1 / 2 hours
4. After cooking dish may be left on low for up to 2 hours before serving

title: lemonade lychee and coconut cocktails
steps:
1. In a saucepan , bring to boil 1 cup water and sugar stirring until sugar is dissolved
2. Pour in a pitcher
3. Add lemon juice , rum , lytchi and their syrup
4. Put in fridge around 4 hours or all night
5. Serve with ice

title: stove top sirloin
steps:
1. Cut steak in half
2. Brown in skillet on medium heat with canola oil
3. Remove steak from skillett
4. Add the rest of the ingredients
5. Bring to a boil
6. Add the steak and let simmer for 20 minutes or until steak is done to your liking
7. Remove and serve with onions and sauce on top of the steak

title: chili s egg rolls lightened up
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Combine chicken , corn , cheese , chili pepper , and spinach in a microwaveable bowl
3. Heat for 30 seconds in micro
4. Warm tortillas in micro for 15 seconds
5. On a clean , flat surface , lay out tortillas side-by-side
6. Put 1 / 3 of chicken mix in the center of each tortilla
7. To assemble each roll , fold the left and right sides in so no filling escapes during cooking , and roll up
8. Place all 3 rolls seam side down on a baking pan that has been sprayed
9. Bake 12 minutes , flipping 1 / 2 way through cooking
10. While eggrolls are in the oven prepare dip
11. Sauce:
12. Combine sour cream , avocado , and dry dip mix in a small bowl until smooth
13. Season to taste with pepper
14. Top dip sauce with tomatoes before serving
15. When eggrolls are done , allow to cool for a few minutes , then cup diagonally

title: lemon cream cupcakes  splenda
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , mix apple sauce and splenda
2. Beat in eggwhites , one at a time
3. Add lemon peel , lemon juice , and vanilla
4. Mix well
5. Combine dry ingredients
6. Add to apple sauce mixture alternately with sour cream
7. Fill greased or paper-lined muffin cups with 1 / 4 cup of batter
8. Bake at 350 degrees f for 25-30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
9. Cool for 10 minutes
10. Remove to wire racks to cool completely
11. For frosting i like to mix maple syrup with some lemon juice and whiskey , and soak bottom of the cup cakes in it , or just use some sugar-free coolwhip

title: egyptian milk pudding  mihallabiya
steps:
1. Add ground rice to 1 cup of milk
2. Dissolve sugar in the remaining milk and bring to a boil
3. Add the rice-milk mixture , lower heat , and cook-stirring occasionally-until the pudding thickens like thin custard
4. Remove from flame , stir in the rosewater , and pour into a shallow serving dish
5. Sprinkle top with nuts

title: newfoundland cod chowder
steps:
1. In a large , heavy saucepan , cook bacon over medium high heat for about 10 minutes or until crisp
2. Chop the cooked bacon coarsely and set aside
3. Drain off all but 1 tablespoons bacon fat from saucepan
4. Add onions and savory to the saucepan
5. Cook , stirring occasionally , for 5 minutes or until softened
6. Add potatoes , carrots , water and salt
7. Bring to boil
8. Cover
9. Reduce heat and simmer for about 20 minutes or until tender
10. Add the cod chunks
11. Simmer for about 5 minutes or until fish flakes easily
12. Add milk and pepper , heat through
13. Serve in bowls and garnish with the bacon and chives

title: garlic and rosemary roasted turkey breast
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Insert pieces of garlic and rosemary under the skin
3. Place additional garlic & rosemary in the neck and abdomen cavities
4. Rub olive oil over the skin , and season with salt & pepper
5. Place on rack in roasting pan and roast in oven at 350f for 1-2 hours for a 4-6 pound breast , until internal temperature checks at least 165f and skin is nicely browned
6. Remove from oven and let rest for 20 minutes before slicing and serving

title: big breakfast biscuit sandwich
steps:
1. Mix together egg , spamcheese , and pepper
2. Set aside
3. In a non-stick skillet melt margarine over medium heat
4. Spray canning ring with cooking spray
5. Place ring in skillet , pour egg / mixture into ring
6. Let cook for about 3 minutes , pour water around ring
7. Cover with lid and let cook for about 5 minutes
8. Remove lid and turn egg and ring over
9. Cover with lid and finish cooking
10. Place in biscuit and eat

title: simply scalloped potatoes  sp5
steps:
1. Arrange layer over potatoes in greased casserole dish
2. Sprinkle with salt
3. Repeat layering , ending in potatoes
4. Mix cream and broth , pour over potatoes
5. Sprinkle cheese over top and cover dish with foil
6. Preheat oven to 400 degrees and bake for 30 minutes
7. Remove foil and continue baking for another 10 minutes

title: pancake cupcakes with maple bacon buttercream frosting
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f line a sheet pan with aluminum foil and arrange bacon on the pan
2. Bake 15 minutes until very crisp
3. Immediately transfer bacon to paper towels to drain
4. Let cool 5-10 minutes
5. Crumble bacon and toss with maple syrup
6. Line a standard muffin pan with paper liners , and spray liners with non-stick spray
7. Whisk together flour , sugar , baking powder and salt in a large bowl
8. Add a third of the cooled bacon
9. In a second bowl , whisk together milk , eggs and melted butter
10. Pour the wet ingredients over the dry and stir just until fully moistened
11. Divide the batter evenly amongst the muffin cups and bake in the preheated oven until puffed and firm to the touch , about 10 minutes
12. Cool in pan 5 minutes , then transfer to a wire rack until fully cooled
13. In the work bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the whisk , whip the butter on high until very light and fluffy , about 5 minutes , scraping down the sides of the bowl every minute or two
14. Turn the speed down to low and add the powdered sugar a little at a time
15. Do not add more until it's nearly completely absorbed
16. Scrape down the sides of the bowl , turn up to medium-high and whip until fluffy , 1-2 minutes
17. Add maple syrup and vanilla and continue to whip 1 minute more
18. Add half the remaining bacon and stir in with a spatula
19. Frost the cooled cupcakes with an offset spatula
20. Top with more bacon

title: mexican ground beef stew
steps:
1. Stew: cook beef
2. Add all ingredients to large pot
3. Simmer on low for 2 hours
4. Serve in individual bowls with cheese and tortilla strips on top
5. Tortilla strips: slice tortillas in thin strips and fry in oil

title: creamy taco dip
steps:
1. Microwave all ingredients in a bowl on high for five minutes or until velveeta is melted , stirring after two minutes
2. Serve with tortilla chips

title: chilli bean tortillas
steps:
1. Cook the ground lamb in a frying pan for 2 minutes
2. Add the onion and cook for 7 minutes until brown
3. Add the chilli powder and cum and cook for 1 minute
4. Reduce the heat , cover and cook for 30 minutes
5. Warm the tortillas in the microwave on high for 45 seconds
6. Spoon the lamb into the center of the tortilla and let everybody add their own extras
7. Fold the edges over to enclose the filling

title: snap pea salad
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a bowl
2. Let stand 10 minutes , tossing occasionally

title: spaghetti with italian tuna   capers
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat olive oil over medium heat
2. Add chopped onion and anchovy fillet , and saute until soft , about 5 minutes
3. Add crushed red pepper and garlic and saute for another minute
4. Add tomato sauce and reduce heat to low
5. Next , add capers and the cans of tuna
6. I like to drain the oil from one of the cans and leave the oil from the second
7. Break up the large pieces of tuna with a fork or wooden spoon
8. Cook pasta in boiling salted water for about 7 minutes or until al dente
9. Drain , and toss with tuna red sauce in a serving bowl
10. Sprinkle with basil or parsley and serve

title: hungarian country bread
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast in water
2. Add most of the flour and the salt
3. Knead vigorously by hand for 5-10 minutes
4. Let rise , covered , to double size
5. Heat the oven to 450 deg f / 230 deg c
6. Knead again , vigorously , for 5 minutes
7. Shape one big , round loaf and put on a greased baking tray
8. Cover and let rise for another 45 minutes
9. Make a few cuts in the loaf with a razorblade
10. Bake in the oven for 10 minutes
11. Reduce heat to 400 / 200 deg and bake another one hour
12. The crust should become quite brown
13. Turn off the oven , take out the bread , and brush the bread with water
14. Put it back in the oven for 15 minutes
15. Let cool uncovered

title: magic kingdom breakfast lasagna
steps:
1. Make the pastry cream first
2. In a 2 quart saucepan , combine sugar , flour , salt and milk over medium heat and cook stirring until mixture thickens
3. In a small bowl with a fork , beat egg yolks slightly , beat small amount of milk mixture into yolks
4. Slowly pour egg mixture back into milk mixture
5. Stirring constantly , cook over medium low heat until mixture thickens
6. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla extract
7. Chill cream until ready to use
8. Assembly:
9. Put a thin layer of pastry cream in a pan , make a layer of waffles , put a layer of pastry cream
10. Cut strawberries into slices
11. Take half the strawberries and half the blueberries and make a layer of fruit
12. Top the fruit with a layer of pancakes , then layer of pastry cream
13. Garnish the lasagna with the rest of the strawberries and blueberries
14. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 20 minutes

title: mandarin orange muffins
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients
2. Mix wet and ingredients and add to dry , and fold in with spatula
3. Fold in fruit
4. Add to tins
5. Sprinkle with sugar
6. Bake at 375 , 20-25 min
7. This makes 6 , and i have enough batter leftover for two muffins
8. It freezes beautifully

title: chicken quesadilla stack
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Lightly coat baking sheet with veggie spray
3. Place one tortilla on baking sheet and spread 1 / 4 cup refried beans on top
4. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 cup chicken , 2 1 / 2 tablespoons chiles , 1 tablespoon cilantro , and 3 tablespoons cheese
5. Repeat layering two times
6. Top with remaining tortilla , pressing down slightly to help hold layers together
7. Cover top tortilla loosely with foil and bake stack until heated through , about 15 minutes
8. Remove foil , sprinkle with remaining cheese , and bake until cheese melts , about 5 minutes longer
9. Meanwhile , combine sour cream and remaining cilantro in a small bowl
10. Cut quesadilla into 6 wedges , but do not separate them
11. Spread cilantro sour cream over top and spoon salsa in centre

title: mexican cheeseburger soup
steps:
1. In a large pot , brown and crumble the ground beef with the garlic , onion and red bell pepper
2. Cook until beef is mo longer pink
3. Drain
4. Return the cooked beef mixture to the pot
5. Add to the pot , the undrained tomatoes , diced green chilies , mexicorn , black beans , salt , cumin , and pepper
6. Bring to a gentle simmer and simmer for about 10 minutes
7. Stir in the cheeses and milk
8. Stir frequently and heat until cheese is melted and smooth -- do not let boil

title: ham   cheese soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan over medium heat
2. Saute onion , celery , carrots , parsley and garlic in butter for 5 minutes
3. Stir in flour , ground mustard , and pepper
4. Add ham and cook for 1 minute stirring constantly
5. Gradually add broth and milk
6. Bring to a boil
7. Cook and stir for 2 minutes
8. Stir in cheese
9. Reduce heat
10. Cook and stir till cheese is melted
11. Do not boil

title: layered banana cream dream pie
steps:
1. Beat cream cheese till light and fluffy
2. Add 2 tablespoons milk , mixing until lump free
3. Add remaining milk , mixing well
4. Stir in the pudding mix
5. Beat on low for 2 minutes
6. Slice bananas and layer on the bottom of the pie shell
7. Pour pudding mixture over bananas
8. Chill 1 hour
9. Whip cream until stiff peaks form , mixing in the powdered sugar
10. Spread over pie filling
11. Dust lightly with nutmeg and refrigerate 1 more hour

title: baby bok choy saut with mushrooms
steps:
1. Saut mushrooms in olive oil over medium heat
2. Cook until the sweat and turn light brown , 3 to 4 minutes
3. Add bok choy and stir-fry until tender-crisp , 2 to 3 minutes
4. Add garlic , cook for about 1 minute or until you start to smell the garlic
5. Add broth and pepper
6. Saut until most of the broth has evaporated

title: hawaiian fruit with pina colada dip
steps:
1. In small bowl , mix yogurt , rum extract and 3 tablespoons of the coconut and pineapple
2. Stir and serve or cover and store in refrigerator until serving time
3. Sprinkle dip with remaining 1 tablespoon toasted coconut
4. To serve , arrange fruit on a platter with dip in the middle

title: halloween butterfinger eyes
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl stir together peanut butter and butter until creamy
2. Gradually add powdered sugar , stirring until combined
3. Stir in butterfinger candy
4. Shape into 1-inch balls
5. Place on waxed paper
6. Freeze about 45 minutes
7. Melt white chocolate in a double boiler or get a med sauce pan filled 1 / 4 of the way with water and heat until simmering and place a large glass or stainless steel bowl over top and turn heat off -if water is boiling it will scorch chocolate
8. Add chocolate to bowl , stir constantly until melted and smooth , if you want the coating thinner add a tbs shortening until desired thickness is reached
9. Dip balls , one at a time , into coating
10. Let excess coating drip off
11. Place on waxed paper , immediately press an m&m onto center of each peanut butter ball
12. Refrigerate until coating is firm
13. Using leftover white chocolate add red food coloring until desired color is reached and place in a ziploc or pastry bag , cut a corner very small , pipe squiggly lines on eyes to make them look blood shot or use red decorating gel
14. Add a dot of black gel or black food colored coating to the center of m&m pieces for pupils

title: asparagus and cashew stir fry
steps:
1. Cut off the tough ends of the asparagus , and then slice diagonally into 2-3 pieces
2. Heat the oil together in a large skillet or wok over medium high heat
3. Add the ginger and stir fry for 1 minute
4. Add the asparagus and stir fry until tender but still a tiny bit crisp , 4-5 minutes
5. Stir in the cashews and soy sauce
6. Serve immediately

title: hot beef and cheese dip
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine cream cheese , sour cream and milk , blend well
3. Add dried beef , green onions , green pepper , pimiento and pepper , mix well
4. Put in oven safe dish , sprinkle with pecans
5. Bake 15 to 20 minutes , or until hot and bubbly
6. This is great served with crusty bread

title: best ever chicken fried rice
steps:
1. Beat egg with water in a small bowl
2. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium low heat
3. Add egg and let it lie flat until cooked
4. Remove from skillet and cut into shreds
5. Add onion to skillet
6. Saute onion until tender
7. Add rice , soy sauce , pepper , and chicken
8. Stir fry together for about 5 minutes then stir in egg

title: irish pot roast
steps:
1. Combine flour , salt , and pepper
2. Dredge roast in flour mixture
3. Save remaining flour mixture for gravy
4. Heat oil in large skillet or frying pan , and sear roast on all sides until well browned
5. In crockpot , layer vegetables , ale , and beef broth on the bottom , then meat , then honey , then onions , garlic , and thyme
6. Cook on low for 8-10 hours , or on high 4-5 hours
7. Mix water and reserved flour in bowl
8. Drain juices from crockpot into a saucepan
9. Bring to a boil , then add flour slurry
10. Cook on medium-high heat until thick and bubbly

title: cheesy chicken noodle  casserole
steps:
1. Combine cooked noodles , chicken , soup , butter , sour cream , pepper and 3 / 4 cup of mozzarella cheese
2. Mix well and put into a 2 quart casserole dish
3. Bake covered at 350 degrees for 30 minutes
4. Uncover and add remaining mozzarella cheese and bake 10 minutes more

title: brown rice and vegetable pilaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
2. Heat chicken broth to boiling
3. Combine broth with brown rice , butter , oregano , marjoram , and summery savory in 3 quart casserole and bake , covered , for 1-1 / 2 hours or until rice is tender
4. Keep hot
5. Melt butter in large skillet or dutch oven
6. Add celery , snow peas , broccoli , green onion , and ginger and stir fry until crisp-tender
7. Add vegetables , lemon rind , and toasted coconut to rice
8. Toss lightly to combine
9. Adjust seasonings

title: pizzeria pizza sauce
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , saut garlic in oil until golden
2. Add tomato paste , water , sugar , oregano , basil , cheese and wine
3. Season with salt and pepper , to taste
4. Simmer for 10 minutes over medium low heat

title: wolfgang puck s house salad dressing
steps:
1. Whisk together first five ingredients
2. Slowly whisk in oil
3. Season with salt and pepper

title: prawn and green onion fritters with avocado
steps:
1. Combine flour , and salt and pepper in a large bowl
2. Lightly whisk milk and eggs in a jug with a fork until combined
3. Pour into flour mixture
4. Stir gently until smooth
5. Add prawns and onions to flour mixture
6. Stir gently to combine
7. Pour enough oil into a large non-stick frying pan to cover the base
8. Heat over medium heat
9. Add tablespoonfuls of prawn mixture , 6 at a time
10. Cook for 3 minutes each side or until golden and cooked through
11. Set aside to cool
12. Repeat with remaining prawn mixture
13. Combine avocado , sour cream , and salt and pepper
14. Top fritters with avocado mixture
15. Sprinkle with chives
16. Serve

title: skillet browned potatoes
steps:
1. Slice potatoes into chunks or into round slices , i have cooked them both ways and both are good
2. It is just personal preference for shape
3. Boil for 10 minutes in salted water , drain in a collander
4. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat melt butter and oil in skillet
5. When butter is melted add onions
6. When translucent , add potatoes and seasonings
7. Cover and cook on one side for 5-7 minute
8. Flip and cook on other side for 5-7 more minute
9. Potatoes should be browned and crispy looking , but also a little soft
10. If butter ran dry during cooking add 2 more tb
11. Enjoy !

title: rosemary cookies
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , except rosemary in mixer bowl
2. Mix thoroughly
3. You may need to add a little more flour is dough appears sticky
4. Add just a tbls at a time
5. Add rosemary and gently mix into the batter
6. Form into small balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet
7. Flatten each with the bottom of glass dipped in sugar
8. Bake at 375
9. Check after 6 minutes
10. Turn pan and bake another 2-4 minutes until cookies are pale golden brown and firm to touch
11. Baking times depend on how large you form your cookies
12. Do not overbake
13. Some residual heat always remains after you take cookies from oven

title: fettuccini with spicy tomato cream sauce
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat
2. Cook onion and pepper flakes 5 minutes until tender
3. Stir in tomatoes and salt
4. Cook over high heat until almost dry , 8-10 minutes
5. Stir in cream
6. Bring to a boil
7. Boil 1 minute
8. Meanwhile , cook fettuccini
9. Drain pasta and toss with sauce
10. Stir in basil
11. Serve with parmesan

title: ww 2 points sweet   sour meatballs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray
3. Combine beef , oats , egg whites , onions , garlic , parsley and oregano in a medium bowl and mix thoroughly
4. Shape beef mixture into 48 1" balls , place on baking sheet
5. Bake meatballs for 25 minutes
6. Transfer to a crockpot to keep warm and set on low
7. Meanwhile , combine remaining ingredients in a small bowl
8. Pour over meatballs and let heat about 10 minutes
9. Points figured for 4 meatballs per serving

title: spinach feta strata
steps:
1. In a greasd 13 x 9 x 2" baking dish , arrange french bread or croissants with sides overlapping
2. In a bowl , combine the eggs , milk , spinach , salt , nutmeg and pepper
3. Pour over bread
4. Sprinkle with cheeses
5. Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight
6. Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes before baking
7. Bake , uncovered , at 350f for 40-45 minutes or until lightly browned
8. Serve warm

title: persian walnut cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees fahrenheit
2. Beat egg yolks with sugar until very thick and almost white
3. Mix chopped walnuts and lemon rind into yolk mixture
4. Drop teaspoonfuls of batter onto ungreased cookie sheet , leaving 2 inches between them
5. Bake for about 10 minutes or until cookies are dry and firm
6. Remove from sheet when cool

title: land o lakes lemon velvet butter sauce
steps:
1. Combine wine , shallots and lemon juice in a 10 inch non reactive skillet
2. Cook over medium high heat until mixture comes to a boil , about 5-7 minutes
3. Continue boiling until liquid almost evaporates about 4-5 minutes
4. Reduce heat to medium low
5. Add flour , mix well
6. Slowly stir in cream with wire whisk until well mixed
7. Cook , stirring constantly , until mixture boils , about 1 to 2 minutes
8. Stir in butter until melted
9. Season with salt and pepper
10. If sauce starts to curdle , decrease heat , whisk until smooth

title: pistachio torte
steps:
1. For the crust , mix together the flour , butter and nuts
2. Press in the bottom of a 9 x 13 pan
3. Bake at 325 for 15 minutes
4. Let cool
5. Mix the cream cheese , powdered sugar and 1 cup cool whip
6. Spread on top of crust
7. Mix well the pudding and milk
8. Pour on top of cream cheese mixture and let set
9. Top with remaining cool whip
10. May top with chopped nuts if desired

title: most delicious garlic cheese bread
steps:
1. Slice or halve the bread and brush one side of slices , or cut side of halves , with olive oil
2. Place the bread under the broiler until it starts to look toasted
3. Remove
4. Mix the garlic , mayonnaise , parmesan , and salt together
5. Spread over the bread
6. Place the bread back under the broiler until the tops are nice and bubbly and beginning to brown
7. Garnish with parsley flakes

title: carne asada burgers
steps:
1. Combine 1 / 4 c lime juice , 1 / 4 c olive oil , salt , pepper , cumin , and garlic powder in a large ziplock bag
2. Add beef patties in a single layer and lay flat to marinade
3. Marinade 1-2 hours , turning to marinade both sides evenly
4. Combine 2 tbsp lime juice , 2 tbsp olive oil , salt , pepper , cumin , and garlic powder in a small ziplock bag
5. Add green onions
6. Marinade 1-2 hours , shaking now and then
7. Combine salsa and mayonnaise and mix well
8. Refrigerate sauce until needed
9. Grill beef patties over gas or coals until cooked to desired doneness
10. Grill green onions for a couple of minutes , until cooked and just charred around the edges
11. Toast buns if desired
12. Assemble burgers by spreading salsa sauce on buns , topping with beef patties , grilled green onions , and avocado slices

title: spicy garlic shrimp with fettuccine
steps:
1. In small saucepan , whisk together white wine with juice of 1 / 2 lemon , lemon pepper , oregano , basil , and thyme
2. Reduce over medium-low heat down to about 1 / 2 cup
3. In skillet , saut garlic in 1 / 2 stick butter for about 4 minutes
4. Add red chili pepper flakes to garlic / butter mixture and saut for about 1 minute
5. Add shrimp to skillet , cook until pink , about 5 minutes
6. Remove shrimp from pan , reserving leftover liquid
7. Add liquid from skillet to saucepan , whisking thoroughly , and raise heat to medium
8. Add 1 / 2 stick butter , sliced , to saucepan , continuing to whisk until melted
9. In separate ramekin or very small bowl , whisk together corn starch with small amount of half and half until smooth
10. Add to saucepan , continuing to whisk until entire mixture is smooth and begins to thicken
11. Add half and half to saucepan , continuing to whisk until thickened to desired consistency
12. Add to fettuccine , tossing until coated
13. Serve fettuccine on a plate , topped with sauted shrimp

title: buttery golden garlic biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Remove biscuits from can , and place them in a row in an 8x4x2-inch loaf pan
3. Separating tops of rows slightly
4. Combine remaining ingredients
5. Pour over the biscuits
6. Bake in oven for 20 minutes , or until the biscuits are golden brown

title: trinidad stewed chicken
steps:
1. Prepare green seasoning marinade:
2. Put all the seasoning ingredients into your blender or food processor and process dry or with a minimum amount of water
3. Store in the fridge , in a glass jar , for up to a week
4. Or add some more water and some vinegar if you want to keep it longer
5. Sorry i can't offer definite measurements
6. I usually just eyeball this
7. Trinidadians use this all purpose mix to season just about any kind of meat
8. It keeps well in the fridge and we usually make a fresh batch of this once a week
9. Season chicken with angustora bitters , green seasoning , salt and black pepper and leave to marinate in the fridge for 1 / 2 hour or longer if you have the time
10. Heat oil in a heavy pot , add sugar and garlic and let caramelize
11. Stir once or twice so that the garlic doesn't burn
12. The sugar will go from the colour of peanut butter to a bubbling , dark , reddish brown
13. When the outer edges start to turn an even darker brown , add all the chicken to the pot
14. Do not stir
15. Let the water generated by the addtion of the chicken dry out some and give chicken a chance to caramelize
16. Turn chicken and let rest again for the other side to caramelize
17. Reapeat this process , turning chicken occasionally so that it browns on all sides
18. If the sauce at this point looks a little bit gooey you are on the right track
19. You may need to add a few tablespoons of water during this process if it seems that the sauce is drying out too quickly but keep it at this thickened stage until the chicken is brown
20. If your sauce is too thin and watery the chicken will not caramelize
21. Do not walk away while browning the sugar
22. Once brown you'd be surprised how quickly it goes to black leaving you with a bitter charred mess that dries hard and ruins your pot and your spoon:=)no this never happened to me before lol
23. Don't rush this stage
24. Let the liquid dry out , turning chicken occasionally so that it browns on all sides
25. If water is added too soon the brown colour will wash right off
26. The chicken will be too pale
27. When chicken is nice and brown , add the worcestershire sauce , the maggi cube and 2 cups cup or more of water to cover the chicken or two cups of broth
28. Add hot pepper sauce
29. Cover pot and bring to a boil
30. Remove the pot cover part of the way as you want the liquid to start drying up but not so quickly that the chicken doesn't have time to cook
31. If liquid dries out too quickly you can always add more water
32. Cook on medium heat until chicken is tender
33. Once the chicken is cooked , let liquid dry out until the sauce in the pot is no longer watery
34. Serve with hot rice , salad or vegetables
35. Variations: you can add a 1 / 4 cup pumpkin cut in small cubes after you brown the chicken if you want a slightly thicker sauce

title: green beans and onions
steps:
1. Cook bacon in skillet until it begins to brown
2. Add onions , cooking until slightly translucent
3. Add beans , stirring occasionally , until beans are soft
4. Salt and pepper to taste

title: shrimp and scallop curry
steps:
1. Combine shells , green onion , garlic and curry powder in medium skillet over med
2. High heat and cook for 1 minute
3. Blend in cream and wine
4. Increase heat to high and cook , stirring constantly for 5 minutes
5. Remove from heat
6. Discard shells
7. Set sauce aside
8. Season shrimp and scallops with salt , pepper and curry powder
9. Heat butter in saucepan over med
10. High heat
11. Add shrimp and scallops in batches and cook for 2 minutes
12. Remove shrimp and scallops from pan and set aside
13. Add cream sauce to pan and cook until sauce is thick about 3 minutes
14. Return shrimp and scallops to saucepan
15. Blend in parsley

title: arugula  fennel and orange salad
steps:
1. Using a sharp knife , peel the oranges , removing the bitter white pith
2. Slice crosswise 1 / 4 inch thick
3. In a bowl , whisk the oil and vinegar and season with salt and pepper
4. Add the fennel , scallions and arugula and toss
5. Add the oranges
6. Season with salt and pepper and serve

title: amazingly easy three ingredient creamed spinach
steps:
1. Put frozen spinach in a medium size sauce pan
2. Turn heat to medium and heat spinach until it thaws completely
3. Add soup mix and sour cream
4. Stir until heated completely

title: roasted heart
steps:
1. Mix together the tomato paste , crushed garlic , 1 teaspoons italian spices , and brown sugar in a small saucepan and place over medium heat
2. Cook for at least 20 minutes , stirring frequently
3. While the tomato sauce is cooking , fill a large pot with enough water to easily cover the chicken breasts by a few inches , but don't add the chicken yet
4. Add the onion , garlic , 1 tablespoons italian spices , salt , and pepper
5. Bring to a boil
6. Toss the chicken breasts into the pot , cover , and turn off the heat
7. Leave on the burner , but let sit for about 20 minutes
8. Do not peek
9. Remove the thickest piece of chicken , and check to make sure that it is thoroughly cooked
10. If not replace to the pot , recover , and let sit for a few minutes more
11. When the chicken is cooked , drain thoroughly , and discard the vegetables and spices along with the water
12. While the chicken breasts are cooking , melt the butter in a medium saucepan , but don't brown
13. Add the flour and whisk to form a roux
14. Cook until lightly browned , then slowly add the heavy cream
15. Whisk briskly
16. Continue to cook the sauce over medium heat until thickened
17. Add the tomato paste mixture and mix well
18. Lower the heat to keep warm while you assemble the dish
19. Place a pool of the tomato sauce on an individual serving dish
20. Top with a chicken breast , and thoroughly cover with more of the tomato sauce
21. Top with half of a roasted pepper
22. Serve hot

title: the one and only garlic spaghetti
steps:
1. Boil spaghetti in a pot of boiling water
2. While spaghetti cooks , prepare sauce
3. Place the egg garlic , butter , grated parmesan cheese and dried sweet basil in a blender or food processor and blend together until smooth and well blended
4. When spaghetti is cooked and drained , place it in a large bowl and add the garlic-cheese paste and chopped parsley and ground black pepper
5. Toss well
6. Place on servining plater and pass the red pepper flakes , bacon bits and more parmesan and black pepper around for each to add
7. You can vary this recipe by adding sauteed onions and mushrooms , stir-fried green peppers or added cream or sauteed shrimp
8. Enjoy , and you will know you added enough garlic if you wake up the next morning tasting it on your breath

title: best ever fettuccine alfredo
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil
2. Add fettucine pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente and drain melt butter in a large skillet and add chopped garlic
3. Cook on low for about 5 minutes , stirring often , making sure not to burn the garlic pour about 1 / 4 cup of the heavy cream into a small bow
4. Add the egg yolk and beat together and put aside
5. Pour the remaining cream into the frying pan
6. Increase the heat to medium-high
7. As the cream starts to boil , mix rapidly using a whisk
8. Slowly add the cream / egg mixture
9. You do not want the egg to cook
10. Continue beating the cream mixture until all mixed together
11. Add 1 cup of parmesan cheese and continue to mix the cream
12. Pour in remaining parmesan and parsley and mix until smooth
13. Immediately remove from stove
14. Serve over cooked pasta

title: taco pasta
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees , and cook pasta according to directions , and set aside
2. In a large skillet , cook ground chiocken , and onion half at a time , until meat is brown , and drain fat
3. Return mixture to skillet , and stir in water , and taco seasoning mix , bring to a boil , and reduce heat
4. Simmer uncovered for 2 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Stir in cooked pasta , corn , olives , and half of the shredded cheese , all the salsa , and all the chile peppers
6. Transfer mixture to a lightly greased 3 quart rectangular casserole
7. Bake uncovered for 35-45 minutesor until heated through
8. Remove from oven and sprinkle the remaining cheese
9. Serve with lettuce , tomato , tortilla chips , and sour cream

title: pork chops in creamy herbed brandy sauce
steps:
1. In a large plastic or ceramic dish , mix the evaporated milk with the brandy , pepper , chicken bouillon , oregano and parsley
2. Add the pork chops and turn over to coat both sides
3. Marinate in the refrigerator for 2 or 3 hours
4. Drain the pork chops , reserving the marinade
5. Meanwhile , heat the oil in a large , deep skillet
6. Add the flour and cook stirring often until it turns golden
7. Slowly and whisking constantly , add the water and the reserved marinade
8. Cook over low heat stirring constantly
9. Add the pork chops and bring to a boil
10. Lower the heat and cook until pork chops are thoroughly cooked and tender , about 25 minutes
11. Serve

title: stir fry beef and vegetables
steps:
1. Toss beef in bowl with soy sauce and sherry
2. Cover and marinate for 30 minutes
3. Heat oil in wok , or wide frying pan
4. Add garlic and ginger and saute over high heat
5. Add drained beef
6. Stir fry until meat is brown
7. Add scallions , celery , carrots , broccoli and mushrooms
8. Cover and steam about 5 minutes
9. Mix water , cornstarch , sesame oil and marinate in small bowl
10. Pour into pan
11. Heat to boiling
12. Cook until thickened
13. Serve over rice

title: light sweet and sour pork
steps:
1. Trim fat from pork and cut into 3 / 4 inch pieces
2. Place breadcrumbs on a plate
3. Mix melted margarine and a clove minced garlic
4. Add to pork in a plastic bag and toss to coat evenly
5. Roll pork in breadcrumbs and place on a baking sheet
6. Bake at 375 for 10 to 12 minutes until the pork is no longer pink
7. Do not turn it
8. In a bowl mix together chicken broth , sugar , wine vinegar , cornstarch , and soy sauce
9. Set aside
10. Spray a wok or skillet with nonstick cooking spray , along with a teaspoon of oil , if needed
11. Add a clove minced garlic and stir-fry 15 seconds , then add carrots , cover and cook 3 minutes , add green and red bell peppers with onion and stir fry again for 3 or 4 minutes
12. Remove veggies from wok
13. Stir the sauce and add to the wok , cook until bubbly and thickened , plus an additional minute
14. Stir in the vegetables and pineapple chunks
15. Cook about a minute or until heated through
16. Arrange pork on a platter and spoon sauce over top
17. Serve with hot cooked rice

title: spicy chicken thick gravy
steps:
1. Wash the chicken well and with a knife slash the chicken flesh a little to enable to juices to penetrate
2. In a bowl mix , chicken , chili powder , coriander powder , garam masala , salt , lime juice , yoghurt and set aside
3. You can choose to set aside this mixture for about 1 hour to enable better flavoring
4. In a deep vessel / casserole vessel heat the oil and mustard seeds on medium flame
5. Add onions and saut till golden brown
6. Add the turmeric powder and stir a little
7. Next add the cinnamon stick , cardamom , cloves , bay leaf and fry for about 2 minutes
8. Next add the chopped tomatoes and saut till the tomato smell disappears and then mash the tomatoes with your stirring spoon
9. Now add the cubed potatoes and stir for about 2 minutes
10. Add the chicken mixture to this mixture and stir for about 2 minutes
11. Add the coriander leaves and stir again for about 2 minutes
12. Add the water and stir again
13. Close the lid and let it simmer till the chicken is done
14. When chicken is done check the salt content and add a bit more salt as per taste
15. You can also add additional chili powder if you would like it spicy
16. When serving you can garnish this with a tsp of cream drizzled on top

title: vegetable green curry
steps:
1. In a skillet , heat oil over high heat
2. Stir in curry paste and garlic , cook for 1 minute
3. Stir in coconut milk , soy sauce and ginger
4. Add broccoli , red peppers and green beans
5. Cover and simmer , stirring occasionally , until the vegetables are crisp-tender , about 4 minutes
6. Stir in basil before serving

title: deb s favorite way to eat fresh fruit
steps:
1. Place fruit in a dessert dish
2. Blend sour cream and brown sugar in a small bowl
3. Spoon over fruit

title: another amaretto chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Mix amaretto , brown sugar , water , pepper , garlic powder& onion powder in a small bowl
3. Microwave about 20-30 seconds to melt sugar
4. Blend well
5. Line a pan with foil
6. Spray foil with cooking spray
7. Clean chicken removing insides
8. Pat dry with a paper towel
9. Place chicken in pan
10. Spray with cooking spray
11. Brush chicken with amaretto mixture
12. Place in oven
13. Bake for 45 minutes to 1 1 / 2 hours
14. Baste from time to time with amaretto when juices run clear about 180 degrees remove from oven
15. Let rest about 5 minutest before slicing
16. Serves 4-6 depending on size of bird

title: lazy man s beef stew
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 275 degrees
2. Grease a large casserole dish
3. Put in beef , carrots , soup , bay leaf , potatoes , onions and 1 / 2 cup red wine
4. Cover tightly with aluminum foil and bake for 4 hours
5. Remove cover and stir in peas , mushrooms and the rest of the red wine
6. Cook for 1 hour longer

title: microwave potatoes a la helga
steps:
1. Cube potatoes into 1 / 2" chunks
2. Melt butter on high for 30 seconds in a microwave safe dish
3. Add in onions and potatoes and toss to coat
4. Sprinkle with salt , pepper dill and paprika
5. Cover and microwave at full power 10-12 minutes or until tender
6. Sprinkle with cheese
7. Cover and let stand 5 minutes or until cheese melts

title: baked chicken and pumpkin with herbed cream sauce
steps:
1. Combine all the baked chicken and pumpkin slice ingredients in a large bowl , season with salt and pepper to taste and mix well
2. Lightly grease a 13 x 9 inch baking dish
3. Spread the mixture evenly into the prepared dish and smooth over the top
4. Bake at 400 degrees f for about 40 minutes , or until firm
5. Herbed cream sauce:
6. While the chicken and pumpkin mixture is baking , heat the oil in a small saucepan , add the garlic and cook , stirring , until the garlic is lightly browned
7. Add the wine and stock and simmer , uncovered , until reduced to about 1 / 2 cup
8. Add the cream and herbs and stir until hot
9. Season with salt and white pepper
10. Cut the baked chicken and pumpkin mixture into small diamond shapes , divide between warmed serving dishes and spoon over the herbed cream sauce
11. This recipe can be made a day ahead and kept covered , separately , in the refrigerator
12. The baked chicken and pumpkin mixture is suitable for freezing

title: crock pot turkey with stuffing
steps:
1. Heat oil in large skillet
2. Add onion and cook for 5 minutes until light brown , stirring frequently
3. Add jelly and heat for 1 minute longer or until golden brown
4. Spray a 4-6 quart slow cooker with nonstick cooking spray
5. Place stuffing mix in prepared cooker
6. Drizzle with water and mix gently
7. Sprinkle turkey with salt and pepper and place on stuffing mix
8. Spoon onion mixture over turkey and spread evenly
9. Cover and cook on low for 5-6 hours

title: chewy pecan cookies in a jar mix
steps:
1. Mix flour with baking soda and baking powder --
2. Then layer ingredients in order written above into a wide-mouth quart jar
3. Press each layer firmly before adding next ingredient
4. Empty jar of cookie mix into large mixing bowl
5. Use your hands to thoroughly blend mix
6. Add: 1 stick butter or margarine , very soft
7. Please do not use diet margarine or butter in this recipe --
8. 1 egg , slightly beaten
9. 1 tsp vanilla extract
10. Mix until completely blended
11. You will need to finish mixing with your hands --
12. Shape into balls the size of walnuts --
13. Place 2" apart on sprayed baking sheets --
14. Bake at 350 -- for 10-12 minutes until edges are lightly browned
15. Cool 5 minutes on baking sheet
16. Remove cookies to racks to finish cooling

title: the best chili you will ever taste
steps:
1. Heat oil
2. Cook onions , garlic and meat until brown
3. Add tomatoes , beer , coffee , tomato paste and beef broth
4. Add spices stir in 2 cans of kidney beans and peppers
5. Reduce heat and simmer for 1 1 / 2 hours
6. Add 2 remaining cans of kidney beans and simmer for another 30 minutes

title: eggplant paprikash
steps:
1. In a 4+ quart braising pan , heat the olive oil on a low flame until it spreads entirely across bottom of pan
2. Add onions and peppers
3. Sweat until soft
4. Turn heat up and stir in garlic
5. Keep stirring until the garlic releases it's aroma
6. Turn heat down
7. Remove onion , peppers and garlic from pan
8. Add more oil if needed
9. Turn heat up to medium high
10. Add eggplant cubes , keep stirring until they are becoming aromatic
11. Add the onions , peppers and garlic back
12. Turn heat down and cover
13. Combine tomatoes and vegetable broth in a microwave safe bowl and heat almost to boiling
14. Pour this into onion / eggplant mixture in the braising pan
15. Stir to combine
16. Sprinkle pimenton over mixture and stir in well
17. Simmer on low heat until liquid is absorbed
18. This can take up to 2 hours
19. Stir occasionally
20. Remove pan from heat and let vegetable mixture cool until it is possible to pick up an eggplant cube with your bare fingers and eat it
21. Stir in room temperature sour cream
22. Serve over brown rice

title: easy italian pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Drain
3. Mix seasoning , italian dressing and miracle whip in large bowl
4. Add remaining ingredients
5. Mix well
6. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve

title: three bean lentil soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan or dutch oven , heat the oil over medium heat
2. Cook the onions , garlic , ginger and curry paste , stirring occasionally , for 5 minutes or until softened
3. Add the tomatoes , chicken stock , water and lentils
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 20 minutes or until the lentils are softened
6. Add the chick peas , kidney beans and black beans
7. Cook for 15 minutes or until heated through
8. Stir in the coriander , lemon juice , salt and pepper

title: coconut frappe
steps: 1. Shake until frothy , then pour over ice and garnish with toasted coconut

title: baked stuffed sweet onions
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Peel onions and slice 1 / 2" from the top of each
3. Discard
4. Slice just enough from the bottoms to allow the onions to stand upright
5. Use a melon baller to hollow out the inside of each onion , leaving a 1 / 3" to 1 / 2" wall
6. Set aside
7. Chop the removed parts and set 1 / 2 cup aside
8. Save the rest for another use
9. Gently add onions to a pot of boiling , salted water and boil for 5 minutes
10. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside to dry on a wire rack
11. Saute reserved chopped onions in 1 / 2 t oil until translucent , about 8 minutes
12. Add mushrooms , ham and pepper and saute until browned , about 5 minutes
13. Deglaze pan with wine and pour mixture into a small bowl
14. Let cool for 2 or 3 minutes
15. Add the parsley and cheese and stir to combine
16. Stuff the onions
17. Place in a small roasting pan and drizzle with remaining 1 / 2 t oil
18. Cover with foil and bake until tender , about 50 minutes
19. Remove foil 10 minutes before done and allow to brown

title: martha s eggnog cookies
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , cream butter and sugar
2. Beat in eggnog , baking soda and nutmeg
3. Gradually add flour and mix well
4. Cover and chill at least 1 hour
5. On a lightly floured surface roll out half of the dough to 1 / 8 thickness
6. Cut into desired shapes , place on an ungreased cookie sheet
7. Brush cookies with beaten egg white and sprinkle on colored sugar
8. Bake at 350 for 6-8 minutes
9. Remove to cool on a wire rack
10. This should make about 16 dozen cookies

title: easy oatmeal muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f
2. Grease muffin cups or line with paper muffin liners
3. In a small bowl , combine milk and oats
4. Let soak for 15 minutes
5. In a separate bowl , beat together egg and applesauce
6. Stir in oatmeal mixture
7. In a third bowl , sift together flour , sugar , baking powder and salt
8. Stir flour mixture into wet ingredients , just until combined
9. Spoon batter into prepared muffin cups until cups are 2 / 3 full
10. Bake in preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes , until a toothpick inserted into the center of a muffin comes out clean

title: yummy w  s  clam chowder
steps:
1. Shuck clams , reserve juices , add water to total 5 cups
2. Coarsely chop clam meat
3. In large pot over medium heat , saut pancetta
4. Pour off all but 1 tbs fat
5. Melt butter
6. Add onion , celery , garlic and thyme
7. Cook for 3-5 minutes
8. Add flour , cook 1 minute more
9. Add potatoes , bay leaves and clam juice-water mixture and bring to boil
10. Reduce heat , simmer until potatoes are tender , about 15 minutes
11. Stir in cream , worcestershire , salt , black pepper and cayenne
12. Using fork , lightly mash potatoes against side of pot
13. Add clams , cook 2 minutes
14. Ladle into bowls , garnish with chives and serve

title: kansas cucumber salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine salad dressing , sugar , vinegar , dill , and salt
2. Mix well
3. Peel and slice cucumbers thin
4. Chop green onions , stalks and all
5. Add to bowl and toss
6. Cover and chill at least one hour before serving

title: mashed potatoes with caramelized onions   horseradish
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Place potatoes in large saucepan with salted cold water to cover and bring to boil over high heat
3. Cook till tender , about 10 minutes
4. Drain well
5. Scatter on a baking sheet & let cool for several minutes
6. Place in oven to dry out , about 5 minutes
7. Press potatoes through a ricer or mash with a potato masher
8. Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a large saucepan until it gets light brown
9. Add minced garlic & cook quickly until pale gold
10. Add cream , onions , horseradish , and season with salt and pepper and bring to a boil
11. Reduce heat to low beating potatoes with large whisk
12. Add remaining butter or margarine by tablespoonsful stirring vigorously after each addition
13. Taste for seasoning , if necessary , add salt and pepper , again
14. Serve warm
15. Caramelized onions:
16. Cook onions in butter in large saute pan over medium-high heat , 8-10 minutes or until golden brown , stirring frequently
17. Remove onions with slotted spoon and add to the cream mixture

title: chilean pastel de choclo
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400f
2. Combine milk and corn in a large saucepan , bring it to a boil
3. Cover , reduce the heat , and simmer 15 minutes
4. Remove from the heat , let stand , covered 5 minutes
5. Place the corn mixture in a food processor , process it until smooth
6. Stir in the basil , 1 tsp of the sugar , and 1 / 2 teaspoons salt
7. Combine broth , onion , bell pepper , carrot , black pepper , garlic and bay leaves in a large saucepan
8. Bring it to a boil
9. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 15 minutes
10. Add remaining 1 / 2 teaspoons salt , chicken , and parsley
11. Cover and cook 10 minutes or until chicken is done
12. Drain , discard bay leaves
13. Place chicken mixture in the bottom of an 8-inch square baking dish coated with cooking spray
14. Top with the corn mixture , sprinkle evenly with remaining 1 tbsp sugar
15. Bake at 400f for 25 minutes
16. Preheat broiler
17. Broil 3 minutes or until lightly browned
18. Enjoy !
19. Yield: 4 servings

title: split pea soup  my way
steps:
1. In a 5-1 / 2 quart kettle over medium heat , melt butter
2. Add onions , carrots and celery and cook , stirring occasionally , until vegetables are soft but not browned
3. Add potato , ham bone or hock , split peas , beer , water , and spices
4. Bring to a boil , cover , reduce heat , and simmer , stirring occasionally , until ham and peas are very tender , 2 or 2-1 / 2 hours
5. Remove ham bone and when cool , pull off meat discarding fat , skin and bones
6. Reserve 1 cup of ham for dumplings , and return the remainder to the soup
7. Add the optional franks or sausage and reheat
8. Blend in vinegar
9. Taste and add salt if desired
10. Stir in parsley and green onions
11. Serve very hot in warmed bowls
12. When reheating leftovers , add water or more beer to thin if desired
13. Directions for ham dumplings:
14. Put about 1 cup of finely chopped ham in a small bowl
15. Stir in egg , flour , baking powder & soda
16. Divide into 8 mounds and shape into meat balls
17. Make a hollow in each with your finger and fill with a rounded t
18. Of chopped peanuts
19. Reshape into a ball and roll in chopped parsley
20. Reheat soup and simmer dumplings on top of soup for 10-12 minutes
21. Place a dumpling in each bowl and ladle soup over the top

title: ww different taco soup
steps:
1. Brown beef and drain well
2. In large stock pot combine all ingredients and heat to a boil
3. Season with salt and pepper if desired
4. Entire recipe takes about 15 minutes and that includes browning the beef
5. My dh doesn't like the potatoes in the soup , so we just don't put any in his bowl
6. Serve with some shredded cheddar cheese , if desired

title: yogurt rice
steps:
1. Bring water to boil in saucepan and add rice
2. Return to boil , then reduce heat , cover and simmer until tender and water is absorbed , 20 to 25 minutes
3. While rice is cooking , toast mustard seeds and dal in skillet sprayed with nonstick cooking spray and oil until mustard seeds begin to pop , 2 to 3 minutes
4. Fluff rice with fork and stir in mustard seeds , dal , chile , ginger and cucumber
5. Combine yogurt , milk and salt
6. Lightly stir into rice with fork
7. Sprinkle with cilantro

title: lamb burgers with cucumber feta dressing
steps:
1. Combine dressing ingredients and set aside
2. Mix together burger ingredients until combined
3. Shape into 4 patties
4. Grill or fry to desired doneness , 6-10 minutes
5. Serve in warm pita , toasted rolls or lettuce leaves , and top with dressing

title: easy mexican sopaipillas
steps:
1. Quarter the tortillas
2. Heat oil in a frying pan
3. Place tortillas in and flip when they start turning brown
4. This part does not take long at all !
5. Place tortillas on paper towel lined plate
6. After you are done
7. Mix together your sugar and cinnamon in a large bowl
8. Place fried tortillas in mix and coat well
9. Place sugared tortillas on a serving plate
10. Drizzle with honey or serve on the side
11. Enjoy !

title: baked buffalo chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spread half of the jar of wing sauce in a 13x9 baking dish
3. Coat chicken in bread crumbs
4. Place in baking dish
5. Spread the rest of the wing sauce on top of chicken
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 30-45 minutes
7. Serve with ranch dressing for dipping

title: aunt phyllis  clam casserole
steps:
1. Saute first 4 ingredients in a large skillet , simmering for a few minutes
2. Combine and add the next 7 ingredients and then add the stuffing slowly until you have an oatmeal consistency
3. Place in a casserole dish and sprinkle with parmesan cheese
4. Bake at 325 degrees f
5. For 20-30 minutes

title: spinach   red pepper salad with brie cheese
steps:
1. Whisk together the oil , mustard , vinegar , honey , salt& pepper
2. Place spinach in a salad bowl and just before serving pour in the dressing and toss
3. Add red peppers , pecans& brie toss again and serve immediately

title: swiss beer bread
steps:
1. Add ingredients , in this order to bread machine
2. Cook on"basic" cycle

title: vidalia onion dip
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large skillet
2. Add the garlic and 1 generous cup of the onions , and saut over medium high heat until softened , 3 to 5 minutes
3. Sprinkle with the sugar and the thyme , drizzle in the stock and sherry , and simmer until the liquid is reduced to 1 tablespoon , about 2 minutes
4. Remove from the heat and allow to cool to room temperature
5. Combine the cream cheese and sour cream in a mixing bowl and whip together with an electric mixer on high speed to soften and combine
6. Add the cooled onion mixture and stir or blend in on low speed
7. Stir in chives and remaining raw onions
8. Season to taste with salt
9. Spoon into a serving bowl and serve with crackers such as triscuits
10. Recommend you refrigerate for a couple hours to allow flavors to mix

title: spam and egg salad  spread
steps:
1. Brown the cubed spam lightly in a nonstick frying pan and set aside
2. Mix all other ingredients together
3. Mix in the spam and season to taste
4. Chill
5. Serve as a side dish or top assorted crackers with it
6. It is also very good spread on top of toast and placed under the broiler until bubbly and the cheese starts to brown

title: stove top rice pudding from leftover rice
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , combine all dry ingredients
2. Slowly whisk in milk till well blended
3. Put saucepan over medium heat
4. Add butter and vanilla
5. Whisk or stir until mixture thickens
6. Remove from heat and add brown sugar and splenda packets to desired sweetness
7. Combine rice , raisins and contents of saucepan
8. Enjoy warm or refrigerate and eat it later
9. This is really good -- you might eat too much !

title: ratatouille with chickpeas    crock pot
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat oil over medium heat , cook onion , garlic , eggplant , basil , oregano , salt & pepper , stirring occasionally , until onion is softened , about 10 minutes
2. Scrape into crockpot
3. Halve , core , and seed peppers
4. Cut into 1 inch pieces
5. Cut zucchini into half lengthwise , cut crosswise into 1 1 / 2 inch chunks
6. Add to crockpot
7. Add tomato paste , chickpeas , and tomatoes , breaking up tomatoes with a spoon
8. Cover and cook on low for 4 hours , or until vegetables are tender
9. Stir in basil / parsley

title: eggplant parmigiana   weight watchers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f coat a 9 x 13-inch baking dish with cooking spray
2. Set aside
3. Combine bread crumbs , parmesan cheese , italian seasoning and garlic powder in a medium-size bowl
4. Set aside
5. Remove skin from eggplant and trim off ends
6. Slice eggplant into 1 / 2-inch-thick slices
7. Dip eggplant first into egg whites and then into bread crumb mixture
8. Bake eggplant on a nonstick cookie sheet until lightly browned , about 20 to 25 minutes , flipping once
9. Place a layer of eggplant on bottom of prepared baking dish , then add 1 / 3 of tomato sauce and 1 / 3 of mozzarella cheese
10. Repeat with 2 more layers in same order
11. Bake until cheese is melted and sauce is bubbling , about 10 minutes more
12. Slice into 4 pieces and serve

title: huevos banderas
steps:
1. If using whipping cream , beat until stiff peaks form andset aside
2. Bread: cut in 1 / 2 and 1 / 2 again to create 8 square pieces and set aside
3. Eggs: beat eggs well
4. Add amber rum
5. Beat again and set aside
6. Pears: dip sliced pears into lemon juice
7. Coat each slice well and set aside
8. Mix cinnamon powder and brown sugar and set aside
9. Dip bread squares in egg / rum mixture and coat well
10. Be sure to use all the egg mixture
11. Heat oil and butter together
12. Cook bread to desired doneness and transfer to warm plates
13. Roll prepared pear slices in cinnamon and brown sugar mixture
14. Place sliced pears in melted butter and cook until browned on both sides
15. Arrange pear slices on cooked bread squares
16. One slice per piece
17. Top with whipping cream and serve

title: penne alla pizzaiola  penne pizza style
steps:
1. Bring water to a boil
2. Add penne and cook approximately 3-4 min less then stated on the package
3. Without heating the oil first , put all ingredients: olive oil , garlic , tomato sauce , parsley , salt and pepper in a pan and cook for about 30min on medium heat
4. Drain the pasta and toss in a casserole dish
5. Add the cooked tomato sauce
6. Then the mozzarella cut into small pieces
7. Add some oregano on top
8. And finally a little bit of olive oil all over the pasta
9. Bake for about 5-10 minute in the oven until the mozzarella melts
10. Enjoy , buon appetito !

title: shrimp in yellow curry  gang lueng goong
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large saucepan
2. Brown onion and then and ginger and garlic
3. Add curry paste , and mix well
4. It might be a bit globular , but don't worry - it will mix in nicely once you add the liquid next
5. Add coconut milk and mix well
6. You can add about 1 / 3cup water if it is too thick
7. Add carrot and potatoes and bring to a boil
8. Leave the pot uncovered so that the water previously added will evaporate and you will get a nice thick gravy
9. When the carrots and potato are just about cooked , add shrimp , bell pepper , fish sauce , sugar , chili peppers and curry powder
10. Simmer for 5 minutes until shrimp turn pink
11. Do not overcook at this stage as shrimp will turn rubbery
12. Top with chopped spring onions just before serving

title: passion tea
steps:
1. Pour 6 cups boiling water over tea bags
2. Cover and steep 5 minutes
3. Remove tea bags
4. Stir in sugar until dissolved
5. Chill 1 hour
6. Stir together chilled tea , cranberry juice , and juice concentrate
7. Serve over ice
8. Enjoy !

title: sausage and chickpea casserole
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a frying pan and brown the sausages
2. They dont have to be cooked through
3. Remove and let cool slightly
4. Cut the bacon into strips and fry in the oil
5. Add sliced onions and continue cooking , stirring occasionally until the onions are soft
6. Cut the sausage into slices and put in a casserole dish
7. Add the tomatoes , drained chickpeas and chopped leek
8. If there is a lot of fat in the bacon you may want to drain the fat off the onions and bacon
9. Add them to the casserole dish
10. Add paprika , salt , pepper and thyme and stir to combine
11. Dried mixed herbs or dried thyme will do
12. Finely chop the parsley and add half of it to the dish
13. Cover and bake in the oven at 170c / 340f for 35 minutes
14. In the last few minutes of cooking , steam some cauliflower and / or broccoli or cook in the microwave
15. Stir the steamed vegetables into the casserole
16. Garnish with the reserved parsley

title: pasta bows and chicken
steps:
1. Chicken:
2. 1
3. Melt butter
4. Add onion and garlic
5. Cook until onion is clear
6. 2
7. Stir in chicken stock powder
8. 3
9. Add chicken and cream , heat through but don't boil
10. Add pepper
11. Sprinkle with parsley
12. Pasta:
13. 1
14. Cook pasta , add 1 tbsp butter and 1tbsp chicken stock powder
15. 2
16. Put on plate , pile chicken mixture on top

title: walnut rice florentine
steps:
1. Add water to broth to make 2 1 / 4 cups , set aside
2. Melt butter in large sauce pan then add rice , onion and garlic
3. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly , 3-4 minutes
4. Add sherry and broth and bring to a boil
5. Reduce the heat , cover and simmer 20 minutes
6. Remove from heat and stir in the spinach and heavy cream
7. Let stand until liquid is absorbed
8. Stir in walnuts and sprinkle with parmesan cheese and pepper to taste

title: chinese spinach
steps:
1. Cook spinach according to directions on package
2. Drain well and set aside
3. Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat for 1 / 2 minute
4. Swirl oil around the bottom of the pan , add onions and cook and stir until onions are soft but not browned
5. Add soy sauce and sugar to onions and mix lightly
6. Add chestnuts and spinach to onion mixture and cook and stir over medium heat to reheat to serving temperature
7. Serve hot using 1 / 2 cup per serving
8. Food exchange per serving: 1 veggie and 1 fat , low sodium diets , omit soy sauce low cholesterol diets , use as is

title: vodka stinger
steps:
1. Stir ingredients together in a cocktail shaker
2. Strain into a glass half filled with ice

title: wasabi baked halibut
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425
2. Line a rimmed baking sheet with nonstick foil
3. Arrange fillet pieces on foil
4. Spread top of fish with mayonnaise , then sprinkle with cornflake crumbs
5. Bake 15 minutes or until fish is opaque in center and crumbs have begun to brown

title: over stuffed zucchini
steps:
1. Lop off the ends of each zucchini and slice in half lengthwise
2. Scoop out the middle with a spoon leaving 1 / 4 inch on the bottom and sides of the zucchini halves
3. Chop the pulp and reserve
4. Brown beef and pork
5. Saute onions and mushrooms until soft
6. Combine the two mixtures and set aside
7. Blend spinach , tomatoes , zucchini pulp , bread cubes , parmesan cheese , egg , garlic , italian seasoning and red pepper flakes
8. Add this to the meat , onion and mushroom mixture
9. Equaly divide between the zucchini halves
10. Top with mozzerella
11. Place in 2 large baking dishes with 1 / 4 cup of water each
12. Cover with aluminum foil
13. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes , then uncover and bake for 20 min longer or until zucchini is tender and cheese is browned and bubbly

title: quinoa puddng
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350 f
2. Cream sugar and butter
3. Stir in eggs , milk , vanilla , cinnamon , and salt until blended
4. Add quinoa , hazelnuts , and currants and mix thoroughly
5. Butter a 1 quart casserole or souffl dish
6. Pour the custard mixture into the casserole or ramekins and grate a little nutmeg over it
7. Bake for 40 minutes or until just set
8. To serve , spoon from the casserole or ramekins or loosen the edges with a knife and invert pudding onto a plate
9. Or , steam covered in the top of a double boiler over boiling water for about 1 hour

title: barefoot contessa s brownie tart
steps:
1. Grease and flour a 9-inch tart pan with removable sides
2. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
3. Melt the butter in a bowl set over simmering water
4. Add 2 cups of the chocolate chips , remove from the heat , and stir until the chocolate melts
5. Set aside to cool completely
6. In the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the paddle attachment , beat the eggs , sugar , coffee , and vanilla on medium-high speed until light and fluffy , about 3 minutes
7. Stir in the cooled chocolate
8. In a medium bowl , combine the flour , baking powder , salt , 1 cup of the chocolate chips , and the walnuts
9. Fold the flour mixture into the batter until just combined
10. Pour into the pan and bake for 35 to 40 minutes , until the center is puffed
11. The inside will still be very soft
12. Cool to room temperature before removing the sides of the tart pan
13. Melt the remaining 1 / 4 cup of chocolate chips with the heavy cream and drizzle on the tart

title: swirled peanut butter fudge brownies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a 11 x 17 inch sheet cake pan
3. In large sauce pan , melt butter
4. Add peanut butter , stir until peanut butter is melted
5. Stir in sugar and vanilla , remove from heat
6. Lightly beat eggs in a bowl and add to mixture in pan , if it is cool enough
7. In seperate bowl whisk together flour , baking powder and salt
8. Add flour to batter in pan and beat well with spoon
9. Remove 3 1 / 2 cups of batter to another bowl and stir into it the 1 / 2 cup cocoa
10. Spread chocolate batter into cake pan
11. Spread the peanut butter batter over top and swirl with the back of a small spoon
12. Bake 30 minutes or until just done
13. Cool in pan then cut into small squares as they are rich

title: lily s ginger cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 170c
2. Melt butter , sugar and syrup in water
3. Add sieved flour and ginger
4. Add milk / baking soda mixture in and quickly beat well
5. Put into an 8 cake tin , greased and floured or lined
6. Bake approx 45 minutes
7. Take out and sit for five minutes then put onto a cake wire and cool
8. This cake is better if left to stand in an airtight tin , not in fridge for 24 hours then make butter cream
9. Sieve icing sugar carefully
10. Cream the butter and sugar together , add chopped ginger
11. Cut the cake in half horizontally and use this to sandwich the cake and also spread a little on top

title: wet burrito casserole
steps:
1. Stir together sour cream and condensed soup
2. Pour half of this in the bottom of a large casserole or 9x13-inch baking dish , spreading it evenly across the bottom
3. Brown and cook through the ground beef with the onion and bell pepper
4. Drain any fat
5. Stir in taco seasoning , mushrooms and refried beans , mixing well
6. Spoon mixture onto tortillas , rolling tortillas up and placing them seam-side-down in the casserole dish
7. Top with remaining soup / cream mixture and sprinkle with the cheese
8. Place a few sliced black olives or jalapeno slices on top of the cheese , if desired
9. Bake at 350f for 30-35 minutes or until cheese is melted and dish is heated through

title: beef and potato nacho casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Brown beef and 1 / 2 cup onion in skillet , drain fat
3. Stir in taco seasoning , water and tomato sauce
4. Bring to a boil and simmer 5 minutes
5. Spread meat mixture into a greased 9 x 13 pan
6. Top with chilies , kidney beans and potatoes
7. In mixing bowl , combine soup , milk , remaining onion , pepper , sugar and worcestershire sauce
8. Pour over potatoes
9. Sprinkle with paprika
10. Cover with foil and bake 15 minutes
11. Uncover and bake another 5-10 until lightly browned
12. Allow to stand 10 minutes before cutting into squares

title: easy kitchenaid mixer pizza dough
steps:
1. Put water in mixer bowl and sprinkle yeast over water to dissolve
2. Mix water and yeast with whisk attachment until foamy
3. Add olive oil , salt , oregano and honey and whisk together until well blended
4. Add 1 cup of flour and mix together
5. Remove whisk attachment scraping dough mixture into bowl and attach bread hook to mixer
6. Add another cup of flour and mix on low speed until well incorporated and dough is not "sticky"
7. If dough is too sticky , add the additonal 1 / 4 cup of flour until it resembles bread dough
8. Mix dough on medium speed for 5-7 minutes until it is elastic and smooth
9. Remove dough ball from mixer and place in an oiled bowl large enough for the dough to double in size
10. Cover bowl with a damp cloth and allow dough to rise in a warm place , away from drafts
11. When dough is doubled in size , remove from bowl and punch down dough , roll out to desired thickness and shape
12. Drizzle olive oil on rolled out dough , sprinkle with additonal dried oregano and kosher salt , and top as desired
13. Bake on a perforated pizza pan in a very hot oven
14. Start pizza on bottom rack for 5 minutes
15. Using a pizza peal , slide the peal underneath the pan and move the pizza to the oven's top rack
16. Continue baking until crust is browned , and toppings are heated
17. Using the pizza peal , remove the pizza pan from the oven carefully
18. Place pan on a heat proof surface , then use the pizza peal to remove the pizza from the pan
19. Allow pizza to cool for 2 minutes on the peal , then slice as desired using a pizza cutter

title: shell pasta with salmon bechamel sauce
steps:
1. Cook pasta in salted boiling water , following directive on package
2. Drain and set aside in an oven dish
3. Drain salmon , but keep the liquid
4. Mash the salmon with the bones
5. Set aside
6. Melt 1 / 4 cup butter in a saucepan and add the flour
7. Stir 1 minute
8. Add milk and bring to boil , while stirring
9. Reduce heat and keep cooking stirring constantly , until thick
10. Set aside in a warm place
11. Melt remaining butter in a skillet
12. Cook the onion 5 minutes , until tender
13. Add to the previous mixture of milk
14. Then add the salmon and his liquid
15. Add mozzarella and parsley
16. Add salt and pepper
17. Let heat while stirring , until cheese has melted
18. Pour the sauce on the pasta
