title: kung pao chicken ii  copycat
steps:
1. Combine chicken , salt , egg white , and cornstarch
2. Mix well by hand and set aside
3. In a small bowl , blend all sauce ingredients
4. Set aside
5. Add 2 tablespoons oil to heated wok and stir fry chicken
6. Cook the chicken until it's golden to golden brown on each side
7. Remove to serving bowl
8. Add 2 more tablespoons oil to same wok
9. Toss peanuts and chili peppers in the wok and stir fry until peppers turn dark red
10. Remove from wok and add to chicken
11. Lower heat
12. If necessary , add more oil
13. Stir fry green onions and garlic for several seconds
14. Return chicken , peanuts and peppers to wok and stir fry a few seconds to combine
15. Add water chestnuts and combined sauce ingredients and stir fry till heated through and thickened
16. Serve over rice

title: herb and cheese grilled salmon
steps:
1. Place salmon fillet , skin side down , on a large piece of heavy duty foil
2. Sprinkle vinegar , soy , lemon juice , salt , pepper , basil , oregano , garlic powder , and parmesan over salmon
3. Arrange scallions over cheese
4. Fold foil over , forming a packet , sealing all edges
5. Grill over medium high heat 15-20 minutes , until salmon flakes easily
6. Do not turn !
7. I recommend not checking the fish until at least 15 minutes have passed , as the fish is steamed by the packet

title: buckaroo beans
steps:
1. Add washed beans to water in large heavy pot
2. Bring to boil
3. Boil for 2 minutes , then remove from heat and cover
4. Let stand an hour
5. Slice onion thick and garlic thin
6. Add them along with the bay leaf and salt pork and bring to a rapid boil
7. Reduce heat to a simmer
8. Cover tightly and cook until beans are tender
9. Add tomatoes , dry mustard , green pepper , chili powder , brown sugar and oregano
10. Cover and simmer for about 2 hours to get full rich flavor
11. Beans should cook until there is just enough liquid left to resemble thick gravy
12. You may have to remove cover at the last hour of cooking to thicken beans

title: cranberry   grapefruit relish
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , mix sugar and water
2. Heat to boiling
3. Add cranberries and cook until skins begin to pop
4. Remove from heat
5. While that is cooling , peel & section the grapefruit , cut into bite-size pieces
6. Add to cooled berries
7. Stir to mix
8. Serve warm or room temp in a glass compote dish for best color display !
9. Leftovers: exquisite !

title: vegan apple bottomed gingerbread muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. To make apple bottoms: peel , core , and slice apples into 1-inch chunks
3. Mix apple chunks , tablespoon melted margarine , and 2 tablespoons brown sugar in a bowl until apples are lightly coated
4. Place a spoonful of apple mixture in the bottoms of a lightly greased muffin pan and set aside
5. To make gingerbread batter: combine flour , brown sugar , baking soda , and spices
6. Mix egg replacer , melted margarine , molasses , and hot water in a separate bowl , then add this mixture to the dry mixture
7. Stir just until thoroughly combined and spoon batter over apples
8. Bake for 25 minutes
9. I recommend eating these with a fork as the apples don't always stay together , but i promise they're delicious !

title: quicky pickles
steps:
1. Place cucumbers and tarragon in a quart jar
2. Heat vinegar , sugar , red pepper flakes and salt in a saucepan , stirring until sugar and salt dissolve
3. Pour into the jar
4. Let cool completely , uncovered
5. Pickles are best refrigerated overnight , or up to 6 weeks before serving
6. Enjoy !

title: spring onion pancakes
steps:
1. Whisk all ingredients except the onions in a bowl until smooth
2. Stir in the spring onions
3. Lightly coat a small frying pan with cooking spray
4. Place over med-high heat
5. Pour in the batter and swirl the pan to spread the mixture thinly
6. Cook for 2 minutes each side or until lightly browned
7. Keep pancakes warm while cooking the remainder
8. Serving suggestions- hoisin chicken / pork , char siu bbq pork , peking duck

title: just like homemade green beans
steps:
1. Drain green beans
2. Mix all ingredients in a microwave safe bowl
3. Microwave on high for 4 minutes
4. Stir and serve

title: creamy cucumber bites
steps:
1. Combine cream cheese , mayonnaise , dressing mix and dill in a medium bowl until well mixed
2. Spread on one side of each bread slice
3. Top each slice with a slice of cucumber and sprinkle with additional dill
4. Chill until ready to serve

title: sugar and spice nuts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f degrees
2. Grease a baking sheet and set aside
3. Beat egg white in a large bowl with a fork or whisk until foamy
4. Stir in two cups of unsalted nuts until coated
5. Stir in sugar and spices
6. Toss with nuts until coated
7. Put nuts onto prepared baking sheet
8. Spread out well
9. Bake , stirring often , until golden-- about 20-25 minutes
10. Cool completely
11. Store in an airtight container

title: tequila pork chile verde
steps:
1. Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
2. Combine cornmeal and chile powder in a medium bowl
3. Add pork , tossing to coat
4. Remove pork from bowl , reserving any remaining cornmeal mixture
5. Add pork to pan
6. Saute 5 minutes or until browned
7. Stir in remaining cornmeal mixture
8. Cook 30 seconds , stirring constantly
9. Stir in tomatillos , broth , chiles , and jalapeno
10. Bring to a simmer over medium low heat
11. Cook 8 minutes or until tomatillos are tender
12. Stir in onions and remaining ingredients
13. Simmer 1 minute

title: spicy rice and beans
steps:
1. Saute onion , garlic , celery and jalapeno pepper in canola oil in large non stick frying pan for 3 minutes , stirring occasionally
2. Add cumin , coriander , chili powder and rice
3. Cook on medium , stirring occasionally until golden
4. Stir in carrot , water , bouillon powder and bay leaf
5. Cover
6. Simmer on medium low for 20 minutes
7. Stir in beans , tomato and corn
8. Cover
9. Heat for 15 to 20 minutes until liquid is absorbed
10. Remove and discard bay leaf
11. Stir in cilantro and 1 tablespoon parsley
12. Garnish with remaining parsley

title: almond glazed cherry chip sugar cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Combine butter , sugar and almond extract in a large mixer bowl
3. Beat at medium speed , until creamy
4. Reduce speed to low
5. Add all remaining ingredients and beat until well mixed
6. Roll dough into 1 inch balls
7. Place 2 inches apart on cookie sheet
8. Flatten balls to 1 / 4 inch thickness with the bottom of a buttered glass dipped in sugar
9. Bake for 7-9 minutes or until edges are very lightly browned
10. Cool 1 minute
11. Remove from cookie sheets
12. Cool completely
13. Stir together glaze ingredients with wire whisk , adding additional water if necessary to make a smooth and creamy glaze
14. Decorate cooled cookies with glaze

title: double chocolate cookies
steps:
1. Cream together magarine and sugar , then add oil
2. Slowly stir in vanilla and milk til blended
3. In separate bowl , mix dry ingredients
4. Stir into the"wet" ingredients and mix
5. When half mixed , pour in the chips and blend til ingredients are just mixed
6. Drop by generous spoonful onto greased cookie sheet
7. Bake ate 350% for 10- 15 minutes

title: golden delicious oatmeal
steps:
1. Combine all but the oatmeal in saucepan
2. Bring to a boil
3. Stir in oats and cook 1 minute
4. Cover and let stand several minutes , then serve

title: cuban black bean soup   healthier version
steps:
1. Combine beans and water and let soak overnight
2. Next day , add chile peppers , 2 cloves of garlic to the beans
3. Cut an onion in half , "pin" the bay leaf to one half with the clove , add onion halves to beans
4. Bring to boil , reduce heat , cover loosely and simmer , stirring occasionally , for about 1 hour , until beans are tender
5. Chop remaining onion , mince remaining garlic
6. Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat
7. Add onions , garlic , chopped peppers , celery and bacon to skillet
8. Cook for 4 minutes until soft , but not brown
9. Stir veggie / bacon mixture into beans
10. Add wine , vinegar , cumin and oregano
11. Season with salt and pepper
12. Cover , reduce heat , simmer for 10 minutes until beans are soft
13. Remove bay leaf , halved onions and whole garlic cloves
14. Blend 2 cups of soup in blender , return to soup
15. Season to taste with additional salt , pepper and vinegar , to taste
16. Serve topped with sour cream and scallion tops

title: depot coffee house butterscotch cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Beat together: crisco , brown sugar
3. Add eggs , molasses , milk , salt , baking soda , baking powder
4. Add whole wheat flour
5. Add rolled oats
6. Mix in butterscotch chips by hand
7. Bake about 12 minutes

title: fire eater
steps: 1. Pour into a short glass in order of recipe

title: tippys amazing broiled haddock
steps:
1. Rinse fillets and sprinkle both sides with salt and pepper
2. Place fillets skin side down on well greased broiler pan
3. Top fillets with pats of butter
4. Broil at 500 for approx 10 minutes
5. Baste once and turn around 5 minutes into cooking time
6. Serve with lemon wedges
7. Enjoy !

title: awesome gluten free vegan peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In a large bowl combine dry ingredients , set aside
3. In a food processor blend syrup , oil , vanilla and peanut butter
4. Add the wet ingredients to the dry , blend well
5. Shape dough into walnut sized balls
6. Place on a slightly greased cookie sheet and flatten gently with the tines of a fork
7. Bake about 13-15 minutes
8. Cool on wire rack

title: matt s crusty home fries
steps:
1. Roughly chop onion into wide pieces - i like inch wide slices , cut into about sixths
2. Chop pepper into similar size pieces , discarding stem and seeds
3. Heat about three tablespoons oil in large frying pan over medium-high heat
4. Add onions , cook until golden and slightly transparent , about three minutes
5. Add peppers , cook until tender , about an additional two or three minutes
6. Peel and cube potatoes
7. I like them about 3 / 4" square
8. Add them and additional tablespoon or two of oil to frying pan
9. Add salt and pepper to taste
10. Cook , stirring frequently and then patting back down , until tender and cooked through and slightly golden brown , about 8 minutes
11. Stir one more time , and pat down to maximize surface area in contact with frying pan
12. Increase heat to high , and cook without stirring to get a great crust , about an additional 5-8 minutes

title: pear apple butter
steps:
1. Put pears and water in a heavy 3-quart saucepan
2. Cover and simmer over medium-low heat about 20 minutes until pears are tender , stirring occasionally
3. Drain
4. Process in 2 batches in food processor or blender until smooth
5. You will have about 4 cups puree
6. Pour back into same saucepan
7. Stir in remaining ingredients
8. Bring to a simmer over medium heat
9. Reduce heat to low
10. Cover pot , leaving lid slightly ajar , and simmer about 1 hour until mixture is shiny and very thick , stirring often
11. Spoon into clean hot jars
12. Cover tightly , cool and refrigerate

title: baked fish
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Butter a baking dish with 1 / 2 t butter
3. Sprinkle the bottom of the dish with salt , pepper and 1 tsp shallots
4. Season fillets with salt and pepper
5. Roll each of the fillets , turban-like , as compactly as possible
6. Arrange in dish , seam side down
7. Sprinkle wine and cream over the fish
8. Sprinkle evenly with salt , pepper , bread crumbs , parsley and remaining tsp of shallots
9. Melt remaining t of butter and drizzle over all
10. Bake 20 minutes or until fish are cooked and the crumbs are lightly browned

title: peanut butter lover s puppy chow
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients but the cereal and sugar in a large pot
2. Heat on medium until butter and chocolate are melted
3. Stir in cereal
4. Transfer mixture to large paper bag or a bowl w / a lid
5. Shake puppy chow in powdered sugar until coated
6. Enjoy ! :d

title: healthy coconut shrimp
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Spray a large baking sheet with butter flavored cooking spray
3. In a small bowl combine cornstarch , pepper and salt
4. In a small microwave safe dish heat up honey approximately 30-45 seconds
5. Add lime juice to honey and stir
6. Slowly add in egg whites and continue to stir
7. Place coconut in a thin layer on a pie plate or other relatively flat dish
8. Take each shrimp and first dip it into cornstarch mixture then in egg white mixture and finally roll in the coconut
9. Then place on the baking sheet
10. Lightly spray with cooking spray and bake 10-15 minutes or until shrimp is pink and the coconut is lightly toasted

title: nana s red velvet cake icing
steps:
1. Mix the flour and milk in a small saucepan
2. Over medium heat bring to a slow boil while stirring constantly
3. Boil until thick , remove from heat , place pan in refrigerator
4. While boiled mixture is cooling , using mixer cream together butter , powdered sugar and vanilla extract
5. When boiled mixture is completely cool add to butter mixture and beat until very fluffy and thick

title: traditional tamales
steps:
1. To prepare chile paste:
2. Break caps off all red chiles and shake seeds out
3. Soak red chiles in hot water until soft
4. Blend or process chiles into a paste using a small amount of water in which they were soaked to help it move in the food processor or blender
5. Put paste through a sieve to remove the skins
6. Throw skins away
7. This may be made way ahead of time and refrigerated until you make the tamales
8. To prepare meat:
9. Use the cheapest roasts you can find ! try to cook the meat the day before assembling tamales , keeping it in the refrigerator until tamale-making time
10. Cut meat into large chunks
11. Cover meat with water in a very large pot
12. Add 6 to 12 garlic cloves and 2 or 3 tablespoons salt
13. Cook meat , covered , for 3 hours or until meat is tender and falling apart
14. Remove meat from juice and shred
15. Save the juice
16. Mix meat sauce with the meat
17. To prepare meat sauce:
18. Melt 2 / 3 cup lard or crisco and add 2 / 3 cup flour
19. Boil for 2 minutes
20. Pour over shredded meat and mix
21. Add chili paste , one cup at a time , to taste
22. Add 1 tablespoon of cumin
23. Add salt and pepper to taste
24. To mix masa:
25. Place 12 pounds masa in a very large pan and mix with 1 1 / 4 cups lard or crisco , 2 tablespoons salt , 2 tablespoons baking powder , 1 cup chile paste and 2 cups meat broth
26. Mix with hands
27. Add more meat broth
28. Add more chile paste for color if desired
29. Work all ingredients together with hands for about 10 minutes
30. The dough is ready when a small lump floats slowly to the bottom of a glass of water
31. To assemble tamales:
32. Soak corn husks in hot water until soft
33. Using the larger husks , place each husk waxy side up
34. Spread masa onto each husk out to the wide edge
35. Place a small portion of meat in the center of masa
36. Roll husks and fold back , wide sides to center , then tapered flap up
37. Set a wire rack or vegetable steamer in the bottom of a large kettle
38. Put water in kettle just up to the bottom of the rack or steamer
39. Set tamales in kettle standing on end
40. Pack them in , allowing room for expansion of masa as they cook
41. Steam for about 20 to 40 minutes , or until masa pulls away from corn husk easily

title: beef kefta patties with cucumber salad
steps:
1. Heat a grill pan over medium-high heat
2. Coat pan with cooking spray
3. Combine beef , 1 / 4 cup parsley , cilantro and next 5 ingredients in a medium bowl
4. Divide mixture into 4 equal portions , shaping each into a 1 / 2 inch thick patty
5. Add patties to pan
6. Cook 3 minutes per side or until desired degree of doneness
7. Combine cucumber and vinegar in a medium bowl
8. Toss well
9. Combine yogurt , remaining 2 tablespoons parsley , juice , and pepper in a small bowl
10. Stir with a whisk
11. Arrange 1 patty and 1 / 2 cup cucumber mixture on each of 4 plates
12. Top each serving with about 2 tablespoons yogurt sauce
13. Serve each with 2 pita wedges

title: red snapper baked with cilantro
steps:
1. Arrange fish in glass baking dish
2. Combine lime juice , jalapeno juice , and cumin
3. Pour over fish
4. Arrange onion , jalapeno chilies , garlic , and cilantro over fish
5. Refrigerate , covered , 2 hours , turning fish once
6. Bake , uncovered , at 400 degrees until fish is tender and flakes with a fork , about 10 minutes
7. Sprinkle fish lightly with salt and pepper
8. Arrange fish on serving platter
9. Sprinkle with green onion and serve with lime wedges

title: thai drunken pasta
steps:
1. Cook noodles and set aside
2. Add a small amount of peanut oil to keep from sticking
3. Heat oil in a wok or large skillet
4. Add the garlic and brown lightly
5. Add chicken and cook until no longer pink
6. Add onions , pepper , mushrooms , and broccoli
7. Stir fry lightly for 4 to 5 minutes
8. Add noodles and stir
9. Add lime juice , chili sauce , soy sauce , pepper flakes , basil , brown sugar , and salt
10. Stir continuously until noodles are firm but tender

title: rice crispy treats
steps:
1. Melt butter over low heat in a large pot
2. Stir in marshmallows and cook until melted
3. Stir in peanut butter or coffee granules if you don't like peanut butter
4. Stir in rice krispies cereal mix until all combine
5. Pour out onto a buttered baking dish 9"x13"
6. Smooth out the top by moistening your hands with a little water and using the palms of your hand to press gently
7. Don't press down too hard or your treats will be too dense
8. Set a side to cool
9. Once they cool cut them into even squares and dip into melted chocolate or just drizzle chocolate over the top

title: crock pot cube steak with gravy
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in crock pot and mix well
2. Put cube steak in the mixture ,
3. Cook on low for 6-8 hours
4. Serve over mashed potatoes

title: garlic shrimp  lemon and feta spaghetti
steps:
1. Cook pasta in large saucepan of boiling water following packet directions until tender
2. Meanwhile , heat oil in large non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat
3. Add onion
4. Cook , stirring , for 3 minutes or until tender
5. Add shrimp / prawns and garlic
6. Cook , stirring for 2 minutes or until seafood is just pink
7. Add wine and bring to the boil
8. Simmer uncovered for 1minute or until shrimp / prawns are cooked through
9. Remove from heat
10. Add lemon rind and juice
11. Drain pasta
12. Return to pan on low heat
13. Add shrimp / prawn mixture , parsley and feta
14. Toss to combine
15. Season with cracked pepper and serve with crusty bread and fresh green salad

title: avocado and pinto bean salad
steps:
1. Combine the beans , tomatoes , cilantro , vinaigrette , and pepper in a serving bowl and toss well
2. Just before serving , stir in the diced avacado

title: easy peasy healthy mango lassi
steps:
1. Thaw the mango
2. Puree thawed mango in the food processor until smooth
3. Add salt , yogurt , and stevia powder , process until smooth
4. Add water
5. Mix to blend
6. Serve as desired ! i like mine over ice with a straw
7. :d can be pre-made and stored in advance too
8. It keeps for days and doesn't separate

title: party empanadas
steps:
1. Cook ground beef and chorizo together over medium heat until done
2. Pulse in food processor
3. Chop and saute onion and garlic
4. Add to meat mixture
5. Place in freezer for 10 minutes
6. To prepare jalapeos , char under broiler and put in plastic bag for five minutes
7. Peel skins and remove seeds
8. Chop and add to mixture
9. You can substitute a can a green chili's
10. Fold in grated jack cheese and thawed corn
11. Place puff pastry in a plastic bag and bring to almost room temperature place sheet on floured surface
12. Cut along folds into three long strips
13. Using a floured rolling pin , roll first strip about six times length wise
14. Put about two tablespoons of the filling about 1 inch from each end and another just above center
15. Cut to make three pockets and fold over dough
16. Enclose by pressing dough together and shape into half rounds using scissors
17. Optional- using the tines of a fork press around edges
18. Continue with remaining pastry
19. Bake 400 degrees until tops are just brown
20. To freeze , place wax paper between stacks
21. For parties , bake using frozen pastries straight from freezer

title: marmie s parm and garlic swiss chard
steps:
1. Wash and dry chard
2. Cut stems into 1 inch pieces - place in seperate bowl
3. Chop leaves - place in another bowl
4. Saute garlic in bacon fat or olive oil untill aromatic
5. Add chard stems , saute for 6 - 8 min untill just beginning to soften
6. Add chard leaves , saute 5 min untill nicely wilted
7. Sprinkle with parm if desired and serve immediately

title: beanie weenie soup in the crock pot
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a crock pot and cook for 8 hours on low
2. We have this with salad and crusty bread
3. Leftovers make good lunch the next day !

title: coconut custards
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Spread coconut in a single layer on a baking sheet
3. Toast in oven for 8-10 min until lightly brown
4. Set aside 2 tbsp for garnish
5. In a small pot over medium heat cook milk , sugar stirring often until sugar dissolves and mixture begins to bubble around the edges
6. Remove from heat and add the coconut , stir
7. Cover tightly and let stand 15 minutes
8. In a large bowl sprinkle gelatin over a 1 / 4 cup of cold water
9. Let soften this will take about 5 minutes
10. Strain warm coconut mixture through a fine mesh sieve into gelatin mixture
11. Whisk until gelatin dissolves then whisk in the half and half , salt and vanilla
12. Divide into 4 ramekins and refrigerate until set , 3 hours
13. When ready , unmold and sprinkle the reserved coconut on top
14. 212 calories per serving

title: pork tenderloin with garlic rosemary and bacon
steps:
1. Trim all silver skin from pork tenderloin & cut 4 shallow slits in the surface
2. Push in garlic clove halves
3. Rub meat with olive oil
4. Sprinkle with pepper
5. Line a baking sheet with a large piece of heavy duty aluminum foil
6. Place a baking rack on the foil and lay out the bacon slices
7. Center the tenderloin across the bacon and arrange rosemary sprigs over the top
8. Wrap bacon slices around the meat and rosemary , securing with toothpicks if necessary
9. Try to cover as much of the rosemary as possible so it doesn't burn when roasting
10. Cover tightly and refrigerate for at least 2 hours
11. Preheat oven to 425f
12. Remove meat from fridge and place in oven still wrapped
13. Roast for 15 minutes
14. Uncover and bake for 10-15 minutes more or until internal temp reaches 150-155
15. Don't overcook it - the temp will rise about 5-10 more from carry-over cooking after you take it out of the oven
16. Your goal temp is ~160
17. The meat may look faintly pink in the center but it is done if the juices run clear
18. Remove from oven and pour off pan drippings to a small saucepan
19. Loosely rewrap meat with the foil and let rest for 10 minutes
20. Whisk the cornstarch into pan drippings , heating and stirring until thickened
21. Add salt to taste and more pepper if you want
22. Remove toothpicks , bacon and rosemary from meat and discard
23. Slice pork at an angle into thin slices
24. Serve with the gravy

title: rutledge taco casserole  potluck
steps:
1. Brown hamburger , adding 1 cup chopped onion , and 1 cup chopped green pepper as the meat browns
2. Add 1 large can chili beans , 1 large can stewed tomatoes and season to taste with salt , pepper , garlic , cumin , and extra hot chili powder , if desired
3. Layer meat and bean mixture in casserole with 1 package of corn tortillas
4. Top with grated cheese
5. Bake in 350 oven for 20-30 minutes
6. Variations: add canned or left over corn , chopped olives to make it a mock tamale pie

title: turkey applesauce meatballs with cranberries
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Line a 15-1 / 2" x 10-1 / 2" jelly-roll pan with foil
3. Grease foil
4. Heat 4-quart saucepan of water to boiling over high heat
5. In large bowl , combine turkey , cornflake crumbs , applesauce , salt , and thyme just until blended
6. With hands , shape turkey mixture by 1 / 4 cups into twelve 2-inch meatballs
7. Place meatballs , 1 inch apart , in prepared jelly-roll pan
8. Roast meatballs 15 minutes or just until they lose their pink color throughout
9. Meanwhile , add noodles to boiling water and cook as label directs
10. Drain noodles
11. Set aside
12. In same saucepan , combine cranberries , water and sugar
13. Heat to boiling over medium-high heat
14. Cook 5 minutes or until mixture thickens slightly
15. Remove saucepan from heat
16. Stir in dijon mustard
17. To serve , divide egg noodles among 4 dinner plates
18. Top with meatballs and cranberry mixture

title: easy rich brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease and flour an 8x8 or 9x9 inch baking pan
3. In a medium bowl , beat together the butter and sugar
4. Add eggs , and mix well
5. Combine the flour , cocoa and salt
6. Stir into the sugar mixture
7. Mix in the vanilla and stir in walnuts if desired
8. Spread evenly into the prepared pan
9. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes in the preheated oven , or until edges are firm
10. Cool before cutting into squares

title: simply  a great macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Pre heat oven at 400 degrees
2. In the oven , in a large casserole dish , melt the butter
3. Remove , coat the macaroni in the butter , adding salt and pepper
4. Add milk , cheese
5. Mix
6. Bake 45-50 minutes

title: tuna tater tot casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Place tater tots in a greased 2-quart baking dish
3. Mix together the tuna , soup , and milk
4. Pour over tater tots
5. Sprinkle cheese evenly over the top
6. Cover and bake 1 hour

title: plum salad
steps: 1. Gently mix

title: easy shaked up macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking dish
3. Cook the macaroni in boiling water until al dente drain , then place into a bowl
4. Place the milk , flour , onion salt and garlic powder in a 1-quart jar
5. Cover tightly and shake vigorously for 1 minute
6. Pour the mixture over the macaroni and add in 3-1 / 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese
7. Mix thoroughly to combine , then spread into the baking dish
8. Sprinkle with breadcrumbs then remaining 1 cup of cheddar cheese
9. Drizzle 1 / 4 cup melted butter or margarine over the top
10. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes or until golden brown

title: linda s fantabulous chicken fingers with honey mustard
steps:
1. Mix flour and spices in a large zip lock baggie
2. Slice the chicken breasts into 3 / 4 inch 'fingers' and shake in the baggie of seasoned flour a few fingers at a time
3. Beat eggs and milk together and roll chicken fingers in mixture , shaking off the extra , and immediately roll in the panko crumbs
4. Fry in hot crisco until chicken tests done
5. For dip: mix honey and mustard together

title: kool aid pie
steps:
1. In a bowl , mix all ingredients except crust
2. Pour mixture into pie crust
3. Refrigerate to set up for a couple hours

title: terrific tonkatsu  japanese pork cutlet chops tenderloin
steps:
1. Combine applesauce , ketchup , worcestershire , mustard , and vinegar in medium saucepan and bring to a boil , stirring constantly
2. Remove from heat and allow to cool
3. Bread pork: dredge in flour , shake excess , dip in egg , drain excess , press into panko
4. Add 3 t
5. Of oil to large skillet over medium heat
6. Cook pork for ~5 minutes each side , until golden brown
7. Add reserved oil to pan prior to flipping pork
8. Remove golden brown and delicious chops from pan and allow to rest for 3 minutes before cutting into strips ~1-1 1 / 4 inches wide
9. Serve immediately with sauce

title: aloha joes
steps:
1. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat
2. Crumble meat into pan and cook until no longer pink
3. Reduce heat to medium
4. Add garlic and onion , cook until onion is soft
5. Drain and discard excess fat
6. Sprinkle meat mixture with salt and pepper
7. Add tomato sauce , worchestershire sauce and chili powder
8. Simmer , uncovered , 15 minutes
9. Stir in pineapple
10. Remove from heat
11. Spoon onto buns

title: lea   perrins two pepper marinade
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except steak
2. In large , shallow non-aluminum baking dish or plastic bag , pour 3 / 4 celsius marinade over steaks
3. Turn to coat
4. Marinate in refrigerator at least 30 minutes
5. Refrigerate unused marinade
6. Remove steaks
7. Grill or broil , to preferred doneness , brushing frequently with the reserved marinade

title: 3 ingredient individual quinoa pizza crust  no soaking
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 425 degrees
2. Place the quinoa and water into a small saucepan , adding a dash of salt and bring to a boil
3. Once boiling , reduce heat to a simmer
4. Cover , and simmer approximately 15 minutes or until the quinoa is soft and fluffy
5. Important: you should not let the quinoa absorb all of the water , there should be a couple teaspoons left , although the quinoa will be cooked
6. In a small mixing bowl , combine the warm cooked quinoa , its liquid , the oil , and the flour
7. Mush it all together with your hands until a dough like texture is achieved
8. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and shape the dough on it into a circle
9. The crust should be 1 cm thick and yield one pizza about 6 inches in diameter
10. Bake ten minutes , flip , and bake ten more minutes
11. You want to keep flipping the pizza so both sides are evenly crisped , however long that takes
12. If you don't do this correctly , the pizza will be "wet"
13. Do not add your toppings until the crust is crisped on both sides !
14. Remove from the oven and remove the parchment from the pan
15. Now you can add your toppings to your pizza
16. Return it to the pan , and bake it for about 10 more minutes , or until everything looks crisp and melted
17. Remove from the oven again , cut into pieces , and enjoy !

title: habichuelas guisadas
steps:
1. Wash , peel and cut all of the vegetables into 2 inch pieces
2. Boil them all in a large pot of salted water for 15 minutes over medium heat , or until slightly tender
3. Drain , and set aside
4. In another large pot , heat achiote oil over medium heat
5. Add the ham , and cook for four minutes
6. Add the sofrito , the onion , and the pepper and cook for three minutes
7. Add the sauce , beans , water and the seasonings
8. Stir well
9. After six minutes , add the yucca and the potatoes
10. Now comes the fun part -- take the cooled platanos , and mash them in a bowl with 1 / 4 - 1 / 2 tsp of salt add about 1 tbls
11. Of water , and mash until they are almost free of any lumps
12. Take a small amount of the mixture , and form a ball about the size of a walnut
13. Continue with the rest of the mixture , and then add all of the balls to the pot of beans
14. Mix gently , as to not break any
15. Cover the pot and lower the heat to low
16. You can simmer them for up to two hours , very slowly , and stir them every twenty minutes or so , or they will stick to the bottom
17. Or you can put them in a 325 degree oven for 1 1 / 2 hours
18. I like to use the oven , because you don't have to stir the pot during cooking

title: margarita grill
steps:
1. Stir first seven ingredients together in small bowl until brown sugar is dissolved
2. Makes 3 / 4 cup marinade
3. Toss all four fruits with marinade in large bowl
4. Let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes
5. Preheat lightly sprayed electric grill to high
6. Drain fruit and discard marinade
7. Cook fruit on grill for about one minute per side

title: seared salmon with crispy potatoes  peas   summer vegetable gratin
steps:
1. Set the oven at 375 degrees
2. Have on hand a 10-inch shallow baking dish
3. Potatoes: toss the potatoes with enough olive oil to coat them and spread them in a single layer on a rimmed baking sheet
4. Bake for 35 minutes or until golden brown and crispy
5. Drain on paper towels and keep warm
6. Leave the oven on
7. Vegetables: in a bowl combine the peas , asparagus , swiss chard , leeks , fava beans , mint , basil , cream , half the lemon juice , salt and pepper to taste
8. Toss well and transfer to the baking dish
9. Combine the bread crumbs , garlic , shallots , 2 tablespoons of oil and salt and pepper
10. Sprinkle the crumbs onto the vegetables
11. Transfer the dish to the hot oven
12. Bake for 10 minutes or until the cream is bubbling at the edges
13. Sprinkle the fish with salt and pepper
14. Heat a large frying pan over medium-high heat
15. Add several tablespoons oil and heat until hot
16. Sear the salmon boned side down until golden brown
17. Turn and cook the other side until golden and the fish is cooked through
18. Arrange the fish on the vegetables
19. Squeeze the remaining lemon juice over it
20. Garnish with crispy potatoes
21. Scatter the parsley over the rim of the dinner plates and serve at once

title: chickpea salad sandwich
steps:
1. Rinse and drain the chickpeas if using tinned
2. In a medium bowl mash the chickpeas with a potato masher , i usually mash about half way so there are still some whole ones left
3. Add in all the other ingredients and mix well

title: parmesan zucchini crisps
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Slice zucchini in rounds
3. Pour parmesan cheese into a zip lock bag
4. Dip zucchini slices into egg
5. Place zucchini in cheese bag
6. Shake until all pieces are coated
7. Place zucchini on a non-stick baking sheet
8. Bake for 15 minutes or until cheese starts to melt and brown

title: strawberry and peach jam
steps:
1. Measure strawberries and place in large saucepan
2. Peel and pit about 2 1 / 2 pounds fully ripe peaches
3. Crush thoroughly
4. Add enough peaches to strawberries to make 4 cups fruit
5. Measure sugar and set aside
6. Place saucepan holding fruit over high heat
7. Add fruit pectin and stir until mixture comes to a hard boil
8. At once stir in sugar
9. Bring to a full rolling boil and boil hard , one minute , stirring constantly
10. Remove from heat , skim and ladle quickly into hot sterilized glasses
11. Process for 10 mins in hot water bath
12. Makes 8 glasses

title: brown sugar substitute
steps: 1. In a food processor combine both ingredients and process till combined

title: fermented giardiniera
steps:
1. Prepare brine by dissolving the salt in water
2. Mix all the ingredients except the brine in a large bowl
3. Add them to the fermenting vessel of choice packing them down as you go
4. Fill each jar with the brine , leaving 1 -2 inches of headroomthe space at the top , between the rim of the jar and the top of the vegetables
5. Weight the vegetables so they are completely submerged in the brine
6. Cover the top of the vessel with a lid , coffee filter , paper towel , cheese cloth , or tea towel to keep bugs out and odors inches
7. Be sure to secure towels with a very tight rubber band or the ring from the canning jars
8. Place the jar out of direct light
9. Ferment at room temperature 4 days before checking the flavor
10. If you prefer the flavor more sour , continue fermenting
11. If to your taste transfer the jars to the refrigerator
12. Burp the jars once daily the giardiniera does continue to ferment while in the refrigerator
13. This doesn`t need to be done in my home because we help ourselves to it daily

title: hootin  holler chicken bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Arrange chicken in casserole pan
3. Pour vinegar over chicken pieces , followed by tabasco sauce
4. Whisk cream of mushroom soup , water and flour until smooth
5. Pour over chicken
6. Saute mushrooms in butter and garlic for three minutes
7. Add mushroom mixture to cover chicken in casserole
8. Bake uncovered for 65 minutes or until chicken is done and gravy is has thickened

title: heart attack brussels sprouts
steps:
1. Blanch the brussels sprouts in about 3 quarts of salted boiling water for about 10 minutes
2. When the 10 minutes is done , plunge the sprouts into cold , salted water and drain
3. While the sprouts are boiling start the sauce
4. Heat a saut pan on medium heat
5. When the saut pan is ready , add the pancetta
6. Cook until the pancetta has rendered its fat
7. Add the lard
8. When the lard is rendered , add the pine nuts
9. Stir this occasionally for about 10 minutes
10. Add the shallots and stir every once in a while for about five minutes
11. Add the garlic and stir more often for about a minute
12. Throw in the butter
13. Stir every once in a while until the butter is melted
14. Once the butter is melted , throw in the brussels sprouts , and cut the heat back to low
15. Cover and simmer for about 35 minutes
16. Stir when you feel like it
17. Turn off the heat and grate the cheese over the top
18. Stir at about 1 / 3 increments
19. The picture shows variation 1 with prosciutto ham
20. Just dice it and stir it at about the 20 minute simmering mark

title: olive garden chicken giardino
steps:
1. Melt butter in a sauce pan over medium heat
2. Stir in thyme , garlic , pepper and rosemary
3. Whisk to thoroughly blend and cook for 1 minute
4. Combine chicken broth , water , wine , milk , and lemon juice in a mixing bowl
5. Add cornstarch and whisk until cornstarch has dissolved and there are no lumps
6. Add liquid mixture to sauce pan
7. Whisk all ingredients together and bring to a boil
8. Season with salt and pepper to taste , then remove from heat
9. Chicken & vegetables preparation:
10. Cut chicken into strips width-wise
11. Combine all chicken ingredients in a mixing bowl and blend well
12. Marinate for 30 minutes
13. Heat a saute pan over medium high heat
14. Add cup extra virgin olive oil
15. Saute chicken strips until internal temperature reaches 165f
16. Add all vegetables and saute until cooked through
17. Add cooked , drained pasta and sauce to saute pan
18. Stir until pasta is thoroughly coated with sauce
19. Transfer to a serving platter and garnish with chopped parsley

title: chicken stew for couscous
steps:
1. Set aside tomatoes , zucchini , chick-peas and cayenne
2. Combine all remaining ingredients in a large saucepan and bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat and cook , covered about 8 minutes
4. Add tomatoes and zucchini and cook 3-5 minutes
5. Add chick-peas and cayenne pepper
6. Cook until heated through
7. Serve over steaming couscous

title: corn off the cob with chili butter
steps:
1. Slice kernels off each ear of corn
2. Put corn in a skillet with 1 / 3 cup water and cook , stirring a few times , over medium heat until water evaporates , about 3 minutes
3. Add butter and chili powder
4. Lower heat slightly and cook about 3 minutes , stirring a few times

title: jiffy spoon bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Prepare a 9x13 glass baking dish by spraying it with cooking spray
3. Pour the jiffy mix into a mixing bowl
4. In another bowl , whisk the sour cream until soft
5. Mix in the butter , corn , and buttermilk
6. Add the wet ingredients to the jiffy mix and stir until just blended
7. Pour the mix into the baking dish and bake at 350 degrees for 50 minutes , until it's just starting to brown on top

title: ice cream taffy
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a saucepan
2. Stir and boil until hard-cracked stage
3. While warm , pull into long strips until white
4. Place on waxed paper
5. Break into small pieces
6. Dust with powdered sugar if desired

title: baked salmon in foil
steps:
1. Lay a piece of silver foil , large enough to wrap the salmon in a very loose parcel , on a baking tray
2. If the salmon is to be served hot , grease the foil with the butter , or use the oil if serving the salmon cold
3. Thinly slice the lemon and put about half on the foil
4. Put the salmon on top , with a few slices of lemon inside with onions , if using , and lay the rest of the lemon along the top of the salmon
5. Season generously and wrap loosely , making sure the edges are securely folded together so that no steam can escape
6. Put into a medium oven , 450f , for 10 minutes per pound
7. If serving hot , take it out of the oven and let it stand for a further 10 minutes
8. If serving cold , leave the salmon in the foil for two to three hours
9. To serve: unwrap the fish and gently pull off the skin

title: spicy tuna gourmet ribbon sandwiches
steps:
1. Spread a slice of white bread with margarine , top with spicy tuna
2. Spread a slice of wholemeal bread with margarine and cover
3. Top this layer with cream cheese mixed with finely chopped capsicums and top again with a slice of white bread
4. Cut off the crusts as accurately as possible , and then cut long ways into three and then in half
5. Makes almost both loaves of sandwich bread
6. You can also mix and match using wholegrain loaf
7. Garnish sandwiches on a tray with parsley and serve

title: jazzed up citrusy beets
steps:
1. Leaving root end intact , trim tops from beets , leaving about 1-inch stem
2. In saucepan of boiling salted water , cover and cook beets for 25 minutes or until fork-tender
3. Drain and let cool enough to handle
4. Slip off skins
5. Quarter beets
6. Meanwhile , thinly slice green onions
7. Set light and dark green parts aside separately
8. In shallow dutch oven or sauce pan , heat oil over medium heat
9. Cook light green parts of onions , garlic , coriander , salt and pepper for about 2 minutes or until softened
10. Stir in orange rind and juice
11. Boil for 30 seconds or until reduced by half
12. Stir in beets
13. Cook , covered and stirring once , for about 4 minutes or until beets are heated through
14. Sprinkle with dark green parts of green onions

title: diabetic banana pecan pie
steps:
1. To make crust:
2. Soften the margarine
3. Blend cookie crumbs , pecans , and margarine in a bowl to make the crust
4. Press the pie crust into a 9 inch pie plate
5. Chill for 30 minutes
6. To make filling:
7. In a saucepan , heat all filling ingredients , except margarine , to a boil over medium heat , whisking until smooth
8. Reduce heat and simmer for 1 minute
9. Scrape into a bowl
10. Whisk in remaining 2 tablespoons of margarine until smooth
11. Cover with plastic wrap and cool to room temperature
12. Slice the bananas
13. In prepared pie plate , arrange sliced bananas in 1 layer
14. Whisk cooled filling and pour evenly over bananas
15. To make topping:
16. Mix remaining cookie crumbs and pecans together and sprinkle over the filling
17. Chill the banana pecan cream pie for 1 hour before serving

title: beef  rice  peas and carrots one dish meal
steps:
1. Dice onion
2. In a medium sized pot , brown ground beef , with onion
3. When the beef is done , add the peas and carrots , and 2 1 / 2 cups of water
4. Let it reach a boil , and turn heat to medium
5. After about 5 minutes , add the minute rice , and an additional 1 / 2 cup of water if needed
6. Simmer for 5 minutes or so , until the rice and vegetables are tender
7. Season with salt and pepper to taste just before serving

title: cranberry almond tart
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Cranberries: bring orange juice and sugar to a boil
3. Add cranberries , remove from heat and let cool
4. Filling: beat almond paste and sugar until smooth
5. Add remaining ingredients and beat until blended
6. Assembly: spread filling in tart shell
7. Drain cranberries and place on top of filling
8. Sprinkle with almonds to cover
9. Bake until puffed , crust is done and almonds are golden , then cool
10. Tart dough , cranberries and almond filling can all be made a couple of days ahead
11. Filling should be brought to room temperature or beat in a mixer to facilitate spreading

title: italian ricotta cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar and salt
2. Add eggs and ricotta cheese , vanilla and grated orange rind
3. Sift flour , baking powder , baking soda together in another bowl
4. Add to batter in three additions
5. Preheat oven 350
6. Drop by teaspoon of dough on ungreased cookie sheet
7. Bake 10 minutes until edges lightly browned
8. Cool on racks
9. Mix frosting ingredients
10. Spread on cool cookies

title: crostini with sun dried tomato jam
steps:
1. For the sun-dried tomato jam: place a medium saucepan over medium heat
2. Add the chopped sun-dried tomatoes , 1 tablespoon of the reserved sun-dried tomato oil , olive oil , onion , and garlic
3. Stir and cook until the onions are soft and beginning to brown at the edges , about 5 to 7 minutes
4. Add the sugar , vinegar , water , chicken broth , thyme , salt , and pepper
5. Bring the liquid to a boil , reduce the heat , and simmer , covered , for 30 minutes
6. Remove the cover and continue simmering until most of the liquid is reduced and the mixture is the consistency of jam , about 5 to 10 more minutes
7. Remove from the heat and set aside
8. For the crostini: preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
9. Line a baking sheet with foil
10. Place the baguette slices on the baking sheet
11. Using a pastry brush , lightly coat the baguette slices with olive oil
12. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
13. Bake until lightly toasted , about 8 minutes
14. Place the soft goat cheese in a small bowl
15. Stir in the thyme
16. To assemble: spread the crostini with sun-dried tomato jam and top with the goat cheese and herb mixture
17. Transfer to a serving plate and serve

title: sugar and spice sweet pickle
steps:
1. Prepare vegetables cutting into serving size pieces , sprinkle with 1 / 2 cup salt and let stand for three hours
2. Rinse well with cold water to remove salt
3. Brine mix: mix and bring to a boil
4. Put vegetables in sterilized jars , cover with boiling brine and seal

title: quick bacon   egg wich
steps:
1. Place 1 english muffin half on microwaveable plate
2. Carefully crack egg over muffin
3. Microwave on high for 40 seconds
4. Top with tomato , bacon and velveeta
5. Cover with remaining muffin half
6. Microwave on high 30 seconds or until egg white is completely set and yolk is thickened around the edge

title: rice pilaf with pecans
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large dutch oven over medium-high heat
2. Add carrot and onion
3. Saut 5 minutes
4. Add broth and orange juice , and bring to a boil
5. Add rice , raisins , sugar , salt , and cinnamon
6. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer for 20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed
7. Sprinkle with pecans

title: graham crackers  gluten free
steps:
1. In a large bowl , whisk together flours , sugar , cinnamon , baking powder , xanthan gum , baking soda and salt
2. Cut in butter using a pastry cutter or two knives until it resembles cornmeal
3. Stir in cold water , honey and vanilla
4. Dough should form a ball
5. If dough is too dry , add more cold water a tbsp at a time
6. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
7. Get out two cookie sheets and cover with wax or parchment paper
8. Spray lightly with non-stick cooking spray
9. Gather dough into a ball and divide in half
10. Using a lightly floured cloth covered rolling pin , roll half of the dough into a rectangle on one of the cookie sheets to about a 1 / 8" thick
11. Repeat with the other half
12. Score dough with a pizza cutter into desired shapes and prick all over with a fork
13. Very lightly sprinkle all over with sugar
14. Bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown and starting to harden
15. Let cool for 5 minutes before breaking apart

title: star spangled fruit tart
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Press cookie dough onto an ungreased 12 inch pizza pan or onto a cookie sheet
3. Bake for 10-15 minutes or until golden brown
4. Cool on wire rack
5. In a small bowl , beat cream cheese , sugar and almond extract until smooth
6. Spread over crust
7. In center of tart , arrange berries in the shape of a star
8. Add a berry border
9. Refrigerate until ready to serve

title: fruit salad fantastico
steps:
1. Put all ingredients in a large bowl
2. Mix well
3. Chill 3 or 4 hours or overnight
4. Store in refrigerator

title: khatta channa   a punjabi indian speciality chickpeas dish
steps:
1. Soak the black channa overnight in a large bowl with lots of water
2. The water level should be atleast 3 inches above the level of the black channa{chickpeas}
3. The next morning , drain out the water completely and wash the channa in a bowl of fresh and clean water
4. Now , put the washed channa in a large pot
5. Add water{should be 2-3 inches over the level of the chickpeas}
6. Boil the chickpeas on high heat
7. Heat oil in a pot
8. Add asafoetida , fenugreek , corriander , turmeric and red chilli powders with salt to taste
9. Mix well and stir-fry for a few seconds
10. Prepare tamarind water by dissolving a lemon-sized piece of tamarind in 1 / 2 cup of hot water
11. Squeeze the tamarind ball really hard to let its juices flow into the water
12. Pass this through a strainer and into a bowl
13. Your tamarind water is ready
14. In a bowl , dissolve the gramflour in 3 tbsps
15. Of water
16. Mix this really well ensuring that no lumps remain
17. Add this mixture and the tamarind water to the pot containing all the spice powders{masalas}
18. Stir well and bring to a boil
19. Lower flame , add the boiled chickpeas , dry mango powder and 2 1 / 2- 3 cups of water
20. Boil for 10-15 minutes on medium flame
21. Remove from flame
22. Serve hot over a bowl of white long-grain basmati rice
23. Enjoy !

title: spiced orange and almond cake
steps:
1. Mix the breadcrumbs with the sugar , almonds and baking powder
2. Add the oil and eggs and beat well
3. Stir in the orange and lemon zest
4. Pour the mixture into a greased 8inch round cake tin , put into a cold oven and set the heat to 375f , or slightly less for a fan assisted oven
5. Bake for 40-45 minutes until the cake is golden brown and a toothpick inserted into the centre comes out clean
6. Cool for 5 minutes in the tin then turn out onto a plate
7. While the cake is baking , make the syrup- put the 1 / 2 cup sugar , juices , cloves and cinnamon stick into a pan and bring gently to the boil , stirring until all the sugar has dissolved
8. Simmer for about 3 minutes
9. Pierce holes in the cake with a toothpick while still warm and pour the syrup over it in small batches
10. Leave to cool and continue spooning over the syrup until it is all soaked up

title: chasen s beef belmont with matzo balls
steps:
1. For the beef
2. Place short ribs and broth in a large dutch oven
3. Add water to cover ribs , and bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat and simmer , skim foam from the broth
5. Make a bouquet garni by tying bay leaves , parsley sprigs and thyme into a cheesecloth bundle with kitchen string
6. Place the bundle in the broth with salt and pepper
7. Simmer , covered , for about 1 1 / 2 hours or until meat is very tender and falls off the bone
8. Remove the bouquet garni and strain the broth
9. Return the broth and meat to the pan
10. Stir in the carrots , leeks and celery
11. Bring mixture to a boil
12. Reduce heat and simmer , covered for 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender
13. Return mixture to the boil , add lima beans and egg noodles , cooking just until noodles are nearly tender
14. Remove meat , and separate meat from bones
15. Have soup at room temperature or warmer and add matzo balls
16. Simmer for 5 minutes
17. Serve soup forst with 2 or 3 matzo balls per bowl
18. Slice meat and garnish plate
19. For the matzo balls:
20. Blend fat or oil with eggs
21. Mix matso meal with salt , and combine these 2 mixtures and blend well
22. Add soup stock or water and mix until uniform
23. Cover mixture and refrigerate for one hour
24. In a 3-quart pot , bring 2 quarts of water to a full boil , adding salt if desired
25. From the refrigerated mix , form about 16 matzo balls , each 1 inch in diameter
26. Reduce flame and drop matzo balls into the gently boiling water
27. Cover pot and cook 30 to 40 minutes
28. Remove matzo balls from water and add to the boiled beef belmont soup
29. The soup is seved separately from the platter of boiled beef
30. Add your own choice of accompaniments to the beef platter

title: sausage   cabbage casserole
steps:
1. Heat oil & brown sausages , remove from pan & slice thickly & place in a casserole dish
2. Melt butter & saute onion & garlic until tender , add tomato paste , cabbage , tomatoes & zucchini and cook for a few minutes
3. Blend all remaining ingredients , bring to the boil & pour over sausages
4. Bake covered in a moderate oven for approx 1 hour
5. Combine topping ingredients & sprinkle over casserole
6. Bake for a further 5-10 mins uncovered

title: no crust coconut pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl and stir until well blended
3. Grease two 9-inch pie plates and divide mixture evenly between them
4. Bake at 350f for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown

title: greek garbanzo bean salad
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl
2. Toss well and refrigerate 1-2 hours before serving
3. Serve chilled

title: emerald city martini lite
steps:
1. Mix it all together
2. Serve either shaken or with a bit of crushed ice

title: strawberry vanilla bean cheesecake pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a medium sized mixing bowl , stir together graham cracker crumbs , butter and honey until well combined
3. Press into a 9-inch pie plate
4. Bake for 8-10 minutes or until golden brown
5. In a large mixing bowl , using a mixer on medium speed , beat together cream cheese and ricotta cheese until smooth
6. Beat in 2 / 3 cup sugar and vanilla bean seeds until combined
7. Beat in egg until just combined
8. Pour into prepared crust
9. Bake for 20 minutes or until set , and wobbles only slightly
10. Cool for 45 minutes before lightly covering and transferring to refrigerator to cool completely , at least 2 hours
11. To make the strawberry sauce , in a large nonstick skillet , stir together additional 5 tablespoons sugar , water and cornstarch until combined
12. Turn heat on to medium and bring mixture to a boil , stirring frequently
13. Stir in strawberries and cook for 3-4 minutes or until fragrant and mixture starts to thicken up
14. Transfer strawberries and juices to a bowl and cool for 15 minutes before lightly covering and transferring to refrigerator to cool completely
15. Serve strawberry sauce over sliced cheesecake pie

title: fish vinaigrette
steps:
1. Combine the water , 1 / 4 cup vinegar , 1 / 4 cup lemon juice , peppercorns and bay leaf in a large skillet and heat to just below boiling point
2. Add fish fillets and poach 5-7 minutes until done , turning once
3. Do not let the liquid boil
4. Drain and cool , discarding the bay leaf and peppercorns
5. Make a vinaigrette dressing by combining the olive oil , 3 tbs vinegar , 3 tbs lemon juice , lemon zest , onion , capers , parsley , tarragon , salt and pepper in a jar and shaking vigorously
6. Break the fish into pieces and place in a bowl
7. Pour the dressing over the fish , cover and refrigerate at least 2-4 hours
8. Serve chilled

title: turkey scallopini with lemon and capers
steps:
1. Pat turkey dry and season with salt and pepper
2. Coat the slices in flour and shake off any excess
3. Over high heat in a large heavy skillet , heat 1 1 / 2 tablespoon oil and brown half of the turkey cutlets , cooking until just cooked through
4. Remove to a covered platter and keep warm
5. Add and heat another 1 1 / 2 tablespoons oil and brown and cook the rest of the turkey in the same way , also removing to the covered platter to be kept warm when finished
6. Turn down heat a bit and add remaining tablespoon of oil to skillet
7. Cook the garlic in the oil until fragrant , careful not to burn , about 30 seconds
8. Then , over moderately high heat , deglaze pan with the broth
9. Be sure to get all the beautiful browned bits loose & into the broth !
10. Boil broth until reduced to about 3 / 4 cup
11. Stir in lemon juice , capers , parsley , salt and pepper to taste , and butter
12. Whisk sauce until smooth
13. Return turkey cutlets and any juices to the saucepan and simmer until heated through , about 1-2 minutes

title: chocolate mint candy  fudge
steps:
1. In a heavy saucepan , melt chocolate chips with 1 cup milk
2. Remove from the heat
3. Stir in vanilla
4. Spread half into a waxed paper-lined 8-in
5. Square pan
6. Chill for 10 minutes or until firm
7. Meanwhile , in a heavy saucepan over low heat , cook and stir candy coating with remaining milk until coating is melted and mixture is smooth
8. Stir in peppermint extract and food coloring
9. Spread over bottom layer
10. Chill for 10 minutes or until firm
11. Warm remaining chocolate mixture if necessary
12. Spread over mint layer
13. Chill for 2 hours or until firm
14. Remove from pan
15. Cut into 1-in
16. Squares

title: stuffed peppers   european style
steps:
1. Preheat over to 375 degrees f
2. Combine finely chopped vegetables , oil , and seasonings in a pot or wok
3. Saute them for about 10-15 minutes
4. Add ground meat
5. Your choice
6. Cook until brown and ready
7. Add rice to mixture and saute / cook through another 5 minutes , add sauce
8. Wash the peppers and take out the insides
9. Spoon the cooked mixture into the peppers
10. On bottom of pan lightly coat with sauce , place the peppers in the pan - do not layer one on top of the other
11. Sprinkle some paprika , olive oil , and if any remaining mixture on top of the peppers
12. Bake covered with foil at 375 for 50 minutes
13. Bake another 10-15 minutes at 400 degrees uncovered
14. Enjoy !

title: best sugar cookies
steps:
1. Cream together the crisco and sugar
2. Add vanilla , egg , and evaporated milk
3. Mix well
4. Add the flour , baking powder , and salt
5. Mix well
6. Cover the dough and chill for 1 hour
7. Roll out and use your favorite cookie cutters
8. Bake at 375 on a greased cookie sheet for 6-8 minutes or until bottoms are lightly browned

title: turkey   sausage soup
steps:
1. Saute the sausage and onions til brown and onions soft
2. Add the rest of the ingredients and simmer for an hour
3. Serve with a good crusty bread

title: hot lemonade with rum
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan combine water , lemon juice and sugar and simmer over low heat , stirring frequently , until sugar dissolves
2. Stir in the rum
3. Pour into warm mugs , garnish with lemon slices & candy swizzle sticks

title: salsa spiked macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Following the package directions , cook macaroni in boiling water for the minimum cooking time- usually 7 minutes
2. Drain& rinse with cold running water to stop the cooking process
3. Drain well& place in an ungreased baking dish large enough to hold 8 cups
4. Meanwhile , pour milk into a large saucepan , over medium heat until milk is steaming hot
5. Do not boil
6. Cut cream cheese into 1 / 2 inch cubes
7. Combine grated cheddar& flour in a small bowl
8. As soon as the milk is hot , stir in cream cheese cubes until they melt
9. Continuing to stir , gradually sprinkle in the cheddar / flour mixture , then the parmesan , mustard , salt , paprika& cayenne
10. Stirring frequently , cook until cheeses melt& sauce is smooth
11. Pour sauce over cooked macaroni& stir until coated
12. Fold in salsa& green onions just until evenly distributed
13. Smooth top
14. Cover& bake in the center of a preheated 350f oven until hot& bubbly , about 30- 35 minutes
15. For extra crunch , uncover& sprinkle with buttered breadcrumbs during the last 10 minutes of baking time

title: june s addiction  cucumber sandwich
steps:
1. Assemble in order given
2. Openfaced
3. Easy !

title: cheesy pretzel dippers  lunch box surprise
steps:
1. Cut cheese into 16 cubes
2. Let stand at room temperature 10 to 15 minute or until cheese is at room temperature
3. Insert a thin pretzel stick into each cube
4. Serve with honey dijon mustard or your child's favorite dressing

title: grilled pimento cheese and bacon sandwiches
steps:
1. Mix the cheese , mayonnaise , and pimentos
2. Divide the mix and spread onto two of the bread slices
3. Top with the bacon and add the other bread slices
4. Melt the butter in a large skillet
5. Add the sandwiches and lightly brown on both sides
6. Serve warm

title: bbq chicken with grilled sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Mix paprika through to sugar
2. A few hours before you plan to grill , rub chicken breasts with seasoning mixture
3. Cover and refrigerate until 15 minutes before you grill
4. Peel sweet potatoes and slice into 1 / 3-inch discs
5. Place in a pot with enough cold , salted water to cover , and bring to a boil over medium heat
6. Boil for 3 to 4 minutes , then drain and cool
7. When it's time to grill , preheat grill , then spray potatoes with cooking spray or olive oil spray and salt them
8. Salt chicken breasts
9. Place potatoes and chicken on grill and cook until done
10. The seasoning mixture makes the chicken very reddish in color , so be careful not to cook the chicken too long

title: weight watchers 1 point ice cream sandwich
steps:
1. Break graham crackers in half
2. Place on one half of the cracker a tbsp of whipped cream and top with another cracker
3. Press lightly
4. Place in freezer until ready to be eaten
5. Make as many as you like as they are so good and are only 1 point

title: pear salsa
steps: 1. Combine ingredients season with salt& pepper , refrigerate

title: baba ganous  turkish eggplant salad
steps:
1. Wash the eggplants and cook them over a charcoal fire or place them in the oven , until they become soft
2. Let them cool and then carefully remove all the skin , or else the eggplants will have a bitter taste
3. Remove all seeds from the eggplants , dice them as finely as you can and toss them with the tahini , lemon juice , crushed garlic , salt and cumin
4. Mash and combine all ingredients together using a fork
5. Drizzle some olive oil and sprinkle with black pepper before serving

title: light chicken and cashew casserole
steps:
1. Saute celery and onion in water
2. Add all but 1 / 2 c cashews and chow mein noodles
3. Pour into greasted 1 1 / 2 quart casserole dish
4. Bake at 350f for 30-35 minutes
5. Sprinkle with chow mein noodles and remaining cashews
6. Bake 5 minutes more
7. Serve with brown rice , soy sauce , and red pepper

title: potaddies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Cut potatoes lengthwise in inch slices
3. Drizzle oil over bottom of baking sheet
4. Spread each potato slice with 1 tsp of butter on one side
5. Place potato slices , buttered side up , in pan
6. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until light brown and slightly crisp
7. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
8. Serve immediately

title: sherry marinade
steps:
1. Blend all the ingredients and pour the marinade over you meat
2. Marinate 4-24 hours in the refrigerator , turning pieces occasionally

title: tuna and pesto pasta bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c cook pasta in a large saucepan of boiling , salted water , following packet directions , until tender
2. Drain
3. Heat oil in a large frying pan over medium heat
4. Add onions , garlic and celery
5. Cook , stirring , for 2 minutes or until onion is soft
6. Add tomatoes
7. Cook for 2 minutes
8. Add spinach , pesto and milk
9. Cook , stirring , for 2 minutes or until spinach just wilts
10. Add pasta to pan with tuna
11. Season with salt and pepper
12. Toss gently to combine
13. Spoon mixture into an 8 cup-capacity ceramic baking dish
14. Top with cheese
15. Bake for 20 minutes or until cheese is melted and golden
16. Stand for 5 minutes before serving

title: green chili spicy cheeseball
steps:
1. 1- let cream cheese come to room temperature
2. 2- in bowl , combine all ingredients
3. 3- blend well
4. 4- place mixture on wax paper or plastic wrap
5. 5- wrap and form into ball
6. 6- chill for several hours or overnight

title: pour over  no cook  barbecue sauce
steps:
1. Whisk together all ingredients
2. Use immediately or cover and refrigerate until needed

title: seared scallops  orange rice  and citrus key lime sauce
steps:
1. Scallops -- now before you start anything , just take out the scallops from the fridge , rinse well and pat dry
2. Then season well with salt and pepper and set to the side so they get to room temperature you don't want to sear cold scallops
3. Rice -- now even though it is quick cooking , the scallops take such little time we need to start the rice first
4. Now i happen to use the quick cooking , but you can use any jasmine brand , quick cooking or not that you want
5. Just follow the directions for cooking the rice
6. But these are my changes
7. For the liquid , i use vegetable broth instead of water and i replace some of the broth with the juice of 1 orange , however much that will be depends on the size of the orange
8. Just make sure if it calls for 3 cups of liquid , use the orange juice and the rest should be the vegetable broth
9. This will just really help to flavor the rice as it cooks
10. I also add the zest of 1entire orange to the liquid as the rice cooks
11. Just cover and let cook as you sear the scallops
12. Scallops -- as the rice cooks , time to make the scallops
13. In a cast iron if you have one or a stainless pan for this dish heat up 2 tablespoons of the the butter and 1 teaspoon olive oil to medium high heat and sear the scallops
14. Once you place them in the pan do not move
15. They take about 2-3 minutes per side and when you can easily lift them , then it is time to turn
16. They don't take long and don't over cook
17. When they become opaque and firm to the touch they are done
18. They will also continue to cook once removed
19. They should be golden brown per side
20. Once done , remove to a plate and cover with foil
21. Rice -- now the rice should be done
22. Add the scallions , butter , salt and pepper to taste if you want
23. Cover and set to the side
24. It is all done
25. Key lime sauce -- now in the pan where you seared the scallops , add the garlic and saute just a minute
26. Then add the orange juice , key lime juice , honey , ginger , red pepper flakes and reduce on medium for 3-4 minutes to reduce
27. Then add in the cilantro , salt and pepper if needed and butter to glisten the sauce
28. Serve -- serve the orange rice and top with 6 of the scallops per person and top with the key lime sauce
29. I love to garnish this with a lime and orange slice to let those know what is in the dish

title: garlic roasted asparagus with parmesan
steps:
1. Heat oil and garlic in a small saucepan over low heat until garlic becomes golden- several minutes
2. Allow oil to cool
3. Bend asparagus gently at a natural point and when it snaps , discard end pieces
4. Place asparagus on a lipped roasting pan and toss with infused olive oil and garlic , coating all pieces
5. Line up asparagus and push together , season with salt and pepper , then sprinkle with grated parmesan
6. Roast in a preheated oven at 400f for 12 minutes or until cooked to your liking
7. Serve at once

title: fresh corn chowder
steps:
1. Puree the almond milk , 2 cups of the corn kernels , 3 / 4 of the avocado and salt in a blender until smooth
2. Chill before serving
3. To serve , ladle into bowls , garnish with the remaining corn and avocado , and sprinkle with cracked black pepper

title: peruvian marinade for chicken
steps:
1. Whisk all marinade ingrediants together in a bowl
2. Place chicken breasts in a large ziplock bag and pour marinade over top
3. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes but no longer than 4 hours
4. Heat a grill to medium-high
5. Chicken is easiest grilled if you brush vegetable oil liberally on the grill first so it doesn't stick
6. Grill , with lid down for 7 to 7 1 / 2 minutes per side

title: spicy orange shrimp ceviche
steps:
1. Peel and devein shrimp
2. Pat dry
3. In a large bowl , whisk the ketchup with the orange juice
4. Add the lime and lemon juices , garlic , jalapeo , oregano , pepper , cumin , cinnamon and cloves and season generously with salt and hot sauce
5. Add the shrimp , red onion , tomato and chopped cilantro
6. Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours or overnight
7. Stir once or twice
8. Spoon the shrimp and sauce into martini glasses or onto small plates , garnish with endive spears and cilantro leaves and serve

title: clay aiken s favorite   pineapple salad
steps:
1. Mix together crackers , sugar , pineapple , cheddar cheese , and flour
2. Put in 9x13 bakng dish
3. Put more curshed crackers on top and the melted butter
4. Bake in 350f oven for 35-40 minutes
5. Delicious !

title: broccoli and tuna macaroni and cheese casserole
steps:
1. Prepare shells and cheese dinner according to package direction
2. Drain but do not rinse
3. Return cooked shells to hot pot
4. Add in liquid cheese packet , condensed soup , milk , tuna , thawed broccoli , onion and garlic powder
5. Gently stir to mix well
6. Pour into a casserole dish
7. In a small bowl , mix together melted butter and breadcrumbs
8. Sprinkle the buttery breadcrumbs on top of the casserole
9. Bake
10. Uncovered for 25-30 minutes

title: sauteed chicken legs moutarde
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large skillet and brown the chicken legs on both sides
2. Add 1 / 4 teaspoon of the salt and 1 / 8 teaspoon of the pepper
3. Discard the browning oil and replace it with 1 / 4 cup of the chicken broth
4. Cover pan and cook until tender , about 30 minutes
5. Cook and butter the noodles , season with the remaining salt , pepper and chives
6. Remove the chicken pieces to a serving platter
7. Skim fat from the juices and add 1 / 3 cup of chicken broth to the pan , scrape well to dissolve all the chicken cooking juices and bring to boil
8. Dissolve the cornstarch in the remaining cold chicken broth and add to the skillet and stir until thickened
9. Remove from heat and let cool a minuite or so and stir in the mustard
10. Do not reboil
11. Strain the sauce into a small bowl
12. Add 1 teaspoon of chopped parsley
13. Spoon the sauce over chicken and surround it with the noodles

title: the full monty   f e b    full english breakfast
steps:
1. Heat the flat grill plate over a low heat , on top of 2 rings / flames if it fits , and brush sparingly with light olive oil or vegetable oil
2. For the sausages
3. Always buy sausages with a high meat content
4. Cook these first
5. Add the sausages to the hot grill plate / the coolest part if there is one and allow to cook slowly for about 15-20 minutes , turning occasionally , until golden
6. After the first 10 minutes , increase the heat to medium before beginning to cook the other ingredients
7. If you are struggling for space , completely cook the sausages and keep hot on a plate in the oven
8. For the bacon
9. Choose between back or streaky , smoked or unsmoked bacon
10. Generally , dry-cure has the best flavour
11. Snip a few small cuts into the fatty edge of the bacon
12. Place the bacon straight on to the grill plate and fry for 2-4 minutes each side or until your preferred crispiness is reached
13. Like the sausages , the cooked bacon can be kept hot on a plate in the oven
14. For the mushrooms
15. Brush away any dirt using a pastry brush and trim the stalk level with the mushroom top
16. Season with salt and pepper and drizzle over a little olive oil
17. Place stalk-side up on the grill plate and cook for 1-2 minutes before turning and cooking for a further 3-4 minutes
18. Avoid moving the mushrooms too much while cooking , as this releases the natural juices , making them soggy
19. For the tomatoes
20. Cut the tomatoes across the centre / or in half lengthways if using plum tomatoes , and with a small , sharp knife remove the green 'eye'
21. Season with salt and pepper and drizzle with a little olive oil
22. Place cut-side down on the grill plate and cook without moving for 2 minutes
23. Gently turn over and season again
24. Cook for a further 2-3 minutes until tender but still holding their shape
25. For the fried bread
26. For 'proper' fried bread it's best to cook it in a separate pan
27. Ideally , use bread that is a couple of days old
28. Heat a frying pan to a medium heat and cover the base with oil
29. Add the bread and cook for 2-3 minutes each side until crispy and golden
30. If the pan becomes too dry , add a little more oil
31. For a richer flavour , add a knob of butter after you turn the slice
32. For the fried eggs
33. Break the egg straight into the pan with the fried bread and leave for 30 seconds
34. Add a good knob of butter and lightly splash / baste the egg with the butter when melted
35. Cook to your preferred stage , season and gently remove with a fish slice
36. Once all the ingredients are cooked , serve on warm plates and enjoy straight away with a good squeeze of tomato ketchup , worcestershire sauce or brown sauce , and don't forget the toast and marmalade with a pot of good english breakfast tea
37. Optional extras
38. Black pudding
39. Cut the black pudding into 3-4 slices and remove the skin
40. Place on the grill plate and cook for 1-2 minutes each side until slightly crispy
41. Baked beans
42. Heat up the baked beans in a saucepan and serve on top of the fried bread , or on the side
43. Fried potatoes:
44. Fry the sliced cooked potatoes in a little butter until crispy and golden brown
45. Season with a little salt and black pepper

title: microwave rice pilaff
steps:
1. In a 2 qt casserole dish , combine butter , rice , onions , celery and garlic
2. Microwave 5 minutes on high
3. Add chicken broth , thyme and parsley
4. Cover and cook 15 minutes stirring twice during cooking time
5. Let stand 10 minutes to finish cooking before serving
6. Serves 6
7. Use fresh herbs for best results

title: paulie s hotdish
steps:
1. Brown ground beef and drain
2. Mix ingredients together in 1 1 / 2 quart baking dish
3. Cover dish with foil and bake for 1 hour at 350 degrees
4. Remove foil for the last 10 minutes , to brown

title: poppin  jalapeno bread
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast in warm water in a large bowl
2. Let stand 5 minutes until foamy
3. Combine dissolved yeast , egg and butter
4. Mix until butter melts
5. Combine 3 cups flour , sugar , salt and garlic salt
6. Gradually add flour mixture to yeast mixture , beating at medium speed of electric mixer until smooth
7. Beat in peppers , cheese , onion and enough of the remaining flour to form a soft dough
8. Turn dough out onto a well-floured surface and knead 1 minute
9. Shape dough into a loaf
10. Place in a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan
11. Cover and let rise in a warm place , free from drafts , 30 minutes or until doubled in bulk
12. Preheat oven to 400
13. Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until done and loaf sounds hollow when tapped
14. Remove from pan and allow to cool on wire rack

title: vegetarian afghani boulanee  turnovers
steps:
1. Boil potatoes , or if using mashed potatoes proceed with recipe as follows:
2. In large bowl combine the cooked potatoes , scallions , leek , cilantro and spices
3. Season with salt and pepper
4. Mix well but do not overmix
5. Divide the mixture evenly into the tortillas
6. Fold tortillas in half
7. Flatten with a spatula or your hand
8. In large frying pan heat oil on medium and fry the turnovers until golden , flattening turnovers slightly with spatula
9. Flip over and cook turnovers on other side until golden
10. Drain on paper towel
11. Transfer turnovers to serving platter
12. Serve hot
13. Boulanee make great picnic food as they travel well and don't require refrigeration

title: quick fettuccine carbonara
steps:
1. Saute the bacon in a small skillet until crisp
2. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain well on a paper towel
3. Cook fettuccini noodles according to package instruction until firm and tender
4. Meanwhile , beat the eggs thoroughly in a large bowl suitable for serving
5. Have the cooked bacon and the chopped parsley ready at hand
6. When the pasta is done , drain it immediately in a colander , and pour into the bowl of eggs and immediately begin tossing it
7. As the strands of pasta become coated with the beaten eggs , their heat will cook the eggs
8. Sprinkle the bacon , italian seasoning and parsley on , and serve immediately
9. Top with lots of freshly grated parmesan cheese and freshly ground black pepper

title: chicken enchilada pasta
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Lightly grease a 13 x 9 pan
3. Set aside
4. Cook the pasta according to package directions
5. Drain well
6. Return the cooked , drained pasta to the empty pot
7. Stir in the cooked cubed chicken , scallions , tomatoes , corn , tomato sauce , enchilada sauce , cumin , chili powder and garlic powder
8. Mix well and add salt if needed
9. Pour mixture into the 13 x 9 dish
10. Evenly sprinkle with the shredded cheese and then the cilantro or parsley
11. Bake at 350 for about 20-30 minutes
12. Remove from oven
13. Serve with dallops of the sour cream , if desired

title: white chicken chili
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , except last 3 , in a slow cooker
2. Cover and cook on low for 8-10 hours or high for 4-5 hours
3. Top individual servings with sour cream and cheese and serve with chips
4. You don't have to use that brand but we think they are the best with this dish

title: pecan diamonds
steps:
1. For the crust:
2. Combine flour , baking powder& salt , set aside
3. Cream butter , sugar and shortening until light and fluffy
4. Add egg and vanilla and beat until well combined
5. Add dry ingredients , stirring until dough forms a ball
6. Wrap dough and refrigerate overnight
7. Preheat oven to 375f between 2 sheets of waxed paper roll the dough into a 15x10 inch rectangle 1 / 8 inch thick
8. Remove top sheet of waxed paper and invert onto a 15x10 inch jelly roll pan
9. Remove remaining wax paper and if necessary , patch the dough
10. Prick the dough liberally with a fork to prevent shrinkage during baking , and bake 10 minutes
11. Cool completely and reduce oven temperature to 350f
12. For the filling:
13. In a large saucepan combine butter , honey , and both sugars and bring to a boil over medium heat
14. Stir in nuts and mix thoroughly
15. Stir in cream and mix thoroughly
16. Set cooled partially baked crust into a pan of the same size
17. Carefully spread pecan mixture over partially baked crust
18. Bake 35 minutes in 350f oven
19. Cool completely in pans on wire rack
20. Once cool cut crosswise into 1 1 / 2 inch s
21. It is recommended that you do not use dark coated baking pans for this recipe
22. If you must , shorten baking time by at least 10 minutes

title: cottage cheese waffles
steps:
1. Sift flour and salt together , set aside
2. Beat eggs , milk , vegetable oil , and vanilla together
3. Add cottage cheese and beat until smooth
4. Combine with flour and cook as usual in your waffle iron

title: light gingerbread cake
steps:
1. In a medium bowl cream together the butter , molasses , brown sugar and cinnamon until light
2. Dissolve the baking soda in 1 cup of boiling water
3. Add to creamed butter mixture
4. Add flour and eggs
5. Pour batter into a greased and floured 9" round baking pan and bake at 325f for 30-35 minutes

title: dr pepper barbecue pork roast
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine dr pepper , worcestershire , vinegar , garlic , bouillon , mustard , chili powder and red pepper flakes
2. Save 1 / 2 cup of this for sauce
3. Place meat and onions into crockpot and pour the remaining sauce over the meat
4. Cover and cook on low for 10-12 hours or on high for 5-6 hours
5. Transfer to serving platter and let 'settle' 10 min , before slicing
6. While the meat 'settles' , in a small pan combine reserved 1 / 2 cup sauce , catsup and butter
7. Heat through
8. This is your 'gravy'

title: seared prawns with lime with mint and cilantro chutney
steps:
1. Poke a skewer into each shrimp through the tail and straight through the center of it lengthwise , and set aside
2. Place a cast iron skillet over medium-high heat and add the oil
3. When it begins to get hot , add the garlic , fenugreek , paprika , cumin seeds , and cardamom seeds , and toast well , or until garlic is golden
