4. Add the shrimp skewers to the pan and cook them in the spices until done , about 3 to 4 minutes each , turning frequently
5. Sprinkle the prawn with lime juice and serve with the mint and cilantro chutney
6. To make the chutney:
7. Place the mint leaves , chile pepper , red onion , cilantro leaves , garam masala , salt , water , and tamarind water in a food processor and process until smooth , like the consistency of pesto
8. Put into a serving bowl and serve with the seared prawns

title: asian flavored butter
steps: 1. Combine all of the ingredients in a small bowl

title: custard pie  nothing fancy
steps:
1. Combine eggs , sugar , nutmeg or cinnamon , vanilla , and salt
2. Add scalded milk a little at a time while whisking , so as not to cook the eggs
3. When all is blended , pour into the unbaked pie shell
4. Bake at 350f for 30 minutes or until a knife inserted into center comes out clean

title: pasta shells with peas and ham
steps:
1. Cook pasta shells according to package directions until al dente
2. Drain the shells , return them to the pot and toss with 1 teaspoon of the olive oil to prevent sticking
3. Meanwhile , in a large skillet , heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil
4. Add the garlic and cook over moderate heat until golden , about 4 minutes
5. Add the peas and ham and cook until the peas are hot and the ham in lightly browned , about 5 minutes
6. Add the cream and stock and simmer over moderate heat until thickened slightly , about 5 minutes
7. Stir the cream sauce into the shells
8. Add the parmesan and dill and season with salt and pepper to taste

title: barefoot contessa pork loin   ina garten
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
2. Allow the pork to stand at room temperature for 30 minutes
3. Place the pork , fat side up , in a roasting pan just large enough to hold it comfortably
4. In a small bowl , whisk together the olive oil , 2 teaspoons of each mustard , the fennel seed , 2 teaspoons salt , and 1 / 2 teaspoon black pepper
5. Rub the mixture on top of the pork and roast for 1 to 1 1 / 4 hours , until the internal temperature reaches 140 degrees f
6. Remove from the oven , transfer to a cutting board , and cover tightly with aluminum foil for 20 minutes
7. For the sauce , remove all but 1 / 4 cup of fat from the roasting pan
8. If there isn't 1 / 4 cup , add enough butter to the pan to make 1 / 4 cup total
9. Over medium heat , whisk the flour into the fat in the pan and cook for 1 minute
10. Add the wine and scrape up all the brown bits from the bottom of the pan
11. Add the chicken stock , the remaining 2 teaspoons of each mustard , the green peppercorns , 2 teaspoons salt , and 1 / 2 teaspoon black pepper
12. Bring to a boil , then lower the heat to a simmer for 5 to 10 minutes , until the sauce is reduced and slightly thickened
13. Remove the strings from the roast pork , slice between the bones , and serve warm with the hot sauce

title: 100  whole grain bread with biga soaker
steps:
1. Mix the biga ingredients , cover and let rest for 1 hour at room temperature
2. Then , refrigerate for 3 to 18 hours
3. Mix the soaker , cover and rest for 4 to 19 hours
4. To make the bread , warm the biga at room temperature or in low heat until room temperature
5. Spread the biga on a floured counter and layer the soaker over that
6. Cut dough into 12 pieces and add to mixing bowl
7. Add the remaining ingredients and mix and knead for 7 - 8 minutes
8. Rest for 5 minutes and knead for 1 to 2 more minutes until a moderate windowpane is achieved
9. Do a stretch and fold
10. On a lightly floured counter , stretch the dough into a rectangle and fold it like a letter going into an envelope
11. Turn 90 deg and fold again
12. Invert and place in an oiled bowl or straight sided clear container
13. Rest for 20 minutes and do another stretch and fold and return to container
14. After the dough has risen to one and a half times it's original volume , turn out onto a floured counter
15. Shape into loaves and pan
16. Let rise , covered with oiled plastic , for 45 minutes or so or until loaves are risen to 150% of their volume
17. Bake in preheated 375f oven until 190-200f internally , about 35-40 minutes
18. Cool on rack before slicing

title: quick pickles
steps:
1. Stir sugar in the vinegar until dissolved
2. Add salt , celery salt , and dill seed , mixing together
3. Pour over cucumbers and onions
4. Stir and push under liquid
5. Let stand for 24 hours
6. Put in jars and refrigerate
7. No need to can , just keep in refrigerator
8. They will keep indefinetely in refrigerator

title: indian turkey cutlets
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. Grate 1 teaspoon peel from 1 lime and squeeze 1 tablespoon juice
3. Cut remaining lime into wedges
4. Reserve for squeezing juice over cooked cutlets
5. In a large bowl , mix lime peel and juice , yogurt , vegetable oil , ginger , cumin , coriander , garlic and salt
6. Just before cooking add turkey cutlets to the yogurt mixture and stir to cover cutlets
7. Do not let cutlets marinate more than 15 minutes or the texture will become mealy
8. Broil 2 1 / 2 minutes on each side , 5 minutes total
9. Serve with lime wedges and steamed rice

title: banana cake with poppy and lemon cream
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f grease and flour a round pan of 9 inches
2. In the food processor or the way you want , reduce in a puree the bananas , buttermilk and vanilla
3. Set aside
4. In a bowl , cream the butter and sugar for 2 minutes with a mixer
5. Add egg and beat well
6. Add dry ingredients alternating with the banana mixture
7. Mix at medium speed for 1 1 / 2 minute
8. Pour the dough in the pan and cook in the center of oven for about 40 minutes
9. Remove from oven
10. Let rest 5 minutes and unmold on a rack
11. Whisk the cream until is is thick while adding sugar
12. Add poppy seeds and lemon zest , mix and put on the cold cake
13. Garnish with banana slices

title: fabulous ham bone and lentil soup
steps:
1. In a dutch oven , bring ham bone and water to a boil
2. Reduce heat and cover and simmer for 1 1 / 2 hours
3. To broth , add lentils , tomatoes , carrots , celery , onions , and seasonings and bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat and cover and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes or until lentils and vegetables are tender
5. Meanwhile , remove ham from bone and coarsely chop
6. Add ham and parsley to soup and heat through

title: roasted tomato bruschetta
steps:
1. Heat the oven to 400 degrees
2. In a medium bowl , combine the tomatoes , 2 tablespoons of the olive oil , salt and pepper
3. Toss to coat evenly
4. Transfer the tomatoes , along with any oil in the bowl , to a rimmed baking sheet
5. Roast for 35 minutes , or until the tomatoes are lightly browned and wrinkled
6. While the tomatoes roast , in a small saucepan over medium heat , bring the balsamic vinegar to a simmer and let reduce by half
7. Set aside
8. During the final 10 minutes of roasting , place the bread on one of the oven racks and toast until just lightly browned
9. Remove the tomatoes and bread from the oven and let the tomatoes cool slightly
10. While the tomatoes cool , rub the toasted bread with the garlic
11. Slather a generous layer of ricotta on each slice of bread , then arrange the slices on a serving platter
12. Top each with some of the tomatoes
13. Sprinkle with fresh thyme , then finish with a drizzle of the reduced balsamic vinegar and remaining olive oil

title: goombay fruit salad
steps:
1. Slash the cataloupe down the section lines , but do not cut as far as the base
2. Carefully open like a flower and scoop out the seeds and some of the flesh
3. Drain off the juice and preserve in a small bowl
4. Chill the cantaloupe and juice for 1 hour
5. Peel the bananas , slice and dip into the lime juice
6. Peel the tangerines , cut into segments and remove the seeds
7. Cut the papaya in half , remove the seeds and dice the flesh
8. Peel the mongoes
9. Cut the flesh off the seeds and slice , preserving the juice
10. Strain the melon juce
11. Mix with the sugar , adding the rum and blending well
12. Set a few strawberries aside for decoration
13. Mix all of the fruits together with juices and chill
14. Just before serving , fill the cantaloupe wth some of the furit salad , place onto a serving platter and arrange the remaining fruit around the base decorating with the strawberries

title: indian carrot rice
steps:
1. Cook the basmati rice , according to package directions
2. While rice is cooking , heat oil in skillet , add mustard seeds and when they start to sputter , add cashews
3. Cook until cashews are lightly browned
4. Add onion and jalapenos
5. Cook until onion is golden
6. Add tumeric , chili powder and salt
7. Cook 1 minute
8. Add carrots and 1 tbsp water
9. Cover and cook until carrots are soft
10. Add lemon juice , stir and then fold in peas and rice
11. Serve with cilantro leaves sprinkled on top

title: painted toast
steps:
1. Fill 5 shallow glasses with a 1 / 4 cup of milk in each
2. Take your 5 food colorings and in each glass put 5 drops of food coloring in the milk and stir till color shows
3. Use a small paint brush and dip the brush into the food coloring
4. Then take a piece of bread and paint a face or picture of choice on it
5. Place the bread into a toaster and wait till the bread is lightly toasted
6. Butter lightly to give taste
7. Enjoy your masterpiece !

title: grilled citrus steak
steps:
1. In a bowl combine all wet ingredients
2. Pour 1 cup of the marinade into a resealable plastic bag
3. Add steak and marinate 6-8 hours , turning bag occasoinally
4. Grill steak to desired level of doneness , basting occasionally with the reserved marinade

title: any fruit cobbler pie
steps:
1. Put margarine or butter in 15 x 9-inch pan
2. Put pan in oven until butter melts
3. Add sugar and mix in pan with butter
4. Add bisquick in same pan
5. Add the milk and mix well
6. Pour fruit over the bisquick
7. Do not mix
8. Bake at 375 degrees for 1 hour

title: egg salad sandwich  diabetic
steps:
1. Cut each egg in half
2. Carefully remove the yolks
3. Discard one yolk
4. In a small bowl , mash the remaining egg yolk
5. Add the sour cream , pickle relish , mayonnaise , mustard , and salt
6. Stir to mix well
7. Stir in the celery
8. Chop the egg whites and stir them into the yolk mixture
9. Spread the mixture on each slice of bread
10. Serve as open-faced sandwiches
11. If desired , garnish with a light sprinkling of paprika
12. Serving size: 1 / 3 cup egg salad with 1 bread slice
13. Exchanges per serving: 1 medium-fat meat , 1 starch
14. Nutrition facts: calories 148
15. Calories from fat 62
16. Total fat 7g
17. Saturated fat 2g
18. Cholesterol 215mg
19. Sodium 296mg
20. Carbohydrate 14g
21. Dietary fiber 3g
22. Sugars 4g
23. Protein 9g

title: yummy coffee
steps:
1. Pour coffee in a cup
2. Put in sugar and add creamer
3. Then you stir that up , and finally , you add your whipped cream to the top
4. But don't stir it up

title: buttermilk and chive mashed potatoes
steps:
1. In a saucepan , cook potatoes in salted boiling water until tender , about 15 minutes
2. Drain
3. With a mash potatoes , mash the potatoes with the butter
4. Then with an electric mixer , reduce the mixture to a puree with the buttermilk and chive
5. Add salt and pepper

title: pirate s booty
steps:
1. Make sure you have your pirate first
2. Take the icecream out of the freezer , and allow the icecream to thaw slightly by leaving out at room temperature for about 20 minutes
3. Dump the icecream into a large bowl
4. Pour kahlua over icecream , then pour the chocolate sauce - all of it - over the icecream
5. Sprinkle with almonds , then dispense about 1 / 2 the can of whipped cream over the almonds
6. Save the rest of the can for the pirate
7. Cook time is relative --
8. )

title: gulab jamuns
steps:
1. Bring the water , rose water and sugar to boil , add the saffron , remove from heat and set aside
2. Mix the milk powder , flour , soda , heavy cream well and knead until a soft dough is made
3. Take a teaspoon of the dough , place one cardamom seed in it and make a small ball
4. Similarly make the balls with the remaining dough , and fry them when the ghee is ready until golden brown
5. Remove with a slotted spoon and transfer into the syrup , which should be quite warm
6. Serve these delicious gulab jamuns with hot syrup and garnished with almonds or pistachio

title: artichoke hearts with garlic  olive oil and parsley
steps:
1. Heat oil in heavy large skillet over medium heat
2. Add garlic and 1 tablespoon parsley
3. Stir 30 seconds
4. Add artichokes and stir to coat
5. Cover skillet , simmer until arichokes are tender , about 12 minutes
6. Uncover , simmer until juices thicken and coat artichokes , stirring occasionally , about 2 minutes
7. Season with salt and pepper
8. Transfer to bowl
9. Sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon parlsley

title: spaghetti with spicy eggplant
steps:
1. Spaghetti and spicy eggplant:
2. Place eggplant in colander , sprinkle with salt , and let rest for one hour
3. Pat eggplant dry
4. In a large skillet , heat 1 / 4 cup olive oil on high
5. Add in one layer of eggplant and cook until crispy on one side
6. Do not stir
7. Turn to crisp other side
8. Eggplant will shrink and crisp
9. Repeat until all the eggplant is crispy
10. In a wide pot , heat 1 / 4 cup olive oil , add diced tomatoes and peppers , and cook on high , stirring , for about 3 minutes
11. Lower heat , add garlic , and cook for 2 more minutes
12. Add eggplant and salsa rossa , and cook , stirring gently a couple of times
13. Add basil italian seasoning , red pepper flakes , oregano , and parsley
14. In a large pot , bring salted water to boil and cook spaghetti until al dente
15. Drain , reserving 2 cups cooking water
16. Add pasta to sauce and cook over high heat 2 to 3 minutes , adding a little pasta water if needed to keep everything juicy
17. Serve with shaved parmigiano , a nice salad and why not some chianti ?
18. Salsa rossa:
19. Heat the olive oil in a skillet
20. Add tomatoes , garlic , and red pepper flakes , and saut until tomatoes are soft
21. Stir in fresh basil , and add salt and pepper to taste
22. Puree or leave chunky

title: bruce s crock pot pepperoncini roast sandwich
steps:
1. Place roast , pepperoncini peppers with stems removed and de-juiced , minced garlic
2. Cook for 8 hours on low or until the beef falls apart
3. Place some meat on a sub roll , topped with cheese
4. You can really use any cheese you want

title: he proposed   red velvet cake
steps:
1. In a large bowl add flour , baking soda , baking powder , salt & cocoa powder
2. Whisk until well combined
3. Set aside
4. In a separate large bowl , add sugar and oil
5. Mix until combined
6. Add in eggs , buttermilk , vanilla & red food coloring
7. Stir until combined
8. Next add in the coffee & vinegar
9. Stir until combined
10. Next add in the coffee & vinegar
11. Stir until combined
12. Pour the flour mixture into the sugar mixture a little at a time
13. Beating until well combined
14. Pour the batter into 2 greased & flour 9 inch round cake pans
15. Bake for 30-40 minutes at 350 or until toothpick inserted into center comes out clean
16. Another way to check for doneness is to lightly press the cake on top , if it springs back then it is done , if the dent remains in the cake then it is not done
17. Do not overbake
18. When the cakes are done let them cool in the pan for about 10-15 minutes
19. Then remove them from the pan and let them finish cooling on a wire rack

title: traditional pico de gallo
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in medium bowl
2. Season to taste with additional lime juice , salt or pepper , if desired
3. Store , covered , in refrigerator until ready to use

title: reindeer dust food
steps:
1. Place oatmeal in a small zip-lock baggie
2. Add a small amt of glitter and attach the following saying: sprinkle on the lawn at night
3. The moon will make it sparkle bright
4. Santa's reindeer fly and roam
5. This will guide them to your home
6. Variation: here is a different version using bird seeds
7. Place seed in baggie with glitter and attach the following: it is the night before christmas and since you always feed santa claus now feed his reindeer
8. Sprinkle contents of the bag on the front and / or lawn on christmas eve

title: sweet potato carrot bisque
steps:
1. Put both carrots and sweet potato into large kettle with the chicken broth and simmer until the veggies are tender , adding water if needed to keep veggies covered
2. Saute onion in butter
3. When onion is translucent add to pot of veggies
4. Cool mixture for 15 minutes
5. Place mix into blender 2 cups at a time and puree until smooth
6. When all of mixture is pureed , add spices and blend
7. Simmer about 15 minutes
8. Blend in yogurt right before serving
9. Serve with toppings on the side

title: double corn kugel
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix dry ingredients in a bowl
3. Mix cheese , yogurt , sour cream and corn in a separate bowl
4. Cream butter and sugar in a separate large bowl
5. Add egg yolks and beat until smooth
6. Add dry ingreds and cheese mixture alternately , mixing well
7. Beat eggwhites and fold into batter
8. Pour into a baking dish , bake 40 minutes until set

title: spicy season salt
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Store in air tight container

title: venison lasagne  or beef
steps:
1. Cook lasagne noodles according to package directions
2. Drain and set aside
3. For meat sauce: in a large saucepan or skillet , scramble-fry meat , onion , and garlic until meat is brown and onion is tender
4. Drain fat
5. Stir in crushed tomatoes , tomato sauce and paste and seasonings
6. Bring to a boil
7. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. For cheese filling: combine egg , cottage cheese , 1 / 4 cup parmesan cheese , and parsley
9. Layer half lasagne noodles in a lightly greased 9x13 pan
10. Spread with half the meat sauce and then half the cheese filling
11. Repeat layers
12. Sprinkle remaining parmesan cheese on top and additional grated mozzarella , if desired
13. Bake at 375f for 30-35 minutes and let stand 10 minutes before serving

title: poached salmon swimming on fennel with saffron and clams
steps:
1. Saute fennel and garlic in olive oil for 8-10 minutes till tender and lightly golden
2. Add saffron and toss to release the beautiful yellow color and aroma
3. Add clam juice , wine , and clam juice for can clam sauce bring to simmer
4. Place fillet on top of fennel mixture and spoon some of the mixture on top and cover pan
5. Simmer low heat a barely simmer for 10 minutes
6. Less time if very thin fillets
7. Add white clam sauce heat 2 minutes
8. Adjust seasoning
9. Garnish with the fronds of the fennel and serve over mashed potatoes , rice or pasta with lots of crisp bread to soak up the juice

title: my mom s oatmeal cake
steps:
1. Bring to a boil water and quick oats
2. Let stand 15 mins
3. Cream together 1 / 2 cup butter or margarine , brown sugar , white sugar and 2 well beaten eggs
4. Mix with oatmeal
5. Sift together flour , baking soda , cinnamon , and salt
6. Add to mix and beat well
7. Pour into a 13 x 9 in
8. Baking pan
9. Bake 350 degrees f 30 to 35 mins
10. Frosting mix together melted butter or margarine , canned cream or milk , vanilla , and brown sugar
11. Spread on cake brown in oven for a few mins
12. Can add rasins or cocconut

title: 5 minute chocolate lava cake
steps:
1. In a microwave-safe 2-cup measure , stir together a heaping 1 / 3 cup granulated sugar , 1 / 2 cup king arthur unbleached all-purpose flour , 1 teaspoon baking powder , 1 / 4 teaspoon salt , and 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder
2. Add 6 tablespoons milk , and a teaspoon of vanilla
3. Stir till smooth
4. Mix 2 tablespoons brown sugar , 1 tablespoon granulated sugar , 1 tablespoon cocoa , and 3 tablespoons hot or cold coffee
5. Pour into the cup
6. Gently swirl it in
7. Dont mix thoroughly
8. Cook in the microwave for 2 1 / 2 to 3 minutes , depending how powerful your microwave is
9. When done , itll look set on top , and kind of mushy around the edges
10. Turn the cake onto a plate
11. Itll be layered with well , lets call it sauce
12. Its actually semi-baked batter , but since there are no eggs in here , its fine

title: mini hot ham   swiss sandwiches
steps:
1. Put ham and swiss cheese on small buns
2. Spread with sauce
3. Put in baking dish
4. Cover with foil
5. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes

title: slow cooker southwestern chicken and beans
steps:
1. Rinse and sort beans
2. Place in medium bowl
3. Add enough cold water to cover
4. Let stand overnight
5. Drain beans and rinse
6. Place beans and next 7 ingredients into a 4 quart slow cooker and mix well
7. Cook on high for 6 to 8 hours or until chicken is no longer pink and beans are tender
8. Sprinkle with cilantro and serve

title: fresh orange rice
steps:
1. Remove the zest from the orange and measure out up to 2 tablespoons , if desired
2. Mince and set aside
3. To garner the maximum amount of juice from your oranges , with a sharp knife pierce the oranges about 5-6 times and microwave for 30 seconds
4. Juice the orange and measure out 3 / 4 cup
5. More or less according to your preference
6. You may need to juice another orange if two oranges don't yield enough juice
7. Remember that for 2 cups of rice you will need 4 cups of liquid in whatever ratio you choose
8. Place the rice in a pan along with the water , salt and orange juice
9. Do not add the zest in with the rice while it is cooking or the rice will turn bitter
10. Cover pan , bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer about 20-25 minutes or until liquid is absorbed
11. Remove pan from stove
12. Fluff rice with a fork and stir in the zest
13. Let stand covered for a few minutes then serve
14. Garnish with orange slices if desired

title: white chocolate peppermint scones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Lightly spray a baking sheet with nonstick baking spray with flour
3. In a large bowl , sift together flour , 1 / 3 cup sugar , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
4. Using a pastry blender , cut in butter until mixture is crumbly
5. Stir in white chocolate morsels and peppermint baking chips
6. In a small bowl , whisk together buttermilk , egg yolk , vanilla extract and peppermint extract
7. Add buttermilk mixture to flour mixture
8. Mix until dough comes together in moist clumps
9. Gather dough into a ball and knead for 2 to 3 turns
10. Place on a lightly floured surface and pat to about 1 / 2-inch thickness
11. Using a 4-inch cutter , cut out dough
12. Transfer to prepared baking sheet , spacing 1 inch apart
13. Whisk 1 / 4 cup water with 1 egg and brush over tops of scones
14. Lightly sprinkle scones with remaining tablespoon of sugar
15. Bake scones for 18 to 20 minutes , or until light golden brown
16. Serve with candy cane cream , if desired
17. Candy cane cream:
18. In a medium bowl , beat cream and candy canes at medium speed with an electric mixer until medium peaks form
19. Garnish with mint leaf and crushed peppermint candies , if desired

title: blue cactus margaritas
steps:
1. To make prickley pear margarita mix:
2. In a blender add your bottle of margarita mix
3. I usually just cut the cactus pears in half and scoop out the pink flesh
4. Add the fruit's flesh to the blender and blend until smooth
5. Strain mixture through a fine sieve or rice strainer
6. Press the pulp down to get any remaining liquid out
7. I usually pour strained mix back into margarita mix bottle and use the little left in the bottom of the container to make my first drink
8. For each drink:
9. Fill shaker half full of ice
10. Add 2 oz tequila , 3 / 4 oz blue curacao and the juice of half a lime
11. Shake well and strain into a 12 ounce glass that's been dipped in margarita salt and packed with ice
12. Pour prickly pear margarita mix to the top and serve
13. Garnish with lime
14. Should make about 8 drinks

title: seafood enchiladas
steps:
1. To toast walnuts , place in a shallow baking pan
2. Bake at 350f for 15 to 20 minutes or until walnuts are lightly browned , stirring occasionally
3. Cool
4. In large skillet , saute onions in butter until they become transparent
5. Remove from heat and add chilies , crab , shrimp , walnuts , and olives
6. Combine cheeses , reserving 1 1 / 2 cups of the cheese mixture for top of casserole
7. Stir remaining cheese into seafood mixture
8. In medium skillet , heat 1 / 4 inch oil
9. Fry tortillas , one a time , just long enough to soften , about 30 seconds
10. Drain on paper towels
11. Fill each tortilla with seafood filling , roll up and place seam side down in a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish
12. In medium saucepan , combine the half and half , sour cream , butter , oregano , salt and garlic powder , stirring constantly over medium heat until lukewarm and well blended
13. Remove from heat and pour sauce over enchiladas
14. Sprinkle enchiladas with reserved cheese
15. Bake at 350f for 30 minutes or until bubbly
16. Allow to set 5 minutes before serving

8. Combine buttermilk with baking soda and stir into mixture in pan
9. Stir in cornmeal , flour , and salt until well blended and few lumps remain
10. Pour batter into the prepared pan

title: gramma connie s hot fudge sauce
steps:
1. In a saucepan over low heat melt the butter and chocolate chips
2. Once melted add the evaporated milk and powdered sugar
3. Mix well until smooth
4. Turn the heat to medium high and bring to a boil
5. Stir constantly
6. Once at a boil , reduce heat to medium low and boil slowly for 8 minutes , stirring constantly
7. Remove from the heat and add the vanilla
8. Stir well and cool
9. Can be served warm over ice cream or kept in the refrigerator for later use

title: crispy baked tilapia
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Toss first 5 ingredients in evoo and spread on cookie sheet
3. Put filets on top , season with salt and pepper
4. Spray fish with pam
5. Cover fish w / crumbs , pressing into fish
6. Bake 20 minutes

title: cold breakfast oatmeal
steps:
1. The night before your breakfast , mix oats , milk , cinnamon and sweetner together in a cereal bowl
2. If you are using frozen blueberries , add these the night before also
3. Cover with plastic wrap and place in the fridge overnight
4. In the morning , add your fresh berries and stir gently
5. Enjoy

title: hot cocoa sticky bundt
steps:
1. Cut the rolls in half and wrap each half around 1 teaspoon of chocolate chips , enclose completely
2. Roll each bundle in the cocoa mix until well coated
3. Layer in a 12-cup bundt pan that has been sprayed with non-stick cooking spray
4. Sprinkle pecans and toffee bits over each layer of rolls and finally sprinkle any remaining cocoa mix over all
5. Combine the butter and brown sugar in a bowl and microwave for 30 seconds , stir to combine and pour over rolls
6. Cover pan with plastic wrap and let rise almost to the top of the pan
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes , cover with foil last 10 minutes
8. Invert onto serving plate and enjoy
9. Please
10. This will depend on room temperature , altitude , etc

title: chicken baked with 40 cloves of garlic
steps:
1. Sealing dough:
2. Add the water , flour , salt and olive oil in a bowl
3. Stir to form a paste
4. Use the dough on the casserole to seal
5. Chicken:
6. Preheat the oven to 375f
7. Season the chicken with salt and pepper
8. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat
9. Carefully add the chicken pieces
10. Cook the chicken until golden brown on all sides
11. Remove chicken from the oil onto a kitchen towel to absorb excess fat
12. Discard the oil
13. Place the seared chicken pieces in a casserole that holds the chicken pieces snugly
14. Add the rosemary , thyme , bay leaves , wine and garlic
15. Place the lid on the casserole and seal with the sealing dough
16. Transfer the casserole to the oven
17. Bake for 2 hours
18. Remove from the oven and let cool slightly
19. Crack the sealing dough to open the lid
20. Carefully remove the chicken onto 4 large dinner plates
21. Divide the garlic and cooking juices and serve

title: microwaved bacon and eggs for one
steps:
1. Combine butter and onion in small microwave-safe dish and cook on high for three minutes or until onion is soft and then stir it to make it sure it is combined
2. Beat eggs with sour cream in a small cup or bowl and then pour over onion
3. Cook on high about 1 1 / 2 minutes , stirring several times
4. Sprinkle bacon along rim of dish and cook on high for 30 seconds

title: vodka sauce with penne
steps:
1. In a large frying pan , saute garlic in olive oil
2. Add the drained tomatoes , and bring to a boil
3. Add the vodka , and simmer for 5-10 minutes
4. Add the fish boullion , stir until dissolved
5. Add the cream and the tarragon
6. Simmer until thickened
7. Finish off with butter if desired
8. Toss with cooked pasta
9. Top with freshly grated parmesan cheese

title: mac and cheese with polish sausage  low fat
steps:
1. Bring a medium pot of lightly salted water to a full boil
2. Cut the sausage into 1 / 4-inch thick slices
3. Add the macaroni and the sausage to the pot and cook , stirring occasionally , until the macaroni is cooked al dente , about 5 to 6 minutes
4. Drain
5. Meanwhile , mix the flour with just enough milk to form a paste in a small bowl
6. Slowly add the remaining milk , stirring as you do , making sure to remove any lumps
7. Place a medium saucepan over medium heat
8. Pour the milk mixture into the saucepan
9. Stir in the salt
10. Add the cheese and continue to stir the mixture with a wooden spoon until the cheese is completely melted and the mixture starts to thicken
11. When the mixtue is almost smooth , stir in the cooked macaroni and sausage until it is well incorporated
12. Serve immediately

title: pork parcels
steps:
1. Preheat oven 190
2. Rip up 4 pieces of silver foil
3. Put a bit of butter on each and rub around in a circle
4. Place potato slices of the bottom of the foil
5. Place the thin sliced onions on top
6. Now place the pork on top on that
7. Add salt and pepper
8. Place a layer of mushrooms
9. Place on top one more layer of potatoes
10. Put a couple of drops of lemon on top
11. Bring the edges of foil together and twist shut
12. Bake 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours

title: pumpkin cheesecake a la martha stewart
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Place gingersnaps in the bowl of a food processor , and process until finely ground
3. Add pecans , melted butter , sugar , and cinnamon
4. Process just until combined and the mixture holds together
5. Transfer the cookie mixture to a 9-inch nonstick springform pan , and pat out evenly to make the crust , lining the sides of the pan about 1 1 / 2 inches of the way up
6. Bake for 10 minutes
7. Cool completely on a wire rack
8. In a small bowl , whisk together flour , ginger , cinnamon , and nutmeg
9. Set aside
10. In another bowl , beat the cream cheese and sugar on medium speed until light and fluffy , about 2 minutes
11. Add pumpkin , bourbon , vanilla , and flour mixture
12. Beat to combine
13. Add eggs , one at a time , beating to incorporate after each addition
14. Pour batter into prepared crust
15. Wrap the outside of the springform pan with a double layer of aluminum foil
16. Place in a roasting pan
17. Add enough hot water to come halfway up the sides of the springform pan
18. Bake until cake is set in the center , about 1 hour and 45 minutes
19. Remove from water , and cool on a wire rack
20. Remove foil , and refrigerate for at least 4 hours and up to overnight
21. Serve with whipped cream , if you'd like

title: ginger lime salmon
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Rub a 10 ounce skinless salmon fillet with just enough olive oil to coat
3. Place in a 10-inch nonstick skillet with an ovenproof handle
4. Season with salt and pepper , a squeeze of lemon or lime , and freshly grated ginger or garlic to taste
5. Bake 12-15 minutes or until firm to the touch or to your liking

title: brussels sprouts  n potatoes
steps:
1. For the brussels sprouts , make sure they are cleaned and x on the stem , or cut in half if large
2. Melt butter in a skillet and over medium heat cook the onions and the potatoes with the bay leaf , stirring often until the onion is tender 2-3 minutes
3. Add brussels sprouts and stock
4. Cover and cook for about 8 minutes
5. Add red pepper cook 2 minutes or until the potatoes and sprouts are tender and the red pepper is still crisp
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Remove bay leaf
8. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve
9. For vegetarian , use the water not the chicken stock

title: pumpkin   leek risotto
steps:
1. Cook the pumpkin and leek in the 100ml vegetable stock in a large heavy based pot until the leek has wilted and the liquid almost gone
2. Transfer the vegetable mix to a bowl
3. Heat the oil in the pot and add the rice
4. Fry until the rice becomes translucent
5. Add the wine and cook over medium heat , stirring until the liquid is almost gone
6. Progressively add the remaining stock in 250ml lots , returning the rice to the boil after each addition and then lowering the heat to a steady simmer , stirring as you go
7. There is no need to stir continuously , just enough to stop the rice sticking to the bottom of the pan
8. Don't add more stock until the liquid from the previous addition has almost been absorbed
9. Add the peas with the third addition of stock
10. Add the pumpkin mixture with the last addition of stock
11. The dish is ready when the rice is aldente and the mixture is a little wet
12. Add the pesto and cheese and stir for a minute
13. Let the risotto sit , covered , for five minutes and serve with shaved parmesan and freshly ground black pepper

title: broccoli tomatoes
steps:
1. Steam the broccoli in a small amount of water for about 3 minutes
2. Drain well
3. Combine broccoli with cheddar , breadcrumbs , celery , mayo , and salt
4. Take the stem off the top of each tomato
5. Carefully cut 5 wedges in each tomato without cutting all the way through the bottom - the wedges should stay connected at the bottom
6. Spoon equal amounts of the broccoli filling into each tomato
7. Gently press the wedges back toward the center of the tomato
8. Sprinkle each with some of the parmesan cheese
9. Place tomatoes in a shallow pan and bake at 325 degrees for about 25 minutes

title: german chocolate cake
steps:
1. Grease the bottom of 3 pans or one 9x13 pan
2. In a microwave proof bowl melt the chocolate and water on high for 1 1 / 2-2 minutes or until chocolate is almost melted , stirring after each minute
3. Stir until chocolate is completely melted
4. Mix flour , baking soda , and salt
5. Set aside
6. Beat butter and sugar in large bowl with electric mixer till light and fluffy
7. Add egg yolks , one at a time , beating well after each addition
8. Stir in chocolate mixture and vanilla
9. Add flour mixture alternately with buttermilk , beating well after each addition
10. In another bowl , beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form
11. Gently stir into batter and pour evenly into pans
12. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean
13. Cool for 15 minutes and remove from pans
14. Frost with coconut-pecan frosting

title: chicken and rice wraps
steps:
1. Cook brown rice for 20min
2. In another pot add chicken , enchilada sauce , and seasoning mix
3. Bring to a boil
4. Add rice when fully cooked to pot with chicken in it and stir together
5. Spoon mixture into tortillas and serve

title: easy chocolate chip cake
steps:
1. Pour water over oatmeal and let stand for 10 minutes
2. Add sugars and margarine and mix well
3. Add eggs and mix
4. Add dry ingredients except chips and mix
5. Add 1 / 2 of the chocolate chips
6. Pour batter into greased 9x13 pan
7. Top with the remaining chocolate chips
8. Bake at 350f for 40 minutes

title: gourmet grilled cheese sandwich milan style
steps:
1. Mix the sliced olives and sliced roasted red peppers in a bowl with garlic and cilantro or green onion
2. Sprinkle 4 slices of bread with half of the cheese and then top with the pepper-olive mixture
3. Apply the remaining cheese as another layer
4. Top with a second piece of bread and press together
5. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet and gently brown the sandwiches , turning once or twice as the cheese melts and holds the bread together
6. Some of the cheese will ooze out and crisp in the skillet , which is delicious , even if it burns slightly
7. Serve hot , on a paper napkin lined plate to absorb the excess cooking fat
8. Enjoy !

title: beef  beet and cabbage soup  crock pot and ww
steps:
1. In a large skillet over medium high heat heat the oil and then add the beef , cooking until browned
2. Transfer beef to slow cooker
3. Add onions to skillet and cook until softened
4. Transfer to slow cooker with the remainder of the ingredients
5. Cover and cook on low for 8-10 hours
6. Remove bay leaf and serve

title: chocolate hazelnut truffles
steps:
1. Place the cream and chocolate in a medium heatproof , microwave-safe bowl
2. Heat , uncovered , stirring every minute , for 2 minutes or until smooth
3. Stir in the spread until well combined
4. Cover with plastic wrap and place in the fridge for 1 hour or until firm enough to roll into balls
5. Place the slivered almonds in a shallow bowl and line a tray with non-stick baking paper
6. Scoop out a teaspoonful of the chocolate mixture and use your hands to roll it into a ball
7. Roll the truffle ball in the almonds until it is completely covered and then place it on the lined tray
8. Repeat with remaining chocolate mixture
9. Refrigerate for 45 minutes or until firm and set

title: crock pot   dulce de leche
steps:
1. Remove the label from the cans of sweetened condensed milk
2. Place the cans on their side inside the crock pot
3. Fill the crock pot with water so that there is at least an inch of water covering the top of the cans
4. Make sure that there is always enough water completely covering the cans
5. Set the crock pot on low and cook the cans in water for 8 hours
6. When cooking is complete let the cans cool until they are room temperature
7. Do not open the cans when they are hot , because there is the potential chance for explosion
8. Warning: make sure your cans are not dented or damaged in anyway
9. Using a damaged can could lead to problems when cooking
10. What i love about this recipe is that you can start it before you go to work and 8 hours later you have the perfect base to a variety of dessert possibilities !

title: fajita salad with creamy cilantro lime sauce
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients for cilantro-lime sauce , and stir well with a whisk
2. Cover sauce , and chill
3. Combine first 6 ingredients olive oil to black pepper in a medium bowl
4. Add chicken
5. Toss to coat
6. Place a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium heat until hot
7. Add chicken mixture
8. Saut 8 minutes or until chicken is done
9. Set aside
10. Divide lettuce and next 6 ingredients among 4 bowls
11. Top with chicken mixture
12. Serve with creamy cilantro-lime sauce

title: mashed sweet potatoes with pecans
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Peel potatoes and chop into medium-sized chunks
3. Cover with water in a large pot and boil until pieces are easily pierced with a fork
4. While sweet potatoes cook , spread the pecans on a cookie sheet and place in oven to toast
5. When potatoes are done , drain and add buttermilk , margarine , and spices and mash together
6. Use your blender or immersion blender to whip them smooth
7. Spray your serving dish lightly with pam and put the potatoes in it
8. Top with the toasted pecans

title: brownie puddle
steps:
1. -------------brownie-----------
2. Lightly grease a 9 1 / 2 inch tart pan with a removable bottom , line with parchment , and then lightly spray with baker's joy or nonstick vegetable spray
3. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
4. Place pecans on a cookie sheet and toast them , stirring occasionally , for about 10 minutes or just until the color deepens slightly
5. Cool completely
6. In a double boiler over hot water or in microwave-proof bowl , melt the butter and chocolate , stirring two or three times
7. If using a double boiler , transfer the mixture to a bowl
8. Beat the cocoa , then the sugar , into the chocolate mixture , beating until incorporated
9. Beat in the eggs and vanilla
10. When incorporated , beat in the cream cheese until only small bits remain
11. Add the flour and salt and mix only until the flour is fully moistened
12. Stir in the nuts
13. Place the prepared tart pan on a cookie sheet to catch any possible leaks
14. Scrape the batter into the pan and spread it evenly
15. It will fill the pan almost to the top
16. Bake for 30-35 minutes or until the batter has set
17. A toothpick inserted 1 inch from the side should come out clean
18. The mixture will puff and rise a little above the sides but sinks on cooling
19. -------------ganachepuddle-----------
20. While the brownie is baking , prepare the puddle
21. Melt the chocolate in a double- boiler over hot but not simmering water , stirring occasionally , or in a microwave , using 15-second bursts on high power and stirring several times
22. Add the cream and stir gently until the mixture is smooth and dark
23. As soon as the brownie is removed from the oven , grease the end of a wooden spoon and insert it into the brownie at 1-inch intervals , all the way to the bottom , twisting slightly as you insert and withdraw it , to create 23 to 28 holes
24. Using a small spoon or a reclosable freezer bag with a small piece cut off one corner , fill the holes with the ganahe until slightly rounded on top
25. Place the pan on a wire rack and cool completely
26. The chocolate puddles will sink in as the brownie cools and more ganache can be added to fill in any depressions as long as the brownie is still warm enough to melt it
27. Unmold the tart
28. When puddles are firm to the touch , cover a flat plate with plastic wrap , spray ti lightly with nonstick vegetable spray , and set it on top of the tart
29. Inver the tart , peel off the parchment , and reinvert it onto a serving plate
30. To serve , use a sharp knife to cut wedges

title: chicken mediterranean cruise
steps:
1. Shake chicken thighs in a plastic bag with flour , salt and pepper
2. Keep unused flour in the bag
3. With a medium heat , saute chopped bacon in 2 t olive oil until lightly browned in a frying pan
4. Remove bacon pieces and place in a crock pot
5. Keep oil in the pan
6. Saute chicken pieces in the same frying pan 3 minutes each side until lightly browned
7. Do not overcook
8. Remove chicken pieces and place in a crock pot
9. In the same frying pan , saute leek , green pepper , celery , and garlic for 2-3 minutes
10. Add remaining flour from the bag
11. Saute 2 more minutes
12. Place the mixture into the crock pot
13. Add sliced green olives , diced tomatoes and green chilies , canned fire roasted tomatoes or canned chopped tomatoes , lager beer , basil , paprika , sugar , 1 tsp salt , and parmesan cheese
14. With a microplane grater or grater , grate 1 / 2 orange peel into the crock pot
15. Pare and section oranges and place the sectioned oranges into the crock pot
16. Cover the crock pot
17. Cook for 4 hours on medium heat
18. With regular crock , cook for 6 hours
19. Skim any fat floating on the surface
20. Serve over cooked white rice or simply serve with crusty well buttered country bread

title: lemon chocolate pudding
steps:
1. Preheat oven to a moderate temperature
2. Cream butter and sugar until pale in colour and fluffy in appearance
3. Add the eggs and beat well
4. Sift in the flour and fold in with the milk
5. Fold in the lemon zest and the chocolate
6. Spoon into a oven proof dish and sprinkle with the extra sugar
7. Combine water and lemon juice and pour over the top of the pudding
8. Bake 30 -40 minutes until pudding is brown and firm on top

title: banana peanut butter quick bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Either mash it all together , place in small casserole and bake 20 minutes
3. Or
4. Put everything except the oats in the food processor
5. Pour into casserole
6. Blend in the oats
7. Bake 20 minutes

title: ricotta parmesan pancakes
steps:
1. Place ricotta , egg yolk , butter , flour , parmesan , parsley , and pepper in mixing bowl
2. Whisk until completely blended
3. Heat vegetable oil in large nonstick skillet or on griddle over low heat
4. Drop batter by rounded tablespoons into skillet to make small pancakes
5. Cook until underside is golden , about 5 minutes
6. Turn and cook second side about 3 minutes
7. Keep warm on covered plate or serve

title: swiss melt mushroom burgers
steps:
1. Mix well the first 7 ingredients and form into twelve 1 / 4-inch thick patties
2. Melt the butter and saute the mushrooms lightly in it
3. Place on 6 of the patties
4. Top with remaining patties and seal edges
5. Broil or grill to desired doneness
6. Top with cheese
7. Place each patty on a slice of toasted bread and top with another slice of toast

title: barbecued lil  smokies
steps:
1. Place smokies in a 6-quart crock pot
2. Pour in barbecue sauce and water
3. Bring to a boil , then simmer
4. Serve once smokies plump up
5. Serve with potato chips

title: delicious carrots
steps:
1. Melt butter in a medium skillet over medium heat
2. Add onions and cook , stirring often , until soft and transparent
3. If butter begins to brown , reduce heat to medium-low
4. Add carrots and cook , stirring often , until tender , about 5 minutes for crisp-tender
5. Season with a dash of nutmeg and salt & pepper to taste

title: a 1 round steak  crock pot
steps:
1. Put scrubbed and quartered potatoes in crock pot
2. Mix mustard and a-1 sauce
3. Paint meat with a-1 sauce mixture
4. At this point you could put the whole thing in the fridge overnight and put it on to cook in the morning
5. When ready to cook , pour the beef broth over the top of the meat
6. Cook on low 6-8 hours , or high for 4-6
7. If you start with frozen meat , it will probably take the longer amount of time
8. I forgot to turn mine on until late , so i cooked it on high 2 hours , and then turned it back to low for another 3 hours and it was perfect

title: super bowl indiana succotash
steps:
1. Cut beans in rounds the size of corn
2. Cook with 1 / 4 teaspoon salt about 15 minutes or until tender , drain
3. Saute green onions and red pepper in butter until transparent
4. Add corn , 1 / 4 teaspoon salt , paprika , celery salt and sugar , then beans
5. Simmer succotash , covered , for about 10 minutes

title: jell o party punch
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , combine hot water , sugar and jell-o , stirring until dissolved
2. Set aside and let cool
3. Combine cold water , almond extract , pineapple and lemon juice in a large bowl and stir in cooled jell-o mixture
4. Freeze until about 3 hours before serving
5. To serve chop up partially defrosted mixture and combine punch with chilled soda or gingerale in a large punch bowl

title: creamy taco bean dip
steps:
1. In a small mixing bowl , combine sour cream , cream cheese and taco mix
2. Mix on medium speed till creamy
3. Stir in beans
4. Mix well
5. Spread in 12x8-inch baking dish
6. Sprinkle cheese over top
7. Bake at 350 for about 30 minutes or till thoroughly heated through
8. Serve with tortilla chips or your choice of chips

title: pineapple coconut squares
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Place pineapple in a strainer over a bowl
3. Reserve juice for another use
4. In a medium bowl beat the butter and sugar together until well blended
5. Stir in flour and salt until combined
6. Press into an ungreased 8 inch square baking pan
7. Press pineapple with a spoon to remove the remaining juice
8. Sprinkle pineapple evenly over crust
9. In a medium bowl beat the egg with brown sugar , coconut , vanilla and salt
10. Gently spread coconut mixture over pineapple , keeping pineapple in place as best as you can
11. Bake for 35 minutes or until topping is golden brown
12. Remove from oven and cool completely on a wire rack
13. Cut into squares

title: middle eastern tuna salad pitas
steps:
1. To prepare tuna salad:
2. Combine all ingredients except pitas , lettuce , and tomato in a medium-sized mixing bowl and stir well to mix
3. Taste and add salt and more cayenne , if desired
4. Salad can be prepared 1 day ahead
5. To store , cover and refrigerate
6. To assemble sandwiches: divide tuna salad equally and mound in pita pockets
7. Add several tomatoes slices and a lettuce leaf to each pocket
8. Arrange sandwiches in a basket or on a serving plate
9. Serve immediately

title: shepherd s pie potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 200c
2. Prick each potato 6 times with a skewer
3. Spray with oil and sprinkle with sea salt flakes
4. Bake for 1 hr or until tender
5. Cool
6. Cut each potato in half length ways and scoop out the flesh , leaving a 1cm-thick shell
7. Transfer flesh to a bowl and set aside
8. Spray inside of shells with oil
9. Bake for 15mins or until crisp and golden
10. Meanwhile , heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat
11. Add oil and mushrooms
12. Cook , stirring , for 5 minutes or until softened
13. Add mince and carrot
14. Cook for a further 4 minutes
15. Stir in tomatoes and bring to the boil
16. Reduce heat to medium-low
17. Cook for 2 minutes or until sauce has thickened
18. Season with salt & pepper
19. Add milk to reserve potato flesh and mash
20. Spoon mixture into potato shells
21. Top with mash mixture and sprinkle with parmesan
22. Spray with olive oil spray
23. Bake for 15 minutes or until cheese is golden
24. Serve

title: fettuccine greta garbo
steps:
1. Bring large pot of water to boil over high heat
2. When water is boiling , drop in pasta and boil until al dente
3. Drain and set aside
4. In a large pot over medium-high heat , heat butter and garlic
5. Stir and cook until butter has melted and garlic is aromatic
6. Add cooked pasta and smoked salmon
7. Using a fork or pasta tongs , stir until pasta and salmon are hot and well mixed
8. Add heavy cream
9. Cook , stirring frequently , until cream begins to thicken
10. Stir in parmesan cheese and green onions
11. Transfer to serving dish and serve at once , with additional cheese if you like

title: lemon velvet cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven 350f
2. Prepare 9x13-inch pan with nonstick spray
3. Set aside
4. Mix first 4 ingredients together with mixer for 10 minutes
5. Pour into prepared pan and bake 40 minutes
6. While baking , mix 3 glaze ingredients together
7. When cake is done , remove from oven & prick top all over using a fork
8. Immediately dribble glaze slowly while cake is still hot

title: raspberry cranberry bread
steps:
1. This recipe is for a regular size loaf
2. Set machine setting for "light" , if able
3. Add all ingredients as per machine instructions
4. Operate machine
5. Enjoy your loaf !

title: oven roasted chicken with new potatoes
steps:
1. Heat oven to 450
2. In small bowl , mix herbs , salt , pepper and oil
3. Place chicken , breast side down , in shallow roasting pan
4. Arrange potatoes around chicken in pan
5. Drizzle half of oil mixture over potatoes
6. Stir to mix
7. Bake 20 minutes
8. Remove pan from oven
9. Spoon some of the remaining oil mixture over chicken and potatoes
10. Stir potatoes
11. Turn breast side up
12. Return to oven
13. Bake 10 minutes longer
14. Remove pan from oven
15. Reduce oven temperature to 325
16. Drizzle remaining oil mixture over chicken and potatoes
17. Stir potatoes
18. Insert ovenproof meat thermometer so
19. Return to oven
20. Bake 40 to 50 minutes longer or until thermometer reads 180 and legs move easily when lifted or twisted and potatoes are tender

title: gingered rhubarb chutney
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat , and simmer 35 minutes or until thick
4. Serve warm or at room temperature
5. Will keep well in refigerator for weeks , or freeze remainder

title: tiramisu baked oatmeal
steps:
1. Mix all the above using only 1 tbs of the greek yogurt in an oven proof bowl
2. Sprinkle top with dash of cinnamon
3. Bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for 30 minutes
4. Mix remaining yogurt with sweetener of choice and add to top of oatmeal , and serve

title: ila s pear cake
steps:
1. Peel , core and slice pears
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
3. Butter an 8 inch baking dish
4. In a food processor , pulse 2 cups of flour with 3 / 4 cup of sugar , light brown sugar , baking powder and salt
5. Add the butter and pulse until the mixture resembles coarse meal
6. Add the egg and pulse just until combined
7. Turn the dough out onto a work surface and knead several times
8. Divide the dough roughly in half
9. Leave one piece slightly larger
10. Flatten into disks , wrap in plastic and refrigerate for 20 minutes
11. Wipe out the food processor
12. Add the almond paste , lemon juice , cinnamon , 2 tablespoons sugar and 1 tablespoon flour
13. Process until smooth
14. Scrape into a bowl and gently stir in the pear slices
15. On an unfloured work surface , roll out the larger piece of dough to an 11" square
16. Put the dough into the baking dish , pressing it three quarters of the way up the side
17. Spoon the pear filling into the cake pan in an even layer
18. Roll out the remaining dough to an 8 1 / 2" square
19. Set the dough on top of the pears and press the rim to seal
20. Bake for 55 minutes or until golden brown

title: pressure cooker carnitas
steps:
1. Throw all ingredients into the pressure cooker , stir and set it on high
2. Make sure there is extra liquid , you don't want your cooker to dry out !
3. Cook for 35-45 minutes depending on your cooker
4. Release steam according to your cooker's instructions
5. The meat should be falling apart by now , and there should be lots of liquid left
6. Drain and save the liquid , put the meat on a plate and shred it with two forks , or use a potato masher , the onion included
7. Place meat on a flat roasting pan and put it under the broiler in the oven for about 15 minutes , stirring often , and adding juice from the cooker to make sure it doesn't get too dry
8. It is done when it is a bit crispy , but not burned
9. Alternatively , after you shred the meat , you can heat oil in a large skillet and brown it , adding a bit of the meat juice after it is already well crispy
10. Serve with pico de gallo , tortillas , rice , and any fixin's you have on hand like guacamole , lettuce , cheese , etc
11. Hint-
12. For spicier carnitas , blend 3 / 4 cup of juice from cooking with 4 chipotles en adobo , or a fresh habenero , serrano , or jalapeno
13. Pour this over the meat before you put it under the broiler

title: huevos a la mexicana
steps:
1. Melt the butter with the oil in a deep skillet , add the onion and the peppers and saut until the onion is translucent
2. Add the tomato and the eggs , stirring constantly to prevent sticking until the eggs are done
3. Season to taste with salt

title: wine bar nut mix
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a bowl , toss the nuts with the maple syrup , olive oil , herbs and cayenne
3. Spread the nuts on a rimmed baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes
4. , stirring occasionally , until browned
5. Season the nuts with salt and pepper and toss frequently until cooled

title: quick to fix cheese calzone
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f
2. In a medium bowl , combine ricotta , mozzarella and garlic
3. Season to taste with salt and black pepper
4. Roll dough out to a 15" circle on a baking sheet that has been lightly dusted first with either flour or cornmeal
5. Spread cheese filling over 1 side of circle , to within 1-inch of the edge and then top with filling of your choice
6. Lift 1 side of dough and fold over so that it meets the other side , forming a half moon , and pinch the edges together to seal , using a fork to press edges together
7. Brush with olive oil and sprinkle some parmesan cheese over top , to taste
8. Cut a few slits in the top to allow steam to release
9. Bake 10-15 minutes , until puffed up golden brown
10. Let stand 5 minutes before slicing
11. Serve with some heated marinara sauce to dip , if desired

title: baked palak  spinach  and corn
steps:
1. Oven temp 160 c- 325 f
2. Heat oil , add the cumin
3. When it splutters , add the onions and stir-fry over high heat , till well covered with oil
4. Add the corn and palak and continue to stir-fry over high heat , to mix well
5. Add the flour , stir fry till slightly colored and add the milk , stirring continuously , till well blended
6. Add salt and black pepper and transfer on to an oven-proof serving dish
7. Sprinkle the cheese on top
8. Bake in a pre-heated oven for half an hour before serving
9. You can omit spinach and increase corn

title: apple pie with walnut streusel
steps:
1. To make topping: in a small bowl with your finger
2. Chill topping , covered
3. To make filling: peel and core apples
4. Cut apples into 1 / 2-inch wedges and in a bowl toss with remaining filling ingredients to coat
5. Preheat oven to 350f
6. Unfold dough in a 10-inch pie plate , easing to fit and letting dough overhang rim of skillet or pie plate
7. Spoon filling into shell and fold pastry overhang over filling , leaving center uncovered
8. Bake pie in middle of oven 1 hour and remove from oven
9. Crumble topping over center of pie , breaking up any large chunks
10. Brush crust with milk and sprinkle with sugar
11. Bake pie in middle of oven 30 minutes more , or until crust is golden and filling is bubbling
12. Cool pie on a rack
13. Serve pie warm or at room temperature with ice cream

title: rosella s corn salad
steps:
1. Mix corn , onion , bell pepper , cheddar cheese and jalapeo pepper well
2. For the dressing: mix the vinegar , sugar and mayonnaise and pour over the vegetable mixture
3. Mix well and refrigerate for several hours

title: cheesy smoked salmon appetizers
steps:
1. Lay a sheet of good quality baking paper or a double layer of aluminum foil on your bench top
2. Spread the salmon onto the paper to form a large square shape
3. Overlap each slice- there should be no gaps and you must be able to roll the salmon later and have the slices hold together
4. In a bowl mix all remaining ingredients
5. Spread this mixture over the salmon
6. Using the paper or foil
7. Roll the salmon
8. The cream cheese will end up in the centre of the salmon rolls
9. Refrigerate until required
10. Slice into approx one inch rolls
11. Sprinkle with extra finely chopped chives , or parsley

title: sous vide   pork tenderloin
steps:
1. Fill and preheat the sousvide supreme to 135f / 56
2. 5c
3. Rub the tenderloin with your favorite seasoning rub then put into a cooking pouch
4. Add a pat of butter and vacuum seal
5. Submerge the pouch in the water oven and cook for 3 hours
6. Remove from the pouch , save the juices to dress your slices of pork at serving
7. Sear the surface to caramelize on grill , on a high heat cast iron pan , or with a cooking torch

title: edible candles  decoration for banana bread  banoffee cheesecake
steps:
1. Cut each banana into 2 candle sticks
2. Do not do this step too far ahead or the banana will brown
3. Slice the sides of the strawberry so that you are left with a thick middle piece
4. Use a toothpick to fix the strawberry onto the banana

title: southern chicken breasts with sweet potatoes
steps:
1. In a large frying pan , heat oil over medium heat
2. Add chicken breast and cook until lightly browned , about 5 minutes per side
3. Drain on paper towels
4. Preheat oven to 350
5. Arrange chicken in a 13 by 9 inch baking dish
6. In a small bowl , combine evaporated milk , honey , salt , nutmeg and cloves
7. Pour over chicken
8. Bake 10 minutes
9. Remove from oven and arange sweet potatoes and raisins around chicken
10. Pour reserved 1 / 4 cup syrup over chicken
11. Return to oven and bake 40 minutes or until chicken is done

title: chicken   mushroom risotto
steps:
1. In a large pot heat oil and add mushrooms and chicken and cook through until cooked
2. Remove from pot
3. Using the same pot , add butter and saute onions and garlic in butter and leftover oil mixture until translucent
4. Add the rice and stir until the rice turns opaque - about two minutes
5. Add the wine , salt and pepper to the rice and stir frequently until the wine has been absorbed into the rice
6. Add 1 / 2 cup of the heated chicken stock and stir frequently until absorbed
7. The rice and broth should bubble gently
8. Continue to cook the rice , adding chicken stock 1 / 2 cup at a time and allowing the rice to absorb it before adding the next 1 / 2 cup
9. Cook rice this way until tender which should take about 25-30 minutes
10. Just before the last batch of stock has been absorbed into the rice , add the chicken and mushroom mixture back into the pot
11. Stir through
12. Add 1 / 2 cup of grated parmesan cheese , the parsley and the cream and stir through
13. Remove from heat when all the remaining stock has been absorbed and the risotto mix is a thick creamy consistency
14. Serve immediately
15. The remaining parmesan can be added to each serve if requested

title: pink tarragon cream dressing
steps:
1. Mix mayo , sour cream , sherry , tarragon , garlic powder , and tabasco until blended well
2. Add a few drops of food coloring to tint it slightly pink
3. If the dressing is too thick , you may thin it with a small amount of milk
4. Chill well before serving

title: lamb and artichoke stew  greek
steps:
1. Cut the lamb into 1 inch pieces
2. Clean the artichokes , placing them in a bowl filled with water and the lemon slices , so they dont discolor
3. Slice each artichoke heart in half
4. Pour the oil into a large saucepan and , over medium heat , saut the onion until translucent , about 5 minutes
5. Add the spring onions and cook for 3-4 minutes
6. Increase the heat to high and add the meat
7. Brown the meat until it becomes a rich , dark colour
8. Add the hot stock and , as soon as it comes back to the boil , lower the heat to medium , cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes
9. Add the artichokes , minced dill , juice and rind of 1 lemon , salt and pepper to taste
10. Cover again and simmer until the artichokes and the meat are very tender , about 15 minutes longer
11. Turn off heat
12. In a large bowl , whisk together the egg , yolk , lemon juice and corn flour
13. With a ladle , slowly add the hot stock from the meat / artichokes to the egg / lemon mixture , whisking constantly
14. When you have added all the stock , pour the egg / lemon sauce over the meat , shaking the pan to mix it thoroughly , let it thicken slightly for about 2 minutes , and serve

title: chocolate cappuccino
steps:
1. Beat the whipping cream and powdered sugar with an electric mixer on low speed until soft peaks form
2. Set aside
3. Spoon 1 tablespoon each chopped chocolate and peppermint candies into a coffee cup
4. Add hot espresso
5. Top with the whipped cream and chocolate curls
6. Serve at once
7. Makes 8 servings

title: hard rock cafe twisted mac   cheese by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Cook pasta following the directions on package
2. Drain
3. Combine milk , velveeta , cheddar cheese , jack cheese , cayenne pepper , and black pepper in saucepan
4. Cook over low heat until cheese is melted and sauce is smooth
5. Add pasta and roasted pepper to the pan , and then toss to coat the pasta
6. Combine the breadcrumbs , parmesan and parsley in a small bowl
7. Pour pasta into a serving bowl , and then sprinkle parmesan breadcrumbs over the top

title: carolyn s apple pudding cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Slice apples , with or without the peel , to fill a casserole dish
3. Sprinkle with brown sugar , cinnamon and water
4. In a medium bowl , mix flour , white sugar , baking soda , baking powder and salt
5. Set aside
6. In a small bowl or shaker , combine vanilla , egg , melted shortening and milk
7. Add to the flour mixture and beat until smooth , then pour over the apples
8. If desired , sprinkle with sugar cinnamon
9. Bake for 1 hour or until golden
10. Serve warm with a dollop of whipped cream

title: milkshake kaboom
steps:
1. Put ice and milk in blender and blend for 30-45 seconds
2. Add in banana and blend for 10-15 seconds or until mostly smooth banana
3. Add in ice cream of choice and kahluha or bailey's
4. Blend til texture is your style
5. Pour into large glass
6. Drizzle with chocolate or carmel syrup
7. Add whipped cream
8. Enjoy !

title: rum banana sauce
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , combine the brown sugar , butter , cream and maple syrup
2. Cook and stir over medium heat for 4-5 minutes or until sauce is smooth
3. Stir in bananas
4. Heat through
5. Remove from the heat
6. Stir in extract
7. Serve over ice cream

title: teriyaki portabella mushroom burger
steps:
1. Place crushed ginger and garlic in a 1 gallon size plastic locking bag
2. Add soy sauce , sweetener and oil to bag , seal and shake well
3. Clean portabello mushrooms by wiping off dirt with a clean damp cloth
4. Cut off stem end of mushrooms
5. Place mushrooms in bag with soy mixture , reseal and let stand about 15 minutes
6. Heat nonstick skillet on range on medium high heat
7. Remove mushrooms from bag and place cap side down in hot skillet
8. Cook 2 to 3 minutes and turn mushrooms
9. If the skillet is dry add some of the soy sauce from the bag
10. Continue cooking until the skillet is almost dry and sauce caramelizes on mushrooms
11. Remove skillet from heat
12. Optional: if you do not like the taste of raw onions , you may remove mushrooms from skillet and set aside
13. Add 1-2 tablespoons of canola oil to skillet on medium heat and sweat sliced onions until translucent and caramelized
14. To assemble the sandwich , spread mayonnaise on each half of the kaiser roll
15. Place 1 lettuce leaf , cut to fit the bun on one half
16. Place cheese slice on top of lettuce and then 1 tomato slice on top of the cheese
17. On the other half of the bun , place 1 portabella mushroom and either the cooked or raw onion slice on top of the mushroom
18. Put the two halves of the buns together and enjoy

title: sauteed oyster mushroom caesar salad
steps:
1. Dressing: combine the ingredients for the dressing in a food processor or blender
2. Blend until smooth
3. In a skillet , add the vegetable oil and saute the oyster mushrooms for 5 - 8 minutes or until tender and brown
4. Cool slightly
5. Toss the greens with enough dressing to coat
6. Divide among 6 plates and top with the sauted mushrooms
7. Sprinkle with the parmesan cheese

title: lazy lasagna bake
steps:
1. Brown beef with onion , garlic and salt
2. Drain
3. Stir in spaghetti sauce , simmer until heated
4. Remove 1 cup meat sauce & set aside
5. Stir noodles into remaining sauce
6. Place 1 / 2 noodle mixture into greased 2qt
7. Casserole dish
8. Cover w / cottage cheese and 1 cup mozzarella
9. Add remaining noodle mixture , top with reserved meat sauce and remaining mozzarella
10. Sprinkle w / parmesan cheese
11. Bake covered at 350degrees for 20-25min
12. Let stand about 5 min before serving

title: ali s fried rice
steps:
1. Scramble the eggs in a wok
2. Remove and set aside
3. Add one tablespoon of shortening to hot wok and add onions
4. Saute onions to your preference
5. Add to wok the celery and carrot
6. Saute for about ten minutes , stirring often
7. Add garlic and saute for another four to five minutes
8. Add remaining two tablespoons of shortening to wok and add cold rice
9. Cook for about fifteen minutes , stirring every three to four minutes
10. Mix ginger and soy sauce together , toss in with rice
11. Add scrambled eggs to rice
12. Cook , stirring , another five minutes or until your preference
13. Makes 4 one cup servings

title: field greens with red chili dressing
steps:
1. In a blender puree firs t 8 ingredients for 20 seconds
2. Season to taste with salt and papper
3. Place greesn in large bowl and toss with dressing

title: zopf   great tasting swiss bread
steps:
1. Put the flour into a bowl
2. If you are using a kitchen aid you can put it into that mixing bowl
3. Mix 2 teaspoons of salt with flour
4. Make an indentation into the middle of flour
5. Pour 1 dl milk into a cup
6. Add 2 tsp sugar into the milk , stir well
7. Heat milk for 30 seconds in the microwave
8. Add 21 grams yeast into the milk and stir well
9. Pour yeast into the indentation in the flour
10. Let the yeast sit for 10 minutes
11. Cut butter into small pieces
12. Put pieces into a pan and melt on medium heat
13. Add 6 dl milk to the melted butter
14. Make sure butter is lukewarm
15. Go back to your flour and yeast and now put the bowl into the mixer and mix on the lowest setting
16. Add the melted butter to the dough while mixing
17. Let mix for 10 minutes
18. Loosen the dough from the bowl and put a wet cloth over the dough
19. Make sure it is loose to allow room for rising
20. Let sit for one hour
21. Pre heat oven to 425
22. Separate dough into two pieces
23. Each piece will make a single loaf of bread
24. With one of the pieces , separate it into two sections and roll them out and a floured surface
25. You want to roll them so the middle is the thickest and the ends are slightly narrower
26. Fold dough --
27. Start by putting one roll vertically and one on top of it horizontally
28. Fold top part down to bottom
29. Fold bottom part to top
30. Fold left part to right
31. Fold right part to left
32. Repeat- at end , join parts together
33. Separate an egg yolk from the egg white
34. Break the yolk and add a drop of half and half or heavy cream
35. Use food brush to spread yolk on dough- avoid crevices
36. Put dough into oven with small bowl of water
37. Put dough on wax paper to prevent the bread from sticking
38. After 10 min
39. , set temperature of oven down to 395 for 20 minute
40. Take out of oven
41. The bread is done
42. Let cool on a cooling rack and enjoy !

title: nutty colada
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients together with 1 / 2 cup ice
2. Add more ice as you wish

title: comfort cake
steps:
1. Pour pineapple into ungreased 13x9x2 inch baking pan
2. Spread one half of the bag of peaches over the pineapple
3. Sprinkle the entire box of white cake mix over the pineapple and peaches , mix a little
4. Add the rest of the peaches , spread on cake mix
5. Sprinkle raisins over this
6. Sprinkle pecans over raisins
7. Drizzle melted butter over all
8. Bake at 350f for 1 hour
9. Let stand for 5 minutes
10. Serve with ice cream

title: brussels sprouts and baby carrots
steps:
1. Bring a pot of water to boil and add carrots and brussels sprouts , boil for 6-10 minutes or until tender
2. Drain and cool
3. In a skillet over medium heat melt butter and then stir in chives , lemon peel and mustard
4. Stir in vegetables , tossing until coated and heated through
5. Season with salt and pepper to taste , if desired

title: healthy  hearty italian dinner
steps:
1. Brown onions and baby carrots in a little olive oil over medium heat
2. Stir in other vegetables and toss well
3. Add spaghetti sauce , stock , vermouth , and herbs
4. Stir well and bring to a boil
5. Simmer until carrots are fully cooked and flavors are blended about 30 minutes though it can hold as long as needed
6. Taste and adjust seasonings if necessary
7. If the sauce is too thick for your tastes add additional stock , tomato juice , or v8
8. If the sauce is too thin for your tastes add tomato paste or simmer , uncovered , until it thickens
9. To prepare the polenta , first slice about 1 / 2 to 3 / 4 inches thick
10. Lightly grease a griddle with olive oil
11. Heat it on medium to medium-high heat
12. Brush the polenta slices with olive oil as well
13. Brown both sides of the polenta on the hot griddle then sprinkle lightly with garlic powder and italian seasoning
14. Serve sauce over polenta and top with parmesan
15. If you like , you can round out the meal with a green salad and garlic bread
16. Brown onions and carrots first for the best flavor

title: confit byaldi
steps:
1. For piperade , heat oven to 450 degrees
2. Place pepper halves on a foil-lined sheet , cut side down
3. Roast until skin loosens , about 15 minutes
4. Remove from heat and let rest until cool enough to handle
5. Peel and chop finely
6. Combine oil , garlic , and onion in medium skillet over low heat until very soft but not browned , about 8 minutes
7. Add tomatoes , their juices , thyme , parsley , and bay leaf
8. Simmer over low heat until very soft and very little liquid remains , about 10 minutes , do not brown
9. Add peppers and simmer to soften them
10. Season to taste with salt , and discard herbs
11. Reserve tablespoon of mixture and spread remainder in bottom of an 8-inch skillet
12. For vegetables , heat oven to 275 degrees
13. Down center of pan , arrange a strip of 8 alternating slices of vegetables over piperade , overlapping so that only 1 / 4 inch of each slice is exposed
14. Around the center strip , overlap vegetables in a close spiral that lets slices mound slightly toward center
15. Repeat until pan is filled
16. All vegetables may not be needed
17. Mix garlic , oil , and thyme leaves in bowl and season with salt and pepper to taste
18. Sprinkle over vegetables
19. Cover pan with foil and crimp edges to seal well
20. Bake until vegetables are tender when tested with a paring knife , about 2 hours
21. Uncover and bake for 30 minutes more
22. If there is excess liquid in pan , place over medium heat on stove until reduced
23. For vinaigrette , combine reserved piperade , oil , vinegar , herbs , and salt and pepper to taste in a bowl
24. To serve , heat broiler and place byaldi underneath until lightly browned
25. Slice in quarters and very carefully lift onto plate with offset spatula
26. Turn spatula 90 degrees , guiding byaldi into fan shape
27. Drizzle vinaigrette around plate
28. Serve hot

title: rhubarb streusel cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f generously butter an 8 inch round pan or spring form pan , line the base with parchment paper , then lightly butter the paper
2. Make the crumble topping: whisk together flour , brown sugar , cinnamon and salt in a bowl
3. Blend in butter with your finger
4. Make cake batter: whisk together flour , baking powder , and salt in a bowl
5. In a separate large bowl , beat together butter and sugar with electric mixer at medium speed until blended , about two minutes
6. Add eggs and vanilla and beat until fluffy , about one minute
7. Reduce speed to low and add flour mixture and milk alternately in two batches , beginning and ending with the flour mixture until just combined
8. Top and bake cake: spread batter evenly in pan
9. Toss rhubarb with icing sugar , then immediately sprinkle over batter
10. Scatter the crumble topping evenly on top
11. Bake in the middle of oven until top is golden and a tester inserted comes out clean , about 40 minutes
12. Cool cake in pan on a rack for three minutes , then loosen edges of cake with a sharp knife or small spatula
13. Remove cake from pan or unclip the spring form and put on rack to cool slightly
14. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: grilled collard greens
steps:
1. Prepare a large bowl of ice water
2. Preheat your grill
3. Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil and add the salt and fat
4. When salt is dissolved and fat is melted , add the collard greens to the boiling water and simmer for 3 minutes
5. Remove collards from the water and immediately plunge into the ice water to halt the cooking and preserve the beautiful green color
6. Remove the collards from the ice water a leaf at a time and stack them flat on top of each other , about 7 to 9 leaves high
7. Oil your grill well and grill the stacked collard leaves until done , turning once , about 5 minutes per side
8. Cut stacked collards in half or quarters , season with salt and pepper , and serve immediately

title: quick skillet lasagna
steps:
1. Cook sausage over medium high heat in a 10-inch skillet until crumbled and no longer pink
2. Drain
3. Blend in spaghetti sauce
4. Simmer for 5 minutes
5. Remove from pan
6. Keep warm
7. Place half of the cooked pasta in bottom of the skillet
8. Pour half of sausage sauce mixture over pasta
9. Sprinkle with 1 cup mozzarella cheese
10. Top with remaining pasta , sausage sauce and mozzarella
11. Cover and cook over medium heat for about 5 minutes or until heat through and cheese is melted
12. Remove from the heat and let it stand for about 1 minute before serving

title: saltuna
steps:
1. 1
2. Get a microwave safe bowl and put the can of tuna in it
3. I recommend that you don't drain it , or as little as possible
4. 2
5. Heat the tuna with a loose lid in the microwave for 50 seconds
6. 3
7. Take out the tuna and place your 5 crackers in a single layer over the tuna while it is still steaming
8. 4
9. Submerge the cracker into the tuna if you like break them
10. 5
11. Pop the tuna back into the microwave for about 10 seconds
12. 6
13. Now mix in the crackers until all is moist and softened
14. 7
15. Now you can add your salt and pepper or whatever you like with tuna fish , but i suggest you try it plain and then add what you prefer to it
16. 8
17. Enjoy

title: tropical life saver
steps: 1. Mix in a tall glass

title: waffles w  wheat flour
steps:
1. Combine milk , oil , and eggs in a medium bowl
2. In a separate bowl , stir together the dry ingredients
3. Add the dry ingredients to the liquid ones
4. Whisk to combine
5. Pour about 1 / 2 cup batter onto the center of the waffle grid
6. Cook until done , about 4 minutes

title: easiest sauteed zucchini ever
steps:
1. Heat oil in a skillet and saute the onion
2. Add zucchini in a single layer atop the onion and sprinkle with soy sauce
3. Stir-fry approximately 5 minutes , or until zucchini is cooked to your liking
4. Serve warm

title: sloppy joe confetti tacos
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. In a 10 inch skillet , cook ground beef over medium high heat 5 to 7 minutes , stirring frequently , until cooked through
3. Drain
4. Meanwhile , heat taco shells as directed on box
5. Stir sloppy joe sauce , bell pepper and corn into ground beef
6. Cook 2 to 3 minutes longer , stirring occasionally , until mixture is hot and bubbly
7. Spoon about 1 / 4 cup beef mixture into each warmed taco shell
8. Top with olives , lettuce and cheese

title: brie pie  tourte au brie
steps:
1. The day before , combine flour , butter and a little water to make the dough for the pie crust
2. Refrigerate overnight
3. Divide the dough into 2 parts , bearing in mind that the bottom crust requires more dough than the top
4. Roll out the dough
5. Butter a pie plate or line with parchment paper , then place bottom crust in pie plate
6. Remove the crusts from the cheeses , then slice the cheeses
7. Cover the bottom of the pie crust with the cheese slices , then sprinkle with nutmeg
8. Beat 1 egg together with the liquid cream and pour over the brie slices
9. Cover with the top pie crust , carefully sealing the edges and cutting a few small slits in the top crust
10. Beat remaining egg together with a dash of salt and brush over top crust to make it golden brown during baking
11. Bake at 350f for 25 minutes
12. Serve warm with a green salad

title: creamy cheese bowl
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in heavy , medium-sized saucepan
2. Heat slowly until cheese melts , stirring often

title: cutout cookie decorator icing
steps:
1. Place sugar into mixing bowl
2. Combine milk , corn syrup and vanilla , and blend
3. Add liquid mixture to powdered sugar and mix thoroughly
4. Add softened butter and blend until thoroughly incorporated
5. Divide frosting into several cups , and add food coloring to each
6. If using liquid coloring , add a little more powdered sugar until it reaches good spreading consistency
