7. Spread onto cookie with knife , or place in zip-loc sandwith bags with the corner nipped off 1 / 16" to pipe onto cookies
8. Decorate with sprinkles or colored sugars
9. Once cookies are decorated , place on flat surface to allow frosting to dry
10. Store cookies in covered container
11. Sugar can be added or milk lessened to achieve the best consistency

title: jessica s special salad
steps:
1. Put ingredients into a serving bowl and mix with clean hands
2. Serve with salad tongs
3. Goes well with other light foods like chicken
4. Is perfect with a light , sweet wine
5. The sweetness of the wine compliments the slight bitterness of the salad

title: apple cheese english muffin pizzas
steps:
1. Top toasted muffins with 1 tablespoons cream cheese , then place apple slices on top , and 2 pieces of cheese
2. Heat in toaster over 30 seconds , or until cheese melts
3. Top with dried cranberries

title: chicken with garlic  basil    parsley
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Coat a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray
3. Sprinkle 1 teaspoon parsley and 1 teaspoon basil evenly over the bottom of the baking dish
4. Arrange chicken breast halves in the dish , and sprinkle evenly with garlic slices
5. In a small bowl , mix the remaining 2 teaspoons parsley , remaining 2 teaspoons basil , salt , and red pepper
6. Sprinkle over the chicken
7. Top with tomato slices
8. Bake covered in the preheated oven 25 minutes
9. Remove cover , and continue baking 15 minutes , or until chicken juices run clear

title: the healthiest banana and blueberry muffins
steps:
1. Lightly grease a 12 hole muffin pan
2. Combine flour and sugar in a bowl
3. Mix the egg , yoghurt and milk together and add to the flour mix
4. Stir until just combined
5. Stir in bananas and blueberries
6. Divide mixture between pan holes
7. Cook in a moderate oven , 180 degrees , for about 20 to 25 minutes or until skewer comes out clean
8. Let stand in pan for 5 minutes before turning out onto a wire rack to cool

title: whipped cream cream cheese frosting
steps:
1. In a bowl whip the 1-1 / 2 cups whipping cream until stiff peaks form
2. In another large bowl beat together the cream cheese with sugar , salt and vanilla until smooth
3. Using a spatula fold in the whipped cream into the cream cheese mixture

title: boston baked beans with bacon
steps:
1. Do this a day before: place the beans in a large bowl
2. Add enough cold water to cover the beans by 3 inches
3. Let stand at room temperature overnight
4. The next day drain the beans very well in a colander
5. Set aside
6. Set oven to 350 degrees
7. In a large oven-proof dutch oven cook the bacon pieces until crisp
8. Add in well-drained beans and all the remaining ingredients
9. Mix well to combine and bring to a boil on top of the stove
10. Transfer the pot to the oven
11. Bake uncovered until beans are tender and the liquid thickens , stirring occasionally

title: sirloin burgers with mushrooms  swiss  and balsamic mayo
steps:
1. Preheat grill pan or large nonstick skillet over med-high heat
2. In a small nonstick skillet over medium heat , saute chopped onion in a drizzle of olive oil for 2-3 minutes
3. Set pan aside
4. In a bowl , combine meat , worcestershire sauce , and steak seasoning
5. Mix in sauteed onion and form into 4 large patties
6. Drizzle patties with a touch of oil
7. Quick toast your split rolls on the hot grill pan and set aside
8. Then add burgers to hot pan
9. Grill 4-5 minutes on each side for medium to medium-well burgers
10. Return small nonstick skillet to stove over med-high heat
11. Add 1 tablespoon olive oil and sliced mushrooms
12. Season with salt and pepper , then saute until just tender , 3-5 minutes
13. Remove from heat
14. Pile mushrooms on top of burgers just before you are ready to take them off the grill
15. Fold each slice of swiss cheese in half and rest on top of mushrooms
16. Place a loose tin foil tent over burgers and turn off heat
17. Let cheese melt down over the mushrooms for 2-3 minutes
18. In a small dish , combine balsamic vinegar , mayo , and lots of coarsely ground black pepper
19. To assemble burgers: place burgers topped with mushrooms and cheese on bun bottom
20. Slather tops of buns with mayo mixture and add romaine
21. Set burger tops in place and serve

title: cumin potatoes and tomatoes
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 200c
2. In a large mixing bowl , mix the potatoes , onion , cumin , cinnamon , oil , salt and pepper
3. Spread this mixture evenly in a baking dish
4. Pour the crushed tomatoes and any juices over the potatoes
5. Pour water into the pan
6. Cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes
7. After this time , reduce oven temperature to 180c , remove foil and bake an additional 30 minutes until the potatoes are tender and the sauce has thickened

title: garlic mashed potatoes restaurant style
steps:
1. Remove papery outer skin from garlic cut top off garlic do not seperate the cloves as you will be roasting the garlic whole
2. Brush the top of the garlic with 1 tsp oil
3. Wrap the bulb of garlic in tin foil and bake @ 425 for 30 to 35 minutes
4. Meanwhile in a large skillet cook onion in remaining oil for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown stirring occasionally
5. Transfer the onions to a food processor
6. Cover and process until blended
7. Set aside
8. Place potatoes in a large saucepan and cover with water bring to a boil
9. Cook until tender
10. Drain and place potatoes in a large bowl
11. Squeeze softened garlic into bwl add the butter , sourcream , parmesan cheese , milk , salt and pepper and onion
12. Beat until mashed

title: beef stew for 100
steps:
1. Brown beef and garlic
2. Add water and simmer covered about 1 hour until meat is tender
3. While meat is cooking , remove about 1 / 2 gallon of broth and allow to cool slightly
4. Stir broth into dry ingredients
5. Pour mixture into simmering meat , stirring constantly until thickened
6. Cook potatoes , carrots , celery , and onion slightly and add to meat mixture
7. Bake 1-2 hours

title: low fat crusty whole wheat bread
steps:
1. Add all ingredients in the order suggested by your bread machine manual and process on the basic bread cycle according to the manufacturers directions
2. If the prunes are hard , pour boiling water over them to soften , then drain well

title: amy s favorite indian fry bread tacos
steps:
1. For meat / bean mixture :
2. Thoroughly combine uncooked ground beef , refried beans , taco seasoning mix and water
3. Bring mixture to a boil
4. Cover , reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour
5. Uncover and continue to simmer until liquid is reduced and mixture is thick
6. This usually takes another 20 minutes or so - just enough time to make the fry bread
7. For fry bread tacos:
8. Mix flour , baking powder and salt together well
9. Add water gradually making sure the dough is stiff
10. Pull off egg-sized balls of dough and quickly roll , pull , and on a floured surface pat them out into large , plate-sized rounds
11. They should be thin in the middle and about 1 / 4 inch thick around the edges
12. Using a fork poke holes in the dough to prevent bubbles from forming
13. In skillet , heat 1 / 2-inch vegetable oil
14. Brown dough circles on each side until golden brown
15. You will need to stand over the skillet and with your fork and poke at any bubbles that may come up
16. When golden brown , lift from oil , shake gently to remove bulk of oil , and place on paper towels to drain
17. Spread meat / bean mixture on fry bread and top with your favorite toppings

title: easy chicken stir fry
steps:
1. Heat pan and add sweet chilli sauce , hoisin sauce , soy sauce and chilli flakes and stir well
2. When the sauce begins to bubble , add the chicken fillets and stir to combine , cook for 2 minutes
3. Add the vegetables and stir-fry
4. Cover and cook for another 3 minutes , stirring regularly
5. Serve over rice

title: bacon wrapped shrimp
steps:
1. Wrap each shrimp with a bacon slice and secure with 2 wooden picks
2. Stir together the melted shortening , cheese , garlic and lemon juice
3. Brush mixture on shrimp
4. Place shrimp on a baking sheet and broil , about 5 inches from the heat , for 4 minutes per side or until bacon is crisp

title: two tone fudge brownies
steps:
1. For brownie layer , in microwave-safe bowl , melt chocolate chips
2. Cool slightly
3. In a mixing bowl , cream butter and sugar
4. Add eggs and vanilla
5. Mix well
6. Stir in melted chocolate
7. Combine flour and baking soda
8. Add to batter
9. Stir in walnuts
10. Spread into a greased 13-inch by 9-inch by 2-inch baking pan
11. Bake at 350 degrees for 16-22 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near center comes out clean
12. Cool on a wire rack
13. In a mixing bowl , cream butter and sugars
14. Beat in milk and vanilla
15. Gradually add flour
16. Stir in chocolate chips
17. Drop by tablespoonfuls over cooled brownies
18. Carefully spread over top
19. Cut into squares
20. Store in the refrigerator

title: perfect spaghetti sauce  crock pot
steps:
1. Heat oil in large skillet over med-high heat until hot
2. Brown onion and 2 cloves of garlic in oil , but do not burn !
3. Add meat to skillet and cook thoroughly
4. In a crock pot , add juice , sauce , paste , 2 cloves of garlic , sugar , spices , and meat mixture and cook on low all day
5. Can cook on high for less time , as well , but may not be as thick
6. To thicken up , "crack" lid for the last few hours
7. Serve over hot pasta and freeze any leftover sauce for later !

title: papa roberto s spinach lasagna
steps:
1. Directions:
2. Prepare the lasagna noodles according to package directions
3. Drain and set aside
4. Meat sauce:
5. Use a dutch oven or large heavy pot suitable for slow cooking
6. Brown the ground beef and sausage
7. Drain off the grease
8. Add the onion and garlic to the meat / sausage mixture
9. Saut until onion is tender
10. Grind the fennel seed with mortar and pestle
11. Add the sugar , salt , basil , fennel seed , pepper , chili flakes , tomatoes and tomato paste
12. Stir well and simmer covered for 1 hour , stirring occasionally
13. Add port or other red wine and simmer for an additional 30 minutes
14. Spinach filling:
15. Steam spinach until very tender
16. Drain spinach and chop up very fine
17. Mix with mozzarella , parmesan and ricotta until well blended
18. Put lasagna together and bake:
19. In the bottom of a very large baking pan , spread just enough of the meat mixture to cover the bottom
20. Layer as follows
21. Lasagna noodles , spinach filling , meat sauce , light extra cheese layer
22. Repeat until pan is full
23. Make sure lasagna noodles overlap slightly and make sure you finish with mozzarella and a sprinkle of parmesan on top
24. Cover with foil
25. Bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes
26. Remove the foil and bake for 25 additional minutes

title: vegan macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. In a blender , combine all ingredients and blend on liquefy setting until creamy
2. Pour contents into saucepan and simmer , stirring frequently while you cook macaroni noodles
3. Drain noodles
4. Pour sauce over noodles , serve and enjoy !

title: chile pepper dressing
steps:
1. Roast and peel bell pepper and anaheim chile
2. Finely chop roasted pepper and chile
3. Wearing rubber gloves , seed and mince jalapeno chili
4. Mince garlic
5. In a bowl whisk together all ingredients with salt& pepper to taste
6. Makes about 1 1 / 4 c

title: savory hamburger skillet pie
steps:
1. In large skillet cook beef , celery , and onion until meat is browned and vegetables are crisp-tender
2. Meanwhile cube and boil potatoes in salted water until tender and drain
3. Stir in worcestershire , pepper , green beans , tomato soup , ketchup , and 1 / 4 cup of water , and simmer over medium-low heat for 15 minute
4. Whip potatoes with sour cream , chives , salt , garlic powder and hot water as needed until desired consistency , added a little bit at a time
5. Spoon the mashed potatoes in dollops over the mixture , sprinkle with the cheese and a little paprika , cover and heat until the cheese melts
6. Enjoy ! :)

title: orange cranberry screwdriver
steps:
1. In a large pitcher , add cranberry-apple juice , orange , juice , and lemon juice
2. Stir to mix
3. Pour the sparkling water slowly down the side of the pitcher
4. Stir gently to mix
5. Stir in vodka
6. Serve in glasses over ice

title: blueberry orange bread
steps:
1. Grease bottom and 1 / 2" of sides of 8x8x4 loaf pan -- set aside
2. In large bowl , stir together flour , baking powder , salt and baking soda
3. Make a well in the center and set aside
4. Stir together butter and boiling water till melted
5. In a medium bowl , combine egg , sugar , and orange juice
6. Stir in butter mixture , combine well
7. Add to dry ingredients
8. Stirring just till moistened
9. Fold in berries --
10. Spoon batter into pan --
11. Bake in 350 for 60 minutes
12. Cool in pan 10 minutes
13. Turn out on rack to cool --
14. Yield 16 slices

title: bacon wrapped shrimp with chunky tomatillo salsa and tomato vina
steps:
1. Tomatillo salsa:
2. For the tomatillo salsa , toss the tomatillos , avocados , jalapenos , cilantro and onion together in a large bowl
3. Add the lime juice and canola oil , and turn to coat
4. Season with salt and black pepper
5. Turn the mixture over a few times until the avocados are slightly mashed and the salsa is creamy
6. Cover and refrigerate while you prepare everything else
7. Tomato vinaigrette:
8. Puree the tomato , chipotle , garlic , lime zest , lime juice , sherry vinegar , sugar and salt in a blender until smooth
9. Pour in the oil and puree again until emulsified and slightly thickened
10. Refrigerate
11. Shrimp:
12. Wrap each shrimp in a piece of bacon , overlapping the ends so they stick together
13. Place a large skillet over medium heat , drizzle with a 1 / 2 count of oil and heat just to the smoking point
14. Lay the shrimp in the pan and saute until the bacon is crisp , tossing so the shrimp cook evenly
15. To serve:
16. Spoon a mound of the tomatillo salsa on each plate
17. Drizzle a pool of the tomato vinaigrette on another area of the plate and top with 5 shrimp
18. Garnish with the green onion and cilantro leaves

title: chicken   corn pastries
steps:
1. Combine chickem , corn , garlic , stock powder andspring onions , mix well
2. Cut 4 8cm circles from each pastry sheet , brush edge of pastry with egg yolk
3. Place tablespoonfuls of mixture on one half of circles , fold pastry over to meet edge , pinch edges together , brush with egg yolk and sprinklewith sesame seeds
4. Place on greased oven trays , bake at 200
5. C for 8 mins , reduce heat to 180
6. C and cook for a further 5 mins until golden

title: ginger apple salad
steps:
1. Mix the honey and orange juice in a large bowl , until the honey is dissolved
2. Wash , core and chop the apples , and add them to the orange juice and honey
3. Grate the gingerroot , and add it , with its' juice
4. Wash and chop the celery , and add the celery , dried fruit and walnuts to the salad
5. Chill the salad
6. Wash and dry a few lettuce leaves , and arrange the salad on them
7. Serve sprinkled with a little minced fresh mint , if desired

title: easy spicy shrimp
steps:
1. Mix together the water , ketchup , soy sauce , cornstarch , honey , red pepper flakes , and ground ginger in a small bowl and set aside
2. Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and stir in the green onions and garlic and cook for about 30 seconds
3. Stir in the shrimp and stir them around to coat with the oil
4. Cook until shrimp are pink and cooked through ~ just a few minutes
5. Stir in the sauce and stir until sauce is thickened and bubbly
6. Serve over rice

title: shrimp   andouille sausage jambalaya
steps:
1. In a dutch oven , saute onion , celery , green bell pepper , and garlic in butter until tender
2. Add the next 9 ingredients
3. Bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat
5. Cover and simmer until rice is tender , approximately 25 minutes
6. Add shrimp and parsley
7. Simmer , uncovered , until shrimp are cooked , approximately 7-10 minutes

title: thai noodles with seafood
steps:
1. Cut 500g of mixed seafood into bite-size pieces , first removing any shells
2. If you are using mussels , wash and scrape the shells and open them by putting them in a pot with a little boiling water
3. Cover and boil for a few minutes , removing each mussel as it opens to prevent overcooking
4. Chop a handful of basil leaves and seed and finely slice 3 bird's eye chillies
5. In a frying pan or wok , heat 1 tablespoon of oil
6. Brown 2 tablespoons of crushed garlic and saute the seafood for a couple of minutes
7. Drain off the oil and set the garlic seafood mixture aside
8. Put another tablespoon of oil in the pan and increase the heat
9. Add 2 tablespoons of light soya sauce and the noodles and saute for 2-3 minutes
10. Stir well
11. Add the basil leaves and chillies and cook for 1 minute more , stirring

title: coney islands  or sloppy joes
steps:
1. Cook beef , onion and green pepper until meat is browned
2. Drain
3. Add tomato sauce , water , chili powder , paprika , salt and pepper
4. Simmer 15 minutes
5. Cover frankfurters in cold water in a saucepan
6. Bring to boil
7. Simmer 5 minutes
8. Place frankfurters in warm buns
9. Top each with meat mixture

title: white chocolate cherry bread pudding
steps:
1. Coat 6-cup baking dish with cooking spray
2. In large bowl , whisk eggs with half and half , 1 / 2 cup sugar and almond extract until blended
3. Stir in pie filling , bread , dried cherries and chocolate chips
4. Transfer to prepared 6-cup baking dish
5. Sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon of sugar
6. Cover
7. Refrigerate 30 minutes to 12 hours
8. If refrigerated more than 30 minutes , let stand at room temperature 20 minutes before baking
9. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
10. Cover baking dish
11. Bake 30 minutes
12. Uncover
13. Sprinkle with sliced almonds
14. Bake uncovered , 35-40 minutes or until set and golden
15. Let stand 20 minutes before serving
16. If desired , sprinkle with confectioners' sugar

title: baja sauce
steps:
1. Blend mayonnaise , sour cream , avocado , and lime juice with a food processor or blender
2. Stir in chopped cilantro and jalapeno
3. Stir in salt and pepper
4. Yum

title: ground pork and shrimp in coconut milk
steps:
1. Start rice cooking , this takes 3 times as long as cooking the sauce
2. Put the coconut milk , chiles , ginger , and garlic in a medium saucepan
3. Bring the mixture to a boil
4. Stir in the pork and adjust heat to keep mixture at a light boil
5. While stirring , cook mixture 4 - 5 minutes
6. Take pan off of stove and add shrimp
7. Stir in the nam pla fish sauce , then salt and pepper to taste
8. Serve over rice
9. Garnish with onions , cilantro and mint

title: honey pepper sauce
steps:
1. Mix water and corn starch in a saucepan until no lumps remain
2. Add honey , soy sauce , and pepper sauce and stir thoroughly
3. Heat over medium , stirring occasionally until thickened
4. Remove from heat and serve

title: penne alla panna
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a skillet
2. On a high heat , quickly fry the ham or prosciutto until starting to brown , keep stirring it continuously to stop it from burning
3. Turn down to a low heat or if cooking on an electric hob turn it off , pour in 250 ml of cream
4. Add the cayenne pepper and stir in the parmesan
5. If the sauce seems really thick add some more cream , the pasta shouldn't be dry , but neither should it swim in sauce
6. Stir in the pasta and serve straight away

title: ww turkey and cheddar burgers  7 points
steps:
1. Combine turkey , zucchini , cheese , onion , salt and pepper in a bowl
2. Shape into four patties
3. I wrap mine in cling film , and chill them for 30 mins or so to firm up
4. Heat a nonstick ridged grill pan over medium low heat
5. Grill the patties until browned on the outside and no longer pink in the middle
6. Whisk together the ketchup and mayp in a small bowl
7. Layer the lettuce , burgers and tomato in the bottom of the buns , top with ketchup mixture , then the bun tops

title: yellow squash in dipping oil
steps:
1. Heat heavy skillet over med-hi heat
2. Add oil
3. When heated , add squash and saute until tender and slightly browned , about 8-10 minutes
4. Tasty !

title: german apple bread
steps:
1. Heat oven to 325f
2. Mix all ingredients in large bowl
3. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans
4. Divide dough between 2 pans
5. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minute

title: healthier oatmeal cookies  lower cal and fat
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper or spray with nonstick spray
3. With a hand mixer , mix together yogurt , brown sugar , honey , vanilla , cinnamon and egg
4. In a separate bowl , mix together all dry ingredients
5. Add dry to wet and mix until combined
6. At this step you can add raisins or chocolate chips or nuts or anything you've chosen
7. Drop by teaspoonful onto cookie sheet and bake for 8-10 minutes

title: easiest chicken enchilada bake e v e r
steps:
1. In a greased 13x9in baking dish , layer half of the chicken , enchilada sauce , sour cream , tortillas and cheese
2. Repeat layers
3. Cover and bake @ 375 for 40 minutes
4. Uncover
5. Bake 10 minutes longer or until bubbly
6. Let stand for 15 minutes before serving

title: fiery kickoff wings
steps:
1. Mix marinade mix , vinegar , oil , ketchup and red pepper in large bowl
2. Add wings
3. Toss to coat evenly
4. Cover
5. Refrigerate 30 minutes or longer for extra flavor
6. Remove chicken from marinade
7. Discard any remaining marinade
8. Grill over medium heat 15 to 18 minutes or until cooked through , turning frequently
9. Or , bake in preheated 400f oven in 15x10x1-inch baking pan for 30 to 35 minutes
10. Serve with ranch or blue cheese dressing , if desired

title: cheerios cookies
steps:
1. Mix the butter , both sugars , peanut butter , vanilla and eggs thoroughly
2. Sift flour , salt , soda and baking powder
3. Fold into the first mixture
4. Add oatmeal , cheerios and chocolate chips
5. Drop by tblsp onto ungreased cookie sheet
6. Bake at 375 for 10-12 minutes
7. I got 82 cookies , using a small cookie scoop that holds approximately 1 tblsp dough

title: chicken barbecue sandwiches
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients together in a bowl except the chicken & buns
2. Place the chicken into a crock pot then pour the sauce over until the chicken is smothered
3. Cover with the lid & cook on low for 5-6 hours
4. Shredded the chicken with a fork then scoop the mixture onto the buns

title: chinesey chicken wings
steps:
1. Cut
2. Cut remaining wings in half at joint
3. Rinse chicken and pat dry
4. Put in ungreased , shallow baking pan in single layer
5. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
6. Mix together in a small jar the remaining ingredients
7. Cover and shake well
8. Pour over wings
9. Cover pan with foil and bake 2 hours at 325 degrees
10. Remove foil , reduce heat to 300 degrees and continue baking another 30 minutes , basting with drippings every 10 minutes
11. When wings are brown remove and drain on papper towels
12. Serve hot or cold

title: slow cooker southern barbecue pork on a bun
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , over medium-high heat , combine ketchup , chili sauce , mustard , vinegar , worcestershire sauce , red pepper flakes and garlic
2. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes , then let cool
3. Rinse pork shoulder and pat dry , then place in a large glass bowl or resealable plastic bag
4. Pour sauce over pork and marinate overnight in the fridge
5. Remove roast from the marinade and place in the slow cooker
6. Add 3 / 4 cup water to marinade , mix well and add to roast in slow cooker
7. Cover and cook on low for 8-9 hours or on high for 4-6 hours , until meat is tender but not falling apart
8. Remove meat from sauce and let it stand on a carving board for 10-15 minutes , then cut it into thin slices and keep warm
9. To serve: place meat on one half of bun , add sauce and top with the other half of bun

title: swirlberry ice cream
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , combine the strawberries , raspberries , 1 / 4 cup sugar and a pinch of salt
2. Bring to a simmer over medium heat , stirring , and cook until jamlike , about 10 minutes
3. Let cool , cover and refrigerate until cold , about 1 hour
4. In a medium bowl , whisk together the cream , milk , remaining 1 / 4 cup sugar and another pinch of salt until the sugar is dissolved
5. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour
6. Using an ice cream machine , process the cream mixture according to the manufacturer's instructions
7. Fold in the chilled berry mixture to make a swirl pattern and then transfer to an airtight container
8. Freeze until firm , about 4 hours

title: the answer  protein shake
steps:
1. Put them in the blender
2. Mix
3. Drink
4. Repeat every day

title: white wine ginger cooler
steps:
1. Fill a large goblet with ise cubes
2. Stir in the wine and the bitters and top off with ginger beer
3. Garnish with lemon

title: grandma florence s fruit cookies
steps:
1. Sift all dry ingredients into bowl
2. Stir liquid into well of flour
3. Add raisin and nuts stir drop cookies onto pan will spread out 400 oven 10 minutes

title: favorite homemade buttermilk biscuits
steps:
1. Measure out buttermilk in measuring cup and let sit for 5-10 minutes , add a pinch of baking powder and stir well
2. Preheat oven to 450f
3. Measure out flour with 1 / 4 tsp of baking powder and sift with a sifter into a bowl
4. Add crisco shortening and cut into flour well
5. Make a well in middle of flour mixture and pour buttermilk in slowly
6. Flour your hand , mix together flour mixture and buttermilk well , forming a ball and turn out onto a floured surface
7. Clean hands
8. Roll with a floured rolling pin or you can use your hands to flatten out , to about 1 / 2 to 1-inch thick
9. Cut with a large floured biscuit cutter or use the rim of a floured round drinking glass
10. Place on a greased baking sheet and bake 12 to 15 minutes or until tops are lightly brown

title: lemon raspberry tiramisu
steps:
1. Combine water and gelatin in small microwavable bowl
2. Microwave on high for 30-60 sec
3. Until water is boiling and gelatin is dissolved
4. Cool slightly
5. Meanwhile , combine cream cheese , splenda , and vanilla in large bowl
6. Beat until smooth
7. Add gelatin mixture to cheese mixture and beat for 1 minute
8. Add cool whip and beat 1 more minute , scraping sides of bowl
9. Set aside
10. Whisk together preserves , water and marsala until well blended
11. Reserve 2 tablespoons of preserves mixture and set aside
12. Spread 1 / 3 cup of preserves mixture evenly over bottom of 11x7 glass baking dish
13. Put half of split ladyfingers in bottom of dish
14. Spread half of cream cheese mixture over ladyfingers
15. Sprinkle 1 cup of berries over over cheese mixture
16. Top with remaining ladyfingers , then a layer of preserves mixture , then a layer of cream cheese mixture
17. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours
18. Sprinkle with remaining berries and drizzle with reserved 2 tbs of preserves mixture before serving

title: lynn s super smoothie
steps: 1. Put all ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth

title: emz chocolate wizz cake
steps:
1. Put all ingredients into food processor , if food processor is small you may need to wizz in two batches
2. Wizz for 2-3 minutes
3. Stir in chocolate chips / nuts with a spoon
4. Pour mixture into a 8-10 inch tin , lined on the bottom with lightly greased sides
5. Bake in pre heated oven at 180 degrees c for approx 1 1 / 4 hours
6. Remove from oven and allow to stand for a few mins before turning onto a cake rack
7. Allow to cool and frost with your favorate icing or whipped cream and berries , alternativly dust with icing sugar
8. Delishious on its own or with youghurt and fruit / icecream / custard
9. Enjoy !

title: avocado   coconut cream smoothie
steps:
1. Peel , remove the stone and chop the avocado , then add to a blender along with the remaining ingredients
2. Blitz until smooth and creamy
3. Enjoy

title: stuffed avocado california style  pseudo sushi
steps:
1. Slice avocado in half and remove pit
2. Mix together remaining ingredients
3. Stuff into avocado half , garnish with sesame seeds and enjoy

title: belgian chicons au gratin  endives au gratin
steps:
1. Cut the bottom part of the endives , and boil them in salted water , until tender
2. Prepare a bechamelle sauce:
3. Melt 2tb butter in a saucepan
4. Add flour and stir
5. Add milk a little at a time
6. Cook until thickened
7. Add grated swiss cheese , salt , pepper , and nutmeg
8. Drain the endives
9. Roll each endive in a slice of ham
10. Place in a rectangular baking dish
11. Pour the bechamelle over the rolled slices of ham
12. Sprinkle more swiss cheese over the sauce
13. Dot with remaining butter
14. Place under the broiler until golden

title: white jamaican
steps:
1. Stirred , not shaken , over ice
2. Paper umbrella optional

title: raspberry and mango jam
steps:
1. Peel mangoes , remove pits , and puree flesh in a blender or food processor
2. Combine mango pulp , raspberries and sugar in a heavy saucepan
3. Bring slowly to a boil while stirring
4. Reduce heat and cook until thick , about 15 minutes
5. Ladle into jars and seal and keep in the refrigerator up to 4 months , or freeze

title: lime honey fruit compote
steps:
1. Combine lime zest and lime juice
2. Drop grated apple immediately into the lime juice
3. Add honey , raisins , prunes , and dates
4. Mix well
5. And chill 12-24 hours for flavors to blend
6. Just before serving , mix in the pecans or walnuts
7. May serve with cream

title: white chocolate bakewell  cherry and almond  fudge
steps:
1. Put the white chocolate chips and sweetened condensed milk in a saucepan and warm over a very low heat , stirring continuously until the chocolate has melted and the mixture is smooth
2. Remove from the heat
3. Stir in the almond extract and then the glace cherries
4. Line a loaf pan with cling film and pour the warm fudge mixture inches
5. Chill in the fridge for at least 3 hours , until completely set
6. Then turn out of the pan and serve
7. Nb if desired , you can quarter extra glace cherries and scatter them over the top of the fudge before chilling to make it look a little more colourful !

title: original tuna melts
steps:
1. Drain and flake tuna in a medium bowl
2. Add pickles , onion and cheese and mix well
3. Add mayonnaise and mix well
4. Fill hot dog rolls and wrap each in tin foil , twisting both ends to close
5. Place on cookie sheet and bake at 350 degrees for 20-25 minutes
6. Serve in corn-on-the-cob dishes with french fries and a salad
7. These can also be cooked on a grill , making them suitable for camping

title: cheesy hash browns and ham casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish
3. In a large bowl , mix hash browns , ham , cream of potato soup , sour cream , and cheddar cheese
4. Spread evenly into prepared dish
5. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese
6. Bake 1 hour in the preheated oven , or until bubbly and lightly brown
7. Serve immediately

title: cranberry  spread  jam
steps:
1. Put cranberries into a colander , rinse with cold water
2. Throw away any berries that are dried out or mushy
3. Bring water to a boil and put cranberries into boiling water
4. Cook over medium heat until the berries pop
5. Ladle cranberries into food mill and sieve
6. Pour prepared fruit back into pot , add cinnamon and pectin
7. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly for 3-5 minutes
8. Add sugar and bring to jam stage stirring constantly to prevent scorching
9. Boil for 3 minutes more
10. Skim off any foam with a wooden spoon
11. Jar as usual

title: chicken sausage  apple and cabbage saute
steps:
1. In a 12" , extra deep skillet with a lid , heat oil over medium heat
2. Peel onion , slice into 1 / 8th inch thick slices , adding to skillet as you slice
3. Stir and cook
4. Meanwhile , slice each sausage unto 1 / 2" pieces
5. Set aside
6. Core the apples
7. Chop into bite sized pieces
8. Add apples and sausage to the skillet
9. Stir well and cook over medium heat
10. Thinly slice cabbage no larger than 1 / 4" wide slices for quick cooking
11. Add to skillet
12. Add water , butter , and honey
13. Stir to mix well
14. Bring liquid to a boil , cover skillet , and steam until cabbage is crisp tender , approx 5-6 minutes
15. Uncover the skillet and sprinkle with pepper and vinegar
16. Toss to mix
17. Taste and add more vinegar if desired
18. Serve immediately

title: pumpkin cheesecake cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 , and line a 12 cup muffin tin with baking liners
2. Using an electric mixer , beat cream cheese with powdered sugar for 3 minutes
3. Beat in egg white and 1 / 2 tsp vanilla , mix well
4. In a seperate bowl whisk flour , pumpkin pie spice , baking powder and salt
5. In another bowl beat together pumpkin puree , 2 eggs , granulated sugar , oil and 1 tsp vanilla
6. Whisk in the flour mixture
7. Layer some of the batter in the bottom of the baking cups , then a layer of the cream cheese mixture , then top with another layer of pumpkin miture
8. Bake at 350 for 25 minutes , until the tops are springy
9. The original recipe calls for icing- but i think they're delightful as is !

title: the best summer sangria
steps:
1. Chop and slice all of the fruit and put into large pitcher
2. Add the wine , cranberry juice and brandy
3. Stir and let sit overnight
4. Enjoy !

title: pork chops with curried apple onion sauce
steps:
1. Sprinkle pork with 1 / 2 teaspoon thyme , 1 / 2 teaspoon marjoram , salt and pepper
2. Heat oil in heavy large skillet over medium-high heat
3. Add pork and cook until no longer pink inside , about 5 minutes per side
4. Transfer pork to plate
5. Tent with foil to keep warm
6. Reserve drippings in skillet
7. Add apple , onion and garlic to drippings in skillet and saut over medium-high heat 2 minutes
8. Add chicken broth , wine , cream , mustard , curry powder and remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon thyme and 1 / 2 teaspoon marjoram
9. Boil until sauce thickens slightly , about 5 minutes
10. Divide pork among plates
11. Pour sauce over and serve

title: blue cheese and mushroom pasta
steps:
1. Saute the onion and garlic in butter or olive oil over medium heat
2. Add the mushrooms , sautee until soft
3. Add the blue cheese , yoghurt , and creme frais
4. Stir until heated through and the bluecheese is melting
5. Pepper to taste
6. Just before you take the sauce off the stove , add salt and pepper to taste
7. A dash of cayenne is really nice
8. Server over hot pasta and sprinkle with freshly ground parmasean and chopped parsley

title: pan seared shrimp with ginger hoisin glaze
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a small bowl
2. Follow "base recipe for pan seared shrimp" recipe number 316590 , except , subsitute an equal amount of red pepper flakes for black pepper
3. Add hoisin mixture when returning first batch of shrimp to skillet

title: butter crumb cake
steps:
1. Topping: cut butter into brown sugar , flour mixture until crumbly
2. Grease bottom only of a 9 x 13-inch cake pan
3. In mixing bowl cream butter and cream cheese until light and fluffy
4. Add remaining ingredients and beat at low speed until well blended
5. Spread in prepared pan and sprinkle topping over top of cake
6. Bake at 350 for 30-35 minutes

title: cornmeal fried oysters with red cabbage and sausage
steps:
1. Toss the red cabbage , vinegar , salt and sugar
2. Set aside while you are preparing the other ingredients
3. Heat the 2 tablespoons oil in a large heavy frying pan over medium heat and saut the garlic until light gold in color
4. Stir in the onion and saut until lightly browned
5. Add the sausages and fry , crumbling with a fork , until cooked through
6. Add the apple and the red cabbage mixture and turn the heat to high
7. Saut , stirring frequently , until the cabbage is glistening and heated through
8. Remove from the heat
9. Coat the oysters with the cornmeal mixture and place on a plate
10. Sprinkle the leftover cornmeal mixture over the oysters
11. Preheat the oven to 250
12. Heat inch vegetable oil in a large , heavy frying pan until a haze forms over the oil
13. Fry the oysters , without overcrowding the pan , until golden brown on both sides
14. Drain each batch on absorbent paper , then transfer to a baking sheet and place in the oven
15. When the oysters are all cooked , reheat the cabbage and sausage mixture over high heat , stirring frequently , until hot and tender-crisp
16. Place on a heated platter and surround with the oysters

title: jungle juice for a group
steps:
1. Mix together and freeze
2. Fill large glass 1 / 3 full with frozen mixture and add 7-up , sprite , gingerale , etc

title: cassis champagne cocktail
steps:
1. Place one sugar cube in each of 8 glasses , add a capful or 2 teaspoons of liqueur to each glass
2. Fill each glass with well chilled champagne
3. Serve immediately

title: easy baked custard
steps:
1. Preheat oven 350 f
2. Combine all ingredients in a blender
3. Blend until smooth
4. Pour into a buttered 9-in
5. Deep-dish pie or cake pan
6. Bake at for 50 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean
7. Cool on a wire rack until room temperature
8. Refrigerate until serving

title: herbed barley salad
steps:
1. Combine water , garlic and barley in a large pot
2. Bring to boil and then reduce heat , cover and simmer for 40 minutes or until barley is tender
3. Drain excess water
4. To make dressing , combine mustard , garlic and vinegar
5. Whisk together , then slowly whisk in olive oil
6. Season with salt and pepper if desired
7. Combine half of dressing with warm barley
8. Stir in vegetables and herbs
9. Toss with remaining dressing
10. Season to taste

title: egg flower soup
steps:
1. Boil chicken broth , ginger and green onion 2 minutes
2. Add salt , msg , mushrooms and frozen peas
3. Cook 5 minutes
4. Pour soup slowly into serving bowl containing eggs
5. Stir gently
6. Serve hot

title: eggs in a spud
steps:
1. Cut potato in half lengthwise
2. Scoop out about half of the pulp from each potato half
3. Reserve potato flesh for another use - maybe mashed potatoes for dinner
4. Remove a thin slice of potato from the bottom to stabilize the potato , if necessary
5. Set potato shells in a shallow baking dish
6. Sprinkle each cavity with salt , pepper and 1 tbsp cheese
7. Break an egg into each cavity
8. Bake at 350f for 15 to 20 minutes or until eggs are cooked as desired
9. Sprinkle with parsley or chives and pepper
10. Serve immediately

title: potato goat cheese gratin
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f in nonstick skillet cook leeks in 1 tablespoon olive oil over medium-low heat , 20 minutes , or until tender and beginning to brown , stirring occasionally
2. Remove from heat
3. In bowl whisk 2 tablespoons of the milk into the flour
4. Whisk in remaining milk , salt , pepper , nutmeg , and garlic
5. Coat 2-quart casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray
6. Arrange half the potato slices in dish
7. Sprinkle with leeks and goat cheese
8. Pour half the milk mixture over potatoes , leeks , and cheese
9. Layer remaining potatoes
10. Pour remaining milk mixture over all
11. Cover with foil
12. Bake 45 minutes
13. Remove foil and bake 25 minutes more or until potatoes are tender
14. In small bowl stir together the bread crumbs and parmesan cheese
15. Sprinkle on potatoes
16. Bake , uncovered , 15 minutes more or until topping is browned
17. Let stand 10 minutes before serving
18. Top with parsley

title: snicker s salad
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in large bowl and serve
2. Store in refrigerator

title: easy shrimp linguine with basil garlic butter
steps:
1. Heat oil in a skillet
2. Add shrimp and cook until just pink
3. Add the garlic and basil
4. Add butter
5. Toss in the cooked pasta
6. Garnish with the cheese

title: not  fried zucchini
steps:
1. Cut the zucchini into thin wedges
2. In a shallow bowl , whisk together the vinegar , rosemary , and garlic
3. Add salt and pepper to taste
4. Add the zucchini and toss so that all the sticks are thoroughly coated
5. Allow the zucchini to absorb the marinade for 2-3 minutes
6. Coat a baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray
7. Arrange the zucchini on the prepared baking sheet
8. Roast at 375 for 25 to 30 minutes , or until dark brown

title: absolute stress  alcoholic  pineapple version
steps:
1. Combine rum , vodka & schnapps in a shaker that's half full of ice & shake till frosty
2. Pour into highball glass then add cranberry & pineapple juices
3. Garnish with fruit on cocktail pick & serve

title: quick and simple no bake lemon mousse
steps:
1. Start with eggs at room temperature
2. Separate eggs , breaking yolks into the bowl of a nonreactive double boiler
3. Add sugar to the yolks and beat with an electric or immersion mixer until thick and pale
4. Grate the rind from one or both lemons and juice them both
5. Strain the juice
6. Add the rind and the 1 / 2 c , water to the sugar / yolk mix
7. More rind means more lemony flavor
8. I use it all but you may prefer less
9. Place the bowl over simmering water and cook , stirring very often , until the foam has mostly disappeared and the mix is thickened to a thin syrup
10. This takes a while and the foam disappearing is your best clue that it's done
11. Remove from heat
12. Mix the gelatin with 11 / 2 t
13. Cold water and immediately add it to the mix , stirring until the gelatin completely dissolves
14. Set aside to cool
15. Meanwhile , beat the egg whites to soft peaks in an electric mixer
16. Before you start make sure the bowl and whisk are perfectly clean as egg whites will not stiffen well if they touch even a trace of grease
17. Fold whites carefully into the sugar / yolk / gelatin mix
18. It can be hard to get all of the yolk mix folded in , so i flip the ingredients into another bowl so i can see and incorporate any remaining liquid
19. Place into the serving bowl or bowls of your choice
20. Refrigerate 5 hours or until serving time

title: seafood   prawn   squid stir fry
steps:
1. Shell and de-vein the prawns
2. Clean the squid , lightly cut a check pattern in the flesh and cut into
3. 1in squares
4. Add the garlic , ginger , squid and prawns and mix gently
5. Put the cashews in the wok and cover with water , bring this to the boil
6. Discard the water and allow the nuts to drain
7. Heat the 2tbl oil in the wok and then add the cashews and stir-fry until golden brown then allow to stand
8. Thinly slice the carrot and place in a saucepan with the drained bamboo shoots , cover in water and bring to the boil , simmer 1 min then drain
9. Cut the spring onions diagonally into 2cm lengths
10. Mix the soy sauce , sugar , corn flower and water
11. Heat 2tea sps oil in the wok and stir-fry the prawns and squid until the squid starts to curl and the prawns change colour
12. Add the cashews , carrots and bamboo shoots and spring onions and stir-fry about 30 seconds
13. Add the water , soy etc and stir-fry until the sauce thickens

title: african millet salad with corn and peppers
steps:
1. In a two quart saucepan with tight-fitting lid , heat one tablespoon of the olive oil , then saute the onion over medium heat until very golden and soft
2. Add the garlic and ginger and cook for a minute , then add the paprika , black pepper , allspice and cayenne and cook for a minute more
3. Wash the millet quickly and drain
4. Add the millet to the pan and stir , coating the grains and cooking until hot to the touch
5. Add the water and salt and bring to a boil , then reduce the heat and cover
6. Simmer on low for 20 minutes before checking for doneness
7. When all the liquid is absorbed and the grain is tender , cover and take the pan off the heat for 10 minutes to steam
8. Scrape the cooked millet into a bowl and cover , then let cool
9. Whisk the remaining two tablespoons olive oil with the lemon juice and brown sugar in a small bowl
10. Stir the corn , bell pepper , tomato and parsley into the cooled millet mixture , then drizzle the dressing over it and stir to coat
11. Serve topped with the peanuts

title: umbrian style hot garlic and olive oil spaghetti
steps:
1. Prep ingredients while water boils for pasta- sauce is quickly prepared once spaghetti is cooking
2. Heat a heavy based pan
3. Add oil , garlic , chile , ginger , salt and pepper and continue heating until pieces begin sizzling , and garlic is starting to turn golden
4. Add the parsley and lemon / vinegar , lower heat and keep warm until pasta is cooked
5. When pasta is done , use tongs to put directly from the water into the hot sauce in the pan and toss , adding more salt and pepper to taste , if necessary
6. Serve immediately , offering optional additional black pepper , grated cheese , and a fire extinguisher

title: greek style burgers with feta aioli  8 ww pts
steps:
1. To prepare aioli , combine first 5 ingredientsina food processor , pulse 1 minute or until smooth , cover and chill prepare grill or broiler to prepare the burgers , place onion slices on a grill rack or broiler pan coated with cooking spray and cook 2 minutes each side
2. Set aside
3. Combine the beef and the next 9 ingredients ina large bowl
4. Divide the beef mix into 5 equal portions , shaping each portion into a 1 / 2-inch-thick patty
5. Place patties on grill rack or broiler pan coated with cooking spray , and cook for 6 minuteson each side or until burgers are done
6. Spread 1 1 / 2 tbsps aioli over top half of each bun
7. Place patties on bottom half of each bun

title: cream cheese corn casserole
steps:
1. Preheat over to 350 degrees f and grease an 8x8 inch baking dish
2. Heat oil in skillet over medium heat and saute onions until translucent
3. In large bowl combine butter and cream cheese
4. Stir in corn , cream corn , chilis and onions
5. Pour into prepared dish
6. Bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes
7. Remove from oven and stir in half of the french fried onions and sprinkle remaining onions on top
8. Bake 15 minutes longer

title: impossible buttermilk pie
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Grease pie plate
3. Beat all ingredients until smooth , 30 seconds in blender on high or 1 minute w / hand blender
4. Pour into pie plate
5. Bake for 40-45 minutes
6. Cool 5 minutes
7. Enjoy !

title: peshawari naan bread  bread machine
steps:
1. Add all ingredients to your bread machine in the order your machine recommends
2. If your machine recommends pre-heated liquids , just heat the skimmed milk till it's lukewarm
3. Start your machine on the dough setting
4. 10-15 minutes before your machine stops mixing and starts proving , add the sultanas
5. Preheat your oven to 250c and have 3 shelves in it
6. Grease 3 flat oven trays
7. When the bread machine has finished ,
8. Tear off a chunk of dough about 1 sixth of the total size and flatten out with the hands to a pear shape about half the size of your tray
9. Do not use a roller as the bread probably won't rise
10. Repeat till you have 6 naans on your trays
11. Bake in the oven for about 7 minutes , or until the bread just begins to colour
12. The bread can be frozen in bags for later use

title: mini christmas puds   quick n easy
steps:
1. Melt white choc in microwave
2. Drizzle white chocolate icing over top of biscuit , top each with a imitation cherry and decorate with green icing
3. Place in fridge to set
4. Viola -- little christmas puds

title: ice cream slice
steps:
1. Line a slice tray with cling wrap
2. Put half the biscuits on the tray
3. Beat the cream and condensed milk for about 5 mins , until it looks like whipped cream
4. Chop up your chocolate bar and fold thru
5. Pour mix over biscuits , and top with remaining biscuits
6. Try and put them in the same order as the bottom row , makes for easier cutting
7. Freeze for at least 2 hours

title: gourmet shrimp enchiladas
steps:
1. Filling:
2. Combine sour cream and cream cheese
3. Beat by hand until smooth
4. Add remaining ingredients and combine well
5. Set aside
6. Sauce:
7. Heat half and half with cream cheese until melted and smooth
8. In a separate small bowl combine tomatoes , onion , parsley , salt , and pepper
9. To assemble:
10. Lightly oil a shallow casserole large enough to hold 8 enchiladas in one layer
11. Pour enough of the cream cheese sauce to just lightly coat the bottom of the pan
12. On the center of each tortilla , place about 3 tbls
13. Filling mixture
14. Roll up and place seam-side down in casserole
15. Pour remaining cream cheese sauce over the enchiladas
16. Cover with tomato mixture and sprinkle with fontina cheese
17. Bake at 475 degrees for 10-12 min
18. , until filling is hot and bubbling

title: spinach   cheese calzones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. If making pizza dough start the dough first so it can rise while you make the filling
3. Heat oil in a large skillet and cook onion , covered , over medium-low for about 5 minutes
4. Stir in the garlic and cook , uncovered , for 1 minute
5. Stir in the spinach and cook until wilted , about 2 minutes
6. Transfer vegetables to a mixing bowl and stir in the ricotta , nutmeg , salt and cayenne
7. Then stir in egg yolk and feta until mixed
8. Sprinkle a large baking sheet with the cornmeal
9. On a flat surface , roll or pat the pizza dough to a rough 12- or 14-inch square
10. Use a sharp knife or pizza wheel to cut the dough into 4 equal squares
11. Divide the filling among the dough squares , spooning it onto one diagonal half of each square and leaving about a 1 / 2-inch margin all around
12. Fold the top over to make a triangle and seal the edges by pressing with a fork
13. Use a knife to make 3 slashes on the top of each calzone
14. Place calzones on the baking sheet and bake until golden brown , 25 to 30 minutes
15. Serve with heated marinara sauce for dipping

title: cheese zombies
steps:
1. Thaw bread dough and divide in half
2. Using whatever means you feel is necessary , spread dough in a 13x18 inch jelly roll pan , or any pan with low sides
3. Shred your cheese and reserve 4 ounces
4. Spread 12 ounces of cheese over bread dough
5. Roll second half of dough into a 13x18 inch square and place on top of the cheese
6. Press down the edges a bit to keep the top and the bottom the same size during baking
7. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes sprinkle remaining 4 ounces of cheese on the top of the bread and bake another 5 minutes
8. Let this cool for about 20 mins before cutting into 12 squares
9. Serve with soup or steamed veggies
10. Variations: add fun things to the cheese in the middle like chopped red pepper , chopped mushrooms , sliced green onion , or chopped black olives
11. I do not recommend spinach as a potential add-in since it's so water-filled
12. I know , i know , so are mushrooms , but not as much

title: lemon coconut pound cake
steps: 1. Preheat oven to 325 grease and flour a 10" tube pan in a large bowl beat sugar , butter and shortening until fluffy add eggs one at a time , beating after each addition add lemon juice and extracts add flour and eggnog , beating well stir in coconut pour into prepared pan and bake for 1 hr 15 minsuntil done cool for 10 minutes turn out to a wire rack , cool completely for glaze , mix together the ingredients and drizzle over cake

title: gilroy marinated garlic mushrooms
steps:
1. Saute garlic in oil and add vinegar , wine , soy sauce , honey , parsley , and salt
2. Stir util mixture is hot
3. Place mushrooms in container and pour hot mixture over mushrooms
4. Marinate for 3 hours or more , turning over several times
5. You can use marinade for later use on more mushrooms or as a salad dressing

title: blueberry muffin bread  bread machine
steps:
1. Add all the ingredients to the bread pan following the manufactures's directions for your bread machine
2. Set the machine for the basic bread cycle
3. Select the medium crust setting
4. Do not use the delay cycle for this bread recipe
5. Optional powdered sugar glaze
6. Stir together in a small mixing bowl 1 / 2 cup sifted powdered sugar and 1-2 teaspoons milk to make a glaze to drizzle over the loaf of bread

title: kitchenaid pull apart dinner rolls    small batch
steps:
1. Place warm water , yeast and sugar in the mixer bowl
2. Let sit for 5 minutes or until bubbly
3. Add in butter , beaten egg ans salt : mix together
4. Add flour , a little at a time until a smooth dough is formed
5. Knead with dough hook for an additional 5 minutes
6. Place dough in oiled bowl-turn over dough bowl so oil is on both sides
7. Cover with saran wrap
8. Let rise for 1 hour or until doubled and light
9. Punch dough down and divide dough into 6 pieces
10. Rolls dough balls and place into greased round or square baking pan
11. Cover with wrap and let rise for another 30 minutes
12. Bake in preheated 400 f oven for 30-35 minutes or until golden brown
13. Remove from oven and brush with additional butter
14. Let rolls sit in pan for 20 minutes before taking out

title: chicken elia
steps:
1. Place chicken breast on a cookie sheet lined with aluminum foil
2. Sprinkle each piece of chicken with 1 tsp each of olive oil , lemon juice , soy sauce , rosemary , salt , pepper , and garlic powder
3. Drizzle 1-1 1 / 2 tsp honey over each piece of chicken
4. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and marinate for several hours
5. Bake , uncovered , at 350 degrees for one hour

title: double chocolate bundt cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Melt 2 ounces of the chocolate over low heat in a small saucepan , stirring constantly
3. Scrape the chocolate into a medium bowl and let cool slightly
4. Whisk in the oil and sugar until smooth , then whisk in the egg
5. In a small bowl , mix together the flour , cocoa , baking soda , and salt
6. Add half to the chocolate mixture along with 1 / 2 cup coffee and 1 / 2 cup buttermilk
7. Whisk until smooth
8. Add remaining dry ingredients , coffee and buttermilk
9. Whisk until smooth
10. Pour into a 12-cup bundt pan that has been sprayed with vegetable oil spray
11. Bake in the lower third of the oven for about 35-40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out with a few moist crumbs attached
12. Let cake cool on a rack for 10 minutes , then turn it out and let cool completely
13. Ganache glaze
14. Bring the cream to a boil in a small saucepan
15. In a heatproof bowl , combine the remaining 3 ounces of chocolate with the corn syrup and butter
16. Pour the hot cream over the chocolate and let stand until melted
17. Whisk until smooth
18. Let the ganache cool until thick but still pourable
19. Pour ganache over the cooled cake
20. Let the cake stand until the glaze is set before serving

title: super easy canned bean stew
steps:
1. Sautee the onion and carrots in some cooking spray
2. Add the broth , the drained beans , and the canned tomatoes
3. Season with spices
4. Simmer for 10 minutes

title: pasta with garlic and oilaglio e olio
steps:
1. Adjust oven rack to lower-middle position , set large heatproof serving bowl on rack and heat oven to 200 degrees
2. Bring 4 quarts water to rolling boil , covered , in large dutch oven or stockpot
3. Add pasta and 1 1 / 2 teaspoons table salt to boiling water , stir to separate pasta , cover , and cook until al dente
4. Reserve 1 / 3 cup pasta cooking water and drain pasta
5. While water is heating , combine 3 tablespoons oil , 3 tablespoons garlic , and 1 / 2 teaspoon table salt or sea salt flakes in heavy-bottomed nonstick 10-inch skillet
6. Cook over low heat , stirring constantly , until garlic foams and is sticky and straw-colored , 10 to 12 minutes
7. Off heat , add remaining tablespoon raw garlic , red pepper flakes , parsley , lemon juice , and 2 tablespoons pasta cooking water to skillet and stir well to keep garlic from clumping
8. Transfer drained pasta to warm serving bowl
9. Add remaining 3 tablespoons olive oil and remaining reserved pasta cooking water and toss to coat
10. Add garlic mixture and 3 / 4 teaspoon table salt or 1 teaspoon sea salt flakes to pasta
11. Toss well to combine
12. Serve immediately , sprinkling individual bowls with portion of parmesan , if desired

title: a la truck shrimp
steps:
1. Thoroughly combine the lime juice , sugar , fish sauce or oyster sauce and sambal or chili paste in a jar or small bowl sauce
2. Pour this sauce into a 10-inch non-stick pan
3. Turn the heat to medium high and bring to a boil
4. Add the shrimp and reduce heat to medium low
5. Cook until the shrimp is tender and the sauce thickens slightly , about 3 to 4 minutes if you like a thicker sauce , temporarily remove the cooked shrimp with a slotted spoon while the sauce continues to thicken , this will prevent the shrimp from becoming overcooked and rubbery
6. Add cilantro to the sauce
7. Taste and adjust the seasonings , pour over cooked rice or noodles

title: chewy  peanut free  granola bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large bowl , mix together dry ingredients (barley flakes , rolled outs , crisped rice , wheat germ , flour , almonds , flax meal , and coconut flakes
3. At a low heat , slowly melt the sugar on the stove in a sauce pan , stirring regularly (you can substitute additional honey and molasses for this , if it's too much work , but i couldn't get the "stickiness" i wanted without melting the sugar
4. Once the sugar s melted through , immediately add the melted butter followed by the honey , agave nectar , and molasses
5. Stir in the sunflower butter , vanilla extract , and liquid lecithin
6. Once your wet ingredients are well combined , pour them into the dry ingredients
7. Mix together with a wooden spoon until all the dry ingredients are incorporated
8. Finally , add the chocolate chips
9. Spread into 2 greased 8x11 pans
10. Use a glass to smooth out the mixture making it uniform in thickness
11. Feel free to add additional chocolate chips at this time if they don't seem to be evenly dispersed
12. I just sprinkle them where i want them and then roll them into the mixture with the glass
13. Cook at 350 degrees for 20 minute
14. For best results , let cool in the greased pans for 12-24 hours before cutting
15. Cut them into bar form and they are ready to eat !

title: cocoa krispies cupcakes
steps:
1. Grease 24 muffin pans
2. Butter a 4 quart microwavable bowl on high for 45 seconds or until melted place marshmallows in the bowl and mix around to ensure it is coated with the melted butter
3. Place in the microwave for 45 seconds and then stir
4. Replace in the microwave for another 30 seconds or until marhmallows are melted
5. Add cereal to melted mixture and stir well
6. Firmly pack cereal into the muffin pans to form a cupcake
7. Let cool
8. After cooled , remove , frost and decorate as desired

title: hey diddle diddles
steps:
1. Cream the margarine , sugar and peanut butter well
2. Beat in the egg and vanilla
3. Stir in the baking soda , then the cocoa and flour
4. Form this dough into 30 balls for regular sized cookies
5. Combine the filling ingredients and form into 30 balls
6. With floured hands , shape the chocolate ball around the peanut butter centers
7. Place 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet
8. If they are not totally covered that's ok
9. Flatten slightly with the bottom of a drinking glass dipped in sugar
10. Bake in a preheated oven 375 degrees for 7-9 minutes
11. This makes chocolate cookies with soft peanut butter centers that taste like peanut butter cups !

title: sun maid old fashioned creamy rice pudding
steps:
1. Combine rice , sugar , milk , and salt in a 6-cup baking dish
2. Bake in a moderately slow oven 2 hours , until rice is very soft , stirring every 20 minutes
3. Stir in vanilla and raisins , sprinkle with cinnamon , bake without stirring until a light golden crust forms , about 15 minutes longer

title: chocolate challah  bread machine
steps:
1. Add the ingredients , except the chocolate chips , in the pan according to the order in the manufacturer's
2. Instructions
3. Set crust on medium and program for basic or sweet bread cycle
4. Press start
5. At the beep , add the chocolate chips
6. When the baking cycle ends , immediately remove the bread from the pan and place it on a rack
7. Let cool to room temperature before slicing

title: outback steakhouse tangy tomato salad dressing
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a small non-reactive saucepan over medium heat , stirring , until boiling
2. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
3. Set aside to cool
4. Pour into a clean covered jar and refrigerate
5. Makes 1 1 / 4 cups or 10 servings

title: mulled apple juice
steps:
1. Mix the water and juice concentrate together and pour into a large teapot or 3 quart saucepan
2. Add all spices to juice , cover , and bring to a boil for 2 minutes
3. Remove from heat but keep the lid on
4. Allow to cool for 10-15 minutes
5. Strain through cheesecloth or wire mesh strainer into serving container
6. This drink keeps well in the refrigerator to be reheated by stove or microwave for single serving or later use

title: ultimate  dark chocolate oreo truffle
steps:
1. Set out 1 pkg philadelphia cream cheese
2. In a blender or food processor , blend 1 pks oreos until a fine powder is formed throughout
3. If you do it all at once , it's impossible to get a consistent powder
4. Remove any remaining cookie pieces
5. Knead 1 pkg philadelphia cream cheese into mix until mixture is consistent throughout
6. Roll into 2 in balls and place on cookie sheet
7. Refrigerate 30 minute
8. Melt 1 bar baker's semi-sweet chocolate
9. Using two spoons , coat each ball individually
10. Place on cookie sheet and refrigerate 30 minute

title: killer chocolate chunk muffins
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Line 12 muffin tins with paper liners
3. Place the muffin tins on a baking sheet
4. In a bowl with an electric mixer , cream butter and cream cheese , until fluffy
5. Add in the both sugars
6. Beat until combined
7. Add in eggs and vanilla
8. Blend well
9. Fold in sour cream
10. In a bowl , blend together the flour , cocoa , baking powder , baking soda and salt
11. Fold , do not beat into the batter , making certain not to overmix
12. Fold in the chocolate chips by hand
13. Using a large ice-cream scoop , scoop the muffins into the prepared muffin tin
14. Bake about 25-30 minutes , or until muffins spring back when touched , or a toothick inserted in the middle comes out clean

title: fresh vanilla bean vinaigrette
steps:
1. Place the oil , vanilla bean pods and seeds into a small sauce pan over medium heat
2. Bring the oil up to a low simmer , and then remove from heat and let stand at least 1 hour to infuse the vanilla flavor
3. Strain the oil through a fine sieve to remove the vanilla pod
4. Cool completely
5. Combine all ingredients except the oil in a small immersion blender or food processor , pulsing until the mixture is completely blended and smooth
6. Slowly add the oil while blending until the mixture is completely emulsified
7. Transfer to a small bowl or squeeze bottle and chill before dressing salad

title: oven baked sweet potato   chicken risotto
steps:
1. Preheat oven 190c
2. Put rice , sweet potato , stock and butter in oven proof dish
3. Seal with foil or place on a well fitting lid
4. Cook for 30 minutes , then check and stir
5. Cook further 5 minutes
6. Remove , add chicken , cheese , thyme , salt and pepper and stir until creamy
7. Serve immediately

title: ploye
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients
2. Add 2 cups cold water to the dry ingredients and mix well
3. Let stand 5 minutes
4. Add 1 cup boiling water and mix vigorously
5. If batter looks too thick , add a little bit of cold water
6. Pour batter as you would a pancake in cast iron skillet or i have used a breakfast plate to cook mine and they came out very good
7. Let the ploye cook , you will see little holes come up everywhere , the more holes , the better your ploye is
8. When you see that the mixture is not liquid anymore , your ploye is ready
9. Only cook on one side , a ploye is not to be turned to cook
10. To really have good ployes you have to mix your batter between each ploye

title: mocha cream liqueur
steps:
1. Put all ingredients in blender anc cover tightly
2. Blend on high speed until the mixture is well blended and smooth
3. Serve in small glasses over crushed ice
4. Also excellent in coffee or chai tea
5. Store in a tightly covered container in the refrigerator for up to two weeks
6. Make sure to stir or shake thoroughly before serving
7. Makes an excellent gift !

title: south of the border pick up sticks
steps:
1. In a 13 x 9 x 2 casserole dish , combine the potato sticks , peanuts and onions
2. Drizzle this mixture with the melted butter and stir well
3. Sprinkle the top with taco seasoning and mix well
4. Bake at 250 degrees for 45 minutes stirring every 15 minutes for about 30 minutes
5. Remove from oven and place mixture on paper towels to dry
6. Cool and serve

title: hollywood filet mignon
steps:
1. Combine broth , red wine , flour , mushrooms , onions , and shallots in medium glass baking dish and mix well until flour is no longer visible
2. Poke fillets about 3 times on both sides with a fork
3. Cover them completely with maggi seasoning
4. Let sit for 10 minutes or place in ziplock bag and into the fridge for 5 minutes
5. Preheat oven to 425
6. Place fillets inside dish covering with broth on both sides and place in the oven
7. Make sure broth covers at least half of the fillet
8. Flip fillets after 20 minutes and add a pinch of kosher salt and pepper to the top of fillets
9. Flip fillets again after another 20 minutes and add the rest of the salt and pepper to the top of the fillets
10. With a fork , place butter on top of each one
11. Place back in oven
12. Cook to your desired taste
13. If you want them medium well cook for 10-20 more minutes , if you want them well done , cook 15-30 minutes longer , turning them over once more if needed
14. Either way this will come out the juiciest and most flavorful fillet you've ever tasted
15. Enjoy !

title: cinnamon nut cake
steps:
1. Cream together butter and sugar
2. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each
3. Sift together flour and baking powder
4. Gradually add to the creamed mixture blending well
5. Stir 2 tsp baking soda into sour cream
6. Add to mixture and blend well
7. Stir in nuts
8. Pour approx
9. 1 / 3 of batter into greased and floured tube or bundt pan
10. Mix cinnamon& 3 tbsp sugar
11. Sprinkle half of cinnamon and sugar mixture over batter
12. Swirl with a knife
13. Repeat with remaining batter and sugar mixture , ending with batter
14. Bake at 350 for 1 hour
15. Cool for 10 minutes
16. Remove from pan and cool completely
17. Dust with confectioners sugar

title: vegan pastry cream
steps:
1. In a small bowl , place the flour and whisk in 1 / 2 cups soy milk , and set aside
2. In a small saucepan , place the remaining soy milk , sugar , and salt , and whisk to combine add the flour mixture to the liquid ingredients and whisk well to combine
3. Cook the mixture over medium heat , while whisking constantly , for 5-6 minutes or until thickened add the remaining ingredients , whisk well to combine , and cook the mixture an additional 1 minute remove the saucepan from the heat and transfer the mixture to a glass bowl
4. Place a piece of waxed paper or plastic wrap directly on top of the pastry cream to prevent a skin from forming on the top place the pastry cream in the refrigerator for several hours to cool completely

title: artichoke parmesan dressing
steps:
1. Combine all of the ingredients in a blender or food processor
2. Process until well combined

title: tomato   feta salad
steps:
1. Prepare dressing:
2. In a jar combine the olive oil , vinegar , garlic , salt & pepper
3. Shake well
4. Set aside
5. Just prior to serving , slice tomato , sprinkle with feta
6. Shake dressing well to combine and drizzle over all

title: swedish hamburgers  malda flaskbiffar
steps:
1. Soak bread crumbs and seasonings in water and cup cream for 10 minutes
2. Add pork , egg and parsley
3. Mix well until blended
4. Shape into 8 round flat patties
5. Melt half of margarine in large skillet
6. Fry patties about 4-5 minutes on each side over medium heat
7. Place on warm platter and keep warm
8. Peel and thinly slice onions
9. Saut in remaining margarine until soft and golden about 12-15 minutes
10. Spoon onions over burgers and keep warm
11. Pour 1 cup cream into frying pan
12. Cook , stirring down the sides for about 4-5 minutes until it starts to thicken
13. Season with salt and pepper
14. Pour over burgers and serve immediately , preferably over mashed potatoes

title: pioneer bread pudding
steps:
1. For bread pudding: place bread cubes in a greased 1 quart baking dish
2. In a saucepan , heat next four ingredients over low heat until butter melts
3. In a bowl , beat eggs
4. Whisk in warm milk mixture
5. Stir in vanilla
6. Pour over bread
7. Place baking dish in a shallow pan of hot water
8. Bake , uncovered , at 350f for 40-45 minutes or until a knife inserted 1' from edge comes out clean
9. For lemon sauce: combine sugar , cornstarch and salt in a saucepan , stir in water and lemon peel
10. Bring to a boil
11. Cook and stir for 2 minutes
12. Remove from heat
13. Stir in butter , lemon juice and food coloring
14. Serve warm or cold with the pudding
15. Refrigerate leftovers

title: tomato and macaroni dinner
steps:
1. Cook macaroni according to package directions
2. Cook onion in vegetable oil
3. Add in ground beef and cook until meat is browned
4. Stir in tomatoes , macaroni , and spices
5. Bring to a boil
6. Cover and simmer , stirring often for 10min
7. Uncover and boil if not thick enough

title: my mom s carne asada
steps:
1. Place meat , soy sauce , garlic and pepper in a resealable bag
2. Marinate for at least 4 hours
3. Grill 3 minutes or longer depending on thickness on each side
4. Let rest for 5 minutes before slicing
5. Serve with tortillas and toppings
6. Enjoy !

title: green goddess chive salad dressing
steps:
1. Combine the first 8 ingredients in a blender or processor
2. Blend until smooth
3. If the dressing is too thick add in a litle buttermilk to thin then season with salt and pepper to taste
4. Refrigerate for a minumum of 4 hours before using

title: chocolate fudge cookies with toffee   dried cherries
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f line two heavy baking sheets , not non-stick with parchment paper and set aside
2. Sift flour , cocoa , baking soda and salt together in a bowl and set aside
3. In a large mixing bowl or the bowl of an electric or stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment , cream together the butter and both sugars until light in colour and fluffy - about 2 minutes
4. Add the eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition and scraping down the sides of the bowl
5. Beat in the vanilla
6. Stir in the flour-mixture in 3 additions , blending just until the dry ingredients are moistened
7. This part is really easier with a wooden spoon since the batter is quite dense
8. Drop the batter by heaping tablespoons onto the prepared baking sheets and place them in the centre of the oven , turning half way through baking
9. Bake the cookies for 15-18 minutes or until barely set in the centre and just firm around the edges
10. Cool cookies on tray for 3-5 minutes , then transfer to wire rack to cool completely before storing
11. Store in air tight containers , layered between sheets of parchment or waxed paper for up to 5 days

title: herbed italian pot roast
steps:
1. Mix the salt , pepper and oregano together and rub all over the roast
2. Set aside
3. Heat the oil in a large skillet and brown the roast well on all sides
4. This is a really important step because it adds a lot of flavor through carmelization
5. Transfer roast to the slow cooker or heavy duty oven roaster
6. In the same skillet used to brown the roast , cook the onion , carrot , and garlic until the mixture is soft , then add them to the slow cooker or oven roaster
7. Combine the wine and tomatoes in a bowl and add to the slow cooker or oven roaster
8. Tie the rosemary basil and parsley together with kitchen string and add to the slow cooker or roaster
9. Mix the ingredients well , cover and cook in slow cooker for 4-5 hours on high or 6 to 8 hours on low
10. For the oven roaster , cover with heavy duty foil and cook 3 to 4 hours or until fork tender
11. When cooked , transfer the meat to a cutting board
12. Cover and allow to stand for 20 minutes
13. Cut into slices and return the meat to the slow cooker or oven roaster just to reheat
14. Serve hot with some of the sauce
15. The sauce is also good over pasta or rice

title: papa buds pizza sauce
steps:
1. Mix together and use on your pizza dough
2. This does make a large amount of sauce but freezes well

title: magic meatloaf
steps:
1. Mix egg , milk , salt and bread crumbs
2. Allow for mixture to soften
3. Thoroughly combine with hamburger
4. Shape into a loaf and place in crock pot
5. Top with ketchup
6. Cover and set to high for 1 hour then turn to low for 6-7 hours

title: hungry girl kung pao chicken 4 ww pts
steps:
1. Begin by combining 2 tablespoons of cold water with soy sauce , vinegar , splenda , cornstarch and chili sauce -- stir well until all ingredients have dissolved
2. Set sauce aside
3. Spray a large pan or wok with nonstick spray , and bring to medium-high heat
4. Add chicken , mushrooms , bell peppers , celery , onion , garlic and 2 tablespoons of water
5. Stirring occasionally , cook for about 5 minutes
6. Once chicken is almost fully cooked but still tender , add peanuts and water chestnuts to the pan or wok
7. Raise heat to high , give sauce a stir , and add it to the pan / wok as well
8. Mix entire dish until all ingredients are coated in sauce , and the sauce is hot and thick
9. Season to taste with salt , pepper , and red pepper flakes
10. Enjoy !

title: lauren s oat bran pancakes
steps:
1. Whisk together the wet ingredients
2. Add all dry ingredients except oat bran and mix well
3. Stir in oat bran
4. Fry on griddle at medium heat in a little oil or cooking spray

title: roasted red pepper  garlic and anchovy appetizer
steps:
1. Place roasted red peppers on plate
2. Place 2-3 anchovy fillets on peppers
3. Add desired amount of minced garlic
4. Add extra virgin oil as desired
5. Enjoy the great combination of flavors
6. Guaranteed to come back for more !

title: turnip and onion hot dish
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Peel turnips , cut in half lenthwise , then slice each half crosswise into thin slices
3. Arrange alternate layers of turnip and onion in a greased 2 1 / 2-quart casserole dish
4. Sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper
5. Dissolve bouillon cube in boiling water and pour over vegetables
6. Dot with butter or margarine
7. Cover casserole with foil or lid and bake 1 hour 15 minutes , or until turnips are tender

title: peachy licious oatmeal
steps:
1. Heat the juice to a simmer in a small saucepan
2. Stir in the oats , and let it cook for 2-4 minutes to thicken up
3. Add a little water if needed
4. Meanwhile , mash the banana in a bowl till very smooth
5. When the oats are ready , remove from heat and add the banana , chopped fruit and sweetener
6. Stir together and let the saucepan sit covered for 2-3 minutes to let the fruitiness blend
7. Then dig in !

title: garlic pizza wedges
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Place crust on an ungreased 14 in pizza pan
3. In a small bowl , combine cheese , mayonnaise , onion , garlic and oregano
4. Spread over crust
5. Bake at 450 degrees for 8 to 10 minutes or until edges are lightly browned
6. Cut into wedges and serve warm or slightly cooled

title: slimming world green day cannelloni
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200c / 400f / gas6
2. Blanch spinach in boiling water for 30 seconds , drain and place in a bowl
3. Mix together the quark and cottage cheese
4. Crush 1 clove of garlic and stir into the mixture with the lemon zest 1 / 2 the basil , the parsley and the egg yolk
5. Add the mixture to the spinach , season to taste and combine
6. Spoon mixture into tubes and place in an oven-proof dish
7. Crush the remaining garlic and mix with the passata , sweetener and remaining herbs
8. Season to taste
9. Pour over the pasta , sprinkle with the parmesan and bake for 20 minutes until bubbling
10. Garnish with fresh basil leaves and serve with a salad

title: blackhawk chicken
steps:
1. Wrap each slice of gruyere in a slice of prosciutto
2. Put boned breasts between 2 pieces of wax paper and pound them with the flat side of a cleaver or heavy knife
3. Wrap each chicken breast piece securely around a ham packet , covering it completely , using toothpicks to secure , if you desire
4. Dust with seasoned flour then dip in beaten egg and roll in fine bread crumbs
5. Refrigerate at least 1 hour
6. Brown breasts carefully on both sides in butter , then arrange on a heat proof platter and finish cooking in oven at 350 degrees for 10 minutes or until fork thender
7. Do not allow them to dry out
8. Into the pan in which they were browned , pour cognac , ignite and when the flame dies down , add cream
9. Simmer until thickened
10. Add salt and pepper to taste
11. Pour sauce over chicken just before serving

title: easy chocolate cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Grease 2 baking sheets with butter
3. Put the confectioners' sugar into a medium bowl and set aside
4. In another medium bowl , stir together the flour , cocoa , baking powder , and salt
5. In a large bowl , using an electric mixer on medium speed , beat the butter and sugar and vanilla extract for about 3 minutes
6. Make sure to scrape down the sides of the bowl !
7. Add one egg to the bowl and beat until blended
8. Then , add the second egg
9. Add the flour mixture
10. Mix on low speed until blended
11. Using a tablespoon , scoop up a rounded spoonful of dough
12. Roll the dough into a ball using your hands
13. Roll the ball in the confectioners' sugar until covered
14. Place the balls on the prepared baking sheet
15. Space each ball of dough about 2 inches apart
16. Bake cookies for 10 to 12 minutes , until crackled and puffed
17. Enjoy ! (:

title: chilled tomato and yogurt soup
steps:
1. Saute the onion in butter in a large saucepan over medium heat , stirring constnatly , until tender
2. Add tomato , cucumber , chicken broth and basil
3. Bring to a boil
4. Reduce heaet , and simmer , uncovered , 30 minutes , stirring frequently
5. Transfer half of the tomato mixture to a blender , cover and process until smooth
6. Repeat the procedure with the remaining mixture
7. Stir in the yogurt and salt
8. Cover and chill
9. To serve , ladle into individual soup bowls
10. Garnish with fresh chopped mint

title: basboosa
steps:
1. To make the syrup: peel the lemon with a potato peeler to get flat strips of peel
2. Juice the lemon
3. Bring the sugar , water , and lemon juice to a boil
4. Throw in the rind of the lemon
5. Boil until the lemon rind is hard or the mixture is a runny syrup consistency
6. Add the honey
7. Set aside while you make the basboosa
8. Mix the semolina , flour , sugar , and baking powder
9. Add the oil and mix until all the batter is well blended
10. Grease a large cookie sheet tray
11. Add the milk just before you are about to bake
12. Dot the mixture into the greased pan by spoonfuls
13. Level the mixture with your hand
14. Shake the tray to level
15. Bake for 1 / 2 hour at 350 degrees
16. Cut into squares and return to the oven for 5-10 minutes
17. Pour the syrup over the basboosa immediately after you remove it from the oven the last time

title: buttermilk muffins with variations
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Prepare muffin cups by spraying with non cooking spray or lining with paper muffin cup liners
3. Mix together all streusel ingredients with a fork to make a crumbly mixture
4. Set aside
