5. For the batter , whisk together the oil , brown sugar , zest and egg
6. Stir in the buttermilk and vanilla
7. Stir together 2 1 / 2 cups flour , salt , baking powder , soda and cinnamon in a bowl
8. Add to the wet ingredients and blend
9. Fold in your desired fruit
10. The use of frozen fruit may help firm up the batter
11. If the batter seems too loose , add 1 / 4 cup more flour to make the batter stiffer
12. Fill the muffin cups to the top
13. Sprinkle streusel topping over each muffin evenly
14. Bake for 15 minutes , lower the oven temperature to 350f and bake for another 12 to 15 minutes or until the muffins spring back when pressed lightly
15. Let cool in pan for 5 minutes before unmolding onto wire racks

title: sweet jalapeo  glazed ribs
steps:
1. Mix dry rub ingredients and rub onto ribs
2. Let sit in refrigerator at least 30 minutes to two hours
3. Wrap ribs in foil and place on grill on low heat for 1 1 / 2 - 2 hours or until very tender
4. While ribs are cooking mix glaze ingredients and simmer until mixture begins to thicken
5. When ribs are tender remove from foil and place onto grill and turn heat up to medium brush glaze over ribs
6. Cook for another 20 minutes
7. Serve ribs with remaining glaze for dipping

title: applesauce cinnamon microwave mug cake
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a mug
2. Microwave on high for 2:22

title: cowboy chicken
steps:
1. Pre heat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Place the chicken in a shallow baking dish
3. In a medium bowl , stir together the salsa , brown sugar , and mustard
4. Pour over the chicken
5. Cover the dish with aluminum foil
6. Bake for 1 hour in the preheated oven , until chicken is cooked through
7. Remove the foil for the last 15 minutes to brown the chicken
8. Serve over rice

title: aunt nan s french dressing
steps: 1. Put all into blender jar , blend , and refrigerate

title: one pan chicken   rice
steps:
1. Spray large frying pan with pam cooking spray and cook chicken breasts until done
2. Cook onion with chicken if onions are desired
3. Cut chicken into bite size pieces
4. Add the can of cream of chicken soup
5. Add water to soup and chicken mixture and mix until creamy
6. Bring to a boil
7. Add rice and stir to mix
8. Return to a boil then reduce heat to simmer
9. Simmer for 5 minutes stirring occasionally so rice does not stick to the bottom
10. Turn off heat and let sit , covered , for an additional 5 minutes
11. This makes 4"hefty" servings but would easily serve 6 with side dishes
12. I have mixed broccoli in to this as well for a truly"one dish meal" and it is good

title: esther s orange marmalade cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Butter and flour 3 - 9 inch pans
3. In a large bowl , cream the butter , sugar and oil
4. Add the baking powder , orange zest , vanilla and salt
5. Beat until creamy
6. Add the eggs and egg yolks , one at a time
7. Alternately add the flour with the buttermilk
8. Divide the batter between the 3 pans
9. Bake for 25 or 30 minutes
10. Cool for 20 minutes
11. Syrup:
12. Mix the orange juice and sugar together
13. Poke holes in cake with a fork
14. Spoon on the syrup
15. Frosting:
16. Beat the whipping cream and sugar together until soft peaks form
17. Fold in the sour cream
18. To assemble this bad boy:
19. Put 1 cake on plate
20. Spread 1 / 3 marmalade on it
21. Put 2nd cake on top and spread again with 1 / 3 marmalade
22. Put the last cake on top
23. Spread marmalade in center , leaving a 1-1 / 2 inch border
24. Frost the side and the border
25. You need to refrigerate this overnight so it can set and meld together

title: chunky chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Combine flour , baking soda , cinnamon , and salt in medium bowl
2. Whisk together oil , granulated sugar , and brown sugar in large bowl
3. Whisk in egg whites and vanilla until smooth
4. Stir in dry ingredients until blended
5. Fold in oats and then chocolate
6. Cover and chill dough at least 15 minutes
7. Mean while , heat oven to 375
8. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper
9. Shape dough into 16 balls with hands , using a little pressure
10. Place 8 balls on each prepared sheet
11. With fingers , press each into a patty about 3" in dibmeter , allowing about 2" between patties for slight spreading
12. Bake 7-10 minutes or until desired browness , switching position of sheets halfway through
13. Let cool a few minutes before moving to rack to cool completely

title: banana bread and butter pudding
steps:
1. Remove crusts from bread and spread slices with jam on one side
2. Cut the bread slices in half diagonally
3. Arrange a 1 / 3 of the bread over the base of a 2 litre greased ovenproof dish
4. Top the bread with half of the sliced banana and half the coconut and sultanas
5. Repeat another layer of bread slices , topped with all of the remaining banana , coconut and sultanas
6. Finish off with a final layer of bread slices on top
7. Beat the eggs , milk , vanilla and sugar in a bowl until well combined
8. Pour over the dish and let dish stand for 15 minutes
9. Heat the oven to 180 degree c
10. Place a large baking dish with sides into the oven
11. Place the pudding dish in the larger dish
12. Now pour boiling water into the larger dish until the water comes halfway up the sides of the pudding dish
13. Cook for 1 1 / 4 hours or until set
14. Cover the pudding with foil after 30 minutes to prevent over browning
15. Serve dusted with the icing sugar
16. This is fabulous with vanilla or macadamia nut icecream
17. Also lovely served with maple syrup or passionfruit sauce or any combination !

title: sweet vege macaroni salad
steps:
1. Cook macaroni as directed on box
2. Drain and rinse in cold water
3. In a large bowl , combine all salad ingredients
4. In a small bowl , combine the dressing ingredients
5. Pour the dressing ingredients over the macaroni salad and toss to coat
6. Refrigerate until serving

title: turkey stew with dumplings
steps:
1. In a soup pot or dutch oven , saute carrots , celery and onion in butter for 10 minutes
2. Add consomme , water , salt and pepper
3. Cover and cook over low heat for 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender
4. Add turkey and beans
5. Cook for five minutes
6. In a small bowl , combine flour , worcestershire sauce and remaining water until smooth
7. Stir into turkey mixture
8. Bring to a boil
9. Reduce heat and cover , simmering for an additional five minutes , stirring occasionally
10. For dumplings , combine flour , baking powder and salt into flour mixture just until moistened
11. Drop by tablespoons onto simmering stew
12. Cover and simmer for ten minutes
13. Uncover and simmer ten minutes longer

title: bleu krab quiche
steps:
1. Saute the onions in the butter until caramelized
2. Distribute the caramelized onions over the bottom of the crust
3. Sprinkle the krab over the onions and then top with the bleu cheese , mozzarella and provolone
4. Whisk together the eggs , milk , salt and pepper and then pour the mixture into the crust
5. Sprinkle the top with parmesan cheese
6. Bake at 350f for 40 to 50 minutes
7. Allow to set at least 5 minutes before serving

title: holiday rice dish
steps:
1. Combine rice and broth in saucepan and bring to boil
2. Reduce heat to low , cover and simmer until rice is tender and broth absorbed , about 20 minutes
3. In a medium skillet , melt butter over medium-high heat and add onions and sugar
4. Saute until butter is absorbed and onion is translucent and soft
5. Lower heat and cook onions for another 15 minutes or until they are caramelised
6. Stir in cranberries and mushrooms
7. Cover skillet and cook for 10 minutes until cranberries soften and swell
8. Stir in nuts and orange zest , then fold into the cooked rice
9. Add salt to taste

title: german butterballs
steps:
1. Mix all together , and roll into walnut size balls
2. Drop into a light boiling to a simmer chicken stock
3. Always try one first
4. If it breaks apart , add one more egg to bind
5. Different breads and dryness makes this not always perfection

title: twinkie tiramisu with espresso syrup
steps:
1. Espresso syrup: combine water and sugar in a small saucepan
2. Bring to a simmer over medium high heat , stirring occasionally to dissolve sugar
3. Remove from heat , cool and add coffee and brandy
4. Mascarpone filling: beat mascarpone , sugar and vanilla until smooth
5. Whip cream until soft peaks form
6. Fold gently whipped cream into mascarpone mixture
7. To assemble: place a layer of the twinkie slices in the bottom of a shallow 2 1 / 2 quart baking dish
8. Drizzle with half of the espresso syrup
9. Spread with half of the mascarpone filling
10. Repeat with the remaining twinkie slices , syrup and filling
11. Smooth top with a spatula
12. Cover and refrigerate for up to 24 hours before serving
13. Just prior to serving , sift cocoa to lightly dust the top

title: peach cobbler cocktail
steps:
1. Fill a large wine goblet with crushed ice
2. Gently muddle the rye , peach nectar , dash of bitters , peaches , mint , and a squeeze of lemon juice in a cocktail shaker
3. Pour over ice and serve cold

title: spicy chili chipotle rice
steps:
1. Chop up chipotle chilie
2. Combine all ingridents
3. Bring to a boil
4. Cover and simmer on lowest heat
5. Remove 20 to 25mins
6. Fluff rice to serve

title: crock pot chicken adobo
steps:
1. Put chicken thighs in the crock-pot
2. Mix all remaining ingredients and pour over chicken
3. Cook on low for 8 hours or until chicken falls apart
4. Serve over rice with broccoli as a side dish

title: fabulous fettuccine
steps:
1. In a skillet , cook bacon until crisp
2. Remove to paper towels
3. Drain , reserving 1 tbsp drippings
4. Add oil and onions to drippings
5. Saute until tender , about 5 minutes
6. Add tomatoes and garlic
7. Simmer uncovered for 5 minutes
8. Stir in tarragon , salt , pepper and cayenne
9. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes , stirring occasionally
10. Meanwhile , cook fettuccine according to package directions
11. Add parsley to the tomato mixture
12. Simmer 5 minutes longer
13. Stir in bacon
14. Drain fettuccine
15. Top with tomato mixture
16. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese

title: if shrimp had wings  they d be buffalo
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in large skillet over medium heat
2. Season the shrimp with salt , pepper , and garlic powder
3. Add to skillet
4. Saute for 3 to 5 minutes or until the shrimp just turn pink
5. Add the hot sauce and chicken stock ,
6. Cook for another minute
7. Remove from heat and add heavy cream
8. Serve immediately and enjoy !

title: salmon poached in champagne with capers   tarragon
steps:
1. Place salmon in a shallow pan large enough to hold in a single layer
2. Add champagne , lemon juice , zest and enough water to just cover fillets
3. Remove fish and bring poaching liquid to a boil
4. Lay fish skin sides down back in pan and top with onion slices , capers , olives , tarragon , salt and pepper
5. Reduce heat until liquid is at a very low simmer and poach 4 to 6 minutes , depending on thickness of the fish
6. Fish is done when flesh is opaque and flakes easily with a fork
7. Remove fish from liquid , along with onions , capers , olives , and tarragon
8. Drain well and serve immediately

title: tender flank steak taste of home
steps:
1. In a large resealable plastic bag , combine the soy sauce , lemon juice , honey and garlic
2. Add steak
3. Seal bag and turn to coat
4. Refrigerate for 6-8 hours
5. Drain and discard marinade
6. Broil 4-6 inches from the heat or grill over medium heat for 8-10 minutes on each side or until meat reaches desired doneness
7. Thinly slice steak across the grain

title: mild and creamy macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Cook macaroni and drain
3. Melt butter in pan
4. Remove from heat and stir in salt , pepper and flour until smooth , making a light roux
5. Gradually stir in milk
6. Return to heat and bring to a boil , stirring constantly
7. Reduce heat and stir in 1 1 / 2 cups cheese
8. Add macaroni
9. Pour into 1 1 / 2 quart casserole
10. Arrange tomato slices on top , and sprinkle with remaining cheese
11. Bake for 15-20 minutes , until hot and bubbly

title: beer braised bratwursts with onion
steps:
1. Place mustard seeds and caraway seeds in a small resealable plastic bag and crush with a meat mallet or rolling pin
2. Melt butter in a dutch oven or a large , heavy-bottomed pot with a tightfitting lid over medium heat
3. When the foaming subsides , add 6 of the bratwursts and cook , turning , until browned on all sides , about 10 minutes
4. Remove to a plate and repeat with remaining bratwursts
5. Reduce heat to low , add crushed seed mixture and onions , and season generously with salt and freshly ground black pepper
6. Cook , stirring occasionally , until onions have softened and are beginning to brown , about 30 minutes
7. Add reserved bratwursts and any accumulated juices , nestling the brats in the onions
8. Pour in beer and braise bratwursts , turning once , until they are completely cooked through , about 30 minutes
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste
10. Toast hoagie rolls and spread about 1 1 / 2 tablespoons mustard on each
11. Place a bratwurst in each bun and cover with onions

title: cranberry pineapple iced tea
steps:
1. Prepare tea by letting tea bag steep in boiling water
2. Miix prepared tea with pineapple and cranberry juices
3. Add optional sugar or splenda , if using
4. Pour over ice cubes and enjoy !

title: vegetable tempura with honey mustard sauce
steps:
1. Heat oven to 450f degrees
2. Coat a 15x10x1" baking sheet with spray
3. Set aside
4. In a medium bowl combine panko crumbs , salt , pepper , garlic powder & onion powder
5. In a large bowl toss the vegetables in flour , shaking to remove any excess flour
6. Dip the vegetables , a few at a time , into the eggs , then the panko crumbs mixture to coat
7. Place the vegetables in a single layer in the prepared cookie sheet
8. Drizzle the vegetables with melted butter
9. Bake uncovered for 9-11 minutes or until vegetables are golden brown , gently stirring twice
10. Serve immediately with honey-mustard sauce where the ingredients have been stirred in a small bowl
11. Then enjoy !

title: nouilles avec carottes et graines d oeillette
steps:
1. Sliver the carrots
2. You should have about one cup
3. Cook noodles in a saucepan , according to package directions , in salted water
4. Drop the carrots into boiling salted water and simmer about 3 minutes or until tender-crisp
5. Drain
6. When noodles are done , drain and return to the pan
7. Add the butter and carrots
8. Add the poppy seeds and stir
9. Salt and pepper to taste

title: lemon strawberry fluff
steps:
1. In mixing bowl , fold strawberries with their juice and lemon pudding mix into whipped topping
2. Mix well with spatula using folding motion until all ingredients are incorporated
3. Spoon into decorative serving bowl or into individual dessert bowls

title: pack a punch citrus tequila
steps:
1. In a 2 quart pitcher , stir together pineapple juice , lemonade concentrate , tequila and orange liqueur
2. Cover and chill thoroughly
3. Just before serving , add lemon and lime slices to pitcher
4. Stir
5. Pour over ice cubes in tall glasses

title: quick asian style cole slaw
steps:
1. Whisk together mayo , lime juice , ginger and sesame oil
2. Add cole slaw mix , cilantro and onion and mix together
3. If desired , you can use 2 tb mayo and 1 tb chipotle mayo for a little spice

title: toasted coconut golden oreo cookie balls  truffles
steps:
1. Mix cream cheese , cookie crumbs and 1 cup toasted coconut until well blended
2. May need to chill
3. Shape into 42 balls
4. Dip in melted chocolate or almond bark
5. Place in single layer in shallow waxed paper-lined pan
6. Sprinkle with remaining coconut
7. Refrigerate until firm , about 1 hour

title: soft golden crust beer yeast bread  abm
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in machine according to your manufacturer's instructions and let bread bake in breadmaker
2. Or select dough cycle and shape into two oval loaves
3. Place on greased baking sheet , cover and let rise until doubled
4. Bake at 350 for about 22 minutes or until done
5. Or shape into rolls , cover and let rise until doubled and bake on a greased baking sheet at 375 for approximately 15 minutes

title: cheesy zucchini crisps
steps:
1. Combine corn flake crumbs , cheese , and seasonings in a plastic bag
2. Dip zucchini in butter and shake in bag to coat
3. Bake at 375 for 10-15 minutes

title: tender italian baked chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f
2. In a bowl , mix the mayonnaise , parmesan cheese , and garlic powder
3. Place bread crumbs in a separate bowl
4. Dip chicken into the mayonnaise mixture , then into the bread crumbs to coat
5. Arrange coated chicken on a rack over a baking sheet
6. Bake 20 minutes in the preheated oven , or until chicken juices run clear and coating is golden brown

title: stack pudding
steps:
1. Layer 1
2. Mix ingredients together and press into greased 9 x 13 pan
3. Bake for 15 minutes at 350 degrees
4. Let cool completely
5. Layer 2
6. Mix ingredients together and pour over layer 1
7. Layer 3
8. Mix ingredients together and pour over layer 2
9. Layer 4
10. Spread cool whip over layer 3
11. Garnish with pecans and / or chocolate curls
12. To make chocolate curls--chill chocolate candy bar and"shave" with a vegetable peeler
13. Chill
14. {ihave made this with walnuts in the crust and used butterscotch pudding-- it's all good !
15. }

title: quick tortellini soup  6 ingredients  easy
steps:
1. Bring broth to a boil in a large saucepan over med-high heat
2. Add tortellini and next 4 ingredients
3. Reduce heat , and simmer 10 minutes
4. Garnish , if desired with shredded parmesan cheese

title: susan strahm s sugar cookies
steps:
1. Cream first 5 ingredients together
2. Sift the last 4 ingredients together , then mix with the rest
3. Chill dough
4. Roll out 1 / 2" thick & cut
5. Bake at 375 for 8 - 10 minutes , just till barely brown
6. Don't overcook

title: fruit shake
steps:
1. Combine peaches , strawberries , and apple juice in container of blender or food processor , process until smooth
2. Add frozen yogurt , and process until blended
3. Serve immediately
4. Can exchange fresh peaches with frozen ones
5. Use 2 cups frozen peach slices

title: chicken french fry casserole
steps:
1. Chop chicken breasts up into bite sized pieces and brown a a large skillet with the butter
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
3. In a large casserole dish , combine french fries , cream of mushroom soup , milk , onion powder , garlic powder , and about half the cheese
4. Stir in browned chicken
5. Top with remaining cheese , then sprinkle with paprika
6. Bake uncovered for 1-1 / 2 hours , until fries are completely soft

title: speedy little devils cookies
steps:
1. Melt margarine and add dry cake mix
2. Add egg and stir till well mixed
3. Put approximately 1 / 2 of mixture on bottom of ungreased 9 x 13" pan
4. Pat down evenly
5. Combine peanut butter and marshmallow cream and spread over bottom layer
6. Crumble remaining cake mixture over the top and bake 20 minutes at 350
7. Cool and cut into bars

title: polenta with leeks
steps:
1. Wash leeks well
2. Thinly slice white and pale green parts only
3. In a large saucepan over medium heat , melt 2 tablespoons butter
4. Add leeks and stir
5. Cook covered about 10 minutes until leeks are softened , stirring occasionally
6. Add water , broth and bay leaf
7. Bring to a boil and gradually whisk in the polenta
8. Reduce heat to medium low and cook stirring almost constantly until thick
9. And creamy , about 35 minutes
10. Remove from heat and discard the bay leaf
11. Stir in the 1 tablespoon remaining butter and the parmesan cheese
12. Season with salt and pepper

title: burnt grapes
steps:
1. Wash and dry grapes
2. Mix sour cream , white sugar and vanilla together
3. Pour mixture over grapes , and stir gently
4. Place in a 9x13-inch pan or into individual dished
5. In a saucepan , bring butter and brown sugar to boil
6. Continue boiling until golden , 1-2 minutes , and immediately pour over grapes
7. Do not stir
8. Chill 3-4 hours
9. Makes 6 servings

title: melkkos  milk food
steps:
1. Sift the flour and salt together and rub in margarine / butter
2. Bring milk to the boil
3. Add flour mixture to milk and beat
4. Lumps will form but keep stirring well !
5. When lumpy , cover with lid and simmer for 5- 8 minutes , until cooked
6. Serve hot with cinnamon sugar

title: baked spiced oatmeal
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in 2 quart casserole dish sprayed with cooking spray
2. Refrigerate overnight
3. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes

title: roasted strawberries with wine   balsamic vinegar sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Add 2 tbsp butter to oven safe skillet and melt in oven
3. Add vanilla to butter to butter and combine
4. Place strawberries , cut side down in skillet andsprinkle with brown sugar
5. Bake at 400f for 10 minutes or until berries are soft
6. Remove pan from oven
7. With a slotted spoon , remove berries from pan and set aside to let cool
8. Add wine and vinegar to skillet and simmer over medium heat until reduced slightly
9. Remove from heat and whisk in chilled butter
10. To serve , spoon ice cream into dessert bowls , top with warm strawberries and drizzle with sauce

title: yorkshire pudding with herbs
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , whisk eggs just to blend
2. Gradually whisk in milk
3. Sift flour and salt into egg mixture and whisk until well blended and smooth
4. Whisk in all herbs
5. This is the first key to success- let the batter stand at room temperature for at least 30 minutes !
6. While the batter is resting , preheat the oven to 450f
7. This is the second key to success- the oven must be very hot !
8. Re-whisk the batter before using and transfer to large measuring cup or pitcher with a spout so it will be easy to pour
9. Heat muffin tin with 12 muffin cups in oven for 10 minutes
10. This is the third key to success- the muffin tins must be very hot !
11. Transfer drippings or melted butter to a measuring cup with a spout so you can easily pour it into the muffin tin
12. Pour about 1 tsp drippings or melted butter in each muffin cup
13. Return pan to oven for about 6 to 8 minutes
14. This is the last key to success- the fat must be very hot !
15. Pour batter evenly into the muffin cups onto the hot fat
16. Bake until puddings are golden and puffy , about 12 to 15 minutes
17. Puddings will sink slightly in centre
18. Serve immediately out of oven while still hot

title: country chicken cobbler  no hassle  way
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. In nonstick 12-inch skillet , combine frozen vegetables , undiluted soup , milk , and pepper
3. Cover and cook over medium-high heat until vegetables are thawed , stirring once
4. Stir in chicken
5. Transfer chicken mixture to shallow 3 1 / 2- to 4-quart casserole
6. Top with biscuit quarters , leaving space between pieces
7. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until biscuits are browned and mixture is heated through

title: crock pot sauerkraut soup
steps:
1. Combine first 12 ingredients in crockpot
2. Cover
3. Cook on high 5-6 hours
4. Skim off fat
5. Garnish with bacon

title: creme fraiche whipped cream
steps:
1. Whip the heavy cream until it begins to thicken
2. Sprinkle with confectioner's sugar and continue to beat the cream until it makes a soft lazy peak
3. Fold or gently whisk in the creme fraiche

title: hazelnut  crinkles
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Mix flour , baking powder and salt in a medium-sized bowl
3. Set aside
4. Beat shortening in bowl of electric mixer , then add chocolate-hazelnut spread
5. Add sugar and eggs one at a time until well incorporated
6. Alternately add dry ingredients and milk into chocolate-hazelnut mixture
7. Chill dough 2 hours
8. Remove dough from refrigerator and roll into 1" balls , roll in chopped hazelnuts , then powdered sugar
9. Place 2" apart on a parchment-lined cookie sheet
10. Bake about 10 minutes then remove to cooling rack
11. If they last as long as 3 days , they begin to absorb moisture and crumble , so eat or distribute them before then !

title: sarah s secret chocolate silk pie  easy
steps:
1. Melt the chocolate chips however you like to melt them
2. I heat them in a non-stick skillet over a low-heat burner , stirring often and keeping a close eye so to remove them when just melted
3. Combine tofu and vanilla in a food processor
4. While processing , add the melted chocolate slowly
5. Process until well combined
6. Spoon into the pie crust
7. Chill in the refrigerator for a couple hours until the pie has solidified
8. Served chilled

title: roasted potato fennel soup
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. In a large bowl , toss the potatoes with 1 / 4 cup olive oil , garlic , salt , and pepper
3. Spread on a baking sheet and roast for 30 minutes , until cooked through
4. Saute the chopped onions and chopped fennel with 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large stockpot on medium heat until translucent , 10 to 15 minutes
5. Add the roasted potatoes and the stock
6. Cover and bring to a boil
7. Lower the heat and simmer uncovered for 1 hour , until all the vegetables are very soft
8. Add the heavy cream and allow the soup to cook slightly
9. Using a stick blender , puree the soup in the pot
10. Taste for salt and pepper
11. Reheat and serve hot

title: chicken with sun dried tomato sauce
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat
2. Put flour and 1 / 4 tsp each salt and pepper in a plastic food bag
3. Add chicken , close bag and shake to coat
4. Cook in skillet , turning once , 5-7 minutes until golden and cooked through
5. Add broth and tomato spread
6. Cook until hot , spoon over chicken

title: simple healthier seafood salad
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a bowl and combine well
2. Serve on salad greens , toast or enjoy it 'as is" --

title: innkeeper s mussel chowder
steps:
1. Scrub mussels in cool water and pull off beards
2. Discard any whose shells don't close when tapped
3. In an 8- to 10-quart pan , combine mussels and wine
4. Bring to a boil over high heat
5. Cover and simmer over medium heat until mussels open , 5 to 8 minutes
6. Pour into a colander set in a large bowl to collect juices
7. Let mussels stand until cool enough to touch
8. Meanwhile , peel potatoes and cut into 1 / 2-inch cubes
9. Peel and chop onion
10. Rinse celery and cut into 1 / 2-inch pieces
11. In the pan used for mussels , melt butter over medium heat
12. Add onion and celery
13. Stir often until onion is limp , 6 to 8 minutes
14. Add curry powder and basil
15. Stir until spices become more fragrant , about 30 seconds
16. Pour mussel juices from bowl into pan
17. Add tomato sauce , cream , and potatoes
18. Turn heat to high
19. When mixture is boiling , cover , reduce heat to low , and simmer , stirring occasionally , until flavors are well blended , about 30 minutes
20. Meanwhile , remove mussels from shells
21. Discard shells
22. Add mussels to soup
23. Cover and simmer just until mussels are hot , 3 to 5 minutes
24. Add salt and pepper to taste
25. Ladle into bowls

title: beautiful borscht salmon
steps:
1. Step 1 is good to do in advance
2. Place beet in a pot of boiling water and cook uncovered 15 minutes until semi-tender
3. Remove from heat , cover pot , and allow beet to steam another 15 minutes
4. Remove beet from hot water with slotted spoon
5. Once cool , peel and dice beet
6. Steps 2 and 3 may also be done in advance
7. Saute aromatic shallots , carrot , and celery in olive oil until semi-tender
8. Stir in cabbage and garlic
9. Add diced beet , broth , bay leaf , and peppercorns
10. Adjust heat , cover pot and gently simmer for one half hour until vegetables are tender
11. Remove from heat
12. Discard bay leaf and peppercorns
13. Add salt , dill , and red wine vinegar
14. Puree sauce in blender or food processor until smooth
15. Stir in crme fraiche
16. Taste and adjust seasonings as desired
17. Borscht sauce may be served hot or cold
18. Keep heated in saucepan until serving time
19. Or chill sauce in refrigerator
20. While borscht sauce is cooking , rub salmon fillets on both sides with olive oil
21. Sprinkle salmon with garlic salt and pepper
22. Grill fillets 4-5 minutes per side until done
23. To serve , plate each salmon fillet , then top with 1 / 4 cup borscht sauce , additional crme fraiche , and sprigs of fresh dill
24. A beautiful presentation your dinner guests will not soon forget !
25. This recipe makes just over 2 cups borscht sauce
26. Canned broth may be used to thin any unused sauce to preferred soup consistency
27. Stir in broth and reheat , or enjoy a cold summer soup
28. Very delicious the next day !

title: sweet memories cinnamon rolls
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast and sugar in lukewarm water
2. Add melted shortening and beaten egg
3. Add flour , powdered milk and salt
4. Mix thoroughly
5. Cover and let rise until double in a warm place
6. Work down and roll to 11 / 4-inch thickness
7. Brush with butter
8. -------to prepare filling------
9. Combine sugars and cinnamon mixing thoroughly
10. Sprinkle cinnamon mix and roll up lengthwise
11. Cut into 12 rolls
12. Place on greased tray
13. Let rise until double
14. Bake in 400 f oven for 20 to 25 minutes
15. --------glaze-------
16. Brush hot cinnamon rolls with powdered sugar glaze

title: rolled chicken washington
steps:
1. In pan on medium heat cook mushrooms in butter for five minutes or until soft
2. Blend in flour , stir in cream , add seasonings , cook and stir until thick
3. Stir in cheese until it melts , turn out into a loaf pan and leave to cool for an hour
4. Pound chicken with a mallet to 1 / 4 inch thick , sprinkle with a little salt
5. Cut cheese mixture into fingers - don't cut filling too wide , place on breasts leaving about a 3 / 4 inch on each side
6. Now comes that part that may have you a little intimidated - but after that first one you're on your way - on occasion i have been known to use a tooth pick for the ones that are a bit defiant - they do roll and are so worth the effort
7. Add filling length wise , tuck in side pieces and roll up
8. Dust with flour , dip very generously into egg and then into the breadcrumbs , this seals in the filling
9. Chill one hour
10. Fry in deep oil for five minutes or until nicely browned , be sure your oil is not too hot to avoid over browning - drain on paper towel
11. Place in shallow dish and bake at 350 for 45 minutes or until done

title: chicken with lime butter
steps:
1. Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper --
2. Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat
3. Saute chicken until light brown , about 3 minutes per side
4. Cover , reduce heat to low
5. Cook 10 minutes or until chicken is tender
6. Remove chicken to serving platter
7. Drain oil from skillet
8. Add lime juice --
9. Cook over low heat until juice begins to boil
10. About 1 minutes
11. Add butter , one tbls at a time , until butter becomes opaque and forms a thick sauce
12. Remove from heat and stir in chives and dill
13. Spoon sauce over chicken --
14. Serve immediately

title: chocolate ice cream
steps:
1. Place the cocoa powder along with 1 cup of the half-and-half into a medium saucepan over medium heat and whisk to combine
2. Add the remaining half-and-half and the heavy cream
3. Bring the mixture just to a simmer , stirring occasionally , and remove from the heat
4. In a medium mixing bowl whisk the egg yolks until they lighten in color
5. Gradually add the sugar and whisk to combine
6. Temper the cream mixture into the eggs and sugar by gradually adding small amounts , until about 1 / 3 of the cream mixture has been added
7. Pour in the remainder and return the entire mixture to the saucepan and place over low heat
8. Continue to cook , stirring frequently , until the mixture thickens slightly and coats the back of a spoon and reaches 170 to 175 degrees f
9. Pour the mixture into a container and allow to sit at room temperature for 30 minutes
10. Stir in the vanilla extract
11. Place the mixture into the refrigerator and once it is cool enough not to form condensation on the lid , cover and store for 4 to 8 hours or until the temperature reaches 40 degrees f or below
12. Pour into an ice cream maker and process according to the manufacturer's directions
13. This should take approximately 25 to 35 minutes
14. Serve as is for soft serve or freeze for another 3 to 4 hours to allow the ice cream to harden

title: hot dog roll ups
steps:
1. Cut a lengthwise slit in each hot dog
2. Fill with a strip of cheese and about 1 / 2 teaspoon bacon
3. Separate crescent dough into eight triangles
4. Place a hot dog on the wide end of each triangle
5. Roll toward the point
6. Place cheese side up on an ungreased baking sheet
7. Bake at 375 degrees f for 12 minutes or until golden brown

title: mikey s chicken a la king
steps:
1. Melt margarine / butter in a large skillet over medium heat
2. Add mushrooms and onion cook until crisp-tender
3. Stir in flour and pepper
4. Cook over low heat until mixture is smoothand bubbly stirring constantly
5. Stir in bouillion , milk , water and reserved mushroom liquid
6. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly
7. Boil for 1 minute stirring constantly
8. Stir in chicken
9. Cook until thoroughtly heated , stirring occasionally
10. Serve over biscuits
11. Very good !

title: pan seared sea scallops with orange braised shallots
steps:
1. Dry scallops well and season with salt and pepper
2. Heat olive oil in large saute pan until smoking then add the scallops
3. Don't overcrowd them
4. Brown well
5. Let cook over medium high heat until done , about 5-8 minutes
6. Keep warm
7. In non-aluminum pan bring orange juice and concentrate to boil
8. Lower heat and simmer for 5 minutes
9. Set aside
10. In a saute pan , heat olive oil until almost smoking
11. Add the shallots , browning them well on all sides
12. Add orange juice mixture and chicken stock , cover
13. Let simmer over moderate heat until shallots are nearly cooked through
14. Remove shallots and let the remaining liquid reduce uncovered to about one cup
15. Swirl in butter and serve immediately over shallots and scallops

title: diet coke salmon
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Place butter in 9x9" glass pan and place in oven to melt as oven preheats
3. Once butter is melted , place salmon steaks in dish
4. Sprinkle seasoning evenly over steaks
5. Pour diet coke over steaks and bake approximately 40 minutes or until salmon is cooked all the way through
6. Fabulous served with carmelized onions !

title: breakfast fried cornbread
steps:
1. Slice cornbread in half , placing the baked sides up on a plate
2. Heat pan on medium , pouring or dropping oil or lard in once it's hot
3. Fry each piece on baked side first
4. Flip , fry on other side
5. Serve with warmed maple syrup

title: harvey house coleslaw
steps:
1. Shred cabbage , onion , and carrots
2. Mix well
3. Layer cabbage mixture , sprinkling each layer with sugar in 13x9-inch glass dish
4. Mix celery seed , dry mustard , salt , vinegar , and oil in sauce pan
5. Bring to a boil
6. Pour over cabbage mixture
7. Refrigerate for a day , stirring occasionally

title: zucchini strips
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to about 350
2. Use a peeler to take the skin off the zucchini
3. Cut the zucchini into thin strips
4. Spray a baking pan with pam
5. Lay the strips down , not overlapping , and spray them with pam too
6. Sprinkle them with the salt , pepper , and cumin
7. Put them in the oven and let them cook until they start to brown around the edges
8. Let them cool

title: iranian yogurt soup   ashe mast
steps:
1. Put the meat in a bowl
2. Add grated onion and salt and pepper and mix well
3. Make meat balls the size of walnuts
4. Put yogurt in a 3-qt pot
5. Add rice , egg , flour and mix well
6. Add water
7. Cook over low heat , stirring constantly for about 20 minutes or until it thickens and rice cooks
8. Add meat balls to the yogurt mixture and let simmer for 10 minutes
9. Add greens and beans and let simmer for 15 minutes
10. Can substitute fresh beans for canned
11. Stir often to avoid curdling
12. As a soup garnish , chop one or two cloves of garlic and saute in butter , add dried mint , about 1 tablespoon , and put a teaspoonful of this hot garlic sauce on each plate of yogurt soup when serving

title: dutch shrimp soup
steps:
1. Melt butter in a 5-quart pot over medium-high heat
2. Add flour and cook , stirring , until mixture is bubbly
3. Remove from heat and gradually stir in broth
4. Return to heat and cook , stirring , until sauce is smooth , thick and boiling
5. Stirring constantly , gradually add milk and cream
6. Then stir in parsley , paprika , dill , lemon juice , and tomato paste
7. Cook just until heated through , about 2-3 minutes
8. Stir in shrimp and cook for 1 more minute

title: pears  celery  peas  dried cranberries    walnut salad
steps:
1. Mix salad dressing in bowl
2. Add all salad ingredients to dressing
3. Plate on a bed of greens and top with candied walnuts

title: emeril lagasse s creton
steps:
1. In a large saute pan , add the pork and cook until no longer pink , about 3 minutes
2. Add the onions and garlic , and cook for 1 minute
3. Add the salt , pepper , cloves , cinnamon , ginger , and nutmeg and cook for 1 minute
4. Add the milk and bread crumbs and cook for 3 minutes over medium heat , stirring to break up the meat
5. Reduce the heat to low , cover , and cook , stirring occasionally , until the pork is very tender and most of the liquid is evaporated , about 1 hour and 15 minutes
6. Remove the lid and cook uncovered , stirring occasionally , until the mixture is thick and all the liquid is evaporated , about 10 to 15 minutes
7. Remove from the heat and adjust the seasoning , to taste
8. Transfer to a decorative bowl or several smaller ramekins , smoothing the top with a rubber spatula
9. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate until well chilled and firm , at least 4 hours or overnight
10. Serve with thinly sliced french bread or toasted french bread croutons

title: french pastry cream
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , heat 2 cups milk to boiling
2. While milk is heating , whisk egg yolks , sugar and remaining 1 / 4 cup milk
3. Whisk in cornstarch and flour until smooth
4. Temper the egg mixture by slowly whisking in about 1 / 3 of the heated milk , then whisking in the remaining milk
5. Return mixture to saucepan and cook over medium-high heat until mixture thickens and boils
6. Whisk constantly
7. Reduce heat to low and cook for another 2 minutes
8. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla or other flavorings
9. Pour into a bowl , press plastic wrap on the surface to prevent a skin from forming and cool to room temperature before chilling for at least 2 hours

title: prune and proscuitto rolls
steps:
1. Cut each proscuitto slice in half across the width and then in half again down its length
2. Wrap a strip of prosuitto around each prune
3. Secure with a toothpick
4. Serve as an hors d'oeuvre

title: sunday chicken casserole
steps:
1. Cook the rice according to the package instructions
2. While the rice cooks , dissolve the tablespoon of salt in the 3 cups of water in a bowl large enough to hold the chicken
3. Wash the chicken breasts , fillet them in half to make them thinner and soak them in the bowl of salt water for about 15 minutes
4. After soaking , pat them dry with a paper towel
5. In a large skillet , melt the butter over medium-high heat and cook the chicken turning once until both sides appear to be cooked , about 5 minutes each side
6. When done , remove from pan and set aside
7. Preheat oven to 350 now
8. Stir in flour and sour cream , whisking to remove any lumps
9. Stir in the 3 / 4 cup water and bouillon cube , mixing well to combine
10. Add the mushrooms and cook , stirring until sauce thickens , about 8 minutes
11. Spread the cooked rice in the bottom of a 13x9 baking dish , lay the chicken on top , pour the mushroom sauce over the top and sprinkle the mozzarella cheese evenly over top
12. Sprinkle lightly with paprika
13. Bake 30 minutes
14. Yum !

title: gingerbread sweet potato casserole
steps:
1. Cook sweet potatoes in a dutch oven in boiling water and cover over medium heat 30 minutes or until tender
2. Cool
3. Peel and mash potatoes
4. Combine mashed sweet potatoes , 1 / 2 cup brown sugar , and next 4 ingredients in a mixing bowl
5. Beat at medium speed with an electric mixer until smooth
6. Spoon into a greased 2 1 / 2-quart pr 13"x9" baking dish
7. Combine 1 / 2 cup brown sugar and flour
8. Cut in 1 / 4 cup cold butter with a pastry blender until crumbly
9. Stir in crushed gingersnaps
10. Sprinkle streusel over sweet potato mixture
11. Bake , uncovered , at 350f for 25 minutes or until streusel is lightly browned

title: heinz chili sauce  copycat
steps:
1. Whisk all ingredients well in a medium bowl: 1 can quality tomato paste , 1 / 2 cup water , 1 / 2 cup light corn syrup , 1 / 2 cup distilled white vinegar , 1 tablespoon minced onion flakes , 1 teaspoon unseasoned sweet chili powder , 1 teaspoon plain salt , 1 / 2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce , 1 / 4 teaspoon ground allspice , 1 / 8 teaspoon ground cloves , 1 / 8 teaspoon garlic powder , 1 / 8 teaspoon red chili flakes , 1 / 8 teaspoon white pepper
2. Simmer sauce in a small saucepan over low heat until proper / desired consistency is reached
3. Taste sauce
4. Season to taste with a pinch of salt salt or more if necessary
5. Remove from heat and allow to cool completely
6. Pour sauce into a squeeze bottle and serve
7. Enjoy it while it lasts ! refrigerate unused portion in sealed squeeze bottle

title: skor cheese ball
steps:
1. Beat together the cheese , butter and vanilla
2. Add in sugars and then chocolate chips
3. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours
4. Place in freezer if needed faster
5. Form into a ball
6. Wrap it in plastic and refrigerate one more hour
7. Roll the ball in skor pieces
8. Serve with dare wafer cookies , ginger , lemon , chocolate and cinnamon

title: chicken and rice chowder
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , bring chicken broth and water to a boil and add the chicken
2. Add thyme and season with salt and pepper
3. Add rice and reduce heat
4. In a skillet , heat olive oil over medium-high heat
5. Add garlic , onion , carrots , and celery
6. Cook until onions are translucent
7. Add flour to the mix and combine well
8. Add this mixture to the chicken broth mixture in the saucepan
9. Stir milk into everything and continue to simmer , stirring occasionally until thickened , about 20-30 minutes

title: cheesy apple breakfast quesadillas
steps:
1. Spread each flour tortillas with 1 tablespoon sour cream
2. Sprinkle with
3. 1 teaspoons cinnamon sugar
4. Top one tortilla 1 / 3 cup cheese , 1 / 4 cup chopped apple and second tortilla
5. For each serving , melt 1 tablespoon butter in a large skillet , brown quesadilla
6. 1 minute on each side or until lightly browned , carefully turning over tortilla
7. Cut into wedges
8. Serve with sour cream , if desired

title: fresh and light garbanzo salad
steps:
1. Bring water to boil , stir in couscous , cover , and remove from heat
2. Let stand 5 minutes
3. In large bowl , toss couscous , garbanzo beans , tomato , cucumber , onion , and parsley
4. Combine dressing ingredients and pour over salad
5. Toss well
6. Cover and chill before serving

title: mole negro   dark mole
steps:
1. Toast ancho , guajillo , and cascabel chiles in a cast iron skillet until skins blister
2. Remove from skillet and stem , seed , and devein chiles
3. Set to the side
4. Place tomatoes and green tomatoes in a saucepan and bring to a boil
5. Drain and whirl in blender or food processor and set aside
6. In a large saucepan , heat corn oil over low flame
7. Cut the bread into pieces and fry in the corn oil until golden brown
8. Add next 11 ingredients to the toasted bread and stir together , adding more corn oil as necessary to coat everything lightly
9. Add chopped roasted onion and minced roasted garlic
10. Continue to fry over low flame for about 20 minutes
11. Add blended tomato mixture
12. Remove from heat and set aside
13. Place corn tortilla over open flame and cook until burnt and crispy
14. Tear up and set to the side
15. In a medium frying pan , fry roasted chiles in corn oil along with burnt tortilla pieces for a few minutes
16. Combine tomato / spice / nut mixture with chile mixture in large saucepan
17. Add chocolate piece and cook until melted over a low flame
18. Add about 1 / 2 cup chicken stock to mixture and stir
19. Place mixture into blender or food processor and puree until all ingredients have combined completely
20. More chicken stock may be added to smooth out sauce
21. In a large saucepan , heat vegetable shortening
22. Add puree to the shortening and cook , stirring constantly to avoid scorching
23. Add more of the chicken stock until you achieve the right level of consistency that you'd like
24. Warm sauce for another 30 minutes over a low flame

title: upside down banana walnut french toast
steps:
1. Spray bottom and sides of a 13x9x2-inch glass baking dish with cooking spray or grease with shortening
2. In a large bowl , stir together first four ingredients then gently stir in the bananas
3. Spoon this mixture into the baking dish
4. Reserving heels of bread for another use arrange 2 layers of bread on banana mixture , tearing bread to fit if needed
5. In a medium-size bowl , beat eggs , milk and vanilla until well mixed
6. Pour over bread
7. Cover tightly and refrigerate at least 1 hour but no longer than 24 hours
8. Heat oven to 325
9. Uncover casserole and bake 45-50 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean
10. Serve portions upside-down , spooning sauce from bottom of dish over each serving

title: season s easiest fruit cobbler
steps:
1. Put fruit in the bottom of an 8x8 inch casserole dish
2. Melt the butter and mix in bisquick , sugar and milk
3. Pour over fruit
4. Cook for 45-50 minutes at 350 degrees fahrenheit
5. Serve with cool whip or ice cream

title: worcestershire chicken
steps:
1. Pat chicken dry and place between 2 sheets of plastic wrap
2. With a meat pounder , flatten chicken lightly to about 1 / 2 in thickness and season with salt and pepper
3. In large non-stick skillet heat oil over moderate heat and cook chicken until lightly browned , approximately 6 minutes on each side
4. Add remaining ingredients except lemon juice , and simmer until chicken is cooked through , about 4 minutes
5. Transfer chicken with tongs to a platter
6. Simmer sauce until reduced to about 1 / 4 cup
7. Add lemon juice and salt and pepper to taste
8. Pour sauce over chicken

title: honey glazed pearl onions
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat
2. Once hot , add onions and cook until they begin to brown in spots , stirring occasionally
3. Add beef broth or reserved braising liquid and cook until nearly evaporated , about 20 minutes
4. Stir in honey and cook 3 minutes longer , spooning the glaze over onions
5. Season with salt and pepper

title: kittencal s salmon pate
steps:
1. In a bowl mix all ingredients except salt and nuts
2. Season with salt to taste
3. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours or until firm enough to handle
4. Form into a ball then roll in the nuts
5. Transfer to a fancy serving bowl
6. Serve with crackers

title: heavens own chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Grease cookie sheet lightly
3. Combine flour , baking soda , salt
4. Stir and set aside
5. Cream together sugars and shortening
6. Add eggs one at a time and add vanilla , mix well
7. Slowly add in flour mixture into blended shortening , 1 / 3 at a time
8. Thoroughly blend each addition before adding more
9. Add cinnamon to the cookie dough for taste
10. Mix in chocolate chips
11. Spoon dough into a ball , about ping-pong size
12. It's important to create a smooth ball as it will effect the look of the finished cookie
13. Place on cookie sheet two inches apart
14. Bake at 375 degrees for 9 minutes or until it just begins to brown
15. Remove from oven and let it cool for five minutes on the cookie sheet
16. Remove to cooling rack
17. Don't stack warm cookies
18. Enjoy !

title: baked ham  cheese and broccoli casserole
steps:
1. Mix all casserole ingredients together except 1 / 2 cheddar cheese
2. Put in a 13 x 9 baking dish
3. It will seem like there's no way for it to all fit , but i promise it will
4. You may have to stir and combine with your hands
5. Top with half the cheddar cheese
6. Bake at 350 for 45 to 60 minutes or until bubbly and browned on top

title: extremely easy carrot muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease muffin cups or line with paper muffin liners
3. In a large bowl , sift together flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt and cinnamon
4. In a separate bowl , combine eggs , apple sauce and brown sugar
5. Beat well
6. Combine egg mixture and flour mixture
7. Mix just until moistened
8. Fold in carrots and drained raisins
9. Spoon into prepared muffin cups
10. Bake in preheated oven for 20 to 30 minutes
11. Let cool for 30 minutes or eat immediately

title: creamy black bean salsa
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine the beans , corn , peppers , onion and parsley
2. Combine the sour cream , mayonnaise , vinegar and seasonings
3. Pour over the corn mixture and toss gently to coat
4. Serve with your favorite tortilla chips or toasted pita wedges
5. Refrigerate leftovers

title: jean s peanut butter squares
steps:
1. In a large microwaveable bowl , melt 1 cup of peanut butter and the margarine
2. Mix well , stirring in the icing sugar
3. Spread into a square or small rectangular pan and refrigerate about 10 minutes
4. Melt together the 1 / 2 cup of smooth peanut butter and the chocolate chips , mixing well , then pouring the melted mixture over the cooled base
5. Place in the refrigerator til set , about an hour
6. Cut into squares or diamonds and enjoy !

title: saucy cocktail meatballs
steps:
1. Mix first four ingredients and shape into balls , fry or boil until done
2. Drain if necessary and place in baking dish
3. In saucepan saute the green pepper& onion in 2 tbsp
4. Butter until soft , stir in remaining sauce ingredients
5. Pour over meatballs and bake at 350 for 20-30 minutes
6. Serve over rice

title: chicken and flour tortilla dumplings
steps:
1. Fill 4-quart pot half full with water
2. Boil chicken until tender
3. While chicken is cooking , slice tortillas with a sharp knife 5 slices across and one slice through the middle
4. Remove cooked chicken and shred with a fork or cut into cubes
5. Place chicken , cream of chicken soup , butter , salt and pepper into boiling chicken broth
6. Bring to a rolling boil
7. Drop individual tortillas into pot one piece at a time
8. Do not stir , you can pat the top of the dumplings and move them around slightly with a wooden spoon
9. Boil medium / high heat for 12 minutes
10. Remove from heat
11. Add 1 cup of milk and move the dumplings around gently to mix the milk

title: ziti baked with spinach  tomatoes and smoked gouda
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to directions
2. Drain
3. Heat oven to 375 degrees
4. Heat oil in a dutch oven on medium-high heat until hot
5. Add onion and pepper
6. Cook 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
7. Stir in garlic
8. Cook 2 minutes
9. Stir in tomatoes
10. Bring to boil
11. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes
12. Add spinach
13. Cook 30 seconds or until spinach wilts , stirring frequently
14. Remove from heat
15. Add pasta and 3 / 4 cup cheese to tomato mixture , tossing well to combine
16. Spoon pasta mixture into a 9-by-13-inch baking dish coated with cooking spray
17. Sprinkle evenly with remaining cheese
18. Bake 15 minutes or until cheese melts and begins to brown

title: almost payday casserole
steps:
1. Brown ground chuck with onion
2. Salt , and pepper meat to taste
3. Drain oil
4. Peel and boil potatoes , until tender
5. Drain
6. Add 2 tablespoons margarine , and milk to potatoes
7. Salt to taste
8. Mash
9. Grease a 2 1 / 2 quart oven deep dish pan
10. Place ground chuck on bottom
11. Pour the two drained cans of corn over top of chuck
12. Top with mashed potatoes
13. Place remaining margarine over potatoes , in thin strips
14. Bake in preheated oven 400 degrees , for 1 hour

title: smoked turkey with sweet coffee glaze
steps:
1. Bring 1 gallon of the water to a boil in a large pot and keep warm
2. In a stockpot large enough to hold the turkey , combine cider vinegar , coffee , onion , thyme , salt and peppercorns with 1 3 / 4 cups of the brown sugar or syrup and the remaining gallon of water
3. Bring to a boil
4. Hold turkey by legs and ease into the hot brine , neck end down
5. Add enough of the hot water to the stockpot to cover turkey and bring to a simmer
6. Simmer for 1 1 / 2 hours
7. Remove turkey from the stockpot
8. Strain 2 cups of the braising liquid into a heatproof bowl and stir in the remaining 1 / 4 cup brown sugar or remaining cane syrup
9. Discard the remaining liquid
10. Meanwhile , light a charcoal grill or preheat a gas grill
11. Right before the turkey has finished simmering , add 2 cups of the hickory chips to the coals
12. When the chips start smoking , brush the turkey breast with oil
13. Set the turkey , breast side down , on the grill
14. Cover & smoke over a low flame for 15 minutes
15. Baste turkey with reserved braising liquid - turn it breast side up and baste again
16. Cover grill and continue smoking for about 40 minutes longer , basting occasionally with braising liquid and adding more coals or hickory chips to grill as necessary
17. The turkey is done when a thermometer inserted in the inner thigh registers 165
18. Place the turkey on a cutting board and let rest 20 minutes before carving

title: peanut butter  n fudge brownies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Greased 13 x 9 inch pan
3. In large bowl , beat 2 cups of sugar and 1 cup of butter until light and fluffy
4. Add 4 eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
5. Add 2 t
6. Vanilla
7. Blend well
8. In small bowl , combine 1 1 / 2 cups flour , cocoa , baking powder and 1 / 2 t
9. Salt
10. Gradually add flour mixture to sugar mixture
11. Mix well
12. Stir in peanut butter chips
13. In small bowl , beat peanut butter and 1 / 3 cup butter until smooth
14. Add 1 / 3 cup sugar and 2 t
15. Flour
16. Mix well
17. Add 3 / 4 t
18. Vanilla and 2 eggs
19. Blend well
20. Spread half of chocolate mixture in greased pan
21. Spread peanut butter mixture evenly over chocolate mixture
22. Spread remaining chocolate mixture evenly over peanut butter mixture
23. To marble , pull knife through layers in wide curves
24. Bake at 350 for 40-50 minutes or until top springs back when touched lightly in center and brownies begin to pull away from sides of pan
25. Cool completely
26. In medium saucepan over low heat , melt chocolate and 3 t
27. Butter , stirring constantly until smooth
28. Remove from heat , stir in powdered sugar , 1 / 4 t
29. Salt , 3 / 4 t
30. Vanilla and enough water for desired spreading consistency
31. Frost cooled brownies
32. Cut into bars

title: unleavened chocolate mint cake brownies
steps:
1. Cream sugar and butter well
2. Add beaten eggs , flour , cocoa and salt and mix until thoroughly combined
3. Bake in a greased 13x9 pan at 400f for 25 minutes
4. While brownies are baking cream together the confectioners sugar , peppermint extract , softened butter and as much food coloring as desired in a bowl and set aside
5. Spread on brownies after they have cooled in the pan for 15 minutes
6. When brownies are completely cool , melt together the chocolate chips and 6tbsp butter
7. Spread immediately on top of mint layer of brownies
8. Chill until set , but soft enough to cut
9. If chocolate is too hard it will crack and make it difficult to cut brownies squares
10. Slice brownies into 2" x 1" squares

title: whole wheat pita chips with garbanzo bean cumin dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Cut each whole wheat pita bread round horizontally along folded edges , forming 4 rounds total
3. Stack pita rounds on work surface
4. Cut stack into 8 wedges , forming 32 wedges total
5. Place pita wedges in single layer on baking sheet
6. Bake until wedges are crisp and golden , about 10 minutes
7. Cool completely
8. Stir cumin in small dry skillet over medium-low heat until fragrant , about 30 seconds
9. Remove from heat
10. Combine garbanzo beans , 3 tablespoons reserved garbanzo bean liquid , lemon juice , oil , garlic , and cumin in processor
11. Puree until smooth , adding more garbanzo bean liquid by tablespoonfuls for desired consistency
12. Season to taste with salt and pepper
13. Transfer dip to bowl
14. Serve dip with pita chips

title: oatmeal crisp marshmallow squares
steps:
1. Spray a 9"x13" pan with non-stick spray
2. Mix the cinnamon and cereal in a large bowl
3. Place bowl near the stove
4. In a very large pot , melt the margarine over low to medium heat
5. Add the marshmallows stirring constantly until melted and smooth
6. Remove from heat and quickly stir in vanilla
7. Add cinnamon / cereal mixture and stir quickly but thoroughly
8. Press evenly in pan
9. When cool cut into 24 squares

title: oven frites  fries
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400
2. Place a heavy-duty baking sheet in the oven
3. Scrub and rinse potatoes
4. Cut lengthwise into 1 / 2 inch wide batons
5. Place potatoes in a medium bowl
6. Toss with olive oil , salt and pepper
7. When baking sheet is hot , about 15 minutes , remove from oven and spray with olive oil cooking spray
8. Place prepared potatoes on baking sheet in a single layer
9. Return to oven , and bake until potatoes are golden on the bottom , about 30 minutes
10. Turn potatoes over and continue cooking until golden all over , another 15 minutes
11. Serve immediately

title: greek salad with tofu  feta cheese
steps:
1. Mix together salad dressing ingredients in a large cup
2. Add tofu , cover and marinate overnite stirring ocasionally to make sure all tofu marinates evenly
3. Just before serving make up salad ingredients and add salad dressing and tofu
4. Toss and serve

title: toddler favorite oatmeal pancakes or waffles
steps:
1. Pour milk over oats and let stand 8-10 minutes
2. Beat in eggs , oil , then remaining ingredients except baking powder
3. Add baking powder and only stir until incorporated
4. Wait until it looks a bit puffy
5. Warm up griddle on medium low
6. Add a bit of butter to melt in the griddle
7. Cook em up !
8. I use a 1 / 4 cup measure
9. For the toddlers i let them dip in baby yogurt or applesauce
10. I send leftovers in my preschoolers laptop lunchbox with pb&j !

title: p  n p parsnips   pineapple
steps:
1. Put all the ingredients into an oven proof casserole
2. Stir to combine
3. Cover and bake in 375 degree oven for 30 minutes or until veggies are cooked
4. Time depends if you pre cook
5. Mix them half way through the baking
6. Remove from oven
7. You may now serve as is , puree or mash them

title: pumpkin and mushroom lasagna
steps:
1. In a large pot , saut the onions in the oil for five minutes
2. Add the mushrooms and saut for another five minutes , until the mushrooms are somewhat wilted
3. Add the sage , 1 / 2 teaspoons of salt , and the wine or stock and simmer on low heat for five minutes
4. Set aside
5. In a large bowl , stir together the eggs , pumpkin , ricotta cheese , pepper , nutmeg and remaining salt
6. Set aside
7. Preheat the oven to 375f lightly grease a 9x13-inch baking dish
8. Dip out about 1 / 2 cup of the liquid from the sauted mushrooms and pour it into the prepared baking dish
9. Cover the bottom with a layer of lasagna noodles arranged close together
10. Evenly spread on half of the pumpkin mixture
11. Spoon on about a third of the sauted mushrooms and sprinkle with 1 / 2 cup of ricotta salata
12. Add a second layer of noodles followed by the remaining pumpkin mixture , another third of the sauted mushrooms , and 1 / 2 cup of ricotta salata
13. Finish with a third layer of noodles thoroughly moistened by the last third of the sauted mushrooms
14. Evenly sprinkle on 1 / 2 cup of ricotta salata and top with the grated pecorino
15. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 50 minutes
16. Uncover and bake for an additional 10 minutes , until the lasagna is bubbly , the noodles are tender , and the top is browned
17. Remove from the oven and let stand for about 10 minutes before serving

title: mock coconut pie  spaghetti squash
steps:
1. Set oven 350
2. With two forks , scoop squash from shell and set aside
3. In large mixing bowl combine eggs , sugar , butter , lemon juice and vanilla
4. Whisk well
5. Stir in spaghetti squash
6. Pour into prebaked pie shell and sprinkle with nutmeg or cinnamon if desired
7. Bake 40-45 minutes until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean
8. Cool on rack
9. Serve with a dollop of whipped cream
10. Store , covered , in the refrigerator

title: mom s macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Cook macaroni in boiling salted water until tender
2. Drain
3. Mix cooked macaroni with butter , stirring well
4. While macaroni is cooking , cook ground beef , garlic and onion in a large skillet until beef is browned and cooked through
5. Drain any accumulated fat
6. Add chili powder , salt , pepper , tomato sauce , diced tomatoes , mixing well
7. Bring meat mixture to a boil , then reduce heat , cover and simmer for 10-15 minutes or until macaroni is done
8. Mix meat mixture with cooked buttered macaroni
9. Sprinkle contents of cheese packets into pasta and stir until blended
10. Serve garnished with grated cheddar , if desired

title: banana   walnut cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 170c
2. Butter or oil the pan
3. Cream the butter and sugar , add all the wet ingredients slowly while beating
4. Combine the dry ingredients with a wooden spoon into the wet mixture and pour into the pan
5. Cook for 40-60 minutes or until the skewer comes out dry

title: cranberry brisket
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 500 degrees
2. Remove the brisket from it's package , rinse , and wipe dry
3. You can see how much fat is on the top
4. Trim off most of the fat , including the membrane that's right beneath it
5. Dump the blacken on top , then the dark brown sugar
6. Rub it into the meat real well , including the sides
7. Place the brisket into the oven , uncovered at 500 degrees for 15 minutes
8. While the meat is in the oven , open the cranberry sauce , place it in a pot , and break it up a little
9. Add the rum , and heat over medium heat just until the jelly is melted
10. After 15 minutes in the oven , the meat will have a nice crust on it
11. Take it out of the oven and pour the cranberry sauce over the top and sides of the meat
12. Cover it tightly with aluminum foil , place the pan back in the oven , and turn the heat down to 300 degrees
13. This slow cooking will break down the collagens in the meat , making it tender
14. Cook for another 2 1 / 2 hours
15. Take it out of the oven , let it cool , then refrigerate in the same pan overnight
16. The next day , preheat the oven to 325 degrees
17. You'll notice that the fat has risen to the top , and become quite hard
18. Remove this fat with tongs
19. Don't be too concerned with getting every last bit of fat out , because it really won't matter
20. Slice the meat into 3 / 8" - 1 / 2" pieces
21. Place the pieces back into the pan trying to recreate the shape of the meat
22. Pour an additional cup of cranberry juice , apple juice , orange juice , etc
23. Into the pot to increase the amount of liquid
24. Cover tightly with aluminum foil , and bake for another 2 hours
25. When it's done place the meat on a platter , and pour the drippings into a gravy boat
26. We didn't feel that there was any need to thicken the drippings , because , being thin , they added to the flavor and moistness of the meat
27. I served this with potato salad , corn bread , and additional cranberry sauce

title: mary poppins  no bake cookies
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients but quick oats in large saucepan
2. Melt and bring to boil , and let boil for 1-2 minutes
3. Add oats and stir to combine
4. Drop onto sprayed or lined cookie sheets , and let cool
5. Keep refrigerated in an air-tight container

title: twice baked potato puffs
steps:
1. Whip all ingredients on high until slightly fluffy
2. They won't be really fluffy
3. Line a baking sheet with waxed or parchment paper and lightly grease with oil or cooking spray
4. Scoop potato mixture with an ice cream scoop and place about 1 / 2 inch apart on baking sheet
5. Bake at 425f for 20 minutes or until golden brown

title: peanut butter caramel bites  gluten free vegan snickers
steps:
1. Crush cornflakes and mix with vanilla and coconut flakes in medium bowl
2. Mix sugar , corn syrup and peanut butter in small pot , heat over medium-low heat , stirring constantly , until it begins to boil
3. Pour caramel over cornflake mixture and stir to combine
4. Press into prepared mini muffin tins or pan for bars
5. Refrigerate until set

title: ruth s chris steak house creamed spinach
steps:
1. Melt 4 tablespoons butter in heavy medium saucepan over medium heat
2. Add flour and stir until light golden , about 7 minutes
3. Stir in onion , bay leaf and clove
4. Gradually whisk in milk
5. Whisk until mixture boils and thickens , about 10 minutes
6. Reduce heat to low and simmer 5 minutes longer , whisking frequently
7. Remove bay leaf and whole clove
8. Cook spinach in large pot of boiling water just until wilted and tender , about 2 minutes
9. Drain
10. Transfer spinach to bowl filled with ice water to cool
11. Drain well
12. Roll up spinach in kitchen towl and squeeze out as much liquid as possible
13. Transfer spinach to processor and finely chop
14. Add spinach to warm sauce , simmer over low heat until spinach is heated through , stirring often , about 5 minutes
15. Stir in remaining 2 tablespoons of butter
16. Season to taste with salt and pepper and serve

title: slow cooker stuffing
steps:
1. Melt butter or margarine in a skillet over medium heat
2. Cook onion , celery , mushroom , and parsley in butter , stirring frequently
3. Spoon cooked vegetables over bread cubes in a very large mixing bowl
4. Season with poultry seasoning , sage , thyme , marjoram , and salt and pepper
5. Pour in enough broth to moisten , and mix in eggs
6. Transfer mixture to slow cooker , and cover
7. Cook on high for 45 minutes , then reduce heat to low , and cook for 4 to 8 hours

title: spicy sweet bbq sauce
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a sauce pan over low heat and stir occasionally until jelly is melted
2. Keep over low heat stirring as needed to keep from sticking
3. Pour over meat prior to serving and use extra for dipping
4. Adjust amounts to increase quantity
5. Keep proportions the same

title: potato skin poppers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Cook potatoes according to package directions
3. In a bowl , stir together cooked potatoes , cheese , 1-cup of soup cream , bacon , onions , salt and pepper
4. Warm the tortillas , then spoon equal amounts of the mixture in the center of each
5. Roll tortillas burrito-style , brush with melted butter and place seam down on a baking pan
6. Bake for 12-15 minutes , or until golden brown
7. Let cool for 5 min
8. , then cut diagnally into halves
9. Serve with remaning sour cream

title: lentil soup  truly good and easy   eat your lentils
steps:
1. Cook onions in oil over moderate heat , stirring occasionally , until softened
2. Add garlic , celery and carrots
3. Cook vegetables 10-15 minutes , until softened
4. Add all remaining ingredients and simmer 1 1 / 2 - 2 hours or until lentils are tender

title: memere s meat pie and meat stuffing
steps:
1. Chop onions and celery and saute until soft
2. Lightly cook pork and drain off grease
3. Add ground beef to pork and cook 5 minutes
4. Transfer meat to deep pan , pot , or dutch oven
5. Add onions and celery
6. Cook over low heat for 25 minutes , stirring occasionally to prevent sticking
7. Drain any grease that has surfaced , and remove from heat
8. Add seasoning , salt , and pepper
9. Add hot water and bread crumbs , and mix well
10. Cover and let stand for 30 minutes
11. While that's standing , preheat the oven to 350f
12. Spoon meat mixture into pie crust and bake for 20-25 minutes
13. Add top crust and seal
14. Bake until done

title: tuna stuffed avocado
steps:
1. Cut avocado in half lengthwise and remove pips
2. Brush lemon juice over avocado to prevent discoloration
3. Blend together fish , salt , pepper and mayonnaise and spoon into avocado
4. Chill before serving
5. Garnish as desired

title: easy  all natural and healthy energy bars
steps:
1. Toast sesame seeds and sunflower seeds until fragrant , set aside
2. Warm honey until it reaches a mixable consistency , and slowly mix in peanut butter until it is well incorporated
3. Fold in remaining ingredients
4. Press entire mixture into a 8x8-inch pan
5. Chill in the fridge for at least an hour or up to 1 month or freeze !

title: one pan salsa cheesy beef and macaroni
steps:
1. Brown and drain hamburg
2. Add water and salsa
3. Add noodles
4. Simmer until tender , about 10 minutes
5. You may need to add a bit more water
6. Add cheese pouch
7. Add frozen corn and heat through , about 5 minutes
8. Add shredded cheese

title: chopped beef stroganoff
steps:
1. In skillet cook meat untill browned , drain
2. Blend in onion soup mix , flour , tomato paste
3. Add water and simmer covered 15 minuetes
4. When ready to serve stir in sour cream
5. Serve over noodles or rice

title: pina colada pie
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , beat the cream cheese , sour cream , coconut cream and sugar until well blended and slightly fluffy
2. Fold in the coconut extract and 1 / 2 cup shredded coconut
3. Pour mixture into pie crust , cover and refrigerate for 3 hours minimum to set
4. Toast remaining coconut to a light brown on top of stove over medium-medium-high heat while stirring almost constantly
5. Set toasted coconut aside until pie has set
6. When pie has set , remove it from refrigerator and spread the pineapple preserves over the top of it evenly
7. Sprinkle the toasted coconut on the pie and serve
8. Enjoy !

title: lamb stifado
steps:
1. Saute the onions and garlic in the olive oil until turning brown and soft
2. Remove and set them aside
3. Add the meat and brown well
4. Add all the remaining ingredients , including the onions
5. Add water to just cover
6. Tightly cover the pot and simmer very slowly for 2 to 4 hours , stirring occasionally
7. Like most stews , this is better reheated the next day

title: dede s broccoli casserole
steps:
1. Saute onions and mushrooms together
2. Melt cracker barrell cheese with mushroom soup
3. Beat eggs and add to broccoli
4. Then add to mushrooms and onion mixture
5. Place in 9x13 inch baking dish
6. Top with ritz crackers and velveeta cheese
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 20-30 minutes

title: rice and nut salad
steps:
1. Put the olive oil , lemon juice , salt and pepper in a screw top jar and shake vigorously until thickened
2. Mix together the soaked fruits , rice , nuts , peaches , cucumber , beans and olives
3. Pour the dressing over and toss thoroughly
4. Serve on a bed of shredded crisp lettuce or endive

title: strawberries to die for   with cointreau sauce
steps:
1. Wash and hull the strawberries
2. Pick out the over ripe or very ripe ones
3. Cut strawberries in half and sprinkle the splenda
4. To make the sauce , roughly chop the remaining strawberries in a blender and blend for about 15 seconds , tossing in the contreau and 1 / 2 tbpn of the splenda
5. Chill and serve with the choice of light cream or ice cream

title: vegan mac daddy  veganomicon
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f
2. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil
3. Add the pasta and cook according to the package directions
4. When the pasta is ready , drain and set aside
5. Meanwhile , prepare the cheezy sauce
6. Whisk the broth and flour in a measuring cup with a fork until dissolved
7. Saute the oil and garlic in a saucepan over medium-low heat about 2 minutes , stirring often and being careful not to burn the garlic
8. Add the thyme , salt , and pepper , and cook for about 15 seconds
9. Add the broth , turmeric , and nutritional yeast , raising the heat to medium
10. Use a whisk and stir constantly
11. The mixture will start bubbling and thickening in about 3 minutes
12. If it doesnt , turn the heat on a bit higher
13. Once the mixture starts bubbling and thickening , stir and cook for about 2 more minutes
14. Add the lemon juice and mustard and stir well
15. The mixture should resemble a thick , melty cheese
16. Taste for salt , turn off the heat , and cover the pan to keep it warm
17. Now that the sauce is ready , begin assembling:
18. Crumble the tofu into an 11x13 inch baking dish
19. Mash the tofu with your hands until it resembles ricotta cheese
20. Mix in the salt , olive oil , and lemon juice
21. Add 1 / 2 cup cheezy sauce to the tofu and stir
22. Add the pasta to the tofu , along with 3 more cups of sauce , and stir well
23. Smooth the top of the pasta mixture and press it down with a spatula to level it
24. Pour the remaining sauce over the pasta and smooth again
25. Bake for 30 minutes
26. The top of the macaroni should be slightly browned
27. Let sit for 20 minutes to cool and firm up
28. For even more comfort food deliciousness , top it with toasted breadcrumbs before going into the oven
29. Make it even more nutritious with the addition of 4 cups of your favorite greens , chopped small - spinach is divine
30. I try to use less fat when i cook
31. Reducing the oil with the tofu mixture to just a scant teaspoon was still perfectly delicious

title: witch s finger cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 325f
2. Reserve 36 nuts for later use
3. Process remaining nuts in food processor until finely ground
4. Beat cream cheese , butter , sugar , extract and salt in large bowl with mixer until light and fluffy
5. Gradually beat in flour
6. Stir in ground nuts
7. Roll dough into 36 "fingers , " using 1 tablespoons dough for each
8. Place , 2 inches apart , on baking sheets sprayed with cooking spray
9. Press 1 of the reserved nuts into dough in 1 end of each finger for the fingernail
10. Use sharp knife to make 3 crosswise slits in top of each finger for the knuckles
11. Bake 15 to 20 minute or until lightly browned
12. Cool 3 minute on baking sheet
13. Carefully transfer to wire racks
14. Cool completely

title: orange thyme sauce and marinade for grilling
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine all the ingredients
2. Set aside 1 / 3 cup for basting meat
3. Grill steak , chicken or pork over medium high heat basting with some of the reserved sauce near the end of cook time so it does not burn

title: bubba gump shrimp co  forrest s net catch
steps:
1. Combine all poaching liquid ingredients and then bring to boil , then reduce to a medium simmer
2. Add shrimp , vegetables , corn , potatoes and the lemon wedges from 1 lemon and cook until shrimp is completely done
3. Remove from poaching liquid , strain and place in stainless steel bowl
4. Add butter , cajun spice , garlic and liquid smoke and toss together
5. Serve on large platter with the extra lemon wedges

title: potato harvest soup
steps:
1. In a 3 quart saucepan over medium heat , combine broth and water
2. Cover and bring to a boil
3. Add potatoes and carrot
4. Cover and cook for 5 minute
5. Add chicken , zucchini , onions , and basil
6. Bring to boil , reduce heat , cover and cook until chicken is opaque throughout , about 7 minutes
7. Season with salt and pepper

title: carrot   cucumber salad
steps:
1. Combine carrots , cucumber , radishes & onion rings
2. Add dressing & toss lightly , season to taste
3. Place in a lettuce lined bowl and garnish with spring onions

title: greek meatballs with artichokes and lemon sauce
steps:
1. Drain artichokes and reserve marinade
2. Slice lemon
3. In a large skillet , warm 1 tbsp reserved marinade over medium heat
4. Saute onion in marinade
5. In a large bowl , beat egg whites lightly with fork
6. Add onions , breadcrumbs , milk , salt , pepper , oregano , eggs , mint and ground beef
7. Mix well
8. Shape into meatballs
9. Roll each meatball in flour
10. In a large skillet , over medium heat , saute meatballs in the remaining artichoke marinade
11. Remove meatballs as they brown
12. Add water and bouillon cubes to skillet
13. Mash bouillon cubes into water
14. Stir until smooth and thick
15. Stir in lemon juice and lemon slices
16. Return meatballs to pan
17. Cover and cook over low heat about 10 minutes
18. Add artichoke hearts
19. Cook 2 more minutes
20. Remove meatballs and artichokes to serving platter , leaving sauce in pan
21. Beat egg yolks
22. Stir 1 tbsp sauce in pan into yolks and combine with remaining sauce
23. Serve over meatballs

title: iraqi shabbat chicken
steps:
1. Chop onions and place in a large oven casserole dish adding tomato puree and about 1 litre of water
2. Place chicken on top of onions and put into a pre-heated oven at about 150c for about 3 1 / 2 hours
3. When cooked , remove chicken and place to one side
4. Take half the juices with the puree and onions and put into a saucepan
5. Add the okra , salt , pepper and lemon juice and bring to the boil , simmer gently for 30 minutes
6. If tinned okra is used , drain well before use
7. Wash basmati rice throughly and add to the rest of the juices in the casserole dish , add some more water to just cover and place back into the oven to cook for a further 1 hour
8. When the rice is cooked , portion up the chicken and add to the top of the rice and cook for a further 1 / 2 hour
9. The rice is now a wonderful reddy / golden colour with the taste of the chicken infused
10. Serve altogether with the okra sauce

title: even cowgirls get the blues cookies
steps:
1. Ghiradelli or other fine chocolate only , no substitutions !
2. Preheat oven to 350-degrees
3. Melt butter and 1 / 2 bag of chocolate chips over low heat , stirring frequently
4. Combine both sugars in large bowl , and add butter-chocolate mixture , stirring well
5. Add vanilla and eggs
6. Add baking powder , soda , cinnamon , nutmeg and flour , blending thoroughly
7. Add chocolate chips , oatmeal , and coconut , mixing well
8. Drop by rounded tablespoons onto cookie sheet
9. Bake 12-15 minutes , until cookies just begin to turn brown- don't overbake !

title: creamed spinach with jalapenos
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees
2. Butter a small casserole dish
3. Place the spinach in a microwave-safe bowl , and cook in the microwave 5 minutes on high , until heated through
4. Drain well , reserving 1 / 2 cup liquid
5. Melt 2 t
6. Butter in small saucepan over medium heat , and stir in the bread crumbs until well coated
7. Remove from heat , and set aside
8. Melt remaining 2 t
9. Butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat
10. Stir in flour
11. Mix in onion and garlic , and cook 1 minute
12. Gradually stir in reserved spinach liquid , evaporated milk , cheese , and jalapeno
13. Season with celery salt and pepper
14. Mix in the spinach
15. Transfer to the prepared casserole dish , and top with bread crumbs
16. Bake 45 minutes in the preheated oven , until bubbly and golden browned

title: top me twice cake
steps:
1. Preheat overn to 350
2. In large mixing bowl , combine all cake ingredients and beat low speed till blended
3. Beat 2 minutes more at medium speed
4. Pour into 9 inch square pan , greased on bottom only
5. Prepare topping by combining all ingredients
6. Sprinkle over cake
7. Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until top springs back when lightly touched in center
8. Just before cake is done , prepare sauce by melting butter in saucepan
9. Blend in remaining ingredients
10. When cake comes out of oven pour sauce over warm cake
11. Cool
12. Best served the same day it is made
