title: raw vegan moroccan carrot salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix together all the ingredients
2. Cover and let marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours or up to 2 days to allow the flavors to meld
3. Served chilled or at room temperature

title: ultimate red velvet cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease and flour a 9x13" cake pan , or three 8" cake pans and set aside
3. Cream sugar and butter together
4. Stir in eggs , vanilla and food coloring
5. Stir in mashed potatoes
6. Beat well
7. Whisk together flour , baking soda , salt , and cocoa
8. In a large bowl combine alternating portions of milk , flour mixture , and butter mixture until all ingredients are combined
9. Spread batter evenly in prepared cake pans
10. Bake in a preheated 350 oven for 30-45 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted near center of cake comes out clean
11. And you may use mashed fresh pototoes instead of instant ~ just be sure and get all the lumps out
12. ) if you do

title: butternut squash spaghetti sauce
steps:
1. In a blender / food processor , puree the squash and the can of tomatoes
2. You may have to do more than one batch
3. In a sauce pan , simmer the puree and add the remaining ingredients
4. Add more stewed tomatoes , sauce and / or paste as needed
5. Simmer for 15-20 minutes
6. Wonderful served over whole wheat pasta with a big green salad and crusty bread
7. Enjoy !

title: chicken breast stuffed with apple and goat cheese
steps:
1. Place chicken breast on a large sheet of waxed or plastic
2. Cover with another sheet
3. Pound chicken breast to 1 / 4 inch thickness , remove the top sheet and season with salt and pepper
4. Combine the goat cheese , lemon rind , and apple
5. Divide the apple mixture among the chicken breast and spread the mixture evenly over half the surface of each breast
6. Fold each breast in half and press the edges together , forming a pocket
7. Sprinkle the flour onto a sheet of waxed paper
8. In a small bowl combine the egg and water
9. In a shallow bowl , combine the bread crumbs and parmesan cheese
10. Dust each chicken breast lightly with flour and dip into egg mixture , moistening all surfaces
11. Coat with bread crumb mixture , patting the crumbs gently in place
12. In a large , heavy skillet , heat butter and oil over medium heat
13. Add chicken
14. Cook until browned and cooked through , about 8 to 10 minutes per side , drain on paper towels and serve

title: italian knife and fork soup
steps:
1. Slice both kinds of sausage
2. Combine with 1 / 4 cup water in a large saucepan
3. Simmer , covered , 4 minutes
4. Drain
5. Brown the sausage in the saucepan
6. Remove , discard drippings , and wipe pan clean with a paper towel
7. Slice the potatoes thinly
8. Cut the red and green peppers into thin strips
9. Chop the onion
10. Heat the olive oil in the saucepan
11. Saute the potatoes , peppers , onion , garlic , oregano , and rosemary in hot oil for 5 minutes
12. Stir in the chicken stock , tomato paste , 1 / 4 cup water , and sausage
13. Cook , covered , for 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
14. Season with salt and pepper
15. To serve , ladle into soup bowls and top with green onion , parmesan cheese , and croutons

title: spicy sausage quiche
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish
3. Place sausage in a large , deep skillet
4. Cook over medium-high heat until evenly brown
5. Drain and crumble
6. Spread into bottom of baking dish
7. Sprinkle with cheddar cheese , monterey jack cheese , onion , chile peppers , and jalapeno pepper
8. In a medium bowl , mix eggs with chili powder , cumin , garlic powder , salt and pepper
9. Pour over contents of baking dish
10. Bake in preheated oven for 18 to 22 minutes , or until a knife inserted into the center comes out clean
11. Cool for 10 minutes , then cut into squares

title: vegetable soup with creamed corn
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat
2. Add leek and celery and cook for 3-4 minutes or until leek has softened
3. Add stock , creamed corn and squash , stir to combine
4. Bring to the boil , reduce heat to low , simmer , stirring occasionally for about 10 minutes
5. Add spinach and pepper , remove from heat , stir until spinach has wilted
6. Serve immediately and enjoy !

title: bleu egg salad and bacon sandwich
steps:
1. Coarsely chop the eggs and combine them with the celery , bacon , scallion and bleu cheese dressing in a mixing bowl
2. Stir well
3. Keep chilled until just before serving
4. Spread the salad evenly , topped with lettuce and tomato , on your choice of rolls or bread pieces of bread

title: slow cooker korean bbq
steps:
1. Mix everything together , put into crockpot on low for 8 hours
2. Serve with rice

title: salmon and asparagus pasta   clean eating
steps:
1. Blanch asparagus , then run under cold water to stop the cooking process
2. Broil pasta
3. Meanwhile , in a large bowl , combine ricotta , lemon juice and , once pasta is done , water
4. Toss with asparagus , pasta , salmon salt and pepper

title: romaine and greek vegetable salad
steps:
1. Combine first 8 ingredients in a large bowl
2. Toss gently
3. Add dressing and cheese just before serving
4. Toss gently and serve

title: slow cooker barbecue ribs
steps:
1. Cut ribs apart if neccessary , and trim
2. Sprinkle with 1 t salt evenly over ribs , and set aside
3. Stir together remaining 1 t salt , chopped onion , and next 9 ingredients until blended
4. Pour half of mixture into a 5 quart slow cooker
5. Place ribs in slow cooker
6. Pour remaining mixture over ribs
7. Cover and cook at high for 6-7 hours

title: oeufs enterallies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Peel and slice thinly the hard boiled eggs
3. Make medium cream sauce using butter , flour , light cream and milk
4. Add cheddar cheese , stirring until cheese is melted
5. Season with garlic , thyme , marjoram and basil
6. Add parsley
7. Pour some of the cream sauce into a 13 x 9 inch baking dish
8. Add a layer of egg slices , then bacon crumbles and more cheese sauce
9. Continue until ingredients are used up , ending with sauce
10. Sprinkle with buttered bread crumbs
11. Bake for 20 minutes until bubbly and crumbs are browned

title: grown up hot chocolate
steps:
1. In saucepan over low heat , bring chocolate chips and half-and-half to simmer , whisking constantly
2. Simmer 1 min or until mixture thickens slightly
3. Remove from heat
4. Whisk in liqueur & vanilla
5. Pour into four 1 / 2 cup demitasse cups or coffee cups
6. Top each serving with 2 tablespoons whipped cream
7. Dust wih ghirardelli unsweetened cocoa , if desired
8. Serve immediately and enjoy !

title: spaghetti alle vongole  spaghetti with clams
steps:
1. Saute garlic and pepper in the oil
2. Add the tomatoes and cook 10 to 15 minutes over medium flame
3. Add clams , cover and cook 5-10 minutes , stirring frequently
4. Clams are cooked when they are opened
5. Serve over spaghetti or your choice of pasta cooked al dente
6. Don't eat any of the clams that do not open

title: chameleon macaroni salad
steps:
1. Cook and drain macaroni
2. Fry and crumble bacon
3. Stir all ingredients together
4. Chill
5. May need to add a little salad dressing before serving depending on how you like it

title: potato salad with warm onion dressing
steps:
1. Place a steamer basket in a saucepan with 1 / 2" of water
2. Place the potatoes in the steamer
3. Bring to a boil over high heat
4. Reduce heat to medium , cover& cook 20 minutes , or until tender
5. Rinse under cold water briefly & drain
6. Place in large serving bowl
7. Meanwhile , heat the oil in a medium nonstick skillet over medium heat
8. Add onion & garlic & cook stirring for 8 minutes , or until the onion is very soft
9. Add the vinegar , apple juice , mustard , parsley , & salt
10. Cook for 2 minutes or until heated through
11. Pour over the potatoes
12. Toss to coat
13. Than let stand at least 15 minutes to allow the flavors to blend

title: honey hoisin basting sauce
steps: 1. Combine all the ingredients in a nonreactive bowl or blender

title: coney island hot dog chili
steps:
1. Saute onion , green pepper and garlic in oil for about 3 minutes
2. Add in ground beef
3. Cook and stir until browned
4. Add remaining ingredients
5. Cover and simmer 35-40 minutes
6. Add a little water to thin sauce if desired
7. Cool completely
8. Puree in batches for desired consistency , but don't puree until thoroughly smooth

title: moldovan eggplant with garlic and walnut sauce  appetizer
steps:
1. Slice the unpeeled eggplant into rounds of 1 / 2 inch thick , and then cut each round in half crosswise
2. Rinse and place on paper towel to drain
3. Sprinkle with salt and let the eggplant stand for at least 30 minutes
4. Pat dry
5. In large skillet heat 1 tablespoon of oil
6. Place some eggplant slices in the hot oil and cook over medium-low heat , covered , until soft and lightly browned , about 2 to 3 minutes
7. Turn the eggplant , add another tablespoon of oil to the pan , and cook , covered , for another 2 to 3 minutes
8. Remove the eggplant slices from the oil and drain well
9. Repeat the process with the remaining slices , adding oil as necessary
10. In a mortar with a pestle , pound 1 teaspoon salt the garlic and the nuts to make a paste
11. Mix well the paste adding the vinegar and the water
12. Spread the paste lightly on the cooked eggplant slices
13. Let sit for 10 minutes
14. Place the eggplant on a dish and serve at room temperature , garnished with chopped parsley

title: best kabobs ever pakistani style
steps:
1. In large bowl crumble ground beef and all ingredients
2. Mix it all up and shape into kabobs
3. Grill or pan cook

title: chilled mocha eggnog
steps:
1. In a bowl , dissolve coffee in water
2. Add eggnog , brown sugar and cinnamon
3. Whisk until sugar is dissolved
4. Chill
5. In a mixing bowl , beat cream ,
6. Confectioners' sugar and vanilla until soft peaks form
7. Pour eggnog mixture into glasses
8. Top with whipped cream

title: country fried steak and gravy
steps:
1. If necessary , pound cubed steaks to 1 / 4-inch thickness between 2 sheets of plastic wrap , using a meat pounder or rolling pin
2. Set aside
3. Combine flour and pepper in a shallow dish
4. Pour buttermilk into a second dish
5. Spread crushed crackers on a plate
6. Dredge steaks , one at a time , in seasoned flour
7. Dip in buttermilk
8. Then in crushed crackers , to coat thoroughly , pressing with finger
9. Melt shortening in 12-inch skillet over medium heat
10. Add steaks
11. Cook 2-3 minutes on each side , until golden brown and cooked through
12. Remove to paper towel-lined platter and keep warm
13. Stir mushroom soup and milk into drippings in skillet
14. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly
15. Remove from heat
16. Serve steaks accompanied by gravy

title: pistachio brittle
steps:
1. Place pistachios on baking sheet
2. Bake in 300 degree f oven to keep warm while preparing candy
3. Combine sugar , butter , water and corn syrup in saucepan
4. Cook , without stirring , to soft crack stage on candy thermometer
5. Add lemon extract and pistachios
6. Pour onto foil lined baking sheet
7. Cool
8. Break into serving-size pieces
9. Makes approximately 36 pieces

title: kiftah  palestine  middle east
steps:
1. Place hamburger meat in a bowl , and add salt , and some mixed spices
2. If you don't have mixed spices , there are a couple recipes on this website for mixed spices
3. Or , you can add salt , all season , cumin , black pepper , and adobo
4. Using a food processer or blender , chop 1 onion and 1 cup of fresh parsley
5. If you dont have fresh parsley , dry parsley will work , just make sure its chopped finely
6. Add both the onion and the parsley to the hamburger meat , and mix well
7. Next , you can either make good sized meatballs with the hamburger meat , or make them longer , short of like fat stubby fingers
8. Do this until you have used up all the hamburger meat , and put these on the bottom of a baking pan with at least a 1 inch edge to it
9. Peel the onions and the potatoes , and core the green peppers
10. Cut them each into four pieces , and place in the pan with the hamburger meat
11. Also cut the tomatoe into four pieces and add as well
12. In a blender , add 1 heaping tablespoon of tahina , squeeze one lemon into the blender , and add a teaspoon of salt
13. Then fill the blender half way with water , and mix well
14. Poor the blender mixture on top of the meat and vegetables , and bake in the oven at 350 degrees for about 45 minutes
15. This is normally serves over rice , or can be eaten with pita bread
16. Enjoy !

title: whole wheat pizza crust fleischmann
steps:
1. Oven 450
2. I like thin , crunchy crust - i bake crust on a drying rack right on oven shelf
3. Combine sugar into water , add yeast
4. Set aside
5. Combine flours and salt
6. Pour in yeast and corn oil
7. Mix or hand knead for 3 minutes
8. Place in oiled bowl , cover , and let rise 30 minutes in a warm place
9. Punch down and divide for two crusts
10. You can freeze dough up to one month
11. Thaw in refrigerator 8-12 hours or room temp 2-3 hours
12. No need to let it rise after thawing

title: super spicy brown pork chops
steps:
1. Set out three medium bowls or pie plates
2. In first bowl , combine mustard and honey
3. In second bowl , combine egg and milk
4. In third bowl place the bread crumbs
5. Dip each pork chop in honey mustard , lightly coating each side , then in egg mixture , then in bread crumbs , coating well
6. Fill a large frying pan with about 1 / 4-inch of vegetable oil and heat over high heat
7. Reduce to medium heat and add pork chops
8. Fry each side until brown and crispy , about 10 minutes per side for thick chops , adjust accordingly for different thicknesses
9. Keep any cooked chops in a 375f oven on a baking sheet until remaining are done
10. Enjoy !

title: basque tomato sauce
steps:
1. In a 6-quart saucepot saute the garlic , onion , and green pepper in the oil until tender
2. Add the tomatoes , pureed chilies , and parsley and simmer until very tender
3. Add beef stock
4. Cover and simmer 1 hour
5. Uncover and simmer 1 hour more to reduce and thicken the sauce
6. Stir occasionally
7. Salt and pepper to taste

title: ham hodgepodge
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except the garbanzo beans in a dutch oven
2. Bring to boil
3. Cover and simmer for 1 hour
4. Stir in the undrained garbanza beans
5. Cover and cook for 10 to 15 minutes more
6. Add more water if needed

title: jalapeno zucchini cornbread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease a loaf pan d or a square cake pan
3. In a medium pan , saute onion in butter until soft and translucent
4. Let cool
5. With an electric mixer , combine softened butter , eggs and buttermilk
6. Add in zucchini , jalapeno peppers , honey , flour , cornmeal , baking powder , baking soda ands salt
7. Mix well
8. Pour mixture into prepared pan
9. Bake in preheated oven for about 45-50 minutes or until toothpick comes up clean before slicing
10. Serve with butter and jam or jelly
11. Can be made ahead and frozen
12. Let sit for about 20 minues until slightly thickened

title: rachael ray s thick cut onion rings with spicy dipping sauce
steps:
1. Heat 1" oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat
2. Slice onions across into 1" rings and separate , discarding the outer layer of skin
3. Pour evaporated milk into a small bowl
4. Mix flour with seasonings in a pie plate or shallow dish
5. Dip individual rings in milk , then coat in flour
6. Fry in a single layer in hot oil till golden brown
7. Remove to brown paper bag or paper towel lined surface to drain
8. Salt while hot , to taste
9. For dipping sauce , combine all ingredients in a bowl and stir
10. 15 minutes is approximately
11. Frying time

title: snicker surprise peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300f
2. In a medium bowl , sift together flour , baking soda , and salt
3. In a large bowl , mix together butter , peanut butter , and sugars until light and fluffy
4. Add eggs and vanilla and combine thoroughly
5. Then mix in flour mixture
6. Cover and chill dough 2-3 hours
7. To form cookie , scoop a tablespoon of chilled dough and flatten
8. Place a miniature snickers in the center and form the dough into a ball around the snickers
9. Place on a greased cookie sheet
10. Bake for 10-20 minutes
11. Cool cookies on a rack
12. Optional: decorate cookies with powdered sugar or drizzled melted chocolate or both

title: low fat beef goulash
steps:
1. Heat oil in a skillet , and fry onion until softened
2. Add steak and cook for a few minutes
3. Stir in paprika , add bay leaves , wine , tomatoes and stock
4. Bring to boil
5. Season to taste , then simmer for 1 hour or so
6. Garnish with chopped parsley before serving

title: millet with sweet vegetables
steps:
1. Layer ingredients in the following order
2. Onions , squash , carrots , cabbage , millet
3. Gently add water and bring to a boil
4. Simmer for 30 minutes then season with salt
5. Simmer for 10 more minutes
6. Place in serving bowls and garnish with parsley

title: quinoa with edamame  parm  and egg
steps:
1. In a bowl , mix together the quinoa and edamame , and toss with one teaspoon of olive oil and season to taste with salt and pepper
2. Heat a tablespoon or so of olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat
3. Fry the egg until whites are set , but yolk is still runny
4. Season egg with salt and pepper
5. Sprinkle the cheese over the quinoa and top with the hot fried egg
6. Serve with the sliced avocado , drizzled with a bit of olive oil and seasoned with salt and pepper

title: traditional lemonade
steps:
1. Thinly slice two lemons and place into a serving jug
2. Using a vegetable peeler , thinly peel the rind from the remaining two lemons
3. Place in a pan with sugar and water and stir over a low heat until the sugar is dissolved
4. Bring to boil and add mint , simmer uncovered for 5 minutes and allow to cool
5. Strain the sugar syrup into the serving jug and stir in the juice
6. Prior to serving , add mineral water and ice cubes and stir well

title: multi grain bread
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl combine bread flour , yeast , sunflower seeds , and flax seeds
2. Set aside
3. In a medium saucepan , combine milk through salt
4. Heat and stir over medium-low heat until warm
5. Add to dry mixture
6. Beat with electric mixer on low to medium 30 seconds , scraping sides of bowl often
7. Beat on high 3 minutes
8. Using a wooden spoon , stir in soy flour , rolled oats , and as much whole wheat flour as you can
9. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface
10. Knead in enough of the whole wheat flour to make a moderately stiff dough that is smooth and elastic
11. Shape into a ball
12. Place in a lightly greased bowl , turning to grease top
13. Cover and let rise until nearly double
14. Punch dough down
15. Turn dough out onto a lightly greased surface
16. Divide in half
17. Cover and let rest for 10 minutes
18. Lightly grease 2 loaf pans
19. Shape each portion into a loaf
20. Place in prepared pans
21. Cover , let rise till double
22. Brush tops of loaves with water , sprinkle with additional rolled oats
23. Bake in a 375f oven for 30-35 minutes until center of loaf reads 190f on an instant read thermometer
24. If necessary , cover loosely with foil for last 10 minutes to prevent over browning
25. Immediately remove bread from pans
26. Cool on wire racks

title: subway vegetable  delite  wrap  copycat
steps:
1. Spread the refried beans and sliced cheese onto the tortilla and microwave it for 30 seconds , or until melted
2. Put the lettuce , tomato , onion , pickles , olives and any other vegetable that you want on top of the cheese
3. Drizzle with dressings
4. Making sure that all the filling is in the centre of the tortilla , wrap it up carefully , tucking in all edges
5. I hope my instructions are clear enough ! :)

title: gingerbread skeletons
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , cream the sugar and butter together
2. Add molasses and water
3. In a separate bowl , mix the flour , salt , nutmeg , baking soda , ginger , and allspice
4. Gradually add the dry mixture to the wet and blend until the dough holds together
5. Cover and chill for 2-3 hours
6. Preheat the oven to 375f
7. Roll out dough 1 / 4" thick on a lightly floured surface
8. Cut into shapes with cookie cutters and transfer to cookie sheet
9. Bake for 10-12 minutes
10. Remove from the oven and let cool on baking sheets or cooling racks
11. Using the white decorating icing , decorate the cookies with "bones" so that they resemble skeletons

title: sweet  n tangy bbq sauce
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , stir chili sauce and apple jelly over medium heat until jelly dissolves
2. Stir in remaining ingredients and use on ribs , or whatever you desire !

title: ziti alfredo
steps:
1. Melt butter in a medium , non-stick saucepan over medium heat
2. Add cream cheese and garlic powder , stirring with wire whisk until smooth
3. Add milk , a little at a time , whisking to smooth out lumps
4. Stir in parmesan and pepper
5. Remove from heat when sauce reaches desired consistency
6. Sauce will thicken rapidly , thin with milk if cooked too long
7. Toss with hot pasta to serve
8. Enjoy

title: pork  squash and apple dinner
steps:
1. Heat over to 350
2. In small bowl mix brown sugar , butter and cinnamon until crumbly
3. Set aside
4. Slice squash into 1 / 2" rings
5. Cut rings in half
6. Remove seeds
7. Cut apple into chunks
8. In shallow dish , stir together bisquick mix , salt , pepper and cracker crumbs
9. In another shallow dish , mix egg and water
10. Dip pork into egg mixture , then coat with bisquick mixture
11. Spray a 12" nonstick skillet with cooking spray , heat over medium high heat
12. Cook pork in skillet 6-8 minutes turning once , until coating is brown
13. Place pork in ungreased 13x9 baking dish
14. Arrange squash and apples around pork
15. Sprinkle with brown sugar mixture
16. Bake uncovered 40-45 minutes or until squash is tender and pork is no longer pink in the center

title: marrow rice
steps:
1. Wash the marrow and cut it into cubes
2. Heat the oil in a large , heavy based pan and fry the onions for 5 mins , then add the marrow , green peper , rice , garlic , bay leaf , tomatoes and water
3. Add salt and pepper to taste
4. Bring to the boil , then turn the heat down and cover
5. Cook very gently until the rice is cooked and all the liquid is absorbed
6. Check the seasoning
7. Sprinkle with the parsley and serve

title: pumpkin bread with caramel icing
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a bowl combine sugar , oil , orange juice , eggs and pumpkin
3. Using a hand mixer beat on low for one minute
4. Add dry ingredients and mix on low for one minutes or until moistened
5. Spray and flour two 9x5 loaf pans
6. Divide mixture between the two pans
7. Brown sugar topping: in a small bowl with a fork blend all ingredients until crumbly
8. Sprinkle over the top of the pumpkin mixture and bake for 60 minutes or until a tooth pick comes out clean
9. Caramel icing: in a small sauce pan melt the butter , brown sugar and milk
10. Cook for one minute until everything is melted and mixture starts a slight boil
11. Remove from the heat and add remaining ingredients and beat on low until all items are combined
12. Cool slightly
13. Using a plastic storage bag with the corner cut off or a cake decorating bag drizzle caramel icing across the top of the pumpkin bread

title: southwestern casserole
steps:
1. Cook chicken breasts and shred or cube then set aside
2. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
3. Blend can of stewed tomatoes and enchilada sauce in a blender until smooth
4. In a large pot , heat olive oil and saute red onion and bell pepper until tender
5. Add the enchilada sauce , corn and spinach then simmer for 3-4 minutes
6. Drain and rinse beans
7. Then add seasonings , chicken , and beans
8. Simmer for about 5 minutes
9. Finally , add about 2 hand fulls of cheese
10. Have a casserole dish ready and begin assembling
11. First lay down a layer of tortillas , then a layer of the mixture
12. Continue this ending with a layer of tortillas on top
13. Put a generous layer of cheese on top
14. Place casserole in the oven for 20 minutes or until cheese is golen brown

title: pork chops   mushrooms  baked in foil
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c
2. Line a large baking tin with alumnium foil leaving a very generous overlap over all sides
3. In a large frying pan , melt the butter and fry the pork chops on both sides until golden brown
4. Transfer cooked chops to the foil lined baking tin
5. Sprinkle chops evenly with 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , 1 / 4 teaspoon freshly ground pepper and thyme
6. Add mushrooms to the frying pan , along with a little more butter if necessary , and cook , stirring , until the juices from the mushrooms begin to run
7. Add the lemon juice and allow it to boil for 1 minute
8. Now , sprinkle on the flour and stir with a wooden spoon to combine
9. Spoon this mushroom mixture evenly over the pork chops
10. Sprinkle lightly with a little more salt and pepper
11. Spoon big dobs of creme fraiche evenly over the top of the mushroom mixture
12. Wrap the whole lot loosely in the foil , sealing securely , but making sure you leave some space between the top of the chops and the foil
13. Bake on the centre shelf of the preheated 180c oven for 1 hour
14. Remove from oven , unwrap and serve , spooning any extra juices over the chops - you'll find you have more of a 'topping' than a 'sauce'
15. Serve with simple side dishes as this is a rich meal

title: cuban chopped beef and rice
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large skillet
2. Add the beef and saute until lightly browned , stirring to break up any clumps , about 7 minutes
3. Add the onion and garlic and saute for 5 minutes longer
4. Add all the remaining ingredients except the butter and almonds
5. Mix well and simmer , uncovered , over moderate heat for about 20 minutes
6. In a small skillet , heat the butter and saute the almonds until they are golden brown
7. Mound the beef onto a serving platter and surround with white rice
8. Drizzle almonds over rice

title: dry ranch dressing mix
steps:
1. Put crackers through blender on high speed until powdered
2. Add parsley , minced onions , and dill weed
3. Blend again until powdered
4. Dump into bowl
5. Stir in onion salt , garlic salt , onion powder , and garlic powder
6. Put into container with tight-fitting lid

title: cucumber spaghetti salad with dill
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to directions for "al dente"
2. Rinse
3. Drain well
4. Combine dressing , seasoned salt , pepper , dill weed , half & half
5. Stir together
6. Add cucumbers and onions
7. Set aside
8. Combine with pasta
9. Chill
10. Best when allowed to sit overnight so all the flavors and the sauce can absorb into the pasta

title: ryan s rich cream biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Sift flour , sugar , baking powder , cream of tartar and salt into medium bowl
3. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse meal
4. Add cream and stir just incorporated
5. Turn dough out onto lightly floured surface and knead 15 seconds
6. Pat dough into 1 / 2-inch-thick round , using heel of hand
7. Cut into rounds using a 1 1 / 2-inch biscuit cutter
8. Pat scraps into disc and cut out additional rounds
9. Arrange biscuits on 2 large baking sheets spacing 1 inch apart
10. Bake until biscuits have risen and tops are golden brown , about 15 minutes
11. Transfer to racks
12. Cool slightly
13. Serve hot or at room temperature

title: caribbean chicken quesadillas
steps:
1. Combine the chicken with all of the ingredients except tortillas
2. Brush 1 side of each tortilla with vegetable oil
3. On the non-oiled side , top half of each tortilla with the chicken mixture and fold in half
4. Cook in a large skillet or griddle over medium low heat for at least 3 - 4 minutes per side or until the cheese is melted and the tortilla is lightly browned
5. Cut each quesadilla into 3 wedges
6. Serve with salsa and sour cream , if desired

title: cranberry crumble cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Spray a 13 by 9 inch baking pan with cooking spray
3. To prepare filling: combine dried apricots and water in a small bowl
4. Let stand 30 minutes
5. Combine remaining filling ingredients in a large bowl
6. Add apricots and soaking liquid
7. Mix well
8. Spoon into prepared pan
9. To prepare cake: combine flour , sugar , butter and salt in food processor
10. Pulse until crumbly
11. Set aside 1 cup for streusel topping
12. Add egg to flour mixture in food processor
13. Dissolve baking soda in buttermilk , stir well and add to flour mixture
14. Add vanilla
15. Pulse to make a cake batter
16. Pour over cranberry mixture in pan
17. To prepare streusel , add streusel ingredients to reserved flour mixture
18. Toss well
19. Sprinkle over cake batter and bake 40 to 45 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted into the center comes out clean
20. Cool on a wire rack

title: overnight brick sandwich
steps:
1. Slice the focaccia lenghtwise through the center to split the loaf into halves
2. Pull out most of the soft insides of both halves of the focaccia and discard or reserve for another use
3. Spread half of the soft spreadable cheese over the insides of both bread halves , then top that with a thin spread of tapenade
4. Arrange the red peppers on top of the tapenade on only one of the bread halves
5. Top the peppers with the prosciutto , then the artichoke hearts , half of the provolone cheese , the sun-dried tomatoes , salami , basil , then the remaining provolone cheese
6. Top the sandwich with the other half of the bread , then wrap sandwich tightly in plastic wrap
7. Set the sandwich on a large baking sheet , then carefully set 1 or 2 bricks on top
8. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours , preferably overnight
9. When ready to serve , unwrap the sandwich and cut crosswise into slices
10. If your bricks are too dirty for you to feel comfortable placing them in your refrigerator , cover them in foil

title: honeyed apple pratie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Place mashed potato in a bowl
3. Sift the flour , sugar and baking powder over potato mash
4. Mix to form a stiff dough
5. Refrigerate this pastry for 30 minutes
6. Meanwhile: peel and core apples , cut them into 1 / 2 inch slices , cover with water to prevent browning while rolling out pastry
7. Lightly grease an 8 inch pie plate
8. Divide pastry in half
9. Roll out one half to fit base of pie plate
10. Drain and pat dry apple slices , arrange them over pastry base and sprinkle with cinnamon and drizzle with honey
11. Roll out remaining half of pastry to cover top of pie
12. Trim edges
13. Cut three deep slits into pastry for steam vents
14. Glaze with water and sprinkle sugar
15. Bake 30-40 minutes or until golden
16. Serve immediately
17. Whipped cream or even vanilla ice cream is a perfect accompaniment

title: coconut macaroon pie
steps:
1. Beat sugar , salt and eggs until mixture in a lemon color
2. Add butter and flour
3. Blend well
4. Add milk and one cup of coconut
5. Pour into the pie shell
6. Top with remaining coconut
7. Bake at 325 degrees for an hour

title: spinach casserole dee lish
steps:
1. Cook spinach until done , drain well , return to pan
2. Over a low heat , stir in chunks of cream cheese and the cream of chicken soup
3. Keep stirring and heating until all ingredients are melted into a creamy mixture
4. Can be served from the pan , but better if baked at 350f for approximately ten minutes

title: dessert puff pastry
steps:
1. 1
2. Bring the water to a boil in a large pot over the stove
3. 2
4. Add the butter and allow it to melt completely
5. 3
6. Turn off heat and mix in flour and sugar , followed by eggs and vanilla
7. 4
8. Transfer dough into pastry bag
9. 5
10. Squeeze dough onto well greased cookie sheet
11. Form thick lines or dots
12. 6
13. Bake 20-25 minutes at 395 degrees
14. Watch for the top to tan
15. They should be light brown for the best texture
16. 7
17. Wait to cool before filling and / or frosting

title: autumn pumpkin popcorn
steps:
1. Mix sugar and pumpkin pie spice together in small bowl
2. Pop corn in your microwave according to package directions , or your microwave settings
3. Remove from microwave and open bag
4. Sprinkle pumpkin spice mixture over hot popcorn and shake up to distribute evenly
5. Enjoy !

title: pecan nut  meat  balls
steps:
1. Saute onion and celery in oil
2. Dissolve bouillon cubes in 1 cup boiling water
3. Toss all dry ingredients together
4. Add onion , celery and vegetable broth to dry mixture and mix well
5. Let stand 15 minutes
6. Form into balls
7. Bake on well greased cookie sheet for 15 minutes at 350f
8. Serve with your favorite tomatoe sauce or brown gravy

title: peanut butter hot cocoa
steps:
1. In a large kettle , combine 1 cup milk and peanut butter
2. Stirring frequently , cook over low heat until smooth
3. Increase heat to medium
4. Slowly stir in remaining 8 cups milk and chocolate mix
5. Stirring occasionally , cook just until mixture simmers
6. Garnish with whipped cream

title: easy creamy ranch chicken potato soup  rsc
steps:
1. Place 1 / 2 cup water in 5-6 quart pot , add two packets of hidden valley ranch dip mix and stir until well mixed
2. Add 6 1 / 2 cups water and add all remaining ingredients
3. Except fresh spinach
4. Bring soup to boil over medium heat
5. Reduce heat to med / low cook until vegetables are desired crispness
6. 30-45 minute
7. Garnish with fresh chopped spinach
8. Serve hot
9. May be made in crock pot

title: coconut ice cream
steps:
1. Mix the coconut cream powder and the warm water together
2. Spoon a bit of the liquid into the cornstarch to liquefy , and then add back into the coconut milk mix
3. Add sugar and salt and bring to a boil
4. If lumps form for any reason , strain them out
5. Cool mixture and use in your ice cream maker
6. Delicious !
7. You can also do the poor man's freeze ice cream where you freeze , scrape , freeze , scrape like granita but the texture is not going to be as nice as the ice cream machine
8. If your ice cream maker only makes a quart at at a time then just double the recipe

title: aunt joan s cinnamon rolls
steps:
1. Dough: mix first ingredients with a spoon
2. Add in flour gradually and then mix with your hands until you can knead the dough
3. Warm a bowl with hot water , dry and grease the bowl
4. Let the dough rise in the warmed , greased and covered bowl at room temperature until doubled
5. Make topping: cook sugar and butter until it is combined
6. Take off the heat , add caro syrup and stir
7. Pour 1 / 2 syrup mixture into each greased 9x13 pan
8. You can make the topping ahead of time and pour into the prepared pans while the dough is rising
9. Divide dough in half once doubled
10. Perform the following on each dough: roll dough out oblong to about 12 x 18 inches
11. Spread milk over the dough with your fingers sprinkle sugar and cinnamon over the dough
12. Can optionally add raisins
13. Roll up dough lengthwise
14. Researched cinnamon rolls on the internet and found 1c sugar + 1 tbl cinnamon was a pretty common ingredient set in cinnamon rolls
15. I tried these amounts and the sugar melted out of the rolls when they cooked and left gaps in the rolls that i wasn't happy with
16. Next time will use between 1 / 2 - 3 / 4 c sugar and a slightly reduced amount of cinnamon
17. Cut rolls about every 1 1 / 2 inches and place on top of syrup in pan
18. When you place the rolls , there will be big gaps between them - rolls will be 3 x 4 in the 9 x 12 pan
19. As they rolls rise the second time , these gaps will be filled in nicely
20. Let rise until "ready"
21. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes
22. Important - check the rolls about 20 minutes inches if the rolls on the edges start to brown and the middle looks not done - put tin foil over the rolls and cook a bit longer
23. Once all are done , run a spatula along the edge of the pan and then immediately turn out onto a bread board , cookie sheet , foil or wax paper to cool completely
24. Aunt joan lets them cool completely and then wraps tightly in wrap and puts most into the freezer now days as her kids are long ago grown and moved away
25. Believe me - even frozen and thawed these things rock

title: blackberry ham glaze
steps:
1. Mix everything in a sauce pan and bring to a boil
2. Reduce to simmer , and simmer stirring frequently until thickened and reduced to a syrup like consistancy
3. Baste ham with glaze during last 1 / 2 hour of cooking , being careful to keep an eye that it doen't burn
4. (just baste frequently

title: cinnamon bran and raisin cookies
steps:
1. In a bowl mix bran cereal and hot water
2. Cover and set aside
3. Cream shortening , white sugar and brown sugar until fluffy
4. Add eggs
5. In a seperate bowl combine flour , cinnamon , baking soda , and salt
6. Add to mixing bowl and stir until combined
7. By hand mix in rolled oats and raisins , and bran cereal until well combined
8. Drop by tablespoonful onto ungreased baking sheet
9. Bake 375f for about 10-12 minutes , or until golden brown
10. Cool completely and store in airtight container

title: fruit and feta salad
steps:
1. Cut or ball up the watermelon
2. Wash the strawberries and spinach
3. Slice up the strawberries & combine the watermelon , strawberries , feta , and spinach
4. Juice the limes and combine the limes , olive oil , salt , and pepper

title: louisiana fried oysters
steps:
1. Combine the first 9 ingredients in a bowl and mix well
2. Add in the oysters and marinate at least 30 minutes in the fridge
3. Put the remaining ingredients in a paper bag and mix well by shaking
4. Remove the oysters from the marinade and drop in the bag
5. Shake the bag to coat the oysters and let them rest in the bag for a few minutes
6. Heat about 2" of oil in the pan to 365 degrees
7. Place the oysters in the oil leaving at least a 3 / 4" space between pieces
8. Fry the oysters about 4 minutes or until done
9. Remove to paper towels to drain
10. After most of the oil has drained , remove to fresh paper towels
11. Make sure the oil is at least 360 degrees before adding and frying the next batch

title: carrot and lentil soup
steps:
1. Heat oil in a heavy based saucepan
2. Saute carrots and onion until onion is translucent
3. Add garlic , stock , orange juice , vinegar and pepper
4. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes
5. Add lentils and continue to simmer a further 10 minutes or until lentils and carrots are soft
6. Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly
7. Using a hand mixer , blend until smooth
8. Stir through coriander to serve

title: spicy peanut sauce
steps:
1. In a saucepan heat oil over medium heat and saut the scallions , garlic and ginger
2. Add / stir in the remaining ingredients and bring to a simmer , stirring
3. Simmer the sauce until smooth , then cool to room temperature
4. This sauce is best served at room temperature

title: dazzling herb gnocchi with basil oil
steps:
1. For the basil oil
2. To make the basil oil , place the extra basil , oil , lemon juice , parmesan , salt and pepper in the bowl of a food processor and process until finely chopped
3. Set aside
4. For the herb gnocchi
5. Follow the basic gnocchi recipe , adding the lemon zest , mint , parsley , basil , salt and pepper to the mixture
6. Place the ricotta , parmesan , eggs , flour , salt and pepper in a bowl and mix well to combine
7. Turn out the mixture on a lightly floured surface and roll into 4 15cm long ropes
8. Cut into 2cm lengths and press lightly with the back of a fork
9. Place in a large saucepan of salted water over high heat
10. Bring to a boil and cook the gnocchi in batches for 2-3 minutes or until cooked through
11. Remove with slotted spoon and place in serving bowls
12. Place in a large saucepan of salted water over high heat
13. Bring to a boil and cook the gnocchi in batches for 2-3 minutes or until cooked through
14. Remove with slotted spoon and place in serving bowls
15. To serve
16. Spoon the basil oil over the cooked gnocchi and toss to coat
17. Top with the parmesan cheese

title: lemon mousse cake
steps:
1. Bring sugar and water to a boil in saucepan , stirring to dissolve sugar
2. Add lemons
3. Return just to boil
4. Pour lemons and syrup into bowl , and let stand at least 2 hours or up to 6 hours
5. Grease 9" spring form pan
6. Line bottom with parchment or wax paper
7. Beat butter and sugar until fluffy
8. Beat in eggs , one at a time , and lemon rind
9. Combine dry ingredients together and add to butter mixture alternately with milk making 3 additions of flour and 2 of milk
10. Bake at 350 for 30-35 minutes or until toothpick inserted in centre comes out clean
11. Cool completely
12. Mousse:
13. Bring sugar , lemon rind and juice to boil
14. In a bowl beat eggs
15. Pour in hot lemon mixture and mix well
16. Pour back into pan and bring to just a boil over medium heat , stirring constantly
17. Cook and stir constantly for 5 minutes , or until thickened
18. Scrape into a bowl
19. Sprinkle gelatin over cold water in small saucepan
20. Let stand 5 minutes
21. Heat over low heat until dissolved
22. Stir into lemon mixture , mixing well
23. Place plastic wrap on surface of mousse and let cool , stirring once , gently , for 30 minutes or until no longer warm
24. In another bowl , whip cream and fold into lemon mixture
25. Refrigerate
26. Line 10" spring form pan with enough plastic wrap to leave overhang to cover top
27. Arrange lemon slices over bottom of pan , reserving syrup
28. Spoon half of mousse over lemons
29. Cut cake in half and brush cut sides with 3 / 4 cup reserved lemon syrup
30. Place one cake layer over mousse , cut side up
31. Spoon remaining mousse over cake
32. Place second cake layer over mousse , cut side down , and press to surround cake with mousse
33. Cover with plastic wrap and place on tray to catch any leaks
34. Refrigerate for at least 6 hours , or up to three days
35. Uncover cake and invert gently onto plate , remove plastic wrap and smooth sides if necessary with metal spatula
36. Garnish with fresh raspberries

title: chipotle baked stuffed potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Wash the potatoes and bake for an hour
3. Move to a baking sheet to cool 5 minutes
4. Leave oven on
5. Mince the chipotle
6. Melt the butter over low heat
7. Add the chipotle and cumin and cook about 3 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. Transfer to a bowl , add sour cream , and combine
9. Cut each potato in half lengthwise
10. Scoop out flesh , leaving a shell 1 / 2-inch thick
11. Add the potato flesh to sour cream mixture and stir until smooth
12. Add cilantro , salt , and pepper
13. Spoon mixture back into shells , and sprinkle with cheese
14. Bake 30 minutes until golden
15. Sprinkle with scallions and serve

title: carrot salad with black mustard seeds
steps:
1. If very moist , press shredded carrots dry before mixing the salad
2. Mix carrots , bell pepper , cashews and salt
3. In a small pan heat oil over medium heat until hot
4. Add mustard seeds and fry until they sputter and turn grey
5. Pour oil and seeds over salad , add herbs and toss to mix
6. Serve

title: tiropitakia  miniature greek cheese pies
steps:
1. Remove the filo pastry from the refrigerator and let stand at room temperature about 1 hour
2. Make the filling by mashing the feta until it crumbles
3. Add to this the eggs , emmenthal cheese , ricotta , parsley , mint and pepper and blend well
4. Cut each filo leaf into a strip 6 x 12"
5. Brush each leaf with the melted butter
6. Fold the leaves in half lengthwise making strips 3 x l1"
7. Again brush with butter and place 1 tbsp
8. Of the filling at the bottom of each leaf
9. Fold over to form a triangle and continue folding until the strip is completed
10. Repeat with each of the strips and place the completed triangles on a well greased cookie sheet
11. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
12. Brush the tops of each triangle with butter and then with a mixture of the egg yolk and 2 tbsp of water
13. Sprinkle over with the sesame seeds and bake in a medium oven until the pastries are golden brown and flaky
14. Serve hot or cool
15. Yields 16- 24 pastries

title: chicken with mushrooms and mustard
steps:
1. Pound breasts until 1 / 4" thick
2. Dredge in flour mixture
3. Heat oil over medium heat
4. Add chicken and saute about 7 minutes , turning once
5. Remove and keep warm
6. Add butter to frypan and increase heat to high
7. Add onion and mushrooms
8. Saute about 5 minutes
9. Reduce heat to low
10. Add cream , parsley , mustard and lemon juice
11. Bring to a boil stirring constantly
12. Add juices from chicken into cream mixture
13. Pour sauce over chicken and serve

title: the bianca pop
steps: 1. Pour coconut rum first then add amaretto

title: banana waffles
steps:
1. Beat the egg yolks until thickened
2. Add the milk and melted butter into yolks
3. Beat egg whites until stiff and set aside
4. Mix together the dry ingredients then add them to the yolk mixture
5. Add the beaten egg whites into the yolk mixture
6. Gentle stir in the bananas
7. Pour into a hot waffle iron
8. Bake for 3 minutes

title: venison parmesan
steps:
1. Mix together 3 tbsp
2. Parmesan cheese with 1 cup bread crumbs
3. In bowl , beat 2 eggs , salt and pepper to taste
4. Dip venison in eggs , then bread crumbs
5. Heat 6 tbsp
6. Olive oil in skillet till hot
7. Fry venison 5 mins
8. Each side till brown
9. Then place venison on a cookie sheet , spoon spaghetti sauce over venison and bake in 325 degree oven till tender , i usually bake 15 or 20 mins
10. Then add mozzeralla cheese and bake till cheese melts

title: jersey brisket
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees ,
2. Place meat in roasting pan
3. Combine ketchup , brown sugar , onion soup mix , water , and blackberry wine , mixing together well
4. Spoon over brisket in pan
5. Cover and bake for approximately 1 hour for each pound of meat
6. After baking 2 hours , remove from the oven and slice the meat
7. Return sliced meat to the pan and continue to bake until done

title: vegan pesto
steps:
1. Combine all the ingredients except the cloves of garlic into a food processor until everything is ground
2. I personally like it smoother than normal so i let the food processor run for a bit longer
3. Combine in the cloves of garlic one at a time and keep doing taste tests until you feel there is enough
4. Add more salt and pepper to taste and enjoy !

title: lobster seafood stuffing
steps:
1. Saut the celery and onion in the butter until tender
2. Add the herbs and seafood and cook until the shrimp and scallops are cooked through , about 10 minutes
3. Add the crushed crackers and mix well
4. Add the sherry and continue to cook for another 2 minutes
5. This is enogh stuffing for six lobsters
6. Or this can be made as a side dish
7. Cook for 20 minutes in a casserole dish at 350f

title: festive sugar plums   old fashioned sweetmeats
steps:
1. Put all of the dried fruit , ground almonds and glace ginger into a food processor and pulse until finely chopped
2. Add the grated orange zest and mix well
3. Then add the brandy or orange juice and pulse briefly until the mixture comes together
4. Mix the sugar and mixed spice together
5. Divide the sugar plum fruit mixture into 12 pieces and then roll into small balls , before rolling them in the spiced sugar to coat them all thoroughly
6. Cut the pistachios into slivers and cut the cherries into quarters , then push the pistachio slivers and cherry pieces into the top of the sugar plums , to imitate leaves and berries
7. Place them into small paper cases if you wish and store them in an airtight tin for up to 4 weeks if made with brandy , or up to 2 weeks in the fridge if made with orange juice
8. You may be able to perform the nutcracker ballet now - or not !

title: chicken in orange
steps:
1. Brown chicken on all sides in hot oil
2. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
3. Optional step: remove chicken from skillet , let cool , and cut into bite-size pieces , then return to skillet
4. Arrange onion over chicken
5. Combine oj concentrate , water , brown sugar , parsley , and ginger
6. Pour over chicken and onion
7. Cover and simmer 35-40 minutes or until chicken is tender
8. Serve over hot , cooked rice

title: easy sopapilla cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees and prepare a 9x13 pan with cooking spray
2. Mix cream cheese , vanilla and 1 c sugar until smooth
3. Spread 1 pk crescent rolls onto bottom of pan , press perforations to seal crust
4. Spread cream cheese mix on crust
5. Layer the 2nd pk crescent rolls on top of cream cheese mix
6. Melt butter and add 1 / 2 c sugar and cinnamon
7. Pour over top and bake for 30 minutes or until golden brown

title: jicama   orange salad with lime dressing
steps:
1. For the lime dressing , combine the sugar and dry mustard in a medium bowl
2. Add the oil , lime juice , honey water , and vinegar
3. Stir until well blended
4. Stir in cilantro
5. For salad , layer ingredients in order they are listed
6. Serve with the lime dressing

title: chicken green bean and walnut salad
steps:
1. Flop the beans , chicken , parsley , and nuts in a large bowl
2. Whisk together the vinegar , oil , salt , and pepper in a small bowl
3. Pour the dressing over the beans and chicken mixture and toss well
4. Stash it in the fridge for a couple of hours to allow the flavors to meld

title: skillet franks  n noodles
steps:
1. In a large skillet , melt the butter or margarine
2. Add the franks , onion , basil or oregano , to the skillet
3. Lightly brown the franks , and cook until onions are tender
4. Add the soup , milk , and tomatoes
5. Stir until well mixed and heated through
6. Add the cooked noodles , and finish heating
7. Stirring occasionally
8. Sprinkle parsley on top just before serving

title: portuguese potato salad
steps:
1. When potatoes are cool enough to handle , peel and cut into 1 / 2-inch cubes
2. Place potato cubes in a bowl
3. Sprinkle with vinegar while they are still warm
4. In a large skillet over medium heat
5. Add the olive oil and let it get heated
6. Add the sausages
7. Stir / saute for about 4 minutes or until lightly browned
8. Use a slotted spoon and transfer sausages to a paper-towel lined plate
9. To make the dressing: in a small mixing bowl , whisk the vinegar , salt and pepper together until the salt dissolves
10. Whisk in the mustard and anchovy paste until well blended
11. Gradually whisk in 4 tablespoons olive oil until an emulsion forms
12. If the dressing is too thick , go ahead and whisk in the remaining olive oil
13. Set dressing aside
14. Add the sausages , garbanzo beans , bell pepper , onion , celery , and parsley to the potatoes
15. Pour the dressing over the mixture
16. Toss gently until thoroughly coated
17. May serve right away or cover and refrigerate for up to 1 day
18. Bring to room temp before serving

title: kai si ming
steps:
1. Fry onion in large saucepan in oil until golden
2. Brown mince in oil
3. Add soup mix , curry powder , rice and boiling water
4. Simmer for 30 minutes
5. Add frozen peas and broccoli , celery and simmer a further 10 minutes
6. Add shredded cabbage and turn off heat
7. Leave to stand 5 minutes and serve

title: cheese  beef and tater tots casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. In a large skillet , brown beef and onion , stir in soup , milk , gravy mix and seasonings
3. Place green beans on the bottom of a 9x15 inch baking dish or pan
4. Pour meat mixture on top of beans
5. Arrange tater tots over the beans
6. Sprinkle cheese on top and bake for 30-35 minutes

title: honey butter
steps:
1. Beat butter and honey together until creamy
2. Sprinkle with cinnamon
3. Serve at room temperature

title: khasta roti
steps:
1. Sieve flour
2. Add baking powder , salt , ghee , cumin seeds and grated ginger
3. Mix
4. Make into a dough using eggs and milk
5. Keep aside , covered , for 20 minutes
6. Divide the dough into 6 equal parts
7. Shape them into round balls
8. Flatten and roll out each piece to about 5" diameter
9. Cook as parathas
10. Serve hot and crisp

title: kellys lime chiffon cheesecake dessert
steps:
1. Mix crust ingredients , save aside 2 tablespoons
2. Press rest on bottom of 13x9 greased glass dish or pan
3. Dissolve jell-o in boiling water , cool
4. In mixing bowl , beat cream cheese and sugar
5. Beat in vanilla ,
6. Slowly beat in jell-o
7. Beat / fold in cool whip
8. Beat in 3-4 drops green food coloring
9. Spoon over crust , smooth top
10. Sprinkle with reserved crumbs
11. Chill til set , 3 hours or overnight
12. Serve topped with more cool whip and a maraschino cherry

title: avocado with prosciutto
steps:
1. For dressing , in a small screw-top jar , combine olive oil , lemon juice , oregano , garlic , and pepper
2. Cover and shake well
3. Set aside
4. Cut the avocado in half lengthwise
5. Remove the seed
6. Peel avocado halves and cut each into four wedges
7. Wrap one strip of prosciutto around each wedge of avocado
8. Arrange wedges on a serving plate
9. Shake dressing well
10. Drizzle over wedges
11. Make-ahead
12. Prepare dressing as directed
13. Chill for up to 2 days
14. Shake well before using

title: yogurt waffles
steps:
1. Preheat waffle iron and spray lightly with oil
2. In a large bowl , combine dry ingredients
3. In a medium bowl , beat egg whites until peaks form
4. In another medium bowl , beat egg yolks until lemon-colored
5. Add yogurt to egg yolks and mix
6. Add yolk mixture to dry ingredients , along with milk and melted butter
7. Fold egg whites into batter
8. Pour 3 / 4 cup batter onto hot waffle iron , close lid and bake until steam stops and waffle is lightly browned and crisp , 3 to 4 minutes
9. Remove waffle and repeat with remaining batter

title: fettuccine with ham and cream
steps:
1. Cut ham into small chunks
2. Melt butter in a medium frying pan
3. Add shallots& ham and cook until golden
4. Season with salt& pepper , to taste
5. Stir in the cream and keep warm over low heat while the pasta is cooking
6. Boil the pasta in a large pan of boiling water
7. Cook"al dente"
8. Drain pasta& mix with sauce
9. Serve immediately

title: fragrant egg curry
steps:
1. Place onion , ginger and garlic in a food processor and process to form a paste
2. Heat the oil in a heavy-based saucepan , add the paste and cook over low heat for 2-3 minutes
3. Add the spices and cook for 1 minute , stirring to release the flavours
4. Add the tomatoes and 500ml water and bring to the boil
5. Reduce heat to medium and simmer for 15 minutes
6. Meanwhile , shell and halve the eggs and add to the pan with the lentils and peas - if mixture is too thick add an extra 125ml
7. Cook over low heat for 15 minutes or until lentils are soft
8. Stir in the coriander and serve with cooked rice

title: agua de meln
steps:
1. In a blender or food processor , combine water , cantaloupe , sugar , and lime juice until smooth
2. Pour mixture through a strainer into a pitcher , forcing through most of the pulp
3. Chill at least 30 minutes before serving
4. Serve with or without ice cubes
5. As a decorative touch , add slices or chunks of melon

title: scrambled egg sandwiches  with onions and red peppers
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large skillet
2. Add onion and saute over medium heat until slightly softened , about 2 minutes
3. Add pepper strips and cook stirring occasionally until tender about 8-10 minutes
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste
5. Add egg beaters to skillet and cook stiring often , until set about 2 minutes
6. Divide the egg mixture between two slices of toast , now top with slice of cheese and remaining toast
7. Cut each sandwich in half and serve

title: pressure cooker corned beef
steps:
1. Rinse and dry brisket with paper towels
2. Brown brisket in pressure cooker fat side down
3. Add onion , garlic , celery , water and spices
4. Set cooker to 75 minutes on high pressure and secure lid
5. Let cool down on it's own
6. While meat is cooling down in the pressure cooker steam cabbage wedges , red new potatoes and chunked carrots until fork tender
7. Use the veggies you like
8. Some add parsnips but we are purists
9. Place meat on a large platter surrounded by veggies
10. Serve with mustard and soft butter for the veggies

title: apple pie oatmeal
steps:
1. Stovetop directions:
2. Bring water to a boil in medium saucepan
3. Stir in oats and salt
4. Cook , stirring occasionally , over medium heat for 5 minutes
5. Top oatmeal with splenda , chopped apple and spice
6. Microwave directions:
7. Combine water , oats , and salt in a microwave-safe container
8. Cover tightly with heavy duty plastic wrap , leaving a small edge uncovered for steam to escape
9. Microwave on high for 2 1 / 2 to 3 minutes , stir well
10. Top oatmeal with splenda , chopped apple and spice

title: orange oregano dressing
steps: 1. Combine ingredients and shake / whisk until combined

title: hash browns casserole
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the soup , sour cream and garlic salt
2. Add potatoes and cheddar cheese
3. Mix well
4. Pour into a greased 13-in
5. X 9-in
6. X 2-in
7. Baking dish
8. Top with parmesan cheese
9. Bake , uncovered , at 350 for 55-60 minutes or until potatoes are tender
10. Yield: 12-16 servings

title: puffy bacon bites
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 375 degrees
2. Mix all ingredients except biscuits
3. Spray mini-muffin pan with cooking spray
4. Separate each biscuit into 3 layers
5. Press each layer into a muffin well
6. Fill with a small spoonful of mixture
7. Bake for 10-12 minutes until puffy and golden

title: beef tortellini soup
steps:
1. Brown beef well in a deep dutch oven or stock pot
2. Add leek , celery , and onion and saute on low until veges are soft
3. Add broth and all other ingredients
4. Simmer on low for 2-3 hours or until beef is tender
5. Add tortellini
6. Simmer for 5 minutes , then turn off heat and let stand , covered , for at least 30-45 minutes
7. Tortellini will cook in the hot broth
8. Serve with crusty bread

title: amish  oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. To grease cookie sheets: grease cookie sheets lightly
2. Too much shortening on the baking sheet will cause cookies to spread and edges will be too thin and too brown
3. Do not use butter or margarine to grease sheets
4. Grind raisins and peanuts in food grinder , using medium blade
5. Set aside
6. Sift together 6 cups flour , baking powder , salt , cinnamon and nutmeg into very large bowl or dishpan
7. Cut in lard until mixture forms fine crumbs , using pastry blender
8. Add ground raisin mixture , sugar and oats
9. Mix well
10. , using hands if necessary
11. Dissolve baking soda in buttermilk in small bowl
12. Add molasses and 3 of the eggs to buttermilk mixture
13. Beat with rotary beater until blended
14. Add buttermilk mixture to flour mixture
15. Mix well with spoon
16. Drop mixture by heaping teaspoonfuls or a small ice cream scoop , about 3 inches apart , on greased baking sheets
17. Flatten each with bottom of drinking glass dipped in flour to 2 inch round
18. Beat remaining egg in small bowl until blended
19. Brush tops of each round with egg
20. Bake in 375f oven 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown
21. Remove from baking sheets
22. Cool on racks
23. Makes 4 dozen
24. Farm journals complete home baking book

title: thai fish curry
steps:
1. Heat oil in large skillet or wok
2. Add curry paste , garlic , lime leaves , and galanga
3. Stir-fry for 1 minute or until mixture becomes very fragrant
4. Add onions , chiles , and peppers and stir-fry until onions are slightly tender
5. Add vegetable broth , sake wine , shrimp sauce , coconut milk , lemongrass and bring to a boil
6. Add the fish cubes and tomato quarters , then cover , and simmer for 6-8 minutes or until fish is firm and cooked
7. Stir together cornstarch into water to make a slurry and add to wok
8. Stir until curry is thickened
9. Remove kaffir leaves before serving if desired
10. Add the juice of the lime and stir in , then sprinkle with chopped fresh cilantro just before serving
11. Serve with steamed jasmine rice , if desired

title: tasty chicken fingers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Spray a large baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray
3. Cut each piece of chicken into 6 strips
4. Combine bread crumbs , parmesan , oregano , salt and pepper in a shallow bowl
5. Mix well
6. Dip each piece of chicken into egg , allowing excess to drip back into bowl
7. Coat chicken pieces with crumb mixture
8. Place chicken on prepared baking sheet
9. Bake chicken , turning halfway through baking , until golden , about 15 minutes
10. Serve immediately with prepared dressing

title: quick   easy taco burger casserole
steps:
1. Cook macaroni noodles according to package directions for al dente , drain and rinse with cold water
2. Set aside
3. In a large skillet , brown ground beef with onion , drain
4. Return meat mixture to skillet , stir dry taco seasoning mix into meat mixture along with water
5. Cook over medium heat , stirring occassionally , for 10 minutes
6. Add the corn , tomato soup , cheddar cheese and cooked macaroni noodles to the meat mixture and stir until well blended
7. Turn mixture into a greased , large oblong casserole dish
8. Cover , and bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes
9. Remove cover and bake an additional 15 minutes or until bubbly
10. You may add extra grated cheese to top the casserole , if you wish , during the last 15 minutes of baking time

title: columbus sweet sour salad dressing
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients till sugar is dissolved
2. Chill

title: red hot applesauce salad
steps:
1. Dissolve red hots in boiling water
2. Add jello and applesauce , stirring well
3. Serve on a lettuce leaf
4. Goes especially good with pork

title: raisin bread with spiced apple slices
steps:
1. Lightly toast bread
2. Spread each slice with butter
3. Arrange apple slices on top
4. Mix sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle on top of apple slices
5. Grill / broil under medium-low heat for 3 minutes until lightly caramelised

title: oven baked carrot burgers
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375f
2. Grate carrots and onion
3. Drain and squeeze out as much liquid as possible
4. Add oats , eggs , oil and spices
5. Mix well
6. Put a parchment paper on a baking sheet and brush with a little oil
7. Form 4-5 burgers with your hands and put on baking sheet
8. Bake , in the middle of the oven , for about 15 minutes
9. Turn the burgers and bake another 15 minutes
10. They freeze well

title: black bean mango salsa
steps:
1. Combine all of the above ingredients and chill in fridge for 1 hour
2. Best if served the same day

title: pasta for dessert  you re kidding  nope
steps:
1. Cook the pasta according to instructions in unsalted water until tender and then drain and dash in cold water , drain in a large bowl combine sour cream , cottage cheese& eggs , mix well
2. Add pasta , raisins , sugar , nuts , vanilla nutmeg& cinnamon
3. Put the mixture in a 1 1 / 2 quart casserole dish , even out the top
4. Bake in 350f oven until golden brown , cool for 10 minutes , serve warm

title: healthy cranberry walnut muffins
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350
2. Mix the first six ingredients in a large mixing bowl
3. Then mix the last six ingredients in a separate , smaller mixing bowl
4. Add the wet ingredients to the dry and stir just until it's all moistened
5. Grease muffin pans or insert liners
6. Place a large spoonful of the mix in each muffin cup -- these don't rise very much , so i usually fill them about 3 / 4 to almost completely full
7. Bake at 350 for about 35 minutes

title: grand peres  quebec style maple syrup dumplings
steps:
1. Bring syrup and water to a boil in a 6 qt dutch oven over medium-high heat
2. While the syrup / water is rising to a boil , whisk flour , baking powder , and salt in a bowl
3. Set aside
4. Grate butter on large holes of a box grater into flour and toss to coat
5. Add milk and stir with a fork until dough forms
6. When syrup mixture reaches a boil , use a spoon to drop large clumps of dough into syrup
7. Cover pot and simmer until dumplings are cooked through
8. Spoon dumplings and sauce into 6 bowls and serve

title: light macaroni and cheese with spinach
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f
2. Spray 8" square baking dish with nonstick cooking spray
3. In small bowl , whisk 1 / 4 cup of the milk and flour until smooth
4. In heavy medium saucepan , heat remaining 1 1 / 2 cups milk over medium heat until steaming
5. Add flour mixture
6. Cook 2-3 minutes or until sauce boils and thickens , whisking constantly
7. Remove from heat
8. Stir in cheddar cheese until melted
9. Stir in cottage cheese , salt , pepper and nutmeg
10. Cook spinach according to package directions
11. Drain
12. Rinse under cold running water
13. Squeeze out excess moisture
14. Cook macaroni in large pot of boiling lightly salted water 4-5 minutes or until not quite tender , stirring often
15. Drain
16. Rinse with cold water
17. Drain again
18. In large bowl , stir together cheese sauce and macaroni
19. Spread half of the macaroni mixture in baking dish
20. Spoon spinach over top
21. Spread remaining macaroni mixture over spinach layer
22. Sprinkle with wheat germ
23. Bake 35-45 minutes or until bubbly and golden
24. Variation: to make southwestern macaroni and cheese with peppers , substitute 1 cup grated pepper jack cheese for 1 cup of the cheddar cheese
25. Omit the nutmeg
26. Add 1 can chopped mild green chiles , 1 / 3 cup chopped fresh cilantro and dash cayenne pepper to cheese sauce
27. Omit spinach
28. Instead , cook 2 cups thawed frozen pepper stir-fry vegetables in 1 teaspoon olive oil 3 to 4 minutes or until tender
29. Replace spinach with pepper mixture

title: asian lettuce cups with turkey and green apple
steps:
1. Fry noodles in a wok or saucepan
2. Fill with about 2" of oil
3. While oil is heating to 375f , use your hands to separate the strands of the mung bean noodle into small clumps
4. When oil hot , fry one batch at a time
5. Should only take 10 seconds to fry
6. Remove , let drain paper towels
7. Dice all your vegetables and apple into very small pieces - try to get everything around the same size
8. Heat a wok or large skillet to high heat and add cooking oil
9. Add ground turkey and fry until 80% done
10. With spatula , make room in the center of pan to fry the aromatics
11. Just push the meat out of the way
12. Add a touch more cooking oil if needed
13. Fry garlic , ginger , scallions until fragrant , about 10 seconds
14. Add red bell , yellow bell
15. Cook just a minute until vegetables are slightly softened
16. Add sauce ingredients
17. Mix well and heat through
18. Taste
19. Need more salt ? sugar ? heat ? zing ?
20. Don't over spice - you still want the flavor of the vegetables to come through
21. Don't over cook - the vegetables should still have texture and some crunch
22. Add apples
23. Toss to coat
24. Immediately remove
25. You don't want to "cook" the apples - keep them nice and crunchy
26. Serve with more rooster sauce , lettuce cups , fried noodles and shaved carrots

title: pork loin with maple mustard glaze
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a small bowl combine garlic , maple syrup , mustard , oil , salt and pepper
3. Coat pork loin with the mixture
4. Place pork in a roasting pan and pour any extra syrup on top
5. Bake for 20-25 minutes per pound or until temperature reaches 150f and juices run clear
6. Remove from oven and tent with foil
7. Allow to rest for 10 minutes during which time the temperature will rise to 160f and the juices will distribute evenly
8. Carve and enjoy

title: tofu tikka masala
steps:
1. Drain tofu for approximately half an hour
2. Meanwhile , mix 1 / 4 cup soy yogurt with 2 cloves crushed garlic and 1 teaspoon grated ginger
3. Cut tofu into cubes and marinate in yogurt mixture for at least 2 hours in refrigerator
4. In a medium pot , mix remaining ginger and garlic , tomato products , and seasonings
5. Simmer over low heat until thick
6. While the sauce simmers , sautee tofu in a dry , non-stick skillet until golden brown
7. Stir tofu cubes into sauce
8. If a creamier sauce is desired , add soy yogurt until desired consistency is achieved
9. Heat just until warm
10. Serve over rice with a pot of soy chai

title: slow cooked beef in onion sauce  crock pot
steps:
1. Trim off any excess fat from the meat
2. Mix salt , pepper , paprika and oregano
3. Rub this mixture into the meat , on all surfaces
4. Put onions , garlic , tomato paste and about one-half of the liquid into the crock pot , or slow cooker and mix well
5. Add the remaining liquid and stir
6. Nestle the meat down into the liquid , cover and cook on the low setting 8-9 hours , or until the meat is tender
7. Taste for seasoning and make any adjustments
8. Serve with noodles , rice , or potatoes

title: pumpkin pie  amish recipe  delicious
steps:
1. Mix sugars& flour
2. In a separate bowl , mix pumpkin , yolks & molasses together
3. Add scalded milk to pumpkin mixture
4. Add spices and 1 t
5. Browned butter to pumpkin mixture
6. Add dry ingredients to pumpkin mixture
7. Fold in egg whites
8. Mix well& pour into pie shells
9. Bake at 400 for 10 minutes , then lower temperature to 350& cook until finished , approximately 40-45 minutes

title: chicken crunch casserole
steps:
1. Saute onions and celery in butter until tender
2. Mix all ingredients together , reserving a few nuts and noodles for the top
3. Bake in 9" x 13" pan in 350 degree oven for 40 minutes

title: teriyaki chicken kabobs
steps:
1. Combine all marinade ingredients in large resealable plastic food bag
2. Reserve 2 tablespoons marinade
3. Set aside
4. Add chicken pieces
5. Tightly seal bag
6. Turn bag several times to coat chicken well
7. Place in 13x9-inch pan
8. Refrigerate , turning occasionally , at least 3 hours or overnight
9. Heat 1 side of gas grill on medium or charcoal grill until coals are ash white
10. Remove chicken from marinade with slotted spoon
11. Discard marinade
12. To assemble kabobs , alternately thread chicken , pineapple , tomatoes , green pepper and zucchini onto skewers
13. Place kabobs onto grill
14. Grill , turning and brushing occasionally with reserved marinade , until chicken reaches at least 170f or until juices run clear when pierced with fork

title: fruit chutney
steps:
1. Add all ingredients to heavy bottomed saucepan and heat over low , stirring constantly , until the sugar has dissolved
2. Turn the heat to low
3. Simmer 20 minutes or until the fruit is cooked and thick
4. Check periodically to see if more liquid is needed
5. If time allows , use proper methods to can the chutney and let sit for 6-8 weeks
6. Otherwise , cool and dig in !

title: healthy oatmeal surprises
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Cream together butter and white and brown sugars until light and fluffy in a large bowl
3. Add egg whites and egg one at a time , beating well with each addition
4. Stir in vanilla
5. In a separate bowl , combine flour , baking soda , cinnamon , nutmeg , and salt
6. Gradually stir into the creamed mixture
7. Stir in quick oats , chocolate chips and raisins
8. Optional if using raisins: bring 1 cup of water to a boil
9. Add 1 / 2 cup raisins , remove from heat , and soak for 10 minutes
10. Drain and cool before adding them to batter
11. Drop batter by heaping spoonfuls onto an ungreased cookie sheet
12. Bake 8-10 minutes
13. Cool 5 minutes on cookie sheet before transferring to wire rack to cool completely

title: irish cream brownie dessert
steps:
1. Grease the bottom of an 8-inch square baking pan
2. In a mixing bowl , add the brownie mix , oil , 2 tablespoons bailey's irish cream and eggs
3. Stir until blended
4. Spread batter into prepared pan
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 23-26 minutes or until wooden pick comes out clean
6. Cool completely
7. In another mixing bowl , add the whipping cream , milk , pudding mix and 3 tablespoons bailey's irish cream
8. With an electric mixer , beat at high speed for 4-6 minutes or until soft peaks form
9. Spread mixture over the cooled brownie layer
10. Sprinkle with crushed candy bar
11. Cover and refrigerate 3-4 hours before serving

title: caffeine jolt chicken
steps:
1. In a saucepan combine
2. Coffee , ketchup , sugar , worcestershire sauce , vinegar& lemon
3. Bring to boil and simmer 5 minutes
4. Arrange chicken legs , single layer in a shallow oven proof dish
5. Pour sauce over
6. Cover and marinate in fridge for 1-8 hours
7. Bring to room temp and bake in 375f degrees oven for 45 minutes- 1 hour depending on the size of the legs
8. Baste often with sauce
9. When chicken juices run clear pierced with a fork the chicken is done
10. Bon appetite

title: berry blast energy smoothie
steps:
1. Toss everything into blender
2. Blend until smooth and enjoy
3. If it's too thick add more milk until you reach a desired consistency

title: gluten free bananas foster pancakes
steps:
1. For the pancakes: combine the banana , flour , 2 teaspoons of the oil , the baking powder , vanilla , cinnamon , salt and egg in a medium bowl and mix until smooth
2. Heat the remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon oil in a large nonstick skillet set over medium heat
3. Pour out the batter , 1 / 4 cup at a time , onto the pan , making 4 pancakes
4. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes per side
5. The pancakes are ready to be flipped when numerous bubbles appear on the surface
6. Place two pancakes on two plates
7. For the topping: combine the butter , rum and brown sugar in a medium skillet set over high heat
8. Stir constantly until the butter melts and the sugar dissolves , about 1 minute
9. Add the bananas and cook for 1 minute , stirring constantly
10. Remove from the heat , sprinkle in the vanilla and cinnamon , and baste if the cinnamon clumps
11. Top the pancakes with the cooked bananas and sauce , and serve

title: chicken and mushrooms
steps:
1. Mix the cornstarch , egg white and 1 / 2 teaspoon of the salt
2. Put the slices of chicken into this mixture
3. Heat half the oil in a non-stick wok
4. Stir fry the chicken until lightly coloured
5. Remove meat with a perforated spoon
6. Heat the remaining oil in the wok until smoking
7. Toss in the spring onions
8. Then add the mushrooms , water chestnuts and peas
9. Add the remaining salt and stir for approximately 5 minutes
10. Add the chicken slices , soy sauce and sugar
11. Cook together for 1 minute
12. Serve

title: super moist chocolate mayo cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Blend all ingredients
3. Bake as directed on cake mix box

title: papas and chorizo frittata
steps:
1. Thoroughly mash the tater-tots in a zip-loc bag
2. Heat the olive oil in a 10-inch oven safe skillet over medium heat
3. Add the onion and chorizo and saut for 5 to 6 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Add the mashed tater-tots , garlic and red pepper and cook until potatoes are heated through
5. Pour the egg mixture into the pan
6. Gently mix the chorizo / potato mixture with the eggs as they begin to set
7. Reduce the heat to medium-low , cover and cook the frittata until the eggs are almost completely set through
8. Use a spatula to ensure the egg mixture is not sticking to the skillet before placing the pan in the broiler
9. Broil on medium for 2 minutes
10. Remove the pan from the heat
11. Invert the frittata onto a platter or large plate and spread the shredded cheese over the top
12. Lightly cover the frittata with aluminum foil and let it rest for a couple of minutes
13. Remove foil and garnish with sliced avocado , salsa , sliced scallions and the sprigs of cilantro then serve

title: salmon burgers with lemon sour cream sauce
steps:
1. To prepare the lemon-sour cream sauce: in a medium bowl , combine sour cream , lemon zest , lemon juice , and sugar
2. Mix until well blended
3. In a large bowl , combine salmon , egg , bread crumbs , onion , salt , and pepper
4. Shape into six equal-sized patties
5. In a large frying pan over medium heat , melt butter
6. Add salmon patties and brown on both sides
7. Remove from heat , transfer onto a serving platter , and serve with lemon-sour cream sauce and lemon wedges

title: ww spicy molasses baked beans   2 pts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Coat a small nonstick skillet with cooking spray , and place over medium-high heat until hot
3. Add onion and jalapeno pepper
4. Saute 2 minutes or until tender
5. Combine onion mixture , beans , and remaining ingredients in a large bowl
6. Stir well
7. Spoon bean mixture into a 2-quart casserole coated with cooking spray
8. Bake , uncovered , at 350 for 1 hour or until thick and bubbly

title: cranberry loaf with a hiccup recipe
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f
2. Sift together the flour , baking powder , and salt
3. In a separate bowl using an electric mixer , cream the butter and sugar
4. Beat in the eggs one at a time
5. Mix in the beer
6. Blend the marmalade / apricot jam with a spatula or wooden spoon
7. Add the flour mixture and blend together
8. Add the cranberries last
9. Butter and flour a 9 inch loaf pan
10. Pour the mixture in and bake for approximately 1 hour , or until a cake tester comes out clean
11. Cool the loaf for about 10 minutes , then turn onto a rack to cool completely

title: cheesecake cupcakes  1
steps:
1. Add eggs to softened cream cheese , one at a time
2. Blend thoroughly
3. Add 1 c sugar and 1 tsp vanilla and mix together well
4. Place in paper cups in cupcake tin and bake at 300 degrees for 40 minutes
5. Let cool
6. Mix sour cream with 1 / 4 c sugar and 1 / 2 tsp vanilla
7. Place mixture in cupcakes and return to 300 degree oven for 5 minutes
8. Let cool
9. Place pie filling on top before serving

title: turkey stroganoff
steps:
1. Brown the turkey in heated olive oil
2. Add in the bouillon cubes
3. Stir well
4. Remove from heat and set aside
5. In another skillet , saute onion and mushrooms in melted margarine
6. Add in the garlic
7. Stir / saute until golden
8. Combine the vegetable mixture with the turkey mixture
9. Add in the sour cream--stir to combine
10. Heat throughly but do no boil
11. To serve--arrange warm noodles on individual plates
12. Spoon stroganoff over noodles

title: brown sugar and mustard glazed corned beef
steps:
1. Rinse off the brisket under running water
2. Trim off excess fat
3. Place in large stock pot and cover with water
4. At this point you may use the seasoning packet that came with the corned beef
5. Bring to a boil
6. Lower the heat to simmer
7. Cook about 3 hours until very tender
8. Add more water if needed to keep covered
9. Crock pot directions: if desired , cook corned beef in crock pot until tender
10. Continue on past this point
11. Preheat oven to 325
12. In a sauce pan , combine the brown sugar and 1 / 2 cup water
13. Bring to a simmer over medium-high heat
14. After about 5 minutes , stir in mustard
15. Continue simmering another 2-3 minutes
16. Place the brisket on a rack in a roaster
17. Thinly coat meat with glaze
18. Put in oven and bake for 30 minutes , reglazing every 10 minutes
19. Remove from oven and let rest at least 15 minutes
20. Slice thin to serve

title: gluten free strawberry pear cobbler
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f in a medium bowl mix the sugar , cornstarch and nutmeg
2. Add berries and pears , and mix thoroughly until fruit is coated with the dry ingredients
3. Pour fruit mixture into greased 8x8" baking dish
4. In a large bowl , mix baking mix and salt
5. Cut shortening or butter into the baking mix , using your hands to mix until no large lumps appear
6. Add milk or milk substitute , and mix thoroughly with a wooden spoon
7. Spoon batter over the top of the fruit , spreading over the whole dish
8. It will be thick , so use your hands to distribute it evenly
9. Leave a few small uncovered areas so that some of the liquid from the fruit can evaporate during the baking process
10. Shake a bit of cinnamon evenly over the top of the dough
