11. Bake for 30 minutes or until knife inserted in biscuit topping comes out clean and the top has browned
12. Serve warm

title: salsa guacamole
steps:
1. In a bowl , mash avocados with lemon juice
2. Stir in the salsa , onions , salt and garlic powder
3. Serve immediately with tortilla chips

title: white chocolate macadamia nut muffins
steps:
1. Combine baking mix and sugar in a large bowl
2. Stir in chocolate and nuts
3. Make a well in center of mixture
4. Combine half-and-half and remaining 3 ingredients
5. Add to dry ingredients , stirring just until dry ingredients are moistened
6. Spoon into greased muffin pans , filling two-thirds full
7. Bake at 400 for 11 to 12 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted into center comes out clean
8. Remove from pans immediately

title: easy microwave popcorn
steps:
1. Place popcorn in a lunch sized brown paper bag
2. Fold the open end once and staple with one staple
3. Microwave until the popcorn slows down popping
4. My microwave takes 1:50
5. Open carefully and pour into a bowl
6. Top with your favorite toppings
7. I use spray margarine and garlic salt

title: extra crispy fried chicken
steps:
1. Combine the pancake mix with one package of the italian salad dressing mix
2. Combine the other package with the egg and club soda or beer
3. Dip each piece of chicken in the egg mixture , then in the pancake mix mixture
4. Place pieces on a wire cooling rack without allowing to touch each other
5. Let dry for 5 minutes
6. Spray baking pan with non stick spray and place chicken on without allowing pieces to touch each other
7. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes or until done
8. Or:
9. Deep fry at 425 for about 7 minutes

title: black eyed peas with sausage
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a dutch oven until hot
2. Add the onion , celery , garlic , and bell pepper and cook until vegetables are tender , about 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
3. Add the remaining ingredients and bring to a boil
4. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer for 40--45 minutes

title: sugar plum bread with homemade butter
steps:
1. In a large bowl , dissolve 1 tsp sugar in warm water
2. Sprinkle in yeast and let stand 10 minutes then stir well
3. Add 1 / 2 cup sugar , butter , salt and 2 cups flour
4. Beat for 2 minutes
5. Add 2 more cups flour and eggs
6. Beat 3 minutes
7. Stir in remaining flour
8. You should have a soft dough
9. Knead for 8 minutes
10. Place in a lightly greased bowl
11. Cover with greased paper and a towel
12. Let rise for 2 hours in a warm oven
13. Punch down
14. Knead in fruit and nuts
15. Shape into 2 balls
16. Place in greased 8 cake pans
17. Cover with a towel and let rise for 1-1 / 2 hours
18. Bake for 45 - 50 minutes at 350
19. Remove from pans at once
20. Drizzle with glaze
21. Glaze: mix sugar and water together
22. If too stiff , add more water by drops
23. Butter: in a glass jar , shake the whipping cream until butter forms
24. Drain and chill until ready to use

title: glitter grapes
steps:
1. Spread about 1 / 4 of the the gelatin mix on a pie plate or plate of your choice
2. Rinse the grapes under water , and place a handful on the plate
3. Shake the plate gently to roll the grapes in the gelatin , coating the grapes
4. Place coated grapes into a bowl
5. Repeat with the remaining ingredients until all of the grapes are covered
6. Place the bowl and let set in the refrigerator for at least an 1 hour , until the gelatin is set
7. The colder they are the better

title: black bean salsa  aruba
steps: 1. Mix all ingredients and enjoy

title: easy beef stroganoff   ground beef version
steps:
1. In a large , deep skillet , add onions and beef and brown until no longer pink
2. Drain off fat
3. Stir in remaining ingredients , except sour cream , reduce heat , cover and simmer 20-25 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Remove from heat when mixture thickens to desired consistency and let sit for a few minutes
5. Then add sour cream and mix well until blended
6. Serve immediately over hot noodles
7. Edit: if you prefer your stroganoff mixture a little thinner , increase the milk from 1 / 2 cup to 3 / 4 cup

title: wet chocolate cake   cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix together dry ingredients
3. Mix in all wet ingredients and blend on medium speed until smooth
4. Pour into ungreased 13x9 pan or 2 9x9 pans or cupcake tins
5. Bake for approximately 35 to 40 minutes for 13x9 pan
6. 20 to 25 minutes for 9x9 pans
7. 25 to 30 minutes for cupcakes
8. Sometimes with the 13x9 pan , i take it out when it's still a little squishy in the middle
9. It will finish baking while it cools
10. This cake is very moist , so don't over bake it !
11. Frosting options from zaar:
12. Recipe #33520
13. Recipe #103762
14. You can just make the peanut butter frosting recipe with no peanut butter and it will just be a plain butter cream frosting if you wish

title: cream of garden tomato soup   pressure cooker   west
steps:
1. Heat the oil and butter in the pressure cooker over medium high heat until the butter melts
2. Add the onion and cook , stirring occasionally , until wilted , about 5 minutes
3. Add the tomatoes and their juices , thyme , salt , pepper , and broth and stir to mix
4. Lock on the lid and bring to pressure over high heat , about 4 minutes
5. Reduce heat to medium and cook for 15 minutes
6. Remove from the heat and let sit for 10 minutes to finish cooking
7. With the steam vent pointed away from your face , gently release any remaining pressure
8. Let cool enough to remove lid
9. Use immersion blender to puree soup
10. If after blending you see any chunks of tomato peel , put soup through strainer or food mill to remove
11. If using right away , place soup in large pan and stir in cream
12. Reheat gently without boiling then add garnish of choice and serve
13. If not using right away , store in the refigerator until ready to use
14. Then stir in the cream , heat and serve

title: roasted garlic potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Place the cubed potatoes in a medium bowl and add the rest of the ingredients and stir together
3. Lay evenly onto a cookie sheet or lasagna pan and bake in the oven for 30-40 minutes , until potatoes are golden brown and can be easily pierced with a fork

title: creamy   easy broccoli slaw
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients thoroughly
2. Cover bowl and refrigerate several hours or overnight before serving

title: olive garden pasta e fagioli soup in a crock pot  copycat
steps:
1. Brown beef in a skillet
2. Drain fat from beef and add to crock pot with everything except pasta
3. Cook on low 7-8 hours or high 4-5 hours
4. During last 30 min on high or 1 hour on low , add pasta

title: grilled buffalo wings with a bite
steps:
1. In a saucepan , combine the brown sugar , hot sauce , butter and vinegar
2. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 6-8 minutes until butter is melted and sauce is heated through
3. Cool
4. In a gallon size resealable bag , combine the sugar , seasonings and 1 cup of the cooled sauce
5. Add chicken wings in batches
6. Seal and toss to coat evenly
7. Grill wings , uncovered , over indirect medium heat for 12-15 minutes or until juices run clear , turning once and basting occasionally with remaining sauce
8. Total cooking time will vary depending on how many wings you can fit on your grill at one time

title: layered picnic pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions , drain
2. Return to cooking pan and toss with 2 tablespoons vinaigrette dressing
3. Transfer half of pasta to a clear glass bowl
4. Layer peas , tomatoes , mushrooms , and proscuitto on pasta
5. Top with remaining pasta
6. Sprinkle with basil and pour remaining dressing evenly over salad
7. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese
8. Serve at once or cover and chill until ready to serve
9. Toss right before serving to evenly coat dressing

title: meaty moussaka
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350
2. In a large skillet , heat 2 tablespoons butter over medium-high heat
3. Add the onion and cook until softened , 3 to 5 minutes
4. Add the beef and cook until no longer pink , about 5 minutes
5. Stir in the cinnamon and nutmeg and season with salt and pepper
6. Add the tomato sauce and cook until most of the liquid has evaporated , 3 to 5 minutes
7. Pour into an 8-inch square baking dish and set aside
8. In a medium bowl , lightly beat the eggs and set aside
9. In a small saucepan , melt the remaining 2 tablespoons butter over medium-high heat
10. Whisk in the flour and cook , whisking often , until the mixture is smooth , about 30 seconds
11. Slowly whisk in the milk until thickened
12. Lower the heat to medium and stir in the cream cheese and ricotta
13. Season with salt and pepper
14. Whisk one-quarter of the cheese sauce into the reserved eggs until smooth
15. Whisk the egg mixture into the cheese sauce in the saucepan
16. Pour the sauce over the meat in the baking dish and spread evenly
17. Bake until the top is lightly browned and firm to the touch , 40 to 45 minutes
18. Let cool for 10 minutes
19. Cut into squares to serve

title: home style chicken and ham soup
steps:
1. In large saucepan cook bacon until crisp
2. Remove and crumble
3. Brown ham and cook onion with thyme in drippings until tender
4. Add remaining ingredients except bacon
5. Heat
6. Stir occasionally
7. Garnish with bacon

title: eggnog caramels
steps:
1. Line an 8x8-inch baking pan with a double-thickness of foil
2. Coat well with cooking spray
3. Place all ingredients in a heavy , deep-sided saucepan
4. Attach a candy thermometer to the side of the saucepan
5. Bring mixture to a boil over high heat , stirring constantly
6. Lower heat to medium and continue cooking , stirring constantly , until mixture reaches 245 degrees f
7. Immediately pour caramel mixture into prepared pan
8. Cool and refrigerate for 3 hours or more , until completely firm
9. Using foil , lift caramel slab from prepared pan
10. Pull the foil down from the sides of the caramel
11. Using a long knife , trim the edges off the caramel slab , and then cut the block of caramel into 8 rows
12. Cut each row into 8 squares

title: instant potato sourdough starter
steps:
1. Combine 1st 4 ingredients and store in covered glass container for 5 days at room temperature
2. Stir daily using wooden spoon take out 1 cup starter for bread and store remaining in refrigerator
3. Feed starter every 3 days
4. Makes 1 cup starter every 3 days

title: good morning fruit smoothie
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a blender
2. Add 1 - 2 cups ice cubes
3. Blend till smooth !

title: tuna sweet and sour
steps:
1. Saut peppers and pineapple in butter
2. Add 1 / 4 cup pineapple juice
3. Cover and simmer about 5 minutes
4. Combine remaining 1 / 2 cup pineapple juice with cornstarch
5. Add soy sauce , vinegar , sugar and broth
6. Add to pepper mixture and cook , stirring constantly , until thickened
7. Add tuna and season to taste with salt and pepper
8. Heat until hot
9. Serve with cooked rice

title: raspberry chocolate chip bundt cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Measure out 1 cup of the raspberries
3. Thaw in sieve , reserving juice
4. Set aside the cup of berries
5. Thaw remaining berries
6. Puree in food processor , adding reserved juice
7. Press through sieve to remove seeds
8. Add icing sugar
9. In bowl , cream butter with granulated sugar until fluffy
10. Beat in eggs , one at a time , and vanilla
11. Stir together flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
12. Add half to the butter mixture
13. Stir in sour cream
14. Stir in remaining flour mixture and 1 cup of chocolate chips
15. Spread half into a greased 10 inch bundt pan
16. Sprinkle with reserved drained berries
17. Spread remaining batter on top
18. Bake for 40 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched
19. Let cool for 10 minutes
20. Invert on rack to cool completely
21. Transfer to plate
22. Slip strips of waxed paper under cake
23. Melt remaining chocolate chips with cream
24. Pour over cake , drizzling down sides
25. Remove wax paper
26. Serve with raspberry sauce

title: hot water cornbread
steps:
1. Mix together the cornmeal , flour , salt and sugar
2. Stir in the egg
3. Slowly add enough boiling water until you have a thick batter that you can form into patties
4. Form into patties and fry in hot oil in a heavy skillet until golden brown on both sides
5. Serve immediately

title: grilled italian chuck roast with vegetables
steps:
1. Pierce beef several times and put into ziplock bag
2. Dump in the italian dressing and first sliced onion into bag
3. Refrigerate for at least 6 hours
4. Prepare the grill for medium heat
5. Drain marinade from beef and put roast onto grill rack
6. Discard marinade and first onion
7. Grill roast at medium on grate , hood down , until beef is well seared , about 20 minutes , turning over at least once
8. Meanwhile prepare a large aluminum roasting pan lined with foil large enough that later you can cover the meat)
9. Place the seared meat into that foil container , sprinkle with the salt and pepper
10. Pierce the potatoes
11. Arrange potatoes , second onion , and carrots around meat
12. In a small bowl , mix beef broth , garlic , pepper , and rosemary)
13. Pour this over the meat and vegetables
14. Cover all with foil
15. Grill covered at medium heat until roast is tender , possibly up to 1 1 / 2 hours
16. Recently , made a 2 1 / 4 pound roast and it only took 1 hour and 15 minutes after the initial searing
17. Use your meat thermometer to gauge doneness level i would start checking after 1 hour and 15 minutes
18. Allow resting time of 10 minutes

title: fresh ginger infused lemonade
steps:
1. In a small saucepan stir together ginger , sugar , and 1 cup of water , bring to a boil , then set aside and let cool completly
2. Strain the ginger simple syrup into a pitcher and discard ginger , stir in lemon juice and 4 cups of water
3. Chill before serving

title: mocha   jamocha shake
steps:
1. Combine the coffee , milk , and sugar in a blender and mix on medium speed for 15 seconds to dissolve the sugar
2. Add ice cream , and chocolate syrup then blend on high speed until smooth and creamy
3. Stop blender and stir mixture with a spoon if necessary to help blend ingredients
4. Pour drink into two 16 ounce glasses

title: lee lee s famous barbecue sauce for ribs w  preserves
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in small saucepan and heat until butter is melted
2. Recipe can be doubled or tripled

title: budget seasoned steak
steps:
1. Mix ramen seasoning , water
2. Place steaks in skillet or saucepan
3. Baste steaks with ramen / water mixture , pouring excess into bottom of skillet
4. Cover and refrigerate overnight
5. Ideally , flip steaks halfway through marinating period so other side soaks up juice
6. After steaks are marinated , cook at medium-high heat on stovetop to desired thoroughness

title: lower sodium low sugar oriental coleslaw
steps:
1. In a large ziploc bag , combine the cole slaw , onions , almonds , nuts and broken up ramen noodles
2. Close bag and toss well
3. In a covered jar combine the oil , vinegar , sugar and chicken bullion
4. Shake to emulsify
5. Pour over the cole slaw mix close and toss well
6. Let chill at least 2 hours better over night

title: french strawberry crepes
steps:
1. For the filling: toss the strawberries and brown sugar in a bowl and set aside
2. For the crepes:in a medium bowl whisk flour , egg , oil , vanilla , baking powder , cinnamon , and skim milk
3. Heat frying pan over medium heat and spray with cooking spray
4. Pour 1 / 3 a cup of the batter in the pan and make sure it evenly covers the bottom
5. Cook each side for 30-45 seconds on each side and remove to a plate
6. When all crepes are fully cooked , spread one or two spoonfuls of cool whip into the middle , cover with a spoonful of the berry mixture
7. Then wrap one side of the crepe over the mix and the other side over the first
8. Cover with cool whip and more berry mix
9. Repeat and enjoy !

title: apple cinnamon bundt cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 , and prepare the 12 cup bundt pan
2. In a medium bowl , whisk the flour , cinnamon , baking powder , salt , and baking soda together
3. In a large bowl , melt the butter in the microwave , and add brown sugar and eggs , whisking until smooth
4. Gradually whisk in dry ingredients just until combined- don't overmix
5. Fold in the apples and spoon batter into the bundt pan , smoothing the top
6. Bake until a tester inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean
7. Cool in the pan for about 15 minutes , and invert onto a rack placed over wax paper to cool completely
8. Make the glaze by whisking the water together with the confectioners' sugar adding just enough liquid to make the glaze thick but pourable
9. Drizzle glaze over completely cooled cake , and let it firm up before serving

title: paparazzi cream cheese dip
steps:
1. Puree in food processor till spreading consistency
2. Serve with bread sticks , crackers or ciabatta

title: crock pot citrus chicken
steps:
1. In a 1
2. 5 quart crock pot add lemon juice to the bottom
3. Then cut green beans in bite sized pieces and add to crock pot
4. Add chicken thighs on top of lemon juice
5. Pour orange juice on top of chicken
6. Add honey
7. Cover and cook on low 6-7 hours
8. Enjoy

title: pickled jalapeo peppers
steps:
1. Combine all , except jalapeons in a saucepan over high heat
2. Bring all to a boil , stir in jalapeos & remove from heat
3. Let mixture cool for 10 minutes
4. Pack peppers into jars using tongs , cover with liquid mixture , seal and refrigerate until desired use

title: lebanese walnut cookies
steps:
1. Line cookie sheets with parchment paper , and heat oven to 375f
2. Cream butter and sugar in a large bowl
3. Add orange water and sifted flour , and stir until the mixture forms a thick dough
4. Set aside
5. To prepare the filling , combine the nuts , sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl
6. Form 1 inch balls with the dough , and press the center to form a dent for the filling
7. Fill each cookie with about a teaspoon of the filling , and place the cookies on the parchment
8. Bake 15-20 minutes or until golden
9. Cool on wire racks

title: scallion cake
steps:
1. Put flour on a board
2. Make a well in the center and add the water
3. Mix into a soft , smooth dough and divide into 2 portions
4. Roll each portion very thin
5. Brush each with 1 tablespoon of oil
6. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon salt
7. Spread half the scallions evenly on each sheet
8. Roll each portion up like a jelly roll
9. Coil it up so it's lying flat on the board in a spiral
10. Flatten with a rolling pin until it is 7-inches in diameter
11. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a small saute pan
12. Add the cakes , one at a time , and fry 2 minutes on each side
13. Cut each cake into 8 wedges and serve

title: malasadas
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast and 1 teaspoon sugar in warm water
2. Set aside
3. Combine flour , salt , and 1 / 2 cup sugar in a large mixing bowl
4. Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients
5. Combine yeast mixture with eggs , lemon extract , butter , evaporated milk , and water
6. Mix thorourghly and add to well
7. Combine wet and dry ingredients until the dough comes together
8. Knead to form a soft , smooth dough
9. Cover
10. Let rise in a warm place until doubled
11. Punch down
12. Form into balls on a floured surface
13. Cover
14. Set aside to rise again
15. Heat oil to 375 degrees
16. Drop dough carefully into hot oil and fry until both sides are golden brown
17. Drain on paper towels
18. Coat with sugar or cinnamon sugar and serve immediately

title: flax meal waffles
steps:
1. Heat up your waffle iron
2. Mix dry ingredients
3. Blend in wet ingredients
4. Pour about 3 / 4 cup onto iron & cook according to manufacturer's directions
5. I also usually add chocolate chips

title: pink molded salad
steps:
1. Add water to liquid from pineapple to make 2 cups liquid
2. Combine with sugar and bring to a boil
3. Dissolve jell-o and marshmallows in boiling liquid
4. Chill until partially set
5. Stir in pineapple and cottage cheese
6. Fold in cool whip or 1 cup cream whipped
7. Put in mold
8. Chill overnight

title: the easiest broccoli soup in the world
steps:
1. Wash thoroughly the broccoli
2. You will need 600g so remove the stems and just use the heads
3. Chop the onion
4. In a saucepan cook the broccoli and onion together with the stock cube and the water for 15 minutes keep the lid on whilst you do this
5. When the broccoli and onion are very tender add the low fat milk
6. Then blend the soup thoroughly using a blender
7. I sometimes do this immediately but , from a safety point of view , its probably best to let the soup cool then re-heat
8. You will be surprized how creamy this soup is , even using only low fat milk , check seasoning and serve
9. Serve the soup however you like -- we like it with toasted almonds on top , it is also good with grated cheese piled on the top
10. Another good combination is a large teaspoon of cream cheese dropped into the centre and some chives
11. Last time i served it to guests i sprinkled stilton cheese and croutons over the hot soup and it was enjoyed by all
12. However you serve it , for extremely basic ingredients , it makes a tasty affordable soup

title: strawberry rhubarb cream
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , combine the rhubarb , 2 tablespoons sugar and water
2. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly
3. Reduce heat
4. Simmer , uncovered , for 10 minutes or until tender
5. Transfer to a small bowl
6. Cool to room temperature
7. Place strawberries and remaining sugar in a food processor
8. Cover and process until pureed
9. Stir into rhubarb mixture
10. Fold in whipped cream
11. Spoon into two parfait glasses or dessert dishes
12. Cover and refrigerate until chilled
13. Garnish with additional berries if desired
14. Yield: 2 servings
15. Drain in a colander , but do not press liquid out

title: pork chops with lemony bread crumbs
steps:
1. In a large ovenproof frying pan , heat 1 tbsp of the oil over medium-high heat
2. Sprinkle pork with 1 / 2 tsp of the salt and half the pepper and brown the chops about 2 minutes per side in the oil
3. Do not cook the meat through
4. Remove from heat and spoon pasta sauce over chops
5. In a small bowl , combine bread crumbs , sage , lemon peel , garlic , and another 1 / 2 tsp of salt and the remaining pepper
6. Sprinkle this evenly over the sauce and place pan in oven preheated to 350 f and bake for about 10 minutes , or until sauce is bubbling

title: chocolate cinnamon banana cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease and flour 2 9 inch round cake pans
3. Place bananas into mixing bowl
4. Beat with mixer on low speed for about 45 seconds , or until smooth
5. Add remaining ingredients and beat on low speed for about 1 minute , scraping bowl constantly
6. Increase mixer speed to medium , and beat for about 2 minutes more , or until smooth and thick
7. Pour batter into pans , smooth with a spatula and bake for 28-32 minutes , or until they test done
8. Cool in pans for 10 minutes , then remove from pans and cool completely
9. Assemble into layers using your choice of frosting

title: feta couscous salad
steps:
1. Heat broth until boiling and stir in couscous
2. Cover and remove from heat
3. Let it stand for five minutes
4. Transfer to a large bowl and fluff couscous with with and let cool for ten minutes
5. Add feta , cucumber , tomato , pepper , green onion and fresh basil
6. Prepare the dressing
7. Combine vinegar , oil , garlic and sugar
8. Pour dressing over couscous and vegetables and add salt and pepper to taste

title: cranberry glazed baby carrots
steps:
1. Bring a pan of water to boil and add the carrots
2. Cook for 8-10 minutes ,
3. Drain and put aside
4. In a pan over medium-high heat , combine the butter , brown sugar and cranberry sauce , stirring until smooth
5. Simmer 2 minutes , then add the carrots and glaze for 5 minutes
6. Season with salt and pepper , if desired

title: east west veggies
steps:
1. In a large skillet cook and stir onion wedges in hot butter and olive oil over medium heat about 4 mins
2. Or until tender but not brown
3. Stir in green onions , hoisin sauce , and paprika
4. Add corn , beans , celery and red sweet pepper
5. Cook and stir until heated through
6. Transfer to a serving bowl

title: grandma landers s chicken  n  rice
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Pour uncooked rice on the bottom of a 9" x 13" pan
3. Top with onions
4. Season chicken with salt and pepper and lay over the rice
5. Combine soups , broth , and garlic
6. Pour over chicken and bake for 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours , until chicken is tender and rice is cooked

title: thai noodle delight with sweet spicy peanut sauce
steps:
1. Disolve 1 / 8 cup salt and 1 / 4 cup sugar in 1 quart of water in a glass or plastic container
2. Cut your meat into bite-sized pieces , place in the brine , cover and refrigerate for 2 hours
3. Drain meat and allow to dry on paper towels
4. In a large pan , bring plenty of salted water to boiling
5. Add noodles and cook according to directions
6. In a small bowl , whisk together peanut butter , coconut milk , lime juice , soy sauce , brown sugar , sambal oolek , and sweet chile sauce until smooth
7. Warm in heavy bottomed pan on stove , but do not cook ! heat to no more than steaming or the sauce might break
8. In a wok or large , heavy skillet , heat 1 tbls oil on medium-high heat until the oil just starts to smoke
9. Immediately add your meat , stirring constantly , until the meat is almost done
10. Add the garlic and continue cooking about a minute
11. Remove the meat from the pan and allow to drain
12. Add the other 1 tbls oil to the wok and add the veggies in the following order: red onion , carrot , celery , broccoli , snow peas , red bell pepper , scallion
13. If you like , you can add other favorite asian-style vegetables such as water chestnuts or bamboo shoots , but i would avoid mushrooms
14. Stir very frequently , waiting 30 seconds to 2 minutes between additions
15. Just before the veggies are ready to be served , add the meat and stir for just long enough to reheat thoroughly
16. Serve by putting the meat & veggie mix over the noodles and top with a healthy spooning of peanut sauce
17. Serve hot

title: cinnamon mocha coffee
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine coffee grounds , cinnamon and nutmeg
2. Pour into a coffee filter of a drip coffeemaker
3. Add the water
4. Brew according to the manufacturer's directions
5. In a large saucepan , combine the milk , chocolate syrup and brown sugar
6. Cook over low heat until sugar is dissolved , stirring occasionally
7. Stir in the vanilla and brewed coffee
8. Ladle into mugs
9. Garnish with whipped cream if desired

title: copycat ihop pancakes
steps:
1. Mix all in blender
2. Let sit 1 or 2 minute
3. In a preheated non stick skillet pour 1 / 3 cup of batter
4. Cook over med
5. Until surface bubbles
6. Flip and cook until underside is golden brown

title: sweet lemon and spice pork chops or ribs
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Spread chops or full rack of ribs in roasting pan
3. Mix honey mustard , ketchup , lemon and herb spice , and dices garlic
4. Spread mixture over meat
5. Place cut onion over meat and sauce
6. Spinkle black pepper over entire dish
7. Bake for 30-40 minutes , until tender
8. Serve with your choice of vegetables for a little sweeter sauce add granulated sugar to taste

title: homemade icing
steps:
1. Add together and blend well with mixer
2. Place in refrigerator until ready to put on any cake desired

title: mini pizza bites
steps:
1. Set the oven to 375f
2. On a lightly floured surface , with a 1-1 / 2-inch round cookie cutter , cut out 24 rounds from the dough
3. Press each of the rounds into the bottom , and up the sides of ungreased mini muffin cups
4. In a small bowl , combine pizza sauce , parmesan , & oregano
5. Using 3 / 4 cup of shredded mozzarella , pinch an even amount in each muffin cup
6. Next sprinkle pepperoni pieces evenly throughout the cups
7. Then add a small spoonful of the pizza sauce evenly
8. Lastly , top each muffin cup with the remaining 3 / 4 cup of mozzarella
9. Bake for 20-25 minutes , or until puffed and golden brown
10. Cool in pan on wire rack for 10 minutes
11. Loosen quiches from pan with
12. Serve warm
13. To freeze , leave intact in muffin pan and place into freezer until frozen
14. Remove cups and freeze up to 1 month in either a freezer bag or food save them if you have the machine

title: a different banana pound cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Melt the chilled butter over medium heat
3. Sprinkle bananas with the 1 tblsp sugar and add to butter in skillet stir frequently until soft and slightly caramelized
4. Set aside to cool
5. In bowl combine eggs and the remaining sugar and beat until creamy
6. Gradually add flour and baking powder
7. Add melted butter beating to blend
8. Add the caramelized bananas and gently stir with a wooden spoon
9. Scrape into a floured loaf pan
10. Bake in the center of oven for 40 to 50 minutes

title: chocolate addiction  the stress reliever of champions
steps:
1. Slice and press 1 1 / 2 tubes chocolate chip cookie dough into the bottom of a 9x13 pan to form bottom crust
2. Return the remaining half of the cookie dough to the freezer
3. In a small saucepan over low heat , add the chocolate morsels , milk and salt
4. Stir until mixture is smooth and shiny
5. Remove from heat and add the vanilla extract
6. Mix well
7. Pour the chocolate mixture over the chocolate chip cookie dough in the baking pan
8. Slice , then crumble , the remaining 1 / 2 tube of dough evenly over chocolate mixture
9. Place in a 350 degree oven 30-35 minutes until top layer of cookie dough is golden brown
10. Cool completely and slice into bars or squares or use a biscuit cutter to make cookies and save the scraps for yourself
11. Evil grin

title: butternut slaw   tyler florence
steps:
1. Over medium-low heat , in a dry pan , toast walnuts , shaking pan frequently
2. Remove nuts to a plate as soon as they begin to smell nutty
3. Peel squash with a potato peeler or knife
4. Shred finely using a box grater , mandoline or food processor
5. In a bowl , whisk together goat cheese , honey , cider vinegar and lemon juice
6. When smooth , drizzle in olive oil , whisking constantly
7. Season with salt and pepper
8. Toss squash , walnuts , cranberries and parsley in dressing until fully coated
9. Cover tightly and refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving

title: christmas reindeer mix
steps:
1. Mix wheat chex , rice chex , corn chex , cheerios , peanuts , m&m , in a large bowl
2. Spread a large sheet of wax paper over counter top
3. Melt white chocolate squares in microwave
4. Pour melted chocolate over mixture
5. Mix together very fast
6. Spread evenly over wax paper and let dry , then break apart and you have a great choc snack !

title: banana halva
steps:
1. Mash the bananas to a pulp and place in a saucepan with the sugar and water
2. Stir over a low heat until the sugar has dissolved then boil rapidly for 5 minutes
3. Remove pan from heat and gradually stir in the melted ghee
4. Replace pan on the heat and stir constantly until the mixture begins to form a firm ball in the pan
5. Stir in the nuts and cardamom seeds , colour with saffron if desired and turn out on to a flat dish
6. When the mixture is cool , cut into 1 inch squares

title: michelle s lasagna with oven roasted vegetables
steps:
1. Heat the oven to 450f
2. In a large roasting pan , combine bell peppers , eggplant , zucchini , squash , mushrooms , shallots , and rosemary
3. Toss with the oil , 1 tsp salt , tsp pepper
4. Roast , stirring occasionally , until softened and beginning to brown , about 25 minutes
5. Discard the rosemary sprig , if using
6. When the shallots are cool enough to handle , peel and chop them
7. Combine the chopped shallots , ricotta , 1 cup of mozzarella , 2 tablespoons of the parmesan , nutmeg , egg , tsp salt , 1 / 8 tsp pepper
8. Cook the lasagna noodles , slightly underdone
9. Drain with cold water and dry on paper towels
10. Oil a 9x13 baking dish
11. Spread cup of tomato sauce over the bottom of dish
12. Lay several sheets of pasta , slightly overlapping , on the sauce
13. Dot with half the ricotta mixture
14. Spread half of the roasted vegetables on top of the cheese
15. Pour about 1 cup of sauce over the vegetables
16. Top the sauce with a second layer of pasta
17. Dot with the remaining ricotta mixture and cover with the remaining vegetables and about 1 cup of sauce
18. Top the sauce with a final layer of pasta and the remaining sauce
19. Sprinkle with the remaining 1 cup of mozzarella and 2 tablespoons of parmesan
20. Bake at 350f until golden and bubbling , about 45 minutes
21. Let rest 15 minutes before cutting into squares

title: celebration pumpkin cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease and flour three 9-inch round cake pans
3. Combine cake mix , pumpkin , eggs and butter in a large bowl
4. Beat with electric mixer at medium speed for 2 minutes
5. Divide batter evenly among prepared pans
6. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until toothpick inserted into center comes out clean
7. Cool cakes for 5 minutes on wire racks
8. Remove to racks
9. Cool completely
10. Place on cake layer on serving plate
11. Cover with frosting
12. Place second layer on top of first
13. Cover with frosting
14. Top with remaining cake layer
15. Frost top and side of cake
16. Spread caramel over top of cake , letting some caramel drip down side
17. Garnish with pecan halves

title: rhubarb custard
steps:
1. Cook rhubarb , 1 / 4 cup sugar and ginger together over medium heat for about 10 minutes until the rhubarb is tender
2. Drain
3. Heat whipping cream
4. Mix egg yolks , 3 tablespoons sugar , cornstarch and vanilla together until smooth
5. Whisk warm whipping cream into egg yolk mixture slowly
6. Return to saucepan
7. Heat until thickened over medium heat about 5 minutes
8. Pour into bowl and cool
9. To serve swirl rhubarb and custard together in sherbet glasses or put rhubarb into sherbet glasses and top with custard
10. Serves 4 to 6
11. Ruth fremes whats cooking

title: whole wheat apple turnovers
steps:
1. Sift together flour and salt
2. Cut in shortening , add water
3. Roll 1 / 8 thick & cut into twelve 4 squares
4. Set aside
5. Mix apples , sugar , cinnamon , lemon juice , and salt
6. Drizzle with honey
7. Place 1 heaping tablespoon apple mixture in center of each square
8. Dot with 1 / 2 teaspoon margarine
9. Moisten edges with water , fold into triangle , and press edges together with fork
10. Place on greased cookie sheet
11. Prick top with fork
12. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 400f

title: sommer s ground turkey chili
steps:
1. Brown ground turkey , worcestershire sauce , chopped onion , chopped green , yellow , and red bell peppers over medium-high heat in a dutch oven or large saucepan
2. Until meat is browned
3. Drain , if desired and return to pan
4. Add the 3 cans of beans , the can of diced tomatoes , the ketchup , the brown sugar , and all of the spices , plus the water
5. Stir to combine and bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat to medium , cook uncovered for 30 minutes , stirring occasionally

title: tortellini and tomato soup with rosemary
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat
2. Add onion and garlic , and saute 5 minutes or until softened
3. Add tomato and cook 1 minute
4. Stir in broth and rosemary and bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat and simmer , covered , 5 minutes
6. Add pasta , stirring to blend , and simmer 5 to 6 minutes more
7. Add spinach , salt and papper
8. Simmer , stirring often , 3 minutes or until spinach is wilted and pasta is just tender
9. Ladle soup into bowls and sprinkle with cheese or stir in a spoonful of pesto

title: unleavened bread for passover
steps:
1. Roll out to 1 / 8 inch thick
2. Place on greased cookie sheet
3. Score into about 1 inch squares
4. Cut into 4 x 5 rectangles
5. Bake at 400 degrees about 15 minutes
6. In the first minutes of baking , prick bubbles that may form

title: candy apple punch
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large pitcher and chill for 8 hours or until candies are dissolved
2. Pour mixture into a large dutch oven and heat thouroughly
3. Serve hot

title: lemon and blueberry yogurt parfait  low fat
steps:
1. Divide lemon curd into the bottom of two dessert dishes
2. Put flaked almonds into a very hot pan and toast for about three minutes
3. Keep moving them constantly to make sure they don't burn
4. Layer toasted almonds on top of lemon curd
5. Put half a cup of greek yogurt on top of the almonds in each dish
6. Put the blueberries into a saucepan over medium heat
7. Add the lemon juice and sugar and stir gently stir into the blueberries over the heat
8. Keep stirring for about four minutes until the berries have popped and are cooked through
9. Pour the blueberries on top of the yogurt layer along with any of the juices in the pan you cooked them inches
10. Serve

title: bacon cheeseburger upside down pizza
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees f
2. In large saucepan , brown ground beef with onion and bell pepper
3. Drain
4. Stir in 6 slices crumbled bacon and pizza sauce
5. Spoon into ungreased 13 x 9-inch baking dish
6. Sprinkle evenly with tomatoes
7. Top with cheese slices
8. In medium bowl , beat eggs slightly
9. Add milk and oil
10. Mix well
11. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup
12. Level off
13. Add flour and salt
14. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed
15. Pour evenly over cheese slices
16. Sprinkle with crumbled bacon
17. Bake at 400 degrees f for 20 to 30 minutes or until topping is slightly puffed and deep golden brown

title: roast beef horseradish spirals
steps:
1. Combine first 6 ingredients
2. Place the two tortillas on work surface , spread half of cheese over each , top each with half of the roast beef slices , leaving a 1 / 2 inch border around edges
3. Roll up , wrap tightly in plastic wrap
4. Refrigerate until firm , 30 minutes or up to 1 day ahead
5. Cut diagonally into 1 / 2 inch slices and serve

title: granny s beef and barley vegetable soup
steps:
1. Put 12 cups of water into large stock pot
2. Add meat , bay leaves , salt , pepper , and onion powder
3. Simmer covered for 2 hours
4. Add tomatoes and simmer for another hour
5. Remove meat , take out bones , and cut up
6. Add barley and frozen vegetables
7. Simmer for another 45 minutes
8. Return meat to pot and add corn
9. Simmer another 30 minutes
10. Add sugar and check seasonings
11. Adjust salt and pepper if necessary

title: apple jack
steps: 1. Put it all in blender and puree until smooth

title: korean zucchini  hobak chon
steps:
1. Wash and slice zucchinis into 1 / 4 inch slices
2. Place flour into a shallow bowl , for dredging
3. Place eggs into another shallow bowl , and beat
4. Heat a non-stick pan to medium low
5. Put a small amount of oil into the pan
6. In an assembly line , dredge zucchini slice in flour , shake off excess and then dredge in beaten egg
7. Put into pan
8. Repeat assembly line until pan is filled
9. Check sliced zucchini and flip when lightly browned
10. Green of zucchini should turn bright when it is cooked enough
11. Drain on paper towels
12. Serve along side a korean soy sauce dipping sauce , recipe #191136
13. This recipe can also be used with thin slices of asian eggplant or other vegetables

title: no fuss swiss steak
steps:
1. In a large skillet , brown beef in oil over medium-high heat
2. Drain
3. Transfer to a slow-cooker
4. Add carrots and celery
5. Combine the remaining ingredients
6. Pour over meat and vegetables
7. Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours or until meat is tender
8. Discard the bay leaf before serving
9. Thicken coooking juices if desired

title: easy roast salmon
steps:
1. Rinse salmon and place in large baking pan
2. Drizzle olive oil over one side of fish
3. Spread oil evenly with hands and sprinkle liberally with salt and pepper
4. Turn fish over and repeat on the other side
5. Roast 20 minutes at 500 degrees , then let stand 10 minutes before removing skin and deboning

title: alton brown s eggnog
steps:
1. In the bowl of a stand mixer , beat the egg yolks until they lighten in color
2. Gradually add the 1 / 3 cup sugar and continue to beat until it is completely dissolved
3. Add the milk , cream , bourbon and nutmeg and stir to combine
4. Place the egg whites in the bowl of a stand mixer and beat to soft peaks
5. With the mixer still running gradually add the 1 tablespoon of sugar and beat until stiff peaks form
6. Whisk the egg whites into the mixture
7. Chill and serve
8. Cook's
9. In the bowl of a stand mixer , beat the egg yolks until they lighten in color
10. Gradually add the 1 / 3 cup sugar and continue to beat until it is completely dissolved
11. Set aside
12. In a medium saucepan , over high heat , combine the milk , heavy cream and nutmeg and bring just to a boil , stirring occasionally
13. Remove from the heat and gradually temper the hot mixture into the egg and sugar mixture
14. Then return everything to the pot and cook until the mixture reaches 160 degrees f
15. Remove from the heat , stir in the bourbon , pour into a medium mixing bowl , and set in the refrigerator to chill
16. In a medium mixing bowl , beat the egg whites to soft peaks
17. With the mixer running gradually add the 1 tablespoon of sugar and beat until stiff peaks form
18. Whisk the egg whites into the chilled mixture

title: baked chili mac
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Cook the pasta according to package directions until al dente
3. Drain and set aside
4. While pasta is cooking , in a large saut pan cook the ground meat , onion , and garlic until meat is browned , about 5 to 7 minutes
5. Drain fat if desired or necessary
6. Add the tomatoes , tomato paste , mild green chiles , beans , chili powder , ancho , oregano , cumin , pepper , salt , and tabasco and simmer for 5 minutes
7. Add the cooked macaroni and stir well to incorporate
8. Pour mixture into a lightly pan-sprayed large casserole dish and sprinkle with the cheddar cheese
9. Bake at 350 degrees f for 20 to 30 minutes or until the cheese is golden and bubbly
10. Serve with a bit of sour cream for topping and veggies

title: vegan and heart healthy cookies
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350 degrees
2. For egg substitute whisk ground flax seed and water in it's own bowl
3. Mix apple sauce , honey , vanilla , lastly add in the egg replacers
4. In another bowl mix baking soda and flours
5. Add flour to the apple sauce bowl and slowly blend together
6. Drop by spoonfuls onto un-greased cookie sheet
7. Bake for 9 minute

title: healthy carrot cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Coat a 9x13 pan with spray and dust lightly with flour
3. Tap out the excess flour
4. Whisk the flours with the baking soda , cinnamon , nutmeg and salt
5. Set aside
6. Beat the egg , egg whites , brown sugar and oil with an electric mixer until smooth
7. Add the carrots and beat for 1 minute
8. Add the buttermilk , pineapple and raisins and beat again
9. Add the flour mixture and beat until well mixed
10. Scrape the batter into the pan and bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
11. Cool the cake in the pan set on a wire rack
12. Frost , if desired , when completely cool
13. Store the cake in the pan in the refrigerator
14. To make the frosting , beat cream cheese , sugar and vanilla with an elecric mixer set at medium-high speed until smooth
15. Reduce the speed to medium-low and add the milk , a tsp
16. At a time until the frosting is at spreading consistency
17. Spread the frosting on the cooled , uncut cake

title: chickpea dahl
steps:
1. Cook potatoes in salted water until tender yet firm
2. Drain and set aside
3. Saute onion in 1 tablespoons oil until clear
4. Transfer to a food processor along with the tomatoes and fresh ginger , and blend until smooth
5. Set aside
6. In a large saucepan , melt margarine and add the curry powder and cumin
7. Saute for 4-5 minutes over medium heat
8. Stir often to avoid burning
9. Add the tomato mixture and continue to cook for 5 - 6 minutes , stirring often
10. Add the chickpeas , potatoes and frozen peas
11. Cook 5 - 10 minutes more
12. Serve hot over rice

title: corn dog cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f and lightly grease baking pan
2. Combine flour , brown sugar , corn meal , baking powder , and salt in a bowl
3. Mix together
4. Set aside
5. Combine milk , eggs , butter
6. Mix well
7. Add dry mixture to wet mixture , stir until just blended
8. Pour into baking pan
9. Cut hot dogs into bite size pieces
10. Sprinkle hot dogs into mixture
11. Bake at 350 f for 35 minutes or until golden brown

title: honey corn flake crumb chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Spray a casserole dish with pam
3. Coat chicken with honey and mustard
4. Sprinkle both sides with crumbs and the seasonings
5. Place chicken in casserole dish
6. Bake uncovered for 30-35 minutes until golden and turn over halfway though cooking

title: cafe green salad by melissa d arabian
steps:
1. Rub the inside of a large wooden bowl with the garlic clove and then either discard it or save it for another use
2. Put the mustard in the bowl and whisk in the balsamic vinegar and soy sauce vigorously for about 10 seconds to get a creamy consistency
3. Season with salt and pepper , to taste
4. Drizzle in the olive oil as slowly as possible with 1 hand while whisking as quickly as possible with the other hand to emulsify
5. Lay the salad greens on top of the dressing and toss just before serving

title: taco popcorn
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit
2. Put popcorn in a large mixing bowl
3. Lightly coat popcorn with cooking spray
4. Toss and coat again
5. Combine cumin , garlic powder , onion powder , and cayenne pepper
6. Sprinkle spices over popcorn and toss to coat evenly
7. Drizzle worcestershire sauce over popcorn and toss again
8. Spread popcorn evenly in large baking pan
9. Bake for 10 minutes , tossing once

title: deep dish pizza from oamc easy mix yeast bread dough for 2
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl combine 1 1 / 2 cups of the flour , the yeast , and , if desired , herb
2. In a medium saucepan heat and stir milk , margarine , sugar , and salt just till warm and margarine almost melts
3. Add to flour mixture
4. Add egg
5. Beat with an electric mixer on low to medium speed for 30 seconds , scraping bowl
6. Beat on high speed for 3 minutes
7. Stir in the remaining flour
8. Divide dough into halves or quarters
9. To chill , cover portions and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or up to 3 days
10. Or , to freeze , wrap the portions in plastic wrap and place in freezer bags
11. Seal , label , and freeze for up to 3 months
12. To use , let dough stand at room temperature about 2 1 / 2 hours or till thawed
13. To make pizza , use 1 / 2 of the above recipe
14. With lightly greased fingers , pat dough into the bottom and up the sides of a greased 11x7x1 1 / 2 or 9x9x2 inch baking pan
15. Cover and let rise in a warm place til nearly double
16. Bake in a 375 oven about 10 minutes or till light brown
17. Spread pizza sauce over hot crust
18. Sprinkle with meat and veggies , add cheese
19. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes more or till crust is golden brown
20. Serves 2

title: hot raspberry cider
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a 4 quart saucepan
2. Heat over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until mixture starts to simmer
3. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes
4. Remove from heat
5. Remove cinnamon stick
6. Serve hot

title: johnny s chicken wings
steps:
1. In a large skillet over a low / med heat saute chicken wings in butter and garlic until wings brown
2. Mix brown sugar and orange juice , add to the pan and finish cooking wings
3. Sauce should not be boiling , but a gentle simmer
4. Wings should have a nice glaze and the meat should be about falling off the bone when they are done
5. If needed you can add more juice as the wings cook
6. Don't cook over too high a heat , the butter and garlic will burn quickly and the orange juice will cook off too quickly
7. You can also put a lid on the pan after adding the orange juice and brown sugar to help slow evaporation and reduce spatters

title: tri color pasta
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Add peas during last 5 minutes
3. Drain in colander
4. Rinse under cold water to cool
5. In large bowl , combine pasta , peas , tomatoes and cheese
6. Stir in pesto

title: vegetarian teething cookies
steps:
1. In food processor , blender , or mixing bowl , blend the egg yolk , molasses , oil , and vanilla
2. Preheat oven to 350f degrees
3. Combine the flours , wheat germ , and milk powder , and add them to the egg mixture to make a dough
4. Roll the dough out on a lightly floured surface
5. Place the dough on a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper or greased lightly with a mixture of liquid lecithin and oil
6. Cut the dough into rectangles no smaller than a baby's finger
7. Should be able to just fit into the baby's mouth
8. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes
9. Cool on a wire rack
10. A baby's airway is the size of their pinkie finger
11. Babies should always be supervised while eating to avoid choking

title: lamb with apricots
steps:
1. In a large skillet , saute onion in oil until tender
2. Add the lamb , cumin , cinnamon , coriander , salt and pepper
3. Cook and stir for 5 minutes , or until meat is browned
4. Add apricots , orange juice , almonds and orange peel
5. Transfer to a 2-1 / 2 quart baking dish
6. Stir in broth
7. Cover and bake at 350 for 1-1 / 2 hours or until meat is tender
8. Sprinkle with sesame seeds

title: skillet gardener s pie   vegan
steps:
1. Scrub the potatoes and cut them into cubes
2. Place potatoes in a large pot and cover with water
3. Bring to a boil and simmer until potatoes are tender
4. Reserve a cup of their cooking water , if possible , and drain
5. Place in a large bowl , add the soymilk , and mash until smooth , adding a little of the potato-cooking water if they seem too dry
6. Add salt and freshly ground pepper to taste and set aside in a warm place
7. While the potatoes are cooking , make the "pie" filling
8. Spray a large non-stick or cast iron skillet with canola oil
9. Heat it on a medium-high burner and add the onions
10. Saut until onions are translucent
11. Add the garlic , carrots , celery , and mushrooms , and saut for 3 more minutes
12. Add the vegetable broth , kidney beans , green beans , and herbs
13. Simmer on medium heat for 20 minutes and all vegetables are tender
14. Add salt and pepper to taste
15. There should still be some liquid in the pan , but if it has become too dry , add a little of the potato-cooking water
16. Add the spinach and stir until it's completely wilted
17. Mix the corn starch with the water until smooth , and add it to the pan
18. Cook , stirring , until mixture has thickened
19. Spoon the potatoes evenly over the top of the filling and sprinkle with chopped rosemary
20. If potatoes have cooled , put the skillet under the broiler for a minute or two
21. Serve immediately while hot

title: homemade honey
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , bring water , sugar and alum to a boil and boil for 10 minutes
2. Take off heat
3. Rinse off blossoms in strainer and drain well
4. Stir in blossoms and steep for 3 hours
5. Remove flowers , strain through cheesecloth if necessary
6. Reheat to a boil , then pour into jars and seal

title: 5 layer delicious dessert
steps:
1. 1st layer: heat oven to 350f
2. Mix all the ingredients together and use fingers to evenly pat down into the bottom of a baking dish about 9x13 size
3. Bake for 25 minutes to form crust
4. Cool before 2nd layer
5. 2nd layer: mix all ingredients together and put all on top of the crust
6. 3rd layer: open can of cherries and spread out over 2nd layer
7. 4th layer: mix the 2 pudding boxes and the milk together and spread out over the cherries
8. 5th layer: spread out the cool whip on top of the pudding mixture and grate the hershey bar over the whole thing
9. Put the entire dish into the fridge to set up

title: irish sausage and potato pie
steps:
1. Heat oven to 325f
2. Heat a nonstick fry pan
3. Add the sausages and gently fry for about 10 minutes , until almost cooked through and golden brown
4. Remove from the pan and slice into three , lengthwise on the diagonal
5. Heat the frying pan once more
6. Add half the butter , and when melted add the onions
7. Cook gently for 10 minutes until soft and translucent
8. Remove from the pan and set aside
9. Add the bacon lardons to the pan and cook over a high heat for 3 to 4 minutes until golden and crispy
10. Remove and drain on paper towel
11. Add the cabbage and 2 tbs water
12. Quickly cook for 2 to 3 minutes until the cabbage is just beginning to wilt
13. Drain off any fat , remove from the pan and set aside
14. Grease a large gratin dish with 1 oz
15. Of the butter
16. Place a layer of sliced potatoes in the bottom of the dish
17. Season with salt , freshly ground black pepper and a sprinkling of the thyme
18. Top with a layer of sliced sausages , then a layer of onion
19. Spoon over the cooked cabbage and bacon
20. Top with another layer of potato , season again as before , then add another layer of sausage , then onion and finally sliced potato
21. Season again with the salt , pepper and thyme
22. Gently heat the cream , stock and bay leaves until almost boiling
23. Don't boil ! pour over the sausage and potato pie , just to cover the top layer of potatoes
24. Dot with the remaining butter and cover with foil
25. Place on a baking sheet and bake in the oven for 1 3 / 4 hours
26. Remove foil , increase oven temp to 400f and bake for a further 15 minutes until golden

title: lasagne supremo
steps:
1. Chop onion finely and cook with minced garlic til soft in a non stick frying pan with 1 tbsp oil
2. Brown ground meat , season with salt , pepper , sambal olek and italian seasonings
3. Set aside and keep warm
4. Beat eggs
5. Add eggs to ricotta and stir well
6. Season ricotta and egg mixture with salt and pepper
7. Add fresh torn basil if you have it , if not use chopped parsley
8. Put a thin layer of spaghetti sauce on bottom of an 11x9 greased pan
9. Add a layer of lasagne noodles
10. Be sure to use instant lasagne noodles !
11. Stir together remaining spaghetti sauce with the ground meat and spread 1 / 3 mixture over the noodles in the pan
12. Top with ricotta cheese mixture
13. Layer on 1 / 2 thawed drained spinach over cheese layer
14. Add a 2nd layer of noodles , top with sauce / meat mixture , then ricotta , remaining spinach and finally the remaining meat / sauce mixture
15. Top with mozzarella and bake in a hot oven until cheese is browned and bubbling , approximately 40 minutes
16. Let sit for 10 minutes to allow to set for easy serving
17. Serve with crusty garlic bread and copious amounts of good red wine !

title: kombucha scoby   to start your own kombucha brew
steps:
1. Pour the bottle of kombucha and sweetened tea into a large glass jar
2. Cover jar with a towel or coffee filter secured with a rubber band so the brew can breathe but still be protected from insects and other contaminants
3. Let it sit for a week
4. Put it in a room temperature area that is dark
5. With time , a new scoby will start to form on top of the liquid
6. It will appear first as a thin film , then slowly fill in and thicken up
7. Once its about 1 / 4 inch thick , its ready to go
8. You can let it sit longer and get even thicker , but thats really not necessary
9. If you see any mold - discard it and start over
10. It will look like bread mold
11. To start a batch with your scoby , wash your hands
12. Never touch your scoby with dirty hands as it will cause it to mold
13. Drain 75% of the liquid you have from your brew into a food grade glass container to drink
14. Place 4 c black or green tea that has been in food grade glass container with 25% remaining liquid
15. Top with new scoby and let it go through the same week long fermentation process as you did to make the scoby
16. A new scoby will form on top of the old scoby and you can peel it off and start a new batch from the new scoby or have two batches going at the same time in different jars
17. You can give away the new baby scobys but make sure to include 1 / 2 c of the brew it came from and enough sugar and tea bags for somebody to start their own
18. With the remaining 75% juice , drink 4 oz
19. At most a day if you're not going to dilute it with tea or fruit juice
20. If diluting with juice , pour 2
21. 5 ounces into a quart sized food grade glass jar and top with kombucha brew
22. Cover , set it back in the pantry and let "brew" for 48 hours
23. Place fruit juice kombucha in the fridge and enjoy

title: apple muffins  cake mix
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Beat pie filling , eggs , apple pie spice and yellow cake mix together with an with electric mixer on medium-speed until thoroughly mixed
3. Divide batter equally between 24 paper-lined cupcake wells
4. Bake in a preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean
5. Allow to cool before peeling off paper liners

title: creamy orange dressing  raw vegan
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients together until smooth !
2. Pour over dark leafy greens & kiss iron absorption problems good bye !

title: egg pizza
steps:
1. Fry sausage or hamburger meat and drain
2. While meat drains , fry onions , when onions are tender whip eggs like you would to scramble , add meat , onions mix well
3. Pour into a cast iron frying pan
4. Cook over medium low heat until eggs start to set and thicken
5. Pour catsup over the top
6. Add grated cheese
7. Put into pre heated oven at 350 degrees for 20 to 30 minutes or till cheese melts and turns light brown
8. Remove from oven
9. Let set for a few minutes
10. Slice like you would pie wedges and serv with grits and toast

title: slow cooker beef tips and noodles
steps:
1. Place beef in the slow cooker
2. Combine mushroom soup , onion soup mix and gravy mix in a bowl until well blended
3. Stir in beef broth
4. Add mushrooms and onions to mixture , then pour over beef
5. Cover and cook on low for 5 to 6 hours , or on high for 3 to 4 hours
6. Cook egg noodle according to directions on package
7. Spoon beef mixture over hot noodles and serve

title: easy spicy chicken casserole  the spicy is optional
steps:
1. Cut chicken in 1 inch cubes
2. Boil chicken in a big covered pot of water seasoned with sea salt , garlic powder , oregano , rosemary , cayenne , cumin and bay leaves for approximately 1 hour
3. Have soups , veggies , green chilies and 1 cup shredded cheese pre-mixed in bowl
4. Set aside
5. Once cooked , scoop chicken out of pot , add more water to broth and boil egg noodles in broth until soft
6. Drain pasta and return to pot
7. Add chicken and soup mixture to pot and stir
8. Pour into casserole dish and top with remaining cheese
9. Bake at 400f for 15 minutes
10. Turn to broil for another 5-6 minutes checking every few minutes to make sure the cheese doesnt burn
11. Sprinkle top with crushed red pepper and cayenne if you want it spicier
12. I usually top half of the casserole with the red pepper and cayenne for those that want it spicier

title: dan s crockpot lasagna
steps:
1. Brown meat over med-high heat with onion until thoroughly cooked , stirring frequently
2. Season with a little salt and pepper
3. Drain well
4. Spray 4-5 quart crockpot with non-stick cooking spray
5. Spread 3 / 4 cup of spaghetti sauce in bottom of crockpot with diced tomato
6. Stir remaining spaghetti sauce , mushrooms , add no-salt tomato sauce into ground beef
7. Lay out one layer of lasagna noodles evenly over sauce in crockpot , breaking noodles as necessary
8. Top with 1 / 3 of the alfredo sauce , spreading evenly
9. Sprinkle with 1 c of mozzarella cheese
10. Top with 1 / 3 of the meat mixture , spreading evenly
11. Repeat , layering twice
12. Three full layers total
13. Sprinkle parmesan cheese over top
14. Cover
15. Cook on low for 4 hours , or on high for 2 hours

title: buttery cinnamon sheet bread
steps:
1. Set oven to 375 degrees
2. Grease a 15 x 10-inch jelly-roll pan
3. Spread the room temperature thawed dough on the bottom of the greased jelly-roll pan
4. Spread the softened butter over the dough , then prick holes in the dough with a fork
5. In a bowl stir together both sugars with cinnamon and nuts , then sprinkle all over the top of the buttered dough
6. Bake for about 15-20 minutes or until golden brown
7. Whisk the powdered sugar with the whipping cream until desired consistancy , then drizzle over the warm bread ,
8. Cut into squares or triangles
9. Serve warm

title: almond cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees and set rack to middle position
2. Line the bottom of an 8" cake tin with parchment paper
3. Butter and flour the tin
4. Using an electric mixer cream the butter and sugar until light and fluffy
5. Add the almond paste about a walnut sized piece at a time , beating until well blended after each addition
6. Beat in the eggs , one at a time
7. Mix in the kirsch , almond extract and the salt
8. Combine the cake flour and baking powder in a small bowl , add to the batter and beat vigorously for about 30 seconds
9. Pour the batter into the cake tin
10. Bake for about 35 minutes until golden brown on top and a cake tester inserted in the middle comes out clean
11. Start testing at the 30 minute mark
12. Cool the cake in the tin on a rack
13. Unmold the cake on to a serving platter
14. Dust with powdered sugar just before serving
15. This cake has a tendency to collapse in the middle as it cools
16. I have found that beating the batter vigorously after the flour is added develops a bit of structure that helps alleviate the collapse
17. Because it is cake flour there is only so much gluten that can be developed so the cake does not become tough
18. And anyway , collapsed or not , it still tastes great
19. This cake is delicious served plain as is
20. With a little raspberry coulis , a dollop of whipped cream and a fresh berry or two , it makes for an elegant desert
21. If you have cake strips you can use them here
22. It's not really necessary but i find you get more even rise if you do
23. If you don't have any liquor in the house you can omit it altogether
24. This cake keeps very well , wrapped , at room temperature for a couple of days

title: slow cooker granola
steps:
1. In your slow-cooker [crockpot] , stir together the oats , almonds , coconut , and wheat germ
2. In a seperate microwaveable bowl , mix honey , apple juice concentrate , br
3. Sugar , vanilla , and cinnamon
4. Microwave for one minute
5. Pour the liquid into the slow cooker and stir until evenly coated
6. Cook for one hour on high , uncovered
7. Then cook four hours on low , covered
8. Periodically , stir the granola
9. It will be a nice toasted-brown color
10. When done , stir in the cranberries
11. Please , do not add the cranberries earlier ! if they cook in the crockpot with everything else , it will burn and became a huge mess
12. [i'm speaking from experience here
13. ]
14. Store in an airtight container
15. It should yield approximately ten 1 / 2c servings

title: hg s top banana bread   ww points   2
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large bowl , combine both types of flour , splenda , baking powder , salt , and cinnamon
3. In a separate bowl , mix together the mashed bananas , egg substitute , applesauce and vanilla extract
4. Add this mixture to the bowl with the dry ingredients , and stir until just blended
5. Spoon batter into a large loaf pan sprayed with nonstick spray
6. Bake for about 50 minutes , or until a knife inserted in the middle comes out clean
7. Allow to cool slightly , and then cut into 8 slices
8. If you like , spritz with some spray butter or spread on some cool whip free
9. Update: for muffins - prepare 9 muffin cups
10. Bake for 28 minutes

title: apple meringue
steps:
1. Peel , core and slice apples , not too thin
2. Make a syrup with the water and the sugar
3. Add the spices , apples and raisins
4. Cook covered until tender , but still hold their shape
5. Add the liqueur and the honey
6. Place in a baking dish
7. Make italian meringue------------------
8. Stir sugar and water over heat until sugar is completely dissolved
9. Let cook until a thick syrup
10. Meanwhile , whip with an electric beater the whites until they form soft peaks
11. Slowly pour the hot syrup into the whites , beating all along until cool
12. Spread meringue on top of apples , bake in preheated 350 f oven until golden
13. Chill

steps:

steps:

2. , or until you can easily pull the leg away from the cavity

4. If bloody , cook longer

title: world s greatest baked lasagna
steps:
1. Combine tomato sauce , tomato puree , tomato paste , water , bay leaf and oil in lg saucepan
2. Cook at medium-high heat , stirring constantly to a light boil
3. In a separate frying pan , saut sausage
4. Drain fat and add garlic , mushrooms and onion , sauting for 1-2 minutes

12. In a casserole dish layer lasagna as follows:

14. Bake for 35 minutes , uncovered
15. Check for doneness by poking through noodles with knife

title: cheesy asparagus casserole
steps:
1. Hard boil the eggs
2. Cut asparagus into bite size pieces and parboil
3. Line a 2
4. 5 litre casserole dish with asparagus , then sliced or chopped eggs
5. Melt 2 tbsp butter in a nonstick saucepan
6. Add enough flour to make a thick paste

9. Pour the cheese sauce over the asparagus and eggs
10. Melt 2 tbsp butter in saucepan and add the cornflakes

12. Sprinkle cornflakes over all and bake in the oven for 25 minutes at 350f
13. Or you can put it in the microwave for about 5 minutes

title: ange s pizza sauce
steps:

3. Pour into a container , or use straight away

title: banana chocolate chip muffins
steps:

title: ww chicken tikka masala
steps:
1. To make chicken , in a large bowl , whisk together first seven ingredient
2. Add chicken breasts and toss to coat
3. Cover bowl and marinate for 1 hour and up to 24
4. Preheat outdoor grill , stovetop grill , or non-stick skillet

title: spinach   feta quiche
steps:
1. Pastry- put all the dry ingredients into the food processor
2. Pulse a few times , then add the butter , then pulse a few more times until the butter is in pea sized chunks
3. Beat the egg into 3 tbl
4. Of the water and add to the mix , pulsing a few more times
5. Add more water as needed to get the dough to just come together , a tablespoon at a time , pulsing after each addition
6. Turn the dough out onto plastic wrap , knead once or twice , pat flat and chill for about an hour
7. Pull out of the fridge , roll out on a floured board until it will fit into the tart pan
8. Trim the edges , prick the bottom several times with a fork , and lay a piece of foil across the bottom weighted down with beans or pennies

6. Divide the crab mixture into 8 equal portions and shape each into a patty about 1 / 2 inch thick
7. Dip each patty into the flour to coat
8. Next dip into the beaten eggs and then roll carefully in the crumb mixture to cover well
9. Place on a plate and allow to air dry for 30 minutes
10. In a large , heavy skillet , heat the oil over medium heat
11. Cook the patties without crowding in the pan until desired browness , turning once

title: oyster shooter  adult beverage

title: bread and butter pickles  cukes or summer squash
steps:
1. Wash cucumbers or squash
2. Cut 1 / 16-inch off blossom end and discard
3. Cut into 3 / 16-inch slices
4. Combine cucumbers and onions in a large bowl
5. Add salt
6. Cover with 2 inches crushed or cubed ice
7. Refrigerate 3 to 4 hours , adding more ice as needed
8. Combine remaining ingredients in a large pot
9. Boil 10 minutes
10. Drain and add cucumbers and onions and slowly reheat to boiling
11. Fill pint jars with slices and cooking syrup , leaving 1 / 2-inch headspace

15. Cut 1 / 1 6-inch off blossom end and discard
16. Cut into 3 / 16-inch slices
17. Mix 1 cup pickling lime and 1 / 2 cup salt to 1 gallon water in a 2- to 3-gallon crock or enamelware container
18. Avoid inhaling lime dust while mixing the lime-water solution
19. Soak cucumber slices in lime water for 12 to 24 hours , stirring occasionally
20. Remove from lime solution , rinse , and resoak 1 hour in fresh cold water
21. Repeat the rinsing and soaking steps two more times
22. Handle carefully , as slices will be brittle
23. Drain well
24. Procede as with step #2 above

1. Blend or process nuts until finely ground

4. Absolutely amazing and quick

title: arroz de mexico  mexican rice
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large skillet and saut rice until golden
2. Add 1 / 2 cup broth , onion and bell pepper and saut for 2 more minutes

1. In a large mixing bowl , combine the cake mix , water , oil and egg whites just until moistened

title: chili with ravioli

1. Heat vegetable oil in a wide deep skillet or dutch oven

1. Add only 1 / 2 cup of water and the roast to crockpot

3. Remove roast from crockpot , allow to cool slightly

2. Cook pasta in boiling salted water until al-dente
3. Drain and set aside
4. Heat the milk in the microwave , on high for 1-1 / 2 minutes
5. In a medium saucepan , melt butter
6. Add salt , pepper and chopped onion
7. Saut on medium heat , until the onion is transparent and soft , but not brown
8. Sprinkle the flour on top , and allow the butter to absorb some of it before stirring
9. Add the hot milk in 3 additions , stirring constantly
10. The mixture will get thick very quickly
11. After the final addition of milk , continue heating the mixture , on medium heat , stirring constantly , until thick and bubbly
12. Remove from heat and stir in the grated cheese , chives and red pepper flakes
13. Add the drained pasta and mix well
14. Fold in the cubed cheese
15. Pour into two greased onion soup bowls
16. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes
17. Allow to cool a bit before serving

title: chicken with mushroom cream sauce
steps:
1. Pound chicken breasts with a meat mallet to flaten
2. Sprinkle chicken breasts with salt , basil and thyme
3. Using a large saucepan over low heat , saute chicken breasts in olive oil until juices run clear -- approximately 10-15 minutes
4. Turn heat off , cover with lid and allow chicken to remain in pan for 10 minutes
5. In a small saucepan saute mushrooms in olive oil
6. Add minced garlic and wine
7. Remove chicken from large saucepan to a plate
8. Place mushroom mixture in large saucepan and stir to loosen brown bits from bottom of pan
9. Allow mushrooms to simmer approximately 2 minutes
10. Add heavy cream
11. In a small cup , dissolve cornstarch with cold water and add to cream
12. Heat and stir until sauce thickens
13. Place chicken breasts back in pan and spoon sauce over chicken
14. Allow chicken to reheat
15. Sprinkle parmesan cheese on top
16. Serve with pasta of choice
17. Enjoy !

title: jolean s   sick egg  recipe
steps:
1. Toast a piece of white bread lightly in a toaster
2. Leave it plain
3. Meanwhile , in a very small non-stick skillet lightly sprayed with pam , gently crack 1 egg over medium-high heat
4. Cover skillet and listen -- when you begin to hear a slight "sizzling sound" , turn the heat off and let it sit on the burner for about 4 minutes
5. Uncover and check egg -- there should be no slimy eggwhite on top , and the yolk should be 1 / 4 done and 3 / 4 runny
6. Lay egg flat on top of toast and cut into about 1 / 2" cubes
7. Transfer to a bowl and toss gently , letting the soft yolk sort of coat the toast pieces a little bit

title: zesty moroccan pita
steps:
1. Combine cumin and chili powder in a plastic bag
2. Add chicken and shake to coat
3. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in large skillet over medium heat
4. Add chicken
5. Cook 5 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink , stirring frequently
6. Take off heat , set aside to cool
7. Combine remaining ingredients , mixing well
8. Stir in chicken
9. Add salt and pepper to taste
10. Cut top off pitas to open
11. Divide chicken mixture among the pitas
12. Top with yogurt or sour cream , if desired

title: savory italian bread
steps:
1. Cut bread to , but not through the bottom into 12 slices
2. Place on baking sheet
3. Combine all other ingredients in a small bowl and mix well
4. Spread the mixture between the slices and over the top of the bread
5. Bake at 400 for about 12 minutes or until golden

title: brussels sprout and bacon gratin
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f and place rack at the highest level
2. Toss brussels sprouts with melted butter , bacon , salt and pepper
3. My suggestion , spray selected baking dish with non stick spray , for easier cleanup
4. Arrange in a shallow baking dish just large enough for a generous single layer with a little overlap
5. Roast for 25 minutes , stirring 2 or 3 times during cooking
6. Meanwhile: while sprouts are roasting , in a medium bowl mix together all of the topping ingredients
7. Set aside
8. When sprouts are ready , toss with cream
9. Return to the original baking dish and arrange in a single layer
10. Sprinkle the topping evenly over all
11. Return to oven and roast until gratin is bubbling and breadcrumbs are golden brown , 20-25 minutes
12. Let rest 15 minutes before serving

title: churros con chocolate  spanish
steps:
1. For the churros: in a saucepan , combine first 4 ingredients and bring to a boil
2. Skim out the rind , add flour and beat mixture with a wooden spoon on low flame until the batter becomes smooth and then congeals into a ball
3. Remove from flame and put batter in a pastry bag and pipe long strips or rings of it into deep , hot oil
4. Fry in deep oil until golden brown , remove and drain
5. Cut into short strips and dust with sugar
6. For the chocolate: combine the chocolate , sugar and milk in a medium saucepan over medium heat
7. Cook , stirring , for 5 minutes or until chocolate melts and the mixture is smooth
8. If you like your chocolate thicker , lessen the milk a bit
9. Pour in a cup
10. Dunk the churros in it and eat ! enjoy !

title: baked salmon fillets
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Pour 1 tbsp of olive oil evenly in the bottom of a 9x9-inch glass baking dish
3. Place the fillets in the bottom of the baking dish
4. Pour the remaining olive oil over the fillets
5. Sprinkle half of the garlic over the fillets
6. Sprinkle the bread crumbs over the fillets
7. Sprinkle the cheese over the fillets
8. Bake for approximately 18 to 20 minutes making sure not to over bake
9. Squeeze the juice of a lemon quarter over each fillet

title: rose scented geranium lemonade
steps:
1. In a small pot boil water with sugar
2. Remove from heat , add leaves and let infuse until cold
3. Squeeze out leaves well
4. Add lemon or lime juice
5. Pour it into bottle and refrigerate
6. To serve , add 1 tablespoon of this concentrate to each cup of chilled water and mix well
7. Serve over ice in a goblet garnished with a small scented geranium leaf of rose petals
8. Store refrigerated for at least two weeks

title: fantabulous family style pizza
steps:
1. Combine warm water , yeast , and honey
2. Let sit 5 minutes to dissolve and activate yeast
3. Stir together yeast mixture , water , olive oil , salt , and 1 cup flour
4. Gradually add remaining flour , stirring , until dough comes together
5. Knead for 10 minutes until soft , smooth , and elastic
6. Turn dough into a large oiled bowl
7. Cover and allow to rise at room temperature for about 1 hour until doubled
8. Preheat oven to 450
9. Spray a 12x17" baking sheet with no-stick cooking spray then sprinkle the sheet lightly with cornmeal
10. Set aside
11. Punch down dough
12. Turn out on a lightly floured surface and press dough out thinly into a fairly large rectangular shape
13. Lift and transfer dough onto prepared baking sheet
14. Press dough outward until it covers the baking sheet
15. Form a ridge around the outer edge
16. Parbake pizza crust for 3-4 minutes
17. Remove parbaked pizza crust from oven and pat down any overly-puffed-up spots using with the palm of your hand or a clean kitchen towel
18. Spread sauce evenly over surface of pizza crust
19. Top pizza with layers of low-moisture part-skim mozzarella cheese and your choice of pepperoni , canadian bacon , cooked sausage , sliced black olives , mushrooms , chopped green peppers , etc
20. Lastly sprinkle a small amount of cheddar cheese over the very top
21. Return pizza to oven and bake and additional 15 minutes until crust is golden-brown and cheese is melted , bubbly , and just beginning to brown
22. Variation: to make two 13" thin and crispy pizzas , decrease rising time of dough by about half and place pizza stone into oven
23. Preheat oven and pizza stone to 450
24. Punch down dough
25. Divide into 2 equal portions
26. Turn portions , one at a time , out on a lightly floured surface and press dough as thinly as possible into about about a 10" circular shape
27. Remove the hot pizza stone from the oven and sprinkle it with cornmeal
28. Carefully move dough onto the preheated pizza stone
29. Continue pressing dough circle outward to cover pizza stone and form an outer ridge
30. And don't worry if you hear a faint sizzling sound or see bubbles forming in the uncooked dough during this step , that's what seems to always happens here !
31. Parbake pizza crust for 3-4 minutes
32. Remove from oven , pat down , and top as instructed above
33. Return pizza to oven for 12-13 minutes until done
34. Enjoy !

title: market street clam chowder
steps:
1. Combine melted butter and flour in oven-proof container and bake at 325 for 30 minutes in large saucepan , combine remaining ingredients except half-and-half
2. Simmer until potatoes are thoroughly cooked
3. Stir butter-flour mixture into chowder and stir until thick
4. Mixture will be slightly less thick than cookie dough
5. Remove chowder from heat
6. Stir in half-and-half until blended
7. Heat to serving temperature , stirring occasionally
8. Serve immediately

title: five fruit salsa
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine the first eight ingredients
2. Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight
3. Drain if desired
4. Just before serving , stir in strawberries

title: abby s cream cheese pound cake
steps:
1. Cream butter , sugar , eggs , cream cheese and vanilla or butter extract together
2. Beat in flour
3. Bake @ 325 degrees in a greased and floured loaf pan for 90 minutes

title: low fat crock pot triple chocolate mess
steps:
1. Spray crock pot with pam
2. Mix all ingredients in large mixing bowl
3. Dump into crock pot
4. Place a paper towel over crock pot before placing lid to collect the moisture
5. Cook on low 6-8 hours or on high for 3-4 hours

title: easy  no egg  key lime pie
steps:
1. In blender , mix condensed milk , cream cheese , and lime juice until smooth
2. Add vanilla and blend until mixed through
3. Pour into graham cracker crust
4. Add whipped topping to top of pie
5. Refrigerate for 3-4 hours before serving
6. Decorate top of pie with lime slices

title: ranch style dressing and dip mix
steps:
1. Combine ingredients
2. Blend well
3. Store in an airtight container
4. Give in decorative jars with directions below for dressing and dip
5. ---dressing---
6. In a bowl or jar combine 1 cup of mayonnaise and 1 cup buttermilk
7. Add 1 tablespoon mix and blend well
8. ---dip---
9. In a small bowl blend 1 tablespoon mix with 1 cup sour cream
10. Refrigerate for 1 hour before serving

title: potato pastry dough
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , stir together the potatoes , oil , lemon juice , brown sugar and sea salt until well blended
2. Add the flour , baking powder and nutmeg and mix well
3. Divide in half , wrap each half in cling wrap and refrigerate 1 hour
4. Working one half at a time , roll out into a thin circle between sheets of wax paper
5. Turn into a 9" pie plate
6. Repeat with remaining half of dough
