7. Use immediately or wrap well in cling wrap , then heavy duty foil , and freeze up to 6 months

title: mock baklava    kataifi
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Combine first 5 ingredients in a saucepan
3. Gently boil for 15 minutes or until syrupy
4. Place shredded wheat halves in a single layer in a shallow baking pan
5. Drizzle with butter or margarine
6. Bake in oven 10 minutes or until lightly browned , stirring once
7. Sprinkle half of the nuts over the bottom halves of the biscuits & drizzle with half of the warm syrup
8. Replace top halves & drizzle with the remaining syrup
9. Spoon excess syrup over biscuits until absorbed
10. Top with remaining nuts
11. Serve warm topped with whipped cream

title: lizzy s crabapple crisp
steps:
1. Slice the crab apples with skin on
2. Add sugar and cinnamon to crab apples set aside
3. Combine the 6 ingredients for crust use any depth pan you want it will just increase the cooking time
4. Put your crab apples into pan with your water use the 1 / 2 cup water if your pan is a deep dish
5. Then top with your crumb topping completely
6. Bake at 375 for 15 minutes then 350 for 40 minutes
7. If using a glass dish bake at 350 for 15 minutes then 325 40 - 50 minutes until golden and the edges are slightly crispy

title: italian sweet  and savory bread
steps:
1. Place all bread ingredients in bread machine pan according to manufacturer's directions
2. Select dough cycle and check after 5 minutes of mixing
3. If needed , add 1 to 2 tablespoons water or flour
4. When cycle is complete , turn dough onto a floured surface and divide in half
5. Shape each half into a ball and flatten slightly
6. Place in two greased 9" round cake pans , cover and let rise until doubled
7. Beat egg and water and brush over dough
8. Sprinkle with italian seasoning
9. Bake at 350 for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown
10. Remove from pans and place on wire rack to cool

title: platanos maduros  costa rican fried ripe plantains
steps:
1. Heat vegetable oil in skillet over medium heat
2. Fully peel plantains , and cut them diagonally into approximately 1-inch wide pieces , working your way down the length of the plantain
3. Carefully place pieces of plantain in skillet
4. Flipping often , fry plantains until golden brown
5. The plantains will be rather mushy - they're supposed to be
6. They will be sweet - the riper the plantains , the sweeter they will be
7. If you prefer them sweeter , you can sprinkle with sugar before cooking

title: brown sugar brussels sprouts
steps:
1. Steam the brussels sprouts over boiling water until tender , about 10-15 minutes
2. Heat oil and garlic over medium-high heat until fragrant , being careful not to burn
3. Add brussels sprouts , lemon juice , red pepper flakes , and salt
4. Stirring until they begin to brown , about 5 minutes
5. Add balsamic vinegar and brown sugar , stir for a minute and remove from heat
6. Serve immediately

title: ranch ritz chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Pour ritz crackers into plastic bag and crush until they are all crumbs
3. Mix mayonnaise with dry ranch dressing
4. Coat chicken breasts in mayonnaise mixture first , and then in crushed crackers
5. Bake for 20-30 minutes or until chicken is done throughout

title: pumpkin cookies as created by ms  ash
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together , then stir in chocolate chips and walnuts if desired
2. Bake at 375f for 10-12 minutes
3. Cookies will be soft

title: saute spinach with garlic
steps:
1. In a large saut pan , heat olive oil over medium heat
2. Add garlic , and cook until golden brown , 2 to 3 minutes
3. Using a slotted spoon , transfer garlic to paper towels
4. Reserve
5. Discard oil
6. Spray pan with cooking spray , and heat over medium heat
7. Coarsely chop spinach and stalks
8. Working in batches , add damp spinach to the pan
9. Cover , and cook until spinach just begins to wilt , 4 to 5 minutes
10. Transfer the cooked spinach to a metal bowl , and cook remaining spinach
11. Season with salt and pepper
12. Sprinkle reserved garlic over spinach , and serve warm

title: rheinischer sauerbraten
steps:
1. Select a glass bowl just large enough to take the meat with a little space to spare , and combine in it the carrots , parsnip , cloves , sugar , peppercorns , garlic , thyme and wine
2. Then add the meat
3. In a medium-sized pan , bring the vinegar , water , and bay leaf to a boil
4. Then simmer for 10 minutes before removing and cooling slightly
5. Pour the water-vinegar mixture over the meat , , and store refrigerated for 3 to 4 days , turning meat occasionally
6. Remove the beef and pat dry with paper towels
7. Then salt and pepper all sides
8. Melt butter in a large cooking pot and brown beef in it on all sides
9. Pour in the marinade , including solids
10. Stir in tomato paste , cover , and simmer for 1 1 / 2 hours or until meat is tender
11. Remove meat and pour the broth through a fine sieve
12. Return broth to pot , add gingersnaps , apple butter , and raisins
13. Bring to a boil and thicken with prepared thickener
14. Taste and adjust seasoning as necessary
15. Slice meat , pour a little gravy over it , and serve the remaining gravy in a sauce-boat

title: healthy low calorie chocolate biscotti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. In a small bowl , beat the eggs and vanilla together , set aside
3. Combine flour , sugar , baking powder , cocoa and salt in a large bowl
4. Gradually add the egg mixture and beat until dough forms
5. Fold in chocolate chips
6. On a lightly floured surface , roll dough into a log , place log on greased cooking sheet
7. Bake for 20 mins , or until firm to touch
8. Let cool on wire rack for 10 minutes
9. Cut log into 1 / 2 inch thick pieces , assemble on baking sheet
10. Bake for 10-15 mins then flip each piece and bake for 10-15 mins more , remove from oven and enjoy

title: perfect roast potatoes
steps:
1. Cut your peeled potatoes into chunks , approximately the size of an egg
2. Par-boil them in salted water for about 8 minutes
3. Set aside and leave to cool completely
4. Preheat the oven to 400f / 200c / gas 6
5. Pour the oil and dripping into a large roasting tin and place in the hot oven to heat
6. Rough up the sides of the potatoes by scratching them with a fork and season with salt
7. When the oil is hot , carefully place the potatoes in a single layer in the oil
8. Baste or turn over immediately , so they are coated with oil on all sides
9. Roast for 45 minutes , turning at least once
10. After that time , it's up to you to decide whether they are crispy enough or whether to give them another 15 minutes
11. Drain of fat and place on paper towels to absorb more access fat
12. Season again with salt before serving

title: pretty in pink
steps:
1. Pour all ingredients into a shaker with ice
2. Shake
3. Strain into a pretty glass and enjoy !

title: chocolate pecan cheesecake bars
steps:
1. Heat oven 350f
2. Grease 9x13-inch pan
3. In large bowl , combine cake mix , butter , egg
4. Mix at low speed until combined
5. Stir in pecans
6. Reserve 1 cup for topping
7. Press remaining mixture evenly in bottom of greased pan
8. Beat cream cheese in medium bowl until fluffy
9. Add remaining filling ingredients and beat at medium speed until smooth
10. Pour over crust
11. Sprinkle with reserved topping
12. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until center is puffed and edges are lightly browned
13. Cool completely
14. Cut into bars and store in refrigerator
15. Enjoy

title: two toned baked potatoes
steps:
1. Pierce russet and sweet potatoes with a fork
2. Bake at 400 for 60-70 minutes or until tender
3. Set sweet potatoes aside
4. Cut a third off the top of each russet potato
5. Scoop out pulp , leaving skins intact
6. Place pulp in a bowl
7. Mash with 1 / 3 cup sour cream , milk , cheese , 2 tablespoons chives and 3 / 4 teaspoon salt
8. Set aside
9. Cut off the
10. Mash pulp with remaining sour cream , chives and salt
11. Stuff mixture into half of each potato skin
12. Spoon russet potato filling into other half
13. Place on a baking sheet
14. Bake at 350 for 15-20 minutes or until heated through

title: pork chops baked with potatoes and pears
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f
2. Wash , peel , and slice the parsnips into 1 inch thick peices
3. Scrub and slice the potatoes into 1 / 2-inch thick slices
4. Place into a large bowl and coat lightly with olive oil
5. Add 1 / 2 of the thyme , garlic cloves , salt and pepper
6. Pour into a baking dish and bake in the oven for 10-15 minutes
7. While the vegetables are in the oven , mix the remaining thyme , softened butter , and seasoning
8. Rub onto the chops
9. Quarter pears and scoop out the seed center
10. Place the chops and pears in the tray with the parsnips and potatoes
11. Cook about 30 minutes until the meat is tender and the vegetables are golden

title: larb
steps:
1. Cook the ground meat until done and drain
2. Mix the meat with the lime juice , fish sauce , red onions , chili peppers , roasted rice powder and mix well
3. Serve on bed of lettuce and top with sliced green onions and mint leaves
4. May add additional red peppers if you desire it hotter
5. Enjoy

title: spicy shrimp in fresh tomato sauce
steps:
1. In a saucepan over medium heat , melt butter
2. Add the onion , cover , and cook for 7 minutes or until soft but not browned
3. Add in the garlic , tomatoes , oregano , and harissa sauce
4. Simmer , stirring frequently , for 10 minutes
5. Season with salt and pepper to taste
6. Pour the mixture into a baking dish
7. Salt and pepper the shrimp
8. Add the shrimp to the tomato sauce , making sure the shrimp are pushed down into the sauce
9. Bake , uncovered , at 375 for 10 minutes or until the shrimp are pink
10. Garnish with parsley and serve

title: thit kho to    pork in clay pot
steps:
1. Make the caramel by heating the sugar in a small , heavy-based pan over a low heat
2. Stir constantly until it is moist and thick
3. Take off the heat and add the fish sauce
4. Return to a low heat and stir until the sugar dissolves
5. Add the shallots and pepper to the caramel and leave to cool
6. Pour the sauce into a claypot or flameproof casserole
7. Add the pork to the sauce
8. Cover and simmer for about 30 minutes over a low heat , stirring occasionally
9. At the end of cooking , the pork should be in a little rich gravy
10. Serve with the egg if using , spooning the gravy over them

title: sirups kager  danish brown spice cookies
steps:
1. In a medium mixing bowl , cream butter or margarine , sugar and corn syrup
2. When well combined , stir in cinnamon , cloves and baking soda mixture
3. Slowly add flour and mix well after each addition until dough becomes stiff
4. Cover dough with plastic wrap and refrigerate until firm , approximately one hour
5. This time is included in the preparation time
6. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
7. On a floured surface , roll dough to 1 / 8-inch thickness
8. Using a reindeer or desired shaped cookie cutter , cut shapes into dough
9. Dough can also be rolled into logs about 1-inch in diameter and sliced crosswise into 1-inch-thick rounds
10. Bake on ungreased cookie sheets until lightly browned , about 8 to 10 minutes

title: pan seared tuna with avocado  soy  ginger  and lime
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , combine the cilantro , jalapeno , ginger , garlic , lime juice , soy sauce , sugar , salt , pepper , and 1 / 4 cup of olive oil
2. Stir the ingredients together until well incorporated
3. Place a large skillet over medium-high heat and coat with the remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil
4. Season the tuna pieces generously with salt and pepper
5. Lay the tuna in the hot oil and sear for 1 minute to form a slight crust
6. Flip and sear the other side 1 minute
7. Pour half of the cilantro mixture into the pan to coat the fish
8. Transfer the seared tuna to plates and serve with the sliced avocado and the remaining cilantro sauce drizzled over the whole plate

title: easy pan roasted potatoes
steps:
1. Peel potatoes and cut into 1
2. 5in even pieces
3. Place potatoes in a frying pan
4. Pour over 100ml of water
5. Place over high heat until all the water has gone
6. Lower the heat to minimum
7. Add lard
8. Cook gently , stirring occasionally for 30min or until the potatoes are the colour you like

title: ww cuban style pork and sweet potato slow cooker stew
steps:
1. Place potato , pork , tomatoes , garlic , orange juice , scallions , salt , cumin , and pepper in a 4 to 5 qt crock pot , cover and cook on low setting
2. Stir in lime juice and cilantro , cover slow cooker and cook for 5 minutes

title: baked chicken parmesan over pasta
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine sour cream and milk and mix well
3. Pour into a shallow dish in which the chicken can be dipped
4. In a second shallow dish , combine the bread crumbs , parmesan cheese , rosemary , and sage
5. Coat the chicken with the sour cream mixture and then dredge in the bread crumb mixture until well coated
6. Place on a greased baking dish
7. Bake for 25 minutes , or until tender and chicken is cooked through
8. Meanwhile , prepare the spaghetti per the package directions
9. Warm each sauce separately in small pots over the stovetop
10. To serve , divide the pasta evenly between four plates
11. Top the pasta with tomato sauce , and place a piece of chicken on top
12. Drizzle with alfredo sauce and sprinkle with the shredded cheese
13. Garnish with optional parsley

title: charlie s dip
steps:
1. Mix first 6 ingredients together and place in an oven proof casserole dish
2. Sprinkle cheese on top and bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 350
3. Serve hot over chips , this isn't very good cold

title: anise milk   anijsmelk
steps:
1. Heat milk to boiling point , taking care not to scorch
2. Add sugar and anise
3. Serve either hot or cold

title: egg salad for a crowd
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the first seven ingredients
2. Whisk mayonnaise , milk , mustard , salt and pepper until smooth
3. Stir into egg mixure
4. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour
5. Garnish with lettuce , tomatoes and sliced egg if desired
6. For sandwiches , spread about 1 / 3 cupful egg salad on one bread slice
7. Top with another bread slice
8. Yield: 50 sandwiches

title: chana masala in the slow cooker
steps:
1. Combine everything except the chickpeas and basmati rice in your slow cooker and turn on low for 6-8 hours
2. Add chickpeas
3. Cook 2 more hours until they're tender and have incorporated the indian flavors
4. Serve over basmati rice

title: onion tomato blush
steps:
1. Peel the onions and give 2 slits diagonally without letting the layers come off
2. Use of mustard oil is preferred but feel free to use your regular cooking oil if you want
3. Take a heavy bottomed skillet or broad pan with flat bottom
4. Let oil smoke properly if you are using mustard oil
5. Once oil is smoked , lower the heat , wait for the oil to cool down for a minute or so
6. Add all the spices and the salt
7. Take care as not to burn the spices
8. Immediately add onions and tomatoes
9. Keep sauteeing and tossing them on high flame / heat for 10-12 minutes
10. Let them go brown on the edges
11. Do not cover the lid
12. The blush is ready to be served alongside any favourite main course dish of yours

title: apple stuffed sausage patties
steps:
1. Shape sausage into 8- 1 / 4 inch patties
2. Cook celery , and onion in butter until tender , but not brown
3. Remove from heat
4. Add water
5. Add stuffing mix , apple , parsley , chili sauce , mustard , and pepper
6. Mix well
7. Place about 1 / 2 cup of the stuffing on 4 of the patties
8. Top with remaining patties
9. Press around the edges to seal
10. Place in a 13x9x2-inch baking pan
11. Bake in a 375 degree oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until done

title: portuguese fried potatoes    batas a portuguesa
steps:
1. Slice the peeled potatoes into thin rounds , about 5- 10 mm thick
2. Heat the butter and oil in a pan and cook the potatoes slowly on a low heat until cooked though and golden brown
3. Cooking on a low heat ensures an even golden brown colour and less little burnt bits
4. Once cooked though , add the salt , pepper and parsley and mix well though the potatoes
5. Transfer to a heated serving dish and serve immediately with additional parsley for garnish if desired

title: crab dip   baked
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and mix well
2. Pour into a small deep baking dish - good for dipping
3. Bake at 350 degrees for 30-40 minutes
4. Until bubbling
5. Serve hot with sociable crackers - enjoy !

title: quick ginger carrots
steps:
1. Chop carrots on an angle and place in mirowave proof bowl
2. Add other ingredients on top , do not stir
3. Cook for 1 min on high , then stir all ingredients to coat carrots evenly
4. Cook for a further 3 mins on high , then serve
5. Drizzle remaining butter suace over the top of the carrots

title: peppered t bone steaks
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine the steak sauce , thyme , pepper and cayenne
2. Sprinkle steaks on both sides with salt
3. Spoon about 2 teaspoons steak sauce mixture over one side of each steak
4. Place steaks , sauce side down , on grill
5. Grill , covered , over medium heat for 6 minutes
6. Brush steaks with remaining sauce and turn over
7. Grill steaks 4-6 minutes longer or until desired doneness

title: fruit chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degree f
2. In a mixing bowl beat butter with electric mixer on medium speed for 30 seconds
3. Add brown sugar , granulated sugar , and baking soda
4. Beat until combined
5. Beat in eggs and vanilla until combined
6. On low speed beat in as much of the flour as you can with the mixer
7. By hand , stir in remaining flour and granola
8. Stir in remaining ingredients
9. Drop dough by slightly rounded tablespoonfuls 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet
10. Flatten slightly
11. Bake 11 to 13 minutes or until edges are browned
12. Cool on baking sheet for 1 minute
13. Transfer to wire racks
14. Cool

title: baked coconut shrimp with curried apricot sauce
steps:
1. Thaw shrimp if frozen
2. Peel and devein shrimp , leaving tails intact
3. Rinse shrimp , pat with paper towels , set aside
4. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
5. For sauce , in a small bowl combine mayonnaise , apricot preserves , and curry powder
6. Cover and chill until ready to serve
7. Spread the oil on the bottom of a 15x10x1-inch pan
8. Set pan aside
9. In a large shallow dish , combine coconut , cornstarch , sugar , and salt
10. In another small shallow dish place the egg whites
11. Dip shrimp into egg whites
12. Coat with coconut mixture , pressing the mixture firmly onto the shrimp
13. Arrange shrimp in prepared pan
14. Bake in a 400 degree oven about 10 minutes or until shrimp are opaque , and coconut is golden , turning once
15. Serve with sauce

title: chicken on a stick
steps:
1. To make the paste: in a bowl , mix together the garlic , onion , paprika , cumin , lemongrass , basil , thyme , salt , pepper , and cayenne
2. Whisk in the canola oil
3. Rinse the chicken breasts under cold water and pat dry
4. Cut chicken into 1-inch cubes
5. Add to paste mixture
6. Toss to coat evenly
7. Cover with saran wrap and refrigerate for 30-60 minutes
8. To make dipping sauce: mix together the dipping sauce ingredients in a small bowl
9. Add 2 tablespoons water and whisk to combine
10. Pour sauce into individual serving bowls
11. Thread chicken cubes onto skewers
12. Grill over direct medium heat for about 8-10 minutes or until juices run clear (turn once , halfway through grilling time
13. Serve warm w / dipping sauce

title: hot tuna buns
steps:
1. In a bowl , stir together mayo , relish and mustard
2. Add tuna , cheese , celery and onions , stir until well combined
3. Spread tuna mixture evenly over bottom halves of rolls and top with remaining roll halves
4. Wrap each sandwich in foil
5. Place on a baking sheet into a pre-heated 350 oven for 15-20 minutes or until cheese is melted
6. Unwrap and serve immediately

title: speedy chicken stir fry
steps:
1. Cook pasta as directed on package , adding broccoli to the boiling water for the last 3 minutes of the pasta cooking time
2. Meanwhile , spray large nonstick skillet with cooking spray
3. Heat on med-high heat
4. Add chicken
5. Cook 6-8 minutes or until cooked through , stirring occasionally
6. Stir in dressing , soy sauce , ginger , garlic , and crushed red pepper
7. Cook 1 minute , stirring occasionally
8. Drain pasta mixture
9. Place in large bowl
10. Add chicken mixture
11. Mix lightly
12. Spoon evenly into 4 serving bowls
13. Sprinkle with peanuts

title: pounded pork chop for two
steps:
1. If using a thick pork chop , cut through the thick part to make two
2. You want your pork chop to be no more than a half inch thick , and thinner if possible
3. Use a piece of plastic wrap to surround the pork
4. Place it on a board and place the board on a sturdy surface
5. Use a board you don't mind being marked as it might be by the hammer
6. Now , have fun
7. Take out your aggressions on the pork and pound it thin
8. It should have at least doubled in area
9. Beat the egg and spices to create an egg wash
10. Place that in a bowl next to a sheet of plastic wrap or waxed paper with cracker crumbs on it
11. Take each piece of meat and drag it through the egg wash and then coat with cracker crumbs
12. Set aside
13. When the meat is all coated , heat a skillet with some butter / margarine
14. Fry each piece of meat until golden brown on both sides and cooked through
15. Because the meat is thin this should take no more than about three to four minutes on a side
16. Serve

title: moose nose
steps:
1. Place nose in large pot -- hide , hair and all !
2. Boil for 2 hours
3. Don't look in the pot during cooking
4. Cool dish down until you can handle it , then skin the nose without fainting
5. Discard the hide
6. Wash the nose in cold water
7. Place the nose in a pot of clean , cold water
8. Add salt & pepper to your taste , bay leaves , and onions
9. Boil until tender
10. Chill and serve sliced on crackers with a smear of cream cheese

title: 3 ingredient peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Combine the three ingredients , stirring until well blended
3. If using the chocolate chips , stir in now
4. Form dough into small balls , using about a tablespoon of dough
5. Place 12 balls on a cookie sheet , evenly spaced
6. Using a fork , press the tines across the ball to flatten and make a criss-cross pattern
7. Bake about 6-8 minutes , or until lightly browned
8. Remove cookie sheet from oven and let sit for a couple of minutes before removing the cookies
9. They are very delicate when hot and will crumble if you try to remove them too soon
10. Set cookies on rack to cool

title: puffy parmesan pinwheels
steps:
1. Place layer of store-bought puff pastry on a baking sheet
2. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese , chopped black olives , and paprika
3. Roll pastry into a cylinder , cut into 1 / 4-inch-wide slices , and spread out flat side down about 2 inches apart
4. Bake at 425 degrees f for 8 minutes or until golden

title: quick rum sauce
steps:
1. Melt altogether until runny in a glass dish or small jug in microwave
2. Takes about 1 / 2 minute on high depending on wattage of your oven
3. To serve over bananas:
4. Peel & slice lengthways 1 or 2 bananas and fry in a little butter until hot
5. Place in a dish and pour over sauce

title: witch s brew
steps:
1. Combine champagne and orange juice in large punch bowl
2. Scoop sherbet into bowl
3. Add sugar to taste if desired
4. Float peeled grapes in mixture , and garnish bowl with the rest of the grapes
5. Drop in pieces of dry ice for steaming effect , but
6. You can add more or less vodka depending on your preferences , or leave it out completely

title: colorado beef stroganoff
steps:
1. Trim fat from beef and cut into 1 / 2-inch slices
2. Over high heat sear the beef quickly in 1 tablespoon butter
3. In 3 tablespoons butter saute onion , garlic and mushrooms about 5 minutes
4. Remove from heat
5. Stir in flour , meat extract paste , catsup , salt and pepper
6. Stir until smooth
7. Gradually add bouillon , stirring constantly bring to a boil
8. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes
9. Over very low heat , add wine , dill and sour cream
10. Add beef , simmer only until beef is hot
11. Serve over wild rice
12. Serves 6

title: zucchini muffins  cookies  bread
steps:
1. Cream shortening and sugar
2. Add eggs , zucchini and remaining ingredients
3. Mix well
4. Put this into greased muffin tins , greased loaf pans or drop onto cookie sheet
5. Bake cookies 8-10 min 370 , bread and muffins add a little time
6. Bake till golden brown and toothpick inserted comes out clean

title: tomato and bacon rice  quick and french inspired
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a skillet , and add the garlic and onion
2. Sweat them for 30 seconds , then turn the heat up a bit and add the bacon
3. Once the bacon is cooked through , add the cooked rice
4. Sautee the mixture until the rice is heated through and add the can of tomato sauce
5. Cover and allow to cook for a few minutes until the rice has absorbed the liquid
6. Serve !

title: drunken pork roast
steps:
1. Marinate pork loin in wine , garlic and herbs overnight
2. Place pork in a a large covered roasting pan (i used a three quart casserole , but if you want to add a few extra veggies , you may want to go bigger
3. Arrange vegetables around the roast
4. Pour the marinade over roast and vegetables
5. Cover and bake at 350f for 1 1 / 2- 2 hours
6. Remove cover and continue baking for another 1 / 2 hour

title: creamy hot beef dip
steps:
1. Combine first eight ingredients in a 1 quart baking dish
2. Bake at 375 degrees , uncovered , for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly
3. Serve with veggies and / or crackers

title: svella culla  pickled fish
steps:
1. Fillet fish , remove skin , slice thin , layer into an open container with plenty of coarse salt between layers and a thick layer on top
2. Cover with a tea towel or a breathable cloth , you do not want to put a plastic lid or saran wrap on it as the liquid needs to evaporate off
3. Leave for at least a month
4. After a month dump the whole works into the sink and rinse , rinse , rinse , i let the water run into the container for an hour or so
5. Cut into strips
6. Make up the brine and make sure it cools well
7. You do not want to cook the fish by adding hot brine
8. Layer in a glass gallon jar with onions , add the cooled brine
9. Set in the fridge for a couple of weeks and enjoy !

title: banana bread pudding
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Place bread cubes into greased 2-quart casserole
3. Pour butter over and toss to coat
4. In medium bowl , lightly beat eggs
5. Add the milk , sugar , vanilla , cinnamon , nutmeg and salt
6. Stir in the bananas
7. Pour over bread and stir to coat
8. Bake uncovered for 40 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean
9. While baking , melt butter in a small saucepan
10. Combine sugar and cornstarch
11. Add to butter
12. Stir in milk and corn syrup
13. Cook , stirring , over medium heat until mixture comes to a full boil
14. Boil 1 minute then remove from heat
15. Stir in vanilla
16. Serve warm over warm pudding

title: hot and fast german potato salad
steps:
1. Boil your potatoes in hot salted water
2. Drain when just done and immediately add the onion
3. Then add your salad dressing
4. Toss until coated
5. Eat warm and enjoy

title: brunch casserole
steps:
1. Mix croutons and cheese
2. Put into greased 2 qt casserole
3. Whisk eggs , milk , mustard , salt and pepper well
4. Pour over croutons
5. Sprinkle with bacon
6. Bake , uncovered at 325 for 45 minutes , or until set

title: sweet potato trta
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease a 9 " - deep dish - pie plate or round 2 quart baking dish with butter
3. Combine zest , juice , cream , honey , cinnamon , and tarragon in medium saucepan and bring just to boil
4. Reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes
5. Remove from heat and discard cinnamon sticks
6. Layer potatoes in pie plate or dish , pouring some cream mixture over each layer and seasoning each layer with salt and pepper
7. Pour any remaining liquid over last layer of potatoes
8. Bake 1 to 1 hours , until potatoes are tender and liquid has been absorbed
9. Cut into wedges and serve

title: strawberry margaritas
steps:
1. Squeeze the juice from all four limes into the pitcher of a blender
2. Add strawberries , powdered sugar , tequilla , and triple sec
3. Puree mixture
4. Stir and add ice , if desired

title: mashed sweet potatoes   parsnips
steps:
1. Combine sweet potatoes and parsnips in large saucepan
2. Cover with cold water
3. Bring to a boil over high heat
4. Reduce heat
5. Simmer , uncovered , 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender
6. Drain vegetables
7. Return to pan
8. Add milk , butter , salt and nutmeg
9. Mash potato mixture to desired consistency over low heat
10. Stir in chives

title: indonesian cucumber salad
steps:
1. Peel the cucumbers , cut in half and remove the seeds
2. Half them again and slice them up in approx 1 / 2 inch pieces
3. Mix with all the other ingredients , cover and put in the fridge for at least an hour
4. Take it out of the fridge and taste , if you want to , add more limejuice , sugar or sambal oelek

title: oven baked rice
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients into a glass oven dish with a lid
2. Bake at 375 f for 45 minutes
3. Tada !

title: banana bread walnuts
steps:
1. 1
2. Place the walnuts in a medium size mixing bowl
3. Blend the bananas , raw honey , cinnamon and sea salt in a blender
4. Blend until smooth
5. 2
6. Pour banana mixture into the bowl with the walnuts and stir until the walnuts are evenly coated
7. Spread this mixture on a teflex lined dehydrator sheet , dehydrate on 105 degrees for 24 hours
8. 3
9. Store banana bread walnuts in a mason jar and enjoy on their own or as cereal with almond milk

title: mexican melon   cucumber salad salsa
steps:
1. Take one of the melons , peel it and dice it
2. In a large non metal bowl , combine the 1 cantaloupe , papaya , cucumber , chopped mint , lime juice& honey , mix gently set the 4 remaining cantaloupe halves in 4 bowls and fill with the fruit mixture cover and refrigerate until ready to serve

title: oatmeal buttermilk pancakes
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine the first 6 dry ingredients
2. In another smaller bowl whisk together buttermilk , eggs , melted butter and vanilla until well blended
3. Add to the dry ingredients , whisk until blended
4. Cover and chill for a minimum of 2 hours or overnight
5. Heat oil in a skillet
6. Drop about 1 / 4 cup of batter into the skillet
7. Cook the pancakes until the bottoms are golden brown and bubbles form on top
8. Turn the pancakes over and cook until the bottoms are golden brown , brushing the skillet with more oil or butter if necessary

title: lemon mint lamb chops
steps:
1. Grill chops until tender
2. While chops are under the grill , prepare the sauce:
3. Melt butter in pan
4. Add finely chopped onion , saute until tender
5. Add lemon rind , lemon juice , sugar and mint , heat gently
6. Spoon over hot chops
7. Cheers , doreen doreen randal , wanganui , new zealand

title: mean chef s pecan cardamom sand cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. I an electric mixer cream butter , shortening , both sugars and vanilla until mixture is well combined
3. Sift dry ingredients together and add to mixer along with chopped pecans
4. Combine well
5. Either use a small portion scoop or roll pieces of dough into 1 - 2-inch balls
6. Arrange on parchment-lined sheet pan
7. Place a pecan half on top of each round , sprinkle with a little sugar and press down with the bottom of a glass to flatten to about 1 / 4-inch thick
8. Bake until very pale golden
9. Cool

title: crispy ginger lime chicken thighs
steps:
1. Arrange chicken on baking sheet , add salt and pepper
2. Mix sauce ingredients in a small dish
3. Divided equally underneath chicken skin
4. Bake at 350 30-40 minutes or until internal temperature reaches 165f

title: bourbon sauce for bread pudding and bread pudding souffl
steps:
1. In a medium bowl or the bowl of your electric mixer combine eggs , yolks and sugar , whisk to combine
2. Place your mixing bowl over a pan of hot water over low heat and stir continuously until it reaches 165f
3. I like to start the water off at well below the boiling point and slowly raise the temperature until it's just shy of boiling
4. Do not whisk this mixture too much at this stage or you will incorporate too much air and take too long to heat
5. If water starts to boil or you see steam coming off your mixture remove from the heat for a few seconds and whisk
6. Getting this mixture too hot will cause eggs to cook
7. After desired temperature is reached , use the whip attachment for your electric mixer and beat on high speed until thick and cooled to just warm to the touch
8. Beat in vanilla and optional bourbon , serve asap
9. The mixture will keep in the fridge for a day or so before it starts to separate
10. Variations: use rum , flavored liqueur or various extracts in lieu of bourbon

title: greek big beans
steps:
1. Let the oil get heated in a skillet over medium heat
2. Add in the onion
3. Cover and cook about 5 minutes or until onion is soft
4. Add in garlic
5. Stir / saute for 1 minute or until softened
6. Transfer vegetable mixture to a 4-quart slow cooker
7. Add in the beans , tomatoes with liquid , and salt / pepper to taste
8. Stir to combine
9. Cover and cook on low for 4-6 hours
10. Just before ready to serve , add in the parsley
11. Stir to combine

title: easy  creamy  no bake chocolate pie
steps:
1. Melt chocolate and 2 tbsp
2. Of the milk in double boiler over low heat until chocolate is almost melted
3. Stir until chocolate is completely melted
4. Beat melted chocolate , cream cheese , sugar and remaining milk with mixer until well blended
5. Refrigerate about 10 minutes to cool
6. Gently stir in whipped topping until smooth
7. Spoon into crust
8. Place pie in freezer at least 4 hours or until firm
9. Pie can be garnished with additional whipped topping and chocolate curls , but it tastes terrific plain too
10. Let it stand at room temperature or in refrigerator about 15 minutes or until pie can be cut easily
11. Store leftover pie in freezer

title: bbq or griddled peaches
steps:
1. Halve the peaches and remove and discard the stones
2. Cut the peaches into thick slices
3. There's no need to remove the skins but you can if you wish to
4. Heat the oil
5. Add the peaches and cook 3-5 minutes on each side
6. They should start to caramelise
7. Sprinkle with the toasted nuts and serve
8. You can drizzle a little maple syrup around the plate if you wish

title: almost vegetarian vegetable soup
steps:
1. In a heavy stock pot , melt butter and saute onions until they are clear
2. Add broth and bring to a boil
3. Add potatoes and carrots
4. Let cook at a boil until veggies are tender
5. Add corn , and , again , bring to a boil
6. Add all remaining ingredients
7. Allow to cook together for another 10 - 15 minutes
8. Serve with corn bread or other good bread , or fix rice to add to your soup bowls

title: garlic spinach with white beans
steps:
1. Heat a large skillet
2. Add oil
3. Saut garlic 1 minute
4. Add all the spinach
5. Lower heat to med and cover
6. Cook just long enough to wilt spinach
7. Add beans & stock and heat through
8. Serve

title: almond cream  crema di mandorle
steps:
1. Lightly grease a baking sheet
2. Set aside
3. Melt butter in a small skillet over low heat
4. Add sugar
5. Cook until golden brown , stirring constantly
6. Stir in almonds
7. Spread almond mixture on greased baking sheet
8. Cool completely
9. Crush into crumbs
10. In a medium bowl , whip cream until stiff
11. Fold in brandy or liqueur
12. Reserve some of the crumbled almond mixture to sprinkle over the top of dessert
13. Fold remaining crumbs into whipped cream
14. Spoon into 4 to 6 dessert dishes
15. Sprinkle with reserved almond crumb mixture
16. Refrigerate until set

title: shrimp rice
steps:
1. Marinate the shrimp with salt , pepper , 1 tsp of cumin , and the crushed garlic , let rest for an hour
2. Bring water to boil in a large pot , add the shrimp and boil for about 2 minutes
3. Remove the shrimp from the water and reserve 3 cups of the water they cooked in to prepare the rice
4. Remove the shells and tails from the shrimp
5. Leave the tails on a few of the shrimp that will be used as a garnish
6. Chop the shrimp that are not being used for the garnish
7. Heat the oil in a large saucepan or pot , add the minced garlic , cook for about 2-3 minutes on medium heat
8. Add the rice to the garlic and oil , mix well until the rice is coated with oil
9. Add the 2 cups of water that was used to boil the shrimp
10. Bring to boil and reduce heat to low
11. In the meantime , melt the butter over medium heat in a large saut pan
12. Add the onions , peppers , tomatoes , parsley , ground achiote , salt , pepper , and remaining 1 tsp of cumin
13. Cook for about 10 minutes , stirring often
14. Add the white wine to the vegetable mix and continue cooking for another 5 minutes , until the onions and peppers are tender
15. Mix in the sauted vegetables and chopped shrimp with the rice , which should still be cooking , and cook on low heat until the rice is tender
16. Add the remaining shrimp during the last minutes and mix well
17. Taste and add salt and pepper if needed
18. Sprinkle with chopped parsley and garnish with shrimp with tails on
19. Serve with avocado slices , tomato and onion curtido salad , lime slices , and of course some good aji or hot sauce

title: buffalo chicken spread
steps:
1. Melt cream cheese and blend with salad dressing until smooth
2. Spread chicken in 9 x 12 baking dish
3. Pour hot sauce over chicken
4. Pour cream cheese / dressing mixture over all
5. Cover with foil and bake 20 minutes at 350 degrees
6. Remove foil , top with cheese and bake an additional ten minutes

title: chicken corn chowder soup
steps:
1. In a large pot cook salted chicken parts in a little oil
2. Until fully cooked
3. Remove from pot and remove skin
4. And dice
5. Add onion until cooked
6. Sprinkle 1-2 tbsp flour and lightly brown
7. On medium heat , add 1 cup milk
8. Add bullion
9. Cook until it thickens
10. Add 1 cup milk or water
11. Cook until thickened
12. Add can of cream corn and diced potatoes
13. Add salt and pepper to taste
14. Cook down until correct thickness , 1 hour

title: linzer torte  wheat free  no refined sugar
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine flour , almonds , cinnamon and salt in a medium bowl
3. Set aside
4. Beat honey , butter and lemon peel in a large bowl with electric mixer
5. Beat in egg until well blended
6. Beat in flour mixture at low speed until well blended
7. Spoon 2 / 3 of dough onto bottom of 10-inch tart pan with removable bottom
8. Pat dough evenly over bottom and up side of pan
9. Spread jam over bottom of dough
10. Roll remaining 1 / 3 of dough on lightly floured surface into 10x6-inch rectangle
11. Cut into narrow strips and arrange in a lattice design over jam
12. Bake 25 minutes or until crust is golden brown
13. Cool completely on wire rack
14. Serve at room temperature

title: couscous with three peppers
steps:
1. In a saucepan , cook bell peppers , onion and jalapeno in oil until tender
2. Season to taste with salt and pepper
3. Add vegetable broth and bring to a boil
4. Add couscous and return to a boil
5. Remove from heat and let stand for 5 minutes , covered
6. Stir in tomato and parsley and fluff with fork

title: twice baked sweet potatoes with leeks and sausage
steps:
1. Heat the oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit
2. Prick the sweet potatoes with the
3. Bake for 1 hour , or until completely tender
4. In a medium skillet over medium high heat , crumble the sausage
5. Cook until all trace of pink is gone
6. It doesn't need to be brown , just cooked through
7. Drain any excess fat and set aside
8. In the same pan , melt the butter over medium low heat
9. Add the leeks , sage , and thyme
10. Cook until the leeks are soft and starting to turn golden
11. Remove the leeks from the pan and set aside with the sausage
12. Cut the sweet potatoes in half lengthwise
13. Carefully scoop the flesh into a mixing bowl , leaving 1 / 8 inch of flesh around the edge , so the skin will not fall apart when you fill it
14. Place the empty skins on a baking sheet
15. Preheat broiler , placing the rack about 6 inches from the heat
16. Mash the sweet potato flesh until smooth
17. Add the sour cream and kosher salt , mixing to combine
18. Add the sausage and leeks and mix well
19. Taste for seasoning , and add more salt if needed
20. Scoop the sweet potato mixture back into the skins
21. Top with the grated cheese
22. Place in the oven and broil until the cheese starts to brown , about 4 to 5 minutes
23. Remove from oven
24. Cut each potato in half to make two servings

title: russian creme
steps:
1. Combine sugar , water , and gelatin in small saucepan and blend well
2. Let stand 4 to 5 minutes
3. Place over medium heat and bring to boil , stirring constantly
4. Remove from heat
5. Gradually blend in cream
6. Combine creme fraiche and vanilla in medium bowl
7. Gradually add hot sugar mixture , whisking constantly until smooth
8. Pour into 6 or 8 wine glasses or desert dishes
9. Cover and refrigerate 4 to 6 hours
10. Garnish with sliced strawberries and blueberries

title: bisquick pizza pull apart bread
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425 degrees
2. Grease square pan 9x9
3. Sautee the onion and bell pepper in the oil until the mixture is translucent
4. Mix bisquick , tomatoes , half of the cheese and milk in a medium bowl until a dough forms
5. Mix remaining cheese , pepper and onion mixture , pepperoni and pizza sauce in a small bowl
6. Drop half the dough by tablespoonfuls closely together in the pan
7. Spoon half the cheese mixture over dough
8. Drop remaining doug over the cheese mixture
9. Top with the remaining cheese mixture
10. Bake about 20-25 minutes until golden brown
11. Serve warm

title: ground beef   cabbage stew
steps:
1. Brown ground beef and drain
2. Set aside
3. Heat olive oil in skillet and add onion and cook 2-3 minutes
4. Add cabbage , tomatoes , potatoes , carrots , bell pepper , thyme
5. Mix well
6. Add broth
7. Heat to boiling
8. Reduce heat
9. Cover and cook 20 minutes
10. Stir in corn and beans
11. Cover and cook 15 minutes

title: key west cream pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease or spray with non-stick cooking spray an 8-inch cake pan and set aside
3. In a small mixing bowl , mix together the flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
4. Set aside
5. In a large mixing bowl , cream butter and sugar and beat until blended
6. Beat in the egg , lime zest , and juice
7. Alternately stir into the creamed mixture the flour mixture and buttermilk mixing well
8. Pour batter into prepared pan and bake for about 35 to 40 minutes or until wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
9. Allow cake to cool in pan for 5 minutes , turn cake out onto cooling rack and allow to cool completely
10. For the raspberry cream , on medium speed of mixer , beat the cream cheese and powdered sugar together , add milk , and vanilla
11. Gently fold raspberry preserves and pecans into cream mixture
12. For the chocolate ganache , melt chocolate , cream & butter in double boiler over boiling water until melted and smooth
13. Add vanilla , and whisk to combine
14. To assemble , when the sponge cake is completely cool , cut in half with a bread knife to form 2 equal layers
15. Remove "top" and spread bottom of cake with the raspberry cream , replace top and pour chocolate ganache over top allowing it to drip down the sides of cake
16. Garnish with fresh raspberries and / or strawberries if desired
17. Please

title: five minute butter bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Line a med
3. Cookie sheet with foil , then spray the foil with cooking spray
4. Lay the crackers flat on the foil , covering it as completely as you can
5. You may substitute with keebler crackers , or even soda crackers
6. It doesn't matter if they fit tightly together
7. Sprinkle the slivered almonds over top
8. Melt the butter in a saucepan , then add the brown sugar
9. Bring to a boil , the cook over med
10. Heat for 5 min's
11. Remove from heat , add 1 teaspoons vanilla , then pour the mixture over the crackers in the pan
12. Bake at 350 for 5 min's
13. Remove from oven and sprinkle with choc
14. Chips
15. This is optional , as the bars are delicious without the chocolate
16. Cool , and slice

title: tofu rice salad
steps:
1. Marinate tofu in soy sauce , garlic , ginger and cayenne pepper for 30 minutes to 24 hours
2. Whisk rice vinegar , olive oil , and pepper together
3. Steam broccoli and snow peas briefly until tender-crisp
4. Toss everything together and refrigerate until cold

title: rice  krispies treats lollipops
steps:
1. In a large saucepan or large microwavable bowl , melt butter and marshmallows
2. Stir until smooth
3. Remove from heat and stir in the cereal until it is evenly coated
4. Let the mixture cool for about 15 minutes or so , giving it a stir once in awhile
5. Butter you hands and then shape the treats into 2 inch balls , pressing gently so they are compact , not loose
6. Push a stick into each ball and set aside to cool
7. Melt the chocolate in the microwave or double boiler and stir until smooth
8. Dip the top of the treat balls into the chocolate and then sprinkle with the candy or sugar sprinkles
9. Lay on a wax paper lined tray until chocolate is hardened
10. For bake sales or potlucks , wrap each treat in plastic and tie with curling ribbon

title: corn chowder with shrimp
steps:
1. Let frozen corn stand at room temperature to thaw slightly
2. In 4-quart saucepan , heat oil over medium heat
3. Cook onion , bell pepper , celery and garlic in oil , stirring frequently , until tender
4. Add broth , potato , thyme and ground red pepper
5. Heat to boiling
6. Reduce heat
7. Cover and simmer 10 minutes
8. Remove frozen corn from pouch
9. Add corn to mixture in saucepan
10. Heat to boiling , stirring frequently to break up frozen corn
11. Using wire whisk , stir flour into milk until smooth
12. Stir into mixture in saucepan
13. Heat to boiling
14. Reduce heat
15. Simmer uncovered about 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender and soup is thickened
16. Stir in shrimp
17. Cook 1 to 2 minutes or until hot

title: lemon and ricotta mini cheesecakes
steps:
1. 1
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
3. Have a large pan and a kettle of water
4. 2
5. Mix cream cheese with flour and sugar untill smooth w / electric mixer on medium speed
6. Add eggs one at a time , stir in ricotta , milk , vanilla , lemon zest , and kemon juice
7. Pour in the custard cups or ramekins
8. 3
9. Set each cup in the pan
10. 4
11. Place pan in the oven , pour enough of the boiling water in the pan to reach halfway up the sides of cups
12. Bake untill cheesecakes are set , and no longer jiggly in the middles
13. Remove the pan from oven , but leave the cheesecakes in the water for about 15 minutes
14. Remove the cups from the pan , set on a wire rack untill completely cool
15. Cover each one individually and refrigerate for at least 4 hours
16. 5
17. Top each cheesecake with berries and mint or cookie crumbs (i use strawberry slices , blueberries and raspberries w / mint leaves , color is beautiful as the cakes will have a slightly yellow color

title: salted peanut chews
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a large bowl , combine the flour , brown sugar , butter , egg yolks , vanilla , baking powder , baking soda and salt
3. Beat mixture with an electric mixer until crumbly
4. Firmly press the mixture into the bottom of a 13x9x2-inch baking pan
5. Bake for 12-15 minutes
6. Immediately sprinkle the marshmallows over the surface
7. Return to the oven for 1 to 2 minutes
8. Remove from oven
9. Let cool
10. In a large saucepan , stir together the peanut butter chips , corn syrup , butter and vanilla
11. Cook over low heat , stirring constantly , until the chips are melted and the mixture is smooth
12. Remove from heat
13. Stir in the rice cereal and peanuts
14. Immediately spread the cereal mixture over the marshmallow layer
15. Cover and refrigerate about 2 hours
16. Cut into bars

title: quick  n healthy vegetarian taco soup
steps:
1. Saute onions , green pepper , and crumbles together
2. Add rest of ingredients
3. Simmer until cooked through
4. For vegan do not use the butter

title: boo beverage
steps:
1. In four batches , process the orange juice , milk , sherbet and bananas in a blender until smooth
2. Pour into glasses
3. Cut a hole in the corner of a pastry or plastic bag
4. Fill with whipped topping
5. Pipe a ghost shape on top of each beverage
6. Position chocolate chips for eyes

title: hoisin glazed cornish hen
steps:
1. Pre-heat oil in a pot large enough to fit a cornish hen comfortably , to about 350 degrees
2. Thoroughly wash and pat cornish hen dry to avoid unnecessary spatter , and carefully ease into hot oil
3. Cook for 8-10 minutes on each side until you see that it is turning slightly golden brown around the edges and crispy
4. Remove and place on cooling rack
5. In a small bowl , prepare glaze by mixing together first 4 ingredients , adding red pepper flakes to your heat preference
6. Baste entire hen liberally with the glaze
7. Pop in pre-heated oven at 350 degrees for about 8 minutes or until it gets crispy
8. Flip over , and re-baste bottom of hen , and put back in oven for another 8 minutes to crisp up the other side
9. Let rest before serving
10. You can cut into quarters for 2 servings , or serve whole
11. Serve alongside steamed veggies and / or jasmine rice for a complete meal !

title: avocado tortilla chip rounds
steps:
1. Peel , pit& mash the avocado- keep the pit to place in the mixture to help keep it from browning
2. Add spice , lime juice& tabasco to the avocado
3. Mix well
4. Cover& chill until ready to serve
5. Spread the avocado mixture on the 20 tortilla chips
6. Slice cherry tomatoes and place a slice on each chip
7. Serve

title: new chef mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Boil 1 gallon of water in a 2 gallon cooking pot , covered
2. Do not add salt
3. Meanwhile , peel the potatoes and then cut each in half
4. Rinse them and drop them into a bowl of cold tap water
5. When the water begins a good rolling boil , drain the potatoes from the cool water and drop them into the pot
6. Cover the pot until it begins to re-boil , then remove the lid and reduce the heat until the potatoes are cooking at a low boil , uncovered
7. When the potatoes are "fork-tender , " drain them in a colander and return them to the pot
8. Cut in the two sticks of butter , add the salt and pepper , and then begin mashing the potatoes with a hand masher
9. When the potatoes are pretty well mashed , begin adding the milk , 1 / 4 cup at a time , and stir until the desired consistency is achieved
10. You may not end up using the entire cup , or , you may end up using a bit more -- potato moisture varies widely
11. If you get them too thin , just re-warm them over very low heat , stirring frequently , uncovered , until they stiffen back up
12. Serve hot
13. Honestly , i like the basic recipe , with no additions , the best

title: easy apple  streusel coffee cake
steps:
1. Combine the streusel mixture in a med
2. Size bowl , and with 2 knifes or your hands combine until you have nice medium-size clumps
3. Set aside
4. Combine the cake ingredients in a mixing bowl and stir well with a fork until combined
5. Pour into a greased 9x13 pan and bake at 350f for 15 minutes
6. Remove from oven and cover top with the streusel mixture
7. Return to bake for 30 more minutes

title: mexican vegetable roll ups
steps:
1. In small bowl , beat cream cheese , sour cream and taco seasoning mix until well blended
2. Stir in corn , beans , cilantro , tomato , green chilis and salsa
3. Spread cream cheese mixture over each tortilla to edges
4. Roll up each
5. Cut off tapered ends
6. Wrap each tortilla roll in plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 1 hour but no longer than 8 hours
7. To serve , cut each roll into 1-inch slices
8. Garnish with cilantro sprigs

title: pork stir fry
steps:
1. Combine cornstarch , soya sauce , vinegar , honey and garlic together
2. Add sliced pork and marinate a few hours:this can be done on the morning
3. Refrigerate
4. Remove meat from marinade
5. Heat wok or large frypan on high
6. Add oil , ginger and pork
7. Stir fry until golden brown
8. Remove meat
9. Add onion , celery , pepper , mushrooms and broccoli
10. Stir fry for 2-3 minutes
11. Add chicken broth , marinade , pork and beansprouts
12. Stir on high until vegetables are tender crisp
13. Recipe can be easily doubled

title: weetabix honey muffins
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees
2. Grease muffin cups or use paper baking cups
3. In a large mixing bowl , combine flour , baking soda , salt , and allspice
4. Stir in the weetabix and sugar
5. Mix the yogurt and milk together in separate bowl and beat in the egg , melted butter , and honey
6. Mix the wet ingredients into the dry until just combined
7. Scoop batter into the muffin cups and sprinkle a little more brown sugar on top of the batter
8. Bake 20-25 minutes or until the miffins have risen and are golden brown
9. Turn out onto a rack to cool or serve warm for breakfast with yogurt and fruit

title: lamb  with garlic   fava beans
steps:
1. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in large dutch oven
2. Add half of cubed lamb & brown well on all sides
3. Remove meat from pan , set aside & brown the rest of the lamb the same way
4. Remove meat from pan & set aside
5. Heat remaining 2 tbsp of olive oil in the same pan , add chopped onion & cook for approx 5 min till soft
6. Return meat to pan with any drippings accumulated & combine w / onions
7. Add whole garlic cloves , bay leaf , paprika & dry sherry
8. Bring to a slow boil , reduce heat , cover tightly & simmer very gently for 1 1 / 2 hrs till tender
9. Add fava beans 10 min b4 end of cooking time
10. Remove garlic cloves + bay leaf , season w / salt & pepper to taste & stir in fresh parsley just b4 serving
11. I used fava beans & did not peel their wrinkled skin before serving as the pic showed them unpeeled
12. Just to ck , i peeled a few & found i preferred them peeled for any future efforts
13. I worried a bit about the apparent shortage of liquid , but that was unfounded as there was plenty of the rich brown sauce

title: pecos pasta
steps:
1. Prepare macaroni , drain
2. In large skillet , melt butter
3. Add green pepper , and onion and cook until tender
4. Add chili , corn , and seasonings
5. Simmer on low heat 5 minutes
6. Stir in macaroni and top with cheese
7. Cover and heat on low 5 minutes

title: captain d s batter dipped fish
steps:
1. In a bowl mix the yeast and beer
2. In another bowl beat together the egg , hot water and salt
3. Add the egg mixture to the beer
4. Slowly beat in the flour until batter is consistency of light pancake batter
5. Roll or dust fish with flour
6. Drop fish into batter and cover thoroughly
7. Fry in hot oil
8. Drain on baking rack or broiling pan

title: meatless   veggie spaghetti
steps:
1. In frying pan heat olive oil and add onion , celery and bell pepper and saute until they start to soften
2. In large pot combine tomatoes , sauce , carrots , zucchini , mushrooms and olives , seasoning and herbs and then add sauted veggies to it
3. Bring to a boil , reduce to low and simmer until veggies are done
4. In a pot , bring salted water to boil
5. Enough to cover spaghetti squash
6. Cut squash in half and scoop out seeds then drop carefully into boiling water
7. Boil approximately 20-25 minutes until inside meat is tender
8. Remove squash and with a fork , scrape sides of squash removing the pasta like strands into a bowl
9. Pour sauce over squash and garnish with parmesan cheese

title: poulet dijon  dijon chicken
steps:
1. Pound 2 or 3 chicken breasts till thin
2. Dredge in a mixture of flour , salt , and pepper
3. Saute in oil until brown on both sides
4. Remove chicken and keep warm
5. Sauce: deglaze pan with 1 / 2 cup white wine
6. Allow to reduce
7. Add 2 tablespoons of dijon mustard
8. Stir
9. Add 3 / 4 cup of heavy cream
10. Simmer gently for a few minutes and serve poured over chicken

title: mexican chicken rice bake
steps:
1. Blend cottage cheese , cream cheese and sour cream until smooth
2. Add mixture to remaining ingredients except corn chips
3. Pour mixture into a shallow 2 qt
4. Baking dish
5. Sprinkle with tortilla chips
6. Bake at 350 for 25-30 minutes or till heated throughout

title: baked polenta with mushrooms and gorgonzola
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Bring 4 1 / 2 cups water to a boil
3. Whisking constantly , slowly add the polenta
4. Add 1 1 / 2 teaspoons of the salt and the butter
5. Reduce heat and simmer , stirring frequently , for 10 to 15 minutes
6. Stir in the cream cheese and 1 / 2 cup of the gorgonzola
7. Meanwhile , in a large skillet , over medium-high heat , warm 2 tablespoons of the oil
8. Add half the mushrooms and cook for 6 minutes
9. Add half the shallots and cook for 2 minutes more
10. Transfer to a plate
11. Repeat with the remaining oil , mushrooms , and shallots
12. Season the mushrooms with the pepper , thyme , and the remaining salt
13. Butter an 8 or 9-inch baking dish or eight 6-ounce ramekins
14. Stir 2 / 3 of the mushrooms into the polenta and transfer to the prepared dish or ramekins
15. Top with the remaining mushrooms and gorgonzola
16. Bake , uncovered , until the gorgonzola has melted , about 15 minutes

title: kathy s scalloped potatoes with ham
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. In a saucepan , melt butter
3. Stir in flour , parsley , salt , thyme , and pepper
4. Gradually add all of the milk
5. Bring to a boil
6. Cook and stir for 2 minutes
7. Set pan aside
8. Combine in a large bowl the potatoes , ham , and onion
9. Place half in a greased 2 1 / 2 quart baking dish
10. Top with half of the sauce
11. Put in rest of potato mixture
12. And then put in last half of the sauce
13. Cover and bake at 375 degrees for 65 to 75 minutes or until potatoes are almost tender
14. Bake uncovered , 15-20 minutes longer , or until potatoes are fully cooked
15. If you need to have an oven at 325 degrees b / c of the rest of the meal , cook 2 hours covered and then 15 minutes uncovered

title: creamy red potato salad
steps:
1. Cut potatoes into 1 / 2-inch chunks
2. Place in a medium saucepan
3. Add water to cover
4. Bring to a boil
5. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until tender
6. Drain and cool
7. Combine potato , celery , chopped green onions , pimiento , and hard boiled eggs , if using , in a large bowl
8. Toss gently
9. Combine mayonnaise and next 9 ingredients
10. Stir well
11. Add to potato mixture , tossing gently to coat
12. Cover and chill
13. Sprinkle with paprika to garnish
14. Enjoy !

title: beef and vegetable stew
steps:
1. Wipe and trim the meat and cut into 1 1 / 2" cubes
2. Season the flour with the salt and pepper and toss the pieces of meat until evenly coated
3. Peel and slice the onions
4. Heat the oil in a heavy based saucepan and fry the onions until transparent
5. Add the meat and fry until browned all over
6. Then add the remaining flour
7. Gradually add the beef broth and bring to a boil , stirring constantly
8. Add the tomato paste , bay leaf , and season with a little salt and pepper
9. Reduce heat , cover and simmer for 1 hour
10. Meanwhile , scrape the carrots and peel the potatoes and parsnips
11. Cut all into bite-sized chunks and add to the meat
12. Cover and simmer for a further 30 minutes
13. Taste and adjust seasonings
14. Stir in peas and simmer for another 10 minutes , then serve

title: chicken kabobs with thai dipping sauce
steps:
1. Thread chicken , cucumber , tomatoes and onions alternately on metal skewers
2. Set aside
3. To prepare thai dipping sauce:
4. Combine teriyaki baste & glaze sauce , hot sauce , peanut butter , orange juice concentrate and garlic
5. Mix well
6. Reserve 2 / 3 cup sauce for dipping
7. Brush skewers with some of the remaining sauce
8. Grill kabobs on an oiled rack over hot heat for 10 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink , turning and basting often with remaining sauce
9. Serve skewers with thai dipping sauce
10. Enjoy !

title: orange and chocolate bread   abm
steps: 1. Add all ingredients in the order suggested by your bread machine manual and process on the bread cycle recommended in the manual

title: bayou buffalo wings
steps:
1. In a bowl , blend all of the dry ingredients for the breading
2. In a separate bowl , make the egg wash by blending the eggs and milk
3. Add the chicken and coat well
4. Place coated chicken in breading and toss
5. Place the breaded chicken in a deep fryer or in pot that has enough hot 350 f oil to cover chicken
6. Cook until golden brown
7. In a large bowl , mix all ingredients for the sauce and toss in cooked chicken , mix well

title: quick cajun chops
steps:
1. Combine paprika , salt , sage , cayenne , and black peppers and garlic powder
2. Coat chops well on both sides with the seasoning mixture
3. Heat butter over high heat just until it starts to brown
4. Put chops in pan , reduce heat to medium
5. Fry on both sides until dark brown , about 6 to 8 minutes

title: gluten free tater tot casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Brown the hamburger and drain
3. While the hamburger is cooking , combine the soup and the sour cream
4. Combine the soup mixture with the cooked hamburger
5. Spread the beef mixture at the bottom of a lightly greased 9x13 pan
6. Top with an even layer of tater tots , pressing the tater tots slightly into the beef mixture
7. Bake for about 45 minutes or until tater tots are brown
8. Remove from oven , top with desired amount of shredded cheddar , and continue to bake until cheese is bubbling and tater tots are all heated through

title: southwestern cornbread salad
steps:
1. Prepare the cornbread according to directions on package
2. Cool and crumble
3. Set aside
4. Mix ranch salad dressing mix with the buttermilk and mayonnaise
5. Set aside
6. Layer a large bowl with half each of cornbread , lettuce , tomatoes , beans , corn , bell peppers , cheese , bacon bits and green onions
7. Spoon half of dressing evenly over the top
8. Repeat layers with remaining ingredients and dressing
9. Cover and chill at least 2 hours
10. Enjoy !

title: greek style ravioli
steps:
1. Cook ravioli according to package directions
2. Meanwhile , in a small skillet , cook beef over medium heat until no longer pink
3. Drain
4. Stir in tomatoes
5. Bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat
7. Simmer , uncovered , for 10 minutes
8. Drain ravioli
9. Add the ravioli , spinach and olives to the beef mixture
10. Heat through
11. Sprinkle with feta cheese

title: my favorite peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter , shortening and sugars
2. Add the eggs and blend well
3. Add the peanut butter and vanilla
4. Add all dry ingredients until well blended
5. Roll tablespoonfuls of dough into balls and place 3 inches apart on lightly greased baking sheets
6. Using a fork , make a crisscross pattern in each cookie
7. Bake at 375 for 8-10 minutes
8. Do not overbake
9. Leave the cookies on the sheets for 5 minutes before removing to a rack to cool completely

title: lemon chicken with white wine and parsley easy
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200f
2. Place chicken breasts side by side on a cutting board and lay a piece of plastic wrap over them
3. Pound the chicken breasts with a flat meat mallet or the bottom of a heavy saucepan to about 1 / 4-inch thick
4. Put flour in shallow platter and season with fair amount of salt and pepper
5. Mix with fork to distribute seasoning
6. In wide bowl , beat eggs with 3 tablespoons water to make an egg wash
7. Place oil in large skillet and heat over medium-high heat until hot
8. Dredge chicken in seasoned flour , and pat off excess
9. Dip chicken in egg wash to coat completely , letting excess drip off
10. Add chicken to hot oil and fry about 2 minutes on each side , or until golden , turning once
11. Remove cutlets to a large platter and place in oven to keep warm
12. Now toss the lemon slices into pan and cook for a minute or two , until fragrant
13. Add wine , stock and lemon juice , and simmer 5 minutes to reduce sauce slightly
14. Roll the pat of butter in the seasoned flour and add to skillet
15. This will help thicken sauce
16. Stir or whisk to emulsify and dissolve flour
17. Reduce heat to medium-low and return chicken to pan
18. Fish out lemon slices with tongs and place on top of chicken
19. Simmer the whole thing gently for about 2 minutes to heat chicken through
20. Season with salt and pepper and garnish with chopped parsley before serving

title: cajun style chicken fingers
steps:
1. Cut chicken into 1 inch strips , or"fingers" about 3 inches in length
2. Mix together remaining ingredients , , in a bowl and add chicken and mix well , insuring that chicken is coated on all sides
3. Allow chicken to marinate in this for at least 20 minutes
4. Coat chicken in breadcrumbs , shaking off excess , and place chicken fingers on plate
5. Heat margarine in skillet over medium heat
6. Add chicken fingers , and cook until browned and crispy , about 5 minutes per side
7. Add more margarine to the skillet if necessary
8. Drain fingers on paper toweling
9. Serve hot with tabasco sauce , if desired

title: broccolicious salad
steps:
1. In a roomy bowl , combine broccoi , bacon , onion and nuts
2. Whisk together the dressing ingredients
3. Pour over the salad and toss
4. Just before serving , add the cheese and toss again
5. Flavor is better if the dressing is tossed with the salad half an hour before serving

title: pashtida
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees and grease a 9-by-13-inch baking pan
2. Place the potatoes in a saucepan in water to cover
3. Bring the water to a boil and simmer , uncovered , about 20 minutes or until the potatoes are soft
4. Drain and mash the potatoes
5. Beat the eggs until frothy
6. Add the salt , pepper , cumin , parsley , turmeric , garlic and onion
7. Fold in the potatoes and mix well
8. Spread in a baking pan and bake in the oven for about 50 minutes or until the top is golden and crusty and the potatoes spring away from the sides of the pan
9. Cool slightly before cutting

title: macaroni and cheese with garlic breadcrumbs  plain and chipotle
steps:
1. Make bread crumbs:
2. Heat butter and oil in a 10-inch heavy skillet over moderate heat until foam subsides , then cook garlic and bread crumbs , stirring , until crumbs are golden
3. Transfer to paper towels to drain and season with salt
4. Make macaroni:
5. Preheat oven to 350f
6. Chop chipotles
7. Melt butter in a 3- to 4-quart saucepan over moderate heat , then add flour and cook , whisking , 1 minute
8. Gradually whisk in milk , cream , and mustard and simmer , whisking occasionally , 3 minutes
9. Cook macaroni in a 6- to 7-quart pot of boiling salted water until just tender
10. Drain in a colander and transfer to a large bowl
11. Stir in white sauce , cheese , and salt to taste
12. Fill a 1 1 / 2-quart shallow casserole with half of macaroni mixture
13. Stir chipotles into remaining macaroni
14. Spoon into another 1 1 / 2-quart shallow casserole and sprinkle both with bread crumbs
15. Bake casseroles in middle of oven 30 minutes , or until bubbly
16. Macaroni and cheese may be made 2 days ahead , put into casseroles , cooled completely , and chilled , covered
17. Do not add bread crumbs until ready to bake
18. Serves 8 adults plus 10 children as part of a buffet

title: tastes like clodhoppers
steps:
1. Melt chocolate
2. Pour over cereal and nuts
3. Cool
4. Break into pieces
5. Enjoy !

title: greek tycoon
steps: 1. Combine and pour into a brandy snifter

title: dijon steak
steps:
1. Melt butter in large skillet
2. Brown steaks quickly on both sides
3. Remove , set aside
4. Reduce heat
5. Add gravy , half-and-half and mustard to skillet
6. Heat , stirring , till bubbly
7. Return steaks to pan with gravy
8. Turn heat down
9. Cover and let simmer about 30 minutes , or until done
10. Sprinkle fresh parsley over steaks just before eating

title: homemade chocolate truffles
steps:
1. Pulverize the cookies completely
2. Put the cookie powder in a bowl and add the rest of the ingredients , except the ingredients to cover them
3. Mix well , until it becomes a chocolate mixture
4. Refrigerate , covered for a few hours at least or like i do , make them on the evening and let them in the fridge overnight
5. This hardens the mixture and makes it easy to handle
6. When ready to make , wet your hands just enough to work with the paste and make small balls until finished
7. If you like you can put an almond or a nut inside each truffle
8. Now you can cover them with nuts , or chocolate , or colorful thingies :) , or just leave them like that
9. You can keep them in the fridge in a covered container for several days , but they also hold well unfridge if eaten within 1 or 2 days :)

title: white chocolate truffle and chocolate fudge layer cake
steps:
1. For chocolate stars:
2. Line baking sheet with foil
3. Stir chocolate and shortening in top of double boiler set over simmering water until melted and smooth
4. Pour onto prepared baking sheet , tilting pan to spread chocolate mixture to irregular 14x9-inch rectangle
5. Refrigerate until just firm , about 12 minutes
6. Spray assorted star-shaped cookie cutters with nonstick spray
7. Cut out stars
8. Refrigerate until firm , about 30 minutes
9. Using small offset spatula , carefully transfer stars 1 at a time to another foil-lined baking sheet
10. Refrigerate until ready to use
11. For cake:
12. Preheat oven to 350f butter two 9-inch-diameter cake pans with 1 1 / 2-inch-high sides
13. Line bottoms with parchment paper
14. Butter parchment
15. Stir unsweetened chocolate in heavy medium saucepan over low heat until melted and smooth
16. Cool slightly
17. Sift flour , cocoa powder , baking powder , baking soda , and salt into medium bowl
18. Using electric mixer , beat sugar and butter in large bowl until well blended
19. Beat in lukewarm melted unsweetened chocolate and vanilla
20. Beat in eggs , 1 at a time , blending well after each addition
21. Mix in cocoa powder mixture in 3 additions , alternating with milk in 2 additions
22. Divide batter between prepared pans
23. Bake cakes until tester inserted into center comes out clean , about 35 minutes
24. Cool cakes in pans on racks 10 minutes
25. Run knife around edge of each pan to loosen cakes
26. Turn cakes out onto racks and cool completely
27. Peel off parchment
28. For filling and frosting:
29. Bring 1 cup cream and butter to simmer in heavy medium saucepan over medium heat , stirring until butter melts
30. Remove from heat
31. Add white chocolate and stir until smooth
32. Whisk in vanilla
33. Pour 1 1 / 2 cups white chocolate filling into small bowl
34. Cover and freeze until cold , about 2 hours
35. Let remaining white chocolate mixture in saucepan stand at room temperature until lukewarm , about 20 minutes
36. Using electric mixer , beat remaining 2 cups cream and almond extract in large bowl until peaks form
37. Working in 3 batches , fold in lukewarm white chocolate mixture
38. Refrigerate whipped cream frosting just until medium peaks hold , folding occasionally , about 3 hours
39. Brush 2 tablespoons amaretto over top of each cake layer
40. Place 1 layer on platter
41. Spread chilled 1 1 / 2 cups white chocolate filling over
42. Top with second cake layer
43. Spread whipped cream frosting over top and sides of cake
44. Chill until cold and set , about 1 hour
45. Arrange chocolate stars decoratively atop cake and serve

title: simple spaghetti sauce
steps:
1. Brown your ground beef or , skinless chicken tenderloins until done all the way through
2. If using chicken tenderloins , strip off fat after done cooking and dice the chicken into bite sized cubes
3. While meat is browning on medium temperature cut and dice your garlic and fry together with your meat
4. While those two are cooking begin crushing your herbs
5. If you don't have a mortar and pestle , put the herbs in a thick plastic sandwich bag or similar and use a rolling pin , meat mallet or , similar and gently ) and beat the herbs until almost a fine grind of sorts , should not look like dust ! then add this to your meat mixture
6. Last but not least add in all the other ingredients and stir together , mixing well
7. Let simmer on med-high for about 5 minutes stirring occasionally and then turn down to med
8. Low for remainder of time and cover
9. After you have done this then cook your favorite pasta and when that is done , just top with your sauce and you're done
10. Don't forget to make garlic bread !
11. If it is not thick enough just add more parmesan to the mixture
12. Also feel free to add other veggies like zucchini , eggplant , mushrooms , etc
13. Make it your own !

title: weekend brunch eggs and sausage casserole
steps:
1. Set oven to 350f
2. Generously grease a 13x9-inch baking dish with butter
3. Cook the sausage in a skillet breaking up into large pieces until browned drain any fat and set the sausages aside to cool
4. Mix the minced garlic with the softened butter and parmesan cheese in a small bowl
5. Slice the loaf of bread in half lengthwise
6. Spread a thin layer of the garlic butter on both sides of the cut side of the bread
7. Arrange the two bread slices side by side in the bottom of the baking dish
8. Sprinkle the cooked crumbled sausage on top of the bread
9. In a bowl whisk together eggs , half and half until frothy about 3 minutes , then whisk in green onions and half of the shredded cheese
10. Pour the egg mixture over the sausage
11. Sprinkle with remaining cheese
12. At this point you can cover and refrigerate until ready to bake , or bake right away
13. Bake covered with a large piece of buttered foil for about 30 minutes
14. Carefully remove the foil and bake until the top is slightly puffed and the eggs are cooked through
15. Let stand 10 minutes , then cut into squares

title: snow shoes  cream puff dessert
steps:
1. Mix the first 3 ingredients together and pat onto a greased cookie sheet , either covering the entire sheet or shape into a shoe
2. Mix and boil the next 3 ingredients until it leaves the sides of the pan turning to a ball
3. Remove from heat and add the eggs , one at a time , beating well and fast after each addition
4. Spead over dough and bake at 350f for 45 minutes
5. Let cool a little before frosting
6. For the frosting , mix with a mixer all the ingredients , adding the milk 1t
7. At a time until you reach desired consistency
8. Spread over the crust

title: hot chinese eggplant  aubergine
steps:
1. Cut unpeeled eggplant into 3 / 4" by 3 / 4" by 2" sticks
2. Place strips in a colander , sprinkle with salt and toss to coat
3. Let drain for 30 minutes
4. Rinse
5. Squeeze to remove water
6. Mix first 5 ingredients in a bowl
7. In a skillet or wok heat the oil
8. Add the eggplant , garlic and ginger
9. Stir fry over high heat for 3 minutes
10. Add sauce and stir well
11. Reduce heat to medium low , simmer 15 minutes
12. Gradually turn up heat
13. Cook until sauce is reduced to a thick glaze
14. Garnish with sesame seeds
15. Serve immediately

title: buster brown cake with rich vanilla icing
steps:
1. Grease and lightly flour two 8x11 / 2-inch round cake pans or grease one 13x9x2-inch baking pan
2. Set the pan aside
3. In a medium bowl stir together the flour , baking soda , and salt
4. Set aside
5. In a large mixing bowl beat shortening with an electric mixer on medium to high speed for 30 seconds
6. Add brown sugar and vanilla
7. Beat until well combined
8. Add egg yolks 1 at a time , beating well after each addition
9. Alternately add flour mixture and buttermilk to shortening mixture , beating on low speed after each addition just until combined
10. Thoroughly wash the beaters
11. In a medium mixing bowl beat egg whites with an electric mixer on medium speed until stiff peaks form
12. Gently fold egg whites into the beaten mixture
13. Spread batter into the prepared pan
14. Bake in a 350 degree f oven for 30 to 35 minutes for the 8-inch pans or 35 to 40 minutes for the 13x9x2-inch pan , or until a wooden toothpick inserted near centers comes out clean
15. Cool cake layers in pans on wire racks for 10 minutes
16. Remove cake layers from pans
17. Cool thoroughly on racks
18. Or , place 13x9x2-inch cake in pan on a wire rack
19. Cool thoroughly
20. In a screw-top jar combine 1 cup milk and 1 / 4 cup flour
21. Cover and shake well
22. Place milk mixture in a small saucepan
23. Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly
24. Reduce heat
25. Cook and stir for 2 minutes more
26. Remove from heat
27. Transfer cooked mixture to a small bowl
28. Cover surface with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 2 hours or until thoroughly chilled
29. In a large mixing bowl beat 1 cup butter , 1 cup sugar , and 1 teaspoon vanilla with an electric mixer on medium speed until light and fluffy and sugar is almost dissolved
30. Add the chilled cooked mixture , 1 / 4 at a time , beating on medium speed after each addition until smooth
31. Frost
32. Cover and store cake in the refrigerator for up to 3 days
33. Let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes before serving

title: corn salad with queso fresco   ensalada de choclo
steps:
1. 1
2. Whisk lime juice into oil and season with salt and pepper
3. 2
4. Gently toss all ingredients together
5. Taste and season with salt and pepper as desired
6. 3
7. Serve chilled

title: pasta with kielbasa and swiss chard
steps:
1. Cut out center ribs and stems from chard , then thoroughly wash , along with leaves , in several changes of cold water
2. Cut ribs and stems crosswise into 1 / 4-inch-thick pieces and coarsely chop leaves
3. Cook kielbasa in oil in a 5-quart heavy pot over moderately high heat , stirring occasionally , until golden , 2 to 3 minutes
4. Transfer with a slotted spoon to a bowl
5. Cook chard ribs and stems with salt in fat remaining in pot over moderate heat , stirring occasionally , 3 minutes
6. Add garlic and cook , stirring , 1 minute
7. Add chard leaves , water , and red-pepper flakes and simmer , partially covered , until chard stems are tender , about 5 minutes
8. Remove lid and stir in kielbasa
9. Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente , then reserve 1 / 2 cup pasta-cooking water and drain pasta in a colander
10. Add pasta to chard mixture with cheese and salt to taste and toss until combined well
11. Thin with some of reserved pasta water if necessary

title: chicken breasts  to die for
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Clean chicken breasts and add pepper to taste
3. Place in baking dish
4. Cut one stick of butter into 8 pieces and place in saucepan on low heat
5. Once butter is nearly melted , pour in chicken broth and raise the heat to medium
6. Add both cans cream of chicken soup and stir till thoroughly combined
7. Pour the heated mixture over the chicken breasts
8. Cut remaining stick of butter into 8 pieces and place on chicken pieces
9. Cover tightly with foil and bake in 350 degree oven for 45-50 minutes , depending on size of breasts
10. During the last 15 minutes of baking , cook the noodles according to directions
11. Place noodles on large platter
12. Place chicken breasts on top
13. Stir sauce to incorporate the chicken juices and butter , and pour over platter -or- pour sauce into gravy boat and serve on the side

title: the best hummus
steps:
1. Combine chickpeas , lemon juice , garlic and tahini in blender or food processor and blend until smooth
2. Add water as necessary
