3. If not serving immediately , add paprika
4. Add olive oil through feeding tube while running food processor
5. If serving immediately , put hummus in serving bowl with olive oil and paprika on top
6. For even better hummus , cook 3 / 4 cup of chickpeas instead of using canned , and use some cooking liquid instead of the water

title: applesauce spice bran muffins
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
2. Lightly grease two non-stick muffin pans or line with paper muffin cups
3. In a large bowl , combine the bran , flour , cranberries , cinnamon , baking powder , baking soda , salt , ginger , nutmeg and orange zest
4. In a separate bowl , beat together the applesauce , sugar , oil and eggs until well mixed
5. Stir in the milk and molasses
6. Add to the dry ingredients , stirring just enough to moisten
7. Be careful not to overmix
8. Spoon into the prepared muffin pans
9. Bake for 20 minutes or until the tops are firm to the touch

title: louisiana stuffed bell peppers
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , brown the sausage and drain the fat
2. Add the water , olive oil , and zatarain's black beans & rice mix to sausage
3. Bring to a boil and stir
4. Cover and simmer over low heat for 25 minutes
5. Remove from heat
6. While the rice is cooking , cut the bell peppers in half from the stem to the bottom , leaving the stem in tact
7. Remove the ribs and seeds
8. Spoon the black bean mixture into pepper cavities in even portions
9. Place on a baking sheet and bake for 40 minutes
10. After 35 minutes remove the peppers and top with cheese
11. Finish baking until cheese is melted

title: date cookies like awrey s
steps:
1. Mix filling ingredients in saucepan
2. Cook til smooth
3. Mix cookie ingredients as if for a pie crust
4. Pat one half of the mixture on a buttered pan
5. Press down firmly and spread on the filling
6. Cover with the other half of the oatmeal mixture and press down lightly
7. Bake at 350 for 10-15 minutes
8. Cut into squares

title: walley s crock pot swiss steak
steps:
1. In a 3-4 quart crock pot , layer onion , celery , carrots , bell pepper and beef
2. Sprinkle beef with salt and pepper
3. In a medium bowl , mix soup , beef bouillon , garlic and tomatoes
4. Pour over beef
5. Cover , cook on low for 8 to 10 hours

title: chicken breasts  n wild rice
steps:
1. Rinse wild rice
2. Place in a heavy saucepan with salt and water
3. Bring to boil and simmer , covered till kernels open slightly
4. Drain
5. Place rice in buttered oblong baking dish
6. In a separate bowl , combine soup , sour cream , mushrooms , and sherry
7. Pour about 1 / 2 soup mixture over rice
8. Place chicken over soup
9. Spoon remaining soup mixture over chicken
10. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese
11. Bake uncovered in a 375 degree oven for 30 minutes
12. Uncovered 30 minutes

title: gluten free pepperoni pizza quesadilla
steps:
1. Spread one half of the tortilla with the pizza sauce
2. Top with half of the cheese
3. Top with pepperoni
4. Top with remaining cheese
5. Fold top over
6. Heat a grill pan over medium high heat
7. Spray with oil
8. Place quesadilla on grill pan
9. Cook for 5 minutes and flip
10. Cook for about 2-3 more minutes or until cheese is melted
11. Cut into wedges and enjoy !

title: tarte flambee  alsatian pizza
steps:
1. Put the flour and salt in a mixing bowl or in the work bowl of a food processor
2. In a measuring cup , sprinkle the yeast over the warm water and stir in the sugar
3. Add to the flour all at once and stir or motor until smooth
4. Be careful not to over-process
5. Cover the dough with plastic wrap and allow it to rise , undisturbed , for 45 minutes
6. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees and rub two large baking sheets with a little vegetable oil
7. Divide the dough into four parts , and on a well-floured surface , roll each part into an 8-inch round
8. Put the rounds on the oiled baking sheets and set aside
9. Combine the fromage blanc or cottage cheese , the crme frache and the 1 tablespoon of flour and stir or process until smooth
10. Cook the bacon in a skillet over medium heat until some of the fat is released , then add the sliced onion and cook 2 or 3 minutes , or until the onion is barely softened
11. Distribute the cheese evenly between the rounds of dough and spread it up to the edges
12. Sprinkle the bacon and onions on top
13. Season with kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
14. Bake 12 to 15 minutes , or until the pastry is browned
15. Serve hot

title: sticky harissa chicken thighs
steps:
1. Preheat the broiler to high
2. Mix together 1 tbsp harissa with 1 tbsp clear honey
3. Lightly slash 6 skinless free-range chicken thighs and brush all over with the marinade
4. Set aside for 10 minutes , then place the thighs on a lightly oiled baking sheet and pop under the broiler for 16 minutes , turning halfway , until sticky and cooked through

title: chevys fresh mex salsa
steps:
1. Char tomatoes , onion and jalapenos on a hot pan , griddle or grill
2. Put charred ingredients in blender
3. Add in pepper , salt and cilantro
4. Blend until smooth

title: zesty lasagna  southern living
steps:
1. Brown ground beef and garlic in a heavy skillet over medium heat until meat is browned , stirring to crumble meat , drain
2. Stir in the tomato paste , water , mushrooms , bay leaves , salt , pepper , italian seasoning , and oregano
3. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Remove the bay leaves
5. Cook noodles according to package directions and drain
6. Combine cottage cheese and sour cream in a medium bowl
7. Stir well
8. Layer half each of noodles , meat sauce , and cottage cheese mixture in a greased 12 x 8 x 2 inch baking dish
9. Sprinkle with 3 / 4 cup mozzarella cheese
10. Repeat layers of noodles , meat sauce and cottage cheese mixture
11. Cover and bake at 350f for 40 minutes
12. Top with the remaining mozzarella cheese and bake an additional 5 minutes or until cheese melts
13. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving

title: soft italian sugar cookies
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , cream together shortening and sugar
2. Beat in eggs and vanilla
3. Combine flour , baking powder , and salt together and gradually add to the creamed mixture and mix well
4. Shape dough into 1-1 / 2" balls
5. Place 1 inch apart on ungreased baking sheets
6. Bake at 400 degrees for 8-10 minutes or until lightly browned
7. Remove to wire racks to cool after 2 minutes
8. For icing
9. In a small bowl , combine the milk , butter , vanilla and confectioners' sugar until smooth
10. Tint with food coloring if desired
11. Decorating
12. Dip the cooled cookies into the icing
13. Sprinkle with colored sugars if desired
14. Place on waxed paper until icing is set

title: stuffed manicotti alfredo
steps:
1. Prepare the alfredo sauce
2. Melt the butter in a med
3. Saucepan
4. Whisk in cream and parmesan cheese and seasonings
5. Simmer for 15 minutes on low heat , being careful not to boil or let stick
6. Remove from heat
7. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees
8. Prepare the filling
9. In a small bowl , stir together ricotta , 2 1 / 4 cups mozzarella cheese , parmesan cheese , egg and seasonings
10. Make sure shells are drained well
11. Spread a thin layer of alfredo sauce in the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish
12. Using a pastry bag or zip-top bag , fill the shells and arrange them on the sauce
13. Pour the remaining sauce on top of the shells
14. Cover and bake for 35-40 minutes
15. Uncover and sprinkle with the remaining mozzarella cheese
16. Bake 10 minutes more or until cheese is just melted , but not browned and manicotti shells are heated through

title: cheese and bean burritos
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Prepare filling by mixing refried beans , chilies , cumin and garlic together in a bowl
3. Spoon approximately 4 ounces bean filling into the center of each tortilla and top with about one tablespoon of cheese
4. Fold in ends and then sides
5. Place burritos seam side down on baking sheets that have been sprayed with vegetable oil spray
6. Bake for 2025 minutes until golden brown

title: crock pot cranberry apple butter
steps:
1. Core and chop apple
2. Do not peel
3. Combine apples , cranberries and cranapple juice in a slow cooker
4. Cover and cook on high for five hours
5. Puree in sieve , food mill or processor
6. Return pureed mixture to crock pot and add sugar , cinnamon and cloves
7. Cover and cook on high for 1 to 2 hours

title: favorite  gourmet meatloaf
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine beef , stuffing , tomato sauce , egg , onion , green pepper , oregano , basil , garlic powder , salt and pepper
2. With hands blend mixture well and form into a firm loaf
3. Place in center of greased baking dish
4. Bake in preheated 350 degree oven for 30minutes
5. Meanwhile , combine bbq sauce , brown sugar and nutmeg
6. Stir well
7. Pour mixture over top of meatloaf
8. Continue baking meatloaf for an additional 30 minutes
9. Remove from oven and let set for 5minutes before slicing and serving

title: no garlic garlic bread
steps:
1. Slice bread legnth wise and lay on a cookie sheet
2. Drizzle melted butter on both halves and spread with a spoon as best you can
3. Put 2 tbs dressing on each half and spread out evenly
4. Then sprinkle the parmesan on top
5. Then sprinkle on the seasoning
6. Then the pepper , and you dont want to use too much of this , just a little
7. Bake at 375 for ten minutes
8. Take out of oven and slice in 10-12 slices

title: spicy jalapeno and crab stuffed chicken
steps:
1. Flatten each thawed chicken breast with a meat tenderizer or other means
2. In a small bowl , mix 6 ounces cream cheese with 6 ounces crab meat and preferred cajun seasonings
3. Stir
4. Stir in jalapeno peppers
5. Divide and spoon the cream cheese / crab mixture over the flattened chicken breast
6. Spread
7. Roll each chicken breast into a tight wrap and cover with tinfoil
8. Bake at 375 f for approximately 35-40 minutes , or until chicken is done
9. Sauce:
10. Use the remaining cream cheese and crab and mix in a bowl
11. Add beer and cajun seasonings , and stir
12. Nuke it about 1 minutes , then pour over the top of the finished chicken
13. Dust with more cajun seasonings for taste and color , and serve !

title: chocolate mint cheesecake
steps:
1. Coat an 8- or 9-inch springform pan with nonstick spray
2. Break up cookies into a food processor
3. Pulse until fine crumbs
4. Transfer 1 / 4 cup crumbs to a small bowl
5. Cover and reserve
6. Add butter to remaining crumbs and pulse until blended
7. Press into bottom of prepared pan
8. Place in freezer
9. Sprinkle gelatin over cold water in a small saucepan
10. Let stand 1 minute , then stir with a heatproof plastic spatula over medium-low heat until granules completely dissolve and liquid begins to steam
11. Remove from heat
12. Whisk cocoa powder into warm water until well blended
13. Set aside
14. Beat both bricks cream cheese and the sugar in a large bowl with mixer on medium speed until smooth and fluffy
15. On low speed , beat in cocoa mixture , dissolved gelatin and mint extract until blended
16. Pour over the chilled crust
17. Cover and refrigerate at least 5 hours or until firm
18. Shortly before serving: remove sides of pan
19. Using 2 broad spatulas , lift cake off springform-pan base onto a serving platter
20. Press reserved crumbs onto sides of cake
21. Drop small dollops of topping around top edge , then garnish with mint triangles and mint sprigs

title: california rice
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and place in a greased 2 quart shallow casserole
2. Bake 25 minutes at 325 degrees or microwave until heated through
3. Can be assembled the day before
4. Or can be frozen before baking
5. Defrost before baking

title: 2 sauces for basting or dipping
steps:
1. For pineapple sauce--------------
2. Pour undrained pineapple into bowl
3. Add peaches and sugar
4. Mix well
5. Add spices and stir until blended
6. For orange sauce--------------
7. In small saucepan , combine ingredients
8. Heat on med to boiling
9. Reduce heat to low
10. Cook 10 minutes or until thickened , stirring often
11. Can be used to baste chicken , pork , or fish
12. Or are excellent as dipping sauces for nuggets , strips , etc

title: mousaka
steps:
1. Place the eggplant slices on a coated baking sheet
2. Broil the eggplant until lightly browned , about 5 minutes on each side
3. Heat the milk , just as small bubbles start to form , in a saucepan with onion slice and bay leaf
4. Remove from heat and discard the onion and bay leaf
5. Saut chopped onion
6. Add ground beef , 1 / 4 teaspoon of salt , pumpkin pie spice , red pepper , and pepper to the onions
7. Continue cooking over medium heat for 8 minutes
8. Drain meat on paper towels and wipe out skillet
9. Return the meat to the skillet and mix in the tomatoes
10. Cook for 5 minutes over medium heat
11. Melt the margarine in a saucepan and stir in the flour , whisking constantly for 1 minute
12. Stir in the milk and the remaining 1 / 4 teaspoon salt
13. Cooking for 5 minutes stirring constantly
14. Place half of the eggplant across the bottom of a coated 13 x 9 baking dish , then half of the meat mixture
15. Repeat layers
16. Pour the milk sauce over top and spread on the grated parmesan cheese
17. Bake dish for 45 minutes at 350 degrees

title: vegetarian baked bean meatloaf
steps:
1. Heat oven to 325f
2. Mash beans and breadcrumbs together
3. Add other ingredients and form to a dough
4. If needed , you may add touch of skim / soy milk to thin
5. Place loaf in greased loaf pan
6. Bake approximately 1 hour and enjoy !

title: easy chicken tetrazzini
steps:
1. Melt margarine in a large saucepan over medium-high heat
2. Add scallions and mushrooms
3. Cook until tender , stirring , about 5 minutes
4. Combine flour , garlic powder , pepper , broth and milk in a small bowl
5. Mix until well blended
6. Add flour mixture to saucepan
7. Cook until mixture boils and thickens , stirring constantly , about 10 minutes
8. Add chicken , pimentos and sherry
9. Cook until thoroughly heated , stirring occasionally , about 2 minutes
10. Stir in cheese and add cooked spaghetti
11. Toss gently
12. Yields about 1 cup per serving

title: tropical fudge
steps:
1. Grease an 8 inch square cake pan
2. Combine the evaporated milk , sugar and pineapple juice in a saucepan
3. Heat to 238f , stirring constantly
4. Remove from heat and stir in the butter until melted
5. Let stand - without stirring - until completely cool
6. When cool , add candied fruit and lemon juice
7. Beat until crystallized
8. Pour into prepared pan and score top with knife in 1 inch squares
9. Let sit until hardened

title: herbed zucchini spirals
steps:
1. Using a mandoline or similar slicing device , sut the zucchini lengthwise into 1 / 8 inch slices
2. Arrange the slices on a steamer rack , set over simmering water and steam them , covered , for 3 to 5 minutes , or until just tender
3. In a food processor puree the parsley , garlic , walnuts , 2 tbsp of the parmesan cheese and salt to taste until the mixture is smooth
4. Arrange the zucchini slices on a work surface and dot each slice along its length with a heaping teaspoon of the puree
5. Smooth the puree to an even layer on each slice
6. Roll up each slice jelly- roll fashion and fasten the spirals with wooden picks
7. Arrange the spirals in a shallow baking dish , sprinkle with the remaining 1 teaspoons parmesan cheese
8. Bake the spirals in the upper third of a preheated 425 f oven for 5 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the spirals are heated through

title: no cheese whiz broccoli rice casserole
steps:
1. Cook onion in butter in large skillet until soft
2. Add remaining ingredients and cook just until cheese is melted
3. Put in 2 quart casserole dish
4. Bake at 350 for 1 hour
5. To make ahead and freeze: mix all ingredients together and spoon into two or even three smaller casserole dishes , cover , label and freeze
6. If you thaw overnight , just cook the one hour
7. If cooking from frozen state , add ten minutes or so , check for doneness
8. Many thanks to tornado ali , for her wonderful

title: simple chicken and rice  with a kick
steps:
1. Bring the stock , basil , garlic powder , tabasco sauce and tomatoes in a large saucepan over medium heat to a boil
2. Stir in the rice , and reduce heat to low
3. Cover and cook for about 20 minutes
4. Stir in the peas and chicken
5. Cover and continue to cook for about 5 minutes

title: red star tavern moist and rich cornbread
steps:
1. Mix eggs , butter , milk , sour cream , corn and cheese well
2. Add cornmeal , flour , sugar , salt , baking powder and soda
3. Whisk until combined
4. Preheat oven to 350f degrees
5. Heat a 9-inch cast-iron skillet in oven until quite hot , 10 to 15 minutes
6. When hot , oil pan with nonstick cooking spray
7. Pour batter into hot pan
8. Fill about three-fourths full
9. Bake until golden brown on top , about 25 minutes
10. Corn bread will still seem wet or moist , but will be somewhat firm to the touch
11. Let cool in pan
12. The residual heat will finish cooking corn bread
13. To serve , reheat cooled corn bread in its pan
14. When hot , loosen from edge of a pan with a butter knife and turn out onto a warm plate
15. Drizzle generously with honey

title: asparagus with caramelized onions   bacon
steps:
1. Fry the bacon in a large skillet until crisp
2. Drain , break into pieces and set aside
3. Pour off and reserve the excess bacon drippings
4. Saute the onion rings and garlic in 1 tablespoon of the drippings
5. Cook the onions and garlic , stirring constantly , over medium heat until the onions turn a rich golden brown
6. Remove from the pan and set aside
7. Pour the drippings back into the skillet and saute the asparagus spears for 8 to 10 minutes
8. Season with the salt and pepper
9. The asparagus should remain crunchy but still cooked through
10. Remove from the heat
11. Place in a serving bowl , top with the onions and sprinkle with the bacon

title: chihuahua tomato soup with crispy lime chili tortillas
steps:
1. Saute onion in olive oil until slightly browned
2. Add garlic , cumin and oregano
3. Cook for 10 more minutes , stirring frequently
4. Add tomatoes , vegetable broth and pasilla chile
5. Bring to a boil , then lower heat slightly and add masa harina , stirring well until it's dissolved
6. Simmer gently 30 minutes
7. In the meantime , heat vegetable oil in a skillet
8. Carefully add tortilla strips
9. Sprinkle with salt and chili powder and fry until lightly crispy
10. Sprinkle with the juice of 1 / 2 lime and set aside
11. And here's the important part- try not to eat all the tortilla strips before the soup is done !
12. Lol !
13. Squeeze the juice of 1 lime into the soup after it's simmered for 30 minutes
14. Heat 10 minutes more
15. To serve , place cheese in soup bowls
16. Ladle soup over and top with crispy tortilla strips

title: horseradish butter  pepperrotsmor
steps:
1. Cream the butter until it is light and fluffy
2. The butter should be almost white in colour
3. Add the horseradish sauce and salt , if using , and beat into the butter to mix thoroughly
4. Transfer to a serving dish or small individual sized pots
5. Chill until ready to use

title: peanut butter marshmallow crunch brownies
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease a 913-inch pan
3. For the brownies: in a medium saucepan , melt the unsweetened chocolate , butter and cup of the semisweet chocolate chips over medium heat
4. Stir occasionally while melting
5. Set aside and cool for 5 minutes
6. In a medium bowl sift the flour , baking powder and salt
7. Set aside
8. In a large bowl , whisk the eggs thoroughly
9. Add the sugar and vanilla and whisk until well blended
10. Stir the melted ingredients into the egg mixture , mixing well
11. Stir in the dry sifted ingredients and mix well
12. Fold in the remaining cup semisweet chocolate chips
13. Pour the batter into the prepared pan , smoothing the surface with a spatula
14. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes , or until a cake tester inserted into the corner of of the pan comes out with moist crumbs
15. Remove the brownies from the oven and immediately sprinkle the marshmallows over them
16. Return the pan to the oven for 3 more minutes
17. Meanwhile , place the milk chocolate chips , peanut butter , and tablespoon of butter in a medium saucepan
18. Melt over low heat , stirring constantly , until completely melted
19. Remove from heat , add the rice krispies and mix well
20. Allow to cool for 3 minutes
21. Spread / pour the mixture evenly over the marshmallow layer
22. Refrigerate until chilled before cutting

title: filling mexican  dip   its more like a meal
steps:
1. In a large pot , fry ground beef
2. Drain
3. If you're making the spanish rice , cook that while the beef is cooking
4. Return to same pot and add all ingredients and heat until cheese is completely melted
5. Enjoy with tortillia chips or eat it like chilli , or both !

title: vegan nutritional yeast  nooch  cheezy biscuits
steps:
1. Pour the soymilk , almond milk , etc
2. Into a glass measuring cup and stir in the lemon juice
3. Let it rest at room temp for 10 minutes to sour
4. Place the flour , nutritional yeast , baking powder , chili and garlic powders , and salt into a medium mixing bowl and stir them together
5. Pour the oil into the dry ingredient mix , and cut in with a pastry cutter or fork until the mixture is crumbly
6. Using a fork , stir in just enough of the soured non-dairy milk so the dough can come together and can form into a large ball-- too much milk will make the dough sticky but not enough will make the biscuits dry
7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly-floured surface and knead it gently until it is smooth gently form it into a ball
8. Reflour the work surface and roll the dough out into a 1 / 2 inch thick sheet
9. Cut the dough with a floured biscuit cutter-- the book recommends a 2
10. 5" one but i find that using an empty can works , and i have heart-shaped biscuit cutters in both small , regular 2
11. 5" , and large size
12. Place the biscuits on a dry baking sheet or sil-pat as soon as they are cut
13. Arrange them close together if you want soft sides , but at least 1 inch apart for crustier sides
14. Bake at 400f for 15-18 minutes or until golden brown
15. I'd recommend about 12-13 minutes for smaller biscuits and closer to 18 for bigger biscuits

title: fruitful pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. Place crust , in pie pan , prick bottom of crust with fork
3. Place in oven for 10 to 12 mins or till golden
4. Remove and cool
5. While crust is cooling , in a microwave safe dish , combine sugar , water and cormstarch
6. Cook 4 to 6 mins , stiring every couple of minutes mixture will get very thick and almost clear
7. Remove from microwave and pour in jello
8. Stir to disolve
9. Place fruit in cooled crust and pour hot jello mixture over covering all pcs of fruit with a thin glaze
10. Place in fridge to chill about 2 hours
11. The jello should set firm
12. Serve with cool whip

title: teriyaki chicken   noodles  21 day wonder diet  day 20
steps:
1. Combine chicken , half the sauce and garlic in medium bowl
2. Cover
3. Refrigerate 30 minutes
4. Spray wok with cooking oil
5. Cook chicken , in batches , in heated wok until browned
6. Cook onion in wok 1 minute
7. Return chicken to wok with remaining sauce , stock , noodles and peas
8. Stir-fry until hot
9. Serve stir-fry topped with sprouts and chilli

title: dill pickle dip     yum
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients well
2. Chill
3. Serve with chips , crackers or rye bread

title: couscous with roasted vegetables
steps:
1. Vegetables-
2. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
3. Combine the first 4 ingredients in a large , shallow roasting pan
4. Whisk together the oil , vinegar , herbs , garlic , salt and pepper in a small bowl until blended
5. Drizzle the mixture over the vegetables and stir to coat
6. Roast uncovered , until the vegetables are tender , , stirring once halfway through the roasting time
7. Couscous-
8. In a saucepan , heat butter , add couscous and stir to coat
9. Cook until it is starting to brown
10. Add seasoning package
11. Add boiling broth , stir , cover , and remove form the heat
12. Let stand for 5 minutes
13. Place in a serving bowl , fluff with a fork and arrange vegetables on top

title: chocolate grab bag brownies   use up that  halloween candy
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f grease 13x9x2-inch baking pan
2. Remove wrappers from candies
3. Cut each candy into 1 / 2-inch pieces
4. Set aside
5. Melt butter in saucepan over low heat
6. Add sugar and cocoa
7. Stir to blend
8. Remove from heat
9. Stir in eggs
10. Stir together flour , salt and baking soda
11. Stir into chocolate mixture
12. Stir in vanilla and candy pieces
13. Spread in prepared pan
14. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until brownies begin to pull away from sides of pan and begin to crack slightly
15. Do not overbake
16. Cool completely in pan on wire rack
17. Cut into bars

title: mexican tuna loaf
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except salsa together until well combined
2. Line the bottom of a 20 x 10xm loaf pan with baking paper and pack the mixture inches
3. Cover with foil and bake at 180 c for 30 minutes
4. Remove foil and continue to cook for a further 15 mins or until set
5. Remove from oven and let stand for 10 mins to firm before turning onto a serving dish
6. Serve with tomato salsa

title: football season beef   beer stew
steps:
1. Fry the bacon and remove the bacon but leave some of the grease
2. Coat the beef with flour and add to the hot bacon grease along with the onions
3. Cook over medium heat until the onions are soft
4. Add the beer and beef base
5. Stir until the bottom of the pot is clean
6. Add the tomato sauce , water and seasoning
7. Bring the mixture to a boil
8. Turn the heat down and add the rutabega , carrots and potatoes
9. Simmer for 1-2 hours

title: very good for your health and mine vegetarian lemon  pepper soup
steps:
1. Firstly , prepare vegetable stock
2. For this , dissolve 2 cubes of maggi vegetable stock with onions in 4-5 cups of water and boil until the cubes are completely dissolved
3. Your veg
4. Stock is ready
5. Now keep this aside and proceed
6. Heat oil in a saucepan
7. Add carrot , cabbage and mushrooms and stir well
8. Add capsicum , tomato and salt
9. Stir-cook for 10-15 minutes till the veggies are tender
10. Then , add the stock and let it come to a boil
11. Lower heat , stir in the crushed peppercorns and remove from flame
12. Add bean sprouts and lemon juice
13. Stir well and serve hot on a cold windy winter night

title: grilled herbed chicken thighs
steps:
1. Starting with the herbs , mix all ingredients together into a rub mixture
2. Rub mixture into chicken , under and on top of skin
3. Set aside for an hour to let flavors soak into meat
4. Leave longer if you have time
5. Preheat your grill to hot
6. Once the grill is heated , lower the grill temp to medium then grill on indirect heat with grill closed for 20-30 min or until juices run clear

title: classic blondies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease and flour a 9 x 13 inch pan
3. Cream butter & sugars until pale brown and thick
4. Add the eggs one at a time and then add vanilla
5. With a wooden spoon , stir in chocolate chips , then add the flour , baking powder & salt
6. Spread into the prepared pan
7. Bake for 45 minutes

title: island pasticio  greek noodle casserole with ground meat
steps:
1. Prepare the pasta in salted water as indicated in the product descriptions
2. Drain it well and keep warm
3. In the meanwhile prepare the meat sauce:
4. Fry the onion in the oil until golden
5. Add garlic and meat
6. Cook for 5-8 minutes until done
7. Switch off the heat
8. Add all the other ingredients one after the other as indicated in the ingredients list
9. If necessary adjust the salt
10. Mix milk with water in bowl
11. For the bechamel melt margarine and add the flour
12. Reduce heat when the flour changes color and add the milk / water mix at once
13. Stir it quickly until it thickens
14. Switch off the heat source
15. Add all the remaining ingredients and adjust the salt
16. Prepare your baking mold with some olive oil
17. Put 2 / 3 of the pasta on the bottom of the mold
18. Add the meat sauce , followed by the remaining pasta and top with the bechamel sauce
19. Don't stir !
20. Bake 40 minutes at 180c or until the top is golden

title: quinoa  kale  and avocado salad
steps:
1. In a small pot combine one cup quinoa with 2 cups of salted water and bring to a boil
2. Cover and simmer over low heat for about 15 minutes , or until all water has been absorbed
3. Let cool at least slightly before adding to salad
4. While the quinoa cooks , remove the stems from the kale
5. Discard stems and chop the leaves finely , adding them to a large bowl
6. You may saute the kale in a large skillet if you wish before adding to the bowl
7. Add shredded nori or furikake and cucumber
8. Add the pine nuts and sesame seeds to the kale , nori and cucumbers
9. Add the avocado last to limit browning
10. Add vinegar and lemon juice , and quinoa
11. Mix well , season to taste , and enjoy !

title: comfort food rice casserole
steps:
1. Mix all together and place in greased casserole dish
2. You can sprinkle additional cheese on top if desired
3. Bake in 375 degree oven for 30-35 minute

title: asian burgers
steps:
1. Ina bowl , combine allthe ingredients except the kaiser rolls , and mix well
2. Fo9rm into 4 patties
3. Cook in skillet , or grill over medium heat until brown on one side
4. Turn and repeat , sprinkling with salt , and pepper if desired
5. Spread buns with mayonnaise , and topping of your choice

title: diet friendly lemon cookies
steps:
1. Whisk egg whites , soy milk , spray butter , and lemon flavor + juice together in large bowl
2. Mix in sugar substitute
3. Whisk flour , baking powder and salt together in small bowl
4. Add to egg white mixture
5. Spoon 1 inch cookies onto nonstick cookie sheet
6. Sprinkle tops with colored sugar
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 7-8 minutes

title: gingerbread bowl
steps:
1. In a large bowl , cream the butter and sugars until fluffy , about 1 minute
2. With the mixer running , add molasses , corn syrup , vanilla and orange extract
3. Add the eggs , one at a time , beating until mixture is well combined
4. In a large bowl , combine remaining ingredients with a whisk
5. Add flour mixture gradually to creamed mixture-the dough will be very stiff , so i used my hands to get all the flour incorporated
6. Divide the dough into thirds and wrap in plastic wrap
7. Chill overnight
8. Remove dough from the fridge and let stand at room temperature about 1 1 / 2 hours
9. Cover the outside of any ovenproof bowl , with tin foil , bringing foil over the edges to the inside
10. Make sure foil is on very smoothly
11. Spray the entire bowl with a non-stick cooking spray and set aside
12. On floured surface , roll a third of the dough into a circle 3 / 16-inch thick
13. Immediately lift dough and press on to outside of bowl , molding firmly to shape of bowl without stretching it
14. I use the palms of my hands to smooth any cracks
15. Trim dough around the edge of bowl with sharp knife , then using a cookie cutter , like a heart or a star , cut out stars around the lipped edge of the bowl about 1 1 / 2 inches apart
16. Refrigerate bowl for 1 1 / 2 hours
17. This firms up the dough
18. Place inverted bowl on an ungreased baking sheet and bake at 350f for 20-30 minutes , or until firm to the touch
19. Allow the gingerbread to cool on bowl
20. When completely cool , carefully loosen foil and lift foil and gingerbread shell off the bowl
21. Peel off foil from shell
22. A
23. I broke a large one
24. Have fun , i did !

title: dad s beef stew
steps:
1. 1
2. In a frying pan melt the butter , then brown onions thoroughly
3. 2
4. Remove onions from frying pan and place in a large pot , leaving some of the butter behind in the frying pan
5. 3
6. Place flour , salt , and pepper into gallon sized ziplock bag , add beef cubes , and mix so that all sides of the beef cubes are covered
7. 4
8. Brown beef in the same frying pan as onions in the leftover butter
9. When all sides of beef are browned , deglaze frying pan with some water , and pour contents into pot with onions
10. 5
11. Add beef stock , carrots , celery , and bay leaf to pot , simmer for 1 hour
12. 6
13. Add potatoes to pot , continue simmering until potatoes are done
14. 7
15. Add can of corn and water to achieve desired consistency
16. 8
17. Remove bay leaf and serve

title: black and white cupcakes
steps:
1. For chocolate icing: bring cream and corn syrup just to simmer in heavy small saucepan over medium heat
2. Remove from heat
3. Add chocolate and vanilla
4. Whisk until melted and smooth
5. For white icing: whisk all ingredients in small bowl to blend
6. Let both icings stand 1 1 / 2 hours at room temperature to thicken
7. For cupcakes: preheat oven to 325f
8. Line 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners
9. Whisk eggs , vanilla , and lemon peel in medium bowl to blend
10. Mix cake flour , baking powder , and salt in another medium bowl
11. Using electric mixer , beat sugar and butter in large bowl until well blended , stopping occasionally to scrape down sides of bowl
12. Gradually beat in egg mixture
13. Beat in dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk in 2 additions each
14. Divide batter among cups
15. Bake until tester inserted into centers comes out clean , about 25 minutes
16. Cool cupcakes in pan on rack 5 minutes
17. Remove cupcakes from pan and cool completely
18. Spread chocolate icing over half of each cupcake
19. Spread white icing on second half of each cupcake
20. Let stand until set , about 1 hour

title: homemade mac   cheese  the best you ll ever have
steps:
1. Boil water
2. Add macaroni
3. Cook until tender
4. Meanwhile , saute onion in olive oil , then set aside
5. Combine softened cream cheese and sour cream
6. Heat cream cheese and sour cream mixture over medium heat until uniform
7. Add desired amount of garlic powder
8. When mixture is smooth , add cheeses , bit by bit
9. I don't know the exact measurements for the cheeses , i just got all the cheeses in standard blocks and shredded it all
10. It looked like alot to me
11. Once all the shredded cheese is incorporated , combine cooked macaroni , cheese sauce , and caramelized onions in a baking dish
12. Top with bread crumbs , and bake at 350 for 35 minutes

title: moo less chocolate pie
steps:
1. Over a double boiler or in a microwave , melt the chocolate and coffee liqueur together , stir in vanilla
2. Combine the tofu , chocolate mixture , and honey in a blender jar , liquefy until smooth
3. Pour the filling into the crust and refrigerate for 2 hours , or until the filling is set

title: bill s calzones
steps:
1. For sauce:
2. Brown 1 / 2 lb of the sausage in sauce pan
3. Mix tomato sauce , onions , minced garlic cloves , mushrooms , olives , cooking sherry , celery salt , brown sugar , honey , tomatoes , olive oil , artichoke hearts , oregano , basil , sage , red peppers , black pepper , thyme , cilantro , savory and half lb of sausage into large pot
4. Let sauce come to a simmer
5. Cover , and simmer for 6 hours , stirring occasionally
6. After sauce has simmered , refrigerate overnight
7. Brown two lbs hot italian sausage
8. Set aside
9. Mix dough ingredients and knead for several minutes
10. You will need to repeat the dough recipe five times in order to make 40 calzones
11. Cover dough
12. Punch down after it has doubled in bulk , about 1 hour
13. After dough has doubled in bulk again , take a batch of dough and cut into four , six or eight equal pieces , based on how big you want your calzones
14. On a floured counter , press and roll dough into a round about 12" in diameter
15. Put a couple of scoops of sauce into the center
16. Sprinkle some sausage over the sauce
17. Add some slices of whatever other meat that you wish to add
18. Sprinkle a dash of romano and parmesan cheese
19. Don't go overboard with these two cheeses , or else it will make the calzone taste too sour
20. Liberally apply mozzarella
21. Fold dough over the mass in the middle , leaving about a half of an inch to go
22. Dab the lip of the dough that you just folded over with olive oil
23. You finger will do fine , no need to brush
24. Fold the bottom dough over the lip , and press into place with the tines of a fork
25. Place on a floured pizza stone or floured cookie sheet , if that's what you've got
26. Use flour , not non-stick spray
27. Fill up the stone with the calzones
28. In a small bowl , separate two eggs , and save the yolks
29. Give the whites to your cat , if you have one
30. Add two or three tablespoons of water
31. Mix well
32. Brush this yolk mixture over the calzones
33. This will give them a golden brown look
34. Lightly sprinkle the calzones with mozzarella cheese
35. I mean , really lightly
36. It's really just for looks
37. When the oven is good and pre-heated , bake them for 20 minutes , or until golden brown
38. Be wary !
39. The calzones freeze well , and are ready to eat again after 20 minutes or so in a oven or toaster oven
40. Do not reheat in the microwave , because they'll be soggy

title: avocado chicken pitas
steps:
1. Brush one side of each pita with olive oil
2. Bake on cookie sheet 350 degrees 7 minutes until golden and crisp
3. Combine mashed avocado , lime juice , cilantro , salt , garlic powder and hot sauce until well blended
4. Spread even layer over each of the 4 pitas
5. Top each pita with chicken , tomato and cheese
6. Bake for 5 minutes or until cheese is melted and enjoy

title: yummy vegan banana flaxseed muffins
steps:
1. 1
2. Preheat oven to 375f grease a standard-sized muffin pan or use liners
3. 2
4. In a large bowl , combine the flour , sugar , baking powder , salt , egg replacer & flaxseed meal
5. 3
6. In a medium bowl , whisk together soy milk , oil , vanilla , and butter pecan flavoring
7. Add to dry mixture carefully
8. Mix them together then add the banana's
9. 4
10. Drop tablespoon amounts of the mixture to the muffin pan
11. Bake at 375f for about 15 minutes
12. 5
13. Let cool for about 10 minutes and enjoy with some awesome vegan butter !

title: another broccoli chicken  brassica oleracea  gallus domesticus
steps:
1. Cut thawed chicken breast into bite sized chunks
2. Soak chicken pieces in italian dressing
3. Bring water to boil
4. Add undisclosed amount of basil and garlic salt
5. Add frozen broccoli and cook covered over medium heat 3 minutes
6. Add chicken , along with favorite spices or veggies , and allow chicken to cook through

title: roasted beetroot
steps:
1. Peel the beets and trim the stems to about 3 cm
2. Cut into 4 to 6 wedges , depending on size
3. Put the wedges in a baking dish that will hold them all in one layer
4. Add the vinegar , oil and herbs along with a good pinch salt
5. Toss well
6. Cover the dish with foil and roast in a preheated oven at 200c for 30 minutes
7. Remove the foil and roast until just tender when pierced with a fork , about 20 minutes more
8. There should still be some liquid in the dish
9. If this evaporates too quickly , add a spoonful or so of water during cooking

title: crock pot sweet potatoes with apricot pie filling
steps:
1. Place potatoes in a 3-1 / 2 to 4 quart crock pot and sprinkle with garlic
2. In a medium bowl , combine the remaining ingredients and blend well
3. Pour into slow cooker
4. Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours or until potatoes are tender and glazed , stirring once during cooking time

title: easy tuna melt  no mayo
steps:
1. Toast bread
2. Add cheese & tuna to bread to make sandwich
3. Microwave for 20-40 seconds

title: crispie orange chicken rice pilaf salad
steps:
1. Rice pilaf:
2. Brown orzo in skillet with 1 / 8 c olive oil
3. Saute onions and celery
4. Mix with rice , bouillion , red pepper flakes , water and honey in a casserole dish
5. Bake 350 degrees covered for 30-40 minutes
6. While the pilaf is cooking , fry the chicken in oil 375 degrees for 3-4 minutes till golden brown
7. Cut chicken into 1" pieces
8. Beat 2 eggs , mix in 2 tblsp oil
9. Dip chicken in egg mixture and coat with mixture of 1c cornstarch and 1 / 2 c flour , salt and pepper
10. When golden brown , drain on paper towels
11. Keep warm in oven , till time to assemble salad
12. Steam vegetables or microwave 3-4 minutes
13. Assemble salad 4 salad bowls
14. Add to each
15. Divide rice pilaf between 4 bowls -- top off with tender crisp vegetables 5 broccoli florets , 3-4 strips of red pepper , 5 green beans , snapped in half , 6 snow pea pods , 1 tblsp toasted almonds1 tblsp shredded carrots
16. Top off with 1 tblsp chinese noodles
17. Dip hot chicken pieces into 3 / 4 cup warmed orange marmalade
18. Place 7-8 pieces of orange chicken on top of salad
19. Serve while still hot --

title: hot chipped beef and chipotle dip
steps:
1. Combine cream cheese , cheese , onion , mayonnaise , garlic powder and chiles
2. Mix well
3. Stir in dried beef
4. Spoon into 1 or 1 1 / 2 quart slow cooker
5. Cover
6. Heat on low setting for 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours
7. Just before serving , sprinkle pecans over top
8. Dip can be kept warm in slower cooker for up to 1 hour
9. Serve with crackers

title: rib eye steaks with roasted red peppers and balsamic vinegar
steps:
1. Whisk oil , 1 t
2. Vinegar , 2 t
3. Garlic , rosemary , and pepper in 13x9x2-inch glass baking dish
4. Add steaks
5. Turn to coat
6. Let stand 1 hour
7. Heat heavy large skillet over high heat
8. Remove steaks from marinade
9. Sprinkle with salt
10. Place in skillet
11. Saute to desired doneness , about 4 minutes per side for medium-rate
12. Transfer to plates
13. Add peppers , 1-1 / 2 t
14. Vinegar , and 1 t
15. Garlic to skillet
16. Stir until heated through , about 1 minute
17. Spoon peppers and pan juices over steaks

title: sweet   sour chicken kebeb with peanut dipping sauce
steps:
1. Cut chicken breasts lengthwise into strips 25mm wide
2. Using one hand to secure chicken , press skewer down the length of one strip
3. Repeat with remaining strips
4. Place skewers in a glass baking dish and set aside
5. Combine sherry , teriyaki sauce and sweet and sour sauce in a small bowl
6. Add garlic , lemon juice and honey
7. Blend thoroughly
8. Pour marinade over skewered chicken , cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes , turning once
9. When ready to cook , drain marinade from the chicken , reserving marinade
10. Arrange skewers directly on a wire rack in a baking dish , being careful not to pack them too tightly together
11. Set heat to 200c and cook in oven for 10 minutes , or simply bbq or grill them until done
12. In the meantime , prepare the dipping sauce
13. Combine peanut butter , lemon juice , chicken broth and remaining marinade in a saucepan
14. Bring to the boil over medium-high heat
15. Reduce heat and simmer sauce for 10 minutes , or just until sauce begins to thicken
16. To serve , arrange chicken skewers on serving platter& serve dipping sauce on the side

title: best ever sloppy joes
steps:
1. In large pan , i use a large electric skillet , brown the ground beef and sausage
2. Drain off the fat
3. Add remaining ingredients to the pan except for the flour and mix well
4. Cook on low heat , stirring occasionally breaking up any large chunks of meat
5. Once mixture has cooked through and is slightly thickend sift flour over the top and mix in well to further thicken

title: belgian endive and beetroot salad
steps:
1. Mix the sour cream with the mustard and add salt and pepper
2. Combine with the rest of the ingredients
3. Variations: use chopped hard-boiled eggs instead of the beets , then leave out the mustard and use some curry powder in the sour cream
4. Add some chopped green onion
5. Use 4-6 oz cubed or chopped cheese of your choice instead of the beets

title: mushroom garlic sauce
steps:
1. In a large saucpan , cook mushrooms , shallots , garlic , curry powder and crushed red pepper in hot oil until the mushrooms are tender
2. Add in 3 / 4 cup chicken broth , soy sauce and nutmeg
3. Bring to boiling
4. In a small cup or bowl whisk together wine and cornstarch until smooth
5. Add to the saucepan
6. Cook and stir until smooth and slightly thickened

title: ally style pasta carbonara
steps:
1. Mix a little of the milk with the cornflour to make a smooth paste
2. Add to the remaining milk and cook in a saucepan over a medium heat , stirring constantly until thickened
3. Add the cheese and stir until combined
4. Add the ham
5. Cook the pasta and stir in the sauce

title: make ahead wraps   oamc
steps:
1. Combine rice , southwest seasoning and water in a saucepan , and bring to a boil
2. Reduce heat to low , cover , and simmer for 35-40 minutes , or until tender
3. Remove from heat , and cool
4. Place black beans and pinto beans into a colander or strainer , and rinse
5. Transfer to a large bowl
6. Add corn , onion , spices and salsa , and toss to mix
7. Mix in rice and cheese
8. Divide the mixture evenly among the tortillas , and roll up
9. Freeze wraps in single layer on lightly greased cookie sheet
10. When fully frozen , wrap individually
11. Place wraps in large zip-top freezer bags
12. Freeze
13. To serve: unwrap wraps from foil or plastic wrap that you used for freezing
14. Wrap in a paper towel
15. Cook in microwave until heated through
16. Or thaw wrap , put foil , and bake at 350f for ten minutes

title: baked chicken with mushrooms and lots of almonds
steps:
1. Saut three quarters of a cup of sliced brown mushrooms , get a slight color change and remove them from the pan
2. Then , make a roux
3. What's a roux ? one tablespoon of butter , one heaping tablespoon of flour cooked about three minutes but not browned
4. Add a half cup of chicken broth and a couple tablespoons of milk or light cream
5. Break an egg , you just need the yoke
6. Put it in a little bowl , add a teaspoon or so of the hot liquid and mix
7. This is called tempering , and it pre heats the egg so when you add it back to the sauce you don't get scrambled eggs
8. This works every time you have to add eggs to something hot
9. Whisk it back in to the sauce
10. Add a good grate of nutmeg
11. In a small baking dish spread a cup of cooked chicken cut in large pieces
12. Spread on the cooked mushrooms and a half cup of sliced water chestnuts
13. Add a half tablespoon of soy sauce to the sauce and pour it over the chicken and mushrooms
14. Sprinkle on a quarter of a cup of slivered almonds (you might try some of those smokehouse to add some zap)
15. Bake , uncovered , for about twenty five minutes in a 350f oven

title: freezer french   toasted muffins
steps:
1. In a small bowl , mix eggs , milk , sugar and vanilla until blended
2. Split muffins in half , and place on a 17x11x1 inch rimmed , greased baking sheet
3. Slowly pour egg mixture over muffins , turning to coat both sides
4. Let stand 5 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed
5. Place muffins in freezer uncovered until frozen
6. Place frozen muffins in zip lock bag , and return to freezer until ready to use
7. To serve muffins
8. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
9. Grease rimmed baking sheet
10. Brush each side of muffin with melted butter or margarine
11. Place on baking sheet - cut - side down
12. Bake 10 minutes , turn slices over
13. Bake 5 minutes longer , or until golden brown and toasted
14. Serve with maple syrup , jam or honey if desired

title: breakfast scramble quesadilla
steps:
1. In a small mixing bowl , combine eggs and tabasco sauce
2. Add the eggs to a non-stick pan and cook to desired doneness
3. Set aside
4. Lightly grill or heat in a skillet one flour tortilla
5. Spread half of parmesan cheese on grilled tortilla
6. Place scrambled eggs on cheese and sprinkle with remaining cheese on egg
7. Top with the second tortilla and carefully flip the entire quesadilla and cook on the other side until cheese begins to melt
8. Sprinkle with tabasco green sauce and serve

title: brown russian
steps:
1. Break up chocolate and melt in 60 mls of the milk over a low heat
2. Stir in remaining milk
3. Heat till very hot and well combined
4. Pour into a mug and add vodka
5. Adorn with whipped cream if desired

title: one pot chicken dish over cheesy rice
steps:
1. Cheesy rice pilaf:
2. In a heavy , medium saucepan , melt the butter over medium-high heat
3. Add the chopped onions and bell peppers and cook until soft , about 4 minutes
4. Add rice , salt , and bay leaf and cook for 1 minute
5. Add the stock and stir
6. Reduce the heat to low , cover , and simmer until the rice is almost tender , about 15 minutes
7. Add the peas , cover and continue simmering until the liquid is absorbed , about 5 minutes
8. Remove from the heat and let sit covered for 10 minutes
9. Remove the bay leaf and fluff the rice with a fork
10. Stir in the cheese and parsley
11. Chicken:
12. In an electric skillet or a large heavy skillet , cook the bacon over medium-high heat , stirring occasionally , until crisp , about 5 minutes
13. Transfer with a slotted spoon to paper towels
14. Season the chicken with the essence , and add to the fat in the pan
15. Cook , stirring occasionally , for 5 minutes
16. Transfer to a plate
17. Melt the butter in the pan
18. Add the onions and pepper and cook until soft , about 4 minutes
19. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds
20. Add the mushrooms and thyme and cook until the mushrooms give off their liquid , about 5 minutes
21. Add the chicken stock and bring to a boil , stirring to deglaze the pan
22. Add the chicken , lower the heat , and simmer until heated through , 1 to 2 minutes
23. Add the bacon and green onions , and stir well
24. Remove from the heat and serve over the cheesy rice pilaf
25. Garnish with parsley

title: mom s rouladen
steps:
1. Lay the cutlets on a flat surface
2. Spread each one with mustard , then sprinkle with salt and pepper
3. Divide the pickles , bacon and onion evenly between the cutlets
4. Roll up jelly roll style and secure with wooden toothpicks
5. Heat the oil in a large saucepan
6. Add the rouladen and brown well on all sides
7. Pour in the broth and add the peppercorns and bay leaf
8. Cover , simmer for 1 hour and 20 minutes
9. Remove the rouladen
10. Keep warm
11. Blend the cornstarch with the cold water and add to the broth in the pan
12. Bring to a boil and cook until thick and bubbly
13. Stir in the sour cream and heat through
14. Adjust the seasonings and serve

title: pesto ties
steps:
1. Prepare your pasta by combining 4 quarts of boiling salted water and farfalle pasta
2. Boil for 10-12 minutes until al dente
3. While the pasta is boiling combine pesto ingredients in food processer
4. Process pesto on highest speed until smooth
5. Drain pasta completely
6. Combine pesto sauce and pasta together in a bowl and garnish with basil leaves
7. Serve on warm plates

title: crock pot black bean salsa chicken  oamc
steps:
1. For immediate cooking:
2. Mix corn , beans and 1 cup of salsa together and put in the bottom of the crock pot
3. Add the chicken
4. Salt and pepper to taste if desired
5. Added 1 more cup of salsa over the top of the chicken
6. Cook on low for 6 hours add 8 oz of cream cheese- cubed and stir in until melted
7. For oamc:
8. You can dump everything into a freezer bag except for the cream cheese and freeze
9. Dump in the crock pot
10. Cook on low for 8 hours
11. Add cream cheese when you are done
12. Good served over cooked rice and dipped into with tortilla chips

title: ras el hanout spice mix
steps: 1. Mix together , and store in an airtight jar

title: halloumi and olives skewers
steps:
1. Brush the cheese and olives with olive oil and skewer alternating onto 4 skewers
2. Place onto a medium hot oiled grill for 2 minutes on each side , or until marked
3. Grill lemons cut side down till marked
4. Remove cheese and sprinkle with oregano
5. Remove lemons
6. Drizzle the olive oil on top and squeeze the lemon juice over the cheese
7. Serve with grilled pita bread

title: south beach diet oatmeal pancakes
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine oats and milk and allow to stand for 10 minutes
2. Stir in egg , flour , wheat germ , baking powder , sugar substitute , oil , and salt
3. Whisk until smooth
4. Let batter stand for 30 minutes in the refrigerator
5. Heat a large non-stick skillet or griddle
6. Spray with cooking spray
7. Pour batter by 1 / 4 cupfuls onto skillet or griddle
8. Cook until the top starts to bubble and the bottom is browned
9. Turn and cook another 1-2 minutes

title: loaded italian bread
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , mix all the ingredients together except the bread
2. Slice the bread in half horizontally and spread the mixture evenly over both sides
3. Put the bread spread side up on a cookie sheet and broil until edges are browned and cheese is melted being careful not to burn it

title: icelandic salmon grill
steps:
1. Place two large pieces of tin foil down
2. Spread sliced onion pieces from one onion , on tin foil the length of the salmon
3. Lay salmon whole or fillet pieces on top of the onion slices
4. Salt & pepper to taste
5. Lightly spread butter or margarine on salmon
6. Sprinkle with your hand , brown sugar over salmon
7. Cover salmon with remaining onion slices
8. Cover salmon with two pieces of tin foil and crimp sides together
9. Place on grill and check after about 10 minute do not over cook the salmon
10. When salmon changes color and can be flaked with a fork your fish is done

title: applesauce  using only apples  to freeze
steps:
1. Place unpeeled apples and water in a large heavy bottomed pot
2. Cover and place over low-med heat , stirring occassionally
3. When apples are soft and still hot , run through a food mill placed over a bowl
4. To freeze: cool place in quart ziplock bags and freeze
5. Makes about 4 quarts

title: crescent roll pastry
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 deg
2. Grease 9x13 pan
3. Pat out 1 can of crescent rolls on bottom of pan , pinching seams together
4. Cream the cream cheese , sugar , egg and vanilla together until well mixed
5. Spread over layer of rolls
6. Pat out second can of rolls on wax paper , pinch seams together and cut into strips
7. Place , latticelike , on top of cheese mixture
8. Bake for 25 minutes or until golden brown
9. While cooling just a bit , mix together the powdered sugar and lemon juice
10. Add enough milk to make mixture a thick syrup consistency
11. Dribble over top of still warm pastry
12. This is very pretty at christmas to decorate with sugared cranberries and mint leaves

title: nutmeg log cookies
steps:
1. Cream together first 3 ingredients and then slowly add sugar
2. Blend in egg
3. Add flour and nutmeg gradually and mix well
4. Shape dough on lightly floured surface into long longs 1 / 2 inch in diameter
5. Cut into 2 inch lengths
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 12- 15 minutes or until golden
7. Drizzle with melted chocolate
8. These freeze very well

title: baked onions topped with french bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cook onions in butter for 15 minutes until real soft
3. Arrange onions in greased 12x7 pan for baking
4. Sprinkle cheese over entire top
5. Blend soup , milk , soy sauce and pepper
6. Pour over cheese and onions and mix slightly
7. Arrange bread over top
8. Bake uncovered for 40 minutes

title: gourmet egg salad sandwich
steps:
1. Place bacon in a large skillet and cook over medium-high heat , turning occasionally , until evenly browned , about 10 minutes
2. Drain bacon slices on paper towels
3. Crumble
4. Preheat oven broiler and set rack about 6 inches from heat source
5. Mix eggs , mayonnaise , mustard , salt , and pepper in a bowl
6. Fold in crumbled bacon
7. Toast sourdough bread under broiler until lightly browned , about 2 minutes
8. Spread pesto evenly on each slice of bread
9. Top with 1 / 4 egg salad mixture and spread to cover completely
10. Top each sandwich with 1 slice jarlsberg cheese
11. Return sandwiches to broiler and cook until cheese is melted , 2 to 3 minutes
12. Served sandwiches warm and open-faced

title: ham and cheese omelet bake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Cut small slit into center of broccoli and cheese sauce pouch
3. Microwave on high for 3 to 4 minutes , rotating pouch 1 / 4 turn once halfway through cooking , set aside to cool slightly
4. Spray bottom only of 9x13 pan with cooking spray
5. Separate dough into 5 biscuits
6. Cut each into 8 pieces
7. Arrange evenly in sprayed dish
8. In large bowl , beat eggs , milk , mustard , salt and pepper with wire whisk until well blended
9. Stir in onion , both cheeses , mushrooms and broccoli cheese mixture
10. Pour mixture over biscuits in dish
11. Press down with back of spoon , making sure all biscuit pieces are covered with egg mixture
12. Bake at 350 for 40 to 50 minutes or until edges are deep golden brown and center is set
13. Let stand 10 minutes before serving
14. Cut into squares

title: stuffed baked tomatoes
steps:
1. Simmer the water , onion , red pepper , jalapeno& green onions until just tender
2. Scoop out the tomatoe pulp
3. Mix the tomatoe pulp , chopped , cooked rice , parsley , soy , basil& cayenne
4. Combine rice mixture and veggies
5. Stuff the tomatoes and sprinkle with the cheese
6. Place in lightly oiled pyrex dish
7. Bake at 375f for 20-25 minutes or until heated through and the cheese is nicely browned

title: cucumber salad  acar ketimun
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. If you prefer a little heat , you can add slices of hot chili peppers to taste
3. Chill and marinate at least 30 minutes before serving

title: snow bunny
steps:
1. Pour the grand marnier into a heatproof toddy glass
2. Add the prepared hot cocoa
3. Stir with a cinnamon stick for the full flavor

title: delicious chocolate chip cookie dough brownies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Grease bottom only of rectangular baking pan , 13x9x2 inches
3. Make brownie mix as directed on package , using oil , water and 2 eggs
4. Spread in pan
5. Make cookie mix as directed on pouch , using butter and 1 egg
6. Drop dough by rounded tablespoonfuls evenly onto brownie batter
7. Press down lightly
8. Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until toothpick inserted 2 inches from side of pan comes out almost clean
9. Cool completely , about 1 hour
10. Frost with frosting

title: kittencal s chili seasoning mix
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Store in an airtight container at room temperature or refrigerate
3. Shake the bottle before using
4. Use any amount desired in recipes

title: filet mignon with lemon parsley butter
steps:
1. For the butter:
2. In a small bowl , combine the butter ingredients
3. Using the back of a fork , mash and stir until evenly distributed
4. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve
5. Allow the filets mignons to stand at room temperature for 20 to 30 minutes before grilling
6. Lightly brush or spray both sides with oil
7. Season evenly with the salt and pepper
8. Grill over direct high heat until cooked to your desired doneness , 8 to 10 minutes for medium-rare , turning once
9. Transfer each filet to a warm serving plate and place a tablespoon of the butter on top to melt
10. Serve warm , after allowing to rest at least 5 minutes

title: carrie s pie crust
steps:
1. Mix flour and salt together , remove 1 / 4 cup of flour mixture to a separate bowl
2. Cut the shortening in to the remaining flour mixture until pebble-ey
3. Add 1 / 4 cup water to 1 / 4 cup flour mixture and stir to make a paste
4. Add paste to flour mixture and mix until ball forms

title: indonesian style chicken curry
steps:
1. Finely grind the coriander and chilli flakes in a spice grinder or mortar and pestle
2. Put the spice mixture into a small food processor with the garlic , onions and ginger and puree to a paste
3. Adding 1-2 tablespoons of water , if necessary
4. Heat the oil in a large casserole or saucepan with lid , over medium-low heat
5. Add the paste
6. Cook , stirring frequently , until fragrant , 5-7 minutes
7. Add lime leaves , cinnamon and lemongrass
8. Cook , stirring occasionally , until cinnamon is fragrant , about 2 minutes
9. Increase the heat to medium , add the chicken and cook , turning once , until golden brown , 8-10 minutes
10. Stir in 1 only cup of coconut milk , 1 1 / 4 cups of water and the salt
11. Simmer , stirring occasionally , until chicken is tender , 40-50 minutes
12. Add the remaining coconut milk
13. Cook for 2 minutes
14. Let cool for 15 minutes before serving with rice , leaving the cinnamon sticks behind

title: sugar cookies  if it has to come to that
steps:
1. Mix flour , sugar , baking powder , nutmeg and butter in bowl until fluffy
2. In a measuring cup , beat eggs and vanilla
3. Pour in cream until the combined liquids reach the 1 cup mark
4. Stir into mix
5. Roll out on floured board
6. Cut out
7. Bake at 375f for 8 minutes
8. Cool and frost

title: soothe aching joints curried celery soup
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large soup pot over medium heat
2. Saut celery , onion and garlic until vegetables soften and onion becomes translucent
3. Add spices , mustard and herbs and saut another minute
4. Add water or stock
5. Bring to a boil , then lower heat and simmer 30 minutes
6. Add peppers before serving

title: leftover lamb   rice casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a medium frying pan saute the onion in butter until soft and lightly browned
3. In a medium sized casserole combine the sauteed onions with the remaining ingredients , add salt and pepper to taste
4. Bake covered for 45 minutes

title: the best homemade mac and cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Boil the elbow noodles until cooked , drain and pour into a greased 9x9 casserole dish
3. Cut 3 / 4 of the bar of 16 oz
4. Sharp cheddar cheese in to small cubes , do the same with the mild cheddar
5. In a 2 quart saucepan melt the butter
6. With a fork mix in flour until it looks like a paste
7. Stir in the milk , and cook until warm
8. Once warm add in cheese and continue cooking until cheese is melted stirring continuously with a fork
9. Once cheese is melted , pour over the noodles
10. Use a fork to move the noodles around to get the cheese mixture to the bottom
11. Bake at 350f for about 30 minutes , or until you see some brown on top
12. Let it sit out for about 15 minute before eating
13. I usually start making the cheese mixture about 5 minute before the noodles are done , it goes a little faster
14. You just don't want to cook the cheese mixture first because it can't sit in the pan

title: chicken and mushroom risotto
steps:
1. Heat a small amount of oil in a large heavy based pot and add the chicken
2. When cooked , remove from the pot and set aside
3. On a high heat , warm a little more oil to the pot and add the garlic and onion
4. Saute until the onion is translucent
5. Add the rice to the pot and stir to coat the grains with the oil and onion
6. Add wine and saffron
7. Stir to combine
8. Add one cup of the stock and continually stir whilst bringing to the boil
9. Turn down to a medium heat
10. When the liquid has almost all been absorbed add another cup of stock and keep stirring continuously
11. Keep repeating step 5 until the rice is cooked
12. I find that i need to use six cups of stock , but quantities can vary from person to person
13. The best technique is to taste the rice after four cups , and keep checking after each cup you add after that
14. When the rice is cooked and almost all liquid has been absorbed stir in the chicken and mushrooms
15. Remove from heat when the mushrooms are starting to look cooked
16. Slowly add in the spinach and stir until the spinach has wilted
17. Add pepper to taste
18. Serve warm
19. If desired , a large handful of parmesan can be added with the chicken and mushrooms , or sprinkled over the top when served

title: baked vegetable crumble
steps:
1. To make the filling , melt the butter in a large pan over low heat
2. Add the garlic and leek , and cook , stirring , for 4 minutes until softened
3. Add the potatoes , carrots , parsnips , broccoli , and tomatoes and cook , stirring occasionally , for 12-15 minutes
4. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute
5. Remove from the heat and gradually stir in the milk and stock
6. Return to the heat and cook , stirring , until thickened
7. Add the herbs and seasoning
8. Simmer for 20 minutes
9. Meanwhile , to make the crumble , put the flour into a large bowl , then rub in the butter until the mixture resembles bread crumbs
10. Add the cheese , walnuts , almonds , and thyme and mix well
11. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
12. Remove the vegetable mixture from the heat and transfer to an ovenproof dish
13. Spoon the crumble over the top and press down gently
14. Bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes , or until golden and the vegetables are cooked through
15. Serve hot

title: banana oatmeal muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Grease a muffin pan
3. In a large bowl , whisk together flour , brown sugar , baking powder and soda
4. In another bowl stir together oats and yogurt , stirring in banana , oil and egg
5. Stir mixture into flour mixture and stir until moistened
6. Put in muffin pans and bake for 20- 25 minute until done

title: chicken lemon   cream cheese
steps:
1. Cut the chicken breast in small pieces ,
2. Put olive oil in a pan ,
3. Add the chicken in the pan ,
4. Brown the chicken for 15 min ,
5. Pour the lemon juice ,
6. Let it evaporate and
7. Slowly add cream cheese mixing
8. After it has thickened ,
9. Place in serving dish and
10. Sprinkle with the herbs

title: light artichoke tomato pasta sauce
steps:
1. Sautee garlic and onion and garlic in 1 / 2 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat for 2-5 minutes
2. Add additional 1 / 2 tablespoon of olive oil and mushrooms and sautee for another 5 minutes , until mushrooms are tender
3. Add additional ingredients , bring to a boil , reduce heat , cover for 15-20 minutes
4. Serve over your favorite style whole wheat pasta

title: quiche   spinach and bacon
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Melt butter over low heat
3. Add flour and stir until smooth
4. Add milk and continue stirring
5. Slowly add eggs , then stir in the rest of the ingredients
6. Pour the mixture into the crust in a 9 inch pie pan
7. Bake for 40 minutes

title: slow cooker bacon jam
steps:
1. In a large skillet , cook bacon over medium-high , stirring occasionally , until fat is rendered and bacon is lightly browned , about 20 minutes
2. With a slotted spoon , transfer bacon to paper towels to drain
3. Pour off all but 1 tablespoon fat from skillet and add onions and garlic
4. Cook until onions are translucent , about 6 minutes
5. Add vinegar , brown sugar , maple syrup , and coffee and bring to a boil , stirring and scraping up browned bits from skillet with a wooden spoon , about 2 minutes
6. Add bacon and stir to combine
7. Transfer mixture to a 6-quart slow cooker and cook on high , uncovered , until liquid is syrupy , 3 1 / 2 to 4 hours
8. Transfer to a food processor
9. Pulse until coarsely chopped
10. Let cool , then refrigerate in airtight containers , up to 4 weeks

title: skillet shepherds pie
steps:
1. In a large skillet , combine all the ingredients except the potatoes over high heat
2. Mix well
3. Cook for 5 to 8 minutes , or until heated through , stirring frequently
4. Remove from the heat and dollop with the potatoes
5. Serve immediately
6. You can use prepackaged chicken and potatoes

title: beet wine
steps:
1. Pare and quarter beets
2. Boil in water till tender
3. Let stand 24 hours
4. Remove beets
5. Add enough water to make one full gallon of liquid
6. Add sugar and pepper
7. Boil 10 minutes
8. Strain through cloth into clay crock
9. Spread yeast on a slice of bread which has been thoroughly dried in the oven
10. Place in lukewarm liquid
11. Let ferment 10 days
12. Bottle
13. Do not cork tightly

title: asian sesame chicken
steps:
1. Combine sesame seeds , breadcrumbs , and salt in pie plate
2. Beat egg in medium bowl
3. Dip chicken in egg
4. Dip both sides chicken in sesame seed mixture to coat
5. Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
6. Cook chicken 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through
7. Transfer to plate
8. Whisk vinegar , pepper , onion , sugar , ginger , salt and crushed red pepper in a medium bowl
9. Whisk in oil
10. Toss chicken in with the dressing
11. Transfer in a plate
12. Serve with hot rice

title: peanut butter crumble
steps:
1. Pre heat oven to 350 degrees farenheit
2. Spray pan with non-stick cooking spray or grease with oil and flour
3. Combine all ingredients in a bowl and beat together very important to beat the mixture
4. Drop by rounded spoonfuls onto pan , about 2 inches apart , bake for 10-12 minutes

title: mel s infamous b l p
steps:
1. Toast your bread
2. Cook the bacon you need for this sandwich and any blts being served but for this sammy you'll need two crispy slices
3. Spread the peanut butter on one toasted bread slice , top with the slices of bacon and lettuce)
4. Place other bread slice on top
5. Slice diagonally if you want a fancy plate or directly across for those quick lunches
6. Take a bite and then say yummmmmm

title: hotel condon corn bread
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees
2. In a large bowl , whisk together the eggs
3. Then add the creamed corn , and melted butter
4. Whisk in the sugar until blended
5. In a small bowl , whisk together the flour , cornmeal and baking powder
6. Slowly add the flour mixture into the large bowl until combined
7. Fold in the diced chiles and cheese until combined
8. Place the mixture into a greased 10-inch round cake pan and smooth the top of the batter
9. Bake until the top is golden brown and a toothpick inserted into the center of the bread comes out clean , about 30 minutes
10. Remove from the oven and cool the bread for 15 minutes on a rack
11. Invert the bread onto a platter and drizzle with honey
12. Cool completely , then cut and serve

title: chocolate belton cream pie
steps:
1. Cake:
2. Spray two 9" round or square cake pans with cooking spray
3. Mix all ingredients together
4. Pour into cake pans
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes , or till a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
6. Remove from oven
7. Allow to cool
8. Place one layer on cake plate
9. Spread with pudding
10. Top with second layer
11. Pour fudge glaze over the top
12. Refrigerate till serving time
13. Pudding:
14. Place sugar , flour , salt , cocoa in 2 quart saucepan
15. Whisk till lumps are gone
16. Add cream
17. Whisk till well blended
18. Cook over medium heat till thick and bubbly
19. Remove from heat
20. Add vanilla
21. Stir till well blended
22. Allow to cool
23. Spread over first cake layer
24. Top with second cake layer
25. Fudge glaze:
26. In 2 quart saucepan , melt butter
27. Add cocoa and cream
28. Stir well
29. Cook over medium heat till it bubbles
30. Remove from heat
31. Add powdered sugar
32. Stir till lumps are gone
33. Pour over top of cake , spreading to cover all , allowing it to run down sides
34. Cover cake
35. Place in refrigerator till serving time

title: manchego chorizo puffs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f degrees
2. On floured surface , unroll pastry
3. Roll out to approximately a 10 inch square , about 1 / 4 inch thick
4. Using a 3 inch round cutter , cut out 16 rounds , gathering and re-rolling scraps as necessary
5. In a bowl , mix chorizo with cheese
6. Place scant 1 tablespoon in center of each round
7. Lightly brush edges with water
8. Fold pastry over to create half moon shapes
9. Pinch edges to seal
10. Place on parchment paper-lined rimmed baking sheet
11. In a small bowl , whisk together egg , 2 teaspoons water and paprika
12. Brush on tops of puffs
13. Bake on center rack of 450f degree oven , 10 to 12 minutes until golden

title: spiced squash and apple soup
steps:
1. Melt the butter and olive oil in a soup pot over moderate heat
2. Add the diced onions and apples and cook until tender , about 10 minutes
3. Stir in the spices , cook for one minute
4. Add the squash and chicken stock , bring to a boil , reduce the heat , and simmer , uncovered , until the squash is very tender , about 20-30 minutes
5. In a blender or food processor , puree the vegetables in batches with a little bit of the stock
6. Transfer puree mixture into a large bowl
7. Stir in enough of the remaining stock to make a medium-thick soup
8. Reserve any leftover stock if not serving right away , as the soup may thicken on standing
9. This is rich broth so if you have any left just add it to your favorite homemade soup or freeze for another use
10. Season with salt and pepper and adjust the spices
11. This soup may be made a day ahead , refrigerated uncovered until cold and then covered to store
12. To serve , in a large pot heat the soup almost to scalding
13. Ladle into bowls and top with thin slices of apple

title: linda s awesome home fries
steps:
1. In a lg
2. Cast iron frying pan add olive oil
3. Fry sliced onions on med-high , for about 5 minutes and often so they don't stick
4. Push onions to one side of the frying pan , and add raw chopped potatoes
5. Cook potatoes and onions turning often to brown evenly
6. When potatoes are a golden brown , mix onions in with potatoes
7. Add garlic , and mix in with potatoes and onions
8. Add tony chachere's creole seasoning
9. Mix in with potatoes
10. Salt and pepper , to taste
11. Serve

title: vanilla pound cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Combine sugar and melted butter in large bowl
3. Beat at medium speed , scraping bowl often , until creamy
4. Add eggs , , one at a time , beating well after each addition
5. Add vanilla
6. Beat until well mixed
7. Stir together flour and baking powder in small bowl
8. Gradually add flour mixture alternately with milk to butter mixture , beating at low speed until well mixed
9. Pour batter into greased and floured 10-inch angel food cake pan
10. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
11. Cool 10 minutes
12. Remove from pan

title: celtic homemade pratie oaten
steps:
1. Work enough of the oatmeal into the mashed potatoes to form a soft dough
2. Add salt to taste and enough melted butter or lard to bind it together
3. Scatter oatmeal on a cutting board and roll out dough
4. Cut into triangular wedges and cook on both sides on a hot greased griddle in the oven , or fry on the stove
5. Serve hot or cold

title: steak and potato casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degree season meat with seasonings
2. In large skillet over medium high heat , saute the meat until well browned on all sides
3. Next , place the potatoes , onions , green peppers and mushrooms over the meat
4. Top with salad dressing , and cover with foil
5. Bake at 350 degree for 1 hour , or until potatoes are done and meat is tender

title: hood river salad
steps:
1. Toast the almonds on medium-low heat in a non stick pan , just until light brown , stirring so they don't burn
2. Make the dressing and shake till sugar is dissolved , then refrigerate
3. You can make this salad an hour or so ahead by tossing the torn romaine , raisins and almonds together
4. At the last minute add the freshly diced avocado and the bacon , then toss all with the dressing just before serving
5. Nobody tastes the difference , including me , so i do this and it's a huge time saver

title: bratwurst potato skillet dinner
steps:
1. In a large heavy skillet heat the oil over medium heat
2. Cook the potatoes until they are lightly browned and crisp-tender , about 20 minutes turning occasionally
3. Add the bratwurst , onion , and red and yellow bell peppers
4. Stirring occasionally , cook until the vegetables are crisp-tender and heated through , 10-15 minutes
5. Combine the teriyaki sauce , orange juice , basil , and pepper in a small bowl
6. Stir the sauce mixture into the brats and vegetables , and heat through , about 5-10 minutes
7. We served this with stone ground mustard on the side for dipping the brats

title: tiny whole wheat pepper scones
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees
2. Mix flours , baking powder , baking soda , pepper , and salt in mixing bowl
3. Cut in shortening and butter with pastry blender until mixture resembles oatmeal
4. Add egg and yogurt
5. Mix with fork just until dough comes together
6. Turn dough out onto well-floured surface and knead gently about 8 turns
7. Roll or pat dough 1 inch thick
8. Cut out scones , using 1-1 / 4" round cutter
9. Place 1 / 2 inch apart on nonstick baking sheets
10. Bake scones until puffed and golden brown , 12-15 minutes
11. Transfer to rack and let cool several minutes before serving

title: brown rice and edamame
steps:
1. In a med saucepan , bring 1 1 / 2 cups lightly salted water to boil
2. Add rice , reduce to a simmer
3. Cover and cook , 30 minutes
4. Stir in edamame
5. Cover and cook until rice is tender , 15 to 20 minutes
6. In a small bowl , stir together lime juice , vinegar , oil , chili flakes and sugar until sugar is dissolved
7. With a fork , stir in lime juice mixture and scalliions into rice
8. Season with salt and pepper

title: fruited blueberry nut cake
steps:
1. Spray interior of slow cooker with non stick cooking spray
2. Place pie filling in slow cooker
3. In a mixing bowl , combine dry cake mix , and butter
4. Spoon over filling
5. Drop walnuts over top
6. Cover , and cook on low for 3-5 hours or until a toothpick inserted into center comes out clean

title: fresh strawberry cream cheese coffee cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine cream cheese , butter and sugar
3. Beat until light and fluffy
4. Stir in milk , eggs and vanilla
5. Sift together flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
6. Add to cheese mixture and mix until smooth
7. Spread half the batter in a greased and floured 13x9 inch baking pan
8. Spread berries evenly over batter
9. Dot remaining batter over berries
10. Mix brown sugar and nuts
11. Sprinkle evenly over cake
12. Bake 40 minutes
13. Serve warm or cold

title: honey glazed brandied carrots
steps:
1. Cook carrots in salted water until they are tender
2. Drain
3. In a skillet , place carrots and remaining ingredients
4. Cook and stir until carrots are glazed and glossy

title: brown rice and cheese
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 300f
2. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish
3. Saute celery , onion and mushrooms in oil until tender
4. Mix with remaining ingredients
5. Put into greased baking dish and bake for 25-30 minutes

title: chilean fish bake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 450f
2. Place chilean sea bass fillet , cut into 6 pieces , into greased 9 x13 glass dish
3. From the two tangerines , zest and juice 1
4. Peel and segment the other one
5. Top the fillets with the tangerine segments , chopped scallions , and garlic
6. Pour 1 / 3 cup tangerine juice and 1 tsp zest over fish
7. Dot with 2 tbsp unsalted butter , cubed
8. Cook 10 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork
9. Add pepper to taste , and enjoy !

title: sugar and spice candied pecans
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Butter large cookies sheets
3. Heat in a saucepan melted butter , water and sugar till sugar is dissolved , add spices and pecans stirring till well coated about 3-5 minutes
4. Transfer to cookie sheet and bake until golden about 10 minutes
5. Cool store in airtight containers

title: potatoes on the half shell
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f degrees
2. Scrub the potatoes and place them in the oven until done , about 1 hour
3. Cut each potato in half , lengthwise
4. Carefully , scoop out the potato and place in a bowl
5. Set the potato shells aside to use later
6. While still hot , mash the potatoes with the milk , beaten egg , and butter
7. Beat until fluffy
8. Season with salt and pepper , to taste
9. Add in the onion
10. Spread the potato shells with butter and fill each shell with the potato mixture
11. Sprinkle the tops with parmesan cheese
