12. Bake until tops are browned

title: ham   broccoli breakfast casserole
steps:
1. In a 9x13x2-inch baking dish , put enough of the bread pieces into the bottom of the pan to make a thin layer
2. Make a layer of ham , followed by a layer of broccoli , and then the cheese
3. Whisk together milk , eggs , salt , and dry mustard
4. Pour over top
5. Toss remaining bread with butter
6. Sprinkle over the top of the casserole
7. Bake at 325 for 45 minutes
8. Let cool for about 20 minutes
9. Cut into squares

title: a fuzzy thing
steps:
1. Pour alcohol first , then add the juice
2. A little sour mix is needed , but not enough to overpower the juice
3. Shake before serving , and make sure there isn't too much ice in the drink

title: baked ham with spiced cherry glaze
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Line a roasting pan with foil for easy clean-up
3. Score top & sides of ham in a crisscross pattern
4. Put ham in pan , pour 1 / 2 c water or white wine into bottom of pan and bake , covered loosely with a tent of foil , 45-60 minutes
5. To make the glaze , combine the preserves , horseradish , brown sugar , cinnamon , cumin , cardimom , salt and lemon juice in a small saucepan and bring to a boil over medium heat
6. Boil until slightly thickened , 2-3 minutes
7. Remove from heat and stir in lemon zest
8. Remove ham from oven and brush with 1 / 4c of glaze
9. Bake uncovered for another 20 minutes or until thermometer hits 140 degrees internal
10. Remove ham from oven and let rest for 10 minutes before slicing
11. Arrange sliced ham on platter and serve with reserved glaze

title: herb crusted sole with garlic basil sauce
steps:
1. Preheat the grill to medium-high and coat grill rack with nonstick cooking spray
2. Sprinkle filets evenly with salt and pepper
3. Combine lemon peel , 2 garlic cloves , 2 tbsp of basil , 2 tbsp of parsley in a shallow bowl
4. Gently press both sides of filets into garlic mixture
5. Coat filets evenly with cooking spray
6. Grill filets on rack , covered with grill lid , 5 to 7 minutes on each side or until fish flakes with a fork
7. Arrange filets on serving platter
8. Cover and keep warm
9. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat
10. Add remaining garlic and cook 1 minute
11. Add remaining basil , parsley and the lemon juice
12. Bring to a boil
13. Remove from heat
14. Spoon sauce over fish
15. Serve immediately

title: moroccan beef   cauliflower
steps:
1. Pull off the green leaves surrounding the cauliflower
2. Then cut the bottom off & break the cauliflower into large pieces
3. Rinse & then place in a bowl to be used later
4. Heat the olive oil in either a sauce pan or pressure cooker
5. Cook the beef in the oil until all the sides are brown
6. Add enough water in the pot to cover the beef
7. At this point put everything into the pot except the cauliflower and cover with a lid
8. If using a sauce pan simmer the beef for 40 minutes , stirring occasionally
9. If you are using a pressure cooker , let the beef cook for 15 minutes
10. Dip the cauliflower into the sauce to cover all the sides
11. Once that is done leave it in the pot & recover with a lid
12. Simmer for another 15 minutes or until the cauliflower is done
13. If using a pressure cooker , cover & cook for additional 5-7 minutes

title: vegan vegetable pot pie
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine all of the dried ingredients for the crust
2. Stir with a fork while slowly drizzling in the olive oil
3. Then , - c at a time , pour in the water and knead by hand until you get a firm , moist dough
4. Form into a ball , set it in a bowl and chill it in the refrigerator
5. While the dough is chilling , preheat the oven to 400 degrees and bring the broth to a boil in a saucepan
6. Turn the heat to medium-low and slowly sift in the flour while whisking the broth
7. When the last of the flour is in , the broth should be much thicker
8. Turn off the heat and set aside
9. Take the dough out of the refrigerator and lightly dust the work surface with flour
10. Split the dough in half
11. Roll out the dough until it's 2-3 inches wider than the pie plate
12. Lightly coat the plate in oil and dust with flour
13. Lay the crust in the plate and make sure it is evenly covering the plate
14. Put the frozen vegetables into the pie in an even layer
15. Cover with the gravy and sprinkle with the seasonings
16. Roll out the rest of the dough and cover the pie
17. Trim off the excess crust and seal shut by pressing with a fork all the way around the edge
18. Make a few puncture holes in the top of the crust to vent any steam
19. Place the pie in the oven for 40 minutes , or until the edges are brown and the top is dry
20. Let cool for at least ten to fifteen minutes before cutting
21. This will allow the gravy to thicken up a bit
22. Cut into the pie and check
23. If the gravy is still pretty thin and soupy , let it cool for a while longer

title: cinnamon candy
steps:
1. In a sauce pan , bring syrup and sugar to the hard- crack stage , to about 300 to 310 degrees
2. Add cinnamon oil and food coloring
3. Stir quickly and pour into a well greased pan
4. Let candy harden
5. Crack into pieces and coat with powdered sugar

title: elena s garbanzo ceviche
steps:
1. Mix together and chill for several hours or overnight
2. Serve with crackers

title: peanut  butter cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375
2. Beat peanut butter , water , eggs and half the cake mix until smooth
3. Stir in remaining cake mix
4. Using a #40 cookie scoop , drop dough 3 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet
5. Press floured thumb deeply into the center of each mound
6. Bake 8-10 minutes or until the cookies just start to turn golden brown
7. Do not overcook ! cool slightly before removing from baking sheet

title: mango strawberry fool
steps:
1. Peel the mangoes and remove the pulp from the seed , trying to keep at least 4 nice slices of mango intact for garnish
2. Set them aside
3. In a food processor , puree the remaining pulp to a very fine puree with the salt
4. Strain through a fine mesh strainer , pushing hard on the solids
5. Chill your mixer bowl and whip in the freezer for 10 minutes
6. Whip the cream and sugar until soft peaks form
7. Carefully , carefully fold the cream into the mango
8. Wash , dry and hull the strawberries
9. Slice into quarters
10. Into each glass put a spoonful of strawberry pieces
11. Top with a dollop of mango-cream
12. Top with more berries , then more mango , continuing in layers this way until you have filled the glasses
13. End each with the mango-cream
14. Garnish each with one of the reserved slices of mango and a little mint sprig
15. Serve immediately
16. But you can prepare the mango cream and strawberries up to the point of layering several hours a head
17. Get your glasses out and ready , and then just layer before service

title: creamy crab and portabella pasta
steps:
1. Follow instructions on box to cook pasta , while the water is coming to a boil and your cooking the pasta make the sauce as follows
2. In a saucepan over medium-low heat , melt the butter and cream cheese together , stirring occasionally to blend
3. Add the diced onion and garlic while stirring
4. Once smooth add the milk and stir to blend , stir in cheese until melted
5. Add crab , portabella and old bay
6. Bring to a light simmer
7. Thin sauce with additional milk if desired
8. Toss with cooked pasta

title: chicken with roasted garlic   parmesan sauce
steps:
1. Coat garlic gloves with olive oil and wrap tightly in foil , roast in a 450 degree oven for 15-20 minutes or until soft
2. Remove from foil and mash well
3. Brown chicken breasts in olive oil , not cooking the chicken through at this point but adding color
4. Remove when finished and set into a casserole dish
5. Deglaze the sauce pan with the white wine and let boil
6. Add chicken stock , parsley and roasted garlic
7. Allow to simmer
8. Add milk and cream cheese , stirring until it is incorporated , and then add the parmesan cheese
9. Whisk until smooth
10. Add black pepper to taste and salt if needed
11. Pour over the chicken and bake uncovered in a 350 degree oven for 25-35 minutes or until chicken is cooked through
12. Serve sauce over mashed potatoes or pasta
13. If it is too thin , return to a saucepan and mix together one tablespoon water and one tablespoon of corn starch and whisk into sauce when simmering

title: sweet potato angel biscuits
steps:
1. Combine yeast and 3 / 4 cup warm water in a 2 cup liquid measuring cup
2. Let stand 5 minutes
3. Stir together flour and next 3 ingredients in a bowl
4. Cut in shortening with a pastry blender until mixture is crumbly
5. Stir in yeast mixture and mashe sweet potatoes just until blended
6. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface , and knead until smooth and elastic , about 5 minutes
7. Place dough in a well-greased bowl , turning to grease top
8. Cover and chill 8 hours , if desired
9. Roll dough to 1 / 2 inch thickness
10. Cut with a 2 inch round cutter
11. Freeze up to 1 month , if desired
12. Thaw biscuits
13. Place on ungreased baking sheets
14. Cover and let rise in a warm place 20 minutes or until doubled in bulk
15. Bake at 400 for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned

title: claire s mexican bean soup
steps:
1. In a 2 quart sauce pan cook bacon until crisp
2. Add onion , celery , and garlic
3. Cook covered over low heat stirring occasionally for 10 minutes
4. Add remaining ingredients
5. Bring to boil
6. When heated through , serve in bowls and top with cheese
7. Serve with chips

title: professional cream cheese buttercream frosting
steps:
1. In a large bowl cream together shortening and butter
2. Stop and scrape down , start again till creamy
3. Add cut-up cream cheese and cream again , scraping down sides till fluffy on high
4. Add vanilla extract and blend
5. Add at time confectioner's sugar , starting on low speed as to not spray sugar all over , then increase speed till blended each time and scrape down each time
6. You may add salt if you need to
7. Turn on high speed for 15 minutes to make frosting blended , smooth and fluffy
8. Also you may have to chill frosting after completed

title: quick spinach and alfredo pizza
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400f
2. Spread the dough onto a baking sheet
3. In a bowl mix the alfredo sauce and spinach
4. Spread on to the pizza dough
5. Top with mozzarella and any other desired toppings
6. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese
7. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes

title: wild rice broccoli casserole
steps:
1. Cook rice mixture as directed
2. Cook broccoli until cunchy
3. Mix soup and cheese
4. Butter the casserole dish
5. Alternate cheese-soup mixture , broccoli and rice in layers
6. Sprinkle with additional grated cheese
7. Cook at 350 for 45- 60 minutes

title: stuffed pita mexican style  torta arabe
steps:
1. Carefully cut open pita bread 2 / 3 down , but not entirely
2. Optional-- spread some butter on each inner flap
3. Spread a thin refried bean layer on each inner flap
4. Continue filling with rest of ingredients
5. Finish off with a few drops of lime juiceand a sprinkling of your favorite mexican chile sauce
6. Carefully transfer to pancake type of grill and lightly toast or fry golden brown on both sides
7. Careful when turning over-- would be best to use long ice cube type prongs to keep filling inside when turning
8. --donot overstuff , of course !
9. Just before eating add some sour cream , if desired

title: pork chop potato casserole
steps:
1. Sprinkle pork chops with seasoned salt
2. In a skillet , brown chops on both sides in oil
3. In a large bowl , combine the soup , milk , sour cream , salt and pepper
4. Stir in hash browns , 2 / 4 cup cheese and half of the onions
5. Spread into a greased baking dish
6. Arrange pork chops on top
7. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes
8. Uncover
9. Sprinkle with the remaining cheese and onion
10. Bake , uncovered , 5-10 minutes longer or until potatoes are tender , cheese is melted and meat juices run clear

title: salad bar bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Blend all ingredients in bowl , full thoroughly mixed
3. , divide batter into 2 greased 9x5 loaf pans --
4. Bake 1 hour -- let cool 10 minutes
5. Then remove from pans to cool completley on wire rack

title: layered cauliflower salad
steps:
1. In an oblong dish , layer first lettuce then cauliflower
2. Spread mayonnaise over cauliflower , then make a layer of chopped onion
3. Spread bacon over the onion , then make a layer of parmesan cheese
4. Last , spread the sugar over the cheese
5. Refrigerate overnight , then toss before serving

title: impossible bisquick pumpkin pie
steps:
1. Place ingredients in blender and blend till smooth
2. Put in oiled pie pan
3. Place n oven and bake at 350 degrees for 30 min or until fork n middle comes out clean

title: aunt martha s country green beans
steps:
1. Using a large pan , put all the ingredients in the pan
2. Bring to a boil
3. Cook for approximately two and a half hours
4. If needed add more water
5. Make sure the beans are really tender before serving

title: simple and healhy penne with chicken  broccoli and cherry tomato
steps:
1. Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper cut into bite size pieces and brown in a skillet
2. Cook pasta according to package directions
3. After 7 minutes , add broccoli to the water
4. Cook three more minutes and then drain
5. Add broth and garlic to the skillet and boil until reduced by half
6. Add tomatoes and over low heat cook until color brightens and are soft to the touch
7. Add cheese and stir until well blendedadd everything together and top with parsely

title: daube de boeuf a la provencale
steps:
1. Mix olive oil through onions and marinate steak in refrigerator at least 6 hours , basting and turning meat several times
2. Scrape marinade off meat and reserve
3. Season meat lightly with salt and pepper
4. Roll in flour and set aside on waxed paper
5. In a bowl toss marinade with tomatoes and mushrooms
6. Place 1 / 3 of mixed vegetables in bottom of 6 quart flame-proof casserole
7. Alternate layers of meat and vegetables , ending with vegetables
8. Pour in any left-over marinade
9. Cover , set over moderate heat and simmer 15 minutes
10. If vegetables have not rendered enough liquid to almost cover meat , add a little bouillon
11. Cover and simmer 1-2 hours until meat is tender when pierced
12. If liquid has not reduced and thickened , drain out into a saucepan and thicken with 1 tbs cornstarch mixed with bouillon , boil 2 minutes , then pour into casserole
13. Chop or pure garlic and mash with capers
14. Beat in mustard
15. Gradually beat in olive oil to make a thick sauce
16. Stir in basil or parsley just before serving

title: key lime  bar cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray the bottom and sides of a 9x13 inch cake pan with nonstick spray
3. Crust:
4. Combine butter and confectioner's sugar in the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with paddle attachment
5. Beat on medium high for 2-3 minutes , until light and fluffy
6. Add flour and salt , and mix one more minute , until well combined
7. Move the dough to the prepared cake pan
8. Pat out to an even thickness over the bottom of the pan
9. Bake the crust for 20-25 minutes , until lightly golden
10. Remove from the oven , and cool on a baking rack
11. Topping:
12. Whisk the eggs and sugar together in a large bowl
13. Add the flour , and whisk until just combined , then whisk in the lime juice and zest
14. Pour the lime topping over the cooled crust , then bake for 25 more minutes , or until filling is set
15. Let the bars cool completely
16. Liberally dust with confectioner's sugar and cut into squares
17. For the neatest presentation , use a meta spatula to remove the bars from the pan
18. Leftovers will keep for 2-3 days at room temperature , or for up to a week in the fridge
19. Enjoy !
20. The cookie crust dough can be prepared up to 2 days in advance , then wrapped in plastic and stored in the fridge
21. When you're ready to bake the bars , bring the dough to room temperature and pat out as described above

title: terrine de saumon aux epinards
steps:
1. Cook the spinach for 7 minutes in salted boiling water
2. Cool under cold water then drain and squeeze out as much water as you can
3. Butter 4 souffle dishes and line them with the salmon leaves
4. Salt to taste
5. Leave a large enough part outside the dish so that you can fold it back later
6. Finely chop the spinach and put in large bowl
7. Add the cream , eggs , nutmeg , salt and pepper and mix
8. Evenly fill the 4 dishes with spinach mixture and cover with the outside part of the salmon leaves
9. Bake in preheated oven at 400f for 10 minutes
10. Invert the dishes on serving plates to remove terrines
11. Serve them right away on a rice pilaf

title: basic sour cream white cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Generously grease and flour a 13 x 9 inch baking pan
3. Place cake mix , sour cream , oil , eggs , and vanilla in mixing bowl
4. Blend with mixer on low speed for 1 minute
5. Stop machine , scrape down sides of bowl
6. Increase mixer speed to medium and beat 2 minutes more
7. Scrape down sides again if needed
8. The batter should look well combined and thickened
9. Pour the batter into the prepared pan
10. Place pan in oven
11. Bake the cake until it is light brown and springs back when lightly pressed with your finger , 35-40 minutes
12. Remove pan from oven and place on wire rack to cool for 20 minutes
13. Run a dinner knife around edge of cake and invert it onto wire rack
14. Allow cake to cool completely , 30 minutes
15. Frost as desired

title: seoul food bbq skewers oamc  dinner kit
steps:
1. In a large freezer bag place all of the ingredients except the bamboo skewers
2. Mix the ingredients together until well blended
3. Seal the bag
4. Print this recipe and place baggie of meat / marinade and recipe into a 2nd large freezer bag , seal
5. At this point i choose to tape the skewers to the outside of the bag
6. To cook:
7. Thaw completely in fridge overnight
8. Remove bamboo skewers from the freezer bag , and soak in water for at least one half hour do not skip this step !
9. Pull the steak from the marinade , and throw away the remaining marinade and the bag
10. Thread the steak onto the soaked bamboo skewers
11. In a snake like motion
12. Lightly coat your grill with cooking spray before you preheat to high
13. Once the grill is nice and hot , grill the bbq skewers for 3 minutes on each side or until done to your liking
14. Remove the skewers and serve right away
15. This can also be done stove top like a stir fry
16. Saut beef in 1 tablespoon of olive oil until desired doneness

title: butter bean   basil dip
steps:
1. Wash the zucchini , but leave it whole
2. Cook in a pan of simmering water until very soft - about 20 minutes
3. Drain and rinse the butter beans
4. Top and tail the zucchini , squeeze most of the water out of it and chop roughly
5. Put all ingredients into a blender or food processor and puree until smooth
6. Leave for flavours to blend for at least 30 minutes , then serve with dippers such as breadsticks or carrot sticks

title: wonderful country  coconut cream pie
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , combine half-and-half , eggs , sugar , flour and salt
2. Bring to a boil over low heat , stirring constantly
3. Remove from heat , and stir in 3 / 4 cup of the coconut and the vanilla extract
4. Pour into pie shell and chill 2 to 4 hours , or until firm
5. Top with whipped topping , and with remaining 1 / 4 cup of coconut

title: kim s tiger butter
steps:
1. Place white chocolate wafers and peanut butter in a large , microwave-safe glass bowl
2. Microwave at 50% power for 2-3 minutes
3. Stir and microwave for an additional 2-3 minutes until completely melted
4. The time required will depend on your microwave
5. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper
6. Spread the white chocolate-peanut butter mixture evenly on the lined baking sheet
7. Melt the chocolate chips in a small bowl in the microwave
8. This should take less than a minute at 50% power
9. Drop spoonfuls of melted chocolate randomly on the white chocolate mixture
10. Use a skewer or the
11. Cool , break into bite size pieces or use a bench knife to cut into small squares

title: pumpkin bread with an orange spice glaze
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease 2 8"x4" loaf pans
3. In a large mixing bowl , cream together oil , eggs , pumpkin and sugar
4. Stir in orange juice
5. In another mixing bowl , sift together flour , baking soda , baking powder , salt , cloves , cinnamon and nutmeg
6. Combine both mixtures and mix well
7. Spoon batter into pans and bake for 50-60 minutes
8. Cool in pans for 10 minutes and turn onto wire racks to finish cooling
9. Combine glaze ingredients and brush on warm , but not hot , bread

title: emeril s chocolate peanut butter pie
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375f
2. Combine the graham cracker crumbs , oreo cookie crumbs , butter , and 4 tablespoons of the granulated sugar in a medium bowl
3. Stir to thoroughly combine
4. Press the mixture firmly into a 9-inch pie pan and bake for 15 minutes
5. Remove the pan from the oven , let the crust cool completely , then wrap it with plastic wrap and place the pan in the freezer for at least 1 hour and for up to 2 weeks
6. Allow the crust to come to room temperature before filling
7. Combine the cream cheese , confectioners' sugar , and milk in a large bowl
8. Beat with an electric mixer until well blended and smooth , about 1 minute on medium speed
9. Add the melted chocolate and the peanut butter and continue to blend for another minute on medium speed
10. Combine the cream with the remaining 2 tablespoons granulated sugar in another medium bowl
11. Beat with a whisk or electric mixer until stiff peaks form
12. Gently fold the whipped cream into the chocolate and peanut butter mixture until thoroughly incorporated and smooth
13. Pour the filling into the pie crust
14. Smooth the top of the pie with a spatula , cover , and refrigerate for at least 4 hours before serving
15. To serve , use a hot wet knife to slice the pie into 8 portions
16. Garnish with the peanuts and drizzle with the rich chocolate sauce
17. Rich chocolate sauce:
18. In a small heavy saucepan , bring the half-and-half to a bare simmer over medium-low heat
19. Remove from the heat
20. Place the chocolate in a medium heatproof bowl
21. Whisk the half-and-half slowly into the chocolate
22. Add the vanilla and butter to the sauce and whisk until the butter is completely incorporated
23. The sauce can be kept refrigerated in an airtight container for several days , but it must be returned to room temperature before serving

title: curried turkey strips
steps:
1. Slice turkey breast into strips
2. In a medium bowl combine all dry ingredients
3. In a separate bowl beat egg
4. Using one hand for the wet and the other for the dry , dredge the turkey in the egg followed by the flour mixture
5. Repeat until all strips are coated
6. Drizzle about a tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat
7. Place turkey strips in skillet , cook for 3-4 minutes
8. Flip strips , cook an additional 3-4 minutes until cooked through , taking care to not overcook or the turkey will become incredibly dry

title: not your grandma s rice krispie bars
steps:
1. Melt butter and marshmallows in a large bowl in the microwave or a pot on the stove
2. Mix in cake mix by the spoonful until all is mixed
3. Mix in rice krispies until they are all coated in the goo
4. Spray 9 x 12 pan with cooking spray
5. Press into pan
6. Top with sprinkles
7. Let cool before serving

title: low fat choc orange cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180deg c
2. Beat egg whites and sugar together for 1 minute
3. Stir baking soda into apple sauce and then add to bowl
4. Gently fold in flour , rind and choc chips alternately with orange juice
5. Pour into prepared loaf tin
6. Bake 30- 35 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean

title: friedel s old fashioned baked beans
steps:
1. Soak beans overnight in cold water
2. Drain
3. Rinse beans , then place in a saucepan along with the cold water
4. Heat water to boiling and simmer beans for 30 minutes , then drain
5. Place onion slices in the bottom of a 6 cup casserole
6. Mix seasonings and turn into the pot
7. Add beans and water to cover
8. Arrange bacon on top , before covering and baking in an oven for 7 hours at 250 f
9. In the middle of the cooking , when the beans have become soft enough , remove 1 cup of beans , mash and then stir back into the pot
10. Cover and continue to bake , adding water as needed to keep the beans just covered
11. One hour before serving , remove cover to darken the beans

title: oat and cashew waffles
steps:
1. Put the oats and cashews in a blender and grind
2. Add the salt , oil and water and blend thoroughly
3. Pour the batter in a waffle iron and leave for a few minutes until cooked

title: egg drop soup  my style
steps:
1. In a saucepan , combine 2 cups of water , 2 bouillon cubes , green onions , and the seasonings , and bring to a boil
2. In a bowl , beat the egg , until it is blended together
3. Slowly , pour the egg into the broth little by little and let the egg cook until it floats and then you can stir the soup
4. Lets cool and serve

title: shrimp remoulade
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except shrimp and lettuce in blender or food processor
2. Process at high speed until smooth
3. Chill thoroughly , for at least two hours
4. To serve , arrange boiled shrimp on lettuce leaves and pour dressing over shrimp

title: pecan praline bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Arrange graham crackers in ungreased 15x10x1-inch pan
3. Place butter and sugar in sauce pan
4. Heat to boiling point
5. Boil 2 minutes
6. Stir in pecans and spread evenly over crackers
7. Bake about 10 minutes
8. Cut each graham cracker in half while warm

title: ultimate shrimp scampi linguini
steps:
1. Saute garlic , shallots and red pepper flakes in 2 tablespoons butter and 2 tablespoons olive oil over medium heat in large skillet
2. Add shrimp to skillet , cooking until pink about 2-3 minutes
3. Remove shrimp from pan
4. Add wine and lemon juice to skillet
5. When mixture comes to a boil , add 2 tablespoons butter , 2 tablespoons olive oil
6. When butter melts , return shrimp to pan and add parsley , cooked pasta and 1 cup pasta cooking liquid
7. Toss to combine
8. To be extra fancy: drizzle a little more olive oil over finished dish !

title: godiva brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease a 9 x 13 inch pan
3. In a small bowl , combine flour , baking powder , and salt
4. Set aside
5. In a large bowl , cream together the butter , white sugar , brown sugar , vanilla extract , and godiva liqueur until smooth
6. Beat in the eggs , one at a time , then stir in the flour mixture
7. Mix in the white chocolate chips
8. Spread the batter evenly into the prepared pan
9. Bake for 30 minutes
10. Cool in the pan on a wire rack
11. When completely , cooled , cut into squares

title: crock pot chicken stew with pepper and pineapple
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except pineapple , cornstarch , and bell pepper in 3 1 / 2 to 6 quart crock pot
2. Cover and cook on low 7 to 8 hours , high 3 to 4 hours , or until vegetables are tender and chicken is no longer pink in center
3. Mix reserved pineapple juice and cornstarch until smooth and stir gradually into chicken
4. Stir in pineapple and bell pepper
5. Cover and cook on high about 15 minutes or until slightly thickened
6. Serve over hot cooked rice , and garnish with sliced green onions and toasted coconut , or chopped peanuts or cashews if desired

title: cinnamon mocha molten cake  egg free  dairy free
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a large mixing bowl , stir together flour , sugar , cocoa , baking soda , salt and cinnamon
3. Make three depressions in the dry mixture
4. Pour oil into one depression , cider vinegar into another and vanilla into third
5. Pour cold coffee over entire surface and mix well
6. Spread batter evenly into a greased 13" x 9" cake pan
7. Bake for 25-30 minutes
8. When pulled from the oven , cake will be flaky on top with a layer of gooeyness underneath
9. Drizzle remaining 1 cup of hot , fresh coffee over hot cake
10. Serve immediately with a scoop of ice cream

title: famous oatmeal pie
steps:
1. With electric mixer , combine eggs , sugars , vanilla , milk , and butter until blended
2. Stir in oats& pecans
3. Pour in shell
4. Bake in preheated 350 degree oven for 45 minutes or until pie is set and lightly brown
5. Serve warm with ice cream and caramel ice cream topping if desired

title: fiesta crescents
steps:
1. Saute the beef , onion and garlic until beef is lightly browned
2. Add remaining ingredients except for the crescent roll dough and egg and water
3. Mix well and warm but do not bring to boil
4. Remove from heat and let this mixture cool to room temp
5. Separate crescent roll dough and spread each one with the cooled beef mixture
6. Roll into crescent shape as directed on the cans
7. Spray a cookie sheet , very lightly , with cooking spray or you may use a light film of cooking oil
8. Whisk egg white and 1 tablespoon water together to make an egg wash
9. Brush egg wash on each crescent roll and place on cookie sheet
10. Bake in preheated 375 degree oven for 10-15 minutes or until rolls are golden brown
11. Serve hot

title: the best pot pie you will ever eat
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. In a saucepan , combine chicken , carrots , and peas
3. Add water to cover , bring to a boil , and boil for 15 minutes
4. Remove from heat , drain and set aside
5. In a saucepan over medium heat , cook onions in butter until soft and translucent
6. Add in garlic and stir
7. Cook for 1 minute
8. Stir in flour , salt , pepper , and celery seed
9. Slowly stir in chicken broth and milk
10. Simmer over medium heat until thick
11. Remove from heat and set aside
12. Place the chicken mixture in bottom pie crust
13. Pour hot liquid mixture over the top
14. Cover with top crust , seal edges , and cut away excess dough
15. Make several small slits in the top of the pie to allow steam to escape
16. Bake for 30-35 minutes , or until pastry is golden brown on top and the filling is bubbly
17. Cool for 10 minutes before serving

title: sour cream smashed potatoes
steps:
1. Peel potatoes
2. Cook potatoes and garlic cloves , covered , in boiling water for 20 to 25 minutes or until tender
3. Drain
4. Mash potatoes and garlic
5. Add sour cream
6. Beat in enough milk to make fluffy
7. Season to taste with salt and pepper
8. Return potatoes to pan and heat through
9. Transfer to a serving bowl
10. If desired , sprinkle with parmesan cheese and garnish with basil
11. Make-ahead instructions: prepare potatoes as directed , except place in a greased 1-1 / 2-quart casserole before heating through
12. Cover and chill for up to 24 hours
13. Bake covered in a 350f oven for 55 minutes or until heated through
14. If desired , sprinkle with parmesan cheese and garnish with basil just before serving

title: reese s pieces peanut butter banana bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cream the butter and sugar until smooth
3. Add eggs until smooth
4. Add peanut butter , cinnamon , baking soda , salt , pudding mix and flour until combined
5. Stir in bananas and reeses
6. Pour batter into 3 greased bread pans
7. Bake 45-60 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean from center of each loaf
8. Let cool
9. Place powdered sugar , milk and peanut butter in a bowl
10. Whisk until smooth and drizzling consistency
11. Drizzle over each loaf

title: balsamic chicken with white beans   spinach
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add the chicken and cook for 10 minutes or until well browned on both sides
3. Remove the chicken from the skillet
4. Reduce the heat to medium
5. Add the garlic to the skillet and cook and stir for 1 minute
6. Stir in the vinegar and cook , scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan
7. Stir the soup and beans in the skillet and heat to a boil
8. Stir in the spinach
9. Return the chicken to the skillet
10. Reduce the heat to medium
11. Cover and cook until the chicken is cooked through and the spinach is wilted

title: dill  pesto sauce
steps:
1. Combine all the ingredients in a blender or food processor and blend till smooth
2. Chill

title: italian ized  pork chops
steps:
1. Salt and pepper the chops and brown both sides
2. Add all other ingredients and mix to combine
3. Simmer for one hour , until chops are tender and falling off the bone
4. Serve over cooked noodles or mashed potatoes
5. I also sometimes add a small can of mushrooms
6. You can also add or remove garlic per preference

title: simple orange citrus bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350'
2. Lightly greased a 13x9 baking dish , set a side
3. In a large bowl , combine 2c
4. Flour and 1 / 2c
5. Confectioner sugar
6. Add in butter , stir til crumbly
7. Press mixture evenly into the bottom of prepared baking dish
8. Bake 20 minutes or until lightly browned
9. In another bowl , stir together sugar , eggs and orange juice until well blended
10. Set aside
11. In a small bowl combine flour and baking powder and add to sugar mixture
12. Stir to combine
13. Pour onto hot crust and bake another 25 minutes or until set
14. Sprinkle with extra confectioner sugar if desired

title: broccoli with sour cream sauce
steps:
1. Steam broccoli
2. Meanwhile , make sauce by combining remaining ingredients in the top of a double boiler and cooking over hot water just until warm
3. To serve , drizzle sauce over steamed broccoli and sprinkle with paprika

title: chicken and black bean salad
steps:
1. Combine dressing ingredients
2. Stir well
3. Set aside
4. In a large bowl , toss together beans , corn , red pepper and onions
5. Arrange lettuce on individual plates
6. Top with black bean mixture and chicken strips
7. Drizzle with dressing and serve

title: olive appetizer tree
steps:
1. Get a box of toothpicks and a 9 inch cone shape to begin
2. Drain olives
3. Cut block of cheese into 1 / 2 inch thick slabs and cut 1 inch stars with a cookie cutter
4. Cover with wrap
5. Break toothpicks in half
6. Starting at the bottom of the cone , insert toothpicks in a random order and push olives onto them
7. Vary the olives and leave room for the cheese stars
8. Place larger olives near the bottom
9. Push each cheese star into a toothpick half , top the tree with a cheese star and insert rosemary sprigs randomly
10. Serve immediately or cover and refrigerate no longer than 8 hours

title: veggie burgers ii
steps:
1. Add lentils to pan of boiling water and cook uncovered for 10 minutes or until just tender
2. Drain
3. Heat the oil in a pan and cook onion and garlic until softened
4. Add zucchini and carrot and cook for 2-3 minutes
5. Combine remaining ingredients except cubed breadcrumbs with cooked ingredients
6. Shape into patties and toss in cubed breadcrumbs
7. Heat oil in a frying pan and cook the lentil patties for approximately 1 to 2 minutes on both sides or until crisp and golden

title: black bean and chicken chilaquiles
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
3. Coat pan with cooking spray
4. Add onion
5. Saute 5 minutes or until lightly browned
6. Add garlic , saute 1 minute
7. Add chicken , cook 30 seconds
8. Transfer mixture to a medium bowl
9. Stir in beans
10. Add broth and salsa to pan , bring to a boil
11. Reduce heat , and simmer 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
12. Set aside
13. Place half of tortilla strips in bottom of an 11 x 7 baking dish , coated with cooking spray
14. Layer half of chicken mixture over tortillas , top with remaining tortillas and chicken mixture
15. Pour broth mixture evenly over chicken mixture
16. Sprinkle with cheese
17. Bake at 450 for 10 minutes or until tortillas are lightly browned and cheese is melted

title: tofu salad
steps:
1. Whisk canola oil , vinegar , honey , soy sauce , sesame oil , ginger , crushed red pepper and salt in a bowl
2. Place tofu and 2 tablespoons of the dressing in a large nonstick skillet
3. Cook over medium-high heat , turning every 2 to 3 minutes , until golden brown , 12 to 15 minutes total
4. Remove from the heat
5. Add 1 tablespoon of the dressing to the pan and stir to coat
6. Toss greens , carrots and cucumber with the remaining dressing
7. Serve immediately , topped with the warm tofu

title: roasted red pepper   herb dip
steps:
1. ---to roast pepper---
2. Preheat broiler
3. Line broiling pan with aluminum foil
4. Cut pepper lengthwise in half , discard stem and seeds
5. Arrange halves , cut side down , in broiling pan
6. Place broiling pan in broiler 5 to 6 inches from source of heat and broil pepper until it's blackened and blistered , about 6 to 8 minutes
7. Wrap foil around pepper and allow to steam at room temperature 15 minutes or until cool enough to handle
8. Remove pepper from foil
9. Peel off skin and discard
10. Cut each pepper half into 4 pieces
11. --to prepare dip--
12. In food processor with knife blade attached , blend roasted pepper with cream cheese , milk , salt , pepper , and garlic until smooth
13. Transfer mixture to medium bowl , stir in parsley , chives , and thyme
14. Cover and refrigerate if not serving right away

title: cheese and wine chicken
steps:
1. Place cut up chicken in a shallow pan
2. Mix all ingredients except cheese and paprika
3. Pour over chicken
4. Sprinkle with cheese and paprika
5. Bake at 325 for 1 1 / 2 hours

title: easy eggless sponge cake
steps:
1. Sieve the flour , baking powder and baking soda together
2. Mix the flour mixture , condensed milk , melted butter , essence , and water and beat well
3. Pour the mixture into a greased and dusted 6 inch diameter round tin
4. Bake in a hot oven at 200 degrees c for 10 minutes
5. Then reduce the temperature to 150 degrees c and bake for a further 10 minutes
6. The cake is ready when it leaves the sides of the tin and is springy to touch
7. When ready , take out from the oven and leave for 1 minute
8. Invert the tin over a rack and tap sharply to remove
9. Cool the the cake on a wire rack

title: lemon gelato  for ice cream machine
steps:
1. Heat milk in sauce pan to a simmer
2. Put the lemon zest and vanilla bean in a bowl , and add the hot milk
3. When cool , cover and allow to infuse for about 8 hours or overnight in the refrigerator
4. Strain the milk into a sauce pan , add half the sugar , and bring to a simmer
5. Whisk the egg yolks with the remaining sugar until combined
6. Gradually dribble the hot milk into the egg yolks , half a cup at a time , whisking to heat the yolks without cooking them
7. When all the milk has been added , cook the mixture over medium heat , stirring continuously , for about 4 to 5 minutes or until the mixture is thick enough to coat the back of a spoon and leave a trail when a finger is run over the spoon
8. Stir in a pinch of salt , and straininto a heatproof bowl set over ice
9. Cover , and refrigerate for at least 6 hours or overnight
10. Transfer mixture to an ice cream machine , and process according to directions
11. Transfer gelato to a container and return to freezer for about 2 hours
12. Serve in chilled glasses

title: sun dried tomato and parsley dip
steps:
1. In a tall bowl combine all the ingredients
2. Blend together using a hand-held blender
3. Alternatively you could also use a food processor or blender
4. Enjoy !

title: caramelized sunflower seeds
steps:
1. Heat sunflower kernels in a non-stick skillet about 3 minutes over medium-high heat
2. Stir in the brown sugar , stirring constantly until melted and kernels are coated
3. Turn out onto waxed paper to cool

title: deep dark chocolate moist cake
steps:
1. Place the two layer size packaged devils food cake mix in a large mixer bowl , and sift out lumps
2. Add all other ingredients into bowl , and beat well , until combined and thick
3. Bake in greased cake pans at 350 degrees preheated oven
4. Bake for 25 minutes or until toothpick or tester comes away clean
5. Cool ten minutes , invert onto cooling rack
6. Fill and frost with your favourite frosting
7. The original frosting that came with this recipe is as follows:
8. 3 teaspoons brown sugar
9. 1 teaspoon molasses
10. 1 teaspoon rum or water
11. 1 can french vanilla canned frosting
12. Dissolve the sugar , water and molasses until dissolved in the microwave
13. Cool then whip into the one can of frosting to blend
14. These amounts can be doubled the original was triple

title: kifli   crescent cookies
steps:
1. Dough:
2. Blend flour and butter thoroughly using a pastry blender if desired
3. Add egg yolks and yeast cake which has been dissolved in cream
4. Add sugar and vanilla
5. Chill dough if it is too soft to roll out easily
6. Divide into 2 parts and roll each into a 12-inch circle or larger
7. Cut into 16 or more pie-shaped pieces
8. Place a small amount of nut filling or jam on each wedge and beginning at the rounded edge , roll up
9. Place on greased baking sheet , point underneath
10. Let stand for 20 minutes
11. Brush top of crescents with beaten egg
12. Bake at 350f for 15 to 18 minutes or until light brown on bottom
13. Filling:
14. Mix all ingredients listed for filling together , mixing well

title: penne spinach goodness
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large saucepan , or coat bottom of pan evenly with olive oil
2. Saute onions and garlic until onions start to become translucent
3. While your onions and garlic are cooking , start water to boil for your spinach
4. Add mushrooms to onions and garlic
5. Saute and season with your oregano , salt , and pepper
6. Cover and stir occasionally for 5-10 minutes or until mushrooms are done
7. Once mushrooms are done add the tomato if using , and cook for about 2 minutes
8. Add cooked spinach and mix
9. Start water for cooking your pasta if you haven't already
10. Boil pasta til al dente , drain
11. You can make your white sauce in a seperate saucepan , or do what i do and just start making it directly with the vegetables / / heat milk over med heat and whisk in flour
12. Add shredded cheese and stir occasionally until cheese is melted , then give your sauce a final whisk to make sure cheese is spread evenly throughout
13. Combine cooked pasta , vegetables and white sauce and transfer into a 13x9 casserole dish
14. Top with breadcrumbs or wheat germ
15. Maybe a little paprika or a final dash of pepper
16. Cover and bake in oven @ 350 degrees for half an hour

title: elizabeth taylor s chicken steamed in wine
steps:
1. Flour chicken lightly and brown in a heavy skillet or dutch oven
2. Combine all the other ingredients and pour over the chicken
3. Cover and simmer for about an hour , or until tender

title: chicken tuscany
steps:
1. In 13 x 9-inch baking pan , arrange chicken ,
2. Red pepper and mushrooms
3. Blend remaining ingredients
4. Pour over chicken
5. Bake 50 minutes at 425 degrees or until chicken is thoroughly cooked

title: thai lettuce folds
steps:
1. Heat peanut oil in a large skillet over medium high heat 1 minute
2. Add garlic and chicken
3. Cook , stirring constantly , 3 to 5 mins
4. Or until chicken is lightly browned
5. Add broth and cook over medium heat until most of liquid evaporates
6. Stir in green onions and next 5 ingredients
7. Spoon 2 tbls
8. Chicken mixture onto each lettuce leaf
9. Sprinkle with bean sprouts , and fold over
10. Serve with cucumber dipping sauce
11. Cucumber dipping sauce: in small bowl , stir together plain low fat yogurt , cucumber and dried dill weed , crushed
12. Cover , refrigerate until serving time
13. Makes 1 cup

title: balsamic roasted pumpkin
steps:
1. Peel and slice the pumpkin into 1" cubes
2. Brown the butter and add sage
3. Add the pumpkin
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Add balsamic vinegar , molasses and sugar
6. Bring to a boil
7. Transfer to a baking dish
8. Roast at 425-450 for 30 minutes until very tender and caramelized
9. Serve as a side dish to roasted chicken or turkey , use as a stuffing for ravoli , mix with vegetables and chicken stock to make a soup or serve alone with bread
10. Serves 4

title: crock pot beef marrakesh
steps:
1. Heat a little oil in deep sided pan on high , fry onion until browned
2. Remove and put aside
3. Heat a little more oil on high , brown beef in small batches , removing each batch before adding the next
4. Toss into crock pot beef , onion , and remaining ingredients , stir to combine
5. I like to include a cup of dried apricots
6. Cook on low all day , 8 to 10 hours until fork tender
7. Season to taste
8. Serve over rice or with couscous and veggies
9. Savour !

title: mexican chicken casserole  no soups
steps:
1. Boil chicken strips until done
2. About 20-30 minutes
3. While it is cooking , chop the onion , pepper , jaapeno , and tomatoes and set aside
4. When chicken is done , cool slightly and shred with a fork
5. Add the onions and peppers with the shredded chicken into a skillet and add the butter , and water
6. Salt and pepper to taste , and saute for about 10 minutes
7. Add enchilada sauce , chili powder and cayenne
8. Simmer 5 minutes
9. If the mix isn't juicy enough you can add a little more water
10. Stir in the sour cream and mix well
11. In an 8x8 casserole dish , put some crushed tortillasor nachos in bottom
12. Add the chicken mix on top , and spread the diced tomatoes and put on the mix
13. Mix cheeses and spread on top
14. Bake in oven at 350 degrees for 15 minutes , or til cheese is melted

title: bacon wrapped stuffed chicken  gluten free
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f
2. In a medium saut pan , place the olive oil and slightly heat up then add the mushrooms in , then minced garlic
3. Cook for 3-4 min or until they lightly start to brown
4. Place mushroom and garlic in a bowl and add in the chopped spinach
5. Fold mixture together , and allow to cool
6. Using a small sharp knife cut into the thick end of the chicken and make an incision reaching 2 / 3 the way down the breast
7. Loosen up the incision with your fingers to make a pocket
8. Season the chicken with pepper
9. Combine the blue cheese with the spinach and mushroom mix and stuff the breasts
10. Then spiral-wrap the breasts with the bacon tightly to cover the meat evenly
11. Place chicken on a nonstick baking sheet and roast 20 to 22 minutes until bacon is crispy and chicken is firm
12. By: chef travis w
13. Holland

title: tomato   mozzarella pasta salad
steps:
1. In a small bowl , whisk together dressing ingredients
2. Set aside
3. Cook pasta , rinse with cold water and drain
4. In large bowl gently toss together pasta and vegetables
5. Pour dressing over and toss gently
6. Cover , refrigerate 1 hour to blend flavors

title: penne with spicy red sauce
steps:
1. Cook oil and garlic in heavy large skillet over medium-high heat until garlic begins to sizzle
2. Stir in tomatoes with their liquid , 3 / 4 cup parsley and red pepper flakes , breaking up tomatoes with the back of a spoon
3. Season with salt and pepper
4. Reduce heat to medium-low
5. Cover partially and cook until tomatoes are thick and pulpy , stirring occasionally , about 1 hour 15 minutes
6. Discard garlic
7. Mix in remaining parsley
8. Pour sauce over pasta and toss well
9. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese and serve

title: meatballs with blue cheese sauce
steps:
1. For meatballs: preheat oven to 5oo f
2. Combine meat , crumbs , milk , eggs and salt in a bowl
3. Mix lightly to blend
4. Shape into balls about the size of marbles
5. Arrange on shallow , rimmed baking pans and bake for 4 to 5 minutes or until lightly browned
6. Add meatballs to the sauce , including any pan juices
7. For sauce: heat butter in a pan over medium heat , stir in the flour and mashed garlic and cook until blended and bubbly
8. Gradually stir in the half& half and chicken broth
9. Cook , stirring , until thickened
10. Add the crumbled blue cheese and stir until blended
11. Add salt if needed
12. Stir in meatballs
13. To serve : refrigerate the meatballs and sauce until time to serve
14. Reheat meat and sauce together , covered , over low heat , stirring gently several times
15. Sprinkle with garnish just before serving
16. Keep warm in a crockpot or chafing dish

title: chocolate peanut butter breakfast bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray 13x9-inch baking pan with baking spray
3. Combine oats , flour and sugar in large bowl
4. Cut in peanut butter with pastry blender or two knives until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
5. Stir in egg beaters and chocolate morsels
6. Press mixture evenly into prepared pan
7. Bake 17 minutes , or until lightly browned
8. Cool
9. Cut into bars
10. To make bars similar in shape to granola bars , cut down center lengthwise into halves
11. Then cut crosswise into eights

title: passover cottage cheese cake
steps:
1. Set oven rack at middle of oven
2. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
3. Prepare the crust:
4. In a small bowl with an electric mixer , beat the butter until smooth
5. Add matzo meal , sugar and cinnamon
6. Beat until it resembles coarse meal
7. Add wine , blend just until it holds together
8. Press onto bottom of an ungreased 8 inch springform pan
9. Prepare the filling:
10. In a large bowl with an electric mixer , beat the cottage cheese and cream cheese until smooth
11. Add the egg yolks one at a time , beating well after each addition
12. Beat in sugar
13. Add sour cream , potato starch , rind and vanilla
14. Beat until combined well
15. In a separate bowl with clean beaters , beat egg whites until they just hold stiff peaks
16. Stir cup of the beaten egg whites into the cheese mixture
17. Fold in remaining egg whites gently but thoroughly
18. Pour on top of prepared crust
19. Bake for 1 hour
20. Turn off oven
21. Let cake cool in oven with door slightly open
22. Chill in the pan at least 4 hours or overnight
23. Run a thin knife around edge of pan
24. Remove side of pan

title: fattoush   lebanese salad
steps:
1. Put lettuce into a mixing bowl and add all ingredients except the oil and bread
2. Toss well
3. Cover and chill for at least 1 hour before serving
4. The oil and bread are added and mixed in just before serving to prevent wilting of the lettuce and softening of the bread

title: perfect fried pork chops
steps:
1. Mix milk with first amount of salt and allow pork chops to soak in this mixture for as long as you'd like , about an hour to maybe four works well
2. Overnight soaking will result in too much moisture & your breading will fall off
3. Remove pork chops from brine , and set aside
4. Brine should be discarded
5. Mix all spices in with flour
6. Heat oil in pan
7. Coat each side of the pork chops , applying pressure to make the batter stay on during cooking
8. One coat is good for a thin layer of batter
9. For a thicker coating , dip them in a separate bowl of a little milk with an egg mixed well , and again in the flour
10. Make sure oil is hot
11. You can check by dropping a pinch of flour in , and it will sizzle if it is
12. Oil temperature should be around 375 degrees f , if you have an oil thermometer
13. Cook on each side 4-6 minutes on each side , or until meat is no longer pink inside
14. Chops with bones will take a bit longer , and we cook them on one side until blood starts to come out of the bone before flipping
15. If you have a meat thermometer , the inner temperature should be at least 160 degrees f

title: grilled shrimp    mmmmmm
steps:
1. In a 1 gal plastic food bag place shrimp and olive oil , toss to coat , sprinkle enough rub to coat the shrimp
2. The bag should look dark red
3. Refrigerate for 1-4 hrs , the longer you wait the hotter they'll be
4. Light the grill and while it's heating place shrimp on skewers
5. When coals are very hot , clean the area that the shrimp will be on and rub with a bit of canola oil on a rag
6. Immediately place shrimp on greased grill for 2-3 minutes , turn and cook an additional 2-3 minutes
7. Remove from skewers and serve hot
8. No dipping sauce required
9. This rub works well on chicken wings too !

title: chicken tortilla soup
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat
2. Add the onion , garlic , chipotle , chili powder , and salt and cook until the onion softens , about 15 minutes
3. Add the chicken broth , bring to a boil , reduce the heat slightly , and simmer , uncovered , for 10 minutes
4. Add the corn and cook for 5 minutes more
5. Pull the saucepan from the heat and stir in the tomato , chicken , cilantro , and lime juice
6. Divide the tortilla chips among 4 warmed bowls , ladle the soup on top , and serve with the lime wedges , if desired

title: t g i friday s fire bites
steps:
1. Drain jalapeo peppers and set aside
2. Mix cracker crumbs and flour together , blend well
3. In separate bowl beat eggs and add water blend well
4. Heat oil in fry pan , deep fryer , or fry cooker until temperature is the same degrees that you would fry french fries at
5. Dip slices of peppers in egg wash and then the flour and cracker crumb mixture , dust off excess dry ingredients and carefully place in hot oil
6. Place enough of the peppers in your deep frying system so they are not over crowded
7. Take care , the peppers like to pop a little
8. Fry until golden brown
9. Remove peppers and dry on a paper towel
10. Peppers are served with your favorite con queso dip on the side

title: overnight apple cinnamon oatmeal
steps:
1. Coat the inside of a 4-5 quart slow cooker with cooking spray
2. Combine all the ingredients in the slow cooker and stir
3. I find it helpful to mix the brown sugar with the cinnamon
4. The cinnamon gets better incorporated and doesn't separate from the mix as much
5. Cook for 7-8 hours on low
6. Stir thoroughly before serving with a rubber spatula or wooden spoon
7. Serve immediately
8. Refrigerate leftovers
9. Reheat with a splash of milk
10. This recipe is easily cut in half for smaller slow-cookers
11. A time of 4 hours is optimal

title: 123 cake
steps:
1. In 9x13 pan , pour oil
2. Covering bottom and sides
3. Add cake mix , pudding , water and egg
4. Mix with fork
5. Moistening all dry ingredients
6. Pour in pie filling
7. Swirl into mixture
8. Bake at 350 for 35 minutes , or until toothpick comes out clean

title: ultimate roast beef   slow cooker recipe
steps:
1. Add slow-cooker liner for easy clean up
2. Peel and chop vegetables into large chunks
3. Add 1 / 2 of the onion soup mix and 1 / 2 of the au jus mix to slow cooker
4. Add oil into frying pan , turn on high heat
5. Brown roast on all sides
6. Add to slow cooker
7. Add vegetables to slow-cooker , add remaining au jus and onion soup mix
8. Pour beef stock over roast & vegetables
9. Cook on low for 8-10 hours , turning half way through
10. Roast is done when meat falls apart

title: the great american macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Combine grated cheddar and mozzarella and set aside
2. In a small saucepan , heat milk until near boiling
3. Turn off heat
4. Melt butter in a heavy pan large enough to hold the pasta after it is cooked
5. When foam from butter recedes , remove from heat , add flour , and mix well
6. Return to medium-low heat , and , stirring occasionally , simmer for 2 to 3 minutes to cook , but not brown , the flour
7. Gradually stir in hot milk
8. Raise heat to medium-high and continue stirring until mixture is smooth and thick
9. Add parmesan and romano cheeses
10. Whisk until smooth
11. Add tabasco and white pepper and blend
12. Cook rigatoni in boiling salted water about 4 minutes
13. Thoroughly drain rigatoni and fold it into the cheese mixture
14. If cooking immediately , preheat oven to 375 degrees
15. Layer one-half the rigatoni mixture into a 9x13 pan
16. Top with one-half of the cheddar and mozzarella
17. Repeat layers
18. Top with chili powder , sprinkled evenly over top
19. If not baking immediately , cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate or freeze
20. When ready to bake , drizzle the 3 / 4 cup milk over the dish
21. Bake for approximately one hour
22. If frozen , add at least 20 minutes to baking time
23. The dish should be rusty brown on top
24. Should it appear to be browning too fast , cover with foil for part of cooking time
25. Be sure to check for doneness in the very center of the dish

title: simple italian bean salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the spring onions , garlic and chili
2. Add the three cans of beans and mix thoroughly
3. Whisk together the olive oil and white wine vinegar and season
4. Drizzle over the bean salad and stir in with the parsley
5. Serve straight away or refrigerate until ready

title: alaskan blue stew
steps:
1. Cut whale in bite size pieces
2. Dust with flour
3. Brown in hot olive oil in very large skillet
4. Add vegetables , and saute until translucent
5. Add water to cover
6. Add msg and salt and pepper to taste
7. Cook over moderate heat until thickened
8. Reduce heat and simmer until meat is tender , about 6 days
9. Serve with hot french bread and a green salad
10. Serves 401 , 851

title: amish baked fried chicken
steps:
1. Mix the beaten egg and milk together
2. Dip chicken parts in liquid
3. Stir together the salt , pepper and cracker crumbs
4. Dip chicken in dry mixture , using a spoon to cover well
5. Melt butter in a heavy cast iron skillet
6. Brown chicken well on both sides
7. Remove from stove top and place into the oven , cover with foil and bake at 325 degrees for 30 minutes
8. Uncover and continue baking for an aditional 30 minutes

title: pina colada cheesecake bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Crust: combine first 4 ingredients in a bowl
3. Add butter , oil , and 1 tablespoon water
4. Toss well
5. Press mixture into the bottom of an 8-inch square baking pan coated with cooking spray
6. Bake for 10 minutes
7. Cool completely on a wire rack
8. Filling: combine cottage cheese and the next 7 ingredients in a food processor , and process until smooth
9. Add egg substitute , and process until blended
10. Spread cheese mixture over cooled crust
11. Bake for 33 minutes or until set
12. Cool for 10 minutes on a wire rack
13. Refrigerate for 2 hours or until thoroughly chilled
14. Topping: top with pineapple and coconut

title: bbq balsamic cornish game hens
steps:
1. Marinade:
2. Combine garlic , vinegar , oil , rosemary , hot sauce , cumin , oregano and pepper in a large zip lock plastic bag
3. Put hens in the marinade bag and turn to coat the hens
4. Refrigerate for 30 minutes
5. Heat bbq to medium heat
6. Spray grill with oil and place hens skin side down on rack
7. Baste with the reserved marinade
8. Cook until the juices run clear when the thigh pierced 20-30 minutes

title: raspberry coffee  diabetic
steps:
1. Place coffee and sugar in filter in brew basket of coffee maker
2. Place extract in empty pot of coffee maker
3. Add water to coffee maker
4. Brew as directed
5. Pour into serving cups
6. Sweeten to taste with splenda and garnish with the cool whip , if desired

title: iraquian rice with potato crust  zwt3
steps:
1. Melt the 3 tablespoons of butter in a saucepan over medium heat
2. Stir in the rice and cook for 1 minute
3. Add the boiling water and 1 teaspoon of salt
4. Cover , lower the heat and simmer for 10 minutes
5. Remove from the heat and drain , reserving the rice
6. In a large bowl , toss the potato slices with half of the melted butter and the remaining salt
7. In a heavy-bottomed pot with a tight-fitting cover , arrange the potato slices , overlapping in 2 or 3 layers covering the bottom of the pot
8. Sprinkle with the garlic
9. Evenly spoon the half-cooked rice on top of the potatoes and garlic , and spoon the remaining melted butter over the rice
10. Cover the pot with aluminum foil and put the cover on top
11. Cook over very low heat for 45 minutes , or until the rice is tender
12. Sprinkle wit the almonds , gently stirring them into the rice with a fork
13. Be careful not to touch the bottom potato layer while you fluff the rice
14. Serve on warm plates with spoons of rice beside crisp garlic-potatoes

title: microwave steamed asparagus tips
steps:
1. Clean fresh asparagus and snap off wooden ends
2. Discard wooden ends or use in another recipe
3. Place water in bottom of steamer
4. In steamer basket lay the asparagus with
5. Mist asparagus with olive oil or drizzle lightly with olive oil
6. Sprinkle with seasoned salt
7. I usually eyeball this , but it is around 1 / 2 teaspoon
8. Place in microwave
9. Microwave on high 2 to 3 minutes
10. Let stand 2 minutes
11. Enjoy

title: quick and easy sweet and sour shrimp
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil
2. Add the pasta and cook as per package directions and drain
3. Meanwhile , heat 2 tablespoons oil in a 12 inch skillet , over medium-high heat , add onions and cook 2 minutes then add broccoli and continue to cook , stirring , an additional 5 minutes
4. Add shrimp
5. Season with salt and pepper and cook , stirring , for 3-5 minutes until shrimp are no longer pink
6. Stir in sweet and sour sauce and the pasta too , tossing with tongs so that ingredients are well blended
7. Remove from heat
8. Divide onto plates and serve immedietly

title: alton brown s bread and butter pickles
steps:
1. Combine onion cucumber slices in a clean ait tight jar or container
2. Combine the remaining ingredients in a non reactive sauce pan and bring to a boil simmer for 4 minutes to wake up the flavors of the spices
3. Slowly pour the hot pickling liquid over the onions and cucumber slices completely filling the jar
4. Allow the pickles to cool to room temperature beforetopping off with any remaining pickling liquid the refridgerate

title: banana pudding cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease a bundt pan and set aside
3. In a large bowl , combine all ingredients and beat with your electric mixer for 3 minutes
4. Pour into prepared pan and bake for 50-55 minutes , or until a tester comes out clean
5. Cool for 15 minutes before removing from pan
6. If desired , combine 1 cup of sifted icing sugar with a little milk and drizzle this over the cake

title: linda s crab pinwheels
steps:
1. Mix crab , cream cheese , sour cream , onions , peppers and cheese
2. Spread evenly over tortillas out to the edges and roll up
3. Place in ziploc bags and cool for two hours
4. Cut and serve

title: maui chicken salad
steps: 1. Mix all ingredients

title: black bean burgers with mango salsa
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Place black beans in a medium bowl
3. Mash with a fork
4. Stir in 1 / 2 cup finely chopped cilantro and the next 7 ingredients
5. Shape bean mixture into 6 patties
6. Arrange patties on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray
7. Bake at 350 for 20 minutes , carefully turning once
8. Combine remaining 1 / 4 cup cilantro , mango , and the next 4 ingredients in a medium bowl
9. Place a patty on bottom half of each hamburger bun
10. Top each with 1 lettuce leaf , 1 / 3 cup salsa , and top half of bun

title: cheesecake factory key lime cheesecake  my version
steps:
1. In 9 or 10 inch springform pan , combine crumbs , melted butter , and 1 / 4 cup sugar
2. Press evenly over bottom of pan and halfway up sides
3. Bake at 375 for 7-8 minutes , no longer
4. Cream room temperature cream cheese well , add sugar , and cream until smooth , scraping sides and bottom of bowl frequently to integrate any cream cheese lumps
5. Cream in sour cream , eggs , flour and vanilla
6. When smooth once more , stir in lime juice
7. If you prefer a less tart cheesecake , start with 1 / 3 cup and increase to taste
8. Pour over prepared crust
9. Return to 375 oven for 15 minutes
10. Lower temperature to 250 and continue baking 50 minutes for 10 inch pan , 55 minutes for 9 inch pan
11. Cool on wire rack in pan for 20 minutes
12. Run a sharp knife around edge to loosen cheesecake , but do not remove from pan
13. Refrigerate at least 6 hours before serving
14. May be garnished with sweetened whipped cream , lime zest , or both

title: marinated grilled chicken
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in resealable food storage plastic bag
2. Marinate for 3 hours or overnight
3. Remove chicken from marinade and discard marinade
4. Grill chicken over medium-hot coals or broil for 3-5 minutes per side or until chicken in no longer pink in center
5. Serve at once

title: grape breeze
steps: 1. Shake all ingredients together and strain inot a glass with ice

title: festive tuna pate
steps:
1. With electric mixer , mix cream cheese and salt until fluffy
2. Fold in other ingredients
3. Chill 2 to 3 hours
4. Serve with crakers

title: easy sour cream banana bread
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together & place in a pan that has been prepared with butter and flour
2. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees bake 30-45 minutes depending on pan used
3. Bake until toothpick inserted comes out clean
4. Makes 2 small or 1 large loaves
5. No alterations required for high altitude except to increase cooking time

title: rogene s pudding dessert
steps:
1. Mix flour , butter and walnuts until mealy and spread in bottom of a 13 x 9 pan
2. Bake for 25 min for 375
3. Cool
4. Cream powdered sugar and cream cheese
5. If it is too stiff add a few drops of milk
6. Spread over the crust , then spread half of the cool whip
7. Beat the pudding mix in the milk until thick and spread over cool whip and top it off with the rest of the cool whip
8. Sprinkle the top with shredded coconut
9. Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving

title: spice pancakes
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients
2. Lightly coat a large skillet with vegetable oil and heat over medium heat
3. Flip the pancakes when they start to bubble
4. This makes a large batch that freezes and reheats well and they smell wonderful !

title: chicken tarragon   for chicken sandwich filling
steps:
1. Boil the chicken breasts with bay leaves , tarragon and onion
2. Once the breasts are cooked , remove them from heat and allow them to cool
3. Cut them into 1 / 2 inch cubes
4. Make the dressing by mixing everything listed under"dressing" together
5. Then add the chicken cubes to the dressing
6. Put it in a plastic dish and refrigerate for 4 hours so that the flavours get stronger
7. Use this filling to make sandwiches as required
8. Enjoy !

title: the realtor s meatloaf
steps:
1. Mix together ground beef , dry bread crumbs , egg , milk , chopped onion , salt , dry mustard , pepper , sage , garlic powder , and worcestershire sauce
2. Spoon into an ungreased loaf pan and top with ketchup
3. Bake at 350f , uncovered , for 1 to 1 1 / 4 hours , or until done
4. Drain
5. When cool , cut into 1 / 2-inch slices

title: crock pot steak and potato soup
steps:
1. Turn on crock pot , cut beef into bite size pieces
2. Mix beef , potatoes , celery , carrots , onion , garlic , bouillon , pepper , and broth in the crock pot
3. Cover and cook on low setting for 8-9 hours
4. Turn crock pot on high , mix flour and water
5. Gradually stir in the flour mixture to the crock pot
6. Cover and cook an additional 25 minutes or until thickened

title: snowman salmon spread
steps:
1. Mix 8-ounce and 3-ounce packages cream cheese , the salmon , onions , lemon juice , mustard and horseradish
2. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours but no longer than 3 days
3. Shape two-thirds of the salmon mixture into a ball
4. Place on serving plate
5. Shape remaining salmon mixture into a ball
6. Place on top of larger ball
7. Cover loosely and refrigerate about 1 hour or until firm
8. Frost snowman with whipped cream cheese before serving
9. Garnish as desired with decorations
10. Serve with crackers , bagels or vegetables
11. About 3 cups spread
12. Decorate with fresh rosemary , dried cranberries
13. Chopped olive pieces or raisins
14. Carrot
15. Pimento or red bell pepper
16. Radicchio or carrot ribbon
17. Asparagus or celery

title: mojito jelly   lime and mint jelly
steps:
1. Prepare boiling water canner
2. Heat 5 half pint glass preserving jars with lids and bands in simmering water until ready for use
3. Do not boil
4. Set bands aside
5. Combine mint and water in a large pot
6. Simmer covered , about 20 minutes
7. Strain
8. Return mint infused water to a large pot
9. Boil until reduced to 3 cups
10. Add sugar , stirring to dissolve
11. Stir in lemon zest and lime juice
12. Bring to a boil
13. Stir in liquid pectin
14. Bring to a rolling boil
15. Boil hard for 1 minute
16. Remove from heat
17. Skim foam if necessary
18. Stir in a few drops of food coloring , if desired
19. Carefully ladle hot jelly into hot jars , leaving 1 / 4-inch headspace
20. Wipe rim and threads of jar with a clean damp cloth
21. Place lid on jars and then screw band down evenly and firmly just until a point of resistance is met-finger
22. Process 10 minutes in a boiling-water canner adjusting for altitude
23. Remove jars and cool
24. Check lids for seal after 24 hours
25. Lid should not flex up and down when center is pressed
26. Label

title: beef fajita burgers
steps:
1. Heat grill pan or skillet
2. In a large bowl , combine the meat , worcestershire , chili powder , cumin , thyme and grill seasoning
3. Divide the mixture into 6 portions and make 6 patties
4. Cook for 4 minutes or so on each side , or until desired doneness

title: baked cod with tomato and green onion
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 deg f
2. Coat 2 quart shallow glass baking dish with 2 tbsp olive oil
3. Place cod fillet in center of dish
4. Brush remaining 1 tbsp olive oil over top of fillet
5. Place tomato slices around cod fillet
6. Sprinkle green onion over tomato slices
7. Grind sea salt over top of cod fillet to taste
8. Sprinkle paprika over top of cod fillet
9. Sprinkle pepper over cod fillet and tomato slices
10. Sprinkle garlic powder only over tomato slices
11. Pour lemon juice over tomato slices
12. Bake in 400 deg f oven for 20 minutes or until fish flakes easily
13. Plate up and place tomato / green onion over top of fish
14. Goes great with quinoa and a colorful vegetable

title: tea dainties
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f and lightly grease cookie sheets
2. Beat eggs and add brown sugar
3. Sift flour , baking powder and salt together
4. Add to egg mixture and blend thoroughly
5. Add walnuts
6. Drop from teaspoon onto prepared cookie sheet , 1 / 2" apart and bake for 12 minutes

title: spinach feta rice and ham
steps:
1. Combine rice , broth and water in saucepan
2. Bring to boil
3. Reduce heat , cover and simmer 15 minutes or until tender
4. Saute onion and garlic in another pan
5. Add to rice along with remaining ingredients
6. Heat until heated through

title: two bean toss
steps:
1. Cook all the beans in a large pot of boiling water for 4 minutes , or until crisp-tender
2. Drain and rinse with cold water
3. Combine the last 6 ingredients in a medium bowl , and stir
4. Add beans , and toss to coat

title: little lemon pound cake for 2
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease and flour pan very well
3. I designed this to go in a petit loaf pan that measures about 5x3x2 but you can use 2 mini bundts , 4 cupcake cups , 2 jumbo muffin cups or whatever small pan you like
4. When doubled it works nicely with the 6 cup bundt pan , a 5 inch springform , 4 mini bundts or a 7x4x3 loaf pan
5. Whisk together flour and sugar in small mixing bowl
6. In another small bowl , whisk together buttermilk , lemon juice and baking soda
7. Add egg and lemon ex , gently whisk to combine
8. Add the butter and 1 / 2 of the buttermilk mixture to the flour mixture and mix with electric mixer until moistened
9. Beat on low for about 45 seconds
10. Add remaining buttermilk mixture and lemon zest and beat on medium until well blended , 30 seconds
11. Don't over mix or you'll ruin the texture
12. Pour into prepared pan and bake until browned well and toothpick inserted in center comes out clean , about 25-30 minutes for the petit loaf pan
13. When doubled bake 40 minutes in the small loaf pan
14. Baking times vary slightly depending on which pan you use
15. The important thing is that the cake is browned and toothpick comes out clean when inserted in center
16. Cool in pan 10 minutes on rack
17. Remove from pan and cool completely

title: savory chicken saute  sbd  phase 1
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat
2. Saut the chicken breasts in the oil for 4 minutes , then turn them over and add the onion
3. Cover and cook for 3 minutes longer , stirring occasionally
4. Add the garlic , rosemary , and broth
5. Cover and cook until the onion is tender-crisp , about 5 minutes longer , stirring occasionally
6. Season with salt and pepper

title: chocolate raspberry bars
steps:
1. Prehead oven to 350 degrees f , & grease a 15"x10" glass baking dish
2. In large bowl , combine cake mix , egg & butter until crumbly , then press crumb mixture into bottom of baking dish
3. Bake 8-10 minutes or until crust appears puffy & dry , then cool on wire rack
4. When crust is cool , spread jam over crust
5. In microwave or heavy saucepan , melt vanilla chips , then stir until smooth
6. In large mixing bowl , beat cream cheese & milk until smooth
7. Add melted vanilla chips & mix well
8. Carefully spread cream cheese mixture over jam
9. Melt chocolate chips & butter , then stir until smooth
10. Drizzle or pipe over cream cheese layer
11. Refrigerate before cutting into small pieces

title: hawaiian cheesecake fruit salad
steps:
1. In a medium tall bowl , using an electric mixer , whip cream cheese until it becomes smooth
2. It may bind up in the beaters , but continue as is and it will loosen up
3. Add the dry pudding mix
4. Beat until well combined
5. With the mixer on low , slowly add the creamer to the cream cheese mix
6. Add it about a tablespoon at a time and then mix until it becomes a smooth mixture and all of the creamer has combined into the cream cheese , repeat until all of the creamer has been added to the mixture
7. Whip until smooth
8. In a large bowl , combine strawberries , oranges , pineapple , kiwi and mango
9. Add the cheesecake mixture to the fruit
10. Gently fold cheesecake mixture into fruit
11. In a small bowl combine the banana coins and the lemon juice
12. Toss until well coated , drain the excess lemon juice
13. Gently fold the banana into the cheesecake salad
14. Chill until ready to serve or serve immediately
15. Do not pour all of the creamer into the cream cheese at once
16. It will get clumpy and no matter how long you beat it , it will stay that way
17. If you have to substitute cream for the creamer , powdered sugar and vanilla would be the best swap
18. 1 cup heavy cream , 1 / 4 cup powdered sugar and 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
19. To make this ahead: prepare the cheesecake mixture and refrigerate in a bowl
20. Mix all of the fruit in a large bowl and refrigerate
21. Before serving , drain any excess liquid from the fruit and then fold the cheesecake filling into the fruit
22. Serve and enjoy !

title: grandma s boiled raisin cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Bring water to boil in small pot , add raisans and boil 5 minutes
3. Cool
4. Do not drain water - it will be used in recipe
5. Cream shortening and sugar
6. Add eggs and beat well
7. Add cooled raisans with any left over water , and vanilla
8. Stir flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt , cinnamon and allspice to wet ingredients
9. Drop by teaspoon onto a lightly greased cookie sheet
10. This mixture is not meant to be really dry
11. Bake 10 minutes

title: spicy vegan texas black bean chili
steps:
1. Drain the black beans
2. Combine all the ingredients in a large pot , and cook for at least 2 hours or until all the flavors are blended together
3. Enjoy !

title: rich baked custard
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Combine all ingredients thoroughly , being careful to avoid incorporating too much air
3. Divide custard between 6 ramekins
4. Place ramekins in a roasting pan
5. Place roasting pan on oven rack
6. Pour hot water around ramekins until 1" deep
7. Slide rack into oven
8. Bake 45 min , or until custards are set , but the center still jiggles slightly , and the
9. Serve warm or cold

title: jamaican garden salad
steps:
1. Place cabbage into bottom of serving bowl
2. Top with carrot
3. Next , the green pepper
4. Slide the cucumber slices down the side of the bowl , so that they are"standing" on the inside of the bowl , surrounding your salad , and you can see half of each slice sticking out
5. Put the tomato wedges on the top of the salad
6. Serve with thousand island dressing

title: fig   caramelized onion and blue cheese tart
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Soak figs in hot / boiling water for 1 / 2 hr
3. To soften
4. Set aside
5. Lightly coat baking tray with olive oil
6. Spread pastry on baking tray , join edges and pierce with fork to allow air to escape during baking
7. Bake until light brown
8. Cook onions in butter and olive oil over medium heat until soft caramelized
9. Add brown sugar , salt and pepper , thyme and cook over low heat for 5 minute
10. Add drizzle of balsamic vinegar in last 2 minutes
11. Pour onion mixture over pastry covering to edges
12. Add figs
13. Sprinkle with cheese
14. Drizzle with olive oil
15. Bake at 400f fro 10-12 minutes
16. Cool before cutting
17. Cut into appetizer size pieces

title: spaghetti legs
steps:
1. In large dutch oven brown chicken legs , seasoned with salt and pepper and celery salt , in olive oil over med-high heat turning often with the lid on
2. Remove legs and take off skin , place chicken legs back in pot and add onion and garlic and let sweat until just translucent
3. Deglaze pot with wine for 2 minutes add carrots , then turn heat down to medium cook until wine becomes thick
4. Pour in tomatoes and sauce and add spices
5. Reduce heat and simmer for minimum hour to 2 hours
6. Serve over favorite pasta along side a large garden salad and garlic bread
7. Top dish with freshly grated romano or parmesan cheese

title: raspberry white chocolate scones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Stir together the first 4 ingredients , then buttermilk
3. Fold in raspberries and white chocolate chips
4. Cover and chill for 30 minutes
5. Turn out onto a well floured surface and pat down to about 3 / 4 inch thick
6. Cut into 12-14 triangles , place on lightly greased baking sheet , brush with egg white , and sprinkle with a lot of sugar
7. Bake for about 15-20 minutes

title: world s greatest french toast
steps:
1. Mix eggs , milk and cinnamon into large bowl
2. Swirl bread around egg mix until both sides are completely covered
3. Cook over medium heat until both sides are golden brown and no longer wet

title: orange cilantro rice
steps:
1. Spray medium saucepan with cooking spray
2. Heat over medium heat until hot
3. Saute onions until tender , 3-5 minutes
4. Add rice and orange zest to saucepan
5. Cook over medium heat until rice is lightly browned , 2-3 minutes , stirring frequently
6. Add water to saucepan and heat to boiling
7. Reduce heat and simmer , covered , until rice is tender , 20-25 minutes
8. Stir in cilantro and season to taste with salt and pepper

title: apple carrot cake with cream cheese filling   praline icing
steps:
1. In a small bowl , beat cream cheese and 1 / 4 cup sugar until smooth
2. Beat in 1 egg
3. Set aside
4. In a large bowl , beat oil with remaining sugar and eggs until well blended
5. Combine the flour , baking powder , cinnamon , salt and baking soda
6. Gradually beat into oil mixture until blended
7. Stir in the apples , carrots and pecans
8. Transfer half of the apple batter to a greased and floured 10-in
9. Fluted tube pan
10. Layer with cream cheese mixture and remaining apple batter
11. Bake at 350 for 50-60 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
12. Cool for 10 minutes before removing from pan to a wire rack to cool completely
13. In a large saucepan , bring the brown sugar , butter and milk to a boil
14. Cook and stir for 1 minute
15. Remove from the heat
