16. Whisk in confectioners' sugar and vanilla until smooth
17. Drizzle over cooled cake
18. Sprinkle with pecans

title: chicken saltimbocca alla romana
steps:
1. Place chicken cutlet on a cutting board and cover with a sheet of plastic wrap
2. Gently evenly pound the cutlet to 1 / 4 of an inch thick
3. Season both sides of the cutlets with salt and pepper
4. Place 2 sage leaves on each cutlet and top with prosciutto
5. Cover the cutlets with a sheet of plastic wrap and use the meat mallet to lightly pound each cutlet to adhere the sage and prosciutto to the chicken
6. Heat a large saute pan over medium-high heat
7. Add butter and oil and heat through
8. Place the chicken cutlets in the pan prosciutto-side down and cook until crisp , about 2 minutes
9. Turn the cutlets over and cook until done , about 1 minute more
10. Transfer the cutlets to a platter and tent with aluminum foil
11. Return the pan back to the heat and add the wine , scraping up any browned bits for them bottom
12. Cook until the wine has reduced by half
13. Add the cutlets back to the pan to warm through and coat well with the sauce , serve immediately
14. Enjoy !

title: mojito
steps:
1. Muddle 2-3 sprigs of mint with the sugar in the bottom of a 16 ounce glass
2. Stir in the rum
3. Squeeze the lime and add the juice to the glass , straining out any pulp
4. Add the club soda and stir gently
5. Add ice to fill the glass and stir again
6. Garnish with sugar cane and serve

title: bohne beroggi
steps:
1. Dough:
2. Scald milk and cream , add butter , sugar and cool to lukewarm
3. Dissolve yeast in the lukewarm water and add the teaspoon of sugar
4. Add to the first mixture
5. Add remaining ingredients and the flour gradually
6. Mix well
7. Knead the dough
8. Let rise until double in bulk and punch down
9. Let rise again until double
10. Form into small buns the size of a walnut or larger if desired
11. Let rise and flatten with hand
12. Filling:
13. Cook 2 cups pinto bean till soft
14. Pour off liquid and mash
15. Add sugar , salt , and cream
16. Mix well
17. Place a heaping teaspoon of filling in the center of each bun
18. Seal edges
19. Place on a greased pan and let rise until double in bulk , about 1 hour
20. Bake in a 350f oven until brown , 20-25 minutes
21. Sauce:
22. Mix the half and half , sugar and cornstarch in a saucepan and simmer
23. Whisk until thick
24. Pour warm sauce over the buns
25. You can also place the beroggi in a crock pot and pour the sauce over them to keep them warm
26. Enjoy !

title: mini pitas with cheddar  feta  and olives
steps:
1. Coarsely grate cheddar cheese
2. Crumble up feta cheese and combine with grated cheddar
3. Add olive oil , olives , and oregano
4. Season with pepper and mix
5. Slice open pita pockets halfway
6. Scoop mixture into pita pockets and press down
7. Place in toaster oven or microwave until cheese melts

title: blueberry or raspberry butter
steps:
1. Put all ingredients into food processor or blender
2. Process until smooth and fluffy

title: garlic butter bread for soups or barbecues
steps:
1. Heat oven to 325 deg f / 160 deg celsius
2. Slice the bread neatly into generous slices , but do not slice through
3. Mix well together in a bowl: the butter , olive oil , finely chopped and crushed garlic , and parsley
4. Add a good pinch seasoned salt , if you want to
5. It's not necessary and can be left out
6. Without breaking the bottom crust , spread the butter mixture on the slices
7. Push the bread together into its original shape , and wrap it securely in foil
8. Bake in the preheated oven for about 20 minutes , but long enough for the garlic butter to melt and penetrate
9. Open the foil , turn off the oven , and let the top of the bread crisp a little
10. Serve with grilled meats or with a hearty chowder-type soup
11. Can also be served with a salad for lunch

title: peanut butter popsicles
steps:
1. Bring water and sugar to a boil and boil for 3 minutes
2. Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter , mix well and then add milk
3. Cool for 10-15 minutes
4. Pour into6 paper cups
5. Add wooden sticks
6. Freeze until firm
7. Remove 3 minutes before serving --
8. Peel off paper cups

title: creole dirty rice   clean eating
steps:
1. Cook brown rice according to package directions
2. Remove from heat and set aside
3. In a medium-size pot , cover sausage with about 3 inches of water
4. Bring to a boil , then allow to boil for 10 minutes
5. Remove from heat , drain and let cool for 5 minutes before slicing sausage
6. Heat a large pot over medium-high heat
7. Mist with cooking spray and add onion , green pepper and garlic
8. Saute for about 5 minutes or until vegetables are cooked through
9. Drain soaked beans and rinse with cold water
10. Add beans , bay leaf and 3 cups water to pot with vegetables
11. Bring to a boil , then let boil for 20 minutes before reducing heat to medium-low
12. Cook until beans are soft , stirring occasionally and adding more water as it evaporates , about 2 hours
13. When beans are cooked through and water has reduced to less than 1 cup , add tomatoes and cook for at least 15 more minutes
14. Remove bay leaf
15. Stir in cajun seasoning , , cooked rice and sausage and cook for about 10 minutes
16. Season with salt and pepper and garnish with cilantro before serving
17. You will only need to warm them up for about 5 to 10 minutes instead of cooking them for 2 hours
18. And , you can reduce the water from 3 cups to 1 / 2 cup

title: dutch crumb squares
steps:
1. Sift together flour , baking soda and salt
2. Beat butter and sudar until creamy
3. Gradually add the flour mixture
4. Set aside 3 / 4 cup of the mixture
5. To remaining mixture , add raisins , edd and milk
6. Blend well
7. Spread into a lightly greased 8-inch square baking pan
8. Sprinkle reserved mixture overtop
9. Sprinkle with cinamon and sugar
10. Bake at 350 degrees for 20-25 minutes

title: coffee spice cake
steps:
1. Make the coffee
2. Use dark roast
3. Position oven rack in the center of oven
4. Preheat to 350
5. Prepare 12-cup bundt pan as follows: prepare bundt pan using the following methodmake a paste from 1 tablespoon melted butter and 1 tablespoon flour
6. Apply it with a pastry brush , you can thoroughly coat the surface of the pan , including all the nooks and crannies
7. Cream the shortening using a mixer on medium speed
8. Add in the brown sugar gradually
9. Increase mixer speed to med-high and beat until fluffy , about 3 minutes
10. Decrease mixer speed to low
11. Add in the molasses , then add in the eggs one at a time , beating well after each addition
12. In a separate bowl , whisk the flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt , and spices together
13. Add 1 / 3 of the flour mixture to the cream mixture , beat , then add 1 / 4 cup coffee and beat on medium until blended
14. Repeat two more times
15. Pour batter into the pan , smooth off top with spatula
16. Bake for 45 minutes or until the cake tests done
17. Cool for 10-15 minutes in the pan , unmold onto a cake rack , and cool completely
18. Sprinkle with coarse sugar or dust with powdered sugar

title: cheeseburger fry pie  5fix
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Grease 8x9 baking dish
3. Chop up onion
4. Mix hamburger with chopped onions , egg
5. Press simply potatoes shredded hash browns into greased baking dish
6. Press hamburger mixture over hash browns
7. Bake for 30 minutes
8. Sprinkle cheese on top of cheeseburger fry pie
9. Bake for 10 minutes , or cheese has melted

title: red kubbeh soup
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a skillet
2. Saute the onion until transparent
3. Add the tomato paste slowly and heat through
4. Fill a soup pot with 2 1 / 2 liters of water
5. Stir in the tomato and onion mixture from the skillet and vegetables
6. Bring to a boil
7. Add the spices and kubbeh
8. Turn down the flame , and cook , partially covered , for another 20-30 minutes

title: sausage and egg waffle sandwich
steps:
1. Toast waffles
2. Fry sausage patties until desired doneness is reached
3. Scramble eggs until slightly "dry"
4. Assemble "sandwich" in this order: waffle butter side up , half of the scrambled egg , sausage patty , second waffle , buttered side on sausage patty

title: chicken and lime soup
steps:
1. Combine stock , lime juice , oregano , basil , pureed chipotle and bay leaf in stockpot
2. Season to taste with salt and white
3. Pepper
4. Bring to boil and simmer for 15 minutes
5. Add shredded chicken , tomatoes , red onion and cilantro
6. Return to boil and simmer for 5 minutes
7. Taste and adjust seasonings if desired
8. Ladle very hot soup into warm soup bowls
9. Drop in cheese cubes
10. Garnish each serving with a few
11. Tortilla chips , avocado slices , lime slice and cilantro sprig
12. Makes about 1 quart

title: apple danish cheesecake
steps:
1. For crust , combine flour , ground almonds , and sugar
2. Cut in butter until crumbly
3. Add extract
4. Shape dough into a ball and place between 2 sheets of waxed paper
5. Roll dough into a 10 inch circle and transfer to a greased 9 inch springform pan
6. Press the dough gently around bottom and up sides of pan
7. Refrigerate for 30 minutes
8. Filling:
9. Beat cream cheese , sugar , and cream of tartar until smooth
10. Add the egg and beat on low until combined
11. Pour over crust
12. Topping:
13. Combine brown sugar , flour , and cinnamon
14. Add apples and stir until combined
15. Spoon apples over filling and sprinkle with the slivered almonds
16. Bake at 350f for 40-45 minutes
17. Cool on wire rack for 10 minutes
18. Run knife around edge of pan to loosen and cool for another hour
19. Refrigerate overnight , and then remove sides of pan

title: instant oatmeal apple crisp
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Place apples in a 9x13 inch baking dish
3. In a bowl , cream together butter and sugar
4. Stir in flour , instant oatmeal and salt
5. Fold in walnuts
6. Sprinkle oatmeal mixture evenly over apples
7. Drizzle with maple syrup
8. Bake in preheated oven 50 to 70 minutes , until apples are tender and topping is golden

title: groundnut sauce
steps:
1. Mix onions and tomatoes together and toss with curry powder
2. Heat the oil in a heavy saucepan and saut the onions and tomatoes until the onions are yellow
3. Add the peanuts and water , bring to a boil and then lower to a simmer , stirring all the time until the simmering stage is reached
4. Continue to cook , uncovered , until the nuts are well cooked
5. Season with salt , then increase the heat and reduce until the sauce reaches the right consistency
6. Mix in the cooked spinach

title: raspberry and coffee muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Grease a 12-cup muffing pan
3. In a small bowl , pour boiling water over the instant coffee
4. Stir in the milk
5. Set aside to cool
6. In a mixing bowl , mix the hazelnuts , flour , sugar , and baking soda
7. In a larger mixing bowl , beat the eggs and buttermilk with an electric mixer until combined , about 2-3 minutes
8. Stir in the cooled coffee
9. Add the flour mixture , stirring until nearly combined
10. Gently fold in the raspberries
11. Spoon batter into the prepared pan
12. Bake for 18-20 minutes or until test done
13. Remove from oven and cool for 5 minutes
14. Serve immediately

title: hot cucumber soup
steps:
1. As per the recipe: peel and slice the cucumbers
2. Melt the butter / marg in large saucepan and saute the onion until transparent
3. Stir in the flour
4. Add the stock and bring to a boil
5. Add the sliced cucumber and cook until tender
6. Puree in electric blender
7. Season to taste with salt and pepper and stir in lemon juice
8. Just before serving , mix in the cream
9. What liza does: i use alot more cucumbers , maybe+- 800 / 900g and add a touch more water to the stock amount
10. I use more onions , approx
11. 2 med-large
12. Don't use more lemon juice as it changes the taste of the soup
13. Once the soup is cooked , puree the soup: and options: can either leave the soup as it is
14. Or put in one tub of sour cream
15. Or don't put sour cream in the pot and only serve with sour cream as garnish
16. It's yummy

title: crock pot acorn squash with pepper rice stuffing
steps:
1. Cut the squash in half lengthwise and remove the seeds
2. Combine the rice , carrots , peppers , garlic and turmeric , and spoon the mixture into the squash cavities
3. Pour the water into an electric slow cooker , and add the squash halves , cavity-sides up
4. Pour the broth into the rice mixture in each cavity
5. Cook on low until the squash and rice are tender , 5-7 hours
6. Serve garnished with the sour cream and parsley

title: baked orange french toast osceola mills house
steps:
1. In a large bowl whisk together zest , juice , sugar , vanilla , triple sec , eggs , half-and-half , and a pinch of salt
2. Arrange bread slices in one layer in a glass baking dish , 13x9x2"
3. Pour mixture over bread , turning slices to coat , and chill , covered , 4 hours or overnight
4. Preheat oven to 400f
5. Brush large baking sheet with butter
6. Using a slotted spatula arrange bread in one layer on baking sheet , leaving at least 2 inches between each slice , and bake in middle of oven 5 minutes
7. Rotate pan and bake 5 minutes more
8. Turn bread over and bake 5 minutes more
9. Rotate pan and bake until bread is puffed and golden , 5 minutes more
10. Make sauce while bread is baking:
11. In a small saucepan cook the butter , marmalade , and triple sec over low heat , stirring , until butter is melted
12. Drizzle french toast with sauce and serve with syrup

title: hot brandied coffee royale
steps:
1. Whip the cream with sugar , cinnamon , and orange peel until soft peaks form
2. Refrigerate
3. Combine coffee and brandy and heat but do not boil
4. Pour into 8 mugs and top with whipped cream

title: coffee bean and peppercorn steak
steps:
1. Preheat grill to high
2. Smash and peel garlic clove , sprinkle with 1 / 8 teaspoon salt and mash into a paste with a spoon or the side of a chefs knife
3. Transfer to a small bowl and whisk in coffee and vinegar
4. Season with pepper
5. Place coffee beans and peppercorns on a cutting board
6. Coarsely crush with the bottom of a heavy pan
7. Mix the crushed coffee beans and peppercorns together
8. Rub steaks with oil , sprinkle with the remaining 1 / 8 teaspoon salt and coat with the coffee-peppercorn mixture , pressing it into the meat
9. Grill 4 to 5 minutes per side for medium rare
10. Transfer the steak to a cutting board and let rest 5 minutes
11. Thinly slice across the grain
12. Serve with the vinaigrette

title: yummy chocolate pumpkin muffins
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees
2. Put cake mix in a large bowl
3. In a separate bowl , mix 1 / 2 cup water with pumpkin puree
4. Slowly stir in pumpkin mixture to cake mix
5. Add more water if batter is too thick
6. Line muffin cups and fill 3 / 4 with batter
7. Bake according to cake box directions
8. Top with optional frosting when cool

title: iowa ham and corn chowder
steps:
1. Combine onion , water , 1 / 2 cup chicken broth and potatoes in a large saucepan
2. Cook over medium heat about 10 minutes , or until potatoes are tender
3. Use a spoon or masher to crush potatoes
4. Combine margarine and flour
5. Stir into potato mixture
6. Blend in remaining broth , stirring until thickened
7. Stir in corn , milk , ham and pepper
8. Cook on low heat until chowder is hot
9. Top individual servings with desired garnishes

title: spicy egg salad sandwiches
steps:
1. Combine chiles , eggs , mayonnaise dressing , green onion and hot pepper sauce in medium bowl
2. Season with salt and ground black pepper
3. Spread egg salad on toasted bagels or english muffins or bread

title: sugary pastry crisps
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. Bring crusts to room temperature
3. Place one pie crust on an ungreased cookie sheet
4. Seal any cracks
5. Crumble brown sugar evenly over entire crust
6. Sprinkle evenly with cinnamon and nuts
7. Place second pie crust over the first and press down firmly with a flat hand
8. Press edges of two crusts together with your finger
9. Bake until light brown , about 11 minutes
10. Slice into wedges and place on serving plate
11. Drizzle honey over top of slices

title: chili rice dinner
steps:
1. Brown ground beef , onion and pepper
2. Drain
3. Add spices and all other ingredients except rice
4. Bring to a full boil then stir iin rice
5. Reduce heat cover and simmer for 5 minutes
6. Mix and serve sprinkled with shredded cheese
7. You can also serve in cooked whole bell peppers and sprinkle with cheese which looks really impressive , but is super easy !

title: spicy tomato salad
steps:
1. Place tomatoes , chillies and onions in a serving bowl
2. In a separate bowl , combine pepper , seeds , ginger , garlic and spices
3. Heat oil in a large saucepan over high heat until it's almost smoking
4. Add spice mixture , stir vigorously for 2-3 minutes , then pour over tomato mixture and stir
5. Heat balsamic and red wine vinegars , salt and sugar in a pan over high heat until boiling , then immediately pour over tomato mixture
6. Mix well and cool to room temperature

title: smoked turkey tortilla wraps   mexican
steps:
1. Heat flour tortillas in a large skillet over medium heat until slightly browned
2. Divide turkey strips , avocado , sour cream , and cheese among the warmed tortillas
3. Fold in half and serve

title: the everyday italian chicken parmesan
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 500 degrees
2. Pound the chicken breasts to about 1 / 4 thickness
3. In a small bowl , stir the oil and herbs to blend
4. Brush both sides of the chicken with the blended oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper
5. Heat oven-proof pan over high heat
6. Add the chicken and cook until just brown , about 2 minutes per side
7. Chicken should be nearly cooked through
8. Remove from the heat
9. Spoon the spaghetti sauce over the chicken , top with mozzarella and sprinkle with parmesan
10. Dot the tops with butter pieces , and bake until the cheese melts and the chicken is cooked through
11. About 5 minutes

title: turkey pot pie with dumpling crust
steps:
1. In a large saucepan melt 1 / 3 cup butter
2. Add mushrooms , saute 2 minutes
3. Sprinkle with 1 / 4 cup flour and continue cooking for about 5 minutes , stirring constantly , do not brown
4. Add chicken stock and 2 cups of milk
5. Stir to combine and bring just to a boil
6. Reduce heat and add thyme , tabasco sauce , salt and pepper
7. Mixture should thicken , simmer for 10 minutes
8. Add diced turkey and mixed vegetables , stirring to combine
9. Spoon into greases 12 cup casserole
10. Top with dumpling crust
11. Dumpling crust
12. In a bowl , blend remaining ingredients except milk and butter
13. Cut butter in with pastry blender to form a coarse crumb
14. Add milk , stirring just to combine
15. Turn dough onto floured surface and knead a few times
16. Roll out to fit top of casserole
17. Place directly on top of turkey mixture and cut steam vents
18. Bake at 400 f for 25 to 30 minutes
19. To save time i often use frozen mixed vegetables instead of the peas and carrots

title: roasted chicken with peppers
steps:
1. Place washed and dryed chicken in a shallow roasting pan
2. Combine 2 tablespoons oil , rosemary and lemon juice
3. Brush over chicken
4. Sprinkle 1 teaspoons salt and 1 / 2 teaspoon pepper over chicken
5. Roast in a preheated 375 degree oven for 15 minutes
6. Cut bell peppers lengthwise into 1 / 2 strips
7. Slice onion into thin wedges
8. Toss vegetables with remaining oil , salt and pepper
9. Place veggies around chicken
10. Continue roasting until veggies are tender and chicken is cooked , about 40 minutes
11. Serve chicken with peppers and pan drippings

title: clean out the fridge egg fu yum
steps:
1. Cook ramen noodles according to package
2. Do not add the seasoning packet
3. Save for another use
4. In a mixing bowl , beat eggs , mustard , seseme oil , baking powder , and soy sauce
5. Drain bean sprouts and bamboo shoots
6. Drain well and pat dry
7. These ingredients must be completely dry
8. You may use fresh bean sprouts , if you like
9. Shred carrots and dice green onions
10. Chop bamboo shoots
11. Add vegetables and ramen to egg mixture
12. Mix well
13. Heat 1 t butter for each pancake
14. I make my pancakes by using a small ladle to drop into the skillet
15. You don't want the pancake to be more than about 3 inches across , or it will be hard to flip
16. Make sure your skillet is hot , but not screaming hot
17. I usually cook only one pancake at a time , so i can watch them better and not tear them up
18. Cook in butter or oil about four-six minutes each side
19. You want them browned but not burned
20. Do not attempt to flip them until you lift one side with a spatula to see if it is browned
21. Add 1 t butter each time you start a new pancake
22. Set aside pancakes , keep warm
23. For sauce:
24. Chop round steak into bite size pieces
25. Brown in skillet with 1 t oil
26. Drop heat in skillet to low
27. Add soy , dry mustard , beef gravy , peas , and seseme oil
28. Heat until frozen peas are hot , about five minutes
29. Place two pancakes on a plate
30. Serve with the sauce on top or on the side in a dipping bowl

title: pinwheel italian calzones
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a medium bowl , stir together the ricotta cheese , italian seasoning , salt , parmesan cheese , mozzarella cheese , pepperoni , mushrooms , green pepper and onion
3. Set aside
4. Unroll the crescent roll dough and separate into 4 rectangles
5. Press the remaining perforations together to seal
6. Spread the filling evenly onto the rectangles
7. Roll up the filling inside the dough starting at the short side
8. Slice each finished roll into four slices , and place cut side down onto a baking sheet
9. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes in the preheated oven , until lightly browned
10. While the pinwheels are baking , warm the pizza sauce
11. Serve the pinwheels with pizza sauce in small cups for dipping

title: asian inspired zucchini
steps:
1. Use a mandolin to slice zucchini thinly and lengthwise to form a ribbon
2. Peel and thinly slice red onion and finely mince garlic
3. Heat sesame and olive oils together in a medium skillet over medium high heat
4. Add onion and saut until tender
5. Add soy sauce , garlic and ginger and saut briefly
6. Adjust heat to medium
7. Add zucchini and continue to saut for about 5 to 7 minutes , stirring occasionally , until zucchini is tender
8. Do not overcook
9. Remove from heat , transfer to serving dish , top with sesame seeds and serve
10. To modify to italian , use 2 tablespoons olive oil and omit sesame seed oil , ginger and soy sauce
11. Add 2 to 3 diced plum tomatoes and a pinch of red pepper flakes before tossing in zucchini
12. Sprinkle with chopped parsley instead of sesame seeds
13. Season with salt & pepper

title: risotto with beans and vegetables
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan bring broth to boiling
2. Reduce heat
3. Simmer until needed
4. Meanwhile , in a large saucepan cook mushrooms , onion , and garlic in hot oil over medium heat about 5 minutes or until onion is tender
5. Add uncooked rice
6. Cook and stir about 5 minutes more or until rice is golden brown
7. Slowly add 1 cup of the broth to the rice mixture , stirring constantly
8. Continue to cook and stir until liquid is absorbed
9. Add another 1 / 2 cup of the broth , the zucchini , and carrots to rice mixture , stirring constantly
10. Continue to cook and stir until liquid is absorbed
11. Add another 1 cup broth , 1 / 2 cup at a time , stirring constantly until the broth is absorbed
12. Stir the remaining 1 / 2 cup broth into rice mixture
13. Cook and stir until rice is slightly creamy and just tender
14. Stir in beans and parmesan cheese
15. Heat through
16. Sprinkle with parsley and additional cheese , if desired
17. Makes 4 main dish or 6 side dish servings

title: easy spanish rice
steps:
1. Melt butter in sauce pan
2. Add onions and saute until translucent
3. Add rice and stir to coat with butter
4. Cook until rice turns golden brown and smells slightly nutty ,
5. Add tomato sauce , water , salt , pepper , and mustard
6. Stir
7. Bring to a boil , cover , and turn off heat
8. Let stand for 10 minutes

title: sausage ro tel party dip
steps:
1. Fry sausage until brown and drain
2. Drain ro-tel and reserve 1 / 4 cup juice
3. Mix together cooked sausage , cream cheese , ro-tel and 1 / 4 cup juice
4. Place in a slightly greased 1 quart baking dish
5. Sprinkle cheese on top
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes
7. Serve with corn chips or pita chips

title: broccoli   cheese pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Coat a 9-inch deep-dish glass pie pan with cooking spray
3. Add breadcrumbs , tilting to coat sides
4. Whisk eggs , milk , hot sauce , salt and pepper in a large bowl
5. Add bread and stir to coat , set aside in refrigerator
6. Steam broccoli until just tender , 3 to 4 minutes
7. Refresh under cold water and drain well
8. Chop coarsely
9. Heat oil in a mediun nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
10. Add bacon and onion
11. Cook , stirring often , until softened and light golden , 3 to 5 minutes
12. Add the onion mixture and broccoli to the egg mixture
13. Stir in cheese
14. Pour into the prepared pan spreading evenly
15. Bake the pie until light golden and set , 45 to 50 minutes
16. Let cool slightly , cut into wedges and serve

title: southwestern pasta skillet
steps:
1. Cook rotini to desired doneness as directed on package
2. Drain
3. Cover to keep warm
4. In a 12 inch non-stick skillet , brown ground beef over medium-high heat until throughly cooked
5. Drain
6. Stir in beans , corn , and cheese
7. Cover and cook over medium-low heat until cheese is melted and mixture is thoroughly heated , stirring occasionally
8. Gently stir cooked rotini into ground beef mixture and mix until well coated

title: chili cornbread salad dip
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400
2. Prepare corn muffin mix per instructions
3. Add next 4 ingredients to batter
4. Spread into 8x8 greased baking pan
5. Bake for 25 minutes
6. Cool
7. Mix mayonnaise , sour cream and dressing mix
8. Set aside
9. Crumble half the corn bread into a 13x9 dish
10. Layer with half the beans
11. Now half the mayonnaise mixture
12. Half the corn , tomatoes , green pepper , onions , bacon , and cheese
13. Repeat layers
14. Cover and refrigerate until chilled

title: cream crowdie
steps:
1. Place oatmeal in a small pan
2. Stir over low heat five minutes or until lightly toasted
3. Remove from heat
4. Cool completely
5. Whip cream in a small mixing bowl until soft peaks form
6. Add honey and beat just until combined
7. Fold cooled toasted oats into the cream mixture using a metal spoon
8. Layer the cream and raspberry in a dessert glasses , ending with the cream
9. Refrigerate for 2 hours
10. Serve sprinkled with toasted oats

title: wende s lemon pepper fajitas
steps:
1. Cover bottom of pan with oil and heat
2. Coat meat with lemon pepper
3. Add meat to hot oil and cook until almost done
4. Add bell pepper and onion , cook until your desired tenderness , i like them crisp while my husband prefers them softer-- this is simple and you can make them the way you prefer them

title: camellia brand red beans
steps:
1. Rinse and sort beans
2. Render meat in skillet
3. Remove meat and place on side
4. Saute in fat in skillet , onion , garlic , parsley and celery
5. Add these with meat , bay leaf , salt and pepper to beans
6. Boil gently , stirring occasionally for about 1 1 / 2 hours , or until tender
7. Add water while cooking as necessary

title: low carb kahlua liqueur
steps:
1. Combine the water , splenda , vanilla and coffee in a saucepan and heat over medium heat , stirring occasionally until the splenda and coffee are dissolved
2. Remove from the heat and add the vodka
3. Cover and let cool
4. Store in an empty bottle with a screw top / resealable lid
5. Store in a cool dark place - best if stored about 30 days before drinking

title: heavenly  fiber muffins
steps:
1. Peel and chop apples
2. Peel and shred or finely chop carrot
3. Use a mini-food chopper or food processor to speed the process
4. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
5. Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl
6. Add apple , carrot and other wet ingredients
7. Mix well ! batter will be quite thick
8. Grease muffin pan or muffin cups
9. Spoon batter into cups
10. Bake for about 20-22 minutes or until muffins are golden brown on the top and a toothpick inserted into one comes out clean
11. Serve warm with butter , margarine or jam

title: simply wonderful low carb sloppy joes
steps:
1. Brown and break up the ground beef in a large skillet and continue cooking until the meat is no longer pink
2. Then add the diced green pepper and onion to the cooked beef and continue cooking for a few more minutes
3. Add the worcestershire sauce , soy sauce and ketchup and turn down heat to a low simmer for 15 minutes
4. Add a little water , if needed , to keep the mixture just moist but , not soupy
5. Serve with some mayo on low carb bread or wrapped in a low carb tortilla or a lettuce leaf or over a tossed green salad
6. Enjoy !

title: curried chicken with tomatoes and nuts
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large saucepan or wok
2. Cook onion , sugar and ginger over medium heat for about 4 minutes or til onion has softened
3. Stir in curry paste for about 2 minutes
4. Add chicken , cook til lightly browned
5. Add coconut cream
6. Simmer , covered , for about 30 minutes
7. Blend flour with water
8. Stir into curry over high heat til mixture boils and thickens
9. Add tomato , stir til hot
10. Serve onto bed of steamed rice
11. Sprinkle with nuts

title: nate s italian beef
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a large crockpot
2. Place the roast in the crockpot and cook on low 8-10 hours or until fork tender
3. Remove the beef and shred with two forks
4. Add back to the juices and enjoy

title: healthy  lebanese tabbouleh  no tomato  no cucumber version
steps:
1. Cover burgul / cracked wheat with cold water in a bowl , there should be about 2
2. 5cm water above the wheat
3. Soak for 30 minutes , use a sieve to drain it well and spread it out on a clean tea towel to dry off it bit
4. Using a blender or food processor finely pulse parsley and mint
5. Mix the cracked wheat , mint , parsley , spring onions , olive oil , lemon rind and juice together and season with salt and pepper to taste
6. Garnish with lemon wedges and fresh mint sprigs

title: crock pot stuffed cabbage soup
steps:
1. In a pot , warm the oil over medium heat , and saute beef and onions until onions are soft and beef is browned
2. Drain off the fat , and add the tomatoes , bouillon , barley , splenda , paprika , garlic , pepper , and tabasco
3. Mix well
4. Put the cabbage in the crock pot , and top with meat mixture
5. Top with beef broth
6. Cover and cook on low for 9 hours
7. Stir soup well
8. Continue to cook covered on low for another hour

title: amish corn on the cob
steps:
1. When the amish make it , they have every item to be added , at the ready , so when the corn is cut from the cob in the deep bowl , the rest of the ingredients are dumped in , stirred and served within one minute of processing
2. The corn needs to be served hot so the butter melts and the cheese becomes soft
3. Determine pot size to boil corn in , based on volume of corn cobs
4. I use a 6 quart dutch oven to boil 4 ears in , a large canning kettle to boil up to 12 ears
5. Heat the water in your kettle to boiling
6. I do not salt my water for this , as i want the corn to be as sweet as possible and also , the amish i learned it from do not salt their water for this recipe , either
7. While the water is coming to a boil , shuck your corn but leave on at least 2" of the stalk end , so you have a handle to grab when you are cutting the corn kernels off off of the cob
8. The amish use a pot holder or kitchen towel to hold the hot corn but i use a handful of sturdy paper towels to save my hand from the heat
9. Dice the swiss cheese into the same size as the corn kernels
10. Place the diced cheese , the soft butter and the dash of cayenne pepper into a small serving bowl
11. Set aside
12. This will be added to the corn bowl immediately after shucking
13. Before placing corn cobs into the water , have the following items ready: a pair of tongs to remove the corn cobs
14. A pot holder / paper towels to hold the hot corn
15. A kitchen towel or paper towels to blot the water off of the corn cob and keep them warm
16. A super sharp knife to cut off the kernels , and a wide and deep heat-proof bowl to cut the corn kernels into
17. This deep bowl is where the cut corn and swiss cheese will be mixed and served
18. When the water has reached boiling , add corn cobs
19. Heat for only 1-2 minutes , only until corn is almost just blanched
20. The kernels should be crisp and pop in your mouth when eaten
21. With the tongs , remove the hot corn cobs and place onto the kitchen towel , to blot the water and stay covered , to keep in their heat while processing each ear of corn
22. Using the pot holder or paper towels , grab the handle of the corn and using the sharp knife , cut the kernels off the cob into the deep bowl , starting at the top and working down
23. The faster you work , the hotter the corn kernels will be
24. It's okay if they come off as "strips" of corn
25. They will break up when you stir them with the other ingredients
26. After the corn has been cut from the cooked ears , immediately add the diced swiss cheese , butter and cayenne pepper to the hot corn kernels and stir until the butter is melted , about 30 seconds
27. The cheese should still be in chunks , not melted
28. Taste to see if a wee dash of more cayenne should be added
29. Serve immediately
30. Since this dish is to be served very hot , what the amish do is make mul
31. So , they'll make the 1st batch , eat it and enjoy it , make another batch , eat and enjoy that one , equally
32. As with many agricultural families , when a first crop comes in of anything: corn , tomatoes , potatoes , the farm family will make their first meal nothing but the featured food
33. So , with the first harvest of corn , the amish make this corn dish the entire meal , nothing else is served except a dessert
34. This is also the way that i grew up , so i found nothing odd about this celebration of the first season's harvest

title: mesa burgers with sage aioli and spicy chips
steps:
1. Prepare aioli : place mayonnaise , cloves of garlic , fresh sage , olive oil , and fresh lemon juice in a small food processor or blender
2. Blend until smooth and creamy
3. Set aside
4. Mix together ground meat , zucchini , beaten egg , sage , vinegar , garlic , salt and pepper
5. Form into 4 patties and refrigerate on waxed paper until time to cook
6. Peel sweet potatoes
7. Using a food processor or mandolin , shave potatoes on the thinnest setting
8. Heat oil to a depth of several inches in a large skillet or use a deep fryer
9. Cook sweet potato shavings in small batches until they are crisp
10. If you wish to bake your chips instead of frying them , place sweet potato shavings in a large plastic bag with several tablespoons of oil and shake bag gently until shavings are lightly covered with oil
11. Place shavings on an oiled baking sheet and bake at 350f for about 20 minutes , then turn chips and bake another 10 minutes or so or until crispy
12. Drain on paper toweling , and immediately season with salt and a sprinkling of cayenne pepper
13. Heat 2 tablespoons butter and 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet
14. Cook onion slices over medium-low heat until caramelized
15. Keep warm until needed
16. Grill patties over medium-hot coals or cook in a large skillet or griddle for 7-8 minutes per side or until cooked through
17. Plate burgers on toasted kaiser rolls with sage aioli , grilled onions , and a few sweet potato chips
18. Using cheese on your burgers is optional , but i would recommend a sharp cheddar if you go with that
19. Any extra aioli may be refrigerated and used as a dip for crudites , cooked vegetables , etc

title: christmas banana bread
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar in large mixing bowl
2. Add eggs one at a time , beating well after each addition
3. Sift together flour , baking soda , baking powder and salt
4. Gradually addo to creamed butter
5. Mix in bananas
6. Fold in walnuts , chocolate and cherries
7. Pour into greased 9" x 5" x 3" loaf pan
8. Bake at 350 f for 60 minutes , until toothpick inserted in center of loaf comes out clean
9. Cool 10 minutes before removing from pan to wire rack

title: update onion burger
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. In a large bowl , mix together the ground beef , onion soup mix , water , garlic , hot pepper sauce , chili powder , ketchup , mustard , and pepper using your hands
3. Pat into 4 large thick patties
4. Place them on broiler pan
5. Broil the burgers for about 15 minutes per side , or until well done
6. Place buns on the broiler pan and toast briefly
7. Place burger patties onto the bottom halves of the buns and top each one with a slice of cheese , onion , and some avocado slices
8. Top with the top buns

title: turkey cabbage casserole weight watchers
steps:
1. Place shredded cabbage in a lightly greased 2 quart casserole dish
2. In skillet cook turkey until browned and no longer pink in color
3. Add chopped onions
4. Stir occasionally and cook 3 minutes
5. Add uncooked rice to cooked turkey
6. Place turkey rice mixture over cabbage in casserole dish
7. Combine tomato sauce , garlic , and oregano , pour over cooked turkey
8. Cover and bake 350 about 1 hour

title: oriental style round steak
steps:
1. In a large skillet , brown meat in oil on all sides
2. Transfer meat and drippings to a 5-qt
3. Slow cooker
4. Combine the onion , celery , soy sauce , sugar , salt , garlic , ginger and pepper
5. Pour over meat
6. Cover and cook on low for 5-1 / 2 to 6 hours or until meat is tender
7. Add green peppers , tomato sauce , bean sprouts , water chestnuts and mushrooms
8. Cover and cook on low 1 hour longer
9. In a small bowl , combine cornstarch and water until smooth
10. Stir into beef mixture
11. Cover and cook on high for 30 minutes or until gravy is thickened
12. Serve with rice

title: glazed grilled ham
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except the ham
2. Score the fat edge of the ham slice
3. Broil the ham over slow coals for 15 minutes , turning once
4. Brush ham with sauce and broil another 15 minutes , turning and basting twice
5. Heat remaining sauce and serve with ham

title: kofta bi tahini  kofta with tahini
steps:
1. Grind meat , parsley and onions in the meat grinder using the finest disk
2. Alternatively finely dice parsley and onion
3. Add salt , spices and olive oil
4. Mold into finger shapes and place into a large pan so that they cover the whole pan
5. Slice potato and fry until lightly golden on each side
6. Arrange on top of the kofta
7. Mix tahina and lemon juice together well until it forms a smooth paste
8. Slowly add the water while stirring to keep the mixture smooth
9. Pour sauce over kofta
10. If it does not cover , mix some water with a bit of tahini , stir into smooth paste and add so that the sauce reaches the top of the potato
11. Cook on the stove with lid on at a low-medium heat until the water has boil away to form a semi-thick sauce in the bottom of the pan
12. Brown under grill
13. Eat with arabic bread
14. Alternatively , cook until the water has reduced to make a sauce and serve either in bowls with rice or over rice

title: the easiest and best chocolate cake
steps:
1. Combine the first six ingredients in a mixing bowl
2. Add egg and butter and mix well
3. Bake in a greased 8" square baking pan at 350 degrees or til cake tests done
4. Cool and dust with confectioner's sugar

title: elegant white clam sauce
steps:
1. Drain clams , saving 3 / 4 cup juices
2. Melt butter and olive oil together over medium heat
3. Add shallots and stir for 1 minute , then add mushrooms
4. Cook , stirring occasionally , until tender
5. Stir in juices , basil , salt and pepper
6. Bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat , simmer for 10 minutes uncovered
8. Add clams , simmer 3 more minutes
9. Start pasta while sauce is simmering

title: banana oatmeal snack cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350'
2. Grease and flour a 13x9 inch pan and set aside
3. In a medium bowl add flour , oats , baking soda , and salt , mix to blend and set aside
4. In a large bowl , cream together the butter and the sugar until fluffy
5. Add eggs one at a time , mixing well after each addition
6. Mix in buttermilk , bananas , and vanilla
7. Add flour mixture to the butter mixture and mix to blend
8. Fold in nuts , coconut and 1 cup of chocolate chips
9. Pour batter into prepared pan
10. Sprinkle remaining 1 cup of chocolate chips over the top of the batter
11. Bake at 350' for 30-35 minutes or until toothpick tests done

title: award winning  salmon with garlic and sun dried tomatoes
steps:
1. Combine garlic and salt and grind into a paste
2. Combine the garlic , parsley , dried tomatoes and olive oil in a bowl
3. Blending all ingredients
4. Chill until ready for use
5. With a sharp knife , cut two lengthwise slits in the salmon fillet , dividing the surface of the fish into thirds
6. Cut to the skin , but not through it
7. Preheat grill
8. Spread half the garlic mixture over the fillet and into the slits
9. Place the fish on grill and barbecue over a medium heat
10. Close the lid and grill for 15 minutes
11. Spread the remaining garlic mixture on the fillet
12. Close the lid , turning the temperature to high and grill 10 minutes more , or until fish flakes when tested
13. Remove the fish from the grill

title: zucchini peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. In a large bowl , cream margarine , peanut butter and sugars
2. Add in egg and vanilla
3. Stir to combine
4. Stir in zucchini
5. Add dry ingredients
6. Stir to combine
7. Stir in nuts and chocolate chips
8. Cover and chill dough for at least 2 hours
9. Drop by teaspoonful onto greased cookie sheet
10. Bake in a 375 oven for 12-15 minutes
11. Cool on wire rack

title: artichoke pesto
steps:
1. In a food processor combine the artichokes , parsley , walnuts , lemon zest and juice , garlic , salt , and pepper
2. Run the machine to finely chop all the ingredients , stopping the machine a few times to scrape down the sides
3. Then , with the machine running , drizzle in 1 / 2 cup extra-virgin olive oil
4. Toss the mix with pasta
5. Fold in parmesan

title: goldy bear s cereal killer cookies
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375
2. In a small bowl , mix the oats with the brickle chips
3. Sift the flour , baking soda , baking powder , and salt together
4. In a food processor , mix the sugars until blended , then gradually add the butter
5. Continue to process until creamy and smooth
6. Add the eggs and vanilla and process until blended
7. Add the flour mixture and process just until combined
8. Pour this mixture over the oats and brickle chips and stir until well combined
9. Using a 1 / 8 cup measure , scoop out dough and place 3" apart on ungreased cookied sheets
10. Bake 12 to 15 minutes , or until golden
11. Cool on wire racks

title: saucy thighs
steps:
1. Add olive oil and butter to hot frying pan
2. When butter starts sizzling add in the chicken thighs and lightly brown on both sides at a medium to medium high temperature
3. When the thighs are browned add in the onions with a good pinch of salt and pepper
4. When the onions start to take on colour add in the mushrooms and cook for a few minutes
5. Add the wine and give it a minute or two to pick up the bits on the bottom of the pan
6. Pour in the v8 and add italian seasoning
7. Bring to a light boil , put on lid and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes
8. Adjust seasoning to your preference
9. You may need to remove the lid for the last few minutes to let the sauce thicken
10. Serve over noodles or spaghetti
11. Enjoy !

title: heloise s chinese beets
steps:
1. Drain all the liquid from the beets except 1 1 / 2 cups
2. Pour the 1 1 / 2 cups beet liquid into a medium saucepan
3. Add all of the other ingredients except the sliced beets
4. Mix well
5. Add the beets
6. Cook over medium heat for 3 minutes or until liquid thickens
7. Allow to cool
8. Refrigerate

title: peanut butter oatmeal au natural
steps:
1. Combine oats and water
2. Microwave on high for 1 minute and stir
3. Return to microwave and heat on high stirring every 30 seconds until desired consistency is reached
4. Adding the peanut butter will thicken the oatmeal a little
5. I do mine for about 2 minutes and 30 seconds in my 1200 watt microwave
6. Add natural peanut butter and stir until incorporated

title: red hot venutians
steps:
1. Heat cream and cayenne pepper in small saucepan over medium to medium-low heat
2. Do not let boil
3. Chop and melt chocolate over double boiler
4. Just before boiling , pour the cream into the chocolate and stir well
5. Remove from heat and let sit for about two hours
6. Beat with an electric mixer until the chocolate becomes stiff
7. Pipe the chocolate onto a parchment-paper lined baking sheet
8. Refrigerate the chocolates until firm
9. Chop and melt the bittersweet chocolate over a double boiler
10. Dip each chocolate into the melted chocolate to coat
11. Refrigerate until solid
12. Chop and melt the white chocolate over a double boiler
13. Dip just the
14. Refrigerate and serve

title: northwest chicken salad
steps:
1. Combine mayonnaise , ginger and salt
2. Stir in remaining ingredients
3. Cover and chill
4. Serve and sprinkle with walnuts

title: ww deviled eggs with roasted red pepper  2 points
steps:
1. Shell eggs
2. Slice in half lengthwise and carefully remove yolks
3. Transfer yolks to a medium bowl and add mayonnaise , peppers , mustard and hot sauce
4. Mix until smooth and creamy
5. Spoon yolk filling into egg whites , mounding it slightly
6. Sprinkle with chives or parsley just before serving

title: shannon s sooo good barbecued spareribs
steps:
1. Season ribs with salt , pepper and garlic powder
2. In a large dutch oven or kettle , place ribs and onion
3. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
4. Add enough water to cover
5. Bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat
7. Cover and simmer for 1-1 1 / 2 hours or until tender
8. Meanwhile , combine sauce ingredients in a saucepan
9. Simmer , uncovered , for 1 hour or until slightly thickened , stirring occasionally
10. Drain ribs , place on a rack in broiler or on a hot grill
11. Brush with sauce
12. Broil 5 inches from the heat for 5 minutes on each side , brushing frequently with sauce

title: reduced fat banana cream pie  cooking light
steps:
1. Combine first 3 ingredients in a small bowl
2. Stir well
3. Add 1 tablespoon of egg white and 1 tablespoons melted margarine
4. Toss with a fork until moistened
5. Press into bottom and 3 / 4 up sides of a 10-inch pie plate coated with cooking spray
6. Bake at 325f for 17 minutes
7. Let cool on a wire rack
8. Combine 1 / 2 cup sugar , cornstarch , salt , and egg in a large bowl
9. Stir well with a wire whisk , and set aside
10. Heat milk over medium-high heat in a medium heavy saucepan to 180f or until tiny bubbles form around edge
11. Remove from heat
12. Gradually add hot milk to sugar mixture , stirring constantly with whisk
13. Return milk mixture to pan
14. Add 1 tablespoon margarine , and cook over medium heat 4 minutes or until thickened and bubbly , stirring constantly
15. Reduce heat to low , and cook an additional 2 minutes , stirring constantly until it has reached a thick custard consistency
16. Remove from heat
17. Stir in vanilla and banana flavour
18. Place pan in a large ice-filled bowl for 25 minutes or until egg mixture cools to room temperature , stirring occasionally
19. Remove pan from ice
20. Fold in the sliced ripe banana until evenly dispersed , and spoon mixture into prepared crust
21. Spread whipped topping evenly over filling
22. Cover loosely , and chill 4 hours
23. Served garnished with additional bananas and sprinkled cinnamon

title: sinful strawberries and cream icebox cake
steps:
1. To make the pastry cream , combine half and half with milk , 6 tablespoons of sugar , and the salt in a large heavy saucepan and bring to a simmer over medium heat , whisking frequently
2. Meanwhile , in a large bowl , whisk together eggs , egg yolk , cornstarch , and the remaining 2 tablespoons of granulated sugar until pale yellow and smooth , about 1 minute
3. When half and half mixture is simmering , remove from heat and gradually whisk it into the egg mixture , going slowly and whisking constantly so as not to curdle the eggs
4. Return the mixture to the pan and cook over medium heat , whisking constantly , just until a few bubbles break through the surface and the mixture has thickened and is shiny , about 1 to 2 minutes
5. Remove from the heat and whisk in the butter , one piece at a time , and then the vanilla extract
6. Pour through a strainer into a bowl and wrap well with plastic wrap
7. Refrigerate well until chilled , at least 3 hours and up to 2 days
8. To assemble the cake , line the inside of a springform pan with about 20 ladyfingers , standing them up side by side , rounded side out
9. Arrange 14 ladyfingers on the bottom of the pan to cover it
10. Whip the cream , confectioner's sugar , and vanilla extract together in a large bowl with an electric mixer until soft peaks form
11. Reserve 2 cups of the whipped cream , transferring it to a smaller bowl
12. Gently fold the chilled pastry cream into the remaining whipped cream
13. Spread half the pastry cream mixture over the ladyfingers and smooth with a spatula
14. Arrange half the strawberries in a single layer over the pastry cream mixture
15. Arrange 14 ladyfingers over the strawberries
16. Smooth the remaining pastry cream over the ladyfingers
17. Arrange the remaining strawberries over the cream
18. Top with the remaining 14 ladyfingers
19. Smooth the reserved whipped cream over the last layer of lady fingers
20. Cover the pan with plastic wrap and refrigerate until firm , at least 3 hours and up to 1 day
21. Just before serving , release the sides of the springform pan from the cake

title: cappuccino fudge cheesecake
steps:
1. For crust:
2. Finely grind cookies , chopped chocolate , brown sugar , and nutmeg in processor
3. Add butter and process until crumbs begin to stick together , scraping down bowl occasionally , about 1 minute
4. Transfer crumbs to 10-inch-diameter springform pan with 3-inch-high sides
5. Wrap plastic wrap around fingers and press crumb mixture firmly up sides to within 1 / 2 inch of top edge , then over bottom of pan
6. For ganache:
7. Bring whipping cream to simmer in large saucepan
8. Remove from heat
9. Add chocolate and kahla
10. Whisk until chocolate is melted and ganache is smooth
11. Pour 2 cups ganache over bottom of crust
12. Freeze until ganache layer is firm , about 30 minutes
13. Reserve remaining ganache
14. Cover and let stand at room temperature to use later for creating lattice pattern
15. For filling
16. Position rack in middle of oven and preheat to 350f using electric mixer , beat cream cheese and sugar in large bowl until blended
17. Beat in flour
18. Stir rum , espresso powder , ground coffee , vanilla , and molasses in small bowl until instant coffee dissolves
19. Beat into cream cheese mixture
20. Beat in eggs 1 at a time , occasionally scraping down sides of bowl
21. Pour filling over cold ganache in crust
22. Place cheesecake on rimmed baking sheet
23. Bake until top is brown , puffed and cracked at edges , and center 2 inches moves only slightly when pan is gently shaken , about 1 hour 5 minutes
24. Transfer cheesecake to rack
25. Cool 15 minutes while preparing topping
26. Maintain oven temperature
27. For topping:
28. Whisk sour cream , sugar , and vanilla in medium bowl to blend
29. Pour topping over hot cheesecake , spreading to cover filling completely
30. Bake until topping is set , about 10 minutes
31. Transfer cheesecake to rack
32. Refrigerate hot cheesecake on rack until cool , about 3 hours
33. Run small sharp knife between crust and pan sides to loosen cake
34. Release pan sides
35. Transfer cheesecake to platter
36. Spoon reserved ganache into pastry bag fitted with small star
37. Pipe 6 diagonal lines atop cheesecake , spacing 1 inch apart
38. Repeat in opposite direction , making lattice
39. Pipe rosettes of ganache around top edge of cake
40. Garnish with coffee beans , if desired
41. Chill until lattice is firm , at least 6 hours

title: vegan apple shake
steps: 1. Blend until smooth

title: white chili in the crock
steps:
1. Pick through and wash the beans with cold water
2. Put the beans in the crockpot then cover with cold water and soak the beans overnight
3. Drain and rinse the beans , then add 1 cup of fresh water
4. Set the cilantro aside and add all spices , herbs , seasonings , and meat to the crockpot
5. Simmer for eight hours
6. Top off with fresh cilantro before serving
7. Options: use chicken or pork
8. Serve over totilla chips , spaghetti , or rice

title: german cobbler cake  rsc
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300f generously grease and flour dust a bundt pan
2. Peel , core and dice pears and peaches
3. Put in a bowl and toss with cinnamon and 1 / 2 cup of the sugar
4. Set aside
5. In large mixing bowl , mix the remaining sugar , oil , honey , lemon juice , and vanilla
6. In another bowl , stir together flour , baking powder and salt
7. Add the dry ingredients to the batter alternating with the eggs
8. Mix well after each addition
9. Fold in the peaches and pears with their juices
10. Pour into the prepared bundt pan
11. Cover tightly with aluminum foil
12. Roll up a piece of aluminum foil to form a ring and place in the bottom of a 12' round cake pan
13. Place the bundt pan on the foil ring inside the cake pan
14. Press to level on the foil
15. Pour 2 cups warm water in the bottom of the cake pan
16. Put in oven
17. Bake for 2 hours then remove foil cover and test for doneness
18. If not done , leave foil off and continue baking until the cake tests done
19. Remove from oven and allow to cool 10 minutes
20. Invert onto serving plate
21. Serve with a dollup of topping
22. While cake bakes , prepare topping
23. Put cream and vanilla in a medium bowl
24. Beat on medium speed until soft peaks form
25. Add powdered sugar
26. Beat on slow speed to incorporate and then beat on medium speed until soft peaks form
27. Cover with foil and refrigerater until ready to serve

title: irresistible chocolate cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Blend together 1 cup sugar , cocoa powder and 1 / 2 cup yogurt
3. In another bowl , cream butter with 1 cup sugar
4. Beat eggs , one at a time , into creamed butter
5. Then beat in cocoa mixture
6. In a separate bowl , sift together flour , salt and baking soda
7. Add flour to butter cocoa mixture , alternating with remaining 1 / 2 cup of yogurt into which the kahlua has been blended
8. Fold in chocolate chips
9. Pour evenly into a buttered 10-inch springform tube pan that has been dusted with cocoa powder
10. Bake for approximately one hour or until tester comes out clean
11. Cool cake on a rack before removing from pan
12. For the glaze---------------
13. Break chocolate into bits
14. Place double boiler over , not in , a pan of hot water
15. Add chocolate , cream , butter and kahlua
16. Cover tightly and heat for a few minutes , stir until completely melted and smooth
17. Transfer to stainless steel bowl and cover
18. Keep at room temperature
19. Slowly pour about half the glaze over the top of the cake spreading it evenly with a metal spatula over the top , sides and in the center
20. Refrigerate until glaze is firm
21. Then repeat with remaining glaze
22. Refrigerate again to allow second layer of glaze to firm up
23. Decorate with piped buttercream chocolate frosting in an interesting shape and top each with a chocolate coffee bean or pecan or walnut half
24. Or just accent with fresh flowers in center and around the sides
25. Best served the next day

title: the best chicken tortilla soup
steps:
1. Throw everything except the garnishes in your crock pot and let it cook on high for 5-6 hours
2. Dress with garnishes and give it a squeeze of lime and you're good to go !
3. Enjoy !
4. If you are not using a crock pot , saute the garlic and onion in 2 tablespoons olive oil before adding the remaining ingredients
5. Simmer for at least an hour so that the flavors mix together

title: wilton royal icing
steps:
1. Place sugar and meringue powder in a bowl and stir at low speed
2. Add water and mix on low to medium for 7-10 minutes , until icing loses its sheen
3. To prevent drying out , keep the bowl and icing
4. Will keep for two weeks stored in the fridge
5. Whip again before using

title: oatmeal  chocolate chip blondies
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugars
2. Add eggs and vanilla
3. Beat well
4. Sift dry ingredients and add gradually to wet ingredients
5. Mix well
6. Add oats , 1 cup at a time , chocolate chips , coconut or pecans and mix
7. Spread dough evenly into ungreased 15 x 10 inch pan
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 20-25 minutes

title: best damn guac ever  guacamole
steps:
1. Turn your radio to a spanish station
2. Cut open the 4 avocado's around the equator
3. Scoop out the avocado insides and place into medium-sized bowl
4. Now , mash up the avocados in the bowl with a potato masher
5. Next , cut up the bell pepper , onion
6. Tomatoes , jalapenos , apple and cilantro
7. Place all of this into the bowl with the mashed avocados
8. Next , measure out the sour cream , garlic powder , lime juice , and celery seed
9. Add to the avocado bowl and mix thoroughly with a spoon
10. Salt / pepper to taste

title: canadian bacon  mushroom  and peppers pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Place the shell on an ungreased 12-inch nonstick pizza pan
3. To assemble the pizza , spread the pizza sauce over the shell , leaving a 1-inch border around the rim
4. Sprinkle with half of the cheese
5. Arrange the canadian bacon on top of the cheese , covering evenly
6. Top with mushroom slices and bell pepper rings
7. Sprinkle evenly with oregano , basil , and red pepper flakes
8. Top with remaining cheese
9. Bake for 13 to 15 minutes , until the crust is crisp and the cheese is melted and browned
10. Cut into 6 wedges

title: perfect no fail roast turkey gravy
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , bring the water , turkey parts , shredded carrot , celery and onion , and bay leaf to a boil
2. Cover , and reduce heat to a simmer
3. Simmer , about 45 minutes to 1 hour , or until liver is done
4. Remove liver and set aside
5. Continue to cook , covered , until giblets are done , about 2 hours more
6. Use a slotted spoon to remove turkey parts to a cutting board
7. Let cool slightly , then carefully remove all bones from meat
8. Cut up the turkey and liver into fine pieces
9. Set aside
10. Make a paste by whisking together 1 / 2 cup water and the flour in a glass measuring cup
11. Gradually whisk the paste into the warm broth , whisking briskly to combine
12. Bring to a boil and boil gently , whisking all the while , for 2-3 minutes until gravy is thickened
13. Now reduce heat to low and stir in the turkey drippings , milk or cream , and finely chopped turkey meat
14. Heat through briefly , and season with salt and pepper to taste
15. Pour into a gravy boat to serve
16. Enjoy your perfect gravy !

title: my friend the friand
steps:
1. Heat oven to 200 degrees c
2. Melt butter and allow it to cool
3. Use 1 tablespoon to coat 10 muffin tin moulds or individual oval baking moulds measuring 5 x 10 cm
4. Sift icing sugar and flour into bowl , mix in the ground almonds
5. Lightly beat egg whites with a fork , fold them into dry ingredients
6. Add cooled , melted butter and orange rind , mix well
7. Three quarters fill each mould with mixture and bake on the middle shelf of oven for 10 minutes
8. Turn tray around , and bake for another 5- 10 minutes , till tops are golden , and springy to the touch
9. Leave in the tins for 5 minutes , then gently unmould onto a wire tray and leave to cool
10. Dust the friands with icing sugar to serve

title: flemish stew
steps:
1. Make spice bag by tying the spices into a piece of folded cheese cloth or muslin
2. Use a heavy pan or rolling pin to bruise the spices
3. Heat pan on medium-high heat and add oil
4. Put flour and salt into a bag , add pork cubes and shake until well coated
5. Brown cubes in hot oil on on sides
6. Set aside browned meat
7. Reduce heat and add onions and garlic
8. Saute just until translucent , don't brown
9. Add wine or juice to pan , and scrape up all the brown bits
10. Put vegetables into bottom of crockpot , add meat on top and add beef broth and wine or juice and onion mixture
11. Pour broth over everything and set cooker to "low"
12. Add spice bag and simmer for 6 hours
13. Stirring once an hour so helps distribute the spices
14. To serve , remove spice bag and discard

title: italian brunch casserole
steps:
1. Remove and discard casings from sausage
2. Cook sausage in a large skillet , stirring until sausage crumbles and is no longer pink
3. Drain
4. Add green onions and next 3 ingredients to skillet
5. Saut 4 minutes or until vegetables are tender
6. Stir in roasted bell peppers
7. Drain and cool
8. Spread 4 cups of bread cubes in a lightly greased 13- x 9-inch baking dish
9. Top with half each of the sausage mixture and cheese
10. Repeat with remaining bread , sausage , and cheese
11. Whisk together eggs and milk
12. Pour egg mixture over bread
13. Cover and chill 8 hours
14. Bake , covered , at 325 for 1 hour or until bubbly and hot

title: hungarian style potatoes   green beans
steps:
1. Add a bit of water to a microwavable bowl with a steamer basket
2. Place potatoes and beans in the steamer basket
3. Cover and microwave for 3 minutes on high
4. Allow to stand for 2 minutes
5. Add the onion and microwave for another minute
6. Allow to stand for 1 minute
7. Place cooked veggies in a bowl
8. Add the tomato , parsley , olive oil , butter buds and paprika
9. Toss well to combine all ingredients
10. Serve immediately

title: aunt melody s vidalia onion casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Melt the butter in a large skillet , add onions and saute until soft
3. Remove from heat and add sour cream
4. Mix thoroughly
5. Scoop half of the onion mixture into a small greased casserole dish
6. Top with parmesan cheese
7. Layer with remaining onion mixture and 1 / 4 cup parmesan cheese
8. Sprinkle the top with ritz crackers
9. Bake for 30 minutes at 350 degrees

title: guinness pub burgers
steps:
1. In a bowl , gently mix the beef , beer , mustard , ginger , garlic , salt , and pepper together
2. Form mixture into 4 patties , each inch thick
3. Melt the butter in a large skillet over med-high heat
4. Cook the burgers 3-5 minutes per side for medium or until desired doneness
5. Remove patties from skillet
6. Add in the scallions
7. Cook 1-2 minutes , stirring , until just wilted
8. Serve patties on toasted sesame seed buns with some pan sauce on top

title: filet mignon with avocado and sea salt
steps:
1. Halve , pit , and peel the avocado
2. Cut it into slices lengthwise and drizzle with freshly squeezed lime juice
3. Season the filets mignons with salt and pepper
4. Flatten lightly with your hand
5. Use a heavy-bottomed saute pan on high heat , and coat it with the olive oil
6. When the oil smokes , add the filets and sear them for about two minutes on each side , just until brown
7. If you are using a large enough saute pan , simply remove the filets and add a small roasting rack to the pan
8. If not , transfer the filets to an ovenproof pan with a roasting rack
9. Preheat to 350f finish cooking the filets in the oven for about 15 minutes for medium rare
10. Serve with slices of avocado on top , sprinkle sea salt and drizzle with olive oil
11. Garnish with cilantro sprigs
12. Serve with cilantro serrano chile rice , or any other risotto or rice of your choosing

title: zesty mexican tomato soup
steps:
1. Saute' all the veggies with the spices in the olive oil until the peppers have brightened and started to wilt , then add the cilantro and the tomato puree
2. When the puree begins to bubble , add 12 cups of water , and the beans and corn
3. Add the salsa of choice
4. Put in the lime juice after it has all boiled for 5 minutes
5. Season to taste with salt , pepper and ketchup
6. Serve if desired with grated cheddar cheese and corn chips
7. Enjoy !

title: rachael ray s buffalo chicken chili
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f or broiler to medium
2. Place a large pot over medium-high heat , add 1 turn of the pan of evoo , about 1 tablespoon , and the butter
3. Once the butter has melted and the pot is hot , add the ground chicken
4. Brown it , using the back of a wooden spoon to break it up in to small pieces , about 5-6 minutes
5. Add the carrot , onion , celery , garlic , paprika , bay leaf and some salt and pepper
6. Cook , stirring frequently , for about 3-4 minutes
7. Add the chicken stock and scrape up any brown bits on the bottom of the pot
8. Add the hot sauce , tomato sauce and crushed tomatoes , and bring up to a bubble
9. Simmer for 8-10 minutes to let the flavors come together
10. While the chili is simmering , spread the yellow and blue corn chips out on a cookie sheet
11. Top with the crumbled blue cheese and transfer to the oven to melt the cheese , about 4-5 minutes
12. If using the broiler , 2-3 minutes should do the trick
13. Remove from the oven and sprinkle with the chopped parsley
14. Top each serving of buffalo chicken chili with a few blue cheese-topped corn chips

title: soy nut butter cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Combine brown sugar , soynut butter , shortening , soy milk and vanilla in a large bowl
3. Beat at medium speed with an electric mixer until well blended
4. Add egg to sugar mixture
5. Beat just until blended
6. Combine flour , soy flour , baking soda and salt
7. Add to sugar mixture at low speed
8. Mix just until blended
9. Drop dough by teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheets
10. Flatten slightly by pressing 4 soynuts into each cookie center in a pinwheel design
11. Bake cookies for 7 to 9 minutes or until set and just beginning to brown
12. Do not over brown
13. Cool 1 minute on baking sheet
14. Remove cookies to wire rack to cool completely

title: apricot glazed pork tenderloin
steps:
1. Heat broiler
2. Set rack 4 inches from heat
3. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil
4. Rub pork with oil
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Broil 10 minutes
7. In a small saucepan , whisk together jam and mustard
8. Cook over medium heat until jam melts
9. Remove from heat
10. Transfer 1 / 2 sauce to a small bowl for brushing
11. Cover saucepan to keep remaining sauce warm
12. Remove pork from broiler
13. Brush with reserved sauce
14. Continue broiling until pork is blackened in spots and registers 150 degrees on an instant read thermomenter
15. Cover pork loosely with foil and let rest 5 minutes
16. Slice into medallions and drizzle with warm sauce

title: pio chilean empanada filling
steps:
1. Preparation: chop onion , mince garlic
2. Saute onion in olive oil and add garlic
3. Once onions are translucent add beef and brown
4. While browning , add salt , sugar , spices , and bay leaf
5. Simmer for 20 minutes uncovered
6. Remove bay leaf , and add olives and raisins
7. Serve in your choice of empanada dough , made from scratch or frozen

title: cinnamon flops bars
steps:
1. Mix and pour in a well greased pan
2. Sprinkle on topping
3. Bake for 20 minutes at 425 degrees

title: capellini wth shrimp and creamy tomato sauce
steps:
1. Heat oil in a 12-inch heavy skillet over medium-high heat until it shimmers , then cook shrimp and garlic with oregano , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper , turning once , until golden , about 2 minutes total
2. Stir in vermouth and tomatoes , scraping up any brown bits from bottom of skillet
3. Add cream and briskly simmer until sauce has thickened slightly , about 1 minute
4. Stir in lemon juice
5. Meanwhile , cook capellini in a pasta pot of boiling salted water until al dente
6. Reserve 1 cup pasta-cooking water , then drain pasta
7. Serve pasta immediately , topped iwth shrimp and sauce
8. Thin with some of the reserved water if necessary

title: beetleaf vegan pasta
steps:
1. Wash and pat dry beetroot leaves
2. Coarsely slice into strips
3. Place in frying pan with olive oil over a med low flame and cover
4. While beetroot leaves are wilting slice up the garlic
5. When leaves begin to wilt add the garlic to the pan and toss / stir
6. Add a bit of salt to taste
7. Cover again stirring occasionally until the garlic becomes translucent
8. Remove from heat
9. Make pasta according to directions on bag
10. Add cooked leaf / garlic mixture to pasta
11. Add some canned or homemade tomato sauce and freshly ground black pepper
12. Eat and enjoy

title: blueberry apricot jam
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together , stirring frequently , in a heavy-bottom pot over medium heat
2. Cook about an hour , until consistency is thick when dribbled off a spoon
3. Can according to manufacturer's directions , or store refrigerated and use within three months , or freeze for up to a year

title: lemonberry muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. In large bowl , whisk together flour , baking soda , baking powder , and sea salt
3. In small bowl , whisk together soymilk , brown rice syrup , oil , and lemon flavoring
4. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients , mix well by hand
5. Gently fold in raspberries
6. Fill the cups of 12-cup muffin tin two-thirds full
7. Bake 20 to 25 minutes , or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
8. Let muffins cool on cooling rack so bottoms do not become soggy

title: black currant   vanilla punch
steps:
1. Bring apple juice to the boil , remove from heat & put tea bags into the liquid
2. Allow to cool
3. When cold take out tea bags , add mineral water
4. A presentation

title: the treasure box
steps: 1. Neatly place all together and your box is ready !

title: swedish red cabbage
steps:
1. Melt butter in a heavy large dutch oven over medium high heat
2. Add apples and onion and saute until tender , about 10 minutes
3. Stir in cabbage and stir frequently for about 8 minutes
4. Stir in sugar , vinegar , salt , cloves , and allspice
5. Cover and cook until cabbage is crisp-tender about 10 minutes
6. Uncover and add red wine and jelly and cook 5 minutes more
7. Add salt and pepper to taste if desired

title: spiced bulgur salad
steps:
1. Toast the bulgur in a frypan over medium heat for a few minutes , stirring , until it is turning golden and it starts to pop slightly
2. Pour into a bowl , add boiling water , and set aside
3. Heat the olive oil in the frypan over medium heat
4. Add the onions , cinnamon , cardamom , allspice and ginger
5. Cook , stirring frequently , until the onion is translucent
6. Add the cooked and seasoned onions , celery , red pepper , chickpeas , sultanas , pine nuts and most of the herbs to the bulgur mixture
7. Season with salt and pepper , and fold everything together
8. Garnish with the remaining herbs

title: afghan kabuli pulao
steps:
1. Earlier in the day: place the rice in a large colander and run cold water over it to rinse it well
2. Now pour the rice in a large bowl and cover it with cold water to soak for 4 to 5 hours
3. Pour 1 / 6 cup of sugar into a large , hot saucepan over medium heat and keep shaking the pan until the sugar caramelizes
4. Add 1 cup of the reserved lamb stock , the rawspicebars afghan pulao spices , salt and pepper to taste , if needed
5. Bring to a boil , remove from heat and set aside
6. Drain the soaked rice
7. Then , following the cooking directions on the package , boil it until just soft
8. Drain again and pour the rice over the caramelized sugar mixture and stir until the rice is well coated
9. Using a frying pan , heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat
10. Add the carrots and the remaining sugar and stir for 5 minutes or until caramelized and glossy
11. Add the raisins and cook for another minute
12. Remove from heat and set aside
13. With the underside of a large wooden spoon punch holes all over the rice allowing the steam to escape
14. Drizzle rice with olive oil
15. Now , top the rice with the carrot mixture and the prepared lamb
16. Cover with a tea towel and the lid of the pan
17. Make sure the towel is under the lid so it doesnt burn
18. Now turn the heat to high and cook the rice mixture for 5 minutes
19. Reduce the heat to low and cook for another 10 minutes
20. Remove from heat and keep it covered for 10 more minutes
21. To serve , cover a large platter with a layer of the rice , spoon the lamb over it , and then all the remaining rice
22. Top with the carrot mixture and finally with the almonds and pistachios
23. This serves a large family , as is traditional with afghan communities

title: banoffi pie
steps:
1. Put milk can , unopened , in a pan that is big enough to cover it completely with water
2. Boil gently for 2 hours
3. Let cool
4. Open can and spread over the pie crust
5. Toss the bananas with lemon juice and arrange over the filling
6. Cover with whipped cream
7. Dust with cocoa powder or decorate with chocolate curls

title: homemade  beenie weenie
steps:
1. Slice your hot dogs and brown in butter in skillet
2. After they have browned drain off any fat and add baked beans
3. Heat over medium heat until beans are heated through and serve

title: poor man s pudding  pouding chomeur
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400f
2. In a large heavy pan , bring to a boil the maple syrup and the cream
3. Pay close attention , because it will boil over ! once a slow roll begins , continue for about 3 to 4 minutes , and remove from the heat
4. With an electric beater , beat the butter and the sugar together
5. Add the eggs and continue beating for about 2 minutes
6. Sift together the flour , baking powder and the salt
7. Add the dry ingredients into the the egg mixture , alternating with the milk
8. Pour the batter into a 13x9-inch pan
9. Pour the maple syrup / cream mix on top
10. Bake for 30 minutes
11. Enjoy with vanilla ice cream , whipped cream , or all by itself !
12. Before adding anything , put in one or two frozen raspberries , then the batter , followed by the maple / cream mix
13. Makes an impressive and tasty quick dessert on a cold winter night for guests

title: super easy sugar cookies
steps:
1. Combine ingredients in mixer bowl until blended
2. Shape into small balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet
3. Beat egg white slightly with fork
4. Dip fork in egg white and lightly press cookie
5. Sprinkle with additional sugar
6. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350f

title: french onion soup in under an hour
steps:
1. Heat oil in saucepot
2. Add onions
3. Cover and cook over low heat 15 minutes
4. Uncover
5. Add sugar and cook over medium heat 15 minutes , or until onions are golden
6. Add flour and cook and stir 1 minutes
7. Add broth and wine
8. Heat to a boil
9. Cover and cook over low heat 10 minutes
10. Divide soup among four bowls
11. Top each with bread and cheese
12. (i'm sure you could also toast under the broiler for a minute or two if you have oven proof bowls

title: rooibos juice
steps: 1. Combine and pour into ice filled glasses

title: buttered wild mushrooms with onion and hot chilis
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a skillet or wok over moderate heat
2. Add all the ingredients at once and stir-fry for 10 minutes
3. Serve warm with plain rice

title: tagliatelle with meatballs
steps:
1. To make the sauce , heat the oil in a pan
2. Add the onions and celery and cook until translucent
3. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute
4. Stir in all the tomatoes with the tomato paste , sugar , and wine , and season to taste with salt and pepper
5. Bring to a boil and simmer for 10 minutes
6. Meanwhile , break up the meat in a bowl with a wooden spoon , until it becomes a sticky paste
7. Stir in the bread crumbs , garlic , herbs , and spices
8. Stir in the cheese and enough milk to make a firm paste
9. Flour your hands , take large spoonfuls of the mixture , and shape into 12 balls
10. Heat the oil in a skillet and cook the meatballs for 5-6 minutes , until browned
11. Pour the tomato sauce over the meatballs
12. Lower the heat , cover the pan , and simmer for 30 minutes , turning once or twice
13. Add a little extra water if the sauce is beginning to become dry
14. Bring a large pan of lightly salted water to a boil
15. Add the pasta , bring back to a boil , and cook for 8-10 minutes , until tender but still firm to the bite
16. Drain the pasta , then turn into a warmed serving dish , dot with the butter , and toss with 2 forks
17. Spoon the meatballs and sauce over the pasta and serve immediately
18. Enjoy !

title: ginger ale with christmas spices
steps:
1. Fill a highball glass with ice
2. Add remaining ingredients

title: easy baked ravioli casserole
steps:
1. In a large skillet , brown ground beef , until no longer pink , and drain
2. Put it back into the large skillet , and add salt , pepper , and garlic powder
3. In a large saucepan , cook onion , and zucchini in margarinejust until tender crisp , and stir in spaghetti sauce
4. In a buttered 9x13 inch baking dish , spread 1 / 2 cup of sauce , layer 1 / 2 of ravoli , half spaghetti sauce , half beef , and half cheese
5. Repeat again except omit the cheese
6. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes
7. Uncover and sprinkle remaining cheese
8. Let stand 10 minutes before serving

title: fruit cups
steps:
1. Without draining any of the fruit , combine all ingredients in a large bowl
2. Mix well
3. Spoon by the cupful into 9 oz
4. Cups and freeze until firm
5. Remove from freezer about 15 minutes prior to serving
6. I like to serve them when they are slushy but still frozen

title: spiced tangerine ham
steps:
1. Squeeze juice from six of the tangerines
2. Strain the pulp
3. Segment remaining tangerines
4. Set aside
5. In small bowl , combine cornstarch and tangerine juice until smooth
6. Stir in honey , ginger and cloves in non stick skillet with non stick cooking spray
7. Brown ham slices on both sides
8. Remove and keep warm
9. Stir in tangerine juice and add to skillet
10. Bring to a boil and cook and stir for two minutes or until thickened
11. Stir in the segments , heat through
12. Serve over the ham

title: sweet  cinnamon yellow bread
steps:
1. Beat cake mix , pudding , eggs , oil , water and extracts together for 8 minutes
2. Mix sugar and cinnamon together
3. Set aside
4. Pam spray loaf pans
5. Pour 2 / 3 batter into pans equally
6. Pour cinnamon mixture equally over both loaves
7. Using a knife swirl cinnamon through batter
8. Top with remaining batter equally over both
9. Bake at 350f for 1 hour

title: cheesy tater tot casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Brown ground beef , add onion to saute , drain , set aside
3. In a large mixing bowl , combine soup , milk , sour cream , and 1 cup of shredded cheese , as well as any of your favorite seasoning , mix well
4. Add package of tots , beef , and onions to soup mix
5. Mix all together and make sure the tots are well coated
6. Place tot mixture in a 13x9 pan , smooth it out
7. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes
8. Remove from oven , top with remaining 2 cups of cheese and return to oven
9. Cook for an additional 30 minutes

title: simply rich cheddar scalloped potatoes
steps:
1. Use a big pot
2. Saute chopped onions in margarine til soft but not browned
3. In small bowl , combine flour , salt and pepper
4. Stir flour mixture into onion mixture then add milk and half and half and stir and cook over medium heat until mixture begins to thicken
5. Turn off heat
