6. Add 1 1 / 2 cups shredded cheddar to the sauce and stir til melted and smooth
7. Add sliced potatoes and stir well to combine
8. Pour mixture into a 9 by 13 casserole dish that you have sprayed with pam
9. Cover with foil and bake at 350 for 35 minutes
10. Remove from oven , take foil off and sprinkle reserved 1 / 2 cup cheese over top
11. Return to oven to bake another 30 minutes or so or until potatoes are soft , cheese is melted and edges begin to lightly brown
12. Let stand a few minutes before serving to allow sauce to thicken

title: apple cranberry crumb pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven 375f
2. Beat egg yolk and brush on crust
3. Bake at 375f for 5 minutes
4. Set aside
5. In a skillet , melt butter over medium-high heat
6. Saute apples until crisp-tender
7. Combine cranberry sauce and cornstarch
8. Stir into apples
9. Spoon into prepared pie crust
10. For the topping: cut butter into sugar , flour and spices until coarse crumbs form
11. Stir in nuts
12. Sprinkle over apple filling
13. Bake in preheated 375f oven for 40 minutes or until crust is toasted and filling begins to bubble
14. Serve warm with whipped cream or ice cream

title: bacon and tater tots crock pot breakfast
steps:
1. In 4-5 quart crock pot , layer ingredients in order: one third of the tater tots , bacon , onions , green peppers , and cheeses
2. Repeat layers two more times , ending with cheeses
3. In a medium mixing bowl , combine eggs , milk , and flour and beat with whisk or egg beater until combined
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste
5. Pour mixture over layers in crock pot
6. Cover crock pot and cook on low
7. The cooking time may take anywhere from four hours to overnight , depending on your crock pot

title: creamy eggnog punch with spiced rum
steps:
1. Scoop ice cream into a punch bowl
2. Pour eggnog over ice cream , and sprinkle with nutmeg and cinnamon
3. Stir in whipped topping
4. To each glass add a shot of rum , then eggnog , one cinnamon stick , top with a couple of drops of grenadine and a cherry
5. Serve immediately
6. Stir , as needed

title: moroccan cinnamon cookies  mantecados
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Put the flour into a large bowl
3. Make a well in the center
4. Add oil , egg , sugar and grated lemon rind
5. Knead the dough
6. Grease a baking sheet and sprinkle with some flour
7. Gently form small balls from dough and flatten a little
8. Arrange them on the sheet
9. Let stand for 20 minutes
10. Sprinkle the cookies with cinnamon
11. Bake for 20 minutes

title: southwestern creamy ranch dip
steps:
1. In medium bowl , blend together sour cream , mayonnaise , ranch dressing mix and tomatoes and green chiles
2. Finely chop cilantro and stir into tomato mixture and squeeze the lemon juice into tomato mixture and mix well
3. Refrigerate until serving time and serve cold with tostitos

title: another yummy monkey bread
steps:
1. Prepare a bundt pan with cooking spray , arrange pecans on bottom of pan
2. Sprinkle 3 tbsp of brown sugar over the pecans
3. In deep mixing bowl combine both sugars , cinnamon and mix well
4. Melt butter and mix with vanilla
5. Cut loaves in half and then into eights
6. Roll each slice into a ball and dip in butter mixture
7. Toss them into the sugar mixture to coat and layer on top of the pecan mixture in the pan
8. Continue the process until all the slices / balls are coated and in the pan
9. Let rise in a warm place until double in size
10. Bake in a preheated 350f oven for 30-35 minutes or until golden brown
11. Remove from oven and invert onto serving platter
12. Allow the bread to rest about 5 minutes before removing the bundt pan
13. Serve warm
14. May prepare this the night before , follow the directions and cover with wax paper , it will continue to raise in the refrigerator overnight
15. After you take it out let it come to room temperature , then just follow the baking directions

title: wholesome granola bar
steps:
1. Butter or spray 8x8-inch baking pan
2. Preheat oven to 350f
3. Combine granola , oatmeal , cranberries , raisins , flour , almonds , and cinnamon in large mixing bowl
4. In smaller bowl , lightly beat egg whites
5. Stir in honey , brown sugar , and oil
6. Stir in honey mixture into dry ingredients until all coated
7. Press evenly into pan
8. Bake 20-25 minutes or until golden brown
9. Let cool fully then cut into bars

title: chocolate fix
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 deg
2. Spray 24 muffin tins with cooking spray
3. Place cereal in bowl and pour water over
4. Let sit for 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Add remaining mixture and mix well with spoon
6. Fill tins with about 1 / 4 cup of mixture
7. Bake 16-20 minutes
8. Don't overbake !

title: hearty pasta tomato soup   slow cooker
steps:
1. In a skillet , cook the sausage over medium heat until no longer pink
2. Drain
3. Transfer to a 5-qt
4. Slow cooker
5. Add the next 13 ingredients
6. Cover and cook on high for 3-4 hours or until the vegetables are tender
7. Cook tortellini according to package directions
8. Drain
9. Stir into slow cooker
10. Cover and cook 30 minutes longer
11. Serve with parmesan cheese if desired
12. Yield: 14 servings

title: greek rice pudding  rizogalo
steps:
1. Place milk , sugar and lemon peel in a heavy saucepan
2. Bring mixture to a boil , stirring constantly until sugar melts
3. Reduce heat to low and add the rice
4. Cover the pan and cook until the rice / milk mixture has gone thick and creamy
5. Turn off heat
6. Remove lemon peel and discard
7. Whisk together egg yolks with corn flour
8. Quickly whisk egg yolks into the rice mixture , stirring well
9. Keep stirring to make sure yolks are incorporated and won't curdle
10. Spoon pudding into four serving dishes and cool
11. Top with a sprinkling of cinnamon

title: zesty braised chicken with lemon and capers
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350
2. Season the chicken with salt and pepper and dust with flour
3. In a large ovenproof skillet , melt the butter in the oil
4. Add the chicken , skin side down , and cook over high heat , turning once , until browned , 6 to 10 minutes
5. Transfer the chicken to a large plate and pour off all but 1 tablespoon of the fat
6. Add the garlic to the skillet and cook over low heat until softened , about 5 minutes
7. Add the wine and boil over high heat until reduced by half , about 5 minutes
8. Add the stock , lemon zest , thyme , capers and bay leaf and bring to a boil
9. Return the chicken to the pan , skin side up
10. Transfer the skillet to the oven and braise for about 20 minutes , until the meat is tender
11. Return the skillet to the stove and boil until the sauce is slightly reduced , about 5 minutes
12. Discard the thyme , bay leaf and lemon zest , if desired , before serving

title: one dish cinnamon swirl bake
steps:
1. Spray a 8x8-inch baking dish with cooking spray
2. Mixture batter ingredients right in prepared pan
3. Let rest for 10 minutes
4. Combine cinnamon mixture in a small bowl by mixing with fork
5. Top batter evenly with cinnamon mixture , poke topping thoroughly into batter with fingers or the end of a spoon
6. Place in a cold oven
7. Set temperature to 350f
8. Bake 25-30 minutes , until lightly browned and firm in center
9. Cool 10 minutes
10. Combine icing ingredients and drizzle over warm cake

title: cinnabutter toast
steps:
1. Toast the bread and butter it
2. Combine cinnamon and sugar
3. Sprinkle the cinnamon-sugar over the butter
4. Say "mmmmm -- "

title: peach pound cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan and set aside
3. In large mixing bowl , beat butter and sugar well , until very light and fluffy
4. Beating well after each addition , one at a time add eggs
5. In a separate bowl , combine flour , soda and salt
6. Mix together sour cream and peaches
7. Beginning and ending with dry ingredients , alternately add dry ingredients and sour cream-peach mixture to creamed mixture
8. Beat well after each addition
9. Stir in extracts
10. Pour batter into prepared pan and bake until cake tests done , 75 to 80 minutes
11. Cool slightly , remove from pan and cool completely
12. 10-12 servings
13. This recipe was delicious , using the amounts stated in my recipe
14. The reviewer's recipe is an entirely different recipe , and should not be confused with mine

title: ham and potato soup  for the slow cooker
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large slow cooker
2. Cover and cook on low-heat setting for 4 to 6 hours or until potatoes are tender
3. To serve garnish with diced green onions

title: onion cheese bread  bread making machine
steps:
1. Add first 5 ingredients into the bread maker in order
2. Use a spoon to level out the flour , then sprinle yeast on top of flour
3. Set machine to basic setting
4. When the "add in" beeper beeps , add in cheese
5. Let it bake and enjoy !

title: cajun fettuccine alfredo
steps:
1. Heat oil and garlic in a skillet
2. Add shrimp , crawfish , sausage and seasonings
3. When shrimp just turn pink , add heavy cream and bring to a simmer
4. Add parmesan cheese and simmer until a smooth and creamy consistency is reached
5. Toss with cooked fettucine , garnish with chopped scallions and serve with warm french bread

title: butternut squash with lebanese spiced ground beef and garlic yog
steps:
1. Pre-heat the oven to 425f / 220c / gas mark 7
2. Using a strong , sharp knife , halve the butternut lengthways
3. Scrape out and discard the seeds
4. Extend the cavity by cutting out chunks of squash
5. Dont be too fussy about this because you want plenty of butternut to remain
6. Cut a light lattice all over the flesh to speed up cooking
7. Use 1 tbsp olive oil to smear the surface lavishly
8. Season with sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
9. Roast for 35-45 minutes or until the flesh is meltingly tender
10. Meanwhile , peel , halve and chop the onion
11. Heat the remaining 1 tbs olive oil in a spacious frying pan and cook the onion for about 10 minutes until limp and uncoloured
12. Finely chop the excavated butternut
13. Add the mince , increase the heat slightly and cook , stirring and breaking up clumps of meat
14. If using extra lean like i do add some canola oil to keep the meat less dry ! it will take about 6 minutes to be browned all over
15. Add chopped butternut squash
16. Stir in the cumin , baharat , sea salt , to taste , freshly ground black pepper , to taste , and pine kernels
17. Cook for a couple of minutes
18. Add water , simmer , cover and cook for 8-10 minutes
19. Remove the lid and cook briskly until juicy but not the least bit wet or greasy
20. Taste and adjust the seasoning
21. Chop the parsley leaves
22. Stir into the mixture
23. Spoon it into the cavity and over the cooked squash
24. To make the yoghurt , peel , chop and crush the garlic with a generous pinch of sea salt
25. Beat into the yoghurt with the lemon juice and 1 tbsp of the best olive oil you have
26. Spoon the yoghurt over the butternut and serve
27. Enjoy !

title: holly s low carb pizza
steps:
1. Assemble
2. Cook in 350f oven for 10 minutes

title: smoky baked ziti and sausage
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f grease a 13" x 9" x 2" baking dish
2. Set aside
3. Cook pasta in lightly salted boiling water for 8 to 9 minutes
4. Drain
5. In medium-size bowl , stir together the cheeses , garlic salt , basil , and black pepper
6. In large bowl , stir together cooked pasta , half of the cheese mixture , red pepper , sausage , half of the drained tomatoes , and half of the pasta sauce
7. Spoon pasta mixture into prepared baking dish
8. Top with remaining drained tomatoes , pasta sauce , and cheese mixture
9. Cover and bake at 375f for 30 minutes
10. Uncover and bake for 15 more minutes or until bubbly
11. Let stand 10 minutes before serving

title: mexican bread dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Take bread and hollow out to make a bowl ~ reserve removed pieces for dipping
3. Cook & brown sausage till done and drain off excess grease
4. Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix until well combined
5. Place combined ingredients into bread
6. Spray bread , dip , and crumbs with cooking spray and sprinkle lightly with red pepper
7. Bake in oven for 20 minutes
8. Serve immediately

title: chatahoochee rice
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , combine rice , water , salt , 1 teaspoon butter , and vinegar
2. Cook according to directions on rice package
3. Set aside , keeping warm
4. Over medium-high heat , melt 1 / 4 cup butter in a large skillet
5. Add carrots , onions , cashews , and peas
6. Cover and cook 5 minutes
7. Add vegetables to rice and stir to combine
8. Serve immediately

title: green curry chicken noodle stir fry
steps:
1. Place noodles in a heatproof bowl cover with boiling water and soak for 1 minute or until tender
2. Drain well
3. Heat a wok over high heat , add the oil and swirl to coat
4. Cook chicken , in batches , until cooked through and to your liking
5. Remove and keep warm
6. Stir-fry the onion for 1-2 minutes , or until softened
7. Add the curry paste and cook for 1 minute , or until fragrant
8. Add the baby corn , beans , coconut milk and stock to the wok and simmer for 4 minutes or until reduced slightly
9. Add the chicken back to the wok
10. Stir in plam sugar , fish sauce and lime juice
11. Add the noodles and chopped coriander and toss until well combined and the noodles are warmed through
12. Serve immediately

title: fudge brownie pudding cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 degrees
2. You'll need an 8-inch square or other 2-quart , 2-inch deep baking dish
3. Put flour , 1 / 2 cup cocoa powder , granulated sugar , baking powder and salt into a bowl , and whisk to mix well
4. Mix milk , oil , liqueur and vanilla
5. Stir into flour mixture until blended
6. Spread in ungreased baking dish
7. Mix brown sugar and the 3 t cocoa
8. Sprinkle evenly over batter
9. Slowly pour boiling water evenly over surface of batter
10. Carefully place dish in oven
11. Bake 30 minutes , or until top is just set and a wooden pick inserted halfway into center comes out with moist crumbs
12. Cool in dish on wire rack 10 minutes
13. Dust with confectioners' sugar
14. Fore a decorative design , place a paper doily on cake before dusting with sugar
15. Carefully lift doily straight up
16. Serve pudding cake warm with whipped topping

title: snow peas and chicken
steps:
1. Cut chicken into 1 inch cubes
2. Combine 2 tablespoons of the sherry and 3 teaspoons of the cornstarch
3. Mix well
4. Stir in the chicken
5. Cover , refrigerate for 1 hour
6. Combine soy sauce , remaining sherry , remaining cornstarch and sugar in a small bowl
7. Set aside
8. In a heavy cast iron frypan or wok , heat oil over high heat until very hot but not smoking
9. Add chicken and stir-fry for 2 minutes
10. Remove chicken , set aside
11. Add garlic and ginger to pan , stir well , add onions , snow peas and water
12. Stir-fry for 2 minutes
13. Return chicken and soy sauce mixture to pan and stir quickly over high heat until hot
14. Serve over rice or noodles

title: minty cheese filled pasta  krntner kasnudel
steps:
1. Knead a soft pasta dough out of the first 4 ingredients , form a ball , wrap in plastic and place in fridge for about 30min
2. Cook potatoes for about 25-30 minutes peel and mash rather thoroughly
3. Mix together curd , potatoes and mint
4. Salt and pepper to taste
5. Form ~1inch diameter balls out of the filling
6. Use a rolling pin or a pasta machine to flatten dough
7. Cut out medium sized pasta circles ,
8. Place your filling in the center of your pasta circles / rounds and fold / press them together into semicircles
9. Seal edges using your hands or a fork
10. )
11. Put noodels into salted , boiling water and let simmer on low heat for about 15 minutes
12. Either serve kasnudel with melted , browned butter , sprinkled with minced french parsley , or fry them in a pan until lightly brown and crispy

title: yuma jack s jalapeno poppers
steps:
1. Fry the sausage meat and drain really well
2. Cut jalapenos in half , scooping out and discarding the seeds and veins
3. Mix together sausage with garlic , cream cheese and parmesan cheese
4. Spoon into jalapeno halves
5. Bake in 350 oven for 20 minutes
6. Makes 20 poppers
7. Can be made a day in advance and refrigerated til needed

title: hot cheddar dip
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Bake in glass pan at 350 degrees for 20 mins
3. Serve with assorted chips or crackers

title: spicy spinach and potatoes
steps:
1. Dice potatoes and place in pot of boiling water , and cook over high heat until just tender
2. Drain and cool
3. Shred spinach leaves and rinse thoroughly
4. In a wok or heavy based frying pan on medium high heat , add onion and garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute
5. And ginger , coriander , lemongrass and spinach and stir-fry for 1 minute
6. Add potato and capsicum , stir-fry for further 2 minutes
7. Reduce heat to low , add chilli sauce , soy sauce and lemon juice , stir-fry for ther 1 minute

title: peachy pancakes
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda , salt , and nutmeg
2. Set aside
3. In a medium-size bowl , with wire whisk , beat together egg , yogurt , water , 1 tbls
4. Oil , and the vanilla until blended
5. Add yogurt mixture to flour mixture , gently stirring just until dry ingredients are moistened
6. Lightly oil a griddle or 6-inch skillet and heat over medium heat
7. Spread a 1 / 4 cup of batter on griddle to make a 4-inch pancake
8. Cook until bubbles form and begin to break on top surface
9. Flip pancake and cook until bottom is golden brown
10. Remove pancake and keep warm on a baking sheet in 200f
11. Oven
12. Repeat with remaining batter , adding more oil to skillet as necessary
13. Serve pancakes warm with maple syrup , if desired
14. Enjoy !

title: one pot salsa beef skillet
steps:
1. Brown meat in skillet
2. Drain
3. Return to skillet
4. Stir in water , salsa and macaroni
5. Bring to boil
6. Reduce heat to low
7. Cover
8. Simmer 10 minute or until macaroni is tender , stirring twice
9. Add corn and cheese sauce
10. Cook 2 minute or until heated through and blended
11. Ladle into bowls
12. Sprinkle with shredded cheese and green onion

title: japanese style crispy fried chicken tidbits
steps:
1. In a bowl combine eggs with cayenne or black pepper , salt sugar , garlic powder , ginger powder , sesame oil , soy sauce and bouillon powder
2. Mix well to combine
3. Add in chicken cubes and toss to coat with the mixture
4. Cover and refrigerate for 35 minutes
5. Remove from refrigerator and add in the potato starch and rice flour
6. Mix well to combine
7. In a large skillet , wok or deep fryer heat oil to 365 degrees
8. Place chicken in hot oil and fry until golden brown
9. Drain on paper towels

title: crema di mascarpone  chilled cheese dessert
steps:
1. Blend the cheese in an electric blender till very smooth
2. Beat in the sugar , egg yolks , cream & cognac till the mixture is very smooth & thick
3. Refrigerate till well-chilled
4. To serve: spoon chilled crema into 4-6 sml dessert bowls , ramekins or goblets
5. Fresh raspberries or strawberries were suggested as the ideal garnish , but i think a wide variety of imaginative choices would also work well

title: fresh berry syrup
steps:
1. Bring berries , sugar , and water to a boil in a 2- to 3-quart heavy saucepan over moderately high heat , stirring until sugar is dissolved
2. Reduce heat and simmer , uncovered , stirring occasionally , until fruit is soft , about 30 minutes
3. Pour mixture through a fine-mesh sieve into a bowl , pressing gently on and then discarding solids
4. Serve syrup at room temperature

title: fooled you maple spread
steps:
1. In a saucpan , stir together brown sugar , flour , milk and butter
2. Turn heat to low and cook , stirring often , until mixture is lump-free and smooth
3. Remove from heat and stir in maple extract
4. Place in a bowl or jar and refrigerate until serving
5. After it is chilled you can bring it to room temperature if you wish , to make spreading easier

title: baked feta with sweet and hot peppers
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Heat oil in medium skillet over medium heat until hot
3. Add red bell pepper and salt
4. Cook 5-7 minutes or until peppers are tender but not mushy , stirring occasionally slice feta into 1 / 2" thick slices
5. Arrange in one layer in shallow 9" oval or round baking dish
6. Sprinkle with oregano
7. Top with red bell pepper and pepperoncini bake 12-14 minutes or until cheese is soft and oil bubbles
8. Serve warm with crusty bread

title: creamy hawaiian fruit salad
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except coconut
2. Refrigerate several hours or overnight
3. Sprinkle with coconut just before serving

title: avocado with groundnut dressing
steps:
1. Peel the avocados , remove the pit and cube the flesh
2. Place in a bowl with lemon juice
3. Grind the peanuts so you have small chunks
4. Sprinkle the nuts and spices over the avocado and toss gently
5. Garnish with chopped chives

title: grown up macaroni   cheese
steps:
1. Cook macaroni in boiling salted water according to package directions
2. Drain& add a little butter to prevent sticking
3. Cover& put aside
4. Melt butter in a large saucepan over low to medium heat
5. Add flour& cook gently for 4- 5 mins
6. Add milk , mix well& allow to simmer for a few mins
7. Add cream , mix well& cook over low heat , stirring constantly , until sauce starts to thicken
8. Add onion& bay leaf
9. Continue cooking for another 15- 20 mins , stirring constantly
10. Remove from heat , remove bay leaf , stir in mustard& 1 1 / 2 cups of the cheddar , season with salt& pepper and stir well
11. Combine with macaroni in an ovenproof casserole dish
12. Sprinkle the rest of the cheddar over top
13. Combine bread crumbs , parsley& paprika and sprinkle over the top
14. Bake in a preheated 350f oven for about 15- 20 minutes or until light golden brown on top

title: far east peanut dipping sauce
steps:
1. Mix the soy sauce and vinegar together and set aside
2. Put the peanut butter in a bowl and mix in the sesame oil , blending thoroughly
3. Then mix in the chili paste and cayenne pepper , blending well
4. Add the soy sauce blending well
5. Blend in the mayonnaise and serve at room temperature
6. Suggested dippers: beef satay , shrimp , crayfish , sesame crackers , scallions , cherry tomatoes , snow peas

title: pita bread sandwiches
steps:
1. Brown meat in 10 inch skillet until cooked
2. Add onion and cook for 10 minutes
3. Add taco seasoning with water and cook additional 10 minutes
4. Drain mixture
5. Cut pita bread in half and "open" pocket
6. Place ground meat mixture inside
7. Put whatever you want inside your taco and serve ranch dressing over the top

title: o j  muffins
steps:
1. In a large bowl whisk together the flour , baking soda , salt , sugar and the orange rind
2. Add in the orange juice , egg , and the oil
3. Stir so that the mixture is moistened by the wet ingredients but don't overmix it
4. The batter should still be lumpy
5. Turn the batter into 18 well oiled or lined muffin cups and bake at 400 degrees f for about 20 minutes
6. When muffins are nicely browned on top , remove them from the oven and allow to cool slightly
7. For icing: mix the confectioner's sugar , milk and orange juice together to get a nice light icing and then drizzle over the almost fully cooled muffins
8. Allow to set before serving

title: cilantro cream for fish tacos
steps:
1. Puree cilantro , creme franche , and lemon juice in blender until smooth
2. Season to taste with salt and pepper
3. Refridgerate at least 30 minutes to allow flavors to blend

title: lasagna pizza
steps:
1. Cook lasagna noodles until tender but firm
2. Drain
3. Butter cookie sheet
4. Arrange noodles
5. Put on the american cheese
6. Then cover with remaining noodles
7. Spread ragu to your liking
8. Then cheddar cheese , then pepper and onion
9. Add pepperoni
10. Bake at 350f degrees until pepper and onions are done to your liking

title: butterscotch cake   the best you ll ever make
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients
2. Pour into a greased and floured bunch pan
3. Bake 50-55 minutes at 350f

title: bacon potato cheddar tart
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix the minced onions and garlic together
3. Get a skillet or pie dish
4. Coat the cooking area of the skillet with cooking spray
5. Cut the parchment paper into a circle that covers the cooking area of the skillet , and place it in side the skillet
6. Start lining the center of the skillet with a layer of bacon in a fan pattern , with one end of the bacon at the center and the other end hangs over the end of the skill
7. Each slice should overlap about a 3rd to half of the width of a bacon slice
8. Take care to stagger the bacon at the center so you don't end up with a very thick layer of bacon in the center of the pan
9. Slice your potatoes in about 1 / 4 inch thick slices
10. After the skillet is completely covered with bacon , start adding potato slices in layers inside the skillet on top of the bacon , creating a layer of potato on top of the bacon
11. After completely adding a layer of potato that covers the bottom of the skillet , sprinkle some pepper , onions / garlic mixture , and a generous portion of cheddar on top of each layer
12. Repeat the previous 2 steps until the potato & cheese layers are stacked about 1 inch above the top of the skillet
13. Fold all of the bacon s
14. Place a small , metal skillet or pot cover on top of the tart to hold the bacon in place during baking
15. Bake at 350 degrees for 2 hours and 30 minutes

title: runza casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Brown the hamburger and onion in a skillet
3. Then drain
4. Put cabbage on top and cover to steam for a few minutes
5. Add the salt and pepper
6. To taste
7. Add soup
8. Mix well
9. Separate into pieces and spread 1 tube of the crescent rolls over the bottom of a 9x13x2" pan
10. Spread the hamburger / cabbage mixture on top of the crescent dough
11. Sprinkle the cheese on top of the meat mixture
12. Separate the 2nd tube of crescents , put the dough pieces on top of the cheese
13. Bake for 35 - 40 minutes , covering with foil the last 10 minutes to soften the crust

title: egyptian palace bread  dessert
steps:
1. Remove the crust from the bread
2. Soak the slices in honey for at least a half hour
3. Lightly grease a small deep baking dish
4. Using a spatula , pile the slices of bread evenly , one on top of another , in the baking dish
5. Bake in a 300 degrees oven for 45 minutes
6. Cool and chill in the refrigerator
7. Slice and top with heavy cream

title: super easy bolognese sauce
steps:
1. Brown the ground beef and sausage together on medium-high heat
2. Halfway through browning , add garlic and dried oregano
3. Continue to brown all the way through , do not drain fat
4. Sprinkle flour over meat and stir until flour dissolves and disappears
5. Add heavy cream and milk , simmer until it all evaporates
6. Repeat with wine
7. Add in all the tomatoes , the tomato paste , and broth
8. Simmer on low for close to 2 hours
9. Stir in brown sugar

title: spiced pumpkin bread
steps:
1. Prehat oven to 350 f
2. Grease bottoms of 2 loaf pans
3. Cream together butter and sugar in a large bowl
4. Add the eggs , pumpkin , and milk
5. Stir in the flour , baking soda , salt , baking powder , cinnamon , nutmeg , and cloves
6. Do not overmix
7. Fold in the raisins and nuts
8. Divide batter evenly between the two loaf pans
9. Bake until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean , about 65-70 minutes
10. Cool slightly , then loosen sides of pan and invert loaf to remove
11. Allow to cool on a wire rack
12. While bread is cooling , prepare glaze
13. Mix confectioners sugar together with the cinnamon and nutmeg and just enough milk to form a drizzling consistency
14. Drizzle glaze over loaves
15. Slice loaves and serve when cool
16. To store unused portions , wrap and refrigerate for no longer than 10 days

title: sweet potato pie with three nut topping
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Filling: whisk together sugar , flour , baking powder , salt , cinnamon , nutmeg and allspice
3. Skin potatoes , place in bowl and mash well
4. Add butter and stir into potatoes with wooden spoon
5. Blend in dry ingredients and stir until smooth
6. Add lemon juice , vanillaand lemon extract
7. Stir to incorporate
8. Lightly beat egg in small bowl and stir in half and half
9. Stir egg mixture into potato mixture
10. Pour filling into unbaked 9" pie shell
11. Bake for 15 minutes at 425 , reduce temperature to 375 and bake for 40- 45 minutes longer until top is puffy and bottom crust is golden brown
12. Three nut topping: in medium sauce panover low heat , stir butter , sugar and honey until sugar dissolves
13. Increase heat and boil for 1 minute
14. Remove from heat
15. Mix in nuts coating completely
16. Spoon over hot pie
17. Bake for about 5 minutes or until topping begins to bubble
18. Remove from oven and cool completely

title: brazilian bloom
steps:
1. In a cocktail shaker , combine the lime wedges , sugar and hibiscus
2. Muddle with a wooden spoon
3. Fill halfway with cracked ice
4. Add the cachaca and shake for 15 seconds
5. Strain the mixture into a cordial glass
6. Enjoy !
7. )

title: chewy chocolate cookies  low fat
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f grease two cookies sheets
2. Beat egg whites until frothy
3. Sift sugar , cocoa and flour into the whites
4. Add water
5. Continue beating on high for a few minutes until the mixture thickens
6. Fold in walnuts and chocolate chips with a rubber spatula
7. Place generous spoonfuls on the mixture one inch apart on the cookie sheets
8. Bake 12-15 minutes , until firm on top but soft on the inside
9. It is best to bake these one sheet at a time
10. Cool on a wire rack

title: marinated veggie salad
steps:
1. Pour green beans , peas , corn & pimento in a colander to drain over a large bowl
2. Discard 1 1 / 2 cups of liquid
3. Put veggies in a large bowl and fold in onions , celery and green peppers
4. Mix together thoroughly the remaining ingredients and toss with veggies
5. Cover and let sit over night in refrigerator

title: lucille couch s rolls
steps:
1. Soften the yeast in the warm water and set aside
2. Combine the hot milk , sugar , salt , and oil and let cool down to room temperature
3. Add the eggs and the yeast and mix together well
4. Add 2 cups of flour and beat well
5. Add the remaining flour and knead in well until you get a moderately stiff dough
6. Turn this out on a floured surface and knead until satiny
7. Put in a deep bowl with a little oil on top
8. Cover the bowl and let dough rise for 1 1 / 4 hours
9. Return dough back to a lightly floured surface and roll out the dough until about 1 / 4 inch thick
10. Cut out the rolls with a round biscuit cutter , fold them over to form roll shape , cover , and let rise for a further 1 / 2 hour
11. Preheat your oven to 375 f and bake the rolls for 12-15 minutes or until done

title: honey mustard grilled pork roast
steps:
1. In a resealable plastic bag , combine thoroughly the dijon-style mustard , honey , soy sauce , brown sugar , water and worcestershire sauce until well blended
2. Place the boneless pork roast in the resealable plastic bag
3. Mix together
4. Seal the bag and refrigerate for about 2 hours or as long as overnight
5. Preheat grill to medium heat
6. Remove the pork roast from the bag
7. Discard any remaining marinade
8. Place the pork roast on the grill grids over indirect heat
9. Close grill hood and grill for about 1 hour and 15 minutes until internal temperature reads 160f
10. Remove pork roast from the grill , let rest for 10 minutes before slicing to serve

title: lacy oatmeal crisps
steps:
1. Melt butter , brown sugar and corn syrup together in medium saucepan
2. Bring to a boil and remove from heat
3. Add oats and flour , stirring until smooth
4. Line baking shets with parchment paper or greased aluminum foil
5. Drop mixture by 1 tsp , leaving room for spreading
6. Bake at 375 for 5- 8 minutes , or until golden
7. Cool until set before removing from tray
8. Store in covered container in cool place for several weeks

title: chinese spaghetti
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti
2. Drain
3. Return to saucepan
4. Keep warm
5. Meanwhile , in 12"
6. Skillet over medium heat , cook mushrooms , onions and carrot in hot oil until vegetable are tender crisp , stirring quickly and frequently
7. Spoon vegetable mixture into spaghetti in saucepan
8. Add soy sauce and crushed red pepper
9. Toss gently to mix all ingredients well
10. Can be served warm or chilled

title: tenderloin asada with sage and savory apples
steps:
1. About 2-4 hours before you plan to grill the pork , place the tenderloins in a plastic bag
2. Add the cider , vinegar , brandy , oil and mustard and refrigerate
3. Combine the sage , chile , salt , pepper , and garlic powder in a small bowl
4. About 30 minutes before grilling , take the pork from the refrigerator and drain the marinade into a small saucepan
5. Coat the pork with a thin layer of the mixed spices , reserving about 1 t of the mixture , and let the pork sit , covered at room temperature
6. Over high heat , boil the marinade vigorously for several minutes until reduced by half
7. Keep the liquid warm
8. On an outdoor grill , fire up enough charcoal to form a single layer of coals beneath the meat
9. At the same time , put a few handfuls of mesquite chips or beans in water to soak
10. When the charcoal is covered with gray ash , scatter the wood chips or beans over it and place the meat directly over the fire
11. Grill the tenderloins , partially covered with the grill's lid , to trap some of the mesquite smoke
12. Turn the tenderloins once or twice to ensure even cooking
13. Grill till the tenderloins' internal temperature is 155-160 , about 12-14 minutes
14. Let the meat sit at room temp , tented with foil
15. Pell and slice the apples thin
16. Warm the butter in a skillet over medium heat and saute the apples till softened
17. Add the reduced marinade and the remaining spice mixture and simmer till the apples are tender
18. Adjust seasonings if necessary
19. Slice the pork into medallions and arrange it on a platter , surrounded by the apples and garnished with sage sprigs , if desired

title: easy chocolate cherry cake
steps:
1. Mix cake mix with cocoa , beaten eggs , almond flavouring , melted chips and oil
2. Use a two cup glass measure to melt the chips and oil
3. Add cherry brandy if using
4. Fold in cherry pie filling
5. Turn into greased bundt pan
6. Bake 350 degrees for 55 minutes
7. The residue heat will finish the cooking
8. Cool , turn out onto a plate and glaze
9. Glaze:
10. 3 / 4 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips
11. 2 tbsp butter
12. 2 tbsp table cream
13. Microwave on medium the chips , butter , and milk until melted
14. Stir in 1 / 2 cup icing sugar cool and pour over cake
15. I use the same two cup pyrex measuring cup to melt the chips & oil to put into the cake , and save it unwashed to make the glaze
16. No point in wasting a bit of chocolate ! one time i made it , i used a bit more cherries and it was the best one yet ! after i glazed it and let it cool , i dribbled some of the cherry goo over the glaze to keep it moist- went over huge in my home !
17. This cake is best made the day before to allow the flavours to get happy !

title: roasted fries
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 500f
2. Cut potatoes lengthwise into 1 / 3 inch thick slices , then cut into 1 / 3 inch wide sticks
3. Immediately toss with oil , salt and pepper in a large bowl
4. Spread sticks in 1 layer in a large shallow baking pan
5. Bake in lower third of oven 15 minutes
6. Loosen potatoes from bottom of pan with metal spatula , then turn over and spread ot again
7. Bake until crisp and golden brown on edges , about 10 minutes more

title: hearty cabbage soup
steps:
1. Melt butter in saucepan over medium heat
2. Add onion , celery , cabbage , salt , and pepper
3. Partly cover and cook for 10 minutes over a low heat
4. Add potatoes , chicken stock , and dill
5. Bring to a boil while stirring periodically
6. Boil , partly covered , for 20 minutes
7. Mix the flour with the sour cream in a bowl
8. Add 1 / 2 cup of the hot soup stock to bowl , mix well , and pour into soup
9. Mix well and serve

title: swiss  french  salad dressing
steps:
1. Blend together all the ingredients except the water in a blender or food processor until smooth
2. Add enough water to give a lightly coating consistency
3. Put in a screwtop jar and place in the refrigerator until needed
4. Use within 3-4 days

title: buckwheat pancakes   boghvede pandekager
steps:
1. Beat the eggs well and mix with the butter
2. Sift the flours with the other dry ingredients
3. Stir into egg and butter mixture
4. Add milk
5. Stir until smooth
6. Cook on a hot , greased griddle
7. When bubbles start to form on the top , flip the cakes over and cook until done

title: spinach in spicy yoghurt  palak raita
steps:
1. Clean and wash spinach
2. Discard the stems
3. Steam over low heat until tender
4. Drain well and chop finely
5. Heat oil in a small pan
6. Fry mustard seeds until they start spluttering
7. Then add cumin , fenugreek and corriander seeds
8. Stir well
9. Fry until fenugreek seeds turn golden brown
10. Remove from heat
11. Add red chilli powder and salt
12. Cool slightly
13. Stir in yoghurt
14. Mix well
15. Add spinach
16. Mix thoroughly
17. Chill
18. Sprinkle little corriander powder on top
19. Serve chilled

title: easy and quick salmon patties
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Form into "patties" that resemble hamburger patties
3. Brown in oil on both sides for approximately 10-15 minutes or until golden brown
4. I serve mine and most like ketchup poured over the top , just depends on your taste buds !

title: spinach cheese phyllo appetizers
steps:
1. Stir together cream cheese , spinach red pepper and pepper until well blended
2. Lay one phyllo sheet on a flat surface and brush with margarine
3. Cut phyllo lengthwise into 4 long strips
4. Spoon approximately 1 tablespoon filling about an inch from the end of the phyllo strip
5. Fold phyllo over filling at an angle and continue folding like folding a flag until you have a triangle
6. Repeat with remaining phyllo and filling
7. Place triangles on greased cookie sheet , brushtops with margarine and bake at 375 , 12 -15 minutes until golden

title: peach bread or apple bread  quick bread
steps:
1. Mix together oil and sugar
2. Add eggs and vanilla and beat well
3. In a separate bowl combine flour , soda , salt and cinnamon
4. Add to oil mixture alternately with orange juice
5. Fold in nuts and chopped peaches / apples
6. Bake in a greased 9x5 loaf pan for 50 minutes or until done

title: indian style cauliflower
steps:
1. In a 10-inch nonstick skillet , combine the onion , stock , chutney , mustard , basil , ginger , cumin , salt , cinnamon , and curry powder
2. Bring to a simmer and cook , covered for 6 minutes
3. Add the cauliflower and cook , covered , for 5 minutes over moderately low heat
4. Add the peas , cover and cook 4-5 minutes more or until the cauliflower is crisp-tender
5. Stir in the cornstarch mixture , vinegar , and red pepper sauce
6. Cook for 1 minute or until the sauce has thickened
7. Serve hot or at room temperature
8. For vegetarian use the vegetable stock

title: czech pastry cottage cheese kolacky
steps:
1. Let butter soften in a bowl
2. When very soft mix butter and cottage cheese together
3. Add salt and sugar
4. Add flour last and mix by hand
5. To get dough to the consistency of pie dough
6. Put the dough in wax paper in the refrigerator overnight
7. If you want to bake it today leave the dough in the refrigerator at least for 3 hours
8. Then take it out and divide it into 3 parts
9. Take 1 part of the dough and put it on a floured table
10. Flatten the dough to a 1 / 8 of inch thick
11. Then take a small juice glass and cut round circle in the dough
12. Take your thumb and make a dent in the middle of the dough
13. Fill it with apricot or any jam
14. Bake at 350 for about 15-20 minutes or until lightly brown

title: texas cookies
steps:
1. Mix ingredients and drop onto greased cookie sheet
2. Bake at 350 for 12-15 minute cool

title: fresh kielbasa with sauerkraut
steps:
1. Brown kielbasa and pork , set aside
2. Drain all but 2 tablespoons fat
3. Add apple juice , onions , carrots , apple , parsley , bay leaves , garlic salt , caraway seeds , and chicken broth
4. Simmer cover for 20 minutes
5. Stir in saurerkrat , wine , sugar , pork ribs and kielbasa that you cut into 1 / 4 slices
6. Bake , covered , 1 hour at 350 degrees
7. Serve with mashed potatoes and good rye bread& butter

title: buttermilk southern fried chicken
steps:
1. Wash chicken pieces thoroughly and pat dry
2. Place chicken in a long , shallow glass baking dish
3. Pour the buttermilk over the chicken , cover and refrigerate for a least 4 hours , turning once or twice
4. In a clean plastic or brown paper bag , combine the flour , salt , pepper , paprika , and if desired the garlic and onion powders
5. Drain the chicken and place two or three pieces of chicken in the bag and shake well to coat evenly
6. Repeat until all chicken has been coated with seasoned flour mixture
7. In a large , heavy skillet , heat about one-half of oil over medium-high heat until hot , but not smoking
8. Add chicken and brown on all sides , about three minutes per side
9. Place browned chicken on a warm platter until all pieces are cooked
10. When all the chicken pieces are browned , crowd them into the skillet , turn heat to medium-low , cover and cook , turning occasionally , until tender , about 35-40 minutes
11. Remove cover , turn heat to medium-high and cook six to eight minutes more or until skin is crispy
12. Serve at once
13. Serves 4

title: simple greens and fruit salad with gorgonzola cheese
steps:
1. Put the salad greens and the dressing in a ziploc bag
2. Toss to mix well
3. Pour the tossed greens into the serving bowl
4. Top with the cheese , fruit and nuts and serve

title: cranberry cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f lightly grease a 9x13 pan or a 10" springform pan
2. Beat eggs and sugar together for 5-7 minutes
3. The eggs will increase in volume quite a bit , streaming into ribbons when you lift the beaters
4. They will also turn pale yellow
5. Add butter and flavorings and beat for 2 minutes
6. Stir in flour and fold in cranberries
7. Pour into greased pan
8. Optional pecan topping:
9. Heat the butter in a pan over medium-high heat
10. Add the sugar and stir
11. Add the toasted pecans and cook for several minutes , stirring , until the butter and sugar mixture is shiny and smooth and the nuts smell toasted
12. Spread over the cake batter and bake as above
13. Bake 45-50 minutes for a 9x13 , or a little over an hour for the springform
14. You made need to tent the cake with foil in the last 15 minutes or so to keep the top from browning
15. Cool completely before serving

title: advieh
steps:
1. Whizz the rose petals in the spice grinder until they become a fine powder
2. Mix all ingredients together
3. Store in a sealed , airtight jar
4. Before use , shake the jar to blend contents
5. Enjoy this unique blend in vegetable stews and pulse dishes

title: light pineapple pudding
steps:
1. If you buy your pineapple in metric-sized tins , you want the 540ml tin of crushed pineapple
2. In a mixing bowl , whisk together pudding mix and undrained pineapple
3. Whisk in yogurt
4. Spoon into serving dishes and chill until serving time
5. These look particularly attractive when garnished with a few fresh berries-- try blueberries or raspberries
6. If taking to a potluck , don't spoon it into individual dishes but rather leave it in the bowl

title: lemon muffins w yogurt
steps:
1. Set oven to 375 f
2. Use no-stick spray for muffin tin
3. Whisk eggs , yogurt , zest , juices , and melted butter together
4. Combine dry ingredients and add to yogurt mixture
5. Fold together until all the dry ingredients are incorporated
6. Fill muffin cups equally and bake for 22-25 minutes

title: mediterranean spiced rice with apricots
steps:
1. In a saucepan , over medium heat , warm the olive oil , add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds
2. Stir in the chicken stock and water
3. Bring to a boil
4. Add the rice
5. Reduce heat , cover and cook for 15 minutes or until rice is almost tender
6. Stir in seasonings , apricots and green onion
7. Cook an additional 5 minutes to blend flavors

title: egg noodles
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine flour and salt
2. Make a well
3. Mix together the wet ingredients and pour into well
4. Mix well
5. Turn out onto a floured board and knead until firm , shiny and elastic
6. At this point cover and chill for 1 hour , up to 24 hours
7. When ready to use follow instructions for manual pasta machine or cut into manageable pieces and roll out to desired thickness , cut into desired shape

title: chocolate cinnamon nut bars
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Combine flour , 3 / 4 cup of butter , sugar , baking powder and cinnamon in a large mixing bowl
3. Beat at medium speed until crumbly
4. Stir in nuts by hand
5. Press dough onto bottom of an ungreased 13x9-inch baking pan
6. Bake for 15 to 18 minutes until firm
7. Meanwhile , melt chips and 1 / 4 cup butter in a medium saucepan on low heat
8. Stir until smooth
9. Remove from heat
10. Add brown sugar , eggs , and vanilla
11. Stir until well mixed
12. Pour mixture over hot baked crust
13. Continue baking for 20 to 25 minutes or until the center is set
14. Cool completely and sprinkle with powdered sugar

title: tangy raw smoothie treat   pomegranate   berry
steps:
1. Place the pop , frozen strawberries , blackberries , honey and ice cubes in blender
2. Cover and combine until smooth and thick
3. If you prefer a thicker consistency , you may add additional ice cubes , one at a time , until desired thickness is achieved
4. Pour the smoothie into chilled glasses and garnish with the lime slices
5. You will want to squeeze the lime into your glass and stir with your straws
6. Then grab a seat , close your eyes and enjoy , enjoy , enjoy , let the cares of the day slip away !

title: meringue
steps:
1. Whip the whites and cream of tartar until soft peaks form gradually adding 1 tablespoon of sugar at a time
2. Beat a couple of minutes

title: asparagus and eggs  a special breakfast treat
steps:
1. Pan fry the prosciutto in butter and keep warm
2. Poach the asparagus in water
3. Fry the eggs sunny-side up in 2 tbsp butter and season with salt and pepper
4. Drain the asparagus and divide between two plates , place on bottom of plate
5. Place 1 / 4 of the prosciutto overtop of the asparagus , top with two eggs , then top with the remaining prosciutto and parmesan cheese
6. Serve with your favorite bread and fruit for a perfect breakfast treat

title: zesty roasted chicken
steps:
1. Combine first 6 ingredients
2. Lift up the skin and slide your fingers between the breasts and skin all the way up to the legs
3. Pat the chili mixture on the breasts under the skin
4. Rub remaining mixture on the outer skin
5. Tuck the wings under , tie the legs together and place bird in a bed of kosher salt in a roasting pan
6. Roast 15 minutes at 500 degree f
7. Then lower the heat to 450 degees f
8. And cook for another 30 minutes , or until the juices run clear when pierced
9. Let sit 10 minutes to rest

title: the great green vegetable medley
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Steam or boil broccoli , beans and peas together until tender , drain and set aside
3. Cook1 / 2 cup onions in 2 tbsp of butter till tender
4. Add cornstarch , salt , pepper and sour cream
5. Mix well
6. Stir in green vegetables
7. Put in a greased 2 qt casserole dish
8. Mixture can be refrigerated overnight at this point and finished before cooking
9. Top with grated cheese
10. Combine remaining 2 tbsp of butter and cracker crumbs
11. Sprinkle over cheese
12. Bake 30 minutes

title: caribbean honey spiced chicken with mango
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine honey , lemon juice and lemon peel
2. Whisk until well-blended
3. Remove 1 / 4 cup of mixture to food processor container
4. Set aside
5. Add mango to honey lemon mixture in bowl
6. Toss to coat
7. Store in refrigerator
8. Add onion , jalapenos , paprika , oil , garlic salt , cinnamon , pepper and allspice to honey-lemon mixture in food processor container
9. Process until very finely chopped , scrape down sides when necessary
10. Spread mixture evenly over both sides of chicken breasts
11. Spread oil in 13 x 9-inch baking pan
12. Arrange chicken breasts in pan
13. Bake at 375 degrees f for 25 to 30 minutes or until cooked through
14. Remove chicken to serving platter
15. Top with reserved mango

title: arancini   italian rice balls
steps:
1. In a bowl lightly beat 2 eggs
2. Stir in cooked rice , melted butter , parmesan cheese , garlic parsley , seasoned salt and pepper
3. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes
4. Roll into 1-1 / 2-inch balls
5. Press a cheese cube into each ball then reshape rice balls
6. Place the flour into a small bowl
7. Whisk 2 eggs in a small bowl
8. Place the dry breadcrumbs in a small bowl
9. Dip each ball into flour , then into the egg and then lastly into the breadcrumbs
10. Heat oil to 375 degrees , then fry rice balls until golden brown
11. Drain on paper towels

title: artichoke  spinach   feta stuffed shells
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Combine first 4 ingredients in a medium saucepan
3. Place over medium heat
4. Cook 12 minutes or until slightly thick , stirring occasionally
5. Remove from heat , set aside
6. Combine 1 / 2 c provolone and the next 6 ingredients in a medium bowl
7. Spoon or pipe about 1 1 / 2 tablespoons cheese mixture in each pasta shell
8. Place stuffed shells in a 13 x 9 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray
9. Spoon tomato mixture over shells
10. Sprinkle with remaining provolone
11. Bake at 375 for 25-30 minutes or until thoroughly heated and cheese melts

title: they will beg for it beer cheese soup
steps:
1. Combine first 10 ingredients and simmer on low heat for 30-45 mins , until very tender
2. Mash with potato masher until desired consistency
3. Combine milk and flour and slowly add to mixture
4. Add cheese and the rest of the spices
5. Simmer over low heat until cheese melts
6. Stir in beer and allow to heat through

title: honey rosemary and lemon baked chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Line a large baking pan with foil and place a roasting rack on top
3. Place chicken pieces , skin side up , on top of rack
4. Squeeze lemon juice over chicken
5. Rub with butter , then drizzle honey over the top of each piece
6. Season with rosemary , garlic powder , salt and pepper
7. Bake the chicken for 15 minutes , then reduce heat to 350f and bake for 25 more minutes

title: tofu  kale  and raisins
steps:
1. Drain [press] and chop the tofu into 1 inch cubes
2. You can also marinate it overnight in your juice or favorite dressing
3. If you choose to use silken use extra firm and do not press but do drain
4. Saute in a large frying pan over med heat for 8 minutes
5. Serve warm

title: bengali butternut squash and chickpeas garbanzos
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large non-stick pan over a medium heat
2. Add bay leaf , panch phoran and chillies and fry for 1-2 minutes , stirring well to combine
3. Add the onion , stir to coat in the spices , and fry for 4 minutes , or until softened and golden-brown
4. Add the ground turmeric , cumin and coriander , the salt , sugar and ginger and stir well
5. Add a 1 / 2 of water , stir and cook for a further 1-2 minutes
6. Add the butternut squash pieces and 1 / 2 - 1 cup boiling water
7. Bring the mixture to the boil , then reduce the heat to a simmer , cover the pan with a lid and simmer for 10-15 minutes , or until the butternut squash is tender
8. Add the chickpeas , ground garam masala and fennel seeds and another splash of water if necessary to keep the mixture loose
9. Add more salt and sugar , if you like , to taste
10. Stir well and continue to cook for 1-2 minutes , or until warmed through
11. Serve immediately

title: quick creamy potato soup
steps:
1. Melt butter in medium saucepan over medium heat
2. Add onion

4. Stir in water , evaporated milk , potato flakess , seasoned salt and dill weed

title: spaghetti with lemon  chickpeas and bacon
steps:
1. Set spaghetti to cook in heavily salted boiling water
2. While spaghetti is cooking , saut bacon in medium pan over medium heat until crisp
3. Remove to a paper towel to drain , leaving about 1 tablespoon of fat in pan
4. Add onion to the pan with the bacon fat and cook until soft , about 3 minutes
5. Add garlic , chickpeas , lemon slices and olive oil , reduce heat to low and cook while the spaghetti boils
6. When spaghetti is just barely al dente , drain it , reserving about 1 / 4 cup of the cooking water
7. To the garlic-chickpeas mixture add the cooked spaghetti , reserved cooking water , torn sage leaves and pine nuts and toss to coat
8. Pass grated parmesan cheese , lemon zest and red pepper flakes at the table , plus a drizzle of extra-virgin olive oil for garnish

title: matzoh scallion pancakes
steps:
1. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a skillet , add scallions and cook until softened , 2-3 minutes , remove and cool
2. In a big bowl mix together eggs , water , matzoh meal , salt& pepper
3. Add scallions
4. Heat 1 / 2 c oil is large skillet
5. Using a 1 / 4 c size measuring cup add about 3 tbsp of batter per pancake to skillet , cook first side about 2 minutes , flip and cook 2 minutes more , remove to paper towels
6. Repeat adding more oil to skillet as necessary

title: honey mustard dressing or dipping sauce
steps:

title: sweet red pepper chicken
steps:
1. Puree bell pepper in blender or food processor and set aside
2. Pound chicken flat and season both sides with salt and pepper
3. Heat large skillet and cook chicken in hot oil until both sides are cooked through
4. Remove chicken from pan and keep warm
5. Add onions and garlic to skillet

7. Add pureed bell peppers , paprika , salt , and cayenne pepper
8. Bring to a boil and serve over chicken

title: diabetic date squares
steps:
1. Oven: 375 f
2. Filling: mix dates , splenda granular and hot water and cook over medium heat until smooth and consistent
3. Bottom and top mixture: mix all dry ingredients
4. Cut in softened margarine
5. Spread half of mixture onto well greased 8 x 12 pan and press down evenly
6. Add filling and spread evenly

8. Bake 375 f for 25- 30 minutes

title: anti martha stewart meatloaf
steps:
1. Begin preheating oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine first 9 ingredients in bowl and mix thoroughly
3. Mix in crushed crackers until well-blended
4. Pat mixture into ungreased loaf pan
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 60-90 minutes
6. At lower altitudes , it won't take as long

title: quick  n easy gumbo
steps:
1. Pour a glass of nice red wine and have a drink
2. Put some italian opera on the stereo and turn volume up
3. Start a big pot of rice , i prefer white rice to serve this gumbo over
4. Rice is on the top shelf to the right
5. Cut meat into nice bite-sized slices , keeping fingers clear of blade
6. Heat oil over medium heat in a big pot and slowly saute meat with garlic and onions
7. Try not to eat too much of the meat while you cook or allow family members to
8. Precooked meats like the pork will speed process
9. Uncooked meats like chicken or shrimp can be quickly boiled in chicken broth and tossed in later
10. Never under cook chicken
11. Saute until lightly browned
12. Add broth to the pot and bring to a boil
13. Lower heat to medium and then add all the other ingredients one at a time starting with firmer vegetables first and soft last
14. Toss in spices last
15. Cook over medium heat until all ingredients are blended and cooked to your liking
16. Not over cooked or too soft is how i like it
17. Maybe fifteen minutes tops
18. The longer you cook the more the flavors will blend , but i prefer separate identifiable flavors so i cook less
19. Now taste your results being careful not to burn your tongue no matter how hungry you are
20. You're going to need that tongue later
21. Add ingredients according to your liking
22. I like to toss in some of the wine i'm drinking and i always add more garlic and salt and pepper to taste
23. Don't make it too spicy or your wife will not enjoy it
24. Serve over rice in big bowls
25. Put salt and pepper and tabasco on the table for others to adjust flavors to their liking
26. You can now add more tabasco to your own bowl and give your wife a wink
27. Turn off the tv and try talking to each other for a change
28. Finish the bottle of wine and go for a walk around the neighborhood after dinner to aid digestion
29. Enjoy !

title: zesty potatoes with sour cream   chives
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except chives and sour cream into medium or large zip 'n steam bag
2. Shake to mix ingredients and place bag in microwave
3. Cook on full power for 7 minute or until tender
4. Allow bag to sit in microwave for 1 minute before handeling
5. Gently shake to distrubute seasonings
6. Carefully open bag and remove contents
7. Sprinkle with 1 tbs chopped chives
8. Add salt and pepper to taste
9. Serve with sour cream if desired

title: jiffy  roasted corn and jalapeno cornbread
steps:
1. Melt butter in a saut pan
2. Add the corn , onion and red pepper and saut on medium heat until some of the corn kernels start to turn golden brown
3. Whisk egg , corn liquid , and cream together
4. Stir into corn muffin mix with a fork
5. Stir in diced jalapenos and cheddar cheese
6. Quickly stir in hot sauted corn and onion mixture , just mixing in slightly
7. Pour into 8 x 8 buttered baking dish
8. Bake at 350 for 15 minutes
9. Remove cornbread , turn off oven , drizzle cornbread with honey and put back in hot oven for 5 minutes
10. Remove from oven and let stand for 10 minutes before serving

title: lupita s chiles rellenos
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil
2. Add the carrot and cook five minutes
3. Next , add the potato and cook five minutes more
4. Then add the zucchini and cook two minutes more
5. Remove the vegetables and plunge immediately into an ice water bath and let sit five minutes
6. Drain and dry well , then finely dice and place in a medium bowl
7. Mix in the cotija cheese then the oaxacan cheese , and set it aside
8. Toast the chilies by broiling two to three minutes on each side
9. Remove , cool a minute or two , then wrap in plastic wrap and let it sit five minutes
10. Remove the wrap and peel chilies
11. Make an incision in the chilies
12. Remove seeds , and stuff with vegetable cheese mixture
13. Heat 1 cup cooking oil in a pan over medium high heat
14. While the pan heats , beat the egg whites until fluffy
15. Gently beat in yolk , just a few strokes
16. Dredge chilies thoroughly in egg mixture
17. Fry chilies in oil until one side is golden , about 1 minute
18. Repeat with the other side
19. Serve with salsa
20. Enjoy !

title: coconut curried butternut squash soup
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f and place a rack in the middle of the oven
2. Place the butternut squash halves cut-side up on a baking sheet lined with foil
3. Rub 1 teaspoon of the oil on the squash
4. Sprinkle the squash with the salt if using and the black pepper
5. Roast the squash until fork tender , 50 to 55 minutes
6. Cool the squash for 10 minutes
7. Use a spoon to scoop out the flesh and set aside
8. Heat the remaining 1 teaspoon oil in a large saucepan set over medium heat
9. Add the carrots , celery , curry powder , garlic and onions
10. Cook , stirring occasionally , until the onions are translucent and the carrots are fork tender , about 5 minutes
11. Add the squash , broth and coconut milk to the saucepan
12. Bring to a boil , reduce the heat and simmer 5 to 7 minutes
13. Working in batches , puree the soup in a blender or food processor until smooth and silky
14. Serve warm and garnish with a little chopped parsley

title: raspberry blueberry tea bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease a 9-inch square , metal baking pan
3. Sift flour , baking powder and baking soda into a bowl
4. In a medium sized bowl , cream butter and sugar
5. Beat in eggs and orange rind
6. Beat in half of the flour mixture
7. Beat in all the milk , and then the remaining flour mixture
8. Fold in berries , and turn batter into prepared pan
9. Bake for 45 minutes , or until well browned
10. Remove from oven and cool on wire rack
11. When cooled , remove from pan
12. Serve warm or cold

title: tabouli salad
steps:
1. Soak bulghur in water for 2 hours
2. Add the minced garlic , chopped onion , chopped parsley , chopped mint leaves and mix well
3. Add the italian dressing [or make your own dressing of 1 part vinegar to 3-4 parts olive oil or safflower oil]
4. Gently fold in the chopped tomatoes
5. Refrigerate to chill [you can put this in the freezer for 30 minutes if you want to chill it fast ! ]

title: sooji ka upma  semolina upma
steps:
1. Put oil in a wok and heat for a minute
2. Add mustard seeds , channa dal , urad dal and onion
3. Add semolina and saute until light brown
4. Add remaining ingredients , except coconut , and mix well
5. Cook on medium heat for 15 minutes

title: chicken  gyro  burgers
steps:

2. ) place ground chicken in a bowl , along with the garlic , onion , italian seasoning , 1 tbsp olive oil and lemon juice

title: cajun paella
steps:
1. In a large non stick pot heat oil till smoking an brown diced chicken , sauage , then tasso

3. Add shrimp , tomatos onion soup , italian seasoning an salt

9. Mix together meat& rice garnish with parsley are green onions

title: skillet penne and sausage supper
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a 12-inch nonstick skillet over medium heat until shimmering
2. Add the onion and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and cook until softened , about 5 minutes
3. Stir in the sausage and cook , breaking it up with a wooden spoon , until no longer pink , about 4 minutes
4. Stir in the garlic and cook until fragrant , about 15 seconds
5. Sprinkle the sun-dried tomatoes and penne evenly over the sausage
6. Pour the broth and milk over the pasta
7. Cover and bring to a simmer
8. Reduce heat to medium-low and continue to simmer , stirring occasionally , until the pasta is tender , about 10 minutes
9. Stir in the spinach a handful at a time and cook until wilted , about 2 minutes
10. Stir in the parmesan and season with salt and pepper to taste

title: chicken in yogurt and almond curry
steps:
1. Place chicken in a bowl and coat well with ginger and garlic
2. Heat the oil in a pot and roast at medium heat the chicken for about 5-10 minutes
3. Add chili , garam masala and coriander
4. Cook for 2 more minutes turning once
5. Add yogurt , cardamom , cloves and salt
6. Cook 5 minutes
7. Turn once the chicken and cook covered 20 more minutes
8. Add almond ground and cook additional 5 minutes or until through
9. If the sauce is not thick enough you can add more almonds ground or some roasted flour if you have
10. Place chicken with sauce on serving dishes and top with garam masala and almonds
11. Serve with rice or naans and vegetables of course !

title: my take carrot  zrodia  slata
steps:
1. Combine the parsley coriander , and garlic until finely minced
2. Add the lemon juice , oil , tomato paste , and seasonings
3. Combine just until all the ingredients are well mixed
4. This is to be your dressing
5. Place the mixture in a large - or ceramic bowl , top with the carrots , and toss until the carrots are coated
6. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for 4 to 6 hours or overnight
7. Adjust the seasonings
8. Salt , pepper and lemon and serve chilled or at room temperature
9. The cooking time is the chilling time at a minimum

title: gluten free crock pot breakfast grains
steps:
1. Combine ingredients in crock pot
2. Mix well
3. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours
4. Stir before serving
5. Add more water if needed

title: avocado cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine flour , baking soda , baking powder , salt , sugar , cinnamon , and allspice in a large bowl
3. Blend eggs , avocado , and milk smooth
4. Pour into dry ingredients
5. Stir until combined
6. Fold in lemon zest
7. Pour batter into a 9 x 13 baking pan or 2 round pans properly prepared
8. Bake for 40 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean
9. Cool to room temperature
10. Dust with powdered sugar or frost with a complimentary frosting

title: sunday black bean soup
steps:
1. To soak beans quickly , cover them with generous amount of water , cover pot , bring water to boil and boil 2 minutes
2. Remove cover and allow beans to sit in the liquid for one hour
3. Drain
4. In hot oil , saute carrots , onions , celery , and garlic until onions are golden
5. Add cumin and jalepenos
6. When beans are ready to cook , add ham hocks to beans along with sauted vegetables , and chicken broth and enough water to cover
7. Cook for 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours , or until tender
8. Drain the bean mixture and reserve cooking liquid
9. Puree beans and vegetables
10. Add sherry and lime juice and enough of the reserved liquid to make a thick soup
11. Can be served with chopped corriander or sour cream or lemon slice

title: walnut tart
steps:
1. For pastry: combine flour and sugar in large bowl
2. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse meal
3. Blend in yolks and vanilla
4. Gather dough into a ball
5. Turn out on lightly-floured surface
6. Using heel of hand , smear dough a little at a time across surface to blend butter and flour thoroughly
7. Flatten into disc
8. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour
9. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
10. Roll dough out between sheets of wax paper to thickness of 1 / 8 inch
11. Fit into 11 inch tart pan with removable bottom
12. Trim edges
13. Pierce shell all over with fork
14. Line with foil and fill with pie weights or dry beans
15. Bake until pastry is set , about 10 minutes
16. Reduce oven temperature to 350f
17. Remove beans and foil and bake until crust is golden-brown , about another 10 minutes
18. Reduce oven temperature to 300f
19. Blend all filling ingredients , except for walnut halves , and pour into crust
20. Bake until filling is set and looks dry , about 35 minutes
21. Cool and decorate with walnut halves

title: condensed tomato soup with roasted garlic and herbs
steps:
1. Mix soup , lemon juice , basil , garlic powder , and onion in skillet
2. Heat to a boil over med-high heat
3. Reduce heat to low , cover and cook for 5 minute

title: country bread abm
steps:

2. Add flour
3. Make a ridge and add yeast
4. Bake for basic bread

6. To make it even better , remove from bread machine after the dough cycle
7. Shape in one large on 2 smaller loaves
8. Let rise in a warm place for 1 hour
9. Bake in a 375 preheated oven 30 minutes

title: meatloaf burgers
steps:
1. Place onion and celery in a slow cooker
2. Combine beef , and 1 tsp salt and pepper
3. Shape into six patties
4. Place over onion mixture in slow cooker
5. Combine tomato juice , garlic , ketchup , bay leaf , italian seasoning and remaining salt
6. Pour over the patties
7. Cover
8. Cook in slow cooker 7-9 hours until meat is tender
9. Discard bay leaf
10. Separate patties with spatula if necessary and serve on buns

title: too easy oriental chicken
steps:
1. Marinate chicken thighs in the dark soy sauce for at least 1 hour
2. Heat oil in a large frying pan over medium heat
3. Add in garlic and ginger
4. Saute long enough to allow the ginger and garlic to release their aroma
5. Add in the chicken and saute until golden brown
6. Add in green onions , chicken broth , oyster sauce , rice wine , light soy sauce and splenda
7. Stir well
8. Once the sauce starts to boil , about 3-5 minutes , mix in the cornstarch to thicken the sauce
9. Serve and enjoy

title: taco bell peppers
steps:
1. Cut green peppers in half lengthwise and remove the seeds
2. Remove the wrappers from the tamales
3. Cut tamales into 1 / 4-inch slices
4. Mix together the tamales , chili , 3 / 4 cup cheese , onion , and ketchup
5. Stir to combine
6. Spoon tamale mixture into pepper shells
7. Place stuffed peppers in an electric skillet
8. Add enough water to 1 / 4 inch depth
9. Cover and simmer 25 minutes
10. Sprinkle the remaining cheese over the peppers
11. Top with crushed tortilla chips
12. Simmer , uncovered , 1-2 minutes longer until cheese melts

title: caramel turtle tart
steps:
1. Fit pie shell dough into 9 inch tart pan with a removable bottom
2. Preheat oven and bake tart shell according to package directions
3. Let cool completely
4. Combine sugar , water and corn syrup in a small , heavy saucepan
5. Bring to a boil over medium heat without stirring
6. Continue cooking without disturbing until mixture turns golden , reduce heat to low , carefully drizzle in 3 / 4 cup cream and then stir until smooth
7. Stir in pecans and vanilla extract into caramel mixture and then scrape into prepared tart shell
8. Chill for at least 30 minutes
9. Place chocolate , remaining 1 tbsp cream and vegetable oil in a small microwavable bowl
10. Cook mixture for 2 minutes at medium power
11. Stir until smooth
12. Place chilled tart to a serving platter
13. Scrape melted chocolate into a corner of a small , sturdy plastic bag
14. Cut off
15. Chill again until ready to serve

title: garlic and citrus roast chicken
steps:
1. Position the rack in the center of the oven , and preheat oven to 400f
2. Pat the chicken dry and sprinkle the cavity with salt and pepper
3. Stuff the cavity with the orange wedges , lemon wedges , and garlic halves
4. Tie the chicken legs together with kitchen string to help hold its shape
5. Sprinkle the chicken with salt and pepper
6. Place a rack in a large roasting pan
7. Place the chicken , breast side up , on the rack in the pan
8. Roast the chicken for 1 hour , basting occasionally and adding some chicken broth to the pan , if necessary , to prevent the pan drippings from burning
9. Whisk the orange juice , lemon juice , oil , oregano , and chopped garlic in a medium bowl to blend
10. Brush some of the juice mixture over the chicken , after it has baked for 1 hour
11. Continue roasting the chicken until an instant-read meat thermometer inserted into the innermost part of the thigh registers 170f , basting occasionally with the juice mixture and adding broth to the pan , about 45 minutes longer
12. Transfer the chicken to a platter
13. Tent with foil while making the sauce
14. Place the same roasting pan over medium-low heat
15. Whisk in any remaining broth and simmer until the sauce is reduced to 1 cup , stirring often , about 3 minutes
16. Strain into a 2-cup glass measuring cup and discard the solids
17. Spoon the fat from the top of the sauce
18. Serve the chicken with the pan sauce

title: puff pastry sausage rolls
steps:
1. Grease a large baking sheet
2. In a small bowl combine breadcrumbs and milk
3. Let stand until the milk is absorbed
4. Transfer to a processor , and add in sausage meat , onion 1 egg , garlic and oregano
5. Using on / off turns , process until blended
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Unfold the pastry sheet onto a floured surface
8. Roll out into a 20x10-inch rectangle
9. Cut pastry crosswise into 10x4-inch strips
10. Brush each strip with beaten egg
11. Spoon 1 / 3 of the sausage mixture in narrow strip lengthwise down the center of each pastry strip
12. Fold the long sides in covering the filling and overlapping slightly
13. Transfer and arrange the rolls seam-side down on the prepared baking sheet
14. Cover and chill until rolls are set
15. Set oven to 425f
16. Cut each roll crosswise into 8 pieces
17. Separate pieces on the baking sheet
18. Brush with remaining beaten egg
19. Bake until rolls are puffed and golden
20. Serve warm with heated marinara sauce
21. Delicious !

title: chicken fajitas a la ww
steps:
1. Make marinade from soy sauce , lime juice , and herbs
2. Add chicken and marinate for 4 hours in refrigerator
3. Grate cheddar cheese , set aside
4. Chop green onions , set aside
5. Empty can of black beans into small pot
6. Add lime juice and bring to boil , stirring occasionally , reduce heat to simmer , let simmer about 10 minutes
7. Remove from heat , mash with potato masher , keep warm
8. Remove chicken from marinade and cut into strips
9. Spray heavy skillet with cooking spray and heat at high
10. Add chicken strips and sear till no pick is visible
11. Add 1 tbsp marinade
12. Add onions and peppers , heat and stir for about 2 minutes , add tomato , cook 1 minute more
13. Remove from heat
14. Spread tortilla with mashed black beans
15. Add chicken and vegetables
16. Add sour cream
17. Add cheddar cheese
18. Top with green onions

title: meyer lemon poppy seeds pancakes
steps:
1. Heat skillet over medium heat on the stove top
2. Add flour , salt , sugar , baking soda , and baking powder to large bowl and mix
3. Combine egg , oil , lemon zest , lemon juice , vanilla and buttermilk in a separate bowl and whisk vigorously to combine
4. Add wet to dry and stir until just combined
5. A few lumps are ok
6. Do not over-mix
7. Add poppy seeds and stir just slightly to incorporate , then let batter rest for 5 minutes
8. In the meantime , prepare glaze by combining powdered sugar , milk and lemon juice in a small dish and whisking to combine
9. Set aside
10. Once skillet is hot , coat lightly with non-stick cooking spray and spoon on scant 1 / 4 cup measurements of pancake batter
11. Cook until bubbles appear on top and the edges start to dry , being careful not to burn
12. They should be light-golden brown
13. Flip and cook for one to two minutes more on other side
14. Serve immediately with butter , maple syrup or meyer lemon glaze

title: kalua pork quesadillas with tomato and avocado salsa
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degree f
2. In a skillet , saute kalua pork , onion , and won bok until done
3. On 6 of the mooshoo wrappers or tortillas , spread equal amounts of pork mixture , tomato , parsley , and cheese
4. Top with the remaining wrappers
5. Press to seal
6. Combine garlic and butter
7. On surface unit of range , heat an oven-proof skillet , add a tablespoon of the garlic butter
8. Place a quesadilla in pan to brown
9. Flip quesadilla and place skillet in oven until cheese melts
10. Cook the remaining quesadillas
11. Cut each quesadilla into quarters
12. Top with tomato and avocado salsa
13. Tomato and avocado salsa:
14. Combine all ingredients and serve with kalua pork quesadillas
15. Makes 3 cups

title: bruschetta with oven roasted beets and goat cheese
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 400 degrees
2. Rub dirt off beets with paper towel , and put beets in tightly sealed casserole , and bake for 60 to 90 minutes until tender
3. Cool beets , peel them , cut off stem and roots , and cut into small cubes
4. Put beets into medium bowl , add 1 tablespoon of olive oil , green onion , vinegar , thyme , salt , and black pepper
5. In a small bowl , mix together goat cheese and water
6. Preheat broiler
7. Put bread onto a cookie sheet , lightly brush more olive oil onto fronts and backs of bread , and toast both sides under your broiler
8. Cut open your garlic clove and smear some garlic onto one side of bread
9. Spread goat cheese onto the garlic side , top with beet mixture , and serve at room temperature

title: david s goulash
steps:
1. Cook pasta in a large saucepan as you are preparing remaining ingredients
2. Fry bacon to a crispness in a large frying pan and remove to a paper towel leaving drippings in the pan
3. They will be absorbed

5. Stir frequently as the meat browns and the onion becomes translucent
6. Add the tomatoes and stir to mix thoroughly
7. Allow to cook a few minutes for the meat to absorb the flavors
8. Drain the cooked macaroni and add to the pan , again mixing well
9. Cook on a low flame until almost all juices are absorbed
10. Crumble bacon over the goulash before serving
11. Leftovers taste better the next day , so don't be afraid you are making too much
12. Goes well with a salad and french or italian bread

title: maple garlic cheese ball
steps:
1. Mix first 4 ingredients in small bowl
2. Push into ball shape with spatula
3. Refrigerate until firm
4. Quickly round into smooth ball with hands
5. Roll in pecans
6. Cover and refrigerate

title: refreshing lavender cordial
steps:
1. Put the water and sugar into a pan and heat gently until the sugar has dissolved completely
2. Add the lavender flowers and bring to the boil
3. Remove from the heat
4. Cover the pan and leave to infuse for 30-45 minutes
5. Strain the liquid into a pan and reheat , stirring all the time , until the mixture is syrupy
6. Cool completely
7. Pour into a sterilised bottle , seal tightly and leave to cool
8. Store in the refrigerator
9. Dilute with chilled sparkling mineral water to serve - or champagne / sparkling wine for a special occasion

title: shrimp and tomatillo quesadillas
steps:
1. Char bell peppers over gas flame or in broiler until blackened on all sides
2. Remove from heat , enclose in paper bag and let stand 10 minutes
3. Peel and seed , then cut into 1 / 4-inch strips
4. Set aside
5. Preheat broiler
6. Toss shrimp with 1 tablespoon oil and place on baking sheet
7. Broil shrimp until just opaque in center , about 2 minutes
8. Cut shrimp in half lengthwise
9. Set aside
10. Preheat oven to 400f brush 2 baking sheets with oil
11. Place 2 tortillas on 1 baking sheet
12. Place 1 tortilla on second baking sheet
13. Sprinkle 1 / 4 cup chopped cilantro over each tortilla , then 1 / 3 cup monterey jack cheese and 1 / 3 cup cheddar cheese
14. Arrange 8 tomatillo slices atop cheese on each tortilla , then bell pepper strips and shrimp , dividing equally
15. Sprinkle remaining 1 cup monterey jack cheese over shrimp on each tortilla , dividing equally
16. Top with remaining 3 tortillas , pressing lightly to adhere
17. Brush tops of tortillas with oil
18. Bake quesadillas until cheese melts and tortillas are crisp , about 10 minutes
19. Cut each quesadilla into 6 wedges and serve

title: banana date shake
steps:
1. In a blender or food processor , puree all the ingredients until thick and creamy
2. If you like a thinner shake , use 1 / 2-3 / 4 cup more milk

title: seared rump roast
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 500 degrees
2. Put rump roast into large roasting pan and sear each side of roast for about 15 minutes until dark brown
3. Add 1 / 4 cup of water to pan
4. Cover with foil , reduce heat to 325 degrees and cook approximately 1-1 / 2 to 2 hours , or until fork goes easily into meat
5. Remove roast from pan and let it "rest" for about 30 minutes
6. Meanwhile , make the most wonderful gravy from all of the drippings

title: cream of watercress soup
steps:
1. Melt butter and saut onion until transparent
2. Add potato , watercress , milk and stock
3. Bring to boil , cover and simmer for 20 minutes
4. Blend in a processor
5. Add cream and seasoning
6. Heat if needed

title: slow cooker baked beans with maple syrup
steps:
1. Place the beans in large bowl
2. Cover with water and soak overnight at room temperature
3. Add water , as needed , so that the beans are always covered
4. Rinse and drain
5. In a slow cooker , combine all the ingredients
6. Cook for 8 to 9 hours on low , or about six hours on high
7. Adjust the seasoning

title: lighter beef chili
steps:
1. In a large , heavy-bottomed saucepan , heat oil over medium-high
2. Add onion and garlic , and season with salt and pepper
3. Cook until softened , 3 to 5 minutes
4. Add tomato paste , chili powder , and cocoa powder
5. Cook , stirring , until mixture is fragrant , about 1 minute
6. Add beef , and cook , breaking up with a spoon , until no longer pink , 3 to 5 minutes
7. Add tomatoes and beans
8. Bring to a boil over high
9. Reduce to a simmer , and cook until chili is slightly thickened , 10 to 15 minutes
