10. Serve with toppings , if desired

title: fudge puddles
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Sift together flour , baking soda and salt
3. Set aside
4. Cream butter , peanut butter white sugar and brown sugars until fluffy
5. Mix in egg and 1 / 2 tsp vanilla
6. Stir in flour mixture into creamed mixture
7. Shape dough into 48 balls , 1 inch each
8. Place each ball in one compartment of a mini muffin tin
9. Bake for 14-16 minutes or until lightly browned
10. Remove from oven and immediately make wells in the center of each using a melon baller
11. Cool in pan for 5 minutes
12. Then carefully remove to wire racks
13. Using a measuring cup fill each shell with the chocolate mixture
14. Top with a pecan half
15. For filling , put chocolate chips in a double boiler over simmering water
16. Stir in milk and vanilla , mix well
17. I also melt white chocolate and drizzle over the completed cookie cups for a finishing touch

title: orange poppy muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 f
2. Mix dry ingredients
3. Mix flax and orange juice , then add the other wet ingredients
4. Mix both wet and dry together
5. Spoon into muffin pan lined with cupcake liners or safflower oil
6. Bake 15-25 minutes , until toothpick in center comes out clean

title: yellow cake for strawberries and whipped cream
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cream butter and sugar
3. Add eggs one at a time and beat
4. Mix flour and baking powder together
5. Add flour mixture and water alternately to the cream mixture beginning with flour and ending with flour
6. Add vanilla
7. Pour into a greased and floured square pan
8. Bake about 30 minutes till very light and golden colored
9. Touch the top for a gentle spring back to know it's done

title: easy peasy pumpkin muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Mix together the spice cake mix , pumpkin and water until smooth
3. Add cinnamon chips
4. Line muffin tin with paper cups
5. Fill cups 2 / 3 to 3 / 4 full
6. Bake for 15 minutes or until tester comes out clean

title: best banana bread ever  seriously
steps:
1. Cream butter , sugar , bananas and egg
2. Mix all the dry ingredients together except for the cinnamon and 2 tsp of sugar
3. Add the dry ingredients alternatively with the sour milk
4. Try to end with dry ingredients
5. Add vanilla
6. Preheat oven to 325
7. Now -- heres the yummy trick- mix the cinnamon and 2 tsp sugar
8. Then grease the loaf pan and instead of dusting with flour , dust the pan with the cinnamon sugar mixture
9. Then pour in the batter and bake for 1-1
10. 5 hours until a toothpick comes out clean when inserted in the middle
11. Sour milk is 3 / 4 cup of milk with one tablespoon of milk removed and replaced with one tablespoon of white vinegar
12. I like to make my banana bread in a larger cake pan so it cooks faster

title: speedy taco bake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Cook ground beef and onion until done , drain
3. Stir in taco seasoning mix , tomatoes and corn
4. Spoon into 13x9x2-inch ungreased baking dish
5. Sprinkle with cheese
6. Stir together bisquick , milk and eggs
7. Pour over meat mixture
8. Bake 35 minutes or until light golden brown
9. Serve with sour cream , chopped tomato and shredded lettuce if desired

title: picadilla sauce
steps: 1. Combine ingredients in food processor

title: bruschetta gorgonzola and apples
steps:
1. Preheat grill
2. Slice bread into 1 inch thick slices
3. Slice each apple into 8 wedges
4. Remove core
5. Combine first 4 ingredients in a small bowl , stirring to blend
6. Place bread slices on grill that has been coated with cooking spray
7. , cook 2 minutes on each side or until lightly browned
8. Remove from grill and rub cut sides of garlic over one side of each slice
9. Spread 2 teaspoons cheese mixture over each bread slice
10. Serve with apple wedges
11. Serving size is 1 slice bread with 2 apple wedges

title: salmon loaf easy  fast    healthy
steps:
1. Drain salmon and flake / remove bones
2. Combine with the rest of ingredients
3. Shape into a loaf and place in greased pan or casserole dish
4. Bake at 350 for around 40 minutes

title: poppy seed bowknots
steps:
1. In a large bowl , and electric mixer fitted with a dough hook , or a food processor , sprinkle the yeast over the water , stir , and let stand for 5 minutes
2. Stir until dissolved
3. Add 4 cups of the flour , the sugar , salt , butter , and buttermilk to the yeast mixture , and mix thoroughly
4. On a lightly floured board or in the mixer or food processor , knead the dough until smooth and elastic- about 4 minutes by hand , 2 minutes in the mixer , or 30 seconds in the processor
5. Add more flour as needed to keep the dough from sticking
6. This is more malleable and softer than a bread dough
7. Transfer the dough to a large , lightly greased bowl , turn to coat with the grease , and cover with a clean dry towel
8. Let rise in a warm , draft-free spot until doubled in bulk- about 1 hour
9. Punch the dough down and knead it on a lightly floured surface for 2 minutes
10. Roll the dough out to a 24"x6"x1 / 2" rectangle , then cut into 6"x1"x1 / 2" strips
11. Gently tie each strip into a bowknot by slipping one end over , under , then back over the other
12. Lay the roll 2 inches apart on a lightly oiled baking sheet
13. Cover with a clean dry towel
14. Place in a warm , draft-free spot until the rolls have doubled in bulk-about 25 minutes
15. Preheat the oven to 375
16. Brush the tops with the egg white and sprinkle with poppy seeds
17. Bake on the middle shelf fo the oven until golden brown and a toothpick inserted in a knot comes out clean- 20 to 25 minutes
18. Cool on the baking sheet , then serve
19. Makes 24 rolls

title: smoked sausages
steps:
1. Wrap bacon strip around sausage and secure with a toothpick
2. Place on cookie sheet
3. Bake at 350 for 15 minutes
4. Drain grease
5. Put enough brown sugar on links to cover them
6. Return to oven just till sugar melts

title: vegetarian ricepaper rolls
steps:
1. Prepare veges
2. Place the shredded cabbage in a bowl with the lemon juice and fish sauce to marinate
3. Soak the rice paper sheets , 2 to 3 at a time , in cold water for approximately 2 minutes
4. Lift out carefully and place on a damp tea towel to continue softening
5. When they are fully soft and pliable they are ready to use
6. Using one softened rice paper sheet at a time
7. Place a small amount of each vegetable and 1 piece of coriander / cilantro on the edge of the paper
8. It's better to under rather than over fill the rolls as they can become difficult to roll
9. Roll up the rice paper , tucking in the edges
10. Place on a platter or tray
11. Continue with the other sheets of rice paper until all the filling is used
12. You can completely wrap the filling to look like a spring roll parcel or can leave one end folded neatly open to show the colourful fillings
13. Serve rice paper rolls cold or at room temperature , and use sauce to dip rolls into
14. I like to use asian style sweet chilli sauce

title: onion  feta  and zaatar egg noodle kugel
steps:
1. Cook the noodles according to the package directions , i wouldn't recommend more than 7-8 minutes total
2. Drain and set aside
3. If using a block of feta , run it through your food processor or blender a few times to get it nice and crumbled
4. If lacking such an appliance , mashing it up with a fork does the trick too
5. Drain any excess liquid
6. Mix everything in a large mixing bowl , then pour into an oiled 8 x 8 square pan
7. Bake for 45-50 minutes or until golden browned on top

title: bob evans style buttermilk biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f or 220c
2. In a medium mixing bowl stir together flour and baking soda
3. With a pastry blender or two knives cut in butter or margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
4. Make a well in center
5. Add the buttermilk all at once
6. Stir until moistened
7. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface
8. Quickly knead dough by gently folding and pressing dough 10 to 12 strokes or until nearly smooth
9. Pat or lightly roll dough to 1 / 2-inch thickness
10. Cut dough with a floured 2-1 / 2-inch biscuit cutter
11. Place biscuits 1 to 2 inches apart on a lightly buttered baking sheet
12. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden
13. Remove biscuits from baking sheet and serve hot

title: fish baked in lettuce packets
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f
2. Place a few lettuce leaves at a time in hot water
3. Let stand 1-2 minutes or until wilted
4. Drain
5. Mound a portion of carrot and zucchini near stem end of each lettuce leaf
6. Place 1 piece fish on vegetables
7. Sprinkle with marjoram , salt and pepper
8. Dot with margarine
9. Fold lettuce leaf over fish
10. Place seam side down in ungreased rectangular baking dish , 13x9x2
11. Cover and bake 25-30 minutes or until fish is done

title: bbq shredded pork butt roast
steps:
1. Rinse and pat dry roast
2. Place in crock pot
3. Season to taste
4. Cover with 1 bottle bbq sauce
5. Cover and cook on low 8-10 hours or on high 6-7 hours
6. Carefully remove meat from crockpot- place in large baking pan
7. Shred with two forks
8. Pour out all but one cup liquid from crockpot
9. Return meat to crockpot
10. Cover with second bottle bbq sauce ,
11. Mix well
12. Re-heat if necessary

title: nat s sparkling summer spritzer
steps:
1. Fill a highball or wineglass , with ice
2. Pour wine to half way and top with club soda
3. Squeeze in juice of one slice of lemon
4. Garnish with a other lemon slice

title: easy does it rolls
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425
2. Grease a 12-cup muffin tin
3. In medium bowl combine flour , mayonnaise & milk
4. Using a fork , stir only enough to moisten flour
5. Divide dough equally between muffin cups
6. Bake for 20 minutes and serve warm with butter , honey , jam or my posted maple spread

title: herbed baked eggs
steps:
1. Preheat the broiler for 5 minutes and place the oven rack 6 inches below the heat
2. Combine the garlic , thyme , rosemary , parsley , and parmesan and set aside
3. Carefully crack 2 eggs into each of 3 small bowls or teacups without breaking the yolks
4. Place 3 individual gratin dishes on a baking sheet
5. Place 1 tablespoon of cream and 1 / 2 tablespoon of butter in each dish and place under the broiler for about 3 minutes , until hot and bubbly
6. Quickly , but carefully , pour 2 eggs into each gratin dish and sprinkle evenly with the herb mixture , then sprinkle liberally with salt and pepper
7. Place back under the broiler for 4 to 6 minutes , until the whites of the eggs are almost cooked
8. The eggs will continue to cook after you take them out of the oven
9. Allow to set for 60 seconds and serve hot with toasted bread
10. Enjoy !

title: orange nut muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Sift together the flour , sugar , baking powder , salt and soda
3. Stir in grape nuts
4. Combine eggs , orange juice , orange peel and oil
5. Add to dry ingredients all at once
6. Stir just until moistened
7. Fill greased muffin pans 2 / 3 full
8. Bake at 400f for 20 to 25 minutes

title: baked  biscuit filled apple
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a small bowl , combine sugar and cinnamon
3. Core apples , and widen opening at top to accommodate biscuit
4. Rub insides and tops of apples generously with sugar-cinnamon mixture
5. Prepare biscuit dough per instructions on package , using baking mix and milk
6. Spoon biscuit mixture into cored apples , mounding slightly , and spreading to edges
7. Place on baking sheet and bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes , or until apples are done and biscuits golden brown
8. Any leftover dough can be shaped into biscuits and baked together with filled apples , for the same amount of time
9. For variety: a sprinkle of any of the following may be added to biscuit dough: sprinkle of raisins , currants , dried cranberries or chopped almonds

title: quick banana bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Coat 9 / 5 loaf pan with cooking spray
3. Combine dry ingredients
4. Combine wet ingredients
5. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and mix
6. Add nuts and stir gently
7. Pour into prepared pan
8. Bake for 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean

title: fresh vegetable dip
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a bowl
2. Chill for 1 hour
3. Serve with fresh veggies

title: sour cream apple squares
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Prepare an ungreased 13 x 9-inch baking pan
3. In a large bowl , combine flour , brown sugar and butter
4. Beat at low speed until crumbly
5. Stir in nuts
6. Lightly press 2-3 / 4 cups of the crumb mixture in bottom of an ungreased baking dish
7. To the remaining crumb mixture , add cinnamon , baking soda , salt , sour cream , vanilla and egg
8. Mix well with a wooden spoon
9. Stir in apples
10. Spoon evenly over the crumb base in the pan
11. Bake for 30-40 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
12. Cool slightly
13. Cut into squares
14. Serve with ice cream or whipped cream -- yummy !

title: grilled salmon with key lime butter
steps:
1. Heat a lightly greased grill over medium heat or use a foreman grill lightly oiled
2. I used my foreman grill
3. In a saucepan , melt butter and add your lime juice and lime zest
4. Dip the seasoned salmon in the lime butter and put on the grill
5. Grill for approximately l l / 2 to 2 minutes and add more of the lime butter
6. Cook until flakey
7. Serve over rice or noodles seasoned with salt , pepper , lime zest and parsley

title: shrimp creole orleans
steps:
1. Melt butter in large skillet over medium heat and saute onion , garlic , celery , and bell pepper until tender approximately 15 to 20 minutes
2. Add tomatoes , brown sugar , salt , pepper , and bay leaves and simmer for an additional 15 to 20 minutes
3. Add lemon juice and shrimp
4. Cover and simmer for 6 to 8 minutes
5. Serve over a bed of rice

title: crab and asparagus soup
steps:
1. Melt butter over medium-high heat in a medium saucepan
2. Add asparagus , crab and onions
3. Saute 2 to 3 minutes , or until soft
4. Reduce heat to medium low , add soup , broth and water
5. Bring to a boil , add soy sauce and white pepper to taste

title: leek soup with roasted garlic and parmesan
steps:
1. Begin by preparing the roux
2. Melt the butter in a large stock pot
3. Add the cup of flower a little at a time whisking briskly to avoid lumps
4. After all the flower is in , continue to whisk and cook for at least 3 min
5. Add the 3 cups of 1 / 2 reduced chicken broth a little at a time wile continuing to whisk
6. As the roux thickens , add the 3 cups of wine a little at a time until all is incorporated
7. In a saut pan , melt the 2 tbs
8. Of butter over medium heat , add the chopped leaks and saut until tender but not browned and add to the roux
9. Next , add the red bell pepper , green bell pepper , head of roasted garlic , parmesan cheese , soy-sauce , worcestershire sauce , and honey
10. Let simmer for 1 / 2 hour stirring often
11. Lastly , with the heat low , stir in the cream and then the 1 / 2 cup butter to finish
12. Serve soon
13. This soup also keeps well refrigerated for up to a week

title: toffee crunch grahams
steps:
1. Line a 15x10 baking pan with heavy duty foil
2. Place graham crackers in one layer in the pan
3. In a saucepan , combine butter and brown sugar and bring to a boil , stirring constantly
4. Carefully pour toffee mixture over graham crackers
5. Sprinkle with almonds
6. Bake at 400 degrees for 6-8 minutes or until bubbly
7. Cool in pan for 4 minutes
8. Cut each cracker into four sections
9. Transfer to wire rack to cool completely

title: mexican veggie or chip dip
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine all of the ingredients
2. Beat till smooth and creamy
3. Cover and refrigerate several hours , till flavors are blended
4. Serve with assorted raw veggies or tortilla chips

title: uncle bill s french onion soup
steps:
1. In a large cooking pot , add water , celery tops , bay leaves , salt and soup bones
2. Bing to boil , reduce heat and simmer for about 4 hours
3. Remove bones and meat , celery tops and bay leaves and discard
4. Transfer stock to a large bowl , refrigerate until cooled and fat sets
5. Skim all fat off and discard
6. Set soup stock aside
7. Slice onions thin
8. In a large frying pan add butter and sliced onions and saute' until light brown , about 15 minutes , stirring often , but do not burn
9. In a large cooking pot , add stock and if necessary , make up the difference with water
10. Add sautee'd onions , consomme soup , beef broth , sugar , granulated garlic powder , ketchup and worcestershire sauce and simmer for 1 hour , stirring occasionally
11. Adjust spices to taste
12. To serve
13. Pour soup into oven-proof soup bowls leaving enough room in bowl to add 1 tablespoon of beer
14. Rub each piece of toasted french bread with garlic
15. Place 1 piece of toasted french bread on top of soup
16. Sprinkle top of toast liberally with grated gruyere cheese and mozzarella cheese
17. Place bowls of soup on a metal tray or cookie sheet
18. Place under broiler and broil until cheese melts and puffs up , about 3 to 4 minutes
19. Serve immediately

title: orange cranberry pull apart coffee cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 and spray a 9-inch round cake pan with a non-stick baking cooking spray
2. In a medium size bowl , combine the sugar , pecans , cranberries , butter and orange zest
3. Open the biscuits , separate and cut into fourths
4. Toss the biscuits with the sugar mixture and pour into prepared pan
5. Place in preheated oven and bake for 20 to 25 minutes
6. Turn out on a dinner plate and immediately drizzle with glaze
7. Serve warm

title: lemon butter sauce
steps:
1. In a heavy-based saucepan , melt butter
2. Add lemon juice , worcestershire sauce and pepper- simmer for about 1 minute , then add herbs
3. Serve hot

title: chocolate boston cream pie
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Grease and flour 1 9" round baking pan
3. Stir together flour , sugar , cocoa and baking soda in a lg
4. Bowl
5. Add butter , milk , egg and vanilla
6. Beat on low speed of mixer until all ingredients are moistened
7. Beat on med
8. Speed 2 minutes
9. Pour batter into prepared pan
10. Bake 30-35 mins
11. , or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
12. Cool 10 minutes
13. Remove from pan to wire rack
14. Cool completely
15. Prepare chocolate filling
16. Cut cake into 2 thin layers
17. Place 1 layer on serving plate
18. Spread filling over layer
19. Top with remaining layer
20. Prepare satiny chocolate glaze
21. Pour onto top of cake , allowing some to drizzle down sides
22. Refrigerate until serving time
23. Cover , and refrigerate leftover cake
24. Makes 8 servings
25. Chocolate filling:
26. Stir together sugar , cocoa and cornstarch in medium bowl
27. Gradually stir in light cream
28. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until mixture thickens and begins to boil
29. Boil 1 min
30. , stirring constantly
31. Remove from heat
32. Stir in butter and vanilla
33. Press plastic wrap directly onto surface
34. Cool completely
35. Satiny chocolate glaze:
36. Heat water , butter and corn syrup in small saucepan to boiling
37. Remove from heat , and immediately stir in cocoa
38. With whisk , gradually beat in confectionary sugar and vanilla until smooth
39. Cool slightly

title: curried tuna pita pockets
steps:
1. In a medium sized bowl combine the mayonnaise , lime juice , lime zest and curry powder
2. Add all remaining ingredients except the lettuce and pita
3. Mix until combined
4. Split pitas and add one or two lettuce leaves
5. Add a scoop of tuna salad

title: tropical fruit compote
steps:
1. Combine sugar , guava jelly , orange zest , and water in a small saucepan
2. Bring to a boil and boil 1-2 minutes
3. Strain and cool , then stir in the rum
4. Arrange cubed fruits in a serving bowl
5. Pour the cooled guava mixture over the fruit and gently toss to mix using a wooden spoon
6. Chill until ready to serve
7. Garnish with dried coconut

title: greek pasta shells salad
steps:
1. Gradually add pasta shells to 4 quarts rapidly boiling water
2. If desired , add salt
3. Boil 8 to 10 minutes , or until tender , stirring frequently
4. Drain and rinse with cold water
5. In large bowl combine pasta shells and all other ingredients and mix well
6. Cover and chill thoroughly

title: dijon mustard substitute
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients
2. Yield: "2 tablespoons"

title: japanese style  sweet carrots
steps:
1. Cut up carrot and boil in water until it's almost soft
2. Discard most of the water and add a little sugar and butter
3. Continue boiling until the carrot is soft
4. They are just regular carrots , and you don't have to use a lot of sugar
5. Carrots are naturally sweet when boiled
6. A little butter makes the sweetness more noticeable
7. Serve hot with rice

title: apple oat coffee cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f degrees
2. Grease square pan , 9 9 2 inches
3. Prepare oat streusel
4. Set aside
5. Beat remaining ingredients except apples in large bowl with electric mixer on low speed 30 seconds , scraping bowl frequently
6. Beat on medium speed 2 minutes , scraping bowl occasionally
7. Stir in apples
8. Spread half of the batter in pan
9. Sprinkle with half of the streusel
10. Top with remaining batter
11. Sprinkle with remaining streusel
12. Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
13. Serve warm
14. Garnish with apple slices
15. Oat streusel-----------------------
16. Cut margarine into oats , flour and brown sugar , using pastry blender or fork , until crumbly
17. Stir in nuts

title: cherry oatmeal muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Line a 12-cup muffin pan with paper cups
3. With a wire whisk , combine oats , flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda , and salt in a large bowl
4. Combine buttermilk , egg , oil and almond extract in a small bowl
5. Make a well in the center of the oat and flour mixture
6. Add liquid ingredients
7. Stir until just moist
8. Fold in chopped cherries
9. Spoon muffin mixture into muffin pan
10. Bake for 18-20 minutes

title: shrimp salad with zucchini and basil
steps:
1. Whisk lemon juice , capers , shallot , mustard , and dried red pepper in medium bowl
2. Whisk in oil , then basil
3. Bring large saucepan of salted water to boil , add shrimp and cook 1 minute
4. Add zucchini and continue cooking until shrimp are opaque in the center , and zucchini is crisp tender , about 1 minute longer
5. Drain well
6. Transfer to large bowl
7. Add 1 / 3 cup of dressing and toss to coat
8. Season to taste with salt and pepper
9. Toss greens in large bowl with enough dressing to coat
10. Divide greens among 4 plates
11. Arrange shrimp and zucchini atop greens
12. Pass parmesan cheese separately if desired

title: sour cream streusel coffee cake
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Butter a bunt pan and set aside
3. In a small bowl mix together the walnuts , brown sugar , cinnamon , cocoa and currants
4. In a medium bowl sift together the flour , baking soda and baking powder
5. In a large bowl beat the butter and white sugar until well blended
6. Beat in eggs one at a time
7. Mix dry ingredients and sour cream alternately into butter mixture
8. Beat on high for 1 minute
9. Pour 1 / 3 of the batter into the prepared bundt pan
10. Sprinkle with half of the nut mixture
11. Spoon 1 / 3 of the batter over the nut mixture , sprinkle with the remaining nut mixture and top with the remaining batter
12. Bake for 1 hour or until a toothpick inserted in the deepest part comes out clean
13. Remove from oven and allow to cool for 10 minutes on a rack
14. Invert pan on the same rack and remove cake
15. Allow to cool for 1 hour then transfer to a serving platter
16. Whisk powdered sugar and milk in a small bowl until smooth
17. Drizzle over coffee cake and sprinkle with nuts
18. Serve warm or at room temp

title: pasta pesto rosso
steps:
1. Cut dried tomatoes into short strips
2. Dice bell pepper and cut zucchini into slices
3. In a saucepan heat oil
4. Sautee crushed garlic , sun-dried tomatoes and rosemary in it until fragrant
5. Add water , tomato paste and salt and pepper
6. Simmer for 5-8 minutes until sauce looks nice to you
7. Meanwhile in a big pot of boiling water cook pasta shells for 4 minutes
8. Then add bell pepper , zucchini and broccoli
9. Cook for another 4-6 minutes until veggies are tender
10. Drain pasta and veggies
11. Toss with the sauce and add cherry tomatoes to serve
12. If you like sprinkle with freshly grated parmesan cheese

title: sticky soy and maple pork burgers
steps:
1. Place the pork , peanuts , onions , ginger , zest , 1 tbsp soy sauce , 2 tsp maple syrup , chilli flakes and coriander into a large bowl , season well with salt and pepper , then mix well using your hands
2. Shape into 4 patties , cover and chill for at least 30 minutes
3. Preheat the oven to 200 degrees and line a tray with baking powder
4. Heat a frypan / chargrill pan over med-high heat
5. Brush the pan with a little oil and cook the patties for 1-2 mins each side until golden browm
6. Transfer the patties to the baking tray and bake for a further 8-10 mins , until cooked through
7. Mix the oil with the remaining soy and maple syrup or honey in a small bowl and brush over the patties
8. To serve sandwich each ciabatta with some chilli sauce , sour cream etc and a pattie

title: kathy s meaty spaghetti sauce
steps:
1. In a frying pan add 2 tbs oil , add garlic , onion and green pepper
2. Saute vegetables until tender
3. Add ground beef and sausage to pan , cook until done
4. Pour off excess fat , and add meat mixture to large pot
5. Add tomato sauce and canned tomatoes to meat mixture in pot , keep adding sauce until it's as thick as you like
6. Stir sauce until well mixed
7. Add oregano and bay leaf
8. Sprinkle oregano to cover entire top of sauce
9. I add a lot of oregano
10. Mix well , and heat to a boil stirring occasionally
11. Add as much oregano as you like
12. Add salt and pepper to taste
13. Once it starts boiling turn the heat down to a simmer
14. Simmer for 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
15. In the meantime , cook pasta in a large pot of boiling water
16. Drain pasta
17. Pour sauce over pasta

title: grandpa slabaugh s bbq sauce
steps:
1. Mix all together and bring to a boil over the stove just to dissolve salt and mix flavors
2. Dip each piece of chicken in sauce and place on hot grill
3. Baste intermittently as the chicken cooks
4. Direct flame will brown the chicken more than cooking not directly over the fire
5. Chicken will be juicier if you cook indirect however , so i normally will move the chicken on and off the direct flame , rotating them for even cooking
6. This helps to brown each piece but doesn't dry out the chicken
7. Using this method i normally cook the chicken 45 - 60 minutes

title: scotch broth
steps:
1. In a large stockpot or dutch oven , cover the lamb with cold water
2. Bring to a boil
3. Add the barley , partially cover the pot , and simmer until the meat and barley are tender , about 1 hours
4. Add more water to adjust for any evaporation
5. Skim the surface of the soup as necessary
6. Remove meat from broth
7. Cut meat from bone and cut in small pieces
8. Discard the bones and return the meat to the soup
9. Continue simmering
10. In a skillet , melt the butter over medium heat
11. Add the carrots , turnip , celery , and onion and cook stirring often for 10 minutes
12. Add the vegetables to the soup
13. Simmer for about 10 minutes , or until the vegetables are tender
14. Add salt , pepper , and seasonings to taste

title: almond joy cheesecake
steps:
1. For crust: preheat oven to 350f
2. Wrap foil around outside of 9-inch-diameter springform pan with 2 3 / 4-inch-high sides
3. Grind the almonds in a food processor and add the toasted coconut and graham cracker crumbs or put the ingredients in a plastic zip bag and crush with a rolling pin until nuts and toasted coconut are finely ground and mix with crumbs
4. Add butter and brown sugar to the processor to blend or blend ingredients in a large bowl until crumbs stick together
5. Press crust mixture over bottom and 2 inches up sides of prepared pan
6. Bake until set , about 10 minutes
7. Lower oven temperature to 325 degrees and let crust and oven cool while you mix the filling
8. Using an electric mixer , beat cream cheese , sugar and extract in a large bowl to blend
9. Beat in cream of coconut , shredded coconut and flour
10. Add eggs 1 at a time , beating until just combined
11. Pour filling into crust
12. Bake in a water bath until center is almost set , about 1 hour 15 minutes
13. Turn oven off and let cheesecake cool slowly in the oven for another 30 minutes
14. Transfer to a rack and cool for at least 30 minutes
15. Cover and chill overnight
16. For topping: bring cream and corn syrup to simmer in medium saucepan
17. Remove from heat
18. Add chocolate chips
19. Whisk until smooth
20. Cool to room temperature
21. Pour topping over cake
22. Sprinkle top with almonds and coconut
23. Chill until topping is set , about 2 hours

title: basic cinnamon pancakes
steps:
1. Whisk the flour , milk , cinnamon and vanilla together
2. Add the egg and mix well
3. Cook the first side in a heated frying pan , flip the pancake when it's ready and do the other side

title: wedding belle  drink
steps:
1. Shake the gin , dubonnet , cherry brandy and orange juice over ice cubes in a shaker until well frosted
2. Strain into a cocktail glass and serve with the twist of orange peel

title: maple salmon fillets
steps:
1. Spray nonstick frying pan with cooking spray and heat over medium heat
2. Cook ginger and garlic for 3-5 minutes , stirring
3. Remove pan from heat
4. Stir in maple syrup and memories sauce
5. Preheat broiler
6. Line baking sheet with foil and spray with cooking spray
7. Place fillets or steaks on prepared baking sheet
8. Divide sauce among fillets , brushing over tops and sides
9. Broil salmon 4 inches under broiler for 10 minutes per inch thickness or until fish flakes easily when prodded with a fork
10. Serve immediately

title: tofu with garlic mirin sauce
steps:
1. Slice tofu into 1 / 4 inch strips
2. Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat , and add cooking oil
3. Fry tofu until light golden , making sure both sides are browned
4. Remove tofu to paper-towel lined plate
5. Stir all sauce ingredients in a small bowl , adding the sesame oil last
6. Pour mixture into skillet , and cook over medium-high heat until thickened
7. Return tofu to skillet , and toss to coat
8. Serve with steamed jasmine rice , or cooked soba noodles if desired

title: mojito ice cubes
steps:
1. Mix lime juice and sugar till dissolved
2. Add water mix and pour into 2 ice cube trays
3. Place 1 lime wedge and 1 mint leaf in each section
4. Top with additional water if need
5. Freeze till solid
6. Enjoy !

title: chicken breasts on rice
steps:
1. Mix together soup and milk , reserve 1 / 2 cup
2. Stir together soup mixture , rice , 1 / 2 package onion soup mix , and mushroom pieces
3. Pour into baking dish
4. Lay chicken pieces on top
5. Pour 1 / 2 cup reserved soup mixture over chicken , and sprinkle remaining 1 / 2 package soup mix over all
6. Cover and bake at 350 for 1 hour
7. Uncover and bake additional 15-30 minutes

title: easy moist orange loaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In large mixing bowl , mix together eggs , vanilla , sour cream , grated orange peel , and orange juice
3. Stir in sugar and baking soda
4. Stir in flour and mix until most lumps are out
5. You can mix by hand or with a beater
6. Grease a small loaf pan with cooking spray
7. Pour batter into greased loaf pan
8. Bake at 350 for 38-42 minutes or until a knife in the center comes out clean
9. Let cool and slice , or first top with a cream cheese cake frosting

title: vegeroni
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 180 celcius
2. Cook pasta with frozen veg in big pot of boiling water
3. Drain pasta & veg , and return to pot
4. Mix in can of soup , and transfer to casserole / baking dish
5. Sprinkle with grated cheese and bake for 10-15 min

title: turkey soup
steps:
1. Add finely chopped onion , celery stalks and garlic to 2 t of vegetable oil in a soup pot
2. Sweat until tender
3. Add turkey , remaining chicken broth , tomato sauce and water
4. Also add fresh herbs , garlic salt and pepper
5. You may add more water if necessary
6. Bring to a boil and simmer for 1 hour
7. Strain soup into another pot removing the flavoring vegetables , and carcass
8. Return broth to soup pot
9. Remove meat from the carcass and add to broth
10. Chop remaining and celery into small pieces and add to soup
11. You may also add additional turkey leftovers at this point
12. Return to a boil and simmer for 1 1 / 2 hours
13. Put the carrots in 45 minutes before finishing
14. Serve with fine egg noodles

title: smothered pork chops  crock pot
steps:
1. On a plate , combine flour , salt and pepper and dredge pork in mixture , coating both sides
2. In a nonstick skillet , heat oil over medium heat and add pork in batches and brown both sides
3. Transfer to slow cooker when done
4. Add onions to pan , adding more oil if necessary , and cook , stirring until softened
5. Add garlic and cook , stirring for 1 minute
6. Stir in chili sauce , vinegar , brown sugar , worcestershire sauce and mustard
7. Bring to a boil
8. Pour sauce over chops
9. Cover and cook on low for 4-5 hours or cook on high for 2-2 1 / 2 hours , until meat is tender

title: lemon garlic alfredo sauce
steps:
1. Zest a lemon using a zester or a fine grater
2. Set aside
3. Juice two lemons with a citrus reamer or juicer
4. Set aside
5. In a medium sauce pan , melt butter and add the garlic with cream and boil until the cream is reduced by half
6. Add fresh lemon juice and lemon zest
7. Stir in parmesan and romano cheese for 1-2 minutes
8. Remove from heat
9. Sprinkle with black pepper and salt to taste

title: chocolate passion trifle
steps:
1. Sprinkle warm brownies with 1 tbl kahlua
2. Allow to cool completely and cut into 1 / 2 inch squares
3. Pour milk into large bowl and add pudding mix
4. Beat with whisk until blended for 2 minutes
5. Let stand 5 minutes
6. Gently stir in remaining kahlua and 2 cups of cool whip until well blended
7. Refrigerate for 1 hour
8. Reserve a few raspberries and pecans for garnish
9. Layer half of the brownies , half of the raspberries , half of the chopped candy bars , half of the pecans and half of the pudding mixture into a 2 quart glass bowl or trifle dish
10. Repeat layers and and top with remaining cool whip
11. Sprinkle with reserved raspberries and pecans
12. Refrigerate until ready to serve

title: mexican lime with chicken or turkey tortilla soup
steps:
1. Spray a skillet with lite olive oil and fry the tortilla strips until brown& crisp , drain on paper towel
2. Spray the pan again and saute the onions& chilis until tender but not brown
3. Add broth& turkey , cover and simmer for 20 minutes
4. Add tomatoe , simmer 5 more minutes , stir in the lime juice
5. Taste and adjust the seasoning
6. Ladle into hot bowls , add tortilla chips and garnish with a slice of lime

title: groundhog special
steps:
1. Shake vermouth , brandy and limejuice together
2. Pour into glasses filled with cracked ice
3. Let stand 5-10 minutes before serving
4. Serve

title: rubio s baja grill lobster taco recipe
steps:
1. Marinate lobster in salsa for an hour to two
2. Stir fry lobster in a skillet or wok for two to three minutes
3. In a separate pan , heat the tortilla
4. To assemble , spread guacamole down the center of the tortilla , then lay in lobster , shredded cabbage and baja sauce
5. Fold over , garnish with lime slice , and serve

title: tilapia w  citrus bagna cauda
steps:
1. Cook the butter and 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil in a heavy medium saucepan over medium low heat just until the butter is melted , stirring frequently
2. Add the anchovies , if using , and stir until the anchovies dissolve , about 2 minutes
3. Add the garlic and cook just until fragrant , about 30 seconds
4. Remove from the heat
5. Stir in the orange juice , basil , and lemon and orange zests
6. Season the sauce , to taste , with salt
7. The bagna cauda sauce can be made 1 day ahead
8. Cool , then cover and refrigerate
9. Rewarm it before using
10. Meanwhile , preheat oven to 200 degrees f
11. Sprinkle the fish with salt and pepper and brush both sides of the fish with the remaining 4-8 teaspoons extra-virgin olive oil
12. Working in 2 batches , fry the fish until just opaque in center , about 3 minutes per side
13. Transfer fish to platter
14. Cover with foil and keep warm in the oven while cooking the second batch of fish
15. Drizzle the sauce over and around the fish and serve
16. Enjoy !

title: white chocolate macaroons
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Lightly grease cookie sheets or spray with cooking spray
3. In large bowl , break up cookie dough
4. Stir or knead in all remaining ingredients until well blended
5. On cookie sheets , drop dough by tablespoonfuls 2 inches apart
6. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until edges are golden brown
7. Remove from oven and place 1 / 2 of cherry into middle of cookie
8. Cool 2 minutes
9. Remove from cookie sheets to cooling racks

title: hot german potatoes and knockwurst
steps:
1. Cover potatoes with water in a medium saucepan
2. Bring to boil
3. Simmer until tender , 25 to 30 minutes
4. Drain , cool slightly , and cut into slices
5. Place slices into a large heatproof bowl
6. Fry the bacon in a medium saucepan over medium heat until almost crisp
7. Add the onion and cook until translucent , 5 to 10 minutes
8. Mix in the flour , sugar , mustard , salt and pepper
9. Stir in the vinegar , broth , and celery seeds
10. Cook , stirring often , until thickened
11. Meanwhile , heat the knockwurst according to package directions
12. Cut each into 6 to 8 diagonal slices
13. Add the knockwurst to the potatoes
14. Pour the sauce over and toss to coat
15. Sprinkle with the parsley and serve warm

title: sesame zucchini ribbons
steps:
1. Using a vegetable peeler , cut zucchini and squash lengthwise to form ribbons , discarding inner seeded core of squash
2. Heat 1 t vegetable oil in a large nonstick skillet over moderately high heat until hot but not smoking
3. Add half of zucchini and squash ribbons
4. Cook , tossing with tongs 1 minute
5. Transfer to a colander set over a bowl
6. Repeat with remaining 1 t vegetable oil and the ribbons
7. Let stand in colander 20 minutes to drain
8. Transfer to serving bowl
9. Toss with juice and sesame oil
10. Salt and pepper to taste

title: scandinavian brown cabbage soup
steps:
1. Melt butter in a heavy kettle
2. Stir in sugar and cook until browned
3. Do not scorch
4. Add cabbage and cook 3 minutes , stirring constantly
5. Add remaining ingredients
6. Simmer covered 1 hour

title: gouda quesadilla with cilantro walnut pesto
steps:
1. Place cilantro , walnuts , garlic , salt , pepper , lime juice , and olive oil in a food processor and blend until smooth
2. Fill each corn tortilla with 1 / 4 cup shredded gouda and fold in half
3. Cook on a hot grill or grill pan until cheese is melted , about 1-2 minutes per side
4. Serve with the cilantro pesto

title: turmeric orange ginger infused rice
steps:
1. Take cup diced dried mango in a small cup and add 1 tablespoon thawed frozen orange juice concentrate
2. Add enough very warm , but not hot , water to cover
3. Let sit to plump and infuse mango with orange juice
4. Meanwhile , melt butter over low-medium heat in 2 quart saucepan , but do not brown
5. Add garlic and ginger to butter and let combine until entire mixture is no longer raw and cooked to infuse the butter
6. Do not brown
7. Drain mango , take juice and pour into measuring cup and add water to equal 1 cup
8. Add liquid to saucepan and bring to a boil
9. Add rice , salt , cinnamon and pepper and turmeric
10. Cover and simmer about 15 minutes til rice is tender and all liquid is absorbed
11. Remove from heat , covered
12. Then add macerated mango , fluffing with a fork
13. Recover
14. Before serving , sprinkle with freshly minced mint and pine nuts
15. Refluff
16. Taste for seasoning , and adjust to taste
17. Drizzle with extra virgin olive oil and serve
18. Enjoy

title: triple decker strawberry cake
steps:
1. Beat cake mix and next 7 ingredients at low speed with an electric mixer for 1 minute
2. Scrape down sides and beat at medium speed 2 minutes more , stopping to scrape sides if needed
3. Strawberries should be well blended into batter
4. Pour batter into 3 greased and floured 9 inch round pans
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 23 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly pressed
6. Cool in pans on wire racks for 10 minutes
7. Remove from pans , cool completely on wire racks
8. Spread strawberry buttercream frosting between layers and on top and sides of cake
9. Garnish if desired
10. Strawberry buttercream frosting: beat butter at medium speed with an electric mixer for 20 seconds or until fluffy
11. Add the powdered sugar and chopped strawberries , beating at low speed until creamy

title: very good dip
steps:
1. Combine ingredients
2. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve
3. Enjoy with tortilla chips or frito's

title: fried mushrooms  onions and peppers
steps:
1. Put 1 to 1 1 / 2 tablespoons bacon grease in the bottom of a medium fry pan , over medium heat
2. Once grease has melted , add mushrooms and onion
3. Cook over medium heat until onion is translucent , and mushrooms have given up most of their liquid , stirring approximately every 5 minutes
4. About 20 minutes prior to eating , add the pepper and continue to cook stiring every 4 to 5 minutes

title: cream cheese pinwheels
steps:
1. Soften cream cheese
2. Mix in the powdered ranch dressing
3. Add the pimentos , black olives and the jalapeos
4. Spread evenly over the flour tortillas using a rubber spatula
5. Roll tightly
6. Cover and chill for about one hour
7. Slice into pinwheels

title: mincemeat apple pie
steps:
1. Make or buy a double pie crust
2. Line plate with crust
3. Pour mixture into crust
4. Top with the other crust
5. Make slits in top crust
6. Bake at 450f for 15 minutes
7. Reduce heat to 350f for 30 minutes

title: better than dad s clam casino
steps:
1. Saute the first six ingredients in olive oil until softened but not browned
2. Steam clams in batches and remove as they just begin to open
3. Allow to cool and reserve clam broth
4. Remove clams from shells and save half of each shell
5. Process clams with a little broth in a food processor until a little chunky
6. Combine clams with first six ingredients and add 1 cup of mixed cheeses , mix well
7. Add breadcrumbs , mixing completely until it holds together like a stuffing
8. If it seems a little dry add more clam broth
9. Fill clam shells with this mixture and bake at 350 degrees until golden brown
10. Serve immediately and enjoy !

title: microwaved raspberry sauce
steps:
1. In a small jug or bowl mix the sugar with the custard powder or cornflour
2. Stir in the water or wine and microwave on high for 2 mins approx or until it boils and has thickened
3. Stir , then leave to stand for 2 minutes
4. Stir in the fresh or thawed raspberries
5. Add the brandy or rum , if desired , and cover while sauce cools
6. Serve either warm or cold as suggested in the introduction

title: shrimp oreganato
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Drain and keep warm
3. While pasta is cooking , heat olive oil in a large skillet
4. Add garlic and oregano and saute over medium heat for 2-3 minutes
5. Add shrimp and saute until nearly done
6. Add lime juice , stir well , and bring to a boil
7. Add cheese and stir until melted
8. Continue to cook until sauce is slightly thickened
9. Toss warm pasta with a little olive oil
10. Pour shrimp and sauce over pasta and mix well
11. Serve topped with additional grated cheese

title: creamy turkey tetrazzini
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Melt butter in saute pan
3. Add onion , celery , pepper , salt , carrots , and mushrooms
4. Saute until vegetables are tender
5. Add flour and stir until vegetables are coated
6. Add wine , and stir quickly until flour is absorbed
7. Gradually add broth , stirring constantly
8. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes , stirring frequently
9. Remove from heat
10. Add 1 / 2 cup parmesan cheese and the neufchatel cheese , stirring until cheese melts
11. Add the peas , turkey and pasta
12. Stir until blended
13. Coat a casserole with non-stick spray and transfer mixture to the casserole
14. Combine breadcrumbs with 1 / 2 cup parmesan cheese
15. Sprinkle mixture evenly over the top of the casserole
16. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes until lightly browned
17. Let rest for 15 minutes before serving

title: peach butter with cardamom
steps:
1. Cook all ingredients in a heavy saucepan over medium heat until peach butter thickens , about 20 minutes
2. Store , tightly covered , in refrigerator
3. Microwave instructions: cook all ingredients on high , uncovered for 10 minutes or until peach butter thickens
4. To remove peach skins: dip peaches in boiling water and then in cold water
5. Peel

title: kid friendly cheesy nachos
steps:
1. Spread chips in a single layer on a microwave-safe plate
2. Drizzle taco sauce over chips
3. Sprinkle generous amount of cheese evenly over chips
4. Add a few black olive slices
5. Microwave , uncovered for 30-60 seconds or until cheese melts
6. Serve with side of sour cream for dipping

title: diane s fresh apple cake with caramel glaze
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a bundt pan or tube pan and coat with cinnamon-sugar mixture
3. Mix apples , eggs and oil with an electric mixer
4. Add the flour , sugar , baking soda and cinnamon
5. Mix well
6. Pour into pan and bake about 1 hour or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
7. Allow cake to cool in pan for at least 10 minutes
8. Invert onto a cake plate
9. To prepare glaze
10. Combine butter , brown sugar and milk in a medium saucepan , bring to a boil and cook for 1 minute
11. Spoon over cake , allow to cool before serving , enjoy

title: white bean dip
steps:
1. Place first 8 ingredients in a food processor , and process until smooth
2. Top with tomato and onions

title: strawberry rhubarb cobbler
steps:
1. In 3-qt saucepan , combine strawberries and rhubarb
2. Cook over medium heat until mixture comes to a full boil
3. Reduce heat to low
4. Cover , continue cooking 5 minutes
5. Stir in lemon juice
6. In small bowl , combine 1 cup sugar and cornstarch
7. Stir into fruit mixture
8. Cook over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until mixture thickens and just comes to a boil
9. Boil 1 minute
10. Cool
11. Heat over to 350
12. In large bowl , combine flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
13. Cut in butter until crumbly
14. In medium bowl , combine all remaining cake ingredients
15. Beat with wire whisk until smooth
16. Stir sour cream mixture into flour mixture just until moistened
17. Spread half of batter on bottom of greased 13x9x2 aluminum baking pan
18. Spread with cooled fruit mixture
19. Drop remaining batter by spoonfuls over fruit filling
20. Sprinkle with sugar and sliced almonds
21. Bake for 55 to 70 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
22. Serve warm or cool with half-and-half or ice cream

title: baked fish with sour cream topping
steps:
1. If using frozen hake , defrost and dry with kitchen towels
2. Lightly season the fish fillets with salt and peper and arrange in a greased oven dish
3. Combine the sour cream , potato crisps , garlic , cheese , chives and paprika and spread over fish
4. Bake for about 30 minutes at 400 degrees f
5. Garnish with extra chives

title: fudgie wudgies
steps:
1. Combine cocoa , sugar
2. Coffee , cornflour and malted milk in a saucepan
3. Gradually stir in milk and cream
4. Cook , whisking constantly , until thick about 10 minutes
5. Remove from heat , cool slightly
6. Cover surface with plastic wrap to stop skin forming
7. Pour into popsicle molds , insert sticks
8. Freeze till solid overnight

title: arroz al horno  baked spanish rice
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Heat oil in pan on medium
3. Saut pork for 3 minutes
4. Add potato rounds
5. Saute for 3 minutes
6. Add the chickpeas and tomatoes
7. Lower the heat and cook gently for 5-7 minutes
8. Mix in chorizo and rice
9. Stir well
10. Pour in stock and crumbled saffron
11. Bring to boil
12. Place mixture in a casserole dish
13. Cover
14. Place a halved garlic head on top
15. Bake in a medium oven for about 45 minutes
16. Remove garlic head before serving
17. Taste for salt preferences

title: sweet potato and ginger pancakes  can be gluten free
steps:
1. - mix all ingredients together in a medium sized bowl
2. - spoon unto preheated generously oiled pan and press into small patties
3. - cook until lightly browned and flip over
4. Serve and enjoy
5. I enjoyed them on there own but i could see these going really well with maple syrup

title: ellen s easy napa salad
steps:
1. Topping--melt butter in large skillet , brown sesame seeds , almonds , sunflower seeds and ramen noodles until golden brown
2. Drain on paper towels and cool
3. Dressing-- mix sugar , oil , vinegar and soy sauce in small saucepan
4. Cook over medium heat until sugar is disolved
5. Cool
6. Salad-- slice cabbage into ribbons and toss with green onions
7. To serve-- mound salad into bowl , sprinkle on desired amount of topping , and drizzle on desired amount of dressing

title: cherry tomatoes with pesto  gluten free
steps:
1. Wash and dry the tomatoes
2. Using a sharp knife , cut the top of each tomato and scoop out the seeds with a small spoon or melon baller , discard the pulp
3. Put the tomatoes aside on a plate until the pesto is ready
4. To make the pesto- blendd the basil , garlic , pine nuts and olive oil in a food processor- process until smooth
5. Pour the mixture into a smaller bowl and fold in the grated parmesan , extra tasty cheese and seasonings
6. Fill a piping bag with the pesto mixture
7. Using a round nozzle , pipe the pesto into the tomato cups
8. Chill the tomatoes for about an hour before serving
9. Makes approx 30

title: lime coconut fish curry
steps:
1. Rub fish with garam masala and brown on each side in hot oil in a skillet
2. The fish shouldn't cook through
3. Remove from skillet
4. Saute onion and garlic in additional oil in the skillet with the lid on , stirring occasionally , until onions are tender and slightly browned
5. Add pepper , tomato , and more garam masala
6. Cook with the lid on for a minute to "melt" the tomato
7. Add the coconut milk and simmer 5 minutes , stirring often
8. Add the fish and simmer , covered , until cooked through , about 5 minutes longer
9. Squeeze lime juice over fish and sauce
10. Remove the hot pepper
11. Serve over hot cooked rice

title: three berry crisp
steps:
1. Slice the apples and place in greased 2
2. 5 quart baking dish
3. Add strawberries quartered add rhubarb cut in 1 inch length , s
4. Mix together sugar , flour and cinnamon and stir gently through fruit
5. Mix together topping of oats , flour , brown sugar , cinnamon and nutmeg and sprinkle over fruit mixture
6. Melt butter and pour over all
7. Bake at 350 for 1 hour

title: firm polenta
steps:
1. In a large pot bring 4 cups of water to a boil
2. Add the salt and slowly pour in the cornmeal , mixing constantly with a wooden spoon until it is all incorporated
3. Turn the heat to low and cook until it's smooth and no longer grainy
4. Be sure to stir often so that the bottom doesn't burn
5. Spread the warm polenta evenly into a lightly oiled container and allow to cool
6. When cool , cut the polenta into whatever shape you desire
7. Firm polenta can be grilled , baked or fried

title: grandmama s jalapeno jelly
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together except the certo
2. Bring to a rolling boil , stirring often
3. Remove from heat and stir in certo
4. Return to a rolling boil and cook for 1 minute stirring all the while
5. Remove from heat and skim off any foam or seeds on the surface
6. Pour into sterilized jelly jars and seal
7. Store overnight to set
8. Serve

title: cinnamon yogurt
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients
2. Let sit at room temperature for 15 minutes

title: red curry paste  krung gaeng deng
steps:
1. Place chiles in a bowl and cover with hot water
2. Keep chiles submerged for 30 minutes or more
3. Heat a small heavy skillet over medium high heat and dry roast coriander seeds , cumin seed and peppercorns
4. Use a spice grinder to grind the spices together into a powder
5. Mortar and pestle method: place ground spices in mortar , add lemongrass , coriander roots and galangal and pound to a paste
6. Add lime zest to blend
7. Add garlic , shallots and salt and pound to a smooth paste
8. Transfer to a bowl and set aside
9. Drain chiles , place in mortar , and pound to a paste
10. When chiles are fairly smooth , add shrimp paste and pound together
11. Add reserved spice paste and pound together
12. Blender method: chop coriander roots , galangal , garlic and shallots fairly fine
13. With blender running , add to blender
14. Add spices , lemongrass , lime zest , salt and shrimp paste and continue to blend until you have a paste
15. It may be necessary to stop and scrape down sides of blender
16. Add a bit of chile soaking water if mixture seems very dry
17. Drain chiles , reserving liquid
18. Add to blender with enough soaking liquid to blend into a thick paste
19. Store in refrigerator or i freeze in an ice cube tray and transfer to a freezer bag when frozen

title: easter sunday cheesecake
steps:
1. Make crust: mix together melted margarine , sugar , and graham cracker crumbs in 9x13 pan with fork to cover bottom evenly
2. Press down to form crust
3. Bake at 350 for 8 minutes
4. While crust is baking , make filling: beat cream cheese , eggs , sugar , vanilla , and lemon juice on high until whipped
5. Pour over crust
6. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes
7. Cool completely
8. Make topping: mix sour cream , sugar , and vanilla well
9. Pour on top of cheesecake
10. Bake at 400 for 5 minutes
11. Cool 6-8 hours or overnight
12. Make sauce: add enough water to reserved berry juice to make 3 / 4 cup of juice
13. Combine sugar and cornstarch in a 2-cup measuring cup
14. Mix well
15. Stir in juice and lemon juice
16. Microwave on high for 3-5 minutes , until thick
17. Stir occasionally
18. Stir in fruit
19. Cool completely
20. Pour over cheesecake and serve

title: smoky chili joes
steps:
1. Heat large nonstick skillet over med-high
2. Coat pan with cooking spray
3. Add beef to pan and cook 4 min til browned , stirring to crumble
4. Add onion and garlic to pan
5. Cook 2 min stirring frequently
6. Add cumin , chili powder , and chipotle
7. Cook 30 seconds
8. Stir in ketchup , beans and tomatoes , cook 6 min or til slightly thickened
9. Season with salt and pepper
10. Spoon about 2 / 3 c beef mixture over bottom buns , top with cheese and pickles
11. Top with remaining buns

title: strawberry orange banana smoothie
steps:
1. Put 1 / 2 cup orange juice in blender
2. Add strawberries and banana
3. Blend until smooth , adding up to 1 / 2 cup additional orange juice if necessary to obtain desired consistency
4. Serve
5. Makes enough for 1 large smoothie or 2 small smoothies

title: shrimp elegante
steps:
1. Saute onion in butter until golden
2. Add shrimp and mushrooms and saute until shrimp are pink
3. Combine salt , pepper , chili sauce and water
4. Add to shrimp mixture and bring to a boil
5. Stir in rice , cover and simmer for 5 minutes
6. Combine sour cream and flour
7. Add to the shrimp and rice mixture and heat gently
8. Divide between plates , garnish with chives and parsley and serve

title: almond halibut fillets  you can also use sole or perch
steps:
1. In a microwave-safe bowl , combine the butter and almonds
2. Heat , uncovered , on high for 2 minutes , or until almonds are golden brown
3. Place fillets in a greased microwave-safe 11-in x 7-in x 2-in dish
4. Top with almond mixture
5. Combine the lemon juice , dill , salt and pepper
6. Drizzle over fish
7. Sprinkle with paprika
8. Cover and microwave on high for 4 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork

title: kittencal s 60  whole wheat rolls
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , heat the 1 / 2 cup whole milk with 3 tbsp sugar , salt and 4 tablespoons butter until the milk is warmed and the butter is almost melted set aside and cool until lukewarm
2. Proof the yeast with 1 tsp sugar in the 1-1 / 4 cups warm water for 10 minutes until foamy
3. Using a heavy-duty mixer , fitted with the kneader attachment , to the bowl add in 3 cups whole wheat flour and 1 cup white flour with warm milk / butter mixture and the proofed yeast
4. Mix for 2 minutes , then start adding in more flour if needed to create a soft smooth dough that holds around the kneader blade , knead for 5-8 minutes
5. Remove the dough and let rest 10 minutes on the counter , covered with a clean tea towel
6. After 10 minutes , lightly knead the dough into a ball , and then place in a well-oiled bowl
7. Cover with plastic wrap and let rise in a warm place for about 1 hour or until doubled in size
8. Remove and punch down dough
9. Shape into 12 balls
10. Cover and rise again for 30-35 minutes
11. Brush the tops and sides gently using a pastry brush with the egg / water mix , sprinkle with sesame seeds
12. Bake for 25-30 minutes , or until they are a deep golden brown , and sound hollow when tapped

title: splenda easy pumpkin pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In alarge mixing bowl , stir together splenda granulated sweetener , molasses , salt , and cinnamon
3. When these ingredients are well mixed , stir in the egg whites followed by the pumpkin and evaporated milk
4. Pour into the pie crust
5. Bake for 1 1 / 4 to 1 1 / 2 hours in the preheated oven , or until a toothpick inserted into the pie comes out clean
6. Cool then top with whipped topping before serving

title: chicken asado
steps:
1. Place chicken in a large pot
2. Add all ingredients
3. Bring to boil cover and simmer for 1 hour or until tender
4. Serve over top of potatoes or rice

title: lobster bisque with armagnac
steps:
1. Boil water in a large stock pot
2. Twist claws and tails off lobsters and reserve bodies
3. Add claws and tails to the boiling water
4. Simmer tails for 3 minutes , and claws until they turn bright red all over , about 8 minutes
5. Remove lobster pieces as they finish cooking and place in a large bowl
6. Reserve the cooking liquid
7. Let the lobster cool slightly
8. Crack claws and remove the meat from the tails and claws , cover and refrigerate
9. Twist legs off the lobster and cut the bodies into large pieces
10. Heat olive oil in a large enameled cast-iron casserole
11. Add fennel , celery , carrot , onion , leek and garlic and cook over moderately high heat , stirring frequently , until the vegetables are browned , about 8 minutes
12. Add legs and body pieces to the casserole and cook over high heat , stirring , until shells start to brown , about 8 minutes
13. Sprinkle flour evenly over the shells and stir well
14. Add tomato paste and cook , stirring , until it starts to brown , about 3 minutes
15. Stir in wine and armagnac and simmer for 3 minutes
16. Stir in thyme , bay leaf , saffron and the reserved lobster cooking liquid until smooth
17. Simmer broth over low heat , skimming occasionally , for about 1 1 / 2 hours
18. Strain broth and press on the solids to extract as much liquid as you can
19. Return broth to the casserole
20. Add heavy cream to the casserole and simmer for 5 minutes
21. Season the bisque with salt and pepper
22. Cut reserved tail and claw meat into 1" pieces
23. Add the meat to the simmering bisque and cook until just heated through , about 1 minute
24. Add a splash of armagnac to 8 soup plates
25. Ladle the lobster bisque into the soup plates , garnish with the parsley and serve

title: core irish beef stew
steps:
1. 1
2. Place beef , onion soup , tomato soup , soup can of water , salt , pepper , carrots , horse radish and potatoes in slow cooker
3. 2
4. Cover
5. Cook on low in yor crock pot for 6 hours
6. 3
7. Add peas and 1 / 4 cup water
8. Cover
9. Cook on low 1 more hour

title: strawberry  rhubarb  orange  honey jam
steps:
1. Dice rhubarb and place in pan with a little water over medium heat and cook until tender
2. Slice strawberries in quarters and then mash slightly and add to pan with rhubarb
3. Add lemon juice and bring mixture to a boil
4. Reduce eat and cook for about 20-30 minutes
5. Mixture will start to get thick
6. Add orange juice , zest , and cinnamon to pan and stir together
7. Continue cooking
8. In separate bowl , combine honey and pectin
9. I use sage honey , but clover would be good as well
10. You want to use a light colored honey
11. Add honey / pectin to the jam mixture and stir
12. Cook for about 5 more minutes
13. Remove from heat and fill jars to 1 / 4" of top
14. Recipe makes eight 8oz
15. Jars
16. Wipe rims clean and screw on 2-piece lids
17. Submerge sealed jars into hot water at 200 degrees for 10 minutes
18. You will hear a "pop" sound once jars are removed from water - that is when the lids are sealed
19. Let cool on your kitchen counter

title: red   whites
steps:
1. Cream together butter , cream cheese , and sugar
2. Add in vanilla and mix well
3. Gradually stir in flour
4. Shape dough into 1 / 2 tb sized balls
5. Use thumb to make an indentation in the center of each cookie
6. Place berry or cherry half into the indentation
7. Bake cookies for 12-18 minutes at 350
8. Do not overbake and brown

title: tingle mints
steps:
1. Melt butter
2. Place powder sugar in bowl along with flavoring and melted butter
3. Knead with hands until mixture is in a solid non-sticky dough mixture
4. If powder sugar is left in bowl , add very little water to mix in mixture
5. Shape and enjoy

title: chinese takeout pineapple fried rice
steps:
1. Break up the cold cooked rice into smaller clumps
2. Heat a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat until a bead of water sizzles and evaporates on contact
3. Add oil and swirl to coat bottom
4. Add shallots and bell pepper
5. Stir-fry until fragrant and edges of shallots begin to crisp , about 1 minute
6. Move shallots and bell peppers to the side , creating a well in the middle
7. Toss in rice
8. Break up remaining clumps with a spatula
9. Stir in oyster sauce , soy sauce and rice wine
10. Stir-fry until rice starts to turn golden , about 2 minutes
11. Add pineapple and ham
12. Give everything a few quick stirs so that the ham and pineapple are heated through
13. Transfer to a large bowl or plate and serve hot

title: carrot horseradish casserole
steps:
1. Boil carrots in water until just tender reserving cooking liquid
2. Mix mayonnaise , chopped onion , 2 tablespoons horseradish or up to the entire bottle to taste , fresh ground black pepper and a bit of the carrot cooking liquid to make a sauce
3. Fold cooked carrots into sauce and pour into baking dish sprayed with non-stick spray
4. Combine crushed crackers with melted butter to make topping
5. Sprinkle topping onto casserole and bake uncovered in 350 degree oven for about 30-45 minutes or until bubbley and golden brown

title: sweet italian  orzo   veggie soup
steps:
1. In a large soup pot or dutch oven , crumble the sausage and cook over medium heat until no longer raw
2. Drain off all fat
3. Add onion and garlic to pot and cook until soft , add fennel and cook for another minute
4. Stir in the tomates , water , orzo , and bullion and chicken broth
5. Heat to boiling and then stir in basil , green beans and carrots
6. Cook an additional 25 to 35 minutes until veggies are soft
7. Serve with bread of some sort !
8. Enjoy !

title: heart healthy salmon quesadillas
steps:
1. Heat 1 teaspoons of the olive oil in a medium nonstick skillet over medium heat
2. Place the kale in the skillet and cook until just wilted , about 4 to 5 minutes
3. Season with the kosher salt or sea salt
4. Remove the kale from the skillet and set aside
5. In a small bowl , mix together the shredded cheeses
6. Set aside
7. Heat the remaining teaspoon of olive oil in the same skillet over medium heat
8. Place one tortilla in the bottom of the skillet
9. Top half of the tortilla with 1 / 4 cup of the kale , one-quarter of the flaked salmon and 1 / 4 cup of the shredded cheese mixture
10. Fold the other half of the tortilla over the filling and cook for one minute , pressing down lightly with the back of a spatula
11. Using tongs , gently flip the quesadilla over and cook another minute or two , until lightly browned
12. Repeat with remaining three tortillas and fillings
13. Cut each quesadilla into three triangles
14. Serve immediately with guacamole , tomato salsa and non-fat sour cream , if desired

title: slow cooker beef and beer
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except beer in slow cooker
2. Toss until meat is well coated with ingredients
3. Pour beer over meat and stir
4. Place lid on cooker and cook on high for 5-6 hours
5. Remove bay leaf
6. Serve over noodles , rice , or mashed potatoes

title: cranberry cream punch
steps:
1. Prepare cranberry ice ring one day in advance
2. Cranberry cream punch: in punch bowl , combine sweetened condensed milk , cranberry juice concentrate ,
3. Just before serving , add club soda / ginger ale and ice ring
4. Cranberry ice ring: combine cranberry juice cocktail and water
5. In 1-1 / 2-quart ring mold , pour 1 / 2 cup cranberry liquid
6. Arrange cranberries and lime slices or mint leaves in mold and freeze
7. Add remaining 3 cups cranberry liquid to mold
8. Freeze overnight

title: roasted peppers with basil
steps:
1. Quarter the peppers
2. Place them under a hot broiler , shiny side up , until the skin blisters and turns black
3. Allow to cool
4. Tear off the papery skin , and remove and discard the stalk and seeds
5. Cut the flesh into strips and place the strips in a shallow dish
6. Sprinkle with vinegar , oil , salt , and black pepper
7. Tear the basil leaves and scatter them over the top
8. Mix the ingredients lightly together
9. Serve at once , or keep in a cool place for later
10. If served later , mix again , and check the seasoning

title: onion cheddar quiche
steps:
1. Saute onions in butter
2. Beat eggs & add milk , salt , pepper , basil and onions
3. Divide cheese in half , and spread evenly in bottom of each piecrust
4. Pour milk mixture over cheese in both pies
5. Bake at 400 degrees for 35-40 minutes
6. Allow to set 5 minutes before serving

title: the best broccoli salad
steps:
1. Mix all dressing ingredients
2. Combine dressing with all salad ingredients
3. You can also add rasins and more cheese if you like
4. You can also do it all in advance , just mix in the dressing before serving

title: chocolate mint crinkle cookies
steps:
1. In a small bowl , mix together flour , cocoa , baking powder , and salt
2. In a large bowl , whisk together sugar , oil , eggs , and extracts until well blended
3. Stir dry mixture into wet mixture until just combined
4. Cover bowl and refrigerate for two hours
5. Heat oven to 350 degrees f
6. Mix powdered sugar and green sugar
7. Roll cookie dough into 1 inch balls , roll in sugar mixture , and place 1 1 / 2 inches apart on parchment-lined cookies sheets
8. Bake for 11-13 minutes
9. While baking , unwrap kisses
10. When cookies are done baking , immediately press a kiss in each cookie
11. Place cookie sheet in refridgerator or freezer
12. When kisses are set , remove from refridgerator and store in an airtight container
13. Enjoy !

title: oatmeal  fruit and nut bread
steps:
1. Combine oats and buttermilk
2. Mix well and set aside for a few minutes
3. Combine dry ingredients , except for the sugar , and mix well
4. Add brown sugar to oat mixture and mix well , pressing out any lumps
5. Add buttermilk mixture and vanilla to dry ingredients and stir just until dry ingredients are moistened
6. Stir in fruit and nuts
7. Put batter into 2 1-lb loaf pans that have been sprayed with nonstick spray
8. Bake at 325 for 25-30 minutes
9. Cool in pan for 5-10 minutes , then remove from pans to cool on wire rack

title: oven roasted tomato sauce
steps:
1. Preheat the oven 400f
2. Slice tomatoes in half , set aside
3. Pour the olive oil onto a large baking sheet and spread it around the sheet
4. Sprinkle evenly the garlic , herbs , sugar , salt and pepper over the oil
5. Place the tomatoes cut side down onto the baking sheet
6. Roast for about 30-40 minutes , or until the skins start to lift from the tomatoes
7. Allow to cool
8. Remove the skins and put the sauce into a large bowl and break up the flesh with a fork
9. Reheat sauce if using immediately

title: easy baked rigatoni with ham  mushrooms and feta
steps:
1. Set oven to 375 degrees
2. Butter a 13 x 9-inch baking dish
3. Cook the pasta in a large pot of boiling water with 2-3 tablespoons salt until just firm-tender
4. Drain and then place in the baking dish
5. In a bowl , mix together ham , tomatoes , drained mushrooms , feta cheese , mozzarella cheese and thyme
6. Pour the cream over and mix to combine
7. Season with salt and pepper
8. Transfer to the baking dish
9. Sprinkle with more parmesan cheese on top if desired
10. Cover with foil and bake for 15 minutes
11. Remove from the oven and stir the pasta to coat with the cheeses
12. Cover and place bake in oven for about 30 minutes longer

title: ca sizzles tijuana torte
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Brown ground beef with onion
3. Drain grease
4. Add tomato sauce , stewed tomatoes , salsa , green chiles and taco seasoning to the meat and mix well
5. Tear tortillas into pieces and lay in bottom of 9x9-inch dish
6. Spoon 1 / 3 of emat sauce on top of tortillas and sprinkle with 1 / 3 of the cheese
7. Layer 2 more times with tortillas , meat sauce and cheese
8. Top with remaining cheddar cheese , covering entire top
9. Bake 30-45 minutes
10. Cool 15 minutes before serving

title: persian style onion soup
steps:
1. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil , the onions and some seasoning
2. Cover and seat for 12-15 minutes until the onions are soft , lifting the lid and stirring occasionally
3. Add the spices , dried mint and remaining oil , then stir in the flour , cook , stirring frequently , for 3-5 minutes
4. Gradually pour in stock , whisking as you do so to prevent any lumps forming
5. When it has all been added , drop in the cinnamon stick and simmer over a low heat , partially covered with the lid , for 30-40 minutes
6. Stir in the lemon juice and sugar , then taste and adjust the seasoning
7. Discard the cinnamon stick
8. Ladle the soup into warm bowls and scatter over the herbs to serve

title: sausage and beef casserole
steps:
1. Heat skillet to medium heat
2. Brown sausage well , when finished put the sausage into a large casserole dish
3. Brown the stew beef and add to the sausage
4. Saut onion and garlic till tender
5. Add green peppers cook additional minute
6. Add into meat
7. Stir-fry potatoes a little and add to meat
8. Add beans , bouillon and seasonings
9. Stir well
10. Cover and bake 350 1 hour and 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender

title: easy smoked chicken
steps:
1. Soak your hickory chips for 6 hours
2. Split the chickens if you didn't have your butcher do it for you
3. Combine the salt , paprika , and pepper
4. Stir well
5. Sprinkle over the chicken on both sides
6. Combine the vegetable oil , vinegar , and hot sauce , stirring well
7. Set chicken and oil mixture aside
8. Prepare a fire in your grill
9. Let burn until the coals are gray
10. Rake the coals to one end of the grill
11. Put an old disposable foil pan on the other end of the grill
12. Pour water in it to make steam and keep your chicken nice and moist
13. Sprinkle the hickory chips over the hot coals
14. Place the chicken on the side of the grill over the pan with water in it
15. Place the lid on the grill
16. Grill over indirect heat 3 to 3 1 / 2 hours , or until done
17. Turn the chicken occasionally
18. Add hickory chips as needed to keep the smoke going
19. You may also need to throw a few pieces of charcoal in it to keep the fire going nice and hot
20. Baste the chicken with the oil mixture during the last hour of grilling time
21. Enjoy !

title: olive garden caprese flatbread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Dice tomatoes into small pieces and transfer to a mixing bowl
3. Add chopped garlic , salt , pepper , of chopped basil , and 4 tbsp of extra virgin olive oil
4. Set aside and allow to marinate for 10 minutes
5. Flatten pizza dough into pan as indicated on package
6. Drizzle with extra virgin olive oil and brush it over the surface
7. Bake in oven at 350f for 10 minutes on center rack
8. Remove from oven and allow to cool , about 2 minutes
9. Cut garlic clove in half and rub , cut side down , onto the surface of the bread
10. Allow bread to cool completely , about 10 more minutes
11. Increase oven temperature to 450f
12. Combine mayonnaise and garlic powder in a mixing bowl
13. Evenly spread onto the surface of the bread
14. Top with shredded mozzarella to evenly cover surface
15. Drain the caprese mixture and spread the bread mixture evenly over the bread
16. Sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese
17. Return flatbread to oven for 5-7 more minutes or until golden , crisp and bubbly
18. Garnish with remaining chopped basil
19. Serve immediately and enjoy !

title: chocolate peanut butter ice cream
steps:
1. In a heavy saucepan , over medium heat , whisk together the first four ingredients , milk to salt , and cook , stirring constantly , until thickened
2. Turn off heat
3. Using a small ladle or spoon , add about 2 tablespoons of the milk mixture into beaten egg , whisking egg mixture constantly as the hot liquid is added to prevent the egg from clumping up
4. I do this a dribble at a time
5. Whisking milk mixture constantly , pour egg mixture back into the pot in a very slow , thin stream
6. When egg is completely whisked in , turn heat back on , to medium
7. Whisking constantly , cook egg mixture for just two minutes , then turn off heat and remove pot from burner
8. Place the chocolate peanut butter in a small bowl and whisk about half the milk mixture in and combine well , then add this mixture back into the pot , combining all well
9. Scrape into a bowl , cover with plastic wrap , and refrigerate until completely cold
10. After mixture is cold , remove from fridge and whisk in the light cream
11. The peanut butter mixture will be very stiff so it's slow-going at first , but bear with it as it will all come together
12. Once the peanut butter mixture is completely combined with the light cream , whisk in the heavy cream and the vanilla
13. Prepare ice cream according to the directions that came with your ice cream maker
14. I let my cuisinart ice cream maker run for about 25 minutes and that worked well
15. Freeze for several hours to harden
16. This mixture yields slightly less than one quart

title: bruschetta w  fresh basil
steps:
1. Mix first 4 ingredients together
2. Lightly toast 1 / 2 inch slices of bread
3. Spoon mixture onto toast & enjoy

title: washday peach cobbler
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Put undrained peaches in 9x12 baking dish with the margarine
3. Place in oven
4. Meanwhile , in small bowl , mix sugar , flour , milk , baking powder and salt
5. Pour over melted margarine and peaches
6. Do not stir
7. Place back in 350 degree oven and bake 1 hour or until golden brown

title: bistec de palomilla  cuban fried steak
steps:
1. Pound the steaks on both sides , using a mallet , until 1 / 4-inch thin
2. Season with garlic , lime juice , salt & pepper
3. Allow to marinate at least 1 hour , refrigerated
4. Remove the steaks from marinade & pat dry
5. In a large frying pan , heat the oil over medium heat until very hot
6. Brown each steak for 2 to 3 minutes on each side
7. Transfer the steaks to a serving platter & keep warm
8. Add the marinade & onion to the pan & cook until the onion is slightly wilted , 3 to 4 minutes
9. Garnish the steaks with the onion & parsley & serve immediately

title: tomato and fresh mozzarella salad with basil
steps:
1. Take the skin off the tomatoes - a huge difference
2. If the skin is tough to come off , i cut the skin slightly and pour hot water over them and keep the tomatoes covered for a couple of minutes
3. Slice or cut the tomatoes in as big pieces as you like them
4. Cut the mozarella into small cubes
5. Mix the tomatoes , mozarella , basill and season it with salt and pepper
6. Drizzle with olive oil

title: homemade mustard
steps:
1. In a microwave safe bowl mix the evaporated milk , vinigar and eggs
2. Mix together the flour , mustard , salt and sugar and add to the wet ingredients
3. Mix well
4. Place in microwave and cook for 2 minutes on high
5. Stir or whisk until smooth then place back into the microwave and cook for another 2 minutes repeat until thickened this will take 3 or 4 times
6. 1 / 4 teaspoon curry or cayenne can be added
7. Pour into hot jars that can be sealed
8. Once open store in fridge

title: puff pastry quiche lorraine
steps:
1. Set oven to 425 degrees
2. Prepare a 9-inch pie plate
3. In a frypan , melt butter and saute onion and garlic until soft
4. In a large bowl , combine eggs , whipping cream and spices
5. Beat until very well combined
6. Roll out pastry to fit the pie plate
7. Sprinkle the onion / garlic mixture into the bottom of the pie shell , then chopped bacon then top with grated cheese
8. Carefully pour the egg mixture on top
9. Bake at 425 degrees for 15 minutes
10. Reduce heat to 300 degrees , and bake for about another 35-40 minutes , or until a knife inserted in the middle comes out clean

title: strawberry milkshake
steps: 1. Shake with ice and strain into glass

title: zuppa di broccoli  broccoli soup
steps:
1. In saute pan , saute garlic with oil until brown
2. Add broccoli and tomatoes and stir
3. Cool for 1 minute , then add wine and broth
4. Bring to boil 2 to 3 minutes
5. Serve immediately
6. Add basil for garnish

title: spammed sushi  musubi
steps:
1. Slice the spam into about 10 slices
2. Dissolve the sugar in the soysauce and oyster sauce mixture
3. Marinate the spam slices in the mixture for about 5 minutes
4. Heat a tiny bit of oil in a frying pan over medium high heat , cook the spam for about 2 minutes on each side , until lightly browned
5. Ideas:
6. 1
7. Sandwich the spam between 2 "patties" of sushi rice , then wrap a ribbon of nori around the center

title: bbq wasabi onions
steps:
1. Slice or dice the amount of onions that you would normally use for the meal you are preparing
2. Heat some oil in a skillet , fry pan or on the barbeque , or just heat the pan
3. Throw in the onions , add a teaspoon of hot wasabi paste per cup of onion
4. Stir the paste into the onions while they are cooking
5. Eventually the paste will disappear and cook the onions until they are at the point where you like them
6. Serve with whatever you like

title: tortilla ham pinwheels
steps:
1. In a small mixing bowl , combine the cream cheese and salad dressing mix
2. Spread over one side of each tortilla
3. Top with ham
4. Roll up
5. Refrigerate for 1 hour
6. Cut into 1-in
7. Slices

title: tuscan spice and almond biscotti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Finely grind 1 / 3 cup of the toasted almonds in a food processor
3. In a medium-sized bowl , combine the ground almonds , flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt , cinnamon , and allspice
4. In a mixing bowl , cream together sugar and butter
5. Add honey , egg , vanilla extract and almond extract to the creamed mixture
6. Gradually blend in dry mixture and remaining 2 / 3 cup almonds
7. On a well floured surface , shape dough into two logs
