8. Transfer logs to a baking sheet or baking stone , leaving space between the two logs
9. Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes , or until firm and lightly brown
10. Cool logs on a wire rack for at least 5 minutes
11. Cut logs into 3 / 4-inch slices
12. Place slices in a single layer on the baking sheet , leaving space around each slice
13. Continue baking about 10-15 minutes or until desired crispness
14. Cool completely on a wire rack

title: stir grilled fish tacos
steps:
1. Put halibut chunks in a bowl
2. Sprinkle with cajun seasoning and toss to coat
3. Transfer halibut to a well-greased grill wok
4. Stir-grill over hot coals for 8-10 minutes , tossing while cooking
5. In a big bowl , add cabbages
6. Mix well
7. In a smaller bowl , add vinegar , sour cream , green onions , and salt
8. Stir to combine
9. Add dressing mixture to cabbage
10. Toss to coat well
11. For each tortilla , fill with 1 / 3 cup cabbage mixture and 4-5 chunks of halibut
12. Fold up and serve with lemon wedges , salsa , tartar sauce , guacamole , and a pitcher of margaritas

title: honey mustard dip
steps: 1. Stir together and serve right away or chill until needed

title: apple almond pie
steps:
1. Prepare pie crust for filled one-crust pie using 9-inch pan
2. Flute edge
3. Heat oven to 375f
4. Reserve 2 t sugar
5. In medium bowl , combine remaining sugar and corn starch
6. Add eggs , beating well to combine
7. Stir in butter , corn syrup and almond extract
8. Mix in apples and almonds
9. Pour into pie crust-lined pan
10. If desired , garnish with apple slices overlapped in a circle around edge of pie
11. Sprinkle center with almonds
12. Sprinkle reserved sugar over top
13. Bake at 375f for 50 minutes or until center of pie is set
14. Cool completely on wire rack
15. Store in refrigerator

title: thai swordfish wraps
steps:
1. Chile garlic sauce :
2. Combine sugar , water , vinegar , and salt in a saucepan
3. Bring to a boil and reduce heat and simmer until it coats the back of a wooden spoon , about 3 minutes
4. Cool sauce to room temperature , then stir in remaining ingredients
5. Chill until ready to serve
6. Preheat grill to high
7. Make rub:
8. Pulse sugar and spices in a coffee-grinder until coarsely ground
9. Prepare fish:
10. Slice fillets in half crosswise
11. Brush the fillets with oil , season with salt , then pat the rub on both sides to coat
12. Don't move the fillets around too much or the rub will stick to the grates--not the fish
13. Grill fillets about 4 minutes per side
14. Remove the fillets from the grill , peel off the skin and cut each into 3 strips
15. The platter:
16. Moving clockwise starting at 12 o'clock:
17. 12 boston lettuce or bibb lettuce leaves
18. 3 oz cooked vermicelli
19. Sprig of cilantro
20. Shredded carrots
21. Bowl of bean sprouts
22. Lime wedges
23. Leaves of fresh basil
24. Grilled swrodfish
25. And a bowl with cucumber half-moons
26. Serve with chile garlic sauce in several bowls around the platter

title: harvest time pumpkin   oatmeal muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees and line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper cases
2. Combine dry ingredients in a large bowl
3. In another , medium bowl , combine the pumpkin , milk , oil and egg , blending well
4. Stir pumpkin mixture into dry ingredients until the dry ingredients are just moist
5. Fill muffin cases evenly and bake for 22-25 minutes

title: soy garlic marinade  for steaks
steps:
1. Whisk together marinade ingredients
2. Place steak in marinating dish and pour marinade over top
3. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours
4. Before grilling steaks remove from marinade and discard marinade

title: chilled fruit cups
steps:
1. In large bowl prepare pineapple juice concentrate according to package directions
2. Add orange juice concentrate , water , sugar , lemon juice and fruit
3. Spoon 3 / 4 cupful into each plastic cup
4. Place cups in pan and freeze
5. Remove from freezer 40-50 minutes before serving
6. Or place in microwave for approximately 15-20 seconds prior to serving

title: applesauce bread pudding
steps:
1. Cut bread into 1-2 inch cubes and spread a layer on the bottom of a large glass baking dish
2. In a saucepan , warm the milk and butter together long enough to melt butter
3. Once butter is melted , remove from heat
4. Add brown sugar
5. In a separate bowl whisk together eggs and vanilla untill well mixed and a little foamy / frothy
6. Whisk egg mixture into milk mixture
7. Pour mixture over the first layer of bread cubes , making sure to soak them through
8. Spread applesauce over the soaked bread cubes evenly and sprinkle cinnamon , nutmeg , and raisins
9. Add the rest of the bread cubes and pour remaining mixture over them
10. Sprinkle more cinnamon and raisins
11. Sprinkle with brown sugar and / or drizzle with a little maple syrup
12. Bake on 350 degrees for about 20-35 minutes or until the center is set

title: hot cheesy onion chip dip
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients and put in baking dish
2. Bake at 350 degrees for about 20 minutes , or until bubbly and golden on top
3. Add a few green / red peppers mixed in and sprinkled on top if desired
4. Serve with potato chips and / or anything else dippable- bread sticks , vegetables , flatbread , pita etc

title: heavenly clam dip
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients well
2. Season with salt , pepper , and additional tabasco
3. Best if baked in hollowed out sourdough bread wrapped in foil at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until hot
4. Serve with bread from hollowed out loaf and / or corn chips

title: orange  kumara   tuna salad  21 day wonder diet  day 4
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c / 160c fan-forced
2. Place kumara on oven tray , sprinkle with rind
3. Roast , uncovered , about 20 minutes
4. Cool
5. Combine kumara with remaining ingredients in medium bowl

title: misoyaki glazed salmon
steps:
1. To prepare the glaze , place the sake , soy sauce , miso paste and sugar in the top of a double boiler and cook for about 20 minutes , stirring often until the sugar is well dissolved and the mixture is fragrant
2. Set aside to cool
3. Place the salmon fillets in a glass baking dish and generously coat each fillet with the cooled miso glaze
4. Cover the dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 24 hours
5. Remove the salmon fillets from the miso glaze , quickly rinse under cold water and pat dry with paper towels
6. Pour the canola oil and sesame oil into a large saute pan or skillet and set over medium high heat
7. Carefully add the salmon fillets to the pan and cook for 2 to 3 minutes or until the first side has browned nicely
8. Turn the salmon over , turn down the heat to medium and cook for 3 to 4 minutes longer , or until the salmon flakes easily when pierced with a fork
9. Remove the fillets from the pan , pat with paper towels to remove any excess oil , and transfer to a warm serving plate
10. Using the same paper towls , gently pat the saute pan to remove the excessoil and any burnt bits , but leaving the residual drippings
11. Return the pan to the heat , add 1 / 4 to 1 / 2 cup water and deglaze the pan to create a pan juice
12. Top the salmon fillets with the pan juice
13. Garnish with the sliced scallions

title: paula s eggnog a doodles
steps:
1. Cream butter or margarine and sugar till light and fluffy
2. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each
3. Blend in eggnog and vanilla
4. Add dry ingredients into creamed mixture
5. Form dough into 1 inch balls and roll in sugar with nutmeg added
6. Place balls 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet
7. Bake cookies at 350f for 8 to 9 minutes

title: kimchi or kimchee
steps:
1. Cut cabbage into four sections through the core
2. Starting at the end of the leaves , cut cabbage diagonally back and forth until you reach the core
3. Cut radish into large chunks or into julienne strips
4. Layer cabbage and radish in your sink with the salt
5. Put about 1 / 2 cup salt for every two inches of cabbage
6. Make sure you end with salt
7. Add water to almost cover cabbage
8. Let stand
9. After 1 1 / 2 hours start checking the cabbage by rubbing a piece between your fingers
10. If it's slippery , rinse it and taste it
11. If it's pleasantly salty then it's ready
12. Be sure not to let the cabbage stand too long or it will become too salty and will be inedible
13. Fill the sink with water until it covers the cabbage then fish the cabbage out of the sink
14. Return the cabbage to the sink and rinse it this way two or three times until all the cabbage is thoroughly rinsed
15. Drain cabbage by placing it in large colander or by letting it sit in your unstopped sink
16. Make the pul by mixing the rice flour and water in a small sauce pan and heating to boiling , stirring constantly
17. Let cool
18. If you don't have rice flour you can add water to cooked rice and boil it until the water is very cloudy
19. Use one cup of this water
20. Mix pul and remaining ingredients in very large bowl
21. The amount of red pepper you use should depend on how hot you want your kim chee
22. There are many kinds of fish sauce
23. The one cup measurement is for a thin sauce
24. For thicker sauces , use less sauce
25. Wearing plastic or rubber gloves , begin mixing the cabbage with the sauce
26. Use your hands and mix a little cabbage at a time then push it to the side of the bowl until you have mixed all the cabbage
27. This will help you mix the cabbage and sauce evenly
28. Place kim chee in large containers that have tight fitting lids
29. You can eat the kim chee immediately , but most korean women recommend that you leave it outside of the fridge for one day , then store it in the fridge but wait one week after that before you eat it
30. I can't tell you what the difference is because my husband doesn't wait that long
31. Enjoy

title: filled coffee cake
steps:
1. Filling: 1 / 2 cup brown sugar 1 / 4 cup white sugar 2 tablespoons flour 2-3 tablespoons butter 1 / 2 cup finely chopped nuts 1 1 / 2 teaspoons cinnamon work all ingredients of"filling" together until crumbly
2. Cream together butter , sugar , and eggs
3. Sift dry ingredients together
4. Add alternately with buttermilk , to first mixture
5. Add vanilla
6. Pour half the batter into a greased 9" by 9" pan
7. Top with nut mixture
8. Repeat with other half of batter
9. Bake 350 degrees for 35-40 minutes

title: grandma strattons soft cut out cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar until fluffy
2. Beat eggs and vanilla inches
3. Stir in flour , baking soda , salt
4. Roll out on floured board
5. Bake at 400f for 7 min or until the edges become golden brown
6. Cool and frost

title: cornmeal currant crunch cookies
steps:
1. Position a rack in the middle of the oven
2. Preheat the oven to 350
3. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper
4. In a medium bowl , stir the flour , cornmeal , baking powder and salt together
5. Set aside
6. In a large bowl , using an electric mixer on medium speed , beat the butter , 3 / 4 cup of the sugar , and the lemon zest until smooth and creamy -- and the color has lightened slightly
7. About 1 minute
8. Stop the mixer and scrape down the sides of the bowl as needed during mixing
9. Add the egg yolks and vanilla and mix until blended -- about 1 minute
10. On low speed , add the flour mixture , mixing just until it is incorporated
11. Mix in the currants and chopped pecans
12. Spread the remaining 3 tbls sugar on a large piece of parchment or wax paper
13. Using an ice cream scoop with a 1 / 4 cup capcacity , scoop out portions of dough --
14. Roll each between the palms of your hands into a smooth ball
15. Then roll each ball in the sugar and flatten to about 3 1 / 2" circle
16. And place the cookies about 2" apart on the baking sheets --
17. Press a pecan half into the center of each cookie , if desired
18. Bake one sheet at a time until the bottoms and edges are lightly browned
19. About 15 minutes
20. Cool the cookies for 5 minutes on the baking sheets , then use a wide metal spatula to tansfer them to a wire rack to cool compeltely --
21. The cookies can be stored to a tightly covered container at room temperature for up to 3 days

title: chocolate filled rolls
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Unroll dough from tube of crescent rolls
3. Separate into triangles and place on large ungreased cookie sheet , leaving space between the triangles
4. Place one rounded tablespoon on the wide end of each triangle of dough
5. Roll each triangle up , starting from wide end and making sure to enclose chips with dough
6. Bake rolls 12-15 mins or until browned
7. With wide spatula , immediately transfer rolls to wire rack
8. Cool 10 minutes to serve warm , or cool completely to serve later

title: cinnamon orange
steps:
1. With a sharp knife , remove rind and white pith from oranges
2. Cut each into 5 or 6 slices and arrange on 4 plates
3. Whisk together orange juice and lemon juice , sugar and cinnamon
4. Spoon over the orange

title: mediterranean layered dip
steps:
1. Combine cream cheese and miracle whip
2. Spread on bottom of 9 inch pie plate
3. Top with tomatoes cucumbers and olives
4. Sprinkle with cheese
5. Serve with wedges of pita bread

title: corned beef n  rice pot
steps:
1. In large pot or dutch oven , add rotel tomatoes , bring to boil
2. Add rice and water
3. Bring to a rolling boil for 1min
4. Stir
5. Cover , turn heat to low simmer for 25min
6. In skillet add corned beef , onion and seasonings
7. Be careful of adding salt as the beef is already salted !
8. Lightly'fry' , til onion is soft and corned beef is well heated
9. When rice is done , water should be absorbed and rice soft
10. Stir in corned beef mixture
11. Add pepper , hot sauce to personal taste

title: moroccan delight
steps:
1. Blend until the carrots are shredded , don't pulverize them !
2. Serve very cold in a juice glass with a spoon

title: hearty curried chicken bowl
steps:
1. In a large saucepan heat butter over medium heat
2. Add in onion , pepper flakes carrots and celery
3. Saute for about 4 minutes or until softened
4. Add in garlic and cook 2-3 minutes
5. Add in flour , seasoned salt and curry powder
6. Cook stirring for 2 minutes
7. Add in evaporated milk and chicken broth
8. Bring to a boil stirring constantly until heated through and thickened
9. Season with fresh ground black pepper to taste
10. Add in cooked chicken and rice or potatoes
11. Stir until heated through
12. Ladle into bowls and serve with crusty bread

title: candy topped bars
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine flour and brown sugar
2. Cut in butter unil mixture resembles coarse crumbs
3. Stir in pecans
4. Set aside 1 / 2 cup for topping
5. Press remaining crumb mixture into a greased 9 inch square pan
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 12-15 minutes or until edges are lightly browned
7. In a mixing bowl , beat cream cheese and sugar
8. Add egg , milk , lemon juice , and vanilla
9. Mix well
10. Pour over warm crust
11. Sprinkle with reserved crumb mixture
12. Bake for 25-30 minutes or until set
13. Immediately sprinkle with baking bits
14. Cool on a wire rack
15. Cut into bars and refrigerate leftovers

title: crunchy coleslaw
steps:
1. Toss together cole slaw and green onions
2. In a small mixing bowl , whisk together oil , vinegar , sugar , and ramen seasoning packet
3. Pour over salad and toss together
4. Just before serving , add ramen noodles , almonds and sunflower seeds and toss together

title: asia style chicken drumsticks in the crock pot
steps:
1. Put the ponzu sauce , ketchup , maple syrup , sesame oil , ginger , garlic , chili flakes , sesame seeds and crumbled , dried oregano in a large mason jar , screw on the lid and shake vigorously until well blended
2. Pour the sauce in the crock pot and set to high , put the lid on
3. Remove the skin from the chicken drumsticks , rinse them , pat them dry , rub the 5 spice powder all around and add them to the sauce in the crockpot
4. In the meantime , prepare the peppers by removing the core and white membranes , cutting them into 1 1 / 2 by 1 1 / 2 inch squares
5. After 2 - 21 / 2 hours on high , add the peppers to the crockpot and set for another hour on high
6. Make a cornstarch slurry and whisk into the sauce during the last 30 minutes or until the sauce has thickened
7. Check drumsticks fore doneness , the meet should come easy off the bone

title: ham and macaroni salad
steps:
1. Dice ham into 1 / 2-inch cubes
2. Combine ham and cheese with macaroni , celery , onion and pickle
3. Mix mayonnaise and mustard
4. Then stir into macaroni mixture , mixing well
5. Chill well until ready to serve , several hours for maximum flavor !
6. Serve in a lettuce lined bowl , and garnish with fresh parsley , if desired

title: brussels sprouts with pine nuts
steps:
1. In a large skillet , melt 1 tablespoon butter
2. Add nuts and stir for 3 minutes or until golden brown
3. Place nuts in a bowl and set aside
4. Melt 1 tablespoon butter in same skillet
5. Add brussels sprouts
6. Stir 1 minutes
7. Add broth
8. Cover and simmer on medium heat for about 7 minutes or until brussels sprouts are almost tender
9. Uncover and simmer until broth evaporates
10. Using a wooden spoon , push brussels sprouts to the sides of the skillet
11. Melt 1 tablespoon butter in the center of the skillet
12. Add shallots
13. Cook stirring frequently until tender
14. Stir in marjoram and cream
15. Simmer until sprouts are coated with cream , stirring frequently
16. Season with salt and pepper
17. Add half of pine nuts and mix well
18. Transfer brussels sprouts to serving dish
19. Sprinkle with remaining pine nuts

title: slow cooker sloppy joes
steps:
1. In a skillet , brown beef , onion and garlic
2. Drain and set aside
3. Combine remaining ingredients except buns in a slow cooker
4. Stir in beef mixture
5. Cover
6. Cook on low setting for 6 to 8 hours or on high setting for 3 to 4 hours
7. Spoon onto buns
8. Serves 6 to 8

title: taco salad ii
steps:
1. Crumble and brown meat well in a skillet over medium-high heat
2. Drain excess grease , and add green pepper , onion , granulated garlic , and salt and pepper to taste
3. Cook a few more minutes , and add chili powder and cumin
4. In a small saucepan , melt cheese over low heat
5. Stir in tomatoes with green chilies , and season to taste with salt and pepper
6. In a large bowl , layer in the following order , lettuce , tomatoes , chips , hot meat mixture , and hot cheese mixture
7. Toss at the table , and serve immediately

title: beef couscous crock pot
steps:
1. Brown beef in a heavy skillet and pour off excess fat
2. Add broth , pepper , olives , onion , garlic , cumin and thyme
3. Top with beef , cover and cook on low 4-5 hours until vegetables are tender
4. Add water to a small sauce pan and bring to a boil
5. Stir in couscous , remove from heat and cover
6. After 5 minutes , remove cover and stir with a fork
7. Spoon couscous on to individual plates and top with the beef mixture

title: corn with tomatoes and green chiles
steps:
1. Heat oil in skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add corn , onions , garlic
3. Cook stirring occasionally , for 2 to 3 minutes or until onion is tender
4. Add tomato , chiles , and salt
5. Cook , stirring occasionally , for 1 to 2 minutes or until heated through

title: mexican bubble pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Brown ground beef in large skillet or pan over medium heat until thoroughly cooked , stirring frequently
3. Drain
4. Add old el paso taco seasoning mix , water , and tomato soup , and mix well
5. Bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 3 minutes
7. Remove from heat
8. Separate dough from biscuits into 8 biscuits
9. Cut each biscuit into 8 pieces
10. Add to ground beef mixture
11. Stir gently
12. Spoon mixture into ungreased 13x9-inch pan
13. Bake 18-23 minutes or until sauce is bubbly and biscuits are golden brown
14. Remove from oven
15. Sprinkle with cheese
16. Return to oven
17. Bake until cheese is bubbly
18. Cut into 8 squares

title: italian club finger sandwiches
steps:
1. Trim all crusts from bread
2. Spread 4 slices with herb soft cheese
3. Top each cheese covered slice with 2 slices each of prosciutto , 3 leaves of arugula , thinly sliced tomatoes seasoned with a pinch of salt
4. Place a completed layer a top another , making 2 stacks each 2 layers high
5. Set the final trimmed bread slices in place , making 2 triple-decker sandwiches
6. Thinly slice and salt the radishes
7. Pierce a couple of thin slices of radish on each toothpick as you place 4 toothpicks in each sandwich
8. Cut each sandwich into 4 equal parts , cutting the sandwich across evenly on each side
9. The yield will be 8 triple-decker , square-shaped , "club" finger sandwiches , 2 per portion

title: calypso strawberry mango salsa
steps:
1. In bowl , toss all ingredients except salt to blend thoroughly
2. Mix in salt
3. Serve immediately or cover and refrigerate up to two days
4. Serve with corn chips , chicken or mild , white fish

title: a  fitzgeralds casino potato leek soup
steps:
1. : use a heavy guage pot as this soup will scorch easily in thin cooking pots
2. Saute leeks in butter at medium heat until transparent
3. Add chicken base and stir one minute
4. Add flour , stir in well and cook for 5 minutes , stirring regularly
5. Add half-&-half and potatoes
6. Bring to boil , stirring regularly
7. Reduce heat to simmer for 5 minutes , adding a pinch of granulated garlic and salt & pepper to taste
8. Serves 4-6 but it is soooo tasty that you may want to prepare double that amount !

title: pork tenderloin stuffed with spinach and blueberries
steps:
1. Trim the tenderloin and remove a bit of the tail part where it is thinner
2. Cut the tenderloin in half
3. Butterfly each piece lengthwise about 1 / 2-inch , then do the same the opposite way
4. This will give you two flat pieces
5. Lay half the spinach on each piece of meat
6. Add half the hazelnuts , then half the blueberries to each piece
7. Then split the cream cheese in two and with your hand
8. Make flat discs to place on top of the ingredients
9. Then roll tenderloin back up nice and tight without losing any of the stuffing
10. Rub dijon mustard on the outside
11. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
12. In a frying pan , heat the olive oil and sear the tenderloins for two minutes on each side
13. Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake in a preheated 350f oven for 20 minutes
14. Remove from oven and let rest for 10 minutes , cut 4 times on the bias and serve
15. This dish can be accompanied with a warmed blueberry jam

title: taco soup crock pot style
steps:
1. In skillet , brown meat
2. Add onion , salt , pepper & cayenne
3. Put in crock pot
4. Add the rest of the ingredients and stir
5. Cook on low heat for 6-8 hours or high for 3-4 hours , stirring occasionally

title: sweet curried sausages
steps:
1. Cook sausages till browned all over and cooked through in frypan
2. Drain on paper towel and cut into thin slices
3. Discard all but 1 tblsp liquid from frypan and add onion and garlic
4. Cook till onion is soft
5. Add spices , stir till fragrant
6. Add remaining ingredients including sausages
7. Cook gently till apples are tender
8. Serve

title: chile relleno pie
steps:
1. Broil or roast poblano peppers over direct heat until skin is charred
2. Place in plastic or paper bag and let stand until cool enough to handle
3. Split chilies , then carefully remove skin , seeds and veins before using
4. Rinse chilies , if needed , and pat dry
5. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
6. Generously grease 10-inch pie plate or shallow casserole
7. Line plate with split chilies , covering completely and extending up sides as much as possible
8. Combine eggs , cheese , cream , onion , salt , garlic and pepper in blender and mix on low speed about 2 minutes
9. Carefully pour into pie plate and bake until set , about 30 minutes
10. Let cool slightly before cutting into wedges

title: easy meatball tortellini soup
steps:
1. Pour cans of broth into large soup pot
2. Cover and heat over medium heat until simmering
3. Meanwhile , mix ground beef , egg , bread crumbs , salt and pepper
4. Form into 3 / 4" balls
5. Drop into simmering broth and cook through , about 5 minutes
6. Add frozen tortellini and cook another 7 minutes
7. Add spinach and heat a few more minutes
8. If you'd like , top with grated parmesan

title: passover carrot almond cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f grease bottom of 8" springform pan
2. Dust with cake meal , shaking off excess
3. Using electric mixer , beat yolks and brown sugar in large bowl until slowly dissolving ribbon forms when beaters are lifted , about 5 minutes
4. Stir in carrots and vanilla
5. Using clean , dry beaters , beat whites with salt until soft peaks form
6. Gradually add sugar and beat until whites are stiff but not dry
7. Gently fold in yolk mixture
8. Combine almonds , 3 tablespoons cake meal and cinnamon
9. Fold gently into egg mixture
10. Turn into prepared pan , smoothing top
11. Bake until tester inserted in center comes out clean , about 1 hour
12. Immediately run knife around edge
13. Cool completely in pan onrack
14. Remove springform before serving

title: spicy baked beans
steps:
1. Cook pork sausage in an ovenproof dutch oven over medium-high heat , stirring until sausage crumbles and is no longer pink
2. Drain , reserving 2 teaspoons drippings in dutch oven
3. Return sausage to dutch oven and stir in onion
4. Saute until tender
5. Add the remaining ingredients and stir to mix
6. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes or until thickened and bubbly

title: strawberry jello pudding bread
steps:
1. Beat eggs
2. Add jello mix , sugar and oil
3. Mix well
4. Add pudding mix , vanilla and milk
5. Beat for 3 minutes with electric mixer
6. Add rest of ingredients
7. Pour into one large greased loaf pan
8. Cook at 325 degrees for 1 hour
9. Optional glaze: blend 1 cup confectioners sugar with 2 tablespoons milk and drizzle over the top

title: balsamic thyme chicken
steps:
1. Preheat over to 350 degrees f
2. Spray shallow one quart baking dish with veg spray
3. Heat margarine in med
4. Nonstick skillet over med high heat
5. Add chicken and cook until slightly browned
6. Remove chicken to baking dish
7. Pour broth into skillet , add peppers , onion and thyme
8. Simmer about ten minutes
9. Lift veggies from skillet with a slotted spoon and arrange on top of chicken
10. In small bowl , combine vinegar , sugar , salt and pepper
11. Pour into skillet , bring to a boil and simmer about five minutes
12. Pour over chicken , cover , and bake for 20 minutes or till chicken is tender

title: french toast stack
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Bake whole slices of bread on cookie sheet until dry , toasting minimally
3. Spread cream cheese on six slices
4. Lay flat in greased 13 x 9 inch pan
5. Sandwich with another six slices
6. Spread pie filling over second layer
7. Sprinkle over plumped raisins
8. Top with six more slices of bread
9. In large mixing bowl , beat together the eggs , milks , vanilla , syrup , and spices
10. Pour over casserole
11. Refridgerate overnight
12. Place pan in oven before turning it on
13. Turn oven to 350 and bake for 55-60 minutes or until set

title: easy and tasty apple cake with crumb topping
steps:
1. In a big bowl cream butter , sugar and vanilla sugar for 8 minutes
2. Then beat in each egg for 30 seconds
3. In a second bowl combine flour , baking powder and cinnamon
4. Add this to the butter egg mixture and mix in well
5. Dough will be thick , but if it seems too thick , add in a splash or two of milk
6. Pour dough into a well greased spring-form pan and spread it out evenly using the back of a spoon
7. Arrange apple slices in circles on top pressing them into the dough about half way
8. Make the crumb topping by crushing the cookies and combining them with the cinnamon and chilli pepper
9. Sprinkle this on top of the apple slices
10. Bake in the pre heated oven at 175c / 350f for 40-50 minutes or until nicely browned on top and tester inserted in the centre comes out clean
11. If the cake threatens to get too brown , cover it with a baking paper

title: double chocolate chunk cupcakes
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f grease 18 muffin cups
2. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup
3. Level off
4. In large bowl , combine flour , brown sugar , cocoa , baking soda and salt
5. Blend well
6. Add buttermilk , margarine , almond extract and egg
7. Blend just until dry ingredients are moistened
8. Fold in vanilla and milk chocolate chips and almonds
9. Fill greased muffin cups 3 / 4 full
10. Bake at 375f for 15 to 20 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
11. Cool 3 minutes
12. Remove from pan
13. Serve warm or cool
14. To substitute for buttermilk , use 1 tablespoon vinegar or lemon juice plus milk to make 1 cup
15. High altitude -- above 3500 feet: no change

title: javanese dinner
steps:
1. Line up the above ingredients , in given order , in serving bowls on a counter or buffet table
2. Your guests take a plate and begin building their "dinner" using the rice as the base , sprinking on as much or little of each layer , finishing with a cherry on top ! we were always encouraged to try every layer , leaving off no more than 2 in case there is something you are allergic to or just do not like
3. It is amazing how good this is and fun to make

title: lactose free creamy peach snack
steps:
1. Put milk in microwaveable bowl
2. Add sugar to milk and microwave 40 seconds
3. Stir
4. Microwave additional 40 seconds
5. Stir
6. Add peaches to milk mixture , and then slowly stir in the juice from the can
7. You may or may not want to add all of the juice
8. Its a good idea to taste as you go along for sweetness
9. Refrigerate until nice and cold
10. Serve !

title: parmesan yogurt chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Mix cheese , yogurt , bread crumbs and spices together until combined
3. Place chicken in baking dish
4. Spread yogurt mix over chicken
5. Bake for 45 minutes

title: american kitchen classic louisiana gumbo
steps:
1. Heat large saucepan or dutch oven over medium heat
2. When hot , add sausage and cook 5 to 7 minutes or until sausage browns
3. Remove sausage from pan
4. Set aside
5. Add chicken to pan
6. Cook 5 to 7 minutes or until lightly browned
7. Remove from pan
8. Set aside
9. Add butter to pan
10. When melted , stir in flour and cook 10 minutes or until mixture is golden brown and nutty in aroma , stirring constantly
11. If it burns even slightly , throw it out and start over again
12. Add onion , bell pepper , celery and garlic to pan
13. Stir to combine
14. Add broth and undrained tomatoes
15. Bring mixture to a boil
16. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until thickened
17. Season with salt , pepper , thyme and red pepper
18. Add shrimp and okra to pan
19. Cook 5 to 7 minutes more or until shrimp are pink and okra is warmed through
20. Return chicken and sausage to pan
21. Cook 1 to 2 minutes or until hot
22. Remove from heat
23. Stir in file powder just before serving
24. Serve over rice , if desired

title: tuna fish junk
steps:
1. Saut onion and celery in butter
2. Remove from heat
3. Blend in bisquick and salt
4. Add milk
5. Cook and stir until thick
6. Blend in tuna and heat through

title: southwestern beef and pasta casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cook pasta according to package directions
3. Drain
4. Meanwhile , coat a 9-inch springform pan with cooking spray
5. In large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat , cook beef with seasoning and salt until browned
6. Stir in salsa
7. Remove from heat
8. In large bowl , mix alfredo sauce , eggs and 1 cup cheese
9. Stir in pasta
10. In another bowl , toss spinach with 1 / 2 cup cheese
11. To assemble , spoon half of pasta mixture , about 4 cups , into pan
12. Sprinkle spinach mixture evenly over pasta
13. Top with even layer of beef mixture
14. Top with remaining pasta mixture
15. Sprinkle with remaining 1 / 2 cup cheese
16. Bake until hot in center and top is golden , about 1 hour
17. Run sharp knife around edge of pan to loosen pasta
18. Let stand 10 minutes
19. Remove side of pan
20. Sprinkle with parsley

title: english 15th century poor knights of windsor    boozy toast
steps:
1. Remove the crusts from the bread and cut each slice in half
2. Place 1 tablespoon of the sugar , the milk , white wine and sherry in a shallow dish and stir to dissolve the sugar
3. Place the egg yolks in a shallow dish and beat well then dip the slices of bread in the milk mixture and then into the egg yolks
4. Melt the butter in a large frying pan and fry the bread until golden brown on both sides
5. Drain well and keep hot while the remaining pieces are fried
6. To serve - sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon and serve hot with strawberry or raspberry jam

title: sausage gravy casserole
steps:
1. Cook sausage and drain
2. If using links cut them up into bite size pieces
3. Spread crescent rolls into bottom of a greased 9 x 13 casserole
4. Put tater tots evenly on the top of the crescent rolls
5. Sprinkle sausage over top of tater tots
6. Pour sausage gravy over the top
7. Bake at 375 for 20 - 30 minutes
8. I used convection oven and baked for about 20 minutes so a regular oven might take longer than the 30 minutes
9. For us it served 6 that included one adult and 5 children

title: hot fruit and sausage
steps:
1. In a skillet , cook the sausage according to the package directions
2. Drain
3. Add the pineapple , brown sugar , and cinnamon
4. Heat through
5. Stir in the banana just before serving

title: mark bittman s pasta with garlic  tomatoes and anchovies
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and salt it for the pasta -- you should be able to make the entire recipe as the pasta cooks
2. Put olive oil in a medium skillet over medium heat
3. A minute later , add garlic and chilies , if using -- cook garlic so it bubbles gently
4. When it is lightly browned all over , add anchovies and cook , stirring occasionally , for about a minute , until anchovies begin to fall apart , then add tomatoes
5. Adjust heat so tomatoes bubble nicely , and cook until mixture becomes saucy , about 5 minutes
6. Taste and add salt and pepper as necessary
7. Meanwhile , cook pasta until tender but not mushy
8. When it is done , drain it , reserving a little cooking water to thin sauce if necessary
9. Serve pasta with sauce and parsley

title: orange biscotti
steps:
1. Mix together the flour , sugar , salt and baking powder
2. Blend in the butter until a meal-like texture forms
3. Beat the egg
4. Add the zest and egg to the mixture until a dough forms
5. Knead briefly
6. Roll the dough into a 12-inch cylinder
7. Place on parchment paper on a cookie sheet
8. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes
9. Cool slightly
10. Cut , on the bias , into 1 / 2-inch wide slices
11. Place the slices on the parchment and bake for 20 minutes longer
12. Combine the powdered sugar and orange juice
13. Brush onto the biscotti
14. Cool before serving

title: hit the spot lemon water
steps:
1. Place lemon slices in a large pitcher
2. Carefully rub the 1-1 / 2 cups mint leaves between the palms of your hands to slightly bruise the leaves
3. Add to the pitcher with lemon
4. Pour in water
5. Cover and chill for 1 to 8 hours
6. Strain lemon-water mixture
7. Discard herbs
8. Divide lemon slices and additional fresh mint or basil sprigs equally among 6 to 8 tall glasses or pint-sized canning jars
9. For each serving , add 1 cup of ice cubes
10. Fill with the lemon water

title: cinnamon date cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a small saucepan , place dates and add water just to cover
3. Bring to a boil and remove from heat
4. Drain dates and place in food processor
5. Blend until dates have a paste-like consistency
6. In a large bowl add all dry ingredients and mix gently with a fork
7. Add butter , eggs , and warm dates
8. Beat with hand mixer until all ingredients are thoroughly blended
9. Pour ingredients into a greased and lightly floured metal pan
10. Bake for 40 minutes or until inserted knife or skewer comes out clean

title: whipped milk chocolate frosting
steps:
1. Pour the cream into a small , heavy saucepan
2. Place over moderately high heat until the cream begins to boil
3. Remove pan from heat
4. Add the chocolate , shaking the pan so all the chocolate gets immersed with the cream
5. Let stand for 1 minute , or until the chocolate is melted
6. Beat the mixture with a large , heavy spoon until the mixture is smooth and well blended
7. Transfer to a small bowl
8. Let mixture cool to room temperature
9. Whip with an electric mixer on high speed until it thickens and forms soft peaks
10. Frost as desired , swirling the frosting into small peaks
11. The frosting will be soft at first , but will thicken up upon standing

title: salted nut rolls
steps:
1. Melt butter and peanut butter chips in a 3 qt casserole in microwave at 50% power for 2 1 / 2 minutes
2. Until chips and butter are melted
3. Add 1 can eagle brand milk
4. Heat to almost boiling
5. Add mini marshmallows
6. Stir in ,
7. Butter a 13 x 9 , tupperware will work
8. Put in 1 / 2 jar of peanuts , pour mixture over peanuts
9. Add rest of peanuts on top
10. Best if cooled completely before serving

title: solo chicken breast and broccoli
steps:
1. Sprinkle the black pepper on both sides of the thawed chicken breast , next apply the olive oil and place into a very hot non-stick frying pan
2. Fry for 4 minutes , turn over once and fry for another 4 minutes or until the interal temperature is 160 degrees mix the flour and butter in a small bowl until combined
3. Remove the chicken breast , add the wine and chicken stock , and stir to loosen the crispy particles
4. Add the mustard and butter / flour mixture and stir again until the gravy thickens
5. Add the broccoli and olives and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes
6. To serve , pour gravy and broccoli over the chicken

title: moroccan applesauce cake  crock pot
steps:
1. Prepare a 2-quart pudding mold or 2-pound coffee can by greasing and flouring
2. Set aside
3. In bowl of electric mixer , cream butter and sugar
4. Add eggs one at a time , beating until smooth after each addition
5. Beat in vanilla
6. In small bowl combine applesauce and soda
7. Stir in to mixer bowl
8. Mix flour , cinnamon and salt together
9. Add to creamed mixture
10. Beat until smooth
11. Mix in chocolate bits , dates and walnuts
12. Turn into prepared pudding mold or coffee can
13. Place in crockery pot
14. Cover with 4 layers of paper towels
15. Place crockery pot lid loosely on top to allow steam to escape
16. Cook on high 3 to 3 hours , or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean

title: healthy shrimp and pasta alfredo
steps:
1. Begin boiling the water for the pasta
2. Melt butter in a large skillet until sizzling
3. Add pasta to the water
4. Add onion , shrimp , bell pepper , garlic , salt and pepper to the skillet
5. Cook over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until the shrimp turn pink
6. While the shrimp and pasta are cooking , put all ingredients for the alfredo sauce in a blender and puree until smooth
7. Pour contents of blender in a small saucepan over medium heat until it just starts to boil
8. Lower the alfredo sauce to low and stir frequently , adding pepper if desired
9. Strain the pasta if fully cooked and return to the saucepan
10. Add the shrimp mixture to the pasta , then pour the alfredo sauce on top
11. Mix well
12. If extra flavor is desired , feel free to add any of the cajun spices listed above

title: delicious brat casserole
steps:
1. Saut celery and onion in small amount of olive oil or vegetable oil until partially done , about 5-8 minutes
2. Set aside
3. Using the same pan you used for the celery , cook the brat pieces over medium high heat until no pink remains and they are cooked through
4. Drain off any grease
5. In a well buttered 2-quart casserole dish , layer potatoes , then brats , then celery and onions , then green beans
6. Mix the milk with the soup , stir well to combine , and pour over layered ingredients in the casserole dish
7. Bake at 375 for 1 hour 30 minutes , uncovered
8. If desired , increase the amount of brats for a meatier meal

title: baked pasta e fagioli
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Heat large covered saucepot of water to boiling
3. Add pasta and cook 2 minutes less than label directions
4. Drain and reserve 1 / 4 cup cooking water
5. Return pasta to saucepot
6. Meanwhile , drain tomatoes , reserving puree
7. Coarsely chop tomatoes
8. In 4-quart saucepan , heat oil over medium heat until hot
9. Add onion and celery and cook 9-10 minutes or until tender , stirring occasionally
10. Add garlic and cook 1 minute
11. Stir in tomatoes with puree , beans , broth and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper
12. Heat to boiling over high heat
13. Reduce heat to medium and stir in spinach
14. Add bean mixture , pasta cooking water and 1 / 4 cup romano to pasta in saucepot and toss until well mixed
15. Transfer pasta mixture to 3-quart glass or ceramic baking dish
16. Sprinkle with remaining romano and bake 15 minutes or until center is hot and top is golden

title: sugar dusted banana cake
steps:
1. Grease and flour a 9-inch by 11-inch baking pan
2. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f
3. All mixing must be done by hand with a wooden spoon
4. In a small bowl , mix all the dry ingredients except flour and granulated sugar
5. In a large mixing bowl , cream the granulated sugar and shortening
6. Add the dry ingredients , the eggs , vanilla , and milk to the sugar and shortening mixture
7. Mix thoroughly
8. Add the smashed bananas and mix
9. Add the flour , continuing to mix
10. Pour in the batter and bake at 375f for 25 minutes or until a knife through the center of the cake comes out dry
11. Cover with confectioners' sugar
12. Let cool and cover again with confectioners' sugar

title: lemon delight
steps:
1. Put 1 can of carnation milk in the freezer for 1 hr before preparing recipe
2. Crust
3. 1 / 2 c brown sugar
4. 1 / 2 c butter
5. 24 graham crackers
6. Mix together and press 3 / 4 of the crumb mix into 9"x13" cake dish
7. Filling
8. Mix 1 package of lemon jello with 1 / 2 c boiling water
9. Pour chilled carnation milk into bowl and whip
10. Add dissolved jello mix and continue to whip
11. Add 1 / 2 c sugar and continue to whip
12. Add lemon juice to taste and continue to whip
13. Pour filling into cake dish
14. Put the remainder of the crumb mixture onto the top
15. Place cake dish into the fridge for at least an hour before serving

title: kalamata lemon chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degree f
2. In a 4-quart dutch oven brown chicken in hot oil over medium-high heat for 5 minutes , turning once
3. Stir in orzo , olives , the can of broth , lemon wedges , lemon juice , greek seasoning , 1 / 4 teaspoon salt , and 1 / 4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
4. Cover and bake for 35 minutes or until chicken is tender and no longer pink
5. Serve in shallow bowls with additional broth , if desired
6. Top with snipped oregano

title: banana nut ice cream
steps:
1. Combine the milk , half and half , eggs , sugar and salt in a medium saucepan
2. Cook and stir over low heat until mixture thickens slightly and coats the back of a spoon
3. Refrigerate until mixture is thoroughly chilled
4. Combine the cooled custard with the banana , vanilla and nutmeg in blender container , blending well
5. Add the pecan pieces and pour into freezer container
6. Freeze according to manufacturer's instructions

title: cheeseburger pizza
steps:
1. In a skillet , cook beef , onion , garlic , salt , and pepper until meat is browned
2. Drain and set aside
3. Place crust on an ungreased 12-inch pizza pan
4. Spread with pizza sauce
5. Top with beef mixture , bacon , pickles , and cheeses
6. Sprinkle with italian seasoning
7. Bake at 450 degrees for 9-15 minutes or until cheese is melted

title: dilly sun pickles
steps:
1. Scrub cukes well
2. Cut off both ends of cukes and vertically score their skin on opposite sides
3. Place cukes in a glass or a high quality plastic container
4. Place sprigs of dill on top of each layer of cukes
5. This is the time to add the optional few peppercorns and / or cloves of garlic
6. Boil enough water to fill container
7. Add 1 level tbs
8. Salt per 2 cups of water
9. Top with 2 thick slices of white or rye bread and pour enough salty water to cover the bread
10. Cover container loosely with a plate or plastic wrap
11. Place container in a warm , sunny place
12. Carefully stir contents once a day , keeping the bread on top
13. Taste test
14. When the pickles are sour enough strain and reserve their liquid
15. Rinse the pickles in cold water
16. Fill a clean container with your dill pickles and the reserved liquid
17. Cover tightly and refrigerate
18. The pickles could be stored in the fridge for a week

title: not your mama s meatloaf   low carb   beefed up
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In small bowl , combine tomato sauce topping ingredients and set aside
3. Add water to sauce to thin , as needed
4. In large bowl , combine beef , eggs , cheese , vegetables , herbs & seasonings
5. Place meat mixture on a wax paper-lined jellyroll pan or counter
6. Form meat into a 10x8-inch flat rectangle
7. Place prosciutto slices on the meatloaf mixture
8. Place the provolone slices on top
9. Starting with the short side , roll the meatloaf up
10. Seal ends and place , seam side down , into a loaf pan
11. Spread tomato sauce topping on the meatloaf , completely covering the top
12. Bake for 75 minutes
13. Drain fat and let rest 10 minutes before serving

title: summer squash with apple
steps:
1. Trim ends from squash and cut into thin slices
2. Core apple and cut into thin slices
3. In a medium saucepan , combine squash , apple , chicken broth , salt , pepper and nutmeg
4. Cook until squash and apple are tender , 6-8 minutes
5. Serve garnished with chives or parsley

title: chinese general chicken   ww core
steps:
1. Cut chicken into 2 inch pieces
2. In a small bowl , mix together chicken broth , cornstarch , splenda , soy sauce , vinegar and ginger
3. Set aside
4. Heat oil in skillet or wok over medium-high heat
5. Add scallions , garlic and pepper
6. Cook 2 minutes , add chicken and cook until browned , about 5 more minutes
7. Add sauce and simmer until sauce thickens and chicken is cooked through , about 3 minutes
8. Serve chicken and sauce over rice

title: avocado summer salad
steps:
1. Place lettuce on on plate
2. Top with sliced tomatoes
3. Sprinkle vinegar
4. May not need all , just eyeball it
5. Top with salsa
6. Place avocado in fan shape atop salad and tomato mixture
7. Sprinkle red onion on top
8. Salt and pepper to taste

title: koulourakia  greek easter cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Sift together flour and baking powder
3. Set aside
4. Cream butter and sugar
5. Add eggs to butter mixture
6. Combine completely
7. Add vanilla
8. Add enough flour mixture to make a soft dough
9. Shape dough with lightly floured hands into desired shapes and arrange on ungreased cookie sheets
10. Brush with beaten egg and water
11. Bake for 20 minutes , or until golden brown
12. Cool on racks
13. The most common shape ive seen is twists
14. Twists can be made by rolling a piece of dough about 5 inches long and inch round into a tube shape
15. Bring ends together and lightly twist one time from middle to ends
16. Other shapes are balls with flattened bottoms

title: another galaxy oats
steps:
1. Take a microwave safe container and lid
2. Place your oats and water together and mix well
3. Place the mini milky way bar or even a reese's peanut butter cup in the middle
4. The candy treat can vary on your candy bar preference but try to keep the size about the same as a mini of the given brand
5. Place the container's lid on , just setting over the ready to heat mix
6. Now heat for 45 seconds and then check on it
7. Stir the heated ingredients very thoroughly until all is evenly spread throughout the oats and they've changed color
8. You can either heat it longer , chill it in the freezer , or eat when it is cooled enough not to burn your mouth
9. Enjoy !

title: a campfire you can eat
steps:
1. To make an edible campfire , first clear a space on the table to build a safe fire
2. Lay down a tortilla fire base and wrap a licorice rope safety circle around the tortilla about an inch in from the edge
3. Build a peanut rock ring halfway between the safety circle and the center of the fire base
4. Spread a circle of peanut butter in the center of the fire base
5. Lay a small handful of fried chinese noodles on top for kindling
6. Lay tootsie roll logs around the peanut butter circle
7. Use mini pretzel sticks as fuel wood to build a teepee inside the ring of logs and over the kindling , sticking the pretzels into the peanut butter at a 45-degree angle
8. Add another layer of logs , setting them across the corners of the first layer to form a box around the teepee
9. Lay a few more pieces of fuel wood across the logs
10. Make sure buckets of water and dirt are nearby to put out the fire if necessary
11. Light the fire by adding candy corn flames
12. After the camp director approves the fire , throw dirt on the fire to put it out
13. Now , the moment the fire builders have been waiting for: eat your fires !

title: ridiculously simple chocolate sauce
steps:
1. Break chocolate up into pieces and place in a microwaveable dish
2. Melt in a microwave on high power in 30 second bursts
3. When chocolate it melted , remove from microwave and add cream
4. Mix well
5. Initially you'll feel like you've added too much cream and that it'll never mix together but some weird molecular thing will then happen and suddenly the whole thing will thicken and smooth out
6. Serve immediately
7. Yummy , yummy

title: raspberry revolution smoothie  nordstrom
steps:
1. In a blender with a powerful motor , first place the apple juice , followed by the frozen strawberries , and then the frozen raspberries
2. Next add the raspberry sorbet , and top with the ice
3. Cover the blender securely and blend on high speed for 35 seconds or longer
4. Let the vortex swirl 10-15 seconds longer
5. Pour into tall glasses and add sturdy straws
6. Serve immediately

title: almond crescents
steps:
1. In the food processer ---------------
2. Process almonds and sugar until almonds are ground very fine
3. Cut the butter in chunks and , with the motor running , add
4. Process until smooth and creamy
5. Scrape down bowl
6. Add flour and salt , pulse until flour is just incorporated
7. Or in the mixer--------------
8. Soften butter
9. Grind almonds
10. Mix sugar and cinnamon for topping
11. Combine almonds , sugar and butter in a mixing bowl , beat until light and fluffy
12. Add flour and salt , mix on low speed until combined
13. For either method--------------
14. Form dough into a thick disk , wrap in plastic or wax paper and refrigerate for 2 hours , or until firm
15. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
16. Divide dough into 8 portions , work with one section at a time keeping the remainder in the fridge
17. Knead dough with floured hands until malleable , press into a square and cut into 8 equal portions
18. Roll each into a
19. Round ball
20. Roll each ball on a counter into a 3"
21. Cylinder with tapered ends
22. Bend to form a crescent
23. Place about 1"
24. Apart on a cookie sheet and bake for 14-16 minutes , until set , but not browned
25. Cool on pan for 10 mins and , while still warm , use a small angled spatula to dip and gently roll them in the topping
26. Place on a rack to cool , store in an airtight container for about a month

title: ukrainian classic borsch
steps:
1. For the stock: in a large soup pot , bring the meat , bones , and water to a boil over high heat , periodically skimming off the foam as it rises to the top
2. Add the remaining stock ingredients and reduce the heat to low
3. Simmer , partially covered , until the meat is tender , at least 45 minutes
4. When the stock is ready , remove the beef , pork , and marrow bones , and set all but the marrow bones aside
5. Strain the stock through a fine sieve into a clean large pot and discard all the solids
6. Preheat the oven to 375f
7. Meanwhile , wash and dry the beets and wrap each one separately in aluminum foil
8. Bake the beets until tender , 1 1 / 4 hours
9. Do this while the stock is cooking
10. For the soup: allow the beets to cool until manageable , then stem and peel them and cut into julienne or fine dice
11. Bring the stock to a boil , add the cabbage and cook for 15 minutes , add the potatoes , onion , carrots , peppers and cook for 20 more minutes , add beets and tomatoes , and tomato paste
12. Season to taste with sugar , pepper , and additional lemon juice and salt
13. Simmer for 15 more minutes
14. Cut the beef into bite-size pieces and scrape all the meat off the bones
15. Add meat to the soup
16. Simmer for 15 more minutes
17. Remove the borsch from the heat and sprinkle with the minced garlic , bacon , and 3 tablespoons each parsley and dill
18. Let stand at least 15 minutes before serving
19. Serve with sour cream
20. Serves 12 to 14

title: kasha breakfast pudding
steps:
1. In large saucepan , combine milk , buckwheat groats , brown sugar , cinnamon , ginger , nutmeg , and kosher salt
2. Bring to boil and cook for 1 minute
3. Add butter and fruit
4. Gradually blend in the beaten eggs taking care not to'cook' eggs
5. Ladle into greased individual baking dishes or custard cups
6. Place in a water bath
7. Bake at 325f for 30-40 minutes until set or when a knife inserted near the edge of the cup comes out clean

title: whiskey old fashioned
steps:
1. First you will want to grab a cocktail or rocks glass to mix your drink into
2. Then , place a slice of lemon , orange , and a maraschino cherry into the glass
3. Pour about two tablespoons of the maraschino cherry juice in with the fruit
4. Next you will want to add about a spoonful of sugar
5. Once the sugar is in the glass , pour in some club soda
6. You will only want to add about 1
7. 5-2 ounces
8. Next add just a dash of bitters , it's the secret to a good old fashioned
9. Once you have reached this point in the drink where there is fruit , sugar , club soda , and bitters you are going to want to stir and mesh up your fruit in the bottom of the glass to release and mix the juices
10. Once you have thoroughly mixed and meshed the juices , fill the rest of the glass with ice
11. Now it is time to add the whiskey
12. Pour 1
13. 5 to 2 shots of bourbon whiskey into the glass
14. Lastly , stir your drink and ad a lemon slice as a garnish on your glass
15. Enjoy !

title: pan fried sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Dice sweet potatoes no thicker than 1 / 4 inch thick
2. Place pan on medium heat to begin warming
3. While waiting dice onion and prepare garlic
4. Place oil in pan and add potatoes , garlic , and onions and then coat well
5. Sprinkle salt and pepper just after adding other ingredients to the pan
6. Allow the potatoes to cook for a few minutes and check for browning
7. Keep temperature from getting too hot
8. Stir occasionally until potatoes are to your desired doneness (approx 10 minutes for me
9. Turn off heat and add brown sugar while still hot
10. Stir well and serve
11. Variation try using butter instead of olive oil for a more sweet and traditional flavor

title: crock pot kielbasa and bean soup
steps:
1. Place all the ingredients except the tomatoes in a crockpot
2. Cook on low for 7 hours
3. Add the diced tomatoes with juice and cook on high for 30 minutes
4. Added

title: curry apple raisin pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. - cut apples into small pieces
3. - combine sugar , cut apples , raisins , cinnamon , salt , flour , vanilla , and curry until completely incorporated
4. - move mixture to a sauce pan and heat on medium fire , stir constantly as sugar will melt quickly and can burn
5. - line an oven-proof bowl or casserole pan with bakers paper , and lay crust inside with edges of crust hanging over the edges
6. - pour apple mixture into the pie crust , and carefully gather the edges of the pie crust to the middle by pinching the ends together
7. If you did this right , it should look like a little white sack with the opening pinched closed in the middle
8. - prick top with fork
9. - optional: glaze top with mixture of one egg white to 1 tbsp milk
10. - bake in oven until crust has a golden color

title: apple crescent dumplings
steps:
1. Peel and core apples
2. Cut each apple into quarters , having a total of 8 pieces
3. Separate crescent rolls
4. Wrap an apple quarter in each roll
5. Place in a 9 x 9 inch square baking dish
6. Using fingers sprinkle with cinnamon
7. In a medium saucepan , combine butter , sugar , water and orange juice
8. Bring to a boil
9. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla
10. Pour over dumplings
11. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 20 minutes or until crust is golden brown
12. Spoon liquid in baking pan over the hot dumplings and serve
13. Suggestion: serve with a scoop of vanilla ice cream

title: persian   iranian maahi kabab   fish
steps:
1. Wash , drain well then finely chop coriander , parsley and mint
2. Add lime juice , olive oil , pomegranate powder , saffron & salt and black pepper to taste , mix well & set aside
3. Place fish fillets in a large oven proof dish
4. Pour the sauce over the fish
5. Cover with a sheet of aluminium foil and bake in a preheated oven at 180c 40 - 50 minutes baste the fish with the sauce at least once during cooking
6. (cooking time will vary depending on the type and size of your fillets so check after 30 minutes
7. When cooked , decorate each fillet with finely sliced lime and a little fresh chopped parsley and serve with sabzi polow

title: cheese blintz casserole
steps:
1. Mix the first 7 ingredients in a blender until blended
2. Add the flour and mix again
3. Pour half of batter mixture into a 9" square greased or pamd casserole
4. Bake at 350 for about 10 min or until set
5. Mix the remaining ingredients to make the filling
6. Spread filling evenly over the baked bottom layer
7. Re-stir the remaining batter and pour it over the filling , trying to cover all the cheese layer
8. Bake at 350 for about 40 min or until slightly browned
9. Optional - brush top with melted butter the last 5 minute

title: mussels sailor style  moules mariniere
steps:
1. Place mussels in bowl and cover with cold water
2. Discard any that are open or cracked
3. Scrub under cold running water and remove beards
4. Melt butter in a large pot , stir in shallots and garlic and saute gently until soft
5. Add wine and bouquet garni
6. Bring to a boil for 2 minutes
7. Add a pinch of salt and black pepper to taste
8. Add mussels and cover pot
9. Cook over high heat until mussels open
10. Remove mussels from pot with a slotted spoon , set aside
11. Discard any mussels that did not open
12. Boil the remaining liquid until reduced to half , then return mussels to the pan and heat through
13. Sprinkle with parsley and stir
14. Place mussels into a warmed serving dish and pour liquid over top
15. Serve

title: colors of life salad
steps:
1. For the balsamic vinaigrette:
2. Place the shallots and vinegar in a small mixing bowl and whisk to combine
3. Continue whisking and slowly add the olive oil
4. Season to taste with salt and pepper
5. For the grilled chicken:
6. Spray the grill grate with nonstick cooking spray and then preheat the grill to medium-high
7. Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper
8. Grill the chicken on both sides until it is cooked through , about 4 to 6 minutes per side depending on the thickness
9. Transfer the chicken breasts to a cutting board and let cool
10. For the green salad:
11. Slice the chicken breasts into strips and place them in a mixing bowl
12. Add the black olives , red bell pepper and half of the balsamic vinaigrette
13. Place the lettuce in a separate salad bowl and toss it with the remaining vinaigrette
14. Arrange the chicken , black olive and red bell pepper mixture on top and serve

title: my secret tabouli
steps:
1. Cook wheat berries at a high simmer for about 2 hours
2. This goes a little faster if you soak them overnight
3. Drain remaining water and run the wheat under cold water for a couple of minutes
4. Strain and set aside
5. Chop olives , parsley , mint , spinach , onion , garlic and tomatoes
6. Put all ingredients in large bowl
7. Add the wheat berries to bowl
8. Add lemon juice , soy sauce and olive oil
9. Mix together well
10. Add salt to taste
11. Enjoy !
12. This recipe keeps in the fridge for a least a week if needed
13. Just add a little lemon juice , if needed
14. This is a great recipe to make ahead for parties

title: raspberry jam squares
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease and flour a 9x9 inch pan
3. Set aside
4. Cream butter and sugar
5. Add egg and vanilla
6. Sift together flour , baking powder and salt
7. Add to creamed batter
8. Add in the coconut and nuts
9. Put about 2 / 3 of batter in the prepared pan
10. Spread jam over and spoon drop remaining batter on top
11. Bake at 350 degrees for 35-40 minutes

title: singapore five spice stir fry
steps:
1. Cook pasta per package directions
2. Drain and cover to keep warm
3. Meanwhile in a small bowl , combine all sauce ingredients and mix until blended
4. Set aside
5. Spray a nonstick skillet or wok with nonstick cooking spray
6. Heat over medium-high heat until hot
7. Add mushrooms , carrots , onion , and garlic
8. Cook and stir 4-5 minutes
9. Add broccoli , cover , and cook 2-4 minutes or until vegetable are crisp-tender , stirring occasionally
10. Add sauce , cook and stir 2-3 minutes or until bubbly and thickened
11. Serve over pasta

title: pastor tom s tortilla soup
steps:
1. Blend tomatoes , onion , garlic , cilantro and sugar
2. Add blended ingredients to a large pot
3. Add in chicken broth , chipotle pepper and adobe sauce
4. Bring to boil , cover and simmer for 20 minute
5. In individual soup bowls add: tortilla chips , cheese and sour cream
6. Ladle hot soup on top and serve immediatley

title: baked pizza dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Beat the cream cheese and italian seasoning until well blended
3. Spread onto the bottom of a 9" pie plate
4. Top with 1 cup of the cheese and the pizza sauce
5. Sprinkle with the remaining cheese and desired toppings and parmesan cheese
6. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until the mixture is thoroughly heated and the cheese is melted
7. Serve hot

title: carbonade flamande   flemish beef  and beer stew casserole
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 170c , 340f , gas mark 3
2. Make sure the pieces of beef are thoroughly dry , using paper towels
3. In a flame-proof casserole , heat the butter and olive oil
4. Add the bacon cubes and fry them until golden
5. Remove with a slotted spoon
6. Reserve
7. Make sure your flame-proof casserole is thoroughly heated
8. Place the pieces of beef and brown them on all sides
9. Remove with a slotted spoon
10. Keep warm
11. Place the onions and garlic on the bottom of the casserole dish and cook until transparent
12. Season well with salt and pepper
13. Add the sugar and mix thoroughly
14. Cook until a light caramelisation appears then add the red wine vinegar
15. Mix thoroughly then cook for 2 minutes
16. Add the cooked beef and bacon to the dish
17. Mix carefully to make sure there is a full marriage of the flavours of the meat with the onions
18. Pour the beer then the beef stock until the meat is entirely covered with liquid
19. Add the bouquet garni
20. Cut the slices of bread then spread dijon mustard on the bread
21. Cover the meat with the bread
22. Place in the oven
23. The carbonade should cook slowly between 2 and 3 hours , or in a crockpot for up to 5 hours on high
24. When cooked mix the bread thoroughly by breaking it up in the dish , the bread works as a thickener for the sauce
25. Taste then adjust the seasoning
26. Serve hot
27. In belgium the carbonade will be served with chips / fries / frites
28. In northern france , it will be served with either braised chicory in butter or red cabbage

title: severed fingers halloween cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Line two baking sheets with silpats or parchment paper , and set aside
3. Place food coloring in a shallow bowl
4. Crack each whole almond into halves
5. And toss them into the bowl with the food coloring and stir them until the color is evenly distributed
6. Leave them in the bowl and stir them every so often until the color is as dark as you like
7. Separate 1 egg
8. Set aside the white
9. In a small bowl , whisk together yolk , remaining egg , and vanilla
10. Set aside
11. In the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the paddle attachment , combine butter , confectioners' sugar , granulated sugar , and salt
12. Beat on medium speed until well combined
13. Add egg mixture , and beat until smooth , about 2 minutes
14. Add the flour , and mix on low speed just until incorporated
15. Wrap the dough in plastic , and chill until firm , 20 to 30 minutes
16. Divide the dough in half
17. Work with one piece at a time , keeping remaining dough covered with plastic wrap and chilled
18. Divide the first half into fifteen pieces
19. On a lightly floured surface , roll each piece back and forth with palms into finger shapes , 3 to 4 inches long
20. Pinch dough in two places to form knuckles
21. Score each knuckle lightly with the back of a small knife
22. Transfer fingers to prepared baking sheets
23. Repeat with remaining dough
24. When all fingers are formed , brush lightly with egg white
25. Position almond nails
26. Push into dough to attach
27. Bake until lightly browned , about 12 minutes
28. Cool completely
29. To keep them from puffing out too much roll the fingers extra skinny
30. I also try to get them out of the oven before they brown
31. I sometimes add a bit of almond extract to dough

title: indian spinach and potatoes
steps:
1. Put the potatoes in a large pot of salted water and bring to a boil
2. Boil over moderate heat until tender when pierced with a knife , about 25 minutes
3. Drain and let cool , then halve the potatoes
4. Meanwhile , in a large , deep skillet , bring the water to a boil
5. Working in batches , add the spinach by handfuls and cook over moderately high heat until wilted
6. Using tongs , transfer the spinach to a colander and repeat with the remaining spinach
7. Squeeze the spinach dry , then transfer it to a food processor and puree
8. Wipe out the skillet
9. Heat the oil in the same skillet
10. Add the onion and cook over moderately high heat , stirring occasionally , until beginning to brown , about 8 minutes
11. Add the garlic , ginger and jalapeos and cook , stirring , until fragrant , about 3 minutes
12. Add the chopped tomatoes and cilantro and cook over moderate heat until most of the liquid has evaporated , about 10 minutes
13. Add the coriander , cumin , paprika and garam masala to the skillet and cook , stirring , for about 2 minutes
14. Slowly stir in the yogurt
15. Add the potatoes and a large pinch of salt , cover and cook over moderately low heat for 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
16. Add the pureed spinach and stir well
17. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes to blend the flavors
18. Season with salt
19. Transfer the potatoes and spinach to a platter or bowl , garnish with the cilantro leaves and serve

title: desert sour cream potatoes
steps:
1. Parboil potatoes until a fork can pierce through the potato easily
2. Let cool to touch
3. Preheat oven to 350f
4. Grate potatoes and then add remaining ingredients and mix
5. Transfer mixture into an ungreased casserole and bake until completely hot about 45 minutes , depending on the size of the casserole dish

title: stuffed salmon in phyllo pastry
steps:
1. Stuffing:mix gently in a bowl crab , cream cheese , onion , salt , pepper& hot sauce
2. Preparation of fish--------
3. Make a slit in each fillet about 3 / 4 way through
4. Divide the stuffing evenly between the 6 fillets
5. And stuff each one
6. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a hot skillet and brown the salmon fillets on both sides
7. Take out 2 sheets of phyllo pastry and cut them in half , lightly brush each piece with melted butter and layer them
8. Place a fillet with an asparagus spear on top of the phyllo and fold the pastry over the salmon so it is completely covered
9. Repeat with remaining 5
10. You may now place the salmon in the fridge , covered , until ready to bake
11. When ready to bake , preheat oven to 350f bake 20-25 minutes
12. Nice served with a white wine sauce or hollandaise

title: sally s christmas shortbread
steps:
1. Beat butter , brown sugar , orange zest , ginger and cloves until fluffy
2. Stir in baking soda and flour
3. Divide dough in half
4. Press into 8" round ungreased baking pans
5. Bake in a 350 degree fahrenheit oven for 25 minutes or until the tops are dry and cracked , and the edges are slightly higher than the center
6. Cool in the pans for 5 minutes
7. Cut into wedges
8. Prick each wedge with the tines of a fork
9. Cool and dust with confectioner's sugar
10. Store tightly covered

title: shortcut skillet frittata
steps:
1. Heat oil in skillet , add potatoes and green pepper , cook for 5 minutes or until brown
2. Mix eggs and milk
3. Pour mixture evenly over potatoes and sprinkle with bacon
4. Cover
5. Reduce heat to low
6. Cook 8 minutes
7. Sprinkle with cheese and cover
8. Heat until cheese is melted
9. Cut into wedges

title: pear pickles
steps:
1. As you prepare the pears add them to the fruit fresh bath
2. Tie pickling spice , cloves and ginger root in a spice bag
3. Prepare liquid by combining the spice bags , sugar , water , vinegar and lemon slices in a large stainless steel or enamel saucepan
4. Bring to a boil , cover and boil gently for 5 min
5. Transfer pears to pickling liquid to create a single layer
6. Cook 7 minutes
7. Remove and place in a large bowl
8. Repeat until all pears are cooked
9. When all the pears are cooked pour the pickling liquid over them
10. Cover and let stand 12-18 hours-in a cool place
11. Pack pears in clean hot jars-remove spice bags and bring liquid to a boil
12. Pour over pears leaving 1 / 2 inch head space
13. Seal and process 15 minutes at altitudes up to 1000 feet

title: easy pumpkin oat muffins
steps:
1. Combine first 7 dry ingredients in large bowl and mix well
2. Beat egg , pumpkin filling , and melted butter together in small bowl until smooth
3. Add pumpkin mixture to dry ingredients
4. Stir just until moistened
5. Fill greased muffin cups almost full
6. Bake at 375f for 20-25 minutes , or until top springs back when lightly touched
7. Once cool , frost away !

title: easy shrimp parmesan
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , cook onion in hot butter until tender
2. Add garlic , salt , red pepper and white pepper
3. Stir in whipping cream , parmesan cheese , and catsup
4. Bring to boiling
5. Reduce heat
6. Simmer , uncovered , stirring occasionally , about 15 minutes or until sauce thickens
7. Stir in cooked shrimp and snipped basil
8. Serve shrimp mixture over hot cooked rice or pasta

title: easy crock pot meatball minestrone
steps:
1. In a nonstick skillet , heat oil over medium heat
2. Add meatballs and brown on all sides
3. Just before they are completely browned , add the onion to the skillet and reduce heat to medium-low
4. Continue cooking about 2 more minutes or until the onions are soft
5. Add 1 cup of the beef broth to the pan , stirring up all the browned particles from the bottom of the pan
6. Carefully pour contents of skillet into your crock pot
7. I used a 4-quart sized crock pot
8. Add the rest of the beef broth , tomatoes , carrots , celery , green pepper , oregano , basil and parsley to the crock pot
9. Cover and cook on lo for 6 to 8 hours
10. Turn the heat to hi
11. Add the macaroni and rinsed and drained beans
12. Stir
13. Cover and cook about 30 minutes until the macaroni is fully cooked
14. Taste before serving
15. If necessary , adjust seasoning
16. Serve in soup bowls with grated parmesan cheese on top

title: swede casserole
steps:
1. Simmer swedes in lightly salted water for about 20 minutes or until tender
2. Drain and mash or press through a sieve with a wooden spoon
3. Add the flour and half the butter , stirring all the time , then slowly beat in the cream until the mixture is light and fluffy
4. Season to taste with salt , pepper , nutmeg and sugar
5. Add the egg and pour the mixture into a well buttered oven proof dish
6. Sprinkle the breadcrumbs on to , dot with reamaining butter and bake in oven at 180c for about an hour , until the top is lightly browned

title: speedy salsa beef chile
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat
2. Add beef and cook until no longer pink
3. Dice onion and celery and add to pot
4. Sprinkle garlic , chile powder , and cumin over beef
5. Stir in onion and celery and saute 2-3 minutes
6. Stir in tomatoes , water , , salsa , and corn
7. Bring to a boil and simmer 15 minutes
8. Rinse and drain kidney beans and add to pot
9. Cook covered until beans are tender-about 5 minutes

title: best creamy chicken lasagna
steps:
1. Reserve 2 / 3 c mozza for top
2. In med bowl combine soup , milk , nutmeg , pepper and set aside
3. In another bowl combine spinach , egg and ricotta , mix well
4. In bottom of 9x13 spread 1 / 2 soup mix
5. Arrange 4 noodles on top
6. Top with 1 / 3 of remaining soup , 1 / 2 of spinach , 1 / 2 of mozza and 1 / 2 of chicken
7. Repeat layers ending with remaining noodles , soup and reserved 2 / 3 cup mozza and parmesan
8. Bake at 350 for 40 minutes
9. Let stand 15 minutes

title: coconut plantation bread
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingredients
2. Stir well
3. Mix milk , egg , and vanilla
4. Stir well
5. Stir into flour mixture
6. Cover and let stand 20 minutes
7. Pour into greased 9 inch loaf pan
8. Bake at 325 for 60 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean
9. Let cool in pan 10 minutes
10. Remove and cool on rack

title: mussels in yummilicious lemongrass broth
steps:
1. Place stock , ginger , lemongrass and lemon rind in a saucepan over high heat
2. Bring the broth to the boil then add the mussels and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the mussels open
3. Discard any mussels that don't open
4. Serve mussels in deep bowls with the broth and some bread or with some cooked pasta

title: grammy s bbq sauce
steps:
1. Toss all ingredients into a pot
2. Cook over medium heat and bring to slow boil then reduce heat to lower setting and continue cooking for about 15 to 30 min longer
3. Best if used on ribs or chicken
4. Can use this sauce if baking or bbq
5. Usually , depending on the qty i am cooking , i have to double or triple this recipe

title: butteries
steps:
1. Combine all of the listed ingredients
2. Use small or large cup muffin tins , ungreased
3. Fill to top of each muffin cup
4. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 min

title: bali wings
steps:
1. Arrange wings on greased or greased foil lined baking tray
2. If using whole wings discard
3. Bake in oven for 30 minutes at 300
4. Stir first 6 ingrediants together well in saucepan
5. Stir in water , vinegar and soya sauce
6. Heat and stir until it boils and thickens
7. Brush over wings
8. Continue to bake for another 15 to 20 minutes , until tender and brushing sauce on at least 2 more times

title: tortellini broccoli soup
steps:
1. Thinly slice the garlic clove lengthwise , then cut the slices in slivers
2. Combine the broth with the garlic in a small saucepan
3. Over high heat , bring to a boil
4. Reduce the heat to medium and simmer 5 minutes
5. Add the tortellini , broccoli and carrot , and cook a few minutes longer , until the vegetables are tender
6. Season to taste with salt and pepper
7. Sprinkle with cheese if you like

title: homemade spaghetti
steps:
1. In a large pot boiling water , add a pinch of salt for flavor & add pasta
2. Cook according to package directions
3. Drain & set aside
4. While pasta is cooking , in a large skillet add oil
5. Once oil is hot , add ground beef , onions , garlic & green peppers
6. Cook until ground beef & cooked thoroughly & onions are translucent
7. Drain
8. Add ground beef mixture back into skillet & add tomatoes , tomato paste , water , chicken bouillon cubes , oregano , basil & brown sugar
9. Stir
10. Bring to a boil , stirring occasionally
11. Reduce to med
12. Heat to bring the sauce to a simmer
13. Cover with a lid & stir occasionally for about 10 minutes
14. On a large platter , place pasta & then top with spaghetti sauce
15. Top with grated parmesan cheese & parsley
16. Serve with a salad & garlic bread

title: volcano ice cream sundae
steps:
1. Run a knife around the edge to get the ice cream out in one piece
2. You may have to dip the container in hot water
3. Place ice cream upside down on a platter
4. Cut sharp edges from the top and sides to slope the ice cream in the shape of a mountain
5. Pour shell over the top
6. Let harden and then add hot fudge
7. In a little bowl , take 3 or 4 sugar cubes and pour lemon extract over the cubes
8. Open 3 or 4 cherries and stick one of those sugar cubes in each one
9. Put the sugar cube / cherry in the center on the top of chocolate covered "volcano"
10. Light sugar cubes with a match to set fire
11. Voila !

title: florentines   fiorentine  florentine cookies
steps:
1. Finely chop walnuts , almonds , raisins , orange and lemon peel , cherries , and ginger
2. Melt butter in a saucepan , then add sugar and stir over low heat until sugar is dissolved
3. Bring to a boil and let it boil for 1 minute without stirring
4. Remove from heat and mix well with cream and fruit-nut mixture
5. Spoon heaped teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet , leaving plenty of space for spreading- try only doing four at a time until you see how large they spread
6. Bake at 300 degrees f for 10 minutes or until golden brown
7. Let cool on cookie sheet for 1 minute before carefully removing with spatula
8. Melt chocolate in double boiler or microwave and spread thinly on flat side of cookies

title: eggnog pie
steps:
1. Cook mix as directed on package for pie filling , except using 2 cups eggnog and 1 1 / 4 cups milk
2. Stir in rum and nutmeg
3. Pour into crust
4. Cover surface with plastic wrap
5. Chill several hours
6. Garnish with whipped cream and nutmeg

title: cheesy steak sandwich pockets
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. In a frying pan , heat oil
3. When it's hot add steak and red peppers and cook until the steak is done to how you like it
4. Remove pan from heat and stir in basil
5. Cut pizza dough into 3 equal pieces
6. Let sit at room temperature for a few minutes so it's easier to work with
7. Roll out each piece and stretch the dough until it is round and about 6" wide
8. Patch up any holes and place dough circles on a cookie sheet
9. Place 1 / 3 of the steak and pepper mixture on one half of each dough round , keeping 1 / 2" of the border uncovered
10. Cover each with 1 piece of cheese
11. Fold the dough over and press down on the edges gently with a fork to seal
12. Place cookie sheet in oven and bake sandwich pockets for 9-12 minutes or until pockets are lightly browned

title: chili and lemon crumbed white fish with coconut rice
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 200c
2. Coconut rice
3. Start with the rice
4. Rinse rice under cold water until water runs clear
5. Drain
6. Combine rice with water , cream and sugar in a saucepan , bring to the boil , stirring occasionally
7. Reduce heat
8. Simmer covered , 15-20 min's or until rice is tender , stir from time to time to prevent rice from sticking to the bottom of the pan
9. Remove from heat and stand covered for 5 min's , stir in green onion , reserving a few to use as a garnish for the top
10. For the fish
11. While rice is cooking combine panko flakes , chili , garlic , rind and butter in a bowl
12. Place fish on an oiled tray or oven proof dish
13. Drizzle fish with lemon juice , pat crumb mixture onto fish
