14. Cook uncovered 10-15 min's or until fish is cooked through , if using thin fillets that will cook quick so that the topping will not brown and crisp , just turn the grill on for a few minutes towards the end of cooking to brown
15. My fish cooked perfectly in 15 minutes and gave a wonderful brown crispy coating to the topping
16. To serve: place fish on plate serve rice on the side garnish rice with green onion

title: trader joe s grilled zucchini salad
steps:
1. Heat grill on medium-high heat
2. Split zucchini lengthwise and toss with one tablespoon of oil , salt & pepper
3. Grill the zucchini cut side down until cooked
4. Remove zucchini from grill and place in a bowl with tomatoes , garlic , shallot , balsalmic vinegar , and remaining olive oil
5. Toss and season with salt and pepper if needed

title: potato cauliflower soup
steps:
1. In a soup pot , heat the oil and saut the onions , dill and thyme until tender
2. Add the cauliflower and cook a few minutes
3. Add the stock and potatoes
4. Cover and cook until tender , about 30 minutes
5. Remove from heat
6. With a hand blender , puree the soup to your desired consistency
7. It is nice if you leave a few small chunks
8. Return the pot to the heat
9. Simmer on low and add bay leaves , salt , pepper and soy sauce
10. Adjust to taste
11. Cook 10 more minutes
12. Remove bay leaf before serving

title: savory cheese dollars
steps:
1. Soften the butter and cheddar cheese
2. In a small bowl , whisk together the flour , salt and peppers
3. In a mixing bowl , cream the cheese with the butter until well mixed
4. On low speed , add the flour mixture and beat until well blended
5. Scrape the dough onto a piece of plastic wrap and refrigerate for about 1 hour or until firm
6. Form the dough into three 1-inch-diameter rolls
7. Wrap each roll in plastic wrap and refrigerate up to 3 days or freeze up to 3 months until shortly before serving
8. Place 3 oven racks in the upper and lower thirds of the oven
9. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees
10. If the dough has been frozen , remove it from the freezer and let it rest for a few minutes or until it is easy to slice
11. Slice the dough into 1 / 4-inch slices
12. Place the slices about 1 / 2 inch apart on the cookie sheets
13. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes or until very lightly browned
14. For even baking , rotate the cookie sheets from top to bottom and front to back halfway through the baking period
15. Use a small , angled metal spatula or pancake turner to transfer the cookies to wire racks
16. Serve immediately or at room temperature

title: exotic leg of lamb
steps:
1. Combine the rub ingredients in a small bowl , then rub them into the lamb
2. Cover loosely and let rest for 4 hours at room temperature or overnight in the refrigerator
3. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees
4. Place the lamb in a shallow roasting pan
5. Pour the lemon juice and broth into the pan
6. Place the lamb in the oven and immediately reduce the temperature to 350 degrees
7. Roast the meat , basting occasionally , for 1 hr 40 minute for medium-rare meat , or until a thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the leg registers 140 degrees
8. The internal temperature will rise as it rests
9. 1 / 2 tsp crushed red-pepper flakes can be used as an alternate for the chilies
10. If you prefer the lamb less rare , roast it 10 minutes longer

title: nif s roasted grape tomatoes  try them on the barbecue
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Mix tomatoes , garlic , and olive oil in a bowl
3. Sprinkle with salt and pepper , to taste
4. Place tomatoes in a baking dish large enough for the tomatoes to be in 1 layer
5. Do not overcrowd ! roast for 20 minutes , and then stir
6. Add water if the tomatoes are too dry
7. Bake for 20 to 30 more minutes
8. You will know that the tomatoes are done when they have just begun to shrivel and the liquid in the dish is a bit thicker
9. The skins should have split a bit too
10. Serve immediately

title: mayan banana  ice cream  pie
steps:
1. - line a pie plate with wax paper , hanging over the edges for handles
2. - mix together crust ingredients and press into the bottom and sides of the pie plate
3. - slice bananas and layer over top of the crust and up the sides
4. - mix together cream cheese , cool whip and cinnamon , then fold in the chocolate chips
5. - put it in the freezer overnight to freeze
6. - when ready to serve , take out of freezer and grab the wax paper handles to remove pie to a cutting board
7. - use a hot knife to slice into 8 and serve drizzle with chocolate syrup and crushed walnuts !

title: chocolate peanut butter pie latte
steps:
1. Combine espresso , peanut butter and syrup in cup
2. Fill with steamed milk
3. Top with chocolate whipped cream
4. Garnish with chopped peanuts

title: cajun smothered squash
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Combine 1 tbsp oil and garlic in small bowl
3. Brush garlic-oil mixture over butternut squash pieces , and place on baking sheet
4. Sprinkle each squash piece with 1 / 2 tsp cajun seasoning , and season with salt and pepper , if desired
5. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour , or until squash pieces are tender enough to easily pierce with fork
6. Meanwhile , heat remaining 1 / 4 cup oil in large skillet over medium heat
7. Add onions , bell peppers , and celery , and cook 20 to 25 minutes , or until vegetables are soft and beginning to brown , stirring occasionally
8. Stir flour into onion mixture , and cook 1 minute , or until flour begins to brown , stirring constantly
9. Stir in vinegar , remaining 2 tbsp cajun seasoning , and 6 cups water
10. Season with salt and pepper , if desired
11. Reduce heat to medium-low , and simmer 20 minutes , or until sauce has thickened , stirring occasionally
12. When ready to serve , place 2 squash pieces on plate
13. "smother" with 1 cup onion mixture

title: marzipan bars
steps:
1. Butter a 13x9 inch metal cake pan , line with parchment paper
2. Set aside
3. In a small saucepan , bring rum to boil , stir in cranberries
4. Let cool
5. Meanwhile , in bowl , beat butter with sugar until fluffy
6. Beat in eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition , beat in vanilla and almond extract
7. In separate bowl , whisk flour ground almonds , baking powder and salt , stir into butter mixture just until combined
8. Stir in sliced almonds , cranberry mixture and marzipan
9. Scrape into prepared pan
10. Bake in centre of 350 oven until golden and cake tester inserted in centre comes out clean , 45 minutes
11. Let cool completely in pan on rack
12. Dust with icing sugar
13. Cut into bars
14. Make ahead- layer between waxed paper in airtight container , store for up to 4 days or freeze for up to 1 month

title: marshall field s meatloaf with red pepper sauce
steps:
1. Meatloaf:
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
3. Finely crush croutons and combine with broth in small bowl
4. Let stand 10 minutes
5. Heat oil in skillet
6. Add onions and cook over medium heat 8 to 10 minutes or until soft
7. Set aside
8. In large bowl , beat eggs
9. Mix in pesto , pine nuts , worcestershire sauce , seasoned salt and pepper
10. Add meat , spinach , cooked onion and crouton mixture
11. Mix well
12. Place mixture in bread pan and bake 1 hour and 15 minutes
13. Let stand 10 minutes before slicing
14. Remove from pan and slice
15. Serve topped with sauce
16. Sauce:
17. Rub saucepan with garlic
18. Discard clove
19. Melt 4 tablespoons butter over low heat
20. Add flour and stir until blended
21. Stir in beef broth
22. Stirring constantly , cook sauce until it comes to boil
23. Add salt , pepper and worcestershire sauce
24. Remove from heat , stir
25. Melt remaining 2 tablespoons butter in medium skillet
26. Add bell pepper and cook over medium heat 5 minutes or until it begins to soften
27. Add to reserved brown sauce
28. Adjust seasonings as needed and heat through

title: slow cooked minestrone
steps:
1. In 5- to 5-1 / 2-quart slow cooker
2. Combine beef , undrained tomatoes , broth , cannellini beans , kidney beans , carrots , salt , and pepper
3. Cover and cook on low-heat setting for 8 to 9 hours or on high-heat setting for 4 to 4-1 / 2 hours
4. Add pasta and squash to cooker
5. Cover and cook 30 to 45 minutes more or until pasta is tender
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Top with parmesan cheese
8. Makes 8 servings

title: aunt jenny s deep fried seasoned pork chops
steps:
1. 1
2. Preheat deep fryer to 375 degrees
3. 2
4. Whisk together egg and milk
5. 3
6. In large bowl combine flour , salt , lawry's , garlic powder , pepper , italian herb seasoning , meat tenderizer , accent , hungarian paprika and ground cayenne pepper
7. Stir until mixed well
8. 4
9. Pound out pork chops with meat tenderizing hammer on both sides and cut in half along the width so that you have 20 halves
10. 5
11. Place half of the halves in the egg / milk mixture and let sit for 2 - 5 minutes
12. 6
13. Coat each piece well with flour mixture until completely covered and gently shake off excess
14. 7
15. Deep-fry chops , 5-8 pieces at a time for 4 - 5 minutes , until golden brown and crispy
16. Allow chops that are waiting to be fried to soak in the milk / egg mixture until ready to coat with flour
17. 8
18. Drain well
19. Repeat process for remaining chops until all are fried and serve !

title: beefy spinach and rice
steps:
1. Combine rice , barley , butter and water in large microwave safe bowl
2. Microwave on high for approximately 30 minutes , or until it reaches desired consistency and water is absorbed
3. While rice and barley are cooking , cook and brown ground beef
4. Drain fat and set aside
5. Saut and caramelize onion and slivered garlic
6. Combine cooked rice and barley , beef , onions , garlic and mushroom soup
7. Add beef broth to desired consistency
8. Place in casserole dish and top with bread crumbs if desired
9. Heat in oven as desired

title: roasted chicken with caramelized onions
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Bring garlic and milk to boil
3. Drain and discard milk
4. In a small metal baking pan toss garlic with 1 t oil
5. Roast 13 minutes or until golden
6. Cool a bit and put the garlic and it's cooking oil in a food processor
7. Process to a paste
8. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and set aside
9. Saute the onions in the butter and 1 t oil over medium-low heat
10. Cook until golden , about 40 minutes
11. Add vinegar , thyme and bay leaf and simmer until liquid is reduced by half , about 3 minutes
12. Stir in cream and salt and pepper
13. Set aside
14. While the onions are sauteing , preheat the oven to 450
15. Heat the remaining 1 t of oil in a large skillet
16. Salt and pepper the chicken
17. Place skin side down in skillet and cook until golden brown on one side only , about 4 minutes
18. Place chicken , skin side up , on a rimmed baking sheet and roast until internal temperature is 180
19. Spread garlic paste atop chicken pieces and bake another 5 minutes , until golden brown
20. Rewarm onions over medium-low heat
21. To serve plate onions and place 2 pieces of chicken atop them
22. Garnish with parsley

title: simple ice cream   thermomix
steps:
1. Vanilla ice cream:
2. Insert butterfly
3. Add cream and vanilla to bowl and mix on speed 2 as you pour the condensed milk into the mix through the lid
4. Once all in increase to speed 3 for 2-3 minutes until mixture is thick and creamy
5. Pour into suitable container and freeze until set
6. Variations:
7. Fold through chosen variant speed 2 reverse counter-clockwise operation 5 secs
8. The variation ingredient may not be completely through the mix , but as you pour it into the freezing container it will mix a bit more
9. Adjust this time to your preference

title: carrot cake  jar mix
steps:
1. Combine and blend ingredients in a small bowl
2. Store in an airtight container
3. Attach this to the jar
4. Carrot cake
5. Makes 1 13x9-inch cake
6. 1 package carrot cake mix
7. 1 1 / 2 cups vegetable oil
8. 3 large eggs
9. 3 cups grated carrots
10. 1 can crushed pineapple
11. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f& grease 13x9 inch pan
12. Place carrot cake mix in large mixing bowl
13. Make a well in the center of the mix& add the oil , eggs , carrots& pineapple
14. Blend until smooth
15. Pour into the prepared pan& bake for 40 to 50 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted into center comes out clean
16. Cool the cake and frost if desired or dust with powdered sugar

title: finnish salmon potato chowder
steps:
1. Melt butter in a dutch oven over medium heat
2. Add chopped onion , and saut for 5 minutes
3. Sprinkle onion mixture with celery salt
4. Stir in flour , and cook for 1 minute , stirring constantly
5. Gradually add clam juice
6. Bring mixture to a boil , and cook for 1 minute or until thick , stirring constantly
7. Add potato cubes and carrot slices , and stir in milk
8. Bring to a boil
9. Reduce heat , and simmer for 10 minutes
10. Break salmon into chunks
11. Add salmon , chopped dill , and worcestershire sauce to pan
12. Bring chowder to a boil
13. Reduce heat , and simmer for 10 minutes or until potato is tender

title: rich and creamy chocolate mini cheesecakes    low fat
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300f
2. Line 6 medium muffin cups with foil liners
3. Grease the foil cups and sprinkle the base of each cup with 1 tsp cracker crumbs
4. In a blendor or food processor , process remaining ingredients except egg until smooth
5. Gently blend in egg and mix until just combined
6. Divide batter among prepared muffin cups
7. Bake in preheated oven for about 12 minutes
8. Or until edges are just set
9. Turn off oven and leave the cakes in oven for 1 hour
10. Remove from oven and cool to room temperature
11. Chill for at least 4 hours before serving

title: cranberry cornmeal quick bread
steps:
1. Position rack in center of oven and preheat to 350f
2. Spray 9x5x3-inch metal loaf pan with nonstick spray
3. Whisk both flours , cornmeal , splenda , salt , and baking powder in large bowl
4. Whisk buttermilk , melted margarine , maple syrup , egg whites , and extract in medium bowl
5. Add buttermilk mixture to flour mixture
6. Stir just until blended
7. Stir in chopped pecans and the cranberries
8. Spoon batter into pan
9. Arrange pecan halves in row down center of batter
10. Bake bread until top is golden brown and a tester inserted into center of bread comes out clean , tenting bread loosely with foil if browning too quickly , about 1 hour 10 minutes
11. Cool in pan on rack 20 minutes
12. Turn out onto rack
13. Cool

title: peppers and steak for crock pot
steps:
1. Cut steak into serving size portions
2. Place 1 / 2 the steak in crock pot
3. Arrange green peppers on steak
4. Place remaining steak on top
5. Mix remaining ingredients together and pour over meat
6. Cover and cook on low for 8-10 hours or high 4-5 hours serve over white rice

title: chocolate p nut butter pie   shenanigan s restaurant  tacoma  wa
steps:
1. Chocolate peanut butter pie
2. Make the chocolate cookie crust:
3. 1 1 / 2 cup crushed chocolate cream filled cookies
4. 1 / 4 cup course ground amonds
5. 1 / 4 cup sugar
6. 1 / 4 t
7. Cinnamon
8. 1 / 8 t
9. Mace
10. 1 / 8 t
11. Fresh grated nutmeg
12. 1 / 4 cup melted butter
13. 1 t
14. Vanilla
15. 1 t
16. Dark rum
17. Combine cookie crumbs , sugar , cinnamon , mace , nutmeg and almonds
18. Melt butter
19. Add vanilla and rum
20. Pour butter mixture into crumbs and toss to blend well
21. Spray 9-inch pie plate with pam
22. Press crumbs evenly into bottom and sides of pan
23. Set aside in cool place
24. Make the pie filling:
25. 1 cup whipping cream
26. 1 t
27. Vanilla
28. 8 oz
29. Cream cheese , softened
30. 1 cup sugar
31. 1 cup peanut butter
32. 1 t
33. Melted butter
34. Beat whipping cream until firm peaks form , then beat in vanilla
35. In separate bowl beach cream cheese until fluffy
36. Slowly beat in sugar , peanut butter and melted butter
37. Blend 1 / 3 of whipped cream mixture into peanut butter mixture
38. Fold in remaining whipped cream
39. Turn into chocolate cookie crust , smoothing top with spatula
40. Wrap with plastic and chill two hours or overnight
41. Make the chocolate topping:
42. 4 oz
43. Semi sweet chocolate
44. 2 t
45. Butter
46. 2 t
47. Oil
48. Combine all 3 ingredients in a double boiler or micro dish
49. Cook slowly until chocolate melts
50. Remove from heat and cool slightly
51. Spread evenly over top of cooled pie , starting at the center and working outward
52. Sprinkle top of pie with 1 / 4 cup chopped peanuts
53. Slice extraordinarily thin - many people find it difficult to finish even one tiny slice !

title: brianna s herbed kidney bean spread
steps:
1. Put all ingredients in a bowl or blender
2. Pure until smooth
3. Either chill or serve at room temperature

title: cornbread   sausage stuffing
steps:
1. Cook sausage in large skillet until browned
2. Remove with slotted spoon& drain
3. Saute onion& celery in remaining sausage drippings until tender
4. Combine sausage , sauteed vegetables , bread cubes , cornbread , sage , marjoram& pepper in a large mixing bowl
5. Blend well
6. Moisten with chicken broth
7. Mixture can be stuffed into turkey , or placed into a greased 13x9 baking dish& dot with butter
8. Cover& bake 20 minutes at 350f
9. Uncover& bake 10 minutes more , or until golden brown

title: thai barbecued oysters
steps:
1. Sprinkle a layer of rock salt in a 15x10x1-inch jellyroll pan
2. Set aside
3. Scrub oyster shells and open , discarding tops
4. Arrange oysters over rock salt
5. Brush oysters on half shells with barbecue sauce
6. Combine breadcrumbs and remaining ingredients in a small bowl
7. Stir well
8. Sprinkle evenly over oysters
9. Bake at 425 for 12 minutes or until oysters begin to curl

title: broccoli and cheese to please
steps:
1. Place broccoli in 9 1 / 2 square shallow baking dish
2. Stir soup and milk in a small bowl
3. Pour soup mixture over brocolli
4. Mix bread crumbs with butter in a small bowl
5. Sprinkle over broccoli and cheese
6. Bake at 400 fo 25 minutes or until hot and bread crumbs are golden
7. Serve hot or cool

title: honey   nut cheerios squares
steps:
1. Measure honey and sugar into a large saucepan
2. Heat just to boiling
3. Add peanut butter and stir until melted
4. Remove from heat and stir in cheerios , mixing thoroughly to coat evenly
5. Fold into a buttered 13x9 pan
6. Allow to cool one minute
7. With slightly wet hands , gently press mixture down so that bars will be compact and hold their shape
8. Allow to cool thoroughly , about 15 minutes
9. Cut into squares

title: maple stewed dumplings
steps:
1. Combine biscuit mix and milk in bowl
2. Stir until just combined
3. In large saucepan combine syrup and water
4. Heat to boiling over medium heat
5. Drop batter by spoonfuls into the boiling liquid
6. Cook at a gently boil 5 minutes then reduce heat
7. Cover pan and simmer 10 minutes longer
8. Serve warm with whipped cream

title: strawberry sorbet sensation
steps:
1. Line a 8x4 loaf pan with heavy-duty foil
2. Spoon sorbet into pan , freeze for 15 minutes
3. In a small bowl , whisk milk and pudding mix for 2 minutes
4. Let stand for 2 minutes or until soft-set
5. Set aside 1 / 2 cup whipped topping for garnish
6. Refrigerate until serving
7. Fold remaining whipped topping into pudding and spoon mixture over sorbet
8. Cover and freeze for 4 hours or overnight
9. Remove from the freezer 10-15 minutes before serving
10. Unmold onto a serving plate and remove foil
11. Serve with the strawberries and reserved whipped topping

title: second day chicken soup
steps:
1. In 8 quart dutch oven , combine chicken & trimmings / bones , water , broth , boullion cubes , bay leaf , cream soup & seasonings
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat , cover & simmer 90 minutes
4. Strain the soup to separate liquid from the chicken and bones
5. Allow the chicken to cool a bit in the strainer , then separate the chicken from the bones , returning the chicken to the broth and discarding the bones , etc
6. Stir in barley or rice and return to a boil
7. Reduce heat , cover & simmer 30 minutes
8. Add veggies & simmer an additional 25-30 minutes
9. You can substitue or add other veggies , etc
10. A word of caution for noodles , though
11. While they taste great , they absorb a lot of the liquid , so leftovers end up with somewhat bloated noodles and not much broth
12. It still tastes nice , but doesn't look as appealing :-)

title: butternut squash baked with brown onion soup and butter
steps:
1. Slice butternut into 2 inch thick rings , place butternut on foil
2. Sprinkle the brown onion soup powder over butternut dot with nuts of butter fold foil into a parcel to prevent the butternut , soup and butter from falling out bake at 160c for 30 to 40 minutes

title: puerto rican pot roast
steps:
1. Make a deep cut with a sharp knife across the meat
2. Combine salt pork , capers , oregano and vinegar with half the peppers , chilies and onions
3. Add 1 t oil
4. Pound into a smooth mixture and stuff this mixture into the cut in the roast
5. Melt lard in large saucepan and brown meat on all sides over high heat for 10 minutes
6. Add water , salt and remaining peppers , chilies and onions
7. Bring to a boil and simmer over moderate heat for 2 to 2 and 1 / 4 hours
8. Add potatoes , tomato and tomato puree , mixed with the rest of the olive oil
9. Stir into pot
10. Bring back into boil and cook , uncovered , for 30 minutes or until potatoes are soft and the sauce thickens

title: anne s famous irish corned beef
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Place corned beef on a rack in a pan , fat side up , and cover with tin foil
3. Cook for 3-4 hours
4. Mix yellow mustard and brown sugar in a bowl
5. Uncover corned beef
6. Score the top of the corned beef , and stick whole cloves in the top if desired
7. Baste with gingerale
8. Spoon mustard sauce on top and sides of beef
9. Place back in oven and cook for another hour or so , until nicely browned and the meat is falling apart

title: mexican breakfast bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit
2. In large saucepot on medium-high , heat oil
3. Add onion , garlic , pepper , and potato
4. Saut for 5 minutes
5. Add tomatoes , beans , cumin , chile powder and paprika
6. Cover and cook for 20 minutes , until potatoes soften
7. Mist 4 16-oz ramekins with cooking spray
8. Place 1 cup vegetable mixture into each ramekin and spread outside edges , making a well in the center
9. Carefully crack 1 egg in center well of each ramekin
10. Bake for 5 minutes , until eggs are set
11. Remove from oven
12. Set oven to broil on high
13. Add ramekins back to oven and broil for 5 minutes , until eggs are soft set
14. Remove from oven and sprinkle each dish with 1 tbsp cilantro , 1 / 4 oz cheese and 2 or 3 slices avocado
15. Serve immediately

title: potato   peanut butter fried bananas  5fix
steps:
1. Warm potatoes 30 seconds in microwave
2. With a spoon make sure potatoes are mashed really good getting all lumps out
3. Add peanut butter and combine with powdered sugar , blend well
4. Place bananas in batter make sure bananas well coated on all sides
5. Drop bananas in hot oil cook for 45-60 seconds
6. Serve with powdered sugar sprinkled on top

title: abruzzi  shrimp pasta sauce
steps:
1. If you plan on using fresh tomatoes , simply wash , take stem area off , and place in blender to puree
2. Place tomatoes , olive oil , whole cloves of garlic , parsley in large pot and cook slowly for 30 minutes , stirring every 15 minutes
3. If using fresh tomatoes , it will need extra cooking time of 15 minutes
4. Garlic cloves should be very soft and sauce should have nice consistency- not watery
5. During last 15 minutes add the shrimp
6. Season to taste with salt and some red pepper flakes if you like
7. Place water to boil in another large pot
8. When boiling add a tablespoon of oil
9. Place pasta in boiling water & stir , stir often
10. Put timer on for exactly 11 minutes
11. Drain pasta , place in large platter & mix together with sauce
12. Enjoy !

title: white chocolate limoncello truffles
steps:
1. Bring cream to a bare simmer with the zest of one lemon
2. Turn the heat off and allow to cool slightly
3. Strain before using for the rest of the recipe
4. Combine the cream , chocolate , and limoncello together until well blended
5. Chill until firm enough to scoop
6. Roll in grated white chocolate or coconut and shape with a fork
7. Keep refrigerated

title: rock your world chicken quesadillas hard rock cafe
steps:
1. Take flour tortilla and sprinkle half of it with cheese and 1 / 4 of cooked chicken
2. Add bacon bits and a little bit of crushed pineapple if desired
3. Pour a little bit of bbq sauce on top
4. Don't be too generous with the sauce or it will seep out of the quesadilla
5. Spray a sauce pan with cooking spray
6. Fold the tortilla in half and place in pan
7. It only takes a few short minutes to brown one side and then flip over to brown the other side
8. When done , cut into wedges and serve with added bbq sauce if you like to dip

title: weight watchers   ice cream  sandwiches del
steps:
1. Break graham cracker in half
2. Spread fruit spread on top of one half
3. Spread cool whip on top of that
4. Sprinkle with chocolate chips
5. Top with other graham cracker half and squoosh down
6. Freeze
7. Eat

title: frozen fudge sundae dessert
steps:
1. Fudge sauce: melt chocolate chips and butter in saucepan
2. Add sugar and milk
3. Bring to a boil and cook till thick and smooth around 5-7 minutes
4. Stir constantly
5. Remove from heat and add vanilla extract
6. Line a 9x13 pan with whole vanilla wafers
7. Dip half of softened ice cream onto cookies , smoothing it flat layer
8. Add half of fudge sauce and sprinkle with some of the nuts
9. Add the rest of the ice cream over the fudge sauce and smooth again for the next layer
10. Add remaining fudge sauce and and top with remaining nuts
11. Freeze for at least 2 hours
12. This can be made in advance and stored in the freezer for company

title: olive garden three meat sauce
steps:
1. Saute onions in a large pot with about 2 tablespoons of olive oil
2. When onions have become translucent , add the two jars of marina sauce and can of chopped tomatoes
3. Turn down to simmer
4. In a large skillet , brown ground beef and italian sausage until completely cooked , drain fat from meat , and add meat into the large pot with the sauce
5. Add chopped pepperoni to the sauce mixture
6. Add 1 teaspoon of italian seasonings to mixture and allow all to simmer for about 20 minutes before you season to taste with salt and pepper

title: sweet and sour ramen chicken
steps:
1. Drain the pineapple juice into a measuring cup and add enough water to measure 2 cups
2. Set aside
3. Cut the chicken into 1-inch pieces and season with ginger
4. Heat a bit of oil and stir fry the chicken for 3-4 minutes
5. Add the pineapple juice and bring to a boil
6. Break the noodles into pieces and add to the skillet with the seasoning packets
7. Bring back to a boil , reduce the heat , and simmer for 3 minutes until the noodles are tender and most of the liquid is absorbed
8. Add the sweet and sour sauce , pepper , onion , and pineapple
9. Cook until the peppers are tender-crisp

title: emily s favorite breakfast pizza
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large skillet
2. Saute onion , green bell pepper , and bacon until tender
3. Add eggs , salt , and pepper to skillet
4. Stir and cook until eggs are almost set , but not runny
5. Place pizza crust in pizza pan or baking stone
6. Spread egg mixture evenly over pizza crust
7. Top with picante sauce
8. Sprinkle with cheese
9. Bake at 400 degrees for 5-10 minutes or until cheese melts
10. Sprinkle with cilantro

title: fish topping
steps:
1. Melt enough butter to coat both side of the fish in a baking dish
2. Sprinkle garlic & onion powder , salt & pepper on both sides of fish
3. Place on the fish mixture of: crab meat , mayonnaise , parsley flakes , round onion
4. Sprinkle over the above mixture: grated parmesan cheese & then the bread crumbs last
5. Bake 350 degrees for 20-25 minutes or until topping is golden brown

title: garlicky greens
steps:
1. Wash and drain greens
2. Warm wok over low heat
3. Add oil
4. Add garlic and chilies , tossing in oil , until they give off fragrance
5. Add greens and cover immediately
6. Cook three minutes , take the lid off , toss the greens and cover again for two more minutes
7. Turn off heat , add salt to taste , and toss
8. Serve

title: strawberry lemonade moonshine
steps:
1. Place a pot on low heat and pour in water and sugar
2. Stir until sugar is completely dissolved
3. Let cool to room temperature
4. Mix in strawberry puree and lemon juice
5. Next add in everclear and stir well
6. Strain mixture through layers of cheesecloth , making sure to remove all pulp
7. Pour mix into a jar and let sit in refrigerator for a few weeks
8. The more time the jars are allowed to sit in refrigerator , the better it will get

title: four grain bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degree f
2. Spread oats and barley in a shallow baking pan
3. Bake about 10 minutes or until light brown , stirring occasionally
4. Cool
5. Transfer oats and barley to a blender or food processor
6. Cover
7. Blend until ground
8. Set aside
9. In a large bowl , stir together 1 cup of the bread flour , the whole wheat flour , and yeast
10. Add warm water , sugar , oil , and salt
11. Beat with an electric mixer on low speed for 30 seconds , scraping bowl constantly
12. Beat on high speed for 3 minutes
13. Using a wooden spoon , stir in cornmeal , oat mixture , and as much of the remaining bread flour as you can
14. Turn out dough onto a lightly floured surface
15. Knead in enough of the remaining bread flour to make a moderately stiff dough that is smooth and elastic
16. Shape into a ball
17. Place in a lightly greased bowl
18. Turn once to grease the surface
19. Cover
20. Let rise in a warm place until double in size
21. Punch down dough
22. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface
23. Cover
24. Let rest for 10 minutes
25. Coat an 8x4x2-inch loaf pan with cooking spray
26. Set aside
27. Shape dough into a loaf
28. Place in prepared loaf pan
29. Cover
30. Let rise in a warm place until nearly double
31. Preheat oven to 375 degree f
32. Bake 40 minutes or until top is golden and bread sounds hollow when tapped
33. Remove from baking pan
34. Cool on a wire rack

title: really easy apple crescents
steps:
1. Set oven to 350f
2. Liberally butter a 9-inch square baking dish
3. Pour the orange juice in the bottom of a buttered baking pan
4. Unroll crescent roll dough , and separate into 8 triangles
5. Slice each lengthwise to make 16 rolls
6. Cut each apple into 16 pieces
7. Place an apple slice at the wide end of each strip , and roll up
8. Arrange the rolls evenly in buttered baking pan
9. Drizzle melted butter over the tops
10. Combine the cinnamon and sugar , sprinkle the mixture over the tops
11. Bake for 30-35 minutes , or until golden

title: easy bake oven quick cake
steps:
1. Preheat easy bake oven 15 minutes
2. Mix cake mix and water
3. Place in greased toy cake pan
4. Bake for 10 minutes
5. Makes 1 serving

title: home fried breakfast potatoes
steps:
1. Wash & cube potatoes into medium size cubes , skin on or off
2. Heat 10" skillet to medium heat , add margarine and olive oil
3. Add potatoes and stir to coat with oil & margarine
4. Add garlic salt and benson's supreme seasoning , stir to coat evenly
5. Cook over medium heat for about 10 minutes , stir frequently
6. Reduce heat , add diced onions , red and yellow bell pepper , stir frequently
7. Cook for about 5 more minutes , or until potatoes are cooked through
8. Be careful not to overcook the onions and peppers
9. Start this dish first and then get the bacon or sausage going next
10. Start cooking the eggs just before the potatoes finish and everything will finish about the same time

title: chilli tuna pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook the pasta in a large pan of boiling water , uncovered , until it is just tender
2. Drain the pasta , then rinse it under cold water
3. Meanwhile , boil , steam or microwave the beans until just tender , then drain
4. Drain the tuna over a small bowl , reserving the oil for the dressing
5. Flake the tuna into large chunks with a fork
6. Just before serving , combine the pasta , beans tuna , herbs and capers is a large bowl then drizzle with the dressing
7. Serve the salad topped with rocket leaves
8. Dressing
9. Combine all of the ingredients with the reserved chilli oil in a jar and shake well

title: japanese ginger dipping sauce
steps: 1. Put all ingredients in a bowl , and stir well

title: creamy mushroom and bacon soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan or dutch oven pan , cook the bacon over medium heat until crispy
2. Remove the bacon with a slotted spoon and set aside
3. Add the diced shallots to the bacon grease and cook for about 3 minutes , until tender
4. Add the mushrooms , rosemary and garlic to the pan
5. Cook for about 5 minutes , until the mushrooms are tender and golden
6. Return the cooked bacon to the pan
7. Sprinkle the flour over the mushrooms and bacon and stir to coat
8. Cook for about 1 minute , stirring constantly
9. Pour the chicken broth into the pan
10. If desired , add a splash of marsala wine
11. Stir to combine
12. Bring the mixture to a simmer , stirring frequently
13. It should begin to thicken as it simmers
14. Simmer for a few minutes , then reduce heat and add the half and half
15. Remove about a cup of the soup with a bunch of the mushrooms when cool enough to safely handle , blend the cup of soup until smooth
16. Return the blended mixture to the pan with the rest of the soup
17. Or just use a stick blender right in the pan to make a lovely smooth soup
18. Season with the salt and pepper

title: freezer bacon egg and cheese breakfast burritos
steps:
1. In a skillet , fry bacon pieces until crisp
2. Remove to paper towels
3. Drain , reserving 1- 2 tablespoons drippings
4. Beat eggs , salt and pepper and cook in reserved drippings
5. Add green onions just before eggs are done
6. Add bacon and remove from heat
7. Place about 1 / 2 cup of mixture down the center of each tortilla
8. Sprinkle with cheddar cheese
9. Fold bottom and sides of tortilla over filling and place seam side down on a cookie sheet sprayed with pam or lined with parchment paper
10. Freeze overnight or until solid
11. Wrap each in waxed paper and then in aluminum foil and package in freezer bags
12. Store in freezer for up to 1 month
13. To use frozen burritos:
14. Remove foil
15. Place waxed paper-wrapped burritos on a microwave-safe plate
16. Microwave for 1 1 / 2 to 2 minutes or until heated through
17. Let stand for 20 seconds and add sour cream and salsa to taste

title: sizzling steak fajitas
steps:
1. Put skirt steaks in a gallon sized ziploc bag
2. Add the salt , cumin , garlic and onion powders , chili powder , coriander , black pepper , sherry vinegar , cilantro , lime juice and chipotle pepper in a bowl and mix well
3. Pour this mixture over the meat
4. Marinate in the refrigerator for 30 minutes , or overnight for really yummy flavor
5. Preheat grill
6. Grill peppers until charred on all sides , turning , 15 to 20 minutes
7. Transfer to a cutting board , wrap in tin foil , until cool , then peel
8. Grill the onions until nicely browned , 3 to 5 minutes per side
9. Unwrap the peppers
10. Scrape off charred skin of pepper with a knife
11. Scrape out the seeds , and cut into thin inch strips
12. Cut the onions into pieces
13. Grill skirt steaks to taste
14. Slice when done
15. Place the tortillas on grill
16. To serve , place steak and vegetables on a tortilla
17. Add guacamole , sour cream , and salsa on top
18. Wrap and eat

title: chocolate peanut butter terrine
steps:
1. Make the chocolate peanut butter mousse--------------------
2. Lightly grease the bottom and sides of a 9 1 / 4-by-5 1 / 4-by-2 3 / 4-inch metal loaf pan
3. Line the pan with plastic wrap so that the plastic extends about 2 inches beyond the rim of the pan
4. Place the pan in the freezer
5. Fill a medium saucepan one-third of the way with water and bring to a simmer
6. Place the chocolate , butter and peanut butter in a medium metal bowl over the simmering water and melt
7. When melted , set the chocolate mixture aside , keeping it warm
8. In a 4 1 / 2-quart bowl of an electric mixer , using the wire whip attachment , beat the egg yolks at medium speed until wellblended
9. While continuing to beat , add 2 tablespoons of the sugar in a steady stream
10. Remove the bowl from the mixer stand and place over a pot of hot water
11. Cook over medium-high heat , whisking constantly until the mixture is thick and tripled in volume , and registers 140 degrees f for 3 to 5 minutes on an instant read thermometer
12. Remove the bowl from the heat and whisk the mixture until it is room temperature
13. Using a large rubber spatula , gently fold in the reserved chocolate mixture
14. In a chilled stainless steel medium bowl , using a hand-held electric mixer set at medium-high speed , whip the cream and 2 tablespoons of the sugar until soft peaks begin to form
15. Using the rubber spatula , gently fold the whipped cream into the chocolate mixture
16. Carefully scrape the mousse / terrine mixture into the prepared terrine pan
17. Smooth the top with the rubber spatula
18. Tap the pan on the counter to eliminate any air bubbles
19. Cover the top of the terrine with the plastic wrap overhang
20. Refrigerate for at least four hours until set
21. Unmold the terrine------------------------
22. Unfold the plastic wrap from the top of the chilled terrine , and use it to lift the terrine out of the loaf pan
23. Invert the terrine onto a rack set on top of a cookie sheet
24. Remove the plastic wrap from the terrine
25. Glaze the terrine------------------
26. Melt the chocolate and butter
27. Whisk in the corn syrup
28. Remove the melted chocolate from the double boiler and let cool for about 5 told minutes so it can thicken slightly
29. Pour the glaze over the terrine , spreading it evenly over the entire terrine using an offset metal cake spatula
30. Refrigerate until set , about 15 minutes
31. To serve--------------------
32. Slice the terrine with a hot , dry knife into 9 even slices , and then again in half making a total of 18 pieces
33. Place 3 pieces of terrine on each dessert plate
34. Sprinkle with toasted peanuts over the top and sides of the terrine
35. Garnish with sweetened whipped cream and chocolate curls

title: peach salsa with brie and french bread
steps:
1. Heat small or large wheel of brie in 350f oven for approximately 10 minutes or until soft
2. Also heat french bread until warm
3. Prepare salsa ingredients and mix together
4. Serve the peach salsa alongside the brie and french bread
5. This is also great with some blackberry coulis
6. Delish !

title: parmesan green beans
steps:
1. Boil green beans in salt water in a saucepan for about 3 minutes , until tender
2. Drain and return to pan
3. Mix in the rest of the ingredients , saving 1 tablespoon of cheese to top the beans upon serving

title: apricot mustard glazed pork chops  bone in
steps:
1. Season pork with salt and pepper
2. In skillet , heat olive oil over medium-high heat
3. Add chops and onion
4. Cook 3-6 minutes
5. Turn and cook an additional 3-6 minutes
6. Meanwhile , in a small microwave-safe bowl combine preserves , mustard , 1 / 4 cup water , paprika , and nutmeg
7. Heat in microwave for 1 minute or until melted
8. Pour over pork in skillet
9. Reduce heat to medium
10. Cook , covered , 10 minutes or until pork is cooked through

title: chilli jam scallops with asian greens
steps:
1. Steam the chinese broccoli , covered , over a large saucepan of boiling water for 2-3 minutes until just tender
2. Drain and set aside
3. Meanwhile , toss the scallops with 1 tablespoon of the chilli jam
4. Heat a frypan over medium-high heat and add 1 teaspoon of the olive oil
5. When hot , add the scallops and pan-fry for 1 minute on each side until just cooked
6. Remove from the frypan and cover to keep warm
7. Add remaining teaspoon of oil to pan and reduce heat to medium
8. Add onion and cook for 3-4 minutes until softened
9. Add remaining 1 / 2 tablespoon chilli jam and broccoli , tossing to coat
10. Remove from heat and stir in soy
11. Serve vegetables in bowls with scallops

title: rice krispies squares   no sweet tooth needed
steps:
1. In a large pan melt the margarine over a low heat
2. Grease a tray that's about 9 x 11 inches and 2 inches deep
3. Also grease the spoon you'll use for stirring with and something like a cake slice
4. Add the marshmallows and stir till melted
5. Once melted continue to cook for 3 more minutes
6. Remove from heat and add rice cereal and any additional ingredients
7. Mix till all the cereal is coated in marshmallow
8. With the spoon pour the mix out into the greased tray and use the cake slice to press the mixture into the tray
9. If the mix starts to stick to the cake slice you can grease it over top of the marshmallow already stuck on and continue
10. Any mixture left over can be put into greased ramikins
11. Allow to cool
12. This can be sped up in the fridge
13. I cut my squares apart with a large pizza cutter , but any knife will do
14. Squares can then be stored in a tupperware container for around 2 weeks
15. For other flavours add one cup of any of the following: raisins , glacier cherries , cashews , dried cranberries
16. You can also add 1 cup of crunchy peanut butter after you've cooked the marshmallow for 3 minutes , and then continue as normal
17. These tend to come out very crumbly though still nice

title: potatoes con queso    for those who are riced out
steps:
1. A 2 quart pyrex is recommended
2. Melt butter in a medium pan over low heat
3. Add flour , whisking until smooth
4. Cook 1 minute
5. Gradually add milk and cook until smooth
6. Stir in 1& 1 / 2 cups cheese
7. Remove from heat and stir until cheese melts
8. Add pimiento , green chiles , jalapeno , salt and stir well
9. Place half of potato slices in a lightly greased 2 quart baking dish
10. Top with half of cheese mixture and repeat layers
11. Bake covered at 350 for 20 minutes
12. Uncover and bake for 40 more minutes
13. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and heat until the cheese melts and is lightly brown on top !
14. Enjoy something different

title: pink lemonade pie
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , mix together lemonade , sweetened condensed milk , and cool whip until smooth and creamy
2. Pour into pie crust and chill in freezer until set

title: microwave winter pear amaretto jam
steps:
1. Combine pears , apple , apple juice and pectin in a 3 quart microwavable container
2. Microwave , uncovered , on high for 6 minutes or until mixture comes to a boil , stirring twice
3. Add sugar
4. Microwave , uncovered , on high for 4 minutes or until mixture return to a full boil and boil hard for 1 minute
5. Stir in liqueur
6. Ladle into sterilized jars and use inversion method or process in water bath for 10 minutes

title: maple glazed chicken wings
steps:
1. Combine the pure maple syrup , chili sauce , onion , cider vinegar , mustard and worcestershire sauce in a shallow dish
2. Marinate the chicken wings for a minimum of 4 hour on the refrigerator , keeping covered and turning occasionally
3. Grill , oven bake or barbecue the chicken wings until thoroughly cooked , basting occasionally

title: strawberry   raspberry coffee cupcakes
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , add the flour , sugar , baking powder and salt
2. Stir to mix
3. In a second bowl , add the egg , milk , vanilla and butter
4. Stir to mix
5. Add to dry ingredients and stir just until moistened
6. Fill cupcakes liners until about half full
7. Toss strawberries & raspberries with corn starch
8. Place approximately 1 tablespoon of berries evenly over the top of batter in each cupcake
9. To make the topping: combine the flour and sugar in a bowl
10. With a pastry blender , cut in the butter until consistency of coarse crumbs
11. Stir in oats
12. Sprinkle mixture evenly over the strawberries
13. Bake at 375 for 25-30 min minutes or until wooden pick comes out clean
14. Cool and enjoy !

title: carnitas 3 ways
steps:
1. Combine all seasoning in a bowl , mix well
2. Pleace meat in separate bowl and sprinkle seasoning and rub generously over meat - using all seasoning
3. Make foil packet by laying out 2 long sheets of heavy duty aluminium foil and make a cross
4. Place meat on foil
5. Bring up sides of foil and fold making a packet
6. Refrigerate for 6 hours
7. Slow cooked: after marinating , place in a crockpot , cook 4 hours - the meat becomes very tender
8. Then transfer to a plate -- over med-high grill for 5 minutes to get a nice grill mark and crisp
9. Shred and eat in tacos with beans and rice our favorite way to eat them
10. Or add 1 cup of water to the crockpot -- this makes the meat very tender and can be shredded for burritos or tacos
11. Grilling:
12. Preheat grill- to 325 place meat foil packet on grill and cover on indirect heat
13. Cook for 30 minutes then turn packet over and cook additional 30 minutes -- once more turn 30 minutes
14. Open foil packet carefully , with a fork remove from foil and place on the heat for 10 minutes and grill until grilled lines appear on outside
15. Serve in warm corn tortillas or with rice and beans
16. Or by itself
17. Oven:
18. Preheat oven 325'
19. Arrange meat in 9x13x2 baking pan into single layers
20. Cover pan tightly with foil
21. Bake for 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours until very tender
22. Remove foil from pan and bake additional 15-20 minutes until meat is crisp on the outside

title: basic smoothie
steps:
1. Mix all together in a blender and serve immediately
2. The optional wheat germ will not affect the taste or texture but it will give your smoothie an extra health boost
3. Add the ice cubes if you'd like a thicker or colder drink
4. More like a slushy , especially with frozen banana / fruit / yogurt
5. Use up to 1 cup of yogurt for a thicker drink
6. Other options: 1 / 2 t vanilla
7. 1 t honey
8. 1-2 t powdered sugar , white sugar or splenda

title: chocolatey espresso martini
steps:
1. Garnish glass with chocolate syrup and set aside in the freezer
2. Add ingredients into a cocktail shaker filled with ice
3. Shake vigorously
4. Strain into chilled glass
5. Enjoy !

title: mussels with thyme and shallots
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat
2. Add shallots and saute' until softened , about 10 minutes
3. Add bay leaves , thyme , vermouth , clam juice and cream
4. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer until the mixture is reduced to 1 cup , about 10 minutes
5. Add mussels , cover and simmer , discarding any mussels that do not open
6. Using tongs , evenly divide up the mussels between bowls
7. Season broth with salt and pepper and ladle over mussels

title: baked potato wedges
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Wash potatoes , peel if desired , and cut into wedges
3. Place potatoes skin down in a baking dish
4. Mix remaining ingredients together and brush over potatoes
5. Bake 1 hour
6. Add more salt & pepper if desired

title: super easy and yummy doughnuts
steps:
1. Heat oil to 375 degrees fahrenheit in skillet
2. Put granulated sugar and cinnamon in a quart or gallon size plastic bag
3. Shake to mix then set aside to sugar the fried doughnuts
4. Put the powdered sugar in a separate quart or gallon plastic bag and then set aside to use to sugar the fried doughnuts
5. Open the tube of biscuits and separate each one , then poke a hole in the center of each with your finger and then carefully stretch it open some
6. Place each piece in the hot oil and fry until puffy and golden brown
7. Turn with a fork and fry the other side until golden
8. Lift out and drain on paper towels
9. Promptly shake them , one by one , in the cinnamon sugar and then in the powdered sugar

title: butternut squash muffins  diabetic
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Lightly grease a 12 cup muffin pan
3. In a medium saucepan with enough water to cover , boil squash 20 minutes , or until tender
4. Remove from heat , drain , and puree in a food processor
5. In a large bowl , whisk together flour , baking powder , splenda granular , salt and pumpkin pie spice
6. In a medium bowl , thoroughly mix together milk , eggs , and butter
7. Stir in squash
8. Fold the squash mixture into the flour mixture just until moistened
9. Spoon the batter into the prepared muffin pan , filling cups about 1 / 2 to 2 / 3 full
10. Bake 20 to 25 minutes in the preheated oven , or until a toothpick inserted in the centre of a muffin comes out clean
11. Remove from muffin pan and cool on a wire rack

title: chicken paprikas light
steps:
1. Cut chicken crosswise into 1 / 2-inch-wide strips
2. Season chicken with 1 teaspoon paprika , salt and pepper
3. Spray butter-flavored cooking spray in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
4. Add chicken and saut until just cooked through , about 3 minutes
5. Using slotted spoon , transfer chicken to plate
6. Add more butter-flavored cooking pray to the same skillet
7. Add onion and saut until beginning to soften , about 3 minutes
8. Add remaining 3 teaspoons paprika
9. Stir 10 seconds
10. Add tomato and stir until beginning to soften , about 1 minute
11. Add broth and increase heat to high and boil until sauce thickens enough to coat spoon thinly , about 5 minutes
12. Mix in chicken and any collected juices
13. Reduce heat to low
14. Add the reduced-fat sour cream and stir just until heated through
15. Season papriks to taste with salt and pepper and serve

title: piney woods hush puppies
steps:
1. Mix all dry ingredients
2. Beat milk and egg together and combine with dry ingredients
3. Batter should hold its shape when picked up in spoon
4. If it is too soft , add more cornmeal
5. Drop by molded tablespoon into 350"f fat and cook about 1 1 / 2 minutes
6. Turn and cook on second side 1 minute
7. Allow oil to heat a few seconds after removing a batch
8. Delicious freshly cooked and hot
9. However , leftover hush puppies freeze well
10. When ready to serve frozen hush puppies , place on oven rack in preheated 250"f until very hot and crisp
11. Hints on frying: using a small diameter heavy saucepan allows using a minimum oil
12. A 5 or 6 inch pan with oil 1 1 / 2 inches deep and heated to 350 f will cook three hush puppies in about 2 1 / 2 minutes
13. When batter consistency is correct and oil is at 350"f , hush puppies will become firm , round shapes almost as soon as they enter the hot oil
14. If they are cooked in oil that is too hot , they will not cook in the center

title: apple baked beans
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f coat a 1 1 / 2-quart baking dish with nonstick cooking spray
2. In a large bowl , combine all the ingredients except the bacon and mix well
3. Pour into the baking dish and lay the raw strips of bacon on top
4. Cover and bake for approximately 45 minutes , or until thick and bubbly
5. Uncover and bake for 5 more minutes

title: orange doughnuts with honey  yo yo
steps:
1. To make doughnuts: in a medium bowl , beat eggs
2. Stir in oil , orange juice , orange peel and sugar
3. In a large bowl , stir together flour and baking powder
4. Stir into egg mixture , 1 tablespoon at a time , making a soft dough
5. Cover
6. Let stand 30 minutes
7. To make syrup: in a medium saucepan , combine sugar , water and lemon juice
8. Stir over medium heat until sugar dissolves
9. Bring to a boil
10. Boil gently 5 minutes
11. Stir in honey
12. Boil 5 minutes longer
13. Set aside
14. Keep warm
15. To assemble: heat oil to 350f or until a 1-inch cube of bread turns golden brown in 65 seconds
16. Divide dough into 10 equal pieces
17. Shape each piece into a ball
18. Press each ball to flatten slightly
19. Press your thumbs through the center of each flattened ball , making a 1-inch hole
20. Fry 2 doughnuts at a time in hot oil , 2 to 3 minutes on each side
21. Drain on paper towels
22. Keep warm
23. Using a wooden skewer , prick cooked doughnuts in 6 or 7 places
24. Dip pricked doughnuts in warm syrup
25. Serve immediately

title: creamy oven bbqed potato casserole
steps:
1. In large bowl combine 1-1 / 2 cups of the cheese and rest of the ingredients except potatoes
2. Fold in potatoes well
3. Spoon into a greased 9 square pan , making sure potatoes are laying nicely , cover and bake at 350 for 45 minutes
4. Uncover and bake about 30 minutes longer or until potatoes are tender
5. Remove from oven , sprinkle top with rest of cheese and paprika , and let stand 5-10 minutes before serving
6. 4-6 servings

title: roasted red potato salad
steps:
1. Wash potatoes well and slice into uniform pieces , if potatoes are very small , quartering will work
2. Place all potato pieces in a large bowl
3. Coat with oil and spices
4. Spread coated potatoes on a cookie sheet and roast until lightly browned
5. Remove roasted potatoes to colander to drain excess oil
6. While potatoes are roasting , prepare the remaining ingredients
7. Drain rep pepper fillets , and slice lengthwise into quarters
8. Cut quartered fillets on the diagonal into quarters again
9. Set aside
10. Cut red onion into thick slices and chop very coarsely
11. Onion pieces should be 1 / 2-3 / 4 inch to add color as much as flavor
12. Drain black olives well
13. Place drained potatoes into a large bowl
14. Add the diced and drained vegetables
15. Starting with one cup of peppercorn ranch dressing , mix the dressing into the potato / vegetable mixture until well coated
16. Depending on how much dressing you like , you may add as much or as little as needed
17. Mix well , chill 2 hours , and serve

title: the easiest 3 ingredient crock pot roast ever   slowcooker
steps:
1. Place roast in a large crock pot
2. Squirt or spread a thin layer of mustard over the roast
3. Sprinkle onion soup mix on top
4. Cook 8 hours on low
5. Optional gravy: strain the fat off the liquid and discard fat
6. Place reserved liquid in a sauce pan and bring to a slight boil
7. Add cornstarch to the water and make a paste
8. Add paste to the reserved liquid and whisk until thickened
9. Believe it or not , this will make its own liquid

title: tippie biscuits
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together and pour into well-greased muffin tins
2. Fill only half full
3. Let rest 20 minutes , then bake at 400 degrees for about 15 minutes

title: low carb roasted eggplant marinara
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees farenheit
2. Dice the two eggplants into approximately one inch cubes
3. Toss the eggplant cubes with 2-4 tbsp of olive oil
4. Add salt and pepper to taste
5. Spread into a single layer on a baking sheet and pop into preheated oven
6. Roast until eggplant is tender and beginning to brown , 15-20 minutes
7. When eggplant is done roasting , pull out of the oven and top with crushed red pepper , tomato sauce , parmesan , and mozzarella cheese
8. Place back in oven for approximately 10-15 minutes or until cheese is bubbling and starting to brown slightly
9. Serve with salad

title: bunya calda  or banya cauda
steps:
1. This is a single batch
2. As our family is enormous , we will do triple or quad batches to feed everyone
3. Melt butter in a big pot
4. Saute garlic and anchovies
5. Anchovies should melt away
6. They add the salty taste to this dish
7. Add remaining ingredients , and cook on med-low for approximately 45 minutes
8. Do not let boil
9. Our family will buy french bread or your favorite italian bread , cut into chunks , and dip it into the soup
10. We usually have a plate of veggies such as cauliflower , broccoli , celery , green peppers and carrots to use for dipping
11. This is a very rich dish , and the veggies taste wonderful when dipped into the soup
12. I am not sure if it is classified as a soup , but we have made it as a main meal
13. It is a very filling meal too !

title: pappa al pomodoro   tomato bread soup
steps:
1. Heat a medium soup pot over high heat
2. Add three tablespoons of olive oil , garlic and onion
3. Cook 7 to 8 minutes
4. Add tomatoes and season with salt and pepper
5. Add stock / broth and raise heat to make the soup bubble
6. Reduce heat to simmer and add bread and beans
7. Stir soup as it simmers until it thickens to a stew-like consistency
8. Ladel into bowls and top with grated cheese , a little additional olive oil and torn basil leaves to garnish

title: tastes like apple pie apple squares
steps:
1. Mix flour and salt and cut in shortening
2. Add egg and milk mixture and mix till it forms a ball
3. Divide dough in half
4. Roll first half in 17 x 12 inch rectangle
5. Place in cookie sheet and bring pastry up sides
6. Cover pastry with apples and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon
7. Roll out second half of dough and place on top of apples
8. Moisten edges with milk and pinch together
9. Beat egg white until stiff and brush on crust
10. Bake at 400f for 1 hour
11. Mix glaze ingredients together and brush on crust
12. This square freezes beautifully

title: pork chops for the slow cooker
steps:
1. Trim off the fat and place pork chops in slow cooker
2. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over pork chops
3. Cook on low setting for 4 hours , depending on thickness of your chop
4. Add some cornstarch to thicken the juice
5. This can be done the last 30 minutes of cooking or on the stove top in a sauce pan

title: knottsberry farm meatloaf
steps:
1. Mix together ingredients from ground beef to worcestershire sauce
2. Shape into 2 small loaves or 1 big one
3. Mix together the ketchup-mustard-brownsugar- and pour on top of meatloaf
4. Bake at 350 for 1 hour and 15 minutes

title: banana poppy seed cake
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Butter a 13 x 9-inch baking pan
3. In a bowl sift both flours , baking soda and salt together
4. Set aside
5. In another small bowl mix the buttermilk with the mashed banana
6. Set aside
7. Cream the butter , oil , both sugars and vanilla together until fluffy
8. Add in the eggs , one at a time to the creamed mixture , beating well after each addition
9. Add in the banana / buttermilk mixture
10. Beat until combined
11. Add in the poppy seeds
12. Add in the flour mixture to the creamed mixture with a wooden spoon only until combined
13. Transfer batter to prepared baking pan
14. Bake for about 30-35 minutes , or until cake test done
15. Frost with favorite cream cheese frosting or dust with powdered sugar

title: orange cinnamon instant coffee mix
steps:
1. Mix
2. Use 3 teaspoons per mug of boiling water

title: campfire spam and red sauce with pasta
steps:
1. Dice the spam , and saute in the olive oil in a large frying pan
2. Stir until most of the fat from the meat has come out
3. Add the onion and continue to stir until nearly transparent
4. Add the garlic , diced tomatoes , tomato sauce , water , and catsup
5. Simmer for 15 minutes
6. While the spam and sauce is cooking , prepare the pasta according to the package
7. Add basil and black pepper and stir until the diced tomatoes have started to soften
8. Drain the pasta and add to the frying pan , toss and serve

title: greek flatbread
steps:
1. Mix the flour , salt and yeast together and then stir in the warm water and olive oil to make a soft dough
2. Transfer to a floured surface and knead for five minutes until springy , using extra flour if it's too sticky
3. Shape into a ball , brush over a little more oil , cover and leave to rise in a warm place until it doubles in size
4. This should take about an hour
5. Knead again on a floured surface and divide into six pieces , rolling each chunk into a ball
6. Leave to rise for 10 minutes
7. Preheat the oven to 240 c or 475 f
8. Meanwhile , roll the balls flat until they're only 3mm or 1 / 8 of an inch thick and about 17cm or 7 inches across
9. Place on greased baking sheets , cover with a tea towel and let rest for 30 minutes
10. Spray the dough with water and bake for two minutes
11. Check to make sure they haven't gone hard and if not , bake for a couple minutes more
12. You want them firm but not hard or brown
13. Remove from the oven and serve immediately with dips or as a wrap for all sorts of fillings
14. Great with kebabs !
15. If you must serve them later , you can brush them lightly with oil and then reheat them by briefly heating them in a frying pan

title: southern biscuits mufffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. In a large bowl , combine flour , sugar & baking powder
3. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
4. Stir in milk just until flour mixture is moistened
5. It will be very thick and pull away from the sides of the bowl
6. Spoon into greased muffin pan
7. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown
8. Remove from pan and let cool

title: focaccia bread
steps:
1. In the bowl of a standing mixer fitted with a dough hook , proof the yeast by combining it with the warm water and sugar
2. Stir gently to dissolve
3. Let stand 3 minutes until foam appears
4. Turn mixer on low and slowly add the flour to the bowl
5. Dissolve salt in 2 tablespoons of water and add it to the mixture
6. Pour in 1 / 4 cup olive oil
7. When the dough starts to come together , increase the speed to medium
8. Stop the machine periodically to scrape the dough off the hook
9. Mix until the dough is smooth and elastic , about 10 minutes , adding flour as necessary
10. Turn the dough out onto a work surface and fold over itself a few times
11. Form the dough into a round and place in an oiled bowl , turn to coat the entire ball with oil so it doesnt form a skin
12. Cover with plastic wrap or damp towel and let rise over a gas pilot light on the stovetop or other warm place until doubled in size , about 45 minutes
13. Coat a sheet pan with a little olive oil and corn meal
14. Once the dough is doubled and domed , turn it out onto the counter
15. Roll and stretch the dough out to an oblong shape about 1 / 2-inch thick
16. Lay the flattened dough on the pan and cover with plastic wrap
17. Let rest for 15 minutes
18. In the meantime , coat a small saute pan with olive oil , add the onion , and cook over low heat for 15 minutes until the onions caramelize
19. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
20. Uncover the dough and dimple with your finger
21. Brush the surface with more olive oil and then add caramelized onions , garlic , olives , cheese , salt , pepper , and rosemary
22. Bake on the bottom rack for 15 to 20 minutes

title: layered fruit salad
steps:
1. In a 2-1 / 2-qt
2. Glass bowl , layer the fruits in the order listed
3. In a mixing bowl , beat the cream cheese and confectioners' sugar until smooth
4. Fold in whipped topping
5. Spoon over fruit
6. Refrigerate until serving
7. Sprinkle with pecans

title: orange poppy seed cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f for the crust , mix all ingredients in medium bowl
2. Press onto bottom and 1 inch up side of 9-inch springform pan
3. Set aside
4. For the filling , beat cream cheese and sugar in large bowl with electric mixer on medium speed until fluffy
5. Add eggs , one at a time , beating on low speed after each addition just until blended
6. Add remaining ingredients
7. Beat until smooth
8. Pour into crust
9. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes or until top is lightly browned and center is almost set
10. Run small knife or metal spatula around rim of pan to loosen cheesecake
11. Cool in pan on wire rack
12. Refrigerate 4 hour or overnight
13. For the raspberry sauce , pure raspberries in blender
14. Strain seeds from sauce
15. Discard seeds
16. Stir in vanilla
17. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve
18. To serve , spoon raspberry sauce on dessert plates , then place cheesecake slices on sauce
19. Garnish with whipped cream and orange slices , if desired

title: halloween orange hot chocolate
steps:
1. Coarsely chop the premium white chocolate , transfer to a medium-size heatproof bowl and set aside
2. Heat milk in a medium-size saucepan over medium heat , until bubbles begin to form at edge of surface , about 4 minutes
3. Immediately pour milk over chocolate
4. When chocolate begins to melt , stir until combined
5. Whisk in vanilla extract and 2 drops orange food color
6. Whisk until a light foam forms on surface
7. Pour into 10 mugs , garnish with whipped cream and chocolate nonpareils , and serve immediately

title: egg scramble
steps:
1. Place potatoes in a small saucepan and cover with water
2. Bring to a boil , reduce heat
3. Cover and simmer for 10-15 minutes or until tender , drain
4. In large skillet , saute half of the peppers and onion in 1 teaspoon oil until tender
5. Add half of the ham and potatoes , saute 2-3 minutes longer
6. Meanwhile , in a blender , combine eggs , sour cream , milk , onion salt , garlic salt and pepper
7. Cover and process until smooth
8. Pour half over vegetable mixture
9. Cook and stir over medium heat until eggs are completely set
10. Sprinkle with 1 cup of cheese
11. Repeat with remaining ingredients

title: very berry pineapple poppy salad
steps:
1. Core and cut pineapple into 3 / 4 inch cubes
2. Cut off stems and dice strawberries
3. In blender pure strawberries , blueberries , peach and lemon juice
4. Together until complete liquid
5. In bowl mix pineapple , berry mixture and poppy seeds together
6. Enjoy
7. A non-fat low cal fruit salad , with a zing

title: low fat creamy cheesy potato casserole
steps:
1. Mix sour cream , cottage cheese , about 1 / 2 the cheddar , garlic , salt , pepper& basil in large mixing bowl
2. Add potatoes and onions , mix well
3. Pour mixture in a 13 by 9 pan that you sprayed with pam
4. Pat down with the back of your spatula
5. Sprinkle remaining cheese over top
6. In a baggie , crush corn flakes and then add some salt , pepper and garlic powder and toss around a bit
7. Sprinkle corn flake mixture over top of cheese
8. Bake 375 for about an hour

title: new england clam chowder lower fat
steps:
1. Drain the clams reserving juices
2. Add enough water to juice to make 1 cup liquid
3. In a medium saucepan , combine clam juice , potatoes , onions , bouillon granuales , worcestershire sauce , , parsley , pepper and garlic powder
4. Bring to a boil , reduce heat
5. Cover and let simmer 5-10 minutes or until potatoes are tender
6. Using the back of a fork , or a hand masher , mash potatoes
7. In a small bowl combine the milk and cornstarch
8. Add cornstarch and milk mix and evaporated milk to the sauce pan
9. Cook on medium high heat until mixture starts to thicken , 5-10 minutes
10. Stir in clams , bring to a boil , reduce heat to low and simmer 2 minutes , stirring frequently
11. Serve

title: fresh corn quiche
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Combine eggs , onion , flour , sugar and salt in processor
3. Blend until onion is finely chopped
4. Add half and half and butter
5. Process just until blended
6. Transfer to large bowl
7. Mix in corn
8. Pour into crust
9. Bake until filling is slightly puffed and top is golden , about 50 minutes
10. Transfer to rack
11. Cool slightly
12. Serve warm

title: sommer s cinnamon mocha
steps:
1. Dissolve one heaping teaspoon of pero extra dark roast into the hot water
2. Stir in sugar , cocoa powder , and cinnamon
3. Taste and adjust amounts if necessary
4. Enjoy !

title: peanut butter cup brownie bottom cheesecake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f grease 9-inch springform pan with butter
2. Stir together butter , sugar and vanilla in large bowl with spoon or wire whisk
3. Add eggs
4. Stir until well blended
5. Stir in flour , cocoa , baking powder and salt
6. Blend well
7. Spread in prepared pan
8. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until brownie begins to pull away from side of pan
9. Meanwhile make cheesecake layer
10. Immediately after removing brownie from oven , sprinkle milk chocolate chips , peanut butter chips and peanut butter cups over brownie surface
11. Spoon cheesecake mixture over chips
12. Turn down oven 325
13. Cheesecake filling:
14. Beat cream cheese in bowl of electric mixer until smooth
15. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
16. Add sugar , peanut butter and cream
17. Mix until smooth
18. Stir in vanilla
19. Pour filling into prepared crust
20. If some batter is left over , either store or put in smaller springform pan
21. Double-wrap springform pan with aluminum foil to prevent water seeping inches
22. Place springform pan into a larger baking pan
23. Pour hot water into the larger pan so that the water comes 1 inch up the sides of the springform pan
24. Bake at 325 degrees 1-1 / 2 hours , or until firm and lightly browned
25. Remove from the oven and allow to cool on a wire rack for one hour
26. Run a knife along the edge of the cake to loosen it from the pan somewhat
27. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours before decorating
28. Decoration-
29. Remove cake from pan and put on a pretty plate
30. Bring whipping cream to boil in a small saucepan
31. Remove from heat and add semi-sweet and peanut butter chips
32. Stir , stir , stir until melted and smooth
33. Drizzle over cake and then add peanut butter cup halves around the edge of the cake

title: brussels sprouts salad
steps:
1. If using frozen brussels sprouts , cook according to package directions with broth instead of water
2. If using fresh , wash well and trim all outer leaves
3. Bring broth to a boil and add sprouts
4. Bring to a boil again and cook uncovered for 15 minutes or until tender
5. Drain sprouts and place in a bowl
6. Pour vinegar and oil over the top and sprinkle with dried spices , salt and pepper
7. Toss to coat
8. Chill for 2-3 hours or overnight
9. Halve the tomatoes and add to sprouts
10. Taste for seasoning
11. Sprinkle with fresh chives and dill before serving

title: kahlua swirl cake
steps:
1. Grease and flour 9 inch fluted tube pan
2. Prepare streusel filling by mixing all together
3. Preheat oven to 350 f
4. Resift flour with baking powder , soda , salt and mace
5. In large bowl , combine butter , sugar , eggs and vanilla
6. Beat 2 mins on medium speed
7. On lowest speed , blend in flour alternately with sour cream and kahlua
8. Turn 1 / 3 batter into prepared pan
9. Cover with 1 / 2 streusel filling , an additional 1 / 3 batter and remaining streusel
10. Top with remaining batter
11. Bake for 45 mins , or until golden brown
12. Remove from oven and let stand for 10 mins
13. Invert onto cake rack
14. Cool until lukewarm
15. Remove pan
16. Combine all glaze ingredients and beat until smooth
17. Spoon over top of lukewarm cake
18. Garnish with pecan halves

title: maple glazed sausages
steps:
1. In a large non-stick skillet , cook sausages until browned
2. Drain
3. In a bowl , mix together the syrup , brown sugar , and cinnamon
4. Pour into the skillet
5. Bring to a boil
6. Cook and stir until sausages are glazed

title: parmesan cheese biscuit crescents
steps:
1. In medium bowl , mix flour , baking powder , salt , and baking soda
2. Cut butter into mixture until resembles coarse crumbs
3. Making a well in center of dry mixture , add buttermilk
4. Using fork to stir until moist
5. Turn dough out onto lightly floured surface
6. Quickly kneaded dough by folding and pressing gently for 10-12 strokes or until dough nearly smooth
7. Roll dough into 13 inch circle
8. Brush with melted butter
9. Sprinkle with 1 / 3 cup parmesan cheese and parsley
10. Cut into 12 wedges
11. Roll up each wedge from wide end to the point
12. Place crescents seam side down about 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet , curving to form crescents
13. Brush with milk and sprinkle with additional parmesan cheese
14. Bake in 425f oven for 15-20 minutes or until golden

title: grilled beef sandwiches
steps:
1. Mix the marinade until well blended , then add the steaks
2. Make sure the steaks are well coated
3. Put it in a zip lock bag and refrigerate for about 1 hours every so often turn the steaks
4. Remove the steaks from the bag to a hot grill
5. Approximately 15 minute for a medium doneness , turning once
6. Also marinade often with the marinade during this process
7. When almost done , discard the rest of the marinade--do not put any more on after you take it off the grill
8. Optional addition:
9. Saut the peppers in about 2 tablespoons of hot olive oil
10. After the peppers have sauted a few minute begin adding onions , mushrooms , etc
11. Towards the end sprinkle with a little emeril's essence for a nice taste
12. Serve with tomatoes , and / or this optional addition can be put on top , you can add cheese melted if you like , don't forget to use either a dsseldorf mustard , or dijon , or your favorite mustard or topping--these are quick and luscious !
13. Don't overgrill however
14. I am sure once you make it you will think of even more toppings

title: zucchini with bacon corn   peppers
steps:
1. In a wide frying pan , cook your bacon until crisp
2. Drain bacon drippings , but leave 3 tablespoons of bacon drippings in the frying pan
3. Add zucchini , corn , bell pepper , onion , and garlic to the fry pan with the reserved bacon drippings
4. Cook over medium heat stiriring often , until most of the vegetable liquid has evaporated and the vegetables are crisp tender
5. Add the cooked bacon and heat through
6. Add salt and pepper to taste
7. Sprinkle grated cheese on top
8. Cooking time does include cooking the bacon

title: paula deen s potato salad
steps:
1. In a large pot cook the potatoes with skin on in boiling water until just fork-tender
2. Cut into cubes
3. In a large bowl combine all remaining ingredients until well blended
4. Add in the cooked cubed potatoes and mix gently
5. Serve at room temperature

title: chicken and soy sauce
steps:
1. Mix together the first 5 ingredients
2. Add 1 tablespoon oil and chicken , coating well
3. Heat 1 1 / 2 tablespoons oil in wok or large skillet
4. Add chicken mixture and stir-fry until medium well then move to side of pan
5. Add green onions , garlic , and sesame oil to available space in pan and stir-fry until fragrant
6. Add cucumber , water chestnuts , and red pepper and stir briefly
7. In small bowl , mix together the soy sauce , water , sugar , vinegar , wine , dash pepper , and cornstarch
8. Stir into wok or skillet
9. Cover and cook until steamy , then stir to mix well
10. Serve immediately

title: tarragon turkey salad
steps:
1. In a saucepan , heat stock , orange zest , orange juice , tarragon , oil , and vinegar
2. Simmer 2 to 3 minutes , then chill in the refrigerator at least 2 hours
3. Just before serving , arrange salad greens , turkey , and grapefruit in a serving dish
4. Pour dressing on salad and toss well
5. Garnish with tarragon sprigs

title: santa fe chicken oamc
steps:
1. In a saucepan , cook onion and garlic in olive oil until tender
2. Stir in frozen chicken , black beans and salsa
3. If freezing , cool onion and garlic mixture before adding frozen chicken
4. In 2 quart glass baking dish , pour taco sauce onto bottom
5. Lay four corn tortillas over sauce
6. Top with half of chicken mixture
7. Spoon on half of sour cream
8. Sprinkle with half of cheese
9. Top with remaining tortillas , chicken mixture , sour cream and cheese
10. Cover with foil
11. You can wrap the casserole well and freeze up to 3 months or cook now
12. If cooking now , bake at 350 degrees for 25-35 minutes until bubbly
13. Uncover and bake 5-10 minutes longer until cheese is melted
14. If frozen , thaw casserole overnight in refrigerator , then bake covered at 350 degrees for 35-45 minutes until bubbly
15. Uncover and bake 5-10 minutes longer until cheese melts

title: grilled chicken wings   japanese style
steps:
1. Mix together everything but the chicken wings in a large baking dish
2. Add the chicken wings and turn to coat , then cover with plastic wrap , and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or as long as overnight
3. Turn the wings occasionally in the marinade
4. Start a charcoal or wood fire or preheat a gas grill or broiler
5. The fire should be only moderately hot and the rack about 6 inches from the heat source
6. If you are going to broil the wings , line your pan with foil
7. Remove the wings from the marinade and put on the grill or in the broiler
8. Cook for about 10 minutes on each side , remove from the heat , and serve immediately

title: blt burgers
steps:
1. Cook bacon in a 12-inch heavy skillet over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until crisp , then transfer with a slotted spatula to paper towels to drain
2. Cool to room temperature , about 5 minutes
3. Holding one fourth of beef in your palm , make a depression in beef and add one fourth of bacon to depression
4. Pull beef over bacon to enclose completely , then flatten into a 3 / 4-inch-thick patty
5. Make 3 more patties in same manner with remaining beef and bacon
6. Prepare grill for direct-heat cooking over medium-hot charcoal
7. Season patties on both sides with salt and pepper
8. Oil grill rack , then grill patties , covered only if using a gas grill , turning over once , 5 to 8 minutes total for medium-rare
9. Assemble burgers with buns and with suggested accompaniments such as mayonnaise
10. Mustard
11. Iceberg lettuce
12. Sliced tomatoes
13. Dill pickles

title: white overnight buns
steps:
1. Combine c
2. Warm water , 1tsp sugar and yeast stir and let rise app
3. 10 min
4. In a large bowl combine flour , sugar and salt
5. Combine oil , egg mixture and yeast mixture , pour over dry ingredients and mix well
6. Knead until smooth
7. Let rest 5min
8. , knead and place into a well oiled bowl
9. Let rise 6 7 hours , punch down and make into buns
10. Let rise overnight and bake in the morning

title: cold and flu remedy tea
steps:
1. Put water , spices and chilli into a small saucepan over medium heat
2. Simmer till liquid is reduced by half
3. Add orange juice , honey , lemon zest and juice
4. Cook further 5 minutes or until aromatic
5. Put orange slices into 4 tall glasses
6. Pour tea through a strainer into glasses
7. Serve warm

title: mom s chili beans  meatless
steps:
1. Add all ingredients to a large pot on the stovetop
2. Simmer uncovered until onions are transparent , stirring occasionally
3. Serve with shredded velveeta and sour cream

title: salmon dijon sandwich
steps:
1. Combine mayonnaise and mustard
2. Toast bread if desired and spread each slice with mustard mixture
3. Pile roast salmon , cheese , and lettuce on one slice of bread
4. Top with second slice and enjoy !

title: candy snowballs
steps:
1. Melt white chips in a microwave safe 6 cup bowl / dish
2. Stir to make sure completely melted
3. Pour in kix and stir until completely coated
4. Sprinkle splenda over mixture as you stir once more
5. Drop by tbs on a cookie sheet or wax paper
6. Place in frig for 1 / 2 hour or freezer for 15 min
7. After chilled remove from sheet or wax paper onto a dish
8. Place back in fridge

title: chicken breasts with broccoli   cheese
steps:
1. In a skillet , over medium heat , melt the butter , then add the chicken breasts & cook 10 minutes , browning the meat on both sides
2. Spoon off any fat
3. In a medium bowl , combine the soup , water & pepper & pour this soup mixture into the skillet with the breasts
4. Heat to boiling , then add the broccoli & reduce the heat to low
5. Cover & simmer , stirring occasionally , for 10 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender & the broccoli is done

title: prosciutto and mozzarella heros with olive relish
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425
2. In a medium bowl , toss the celery , olives , parsley and capers and stir in the olive oil
3. Spread the rolls open on a cookie sheet and bake for about 3 minutes , or until lightly crisp
4. Arrange 2 arugula leaves on the bottom half of each roll and top with 2 ounces of prosciutto , 2 mozzarella slices and 3 tomato slices
5. Top each sandwich with a layer of pickled peppers and about 1 / 4 cup of the olive relish
6. Close the heroes and serve at once

title: balsamic onion  mushroom   blue cheese tarts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
