2. Put a pan over medium heat and add 1 tablespoon olive oil and 1 tablespoon butter
3. Once the butter starts to froth , put the thinly sliced red onions in and turn the heat down to low
4. Cook , stirring often , until the onions have become translucent
5. This will take about 10 minutes but keep an eye on them
6. Add the sugar and the balsamic vinegar to the onions and cook on low , stirring often for about 10 minutes until the onion mixture is sticky and the liquid thickened up
7. Set the onions aside to cool
8. Melt the remaining butter in another pan and cook the mushrooms for a few minutes until they have just started to change color
9. Set the mushrooms aside to cool
10. Whilst the onions and mushrooms are cooling , layout your pie dough
11. You want the dough to be about as thick as a pinkie
12. If your pre-rolled dough is thicker roll it out to the desired thickness
13. Using a round cookie cutter or a glass , cut out 12 rounds of the dough
14. Press each round of dough into a hole of a 12 yield muffin tin
15. If your pan usually sticks , spray each hole with cooking spray before hand
16. Next , put the egg and sour cream into a bowl with the salt and pepper and beat together
17. Stir through the dried parsley and crumbled blue cheese
18. Set aside
19. Spoon a bit of the balsamic onions into the base of each tart
20. Top the onions with the mushrooms , trying to cover as much of the surface as possible
21. Spoon the blue cheese mixture over the top of each tart
22. Put tarts in the oven and bake for about 15 minutes until the pastry has gone golden and the cheese mixture has set
23. Take out of the oven and allow to cool before serving so the cheese mixture can firm up a little bit

title: thai cucumber salad
steps:
1. Peel cucmbers
2. Cut of the ends , cut them in half lengthwise and scrape out the seeds
3. Slice them thinly into half moons
4. Add the cucumbers to a bowl with the chiles and onion
5. Add the ground shrimp , lime juice , fish sauce , sugar and peanut oil
6. Toss well
7. Allow to sit or serve immediately sprinkled with the peanuts

title: hedonism 43
steps:
1. Mix with ice
2. Garnish with pineapple if desired
3. Enjoy !

title: self crusting citrus tart
steps:
1. Beat eggs well with sugar
2. Add liquid ingredients
3. Add flour and coconut and mix well together
4. Pour into greased 20 cm pie plate
5. Bake at 180 deg c for 45 minutes

title: she crab  cream of crab soup
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in double boiler
2. Simmer until heated through
3. Enjoy

title: irish coffee muffins
steps:
1. Line 12 muffin-tin cups with paper liners
2. Preheat oven to 375
3. In a bowl , combine flour , baking powder , salt and sugar
4. Stir well
5. In a 1-cup measure , dissolve coffee granules in coffee liqueur and whiskey
6. Add enough milk to measure 1 cup
7. Whisk egg in a bowl with coffee-milk mixture
8. Whisk in melted butter
9. Gently stir liquid into dry ingredients just until moistened
10. Spoon into muffin tin
11. Bake at 375 for 25 minutes , or until the top springs back when gently touched

title: tiger candy
steps:
1. Mix the peanut butter , dry milk , and honey together
2. Roll it into small balls
3. It is it too dry to roll , add a little more honey
4. Roll the balls in the shredded coconut or chopped nuts

title: snowy day white chili
steps:
1. Pick through beans and rinse them
2. Soak beans according to package directions
3. Drain well
4. Place chicken in large dutch oven and cover with boiling water
5. Simmer 15 minutes or until tender
6. Drain and let cool
7. Cut the chicken into cubes
8. Saute onions in hot oil in the dutch oven over medium heat for 10 minutes
9. Add the garlic , chiles , cumin , oregano , cloves and cayenne and cook for 2 minutes
10. Add the beans and broth
11. Bring to a boil
12. Reduce heat and simmer 2 hours or until the beans are tender
13. Add the chicken and cheese
14. Cook , stirring constantly , until the chili is thoroughly heated and cheese is melted
15. Season with salt and black pepper
16. Serve immediately with selection of garnishes

title: chocolate covered toffee matzo  matzah
steps:
1. Line a cookie sheet with foil and lay matzo on pan
2. Melt brown sugar with butter in saucepan
3. Boil until mixture coats a spoon
4. Brush matzo with brown sugar mixture
5. Bake in 350 degree oven for 3-4 minutes until it starts to bubble
6. Cover with chocolate chips and put back in the oven until the chips start to melt
7. Spread the chocolate to cover the matzo
8. Freeze until hard , then break into pieces
9. Option- sprinkle chopped nuts on top

title: whole wheat egg  mc muffin
steps:
1. Nuke english muffin about 10 seconds
2. Until slightly softened
3. Place in toaster and toast lightly
4. Until slightly golden but still soft
5. Cook egg white in mini pan , sprinkling with pepper when almost set
6. Place cheese on lower half of english muffin , top with egg , and add a squirt of dijon if desired
7. Top with other half of muffin and serve warm
8. Enjoy !

title: saffron rice with shrimp and scallops
steps:
1. Cut the roasted and peeled peppers into 1 / 2 inch dice and set aside
2. Preheat oven to 325
3. In an ovenproof frying pan or a paella pan about 12 inches in diameter , warm the olive oil over medium heat
4. Add the onion and garlic and saute , stirring , until soft , about 10 minutes
5. Add the rice and parsley and cook , stirring , until the rice is evenly coated with oil , about 2 minutes
6. Add the bell peppers , wine , stock , tomatoes , saffron and water , turmeric , salt and ground pepper
7. Boil gently , uncovered , for 5 minutes
8. Bury the shrimp and scallops in the rice
9. Place in the oven and bake , uncovered , for 10 minutes
10. Cover and continue to bake until the rice is tender and the seafood is cooked , about 10 minutes longer
11. Remove from the oven and let stand for 10 minutes
12. Garnish with lemon wedges and serve
13. Serves 6

title: flying saucers
steps:
1. Fry bologna until lightly browned
2. Prepare creamed potatoes
3. Real or boxed kind or use leftover
4. Place bologna on plate and top with potatoes
5. Then top with cheese
6. Microwave it for about 15-30 seconds
7. Or until cheese has melted

title: vegetarian maque choux
steps:
1. Remove the husks from corn
2. Scrub with a stiff brush to remove silks
3. Rinse
4. Use a sharp knife to remove corn from cobs , cutting two-thirds of the way to the cob
5. Scrape cobs with a dull edge of a knife
6. In a 3-quart saucepan , cook onion and green pepper in butter or margarine about 5 minutes or until tender
7. Stir in corn , tomato , salt , black pepper , and red pepper
8. Cover and cook over low heat about 20 minutes or until corn is tender
9. Season to taste
10. Enjoy !
11. Makes 6 side-dish servings

title: possum lodge firehouse chili con carne with beans   crock pot
steps:
1. Brown beef and onion , drain
2. Combine with remaining ingredients in a crock pot
3. Cook over low setting for 12-24 hours
4. Add chili powder as desired

title: quick zucchini carrot muffins
steps:
1. In a large mixing owl , combine the cake mix , egg , applesauce and oil
2. Mix well , stir in zucchini , raisins and pecans
3. Fill greased or paper-lined muffin cups 3 / 4 full
4. Bake at 350 degres for 25-30 minutes

title: easy  cheesy onion dip
steps:
1. Whisk all ingredients together
2. Refrigerate until ready to serve

title: basic stir fry sauce
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except cornstarch in a small bowl or a 2 to 4 cup liquid measuring cup
2. Place the cornstarch in a separate small bowl , and whisk in the mixture from step 1
3. Just before mixing in to vegetables and / or meat , whisk the mixture one more time
4. Add about 2 / 3 of the way through stir frying
5. Enjoy !

title: those potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. In a saucepan , melt 5 tbsps butter
3. Add flour and cook over low heat , stirring , for 2 minutes
4. Remove pan from heat and gradually stir in cream and broth
5. Cook , stirring until sauce is thick and smooth
6. Stir in parmesan cheese , salt and pepper
7. Fold in potatoes
8. Add more salt and pepper to taste
9. Put in buttered casserole
10. Mix roquefort with melted butter and paprika
11. Sprinkle on top
12. Bake until cheese melts , 12-14 minutes

title: cherry heart pie
steps:
1. Grind granola in food processor or blender until fine
2. Add remaining crust ingredients and process until well blended
3. Press into greased heart-shaped pie plate
4. Preheat oven to 350f while waiting , combine all filling ingredients in a bowl
5. Let stand 15 minutes
6. Pour on top of crust and bake 15-20 min at 350f or until filling begins to bubble

title: the perfect ginger garlic paste subru uncle has taught me
steps:
1. Put everything in a blender bowl , cover and process until smooth
2. Use in any recipe that calls for ginger-garlic paste

title: rhubarb   date chutney
steps:
1. Place all the ingredients in a large saucepan and bring to the boil over medium heat
2. Reduce the heat and simmer gently until the chutney has a jam-like consistency and there is no excess liquid on the surface
3. Stir from time to time to prevent sticking
4. Spoon into hot sterilized jars and seal down
5. Label and store for 6-8 weeks before use

title: vanocka   vnoka   czech christmas bread
steps:
1. Soften yeast in warm water
2. In a mixer bowl , beat together sugar , margarine , and salt
3. Add eggs and beat well
4. Beat in 1 cup of flour
5. Beat in milk , lemon peel , mace , and yeast mixture
6. Stir in as much remaining flour as you can with a spoon
7. Stir in raisins and nuts
8. Turn out onto floured surface
9. Knead in enough of the remaining flour to make a moderately soft dough that is smooth and elastic
10. Place in a lightly greased bowl
11. Turn once to grease surface
12. Cover , let rise in warm place till double
13. Divide in half
14. Divide one portion of the dough into fourths for the bottom braid
15. Cover and let rest 10 minutes
16. Meanwhile , divide the remaining dough into 5 portions for the other two layers of the dough
17. Cover those portions and set aside
18. On a lightly floured surface , form each of the first 4 portions into 16-inch long ropes
19. On a greased baking sheet , arrange the 4 ropes , 1 inch apart
20. Beginning in the middle of the ropes , braid together toward each end
21. To braid 4 ropes , overlap the center 2 ropes to form an x
22. Take the outside left rope and cross over the closest middle rope
23. Then , take the outside right rope and cross under the closest middle rope
24. Repeat braiding until you reach the end
25. Pinch ends together
26. Tuck under
27. Turn baking sheet and braid on opposite end
28. Gently pull width of braid out slightly
29. Form remaining 5 portions into 16-inch long ropes
30. Braid 3 of the ropes together
31. Brush the 4-strand braid with water and center the second braid on top
32. Gently pull width of top braid out
33. Twist the remaining two ropes of dough together
34. Brush the top braid with water
35. Place the twist on top of the second braid
36. Cover the shaped dough and let rise till nearly double
37. While loaves are rising , preheat oven to 350f
38. Brush surface of the shaped dough with egg yolk
39. Bake in oven for 35-40 minutes

title: smoky spicy lime sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Simmer sweet potatoes , uncovered , over medium heat until fork tender , about 15 minutes
2. If foaming occurs , skim off top of water
3. In a bowl combine oil , chile , adobo sauce , cumin , and lime juice and zest
4. Drain sweet potatoes , reserving 3 tablespoons of the cooking water
5. Mash sweet potatoes with cooking water
6. Mix spices in until well incorporated
7. Salt and pepper to taste , and serve

title: sarasota s spicy simple black beans
steps:
1. Vegetables -- in a large saute pan , heat to medium and add the olive oil and saute the onion and garlic and cook on medium , not too high , you want them to sweat more
2. Cook 4-5 minutes
3. Spices -- add in the green chilies , salsa , cumin , chili powder , salt and pepper and mix well , still on medium heat
4. Now add in the beans and stir to combine
5. Just let it hang out and cook on low heat while you prepare your main course
6. As it simmers i often add just a little chicken broth for some moisture
7. Each time it is different , 1 / 4 cup up to 1 / 2 cup , depending on how long they simmer
8. After 5 minutes the beans are done , but if you are still waiting on your main dish to be ready , maybe add a little more broth as the beans simmer so they don't dry out
9. Right before serving -- taste for salt and pepper and stir in the cilantro
10. That's it !

title: quick spinach stir fry with lemon juice
steps:
1. Heat oil in pan
2. Add garlic and spinach to pan
3. Stir fry till spinach is cooked
4. Squeeze a few drops of lemon juice over spinach in pan
5. Stir briskly and serve immediately !

title: taco casserole surprise
steps:
1. Brown the ground beef with the onion and drain
2. Add the taco seasoning and the water
3. Simmer until water is cooked away
4. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
5. Spray 13x9 inch casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray
6. Crunch taco shells into pan
7. This will be the crust
8. Spread beef and onion over taco shells evenly
9. Add tomatoes evenly over beef
10. Add about 1 / 2 of the jar of taco sauce
11. Spread over tomatoes
12. Cover with cheese
13. Bake for approx
14. 10 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly
15. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving

title: cranberry muffins
steps:
1. Mix oatmeal and yogurt in a large bowl
2. Allow some time for the yogurt to absorb into the oatmeal
3. This is a great time to slice your cranberries !
4. Add butter , sugar , and eggs to the oatmeal / yogurt mixture
5. In separate bowl , mix the dry ingredients
6. Add dry ingredients to mixture
7. Mix well
8. Add cranberries
9. Stir until combined
10. Place large spoonfuls into greased muffin tins
11. You can fill each cup about 3 / 4 of the way full
12. Bake at 400 until toothpick comes out clean
13. If you decide not to use muffin cups , allow to cool for a few minutes before removing from pan

title: the ultimate peanut butter pie
steps:
1. Gingersnap cookie crust: preheat oven to 325f in medium bowl , combine crust ingredients with fork until well blended and evenly moistened
2. Firmly press onto bottom and sides of a 9-inch pie pan
3. Bake 8-10 minutes until crust firms up and is set
4. Cool on wire rack
5. Chocolate ganache: combine cream and chocolate in glass measure or bowl
6. Microwave on high 1 to 1 1 / 2 minutes until cream is simmering
7. Whisk mixture until smooth
8. Pour over bottom of cooled crust , spreading into an even layer
9. Place in freezer 30 minutes or until ganache is firm
10. Meanwhile , prepare peanut butter streusel
11. Peanut butter streusel: stir together ingredients in small bowl with fork until confectioners' sugar is incorporated
12. Drop pea-sized clumps of streusel onto a plate , refrigerate 30 minutes
13. Peanut butter filling: using mixer with paddle attachment , cream together confectioners' sugar , peanut butter , cream cheese , ginger and vanilla until light and fluffy , about 2 minutes
14. Fold the whipped cream into the peanut butter mixture until incorporated
15. Spoon half of the filling into crust and spread into an even layer
16. Scatter streusel evenly over filling
17. Spoon the remaining filling over the streusel
18. With offset spatula , smooth filling into an even mound , sloping down to meet edge of crust
19. Place pie in freezer for at least 3 hours , or until filling is frozen hard
20. Peanut butter glaze / garnish: combine cream and white chocolate in 2-cup glass measure
21. Microwave on high for 30 seconds or until cream is simmering
22. Let stand 1 minute
23. Whisk melted chocolate into cream
24. Add peanut butter and vanilla
25. Whisk until glaze is smooth
26. Let glaze stand 5 minutes to thicken slightly
27. Slowly pour glaze over top of frozen pie , letting it slowly run down slopes of filling mound , to cover filling completely
28. Spoon shaved chocolate in a 2-inch band around edge of filling
29. Garnish with peanut halves
30. Freeze at least 1 hour or until firm

title: steamed asparagus with walnuts and browned butter sauce
steps:
1. In saute pan , dry roast the walnuts
2. Set aside to cool then very coarsely chop
3. In large pot steam the asparagus just until tender
4. Do not overcook
5. Arrange the asparagus on a serving platter
6. In the saute pan , melt the butter over medium heat
7. Cook and stir the butter constantly until it browns and smells nutty
8. Do not burn ! stir in the roasted walnuts and lemon zest
9. Pour the browned butter sauce over the asparagus and serve immediately
10. Season with salt and pepper to taste

title: festive ham glaze
steps:
1. Bake ham at 350 degrees for 1 hour
2. Melt butter
3. Stir in apricot preserves , mustard and brown sugar
4. Brush ham generously with apricot glaze
5. Bake 30 minutes longer , basting occasionally wih glaze

title: tasty collard greens
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat
2. Saute garlic until light brown
3. Add turkey leg and chicken broth , cover and simmer until turkey leg is tender
4. Remove turkey leg and cool slightly so comfortable to remove and chop meat and return turkey meat to pot
5. Add collard greens and turn heat up to medium-high and let the greens cook down for about 45 minutes , stirring occasionally
6. Reduce the heat and season with salt , pepper and red pepper flakes
7. Continue to cook until greens are tender - about 45 to 60 minutes
8. Drain greens and reserve liquid to reheat leftovers
9. I often freeze some of the liquid and use with frozen greens at another time

title: chunky southwestern gazpacho
steps:
1. Peel cucumber , but in half lengthwise , and scoop out seeds
2. Cut into bite-sized pieces and put in a 3-quart , or larger , bowl
3. Stem , seed , and cut the bell pepper into bite-sized pieces
4. I usually slide my knife over the inside of the pepper to remove the waxy part
5. Add to the bowl
6. Peel and finely chop the onion and add it to the bowl
7. Add tomatoes , their juice , and tomato-vegetable juice
8. Rinse and drain black beans and add to the bowl
9. Add garlic , stir in the vinegar , worcestershire sauce , and hot pepper sauce
10. Refrigerate for 2 hours or until thoroughly chilled , serve

title: oregano   lemon pork kebabs
steps:
1. For the marinade combine all ingredients in a resealable plastic bag or non-reactive bowl
2. Trim the pork of all visible fat and cut into 1 inch cubes
3. Place cubes in bag and marinate in the fridge for 30 minutes
4. In the meantime soak wooden skewers in water
5. Wash and cut vegetables for kebabs
6. Thread kebabs alternating between the pork cubes and vegetables
7. Depending on the size of your pork cubes and the length of the skewers , you will have 1 large or 2 small skewers per person
8. Place on indoor or outdoor grill and cook for 8 to 10 minutes

title: pineapple coconut jasmine rice
steps:
1. Bring water to a boil in a medium sized pot
2. Stir in the rice and reduce heat to low
3. Cover and cook for approximately 10 minutes or until water is absorbed ,
4. In a separate saucepan , heat the coconut milk over medium heat until hot but not boiling
5. Add the brown sugar and stir until dissolved
6. Add 1 / 2 of the coconut milk mixture to the cooked rice
7. Let the rice stand for about 15-20 minutes
8. Then add the diced pineapple and remainder of the coconut milk to the rice
9. Optional: added a sprinkle of cinnamon to the top of the rice when serving

title: trevor s fresh  onion dip
steps:
1. Place all ingredients except onion in a large bowl
2. Peel onion
3. Grate onion into cream cheese mixture
4. Add as much as you think you will need
5. With a hand blender , mix all till well blended
6. Taste , adjust seasonings
7. Add more milk if necessary to bring to your desired "dipability"

title: chicken breast baked in a bag with mushrooms  butter  white wine and thyme
steps:
1. Using wide tin foil , make your bag by placing 2 pieces on top of each other , folding 3 sides in and leaving 1 side open
2. Preheat the oven to 220c / 425 degrees f
3. Mix everything together in a bowl including the chicken
4. Place in your bag with all the wine juice , making sure you don't pierce the foil
5. Close up the final edge , making sure the bag is tightly sealed and secure on all sides , and carefully slide it onto a roasting tray
6. Place the tray on a high heat on the stove top for 1 minute to get the heat going , then bake in the middle of your preheated oven for 25 minutes
7. Remove from the oven , place the bag on a big plate , take it to the table and break open the foil

title: grannydragon s peanut butter noodles
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Heat oil , in a sauce pan , add onion , garlic and cook 2 minutes on medium
3. Add chicken broth , peanut butter , soy sauce vinegar , lemon juice , sugar and ginger
4. Turn heat to low , simmering 5 minutes , stirring often
5. Put chicken in a large serving bowl
6. Add chopped green onions
7. Drain cooked pasta , well
8. Add to serving bowl
9. Pour peanut butter sauce atop , combine ,
10. Garnish with chopped peanuts , when serving

title: liz s morning glory muffins
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingredients in a mixing bowl , in a seperate bowl , stir together remaining ingredients
2. Add to flour mixture , stirring until just moistened
3. Place paper baking cuts in muffin pans
4. Spoon batter into cups filling 2 / 3 full
5. Bake at 350 for 25 minutes or until golden brown
6. Remove from pans immediately

title: buttery lemon zest salmon with spinach salade and fries
steps:
1. Add zest to melted butter
2. Coat the rack of a pan with nonstick spray and put about 1 / 4 inch water in the bottom on the pan making sure it does not touch the top rack
3. Place frozen salmon on rack and bake for 10 minutes at 350 degrees
4. Turn salmon over and baste with the buttery zest
5. Bake three minutes more
6. Serve with your favorite salad and potato sides
7. Enjoy !

title: easy southern oven fried chicken
steps:
1. Strip skin from chicken pieces
2. Pour buttermilk over chicken in plastic or glass container
3. Turn chicken pieces to coat evenly
4. Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight
5. Preheat oven 425f smear 9x13 with oil
6. Set aside
7. Drainbuttermilk from chicken , place chicken on rack to drain
8. Combine bread crumbs with paprika , salt , thyme , and pepper roll chicken in bread crumbs
9. Arrange in single layer in prepared pan
10. Bake 30 minutes
11. Turn chicken
12. Bake 15 to 20 minutes longer

title: easy fall favorite apple bread
steps:
1. 1
2. Grease loaf pan in medium mixing bowl combine the flour , cinnamon , baking soda , baking powder , salt , and nutmeg
3. Set aside
4. 2
5. In another mixing bowl combine sugar , diced apple , applesauce , and egg
6. Mix well
7. Add dry mixture to apple mixture
8. Stir just till moistened , batter should be lumpy
9. 3
10. Spoon batter into prepared pan
11. Bake in 350 degree oven for 55 to 60 minutes or till a toothpick inserted near center comes out clean
12. Cool the pan on a wire rack for 10 minutes
13. Remove loaf from pan
14. Cool completely on wire rack
15. My oven seems to cook quicker and my bread ends up being ready after 50 minutes
16. Depending on your oven you might want to keep your eye on it a little earlier

title: pumpkin pie milkshakes
steps:
1. Place all ingredients except whipped cream in a blender
2. Blend on high for a few minutes or until everything is mixed up to the thickness you desire
3. Pour into 4 glasses
4. Top with whipped cream and sprinkle with a little more pumpkin pie spice on top
5. Serve cold

title: green bean   bacon wraps
steps:
1. Drain water off of green beans
2. Take five green beans and wrap with bacon end to end
3. Lay in shallow baking dish
4. Bake for 35 min at 375 degrees or until bacon is done
5. Add salt and pepper to taste

title: luau pork
steps:
1. Place a large sheet of heavy duty foil in a baking pan
2. Put roast on top and sprinkle with remaining ingredients
3. Seal very tightly
4. You might want to wrap it a second time
5. Turn on oven to 300or 325
6. Place pan on lower rack of oven and bake for 3 to 4 hours
7. Meat should fall apart and be very tender and juicy
8. To serve , shred the pork and mound on a platter and garnish

title: salad with hard boiled egg
steps:
1. Place the first 8 ingredients in a large bowl , mix carefully to combine
2. In a small bowl add the olive oil , lemon juice and splenda
3. Whisk to combine
4. Place the egg slices on top of the salad in a nice design and add the plum quarters around one edge of the bowl
5. Sprinkle with salt and grind pepper over
6. Drizzle the lemon / oil mix over all

title: falafel for charishma
steps:
1. Soak chickpeas in water-cover with water two inches above the beans
2. Cover and let stand for 8 hours
3. Drain
4. Combine chickpeas , cilantro and next 8 ingredients in a food processor , process until mixture resembles coarse meal
5. Divide chickpea mixture into 16 equal portions , shaping each into a 1 / 2 inch thick patty
6. Heat two tablespoons oil in a large non-stick skillet
7. Add 5 patties cook 3 minutes on each side or until golden
8. Repeat process twice with remaining oil and patties
9. Serve with tahini sauce

title: onigiri  rice balls
steps:
1. Sprinkle salmon with salt and let sit for 30 minute
2. Grill or fry the salmon until the edges are a little bit burned
3. When cool , flake salmon into small pieces and set aside
4. Cut nori into 8 equally sized , rectangular strips
5. Put warm rice in a bowl and combine with salmon and sesame seeds
6. Put a pinch of salt on your hands and take a 1 / 2 cup ball of rice
7. Form the rice into either a round or triangular shape br pressing lightly with both of your palms
8. Wrap a strip of nori around each rice ball

title: cheesecake factory s oreo dream extreme cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Make the chocolate cake by combining the sugar , egg , and vanilla in a medium bowl and mixing with an electric mixer on high for 2 minute
3. Add the oil and shortening and mix well , then add the water and mix until smooth
4. In another medium bowl , combine the flour , cocoa powder , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
5. Pour this dry blend into the bowl with the wet ingredients and mix until smooth
6. Pour into a well-greased 10-inch springform pan and bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes
7. While the cake is in the oven , prepare chocolate icing
8. Once the cake is completely cool , spread icing over the top of the cake , reserving some for garnishing the cake later
9. Freeze cake with icing for 1 hour
10. Prepare the oreo cheesecake layer by mixing the heavy cream , sugar , and vanilla in a medium bowl with an electric mixer on high until the cream forms stiff peaks
11. Mix in the softened cream cheese until smooth
12. Spread 1 / 3 of the mixture over the icing on the cake
13. Place whole oreo cookies in a single layer across the entire cake
14. Follow with the remaining cheesecake mixture
15. Chill for 1 hour
16. Make the oreo mousse layer by mixing packet of the powdered gelatin with the hot water
17. Refrigerate until set
18. Once set , place in cold water to soften gelatin enough to loosen it from the pan
19. Place softened gelatin into a double boiler and melt
20. In a separate double boiler , melt the chocolate , being careful not to burn it
21. Add melted chocolate to gelatin and mix well
22. Whip egg yolks by hand in a small bowl to soft foamy peaks
23. Mean while , bring honey to a boil
24. Pour hot honey onto the yolks stirring constantly
25. Fold the melted chocolate into the yolk mixture
26. Heat the milk in a small saucepan
27. Stir the milk into the chocolate mixture
28. In a large bowl , whip the cream to soft peaks and fold into the chocolate mixture
29. Add the crushed oreos to the mixture and mix well
30. Pour enough mousse over the cheesecake layer to form a layer about inch thick
31. There may be mousse left over
32. Chill for at least 2 hours or overnight
33. Prepare chocolate ganache layer by whisking together the egg , cream , and sugar in a medium metal bow
34. Set the bowl over water that is simmering in a medium saucepan over medium / low heat and whisk for 6 minutes , or until thick
35. Remove the bowl from the heat , add the chocolate chips , and mix with a spoon until smooth
36. Spread over the oreo mousse layer
37. Chill at least 1 hour
38. Load the reserved chocolate icing into a piping bag
39. Remove cake from springform pan and pipe icing into 12 even circles around the side of the cake
40. Lay oreo cookie with cream filling removed back onto each mound of icing
41. Press mini chocolate chips around the sides of the cake
42. Press firmly so that the chips stick
43. Chill the cake for at least another hour , then use a serrated knife to cut the cake into 12 slices
44. Serve with a mound of whipped cream and oreo cookie pieces to the side

title: basic white bread  for bread machine
steps:
1. For bread measure ingredients in order listed into baking pan insert baking pan into unit and close lid select basic setting and choose regular or dark crust
2. Push start button
3. Timer will signal when baking cycle is complete
4. Using pot holders , remove baking pan from unit and carefully turn bread out of baking pan
5. Allow to cool before slicing
6. For buns: prepare bread recipe and use dough setting when cycle ends , divide dough in to 16 small or 24 medium equal pieces
7. Roll into balls and place on greased baking sheet
8. Cover and let rise until double in size about 50 minutes
9. Bake at 375 degrees for 20 minutes

title: chopped iceberg wedge salad  the mermaid oyster bar
steps:
1. Make the dressing by whisking the mayo , ketchup , horseradish , worcestershire sauce and salt to taste in a small bowl to smooth
2. Cook the bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crisp , then transfer with a slotted spoon to a paper towel lined plate to drain
3. Roughly chop the lettuce , then toss with some of the dressing in a serving bowl
4. Top with the tomatoes and scallions
5. Scatter the bacon and cheese over the salad
6. Season with pepper and sprinkle with the parsley
7. Serve with more dressing on the side

title: pizza pot pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Cook and drain pasta as directed on package
3. While pasta is cooking , break apart italian sausage and cook over medium heat in a large skillet , until done , about 5-7 minutes add in onion , oregano , basil and pepper , stir well drain excess fat
4. Stir cooked sausage , onion , oregano , basil and pepper into pasta sauce in an ungreased 9-inch deep dish pie plate or 2 1 / 2 quart
5. Casserole dish
6. Add cooked pasta , blend well
7. Cover top completely with mozzarella slices
8. Bake 15 minutes or until cheese is melted and mixture is hot
9. Great served with garlic bread or garlic sticks and a side salad

title: yum yum balls
steps:
1. Crush the biscuits in a food processor
2. Add condensed milk , 1 cup coconut and cocoa
3. Roll into balls and roll in extra coconut

title: lemon dill broiled fish
steps:
1. In a small bowl , whisk together the olive oil , garlic , salt and pepper
2. Spoon over the fish fillets
3. Broil on a greased baking sheet 6 inches from the heat for 8 minutes or until the fish flakes easily when tested with a fork
4. To serve , whisk together the lemon juice , mustard and dill weed
5. Drizzle over the fish

title: bacon tomato gruyere omelet
steps:
1. After the butter is good and hot in the pan , scatter in the bacon
2. Shake the pan once to make sure the bacon is not sticking
3. Now pour in the beaten eggs
4. Tilt and pull a couple of times and sprinkle in the cheese , keeping it well in the eggs
5. Pull a couple more times to cook to desired doneness
6. Scatter in the tomato pieces , avoiding the edge of the pan
7. Immediately de-pan the omelet , flipping it into a half circle on your warmed plate
8. The tomatoes will be sufficiently warmed being folded into the omelet at the end of the process and shouldn't be cooked so much as to release their water
9. Water in the pan will cause sticking

title: easy ham and noodles
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Place the noodles , ham , cheese , soup and milk in a 9x9-inch casserole dish
3. Mix well
4. Bake at 375 for 20-30 minutes

title: the bestest chocolate cake ever  with chocolate frosting
steps:
1. Mix: sugar , flour , cocoa , baking powder , baking soda , salt , eggs , milk , vegetable oil & vanilla
2. Add: 1 cup boiling water
3. Pour into 2 9" pans
4. Bake @ 350 for 30-35
5. Frosting- mix: cocoa & butter
6. Gradually add : milk , powdered sugar & vanilla
7. Stack cooled cakes
8. Pour frosting over cake

title: pineapple n  biscuit creamy delight
steps:
1. Beat cream and sugar well
2. Add the chopped pineapple and keep aside
3. Next mix coffee with little water
4. Dip each biscuit in coffee and make a layer in a dish or tray
5. Cover the layer of biscuits with the cream and pineapple mix
6. Make layers till you finish the biscuits and cover the top layer with cream and cherries
7. Refrigerate
8. Serve chilled

title: super simple crock pot beef stroganoff
steps:
1. Place stew meat , cream of mushroom , can of mushrooms , and onion in crock pot
2. Cook on low for 6-8 hours
3. Every few hours , give the mixture a quick stir
4. About 30 minutes before you are ready to serve , add the sour cream and mix thoroughly
5. Serve over egg noodles
6. Hint -- if you feel that the stroganoff is too runny -- tilt the crock pot lid so it is slightly open about about 1-1 / 2 hrs before done to let the liquid cook out

title: the chicken  la king
steps:
1. Cut the chicken breasts into 1 / 2-inch cubes
2. In a 12-inch skillet , heat the 4 teaspoons of olive oil over medium-high heat
3. Add the cubed chicken , garlic , celery and the chopped onion
4. Cook , stirring , until the chicken pieces are golden brown , about 8 minutes
5. Stir in the 1 / 3 cup flour and cook 1 minute , stirring constantly
6. While stirring , gradually pour in the milk , sherry and chicken broth , and stir to blend
7. Stir in parsley , paprika , poultry seasoning , rosemary , salt and pepper
8. Bring the mixture to a boil and cook , stirring occasionally , until thickened , 7 to 10 minutes
9. Taste to adjust seasoning
10. Meanwhile , in another skillet , saut red pepper cubes in butter
11. Add to chicken
12. Stir in the cream
13. Serve on patty shell , over rice or on toasts

title: cherry tomato and watermelon salad
steps:
1. Toss tomatoes , 1 / 4 teaspoon salt , and sugar in medium bowl
2. Let stand for 30 minutes
3. Transfer tomatoes to salad spinner and spin until seeds and excess liquid have been removed , 45 to 60 seconds , stirring to redistribute tomatoes several times during spinning
4. Return tomatoes to bowl and set aside
5. Strain tomato liquid through fine-mesh strainer into liquid a measuring cup , pressing on solids to extract as much liquid as possible
6. Bring 1 / 2 cup tomato liquid , shallot , and vinegar to simmer in small saucepan over medium heat
7. Simmer until reduced to 3 tablespoons , 6 to 8 minutes
8. Transfer mixture to small bowl and cool to room temperature , about 5 minutes
9. Whisk in oil and pepper to taste until combined
10. Taste and season with up to 1 / 8 teaspoon table salt
11. Add the drained watermelon , mint , feta , and dressing to bowl with tomatoes
12. Toss gently and serve

title: misoyaki butterfish
steps:
1. Add the sake and mirin to a heavy bottomed pot and bring to a boil for about 10-15 minutes to burn off the alcohol
2. Next , turn down the heat and stir in the sugar and miso
3. Cook until it turns a pale caramel color
4. Remove from heat and allow it to cool completely
5. To prepare the fish , it first needs to be defrosted
6. Once that's done , rinse in cold running water and then pat dry with a clean paper towel
7. Place into a ziploc bag
8. I add the miso marinade and then let this sit in the refrigerator for 48-72 hours
9. 72 hours later remove your filet from the ziploc bag
10. Add about a tablespoon of vegetable oil to a skillet which is on medium-low heat
11. Add your fish to the pan
12. Cook for about 4-5 minutes , turn then cook for another 4-5 minutes , you're ready to serve
13. Serve with hot rice and maybe some tsukimono , salad greens and miso soup
14. If you like that the skin to be crispy , bake until turns black
15. You can also do this on a grill by wrapping the fish in tin foil , but to make skin crispy you have to fry it after taking it off the grill

title: white taco soup
steps:
1. In a large soup pot , saute onion in butter until translucent
2. Toward the end of the onion's cooking time , add garlic
3. Add hot water , bouillon , and cumin
4. Bring to a boil and cook 5 minutes
5. Reduce heat to medium-low to stop boil
6. Stir in milk , cheese , creamed corn , and green chilies
7. Stir and heat through only until cheese is melted

title: fruity tea punch
steps:
1. Dissolve the sugar in the hot tea
2. Stir in the juices
3. Pour over a large block of ice
4. Just before serving add the 7-up and garnish with mint leaves or fruit slices

title: white russian sorbet
steps:
1. Stir water and sugar in heavy medium sauce pan over medium heat until sugar dissolves
2. Increase heat and bring to boil
3. Remove from heat
4. Add espresso powder and stir to dissolve
5. Pour into medium bowl
6. Mix in corn syrup , then whipping cream , vodka and kahla
7. Refrigerate mixture until cold , about 2 hours
8. Transfer sorbet mixture to ice cream maker
9. Process according to manufacturer's instructions
10. Transfer sorbet to container
11. Cover and freeze until firm , about 2 hours
12. Put 4 coffee cups in freezer for 30 minutes
13. Scoop sorbet into cold cups
14. Garnish with coffee beans and serve immediately

title: pilgrim diner hawaiian chicken
steps:
1. In a small sauce pan heat ingredients of fruit cocktail with sugar , clove and cinnamon
2. When comes to a boil , lower heat and simmer for several more minutes , then remove cinnamon and clove set aside
3. Dredge chicken breasts in flour , then eggs
4. Saut in medium-large saucepan in hot oil , several minutes per side , then drain oil
5. In the same pan , add chicken stock to chicken and the fruit sauce
6. Simmer for several minutes
7. Plate with sliced bananas , pineapples , peaches and coconut
8. Serves one

title: wayne s beef macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Heat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Cook the macaroni according to package directions
3. Drain and set aside
4. Heat the oil in a skillet
5. Add the peppers , onion , and garlic , and saute until soft
6. Add the ground beef and saute until browned
7. Add the tomatoes , salt and pepper , to taste , and the basil , cumin , and oregano
8. In a large bowl , combine the macaroni and the beef mixture
9. Spread this mixture into a 9 by 13-inch baking dish
10. Top with the cheese and bake for 20 to 25 minutes , or until the cheese is lightly browned and bubbly
11. Cook's

title: chocolate whipped cream frosting or topping
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients in a bowl and blend with a fork
2. Set in the refrigerator for two hours
3. Whip and frost the cake

title: roasted nutmeg cauliflower
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees
2. Place the cauliflower in a 9x13 inch baking dish , toss with the oil , and sprinkle with the nutmeg and salt
3. Cover
4. Roast for 20 to 30 minutes , stir occasionally-edges should get toasty
5. Top with yogurt

title: low carb copycat godiva chocolate cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
2. Tightly wrap bottom of 9-inch springform pan with heavy-duty aluminum foil
3. Place chocolate in microwave safe bowl
4. Microwave on med
5. Power for 1 min
6. Stir
7. Microwave at 30 sec
8. Intervals until chocolate is smooth
9. Let cool
10. Meanwhile , beat cream cheese in mixing bowl until fluffy , using electric mixer at low speed
11. Gradually add splenda and beat until blended
12. Add eggs , one at a time , beating after each addition
13. Dissolve salt in hot coffee
14. Beat in vanilla and melted chocolate until blended
15. Pour mixture into pan and place in a roasting pan
16. Pour hot water into roasting pan until the water comes up to about half way up the side of the springform pan
17. Bake for 55 to 60 min
18. Or until center is firm
19. Leave cheesecake in oven prop oven door open and let cool in oven for 1 hour
20. Remove cheesecake from roasting pan
21. Cool cheesecake in the pan on wire rack
22. When cheesecake is cooled , cover with aluminum foil and chill at least 6 hours or overnight
23. Then remove sides of springform and cut into 12 wedges

title: sweet potato pound cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease and dust with flour two 8 1 / 2 x 4 1 / 2 x 2 5 / 8 loaf pans
3. Mix flour , baking powder , baking soda , nutmeg , mace , and cinnamon in a medium sized bowl
4. In a large bowl , beat at high speed with electric mixer , unsalted butter , granulated sugar and brown sugar until light and fluffy
5. At low speed , add sweet potato and eggs one at a time until well mixed
6. Beat flour mixture into the sweet potato mixture
7. Add vanilla and mix
8. Pour batter equally divided into 2 loaf pans
9. Bake for approximately 55 minutes
10. Serve warm or cold and can be frozen
11. Enjoy !

title: pastry puffs w sweet cheese filling
steps:
1. Position knife blade in food processor
2. Add flour and butter and pulse 4 or 5 timestil mixture resembles coarse crumbs
3. Add sour cream and egg
4. Process til dough forms a ball and leaves sides of bowl
5. Divide in half , wrap with plastic wrap , and chill 6-8 hours
6. Roll out each ball of pastry on a lightly floured surface to an 1 / 8" thickness
7. Cut pastry into 3" squares
8. Gently press each square into a 1 3 / 4" muffin pan leaving corners extending beyond edge
9. Spoon 1 teaspoons filling into each prepared shell
10. Fold corners over filling and pinch together at the top
11. Chill 30 minutes
12. Bake at 375 for 20-25 minutes
13. Remove from pan and cool on wire rack
14. Sprinkle with powdered sugar
15. Cheese filling:
16. To make the cheesecake-like filling , beat all ingredients at medium speed til smooth and fluffy

title: nif s grilled hawaiian chicken skewers
steps:
1. Mix all marinade ingredients and add chicken
2. Marinate for 1 to 2 hours , no more
3. If you are using wooden skewers , be sure to soak them in water for 2 hours
4. Heat grill to medium-high
5. Alternate chicken , pineapple and pepper pieces on skewers
6. Place on grill until chicken is cooked through , about 5 minutes on each side

title: leeky mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Put diced potatoes in a large saucepan and cover with water
2. Bring to a boil and cover and simmer 12 minutes or until tender
3. Drain
4. Return cooked potatoes to pot
5. While potatoes are cooking: in a skillet over med-high heat , melt 2 tbsp butter and add chopped leeks
6. Saute the leeks , stirring often , for about 5 minutes , or until leeks are soft
7. Add the cooked chopped leeks to the pot of drained , cooked potatoes
8. Add the milk , cubed cream cheese , 3 tbsp butter , salt , pepper , paprika , and parsley
9. Mash everything together w / potato masher to desired consistency

title: chicken chow mein with noodles
steps:
1. Peel and dice carrot , onion , cauliflower and broccoli
2. Heat wok half filled with salted water , add vegetables and boil for ten minutes
3. Drain vegetables and put to side
4. Heat wok with 1 dessert spoon of oil , added chicken plus the sauces , garlic , ginger and half teaspoon of salt
5. Cook chicken until tender then add vegetables to meat
6. Add bean sprouts
7. Cover with warm water and bring to boil
8. When boiling have cornflour mixed with about quarter cup of water and stir into mixture
9. Cook a minute more then serve with noodles
10. Cook noodles as per instructions

title: the absolute best applesauce spice muffins with spice topping
steps:
1. Set oven to 350f
2. Set oven rack to second-lowest position
3. Butter 12 muffin tins or line with paper liners
4. For muffins: in a small bowl mix together first 7 dry ingredients
5. In another large bowl whisk together eggs and brown sugar until well combined
6. Add in melted butter whisking continuously until mixture is creamy
7. Stir in applesauce
8. Fold in flour mixture until just combined
9. Stir in nuts
10. Divide the batter evenly between muffin tins
11. To make the topping: stir together all ingredients then sprinkle over tops of muffin batter
12. Bake for about 20-22 minutes , or until muffins test done
13. Cool in pan for 5 minutes then remove to a rack to cool

title: applesauce maple muffins low fat
steps:
1. Combine dry ingredients and stir
2. Combine wet ingredients and stir
3. Stir wet into dry and blend just until combined and moist
4. Fold in nuts spray muffin tins , and fill each cup 3 / 4 full
5. Bake 350 degrees for 17 minutes , or until tester comes away clean
6. Remove to wire rack , let sit 6 minutes then , remove from tins , onto wire rack

title: simple potato   egg salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix the mayonnaise and yoghurt with a little freshly-ground black pepper
2. Add the quartered new potatoes , and toss well
3. Roughly chop the eggs and add them to the potatoes with the sliced radishes
4. Turn gently to mix , then chill until ready to serve
5. When ready to serve , shred the lettuce and arrange it on one large serving plate or on four individual plates , then place the potato and egg salad in the middle
6. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and a little extra black pepper

title: chili chicken stew
steps:
1. Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces
2. Cook chicken , onion , green pepper , and garlic in hot oil in a dutch oven until lightly browned
3. Add next 6 ingredients
4. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 20 minutes
5. Serve in soup bowls
6. Top individual servings with remaining ingredients

title: steak in rum and mushroom sauce for two
steps:
1. Rub both sides of the steak , first with the pepper , and then the olive oil
2. Sear the meat in a dry frying pan for 3 1 / 2 minutes per side or until you are happy with the doneness
3. Remove the meat , add the butter and stir until it is melted and starts to turn brown
4. Reduce the heat , add the flour , rum , liquid from the mushroom can , and the mushrooms
5. Stir until the sauce thickens
6. If the sauce is too thick , add the water
7. Adjust taste with the salt
8. Serve with a baked potato , or another option is to add cooked pasta to the mushroom sauce while it is still in the pan

title: watercress  sweet pear  rocket  walnut and parmesan salad
steps:
1. If the skins are nice just give them a wash , if not remove with a peeler
2. Then cut them in half and deseed
3. It doesn`t really matter how you cut them up
4. Sometimes in big rough chunks , maybe sliced up or even grated
5. Then place into the bowl with the watercress and rocket
6. The pepperiness of the leaves works so well with the sweetness of the pear
7. Drizzle with a good extra virgin olive oil just to coat , a small squeeze of lemon juice , and season well with salt and freshly ground black pepper
8. Toss all this together and serve
9. Shave over some parmesan or pecorino , crumble your nuts over

title: secret weapon toddler muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f and grease a muffin pan
2. Combine zucchini , baby food , oats , flours , egg , sugar , and vanilla in a bowl
3. The mixture will be dry , just be patient and combine well
4. Let this mixture sit for about 15 minutes or long enough for the oatmeal to soak up some of the liquid
5. Add the baking soda , baking powder , salt , and cinnamon , mixing well
6. Stir in the walnuts
7. Scoop the batter into muffin pan and sprinkle with cinnamon
8. Bake for approximately 25 minutes

title: mashed potato gnocchi
steps:
1. Peel , slice , boil , and drain the potatoes very well
2. Mash the potatoes with butter
3. Knead flour into mashed potatoes , gradually adding garlic and pepper to the dough
4. Meanwhile , simmer spaghetti sauce in a separate saucepan and fill a separate pot of boiled water
5. Roll dough into small balls about 1 / 2" to 1" in diameter
6. Press each dough ball with a fork
7. Carefully drop gnocchi into rapidly boiling water
8. When the gnocchi float , remove them from the water and drop them into the pasta sauce to keep them warm as you boil all gnocchi
9. Serve

title: vegetable strata
steps:
1. Butter an 8 inch square baking pan
2. Cut bread into inch cubes and distribute evenly in pan
3. Top with cheese
4. Toss vegetables together and distribute over cheese
5. In a bowl , whisk together eggs , milk , mustard and salt and pour over vegetables
6. Chill , covered , overnight
7. Preheat oven to 340 degrees f
8. Sprinkle basil and pepper to taste over strata
9. Put in larger baking pan and pour in enough hot water to come halfway up sides
10. Bake in middle of oven for 1 hour , or until top is golden

title: heirloom tomato  mozzarella and basil side dish
steps:
1. Cut the tomato in half
2. If tomato will not sit flat , take a small thin slice off of the bottom
3. Place 1 piece of mozzarella on top of each tomato half
4. Chiffonade the basil into thin strips and place 1 / 2 the basil on top of the mozzarella
5. Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic over the tomato / mozzarella / basil
6. Serve with salt to taste

title: raspberry jello cranberry relish
steps:
1. Mix the 3 boxes of gelatin with the 2 cups of sugar
2. Bring the 3 cups of water to a boil and pour over gelatin and sugar mixture
3. Whisk until dissolved and set aside
4. In a very large mixing bowl , mix crushed pineapple , finely chopped cranberries , chopped apples , and chopped oranges
5. Stir in chopped pecans or walnuts
6. Pour gelatin over fruit and nut mixture
7. Mix well
8. Cover and refrigerate for at least 24 hours and up to 2 weeks before serving

title: pastry cream
steps:
1. Heat half-and-half , 6 tablespoons sugar , and salt in medium heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium heat until simmering , stirring occasionally to dissolve sugar
2. If using vanilla bean , add this as well
3. Whisk yolks in medium bowl until thoroughly combined
4. Whisk in remaining 2 tablespoons sugar and whisk until sugar begins to dissolve and mixture is creamy
5. Whisk in cornstarch until combined and mixture is pal yellow and thick
6. When half-and-half mixture reaches full simmer , gradually whisk half-and-half mixture into yolk mixture to temper
7. Return mixture to pan , scraping bowl with rubber spatula
8. Return to simmer over medium heat , whisking constantly , until a few bubbles burst on the surface and the mixture is thickened and glossy
9. This takes about a minute
10. Off heat , whisk in butter and vanilla
11. Strain the pastry cream through a fine-mesh sieve set over medium bowl
12. This will remove any curdled bits that might have formed during the cooking process
13. Press plastic wrap directly on surface of pastry cream to prevent skimming and refrigerate until cold and ready to use

title: alton brown s yeast doughnuts
steps:
1. Place the milk in a medium saucepan and heat over medium heat just until warm enough to melt the shortening
2. Place the shortening in a bowl and pour warmed milk over
3. Set aside
4. In a small bowl , sprinkle the yeast over the warm water and let dissolve for 5 minutes
5. After 5 minutes , pour the yeast mixture into the large bowl of a stand mixer and add the milk and shortening mixture , first making sure the milk and shortening mixture has cooled to lukewarm
6. Add the eggs , sugar , salt , nutmeg , and half of the flour
7. Using the paddle attachment , combine the ingredients on low speed until flour is incorporated and then turn the speed up to medium and beat until well combined
8. Add the remaining flour , combining on low speed at first , and then increase the speed to medium and beat well
9. Change to the dough hook attachment of the mixer and beat on medium speed until the dough pulls away from the bowl and becomes smooth , approximately 3 to 4 minutes
10. Transfer to a well-oiled bowl , cover , and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled in size
11. On a well-floured surface , roll out dough to 3 / 8-inch thick
12. Cut out dough using a 2 1 / 2-inch doughnut cutter or pastry ring and using a 7 / 8-inch ring for the center whole
13. Set on floured baking sheet , cover lightly with a tea towel , and let rise for 30 minutes
14. Preheat the oil in a deep fryer or dutch oven to 365 degrees f
15. Gently place the doughnuts into the oil , 3 to 4 at a time
16. Cook for 1 minute per side
17. Transfer to a cooling rack placed in baking pan
18. Allow to cool for 15 to 20 minutes prior to glazing , if desired

title: fudgy low fat chocolate cake bites
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray 8-inch square pan with nonstick cooking spray
3. Dust with cocoa , shaking out excess back into bowl
4. Mix margarine , sugar , egg , applesauce and vanilla in a bowl , beating until smooth
5. In a separate bowl sift flour , cocoa , baking soda & salt , then mix until well combined
6. Combine the wet and dry ingredients , mix until well combined
7. Pour into pan and bake 25-30 minutes until set
8. Cool completely and cut into 16 squares
9. Enjoy !
10. Optional- spread sugar-free preserves with splenda on top for a yummy fruity topping !

title: orange   cranberry squares
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f and spray an 8-inch square baking dish with vegetable spray
2. Make squares: in a bowl and using a whisk or electric mixer , beat brown sugar , sugar , orange rind , orange juice , oil , egg and vanilla
3. In another bowl , stir together flour , cranberries , baking powder and cinnamon
4. With a wooden spoon , stir the mixture into the orange mixture until mixed
5. Spread into a prepared dish
6. Make topping: in a small bowl , stir together sugar and cinnamon
7. Sprinkle the mixture over the squares
8. Bake in the centre of the oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until a tester inserted into the centre comes out dry
9. Let the dish cool on a wire rack

title: ginger mangotinis
steps:
1. In small saucepan , bring 1 / 2 c water , the ginger , and granulated sugar to a boil , stirring , to dissolve the sugar
2. Remove from heat
3. Refrigerated for 20 minutes
4. Strain into a pitcher
5. Fill small dish with coarse sugar
6. Lightly wet the rims of 6 martini glasses , then , one by one , turn them over and rotate the rims in the coarse sugar to coat
7. Add the mango nectar , vodka , and lime juice to the pitcher
8. Stir well
9. Refrigerate until chilled
10. Serve in prepared glasses

title: flat omelet for a stress free life
steps:
1. Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a medium sized oven-proof skillet over medium heat
2. I use a 10-inch caste iron
3. When hot add the broccoli
4. Cook the broccoli until heated through
5. Add 1 tablespoon oil and the onions
6. Cook until the onions soften
7. About 5 minutes
8. Turn heat down to medium-low
9. Pour the egg over the broccoli so that it is in an even layer
10. Cook undisturbed until the eggs just set
11. 5-10 minutes

title: chocolate brownie waffles
steps:
1. Grease and preheat waffle iron
2. Combine flour , baking powder , salt , sugar , chocolate chips , cocoa , and walnuts in a large mixing bowl
3. In a small mixing bowl , combine egg yolks , milk , and cooking oil
4. Add the liquid mixture to the dry mixture
5. Stir until combined , but still lumpy
6. In a small bowl , beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form
7. Gently , fold the egg whites into the lumpy batter
8. Pour the batter onto the iron and bake until done
9. For an even more sinful treat , top with whipped cream , fresh strawberries or raspberries , chocolate sauce and chopped nuts

title: south beach phase one  breaded chicken
steps:
1. Place the egg in a bowl and scramble it
2. Cut / trim the chicken and place in the egg mixture
3. Combine ground flax seed , the chicken seasoning and pecans
4. Heat oil in a pan
5. While the oil is heating , take the peices of chicken and dip them in the dry mixture
6. Place these "breaded" peices into the hot oil and cook both sides
7. Drain peices on paper towel to remove excess oil
8. Meanwhile , combine some sour cream and mustard to make a dipping sauce
9. Enjoy !

title: macaroni cheese
steps:
1. To a saucepan of boiling water , add macaroni and olive oil
2. Boil until macaroni is just tender
3. Do not over cook it
4. Drain , and set aside
5. In a large saucepan , place onions , capsicums , mushrooms , and zucchini
6. Sprinkle with a little water , cover , and cook over a medium heat until tender
7. To the vegetables , add the soup , 1 can of water , and cayenne
8. Bring to the boil
9. Add 500g cheese , mix through
10. Add macaroni , mix all together , pour into a large baking dish
11. Cover with extra cheese , and bake at 180c for around 30 minutes , or until cheese has started to brown

title: shrimp potato salad
steps:
1. In a small bowl , mix together mayonnaise , mustard and lemon juice
2. Set aside
3. Combine all remaining ingredients , being careful not to mash
4. Carefully stir in mayonnaise mixture until well blended
5. Garnish with a dusting of paprika

title: zucchini roni pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Place peppers in a food processor and pulse-grind into a paste
3. Spread thinly over pizza crust
4. Top with thin layer of cheese
5. Place thinly sliced zucchini discs in a small bowl and combine with remaining ingredients
6. Toss discs well to evenly coat with seasonings and let marinate
7. The zucchini discs will have a flavor similar to pepperoni
8. Arrange zucchini around the pizza , do not overlap them
9. Bake direcly on the oven rack or on a preheated pizza pan for 10 minutes
10. To roast red peppers: preheat broiler
11. Halve peppers and take out seeds
12. Place on a cookie sheet , skin side up
13. Broil until skins are black
14. Leave door ajar while peppers roast to let steam escape
15. Place blackened peppers in a paper bag and close tightly
16. Let stand 10 minutes or until cool enough to handle
17. Peel off skins
18. Can be roasted on a grill - but leave whole instead
19. 1 serving=2 slices
20. Can be used as a carb craver for lawl

title: nif s light and lean chef s salad
steps:
1. Put lettuce and tomatoes into a large salad owl
2. Pour in the first amount of dressing and sprinkle with preferred amount of pepper
3. Mix well
4. Divide and place on 2 serving plates
5. Arrange half of the cheese , ham , turkey and eggs in rows on each plate of the lettuce mixture
6. You can sprinkle with a bit more dressing if you want to

title: szechuan fried eggplant
steps:
1. In a wok heat oil and cook the eggplant pieces for 3 to 4 minutes , or until lightly brown , remove from wok , drain on paper towels and set aside
2. In clean wok , heat 2 tablespoons of oil , add chili bean sauce , stir rapidly ,
3. Add the gingerroot , and garlic stir until fragrant
4. Add the stock , sugar , and soy sauce
5. Add the eggplant pieces and let simmer for 2 minutes
6. Stir in the scallions and serve

title: peachy vanilla jam
steps:
1. In a large bowl pour in sugar and add both sides of cut vanilla bean
2. Stir
3. Let stand for 48 hours , stirring now and again
4. In a large enamel or stainless steal pot combine peaches , lemon juice and pectin
5. Turn heat to high , stirring constantly for 5 minutes or until a full rolling boil is reached
6. Add sugar and vanilla bean to pot
7. Return to a full rolling boil and boil for 1 minute
8. Remove vanilla bean
9. Ladle into clean hot jars leaving 1 / 4 inch head space
10. Process in a boiling water bath for 5 minutes
11. If you would prefer skip part 1 with the vanilla bean , when you go to add the sugar add 1 t pure vanilla extract , omiting the vanilla bean step

title: peanut butter and chocolate mousse pie
steps:
1. Melt 1-1 / 2 cups peanut butter chips
2. Beat cream cheese , powdered sugar and 1 / 3 cup milk in medium bowl until smooth
3. Add melted chips
4. Beat well
5. Beat in remaining 2 tablespoons milk
6. Spread into cooled crust
7. Sprinkle gelatin over cold water in small bowl
8. Let stand 1 minute to soften
9. Add boiling water
10. Stir until gelatin is completely dissolved
11. Cool slightly
12. Combine sugar and cocoa in medium bowl
13. Add whipping cream and vanilla
14. Beat at medium speed until stiff
15. Pour in gelatin mixture , beating until well blended
16. Spoon into crust over peanut butter layer
17. Refrigerate several hours
18. Garnish with remaining chips
19. Cover
20. Store leftover pie in refrigerator

title: baked beets
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Wrap beets in foil and arrange beets in a casserole dish
3. Bake 1 hour
4. When cool rub skin away and remove stem and root
5. Slice thickly and serve or put in a saucepan , add a little butter and toss beets until warmed through

title: apple orchard punch
steps:
1. In a large punch bowl , combine apple juice , cranberry juice concentrate and orange juice
2. Stir until mixed
3. Slowly pour the ginger ale down the sides of the bowl
4. Thinly slice the apple vertically , forming whole apple slices
5. Float apple slices on the top of the punch
6. You can also try floating dried apple rings or orange slices
7. You can also make a frozen juice ring
8. I think this might be good with a spiced cinnamon syrup

title: spanish garlic shrimp
steps:
1. Heat oil in large nonstick fry pan
2. Add onion and bell pepper , saut 4 minutes
3. Stir in remaining ingredients except shrimp , bring to simmer and cook 2 minutes
4. Add shrimp and , stirring often , cook 2 minutes or until cooked through

title: grilled balsamic eggplant
steps:
1. Add the marinade ingredients into a bag tossing to combine
2. Add the 4 quarters of the eggplant and marinade for 1 hour at room temperature or overnight in the refrigerator
3. Preheat grill to high
4. Place the wedges on the grates reserving the marinade
5. Grill on hot oiled grates lowering heat to medium
6. Brown on all three sides
7. Marking each side
8. Will be ready when easy to remove from grate
9. For more tender move to indirect heat and grill till desired
10. About 10 minutes
11. Pour the reserved marinade over the hot eggplant

title: savoury bacon and blue cheese danish pastries
steps:
1. Pre-heat the oven to 400f , gas mark 6 , 200c
2. Heat the oil , add the onion and saute until lightly coloured and soft
3. Add the chopped bacon and cook gently , stirring occasionally
4. When the bacon is cooked & crispy , add the paprika , mustard , worcestershire sauce , black pepper and salts
5. Allow to cool a little then add the sour cream and crumbled blue cheese
6. Season to taste
7. Roll out the pastry thinly and cut into 8 squares
8. Put a spoonful of the mixture onto each square , and bring two corners over the top to meet each other and make a diamond shape - covering most of the filling
9. Put on a greased and lined baking tray , glaze with the beaten egg and bake in the pre-heated oven for about 20- 25 minutes , or until pastry is puffed up and golden brown

title: orange lacquered duck
steps:
1. Combine first 4 ingredients in a saucepan
2. Boil until reduced to 3 / 4 cup
3. Set aside
4. Meanwhile boil yams in water until almost fork tender , 15 minutes
5. Cool , peel , and cut into 1 / 4" slices
6. In a skillet sear duck , breast side down until brown
7. Flip duck , add yam slices and add oj reduction
8. Cook 8 minutes more or until liquid is reduced by half
9. In a separate pan saute bok choy in sesame oil for 1-2 minutes
10. To serve: fan duck breasts over yams , with bok choy
11. Drizzle with pan juices

title: simple poached herbed chicken
steps:
1. Place chicken in a stockpot or pan large enough for the chicken and other ingreedients to be completely covered with liquid
2. Place carrots , celery , and onion around chicken in pot
3. Combine chicken broth , bullion , and enough water to cover veggies and chicken in pot
4. Add herbs
5. Bring to a rolling simmer , reduce heat and simmer gently 1 hour
6. Remove chicken from liquid , set aside to cool
7. Increase heat to rolling boil for ten minutes or until reduced to desired thickness
8. Remove from heat and strain broth into jar
9. Broth can be stored in refrigerator for up to one week , or in the freezer indefinitely
10. Using two forks , shred chicken into bite-sized pieces
11. Use in salads , wraps and sandwiches , or pastas

title: ham bean soup  pressure cooker
steps:
1. Put the ham bone in the bottom of the pressure cooker
2. Pour the dried beans on top of the bone , and cover with cold water
3. Sprinkle on the dried onion , garlic powder , and pepper
4. Lock on the lid , bring to pressure , then reduce the heat and cook for 25 minutes
5. Remove from the heat , and let sit for 15 minutes , before carefully removing any remaining pressure
6. Remove the lid , pour in the can of tomatoes including their juice , and the ham pieces
7. Simmer for 20 minutes

title: p90x shrimp pasta pomodorolevel iii
steps:
1. Bring large pot of water to boil for pasta
2. Meanwhile , place olive oil and garlic in a large saut pan and saut for several minutes until lightly browned
3. Add chicken broth and tomatoes to pan
4. Simmer for 5 to 10 minutes or until tender
5. Cook the pasta according to the directions on the package
6. Drain
7. Add shrimp to pan and cook for several more minutes , until shrimp are opaque
8. Add basil and toss shrimp mixture with cooked pasta

title: italian creamy noodles
steps:
1. Cook noodles to desired tenderness
2. Drain in colander
3. Place butter or margarine in sauce pan used to cook noodles
4. Add noodles and toss to coat
5. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well
6. Serve immediately

title: italian wedgie sandwiches
steps:
1. Make the bread:
2. Separate the pizza doug in half
3. Roll out as if you were making a regular pizza crust
4. Drizzle each round with olive oil , salt , black pepper , garlic , and parm cheese
5. Bake according to manufacturers directions
6. Make the dressing:
7. Whisk together all ingredients until well incorporated
8. Make the sandwich:
9. Take one of the pizza crusts , seasoned side down , and drizzle 1 / 2 of the dressing on the bread
10. Layer the meat , cheese , and vegetables
11. Pour remaining dressing on top
12. Top the giant sandwich with the second pizza crust
13. Press
14. Cut the giant pizza shaped sandwich into 8 wedges
15. Bake the wedges in oven or toaster oven at 350 for a few minutes to allow cheese to melt
16. Serve and be happy !

title: pizza  beans
steps:
1. Soak the beans overnight
2. Drain beans , place in large saucepan , cover with water , add bay leaves and bring to the boil
3. Allow to simmer for 1 hour , or until tender
4. Drain
5. Finely chop onion and peppers
6. Saute onion , peppers , garlic and spices until onion browns slightly
7. Add cooked beans
8. Stir to mix ingredients
9. Simmer for 5-10 minutes
10. Add the tomato and tomato paste
11. Add salt and sugar to taste
12. Cook for a further 10-15 minutes on low to allow the flavours to develop
13. Serve over cooked white or brown rice

title: feijoa   lime muffins
steps:
1. Sift the flour , baking powder and sugar into a large bowl and make a well in the centre
2. In a jug blend together the eggs and milk and add the feijoa's
3. Blend into the dry ingredients folding in the butter as you go
4. Divide the mixture evenly between 12 well greased muffin tins
5. Bake at 220 degrees celsius for 15-20 minutes until cooked
6. To make the glaze , simmer the sugar , orange juice and lime juice together until the sugar has dissolved
7. Stand muffins for 2 minutes before brushing with the glaze
8. Stand a further 5 minutes before serving

title: grilled lemon oregano chicken
steps:
1. Combine all marinade ingredients
2. Add chicken breast halves to the marinade
3. Marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours
4. Grill until done

title: marshmallow frosting
steps:
1. In top of double boiler , combine egg whites , sugar , cream of tarter , corn syrup , and water
2. Place over boiling water , beat till stiff peaks form
3. Scraping bowl occasionally
4. Remove from heat
5. Add marshmallow cream
6. Beat till spreading consistency

title: layered reuben spread
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. In small bowl mix mayonnaise and dressing until well blended
3. In ungreased 9-inch pie pan , layer sauerkraut , half of cheese , the corned beef and mayonnaise mixture
4. To remaining half of cheese in bag , add onions
5. Toss to mix
6. Sprinkle over top
7. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until bubbly around edge
8. Serve spread with crackers

title: tomato pesto chicken with peach salsa
steps:
1. In bowl cover tomatoes with boiling water and soak for 10 minutes
2. Drain and put in food processor
3. Add basil , garlic , and oil and process until finely mixed
4. Place in large bowl , add chicken and turn to coat
5. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight
6. Peach salsa: combine ingredients and set aside
7. Preheat greased grill to medium and cook for about 6 min
8. Per side or until no longer pink serve with salsa

title: cheesy onion soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan saute onion and pinch cayenne pepper in butter until the onions are just lightly golden
2. Stir in flour and salt until blended
3. Gradually add half and half cream until blended
4. Bring to a boil over medium heat
5. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
6. Season with ground black pepper to taste
7. Stir in colby or monterey jack cheese until melted
8. Ladle into bowls , sprinkle with parmesan cheese and croutons

title: not quite senate bean soup
steps:
1. Heat beans and water to boiling and boil for 2 minutes
2. Remove from heat , cover , and let stand for 1 hour
3. Add ham bone and heat to boiling
4. Cover and simmer about 2 hours
5. Stir in remaining ingredients
6. Cover and simmer 1 hour
7. Remove ham bone from soup and trim meat from bone
8. Cut meat into small chunks
9. Discard the fat and bone , and stir the ham into the soup

title: chicken in peanut curry
steps:
1. In a medium sauce pan heat coconut milk , curry paste , peanut butter , sugar , and fish sauce until they come to a very small boil
2. Set aside and cool adding cornstarch to thicken
3. While the sauce is cooling , stir fry 1 chopped onion and 1 t minced garlic
4. Cut up chicken into small pieces and stir fry with the onion and garlic until chicken is cooked through
5. Combine the garlic , onion and chicken with the sauce and heat
6. Spoon the chicken peanut curry over rice and enjoy

title: spiced coffee frappe
steps:
1. Make the coffee and as soon as it is made put in the spices
2. Cover and then when it comes to room temperature refrigerate it for 2 hours
3. Strain and discard the spices
4. Blend the coffee , cream , sugar and ice cubes till smooth and foamy
5. Pour into 2 long glasses and sprinkle with the drinking chocolate powder and the chocolate flakes
6. Drink immediately as the foam should be there when you have it

title: puff pastry party  treats
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400f and grease two baking sheets
2. Roll out each piece of pastry on a flat surface and cut each one into 2in square pieces - ending up with about 40 squares
3. Place the squares on two large , greased baking sheets about 1in apart to allow for the pastry to puff up
4. Place tsp pesto in the middle of each square and place half a cherry tomato on top
5. Top with a little more pesto and lay across an asparagus
6. Sprinkle a little grated parmesan and a little olive oil over each one
7. Season well and bake in the oven for 5-8 minutes or until the pastry is golden and the cheese has melted

title: potatoes and string   green beans
steps:
1. Put potatoes in a pot with cold water , salt and 1 garlic clove , and bring to a boil
2. Reduce heat and cook until potatoes are very tender
3. Drain , discard garlic
4. Cook beans until very tender , 8 to 10 minutes
5. Drain , dump in a bowl of ice water to cool , drain well
6. Dry on paper towels
7. Cut potatoes into chunks while still warm
8. Cut 2 garlic cloves into the thinnest possible slices
9. Combine the potatoes with garlic , bean , oil , vinegar , eggs and pepper
10. Toss well , check salt and pepper , cover and chill at least 2 hours before serving

title: greek marinade
steps:
1. Mix everything together
2. Marinate for as long as possible !

title: mini pumpernickel grilled cheese and pickle sandwiches
steps:
1. On each of 12 slices of bread , arrange a layer of gouda slices , cover with a layer of pickle slices , and top with a slice of ham
2. Top ham with another slice or two of cheese and cover with a piece of bread
3. Divide butter between two large frying pans and heat over medium heat until butter melts and foam subsides
4. Divide sandwiches between pans and cook , turning once , until cheese is melted and each side is crisp , about 3 minutes per side
5. Cut sandwiches in half diagonally and serve immediately

title: nutty baked caramel corn
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 250 degrees
2. Place popped popcorn into a large 4" deep buttered baking pan and place it in the oven to keep warm
3. In a large saucepan , melt the butter over low heat
4. Stir in brown sugar , corn syrup , and salt
5. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly
6. Boil without stirring for 5 minutes
7. Remove from the heat and quickly stir in the soda & vanilla
8. Remove popcorn from the oven
9. Slowly pour syrup mixture over popcorn and add nut mix , mixing well
10. Butter a 15
11. 5"x10
12. 5"x1" baking pan
13. Turn all into the pan
14. Bake at 250 degrees for 1 hour , stirring every 15 minutes
15. Remove from oven & cool completely
16. Break or cut apart
17. Store in tightly covered container

title: sour beef steak
steps:
1. Cut meat into 6 serving pieces
2. Coat with flour and brown meat in a heavy skillet in the cooking oil
3. Remove meat from skillet and set aside
4. Drain oil from skillet except for just a coating in the skillet
5. Mix the water with the flour slowly until it is mixed with no lumps
6. Add the salt and simmer until the gravy is thick
7. Mix in the vinegar , brown sugar and cloves
8. Add the meat back to the mixture
9. Simmer covered for about 1 hr to 1 1 / 2 hours until the meat is tender

title: grands  taco melts
steps:
1. Combine taco seasoning , water , 1 / 2 cup salsa , and cooked ground beef in a skillet
2. Cook until thickened
3. Press each biscuit into 6-inch round
4. Fill each with taco mixture and 1 tablespoons cheese
5. Fold dough over filling and press to seal
6. Place on greased cookie sheet
7. Bake in preheated 375f oven for 9 to 14 minutes or until golden brown
8. Serve with remaining salsa , cheese , and sour cream

title: mammy s corn fritters
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients
2. Beat together eggs , hot sauce and melted butter
3. Add to dry ingredients and beat together well
4. Stir in corn
5. Drop by spoonfuls into preheated oil and cook for 4 to 5 minutes or until nicely browned
6. Drain on paper towels
7. Serve hot with maple or pancake syrup and crisp bacon

title: spaghetti fest
steps:
1. Cut the kielbasa in 2-inch pieces
2. Finely slice the cabbage , red pepper , and onion
3. Cut the zucchini into 1-inch strips
4. Mince the garlic
5. In a large skillet , brown the kielbasa in the butter
6. Remove from the skillet
7. Add cabbage and stir-fry 10 minutes
8. Add the red pepper , zucchini , onion , and garlic and stir-fry an additional 5 minutes
9. Stir in the kielbasa , chicken bouillion , water , thyme , salt , and pepper
10. Simmer 5 minutes
11. Cook spaghetti according to package directions
12. Drain well
13. Toss hot spaghetti with kielbasa mixture
14. Serve immediately

title: veggie quiche
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Defrost egg substitute
3. Layer in bottom of shell veggie pepperoni , cheese , onions , bell peppers , mushrooms
4. Mix together egg substitute milk , and seasonings
5. Pour into shell
6. Sprinkle with more cheese and seasoning if desired
7. Bake 45-55 minutes

title: austrian rugelach cookies
steps:
1. Beat the butter with the cream cheese with an electric mixer until fluffy
2. Add the flour and using hands make a thick dough
3. Make three balls with the dough , cover them with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 2 hours
4. Mix the brown sugar with the cinnamon , raisins , walnuts and the chocolate chips
5. Remove the dough from the refrigerator let stand in room temperature for a while and make 3-mm thick circles with each piece on a floured surface
6. Divide each circle into quarters and then eighths and sixteenths , until we have 16 equal triangles
7. Coat with marmalade and sprinkle with the sugar mixture
8. Roll each triangle up , starting from the wide side , to make crescents
9. Bake at 360f for 25-30 minutes
10. Dust , if desired with icing sugar , when they are still hot

title: banana nut bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Spray large loaf pan with nonstick cooking spray , set aside
3. Beat sugars and butter inlarge bowl with electric mixer until light and fluffy
4. Add banans , egg and egg whites
5. Sift together flour , baking soda and salt in medium bowl , add to banana mixture
6. Stir in walnuts
7. Pour into prepared loaf pan
8. Bake 1 hour or until wooden pick inserted into center comes out clean
9. Remove from pan
10. Cool on wire rack 10 minutes
11. Serve warm or cool completely

title: pan roasted chicken breasts with lemon and caper sauce
steps:
1. Adjust an oven rack to the lowest position and heat the oven to 450f pat the chicken dry with paper towels and sean with salt and pepper
2. Heat the oil in a 12" oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat until just smoking
3. Carefully lay the chicken breasts skin-side down in the skillet and cook until well browned , 6-8 minutes
4. Turn the chicken breasts and continue to brown lightly on the second side , about 3 minutes
5. Turn the chicken beasts skin-side down and transfer the skillet to the oven
6. Roast until the thickest part of the brests registers 160f on an instant read thermometer - about 15-20 minutes
7. Remove the skillet from the oven
8. Transfer the chicken breasts to a plate , tent loosely with foil , and let rest while making the sauce
9. Sauce: being careful of the hot pan handle , add the oil to the skillet and return to medium heat until shimmering
10. Add the shallot and cook until softened , about 2 minutes
11. Stir in the flour and cook for 30 seconds
12. Stir in the broth , scraping up any browned bits
13. Bring to a simmer and cook 2-3 minutes to reduce slightly
14. Stir in any accumulated juices from the chicken and return to a simmer
15. Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients
16. Add salt and pepper to taste
17. Carve chicken and serve with sauce

title: fiesta corn bake
steps:
1. Stir together dip , flour and sugar
2. Add corn
3. Spoon into 1 quart casserole dish
4. Sprinkle crushed corn chips on top
5. Bake , uncovered , at 357f for 30 minutes , or until heated through

title: fettuccine with sun dried tomato pesto
steps:
1. Combine sun-dried tomatoes and pesto and mix well
2. Cook fettucine in a large pot of salted water until al dente
3. Drain , reserving 1 / 2 cup of the cooking water
4. Combine the tomato pesto with the 1 / 2 cup water and heat
5. Add the fettucine and toss over medium heat , coating the pasta well
6. Salt to taste
7. Serve with the freshly grated parmesan cheese

title: moroccan chicken tagine
steps:
1. Heat oil in large tagine , pan or wok over medium high heat until hot
2. Add almonds and cook until golden brown
3. Remove with slotted spoon and set aside to drain on kitchen paper
4. Add garlic , onion then chicken to same pan in which almonds were cooked
5. Saute for 10 minutes or until browned
6. Mix together harissa paste , water , currants , honey , cumin and cinnamon
7. Add mixture to chicken and stir well
