8. Add chick peas , tomatoes and olives , if using
9. Reduce heat to medium , cover and cook
10. Stir gently and baste occasionally for 20 minutes
11. Add more water if necessary
12. Serve over couscous or rice
13. Top with browned chopped almonds

title: mango cucumber salad
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl
2. Toss gently
3. Let stand 15 minutes before serving

title: cocoa fudge 1965
steps:
1. Mix sugars , salt , cocoa , syrup , and sour cream in a large buttered saucepan
2. Cook without stirring until candy temp
3. Reaches 235 degrees f
4. Or until a soft ball forms in very cold water
5. Add butter
6. Stir just til blended
7. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla
8. Let sit until cool
9. Add chopped nuts
10. Beat until creamy , and just until it starts to loose its glossy appearance dulls slightly
11. Pour into prepared buttered 8 x8 inch pan
12. Cut into squares while still soft and warm

title: madeleines
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Put eggs , sugar , vanilla and orange extract in a medium-size bowl
3. Place over a pan of gently simmering water
4. Beat until very thick
5. Remove from heat
6. Continue to beat until cool and the mixture retains its shape for a few seconds after a spoon is drawn through it
7. Carefully fold in the flour
8. Gently fold in 1 / 2 cup of melted and cooled butter
9. Fill each mold 3 / 4 full with mixture
10. Bake at 400f for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned and springy to the touch
11. Remove from pans , patterned side up and sprinkle with powdered sugar

title: southwestern oven fried chicken
steps:
1. Combine the first 7 ingredients in a small bowl
2. Blend well
3. Rub the chicken pieces with 3 tablespoons of the spice mix and set aside the remaining mix
4. Place the chicken in a 9x 13 dish and let stand 10 minutes
5. Pour the buttermilk over the chicken , turning to coat
6. Cover and marinate 2 hours in the refrigerator , turning occasionally
7. Remove the chicken from the dish and discard the buttermilk
8. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees
9. Combine the remaining spice mixture , breadcrumbs , and cornmeal in a a dish and stir well
10. Dredge each chicken piece in the cornmeal mixture
11. Place on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray
12. Bake 20 minutes 40 minutes or until juices run clear

title: herbed feta and pumpkin muffins
steps:
1. Check oven shelf position and turn onto 180c grease and flour muffin tray
2. Measure and sift flour , sugar , baking powder , cardamon , salt and pepper into a large bowl
3. Melt butter
4. Whisk egg
5. Mash and measure pumpkin
6. Add to beaten egg , along with melted butter
7. Stir with a wooden spoon to combine
8. Add milk to egg mixture
9. Crumble feta cheese into egg mixture
10. Wash , dry and finely chop oregano
11. Add to egg mixture
12. Make a well in dry ingredients - add egg mixture - stir lightly until just combined
13. Add 1 / 2 cup quantities to muffin pans
14. Sprinkle with pumpkin seeds
15. Bake for 20-25 minutes until cooked and golden
16. Test with a skewer
17. Cool for 1-2 minutes in pan before turning out onto a wire rack

title: french fall veggies
steps:
1. Wash and cut the broccoli into small florets
2. Peel the squash and sweet potato and then cut both in rounds about 1 / 2 inch thick
3. In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish , layer the veggies
4. Mix the dressing with the cheese and then pour over the veggies
5. Bake at 350 for 1 1 / 2-2 hours , or until veggies are soft
6. You will need to add a little more dressing to pan in order for veggies to not burn

title: caramelized sweet onion dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Melt 1 1 / 2 teaspoons butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat
3. Add onion and 1 / 8 teaspoon salt to pan
4. Cook 15 minutes or until tender , stirring occasionally
5. Add garlic
6. Cook 10 minutes or until onion is golden brown and very tender , stirring occasionally
7. Remove from heat
8. Cool 5 minutes
9. Combine the remaining 1 / 8 teaspoon salt , mayonnaise , and next 4 ingredients in a medium bowl , stirring until smooth
10. Stir in onion mixture
11. Transfer mixture to a 1-quart baking dish coated with cooking spray
12. Melt remaining 1 1 / 2 teaspoons butter
13. Combine melted butter and panko
14. Sprinkle panko mixture evenly over onion mixture
15. Bake at 350 for 15 minutes or until thoroughly heated and bubbly
16. Sprinkle with parsley
17. Serve hot

title: trogg s nog
steps:
1. Pour liquor over ice
2. Fill with eggnog and stir
3. Serve in a highball glass

title: pickled baby corn
steps:
1. Prepare 6 pint jars with lids
2. Combine the red pepper , green pepper , hot green pepper and garlic
3. Toss and set aside
4. Prepare liquid by combining vinegar , sugar , water and pickling salt in a large stainless steel or enamel saucepan
5. Bring to a boil-boil for 5 min
6. Add the corn and return to a boil for 2 min
7. Divide the pepper mixture evenly between each jar , pack the corn in snugly and add boiling liquid leaving 1 / 2 inch head space
8. Process in a boiling water bath for 10 minutes at altitudes up to 1000 feet

title: black forest crumb cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Crumb topping: stir together flour , cocoa powder and cinnamon
3. Use a pastry blender to mix in brown sugar
4. Cut in cold butter until mixture is made up of medium crumbs about the size of peas
5. Stir in almonds
6. Refrigerate topping while preparing cake
7. Cake: grease bottom of an 8 or 9-inch square disposable pan
8. Place in a larger pan or on a baking sheet
9. Set aside
10. In large bowl of an electric mixer , stir together flour , sugar , cocoa powder , baking powder , cinnamon and salt
11. Briefly beat in eggs and butter
12. Mixture will be crumbly
13. Drain liquid from cherries into a measuring cup
14. Add enough cream to make 3 / 4 cup liquid
15. Beat liquid into cake mixture
16. Add extract
17. Continue to beat at medium speed until batter is smooth and light
18. Stir in cherries and minichips
19. Spread batter evenly in prepared pan
20. Smooth top
21. Sprinkle with crumb mixture
22. Bake about 35 minutes
23. Let cool completely in pan
24. Just before serving , dust with sifted powdered sugar

title: peanut butter pudding  vegan
steps:
1. In food processor or blender , combine all ingredients and process until smooth and creamy
2. Divide mixture among dessert dishes , cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 3 hours before serving

title: chicken crepes with creamy tarragon sauce
steps:
1. In a blender combine all the crepe ingredients and blend on high for one minute , refrigerate for 20 minutes
2. While the batter is chilling , prepare the filling
3. In a medium bowl combine all filling ingredients together
4. Spray a nonstick saut pan with butter flavored spray
5. Heat pan on medium high heat for one minute
6. Pour a scant 1 / 4 crepe batter into the pan using a circular motion
7. You will want the crepe to be approximately 6" in diameter
8. Slant the pan to evenly distribute the batter
9. Cook until the crepe is golden- about 1 minute per side
10. Remove and place in between sheets of waxed paper
11. Continue process until you have 6 crepes
12. Place 1 / 3 cup filling mixture on crepe and roll up tightly
13. Place seam side down in a microwave safe dish
14. Save any additional filling that is left over
15. To prepare the sauce: place flour in a saucepan
16. Gradually add the milk and chicken broth , stirring with a whisk until well blended
17. Stir in tarragon , salt , pepper and worcestershire sauce
18. Add any remaining filling mixture to sauce
19. Cook over medium heat for 8 minutes or until sauce is thickened and coats the back of a spoon
20. Cover crepes loosely with plastic wrap and microwave on high for approximately 3 minutes
21. Pour sauce over crepes and serve

title: orange hoisin chicken
steps:
1. In a zip lock bag , combine the orange juice , honey , soy sauce , hoisin sauce , ginger , garlic , and sesame oil
2. One at a time , put the chicken in the bag , seal , and gently shake to coat with the sauce
3. Transfer the coated chicken to the slow cooker , then pour the remaing sauce over the chicken
4. Cover and cook on low until the chicken is tender and cooked through 5-6 hours
5. Transfer the chicken to a warm platter
6. Strain the sauce through a fine mesh strainer into a small saucepan
7. In a small bowl , stir together the cornstarch and cold water
8. Bring the sauce to a boil over high heat , add the slurry , and cook , stirring a few times until thickened , 1-2 minutes
9. Pour some of the sauce over the chicken & pass the rest on the side
10. If desired , sprinkle the sesame seeds over the top

title: grilled scallops w  prosciutto   honey mustard dipping sauce
steps:
1. Place the lemon juice , lemon zest , olive oil , parsley or oregano / basil , and black pepper in a bowl and mix well
2. Add the scallops and turn to coat thoroughly
3. Wrap each scallop with a thin slice of proscuitto and secure with a toothpick
4. Place on a preheated grill and cook for 3 minutes , basting with the olive oil mixture
5. Turn , baste with more of the olive oil mixture and continue to cook for a further 2-3 minutes & serve immediately
6. Make honey mustard dipping sauce: mix all ingredients well and divide into individual servings in ramekins for each person ~ dip scallops in the sauce ~ wow , is it great !

title: coconut raisin rice pilaf
steps:
1. Make coconut milk: in a medium-sized pot , place dessicated coconut and water
2. Mix and allow to soak for an hour
3. After an hour , turn heat onto low and bring to a gentle simmer
4. Simmer , covered , for 10 minutes
5. Turn off heat and leave pot on element for an hour
6. After an hour , transfer coconut mixture to blender or processor and process for 45 seconds
7. Put a large sieve over a bowl and empty coconut mixture into it
8. Press down hard on coconut solids with the back of a spoon to remove as much coconut milk as possible
9. This method produced 2 cups of coconut milk
10. Can be made up to 2 days before recipe and refrigerated , covered
11. The milk will separate in the fridge , forming a creamy fat layer on top , and a thinner liquid layer underneath
12. Not to worry , the fat layer will melt into the liquid when heated and form a lovely milk
13. Heat oil over medium heat in a medium saucepan
14. Add onion , garlic , ginger and red pepper paste , mashing paste into the rest of the ingredients
15. Cook onion mixture until softened , but not browned , about 2-3 minutes
16. Stir in the rice and cook in the oil , stirring , for 2 minutes
17. Remove saucepan from heat and add coconut milk and stock , along with the coconut and combine well
18. Taste liquid and add salt if you feel the stock didnt provide enough
19. Return to element and bring to a rapid boil
20. Boil uncovered over high heat until the level of the liquid is just above the rice , about 5 minutes
21. Cover immediately , reduce the heat to the lowest setting , and simmer for 10 more minutes
22. Carefully stir in the currants , cover pot , and continue cooking over low heat another 5 minutes without lifting the lid
23. Let the pilaf rest for 10 minutes off the heat
24. Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve with your favourite curry

title: ranch salad dressing mix
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together and store in airtight container
2. If making ranch salad dressing , combine 1 tablespoon of ranch salad dressing mix with 1 cup mayonnaise and 1 cup buttermilk
3. Refrigerate until serving

title: k s veggie bean salad
steps:
1. Dice all veggies
2. Drain garbanzo beans
3. Mix all ingredients together
4. Top with dressing / sauce of your choice
5. I love it with honey dijon
6. Makes 4 lunch sized servings , or 6-8 as a side salad

title: banana split pancakes
steps:
1. Mix together well the flour , sugar , baking powder and salt
2. Set aside
3. Mix together egg , milk , oil and bananas
4. Mix the flour mixture into the egg mixture and blend well
5. Cook the pancakes on medium high setting until both sides are golden brown
6. After the pancakes are cooked , put ice cream on top of pancake , then add chocolate syrup , bananas and whipped cream
7. Add nuts and yum yum ! one is enough though

title: rotini
steps:
1. Brown hamburger
2. Add onion soup mix , oregano , tomatoes and water
3. Bring to a boil , stir in pasta
4. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until all the water has disappeared
5. Stir in parmesean cheese
6. Top with mozarella and cover until melted
7. Enjoy !

title: lao mixed salad with peanuts and fried shallots
steps:
1. Separate the egg yolk from the white
2. Thinly slice the white
3. Put the egg yolk in a blender , add the vinegar and honey and blend until smooth
4. With the blender on , slowly pour in the 2 tablespoons plus 2 teaspoons of oil
5. Season the dressing with salt and pepper
6. In a medium skillet , heat 1 / 4 inch of oil
7. Add the shallot rings and fry over moderate heat , stirring a few times , until golden brown and crisp , about 3 minutes
8. With a slotted spoon , transfer the shallot rings to paper towels to drain
9. Add the garlic to the hot oil and fry , stirring a few times , until golden , about 1 minute
10. Transfer the garlic to the paper towels
11. In a large bowl , drizzle the tomato and cucumber slices with 1 tablespoon of the dressing and toss gently
12. Arrange the slices around a platter
13. Add the mesclun , watercress and sliced egg white to the bowl , top with the remaining dressing and toss well
14. Mound the salad on the platter , garnish with the peanuts and the fried shallot and garlic and serve
15. Make ahead the dressing can be refrigerated overnight
16. The fried shallot and garlic can be kept overnight at room temperature

title: black bean salad santa fe
steps:
1. In a serving bowl , place the beans and corn
2. Add onion , garlic , spices , lemon juice , cilantro and salt
3. Toss to combine
4. Shortly before serving , add the avocado and diced tomato

title: one pot pork chops
steps:
1. Coat the pork chops with the flour and cook in large skillet until brown on both sides
2. Add the potatoes and carrots
3. Combine the water , worcestershire sauce , salt , and oregano in a small bowl
4. Pour over the pork and vegetables , cover and simmer for 25 minutes
5. Stir in the soup , recover , and simmer for an additional 10-15 minutes

title: creamy italian noodles
steps:
1. Cook the noodles and drain well
2. Combine the rest of the ingredients and blend well
3. Enjoy !

title: chicken breasts with portabella mushrooms
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Mix together bread crumbs and parmesan cheese in a shallow dish
3. In a small bowl , beat egg
4. Dip chicken in egg and then breadcrumb mixture
5. Place chicken in baking dish sprayed with nonstick cooking spray
6. Heat olive oil over medium high heat in skillet
7. Add shallot and saute until soft
8. Add mushrooms , parsley , and pepper and cook about 5 minutes , turning once
9. Top chicken with mushroom mixture evenly divided over each piece
10. Place mozzarella slice evenly over each piece
11. Bake at 425f for 20 minutes or until juices run clear from chicken

title: beans and sugar snap peas with lemon   capers
steps:
1. You can boil , steam or microwave the beans and peas separately until they are just tender , then drain them
2. Heat a non stick pan that has been sprayed with olive oil and cook the capers , stirring them until they are lightly browned
3. Add the lemon juice , peas and beans and stir until vegetables are hot
4. Stir in the dill

title: shrimp and poblano chile tamales
steps:
1. Cover corn husks with hot tap water in a shallow baking dish
2. Bring chicken broth , creamed corn and milk just to a boil in a small saucepan over medium heat
3. Gradually add broth mixture to masa harina in a medium bowl , stirring with a wooden spoon , until well blended
4. Cool
5. Heat broiler
6. Line a broiler pan with foil
7. Arrange poblanos and bell pepper on prepared pan and broil 4 inches from heat 10 to 15 minutes , turning until skins are evenly charred
8. Wrap in foil and let stand 15 minutes
9. Peel , seed and dice chile and bell pepper
10. Transfer to a medium bowl
11. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
12. Add onions and cook 2 to 3 minutes
13. Add garlic , reduce heat to medium and cook 1 minute more
14. Cool , then combine with chile , bell pepper and uncooked shrimp
15. Beat lard , baking powder , salt and sugar together in a large mixer bowl , until smooth
16. Gradually beat in masa harina mixture by spoonfuls , beating well after each addition
17. Continue to beat 5 to 8 minutes more , until mixture is light and fluffy
18. Stir in shrimp mixture and cheese
19. Drain and rinse corn husks
20. Keep covered with a damp towel
21. Flatten one husk on work surface
22. Spoon 1 / 4 cup filling in center of husk
23. Spread into a 3-inch long log
24. Roll up lengthwise
25. Secure each end with string
26. Repeat with remaining husks and filling
27. To prepare tamales with foil: cut each foil piece in half to make two 6x9-inch rectangles
28. Spread 1 / 4 cup filling in center of each rectangle
29. Fold all sides in to form 2x3-1 / 2-inch packets
30. Place steamer rack in dutch oven over 1 inch of water
31. Arrange tamales in rack
32. Cover
33. Bring to a boil
34. Reduce heat to low and steam 30 minutes
35. Serve with guacamole , if desired
36. Makes 28 tamales
37. Ymasa harina: a variety of flour made from specially processed corn
38. Used in tamales or to thicken sauces
39. Can be found in the baking section of most supermarkets
40. Yychile poblano: mild to medium-hot fresh chile
41. Popular for stuffing
42. Usually roasted

title: easy black beans
steps:
1. Saute garlic in olive oil over low heat
2. Add black beans and bring the heat up to medium to begin cooking out liquid
3. Stir frequently and mash beans as you stir
4. Cook 10-15 minutes
5. Top with sour cream and chopped onions

title: perfect spicy sausage pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook pasta in the usual way
2. Drain
3. Mix together the pasta , chopped spring onions and sliced beer sticks
4. Add thousand island dressing and mix through

title: v 8 juicy smoothie
steps:
1. Combine ingredients in blender or smoothie maker
2. Blend to desired consistency
3. Adjust sweetness
4. Enjoy !
5. For peach smoothie , substitute peach mango v-8 splash , 1 1 / 4 cup frozen , unsweetened peaches , 1 dash cinnamon , 1 dash ginger , and 1 dash nutmeg
6. For pina colada smoothie , substitute orange pineapple juice , 1 cup frozen , unsweetened pineapple , 1 / 4 cup coconut , and omit the spices
7. You can freeze the juice in ice cube trays
8. Use 2-4 juice cubes
9. If fruit and juice is frozen , you might need to let ingredients thaw slightly so they will blend

title: chinese five spice spareribs
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f rub the ribs all over with the five-spice powder then salt and pepper to taste
2. Set aside
3. Stir together the hoisin and plum sauces in a small bowl
4. Brush evenly over the ribs then cut the ribs into 3-5 rib sections
5. Place the ribs in a large , oiled roasting pan
6. Cover the pan tightly with foil
7. Bake until the meat is tender enough to be pierced easily with a fork , about 1 1 / 2 hours
8. Remove foil and remove ribs to a platter
9. Pour the liquid from the roasting pan into a degreaser or bowl
10. Skim off the fat
11. Pour the liquid into a large dutch oven
12. Heat over medium heat
13. Add the cider , vinegar , tomato paste , honey , ginger , garlic and soy sauce
14. Cook , stirring often , until the liquid reduces to a syrupy consistency , about 15 minutes
15. Cut the ribs into individual pieces
16. Place in the dutch oven
17. Heat over medium heat , turning ribs to coat evenly
18. Transfer ribs to a platter
19. Pass extra sauce on the side

title: marla s magic steak sauce   marinade
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a large glass or stainless steel bowl
2. Whisk until well blended
3. Store in tightly sealed jars in the refrigerator
4. To use , pour a small amount of the marinade in a nonporous baking dish and coat the steaks on both sides
5. Marinade for about 30 minutes before cooking , turning often
6. Grill or broil to desired degree of doneness
7. Or , cook your steaks as usual
8. Pour a small puddle on your plate and dip your steak into the sauce

title: buttery rosemary pecan halves
steps:
1. Combine nuts , butter , rosemary and cayenne in slow cooker
2. Stir to coat
3. Evenly
4. Cover and cook on high 15 minutes
5. Reduce heat to low
6. Cook , uncovered , stirring occasionally 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours
7. Add salt and stir nuts to coat
8. Transfer nuts to baking sheet lined with
9. Parchment paper or foil
10. Let cool completely

title: spicy stir fried chicken with greens and peanuts
steps:
1. Whisk 1 tablespoon soy sauce , 1 tablespoon sherry , 1 teaspoon sesame oil , and 1 teaspoon sugar in medium bowl
2. Add chicken
3. Marinade 20 to 30 minutes
4. Whisk remaining 1 tablespoon soy sauce , 1 tablespoon sherry , 2 teaspoons sesame oil , and 1 teaspoon sugar in small bowl and reserve
5. Heat 2 tablespoons peanut oil in large nonstick skillet over high heat
6. Add white parts of onions and chiles
7. Stir 30 seconds
8. Add chicken
9. Stir-fry just until cooked through , about 3 minutes
10. Transfer chicken mixture to bowl
11. Add 1 tablespoon peanut oil to same skillet
12. Heat over high heat
13. Add greens by large handfuls
14. Stir just until beginning to wilt before adding more
15. Saut just until tender , 1 to 6 minutes , depending on type of greens
16. Return chicken to skillet
17. Add reserved soy sauce mixture
18. Stir until heated through , about 1 minute
19. Season with salt and pepper
20. Transfer to serving bowl
21. Sprinkle with green parts of onions and peanuts

title: chili stuffed sweet potatoes   yams
steps:
1. Bake potatoes at 375 f for about 45 minutes or until tender
2. Warm chili beans while potatoes bake
3. Slice potatoes down the center but not all the way through and gently push in the ends so the potato forms a boat
4. Add about a 1 / 4 cup of chili to each potato
5. They should be full but not overflowing
6. Top with cheese and enjoy

title: spinach linguini with brie
steps:
1. Cut the brie into small pieces
2. Please
3. In a large bowl , combine the cut-up brie cheese , sundried tomatoes , fresh tomatoes , olives , garlic , basil , and pepper
4. In a small bowl , whisk together olive oil and balsamic vinegar
5. Pour immediately over the brie mixture and toss to cover well
6. Cover and let sit at room temperature for 2 hours , tossing occasionally
7. Prepare spinach linguini according to package directions
8. Drain pasta and toss with brie / tomato mixture and melted butter
9. Serve immediately , garnished with grated parmesan cheese and pine nuts
10. Makes 5-6 servings

title: onion   garlicky green beans
steps:
1. In a frying pan , heat olive oil
2. Add garlic and onions sauteeing until golden brown
3. Add green beans and cok until wilted , but make sure they still snap slightly
4. Serve immedietly
5. Enjoy !

title: cheese curry biscuit  australia
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients by sifting into a mixing bowl
2. Cut in the butter with a pastry blender
3. Stir in grated cheese
4. Combine egg yolk and milk by stirring with a fork
5. Add to the dry mixture
6. Continue stirring with fork until a stiff dough forms
7. Turn out on lightly-floured board and roll out until 1 / 8-inch thick
8. Cut into shape desired
9. Place on a lightly greased baking sheet
10. Bake at 375f for 7-8 minutes

title: south african   roasted eggplant salad
steps:
1. To roast the eggplants , preheat a charcoal or gas grill or a broiler
2. Roast the eggplants , turning as needed , until the skin is charred on all sides , the time will vary depending on the cooking method you use
3. The eggplant is cooked when it is soft and looks somewhat deflated
4. Place the eggplant on a plate to cool
5. Trim and seed the red pepper , then cut into 1 / 4-inch dice
6. Cut the cucumber lengthwise in half , scoop out the seeds with a spoon , and cut into -inch dice
7. Peel and finely chop the onion
8. Peel and finely chop the garlic
9. Once the eggplant is cool enough to handle , remove as much of the skin as possible along with any large dark seeds
10. Cut the eggplant into 1-inch squares and place it in a colander in the sink or over a bowl for 5 to 10 minutes to allow excess liquid to drain , set aside until needed
11. Transfer the eggplant to a serving dish and add the red pepper , cucumber , onion and garlic
12. Stir in the olive oil and lemon juice and season with salt and pepper
13. Serve immediately or the salt will draw out too much moister from the vegetables

title: capellini with ham and asparagus
steps:
1. Combine the ham and oil in a large serving bowl
2. Place asparagus pieces in microwave on high for 4 minutes
3. Cook the capellini pasta according to package directions and add the microwaved asparagus
4. Drain capellini and asparagus and toss with ham and oil
5. Pour heated chicken broth over entire mixture and sprinkle with parmesean cheese

title: giada s spinach and pancetta strata yummy
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a heavy large skillet over medium heat
2. Add the pancetta and saut until crisp and golden , about 5 minutes
3. Using a slotted spoon , transfer the pancetta to a bowl
4. Add the onion to the pan drippings in the same skillet and saut until translucent , about 4 minutes
5. Add the spinach and garlic
6. Saut over medium-low heat until the garlic is tender , about 2 minutes
7. Stir in 1 / 2 teaspoon of salt , 1 / 4 teaspoon of pepper , nutmeg , and the cooked pancetta
8. Place half of the bread cubes in a buttered 3-quart baking dish
9. Sprinkle half of the cheese over the bread , then top with half of the spinach mixture
10. Repeat layering
11. Whisk the milk , eggs , remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon of salt and 1 / 4 teaspoon of pepper in a large bowl and pour evenly over the strata
12. Chill the strata , covered with plastic wrap , at least 2 hours and up to 12 hours
13. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
14. Bake strata uncovered until puffed , golden brown , and cooked through , 40 minutes
15. Let stand 5 minutes before serving

title: creole spaghetti bake
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a 2-quart casserole dish
3. Cook spaghetti until firm-tender
4. Drain , and toss with 2-3 tbsp oil
5. In a frypan , saute the bacon , onion and green pepper till the bacon is almost crisp , add in the chopped garlic , cook for 2 minutes
6. Add in the tomato sauce , tomato soup mushrooms and cooked ham or chicken , add in salt and pepper to taste , stir to combine
7. Add in the corn to the cooked spaghetti
8. Toss
9. Then add in the tomato sauce mixture
10. Mix well to combine with the spaghetti
11. Transfer the mixture to a greased casserole dish
12. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese , then sprinkle with grated cheddar cheese
13. Bake for 25-30 minutes , or until bubbly

title: stuffed onions for the grill
steps:
1. Saute minced onion and celery until soft
2. Add vegetables to dry stuffing mix and prepare according to package direction
3. Set aside
4. Coat onion slices with olive oil
5. Place on grill and brown on both sides
6. Cut out foil pieces that will be big enough to wrap around the stuffed onion slices
7. Sprinkle each foil squares with s , p and onion powder
8. Place a grilled onion slice on a tin foil square and top with prepared stuffing
9. Wrap loosely in foil and return packettes to the grill for 10 minutes or until onion slices are tender
10. If you would like to get fancy , parboil whole large onions for 5 minutes , scoop out middle and follow same basic directions for stuffed onion slices

title: garlic glazed onions
steps:
1. Melt the butter , add the garlic and cook gently 1 to 2 minutes
2. Arrange the onions in a baking dish and pour 3 / 4 of the garlic butter over the onions
3. Bake at 350f for 45 minutes or until tender
4. Before serving , reheat the remaining garlic butter , add the dill and pour over the onions

title: the perfect black bean dip
steps:
1. Combine the black beans , tomato paste , lime juice , sour cream , cumin , cayenne pepper and two thirds of your chopped green onions in a sauce pot over medium heat
2. Use a potato masher to lightly mash the contents of the pot together
3. I prefer to leave some beans whole because it makes for a better looking end product
4. Stir your bean dip constantly as it begins to warm through and then add the cheese
5. The dip should be moist , warm , and aromatic
6. Move your dip to a nice serving dish and sprinkle over the remaining green onions and serve with warm tortilla chips

title: kittencal s banana almond muffins with almond streusel
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees f
2. For the topping
3. In a bowl mix together the flour , brown sugar and cinnamon
4. Blend in the soft butter using your finger
5. Line 12 regular muffin tins with paper liners
6. In a medium or large bowl , sift together flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt and cinnamon
7. In another bowl beat the melted butter with sugar , egg and vanilla extract until well blended add in the mashed bananas , mix until just blended
8. Using a wooden spoon mix in the flour mixture until just blended
9. Mix in the chopped almonds
10. Divide the batter evenly between 12 muffin tins , then sprinkle the topping mixture on top of each muffin
11. Bake for about 20 minutes , or until muffins test done

title: buttermilk christmas cookies
steps:
1. Mix together before starting: buttermilk and baking soda
2. Mixture will foam up , so put it in a medium sized bowl or measuring cup
3. Mix sugar and shortening until fluffy
4. Add eggs
5. Then sour cream , nutmeg , and baking powder
6. Alternate buttermilk mixture and flour until well incorporated
7. Refrigerate dough overnight
8. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
9. Roll out dough onto a lightly floured surface
10. Cut shapes into the dough with cookie cutters of your choice
11. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or silicone lining
12. Bake cookies for 9 - 10 minutes or until lightly done

title: grandma  cowboy caviar
steps:
1. Mince garlic
2. Whisk garlic , red wine vinegar , oil , hot sauce and black pepper in a medium bowl until mixed
3. Peel and chop avocado into 1 / 2 inch cubes
4. Add avocado to the vinaigrette and mix gently
5. Chop tomatoes coursely
6. Drain and rinse black-eyed peas and corn
7. Add tomatoes , black eyed peas , corn , green onions and chopped cilabtro to the vinaigrette and mix well
8. Stir in salt
9. Serve immediately or chill mixture covered overnight
10. Serve with tortilla chips or spoon over nachos or taco salad

title: crock pot pizza  easy enough for teens to make
steps:
1. Brown the ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat
2. Drain off grease
3. In slow cooker pour in soup , pizza sauce and pepperonis and mix well
4. Cover and cook on low setting for 4 hours
5. One half hour before dinner stir in the uncooked rigatoni
6. When ready to serve stir in the mozzarella cheese

title: kringle  cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar add egg and villa and beat well
2. Add sour cream and mix well
3. Sift together baking soda , powder and flour
4. Add to creamed mixture and mix well
5. Chill overnite
6. Take a teaspoon of dough and roll out in your hands into a snake about 8-inches long
7. Form into a "figure 8" shape on a parchment-lined cookie sheet
8. Bake at 375 for 10 minutes or until lightly browned
9. Remove and cool completely

title: chicken fried steak   chicken with creamy gravy
steps:
1. Season the chicken breasts with black pepper
2. In a shallow dish combine crushed cracker crumbs with flour 1 teaspoon seasoned salt , 1 / 2 teaspoon black pepper , cayenne pepper and baking powder
3. In another shallow dish whisk together eggs with 3 / 4 milk
4. Dredge the chicken breasts in the cracker mixture then dip in the egg / milk mixture , then dredge again in the cracker mixture
5. Pour the oil into a large skillet and heat to 360 degrees f
6. Fry the breasts in hot oil for about 3-4 minutes on each side or until golden brown
7. Remove to a wire rack and cover lightly with foil
8. Carefully drain oil but reserve the browned bits in the bottom of the skillet along with a couple tablespoons of the oil
9. In a bowl mix together 4 cups half and half cream , 1 / 4 cup flour 1 teaspoon seasoned salt and 1 teaspoon black pepper
10. Whisk until combined , then add to the reserved drippings in the skillet , cook whisking constantly over medium-high heat for about 10 minutes or until thickened
11. Serve the creamed gravy with the breasts

title: penne with chicken in creamy pepper jack cheese sauce
steps:
1. Over medium heat , cook bacon until semi-crisp , reserving drippings
2. Drain bacon on paper towels and crumble when cool
3. Saut sliced chicken in bacon drippings until no longer pink
4. Remove from pan and set aside
5. In the same skillet , add the butter and cook onion , peppers and garlic until just tender
6. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute
7. Add 3 / 4 cup of the broth , and the milk
8. Cook and stir until bubbly
9. Stir in cheese and sour cream
10. Then add the chicken and crumbled bacon to the sauce
11. Reheat , stirring to melt cheese , but do no allow to boil to avoid separation
12. If the sauce is too thick , add the remaining 1 / 4 cup chicken broth and / or a little more milk
13. Serve over cooked penne pasta and sprinkle with chopped green onions before serving

title: egg salad for sandwiches
steps:
1. Boil eggs for 10 minutes
2. Immerse in cool water and peel as soon as possible
3. Dice
4. Mix all together in airtight container
5. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes

title: saucy baked beans
steps:
1. In a large bowl , cover the beans with water to 2 inches above the top of the beans
2. Soak overnight and drain
3. Saut the bacon with the onion until the bacon is crisp and the onion is tender
4. Add the bacon and onion and any pan juices to the beans
5. Combine the bean mixture with 10 cups water plus the maple sugar through the orange peel
6. Place in a 3 quart or larger bean pot or casserole dish , or in two smaller pots
7. Simmer in preheated oven at 250 5-6 hrs or until the beans are tender

title: ricotta spinach quiche
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees
2. Mix spinach , mushrooms and green onions in a bowl
3. Line quiche or tart pan with pastry , pressing and trimming to fit
4. Spoon vegetable mixture into pastry shell , pressing lightly with fingers to flatten evenly into crust
5. Combine ricotta , milk and eggs
6. Stir in nutmeg , rosemary , salt and pepper to taste
7. Pour over spinach mixture
8. Bake quiche until it is lightly browned and set , 30-40 minutes
9. Cool at least 5 minutes before cutting into wedges
10. Serve warm or chilled

title: chocolate macaroon ring cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. For macaroon , whip eggs whites and extract until frothy in a small mixer bowl
3. Gradually add sugar and beat at hgih speed until peaks are slightly rounded
4. Mix in coconut and flour
5. For cake , combine cake mix , oil , water , yolks and egg in large mixing bowl
6. Mix 2 minutes at medium speed
7. Spread half of mix in greased and floured 10 inch tube pan
8. Spoon macarooon in a ring on top of batter
9. Carefully cover with remaining batter
10. Bake at 350 for 55-65 minutes or until toothpick is clean
11. Cool in pan 25 minutes and invert on serving plate
12. Blend remaining ingredients together for glaze until desired consistency
13. Spoon over cooled cake

title: shepherd s pie   a beef and mashed potato casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. In skillet , brown the ground beef and saute with onion
3. Drain beef
4. Stir in tomato sauce , salt , pepper , and celery salt
5. Pour mixture into a 1
6. 5 quart dish
7. Spread mashed potatoes over the beef mixture
8. Sprinkle top with cheese
9. Bake at 375f for 30-35 minutes

title: gingerbread  pancakes
steps:
1. Cream eggs and brown sugar together
2. Add buttermilk , water , and coffee
3. In separate container , sift together dry ingredients
4. Then combine first and second mixture and add melted butter
5. Cook on griddle as you would any other pancake , serve with maple syrup , honey , or molasses

title: puffy oven pancake or  hootin  annies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 450 degrees f
2. In blender or bowl , blend together eggs , milk , flour , and salt
3. Melt butter in 9x13 pan in oven
4. Remove pan from oven
5. Pour in batter
6. Return to oven and bake for 18 minutes
7. Pancake should be very high and puffy
8. Remove from oven and cut into 6 large squares
9. Serve immediately

title: easy crabby baked crab casserole
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients
2. Sprinkle with bread crumbs over top with several pats of butter
3. Bake at 325 degrees for 30 minutes

title: veal with tomato tapenade
steps:
1. To make tapenade , place sundried tomatoes with oil , anchovy fillets , garlic , capers , lemon juice and parsley in a food processor or blender and process to make a smooth paste
2. Heat oil in a frying pan over medium heat and add 3 tablespoons of tapenade and cook stirring for 30 seconds
3. Add veal and cook for 1-2 minutes each side or cooked until your liking
4. To serve put steaks on plate and top veal with remaining tapenade
5. Good served with steam asparagus spears , broccoli and perhaps a baby chat

title: creamy rice   carrots
steps:
1. Simmer carrots in water with salt , onion and sugar for 10 minutes
2. Bring water to a boil , add rice , stir , when returns to boil , turn stove down to simmer & cover the saucepan
3. Cook for 20 minutes without lifting the lid !
4. Add cream , butter and sugar to taste and consistency desired
5. Some people like it a little soupier than others or a little sweeter
6. Just season to taste
7. Enjoy ! bon appetit !

title: shrimp orzo salad  low fat
steps:
1. Cook the pasta until firm-tender
2. Drain and rinse under cold water , place in a large bowl
3. Add in the shrimp , bell peppers , artichokes , red onion , dill and olives
4. In a small bowl whisk vinegar , garlic , salt , pepper , basil and oregano
5. Slowly whisk in olive oil
6. Pour over the pasta mixture
7. Toss to coat
8. Season with more salt and pepper if desired
9. Refrigerate for a minimum of 2 hours before serving

title: brie cheese  grape and pepperoni puff appy
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Defrost puff pastry
3. Roll out on a floured surface to a 1 / 8-in thick rectangle & cut into 2-in squares
4. Whisk eggs w / water , paprika + pepper & use a pastry brush to brush the surface of the squares
5. Place 1 slice of pepperoni , a sml cube of cheese & 1 / 2 grape in the center of ea pastry square
6. Bring the corners inward to form envelopes & secure each w / 1 of the soaked wooden toothpicks
7. Brush the surface of the envelopes w / the rest of the egg mixture , place on a greased baking tray & bake for 15 min or till lightly browned
8. Allow to cool slightly , remove toothpicks & serve warm or allow to cool to room temp & serve
9. The toothpicks work great here to allow for consistently shaped puffs & easy handling ! :-)
10. I have corrected for that by adding back the pepperoni slices now in the ingredients & prep

title: south american raisin cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. In a medium saucepan , over medium-high heat , combine the apple juice , sugar , raisins , walnuts , and cornstarch
3. Bring the mixture to a boil , then reduce the heat to low and cook for 5 minutes or until the mixture thickens
4. Meanwhile , cut each cinnamon roll into 6 pieces
5. Place half of the pieces on the bottom of a 13x9-inch glass baking pan that has been coated with nonstick baking spray
6. Cover with the raisin-nut mixture , then top with the remaining dough pieces
7. Bake for 30-40 minutes , or until the dough is firm and golden
8. Cool , then cut into serving-size pieces

title: spanish tortilla
steps:
1. Use a large non stick pan for the first part of preparation and a 9 non stick pan for the final preparation
2. In large pan , layer potato , onion slices , olive oil and coarse salt to taste
3. Cook over medium heat , lifting and turning the potatoes / onion occasionally , until they are tender but not brown
4. Dont be afraid if they brown a little , you want them to be cooked
5. The potatoes will remain separated , not in a cake"
6. Meanwhile , in a large bowl beat the eggs with a fork until they are slightly foamy
7. Let stand until potatoes are done
8. Remove the potatoes from the skillet and drain them in a colander , reserving about 3 tablespoons of the oil
9. Add the drained potato / onions to the beaten eggs while the potatoes are still hot
10. Press the potatoes down into the eggs so they are completely covered
11. Let mixture stand for 15 minutes
12. Heat two tablespoons of the reserved oil in the 9 pan
13. Add the potato / egg mixture to the pan rapidly spreading evenly with a pancake turner
14. Move the pan around and shake once in a while to evenly brown the mixture and keep it from sticking
15. You can use the edge of the pancake turner as the mixture sets to form the sides to a more vertical orientation away from the sides of the pan
16. Once the mixture is brown place a large plate upside down over the pan
17. Turn the pan upside down , add a little more of the reserved oil , then slide the uncooked side of the potato / eggs back into the pan
18. Continue cooking until browned
19. Flipping the tortilla two or three more times will help give it shape
20. Once cooked , allow to cool several hours and enjoy !
21. Cut into one inch pieces and serve as appetizer with toothpicks

title: cream of sweet potato soup  crema di papata dolci e gabretti
steps:
1. Combine oil and butter in a large saucepan over medium heat
2. Add garlic and leeks
3. Cook , stirring frequently , until they release their flavors , about 5 minutes
4. Add sweet potatoes , carrots , broth , cumin and cinnamon
5. Heat to a boil , reduce heat to a simmer
6. Cook until vegetables are tender , about 5 minutes
7. Puree until smooth in a blender or food processor
8. Return soup to saucepan
9. Stir in cream , salt and pepper to taste
10. Garnish with chives and croutons

title: teriyaki shrimp and scallop kebabs
steps:
1. Glaze:
2. Combine first 6 ingredients in a small saucepan over medium-high heat
3. Bring to a boil , and cook for 2 minutes
4. Cornstarch mixture:
5. Combine cornstarch and water
6. Stir cornstarch mixture into soy sauce mixture
7. Bring to a boil
8. Cook 1 minute
9. Kebabs:
10. Thread 2 shrimp , 2 scallops , 4 mushroom halves , and 3 green onion pieces alternately onto each of 8 skewers
11. Brush kebabs with oil , and place on a grill rack coated with cooking spray
12. Cook for 3 minutes
13. Turn kebabs , and brush with half of soy sauce glaze
14. Cook for 1 minute
15. Turn kebabs
16. Brush with remaining glaze
17. Cook 1 minute or until seafood is done

title: quick black eyed peas   ham
steps:
1. Saute chopped onion in hot oil over medium high heat 3 minutes
2. Add peas & next 4 ingred
3. Bring to boil
4. Reduce heat and simmer 15minutes
5. Stir occasionally
6. Serve over rice w / desired toppings

title: cornflake chocky rocks  chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar until light and creamy
2. Add eggs , mix well
3. Add vanilla , sifted flour , choc chips and 2 cups cornflakes
4. With the remaining cornflakes cover them with plastic and smash them up slightly with the back of a rolling pin or other hard object
5. Roll dessert spoonfuls of mixture into balls and roll in extra cornflakes
6. Place on greased baking tray
7. Bake in a moderate oven for 10 minutes

title: low cal turkey tater tot casserole
steps:
1. Cook turkey , onion , celery , salt , pepper , and garlic powder in pan coated with cooking spray
2. Spray 2 quart casserole dish with cooking spray
3. Spread 1 / 2 bag tater tots in casserole dish
4. Top with meat mixture
5. Layer last 1 / 2 of tater tots over meat
6. Combine soup and milk and pour evenly over casserole
7. Bake uncovered for 1 hour at 350

title: apricot mustard crusted catfish
steps:
1. Combine the jam , mustard and cheese in a small bowl
2. Wash and pat dry the catfish fillets
3. Spread the mustard mixture on both sides of the fillets
4. Cover each fillet with fine bread crumbs
5. Place in a lightly buttered baking dish
6. Recipe may be prepared to this point and held refrigerated until needed
7. When ready to served , place the baking dish in a preheated 350 degree oven for about 20 minutes
8. Serve immediately

title: the best easy beef and broccoli stir fry
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine 2 tablespoons cornstarch , 2 tablespoons water and garlic powder until smooth
2. Add beef and toss
3. In a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat , stir-fry beef in 1 tablespoon oil until beef reaches desired doneness
4. Remove and keep warm
5. Stir-fry onion in remaining oil for 4-5 minutes until softened
6. Add the broccoli and cook for 3 minutes until the broccoli is tender but still crisp
7. Return beef to pan
8. Combine soy sauce , brown sugar , ginger and remaining 1 tablespoon cornstarch and 1 / 2 cup water until smooth
9. Add to the pan
10. Cook and stir for 2 minutes
11. Serve over rice and garnish with toasted sesame seeds

title: alaskan salmon marinade
steps:
1. Rinse fillets and pat dry
2. Place gallon-size ziploc bag in an empty pitcher , folding top edges over mouth of pitcher
3. Combine all ingredients inside ziploc bag
4. Add fillets , squeeze air out of the bag
5. Gently mush the ingredients together and onto the fish
6. Let marinade and fish set for 30 minutes
7. Remove fish from marinade
8. Discard leftover marinade
9. Grill or broil as desired

title: peach almond pound cake
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , cream the butter
2. Gradually add in the sugar , beating at medium speed with an electric mixer
3. Add in eggs one at a time
4. Beat well after each
5. In a second bowl , mix together the flour , soda , and salt
6. In a third bowl , stir together the sour cream and peaches
7. Add the dry ingredients to the creamed mixture alternately with the peach mixture
8. Mix until just blended after each addition
9. Add in flavorings , stir gently to combine
10. Pour batter into two greased and floured 9x5 inch loaf pans
11. Bake at 350 for 1 hour and 5 minutes or until pick comes out clean
12. Cool in the pans for 10-15 minutes
13. Turn cakes out onto cooling rack to cool completely

title: chocolate pb squares
steps:
1. Line 13x9x2-inch baking pan with nonstick foil
2. Combine peanut butter chips and butter in a large glass bowl
3. Microwave on 50 percent power for 30 seconds
4. Stir
5. Return to microwave , heat on high for 1 minute and 30 seconds , stirring every 30 seconds
6. Whisk in condensed milk
7. Gradually stir in crumbs and the 1 / 2 cup of chopped peanuts
8. Pat the mixture evenly into the prepared pan
9. Refrigerate until firm , about 30 minutes
10. Microwave chocolate chips in a medium-size microwave-safe bowl on high for 1 minute
11. Stir until smooth
12. Microwave in additional 15-second increments , if necessary
13. Spread over top of peanut mixture
14. Sprinkle with remaining 1 cup nuts
15. Let stand at room temperature until firm , about 1 hour
16. Cut into 48 squares

title: vegan cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat to 350f lightly grease a 9" tart pan
2. Mix the ingredients together and press into the bottom of the dish
3. If you're using a proper metal tart pan , press the dough up the fluted sides
4. Prick the bottom a few times with a
5. Fork
6. Bake for approx 20 min , until brown
7. Let cool before adding filling
8. Dissolve arrowroot in 1 / 2 cup of water and set aside
9. Filling: mix coconut milk , 1 cup of the water , sugar , agar& turmeric into a saucepan
10. Simmer until agar dissolves
11. Stir in the lemon juice , zest& vanilla then bring to a boil
12. Add the arrowroot / water mixture and boil for one minute
13. [it'simportant to stir throughout as you don't want the agar to clump up along the bottom of the pan
14. You'll feel it thicken up when you add the arrowroot
15. Mix
16. ]
17. Pour into the cooled crust and let firm up before serving

title: pumpkin ribbon bread
steps:
1. Beat together cream cheese , sugar , and flour in medium bowl
2. Add egg and mix well
3. Add orange peel and stir
4. Set aside
5. Combine pumpkin , oil , and eggs in large mixing bowl
6. Stir in sugar , salt , cloves , and cinammon and mix well
7. Stir in flour and baking soda
8. Blend in pecans
9. Pour half of the batter inat a greased and floured 9x5 loaf pan
10. Carefully spread cream cheese mixture over batter
11. Add remaining batter and spread to cover cream cheese mixture
12. Bake for 90 minutes or until golden brown and a toothpick tests clean
13. Cool in pan on wire rack 10 minutes , then remove from pan and let cool on rack

title: marinated cheddar cheese block
steps:
1. Slice cream cheese and white cheddar cheese into thin slices
2. Alternately layer the two cheeses
3. Mix the remaining ingredients together and pour dressing mixture on top of cheese
4. Chill overnight
5. Serve with a knife to slice through the cheese block and assorted crackers

title: darlene s scrambled eggs
steps:
1. Beat eggs in mixing bowl with beater
2. Add milk , worcestershire , tabasco , salt and pepper
3. Beat
4. Drain mushrooms and pat dry with paper towels
5. Melt butter slowly in skillet
6. Add mushrooms to butter and saut over low heat , stirring and moving them constantly
7. Add egg mixture and stir till eggs are done and fluffy

title: easy taco pizza appetizer
steps:
1. To make the crust , spread crescent rolls in a 10x15 pan , sealing all seams
2. Bake until golden
3. Let cool
4. Mix cream cheese , sour cream , and taco seasoning with a mixer until creamy
5. Top with tomato , olives , green onions and cheddar
6. Refrigerate to blend flavors
7. Cut into appetizer size pieces

title: korendekager  currant biscuits
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar
2. Add all remaining ingredients and stir until smooth
3. With a teaspoon , place dots of dough on a well-greased baking sheet
4. Do not place cookies too close , as they spread while baking
5. Bake in a fairly hot oven for 10 minutes until golden brown
6. Leave to cool on baking sheet for a few minutes before removing

title: green tea creme brulee
steps:
1. Heat cream over med high heat
2. Add extract or split the bean and scrape into the cream
3. When cream is scalded add tea bags and steep for five minutes
4. Strain hot cream and squeeze out the tea bags
5. Whisk eggs and sugar until they are smooth and pale yellow
6. Temper cream into eggs slowly
7. Pour mixture into ramekins and place ramekins in a roasting pan with water half way up the sides of the ramekins
8. Bake at 325 degrees for 25 minutes or until custard is just set
9. It should jiggle a bit like firm jello
10. Cool
11. Pour a teaspoon of raw sugar on each and shake to coat evenly and then broil until golden or blow torch the tops to carmelize the sugar

title: pink cole slaw
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine goji berries & sultanas in apple cider vinegar to soften
2. In a large mixing bowl , whisk together remaining ingredients
3. Add the raisins , berries , and vinegar
4. Mix well
5. Add cole slaw mix to finished dressing
6. Stir well to blend
7. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours

title: homemade potato chips
steps:
1. Peel , then slice the potatoes very thinly
2. A mandolin does the best job of this and the slices should be as thin as a wafer
3. As you slice , drop them into deep , cold water
4. Bring a deep pan of frying oil to 190 c or 375 degrees f
5. Dry the potatoes thoroughly , then fry them for a couple minutes until they're crisp and golden
6. Drain them on paper towels and then season generously with salt

title: warm apple pie
steps:
1. Sprinkle the top with goldschlager and light it on fire
2. Blow it out , and slug it down

title: southwest corn and squash stew
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large saucepan , add onion and red pepper , cook over medium heat for 5 minutes or until onions become transparent
2. Add garlic , chili pepper , chili powder and cumin , cook stirring constantly for 1 minute
3. Add tomatoes , butternut and vegetable broth , bring to a boil , reduce heat , cover and simmer on low for 10 minutes
4. Stir in zucchini , corn , evaporated milk and salt to taste , simmer uncovered for 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender
5. Top with cheese and cilantro just before serving

title: caakiri  couscous pudding
steps:
1. Prepare 2 cups of couscous according to package directions and allow to cool
2. Combine evaporated milk , yogurt , sour cream , sugar , and vanilla
3. Stir yogurt mixture into couscous
4. Add more sugar , to taste
5. Garnish as desired
6. Serve warm or chilled

title: desert island green salad
steps:
1. Wash , dry and break apart lettuce in a large bowl
2. Sprinkle with pineapple , peanuts and red onion
3. Set aside and make the dressing by mixing all of the dressing ingredients together in a bowl or shaker
4. Serve dressing with salad

title: meatball hoagie braids
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Spray 2 cookie sheets with nonstick spray
3. Seperate crescent roll dough into 8 rectangles
4. Place on sprayed cookie sheets
5. Firmly press perforations to seal
6. Put 4 meatball halves lengthwise down center of each rectangle
7. Top each with 2 tbsp of sauce and 2 tbsp of mozzarella cheese , more if you like more cheese
8. With kitchen shears or a sharp knife , make cuts 1 inch apart on each side of filling
9. Alternately cross strips over filling
10. Brush dough with beaten egg
11. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese
12. Bake at 375 degrees for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown

title: kale and white beans
steps:
1. If you can get fresh kale from a garden , wash it , shake off excess water , and store it in a partially airtight container in the frig for 3-4 days
2. As it "ages , " it sweetens
3. Heat the olive oil slowly in a large frying pan
4. While the oil is heating , chop the kale in large strips
5. Set aside
6. Saute onion and garlic over medium-low heat until they begin to turn color
7. Do not burn
8. Throughout the rest of this prepartion do not overheat the oil
9. Medium should be the right temperature
10. Stir in the brown sugar , oregano , and thyme
11. Stir gently for another minute or two until the sugar has disappeared
12. If you need to add a bit more olive oil , do so at this point
13. You need a thin layer of hot oil covering the bottom of the pan
14. Stir the chopped kale into the hot oil mix
15. Kale may look to be too much to fit in the pan , but be patient
16. As you stir it in , it begins to wilt down to a manageable size
17. Stir the kale gently for a few minutes , just long enough to cook it down a bit
18. Do not let it become soft
19. Stir in the drained , rinsed beans , the balsamic vinegar , and the salt
20. Lay the tomato slices on top
21. Lay the thinly sliced asiago cheese on top of the tomatoes
22. Turn off heat or turn down very low , cover and let steam for 5 minutes
23. Serve hot

title: reuben bake casserole
steps:
1. Unroll one tube of crescent dough into one long rectangle: seal seams and perforations
2. Press onto the bottom of a greased 13x9 baking dish
3. Bake at 375 degrees for 8-10 minutes or until golden brown
4. Layer with half of the cheese and all of the corned beef
5. Combine sauerkraut and dressing
6. Spread over beef , top with remaining cheese
7. On a lightly floured surface roll out and press together seam of second tube of crescent dough in a 9x13 rectangle then place over cheese
8. Brush dough with egg white and sprinkle with caraway seeds
9. Bake for 12-16 minutes or until heated through and crust is golden brown
10. Let stand for 5 minutes before cutting

title: simple rice and beans
steps:
1. Cook rice according to package directions
2. Saute garlic , cumin and cayenne in oil in a skillet over medium heat 1 minute
3. Stir in beans and broth
4. Bring to a simmer and cook 5-8 minutes to heat through
5. Top rice with beans and garnish with sliced green onions

title: tortas  mexican sub sandwich
steps:
1. First , split bollios in half , lengthwise
2. Spread mayo on the top halves
3. Spread beans on the bottom halves of bollios
4. Top the beans with pico de gallo , avocado slices , tomato slices and lettuce
5. If you want to add cheese you can , personal preference
6. Evenly layer fajitas on top of vegetables
7. Cover with top half of bollio , press down and secure with toothpicks
8. If you don't want to use fajitas , you can use ham or turkey and whatever kind of cheese you want

title: bonelos manglo  air doughnuts    dairy free
steps:
1. Mix ingredients until it comes together to form dough
2. Roll on a board with a rolling pin until 1 / 3 inch thick then cut into long strips about a half inch apart , then cutting it into diamonds
3. Preheat oil in deep frying pan then place diamond shape dough into it , turning occasionally until dough is golden brown
4. Remove , let cool on brown paper bags or paper towels
5. When cool dust with powdered sugar or regular granulated sugar

title: pickled cucumber
steps:
1. Cut unpeeled cucumbers lenghtways in half and scoop out the seeds
2. Slice the cucumbers thinly
3. In a bowl , mix the rice vinegar , sugar , salt and water , stirring to dissolve the sugar
4. Add all ingredients and mix
5. Cover with clingwrap and set aside on the counter for around 40 minutes , turning occassionally
6. Refrigerate and use as required

title: karelian pasties   karjalan piirakat
steps:
1. Rice filling
2. Start making filling by bringing water to the boil
3. Add rice and simmer until water is absorbed in rice
4. Add milk , bring mixture to the boil and let it cook for a couple of minutes , stirring continually with a wooden spoon
5. Reduce heat to the minimum or turn it off completely cover pan with lid and let mixture simmer for about 30 - 40 minutes , stirring every now and then
6. Filling is ready , when it has thickened into a velvety , white porridge
7. Add a lump of butter , mix , cover pan with lid and set aside to cool
8. After cool , mix egg or yolk in rice porridge and season with salt
9. Potato filling: cook potatoes in water until tender
10. Reserve liquid
11. Puree potatoes through food mill and let cool a bit
12. Add eggs and enough cooking liquid and cream to get smooth mixture
13. Amount of liquid depends on the quality of potatoes filling mustn't be too runny
14. Add a lump of butter and mix
15. Season with salt , cover and set aside to cool
16. Prepare pasty dough: mix flour and salt , add oil and water little at a time and mix to get a non-sticky dough
17. Divide dough in 15 - 20 equal pieces and roll them into small balls
18. With a tapered rolling pin , roll out balls one at a time into very thin disks , about 1 mm thick and 10 - 15 cm in diameter
19. Cover pie disks lightly with plastic wrap to prevent them from drying out
20. Spread filling on centre of pie disks
21. Raise edges of pie disks towards the centre , pinching with your fingers to make an oval ridge - center will be open
22. Place pasties on baking sheet covered with parchment paper and bake at 255 - 300c for about 5 - 7 minutes or until pasties start to turn darkish brown
23. Meanwhile , heat about 150 ml whole milk in saucepan , add big lump of butter and let it melt
24. Dip hot pasties one at a time into hot milk-butter mixture and place them in large bowl
25. Cover bowl tightly with parchment paper and towel , and let pasties soften for about half an hour
26. Warm pasties are traditionally served with egg and butter spread
27. Pasties may also be eaten topped with plain butter , cheese , ham or reindeer roast slices , gravlax , shrimps or whatever you happen to like ! pasties can be reheated in oven or toaster
28. Egg & butter spread: cook eggs in boiling water for 10 minutes
29. Rinse eggs with cold water and shell them
30. Using a fork , finely mash warm eggs together with the butter
31. Season with salt , if necessary
32. You can use an egg slicer to slice the eggs before mashing
33. Slice them first crosswise and then lengthwise

title: regular white icing  add butter to make buttercream icing
steps:
1. Mix powdered sugar and vanilla
2. Add milk teaspoon by teaspoon until desired consistency
3. Dash salt
4. Trust me
5. Do this as instructed , or you will have to keep adding sugar until you get a good consistency , and then you will end up with enough icing to cover surplus amout of cakes !

title: beef with potato tagine
steps:
1. Mix the ingredients together for the spice mix , reserve a third of it for later use
2. Rub the remaining mix over the beef cubes
3. Heat the oil over medium-low heat in a tagine
4. Brown the beef & onion for 7 minutes
5. Stir in the water , bouillon , tomato paste , 1 / 2 tsp spice mix , parsley & cilantro
6. Cover with the lid & cook for 30 minutes
7. Uncover the tagine , stir in the tomato & another cup of water if needed
8. Sprinkle the potato wedges with reserve spice mix
9. Place the potatoes on top of the meat then recover & cook for another hour

title: mexican chocolate phyllo triangles
steps:
1. Line an 11x17-inch baking tray with parchment paper
2. Break up 4 ounces of chocolate into 1 / 2-ounce pieces
3. Set aside
4. In a food processor , finely grind the remaining chocolate with the sugar
5. Lay 8 sheets of phyllo out on top of each other
6. Place one sheet lengthwise on the work surface
7. Keep the remaining sheets covered with a damp towel
8. Brush the sheet with some melted butter
9. Sprinkle with 1 1 / 2 tablespoons of the sugar mixture
10. Place a second sheet over the sugared sheet
11. Butter the second sheet and sprinkle with the sugar mixture
12. Add 2 more sheets , buttering and sprinkling between each
13. Cut the phyllo horizontally into 4 even strips
14. Starting at the left side of one of the strips , place a 1 / 2-ounce piece of chocolate 2 inches from the end
15. Fold the phyllo that is to the left of the piece of chocolate over the chocolate toward the back side of the strip , making a 3-inch triangle
16. The left end of the phyllo should be even with the back edge
17. Fold the piece of chocolate to the right , over itself , retaining the triangular shape
18. Fold the chocolate piece toward the front edge of the strip
19. Continue wrapping the chocolate , alternating the direction with each fold , until you get to the end
20. Wrap the other strips in the same manner
21. With the remaining sheets , make 4 more chocolate-filled triangles
22. Preheat the oven to 350f
23. Place the triangles on the baking sheet
24. Bake until golden brown , about 10 minutes
25. Serve warm

title: fruit and peanut butter wraps
steps:
1. Peel and slice the banana very thinly
2. Place in a bowl and toss with the lemon juice
3. Quarter and core the apple
4. Slice into wafer thin slices and add to the bowl with the banana
5. Mix well
6. Warm the tortillas in the microwave for about 10 seconds
7. Spread 3tbsp of peanut butter over each tortilla
8. Place half the banana slices and half the apple slices over the top of each tortilla
9. Roll each one up into a tight log
10. Enjoy immediately or wrap tightly in plastic wrap and refrigerate until later

title: tofu carrot cacciatore
steps:
1. In large pot , heat olive oil over medium heat
2. Add onions and pepper
3. Cook 5-7 minutes , or unti softened , stirring often
4. Add garlic
5. Cook 1 minute , or until fragrant
6. Stir in tomatoes , carrots , tofu , sage , and bay leaf
7. Season with salt and pepper , if desired
8. Cover
9. Reduce heat and simmer until carrots are tender
10. Cook pasta according to package directions
11. Remove the bay leaf and serve the cacciatore over the cooked pasta

title: banana raisin nut coffee loaf
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease two 8 x 4-inch loaf pans
3. In a bowl beat melted butter with brown sugar for 2 minutes
4. Add in eggs , vanilla , almond extract and the rind from 1 orange
5. Mash 2 cups bananas in 1 cup brewed coffee
6. Add to the creamed mixture
7. Mix to combine
8. In a small bowl mix together flour with , baking soda , baking powder , nutmeg and cinnamon
9. Add to the creamed mixture and stir with wooden spoon until just combined
10. Add in raisins and nuts
11. Mix lightly until combined
12. Divide the mixture between the two pans
13. Bake for about 40-50 minutes or until loaves test done

title: slushy lemonade
steps:
1. In blender , combine lemon juice concentrate , water , and sugar
2. Gradually add the 4 cups of ice cubes , blending until smooth
3. Serve immediately

title: apple and spice pizza cookies
steps:
1. Beat margarine and sugars until creamy
2. Add in egg and vanilla and beat
3. Add in dry ingredients and beat until smooth
4. Stir in apples and oats
5. Spread evenly on generously greased pizza pan
6. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden
7. Remove from oven
8. While the crust is hot sprinkle with the butterscotch chips
9. Let stand until soft then spread
10. Sprinkle 1 cup chopped pecans on top of the butterscotch
11. Sift powdered sugar , add milk
12. Mix until smooth
13. Drizzle on top of pizza cookie

title: crockpot ham and bean soup
steps:
1. Soak the beans overnight
2. The next morning , after i rinse the beans , i just throw everything in the crockpot , put in enough water to come within an inch of the top of the crock and put it on low for 8 hours or as long as 12 hours
3. This usually works great in my 3
4. 5 qt crockpot
5. Rethinking this , i realized that everyone doesn't have the same size crockpot that i did , i would suggest adding water to no higher than an inch above the beans
6. Remove the bay leaf and serve

title: warm peanut caramel dip
steps:
1. Combine peanut butter , caramel topping and milk in small saucepan
2. Heat over low heat , stirring constantly , until mixture is melted and warm
3. Serve
4. Microwave directions:
5. Combine all ingredients in small microwavable dish
6. Microwave at medium 1 minute
7. Stir well
8. Microwave an additional minute on medium or until mixture is melted and warm

title: super seasoned salt
steps:
1. Mix all of the ingredients with a wire whisk and pore into your favorite shaker jar
2. We use this on almost everything except when i am using my garlic pepper mix
3. This recipe can easily be doubled or even tripled
4. I usually make enough to fill my shaker and i have a refill container in the cupboard so i never run out

title: greek pita salad
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Place rack in middle of oven
3. In a sieve , sprinkle cucumber with a pinch of salt , let drain for 20 minutes , and pat dry
4. Put pita pieces in a large baking pan , drizzle with 2 tblsps olive oil , toss to coat , season with salt and bake , shaking pan occasionally , for 20-22 minutes , or until golden-brown and crisp
5. Check on them after the first 15 minutes to make sure they're browning evenly and re-distribute
6. Let cool slightly
7. In a large bowl , whisk together oil , lemon juice and garlic
8. Season to taste
9. Whisk until emulsified
10. Stir in bell pepper , tomato , onion , feta , parsley , mint , pita pieces and cucumber , and season to taste
11. Toss salad to combine well
12. Distribute between two large plates , sprinkle with sumac , if using and serve immediately

title: dilly dip
steps:
1. Mix and refrigerate for a few hours to blend flavors
2. Serve with fresh uncooked vegetables

title: vegetarian no cook alfredo lasagna
steps:
1. Cook and drain the frozen italian vegetables slightly shorter than package directions
2. Brown the onion and garlic in a skillet be careful not to burn the garlic
3. Add chunky tomato sauce and tomato paste , ground pepper , and oregano
4. In a large bowl mix ricotta and / or tofu , cottage cheese , eggs , parsley , mozzarella and provolone cheeses
5. Spray the bottom and sides of a 9 x 13 inch baking pan with non stick cooking spray
6. Spread 1 / 4 of the tomato sauce mixture in the bottom of the baking pan
7. Top with a layer of uncooked noodles , leaving about 1 / 4 inch space between noodles
8. Layer 1 / 4 tomato sauce , 1 / 3 vegetables , 1 / 3 alfredo sauce and then 1 / 3 tofu / ricotta mixture , in that order
9. Repeat until you have made three layers of each
10. Cover with foil and bake at 350 degrees f for about 50 minutes
11. Remove foil , layer with 1 / 3 cup parmesan cheese and continue baking about 15 to 20 minutes , until nicely brown on top
12. Serve with additional parmesan cheese to taste

title: a  potato cheese soup
steps:
1. Peel and dice potatoes
2. Boil in water
3. Add chopped onion and bouillon
4. When potatoes are soft , drain a small amount of water to desired thickness
5. Slightly mash potatoes - they can still be a little chunky
6. Add cream-of-chicken soup
7. Add salt and pepper , to taste
8. Over low heat , stir in chucks of velveeta cheese until smooth
9. Soup should be thick
10. Enjoy !

title: venison  or beef   mushroom stroganoff
steps:
1. Mix flour , salt , lemon pepper , and celery seed in bowl
2. Add cubed meat and knead meat into flour mixture
3. Heat corn oil and one tbsp butter in a skillet over medium heat
4. Shake excess flour from meat and set pieces into heated oil
5. Brown meat on each side
6. When meat is almost brown on remaining side , pour chopped onions over meat
7. Cover five minutes , then mix with a wooden spoon
8. Add one cup beef bouillon and soy sauce to meat
9. Simmer 15 minutes on low heat , stirring occasionally
10. Then add a second cup of the beef bouillon , cooking wine and rosemary leaves to the meat mixture
11. Allow the meat to simmer on low heat foran additional 30 to 35 minutes
12. Stir occasionally
13. Don't be in a hurry , as cooking time affects the tenderness of the meat
14. When done , the meat should be covered with a thick , brown gravy
15. Using a separate skillet , combine the remaining cup of beef bouillon and 1 tbsp butter
16. Heat to simmer
17. Add fresh , sliced mushrooms and simmer five minutes
18. Meanwhile , prepare egg noodles in a separate pan , following instructions on label
19. Add mushroom soup to steamed mushrooms
20. Simmer 5 minutes , then add sour cream
21. Simmer another 5 minutes
22. Finally , fold the meat mixture into the mushroom mixture
23. Simmer an additional 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
24. Serve immediately with egg noodles and your favorite vegetable and bread
25. Enjoy !

title: turkey tea sandwiches
steps:
1. Mix the cream cheese and scallions together ahead of time so the flavors can blend
2. Lay out 8 slices of bread and spread them all with a thin layer of scallion cream cheese
3. Place a single layer of turkey on half the slices , cutting the edges to fit the bread
4. Place the basil leaves randomly on top of the turkey
5. Top with the other 4 slices of bread , cream cheese side down
6. Wrap and refrigerate until the cream cheese is cold and firm
7. Cut the sandwiches into whatever shapes desired
8. Serve chilled

title: turtle cake bars
steps:
1. In heavy pot melt all ingredients in step one
2. When melted set aside
3. In large bowl combine dry cake mix with melted butter and evaporated milk and stir well by hand
4. Batter will be sticky
5. Press 1 / 2 of batter in well greased 9x13 baking pan and bake at 350 degrees for 12 to 15 minutes
6. Remove from oven and pour reserved caramel mixture evenly over baked cake
7. On top of caramel sprinkle evenly the pecans and chocolate chips
8. Press pecans and chips lightly into caramel
9. Drop remaining cake batter across top by small amounts and spread carefully with a spatula
10. Cake batter will not completely cover
11. Bake 20 to 22 minutes at 350 degrees
12. Cool completely before attempting to cut into bars

title: quick curried pork chops
steps:
1. Trim fat from pork chops
2. If desired , sprinkle with salt and pepper
3. In a large frying pan over medium heat , cook pork chops on both sides in margarine or butter until no pink remains
4. Remove pork chops from the pan
5. Add apple slices to frying pan and cook for 1 minute
6. Stir parsley , flour , curry powder , bouillon granules and pepper into drippings
7. Add milk all at once
8. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly
9. Stir in wine or water
10. Return pork chops to frying pan and heat through
11. Good served with rice

title: grilled teriyaki salmon
steps:
1. In a bowl mix together together soy sauce , brown sugar , water , worcestershire sauce , oil , ginger and lemon pepper
2. Whisk until no sugar granules remain add in garlic halves and green onion
3. Wash the salmon under cold water then pat dry using paper towels
4. Place the salmon into a long deep glass dish then pour the marinade over
5. Turn salmon to coat in the marinade
6. Refrigerate for 3-6 hours
7. Set grill to medium heat , then grease the grill glates
8. Place the salmon on the grill , then discard marinade
9. Season with salt and more lemon pepper if desired
10. Grill for 6-8 minutes per side or until the fish flakes easily (do not overcook !

title: pork and sweet potatoes packets
steps:
1. In a fry pan , brown chops on both sides
2. Place each in center of a large square of heavy duty foil
3. Peel and slice sweet potatoes
4. Place slices over chops
5. Top with onion slices
6. Quarter and core apples , cut into thin wedges and arrange over onion slices
7. Combine sugar , salt , nutmeg and cloves and sprinkle over apples
8. Bring edged of foil together over chop
9. Fold over with a double fold , leaving a space for expansion and seal ends securely
10. Build a medium fire in a barbeque
11. Barbeque packets 4 inches from heat turning several times for 1 hour or until pork is tender when pierces with a fork

title: comforting chicken croquettes
steps:
1. Melt butter in saucepan over low heat
2. Blend in flour , salt and pepper
3. Cook over low heat , stirring until mixture is smooth and bubbly
4. Remove from heat
5. Stir in milk
6. Heat to boiling , stirring constantly
7. Boil and stir 1 minute
8. Prepare thick white sauce
9. Stir in meat , 1 tablespoon minced onion and the parsley
10. Season with salt and pepper
11. Spread mixture in ungreased square pan , 8x8x2 inches , but you want to use a shallow pan to the mixture can completely cool to make it easier to handle
12. Cover and chill at least 2 hours
13. Mix egg and water
14. Shape croquettes and dip in egg , and then breadcrumbs to cover
15. Chill again
16. Heat fat or oil to 365 degrees in deep fat fryer or kettle
17. Fry croquettes in hot fat 1-1 / 2 to 2 minutes or until light brown
18. Drain
19. Keep warm in 350 degree oven until serving time

title: raspberry lemon whipped cheesecake
steps:
1. To make the filling:
2. In large bowl , beat cream cheese , confectioner's sugar , lemon juice and peel and vanilla until light and fluffy
3. Fold whipped cream into the cream cheese mixture
4. Spread into graham cracker crust
5. To make the topping:
6. In a saucepan , combine sugar and cornstarch
7. Stir in water and 1 1 / 2 cups of raspberries
8. Bring to a boil , stir 2 minutes or until thickened
9. Refrigerate until thickened
10. Spread topping over the filled pie
11. Garnish with remaining berries

title: pickled pigs feet
steps:
1. Wash pig's feet well
2. Cover with cold , salted water
3. Soak
4. Drain
5. Place in a stockpot
6. Cover with cold water and simmer 1 hour
7. Add vinegar , onion , bay leaves , paprika , red pepper , cloves , dry mustard , celery seed , marjoram , salt and pepper to season
8. Simmer until tender

title: easy cabbage and noodles
steps:
1. Cook egg noodles according to package directions
2. Drain
3. In a large skillet , melt butter and saute cole slaw mix , onion and garlic until tender
4. Mix in salt and pepper
5. Gently stir in cooked and drained noodles
6. Toss together

title: vermont country baked ham from governor howard dean  m d
steps:
1. Simmer ham in cider for 2 hours
2. Drain , skin ham , and cover it with paste made from maple sugar , mustard , cloves , and water
3. Place in baking pan , pour cider over it , add raisins to pan , and bake 2-1 / 2 hours at 325 degrees
4. Baste frequently
5. Make thickened gravy of cider raisin drippings

title: cheese ball with everything
steps:
1. Let swiss and cheddar cheeses come to room temperature
2. In a large bowl beat together cream cheese and sour cream till fluffy
3. Beat in swiss cheese , cheddar cheese , onion , undrained pimiento , pickle relish , half of the bacon , 1 / 4 cup of the pecans , salt and pepper
4. Cover and chill till firm
5. Shape into 1 large or 2 small balls on wax paper
6. In a small bowl combine remaining bacon , pecans , parsley , and poppy seeds
7. Turn mixture out onto clean clean sheet of waxed paper
8. Roll cheese balls in seed mixture to coat
9. Wrap and chill
10. Let stand 30 minutes at room temperature before serving
11. Serve with crackers

title: tasty breakfast deer sausage
steps:
1. Doesn't get any more simple than this !
2. Mix all ingredients except egg in bowl
3. Refrigerate for 1 to 4 hours
4. Mix in egg if desired
5. Make into 3-4 inch patties , 1 inch thick
6. Cook on grill or stove top as you would for hamburger patties

title: secret ingredient low fat potato salad
steps:
1. Peel the potatoes if needed & cut into 1" dice
2. Boil until just tender - not too soft ! drain the potatoes in a colander and set on one side too cool
3. Meanwhile , mix together the low fat mayonnaise , low fat creme fraiche or low fat sour cream & maggi seasoning
4. Add the black pepper to taste
5. Add the mayonnaise mixture to the potatoes and mix well but try not to break the potatoes up
6. Add the cornichons , ham & spring onions to the potato salad - mix through gently
7. Taste and add more maggi seasoning or black pepper if required
8. Put into an attractive bowl and sprinkle more spring onions on as a garnish or parsley
9. I also like to sprinkle on smoked paprika as a garnish topping too
10. Optional:
11. Instead of the ham , use crisply fried bacon
12. Great with egg - egg & bacon potato salad ! instead of the spring onions , use diced red onions
13. I have also added diced left over chicken & chopped apple to this mixture
14. I have given the option of using more or less mayonnaise mixture for personal taste
15. Some people like it very creamy & others like it not so creamy !
16. Maggi seasoning is quite salty , so use 1 tablespoon to start with , adding more if needed - teaspoon by teaspoon !

title: vegetables   udon in chicken   miso broth
steps:
1. Combine bones , the water , carrot , celery , peppercorns , bay leaves and brown onion in large saucepan , bring to boil
2. Simmer uncovered 2 hours
3. Strain through muslin lined strainer into large bowl
4. Reserve stock , discard bones and veges
5. Meanwhile place mushrooms in medium heatproof bowl , cover with boiling water
6. Stand about 20 minutes or until just tender
7. Drain
8. Discard stems , slice caps thinly
9. Bring stock to boil
10. Add miso , ginger and sauce , simmer uncovered 5 minutes
11. Just before serving , stir in noodles and mushrooms
12. Simmer uncovered until noodles are just tender
13. Stir in extra carrot and green onion
14. Sprinkle with nori

title: egg and bacon quesadilla
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425
2. Coat a cookie sheet with nonstick spray
3. Place 4 tortillas on cookie sheet
4. Sprinkle with half the cheese , then all the corn and bacon
5. Cover with eggs
6. Top with scallions , the remaining cheese and tortillas
7. Lightly coat tortillas with nonstick spray
8. Bake 6 minutes
9. Then turn over and bake 6 minutes more until lightly browned and crisp
10. Cut in wedges
11. Serve with salsa

title: broccoli cheese souffle
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f , fill round cake pan or pie pan with 1 / 2 inch boiling water
2. Steam broccoli florets until tender
3. Melt butter in medium sauce pan
4. Add flour to melted butter until smooth
5. Slowly stir in milk
6. Once mixture is smooth add onion , nutmeg and cheese
