7. Add broccoli to mix
8. Whipp egg whites into soft peaks
9. Slowly fold in cheese mixture , do not stir
10. Pour egg and cheese mixture into round csserole dish with high sides , approx 1 1 / 2 quart
11. Place dish in pan with water , bake for 50-60 minutes

title: frozen bluethongarita
steps:
1. To blender jar add tequilla , triple sec
2. Limeade , blue curacao and ice
3. Blend until ice is crushed
4. Rub glass rims with lime and dip into coarse salt
5. Serve lime wedge for garnish

title: shrimp and crab salad rolls
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl , and stir well
2. Add chopped cooked shrimp and lump crabmeat , stirring to combine
3. Line each hoagie roll with 1 lettuce leaf
4. Place 2 / 3 cup shrimp mixture in each bun

title: bounty harvest meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In large bowl combine meats
3. Place 2 carrots in frying pan covered with water
4. Boil 10 minutes
5. Drain
6. Shred remaining carrot
7. Set aside
8. Saute onion in butter until browned
9. Combine egg , bread crumbs , cheese , garlic , salt , horseradish and basil
10. Lightly stir in shredded carrot , sauteed onion , tomato , green pepper , olives and parsley
11. Mix in ground meats
12. Put half the meat mixture into a 9x5" loaf pan
13. Place cooked whole carrots down center
14. Pat remaining meat evenly over carrots
15. Bake , uncovered 1 hour 15 minutes
16. Let stand a few minutes before slicing

title: liquid flavored coffee creamer
steps:
1. Combine all ing
2. Stir until creamer and sugar are disolved
3. Store in fridg

title: coq au vin  chicken in red wine
steps:
1. Cook the bacon over medium heat in olive oil in a large dutch oven until crisp , about 8 minutes
2. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside
3. Season the chicken pieces generously with the salt and pepper and brown the pieces in 2 batches in the bacon drippings
4. Set aside
5. Pour off about half of the pan drippings then add the onions , garlic , and mushrooms
6. Cook over medium-high heat until browned , about 8 minutes
7. Stir in the potatoes and carrots
8. Add the 1 1 / 2 teaspoons salt and the flour , stir to coat the vegetables
9. Pour in the wine and chicken broth , stir until you don't see any lumps of flour
10. Add the chicken , thyme , bay leaves , and half of the bacon to the stew
11. Bring to a boil then reduce to a simmer
12. Cover and braise until the chicken and vegetables are almost tender , about 40 minutes
13. Uncover and cook until sauce thickens , about 10 more minutes
14. Stir in the parsley and vinegar
15. Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper , to taste , and serve with the remaining bacon
16. Serve with a nice crusty bread

title: butternut squash soup with apples and potatoes
steps:
1. If you use frozen , just roast with the other vegetables for 45 minutes , stirring halfway through
2. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
3. Cut squash in half , scoop out and discard the seeds , and brush the exposed flesh with half the olive oil
4. Peel and chop the onions into large chunks
5. Chop the carrots in half
6. Peel the garlic cloves
7. Toss the carrots , onions , and garlic with the rest of the oil
8. Place the carrots , garlic , and onions on a foil-lined baking sheet along with the squash , cut side down
9. Roast the vegetables for 45 minutes
10. Remove everything but the squash
11. Roast the squash for another 15 minutes
12. Peel the apples and cut them into large chunks
13. Peel and cut the potatoes into medium-sized chunks
14. Place them in the soup pot along with the broth and thyme
15. Add the scooped out flesh of the squash and the roasted vegetables and garlic
16. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes
17. Remove from the heat and allow to cool slightly
18. Remove the thyme stems
19. Using a blender or food processor , puree the soup
20. Return it to the pot and reheat gently
21. Salt and pepper to taste

title: simple potato salad without mustard
steps:
1. Peel and quarter the potatoes and cook until tender covered with water
2. Drain well and gently mix the grated onion into the hot potatoes then set aside to cool
3. Boil the eggs about 10 minutes , cool , peel and chop
4. When the potatoes are cool enough to handle cut them into medium size chunks or cubes
5. Chop the eggs well and add to the potatoes
6. Add the celery , carrots , and pickles and toss gently
7. Mix the miracle whip well with the salt and pepper
8. Add the dressing mixture to the salad , adding more miracle whip if needed to make sure the entire salad is covered well but not soupy
9. Garnish with the paprika on the top of the salad
10. Chill well several hours or overnight

title: crab stuffed mushrooms with garlic   horseradish
steps:
1. Wash mushrooms , pat dry , remove stems and set aside
2. In a small bowl combine scallions and butter and microwave on high for 2 minutes
3. Stir in crabmeat , parsley , horseradish , garlic and hot pepper sauce , stirring well
4. Place half the mushrooms gill side up on a plate and fill each cap with crab mixture
5. Microwave on high 3-4 minutes , turning plate once
6. Remove mushrooms to a serving plate
7. Repeat this process with the remaining mushrooms
8. Let stand 2-3 minutes before serving
9. Sprinkle with red pepper to garnish

title: butterscotch cream cheese bars
steps:
1. Melt the butterscotch chips and butter over low heat in medium pan
2. Remove from heat
3. Stir in graham cracker crumbs& mix well
4. Set aside 2 / 3 cup of crumb mixture for topping
5. Press the remainder of mixture firmly into the bottom of greased 13x9 inch glass baking dish
6. In mixing bowl , beat the cream cheese until light and fluffy
7. Add condensed milk , vanilla , and egg
8. Fold in the nuts
9. Pour over crust in prepared pan
10. Sprinkle reserved crumb mixture evenly over top
11. Bake at 325f for 25-30 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
12. Cool to room temperature , then chill
13. Serve chilled , cut into squares

title: witches brew marinade
steps:
1. Mix well
2. Marinate meat 3-4 hours

title: diabetic baked beans
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Heat olive oil in skillet
3. Saut onion and garlic over medium heat until onion is translucent
4. Add beans , molasseses , tamari , mustard
5. Stir well
6. Spray baking dish with oil and add bean mixture
7. Bake 20 minutes

title: stir fried shrimp and mushrooms
steps:
1. Saute garlic in oil , in skillet or wok for 1 minute
2. Add shrimp , mushrooms and onions
3. Stirfry for 1 minute
4. Stir in broth
5. Cook 2 minutes longer , or until shrimp turn pink
6. Serve over rice
7. Garnish with lemon

title: tailgating with franks and beans from longmeadow farm
steps:
1. Cook frankfurters , onions , celery , both kinds of peppers , and garlic in butter until franks are warmed and browned in the same saucepan
2. Add seasonings , remaining ingredients , including cooked macaroni to this mixture
3. Cover , and cook over low heat 12 to 15 minutes , stirring often
4. Serve on warmed buns , sliced in half , adding some extra minced onion to the top

title: homemade chicken pot pie
steps:
1. Saute potatoes in margarine for 5 minutes in a dutch oven
2. Add onion , celery and thawed frozen vegetables
3. Saute for another 10 minutes
4. Add flour gradually to the sauteed mixture , stirring constantly for one minute
5. Allow refrigerated pie crust to come to room temperature
6. Meanwhile , combine chicken broth and half and half
7. Gradually stir into the vegetable mixture
8. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until thickened and bubbly
9. Stir in salt and pepper
10. Add chopped chicken , stirring well
11. Add additional salt and pepper to taste
12. Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit
13. Spray a 9 x 13 casserole with nonstick spray
14. Place pie crust on the bottom of the pan to cover , cutting to fit
15. Pour chicken / vegetable mixture over the pie crust
16. Top with the remaining pie crust
17. Cut vents in the top crust
18. Bake for 40 minutes or until crust is golden brown
19. Enjoy !

title: tortellini soup
steps:
1. Saute onions and celery in olive oil until clear
2. Add chicken broth and bring to boil
3. Add tortellini and cook for 8-9 minutes
4. Add seasonings , beans and tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes
5. Serve topped with parmesan cheese

title: gummy bears
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a saucepan until the mixture resembles playdough
2. Place the pan over low heat and stir until melted
3. Once completely melted , pour into plastic candy molds and place in freezer for 5 min
4. When very firm , remove from molds

title: pork and black bean chili
steps:
1. Bring 6 cups water to boil in a 4-quart saucepan
2. Add beans and boil three minutes
3. Remove from heat , cover and let stand one hour
4. Drain and rinse beans
5. Preheat oven to 350f
6. Heat oil in dutch oven
7. Over medium heat , cook onions until translucent
8. Add pork gradually and brown
9. Transfer to a bowl
10. Add peppers , diced jalapenos , garlic and chili powder to dutch oven and cook 5 minutes , stirring frequently
11. Return pork and add black beans , 4 cups water , tomatoes and salt
12. Cover and bake 2 hours , stirring occasionally until beans are tender and pork is cooked through
13. Garnish with cilantro

title: egg sandwich
steps:
1. Heat marinara sauce in microwave until warmed , or heat in sauce pot until warmed
2. Drain sauce , in paper toweled colander to get extra juice out of sauce
3. Set aside
4. In a heavy small skillet over medium heat , warm olive oil
5. Gently crack each egg into warmed skillet
6. Add dash of salt and pepper
7. Cover skillet and cook until the whites are cooked
8. Toast muffins and while still warm , rub the garlic on muffin and add parmesan cheese
9. Add 1 to 2 tablespoons of sauce as desired
10. Place cooked egg carefully atop the sauce covered toasted english muffin
11. Serve immediately

title: roasted bone in chicken breast
steps:
1. Rinse chicken breast and use knife to lift skin
2. Squeeze juice of half lemon over breast and under skin
3. Combine all spices and garlic and rub under skin
4. Spray or rub skin with olive oil
5. Dust with paprika
6. Place remainder of lemon under breast and bake uncovered at 375 degrees for approximately 45 minutes
7. Time varies depending on weight of breast

title: seasoned chicken fried steaks
steps:
1. In a shallow bowl , combine 2 cups flour , baking powder , and seasonings
2. In another shallow bowl , combine eggs , and 1 cup buttermilk
3. Dip each cubed steak in buttermilk mixture , then roll in flour mixture , and let stand for 5 minutes
4. In a large skillet , heat 1 / 2 inch of oil on medium-high
5. Fry steaks for 5-7 minutes , and turn carefully
6. Cook 5 minutes longer or until coating is crisp and meat is no longer pink
7. Remove steaks and keep warm
8. Drain reserving 1 / 3 cup drippings , and stir remaining flour into drippings until smooth
9. Cook and stir over medium heat for 2 minutes
10. Gradually whisk in milk , and remaining buttermilk
11. Bring to a boil , and cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
12. Serve with steaks

title: souvlaki chicken pasta salad
steps:
1. Mix marinade ingredients in food processor or with immersion blender
2. Add water until the consistancy is about that of maple syrup
3. Place with chicken in plastic bag , remove air , marinate overnight
4. Grill or broil chicken until tender
5. Allow to cool and chop in to bite sized chunks mix dressing ingredients in food processor or with immersion blender
6. Add water until the consistancy is about that of maple syrup
7. Combine chicken , oilves , pasta , fresh oregano and toss
8. Add desired amount of dressing while tossing
9. Adjust seasoning and garnish with more fresh oregano

title: chocolate peanut butter tart with caramel peanut glaze
steps:
1. For crust:
2. Dump prepared pie crusts into a gallon size ziploc bag and crush until it is all crumbs
3. Add melted butter and mix thoroughly until all crumbs are moistened
4. Press into bottom and up sides of a 9" fluted tart pan with removable bottom
5. Bake crust in 350f oven for 10 minutes
6. For filling:
7. Stir 1 / 3 cup brown sugar , 3 tbs cream , and butter in medium sauce pan over medium heat until sugar dissolves
8. Cool completely
9. Using electric mixer , beat cream cheese , peanut butter , and vanilla in medium bowl until smooth
10. Stir in brown sugar mixture
11. Using electric mixer , beat remaining 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 / 4 cream in another medium bowl until peaks form
12. Fold into peanut butter mixture
13. Transfer to crust and smooth top with spatula
14. Chill until set , about 3 hours
15. For caramel-peanut glaze:
16. Stir brown sugar , butter , 1 / 4 cup water , 2 tbs cream , and corn syrup in heavy medium sauce pan over medium heat until sugar dissolves
17. Increase heat to high and boil without stirring until candy thermometer registers 238f
18. Remove from heat
19. Stir in remaining 2 tbsp cream and 3 / 4 cup of peanuts
20. Cool just to lukewarm , then pour glaze atop filling , smoothing with a spatula
21. Melt chocolate chips and pour into a ziploc bag
22. Cut a small piece off one corner of the bag and drizzle the chocolate onto the tart in a spiral pattern , starting in the center
23. You should still have some chocolate left over
24. Using a knife , trace a line from the center of the tart to the edge 8 times , spacing evenly
25. In between those line , trace lines from the edge of the tart to the center
26. You should have 16 lines total , resulting in a web pattern
27. Using remaining melted chocolate , trace the lines of the "web" near the center of the tart to create a flower-like pattern
28. Pipe some chocolate in the center as well for the middle of the flower
29. Fill "petals" of the flower with chopped peanuts
30. Chill tart until set
31. Cut into wedges and serve
32. Keep chilled

title: buffalo wing wrap
steps:
1. Put cream cheese in a bowl and beat until smooth
2. Add buffalo wing sauce and mix until fully incorporated
3. Mix in chicken , olives and celery
4. Chill two hours or until mixture firms up
5. Warm tortillas in microwave for 10-15 seconds
6. Spread two tablespoons buffalo wing mixture on tortilla , top with lettuce , cheese and onions to taste
7. Roll up like a burrito and serve with potato chips
8. I also think you could make this like the cream cheese tortilla appetizers , and slice into little rounds as a new option for those office parties or get togethers

title: parmesan crusted smoked cheddar potato cakes
steps:
1. 1
2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat
3. Stir together the mashed potatoes and smoked cheddar then scoop about cup mashed potatoes and form into equal size small patties
4. Combine parmesan cheese and flour into a shallow dish and press potato patties into mixture
5. In batches , place patties into hot skillet and cook for 2-4 minutes per side or until golden brown
6. Transfer to a paper towel lined plate
7. Serve warm with ranch dressing if desired

title: newfoundland white bread
steps:
1. Combine 3 cups of the flour along with the sugar , instant yeast and salt in a large bowl or in the bowl of a large electric mixer that uses a dough hook
2. Add the melted butter and warm milk
3. Using a wooden spoon or the regular paddle of your electric mixer beat for 4-5 minutes until the mixture is smooth with no lumps
4. If using an electric mixer , switch to the dough hook at this point and begin to slowly incorporate the remaining 2 cups of flour
5. If not using an electric mixer keep mixing in the flour gradually until a soft dough forms that leaves the sides of the bowl
6. Turn the dough out onto the countertop or bread board to knead
7. You may need to use a little less or a little more flour , this is not uncommon
8. Knead the dough for an additional 10 minutes either in the electric mixer or on a bread board or countertop
9. Cover dough and leave to rest and rise for one hour
10. Punch the dough down and knead it for a few minutes by hand before letting it rest for another 10 minutes
11. Grease 2 medium loaf pans
12. Divide the dough into 6 equal portions , forming each division into a ball
13. Place 3 balls of dough in each loaf pan
14. Cover with a clean tea towel and allow the dough to rise until it is about 2 inches above the rim of the pan , about 2 hours depending on room temperature
15. Bake at 375 degrees f for 30-40 minutes depending on the size of the pans that you are using
16. When baked , turn loaves out onto a wire rack to cool
17. Brush the tops with melted butter if desired to soften the top crust

title: almond butter yeast cake
steps:
1. Sift together all dry ingredients
2. Add eggs one by one
3. Stir in milk and rest of ingredients except almonds
4. Spread into a bundt pan and bake fpr 40 minute sprinkle with almonds
5. Serve warm

title: southern crock pot meatloaf
steps:
1. Sliced the potatoes about 1 / 4 inch thick
2. Diced the onion and finely dice the green pepper salt and pepper to taste
3. Mix well in a large bowl the meat , diced onions , finely diced green pepper , breadcrumbs , egg and ketchup together by hand
4. Squish real well form into a loaf
5. Spray the bottom of the crock pot with non-stick spray
6. Place sliced potatoes on the bottom of the crock pot
7. This will help stop the sticking of the loaf and keep it from swimming in all the juices
8. Place the loaf in the crock pot on top of the potatoes being sure not to let the loaf touch the sides of the crock pot
9. Mix the ketchup , brown sugar and yellow mustard in a small bowl
10. This is the topping
11. Pour over the entire loaf
12. Turn crock pot on low for 7-9 hours

title: cedar plank teriyaki salmon
steps:
1. Soak cedar plank for about 2 hours
2. Marinate salmon for 2 hours in yoshido's gourmet sauce or kikkoman teriyaki sauce
3. Heat grill to medium heat , leaving the center burner off
4. Close grill and cook for about 10 minutes or until the meat flakes easily with a fork
5. Top with a drizzle of gourmet or teriyaki sauce , chopped green onions and sesame seeds
6. Enjoy !
7. Oh and if you get the chance , please tell me how you like it !

title: creamy maple breakfast bake
steps:
1. Grease 13x9 inch pan
2. Place the bread cubes in the bottom of pan
3. Top with cream cheese cubes place evenly
4. Top with remaining bread
5. In large mixing bowl beat eggs , half and half , maple syrup and salt until smooth
6. Pour evenly over the bread
7. Cover tightly and refrigerate overnight
8. In morning remove casserole from refrigerator and heat oven to 350
9. Combine sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over bread
10. Bake until top in golden brown and center is set , about 35-45 minutes
11. Let stand 10 minutes before serving in cut squares
12. Serve with additional maple syrup or fruit sauce on the side

title: mini potato gratins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 175c / 350f
2. Cook potatoes , uncovered , in a large pot / saucepan of boiling , salted water for 10 to 12 minutes or until just fork tender
3. Set aside for 5 minutes and then cut into small cubes and transfer to a bowl
4. Melt butter in a saucepan over medium-high heat and add spring onion or and garlic and cook until just tender
5. Add flour and continue to stir for a minute
6. Add milk and whisk and whisk until smooth and then continue to stir with a wooden spoon until sauce thickens and then remove from heat
7. Add mustard and thyme and season with salt and pepper , stirring to combine
8. Now add milk mix to the potatoes and gently mix together
9. Spoon potatoes into four 1 cup capacity ovenproof dishes or ramekins
10. Divide the cheese and then the breadcrumbs equally over the top of the potatoes
11. Place dishes on a baking tray
12. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until cheese melts and breadcrumbs are golden
13. Stand for 5 minutes before serving

title: oven fried zucchini sticks
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Spray a cookie sheet with cooking spray
3. Place bread crumbs , cheeses , garlic powder , oregano , basil , parsley in ziploc bag
4. Shake well to combine
5. Set aside
6. Cut each zucchini lengthwise into 8 pieces
7. Cut each piece in half horizontally
8. Beat egg and milk in a shallow bowl
9. Dip each piece of zucchini in egg mixture then bread crumb mixture
10. Repeat until all of the sticks are coated
11. Place them on prepared cookie sheet
12. Bake for 10-15 minutes or until brown and tender
13. Serve with warm spaghetti sauce or ranch dressing

title: pavlova roulade  served with toffee plums
steps:
1. To make the toffee plums , place all ingredients , except plums , in a saucepan with 1 litre water
2. Stir over low heat until the sugar is dissolved
3. Add plums , and cook for 10-15 minutes , or , until they are just tender
4. Set aside to cool , in the poaching liquid
5. Plums will keep up to 4 days in the fridge
6. Pre heat the oven to 160 degrees c
7. Grease and line a 2cm-deepx37cm baking tray
8. Beat egg whites in the bowl of an electric mixer , until stiff peaks form
9. Add sugar in a slow , steady stream , and continue to beat for about 5 minutes , or until thick and glossy
10. Gently fold in vanilla , vinegar and cornflour
11. Spread meringue into pan and flatten gently with a spatula
12. Bake for 20 minutes then allow to cool in the pan
13. Whip the cream with the icing sugar until thick
14. Turn meringue onto a piece of baking paper , dusted with icing sugar , and spread with the sweetened cream
15. Drain plums , reserving liquid , and remove the stones
16. Chop 6 plums , then spread on top of the cream
17. Starting from the short end , gently roll the roulade away from you , using the paper to keep it in shape
18. Wrap the whole roulade in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 3 hours
19. Just before serving , place the plum poaching liquid in a pan over medium heat , and reduce until almost toffee-like in consistency
20. Cool slightly
21. Place thick slice of roulade on each plate , with 2 or 3 plums , then drizzle with sauce

title: easy peasy mini cupcakes
steps:
1. Mix together until just combined
2. I put mini cupcake liners in a tart tray
3. Bake for 9-10 minutes at 250c

title: kim s mexican bean dip
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375
2. In a large bowl add beans , chiles with juice , liquid smoke and garlic
3. Mix together well
4. Stir in cilantro
5. Place mixture in ungreased shallow 9 inch glass pan
6. Top with the cheese
7. Cover with foil
8. Bake at 375 for 15 to minutes or until mixture is thoroughly heated
9. Serve with tortilla chips
10. May microwave on high to 3 to 5 minutes
11. May garnish with tomatoes and green peppers if you desire

title: boterkoek     dutch butter cake
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together with hands until very well mixed
2. Press into bottom of springform pan and bake in preheated 400f oven for 25-30 minutes , or until golden brown

title: vegan rice pudding
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan
2. Heat over medium-low heat for 15-20 minutes , or until rice is very soft
3. Serve hot or cold , for breakfast or dessert ! garnish with fresh sliced mango or fresh berries

title: basic olive oil and vinegar vinaigrette  low gi  south beach
steps:
1. Combine all of the ingredients in a jar
2. Shake well
3. Refrigerate
4. Variations: add one of the following-- four cloves of crushed garlic , a squirt of lemon or lime juice , 2 tsp of fresh chopped basil , 2 tsp of minced scallion , 2 tsp fresh thyme , 2 tsp of fresh marjoram

title: cilantro lime mexican rice
steps:
1. In large wide pan with tight fitting lid , heat oil under medium heat
2. Add onion and sautee for 3 minutes
3. Add garlic and sautee 30 seconds
4. Add white rice and stir very often for 6-8 minutes
5. Add chicken bouillon and sautee for 2 minutes
6. Add water and bring to a boil
7. Cover , turn to lowest setting and do not remove lid for 15 minutes
8. Remove from heat and fluff with fork
9. Add in lime juice and cilantro
10. Cover and let sit for 5 minutes
11. Fluff with fork again and serve hot

title: serendipity s lemon ice box pie
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine graham cracker crumbs , cinnamon , and butter until fully incorporated
2. Scrape mixture into a 9" pie pan
3. Using your fingers or the back of a sppon , press mixture firmly onto the base and up the sides of the pan , forming a uniform crust about 1 / 4" thick
4. Refrigerate until ready to use
5. In a medium nonstick saucepan , whisk together sweetened condensed milk , egg yolks , and lemon juice until smooth
6. Cook custard over medium heat until very hot to the touch , about 10 minutes , stirring occasionally with a wooden spoon
7. Do not allow to boil
8. Strain custard through a sieve into prepared pie shell
9. Smooth the filling , forming a slight dome in the center
10. Refrigerate uncovered at least 1 hour , or until set
11. Cover with plastic wrap and chill completely , at least another hour
12. Serve wedges cold with plenty of whipped cream
13. Store covered in refrigerator

title: the actual olive garden bolognese sauce recipe  spaghetti sauce
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large pan
2. Add celery , carrot , onion , and garlic and cook about 5 minutes
3. Add meat and cook 10 minutes over medium heat , stirring occasionally
4. Deglaze pan with wine , let it reduce
5. Add tomatoes and remaining ingredients and stir , simmer for about 1 hour
6. Serve over fresh , hot pasta

title: un fried potato latkes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Brush 2 baking sheets with 1 tsp oil each
3. Loosely grate potatoes and onion in food processor and place in large mixing bowl
4. Season to taste with salt and pepper
5. Add flour and onion and mix well
6. Mix in eggs and 1 tsp oil
7. Spoon out the batter onto baking sheets and flattern slightly
8. With oven racks in lower and middle positions , bake until brown on the bottom
9. Turn and bake another 5 or until brown
10. Garnish liberally with chives and serve with sour cream or non-fat yogurt

title: rosemary chicken and potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Line a broiler pan with foil
3. In a small bowl , combine the oil with the garlic and 2 tbl of the fresh rosemary in another small bowl , combine the breadcrumbs , parmesan , pepper and remaining 2 tbl fresh rosemary place the chicken skin-side up on the broiler pan
4. Sprinkle the breadcrumb-parmesan mixture over the chicken
5. Drizzle the rosemary-garlic oil over the chicken and potatoes and bake for 20 minutes
6. Reduce the oven temperature to 375 and continue baking for 30 to 40 minutes , or until the potatoes are tender and the chicken is golden and cooked through
7. Microwave
8. Cover loosely with wax paper and cook at 100% for 15 minutes
9. Transfer the chicken and potatoes to a foil lined broiler pan and broil until crisp and cooked through , 8 to 10 minutes

title: simple rice cooker risotto
steps:
1. Place butter in rice cooker and turn on
2. When melted , add onion and saute 3-4 min until soft
3. Add rice and saute 2-3 min until coated with butter and rice has turned milky-white
4. Add remaining ingredients except cheese
5. Cover and cook until rice cooker turns off
6. Stir in cheese before serving

title: so easy sweet and sour meatballs
steps:
1. Add frozen meatballs in your crock pot or my favorite , six quart roasting pan
2. Mix together , chili sauce , jellied cranberry sauce and water
3. Pour over meatballs and cook on low 5-6 hours

title: copycat hershey s chocolate syrup recipe
steps:
1. Combine cocoa , sugar , and salt in a saucepan
2. Add water , and mix until smooth
3. Bring this mixture to a boil
4. Boil for one minute , be careful this does not over boil
5. Remove from heat and cool
6. Add the vanilla
7. My
8. Thank you ! dicummings

title: buttermilk dill bread  bread machine
steps:
1. In bread machine pan , place all ingredients in order suggested by manufacturer
2. Select basic bread setting
3. Choose crust color and loaf size if available
4. Bake according to bread machine directions

title: lemon herb pork chops
steps:
1. For rub , combine the garlic , lemon peel , rosemary , salt , sage , and pepper
2. Trim fat from meat
3. Rub mixture onto both sides of each pork chop and grill or bake for about 45 minutes in the oven at 350 degrees

title: robust cheddar  feta and walnut cheese log
steps:
1. Combine cheddar cheese , cream cheese , feta cheese , garlic , salt and pepper sauce
2. Mix until blended and smooth
3. Add 1 / 2 cup walnuts , capers , bell pepper and gin , if desired
4. Continue to mix until ingredients are incorporated and evenly blended
5. Mixture will be easier to shape if refrigerated 2-3 hours before forming
6. Add cayenne pepper to remaining 1 / 2 cup walnuts and toss to coat
7. Spread nuts on sheet of waxed paper
8. With damp hands , divide cheese mixture in half
9. Pat and press each half into log about 5 inches long and 2 inches wide or into ball about 3 inches across
10. Roll eah log or ball in walnuts , patting coating in firmly
11. Wrap in plastic wrap and chill until ready to serve

title: bed and breakfast rolls
steps:
1. Cream together cream cheese , mayonnaise and enough milk to make spreading consistency
2. Spread onto the slices of bread
3. Roll each slice as a small jelly roll
4. Place seam side down on a baking sheet
5. Chill overnight
6. The next day , preheat oven to 325 degrees
7. Mix the sugar and cinnamon together
8. Brush rolls with melted margarine / butter
9. Coat with sugar and cinnamon mixture
10. Slice each roll into quarters and place onto baking sheet
11. Bake at 325 degrees for approximately 15 minutes
12. Broil for several seconds or until bubbly

title: kansas city beef brisket
steps:
1. The night before cooking , sprinkle brisket with tenderizer , liquid smoke , salt , pepper , celery salt , onion salt and garlic salt
2. Wrap in aluminum foil and refrigerate overnight
3. The next day add nutmeg , paprika , brown sugar and worcestershire
4. Wrap well with aluminum foil this is important
5. Cook 5 hours at 275 degrees f
6. Slice thin on the diagonal
7. Serve with homemade barbecue sauce and buns

title: low fat cherry cheesecake pudding pie
steps:
1. Spoon half of the pie filling into crust
2. In a mixing bowl , combine milk , and pudding mixes
3. Mix until smooth
4. Fold in whipped topping
5. Spoon mixture over pie filling in crust
6. Refrigerate three hours or until set
7. Top with remaining pie filling
8. You can sprinkle with some shaved chocolate for a nice effect

title: kahlua hummer
steps:
1. Add all ingredients into the container of an electric blender
2. Start mixing on low speed and gradually increase speed until the mixture is blended and smooth
3. Pour mixture into a wine goblet and enjoy

title: mchadi
steps:
1. Mix the cornmeal , salt and water to form a dry dough
2. Split into six balls
3. Flatten balls to 1 / 4 inch
4. Fry in a frypan until golden on each side

title: banana white chocolate cake with icing   absolutely decadent
steps:
1. Cake: preheat oven to 350 , grease and flour 2 9 inch cake pans
2. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy , beat in eggs and vanilla
3. In a separate bowl , sift flour , baking powder , baking soda , cinnamon and salt , add to creamed mixture alternately with the mashed bananas
4. Fold in the chopped white chocolate and divide mixture into into pans , spread evenly
5. Bake 30 minutes or until a tester inserted in center of the cakes comes out clean
6. Allow to cool ten minutes in the pans , then turn out onto a serving plate
7. Cream cheese icing: with electric beater cream cheese until smooth , then beat in the butter
8. Reduce speed and add icing sugar beating until smooth , stir in sour cream
9. To assemble: when completely cool ice and garnish with large white chocolate curls made using a vegetable peeler

title: vegan cherry chocolate oat chippers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350&#8728
2. F
3. Beat the oil , brown sugar , applesauce and baking powder together until smooth
4. Sift the flour and baking soda into a large bowl
5. Add the oats , salt , chocolate chips , and cherries , stirring together
6. Add the wet ingredients and stir
7. Drop rounded tablespoonfuls onto sheets lined with parchment paper , or nonstick pans
8. Leave 2 inches between each one so they have room to spread out
9. Bake for 10-12 minutes on the center rack of the oven
10. Let stand 2 minutes after you take them off , then slide the cookies onto a wire rack to cool completely

title: raspberry christmas dessert
steps:
1. Mix togeth first 3 ingredients plus 1 / 3 cup sugar
2. Press into bottom of 9 x 13 inch baking dish
3. Bake 10 minute allow to cool
4. Cream together cream cheese , and remaining 1 / 3 cup sugar
5. Fold in cool whip
6. Spread onto cooled crust
7. Dissolve jello into hot pineapple juice
8. Let cool
9. Stir in frozen raspberries
10. Stir till slightly thickened
11. Pour over cream cheese layer
12. Refrigerate several hours or until set

title: aunt eva s swedish stroganoff
steps:
1. Melt dripping in a pan that is large and heavy enough to hold at least 6 quarts of liquid and meat at a simmer for 4 hours
2. When dripping is at a "sizzle" , add the cubed beef in small enough batches to thoroughly brown the cubes
3. Remove as soon as they start to "bleed-out
4. "
5. When all beef is browned , add onion , stirring well until translucent but not too soft
6. Reduce heat to medium low and return the beef to the pot when your pan has cooled a bit
7. Sprinkle flour over the cubes and stir well , scraping the bottom of the pot , until the flour is well-distributed
8. With heat still at medium low , return onions , if you removed them earlier
9. Gradually add the liquid , stirring and scraping the pot all the time to incorporate everything together
10. Turn heat up to med-high and bring contents to a slow boil
11. Reduce heat to simmer , cover and simmer , checking for liquid level and stirring occasionally
12. Add more broth if the liquid is getting too thick
13. You want enough liquid to make sure your cubes get tender
14. After about 4 hours , the beef should be tender and your liquid getting harder to thin
15. That's a good thing
16. It's hard to judge just exactly what the consistency should be without some experience
17. Keep at it , everyone seems to end up with a stroganoff that is runny or really thick at one time or another
18. Remove the pot from the heat , allow to cool just enough that the sour cream won't break when you put it inches
19. If you aren't sure about this , put in a cereal spoonful and see if it curdles or separates into curds and whey
20. If it does , it's too hot
21. When the beef mixture has cooled enough , gently fold in the sour cream , stirring slowly and steady until it incorporates completely with the rest of the ingredients
22. Serve immediately with egg noodles or on rice , if you prefer

title: houlihan s fruit fizz
steps:
1. Chill all and then combine
2. Serve over ice

title: the kitchen diva s energy boosting stuffed bell peppers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Cut the peppers in half lengthwise , slicing from the stem to the bottoms , leaving the stems intact
3. Remove the white pithy ribs near stern and down length of inside
4. Place the peppers in a shallow 13x9 inch baking dish
5. Drizzle the peppers with 1 tablespoon of the oil
6. Cover the dish with foil , and bake the peppers 15 to 20 minutes , until they start to soften
7. Meanwhile , heat the remaining tablespoon of the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
8. Add the onion , garlic , salt , black pepper , chili powder , and cumin and cook until all vegetables are softened , about 3 minutes
9. Add the sausage to the skillet
10. Cook , breaking it up with a slotted spoon or potato masher , until lightly browned , about 5 minutes
11. Add the salsa and the spinach , and cook , stirring occasionally , about 5 minutes
12. Remove the skillet from the heat and stir in the cooked brown rice and quinoa
13. Carefully fill the pepper halves with the turkey mixture
14. Cover the dish with foil , and bake until the filling is hot and the peppers are tender , 20 to 25 minutes
15. Remove foil , and sprinkle the cheese over the top of the peppers
16. Return to oven and bake , uncovered , until cheese is melted , about 7 to 10 minutes
17. Top the peppers with a heaping tablespoon of the yogurt
18. Place slices of the avocado on top of each pepper
19. Sprinkle with the basil
20. Serve immediately

title: almond cheese rounds low carb
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix up all ingredients
3. Press into 6 muffin top pans to make the round shape
4. Bake for about 10-12 minutes until golden brown
5. Really good coated with butter & garlic and put under the broiler for a few minutes

title: sour cream halibut
steps:
1. Mix wine and salt
2. Pour over halibut and marinate at least one hour and up to 1 day
3. Drain filets on paper towels
4. Dip in bread crumbs and place in greased baking dish
5. Combine mayo , sour cream and onion
6. Spread over the fish
7. Sprinkle with remaining bread crumbs and then paprika
8. Bake at 475 for 20-25 minutes or until done

title: apple pecan cream pie
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine the apple pie filling , brown sugar and cinnamon
2. Stir in pecans
3. Spread half of the mixture in the pie crust
4. Refrigerate the remaining mixture
5. Place the milk and the half and half in a medium sized bowl
6. Add the pudding mix
7. Beat with a wire whisk until well blended , about 1 to 2 minutes
8. Gently stir in the whipped topping
9. Spoon the pudding mixture over the apple mixture in the pie crust
10. Freeze for at least 2 hours before serving
11. Remove from freezer about 10 minutes before serving and garnish with reserved applie mixture and additional whipped topping

title: kinpira gobo  braised burdock root
steps:
1. Peel the burdock root and julienne it into very thin strips
2. Soak the burdock matchsticks in water for 30 minutes and drain well
3. While the burdock is soaking , peel the carrot and julienne it into matchsticks of a similar size as the burdock root
4. Put vegetable oil in a frying pan and put it on high heat
5. Add burdock sticks and fry for a couple minutes
6. Add carrot sticks in the hot pan and fry for one to two minutes , moving the vegetables around constantly
7. Add all remaining ingredients in the pan and stir well
8. Remove from heat and serve !

title: oatmeal sandwich cookies
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , cream shortening and brown sugar
2. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each
3. Beat in vanilla
4. Combine flour , cinnamon , baking soda , salt and nutmeg
5. Add to creamed mixture
6. Stir in oats
7. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto lightly greased baking sheets
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 10-12 minutes or until golden brown
9. Remove to wire racks to cool
10. In a mixing bowl , cream shortening , sugar and marshmallow creme
11. Add enough milk and mix until spreading consistency is achieved
12. Spread filling on the bottom half of the cookies
13. Top with remaining cookies

title: fat free baking mix  like bisquick  copycat   clone
steps:
1. Mix together
2. You will need to tightly cover and store
3. Stir before using

title: hungarian pretzels  perec
steps:
1. Warm milk
2. Remove from heat
3. Add sugar and stir until it dissolves
4. Add yeast and stir until it dissolves
5. Proof yeast
6. Meanwhile add flour , 1 teaspoon salt and butter to large mixing bowl
7. Mix together
8. Add yeast and continue mixing until ball is formed
9. Divide into 4 equal portion and roll into ball
10. Add balls to large mixing bowl , cover with towel and place in warm area
11. Let rise until doubled
12. Remove 1 ball from bowl
13. Divide this portion into 4 pieces
14. Roll each piece into long rope-like shape and form into pretzel shape or cut into pieces for pretzel sticks
15. Place on oiled baking sheet
16. Continue until all pretzels are made
17. Whip egg and 1 teaspoon water together
18. Brush over pretzels
19. Bake at 375f for 10 to 15 minutes or until pretzels begin to brown
20. Meanwhile make salt wash
21. Mix 2 teaspoons salt , 1 teaspoon flour and 1 to 2 teaspoons hot water
22. This should be a jam like consistency
23. Brush salt mixture onto pretzels and bake another 3-4 minutes

title: paalak paneer
steps:
1. Boil spinach , dal , chillies and ginger paste together
2. Remove from fire and grind them well
3. Fry onions in oil until golden brown
4. Add tomotoes to it
5. Add this to the grounded spinach paste
6. Squeeze lemon juice to it
7. Make cubes of panir and add to it

title: fruity whole wheat oat bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Soak raisin in warm water for 10 minutes
3. Grease and flour an 8 1 / 2 x 4 1 / 2 inch loaf pan
4. In a large bowl , combine flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt , cinnamon , nutmeg , brown sugar , sunflower seeds and oats
5. In a smaller bowl mix apple , pear , raisins , eggs , milk , and oil
6. Pour in the dry ingredients and mix until dry ingredients are just moistened
7. Bake for 55 to 60 minutes , or until done
8. Cool on wire rack

title: grilled chicken with cilantro butter
steps:
1. Preheat grill to medium
2. Combine garlic , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper in a small dish
3. Mash into a paste using back side of a large spoon
4. Add lime peel
5. Wash hands
6. Loosen skin of chicken by slipping your hand between the meat and skin
7. Spread a quarter of the garlic mixture and tuck 2 cilantro sprigs under the skin of each breast
8. Wash hands
9. Combine chopped cilantro , butter or margarine , oil and lime juice in a small bowl
10. Brush chicken skin lightly with mixture
11. Sprinkle with remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper
12. Place chicken on grill , skin side down
13. Brush with cilantro-butter mixture
14. Cover and grill 15 minutes
15. Turn chicken
16. Brush with half of remaining cilantro butter
17. Cover and grill 10 minutes
18. Without turning , brush chicken with remaining cilantro butter
19. Cover and grill 5 minutes or until done
20. Serving suggestion: serve with spanish rice and chilled fresh fruit
21. Refrigerate leftovers

title: russian root beer
steps: 1. Serve over ice in a rocks glass

title: bleu cheese bread
steps:
1. Put all ingredients in bread machine bowl
2. Set machine to dough cycle
3. When finished , remove dough , knead lightly and place in greased loaf pan
4. Bake at 350-375 degrees for 40 minutes

title: velvety smooth rich chocolate pudding
steps:
1. Combine the sugar , cocoa and cornflour / cornmeal in a saucepan and whisk in the milk
2. Cook over medium-high heat , stirring frequently , until the mixture boils
3. Boil for 1 minute , still stirring constantly
4. Then remove pan from heat
5. Beat the egg in a small bowl and whisk about 125ml / 4fl oz of the hot milk mixture into the egg
6. Then whisk the egg mixture into the rest of the hot milk
7. Cook over medium heat for 2 minutes , stirring mixture constantly
8. Remove from the heat anf stir in the vanilla essence and butter
9. Pudding is now ready to be poured into serving dishes and placed in fridge to chill
10. Decorate with fruit slices

title: mama s banana bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease two loaf pans
3. In a small bowl , mash bananas together with vanilla
4. In a large bowl combine brown sugar , oil , sour cream , and eggs , stirring until combined
5. In a medium bowl , combine flour , baking soda , baking powder , and salt
6. Gradually add to sugar mixture , stirring until just combined
7. Stir in banana mixture , ground pecans , and mini chocolate morsels
8. Pour into pans and bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes , or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
9. Let cool in pans for 15 minutes
10. Remove from pans , and cool completely on wire racks

title: halibut orange
steps:
1. If halibut is frozen , thaw it
2. Wrap fish thawed or fresh in a paper towel for a few minutes to remove excess moisture
3. Place fish in a single layer in large , thickly buttered , microwave safe baking dish
4. Combine the remaining ingredients , except the parsley , and pour over the fish
5. Bake at high for 10 to 12 minutes , or until fish flakes easily
6. Let stand 5 minutes , then remove to a hot serving dish
7. Pour any sauce remaining in the dish over the fish
8. Sprinkle with minced parsley and serve

title: the ultimate summer sandwich
steps:
1. Spread 2 slices of the bread on 1 side with the pesto
2. Top with the taleggio cheese and scatter with the sun-dried tomatoes , followed by the arugula
3. Sandwich together with the remaining bread slices and squash down slightly
4. Wrap 2 slices of prosciutto around each sandwich
5. Soak each sandwich in the beaten egg for 3 minutes each side
6. Heat the olive oil in a large , non-stick frying pan over a medium-low heat , add the sandwiches to the hot pan and fry for 6 minutes , turning halfway , until the taleggio is melting and the prosciutto is golden
7. Transfer to kitchen paper to drain
8. Cut each sandwich in half and serve with plenty of napkins

title: crab cakes with orange mayonnaise
steps:
1. For the mayonnaise , combine all the mayonnaise ingredients in a non-reactive bowl and stir well
2. For the crab cakes , melt 1 teaspoons butter in a large skillet and add celery , shallots , chives and chilies and saute over medium heat for 2 minutes or until vegetables are limp
3. Remove vegetables to a non-reactive bowl and add the crab meat , mayonnaise , egg , breadcrumbs , lemon juice , salt and pepper
4. Mix gently but well
5. Melt remaining butter in same skillet
6. Shape crab mixture into 6 cakes and ease into skillet
7. Fry 3-5 minutes per side or until firm and golden brown
8. Serve cakes with the mayonnaise

title: citrus yummy
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan combine orange juice , grapefruit juice , honey , and cinnamon
2. Heat , stirring occasionally , just until warm
3. Remove cinnamon with slotted spoon
4. Discard
5. Serve warm
6. If desired , garnish with orange slices

title: jalapeno lime marinade
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Stir well
3. To marinate- put meat to be marinated in a large zip-loc bag
4. Pour marinade over meat and press to make sure all meat is covered

title: traditional bread  abm
steps:
1. Add ingredients in the order that your bread machine instructs
2. Choose light or medium crust and basic setting
3. At the end of the 3-hour cycle when the bread is finished baking , remove and let cool for 15 minutes

title: grandmas chocolate oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Place sugar , cocoa , milk , and butter in a saucepan , mix and bring to a boil
2. Boil for exactly 3 minutes
3. Remove from heat and mix in oats
4. If the mixture appears a little runny , mix in some extra oats
5. Spoon mixture onto wax paper and allow to harden

title: crock pot texas beef barbecue
steps:
1. Cut roast in half and place in crockpot
2. Combine the v8 juice , water , vinegar , ketchup , worcestershire sauce , brown sugar and seasonings and pour over roast
3. Cover and cook on low for 8-10 hours or until meat is tender
4. Remove meat and shred with forks and return to slow cooker and heat through
5. Spoon 1 / 2 cup meat mixture onto each roll

title: perfect spanish rice
steps:
1. In a medium skillet or frying pan , heat your oil and add onion
2. Once the onion starts to brown on the edges add the garlic
3. Stir with a wooden spoon for a few minutes and add the dry rice to the onions and garlic
4. Stir rice frequently till the rice takes on a golden-orange color
5. Be careful not to burn the onions and garlic
6. If your bulbs look like they are starting to get over done immediately add the canned tomatoes
7. While waiting for the rice to brown get a medium sized cooking pot
8. Open the canned tomatoes and with clean cooking shears cut the tomatoes till they are in small pieces
9. Pour the can of cut tomatoes in the pot with 1 can's worth of water
10. Toss in the chicken bouillon and you are now ready for the rice
11. Once your rice has developed a good color , transfer everything from the frying pan to the pot
12. Cover and bring to a hard boil
13. Once boiling reduce heat to a soft simmer for 15-20 minutes
14. After most of the liquid has been absorbed stir the rice and remove from heat
15. Allow rice to steam in the pot for 10-15 minutes
16. Add the green onion , stir then serve and enjoy

title: spiced persimmon bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease and flour a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan
3. Line pan with parchment paper if desired and grease parchment paper also
4. In a mixing bowl , sift together the flour , ground cinnamon , ground cloves , ground nutmeg , ground ginger , baking poder and baking soda
5. Set aside
6. In the bowl of an electric mixer , food processor or blender add eggs , butter , buttermilk , lemon juice , mashed persimmons , sugar and salt
7. Mix or blend until smooth
8. Slowly add reserved flour mixture and mix until well incorporated
9. By hand , fold in nuts
10. Pour batter into prepared loaf pan and bake in preheated oven for 75 to 85 minutes , or until toothpick inserted into the center of bread comes out clean
11. Transfer to wire rack and let cool in pan for 10 minutes before turning out onto rack to cool completely
12. Once cooled , dust top with confectioners' sugar if desired

title: anna maria s rouladen   rachael ray
steps:
1. In a skillet over medium heat , cook the bacon until just crispy
2. Remove and set aside
3. Add the butter and 1 tablespoon olive oil to the skillet with the bacon drippings , then saute the sliced mushrooms until they soften and begin to get crispy - cook them to your desired texture
4. Remove and set aside
5. Season the thin slices of meat with salt and pepper , then spread 1 tablespoon of dijon over each slice and sprinkle each with 1 tablespoon parsley
6. Near the bottom edge of each slice of meat , place 1 slice of cooked bacon and a pickle spear
7. Roll the slices of meat up around the fillings and secure closed with a toothpick or kitchen twine
8. Over medium-high heat in a skillet , heat the extra virgin olive oil then add the secured meat rolls and sear and cook the rolls on 4 sides , about 3 minutes per turn
9. Remove rolls and set aside
10. Add the 2 tablespoons butter to the skillet and let it melt , then sprinkle in the flour and stir it together with a whisk for 2 minutes
11. Add the chicken stock and whisk , scraping the sides and bottom of the pan to get the browned bits
12. Add the cooked mushrooms , season sauce with salt and pepper , stir in the sour cream until well incorporated , and remove from heat
13. Remove the toothpicks or twine securing the meat , transfer rolls to serving platter , pour the mushrooms and sauce over the rolls , garnish with chopped parsley , and serve

title: old bay potato   green bean salad
steps:
1. Place potatoes in medium saucepan
2. Add water to cover
3. Bring to boil
4. Cook 5-6 minutes or until potatoes are just tender
5. Add green beans
6. Cook additional 3 minutes
7. Drain
8. Mix potatoes , beans and remaining ingredients in large bowl until well blended
9. Cover
10. Refrigerate at least 1 hour
11. Stir before serving

title: cream puff filling
steps:
1. Whisk all ingredients together to dissolve cornstarch
2. Put into a saucepan over med-high heat , stirring constantly
3. When it starts to bubble over itself , remove from heat , continuing to stir and add vanilla to taste preference
4. Add more water if too thick
5. Refrigerate for a couple of hours , stir , and check consistency
6. If still too thick , add more water and stir again
7. Repeat , if necessary
8. Put in old-fashioned ketchup / mustard squeeze bottles and pipe chilled mixture inside puffs

title: tomatoes with cheese sauce over toast
steps:
1. Combine 1 / 2 cup flour , 1 / 4 teaspoons salt , and 1 / 4 teaspoons pepper
2. Cut each tomato into 3 thick slices
3. Dredge tomatoes in flour mixture
4. Heat vegetable oil in a heavy skillet
5. Add tomatoes , and fry slowly until browned , turning once
6. Remove fried tomatoes from the skillet , and keep warm
7. Melt butter in a heavy saucepan over low heat
8. Add 1 / 4 cup flour and mustard , stirring until smooth
9. Cook 1 minute , stirring constantly
10. Gradually add milk
11. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until thickened and bubbly
12. Stir in the cheese and next 2 ingredients
13. Arrange 2 slices of bread on each serving plate
14. Top bread with 2 tablespoons of cheese sauce and 2 slices of fried tomato
15. Spoon remaining sauce over sandwiches
16. If desired , garnish with paprika and parsley
17. Serve immediately
18. Yield: 6 servings

title: christmas strawberries
steps:
1. Blend together the gelatin and condensed milk
2. Add coconut and vanilla
3. Mix well and refrigerate until chilled
4. Roll into small balls and shape into strawberries
5. Roll in red sugar crystals
6. Dip fat end into green sugar crystals
7. Place an almond sliver into the fat end for a stem
8. To prevent hardening , store in an air tight container until ready to serve

title: avocado and crabmeat salad
steps:
1. Pick over crabmeat , removing any shell or cartilage
2. In a bowl , combine crabmeat , mayo , juice of 1 / 2 lemon , onion , garlic , parsley , oregano , salt & pepper
3. Mix lightly
4. Cut each avocado in half , peel and remove the pit
5. Cut each half into 6 to 8 wedges , squeezing remaining 1 / 2 lemon over slices to prevent discoloration
6. Place crabmeat in center of large serving platter
7. Arrange avocado and tomato wedges alternately around crabmeat
8. Sprinkle wedges lightly with salt
9. Serve

title: green string bean soup
steps:
1. Place lard , onion and flour in a pot , saute , add red pepper , water , chicken and cook
2. Cook cut up green beans , garlic , and onion in 4 ounces water separately for a half hour , then add to chicken pot and cook for 45 min or more
3. Add parsley and dill last

title: culinary quest chive corn muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees and spray 12 muffin-pan cups with nonstick cooking spray
2. Combine cornmeal , flour , baking powder , sugar and salt in a bowl and set aside
3. Combine milk , egg , chives , and butter in a bowl
4. Pour all at once into the cornmeal mixture , stirring with a fork only until blended
5. Spoon about 2 t
6. Of the batter into each muffin cup
7. Bake until lightly golden - about 20 minutes
8. Serve warm

title: cherry bomb
steps:
1. Pour cherry pucker over ice
2. Top with red bull
3. Enjoy !
4. Also good with watermelon pucker , or cherry vodka

title: french style basil chicken
steps:
1. Put the sage leaves in a pan along with the onions , the white wine and the chicken broth
2. Bring to a rolling boil , and continue to boil until the sauce is reduced to 3 / 4 cup , about 8-10 minutes
3. Remove from the heat and let cool
4. Lay the pieces of chicen in a flat pan or in an airtight plastic bag and use this cooled sauce to marinate the chicken covered overnight in the fridge , or at least 6 hours
5. The next day , preheat the oven to 325 , remove chicken from the marinade , reserving the marinade , and pat dry
6. Put chicken in oven for about 35-45 minutes or until the juices run clear
7. Meanwhile , strain the marinade , discarding the onions , and leaves
8. Put in a suacepan and bring to a rolling boil , and boil for about 10-15 minutes , or until reduced by 1 / 3
9. Take half of the cream , and blend it together with the basil leaves in the blender until very smooth , and a bit pasty
10. Add this to the sauce , along with the other half of the cream , and reduce heat to low and keep warm until the chicken in done
11. Serve this sauce over the chicken , with rice

title: earl grey shortbread cookies
steps:
1. In a food processor , pulse together the flour , tea , and salt , until the tea is just spotted throughout the flour
2. Add the confectioners' sugar , vanilla , and butter
3. Pulse together just until a dough is formed
4. Place dough on a sheet of plastic wrap , and roll into a log , about 2 1 / 2-inches in diameter
5. Tightly twist each end of wrap , and chill in refrigerator for 30 minutes
6. Preheat oven to 375f
7. Slice the log into 1 / 3-inch thick disks
8. Place on parchment or silpat lined baking sheets , 2 inches apart
9. Bake until the edges are just brown , about 12 minutes
10. Let cool on sheets for 5 minutes , then transfer to wire racks and cool to room temperature

title: sam s carrot cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. With an elecgric mixer , mix together cake mix , salad dressing , eggs , water and cinnamon
3. Slowly stir in carrots
4. Pour into 2 cake pans and bake 30-35 minutes
5. For icing blend together cream cheese , vanilla and powdered sugar

title: bbq d cheeseburger pizza
steps:
1. Preheat a fry pan until hot and add your ground beef , yellow mustard , garlic powder and dried parsley flakes
2. Cook until browned , drain and set aside to cool
3. In a bowl , combine the mayonnaise , french dressing and dill relish
4. Roll out your pizza so that it will fit on half of your bbq
5. Preheat your bbq with all grills on high for 15 minutes
6. Clean your grill with a wire brush
7. Take a paper towel and dip it in vegetable oil
8. Using a pair of tongs , wipe your oil over the entire grill
9. You want one side of your bbq on and one side off
10. So if you have a 4 burner grill , turn off the two burners on the igniter side
11. If you have a three burner grill , turn of the burner on the igniter side and the middle burner
12. If you have a 2 burner grill , turn off the 1 burner on the igniter side
13. Gently place your pizza dough on the side of the bbq where the burners are off and close the lid
14. You want to cook your pizza for about 10-15 minutes , until the dough has risen and there are nice grill marks on the bottom
15. Turn off the other side of the bbq and flip your dough over onto that side
16. Relight the igniter side of the bbq as above
17. Spread your bbq sauce over the pizza
18. Using a spoon , place dollops of your mayonnaise mixture all over the pizza
19. Spread the ground beef , tomato , onion , and dill pickle over the pizza
20. Top with the two cheeses
21. You'll want to assemble your pizza fairly quickly to get the lid back down
22. Cook for another 15-20 minutes , until your cheese is melted and the bottom of the crust is cooked through
23. Remove from the bbq and top with the shredded lettuce

title: arrachera beef marinade
steps:
1. Whisk together garlic , olive oil , tequila , lime juice , salt , cumin and black pepper
2. Place flank steak in zip lock bag and pour in marinade
3. Chill at least 1 hour
4. Turning often

title: ospidillo cafe shrimp cocktail sauce no  2
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving
2. Add tabasco only if you want a hot cocktail sauce
3. As for the chili sauce , i prefer bellview brand but heinz brand works well in this blend too
4. Also , be careful to not use the so-called "horseradish sauce" which includes other ingredients

title: flour frosting  red velvet cake frosting
steps:
1. Whisk together the flour , sugar and salt in a saucepan until combined
2. Add the milk and cook over medium heat until it barely simmers , whisking constantly
3. It will thicken slightly
4. Pour mixture into the bowl of a stand mixer and mix on high until the outside of the bowl is cool to the touch
5. Reduce the speed to low and add the butter
6. Once the butter is incorporated , turn the mixer up to medium-high speed and whip until the frosting is light and fluffy , scraping down as needed
7. If you are tinting your frosting , add the coloring and continue to whip until the color is evenly distributed
8. Use immediately to frost a two-layer cake , or 24 cupcakes

title: japanese yuzu and ginger cocktail
steps:
1. Combine gin , yuzu juice and simple syrup in a cocktail shaker
2. Shake shake shakeshake shake shakeshake (pour into a glass filled with ice , garnish with thinly sliced ginger root and mint leaves
3. Combine all ingredients in a small , heavy saucepan over medium heat
4. Stir constantly for 3 minutes to dissolve honey in the water
5. Continue cooking over medium heat for another 5 minutes or until a syrup-like texture is achieved
6. Pour the syrup into a small glass bowl and allow to cool slightly before use
7. When using a cocktail shaker it is helpful to use the syrup while it is still slightly warm , stirring it with the cocktail ingredients to ensure it is well combined before adding ice
8. )

title: rigatoni primavera
steps:
1. Simmer peas for 3 minutes in boiling water and drain
2. Cook pasta in slightly salted water until it is al dente
3. While pasta is cooking , heat 3 t oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
4. Saut garlic , scallion , carrot , and zucchini for about 5 minutes until soft but not mushy
5. Add tomato and cook another 2 minutes
6. Combine vegetable mixture , peas , and pasta
7. Serve immediately , topped with parmesan cheese

title: seasoned bread crumbs
steps:
1. If using fresh baguette , place slices on a cookie sheet in a preheated 400 degree fahrenheit oven for about 10-12 minutes
2. Let cool slightly and cut into cubes
3. Place cubes of stale or toasted baguette in a blender
4. Add herbs , salt and pepper and process for 15-20 seconds , or until the mixture is ground into fine crumbs

title: oriental roasted stuffed chicken
steps:
1. Soak the mushroom slices in water till they soften
2. Keep the soaking liquid aside
3. Loosen skin of chicken
4. Rub the marinade under the skin , in the cavity and over the skin
5. Do keep a little bit of marinade aside for the gravy
6. Tuck the sliced mushrooms under the skin of the chicken
7. Heat oven to 200c
8. Roast chicken in a large roasting tin , loosely covered with foil for 30 minutes
9. Turn heat down to 150c , add shallots and garlic , and roast uncovered for 20 minutes
10. Pierce with a skewer , if the juice runs clear , the chicken is ready
11. To make the gravy: pour out excess oil from the roasting tin , add a cup or so of mushroom water , and leftover marinade to the pan
12. Heat through on top of the stove
13. Taste to adjust seasoning
14. Place the chicken on a pretty plate , and garnish with the baby pak choy

title: banana bread cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Beat butter , sugar , baking soda and salt in a large bowl with mixer on medium speed or until fluffy
3. Beat in eggs , banana and vanilla until well blended and banana is mashed
4. On low speed , gradually beat in flour in three additions until just blended
5. Stir in chocolate and nuts
6. Drop rounded tablespoons of dough 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheets
7. Bake 10 - 12 minutes until golden brown
8. Remove to rack to cool completely
9. Store in airtight container

title: lemon basil potatoes
steps:
1. Place the potatoes , chicken stock , lemon juice , 1 tablespoon olive oil , salt , and pepper in a medium saucepan
2. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat
3. Reduce the heat and simmer until the potatoes are tender , about 20 to 25 minutes
4. Drain the potatoes and place in a serving bowl
5. Drizzle with the remaining olive oil
6. Add the lemon zest , salt and pepper to taste , and 3 tablespoons of the basil
7. Toss well and garnish with the remaining chopped basil

title: braune lebkuchen
steps:
1. Boil honey , sugar and butter together for five minutes
2. Cool
3. Beat egg and add to water
4. Sift dry ingredients together
5. Add sifted dry ingredients to honey mixture alternatively with egg / water mixture
6. Add nuts and citron last
7. Cover and chill at least overnight
8. If the dough is allowed to ripen in the refrigerator for several days before rolling out , the flavor and texture of the cookies are improved
9. Roll out to about 1 / 4-inch thickness and cut with fancy cookie cutters
10. Preheat oven to 350f
11. Bake for 15 or 20 minutes , depending on your oven
12. Ice with colored icing or a sugar glaze
13. To make glaze , mix powdered sugar and water together to make it the consistency of thin cream

title: salade de riz madame bequette french rice salad
steps:
1. Set aside 1 / 2 cup of the rice and a small amount of each veggie type to use as a garnish
2. Mix the dressing ingredients with a whisk , seasoning well to taste
3. Mix everything together lightly , tasting for seasonings and adding more of anything as needed
4. Place a small mound of the reserved white rice in the center and garnish with the reserved veggie pieces
5. Serve immediately

title: chocolate cream cheese frosting
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , beat the cream cheese and butter until smooth
2. Add powdered sugar , cocoa , salt , milk or whipping cream , and vanilla
3. Mix well
4. Spread over the cake or cupcakes
5. Store in the refrigerator

title: macadamia fudge torte
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Spray a 9" or 10" springform pan with pam
3. In a small saucepan , combine condensed milk and chocolate chips
4. Heat on med-low setting til chocolate is melted , stirring occasionally
5. In a large bowl , combine cake mix , cinnamon and oil until crumbly
6. Place pears in a blender and blend until smooth
7. In a large bowl , combine 2 1 / 2 cups of the cake mix mixture , pears and eggs
8. Beat with an electric mixer at low speed until moistened , then at med speed for 2 minutes
9. Spread batter evenly in prepared pan
10. Drop chocolate chip mixture by spoonfuls over the batter
11. Stir nuts and water into remaining cake mix mixture blending well , and sprinkle over batter
12. Bake 45-50 minutes or until top springs back lightly when touched in center
13. Cool 10 minutes
14. Remove side of pan and cool
15. Combine butterscotch topping and milk in saucepan over med-low heat heat for 3-4 minutes or until well blended , stirring occasionally
16. To serve , spoon about 2 tablespoons of warm sauce on to plate and top with wedge of torte

title: five minute spicy marinara
steps:
1. Add olive oil to medium saucepan over moderate heat
2. Add garlic and crushed pepper to the heated olive oil
3. When pepper snaps and garlic sizzles , stir in crushed tomatoes
4. Season sauce with salt , pepper , and italian seasoning
5. Cook for five minutes and stir in parsley
6. Serve

title: eggnog pumpkin bread
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar until fluffy
2. Add eggs and blend well
3. Add eggnog and pumpkin mix completely
4. Combine all dry ingredients and mix well with wet ingredients until well blended
5. Pour into two 9" greased loaf pans
6. Bake at 350 for 45 min or until tooth pick comes out clean

title: lemon bread pudding with lemon sauce
steps:
1. Toss bread and raisins in an ungreased 1 1 / 2 quart baking dish
2. In a saucepan , combine milk , sugar , butter and salt
3. Cook and stir until butter melts
4. Remove from heat
5. Whisk eggs and vanilla in a small bowl
6. Gradually stir in a small amount of the hot mixture
7. Return all to the pan and mix well
8. Pour over bread and raisins
9. Set the dish in a larger baking pan
10. Add 1 inch of hot water and bake uncovered for 50-60 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean
11. For sauce , combine the sugar and cornstarch in saucepan
12. Stir in water until smooth
13. Bring to a boil over medium heat
14. Boil for 1-2 minutes , stirring constantly
15. Remove from the heat
16. Stir in lemon juice , zest and butter until butter melts
17. Serve over warm or cold pudding
18. Refrigerate leftovers

title: sauteed kale with lemon
steps:
1. In a large pot , bring 1 inch of water to a boil
2. Add kale and salt
3. Cover and cook , stirring once , for 5 minutes or until crisp-tender
4. Drain
5. Return kale to pot
6. Drizzle with olive oil
7. Reheat
8. Add lemon juice , red pepper flakes and parmesan cheese
9. Toss and serve

title: christina s guacamole
steps:
1. Halve an pit avocados
2. Scoop out avocados w / tablespoon into bowl
3. Mash until soft but still chunky
4. Add everything else
5. Mix
6. Serve chilled or at room temperature

title: broccoli and feta cheese salad
steps:
1. Loosely mound broccoli on a steamer rack over 1 inch of boiling water in a 2-3 quart pan
2. Cover and steam over high heat until broccoli is barely tender when pierced , about 5 minutes
3. Rinse broccoli with cold water , drain well , and pat dry with paper towels
4. While broccoli is cooking , prepare dressing: in a large bowl , combine olive oil , lemon juice , chives , garlic and mustard
5. Whisk to blend well
6. Season to taste with salt and pepper
7. Add broccoli , red pepper , and half of the cheese to dressing
8. Mix lightly to coat well with dressing
9. Sprinkle with sunflower kernels and remaining cheese and serve immediately

title: prevention magazines chicken burgers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f
2. Mix all ingredients together until just combined
3. Add black pepper to taste
4. Divide mixture to make 4 patties , and place on a greased baking sheet
5. Bake 12 to 15 minutes on each side , or until meat has reached 170f
6. Variation: if you prefer , fry the patties in canola oil , 8-10 minutes per side
7. Makes 4 servings

title: simple glazed pearl onions
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat
2. Add the onions and cook , stirring occasionally , until the onions begin to brown on all sides
3. About 10 - 12 minutes
4. Add the brown sugar and gently stir in the mustard to make a smooth coating over the onions
5. Add salt , pepper , and 1 tbsp parsley
6. Cook about 2 minutes longer
7. Place into a serving bowl and sprinkle with remaining 1 tbsp parsley for garnish

title: southwest chicken hors d oeuvres
steps:
1. Preheat oil in medium skillet on medium heat
2. Add the minced red pepper and green onion to oil and saute two minutes
3. Add diced chicken and toss together
4. Add the black beans , spinach , corn , jalapeno , cilantro , chili powder , and tabasco
5. Cook for about 5 minutes , stirring to blend all ingredients throughout the mixture
6. Remove from heat and add the cheese , stirring as the cheese melts
7. Salt to taste
8. Remove 30 unbroken tostitos scoops from the bag
9. Using a teaspoon , gently round the spoon with filling and scrape out onto the scoops
10. Arrange on a foil lined pan
11. Cover with foil , refrigerate
12. 10 minutes before serving , preheat oven to 450
13. Bake uncovered for 5 to 10 minutes , watching closely

title: ultimate rice pudding
steps:
1. In a saucepan heat water , milk , and salt
2. When liquid is almost boiling stir in rice and butter
3. Bring to boiling , immediately reduce heat and simmer , covered , over very low heat for 35-40 min until all the liquid is absorbed
4. Transfer rice into a large bowl
5. Scrape vanilla seeds into cream in saucepan and heat just until boiling
6. In a bowl whisk yolks and sugar and mix with heated cream
7. Cook over medium-low heat , stirring constantly , for 5-7 min , until mixture coats a metal spoon
8. Pour 1 cup of hot sauce into rice and stir to blend
9. Transfer remaining sauce to a bowl and refrigerate
10. Chil several hours and before serving , stir remaining sauce into rice

title: sweet potato bread  bread machine
steps:
1. Add the ingredients in the order listed
2. Set bread machine for "white bread" with desired crust
3. I use "light" or "medium
4. "

title: buckaroo chicken  green chilies and rice  rsc
steps:
1. 1
2. Spray a six cup casserole with butter flavored cooking spray and heat the oven to 350 degrees
3. 2
4. Mix the hidden valley original ranch seasoning mix , sour cream and milk
5. 2
6. Meanwhile , mince the shallot and add to the dressing mix
7. 3
8. Stir in the cooked rice , 1 / 2 cup cheddar / jack cheese , cubed chicken , bacon bits , baby carrots , green chilies and lemon zest
9. 4
10. Put the mixture in the casserole and top with the remaining 1 / 2 cup cheddar jack and 2 tablespoons shredded parmesan
11. 5
12. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes

title: peanut butter chip    chocolate chip pancakes
steps:
1. Preheat griddle
2. Combine flour , sugar , cinnamon , baking powder and salt in a large bowl
3. Mix together liquid ingredients and whisk into dry mixture until smooth
4. Fold in the peanut butter& chocolate chips
5. Pour 1 / 4 cup batter for each pancake onto hot greased griddle
6. Cook until the bubbles that form on top begin to pop , before flipping , then cook a minute or so more
7. Serve immediately topped with whipped butter& syrup

title: pancakes with lingonberries  sweden
steps:
1. Sift flour , sugar and salt together
2. Add eggs and milk gradually
3. Stir until thoroughly mixed
4. Let stand 1 to 2 hours
5. Heat a griddle , skillet or tempered swedish pancake pan
6. Brush well with butter
7. Spread hot cake batter thin
8. Brown on each side
9. Roll hot cakes
10. Serve with lingonberry preserves

title: ground beef in sour cream v 8 noodles
steps:
1. Saute onion in butter until tender
2. Add meat , brown lightly
3. Place noodles in a layer over meat
4. Combine tomato juice and seasonings
5. Pour over noodles
6. Bring to a boil
7. Cover
8. Simmer over low heat 30 minutes or until noodles are tender
9. Stir in sour cream and mushrooms
10. Bring to a boil
11. Serve hot

title: grilled belgian endive
steps:
1. Heat an outdoor grill or stove top grill pan over high heat
2. Trim the tough , woody bottom of the endive leaving just enough for the leaves to remain connected
3. Cut the endives in half , lengthwise
4. Combine the oil and 1 / 2 tablespoon fresh oregano
5. Brush the cut sides of the endive with the oil oregano mixture
6. Brush grill grates or grill pan lightly with olive oil
7. Grill the endives on the grill by placing them cut side down and cooking until the edges are browned and curled , about 3 - 4 minutes
8. Remove to serving dish and drizzle with balsamic vinegar , remaining oregano , salt and pepper

title: vegetable beef soup
steps:
1. Brown meat in small amount of oil
2. Remove and cook onions and celery till tender
3. Add all ingredients
4. Cook until carrots are tender at a low simmer
5. You can add cabbage or potatoes
6. Potatoes will thicken it like a stew
7. Add any diced potatoes at the same time as the rest of ingredients

title: limoncello vinaigrette
steps:
1. Whisk limoncello , lemon juice , zest , mustard and red-pepper in a small bowl
2. Whisk in oil and season to taste with salt
3. Pour into decorated bottle if giving as gift or can be used immediately

title: grilled shark in beer
steps:
1. Prepare marinade and marinate shark 30-40 minutes
2. Prepare sauce:
3. In a saucepan , combine 1 / 2 cup beer and stock
4. Over medium heat , deglaze and reduce to half
5. Add garlic , shallots and cream
6. Reduce by half again or to desired consistency
7. Reduce heat , add pine nuts and feta cheese
8. Stir in butter , season to taste
9. Remove fish from marinade and grill until cooked to preference
10. To serve , place 2 tablespoons sauce on each plate and place shark on the sauce
11. Garnish with chives and crumbled feta cheese if desired

title: rum and rhubarb compote
steps:
1. In an 8-cup microwaveable dish , combine rhubarb , sugar , 2 tbsp of the rum and orange rind
2. Cover and microwave on high for 5 to 6 minutes , stir gently once , cook until rhubarb is tender
3. Stir in remaining rum
4. Let cool
5. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: green pea and bacon salad
steps:
1. Place peas in a colander and run water over them until they aren't frozen anymore
2. Drain well
3. Crisp fry diced bacon and drain well
4. Finely chop onion
5. Mix pasta , onion , bacon and peas together in large bowl
6. Add salad dressing and sour cream to pasta and mix together well
7. Season to taste with salt , pepper and dill
8. Let sit for a few hours to blend the flavors

title: crock pot turkey joes
steps:
1. Brown turkey with onion , green pepper , celery and garlic
2. Drain
3. Combine remaining ingredients in crock pot
4. Mix well
5. Add turkey mixture and 1 cup water
6. Stir to combine
7. Cook on low for 6-8 hours , or high for 3-4 hours

title: chicken fried pork chops
steps:
1. Mix together flour , salt , mustard and garlic powder
2. Dredge pork chops in mixture
3. In skillet , brown chops on both sides
4. Place in crockpot
5. Combine soup and water and pour over chops
6. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours or until meat is tender
7. Pan juices can be thickened and served with the pork chops

title: homemade tomato juice  without tomatoes   low fat
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients well and then put juice in a pitcher with a sealable lid
2. Refrigerate

title: real custard sauce
steps:
1. Reserve 3 tablespoons of the milk
2. Place the remaining milk and vanilla pod in a saucepan
3. Bring almost to the boil
4. Remove from the heat and leave to stand for 15 minutes to allow the vanilla to infuse the milk
5. Place the egg yolks , sugar and reserved milk in a bowl
6. Beat until thick and creamy
7. Remove the vanilla pod from the milk and pour the milk on to the egg mixture
8. Strain the mixture into a heavy based saucepan and cook , stirring , until the custard thinly coats the back of a spoon and is about the thickness of single cream
9. Pour into a cold jug
10. Serve hot or cold
11. The sauce thickens on cooling

title: artichoke  chicken casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cook chicken , cool and shred
3. Saute mushrooms and green onions in butter
4. Sprinkle with garlic salt
5. In a bowl , combine chicken , artichokes , and mushrooms / onions
6. In another bowl , combine wine , salt , pepper , mayonnaise , sour cream , and parmesan cheese
7. Fold into the chicken mixture and sprinkle with parmesan cheese
8. Place mixture into a 2 quart casserole
9. Bake for 30 minutes

title: hearty banana and yogurt muffins
steps:
1. Stir together flour , soda and salt in large bowl , put aside
2. In a second bowl , cream together butter , sugar and egg
3. Mix in yogurt , applesauce , bananas , and other chopped fruit
4. Gently pour the flour mixture into the wet ingredients , and stir until moist
5. Do not overmix- lumps are a good thing !
6. Fill greased muffin pans pans 3 / 4 full and bake at 375f for 12-18 minutes
7. Other options are chocolate chips , raisins , or nuts
8. Be creative !

title: fruit sparkle sauce
steps:
1. Drain fruit cocktail , reserving syrup
2. In saucepan , combine sugar , cornstarch & salt
3. Blend in water , then add syrup & juice concentrate
4. Cook & stir until mixture thickens & boils
5. Add fruit , then chill
6. Stir in pecans before serving over ice cream

title: out of desperation    flour tortillas
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , thoroughly combine only 1 cup of flour with the salt and baking powder
2. Crumble in the margarine and mix well with your fingers , breaking up any large clumps
3. Add in the warm water and combine well
4. Do this for about 2 minutes until you have a nice ball of dough
5. Put the ball into the bowl and loosely cover with a damp paper towel
6. Place in refrigerator for 15 minutes
7. Lightly sprinkle some of the remaining 1 / 3 cup flour onto a cutting board
8. Use some of the flour to coat a rolling pin
9. Divide and roll the dough into approx 1" size balls
10. One at a time , place each ball onto the floured board
11. Begin to roll the dough ball into a very thin disc
12. Place each flattened ball onto a plate and cover with the damp paper towel
13. Heat a large , non-stick skillet over a medium-low flame
14. Dry fry one tortilla at a time
15. As each one gets lightly browned on both sides , remove to a clean plate and cover with a damp paper towel
16. Repeat until all the tortillas are fried up
17. Serve and enjoy

title: parmesan won ton crisps
steps:
1. Brush 2 baking sheets with butter
2. Cut won tons in half diagonally
3. Place in a single layer on baking sheets
4. Brush won tons with remaining butter
5. Sprinkle with cheese
6. Bake at 375 for 5 to 6 minutes or until golden

title: savory rice pilaf
steps:
1. In a large saucepan add butter and onion
2. Saute together until tender
3. Add chicken broth , mushrooms and peas
