4. Stir and bring to a boil
5. Stir in minute made rice , cover pan and remove from heat
6. Let stand 5 minutes
7. Stir with fork and serve

title: creamed cinnamon raisin nut bread abm
steps:
1. Add all ingredients , except raisins and nuts according to manufacturers recommendations
2. Add raisins and nuts when the machine"beeps" for add-ins

title: upside down date pudding
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , bring 1 1 / 2 cups water to a boil
2. Add 1 tablespoon butter and 1 1 / 2 cups brown sugar and stir until sugar is dissolved
3. Set aside
4. Put the dates in a small bowl
5. Top with 1 cup boiling water and set aside
6. In another small bowl blend 1 / 2 cup brown sugar , 2 tablespoons butter and egg
7. Beat well
8. In another bowl , sift together flour , baking soda , baking powder , salt , cinnamon , and nutmeg
9. Add to egg / sugar mixture alternately with cooled date mixture
10. Pour batter into an 8x12x2 inch baking dish
11. Pour brown sugar sauce evenly over batter
12. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes
13. Cut into squares and invert to serve
14. Top each serving with whipped cream

title: layered fiesta casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Brown meat with peppers in a large skillet
3. Drain
4. Return meat mixture to the pan and stir in salsa , tomatoes and corn
5. Bring to a boil
6. Spoon 1 cup of the meat mixture onto the bottom a a 13x9-inch" pan , top with 6 tortillas , overlapping as necessary
7. Spoon half of the remaining meat mixture over tortillas , sprinkle with half the cheese
8. Top with the remaining 6 tortillas and then the rest of the meat mixture
9. Cover it with foil
10. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through
11. Remove from the oven , uncover and sprinkle with the remaining cheese
12. Let stand 5 minutes or until cheese is melted

title: kalua pig crock pot
steps:
1. Put pork butt or shoulder in crock pot
2. Set to low
3. Add apple cider
4. Add liquid smoke
5. Cook 9-10 hours
6. Shred pork
7. Salt to taste

title: mocha cinnamon shake
steps:
1. Combine the gourmet coffee , ice cream , milk and crushed ice in a blender
2. Blend it until it is all combined , pour into two mugs and add cinnamon sticks

title: mushroom   veggie sausage lasagna
steps:
1. Boil water and make the pasta according to package directions
2. Cook with salt and olive oil to prevent sticking
3. When done , rinse with cold water and lay in separate strips on foil or plates
4. Preheat oven 350 degrees
5. Saute garlic , crumbled vegan sausage , and mushrooms in olive oil
6. Add tomato sauce to the mushrooms & sausage
7. Simmer on low
8. Add up to 1 / 2 cup water and wine to taste to make this more liquidy
9. In a separate medium mixing bowl , combine ricotta cheese and chopped green onion
10. Layer a 9x13x2 pan with 1 / 3 of sauce mixture
11. Lay 3 strips pasta on top
12. Spread 1 / 2 ricotta mixture over this
13. Repeat sauce , pasta , cheese layers until you run out
14. Top it off with pasta
15. Add any sauce that's left
16. Add shredded mozzarella cheese
17. Cover with foil
18. Bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes
19. Let stand 10 minutes before serving

title: gail s christmas cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar
2. Beat in eggs
3. Add sour cream and flavoring , mix well
4. Sift in dry ingredients
5. Refrigerate 8 hours or more
6. Roll thin
7. Cut with cookie cutters , making a hole for hanging
8. Bake at 350f until only slightly brown , about 7-10 minutes
9. Cool
10. Icing: whip egg white until stiff
11. Add sugar and lemon juice as needed
12. Ice cookies
13. Decorate and let dry
14. Put dental floss through hole and hang on tree

title: flavorful beef stir fry
steps:
1. Combine beef and marinade in zipper-type plastic bag
2. Marinate in refrigerator at least 3 hours
3. Heat 2 t oil in wok
4. Stir-fry / pan-fry the meat in 2 batches until cooked through
5. Remove meat to a warm dish
6. Add chopped vegetables and a bit of oil to wok
7. Stir-fry until crisp-tender
8. Return meat to wok
9. Add tofu if desired
10. Stir-fry until heated through
11. Add sauce
12. Cook to desired thickness
13. Serve with steamed jasmine rice , if desired

title: pasta with peanut sauce
steps:
1. Stir sauce ingredients in large bowl
2. Add cole slaw mix and cooked drained pasta
3. Stir to mix

title: orange almond cake
steps:
1. Mix first 5 ingredients with mixer for 3 minutes
2. Pour batter into greased cake pan
3. I use a 10 inch diameter silicone cake pan and make it in one layer
4. Sprinkle top of batter with sliced almonds
5. Bake at 350 degrees until done , about 40 minutes

title: chicken  artichoke   spinach casserole
steps:
1. 1) squeeze spinach in cheesecloth to remove excess water and place in 9" x 9" casserole dish
2. 2) dust chicken tenderloins with tony catchere's seasoning and place atop spinach
3. 3) combine mayo , artichokes , parmesan , garlic , and blend well
4. 4) spread mixture over chicken
5. 5) top with pecan crumbs
6. 6) bake at 350 degrees for about 30-35 minutes
7. 7) serve with rice or a baked potato

title: dr  pepper three bean salad
steps:
1. Combine dressing ingredients and shake vigorously in a jar
2. Toss lightly with vegetables
3. Cover tightly and refrigerate about 24 hours , tossing occasionally
4. Serve on lettuce leaf or salad greens

title: boogers and slugs    halloween cake
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease and flour 9x13" cake pan
3. Wash and dice your green tomatoes
4. Place them in a strainer and let them drain while you mix the other ingredients together
5. At least 10 to 15 minutes
6. Cream butter or margarine with the granulated sugar until light
7. Add eggs one at a time until throughtly mixed and fluffy
8. Mix all dry ingredients together
9. Then toss in the raisins and nuts to coat them
10. Slowly incorporate the dry ingredients to the creamed mixture , then add the chopped tomatoes and mix well
11. Pour batter into the greased and floured baking pan
12. Bake at 350f for about 40 to 45 minutes
13. Check with a toothpick or spaghetti stick for doneness at 40 minutes
14. When stick comes out clean , remove from oven and allow to cool on a rack
15. The boogers will be visible
16. Frost with your favorite frosting

title: s more brownies
steps:
1. With rack in the center of oven , preheat oven to 325^f
2. Butter sides of a 9 inch square cake pan with 2 inch sides
3. Fold 18 x 12 inch piece of foil in half crosswise
4. Line pan with foil , allowing to extend over two of the sides
5. Butter foil
6. Blend graham crackers , sugar and butter in food processor to form moist crumbs
7. Press crumbs evenly into bottom of prepared pan
8. Bake until light golden brown , about 7 minutes
9. Cool crust on wire rack
10. For the brownies: melt 8 oz milk chocolate and 6 tablespoons butter in heavy medium saucepan over very low heat , stirring until smooth
11. Cool mixture to room temperature
12. Sift flour and salt into small bowl until well blended
13. Whisk in melted chocolate / butter mixture
14. Gently fold in dry ingredients
15. Mix in 4 oz
16. Chopped chocolate and spread batter over crust
17. Bake until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean , about 23 minutes
18. Place marshmallows over hot brownies , spacing evenly cover tightly with foil and let stand 15 minutes
19. Remove foil cover from pan
20. Using wet fingers , press marshmallows together to fill in any uncovered spaces
21. Sprinkle grated chocolate over
22. Cool completely on rack
23. Lift brownies from pan using foil sides as aid
24. Cut into squares
25. Can be made 1 day ahead
26. Store in airtight container at room temperature

title: vegetarian noodle casserole
steps:
1. Cook the noodles until just tender by following the package directions
2. Drain and transfer noodles to a large bowl
3. In a large skillet , melt the butter over medium heat
4. Add in the onion and next 4 ingredients
5. Stir / saute for about 8 minutes or until the vegetables are softened
6. Reduce heat to low
7. Add in the milk , cheese , salt , and pepper
8. Stir until the cheese melts
9. Pour mixture over the noodles
10. Toss until well blended
11. Transfer mixture to a 2 quart casserole that has been lightly coated with cooking spray
12. Cover and bake in a 350 oven for 15 minutes
13. In a small mixing bowl , mix together the bread crumbs and melted butter , toss to combine
14. Distribute evenly over the top of the casserole
15. Bake uncovered for 15-20 minutes or until the top of casserole is slightly crusty

title: island cilantro pesto
steps:
1. Place first eight ingredients in food processor
2. Process about 1 minute till almost smooth but not pureed
3. Leave some texture
4. Drizzle in the olive oil while processing
5. If too thick add water or coconut milk , a tbsp at a time
6. Chill at least 3-hours
7. Flavors develop best when chilled overnight
8. Thin with a little water or coconut milk if necessary

title: sweet dough
steps:
1. Scald milk and stir in sugar , salt and shortening
2. Cool to lukewarm
3. Dissolve yeast in very warm water
4. Stir until dissolved , then stir into the lukewarm milk mixture
5. Add beaten eggs and 3 cups flour
6. Beat until smooth and stir in an additional 2 cups flour
7. Turn dough out onto lightly floured board and knead until smooth and elastic
8. Place in a greased bowl and brush top with soft shortening
9. Cover and let rise in a warm place , free from draft , until double in bulk
10. Punch down and turn out onto lightly floured board
11. Use as desired to make any of the following sweet breads

title: nigella lawson s tagliata for two
steps:
1. Heat a grill pan , or cast-iron or heavy non-stick frying pan
2. In a small dish that can take the steak snugly later , combine the extra-virgin olive oil , red pepper flakes , dried oregano , salt , and red wine vinegar
3. Oil the steak lightly and put it in the hot pan and cook for 2 minutes on each side , then remove it to the dish of spicy marinade and sit the cooked steak for 2 minutes a side in the dish
4. Your steak will be rare , but that's the way it's meant to be
5. Remove the steeped steak to a board , ready for slicing , and while it sits there , arrange the cherry tomatoes , cut-side down , in the marinade dish
6. Cut the steak into thin slices on the diagonal and arrange on a serving dish or 2 dinner plates
7. Smoosh the tomatoes around in the marinade , then pour them , and the marinade , over the ribbons of meat
8. Add a few leaves of fresh oregano , if you can get them , and serve immediately

title: pumpkin   chive damper
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 220
2. C
3. Sift flour into a bowl , add butter & rub in using finger
4. Blend in pumpkin , cheese , chives & seasonings
5. Add combined egg & milk , mix quickly to a soft dough
6. Turn onto a lightly floured surface & knead lightly , form into a round
7. Place on a lightly greased baking tray and brush with a little milk , sprinkle with extra cheese
8. Bake for 10 mins then reduce heat to 180
9. C , bake for a further 15-20 mins or until damper sound hollow when tapped
10. Serve warm & buttered

title: whole wheat oatmeal banana pankakes
steps:
1. Dry: blend 1 / 2 cup oats on hi until they reach a powdery consistency
2. Put blended oats into a bowl with remaining oats and set aside
3. Blend the remainder of dry ingredients until thoroughly mixed
4. Add to oats
5. Wet: blend banana , milk , eggs , vanilla , and butter on lo until smooth
6. Combine: pour wet ingredients over dry ingredients , and stir until just mixed
7. Do not over mix
8. Cook: pour onto hot waffle iron and serve immediately
9. Or , place baked waffles into a 200 degree oven until all waffles are done

title: 48 hour marinated shrimp
steps:
1. Bring 7 1 / 2 cups water to a rolling boil
2. Add the shrimp , and cook 2 to 3 minutes or until shrimp turn pink
3. Do not overcook
4. Drain and rinse with cold water
5. Ice the shrimp to cool , then peel and if desired , devein
6. Layer the shrimp , red onion slices and bell pepper slices in an airtight container
7. Whisk together vegetable oil and next 9 ingredients
8. Pour over shrimp
9. Cover and chill 48 hours , stirring occasionally
10. Stir in 1 / 2 cup chopped basil 1 hour before serving

title: bittman cabbage salad
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine mustard , vinegar , sugar , & oil
2. In a large bowl , combine cabbage , peppers , scallions & parsley
3. Add dressing to veggies & toss well to combine
4. Season with salt & pepper to taste

title: easy honey glazed baby carrots
steps:
1. In a microwave-safe dish , combine all ingredients
2. Cover and cook on high 10-12 minutes , stirring once , until tender

title: chilli spare ribs
steps:
1. Place the pork in a large pot with water to cover
2. Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes
3. Drain well
4. Place all the remaining ingredients and the pork ribs in a wok
5. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes
6. Drain , reserving 1 cup liquid
7. Heat a clean wok and sear the pork until browned
8. Add the reserved liquid and cook over medium until it glazes
9. Chop the pork into bite size pieces and serve

title: banana sour cream cake with cream cheese frosting
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Grease and flour 13 x 9-inch baking pan
3. Set aside
4. Beat cake mix , eggs , bananas , sour cream and oil in a large bowl with electric mixer on low speed just until moistened , stopping frequently to scrape bottom and side of bowl
5. Beat on medium speed for 2 minutes
6. Pour batter into prepared pan
7. Bake for 35 minutes or until wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
8. Cool completely in pan on wire rack
9. Beat cream cheese and butter in large bowl with electric mixer on medium speed until well blended
10. Gradually add powdered sugar , beating after each addition until well blended
11. Remove cake from pan , cut crosswise in half
12. Place one cake half , top-side down , on large serving plate
13. Spread top with frosting
14. Top with remaining cake half , top-side up
15. Frost top and sides of cake with remaining frosting
16. Carefully press walnuts into frosting on side of cake
17. Store any leftovers in refrigerator
18. This helps to set the crumbs on the cut edges of the cake layers so they don't pull up into the frosting
19. Don't worry if the frosting doesn't look perfect on the sides of the cake
20. The walnuts will cover any imperfections

title: fresh strawberry cobbler cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Rinse and hull berries
3. Place berries in a 9 square pan and set aside
4. Combine flour , 1 / 2 cup sugar , baking powder and salt in a large bowl
5. Use a pastry blender or two knives to cut in margarine until coarse crumbs form
6. Stir in milk
7. Spoon the mixture over the berries
8. Combine the remaining 3 / 4 cup sugar and cornstarch in a large bowl
9. Stir in water until sugar mixture dissolves
10. Pour over berry mixture
11. Bake 35-40 minutes or until lightly browned
12. Serve warm or cool , garnished with additional berries

title: jewish apple cake
steps:
1. Filling: mix apple pieces , sugar and cinnamon
2. Cake: add wet ingredients
3. Add dry ingredients to wet
4. Batter will be thick
5. Grease and flour a 10 inch tube pan add half the batter to pan
6. Add half the apples
7. Add the other half of batter and top with the apples
8. Bake at 350f for 1 hours

title: cebuano lumpia
steps:
1. Brown ground pork and drain
2. Add all ingredients diced as fine as you can and toss on low heat for 10 minutes or until vegetables are al dente
3. Place in a bowl and allow to cool
4. The trick to rolling a proper lumpia is to put about a tablespoon of the meat vegetable mixture apx 1 / 4" from the bottom of the lumpia wrapper
5. Flip that 1 / 4" over the top of the mix and tuck it underneath and make it tight
6. Roll it like a cigar for 1 roll and then tuck in the sides like a burrito and continue rolling until the last roll
7. Moisten the last 1 / 4" with water to seal it like an envelope
8. Once you get to this stage you can deep fry , refrigerate , or freeze the lupia
9. Regardless when you do fry them fry until the outside is very light brown and place on a plate with a paper towel to dry excess oil
10. Serve with a sweet and sour sauce

title: empanadas  beef turnovers
steps:
1. For the dough: heat 1 cup water and lard together in a medium saucepan over medium heat until the liquid is warm and the lard has melted
2. Meanwhile , mix together flour and salt in a large mixing bowl
3. Make a well in the center of the flour
4. Put paprika in well , then add a little of the warm liquid and stir with your finger
5. Pour in remaining liquid while using your hand to work the flour into the liquid
6. Continue to work dry ingredients into wet ingredients with your hands to form a wet , oily dough
7. Wrap dough in plastic and refrigerate until dough is chilled , about 2 hours
8. For the filling: heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat
9. Add onions , bell peppers , bouillon cube , paprika , red pepper flakes , white pepper , and cumin , and cook until onions are soft , about 7 minutes
10. Add beef , season to taste with salt , and cook , stirring , until meat is browned , about 5 minutes
11. Transfer filling to a large bowl and set aside to cool
12. Once filling has cooled , add potatoes , raisins , olives , scallions , and egg
13. Adjust seasonings
14. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside
15. Preheat oven to 400
16. Tear off pieces of dough and , with your hands , roll into about 12 golf-size balls
17. Using a rolling pin , roll out dough balls on a lightly floured surface into 5'' circles
18. To assemble empanadas , place about 3 tablespoons of filling in the center of each dough circle
19. Fold over and press the edges firmly to seal , starting from the middle and working out to the edges
20. Curve the ends of the empanada to form a crescent
21. To make the ''rope'' around edge , pinch 1 / 2'' of one corner edge between your thumb and index finger and fold edge over onto itself
22. Pinch and pull another 1 / 2'' of the edge and fold again , making a rough triangle over the first fold
23. Repeat this folding around edge , pressing each fold tight
24. Place empanadas on a cookie sheet and bake until golden brown , 15-20 minutes

title: fish and chip bake with spinach and sour cream
steps:
1. Prepare potatoes according to package directions , except reduce water by 1 / 4 cup
2. Stir in well-drained spinach , sour cream , and pepper
3. Turn into a 10x6x2-inch baking dish
4. Skin fish fillets
5. Dip one side of each fillet in milk , then in crushed stuffing mix
6. Fold fillets in half , coating side out
7. Place atop potato mixture
8. Drizzle with melted butter
9. Bake , uncovered , at 350 degrees till fish flakes easily when tested with a fork , 30 to 35 minutes
10. Serve with lemon slices
11. Makes 4 or 5 servings

title: chicken tetrazzini  freezer friendly
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti as directed on package
2. Drain
3. Heat butter in a large skillet until melted
4. Stir in flour , salt , and pepper
5. Stir constantly until smooth and bubbly
6. Remove from heat
7. Stir in chicken broth and half & half
8. Heat until boiling , stirring constantly
9. Boil and stir 1 minute
10. Stir in spaghetti , chicken , & grated parmesan cheese
11. Pour into a greased 9x13-inch pan
12. Top with fresh shredded parmesan cheese
13. To serve immediately: bake at 350f for about 30 minutes until bubbly
14. Or to freeze for another day: after topping with the parmesan cheese , do not bake right away
15. Cover dish with plastic wrap and freeze
16. Thaw completely and bake as directed on serving day

title: coffee lovers muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven 400f , and butter muffin pan
2. Put the coffee , sugar , eggs and yogurt into a bowl and mix well
3. Add the flour and baking powder until just combined
4. Spoon into tins and bake for 15-20 minutes

title: white bean sauce with pasta
steps:
1. Cook pasta until al dente , while making sauce
2. Heat olive oil in frying pan , and add pepper flakes , cook 1 minute
3. Add onion , red pepper , celery , and garlic , and cook until soft
4. Increase heat and stir in tomato , beans , and black pepper
5. Add bean liquid or stock and parsley , heat until thickened
6. Take half of the bean mixture and blend well in food processor
7. Return to pan , and heat until thickened , about 5 minutes
8. Transfer pasta to large bowl and pour sauce on top
9. Sprinkle with grated cheese
10. Serve with garlic bread and tossed salad

title: candied sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Peel potatoes and cut into chunks
2. Place potatoes in 13x9 baking pan
3. In lg saucepan combine remaining ingredients
4. Bring to a boil
5. Boil for 2 minutes
6. Pour over potatoes
7. Cover and bake for 45 minutes

title: golden fried cornbread
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine all ingredients , mixing well
2. In a large cast iron skillet , heat 1 / 2 cup shortening over medium heat until hot but not smoking
3. When oil is hot , add batter 1 / 3 cup at a time , spread batter until about 1 / 4 inch thick
4. Fry until batter starts to bubble and edges look slightly dry , lift edge a bit to see if golden
5. If it is , turn and brown other side
6. After removing from skillet , butter and keep warm
7. Repeat from step 3 with remaining batter

title: bacon wrapped scallops
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400-degrees f
2. Grease a pie dish and set aside
3. In a pie dish combine first 5 ingredients
4. In a seperate pie dish or bowl mix egg and milk together
5. In a third pie dish place bread crumbs
6. If set up assembly line fashion - this makes a really easy process to get the scallops ready - i use disposable pie tins for this
7. Roll scallops in flour mixture and then dip in milk / egg mixture and finally into the breadcrumbs
8. Wrap each scallops with bacon , securing with toothpick and then transfer to prepared greased pie dish
9. Bake for 20-25 minutes
10. Serve warm with tartar sauce or cocktail sauce

title: caramel iced coffee at home
steps:
1. I use recipe #312986 for my syrup
2. Combine the syrup , cream , and milk in a tall glass and mix well
3. Add ice
4. Add coffee and stir and enjoy

title: mocha cream and cookies
steps:
1. Dissolve coffee in 100ml boiling water , cool
2. Process the cookies to medium crumbs
3. Beat cream to soft peaks , fold through the liqueur
4. Divide 1 / 3 of the cream between 4 dessert glasses
5. Add half the crumbs
6. Drizzle with half the coffee
7. Repeat the layers , finishing with cream
8. Chill for at least 3 hours to allow the cookies to soften
9. Serve garnished with the grated chocolate

title: wild rice quinoa garden salad
steps:
1. Combine 1 cup water and wild rice in a medium saucepan
2. Bring to a boil
3. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer for 1 hour or until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed
4. Combine 2 cups water and quinoa in a medium saucepan / bring to a boil
5. Cover , reduce heat and simmer 20 minute or until liquid is absorbed
6. Remove from heat
7. Fluff with a fork
8. Place quinoa and wild rice in a large bowl
9. Stir in green onions , bell pepper and cucumber
10. Combine oil and remaining ingredients in a small bowl , stirring with a whisk
11. Drizzle over quinoa mixture
12. Toss gently to coat
13. Cover and chill at least 2 hours

title: banana sundae wraps with custard sauce
steps:
1. Prepare custard sauce: in a medium heavy saucepan , bring milk to a simmer
2. Meanwhile , in a medium bowl , whisk together egg , sugar , cornstarch and salt until pale yellow
3. Gradually whisk hot milk into egg mixture , return to saucepan
4. Cook , stirring constantly , over low heat until custard coats the back of a spoon
5. Transfer to a clean bowl , cool to room temperature and refrigerate until chilled
6. Prepare egg rolls: peel bananas
7. Quarter lengthwise
8. Lay egg roll wrappers on a flat surface with point facing you
9. Arrange 2 banana quarters on center of wrapper
10. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 tablespoon chocolate chips and 1 large marshmallow that's been halved or 4 mini marshmallows
11. Sprinkle with cinnamon
12. Fold and seal as directed on egg roll package
13. Repeat with remaining wrappers
14. In a deep skillet , pour oil 2 inches deep
15. Heat to 365 degrees f
16. Fry banana rolls one at a time , for 1 to 1 1 / 2 minutes or until deep golden brown
17. Drain well on paper towels
18. Keep warm in a 250 degree f oven until all are fried
19. Serve warm with custard sauce and a scoop of vanilla ice cream , if desired

title: citrus morning sunrise
steps:
1. In a blender , combine orange , grapefruit and lemon juices
2. Add in the pineapple , banana and mango
3. Puree until fruit is blended
4. Add in yogurt and blend until smooth
5. Stir in carrot juice and cranberry juice
6. Enjoy !

title: s mores brownie bars
steps:
1. Place crackers in greased 13x9 baking pan
2. Prepare brownie mix as instructions say
3. Spread over crackers
4. Bake at 350 for 25 minutes
5. Sprinkle with marshmallows
6. Chocolate chips , and peanuts
7. Bake 5 minutes longer

title: favorite chocolate sheet cake
steps:
1. To make cake: preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. You will need a jellyroll pan or a smaller cookie sheet with a rim around all four sides
3. You will not need to grease the pan
4. Mix the flour and sugar for the cake in a large mixing bowl and set aside
5. In a saucepan bring the butter , vegetable oil , water and 4 tbs cocoa powder to a boil
6. Pour the boiling mixture over the flour and sugar and stir together
7. Add the eggs , vanilla , cinnamon , baking soda and buttermilk and stir to mix well
8. Pour in the baking sheet and bake at 375 degrees for 18-20 minutes
9. While cake is baking prepare the icing: bring butter , milk and cocoa powder to a boil stirring constantly and then remove from heat
10. Add the vanilla , nuts and box of powdered sugar and stir well
11. Spread icing over cake while the cake is still warm

title: thai meatballs with peanut sauce
steps:
1. Roll mince into small balls and coat lightly in flour
2. According to preference , deep or shallow fry meatballs until cooked through
3. Drain on absorbent paper and put aside
4. Drain most of the oil from pan in which meatballs were cooked
5. Add curry paste and cook for 1 minute
6. Add all other ingredients , except for meatballs and coriander , and bring to the boil
7. Add meatballs , lower heat , and simmer for 5-10 minutes , or until sauce has thickened
8. Sprinkle with coriander to serve

title: chicken   roasted red potatoes
steps:
1. Pour dressing over chicken in shallow dish
2. Refrigerate 30 minute to marinate
3. Heat oven to 400f
4. Cook bacon in large skillet on medium heat until crisp
5. Remove bacon from skillet , reserving 1 tablespoons drippings in skillet
6. Drain bacon on paper towels
7. Add potatoes and onions to reserved drippings
8. Cook 5 min
9. , stirring occasionally
10. Remove from heat
11. Crumble bacon
12. Add to potato mixture
13. Mix lightly
14. Spoon into 13x9-inch baking dish
15. Remove chicken from marinade
16. Discard marinade
17. Place chicken over potato mixture
18. Bake 55 minute to 1 hour or until potatoes are tender and chicken is done
19. Top with cheese and parsley

title: easy sesame chicken stir fry
steps:
1. Place the chicken cubes in a large bowl
2. Sprinkle cornstarch over the chicken
3. Using clean hand toss together to coat the chicken with the cornstarch until well coated
4. Heat 2 tablespoons in a wok over high heat
5. Add in half of the chicken , then sprinkle with about 1 / 2 teaspoon seasoned salt and black pepper
6. Stir-fry for about 5 minutes or until just cooked
7. Add in 1 tablespoon of soy sauce and continue cooking and tossing until coated with the sauce
8. Remove the wok from heat then drizzle about 1 teaspoon seasme oil over the cooked chicken
9. Toss until very well to combined
10. Place the chicken in a bowl
11. Heat the remaining 2 tablespoons vegetable oil in the wok
12. Repeat the process with remaining chicken , seasoned salt , soy sauce and sesame oil
13. Sprinkle lightly with sesame seeds , then chopped green onion

title: chicken provencale
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c
2. Place flour in a shallow bowl , season with salt and pepper and coat the chicken breasts and shake of excess and place on a plate
3. Melt butter in a frying pan over medium high heat and add the chicken breasts and cook for 2 to 3 minutes each side or until golden
4. Transfer to a 5cm deep x 20cm x 30cm oven proof baking dish
5. Reduce heat to medium low and add onion to pan and cook stirring occasionally for 5 minutes or until softened
6. Increase heat to medium high and add sherry and bring to the boil and boil for 1 minute
7. Add tomatoes and cook stirring occasionally for about 5 to 6 minutes or until boiling
8. Spoon tomato mixture over the chicken and cover
9. Bake for 30 minutes or until chicken is cooked through
10. Add olives if using in the last 5 minutes
11. Sprinkle with parsley and serve

title: strawberry corn flakes
steps:
1. First put your cereal in a microwave safe bowl
2. Now add the water and let is soak while you stir a little
3. Now add the 1 tbsp of your ice cream syrup
4. I assume it could be caramel or even chocolate just the same way
5. Now heat it all with a loose lid for about 20 to 30 seconds
6. Then take it out and as it cools mix and mush it together
7. Now you should be able to eat it with ice cream , plain , or however you like
8. You could chill it as well

title: golden pork chops
steps:
1. 1
2. Preheat oven to 300
3. Heat 2-3 teaspoons oil in dutch oven over medium to medium-high heat until shimmering
4. 2
5. Meanwhile , pat chops dry with paper towels , then season with salt and pepper
6. Place in hot oil and cook until pork chops release from pan and are golden
7. 3
8. Remove chops and sautee onions until softened
9. Add garlic and mushrooms and continue cooking until onions turn golden and mushrooms are cooked
10. 4
11. Mix in condensed soup and return chops , making sure to cover them completely
12. 5
13. Cover and cook for 2-3 hours
14. Meat should be fork tender
15. Continue cooking if it isn't
16. 6
17. Enjoy chops with mashed potatoes , everything topped with the mushrooms and gravy

title: spicy lemon ginger iced brew
steps:
1. Boil 4 cups of water in a nonreactive pot
2. Stir ginger into the boiling water , then reduce heat to low , cover and simmer for 10 minutes
3. Strain mixture through a cheesecloth lined sieve into a clean pitcher
4. Press on the ginger that is caught by the cheesecloth to extract as much liquid as possible
5. Stir honey into the ginger brew until it dissolves , then set mixture aside to cool
6. Stir lemon juice into ginger brew just before serving
7. Prepare tall glasses with ice and one slice of lemon
8. Pour chilled lemon ginger"tea" over the ice and serve

title: pineapple grilled pork chops
steps:
1. Mix together the drained pineapple juice , brown sugar , soy sauce , and garlic powder together in a large plastic zipper bag , and smush the bag a few times with your hands to mix the marinade and dissolve the sugar
2. Place the pork chops into the marinade , squeeze out any air in the bag , seal it , and refrigerate overnight
3. Reserve the pineapple rings
4. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat , and lightly oil the grate
5. Remove the chops from the marinade , shaking off excess , and grill until browned , the meat is no longer pink inside , and the meat shows good grill marks , 5 to 8 minutes per side
6. Brush several times with marinade and let the marinade cook onto the surface of the meat
7. Discard excess marinade
8. While the meat is grilling , place 4 pineapple rings onto the grill , and allow to cook until hot and the slices show grill marks
9. Serve the chops topped with the grilled pineapple rings

title: sarah bernhardt cakes  sarah bernhardt kager   danish
steps:
1. Cover a baking sheet with parchment paper or grease and flour it
2. Preheat oven to 350f
3. In a large bowl , whisk the egg white until foamy
4. Add the sugar , and beat until mixture holds soft peaks
5. Fold in the pulverized almonds , cornstarch , and almond extract
6. Spoon into 12 mounds evenly spaced on the prepared baking sheet , allowing plenty of space between them
7. Bake until top is dry and cakes are a creamy color , about 10 minutes
8. Remove from sheet and cool on rack
9. Melt 1 / 2 cup of the chocolate chips in a small bowl over hot water
10. Melt the butter in another pan
11. Whip the egg with the lemon rind , sugar , and vanilla until light and fluffy
12. Mix the cooled chocolate and butter together and add the egg mixture
13. When this has thickened , spread it over the base of the cakes , allowing the mixture to set
14. Melt the remaining chocolate and pour over the firm chocolate layer
15. Decorate each cake with an almond
16. Makes 12 cakes
17. The great scandinavian baking book-- beatrice ojakangas

title: chicken stir fry with cabbage
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine cornstarch and broth until smooth
2. Stir in the chutney , soy sauce , five spice powder and garlic
3. Set aside
4. In a large skillet or wok , saute chicken in 3 tsp sesame oil for 6-8 minutes or until no longer pink
5. Remove and set aside on a plate
6. In same skillet or wok , saute red pepper and snow peas in 2 tsp sesame oil for 2-3 minutes or until crisp-tender
7. Stir soy sauce mixture and add to skillet
8. Bring to a boil , cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
9. Add chicken back to skillet and heat through on low heat
10. Meanwhile in a large non-stick skillet coated with cooking spray , saute cabbage in remaining 2 tsp sesame oil for 5 minutes or until crisp tender
11. To serve place cabbage on plate and top with chicken mixture

title: gingered turkey burgers
steps:
1. Depending upon your cooking source preference: preheat broiler and coat a broiler pan with cooking spray , or get your grill up to your heat standards
2. In a large bowl , combine turkey , ginger , garlic , sage , thyme , salt and pepper
3. Shape mixture into 4 patties
4. Place on prepared broiler pan and broil 4 inches from heat about 6 minutes , or cook on your outdoor grill
5. Flip and broil or grill 5-6 minutes more , or until centers are no longer pink
6. Serve burgers on buns with any fixings you like

title: eggless apple cake
steps:
1. Grease and flour a 7 to 8 inch round cake tin
2. Cream the butter and sugar with the mixed spice
3. Combine with the other ingredients , mix lightly but thoroughly
4. Bake in a preheated moderate oven until cake in cooked in the center

title: grandma s lemon meringue pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. To make lemon filling: in a medium saucepan , whisk together 1 cup sugar , flour , cornstarch , and salt
3. Stir in water , lemon juice and lemon zest
4. Cook over medium-high heat , stirring frequently , until mixture comes to a boil
5. Stir in butter
6. Place egg yolks in a small bowl and gradually whisk in 1 / 2 cup of hot sugar mixture
7. Whisk egg yolk mixture back into remaining sugar mixture
8. Bring to a boil and continue to cook while stirring constantly until thick
9. Remove from heat
10. Pour filling into baked pastry shell
11. To make meringue: in a large glass or metal bowl , whip egg whites until foamy
12. Add sugar gradually , and continue to whip until stiff peaks form
13. Spread meringue over pie , sealing the edges at the crust
14. Bake in preheated oven for 10 minutes , or until meringue is golden brown

title: chili lime grilled salmon
steps:
1. Heat grill
2. In small bowl , combime all ingredients except salmon and lime wedges
3. Mix well
4. Spread mixture over salmon
5. Place salmon on grill , skin side down on a gas grill over medium heat or on a charcoal grill 4 to 6 inches from medium coals
6. Cook 15-18 minutes or until fish flakes easily with fork
7. Do not turn salmon
8. Serve salmon with lime wedges

title: arabic samboosak
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f
2. To make the pastry , combine flour , baking powder , sugar , and salt in bowl
3. Mix in oil , warm milk , and beaten eggs until a soft dough is formed
4. Cut the dough into small 2 inch balls
5. Cover and let rest for 15 minutes
6. Meanwhile prepare the filling by heating the oil in a large frypan
7. Add the chopped onions , and cook until they are soft
8. Stir the ground meat into the pan and add the cumin , salt , and pepper
9. Fry until well cooked
10. On a lightly floured work surface , roll out the pastry balls into 4-inch round circles
11. Place a teaspoon of filling in the center of a rolled-out pastry
12. Moisten the edges , fold , and press together to seal
13. You may optionally roll the edges inward for a decorative effect
14. Place on a greased baking sheet
15. Repeat the previous three steps for each pastry ball
16. Bake for about 15 minutes or until lightly browned
17. Serve warm

title: spicy dhal with tomatoes
steps:
1. Add water , thoor dhal , and turmeric to a medium saucepan
2. Bring to a boil
3. Turn heat down , cover pan , and simmer for about 30 minutes
4. Do not stir
5. If bubbles begin to spill over , remove cover until bubbles subside
6. While the dhal cooks , add cumin seeds , mustard seeds , and crushed red pepper to a heavy 3-quart saucepan , cover and cook over medium-high heat until mustard seeds begin to pop
7. Turn heat down to medium , add onion , garlic , and peppers , and saute until onion is soft
8. Add tomatoes and cook until they are soft
9. When dhal is completely tender , mash it and add it to the tomato mixture
10. Add salt and bring to a boil
11. Add more water if necessary
12. Consistency should be roughly that of thick soup
13. Simmer for 2 minutes
14. Remove from heat and granish with chopped cilantro
15. Serve over rice

title: cheesecake cake bundt
steps:
1. Thaw lemonade
2. Mix cake ingredients with electric mixer until moistened , then beat at high speed for 4 minutes
3. Pour into greased and floured bundt pan
4. Bake at 350 for 50-60 minutes
5. After 10 minutes remove from pan to rack
6. When cool drizzle the glaze over the top: make glaze by mixing all the glaze ingredients and beating until smooth !

title: chocolate croissant pudding   crock pot
steps:
1. Beat milk , eggs , sugar , cocoa , vanilla and salt in a medium bowl
2. Grease a 1-quart casserole
3. Cut the croissants into 1-inch pieces and layer half in the casserole along with the chocolate chips , and half the egg mixture
4. Repeat layers with remaining croissants and egg mixture
5. Add a rack to a 5-quart crock pot
6. Pour in 1 cup water
7. Place casserole on rack
8. Cover and cook on low 3 to 4 hours
9. Remove casserole from crock pot
10. Top each serving with 2 tablespoons whipped cream , if desired

title: mexican style fruit salad
steps:
1. Take the melons and cut them into slices , remove the rind
2. Slice the cuke into thickish slices
3. Dip each slice in the lime juice
4. Place on a serving tray
5. Sprinkle with the cayenne pepper
6. Sprinkle with a little salt , if desired
7. Chill until ready to serve

title: ginger chicken asparagus stir fry
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine the lemon juice , soy sauce , fresh ginger and garlic
2. Mix / whisk to combine
3. Toss the chicken pieces well with about 3 tablespoons of the lemon / soy mixture
4. Reserve the remaining mixture
5. Dissolve / whisk the cornstarch in chicken broth
6. Heat the oil in a wok or frying pan until hot
7. Add in mushrooms and chicken
8. Stir over high heat until chicken looses the pink colour
9. Add in asparagus and green onions , continue to stir over high heat until veggies at crisp-tender
10. Add / stir in broth / cornstarch mixture and reserved soy sauce mixture until thickened
11. Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds
12. Serve over rice or cooked pasta

title: cobb sandwich
steps:
1. Spread the blue cheese dressing on split rolls
2. Add grilled chicken breast and top with lettuce , tomato , avacado , onion and bacon
3. Top with other half of roll
4. Enjoy !

title: cinnamon cream cheese apples
steps:
1. Peel and core apples
2. Mix candies and water in a saucepan and cook until candies are dissolved
3. Add apples
4. Simmer , uncovered until tender , about 15 minutes , turning them over half way through the cooking process
5. Chill in syrup for several hours
6. In a small bowl , blend cream cheese , milk , lemon juice , dates , pineapple and nuts
7. Drain apples on rack
8. Stuff center of apples with cream cheese mixture
9. To serve , place an apple on a serving plate
10. Drizzle with the syrup

title: arroz con pollo
steps:
1. Mix together the adobo seasoning in a small bowl
2. Cut the onion , peppers , and garlic into a small dice and set aside
3. Trim the chicken of any excess fat and season with adobo seasoning
4. Heat the olive oil and the chili oil in a large pot over medium-high heat until very hot
5. Season the chicken with adobo
6. Save the leftovers in an airtight container
7. Place the chicken skin side down in the oil and saute until golden brown
8. Remove chicken to plate
9. Stir in sofrito and saute for 4-5 minutes
10. Add rice , chicken stock and beer and stir well
11. Add chicken chicken back into pot and stir well
12. Cover the pot and turn heat to low and simmer until the liquid is almost absorbed , about about 10 - 15 minutes
13. Add peas and continue to simmer unil peas are warmed
14. After rice is cooked and the peas are warm add the olives and stir well
15. Garnish with cilantro and serve with hot sauce and corn or flour tortillas on the side

title: lemon crumble bars 1968
steps:
1. Prepare the lemon pie filling according to the package direction
2. Remove from heat and let cool
3. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
4. Grease a 9 inch square pan or a 7 x 11 brownie pan
5. Sift the all purpose flour with the baking powder
6. Rub in the room temperature butter until crumbs are formed
7. Add the crushed soda cracker
8. Add the sugar and coconut
9. Spread half crumb mixture into pan
10. Press to form crust
11. Pour cooked cooled lemon pie filling over evenly
12. Sprinkle and pat down slightly the remainder of the crumbs
13. Bake 350 degrees , until golden brown about 12 to 16 minutes
14. Remove from oven to a rack
15. Must be cooled completely before cutting into squares
16. Can be frozen without any problems
17. Very delicate , can be cut into small squares while frozen

title: honey dump pork chops  oamc
steps:
1. In blender , blend all ingredients except chops thoroughly
2. Place pork chops and blended mixture in freezer bag
3. Seal and freeze flat
4. To serve: thaw completely
5. Dump chops and marinade in baking dish , bake at 350 degrees for 30 to 45 minutes , or until meat is 160 degrees in center

title: crispy baked potato fans
steps:
1. You can use one slice of bread in place of the bread crumbs
2. Chop up and place in food processor , pulse until you get fine crumbles
3. Bake on cookie sheet in 200 degree oven until dry , about 20 minutes
4. Let cool
5. Place bread crumbs in medium-sized bowl and add butter , cheeses , paprika , garlic powder , 1 / 4 teaspoons salt , and 1 / 4 teaspoons pepper
6. Mix well
7. Bread crumb mixture can be refrigerated for 2 days in zipper-lock bag
8. For the potato fans , heat oven to 450 degrees
9. After potatoes have been scrubbed , find flattest part of potato and cut skin off slightly so potato doesn't rock
10. Cut both ends off about 1 / 4" or so
11. Then proceed to fan potato , making 1 / 4" slices
12. Use something on either side of potato so that you don't cut all the way through
13. You should have a bit more than a 1 / 4" left at the bottom
14. Once all are cut , rinse through running water getting gently in-between the slices
15. Let drain and then place sliced-side down on microwavable plate
16. Microwave until slightly soft to touch , 6-12 minutes , flipping potatoes halfway through
17. Arrange potatoes , sliced-side up , on foil-lined baking sheet
18. Brush potatoes with olive oil all over and try to get in-between some of the slices , season with salt and pepper
19. Bake until skin is crisp and potatoes start to brown , about 25-30 minutes
20. Remove from oven and let sit for about 5 minutes
21. Carefully top potatoes with bread crumb mixture , pressing gently to adhere
22. Try to get a bit in-between slices , but don't push too hard or they will separate too much
23. Broil until bread crumbs are deep golden brown , about 3 minutes
24. Serve warm
25. The parmesan helps bind the bread crumbs

title: tsr version of tony roma s baby back ribs by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Combine all but ribs
2. Heat over high heat until boiling
3. Reduce heat , simmer 30-40 minutes until thick
4. Coat 4 pounds of baby back pork ribs , front and back , with bbq sauce
5. Wrap ribs in aluminum foil
6. Bake at 300 for 2 - 2 1 / 2 hours
7. Remove ribs from foil and smother with more sauce

title: french lemon tart   lightened up version
steps:
1. Using an electric mixer , beat eggs , egg whites and sugar for 4 minutes or until thick and creamy
2. Beat in lemon rind
3. Beating constantly , slowly drizzle in lemon juice and orange juice
4. Pour into baked pie shell and place on baking sheet
5. Bake in 350f oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until filling is slightly puffed , browned on top and barely set
6. Let cool completely
7. Just before serving sift the icing sugar over top

title: turkey burgers w  grated zucchini   carrots
steps:
1. Heat broiler
2. In a large bowl , combine the turkey , zuke , carrot , garlic , thyme , s&p , and egg
3. Form the mixture into 6 patties
4. Heat 1-2 t oil in a pan over medium heat
5. Cook the patties , turning once , until no trace of pink remains , 4-5 minutes per side
6. Meanwhile , place the bread on a baking sheet and brush with remaining oil
7. Broil until golden brown and crisp
8. Transfer the bread to individual plates
9. Combine mayo and lemon juice and spread about a tablespoon o each toast
10. Top with lettuce leaves and burgers
11. Can serve with mustard for an extra punch

title: penne romanoff
steps:
1. Bechamel: melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat
2. Add the flour and stir until a smooth paste forms
3. Gradually whisk in the milk
4. Bring to a boil while whisking constantly , then lower the heat and simmer gently for a few minutes
5. Season with salt and pepper and set aside
6. Pasta: in a large pot of boiled salted water , cook the pasta until al dente
7. Drain and set aside
8. In a large skillet over medium-high heat , saut the mushrooms in the butter until they release their liquid and brown
9. Season with salt and pepper
10. Add the onions and garlic
11. Continue cooking for about 2 minutes
12. Add the pasta and heat through
13. Deglaze with the vodka , flambing if desired
14. Add the bchamel and tomatoes and stir to coat the pasta
15. Adjust the seasoning
16. Garnish: transfer to a large serving bowl
17. Garnish with cheese , green onions and pine nuts
18. Serve immediately

title: leek and caper salad
steps:
1. Cut the leeks in half lengthwise and rinse thoroughly under cold running water
2. Then cut the leeks into 5cm lengths and in half again lengthwise
3. Heat the oil in a large heavy based fry pan and add the leeks and stir them until they are covered with the oil
4. Cover and cook them over a low heat for 15-20 minutes until they are soft and tender but don't let them burn or brown
5. Let them cool for about 10 minutes
6. Stir through the vinegar and season to taste with freshly ground salt and pepper
7. Transfer to a serving dish and scatter the baby capers over
8. If you can't get baby capers you can use regular capers but they will need to be chopped

title: not your ordinary boston baked beans
steps:
1. In a large skillet , brown ground beef and onion
2. Drain any grease
3. In a 9 x 13 inch baking dish , combine meat mixtured and remaining ingredients
4. Bake at 350 for 1 hour

title: crabby feta garlic dip
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Chill
3. Serve on crackers

title: sea farin  portobellos
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Clean mushrooms , remove and disgard stems
3. Arrange mushrooms gill side up in a shallow baking pan
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste
5. Combine crabmeat , peppers , mayonnaise and parsley
6. Divide mixture among the caps
7. Combine breadcrumbs and butter , sprinkle over stuffed mushrooms
8. Bake 15 minutes or until centers of mushrooms are tender
9. Serve with lemon wedges , if desired

title: curried quinoa salad
steps:
1. Toast the quinoa in a frying pan for about 5 minutes or until it begins to pop
2. Bring 2 cups water to a boil in a saucepan and add toasted quinoa
3. Cover and simmer over a medium heat for about 15 - 20 minutes or until water is absorbed
4. Put quinoa in a large bowl and let cool
5. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a frying pan and add onion , fry onion over a medium heat until the onion begins to soften , add curry powder and cook for another 2 minutes
6. Remove from heat and set aside
7. Whisk together in a bowl the remaining oil , lemon juice , mustard , salt and pepper and pour over quinoa
8. Stir in reserved onion mixture , carrot , red pepper , apricots , cashews , green onion , and parsley
9. Serve

title: sunflower cookie brittle
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Combine the butter , sugar , vanilla and salt in the mixing bowl of an electric mixer
3. Beat until creamy
4. Stir in flour gradually , beating until well blended
5. Fold in the sunflower kernels and chocolate chips
6. Press the dough into an ungreased jellyroll pan
7. Bake until golden brown , about 20 minutes
8. Let cool then break the baked cookie apart like peanut brittle
9. Store in an airtight container

title: hot and sticky vegetable stir fry
steps:
1. Prepared noodles or rice , for serving
2. For the sauce , combine all ingredients in a small bowl and set aside
3. For stir-fry , wash , peel and cut carrots and sweet potato into 1 / 4 inch stick shaped
4. Tear mushrooms , if using , along gill lines into evenly sized strips
5. Cut asparagus into snow-pea-size lengths
6. Place a wok or large skillet over med-hi heat and heat oil until it shimmers
7. Working in batches , if necessary , stir-fry carrot and sweet potato sticks for 2 minutes , until slightly dark and fragrant
8. Add asparagus and mushrooms , if using , and cook for 2 minutes
9. Increase heat to high and add snow peas and the sauce
10. Cook , stirring constantly , for a minute or two until sauce comes to a boil and vegetables are well coated
11. Season with salt and black pepper to taste
12. Divide among individual plates and sprinkle w / chopped parsley
13. Serve hot w / noodles or rice

title: pitta face mask
steps: 1. Mix in a small bowl and apply to face

title: roasted asparagus   potato salad
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Trim the top off the garlic heads leaving the rest of the bulb intact
3. After a good cleaning , quarter the potatoes and place in a large bowl
4. Add the oregano , thyme , oil and stock
5. Now add the two garlic bulbs and toss together
6. Pour into a baking pan and roast for 30 minutes or until the garlic and potatoes are tender
7. Check about 20 minutes in and if the pan is very dry add another tablespoon or two of broth
8. Remove potatoes from the oven and pour off any remaining liquid into a bowl
9. Let the potatoes and garlic cool
10. Clean and trim the asparagus into 2-inch pieces
11. Steam or boil until they are cooked crisp tender
12. Plunge into cold water to stop the cooking and drain
13. Take the roasted garlic and gently squeeze the soft cloves into the bowl of oil drained from the roasting pan
14. Stir to create a nice dressing
15. If it seems too thick , add a little more broth
16. The exact thickness is up to you but i like mine thicker than a vinaigrette but thinner than a mayonnaise type dressing
17. For me that's about 2-4 tablespoons
18. Season with salt and pepper
19. Toss together the roasted potatoes , asparagus , red onion , scallions and garlic dressing
20. Serve at room temperature

title: pork filet mignon with onions
steps:
1. Cut the tenderloin into 3 or 4 sections
2. In a non-stick stew pan or dutch oven , heat oil and brown onions on medium heat for approximately 15 minutes
3. Brown the pork in the onions for 5 minutes and add salt & pepper
4. Add wine
5. Cover with a lid and let simmer for 30 minutes
6. Turning from time to time
7. Serve with dauphine potatoes

title: mozzarella stuffed pesto turkey meatballs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. In a bowl , place ground turkey , chopped onion , minced garlic , egg , bread crumbs , cheese , pesto , chopped parsley , milk , salt and pepper
3. Mix until combined
4. Form turkey mixture into meatballs , approximately 1 3 / 4 inch in diameter
5. Stuff a mozzarella cheese cube into each meatball and seal the meat around the cheese so it can't leak out
6. Arrange on a nonstick baking sheet and drizzle with the olive oil
7. Bake for approximately 30 minutes
8. Serve with marinara sauce if desired

title: rainbow sherbet ice cream parfait  africa
steps:
1. In the bottom of a tall cold parfait glass , put 2 tbsp of strawberries
2. Add 1 sml scoop raspberry sherbet
3. Put another 2 tbsp of the strawberries over the raspberry sherbet & add 1 sml scoop of lime sherbet
4. Put the remaining 2 tbsp of strawberries over the lime sherbet & add 1 sml scoop of vanilla ice cream to fill the glass to the brim
5. Swirl whipped cream on top
6. Garnish whipped cream w / multicolored or chocolate sprinkles
7. Serve immediately

title: pineapple coconut cream pie  lactose free
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients of base together using just a little of the coconut cream to mix the cornflour with first
2. Cook on low heat till bubbling slowly and then till thickened
3. Spread cooked mix into 2 medium size pie dishes and refrigerate
4. Blend all pineapple from can and add juice last with a little mixed with all the cornflour
5. Cook slowly till thickened and cooked
6. Spread onto cooled bases covering whiteness
7. Decorate with lemon slices , pieces of pineapple , strawberry or kiwifruit

title: pork chop suey
steps:
1. Stir fry veggies in the oil in a pre heated wok till tender crisp
2. Add broth cook till heated through
3. Combine soy sauce and cornstarch and add to vegetable mixture
4. Cook and stir till thick and bubbly
5. Serve over rice or crispy noodles and sprinkle with pork

title: gluten free pizza  hertzberg   francois olive oil bread
steps:
1. To make the dough --
2. Use a container you can cover , but is not airtight
3. Mix together all the dry ingredients
4. In a separate bowl , mix the liquid ingredients
5. Gradually mix the liquid ingredients into the dry ingredients -- no need to knead -- you can use a spoon , a food processor with dough hook , or a stand mixer with paddle
6. Cover and allow the mixture to rest at room temperature for about 2 hours
7. Can be used at this point after the rest , but it's best after a 24 hour rest
8. Alternately , you can refrigerate it , covered , but not airtight and use over the next 7 days
9. On baking day --
10. Prepare a pizza peel , either sprinkled with cornmeal or rice flour or lined with parchment paper
11. In your oven , put the rack in the middle space and put a baking stone on it in the middle space if you have one
12. Otherwise use a cookie sheet , pizza pan , or a silicone mat
13. Thirty minutes before baking , preheat the oven to 500 degrees f
14. Wet your hands slightly -- keep your hands moist so you can work with the dough , but not so wet that the dough becomes soggy
15. Take an orange-sized piece of the dough and quickly shape it into a ball
16. Dust as needed to keep it from being sticky , but no so much that you're working lumps of flour into the dough
17. This dough will be sticky , so use a metal dough scraper and be generous in dusting the peel , the roller , the dough , etc
18. Roll out the dough 1 / 8 - 1 / 16 inch thich , directly on the pizza peel or silicone mat
19. Add toppings of your choice
20. Slide the pizza onto the stone or into the oven
21. Check for doneness in 10-12 minutes
22. May need to be turned to brown evenly
23. May need up to 5 more minutes to complete baking
24. Cool slightly on a rack before serving

title: guy savoy s spinach and mushroom gratin
steps:
1. Clean the mushrooms and cut them into one-eighth-inch slices
2. In a medium skillet , heat the butter over high heat just until melted , then add the mushrooms and saut them until golden , about 10 minutes
3. Drain any liquid from the mushrooms and set them aside
4. Place 2 quarts of water in a medium stock pot with one-half teaspoons salt
5. Bring the water to a boil over high heat , then stir in the spinach and blanch for just a few seconds , until wilted and bright green in color
6. Remove the spinach using a slotted spoon to a large bowl of ice water until cool
7. Drain the spinach well , squeezing out any excess water
8. Heat the oven to 350 degrees f
9. Reduce the cream to one-half cup in a small saucepan over low heat
10. Strain the cream into a small bowl and season with a pinch each of salt and pepper
11. Butter a small baking dish , and spread the spinach in the bottom in an even layer
12. Sprinkle the top of the spinach with one-eighth teaspoons salt
13. Arrange the mushroom slices over the spinach in a fish-scale pattern
14. Spoon the cream evenly over the top and bake for 5 to 10 minutes , until heated through
15. Serve immediately

title: swedish potato pancakes with pork  raggmunk med flask
steps:
1. Fry bacon in heavy skillet until crisp
2. Remove to warm plate
3. Pour off all but 1 tbs
4. Bacon fat
5. Peel and coarsely grate potatoes , place in paper towel and squeeze out excess moisture
6. Whisk together milk , egg , flour and salt
7. Fold grated potatoes into batter
8. Heat pan to medium high
9. Using a 1 / 3 cup measuring cup , transfer batter to pan
10. Flatten each pancake to 3" diameter
11. Fry a few minutes on each side until golden
12. Transfer to platter in a warm oven until all are ready
13. Serve with the bacon and lingonberries , if available !

title: maple and apple braised lamb shoulder chops
steps:
1. Trim the chops of external fat and season to taste with salt and pepper
2. Heat the oil in a large , heavy based pan and saute the chops on a high heat for 2 minutes each side or until browned
3. Combine the apple juice , stock , maple syrup and lemon juice and add to the pan
4. Reduce heat , cover and simmer over a low heat for 30-40 minutes or until lamb is very tender
5. Remove lamb from pan , cover with foil and keep warm
6. Boil the remaining juices until thick and syrupy
7. Return the lamb for a few minutes to heat through and coat well with the sauce
8. Serve the lamb chops with the mashed potatoes or squash and spoon the sauce , apples and prunes over the chops

title: jo ann s spelt carob cake  wheat free
steps:
1. Mix together carob and water
2. Set aside
3. Cream sugar and oil
4. Add eggs and beat well
5. Add carob mixture
6. Sift together dry ingredients
7. Add alternately with yogurt
8. Add vanilla
9. Mix well
10. Pour batter into greased and floured 9x12 or two 8-inch round pans
11. Bake at 350f for 20-30 minutes

title: versatile beef
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients together in bowl until well blended
2. Form into patties , meatballs or meatloaf
3. Every oven is different and each form will have a varying time to cook
4. I find the most common is 350 degrees for 45 minutes or use the frying pan for patties
5. Makes 4 patties , 20 meatballs or 1 small loaf

title: 5 cheese macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Cook 2 cups macaroni noodles in salted boiling water for only about 6 minutes > do not over cook as they will continue to cook in the oven
2. While noodles are cooking: mix eggs , milk , cream cheese , melted butter and spices together in large mixing bowl
3. Drain noodles
4. Add noodles and all the shredded cheese to egg mixture
5. Pour into a greased 9x13 baking pan
6. Bake in a 325 degree oven for 45 minutes

title: potato salad with dill  horseradish   pickle
steps:
1. Slice the unpeeled potatoes into disks
2. Cook the sliced potatoes in slightly salted water until just barely tender then rinse and drain them
3. Put them in a bowl while still hot and pour the cup of vinaigrette or italian salad dressing over them
4. The heat helps the potatoes to absorb the flavor of the dressing better
5. Let the potatoes marinate in the refrigerator for about two hours , then lift them out of the dressing
6. In another bowl , blend together the cup of sour cream , the cup of mayonnaise , the 2 teaspoons of horseradish , the 3 crumbled slices of bacon , the 3 tablespoons of pickle relish , the 3 chopped green onions , the 2 tablespoons of chopped dill and the salt and pepper to taste
7. Blend all of these ingredients together and then fold in the potatoes , refrigerate for at least two hours to chill and serve

title: cherry chicken lettuce wraps
steps:
1. Heat one teaspoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add ginger and chicken and saute until cooked thoroughly
3. Set aside
4. In large bowl , whisk together the reserve two teaspoons of oil , rice vinegar , teriyaki sauce , and honey , until mixed thoroughly
5. Add chicken mixture , cherries , carrot , green onion , and almonds
6. Toss together
7. To serve , spoon 1 / 12 of the chicken / cherry mixture onto the center of each lettuce leaf
8. Roll leaf around filling and serve

title: salmon with almonds and tomato lemon sauce
steps:
1. Bake almonds in a shallow pan at 350f , stirring occasionally , 5-6 minutes or until toasted
2. Set aside
3. Saute onion in hot oil in a skillet 10 minutes or until golden
4. Stir tomatoes and next 3 ingredients
5. Reduce heat , and simmer , stirring occasionally , 15 minutes
6. Stir in lemon juice and 1 / 4 teaspoon each of salt and pepper , keep warm
7. Sprinkle salmon filets with red pepper , remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and pepper
8. Place on a lightly greased rack in a broiler pan
9. Broil 6 inches from heat 10 minutes or until fish flakes with a fork
10. Serve with tomato mixture
11. Sprinkle with almonds

title: cherry almond chews
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl cream shortening and sugar
2. Add the eggs one at a time , beating well after each addition
3. Beat in extract
4. Combine the flour baking soda and salt , gradually add to creamed mixture
5. Stir in coconut and nuts if desired
6. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart on lightly greased baking sheets
7. Place a cherry half in the center of each cookie
8. Bake at 350 for 12-14 minutes or until lightly browned
9. Remove to wire racks to cool

title: nancy drew george s cherry cobbler
steps:
1. Place butter in 9" square casserole and put in 350 degree oven to melt
2. Combine the biscuit mix , sugar , milk , cinnamon and cherry filling
3. Pour into pan and bake 45 minute

title: citrus mint tea
steps:
1. Pour boiling water over tea bags and mint leaves
2. Cover and steep 5 minutes
3. Remove tea bags and mint , squeezing gently
4. Stir in splenda granulated and remaining ingredients
5. Serve over ice
6. Garnish with lemon slices , orange slices and fresh mint sprigs

title: chili chickpea roast
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 180c / 350f / gas mark 4
2. Chop the onion , pepper and garlic , and saute for a few minutes until the onion is transparent
3. Stir in the cumin , oregano and chili powder and cook for a couple more minutes
4. Keep stirring to ensure that nothing sticks to the pan
5. Remove from heat and set aside
6. Drain the chickpeas and either mash them by hand or liquidise in a blender
7. I always leave the mixture a little chunky to keep some texture
8. In a bowl stir together the chickpeas , onion mixture , bread crumbs , tomato paste and a few drops of hot sauce
9. Place this in a casserole dish and bake for 30 minutes
10. Serve hot and enjoy !

title: lemon garlic marinated chicken
steps:
1. Season the chicken with salt and pepper
2. Mix together the garlic , lemon zest and juice , chili , honey and ground coriander
3. Turn the chicken in the marinade to coat and leave to marinate in a covered non-metallic dish for 2-3 hours or overnight in the fridge
4. Preheat the oven to 400f roast the chicken in the marinade for 35-40 minutes until the chicken is tender
5. Place the chicken breasts onto warmed serving plates and garnish wih sprigs of cilantro

title: chocolate chip cookie cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease 9x13 nonstick cake pan
3. Glass works best
4. In a large bowl beat cream cheese , eggs , sugar , and vanilla with an electric mixer
5. Set aside
6. Using 1 1 / 2 to 2 packages of the cookie dough , cut dough into slices and arrange in a single layer in the baking pan
7. Press the dough into the bottom of the pan to make the crust of the cheesecake
8. Make sure there are no holes
9. Pour the cream cheese mixture evenly over the bottom crust
10. Cut the remaining cookie dough into slices
11. Arrange cookie slices ontop of the cream cheese mixture , spacing them evenly like you would when baking cookies on a cookie sheet
12. Bake at 350 degrees for 40-50min
13. The center will not be completly set
14. Refrigerate at least 4hrs before serving

title: sweet tater slices
steps:
1. Use a very thin pan on a cookie sheet , spray with pam
2. Slice the sweet potato's somewhat thin and dip in butter
3. Shake off excess butter
4. Lay flat in pan and top with grated cheese
5. Bake at 325 for 20 minutes , but watch them
6. It all depends on how thick you cut them

title: whole wheat chocolate chip pumpkin cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees farenheit
2. Grease a cookie sheet
3. Stir together flour , baking powder , baking soda , cinnamon , nutmeg and salt , set aside
4. Beat sugar , vegetable oil , eggs , and vanilla together
5. Add pumpkin
6. Add wet ingredient mixture and chocolate chips to dry mixture
7. Drop by teaspoonsful onto cookie sheet
8. Bake until edges are set

title: strawberry almond creme dip
steps:
1. In small bowl , fold strawberries into sour cream
2. Fold in yogurt
3. Stir in almond extract and sugar
4. Chill in freezer for 20 minutes
5. Remove from freezer and place in refrigerator for 1 hour
6. Serve

title: fried eggs with beef and onions
steps:
1. Whisk the eggs with sugar and salt
2. Cut the onion to 1 cm pieces and mix it with the ground beef
3. Fry it to desired cooked level
4. Heat 1 1 / 2 tablespoon oil
5. Fry 1 / 4 of the egg mixture until the down side is light brown
6. Spread 1 / 4 of ground beef and onion mixture
7. Fold the fryin eggs in half the engulfing the beef
8. Fry the upper side of the eggs until light brown
9. Serve immediately
10. Repeat 3 more times , making three more servings
11. For garlic lovers , add garlic to beef and onion mix
12. For color , dash paprika on top

title: chilled summer squash soup with fresh herbs
steps:
1. In a large saucepan place all the squash
2. Add the onion , garlic , broth and salt and pepper
3. Bring to a boil , cover , reduce heat and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes , or until the vegetables are very tender
4. Allow to cool slightly
5. Puree in a food processor or blender with the basil , parsley and lemon juice until smooth
6. Stir in the buttermilk
7. Place in a container , cover and refrigerate overnight
8. When ready to serve , whisk until smooth and adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper
9. Serve chilled , garnished with chopped basil and parsley

title: chicken pizza with avocado salsa
steps:
1. Spread the pizza base evenly with the philly then top with onion and chicken
2. Spray with oil
3. Bake pizza in hot oven 200 degrees c for 10 minutes
4. Top the pizza with salsa and avocado , cut into slices
5. Serve immediately

title: roasted garlic and vegetable soup with pasta
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Allow garlic to sit for 15 mins
3. Then wrap garlic in foil and place in a small casserole
4. Bake 45 to 50 mins or until soft when squeezed
5. Warm oil in a soup pot over med heat
6. Add onions and peppers
7. Saute 5 mins , add broth , water , carrots , tomato paste , basil and blk pepper
8. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and cover , simmer 10 mins
9. Remove 1 cup liquid
10. Mash garlic into the liquid
11. Stir into the pot
12. Add escarole and simmer 7 mins
13. Add broccoli , cover and turn off heat
14. Cook the pasta according to package directions
15. Drain and stir into the soup
16. Adjust seasonings
17. Pour into bowls and pass the parmesan !

title: challah  braided egg bread
steps:
1. Mix together 2 1 / 2 cups flour with the sugar , salt and yeast
2. There is no need to dissolve the yeast first
3. Add the water and oil
4. Mix in 4 eggs
5. Beat in another 1 1 / 2 cups of flour very well
6. Add 4-5 cups of flour , until a very soft dough is formed
7. Knead for about 10 minutes
8. If using the dough hook , knead for about 7 minutes
9. Let rise for 1-2 hours until doubled in size
10. Alternately , let rise in the refrigerator overnight and then let warm to room temperature for about 1 or 2 hours
11. Decide how many challahs you want , how many strands you want to braid in each
12. Make a dough ball for each strand
13. Roll them into ropes and braid
14. Let rise covered for 1 / 2-1 hour
15. Beat the remaining egg and brush on the challah
16. Bake in a preheated oven at 325 f for 30 minutes
17. Apply egg wash once more and bake for another 30 minutes at 350 f
18. This dough is enough for 4 medium sized challahs
19. You can really let your imagination run rampant here , making intricate braids , placing the braids in a loaf pan , even then winding them into a circle
20. You can add about 1 / 4 cup of raisins to the dough , but we leave them out

title: chocolate dipped heart cookies
steps:
1. Combine butter , sugar , cream cheese , egg and vanilla in large bowl
2. Beat until light and fluffy
3. Add flour , beat until well mixed
4. Wrap in saran wrap and refrigerate 2 hours or until firm
5. Preheat oven to 375
6. Roll dough out to 1 / 8 inch thickness on lightly floured surface
7. Cut dough with lightly floured 2 inch heart shaped cookie cutter
8. Place cutouts 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheets
9. Bake 7 to 10 minutes or until edges are very lightly browned
10. Remove immediately to wire racks to cool completely
11. Melt chocolate chips and shortening in small saucepan over low heat , or double boiler until melted
12. Dip half of each heart into melted chocolate
13. Refrigerate on cookie sheets or trays lined with waxed paper until chocolate is firm
14. Store , covered in refrigerator with wax paper in between
15. Makes about 3 1 / 2 dozen

title: low fat oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Combine oats , flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt and cinnamon in a bowl , set aside
2. In another bowl combine the applesauce , brown sugar , corn syrup , egg white and vanilla , stir until sugar dissolves
3. Add dry ingredients to the liquids , mix well
4. Grease a 9x15 inch cookie sheet , spread batter on the prepared pan
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 12-15 minutes
6. Cool and cut into squares yield depends on size of squares

title: the best roast chicken and gravy
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 450f
2. Slather the bird with butter , season the cavity and sprinkle the skin all over with generous amounts of salt
3. This will help the skin crisp
4. Place the bird on a rack over a roasting tin
5. If you have a v-shaped rack , this is the best , as it raises the chicken even higher
6. This will allow the entire bird to cook evenly and the skin to crisp all over
7. Place the bird in the hot oven for 20 minutes , then reduce the temperature to 375f for the rest of the cooking time
8. Depending on the size of the chicken , and the oven , the remaining cooking time will probably be between 40 and 60 minutes
9. Check regularly using the methods above
10. Once fully cooked , remove from the oven
11. Drain the cavity into the roasting pan , then put the chicken to one side , propped with its backside up , in a warm place for 10-15 minutes
12. This resting allows the juices to resettle - propping allows the juice to flow into the breast - and is the most important part of the process
13. Meanwhile , place the roasting tin on a medium heat on the hob and add half the white wine to deglaze the pan
14. Make sure you scrape in all the lovely caremelised bits which have stuck to the pan during the roasting
15. Once the pan has been deglazed , add half the stock and reduce until the sauce coats the back of a spoon
16. Taste and add the remainder of the wine and stock , or a little more of one than the other if you prefer then reduce again
17. Taste the gravy and season as required

title: praline cheesecake squares
steps:
1. For crust , in a large bowl combine flour , melted butter , the 2 / 3 cup finely chopped pecans , and the powdered sugar
2. Mix well
3. Press mixture into the bottom of a 13x9x2-inch baking pan
4. Bake in a 350 degree f oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until crust is set and light golden brown around the edges
5. Meanwhile , for filling , in a large mixing bowl beat cream cheese with an electric mixer on low to medium speed until smooth
6. Add eggs
7. Beat well
8. Beat in sweetened condensed milk , granulated sugar , and the 2 teaspoons vanilla
9. Pour filling over baked crust
10. Bake in a 350 degree f oven for 35 to 40 minutes until set
11. Cool in pan on a wire rack
12. For topping , in a medium saucepan combine brown sugar and whipping cream
13. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture boils
14. Reduce heat
15. Simmer , uncovered , for 10 minutes
16. Remove from heat
17. Stir in the 1 cup chopped pecans and the 1 1 / 2 teaspoons vanilla
18. Pour topping over cheesecake
19. Cover and chill for 2 to 24 hours before serving
20. Cut into squares
21. To tote: cover tightly
22. Transport in an insulated cooler with ice packs
23. For 24sservings: prepare using method above , except assemble and bake in an 8x8x2-inch baking pan

title: leftover greekstyle potatoes
steps:
1. Spray skillet add all the ingredients , brown over medium high heat
2. Turn so all sides get brown& slightly crisp
3. Serve hot

title: cranberry waldorf salad
steps:
1. In a medium mixing bowl , combine apples , grapes , celery , walnuts and raisins
2. For dressing , in a small mixing bowl , combine mayonnaise , sour cream , powdered sugar , lemon juice , and celery salt , fold in cranberry sauce combine fruits with dressing , mix to coat well
3. Chill , mix before serving

title: baby birthday cake
steps:
1. Combine the sliced carrots with 1 cup pluse 2 tbl
2. Of the apple juice concentrate in a pan , bringing it to a boil
3. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes until the carrots are soft
4. Puree carrots and juice with the raisins in a food processor
5. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
6. Line two 9-inch square cake pans with parchment paper , also greasing the parchment
7. Mix flour , wheat germ , cinnamon and baking powder in a mixing bowl
8. Add remaining wet ingredients , adding the carrot / raisin puree last , folding inches
9. Pour evenly into two cake pans
10. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes , until a toothpick comes clean
11. Wait until cakes or cooled until you frost

title: crock pot pork chops in homemade bbq sauce
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a bowl except for pork chops
2. Stir until well mixed
3. Place pork chops in bottom of crock pot
4. Pour liquid mix over pork chops
5. Cook in crock pot on low for 4-6 hours or until meat is cooked and tender

title: slow cooker barbecue pulled chicken
steps:
1. Stir tomato sauce , chiles , vinegar , honey , paprika , tomato paste , worcestershire sauce , mustard , ground chipotle and salt in a 6-quart slow cooker until smooth
2. Add chicken , onion and garlic
3. Stir to combine
4. Put the lid on and cook on low until the chicken can be pulled apart , about 5 1 / 2 hours
5. Transfer the chicken to a cutting board and shred with a fork
6. Return the chicken to the sauce , stir well and serve

title: tastees onion chips
steps:
1. Peel onions and cut into wedges top to bottom
2. Separate layers and put into plastic bag containing cup flour
3. Mix remaining flour , water , sugar , salt and milk
4. Mix until smooth
5. Batter should be thick , resembling pancake batter
6. Add crisco and mix together
7. Dip wedges into batter and deep fry until golden brown
8. From soup to nuts , recipes you'll always remember from places you'll never forget

title: 16 bean soup  crockpot
steps:
1. Combine bean soup mix , bay leaves , oregano , chicken stock , and enough water to cover the beans by 1" to 2 " in crock pot
2. Cook on high for 2 hours
3. Add remaining ingredients and shift cooker to low
4. Cook for additional 3 hours
5. For more zing , add cayenne or crushed red pepper when adding second set of ingredients
6. Serve this as a complete meal or over rice if desired
7. Freezes well

title: eggless  easy and tasty gingerbread made without molasses
steps:
1. Put the sugar into a half-pint measuring cup
2. Fill the cup with the golden syrup
3. Pour the mixture into a bowl
4. Then , put butter into the half-pint measuring cup and fill with boiling water
5. Mix well
6. Add baking soda
7. Now , sift together the remaining dry ingredients
8. Mix well until you have a soft , smooth consistency
9. Pour into a square or oblong baking pan lined with greaseproof paper
10. Bake at 350f for 40 minutes
11. Baking
12. Variation: as a variation , add 1 cup mixed fruits or fruits and nuts , if desired

title: mixed mushroom rice
steps:
1. In a large skillet saute mushrooms and onion in butter until soft
2. Stir in cooked rice , soy sauce , salt , pepper , and green onions
3. Cook until heated through and serve immediately

title: glazed meatballs
steps:
1. Combine ground beef , breadcrumbs , eggs and onion soup
2. Form into meatballs
3. Place meatballs into a cooking oil sprayed 13x9x2 baking pan
4. In a medium size bowl mix remaining ingredients
5. Pour mixture over meatballs
6. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 45 minutes

title: shrimp tikka masala
steps:
1. In a heavy pot , heat the ghee or oil until shimmering
2. Add onion and cook slowly , stirring often , until golden , about 20 minutes
3. Add ginger , garlic , tomato paste , garam masala and chili powder
4. It should be thick , but not pasty
5. It should drip off a spoon
6. If too thick , add more ghee or oil
7. Cook until very fragrant , 3-4 minutes
8. Add water and stir until smooth
9. Season to taste with salt and pepper
10. Add shrimp and poach gently until cooked through , 3-5 minutes
11. Remove from heat and stir in yogurt
12. Serve over cooked jasmine or basmati rice

title: possie stew
steps:
1. Cook the ground beef in a large pot with the onion until done
2. Open the all cans and add entire contents to the same pot
3. Heat to a boil and reduce heat and simmer for 10 minute ok it doesn't get more simple than that

title: creamy poblano pork chops
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Remove visible fat from chops & sprinkle with emeril's seasoning
3. Heat olive oil in frying pan & quickly brown the chops on both sides
4. Remove meat to a baking dish & add onion & poblano to oil
5. Cook & stir till both soften , 3-4 minutes
6. Add minced garlic & cook for another 2 minutes
7. Pour in wine to deglaze the pan
8. Stir in soup & cilantro
9. Heat through
10. Pour sauce mixture over pork chops , cover tightly with foil & bake for 45 minutes
11. Before serving , garnish with additional cilantro sprigs , if desired

title: steamed salmon cantonese style
steps:
1. To steam in a wok , cross two chopsticks in an x , then cut a groove in the lower chopstick so that the top one fits snugly
2. Set the chopsticks in the wok and add water to 1 inch below the level of the chopsticks
3. Place lid on wok and turn heat to high
4. Place the salmon , skin side down , on a glass pie plate or rimmed glass plate slightly smaller than the diameter of the wok
5. Cover with ginger slices
6. Pour rice wine and fish sauce over fish
