7. When the water is boiling , remove the lid from the wok and position the plate containing the salmon and seasonings on top of the chopsticks
8. Replace the lid and cook 7 to 8 minutes , or until the salmon just turns opaque and begins to flake
9. Two to three minutes before the salmon is done steaming , heat the peanut oil in a small skillet over high heat
10. When the oil is very hot , add the garlic and cook until browned
11. Discard the garlic , but do not turn off the heat until you use the oil
12. It must be very hot to sear the fish properly
13. When the salmon is cooked , transfer to a warm plate
14. Place green onion strips on top of the fish and immediately pour hot oil over the fish and onions
15. Garnish with cilantro sprigs and serve immediately
16. Serves 2 as an entree , 4 as an appetizer

title: john madden s bbq beef sandwiches
steps:
1. In a large saucepan or small soup pot , brown onions in butter until tender
2. Add all other ingredients including cooked and shredded beef
3. Cover and cook over low heat for at least 2 hours , uncovering for the last 1 / 2 hour or so
4. Or in a crock pot on low heat for 6 to 8 hours
5. Serve on buns or rolls

title: cucumber mint raita
steps:
1. Coarsely grate cucumber and pat dry with a kitchen towel
2. Whisk yogurt , mint , cumin , and 1 / 4 teaspoon cayenne pepper in medium bowl to blend
3. Add grated cucumber and toss to coat
4. Season raita to taste with salt and pepper
5. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours
6. Sprinkle raita with a pinch of cayenne pepper and serve

title: individual raspberry  jello cream desserts
steps:
1. Drain raspberries and reserve syrup
2. Dissolve jello in boiling water , then add ice cream and stir until melted
3. Stir in lemonade and reserved syrup
4. Chill until slightly set
5. Fold in raspberries and pecans gently
6. Place in individual dessert dishes and chill until set

title: martha s rice salad
steps:
1. Place cooked rice in medium bowl and keep warm
2. Mix together red onion and vinegar in a small bowl
3. Let sit 5 minutes
4. Strain onion in a sieve , discarding vinegar
5. Place lemon juice , oil , garlic , salt and pepper to taste in another small bowl , and whisk to combine
6. Drizzle lemon mixture over warm rice
7. Add reserved onion , dill , and lemon zest
8. Toss to combine
9. Serve

title: blt with smoked bacon  beefsteak tomato  arugula and lemon aioli
steps:
1. Spread butter very thinly on one side of all 4 slices of bread and toast till golden brown
2. Cook the bacon in a skillet over medium heat till it's crisp , about 4-6 minutes and drain on paper towels
3. To make the aioli , whisk the mayo and lemon juice together and season with salt and pepper
4. Spread the aioli on the buttered side of all the bread slices , top 2 of the slices with arugula , tomato and bacon and then place remaining two slices , aioli side down , on the 2 sandwiches
5. Cut in half and serve

title: italian salad dressing
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a jar with a tight-fitting lid
2. Shake well
3. Refrigerate overnight
4. Yield: 2 / 3 cup

title: apple cobbler just for two
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray 2 5-0z custard cups with non-stick cooking spray
3. Toss the apple with the cinnamon sugar , divide between the 2 custard cups and sprinkle each with 1 tablespoon water
4. In a small bowl , mix together the flour , oatmeal , baking powder , brown sugar and 1 / 2 teaspoon apple pie spice
5. Cut in the butter until crumbly
6. Sprinkle the crumb mixture over the apples and place in preheated oven
7. Bake for 35 minutes or until golden
8. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream , whipped cream or plain

title: flax oatmeal cookies  using freshly milled flour
steps:
1. Cream butter , sucanat , and sucanat w / honey making a grainy paste
2. Add eggs and vanilla and beat well
3. Mix dry ingredients and stir into creamed mixture
4. Add almonds and chocolate chips
5. Make into 1" balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet 2" apart
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 10 - 12 minutes
7. Makes about 5 dozen cookies
8. Chocolate chip variation:
9. Use 3 cups fresh soft white wheat flour
10. Omit oatmeal
11. Use 1 cups of shredded unsweetened coconut in place of chopped almonds
12. Use 2 cups of chocolate chips
13. Mix as directed in above recipe

title: meatloaf muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray a muffin pan with veggie oil spray
3. In a medium bowl , combine all ingredients well
4. Press mixture evenly into muffin cups
5. Bake for 25-30 minutes or until no longer pink inside
6. Let stand 2 minutes before removing from pan
7. Perfect portions and faster cooking !
8. Great for freezing !

title: diner meatloaf muffins  light
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Heat the olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
3. Add chopped onion , chopped carrot , dried oregano , and minced garlic
4. Saut 2 minutes
5. Cool
6. Combine onion mixture , 1 / 2 cup ketchup , and the remaining ingredients except cooking spray in a large bowl
7. Spoon the meat mixture into 12 muffin cups coated with cooking spray
8. Top each with 2 teaspoons ketchup
9. Bake at 350 for 25 minutes or until a thermometer registers 160
10. Let stand for 5 minutes

title: microwave lyonaisse potatoes
steps:
1. In 3 quart microwave container , melt the butter or marg
2. On high
3. Add rest ingredients , stir to mix
4. Cover and nuke for 10 minutes on high
5. When i first made these , i watched them like a hawk , worried they would burn with that amount of time on high heat but they
6. Turned out great

title: marmie s really tender crock pot pulled pork
steps:
1. Poke butt evenly around surface with a small butcher knife creating 1 / 2 inch cuts to accomodate how many garlic slivers you have
2. Stuff each hole with some fresh herbs and a sliver of garlic
3. Mix remaining spice and sugar ingredients together and then rub all over the roast
4. Save remaining spice
5. Put roast in zip lock bag and refrigerate for at least 8 - 12 hours
6. Remove from fridge and rub remaining spices onto the roast
7. Place roast in covered crock pot for an hour or two , do not turn on yet
8. Pour soda into crock pot along side of the roast so the spices are not washed offt the top of the roast and into the crock pot
9. Cook on medium for 8 - 12 hours untill tender
10. It will not hurt to leave the pork in the crock pot on low for a good length of time if it is done early
11. Remove pork from the broth and pull / shred apart with forks or fingers into chunks and place in casserole dish
12. Slather with copious amounts of bar b que sauce
13. Serve with fresh crusty buns , baked beans and salads

title: sunday salmon casserole
steps:
1. Boil the potato slices for 5 minutes
2. Drain and set aside
3. Saute the onions in the butter until translucent
4. Add the lox and dill , sauteing for a few more minutes
5. Salt and pepper to taste
6. Sprinkle the salmon steak with lemon juice and steam it for 5-8 minutes
7. It should flake easily
8. Preheat the oven to 375f
9. Skin and bone the salmon and break into chunks
10. Stir fresh salmon and lox mixture in a large bowl
11. Grease a 9 x 9 inch baking dish , and cover the bottom of the pan with the potatoes
12. Layer the cream cheese cubes on top of the potatoes , then layer on the salmon mixture
13. Mix together the eggs and milk with salt and pepper and pour it on top of the other ingredients
14. Dust the top with paprika
15. Bake until firm and golden , about 40 minutes
16. Cut in squares and serve

title: pan seared scallops with lemon sauce
steps:
1. Using a vegetable peeler , remove peel from lemon in long strips
2. Squeeze 1 1 / 2 tablespoons of juice from lemon into a small bowl and set aside
3. Combine lemon peel , wine , shallots and garlic in heavy small saucepan
4. Boil until mixture is reduced to about 1 / 2 cup , about 15 minutes
5. Add cream and turmeric and boil until mixture thickens and is reduced to 1 1 / 4 cups , about 13 minutes
6. Pour mixture through fine strainer and discard solids
7. Return sauce to pan and whisk in 1 1 / 2 tablespoons lemon juice and season with salt and pepper
8. Preheat oven to 200c / 400f rinse scallops and pat dry with paper towels
9. Toss scallops in bowl with salt and pepper
10. Melt 1 tablespoon butter with 1 tablespoon oil in heavy large skillet over high heat
11. Working in batches , add scallops to skillet and sear until browned and almost opaque in center , about 1-2 minutes each
12. Add remaining butter and oil as needed
13. Transfer scallops to rimmed baking sheet and bake about 3 minutes
14. While scallops are baking , saute corals in same pan for 1-2 minutes , if using
15. Divide sauce among plates and arrange scallops and coral atop sauce and serve

title: gladys  sweet onion sausage casserole
steps:
1. Put onions in bottom of 12" x 17" pyrex dish
2. Add ritz crackers , then sausage meat
3. Add a layer of onions , cream of mushroom soup , salt , and seasoning salt
4. Sprinkle layer of cheese and pimento
5. Bake in preheated oven at 400f for 1 hour

title: vegetable risotto with curry sauce
steps:
1. Blanch diced vegetables and set aside
2. Cook rice according to package directions
3. Saute shallots , garlic , chile and ginger in olive oil for about 2 minutes
4. Add curry powder and tomato puree and cook another 2 minutes
5. Finally add chutney and cream and simmer until reduced by half
6. Add blanched vegetables and rice to the curry sauce , season to taste and top with chopped basil and serve
7. Makes 4 servings

title: creamy corn bake
steps:
1. Drain liquid off whole kernel corn
2. Stir all ingredients together
3. Pour in 9x9x2" baking dish
4. Bake at 350 f oven for 1 hour

title: paprika lamb shanks
steps:
1. Heat a layer of vegetable oil in a heavy-bottomed pot and brown the shanks all over , seasoning once the shanks are sealed and remove
2. Add a little fresh oil , if needed and gently saute the capsicum , garlic and onions until tender , regularly stirring
3. Then add the paprika and stir until the spice is toasted
4. Add 2 tablespoons flour , mix in until well incorporated and cook for a few minutes
5. Pour in the wine and stock and add the tomatoes with a decent amount of seasonings and stir well and return the shanks to the pot , together with the carrots and mix well and cover and bring to the boil
6. Then turn down the heat and very gently simmer for about 1 1 / 2 hours until the meat is very tender and almost falling of the bone
7. Combine the sour cream and remaining flour in a bowl
8. Remove the shanks and add the sour cream mixture to the pot and whisk well , taste for seasoning and then add the parsley with the cooked noodles

title: swirled cherry cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease and flour bottom and sides of a 9x13x2" cake pan
3. In a large bowl , mix cake mix , eggs , water and oil with a mixer until well blended
4. Pour batter into prepared cake pan
5. Smooth evenly in pan
6. Drop spoonfuls of the pie filling on top of the cake batter
7. With a knife , swirl the cherry pie filling into the cake batter
8. Be careful not to touch the bottom of the cake pan with the knife
9. This might remove some of flour / shortening coating , causing the cake to stick
10. Bake for 40-45 minutes or until cake is golden brown on top and a knife inserted in the center comes out clean
11. Allow to cool for 10 minutes
12. May be served warm or cooled
13. May be served with ice cream or whipped topping

title: one step easiest ever pressure cooker rice pudding
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a pressure cooker
2. Close without weight
3. Place on high heat till it begins to steam , then put the weight on
4. Wait till steaming well
5. Cook for 25 minutes on the lowest heat setting
6. Wait till relatively cooler before opening
7. You may like to add some more milk later as it thickens
8. Good hot or cold !
9. Cardamom or nutmeg can be added at the start
10. Liquid or powdered flavour eg
11. Vanilla essence is to be added last to prevent loss of flavour in the steam

title: super tasty super messy chicken sandwich
steps:
1. Pound the chicken breast until they are a uniform thickness
2. Marinate the chicken in italian dressing for 1-4 hours
3. "pan fry" chicken unitl cooked through
4. Heat the marinara sauce in a sauce pan
5. Butter the inside of the ciabatta buns rub the garlic on the buns
6. Place buns , buttered side up , under low broiler until lightly toasted
7. Put a thin layer of the marinara sauce on the bottom half of the bun
8. Add pepperoni
9. Add chicken
10. Add another thin layer of marinara
11. Top with cheese
12. Place back under the broiler until cheese melts
13. If desired put a thin layer of marinara on the top half
14. Enjoy -- don't forget the napkins !

title: ultimate chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Mix sugars , butter and egg in large bowl
3. Stir in flour , baking soda and salt
4. Stir in nuts and chocolate chips
5. Drop dough by rounded tablespoonfuls about 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet
6. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until light brown
7. Cool slightly
8. Remove from cookie sheet
9. Cool on wire rack

title: holy smackeroos  easy chocolate peanut candies
steps:
1. Put everything in crockpot , stir , turn on low 45 minutes
2. Turn to low 15 minute
3. Stir every 15 minutes to coat nuts , and let chunks move around for melting
4. Drop by teaspoons onto wax paper
5. Let cool
6. Voila
7. -stirring every 15 minutes allows for blending and checking
8. -
9. Prep time includes turning out onto wax paper

title: eggs in meurette
steps:
1. Simmer bacon , garlic , onions , and shallots until translucent
2. Add the flour and cook for a few minutes
3. Add the wine and mix well
4. Salt and pepper to taste
5. Let cook at a simmer for about 30 minutes
6. When the dish is ready to be served , poach the eggs for 2 minutes
7. Toast the bread
8. Serve the dish with the sauce over the eggs and toast

title: chicken potato packets
steps:
1. Place each chicken breast on a piece of heavy duty foil
2. Mix the oil , rosemary , thyme , basil and garlic
3. Drizzle over the chicken
4. Top with potatoes , squash , onion , butter , salt and pepper
5. Fold the packets up securely
6. Bake on a cookie sheet at 375 for 35-40 minutes , until chicken juices run clear

title: shorba libya
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat and fry the onions for a few minutes until tender
2. Add the lamb , chickpeas , tomato puree , spices and salt , and cook for a few minutes more , stirring occasionally
3. Cover the mixture with water , stir , then simmer with the lid on for 30-45 minutes or until the lamb is cooked
4. Add extra water if required and adjust the seasoning if necessary
5. Stir in the crushed mint about 10 minutes before the end , then squeeze in the lemon-juice just before serving
6. Serves 4-6

title: whole roasted rabbit with garlic  rosemary and coriander
steps:
1. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper
2. Spread rabbit out as flat as possible and place it on prepared pan
3. Season both sides with salt and pepper
4. Combine oil , garlic , rosemary , coriander , peppercorns and chili powder in a small bowl
5. Rub mixture over both sides of rabbit
6. Cover and refrigerate 2-3 hours
7. Preheat oven to 475f
8. Uncover rabbit
9. Roast until tender and cooked through , 30-35 minutes

title: fresh apricot honey sponge cake  russian style
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f
2. Grease a 9-inch cake pan with butter , and dust with bread crumbs
3. Set aside
4. Melt butter in a small saucepan over medium heat
5. Add the sliced apricots , and drizzle with honey
6. Cover , and cook gently until the apricots have softened , then allow to cool to room temperature
7. Meanwhile , beat the egg whites to soft peaks with an electric mixer
8. Slowly pour in sugar while continuing to beat to stiff peaks
9. Set aside
10. Beat the egg yolks on low speed for a few seconds until slightly thickened
11. Slowly pour in sugar while continuing to beat until thickened and light-colored
12. Beat in milk , then sift together flour with baking powder , and fold into yolks along with cooled apricot mixture , walnuts , and egg whites until combined
13. Pour into prepared pan , and bake in the middle or bottom of the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean , about 50 minutes
14. Loosen the cake by running a knife around the edges of the pan
15. Invert cake onto a plate , then place another plate on the cake bottom , and flip right-side-up
16. Cool completely before serving

title: spicy asian wings
steps:
1. In a medium sized bowl , whisk together soy sauce , vinegar , honey , oil , garlic , red pepper flakes and black pepper
2. Add chicken wings and turn to coat
3. Marinate covered in refrigerator 2 hours or overnight
4. Heat oven to 450f
5. Place wings on rack in broiler pan
6. Roast for 30 minutes
7. To crisp skin if desired , increase oven temperate to broil
8. Broil wings for 1-2 minutes or until skin is crisp

title: butter mints  diabetic
steps:
1. Combine powder sugar ingredients in blender
2. Whip until powdered
3. Yields 4 cups
4. Cream margarine , milk and butter flavor
5. Stir in 1 cup sugar replacement
6. Knead til smooth
7. Roll in small marble size balls
8. Press each ball firmly into candy mold
9. Unmold onto waxed paper

title: mrs mm s  potato and bean bhaji
steps:
1. Use a non stick pan with a well fitting lid , heat the oil over medium heat
2. When hot add the mustard seeds , when they start to pop add the cumin seeds , onions , red chillies , and fenugreek seeds
3. Fry for 4 minutes
4. Add the coriander leaves and the turmeric , stir and fry for 1 minute
5. Add the beans , potatoes and salt , stir to mix all the ingredients together
6. Cover the pan and reduce the heat to minimum and cook for 20 mins , stir from time to time to prevent sticking and burning
7. Stir in the ground cumin and cook for 1 minute
8. Serve with boiled rice and a dish of tarka dhal to accompany any good meat curry

title: super easy and delicious peanut butter  ice cream pie
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix together the peanut butter , whipped topping and ice cream
2. Pour into either a graham cracker or chocolate crust , whichever is preferred

title: rosemary bread  bread machine
steps:
1. Combine milk with 2 t rosemary and microwave until warm
2. About 45 seconds
3. Place ingredients in bread pan in order specified by your bread machines manual
4. Use the white bread and light crust setting
5. Press start
6. Before serving:
7. Mix above ingredients for the rub and brush on bread after removing from bread machine
8. Ideally , while bread is still warm
9. Enjoy !

title: double fruit cream pie
steps:
1. In one bowl fold together the strawberry yogurt and 1 cup of the cool whip
2. Fold in the chopped strawberries , then spoon the mixture into the graham cracker crust
3. In a separate bowl , fold the blueberry yogurt into the remaining cool whip
4. Fold in the pureed blueberries , then gently spoon the mixture into the graham cracker crust over the strawberry mixture you already put there
5. Do not mix the layers
6. You should now have a pie with two distinct layers , the bottom strawberry and the top blueberry
7. Freeze the pie at least 4 hours to set
8. Then place in the refrigerator 45 minutes , to thaw a little before serving
9. Suggestions: garnish if you like , with halved strawberries or whole blueberries or a few fresh mint leaves --
10. If you prefer to use frozen berries , try to find ones with no sugar added

title: crazy good garlic breadsticks
steps:
1. Mix yeast into warm water
2. In separate bowl , combine flour and salt
3. Add the oil to the water , and add these liquids to the dry ingredients
4. Knead for 7 or 8 minutes , then let rest for about 10
5. Keep it under a cloth while resting , in a warm place
6. While it's resting you can make the garlic sauce
7. Melt the margarine , and mix in the rest of the ingredients
8. Put to the side
9. Roll dough out into a rectangle shape
10. Cut into strips of desired length , and brush on garlic sauce
11. Stick into a proof box for about 15 minutes
12. If you do not have a proof box , try to put the pans of dough in the warmest spot in your kitchen , such as nearby an oven
13. Or if you live in a hot place like florida , put them in your car for a bit
14. Once they grow a little , throw them into the oven at about 425
15. Check on them after 10 minutes and pull them out when they turn a nice golden brown
16. Brush more of the sauce on , lightly , and sprinkle with the grated cheese
17. Best enjoyed warm
18. :)

title: pork cutlets parmesan with tomato sauce
steps:
1. For tomato sauce---------------
2. Heat oil in saucepan and add garlic
3. Cook briefly
4. Add tomatoes and bring to a boil
5. Add rosemary , pepper flakes , salt and pepper
6. Simmer for 10 minutes
7. For cutlets------------
8. Sprinkle the cutlets with salt and pepper
9. Mix egg and water well
10. Put breadcrumbs in shallow dish
11. Dip cutlets in egg mixture--then in breadcrumbs
12. Heat olive oil in nonstick 10 inch skillet
13. Cook cutlets on med
14. Hi heat about 5 minutes per side until lightly browned
15. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees
16. Place cutlets in baking dish
17. Put mozzarella slices on top
18. Sprinkle with parmesean
19. Spoon sauce around the cutlets
20. Bake until piping hot and the cheese is melted

title: crockpot pinto beans and ham
steps:
1. Sort your beans and remove and broken pieces or pebbles
2. I use one 16 oz package of beans
3. Place in a large bowl or pot , covering with water
4. Add the baking soda to the water , and let the beans soak at least 6 hours or overnight
5. After 6 hours or overnight drain the water from the beans
6. Add the beans to a 6 quart crock pot and cover with fresh water
7. You want the beans to be covered by at least one inch
8. Add the pinto bean seasoning , sugar , vegetable oil , pepper and onion
9. Taste the beans after several hours of cooking and add more seasonings if you think it needs it
10. I used a total of one tablespoons pepper
11. Add one of the following for additional seasoning , one ham hock , ham bone , or slice of country ham cut into pieces
12. Place lid on crock pot and cook on high for about 6-8 hours
13. Make sure the beans stay covered with water , so check occasionally
14. If you need more water , then add it
15. The beans should have a soup consistency
16. In 6 hours , test beans and if they are cooked
17. Remove ham bone and pull of the meat or remove meat from ham hock and serve
18. Don't forget the wedge of cornbread

title: crazy john s spicy mustard
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except water and mix well
2. Then add the water , mix well and simmer for 2 minutes
3. Remove from heat and allow to cool to room temperature
4. Transfer to an air-tight jar and store sealed , in the refrigerator

title: honey lime berries   greens
steps:
1. In a medium bowl combine all salad ingredients and toss
2. In a small bowl blend all dressing ingredients and mix well
3. Serve salad with dressing

title: pistachio cake from scratch
steps:
1. Combine eggs , extract and 1 / 4 of the sour cream in a small bowl
2. Cut butter into chunks
3. Put remaining sour cream in another small bowl with tablespoon of oil
4. Allow all ingredients to come to room temperature while you prepare a 9-inch springform pan , line bottom with parchment , grease and flour
5. You can use a 9x2-inch round pan as well , but it will be a bit more difficult to unmold the cake
6. Toast pistachios in a 350 degree oven for 7-8 minutes , cool then grind fine , -- if using dry measuring cups be sure to grind first then measure sift all dry ingredients into the work bowl of your mixer and mix on low speed for 30 seconds to combine
7. Add softened butter and sour cream , mix on low to combine , scrape bowl , beat on medium for 90 seconds
8. This will aerate the cake and give it structure
9. Scrape the bowl down and in two additions add the egg mixture , beating for 20 seconds after each addition
10. Scrape the bowl one last time and give it a couple pulses
11. Pour batter into prepared pan and bake at 350 degrees for 40-50 minutes , a toothpick inserted in the center will come out clean and the top of the cake will spring back when lightly pressed
12. Remove from the oven and cool on a rack for 10 minutes , remove sides of pan and allow to cool to room temperature
13. About 2 hours
14. It's delicious slightly warm with just a dusting of powdered sugar , topped with sweetened whipped cream or served with pistachio ice cream

title: confetti black eyed pea salad
steps:
1. Whisk oil , vinegar , mustard , onion , salt , pepper , and honey in a large bowl
2. Add black-eyed peas , bell pepper , tomato , celery , carrots , and parsley
3. Gently stir to combine
4. Cover and refrigerate up to 24 hours before serving

title: the only way fried chicken
steps:
1. Wash and pat the chicken dry
2. Beat eggs and water together
3. Put flour in paper bag
4. Salt and pepper the chicken
5. Dip chicken in egg
6. Shake the chicken in the bag with flour
7. Heat the shortning and butter until very hot , but not smoking
8. Add chicken pieces
9. Keep your burner on med hot
10. Keep frying and turning until chicken juices run clear
11. Drain on paper towels

title: healthy garlic shrimp pasta
steps:
1. In a small bowl add shrimp , 2 cloves of minced garlic , lemon zest , 1 / 2 t of oil , salt and pepper
2. Mix all together , and set aside to marinate for 15 minutes
3. Bring a pot of water to a boil , add tomatoes
4. Boil for 2 minutes , then remove from water , run under cold water , until tomatoes are cooled , then peel the skin and chop
5. Set aside
6. In a skillet , heat 1 t oil , add in shrimp , cook only 3-5 minutes , until shrimp is pink
7. Remove and set aside
8. In the skillet , there will be residue from the shrimp
9. Heat back up , add the other 2 cloves of minced garlic , and pepper flakes , once there is an aromatic smell , add the tomatoes , italian spice , and oregano
10. Turn the heat down to med low , and cook the tomatoes slowly for about 10-15 minutes
11. Once they have broken down a bit , add the spinach on top of the tomatoes , and cover with a lid
12. Let it cook for 5-10 minutes on medium low
13. Once the spinach has wilted , mix into the tomatoes , add the lemon juice , and a little salt
14. Serve over your pasta , and add shrimp
15. A sprinkle of parm is good to add on top

title: chocolate cupcakes with nutella and mixed cream cheese frosting
steps:
1. Clear vanilla extract is used to maintain a purer white color
2. If this doesn't matter to you , then you may use regular vanilla extract
3. For the cupcakes: line 3 dozen muffin cups with cupcake liners or grease using non-stick spray
4. Set aside
5. Preheat oven to 350f
6. Sift together flour , cocoa powder , baking soda , baking powder and salt
7. Set aside
8. In a large bowl , beat the eggs and sugar for 5 minutes , until it is pale and thick
9. Add in the butter
10. Mix until combined
11. Add in the nutella
12. Now , add in the buttermilk
13. Beat until well incorporated
14. Add the flour mixture in 3 increments and beat until smooth
15. Divide batter into the cupcake tins
16. Bake for 25 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean
17. Remove from oven and let cool completely before frosting
18. Vanilla cream cheese frosting: cream the butter and cream cheese in the large mixing bowl of a stand mixture
19. Add the vanilla
20. Slowly incorporate the powdered sugar as you continue to cream
21. Scrape down the sides of the bowl
22. Beat on high speed until fluffy and smooth , adding milk or additional sugar to reach desired consistency
23. Nutella cream cheese frosting: cream the butter and cream cheese in the large mixing bowl of a stand mixture
24. Add the nutella and vanilla and continue to cream
25. Slowly incorporate the powdered sugar as you continue to cream
26. Scrape down the sides of the bowl
27. Beat on high speed until fluffy and smooth , adding milk or additional sugar to reach desired consistency
28. For a darker brown add 1 drop brown and 1 drop black food coloring
29. Almond butter or peanut butter cream cheese frosting: cream the butter and cream cheese in the large mixing bowl of a stand mixture
30. Add the almond butter or peanut butter and vanilla and continue to cream
31. Slowly incorporate the powdered sugar as you continue to cream
32. Scrape down the sides of the bowl
33. Beat on high speed until fluffy and smooth , adding milk or additional sugar to reach desired consistency
34. Once cooled , place the 3 varieties of frosting in a piping tube side by side and pipe onto each cupcake
35. Sprinkle with chocolate jimmies if you like !

title: sicilian meat roll   light meatloaf
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the egg substitute , ketchup , italian seasoning , garlic , seasoned salt , and parsley , mixing well
2. Process bread into crumbs
3. Add to mixture
4. Crumble sirloin over mixture
5. Combine completely
6. On a piece of heavy duty aluminum foil , press meat into a rectangle
7. Evenly place ham over meat to within 1 inch of edge
8. Sprinkle 3 / 4 cup mozzarella over ham
9. Roll jellyroll style , removing foil as you roll
10. Seal all edges completely
11. Bake , uncovered , seam side down at 350f for 1 hour
12. Sprinkle with remaining 3 / 4 cup mozzarella
13. Bake 5-10 minutes longer or until cheese is melted

title: kiwi pineapple smoothie  non dairy
steps:
1. Blend together all ingredients in your choice of smoothie maker
2. You may need to add up to 1 / 4 cup more juice if it is too thick for you

title: cheeseburger cups
steps:
1. Set oven at 425f
2. Spray muffin cups with non-stick vegetable spray
3. Roll out biscuits until each is big enough to fit into muffin tins with enough dough to cover
4. Mix together catsup and mustard with ground beef
5. Fill each biscuit cup with meat mixture
6. Sprinkle cheese over all
7. Fold dough over top
8. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown

title: double chocolate muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. In a large bowl add flour , sugar , cocoa , baking powder and baking soda
3. Mix well
4. In a medium bowl mix the egg , milk , butter and vanilla
5. Pour the milk mixture over the dry ingredients , and mix lightly , just enough to moisten
6. Set aside about 1 / 2 cup of white chocolate chips , and mix the rest into the batter
7. Spoon into muffin tins that have been greased or lined with paper muffin cups
8. Sprinkle reserved white chocolate chips over the tops of the muffins
9. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes

title: mojo t bones
steps:
1. Mojo: whisk together all of the mojo ingredients
2. Reserve 1 / 4 cup of marinade , covered , in the fridge
3. Marinate the steak in the remaining mojo for 1 hour prior to grilling
4. Macaroni: heat butter in a large skillet and saut the onions , garlic , and habanero until just tender
5. Add the cooked macaroni , cheese , and poblano puree
6. Mix thoroughly and season to taste
7. Keep warm
8. Grill: grill the steak to desired doneness
9. Trim the roots off the green onions and grill them alongside the steak
10. Serve: place macaroni onto a plate
11. Place the steak atop the macaroni and spoon reserved mojo over the steaks
12. Place grilled green onion stalks over top

title: roasted eggplant  aubergine  spread
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425f
2. Arrange the eggplant in a single layer on a nonstick coated baking sheet
3. Stir the olive oil and garlic together in a small bowl and lightly brush on both sides of the eggplant
4. Roast eggplant slices until lightly browned , turning once , about 20 minutes per side
5. Cool slightly
6. Coarsely chop the eggplant and combine with the red peppers and capers
7. Add black pepper to taste

title: low calorie asparagus   egg whites
steps:
1. Microwave asparagus according to package directions
2. Drain well and separate into halves
3. Put half the asparagus in a 8" pan sprayed with pam
4. Pour egg whites over asparagus and cook 2 minutes over med heat
5. Sprinkle with parmesan and broil for 4-5 minutes or until cheese is brown & bubbly and eggs are set
6. Turn out onto plate & enjoy !

title: spinach fritters  rachael ray
steps:
1. In a large bowl , stir together the spinach , onion , eggs , the flour and cumin
2. Season with salt and pepper
3. Heat the olive oil over medium heat in a frying pan
4. Spoon heaping tablespoons of the spinach batter into the oil
5. Cook the fritters until crisp and browned , about 2 minutes on each side

title: easy  delicious salmon topped with shallot or onion
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Lightly grease a baking dish with vegetable oil
3. Place salmon fillets skin side down into baking dish
4. Top with mayonnaise and spread over the fish
5. Top with onion or shallot
6. Salt and pepper to taste
7. Bake for 12-15 minutes for small fillets

title: sausage  beans   greens casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Lightly grease a 2-quart baking dish
3. Brown sausage in a large deep skillet
4. Drain fat to save calories
5. Stir in onion , garlic , then tomatoes
6. Cover and cook over medium heat about 10 minute or until onions are tender
7. Add remaining ingredients
8. Stir to mix
9. Transfer to prepared dish
10. Can be covered and refrigerated up to 2 days if desired
11. Bake covered 30 minute or until hot
12. Makes 4 servings

title: beef diane
steps:
1. Cut beef into 3cm pieces
2. Heat oil in large pan and add beef in batches , cook stirring , until browned
3. Return beef and any juices to pan and add garlic and onion , cook , stirring until onion is soft
4. Add undrained crushed tomatoes , stock and sauce and simmer covered about 1 1 / 2 hours or until beef is tender
5. Add remaining ingredients , simmer uncovered about 5 minutes or until slightly thickened
6. Serve with pasta and extra chopped parsley

title: hot roast beef sandwiches   gravy
steps:
1. Place beef roast , water , dry onion soup mix and as much salt / pepper as desired in crock pot and cook on low for 9-10 hours
2. Whisk flour and water together for gravy until smooth and set aside
3. When roast is tender and done , pour broth into a saucepan and bring to boil on stove top
4. Add 2 beef bouillon cubes and gravymaster to boiling broth
5. Then add flour and water mixture to boiling broth until desired consistency is reached for your gravy
6. Cut up beef roast and arrange pieces between two slices of bread
7. Smother sandwich with gravy and enjoy !

title: easy as pie 10 minute no rise thin crust pizza dough
steps:
1. Proof the yeast in the warm water with the honey or sugar for 8-10 minutes or until foamy
2. Add the remaining ingredients together and knead well , about 2-5 minutes
3. If the dough seems a little sticky , dust your hands with some flour and knead again
4. Grease a pizza pan or pie pan with cooking spray , and place the dough into it-- entire thing if a 12" pie , or half for an 8" or 9" pan
5. I prefer to bake these crusts ahead of time-- but if you want to eat it now , you can put the sauce , cheese , toppings , etc
6. On it and use the same baking instructions
7. Bake at 500f for 8-12 minutes or until the edges are nice and brown

title: subru uncle s french beans aloo ki bhaji  french beans   pot
steps:
1. Heat oil in a pot on medium flame
2. When it's hot , lower flame and add mustard seeds and cumin seeds
3. Allow the seeds to splutter and crackle in the hot oil
4. Once they stop doing that , add ginger , garlic , onions and green chillies to the oil
5. Mix well and stir-fry for 5-7 minutes or until the raw smell of ginger and garlic is gone and the onions are softened
6. Add potatoes , mix well and cover the pot
7. Cook on medium flame for 5-7 minutes
8. Uncover , mix once and then add turmeric powder , red chilli powder and coriander powder
9. Mix once again and then add the chopped french beans
10. Mix well , cover the pot with a tight-fitting lid and allow the veggies to cook on medium flame for 5 minutes
11. Uncover , add tomatoes and salt
12. Mix well and cover the pot with the tight-fitting lid
13. Allow to cook for 10 minutes on medium flame
14. Uncover , mix once and then cover the pot again
15. Allow the veggies to cook for 5 minutes on medium flame or until the tomatoes are softened and the veggies are tender and cooked well
16. Remove the pot from flame
17. Serve hot with indian flatbreads or bread or parathas

title: smoked chicken and cheddar buttermilk waffles
steps:
1. Mix bisquick , buttermilk , egg yolks , salt and sugar with beaters until well mixed
2. In a separate bowl , beat egg whites with clean beaters until stiff
3. Fold egg whites into batter
4. Pour about 1 / 3 cup batter onto a preheated belgian waffle iron and top with 2 t smoked chicken and 2 t cheddar and bake
5. You can hold the baked waffles in a 200 oven while finishing the remainder of the waffles
6. Serve with warm maple syrup or honey and butter

title: scallop thermidor
steps:
1. Heat a sauce pan to med high
2. Add olive oil to hot pan then sear scallops for 4 minutes on each side
3. Remove and keep warm
4. Saute onions and mushrooms on high heat , till browned and cooked though
5. Add garlic and saute for 30 more seconds
6. Add vermouth , stir to get all brown bits off bottom , reduce heat
7. When most of liquid has cooked off , add cream
8. Bring to a boil for 3 minutes
9. Turn off heat , leave pan on burner add cheese
10. When cheese is melted , stir , add salt and pepper to taste and serve over scallops

title: creole bloody mary
steps:
1. Shake all ingredients with ice in a shaker
2. Just until chilled
3. Strain over fresh ice in 2 12 oz
4. Glasses
5. Sprinkle lemon pepper lightly over both drinks
6. Add celery stick if desired

title: lower fat hamburger pizza
steps:
1. Leave the pizza crust container sitting on the counter for about 10 minutes , it is easier to spread the dough at room temperature
2. Open the container and spread it out on a greased pizza pan
3. Bake in the oven for 7-10 minutes at 375 only until the dough starts to brown
4. Remove the dough from the oven
5. Spread the tomato sauce over the dough
6. Spread the hamburger over the sauce
7. Spread the shredded mozzarella cheese over the hamburger
8. Sprinkle the pineapple over the cheese
9. Bake the pizza another 10 minutes at 375 or until the cheese is melted and the dough just starts to turn brown

title: corn  n sweet pickles salad
steps: 1. Toss all the ingredients place on lettuce leaves and serve either chilled or at room temperature

title: just right pesto pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook pasta as indicated on package
2. Rinse with cold water , drain , and set aside in large bowl
3. Combine water , olive oil , and dry knorr pesto mix together in a small saucepan
4. Bring to boil over medium-high heat , stirring often
5. Lower heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 or more minutes , stirring occasionally
6. Peel and wash garlic
7. Chop finely and add to bowl with pasta
8. Wash tomatoes and slice lengthwise
9. Add to pasta
10. Dice black olives and add to pasta
11. Add basil to pasta and stir until all ingredients are well mingled
12. Pour sauce over pasta mixture and stir
13. Sprinkle parmesan over pasta and stir well
14. Chill overnight for best results

title: ethiopian style lentils with yams  or sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Saute the onion , garlic , ginger and yam in olive oil at medium heat until the onions are almost translucent
2. Add the red bell pepper and saute for an additional minute
3. Add the lentils , tomato paste and water
4. Bring water to a boil
5. Add the paprika , coriander , allspice , fenugreek and ginger
6. Lower heat slightly and allow the stew to simmer for 20 minutes or until the lentils are tender and all the water absorbed
7. Add salt , soy sauce and black pepper as needed , and serve

title: baked caprese salad
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f
2. Arrange the sliced baguette bread on a baking sheet
3. Brush with some of the olive oil
4. Sprinkle with salt
5. Bake until the bread is pale golden and crisp , about 5 minutes
6. Remove from the oven
7. Top each slice of bread with a slice of tomato and sprinkle with salt and pepper
8. Top each slice of tomato with a slice of mozzarella and sprinkle with salt
9. Return the baking sheet to the oven until the cheese and tomato are warmed , about 5 minutes
10. Arrange the toasts on a serving platter
11. Top each toast with a basil leaf
12. Sprinkle with salt and pepper , and serve

title: ants climbing a tree   ma yi shang shu
steps:
1. Soften the noodles briefly in warm water
2. When they are soft , mostly clear and pliable , drain and cut both ends to shorten them to manageable lengths
3. Be careful not to over soak
4. Set aside
5. To prepare the red peppers: top and seed the red peppers and chop finely
6. If using dried red peppers , soak in warm water until softened , then seed and chop
7. Set aside
8. To prepare the green pepper: top , seed and cut into shreds
9. Fry shortly in 1 tbsp cooking oil on high heat with a pinch of salt
10. Set aside
11. To prepare mushrooms: soak dried mushrooms in warm water until softened
12. Cut away the tough stems and cut the mushrooms into 1 / 2 inch pieces
13. Set aside
14. Chop the ginger and green onions
15. Put them both on a small plate with the hot bean sauce and red peppers
16. Set aside
17. In a bowl , mix the rice wine , soy sauce , salt , mushrooms and chicken stock
18. Set aside
19. Heat the oil in a wok or large pan until hot
20. Add the pork and toss until grey , breaking up the pork into very tiny bits as you do
21. Add the ginger , onions , peppers and bean sauce and stir it well
22. When the pork and ginger have absorbed the red color from the bean sauce and become strongly aromatic , add the bowl containing the wine , soy sauce , salt and stock
23. Reduce heat and stir once
24. Add noodles
25. Simmer , stirring occasionally until the liquid is absorbed
26. Stir in green peppers with sesame oil
27. Serve immediately and enjoy !

title: heart healthy pizza topping
steps:
1. In a bowl , mix thoroughly tomato paste , water , basil , oregano , garlic powder and red peppers
2. Spread evenly over an unbaked 12 inch pizza crust
3. Layer green pepper , mushrooms , onions and other vegetables , if desired , evenly over sauce
4. Cover with shredded cheese
5. Bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes or until cheese is melted and crust lightly browned

title: cantaloupe  berry and pineapple smoothie
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a blender & mix , using the on / off pulse function until mostly blended , then continue mixing , gradually increasing the speed , until the mixture is smooth
2. Pour into 2 glasses & enjoy !

title: parsley pesto with sun dried tomatoes
steps:
1. In a food processor , place parsley and pulse briefly
2. Add sun dried tomatoes , pine nuts , garlic , lemon juice and salt , then pulse until almost smooth
3. Drizzle in olive oil and pulse again briefly to incorporate
4. Serve with pasta , sesame crackers or walnut crackers

title: herbes de provence new potatoes
steps:
1. Place potatoes in stockpot & cover with salted water
2. Bring to boil over high heat
3. Cook 8-10 minutes until potatoes are just tender
4. Drain and set aside
5. In large skillet , heat oil over medium heat
6. Add herbs de provence
7. Cook , stirring constantly , 10-15 seconds
8. Add drained potatoes , coarse salt , and lemon juice
9. Toss to coat
10. Cook 2-3 minutes & remove from heat
11. Sprinkle with pepper and flaked sea salt

title: climax explosion
steps:
1. Build over ice in a pilsner glass , adding all spirits
2. Fill with mango juice
3. Garnish with green mango wedge or lime slice
4. Emjoy !
5. )

title: chef flower s cheat chicken parmigiana
steps:
1. Spray olive oil on a heated non-stick pan
2. Place chicken on pan and panfry the pre-made chicken schnitzels until both sides are golden brown
3. Once it is cooked place the cooked chicken schnitzel into an greased ovenproof dish and repeat steps until all the schnitzels are cooked
4. Spread your favourite pasta sauce individually on to the chicken
5. Then sprinkle your chosen cheese on the chicken to cover the top of the chicken
6. Garnish it lightly it with a sprinkle of dried or fresh parsley
7. Bake at 160 degrees celsius uncovered until cheese is melted and lightly browned
8. Serve with a green salad or seasonal vegetables and garlic bread

title: easy pollo guisado
steps:
1. In a large pot boil chicken for about 45 minutes
2. While chicken is cooking , in a large bowl , add all other ingredients except 2 cup of water
3. Stir and set aside
4. Drain chicken , rinse in cold water , cut into strips
5. Set aside
6. Place vegetables / seasoning mixture into the large pot with the 2 cups of water
7. Heat to boiling
8. Once boiling , turn to low
9. Add chicken and let it simmer for 1 hour
10. Stir every 10-15 minutes
11. Remove from heat
12. Let stand for 5-10 minutes
13. Remove bay leaves , and serve

title: caesar burgers
steps:
1. In a large bowl beat egg , add beef , half of the parmesan , lemon juice , anchovy paste , worcestershire sauce and pepper
2. Mix lightly by hand
3. Shape into four thick hamburger patties
4. Grease grill , heat to medium high
5. Place burgers on grill and cook for 10 minutes
6. Flip burgers once and heat for another 10 minutes or until no longer pink inside
7. In a small bowl whisk oil with garlic
8. Cut kaiser rolls in half , brush garlic oil on each cut side , place on grill and toast until golden brown
9. Place burgers on rolls , sprinkle with remaining parmesan and top with lettuce , tomato and onion slices

title: clear spinach and tomato soup ww friendly core
steps:
1. In a 3-quart saucepan over medium heat , saute the onions and garlic in the oil for 3 minutes , or until the onions look translucent
2. Add the broth and bring to boil
3. Reduce the heat to medium low , add the past and simmer for 10 minutes
4. Stir in the spinach and tomatoes
5. Simmer for 5 minutes
6. Stir in the basil and pepper
7. Serve with the parmesan if desired

title: veal and sage meatballs and pasta with gorgonzola walnut sauce
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f
2. Place water on to boil for pasta
3. When it comes to a boil , salt the water and cook pasta to al dente
4. Drain
5. While pasta is working , place veal in a mixing bowl and add to it the egg , garlic , sage , bread crumbs , cheese , nutmeg and salt and pepper , to taste
6. Drizzle a little extra-virgin olive oil into the bowl , mix and roll small 1-inch balls
7. Arrange balls in a single layer on a nonstick cookie sheet and bake 8 to 10 minutes in a hot oven until meat is golden and firm
8. Toast the walnuts and place them into a food processor
9. Grind the walnuts and reserve
10. In a deep skillet over medium heat melt butter
11. Whisk flour into butter and cook a minute then whisk in wine and reduce by half
12. Whisk in stock , when it bubbles and begins to reduce , stir in the cream and reduce heat to medium low
13. Simmer to thicken the sauce a bit , 2 to 3 minutes , melt in the gorgonzola and stir in the ground walnuts then season the sauce with pepper , to taste , and maybe a pinch of salt
14. Shred the greens into thin strips
15. Toss the pasta with the sauce
16. Serve pasta garnished and topped with a generous mound of greens to mix in as you are eating

title: indonesian honey baked beans
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300f
2. Combine all ingredients in a 2 1 / 2 quart casserole
3. Add just enough water to cover
4. Bake 1 1 / 2 hours adding more water if needed

title: nutritious food enhancer
steps:
1. Wash , peel , and cut food
2. Put raw food through a juicer , if you have one
3. If not , just move on to the next step
4. Put juice and pulp into a blender or food processor and process until it's smooth and moves freely or is pureed enough for your needs
5. Put the raw veggie puree into sterilized mason jars and freeze for up to 3 months
6. I use small jars , so i can take them out one at a time
7. Once thawed , they're good for a week
8. Put a little into just about anything: sauces , cereals , drinks , and spreads
9. Anyplace you can hide it will work !

title: greek meatballs in tomato yogurt mint sauce
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , combine the egg , lamb , 1 / 4 cup yogurt and the next 7 ingredients
2. Mix well
3. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes
4. Form lamb mixture into 1-inch meatballs
5. Place on a rimmed baking sheet
6. Bake in a 400 degree oven for about 15 minutes or until browned
7. Lower oven temperature to 350 degrees
8. Transfer meatballs to a 2 1 / 2 quart baking dish that has been coated with cooking spray
9. In a small bowl , whisk the tomato sauce , remaining yogurt , and mint
10. Pour sauce over meatballs
11. Cover and bake 30 minutes
12. Uncover and bake until bubbly
13. Garnish with mint leaves

title: oven roasted cabbage
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 425f
2. Combine salt , pepper , and sugar in small bowl
3. Set aside
4. Cutting option 1- quarter cabbage through core and cut each quarter in to 1-inch wedges , leaving core intact
5. You'll have about 16 wedges
6. Cutting option 2- slice into 1-inch-thick rounds , leaving core in to help hold it together
7. Brush a rimmed baking sheet with 1 tablespoon olive oil
8. Arrange cabbage in single layer on baking sheet and brush with remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil
9. Sprinkle with salt mixture
10. Roast until cabbage is tender and edges are golden , 25 to 35 minutes
11. Sprinkle hot cabbage with balsamic vinegar if using

title: lettuce  satay  together
steps:
1. Rinse butterleaves under cool water
2. Shake off excess water and reserve
3. Using a zip lock baggie mix beef in 1 tablespoon of hoisin sauce
4. Add 1 / 2 ounce ground ginger
5. Allow to marinate i refridgerator for 15 minutes while you prepare the pork and chicken
6. Use another ziplock baggie and place chicken , chinese 5-spice , & garlic and marinate for 10 minutes in the fridge
7. Using a third baggie , toss in the pork , ginger , and a tablespoon of hoisin sauce
8. Marinate for 5 minutes in the fridge
9. Preheat oven to 375
10. Retrieve baggies from the fridge and empty on a parchment-lined sheetpan being careful to keep the meats separate from each other , about 15 minutes
11. In the meantime , let's make the peanut sauce
12. With the remaining peanut butter and hoisin sauce , mix in a blender with cilantro and slowly add water until smooth and pourable
13. To assemble: take a plate and arrange the butterlettuce leaves along outer edge
14. Place beef , chicken , and pork in separate piles
15. Fill a ramekin or fingerbowl with peanut sauce and place alongside of plate
16. Finally , place teaspoon of chili paste on the plte where it can be accessed so you increase the spicyness of of the wraps
17. Use the butterlettuce leaves like a taco shell
18. Just fill , dip and eat ! enjoy !

title: jam filled oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. To make the sour milk , mix the milk and lemon juice together in a small bowl and set aside until needed
2. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
3. In a large bowl add the flour , baking soda , salt , oats , cinnamon and brown sugar together
4. Next add the melted butter and shortening , mixing lightly
5. Lastly , slowly add in the sour milk , making sure to mix well
6. Chill the dough for 1 / 2 hour
7. Then on a lightly floured board , roll to 1 / 4 inch thick
8. Cut the dough using a 2" round cookie cutter
9. Make sure to have an even number of cookie rounds
10. Place a spoonful of jam in the center of the cookie , then top with another cookie
11. Make sure to lightly press the edges together
12. Roll the cookie edges in the ground nuts
13. Place on a lightly greased cookie sheet and bake in a 350 degree oven for 10 - 12 minutes

title: soft gluten free naan bread  indian flatbread
steps:
1. If using milk , whether cow's or rice milk , with vinegar , mix and set aside for 15 minutes until thick
2. If it does not reach the consistency of butter milk , use less than 1 / 2 cup
3. Add warm water to a medium sized bowl
4. Add sugar or honey
5. Stir to dissolve
6. Add yeast
7. Stir
8. And set aside until frothy , about 5 minutes
9. If it does not bubble start over with fresh yeast
10. In a large bowl , add remaining dry ingredients
11. Whisk thoroughly
12. Add buttermilk , beaten eggs , to yeast mixture
13. Whisk well
14. Add dry ingredients to wet ingredients
15. Using a rubber spatula , stir until it reaches a soft dough the consistency of creamy mashed potatoes
16. Allow to rest for 20 minutes
17. Scatter 2 tablespoons potato starch to a clean , flat surface
18. Scoop 1 / 3 cup at a time of dough
19. Add to floured surface
20. Knead with dusted hands
21. Shape into a disk as wide as your spatula
22. Using a wide , thin spatula , transfer to preheated cast iron skillet
23. Using the back of your fingers or a pastry roller dusted with starch , immediately flatten and distribute dough in pan working from the center , moving outwards
24. Fry on each side for approximately 2 1 / 2 minutes
25. Coat tops of fully cooked naan with salted butter
26. Repeat with remaining dough adding additional potato starch as needed for kneading
27. Serve warm and store uncooked dough covered in the refrigerator for up to 3 days

title: creamsicle gelatin
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine gelatin and boiling water
2. Stir until gelatin is completely dissolved
3. With a wire whisk , beat in yogurt until mixture is smooth
4. Refrigerate about 1 1 / 2 hours or just until slightly thickened
5. Stir in orange segments and pineapple
6. Spoon into decorative bowl or individual parfait glasses
7. Cover and refrigerate 1 more hour or until set
8. Serve with a little whipped cream and a sprinkle of coconut if desired

title: pea salad  very pretty
steps:
1. Get a large bowl , and mix everything together gently but thoroughly , seasoning to taste
2. Chill for a couple of hours before serving to allow the flavours to develop

title: bistro naturals jambalaya
steps:
1. Saute onions , garlic , peppers and celery in oil , add sausage and continue to saute
2. Add tomatoes , chicken broth , bay leaves and cayenne and simmer on low for 30 minutes
3. Add rice and cook till tender
4. Finally add shrimp and simmer until shrimp is cooked , approximately 4-5 minutes

title: swedish crispbread  knckebrd
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast in the water
2. Add salt and fennel / aniseed
3. Add rye and enough wheat flour to make a quite firm dough
4. Knead vigorously for at least five minutes
5. Divide into 16 parts and roll to balls
6. Let rise , covered , for 40 minutes
7. Heat the oven to maximum heat
8. Roll out one piece at a time to a thin circle , 8-10 inches in diameter
9. Use plenty of rye flour when rolling
10. Make a one-inch hole in the middle
11. Prick the surface all over with a fork
12. Bake one at a time on a dry tray in the oven for about 2-4 minutes
13. They should get brown , but not too burnt
14. Slip them on a stick through the hole in the middle to cool
15. Store in a dry place and eat with butter , cheese and / or pickled herring , maybe together with beer and aquavit

title: black coffee cake
steps:
1. Mix all dry ingredients
2. Add eggs , oil , coffee and milk and mix
3. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 350 degrees

title: grilled salmon and asparagus salad
steps:
1. Heat gas or charcoal grill
2. In small bowl , mix all maple-dijon dressing ingredients with wire whisk
3. Cut salmon crosswise into 4 pieces
4. Brush salmon with 1 tablespoon of the dressing
5. In large bowl , toss asparagus and 1 tablespoon of the dressing
6. Place asparagus in grill basket
7. When grill is heated , place asparagus and salmon , skin side down , on gas grill over medium heat or on charcoal grill over medium coals
8. Cover grill
9. Cook asparagus 7 to 10 minutes and salmon 10 to 15 minutes , shaking grill basket or turning asparagus occasionally , until asparagus is crisp-tender and salmon flakes easily with fork
10. Slide pancake turner between salmon and skin to remove each piece from skin
11. On 4 plates , divide salad greens , carrots and egg
12. Top with asparagus then the salmon
13. Sprinkle with pepper
14. Serve with remaining dressing

title: swordfish     bbq grilled swordfish
steps:
1. Thaw the fish if frozen , rinse and pat dry with a paper towel
2. Place the fish in a shallow glass bowl
3. For the marinate:
4. Combine orange juice , lemon juice , garlic clove minced , lime juice , cooking oil and ground ginger in a bowl
5. Add the swordfish cover at room temperature for 30 minutes or put in frig if you want to marinate for a longer period
6. Turn the swordfish at least twice
7. Discard marinate when finished
8. For the grill: heat to medium , grill for 7-8 minutes on each side
9. For the broiler: broil for 5-7 minutes each side
10. For the oven: heat oven to 350 bake for 20-30 minutes or desired texture
11. For the salsa:
12. Stir together the orange , pineapple , onion , sweet pepper , parsley , 2 tablespoons lime juice and jalapeno pepper
13. Cover and chill !
14. Serve with salsa on the fish

title: double chocolate double almond brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 and grease and flour a 9x13" baking pan
2. Grate the chilled almond paste into medium bowl , using the large hole side of a grater
3. Add the brownie mix and the chocolate chips to the almond paste
4. Mix with finger
5. Beat the eggs , oil and water called for on brownie box in separate bowl
6. Add the liquid ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir with spoon until well mixed
7. Spread prepared batter into prepared pan and bake according to time listed on box , adding 2-3 minutes
8. Garnish with toasted almonds , if using
9. Cool on wire rack
10. Serve warm with chocolate almond chip ice cream and chocolate syrup for a real down home dessert

title: devil s love slave cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease a 13x9 cake pan , and dust with cocoa powder
3. Prepare cake mix as stated on the box , but adding the cherry extract into the mix
4. Pour into prepared pan , and bake until done , approximately 30 minutes
5. Turn oven off
6. Remove from oven , and let cool 3 minutes
7. Pour chocolate chips evenly over surface of cake , allowing to melt a bit
8. Put cake in oven for about 3 minutes until the chips are glossy
9. Remove cake from warm oven , and spread melting chips over the cake in a thick , even layer
10. Let cool
11. Serve to anyone you wish to make your love slave !

title: rich white cake with strawberry frosting
steps:
1. Cream butter and shortening , gradually add sugar , beating well on medium speed
2. Combine water and milk in small bowl , set aside
3. Combine flour , baking powder and salt , add to creamed mixture alternately with milk mixture , beginning and ending with flour mixture
4. Stir in flavorings
5. Beat egg whites , , til stiff peaks form
6. Gently fold into batter
7. Pour batter into 3 greased and floured 9" round cake pans
8. Bake at 350 for 20 minutes , or til toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
9. Cool in pans 10 minutes , remove from pans and cool completely on wire racks
10. Spread frosting between layers , sides and top of cake
11. Garnish with whole strawberries if desired
12. Strawberry frosting:
13. Thaw berries , place in a strainer
14. Slightly mash , and let drain to measure 2 / 3 cup strawberry pulp
15. Combine pulp and remaining ingredients in top of double-boiler , place over boiling water
16. Beat at high speed for 7 minutes
17. Remove from heat
18. Makes enough frosting for a 3-layer cake

title: millionaires
steps:
1. In a saucepan , melt caramels in milk over low heat
2. Remove from heat and stir in pecans until well combined
3. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto buttered waxed paper
4. Chill until firm
5. Melt chocolate chips and shortening or wax in a heavy saucepan , double boiler or in microwave
6. Remove from heat
7. Dip chilled candy into chocolate , covering completely
8. Return to waxed paper and chill

title: grilled pb j
steps:
1. Its cooked like a grilled cheese
2. With a slight amount of butter on both sides of the bread and in the pan , you cook it on low in a frying pan
3. Of course with peanut butter & jelly in between the bread

title: simple sour cream zucchini potato beef meal
steps:
1. Spray a stainless steel cookie cooling rack with the olive oil spray
2. Lay the oven fries with space apart from each other on the rack
3. Place carefully in an oven to bake according to the package's directions
4. Bake until edges on both sides are browned
5. If you're unable to find the alexia oven fries , spray the fries with olive oil and coat with rosemary and garlic powder
6. While baking the oven fries , spray a skillet with the olive oil spray and cook the ground chuck
7. Before the meat's browned , add the zucchini
8. Cook the zucchini and meat mix until lightly browned
9. Set aside
10. When the potatoes are done , place the zucchini and meat mix on top the "bed" of potatoes
11. On the side of the plate , place the sour cream as a "dip"
12. You can mix the sour cream into the mix but i find it looses some of its flavor
13. Enjoy !

title: everything seasoning blend
steps: 1. Combine all ingredients and place in a small air tight container or spice jar

title: homemade brown bread
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine the first four ingredients
2. Cool to 110-115
3. In a bowl , dissolve yeast in warm water
4. Sprinkle with sugar
5. Add oat mixture , brown sugar , molasses and 3 cups flour
6. Mix well
7. Add enough remaining flour to form a soft dough
8. Turn onto a floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic , about 6-8 minutes
9. Place in a greased bowl
10. Turn once to grease top
11. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled , about 1 hour
12. Punch dough down
13. Divide in half
14. Shape into loaves
15. Place in two greased 9-in
16. X 5-in
17. Loaf pans
18. Cover and let rise until doubled , about 30-45 minutes
19. Bake at 375 for 30-35 minutes or until golden brown
20. Remove from pans
21. Cool on wire racks
22. Brush with butter
23. Yield: 2 loaves

title: warren s stuffed bell peppers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Clean peppers
3. Slice off tops and discard stems
4. Chop up top
5. Mix all loose ingredients in large bowl
6. Include chopped pepper
7. Load up peppers with meat mixture
8. Place in dutch oven
9. Cover with sauce
10. Bake covered for one hour and 15 minutes

title: bedtime butterscotch
steps: 1. Add ingredients to a small cocktail glass with ice cubes , stir and enjoy

title: delicious peachy coffee cake
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a 8-inch square baking pan
3. In a large mixing bowl , mix together the flour , oil , sugar , cinnamon and nutmeg until crumbly
4. Remove 1 / 2 cup of the mixture
5. Set aside
6. Add in the remaining ingredients
7. Stir just until mixed
8. Pour / transfer the batter into prepared baking pan
9. Spoon the pie filling evenly over top of the batter
10. Sprinkle the reserved flour mixture over the top of the batter and the pie filling
11. Bake for 50 minutes , or until cake tests done with a wooden pick
12. Serve warm-- delicious !

title: anise candy
steps:
1. Boil sugar , syrup and water until hard crack stage when dipped in cold water
2. Remove from heat
3. Add flavoring and food color
4. Shake pan to mix , do not stir
5. Pour onto a cooking sheet and cut at once

title: chocolate peanut butter fudge crunch
steps:
1. Line an 8 inch square baking pan with parchment paper
2. In a medium saucepan , melt half of the chocolate and 1 tablespoon butter over low heat
3. Remove from the heat
4. Stir in 1 cup peanut butter , then 2 cups rice cereal
5. Spread the mixture evenly in the prepared pan
6. Refrigerate until set , about 15 minutes
7. Wash out the saucepan
8. In the saucepan , combine the remaining 2 sticks butter and the salt
9. Melt over medium heat , stirring
10. Remove from the heat and stir in the remaining peanut butter and the powdered sugar
11. Spread half of the peanut butter mixture over the cereal layer
12. Top with the remaining 1 cup of cereal
13. In a small bowl , microwave the remaining chocolate at medium power until melted , about 1 1 / 2 minutes
14. Stir into the remaining peanut butter mixture
15. Spread evenly on the cereal topped peanut butter layer
16. Refrigerate until set , about 45 minutes
17. Cut into 16 pieces

title: rj s chicken fajitas
steps:
1. Slice chicken breast into strips and place in a container along with garlic , 2 tbsp oil , lime juice , worcestershire , and beer
2. Mix thoroughly and refrigerate for 30 to 60 minutes
3. Saut fresh vegetables in 3 tablespoons oil for 5 to 7 minutes until crisp tender
4. Salt and pepper to taste
5. Remove vegetables from heat and keep warm in a separate container
6. In the same pan cook the chicken with the marinade on med high heat
7. When chicken is nearly done add the in the sauted vegetables and season with the spices
8. Cook until chicken no longer pink in center
9. Reserve cooking liquid in separate pot and add cold water and cornstarch
10. Bring sauce to a simmer for a few minutes , until thick , and then stir into fajita mixture
11. Serve with hot tortillas , sour cream , guacamole , shredded cheese , shredded lettuce , and pico de gallo
12. Enjoy with an ice cold pilsner lager

title: roasted salmon with wasabi cream
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees
2. Sprinkle a large roasting pan with olive oil
3. Lay the salmon in the pan with the skin-side down
4. Rub a thin slick of oil over the salmon and season with salt
5. Roast until just cooked through , 20 to 30 minutes
6. Meanwhile , dissolve wasabi powder in 8 teaspoons of water
7. Whisk into sour cream and season to taste with salt
8. Add more wasabi if desired
9. Serve with salmon

title: curried noodles with pork
steps:
1. Soak rice noodles in a bowl of hot water for 20 minutes
2. Drain well
3. Cut onion into 1 / 4 inch strips
4. Heat the oil in a wok , add the onion and cook on high heat until onion is soft
5. Add curry powder , salt and noodles
6. Mix well
7. Add the peas , coconut milk and soy sauce , toss to combine
8. Reduce heat , cover and cook on low for 3 minutes
9. Stir in pork and heat for another 1-2 minute

title: stupid easy pizza puff
steps:
1. Criss cross cut the 2 cans of fluffy biscuits , and throw into 8x8 glass baking pan
2. Cover biscuits with 1 1 / 2 cans of spaghetti sauce
3. Cover with 1 cup of shredded cheese
4. Add rest of spaghetti sauce and stir entire mixture covering all biscuits completely
5. Cover with cheese and bake at 350 degrees until cheese in center is brown and bubbly and biscuits are no longer doughy

title: periperi  portuguese hot sauce
steps:
1. Combine the ingredients , let stand for a month or two
2. Use liberally on everything

title: linda s once baked biscotti
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in order listed
2. Grease and flour a cookie sheet
3. Form the dough into a rounded loaf
4. If the loaf is a bit flat , it's no problem- just decrease the cooking time slightly
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour
6. Slice loaf with a heavy knife
7. Don't worry if there is some crumbling as you slice
8. Once the loaf cools , the slices will firm up and stay together

title: kittencal s easy lemon garlic sauteed shrimp
steps:
1. Heat olive oil and butter over medium-high heat
2. Add in garlic and cayenne pepper , saute stirring for about 2 minutes or until softened
3. Add in wine and bring to a boil over medium heat
4. Simmer uncovered until reduced by at least half
5. Add in shrimp then drizzle the juice of 1 lemon over the shrimp
6. Stir until the shrimp turn translucent (about 2-3 minutes season with salt and fresh ground black pepper to taste
7. Immediately remove the pan from the heat then sprinkle with fresh parsley

title: bodacious bbq baby back ribs
steps:
1. Cover ribs with water in a large saucepan
2. Bring to a boil , then lower heat , cover , and simmer for one hour , or until ribs are tender
3. Mix all ingrediants in saucepan and bring to a boil , lower heat , and simmer for 30 minutes , until sauce has slightly thickened
4. Preheat broiler
5. Line broiler pan with foil
6. Place ribs on foil , meat side down , and baste with sauce
7. Broil for 6 minutes , then turn ribs over
8. Baste with remaining sauce and broil for an additional 6 to 7 minutes
9. Serve with bbq beans and corn on the cob and your palette will be especially pleased !

title: eggplant  aubergine  spread
steps:
1. In skillet , over medium heat , in hot oil , cook eggplant , onion , and garlic about 15 minutes or until eggplant is tender , stirring often
2. In covered blender or food processor , blend eggplant mixture till smooth
3. In medium bowl , combine eggplant mixture , vegetable juice , pine nuts , parsley , soy sauce , sugar and pepper
4. Stir until thoroughly mixed
5. Cover
6. Chill until serving time , at least 2 hours
7. Serve with pita bread wedges

title: tomatoes provencale
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a 8-in square baking dish
3. Fry bacon until crisp
4. Drain on paper towel
5. Reserve drippings in skillet , set aside
6. Saute garlic , onions and mushrooms in skillet , until tender
7. Stir in reserved bacon , flour and seasoning salt , set aside
8. Cut tomatoes into 1 / 2-in slices
9. Place half of the slices into prepared baking dish
10. Spoon half of bacon / onion mixture over tomatoes
11. Sprinkle with 3 tbsp
12. Parmesan cheese
13. Repeat layers
14. Dot with butter
15. Bake for 25 minutes

title: sauce for fish tacos
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients and let sit 1 / 2 hour to let flavors develop
2. If you like your sauce a little thinner just add a bit of milk or water and mix it

title: chicken chipotle
steps:
1. Put the chicken breasts , onion , garlic cloves and 1 tablespoon of salt in large pot and add water to cover
2. Bring to a boil , then reduce to a simmer and cook 20 minutes
3. Drain well
4. While chicken is cooking , preheat the oven to 325 degrees farenheit and grease a 9x13 baking dish
5. Combine the cream cheese , milk , chiles and salt and blend well , then season to taste with salt and pepper
6. Place the chicken in the baking dish and pour the sauce over the top
7. Sprinkle with paprika and bake 20 minutes

title: holiday cran raspberry jello
steps:
1. Boil 2 cups of water , add to jello , and stir untill dissolved
2. Add cranberry sauce , use electric mixer to blend and dissolved sauce
3. Add 1 cup os ice , stirring untill ice melts , than add the second cup of ice ,
4. Slowly
5. When jello starts to thicken , remove extra ice pieces
6. Lightly blend in sour cream with a mixer , but dont mix thoroughly
7. Stir in oranges and nuts
8. Spray jello mold with pam spray and fill with jello mixture
9. Let set inches
10. Refrigerator for 2 hours
11. Place onto holiday dish and garnish with more oranges or parsley

title: grammie bea s herbed dumplings
steps:
1. Mix together
2. Drop dumplings into the edge of the soup pan using a lg
3. Tablespoon
4. Cook dumplings in soup with the cover off for the first 10 mins
5. , then cook with cover on for 10 minutes

title: self saucing chocolate pudding  slow cooker
steps:
1. Preheat slow cooker for 20 minutes on high
2. Grease the slow cooker bowl
3. In a separate bowl , combine the first 7 ingredients mixing or whisking well together
4. Sift brown sugar and extra cocoa powder over mixture
5. Using a spoon , gently and evenly pour the boiling water over the mixture
6. Cook on high for 2 1 / 2 hours , or until centre is firm
7. Serve with sifted icing sugar and ice cream or cream

title: perini  ranch steakhouse chili
steps:
1. Brown chili meat , onion and garlic in a heavy skillet , over medium-high heat
2. Add oregano , chili powder , cumin , tomatoes , picante sauce ,
3. And hot water
4. Bring to a boil , lower the heat and simmer about an hour
5. Add jalapeno , salt and pepper and cook an additional 15 minutes

title: punajuuripihvit    finnish beet steaks
steps:
1. Dip beets in beaten egg , then sprinkle half of the bread crumbs onto a paper towel
2. Place beet slices on the crumbs & sprinkle with remaining crumbs
3. In a skillet , over medium-low heat , melt butter , then saute beet slices , turning to brown each side , about 3 minutes for each side
4. Place on a serving platter & sprinkle with lemon juice & parsley

title: hot cold salad
steps:
1. Hard boil the eggs
2. Cool slightly and chop into cubes
3. Put the potatoes on to boil for about 20 minutes or for as long as you see fit
4. Meanwhile cut the tomatoes into small cubes , season with salt and olive oil
5. Set aside
6. When potatoes are ready , peel them and , while still hot cut , cut them into small cubes
7. Salt the potatoes , add a bit of butter or margarine and wait a second until it melts
8. Combine all ingredients in a bowl
9. Mix and serve while the potatoes are still very warm and the tomatoes are cold

title: traditional shortbread
steps:
1. Mix the flour and sugar first , and then rub in the butter
2. Knead the mixture until it becomes a smooth paste
3. Roll out till about 3 / 4 inch thick or 2cm thick
4. Cut into rectangles and decorate the top with a fork creating rows of holes
5. Transfer to a greased baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes at 160c
6. They want to stay pale and light golden
7. In warm weather you may want to chill the cookies before baking
8. This recipe can also be used for petticoat tails
9. Just split the mixture in two and flatten into 7 inch rounds about a half inch thick
10. Mark top into 8 portions and decorate with a fork
11. Bake for 30 minutes
12. To use a shortbread mold: mix a teaspoon of flour and a teaspoon of caster sugar
13. Grease the mold with oil and evenly sprinkle half the flour / sugar mix
14. Press the shortbread into the mold , and turn out onto a baking sheet before baking

title: mexican coffee balls
steps:
1. Crush chocolate wafers into crumbs
2. Mix with ground blanched almonds , unsweetened cocoa powder , and sugar
3. Dissolve instant coffee in coffee liqueur and stir into crumb mixture with the light corn syrup
4. Shape into small balls and roll in cinnamon sugar
5. Store in refrigerator

title: orange cranberry scones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f , & grease a 9-inch round cake pan
2. In a mixing bowl , mix flour , 3 tablespoons sugar , baking powder & orange zest
3. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs , then stir in mandarin oranges & cranberries
4. In another bowl , mix sour cream , egg , orange juice & vanilla , beating until smooth
5. Stir this sour cream mixture into the flour mixture until well mixed
6. Spread batter into prepared pan & sprinkle with the 1 tablespoon of sugar
7. Bake 28-32 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean & scone is lightly browned
8. Cool 5 minutes in pan , then remove from pan & cut into wedges
9. Best served warm , but any leftovers should be refrigerated

title: chanel no  6
steps:
1. Pour vodka , chambord and chilled pineapple juice into a champagne glass
2. Top with well-chilled champagne
3. Add a fresh raspberry

title: arby s oven baked curly fries
steps:
1. Cut potatoes into curly fries using a curly fry cutter , or cut potatoes into regular fries
2. Bring a large pot of water to a boil
3. Put potatoes in boiling water and boil for 3 minutes
4. Rinse potatoes off in a colander with cold water
5. Dry potatoes with paper towels and set aside
6. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f
7. When oven lets you know you are at the correct temperature , combine paprika , salt , garlic powder , onion powder , cayenne pepper , flour and egg substitute in a small bowl
8. Add in milk and mix well
9. Pour fries into a large bowl and add seasoning mixture
10. Mix well
11. Dump fries onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and spread around evenly
12. Bake for 30-35 minutes , flipping every ten minutes so they become nice and crispy

title: pink lemonade cheesecake
steps:
1. Make the crust: in a small bowl , stir the crushed cookies and melted butter together until well combined
2. Press crumb mixture evenly onto the bottom of a greased 9-inch springform pan
3. Set aside
4. Make the filling: in a large bowl , combine the cream cheese , sugar , and cornstarch
5. Beat with an electric mixer until smooth
6. Add in eggs and egg yolk , one at a time , beating well after each addition
7. Beat in the lemonade concentrate , vanilla , and red food coloring
8. Pour cream cheese mixture over the crust
9. Bake in a preheated 350 oven for 15 minutes
10. Decrease temperature to 200 and bake for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until the center no longer looks wet or shiny
11. Remove the cake from the oven and run a knife around the inside edge of the pan
12. Turn the oven off
13. Return the cake to the oven for an additional 1 hour
14. Chill , uncovered , overnight
15. Make the glaze: in a small saucepan , stir the lemonade concentrate , lemon juice , cornstarch , and food coloring together
16. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly
17. Cool and stir 2 minutes more
18. Pour over cheesecake
19. Garnish with lemon
20. Chill until ready to serve

title: orange blueberry bread
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl combine all the ingredients except the blueberries
2. Mix at low speed until well blended , then beat at medium speed for 2-minutes
3. Fold in the blueberries
4. Turn into a loaf pan which is greased on thebottom only
5. Bake at 350-f for 60-70 minutes until done
6. Cool 10 minutes then remove pan and let cool fully before slicing

title: california caesar salad with eggs
steps:
1. In a blender or a food processor combine all of the drained anchovy fillets with worcestershire sauce , wine vinegar , garlic , paprika , dried oregano and 1 tablespoon parmesan cheese
2. Blend on high speed until combined
3. With the motor running add in the oil season with black pepper to taste
4. Place the romaine lettuce in a large bowl , then add in the chopped eggs with croutons and about 1 / 2 cup parmesan cheese
5. Toss to combine
6. Pour the prepared dressing over the with lemon juice to taste
7. Toss well to combine and season with freshly lots gound black pepper
8. Sprinkle with grated mozzeralla cheese on top if desired
9. Delicious !

title: baked chickpea patties with lemon  herb yogurt sauce
steps:
1. In nonstick skillet heat oil over medium heat and cook onion , garlic , jalapeo , oregano and basil for about 5 minutes or until softened
2. Meanwhile , in bowl mash chickpeas using potato masher until smooth
3. Scrape onion mixture into bowl and stir to combine
4. Add egg white and parsley and stir until well combined and smooth
5. Divide mixture into 4 equal portions and form into 1 / 2-inch thick patties
6. Place patties on parchment paper lined baking sheet and bake in 425 f oven for about 20 minutes , turning once halfway through or until golden
7. Lemon herb yogurt sauce: meanwhile , in bowl , stir together yogurt , parsley , mint , garlic , lemon rind and salt
8. Serve with chickpea patties

title: mushroom crab asparagus tart
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Spray bottom and side of 12-inch tart pan with removable bottom or 13x9-inch glass baking dish with cooking spray
3. Cook asparagus as directed on box
4. Drain and cool
5. Meanwhile , in 12-inch skillet , melt butter over medium heat
6. Add mushrooms
7. Cook about 5 minutes , stirring frequently , just until tender
8. Stir in bread crumbs , parmesan cheese , and pepper
9. Press mushroom mixture evenly in bottom and up side of sprayed tart pan or in bottom of sprayed baking dish
10. Sprinkle shredded cheese over mushrooms
11. Top with asparagus and crabmeat
12. In medium bowl or blender , place spreadable cheese , eggs and 1 tablespoon of the parsley
13. Beat with electric mixer on medium speed or cover and blend on low speed until smooth
14. Pour evenly over crabmeat
