15. Bake at 375f for 30 to 35 minutes or until set in center and edges are golden brown
16. Sprinkle remaining tablespoon parsley over top
17. Let stand 10 minutes before serving
18. Carefully remove side of pan
19. Cut into wedges or squares

title: spinach and feta pizza
steps:
1. In large non-stick skillet , heat oil over medium high heat
2. Add onions
3. Once onions begin to brown reduce heat to low
4. Continue to cook onions until soft and caramelized
5. This should take a total of 20-30 minutes
6. Roll dough out
7. Spread pesto
8. Layer remaining ingredients and onions over sauce
9. Bake according to dough directions

title: no bake apple pie
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , combine the apples , 1 cups water , gelatin , cinnamon and nutmeg
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat
4. Cover and simmer 4-6 minutes or until apples are tender
5. Combine the pudding mix and remaining water
6. Add to apple mixture
7. Cook for 1 minute or until thickened
8. Remove from the heat
9. Pour into the crust
10. Refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving
11. Garnish with whipped topping

title: autumn apple salad with pomegranate
steps:
1. Heat oil in an 8&#8243
2. Inch skillet over medium heat
3. Add shallot and saut until soft and clear or for approx 4 minutes
4. Remove from heat and add vinegar and honey
5. Taste and season with salt and freshly ground pepper
6. Toss lettuce and apples
7. Drizzle 1 / 2 of the dressing and toss again
8. Divide salad among plates , top with goat cheese , pomegranate seeds , and remainder of dressing
9. Enjoy !

title: bisquick banana pancakes  chocolate chips
steps:
1. Mix all with a fork in order to break the banana into the rest of the batter
2. Mix until smooth
3. Grease griddle and cook em up !
4. If using chocolate chips , sprinkle onto pancake while the first side is cooking

title: blueberry cheesecake muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Grease 8-10 muffins tins
3. In a large bowl combine with a wire whisk the flour , sugar , baking powder , and salt until well blended
4. In a medium-sized bowl beat together the almond extact , vanilla extract , melted butter , ricotta cheese , yogurt , and eggs
5. Add to flour mixture
6. Carefully fold in the blueberries
7. Batter wil be soft and lumpy
8. Fill the muffin cups 2 / 3 full and bake 20 minutes

title: prawn dip
steps:
1. Mix it all up
2. Eat !

title: my sausage breakfast burritos
steps:
1. Cook sausage in a medium hot skillet until no longer pink , add salsa and cook until most of the liquid is gone
2. ,
3. In another skillet scrample eggs lightly , before completely done , add to sausage / salsa mixture , set aside
4. Heat flour tortillas in a large skillet over high heat , turning twice , heating till tortilla is nice and soft
5. )
6. Place warm , flexable tortilla on serving plate , add 1 / 4 portion of egg / sausge mix on tortilla , top with 1 / 8 cup cheddar cheese , then roll burro style
7. If you like more spice , serve with more salsa , as well as sour cream and cilantro

title: french country chicken stew  crock pot
steps:
1. To prepare the soup substitute , combine all ingredients in a medium sized bowl and whisk until smooth
2. Make sure there are no lumps of dried milk as those will carry over to the sauce of the stew
3. You can omit this step by using a can of creamed soup
4. Prepare your crock pot with a light coating of cooking spray
5. Mix together the aromatics and place as a first layer in the bottom of the crock pot
6. If you are using mushrooms , layer on top of the aromatics
7. Place the chicken breasts on top of the vegetables
8. Combine the onion soup mix with the herbs and sprinkle on top of the chicken and vegetables
9. Pour soup substitute or canned soup on top
10. Cover and cook on high for 3 to 4 hours
11. Blend together the wine and cornstarch
12. Stir into the crock pot until well mixed and smooth
13. Cook uncovered on high for 15 to 20 minutes
14. Serve over rice or noodles

title: cocktail sauce  shrimp or any seafood
steps: 1. Mix all the ingredients together and chill

title: louisiana dirty rice   cajun style
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , bring the gizzards , chicken broth , and water to a boil
2. Reduce the heat to medium-low , cover , and simmer until the gizzards are tender , about 45 minutes
3. Reserving the broth , remove the gizzards , and when they are cool enough to handle , mince them and set them aside
4. In a dutch oven or flameproof casserole , cook the bacon over medium heat until crisp , about 10 minutes
5. Reserving the fat in the pan , drain the bacon on paper towels
6. Crumble and set aside
7. In the bacon fat , saute the gizzards over medium heat until browned , about 5 minutes
8. Add the green and red bell peppers , the onion , scallions , carrots , parsley , garlic , salt , pepper , and cayenne
9. Cook over medium heat until vegetables have softened , about 5 minutes
10. Add the rice and reserved broth
11. Increase the heat to medium-high and bring to a boil
12. Stir once , reduce heat to medium-low , cover , and simmer until the rice is tender , about 15 to 20 minutes
13. Meanwhile , in a medium skillet , melt the butter over medium heat
14. Add the chicken livers and saute until firm , about 5 minutes
15. Let the livers cool slightly , then coarsely chop them
16. Toss the chicken livers and bacon with the rice
17. Cover and let sit for 10 minutes before serving

title: liverwurst rumaki canapes
steps:
1. Blend the soy sauce and brown sugar into the liverwurst
2. Add the water chestnuts and mix thoroughly
3. Chill until ready to use
4. Spread on buttery crackers or buttered toast rounds and sprinkle the tops with the crumbled bacon

title: grand ole opry salad
steps:
1. Mix all the vegetables and set aside
2. In a saucepan , mix vinegar , oil and sugar
3. Bring to boil
4. Coll and then pour over other mixture
5. Marinate , covered for at least 24 hours

title: bleu cheese and roasted pecan salad
steps:
1. Place the greens on salad plates
2. Add the apple slices , then sprinkle pecans and cheese over each
3. Whisk the remaining ingredients together and sprinkle over salads

title: ranchy fried green tomatoes
steps:
1. Slice tomatoes
2. Thin for crisper slices or thick for softer slices
3. Mix ranch dressing and flour
4. I like the peppercorn dressing mix for this if you can find it
5. Dredge tomato slices in flour mixture
6. Fry in hot oil , until golden , turn over and repeat

title: zucchini ribbons with tomato sauce
steps:
1. Saute onion and garlic in olive oil
2. Add fresh tomatoes , sun-dried tomatoes , and juice
3. Simmer 15 minutes
4. Add red wine , spices
5. Boil zucchini in salted water for 15 seconds
6. Drain
7. Arrange ribbons on a platter , spoon sauce over and sprinkle with parm

title: taco roni skillet
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in large skillet over medium-high heat
2. Saute onion , garlic , and red pepper 3-5 minute or until soft
3. Add ground beef and cook until browned
4. Drain off any excess fat
5. Add spices and tomatoes and cook 5 minute
6. Stir in cooked macaroni , cheese , and evaporated skim milk
7. Cover and simmer 5 minute or until cheese melts

title: mrs paradine s lemon squares
steps:
1. Mix together the tin of condensed milk and the lemon juice in a small bowl
2. In a medium sized bowl crumble the soda biscuits with your fingers and then mix in the flour , brown sugar , and baking soda
3. Use a pastry cutter to cut in the butter until it is in small crumbs and then mix in the coconut if desired
4. Put 1 / 2 of the mixture in a 8x8x2 pan and pat it gently with your fingers
5. Spread over the milk mixture and then sprinkle the rest of the crumb mixture on top
6. Pop into a 350 oven for 30 minutes or until lightly browned on top
7. Let cool

title: chicken waldorf sandwiches  diabetic
steps:
1. Place the chicken breasts in a pan and cover with broth
2. Bring to a simmer and cook until done , about 8 to 10 minutes
3. Allow to cool in the broth , then cut into small dice
4. In a small bowl mix together the mayonnaise , sour cream , orange zest , and juice
5. Add the dressing to the chicken
6. Stir in the apple and celery
7. Place a leaf of lettuce on each of 6 slices of bread
8. Top with chicken salad and top with a second piece of bread
9. Refrigerate wrapped in plastic wrap , until ready to serve
10. Cut each sandwich in half
11. Exchanges per serving: 3 very lean protein , 2 carbohydrate
12. Nutrition facts: 286 calories , 34 g protein , 4 g total fat , 30 g carbohydrate , 2 g dietary fiber , 67 mg cholesterol , 479 mg sodium

title: no bake citrus cheesecake
steps:
1. Combine graham crumbs with melted butter
2. Press on bottom of 9 in
3. Springform pan
4. Dissolve jelly powder with boiling water in large glass bowl
5. Make sure jelly powder is completely dissolved before adding cream cheese
6. Blend in cream cheese with a hand mixer on low speed
7. Whisk in juice and rind of lemon and whipped topping
8. Pour over prepared crust
9. Smooth top
10. Chill 4 hrs

title: baked alaska ettes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f and grease muffin pan
2. Sift dry ingredients together
3. Beat the egg and cream together
4. Add vanilla
5. Pour into the dry ingredients , beating thoroughly
6. Bake until cakes test done and remove to a cooling rack
7. When cupcakes are cold , hollow out center and fill with ice cream
8. Level off with the back of spoon and completely blanket the top with halves of marshmallows
9. Preheat broiler
10. Place cake under hot broiler for 30 seconds , or until marshmallows are puffed and brown
11. Serve at once

title: family favorite kabobs
steps:
1. Place potatoes in a large saucepan and cover with water
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat
4. Cover and simmer for 15-18 minutes or until tender
5. Drain and cool slightly
6. Set aside
7. In a small bowl , combine the oil , lemon juice , worcestershire sauce , vinegar , soy sauce , mustard , parsley , pepper and garlic
8. Pour half into a large resealable plastic bag
9. Add the pork
10. Pour remaining marniade into another large resealable plastic bag , add the vegetables and pineapple
11. Seal both bags and turn to coat
12. Refrigerate for 2 hours
13. Drain and discard both marinades
14. On 12 metal or soaked wooden skewers , alternately thread pork with vegetables and pineapple
15. Grill , covered , over medium heat for 8-10 minutes on each side or until pork juices run clear

title: cloudberry cream
steps:
1. Whip the cream and sugar , add vanilla extract
2. Fold in the cloudberry jam
3. Pour into a nice bowl and decorate with cloudberries
4. May be served with krumkaker or almond flavored cookies or used between layers of a torte

title: grilled peanut butter and banana sandwich
steps:
1. Use 1 tbsp of peanut butter on each slice of bread
2. Put 1 / 2 the banana on 2 slices of bread , top with other 2 slices of bread making a sandwich
3. Using 1 tsbp of butter , butter the outside of each sandwich
4. Heat nonstick frypan on meidum hi heat , add 1 tbsp of butter , when butter is melted add sandwich and grill both sides until golden brown
5. Remove to a plate and sprinkle powder sugar on top
6. Serve immediately

title: clam dip appetizer
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine breadcrumbs , lemon , olive oil , and clams
2. In a frying pan over medium low heat , melt butter , add onion , garlic , and pepper , and saute five minutes
3. Stir in bacon , and cook an additonal five minutes
4. Stir into breadcrumb mixture
5. If filling clam shells: spoon about 2t mix into each clam shell , and top with a little bacon
6. Place filled shells on a cookie sheet or in a pyrex with about 1 / 4 inch water
7. Bake about 10 minutes at 350 degrees
8. If filling a casserole dish: spoon mixture into casserole dish , and bake uncovered for 15 minutes at 350 degrees
9. Serve with crackers
10. Change it up by adding a 1 / 2 c shredded mozzerella cheese and 2t grated parmeseano reggianno or pecorino ramano into the mix !

title: italian butterscotch cheesecake with a buttery pecan crust
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. To make the crust , pulverize the pecans in the food processor
3. Add the flour and the butter and whiz around until combined
4. Press the crust into a 10 inch springform pan
5. Bake in the oven for 10 minutes and then remove and cool
6. Keep the oven going , but turn it up to 425 degrees f
7. To make the filling , in an electric mixer mix the ricotta cheese with the brown sugar
8. Melt the butterscotch chips in the microwave or in a double boiler
9. Add to the cheese mixture and mix on medium speed until combined
10. Add the eggs , flour and vanilla
11. Mix until just combined
12. You don't want to incorporate too much air into the cheese since that will cause the cheesecake to crack
13. Pour the filling into the crust
14. Bake at 425 degrees f for 10 minutes
15. After 10 minutes , turn down the oven to 250 degrees f
16. Bake for one hour
17. Do not attempt to open the oven to peek at the cheesecake
18. After one hour , turn off the oven , and leave the cheesecake in there for an additional hour
19. Place the cheesecake in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours

title: persian apricot pudding
steps:
1. Have a 1 quart shallow bowl ready
2. Place rice in a blender container and blend until fine , about 1 minute
3. Place in a small bowl and add cornstarch and water
4. Stir to dissolve cornstarch
5. Place drained apricots in blender container
6. Blend until smooth
7. Add enough milk to apricots to total 4 cups
8. Pour into a small saucepan
9. Add sugar and rice mixture
10. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until mixture comes to a boil
11. Continue to cook and stir for 5 minutes
12. Remove from heat and stir in extracts
13. Pour pudding into bowl
14. Let cool at room temperature for 30 minutes , then chill throughly

title: grilled kielbasa sandwiches
steps:
1. Set grill to medium heat
2. In a blender or food processor blend the olive oil with the next 7 ingredients until emulsified
3. Toss the lettuce leaves with about half of the vinaigrette and reserve the remainder to brush on the buns
4. Grill tops and bottoms of the buns on a lightly oiled grill rack (about 2 minutes per side
5. Transfer cut-sides up to a platter or plate
6. Brush the cut sides of the top halves with remaining vinaigrette
7. On the bottom halves divide / mound the coated lettuce leaves
8. Cut the kielbasa sausage crosswise into 4 long sections , then half each section lenghwise
9. Grill the sausage slices on a lightly oiled grill rack about 3-4 minutes turning over once during cooking
10. Arrange 2 pieces of grilled sausage over the lettuce then top with sliced tomatoes
11. Cover with top half of the rolls
12. Delicious !

title: strawberry cream cheese bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees and spray a 9 x 13 inch baking pan with vegetable spray or non-stick cooking spray
2. In a large bowl , combine the cake mix , butter and 1 egg
3. Mix well
4. Press the mixture into bottom prepared pan
5. In a medium bowl , beat cream cheese with remaining eggs and sugar until mixture is smooth and well blended
6. Pour the mixture over cake mix batter and bake for 30 to 35 minutes until light brown on top
7. Cool , cut into bars and enjoy

title: warm peach french toast bake
steps:
1. Coat a 9- x 13-inch baking pan with cooking spray
2. Cut the baguette into half-inch-thick slices and arrange them in a single layer in the pan
3. In a medium bowl , whisk together the whole eggs , egg whites , milk and vanilla
4. Pour the egg mixture over the bread in the pan
5. Scatter the peach slices evenly over the bread
6. Sprinkle with the brown sugar and cinnamon
7. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight
8. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
9. Uncover and bake until slightly puffed and the bread is golden brown , about 40 minutes
10. If desired , top with yogurt and drizzle with maple syrup

title: bedouin tea
steps:
1. Heat 4 1 / 2 cups water with the thyme , cardamon pods , cinnamon stick and black tea
2. Simmer for five minutes
3. Turn off heat and steep for five minutes
4. Strain tea and serve with honey , if desired

title: tomatoey egg delight
steps:
1. Heat oil in a pan
2. Toss in the onions
3. Saute for 1 minute
4. Add tomatoes and cook on medium flame for 5 minutes or till they are softened and can be mashed
5. Add salt , ginger-garlic paste , red chilli powder , beaten eggs and mix well
6. Cover and cook for 5 minutes
7. Garnish with corriander leaves and serve hot
8. Enjoy !

title: garlicky sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Wrap each potato in plastic wrap
2. Prick each several times with a fork
3. Place in microwave for about 8 minutes
4. Turn potatoes over
5. Continue microwaving 15 minutes
6. Remove and unwrap
7. Mix remaining ingredients together
8. Season to taste
9. Slit potatoes open and top with mixture
10. Serve

title: golden fruitcake ii
steps:
1. Use a pair of scissors to chop the larger raisins and the apricots
2. Spraying the scissors with vegetable spray will prevent sticking
3. Soak the raisins , apricots , and citrus peel in the brandy or liqueur of choice overnight or for several days
4. Soaking the fruit makes the fruit plump and sticky but moist , sticky , glaced fruit is a must for fruitcakes
5. Before mixing , make sure all your ingredients are room temperature
6. Oven to 275 degrees f
7. Generously butter or spray with vegetable spray a 10" bundt pan
8. In a large mixing bowl , cream the butter and sugar until pale
9. Add the cream , then the eggs , one at a time , mixing well and scraping down the sides of the bowl after each addition
10. It may appear curdled- that's okay
11. Blend 2 cups of the flour with the baking powder and slowly mix into the creamed mixture
12. Add the almond and vanilla extracts and mix to combine
13. Toss the fruit and nuts with the remaining 1 / 4 cup of flour
14. Use a large wooden spoon or a rubber spatula to fold in the floured fruit and nuts
15. Spoon the batter into the pan , filling 2 / 3 full , and spreading out even in the pan
16. Tap the pan on the counter to eliminate air bubbles in the batter
17. Place the cake in the center of the oven and bake for approximately 90 minutes
18. Use a skewer to test the thickest part of the cake
19. The skewer should be dry and clean- if it is sticky or tacky , the cake is not done
20. Remove the cake to a baking rack to cool
21. Cool just until warm , then brush the surface with the cornsyrup
22. Unmold the cake when completely cool
23. Brush with more apricot brandy , if desired
24. Wrap the cooled cake in plastic wrap and then in foil to retain moisture
25. It is ready to eat in 24 hours
26. It may also be refrigerated and eaten within a few weeks

title: mom s swiss steak
steps:
1. Preheat oven 350f degrees
2. Brown steak lightly in olive oil
3. Place in roast pan
4. Saut garlic apple and onions
5. Add to meat
6. Place remaining ingredients in saut pan
7. Bring to a boil
8. Pour over meat
9. Seal tightly with foil
10. Bake 2 hours

title: mexican prune chipotle pork
steps:
1. Prehat oven to 150c
2. Sear the meat on all sides on a pan in the hot oil
3. Place on a baking dish in the oven for one hour
4. Process rest of the ingredients in the blender , strain , and pour over the meat
5. Continue cooking in oven until meat isdone and sauce is bubbly

title: aromatic stewed mushrooms
steps:
1. Slice mushrooms fairly thickly
2. Heat the oil in a large frying pan
3. Stir in the garlic , after about 2 minutes , the mushrooms
4. Cook for 8-10 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Season with salt& pepper , and stir in the parsley
6. Cook for 5 minutes more , and serve at once

title: cake of the sugar plum fairies
steps:
1. For the cake:
2. In a small bowl , dissolve the yeast into the warm milk
3. Allow it to stand for 10 to 15 minutes
4. With an electric mixer , cream the lemon zest , sugar and butter until fluffy
5. Add the eggs one at a time and mix well
6. Sift the flour and salt together into a bowl
7. Make a well in the flour and add the egg mixture
8. Knead until mixed well
9. Pour in the yeast mixture
10. Continue to knead until the dough is soft and pliable , then allow it to rest for 15 minutes
11. You want it to rise and bubble
12. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
13. Spray a 9-inch cake loaf pan with cooking spray and transfer the dough to the pan
14. Set it aside in a warm place for 15 minutes or until it rises above the edge of the molds
15. Arrange the plums on top
16. For streusel topping , melt butter in a small saucepan , add the other ingredients and stir with a spoon until mixed well
17. Sprinkle on top of the plums , brush with butter
18. Bake for 15 to 30 minutes or until golden brown

title: brewhaus potato salad
steps:
1. Make the beer vinaigrette: heat 2 tbsp
2. Of the olive oil and saute onions until just soft , about 5 minutes
3. Add beer , vinegar , and sugar
4. Boil for 5 minutes
5. Cool slightly and whisk in the rest of the olive oil , parsley , chives , and dijon mustard
6. Season to taste with salt and pepper
7. Set aside
8. Cook potatoes in boiling salted water about 25 minutes
9. Drain , run cold water over , and as soon as you can handle them , pat dry and slice them 1 / 4-inch thick
10. While potatoes are warm , gently mix them with the beer dressing
11. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: smoothie
steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth

title: pacific northwest stir fried asparagus   sugar snap peas
steps:
1. Trim tough ends from asparagus and slice stalks diagonally into 2 inch pieces
2. Place in a large bowl
3. Pinch bakc the stem ends of sugar snap peas and pull the string down the length
4. Add to asparagus in bowl
5. In a large skillet , heat oil over medium-high heat
6. Add vegetables and stir-fry for 5 minutes , stirring occassionaly
7. Sprinkle with seasonings to taste - be generous !
8. Continue to cook for 3 more minutes or until veggies are cooked but crispy
9. Transfer to a heated dish and serve immediately

title: chai and honey cupcakes
steps:
1. Position oven rack in the middle of oven
2. Preheat to 350
3. Line a standard 12-cup muffin pan with paper or foil liners
4. In a small bowl , steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes
5. Discard tea bags and let the tea cool to room temperature
6. In a bowl , whisk the flour , brown sugar , baking soda , and salt together
7. In a big bowl , combine the honey , melted butter , buttermilk , and egg
8. Add the flour mixture and , using an electric mixer on medium speed , beat until just combined , about 2 minutes
9. Add in the cooled tea and beat until just combined , scraping down the sides of the bowl as needed
10. Divide the batter evenly among the prepared muffin cups , filling each 3 / 4 full
11. Bake about 18-20 minutes , until a pick comes out clean
12. Let the cupcakes cook in the pan on a wire rack for 5 minutes
13. Transfer the cupcakes to the wire rack and let cool completely , about 1 hour
14. Just before ready to serve , make the honey whipped cream--in a chilled bowl , combine the cream and honey
15. Using an electric mixer on low speed , beat until slightly thickened , 1-2 minutes
16. Gradually increase speed to medium-high and continue to beat until the cream holds soft peaks , 2-3 minutes
17. Use right away
18. Frost the cupcakes with the honey cream , garnish with the honeycomb pieces , if using
19. Serve right away
20. If not using the honeycomb , can drizzle with additional honey just before serving

title: creamed carrots  recipe from the titanic  ship   not the movie
steps:
1. Peel and slice carrots
2. Cook , covered , in a small amount of water over medium heat until tender
3. Drain
4. In a medium size skillet , melt butter over medium-high heat
5. Saut onions in butter until tender
6. Stir in flour , salt , pepper and sugar
7. Cook for 1 minute
8. Gradually add milk , stirring constantly until mixture thickens and starts to boil
9. Pour over cooked carrots and stir to coat

title: w w    herbed split pea soup
steps:
1. Heat oil and saut onion and garlic and carrot for about 5 minutes
2. Add the split peas plus 4 cups of water
3. Add all other ingredients , bring to a boil , reduce heat , cover and simmer for about 1 hour

title: pepper jack   green onion mini scones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Spray mini scone pan with flour-added baking spray or line a baking sheet with parchment paper
3. In small bowl , toss pepper jack cheese and green onion with 1 tablespoon of all-purpose flour and set aside
4. In medium bowl , whisk together the all-purpose flour , baking powder , cayenne pepper and salt
5. Use a pastry blender , two knives or your fingers , cut the butter into the flour mixture until the butter is pea-size and the flour is silky
6. Lightly beat eggs and the half & half with a fork and add it to the flour mixture
7. Add the cheese / onion mixture to the flour mixture
8. Use a wooden spoon to fold the mixture until it begins to come together
9. Turn the dough onto a well-floured surface and knead gently for less than a minute
10. Separate into 4 equal parts and pat each one into a portion of the nordic ware mini scone pan
11. Or , pat dough into a 3 / 4 to 1-inch thick circle or rectangle and cut into desired shapes
12. Lightly beat the remaining egg with one teaspoon water
13. Generously brush the tops of the scones
14. Bake 18-20 minutes or until golden brown

title: dill buttermilk bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f
2. Combine flour , baking powder , sugar , dill , baking soda , salt and pepper in a bowl
3. Add buttermilk a little at a time until a soft dough forms
4. Turn into a greased 9 inch by 5 inch loaf pan
5. Bake for 50 minutes or until loaf is golden brown
6. Serve warm
7. Reheat when needed
8. The globe and mail -----

title: pork medallions with mustard caper sauce
steps:
1. Using meat mallet or rolling pin , flatten pork rounds slightly to an even 1 / 2-inch thickness
2. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
3. Melt butter in heavy large skillet over medium-high heat
4. Add pork to skillet and saut until brown and cooked through , about 2 minutes per side
5. Transfer pork to plate
6. Add shallots to skillet and stir 1 minute
7. Add chicken broth and cream
8. Boil until sauce is thick enough to coat spoon , stirring up browned bits , 3-5 minutes
9. Mix in capers and mustard
10. Return pork to sauce
11. Simmer mixture until pork is heated through , about 1 minute
12. Season to taste with salt and pepper and serve

title: guisado a la cerveza  beef tenderloin and beer stew
steps:
1. Heat a dutch oven over medium heat
2. Add the bacon and cook until crisp
3. Remove from heat
4. If it looks like there is more that 2 tbs grease , drain a little
5. Reserve the bacon
6. Add the beef and brown on both sides
7. Add the onions and garlic
8. Cook until onion is wilted
9. Add chile and mix
10. Meanwhile in a bowl , whisk together the rest of the ingredients except the vinegar
11. Add to the beef
12. And bring to a boil
13. Lower the heat and cook , stirring once in a while , until the meat is tender and sauce has thickened
14. Add the vinegar and mix well
15. Sprinkle with the bacon bits and serve very hot

title: yummy and good for you meatloaf  in cupcake pan
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f dice carrot and onion and steam in the microwave to cook
2. Cooking time depends on microwave size / power
3. Steam carrot and onion until tender
4. Drain
5. Tear bread slices and process in the food processor until it is crumbs
6. Add crumbs to a large mixing bowl
7. Add both meats , egg , carrot , onion , cooked spinach , salt , pepper , and curry powder
8. Mix using your hands
9. I like to use a cupcake pan
10. Spray each cupcake hole with cooking spray and distribute meat mixture in each hole (it will probably fill 5-6 mini meatloaf cupcakes
11. Mix the jelly and catsup and spread over the top of each cupcake
12. Bake until cooked through approximately 20 minutes

title: bruschetta style salsa for canning
steps:
1. Drain tomatoes then combine with garlic , shallots , basil , vinegar , lemon juice , salt and pepper in a large saucepan
2. Bring to a boil over high heat , reduce heat and boil gently 5 minutes
3. Check consistency , you may need to simmer awhile longer
4. Stir in green onions and tomato paste and boil one minute
5. Ladle into hot sterilized jars to within 1 / 2 inch of top
6. Process in a hot water bath for 35 minutes for half pints , 40 minutes for pints
7. To serve , spoon out onto sliced bread , top with your favourite cheese and broil until cheese is melted

title: lemon glazed carrots and rutabagas
steps:
1. Cut carrots and rutabaga into 3-inch x 1 / 4-inch strips
2. Place into saucepan
3. Add broth
4. Bring to boil
5. Reduce heat
6. Cover and cook for 13 to 15 minutes or until tender
7. Do not drain
8. Meanwhile , in a small saucepan , combine remaining ingredients
9. Cook and stir for 3 minutes
10. Add to vegetables
11. Cook , uncovered , 3 to 4 minutes longer or until vegetables are glazed , stirring gently
12. Serve

title: blue bleu cheese   cream cheese olive ball
steps:
1. Mix cheeses& butter together until creamy
2. Add chopped olives and mix
3. Form ball and refrigerate overnight
4. Serve with crackers like triscuits

title: zucchini lime bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Spray or grease 2 loaf pans very well
3. Place nuts , lime zest , cardamom , coconut , ginger and mace in food processor
4. Pulse until mixture resembles very coarse meal
5. Set aside
6. Place remaining ingredients in large mixing bowl / stand mixer in order listed
7. Add nut / lime / coconut mixture
8. Beat on low 1 minute
9. Beat on medium 1 minute
10. Pour into 2 loaf pans and bake at 325 for 1 hour
11. Check for doneness
12. Generally done by 1 hour 15 minutes , depending on oven
13. Remove and let cool in pans 5 minutes
14. Then turn out onto cooling rack
15. Mix a glaze: juice of 1 lime with enough confectioner's sugar to make it drizzly
16. Drizzle over cooled loaves

title: hellmann s dijon potato salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine the mayonnaise , mustard , dill , salt and freshly ground black pepper
2. Stir in potatoes , radishes and green onions
3. Cover and chill until ready to serve

title: enchilada sauce for canning
steps:
1. Add 2-1 / 2 tsp of spice blend to each pint jar
2. If omitting seasoning salt , use only 2 tsp
3. Prepare boiling water canner
4. Heat jars and lids in simmering water until ready for use
5. Do not boil
6. Set bands aside
7. Combine tomatoes with just enough water to cover in a large saucepan
8. Bring to a boil and boil gently for 5 minutes
9. Add specified quantity of spice blend , 1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 / 4 tsp salt , if using , to each hot jar
10. Pack tomatoes into hot jars leaving 1 / 2 inch headspace
11. Ladle hot cooking liquid over tomatoes leaving 1 / 2 inch headspace
12. Remove air bubbles
13. Wipe rim
14. Center hot lid on jar
15. Apply band and adjust until fit is finger
16. Process filled jars in a boiling water canner 40 minutes for pints and quarts , adjusting for altitude
17. Remove jars and cool
18. Check lids for seal after 24 hours
19. Lid should not flex up and down when center is pressed

title: date and walnut spread
steps:
1. In a small bowl beat together the neufchatel cheese , powdered sugar and spices
2. In a food processor finely chop the walnuts
3. Add chopped nuts to cream cheese mixture then finely chop the dates
4. Add in dates and stir with a rubber spatula until blended
5. Place mixture into a custard cup , cover and refrigerator until chilled
6. Serve with bagels and quick breads for a delicious treat

title: sesame peanut noodles
steps:
1. Whisk together all the dressing ingredients in a bowl or jug
2. Put the snow peas , beansprouts , red pepper strips , sliced spring onions and the noodles into a bowl
3. Pour the dressing over them and mix thoroughly to coat everything well
4. Sprinkle with the sesame seeds

title: rice delicious
steps:
1. Saute mushrooms and water chestnuts in butter for 15 minutes
2. Add onion soup to mixture and simmer for 2-3 minutes
3. Fill empty soup can with liquid from mushrooms and water chestnuts
4. Add water to reach top of can
5. Pour liquid into pot with mushroom mixture and add rice , mixing well
6. Pour into 9x9 casserole dish , cover and bake for 1 hour at 300 degrees or until rice is tender

title: quinoa black bean broccoli deliciousness
steps:
1. Make the quinoa according the directions on package
2. Typically 2 parts liquid , 1 part quinoa , cooked for 10-15 minutes until liquid is absorbed
3. While the quinoa is cooking , heat the garlic in the olive oil for 2 minutes
4. Add the zucchini and cook until tender
5. When the quinoa and zucchini are done , add all other ingredients and allow to reheat over medium low heat
6. Serve hot

title: brownie pancakes
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , whisk the flour , baking soda , and salt until well combined
2. Set aside
3. If using any of the mix-ins , stir 1 cup of each into the flour mixture
4. Place the butter and chocolate in the top of a double boiler set over simmering water
5. If you don't have a double boiler , place the butter and chocolate in a heat-safe bowl that fits snugly over a small pot of simmering water
6. Stir constantly until half the butter and chocolate is melted
7. Remove the top of the double boiler or the bowl from the pot
8. Then continue stirring , away from the heat , until the butter and chocolate are completely melted
9. Transfer the mixture to a large bowl and allow to cool for 10 minutes
10. Meanwhile , heat a nonstick griddle or a large nonstick skillet over medium-low heat
11. In a large bowl , beat the eggs , sugar , and vanilla just until combined and foamy , using a whisk or an electric mixer at low speed
12. Beat in the melted chocolate mixture until the batter is uniform , about 4 minutes by hand or 2 minutes with a mixer
13. With a wooden spoon or a rubber spatula , stir in the flour mixture just until combined
14. Then stir in the milk just until the batter is pourable
15. Do not overmix !
16. Pour 2 tbsp of the batter onto the heated griddle
17. Repeat , spacing the pancakes evenly
18. Cook for 1 minute , until bubbles form across the surface of the pancakes
19. Turn
20. Cook an additional minute
21. Remove the pancakes and serve immediately , or keep them warm on a cookie sheet in a 250 degree oven
22. Repeat with the remaining batter

title: crab   shrimp casserole
steps:
1. Melt stick of butter over low heat , add flour and stir until well blended
2. Remove from heat and gradually stir in milk and return to heat
3. Cook stirring constantly until thick and smooth
4. Stir in cheese whiz and sherry and remove from heat
5. Fold in crab and shrimp and pour into buttered casserole dish
6. Crush the crackers and stir into the 2 tbsp of melted butter
7. Sprinkle the buttered cracker crumbs over the top of the casserole and sprinkle with paprika if desired
8. Bake at 350 degrees until crumbs are lightly browned and casserole is bubbly
9. Also you can make this ahead of time and freeze minus the cracker topping until ready to use and thaw completely before baking
10. Because it makes such a large amount you can also divide in half and use one now and freeze the other dish

title: chocolate peanut chewy bars
steps:
1. Set oven to 350f
2. Grease a 15 x 10-inch baking sheet
3. In a large bowl , combine the oats , graham cracker crumbs , brown sugar , baking soda and peanuts
4. Mix well until combined
5. In another bowl , combine corn syrup with melted butter and vanilla
6. Mix well and add to the oat mixture
7. Mix to combine
8. Press into prepared baking sheet / pan
9. Bake for 15 minutes
10. Melt the chocolate chips with peanut butter in the microwave or double boiler until smooth
11. Spread on warm bars
12. Refrigerate to slightly set the chocolate
13. Remove from fridge and slice into small bars

title: fudgy brownies from scratch
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease and flour 9x13 inch pan
3. In a large bowl , stir together the cocoa and baking soda , add 1 / 3 c veg oil and boiling water
4. Mix until well blended and thickened
5. Stir in the sugar , eggs , and remaining 1 / 3 c veg oil
6. Mix together
7. Finally add the flour , vanilla , and salt
8. Mix just until all of the flour is absorbed
9. Spread evenly in prepared pan
10. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes , or until toothpick inserted comes out clean
11. Allow to cool before cutting

title: cream soda mix for sodastream pop
steps:
1. In a medium pan , heat the turbinado sugar and 1 / 4 cup water over medium high heat until carmelized
2. Cut and squeeze one lemon
3. Split the vanilla bean or use the vanilla extract
4. Remove pan from stove and add 2 cups water and the lemon juice
5. Add vanilla bean and seeds , return pan to the heat and bring to a boil
6. Remove from heat and allow to stand for 1 hour
7. Pour syrup into an airtight container
8. Store in the refrigerator
9. Add syrup to taste to carbonated water

title: peanut butter honey oatmeal bread  abm
steps:
1. Place ingredients in bread machine according to manufacturer's instructions
2. Let run !

title: mom s chicken curry
steps:
1. Saute onion in butter with curry powder
2. Blend in flour and other seasonings
3. Cook on low until smooth
4. Stir in broth and milk slowly with whisk to make sure to get all the lumps out
5. Bring to boil
6. Boil for one minute or until thickened while stirring
7. Stir in chicken and lemon juice
8. Serve over rice
9. Enjoy !

title: tofu salad crunch pitas
steps:
1. Stir fry tofu cubes in vegetable oil in a non-stick skillet until golden and crispy , about 15 minutes
2. Sprinkle with salt
3. Combine all ingredients except pita bread and lettuce
4. Cover and refrigerate for one hour to blend flavors
5. Line pita pockets with leaf lettuce and fill with tofu salad
6. To press tofu , cut tofu block into 2 or 4 equal pieces and lay on a plate covered with paper towels or a clean dish cloth
7. Cover with more paper towels or dish cloth
8. Place another plate on top and on top of the plate put a heavy object
9. Let stand from 20 minutes to one hour , changing paper towels as they become soaked
10. The longer you press , the firmer the tofu will be

title: cannoli parfait
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine the strawberries and amaretto
2. Cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours or overnight
3. In a large bowl , whip the cream with the confectioners' sugar until soft peaks form
4. In a medium bowl , stir half of the whipped cream into the ricotta to lighten it
5. Gently fold in the remaining whipped cream and cinnamon
6. Fold the pistachios into cream mixture
7. Place a layer of crushed amaretti cookies in each of 4 parfait glasses
8. Top each with a layer of strawberry slices and then cannoli cream
9. Repeat layering
10. If desired , top with miniature chocolate chips

title: bunny in the hole sandwich
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Cut a hole in the centre of 4 slices of bread using a 3-1 / 2 inch egg shaped cookie cutter
3. Set the inner "hole" aside
4. Butter remaining 4 bread slices and place butter side down on baking sheet
5. Top each with a cheese slice and a piece of bread with a hole in it
6. Break one egg into each hole
7. Top eggs with 2 frozen peas or green pepper for eyes , a red pepper triangle for the nose , and chives for whiskers
8. Bake 15 minutes or until the cheese has melted and the egg is set but slightly runny
9. Check frequently as the eggs set quickly
10. Remove from oven , cut the bread "hole" in half to use as bunny ears

title: orange grits
steps:
1. In a saucepan over medium heat bring water and orange juice to a boil
2. Stir in grits , orange peel and salt into water / juice mixture
3. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook stirring for 3-5 minutes or until thickened
4. Pour into serving dishes and sprinkle with brown sugar
5. Let stand until sugar melts

title: chocolate walnut biscotti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300f line a large baking sheet with parchment paper
2. In a food processor fitted with the metal blade , combine the chocolate and sugar and grind until the chocolate is very fine
3. Set aside
4. In a bowl , sift together the flour , cocoa powder , baking soda and salt
5. Set aside
6. In a mixing bowl combine the eggs and the vanilla
7. Beat at medium speed to blend
8. Reduce the speed to low , add the chocolate and flour mixtures and mix until a stiff dough forms , adding the walnuts when about half mixed
9. Transfer the dough to a floured surface and gather it together
10. Divide in half
11. Form each half into a log 12 inches long
12. Carefully transfer the logs to the prepared baking sheet , spacing them evenly
13. Pat to even up the shapes
14. Bake until almost firm to the touch , about 50 minutes
15. Let cool for 10 minutes
16. Leave the oven set at 300f
17. Using a spatula , transfer the logs to a work surface
18. Using a serrated knife , cut on the diagonal into slices 1 / 2 to 3 / 4 inch thick
19. Return the slices cut side down to the baking sheet
20. Bake for 25 minutes
21. Turn the slices over and bake until crispy and dry , about 25 minutes longer
22. Transfer the cookies to wire racks to cool
23. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 1 month

title: alpine latte
steps:
1. Combine bailey's , amaretto & frangelico in a mug , add coffee & stir
2. Garnish with cream & almonds

title: zucchini   tomato casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Steam zucchini until crisp tender
3. Using a slotted spoon , transfer zucchini to a shallow 2 quart casserole
4. Stir pepper and chives into margarine and pour over zucchini
5. Cover with tomato slices
6. Sprinkle with basil and cheese
7. Bake , uncovered , 30 min

title: north african mint tea
steps:
1. Bring the water to a boil in a saucepan , turn off the heat and add the tea
2. Let steep for 5 minutes
3. Put the mint and sugar into a teapot or carafe
4. Strain the tea into the pot and let it steep for 5 more minutes
5. Pour into glasses and serve warm or cold
6. Enjoy !

title: a simple tomato soup recipe  very vegan friendly
steps:
1. Stove top: in a large pot over medium heat melt the butter / oil
2. Add the onions and salt , and cook , stirring occasionally , until the onions soften - 10 minutes approximately
3. Stir in the curry powder , coriander , cumin , and chile flakes , and cook just until the spices are fragrant and toasty - stirring constantly at this point about 30 seconds
4. Stir in the tomatoes , the juices from the cans , and broth
5. Simmer for fifteen minutes or so , then puree with a hand blender until smooth
6. If you'd like your soup even a bit thinner or with more of a coconut taste- you can thin it with more broth or more coconut milk
7. Taste and adjust with more salt if necessary
8. Crock pot: follow directions #1 and #2 above
9. After sauteeing the onion and spices , pour that mixture plus the tomatoes and juices and broth into the crock pot
10. Simmer on high for about 1 1 / 2 hours then low for about 3 hours longer
11. About 5 minutes before serving , i poured in about 5 ounces of the coconut milk
12. Stir and taste
13. Add more coconut milk for a more pronounced taste , as desired
14. Serving suggestions from the apartment therapy website: any or all of the following: cooked brown rice , lemon wedges , toasted almond slices , pan-fried paneer , fresh cilantro , parsley , thyme or oregano , a poached egg
15. For the test recipe , we added to each serving of soup about 1 / 4 cup scoop short grain brown rice , a tablespoon or so of thick coconut milk , fresh cilantro and lemon wedges

title: joyce s fabulous fruit cocktail cake
steps:
1. Beat together sugar , oil , eggs , and vanilla
2. Sift together flour , salt , and baking soda
3. Add fruit cocktail , mix well
4. Pour in 9x13 inch pan
5. Sprinkle coconut over batter
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes
7. Just before removing cake from oven , bring margarine , sugar , and milk to boil in small saucepan for one minute
8. Remove from heat
9. Add coconut , chopped nuts , and vanilla
10. Spread at once over hot cake

title: turkey wings with gravy
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a medium pot
2. Thoroughly wash and dry the turkey wings
3. Fry the wings in the oil , over medium high heat , turning , until they begin to brown on both sides
4. Remove the wings
5. Add the flour to the pot and stir as it browns
6. When the flour is brown , add the wings , bell pepper , onion , and warm water , and bring to a boil , stirring occasionally
7. Add thyme , salt , and pepper shortly after the pot starts to boil
8. Turkey wings should cook until they are tender , 45 to 60 minutes or more
9. Add warm water as needed to maintain a rich gravy
10. Serve with rice or potatoes , or just eat them alone

title: country baked chicken
steps:
1. Place chicken in a large bowl and cover with water
2. Add 2 tsp salt and stir it around
3. Let chicken rest in the salted water for 20 minutes
4. Preheat the oven to 375
5. Drain chicken well
6. Pour the melted butter over the chicken , and stir it around to coat the chicken well
7. Place the chicken in a 9 x 13 baking pan , arranged so that the pieces are close together
8. Add any remaining butter to the chicken in the pan
9. Mix the flour and the pepper in a small bowl
10. Pour through a sifter , or small sieve , and sprinkle the mixture evenly over the top of the chicken pieces
11. Pour in the cup of water from the edge of the pan so that the water fills the bottom , and does not touch the top of the flour-coated chicken parts
12. Bake in the oven for about 45 minutes
13. Time will depend on which chicken parts you are using
14. Breasts take less time than thighs
15. I use a meat thermometer to tell when it's done
16. If there are any spots of raw flour on the chicken , just spoon some of the water over it , and return to the oven for a couple of minutes , to crisp up

title: carrot cake smoothie
steps:
1. Combine all but the carrot sticks in blender , and blend on high until mixture is frothy and ice cubes are finely ground
2. Pour into 4 glasses and garnish w / one carrot stick each for stirring
3. Serve immediately

title: easy pork won tons
steps:
1. Mix together first six ingredients
2. Wrap one teaspoon of meat mixture in each won ton wrap
3. Fry in small amount of oil , turning until golden brown
4. Serve hot with sweet and sour sauce

title: tuna with olive sauce
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a frying pan
2. Saute the tuna & next four ingredients for 5 minutes
3. Mince the onion , parsley , & olives in a food processor then add to the tuna
4. Cook for additional 5 minutes then add the tomato sauce
5. Simmer on low heat for 7 minutes
6. Serve with thick bread

title: zippy orange rosemary chicken
steps:
1. 1
2. Preheat an oven to 375 degrees f
3. Spray an 8x8 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray
4. 2
5. Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper
6. Place in prepared dish
7. Combine orange marmalade , horseradish , and rosemary in a small bowl
8. Pour over chicken
9. 3
10. Bake the chicken in the preheated oven until no longer pink in the center , and the juices run clear , 30 to 35 minutes
11. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees f

title: maxine s marvelous peach pie
steps:
1. Blend first 8 ingredients in large bowl
2. Beat at low speed for 1 / 2 minute
3. At medium speed beat for 4 minutes
4. Pour into well greased 8x8 pan
5. Place peaches on batter
6. Mix cream cheese , 1 / 2 cup sugar & 3 tbsp peach juice until smooth
7. Spread cheese mixture over peaches
8. Sprinkle top with 1 tbsp sugar / 1 / 4 tsp cinnamon mix
9. Bake at 350 degrees for 30-35 minutes

title: cheezy potato poofs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. In a large saucepan , bring water , butter and salt to a boil
3. Remove from heat
4. Mix dry potato flakes and flour and stir into saucepan
5. Return to medium heat and stir vigorously until dough forms a ball and leaves the sides of the pan
6. Remove from heat
7. Add eggs one at a time
8. Beat until the dough is glossy and stiff
9. Stir in swiss cheese
10. Drop dough on a greased baking sheet , 2 inches apart
11. Sprinkle tops with parmesan cheese
12. Bake until golden

title: bahamian johnny bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees and grease an 11x15 baking pan and set aside
2. In a mixing bowl , sift together the flour and baking powder and then add the sugar and salt
3. With your fingers , gently knead in the stick of butter until well incorporated in the mixture
4. Add in the eggs , vegetable oil , milk and water and mix well with a spoon until the texture of your mixture is between that of a bread dough and the batter of a cake mix , adding more water if necessary
5. Pour mixture into greased pan and bake for 30mins
6. Brush the melted butter over the top and continue to bake for another 15 mins or until golden brown and butter knife comes out clean from the middle
7. Cut in squares and serve warm with butter or jam

title: warm avocado salsa
steps:
1. Coat a medium skillet with cooking spray
2. Saute the tomatoes over medium-high heat until they soften , 2-3 minutes
3. Add the scallions , onion , adn chile pepper
4. Reduce the heat to medium
5. Add the avocado , lime juice , salt , and black pepper
6. Mix gently until the avocado is just warm
7. Stir in the cilantro and serve immediately

title: mild but rich chili
steps:
1. Drain the beans , and put them in a large pot with the tomatoes and the ketchup
2. Set the pot over medium-low heat
3. Peel and chop the onion
4. Wash and chop the celery
5. Saute the onion and celery in the oil until softened
6. Add them to the pot
7. Break up the meat and brown it in the same skillet as the vegetables
8. When nearly done , add the spices
9. Add the meat to the vegetables and simmer for half an hour to an hour
10. Serve with hot buttered toast

title: chicken saag
steps:
1. Puree everything but the last four recipe items in a food processor
2. Heat oil in a large skillet or medium saucepan
3. Saute the bay leaves for a couple minutes
4. Add the spinach puree and the chicken
5. Simmer until chicken is tender 30-60 minutes
6. Add cream or yogurt , heat through
7. Add some water or milk if spinach seems too dry
8. Serve when hot

title: best coleslaw
steps:
1. Combine cabbage and carrot in large bowl
2. Whisk together sugar and remaining ingredients until blended
3. Pour over cabbage and toss
4. Chill at least 1 hour

title: sweet and sour hot cole slaw
steps:
1. Combine all vegetables in a large bowl
2. Combine sugar and remaining ingredients in another bowl and mix well
3. Stir dressing into vegetables and mix
4. Cover and chill several hours
5. Drain well and spoon into serving bowl

title: hell s kitchen shrimp
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Have ready an ungreased 2-quart casserole dish
3. In a large skillet , heat oil over medium heat
4. Add onions and saute until light golden brown
5. About 7 minutes
6. Then add parsley , garlic and sugar to onions and stir well
7. Next , add tomatoes and cook until they soften and their liquid is absorbed
8. About 20 minutes
9. Now add wine to skillet and cook until the liquid is absorbed
10. Next , add shrimp , stirring constantly , for just 30 seconds
11. Remove from heat
12. Pour shrimp mixture into casserole dish and top with the feta
13. Bake for about 5 minutes , until the shrimp are cooked and the cheese melts

title: chicken breasts with pine nuts and tomatoes
steps:
1. Combine cup parsley , garlic and oregano in a small bowl
2. Heat 2 tblsps oil in small skillet over medium-low heat
3. Add onion and saute until golden-brown , about 15 minutes
4. Stir in of parsley mixture and continue to cook until garlic is tender , about 2 minutes
5. Transfer to small bowl and stir in prosciutto and pine nuts
6. Cool completely
7. Insert small sharp knife into side of each chicken breast at thick end
8. Carefully cut side to create a 2 inch deep , 2 inch wide pocket
9. Stuff with parsley-pine nut mixture
10. Skewer to close pocket opening
11. Place chicken in baking dish
12. Drizzle with 2 tblsps oil and pour wine over
13. Sprinkle both sides of chicken with remaining parsley mixture
14. Cover and marinate atleast 8 hours , in refrigerator
15. Heat remaining 2 tblsps oil in large skillet over high heat
16. Add chicken and cook until brown on all sides , about 3 minutes
17. Add of reserved marinade
18. Reduce heat to medium-low
19. Cover and cook chicken until it is cooked through , about 5 minutes
20. Transfer chicken to a platter
21. Slice into inch thick slices and overlap
22. Add tomatoes , cream and remaining marinade to skillet
23. Boil until slightly thickened , stirring constantly , about 3 minutes
24. Season
25. Spoon over chicken
26. Sprinkle with parsley

title: elbow mac pepperoni pizza
steps:
1. Cook macaroni to package directions
2. Drain
3. Heat oven to 350f and grease 12-inch round pizza pan
4. In bowl , lightly beat egg , stir in macaroni , 1 / 2 cup cheddar cheese , parmesan and seasonings until well mixed
5. Put mixture in pizza pan and spread evenly
6. Spoon thin layer of pizza sauce evenly over crust
7. Sprinkle with cheese and top with pepperoni
8. Bake about 20 minutes or until cheese is melted

title: bacon   beef wrapped asparagus and goat cheese
steps:
1. Tenderize steaks with a meat tenderizer
2. Rub steaks with your favorite steak seasoning
3. Lay out flat on cookie sheet and drizzle heavily with balsamic vinegar
4. Cover and marinate for 30 minutes
5. Trim asparagus to 4-5 inches in length
6. Divide steaks into 3 oz pieces , large enough to hold approx 3 asparagus spears each
7. Divide goat cheese into 1 / 2 ounce servings
8. Place 3-4 trimmed asparagus spears and 1 / 2 oz of goat cheese in center of each steak
9. Roll steak to seal in asparagus and cheese
10. Wrap each beef roll with 1-2 slices of uncooked beef bacon
11. Place toothpick through seam to help hold bacon on while cooking
12. Place wrap , seam side down , on broiler pan
13. Bake in oven on 350f for 30 - 35 minutes

title: hot fudge pudding cake  vegan
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In medium mixing bowl , combine 3 / 4 cup sugar , flour , 3 tbsp cocoa , baking powder , and salt
3. Blend in the milk , vanilla , and margarine
4. Beat until smooth
5. Spread batter into a square pan 8x8x2 or 9x9x2
6. This cake does not rise , but it bubbles , so be sure your pan height is tall enough or you will have chocolate burning all over your oven
7. In a separate small bowl , mix remaining 1 / 2 cup sugar , brown sugar , and remaining 4 tbsp cocoa
8. Sprinkle mixture evenly over batter
9. Pour hot water over the top
10. Do not stir
11. Bake for 40 minutes or until center is almost set
12. Let stand 15 minutes
13. Spoon into bowls , spooning sauce from bottom of pan over the top

title: rogene s white chocolate and cherry cookies
steps:
1. Cream sugar and butter together
2. Add egg and vanilla
3. Mix in flour and baking soda
4. Stir in cherries , chips and pecans
5. Bake for 15 min at 350 degrees

title: tilapia casserole
steps:
1. Layer frozen fish fillets in greased casserole dish , overlapping if needed
2. Spread cream of shrimp soup over fish
3. Melt margarine and mix with crushed crackers
4. Sprinkle cracker mixture over casserole
5. Bake uncovered at 350 for about 45 minutes
6. Also i add a dash or two of hot sauce to the melted butter before adding to the cracker crumbs

title: granola whole wheat waffles with double berry sauce
steps:
1. 1
2. In 1 1 / 2-quart saucepan , heat syrup and jam to boiling , stirring occasionally
3. Stir in strawberries
4. Remove from heat and keep warm
5. 2
6. Heat waffle iron
7. Grease with shortening if necessary
8. 3
9. In medium bowl , stir all waffle ingredients until blended
10. Pour batter by 2 / 3 cupfuls onto center of hot waffle iron
11. Close lid
12. 4
13. Bake 2 to 3 minutes or until steaming stops and waffle is golden brown
14. Carefully remove waffle
15. Serve with sauce
16. Top with cool whip

title: french bread with chipotle lime butter
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. In a small bowl , combine butter , lime zest , lime juice , and pepper
3. Spread butter mixture evenly over cut sides of bread
4. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil
5. Broil bread , buttered side up 5 inches from heat , for 1 to 2 minutes , or until toasted
6. Cut into slices to serve

title: james river corn pudding
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Butter a 1 1 / 2 quart casserole and set aside
3. Place a kettle of water over high heat to bring to a boil
4. Place beaten eggs in a bowl and set aside
5. In a medium saucepan over medium heat , melt 2 tablespoons butter and whisk in four until smooth
6. Add milk and whisk constantly until thickened , about 5 minutes
7. While whisking vigorously , slowly add about 1 cup hot milk misture into eggs
8. Return saucepan to medium-low heat , and whisk egg mixture back into remaining milk mixture
9. Stir 1 minute , then remove from heat and add corn , salt and pepper
10. Pour corn mixture into casserole and set in a shallow baking pan
11. Pour boiling water into pan to come halfway up sides of casserole
12. Bake until set like custard , 25 to 40 minutes depending on the shape and depth of the casserole
13. Cool for 10 minutes , then serve

title: penne with vodka cream and smoked salmon
steps:
1. Cook pasta in salted water according to package directions to al dente
2. Drain and keep warm
3. Meanwhile , in a large saucepan over medium heat , simmer the marinara sauce , dill and vodka for 15 minutes
4. Add the salmon pieces , peas and cream and heat through
5. Pour sauce over pasta and serve

title: ghee rice
steps:
1. Heat the ghee and oil in a pot
2. Add in the onions , fenugreek leaves , chicken / vegetable / beef boullion cube , curry leaves and cardamoms
3. Fry for a few minutes till the onions are lightly golden brown , the fenugreek leaves are softened and the tantalising aroma of the cardamoms' fills the air in your kitchen
4. Add the drained rice and mint leaves
5. Mix well
6. Careful not to break any rice grain
7. Cook till the rice gets cooked
8. Garnish with fried onions and the sliced tomato
9. Cover with aluminium foil and keep covered for 10 minutes
10. Serve hot !
11. For vegetarian use the vegetable bouillon cubes

title: old english cheese hors d oeuvres
steps:
1. Cream together all ingredients except bread
2. Cut crusts from 27 slices of bread
3. Spread three slices with the cheese mixture
4. Placing on large cookie sheet or jelly roll pan , stack the three slices
5. Then spread tops and sides of stack with more cheese
6. Repeat with remaining bread
7. Place tray in freezer for 10-15 minutes
8. Remove , and carefully cut each stack into 9 squares
9. You can then freeze by placing squares in a large ziploc freezer bag , or , bake at 350 for 20 minutes until golden brown

title: iced limeade
steps:
1. Cut the limes into 4 pieces without removing the skin
2. Remove the seeds
3. Put into a mixer with the rest of the ingredients and half cup water
4. Cover
5. Blend well
6. Add the remaining water
7. Blend again
8. Strain the juice
9. Serve immediately
10. If you dont , then it will become bitter and lose its taste

title: low fat party mix
steps:
1. In large pan , mix the wheat chex , corn chex , cheerios , and pretzels
2. Set aside
3. In another bowl , beat your egg whites til foamy
4. Then add worcestershire sauce and season salt
5. Mix well
6. Pour egg white mixture over cereal mixture
7. Stir well
8. Then lightly spray the cereal mixture with butter flavored non-stick cooking spray , stirring well
9. Place on cookie sheet and put in warm oven for 1 1 / 2 hours
10. Stir every 30 minutes
11. When done , take out and spread on paper towels
12. Sprinkle lightly with garlic salt
13. Store in an airtight container

title: couscous salad with fresh corn
steps:
1. Boil water , pour over couscous , cover and let sit for 10 minutes
2. Fluff couscous , toss with oil and cool
3. Add remaining ingredients and mix well
4. Toss with enough dressing to just coat
5. Adjust seasoning
6. Dressing:blend all ingredients in food processor or blender

title: no bake oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. I've found that it works best to set everything up before you start
2. You will need a sauce pan , a large mixing bowl , and wax paper
3. To prepare place wax paper on counter approximately 18-20 inches long to drop cookies on
4. Before heating the pot , put sugar , vanilla , cocoa , and milk in sauce pan
5. In your large mixing bowl put oat meal and peanut butter
6. Heat sauce pan on high heat stirring very slowly and constantly , when the mixture starts to boil rapidly boil for 3 minutes
7. Pour contents of sauce pan into large mixing bowl and mix with oat meal and peanut butter
8. This must be done quickly
9. Using a medium size spoon drop cookies on wax paper to cool and harden
10. This should take 10-15 minutes depending on the size of the cookies
11. Should cookies not harden you can try placing them in the fridge

title: boiled pig feet
steps:
1. I never measure my ingredients when i make this dish
2. I always season to taste and i suggest you do the same
3. I am very heavy on seasoning
4. I like my foods to be full of flavor
5. Wash the pig feet in the pot that you are going to cook them inches
6. Add vinegar to the pot
7. Making sure the feet get a good coating
8. Massage the vinegar into the meat
9. Add the other ingredients instead of the bay leaves
10. Massage the ingredients into the meat and vinegar
11. Stick your finger into the mix to taste the seasoning
12. If it needs more or whatever ingredient add it and continue the massage
13. Add water to the pot and the bay leaves
14. Stir the feet around in the pot
15. Taste the seasoned water
16. If it needs more seasoning add more
17. Continue to add seasoning and vinegar to the water as it boils if you think it needs more flavoring
18. Cook on low fire for 4 hours or until it is tender
19. Cook it according to how you like to eat them

title: garlic boursin cheese spread
steps:
1. In a food processor , add garlic and process until finely chopped , stopping once to scrape down sides
2. Add the remaining ingredients and process until smooth , stopping twice to scrape down sides

title: hot and cold taco appetizer dip
steps:
1. Fry ground beef over medium heat until no longer pink , drain fat
2. Add taco seasoning and water and simmer for 5 minutes , keep warm
3. In a medium bowl , beat the cream cheese and sour cream until smooth
4. Spread on a serving platter or large pizza pan
5. Layer with meat mixture , lettuce , tomatoes and onions
6. Drizzle on taco sauce and sprinkle cheese on top
7. Serve immediately with tortilla chips

title: khubz arabi  pita or flat bread
steps:
1. In a large bowl , scatter the yeast over the warm water and stir until dissolved
2. Add the salt
3. While kneading constantly , gradually add 6 cups of flour and 2 tablespoons of oil until the dough is smooth and elastic
4. Continue to add more flour if the dough still sticks to your hands
5. Put the dough into a large , greased bowl and turn dough to grease all sides of it
6. Cover with a dry tea towel and let rise in a warm place until doubled in size , about 1 1 / 2 hours
7. Preheat oven to 375-degrees f
8. Punch dough down gently
9. Divide the dough into 24 equal portions and shape them each into smooth balls
10. Place on a floured surface and dust tops lightly with flour
11. Cover with a dry tea towel
12. Let rest undisturbed 15 minutes more
13. Roll out each ball into a 6-inch diameter circle
14. Place on greased baking sheets
15. Bake in 375-degree f oven for 10-12 minutes or until the bread puffs
16. Do not leave baking unattended
17. Yum !

title: oktoberfest beef rouladen
steps:
1. Lay the steaks on a flat surface and brush with the mustard
2. Lightly sprinkle each with salt and pepper
3. Lay a slice of bacon on each steak
4. Layer the onions evenly onto each steak and top with the pickle slice
5. Fold two opposing sides of the steak in towards the center about one inch or so forming a roughly rectangle shape
6. Roll into a tight cylinder and secure with a toothpick or two or butchers string
7. Repeat with the remaining three steaks
8. Brown the rouladen in a thin layer of vegetable oil in a thick bottomed sauce pot thats just big enough to hold all four in a single layer
9. Brown evenly on all sides
10. Use additional oil if needed and when done discard all the oil
11. Add the wine , beef broth and bay leaf to the pot
12. Bring to a simmer and braise with a tight fitting lid over a low heat for one and a half hours or until tender
13. When done a thin knife blade should meet no resistance when poked into the meat
14. Remove the rouladen from the broth
15. Stir together the cornstarch and water then whisk into the broth until it thickens
16. Adjust the seasoning to taste
17. Serve immediately

title: saffron rice pudding    sholeh zard
steps:
1. Start a few hours ahead of time by preparing the rice by picking out any dark or discoloured grains and then washing in a colander until the water runs clear
2. Place the rice in a large bowl or pot with the salt and enough cold water to cover by an inch and soak for about 2 hours
3. Drain the rice , then bring the 2 quarts water to a boil over a high heat
4. Stirring constantly , pour the rice in a slow thin stream
5. Turn the heat down very low and simmer uncovered for 30 minutes
6. Stir in the sugar , then add the butter and saffron mixture and continue stirring until the sugar dissolves , the butter has melted and the rice is bright yellow
7. Stir in the slivered almonds and 1 tbsp of the pistachios and , stirring frequently , cook for 30 minutes longer or until the mixture can hold its shape almost solidly in the spoon
8. Stir in the rose water and ladle the mixture into a large , heatproof serving bowl
9. Spread it out with a spatula and sprinkle the top with two thin crossing lines of cinnamon to divide it into quarters
10. Sprinkle each quarter with the remaining 3 tbsp of pistachios and decorate with whole almonds
11. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or until the pudding is chilled and firm
12. Serve directly from the bowl

title: crunchy potato chip tilapia  salt n vinegar
steps:
1. Pour the milk into a wide , flat dish
2. Spread the flour in the same kind of dish or waxed paper
3. Pour the chips into a ziptop bag and seal
4. Crush them into small pieces (a rolling pin works well for this
5. Coat the fish with milk , then flour , then potato chips
6. Arranged in a greased baking dish
7. Drizzle any leftover milk over the fish to help to coating cook onto the fish
8. Bake at 400 degrees for 12 to 13 minutes until golden

title: my italian style green beans
steps:
1. Melt butter in a saute pan
2. Add bacon and cook until done but not crispy
3. Add next 4 ingredients and saute until onions are slightly browned and soft
4. Add green beans and heat through
5. Season with salt , pepper , and nutmeg to taste

title: tuscan chickpea tuna salad
steps: 1. Mix it all up , chill and enjoy

title: cranberry walnut salad
steps:
1. Place 1 / 2 cup of the water into a medium mixing bowl and sprinkle the gelatin on top
2. Set aside
3. Place the remaining water and the sugar into a small saucepan , place over high heat and bring just to a boil
4. Remove from the heat and add to the juice and gelatin mixture , stirring to combine
5. Place the bowl into the refrigerator and chill , just until the mixture begins to set up , approximately 30 to 40 minutes
6. Fold in remaining ingredients
7. Pour into mold
8. Chill until firm

title: appled sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Slice the sweet potatoes and dice the apples
2. Grease a 9x13 in baking pan
3. Arrange a layer of sweet potatoes , salt and pepper , 2 tbsp butter
4. Add layer of apples , 2 tbsp sugar , nutmeg
5. Repeat the layers
6. Bake in 350 oven for about 40 to 45 min , or until tender and to taste

title: my husband calls this bbq  sloppy joes
steps:
1. Brown beef in skillet
2. Drain grease
3. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over beef
4. Mix well
5. Simmer slowly for 10 to 15 minutes
6. Serve on your choice of rolls

title: ice cream
steps:
1. Beat eggs until light and add sugar
2. Mix in cream , vanilla and lemon extract
3. Pour into your gallon ice cream freezer
4. Fill to instructed level with milk
5. Follow manufacture's directions from here on to freeze

title: gelato alla fragola   strawberry gelato
steps:
1. In a blender combine the strawberries , sugar and whole milk and puree until smooth
2. Add in the heavy cream and mix just enough to combine
3. Add in the lemon juice
4. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours
5. Refrigerating overnight is best because it will allow the flavor to intensify
6. Transfer the mixture into an ice cream machine and freeze according to the manufacturer's instructions
7. Serve at once with fresh cut strawberries , if desired , or freeze for up to one month
8. You can substitute the following fruits using the above recipe: bananas , peaches , pears , raspberries , blackberries , apricots , granny smith apples and blueberries

title: winning apple crisp
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine flour , rolled oats , sugar , and cinnamon
2. Cut in softened butter until crumbly
3. Press half into a greased 2-1 / 2-quart baking dish or a 9-inch square baking pan
4. Cover with peeled , chopped apples
5. In a small saucepan , combine the sugar , cornstarch , water and vanilla
6. Bring to a boil
7. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thick and clear
8. Pour over apples
9. Sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture
10. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 60 to 65 minutes or until apples are tender
11. Serve warm , with ice cream if desired
12. Yield: 8 servings

title: viking meatball on a stick   copycat
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix the three meats
2. Saute onion in butter until translucent , not brown
3. In a separate container , add eggs , oatmeal and milk
4. Beat
5. Add all of the spices to the egg mixture and mix well
6. Add the cooked minced onions and the liquid
7. Beat until fluffy
8. Form meatballs with 1 / 2 cup meat
9. Preheat oven 400
10. Spray pam on baking pans
11. Place meatballs on greased pans , bake 15 minutes
12. Cool
13. Insert a wooden stick in the middle of each meatball
14. Heat oil to 375
15. Dip in the pancake batter
16. Batter should not be drippy
17. Cook until a golden brown
18. Roll to cook all sides
19. Serve with a napkin wrapped around the stick
20. Dip the "viking" in any condiments
21. I quarantee that you can't eat just one !

title: hot dog spread   dip
steps:
1. Cut hot dogs into 1 / 2 inch pieces , place in food processer and pulse on low until chopped
2. Add mustard , onion , pickle relish and dash of pepper , pulse on low until meat is a bit finer
3. Add salad dressing and pulse on low until almost smooth

title: spicy grilled pineapple salsa with ginger and jalapenos
steps:
1. Stir all ingredients together
2. Chill to blend flavors and serve

title: doomed chocolate chip cookie dough   for cheesecake
steps:
1. Cream sugars and butter in bowl on medium speed
2. Add water and vanilla
3. Gradually add flour
4. Stir in chips
5. If using for cheesecake drop teaspoons in filling and gently push dough below surface
6. If eating as is enjoy !

title: st  nick s dove sticks
steps:
1. Combine the butter , confectioners sugar , peanut butter and graham cracker crumbs in a bowl and mix thoroughly
2. Press the mixture into the bottom of a greased 15x10x1-inch pan
3. Melt unwrapped dove miniatures in the microwave for 90 seconds or until smooth
4. Pour melted chocolate on top of the pressed peanut butter layer , and smooth with a spatula
5. Place red and green m&m peanut chocolate candies over the layer of melted chocolate
6. Refrigerate to set chocolate for approximately 1 / 2 hour
7. Cut and serve

title: veronica s rice and chicken combo bake
steps:
1. Chicken: cut chicken breasts into bite size cubes
2. Sprinkle with salt , pepper and a pinch of cumin
3. Place in a bowl and set aside
4. Lime sauce: in a small bowl , combine the lime juice , oil and garlic
5. Mix well , pour over chicken cubes , cover and marinate in fridge for 1 hour
6. Rice: chop the onions and green chilies
7. In a 3 qt shallow baking dish , combine the cream of chicken soup , rice , onions , chilies and spices
8. Add the chicken and marinade , mix together , cover tightly and bake at 375 degrees for 45-60 minutes , or until rice is tender
9. Top with cheddar cheese& cilantro and serve immediately- serving size is 1 cup

title: lemon yoghurt marinated chicken breasts
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a ceramic baking dish and marinate for at least 4 hours , or overnight
2. I like to cut the chicken breast in half lengthways so it's not too thick
3. Cooking options: remove chicken from marinade and grill or bbq over medium heat until cooked through or place chicken , in marinade , in moderate oven and bake for 20 minutes
4. Serve with piles of mixed steamed vegetables and / or rice

title: cornbread cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Cream butter and sugar well
3. Add eggs one at a time
4. Do not overbeat
5. Mix dry ingredients together and add to butter mixture alternately with milk until all milk is gone
6. Pour into an ungreased 9"x13" pan and bake for 35-40 minutes or until golden brown

title: cherry angel food  low fat
steps:
1. Mix the dry cake mix and undrained can of pie filling by hand
2. Pour into ungreased pan or cupcake tins
3. Follow baking directions on the box

title: deluxe chicken breasts with cheese sauce
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Flatten chicken breasts between wax paper
3. Combine egg yolks and water
4. Combine 1 / 2 c flour , salt , pepper , paprika , bread crumbs and 3 t parmesan cheese
5. Dip the chicken in the egg mixture
6. Roll in the flour mixture
7. Brown the chicken in 2 t butter
8. Place the chicken in a shallow baking dish
9. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes or until juices run clear
10. To prepare the sauce: melt 2 t butter in a saucepan
11. Stir in the flour
12. Slowly add the milk
13. Stir constantly until the sauce thickens
14. Add the worcestershire sauce , 1 t parmesan cheese and grated cheddar cheese
15. Stir until the cheese melts
16. Serve by pouring the sauce over the chicken breasts

title: carrabba s t bone steaks with herbed garlic sauce
steps:
1. For the herbed garlic sauce:
2. Place the basil , garlic , mint , salt , pepper , and oregano in a mortar and pulverize with a pestle until the mixture turns into a paste
3. Place the paste in a glass jar and add the olive oil , lemon juice , and vinegar
4. Refrigerate
5. Before using , bring to room temperature and shake well
6. The sauce will hold in the refrigerator for two weeks
7. For the steaks:
8. Heat a gas grill or broiler
9. Lightly coat the steaks with olive oil on both sides , season with salt and pepper to taste and place on a hot grill
10. Cook for about four to six minutes per side for medium-rare
11. Let the steaks rest for five minutes before serving
12. Serve with the herbed garlic sauce on the side

title: marinade  grilled chicken with lemongrass   chilli
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl
2. To prepare the chicken , cut it 7 cm by 7 cms and cut several small incisions across the chicken to soak up the marinade
3. Combine marinade and meat then toss
4. You can either place it in a zip lock bag or just use a bowl with cling wrap
5. Refrigerate for about 2 hours , turning occasionally
6. Remove meat from the marinade and grill until cooked and brown
7. Discard leftover marinade
8. Traditionally it's grilled on an outdoor grill so that the coals are white-hot but i used our barbeque
9. Serve on a bed of lettuce with vietnamese fish sauce to dip
10. Side dish of rice or salad

title: devil dog squares
steps:
1. Mix cake mix , melted butter and 1 egg
2. Once this is well mixed , press the mixture into the bottom of a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking pan
3. In a medium bowl , combine the cream cheese , confectioner's sugar and eggs
4. Beat this until the mixture is smooth
5. Pour over the cake mixture and spread evenly
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 40-45 minutes
7. Allow to cool for 1 hour before cutting
8. Cut into 1-2 inch squares

title: browned butter icing
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , heat butter over medium-low heat for about 15 minutes or until browned
2. Remove browned butter from heat
3. Place 2 cups sifted powdered sugar in a medium bowl
4. Stir in browned butter , vanilla , and 3 to 4 tablespoons milk until icing consistency

title: summer addiction pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook the pasta until al dente
2. Drain and run under cold water
3. Drain well
4. In a large bowl , combine pasta with kidney beans , corn , tuna , onion , peppers and gherkins
5. Combine all dressing ingredients and pour over pasta
6. Toss to coat and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving to cool and blend flavours
7. This is great even 2-3 days after making !

title: linguine in sour cream and chive sauce
steps:
1. In medium saucepan , bring water , milk and butter to a boil
2. Reduce heat to medium
3. Slowly stir in pasta and special seasonings from box
4. Separate pasta with a fork , if needed
5. Boil uncovered 10 minutes or until pasta is tender , stirring frequently
6. Sauce will be thin
7. Let stand 4 to 5 minutes for sauce to thicken

title: szechuan noodles  raw vegan
steps:
1. Place the garlic and ginger in a food processor fitted with a steel blade
2. Add the vegetable oil , tahini , peanut butter , soy sauce , sherry , sherry vinegar , honey , chili oil , sesame oil , and ground peppers
3. Puree until smooth
4. Rinse and drain the kelp noodles in a colander , place it in a large bowl , toss with 3 / 4 of the sauce
5. Add the red and yellow bell peppers and scallions
6. Toss well
7. Serve warm , cold or room temperature
8. The remaining sauce may be added , as needed , to moisten the pasta
9. I love adding some crunch , so i usually throw some chopped peanuts , or blanched broccoli bits , crumbled crisp onions - anything really !
10. If you're not into spice , reduce it - although i personally feel that the spice adds another layer of amazingness ! =)

title: split pea soup with pancetta
steps:
1. In a stockpot , heat olive oil over medium heat
2. Add pancetta and cook out all the fat
3. Add garlic and shallot , saute until tender
4. Add onion , celery and carrot , saute until tender
5. Stir in split peas
6. Combine well
7. Add chicken stock , thyme , salt and pepper
8. Bring to a boil
9. Reduce heat and simmer until peas are soft and are falling apart
10. Remove from heat and cool slightly
11. Place a few ladles of soup into a blender and add a couple handfuls of spinach
12. Blend until spinach is incorporated
13. Place soup in a second pot
14. Repeat with remaining soup and spinach
15. Warm soup over very low heat

title: chipotle potato salad
steps:
1. Boil potatoes until soft , but not mushy
2. After potatoes have cooled , dice them and place in a medium size bowl
3. Add all remaining ingredients and stir
4. Best eaten while potatoes are still warm

title: easy french onion soup
steps:
1. Chop onions to the desired thickness
2. Heat oil and add onions and sugar
3. Cook about medium heat till caramelized , don't burn
4. Add broth , bullion , garlic , onion powder , salt and pepper
5. Simmer low for 10-20 minutes
6. Sprinkle grated cheeses on top of toast rounds and brown
7. Serve soup in individual crocks or i use coffee cups , top with the toast rounds

title: greek stuffed flank steak
steps:
1. Combine first 6 ingredients and set aside
2. Trim fat from steak
3. Cut horizontally through center of steak , cutting to , but not through , the other side and open flat , like a book
