4. Place between 2 sheets of heavy-duty plastic wrap and flatten to an even thickness using a meat mallet or rolling pin
5. Spread spinach mixture over steak , leaving a 1-inch margin around outside edges and roll up , jelly-roll fashion , starting with short side
6. Secure with heavy string at 2-inch intervals
7. Coat a large dutch oven with cooking spray and heat at medium-high until hot
8. Add steak , browning well on all sides
9. Add broth , wine , water , and oregano and bring to a boil
10. Cover , reduce heat and simmer 1 hour and 30 minutes , or until tender , turning meat once
11. Add additional water during cooking if necessary
12. Remove string and cut steak into 8 slices
13. Serve with cooking liquid

title: bistro style onion soup
steps:
1. Heat butter and oil in dutch oven over medium-high heat
2. Add onions and stir to coat
3. Cook , stirring occasionally , until golden , 10-15 minutes
4. Add garlic
5. Cook , stirring , 1 minute
6. Stir in flour
7. Reduce heat slightly and cook , stirring , until most of liquid is absorbed , about 3 minutes
8. Add broth , wine , the water , salt , thyme , and nutmeg to pan
9. Heat to boiling
10. Skim off fat
11. Reduce heat and simmer partially covered about 30 minutes
12. Skim again , then stir in pepper
13. Heat broiler
14. Ladle soup into ovenproof serving bowls set on baking sheet
15. Place 2 slices bread on each
16. Sprinkle with gruyere and press cheese lightly to rims of bowls
17. Sprinkle with parmesan
18. Broil until bubbly and golden , 3-5 minutes
19. Transfer hot bowls to plates and serve at once

title: glazed strawberry galette
steps:
1. Combine flour , sugar and salt in a bowl
2. Add the butter and rub it into the flour with your fingers until the mixture is coarse crumbs
3. Add 3 tbsp water and mix with a fork
4. Use hands to knead the dough in the bowl until it forms a ball
5. Flatten ball into 1-inch thick square , then wrap it in plastic and chill for an hour
6. Combine ground almonds , mascarpone , 2 tbsp honey and vanilla in a bowl and mix until smooth
7. Reserve
8. In another bowl , combine the strawberries , sugar and flour and reserve
9. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
10. Remove dough from fridge and let it sit on the counter for a few minutes
11. Roll it out on a floured work surface to a 14-inch square , then transfer to a parchment-lined baking sheet
12. Cover the dough with the mascarpone filling leaving a border around the edges
13. Arrange the strawberries over the filling
14. Fold edges of dough over the strawberries and pleat or crimp the edges
15. Combine egg yolk and milk and brush over the crust
16. Bake until golden-brown , about 40 minutes
17. Heat reserved honey and brush it over the strawberries

title: pineapple upside down biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to temperature as stated on biscuits
2. Using a cupcake or muffin tin grease 10 cups
3. Drain the can of crushed pineapple , saving the juice
4. Stir together the pineapple , sugar and butter until well mixed
5. Divide the pineapple mixture amongst the muffin cups
6. Place a cherry in the center of each tin , pressing to make sure cherry touches the bottom of the cup
7. Place 1 biscuit in each cup on top of the pineapple mixture
8. Spoon 1 teaspoon of the reserved pineapple juice over each biscuit
9. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes , or until golden brown
10. Cool for 2 minutes
11. Invert the pan onto a plate to relase the biscuits
12. Serve warm sprinkled with powdered sugar or plain

title: blueberry and raspberry pie
steps:
1. In large saucepan combine sugar , cornstarch , lemon juice and zest
2. Cook over medium-high heat until mixture boils , stirring constantly
3. Reduce heat and simmer until mixture is very thick
4. Remove from heat and fold in berries
5. Place one pie crust in bottom of pie plate and pour fruit mixture into crust
6. Top with second crust
7. Sprinkle the top crust with a little granulated sugar
8. Bake for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown
9. (place foil on the bottom rack of oven to catch any drips
10. Cover edges of crust with a strip of foil if you find it's getting too brown
11. Remove from oven and cool 2-3 hours before serving
12. )

title: ww cheese fries
steps:
1. Coat potato strips with cooking spray
2. And place in a large heavy-duty , zip-top plastic bag
3. Combine cheese and remaining 3 ingredients
4. Sprinkle over potato strips in bag
5. Seal bag and turn to coat potatoes well
6. Arrange potato strips in a single layer on a large baking sheet or jelly-roll pan coated with cooking spray
7. Bake at 450 degrees for 25 minutes , turning once
8. Serve immediately

title: the mighty bacon cheeseburger
steps:
1. Put about a 1 / 4 of a bag of charcoal in a charcoal chimmny and light it
2. Combine the ground beef and ground pork in a bowl
3. Add the a-1 steak sauce , cayenne pepper , minced garlic , and paprika to the ground beef and pork mixture
4. Mix together well
5. Form the patties by taking a ring and placing it on a plate
6. Fill it with about 1 / 8 of the meat mixture
7. Add about 1 / 4 of the cheese mixture
8. Add another 1 / 8 of the meat mixture and press together with something heavy , to make sure that the cheese mixture doesn't come out of the patty when you are cooking
9. Repeat this step till you have 4 patties
10. When your grill reaches 450 degrees fahrenheit , add the patties and cook for about 7 to 8 mintues on each side
11. I test this with a meat thermometer and stick it about 1 / 4 of the way into the patty
12. It should be about 165 degrees fahrenheit when it is cooked
13. Push the probe in until you feel it loosen up a bit which means you either poked all the way through or you reached the cheese
14. If you can't see the probe through the other side of the patty , it should read about 250 degrees fahrenheit
15. While the patties are cooking , put a frying pan on the grill next to the patties
16. Once the pan reaches about 300 degrees fahrenheit add the bacon
17. Put the brick on the bacon to keep it from curling up
18. Only do this because the bacon cooks faster and makes it easier to eat the burger when it is done
19. Butter the buns with melted butter and grill for about 1 / 2 to1 minute
20. Take the buns off the grill and put the patties on the buns
21. Add the bacon over the patty
22. Add any condiments you choose

title: sombrero spread
steps:
1. Brown meat and 1 / 4 cup of the onions in a skillet
2. Stir in the ketchup , chili powder , and salt
3. Add the beans with liquid and mash to mix thoroughly with the other ingredients
4. Heat and garnish with the cheddar cheese , the remaining onions , and the olives
5. Serve with corn chips

title: baked zucchini balls  gluten free
steps:
1. Grate the zucchini using a grater or food processor
2. Place the grated zucchini in a bowl , add a little bit of salt and set it aside for 30 minutes
3. Squeeze the water from the zucchini as much as possible
4. Preheat the oven to 400f / 200c degrees
5. Line an oven tray with aluminum foil and spray some oil
6. Add parmesan cheese , bread crumbs , egg , herb , salt and pepper and mix well
7. Form the mixture into small balls
8. Coat the balls with flour and dust off excess flour
9. Bake in the oven for about 20 minutes
10. Broil a few minutes to brown the balls
11. Be careful not to burn the balls
12. Infuse love and serve immediately with your favorite sauce

title: low fat garlic chicken pasta
steps:
1. Cook pasta until done , drain , return to pan
2. Stir in spinach , tomatoes and 2t oil
3. Cover to keep warm
4. While pasta is cooking: in 12 inch saucepan , heat remaing 1t oil over med heat
5. Add onion , cook and stir 1 minute
6. Add chicken , and garlic
7. Cook and stir until chicken is done
8. Stir in chicken broth , salt , and pepper
9. Cook 2 minutes
10. Remove from heat , stir in parsley and butter
11. Add chicken mixture to pasta mixture in saucepan ,
12. Toss to mix

title: rogene s chocolate dipped coconut macaroons
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Combine all ingredients except chocolate
3. Form balls and place 2" apart on lightly greased cookie sheets
4. Bake 20-25 minutes
5. Remove and place on waxed paper to cool
6. Melt chocolate in heavy pan
7. Dip edge of cookies in chocolate - it will set when cooled

title: tennessee hummingbird cake
steps:
1. Sift all dry ingredients
2. Set aside
3. Beat eggs , add oil and vanilla
4. Add dry ingredients and beat about 2 minutes
5. Add bananas , pineapple , nuts and fold in with a fork--don't beat
6. Bake 50 minutes at 350 degrees

title: wicklewood s gluten free scotch eggs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c
2. In a bowl , mix the sausage meat with the herbs and season well and divide into four portions
3. Prepare 3 shallow bowls , one containing the seasoned rice flour , one for the beaten eggs , and the other breadcrumbs
4. Take a boiled egg
5. Roll it in the flour ,
6. Cover the egg in a sausage meat portion
7. Roll it in the beaten egg and then in the breadcrumbs
8. Repeat this process for all the boiled eggs , set aside for five minutes
9. Double dip the eggs in the beaten egg and breadcrumbs one more time for extra texture
10. In a heavy based pan , heat the oil and , place the eggs in the oil and fry gently , turning regularly , for 5-6 mins or until they are golden brown and crispy
11. Transfer to a baking sheet and cook in a preheated oven for a further 10 minutes
12. Serve hot or cold

title: lime cream   fresh strawberry pie with gingersnap crust
steps:
1. Crust: combine all ingredients in a bowl til moistened
2. Press and pack tightly into bottom and sides of 9 inch pie plate
3. Bake about 7 minutes in preheated 350 oven
4. Cool completely before filling
5. Pie: whisk eggs , sugar and lime zest in saucepan til smooth
6. Add lime juice and butter and cook over medium heat , constantly whisking , til thickened 7 to 9 minutes
7. Strain mixture thru fine strainer into a bowl
8. Put plastic wrap on the surface of the filling and refrigerate until cold and thick , at least 3 hours or overnight
9. Whip cream until soft peaks
10. Fold whipped cream into chilled lime mixture
11. Pour into prepared pie shell
12. Cover with plastic wrap and chill at least 6 hours
13. Arrange strawberry slices on top of the chilled pie and serve !

title: easy home style potato wedges with herbs
steps:
1. Boil potatoes until tender
2. Cool slightly and cut each potato into 6 wedges
3. Place wedges in a bowl and sprinkle with remaining ingredients over top
4. Stir to coat all wedges with butter and seasoning
5. Place in a single layer on a cookie sheet and cook at 450 degrees for 30 to 35 minutes

title: japanese steakhouse style golden shrimp sauce
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Chill 24 hours before serving so flavors can meld

title: greatest grilled cheese ever
steps:
1. Slice cheese and lay on bread
2. Spread butter on both outside faces of bread
3. Sprinkly with oregano and garlic powder
4. Grill until both sides are toasted and cheese is melted through
5. I eat this with spagetti-o's , but that's because i'm a poor college student and need to balance out expensive cheese with cheap canned food

title: mustard baked pork chops w brie
steps:
1. In a sml bowl , combine seasoned breadcrumbs , parsley , melted butter , garlic & thyme
2. Set crumb mixture aside
3. In a wide , shallow bowl combine flour , coriander , salt & pepper
4. Evenly coat both sides of ea chop w / mustard & then coat w / flour mixture
5. Heat oil in skillet over med-hi heat
6. Brown chops well on ea side & place in a shallow baking dish
7. Cut brie in half & then cut again horizontally to form thin half-circles & place 1 on ea chop
8. Spoon crumb mixture on top of cheese-covered chops
9. Bake in a 400f oven for 20 minutes or till breadcrumbs are golden & chops just done
10. Serve immediately

title: carne guisado   colombian stewed beef
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a skillet and saut flank steak until browned
2. Remove from the skillet and saut chopped tomatoes , thinly sliced onions , minced garlic and cumin until veggies are tender
3. Add the flank steak , water , bouillon , salt and pepper
4. Allow to simmer on low until tender and meat pulls apart with a fork
5. Pull the steak apart into bite sized pieces
6. Allow the sauce to cook down to desired thickness for serving on rice , or add more water depending on how much it has cooked down
7. Enjoy !

title: grilled salmon with tiger sauce
steps:
1. Heat the grill
2. Place the salmon meat side down on the grill and glaze the skin with 1 tbs or so of tiger sauce
3. Dash it with the red pepper , garlic salt , and pepper
4. Turn it with a spatula in about 2minutes marinate the meat side the same as the skin side
5. Let cook about 3 minutes-- just enough to get the skin crispy
6. Flip the salmon again
7. Let cook another 7 minutes or so adding tiger sauce , garlic salt or pepper to taste
8. A fork will easily cut through the salmon at its thickest part when done
9. Leftovers: make the leftovers into a salmon salad using mayonnaise and onion and a little salt
10. Enjoy !

title: low fat pea soup with quinoa
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , bring water and quinoa to a boil
2. Reduce heat
3. Cover and simmer for approximately 12 minutes or until water is absorbed
4. Meanwhile , in a large saucepan , saute onion in oil until tender
5. Stir in broth and peas
6. Bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat
8. Simmer , uncovered , for five minutes or until peas are tender
9. In a blender or food processor , puree soup until smooth
10. If you are doubling the recipe , you may need to do this in batches
11. Return all to the pan
12. Stir in the salt , pepper and quinoa
13. Heat through
14. Garnish each serving with 1 teaspoon yogurt or sour cream if desired
15. For vegetarian use the vegetable broth and for vegan omit the yogurt / sour cream

title: goblin party mix
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients together in a large bowl , tossing with spoon
2. I often make 1 / 2 batch at a time

title: spicy cold celery
steps:
1. Cut the celery into 2-inch lengths
2. Mix with the salt and sugar and set aside for 10 minutes while you whisk together the remaining ingredients
3. Rinse , drain , and pat dry the celery , then toss with the dressing
4. Let stand in the refrigerator for at least three hours , and up to a day
5. Serve chilled

title: really easy and good mocha brownie icing
steps:
1. In a bowl , beat the cocoa , softened butter , liquid cooled coffee and vanilla until smooth
2. Add in the confectioners sugar 1 cup at a time beating well , until desired consistancy is reached
3. Spread on cooled brownies

title: cabbage stew
steps:
1. Chop onions , bacon or pork , potatoes and carrots
2. Fry onion and bacon or pork until onion is soft
3. Add the cabbage , fry for 10 minutes until it starts to soften
4. Add the rest of the vegatbles and spices , with beef stock
5. Simmer for about 30 minutes until all vegetables are done
6. Serve with lingonberry or cranberry jam

title: ginger applesauce pork leg roast
steps:
1. To a zip lock bag , add the ginger , worcestershire sauce , mustard , lemon zest , lemon juice and majoram
2. Add half the can of applesauce
3. Mix in bag thouroughly
4. Take a sharp fork and poke holes all over the roast , add roast to bag
5. Squeeze all the air out of the bag and squeeze and massage the marinade into the roast , be sure it is completely covered
6. Refrigerate at least 2 hours , or overnight , turning the bag now and then
7. Line a roaster pan with tinfoil or parchment paper , and place roast in centre of roaster
8. Squeeze any marinade left in the bag on top of the roast and spread it evenly with a knife , 'til the roast is completely crusted
9. Roast in a 400f degree oven for approximately 2 hours , or'til juice runs clear , but do not overcook
10. Let stand , covered , for 15 minutes before carving
11. Serve the other half of the appelsauce at the table with the roast

title: tomato and garlic crouton salad
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
2. In a small skillet over medium-low heat , add 3 tablespoons olive oil , the butter , garlic , red pepper flakes , and salt and pepper , to taste
3. Cook to infuse the butter and oil with the garlic , about 4 minutes
4. Add the cubed bread to a large bowl , pour the butter and garlic mixture over the bread and toss to coat
5. Transfer to a sheet tray and bake until crisp , about 10 minutes
6. Remove from the oven and let cool
7. In a small bowl whisk together the remaining olive oil and red wine vinegar and set aside
8. In a large serving bowl , combine the tomatoes , olives , mozzarella , croutons , basil , and the oil and vinegar mixture
9. Gently toss to coat all the tomatoes and croutons
10. Let the salad sit for 10 minutes before serving

title: dominoes   non bake dainties
steps:
1. First make the base by placing the margarine , sugar , cocoa , egg and vanilla in a double boiler
2. Cook over a low heat until well mixed
3. Add in the graham crumbs and coconut , then spread and press into a pan
4. For deep squares use a 9 inch square pan and for thinner ones use a 9 x 13 inch pan
5. Beat together the filling ingredients until creamy
6. Spread on the base and chill
7. Meanwhile , prepare the topping
8. Either melt a bar of chocolate with 1 tsp butter or use your favourite chocolate icing
9. Spread on top of the chilled filling , chill again and then cut

title: cinnamon cider martinis
steps:
1. Make the cinnamon-flavored vodka: place 2 cinnamon sticks inside the bottle of vodkayou may need to pour out a small amount of the vodka to make room for the cinnamon sticks
2. Seal tightly and let stand at room temperature for about 2 weeks , depending on the desired level of flavor
3. Shake the bottle every few days
4. Remove the cinnamon sticks and use
5. Rim the glass: dip the edges of 4 martini glasses in apple cider and rim them with cinnamon sugar
6. Make the drink: in a small saucepan , combine the 1 cup cider and 6 oz
7. Vodka
8. Heat over medium to medium-high heat until warm but not hot
9. Pour into rimmed martini glasses and serve

title: biscuits made easy
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix together with fingers
3. Pinch off - roll into balls
4. Top with oil before cooking
5. Cook for 10-15 minutes

title: apple smoked pork loin
steps:
1. This recipe begins with a light dry rub seasoning , continues with some apple wood smoke flavor , and ends with a tasty apple-cinnamon sauce
2. Begin by removing all of the membrane and excess fat from the outside of the pork loin
3. Rub the loin with olive oil , then lightly season it with a bit of this dry rub mixture
4. Smoke the loin at 225 degrees fahrenheit for two to three hours , or until the internal temperature reaches 155 degrees
5. Remove the smoked pork loin to a platter , covering lightly with foil and a kitchen towel
6. Let it rest for fifteen minutes before serving with the apple cinnamon sauce
7. Apple cinnamon sauce
8. Finely chop two large or three medium sweet apples and place in a saucepan
9. Add one tablespoon sugar , one-half teaspoon each of cinnamon , paprika , salt and white pepper , and two tablespoons rice wine vinegar
10. Cover and bring to a boil over medium heat , then lower to a simmer
11. Cook gently until the apples are tender
12. Slice the smoked pork loin and top with a spoonful of the sauce

title: tenderloin noodle casserole
steps:
1. Cook 6 ounces noodles in boiling salted water
2. Drain
3. Slowly brown six 1 / 2 inches slices pork tenderloin on both sides in hot fat
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Make blue cheese sauce: melt 3 tablespoons butter
6. Blend in 3 tablespoons all purpose flour , 3 / 4 tsp salt and dash of pepper
7. Stir in 1 cup of milk
8. Cook and stir till thick
9. Add 3 / 4 cup crumbled blue cheese
10. Stir till cheese melts
11. Combine noodles , sauce and 3 tbs
12. Each chopped green pepper and chopped pimiento
13. Place in 10x6x1-1 / 2 baking dish
14. Arrange meat on top
15. Bake at 350 about 30 minutes or till done

title: lemon blueberry scones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Mix the first four ingredients in a bowl
3. Cut in shortening
4. Add lemon rind
5. Add egg and milk and work in gently and quickly with hands
6. Add blueberries and gently fold in
7. Pat into round one inch thick on a baking sheet score into 8 pieces
8. Brush with milk and sprinkle with sugar
9. Bake 15 minutes or until slightly golden--do not over bake

title: graham chocolate bars
steps:
1. Combine crumbs , flour and baking soda and set aside
2. Combine butter and brown sugar
3. Stir in beaten eggs and vanilla
4. Add flour mixture and mix well
5. Stir in 1 cup of the chocolate chips and the walnuts
6. Spread mixture in greased 13x9 inch pan
7. Don't be alarmed if the mixture seems thick and doesn't fully cover the bottom of pan
8. It will as it bakes
9. Bake at 375 degrees for 16 to 18 minutes or till done
10. Remove from oven and immediately spread remaining chocolate chips over top
11. When melted , spread like a frosting over the top
12. Cool and cut into bars

title: doritos taco casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In a large skillet , brown ground turkey
3. Add onions and corn , cooking until the onions are tender
4. Add taco seasoning and water and mix until well combined
5. Remove from heat and mix in sour cream and salsa
6. Using a 2 quart baking dish , layer a few handfuls of ranch tortilla chips , slightly crushed , to the bottom
7. Sprinkle half of the meat mixture over the top and sprinkle with half of the cheese
8. Repeat with remaining ingredients
9. Bake for 20 minutes or until heated through and cheese is melted
10. Top with desired toppings to serve

title: spicy glazed almonds
steps:
1. Bring corn syrup , butter and water to a boil in a saucepan large enough to hold the almonds
2. Stir in spices
3. Add almonds and stir to coat
4. Place on a parchment-lined rimmed baking sheet and bake at 275 degrees for 1 hour
5. Stir every 15 minutes to distribute the glaze and separate the nuts
6. Cool and break apart any nuts that are stuck together

title: couscous with chicken
steps:
1. Clean the chicken breasts with cold water , lemon / lime and a pinch of salt
2. Rinse the chicken breasts and pat dry
3. Cut as desired
4. Saut the onion with oil until tender
5. Add to the the onion , the chicken breasts , cloves , cinnamon
6. Stir-fry until the chicken turns to golden brown
7. Combine the chicken , the tomatoes , red chili pepper , curry or turmeric , carrots , zucchini
8. Cook for five minutes
9. Add the chicken broth , bay leaves , salt and black pepper
10. Cook for 15 minutes
11. Meanwhile , prepare the couscous following direction from the package
12. In a serving dish , place the chicken and sauce in the middle and the couscous around it
13. Serve it warm

title: german chocolate pecan pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large bowl mix together the sugar , cocoa , and salt
3. Beat in the evaporated milk , eggs , melted butter and vanilla until well incorporated
4. Stir in the coconut and pecans
5. Pour into the unbaked pie shells and bake for 1 hour , up to 1 hour and 15 minutes
6. Remove from oven and cool on wire racks for 1 hour
7. Place pies in the fridge and chill well

title: sweet potato strudel
steps:
1. Peel and slice the raw sweet potatoes as thinly as possible
2. Measure oil into a small bowl
3. Combine the dry ingredients in another small bowl
4. Layer one quarter of the potatoes in a casserole dish , brushing the tops of the potatoes lightly with oil as you go using a brush
5. Sprinkle about a tbs of the parmesan cheese mixture on top
6. Repeat step 4 until potatoes and cheese are used up
7. Bake , covered , at 425f for 30 minutes
8. Uncover , and bake about 20 minutes more , until browned on top

title: city slicker
steps:
1. In a large drinking glass , place the ice cubes
2. Since they are made of juice , they will not dilute the drink
3. Pour in the pineapple juice
4. Fill the glass the rest of the way with ginger ale
5. Thread a pineapple chunk , then a cherry , and another pineapple chunk on a toothpick
6. Sprinkle on a pinch of ginger for color , not much , though
7. Garnish the drink
8. It wastes time to make each glass individually , having to pick up each ingredient a half a dozen times
9. Also , you can pre-make a ton of the pineapple ice cubes prior to your party and store them in zip-top bags and pre-assemble the garnish sticks
10. I just use canned pineapple and a jar of cherries

title: egg butter
steps:
1. Melt butter in a medium sized sauce pan and cool
2. Stir in the egg , sugar , corn syrup & water
3. Bring the mixture to a boil and cook for
4. 1 minute
5. Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla
6. Cover and set aside to cool while preparing pancakes or waffles or biscuits

title: sugar coated walnuts
steps:
1. Stir together 1st 3 ingredients until sugar melts
2. Cook to soft ball stage
3. Add 1 tsp of vanilla
4. Mix till mixture begins to thicken
5. Add 3 1 / 2 c walnuts or pecans stir till coated
6. Turn out on greased platter or cookie sheet till cool
7. When cool enough to touch break them in pieces

title: tortilla rollups
steps:
1. Mix together cream cheese , olives , chilies , and onions of desired
2. Spread the cream cheese mixture in a thin layer on each tortilla
3. Roll up jelly roll style
4. Slice into 1 inch pieces
5. Serve with salsa for dipping

title: green bean casserole ii
steps:
1. Drain beans , put in 9 x 13-inch baking dish
2. Drain corn , pour over beans
3. Mix onions , celery soup , sour cream and cheese
4. Pour over beans and corn
5. Crush crackers , melt butter and mix with crackers
6. Spread over top and bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes

title: scrambled eggs bacon  potatoes  peppers and onions and sausage
steps:
1. First cut up bacon and sausage into small pieces and fry
2. Take out mix and discard the grease
3. Put potatoes , cut up onions , and cut up peppers into the fry pan and brown slightly
4. Add the bacon / sausage and then scramble the eggs and put into the potatoe / bacon mix and cook all together
5. Add cheese to top if so--
6. You can add or subtract as much as you need--

title: chicken and brown rice medley
steps:
1. "flake" chicken in a medium sized bowl
2. Mix in cooked brown rice
3. Add about half of the nut pieces
4. Melt margarine or butter in a pan
5. Add sliced celery and cook for a couple of minutes until almost translucent
6. Add sliced mushrooms and heat until mushrooms have reduced
7. Mix in sliced green onions and cook until they have wilted slightly
8. Combine cooked vegetables and the liquid with the chicken and rice mixture
9. Top with reserved nuts and serve

title: sweet cherry french toast
steps:
1. Place the bread in a greased 15-in
2. X 10-in
3. X 1-in
4. Baking pan
5. In a bowl , whisk the eggs , milk , syrup , sugar , orange peel and salt
6. Pour over bread
7. Turn to coat
8. Cover and refrigerate overnight
9. In a bowl , combine the cherries , orange juice and sugar
10. Cover and refrigerate overnight
11. Transfer bread slices to another greased 15-in
12. X 10-in
13. X 1-in
14. Baking pan
15. Discard any remaining egg mixture
16. Bake at 400 for 15-18 minutes or until golden brown , turning once
17. Meanwhile , in a small saucepan , combine cornstarch and water until smooth
18. Stir in the reserved cherry mixture
19. Bring to a boil
20. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
21. Serve over french toast
22. Drizzle with yogurt

title: garden stuffed baked potatoes
steps:
1. Cook baked pototoes on bottom rack of oven until done approx 1 hour @ 400 degrees
2. Do not wrap in foil
3. You can rub oil on them but not necessary
4. Let cool
5. Cut potatoes in half and scoop out pulp into large bowl
6. Save skins for stuffing
7. Steam broccoli for 5 minutes
8. Chop only florets into small pieces
9. In skillet , saute onions with butter / margarine over medium heat until tender
10. Mash potato pulp , as desired , in a large bowl
11. Add onion , broccoli , sour cream and ranch dressing to pulp
12. Add parsley if desired
13. Add salt & pepper to taste
14. Spoon mixture into potato shells
15. Sprinkle shredded cheese over potatoes
16. Bake at 350 degrees for 15-20 minutes
17. Leftovers freeze well

title: taco bars
steps:
1. Brown ground beef in skillet over medium heat until no pink remains
2. Drain fat and rinse , if desired
3. Add taco seasoning and prepare according to package directions
4. Unroll one tube of crescent rolls and place on bottom of 9" x 13" cake pan
5. Press seams together and spread out to cover bottom of pan
6. Bake in 375 degrees f oven until rolls just start to brown
7. Cover dough with hot beef mixture
8. Then spread sour cream over beef using a teaspoon
9. Sprinkle with cheese and drizzle with salsa
10. Unroll second tube of crescent rolls and carefully spread out over top , pinching together seams where possible
11. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until top is golden brown
12. Let set 10 to 15 minutes , then cut into squares

title: kumquat refrigerator pie
steps:
1. Beat the condensed milk with the whipped topping
2. Add the lemon juice and beat until thickened
3. Add the kumquats , pour in pie shell and chill in refrigerator for several hours

title: hot feta
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180 c
2. Cut two 40cms lengths of foil and layer on top of each other
3. Top with a piece of baking paper
4. Place feta in middle of baking paper
5. Sprinkle with thyme or other herbs
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Drizzle with oil
8. Fold paper and foil edges and turn upwards to seal and form a parcel
9. Place parcel on a baking tray
10. Bake 20 minutes till feta is heated through and slightly soft
11. Serve warm with crackers and olives

title: mixed greens with dried cranberries and toasted pecans
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Toast the pecans in a shallow pan until they begin to release fragrance , about 5 to 7 minutes
3. Let cool completely
4. Combine the lettuce , mesclun , and onion in a salad bowl
5. Just before serving , pour on the dressing and toss well
6. Check to see if you need to add more dressing
7. You don't want to make the greens too wet
8. Serve on individual salad plates with the pecans and the cranberries sprinkled on each portion
9. To make lemon-soy dressing: place all the ingredients in a jar with a tight-fitting lid and shake vigorously
10. Yield: 3 / 4 cup

title: sue s strawberry almond muffins
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375
2. Line a 12 cup muffin tin with paper liners
3. In the bowl of an electric mixer , cream the butter and sugar
4. Add eggs , one at a time , and blend until fluffy
5. Mix in the milk and the almond extract
6. In a separate bowl , sift together the flours , baking powder and salt
7. Add the dry ingredients to the milk mixture , and blend until just combined
8. Fold in the strawberries and almonds
9. Fill the muffin cups to the top , and bake for 30 minutes

title: roasted sweet peppers  sour orange vinaigrette   goat cheese
steps:
1. Turn on two gas-fired stovetop burners and roast the peppers directly on the flames , turning them often with tongs , until fully blackened
2. Transfer the peppers to a bowl , cover tightly with plastic wrap , and let steam until cool enough to touch
3. Rub off the black skins , cut out the stems , remove the seeds , and rip the peppers in half
4. Cut the pepper flesh into strips and then on the diagonal into 1-inch-wide diamonds
5. Heat 2 tablespoons of the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat
6. Add the garlic and cook , stirring , until it turns light golden brown
7. Add the peppers , season with teaspoon salt , a few cranks of pepper , and a pinch of sugar , and cook over medium-low heat , stirring occasionally , until the peppers soften and sweeten , about 15 minutes
8. Meanwhile , for the sour orange vinaigrette , whisk together the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil , teaspoon salt , black pepper to taste , the red pepper flakes , and the orange and lemon juices
9. Lay the cooked peppers out on a platter , drizzle with the sour orange vinaigrette , and top with the crumbled cheese
10. Serve warm or at room temperature , with grilled bread

title: mississippi mud
steps:
1. Layer one
2. Combine all ingredients for layer one in a a large bowl
3. Mix until crumbly
4. Press into the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish lightly greased
5. Bake at 350f for 20 to 25 minutes
6. Allow to cool completely
7. Layer two:
8. In medium bowl beat together all ingredients for layer two
9. Working with a teaspoon and very little cream cheese mixture slowly spread it over layer one , careful not to pull up any of the first layer
10. Layer three:
11. Prepare pudding according to package directions
12. Let cool , once room temperature spread it over the cream cheese mixture
13. Layer four:
14. Top with the remaining cool whip
15. Garnish with chocolate curls

title: 4 layer pizza dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In a blender combine tomatoes , garlic , onion , italian seasoning , salt , and pepper
3. Blend until pureed
4. Set pizza sauce aside
5. In a medium bowl , combine cream cheese , sour cream and 2 ounces of shredded cheese
6. Mix well until well combined
7. Spread cream cheese mixture in an even layer over baking dish
8. Pour blended pizza sauce over cream cheese mixture and evenly distribute with spatula
9. Sprinkle remaining shredded cheese over pizza sauce
10. Top pizza dip with bacon and pepperoni
11. Bake for 20-25 minutes , until cheese is browned and bubbly

title: sweet and sour mustard
steps:
1. In a saucepan , whisk together all ingredients
2. Cook over low heat , stirring constantly , until thickened
3. Pour into storage container , cover and refrigerate

title: mika s layered cornbread salad
steps:
1. Bake corn muffin mix as directed
2. Cool and crumble 1 / 2 in bottom of a clear bowl
3. Mix tomatoes and onions together
4. Layer 1 / 2 of corn , beans , tomato and onion mixture and 1 / 2 of cheese
5. Pour 1 / 2 of dressing over this
6. Repeat
7. Sprinkle top with crumbled bacon
8. Needs to sit for awhile to allow dressing to saturate evenly
9. Serve cold

title: o charley s chicken harvest soup
steps:
1. In a large pot , melt butter
2. Add flour and cook 3 to 4 minutes
3. Slowly add the 2 1 / 2 to 3 quarts of water , stirring constantly
4. The amount of water used depends on how thick you want the soup
5. )
6. Simmer 20 minutes
7. Add chicken base and chicken stock
8. While chicken stock mixture is cooking , bring 2 quarts of water to a boil in a separate pot
9. Add carrots , celery and onion
10. Cook 6 minutes
11. Drain
12. Add to chicken stock mixture along with white pepper and garlic powder
13. Simmer 10 minutes
14. Add diced cooked chicken tenders
15. Cook noodles in a separate pan of boiling water for 3 to 4 minutes
16. Drain and rinse with cold water
17. Add to soup
18. Simmer soup 2 or 3 minutes more and serve
19. To make your chicken tenders
20. In a large pot , bring water , chicken base , onion and celery to simmer
21. Add chicken
22. Gently simmer until done , about 5 to 6 minutes
23. Do not overcook
24. Drain chicken and reserve stock
25. Place chicken in the freezer to stop the cooking process
26. When cool , use a sharp knife to dice into 1 / 2-inch cubes
27. Add to soup

title: chicago style pizza crust
steps:
1. In a mixer , combine water and yeast , allowing yeast to dissolve
2. Add the remaining ingredients and begin mixing the dough using a dough hook at low speed
3. Once a ball has formed , mix on medium speed for 1 to 2 minutes until dough becomes elastic and smooth
4. Remove from the mixer and place in a bowl coated with olive oil
5. Allow to rest approximately 4 hours
6. Once rested , divid into two portions , place on a flat surface and dust with flour
7. Preheat oven to 425f sprinkle the bottoms of two deep baking dishes or deep dish pizza pans with cornmeal
8. Spread the dough , using your fingers , at the bottom of the pan making sure to have enough to come up the sides approximately 1 / 2 inch high
9. Layer first with mozzarella , then tomato sauce and toppings
10. Bake pizza for 30 to 40 minutes or until crispy and golden

title: snowball potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Put potatoes in a large pot and fill with water until potatoes are just covered
3. Add the 1 tablespoon salt
4. Bring to a boil and cook until potatoes are very soft , about 20 minutes
5. Press potatoes through a potato ricer or pulse in a bowl with an immersion hand blender until they are mashed
6. Let sit for a few minutes until just cool enough to handle
7. While the potatoes are cooking , cut the white cheese in 1 / 2-inch cubes
8. Cover a baking sheet with foil wrap and coat foil with vegetable spray or rub with oil
9. Put bread crumbs into a small bowl
10. While mashed potatoes are still warm , form into 2-inch balls and insert 1 cheese cube in center , then roll into bread crumbs and place on cookie sheet
11. Place snowballs on prepared baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown

title: crusty popovers  w  3 variations  gluten free
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Preheat a 12-cup muffin tin for 5 minutes
3. This is a very important step for popovers
4. A warm muffin tin helps to facilitate the rising of the batter
5. Let the tin stay in the oven until you are ready to pour the batter
6. In a blender , add eggs and milk and pulse just until blended
7. Then add the tapioca flour , rice flour and salt and pulse until combined
8. Remove your baking tin lightly grease with cooking spray
9. Pour in the batter , filling each muffin cup 3 / 4 full
10. Fill any empty muffin cups with water to ensure even baking
11. Bake 25 minutes , or until popovers are puffed high and are a rich , golden brown
12. For puffiest popovers , avoid opening the oven door before 25 minutes
13. Serve immediately
14. Garlic & herb popovers: mix in after salt: 2 tablespoons fresh herbs , stemmed and chopped fine , and 1 clove minced garlic
15. Parmesan cheese popovers: mix in after salt: 1 / 4 cup finely grated parmesan cheese and 1 tablespoon finely chopped italian parsley
16. Yorkshire pudding popovers: add 1 tablespoon of meat dripping to bottom of muffin cups

title: super simple sausage breakfast casserole
steps:
1. Brown sausage
2. Drain
3. Grease a 13x9 pan
4. In the pan , mix together the melted butter and frozen hash browns
5. Smooth into bottom layer
6. In another bowl , mix together the sausage , eggs , onion , cheddar and cottage cheese
7. Pour mixture over the hashbrowns
8. Bake for an hour at 375 degrees
9. It's done when a toothpick comes out clean

title: barefoot contessa s raspberry champagne
steps:
1. Place the sugar in a small dish
2. Place the 1 tbsp chambord in a small dish
3. Dip rim of a flute glass into chambord then into sugar
4. Let dry completely
5. Place a few raspberries in bottom of glass
6. Fill with 2 tbsps of chambord
7. Fill rest of glass to top with champagne

title: maple cupcakes
steps:
1. Whisk togeter the soymilk and vinegar in a bowl and set aside to curdle for a few minutes
2. Sift the flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt and nutmeg into a separate bowl and mix
3. Whisk the maple syrup , oil , brown sugar , maple extract and vanilla into the soymilk mixture
4. Form a well in the dry ingredients and add the wet ingredients
5. Stir until large lumps disappear
6. Fold in walnuts
7. Fill 12 cupcake liners two-thirds full
8. Bake at 350 degress for 20-22 minutes
9. Cool completely before frosting

title: peanut butter chocolate chip brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Coat bottom of an 8 square baking pan with pam
3. Lightly spoon flour into a dry measuring cup
4. Level with a knife
5. Combine flour , chocolate chips , soda , and salt in a bowl
6. Combine sugars and remaining ingredients in a bowl
7. Stir until well-blended
8. Add flour mixture , stirring just until blended
9. Spread batter in bottom of prepared pan
10. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out almost clean
11. Cool on a wire rack

title: tempeh  chicken  salad
steps:
1. Place the cubed tempeh in a saucepan of boiling , salted water
2. Reduce heat to low , and simmer for about 12 minutes , drain and set aside to cool
3. I usually toss it in the fridge
4. In a large bowl , combine the celery , pepper , pickle , scallion and parsley
5. Run a knife through the cubed tempeh , just to give it a rough chop add chopped tempeh to the bowl , along with the mayonnaise , mustard , lemon , salt and pepper
6. Fold everything together , cover , and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors combine
7. This will keep covered in the fridge for 2-3 days
8. This salad goes great on wheat toast , in a pita pocket , or in a lavash wrap

title: cilantro pesto chicken tenders
steps:
1. In a food processor , finely chop the walnuts and garlic
2. Add cilantro , parsley , salt and pepper and process until finely chopped
3. With processor running , slowly add the oil to create a smoothe puree
4. Place chicken in large , resealable bag plastic bag , add the marinade and seal tightly
5. Make sure marinade is evenly distributed on all the chicken tenders
6. Refrigerate for 2 hours
7. Remove chicken from bag and thread on skewers
8. Grill over direct high heat for about 6 to 8 mins , turning over once
9. Serve warm with lime wedges

title: sweet spinach smoothie  my way
steps:
1. Add all ingredients to the blender and process til smooth
2. Add an extra 1 / 4 cup of water if necessary to get the blender going
3. Mine took about 45 seconds total and a full 1 / 2 cup of water

title: ultimate restaurant salsa
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in large nonreactive bowl
2. Refrigerate , covered , at least 2 hours
3. Taste , and readjust seasoning if needed
4. Enjoy !

title: creamy fiesta dip
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients
2. Cover
3. Refrigerate until ready to serve

title: pineapple pecan cheese spread
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , beat cream cheese until smooth
2. Add the cheese , 3 / 4 cup pecans , pineapple , chilies , red pepper , and garlic powder
3. Mix well
4. Transfer to a serving dish
5. Cover and refrigerate until serving
6. Right before serving , sprinkle top with remaining 1 / 4 cup pecans

title: bruschetta mushrooms
steps:
1. Spray pan with non-stick spray
2. Arrange mushroom caps in pan , season to taste with salt , pepper & italian seasoning
3. Break gorgonzola into pieces that will fill the mushroom caps - plop the gorgonzola into the hole left from the stem
4. Combine tomatoes , basil , garlic & balsamic , season to taste if desired
5. Spread tomato mixture over mushrooms stuffed with cheese
6. Sprinkle with mozzarella
7. Bake at 350f until mushrooms are cooked through and cheese is melted
8. If you like browned cheese hit it with the broiler for a few minutes

title: hot and spicy fish soup
steps:
1. Put the first 13 ingredients into a large stockpot
2. Bring to a boil
3. Simmer gently 5 or 6 mnutes
4. Cut the fish into 2 inch pieces and add to broth
5. Simmer for an additional 8 minutes
6. Add cilantro , hominy , butter and heat gently
7. Adjust seasonings to taste
8. Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with boiled white rice and lemon slices

title: french lemon pie
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a bowl , beat eggs for about 3 minutes
3. Add in corn syrup , rind and melted butter
4. Mix to combine
5. In a small bowl , mix together flour and sugar
6. Add to the egg mixture
7. Mix to combine well
8. Pour into unbaked prepared pie shell
9. Bake for 45-50 minutes
10. Cool to room temperature , then chill before serving
11. Just before serving , mound / spread on the whipped cream on top of the pie

title: pan fried steak in cognac peppercorn sauce
steps:
1. Melt 1 tablespoon butter in heavy medium saucepan over medium-high heat
2. Add shallots and saut until beginning to brown , about 5 minutes
3. Add peppercorns and mash with back of fork
4. Add broth , cognac , and cream and boil until sauce is thick enough to coat spoon , whisking occasionally , about 15 minutes
5. Set sauce aside
6. Melt remaining 1 tablespoon butter with olive oil in heavy large skillet over medium-high heat
7. Sprinkle steak with salt and pepper
8. Add steak to skillet and saut until brown and cooked to desired doneness , about 4 minutes per side for medium-rare
9. Transfer steak to cutting board
10. Add reserved sauce to same skillet and bring to boil , stirring to scrape up browned bits
11. Slice steak thinly
12. Transfer steak to platter
13. Serve with sauce

title: make ahead brownie delight
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f grease bottom and sides of 9-inch springform pan
2. Prepare brownies as directed on package , using oil , water and eggs
3. Stir in chocolate chips
4. Spread batter in greased pan
5. Bake at 350f for 45-50 minutes or until center is almost set , cool 1 hour or until completely cooled
6. In large bowl , beat whipping cream until stiff peaks form
7. In large bowl , combine cream cheese and powdered sugar
8. Beat until smooth
9. Stir in melted vanilla chips
10. Fold in 1 / 3 of the whipped cream
11. Fold in remaining whipped cream
12. Reserve 1 cup mixture for piped edge
13. Spread remaining mixture over brownie
14. Using decorating bag fitted with star
15. Cover
16. Refrigerate at least 2 hours
17. Meanwhile , in food processor with metal blade or blender container , process raspberries with syrup until smooth
18. Strain to remove seeds
19. In small saucepan , combine 3 tablespoons sugar and cornstarch
20. Stir in raspberry pure
21. Cool and stir over medium heat until mixture boils and thickens
22. Cool to room temperature ,
23. About 1 hour before serving , arrange fresh raspberries over filling
24. Refrigerate until serving time
25. With sharp knife , loosen dessert from sides of pan
26. Remove sides of pan
27. Cut into wedges
28. Serve with raspberry sauce
29. Store in refrigerator

title: egg free no bake pineapple cheese cake
steps:
1. Drain the pineapple squeeze the excess juice off and let it drain
2. Cream the cream cheese in a mixing bowl ,
3. Then mix in the coolwhip , pineapple and sugar
4. When well mixed pour into the grahm cracker crust
5. Put in the refrigerator to chill
6. Total time to mix is 10 miniute and chill varies depending on how cold your fridge is , 30 minute

title: tomato lentil pasta sauce
steps:
1. Saute onions celery carrots garlic and pancetta in oil
2. Add bay leaves and spices and cook 8 min or until vegetables are tender
3. Stir in lentils tomatoes and wine bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer 30-40
4. Minute
5. Discard bay leaves , stir in parsley
6. Serve over penne or other pasta

title: caramel corn
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 250f spray large baking sheet or roasting pan with cooking oil spray and set aside
2. In a large sauce pan , melt butter over low heat
3. Add next 3 ingredients and bring to a boil , stirring constantly
4. Cover , reduce heat and gently boil without stirring for 4-5 minutes
5. Remove from heat and carefully add soda and vanilla
6. Mix real well
7. Remove unpopped kernels from popcorn
8. Spread popcorn out on pan
9. Pour caramel mixture over popcorn and mix well
10. Don't worry if every kernel isn't coated
11. It will get better distributed when you stir it while it is baking
12. Bake 1 hour , stirring every 15 minutes
13. Cool completely
14. Break apart and store in tightly sealed container
15. Shake it slightly so the kernels settle to the bottom of the bowl , then transfer the popcorn , handful by handful to the roasting pan , leaving the kernels behind

title: holiday cranberry pumpkin cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f spray 1 bundt cake pan or 2 loaf pans with cooking spray
2. In bowl , combine sugar , pumpkin , oil , eggs , and vanilla
3. Mix well
4. In large mixing bowl , combine the other ingredients except the cranberries
5. Make a well in the center of the flour mixture and pour in the pumpkin mixture
6. Mix well
7. Fold cranberries into batter and spoon into cake pan
8. Bake for 1 hour or until cake test done with toothpick inserted in center and coming out clean
9. Let cakes cook for 10 minutes before removing from pan
10. Cool completely before applying the glaze
11. Glaze: in small bowl , combine the sugar and milk until smooth fold in 1 / 3 cup of the cranberries
12. Place cake on wire rack with wax paper under rack
13. Spoon the glaze over the cake to completely cover the top
14. Sprinkle remaining cranberries on top of glaze

title: tilapia with capers and white wine
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. In a medium-hot iron skillet briefly toast fennel seeds
3. In a large pyrex baking dish sprayed with cooking spray , arrange fillets in a single layer
4. Spread mustard on the fillets , and sprinkle with salt and pepper
5. Top with capers and fennel seeds
6. Pour wine around fish
7. Oven-roast uncovered for 15-17 minutes , or until cooked through , and some of the wine has evaporated

title: no butter sauce for vegetables
steps:
1. In a saucepan , combine the first six ingredients
2. Stir in milk and water until smooth
3. Bring to a boil over medium heat , cook and stir for 1 minute or until thickened and bubbly
4. Serve over hot cooked vegetables

title: croatian sarma soup  stuffed cabbage soup
steps:
1. Cook turkey bacon in frying pan until crisped , remove from pan to drain on paper towels
2. Crumble and set aside
3. Add ground beef to pan and brown in turkey bacon drippings until almost cooked through
4. Add diced onion and cook 4-5 minutes until onions are transparent
5. Add garlic and cook an additional 1-2 minutes
6. Drain meat mixture on paper towel lined plate
7. Place all ingredients , including meat mixture and turkey bacon , in a large pot and cook over medium heat until it boils
8. Turn heat down and cook for at least one hour , stirring occasionally
9. Add a little water if it gets too thick for your liking
10. I cook mine 2-3 hours

title: kittencal s easy tartar sauce
steps:
1. Mix all three ingredients together adjusting the relish and garlic powder amounts to taste
2. Cover and chill for a minimum of 2 hours before serving
3. Delicious !

title: beef and orzo soup
steps:
1. Heat oil in 4-quart saucepan until sizzling
2. Add beef pieces , cook over medium-high heat , stirring occasionally , until browned
3. Add all remaining ingredients except cheese and parsley
4. Continue cooking until mixture comes to a boil
5. Cook , stirring occasionally , until orzo is tender
6. To serve , top each serving with cheese and garnish with parsley

title: waikiki meatballs
steps:
1. Mix together hamburger , cracker crumbs , eggs , milk , salt
2. Shape mixture into meatballs and cook in the oven , in a single layer on a cookie sheet with sides , at 350 degrees fahrenheit for about 20 minutes , depending on the size of your meatballs
3. While the meatballs are cooking , mix together corn starch and brown sugar in a small bowl
4. Drain the syrup from the pineapple and add to corn starch and brown sugar , stirring really well
5. Add vinegar and soy sauce
6. Mix until smooth
7. Pour mixture into sauce pan and cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until mixture thickens and begins to boil
8. Reduce heat
9. While waiting for the meatballs to finish cooking , cook the rice
10. As soon as the meatballs are cooked , drain them and add them to sauce on stove
11. Add pineapple
12. Place rice on plate and cover with the meatballs and sauce
13. Serve immediately

title: picnic basket bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Mix cheese , spinach , chicken , onion , and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt for filling
3. Set aside
4. Dissolve yeast in 1 cup warm water
5. Mix yeast mixture , sugar , 1 teaspoon salt , and 1 cup flour in a mixing bowl
6. Gradually add 1 1 / 2 cups flour to dough
7. Knead dough until smooth , using other 1 / 2 cup flour if dough is sticky
8. Roll dough into a 16 x 10-inch rectangle
9. Spread filling down the middle of dough
10. Bring dough edges together and seal
11. Place seam-side down on lightly greased cookie sheet
12. Brush bread with egg white and sprinkle with sesame seeds
13. Bake at 375 for 40 minutes
14. Serve warm , or cool and refrigerate

title: cauliflower and chickpea curry
steps:
1. Fry curry paste in oil
2. Add cauliflower , carrots , chickpeas
3. Fry for 5 minutes
4. Add peas and pineapple , and fry for a further 5 minutes
5. Add chicken stock , and simmer on low heat for 20 minutes
6. Add coconut milk , and simmer for a further 20 minutes
7. Serve with jasmine rice

title: egg salad boats
steps:
1. In a large bowl , gently stir together eggs , mayonnaise , celery , onions , dill and lemon juice until well combined
2. Set aside
3. Cut out cores from tomato stem ends
4. Then cut each tomato almost to the base into 8 wedges
5. Place each tomato on a lettuce lined plate , carefully spread wedges open and spoon about 3 / 4 cup egg salad into center

title: a dilly potato salad  no mayo
steps:
1. Place potatoes large saucepan
2. Add water to cover
3. Bring to boil
4. Cook until potatoes are just tender
5. Add beans
6. Cook 2 minutes
7. Drain
8. Cool slightly
9. Mix potatoes , beans , olives , celery and onion in large bowl
10. Whisk remaining ingredients in small bowl
11. Add to vegetables
12. Toss to coat
13. Refrigerate at least 4 hours or until ready to serve
14. Stir before serving

title: easy french vanilla coconut macaroons
steps:
1. Mix sweetened condensed milk , coconut , and french vanilla blend
2. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased baking sheets
3. Bake in preheated 350 oven 10 to 12 minutes or until edges of cookies are golden brown
4. Immediately remove from sheets
5. Cool on wire racks

title: polish american spaghetti sauce
steps:
1. Saut onion and garlic in butter just until softened
2. Add ground round and brown slowly , breaking up to a fine crumble
3. Add wine and simmer for about 20 minutes until it is reduced by half
4. Add tomato soup , broth , and seasonings , stir well and bring to boil
5. Cover and simmer for 1 hour
6. If sauce is not thick enough for you , uncover and simmer for another 10 to 15 minutes
7. Serve over your favorite pasta

title: coq au vin  the easy way
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add chicken pieces and brown on all sides
3. Remove chicken and drain on paper towels
4. Add onions , garlic and carrots to skillet , and let brown slightly
5. Push vegetables to one side and sprinkle in flour , stirring constantly
6. Gradually stir in sherry
7. Add bay leaf , parsley , thyme and mushrooms
8. Season with salt and pepper
9. Reduce heat to low and return chicken to pan
10. Cover and simmer about 45 minutes , or until chicken is tender , adding more sherry if needed
11. Remove bay leaf before serving

title: jalousie
steps:
1. Put ice until half of the shaker
2. Add the rum , amaretto , curacao , lime juice and pineapple juice
3. Shake vigorously and filter in a highball glass in which you already put a few ice cubes
4. Garnish with a pineapple chunk

title: add a little interest with persian couscous
steps:
1. Stir the couscous , stock powder , sugar and grated orange rind , together in a bowl
2. Add the boiling water , cover , and leave to stand for 6 minutes
3. Heat the nuts and currants in the butter or oil in a small frying pan , until the nuts brown lightly , and the currants puff up
4. Add the chopped apricots
5. Stir the hot nuts and fruit through the couscous
6. Serve hot , warm , or at room temperature , adding the finely chopped spring onions and coriander just before serving

title: southwest mac and cheese
steps:
1. Brown and strain the sausage
2. Start the shells and cheese cooking as the box directs only use a cup more water
3. Dice up the zucchini
4. I slice it thick with the skin on then quarter each slice
5. When the water starts to boil add the shells and zucchini
6. When the shells are tender drain the pot
7. Open and drain the can of rotel
8. Add all ingredients in to the pot adding the cheese package
9. ( i add a handful of my fav shredded cheese and 1 / 3 cup milk in addition to the packet
10. Salt and pepper to taste :)

title: jelly sauce for ham
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a bowl
2. Serve with ham

title: cream puff sundaes
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425 degrees
2. In medium saucepan , heat water and margarine to boiling
3. Stir in flour and salt
4. Cook over medium heat , stirring vigorously until mixture leaves sides of pan in smooth compact ball , about 2 minutes
5. Remove from heat
6. Add eggs , one at a time , beating vigorously after each addition until mixture is smooth and glossy
7. Spoon 6 mounds of dough about 3 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet
8. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until puffed and golden brown
9. Cool completely
10. Split
11. Remove any filaments of soft dough
12. Fill each with icecream and top with chocolate syrup

title: saucy low fat lemonade chicken
steps:
1. In mixing bowl combine , concentrate , ketchup , sugar , vinegar , soy sauce and spices
2. Cut chicken into bite size pieces and toss in ziplock back w / flour
3. In large sauce pan heat oil
4. Shake off excess flour add chicken and brown on all sides
5. Add sauce cover and simmer low , about 30 minutes or until cooked through
6. You can add diced green bell pepper if you would like at the simmering point
7. It adds color and more flavour

title: finger licking ribs
steps:
1. Cut ribs into 8 to 10 portions and place in a heavy saucepan
2. Cover with water and boil gently for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes , or until tender
3. To make sauce , stir remaining ingredients together
4. Brush ribs with sauce and barbeque over hot coals
5. Turn often , basting with sauce , until hot and glazed , about 8 to 10 minutes

title: hillbilly salad with cabbage
steps:
1. Mix cabbage which has been cut up in bite size pieces , onion which has been cut up , tomatoes which have been cut up in small pieces , bacon which as been fried and cut in small pieces in a large bowl , pour bacon grease on top of all & mix and put back in the fry pan
2. Add some celery salt and pepper preference to your taste
3. Fry on medium heat until it's wilted to your taste
4. Enjoy !

title: old italian smokey spaghetti sauce
steps:
1. Heat olive oil over low heat in a pot large enough to hold all ingredients
2. Add butter and simmer until melted
3. Add onions and saut until lightly browned
4. Add ground beef and bacon
5. Saut until browned
6. Drain fat from bacon and beef
7. Add garlic , parsley , bay leaf , salt , black pepper , and red pepper
8. Cook over low heat for 10 minutes
9. Add wine
10. Cover and cook for 5 minutes over low heat
11. Add tomatoes or tomato sauce , paste , and 1 / 2 water
12. Bring mixture to boiling point
13. Add the chopped carrot
14. Cover and cook over very low heat for about 1 hour , stirring occasionally
15. Sometimes my mother let it sit over low heat all afternoon
16. About 20 minutes before the sauce is ready , begin cooking pasta
17. Once the pasta is cooked reserve 1 / 2 cup of pasta water and drain
18. Stir in 1 / 2 cup of pasta water to the sauce and cook just a few minutes over low heat
19. Serve sauce over pasta

title: crock pot stuffed peppers
steps:
1. Cut tops from peppers and remove seeds , rinse and set aside
2. In a large fry pan or skillet cook hamburger and italian sausage until browned , drain
3. Add chopped onion and cook until translucent
4. Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients
5. Mix well
6. Stuff filling into bell peppers: place into crock pot in an upright position
7. Peppers can be overstuffed
8. And leftover filling can either be frozen and used later or placed in and around peppers in crock pot
9. Cook on low setting about 7 hours or on high setting for about 3
10. 5 hours
11. Can also be baked instead: place into a 8x12 baking dish and back covered at 350f degrees for 45 mins and uncovered for 15 mins or until browned as desired
12. Top with desired amount of shredded swiss cheese when serving
13. Substitutions: use quinoa in place of rice
14. Use 6 to 8 med plum tomatoes in place of canned dice tomatoes
15. Use 1 tblsp of fresh chopped garlic in place of garlic salt

title: crunchy shrimp wontons with green onion dipping sauce
steps:
1. In a large bowl , whisk together 1 / 2 cup soy sauce , chopped cilantro , lemon zest , 2 tablespoons ginger , and 1 tablespoons sesame oil
2. Peel shrimp , leaving tails on , and devein
3. Add to soy mixture and marinate , covered , 15 to 20 minutes at room temperature
4. Drain shrimp in a colander , spread out on paper towels , and pat dry
5. Pour oil into a deep , heavy pot to a depth of 3 inches and heat to 375f meanwhile , spread out wonton wrappers
6. Working with one wrapper at a time , put several cilantro leaves and stems along wrapper edge nearest you
7. Top them with a shrimp , arranging shrimp lengthwise so that tail extends beyond wrapper
8. Fold the wrapper edge opposite the tail over shrimp
9. Brush far edge of wrapper with water and , starting with near edge , roll wrapper loosely around shrimp , forming a package
10. Press seam firmly to seal
11. Preheat oven to 200f and put a shallow rack in a baking pan
12. When oil reaches 375f fry wontons in several batches so as not to crowd them , flipping midway through cooking , until medium golden brown , 1 1 / 2 to 2 minutes
13. If shrimp begin to brown to quickly , reduce temperature
14. Lift shrimp out with tongs , draining excess oil , and transfer to baking pan
15. Keep warm in oven
16. In a small bowl , whisk together 1 / 2 cup soy sauce , 1 tablespoon sesame oil , the orange and lemon juices , marmalade , green onion , and 2 teaspoons ginger
17. Serve wontons hot , with dipping sauce on the side

title: ham   swiss soup
steps:
1. Melt butter in a sauce pan
2. Whisk in flour until smooth
3. Gradually add broth and bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat and stir for a couple of minutes until thickened
5. Add broccoli and onion
6. Cook and stir until broccoli is tender tender-crisp
7. Add ham and cream
8. Heat through
9. Stir in cheese and cook until melted

title: spanish chicken with olives for the crock pot
steps:
1. Put the beans , rice , onion , bell pepper , tomatoes with their liquid , water , garlic powder , saffron , cayenne and 1 / 3 cup of olives in a 4 quart crock pot
2. Place chicken on top
3. Season with paprika and garlic pepper
4. Cover and cook on low for about 4 hours , until the chicken is cooked and rice is tender , but not mushy
5. Mix in the remaining olives and serve garnished with parsley

title: low fat chocolate mocha cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray a 9" tube pan with nonstick spray and dust with flour
3. In a large bowl , mix the cocoa , coffee and boiling water
4. Add the margarine and stir until melted
5. Stir in the sugar , honey , egg yolk , and vanilla until blended
6. In another bowl , combine the cornstarch with 1 / 4 cup yogurt , then stir in the rest of the yogurt
7. Add to chocolate-honey mixture
8. Sift together flour , baking soda and baking powder and add to the wet mixture
9. Stir well
10. With an electric mixer , beat the egg whites until frothy
11. Add the cream of tartar and continue to beat until stiff
12. Fold the egg whites gently into the batter
13. Pour the batter into the pan
14. Bake for 45-55 minutes or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean
15. Cool for 30 minutes on a rack
16. Unmold and cool to room temperature
17. Combine all the glaze ingredients in a bowl
18. Mix thoroughly and let stand 5 minutes
19. Spread the glaze over the top of th cake

title: tamarind   date chutney
steps:
1. Place the sugar , dates and water in a saucepan over medium heat
2. Bring to a boil and simmer for about 7-8 minutes , until the dates are very soft
3. Stir in the tamarind
4. Very carefully , pour the ingredients into a blender , clamp the lid down tight and blend until smooth
5. Return the mixture to the pot and boil until thick enough to thinly coat the back of a spoon
6. Stir in the spices and salt
7. Taste for seasoning: the chutney should be equal parts sweet , salty and sour
8. Add more tamarind , sugar or salt if any of these needs a boost
9. Store in a covered container in the refrigerator

title: molasses five spice roast chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Remove gilbets and neck from chicken
3. Rinse chicken with cold water and drain well
4. Pat dry with paper towels
5. Sprinkle 1 / 2 teaspoon of five-spice powder inside cavity
6. With chicken breast side up , tuck wing
7. With string , tie legs together
8. Line medium roasting pan with foil
9. Place chicken , breast side up , on a small rack in center of foil lined pan
10. Wash and dry potatoes and pierce with fork , cut into quarters small enough to cook not so small they turn to mush
11. Place potatoes around chicken in pan
12. You can also peel potatoes and cut them up instead of leaving them whole to bake if you prefer
13. In cup combine molasses , ketchup , honey , soy sauce , salt and remaining five spice powder
14. Brush half of molasses glaze all over chicken
15. Cover pan with loose tent of foil
16. Roast chicken for 30 minutes
17. Remove foil and brush remaining glaze over chicken
18. Roast another 30 minutes longer or until temperature on meat themometer reaches 175 to 180 and juices run clear when thickest part of thigh is pierced with knife transfer potatoes to cutting board
19. Keep warm
20. With tongs , tilt chicken to allow juices from cavity to run into roasting pan
21. Place chicken on platter
22. Let chicken stand 10 minutes before carving
23. Slice potatoes into 3 / 4 slices
24. Arrange on platter with chicken
25. Garnish with chives
26. Skim and discard fat from drippings in pan
27. Serve pan drippings with chicken and potatoes

title: yummy dessert the kids can make themselves
steps:
1. Arrange the ingrediets in a glass in the order they appear above
2. Ie: fruit - topping - decoration

title: peanut lime vinaigrette
steps:
1. Place all ingredients but the oil and salt in a food processor
2. Pulse until everything is combined
3. Drizzle in the oil with the processor on low
4. Scrape the sides of the bowl and chill for half hour before serving
5. Goes great on noodles or a light salad

title: carrot soup with ginger
steps:
1. Combine the carrots , onion , potato , tomatoes , green onions , spices , salt and water in a large pot and bring to a boil
2. Lower heat and simmer for 30 minutes , or until the carrots are soft
3. Transfer the soup in batches to a blender or a food processor and process until smoothly pureed
4. Return soup to pot and stir in milk
5. Reheat until very hot or cover and refrigerate until thoroughly chilled , atleast 4 hours
6. To serve cold , taste and add salt if desired
7. To serve hot , reheat and add salt if desired
8. Either way , ladle the soup into bowls , garnish with toasted almonds and basil , and serve

title: health shake
steps:
1. Put everything in the blender
2. Blend until smooth
3. Enjoy !

title: picnic pasta salad
steps:
1. Toss all ingredients together
2. Chill for at least 2 hours before serving
3. Taste before serving and add more caesar dressing and parmesan to tastes

title: reuben grill
steps:
1. Toast bread and spread each with 1 teaspoon butter , then with 1 tablespoon dressing
2. Distribute corned beef evenly on bread slices
3. Place under broiler until heated through
4. Mix drained sauerkraut with sugar , caraway seeds and relish
5. Divide sauerkraut evenly onto corned beef
6. Arrange a slice of swiss cheese on top of each
7. Return to broiler and heat just until cheese melts

title: supreme oven rice
steps:
1. Prehaeat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine all ingredients in casserole dish
3. Cover and bake for 1 hour
4. Stir once after 40 minutes

title: sticky fingers chicken
steps:
1. Spoon the worcestershire sauce , orange juice , mutard and honey together in a bowl , and stir them until they are evenly mixed
2. Then brush all over chicken pieces
3. Lay the chicken on the bbq and cook for 30 minutes turning and basting occasionally with the glaze

title: ww pizza pasta
steps:
1. Cook meat in a small nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until browned , stirring to crumble
2. Drain and return meat to skillet
3. Add pizza sauce , salt , and pepper
4. Cook 2 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Add macaroni
6. Cook 2 minutes
7. Sprinkle each serving with cheese

title: cool cucumber pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook the pasta according to package directions
2. Drain and rinse in cold water
3. Place in a large bowl
4. Stir in oil , cucumbers and onion
5. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over salad and mix
6. Cover and chill 3-4 hours , stirring occasionally
7. Serve with a slotted spoon

title: healthier barbecue sauce
steps:
1. Melt butter and saute onions and green pepper in butter
2. In small bowl mix remaining ingredients
3. Add mixture to skillet and heat through , stirring occasionally
4. Pour sauce over choice of prepared meat and heat
5. Serve meat with sauce on it

title: chocolate mousse charlotte
steps:
1. Line a springform pan bottom and sides with ladyfingers
2. Follow directions on pudding mix , using 2 cups of milk
3. Add cream
4. Beat until thick with heavy peaks
5. Pour into ladyfinger-lined pan and let set
6. If you like , finish off top with additional whipped cream

title: omelets in a bag
steps:
1. Fill a pan half full with water , the size of pan will vary depending on number of omelets being made
2. Start to bring water to a boil while doing the following directions
3. Put two eggs into a quart size ziplock bag
4. Mush eggs while they are in the bag
5. Add any ingredients you desire , examples listed above
6. Press out air and seal bag
7. Place closed bag in boiling water
8. Boil for 13 minutes
9. Carefully remove bag from boiling water
10. Open bag and slide omelet onto a plate
11. Eat and enjoy

title: beef and mushroom stew
steps:
1. In a dutch oven over medium heat , melt butter and add oil
2. Add bacon pieces to fat and cook , stirring often , until bacon starts to brown
3. Add onion , garlic , carrots , celery , worcestershire , and herbs and spices
4. Cook , stirring often , until onion is softened
5. Pat beef cubes dry with a paper towel , if necessary , then dredge in flour until cubes are evenly coated
6. Increase heat under dutch oven to medium-high and cook beef , adding a few pieces at a time to pan
7. Let pieces brown before adding new ones
8. When all beef cubes have browned , add wine to pan and cook for 1 minute , stirring and scraping up any brown bits on bottom of pan
9. Add chicken stock and bring to a boil
10. Reduce heat to low , partially cover pot , and let simmer for one hour
11. Stir in pearl onions
12. If you don't want to be bothered peeling the pearl onions , substitute 1-1 / 2 cups of cubed yellow onion
13. Continue to cook on low heat , partially covered , for another hour
14. Remove pot lid and add mushrooms
15. Simmer for 30 additional minutes
16. Beef should be very tender
17. Just before serving , remove pot from heat and stir in sour cream and parsley
18. Return to heat to heat through
19. Do not allow to boil
20. Taste , add more salt and pepper if necessary , fish out bay leaf and discard , and serve
21. I serve it with rice but mashed potatoes or egg noodles also work well

title: almond roca  english toffee
steps:
1. Spread almonds evenly on a buttered 12 x 17-inch jelly roll pan
2. Mix sugar , butter and water in a large saucepan
3. Cook over high heat until tan
4. It needs to be past the point where the mixture begins to turn tan
5. It will be a foamy , thick , medium tan
6. Be sure to stir constantly with a wooden spoon
7. Pour over sliced almonds and spread as much as possible
8. Sprinkle chocolate pieces over immediately
9. Let melt a minute or two and then spread evenly with knife
10. When completely cool and chocolate is solid , break into pieces

title: belizean bread pudding
steps:
1. Break up the bread into a large bowl
2. Add the sugar , raisins , butter , cinnamon , and mix gently with a large spoon
3. In a saucepan over medium heat , mix together the evaporated milk , coconut milk , and water
4. Cook until hot
5. Add creamy mixture to the bowl with bread pieces , and set aside until bread is soggy
6. Then add the alcohol and mix well
7. Preheat oven to 375f / 190c ,
8. Grease a 9x13-inch baking pan , pour bread pudding into greased pan , and bake 90 minutes , or until the bread pudding is crunchy
9. Let cool completely
10. Turn out and place crunchy side up
11. It's delicious as is , or even better topped with ice cream , custard , or whipped cream

title: mushroom quesadillas  healthy
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Spray a large skillet with vegetable oil
3. Cook mushrooms , onion and garlic in skillet over medium heat until onion is tender , about 5 to 7 minutes
4. Stir in cilantro and remove from heat
5. Arrange one-third of the mushroom mixture on half of one tortilla
6. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of the cheese
7. Fold the other half of the tortilla over cheese
8. Place on a baking sheet
9. Repeat with remaining ingredients to make 3 quesadillas total
10. Bake quesadillas about 5 minutes , or until filling is hot and cheese melts
11. Cut each quesadilla into 4 wedges
12. Serve warm with salsa if desired
13. Microwave method:
14. Spray a microwave-safe casserole with vegetable oil
15. Add mushrooms , onion and garlic
16. Cook , uncovered , on 100% power for 5 to 7 minutes , or until onion is tender , stirring twice
17. Stir in cilantro
18. Assemble quesadillas as directed above and arrange them on a microwave-safe plate or platter
19. Cook , rotating plate once , uncovered , on 100% power for 1 to 2 minutes , or until filling is hot and cheese melts

title: red chile and pecan coleslaw
steps:
1. Preparation: stir 1 / 2 cup vegetable stock with cornstarch in a measuring cup until blended
2. Bring remaining 28 ounces stock to a boil in a medium saucepan over high heat
3. Reduce heat to a simmer and slowly whisk in stock-cornstarch mixture
4. Stir rapidly until stock is the consistency of olive oil
5. Cool to room temperature , skim off and discard any film on top
6. Place cumin seeds in a dry saut pan over medium-high heat
7. Stir until aroma of seeds is released , about 1 minute
8. Blend 1 / 4 cup stock in a blender with cumin seeds and remaining dressing ingredients until smooth
9. Heat oven to 350f combine pecans , chili powder and oil in a mixing bowl
10. Toss to coat pecans
11. Place nuts on a cookie sheet and roast until the aroma of the chili powder is released , 3 to 4 minutes
12. Combine dressing and slaw ingredients in a bowl
13. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve

title: low fat chicken green chili
steps:
1. In a large saucepan or dutch oven , heat the oil over medium high heat and saute the onions for a few minutes , until softened
2. Add the garlic and saute for another minute
3. If at any time during the saute the pan starts to dry , add a splash of chicken broth and stir
4. When the onions and garlic are soft , add the rest of the broth , salt , pepper , salsa and chicken
5. Stir to combine
6. Bring to a boil over high heat , then reduce to low and simmer , covered , for 15-20 minutes , or until the chicken is no longer pink in the center
7. Remove the chicken and set aside to cool
8. Stir in the rest of the ingredients and bring to a boil over high heat
9. Shred the chicken with two forks and add it back to the pot
10. Stir to combine
11. Reduce heat to low and simmer , covered , for 30 minutes
12. Stir occasionally to keep from sticking to the bottom of the pot
13. We like to eat this topped with a little bit of reduced fat shredded cheddar cheese and a dollop of low fat sour cream

title: pfeffrnusse cookies
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350 f
2. Lightly grease 2 large baking sheets , or line with parchment paper
3. Mix flour , baking powder , baking soda , cinnamon , ginger , pepper , cloves and salt , set aside
4. In a large bowl , beat shortening , until creamy , gradually beat in honey and continue beating until light and fluffy , about 2-3 minutes
5. Beat in egg , then lower mixer speed and gradually mix in the flour mixture , beating just until blended
6. Shape dough into a ball and wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate until firm
7. Scoop tablespoon-sized balls and roll into balls
8. Dust hands with confectioner's sugar to prevent sticking while forming cookies
9. Place balls an inch apart on prepared baking sheets and bake about 15 minutes , or until golden and slightly cracked
10. Cool slightly on baking sheets before removing to a wire rack
11. When cookies are still lightly warm , roll in confectioner's sugar to completely coat the cookies
12. Store in an airtight container

title: umami stuffing
steps:
1. If the sausage is link and not bulk , remove the casings and mince
2. In a large skillet , brown the sausage and drain away the fat
3. Return the meat to the pan , and add the butter , mushrooms , celery and onion
4. Saute for 2-3 minutes or until onion is tender
5. Stir in the spices
6. Do not drain away the butter and sweat from the vegetables
7. Put the croutons in a large bowl and fold the contents of the pan in , giving the croutons some moisture
8. Add the broth about a quarter cup at a time , otherwise the stuffing will turn to mush
9. Taste the mixture from time to time
10. If the consistency and flavor seem right to you , stop adding the broth
11. Place the mixture in a 2-quart baking dish
12. Cover with foil and bake at 350f for 30 minutes
13. Uncover and bake for 20 minutes more

title: bonelos aga ripe banana   peach donuts
steps:
1. Drain the can of peaches
2. Peel and smash the bananas add the peaches and continue to mash together
3. Sift the baking powder & flour into the mashed mix , add sugar if using
4. Stir the mix
5. Heat oil in pan or wok should be enough to allow the dough to float
6. Place tablespoon worth of mix into hot oil , the dough will begin to turn golden brown and float , turn the donut over to get same likeness of color
7. Remove and place on a plate w / paper towels

title: smart alec pork neck bones spaghetti   pressure cooker style
steps:
1. Place neck bones and water in pressure cooker and after it starts steaming , cook for 30 minutes
2. This cooking method is used to remove fat from the neck bones
3. You can also boil the neck bones in a pot for 90 minutes
4. Remove the liquid from the neck bones in the cooker
5. Replace liquid with the spaghetti sauce
6. Bring to a simmer stirring often , so the neck bones or sauce won't stick to the bottom
7. Simmer for about 15 minutes to heat up the sauce
8. Serve with cooked pasta sprinkled with cheese
9. I felt like i was in heaven while eating it
10. Lol
11. The next day , remove the solid fat from the top and use it to make soup , jambalaya , or dirty rice

title: dream whip butter frosting
steps:
1. Combine 1 / 3 cup milk , vanilla , and dream whip in large bowl
2. Add half of sugar
3. Blend well
4. Whip rapidly until thickenedabout 2 minutes
5. At medium speed alternately add remaining sugar and milk
6. Beat after each addition
7. Add butter , 1 tablespoon at a time , beating well
8. Makes 2 3 / 4 cups , enough for 8- or 9-inch layer cake or 24 cupcakes
9. Lemon or orange butter frosting
10. Prepare as above
11. Omit vanilla and substitute 2 tablespoons lemon or orange juice for the 2 tablespoons milk
12. Add 1 teaspoon grated lemon or orange rind after beating in butter

title: marinated broiled  or grilled  pork chops
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. Mix together all ingredients except pork chops
3. Pour over the pork chops , making sure they're all well coated
4. Let sit for 15 minutes or refrigerate for longer marinating
5. Broil , or grill , for at least 3 1 / 2 minutes on each side , or until cooked through
6. Serve at once

title: peach sundae crunch
steps:
