1. In a shallow baking pan , combine oats , brown sugar , butter and cinnamon
2. Spread evenly in pan
3. Bake at 350 for 10 minutes
4. Remove from oven and stir to break into small pieces as mixture cools
5. To serve , spoon peaches into dessert dishes
6. Top with a scoop of ice cream
7. Sprinkle with crumb mixture

title: ez peanut butter bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease an 8 x 8 baking pan
3. Mix oats , salt , milk and vanilla
4. Stir in peanut butter and chips
5. Press into pan
6. Bake 35 minutes
7. Remove and cool completely before cutting
8. Makes 16 bars

title: easy chocolate peanut bars
steps:
1. Beat butter and peanut butter at medium speed with an electric mixer until blended
2. Add powdered sugar and vanilla wafer crumbs
3. Beat until blended
4. Press mixture evenly into a lightly greased 13 x 9 inch baking dish lined with wax paper
5. Stir together chocolate morsels and whipping cream in a medium saucepan over low heat until melted and smooth
6. Spread evenly on top of peanut butter mixture
7. Chill one hour or until firm
8. Remove from refrigerator , and let stand at room temperature 10 minutes or until slightly softened
9. Cut into 48 bars

title: sour cream apple pie with crumb topping
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Beat together sour cream , sugar , flour , salt , vanilla and egg
3. Add apples , mixing carefully to coat well
4. Pour filling into a pie shell and bake at 400 degrees for 25 minute
5. While pie is cooking mix together all ingredients for crumb topping until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs
6. Remove pie from oven and sprinkle with crumb topping
7. Bake for an additional 20 minutes
8. Let cool for a hour before serving

title: grilled potato morel pierogie
steps:
1. In a heatproof bowl , soak the morels in the boiling water until softened , about 20 minutes
2. Rub them to loosen any grit , then lift them out and coarsely chop
3. In a large bowl , combine the flour with 1 / 2 teaspoon of salt
4. Add the eggs and stir until the dough just comes together
5. Transfer to a lightly floured work surface and knead briefly until soft and smooth
6. Wrap the dough in plastic and set aside at room temperature for 30 minutes
7. Meanwhile , cook the potatoes in a large saucepan of boiling salted water until tender , about 20 minutes
8. Drain
9. Return the potatoes to the pan and shake over high heat to dry them , about 1 minute
10. Using a potato masher , mash the potatoes
11. Mash in the milk , sour cream , parmesan and butter
12. Stir in the morels and season with salt and pepper
13. Transfer to a bowl and let cool slightly
14. Cut the dough in half and pat each piece into a disk
15. On a well-floured work surface , roll out the disks to 9-inch rounds
16. Cover with plastic wrap and let stand for 15 minutes
17. On a floured work surface , roll out 1 round at a time to a 1 / 16-inch thickness
18. Using a 4-inch biscuit cutter , stamp out 9 smaller rounds
19. Lightly moisten the edge of 1 round and dollop 1 rounded tablespoon of the potato filling on half of it
20. Pat the filling slightly
21. Fold the dough over the filling to form a half moon and press the edges to seal
22. Set aside on a floured platter
23. Repeat with the rest of the dough and filling
24. Cook half the pierogies at a time in a large pot of boiling salted water until they rise to the surface , about 1 minute
25. Using a slotted spoon , transfer them to paper towels and dry
26. In a large bowl , toss the pierogies with just enough vegetable oil to coat
27. Light a grill or heat a grill pan
28. Grill the pierogies over a hot fire , turning once , until browned , about 3 minutes per side
29. Remove from the grill
30. Add the celery leaves and grill until lightly charred , about 1 minute per side
31. Transfer the pierogies to a platter and garnish with the grilled celery leaves

title: stuffed peppers  no meat no rice
steps:
1. Drain and rinse beans
2. Place in a mixing bowl and lightly mash with a fork so they are still chunky
3. Stir in cheese , dried onions , and 2 tablespoons tomato sauce and set aside
4. In a saucepan , over medium low heat , combine remaining tomato sauce , vegetable or beef broth , worcestershire sauce , mustard , brown sugar and vinegar
5. Cover , reduce heat to low , and simmer while preparing peppers
6. Slice peppers lengthwise , leaving stems intact , but removing seeds and membranes
7. Stuff each half with bean mixture and season with salt and pepper
8. Heat a skillet with one tablespoon oil , over medium high heat , and place stuffed peppers , in batches , stuffing side down and cook 5 minutes
9. Flip peppers , and cook until peppers are browned , about 5 minutes
10. Repeat with remaining peppers adding oil as needed
11. Pour sauce over peppers to serve
12. Season with additional salt and pepper , if desired

title: cream of fresh asparagus soup
steps:
1. In a saucepan , combine the chicken broth , chopped onion , asparagus , lemon juice and ground mace
2. Bring mixture to boiling
3. Reduce heat
4. Cover and simmer for 8 minutes or until vegetable is tender
5. Place half of the vegetable mixture in a blender or food processor
6. Cover and blend 30 to 60 seconds or till smooth
7. Take care when blending hot liquids
8. Pour into bowl
9. Repeat with remaining vegetable mixture
10. Set all aside
11. In the same saucepan , melt the butter or margarine
12. Whisk in flour , salt and pepper
13. Add the milk all at once , whisking till smooth
14. Cook and stir till mixture is thickened and bubbly
15. Stir in the blended vegetable mixture
16. Cook and stir till soup is heated through
17. Season with additional salt and pepper to taste

title: ham   broccoli casserole
steps:
1. Cook broccoli until tender , drain
2. Preheat oven to 350f grease 2 qt baking dish in a medium saucepan melt butter stir in flour to make a roux
3. Whisk in milk cook and stir until mixture thickens
4. Lower heat slightly
5. Stir in cheese and sour cream , until cheese is melted
6. Mix ham and cooked vegetables together and spread into baking dish pour sauce over this combine bread crumbs and 1 tablespoon melted butter
7. Sprinkle on top of casserole
8. Bake uncovered in a 350 degree oven for 40 minutes

title: top secret recipes version of chili s queso by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Cut the velveeta into cubes
2. Combine the cheese with the remaining ingredients in medium sauce pan over medium heat
3. Stir frequently until cheese melts then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minute
4. Serve with hot tortilla chips for dipping

title: italian skillet supper
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except cheese , tomato and macaroni
2. Spoon 1 / 2 of mixture into 8" skillet
3. Cover with macaroni , 1 / 2 of cheese , tomato slices , then remaining mixture
4. Bake at 350 for 40 minutes
5. Top with rest of the cheese , and bake for 5 more minutes

title: butterscotch nut fudge
steps:
1. Line 8-inch square pan with foil , extending foil over edges of pan
2. Combine sugar , marshmallow creme , evaporated milk and butter in heavy 3-quart saucepan
3. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until mixture comes to full boil
4. Boil and stir 5 minutes
5. Remove from heat
6. Gradually add butterscotch chips , stirring until chips are melted
7. Stir in nuts and vanilla
8. Pour into prepared pan
9. Cool
10. Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours
11. Remove from pan
12. Place on cutting board
13. Peel off foil
14. Cut into squares
15. Store tightly covered in refrigerator
16. About 5 dozen pieces or about 2-1 / 4 pounds candy

title: zucchini lasagna casserole  no pasta
steps:
1. Place rice , chicken stock , butter and salt in medium saucepan , bring to boil , reduce heat , simmer tightly covered for 45 minutes , no peeking , or until rice is tender and liquid absorbed
2. Fluff with a fork and set aside to cool
3. The rice can be prepared ahead
4. Preheat oven to 400f degrees
5. Cut zucchini in half lengthwise and in half again if necessary to cover the bottom of a 9 x 13 baking dish
6. Do not peel and place the unpeeled pieces cut side up
7. Sprinkle with salt to taste
8. In a large mixing bowl , add cooked rice , ground chicken , ricotta cheese , fresh sage , stewed tomatoes , chicken stock , garlic and chipotle peppers with some of the adobo sauce , if using , mix well
9. Whisk together the buttermilk and the cornstarch until smooth , add to rice mixture and mix well
10. Spread rice mixture evenly over the zucchini
11. Combine fresh bread cubes and shredded cheese , sprinkle mixture evenly over th rice mixture
12. Place on the middle rack of the oven and bake uncovered for 60 minutes or until the middle is set
13. Remove from oven and let rest 15 minutes , cut into squares and serve hot
14. Can be made ahead and refrigerated , add 5 or 10 minutes to cook time
15. Freezes well

title: jello shot cake
steps:
1. Bake cake mix according to package directions
2. Dissolve jello in 1 cup boiling water and 1 / 2 cup liquor
3. Let cake and jello cool
4. Prick cake all over with a fork
5. Pour jello mixture over cake
6. Refrigerate 1 hour
7. Beat pudding and milk
8. Add vanilla and syrup
9. Fold in cool whip
10. Spread on cake and chill
11. Tried with orange jello , pineapple jello and lemon jello , using other extracts and flavorings and they all are wonderful
12. Also you can sub vodka , coconut rum , instead of rum

title: crock pot oatmeal with dried fruit
steps:
1. Spray slow cooker insert lightly with cooking spray
2. Measure oats , water , salt , and cinnamon into pot
3. Stir to combine
4. Stir in dried fruit
5. Cover and cook on low for 3 hours
6. Leftovers can be reheated in the microwave

title: anglesey eggs
steps:
1. Boil the leeks for 5-10 minutes , strain and combine with the mashed potato
2. Season well and beat in half the butter until the mixture is fluffy
3. Arrange on a greased ovenproof dish
4. To make the cheese sauce , melt 1 ounce of butter in a saucepan and stir in the flour
5. Cook for 2 minutes , stirring constantly
6. Remove from the heat and gradually add the hot milk , mixing vigorously
7. When smooth , return to the heat and bring to the boil , stirring all the while
8. Allow to simmer gently until thick
9. Add nutmeg , most of the grated cheese and season to taste
10. Slice the hard-boiled eggs in half , lengthwise , and arrange on the bed of leek and potatoes
11. Cover with the cheese sauce , sprinkle with the remaining grated cheese and dot with the remaining butter
12. Bake at 200c / 400f / gas mark 6 until brown

title: barefoot contessa s maple  roasted bacon
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
2. Place a baking rack on a sheet pan and arrange the bacon in 1 layer on the baking rack
3. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes , until the bacon begins to brown
4. Remove the pan carefully from the oven
5. There will be hot grease in the pan !
6. Brush the bacon slices with maple syrup and bake for another 3 to 5 minutes , until the bacon is a warm golden brown
7. Transfer the bacon to a plate lined with paper towels and serve warm

title: quick cheese muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180 degrees celcius
2. Add salt and cheese to flour
3. Add milk and mix well
4. Spray a 12-cup muffin tin with nonstick spray
5. Spoon the mixture equally amongst the 12 cups
6. Bake till browned on the top
7. Should be 10 to 15 minutes

title: walnut cream cheese finger sandwiches
steps:
1. In small mixing bowl , beat the cream cheese , walnuts , parsley , onion , green pepper , lemon juice , nutmeg , salt and pepper until blended
2. Spread about 2 t over each of 12 bread slices
3. Top with remaining bread
4. Cut each sandwich into three 1-inch-wide strips

title: nana s potato salad
steps:
1. Boil potatoes , until fork tender-- when done , break apart with fork
2. Immediately , toss with lemon juice and oil , salt and pepper
3. By doing this while they are still warm the flavorings get into the potatoes , better
4. Now , cool , & while cooling , chop the onions and celery and eggs
5. Then add to the potatoes
6. Now blend 1 cup of the mayo with the vinegar , and toss over the salad , gently folding until all coated
7. If it seems dry , add more mayo
8. Line a bowl with the lettuce leaves , and pile the salad in the center

title: glazed chicken balsamic
steps:
1. Dredge the chicken in flour seasoned with salt and pepper
2. Brown the chicken in a skillet in about 1 tablespoon of olive oil on med-hi , 2 minutes on each side
3. Add the vinegar to the skillet and bring to a boil
4. Reduce the heat and let it simmer until the vinegar is reduced by 2 / 3
5. Add the chicken broth and continue to simmer for about 10 more minutes or until the chicken is cooked through
6. Remove the chicken and keep warm
7. Add the rosemary and keep the sauce boiling until it's reduced to a nice sauce / glaze , about 10 more minutes
8. Sauce the chicken and enjoy

title: spicy pork and black bean chili
steps:
1. In a large pot , cover beans with water and bring to boil
2. Cook for 2 minutes
3. Cover and remove from heat
4. Let stand 1 hour
5. Drain liquid and cover with 8 cups of cold water
6. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and let simmer for about 1 1 / 2 hours or until beans are tender
7. Drain and reserve
8. Meanwhile , heat oil in a large saucepan on high heat and brown meat cubes on all sides
9. Remove from pan and set aside
10. Add onions and garlic to pan
11. Cook on medium heat until tender about 5 minutes
12. Add chili powder , paprika , oregano , cumin and chili pepper flakes
13. Cook , stirring for 1 minute
14. Return meat to pan along with tomatoes , including juice , stock and vinegar
15. Bring to boil , let simmer , partly covered , for 1 1 / 2 hours or until meat is tender
16. Add beans and peppers
17. Season with salt and pepper
18. Cover and cook 15 minutes more or until peppers are tender
19. Add chopped parsley or chopped coriander

title: dulce de leche bread pudding
steps:
1. Crme anglaise:
2. Set a large fine strainer over a medium bowl and set the bowl in a shallow pan of cold water
3. In a large saucepan , combine the half-and-half and vanilla bean and cook over moderately low heat just until small bubbles appear around the rim , about 5 minutes
4. In another medium bowl , whisk the sugar and egg yolks just until combined
5. Whisk in half of the hot half-and-half in a thin stream
6. Pour the mixture into the saucepan and cook over moderate heat , stirring constantly with a wooden spoon , until the sauce has thickened slightly , 4 to 5 minutes
7. Immediately strain the sauce into the bowl in the cold water bath to stop the cooking
8. Scrape the vanilla seeds into the sauce
9. Serve right away or refrigerate until chilled
10. Bread pudding:
11. Preheat the oven to 425 and butter a 2-quart shallow baking dish
12. In a large bowl , stir the crme anglaise with the 1 / 2 cup of dulce de leche and the butter
13. Whisk in the egg whites
14. Add the challah , stirring and gently mashing until the cubes are nearly soaked , 2 to 3 minutes
15. Transfer the bread mixture to the prepared baking dish and bake for about 12 minutes , until firm and bubbling around the edges
16. Heat the broiler
17. Broil the pudding for 1 to 2 minutes , shifting the dish a few times , until browned all over
18. Cut the bread pudding into squares , drizzle with dulce de leche and serve

title: balsamic steak and blue cheese salad
steps:
1. Place steak and 1 / 4 cup of the dressing in large resealable plastic bag
2. Seal bag
3. Turn bag over several times to evenly coat steak with dressing
4. Refrigerate 30 minutes to marinate
5. Preheat grill to medium heat
6. Remove steak from marinade
7. Discard bag and marinade
8. Grill steak 5 to 10 minute on each side for medium doneness
9. Meanwhile , grill peppers and asparagus alongside the steak 5 to 7 minute or until crisp-tender , turning occasionally and brushing with the olive oil
10. Remove vegetables from grill
11. Cut crosswise in half
12. Set aside
13. Remove steak from grill
14. Cut across the grain into thin slices
15. Place greens in large bowl
16. Add peppers , asparagus and remaining 1 / 4 cup dressing
17. Toss to coat
18. Place on serving platter
19. Top with the steak slices
20. Sprinkle with cheese

title: creamy chicken manicotti
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , beat cream cheese until fluffy
2. Beat in the sour cream , parsley , salt and pepper
3. Stir in chicken
4. In a small skillet , cook onion in butter until tender
5. Add to chicken mixture
6. Stuff into manicotti shells
7. In a large saucepan , melt butter
8. Stir in flour and salt until smooth
9. Gradually whisk in milk
10. Bring to a boil
11. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
12. Stir in 2-1 / 2 cups monterey jack cheese and 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese just until melted
13. Spread about 1 / 2 cup cheese sauce in each of two greased 11-in
14. X 7-in
15. X 2-in
16. Dishes
17. Top with stuffed shells and remaining sauce
18. Cover and bake at 350 for 25 minutes
19. Uncover
20. Sprinkle with remaining cheeses
21. Bake 10-15 minutes longer or until bubbly and cheese is melted
22. Yield: 7 servings

title: bread machine buckwheat bread
steps:
1. Add all ingredients in the order recommended by your bread machine manufacturer
2. Process on the bread cycle

title: chicken and egg salad with curried mayonnaise and toasted hazeln
steps:
1. Sprinkle the curry powder and cumin into a small dry skillet
2. Heat over low heat until the spices are fragrant , about 1 minute
3. Remove from heat and transfer to a small bowl , add in mayonnaise and cayenne
4. Stir until blended
5. In a big bowl , combine the chicken , egg , apple , onion , and currants
6. Gently fold in the mayonnaise mixture
7. Sprinkle the hazelnuts over the top of the salad and stir just once
8. Serve at room temperature or chilled on salad greens

title: quick mexican 3 ingredient  queso dip
steps:
1. Spread a can of chili in a 9x12 dish
2. Top with 8oz of cream cheese
3. Sprinkle with monetary jack cheese
4. Bake at 350 for 20-30 minutes- until top is bubbly
5. Enjoy !

title: vietnamese hue noodle soup   bun bo hue
steps:
1. Bring 2 1 / 2 quarts water to a boil
2. Add ham hocks and lemongrass
3. Skim constantly for 10 minutes then cover the pan , reduce heat and simmer for 1 1 / 2-2 hours
4. Strain the broth , reserving ham hocks if you desire them
5. Add nuoc mam , sugar , salt and pepper , sirloin , and pork loin to the broth and simmer for 10-15 minutes or until meat is cooked and tender
6. Remove meat
7. Thinly slice meats into small pieces
8. To serve , place a portion of noodles in serving bowl , top with some bean sprouts , pork , beef , and some ham hock , and ladle the broth over
9. Add herbs , chili sauce , chilies , and lime juice to taste

title: minted radish tea sandwiches
steps:
1. Blend mayonnaise / miracle whip , sour cream , zest , mustard , lemon juice and salt and pepper to taste in a small bowl
2. Spread bread slices generously with the mayonnaise mixture
3. Top half of the slices with a layer of mint leaves
4. Top the mint leaves with overlapping rows of radish slices
5. Top radishes with remaining bread slices nad press together gently
6. Trim the crusts and cut sandwiches in half diagonally
7. Sandwiches may be made 2 hours ahead and chilled , wrapped in plastic wrap

title: wild about creamy wild mushroom soup
steps:
1. Soak dried mushrooms in 1 cup hot water till softened
2. Remove mushrooms and drain liquid through cheesecloth and saving liquid and discarding sandy bits
3. Chop mushrooms set aside
4. In the drained hot liquid and crushed pinch of saffron
5. Set aside
6. In a large pot over medium heat melt 2 tablespoons oil and 2 tablespoons butter
7. Saute onions , garlic and all the mushrooms season with thyme , salt and pepper about 5 minutes
8. Optional carrot and celery may be added along with onions
9. Add sherry reduce to half
10. Add chicken stock and liquid reserved from mushrooms simmer 20 minutes
11. In a separate pot melt 4 tablespoons butter then add flour to make a thick paste whisk in 1 pint of cream
12. Then whisk into soup
13. Using a hand blender puree the soup to a nice consistency
14. Let simmer 5 more minutes stirring so not to burn
15. Serve with soup topped with a little extra sherry

title: white chocolate raspberry ripple ice cream
steps:
1. To prepare the sauce: press the raspberries and their syrup through a sieve into a saucepan
2. Add the corn syrup , lemon juice , and cornstarch mixture
3. Bring to a boil , stirring often , then simmer for 1-2 minutes
4. Pour into a bowl and cool , then chill for the ice cream: in a saucepan , combine the milk and 1 cup of the cream and bring to a boil
5. Beat the yolks and the sugar in a bowl with a hand-held electric mixture for 2-3 minutes , until thick and creamy
6. Gradually pour the hot milk mixture over the yolks and return to the pan
7. Cook over medium heat until the custard coats the back of a wooden spoon , stirring constantly remove the pan from the heat and stir in the white chocolate until melted and smooth
8. Pour the remaining cream into a large bowl
9. Strain in the hot custard , mix well , then stir in the vanilla
10. Cool , then transfer the custard to an ice-cream maker and freeze it according to the manufactor's instructions when the mixture is frozen , but still soft , transfer 1 / 3 of the ice cream into a freezerproof bowl
11. Set half the raspberry sauce aside
12. Spoon a third of the remaining sauce over the ice cream
13. Cover with another 1 / 3 over the ice cream and then more sauce
14. Repeat
15. With a knife or spoon , lightly marble the mixture
16. Cover and freeze
17. Let the ice cream soften for 15 minutes before serving with the remaining sauce

title: easy paprika chicken
steps:
1. Melt butter in large skillet or dutch oven over medium-high heat
2. Season chicken with salt and pepper
3. Add to skillet with onions and garlic and saute until chicken is browned and onions are soft , turning chicken once , about 15 minutes
4. Sprinkle with paprika and ground red pepper
5. Combine tomato paste and water and slowly stir into skillet
6. Add bell peppers
7. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes
8. Cover and cook 5 more minutes
9. Serve with rice or noodles

title: cherokee casserole
steps:
1. Cook rice per normal cooking instructions
2. While rice cooks , brown meat and cook onions until tender
3. Drain excess fat from meat
4. Combine meat and onions in skillet , and add crushed tomatoes , mushroom soup , bay leaf , oregano , garlic powder , cumin , salt , pepper , olives
5. Simmer together in skillet until rice is finished cooking
6. Add rice , and mix all ingredients well
7. Top casserole with cheese until melted

title: salmon wraps
steps:
1. In a bowl , stir together mint , mayonnaise , lime or lemon juice , ginger , green onion , salt and pepper
2. Add salmon
3. Mash to combine
4. Place tortillas on work surface
5. Top with lettuce
6. Spoon one -quarter of the salmon mixture onto centre of each tortilla
7. Fold in sides and roll up from bottom
8. Cut in half , if desired

title: l entrecote  steak with mustard sauce
steps:
1. Bring water , lemon juice , mustard and tarragon to boil in a saucepan
2. Simmer approx 10 minutes
3. Grill or barbeque steak to your liking
4. Cut steak very thinly and arrange on a serving plate
5. Pour sauce over and grind pepper on to taste
6. Seve with a mountain of potato chips or french fries

title: vermont whole wheat oatmeal honey bread
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , combine the water , oats , maple or brown sugar , honey , butter , salt , and cinnamon
2. Let cool to lukewarm , about 10 to 15 minutes
3. Add the yeast and flours , stirring to form a rough dough
4. Knead until the dough is smooth and satiny
5. Transfer the dough to a lightly greased bowl , cover the bowl with lightly greased plastic wrap , and allow the dough to rise for 1 hour
6. Since the dough is warm to begin with , it should become quite puffy
7. Divide the dough in half , and shape each half into a loaf
8. Place the loaves in two greased 8 1 / 2" x 4 1 / 2" bread pans
9. Cover the pans with lightly greased plastic wrap and allow the loaves to rise until they've crowned about 1" over the rim of the pan , about 60 to 90 minutes
10. Bake the loaves in a preheated 350f oven for 35 to 40 minutes , tenting them lightly with aluminum foil after 25 minutes , to prevent over-browning
11. Remove them from the oven when they're golden brown , and the interior registers 190f on a digital thermometer
12. Turn the loaves out onto a rack to cool
13. Store at room temperature , well-wrapped , for several days
14. Freeze for longer storage

title: 4 points   diet soda cake
steps:
1. Mix the dry cake mix , the diet soda , and the egg white until well blended
2. Pour into a 9 x 13 sprayed pan or prepared cupcake tins
3. Cook according to the directions on cake mix box
4. Slice into 12 pieces - 4 points per slice
5. Suggested combinations: yellow cake mix / diet lemon-lime soda orange cake / diet mountain dew cherry chip cake / diet cream soda diet lemon-lime soda / lemon cake angel or yellow cake / diet orange white cake / diet peach soda spice cake / diet lemon-lime diet ginger ale / white cake diet cherry soda / chocolate cake diet cola / devils food or chocolate mix diet vanilla coke / chocolate cake devils food cake / diet vanilla coke diet root beer / chocolate cake diet cherry coke / chocolate cake marble cake / diet cream soda lemon cake / tangerine diet rite

title: balsamic steak and romano salad
steps:
1. Preheat grill to medium heat
2. Grill steak 7 to 8 minute on each side or until medium doneness
3. Cut steak across the grain into thin slices
4. Toss greens with the tomatoes , corn and dressing in large bowl
5. Place on serving platter
6. Arrange steak strips over greens mixture
7. Sprinkle with the cheese

title: mojito de mentha
steps:
1. Tear mint leaves in half and put in cocktail shaker
2. Using a pestle or the end of a wooden spoon , mash the leaves until bruised and crushed
3. Add all the remaining ingredients except soda
4. Cover the shaker and shake briskly
5. Pour into a tall glass and top off with sprite or 7-up
6. Stir once , garnish with a mint sprig and serve

title: baby brie topped potato slices
steps:
1. Heat oven to broil
2. Cut small slice off ends of each potato
3. Cut each potato into 6 slices , about inch thick
4. Place on broiler pan
5. Brush with olive oil
6. Broil 4 inches from heat 6 to 7 minutes or until well browned
7. Turn
8. Brush with olive oil and sprinkle with parmesan cheese
9. Broil 3 to 4 minutes or until browned and tender
10. Remove from oven and turn oven off
11. Top each slice with a wedge of alouette baby brie and 1 or 2 strips of sundried tomato
12. Put back into warm oven for another 5 minutes allowing cheese to soften
13. Remove from oven , sprinkle with rosemary and serve

title: french breakfast muffins lowest calories of all these listed
steps:
1. Combine first five ingredients
2. Add milk , egg , and 1 / 3 cup melted butter
3. Mix well
4. Grease and flour small muffin tins
5. Fill 1 / 2 full
6. Bake at 400 for 20 minutes or until lightly browned
7. Remove from pan immediately
8. Dip in remaining 1 / 3 cup melted butter and in the mixture of the sugar , cinnamon , and vanilla
9. Serve warm

title: orange  banana and oat bran breakfast muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c brush 12 medium non-stick muffin pans with the melted butter to lightly grease
2. Sift the flours and allspice into a medium bowl
3. Return the husks to the bowl
4. Add the oatbran and sugar , and mix well
5. Whisk the orange rind , orange juice , oil and eggs together in a large jug until well combined
6. Add to the flour mixture with the banana and use a wooden spoon to mix until just combined
7. Spoon mixture evenly into muffin pans
8. Bake in preheated oven for 24 minutes or until a skewer inserted into centre of muffins comes out clean
9. Set aside for 5 minutes before turning onto a wire rack to cool slightly
10. Serve warm or at room temperature , dusted lightly with icing sugar and accompanied by ricotta

title: whole wheat cherry dark chocolate almond cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. In a large bowl combine sugar , brown sugar , and butter
3. Mix well to cream together
4. Add in egg and vanilla extract , mix well
5. Add cinnamon , baking soda , salt , and flour , mix well
6. Fold in oatmeal , dried cherries , almonds , and dark chocolate - making sure that all ingredients are uniformly distributed
7. Roll or smoosh into ball like shapes and place on a greased cookie sheet , bake for 9-11 minutes , until edges are golden / brown
8. Remove from oven and let cool on sheet 2-3 minutes , transfer to cooling rack

title: 4 minute spicy garlic shrimp
steps:
1. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat
2. Add olive oil , garlic , red pepper flakes , and shrimp
3. Season with grill seasoning or salt & pepper
4. Cook shrimp 3 minutes or until just pink
5. Toss with lemon zest , juice , & chopped parsley
6. Remove shrimp to a serving platter , leaving the garlic cloves in the pan

title: pumpkin dreams
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Cream butter and sugars
3. Add egg and pumpkin
4. Combine dry ingredients , fold into wet ingredients
5. Add chips and pecans
6. Drop onto rounded teaspoonfuls onto a greased or parchment lined cookie sheet
7. Bake for 12-14 minutes
8. Let sit on the cookie sheet for 2-3 minutes , then remove to cooling rack
9. For the icing , boil the brown sugar and butter for 2 minutes , remove from heat and stir in milk and dash of salt
10. Using an electric mixer , gradually beat in the powdered sugar until you achieve the desired consistency
11. Spread on cooled cookies
12. Share and enjoy !

title: italian carrots  1940
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a skillet or large saucepan and cover tightly
2. Cook for about 20 minutes , or until almost tender
3. Remove cover and continue cooking until water evaporates , watching carefully to prevent burning

title: iowa brownies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cream together the butter and sugar'til fluffy
3. Beat in chocolate syrup , then eggs 1 at a time
4. Beat in flour gradually
5. Fold in nuts
6. Pour onto a grased 10x15" baking pan
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes
8. Cool completely- frost with chocolate chip frosting
9. In a saucepan , combine butter , sugar , and evap
10. Milk
11. Bring to a boil and let boil for 2 minutes
12. Stir in choc
13. Chips and take off stove
14. Let sit for 2 minutes to melt chips- don't stir during this time or frosting will be grainy
15. After 2 minutes , stir well
16. Frost brownies while icing is warm
17. Cool completely and cut into squares

title: egg rolls  cheap   easy
steps:
1. Use deep frying pan , add oil , coleslaw mix and onion , meat optional , cook until small and translucent , place 2 heaping t
2. In middle of eggroll fold according to directions
3. Beat egg add to final flap to seal well
4. Drop in deep fryer or large frying pan with cooking oil at 375 for 2-3 mins until golden brown
5. If you dont want to fry all of them you can make them and freeze them , cooking time will change due to being frozen usually 6-8 minutes

title: beef tenderloin steak with mushrooms and madeira
steps:
1. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a large heavy skillet over medium heat
2. Add in the mushrooms
3. Saute until tender
4. Add in shallots with half the minced garlic
5. Saute for about 3 minutes
6. Add in thyme and season with salt and pepper
7. Transfer the mushrooms to a bowl
8. Melt remaining 2 tablespoons butter with 2 tablespoons oil in the same skillet over medium-high heat
9. Season steaks with salt and pepper , and add to skillet
10. Cook the steaks to desired doneness
11. Transfer the steaks to a plate
12. Add in remaining 1 / 4 cup shallots and garlic to the same skillet
13. Sate for about 2 minutes
14. Add in madeira and boil until reduced by half
15. Add in broth and boil until the mixture is reduced to about 2 / 3 cup
16. Add in cream and boil for about 2 minutes
17. This is optional , do this only for a thicker sauce: in a small cup using a small whisk , mix together melted butter with 1 tablespoon flour
18. Add to the simmering cream sauce
19. Stir until thickened
20. Stir in the mushroom mixture , and then season the sauce with salt and pepper
21. Return the steaks to skillet and cook until heated through
22. Transfer to plates and spoon the sauce over

title: perky tomato sauce and tuna
steps:
1. Saute the mushrooms in the olive oil until soft and slightly crispy
2. Add the rest of the ingredients and heat
3. Be served over cooked pasta

title: my favorite pad thai
steps:
1. Set out condiments: chile-vinegar sauce recipe#425009 , 1 / 2 cucumber - sliced , lettuce leaves , 1 lime cut into wedges , salted radish , a small bowl of sugar , and a small bowl of cayenne pepper
2. Place the pork in a bowl and add the sugar
3. In a small bowl , mix the tamarind , soy sauce , and fish sauce
4. In another bowl , lightly beat the eggs
5. Place all the bowls within reach
6. Place a large wok over high heat
7. Add about 1 1 / 2 t of the oil
8. Once hot , add the garlic and fry until the color changes
9. Toss in the pork and fry until it has all changed color
10. About 1 minute if it is cut thin
11. Add the tofu and press it against the hot sides of the wok to scorch it a little
12. 10-20 seconds
13. Pour in the egg mixture and let it cook until it starts to set
14. Break up the egg with your spatula and set it all onto a plate and set it aside
15. Add the other 1 1 / 2 t oil to the wok and toss in the drained noodles and stir fry , pressing them against the side of the wok to slightly sear them
16. After about a minute they soften quite a bit
17. Move the noodles to the side of the wok and toss in most of the bean sprouts and scallions
18. Stir fry until heated but not wilted
19. Add the dried shrimp and salted radish
20. Add the soy sauce mixture
21. Stir for about another half minute and then add the meat-egg mixture back inches once it is gently mixed , turn it onto a platter or individual plates
22. Sprinkle some of the chopped peanuts onto the noodles and leave teh rest as a condiment
23. Add the coriander leaves
24. Everyone makes little portions with the various condiments
25. You can wrap bits in the lettuce leaves or just eat it from your plate
26. It's fun to play with the condiments as they change the flavor so much
27. I enjoy this with a side of cucumbers , quick pickled in mint and lime and rice vinegar

title: quick   dirty chicken mushroom pasta
steps:
1. Boil pasta according to package directions
2. Melt better over medium heat
3. Add mushrooms and garlic
4. Add black pepper to taste
5. Add a little more than you think or it gets lost in the broth and pasta
6. Cook until mushrooms are browned a bit
7. Don't worry about them getting too dark
8. The chicken broth will rehydrate them and lighten them up
9. Add chicken strips and broth
10. Stir occasionally
11. Cook until chicken is heated and broth is close to a boil
12. Pour over pasta and serve immediately

title: best darn meat brick   meatloaf in texas
steps:
1. I never make a 2 pound meat-brick
2. I am giving the majority of these directions as if i was though
3. You will have to adjust some of them to the amount you are making
4. In the coffee mug of sugar , pour in enough bbq sauce to make a glaze
5. You can mix it together in a separate bowl
6. This will be used at the end of the cooking
7. In a very large bowl , combine everything but the bbq sauce , eggs , and sugar
8. Next measure in the 1 / 4 cup of sugar , 1 eggs per pound of ground beef , and 1 / 4 cup of bbq sauce per 2 pounds of beef
9. Mix
10. To know when you have this at the right consistancy , shape the mixture into a ball in the bowl
11. If you can
12. Pick it up , but it oozes over your hands , it is right
13. If it stays in a ball and seems "stiff" , you need to add another egg first and then more bbq sauce
14. You want to add the egg first as it will help the brick to hold together
15. You may also add more spices as needed here
16. When the meat-brick is to your consistancy put it in a baking dish large enough to streach it out
17. If you are making a very large one , you may need to use 2 pans
18. Place the "blob" in the pan
19. Streach it out like a "loaf"
20. Be careful not to make it too narrow , or too wide
21. If it is too narrow , it will dry out , if it is too wide , it be medium-rare in the middle
22. I don't mind it medium-rare , but my family won't eat it that way
23. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour
24. Check on it once in a while , and make sure that it isn't drying out
25. When the hour is up , take your glaze , and pour it over the meat-brick
26. Cook an additional 5 minutes , or until the glaze is bubbly
27. I normally serve this with mashed potatoes and green beans
28. If you hate meatloaf , i can almost bet you will love this !

title: mom s sour cream and chicken enchiladas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Heat oil in large saute pan on medium
3. Cube chicken and cook in saute pan
4. Remove seeds from peppers , and dice
5. Press or mince garlic
6. Add peppers and garlic , along with seasonings to chicken
7. When chicken is cooked through , add 1 / 3 cup of sour cream to mixture
8. Drain
9. Coat 9x13 inch casserole dish with thin layer of sour cream
10. Fill tortillas with about 1 / 3 cup of chicken mixture , and place in dish
11. Spoon the rest of the sour cream over the enchilladas
12. Sprinkle cheese over enchilladas
13. Bake for 20-30 minutes , until cheese is melted and slightly bubbly

title: bpc spicy lemonade juice knockoff
steps:
1. Juice
2. Pour in a sealed jar
3. Enjoy !

title: pork chops aloha
steps:
1. Sprinkle chops with salt
2. Brown chops in heavy skillet in the cooking oil
3. Mix all other ingredients in a bowl
4. Pour over the browned chops
5. Cover with a lid
6. Cook over low heat until chops are tender , about 45 minutes

title: wayne s wow them everytime smoked beef brisket
steps:
1. Liberally sprinkle the meat tenderizer , oregano , rosemary , and worcestershire sauce on the brisket
2. Lay onion and jalepenos on top
3. Wrap the brisket with foil , but leave the top open for the first hour of cooking
4. Have smoker ready , and cooking at about 250 degrees
5. Put brisket on , and cook until tender
6. This recipe may also be done in the oven

title: black walnut cookies
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine flour , baking soda , and cream of tarter
2. Set aside
3. In a large bowl , cream butter , sugar , and brown sugar
4. Add beaten eggs
5. Mix well
6. Add dry ingredients
7. Mix well
8. Fold in black walnuts
9. Separate dough into 4 parts
10. Roll each part and pat on ends to make flat
11. Refrigerate overnight or longer
12. Preheat oven to 375f
13. Grease a baking sheet
14. Slice off cookies from the refrigerated rolls and place on prepared cookie sheet
15. Bake for 5 minutes or until golden light
16. Cool on wire rack

title: prego meat loaf magnifico
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix thoroughly 1 / 2 cup of the prego sauce , beef , bread crumbs , onion and egg
2. In a 12 x 8 inch baking pan , firmly shape meat into an 8 x 4 inch loaf
3. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 1 / 4 hours or until done
4. In a 1 quart saucepan over medium heat , heat remaining prego sauce to boiling , stirring occasionally
5. Serve sauce with meatloaf

title: shrimp   polenta italian bowl  ragu
steps:
1. Cut bacon into inch cubes add to a deep medium non-stick pan saut on medium high heat until bacon is crispy
2. Remove bacon place on paper towel to drain excess fat
3. Discard bacon fat from pan reserving 1 tablespoon add shrimp and cilantro to bacon fat and saut on medium high until shrimp turn pink remove shrimp and set aside to the same pan add raju sauce stir to pick up the flavors of bacon fat and cilantro reduce heat to medium cover and let it warm up
4. While sauce is warming up in a medium pan over high heat , bring water and salt to a boil , and gradually stir in polenta
5. Reduce heat and simmer gently , stirring frequently to prevent sticking until mixture thicken and is creamy add butter and cheese mix until well incorporated
6. To serve add cup sauce to 5 bowls top each with equal amount of polenta , 3 shrimp each and sprinkle with equal amount of cooked bacon you may garnish with additional cilantro serve immediately

title: special k treats
steps:
1. In a stovetop pan on low heat , melt butterscotch chips
2. Once the chips begin to melt , add the peanut butter
3. Stir often
4. Once these ingredients are melted , add the cereal , mix / stir thoroughly
5. Drop by tablespoon full onto wax paper covered cookie sheets
6. Refrigerate
7. Makes 6 dozen

title: potato topped mini meatloaves
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Mix meat , stuffing mix and water
3. Press into 8 muffin cups sprayed with cooking spray
4. Bake 20-25 minutes or until done
5. Add cream cheese and garlic to potatoes , stir until cream cheese is melted
6. Stir in parsley
7. Scoop over meatloaves
8. Serve with gravy
9. Special extra: for more flavor add 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce to meat mixture before pressing into muffin cups as directed

title: frozen bellini
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients with ice
2. Garnish with a peach wedge

title: baked hominy grits with cheese
steps:
1. Combine water , milk , salt , and grits in a saucepan
2. Bring to a boil
3. Lower heat and simmer until thickened , stirring occasionally
4. Allow 5 minutes for quick-cooking grits and 30 minutes for regular grits stir a little of the grits in eggs
5. Return to saucepan and mix well with cheese
6. Pour into a buttered 1 quart casserole
7. Dot with butter
8. Bake in 350 f for 40 minutes or until lightly browned

title: spinach strawberry   almond salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine spinach , sliced strawberries and chopped almonds
2. In a jar with a tight-fitting lid , combine vinegar , honey and sugar
3. Shake well
4. Drizzle over salad and toss to coat
5. Serve immediately

title: asparagus fettuccine
steps:
1. Cook fettuccine according to package directions
2. Meanwhile , in large skillet , saute the asparagus , onion and garlic in butter until tender
3. Add the remaining ingredients
4. Cook and stir over medium heat for 5 minutes or until cheese is melted and sauce is blended
5. Drain fettuccine
6. Toss with asparagus mixture

title: broccoli with nuts and cherries
steps:
1. Place broccoli in a steamer basket , then put that into a large saucepan containing an inch of water
2. Bring to a boil , then cover & steam 3 to 4 minutes or until tender
3. Meanwhile , in a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray , saute walnuts & garlic in the oil until garlic is tender
4. Stir in the cherries , salt , pepper flakes & broccoli , tossing to coat

title: smoky creamy polenta with sun dried tomatoes
steps:
1. In a heavy bottom pot melt butter
2. Add onions season with the salt and cook for 3 minutes
3. Add pepper flakes if using , sun-dried tomatoes , garlic and cook until the aroma of the garlic is released , about 1 minute
4. Add broth bring to a boil
5. Add chipotle sauce
6. Whisk in corn meal adding in a thin stream so not to clump stirring all the while
7. When all the corn meal is added lower the flame to medium
8. Stir with a wooden spoon till it comes from the sides of the pot
9. About 30 minutes
10. Add the brie and stir till melted and blended inches or just mix so to leave some of the cheese still present !
11. Ahh , the goodness of cheese ! watch this polenta change from just polenta to yummy , creamy , comforting polenta !

title: cheesy chicken and biscuit bake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
2. Spray a 9x11 cake pan with non-stick cooking spray , lightly
3. In a small mixing bowl , combine meat , soup and vegetables
4. Spread mixture evenly in the pan
5. Top with shredded cheese
6. In another mixing bowl , combine the flour , baking powder and salt
7. Mix well or sift together
8. Add milk and oil
9. Mix well with a fork until all dry ingredients are moist
10. Drop biscuit dough by spoonfuls over the soup mixture
11. Don't worry of the dough balls don't touch - they swell when cooking
12. Bake 15-20 minutes or until tops of biscuits are starting to brown and visible soup is bubbling nicely
13. Remove from oven and let sit 10 minutes before serving

title: salted cajeta cookies
steps:
1. Sift your flour and combine it with the baking soda and cornstarch
2. In a large bowl , combine the butter and sugars , and beat them to a uniform , fluffy texture
3. Add in the egg , vinegar , vanilla , and the cajeta , and beat again to a uniform , soft texture
4. Add in your dry ingredients , and beat to a sticky , doughy consistency , adding in milk a little at a time to soften the batter
5. Spray a large baking sheet with cooking spray , and preheat your oven to 300 degrees
6. Form balls of dough , roughly the size of a globed teaspoon , and space them on the sheet approximately 1
7. 5 inches apart from each other
8. Flatten each ball slightly with your thumb
9. Take a pinch of salt , to your taste , and gingerly sprinkle it over the cookies , so that each cookie has a few visible granules on its surface
10. Bake for 16 minutes , remove , cool , munch

title: whose yo  daddy apple cake
steps:
1. Mix and pour into 9 x 13 pan , bake for 1 hour at 325 degrees
2. Mix together topping and spread on cake
3. Broil til brown

title: jim s  don t spare the spareribs  ribs
steps:
1. At least the night before you make the ribs , if not earlier , combine the bbq sauce ingredients in a saucepan
2. Simmer over medium low heat for 1 / 2 an hour
3. Chill overnight
4. The night before you make the ribs , combine the spice rub ingredients in a bowl , and mix together well
5. Pat about 1 / 3 of the total spice rub on the top and bottom of the rib slabs
6. Allow to sit , refrigerated , overnight
7. The next day , about 5 hours before dinner , take the ribs out of the fridge , sprinkle top and bottom with about half of the remaining spice rub
8. Let sit at room temperature for 45 minutes
9. Take bbq sauce out of refrigerator and allow to come to room temperature
10. Heat oven to 200- 225 degrees fahrenheit
11. After the ribs sit at room temperature , put them in the oven on a large sheet tray , or indeed several large sheet trays if needed
12. Bake 4 hours
13. If the ribs start to look dry , baste them with a little beer
14. About halfway through cooking time , sprinkle ribs with the rest of the spice rub
15. About 45 minutes before ribs are done , brush with a fairly liberal amount of the bbq sauce
16. Once ribs are done , baste them with more sauce , if you like
17. Let ribs sit 10 minutes before cutting into individual ribs , or 1 / 2 slabs , as i prefer
18. Serve with plenty of extra sauce on the side , and plenty of napkins

title: delectable apricot ribs
steps:
1. Spray large slow cooker with vegetable cooking spray and place ribs in cooker
2. In a large bowl , combine preserves , soy sauce , barbecue sauce , brown sugar , oregeno , and garlic powder and spoon over ribs
3. Cover and cook on low for 6-7 hours

title: chicken hurry
steps:
1. Arrange chicken parts in a casserole dish
2. In a small bowl combine the ketchup , water , sugar and soup mix
3. Mix together well
4. Spoon over chicken , making sure the sauce is on every piece
5. Bake covered at 350f for one hour

title: pork tenderloin with maple pecan marinade
steps:
1. Cut slits in the pork tenderloins to absorb more marinade , and place in a shallow glass pan
2. Top with onions and garlic with hands , distribute the onions and garlic over the pork
3. In a separate bowl combine olive oil , maple syrup , honey , pecans , mustard , chili powder , thyme , salt and red pepper flakes
4. Mix to combine
5. Pour over pork and refrigerate for a minimum of 8 hours or overnight
6. When ready to cook , place the pork on the grill or broil in the oven
7. If grilling , cook the tenderloins on a medium-low heat for about 10 minutes on each side , or until done
8. Let the tenderloin rest for 15 minutes before slicing

title: spanish black beans
steps:
1. Sort and wash beans
2. Place in a large dutch oven
3. Cover with water 2 inches above beans
4. Let soak overnight
5. Saute green peppers , onion and garlic in olive oil in a skillet until tender
6. Drain beans
7. Stir in vegetables and next 4 ingredients
8. Bring to a boil over medium heat
9. Reduce heat to low and cook , uncovered , 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours or until beans are tender , stirring occasionally
10. Remove ham hock and bay leaves from beans
11. Scrape meat from bone
12. Add meat and vinegar to beans
13. Stir well
14. Serve over rice , if desired

title: pizza chicken sub sandwiches
steps:
1. About 2 to 3 hours before grilling thechicken breasts , season the chicken with garlic salt , onion salt , and pepper
2. Start grilling the 3 chicken breasts
3. While grilling the chicken , chop the green pepper and onion
4. Set aside
5. Cut-up the sliced pepperoni
6. Place in a dutch oven or large saucepan
7. Add the mushrooms , and jar of pasta sauce to the pot
8. Keep warm on low heat , until chicken is done
9. When chicken is done gilling , cut into strips , and add to the pasta sauce in the pot
10. When heated through , divide equally among the 6 sub rolls
11. Top with the shredded mozzarella cheese , chopped onions , chopped green peppers , and sliced black olives
12. Serve immediately
13. Makes 6 sub sandwiches

title: portabella burgers with aioli
steps:
1. First make the aioli sauce
2. Just add all the aioli ingredients and whisk together
3. Chill for approximately 20 minutes
4. Then lightly clean the portobello mushrooms and remove the stems
5. Mix the olive oil and garlic and brush all over mushrooms
6. Broil mushrooms for 3-5 minutes with rib side down
7. Turn over and top with cheese
8. Broil an additional 3 minutes
9. Place on hamburger bun and top with aloe or anything you would prefer
10. Put on a bib as these burgers are extremely juicy
11. And enjoy

title: carrot and almond soup  vegan
steps:
1. Place the onions , garlic , carrots , and celery in a large saucepan
2. Add 1
3. 25 litres boiling water and the bouillon powder
4. Bring to a boil and add the herb stalks
5. Lower the heat and simmer for 30 minutes until vegetables are tender when pierced with a knife
6. Remover from the heat and allow to cool slightly
7. Strain , reserving the stock
8. Remove the herb stalks , then blend the vegetables in a food processor or with a hand-held blender until smooth
9. Return the mixture to the pan and add the ground almonds and enough of the reserved stock to make a soup-like consistency
10. Re-heat , then divide between warmed soup bowls and serve garnished with fresh cilantro and parsley

title: waffle berry bread pudding
steps:
1. Set oven to 200c
2. Break the waffles and white chocolate into chunks
3. Place half the waffles in a deep dish and add half of the chocolate and half of the raspberries
4. Combine sugar , flour , creme fraiche , eggs and vanilla essence - whisk and spoon half of the mixture evenly over the raspberries
5. Repeat the process - place the remainder of the waffles , white chocolate and raspberries then cover with the remainder of the mixture
6. Place in oven for 30mins

title: shells and cheese stove top casserole
steps:
1. Brown ground chuck in a large dutch oven
2. Drain any grease and add the crushed tomatoes , onion soup mix and water
3. Simmer 5 minutes
4. Add velveeta shells and cheese , mix well and serve with hot rolls

title: wicklewood s bbq onion sauce   gluten free
steps:
1. Saute the onions and garlic in the oil
2. When the onions have softened , approximately 10 mins , stir in the sugar
3. Meanwhile , prepare mustard to manufacturer's instructions and add ketchup , worcestershire sauce and bbq sauce
4. When the sugar has melted add the ketchup mix and continue to cook on a medium heat for a further 5 mins or until the sauce has reduced by half
5. Season to taste

title: vegetarian  baked  beans  crock pot
steps:
1. Soak navy beans overnight- the longer the better
2. I usually soak them for about 12 hours
3. Drain beans and rinse off
4. Put into crock pot along with the rest of the ingredients
5. Cover crock pot and cook 7-8 hours on high or 10-13 hours on low
6. These cook times are approximate
7. Cook until the beans are finished
8. Add water to crock pot if needed
9. Enjoy !

title: beef goulash  czech
steps:
1. Heat oil in a heavy skillet
2. Add onion and cook over low heat until lightly yellowed
3. Add paprika and blend well
4. Add meat , green pepper , salt , and water
5. Cover and simmer until meat is tender , about 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours
6. Add more water if desired , although mixture should not be overly soupy when finished cooking
7. Serve over hot boiled potatoes or topped with dumplings

title: tartiflette    the indulgent version
steps:
1. Saute onions and bacon in some butter
2. Grease a gratin dish with some butter , then put a layer of potatoes , salt and pepper
3. Spread the cooked onions and salt pork , then half of the cheese
4. Cover with another layer of potatoes , salt and pepper
5. Pour the cream on top and finish with the rest of the cheese
6. Bake at 350f for about 30 minutes

title: southern  road house bbq
steps:
1. Place olive oil into pan , add onions and garlic , saute until golden brown
2. Add sliced smoked brats and bbq sauce to onion mixture and heat
3. Place cabbage slaw into a bowl and add dressing
4. Blend well
5. Slice one kaiser roll in half and place about 1 / 2c of bbq mixture onto the bottom part of the roll
6. Place 3t of cole slaw mix on top of bbq
7. Place top on roll and serve

title: sweet and sour braised pork stuffed napa cabbage rolls
steps:
1. Place cabbage in salted boiling water for 8 minutes with lemon juice
2. Remove cool and separate into individual leafs
3. Make sure to slice middle ridge so the leaf is totally flat for rolling , reserve
4. Heat a large saut pan with olive oil over medium heat
5. Place onions in pan and sweat for 7 minutes
6. Add pork and saut for another 10 minutes making sure to break up pork with a spoon as you saut
7. Add garlic puree and cook till garlic is caramelized
8. Now add teriyaki sauce and reduce till mixture has reduced
9. Drain off excess liquid and cool mixture at room temperature
10. Add cooked rice along with mascarpone cheese and chopped fresh tarragon
11. Combine well
12. Take a tablespoon of mixture and place in cabbage leaf , roll tightly to form a cabbage burrito roll
13. The sauce
14. Pulse tomatoes with the liquid in a blender for 20 seconds
15. Add tomatoes to a pot along with vinegar , sugar , white wine and sweet chili sauce and reduce by 1 / 3
16. Place cabbage rolls in a baking dish and cover with liquid by two thirds
17. Cover with aluminum foil and place in a 350f degree oven for 25 minutes
18. Serve in a bowl and drizzle sauce over cabbage

title: rosemary garlic croutons from st  augustine
steps:
1. Trim the crusts from the slices of bread
2. Cut into 1 / 2 inch cubes
3. Keep aside
4. Heat oil in a skillet or frying pan on moderately low flame
5. While the oil is heating , crush the clove of garlic and rosemary , separately , using your mortar and pestle
6. You can also crumble the rosemary between the palms of your hands if you like
7. I personally like to crush it to bring out the flavour to the fullest
8. Now , add the crushed garlic to the moderately hot oil and cook for a minute , stirring continuously until it is golden
9. Remove the garlic
10. Toss in the bread cubes and crushed / crumbled rosemary
11. Cook these awesome croutons , tossing lightly , until they are lightly browned all over
12. Sprinkle with salt to taste
13. Remove from the skillet or pan and transfer onto paper towels to drain
14. Serve over soup

title: easy parmesan crusted tilapia
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425f in a shallow dish , combine cheese , paprika and parsley and season with salt and pepper
2. Drizzle fish with olive oil and dredge in the cheese mixture
3. Place on a foil-lined baking sheet and bake until the fish is opaque in the thickest part , 10 to 12 minutes

title: italian sausage pie  low fat low cholesterol
steps:
1. Brown sausage , and ground to small pieces drain& rinse with hot water
2. Set aside
3. Preheat oven to 375 mix remaining ingredients in a med size bowl setting aside 1 / 4 c of cheese
4. Pour mixture into pieshell , and bake for 35 minutes
5. Add remaining cheese , and bake for another 5 minutes

title: asparagus with butter lemon and mint drizzle
steps:
1. Simmer , steam or roast the asparagus until tender but still firm
2. Use a paper towel to remove any residual water from the asparagus
3. Place the butter in a microwave proof container along with the lemon juice and chopped mint
4. While the asparagus is cooking warm the butter to the point where it's not quite all melted
5. Remove from the microwave and stir to finish melting the butter and mix the lemon juice and mint nicely together
6. Drizzle the butter mixture over the still hot asparagus
7. Sprinkle the lemon zest over the top if using

title: seasoned barbecued spareribs
steps:
1. Place ribs in slow cooker
2. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over ribs
3. Skim fat from juices before serving

title: vegan ranch dressing
steps: 1. Whisk all ingredients together , and chill

title: bruschetta with roasted red peppers  yummy
steps:
1. Brush red pepper with olive oil
2. Roast red bell peppers over a medium indirect heat until charred on all sides
3. Place in bowl and cover with plastic wrap to steam
4. When cool enough to handle , peel and remove seeds , cut into strips and reserve
5. Mix the tomatoes , basil , parsley , balsamic vinegar , extra virgin olive oil , garlic , salt and pepper together and set aside to allow the flavors to blend
6. Brush each side of french bread with olive oil
7. Grill the bread over medium heat until golden brown on both sides
8. Cut each piece of french bread into 2 slices
9. Top with 4-5 slices of roasted pepper and spoon the tomato mixture over the top with some of the juice
10. Add parmesan cheese and enjoy

title: susan s pumpkin muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix all dry ingredients in a bowl
3. In larger bowl beat sugar , butter , and eggs until light
4. Add pumpkin , beat again
5. Swiftly add dry ingredients alternately with the milk
6. Bake for approximately 20 minutes
7. Makes 8 regular size muffins

title: celery bisque with stilton toasts
steps:
1. Melt butter in heavy large pot over medium-high heat
2. Add celery and leeks
3. Saut until celery is slightly softened , about 4 minutes
4. Add potatoes and 4 cups broth
5. Bring to boil
6. Reduce heat to medium-low
7. Simmer , uncovered , until all vegetables are tender , about 30 minutes
8. Working in batches , puree soup in blender until smooth
9. Return to same pot
10. Whisk in 1 / 3 cup crme frache and cayenne pepper
11. Season soup to taste with salt and pepper
12. Ladle soup into bowls
13. Swirl 1 to 2 teaspoons additional crme frache into each
14. Sprinkle with parsley , if desired
15. Serve with stilton toasts
16. To make toasts: using back of fork , mash cheese and crme frache in small bowl to blend
17. Preheat oven to 350f arrange baguette slices on rimmed baking sheet
18. Brush both sides with oil
19. Bake until just crisp , turning once , about 10 minutes
20. Spread cheese mixture on toasts
21. Bake until cheese mixture melts , about 3 minutes
22. Sprinkle toasts with parsley

title: cinnamon rolls bread from oamc easy mix yeast bread dough for 2
steps:
1. For the basic dough used in my other recipes:
2. In a large mixing bowl combine 1 1 / 2 cups of the flour and the yeast
3. In a medium saucepan heat and stir milk , margarine , sugar , and salt just till warm and margarine almost melts
4. Add to flour mixture
5. Add egg
6. Beat with an electric mixer on low to medium speed for 30 seconds , scraping bowl
7. Beat on high speed for 3 minutes
8. Stir in the remaining flour
9. Divide dough into halves or quarters
10. To chill , cover portions and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or up to 3 days
11. Or , to freeze , wrap the portions in plastic wrap and place in freezer bags
12. Seal , label , and freeze for up to 3 months
13. To use let dough stand at room temperature about 2 1 / 2 hours or till thawed
14. To make cinnamon rolls , use 1 / 4 of the above recipe
15. On a floured surface roll or pat dough into a 6 inch square
16. Melt margarine or butter , brush atop dough
17. In a bowl combine sugar or brown sugar and cinnamon
18. Sprinkle over dough
19. If desired , sprinkle dough with nuts or chocolate pieces
20. Roll up dough starting from any side
21. Pinch seam to seal
22. Cut roll into 6 slices
23. Place slices cut side down in a greased 8x4x2 inch loaf pan
24. Cover , let rise in a warm place till nearly double
25. Bake in a 375 oven about 20 minutes or till golden
26. Cool slightly , remove from pan
27. For icing , in a bowl combine powdered sugar and vanilla
28. Stir in milk , 1 teaspoon at a time , till icing is smooth and of drizzling consistency
29. Drizzle over rolls
30. Makes 6 rolls
31. To make bread instead of rolls ,
32. Prepare as above , except do not cut roll of dough into slices
33. Pinch ends of dough closed , tuck under
34. Place in a greased 7 1 / 2 x 3 1 / 2 x 2 -inch loaf pan
35. Let rise and bake as directed
36. Drizzle with icing
37. Makes 1 loaf

title: oriental beef and spaghetti pie  spicy
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Cook spaghetti according to directions on package
3. Grease a 9" pie pan with the vegetable oil
4. Place drained spaghetti in a bowl with the carrots and squash , and toss to mix , then place evenly in pie pan
5. Bake uncovered for 15 minutes
6. Combine all remaining ingredients , and spread the mixture evenly over the pasta
7. Bake uncovered for 20 minutes

title: polish style royal chicken
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large skillet
2. Add chicken pieces and cook on all sides until starts to become golden color
3. Add onions and mushrooms and sweat until onion is tender
4. Add water salt and pepper
5. Cover and cook over medium heat about 35-40 minutes until chicken is done
6. Blend flour paprika and sour cream
7. Stir flour mix into liquid in pan bring just to a boil then simmer 3 minutes and serve

title: grab  n  go breakfast cookies
steps:
1. Turn on the oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a cookie sheet with shortening
3. Save until step 4
4. Cut up butter with the table knife
5. Put butter in a large mixing bowl
6. Beat with electric mixer on medium speed about 30 seconds or until butter is creamy
7. Stop mixer
8. Add brown sugar
9. Beat on medium speed until combined , stopping the mixer occasionally and scraping the bowl with a rubber scraper
10. Stop mixer
11. Add eggs and vanilla
12. Beat on medium speed until combined
13. Put the whole wheat flour , baking powder , baking soda , and salt in a small bowl
14. Stir with the wooden spoon
15. Stir flour mixture into egg mixture
16. Stir in oats , mixed fruit bits , banana chips , and nuts
17. Scoop the dough with a 1 / 4-cup measuring cup
18. Drop the dough in mounds 2 inches apart onto the prepared cookie sheet
19. If necessary , use the rubber scraper to push the dough from the measuring cup
20. Use your hands to flatten dough on cookie sheet
21. Put the cookie sheet in the oven
22. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until cookie edges begin to brown
23. Use hot pads to remove cookie sheet from oven
24. Let cookies remain on cookie sheet for 1 minute
25. Use a pancake turner to move cookies to a cooling rack
26. Repeat with remaining dough , letting cookie sheet cool between batches or use a second cookie sheet
27. Turn off oven
28. Serve with your favorite fruit-flavored yogurt and orange juice

title: pomegranate  or cranberry  gelatin
steps:
1. Heat 1 cup fruit juice in small saucepan until it just simmers , do not cook for any length of time
2. Turn off heat and stir in sugar , if using
3. Place remaining 1 cup cold juice in a medium bowl and sprinkle with gelatin , stir , let sit for 2 minutes and stir again
4. Add warm juice to cold juice , stir , and pour mixture into an 8 x 8-inch pan
5. Refrigerate until firm , and cut into cubes

title: souper pork chops
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Brown pork chops and arrange in a 9x13 pan
3. In a pan over low heat mix together the soup , water and oregano
4. Remove from heat
5. Stir in 1 / 2 of the can the french fried onions and the sour cream
6. Pour over the pork chops in the pan
7. Cover with foil and bake for 1 hour or until pork chops are tender
8. Remove the foil and sprinkle the rest of the french fried onions over the chops
9. Bake 5 minutes longer

title: mini chocolate chip cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f prepare the mini muffin pans by inserting the mini baking paper cups
2. Chocolate cake batter:
3. Sift all of the dry ingredients together in a large bowl
4. Combine the wet ingredients and mix into the dry ingredients until thoroughly blended , about 2 minutes
5. The batter will be thin
6. Refrigerate until ready to use
7. Cream cheese topping:
8. Beat the cream cheese then add the sugar , salt and the egg and blend with electric mixer until smooth
9. Stir in the chocolate chips
10. Using a small cookie scoop , fill all of the prepared baking cups approximately 3 / 4 full with the chocolate cake mixture
11. Drop about a 1 / 2 teaspoon of the cream cheese filling on the centre of each cupcake
12. Bake for about 10 - 12 minutes or until they spring back
13. Make sure the cheese filling stays white--do not over bake
14. Cool the cupcakes on a rack then refrigerate
15. Yield depends on the size of the paper cups
16. Can also be baked in larger cups , simply adjust the cooking time

title: quick and easy fettuccini  alfredo  with veggies
steps:
1. Mince garlic
2. Add oil and garlic to sauce pan and cook on low heat until garlic is fairly soft
3. Add soy milk to pan and quickly mix in corn starch before soy milk heats up
4. Season to taste

7. Stir constantly until thickened to desired consistency
8. Add veggies and serve on top of cooked pasta

title: sweet  creamy coleslaw
steps:
1. Shred cabbage and carrots into a bowl
2. Mix mayonnaise , vinegar and sugar in a separate bowl
3. Blending well
4. Pour over shredded vegetables and stir to coat
5. Chill
6. Amounts of dressing ingredients can be adjusted to suit taste but always use the same amount of vinegar as sugar

title: marvelous mocha fudge
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingredients in a heavy pan
2. Bring to a full rolling boil -- over medium heat -- stirring constantly -- boil and stir for 4-5 minutes --
3. Remove from heat , mix in remaining ingredients , stir till marshmallows are melted

title: giada de laurentiis s garlic and citrus chicken
steps:
1. Position the rack in the center of the oven and preheat to 400 degrees f
2. Pat the chicken dry and sprinkle the cavity with salt and pepper
3. Stuff the cavity with the orange , lemon , and garlic halves
4. Tie the chicken legs together with kitchen string to help hold its shape
5. Sprinkle the chicken with salt and pepper
6. Place a rack in a large roasting pan
7. Place the chicken , breast side up , on the rack in the pan
8. Roast the chicken for 1 hour , basting occasionally and adding some chicken broth to the pan , if necessary , to prevent the pan drippings from burning
9. Whisk the orange juice , lemon juice , oil , oregano , and chopped garlic in a medium bowl to blend
10. Brush some of the juice mixture over the chicken , after it has baked 1 hour
11. Continue roasting the chicken until an instant-read meat thermometer inserted into the innermost part of the thigh registers 170 degrees f , basting occasionally with the juice mixture and adding broth to the pan , about 45 minutes longer
12. Transfer the chicken to a platter
13. Tent with foil while making the sauce
14. Place the same roasting pan over medium-low heat
15. Whisk in any remaining broth and simmer until the sauce is reduced to 1 cup , stirring often , about 3 minutes
16. Strain into a 2-cup glass measuring cup and discard the solids
17. Spoon the fat from the top of the sauce
18. Serve the chicken with the pan sauce

title: loaded potatoes stuffed with bacon  cream cheese  and scallions
steps:
1. Microwave potatoes till soft about 10 minutes
2. Cut lenghtwise in 1 / 2 scoup out flesh leaving some so to hold the shape
3. Mix the scouped potato with the rest of the ingredients mashing the potatoes
4. Fill back into skins and bake 20 minutes at 425 degrees

title: gipsy cake
steps:
1. Melt the chocolate in a double boiler over hot water
2. Separate the egg whites from the yolks
3. Mix sugar and butter until the sugar completely dissolves and the mixture is creamy
4. Slowly add the egg yolks
5. Mix in melted chocolate , almonds , cinnamon , cloves and lemon zest
6. Sift flour over mixture and carefully fold it inches

8. Preheat the oven on 180c
9. Beat the egg whites until very firm and fluffy
10. Fold it very carefully into the chocolate mixture and fill the model with it

12. When baked remove the cake from the model and place it on a wire rack to cool down
13. That takes for about 6 hours
14. In the meantime , place the raisins into a bowl and pour over the rum
15. Leave them soaking to achieve strong aroma for about 2 hours
16. Melt the couverture chocolate
17. Whip the cream with sugar until very firm
18. Cut the cake into two layers
19. Spread the whipped cream over the bottom layer and sprinkle it with well dried raisins
20. Place the second layer over
21. Spread the melted chocolate over cake and decorate it with whole almonds and sanding sugar to add shine

title: homemade ravioli with tomato sauce
steps:
1. Sauce-in a saucepan , or crock pot , combine all ingredients

5. Knead for 10 minutes or until dough is elastic
