9. Fill pockets with filling
10. Seal the edges with a little bit of water and pinch closed
11. Cook in boiling water for 15 minutes
12. Serve with prepared sauce
13. Especially good with garlic bread and sprinkled with parmesan cheese

title: the jillian special
steps:
1. Mix 2 ounces vodka , 1 ounce cointreau and 8 ounces of grapefruit juice
2. Serve over ice and top it off with a lime slice if you like

title: moroccan chicken southern living recipe
steps:
1. Cook chicken in hot oil in a dutch oven over medium-high heat 5 minutes or until chicken is done
2. Stir in remaining ingredients
3. Reduce heat to low , and simmer 15 minutes

title: ravioli dough
steps:
1. Place the flour on a dry , clean work surface , forming a mound about 8 to 10 inches in diameter at its base
2. Sprinkle the salt in the middle of the mound
3. Using the bottom of a measuring cup , create a well 4 to 5 inches wide , with at least 1 / 2 inch of flour on the bottom of the well
4. Slowly and carefully add the whole eggs , egg yolks and olive oil to the well , treating the flour as a bowl
5. Using a fork , gently beat the eggs without touching the flour walls or scraping through the bottom to the work surface
6. Then , still stirring , slowly begin to incorporate the flour walls into the egg mixture , gradually working your way toward the outer edges of the flour , but disturbing the base as little as possible
7. If the eggs breach the sides too soon , quickly scoop them back in and reform the wall
8. Once the dough starts to take on a thickened , paste-like quality , slowly incorporate the flour on the bottom into the mixture
9. When the slurry starts to move as a solid mass , remove as much as possible from the fork
10. Slide a pastry scraper or spatula under the mass of dough and flip it and turn it onto itself to clear any wet dough from the work surface
11. At this point , with your hands , start folding and forming the dough into a single mass
12. The goal is to incorporate all the flour into the mass , and using a spray bottle to liberally spritz the dough with water is essential
13. It is a very dry dough , and it is very important to generously and constantly spritz it with water to help glue any loose flour to the dry dough ball
14. When the dough forms a stiff , solid mass , scrape away any dried clumps of flour from the work surface , which , if incorporated in the dough , will create dry spots in the final product
15. To knead the dough , on your work surface , drive the heel of your dominant hand into the dough
16. Push down and release , and then use your other hand to pick up and rotate the dough on itself 45 degrees
17. Drive the heel of your hand back in the dough , rotate and repeat for 10 to 15 minutes
18. When the dough is ready , it will stop changing appearance and texture
19. The dough will be firm but bouncy to the touch and have a smooth , silky surface , almost like play-doh
20. Tightly wrap the dough in plastic wrap before proceeding as directed with your recipe
21. Makes about 20 oz
22. Of dough

title: streusel topped cranberry oat muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f and line 9 muffin cups with paper liners
2. Whisk together the first 8 ingredients for the muffins in a large bowl and then stir in dried cranberries
3. Whisk together the last 5 ingredients for the muffins together in a medium sized bowl
4. Stir the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients just until combined - do not over-mix or your muffins will be very dense / dry
5. Spoon batter into the muffin cups
6. Combine the streusel ingredients in a bowl and then sprinkle over the batter for each muffin
7. Bake 20-25 minutes or until pick comes out clean
8. Cool in pan on wire rack for 5 minutes before removing from pan to cool completely on rack

title: italian cheese terrine
steps:
1. For sauce: drain whole tomatoes , reserving 1 / 4 cup juice
2. Chop tomatoes and set aside
3. Cook onion and garlic in olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat , stirring constantly , until tender
4. Stir in chopped tomato , 1 / 4 cup reserved juice , bay leaves , sugar and basil
5. Bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat , and simmer , stirring often , 3-5 minutes or until thickened
7. Remove from heat
8. Remove and discard bay leaves
9. Stir in sun-dried tomatoes
10. Cover and chill at least 2 hours
11. For terrine: beat cream cheese and butter at medium speed with mixer until creamy
12. Add parmesan and pesto
13. Beat until smooth
14. Set mixture aside
15. Line a 3-cup bowl or mold with plastic wrap , allowing edges to overhang 6-7 inches
16. Diagonally cut 5 slices muenster cheese in half
17. Arrange cheese triangles in bowl , slightly overlapping to line bowl
18. Spread half of cream cheese mixture over cheese
19. Top with half of basil-tomato sauce
20. Cut 2 slices muenster cheese in half crosswise
21. Arrange cheese rectangles over tomato mixture
22. Repeat with remaining cream cheese mixture , basil-tomato sauce and 2 slices muenster cheese cut into rectangles
23. Fold plastic wrap over layers , sealing securely
24. Place a heavy object on top to compact layers
25. Chill at least 8 hours or up to 3 days
26. To serve: invert terrine onto a serving platter , peel off plastic wrap

title: hawaiian bananas canning recipe
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a sauce pan and bring to a boil
2. Peel and slice bananas in 1 inch chunks and add to boiling syrup-all at once
3. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes-stirring very gently
4. Ladle into sterilized jars
5. Process in a boiling water bath for 10 minutes at altitudes up to 1000 feet

title: tatsuta age  marinated fried chicken
steps:
1. Cut chicken into bite-size square and marinate in a mixture of soy sauce , sake , and sugar for at least 1 hour
2. Drain chicken , roll pieces in cornflour , and set aside for 10 minutes
3. Heat oil to 350 degrees f in a deep pan
4. Fry chicken in small batches for about 2-3 minutes or until golden brown and crisp
5. Drain on absorbent paper and serve hot

title: leftover mashed potato cakes
steps:
1. Beat the egg
2. Mix the beaten egg with the mashed potatoes
3. Stir in the dry ingredients
4. Add the milk and mix well
5. The batter should be very thick
6. Melt the shortening or heat the oil in a skillet
7. Spoon batter into the skillet to form 3" to 3-1 / 2" inch wide pancakes , about 1 / 2" thick
8. Brown on one side , over medium heat
9. Turn and brown on the other side
10. Serve with ketchup
11. These are great cold and served the next day

title: apple date nut bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Butter a 13 x 9 inch baking pan
3. In a saucepan , combine apples , sugar , lemon juice and water and simmer , covered , stirring occasionally , for 5-10 minutes , or until apples are tender
4. Add dates and simmer , uncovered , stirring and mashing dates , for 3-5 minutes , or until dates are soft and mixture is almost smooth and let puree cool
5. In a bowl , combine butter , brown sugar , salt , flour , walnuts and cinnamon and blend well
6. Press half of flour mixture evenly into prepared pan
7. Spread puree over , and crumble remaining flour mixture over puree , pressing lightly to form an even layer
8. Bake for 35-40 minutes , or until golden
9. Let cool completely
10. Cut into 36 bars

title: hominy  bacon and eggs scramble
steps:
1. Fry bacon in skillet
2. Set bacon aside
3. Reserve two tbs bacon drippings , turn heat down ,
4. Drain hominy , add to skillet along with the green pepper
5. Allow to cook until pepper is tender , about 5 minutes on med heat
6. Beat eggs and pour over hominy mixture in skillet
7. Stir until eggs are just set
8. Crumble bacon and add to mixture
9. Sprinkle cheese on top

title: thai green curry paste
steps:
1. Using a blender or processor , blend all the ingredients to a smooth paste
2. Transfer the paste into a bowl , cover and chill until required

title: chiles en nogada
steps:
1. For the sauce: in a blender combine first 4 ingredients until smooth
2. The sauce is to be served at room temperature , do not heat
3. For the filling: in a large saut pan cook onion and garlic in oil over medium heat until golden brown
4. Add remaining ingredients and cook until beef is done
5. Stuff chiles with meat mixture
6. For the batter: beat egg whites until stiff peaks form
7. In a separate bowl beat yolks well
8. Fold yolks into beaten whites
9. Sprinkle about 2 1 / 2 tablespoons of the flour on top and fold it into the egg mixture
10. Sprinkle a plate with a layer of flour and lay each stuffed chile in it
11. Sprinkle more flour on top of the chiles so that they are thoroughly coated
12. This helps the batter adhere
13. In a large saut pan heat about 1 / 4 inch oil over medium-high heat
14. When oil is hot , pick up each floured chile by the stem and dip it the batter
15. Then gently lay it in the oil
16. As the chiles fry , lift the pan by the handle and tilt it back and forth so that the edges of the battered chiles are cooked
17. When the first side is golden brown , turn and cook the other side
18. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on several layers of paper towels
19. Keep warm in a low oven until all are done
20. Or they may be served at room temperature
21. To serve: to serve , place a stuffed chile on each plate and cover with walnut cream sauce
22. Sprinkle with pomegranate seeds and garnish plate with cilantro

title: tomato sunrise
steps:
1. In a big pitcher , add the first 6 ingredients
2. Stir to combine
3. Taste and add salt and pepper if desired
4. Pour into tall ice-filled glasses
5. Garnish with a lime slice

title: soupy black beans
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , heat olive oil over medium heat
2. Add scallions and garlic cloves and saute until fragrant , about 1 minute
3. Add black beans and water
4. Increase heat and bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat and simmer for about 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
6. Add salsa and stir until heated through
7. Add salt and pepper to taste

title: double cheese macaroni
steps:
1. Cook macaroni according to package directions
2. Meanwhile , place cottage cheese in a food processor
3. Cover and process until smooth
4. Set aside
5. In a large saucepan , melt butter
6. Stir in the flour , salt , pepper and garlic salt until smooth
7. Gradually add cream and milk
8. Bring to a boil
9. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
10. Drain macaroni
11. Transfer to a large bowl
12. Add the cheddar cheese , cottage cheese and white sauce
13. Toss to coat
14. Transfer to a greased 13-in
15. X 9-in
16. Baking dish
17. Combine bread crumbs and butter
18. Sprinkle over the top
19. Bake , uncovered , at 400 for 20-25 minutes or until bubbly

title: english seaside tangy tartar sauce for fish and chips
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a bowl and mix well
2. Place in an airtight jar or container and store in the fridge for up to one week
3. Serve with fish and chips or all manner of seafood and fish !

title: paula deen s ultimate easy chocolate peanut fudge
steps:
1. Grease an 8" square baking dish with butter , oil or cooking spray
2. Line with waxed paper , leaving the edges of the waxed paper to hang over the edges of the dish
3. In a medium , heavy bottomed saucepan , melt the chocolate chips with the milk over medium low heat
4. Stir in the butter until completely melted
5. Stir in the peanuts , vanilla and salt
6. Using a rubber spatula spread the mixture on the bottom of the prepared pan , smoothing the top
7. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and refrigerate until firm , at least 4 hours

title: christmas snowman cupcakes
steps:
1. Melt 2 chocolate coins in the microwave or in in a bowl over a pan of simmering water , until liquified
2. Dip each cylindrical / round chocolate into the melted chocolate and 'glue' to the coins of chocolate , to look like tophats
3. Sieve icing sugar and add to soft butter and hot water
4. Mix slowly for 2 minutes , then fast , until light and creamy
5. Spread buttercream over each cupcake , leaving a little over to 'glue' the hats on later
6. Place a marshmallow in the middle of each cupcake
7. Snap each chocolate stick in half and place into the cupcake for arms
8. Pipe on a green scarf around the marshmallow
9. Pipe on black eyes and red or orange nose and buttons
10. "glue" on the tophat with remaining buttercream

title: blackstone hotel cheesecake
steps:
1. Crust: combine crushed graham crackers and 5 tablespoons of butter until mixed to a flaky consistency
2. Add powdered sugar , just to sweeten the crust slightly press into the bottom of a spring form pan
3. You may bake the crust at this point 350 deg for 5 minutes
4. I like it better if you don't bake it
5. Cake: mix cream cheese , sugar , eggs
6. Add vanilla and if desired 3-5 drops of almond extract
7. Mix again till smooth and creamy
8. Bake 20 minutes at 350 degrees
9. Topping: mix sour cream with white sugar to taste and again a few drops of almond extract to taste
10. Top the cooked and cooled cheesecake with the spread
11. Bake 350 degrees for 5 minutes
12. Should be done but not brown
13. Optional fruit topping: 1 / 2 package frozen raspberries in a saucepan and cover with water and some lemon juice
14. Bring to a boil and add sugar to sweeten and corn starch to the desired consistency and return to a boil , stiring constantly

title: the best spinach salad
steps:
1. Saute in the butter , until lite brown , the package of ramen noodles and the slivered or sliced almonds
2. These are the"crispies" and will keep in a baggie in the freezer if you have any leftover
3. Combine all the dressing ingredients in jar and shake to mix
4. This makes enough salad for 2-3 bags of baby spinach or baby romaine or spring greens , your choice
5. Toss the salad with some crispies and dressing right before serving
6. Works well to serve with tongs
7. Add optional sliced green onions if you wish

title: mustardy fried chicken breasts
steps:
1. Wipe down chicken breast with paper towel
2. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
3. In bowl , beat egg and mustard
4. In separate bowl combine cheese and bread crumbs
5. Dip each breast in egg mixture then coat with cheese mixture
6. Let set 10 minutes
7. Saute chicken in oil for 15-20 minutes or until tender

title: xiao mi zhou  millet porridge
steps:
1. Toast millet in bottom of pan or in skillet over medium-high heat for 5 8 minutes , until some aroma begins to waft
2. In the meantime , bring water to a boil
3. How much you use depends on how thick you want your porridge
4. Add millet to boiling water and boil over medium-high to low heat for 15 25 minutes , until done
5. It will not absorb all the water , but some color and starch will be released to let you know as cooking finishes
6. Eat warm , adding sugar or honey to taste

title: savory mustard rubbed pork
steps:
1. Heat oven to 450 degree fahrenheit
2. Season pork loin with salt and pepper
3. In bowl , combine remaining ingredients
4. Rub herb-mustard-mixture evenly over pork
5. Place pork in roasting pan and roast for 10 minutes
6. Reduce oven temperature to 250 degree fahrenheit
7. Roast for 1 hour more or until inserted thermometer reads 160 degrees fahrenheit
8. Transfer pork loin to platter , cover loosely with foil
9. Let sit 15 minutes before slicing

title: greek vegetables
steps:
1. Prepare beans according to package directions in salted water
2. Drain
3. Meanwhile heat oil in a large skillet and sautee onions , garlic and zucchini until lightly browned
4. Add broth and let simmer covered for about 4 minutes
5. Add beans
6. For the sauce combine yoghurt , herbs and lemon juice
7. Pour into two small serving bowls
8. When beans are heated through , sprinkle feta cheese on top of the veggies and serve with the yoghurt sauce and the bread on the side
9. Enjoy ! :)

title: tostada grande
steps:
1. In large skillet , brown ground beef
2. Drain well
3. Stir in seasoning , tomato sauce , chilies and hot pepper sauce
4. Heat until hot and bubbly
5. Simmer , uncovered , for 15 minutes or until mixture thickens
6. Lightly grease 9 or 10-inch pie plate
7. Separate rolls or biscuits
8. Arrange pan
9. Press over bottom and up sides to form curst
10. Spread beans over dough
11. Top with meat mixture
12. Bake at 375 degrees for 18 to 20 minutes or until crust is golden brown
13. Sprinkle immediately with cheese
14. Garnish with lettuce , tomato and onion

title: katherine oxtail stew
steps:
1. Trim the excess fat off the oxtail
2. In a large pot or dutch oven , fry the oxtails until browned and cooked through
3. Remove from pot
4. Place diced ginger , onion and garlic in pot with meat juices and cook until onions are brown and soft
5. Throw in dollops of tomato paste and mix well
6. Return oxtails to the pot and add 1 / 2 cup of beef stock and keep mixing over heat
7. Add all the chopped up vegetables to the meat mixture
8. Add remaining stock and cook until vegetables are cooked
9. For a more tender meat , stew for a longer period
10. You may have to add a cup or two of beef stock or water to prevent drying out

title: super easy  creamy cucumber salad
steps:
1. Peel and slice cucumbers and onions very thinly
2. Place cucumbers , onion slices and salad dressing in a container that has a tight fitting lid
3. Place the lid on and give the container a couple of shakes which will coat the cucumbers , chives and onions with the dressing and toss the salad
4. Place container in the refrigerator for 24 hours
5. Enjoy !

title: bacon wrapped coconut quiche and coconut popcorn shrimp
steps:
1. 1
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
3. Grease bottom of a muffin baking pan with 6 cups with non-stick cooking spray
4. Put flour into a shallow plate
5. Beat 1 egg into a bowl
6. Put panko and cornmeal into another shallow plate and mix to combine
7. 2
8. Pat shrimp dry with paper towels and season with salt and black pepper
9. 3
10. Make filling
11. In a blender , put coconut milk and corn
12. Puree until almost smooth
13. Transfer the mixture into another bowl
14. Add 2 eggs and parmesan cheese to the bowl and whisk to combine
15. Season with salt and black pepper
16. 4
17. Cook bacon in a non-stick skillet over medium heat until lightly browned flipping once
18. Drain on paper towels
19. 5
20. Place each bacon along sides of each muffin cup
21. Pour the filling into each cup evenly
22. Bake in the oven for 23-25 minutes or until center of the quiche is almost set
23. 6
24. In the meantime , make coconut popcorn shrimp
25. Peel , divined and remove tail from each shrimp and pat dry with paper towels
26. Dredge shrimp in flour , dip in the egg and coat with cornmeal mixture
27. In a deep skillet , heat coconut oil to medium high
28. Work in batches
29. Deep fry shrimp until cooked through and golden brown
30. Drain on paper towels lined plate
31. 7
32. When the quiche is baked , remove the pan from the oven and put popcorn shrimp on each quiche , return the pan into the oven and bake in the oven for another 2 minutes
33. Let rest on a rack for 5 minutes

37. 9
38. To serve , remove each quiche from the pan and place on each serving plate
39. Drizzle the cocktail sauce over the popcorn shrimp
40. Sprinkle with coconut flakes over the top

title: oamc chicken nuggets
steps:
1. In a gallon size zip lock bag combine buttermilk , hot sauce , and seasoning salt
2. Cut chicken breasts lengthwise into three strips
3. Cut strips into bite sized pieces for nuggets or cut strips in half for chicken fingers
4. Add the chicken to the buttermilk mixture and refrigerate for at least 4 hours
5. Overnight is best
6. In a large bowl combine flour , cornstarch , corn flour , paprika , salt , pepper , garlic powder , onion powder , and sage
7. Stir with a whisk until well combined
8. Remove chicken pieces from buttermilk and dredge in the flour mixture
9. Fry in 350-360 degree oil until light golden brown
10. Remove from oil and drain on paper towels while you fry the rest of the chicken
11. When you've fried it all put the drained pieces on a baking sheet and freeze
12. Put frozen chicken nuggets / fingers in bags and label
13. These will keep for 2 or 3 months in the freezer
14. To serve , preheat oven to 350 degrees and bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until heated through and crispy
15. I like to serve mine with buffalo ranch dipping sauce
16. Combine 1 / 4 cup ranch dressing and 2 teaspoons of hot sauce in a small bowl or ramekin

title: spaghetti alla siracusana
steps:
1. Heat 3 tablespoons of the evoo in a skillet
2. Add breadcrumbs and cook , stirring , over high heat until golden brown and crunchy
3. Transfer to a serving bowl and stir in cheese
4. Set aside
5. Add remaining tablespoon of evoo to the skillet and heat
6. Add garlic and sardines and cook and stir until sardines are broken up
7. Dissolve tomato paste in warm water
8. Add to sardine mixture together with pepper
9. Combine and remove from heat
10. Toss sauce with hot cooked pasta
11. Add 1 / 4 cup of the breadcrumbs and toss again
12. Put the rest of the breadcrumbs on the table for each person to sprinkle over individual servings

title: betty browns
steps:
1. In a large bowl , stir until smooth all ingredients except apples and walnuts
2. Mix well
3. Stir in apples and nuts
4. Turn into greased 8x8x2 inch baking dish and bake in 350 oven 35-40 minutes
5. Cool in pan on rack
6. Cut into 16 bars

title: spaghetti with prawns and rocket
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti in large pain of salted boiling water
2. Heat olive oil in a large frying pan and toss in the garlic and chilli
3. Add prawns when garlic begins to colour and saute for a minute
4. Add white wine , tomato puree , simmer for a couple of minutes
5. Toss the spaghetti with the sauce , squeeze in the lemon juice , add half the chopped rocket
6. Season , divide between 4 plates , and sprinkle with grated lemon zest and the remaining rocket leaves

title: eggnog quick bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f
2. Grease bottom of 9x5 loaf pan
3. Beat eggs in large bowl
4. Stir in sugar , butter , eggnog , rum extract , vanilla extract
5. Combine flour , baking powder , salt and nutmeg
6. Stir dry mix into egg mixture , just enough to moisten dry ingredients
7. Pour batter into pan
8. Bake for 40 to 60 minutes , or until tooth pick comes out clean when poked in the middle
9. Let cool for 10 min then turn out onto wire rack to cool completely
10. Wrap and store in refridgerator

title: peach cake ii
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Lightly grease one 8 x 8 inch pan
3. Cream together the sugar and butter
4. Add the flour , milk , salt , and baking powder
5. Mix well and pour into prepared pan
6. Spread fruit evenly over the top of the batter and pour juice from canned peaches ov er top
7. Bake in at 350 degrees f for 50 minutes or until fully browned on top
8. Makes 1 - 8x8 inch cake
9. Peach cake 3 egg , beaten 1 3 / 4 cups white sugar 1 cup vegetable oil 2 cups all-purpose flour 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1 teaspoon baking soda 2 cups sliced peaches 1 / 2 cup chopped pecans preheat oven to 375 degrees f
10. Grease and flour a 9x13 inch pan
11. In a large bowl , combine the eggs , sugar , oil , flour , salt , cinnamon , baking soda , peaches and peacans
12. Mix thoroughly by hand
13. Pour into prepared 9x13 inch pan and bake at 375 degrees f for 50 minutes or until done
14. Makes 1 - 9x13 inch pan

title: corn pudding ii
steps:
1. Mix cornstarch with 2t water to make a smooth paste
2. Add to #2 can of cream style corn
3. Beat eggs and add 3 c canned milk , 1t sugar , and salt to taste
4. Beat together and add to corn mixture
5. Pour into greased casserole or flat pan
6. Bake in slow oven until consistency of custard , 50-60 minutes , until knife comes out clean when inserted

title: country dijon poulet
steps:
1. In large skillet , brown chicken in butter
2. Sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper
3. Add garlic , bay leaf , marjoram , thyme , broth , and wine
4. Simmer , covered , stirring occasionally for 35 minutes
5. Add onions , carrots , and artichokes
6. Simmer covered 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender
7. Remove chicken and vegetables to heated serving dish
8. Add mustard to remaining liquid
9. Bring to boil
10. Thicken sauce with 1 tablespoon flour mixed in 2 tablespoons water , if desired
11. Spoon sauce over chicken and vegetables

title: garden stuffed yellow squash
steps:
1. Cover squash with water
2. Bring to a boil
3. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 8-9 minutes or until squash is tender but still firm
4. Drain
5. Cool slightly
6. Cut squash in half lengthwise
7. Remove seeds , leaving a firm shell
8. Combine onion , tomato , green pepper , basil , salt and pepper on a bowl
9. Stir in cheese
10. Place squash shells in 13x9 baking dish
11. Spoon mixture into shells
12. Dot with butter
13. Sprinkle with bacon
14. Bake , uncovered at 400 degrees for 20 minutes
15. Optional- you can sprinkle more cheese on top and bake the last several minutes till melted

title: 1 2 3 ground turkey mexican rice
steps:
1. Cook rice according to package directions
2. Brown turkey in seperate skillet until no longer pink
3. Drain and rinse black beans , and drain mexi corn
4. Mix turkey , beans and corn into rice
5. Serve with tortillas , sour cream , shredded cheese

title: garlic shrimp alfredo
steps:
1. In a pan , melt 1-2 tablespoons of butter
2. Add the shrimp and liberally sprinkle garlic powder on them
3. Stir occasionally until cooked
4. Set aside
5. In a small sauce pan , melt butter
6. Add garlic and let simmer until garlic is soft ,
7. About 2 minutes
8. Add heavy cream , and pepper , simmer for 8-10 minutes
9. Add
10. Parmesan cheese and let simmer for 5-8 minutes longer
11. When sauce is
12. Thickened add mozzarella cheese and stir until melted
13. Serve
14. Yield: 2 1 / 2 cups sauce

title: pork in lettuce leaf cups
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large pan and cook the shallots and garlic for 2 minutes
2. Add the chilie , pork and five spice and cook for a further 5 minutes
3. Stir in the water chestnuts , fish sauce , soy sauce and honey and warm through gently , stirring until the pork is cooked through
4. Allow to cool then chill for at least 20 minutes
5. Separate the lettuce leaves and place 12 on a large serving platter
6. Stir the bean sprouts into the minced pork then spoon into the lettuce leaves
7. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve

title: down on the farm chicken casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Hashbrown layer-
3. Mix hashbrowns , cream of celery soup , 1 cup sour cream , onion , pimento , and cheese
4. Layer this mixture in a 15 x 11 inch casserole dish
5. Chicken layer-
6. Mix chicken , cream of chicken soup , cream of mushroom soup , 1 cup sour cream
7. Spread this over the hash brown layer
8. Crumb layer-
9. Mix crushed crackers , poppy seeds , and melted butter
10. Spread this on top of the chicken layer
11. Bake for 30-45 minutes until the cumb layer is brown and the center is bubbly

title: cheesy spinach squares
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Butter a 13 x 9-inch baking pan
3. Place the butter in the prepared baking dish , and melt in the oven
4. Remove pan and set aside
5. In a large bowl beat the eggs thoroughly
6. Blend in flour , half and half , cayenne , garlic powder and parmesan cheese seasoning salt , black pepper and baking powder
7. Add in 2-1 / 2 cups grated cheddar or mozzarella cheese , green onion and spinach
8. Mix well
9. Spoon the mixture into baking dish on top of the melted butter , and level off
10. Drizzle the top with 2 tablespoons melted butter
11. Sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese
12. Bake for about 30 minutes or until golden brown and set
13. Remove from oven , and cool for 40-45 minutes
14. If desired you may sprinkle about 1 cup shredded cheddar or mozzarella cheese immediately after baking
15. Cut into squares

title: lime grilled chicken breast
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except chicken in plastic bag
2. Add chicken , marinate in refrigerator 4-8 hours
3. Grill or broil approximately 6 minutes per side , turning and basting with marinade least twice
4. Slice and serve over rice or salad
5. Optional: reserve approximately 1 / 4c of marinade before adding chicken , and use as salad dressing
6. Side

title: puff pasty surprise
steps:
1. Mix the cheese and herbs together and set aside
2. On a lightly floured sheet , lay the pasty with the short side closest to you
3. Cut in half crosswise and arrange the long sides closest to you
4. Spread the pepper jelly evenly over both sheets of puff pastry
5. Don't go all the way to the edges , leave an 1 inch border
6. Arrange the pepperoni , mushrooms and onion in a single layer over the puff pastry
7. Now top with the cheese and herb mixture
8. Brush the farthest edge of each half of pastry with the egg
9. Roll the pastry tightly from the closest edge working towards the egged edge ,
10. Lay the puff pastry logs seam side down on sheet and place in the fridge and chill for 1 hour
11. Preheat oven to 400
12. Remove the logs from the fridge and cut into 1 / 4 " thick slices and place cut side down , 1" apart on parchment papered sheets
13. Bake in 400 oven for 15 minutes or until golden brown
14. Watch to make sure they don't burn
15. Best when served warm

title: the best carrot cake you ll ever have
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine grated carrots and brown sugar
2. Set aside for 60 minutes , then stir in raisins
3. Preheat oven to 350 f
4. Grease and flour two 10 inch cake pans
5. In a bowl , combine the flour , baking soda , salt and cinnamon
6. In a large bowl , beat eggs until light
7. Gradually beat in the white sugar , oil and vanilla
8. Stir in the pineapple
9. Stir the flour combination above into the wet mixture only until absorbed
10. Finally stir in the carrot mixture and the walnuts
11. Pour evenly into the prepared pans
12. Bake 45 to 50 minutes in the preheated oven , until cake tests done with a toothpick
13. Cool for 10 minutes before removing from pan
14. When completely cooled , frost with cream cheese frosting
15. Cream cheese frosting:
16. In a medium bowl , cream together the cream cheese and butter until creamy
17. Mix in the vanilla , then gradually stir in the confectioner's sugar
18. Store in the refrigerator after use

title: super duper apple muffins
steps:
1. Mix all together and spoon into 12 paper lined or sprayed muffin cups
2. Bake at 425 degrees for 20 minutes and enjoy !
3. Each muffin is only 1pt and they are large and super yummy ! this is one of those recipes that you will be licking the bowl afterwards ! let me know what you guys think !

title: buttermilk cheddar biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f
2. Place 2 cups of flour , the baking powder , and salt in the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the paddle attachment
3. With the mixer on low , add the butter and mix until the butter is the size of peas
4. Combine the buttermilk and egg in a small measuring cup and beat lightly with a fork
5. With the mixer still on low , quickly add the buttermilk mixture to the flour mixture and mix only until moistened
6. In a small bowl , mix the cheddar with small handful of flour and , with the mixer still on low , add the cheese to the dough
7. Mix only until roughly combined
8. Dump out onto a well-floured board and knead lightly about 6 times
9. Roll the dough out to a rectangle 10 by 5 inches
10. With a sharp , floured knife , cut the dough lengthwise in half and then across in quarters , making 8 rough rectangles
11. Transfer to a sheet pan lined with parchment paper
12. Brush the tops with the egg wash , sprinkle with salt , if using , and bake for 20 to 25 minutes , until the tops are browned and the biscuits are cooked through
13. Serve hot or warm

title: portsmouth old city jail hot dogs
steps:
1. Boil the hot dogs in 2 quarts of water for 15 minutes
2. Allow them to drain and lay a hot dog on a piece of bread
3. No condiments are necessary
4. Enjoy !

title: bisquick biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. Stir ingredients until soft dough forms
3. Place on greased surface dusted with baking mix
4. Knead 10 times
5. Roll dough 1 / 2 inch thick
6. Cut with 2 2 / 12 inch cookie cutter dipped in baking mix
7. Place on ungreased cookie sheet
8. Bake 7-9 minutes or until golden brown

title: chili brown rice with chicken  black beans and olives
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a dutch oven over medium heat
2. Add the rice
3. Toast , stirring occasionally , until aromatic , 2-3 minutes
4. Turn heat to low
5. Push rice aside
6. Stir in chili powder to taste , cumin and oregano
7. Toast 15 seconds
8. Gradually stir in water
9. Stir in 2 cups of the salsa and the salt
10. Taste
11. Stir in more chili powder if you like
12. Heat to a boil over high heat
13. Cover
14. Reduce heat to low
15. Simmer until rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed , about 1 hour
16. Stir in beans , chicken , corn and olives
17. If mixture seems dry , stir in more salsa
18. Cover
19. Continue cooking 1 minute
20. Turn off heat
21. Let rest , covered , 4 minutes
22. Stir in avocado and cilantro
23. Add lime juice , pepper and salt to taste , if needed
24. Serve at the table with bowls of salsa , sour cream , cheese and onion

title: buttermilk rolls or classic white bread
steps:
1. Mix all dry ingredients except salt
2. Mix egg , and buttermilk and melted butter
3. Add liquids to dry ingredients until a uniform dough is made
4. Cover and let sit for 20 minutes to strengthen dough
5. Add salt
6. Knead by hand or mixer for 8 minutes
7. In a mixer , the dough will clean the sides of the bowl , but the bottom may stick some so take time during the kneading to mix the dough from top to bottom once or twice
8. Also during the kneading add flour or water to make a soft and tacky but not sticky dough
9. Sticky means dough stays on the fingers when touched
10. Test for a windowpane
11. Knead a little more if necessary
12. Let the dough rise in oiled and covered bowl until doubled
13. For rolls: divide into 2 ounce portions and stretch a smooth side to form a ball
14. Roll with a cupped hand on a clean surface to smooth it out
15. The ball can take some downward pressure
16. Place on parchment 1" apart , cover and let rise for 20 to 45 minutes or unitl almost doubled in volume
17. For loaves: divide into 2 loaves , shape and place in 8 x 4" pans
18. Let rise covered , for 45 to 60 min until doubled or just shy of doubled
19. Preaheat oven to 400 f and drop temps once bread is placed in the oven
20. Bake loaves at 350f until 205f internally , rotating in oven after 20 minutes
21. Brush rolls with egg-water mixture if desired
22. Bake rolls at 375f until 205f internally rotating the pan half-way during the bake
23. Remove bread from pans or parchment and cool on a rack

title: lori s risotto
steps:
1. Warm the stock , then remove from heat
2. Put 3 tablespoons olive oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a skillet and saute the onion , garlic , brown and portobello mushrooms
3. Set aside on a plate
4. In the same skillet put the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil and 1 tablespoon butter and lightly brown the rice
5. Gradually add rosemary , nutmeg and 2
6. 5 cups of the stock
7. Cook over low heat stirring occasionally for 20 minutes
8. Return mushrooms to skillet
9. Pour in remaining broth and cook 10 minutes more
10. When rice is tender , not dry , add the wine and truffle oil and cook a few minutes more
11. Add salt if desired
12. Remove from heat
13. Add grated cheese and serve warm

title: sunny pepper flower eggs
steps:
1. Cut bell peppers , red , yellow , orange and / or green into 1 / 2 inch rings
2. Place in a non-stick lightly oiled skillet
3. Crack an egg in the middle of each ring and cover and cook over low heat until done
4. If you like your yolks runny , just cook over low heat until whites are done
5. If you like your yolks firm , break the yolks and then cook over low heat until both whites and yolks are firm

title: chiles rellenos  authentic
steps:
1. Roast chiles 3" under broiler , rotating until charred and blistered , about 3-4 minutes
2. Place chiles in a sealed plastic bag or bowl covered with plastic wrap until cool enough to handle and skin is loose enough to peel
3. Peel off skins under cold running water , then make a small slit three-quarters down length of chile and discard seeds , leaving stem attached
4. Cut cheese in six 3 / 4 - 1" thick slices slightly smaller than the chiles
5. Stuff each chile with 1 piece of cheese
6. Roll stuffed chiles in flour , shake off excess and set aside
7. In medium size frying pan , melt butter over medium-high heat
8. Add onion and garlic , cook , stirring until golden
9. Add tomato puree and oregano , season to taste with salt
10. Reduce heat , cover and simmer for 15 minutes and keep warm
11. Crispy egg coating
12. Seperate 4 eggs
13. In large bowl , whip egg whites with salt until firm peaks form
14. Beat egg yolks until well blended and fold into egg whites
15. Pour oil to a depth of 2-3 inches or so and heat to 425 degrees or med-high
16. Dipp each chile in egg coating and drop into oil and cook about 2 minutes until golden brown on each side , turning once with a fork or spatula
17. Drain on paper towels
18. Top with tomato sauce or enchilada sauce
19. Optional toppings , chopped cilantro , green onions and sour cream

title: no carb meatballs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix all ingredients together in large bowl
3. Brown your meatballs in olive oil in your frying pan
4. Then place them on cookie sheet and bake them for about 20 min
5. Pour your favorite sauce over them
6. Enjoy !

title: maple whiskey glazed carrots
steps:
1. In a small saucepan over medium heat , combine the mustard , salt , pepper , maple syrup , garlic and rosemary
2. Bring to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes
3. Remove the pan from the heat and slowly stir in the whiskey
4. Return the pan to the heat and simmer for another 10 minutes , or until thick and syrupy
5. Set aside but keep in a warm place
6. Bring a large saucepan of water to a boil
7. Add the carrots and cook until just tender , for about 5 minutes
8. Drain the carrots , then return them to the saucepan
9. Add the glaze and toss gently to coat

title: upside down pear gingerbread cake
steps:
1. Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat
2. Reduce to low , then sprinkle brown sugar over the bottom of the skillet and cook without stirring for 3 minutes
3. Then arrange the pear slices decoratively over the sugar and cook without touching for 2 minutes
4. Remove from heat
5. To make the cake: set oven to 350 degrees , and set oven rack to middle position
6. Mix together flour , baking soda , cinnamon , ginger , cloves and salt in a bowl
7. Whisk together molasses and boiling water in a small bowll
8. Beat together butter , brown sugar and egg in a large bowl with an electric mixer at medium speed until creamy
9. Alternatley mix in flour mixture and molasses on low speed
10. Pour the batter over the pear topping in the skillet , spreading evenly
11. Bake for about 40-50 minutes
12. Cool cake in skillet on a rack for 5 minutes
13. Run a thin knife around edge of skillet then invert a large plate with a "lip" over the skillet and press tightly together
14. Invert cake onto plate
15. Replace any pears that stick to skillet
16. Serve warm or room temperature

title: crazy dark chocolate cake
steps:
1. Sift into an ungreased 9x13" cake pan the flour , sugar , baking soda and cocoa , blend well
2. Make a well in the middle of the dry ingredients and add the oil , vinegar and vanilla
3. Pour the water over all the ingredients and mix with a fork untill smooth and well blended , making sure to get into the corners
4. Bake at 350 for 20 to 25 minutes or until the center springs bake when tapped or a toothpick inserted comes out clean
5. Cool completely and frost as desired
6. Frosting
7. Melt the butter and stir in the cocoa
8. Alternating between the two , mix in the milk and powdered sugar
9. Beat to spreading consistency
10. Adding more milk or sugar as needed
11. Stir in the vanilla
12. Makes about 2 cups frosting

title: failproof lemon curd  aka  you couldn t curdle this if you tried
steps:
1. Beat the butter and sugar with an electric mixer , about 2 minute slowly add the eggs and yolks
2. Beat for 1 minute mix in the lemon juice
3. The mixture will look curdled , but it will smooth out as the butter melts in the cooking process
4. Cook the mixture over low heat in a heavy-bottomed saucepan until it looks smooth
5. I find it helpful to use a wisk
6. The mixture will smooth out as the butter melts and change from cloudy to clear
7. Increase the heat to medium and cook , stirring constantly , until the mixture thickens
8. The entire process should take about 15 minutes
9. Your lemon curd is ready when it leaves a path on the back of a spoon
10. If you are super careful you can double check readiness by temperature
11. It should read 170f on a thermometer
12. Don't let the mixture boil
13. Immeadiately transfer to a cool bowl and cool

title: whole wheat penne with sausage  chard  and artichoke hearts
steps:
1. Set a large pot of salted water to boil for pasta
2. Meanwhile , in a large nonstick skillet , heat 1 tablespoon oil over medium
3. Add sausage and cook , stirring occasionally and breaking sausage into pieces , until cooked through and lightly browned , 10 to 12 minutes
4. Add remaining oil , chard stems , artichoke hearts , and garlic
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Cook until chard stems soften slightly , 3 to 5 minutes
7. Add chard leaves and cook , stirring , until wilted , 3 to 5 minutes
8. Remove from heat
9. Add pasta to boiling water
10. Cook until 2 minutes short of al dente
11. Add sun-dried tomatoes and cook 2 minutes
12. Reserve 1 cup pasta water and drain pasta
13. Return to pot
14. Pour half of reserved pasta water into a small bowl
15. Add tomato paste and whisk to combine
16. Add tomato paste mixture , sausage mixture , parmesan , basil , and red pepper flakes to pasta in pot
17. Toss to combine , adding reserved pasta water if necessary
18. Season with salt and pepper

title: top secret recipes version of pineapple julius by todd wilbur
steps: 1. Combine all the ingredients in a blender set on high speed for 1 minute

title: thai cucumber salad with roasted peanuts
steps:
1. Whisk first 5 ingredients in medium bowl
2. Place cucumbers , onion and mint in large bowl
3. Add dressing and toss to coat
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste
5. Sprinkle with peanuts and serve

title: apricot clafouti
steps:
1. With a whisk , blend milk , egg , cognac and sugar until combined
2. Add flour and blend until smooth
3. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
4. Arrange apricots in a buttered 3 cup shallow baking dish
5. Pour custard mixture over and bake for 30-35 minutes or until golden and puffed
6. Let cool for 5 minutes
7. Dust with icing sugar and serve warm

title: corn dog dressing bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. In a skillet , combine celery , onions and butter
3. Saute for 5 minutes
4. Pour into a large bowl
5. Cut the hot dogs into fourths lengthwise
6. Then cut each hot dog strip into 4 pieces
7. Pour hot dog pieces into the same skillet you used for the celery / onion mixture , saute hot dog pieces for 5 min or until lightly browned
8. Add the browned hot dog pieces into the celery / onion mixture bowl
9. In another large bowl , combine
10. Eggs , milk , sugar , sage , and pepper
11. Add 1 / 2 of the hot dog / celery mixture and 1 1 / 2 cups of the shredded cheddar cheese , into the milk mixture
12. Stir in the corn bread mix
13. Spread the mixture into a 13x9 backing dish
14. Top with the remaining half of the hot dog / celery mix
15. Sprinkle remaining 1 / 2 cup of cheese over the top
16. Bake , uncovered , at 400f for approx 35 minutes , or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean
17. Enjoy !
18. If your kids are gonna freak at the sight of celery , leave it out and add a shake or two of celery salt
19. Some of my kids like this with mustard or ketchup

title: cheesy ham   garlic wraps
steps:
1. Combine deviled ham spread and cheese spread
2. Spread evenly over tortillas
3. Evenly arrange roasted peppers then arugula over ham mixture
4. Roll up and secure with toothpicks

title: golden northern cornbread  with bacon
steps:
1. Place diced bacon in medium skillet over medium heat
2. Fry until well browned and crisp
3. Drain , cool , and set aside
4. Adjust oven rack to center position and heat to 425f
5. Grease a 9x9x2-inch metal pan
6. Stir cornmeal , flour , baking powder , baking soda , and salt in large bowl
7. Push dry ingredients up side of bowl to make a well
8. Crack eggs into well and stir lightly with wooden spoon , then add buttermilk and milk
9. Stir wet and dry ingredients quickly until almost combined
10. Add melted butter
11. Stir until ingredients are just combined
12. Crumble bacon and fold into batter
13. Pour batter into greased pan
14. Bake until top is golden brown and lightly cracked and edges have pulled away from side of pan , about 25 minutes
15. Transfer pan to wire rack to cool slightly , 5 to 10 minutes
16. Cut cornbread into squares and serve warm

title: steak quesadillas
steps:
1. In medium bowl , combine black beans , cilantro , tomatoes , avocado , lime juice and cayenne
2. Stir to combine
3. Season with salt and pepper
4. Rub steak with oregano
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. In a 10-inch skillet , heat 1 t oil over high
7. Add steak to skillet , and cook , turning once , until browned and still rare , 2-3 minutes per side
8. Transfer steak to a cutting board
9. Let rest 5 minutes before slicing 1 / 4 inch thick
10. Preheat oven to 425 degrees with racks in upper and lower thirds
11. Brush one side of each tortilla with remaining 2 teaspoons oil
12. Place 1 tortilla , oiled side down , on each of two baking sheets
13. Dividing evenly , layer with half of the cheese , then onion and steak , ending with remaining cheese
14. Top with remaining tortillas , oiled side up
15. Press lightly to seal
16. Bake , turning over once , until lightly browned and crispy , about 5 minutes per side
17. Transfer to a cutting board
18. Cut each quesadilla into 6 triangles
19. Serve with black bean salsa and sour cream

title: india relish
steps:
1. Slice the cucumbers and green tomatoes
2. Peel and slice the ripe tomatoes
3. Seed and chop the peppers , peel and finely chop the onions
4. Mix the vegetables with the salt and let stand overnight
5. Drain the vegetables , add 2 cups of the vinegar and the water , and bring slowly to a boil
6. Drain again
7. Mix the sugar , cinnamon , turmeric , cloves and allspice to a smooth paste with a little of the vinegar
8. Bring the remaining vinegar to a boil , stir in the paste , and add the white mustard seeds and the vegetables
9. Bring to a boil and cook for 20 minutes , stirring constantly
10. Turn into hot jars and seal

title: four layer seafood dip
steps:
1. Mix softened cream cheese and milk and spread on a platter
2. Layer 1 jar of cocktail sauce over cream cheese
3. Layer shrimp & crabmeat over cocktail sauce
4. Sprinkle cheddar cheese over seafood
5. Chill for at least 1 hour and serve with crackers
6. Enjoy !

title: roast chicken with plantains and onions
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. In small bowl , combine paprika , cumin , the salt and 1 / 2 tsp of the pepper
3. Rub over under the skin of the chicken breasts and thighs
4. In shallow dutch oven , heat oil over medium-high heat
5. Place chicken pieces skin side down and cook 3-5 minutes until chicken is browned
6. Transfer to plate
7. Using the same pan , brown the plantains , turning once , about 2 minutes
8. Transfer to plate
9. Drain off any fat in pan
10. Add garlic , onions and remaining salt and pepper
11. Cook until onions are softened , 5 minutes
12. Add broth or wine and bring to boil , scraping up brown bits from bottom of pan
13. Layer plantains on top of the onions
14. Arrange chicken and any accumulated juices on top
15. Bake in oven until juices run clear when chicken is pierced and skin is crispy , about 40 minutes
16. Serve with lime wedges to squeeze over top

title: irene s broccoli and cauliflower salad
steps:
1. Mix salad ingredients together
2. Mix dressing ingredients together
3. Pour dressing over salad ingredients and place in a sealed container
4. Refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight

title: key west key lime cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Spray a 9 x 13-inch baking pan with non-stick cooking spray or grease and flour lightly
3. In a large mixing bowl , add the cake mix , water , lime juice , lime zest , jello , vegetable oil and eggs
4. With an electric mixer , blend ingredients together until well combined , about 3 minutes
5. Pour into prepared pan and bake in preheated oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until a toothpick inserted off center comes out clean
6. For the frosting , combine the butter , cream cheese and vanilla with electric mixer
7. Add confectioners sugar and blend until smooth and creamy
8. Add milk to reach the desired spreading consistency
9. Spread frosting over cooled cake and garnish with lime zest

title: tiramisu bites  diabetic friendly
steps:
1. Combine cream cheese , splenda , coffee and vanilla in medium bowl and mix until smooth
2. Cover and chill 2 hours
3. Fold in cool whip
4. Using a spoon or a pastry bag , fill tart shells
5. Serve
6. Real info is: calories-9
7. 9 , total fat-0
8. 7g , saturated fat-0
9. 5g , total carbs-0
10. 7g , sugars-0
11. 6g , sodium-5
12. 2mg

title: feta and red onion spinach salad
steps:
1. Mix spinach , carrots , onion , almonds , feta , and craisons together in large bowl
2. Mix all dressing ingredients and toss with salad
3. Serve cold

title: indian butter chicken
steps:
1. Heat a wok until really hot , add 1 tbsp oil
2. Add half the chicken and stir-fry for about 4 minutes or until chicken is a nice colour
3. Remove to plate
4. Add extra oil and cook remaining chicken
5. Remove from wok
6. Reduce heat and add the butter
7. When melted add all of the spices and stir-fry until fragrant- about 1 minute
8. Return chicken to wok and stir to coat with the spices
9. Add the tomato and sugar and simmer for 15 minutes- stir occasionally
10. Add the yogurt , cream and lemon juice and simmer for 5 minutes or until the sauce thickens a bit
11. Serve over rice
12. This dish can be frozen
13. After step nine cool completely then store in a zip-lock bag in the freezer
14. To reheat , thaw in bag in fridge overnight then add contents to saucepan
15. Reheat gently , then simmer for 8 minutes - add the yoghurt , cream and lemon juice and simmer for 5 more minutes

title: tastefully simple copycat beer bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Mix all ingredients except melted butter together-stirring just until blended
3. Pour into greased bread loaf pan
4. Spread melted butter over the top of the bread during the last 10 minutes of baking
5. Bake at 350f for 1 hour
6. Perhaps those who have complained that the bread is not the right consistancy have not been spooning the flour into their measuring cups or have been over stirring the batter ?

title: egg salad sandwiches with fresh dill
steps:
1. Place the eggs in a saucepan and cover with cold water
2. Bring to a boil , reduce heat to medium low , and simmer 10 minutes
3. Place pan under cold running water until the eggs are cooled
4. Peel eggs and remove the yolks from 4 eggs
5. Chop yolks and remaining 4 whole eggs
6. In a medium bowl , mix chopped eggs with mayonnaise and season with salt and pepper
7. Mix in the dill
8. Make into sandwiches

title: bree s low fat tomato  bean sprout and spinach wrap w raspberry
steps:
1. Add tomatoes , spinach and bean sprouts to tortilla wraps
2. In a blender mix together raspberries and vinegar until smooth
3. Drizzle over wrap fillings
4. Fold bottom of tortilla up and wrap both sides around it
5. Serve with your favorite soup or salad

title: quick home made rice better than rice a roni
steps:
1. Place rice in a rice cooker
2. No need to water and rinse the rice first
3. Pour 1 1 / 2 cup of cold water right on top of the rice
4. In a separate container dissolve the bouillon in the 1 / 2 cup warm water
5. Once the bouillon is completely dissolved mix it in the rice cooker with the rest of the water and the rice
6. Put rice cooker on "cook" and you are done !
7. Mix well before serving

title: crowned pork chops
steps:
1. Mix together the corn , onion , eggs and crackers
2. Brown the chops on one side
3. Season the unbrowned side and then turn and brown other side
4. Move to baking dish
5. Mound corn mixture on top of each chop
6. Cover
7. Bake 1 hour at 350

title: no cook tomato salsa
steps:
1. Mix together vinegar , sugar , and salt until everything is dissolved
2. Add the remaining ingredients and stir well

title: garlic herb cheese spread
steps:
1. Beat all ingredients in a medium glass bowl with electric mixer on medium speed 2-3 minutes , or until light and fluffy
2. Cover and refrigerate until serving

title: coffee banana smoothie
steps:
1. Combine frozen bananas , milk , yougurt , cinnamon , and nutmeg ina blender container
2. Cover and blend till smooth
3. To serve , pour into glasses
4. If desired , garnish with fresh banana slices and mint

title: jack daniel s cedar plank salmon
steps:
1. Soak cedar planks in salted water for at least 2 hours
2. Set grill for indirect grilling and heat to medium-high
3. Remove skin from salmon fillets
4. Remove any remaining bones
5. Rinse the salmon under cold running water and pat dry with paper towels
6. Generously season the salmon with salt and pepper on both sides
7. Lay the salmon on the cedar plank and carefully spread the mustard over the top and sides
8. Place the brown sugar in a bowl and crumble between your fingers , then sprinkle over the mustard
9. Place the cedar plank in the center of the hot grate , away from the heat
10. Cover the grill and cook until cooked through , around 20 to 30 minutes
11. The internal temperature should read 135f transfer the salmon and plank to a platter and serve right off the plank , or transfer filets to a serving plate
12. Sauce: blend all remaining ingredients in a medium sauce pan and bring to a boil
13. Simmer on low heat for 10-15 minutes
14. Be careful that you don't let it get too think , otherwise it will caramelize as it cools due to the brown sugar
15. Serve salmon over a bed of wilted spinach , then drizzle the sauce over the top of it
16. Alternate cooking method: a direct method to grill the salmon may also be used
17. If this is preferred , spread the mustard and brown sugar on the salmon but do not place the fish on the plank
18. Set up the grill for direct grilling on medium-high
19. When ready to cook , place the plank on the hot grate and leave it until there is a smell of smoke , about 3 to 4 minutes
20. Turn the plank over and place the fish on top
21. Cover the grill and cook until the fish is cooked through , reaching an internal temperature of 135f check the plank occasionally
22. If the edges start to catch fire , mist with water , or move the plank to a cooler part of the grill

title: easy cheese danish  barefoot contessa
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
2. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper
3. Place the cream cheese and sugar in the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with a paddle attachment and cream them together on low speed until smooth
4. With the mixer still on low , add the egg yolks , ricotta , vanilla , salt , and lemon zest and mix until just combined
5. Don't whip !
6. Unfold 1 sheet of puff pastry onto a lightly floured board and roll it slightly with a floured rolling pin until it's a 10 by 10-inch square
7. Cut the sheet into quarters with a sharp knife
8. Place a heaping tablespoon of cheese filling into the middle of each of the 4 squares
9. Brush the border of each pastry with egg wash and fold 2 opposite corners to the center , brushing and overlapping the corners of each pastry so they firmly stick together
10. Brush the top of the pastries with egg wash
11. Place the pastries on the prepared sheet pan
12. Repeat with the second sheet of puff pastry and refrigerate the filled danish for 15 minutes
13. Bake the pastries for about 20 minutes , rotating the pan once during baking , until puffed and brown
14. Serve warm

title: thai celery  rice cooker rice
steps:
1. Saute
2. Carrot
3. Add celery
4. Add garlic
5. Put into rice cooker
6. Add rice water and chili
7. Cook

title: authentic anchor bar buffalo chicken wings
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f
2. If necessary , cut whole wings into two pieces
3. In a bowl toss the wings with the oil , and salt
4. Place into a large plastic shopping bag , and add the flour
5. Shake to coat evenly
6. Remove wings from the bag , shaking off excess flour , and spread out evenly on oiled foil-lined baking pan
7. Do not crowd
8. Bake for about 20 minutes , turn the wings over , and cook another 20 minutes , or until the wings are cooked through and browned
9. While the wings are baking , mix all the ingredients for the sauce in a pan , and over low heat bring to a simmer , stirring occasionally , and then turn off
10. After the wings are cooked , transfer to a large mixing bowl
11. Pour the sauce over the hot wings and toss with a spoon or spatula to completely coat
12. These are always served with celery sticks and blue cheese dressing on the side

title: caramelized cauliflower soup with fresh  crabmeat
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a medium sauce pot over medium heat
2. Stir in cauliflower and slowly cook , being careful not to burn , until the cauliflower begins to show a caramel color
3. Add the carrots , celery and onion and continue to cook for two minutes
4. Add the flour and stir continuously until the mixture is fully mixed
5. It should have a paste like consistency
6. Add the chicken broth , bring to a boil and cook while stirring for one minute
7. Season to taste with salt and black pepper
8. Ladle the soup into four bowls and top each with one-ounce of crabmeat
9. Garnish with smoked paprika and serve

title: graham crackers
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , cream together the shortening and brown sugar
2. Stir in the vanilla
3. Combine the whole wheat flour , all purpose flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt , stir into the creamed mixture alternately with the milk
4. Cover and chill dough until firm
5. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
6. Grease cookie sheets
7. On a lightly floured surface , roll the dough out to 0
8. 125 inch thickness
9. Cut into rectangles
10. Place 1 / 2 inch apart onto the prepared cookie sheets
11. Bake for 10-12 minutes in the preheated oven , or until crisp
12. Edges will be golden brown
13. Remove from baking sheet to cool on wire racks

title: olive oil and garlic broiled asparagus
steps:
1. Cut the bottoms off the asparagus and rinse , then dry between a couple paper towels
2. Evenly spread the asparagus in a brownie pan
3. Coat the asparagus evenly with the olive oil
4. Sprinkle the garlic powder over the asparagus
5. Sprinkle the garlic salt over the asparagus
6. Place in your pre-heated broiler with the door all the way open for 10 minutes , turning 180 degrees halfway through cooking

title: peanut butter and strawberry sundae
steps:
1. Combine the 2 / 3 cup of white sugar and the brown sugar , butter , salt , and half-and-half or light cream in a medium saucepan
2. Warm the mixture over medium heat , stirring continuously , until it starts to simmer
3. Whisk in the peanut butter until smooth
4. Heat the mixture for another minute , then remove the pan from the heat and stir in the vanilla extract
5. Pour the sauce into a small serving bowl to cool
6. Reserve several whole strawberries for garnish
7. Slice the rest into a medium mixing bowl and sprinkle the remaining 2 tablespoons of white sugar over them
8. Gently mash the berries into a chunky sauce and refrigerate it until serving time
9. For each sundae , scoop ice cream into a chilled serving dish , spoon on some of the peanut butter and strawberry sauces , and top with a whole berry

title: homemade potato tots   tater tots
steps:
1. Finely shred or use a ricer while potatoes are still hot
2. Stir in flour , salt , pepper and onion
3. Heat 1 / 4-in oil in heavy pan
4. Form into small balls and drop in oil
5. Fry until slightly golden
6. Drain on paper towels , then freeze for tater tot casseroles or to serve alone
7. When ready to serve , remove from freezer
8. Bake in single layers on a greased baking sheet
9. At 400 degrees until desired doneness

title: kona k s too easy garlic toast
steps:
1. Spray the toast generously with spray butter
2. Sprinkle toast with garlic powder and parmesan cheese

title: green salad with mandarins and sugared almonds
steps:
1. Heat sugar and almonds in pan
2. Stir constantly until sugar turns golden brown
3. Don't let scorch !
4. Let cool on a plate and break into pieces
5. Wash lettuce cut into bite size pieces
6. Add the celery , green onions , drained oranges and sliced strawberries in a salad bowl and toss
7. Combine the dressing ingredients and shake until everything is dissolved
8. Add almonds and dressing when it's time to serve

title: swiss steak  south beach friendly
steps:
1. Saute steaks on medium high with the olive oil in an oven proof skillet until browned on both sides , remove from heat
2. Add diced celery and diced tomatoes
3. Cover and bake at 350 degrees f for 30-45 minutes
4. Check after 20 minutes , you might want to leave the lid off at this point if you like a thicker sauce
5. If you're on phase two of the south beach diet serve with whole wheat egg noodles

title: sugar peanuts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f
2. Combine water and sugar in a saucepan
3. Bring to a boil , and stir until sugar is dissolved , to make a syrup
4. Add peanuts
5. Continue to cook over medium heat , stirring regularly , until peanuts are evenly coated , and no syrup is left in pan
6. Spread nuts out on baking sheets
7. Bake at 300 degrees f for about thirty minutes to one hour or until sugar is completely dried
8. Gently stir the peanuts a few times while baking
9. Remove from oven and place on paper towels , let cool , and store in airtight containers

title: my watermelon slushy
steps:
1. In a blender put the seltzer
2. Squeeze the juice from half a lemon on top of the seltzer
3. Add the splenda and then the watermelon
4. Blend until slushy
5. Depending on your blender , you may need a tad more seltzer

title: unstuffed bell peppers parmigiana
steps:
1. Brown ground beef until no longer pink
2. Drain and set aside
3. Saute peppers , onions and garlic in olive oil until soft and aromatic
4. Add ground beef to vegetable mixture
5. Mix in the next 5 ingredients
6. Transfer to 2-quart casserole dish and top with shredded mozzarella
7. Bake , uncovered , in preheated 350f oven until thoroughly heated
8. Serve with additional tomato sauce
9. Goes well with a nice crusty loaf of italian bread

title: sorbet caribe
steps:
1. Place everything in a blender or food processor , and puree until the mixture is smooth and resembles soft ice cream or slush
2. Serve immediately in chilled bowls

title: chicken and apricots
steps:
1. Drain apricots , reserving syrup
2. In a large skillet , heat oil and brown chicken pieces with garlic
3. Drain off any fat
4. Stir together syrup , stock , soy sauce , cumin and season to taste
5. Pour over chicken
6. Cook , covered , over low heat for about 30 minutes , or until chicken is tender
7. Put chicken in heatproof casserole and reduce liquid in skillet to cup on stove
8. Pour over chicken and place apricots on top
9. When food stops steaming , cover and refrigerate for 2-3 days
10. For longer storage , freeze , thaw in refrigerator overnight before continuing with recipe
11. Reheat in microwave or on top of stove over medium-low heat , until heated through , stirring often
12. Alternatively , reheat in 375f oven for about 20 minutes , or until heated through
13. To serve: sprinkle with chopped parsley
14. Serve with steamed rice

title: baked red snapper with citrus   tomato topping
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 475 degrees
2. Coat the red snapper on both sides with some of the olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper
3. Place the fish in a 9-inch glass pie dish
4. Mix remaining oil , tomatoes w / green chilies , tangerine pieces , green onions and cilantro in a small bowl
5. Season topping to taste with salt and pepper , and fish herbs
6. Spoon the topping over the red snapper
7. Bake until snapper is just opaque in center , about 15-20 minutes
8. Can be cooked through if preferred
9. Sprinkle almonds on top of each serving

title: pineapple bavarian
steps:
1. Dissolve jelly in half required boiling water , leave to cool
2. Add the can of pineapple and all the juice
3. Whip up the milk , as much as you can
4. Fold into the jelly until the milk changes colour
5. Put into the fridge to set
6. Its almost like a souffl , light and tangy
7. Decorate with fresh fruit or grate some diabetic chocolate over the top

title: mookie  oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Mix butter and brown sugar until thoroughly blended
2. Add eggs and vanilla
3. Beat well
4. Combine oats , flour , salt , and baking powder
5. Blend oat mixture with butter mixture
6. Stir in walnuts , coconut and raisins
7. Pack cookie dough into an ice cream scoop or 1 / 2 cup measuring cup , scrape dough level with rim , and empty onto lightly oiled baking sheets , spacing dough about 3 inches apart
8. Bake in 350 oven until cookie edges are golden brown about 20 minutes
9. Cool cookies on a rack , serve or store airtight for up to 2 days
10. But -- they are awesome without them !
11. Also , i have made this using the 1 / 2 cup measuring cup , and by the teaspoon , i believe they taste waaay better when measuring the dough by 1 / 2 cup !

title: our family s no bake cheesecake
steps:
1. Beat the cream cheese until fluffy
2. Beat in sugar , vanilla , and sour cream until smooth
3. Gently fold in the whipped topping until well combined
4. Pour into the prepared pie crust
5. Do not top with filling yet !
6. Let chill for 4 hours until set up
7. Just before serving , top with your chosen pie filling
8. Enjoy !
9. I have to say , my dh really loves it with apple pie filling
10. Its different , but very good !

title: figgy pudding
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a a medium saucepan , heat milk and chopped figs over medium-low heat but do not bring to a boil
3. Cook for 10-15 minutes stirring occasionally
4. The the milk will soften the figs
5. In a medium bowl mix flour , sugar , baking powder , nutmeg , cinnamon , and salt
6. In a large bowl , beat eggs one minute on high
7. Reduce speed to low and add butter , bread crumbs , orange peel , and warm fig mixture
8. Slowly incorporate flour mixture
9. Beat until just blended
10. Pour the mix into the greased bundt pan
11. Level top as much as possible
12. Cover the mold with a piece of aluminum foil greased on one side , greased side down
13. Place the mold in a roasting pan and place on oven rack
14. Fill with hot tap water 2 inches up the side of the mold
15. Bake for 2 hours or until the pudding is firm and it is pulling away from the side of the bundt pan
16. Remove the pudding from the water bath
17. Remove the foil and cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes before unmolding
18. Invert bundt pan onto a serving plate and remove mold
19. It should come away easily
20. Serve with a hard sauce

title: avocado salad with hearts of palm
steps:
1. Dressing:
2. Mix all the ingredients in a blender or food processor
3. Salad:
4. Arrange the lettuce on four small plates
5. Stir together the avocado , hearts of palm and onion in a small bowl
6. Stir in enough dressing to just wet the ingredients
7. Arrange in mounds atop the lettuce
8. Serve

title: balsamic vinegar and garlic oven chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Lay out foil and make a small "pan" with it , two to three layers is okay because it will help clean up
3. Spread a very light layer of butter on the foul where you will place the chicken later
4. Season the chicken breasts with lemon pepper seasoning , press it down into the chicken a little
5. Sprinkle balsamic vinegar on all sides of chicken , don't make a bath for it but just put it on the chicken
6. Place three garlic cloves on each piece of chicken , evenly spaced , smashed on top of each chicken , sprinkle with a pinch of salt
7. Cook in the oven for 35 minutes , open foil
8. Sprinkle desired amount of shredded cheese on top of the chicken and cook uncovered for another 2-3 minutes
9. Cooking time might differ depending on the size of the chicken
10. Enjoy while its hot ! dip in more vinegar or the juices in the foil if you need more flavor

title: fish fillets valenciennes
steps:
1. In a wide skillet with lid cook the onion and mushrooms over medium heat in the margarine for about five minutes , stirring often
2. Reduce heat to low and place the fish fillets over the mushrooms in a single layer
3. Sprinkle the remaining ingredients over the fish
4. Cover the skillet and simmer gently for about 20 minutes
5. Carefully transfer the fillets to a platter
6. If the sauce is watery , boil down rapidly
7. Otherwise , pour the mushrooms , onions , and juices over the fish and serve

title: girl scout cookies  samoas  bars
steps:
1. First , make the crust
2. Preheat oven to 350f lightly grease a 913-inch baking pan , or line with parchment paper
3. In a large bowl , cream together sugar and butter , until fluffy
4. Beat in egg and vanilla extract
5. Working at a low speed , gradually beat in flour and salt until mixture is crumbly , like wet sand
6. The dough does not need to come together
7. Pour crumbly dough into prepapred pan and press into an even layer
8. Bake for 20-25 minutes , until base is set and edges are lightly browned
9. Cool completely on a wire rack before topping
10. Preheat oven to 300
11. Spread coconut evenly on a parchment-lined baking sheet and toast 20 minutes , stirring every 5 minutes , until coconut is golden
12. Cool on baking sheet , stirring occasionally
13. Set aside
14. Unwrap the caramels and place in a large microwave-safe bowl with milk and salt
15. Cook on high for 3-4 minutes , stopping to stir a few times to help the caramel melt
16. When smooth , fold in toasted coconut with a spatula
17. Put dollops of the topping all over the shortbread base
18. Using the spatula , spread topping into an even layer
19. Let topping set until cooled
20. When cooled , cut into 30 bars with a large knife or a pizza cutter
21. Once bars are cut , melt chocolate in a small bowl
22. Heat on high in the microwave in 45 second intervals , stirring thoroughly to prevent scorching
23. Dip the base of each bar into the chocolate and place on a clean piece of parchment or wax paper
24. Transfer all remaining chocolate into a piping bag or a ziploc bag with the corner snipped off and drizzle bars with chocolate to finish
25. Let chocolate set completely before storing in an airtight container
26. Makes 30 bar cookies
27. You wont need quite as much chocolate as

title: colorado cowboy cookies
steps:
1. Position two oven racks to divide the oven into thirds
2. Preheat oven to 350
3. Line cookie sheets with foil
4. Sift together the flour , baking soda , baking powder , and salt
5. Set aside
6. In a big bowl of an electric mixer cream the butter
7. Add in vanilla and both sugars
8. Beat well
9. Add in egg
10. Beat well
11. On low speed , gradually add the dry ingredients and beat , scraping the bowl with a rubber spatula , until incorporated
12. Remove bowl from mixer
13. Stir in oats and then chocolate morsels and nuts
14. Use a well-rounded teaspoonful of the dough to make each cookie
15. Place the mounds 2 inches apart on the foil
16. Bake for about 18 minutes until the cookies are golden-colored and completely dry
17. During baking reverse the sheets top to bottom and front to back to insure even browning
18. Transfer cookies to racks to cool

title: personal portabella pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees , trim mushroom stem even with cap , place mushroom cap in a small baking pan coated with cooking spray
2. Layer pizza sauce , ham and basil in cap and sprinkle evenly with cheese
3. Bake for 15-20 minutes , or until mushroom is tender when pierced with a fork and cheese is melted

title: giada s peppermint chocolate sandwich cookies
steps:
1. Position oven rack in the lower third of the oven
2. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
3. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper
4. In a medium bowl , knead together the cookie dough and 1 / 4 cup flour until smooth
5. Lightly flour a work surface
6. Roll out the dough to a 1 / 4-inch thick
7. Using a 2 1 / 2-inch cookie cutter , cut out circles from the dough
8. Knead together any scrapes of dough and roll out again
9. Continue to cut out pastry circles until there re 24 pieces in total
10. Place the dough circles on the prepared baking sheets
11. Bake until the cookies are slightly golden around the edges , about 10 minutes
12. Cool for 10 minutes and transfer to a wire rack to cool completely
13. Reserve 1 parchment paper-lined baking sheet
14. Combine 1 cup of chocolate chips and the cream in a small saucepan
15. Place the small saucepan over a medium pan of simmering water until the chocolate has melted and the mixture is smooth
16. Whisk in the peppermint extract and refrigerate the mixture for 1 hour
17. Using a 1 / 2-ounce cookie scoop or a tablespoon measure , place the chocolate mixture in the center of the flat side of 12 cookies
18. Place the remaining cookies on top and gently squeeze to distribute the filling evenly
19. Place on a baking sheet and freeze until the filling has set , about 25 minutes
20. Combine the remaining chocolate chips and the vegetable oil in a small saucepan
21. Once again , place the small saucepan over a medium pan of simmering water until the chocolate has melted and the mixture is smooth
22. Dip the top of each cookie in the melted chocolate and return to the baking sheet
23. Sprinkle the tops with crushed candy canes or crushed peppermint candies
24. Refrigerate until firm , about 1 hour
25. Store in an airtight plastic container
26. If you prefer , you can use white , red an green sprinkles or red and green decorating sugar in place of the crushed peppermint candies

title: cappuccino trifle
steps:
1. Cube loaf cake and place 1 / 2 in the bottom of a 2qt serving dish
2. Beat coffee with the cream cheese using a wire whisk until smooth
3. Gradually add all of the milk
4. Add the cinnamon and pudding until well blended
5. Gently add the cool whip until smooth
6. Pour 1 / 2 this mixture on the 1 / 2 half of the cubed cake , then add the remaining cake topped with the remaining cappuccino mixture
7. Garnish with the chocolate shavings
8. Be sure to refrigerate before serving for a nice cool treat !

title: crock pot roast with gravy
steps:
1. In a hot pan , brown roast on all sides
2. Place in crock pot
3. Sprinkle the beef stew mix over the roast
4. And pour the 2 cans of soup on top
5. Cover
6. Cook for 6-8 hours on low

title: meatloaf muffins with stove top stuffing
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients
2. Spray muffin tins with cooking spray , esp for turkey
3. Fill muffins tins to top
4. Bake at 350f for 35 minutes

title: spiced baked pork dinner
steps:
1. In a shallow dish , combine the first 10 ingredients
2. Dredge pork chops on both sides
3. In a skillet , brown chops in oil on both sides
4. Place in a greased 13" x 9" baking dish
5. Combine ketchup , water and brown sugar
6. Pour over chops
7. Bake , uncovered , at 350 degrees for 1 hour or until tender

title: easy cheese bake
steps:
1. Butter a 9-inch square or other shallow 1 1 / 2 quart casserole dish
2. Arrange bread in an even layer , cutting slices to fit over bottom of pan
3. With a fork or whisk , beat together eggs , milk , minced onion , worcestershire sauce , salt and pepper
4. Stir in shredded cheddar cheese , then pour over bread
5. Set aside and let egg mixture set for 15 minutes at room temperature
6. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
7. Bake for 30 minutes or until top is fuffed and lightly browned
8. Sprinkle additional shredded cheese on top if desired , serve hot , enjoy

title: ham soup
steps:
1. Place ingredients in slow cooker
2. Cover and cook on low all day
3. Stir occasionally
4. Add water if necessary

title: steak pie with guinness
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 160c
2. Combine the flour , mustard and pepper , then coat the beef in th emixture
3. Heat 2 tb of oil in a heavy based frying pan
4. Fry a third of the beef for 3-4 minutes until browned
5. Transfer to an oven proof dish and fry the rest of the beef in 2 more batches
6. Add a tablespoon of oil to the pan , then fry the onions for 5 minutes
7. Add the garlic and cook for 2 minutes
8. Stir in the guinness , worcestershire sauce , bay leaves , thyme and sugar and simmer for 2-3 minutes
9. Pour over the beef , then cover and cook for 2 hours
10. Remove the dish and increase the oven temperature to 190c
11. Fry the mushrooms in the rest of the oil
12. Stir into the beef , then transfer to a 15x20cm pie dish
13. Pastry crust:
14. Sift together the flour , baking powder and half a tspn of salt , then add the thyme , and pepper to taste
15. Stir in the suet and bind with 10-12 tablespoons of water to forn a soft dough
16. Roll out the dough , dampen the edges of the dish and cover it with the pastry
17. Trim , then make a small slit in the centre
18. Cook for 30-40 minutes , until golden

title: scallops and mushrooms  pan seared
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat butter over medium-high heat
2. Do not use a non-stick skillet
3. When butter begins to foam , add the minced garlic , scallions , and mushrooms and saut for 2 minutes , or until tender
4. Add the scallops and sprinkle with half of the garlic powder , half of the salt and half of the pepper
5. Saute covered for about 3-5 minutes , or until the scallops begin to turn opaque
6. Turn the scallops over and sprinkle the rest of the garlic powder , salt and pepper
7. Cover again and continue to saut another 1 or 2 minutes
8. Once the scallops are cooked , remove to a plate and cover the plate with the lid from the skillet
9. Add the sherry to the skillet that contains the butter , mushrooms and scallions and continue to heat for 1 or 2 minutes
10. Place 6 scallops on each of the 2 dinner plates
11. Spoon the sauce with the mushrooms and scallions over the scallops and serve

title: aviation
steps:
1. In cocktail shaker , combine lemon juice , gin , maraschino liqueur , and simple syrup
2. Add ice and shake vigorously for 20 seconds
3. Strain into chilled coupe glass and drop in cherry
4. Bartenders
5. To make homemade maraschino cherries: fill a mason jar or sealable crock with pitted bing cherries , add maraska maraschino liqueur to cover , seal the jar , and let stand at least 3 months and up to 1 year

title: tub s favorite meat loaf
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients thoroughly
2. Place in 9x5x3 loaf pan , ungreased
3. Bake at 350 for about 45 minutes
4. Top with ketchup
5. Return to oven for 2 to 3 minutes
6. Serve immediately while warm
7. May be frozen
8. To serve after frozen: place foil wrapped loaf on oven rack at 350 for 50-60 minutes

title: super simple low carb no bake cheesecake
steps:
1. Soften the cream cheese either by leaving it out on the counter or putting it in a microwave safe bowl and heating it gently for a minute or so
2. Using electric beaters , beat the cream cheese until it is nice and smooth with no lumps
3. In a separate bowl , using the same mixer , beat the cream until it is nicely whipped and stiff peaks form
4. Using a rubber spatula , scoop all the whipped cream cheese into the bowl with the whipped cream
