5. Beat the two together until they are completely blended
6. Then , pour in the splenda and beat some more
7. Voila ! a yummy dessert in no time
8. You can either serve this immediately as a "cheesecake flavored mousse" , or , you can spoon it into individual dishes and chill for a more solid product
9. This entire recipe is big enough to fill a 9" pie pan
10. For those of you who are further along in your low carb program , you can add raspberries or strawberries on top to make this a real treat ! enjoy !

title: pot roast meatloaf
steps:
1. Combine first eight ingredients
2. Shape into loaf in the center of a 13x9-inch pan
3. Place potatoes , onions and carrots in layers around meat
4. Be sure to season veggies well with your favorite seasonings
5. Cover tightly with foil
6. Bake at 375f for 1 hour
7. Uncover then bake 10 minutes more
8. I like to brush meat and veggies with a teriyaki glaze before and during baking
9. You are able to change the taste of this meal by the seasoning you use
10. Hope you enjoy

title: tom yum   thai hot and sour soup
steps:
1. Soak the wood ears in warm water for 20-30 minutes until they swell up and become soft
2. Rinse under cold water , and cut into thin ribons , discarding any hard centers
3. Set aside
4. Slice tofu into long thin strips
5. Set aside
6. Bring the 4 cups of water to a boil in a soup pot
7. Add the soy sauce , black pepper , garlic , sugar , vinegar , sambal oelek , and salt and stir to blend
8. Lower heat to medium and cook for several minutes
9. Add the bamboo shoots and cook for a minute before adding the wood ears , the tofu , and the sesame oil
10. Cook the soup for 2-3 minutes , then stir in the cornstarch which should be dissolved in the 1 tablespoonful of water
11. Beat the egg yolks lightly and slide into the soup
12. Turn off the heat and do not stir
13. The egg will cook into the hot soup and stay in pieces
14. Pour soup into serving bowls and garnish with strips of red pepper and cilantro leaves

title: sausage and tortellini skillet
steps:
1. Cook tortellini as directed on package
2. Meanwhile heat oil in a large skillet
3. Cut the kielbasa crosswise into 1 / 2 inch thick slices
4. Cook kielbasa in the oil over medium heat until golden and warm
5. Drain the tortellini and set aside
6. When kielbasa is brown add the marinara sauce and cook until sauce is heated through
7. Add the tortellini to the skillet and mix lightly
8. Sprinkle with the parmesan cheese and serve

title: balsamic roast italian chicken
steps:
1. Whisk together balsamic vinegar , olive oil and lemon juice
2. Add rest of seasoning ingredients and mix well
3. Slip your fingers under the skin of the breast and legs to form a pocket and spoon herb mixture inside
4. Place chicken , breast side up in a shallow roasting pan and bake at 375 for 1 1 / 4 hours or until done
5. Remove chicken from oven , cover with foil and let rest for 10 minutes before carving

title: zucchini quiche  crescent roll recipe
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees
2. Melt butter with the onions and zucchini and saut 10 min or until onions are translucent
3. While this cooks mix herbs and spices in one bowl , eggs and cheese in another
4. Add spices to the pan and mix well
5. Add egg cheese mix to pan and stir quickly
6. Line your pie pan with the crescent rolls and baste with mustard (it helps to space them like a wide spaced puzzle before you join the pieces
7. Quickly transfer to crescent roll lined pan
8. Bake 18-20 minutes or until golden and not runny
9. Allow to cool and firm up 10 minutes

title: french toast in a pan
steps:
1. Melt butter in bottom of 9 x 13 pan
2. Sprinkle brown sugar over butter , then cinnamon over brown sugar
3. Place as many pieces of bread in the pan as possible
4. Mix together eggs , salt , and milk
5. Beat well
6. Pour mixture over bread , cover and refrigerate overnight
7. Pre-heat oven to 350 , cook for 25 minutes , then flip french toast over and cook for an additional 20 minutes

title: bpc cashew milk knockoff
steps:
1. Soak cashews in water overnight
2. Blend cashews and their water in a blender until smooth
3. If desired , strain through cheesecloth
4. Stir in remaining ingredients
5. To stay true to blueprint , add only agave , vanilla and cinnamon
6. To take it up a notch , make it chai by adding 1 / 2 teaspoon each ground nutmeg , ginger and cardamom
7. Enjoy !

title: spicy root vegetable   lentil casserole
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large pan , then cook the onion and garlic over a medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes until softened
2. Turn up the heat , then cook for 6 to 7 minutes , until vegetables are nicely golden
3. Stir in the curry paste or powder and stock , then bring to a boil
4. Reduce the heat and add the lentils
5. Cover with a lid and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes until thickened
6. Season the casserole , then stir in most of the cilantro
7. Heat through for another minute
8. Serve with a spoonful of yogurt , if you wish , and sprinkle over the rest of the coriander

title: five minute hollandaise sauce
steps:
1. In a 1-quart glass bowl , combine butter , water , lemon juice and cayenne
2. Cook in microwave on high for 3 to 4 minutes , or until butter melts and mixture boils
3. With wire whisk , gradually beat in egg yolks , beating constantly
4. Cook at medium-low for 30 to 60 seconds , or until thickened
5. Enjoy !

title: grilled orange tequila salmon
steps:
1. Place all ingredients , except the salmon , in a plastic bag and stir to combine
2. Add salmon and marinate in the refrigerator for 30-60 minutes
3. Preheat grill to medium heat
4. Add salmon , grill 7 minutes , turn fillets and cook 2-3 minutes or until centers are opaque

title: abby s pumpkin pie crustless custard
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , beat the pumpkin , evaporated milk , egg whites and skim milk until smooth
2. Add the sugar , cinnamon , ginger , cloves , nutmeg , and salt
3. Mix well
4. Spoon into 10 6 oz ramekins or custard cups coated with non-stick cooking spray
5. Place on a baking sheet or in a baking pan for stability
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 40-45 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
7. Cool on a wire rack
8. Refrigerate until serving
9. Top with a dollop of whipped topping and enjoy

title: quinoa granola bars
steps:
1. Soak dry quinoa in 1 / 2 cup of water for two hours
2. To make the granola , mix all dry granola ingredients , including the soaked quinoa , in a bowl
3. Preheat oven to 250 degrees
4. Heat oil and honey in a small saucepan until thin
5. Stir into dry ingredients until mixed
6. Pour the granola mixture into a jelly roll pan and toast for 1 hour at 250 degrees , stirring occasionally
7. Store in a plastic bag until ready to use
8. Cook mixed dried fruit with 2 cups water at a simmer half the water has evaporated
9. Add 3 / 4 cup dry quinoa and enough water to cover plus a quarter inche and cook over medium heat 20 minutes , adding more water as needed
10. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
11. Set aside 1 cup cooked quinoa
12. Pour the rest of the quinoa with cooking liquid and fruit pieces into a blender
13. Blend until large fruit pieces are chopped up
14. Add 1 / 2 cup raisins , the salt , lemon juice , vanilla , and banana
15. Blend
16. Spoon blender mixture into a bowl , stirring in granola , 1 / 2 cup dried fruit , and 1 / 2 cup raisins
17. Press into a greased and floured glass baking dish and bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes
18. Cool
19. Cut into desired number of bars

title: coffee glazed doughnuts
steps:
1. Dough:
2. Stir together yeast and warm water in a small bowl until yeast is dissolved
3. Let stand until foamy , about 5 minutes
4. Mix together flour , milk , butter , yolks , sugar , salt , cinnamon , and yeast mixture in mixer at low speed until a soft dough forms
5. Increase speed to medium-high and beat 3 minutes more
6. Scrape dough down side of bowl into center , then sprinkle lightly with flour
7. Cover bowl with a clean kitchen towel and let dough rise in a draft-free place at warm room temperature until doubled in bulk , 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours
8. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and roll out with a lightly floured rolling pin into a 12-inch round
9. Cut out as many rounds as possible with 3-inch cutter , then cut a hole in center of each round with 1-inch cutter and transfer doughnuts to a lightly floured large baking sheet
10. Cover doughnuts with a clean kitchen towel and let rise in a draft-free place at warm room temperature until slightly puffed , about 30 minutes
11. Do not reroll scraps
12. Heat 2 1 / 2 inches oil in a deep 4-quart heavy pot until it registers 350f on thermometer
13. Fry doughnuts , 2 at a time , turning occasionally with a wire or mesh skimmer or a slotted spoon , until puffed and golden brown , about 2 minutes per batch
14. Transfer to paper towels to drain
15. Glaze:
16. Stir together boiling-hot water and espresso powder in a medium bowl until powder is dissolved , then stir in confectioners sugar , corn syrup , vanilla , and salt until smooth
17. Dip doughnuts into glaze , turning to coat well , then put on a rack set in a shallow baking pan
18. While glaze is wet , sprinkle doughnuts with sanding sugar
19. Let stand until glaze is set , about 20 minutes

title: double chip chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Beat butter and sugars ar medium speed with a mixer until they are fluffy
2. Gradually add the eggs and vanilla and beat well
3. Combine flour , baking soda and salt and add to butter mixture , beating at low speed , until blended
4. Stir in the pecans and chocolate chips
5. Drop by heaping tablespoonfuls onto lightly greased baking sheets
6. Bake at 350 for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden
7. Remove cookies to wire racks and cool completely

title: sloppy chicken   crock pot
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in crock pot
2. Cover and cook on low 8 hours
3. Stir chicken until it shreds
4. Pile into steak rolls and serve

title: acorn squash and kale over penne
steps:
1. Place squash in a casserole dish with 1 / 4 cup water
2. Cover with plastic wrap
3. Microwave 7 minutes on high or until tender
4. Heat oil in a dutch oven over medium-high heat
5. Add garlic
6. Cook 1 minute , stirring constantly
7. Add kale and broth
8. Cover
9. Cook 3 minutes , stirring occasionally
10. Uncover
11. Cook 1 minute
12. Stir in the salt , pepper , and nutmeg
13. Stir in squash and pasta , tossing gently
14. Sprinkle with cheese

title: cheesy baked pearl barley
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c fan forced
2. Toss the pumpkin with a little oil and salt and pepper in a heavy bottom baking tray and cook in the oven until tender tossing now and again
3. At the same time , put the pearl barley and a pinch of salt in a pot and just cover with stock and gently cook for about 35 minutes until just tender , adding more stock if needed and then drain well
4. To make the mornay sauce , melt the butter in a pot and add the flour and stir well and gently to cook and then add the hot milk , all at once , and whisk well and then add 2 good handfuls grated tasty cheese , the cream and salt and pepper and whisk until the cheese has melted
5. Heat a little oil in a pan and gently saute the tomatoes until they collapse a bit , regularly stirring and then toss the tomatoes with the cooked pumpkin , pearl barley and salt and pepper and add a general amount of the mornay sauce and mix well and transfer the mixture to a gratin dish
6. Flatten the top and then spoon more mornay sauce on top and sprinkle with some grated cheddar and parmesan and cook in the oven for about 20 minutes or until golden and bubbling
7. Can be made ahead and reheated in the oven though you may need to cover with alfoil to prevent cheese burning

title: daiquiri pie
steps:
1. Mix pudding , gelatin and sugar in saucepan
2. Stir in 1 / 2 cup water and eggs blending well
3. Add remaining water
4. Stir over medium heat until mixture come to full boil
5. Remove from heat and stir in the rum
6. Chill about 1 1 / 2 hours
7. Blend whipped topping into chilled mixture
8. Spoon into crust and chill until firm about 2 hours
9. Garnish with additional whipped topping , lime or lemon slices , grated lime or lemon peel , or graham cracker crumbs

title: simple mushroom barley soup
steps:
1. In a dutch oven or heavy stockpot , bring first 5 ingredients to a boil
2. Lower heat and simmer , covered , for 1 hour
3. Add remaining ingredients , and simmer , covered , until carrots are tender
4. Season with additional black pepper , to taste

title: desert style oatmeal
steps:
1. Boil water with all the spices except black pepper
2. Add oatmeal , boil for 5 minutes , stirring ocasionally
3. Add tuna and olive oil
4. Mix well
5. Serve
6. Add black pepper to taste

title: roasted almonds
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Toss all ingredients together in a large bowl
3. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or foil
4. Roast almond mixture until lightly toasted and skins are just beginning to split
5. Let cool

title: ravioli with lemon cream sauce
steps:
1. Cook pasta in salted boiling water according to packet instructions
2. Drain , set aside and keep warm
3. To make sauce , melt butter in a skillet over low heat , add garlic and cook , stirring , for 1 minute
4. Stir in cream , lemon juice , parmesan cheese , chives and lemon rind , bring to a simmer and cook for 2 minutes
5. Add parsley and black pepper to taste and cook for 1 minute longer
6. Spoon sauce over pasta and toss to combine
7. Garnish with slivered , toasted almonds and serve

title: party potato casserole
steps:
1. Spray 9 x 11 baking dish with cooking spray
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
3. Mix all ingredients except bread crumbs in a very large bowl
4. Pour into baking dish and top with bread crumbs , crackers or cornflakes
5. Bake for one hour

title: ensalada de manzana  apple salad
steps:
1. Combine all the ingredients except reserved syrup in a large bowl
2. Add syrup to taste if the salad looks too dry
3. Refrigerate for 30 minutes and serve

title: steve s salmon pasta
steps:
1. No fat in a creamy sauce !
2. Woooo hooooo !
3. De-seed and almost de-rib chillis , then finely dice with celery , carrot and garlic
4. Gently saute in a teaspoon of good olive oil for three minutes
5. Add the rosemary and de-boned / diced salmon and cook for a further two minutes
6. While this is all going on , pop the tofu into a liquidiser with about 1 / 2 a cup of milk
7. Whizz briefly and add more milk until you have a thick cream
8. Add this to the pan over a low heat and cook gently until heated through
9. Adjust seasoning and stir in the mange tout , then add straight away to the cooked and drained pasta
10. Tastes lovely and fresh !
11. The mange tout were a good addition and added a nice fresh taste and also texture

title: shrimp pinwheels
steps:
1. In a medium bowl mash avocado with a fork
2. Add cheese
3. Stir until smooth
4. Stir in catsup , horseradish , lemon peel , lemon juice , and chili powder
5. On one tortilla spread 1 / 4 cup of the avocado mixture , leaving 1-inch border around the edges
6. Top with a layer of spinach
7. Sprinkle with a scant 2 tablespoons almonds and about 1 / 4 cup shrimp
8. Roll up tightly
9. Secure with a party pick , if necessary , to prevent unrolling
10. Repeat with remaining tortillas , avocado mixture , spinach , almonds , and shrimp
11. Place rolled tortillas on a tray or platter
12. Cover and chill up to 4 hours before serving
13. To serve , cut each rolled tortilla into 1-inch slices , discarding ends
14. Secure with party picks , if necessary
15. Arrange slices on a serving platter

title: sweet potato enchilada stack
steps:
1. In a microwave safe bowl , combine the cubed sweet potato and water
2. Cover and microwave on high for 4-5 minutes or until the potato is almost tender
3. In a large skillet , cook beef and onion over medium heat until meat is cooked through
4. Drain
5. Stir in the beans , enchilada sauce , chili powder , oregano , cumin and sweet potato
6. Heat through
7. Place a flour tortilla in a greased 9 inch deep dish pie plate
8. Layer with a third of the beef mixture and cheese
9. Repeat layers twice
10. Bake at 400 degrees for 20-25 minutes or until bubbly

title: pistachio rice pudding
steps:
1. In a saucepan , combine milk , condensed milk & rice & bring to boil over medium heat
2. Reduce heat to maintain a low simmer & cook , stirring occasionally , for 10 minutes
3. Add cardamom , vanilla & 2 / 3 of the apricots , & cook until rice is tender , stirring occasionally , about 10 minutes
4. Stir in zest & cream , if using it
5. Garnish with pistachios & the remaining apricots , & serve warm or cold
6. If serving cold , press parchment / baking paper directly onto surface of pudding to prevent a skin from forming , & chill at least 3-4 hours

title: chicken with tomato basil cream sauce
steps:
1. Season chicken with salt and black pepper
2. In a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat , add olive oil
3. Brown chicken breasts on both sides for 5 minutes
4. Remove chicken from skillet , keep warm
5. To the same skillet add onions , garlic and italian seasoning , stir until translucent
6. Add tomatoes and cook , until tomatoes are tender
7. Add wine or broth
8. Stir in the alfredo sauce
9. Return chicken to skillet
10. Cover and simmer until chicken is no longer pink
11. When ready to serve sprinkle with fresh basil
12. Serve with angel hair pasta

title: potato doughnuts
steps:
1. Cream sugar and butter
2. Add eggs
3. Mix well
4. Mix potatoes and milk
5. Mix dry ing
6. Add potato mixture and dry mixture alternatly , and mix well
7. Roll out on a floured board to 1 / 2 in thick
8. Cut with doughnut cutter
9. Fry in oil heated to 375 , until brown and inside is done

title: easy noodle kugel
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Butter a 13 x 9-in baking dish
3. Spread uncooked noodles over bottom of buttered dish , sprinkle with raisins
4. Whisk eggs , sour cream , butter and sugar in a large bowl until smooth
5. Whisk in milk , and pour over noodles
6. Let kugel stand for 5 mins
7. Meanwhile , mix cornflakes and brown sugar in a bowl
8. Sprinkle evenly over kugel
9. Bake kugel until set in center , about 1 hour
10. Serve warm , or at room temperature

title: pear peach crisp
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f
2. In a very large bowl toss together sliced fruit , raisins , the 3 tablespoons brown sugar , and 1 / 2 tsp ginger
3. Press into the bottom of a 3-quart rectangular baking dish
4. For topping , in a small bowl combine oats , the cereal , nuts , the 1 / 4 cup brown sugar , the granulated sugar , and the 1 / 4 tsp ginger
5. Stir in the butter
6. Spoon over fruit
7. Pour orange or apple juice evenly over the topping
8. Bake , uncovered , for 55 minutes or until topping is golden brown and filling is bubbly
9. Remove to a wire rack
10. Cool about 45 minutes
11. Serve warm with a scoop of vanilla ice cream , if desired

title: three apple applesauce
steps:
1. Combine 2 cups water and lemon juice in 10-12 quart stockpot
2. Peel , core and cut apples into 3 / 4 inch pices
3. Mix pieces into lemon water as soon as apples are cut , to prevent browning
4. Add sugar , coarse salt , cinnamon , and allspice
5. Stir over medium high heat until sugar dissolves
6. Bring to boil
7. Reduce heat , cover , and simmer until apples are soft and almost translucent , stirring frequently , about 20 minutes
8. Remove from heat
9. Using potato masher , mash apples to chunky consistency
10. Ladle applesauce into hot clean 1 pint glass canning jars , leaving 1 / 2-inch space at top of jars
11. Remove air bubbles
12. Wipe jar threads and rims with damp cloth
13. Cover with hot lids
14. Apply screw bands
15. Process jars in a pot of boiling water for 20 minutes
16. Cool jars completely
17. Store in a cool dark place for up to 1 year

title: hot chocolate pudding cake  a la mode
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. You'll need a shallow baking dish
3. Microwave butter and chocolate in a small bowl just until melted
4. Stir with a whisk to combine , then stir in yolk until well blended
5. Whisk flour , 3 / 4 cup granulated sugar , 1 / 3 cup cocoa , the baking powder and salt in a medium bowl until blended
6. Stir in 1 / 2 cup milk , the butter mixture and vanilla until smooth
7. Spread batter into an ungreased baking dish
8. Mix remaining 1 / 2 cup granulated sugar , remaining 1 / 3 cup cocoa and the brown sugar in a small bowl with fingers or a fork until blended
9. Sprinkle over batter
10. Heat remaining 2 cups milk in microwave just until simmering
11. Slowly pour over mixture in baking dish--don't stir
12. Bake 45 minutes
13. Spoon into dessert bowls
14. Top each serving with a small scoop of ce cream
15. Serve immediately or pudding layer will be absorbed by cake layer

title: two grain cranberry  applesauce bread
steps:
1. In a large bowl , beat butter with sugar until light and fluffy
2. Beat in eggs , one at a time
3. In a separate bowl , whisk together all but 2 tablespoons of the rolled oats , the all purpose and whole wheat flours , baking soda , baking powder , salt and cloves
4. Add cranberries and pecans
5. Stir into butter mixture alternately with applesauce , making 3 additions of oat mixture and 2 of applesauce
6. Scrape into parchment paper lined or greased 9 x 5 inch loaf pan
7. Sprinkle with reserved rolled oats
8. Bake in centre of 350f degree oven until tester inserted in centre comes out clean , about 65 minutes
9. Let cool in pan on rack for 10 minutes
10. Turn out onto rack and let cool completely
11. Make-ahead: wrap in plastic wrap and store at room temperature for up to 2 days or overwrap with heavy duty foil and freeze for up to 1 month

title: chocolate marshmallow bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease an 11 1 / 2 x 7 baking pan
3. Melt chocolate and butter in top of double boiler over hot water
4. Set aside
5. Cream sugar and eggs until light and fluffy
6. Add flour
7. Beat
8. Add melted chocolate and butter
9. Beat well
10. Mix in vanilla and pecans
11. Pour into prepared pan
12. Bake 18 minutes
13. Remove from oven and cover with marshmallows
14. Return to oven and bake until marshmallows are lightly browned
15. Cool slightly and cut into bars

title: savory sweet potato bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Butter an 8-inch baking dish
3. Place potatoes and 1 teaspoons salt in a large pot and cover with water
4. Bring to a boil
5. Cook until potatoes are tender , about 15 minutes
6. Drain
7. Place potatoes in a large bowl and whip with an electric mixer until smooth and light
8. Add sugar , eggs , cinnamon , nutmeg , 1 / 2 teaspoons salt , evaporated milk and butter
9. Beat until smooth
10. Pour sweet potato mixture into prepared dish and bake until golden and slightly puffed , 35 to 40 minutes
11. Let stand 10 minutes , then serve warm

title: grilled jalapenos
steps:
1. Grill the jalapenos on a gas grill , or charcoal grill until skin is blackened
2. Slice them lengthwise
3. Place them in enough soysauce to marinate
4. Marinate the jalapenos for 30 minutes
5. Drain and put back on grill to warm before serving
6. Serve

title: the barbecue sauce for steaks and chicken
steps:
1. Heat oil over medium heat , and add onion , then saute for 2-3 minutes
2. Add the garlic cloves , and saute for 2 minutes
3. Stir in chili powder , paprika , cayenne pepper , salt , black pepper , cocca powder , and celery seeds
4. Stir until well blended
5. Add the remaining ingredients tomato ketchup , pepsi , brown sugar , dried oregeno , cider vinegar , french mustard , worcestershire sauce , maple syrup , liquid smoke , and pepsi
6. Stir continuously with a wooden spoon to combine together
7. Reduce heat to low , and simmer uncovered stirring occasionally over low heat , the textures and flavors will diminish
8. Cool to room temperature , cover and refrigerate for 24 hours before using , and serving

title: macaroni with gruyere cheese serrano ham and leeks recipe
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Cook pasta in a large pot of salted boiling water until al dente , about 8 to 10 minutes , then drain and set aside
3. Heat oil in a medium-sized skillet over medium heat
4. Add the ham and cook until brown
5. Add the leek
6. Then add the cream
7. When the cream begins to simmer , add the parmigiano reggiano cheese and pasta , and season with salt and prepare
8. Divide the pasta into 4 oven-proof dishes
9. Top with gruyere cheese and bread crumbs
10. Bake for about 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown
11. Remove from oven and sprinkle with chopped chives
12. Macaroni will be very hot so it is best to let it sit just a few minutes before serving

title: chicken with baby portabella cream sauce
steps:
1. In a large skillet , melt 2 t
2. Butter and saute chicken breasts until browned on each side
3. Remove from pan
4. To pan juices , add 2 t
5. Butter and melt
6. Add sliced mushrooms and cook until soft , about 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
7. Add garlic powder and paprika
8. Stir
9. Cook for an additional 2 miniutes
10. Pour in can of soup and combine , then add heavy cream and stir to combine
11. Return chicken to pan
12. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat
13. Cover and simmer on low heat for 10 minutes
14. Remove from heat and serve

title: tuna surprise rolls
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients until wet
2. Add more dressing if necessary
3. Spread in rolls
4. Place on foil lined cookie sheet
5. Do not close rolls to heat
6. Heat in oven 400 degrees f
7. For 3 to 5 minutes
8. Tops will be light brown
9. Serve warm

title: freeze ahead golden glazed carrots
steps:
1. Put the carrots in a saucepan and pour boiling water over them
2. Return to the boil and boil for exactly 5 minutes , then drain thoroughly and set aside
3. In another small saucepan , blend together the flour , sugar , salt and thyme
4. Add vinegar , lemon and orange juices , and orange rind
5. Bring to a boil while stirring until creamy
6. Add butter and cook for 5 minutes over very low heat
7. Line a casserole dish you'd like to eventually bake the carrots in with aluminum foil , cutting strips long enough so they can extend over the sides of the pan far enough so there is enough to eventually cover the carrots completely
8. There should be enough strips to cover the bottom and sides of the casserole completely
9. Add the blanched carrots to the foil lined casserole
10. Pour the sauce over them
11. Freeze as is , uncovered , until completely frozen
12. Remove the pan from the freezer , fold over the foil to cover and wrap the carrots completely , and remove the package from the casserole
13. Wrap again in more foil , plastic wrap or freezer wrap if desired , and return to the freezer
14. When ready to serve , preheat the oven to 350f
15. Spray the same casserole dish you used to freeze the carrots with non-stick spray , unwrap the carrots , and place them into the casserole dish
16. Bake , covered , in a 350f oven for 25 minutes
17. Remove the cover and bake an additional 15 minutes

title: lemon blueberry cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Like a cookie sheet with parchment paper and set aside
3. In a large mixing bowl combine the butter and sugar
4. Using an electric mixer beat at medium until well incorporated and fluffy
5. Beat in egg yolks and lemon peel
6. Sift into a medium mixing bowl the flour , cornstarch , baking powder and salt
7. Add flour mixture 1 / 2 cup at a time to the butter mixture , mixing on low speed until just crumbly
8. Stir in blueberries
9. Place dough on lightly floured surface , divide in half
10. Knead each half until dough holds together
11. Using your hands form 16 balls out of each half
12. Place the first 16 evenly on the parchment lined cookie sheet
13. Take a glass , dip it in sugar and press each ball to 1 / 4 inch thickness
14. Bake for 12 to 14 minutes , or until cookies are just golden around the edges
15. Repeat with second half
16. You can also use dried cranberries or cherries for these cookies

title: cranberry pear clafouti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Butter a 9 inch glass pie plate
3. In a medium bowl , whisk together eggs and sugar till lightly colored
4. Whisk in the flour and half and half
5. Stir in the melted butter
6. Pour the mixture into the prepared pie plate
7. Arrange the pears in the batter and surround with cranberries
8. If desired , dust top with sugar and cinnamon
9. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes , or till the pears are tender and the custard is lightly browned
10. Cool slightly and serve

title: cream cheese wrapped dill pickles
steps:
1. Using paper towels , gently pat the pickles and the meat slices dry
2. Combine the cream cheese , sour cream & horseradish , together in a small bowl
3. On a cutting board , or clean surface , lay out 1 slice of deli meat and gently spread with cheese mixture
4. Lay one pickle along the edge of the meat and roll up tightly
5. Repeat with remaining meat , cheese & pickles , then cover and refrigerate overnight
6. Before serving , slice pickles into 1 / 2-3 / 4 inch rounds with a sharp knife

title: italian deli sandwiches
steps:
1. In a food processor , with a metal blade , process the basil , parsley , bread crumbs , parmesan cheese , water , fresh garlic and olive oil , until a paste is formed
2. Spread the mixture evenly between the bread slices
3. Layer one side of the roll with peppers , mozzarella cheese italian prosciutto and arugula , top with a thin layer of onions and / or olives
4. Top with bread
5. Cut , wrap in plastic wrap
6. Refrigerate until serving
7. All ingredients may be doubled or tripled for more sandwiches

title: homemade vanilla extract
steps:
1. Carefully open the bottle of brandy
2. Pour off approximately one shot of liquid
3. On a small cutting board slice vanilla beans in half , then again length wise
4. This will produce 4 strips of vanilla bean husk per each original bean
5. With a sharp fine
6. Put all gathered vanilla pulp straight into bottle of brandy , and then place the husk inside the bottle as well
7. Repeat until all slices of bean husk have been stripped and dropped into the bottle
8. Re-cork / close bottle and gently shake to disburse the vanilla husks and pulp in the liquid
9. This is a very slow steeping process so do not rush the immersion
10. Store bottle on in a space where you will remember to stir / swirl the bottle aprox once a week for at least 2 to 3 months
11. When you pour off some of your homemade vanilla into a smaller bottle for easier usage , remember to refill the original bottle back up with fresh alcohol , and begin the immersion process again
12. The original beans will last at several steeps , in fact my original vanilla has been used for 4 batches now

title: cucumber yogurt chips with pita chips  ww
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. To make chips , split each pita into 2 rounds , lightly coat both sides with pam and then cut each round into 8 wedges
3. Arrange in a single layer on baking sheet
4. Bake until crisp for 5-10 minutes and then transfer to rack to cool
5. To make dip , stir together remaining ingredients in a medium bowl
6. Serve with pita chips and / or veggies

title: jazzed up baked beans
steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and simmer for 20 minutes or until desired consistency

title: pepperoni penne pasta
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Boil pasta until "al dente" , you want it firm but tender
3. Toss pasta with sauce , place one layer of pasta in bottom of 13x9 baking dish
4. Top with layer of mozzarella and pepperoni
5. Repeat until all of pasta has been layered
6. Top with pepperoni and cheese
7. Put in oven and bake until cheese is melted and bubbly
8. Remove , let sit for 5 minutes

title: crunchy noodle salad   award winning
steps:
1. Place sesame and almonds on a microwave safe plate and cook until browned
2. About 1 minute-watch carefully ! allow to cool
3. Mix cabbage , sesame and almonds together in a large bowl
4. Dressing: mix the spice packets from the noodles with the green onions , oil , vinegar and sugar
5. Shake or stir until well blended
6. Refrigerate separately until ready to serve
7. When ready to serve:
8. Break raw ramen noodles into small pieces and mix into cabbage mixture
9. Do not cook noodles !
10. Pour dressing over cabbage and noodles and mix well
11. Experiment !
12. Toasting the seeds and nuts brings out the flavor- you can also add the raw noodles to the toasting step for more added flavor

title: cheesy chili dogs
steps:
1. In large bowl , mix all ingredients except buns and tomato
2. To make 1 chili dog , in small microwavable bowl , microwave about 1 / 2 cup sausage mixture , loosely covered , on high about 1 minute
3. Stirring once halfway through heating , until hot
4. Spoon sausage mixture into bun
5. Sprinkle with heaping tablespoon tomato

title: homestyle corn chowder
steps:
1. In a large pot , cook bacon until almost crisp
2. Add onion and cook until soft
3. Add potatoes and water
4. Cover and simmer until tender
5. In a medium saucepan , melt butter
6. Blend in flour , and gradually add milk stirring until thick and smooth
7. Add thickened flour , ham , corn , salt , and pepper to large pot
8. Bring almost to a boil
9. Add milk if chowder is too thick
10. Serve warm

title: mediterranean greek pizza
steps:
1. Pat the crust dough out on two greased pizza pans
2. Combine all the sauce ingredients , stirring until smooth
3. Divide between crusts
4. Top each pizza with half the mozzarella cheese , followed by other ingredients in order given
5. Bake in a preheated oven at 400f for 20 minutes or until cheese is browned and bubbly

title: drunken mushroom soup
steps:
1. Melt butter in large saucepan , and cook onions , sugar , and thyme slowly until golden , about 30- 45 minutes
2. Add mushrooms and saute for about 5 minutes
3. Stir in flour and stir until smooth
4. Cook for about 2 minutes , stirring constantly
5. Add water and stir until it's smooth and well blended
6. Add the rest of the ingredients and heat until the soup comes to a boil
7. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 10- 15 minutes

title: provencal olive   bean   spread
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a food processor
2. Process until smooth
3. Place bean mixture in a bowl

title: simply sinful cinnamon rolls
steps:
1. Soften yeast in 1 / 2 cup of warm water , with 1 teaspoon sugar added
2. Set aside for five minutes
3. Put milk , sugar , salt , and about one cup flour in a large bowl , and beat well with a wooden spoon
4. Then add eggs and yeast mixture and a couple cups of flour and beat again
5. Add the soft butter and the rest of the flour , adding the rest of flour very slowly , until the dough is still too stiff to stir
6. Knead the dough until it is smooth and satiny , adding only enough to keep if from sticking
7. Add more of the flour , as needed
8. Place dough in a greased bowl , turning once to grease all sides
9. Let rise in warm place until double , about an hour , covering bowl with a towel or plastic wrap
10. I use my oven with the light on and the oven itself turned on for 30 seconds
11. The optimum temperature is around 90 degrees
12. Punch down , kneading for about 30 seconds to remove bubbles
13. Cover and let rise again
14. Punch down dough again
15. Cut with a knife into four parts , and shape into balls
16. Roll each ball into a 8 x 14 inch rectangle
17. Spread the dough with about 3 tablespoons butter , leaving far edge unbuttered
18. Spread with one fourth the cinnamon sugar mixture
19. Roll up
20. Roll tightly
21. Pinch edges
22. Cut into slices
23. Place in greased pan and let rise until double in size , 45-60 minutes
24. Bake in a 350 degree preheated oven for 20-25 minutes
25. Frost with a powdered sugar glaze or light amount of canned vanilla frosting

title: chicken braised with 40 cloves of garlic
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Place all the ingredients in a deep , heavy pot that can be covered
3. Combine everything very well with your hands
4. Seal the pot very tightly with foil
5. Place a cover over the foil
6. Pot must be very well sealed so that no juices or steam can escape
7. Bake for 1 1 / 2 hours
8. Do not open the pot during this time
9. Serve piping hot , with good crusty bread for mopping up the juices and garlic
10. Open the pot at the table , so that the diners may get the full benefit of the marvelous fragrance that explodes out of the vessel

title: caesar salad
steps:
1. Mince and mash the garlic with the anchovies to form a paste and , in a bowl , whisk together paste , yolks , vinegar , mustard , worcestershire sauce , salt and lemon juice
2. Add oil in a stream , whisking , until it is emulsified
3. Toss romaine with parmesan and croutons in a bowl
4. Add dressing and toss well to coat
5. Serve immediately

title: fiber breakfast cereal hot or cold
steps:
1. Prep: grind almonds in a coffee grinder or in a food processor
2. If you have whole flaxseed , then grind it as well
3. I was able to find cold-processed ground flaxseed from my local warehouse store and i keep it in the freezer
4. Combine all ingredients except the fruit
5. Store it in an airtight container in the refrigerator for best quality
6. To serve cold: the evening before , scoop 1 / 2 cup of the mixture into a bowl , add about 2 tbs dried fruit and 1 cup of soymilk
7. Allow to sit overnight to soak up the liquid
8. If fresh fruit is available you may want to wait to add it just before serving
9. If you are in a hurry , you can try 30 minutes soaking time but if you can't soak overnight i recommend the hot serving instead
10. To serve hot:
11. Scoop 1 / 2 cup of mixture into a microwaveable bowl and add 2 tbs of dried fruit or 1 / 2 cup fresh fruit and 1 cup soymilk
12. Micro for 2 minutes
13. Stir , and micro for 1 minute more
14. Allow to cool slightly before eating
15. Chia is very tiny -like the size of kiwi seeds- and it doesn't need to be ground for your body to digest it
16. It has a much higher nutritional footprint than flaxseed
17. Unfortunately it is about $15 a pound and i have never had enough on hand to put a whole cup into the mix
18. Instead i just left out the flax and put one tablespoon into the individual bowl
19. I guess it would depend on the amount in your soymilk etc

title: peaches and cream cheesecake
steps:
1. Beat flour , baking powder , salt , dry pudding , butter , milk and egg with an electric mixer for 2 minutes and pour into an 8-inch square or pie pan
2. Drain and save juice from sliced peaches
3. Arrange peaches over batter
4. Mix cream cheese , sugar and peach juice
5. Beat until smooth
6. Spoon over the top , keeping 1 inch from edges
7. Mix sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over the top
8. Bake at 350f for 30 to 35 minutes

title: bird s perfect baked potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit
2. Pierce potatoes a few times with a fork
3. Place oil in a small bowl
4. Place salt in another small bowl
5. Place one potato at a time into oil bowl , and roll potato around in oil
6. Shake off excess oil
7. Wrap tightly in heavy duty aluminum foil
8. Repeat with remaining potatoes
9. Place the potatoes on a baking sheet so the oil will not drip down into oven
10. Bake for 45 minutes to one hour until a fork inserted will not lift potato off the baking sheet
11. Slice still-wrapped potatoes lengthwise with a knife
12. Pinch open from long sides to create a 'boat' to fill with your favorite toppings
13. Using a meat thermometer , potatoes are done when the internal temperature reaches 210-220 degrees f
14. If you do not have a meat thermometer , then use this as a guide: for medium sized potatoes: 45 minutes at 450f 60 minutes at 400f 75 minutes at 375f 90 minutes at 350f

title: spinach  mushroom  and chicken risotto for rice cooker
steps:
1. Add spinach , rice , and liquid to rice cooker bowl and turn to cook mode
2. While the rice cooks , heat olive oil in a saute pan
3. Saut chicken on all sides , until no longer pink in the center
4. Remove pan from heat and set aside
5. When cooker switches to keep warm , stir in chicken , mushrooms and cheese
6. Replace lid and let rice steam for another 5 minutes on keep warm setting
7. Season to taste with freshly ground black pepper and kosher salt

title: best bar nuts
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 f
2. Toss the nuts in a large bowl to combine
3. Spread them out on a cookie sheet , and toast in the oven until they become light golden brown , about 10 minutes
4. Combine the rosemary , cayenne , brown sugar , salt , and melted butter
5. While the nuts are still warm , add the rosemary / butter mixture
6. Thoroughly toss with the warm toasted nuts

title: carrot cashew curry soup
steps:
1. Add all ingredients to saucepan and boil for 20 minutes
2. Then puree soup in blender
3. Serve

title: fresh peach muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Beat egg and milk
3. Add shortening , sugar , salt , cinnamon , lemon juice , and vanilla extract
4. Sift flour and baking powder
5. Fold together until just mixed
6. Fold in peaches and fill greased muffin tins 2 / 3 full
7. Bake about 20 minutes

title: root beer pulled pork
steps:
1. Place the pork and onion in the slow cooker
2. Pour the root beer over the pork , cover and cook on low until well cooked and pork shreds easily , usually 8-10 hours
3. Drain well and discard the extra root beer
4. Stir in the bbq sauce after pulling the pork
5. Cook on low for another 1 hour till the bbq sauce heats through the meat

title: christine s meatball subs
steps:
1. Meatballs: combine bread crumbs and water to moisten
2. Add beef , cheese , egg white , oregano , onion , garlic powder , and pepper
3. Mix by hand until just completely combined , but do not overmix
4. Shape into 26 meatballs and place in foil lined , greased baking dish
5. Bake at 425 degrees for 12 minutes or until completely cooked through
6. Sauce: while meatballs are cooking , combine sauce , black pepper , cayenne , salt , and thyme in saucepan
7. Heat over medium-low heat
8. As soon as meatballs are done cooking turn oven onto broil
9. Pat off extra grease from outside of each meatball and place into saucepan with sauce
10. Stir and cover each meatball completely with sauce
11. Let simmer for 10 minutes
12. Cut each bun in half , tear out inside of top of each bun and fill with 3-4 meatballs each plus sauce
13. Top meatballs with cheese and bottom of bun
14. Wrap each sandwich separately in foil and place directly on baking rack of oven
15. Broil for 5 minutes

title: berry blue vanilla smoothie
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth
2. Pour smoothie into a large glass and garnish if desired

title: beef chianti
steps:
1. Place beef and flour in a ziplock bag
2. Add ground black pepper and salt to your liking
3. Seal bag and shake and toss until beef is coated
4. Set aside
5. Gather your vegetables and chop them all into bite-size chunks
6. Peel potatoes and do the same
7. Set aside
8. In a stovetop dutch oven , heat oil until hot
9. Drop in coated beef cubes and brown lightly
10. Add chopped onion and saute for about 3 minutes
11. Then add the rest of the vegetables
12. Add the 2 cups of beef broth , one can of tomato sauce and one cup of wine
13. Last , stir in the bay leaf and herbs
14. Bring to a low boil and turn down to simmer for 1 hour
15. Serve with a crusty bread
16. Mmmmm !
17. After the hour is over , if you would like the broth thicker , you can add 2 tablespoons of flour to about 1 / 2 cup of cold water , shake and stir it in to thicken
18. It just depends on how you prefer your stew
19. For thinner , add a little water
20. Mine never seems to turn out the same way twice so i added this for an option
21. :-)

title: jan s christmas date balls
steps:
1. Boil butter , dates and sugar for 5 minutes , stirring constantly
2. Add beaten egg , vanilla and rice krispies
3. Mix well
4. Shape into 1 inch balls
5. Roll balls into crushed rice krispies
6. Store in cookie tins with waxed paper

title: crab stuffed mushrooms
steps:
1. Spray a 9x12-inch glass baking dish with cooking spray
2. Use an additional baking dish if needed
3. Drizzle olive oil or butter in the bottom of the baking dish
4. Wipe mushrooms with a damp paper towel to clean
5. Remove stems , set aside caps and chop stems to add to filling
6. In a medium bowl , mix crabmeat , chopped mushroom stems , onion , dry mustard , 1 cup parmesan cheese , soft bread crumbs , parsley , red and black pepper , and garlic salt
7. Mix well and then stir in egg and mayonnaise
8. Use a small cookie scoop to mound filling onto each mushroom cap
9. Melt butter and mix in garlic salt and drizzle over the filled mushrooms
10. Mound a generous portion of the shredded parmesan cheese on top of each filled mushroom
11. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 425f
12. Best served hot
13. Can be prepared ahead , refrigerated and then baked just before serving

title: sweet and sour new potatoes
steps:
1. In a pot of salted water , boil potatoes until tender
2. Drain , place in bowl and keep warm
3. Meanwhile , in a skillet , cook diced bacon and onions until onions are soft and bacon is crisp
4. Drain the grease
5. Return to heat and stir in remaining ingredients
6. Cook / stir for 1 minute
7. Pour over hot potatoes in bowl and gently toss to coat
8. Serve

title: chicken with orange and honey
steps:
1. Mix together bread crumbs , orange rind , salt and pepper
2. Dip each piece of chicken in orange juice , then coat with crumb mixture
3. Place coated chicken on a lightly greased , foil-lined , 9x13 inch pan
4. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes
5. Dissolve bouillon cube in boiling water , add butter and honey
6. Stir until butter melts
7. After chicken has baked for 30 minutes , baste with honey glaze
8. Bake chicken 35-40 minutes longer , or until chicken is browned and tender , basting several times with glaze

title: shake it up  iced tea for two
steps:
1. Place the tea bags in a very large mug or other heatproof cup
2. Pour boiling water over teabags
3. Brew tea for about 5 minutes
4. Remove tea bags , squeezing with a spoon to remove the liquid
5. Stir in sugar until dissolved
6. While tea is brewing , fill shaker and a glass or two with ice cubes
7. Pour hot tea over ice in shaker until almost full
8. Replace lid and shake until cold
9. Strain over ice in glass
10. Add remaining tea and shake until cold

title: pork madras
steps:
1. Mix together all the spices and add a few spoonfuls of coconut milk , enough to make a thin paste
2. Add enough cayenne to make it fairly hot
3. Enough to give spicy heat to all the meat and onions
4. Heat the oil or butter , etc
5. And cook the onions and garlic until lightly browned
6. Add the paste and continue frying for a couple minutes
7. Add the meat and stir to cover with the paste and brown a bit
8. Add the beef broth , bring to a boil , then cover and simmer gently until the meat is very tender - at least 2 hours
9. Add the optional potatoes when the meat is tender and continue cooking until the potatoes are done
10. Stir in the remaining coconut milk and the lemon juice and continue simmering for 10 minutes until thickened a bit
11. Serve over any type of indian style boiled rice

title: french s tangy ranch chicken  baked or stir fry
steps:
1. Mix ranch , mustard and brown sugar
2. Reserve 1 / 2 c of sauce
3. With the reserved 1 / 2 c sauce , heat in a saucepan over medium heat , stirring slowly , but constantly until it starts to get bubbly
4. Remove from heat
5. Coat chicken with remaining , uncooked sauce in a 3 qt baking dish
6. Bake chicken at 350 for 30 minutes or until juices are no longer pink
7. Serve with cooked sauce
8. Stir fry instructions:
9. Mix the sauce ingredients the same but do not heat them
10. Dice 4 chicken breasts and cook in olive oil over medium heat until no longer pink
11. Add the sauce and heat until bubbly
12. Serve over already cooked veggies and rice

title: slow cooker clam chowder  new england style
steps:
1. Drain clam liquid into slow cooker
2. Set aside whole clams
3. Add water , clam juice , potatoes , worcestershire sauce , bacon , vegetables , salt , pepper and bay leaf
4. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours or until potatoes are cooked
5. Remove bay leaf and discard
6. In a bowl combine flour and half cup of evaporated milk
7. Mix well to dissolve lumps
8. Add to slow cooker along with reserved whole clams , green pepper an remaining milk
9. Stir , cover and cook on high for 30 minutes or until thickened , stirring occasionally

title: ham  cheese   asparagus crepes
steps:
1. Use a non-stick frying pan and heat it to medium
2. In a bowl , combine flour , milk , eggs , sugar , oil and salt
3. Beat until well blended
4. When the pan is hot , add 3 - 4 tbsps
5. Of batter
6. Swirl the batter until the bottom is coated and part way up the side of the pan
7. Add 1 / 4 of the mozzarela cheese , ham , asparagus
8. Cook until the edges of the crepe start to come away from the side of the pan and the bottom is golden brown
9. Using a spatula , slowly fold the crepe in half and repeat until all of your crepes are made
10. Should yield about 4 large
11. Serve immediately with a bit of butter on top and maple syrup -- pure comfort !

title: frozen coleslaw
steps:
1. For slaw: mix salt with cabbage and let stand one hour
2. Then squeeze out excess moisture
3. Add carrot and green pepper
4. Set aside
5. For dressing: combine vinegar , water , sugar , celery seed and mustard seed and bring to boil
6. Boil one minute
7. Cool to lukewarm
8. Pour over cabbage mixture and put into containers and freeze
9. Thaws quickly

title: deviled eggs with shrimp filling  krevetitidisega munad
steps:
1. Boil the eggs for 8-10 minutes , then cool under cold running water
2. Peel the eggs and halve lengthwise
3. Remove the egg yolks and chop them finely
4. Put 12 shrimps aside for garnishing
5. Chop the rest of the shrimps as finely or coarsely as you wish
6. Mix with sour cream , grated lemon zest , ground caraway seeds and chopped dill and egg yolks
7. Season with salt and pepper
8. Spoon the filling onto the egg whites
9. Place on a serving tray , garnish with whole shrimps and dill sprigs

title: mrs  field s oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter and both sugars
2. Add egg and vanilla - mix well
3. Take 1 1 / 4 cups oatmeal - put small amounts in blender and blend until it turns to powder - set aside
4. Grate hershey bar - set aside
5. Combine oatmeal , flour , salt , baking powder , and baking soda
6. Add this to butter / sugar mixture and mix well
7. Add chips and grated chocolate
8. Shape dough into golfball sized cookies
9. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet for 6 mins
10. At 375

title: round teething biscuits for baby
steps:
1. In a bowl stir eggs until creamy
2. Then add in sugar and mix well
3. Then add in flour just until the dough is stiff and easy to handle
4. Roll into a 3 / 4 inch thickness and cut in round shapes
5. Put on a cookies sheet and let sit overnight or for 10 hours
6. Put in the oven and bake at 325 until they are browned and hard to the touch

title: tarako spaghetti  salted cod fish roe pesto with pasta
steps:
1. Cut open the casing on each piece of tarako and gently scrape or squeeze out the roe
2. Discard the casings
3. Start your water to boil for the spaghetti
4. Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat
5. Reduce heat to low and add roe , stirring until the color of the roe changes to a pale orange
6. Stir in about half the heavy cream until well blended and heated through
7. As necessary , you can add the rest of the heavy cream
8. Turn off the heat and keep the sauce just warm
9. Don't ask me why , but a friend stirs in a spoonful of kewpie mayonnaise before tossing this dish together
10. Cook the pasta to al dente
11. Drain pasta and toss with sauce to serve

title: blueberry and apple jam
steps:
1. Peel , core , and dice the apples , reserving the trimmings
2. Put as many of the apple trimmings in a jelly bag or 4 layers of cheesecloth as will fit , and tie the bag closed
3. Set the diced apples aside
4. Don't worry about it if they start to brown a bit
5. They are going to be turned purple by the blueberries anyway
6. Place two or three small saucers in the freezer
7. You will use these later to check the set of the jam
8. Put the blueberries and sugar in a wide , 6 to 8 quart preserving pan
9. I use a potato masher to mash up some of the blueberries , about a third of them , but you don't have to do this
10. I just feel that it gets the juices flowing quicker
11. If you do not have a preserving pan , use the widest pan you have
12. The wider the pan , the more quickly moisture will evaporate from the mixture , and this is what you want when you are making jelly , jam , or marmalade
13. Bring the berries and sugar to a simmer over medium heat , stirring frequently , then continue to cook until the juices are just deep enough to cover the blueberries , about 5 minutes
14. Pour the berries into a colander set over a large bowl and stir the berries gently to drain off the juice
15. Return the juice to the pan , along with the diced apples and the bag with the trimmings , and bring to a boil over high heat
16. Boil , stirring occasionally , until the syrup is reduced and thick
17. This usually takes about 15 to 20 minutes
18. Take the pan off the heat and remove the bag containing the apple trimmings from the syrup and place it between two plates
19. Hold these plates over the preserving pan , and squeeze the plates together to squeeze out any juice which is in the bag
20. You don't have to try to get every last bit of juice out , just as much as you can get reasonably , and then set the bag aside
21. Return the blueberries and any accumulated juice , along with the lemon juice and zest , to the pan and bring to a simmer
22. Simmer , stirring frequently , for 5 minutes , and then check the set
23. Use the cold plate test to check set: take the pan of jam off the heat place a drop of the jam mixture on one of the saucers you've kept in the freezer , & place the plate back in the freezer for 1 minute
24. After 1 minute , take the saucer out of the freezer and nudge the drop of jam with your finger
25. If it "wrinkles" when you nudge it with your finger it is done
26. If the jam is not set , continue cooking over medium-high heat , checking the set again every 5 minutes
27. Once the jam is set , remove it from the heat and stir gently for a few seconds to distribute the fruit in the liquid
28. Ladle the jam into sterilized canning jars , leaving 1 / 4" headspace
29. Wipe the rims of the jars with damp paper towels to remove any jam which got on the rims or the threads
30. Place the lids and the bands on the jars , just tightening the bands finger
31. Process in a boiling water bath for 5 minutes , then remove and let sit , undisturbed , for at least 12 hours before checking seals
32. It is important to let them sit undisturbed for 12 hours because the sealing compound on the lids is still cooling and hardening , completing the seal
33. While the jars cool , you will hear a "plink" type sound from each jar - this is the jars completing the vacuum seal as the final air escapes the jar
34. After 12 hours have passed , remove the bands and check the lids - press down in the center of the lid
35. If you cannot push the lid down any further , the jar is sealed
36. If the lid "gives" a bit , and you can push it down , the jar did not seal
37. You can either put the band back on the jar , and reprocess it for another 5 minutes , or you can just put it in the fridge and use it within 3 months

steps:
1. Cook the sugar in a small heavy saucepan over low heat , stirring constantly , until brown
2. It will smoke slightly
3. Immediately remove the pan from the heat and stir the fish sauce into the caramel , being careful to guard against splattering
4. Return the mixture to low heat and gently boil , stirring occasionally , until the sugar is completely dissolved , about 3 minutes
5. Add the shallots and ground pepper to taste
6. Stir to combine
7. Cover chicken with marinade for at least 1 / 2 hr , preferably more
8. Grill or barbecue or stir-fry for about 3 minutes
9. If cold food is added to a caramel sauce that is hot , the sugar will harden instantly and you'll end up with a dish full of candy chips

title: tunisian zucchini
steps:
1. Steam or microwave zucchini
2. Combine olive oil and lemon juice , then garlic and caraway seed
3. Salt and pepper
4. Drain zucchini and place into server
5. Pour dressing over zucchini and mix
6. Top with paprika

title: royal pear salad
steps:
1. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water
2. Stir cold water , lemon juice , and cranberry sauce
3. Chill mixture until the consistency of unbeaten egg whites
4. Fold in chopped pears and pecans
5. Transfer mixture to a 7-cup mold
6. Chill until firm

title: kale soup
steps:
1. Heat oil in deep pot over medium heat
2. Add potatoes and onions
3. Cover and cook 5-minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Add garlic , bay leaves and kale to the pot
5. Cover pot and wilt greens 2 minutes
6. Eason with salt and pepper
7. Add beans , tomatoes , chourico and broth to the pot and bring soup to a full boil
8. Reduce heat back to medium and cook 5-10 minutes longer or until potatoes are tender
9. Serve soup with bread and butter

title: chicken pot pie for two  cook s country
steps:
1. Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 450 degrees
2. Line rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper
3. Unroll dough on baking sheet
4. Use 12-ounce ovensafe ramekin as guide to cut out 2 dough rounds about 1 / 2 inch larger than mouth of ramekin
5. Fold under and crimp outer 1 / 2 inch of dough , then cut 3 vents in center of each crust
6. Bake until crusts just begin to brown and no longer look raw , about 7 minutes
7. Set aside
8. Meanwhile , melt butter in medium saucepan over medium heat
9. Add carrots , onion , celery and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and cook until vegetables are softened and browned , 8 to 10 minutes
10. Stir in garlic and thyme and cook until fragrant , about 30 seconds
11. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute
12. Slowly whisk in broth , cream , and soy sauce , scraping up any browned bits
13. Nestle chicken into sauce and bring to simmer
14. Cover , reduce heat to medium-low , and cook until chicken registers 160 degrees , 10 to 15 minutes
15. Transfer chicken to plate
16. Let cool slightly
17. Using 2 forks , shred chicken into bite-size pieces
18. Meanwhile , return pan with sauce to medium heat and simmer until thickened and sauce measures 2 cups , about 5 minutes
19. Off heat , return shredded chicken and accumulated juices to pan
20. Stir in peas , parsley , and lemon juice and season with salt and pepper to taste
21. Divide filling between ramekins and place parbaked crusts on top of filling
22. Place pot pies on baking sheet and bake until crusts are deep golden brown and filling is bubbling , 10 to 15 minutes
23. Let pot pies cool for 10 minutes before serving

title: popcorn with an attitude
steps:
1. While the corn is popping , mix the first 5 ingredients
2. In a large bowl , drizzle 1 / 2 of the butter over the freshly popped corn and toss
3. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 of the pepper mix and toss well until evenly coated
4. Repeat with the remaining butter and pepper mix

title: belgian waffles
steps:
1. Sprinkle yeast over warm milk stirring to dissolve
2. Beat egg yolks and add to yeast mixture with vanilla
3. Sift together flour , salt , and sugar and add to liquid ingredients
4. Stir in melted butter and combine thoroughly
5. Beat the egg whites until stiff and carefully fold into batter
6. Let mixture stand in a warm place about 45 minutes or until it doubles in bulk
7. Use 1-1 / 3 cups mix per waffle in your hot waffle iron
8. Sprinkle with powdered sugar

title: chipotle spiced black beans
steps:
1. Saute onion and garlic for 5 minutes or until onion is tender and lightly browned
2. Add remaining ingredients
3. Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes , uncovered
4. Serve topped with crumbled mexican cheese , queso blanco , and sliced green onion or maybe even a dollop of pico de gallo

title: vegetarian pasta sauce
steps:
1. Saute the onion in the oil
2. Add all other ingredients in the order listed , with the tvp last
3. Simmer until onions are soft and / or the desired texture for the sauce is achieved

title: lebanese chicken and rice  djaj mah ruz
steps:
1. Step a: set oven to 450 degrees f
2. Clean chicken and rub all over with remaining ingredients in step a
3. Place in a roasting pan with a 1 / 2 cup water
4. Bake for 1 1 / 4 hours or until chicken is tender
5. Step b: while chicken is cooking , prepare stuffing on top of stove
6. In a saucepan , saute butter and meat until meat is brown
7. Add the washed and drained rice , salt , pepper , and cinnamon
8. Saute for 1 minute
9. Add the water
10. Bring to a boil over high heat
11. Lower heat , cover , and simmer for 30 minutes , or until rice is tender
12. Step c: while rice is cooking , saute nuts in butter until golden brown
13. Add the raisins , if desired , and saute for 1 minute
14. To serve: de-bone chicken
15. Set aside
16. Place rice stuffing on a large platter
17. Arrange chicken meat pieces over top of rice
18. Sprinkle nuts and raisins over the chicken

title: spicy grilled tuna un roll
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except steaks and garnishes
2. Spread the mix on steak and let sit for 30 minutes
3. Meanwhile preheat the grill for high heat , brush oil onto the grill , and place tuna on grill
4. After 2 minutes , rotate the steak 45 to 90 degrees for grill marks
5. Grilling will take a total of 4 minutes on each side depending on thickness and taste
6. Let rest at room temperature for 10 minutes
7. Slice into 12 slices
8. Serving 3 per person
9. Serve over avocado slices with soy and wasabi paste and additional garnishes of choice

title: salmon potato patties
steps:
1. Drain and remove skin from salmon , leave bones
2. Mix everything but the oils and 1 tbsp butter together
3. Let rest in refrigerator for at least 30 minutes
4. Make all the patties and place them on a plate
5. If they feel a bit too soft to you from the handling , place back in refrigerator for awhile
6. Don't make more than recipe calls for or they will be dry on the inside
7. Keep them about the size of your palm -- they will be fat -- press down but don't mash flat
8. Spray large frying pan with pam
9. Heat over medium-high
10. Add 1 / 2 tbls butter and one tbsp oil to coat pan nicely
11. Swirl butter around
12. Fry four patties at a time til golden brown on both sides
13. Add rest of butter and 1 tbsp oil
14. Repeat
15. These are good either hot or cold

title: lemon sherbet punch
steps:
1. Mix lemonade in very large punch bowl
2. Add soda and frozen fruit
3. Open sherbet and dump the entire package of it into punch
4. Due to the frozen fruit and sherbet , there is really no need for ice until later , or unless it it very hot

title: ham and cabbage stew
steps:
1. In a 5 quart saucepan or dutch oven heat margarine until bubbly and hot
2. Add onion and garlic and saute until onion is softened
3. Add ham and mushrooms and saute for 2 minutes
4. Add cabbage , carrots , bay leaf , caraway seed and pepper and continue sauteing for 5 minutes longer
5. Stir in water and broth , bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat , cover and let simmer , stirring occasionally , for 30 minutes
7. Stir in dissolved cornstarch and let simmer , uncovered , until mixture thickens , about 5 minutes
8. Remove bay leaf before serving

title: perfect turkey meatballs
steps:
1. Into a medium bowl , mix all ingredients except the oil
2. Form into approximately 16 meatballs
3. Heat oil in skillet over medium-low heat and add meatballs , browning as desired
4. When browned as desired , add 1 / 2 - 3 / 4 cup water to skillet and cover with lid
5. Simmer over medium-low heat for approximately 20 minutes or until a split meatball is no longer pink inside and the juices are clear

title: peanut butter and milk chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Combine flour , baking soda and salt
2. Beat butter , sugar , brown sugar and vanilla until creamy
3. Add eggs one at a time , beating well after each addition
4. Gradually beat in flour mixture
5. Stir in chips and nuts
6. Drop by rounded tablespoon onto ungreased baking sheets
7. Bake at 375 degrees for 9 to 11 minutes
8. Cool on baking sheets for 2 minutes
9. Remove to wire racks to cool completely

title: moroccan spiced salmon marinade
steps:
1. Mix ingredients in a bowl and brush onto salmon
2. Let salmon stand in marinade for a few minutes or place in refrigerator for a couple of hours
3. Keep some aside for use during cooking

title: incredibly rich chocolate pudding
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine cocoa and cornflour
2. Add 3 / 4 cup milk and mix thoroughly
3. Heat the remaining milk and sugar in a saucepan , stirring constantly , until sugar dissolves
4. Remove from heat and set aside
5. Add cocoa mixture to the saucepan and mix to combine
6. Return to heat and cook for 2 minutes , stirring constantly
7. Remove from heat
8. Remove one cup of the mixture and blend with egg whites
9. Return everything to the saucepan and heat on medium-low for 2 minutes , stirring constantly
10. Finally , add in vanilla and mix well
11. Divide the mixture among 4 dessert cups and chill for at least one hour before serving

title: cookie icing frosting that hardens
steps:
1. Very important
2. The confectioners sugar must be sifted before using
3. In a bowl beat the sifted confectioners sugar with milk until smooth
4. Beat in corn syrup and almond extract until smooth and glossy
5. Divide into as many separate bowls as desired
6. Add in different food coloring to each bowl beating / whisking until the intensity is achieved
7. Paint the icing over the cookies using a brush or dip the cookie edges into icing
8. Place cookies on waxed paper to dry

title: onion cheese dip mix
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a small bowl
2. Blend well
3. Spoon mixture onto a 6-inch square of aluminum foil and fold to make airtight
4. Label as onion-cheese dip mix
5. Store in a cool dry place and use within 3 to 4 months
6. Makes 1 package of mix
7. This recipe may be increased to make more packages of mix
8. Onion-cheese dip: combine 1 cup sour cream with 1 package of mix
9. Chill at least 1 hour before serving
10. Makes about 1 cup of dip

title: easy teriyaki chicken oamc
steps:
1. Mix soy sauce , sugar , vinegar , vegetable oil , garlic and ginger to make marinade
2. Freeze chicken in marinade in a 1-gallon bag
3. To serve:
4. Thaw
5. Pour chicken and marinade into a baking dish
6. Bake in a preheated 350 oven for 35 minutes
7. Prepare rice according to package directions
8. Serve chicken over rice

title: smorgastrata
steps:
1. Make each filling individually , stirring ingredients together until combined well
2. Season each filling with salt and pepper
3. You should have three separate bowls of filling
4. One egg , one cream cheese , one herb , and one bowl for the topping
5. Stack 4 bread slices together and with a serrated knife trim crusts from bread
6. Stack and trim remaining 36 bread slices in same manner
7. On a baking sheet lined with parchment paper or wax paper arrange 8 bread slices side by side in 2 rows of 4 slices each to form a rectangle
8. Top rectangle with half of egg salad filling , spreading evenly , and cover with 8 more bread slices in same manner , pressing gently on top and sides to form an even layer
9. Top second layer of bread with half of salmon filling , spreading evenly , and cover with 8 bread slices in same manner to form an even layer
10. Top third layer of bread with all of cream cheese filling , spreading evenly , and cover with 8 bread slices in same manner to form an even layer
11. Make layers with remaining salmon filling , remaining 8 bread slices , and remaining egg salad filling in same manner , ending with egg salad
12. Chill torte , covered with plastic wrap , at least 12 hours and up to 2 days
13. Make topping:
14. In a bowl stir together herbs until combined well
15. Trim sides of torte and sprinkle topping over egg salad layer
16. Serve torte cut into small pieces
17. Makes 20 half-sandwiches or 40 bite-size quarters

title: heavenly sweet potato  potato soup
steps:
1. Roast the sweet potato in its jacket
2. I roasted mine until it was carmelized and the skin very loose
3. Saute onions and pressed garlic for about 3 minutes over medium high heat
4. Add potato and saute for another 3 minutes
5. Add broth , spices , and sweet potato
6. Simmer until potatoes are soft
7. Meanwhile assemble the salad ingredients (do not add dressing until served
8. The whole grain rolls can be wrapped in tinfoil and warmed in the oven
9. Remove from burner , mash soup with potato masher
10. Add half and half
11. Reheat but not to a boil
12. Serve soup in soup bowls with a dollop of sour cream or yoghurt in the middle and a sprig of parsley salad can be served out of a salad bowl or on side plates with warmed rolls

title: buca di beppo warm tomato and spinach salad
steps:
1. Balsamic vinaigrette dressing:
2. Place balsamic vinegar , garlic and brown sugar in mixing bowl
3. Whisk rapidly by hand while drizzling in the olive oil mix well
4. Place in glass jar and store in fridge until needed
5. Pecan's: preheat oven 350f
6. Melt butter in saute pan
7. Add brown sugar , cinnamon , salt , cayenne pepper and pecan pieces
8. Mix well
9. Spread pecans on cookie sheet and bake about 5-7 minutes watch carefully to not burn
10. Remove from oven and let cool
11. Salad: place red onion and tomato wedges in medium glass bowl
12. Stir balsamic vinaigrette and pour some of the dressing over the onions and tomatoes
13. Microwave for about 2-3 minutes
14. Place spinach on large plate
15. Using large spoon , place tomatoes around the spinach not on top
16. Place the onions on top of the spinach
17. Pour some of the dressing over the salad coating as desired and mix well
18. Sprinkle pecans and goat cheese over salad

title: merry tomatoes
steps:
1. Pierce the tomatoes a few times on the top
2. Place the tomatoes in a serving dish or bowl
3. Pour the vodka over the tomatoes
4. Allow to marinate for at least 6 hours
5. In a small bowl combine the celery salt and lemon pepper seasoning , mixing well
6. Place the bowl of seasoning next to the bowl of tomatoes along with a small container of toothpicks
7. Guests are to spear a tomato with a toothpick and then dip it in the seasoning mixture

title: frozen lemon dessert
steps:
1. Lightly grease an 8" pan
2. Melt butter and add graham wafer crumbs
3. Mix and press most of the crumbs in the bottom of the pan reserving a couple of tablespoons for later
4. Combine in a sauce pan a 1 / 2 cup sugar , 2 egg yolks and lemon juice
5. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened
6. Add a tablespoon of lemon zest
7. Cool
8. Beat 2 egg whites to form stiff peaks
9. Gradually add 1 / 4 cup sugar and beat until stiff
10. Fold meringue into cooled custard together with 1 1 / 4 cups of whipping cream whipped
11. Turn into prepared pan
12. Sprinkle reserved crumbs and freeze until firm
13. Serve frozen
14. Keeps well in freezer

title: smoked fish pate
steps:
1. Remove skin and bones from fish and separate into individual flakes with a fork
2. Mix cream cheese , lemon juice , and onion
3. Whip until smooth and fluffy
4. Add fish and parsley and mix
5. Chill for 1 hour
6. Serve with assorted crackers

title: portuguese steamed clams
steps:
1. Wash clams well in a sink of cold water
2. Discard any clams that are already opened
3. In a large stock pot with a tight fitting lid , place the cleaned clams
4. Add the sausage , onion , tomatoes , wine , garlic and red pepper
5. Cover and set over high heat
6. Steam until all the clams open up
7. Be sure to shake the pan often to insure even heat
8. Drizzle olive oil over the cooked clams
9. Evenly divide all the ingredients into warm soup plates
10. Divide the broth into side cups for dipping

title: cheap and easy sausage casserole
steps:
1. Heat oil in a frypan and cook the onion
2. Add the onion to a saucepan or oven proof casserole dish
3. Brown sausages in frypan
4. Slice the sausages and add to onion
5. Add the can of tomatoes , paprika , barbeque sauce and water
6. Simmer over medium heat until sausages are cooked through - about 5 - 10 minutes
7. If sauce does not thicken by itself , add the flour
8. Alternatively after step 3 place into casserole dish and bake in oven until hot
9. Serve with mashed potatoes , pasta or crusty bread

title: melted cheese with potatoes and pickles  raclette
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 500 for at least 15 minutes
2. Heat four 10-inch ovenproof dinner plates in the oven for 3 to 5 minutes
3. To ensure the success of the raclette , the plates must be very hot
4. When ready to serve , remove the plates from the oven , grasping them with potholders , and , as quickly as possible , arrange four slices of cheese in the center of each plate , overlapping them slightly
5. The cheese should begin to sizzle as soon as it comes in contact with the plate
6. At once , place the four plates on the rack lowest to the source of heat
7. In about 5 to 6 minutes the cheese should melt to a creamy , bubbly mass
8. Do not let it turn the slightest bit brown
9. Remove from the oven , place a potato and one or two gherkins and pickled onions on the side of each plate and serve at once , setting each plate on a service plate to prevent it from scorching the table

title: beef and sun dried tomato roll ups
steps:
1. Spread each slice of roast beef with cream cheese
2. Sprinkle with chopped sundried tomatoes
3. Roll up each slice tightly
4. Refrigerate , covered , for at least an hour or until firm
5. To serve , cut each roll into 4 pieces
6. Secure each with a cocktail toothpick
7. Also , these rollups are not served on their sides like pinwheels
8. The cut sides are on each end , not up and down
9. They may be secured with sprigs of fresh rosemary , instead of the toothpick

title: bruce s ground beef curry
steps:
1. Heat oil and fry ground beef until well browned
2. Add onion and fry until transparent
3. Add garlic and ginger and fry for another minute
4. Add tomatoes and curry powder and cook for 2 to 3 minutes
5. Add 1 / 2 cup water if curry is drying up
6. Add peas
7. Add another cup of water and when curry starts boiling , add potatoes and cook until potatoes are done
8. Serve hot over boiled rice or dip crusty bread in curry

title: pineapple pumpkin bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray 2 loaf pans with non-stick baking spray with flour
3. In large bowl , combine flour , sugar , baking powder
4. Baking soda , cinnamon , ginger , salt , and nutmeg
5. Add eggs and oil , beat at low speed with an electric mixer until smooth
6. Stir in pumpkin , pineapple , and pecans
7. Pour batter evenly into prepared pans
8. Bake for 38 to 42 minutes
9. Cool in pans for 10 minutes
10. Remove from pans and cool completely on wire racks

title: peartini
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a martini shaker
2. Shake
3. Strain into a chilled martini glass
4. Garnish with sliced pears

title: mango blueberry trifle
steps:
1. Cut almond cake into 4 layers
2. Line the bottom of a glass bowl with one layer of cake , spread on 1 / 2 cup pastry cream , top with 1 / 4 of the mangoes , blueberries and sweetened passionfruit puree
3. Add another layer of cake and repeat the layering process until done
4. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour
5. Spoon out to serve

title: grilled potatoes in foil
steps:
1. Mix salad dressing , paprika , salt and pepper in large bowl and blend well
2. Add potatoes and sliced onions and stir to coat
3. Divide potato mixture among 6 15" square pieces of heavy duty aluminum foil
4. Seal each to make a packet
5. Place packets on grill over medium heat
6. Grill uncovered 30 minutes

title: apple  amaretto  cream cheese omelet for two
steps:
1. Melt butter in a small skillet
2. Stir in sugar and sliced apple and saute until apples are tender
3. Remove from heat and add liqueur or extract
4. Keep warm
5. Beat together egg mix and when ready to cook omelet , melt 1 teaspoon of butter in omelet pan and pour in half of the egg mix
6. Cook as for an omelet , pushing raw egg to outside edge , when eggs are set , cover with half of cream cheese and half of apple mix
7. Continue cooking for one minute and fold or roll and slide out of pan onto heated serving plate
8. Repeat for second omelet or use two pans

title: sauerbraten meatballs
steps:
1. Mix beef , crushed gingersnaps , onion , salt , pepper , and evaporated milk in a large mixing bowl
2. Spray a large non-stick skillet
3. Shape meat mixture into meatballs and brown evenly
4. Mix remaining ingredients
5. When meatballs are browned , add liquid mixture
6. Bring to a boil
7. Cover tightly , reduce heat to low , and simmer 15 minutes

title: potatoes italiano
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Peel and slice potatoes in 1 / 4-inch slices
3. Oil a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish
4. Combine two cheese , reserving some for topping
5. Arrange potatoes , tomatoes and onion slices in layers
6. Sprinkle each layer with cheese and seasonings
7. Dot with butter and bake uncovered for 30 minutes
8. Remove the potatoes from the oven and sprinkle with remaining cheese and bake for an additional 20 minutes

title: chicken casserole delight
steps:
1. Cook rice in chicken broth until done and set aside
2. Saute onion , garlic and celery in butter
3. Mix chicken , rice , onion , celery , garlic , water chestnuts , pimientos , mushrooms , soup and mayo in large casserole dish
4. At this point it can be refrigerated and baked later if you wish
5. Sprinkle with crushed potato chips and bake at 350 for 30 minutes

title: apple orange brownies
steps:
1. Melt butter and remove from heat
2. Add brown sugar
3. Mix well
4. Stir in apple sauce , eggs , orange peel and vanilla
5. Sift together flour , baking powder , salt and baking soda
6. Stir into apple sauce mixture
7. Pour into a greased 9 inch x 13 inch pan
8. Bake at 325 f for 30-40 minutes
9. Cut into squares while still warm and roll in icing sugar

title: won ton soup with pork and snow peas
steps:
1. Additional salted water is to be used to pre-cook won tons before placing in broth
2. Put water and 1 tsp salt in a stock pot
3. When all wrappers are filled , heat water to a boil
4. Combine stock ingredients in a 2 quart stock pot
5. Gently simmer while preparing won tons
6. Mix all filling ingredients in a pie pan , then flatten mixture to cover the base of the pan
7. Divide into 12 wedges so each won ton will contain similar amounts of filling
8. Keep unfilled / filled wrappers covered with a damp towel to keep them from drying
9. Place each portion of filling on the center of a wrapper
10. Moisten the edges of the wrapper with water , then fold like an envelope , making sure all edges are adhered
11. When all wrappers are filled , gently drop into boiling salted water
12. Add 1 / 2 cup cold water and return to a boil , stirring gently so won tons don't stick to bottom of pan
13. When won tons begin to float , cook for an additional minute then remove from water and drain
14. Won tons will adhere to each other , so separate them
15. Remove scallions / green onions and ginger slice from simmering broth and add halved snow peas and drained won tons
16. Heat thoroughly , then portion 3 won tons in 4 bowls , with snow peas and broth divided among the bowls

title: prosciutto   sage crostini
steps:
1. Slice bread on the diagonal approximately thick
2. Place sliced bread in an even layer on a baking sheet
