3. Brown cup of butter in a pan when putting the butter in the pan add sage leaves , add salt and pepper to taste while allowing all ingredients to brown together in the butter
4. Remember , the prosciutto is a cured ham , thus there is salt already in the meat , do not add too much into your butter
5. Place one slice of prosciutto on each slice of bread - making sure the prosciutto is not hanging over a lot on the bread
6. Slice the mozzarella in thick slices , and place on top of the prosciutto
7. At 350 , bake the bread in the oven until the mozzarella is melted and just barely turning golden
8. Take the bread out of the oven , and spoon your browned butter over top of each slice of bread , dont over use the butter or everything will be mushy
9. Place one sage leave on top of each slice , and now youre ready to serve !

title: jazzy french toast
steps:
1. Whisk the eggs in a bowl
2. Add the milk , continue to whisk
3. Add the nutmeg , cinnamon , and vanilla and stir
4. Pour into a pie sheet big enough to hold the mix
5. Heat frying pan on medium to high heat , add 1t butter to grease pan
6. Cook dipped bread until golden brown on both sides
7. Slice whats left of the butter and place on top of each piece of toast and serve
8. Serve with maple syrup

title: i can t believe it s carrots casserole
steps:
1. Peel the carrots , trim the ends , and cut into chunks about 1 inch long
2. Place in a saucepan with water to cover , and cook over medium-high heat until very tender , about 40 minutes
3. Drain the carrots well and place them in a large mixing bowl
4. Use a potato masher to finely mash the carrots
5. Add the butter / margarine to the carrots and blend well with an electric mixer or a wooden spoon
6. Add the remaining ingredients to the carrots , mixing until smooth
7. Pour the carrot mixture into a buttered 3-4 quart casserole dish or baking pan
8. Bake at 350 f for about 40 minutes , or until center is set

title: holiday shortbread cookies
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350
2. In medium bowl combine flour , corn starch and 2 / 3 celsius of powdered sugar
3. Set aside
4. In large bowl with mixer at medium speed , beat 2 cups of butter until softened and smooth
5. Add flour mixture , 1 1 / 2 t
6. Lemon peel and vanilla
7. Beat until well blended
8. [ifnecessary , refrigerate dough 1 hour or until easy to handle
9. ]shape dough into 1 inch balls
10. Place 1 1 / 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets
11. Bake about 10-12 minutes or until edges are lightly browned
12. Remove from oven
13. Cool completely on wire racks
14. Store in tightly covered container
15. Icing:
16. In a medium bowl beat together the remaining 1 / 3 celsius butte and the remaining 1 t
17. Lemon peel until butter is softened
18. Add remaining 4 celsius powdered sugar and beat until well combined
19. Add lemon juice and beat well
20. Decorate cookies with icing

title: delicious chicken  or turkey   tetrazzini
steps:
1. In a saucepam combine bouillon cubes and hot water
2. Cook over low heat until cubes dissolve
3. Boil the spaghetti in the bouillon until cooked
4. Set aside
5. In another saucepan melt the butter
6. Add the flour , salt , pepper and cayenne
7. Blend thoroughly
8. Pour in the milk
9. Add the sour cream , cottage cheese , chicken , mushroom and parsley
10. Mix thoroughly , and bring to a boil
11. Add the spaghetti
12. Pour the mixture into a large baking dish
13. Top with grated cheese
14. Bake at 350f for approx 40 minutes , until top is golden brown

title: mema s thousand island dressing
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients
2. Add as much sugar as you like to make it sweet

title: cream cheese cut out cookies   tips you will use forever promise
steps:
1. Place butter and cream cheese in large mixing bowl
2. Mix with electric mixer until blended
3. Add sugar and extracts
4. Mix till blended
5. Add egg and mix until blended
6. Place flour and baking powder in a medium bowl and blend with a whisk
7. Add flour mixture to creamed mixture and mix on low speed until just blended
8. This is the place where your normally divide your dough and wrap in plastic wrap and chill
9. This dough requires 1 1 / 2 hours to chill
10. I have had great success with rolling out dough between two sheets of paper to the thickness i want for my cookies--cover dough with another sheet of paper and place on cookie sheet or pizza pan and place in freezer for 20 minutes or chill in refrigerator for recommended chilling time
11. When ready to cut out
12. I get out one portion of rolled dough at a time--place on counter and then gently remove top sheet of wax paper and then gently place back on top -- then i flip the waxed paper with dough inside and then gently remove top sheet of paper and discard
13. Then i can cut out cookies in desired shapes
14. These cookies can then be placed on cookie sheet ready to bake
15. Very important
16. I forgot to mention when rolling dough , be sure to check under-side and make sure you do not have wrinkles , by removing wax paper and then replacing it before flipping , this will ease removing cookies after they have been cut
17. This is especially helpful with any rolled dough
18. Also helps when grandchildren like to help cut out cookies
19. We can just do one sheet at a time -- no more rolling for them
20. We can just get down to business of cutting , baking , decorating and then eating , their favorite part
21. After placing on baking sheets , sprinkle with decorating sugar if desired
22. Unless planning on frosting when cooled
23. Bake at 375 on ungreased sheet for 9-12 minutes
24. Remove immediately to wire rack to cool
25. Sometimes we "paint" edges of cooled cookies with clean paint brush , reserved for this purpose only , and paint light corn syrup on edges of cookies and roll in colored sugar , sprinkles , chocolate jimmies , coconut , toasted if prefered
26. Use your imagination
27. I have found that you can also use food coloring and buy a blank stamp pad , reserved for just that color and use rubber stamps and stamp directly on cookie
28. This of course is edible
29. We sometimes stamp and roll edges

title: stabilized whipped cream
steps:
1. Soak plain gelatin in cold water for 5 minutes
2. Dissolve by placing it in a container over a small pot of simmering water
3. Allow to cool
4. Using an electric mixer , beat cream in a large well-chilled bowl
5. Just before it becomes soft and billowy , slowly add the sugar and flavorings to the whipped cream at the sides of the bowl , continuing to whip as you do
6. Whip the cream until barely stiff
7. Add melted and cooled gelatin all at once to cream during whipping
8. Stop whipping when cream forms soft peaks
9. Finish beating with whisk to adjust consistency
10. Serve immediately or cover and refrigerate
11. For 2 cups of cream use 1 teaspoon gelatin soaked in 2 tablespoons cold water
12. For 6 cups of cream use 1 tablespoon soaked in 1 / 4 cup plus 2 tablespoon cold water
13. Stabilized whipped cream can be flavored , but do it as soon as possible before the gelatin sets

title: garlic marinade for steaks
steps:
1. Mix all together and marinade steaks 24-48 hours
2. Grill and enjoy

title: chicken taco  crockpot
steps:
1. Throw it all in a crockpot and cook on low for 8-10 hours
2. Serve straight out the pot , with tortillas , taco shells , on a bed of lettuce , over rice , or on a potato ! the options are endless !

title: addie s favorite peanut butter chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients and set aside
2. Mix butter and peanut butter
3. Add both sugars , cream well
4. Add eggs and mix well
5. Add flour mixture , mix well
6. Fold in chocolate morsels
7. Drop dough from rounded teaspoons onto cookie sheet
8. Bake in pre-heated 375 degree oven for 10-13 minutes
9. Allow to cool on cookie sheet 2 minutes
10. Remove to cooling rack to finish cooling

title: braised fennel with carrots and potatoes
steps:
1. Cut the top off the fennel , reserving feathery leaves
2. Chop feathery leaves finely and reserve
3. Cut fennel into quarters , remove core and any tough outer layers , and slice finely
4. Melt butter in a large saucepan or dutch oven
5. Add garlic , fennel , carrots , onion and potato , together with ground fennel , salt and pepper
6. Cook , stirring frequently , until fragrant and the onions and fennel are beginning to soften and turn transparent
7. Add chicken stock , wine and fennel leaves and heat until simmering
8. Lower heat , cover and simmer gently for 20-30 minutes , or until carrots and potatoes are soft
9. Remove cover , increase heat and allow to boil briskly for 30 minutes , stirring occasionally , until the potato is broken down into an almost'mashed' consistency , but still with a little texture- the remaining liquid should be well thickened with the potato
10. Taste and add extra seasoning if required

title: awesome crock pot sweet  sour and spicy chicken
steps:
1. I use reynold's slow cooker liners , so if you use them put one in your crockpot
2. I also use a 7 quart crockpot and have room to spare with this recipe
3. Slice carrots into 1 inch or so pieces and spread into bottom of crock pot
4. Chop onions coarsely and spread over carrots
5. Cut the green peppers into 1 / 2 inch pieces , cover and refrigerate for later
6. Peel the gingeroot and chop finely
7. Sprinkle the gingeroot over the onions
8. Wash chicken and arrange over top of the vegetables in the crock pot , leaving a little space between pieces if you're able to so liquids can flow through
9. Pour chicken broth in a bowl
10. Add the brown sugar and stir well to dissolve
11. Next stir the allspice , ground ginger , hot sauce and soy sauce into the broth mixture
12. Stir well and pour evenly over the chicken in the crockpot
13. Sprinkle a little extra allspice and ground ginger over the chicken , if desired
14. I do this because it flavors the chicken well
15. Put the lid on the crockpot and cook on high for 6 hours or low for 8 hours
16. Turn crock pot to high if it isn't already there and pull chicken out into a big bowl for now
17. Cover chicken to keep it hot
18. Put lid back on crockpot
19. About now i start the water for the rice , so if you're using boil in bag or minute rice get the water going now
20. If you're using other rice that cooks for a longer time start it well before now
21. Drain pineapple juice into a bowl and reserve
22. Stir pineapple chunks and green pepper into crockpot , replace lid
23. Stir cornstarch into pineapple juice until dissolved and slowly stir into the crockpot
24. Stir well , replace lid and continue to cook for 15 minutes
25. During this time finish getting the rice ready
26. Shred the chicken and stir into crockpot
27. Put 1 cup of rice into individual soup bowls and top with the sweet , sour and spicy chicken
28. Enjoy !

title: chocolate chip spice cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. In a bowl , mix all the dry ingredients except the sugar and set aside
3. In another bowl , cream the butter with the sugar
4. Add the eggs one by one , mixing well after every addition
5. Add the vanilla and mix well
6. Start adding the flour mixture , 1 / 3 at a time and alternating it with the milk , beating on low so that it incorporates smoothly
7. Pour the chocolate chips in and mix them in with a spatula or spoon
8. Pour batter into a greased cake pan and bake for 25-35 minutes or until golden brown and a toothpick inserted n the center comes out clean

title: roast loin of pork
steps:
1. Remove most fat from the meat
2. Sprinkle lightly with flour
3. Heat oil in a large skillet or roasting pan and brown pork quickly on all sides
4. Remove from pan and cool slightly
5. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
6. Combine garlic , salt , pepper , soy sauce , ginger and lime juice
7. Rub mixture into roast
8. Place meat in a roasting pan , rib side down , cook in hot oven for 25 minutes per pound , or about 1 hour 45 minutes
9. About 30 minutes before roast is done , place pineapple rings on top , sprinkle with sugar , and finish cooking
10. During cooking , baste roast a few times with the pineapple juice-vinegar-soy mixture and the pan juices
11. Serve with pan gravy

title: lebanese bean stew
steps:
1. Soak the beans in water overnight
2. Drain and rinse
3. Cook the meat and garlic with olive oil in a pan
4. Once the meat is all browned , add the rest of the ingredients with the exception of the cilantro
5. Stir to deglaze the pan
6. Bring to a boil , add the cilantro , cover and simmer until the beans are fully cooked
7. You might need to add some water if it becomes too dry , so check on it every 10 minutes
8. Eat over cooked white rice

title: stuffed anaheim chiles with oregano vinaigrette
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Combine all ingredients in mixing bowl and mix together well with fork
3. Spray large baking sheet with pam or oil lightly with olive oil
4. Stuff chile halves with stuffing mixture , mounding slightly on top
5. Place on prepared baking sheet
6. Bake for 30 minutes
7. Filling will be slightly browned
8. While peppers are baking , prepare the vinaigrette by mixing all vinaigrette ingredients together with a fork
9. You will want to stir it again right before serving
10. When peppers are done , place two baked stuffed halves on each of four small plates and drizzle with oregano vinaigrette
11. Serve immediately

title: leighs mexican rice
steps:
1. Put tomato sauce in 2 cup measure cup and add water to make 2 1 / 4 cups
2. Put rice and all in pan
3. Bring to boil
4. Reduce and simmer on low to med for 20 to 25 minutes until rice is tender
5. Stirring from time to time to keep from sticking

title: white dragon
steps:
1. Pour liquors over ice
2. Shake , strain and pour into glass
3. Top with half and half serve

title: brandy marinated pork tenderloin stuffed with rice and apricots
steps:
1. Combine oj , alcohol of your choice (pepper is optional
2. I did not use salt so it is up to you
3. Add cinnamon (i probably used more than a tbsp but most people would prefer to make the marinade and decide for themselves
4. For stuffing combine the following
5. Combine apple juice with rice and diced appricots (raisons or any dried fruit would work as well and cook according to directions for rice
6. It actually cooks a lot faster than normal due to the quantity , so check it after 10 minutes , or double it for left overs and use the recipe directions on your rice container
7. Butterfly pork and add stuffing
8. Tie with cooking string , and wrap in tin foil if you wish
9. It just makes less of a mess and it is still browned
10. Put in flavour wave machine setting 400 degrees
11. I stuffed mine really full so it took 40 minutes double the 20 minites they say for pork , but i stuffed it so that would take longer , as well i opened it up a couple of times because i did not have a recipe (since i just used what i had around
12. I would suggest checking it after 20 minute since depending on the amount of stuffing and where you placed the rack (i used the 4" which cooks more slowly
13. Let rest for 5 to q0 minutes with foii removed
14. I served brocolli with sesame seeds on the side

title: simple mango smoothie
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in blender container
2. Cover and blend on high until smooth

title: chicken with cranberry dijon mustard sauce
steps:
1. Combine sauce ingredients in a small mixing bowl , stirring until blended
2. Set aside
3. Pound the chicken pieces to a uniform 1 / 2" thickness
4. In a large frying pan , heat up the oil on medium-high heat and season the chicken with salt and pepper
5. Cook on both sides until golden brown , approximately 10 minutes
6. Spoon the cranberry-dijon sauce evenly over the chicken
7. Cover pan and reduce heat to simmer
8. Cook approximately 30 minutes or until chicken is tender and cooked through
9. Garnish chicken with fresh parsley
10. Serving suggestion: if you want , slice up the chicken and arrange on a serving platter

title: nutty chocolate snickerdoodles cookies  gift mix in a jar
steps:
1. Creating the gift in a jar:
2. Wash and thoroughly dry a 1-quart wide-mouth canning jar
3. Layer the ingredients in the jar as listed above starting with the flour , baking powder , cocoa powder , sugar and then pecans - make sure to press firmly with a flat bottomed object after each addition
4. Make the layers as level as possible
5. Secure the lid and decorate as desired
6. Attach the instructions for making these cookies found below
7. Nutty chocolate snickerdoodles cookies gift tag:
8. Additional ingredients to be added by the recipient: 3 / 4 cup butter , softened , 1 egg , 2 tsp milk , 1 tsp vanilla extract , 3 tbsp sugar and 1 1 / 2 tsp cinnamon
9. Cookie instructions:
10. Preheat oven to 375
11. In a large bowl , blend the butter , egg , milk and vanilla extract
12. Add the contents of the jar , and blend with an electric mixer set on medium speed
13. Combine the sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl
14. Roll the dough into 2 inch balls and roll in the sugar mixture to coat
15. Place the balls 2 inches apart on an ungreased baking sheet
16. Bake for 10-12 minutes , or until the edges are light brown in color
17. Allow to cool for 2 minutes on the baking sheet , then transfer to wire racks and cool completely
18. Serve immediately or store in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks

title: orzo with spinach and pine nuts
steps:
1. Spread pine nuts in a shallow pan
2. Bake at 350 for 5-10 minutes or until nuts are lightly toasted , stirring occasionally
3. Set aside
4. Melt margarine in a saucepan over medium heat
5. Add in garlic
6. Stir / saute 1 minute
7. Add in water , orzo , and salt
8. Bring to a boil
9. Decrease heat to med-low
10. Cook 13 minutes or until liquid is absorbed
11. Stir in spinach , parmesan cheese , and toasted pine nuts
12. Season to taste and serve

title: christmas crostini
steps:
1. Slice baguette into 36 slices
2. Place , cut side down , on an aluminum foil-lined baking sheet
3. Bake at 400 degrees for 5 minutes or until lightly browned
4. Combine cream cheese and next 3 ingredients
5. Spread mixture evenly on bread slices
6. Bake at 400 degrees for 5 minutes or until cheese melts
7. Garnish , if desired , and serve immediately

title: taco skillet dinner
steps:
1. Brown and drain hamburg
2. Add taco seasoning , water and raw macaroni
3. Bring to boil , then reduce heat to medium low and simmer until noodles are tender , about 8-10 minutes
4. Serve with cheese , sour cream and tomatoes
5. I used one envelope of taco spice , but i'm not sure of the size
6. It looks like about 1 teaspoons

title: ali s real crab crab dip  hot or cold
steps:
1. If serving hot: preheat oven to 425 degrees f
2. Mix all ingredients except for crabmeat into a medium oven safe baking dish
3. Place mixture into oven for 15 minutes or until heated through
4. Once heated , take cream cheese mixture out of the oven and fold in crab meat
5. Serve with toasted ciabatta bread
6. If serving cold: simply mix all of the ingredients together then place in a serving dish
7. Serve with toasted ciabatta bread

title: roast beef party sandwiches
steps:
1. Mix cream cheese , horseradish and soup mix till smooth
2. Remove all crust from bread and flatten with a rolling pin
3. Spread cream cheese mixture on bread
4. Cut roast beef to fit bread then put 1 slice on top of cheese mixture
5. Roll the bread up like jelly roll and cut in slices or just in half
6. I serve these as appetizers and everybody seems to like them

title: lemon biscotti with lemon drizzle
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Lightly spoon flour into dry measuring cups
3. Level with a knife
4. Combine flour , sugar , and baking powder in a large bowl
5. Combine rind , 1 tablespoon lemon juice , extract , oil , and eggs , and add to flour mixture , stirring until well-blended
6. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface
7. Knead lightly 7 to 8 times
8. Divide dough in half
9. Shape each portion into an 8-inch-long roll
10. Place rolls 6 inches apart on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray
11. Flatten each roll to 1-inch thickness
12. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes
13. Remove the rolls from baking sheet
14. Cool for 10 minutes on a wire rack
15. Cut each roll diagonally into 15 slices
16. Place the slices , cut sides down , on baking sheet
17. Reduce oven temperature to 325
18. Bake for 10 minutes
19. Turn cookies over
20. Bake an additional 10 minutes
21. Remove from baking sheet , and cool completely on wire rack
22. Combine 1 tablespoon lemon juice and powdered sugar , and drizzle over the biscotti

title: apple  honey   caramelized onion flatbread pizza
steps:
1. First , the long part requiring patience: make the caramelized onions for your pizza
2. Heat the olive oil over medium heat and add the onions , rosemary , salt , and pepper
3. Stir to combine thoroughly
4. Cook over medium until the onions become translucent
5. Then turn down the heat and cook slowly , stirring frequently , until golden and irresistibly fragrant
6. Remove from heat
7. That was the hard part !
8. Preheat your oven to 450 degrees
9. Assemble your pizza: spray your your pan / stone lightly with cooking oil , then sprinkle it scantly with the cornmeal
10. Spread your prepared pizza dough over this in a circle
11. Top this with your caramelized onions
12. Next arrange the apple slices--i did a mix of finely sliced "honey crisp" and "granny smith" apple , using just a bit less than one apple total
13. Top the apple layer with the cheeses: first the brie , then just a bit of mozzarella , then the parmesan
14. Drizzle the pizza lightly with a good honey
15. Then sprinkle artistically with parsley because you've now committed to this strange pizza
16. Cook this in the preheated oven for 15-25 minutes , or until the crust is slightly crisp and the cheeses begin to turn golden-brown
17. Enjoy !

title: light  sugar cookies
steps:
1. Adjust oven racks to middle postion , preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Line two baking sheets with foil or parchment paper
3. Whisk the flours , baking powder and salt together in a medium bowl and set aside
4. Using an electric mixer , cream the butter and one cup of the sugar together at medium speed until light and fluffy , about 3 to 5 min
5. , scraping down the sides as needed
6. Add the egg and vanilla and continue to beat at medium speed until combined , about 30 to 60 seconds
7. Add flour mixture and beat until combined , about 30 to 60 seconds more
8. Place remaining 1 / 3 cup sugar in a shallow bowl , working with a level tablespoon of dough each time , roll the dough into balls
9. Roll the balls in the sugar and place on baking sheet 2 1 / 2 inches apart
10. Bake cookies , one tray at a time until edges are golden and centers are just set
11. Cool cookies onthe baking sheets for 5 minutes and serve warm or transfer to wire rack to cool completely

title: grandma s italian spaghetti sauce
steps:
1. Saute garlic , onion and bell pepper in oil until onion and pepper are translucent
2. Add beef to onion-pepper mix
3. Cook til you no longer see pink
4. Drain well and then return to pot
5. Add tomatoes with juice , paste , chili powder and worcestershire
6. Mix well
7. Simmer for 20 minutes
8. Add mushrooms
9. Mix well
10. Simmer 10 minutes longer
11. Serve over hot pasta
12. I like angel hair with this sauce--it gives it a unique texture
13. I use georgio bottled mushrooms , del monte tomatoes , hunts paste , lea& perrins worcestershire sauce , mccormick chili powder
14. All the rest are fresh ingredients
15. This is an old family recipe
16. Once you taste it , you will never go back to any other sauce

title: potato mushroom casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. In a very large bowl , mix all ingredients
3. Pour into a casserole pan
4. Bake for one hour or until potatoes are tender

title: fresh cherries jubilee sauce
steps:
1. Combine sugar and cornstarch in med saucepan
2. Add water and orange juice
3. Blend well
4. Cook and stir until smooth and thickened
5. Add cherries and orange peel
6. Bring to boil and simmer 10 minute
7. Gently heat brandy in separate pan , pour over sauce and ignite , if desired
8. Serve over ice cream

title: souperior frosted meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. In a large bowl , combine soup mix , ground turkey , breadcrumbs , ketchup , water and egg substitute
3. In a shallow baking pan , shape meat mixture into a loaf
4. Bake in the pre-heated 350f oven for 45 minutes
5. Frost the loaf with the mashed potatoes
6. Then sprinkle with the cheddar cheese and bacon bits
7. Bake 5 more minutes in order to melt the cheese , no browning involved
8. Then remove from the oven and let 'settle' 5 min before serving
9. Variation: you can also swap out the cheddar cheese for a different cheese such as monterey jack

title: potato cauliflower chowder
steps:
1. In a large saucepan or dutch oven , cook onion in hot butter until tender
2. Carefully add broth and potatoes
3. Bring to boiling
4. Reduce heat
5. Cover and simmer for 6 minutes
6. Add cauliflower and return to boiling
7. Reduce heat
8. Cover and simmer for 4 to 6 minutes or until vegetables are tender
9. In a small bowl , whisk half-and-half into flour until smooth
10. Add to soup mixture
11. Cook and stir until mixture is thickened and bubbly
12. Reduce heat to low
13. Add the shredded cheese , stirring until melted
14. Do not allow mixture to boil
15. Season to taste with salt and pepper

title: tuscan roasted chicken
steps:
1. Combine oil , garlic , lemon zest and juice
2. Coat chicken with this , plus grind a few turns of pepper over it
3. At this point you can let it marinate up to a day or cook it right away
4. When ready for baking , sprinkle a little salt over the chicken
5. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
6. Roast chicken for 20 minutes , then add the fresh herbs
7. Cook for about 25 more minutes , or until chicken is cooked through
8. If you use bone-in chicken breasts , you will need to increase the cooking time

title: simple pecan rolls
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , beat butter , brown sugar and cinnamon until well blended
2. Spread in the bottom of a 9 inch round baking pan
3. Top with pecans
4. Place rolls upside down over pecans
5. Bake at 450 for 8-10 minutes or until golden
6. Immediately turn onto a serving platter
7. Serve warm

title: wicked spicy crock pot cheese dip
steps:
1. Start browning the sausage in a skillet , breaking it into small pieces as you would for tacos
2. Cut the cheese into cubes and throw them in the crock pot with the 2 cans of drained hot rotel
3. You can go ahead and turn it on to get the melting process started
4. When the sausage is fully cooked , drain the fat and add it to the crock pot
5. Prepare yourself and your kitchen for cutting hot chillis / peppers
6. You do not want to touch anything that you dont need to , especially the cover to the crock pot , because it will get on everyone so just leave it off
7. Wash your hands several times afterwards
8. Chop / dice the jalapenos fairly well , and the habeneros very well
9. Add to crock pot
10. As long as you leave about 2 hours for the peppers to cook in the cheese , the actual pepper pieces will not be much spicier than the dip itself
11. Stir occasionally , and implement step 7 as needed
12. The salsa is a trick i use for any cheese dip
13. Because you've used fresh peppers and drained the rotel , the dip will be thick
14. The salsas primary role is thickness control
15. You can always thin out a dip , but it takes a long time to thicken one out
16. Just add a spoon full at a time until it's just right
17. After it sits out for a while it might need more
18. Throw in something new and let me know ! i think some beans would go in nicely , or some chili

title: curried lentils and vegetables
steps:
1. Soak the lentils in cold water overnight
2. Combine all ingredients in a pot
3. Bring to a boil , cover and simmer for 30 minutes , or until lentils are tender

title: double dutch mac   cheese with chard
steps:
1. Melt 3 tablespoons butter in large pot over medium heat
2. Add onion
3. Saut until translucent , about 5 minutes
4. Stir in garlic , then flour
5. Stir constantly 1 minute
6. Gradually whisk in milk
7. Cook , whisking occasionally , until mixture begins to boil , about 5 minutes
8. Add 2 cups coarsely grated gouda and 1 cup edam
9. Stir until cheeses melt , about 2 minutes
10. Stir in cayenne and nutmeg
11. Season sauce with salt and pepper
12. Preheat oven to 350f butter 13x9x2- inch baking dish
13. Cook chard in large pot of boiling salted water until tender , about 1 minute
14. Using slotted spoon , transfer chard to plate
15. Cool
16. Reserve pot with water
17. Squeeze water from chard
18. Chop finely
19. Return water in pot to boil
20. Add macaroni
21. Cook until tender but still firm to bite , stirring occasionally
22. Drain
23. Stir macaroni into warm cheese sauce
24. Place half of macaroni in dish
25. Smooth top
26. Top with 1 cup edam cheese , then chard
27. Top with remaining macaroni mixture
28. Spread evenly
29. Melt 3 tablespoons butter
30. Place breadcrumbs in medium bowl
31. Drizzle butter over
32. Toss
33. Add 1 / 2 cup finely grated gouda and sprinkle with salt and pepper
34. Toss
35. Sprinkle breadcrumb mixture over mac and cheese
36. Sprinkle cumin seeds over , if desired
37. Bake mac and cheese until breadcrumbs are golden and edges are bubbling , about 40 minutes
38. Let stand 10 minutes

title: jam swirl muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Grease 10 cups of a 12-cup muffin pan or line with paper liners
3. Combine wet ingredients in medium-sized bowl
4. Add flour , powder , cinnamon and salt
5. Stir until just combined
6. Add jam , mixing lightly and divide evenly among the prepared muffin cups , pouring water into the 2 unused cups
7. Bake in centre of preheated oven for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown
8. Cool in pan

title: hubby s late night thrown together egg salad
steps:
1. Add three eggs to a pan of cold water
2. Bring to a boil
3. Turn temperature down to a simmer
4. Simmer for five minutes
5. While eggs are boiling mix five final ingredients
6. Take eggs off heat
7. Run pan under cold water until eggs are cool enough to touch
8. Drain water from pan
9. Shake eggs in empty pan until shells crack
10. Peel eggs
11. Mash eggs together with vinegar-mayonnaise mixture
12. Eat on whatever bread you prefer

title: jalapeo macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. In a saucepan melt butter
2. Add cream cheese and mix until blended
3. Add heavy cream and whisk
4. Add jalapeo juice and whisk
5. Mix in cheddar , stirring until cheddar is completely melted
6. Add salt , cajun seasoning and flour
7. Whick until all ingredients are completely incorporated
8. Stir in jalapenos
9. Spray loaf pan with pan coating
10. Layer bottom of pan with cooked macaroni
11. Cover with cheddar mixture
12. Add another layer of pasta and cheddar mixture
13. Dust top with bread crumbs
14. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes
15. Uncover and bake for 20 to 30 minutes until brown

title: spicy grain soup
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , cover the barley with 4 cups of water and bring to a boil
2. Cover and simmer over low heat until tender , about 35 minutes
3. Drain
4. Return the barley to the pan and cover
5. Meanwhile , in another medium saucepan , cover the brown rice with 2 cups of water and bring to a boil
6. Cover and simmer over low heat until tender , about 35 minutes
7. Drain the brown rice and add to the barley
8. Meanwhile , in a medium bowl , cover the bulgur with 1 cup of hot water
9. Cover and let stand until the water is absorbed , 10 minutes
10. In a large , heavy pot , heat the olive oil
11. Add the chiles , onion and garlic and cook over moderately high heat , stirring occasionally , until the onion is lightly browned , about 5 minutes
12. Add the broth , tomatoes , cilantro sprigs and allspice and season with 1 tablespoon of salt and a pinch of pepper
13. Bring to a boil , then cover and simmer over low heat for 45 minutes
14. Let cool slightly
15. Puree the soup in a blender and return to the pan
16. Add the mushrooms , black beans , carrot , zucchini and parsnip to the pureed soup and bring to a boil
17. Cover and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes
18. Add the barley , rice and bulgur and season with salt and pepper
19. Ladle the soup into bowls , sprinkle with the pumpkin seeds and chopped cilantro and serve

title: blueberry oatmeal breakfast cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees
2. Grease an 8 inch round baking pan
3. Set aside
4. Combine dry ingredients in large bowl
5. Stir egg , milk and oil in small bowl
6. Add all at once to dry mixture
7. Stir just until moistened
8. Fold in blueberries
9. Spoon into prepared pan
10. Bake 25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
11. Cool in pan 5-10 minutes

title: crispy breadsticks
steps:
1. Combine first 6 ingredients
2. Cut bread halves into 1 / 2-inch-thick slices
3. Place on baking sheets
4. Brush with oil mixture , and sprinkle with cheese
5. Bake at 425 for 7 to 10 minutes or until cheese melts

title: crusty french bread
steps:
1. In mixing bowl , dissolve yeast in 1 / 2 cup water
2. Add sugar , salt , shortening and remaining water
3. Stir until dissolved
4. Add flour and stir until smooth
5. Cover and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour or until doubled
6. Turn on to a floured surface
7. Divide in half
8. Let rest for 10 minutes
9. Roll each half into 10-inch by 8-inch rectangle
10. Roll up from a long side
11. Pinch to seal
12. Place seam side down on greased baking sheets sprinkled with cornmeal
13. Sprinkle the tops with cornmeal
14. Cover and let rise until doubled , about 45 minutes
15. With a very sharp knife , make five diagonal cuts across the top of each loaf
16. Bake at 400 degrees for 20-30 minutes or until lightly browned
17. Cool on wire racks

title: carrabba s italian grill stuffed mushrooms parmigiana
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Wash mushrooms and remove stems
3. Finely chop stems and reserve
4. In a large skillet , melt butter and cook onion , pepperoni , green pepper , garlic , and chopped mushroom stems until tender but not brown
5. Add crackers , parmesan , parsley , salt , oregano , a dash of pepper , and mix well
6. Still in broth
7. Spoon mixture into mushroom caps , heaping tops
8. In a shallow baking pan with 1 / 4-inch water covering bottom of pan , place stuffed mushrooms
9. Bake uncovered about 25 minutes until heated thoroughly

title: double chocolate pudding cookies
steps:
1. Sift together flour , baking soda , sugar and dry pudding mix
2. In a large mixing bowl , with electric mixer , beat butter , brown sugar , vanilla and eggs , until light and fluffy
3. Gradually beat in flour mixture
4. Stir in chocolate morsels and nuts
5. Drop dough by heaping tspfuls onto lightly greased baking sheets
6. Bake in preheated 375 about 10 minutes , or until set
7. Do not overbake
8. Transfer to racks to cool completely immediately

title: wake up sandwiches
steps:
1. Stir cream cheese and milk until smooth stir in corned beef , cheese and eggs
2. Spread on muffins halves
3. Serve cold or put under broiler for 2-3 minutes

title: chicken enchilada casserole oamc
steps:
1. Brown chicken and then mix in onion , corn and garlic
2. Pour 1 / 2 cup sauce in the bottom of both pans
3. Mix remaining 3 cups tomato sauce and 2 taco sauce packets into the chicken pan and let simmer for 5 minutes
4. Tear tortillas and completely cover bottom of pans
5. Layer chicken mixture , cheese and tortillas into the pans about 4 layers
6. Top with remaining cheese

title: stuffed any way you want hamburgers
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except the fillings
2. Shape mixture into 12 thin patties , each about 3 1 / 2-inches in diameter
3. Top each of 6 patties with a filling , spreading to within 1 / 2-inch of the edge
4. Cover with a remaining patty , sealing the edges firmly
5. Broil or grill patties 4-inches from the heat , carefully turning once , to the desired doneness , about 10 minutes
6. Peppy cheese filling: mix all ingredients

title: jolean s hominy and sausage
steps:
1. In a large skillet , brown the sausage and cut into chunks
2. Remove sausage and drain grease but leave drippings in the pan
3. Saute onion and garlic in butter in the same pan with the sausage drippings
4. Add hominy and cook over medium heat stirring frequently , until heated through
5. Sprinkle with salt & pepper to taste
6. Add sausage back to the skillet for about 5-10 minutes , stirring frequently until heated through
7. Serve with big , fluffy biscuits with butter and honey ! yum !
8. Oh , just a

title: pumpkin gingerbread trifle
steps:
1. Prepare and bake gingerbread according to package directions using two greased 9 inch round cake pans
2. Cool completely on wire racks
3. Meanwhile , for pudding , in a large saucepan combine pudding mix and milk
4. Stir until smooth
5. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil
6. Cook and stir 1-2 minutes longer , or until thickened
7. Remove from heat and cool to room temperature
8. Combine pumpkin and brown sugar and stir into pudding
9. In a 4-quart glass serving bowl or trifle dish crumble one gingerbread cake and gently press down
10. Top with half of pudding mixture and half of whipped topping
11. Repeat layers
12. Cover and refrigerate overnight

title: loaded potato salad
steps:
1. Boil potatoes in slightly salted water for about 20 minutes until fork tender in thickest part
2. In a large bowl mix ranch with sour cream and mayo and refrigerate
3. When potatoes are al dente , remove from heat and drain ,
4. Place drained potatoes in bowl with ranch mixture and carefully turn to coat
5. Sprinkle bacon bits , green onion and cheese over the top and gently combine through the entire mixture
6. Serve slightly warm or chill for later

title: bread dough 101
steps:
1. Heat water to 100f and add to mixing bowl
2. Add yeast and mix with a whisk to dissolve
3. Add oil and salt and 1 cup of flour
4. Whisk to combine well
5. Add remaining flour and dough hook
6. Mix on low speed until dough is proper consistency and pulls away from sides of bowl
7. Add additional flour if necessary
8. Remove from bowl and transfer to oiled bowl and coat dough with oil
9. Let rise until doubled
10. Form into what ever you desire to make and let rise again
11. Bake at 350f to 425 for 20 to 30 minutes the higher the heat the faster it bakes and the harder the crust
12. Variations:
13. Finer cake like dough for like rolls , use the egg and milk
14. Sweet dough for like coffee cake or sweet rolls , use the sugar , egg and milk

title: tomato mozzarella bread  bread machine
steps:
1. Place ingredients in the bread machine in order given directed by for your machine
2. Set crust to light and bake on white bread

title: cloud nine brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f grease 8" square pan
2. Melt butter with 2 / 3 cup vanilla chips in top of double boiler over low heat , stirring constantly until smooth
3. Remove from heat
4. Set aside
5. In larger bowl of electric mixer , beat eggs , sugar , and salt at high speed until very pale and thick , about 5 minutes
6. Blend in melted mixture and vanilla at low speed
7. Mix in flour until combined
8. Stir in remaining vanilla chips and cappuccino chips
9. Spread mixture into prepared pan
10. Bake 35-40 minutes or until toothpick inserted into center comes out almost clean
11. Top will be crusty and browned
12. Cover pan with foil if browning too quickly
13. Cool before cutting into squares

title: crockpot easiest ever chuck roast
steps:
1. That's it ! mix them all up and spread over roast with water on bottom of crockpot
2. Cook all day on low
3. You'll be amazed
4. Add vegetables of your choice the last hour or two
5. (i do use name brand dry soups

title: lamb tagine with cinnamon  saffron and dried fruit
steps:
1. Combine anaheim chili , cumin , coriander , ginger , salt , paprika , ground peppercorns and garlic
2. Heat a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium-high heat
3. Add lamb
4. Cook 8 minutes on all sides or until browned
5. Remove lamb from pan
6. Add onion to pan
7. Cook 5 minutes or until tender , stirring frequently
8. Stir in half of chili mixture and tomato puree
9. Cook 3 minutes , stirring occasionally
10. Stir in lamb and water
11. Bring to a boil
12. Reduce heat
13. Simmer 5 minutes
14. Wrap handle of skillet with foil , and bake , covered , at 325 degrees for 1 hour
15. Stir in bell pepper , squash , carrot , saffron and cinnamon
16. Cover and bake an additional 15 minutes
17. Stir in remaining chili mixture and apricots
18. Cover and bake an additional 15 minutes
19. Remove cinnamon stick
20. Serve tagine over couscous
21. Sprinkle with cilantro

title: crab blt salad magnifico
steps:
1. Stir together mayo , mustard , old bay seasoning , hot-pepper sauce , salt and lemon juice in a large bowl
2. Add crab , tomato , bacon and scallion
3. Toss to mix
4. Cover , refrigerate
5. Make bed of spinach leaves and serve on top

title: eggnog fudge
steps:
1. Line a 9 inch square pan with aluminum foil and set aside
2. Spray sides of a large saucepan with butter flavored nonstick cooking spray
3. Bring egg nog and sugar to a rolling boil at medium heat stirring constantly with a wooden spoon
4. Let boil for two minutes exactly with heat turned down to the lowest setting that will maintain the boil
5. Stir occasionally to keep the mixture from boiling over or burning
6. Fold in marshmallows , cinnamon and nutmeg
7. The boil will probably stop until the marshmallows completely dissolve
8. Bring mixture back to a rolling boil for another 6 full minutes
9. Stir constantly
10. The mixture will start to turn brown during the boil
11. If you get brown flakes in the mixture , reduce heat a little
12. Remove from heat and add butter , chips and nuts
13. Stir until thoroughly mixed or until fudge starts to lose its glossy appearance
14. Pour into prepared pan
15. Sprinkle with nutmeg
16. Cool at room temperature
17. Remove from pan , remove foil and cut into 1 inch squares
18. Store in an airtight container

title: spinach mushroom souffle roll
steps:
1. Line a 15 x 10 x 1" baking pan with foil , extending foil 1" beyond edges of pan
2. Grease and lightly flour
3. Set aside melt the butter
4. Stir in the 1 / 2 cup flour , salt , and pepper
5. Add milk all at once
6. Cook and stir till thickened and bubbly
7. Cook and stir 1 minute more
8. Remove from heat beat the egg yolks till thick and lemon colored
9. Slowly stir thickened milk mixture and parmesan cheese into beaten egg yolks
10. Using clean beaters , beat egg whites and cream of tartar till stiff peaks form
11. Fold a small amount of the beaten egg whites into egg yolk mix
12. Fold egg yolk mixture into remaining egg whites
13. Spread in prepared pan
14. Bake in a 375f oven about 20 minutes
15. While that's cooking cook the frozen chopped spinach and squeeze it dry
16. Meanwhile , cook the mushrooms and onion in 1 tbs butter till tender but not browned
17. Stir in the spinach , softened cream cheese , dijon mustard and nutmeg
18. Heat through , stirring occasional
19. Immediately loosen the souffl from pan when puffed and slightly set
20. Turn out onto foil
21. Spread spinach mushroom filling over souffle to within 1 / 2" of the edge
22. Use foil to start rolling up souffl jelly roll style , beginning with one of the short sides
23. Slice
24. Serve immediately

title: the green drink
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients in blender
2. Easy !

title: very chocolate cake kids can make in 1 pan carrie sheridan
steps:
1. Sift together dry ingredients [pressing through a fine sieve is fine] into a 9 inch square pan
2. Blend
3. Make 3 holes with a spoon and add oil into 1st , the vinegar in the 2nd and vanilla in the 3rd
4. Pour 1 cup cold water over all and whisk vigorously
5. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes
6. [325 for a glass pan]
7. Let cool and frost
8. Vanilla frosting: heat 2-3 tbs of cream and let cool
9. Blend with with softened butter and powdered sugar to taste
10. Add a splash of vanilla
11. Easy chocolate frosting: melt butter and semisweet chocolate morsels [in a bowl over a pan of hot water
12. Remove , add powdered sugar and vanilla
13. Refrigerate
14. Whip with a mixer to add air and lighten - then frost cake

title: grilled mexican style corn
steps:
1. Set out the sour cream , cheese , and corn , and let each person fix his own
2. Heat grill to medium high
3. Place 1 cup sour cream or creme fraiche in a small bowl and sprinkle with 1 / 8 teaspoon cayenne pepper
4. Set aside
5. Grate 2 cups cheese into a small bowl
6. Set aside
7. Grill corn until tender , about 15 minutes , turn frequently
8. Remove from grill
9. When cool enough to handle , pull back husks and remove silk
10. Brush corn with sour cream and roll in cheese

title: fruit cake  fresh fruit in the shape of a cake
steps:
1. Lay watermelon on its side
2. With a large , non-serrated , sharp butcher knife , cut both ends off to form straight edges
3. Turn watermelon so that it is sitting flat-sides up and down
4. Carefully trim the rhind off , so it resembles the smooth , straight curve of a round cake
5. Arrange pineapple , strawberries and kiwi however you wish atop the cake and around the bottom
6. If it is being prepared ahead of time , leave the tops on the strawberries to preserve their freshness
7. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve
8. The best way i found to serve it was for our guests to pluck their fruit of choice off the "cake" while i sliced chunks of watermelon as requested

title: indian style omelet my mom s version
steps:
1. Preheat a small nonstick skillet and spread lightly with oil
2. In a small bowl , whip the eggs , add 2 tablespoons water and whip until fluffy
3. Add in coconut , onion , red chili flakes and salt to taste
4. Continue to mix until all ingredients are blended
5. As soon as the skillet is hot , pour in the egg mixture
6. Cook as you would a traditional omelet , making sure that the underside is browned
7. Flip over and continue cooking until the omelet is well done
8. Serve hot and enjoy !

title: lemon vanilla custard pie w  brandied whipped cream
steps:
1. Mix french vanilla pudding mix with 1 / 4 cup cream , 1 cup milk , vanilla , and lemon curd
2. Mix with wire whisk until well combined
3. Pour into prepared pie crust and put in refrigerator 5 minutes or until set
4. Meanwhile , cook coconut pudding mix , 1 / 4 cup cream , 1 cup milk , and vanilla over medium high heat for 2 minutes stirring constantly until slightly thickened
5. Fold in whipped cream and spread on top of vanilla layer
6. Set up in refrigerator for another 5 minutes
7. Meanwhile , whip together 1 pint whipping cream , comfections sugar , and brady with electric mixer until it forms stiff peaks like mernigue
8. Spread over top and set in refrigerator for 5 minutes to 1 hour to set
9. Slice and enjoy ! store leftovers in refrigerator

title: flounder francaise or chicken francaise
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat the oil and 1 tablespoons of butter over medium heat
2. Place the flour and all the seasonings in a plastic bag and shake to blend
3. Place the beaten eggs in a shallow dish
4. When the skillet is good and hot , put the flounder fillets in the bag one at a time and then dip in the egg
5. Coat them completely with the egg and place in skillet
6. The egg should sizzle immediately
7. If it doesn't , the oil isn't hot enough
8. Save 1 tablespoon of the flour mixture for the sauce
9. Fry over medium heat until brown on both sides , about 3 to 4 minutes per side
10. Add extra butter if you need to
11. Remove from skillet , keep warm
12. Discard any oil left in skillet and add the butter and the 1 tbsp of seasoned flour reserved from the flounder
13. Whisk until smooth
14. Add the rest of the sauce ingredients , stirring constantly until well blended
15. Bring to boil and cook 5 minutes , stirring frequently
16. If the sauce thickens too much , add more water- just 1 tsp at a time until you achieve the desired consistency
17. To serve place flounder over a bed of buttered rice and pour a little sauce over each fillet
18. Garnish with lemon slices and parsley

title: diabetic bran muffins
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine flour , baking powder , soda and salt
2. Stir well
3. Push up around sides of bowl making well in cetner
4. In another bowl stir buttermilk with bran
5. Let stand 5 minutes
6. Add remining ingredients to bran mixture in order given
7. Beat with spoon until mixd
8. Pour into well in flour mixture and stir to moisten
9. Batter will be lumpy
10. Fill greased muffin cups 3 / 4 full
11. Bake at 375 for 20-25 minutes
12. Let stand 5 minutes
13. Remove from pan

title: sour cream chicken bake
steps:
1. Cook chicken to your liking and cool
2. Separate or cut chicken into bite size pieces , layering them in an ungreased 8x10 or medium casserole dish
3. Salt light lightly if desired
4. Combine sour cream and undiluted soup in a small bowl , and spread over chicken
5. In a separate bowl microwave or otherwise melt butter and crush crackers into it , stirring to coat
6. Layer buttered crumbs on top of sour cream / soup mixture
7. Bake at 350f for one hour or till bubbly
8. If you like you may broil the top till more browned , but watch carefully !
9. Serve hot and enjoy !

title: peach blackberry pie ice cream
steps:
1. Combine the peaches , blackberries , lemon juice and 3 / 4 c sugar in a bowl
2. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour , stirring every 15 minutes
3. Whisk the eggs in a mixing bowl until light and fluffy , 1 to 2 minutes
4. Slowly whisk in 3 / 4 cup of sugar until completely blended
5. Remove the fruit mixture from the fridge , drain the juice into another bowl and set aside
6. Return fruit to the fridge
7. Add the juice mixture , cream , milk and cinnamon to eggs and whisk to blend completely
8. Pour into your ice cream maker and freeze according to the ice maker's directions
9. When the ice cream is almost frozen add the fruit and continue freezing until it is ready

title: norwegian coleslaw
steps:
1. Shred cabbage and toss with salt
2. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours
3. Meanwhile , in a saucepan heat the sugar , vinegar , and seeds , simmering 10 minutes
4. Cool completely
5. Add to the cabbage along with the remaining vegetables
6. Cover and refrigerate at least 24 hours before serving
7. Keeps 4-6 weeks in the refrigerator

title: spanish chicken salad
steps:
1. Dice the potatoes
2. Boil until just tender , then rinse in cold water
3. Blanch the asparagus spears in boiling water for 2 minutes
4. Drain and rinse with cold water
5. Cut into 2-inch pieces
6. Chop the red pepper
7. Slice the radishes and olives
8. In a large bowl , toss together the chicken , salami , potatoes , pepper , peas , radishes and olives
9. In a smaller bowl , whisk together the sherry , olive oil , vinegar and pepper
10. Pour over salad and chill
11. To serve: slice the red onion
12. Chop the hard boiled eggs and fold into the chicken mixture
13. Line salad bowls with boston lettuce leaves and fill with the chicken salad
14. Garnish with asparagus spears , chopped parsley and red onion rings

title: tomatoes au gratin
steps:
1. Skin the tomatoes by putting them into a bowl , adding boiling water and leaving them for 20 seconds , drain and plunge them into cold water , the skins should come off easily
2. Slice the tomatoes thinly
3. Grease a baking dish well with some butter , arrange a layer of tomato slices evenly on the bottom of the dish and then sprinkle with some of the garlic , sugar , basil , salt and pepper
4. Add a thin layer of cream and repeat with more tomato sllice layers until all ingredients are used
5. Mix the parmesan cheese and the breadcrumbs together and srinkle over the top
6. Drizzle any remaining butter over the top
7. Bake in the oven at 189 c for 40 minutes until golden brown
8. Serve hot

title: thanksgiving turkey in a crock pot  with sage and bacon
steps:
1. Spray 5 to 6 quart slow cooker with cooking spray
2. Place turkey in cooker
3. Sprinkle with garlic pepper
4. Place potatoes and carrots around turkey
5. Mix bacon , gravy , flour , sage and worcestershire sauce in small bowl
6. Pour over turkey and vegetables
7. Cover and cook on low setting for 7 to 8 hours
8. Remove turkey and vegetables , and thicken gravy as necessary with cornstarch or flour
9. Dig in !

title: chipotles  smoked jalapenos
steps:
1. Fire up any kind of smoker: dry , water , electric , side or stovetop
2. Keep heat very low , under 230 degrees if possible
3. Stem your peppers , but don't seed them
4. Place peppers in a single layer on the grate
5. Using pecan or another wood according to your taste , bring up a good dense smoke
6. Keep the smoke as dense as possible , while keeping a very close eye on the heat
7. When using a stovetop smoker , after bringing the smoker up to temperature and producing smoke , reduce the heat to low
8. The process will take a lot longer but you won't cook your peppers
9. Check them every hour or so
10. They're ready when they have shrivelled up and look like dark leather
11. I just put mine in a canning jar , put on the lid and keep them in the cupboard
12. They keep nearly forever , if they are smoked through
13. If you want to pack them in adobo , this is a good recipe: #140353 adobo de chile [url]

title: spring mix strawberry asparagus salad
steps:
1. In a bowl , toss the asparagus with 1 tablespoon oil
2. Spread in a single layer in a greased 15x10-inch baking pan
3. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
4. Bake at 400f for 15-20 minutes or until tender
5. In a large salad bowl , toss greens , strawberries , onions , pecans and asparagus
6. In a small bowl , whisk the vinegar , sugar and remaining oil
7. Drizzle over the salad and toss to coat

title: honey spice oatmeal cookie mix   gift in a jar
steps:
1. To make mix:
2. In large bowl , combine flour , ginger , cinnamon , baking soda , salt , cloves and nutmeg
3. Mix well
4. Add oats
5. Mix well
6. Transfer to resealable plastic bag , an unbreakable decorative jar with lid or other airtight container
7. Store in cool dry place
8. A quart canning jar is most commonly used
9. If using a jar , cut out a square or circle of pretty fabric with pinking shears and place over jar lid , tie with a pretty ribbon or raffia
10. Attach a gift tag with the following mixing and baking instructions:
11. :
12. 1 / 2 pound butter , softened
13. 3 / 4 cup honey
14. 1 large egg
15. In a large bowl , beat butter and honey with electric mixer until creamy
16. Add egg
17. Beat well
18. Add half of cookie mix
19. Beat well
20. Add remaining cookie mix
21. Beat well
22. Divide dough into thirds
23. Place each on a piece of plastic wrap and flatten to 1 / 2-inch thickness
24. Wrap tightly
25. Chill at least 4 hours
26. Heat oven to 350f remove one portion of dough from refrigerator
27. Shape dough into 1-inch balls
28. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets
29. Flatten to 1 / 8-inch thickness with bottom of glass dipped in granulated sugar
30. Repeat with remaining dough
31. Bake 5 to 7 minutes , just until centers are set
32. Cool 1 minute on cookie sheets
33. Remove to wire rack
34. Cool completely
35. Store tightly covered

title: grandma d s chicken noodle soup
steps:
1. Cook chicken about 1 hour in a large pot of boiling water
2. Add chopped celery , onions , and parsley
3. Cook for 30 minutes
4. Add chopped carrots and potatoes
5. Cook for 15 minutes-20 minutes
6. Add chicken bouillon powder
7. Strain and set chicken and vegetables aside
8. Cook egg noodles in broth
9. Add chicken and vegetables back to water and noodles

title: chocolate cherry bars
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f
2. Spray an 8x8-inch baking pan with nonstick cooking spray
3. In a medium saucepan , melt the margarine
4. Add the sugar and stir until smooth and slightly cooled , 2 minutes
5. Blend in the egg
6. Add the cocoa , vanilla , baking powder , and baking soda
7. Stir until the cocoa is fully incorporated , 1 minute
8. Add the flour and stir just until smooth , 1 minute
9. Spread the batter in the prepared baking pan and top evenly with pie filling
10. Bake until the top becomes slightly crusty , 8 to 10 minutes , then sprinkle on the chocolate chips
11. Bake until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean with a few moist crumbs , about 8-10 minutes

title: hill country peach custard pie
steps:
1. Beat the eggs
2. Add the sugar and milk and beat well
3. Add the peaches and stir
4. Pour into the pie crust and bake at 450 for 10 minutes
5. Turn oven down to 375 and bake for another 45-55 minutes , or until tests clean

title: african mango fool
steps:
1. Heat the milk in a double boiler , or in a saucepan over low heat
2. Do not boil
3. In a bowl , mix the 1 / 4-1 / 2 cup of sugar into the beaten eggs
4. Slowly add about a quarter of the heated milk to the egg / sugar mixture , while stirring constantly
5. Slowly stir the egg / sugar / milk mixture into the remaining heated milk
6. Cook on low heat , until it thickens into a custard , stirring gently and continuously
7. Spoon it into a clean bowl and place in the refrigerator to cool
8. While the custard is cooling , cook the fruit:
9. Bring the water and three tablespoons of sugar to a boil in a saucepan
10. Add mango pieces
11. Reduce heat and cook until tender , five to ten minutes , stirring occasionally
12. Mash mango , or press it through a sieve
13. Scoop it into a clean bowl and place in the refrigerator to cool
14. To serve:
15. Gently fold together custard and fruit
16. Spoon into serving bowls
17. Top with whipped cream , if desired
18. Serve immediately or keep in refrigerator for no more than a day
19. Fold into whipped cream
20. Chill and serve

title: cheddar and blue cheese cajun noodles
steps:
1. Cook noodles according to package directions
2. Drain
3. While noodles are cooking , mix together blue cheese dressing , cheddar cheese , and cajun seasoning
4. Microwave for 30 seconds or so to form a sauce
5. Add noodles to sauce
6. Stir

title: easter cakes
steps:
1. Rub butter and flour together , add sugar and aniseed , stir in beaten eggs ,
2. Add the custard powder and the coconut
3. Knead and divide into 6
4. Form into 6 long ropes and
5. Place each on a tray , forming a circle , like a ring , and place a boiled egg at each end , where the dough meets
6. If you have kids , they can each decorate the eggs or paint them with food colouring
7. Cut 2 strips of the pastry , and place on the egg like an x
8. Bake in the oven for 45 minutes

title: crab portabella mushrooms
steps:
1. Gently scoop out inside of mushroom caps
2. Bake mushroom caps at 350 for 4-6 minutes to soften
3. Set aside
4. Mix the creme cheese , crabmeat , celery and old bay together
5. Spoon over mushroom caps and sprinkle with grated cheese
6. Broil six inches from heat source for 4 - 6 minutes
7. Watch carefully
8. Serve immediately

title: vanilla butter cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Cream butter and sugar
3. Add egg , vanilla , and almond extract , if using , and beat well
4. Mix in flour
5. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto parchment-lined cookie sheet and bake 10-12 minutes

title: party bruschetta
steps:
1. Slice baguette into 1 / 2" slices on an angle
2. Pour olive oil into a shallow bowl , like a small cereal bowl
3. Dip each slice into the olive oil and place on a cookie sheet
4. Holding your hand very high , dust a tiny amount of kosher salt over the bruschetta
5. Cut the roma tomatoes in quarters and remove all of the seeds
6. Then dice them into 1 / 4" pieces
7. Sprinkle the diced tomato on the bruschetta
8. There should be no more than 4-5 pieces of tomato on each
9. Put no more than 2-3 pieces of basil on each bruschetta
10. Dust each piece with shredded parmesan cheese if desired
11. Broil for just a minute or two , watching carefully
12. They can go from just right to burnt in a flash !

title: pap  potatoes and cornmeal
steps:
1. Peel potatoes and dice
2. Put potatoes , water , salt , and oil in a pot and cook at a medium heat with the lid on until the potatoes are soft enough to mash
3. Mash the potatoes in the pot
4. Stir in the cornmeal and cook the pap for about 15 minutes until done
5. It's good to use a wooden spoon to mix the pap every 5 minutes
6. Serve hot and enjoy the pap with chakalaka

title: delicious pot roast
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Rub roast with black pepper
3. Heat olive oil in a heavy flameproof casserole or dutch oven and sear roast for several minutes on each side , browning well
4. Pour in stock and wine and add parsley , 1-teaspoon salt , 1-teaspoon black pepper and the whole cloves
5. Stir in onions , carrots , potatoes , tomatoes and celery
6. Liquid in casserole should just cover vegetables
7. Add additional beef stock if necessary
8. Bring to a simmer on top of the stove , cover and bake in center of oven for 2 hours
9. Uncover and cook longer , until meat is tender , about 1- hours , basting frequently
10. Transfer roast to a deep serving platter and arrange vegetables around it
11. Spoon a bit of sauce over all and garnish the platter with parsley
12. Pass additional sauce in a gravy boat

title: bohemian sauerkraut
steps:
1. Rinse sauerkraut in warm water and drain well
2. Place in a heavy saucepan with caraway seeds , berries , butter , and chopped onions
3. Cover pan tightly and simmer over lowest heat 15 to 30 minutes
4. Add pepper , water and white wine and cook 30 to 90 minutes longer depending on how soft you like your kraut

title: instant candy bar s mores
steps:
1. Unwrap candy bar
2. Place 1 graham cracker square on a plate
3. Sandwich candy bar between both graham cracker squares
4. Microwave 15 to 30 seconds
5. The candy shouldn't melt down too much in the microwave , but it should get warm enough so that when you remove it from the microwave and press down , the chocolate will "squish"

title: sinfully easy one bowl brownies
steps:
1. Heat the oven to 350
2. Grease the bottom only of a square pan 8x8 x 2 "
3. Heat margarine and 6oz semi sweet chocolate in microwave at 50% power , until melted
4. Remove from heat
5. Stir in the remaining ingredients with a wooden spoon until smooth
6. Stir in chocolate chips
7. Spread in pan with a rubber scraper
8. Bake until the center is set , about 30-35 minutes
9. Let brownies cool completely , then cut into 2x2 inch brownies
10. Store brownies tightly covered

title: kielbasa and potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Using mandolin , slice potatoes and place in 11x13 baking dish or pan
3. Mince onion finely and scatter throughout the potatoes
4. Add as much garlic as you want
5. I tend to use a heaping tbs of the jarred minced garlic
6. Lay a few pats of butter or margarine on top of the potatoes / onion mixture
7. Next cut kielbasa into bite-size pieces and completely cover the bottom layer
8. You may have to overlap some of the pieces
9. Cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes
10. After 30 minutes , remove foil and continue baking

title: mrs  vi s dill dip
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Refrigerate several hours before serving with such things as chips , cucumber slices , carrot sticks , celery , cauliflower , and broccoli

title: christmas cookie   cookies puffs
steps:
1. Boil the two whole eggs , cool and peel
2. Remove the yolks and press through a seive so it is fine ground
3. Eat the cooked whites for your lunch or snack-- !
4. Cream shortening and 1 / 2 cup of the granulated sugar
5. Add beaten egg yolk
6. Cream very well
7. Add the sieved egg yolks and blend
8. Add the orange zest and blend
9. Sift the dry ingredients and the other 1 / 2 cup of granulated sugar together
10. Cut the dry ingredients into the creamed ingredients
11. Add the almonds
12. Shape into walnut size balls
13. Dip into slightly frothy egg white
14. Roll into extra granulated sugar
15. Bake in preheated oven 350f for 16- 18 minutes , until golden on bottoms
16. Can dredge in icing powder if desired

title: family palachinka recipe
steps:
1. First you will make the filling
2. Mix 2 48 oz
3. Small curd cottage cheese , 1 cup sugar , 1 8 oz
4. Philadelphia cream cheese , and 8 egg yolks together to make the filling
5. Next you will make the batter
6. Beat 5 eggs until frothy
7. Add in 1 quart milk
8. Pour in 1 cup sugar
9. Add 2 3 / 4 cups flour
10. Grease 9-inch frying pan with butter
11. Pour 1 / 2 cup batter into heated 9-inch frying pan and make a thin pancake
12. This will cook quickly
13. Next you will construct the crpes and fill them
14. Fill crpes with the filling carefully
15. You don't want too little filling and you don't want too much
16. I suggest anywhere from 1 / 2 to 3 / 4 cups filling
17. Roll the crpe carefully so as not to spill any filling
18. Place crpes in glass pan for cooking
19. Now add topping
20. Combine 16 oz
21. Sour cream , 1 cup sugar , 4 egg whites , and 1 egg
22. Mix and pour over rolled crpes
23. Finally you will cook and chill
24. Cook for 1 hour at 350f
25. Once done , chill for about 1 hour or until cold
26. If it happens to be winter , it works well to wrap the pan in foil and put on a table

title: easy grilled chicken teriyaki
steps:
1. Place chicken , teriyaki sauce , lemon juice , garlic , and sesame oil in a large resealable plastic bag
2. Seal bag , and shake to coat
3. Place in refrigerator for 24 hours , turning every so often
4. Preheat grill for high heat
5. Lightly oil the grill grate
6. Remove chicken from bag , discarding any remaining marinade
7. Grill for 6 to 8 minutes each side , or until juices run clear when chicken is pierced with a fork

title: chicken pot roast with mushrooms
steps:
1. Marinate the chicken with all the ingredients except the onions and the mushrooms for 1 hour spread the onions in a pot put the mushrooms on top of them then place the chicken on the veges cook on sim for till chicken is done keep checking if there is enough liquid as the onions should not burn they will caramalise and form a sauce with the musrooms if there is a dearth of liquid in the vessel put a tblsp of water at a time just enough to keep the dish from burning if there is a lot of liquid that remains at the end of the cooking time then keep the vessel uncovered and the gas on full till all the liquid evaporates
2. Serve hot in a plate with the sauce poured on top of the chicken

title: brenda s best blueberry yogurt pound cake
steps:
1. In a large bowl , cream butter until fluffy
2. Beat in sugar until light and fluffy
3. Beat in eggs , one at a time
4. In a second bowl sift together flour , baking soda and salt
5. In a third bowl mix together yogurt , orange juice and rind
6. Alternately add dry and wet mixture to the creamed mixture , making 3 additions of dry and 2 of wet
7. Stir in blueberries
8. Pour batter into well greased and floured 9" or 10" tube or bundt pan
9. Tap pan lightly to release air bubbles and smooth top
10. Bake at 350f for 60-70 minutes or until knife comes out clean
11. Let cool for 15 minutes in pan , the remove and cool on rack
12. Before serving , sieve icing sugar over top

title: fragrant beef curry
steps:
1. Heat 2 tablespooons of the oil in a large casserole dish and brown the beef on all sides
2. Set aside , add 1 1 / 4 cups cold water to the dih and scrape the bottom of the pan with a wooden spoon
3. Retain these juices
4. Heat the remaining oil and cook the onion and chili peppers for 5 mins until soft
5. Add the curry paste and turn up the heat for 2 mins or until the onion is going a light brown in colour
6. Return the beef to the pan along with the beef juices , coconut milk and broth
7. Cook , uncovered , over a very gentle heat for 1 1 / 2 hours so that it is barely simmering and the beef becomes tender
8. If the coconut milk boils it will split so keep an eye on it
9. Once the beef is quite tender , add the sweet potatoes and cook for 20 mins or until they are soft
10. Season with the fish sauce and soy sauce
11. Sprinkle with cashew nuts and cilantro and serve with a bowl of rice on the side

title: chocolate truffle cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees
2. Mix crust ingredients together and press into the bottom of a 9 inch springform pan
3. Melt the chocolate chips , making sure that they are very smooth
4. In a large bowl , beat cream cheese until fluffy
5. Gradually beat in condensed milk until smooth
6. Add melted chocolate , eggs , and vanilla
7. Beat on low speed until the ingredients are thoroughly blended
8. Pour the filling into the prepared crust
9. Bake at 300 degrees for 55 minutes

title: quick   easy eggplant parmesan in the microwave
steps:
1. Peel eggplant
2. Cut into 1 / 8" slices
3. In bowl combine tomato paste , water and tomatoes
4. Mix well
5. Add oregano and basil , spread sauce on bottom of 2-qt casserole
6. Layer half of eggplant , more sauce , and half the mozzarella cheese
7. Repeat layers
8. Finish by sprinkling paremsan cheese on top
9. Cover casserole
10. Place in microwave and cook on high 14 minutes , turning dish once after 7 minute if your microwave does not rotate
11. Make sure cheese has melted
12. Serves 4
13. To freeze: label casserole and freeze up to 2 months
14. To thaw: thaw and place in microwave on high for 7 minutes

title: mimi s  if you give a moose a muffin
steps:
1. Cream the butter and brown sugar in a bowl
2. Add the eggs and sour cream
3. Beat well
4. Stir in the carrots , coconut and raisins
5. Add the flour , baking soda , and cinnamon and stir till moistened
6. Fold in nuts
7. Fill muffin tins till three-quarters full
8. Bake at 375 degrees for 20-25 minutes or till done
9. Cool for 5 minutes before removing from pan to a wire rack
10. Serve warm

title: pie filling from frozen sweet cherries
steps:
1. Reserve about 1 / 2 cup juice and mix the cornstarch in it
2. Mix sugar with cherries and juices and cook till bubbling
3. Stir constantly if cooking on stove stop
4. In the microwave i cook at 5 minute intervals and stir in between
5. Add the reserved juice / cornstarch mixture and stir to mix
6. Cook for about 3 minutes until thickened
7. Cool and use in your favorite pie crust

title: seafood crab sticks with chilli sauce
steps:
1. Sift flour and soda into bowl and gradually add water and mix to a smooth thin batter of coating consistency
2. Dipped thawed crab / seafood sticks into batter and then drop into hot oil and fry until golden brown and then drain on absorbent paper
3. Serve hot with chilli sauce as a dipping sauce
4. Chilli sauce - combine all ingredients in a small saucepan , stir over a gentle heat until heated through

title: pork with spiced fruit sauce
steps:
1. Cook pork i cut the tenderloin into 1" chops , and used my flavour wave to cook them at 400 degrees for approximately 15 minutes , but you can cook them using whatever method you would like
2. Mean while i added fruit to a pan
3. These were just what i happened to have
4. Stir in 1 / 2 of the juice saving the rest to mix with cornstarch
5. Heat , then add pepper flakes , and cinnamon
6. I added more than i have suggested but as they say you can always add but can not take away
7. Mix remaining juice with cornstarch until bubbling
8. Add more sauce with the cornstarch if you prefer it to have extra juice
9. By this time the pork should be done
10. I could not find a recipe so just put it together
11. Spoon sauce over pork , and serve with your favourite side dishes
12. I served it with baked potato , and corn that i cut off the cob

title: ground beef and wild rice casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350'
2. Butter well a 2 quart or larger casserole dish
3. In a skillet add ground beef and onions and brown until meat is no longer pink
4. Drain off fat
5. While beef is browning , prepare rice mix as directed except omit butter
6. When most of the liquid is cooked down and rice is becoming tender , remove from heat and stir into meat mixture
7. Add soup , milk , pepper and 1 cup cheese and blend well
8. Transfer to 2 qt baking dish , bake uncovered 20-25 minutes or until bubbly and heated through
9. Top with remaining 1 / 2 cup cheese and bake another 5-10 minutes or until cheese melts and turns bubbly

title: scottish borders rumbledethumps
steps:
1. Heat the oven to 350f
2. Peel potatoes and cut into coarse chunks
3. Remove any tougfh outer leaves and the core from the cabbage , and finely slice the leaves
4. Cook the potatoes in a large pan of simmering salted water for 10 minutes , then add the cabbage and cook until both are tender , but not overly soft , about 10 more minutes
5. Now add the green onions for the last minute of cooking
6. Drain well
7. Add the butter , half and half , and most of the cheeses , leaving a little to sprinkle over the top later
8. Mash well , seasoning with salt and pepper
9. You may serve it at this stage , sprinkled with the rest of the cheese
10. Or , if you like , pour it all into a buttered baking dish , sprinkle with the remaining cheese , and bake until lightly browned and steaming hot , 25-30 minutes !
11. If you want to make this a main dish , fry the eggs to your liking and place on top of each serving
12. Now you're feeling better
13. Enjoy !

title: plum conserve penn  dutch
steps:
1. Wash oranges , remove seeds and grind
2. Pit the plums and cut in quarters
3. Combine the oranges and plums and add the sugar and raisins
4. Simmer about 1-1 / 2 hours
5. Add the walnuts and cook about 45 minutes longer
6. Pour into sterilized jars and seal
7. Source: pennsylvania dutch cook book- fine old recipes , culinary arts press , 1936

title: corn and tomato salad
steps:
1. Remove corn kernels from cob
2. Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat
3. Add garlic and saute 1 minute
4. Add corn and saute for an additional 5 minutes
5. Add 1 / 4 c of basil and transfer mixture to a large bowl
6. Cool slightly
7. Stir in tomatoes , balsamic vinegar , and the remaining olive oil and basil
8. Season with salt and pepper
9. Chill for 3-8 hours before serving

title: cabbage braised in butter
steps:
1. In a skillet on medium heat , melt the butter and add the cabbage wedges
2. Cook 5 minutes , until browned on one side
3. Turn the wedges over and cover the pan
4. Cook 10 minutes , until tender and browned a bit
5. Just before serving , very lightly season with salt

title: spiced dates with mascarpone cheese
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , bring the wine to a simmer
2. Add the dates and poach until the skins blister
3. With a slotted spoon , lift out the dates and , while warm , remove and discard the skins
4. Cut open the dates on one long side , remove the pits and place two almonds in the center of each date
5. Fold closed
6. To the wine , add the honey , peppercorns , cloves , orange zest , allspice , cinnamon sticks and bay leaf
7. Continue simmering until the wine is reduced by half , about 20 minutes
8. Strain wine into a clean saucepan
9. Add the dates to the wine and heat gently , over a medium low heat , until warmed through , but not hot , then remove from heat
10. To serve , place a dollop of mascarpone in the center of each of four plates
11. Spoon two dates and a little wine sauce on each plate , sprinkle lightly with sea salt and serve

title: peanut butter and banana walnut breakfast strata
steps:
1. Make "peanut butter and banana" sandwiches with the bread , peanut butter , and bananas
2. Place in a 9x9 inch baking dish
3. Don't be afraid to cut in half or crunch together to make them fit in all areas of the pan
4. Sprinkle mixture with the toasted walnuts and butter chunks
5. Place softened mascarpone cheese in a large bowl
6. In a separate bowl , mix together eggs , egg yolks , milk , cream , cinnamon , vanilla , and salt
7. Add egg mixture to to the cheese mixture in small scoops
8. Whisk well after each scoop
9. This will help incorporate the cheese with the eggs to build a smooth custard
10. Repeat this process until all ingredients are incorporated and a thick pretty custard is the result
11. Pour the custard over the peanut butter and banana sandwiches
12. Press a bit to ensure that all pieces of bread are covered
13. Refrigerate for a few hours or up to overnight to ensure the flavors melt together
14. You can also freeze this mixture for a future purposes sealed well in foil and plastic
15. Bake mixture at 350 degrees for about 40 minutes
16. I like to keep it covered in foil for the first 30 minutes and remove the foil at the end to allow the top to brown
17. Serve with -- well -- whatever you want ! i'm not a big fan of super sweet breakfasts , so i will eat this plain
18. My friends and family will sprinkle powdered sugar or add butter & maple syrup

title: dad s carrot cake
steps:
1. Cake
2. Combine all cake ingredients in a large mixing bowl & beat for 2 minutes
3. Then fold in the grated carrots
4. Pour into a greased & lightly floured rectangular cake pan
5. Bake at 350f for 35-45 minutes
6. Icing
7. In a medium mixing bowl , beat all four ingredients until creamy
8. Spread onto room temperature cooled cake
9. For an extra treat , sprinkle fresh diced pecans & enjoy

title: gnocchi with chicken sausage  bell pepper  and fennel
steps:
1. Cook the gnocchi according to package directions , omitting salt and fat
2. Drain the gnocchi in a colander over a bowl , reserving 1 / 4 cup cooking liquid
3. Keep gnocchi warm
4. Heat 1 teaspoon olive oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
5. Add sausage to pan
6. Saut 3 minutes or until lightly browned , stirring frequently
7. Remove sausage from skillet using a slotted spoon
8. Heat remaining 1 teaspoon oil in pan
9. Add fennel , bell pepper , and onion to pan
10. Cook 13 minutes or until tender , stirring occasionally
11. Add sausage , gnocchi , cheese , black pepper , and reserved cooking liquid to pan
12. Cook 1 minute or until cheese melts , stirring constantly
13. Remove from heat
14. Stir in parsley

title: cajun style corn on the cob
steps:
1. Mix butter with pepper , oregano , onion and a pinch of salt
2. Spread on ears of corn , right off the grill or from boiling water

title: banana fritters a la jacques pepin
steps:
1. Place flour , egg , and about 1 / 2 the water in a bowl
2. Mix with whisk for a few seconds , until the mix is smooth , and then whisk in the remaining water
3. To cook the fritters , take a large nonstick skillet and heat 1 / 3 cup of the oil to 400f
4. Meanwhile , peel the bananas , and , holding them directly over the bowl containing the batter , cut them crosswise into 1 / 4" slices
5. Make 3-4 fritters at a time - using about 1 / 3 cup batter for each pouring it into the hot oil
6. Spread mixture lightly as it hits the pan to create fritters about 3" in diameter
7. Cook for 3-4 minutes , turn , and cook for 3-4 minutes on other side , until lightly golden brown
8. Remove fritters with slotted spoon and place them on wire rack to drain
9. Continue to make fritters , adding oil as needed , until all batter has been used
10. Sprinkle the drained fritters generously with sugar and serve as soon as possible

title: cider poached apples with cinnamon yogurt
steps:
1. Bring apple cider and cinnamon stick to a boil in small sauce pan over high heat
2. Let boil , uncovered , about 20 minutes or until liquid is reduced to about 1 / 2 cup
3. Add apples
4. Cover and simmer about 10 minutes or until apples are just tender
5. Gently remove apple halves and poaching liquid from saucepan
6. Refrigerate until cooled
7. Combine yogurt and ground cinnamon in small bowl
8. Reserve 1 tablespoon
9. Divide remaining yogurt mixture evenly among 2 dessert dishes
10. Place apple halves on top of sauce
11. Sprinkle each apple half with toasted pecans
12. Drizzle with reserved yogurt sauce

title: brussels sprouts in creamy mustard sauce
steps:
