1. Whisk together the first 6 ingredients in a medium sized bowl
2. Cover and let the mixture come to room temperature
3. Set aside
4. Quarter the sprouts , unless they are very small , in which case leave them whole
5. Melt butter in skillet
6. Add brussel sprouts and sprinkle lightly with salt if desired
7. Stir , cover , and cook over medium heat until quite tender
8. When they are done , transfer them to a bowl and pour sauce over the top
9. Serve right away

title: homemade pasta  fettuccine
steps:
1. Sift the flour and salt into a large bowl
2. Make well in center of flour
3. Add eggs , oil and water
4. Work liquids into flour with fingers to make a soft dough
5. Knead dough 10 minutes or until dough is soft and smooth
6. Cover with a damp towel and let dough rest at least 15-20 minutes
7. Cut dough into 4 quarters
8. Roll each quarter to a very thin rectangle
9. Fold each rolled out dough into quarters lengthwise
10. Slice dough across 1 / 4 inch wide strips
11. Unwind strips and allow to dry on clean dry towels for 1 hour or longer

title: salad dressing muffins
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients
2. Spoon into hot greased muffin tins
3. Bake at 350f for 10-12 minutes

title: warm cheesy salsa dip
steps:
1. Melt cream cheese and velveeta
2. Add salsa
3. If using a slow cooker , it's going to take much longer to melt , so plan at least 2 hours for mixing

title: roast beef roll ups
steps:
1. In a small bowl , add the sour cream , mayonnaise , and salsa
2. Stir to combine
3. Spread mixture evenly over the tortillas
4. Sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper if desired
5. Top with roast beef slices
6. Then top with lettuce
7. Roll up tightly and secure with toothpicks
8. Cut in half and serve with salsa for dipping

title: sour cream hash browns bake
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Butter a 13 x 9-inch baking dish
3. In a skillet saute the yellow onion , green onion , garlic and celery in 1 / 4 cup butter for about 3-4 minutes or until softened
4. Transfer to a large bowl
5. Add in soup , hash brown potatoes , parmesan cheese , sour cream , cheddar cheese and mayo
6. Mix well with a wooden spoon to combine , then season with seasoned salt and black pepper
7. Transfer the mixture to prepared baking dish
8. Top with grated parmesan cheese
9. Bake for about 40 minutes

title: chipped beef dip ii
steps:
1. Blend cheese and milk together
2. Add the beef , onions , green pepper , black pepper , and the sour cream
3. Place mixture into a pie plate
4. Sprinkle the walnuts on top of it
5. Bake in oven at 350 for 20 minutes
6. Serve with crackers or party rye

title: oak bluffs massa sovada
steps:
1. Dissolve butter , sugar , and salt in 1 cup hot milk
2. Cool to luke-warm
3. Combine with dissolved yeast
4. Add 5 cups of the flour
5. Cover and set aside this sponge overnight
6. In the morning , cut down
7. Shape into two round loaves
8. Grease 8" cake pans and place loaves into them , let rise another hour
9. Bake at 350 degrees for one hour
10. Cool 5 minutes , then turn out on a rack , brush with melted butter and cover with a towel while cooling

title: slow cooker bbq chicken wings
steps:
1. Arrange chicken wings on broiler pan
2. Broil 4-5" from heat
3. Turning once
4. Cook until chicken is golden
5. About 10 minutes
6. Place chicken in slow cooker
7. Combine barbecue sauce , honey , mustard and worchestshire sauce in a bowl
8. Mix well
9. Pour over chicken
10. Cover and heat on low setting for 2-2 1 / 2 hours

title: double rich chocolate cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease 2 8-inch round pans
3. Sift flour before measuring , resift with baking powder
4. Add salt , cinnamon , cloves and chopped nuts
5. In double boiler melt chocolate , add boiling water and set aside
6. Cream butter until soft , add sugar , and cream again
7. Add egg yolks to cream mixture 1 at a time as you beat them into the batter
8. Now add cooled chocolate mixture , and mix well
9. Alternate flour and milk into chocolate mixture
10. Stir until smooth , add vanilla and set aside
11. Whip egg whites until stiff
12. Fold lightly into cake batter
13. Pour into 2 8" round pans
14. Bake about 30-35 minutes
15. Frost as desired

title: provolone  olive  and salami
steps:
1. Cut the provolone cheese into 40 small cubes
2. Wrap a slice of pepper around each cube
3. Wrap salami around cheese and pepper twice , place on wooden skewer
4. On another skewer add one black olive , one piece cheese , and one green olive
5. Repeat until all skewers have been used

title: low fat blueberry muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Coat a nonstick 12-cup muffin pan with cooking spray or line with paper cups
3. In a large bowl , stir flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda and salt together
4. In a small bowl , combine milk , canola oil and egg
5. Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients and add milk , oil and egg mixture
6. Stir until just moist
7. Fold in blueberries
8. Fill muffin cups 2 / 3 full and bake 18-20 minutes until golden
9. Cool on wire rack

title: mashed rutabaga and potatoes
steps:
1. Cook diced rutabaga , covered , in as small amount of boiling , salted water as possible about 30 minutes , or until tender
2. Drain
3. Boil unpeeled potatoes for about 30 minutes , or until very tender
4. Drain and slip off skins
5. Combine hot rutabaga and hot potatoes
6. Mash or beat together with butter , salt and pepper to taste
7. If mixture is dry , beat in a little hot milk to obtain the consistency you like
8. Serve sprinkled with parsley

title: cheese  pesto and sun dried tomato torta
steps:
1. Finely chop garlic cloves in food processor
2. Add basil , nuts , oil and lemon juice
3. Process until well blended
4. Add 1 / 3c cream cheese , all of parmesan cheese , and pulse until just blended
5. Turn into a medium bowl and set aside
6. Coarsely chop tomatoes in food processor
7. Add tomato paste and blend until mixture is almost smooth
8. Add 1 / 3c cream cheese and blend well
9. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside
10. In a large bowl , mix remaining softened cream cheese and butter until fluffy
11. Season with salt and pepper
12. Spray 6c straight sided dish with non-stick pan spray , line with plastic wrap allowing wrap to drape over the sides
13. Without worrying about keeping the layers perfect , spread 3 / 4c cream cheese / butter mixture evenly over prepared dish with a spoon dipped in hot water
14. Top with half of the tomato mixture , then 1 / 2c of cream cheese mixture , then half the pesto mixture
15. Repeat layering with 1 / 2c cream cheese mixture , remaining tomato mixture , 1 / 2c cream cheese mixture , remaining pesto , then remaining cream cheese mixture
16. Cover and chill 6hrs or overnight
17. Invert torta onto serving platter , carefully peel away plastic wrap , and serve

title: crock pot chile colorado
steps:
1. Toss beef and 1 t
2. Kitchen bouquet together in crock pot
3. Combine 2 t
4. Flour , 2 t
5. Salt and 1 / 4 t
6. Pepper
7. Add to beef , mix
8. Cut green pepper and whole chiles in 1" pieces
9. Add to beef
10. Add tomatoes and onion
11. Combine tomato sauce , garlic , parsley , cumin and sugar
12. Pour over beef , mix
13. Cook 10-11 hours on low or 4-5 hours on high
14. Mix 2 t
15. Softened butter , 2 t
16. Flour and 1 / 2 t
17. Kitchen bouquet into a paste
18. Drop into stew
19. Cook 1 more hour , stirring occassionally
20. May be eaten as a stew from a bowl with shredded monterey jack or cheddar cheese , or rolled in a large flour tortilla as a burrito with whatever condiments you prefer
21. Excellent the next day !

title: grilled garlic tarragon  lobster tails
steps:
1. Preheat grill
2. Remove the soft part of lobster tail with scissors
3. Hit shell lightly with a mallet to make it lie flat
4. Melt butter in saucepan and add garlic , ginger , tarragon , mustard and salt
5. Spoon some of the butter mixture over tails and reserve remaining
6. Let stand 20 minutes
7. Grill lobster 4 inches from heat for 10 - 15 min with meaty side up , basting frequently with reserved butter mixture

title: curried chicken and chickpeas
steps:
1. Heat a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium-high heat
2. Combine 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , garlic , and chicken , tossing to coat
3. Add chicken mixture to pan
4. Saute 3 minutes or until browned
5. Stir in curry powder
6. Cook 1 minute
7. Add tomato , broth , chile sauce , and chickpeas
8. Bring to a simmer
9. Cover and cook 8 minutes
10. While chicken mixture cooks , place 1 / 4 teaspoon salt , 1 cup water , and oil in a medium saucepan
11. Bring to a boil
12. Gradually stir in couscous
13. Remove from heat
14. Cover and let stand for 5 minutes
15. Fluff couscous with a fork
16. While couscous stands , poke holes in spinach bag
17. Microwave at high 2 minutes
18. Garnish with lemon wedges , if desired

title: south of the border burgers
steps:
1. Divide the hamburger into 4 equal portions and make two patties from each portion on 4 of the 8 patties put a tbsp of refied beans , sprinkle on some jalapeno pepper and a tbsp of onions , salt& pepper place the second pattie on top and firmly seal
2. Really pat them so they won't fall apart while cooking
3. If bbqing i recommend that you use a stir fry pan or use a solid grill to cook them in / on to ensure they do not end up as the fuel for the bbq
4. These burgers are delicate because there is no filler in them
5. Or pan fry when the burgers are cooked on one side flip and
6. Add mushrooms , cover with a lid and finish cooking
7. Slit the buns and start toasting one side , when browned slightly add cheese and continue heating until the cheese has melted assemble the burger , butter the bun if you wish , put in the bacon& mushrooms then the burger , top with the salsa , avacado& sour cream

title: a memory of french onion soup
steps:
1. In large soup pot , melt butter with oil
2. Add onions and cook slowly until translucent
3. Add sugar and flour and cook for 1-2 minutes
4. Add broth , water and seasonings and simmer for 30 minutes
5. Stir in wines , and simmer for 2 more hours
6. Preheat broiler
7. To serve , pour soup into oven- proof crocks
8. Place a slice of french bread on top of soup
9. Cover bread with lots of sliced or shredded cheese , your choice
10. Place soup crocks in oven on a sheet pan and broil until cheese is melted and bubbly
11. I like to place slices of cheese slightly over the edge , so it completely seals the top and melts down the side of each crock
12. I'm guessing 8-10

title: easy oven fried potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Cut potatoes lengthwise into 2-inch strips , about 1 / 4- to 1 / 2-inch thick
3. Place mayonnaise in large plastic food bag
4. Add potatoes
5. Shake and squeeze to coat well
6. Arrange potatoes in a single layer on baking sheets , so that they do not touch or overlap
7. Sprinkle generously with old bay seasoning , to your taste
8. Bake in preheated 400 degree oven for 40 minutes , turning once , until golden brown and tender
9. Drain on paper towels

title: winter snow cream
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except snow
2. Add snow and stir til desired thickness

title: easy spicy parmesan toasts
steps:
1. Set oven to 375 degrees
2. Prepare a one or two large baking sheets
3. Slice the baguette into 1 / 4-inch slices and arrange in a single layer on baking sheet / s
4. Brush one side with olive oil and sprinkle with salt
5. Bake for 8-10 minutes
6. Toss the cheese with the cayenne pepper
7. Remove the toasts from oven and sprinkle with the cheese / cayenne mixture
8. Place back into the oven and bake for 6-8 minutes more , until the cheese melts and the toasts are golden
9. Cool completely

title: mama s lemon sour cookie bars
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350
2. Mix the flour and butter together until it resembles a very fine crumb
3. Sprinkle evenly into the bottom of an 11 x 7" pan , and pat lightly to smooth out any lumps
4. Bake for 10 minutes at 350
5. Meanwhile beat the eggs , and mix in the brown sugar , nuts , coconut , vanilla and baking powder
6. Spread this mixture onto the baked crust as soon as you take it from the oven
7. Return the pan to the oven and bake for an additional 20 minutes at 350
8. Mix the lemon rind and juice with the confectioner's sugar to make a creamy glaze
9. Spread the lemon glaze evenly over the top of the hot cookie mixture as soon as you take it from the oven
10. Cool completely before cutting into squares
11. Store in an airtight container as the lemon glaze will dry out if left out for more than a day
12. I use the angel flake coconut in the can or the bag
13. Any brand of moist , flaked coconut will do , but you do not want to use the dry , shredded coconut for this recipe

title: chops with mushroom gravy
steps:
1. In a large resealable plastic bag , combine the first four ingredients
2. Add pork chops , one at a time
3. Toss to coat
4. Set remaining flour mixture aside
5. In a large skillet , saut chops in butter until golden brown
6. Transfer to a greased 13x9x2in baking dish
7. In same skillet saut onion , green pepper and mushrooms until tender
8. Stir in reserved flour mixture
9. Gradually add milk until blended
10. Bring to a boil
11. Cook and stir 2 minutes or until thickened
12. Remove from heat
13. Stir in lemon juice
14. Pour over chops
15. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 50-60 minutes or until meat is no longer pink
16. Serve with mashed potatoes

title: chocolate peanut butter bars
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 degrees
2. Grease a square baking pan
3. Mix crisco , peanut butter , both sugars and egg thoroughly
4. Stir in water , flour , baking soda , baking powder , and salt
5. Add in half of the chocolate chips
6. Spread in pan
7. Bake about 20 minutes
8. Remove from oven and immediately sprinkle remaining 6 oz
9. Chocolate chips over top
10. Cover with a cookie sheet so that they melt
11. Spread softened morsels over the top
12. Sprinkle with peanuts
13. Refrigerate several hours
14. Remove from refrigerator and let sit about 15 minutes
15. Cut into 2x1" bars

title: green tea pound cake
steps:
1. Cream butter in a bowl
2. Add sugar in the butter and mix well
3. Gradually add beaten eggs and stir well
4. Sift flour , baking powder , and green tea powder together and add the flour to the egg mixture
5. Pour the batter into a buttered loaf pan
6. Bake in preheated 340 degrees f oven for about 30-40 minutes

title: peach shake
steps: 1. Empty peaches into blender , add ice cream and malted milk powder if desired , process til smooth

title: italian stuffed burgers
steps:
1. In small bowl , combine cheese , olives , and onion
2. Shape ground beef into eight patties , approximately 4 1 / 2-inch diameter
3. Place approximately 1 / 4 cup of cheese mixture in center of four patties
4. Top with remaining patties
5. Press edges firmly together to seal
6. Gently pat to 3 / 4-inch thickness
7. In small bowl , combine italian seasoning , garlic powder , and pepper
8. Press evenly into both sides of each patty
9. Place patties on grill over medium , ash-covered coals
10. Grill , uncovered , 22 to 24 minutes to medium doneness or until centers of patties are no longer pink and juices show no pink color
11. Turn occasionally
12. Season burgers with salt , as desired
13. Line bottom of each roll with one tomato slice
14. Top with burger
15. Add choice of toppings , if desired

title: creamy sweet potato casserole
steps:
1. 1
2. Cook potatoes combine potatoes , cream , butter , sugar , salt , and pepper in dutch oven
3. Cook covered , stirring occasionally , over medium heat until potatoes begin to break down , 20 to 25 minutes
4. 2
5. Simmer potatoes reduce heat to medium-low and continue to cook , covered , until liquid has been absorbed and potatoes are completely tender , 15 to 20 minutes
6. Meanwhile , adjust oven rack to upper-middle position and heat oven to 450 degrees
7. 3
8. Mash potatoes add cream cheese to pot
9. Using potato masher , mash until cream cheese is fully incorporated and sweet potatoes are smooth or if you prefer silky-smooth potatoes , use a hand mixer to beat the potatoes
10. Continue to cook , stirring constantly , until potatoes are thickened , about 5 minutes
11. 4
12. Toast marshmallows transfer potato mixture to 2-quart baking dish and top with single layer marshmallows
13. Bake until marshmallows are browned , about 5 minutes
14. Serve
15. Make ahead: after transferring sweet potato mixture to baking dish , mixture can be refrigerated , covered , up to 2 days
16. Microwave until warm for 4 to 7 minutes before topping with marshmallows and baking as directed

title: chili bbq sauce
steps:
1. Combine all of the ingredients in a small bowl
2. Mix well
3. Use as a marinade , or brush over the seafood , chicken or pork the last 10 minutes of grilling

title: cabbage and potato fry
steps:
1. Quarter , core and shred cabbage
2. Heat oil over medium heat
3. When hot , add cumin and mustard seeds and wait till they sputter
4. Then add finely sliced onion
5. Allow onion to soften and then throw in the shredded cabbage
6. Add salt , turmeric and coriander powders
7. Close pot , reduce heat slightly and allow to cook until cabbage wilts
8. As soon as cabbage reduces in volume , add small pieces of diced potatoes and continue cooking on medium heat till potatoes soften and cabbage is tender
9. If desired , add in shredded coconut with potatoes as allow to cook as in previous step
10. Garnish with coriander sprigs
11. Goes well as a low-fat option with parathas

title: easy chicken dish
steps:
1. Preheat over to 350 degrees
2. Debone chicken , tearing it into bite size pieces and place in 9 x 9 baking dish
3. Mix soup , red pepper , and onion in separate bowl
4. Add soup mixture to chicken , mixing well
5. Bake for 30 minutes or until bubbly
6. Sprinkle parmesan cheese over top the last 5 minutes
7. Serve over toast or rice

title: sausage and rice casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven at 350
2. Brown sausage in frying pan and pour off grease
3. Add chopped onion , garlic , celery , and green pepper to sausage and simmer until tender
4. In bowl combine rice and soups and then add cooked ingredients
5. Pour into greased pyrex pan
6. Bake 1 1 / 2 hours at 350 , stirring occasionally

title: shaye s favorite chili
steps:
1. In a dutch oven or stock pot , brown ground chuck and onion in oil
2. When it is brown , add the flour and continue to stir for 5 more minutes
3. Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 30 minutes

title: butternut squash bake
steps:
1. Place squash in a saucepan and cover with water
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat
4. Cover and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until very tender
5. Drain well and place in a large bowl
6. Mash squash
7. In another bowl , combine the mayonnaise , onion , egg , sugar , salt and pepper
8. Add to the squash and mix well
9. Transfer to a greased 1-qt
10. Baking dish
11. Combine the cracker crumbs , cheese and butter
12. Sprinkle over top
13. Bake , uncovered , at 350 for 30-40 minutes or until heated through and top is golden brown
14. Yield: 6 servings

title: tangy tamarind chickpeas    khata imlee chana  slow cooker
steps:
1. Place the chickpeas and water in a 5 quart slow cooker
2. In a food processor , puree all of the remaining ingredients , except the lemon , onion for garnish and bread
3. Add to slow cooker , stir , and cook on high for 10 hours
4. Add the half lemon and cook another 2 hours on high
5. After cooking , remove and discard the lemon
6. Top with the sliced red onion and serve with hot naan
7. To make half the quantity , use a 3 1 / 2 qt slow cooker
8. Mix chopped cucumbers - i used seedless - and some chopped red onion if you like , stir in some sour cream or thick yogurt
9. Spoon onto the chickpeas and naan - the contrast between the spicy chickpeas and the cool creamy cucumbers is out of this world !

title: beef tips on rice   pressure cooker
steps:
1. Place first five ingredients in a zip top bag and shake well to distribute
2. Add the beef cubes to the bag and shake until all are well covered
3. In a pressure cooker , brown the meat in the vegetable oil over medium heat
4. Once the meat is browned , add the onions and the garlic to the the cooker and saute the onions while deglazing the pan
5. Once the onions turn translucent add the can of beef consomm and stir to combine
6. Place the lid on the cooker and bring to pressure over medium heat
7. Cook 25 minutes and remove from heat
8. Once the pressure subsides open the lid and simmer until the proper consistency
9. Serve over rice

title: chocolate brittle surprise
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Cover cookie sheet with foil
3. Spray foil with cooking oil spray
4. Place crackers on foil in 5 x 7 inch rows
5. Microwave butter on high for 2 minutes
6. Add brown sugar and stir
7. Microwave on high for 2 more minutes , stirring every 30 seconds
8. Pour over crackers
9. Bake 10-15 minutes
10. Sprinkle chocolate chips over hot crackers
11. Spread after 2 minutes
12. Sprinkle nuts on top
13. Refrigerate 1 hour
14. Break into pieces
15. Can be frozen
16. Cook time doesn't include refrigeration time of 1 hour

title: olive garden risotto milanese
steps:
1. In a saucepan , heat oil until fragrant
2. Add onions and saffron and saute 3 minutes or until onions are soft
3. Keep broth warm in a separate pot
4. Add rice to the onions and stir for 2 minutes
5. Add white wine and let evaporate
6. Add the broth , about 1 / 2 cup at a time , stirring frequently
7. Wait until each addition is almost completely absorbed by the rice
8. Continue to add until all of the broth has been used
9. Turn off heat
10. Add butter and parmesan cheese
11. Stir to combine with rice / risotto
12. Transfer to large bowl and garnish with parsley
13. Serve immediately
14. Finished risotto should be creamy and rice is firm

title: ye old pub grilled steak  english uk
steps:
1. Mix soy sauce and honey
2. It's basically a one to one ratio , but you can adjust for sweet verses salty preferences
3. Warm the mixture on the stove until the honey is incorporated into the soy sauce
4. Keep warm until ready to brush on steaks
5. Salt and pepper the steaks
6. I use coarse ground black pepper and kosher salt
7. Place steaks on a hot grill
8. For great looking grill marks:
9. Place the meet on the grill at a 45 degree angle for 1 / 2 the cooking time for the first side
10. Turn 90 degrees for the remaining cooking time for the first side
11. Turn the steak over , again at a 45 degree angle for the first half , then turn 90 degrees and finish cooking
12. You should end up with diamond shaped grill marks
13. When meat is almost ready to come off the grill , brush with the soy sauce / honey mixture
14. Let it cook / sear on one side , then turn over and do the same to the other
15. Repeat as necessary to get a noticable glaze on the meat
16. Remove from heat and brush again
17. Let meat stand for 15 min before serving

title: glazed espresso brownies
steps:
1. Line a 13x9 inch pan with foil , extending foil over edges of pan
2. Butter foil
3. Melt butter and unsweetened chocolate in a small saucepan over low heat
4. Stir constantly
5. Cool to room temperature
6. In medium bowl , combine flour , baking powder and salt
7. In large bowl , beat eggs , sugar , espresso powder , kahlua , and vanilla with an electric mixer until well combined
8. Beat cooled chocolate mixture into egg mixture
9. Add flour mixture , and stir just until combined
10. Spread batter in prepared pan
11. Bake at 350 for 25-30 minutes or until top is set and dry
12. Cool in pan on rack
13. To prepare glaze , combine all glaze ingredients in medium saucepan
14. Heat over low heat , stirrng constantly , until melted and smooth
15. Pour glaze over brownies and spread evenly
16. Cover and chill until glaze is set
17. Let stand at room temperature 20 to 30 minutes before serving
18. Use foil to lift brownies out of pan
19. Cut into bars

title: pepperoni
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , mixing until thoroughly blended
2. Divide in half into slender rolls about 1 1 / 3 inch in diameter
3. Wrap in plastic or foil
4. Refrigerate overnight
5. Unwrap and bake on broiler pan at 200 f for 4 hours
6. Store wrapped in the refrigerator

title: ensalada palmito recipe  hearts of palm salad
steps:
1. Cut the heart of palm into small bite sized pieces and place on lettuce lined plates
2. Squeeze lime juice over the hearts of palm
3. Add a tiny dash of salt and fresh pepper
4. The optional ingredients can be added together or individually
5. Mayonnaise can be substituted for the lime , salt , and pepper as is common in restaurants

title: healthy raisin coconut muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f and line 12-15 muffin cups with liners
2. Mix the first 6 ingredients in a large bowl
3. Add in the remaining ingredients and mix well
4. Spoon batter into muffin cups
5. Bake for 20 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean
6. Cool on wire rack

title: grilled parmesan broccoli
steps:
1. Place broccoli in large bowl
2. Combine next four ingredients , drizzle over broccoli , and toss to coat
3. Let stand for half an hour
4. Spray grill rack before preparing grill for indirect heat
5. Toss broccoli again and drain marinade
6. Place parmesan in large ziploc bag and shake broccoli , a few pieces at a time , with the cheese to coat
7. Grill broccoli , covered , over indirect medium heat for 8-10 minutes on each side or until crisp-tender

title: black bean quinoa burgers
steps:
1. In a small saucepan combine quinoa and 1 1 / 4 cup water seasoned with a dash of salt and bring to a boil
2. Once boiling , cover , and reduce to medium-low heat to simmer for about 20 minutes or until all the liquid is absorbed
3. When the quinoa is done , you should have about 1 1 / 2 cups cooked quinoa
4. While waiting for the quinoa to cook , put the onion and sun-dried tomatoes in a medium-sized frying pan and cook for 3-4 minutes or until the onion is soft
5. The genius part of having the sun-dried tomatoes in this step is that there is no need to add any extra oil , as the the tomatoes should have enough oil still on them to cook up the onion
6. Add garlic , steak seasoning , 3 / 4 cup black beans , and 1 / 2 cup water , stirring to combine
7. Simmer this mixture for about 5 minutes or until most of the liquid has evaporated
8. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
9. Place hot mixture along with 3 / 4 cup cooked quinoa into food processor and pulse until smooth
10. Transfer blended mixture into a mixing bowl and stir in remaining 3 / 4 cup cooked quinoa and 3 / 4 cup black beans
11. You can choose to season with salt and pepper at this time , but i usually feel as if the steak seasoning is enough for my taste buds
12. Allow the mixture to cool a couple minutes , so you don't burn your hands during the patty-making process
13. Mold the mixture into 8 patties , or about 1 / 2 cup each by patting with hands
14. Place on greased baking sheet and bake for about 20 minutes
15. Flip burgers and bake for another 10 minutes
16. Serve with desired toppings on buns or bread and enjoy !

title: slimmed down macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Spray a 4-quart slow cooker with nonstick cooking spray
2. In a small saucepan , heat the mustard , cornstarch , pepper and evaporated milk until warmed through , whisking occasionally
3. Stir in the cheese
4. Pour the macaroni into the slow cooker
5. Top with the cheese mixture and stir
6. Cover and cook on low for 1-2 hours or on high for 30 minutes

title: apple peanut salad with tuna
steps:
1. Arrange lettuce leaves on 2 salad plates , covering each plate
2. With an apple corer or small , sharp knife , core the apple and cut it into quarters
3. Then cut each quarter into thin slices and arrange 1 / 2 of them on each plate
4. Sprinkle 1 / 2 of the celery on each plate
5. Sprinkle 1 / 2 of the tuna and 1 / 2 of the peanuts on each plate
6. In a small bowl , stir together mayonnaise and enough apple juice to make a thin salad dressing
7. Drizzle the dressing over each salad

title: spinach mash
steps:
1. Chop and boil the potatoes until tender
2. Drain
3. Mash the potato until smooth
4. Melt the butter in a frying pan
5. Add the garlic and baby spinach leaves and stir until the spinach has wilted
6. Use a gentle heat
7. Blend or process the spinach mix with half of the cream
8. Use a stick blender or food processor
9. Blend until pureed
10. Mix the mashed potato , spinach mix and the remaining cream

title: heringstopf mit saurer sahne  herring salad with sour cream
steps:
1. Sauce:
2. Blend thoroughly sour cream , yogurt , lemon juice and sugar
3. Salad:
4. Peel onions and cut into thin slices
5. Peel and quarter apples , remove cores and cut into thin wedges
6. Blend onions and apples with sauce
7. In a dish arrange herring and apple-onion mixture in layers
8. Cover tightly and marinate in refrigerator for 5 hours
9. Sprinkle with dill before serving

title: banana raisin bread
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients in a mixing bowl
2. Mix wet ingredients in another bowl
3. Combine wet and dry ingredients
4. Pour in loaf pan sprayed with pam and sprinkle with 2 tablespoons sugar
5. Bake at 350 for about an hour , until golden brown
6. Cool completely before slicing

title: ww 3 points   steak with roasted garlic and chili rub
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Wrap garlic in foil and place on baking sheet
3. Roast until softened , about 10-12 minute
4. Remove garlic from oven
5. Spray broiler rack with nonstick spray and preheat broiler
6. When cool enough to handle , squeeze garlic from its skin into small bowl
7. Add chili powder , cumin , oregano , and salt
8. Stir and mash together
9. Rub steak on both sides with garlic and chili mixture
10. Increase oven temp to broil
11. Broil steak 4-inches from heat until done to taste , about 5 min on each side for medium

title: ham   noodles
steps:
1. Cook noodles according to package instructions
2. Drain and add butter , making sure to mix to coat
3. Set aside for now
4. Add oil to large skillet , heat and add onions , ham and seasonings
5. Cook until onions become translucent and start to brown slightly
6. Remove from heat
7. In a bowl add soups and milk mix well together
8. Pour into pan with onion and ham mix
9. When it becomes bubbly add cheese
10. Stir to melt cheese and remove
11. Add to noodles , mixing well and serve
12. This is excellent with a side salad and garlic bread to lighten it up

title: fruits in syrup
steps:
1. Cook the sugar and water into a syrup
2. Cool and stir in sherry and lemon / lime juice
3. Peel and segment the orange
4. Toss with the pineapple and litchis
5. Pour the syrup over the fruits
6. Chill 1 hour before serving

title: tsr version of red lobster cheddar bay biscuits by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Combine bisquick and cold butter
3. Don't combine too thoroughly
4. There should be small chunks of butter about the size of peas
5. Add cheddar , milk and 1 / 4 tsp garlic
6. Mix by hand until combined , but don't over mix
7. Drop 9 equal portions onto greased cookie sheet
8. Bake for 15-17 minutes or until tops are light brown
9. Melt 2 tbsp butter in a bowl
10. Stir in 1 / 2 tsp garlic powder and parsley flakes
11. Use a pastry brush to spread garlic butter over tops of biscuits

title: un fried  fish
steps:
1. Set oven to broil to preheat
2. Mix cornmeal , salt and pepper in a shallow dish
3. Rinse and pat excess water from fish
4. Roll fish in mixed cornmeal till nicely coated
5. Place fish on broiler pan or baking sheet and spray lightly with the becel topping spray or butter flavored pam
6. Place in oven
7. Broil till nicely brown , about 5 mins - depending on thickness of fish , turn fish and brown the other side

title: mango chutney spread
steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together , chill if desired & enjoy !

title: make ahead burritos
steps:
1. In a large skillet or saucepan , combine meat , salsa , beans , chilies , seasoning , and water
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 5 minutes or until heated through
4. Spoon abour 1 / 3 cup off-center on each tortilla and top with a cheese strip
5. Fold edge of tortilla nearest filling over to cover
6. Fold ends of tortilla over filling and roll up
7. Wrap individually in aluminum foil
8. Freeze for up to 2 months

title: green tea muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven at 350f
2. Sift together the flour , baking soda , and green tea powder and set aside
3. In a large bowl , beat the butter until light
4. Add the sugar and eggs and beat some more until light and fluffy
5. Add the dry mixture and the milk
6. Stir with a spatula or wooden spoon until the dry ingredients are just incorporated
7. The batter will be somewhat lumpy
8. Divide the batter among the muffin tins , about 2 / 3 full
9. Bake for 25-30 minutes
10. Allow to cool on a wire rack
11. Bon appetit !

title: pumpkin muffins with struessel topping
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Mix all ingredients together adding water last
3. You can make loaves or muffins
4. I then mix cinnamon and sugar together and sprinkle on top of muffin and then add pecans and sprinkle with more cinn-sugar mixture lightly before i bake
5. Bake for about 25 min or until done

title: banana nut oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Mix together oats , milk , and pecans in a bowl and set aside
2. Mix together brown sugar , egg whites , mashed banana , and vanilla in a large mixing bowl
3. Add flour , baking soda , salt , nutmeg , and cinnamon , and stir well to combine
4. Add oat mixture and stir well
5. Drop batter by tablespoonfuls onto cookie sheets sprayed with non-stick spray or lined with parchment paper
6. Flatten each cookie slightly with a fork or spatula
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 12 minutes

title: spaghetti siciliana
steps:
1. Cube eggplants and cut bell peppers into slim strips and sliver garlic
2. Cook oil and garlic over medium heat for 2-3 min
3. Add eggplant and bell pepper and cook 2-4 min
4. Add tomato and bring to boil
5. Chop olives , capers , and 5 leaves basil and add to sauce , then reduce heat to low and simmer to thicken
6. In the meantime , cook the pasta and chop remaining basil into ribbons
7. Toss pasta with sauce and top with cheese and basil ribbons

title: mexican three bean salad
steps:
1. Cut the ends off the green beans and slice into pieces about an inch long
2. Fill a medium sized pot halfway with salted water
3. Bring to a boil and add the green beans to the pot and boil for 5 minute , or as long as it takes for the beans to get tender
4. Green beans can be highly variable in how long it takes to cook them to tenderness
5. More mature beans can take longer - up to 20 minutes
6. Drain the green beans and put in the bowl with the pinto and black beans
7. Drizzle the olive oil over everything and toss to combine
8. Mix in the green onions , jalapeno , garlic and cotija cheese
9. In a separate bowl , mix the lime juice and sugar until the sugar dissolves - then add it to the salad
10. Coat the beans well and let marinate for at least 1 hour , preferably several hours
11. Right before you serve , toss in the cilantro
12. Add more salt to taste if needed

title: hot sweet cucumber lime pickles   3 day
steps:
1. Day 1: soak cucumbers in soaking solution of lime and water for 24 hours , making sure all cucumber slices are covered
2. Place a plate on top and weight it with a heavy , clean object , such as a gallon of water
3. Day 2: remove cucumbers , wash well until water runs clear
4. Soak in clear water for 3 hours
5. Drain cucumbers and wash again
6. Place cucumbers in the pickling solution and leave overnight
7. Day 3: after soaking cucumbers in the pickling solution overnight , pour the pickling solution into a very large pot
8. Bring to a boil
9. Add cucumbers and bring to a boil again
10. Boil 35 minutes
11. Seal in hot , sterilized , pint or quart canning jars
12. Let jars cool and dry
13. Label and store
14. Chill before serving
15. House specialty appetizers: serve chilled , drained pickles slices in a small bowl
16. Surround with bowls of thinly sliced summer sausage , crackers , and thinly sliced cheeses
17. To assemble , place summer sausage , pickle slice , and cheese on top of each cracker
18. Enjoy !

title: fruit medley
steps:
1. For sauce , in a small mixing bowl stir together yogurt , cheese , honey , and ginger'til mixture is smooth , cover and chill if desired
2. Drain orange sections and pineapple chunks
3. In a medium bowl combine the orange sections , pineapple chunks and grape halves
4. In a small bowl toss together banana slices and lemon juice , add fruit mixture
5. Chill
6. To serve , divide the fruit mixture among 4 dessert dishes
7. Top each with the sauce and the coconut

title: light teriyaki chicken
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. In a small bowl , whisk together honey , chicken broth , soy sauce , ketchup , garlic salt , and ginger
3. Place chicken breasts in an oven proof dish and pour sauce over
4. Bake 20 to 25 minutes , turning once , or until chicken is no longer pink
5. Serve with sauce drizzled over chicken

title: kicked up country breakfast  emeril lagasse style
steps:
1. Heat a large frying pan over medium-high heat
2. Add the sausage and cook , stirring to crumble , until browned , about 3 minutes
3. Add the butter , and when melted , add the onions , bell peppers , 1 teaspoon of the essence , the hot sauce , salt , and pepper , and cook , stirring , until soft , about 4 minutes
4. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds
5. Add the potatoes , and cook , stirring , until lightly browned , about 4 minutes
6. Add the parsley and chicken stock , stir well , and bring to a boil
7. Reduce the heat to low and simmer until the potatoes are soft and stock is absorbed , about 10 minutes
8. With a spoon , make 4 indentations in the mixture , and break an egg into each
9. Cover and cook until the eggs are set , about 4 minutes
10. Sprinkle the eggs with the remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon of essence and the cheese
11. Serve immediately with hot toast or tortillas

title: mac and jack and cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Bring a large pot of water to a boil
3. Add the macaroni and cook according to the directions on the package , 6-8 minutes
4. Drain well
5. Meanwhile , heat the milk in a small saucepan , but don't boil it
6. Melt 6 tablespoons of butter in a large pot and add the flour
7. Cook over low heat for 2 minutes , stirring with a whisk
8. While whisking , add the hot milk a little at a time and cook for a minutes or two more , until thickened and smooth
9. Off the heat , add the pepper jack , cheddar , salt , and pepper
10. Add the cooked macaroni and stir well
11. Pour into a 3 quart baking dish
12. Slice the tomato and arrange on top with the jalapenos
13. Melt the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter , combine butter with bread crumbs , and sprinkle on top
14. Bake 30-35 minutes , or until the sauce is bubbly and macaroni is browned on the top
15. If you want it more browned , try broiling ti for 2 minutes at the end

title: picante lentil sauce  crock pot
steps:
1. Combine the tomatoes , lentils , onions , garlic , sugar , cumin , chili , and picante sauce in an electric slow cooker
2. Cover and cook on low until the lentils are tender , 6 to 8 hours

title: sherry tofu and snow peas
steps:
1. Fry the tofu , covered , in 1 tablespoon of the oil until the tofu is nicely browned
2. Remove from heat
3. In a small bowl , mix together the sherry , soy sauce , and cornstarch
4. Pour over the tofu , stir well , and set aside to marinate
5. Remove the ends and strings from snow peas and cut each one into 2 to 3 pieces
6. Blanch the snow peas in boiling water for 1 to 2 minutes , then plunge them into very cold water to halt further cooking
7. In a skillet or wok heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil and saute the green onions , minced yellow onion , water chestnuts , and garlic for 4 minutes
8. Add the snow peas and cashews and stir well
9. Add the tofu together with the marinade , lemon juice , and pepper and cook for 3 to 5 minutes or until the snow peas and sauce reach desired texture
10. Serve immediately with rice or noodles

title: rice pilaf with mushrooms
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large flameproof casserole and cook the onion over low heat for 5 minutes
2. Add the mushrooms , salt and pepper and continue cooking 5 minutes longer or until the mushrooms release their liquid
3. Turn up the heat and cook , stirring constantly , until the moisture in the mushrooms evaporates
4. Add the rice and stir it for a few minutes or until the grains are transparent
5. Pour in the stock or stock mixed with water and bring to a boil
6. Lower the heat , cover the pan and cook the rice for 20 minutes or until all the liquid is absorbed
7. Transfer half the rice to a plastic container
8. Serve remaining rice at once

title: meatloaf  yes  simple  yet  to die for
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 degrees
2. Combine all ingredients
3. Form into loaf in loaf pan
4. Bake 45 to 50 minutes
5. To vary recipe i have made a mixture of hamburger and local grocery store breakfast sausage , so tender
6. I've also formed into meatballs and cooked in spagetti sauce in crockpot or on stove till done

title: german rotkohl   spiced red cabbage with apples and wine
steps:
1. Cook the pork fat or bacon in a large skillet or dutch oven over low heat , stirring occasionally until it has rendered its fat , about 20 minutes for the pork fat or 10 minutes for the bacon
2. Add the onion , ginger , and cinnamon stick , increase the heat to medium , and cook , stirring occasionally for about 5 minutes , until the onion has softened
3. Add the cabbage , stirring and cooking over medium heat until some of the bits are slightly browned and caramelized , about 10 minutes
4. Now add the marjoram , garam masala , vinegar , and port or madeira , and stir well
5. Reduce heat to medium-low , cover , and simmer for 1 to 1 1 / 4 hours , stirring occasionally to make sure the cabbage is not sticking to the bottom of the pan
6. Remove the lid and cook , stirring frequently , for 15 minutes
7. Stir in the brown sugar and cook for 15 minutes longer , or until most of the liquid has cooked away
8. Remove the cinnamon stick and bay leaf before serving

title: chocolate chunk pumpkin bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Mix flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt and spices until well blended
3. Set aside
4. Beat eggs , pumpkin , sugars , milk and oil in large bowl with wire whisk until well blended
5. Add dry ingredients
6. Stir just until moistened
7. Stir in chopped chocolate
8. Pour into greased 9x5-inch loaf pan
9. Bake 55 minutes to 1 hour or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
10. Cool 10 minutes
11. Remove from pan
12. Cool completely on wire rack
13. Cut into 18 slices to serve

title: turkey and roasted red pepper panini
steps:
1. Preheat an electric panini maker according to the manufacturers instructions
2. Brush one side of each bread slice with olive oil
3. Lay the slices , oiled side down , on a clean work surface
4. Spread the top of each slice with mayonnaise
5. Place the turkey on one slice and top with the bell pepper , cheese and watercress
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Top with the other bread slice , oiled side up
8. Place the sandwich on the preheated panini maker and cook according to the manufacturers instructions until the bread is golden and the cheese is melted , 3 to 5 minutes
9. Transfer the sandwich to a cutting board and cut in half
10. Serve immediately
11. Serves 1

title: mexican corn muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f grease a large muffin pan , or use paper liners
2. Mix all ingredients together , blending well
3. Pour into muffin pan and fill about 1 / 2 full
4. Bake for 22-28 minutes

title: ayam panggang  honey roasted malay style chicken
steps:
1. Rinse chicken pieces and pat dry with kitchen towel
2. If using chicken pieces , slit on sides for easier cooking
3. Mix ginger , soy sauce , honey , oil and salt in small bowl
4. Pour this over chicken together with spices and marinate for at least an hour
5. Grill chicken under preheated grill or roast in oven set at 190c for 30 min , turning chicken over halfway through the cooking time

title: italian bruschetta with herbed mozzarella   garlic tomatoes
steps:
1. In a large grill pan , heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil
2. When oil is hot , press slices of bread or foccacia firmly against the grill
3. Turn the flame on high until the bread has become slightly and pleasantly streaked with char lines
4. Heat 5 tablespoons of olive oil on medium heat , and add crushed garlic
5. Tilt the pan upwards so that the oil collects near the end and 'deep-fries' the garlic until golden brown , on medium to high heat
6. Set golden brown garlic aside
7. In a small bowl , mix all the herbs together
8. Put in tomato slices in the grill pan and sprinkle the mixed herbs liberally and all over the tomatoes
9. Season with salt and pepper
10. If you have a cover for the grill pan , do so and let grill on a soft flame for 5 minutes or so
11. If not , leave to grill for about 7 minutes
12. When the tomatoes are soft , but still retaining their shape - or the time has elapsed , add the grated mozzarella cheese
13. Leave for another 5 - 10 minutes , or until cheese has melted and is bubbling
14. Quickly , scoop the cheese covered tomatoes out , and place side by side , slightly overlapped , on the grilled bread
15. Season with more salt and pepper , and add chopped fresh coriander herb on the bruchetta
16. Serve immediately

title: cheater s garlic bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Lay out each piece of white bread and cut off crusts
3. Cut each piece of bread in half vertically
4. Set bread aside and discard crusts
5. In a small bowl mix together butter , garlic powder , italian seasoning and salt to taste
6. Spread butter mixture thinly over one side of each slice of bread
7. Place bread buttered side up on a small baking sheet and place in the broiler
8. Let bread toast for about 3 or 4 minutes or until golden brown
9. Remove from broiler and serve immediately

title: not your grandmothers fruitcake
steps:
1. For the cake:
2. Heat oven to 350f
3. In a medium pot , cook the dried fruits , bourbon and orange juice just until the fruits are plump about four to five minutes
4. There will be some liquid left
5. In the bowl of a stand mixer , cream the butter and sugar on medium speed until light and fluffy
6. Add the eggs one at a time
7. On low speed , add the dry ingredients and mix until combined
8. Add the orange juice bourbon and fruit mixture
9. Stir to combine
10. Pour batter into a bundt pan sprayed with non-stick spray
11. Bake at 350f for about 45 minutes until a tooth pick inserted into the cake comes out clean
12. Let cool
13. When cake is completely cooled , seal in an airtight container
14. Every two to three days , feel the cake and if dry , brush with more bourbon
15. Continue to baste for two weeks for maximum flavor , or eat whenever you want
16. For the glaze:
17. Mix all glaze ingredients together and drizzle over the top of the cake
18. Optional:
19. Feel free to use any and all dried fruits in this: chopped dried peaches , dried apples , dried pears , dates if its dried , it will work !
20. For a chocolatey twist , add cup chopped semisweet chocolate to the batter
21. Get nutty: add pecans or hazelnuts to the batter or the top of the cake for a nutty , crunchy variation
22. Garnish the top of the cake in festive holiday style
23. Dried fruit slices , cinnamon sticks , red and green cherries are all seasonally appropriate
24. Traditionally , fruitcake is boozy , but feel free to use apple cider in place of the bourbon
25. I like to use a bundt pan for this but you can use a loaf pan , a 9-inch cake pan or even make fruit cake cupcakes !

title: yams with apples and cranberries
steps:
1. In a skillet , melt margarine over medium heat
2. Saute apples until crisp-tender
3. Place apples and yams in a 3-quart casserole coated with nonstick cooking spray
4. Sprinkle with nutmeg
5. Combine cranberry sauce and marmalade
6. Spoon over yams
7. Bake , uncovered , at 350-degrees for 30 minutes

title: dhal
steps:
1. Wash lentils and pick out all the brown bits
2. Wash
3. Place in a medium saucepan and cover with water 3-4 inches above lentils
4. Simmer for 45 minutes , skimming the foam off the top of the water occasionally
5. Top up with extra water , if necessary
6. Strain lentils , retaining the liquid
7. Blend lentils with some of the liquid in blender until smooth
8. Add more water if necessary--blend should be like a thick paste
9. Put to one side
10. Place oil in medium saucepan
11. Add the mustard seeds and cook stirring until the seeds start to pop
12. Immediately add the onions and garlic
13. Cook , stirring until onions are soft
14. Add all the spices
15. Stir and cook for another minute or two
16. Add the pureed lentils and stir well until fully mixed
17. This freezes extremely well
18. Serve with curry and rice as an accompaniment

title: bed   breakfast scones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Set aside a lightly greased baking stone or cookie sheet
3. In a large bowl , combine dry ingredients
4. Cut in butter to resemble coarse crumbs
5. Select one or more optional add-in from the list above
6. Make well in the center
7. In a measuring cup , mix milk and eggs , pour into well in flour mixture except -- reserve about 1 tablespoon of egg-milk
8. Add flavoring of choice
9. Stir flour-milk mixture with a fork , it will be slightly dry and rather stiff
10. Dump dough onto a floured surface , incorporating any dry crumbs from the bottom of the bowl
11. Knead several times but do not overwork the dough
12. Divide into two balls
13. Place one on either end of the baking stone or cookie sheet
14. Pat into an 8-inch disk , about half-inch thick
15. Using a pastry brush , spread the reserved egg-milk over the tops of both disks
16. Sprinkle with topping of choice covering thoroughly
17. With a pizza cutter or big knife , cut each cake into wedges , leave in place
18. Bake for 20-25 minutes
19. Separate wedges and check that dough is "dry" -- if not , pop back in oven & give it 2-3 more minutes
20. Then serve immediately
21. Serve with: recipe #186965 or recipe #208437
22. Leftover scones: as if -- but okay if you have leftovers , cut horizontally , spread with butter and toast lightly
23. Great combinations:
24. Chocolate chips with cranberries & brown sugar topping
25. Chocolate chips with orange zest & orange flavoring
26. Cranberries with walnuts
27. Cranberries with apricots
28. Apricots with nuts
29. Poppyseeds with lemon flavoring & zest
30. Cheese with nuts or chocolate chips

title: onion gravy
steps:
1. In medium saucepan , bring 2 cups water to boil
2. Stir in lipton onion recipe soup mix
3. Simmer covered 10 minutes
4. Stir in flour blended with remaining water
5. Bring to a boil , then simmer , stirring constantly , until gravy is thickened , about 5 minutes

title: white bean and red onion salad
steps:
1. Drain the beans in a colander and rinse well with cold running water
2. Combine with onion in a large bowl
3. Stir the remaining ingredients in a small bowl until blended
4. Add to the beans and onions and toss until coated
5. Let stand or chill briefly and toss again before serving
6. These are even better the second day !

title: tomato and watermelon salad
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine the tomatoes , cucumber , watermelon , avocado , and herbs
2. In a spice grinder , grind the coriander seeds to a fine powder
3. Add the ground coriander to the tomato mixture and toss gently
4. In a small bowl , whisk together the olive oil , balsamic vinegar , and salt and pepper to taste
5. Pour over the tomato mixture and toss to coat evenly
6. Taste and adjust the seasoning before serving

title: jazz fest sweet potato pone
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Cook the potatoes unpeeled until tender throughout
3. Let cool , peel and mash the potatoes , then stir in melted butter
4. In a bowl , beat the eggs , add sugar
5. Add milk , vanilla , molasses , salt , cinnamon , nutmeg , cloves and orange zest
6. Beat until well blended
7. Stir into mashed sweet potatoes , then mix until well blended
8. Place the mixture into a buttered 1-1 / 2 quart baking dish
9. Optionally , you may sprinkle the top of the pone with additional brown sugar
10. Cover with foil and bake for 50 minutes
11. Uncover , then bake for 10 minutes
12. Allow the pone to cool completely before serving

title: banana shakes
steps:
1. In a blender , combine all ingredients
2. Cover and process until smooth
3. Pour into chilled glasses
4. Serve immediately

title: jamaican rum cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Sift together and set aside the flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
3. Cream butter and sugar until it is light and fluffy
4. Stir in vanilla and eggs , mix well
5. Add the lime zest and rum
6. Stir well to combine
7. Gradually add the dry ingredients , alternating with the heavy cream and ending with the dry ingredients
8. Mix between additions until well combined
9. Grease a bundt cake pan with some butter
10. Pour batter into the pan and bake for approximately an hour or until a toothpick inserted into the cake comes out clean
11. Carefully turn out and cool on a wire rack
12. Dust with some powdered sugar if desired
13. You can also sprinkle on some more rum too
14. Slice and serve when cool

title: buttermilk kuchen
steps:
1. Mix together sugars , flour , salt , nutmeg , and oil
2. Take out 1 / 2 cup of this mixture and stir in cinnamon
3. Set aside for topping
4. To remaining mixture , add well beaten egg , buttermilk , and soda
5. Pour into greased 10x15 inch greased jelly-roll pan
6. Spread with fruit to lightly cover sheet
7. Sprinkle reserved topping over evenly
8. Bake 325 degrees f
9. For 30 minutes

title: cold indian split pea soup
steps:
1. Pick over the peas to remove any grit & then wash and drain them
2. Place the drained peas in a large saucepan with water and turmeric
3. Bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat and cover
5. Simmer for 90 minutes or until peas are tender
6. Remove from heat
7. Put peas & liquid into a blender or food processor
8. Add the lemon juice , cumin , coriander , chili , salt and pepper
9. Blend until smooth
10. Transfer to a serving bowl and refrigerate until cool
11. Garnish with a swirl of yogurt

title: fruit cobbler
steps:
1. Melt butter in 8 x 8 cake pan
2. Mix remaining ingredients together into pan
3. Spoon sweetened fruit over batter
4. Bake at 375 for 35-45 minutes

title: ginger skillet steak strips with bell peppers
steps:
1. In a bowl combine the flour with garlic , ginger , salt and black pepper
2. Add in the beef strips and toss to coat
3. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
4. Add the beef to the skillet and saute for about 3 minutes
5. Add in the chili flakes bell peppers , onions and stir with wooden spoon for about 1 minute
6. Add in consomme , soy sauce and sesame oil
7. Cover and simmer for about 7-8 minutes or until the veggies are just crisp-tender
8. Season with black pepper to taste

title: vegan chicken salad
steps:
1. Steam tempeh for 15 minutes
2. Remove from heat and set aside to cool
3. Toss together all ingredients
4. Add 1-2 teaspoons of curry powder to spice it up a little
5. And of course , refrigerate

title: always perfect chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Sift dry ingredients together and set aside
2. Cream shortening , butter , and sugars together , then eggs and vanilla extract
3. Slowly blend in dry ingredients , about a third of the total amount at a time
4. Stir in chocolate chips
5. Drop by large tablespoons onto an ungreased cookie sheet , leaving at least 2 inches between to allow cookies to spread
6. Bake at 375f for 11-12 minutes or until lightly golden
7. Makes 2-3 dozen cookies depending on size

title: kelly stew
steps:
1. Cut steak into 1 inch pieces
2. Slice onion
3. Cut carrots into 2 inch pieces
4. Chop celery
5. Add above ingredients to a large pot and cover with tomatoes , pepper and tapioca
6. Cover pot and cook in a 275 to 300 degree preheated oven for six hours
7. Serve over mashed potatoes

title: horsey ham casserole
steps:
1. Cook noodles according to package directions
2. Cook butter , milk and flour in large saucepan on low until thick
3. Add velveeta , horseradish , mustard and pepper to white sauce and cook until creamy
4. Add ham and cooked noodles to white sauce , mix thoroughly
5. Pour into 9x13 inch glass or metal baking pan
6. Cook uncovered at 350f for 45 minutes

title: vegetarian japanese curry
steps:
1. Heat oil in large pot over medium heat
2. Saute onion 7 to 9 minutes , or until onion starts to brown
3. Add carrots and saute 5 minutes
4. Stir in curry powder and garlic and cook 1 minutes , or until fragrant
5. Add broth , potatoes , apple , ketchup , worcestershire sauce and miso
6. Bring to a simmer
7. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook 30 minutes , or until the potatoes are tender
8. Add edamame and simmer 5 minutes more
9. Serve over sticky rice

title: smashed roots and tubers with chevre
steps:
1. Peel and trim all vegetables , and cube in 1-inch pieces
2. Bring large pot of water to boil , and add vegetables
3. Cook until just tender , about 15 minutes
4. Drain and return to pan
5. Add chevre and butter and mash until desired consistency
6. Stir in chives and season with salt and pepper to taste
7. Bring back to heat over medium burner , stirring to keep from sticking
8. Serve

title: mom  i m home  p b banana chocolate chip muffins  rsc  12
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Stir together flour , splenda , brown sugar , baking powder and cinnamon
3. In another bowl , combine bananas , milk , peanut butter , oil , vanilla , egg white and applesauce
4. Add the two mixtures together and stir until combined
5. There should be no lumps
6. Gently stir in mini chocolate chips
7. If making loaves , pour batter evenly into two sprayed 8"x 4" loaf pans
8. If making muffins , pour batter evenly into sprayed muffin tins , or use cupcake liners
9. Depending on size of tins , you will have enough batter for 15-18 muffins
10. If you'd like to make just one loaf of bread , you will have enough extra batter to make 6 large muffins
11. Bake bread for 50-55 minutes
12. Bake muffins for 20-25 minutes
13. Use toothpick test to check for doneness
14. Dust with powdered sugar when cool

title: bea s pesto bruschetta
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees farenheit
2. Mix together butter , pesto and garlic
3. Spread butter mixture over bread slices
4. Mix together tomatoes and parsley
5. Top bread slices with tomato and parsley mixture
6. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
7. Place on a baking sheet and cook for 15 minutes

title: anything goes muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Line muffin tins with paper liners
3. Set aside
4. Measure flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda , cinnamon and salt into large bowl
5. With your fingers , break brown sugar apart until no lumps remain
6. Whisk to blend ingredients together
7. Break eggs into medium bowl
8. Add milk , oil , orange rind and vanilla
9. Whisk until smooth and no streaks remain
10. With rubber spatula , scrape over dry ingredients
11. Sprinkle with blueberries
12. With wooden spoon , stir together just until only a few streaks of flour remain
13. Using ice cream scoop , fill muffin cups almost full with batter
14. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden and domed
15. Wearing oven mitts , remove pans from oven to rack and let cool for 10 minutes
16. Lift muffins out of pans and let cool completely on rack

title: grilled cheese with bacon and apples
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Line baking sheet with foil and arrange bacon slices
3. They can be touching but make sure they do not overlap
4. Bake 15-25 minutes depending on your desired tastes - i like my bacon extra crispy so i went the full 25
5. Remove and drain on paper towels
6. Heat large skillet over medium heat
7. Assemble sandwich
8. Generously spread dijon on 4 slices of bread
9. Top with slices of cheddar , 3 pieces of bacon , apple slices and additional cheddar
10. Place the remaining bread on top and spread with butter
11. Place on skillet buttered side down and butter the remaining side
12. Cook until cheese starts to melt and bread is browned , about 4 minutes
13. Flip the sandwich and continue to cook until cheese is melted and bread is golden brown , about 2-3 minutes

title: scalloped potatoes   dairy free
steps:
1. Cook the margarine , flour , chicken broth , mayonnaise , salt and pepper , whisking constantly until bubbly and thick
2. Slice the potatoes paper thin
3. You can use a mandolin for this
4. Mix the potatoes and onions and place in a deep oven-safe bowl
5. Pour the sauce over the potatoes
6. Sprinkle with paprika
7. Bake at 350f for 1-1 / 2 hours

title: acorn squash with spiced brazil nut filling
steps:
1. Cut acorn squash in half lengthwise
2. Then scrape out seeds and stringy portions
3. Put dry ingredients , nuts and grated rind in mixing bowl
4. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse meal
5. Place squash halves in baking pan and fill with crumbly mixture
6. Set the bottom of the baking pan in hot water , cover and bake at 400f for 30 minutes
7. Uncover and bake 30 minutes longer

title: flavored butter  chili and garlic butter
steps:
1. Mix all until smooth and store in refrigerator
2. For gift:
3. Wrap each butter roll in foil and then tissue paper , twisting the ends like a sweet wrapper
4. Add a label with the flavour
5. Include suggestions for uses or recipes and bundle together in a gift basket

title: white bean bruschetta
steps:
1. Preheat grill pan or broiler
2. In a bowl , gently combine the beans , olive oil , balsamic vinegar , red pepper , basil and garlic
3. Season with salt and pepper to taste
4. It's nice if the mixture can sit for a half an hour or so
5. For the bread: i usually warm a clove or two of chopped garlic in some olive oil to infuse the flavor
6. This can be done on the stovetop over very low heat , or in the microwave heated for about 30 seconds
7. Add a couple shakes of salt and pepper , and brush garlic oil evenly over the bread slices
8. Toast bread under the broiler , or on a grill pan for a few minutes , until slightly brown and crisp , or until there are grill marks
9. Top the bread slices with the bean mixture and drizzle any extra balsamic / oil over the top
10. This bruschetta is nice served with a tossed green salad

title: mexican chicken red mole  mole colorado de pollo
steps:
1. Place chilies in large saucepan
2. Add water to cover
3. Bring to a boil , remove from heat and let stand 1 hour
4. Cover chilies with a plate to submerge them
5. Season chicken on both sides with salt and pepper
6. Heat a large saucepan or dutch oven over medium heat
7. Add olive oil to coat bottom of pan
8. Add chicken , and lightly brown on all sides
9. Then add 4 cups water and 1 / 4 onion
10. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour
11. Grind sesame seeds , cloves , peppercorns , cinnamon , oregano , and thyme until pulverized
12. Set aside
13. Drain soaked ancho chilies and remove stems and seeds
14. Puree chilies in blender , adding a little water if needed
15. Pass through a sieve to strain out the peels
16. Without washing blender , puree onion and tomato
17. Remove chicken and strain broth into a bowl or pot
18. Add pureed chilies and tomato-onion mixture to pan
19. Cook over medium heat for about 7 minutes , stirring occasionally
20. Add ground spice mixture , 1 1 / 2 cups of reserved broth , chocolate
21. Sugar , and salt to taste
22. Add the meat
23. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes
24. Add more broth as desired for consistency
25. Serve with soft tortillas and steamed rice , if you desire

title: my ivy chopped salad
steps:
1. Make the dressing: whisk vinegar with agave nectar and lime juice in a bowl
2. Slowly whisk in oil
3. Add salt and pepper to taste
4. Set aside
5. Prepare salad: steam or boil beets until cooked through , about 30 minutes
6. Let cool
7. Peel and cut into a medium dice
8. While beets are cooking prepare the rest of the ingredients
9. Heat a grill or grill pan over medium-low heat
10. Rub zucchini , corn , scallions and salmon with oil
11. Sprinkle with salt
12. Grill vegetables and fish until browned and cooked through [flip once] , about 20 minutes
13. Cut zucchini and scallions into a medium dice
14. Cut corn off the cob
15. Break salmon into large pieces
16. Toss grilled vegetables with lettuce , tomatoes , cilantro and basil
17. Place on a large platter and top with salmon
18. Drizzle with vinaigrette
19. Serve with lime quarters

title: bacon wrapped chicken breasts with gorgonzola  walnut stuffing
steps:
1. Place oven rack 6 inches from the top of the oven and preheat oven to 350
2. Mash together gorgonzola , walnuts , breadcrumbs and sage
3. Season with pepper
4. Mold into 4 logs
5. Cut a deep pocket into the thickest side of each breast
6. Season chicken breast with salt and pepper
7. Stuff each breast with a cheese log
8. Smooth side of each breast facing up , wrap a bacon slice around the chicken breast in a spiral
9. If necessary , use a toothpick to secure
10. Heat oil in oven-safe skillet over med-high
11. Place chicken , smooth sides up , in the skillet
12. Cook until undersides are browned , about 2 minutes
13. Turn carefully and brown the other side
14. Drain fat from the skillet
15. Loosely cover skillet with foil
16. Cook about 20 minutes
17. Remove foil and place skillet on oven rack and broil until bacon crisps , about 2 minutes

title: hawaiian ham salad
steps:
1. Combine ham , pineapple , celery , and olives
2. Mix
3. Mayonnaise and lemon juice
4. Stir into ham mix
5. Chill at least an hour
6. Stir in peanuts before serving
7. -----

title: super easy oven baked chicken thighs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. In small bowl combine mustard , brown sugar and curry powder until well blended
3. Spread cornflake crumbs on a sheet of waxed paper
4. Spread some of the mustard on each thigh , coating both sides , and coat completely with crumbs
5. Place on a shallow baking pan and bake on center rack for 35-40 minutes , or until cooked through

title: grilled mouth watering barbecued chicken
steps:
1. Barbecue sauce:
2. Heat all barbecue sauce ingredients to boiling in 1-quart saucepan , stirring occasionally
3. Barbecued chicken:
4. Brush grill rack with vegetable oil
5. Heat grill to medium heat
6. Mix salt , paprika and pepper
7. Sprinkle both sides of chicken with salt mixture
8. Place chicken skin side up on grill rack
9. Cover and grill 4 to 6 inches from heat 15 minutes
10. Turn chicken
11. Brush with barbecue sauce
12. Cover and grill 20 to 25 minutes longer , turning and brushing with barbecue sauce , until juice of chicken is no longer pink when centers of thickest pieces are cut
13. To bake: heat oven to 425f mix salt , paprika and pepper
14. Mix in 1 / 2 cup gold medal all-purpose flour
15. Sprinkle both sides of chicken with flour mixture
16. Melt 1 / 4 cup butter or margarine in rectangular baking dish , 13x9x2 inches , in oven
17. Place chicken , skin sides down , in dish
18. Bake 45 minutes
19. Drain and turn chicken
20. Reduce oven temperature to 375f spoon hot barbecue sauce over chicken
21. Bake 15 minutes longer or until juice of chicken is no longer pink when centers of thickest pieces are cut

title: 3 ingredient sausage squares
steps:
1. Brown sausage in a 12" skillet
2. Drain
3. Add cream cheese , stirring until melted and well blended
4. Remove from heat and set aside
5. Press dough from one tube cresent rolls in a greased 9x13" baking pan -- being sure to cover bottom and part way up sides of pan
6. Press perforations together
7. Pour sausage mixture over the top -- set aside
8. Roll remaining crescent roll dough into a 13x9" rectangle , layer over sausage mixture
9. Bake at 350 for 15-20 minutes or until golden
10. Cut into squares to serve

title: cinnamon beef noodles
steps:
1. In a bowl , mix together the first 4 ingredients
2. Set aside
3. Heat 1 teaspoon oil in a large pot over medium-high heat
4. Add in half the beef , browning on all sides
5. Remove from pan and repeat procedure with 1 teaspoon oil and remaining beef
6. Return beef to pan
7. Add in water mixture , onions , garlic , cinnamon , and ginger
8. Bring to a boil
9. Lower heat , cover , and simmer 2 hours or until beef is tender
10. Discard ginger slices and cinnamon
11. Stir in spinach
12. Cook for 3 minutes or until wilted
13. Serve over noodles

title: very yummy fig jam and cream cheese spread or salad dressing
steps:
1. Mix cream cheese and jam together and refrigerate for at least two hours
2. Sprinkle nuts on top
3. Serve as a spread / dip with sliced pears , apples , assorted crackers
4. For salad:
5. Mix in the mayonnaise and drizzle over a bed of mixed lettuces , onion and sliced fruit and garnish with dried figs

title: ciasteczka z orzechami  polish walnut cookies
steps:
1. Cream the butter with the sugar mixing well
2. Add the egg and vanilla beat five minutes
3. Blend in the flour mixed with the baking powder combined with walnuts
4. Divide dough in half and shape into 2 rolls wrapping each roll in wax paper
5. Refrigerate overnight
6. Slice 1 / 8 thick , bake on a buttered cookie sheet at 400 for 5 - 7 minutes or until nicely golden

title: easy slow cooker bean dip
steps:
1. Add all the ingredients to a slow cooker
2. Stir to mix
3. Heat on low heat for 2-3 hours or until cheese melts
4. Stir often

title: christmas slice
steps:
1. Place dried fruit , fruit mince , butter , sugar , orange zest and juice in a large saucepan and over low heat stir until sugar dissolves and butter melts and then remove from heat and cool
2. Preheat oven to 160c / 140c fan forced
3. Lightly grease a 30x20cm slice pan and line with baking paper , extending paper at long sides for handles
4. Stir chocolate and egg into fruit mixture
5. Sift flours over mixture and stir to combine
6. Spread mixture into prepared pan and the spread mixture into prepared pan and then top with nuts and bake for 45-50 minutes or until a skewer inserted at centre combes out clean
7. Cool in pan and cut into pieces to serve

title: mini brioches  bread machine
steps:
1. Add ingredients to your bread machine in the order recommended by the manufacturer
2. Set cycle: dough , size: 1lb
3. Check your dough after 5 minutes , if too dry add a tablepoon of water at a time , if too wet add a tablespoon of flour at a time , until dough forms a ball and is slightly sticky to the touch
4. Meanwhile , oil 6 1-cup brioche molds
5. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
6. When the cycle is finished , take dough out and knead gently
7. Divide into 6 equal pieces , cut about a quarter from each
8. Shape into balls , and put the large ball into the mold , pressing with your finger in the center to make a hole
9. Place the small ball over the hole and press again to seal
10. Cover and leave to rise in a warm place until doubled , about 20-30 minutes
11. Brush with milk and bake for 5 minutes , reduce heat to 350 and bake until golden brown , about 15 minutes
12. If your brioches are browning too quickly , cover with aluminum foil
13. Brioches should sound hollow when you tap the bottom of each

title: dark molasses ginger ginger  cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f
2. Beat margarine , sugar , salt , molasses , ginger and eggs together in a large bowl for one minute
3. Sift flour and baking soda and add to molasses mixture
4. Drop by teaspoonsful on a greased cookie sheet
5. Flatten using the flat bottom of a glass dipped in water
6. Bake for 12 minutes
7. Remove the very soft cookies to a cooling rack using a spatula

title: marinated greek feta
steps:
1. Cut the feta cheese into 2cm cubes and place them in a shallow , ceramic dish
2. Combine the oil , pepper , oregano and bay leaf in a jug , pour this over the feta and cover and refrigerate overnight
3. Serve the feta on a mezze platter with olives , skordalia and crusty bread
4. If you remove the marinated feta from the refrigerator 1 hour before serving , the "cloudiness" will disperse , and the oil will be clear

title: chili bread
steps:
1. Cut bread in half lengthwise
2. Place cut sides up on a foil-covered baking sheet
3. In a bowl , mix together the beans , chili , spaghetti sauce , garlic , salt and pepper
4. Spread mixture evenly over the bread
5. Top with tomatoes and green onions
6. Sprinkle evenly with mozzarella and parmesan cheese
7. Bake at 350f for 10-12 minutes or until cheese is melted
8. Slice and serve

title: rich chocolate brownie cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c
2. Grease a deep 20cm cake pan and line base and sides with baking paper
3. Combine the sugar , sifted flour , cocoa and nuts in a large bowl
4. Add the chopped chocolate and mix
5. Make a well in centre
6. Combine the butter , vanilla and eggs and pour onto dry ingredients
7. Stir until moistened and mixed well
8. Pour into prepared pan and smooth the surface
9. Bake for 45-50 minutes or until a skewer inserted into centre comes out nearly clean
10. Cool in pan for 5-10 minutes before cooling on wire rack
11. Slice and dust with icing sugar

title: chicken loaf ii
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f
2. Line a 8 by 4 inch loaf pan with foil
3. In a large bowl , combine ground chicken , crushed stuffing mix , cheese , egg , onion and salt and pepper
4. Mix well and pack into the loaf pan
5. Spread ketchup over the loaf
6. Bake for 45 minutes or until a thermometer inserted in the center of the loaf reads 1800 f
7. Leave the loaf at room temperature for 10 minutes then drain off any liquid
8. Lift the loaf out of the pan , peel away the foil and slice
9. Makes 4 to 6 servings

title: char crusted raspberry ribs
steps:
1. Season both sides of ribs with seasoning blend , then coat both sides with raspberry chipotle sauce
2. Place on a foil-lined baking dish or roasting pan
3. Bake uncovered in a 350 degree oven for 1 1 / 2 hours
4. Glaze with additional raspberry chipotle sauce after they come out of the oven

title: broccoli   cranberry salad
steps:
1. Combine , broccoli , monterey jack , cheddar , cranberries , bacon bits& walnuts
2. Combine sugar , mayo , cider vinegar salt& pepper , mix well
3. Pour over the salad and mix well

title: cheesy twice stuffed baked potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Wash , dry potatoes , bake until soft
3. About 45-60 minutes
4. Cut a slice from the top of each potato being careful not to break skin
5. Scoop out insides
6. Mash well
7. Beat in sour cream , cheese , salt and pepper
8. If necessary , add more sour cream to make light and fluffy
9. Stir in onions
10. Spoon mixture back into shells
11. Place potatoes on a baking sheet
12. Dust tops with paprika and return to oven until lightly browned

title: spicy chicken drumsticks
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 450f
2. Mix all ingredients except the chicken in a large bowl
3. Roll the chicken in the mixture so it is well covered
4. Cook for 20 to 40 minutes or until chicken is fully cooked

title: sgt  michael s  steak marinade with a kicker
steps:
1. Blend all in a gallon size zip loc bag
2. Add in meat
3. Mush around
4. Beat it like rocky balboa
5. Let sit in marinade until ready to cook or 10 minute
6. On grill sear the outside for 1 min each side
7. Brush on remaining seasoning from bag
8. Grill til done
9. For larger cuts of beef as in roast let marinade no more than 30 min , place in roasting pan with all sauce and cook til done
10. Cooking / grilling time includes marinade time for steaks
11. Increase as needed

title: spicy sriracha ramen
steps:
1. Prepare enough water as suggested on the ramen package and prepare the ginger while the water is heating to a boil
2. Cook the noodles in the boiling water for 2 minutes
3. After 2 minutes , drop in the egg and stir quickly with a fork
4. Then add the ginger , bullion , and bean sprouts and let cook for an additional minute , so that the noodles cook for a total of 3 minutes
5. Drain the water
6. Stir in the soy sauce and sriracha sauce
7. On the plate , garnish with red pepper flakes and chives

title: blueberry muffins from the loveless cafe
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees
2. Whisk the butter , sugar , salt , eggs , and vanilla together in a bowl
3. Sift the flour and baking powder into the butter mixture
4. Stir
5. Add the berries to the mix and gently fold a few times
6. Add the buttermilk and mix gently
7. Scoop out the dought into paper-lined muffin pans
8. Sprinkle with additional sugar if desired , and bake for 20 to 35 minutes , depending on the size of your muffin pans
9. This will make 12 standard sized muffins or 6 texas sized muffins

title: pork cutlets a la creme
steps:
1. Pound pork cutlets to about 1 / 8" thick
2. Cut each into 2 or 3 pieces and set aside
3. Beat egg and water with a fork in a pie plate
4. Combine flour , salt and pepper
5. Dip cutlets in egg mixture and then into flour mixture , coating both sides
6. Melt 2 t butter or margarine in a large skillet
7. Cook cutlet pieces , a few at a time , until brown on both sides , adding more butter as needed
8. Remove cutlets to a warm platter
9. Into the same skillet , over medium heat , stir in half and half , wine , and bouillon , scraping brown bits from bottom of skillet
10. Cook and stir 3 minutes until thickened and flavors are blended
11. Pour sauce over cutlets and sprinkle with parsley

title: the suffed crepes have a mild spice  ragu
steps:
1. Prep: remove stems from arugula and chop into about 1 to 2 inch pieces
2. Slice bacon into thin strips
3. In a medium sauce pan start heating the ragu sauce low top
4. Add red wine , 1 / 2 cup feta , capers and 1 / 2 cup arugula let simmer for flavor to blend while preparing rest
5. Make sure to stir occasionally
6. In another pan on medium heat add light amount of olive oil , italian sausage , bacon , garlic , black pepper
7. Sautee until italian sausage is cook through stirring occasionallyfor about 10 to 15 minutes
8. Drain the dripping from meat into the sauce that is simmering in other pan , and add 2 / 3 cup of meat mix , stir and raise heat to burn off the alcohol from the wine for about 5 mins then reduce to low
9. Add the remaining arugula to meat mixture and cook for another 5-7 minutes or until the leaves have softened a little , add a dash of salt , stir then reduce heat to 1
10. Turn oven to broil and place a rack on lowest shelf
11. While oven is warming up
12. Start to fill the crepes with he meat mixture , 2 / 3 cup of meat mixture for each 9 inch crepe
13. Roll up crepes and place on a lightly oiled baking sheet
14. Top with the remaining 2 / 3 cup of meat mixture and rest of the crumbled feta cheese , broil for about 2-3 mins until golden brown on the top of the crepes
15. Remove from oven and place 2 of the rolled crepes per plate and coat equal parts of the sauce over each entre

title: carolina red pulled pork shoulder
steps:
1. In a small bowl mix the rub ingredients
2. Coat the pork shoulder all over with the rub and press the spices into the meat
3. Allow the pork to stand at room temperature for 30 to 40 minutes before grilling
4. Follow the grills instruction for smoking with wood chips
5. With the lid closed , grill and smoke the pork , fat side up , over indirect low heat for about 1 hour
6. Meanwhile , make the sauce
7. In a heavy-bottom saucepan , whisk together the sauce ingredients
8. Bring to a boil over high heat , reduce the heat , and let simmer for about 25 minutes
9. Season to taste with salt and pepper , and , if desired , add extra hot pepper sauce
10. After the pork has been grilling for 1 hour , baste it with the sauce and continue to baste every 30 minutes
