11. Continue grilling until the temperature at the center of the meat registers 180f when it is done , the meat should be tender enough to tear with your fingers
12. The total grilling time will be 5 to 6 hours
13. Transfer the pork shoulder to a baking sheet , brush liberally with some remaining sauce , and tightly cover with aluminum foil
14. Let the pork rest for 30 minutes before serving
15. To serve , pull the warm meat apart with your fingers or two forks and shred into pieces
16. Discard any large pieces of fat
17. Pile the seasoned pork on hamburger buns along with your favorite coleslaw and a generous amount of sauce

title: carrot   turnip
steps:
1. Boil the carrots and turnip until they are tender enough for mashing
2. Mash them
3. Add salt & pepper to taste and stir through
4. Add butter to taste and stir through

title: purple potato gratin
steps:
1. Begin by making the gratin sauce
2. In a small pan place the butter and melt
3. Over medium heat add the flour and stir to combine , approximately one minute
4. Slowly whisk in the milk and stir until thickened
5. Add cheese and when melted remove pan from heat
6. Add salt and pepper to taste
7. Add the olive oil to a frying pan and heat
8. Add shallots and saute until slightly brown and caramelized
9. Remove from the pan and set aside
10. Place bacon in same skillet and cook through but do not let bacon get crispy
11. Remove from pan and cut into one inch pieces
12. Grease a gratin dish or shallow baking dish and add one half of the sliced potatoes
13. Sprinkle the shallots over the potatoes and then add the remaining potato slices
14. Pour the gratin sauce over the potatoes and spoon into visible cracks and crevices
15. Top with parmesan cheese and bacon
16. Bake for 40 minutes in a preheated 350 degree oven
17. Serve immediately

title: 7th inning stretch layered potato salad
steps:
1. Whisk eggs and sugar in medium saucepan
2. Whisk in vinegar and 2 tablespoons water
3. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat
4. Boil 4 minutes or until thickened , stirring constantly
5. Pour into medium bowl
6. Whisk in mayonnaise , mustard and salt
7. Refrigerate until well-chilled
8. Meanwhile , cook potatoes in large saucepan of simmering water over medium to medium-low heat 20 minutes or until just tender when pierced with a knife
9. Drain
10. Cool
11. Peel
12. Cut into 1-inch pieces
13. Layer potatoes , celery , red onion , eggs , dressing , green onions and sunflower seeds in large clear bowl

title: omelette with mushrooms for one
steps:
1. Crack the eggs into a bowl , add 1 teaspoon of cold water , and beat with a fork until you can't see white from yellow
2. Set aside
3. In a small frying pan , over medium-high heat , cook the shallots in half the butter until soft , add the mushrooms all at once and cook , stirring , until the mushrooms are half wilted
4. Add the herbs and mascarpone with salt and pepper and cook until the cream has melted
5. Remove from the heat
6. In a medium , non-stick frying pan , heat the remaining butter , over medium-high heat
7. Pour in the eggs , and with a rubber spatula draw the egg mixture across the pan in one direction and then in the other
8. You should have a mound of fluffy eggs in the middle of the pan
9. Let the remaining egg mixture sit and cook for half a minute , then , with the rubber spatula , lift the edges of the omelette around so that the remaining liquid slides underneath
10. When all the eggs are lightly cooked , remove the pan from the heat
11. With your wrist facing the ceiling , slide half the omelette onto a heated plate , cover this with the mushroom mixture , then , fold over the other half of the omelette

title: creamy meatballs and vegetables
steps:
1. In a 3-1 / 2 quart crockpot , mix the meatballs , potatoes and vegetables
2. Combine the soup , water and black pepper and pour over , stirring lightly to coat everything
3. Cover and cook on lo for 5-7 hours
4. Stir the sour cream into 1 / 4 cup of the pot liquid
5. Stir this back into the pot
6. In this case , cut them into wedges and precook them 6 or 7 minutes in boiling salted water

title: sarge s spaghetti polpette
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300
2. Brown beef and sausage in the olive oil
3. Remove meat mixture and set to the side without removing pan juices
4. Saute onions in remaining pan juices
5. Drain onions and add to the meat
6. Cook noodles about five minutes in slightly salted water , drain and transfer to a large baking dish or casserole dish
7. Stir in meat and onion mixture along with remaining ingredients
8. Do not include the bread crumbs
9. Sprinkle bread crumbs over the top
10. Cook at 300 degrees for 3 hours

title: three tomato pasta
steps:
1. Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add the onion and saute until tender , about 4 minutes
3. Add the garlic , saute for a minute or two being careful not to let the garlic burn
4. Add sun-dried tomatoes and next 5 ingredients
5. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 20 minutes , stirring frequently
6. Mixture will reduce
7. Prepare penne while the sauce cooks
8. Drain , place pasta in same pot that you cooked it in and add the sauce , cheese , parsley and basil , if using
9. Mix lightly and serve

title: chayote  corn   tomato salad
steps:
1. After steaming the chayote , cool , peel and cut into 1 / 2" cubes
2. Combine the chayote , corn , tomatoes& green onions
3. In your blender or food processor blend together the lime juice , salt& red pepper flakes
4. Slowly pour in the olive oil with the blender on
5. Toss the dressing with the salad , sprinkle with the parsley flakes chill and serve

title: klupskies  polish burgers
steps:
1. Mix beef , onion , green pepper , eggs , salt , and ketchup
2. Tear bread up into small chunks and mix into the beef until the pieces are evenly distributed
3. Form meat into 4 patties
4. Cook in a skillet sprayed with olive oil spray over medium heat until one side is browned
5. Turn and cook other side , until the other side is brown and the juices from the burgers run clear
6. Please

title: emeril s homemade pepper sauce
steps:
1. Remove the stems from the peppers , cut them lengthwise in half , and remove the seeds
2. Cut crosswise into 1 / 2-inch-thick slices
3. Put the peppers , vinegar , water , and salt in a medium-size nonreactive saucepan over medium-high heat
4. Bring to a boil , reduce the heat to medium , and simmer for 20 minutes
5. Remove from the heat and let steep until completely cool
6. Pour the mixture into a food processor or blender and process until smooth
7. Strain through a fine-mesh strainer , pour into sterilized bottles , and secure with airtight lids
8. Refrigerate and let age for at least 2 weeks before using

title: light and creamy vanilla ice cream   anne of green gables
steps:
1. You will need:
2. Double boiler
3. Measuring spoons
4. Measuring cups
5. Small saucepan
6. Wooden spoon
7. 2 small mixing bowls
8. Fork
9. Wire strainer
10. Electric mixer
11. 2 large mixing bowls
12. Rubber spatula
13. Metal bowl or pan
14. Put the whipping cream , electric beaters and one of the large mixing bowls in the refrigerator to chill
15. Put about 2 inches of water in the bottom of the double boiler and bring to a boil
16. Put the gelatin and the cold water in the top pot of the double boiler
17. Let the gelatin soften for 5 minutes away from the stove
18. Meanwhile , pour the milk into the small saucepan and place it over medium low heat
19. When tiny bubbles form around the edge of the pot , the milk is ready
20. To the gelatin in the top pot of the double boiler add the hot milk , sugar , corn syrup , flour , and salt
21. Place over the bottom pot containing the boiling water
22. Stir constantly with the wooden spoon until the mixture thickens- about 15 minutes
23. Put the lid on and cook the mixture over boiling water for another 10 minutes
24. Meanwhile , separate the egg into the 2 small mixing bowls
25. Set aside the egg white for later
26. Beat the egg yolk slightly with a fork
27. When the 10 minutes are up , stir the egg yolk very slowly into the mixture on top of the stove
28. Cook and stir for 1 more minute
29. Pour the hot ice cream mixture through a wire strainer into the other large mixing bowl
30. When the ice cream mixture has cooled to room temperature , beat it with the electric mixer until it is light and creamy - about 5 minutes
31. In the chilled large mixing bowl whip the cold whipping cream with the electric mixer until it falls in large globs and forms a soft peak
32. Rinse the beaters thoroughly with hot water
33. Then beat the egg white until it is stiff and glossy but not dry
34. Very gently with the rubber spatula , fold first the whipped cream , then the egg white into the ice cream mixture
35. Gently stir in the vanilla
36. Spoon the mixture into the metal bowl or pan and place in the freezer
37. Freeze for about 3 or 4 hours - until firm

title: balsamic mushroom chicken
steps:
1. Dust the chicken lightly with flour and brown in 1 tablespoons of the olive oil over medium heat , about 2 minutes on each side
2. Remove the chicken , set aside
3. Add the remaining tablespoon of oil to the pan and saute the garlic cloves and mushrooms about 3 to 5 minutes , or until most of the moisture from the mushrooms has evaporated
4. Add the vinegar , broth , bay leaf and thyme
5. Cook about 5 minutes over medium heat until reduced slightly
6. Return the chicken to the pan , cover , and simmer another 2 to 4 minutes or until cooked through but not overdone

title: alice springs chicken quesadillas
steps:
1. With an electric mixer combine the mustard , honey , and 1 tbsp oil , and lemon juice for 1 minute
2. Pour 1 / 2 mixture over chicken in a gallon ziplock to marinate in fridge 2-24 hours
3. Chill remaining marinade to serve with chicken
4. After marinating chicken , put remaining oil in frying pan
5. Sear chicken on both sides until cooked thru
6. Transfer chicken to a pan and brush with marinade
7. Keep warm
8. Meanwhile in frying pan add butter and saute mushrooms
9. Remove from the heat
10. Cut chicken into bite size pieces and line your ingredients up , this part will go quickly ! chicken , cheese , mushrooms and bacon
11. If you have a quesadilla maker get it heated up , otherwise , heat a frying pan and to medium heat and spread a little butter or non stick spray on the bottom
12. Prepare tortillas by spreading a little butter on the ousides
13. Place a tortilla , butter side down and add chicken , mushrooms , bacon and then the cheese but do not overfill
14. Place the other tortilla on top , butter side up
15. Flip once bottom side is golden and do the same to the remaining side
16. Repeat until you are out of ingredients
17. Use the remaining honey mustard for dipping

title: durkee famous sauce  clone
steps:
1. Whirl all ingredients in blender on high speed until smooth , about two minutes
2. Transfer to top of double boiler and cook over gently boiling water , stirring often for 12 to 15 minutes or until thickened and smooth
3. Replace mixture back into blender and whirl 30 seconds or until smooth , using high speed
4. Refrigerate in covered container 24 hours before using
5. Keep covered in the refrigerator for up to 3 months

title: brown sugar meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Lightly grease a 5x9 inch loaf pan
3. Press the brown sugar in the bottom of the prepared loaf pan and spread the ketchup over the sugar
4. In a mixing bowl , mix thoroughly all remaining ingredients and shape into a loaf
5. Place on top of the ketchup
6. Bake in preheated oven for 1 hour or until juices are clear

title: zucchini avocado saute
steps:
1. Melt butter or margarine in large skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add mushrooms and cook 5 minutes or until soft
3. Remove from skillet and set aside
4. Add zucchini and green pepper to skillet and cook 10 minutes
5. Remove from heat and put in serving dish
6. Add avocado and mushrooms to zucchini mixture and sprinkle with cheese and chili powder
7. Stir to combine all ingredients
8. Garnish with sour cream , chives and / or chopped chili peppers

title: stove top smoker new beef brisket   bbq sauce recipe
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients and rub onto brisket
2. Place on a large sheet of plastic wrap , and wrap tightly
3. Place on a baking sheet and chill for 6 -8 hours
4. Remove meat from refrigerator and bring to room temperature
5. Prepare the smoker with the mesquite and apple wood chips
6. Line drip tray with foil , and place the meat on the rack
7. Preheat the stovetop
8. Place smoker on stove top and smoke for 1 hours at a medium to low heat setting
9. Preheat oven to 275 degrees
10. Remove meat from smoker and place in a covered roasting pan or wrap in heavy foil
11. Bake for 3 hours
12. Remove meat from the oven and carve against the grain
13. Serve with bbq sauce on the side for dipping
14. Barbecue sauce:
15. Tbsp vegetable oil
16. Cup chopped yellow onion
17. 1 tsp chopped garlic
18. 1 cup ketchup
19. 2 tbsp dark brown sugar
20. 1 tsp molasses
21. 2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
22. 1 tbsp each lemon juice , orange juice , dry mustard , worcestershire sauce , hot red sauce
23. In a large saucepan , heat oil over a medium high heat , add onions , cook till soft , stirring 4 minutes
24. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute
25. Add the rest of the ingredients and bring to boil lower the heat to simmer and cook stirring occasionally until sauce thickens 15 20 minutes
26. Cool slightly before serving
27. Enjoy !

title: grilled salmon salad with vegetable and balsamic dressing
steps:
1. Mix 1 / 2 cup oil and lime juice in small bowl
2. Season to taste with salt and pepper
3. Place salmon in ziplock bag and pour marinade over salmon
4. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours , turning once
5. Combine 3 / 4 cup oil , tomatoes , carrot , zucchini , parsley , vinegar , olives , basil , tarragon , and capers in bowl
6. Season to taste with salt and pepper
7. Prepare barbecue or preheat broiler
8. Grill salmon until just cooked through , about 4 minutes per side
9. Toss greens and endive with enough vegetable dressing to coat
10. Divide among 6 plates
11. Place salmon atop greens
12. Spoon additional vegetable dressing over and serve

title: southern sweet potatoe pie
steps:
1. To prepare sweet potatoes:
2. With the oil cover the sweet potatoe skin with the oil 1 teaspoon =1 sweet potatoe
3. Poke holes in the sweet potatoe on all sides with a fork
4. Place on a cookie sheet and bake @ 375 degrees for about an hour or until the sweet potaotes are mushy to touch
5. Take them out of the oven and let cool
6. Once cooled the skin has to be peeled
7. It will peel off very easily to be careful not to tear up the sweet potatoe
8. Once they are all peeled put in a big bowl and with an electrical mixer start blending the sweet potatoes
9. Blend all wet ingredients together except the egg whites
10. Blend all dry ingredients together
11. The potatoes will be a little heavier than pudding consistency
12. Once all blended taste to adjust sugar sweetness to your liking
13. Next beat egg whites until you have high peaks
14. Fold in egg whites
15. Potoaotes will fluff up with air
16. Pour potatoes into pie crusts and bake @ 350 degrees for 45 minuets
17. You'll start to see dark brown areas on the top of the pies
18. Take out let it cool
19. Once cool serve with cool whip
20. Yummy !

title: melissa s drop biscuits with green onions
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f
2. Put the flour , baking powder , and salt in a food processor and pulse briefly to mix
3. Add the butter and pulse until the mixture is crumbly
4. Add green onion and parmesan and pulse just enough to blend
5. Add the milk and pulse until combined
6. Drop the dough in rounded tablespoons onto a greased baking sheet , and bake until golden , about 13 to 15 minutes

title: jumbo coconut cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375
2. Film the inside of the muffin / cupcake cups with nonstick cooking spray
3. Set aside
4. Sift the flour , baking soda , salt and nutmeg onto a sheet of waxed paper
5. Cream the butter in the large bowl of a freestanding electric mixer on moderate speed for 3 minutes
6. Add half of the superfine sugar and beat for 1 minute
7. Add the balance of the superfine sugar and beat for 2 minutes longer
8. Beat in the eggs , one at a time , mixing for 45 seconds after each addition
9. Blend in the vanilla extract
10. Scrape down the sides of the mixing bowl frequently with a rubber spatula to keep the batter even textured
11. On low-speed , alternately add the sifted mixture in three additions with the sour cream in two additions , beginning and ending with the sifted mixture
12. The batter will be smooth , moderately thick , and buttercream-like
13. On low speed blend in the coconut
14. Divide the batter among the prepared muffin / cupcake cups , mounding it slightly in the center
15. Bake the cupcakes for 30 to 35 minutes , or until risen and completely set
16. When baked , a wooden pick inserted in the center of a cupcake will withdraw clean
17. Cool the cupcakes in the pans on racks for 15 minutes
18. Carefully remove the cupcakes to cooling racks
19. Cool completely

title: butternut squash with browned butter and thyme
steps:
1. Heat a large skillet on medium heat
2. Add the butter , whisking frequently
3. Continue to cook the butter
4. Once melted it will foam up a bit , then subside
5. Honey-colored browned milk solids will begin to form
6. The butter should have a wonderful nutty aroma
7. Remove from heat
8. Add the thyme , whisking continuously
9. If using fresh thyme , the mixture will foam up a bit
10. Add the cubed butternut squash pieces to the pan and return the pan to the burner , heating to medium high
11. Use a wooden or metal spoon to stir the squash pieces so they are all well coated with the butter thyme mixture
12. Sprinkle generously with salt and pepper
13. Spread the squash pieces out in an even layer and let cook , without stirring , so that they brown a bit on one side
14. Stir and spread the pieces out again and let cook without stirring so more sides get browned
15. Reduce the heat to low , cover the pan , and let cook until the squash is tender , 10 to 20 minutes , depending on how big you cut the pieces
16. Add more salt and pepper to taste , sprinkle with a bit more chopped fresh thyme before serving

title: velveeta dirty dip
steps:
1. Cube velveeta cheese
2. In large crock pot on medium heat add in cheese , taco sauce , and salsa
3. Brown ground sausage and drain
4. Add sausage to cheese mixture in crock pot
5. Allow mixture to completely melt before serving
6. Serve with favorite tortilla chips

title: crock pot cabbage roll casserole
steps:
1. In a large skillet brown together the beef , onion , garlic , salt and pepper
2. Cook to done
3. Drain
4. Add to this the tomato sauce , 1 / 2 can of soup and mix well
5. Add the rice and water and mix well
6. In your crock pot layer 1 / 2 meat mixture , 1 / 2 cabbage
7. Repeat
8. Mix together the remaining soup and tomato juice
9. Slowly pour over mixture in crock
10. Cook on high for 4-6 hours , or low for 8-10 hours

title: sugar dove cookies
steps:
1. In a large bowl with an electric mixer , beat the butter and sugar until light and fluffy
2. Add the egg and vanilla extract and beat until combined
3. In a separate bowl whisk together the flour , salt baking soda and cream of tartar
4. Add the flour mixture and beat until you have a smooth dough
5. Cover dough and refrigerate for about 30 minutes
6. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
7. Using a tablespoon or a small cookie scoop , roll dough into 1" balls
8. Roll each cookie dough ball in granulated sugare and place in a well greased mini muffin pan
9. Bake for 15 to 18 minutes or until the edges of the cookies are light brown
10. Remove pan from oven and immediately press an unwrapped dove chocolate miniature in the center of the cookie being cautious not to push through the bottom of the cookie
11. Cool completely before removing the cookies from the pan
12. You may have to place the pan in the refrigerator for a few minutes to get the cookies cooled enough

title: five meat chili con carne with beans
steps:
1. In a large pot brown meat in stages , about a 1 / 4 at a time
2. Remove meat
3. Add onion and garlic and cook until translucent
4. Return meat to the pot , add the tomato juice , and 1 / 2 the spices
5. Cook about 1 hour and add the tomato sauce and the rest of the spices
6. Let simmer about 2 hours
7. Add the beans and simmer about 30 more minutes , then enjoy
8. I like mine served with corn bread and grated cheddar cheese

title: apple skewers
steps:
1. Thread apples on four skewers that are lightly spray with cooking spray
2. Combine sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over apples
3. Lightly coat the grill rack with oil if needed
4. Grill , covered , over medium heat for 6-8 minutes or until golden
5. Turn them and cook another 8-10 minutes longer or until golden and tender
6. Serve warm

title: incredibly easy cocoa cappuccino mousse
steps:
1. In medium saucepan , combine sc milk , cocoa , butter , and coffee
2. Cook over low heat until smooth
3. Remove from heat
4. Cool
5. In large bowl , fold together choc mixture and whipped cream / cool whip
6. Pour into 8 dessert dishes
7. Optional: garnish with whipped cream and sprinkle some cocoa powder ove it
8. Enjoy !

title: cajun chicken over pasta
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil
2. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente
3. Drain
4. Place the chicken and the cajun seasoning in a plastic bag
5. Shake to coat
6. In a large skillet over medium heat , saut the chicken in butter or margarine until almost tender
7. Add the red bell pepper , green bell pepper , mushrooms and green onion
8. Saut and stir for 2 to 3 minutes
9. Reduce heat
10. Add the cream , basil , lemon pepper , salt , garlic powder and ground black pepper
11. Heat through
12. Add the cooked linguine , toss and heat through
13. Sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese and serve

title: spicy lentil tomato stew
steps:
1. Optionally , you can soak the lentils in cold water before you start the prep for this
2. Drain them before you add them to the soup
3. Mince the onion , celery , and garlic
4. Peel and mince the carrot
5. Warm the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat
6. Add the onion , carrot , and celery with a pinch of salt
7. Cook , stirring often , for 6 minutes
8. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minutes
9. Sprinkle on the spices , and stir
10. Make a space in the middle of the pot , and add the tomato paste
11. Mix everything together until a thick paste forms
12. Add the chopped tomatoes with their juice and stir
13. Add the chicken broth and water and stir
14. Add the lentils
15. Bring to a boil , then back the heat off to a simmer
16. Simmer for 30 - 45 minutes , stirring often
17. Remove from the heat , add the lemon juice , and puree to desired consistency
18. Add pepper to taste
19. Possible garnishes:
20. Lemon zest / freshly squeezed lemon juice
21. Plain yogurt blended with salt , pepper , and chopped parsley or cilantro

title: spanish beef and potato stew  w saffron from la mancha  tonjunto
steps:
1. Put the olive oil , bell peppers , onion , garlic , and beef in the stew pot , in that order
2. Layer the potatoes on top of the beef
3. Add the salt , pepper , cloves , bay leaf , and saffron
4. Pour the wine over and add enough water to cover
5. Bring to a boil , reduce the heat to low , cover , and cook until the meat is very tender , about 2 hours
6. Makes 4 servings
7. Serve immediately real stew

title: chee zee pecan pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f degrees
2. In a mixing bowl , with electric mixer , beat together cream cheese , white sugar , one egg and vanilla until smooth
3. Spread mixture evenly in pie shell
4. Sprinkle pecans over cream cheese mixture
5. In another mixing bowl , with electric mixer , beat together remaining 3 eggs , corn syrup and brown sugar
6. Mix well
7. Pour this mixture evenly over the pecans
8. Bake in preheated oven for 10 minutes , then reduce heat to 375f and bake for 25 to 30 minutes longer , or until pie is set and golden
9. Let cool before slicing

title: very veggie casserole
steps:
1. In a saucepan over medium heat , cook spinach in about 1 inch of gently boiling water for about 3 minutes
2. Toss with a fork until wilted
3. Drain well and squeeze dry
4. Chop
5. In a 13x9 inch baking dish that has been sprayed with non-stick cooking spray , layer potatoes , mushrooms , cottage cheese , onions , 1 cup mj cheese , and spinach
6. In a saucepan over medium heat , add tomato sauce , parsley , basil , salt , and pepper
7. Simmer for approximately 2-3 minutes or until flavors blend
8. Adjust seasoning to taste
9. Pour sauce over vegetables
10. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes or until potatoes are tender
11. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and bake uncovered for 10 more minutes

title: double chocolate european style buttercream
steps:
1. Set-up a pan with about an inch of water and warm it to 160 degrees
2. Chop chocolate and place in a clean , dry , bowl that fits in the pan without touching the water , but is within an inch or so
3. Stir chocolate occasionally until almost melted
4. Remove from heat and continue stirring until smooth , the residual heat will finish the job
5. In a large bowl that will also fit over the pan with water , place eggs , cocoa , sugar and salt
6. Whisk lightly until blended
7. Turn heat up so water simmers , place the bowl with the egg mixture over the simmering water and whisk gently until the mixture reaches 165 degrees
8. 160 degrees is the instant kill temperature for salmonella and many other nasty bacteria
9. If you dont have an instant read thermometer , then the mixture should feel fairly warm , but not too hot
10. If you start to smell eggs cooking then youre too hot
11. Place the bowl on your mixer , or pour it into your mixer bowl , and , with a whisk attachment , beat at high speed until cooled to room temperature
12. I like to do this in the winter and open up a window next to my mixer
13. If you dont have a standing mixer , you can place your bowl in an ice bath and do it with a hand mixer on high speed
14. Lower speed on mixer to medium-low , add vanilla extract
15. Start adding butter one chunk at a time mix until each chunk is incorporated
16. When all butter is added whip on high speed for a minute or so
17. Turn off mixer , add chocolate and run on low speed until incorporated
18. Use immediately , keep at a cool room temperature for a day , refrigerate for a week , or freeze for 3 months
19. Re-whip before using

title: mrs  mountain s pork chops
steps:
1. Bring all ingredients except pork chops to a boil in a medium saucepan
2. Simmer on low for 1 / 2 hour
3. Place pork chops in large baking pan
4. Place one or two slices of onion on each chop and top off with lemon slice
5. Pour sauce over top of chops
6. Cover with foil wrap
7. Bake at 375 degrees for 1 1 / 2 hours

title: baked butternut squash  raisin and pine nut lasagna
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Prepare lasagna noodles as directed on the package
3. To prepare the squash , peel and remove seeds , trimming into 1 or 2 inch cubes
4. Place in a pot of boiling water and cook until just tender
5. Remove water and mash by hand
6. Place flour in a small saucepan over low to medium heat and very gradually whisk in milk and garlic
7. Warm milk slurry , stirring constantly , until sauce simmers and is thickened , about 3 minutes
8. Remove from heat and stir in parmesan cheese , salt and pepper
9. ?
10. Spread 1 / 3 cup of cheese sauce over bottom of a 9 x 13-inch glass or metal pan and cover with 3 lasagna noodles
11. Top with 1 / 3 of squash and 1 / 2 cup of cheese sauce
12. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 cup of mozzarella cheese and 1 / 4 cup of raisins
13. Cover with 3 more lasagna noodles and spread with 1 / 3 of remaining squash and 2 / 3 cup of cheese sauce
14. Sprinkle with 1 / 4 cup of raisins
15. Cover with 3 more lasagna noodles and top with remaining squash and raisins
16. Cover with last 3 lasagna noodles , pressing sheets firmly down
17. Top with remaining cheese sauce
18. Sprinkle with pine nuts and remaining mozzarella cheese
19. Cover lasagna with aluminum foil and bake for 15 minutes
20. Remove foil and continue baking until lasagna bubbles around edges and is browned on top , about 15-20 additional minutes
21. Slice into 8 pieces and serve

title: mango black bean salsa
steps:
1. Combine all in a bowl and mix well
2. Store in refrigerator

title: creamy vinaigrette salad dressing
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together well
2. Chill and pour over your favorote salad !

title: armadillo eggs
steps:
1. You will need toothpicks for this
2. I buy the strong kind so that they don't break easy
3. Soak toothpicks in water for about 30 minutes
4. First you will need to cut jalapenos lengthwise in half and remove seeds
5. You can use canned jalapenos
6. I just prefer fresh
7. Flatten chicken to about 1" and cut into 4-6 pieces
8. Season with whatever seasonings you prefer
9. I use my dad's homemade seasonings
10. Take a chicken piece , roll it around a jalapeno half , then roll 1 slice of bacon over top and secure with a toothpick
11. This may take a while
12. I usually do this the night before i grill or bake them
13. Cook on grill until bacon is crisp and chicken is cooked through
14. You can bake these in the oven at 350 degrees fahrenheit for about 45 minutes
15. I just like them grilled
16. You can steal some off the grill as you are cooking them ! yum !
17. If you have extra jalapenos left over , grill 'em if you can take the heat !

title: pork medallions with cider sauce
steps:
1. Heat large skillet over med-high heat and add oil
2. Season pork with salt and pepper lightly on each side
3. Sear pork about 5 minutes on each side or until brown
4. Add cider , vinegar and wine and bring to a boil
5. Cover and cook 5 more minutes
6. Remove lid and reduce heat to med
7. , simmer 5 more minutes
8. Remove pork to a plate and keep warm
9. Simmer liquids until reduced to 1 / 2 cup
10. Spoon sauce over pork and enjoy !

title: spiced up butternut squash soup
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees
2. Place butternut squash in a cookie sheet , drizzle with 2 tbsp of oil , sprinkle 1 / 4 tsp of salt and pepper
3. Roast until squash is tender but not mushy
4. Stir the squash during the roasting process for even cooking
5. While the squash is roasting , heat 1 tbsp of oil in a large pot over medium heat
6. Add onion , carrots and celery
7. Once the onion is translucent , add garlic and green onion , stir and cook for 1 minute
8. Turn the heat on low , add all the spices to the pot , stir and cook for 2 minutes
9. Add roasted squash and stock
10. Cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes
11. Turn off heat
12. Puree soup using a stick blender or in a blender
13. Stir in coconut milk
14. Salt and pepper to taste
15. Turn heat on low and warm through

title: green beans  balsamic and pancetta
steps:
1. Bring a large saucepan of water to a boil over high heat
2. Meanwhile , slice pancetta into thin strips
3. Finely chopped shallots should measure about 3 tablespoons
4. Trim ends from beans
5. Over medium heat , melt butter in a wide frying pan
6. Add pancetta and shallots
7. Stir often 3 to 5 minutes until pancetta is crisp
8. While pancetta is cooking , place beans into boiling water
9. Boil uncovered , 2 to 3 minutes , until almost tender-crisp
10. Drain thoroughly
11. When pancetta is cooked , add hot beans to pan
12. Sprinkle with salt
13. Add in vinegar
14. Stir often for about 1 minute , until vinegar is absorbed
15. Turn onto a platter
16. Garnish with parmesan shavings , if you wish
17. Serve immediately , with roast pork , stuffed with stilton
18. Make ahead: after boiling beans , drain and plunge into a bowl of ice water to stop cooking
19. Drain
20. Pat dry with paper towels
21. Wrap and refrigerate
22. Prepare shallots and pancetta following the recipe , but do not cook
23. Wrap and refrigerate up to 2 days
24. When ready to cook , continue with recipe
25. Beans , from the refrigerator , may need a couple of extra minutes to heat

title: best crock pot beef stew
steps:
1. Cut beef in 1 inch cubes removing any fat
2. Place cut up vegetables in order in bottom of large crock pot carrots , potatoes , celery then onions
3. Place cubed beef over vegetables
4. Sprinkle with salt , pepper and thyme
5. Sprinkle with package of au jus gravy mix
6. Pour tomatoes over all
7. Cook for 1 hr on high then reduce to low for 6 hours
8. Stir all together gently and let cook for 45 minutes

title: deviled hamburgers
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and mix
2. Divide equal portions of mixture between the eight bun halves and spread on top
3. Make sure to spread mixture out to the edge of the bun as any portion of the bun exposed to the broiler has a tendency to brown too much
4. Place under the broiler for 6-8 minutes

title: hot spicy  southwestern buffalo wings
steps:
1. Cut off
2. Sprinkle wings with salt and pepper to taste
3. Heat oil in deep fryer or large heavy pot
4. When it is quite hot , add half the wings and cook about 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. When wings are golden brown and crisp , remove them and drain well
6. Add remaining wings and repeat process
7. Meanwhile , melt butter in saucepan , add hot sauce and vinegar to taste
8. Pour hot sauce over wings and mix well to cover
9. Serve with blue cheese dressing and celery sticks

title: corn on the cob   cooked in the old ways
steps:
1. Boil water in large pot
2. Place the unshucked corn in the boiling water
3. Boil for 10 minutes
4. Shuck corn and serve with butter and salt

title: black sesame asparagus
steps:
1. Trim bottom 1 / 4 of asparagus off , or the whitish colored part , and discard
2. Wash before cooking
3. Saut the asparagus in butter , with salt , pepper and black sesame , over medium heat
4. Continue until the asparagus"gives" a little
5. This all depends on the thickness of the asparagus
6. Some water can be added if the asparagus starts to brown
7. Squeeze juice from 1 / 2 lemon over asparagus , and serve

title: hungry girl cheesecake brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Prepare a 9" x 13" baking pan by coating it with nonstick cooking spray
3. In a large mixing bowl , combine cake mix and pumpkin
4. Stir until completely blended
5. Using a spatula , spread batter into pan and set aside
6. Dissolve powdered coffee creamer in the water
7. Combine softened cream cheese with splenda , coffee-creamer mixture , and vanilla extract
8. Mix vigorously until completely blended , smooth and lump-free
9. Spoon cheesecake mixture over the brownie batter , and use a knife to swirl it into the batter
10. Place pan in the oven , and bake for 20 - 25 minutes
11. Allow to cool , and then cut into 16 pieces

title: savory tomato mini tarts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In small bowl , combine the first 8 ingredients
3. In another bowl , combine italian cheese and mayonnaise
4. Spoon tomato mixture into tart shells
5. Spread mayonnaise mixture over tops
6. Place on an ungreased baking sheet
7. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 8 - 12 minutes or until lightly browned
9. Garnish with chives if desired

title: squash fritters
steps:
1. Salt zucchini and onion lightly and set in a colander over a bowl
2. Squeeze out excess liquid
3. Mix with dill , parsley , mint , eggs , paprika , salt , pepper and feta in a bowl
4. Gradually add flour
5. Mixture should be like a thick batter
6. Heat 2 to 3 tablespoons oil in a frying pan to medium high
7. Drop a teaspoon or tablespoon of the mixture into the hot pan
8. Turn when browned on one side and cook on the other side until lightly browned and slightly firm
9. Carefully lift with a spatula and set onto paper towels to absorb the excess oil
10. As you cook more fritters , add more oil
11. Mix yogurt with dill and lemon and a little salt , if you wish
12. Serve on trays with dollop of yogurt and dill garnish , or on small plates

title: cornbread salad ii
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Lightly grease one 9x13 inch pan
3. Combine the cornbread muffin mix , eggs and milk , stir until just combined
4. Pour batter into the prepared pan
5. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean
6. Set aside to cool
7. Once cool crumble into bite-size chunks
8. Place bacon in a large , deep skillet
9. Cook over medium high heat until evenly brown
10. Drain , crumble and set aside
11. Whisk together the pickle juice and mayonnaise
12. In a large bowl layer 1 / 2 of the crumbled cornbread followed by the onion , pepper , tomatoes and pickles
13. Drizzle with 1 / 2 of the dressing and repeat
14. Top with bacon and chill for 1 hour

title: cranberry pepper jelly  hot
steps:
1. In medium saucepan combine jalapeo peppers , cranberry juice and vinegar
2. Bring to a boil and then reduce heat
3. Cover and simmer 10 minutes
4. Strain mixture through a sieve , pressing with back of spoon to remove all liquid
5. Measure 2 cups liquid
6. Discard pulp
7. In 4-quart kettle combine the 2 cups liquid and the sugar
8. Bring to a full rolling boil over high heat , stirring constantly
9. Stir in pectin and if using , add the whole hot peppers
10. Return to a full rolling boil
11. Boil 1 minute , stirring constantly
12. Remove from heat and quickly skim off foam with a metal spoon
13. Ladle into hot , sterile 1 / 2-pint jars adding 1 whole pepper to each jar
14. Wipe rims , adjust lids
15. Process in boiling water bath for 5 minutes
16. Cool on wire rack
17. Jelly may require 2 to 3 days to set

title: cider roasted vegetables
steps:
1. Heat oven to 450f
2. Place the vegetables in two small roasting pans
3. In a medium bowl , whisk together the brown sugar , oil , and vinegar
4. Pour over the vegetables and toss to coat well
5. Cook until tender , about 1 hour , stirring halfway
6. Add the mushrooms during the last 10 minutes , toss to coat well , and finish roasting
7. Season to taste with salt and freshly ground pepper

title: spaghetti puttanesca in 25 minutes
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a pan add the garlic & cook over a low heat for 1-2 minutes
2. Add the chopped tomatoes & anchovies & simmer uncovered for 10 minutes - stir occasionally
3. Meanwhile , heat a large pan of water until boiling
4. Boil the spaghetti uncovered for 10-11 minutes or until just tender
5. Add the olives , capers & basil to the sauce & simmer for 4-5 minutes
6. Drain the spaghetti well , toss with the sauce & serve garnished with basil leaves

title: baked chicken chimichangas
steps:
1. In a skillet , simmer the chicken , salsa , onion , cumin and oregano until heated through and most of the liquid has evaporated
2. Place 1 / 2 cup chicken mixture down the center of each tortilla and top with 2 tablespoons cheese
3. Fold sides and ends over filling and roll up
4. Place seam side down in a 13-in
5. X 9-in
6. X 2-in
7. Baking dish coated with cooking spray
8. Bake , uncovered , at 425 for 15 minutes or until lightly browned
9. In a saucepan , combine the broth , bouillon and pepper
10. Cook until bouillon is dissolved
11. In a bowl , combine flour and cream until smooth and gradually stir into broth
12. Bring to a boil , cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
13. Stir in chilies and cook until heated through
14. Top chimichangas with sauce

title: white candy fantasy clusters
steps:
1. Mix cereal , pretzel , and cashews in large bowl
2. Set aside
3. Grease 13x9x2 baking dish or pan
4. Melt candy coating in 2 quart saucepan over low heat , stirring constantly
5. Pour over cereal mixture , stirring until evenly coated
6. Press in pan
7. Cool slightly
8. Drizzle with melted chocolate chips
9. Let stand until chocolate is firm
10. Break into clusters

title: lithuanian cabbage soup  kopustu sriuba
steps:
1. In a large pot , place the sauerkraut , chicken stock , smoked meat , peppercorns and bay leaves
2. Add water to cover
3. Bring to a boil , reduce temperature , cover and simmer for 1 to 2 hours
4. Meat should be tender
5. Remove meat , discard bones , dice and return to the pot
6. Add the shredded cabbage , tomatoes and onion
7. Bring to a boil , reduce to a simmer and cook another hour or so
8. Add water , as necessary , to keep it soupy
9. To serve , remove the bay leaves and dish up , with hot boiled potatoes on the side
10. Smoked turkey is a good substitute for the ham hocks
11. And there is nothing wrong with a nice hambone !
12. I also have used the strained liquid left over after cooking a corned beef in the crock

title: thai mango salad
steps:
1. Zest peel from 1 lime and place in a measuring cup along with 1 / 4 cup of lime juice
2. Whisk in fish sauce , sugar and thai pepper until sugar is dissolved
3. Gradually whisk in peanut oil until blended
4. Add shallot , mix well
5. Set dressing aside
6. Peel mangoes , then cut away chunks of fruit from pits then , cut into thin strips and place in a large bowl
7. Seed sweet pepper , cut into very thin strips and add to mangoes
8. Add carrot , half of green onions , and cilantro
9. Toss gently until combined
10. Add dressing and a pinch of salt , toss until mixed
11. Sprinkle with nuts and remaining green onions

title: momma maglione s easy pasta fagioli
steps:
1. Saute garlic in olive oil
2. Add tomato sauce , water , cannellini beans and crushed red pepper and simmer while pasta is cooking
3. Rinse pasta
4. Mix ditallini and sauce mixture

title: grandma s tortilla treats
steps:
1. Warm the tortilla
2. Spread the peanut butter on the hot tortilla
3. Pour syrup over the peanut butter
4. These are quite messy to eat , as you can imagine you can either tear off little chunks of tortilla and munch on them or fold the tortilla like a taco or burrito to eat it either way , be prepared for syrup and melted peanut butter to ooze out

title: chicken and pineapple salad
steps:
1. In a small bowl , whisk together mustard , oil , and lime juice
2. In a large bowl , toss together chicken , cabbage , tomatoes , and scallions
3. Just before serving , toss chicken mixture with pineapple and dressing
4. Season with salt and pepper

title: quick minestrone
steps:
1. In a 5-quart kettle cook bacon over medium heat until it begins to brown
2. Mix in onion , mushrooms , garlic and a carrots
3. Cook , stirring , until onion is soft
4. Add broth , tomatoes , salt , basil , thyme and pepper
5. Bring to boiling
6. Cover , reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes
7. Bring soup to boiling and add pasta
8. Bring again to boiling and cook , uncovered , stirring occasionally , until nearly tender , about 10 minutes
9. Add peas and parsley , boil for 2 minutes
10. Taste
11. Add salt , if needed
12. Serve soup with cheese and add to taste
13. Serve with italian bread sticks

title: stuffed fish fillets
steps:
1. Put crushed crackers in a bowl and mix in bread crumbs
2. Add chopped parsley and garlic
3. Add 1 / 2 cup melted butter and stir to mix
4. Add artificial crab meat and mix again
5. Wash fish and pat dry
6. Roll each fillet with a handful of stuffing and place in buttered 9x13 casserole dish
7. Put remaining stuffing on top and around rolled fillets
8. Drizzle with remaining 1 / 4 cup melted butter
9. Cover with foil or lid and bake for about 1 hour at 350 degrees
10. Uncover fish and cook another 10 to 15 minutes

title: peach strawberry smoothie
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth
2. Add honey or ice cubes if desired for sweeter or thicker smoothie

title: marinated beef tenderloin
steps:
1. Pierce meat with a fork in several places
2. Put meat in a deep plastic bag
3. Combine all ingredients and pour over meat
4. Refrigerate for 24 hours
5. Preheat oven to 425 and bake for 40 - 50 minutes , depending on how you prefer your meat cooked
6. Please

title: baked citrus mahi mahi
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Lightly grease one or two baking dishes
3. Wash and pat dry mahi mahi fillets and lay them in a single layer in the baking dishe
4. Drizzle fillets with lemon juice , then melted butter
5. Sprinkle evenly with the ginger , salt , pepper , and paprika
6. Place an orange slice over each fillet
7. Evenly pour the crushed pineapple over all the fillets
8. Bake at 375 for about 20-30 minutes or until fillets are opaque
9. Do not overbake

title: light butterscotch bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Beat sugars and butter with a mixer at medium speed until well-blended (about 4
3. Minutes)
4. Add egg whites and vanilla
5. Beat well
6. Lightly spoon flour into dry
7. Measuring cups , and level with a knife
8. Combine flour , baking powder , and salt
9. Stir
10. Well with a whisk
11. Add flour mixture to sugar mixture
12. Beat at low speed just until blended
13. Stir in morsels
14. Spread batter evenly into an 8-inch square baking pan coated with cooking spray
15. Bake at 350 for 28 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
16. Cool in pan on a wire rack

title: black bean falafel or dip and cucumber sauce
steps:
1. Drain the black beans
2. If you have a food processor , pulverize them until a paste
3. If not , mash them with a fork , your hand , or potato masher
4. Chop onion , green onion , garlic , and cilantro
5. Add to the beans and again process until paste like if you have the equipment , or just mix in thoroughly
6. Add coriander , cumin , black pepper , baking powder , salt , and red pepper flakes and mix well
7. At this point , the mixture is a yummy bean dip
8. You may choose to reserve all or part of it solely for this purpose
9. To continue with the falafel , if the mixture is noticeabley runny add enough flour to make it hold together
10. Lightly beat the egg , add it to the bean mixture , and mix well
11. Refrigerate for 30 minutes
12. While the falafel mixture refrigerates , chop the remaining 1 / 4 onion , garlic clove , and cucumber into small bits
13. Add these to the yogurt with the dill and black pepper and mix thoroughly
14. Refrigerate in a covered container until needed
15. Coat a large frying pan with enough oil to keep the falafel from sticking
16. Spoon the falafel mixture into the pan and flatten to make patty-shaped
17. Cook over medium-high heat on each side for 5-10 minutes , or until brown and crispy
18. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate to cool
19. Serve warm

title: luscious lemon cheesecake
steps:
1. Combine graham cracker crumbs with melted butter and press on the bottom of a 9" springform pan
2. Beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth
3. Add eggs one at a time and mix until just blended
4. Stir in zest and juice from lemon
5. Pour mixture into crust and bake at 350 degrees for 45 to 50 minutes or until center is almost set
6. Cool completely , then refrigerate for a minimum of 3 hours
7. Top with cool whip and garnish with lemon slices

title: raw pasta sauce
steps:
1. Roughly chop tomatoes , avocado , carrots , and celery
2. Put everything in the blender and blend to a thick sauce

title: chicken and broccoli spaghetti
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti according to package directions
2. Heat oil in a large non-stick skillet
3. Add broccoli and garlic
4. Cook
5. 4 minutes
6. Stir in chicken
7. Cook 4 minutes or until chicken is hot
8. Stir in lemon juice , seasonings , tomatoes and pasta
9. Toss well
10. Top with cheese
11. Serve immediately or chill and serve as a salad

title: thanksgiving fruit compote
steps: 1. Mix everything in saucepan , simmer gently for 15 minutes , let cool

title: italian vegetable custard
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. In a medium bowl , beat together eggs and the flour until smooth
3. Stir in squash , zucchini and 1 / 4 cup of the olives
4. Spread in a greased 8x8x2-inch baking dish or pan
5. Bake just until set , about 10 minutes
6. Meanwhile , in a small bowl , stir together parmesan cheese , basil and garlic salt
7. Sprinkle over baked squash mixture
8. Top evenly with tomato slices , remaining olives , onion slices and monterey jack cheese
9. Continue to bake until cheese is melted , about 4 minutes longer

title: darn good mashed taters
steps:
1. Place the potatoes in a large dutch oven , cover with water and add the garlic powder , onion powder , salt , and pepper
2. Bring the potatoes to a boil over high heat , then reduce heat to medium and cook until tender ,
3. Drain well
4. Place the drained potatoes in a large bowl , add butter and whip the potatoes with an electric mixer until there are no lumps
5. Pour in the cream and continue whipping until the potatoes are fluffy

title: fried potatoes with chile sauce
steps:
1. Chile sauce:
2. In a large heavy saucepan , warm the oil over medium heat
3. Sprinkle in the breadcrumbs and brown briefly
4. Add the garlic , oregano and chile
5. Stir in the water slowly to avoid lumps and add the vinegar and salt
6. Bring the sauce to a boil , then reduce the heat to a simmer
7. Cook the sauce for 20-25 minutes
8. Set aside
9. Potatoes:
10. Heat the broiler
11. Peel the cooked potatoes , if you wish
12. Slice the potatoes into thick rounds
13. In a large , heavy ovenproof skillet , warm the oil over medium high heat
14. Add the onion and garlic and saute till the onion is translucent
15. Stir in the potatoes , reduce the heat to medium , and fry until the potatoes are crisp and a little browned
16. Pour the chile sauce over the potatoes and scatter the cheese over the top
17. Place the potatoes under the broiler just long enough for the cheese to melt
18. Serve immediately , topped with sour cream , green onions or cilantro if you wish

title: peppermint cream sauce
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , combine all ingredients
2. Stir constantly with a wooden spoon
3. Cook over medium heat until smooth
4. Remove from heat
5. Pour into an airtight container and place in refrigerator
6. Serve over ice cream or cake

title: super bowl party red and white chili  crock pot
steps:
1. Put all ingredients into crock pot
2. Mix thoroughly
3. Cook on low 6-7 hours or high 3-4 hours

title: berry cherry smoothie
steps:
1. Put all ingredients in order suggested into blender
2. Blend on high until smooth

title: smashed potatoes plus cfa
steps:
1. Heat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat
2. Add 1 tablespoon of the a butter , then the celery and onions
3. Saut until the vegetables are golden , about 5 minutes
4. Remove from the pan and reserve
5. Add the potatoes and just enough cold water to cover
6. Bring the water to a boil
7. Cover , reduce heat to medium-low and cook until potatoes are tender ,
8. About 15 minutes , depending on size
9. Drain the potatoes and return the pan to medium heat
10. Stir in the cooked vegetables , 3 tablespoons of butter and milk
11. "smash" lightly with a masher or fork
12. Add more salt , pepper and taste for seasoning
13. Serve immediately or keep warm over low heat with the lid slightly opened

title: zesty cioppino
steps:
1. Spray a 6-quart dutch oven with nonstick cooking spray
2. Heat over high heat
3. Add the mushrooms , onions , and garlic
4. Saute for 4-6 minutes or until veggies are tender , stirring frequently
5. Add in the tomatoes with juice , wine , italian seasoning , red pepper flakes , and bay leaf
6. Stir
7. Bring to a boil , decrease heat to low , cover , and simmer for 20 minutes
8. Take off lid , increase heat to high
9. Bring back to a boil
10. Add fish , scallops , and shrimp
11. Cook for 8-10 minutes or until fish flakes easily and shrimp are pink , stir occasionally
12. Serve with hot sourdough bread

title: riccioli con melanzana e mozzarella
steps:
1. Peel and sliced the eggplant
2. Salt the slices and put them in a colander in the sink for an hour , while the salt draws out their bitter juices
3. Rinse them , pat them dry , and dice them finely
4. Heat the olive oil in a large deep skillet and saut the onion until it has become golden and translucent
5. Add the eggplant and cook , stirring , for 5 minutes
6. Add the tomatoes and the basil , check seasoning , and cook the sauce for 15 minutes
7. While preparing the sauce you should also heat the pasta water , salt it , and cook the pasta
8. By this point the pasta should be about done
9. Drain it , and turn it into a bowl with the mozzarella and freshly grated parmigiano
10. Serve at once , with more parmigiano for those who want it

title: scallops and bacon dijon   red lion inn style
steps:
1. Clean scallops and pat dry
2. Mix together wine , mustard , salt and pepper , add the scallops and coat with the mixture
3. Marinate for 1 hour in a covered container in the fridge
4. Preheat the oven to 250 f
5. Place the bacon slices on a baking sheet in a single layer and cook for 10 minutes or until soft , drain on paper towels and then cut each slice in half crosswise
6. Increase the oven temperature to 350 f , drain the scallops and wraps a bacon strip around each one , fastening with a toothpick
7. Place the scallops in the baking tray and bake 8-10 minutes , basting with the juice they release
8. Serve immediately once cooked

title: linda s holiday m m candy bar pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Cream shortening , then combine thoroughly with sugars
3. Beat in the egg and vanilla
4. Sift together the flour , cocoa , and baking powder
5. Stir into batter
6. Stir in 1 / 2 of the m&ms
7. Spread batter onto a 14" lightly greased pizza pan
8. Bake for 18-20 minutes
9. Remove pan , and spread candy bar pieces evenly over pizza while hot
10. Top with coconut
11. Return to oven , and bake additional 3-5 minutes
12. Stir the candy pieces and coconut together on the pizza , with a fork , just to blend
13. Drizzle on melted caramels or caramel topping
14. Sprinkle remaining m&ms over top , and lightly press into the caramel
15. Let cool and cut

title: carrot soup indienne
steps:
1. In a large saucepan or cooking pot , measure water and bring to boil
2. Add chopped carrots , diced potatoes , chopped celery and chopped onion and return to boil
3. Reduce heat , cover and simmer for 1 / 2 hour or until carrots are tender
4. Remove from heat and let cool for about 5 minutes
5. In a food processor or blender , puree' soup in batches until smooth and return to saucepan
6. Add soy sauce , cumin , cayenne pepper , chili powder , garlic powder , curry powder , whole milk , instant potato flakes and return to boil
7. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. Adjust seasonings to taste
9. Serve hot along with cooked rice
10. You can also use vegetable broth or chicken broth instead of water

title: spiced apple cupcakes with salted caramel buttercream
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Prepare muffin pans with cupcake liners
3. In large bowl , combine flour , sugar , brown sugar , baking soda , salt , cinnamon , nutmeg , ginger and cloves
4. In a medium bowl , whisk eggs
5. Then whisk in oil , milk and vanilla
6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and beat at medium speed until combined
7. Fold in chopped apples
8. Fill cupcake liners 2 / 3 full with batter
9. Bake for 18-19 minutes , until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean or cakes bounce back when pressed lightly
10. Allow cupcakes to cool completely
11. Meanwhile , prepare your caramel buttercream
12. In saucepan over medium heat , melt butter
13. With a wooden spoon , stir in brown sugar and continue to stir until dissolved
14. Then stir in heavy cream , vanilla and salt
15. Once mixture reaches a slow , rolling boil , cook for 5-7 minutes or until mixture begins to thicken to a syrupy consistency
16. Remove from heat and set aside to cool
17. Once cooled to a manageable temperature , transfer to a mixing bowl
18. With an electric mixer , gradually beat in confectioners sugar until mixture is smooth and velvety
19. If necessary , use a little more or less to reach the desired consistency
20. Frost cupcakes using your desired method
21. I prefer to pipe it in a thick swirl , using a wide round

title: maple sugar glazed pork with baked apples and thyme
steps:
1. Put the chops & apple halves into a large buttered ovenproof dish along side each other , it does not matter if they fit snugly
2. Mix the maple syrup , sugar , mustard and cider together to make a thickish , sludgy syrupy , paste and spread over the top of the chops & apples
3. Allow to rest / marinade at room temperature for about 30 minutes
4. Preheat the oven to 2250c / 450f / gas 6
5. Sprinkle the chopped onion over the top of the chops and apples , and place several sprigs of fresh thyme on top
6. Season well with freshly ground pepper and sea salt
7. Bake for about 45 to 60 minutes , or until chops are and apples are cooked , soft and golden brown and glazed
8. You can flash the chops and apples under a grill to achieve a deeper and stickier glaze
9. Serve each person with one chop , one-half of apple and some of the juices and the glaze
10. Garnish with some fresh thyme

title: decadent apple bran crisp
steps:
1. Peel , slice and core apples , and put in small baking dish
2. Sprinkle with remaining ingredients
3. Bake at 350 for 20 minutes

title: lower fat death chicken
steps:
1. Put bacon bits in bottom of 9x13 inch casserole dish
2. Put uncooked rice in dish
3. Lightly salt , pepper , and paprika chicken pieces , put them in dish
4. In bowl , mix soup , water , garlic salt , nutmeg , oregano , and parsley
5. Pour into casserole dish
6. Cover and bake 2 hours at 300 degrees- don't uncover during cooking !

title: sweet cereal puffs
steps:
1. Heat oven to 325 degrees
2. In large mixer bowl , beat egg whites until foamy
3. Beat in sugar , 1 tablespoon at a time
4. Continue beating until very stiff and glossy
5. Fold in cereal
6. Drop mixture by teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto lightly oiled baking sheet
7. Bake 14 to 16 minutes

title: brussels cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f and lightly grease baking sheets
2. Have ready pastry bag fitted with 1 / 2 inch
3. Sift flour , baking soda and cream of tarter together , set aside
4. Using mixer on medium speed , cream butter , sugar , extracts , and orange zest until light and fluffy , about 2 minutes
5. Add egg whites and beat on medium high until blended , about 1 minute , scraping bowl well
6. Add flour and mix by hand until blended , then stir in almonds and oats , blending well
7. Fill pastry bag with batter and pipe 2 inch long fingers or 2 inch round circles 3 inches apart on baking sheets
8. Bake until lightly golden with darker golden edges , about 12 minutes
9. Using spatula , immediately transfer to wire racks to cool
10. When cookies are cooled , melt chocolates together
11. Turn half of cookies upside down and spread small thin layer of chocolate over each bottom half
12. Immediately place remaining cookies on top , pressing down gently
13. Refrigerate 1 hour to set
14. Store airtight for up to 2 weeks in freezer
15. Makes about 24 cookie sandwiches

title: unique potato salad roll up  via susiequsie
steps:
1. Peel , boil , drain and mash potatoes
2. Do not add any liquid !
3. Combine potatoes with 1 / 3 cup mayonnaise , salt and paprika
4. Stir in celery , hard boiled eggs and onion
5. Refrigerate until well-chilled
6. On waxed paper , pat potato mixture into a 12 x 9" rectangle
7. Combine cottage cheese , 2 tablespoons mayonnaise , and green pepper
8. Spread cottage cheese mixture over potato rectangle to within 1" of edges
9. Using wax paper as your guide , gently roll up and chill
10. Garnish with parsley and egg slices
11. Sprinkle with paprika if desired
12. I used parchment paper brushed lightly with olive oil using my pastry brush
13. Then i wiped it to a very thin film using paper towel , folded the parchment paper several times on the edge where i intended to begin the roll , so i would be able to firmly manage the roll
14. I spread the potato mixture on the paper , chilled it in my freezer for 15 minutes and rolled it up with no problem

title: bob s peach cobbler
steps:
1. Dump peaches into glass baking sheet
2. Empty cake mix contents over peaches
3. Pour sprite over the top of the cake mix , add butter on top
4. Bake as directed on box
5. Do not add any ingredients listed on box

title: spicy broccoli pasta
steps:
1. Cook broccoli in boiling water , 3-5 minutes until just tender
2. Heat oil in skillet over medium heat
3. Add garlic
4. Cook over medium heat until just golden , about 2 minutes
5. Add drained broccoli and red pepper flakes , and cook 5 minutes
6. Add salt and pepper to taste
7. Add broccoli mixture to cooked pasta
8. Toss and serve

title: scallops d aulon
steps:
1. Melt 1 stick of butter in saute' pan over medium heat
2. Add spinach and coat
3. Saute just until dark but not limp , add wine and deglaze
4. Add cream and turn down heat to low
5. Not letting boil , saute' 2-3 minutes and remove from heat
6. Preheat oven to broil
7. Heat flat griddle on grill to very high heat , somewhere over 600
8. Melt butter off heat or on stove
9. Add lemon to taste
10. Pour over scallops , salt and pepper to taste , rub to coat
11. Sear over very high heat >1minute per side , remove immeditately
12. Divide and place in ramakins , top with spinach , spooning in the sauce as desired
13. Top with mozzarella , place in bottom rack of broiler untill well melted

title: shane s spinach dip
steps:
1. Mix together
2. Enjoy

title: marula
steps:
1. Mix vanilla vodka and amarula cream together with ice in a martini shaker , strain and pour into a glass
2. Or
3. Serve over ice

title: goat cheese crostini
steps:
1. Preheat oven broiler
2. Rub each slice of bread with the garlic and place a sliver of butter on each one
3. Prepare a cookie tray , line it with tin foil and spray it with veggie spray
4. Place the bread slices on the tray and place on middle rack of the oven
5. Broil for approximately 10 minutes until the bread is golden brown
6. Remove from oven , leaving the broiler on
7. On each bread slice place a fresh basil leaf , then a slice of the goat cheese
8. Top the goat cheese with half a cherry tomato , cut side up
9. Place a small piece of goat cheese in the centre of the tomato
10. Grind sea salt and pepper over all
11. Place the tray back on the middle rack under the broiler for about 5 minutes , just until the cheese starts to spread and turns a little brown
12. Serve warm or at room temperature
13. Recipe may easily be doubled

title: the best taco pizza ever
steps:
1. For the crust add cumin , garlic powder , paprika , and onion powder to the crust mixture and prepare as directed on box
2. Press crust on a round pizza pan , bake at 425 degrees for 10 minute
3. In a skillet cook onion and hamburger until no longer pink
4. Add 2 packets of taco seasoning , and diced tomatoes
5. Let simmer for about 10 minute
6. On crust spread refried beans , then meat mixture , then olives , and then mozzarella , and cheddar cheese
7. Bake at 425 degrees for about 10 min or until the cheese turns a light brown
8. Top with chips , lettuce , and taco sauce
9. Enjoy !

title: copycat pizzeria uno  chicago deep dish  pizza dough
steps:
1. Old school method: mix the yeast and water together in a large mixing bowl with a fork until totally dissolved
2. Blend in 1 cup of flour , and all the cornmeal , salt , and oil
3. Mix well with a large spoon
4. Continue stirring in the rest of the flour in 1 / 2-cup increments until the dough stops sticking to the sides of the bowl
5. Put some flour on your hands and knead the dough until it is no longer sticky , about 5-10 minutes
6. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and put in a warm , dry , draft-free area for 45-60 minutes to rise until doubled
7. Punch it down and knead briefly
8. Go to step #8
9. Didn't want to do all that just to have another rise later ? check out the bread machine instructions !
10. Bread machine instructions: put all the ingredients into your bread machine according to your manfacturer's directions and do a 1
11. 5-lb or 2-lb dough cycle , kick back and let it do its work
12. Press the dough into an oiled 15-inch deep dish pan
13. Let it rise for another 20 minutes before pre-baking
14. After the rise in the pan is finished , bake at 450f for 10 minutes
15. Then add the sauce , cheese , toppings , etc , and whatever else you like and bake at 400f according to how much you put on i like cheese and veggie toppings which only take about 15-20 minutes , then turn on the broiler for 5 minutes to get a nice crispy edge and cheesy crunch
16. Don't have a deep-dish pan ? can probably split this up among casserole dishes and large pie pans

title: potato and parmesan gnocchi
steps:
1. Peel and dice potatoes placing in a pot of cold water
2. Bring water to a boil and cook potatoes until fork tender
3. Drain potatoes and return to pot and burner that is turned off but still hot to evaporate any excess water
4. Mash potatoes with a masher or hand-held mixer
5. Add all remaining ingredietns except for flour and blend
6. Slowly add flour until you get a nice smooth dough
7. Pull off pieces of dough and roll into logs / snakes
8. Cut into 1 / 2 inch pieces
9. Shape dough with a fork if you like
10. I keep it simple and leave them how i cut them
11. Add gnocchi to boiling , salted water and cook until they all are floating at the top
12. This takes about 3-4 minutes typically , depending on the size of your dumplings
13. You may need to do this in several batches to not overcrowd the pot
14. Serve with your favorite sauce and lots of cheese !

title: baba s perogies
steps:
1. Mix flour and salt , and add water to make dough that doesn't stick to fingers
2. Knead well and cover with damp cloth for 10 minutes
3. Roll out to 1 / 8" thick
4. Cut in squares or circles and fill with mashed potatoes and cheese
5. Pinch closed and boil until they rise to the top
6. Strain and serve with fried onions , sour cream , mushroom gravy , etc

title: turkey filet mignon wrapped in turkey bacon
steps:
1. Combine molasses and softened butter
2. Cover and hold for service
3. Wrap each turkey medallion with one strip of bacon
4. Lightly sprinkle with black pepper
5. Bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven for 15-20 minutes or until food thermometer reaches 170 degrees f
6. Pipe molasses butter into a star on top of the turkey filet

title: blue cheese meatloaf                            mmmmmmmmmmmmm
steps:
1. Saute onion and mushrooms in olive oil until translucent
2. Mix all ingredients in large bowl
3. Shape into loaf pan and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour and 15 minutes --

title: peppery tomato aspic
steps:
1. In small bowl , sprinkle gelatin over cold water and let stand to soften
2. In a medium saucepan heat tomato juice , chopped red pepper and onion simmer for 15 minutes
3. In food processor or blender puree tomato juice mixture , add worcestershire , hot pepper sauce and softened gelatin , stir until dissolved
4. Pour into a rinsed 6-cup mould or 8 individual moulds
5. Cover with foil
6. Chill until firm , at least 6 hours
7. To serve unmould onto serving plate
8. Garnish with garnish ingredients

title: avocado with salmon appetizer
steps:
1. Wrap a slice of salmon around each quarter of avocado
2. Secure with picks
3. Garnish with lime& onion
4. The lime helps prvent the avocado from discoloring

title: noodle   cheese casserole
steps:
1. Cook noodles in salted , boiling water until nearly done , rinse well and set aside
2. Brown onions in margarine
3. Add ground beef and seasonings& fry until meat loses it's red colour
4. Combine soup with milk and stir well
5. In a casserole dish , put down a layer of noodles , top with a layer of ground beef and then a layer of the soup mixture
6. Repeat layers ending with noodles
7. Sprinkle with grated cheese and pour beaten eggs on top
8. Bake in a 350 degree oven for about 60 minutes or until top is crisp and golden brown

title: crab rockefeller stuffed mushrooms
steps:
1. Clean mushrooms and remove stems
2. Dry and brush tops with olive oil
3. Set aside
4. Melt butter in pan
5. Add onion and saut until tender , but not browned
6. Add spinach and mix well
7. Add crabmeat , cream , and cheese
8. Mix to blend
9. Stuffed mushrooms to heaping
10. Put in lightly sprayed baking dish
11. Bake at 375 degrees f
12. For 15-20 minutes or until juices release into dish
13. Brown slightly until broiler , if needed

title: moroccan couscous and chickpea salad
steps:
1. Place couscous and dried cherries in a med
2. Bowl
3. Add boiling water
4. Immediately cover bowl with plastic wrap and let sit until water is completely absorbed , about 5 minutes
5. Meanwhile , heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
6. Add peppers and onions , sauteing until tender , about 5 minutes , and seasoning with cumin , ginger , cinnamon , salt and pepper as they cook
7. Add to couscous , along with chickpeas and cilantro
8. Whisk remaining 3 tablespoons of oil with vinegar and orange juice concentrate
9. Pour over salad
10. Toss to coat
11. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve

title: majestic potatoes au gratin
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Oil bottom of a casserole pan
3. Melt butter in microwave oven
4. Mix in flour and then whisk in milk
5. Microwave 2 minute to slightly thicken
6. Stir in nutmeg , pepper flakes
7. Set aside
8. Place the white and purple sliced potatoes into separate bowls
9. Mix half of the red onion and garlic with each of the potatoes
10. Drizzle with olive oil just to coat and sprinkle with seasoned salt to taste and black pepper
11. Toss to separate the slices and coat them with the oil and seasonings
12. Layer half of the purple potatoes in the casserole dish then place 1 / 4 of the cheese over the layer of purple potatoes
13. Layer 1 / 2 the white potatoes over the layer of cheese then top with 1 / 4 of the cheese
14. Repeat with remaining potatoes and cheese
15. Pour the white sauce over the potatoes and using a knife help it into the layers
16. Mix the panko and parmesan cheese together and then sprinkle on top of the sauce
17. Bake for 45-60 minutes

title: rhubarb crunch
steps:
1. Mix flour , rolled oats , brown sugar , margarine and cinnamon until crumbly: press half of this mixture into a 9" greased pan
2. Cover with chopped rhubarb
3. Combine sugar , cornstarch , and water
4. Cook until thick and clear in a small saucepan
5. Remove from heat and add vanilla
6. Pour over rhubarb
7. Top with remaining crumbs
8. Bake at 350f for 1 hour

title: spiced christmas coffee
steps:
1. Using electric mixer , beat whipping cream in a large bowl to soft peaks
2. Add powdered sugar and brandy
3. Beat to peaks
4. Place ground coffee , cardamom , sugar , cinnamon and nutmeg in coffee filter
5. Using spoon , mix gently
6. Add water to the coffee maker and brew according to manufacturer's instructions
7. Divide coffee among 8 cups
8. Garnish each with a dollop of whipped cream and serve immediately

title: paula deen s batter dipped french fries
steps:
1. Heat oil to 325 in a deep fryer or a large deep pot , no more than half full
2. Slice potatoes into wedges
3. Fry potatoes for 2 minutes and drain , allow to cool off
4. Turn oil up to 360
5. In a bowl combine flour , salt and black pepper and set aside
6. In another bowl add evaporated milk
7. Dip cool potato fries in evaporated milk than into flour mixture
8. Fry 5-10 minutes or until browned
9. Drain on paper towel and enjoy

title: moroccan saffron chicken
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a dutch oven or heavy-bottomed pot
2. Cover , and cook over medium to medium-high heat , stirring occasionally , for about 1 hour , or until the chicken is very tender and pulls easily off the bone
3. Do not add water , and be careful not to burn the chicken
4. Reduce the liquids until they are mostly oils
5. Discard the cinnamon sticks , and taste for seasoning

title: champinones al ajillo  garlic fried mushrooms
steps:
1. Warm the oil in a large saute pan over medium heat
2. Add the garlic and saute about 2 minutes
3. Do not let it burn
4. Increase the heat to high , and add the mushrooms
5. Saute until tender for about 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
6. The time may need to be adjusted according to the type of mushroom used
7. Add the wine and continue to cook until the liquid is absorbed
8. Add the parsley , salt and pepper , and stir to combine
9. Serve while hot

title: orange lettuce salad
steps:
1. Combine salad ingredients 1-2 hours before serving
2. Make dressing up to a day ahead or as close as 20 minutes before serving
3. Pour dressing over salad and toss lightly
4. Serve immediately

title: crummy halibut
steps:
1. Combine the first 9 ingredients
2. Pat the fish dry
3. Place , skin side down , in a 13x9 inch baking pan
4. Drizzle with 1 t butter
5. Cover with crumbs
6. Press the crumbs onto the fish
7. Drizzle with remaining 1 t butter
8. Bake , uncovered at 350 for 20 minutes

title: macaroni   cheese   easy and cheesy
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Cook pasta in salted water until al dente
3. Drain and set aside
4. Place milk , flour , pepper , basil and tabasco in a lidded container
5. Shake for about a minute to blend
6. In a large bowl combine cooked pasta , milk / flour mixture , onions and 4 cups of cheese
7. Stir well
8. Pour into a lightly greased baking dish
9. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and remaining 1 / 2 cup of cheese
10. Bake for 45 minutes or until brown and bubbly

title: parker s beef stew
steps:
1. Place the beef in a bowl with red wine , garlic , and bay leaves
2. Place in the refrigerator and marinate overnight
3. The next day , preheat the oven to 300 degrees f
4. Combine the flour , 1 tablespoon salt , and 1 tablespoon pepper
5. Lift the beef out of the marinade with a slotted spoon and discard the bay leaves and garlic , saving the marinade
6. In batches , dredge the cubes of beef in the flour mixture and then shake off the excess
7. Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large pot and brown half the beef over medium heat for 5 to 7 minutes , turning to brown evenly
8. Place the beef in a large oven-proof dutch oven and continue to brown the remaining beef , adding oil as necessary
9. Place all the beef in the dutch oven
10. Heat another 2 tablespoons of oil to the large pot and add the onions , carrots , mushrooms , and potatoes
11. Cook for 10 minutes over medium heat , stirring occasionally
12. Add the garlic and cook for 2 more minutes
13. Place all the vegetables in the dutch oven over the beef
14. Add 2 1 / 2 cups of the reserved marinade to the empty pot and cook over high heat to deglaze the bottom of the pan , scraping up all the brown bits with a wooden spoon
15. Add the chicken stock , rosemary , sun-dried tomatoes , worcestershire sauce , 1 tablespoon salt , and 2 teaspoons pepper
16. Pour the sauce over the meat and vegetables in the dutch oven and bring to a simmer over medium heat on top of the stove
17. Cover the pot and place it in the oven to bake it for about 2 hours , until the meat and vegetables are all tender , stirring once during cooking
18. If the stew is boiling rather than simmering , lower the heat to 250 or 275 degrees f
19. Before serving , stir in the frozen peas , season to taste , and serve hot

title: whole fruit berry lime popsicles
steps:
1. Have whatever youre going to make your popsicles in ready , i use little 5 ounce paper cups and popsicles sticks from the craft store
2. Measure and thaw out your strawberries for a minute and a half in the microwave
3. You want them to give to the touch but not be cooked
4. Put the sugar , lime juice , and strawberries in a blender and start it up on low speed
5. Quarter your pineapple chunks while its blending
6. Once its all mixed dont stop your blender , open up the little cap on the top and add a few pieces of pineapple letting them blend in a few seconds before adding more
7. You want it to incorporate , adding it all at once wont give you a smooth texture
8. Oh , you might want to put the lid back on quick after each time , it has a tendency to shoot up when you start but thats part of the fun , right ?
9. After all the pineapple is thoroughly blended in add a half a handful of raspberries at a time until blended in , repeat until theyre all in , your mixture will start to get thick being semi-frozen you may have to let it sit and warm up a little as you add the raspberries
10. Make sure your mixture is blended well before you turn off and taste it
11. This is key , if its too tart for you or too sweet you want to adjust it now
12. A little more sugar or lime juice , you want to barely taste the lime
13. If your strawberries are tart this can mean putting in a little sugar for that as well
14. Pour equal amounts into five paper cups , if your mixture is pretty thick you can push in the sticks and theyll hold themselves up and put in the freezer
15. If not freeze them for half an hour to an hour until the sticks will hold up themselves
16. I let them sit overnight so i know theyre completely frozen but you can judge for yourself when theyre done

title: devil s food squares
steps:
1. Mix the first 4 ingredients and bring to boiling point , combine the next two ingredients and pour the hot chocolate mixture over
2. Add the remaining ingredients
3. Bake in 9x13 pan at 400 degrees for 20 minutes
4. Icing
5. Bring margarine , cocoa and milk to boiling point over low heat , add powdered sugar , vanilla and nuts , ice cake while hot

title: baked macaroni and brie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Butter a medium casserole dish and set aside
3. Boil pasta until al dente
4. Drain
5. While pasta cooks , melt 2 tablespoons butter in a large saucepan over medium-low heat
6. Sprinkle in flour and cook , stirring continuously for 2 minutes , to form a golden brown roux
7. Stir in milk and cream
8. Bring to a boil , stirring continuously , then reduce heat to low
9. Add cheese and continue to stir until melted and smooth
10. Salt and pepper to taste
11. Toss in drained pasta , combine very well , making sure the sauce soaks the pasta thoroughly
12. Pour into the prepared casserole dish
13. Stir together bread or cracker crumbs with 3 tablespoons melted butter
14. Sprinkle evenly over pasta
15. Bake for 15 minutes

title: pollo bucco alla milanese
steps:
1. Coat the chicken thighs in flour and season with salt and pepper
2. Heat the olive oil in a stove-proof casserole on the stove
3. Brown the chicken until golden all over
4. Add the garlic clove , bay leaf , spices and white wine
5. Cover and cook in medium oven until tender , about an hour
6. Remove from the oven
7. Stir together the parsley , garlic and lemon
8. Toss the chicken thighs in the mixture
9. Serve immediately with risotto

title: italian parmesan baked chicken
steps:
1. Skin chicken if desired
2. Combine dry ingredients in one pie plate and milk and beaten egg in another
3. Wet drumsticks completely in milk and egg
4. Coat them thoroughly with the breadcrumb mixture , turning so that the crumbs cover the leg
5. Place legs in a lightly greased 9x13 , making sure that the legs do not touch
6. Place in an oven preheated to 375 and bake 45-55 min or until juices run clear and chicken reaches an internal temp of 180

title: munchy crunchy asian broccoli slaw
steps:
1. Mix the broccoli slaw , carrots , cucumbers , scallion and cilantro in a medium bowl
2. In a jar , mix the oil , soy sauce , sesame oil , rice vinegar , peanut butter , sugar , salt and pepper
3. Stir vigorously to mix
4. Pour over salad and toss well to mix
5. Enjoy !

title: calabacitas    mexican style zucchini
steps:
1. Melt butter in large skillet
2. Add steak cubes , a few at a time and remove to a bowl as they brown
3. Saute zucchini until slightly tender , about ten minutes
4. Return meat to skillet
5. Add corn , chilies , garlic , salt , oregano and cumin
