6. Cook , stirring occasionally until meat is tender , about ten minutes
7. Add cheese
8. Stir until blended
9. Serve while hot

title: chunky pork chipotle chili
steps:
1. Chop the onion
2. Mince the garlic
3. Cut the pepper into 1 / 2 inch chunks
4. Cut the pork into 3 / 4 inch cubes
5. Heat the oil in a large saucepan
6. Add onion and garlic and cook 3 minutes
7. Toss the pork cubes with the cumin and chili powder until well coated
8. Add the pork to the saucepan and cook until the pork is browned , about 3 minutes
9. Add the bell pepper , beer , picante sauce , and 1 tablespoon of the chipotle chilis
10. Bring the mixture to a boil
11. Simmer about 5 minutes or until pork is tender
12. Taste and add more chipotle if desired
13. Add the beans and heat through
14. Serve topped with sour cream and cilantro , if desired

title: okra 1 2 3
steps:
1. In a wok / pan , add okra , salt , tamarind pulp and turmeric -this prevents the okra from becoming slimy
2. After it comes to a boil , adjust the heat to medium and let it cook through
3. Ater the okra is soft and done , add the sambar powder
4. Ready to eat ! vary the ingredients according to your own taste
5. Goes very well with chappatis , puris or yoghurt rice

title: baked scrod with lemon herb panko crumbs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. In a skillet , saute the onion in 1 teaspoon of oil and 1 teaspoon of butter until soft but not browned
3. In a medium sized bowl , combine the panko crumbs with the parsley and 1 teaspoon of melted butter , 1 teaspoon of olive oil , and the juice of half the lemon
4. Once the onions are soft , add a pinch of red pepper flakes , salt and pepper
5. Add to the onions , the juice of 1 / 2 the lemon and the white wine and continue to cook for 1 minute
6. Spread the onion and lemon mixture into individual baking dishes or one baking dish large enough to snuggly hold all the fish
7. Place the fish on top of the onions and season the fish with salt and pepper and a little spray of olive oil
8. Divide the crumb topping evenly over the fish and sprinkle with parsley and give a light spray of olive oil
9. Bake for about 20 minutes until fish is cooked through and the crumbs are nicely browned
10. Cover with tinfoil half way through baking if the top is browning to fast

title: apricot glazed cornish game hens with apricot rice stuffing
steps:
1. For glaze: put 1 / 4 cup water , apricot preserve and cinnamon in a microwave safe bowl
2. Microwave on high about 20 seconds
3. Stir to blend
4. If not blending well , microwave another 10 seconds
5. Stir again till smooth
6. For rice: saut garlic , celery , onion , apricots in oil about 5 minutes
7. Add brown rice
8. Saut another 3 minutes
9. Add 2 cups chicken broth and 3-4 tablespoons of glaze sauce
10. Bring to a boil
11. Lower heat to a low simmer
12. Simmer covered 10-15 minutes
13. Add pilaf rice
14. Stir , cover and simmer 15-25 minutes or longer until liquid is absorbed
15. Allow to cool
16. For hens: preheat oven to 400f
17. Line a 13 x 9 pan with foil and spray foil with cooking spray
18. Wash hens , remove giblets and pat dry
19. Sprinkle with garlic powder in and out of hens
20. Stuff with rice mixture
21. Brush with glaze mixture
22. To prevent over browning make a foil tent
23. Crease a sheet of foil crosswise through the center to form a tent leave 1-2 inches between top of hens so heat can circulate crimp on sides
24. Bake 30 minutes
25. Remove foil and brush with glaze
26. Bake uncovered until hens are tender and juices run clear , about 40-45 minutes , basting about every 10-15 minutes until glaze is used up
27. 2-4 servings depending on appetite

title: chicken bruschetta
steps:
1. Spray broiler pan with nonstick cooking spray
2. Sprinkle chicken breast halves with garlic powder , 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and 1 / 8 teaspoon pepper
3. Place on sprayed broiler pan
4. Broil 4 to 6 inches from heat for 12 to 16 minutes or until fork-tender and juices run clear , turning once
5. Meanwhile , heat oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until hot
6. Add mushrooms , garlic and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt
7. Cook 1 to 2 minutes or until garlic is tender , stirring occasionally
8. Add onion , chopped basil , tomatoes , vinegar and 1 / 8 teaspoon pepper
9. Cook and stir 30 to 45 seconds or until thoroughly heated
10. To serve , arrange chicken on individual plates
11. Sprinkle with half of the cheese
12. Top each serving with mushroom mixture
13. Sprinkle with remaining cheese
14. Garnish with basil sprigs
15. High altitude :
16. Broil chicken 16 to 20 minutes
17. Ingredient info:
18. Italian plum tomatoes , also called roma tomatoes , are small oval fruits prized for their low moisture and high flavor
19. These characteristics make them perfect for canning , sauce and toppings
20. Other tomatoes can make pizza and bruschetta soggy
21. Ingredient substitutions:
22. To boost italian flavor , use fresh garlic on the chicken breasts
23. Mince 1 or 2 cloves and rub into poultry
24. Another italian grating cheese can be used in place of the parmesan
25. Try asiago or romano

title: black bean and cheesy burrito   ww
steps:
1. Layer black beans on tortilla and top with cheese
2. Microwave until cheese melts
3. Roll up tortilla , top with salsa

title: triple play peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Line baking sheets with parchment
3. Cream butter , sugars , peanut butter , baking powder , baking soda and salt
4. Add eggs one at a time
5. Stir in the flour , nuts , and chips
6. Drop by tablespoon onto prepared sheets
7. Bake for 14 minutes , until set and brown around the edges
8. Remove from oven and cool on pan 5 minutes before transferring to wire racks to cool

title: cafe de menthe
steps:
1. Pour syrup into large coffee mug or tall footed continental cup and fill with 3 / 4 cup strong coffee
2. Stir
3. Top with whipped cream and pour a jigger of creme de menthe over all

title: beef fillet with irish whiskey and cream pan sauce
steps:
1. Season each steak generously with salt and pepper
2. Heat a heavy-based skillet that's large enough to hold the steaks over high heat until quite hot
3. Add the vegetable oil if not using cast iron
4. Test pan by touching the edge of one steak to the pan surface
5. It will sizzle briskly when ready
6. Immediately drop in the steaks and sear one side for 2 minutes
7. Sneak a peak to see if the first side is nicely browned
8. Flip the steaks and sear the other side for 2-3 minutes
9. Reduce heat to medium high , cook for another 2 minutes , flip , and cook until a digital thermometer reads 120 degrees for rare , or 125 degrees for medium rare , another 1-2 minutes
10. Transfer steaks to a warm platter and let them rest , covered loosely with foil , while you make the sauce
11. Return unwashed pan to medium heat
12. Add butter and let it melt
13. Add shallots and cook , stirring , until fragrant and just tender , 1-2 minutes
14. Add whiskey and stir with wooden spoon , scraping up any browned bits stuck to the pan
15. Add broth and worcestershire sauce , raise the heat to medium high , and bring to a boil
16. Whisk in the mustard and then the cream
17. Continue to cook at a boil , stirring , until reduced to a saucy consistency , 3-5 minutes
18. Taste the sauce and season with salt and pepper , and lemon juice
19. Serve steak with the sauce

title: valerie s mexican lasagna
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Season ground beef according to directions on taco seasoning packet
3. Set aside prepared beef for layering
4. Spray 9 x 12-inch baking dish with cooking spray
5. Layer ingredients in the following order:
6. 4 corn tortillas
7. Spread 1 / 2 can of beans over tortillas
8. Sprinkle 1 / 3 of beef over the beans
9. Spread about 1 / 4 cup of taco sauce over beef
10. 1 / 2 can of corn over sauce
11. 1 cup of shredded cheese
12. Another layer of corn tortillas
13. Repeat above layers ending with a layer of beef
14. Bake , covered 30 minutes
15. Uncover and sprinkle with 1 cup of shredded cheese
16. Return to oven until cheese is fully melted
17. Serve casserole hot with chopped lettuce , diced tomato , sour cream , chips and salsa

title: creamy crawfish pasta
steps:
1. Cook linguine according to package directions
2. Drain
3. Keep warm
4. Melt butter in a dutch oven over medium heat
5. Add flour , and cook , stirring constantly , 2 minutes or until blended
6. Add green onions and next 4 ingredients
7. Saute 5 minutes or until tender
8. Add bouillon cube and next 7 ingredients
9. Cook 10 minutes or until thickened
10. Stir in hot sauce , if desired
11. Serve over linguine noodles
12. Sprinkle with shredded parmesan cheese

title: vegetable hamburger soup   stew
steps:
1. In a very large pot , brown meat of your choice and garlic over medium heat
2. Drain off grease and return meat to the pot
3. Add remaining ingredients
4. Stir to combine
5. Over medium-high heat bring to a slight boil
6. Reduce heat to low
7. Cover
8. Continue simmering , stirring occasionally for 30 minutes or until pasta is cooked

title: mexicali pepper muffins
steps:
1. Stir together cornmeal , flour , sugar , baking powder , salt and seasonings in a large bowl and set aside
2. Saute peppers and corn in butter in a skillet for 3 to 4 minutes
3. Beat together milk and eggs and stir pepper / corn mixture into this milk mixture
4. Combine this mixture with the flour mixture
5. Stir until just combined
6. Pour into greased muffin cups
7. Bake at 400 for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden

title: cherry tomato and ravioli soup
steps:
1. In large , deep skillet with a tight-fitting lid , or a dutch oven , heat the olive oil over medium-high heat
2. Stir in the cherry tomatoes and garlic and onion
3. Season with salt and pepper
4. Cover the pan and cook , shaking the pan occasionally , until the tomatoes burst and a thick sauce forms , 7-8 minutes
5. Add the chicken stock and water and bring to a boil
6. Cook for a couple of minutes , then add the ravioli and cook until tender , 3-4 minutes
7. Remove from the heat and stir in the basil and italian seasoning to wilt
8. Serve the soup and top with the cheese
9. Serve with crusty bread

title: lemon cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In a mixer , blend butter and sugar until combined
3. Add in lemon zest , lemon juice and egg and mix until fluffy
4. Dump in flour , baking soda and salt and combine
5. Prepare cookie sheet with silpat or parchment paper
6. On a small plate , roll teaspoons of dough into balls and then roll in the remaining sugar
7. Add to cookie sheet
8. Bake for about 12-14 minutes or until the edges are lightly golden
9. Remove from sheet and cool on racks

title: julia child s baked yogurt tart
steps:
1. Working on a lightly floured surface , roll dough into a 12" circle 1 / 8 to 1 / 4" thick
2. Fit into the pan , pressing against bottom and up the sides
3. Trim to 1 / 2" and crimp edges
4. Chill about 30 minute
5. Fit a round of parchment or wax paper or aluminum foil into bottom of the crust , fill with dried beans , rice or pie weights
6. Blind bake crust 20-25 minutes in a 400 oven , until set and lightly browned
7. Remove weights and liner
8. Cool to room temperature on a rack and lower oven to 325
9. Beat the eggs and sugar together until they thicken slightly and turn pale , 2-3 minutes
10. Fold in yogurt and vanilla , mix just until blended
11. Gradually add the flour through a sifter , folding it in gently
12. Pour the yogurt filling into the cooled tart shell , smoothing the top
13. The filling will only come about 2 / 3's of the way to the top
14. Scatter the fruit over the top of the tart
15. It will push the filling to the top of the crust
16. Sprinkle with chopped nuts around the edge of the tart
17. Place tart on jelly roll pan to catch drips and bake for 35-40 minutes , or until top is golden
18. Transfer to rack and cool to room temperature
19. Unmold tart
20. Serve at room temperature , or chilled if desired
21. Sprinkle with confectioner's sugar
22. Serve the same day as baked
23. Cover and refrigerate

title: sausage herb bread
steps:
1. Roll out dinner rolls to approx 3-inch circles
2. Lay 8 of the rolls in the bottom of a 10-inch bundt pan , sprayed with no stick cooking spray , overlapping slightly
3. Spray the rolls lightly with icbinb spray
4. Sprinkle with crushed herbs
5. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese
6. Sprinkle in the cooked sausage
7. Top with remaining 8 dinner rolls , overlapping slightly
8. Cover and let rise at room temp until doubled in size , approx 2 hours
9. Bake in a 350f oven for 20 minutes , or until golden brown
10. Remove from oven and cool in pan for 5 minutes
11. Invert onto a plate
12. Cool another 5 minutes before slicing
13. Enjoy !
14. Cook time includes rising time !
15. You could also change the herbs if those aren't your favorite !
16. Cheeses could be changed too !
17. Play with it !

title: pecan crusted trout  south beach diet phase1
steps:
1. Heat the oven to 400
2. Line a baking sheet with parchment
3. In a food processor , pulse pecans , rosemary , garlic , and cayenne until finely chopped
4. Place each trout , opened and flesh side up on the baking sheet
5. Season flesh side of trout with salt and brush with egg white
6. Sprinkle nut mixture over egg white and press to adhere
7. Drizzle evenly with oil and bake until trout is opaque and tender inside , about 20 minutes

title: frozen cranberry punch
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large plastic container or ice cube trays
2. Cover and freeze
3. To serve , spoon into wine glasses or goblets

title: crunchy cheese stuffed chicken
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400
2. Cut a 3-inch slit in each chicken breast half to form pocket
3. Insert 1 strip cheese into each pocket
4. Secure each pocket with several toothpicks
5. Combine crumbs , shredded cheese and seasoning salt in pie pan or shallow bowl
6. Place beaten egg in another pie pan or shallow bowl
7. Dip chicken in egg
8. Lightly press both sides of chicken in crumb mixture to coat
9. Place chicken onto greased baking sheet
10. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink

title: balsamic herbed marinade for goat cheese
steps:
1. Mix vinegar , lemon juice , orange juice , lemon peel , garlic , basil , rosemary , and oregano in medium bowl
2. Gradually whisk in oil
3. Season to taste with salt and pepper
4. Pour mixture into glass baking dish or a pickling jar
5. Add goat cheese
6. Turn to coat
7. Refrigerate at least 2 hours or up to 2 days , turning occasionally
8. Transfer goat cheese to platter
9. Spoon marinade over
10. Top with sun dried tomatoes and or black olives

title: chocolate soda cake
steps:
1. Mix dry cake mix with soda
2. Don't pay any attention to adding oil , egg , etc
3. Pour into floured cake pans , bundt pan , muffin tins , etc
4. Bake according to directions on box

title: basic mojito ingredients
steps:
1. In a tall thin glass , crush or muddle part of the mint with a fork to coat the inside
2. Add the sugar and lime juice and stir thoroughly
3. Top with ice
4. Add rum and mix
5. Top off with the club soda
6. Add a lime or lemon slice and the remaining mint
7. Serves one

title: mediterranean chicken pita pockets
steps:
1. Bring a half cup of water to a boil in a medium saucepan
2. Add the frozen peas , bring to a boil , and simmer for 4 minutes
3. Drain , and set aside
4. In a large bowl , combine the cooked chicken , cooked peas , tomatoes , feta cheese , green onion and black pepper if desired
5. Fold in the yogurt , mayo , lemon juice and dillweed
6. Toss well to combine
7. Line the pita halves with a leaf of lettuce or shredded lettuce if desired , and stuff with chicken mixture
8. If you are a garlic lover , then fresh garlic or garlic powder may be added to the mixture

title: evan s chicken salad
steps: 1. Mix all together

title: madeira mushroom gravy  to go with oven roast
steps:
1. Combine water , 2 tbsp butter and lemon juice in a saucepan , bring to a boil and reduce heat to low and add mushrooms , cover and cook 5 minutes pour off the fat from the roasting pan
2. Add 1 / 4 cup butter to the pan and place over medium high heat , stir butter to melt and add the onions , saute until transparent drain mushroom liquid and add to the pan
3. Add beef broth , tomato paste and madeira wine , blend well
4. Stir in the mushrooms and flour
5. Stir until the gravy is slightly thickened
6. Season to taste serve

title: apple cranberry raisin salad
steps:
1. Combine salad dressing ingredients , shake & let set for at least 2 hours at room temperature
2. Put all salad ingredients together in large bowl
3. Toss salad with dressing and chow down !
4. Cooking time does not include dressing

title: fried norwegian cookies aka fattigmans bakkelse
steps:
1. Beat eggs and sugar in large bowl with electric mixer at medium speed until thick and lemon colored
2. Beat in butter , milk and vanilla until well blended
3. Gradually add 1 1 / 2 cups flour
4. Beat at low speed until well blended
5. Stir in enough remaining flour with spoon to form soft dough
6. Divide dough into 4 portions
7. Cover and refrigerate until firm , at least 2 hours or overnight
8. With floured hands , shape 1 portion dough at a time into 1-inch-thick square
9. Place dough on lightly floured surface
10. Roll out dough to 11-inch square
11. Cut dough into 1 1 / 4-inch strips
12. Cut strips diagonally at 2-inch intervals
13. Cut 1 1 / 4-inch slit vertically down center of each strip
14. Insert one end of strip through cut to form twist
15. Repeat with each strip
16. Repeat with remaining dough portions
17. Heat oil in large saucepan to 365f
18. Place 12 cookies at a time in hot oil
19. Fry about 1 1 / 2 minutes or until golden brown , turning cookies once with slotted spoon
20. Drain on paper towels
21. Dust cookies with powdered sugar
22. Cookies are best if served immediately , but can be stored in airtight container for up to 1 day

title: rice pilaf with beans
steps:
1. Heat oil in a heavy saucepan over medium heat
2. Saut rice until golden
3. Stir in stock , water and pepper
4. Increase heat to high and bring to a boil
5. Immediately reduce heat to low
6. Cover and simmer 20-25 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid absorbed
7. Stir in beans
8. Turn on broiler
9. Transfer rice to ovenproof serving dish
10. Arrange tomato slices over beans and dot with butter
11. Broil 2-3 minutes or cook until tomato slices are cooked throughout
12. Serve pilaf sprinkled with mint

title: raspberry grilled cheese sandwiches
steps:
1. Spread preserve onto 2 slices of sourdough bread
2. Sprinkle with pecans and green onions
3. Lay two cheese slices on each of the two bread slices
4. Top with remaining bread slices to make sandwiches
5. Spread butter on the outside of each sandwich
6. Grill on a hot griddle or in a hot skillet for 3-4 minutes on each side or until golden brown

title: swedish  meat  balls with gravy  vegan
steps:
1. In a medium bowl combine the breadcrumbs with the soy or rice milk
2. Set aside
3. Heat up the vegetable broth in a pyrex measuring cup and then add in the dry tvp
4. Mix together well and let the tvp absorb for a few minutes
5. While that sits , dice up your onion
6. Mix together the breadcrumb mixture with the tvp , about 2 tbsp of the onion
7. The parlsey flakes , garlic powder , nutmeg , salt and pepper
8. Adjust the salt to taste as it will really depend on how seasoned your veggie broth is
9. You want the mixture to hold together when formed into a ball in your hand - you may need to add a little extra broth , maybe a few tablespoons
10. I find pushing down with the spoon as you mix helps to combine everything
11. Form into balls , 1 1 / 2 inches in diameter
12. Heat up the oil in a saute pan , add in the "meat" balls and brown on all sides as best you can
13. When complete , place them into a casserole dish and set aside
14. Put your oven on to 350 degrees
15. Clean out your saute pan of any bits and then return to medium heat
16. Saute the rest of the onion and the mushrooms for about 5 minutes until the onions are translucent
17. In a bowl whisk together 1 / 3 cup soy creamer with the corn starch
18. Mix in 1 1 / 2 cups veggie broth , or less if you're using more creamer , along with the nutritional yeast and a pinch of nutmeg
19. Pour the broth mixture into the pan with mushrooms & onions , bring up to a gentle boil , stirring well to get a smooth sauce
20. Turn heat down and let it simmer for just a few minutes
21. Add in some braggs for flavour or colour if you choose
22. Pour the gravy over the meatballs and bake in the oven for about 20 minutes until bubbly
23. Serve over noodles or mashed potatoes

title: mango strawberry trifle
steps:
1. Wash , hull and slice your strawberries and set aside
2. Using a serrated knife cut the pound cake into 1 / 2 inch slices and then each slice into thirds
3. Set aside
4. Pour all the cream in a large bowl and add the juice of 1 / 2 a lime
5. Whip either manually or with a mixer until stiff peaks form
6. Using a spatula , about a cup at a time slowly fold in the mango pulp until fully incorporated
7. Now , here's hoping you have a large , deep glass dish of some sort ! begin with a layer of poundcake , layer tightly but now so tightly that they're smashed
8. If you're using alcohol pour about 1 / 3 to 1 / 2 a cup of the alcohol over the cake and allow to soak inches
9. Then put a layer of strawberries on the cake
10. Next place the sliced strawberries around the perimeter of the cake and against the glass with the narrow end up
11. Now spoon a generous amount of the mango fool over the strawberries
12. Then a layer of cake , alcohol , strawberries , fool and so on until you reach the top of your dish
13. At this point i like to decorate with some mint leaves or strawberries on top
14. Chill for about an hour and serve !

title: salsa fresca
steps:
1. In a medium-size glass mixing bowl , stir together all the ingredients
2. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 4 hours to let the flavors develop
3. Stir before serving
4. Variations:
5. If you would like a smooth salsa , puree the ingredients in a food processor or with an immersion blender

title: light and yummie strawberry pie
steps:
1. Drain pineapple , reserving juice in a 2-cup measuring cup
2. Set pineapple aside
3. Add enough water to juice to measure 1
4. 5 cups
5. Transfer to a suacepan
6. Whisk in the pudding mix and gelatin until combined
7. Bring to a boil
8. Cook and stir for 1-2 minute or until thickened
9. Stir in pineapple
10. Remove from the heat
11. Cool for 10 minute
12. Add the strawberries
13. Toss gently to coat
14. Pour into crust
15. Refrigerate until set
16. About three hours
17. Garnish each piece with 1 tablespoons whipped topping

title: very berry blueberry muffins
steps:
1. Place oven rack in top 1 / 3 of oven
2. Preheat oven to 375f line 12 muffin cups with paper liners
3. Lightly spray liners with non-stick cooking spray
4. Sift together flour , baking powder and salt , set aside
5. Beat margarine at medium speed with an electric mixer until creamy
6. Gradually add splenda and honey , beating until light and fluffy
7. Add eggs one at a time beating until blended after each addition
8. Stir in vanilla
9. Alternately add flour mixture and milk , beginning and ending with flour mixture
10. Beat at low speed until blended after each addition
11. Fold in berries
12. Spoon batter evenly into paper lined muffin cups
13. Bake 20 to 22 minutes or until golden
14. Remove from pan immediately , and cool on wire rack

title: prego no po   garlic nailed steak   portugal
steps:
1. Place the steaks on your workspace , lay the slices of garlic on the side of the steaks , using a tenderizing mallet , "nail" the garlic to the steak by pounding the slices into the meat
2. Repeat on the reverse side of the steaks
3. Melt 3 tablespoons butter in a skillet over medium-high heat
4. Fry each steak in the butter for two to three minutes , turning once , then transfer to a dish and cover
5. Melt the remaining tbsp of butter in the same skillet , add the onions and saute until they are golden
6. Transfer the onions to the dish holding the steaks
7. Pour the wine into the same skillet and using the flat edge of a wooden spoon , scrap up the caramelized coating on the bottom of the pan
8. Raise the heat to medium-high and reduce the sauce by half
9. Return the onions and beef to the sauce and heat through for 1 minute
10. Serve on a plate with rice and vegetables

title: delicious living s compote of plums pluots w  fresh ginger
steps:
1. Rinse plums and slice into wedges about -inch thick at their widest part
2. In a 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat , melt butter with honey , grated ginger and ground cardamom
3. When the mixture is saucy , add plums
4. Increase heat and cook , moving fruit around pan about every 20 seconds so that cut surfaces take on some color and juices begin to flow , 23 minutes
5. Stop cooking when juice just coats fruit
6. Remove from heat and transfer to a serving bowl , scraping in all pan liquid
7. Serve warm or cool

title: pork with pear and ginger sauce
steps:
1. Trim fat from porkchops
2. In larg non stick skillet heat oil
3. Cook pork 3-5min per side
4. Transfer to dish and cover with foil to keep warm
5. Add the lemon juice and the sugar to the pan and stir contantly abd cook until golden
6. Stir in wine and chicken broth
7. Add pears and cook uncovered for 5-7 minutes or until tender
8. Mix cornstarch with 2 tsp water
9. Add salt and pepper to taste
10. Add ginger
11. Return pork chops to skillet and heat through
12. I serve this with rice

title: creamy shrimp salad on romaine
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the shrimp , celery , egg whites , walnuts and onions
2. Add the dressing and stir until the shrimp-mixture is coated
3. Cover and chill in the refrigerator about 30 minutes to blend the flavors
4. To serve , divide the lettuce among four plates
5. Then top with shrimp mixture

title: pasta and shrimp
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Steam the broccoli
3. Combine all ingredients except the parmesan cheese and heat on low
4. Top w / parmesan cheese and serv

title: colcannon  ww
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray a 1 1 / 2-quart casserole with nonstick cooking spray
3. In large bowl , combine potatoes and yogurt
4. With mixer at low speed , beat until potatoes are chunky-smooth
5. Stir in cabbage , leeks , chives , salt , white pepper and nutmeg , mixing well
6. Spoon mixture into prepared casserole
7. Dot with margarine
8. Bake 30 minutes , until lightly browned
9. Each serving provides: 2 vegetables , 1 / 2 bread , 15 optional calories
10. Per serving: 95 calories , 3 g protein , 1 g fat , 19 g carbohydrate , 320 mg sodium , 1 mg cholesterol , 2 g dietary fiber
11. 2 points

title: group hugs
steps:
1. Place the chocolate in a single layer on the bottom of the slow cooker , and sprinkle the almonds and cranberries on top
2. Cook on low for 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours , or until the chocolate is soft but not completely melted
3. Turn off the slow cooker , stir the ingredients well , and drop by spoonfuls onto a tray lined with wax paper
4. Chill for a few hours before serving

title: chicken biriyani beggars pouches
steps:
1. Mix the cayenne powder , coriander powder and tumeric powder , set aside
2. In a clean food processor grind the medium onion , garlic and ginger to a paste
3. Dry the chicken well and chop finely , but do not grind ( a couple of pulses in the food processor will do fine
4. Heat the oil or ghee in a pan and fry the onion slices to golden and set aside
5. Do the same to the cashew nuts and raisins and set aside
6. Add the ground paste and dry spice mix to the pan and cook for 3 to 4 minutes , then add the chopped chicken
7. Cook the chicken in the spice paste for a few minutes , turning it over a few times with a spoon , until it is no longer pink
8. Add the green chilies , garam masala , whole cardamom , yoghurt , coriander leaves and salt to taste
9. Let the chicken simmer in the sauce until the chicken is cooked and the sauce thickens
10. Remove from heat and let cool
11. Cut the phyllo sheets in half , so you have 32 squares
12. Cover the phyllo with plastic wrap and a damp towel while working so it does not dry out
13. Place one sheet of phyllo on your work surface
14. Brush with a little melted butter , especially the edges
15. Place a second sheet on top in the opposite direction to make a cross , brushing this sheet with melted butter as well
16. Place two more sheets in the same manner on top of the previous sheets of phyllo (you will have 4 layers , criss crossing each other
17. Divide chicken mixture into 8 and place 1 / 8th of mixture into center of one of the layers of phyllo
18. Sprinkle 1 / 8th of the cashews and raisins on top
19. Loosen the sheets of phyllo with a flat metal spatula or knife and using your fingers , carefully lift and gather the phyllo encasing the chicken in a bundle with a loose flowing frilly top
20. Pinch the gather together and hold for 5 seconds
21. This will hold the package closed
22. Place each purse on a lightly greased baking sheet and repeat with remaining chicken and phyllo
23. Refrigerate until ready to bake
24. When placing the chicken on the sheet pans , leave enough space between the bundles to that they will become crispy on the sides when baked
25. Preheat oven to 375f
26. Place the pans with the beggars purses on them into the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes , until nicely crispy
27. To serve place one beggars purse on a warm plate , with a dollop of creme fraiche on the side , sprinkling the chopped coriander on for a garnish
28. If you wanted , two of these purses could be served as a main course along with a spicy basamati pilaf

title: queijadas de sintra  portuguese cheese tarts with cinnamon
steps:
1. For the pastry: combine the flour and salt in a large bowl
2. With a pastry blender , cut in the shortening until the texture of fine meal
3. Forking briskly , drizzle just enough ice water over the mixture to make it hold together
4. Shape into a ball , wrap in wax paper , and refrigerate several hours
5. Meanwhile , prepare the filling: in a food processor fitted with the metal chopping blade , process the mozzarella , butter , sugar , and cinnamon about 60 seconds nonstop until smooth and creamy
6. Scrape down the work bowl sides with a rubber spatula and beat 60 seconds longer
7. Add the egg yolks , one at a time , beating well after each addition
8. Add the flour and pulse the motor on once or twice to blend
9. Transfer the mixture to a small bowl
10. Cover and chill several hours
11. When ready to bake the queijadas , preheat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit
12. Divide the pastry in half and roll , first one half , then the other , as thin as paper , on a lightly floured pastry cloth with a lightly floured , stockinette-covered rolling pin
13. Cut into rounds with a 3 1 / 2 inch cutter
14. Also re-roll and cut the scraps
15. Fit the pastry into plain or fluted tart tins measuring 2 1 / 2 inches across the top
16. Set the tins on baking sheets , then half-fill each tart shell with the cheese mixture
17. Bake uncovered for 18 to 20 minutes , just until the filling is puffy and a rich amber brown
18. Remove the tarts from the oven , cool until easy to handle
19. Then using a small pointed knife , gently pry the tarts from the tins
20. Serve at room temperature

title: mincemeat fruitcake cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f , & lightly coat baking sheet with cooking spray
2. In large bowl , beat oil & sugar until light
3. Beat in egg & almond extract until smooth
4. Stir in mincemeat
5. In medium bowl , whisk together flour , baking powder & salt
6. Beat into egg mixture until blended
7. Stir in cherries
8. Drop by rounded teasoonfuls onto parchment paper lined baking sheets
9. Bake 12-14 minutes , or until lightly brown & firm
10. Cool on wire rack

title: wildfire horseradish crusted pork chops
steps:
1. Horseradish crust:
2. In a large mixing bowl , beat together well 1 stick butter , 6 tablespoons horseradish , ground pepper and fine bread crumbs
3. Cover and refrigerate until use
4. Pork chops:
5. In a large zip lock bag , mix together the garlic , herbs and 2 tablespoon olive oil , add chops and seal bag
6. Shake and refrigerate overnight
7. Remove chops from bag , season with salt and pepper
8. Heat oven to 450f
9. Heat the teaspoon olive oil in a large non-stick frypan over medium high heat
10. Add chops and cook for 5 minutes , turn and brown for 5 minutes more
11. Remove chops to shallow baking dish , top each chop with 1 to 2 tablespoons horseradish crust and place in oven 6 to 8 minutes until crust is golden brown

title: easy breezy rice milk
steps:
1. In a blender or food processor , blend all the ingredients until smooth
2. This will be quite thick and gets thicker as it sets
3. Thin the mixture with more water if necessary
4. Strain any lumps and chill
5. In addition to drinking it as is , it may be used in gravies , sauces , and soups in place of milk

title: rice noodles with coconut cashew sauce
steps:
1. Combine the coconut milk and water in a medium-sized saucepan
2. Add the ginger , lime juice , chilies , garlic , coriander , cilantro , mint , and salt , and bring to a boil
3. Lower the heat to a simmer , and cook uncovered for 10 minutes
4. Remove from the heat and stir in the sugar
5. At this point , you can let the sauce steep for a stronger flavor for a few hours , or even overnight , or continue on with the recipe
6. Strain the mixture through a fine sieve into a bowl
7. Press all the liquid from the garlic , ginger , cilantro , etc
8. , then discard the solids that remain in the sieve
9. Place the cashews in a blender , and then pour in the coconut milk mixture
10. Puree until smooth
11. Heat a potful of water to a boil
12. Add the noodles , and cook them according to the directions on the package
13. Drain the noodles , rinse , and drain again , then transfer to a large , shallow serving bowl
14. Immediately add the minced green onion and all the sauce
15. Toss well and enjoy !

title: fried pizza  andre  style
steps:
1. For bread dough: place flour , salt and sugar in a bowl
2. Fold salt in once to accommodate yeast later
3. Melt shortening and butter
4. Scald milk--must be cooled before added or be lukewarm
5. Add yeast and fold once , then make a well into flour mixture and add melted fat and milk
6. Make a dough
7. Rest dough for few minutes at room temperature to allow yeast to mul
8. When dough has risen twice the size , you can punch down lightly and then begin kneading
9. Knead dough until when you you break a piece and stretch it does not tear
10. Put to proof
11. Mold dough into round mini's just the size to fit your skillet and have space for flipping the dough
12. In a skillet put oil to heat then combine all the topping ingredients and saut for 2
13. 5 minutes
14. Prepare pan for frying the dough
15. Ensure the pan is clean , then add pinch of salt and shortening , then use a pastry brush to brush salted fat evenly including sides
16. Put pan to heat on medium flame
17. When heated , add the 1 dough to pan
18. When the bottom of the dough begins to turn golden brown , flip the dough over
19. Brush with melted fat and then add some of the topping
20. Cover the pan with cover for 2 minutes
21. Gently remove your pizza from the pan
22. Repeat this step with the other
23. Serve warm or cold if desired

title: mini crab cakes with remoulade sauce
steps:
1. In a medium skillet , heat the butter
2. Add the scallions , celery , and garlic , and cook over medium heat until the vegetables are translucent , about 3 to 4 minutes
3. In a medium bowl , combine the cooked vegetables with the crab , eggs , lemon juice , mustard , and parsley
4. Season with the salt , pepper , and nutmeg
5. Add the cracker meal and stir well to combine thoroughly
6. Form heaping tablespoons of the crab mixture into 1-1 / 2 inch-round cakes
7. Roll the cakes in additional cracker meal and place them on a baking pan
8. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before cooking
9. When ready to serve , heat a large skillet and pour the oil to a depth of 1 / 2-inch
10. Heat the oil over medium heat , keeping the oil at a low simmer
11. Cook and brown the crabcakes for 1 to 2 minutes on the first side and about 1 minute on the second side , or until they are cooked through and golden brown
12. Transfer the cakes to paper towels to drain
13. Serve the cakes warm , with the remoulade sauce
14. -=remoulade sauce=-
15. In a small bowl , whisk all of the ingredients together and refrigerate until ready to serve
16. Makes 1 cup

title: glazed harvest apple cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease and flour 12 cup bundt pan
3. In large bowl , combine all cake ingredients
4. Beat at low speed until moistened
5. Beat 2 minutes at high speed
6. Pour into prepared pan
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 40- 55 minutes or until cake tester comes out clean
8. Cool in pan 15 minutes
9. In medium saucepan , combine all glaze ingredients
10. Cook over med
11. High heat until mixture starts to boil , stirring occasionally
12. Boil 1 minute
13. Reserve 1 / 4 cup glaze , keep warm
14. With cake still in pan , pour remaining glaze over warm cake , between cake and edges of pan so glaze runs down sides of cake
15. Let stand 15 minutes
16. Invert onto serving plate and remove pan
17. Slowly pour reserved 1 / 4 cup of glaze over top of cake
18. Sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired
19. Serve warm or cool

title: cherry chocolate oat bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Line a 14x10 pan with parchment paper
3. Whip the butter , applesauce , faxseed and brown sugar
4. Beat in egg , milk and vanilla extract
5. Stir in all flour , baking soda , and cinnamon
6. Fold in oats , cherries , chocolate chips and coconut
7. Pour the wet mixture into the lined pan , spread evenly and bake for 30 - 35 minutes

title: cream of tomato soup with green chilies and cilantro pesto
steps:
1. Heat oil in large saucepan or dutch oven over medium low heat
2. Add celery , leek and onion and cook for 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender
3. Add next 7 ingredients and simmer for 45 minutes or until vegetables are tender
4. Strain soup , pressing on solids to extact as much liquid as possible , discard solids
5. In same saucepan as used to make tomato broth / soup , melt butter over medium-low heat
6. Add flour and whisk for about 10 minutes
7. Whisk in soup and simmer for 20-30 minutes or until thickened
8. Stir in half and half and continue simmering until heated through
9. Add chilie , tomatoes , 2 tablespoons pesto , sugar , salt and pepper
10. To make pesto: mix all pesto ingredients together in a food processor for 2 minutes until smooth
11. Store in jar in refrigerator

title: homemade oven chips
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 220 degrees celcius
2. Cut the potatoes into thick chips
3. Plunge into a pan contaning the boiling stock and cook for 5 minutes , until just tender
4. Drain in a colander
5. Allow to cool slightly
6. Put the oil in a plastic food boc and carefully toss the chips in the oil
7. Transfer the chips to a lightly greased baking tray and bake for 10-15 minutes , turning them once or twice , until golden and crisp
8. Sprinkle with paprika or salt to serve

title: mustard and brandy steaks
steps:
1. Heat a non stick frying pan until very hot
2. Dry fry for 2-3 minutes each side or until done to your preference
3. Remove from pan and keep warm
4. Take pan off the heat and add the brandy , water and mustard
5. Stir well , then add in the yoghurt and season with pepper
6. Return pan to heat to warm through , then add the steaks and coat with the sauce
7. Serve immediately

title: the migas breakfast tacos
steps:
1. Beat each egg one at a time
2. Add in 1 tsp water , about 1 / 8 cup crushed tortillas , about 2 tbsp tomatoes , and 1 tbsp scallions
3. Over medium heat , put 1 pat of butter into a shallow pan and lightly fry flour tortillas until they are slightly golden and still very flexible and workable
4. Set aside
5. Spray a pan with cooking spray and heat over medium flame
6. Once pan is hot , pour the egg mixture into the pan and stir quickly , then let it cok in one round piece
7. Once the eggs are almost done , pour about 1 / 4 cup of cheese on top and fold
8. Cook until melted
9. Put the eggs onto a warm tortilla and serve
10. This would taste great with any number of dips or sauces
11. Try salsa , hot sauce , guacamole , black beans , or whatever else comes to mind !

title: rustic apple tart with rich cream cheese crust
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees
2. To make the filling: peel the apples and cut them in half
3. Remove the cores with a paring knife
4. Cutting from blossom end to stem end , slice each half into 1 / 4 inch thick slices
5. Combine the apple slices with the lemon juice , 1 / 4 cup of the sugar , and the cinnamon in a large mixing bowl
6. Stir to combine
7. Let the apples stand until the sugar is dissolved , about 15 minutes , stirring once or twice
8. Place a shaped large dough round on a baking sheet
9. Arrange the apples slices in 2 concentric circles on the large dough round or in one circle on the small rounds , overlapping the apple slices slightly
10. Brush the rim of the crust with the egg yolk
11. Sprinkle the apples with the remaining 2 tablespoons sugar
12. Bake until golden , 30 to 35 minutes
13. Serve warm or at room temperature with vanilla whipped cream or ice cream on the side
14. Rustic apple tart is best served on the day it is made
15. To make the cheese tart dough: line a baking sheet with parchment paper
16. Place the cream cheese , butter , 1 cup flour , salt , and sugar in a food processor
17. Process until the dough just comes together
18. It will be sticky
19. Sprinkle the parchment paper with flour
20. Turn the dough out onto the sheet and , with floured hands , press the dough into a rough 10-inch circle or four 5-inch circles
21. Roll about 1 / 2 inch of the edge of the circle inward to create a lip to catch the juices
22. Refrigerate the crust for 1 hour or wrap the baking sheet in plastic and refrigerate it for up to 24 hours until you are ready to use it
23. Shaped rich cream cheese tart dough , wrapped in plastic , may be frozen for up to 2 months and used directly from the freezer
24. To make vanilla wihpped cream: combine the cream , sugar , and vanilla in a large mixing bowl
25. With an electric mixer fitted with a whisk attachment , whip on high speed until the cream just holds stiff peaks
26. Do not over whip
27. Use immediately , or refrigerate it , wrapped in plastic wrap , for up to 6 hours
28. Whisk it again for a couple of seconds before using
29. The dough can be made and shaped weeks ahead of time , and the rest of the prep is minimal , leaving lots of time to prepare the rest of the meal

title: marion county ia  pork producers barbecue sauce
steps:
1. In a saucepan , combine ketchup , vinegar , oil , worcestershire sauce , brown sugar , mustard , and garlic
2. Squeeze lemon juice into sauce and add 1 lemon half shell
3. Heat slowly for about 10 minutes
4. Sauce does not have to reach the boil , but heating blends flavor
5. Use sparingly as a basting sauce for fresh pork , ham , ribs , or chicken
6. Heat additional sauce and serve as a table sauce
7. Makes about 3 cups

title: white bean  parsley   garlic mash
steps:
1. Heat oil in saucepan and
2. Cook gently for 5 minutes
3. Add the chopped garlic cloves and cook for another 2 minutes until soft
4. Add stock to loosen as you mash
5. Stir in the parsley and the salt and pepper

title: gingerbread cookies
steps:
1. Pre-heat over to 350 degrees
2. In a large bowl cream butter , sauce , egg , sugar / honey , and warmed molasses
3. Dissolve baking soda in the warm water and add to mixture
4. Beat until smooth
5. Mix in flour , spice , and salt until well blended
6. Chill for 3-4 hours
7. It rolls out pretty well , but you'll probably need flour ! i always use a pretty good amount on my counter and rolling pin
8. Cut cookies into desired shapes and bake for 10-12 minutes
9. Depending on how you like your cookies , you'll need to watch the time and the thickness
10. For adorable christmas ornaments , i make thin cookies and bake them till they are pretty hard and crispy
11. Then , i put an ornament hook on them and they make great ornaments !

title: grilled zucchini  parmigiano crumbed
steps:
1. Preheat grill pan over medium-high heat
2. Chop bread and thyme in a food processor , and pulse 10 times
3. Heat in a skillet over medium-high heat
4. Add olive oil
5. Add bread mixture , and cook 5 minutes , stirring frequently
6. Combine zucchini , bread mixture , and parmigiano-reggiano , and serve

title: bisquick clone
steps:
1. Combine flour , milk , baking powder , and salt in a very large bowl
2. Cut in shortening until it resembles coarse cornmeal
3. Store in tightly closed covered container in a cool place

title: custard style macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Cook macaroni in water until tender
2. Drain thoroughly
3. Stir in butter and egg
4. Mix mustard and salt with 1 tbsp
5. Hot water , and add to milk
6. Add cheese to milk
7. Pour macaroni into a buttered casserole and add milk / cheese mixture
8. Sprinkle top with reserved cheese
9. Bake at 350 for approx
10. 40 minutes , or until custard is set and top is crusty

title: pear cobbler
steps:
1. Mix pears with 1 / 2 cup sugar and let stand
2. Put margarine in 2-quart casserole and place in 325 oven until melted
3. Combine all dry ingredients , including remaining 1 / 2 cup of sugar
4. Mix well
5. Beat egg and add to milk
6. Slowly combine with dry ingredients to make a batter
7. Pour over melted margarine
8. Do not stir
9. Spoon pears on top of batter
10. Do not stir
11. Bake at 325 for 1 hour
12. Serve hot or cold
13. Cool whip or ice cream topping is very good
14. I haven't tried this recipe , but after two reviews , i'm editing the recipe to cut the sugar in half

title: fastest cinnamon buns   rolls
steps:
1. Heat the oven to 400f grease the sides and bottom of a 9- or 10-inch springform pan or a 9-inch cake pan with cooking spray
2. Make the dough:
3. In a food processor , combine the cottage cheese , buttermilk , sugar , melted butter , and vanilla
4. Process until smooth , about 10 seconds
5. Add the flour , baking powder , salt , and baking soda and pulse in short bursts just until the dough clumps together
6. The dough will be soft and moist
7. Scrape the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead it with floured hands 4 or 5 times until smooth
8. With a rolling pin , roll the dough into a 12x15-inch rectangle
9. Make the filling: brush the dough with the melted butter , leaving a 1 / 2-inch border unbuttered around the edges
10. In a medium bowl , combine the brown sugar , cinnamon , allspice , and cloves
11. Sprinkle the mixture over the buttered area of the dough and pat gently into the surface
12. Sprinkle the nuts over the sugar mixture
13. Starting at a long edge , roll up the dough jelly-roll style
14. Pinch the seam to seal , and leave the ends open
15. With a sharp knife , cut the roll into 12 equal pieces
16. Set the pieces , cut side up , in the prepared pan
17. They should fill the pan and touch slightly , but dont worry if there are small gaps
18. Bake until golden brown and firm to the touch , 20 to 28 minutes
19. Set the pan on a wire rack to cool for 5 minutes
20. Run a spatula around the inside edge of the pan and remove the springform ring
21. Transfer the rolls to a serving plate
22. Make the glaze: in a small bowl , mix the confectioners sugar , 2 tbs
23. Milk , and vanilla to make a smooth glaze
24. It should have a thick but pourable consistency , so add up to 1 tbs
25. More milk if necessary
26. Drizzle the glaze over the rolls
27. Let stand 15 minutes and serve

title: marinated greek olives with grape tomatoes and feta cheese
steps:
1. For the olives- combine all ingredients in a large resealable freezer bag
2. Remove all the air you can and refrigerate for 24 hours , turning 2 or 3 times
3. For the cheese and tomatoes- drizzle the feta and tomatoes with the oil and lemon juice
4. Sprinkle with the oregano and pepper , tossing well
5. Cover and let stand for 30 minutes at room temp
6. Combine the olives with the feta and tomatoes , tossing well
7. Serve

title: sarah s best chili recipe
steps:
1. Cook ground beef in a skillet until browned
2. Drain off fat
3. Pour into a slow cooker
4. Add the rest of the ingredients except shredded cheese
5. Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours
6. Serve with diced onions , shredded cheese and fritos
7. Enjoy !

title: summertime fresh blackberry peach cobbler
steps:
1. Put berries , peaches , orange juice , water , 1 cup splenda , 1 / 4 cup butter and 1 tsp
2. Nutmeg in large shallow skillet on medium-low heat
3. Stir gently to mix
4. Cook until just simmering
5. Keep warm while making batter and crumb topping
6. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
7. Coat glass 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish with cooking spray
8. Cut 1 1 / 4 sticks of butter into pieces
9. Put in pan and melt in oven while making batter
10. Mix flour , salt , baking powder and 2 / 3 cup of splenda in large bowl
11. Blend in buttermilk just until moistened , set aside
12. In a small bowl mix oatmeal , 1 / 2 cup of splenda and spice
13. Set aside
14. Remove melted butter from oven
15. Scoop about 4 tablespoons of butter into oatmeal mixture and blend well
16. Set aside
17. Pour buttermilk batter into remaining hot melted butter in pan spreading it evenly
18. Now spoon the hot fruit mixture over the batter , it will puff up very dramatically , nearly filling the pan
19. Place the baking dish on a cookie sheet in case it runs over
20. Crumble the oatmeal topping over the center of the cobbler , covering the fruit
21. Place in oven and bake for 50 to 55 minutes or until top is well-browned and syrup is bubbly all around
22. Let cool 15-20 minutes before serving
23. Serve as is or with ice cream , whipped cream or plain cream dolloped on a serving

title: quick creamy vegetable soup
steps:
1. Combine water and salt in a saucepan
2. You may want to substitute chicken broth for the water
3. Add the vegetables and celery and cook 10 minutes
4. Blend in the cream of chicken soup or whatever creamy soup you choose
5. Reduce heat to simmer and heat 2 to 3 minutes longer

title: chicken fettuccine in bourbon sauce
steps:
1. Cook the fettuccine according to package instructions , but do not drain until just before serving
2. Melt the butter in a frying pan and saute the onions until transparent , then add the garlic
3. Add the flour and ground red pepper , stir and then add the half and half , followed by the chicken stock
4. Take the pan off the cook top briefly while adding the bourbon
5. Return the pan to the cooktop and add the chicken
6. Stir until the sauce has thicken and the chicken is hot
7. Place the cooked and drained fettuccine into a serving bowl , and pour the chicken and sauce over the top

title: baked salmon patties or muffins
steps:
1. Drain salmon and remove skin and bones
2. Mix all salmon pattie ingredients except for panko crumbs and add those to get a moldable texture
3. Spray a nonstick muffin pan with vegetable spray - about 7 out of 12 muffin cups
4. Add mixture to fill each cup , just short of full and top with panko crumbs
5. Spray tops with vegetable spray and bake in a 375f oven for about 20 minutes or until 160f internally
6. Meanwhile , mix the sauce ingredients until smooth and chill

title: bacon  spinach  and egg scramble
steps:
1. Fry chopped bacon in a non stick skillet
2. Beat together egg , egg whites , milk , salt , and pepper
3. When bacon is almost done , add chopped spinach and saute until just wilted
4. Add egg mixture and scramble
5. Top with cheddar cheese

title: easy shrimp pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Mix together first 5 ingredients , and place into 9" pie plate
3. Blend together last 5 ingredients in blender until smooth
4. Pour over mixture in pie plate and bake for 35-40 minutes

title: zucchini pasta with red onion  oregano and feta
steps:
1. Bring large pot of water to boil
2. Add salt
3. Stir in pasta and cook until al dente , about 9 minutes
4. Reserve 1 cup cooking liquid , then drain pasta
5. Heat 3 tablespoons oil and the butter in a large deep skillet over moderate heat until butter is melted
6. Add onion and oregano , season with salt and pepper , and cook until softened , about 5 minutes
7. Add zucchini and squash
8. Cook , stirring frequently , until wilted , about 5 minutes
9. Add broth
10. Bring to a simmer
11. Remove from heat and keep warm , covered , for sauce
12. Add pasta and 1 / 2 cup reserved cooking liquid to sauce in skillet
13. Toss to combine
14. Season with salt and pepper
15. Simmer until pasta is coated well , about 2 minutes
16. Remove from heat and toss in feta
17. Spoon into bowls , drizzle with remaining 2 tablespoons oil and serve

title: chinese pork   vegetable hot pot
steps:
1. Place carrots and turnips in the bottom and up the sides of a 4-quart or larger slow cooker
2. Top with pork and scallion whites
3. Bring broth , water , soy sauce , sherry , brown sugar , ginger , vinegar , chile-garlic sauce to taste and garlic to a simmer in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat
4. Pour over the pork and vegetables
5. Nestle star anise pod and cinnamon stick into the stew
6. Cover and cook until the pork and vegetables are tender , 3 to 3 1 / 2 hours on high or 5 1 / 2 to 6 hours on low
7. Discard the star anise pod and cinnamon stick
8. Skim or blot any visible fat from the surface of the stew
9. Add the cornstarch mixture , cover and cook on high , stirring 2 or 3 times , until slightly thickened , 10 to 15 minutes
10. Serve sprinkled with scallion greens and sesame seeds

title: chicken with sweet peppers and balsamic vinegar
steps:
1. Season the chicken with salt and pepper
2. In a large skillet , heat 2 tbsp of the oil
3. Saute the chicken over med-high heat , turning once , until golden on both sides , about 8 mins total
4. Transfer the chicken to a plate
5. Add the remaining of oil to the skillet and reduce the heat to medium
6. Cook the bell peppers and onion , stirring often , until just softened , about 4 minutes
7. Add the garlic and cook , stirring , for 1 minute
8. Stir in about half the basil and all the vinegar
9. Return the chicken and any accumulated juices to the skillet
10. Reduce the heat to med-low
11. Simmer until the chicken is cooked through , about 3 minutes
12. Stir in the remaining basil and season with salt and pepper

title: choux a la creme cabbage in cream
steps:
1. Remove core from cabbage , cut into quarters and slice , very finely , set aside
2. Place cabbage into salted boiling water and allow to cook for 5 minutes
3. Drain and set aside
4. Finely slice bacon
5. Finely dice onion
6. Set aside
7. Sift flour , measure butter , milk and cream
8. Set aside
9. Place a little clarified butter into a saucepan and add bacon , onion and dried thyme
10. Allow to cook for 1 minute
11. Add the butter and stir in the flour to form a roux -allow to cook 1 minute
12. Whisk in the milk , stirring to form a smooth sauce
13. Bring to a boil and season with salt , pepper and freshly grated nutmeg
14. Add the cabbage to the roux and allow to cook for 10 minutes
15. Just before serving , stir in the cream

title: pasta with roasted vegetables   balsamic vinegar
steps:
1. Combine scallions , bell pepper , zucchini , tomatoes , garlic , balsamic vinegar , and olive oil in shallow baking dish
2. Bake at 400 degrees for about 30 minutes , or until vegetables are tender
3. Cook pasta in boiling water according to package directions
4. Drain hot cooked pasta and toss with vegetables and serve

title: spaghetti with zesty bolognese
steps:
1. Cook onions in dressing in large skillet on medium heat
2. Increase heat to medium-high
3. Add meat
4. Cook , stirring frequently , until browned
5. Stir in tomato sauce and tomatoes
6. Bring to boil
7. Reduce heat to medium-low
8. Simmer 15 minutes
9. Remove from heat
10. Stir in cream cheese until well-blended
11. Meanwhile , cook pasta as directed on package
12. Spoon sauce over pasta
13. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese

title: best ever eat em up pancakes
steps:
1. Sift flour with dry ingredients into mixing bowl
2. Beat egg together with milk and sour cream
3. Stir into flour mixture
4. Add melted butter and whisk until smooth
5. Cook on hot griddle as usual

title: black bean nachos with chipotle tabasco
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine beans , cumin and tabasco brand chipotle pepper sauce and mix well
2. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
3. Spread tortilla chips in a single layer over large baking sheet with edges slightly overlapping
4. Spoon approximately one teaspoonful of black beans onto each corn chip and top with onion , tomato , and cheese
5. Bake in oven 6 to 8 minutes or until cheese melts and nachos are heated through
6. Sprinkle with the fresh cilantro
7. Serve hot

title: trout amandine  steamed asparagus and new potatoes
steps:
1. Turn oven on a low setting and rest an oven-proof platter on the oven rack
2. Veggies:
3. Get a deep pot of salted water to the boiling point and add the potatoes
4. Cook for about 12 minutes , or until fork tender
5. Trim the tough ends off of the asparagus and put in a colander and rest the colander on top of the potato pot and cover
6. Do this the last 5 or 6 minutes that the potatoes are cooking , and the asparagus will steam at the same time
7. The potatoes will be just about done when the last of your trout is going into the skillet
8. When the potatoes are tender , take a minute to drain them and return them to the warm pot
9. Leave asparagus covered and set aside
10. Dress potatoes with chives , a drizzle of olive oil and a little salt
11. Leave in warm pot until trout is on the table , then transfer to a serving bowl
12. Trout:
13. Heat a large skillet over medium heat
14. Combine egg and milk in a pie tin and beat with a fork
15. Place a cup of flour in a second pie tin and season well with salt and sparingly with pepper
16. Coat the trout fillets in egg and milk mixture , then in seasoned flour
17. Put fillets on a plate until all of them are dredged and ready to be cooked
18. To the skillet add 1 / 2 t olive oil and 1 1 / 2 t butter
19. When butter foams , add trout and gently saute 4 fillets for 2 to 3 minutes on each side , until golden
20. Transfer trout to the warm platter in the oven
21. Return the pan to the stove and add remaining oil and 1 1 / 2 t butter and saute rest of the trout
22. When all of the trout is cooked and added to the serving platter , add last t of butter to the pan
23. When the butter melts , add almonds and brown them until lightly golden , 1 to 2 minutes
24. Remove trout from oven and pour almonds over the platter
25. Garnsih with chopped parsley , lemon wedges and steamed asparagus spears
26. Serve the potatoes alongside

title: eggplant  aubergine  gyro
steps:
1. Preheat broiler to high
2. Combine all ingredients for the sauce in a small bowl
3. Set aside
4. Toss tomatoes , cucumbers , scallions , olives , vinegar , parsley , oregano , oil , salt , and pepper together in a large bowl
5. Chill until ready to use
6. Saute eggplant in oil over medium-high heat 3 minutes
7. Add to vegetable mixture
8. Brush pitas with oil , season with salt , and broil until lightly toasted on both sides
9. Assemble by placing each pita on top of a sheet of foil or parchment paper
10. Drizzle 1 / 4 cup of sauce down the center of the pita and place about 1 cup of vegetables on top of the sauce
11. Wrap foil or paper around pita and serve

title: smoked gouda mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Place potatoes in a saucepan
2. Cover with water
3. Bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minsutes
5. Drain
6. Return potatoes to pan
7. Add milk , salt and pepper
8. Mash with potato masher
9. Stir in the cheese
10. Serve and enjoy

title: kato s  easy banana cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cream the butter , add sugar and eggs
3. Mix well , add the bananas , nuts and vanilla
4. Prepare the sour milk by stirring the lemon juice into the milk
5. Sift the dry ingredients and add them to the banana mixture
6. Mix in the sour milk gently
7. Pour into a prepared 9 x 12" pan
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 min - 1 hour
9. We find this cake sweet , so i usually just sprinkle icing sugar on top and serve it warm with vanilla bean ice cream
10. It's also nice with vanilla or chocolate buttercream frosting
11. If making cupcakes , bake for 15 - 20 minutes , or until toothpick comes out clean

title: blue shark
steps:
1. Add ingredients to a cocktail shaker filled with ice
2. Shake vigorously
3. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass or over ice in an old-fashioned glass

title: gruyere and chicken roulade
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Slice 3 / 4 of the way horizontally through chicken breasts , cutting through the rounded edge
3. Open out , cover with plastic wrap and beat with a rolling pin to flatten
4. Cover each filet with a slice of ham , then a slice of gruyere
5. Set aside one tablespoon chives
6. Sprinkle rest over cheese
7. Roll up chicken
8. Secure with a wooden toothpick or string
9. In an ovenproof pan , heat oil
10. Cook chicken rolls gently , turning occasionally , until sealed
11. Pour off excess oil
12. Add garlic , wine and seasoning to pan , cover and cook in the oven for 25-30 minutes , until tender
13. Place roulades on a dish , remove toothpick or string and keep warm
14. Put pan and remaining contents on high heat and boil rapidly to reduce slightly
15. Add devon cream and remaining chives and heat through
16. Cut each chicken roulade into half inch slices and arrange them overlapping on four warmed dinner plates
17. Pour over the sauce and serve immediately , with a selection of baby vegetables

title: easy chicken parmesan salad
steps:
1. Bake chicken patties according to package directions
2. Cut chicken into 1 / 2 inch slices
3. Combine lettuce , croutons , tomatoes , cheese , dressing and chicken
4. Toss to coat

title: turmeric rice by madhur jaffrey
steps:
1. Put the rice in a bowl and wash in several changes of water
2. Drain and leave in a strainer set over a bowl
3. Put the oil in a heavy based saucepan and set over a medium high heat
4. When the oil is hot and beginning to bubble , put in the cloves , bay leaf , cardamom pods and cinnamon
5. Stir once or twice and put in the garlic
6. As soon as the garlic turns medium brown put in the rice , turmeric and salt
7. Stir gently for a minute
8. Now add the water and bring to the boil
9. Cover tightly , turn the heat down to very , very low and cook for 20 minutes
10. Stir the rice with a fork to separate the grains and serve garnished with chives or spring onions

title: smoked salmon omelet with red onions and capers
steps:
1. Whisk eggs , salt and pepper in a large bowl to blend
2. Melt 2 teaspoons butter in a 8-inch diameter nonstick skillet over medium heat
3. Ladle 3 / 4 cup of the egg mixture into the skillet
4. Cook until eggs are softly set , stirring often and lifting edge of eggs to allow uncooked portion to run under , covering skillet if necessary to help set the top
5. Place 1 / 4 of the salmon on half of the omelet
6. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon onion and 1 teaspoon capers
7. Top with 2 tablespoons cream cheese
8. Fold omelet in half and slid out onto plate
9. Repeat with ingredients to make 3 more omelets

title: sticky soy chicken
steps:
1. First , soak the mushrooms for 10 minutes in boiling hot water
2. Slice
3. In a hot wok , add oil and fry the onions till golden brown
4. Add chicken pieces , fry till golden brown as well over high heat , constantly stir-frying to
5. Prevent overcooking the chicken
6. Once the chicken is browned , add the chicken stock , one cup of water
7. Cover
8. Bring to a boil
9. Lower heat when it starts bubbling
10. Let simmer for 30 minutes
11. Garnish with coriander
12. Serve !

title: creamy succotash
steps:
1. Cook lima beans according to package directions
2. Drain and set aside
3. In large nonstick skillet , add butter and bacon
4. Cook over medium-high heat until bacon starts to brown , about 3 minutes
5. Stir in onion and green pepper and cook 10 more minutes , stirring occasionally
6. Add corn , broth , salt , pepper and cooked lima beans
7. Simmer , uncovered , 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. Stir in cream , tomatoes and parsley and heat through

title: keys style citrus chicken
steps:
1. In large skillet , cook chicken and garlic in hot butter over medium heat for 8-10 minutes or until chicken is tender and no longer pink , turning chicken once and stirring garlic occasionally
2. In a small bowl , combine lime peel , lime juice , ginger , and red pepper
3. Set aside
4. Peel orange
5. Reserving juice , cut orange in half lengthwise
6. Then cut crosswise into slices
7. Add any reserved orange juice and the lime juice mixture to the skillet
8. Place orange slices on top of the chicken
9. Cook , covered , 1-2 minutes or until healted through

title: mayonnaise biscuits  cookies
steps:
1. Sieve flour and baking powder , set aside
2. Mix the mayonnaise , sugar , salt and vanilla paste
3. Add the flour to the mayonnaise and mix well
4. Depending on the brand of mayonnaise you may need to add an extra tablespoon of flour if it is still sticky
5. Form into small balls and roll in extra sugar
6. Place onto baking tray and bake for 10-12 minutes

title: sherry pecan balls
steps:
1. In a bowl stir together flour and 1 / 2 cup of the pecans to combine thoroughly
2. Set aside
3. Spread remaining 1 cup pecans in a shallow pan
4. Set aside
5. In mixer bowl combine butter and sugar
6. Beat until fluffy
7. Add egg yolks , one at a time , beating well after each addition
8. Blend in orange rind and vanilla
9. To butter mixture add flour mixture alternately with sherry , mixing to blend after each addition
10. Gather dough into a ball and enclose in plastic wrap
11. Refrigerate until dough is firm enough to shape
12. Preheat oven to 350f shape dough into 1-inch balls
13. Roll balls in pecans to coat evenly
14. Place about 1 inch apart on ungreased baking sheets
15. Bake until cookies are golden brown and feel firm when touched lightly
16. Transfer to wire racks to cool

title: almond joy butter
steps:
1. Place almonds on a rimmed baking sheet and bake in a 350 degree oven for 12-15 minutes
2. Remove and set aside to cool for 5-10 minutes
3. In the meantime place coconut in a food processor and process until it turns into butter , scraping down sides as needed
4. Scoop into a dish and set aside
5. Place cooled almonds in the food processor and process until it turns into butter , scraping down the sides as needed
6. Then add in the coconut
7. Process to combine , add sea salt and vanilla and process once more
8. The mixture will be warm at this point so you can add in the chocolate to let it melt and fully combine , or you can wait until the spread cools to keep a chunkier chocolate texture
9. Stir chocolate to combine and then place in glass jar or tupperwear for storing
10. Store at room temperature so it does not solidify
11. However , if storing for more than 2 weeks , store in the refrigerator and bring to room temperature before use

title: italian pot roast
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large dutch oven over medium heat and brown roast on all sides
2. Combine water and remaining ingredients , mixing well
3. Pour over roast
4. Bring to a boil
5. Cover and reduce heat
6. Simmer for 3 hours or until tender
7. Let cool slightly
8. Cover and chill
9. Remove roast from broth
10. Cut into very thin slices
11. Return meat to broth
12. Cook over medium heat until thoroughly heated
13. Remove bay leaves and serve

title: apple corned beef brisket for the slow cooker
steps:
1. Place red potatoes , onion , and apple in a large slow cooker
2. Top with corned beef brisket
3. Place cabbage over top
4. In a small bowl , whisk together cider , brown sugar , mustard , cloves and pepper
5. Pour into slow cooker
6. Cook on low for 6 - 8 hours , or high for about 3 - 4 hours

title: cowboy burgers
steps:
1. Preheat grill to medium heat
2. Meanwhile , heat oil in large nonstick skillet on medium-high heat
3. Add onions
4. Cook 5 minutes , stirring frequently
5. Cover with lid
6. Simmer 20 minute or until onions are golden brown , stirring frequently
7. Meanwhile , grill patties 5 minute on each side or until medium doneness
8. Stir steak sauce into onion mixture
9. Place 1 tomato slice and burger on bottom half of each bun
10. Cover with 1 slice cheese , 3 tablespoons of the onion mixture and top of bun

title: easy slow cooker applesauce
steps:
1. Peel , core , and slice apples into bite sized pieces
2. Pour 1 / 8 c of water and apples into the slow cooker
3. Add salt , maple syrup , cloves , coriander , ginger , and lemon juice and stir so all apple slices are coated
4. Place cinnamon sticks so that they are sticking into the container on three sides
5. Turn the slow cooker on low and let cook for 6-7 hours or until the apples are very soft to pierce and most of the liquid is evaporated
6. Turn off the slow cooker and take out the whole cinnamon sticks
7. For a chunky texture , mash with a potato masher , for a smooth texture , put into a food processor / blender or use an immersion blender until you reach the desired texture

title: date panettone bread and butter pudding
steps:
1. First take out a baking dish and heavily butter it
2. Then , arrange half of your panettone triangles in the dish overlapping them a bit
3. Scatter 1 / 2 of your nuts over the panettone and then evenly scatter your chopped dates
4. Then , place another layer of the panettone on top , overlapping them a bit
5. Heat your butter , milk , cream , and vanilla in a small saucepan just until simmering , remove from heat
6. Put the egg , maple syrup and honey in a large bowl and add freshly grated nutmeg
7. Next , whisk in the hot milk , making sure to whisk vigorously so as to keep the egg from cooking
8. At this point you will want to preheat your oven to 400 degrees f
9. Pour your milk-egg mixture over the panettone layers , and lightly press down on the bread so that it is fully submerged in the liquid
10. Leave the panettone pudding aside for about 15-20 minutes to allow everything to soak up nicely
11. Take the rest of your pecans and sprinkle just a bit of water over them
12. Toss them in the sugar / cinnamon mixture , and toss them over the pudding
13. Sprinkle the leftover cinnamon sugar mixture evenly over the dish
14. Grate a small amount of nutmeg over as well
15. Bake in your preheated oven for 40-45 minutes until it has risen and has a beautiful golden color

title: beef and prunes a la tajine tagine
steps:
1. Heat oil in tagine
2. Add butter
3. When melted , add meat
4. Add garlic , ginger , salt , pepper , saffron , and ras el hanout spice
5. Top with chopped onions and remaining vegetables
6. Cover and cook for 2 hours
7. Check after 1 hour and add 1 / 2 cup water if needed
8. Use hot water to keep from cracking tajine
9. When meat and vegetables are tender , add prunes
10. Cook for another 10 minutes
11. Sprinkle with sesame seeds if desired
12. Serve plain , with couscous , or rice

title: chocolate espresso tiramisu
steps:
1. Biscuit-allow egg to stand at room temperature for 30 minutes
2. Meanwhile , grease a 9 x 9 inch baking dish , preheat oven to 350 degrees
3. Line the bottom of baking pan with parchment paper , grease and flour paper
4. Set aside
5. In a small bowl , stir together the flour , cocoa , baking powder , and salt
6. In a medium bowl , beat egg with an electric mixer on high speed about 3 minutes or until thick and lemon colored
7. Gradually add sugar , beating on medium speed for 4 minutes or until light and fluffy
8. Add the flour mixture
9. Beat on low to medium speed just until combined
10. In a small saucepan , combine milk and butter
11. Heat and stir until butter melts
12. Add to batter along with vanilla , beating until combined
13. Pour batter into prepared pan
14. Bake about 15 minutes or until a wooden toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
15. Cool biscuit in pan on a wire rack for 10 minutes
16. Loosen sides from pan and turn out onto a kitchen towel sprinkled with cocoa powder
17. Carefully remove paper
18. Discard
19. Cool completely , about 25 minutes
20. Pudding:
21. Chill large metal bowl and whipping beater in freezer
22. Optional-place bittersweet chocolate in a small microwave safe bowl , microwave , uncovered , on 50 percent power about 1 minute or until chocolate is melted and smooth , stirring every 15 seconds-set aside to cool about 15 minutes
23. Careful as you don't want it to harden up again
24. Beat inmascarpone , vanilla , and optional cooled chocolate with an electric mixer on medium speed until soft peaks form , about 2 to 3 minutes
25. Set up chilled metal bowl and whipping beater , whip whipping cream and powdered sugar until soft peaks form , then gently fold the whipping cream mixture into the mascarpone mixture
26. Put kahlua and espresso into a shallow dish
27. Cut cooled biscuit into 16 pieces
28. Dip 8 pieces quickly into the coffee mixture one at a time and arrange side by side , in a serving dish-about 1 quart size or you could use pudding cups
29. Cover biscuit with half the mascarpone mixture
30. Top with remaining biscuit , and remaining mascarpone mixture
31. Dust top with cocoa , chocolate shavings , or chocolate covered coffee beans ,
32. Refrigerate 24 hours , or freeze

title: simple goulash
steps:
1. Boil noodles according to box directions in a large pot
2. In a medium sized pan cook the ground chuck or beef on high until brown
3. Put on medium heat , in a medium size pot add tomato soup , water and stir until soup is mixed well
4. Then add all seasonings and ketchup
5. Stir sauce frequently
6. When ground chuck or beef is cooked and brown , add to sauce
7. Continue stirring frequently
8. Let the sauce boil on medium-low until the noodles are cooked
9. Strain the noodles and then pour them back into the pot you cooked them inches slowly pour the sauce over the noodles and stir
10. Let cool for 5 minutes then serve
11. If desired use parmesan cheese to top goulash

title: peas and pasta soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , heat oil at medium heat
2. Add onion , garlic and carrot
3. Cook , stirring often , for about 5 minutes or until onion has softened
4. Add stock and pasta
5. Bring to boil
6. Reduce heat to low and let simmer for 8 minutes
7. Add small peas and bring to boil again
8. Reduce the heat to low and let simmer 3 minutes
9. When ready to serve , sprinkle each serving with parmigiano

title: cheddar broccoli corn bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Melt 2 t
3. Butter in a large saucepan on low
4. Stir in flour and salt
5. Add milk gradually , stirring until smooth
6. Increase heat to medium and cook until bubbly and thickened , stirring constantly
7. Add cheese , stirring until melted
8. Stir in 1 / 4 cup corn flakes and corn and remove from heat
9. Arrange the broccoli in a 12 x 7 x 2 glass baking dish
10. Pour the cheese sauce over broccoli
11. Melt remaining butter in small saucepan
12. Stir in remaining corn flakes
13. Sprinkle over the casserole
14. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes

title: biscuits or scones 1972   british
steps:
1. Sift the salt , flour , soda , and cream of tartar all together in a bowl
2. Add cold butter , and rub with the palms of your hands to mash butter into flakes or long flat slivers well
3. There should be still flat lumps or flakes that are noticeable
4. Add the cold milk and just toss all with your hands until a soft dough starts to form
5. Just adding the amount of milk that takes you to this stage , i usually use just 3 / 4 cup
6. This depends on the flour and weather
7. Place on floured counter and form into a round disk about 3 / 4 inch thick , gently
8. Cut into 8 wedges
9. Place on greased cookie sheet
10. Brush with some cold milk
11. Bake at 425 for 12 to 15 minutes , until golden brown
12. If you would like a sweeter scone add in 2 tablespoons granulated sugar , and 1 / 2 cup plumped raisins
13. Or a cheddar cheese biscuit before adding the milk add in 1 / 2 cup grated cheddar

title: elderberry muffins
steps:
1. Cream sugar and oleo , add additional ingredients and mix until blended
2. Bake at 425 degrees for 20 minutes in a muffin pan

title: creole spinach salad
steps:
1. To prepare , macerate the minced garlic in the extra virgin olive oil for at least 15 minutes , preferably while preparing the remaining ingredients
2. Set aside
3. In a skillet , preferably non-stick , render the fat from the bacon over medium heat
4. This will take about 5-10 minutes
5. When the bits of bacon are cooked , remove them and set aside , leaving the hot fat in the pan
6. Add the celery , onion , and green pepper and saute until the onions become translucent
7. Retaining as much of the extra virgin olive oil as possible , add the minced garlic and saute until the garlic turns light brown on the edges
8. Add the andouille sausage and saute until browned
9. Add the cilantro , balsamic vinegar , and molasses and stir
10. Wile the liquids reduce , prepare a salad bowl or serving platter with a bed of the spinach greens
11. Layer the lump crab meat , slivered almonds , and feta cheese over the spinach
12. Season the salad with salt and pepper to taste
13. Add the remaining extra virgin olive oil to the hot skilled and spoon it over the salad to serve

title: jus de bissap  hibiscus tea
steps:
1. Briefly rinse the dried flowers in cool water
2. In a saucepan heat two quarts of cold water
3. As soon as the water begins to boil , add the dried hibiscus leaves
4. Immediately remove from heat and let the flowers steep for ten minutes
5. Pour the water from the pot into a pitcher using a strainer to separate the flowers from the water
6. Stir in the sugar
7. Add mint and orange water
8. Add ice and chill completely
9. May be served over ice

title: classic smoked salmon appetizer
steps:
1. Beat together until smooth cream cheese , milk , lemon juice , dill weed , and bottled hot pepper sauce
2. Arranged smoked salmon , small bowl of herbed cream cheese and bread on medium-sized serving platter
3. Garnish with red onion , capers , lemon slices and dill

title: chili rice with chicken
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add the chicken
3. Cook , stirring occasionally , for 2 to 3 minutes , or until it is no longer pink on the outside
4. Stir in the bell peppers , onion , garlic , jalapeno pepper , chili powder , dried oregano , and cumin
5. Cook , stirring occasionally , for about 5 minutes , or until the vegetables are tender and the chicken is cooked through
6. Reduce the heat to medium
7. Stir in the rice , tomatoes with juice , fresh oregano , and pepper
8. Heat through , stirring occasionally , for about 5 minutes
9. Taste and adjust the seasoning
10. This dish will keep for up to 2 days in the refrigerator and reheats well
11. Optional:
12. When stirring in the rice , add one 15-ounce can beans , drained and rinsed , such as black beans , kidney beans , or garbanzo beans

title: gluten and wheat free banana honey muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c or 160c for fan forced
2. Lightly grease muffin pan
3. Sift flours , bicarb , baking soda , xantham gum and salt together , set aside
4. In a separate large mixing bowl , mash banana , add egg , canola oil , honey , butter and sugars , mix well
5. Add dry ingredients to wet ingredients , mix until well combined
