6. Spoon into prepared muffin pan , bake for 20mins
7. Cool on cooling rack
8. Serve warm or cool , with or without butter

title: tangy green bean and olive salad
steps:
1. Place green beans and onion slices in a deep dish
2. Pour olives and olive brine over all
3. Cover , refrigerate , an marinate at least 3 hours , overnight is better , tossing occasionally
4. Serve on lettuce leaves

title: southern iced tea
steps:
1. Place tea bags in a 2 quart glass pitcher
2. Pour one quart boiling water over tea bags
3. Let this steep for five minutes
4. Remove tea bags from water , and press tea bags gently against the side of the container with the back of a wooden spoon
5. Remove tea bags from container and discard
6. Stir in one cup sugar
7. Add the remaining one quart of water
8. Stir , cool to room temperature
9. Serve over ice
10. If desired , garnish with lemon wedge
11. If you want to take the haziness out of the tea , you may stir in 1 / 4 cup boiling water per quart of iced tea just before serving

title: greek meat rolls in tomato wine sauce
steps:
1. Mix all meat roll ingredients , except flour , together until blended
2. Shape into finger-like rolls
3. Coat lightly with flour and brown in large frying pan with oil
4. Remove and drain on paper towls
5. In pan used to brown meat , make sauce by wisking all ingredients until smooth
6. Add meat rolls and simmer one hour on top of stove
7. Serve over cooked orzo or rice
8. Can bake in oven for 1 hour at 400 or in crockpot on low for 4-6 hours

title: cinnamon pears in apple juice canning
steps:
1. Peel pears , and cut into halves and core
2. Treat to prevent darkening
3. Drain
4. Rinse and drain again
5. Cook pears in water one layer at a time until hot throughout
6. Heat the apple juice just to a boil
7. Pack hot pears into hot jars , leaving 1 / 2" headspace
8. Place 1 cinnamon stick in each jar
9. Ladle hot apple juice over pears , leaving 1 / 2" headspace
10. Remove air bubbles
11. Adjust two piece caps
12. Process pints 20 minutes in a boiling water canner
13. Enjoy !

title: sausage and chicken jambalaya stirfry
steps:
1. Cook rice according to package directions
2. Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat until hot
3. Stirfry chicken 2 minutes , add sausage
4. Stirfry chicken and sausage until brown
5. Remove from pan to separate bowl
6. Add onion and bell peppers to skillet , reduce heat to low
7. Cover and cook 2 to 3 minutes , stirring once or twice
8. Add garlic , cook and stir , uncovered , 1 minute
9. Add tomatoes , sausage , chicken , broth , parsley , thyme , salt , black pepper and red pepper , to pan
10. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat to medium-low
11. Simmer , uncovered , 5 minutes , or until most liquid has been absorbed
12. Stir in rice and heat through
13. Probably took a bit longer , but turned out well :)

title: floating hands halloween punch
steps:
1. Floating hands:water or juice , pair of clear plastic gloves , rubber bands or twist ties pour water or juice into gloves , adding enough liquid to fill loosely but not so full that fingers will not move
2. Fasten closed with rubber bands or twist ties
3. Place on a paper towel lined baking sheet
4. Freeze for 3 hours to 6 hours or until firm
5. Make more than one pair if you would like to replace the"hands" when they melt
6. Punch: combine juicy juice punch and lemonade concentrate in a large bowl
7. Slowly stir in soda
8. Carefully cut gloves from hands with scissors and float hands in the punch
9. When the hands have melted , replace with a new pair !

title: sarah s molasses wagonwheels
steps:
1. Mix together margarine and sugar , then stir in molasses and water
2. Sift together the remaining ingredients and stir into above mixture
3. Chill dough for several hours or overnight
4. Roll 1 / 4 inch thick , cut in 3 inch circles and sprinkle with sugar
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 10-12 min and until when touched lightly with your finger , almost no imprint remains
6. Leave on baking sheet for a few minutes before removing to prevent breaking
7. Leave unrolled dough in the fridge
8. It will quickly get too soft to handle if left out while you roll the other

title: stir fried green beans with pine nuts
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet or wok over medium-high heat
2. Add green beans , garlic , onions , and pine nuts
3. Cook , stirring constantly with a tossing motion , 5 to 7 minutes , until onions start to brown
4. Stir in soy sauce , pepper and water
5. Reduce heat to medium-low , cover , and cook 5 minutes , stirring once during cooking time

title: swedish cabbage and orange salad
steps:
1. In a covered container , combine cabbage , oranges & raisins , then add oil & lemon juice & toss well
2. Chill in the refregerator for up to 2 hours
3. Serve with meat & fish dishes

title: rose water or orange blossom pancakes
steps:
1. Mix the flour , baking powder , cardamon , sugar , and salt in medium bowl
2. Beat the egg , honey , rose water and oil together in small bowl
3. Then combine the egg mixture with the dry ingredients
4. Stir until well blended
5. Pour a small amount of almond oil onto griddle then heat
6. Ladle a small amount of the batter onto the griddle
7. Smooth into a circle then fry until bubbles appear and edges are dry
8. Flip over & continue to cook until the other side has turned golden

title: perch or snapper fillet with tomatoes and onion
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
2. Coat a baking dish with canola oil thoroughly and add the fillets skin side down
3. Pour the lemon juice over the fish and bake approximately 8 minutes or less , the fish will flake when touched with a fork when done
4. While the fillets bake , heat a medium saute pan over medium heat and add the olive oil to it
5. Heat the oil and add the garlic and onions
6. Once the onions are translucent , add the tomatoes and parsley
7. Continue to saute for approximately 5 minutes over medium heat
8. Remove the fillets from the oven and serve with the tomatoes and onions on top

title: brie and shallot parisian burgers
steps:
1. In a medium skillet over low heat , combine the shallots with the oil and cook until they are browned but not scorched , about 20 minutes , stirring often
2. Let cool to room temperature
3. Prepare the grill for direct cooking over high heat
4. In a large bowl gently mix the patty ingredients and shape into 4 patties of equal size and thickness
5. Make a hole in the center of each patty for the cheese
6. Trim away the rind of the brie and bury the cheese , about 1 / 4 ounce for each patty , into the hole of each patty
7. Close the opening to seal the cheese inside
8. Its important that there is one-third of an inch of meat on the top and bottom of the cheese so it doesnt seep out
9. Brush the cooking grates clean
10. Grill the patties over direct high heat , with the lid closed as much as possible , until cooked to medium , 8 to 10 minutes , turning once when the patties release easily from the grate without sticking
11. During the last minute of cooking time , toast the buns , cut sides down , over direct heat
12. Assemble the burgers with shallots , mustard , and arugula
13. Serve warm

title: grandma s waffles
steps:
1. Combine flour , baking powder , salt
2. In a separate bowl beat egg yolks and then add milk and butter
3. Combine dry mixture with egg+milk+butter mixture
4. Beat until smooth
5. Beat egg whites until stiff , but not dry
6. Slowly add sugar , beating constantly
7. Mix 1 / 3 of beaten whites with batter then fold remaining whites in carefully
8. Pour around 3 / 4 cup of batter in waffle iron

title: bulgur stuffing with dried cranberries   hazelnuts
steps:
1. Over medium heat , in a dutch oven , heat oil
2. Add onions and celery and cook , stirring often , for approximately 5 to 8 minutes or until softened
3. To softened mixture , add garlic , cinnamon , and allspice and cook for 1 minute , stirring often
4. Add bulgur , stir for a few minutes to combine , than add broth , bay leaf , and salt
5. Bring to a simmer
6. Reduce heat to low , cover dutch oven and simmer until all liquid is gone and bulgur is tender , approximately 15 to 20 minutes
7. In a small microwave-safe bowl , combine dried cranberries and orange juice
8. Cover with plastic wrap and add a few slits in the plastic wrap for vents
9. Microwave on high for approximately 2 minutes
10. This step can also be done on the stove top
11. In a small saucepan , bring dried cranberries and orange juice to a simmer
12. Remove from microwave or heat and set aside to let cranberries plump
13. In large mixing bowl , add bulgur and discard the bay leaf
14. Add cranberries , toasted hazelnuts , parsley , and pepper to bulgur
15. Fluff mixture with a fork and serve
16. Cover stuffing and microwave on high for 10 to 15 minutes or until heated through
17. The stuffing can also be baked at 350f degrees for 25 to 30 minutes or also until heated through
18. If using to stuff a turkey , prepare as stated above
19. Let cool completely and place about 5 cups of stuffing loosely into the turkey cavities
20. Heat remainder separately

title: pizza with honey  caramelized onions  cheese and mushrooms
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Heat olive oil over medium heat , add onions and saute until tender , about 10 minutes
3. Add honey and vinegar , reduce heat and saute until onions are golden brown , about another 8 minutes
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Place pizza crust on pizza stone or baking sheet , sprinkle with cheese and thyme
6. Top this with onion mixture , then mushrooms
7. Cook for about 15 minutes or until cheese is melted

title: avocado and lime dessert mousse
steps: 1. Put everything in the food processor and blend until smooth , enjoy straight away in small glass bowls

title: english sweet and sour ribs
steps:
1. Trim excess fat from short ribs
2. Combine flour , seasoned salt and pepper
3. Dredge shrot ribs
4. Brown ribs in oil on all sides in dutch oven
5. Remove meat from pan
6. Add onions and cook until golden brown
7. Place ribs on top of onions
8. Combine water , brown sugar , catsup , vinegar , garlic and bay leaves
9. Pour over ribs
10. Cover and bake in moderate oven 2 1 / 2 hours
11. Remove bay leaves before serving

title: cantaloupe milkshakes
steps:
1. Fill one cup measure with cantaloupe
2. Pour milk over cantaloupe until cup is filled to the top
3. Pour milk and cantaloupe into blender
4. Add ice , sugar and cardamom
5. Blend until smooth and creamy
6. Serve immediately

title: transylvania goulash
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick pan at a medium heat
2. Add garlic and cook for several minutes
3. Add the chicken and pork and cook for 5 minutes
4. Add the paprika , pepper , salt and onion powder and stir
5. Add the onion , green onion and cook for 2 minutes
6. Add the mushroom soup and stir until a smooth sauce is formed
7. Add the sauerkaut , stir until mixed
8. Add the chicken broth and stir until integrated
9. Cover and turn down the heat to minimum and simmer for 2 hours
10. If the sauce is too runny when you want to serve , mix several tablespoons of cornstarch with enough water to form a thin paste
11. Bring the sauce to a boil , reduce heat and add the paste , by teaspoonfuls , stirring vigorously until the desired thickness
12. Serve hot over gnocchi or egg noodles

title: baked shells and meatball casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Boil pasta according to directions- making sure to not overcook !
3. If meatballs are frozen , thaw--i like to brown mine either on the stove or in the oven
4. Combine the ricotta , sour cream and italian seasoning- i add an extra dash of garlic and freshly ground pepper
5. Spray a 9x13 deep baker with pam
6. Spread a thin layer of sauce on the bottom of baking pan
7. Top this with 1 / 2 of the pasta shells drained
8. Top with the ricotta mixture
9. Top with all the meatballs
10. Then layer with remaining 1 / 2 of shell pasta
11. Top with all the sauce
12. Top with the mozzarella and parmesan cheese
13. Bake at 350f for 30 minutes until heated through and cheese is bubbly !

title: baked haddock with spinach
steps:
1. Cook frozen spinach in a small amount of boiling water with 1 teaspoon salt , for about 5 minutes
2. Drain well , squeezing out excess water
3. In a medium skillet , melt butter or margarine over medium low heat
4. Add onions and saut for about 5 minutes , or until onions are tender
5. Add spinach and nutmeg
6. Cook for 3 minutes , stirring frequently
7. In a shallow , lightly buttered 2-quart casserole , arrange fish fillets in a single layer
8. Place a spoonfuls of spinach between haddock fillets
9. Place tomatoes around haddock fillets
10. Sprinkle with herbs and remaining 1 teaspoon salt
11. Bake , uncovered , at 375 for 20 to 25 minutes
12. Fish should flake easily with a fork when done
13. In a small saucepan , melt 1 tablespoon butter or margarine
14. Saute 1 tablespoon finely chopped onion until tender
15. Add 3 / 4 cup reserved tomato juice and bring to a boil
16. Stir cornstarch into remaining 1 / 4 cup tomato juice then stir into boiling mixture
17. Continue cooking and stirring until mixture returns to a boil
18. Pour sauce over haddock fillets
19. Serve and enjoy !

title: tuna spaghetti for one or two
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti until tender but firm
2. Drain
3. Mix the next six ingredients into the pasta
4. Mix well until pasta is coated
5. Put the pasta into a small casserole dish
6. Top with tuna , then cheese
7. Sprinkle with peas
8. I choose to bake this at 350 for 15 minutes until the cheese is melted & casserole is heated through
9. But i'm sure you could omit the baking step if desired
10. I usually eat half of this for a lunch with some salad & i'm full !

title: lemon daisy
steps:
1. Pour lemon juice and grenadine over ice in an old-fashioned glass
2. Stir well
3. Add equal parts soda and sparkling water
4. Stir gently
5. Add a lemon twist

title: simple orange sangria
steps:
1. Cut 1 orange into thin slices , then into quarters , and reserve for garnish
2. With vegetable peeler or zester , thinly remove outer peel from second orange
3. In large bowl , using a spoon , bruise the peel with the sugar to release the oils
4. Stir in orange juice , wine and liqueur
5. Cover and chill
6. Remove orange peel after 15 minutes
7. Serve the sangria , garnished with the orange slices , over ice

title: vegetarian tamales
steps:
1. In a food processor blend corn and cheese until corn is in nearly a meal consistency
2. Add butter , masa flour , salt , sugar , pepper and baking powder and process until the mixture is loosely mixed
3. Add broth and mix until just smooth
4. Place about 2 tbsp of mixture into soaked corn husk or parchment paper
5. Fill with some cheese , slices of roasted chili pepper and tomatoes
6. Close parchment paper or corn husk around filling , trying to cover filling with masa flour mixture
7. If you have trouble closing or have too much filling try using less in your subsequent tamales
8. Roll wrapper closed , roll and fold over ends and set aside
9. Once they're done they can be refrigerated or frozen , or placed immediately in steaming tray above boiling water for about 30 minutes , or until masa flour mixture is set

title: snowball fight
steps:
1. Fill a tall glass with crushed ice
2. Add the vanilla vodka , vanilla , sugar or splenda , and fill with half and half or milk
3. Add more sugar to taste , then garnish with cinnamon

title: tartiflette
steps:
1. Cook the potatoes in boiling water until a little undercooked
2. Reserve
3. Melt the butter in a saut pan and gently cook sliced onion and lardons , without letting them brown
4. Slice the potatoes thickly , add them and continue to cook gently for 10 minutes
5. Add the white wine and allow to reduce
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Preheat the oven to moderately hot , butter a gratin dish , and put the potato mixture in it
8. Pour over the cream
9. Place the cheese on top and put in the oven for 15-20 minutes , until the cheese has melted into the potatoes
10. Serve with a lightly dressed green salad

title: the market s spring fling cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease and flour a 10 inch cake pan
3. Cake: in a large mixing bowl , combine shredded zucchini , eggs , sugar , oil , sour cream , and vanilla
4. Combine the dry ingredients in another bowl
5. Then add to zucchini mixture
6. Batter will be rather wet and easy to pour
7. Pour batter into prepared cake pan and bake for 50-70 minutes
8. Cool on rack 10 minutes , then remove cake from pan
9. Frosting: whip cream cheese with butter until smooth
10. Gradually add the powdered sugar , mixing until combined
11. In another bowl , whip the heavy cream until stiff , then fold the whipped cream and 1 / 2 t vanilla into the frosting mixture
12. Assemble cake: cut cooled cake in half lengthwise
13. You can cut the cake into three layers , like they do at the market
14. Spread frosting over the first layer , add a layer of fruit
15. Put on the top layer and frost
16. The sides of the cake are not frosted
17. Arrange fruit in circles over entire top of the cake , slightly overlapping the fruit
18. Spread apricot glaze over fruit with a pastry brush

title: tarragon walnut chicken salad
steps:
1. Place chicken in large skillet or dutch oven
2. Add enough water to cover chicken
3. Bring to a gentle boil over medium high heat
4. Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes or until juices run clear
5. Remove chicken from liquid
6. Cool and cut into 1 / 2" cubes in a small bowl , blend together mayonnaise and sour cream , stir in vinegar , salt and pepper
7. Whisk in walnut oil until blended
8. Stir in chopped tarragon and chives
9. Reserve 2 tbs of the apricots and 2 tbs walnuts for garnish , then add remainder to mayonnaise mixture
10. Mix well
11. Stir in chicken
12. Cover and refrigerate 1-2 hours or until well chilled
13. Place 1 lettuce leaf on each plate and mound chicken salad onto leaves
14. Sprinkle with reserved walnuts and apricots , then garnish with tarragon sprigs
15. Ifyou don't have walnut oil you can toast the walnuts before chopping them to bring out their flavor and substitute 2 tbs of cream for the walnut oil

title: dilly cheese pinwheels
steps:
1. Place cream cheese in a mixer or food processor and cream until smooth
2. Add dill and edam cheese to mix and blend
3. Open first canister crescent dough and piece together the dough into 2 rectangles pairing the our four triangles together in one sheet and the inner for triangles together in another
4. Its okay to stretch the dough out a little bit
5. Spread a thin layer of of the cream cheese on the dough
6. Begin rolling the dough using the long side as the center of the pinwheel
7. Contine rolling into tube
8. Wrap tubes with wax paper twisting edges of paper
9. Repeat with the second roll of crescent dough
10. Place both tubes into the freezer for 20 minutes
11. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
12. Remove dough from wax paper and begin slicing into 3 / 8 inch pieces
13. Place the pieces on cookie sheet
14. Bake 12-13 minutes
15. Allow the pinwheels to cool 5-10 minutes before removing from the cookie sheet
16. If you remove too soon , they will not retain their shape as the cheese will be too hot and soft
17. Serve either hot or cold

title: cooking light edamole
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a food processor & process until smooth
2. Cover & chill

title: creole boiled shrimp cocktail
steps:
1. For shrimp:
2. In a large bowl toss the shrimp with 2 tablespoons of the creole seasoning or essence
3. Coat evenly
4. Combine 3 gallons water , the zatarains boil , salt , remaining 2 tablespoons of creole seasoning , the 2 halved lemons , onion , celery , bay leaves , and garlic in large stockpot
5. Bring to a boil and taste
6. The salinity of the water should be that of saltwater
7. Add the shrimp and cook stirring frequently until pink and cooked through , 3-4 minutes
8. Drain in colander , transfer to a bowl and cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate about 1 hour
9. For creole seasoning:
10. Combine all ingredients and mix thoroughly
11. Store in an airtight container for up to three months
12. For cocktail sauce:
13. Combine all ingredients and whisk well
14. Cover and chill for 2 hours
15. Will keep in the refrigerator for up to two days
16. Serve shrimp with the remaining lemon cut into wedges and the cocktail sauce

title: weight watchers korean style grilled flank steak
steps:
1. Put flank steak into a shallow glass or ceramic dish
2. To make marinade , combine garlic through to sesame oil in a blender and blend until smooth
3. Pour half the marinade over flank steak , turn over to coat both sides , cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes and up to 24 hours
4. Refrigerate remaining marinade as well
5. Prepare coals for grill
6. Grill flank steak for 5 to 7 minutes on each side for medium-rare
7. Set on a cutting board to rest while you finish salad
8. Put remaining marinade into a small saucepan and add 3 tablespoons water
9. Bring to a simmer over very low heat and cook for 3 to 4 minutes
10. In a large bowl , toss watercress , scallions and carrot with warm marinade
11. Slice flank steak into thin strips
12. Pour any juice from meat over salad and toss it inches serve flank slices alongside salad

title: chocolate orange biscotti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In large bowl , mix melted butter , cake mix , eggs , flour , orange extract , orange peel and almonds
3. Mixture will be thick
4. Mix it with hand mixer or hands until if forms a big ball
5. Form the ball into a 14 x 4 rectangle
6. Place rectangle in oven and bake for 30 minutes
7. Remove rectangle and let cool for 10
8. Slice cross-wise into 1 inch slices and lay slices on their sides
9. Bake at 350 for 10 more minutes
10. Turn off oven and let biscotti's sit for another 30 minutes
11. Remove from oven and let cool

title: broccoli   cheddar cheese with chicken casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cut up broccoli , and place it in the bottom of a glass casserole dish
3. Place the chicken in the dish ontop of the broccoli , i prefer to chop it up
4. In a bowl , mix the chicken soup , mayonnaise , and curry until well blended and smooth
5. Spread the soup mixture over top the chickenand broccoli
6. Cover with shredded cheddar and beake uncovered for approximately 30 minutes

title: molly mayer s nacho dip
steps:
1. Mix taco seasoning with cream cheese and sour cream
2. Spread on the bottom of a 9 x 9 pan pie
3. Layer: lettuce , tomato , onion , salsa and cheese
4. Serve with nacho or corn chips

title: season all seasoning blend
steps: 1. Mix all ingredients thoroughly and store in a large airtight container

title: dry rubbed rib eye steak restaurant style
steps:
1. Combine all the spices in a bowl
2. Stir to evenly distribute all the ingredients
3. If you want to monitor the amount of salt , combine all the spices except the salt in a bowl
4. Add 1 tablespoon kosher salt and stir
5. Taste the rub and then gradually add more salt to taste
6. Rub the outside of each steak on all sides generously with the rub and store any leftovers in an airtight container
7. Wrap each steak in plastic wrap two times , and refrigerate up to 24 hours or at most 3 days
8. This makes the steak taste aged
9. Preheat a gas or charcoal grill until hot
10. Brush the grill to remove any left over food , then oil the grill
11. Remove the steaks from the refrigerator about 20 to 30 minutes before cooking and let them come to room temperature
12. Just before cooking , remove the plastic wrap and lightly oil the steaks with extra-virgin olive oil
13. Place the steaks on a very hot grill and char both sides of the steaks , a few minutes per side
14. When the outsides of the steaks have become well seared , move the steaks to a cooler part of the grill to continue cooking for 6 to 7 minutes per side for medium rare
15. Remove steaks from the grill and let rest in a warm spot for 7 to 8 minutes
16. Cut the steak off the bone and slice on the bias across the grain in slices to the thickness you prefer , up to 1 inch thick
17. Add the bone to the serving plate if you have folks who will appreciate it
18. If desired , drizzle the meat with extra-virgin olive oil
19. Serve immediately

title: fluffy lemon fruit pie
steps:
1. Spread half of the cherry pie filling on bottom of crust
2. In a large bowl , beat cream cheese with wire whisk until smooth
3. Gradually beat in milk until well blended
4. Add pudding mix
5. Beat until smooth
6. Gently stir in 1 / 2 tub whipped topping
7. Spread over cherry pie filling on bottom of crust
8. Spread remaining whipped topping over pudding mixture
9. Spoon remaining cherry pie filling over whipped topping layer
10. Refrigerate 3 hours

title: oma s cream of wheat pudding  german griesbrei
steps:
1. Using a heavy saucepan so as not to scorch the milk , bring the milk & salt just to a boil
2. Gradually stir in the cream of wheat , whisking until well blended
3. Return to a boil
4. Reduce heat to low
5. Simmer uncovered , 2 1 / 2 minutes or until thickened , stirring frequently
6. Meanwhile , beat eggs well with a fork in a glass measuring cup
7. Add about one tablespoon of thickened hot porridge to the beaten eggs and stir well to combine
8. Add one more tablespoon of the hot porridge to the egg mixture
9. Stir well
10. Gradually add the egg mixture into the pot of hot porridge , stirring well to combine
11. Remove from heat and stir in the lemon juice
12. Let cool slightly before serving
13. Top with butter while warm
14. Enjoy pudding warm or chilled , sweetened to your taste and with fruit toppings of your choice

title: coconut   lemon syrup muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to moderately hot
2. Grease a 12-hole muffin pan
3. Sift flour into a large bowl , and rub in the butter until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs
4. Stir in sugar , desiccated coconut , zest , egg and coconut cream- be careful not to over-mix
5. Spoon mixture into prepared pan , and sprinkle with shredded coconut
6. Bake in the oven for about 20 minutes
7. Transfer muffins to a wire rack over a tray
8. Pour hot lemon syrup over the hot muffins
9. If necessary , drain the syrup from the tray and pour over muffins again
10. Lemon syrup: combine all ingredients in a small saucepan
11. Stir over heat , without boiling , until sugar dissolves
12. Simmer uncovered , without stirring , for 2 minutes

title: marie s chikin nuggets
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f in a food processor , put the tofu , dried thyme , nutritionnal yeast , lemon juice , onion powder and some salt and pepper , to taste
2. Pulse until well blended
3. Mix the cornflakes and the breadcrumbs in a bowl
4. Salt to taste
5. Put the soymilk in a small bowl
6. Form 18 small patties with the tofu mix
7. Dip in the soymilk then roll in the cornflake crumb --
8. Bake on a cookie sheet for 30 minutes --
9. You can also freeze them before cooking
10. It will make the tofu chewier , and more nugget-y

title: balsamic marinated vegetables
steps:
1. Combine the vegetables in a large glass or ceramic bowl
2. Mix dressing ingredients and pour over vegetables
3. Stir well , cover and refrigerate for 6 to 24 hours , stirring occasionally
4. Cooking time reflects time to marinate vegetables

title: beefy cheese ball
steps:
1. Knead all together with hands
2. Form into a ball
3. You can roll in chopped nuts if desired
4. Chill
5. It taste good immediately , but it's better if it sits for a couple of hours

title: tortellini vegetable soup  4 ww points
steps:
1. In large pot , heat oil over medium heat
2. Add carrots , celery , onion , salt & pepper
3. Cook , stirring until softened , about 5 minutes
4. Add broth
5. Bring to boil
6. Add tortellini
7. Cook until tendr according to package
8. Stir in spinach and lemon juice
9. For a heartier soup , add shredded cooked chicken but don't forget to add the points when calculating
10. Servings: 6
11. Calories: 216
12. Protein: 20 g
13. Fat: 5 g
14. Chol: 12 mg
15. Carbs: 31 g
16. Sodium: 960 mg
17. Fiber: 5 g
18. Sugar: 4 g
19. Points: 4 per serving

title: overnight macaroni casserole   pizza flavored
steps:
1. Mix everything
2. Spread in 9x13 pan
3. Cover and refrigerate overnight , or at least 4 hours
4. Place in cold oven
5. Turn heat to 350 and bake one hour

title: lamb biryani
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine the yogurt , garlic , cayenne , cumin , black pepper and teaspoon of the salt
2. Stir in the lamb
3. In a large saucepan , melt the butter over moderate heat
4. Add the onion and cook until starting to soften , about 3 minutes
5. Stir in the coriander , turmeric , cloves , cinnamon , rice , and the remaining salt
6. Cook , stirring , for 1 minute
7. Add the lamb mixture to the pan
8. Stir in the water and raisins
9. Bring to a simmer
10. Cover and simmer until the rice and lamb are almost done , 20 minutes
11. Remove from heat
12. Let stand , covered , until the rice and lamb are just done , about 5 minutes
13. Stir in the cashews

title: turkey and dressing patties with gravy
steps:
1. Mix together turkey , dressing , and enough gravy to hold mixture together
2. If needed add enough bread crumbs to be able to make patty shaped
3. In a medium sized skillet , heat oil until hot but not smoking
4. Shape turkey mixture into two patties
5. Add to skillet , fry until golden brown , about 5 minutes on each side
6. Remove to serving plate , add rest of warmed up gravy over patties

title: raspberry apple muffins
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 180c lightly oil a non-stick muffin tray
2. Sift the flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt into a large bowl
3. Roughly grate the apple , with its skin but without its core , into the bowl
4. Mix it in with the honey and lemon zest
5. Roughly stir in the egg , oil and milk until the batter is just mixed but still a little lumpy
6. Toss the frozen raspberries in the sugar then quickly fold them in to the batter
7. Spoon into the muffin tins , filling each to the top as these don't rise too much
8. Bake for 20 minutes until a thin knife inserted into them comes out clean
9. Let cool in the tin for 10 minutes , then on a wire rack
10. Enjoy !

title: smothered pork chops with fried onion rings
steps:
1. Season chops with salt , pepper and whatever else you like and brown chops in margarine or butter
2. Drain
3. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
4. Place the browned chops in single layer in a glass baking dish
5. Heat the mushroom soup , plus 1 / 2 a can of water and thyme and mix well
6. When blended , mix in sour cream , parsley , and crushed fried onions
7. Pour this mixture over the chops and then sprinkle the remaining reserved onions on top
8. Cover and bake for 1 hour at 350 degrees f
9. Remove cover for the last 5 minutes of baking

title: spicy turkey chili
steps:
1. Saute onions and garlic briefly
2. Add ground meat and fry until cooked
3. Add plum tomatoes , sauce , and beans
4. Stir until blended
5. Add all spices and stir until blended
6. Reduce heat and simmer for 1
7. 5-2 hours
8. Serve on top of corn chips or with corn muffins on the side !

title: singapore black pepper chicken
steps:
1. Heat oil in wok
2. Add onions , peppers , garlic , ginger , and green beans
3. Stirfry until crisp tender and remove from wok , leaving as much oil as possible behind
4. Keep warm
5. Add chicken to oil in wok , and stirfry until done through
6. Push chicken up the sides of the work , and add sauce
7. Heat sauce , and as it thickens , stir in chicken
8. Add veggies back to chicken in wok
9. Add black pepper
10. Stir to combine and reheat veggies if needed
11. Serve immediately over hot rice

title: black eyed pea con queso
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large dutch oven
2. Add onions and garlic and saute until tender
3. Add cheese and cook over low heat , stirring constantly until melted
4. Stir in peppers and peas
5. Cook stirring often until thoroughly heated
6. Serve with tortilla chips

title: dried fruit roll ups
steps:
1. For each cup of fruit you will need 1-1 / 2 tablespoons of sugar
2. Chop peaches , nectarines or plums very fine , being careful to reserve the juice
3. Place fruit and its juices in saucepan and bring to a boil
4. Boil until candy thermometer reads 180 degrees
5. Cool slightly
6. Put into blender and mix until smooth
7. Return to heat and cook until the mixture has the consistency of a thick paste and is reduced by half
8. Spread fruit 1 / 4-inch thick on plastic-wrapped trays or cookie sheets
9. Cover pans with a cheesecloth screen , taking care to keep the cheesecloth from touching fruit
10. Place in direct sunlight for 12 to 24 hours until dry
11. You can also bake in a 250-degree oven for about 4 hours
12. Put the fruit on a lightly greased cookie sheet or use foil to line tray
13. Fruit rollups are done when edges pull back from plastic and center is not sticky when cooled
14. Ten cups of fruit will cover a 12 x 17-inch tray
15. - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - serving ideas : make dried fruit roll-ups the old-fashioned way

title: nif s pineapple squares
steps:
1. Cream together butter and sugar in a large bowl
2. Add egg yolks and mix well
3. Sift together flour , baking powder and salt
4. Add to the creamed mixture , mixing well
5. Press into an 8" x 8" cake pan
6. Cover with pineapple
7. Beat the egg whites until stiff
8. Add the sugar and coconut
9. Spread over the pineapple
10. Bake at 350f for 30 minutes
11. Cool and cut into squares

title: vegan biscotti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Whisk together wet ingredients in a bowl
3. Dry in another
4. Fold wet into dry and knead until dough if firm
5. Shape into a log and bake 28 minutes until slightly puffy or cracked
6. Remove and cool
7. Cut and rebake at 375 degrees for 12 to 15 minutes
8. Cool and enjoy !

title: starbucks peppermint mocha
steps:
1. Combine 3 tbsp baking cocoa with 3 tbsp warm water to make into a rich syrup
2. Pour into a 16 ounce mug
3. Add espresso
4. Add peppermint syrup
5. Steam milk and add to remainder of cup
6. Garnish with whipped cream and sugar crystals
7. Don't let the thought scare you it is almost as easy as making regular american coffee- it just takes a little practice:
8. Buy a $30 machine
9. Put water into carafe up to band and put into machine
10. Put coffee into filter head and pack down well
11. Turn on and brew until carafe fills to 4 cup line that way there is still enough water in machine to steam milk
12. Switch to steam mode and steam milk
13. Follow recipe and enjoy !

title: variations on a lemonade
steps:
1. Place lemon juice , sugar , and 1 cup water in a large pitcher
2. Stir until the sugar dissolves , then add 5 more cups water , a few slices of lemon to garnish , and plenty of ice
3. Before you sip , try any of the variations

title: easy creamed spinach
steps:
1. Bring cream to a boil in a saucepan
2. Add the spinach and seasoning
3. Continue to cook until cream reduces to desired consistency
4. If cream dries up too fast , you can add more as needed

title: mediterranean olive pasta
steps:
1. If using kalamata or greek olives , remove the pits by smashing the olives with the flat side of a chef's knife blade and discarding the pits
2. Roughly chop the olives
3. Heat the olive oil in a pan
4. Add the onions and saute for one minute
5. Stir in the garlic and saute for one minute
6. Stir in the chopped tomatoes and olives
7. Heat for five minutes and then add the marinara sauce and the wine
8. Warm until heated through and toss with the hot pasta

title: easiest sweetened ice tea
steps:
1. Bring 2 cups of water up to a boil
2. Place 8 tea bags and sugar into pitcher
3. Pour water over tea bags and let steap for 5 minutes
4. Remove tea bags and add 6 cups of ice
5. Add fresh lemon and mint as desired

title: raspberry cake with marsala   crme frache
steps:
1. Position rack in center of oven and preheat to 400f
2. Butter 10-inch-diameter springform pan
3. In medium bowl whisk first 5 ingredients to blend
4. In small bowl , combine marsala and orange juice
5. In large bowl , beat 12 tablespoons butter and 1 cup sugar until well blended
6. Beat in eggs , vanilla , and lemon peel
7. Beat in marsala mixture in 2 additions alternately with flour mixture in 3 additions
8. Transfer batter to prepared pan
9. Sprinkle with 1 1 / 2 cups raspberries
10. Bake cake until top is gently set , about 20 minutes
11. Reduce oven temperature to 375f dot top of cake with 2 tablespoons butter and sprinkle with 2 tablespoons sugar
12. Continue baking until tester inserted into center of cake comes out clean , about 15 minutes
13. Cool in pan on rack
14. Release pan sides
15. Transfer cake to platter
16. Cool to room temperature
17. Mix crme frache and 2 tablespoons sugar in small bowl
18. Cut cake into wedges
19. Top each with dollop of crme frache and fresh raspberries and serve

title: cauliflower carrot soup or broccoli
steps:
1. Prepare vegetables
2. In large sauce pan , heat oil
3. Add onions , celery and garlic
4. Saut on medium-low heat about 5 minutes stirring occasionally
5. If necessary add a little water to prevent sticking
6. Add potatoes , carrots and broth to sauted vegetables
7. Bring to a boil
8. And simmer 20 minutes uncovered
9. Add cauliflower and red pepper
10. Simmer another another 15- 20 minutes vegetables are tender
11. Pure with hand blender or potato masher to break up vegetables
12. Leave the soup chunky
13. Add milk , thyme , salt and pepper to taste
14. At this point you can more or less milk depending on how thick you want to have your soup
15. I used carnation no fat milk
16. Reheats and freezes well
17. You can replace the cauliflower with broccoli for a different version

title: fish fillets with a triple cheese crust
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Combine mustard , breadcrumbs , cheeses , parsley , garlic and seasoning in large bowl
3. Place fish on oiled oven tray
4. Press cheese mixture onto fish , spray with cooking oil spray
5. Bake , uncovered , in hot oven about 10-15 minutes or until cheese browns and fish is cooked through

title: sex in the pan
steps:
1. Crust: mix graham cracker crumbs and melted margarine
2. Press into pie pan and bake 20 minutes
3. Set aside to cool
4. Filling: mix cream cheese , powdered sugar and 1 cup cool whip with electic mixer
5. Spread on cooled crust
6. Topping: combine chocolate pudding and 1 1 / 2 cups milk
7. Stir in mini chocolate chips , set aside
8. Combine vanilla pudding and 1 1 / 2 cups milk in a separate bowl
9. Spread vanilla pudding on cream cheese filling
10. Spread chocolate pudding on vanilla pudding
11. Top pie with remaining 2 cups cool whip
12. Garnish with shaved chocolate
13. Refrigerate one hour to set

title: microwaved fish fillet
steps:
1. Place fish in a casserole dish and pour wine mixed with teriyaki sauce
2. Sprinkle wth scalions and herbs
3. Cover loosely and nuke for about 9 minutes or until fillets flake

title: halo halo   hawaiian filipino dessert
steps:
1. Cook tapioca until pearls become translucent
2. Rinse tapioca in cool water and set aside
3. Prepare jell-o using half of the water called for and refrigerate until stiff
4. Put the fruit and coconut into drink cooler or large bowl
5. Cut jell-o into 1 / 2" squares
6. Add bananas , tapioca , and jell-o to fruit mixture
7. Prepare ice cream by emptying container into a large bowl and smoothing into paste scoop ice cream into fruit mixture
8. Cover fruit mixture with crushed ice
9. If using cooler , cover with lid
10. Wait 30 minutes and stir to combine all ingredients well
11. Serve with ladle in paper cups with spoons
12. Leftovers can be refrigerated for the next day

title: chocolate sour cream coffee cake
steps:
1. Cream together the butter and sugar
2. Add eggs one-at-a-time
3. Gradually add the flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
4. When dry ingredients are completely blended , add the sour cream& vanilla
5. Fold in the chocolate bits
6. Prepare streusal by mixing all ingredients together
7. Pour 1 / 2 of the batter into prepared loaf or tube pan
8. Top with 1 / 2 of the streusal
9. Add remaining batter on top of streusal
10. Top with with remaining streusal
11. Bake for one hour at 350 degrees

title: creamy mushroom and chicken soup
steps:
1. 1
2. In a stock pot , melt butter and add onions until tender
3. Reduce heat and stir in flour , salt , and pepper and stir until smooth
4. Slowly add broth and stir
5. Turn the heat up to med-med high and bring to a boil
6. Add mushrooms , celery , carrots , potatoes , squash , corn and thyme
7. Reduce and simmer soup about 30 minutes or until the veggies are as tender as you like
8. 2
9. Add cream , parmesan and chicken
10. Reduce heat and heat the soup about 10 additional minutes without letting it boil

title: lovers  creamy chocolate cocktail
steps:
1. Place the chocolate in a small plastic bag
2. Squeeze it to one end
3. Twist the bag
4. Snip the corner of the bag
5. Pipe chocolate heart shapes around the inside of 2 chilled cocktail glasses
6. Refrigerate the glasses while preparing a cocktail
7. Blend or process the liqueurs , milk and ice cream until smooth
8. Divide the extra ice cream between the prepared glasses and pour the cocktail mixture over the top
9. Share with your loved one

title: cheesy cabanara
steps:
1. Cook pasta as directed
2. Drain
3. Set aside
4. Drizzle oil in skillet over medium heat
5. Add bacon , onion , and garlic
6. Stir
7. Cook until bacon is cooked and onions are slightly browned
8. Add cheese and cream and stir until creamy and well blended
9. Add pasta and mix well
10. Add salt and pepper to taste , serve immediatly

title: sweet potato pie vi
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in mixing bowl
2. Mix well
3. Pour into pie shells
4. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes

title: tuscan cacciatore risotto  rachael ray
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , bring the wine and broth to a simmer , then reduce the heat to low and keep warm
2. In a large , deep skillet , heat 1 tablespoon evoo , over medium-high heat
3. Add the pancetta and cook , stirring occasionally , until crisp , 7 to 8 minutes
4. Using a slotted spoon , transfer the pancetta to a paper-towelled plate
5. Set aside
6. Add the remaining 2 tablespoons evoo , the mushrooms , onion , garlic and crushed red pepper to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes
7. Stir in the rice until coated with the oil and slightly toasted , about 2 minutes
8. Stir in the rosemary and tomato paste , season with salt and pepper and cook for one minute
9. Reduce the heat to medium and stir a ladle or two of the warm broth mixture into the risotto every few minutes until absorbed
10. After about 7 minutes , stir in the chicken along with some broth
11. Continue to add the broth gradually , stirring constantly with a wooden spoon to make a creamy consistency , until the rice is al dente , about 22 minutes
12. Stir in the cheese and green peas and adjust the seasonings
13. Serve the risotto in shallow bowls topped with the reserved pancetta bits
14. Pass more cheese around the table
15. Enjoy with some chianti and some nice and crusty warm bread !

title: chocolate irish dream cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Stir all ingredients together except chocolate chips
3. Beat for 2 minutes on medium speed
4. Fold in chocolate chips
5. Pour into greased and floured bundt or tube pan
6. Bake for 55-60 minutes or until toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
7. Cool in pan 15 minutes , then remove
8. Serve with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream

title: healthy lemon cupcake frosting
steps:
1. Place icing sugar in a bowl and create a whole in middle and hollow out
2. Add yoghurt into centre of bowl
3. Carefully fold yoghurt into icing sugar making sure of no lumps
4. Continue mixing until a thick but moveable texture is formed
5. Add lemon zest and lemon juice and mix
6. Finally add a tiny drop of yellow food colouring and mix
7. Your ready to generously frost your cupcakes

title: foolproof chocolate frosting
steps:
1. In food processor , process butter , sugar , cocoa , and salt until smooth , about 30 seconds , scraping sides of bowl as needed
2. Add corn syrup and vanilla and process until just combined , 5 to 10 seconds
3. Scrape sides of bowl , then add chocolate and pulse until smooth and creamy , 10 to 15 seconds
4. Frosting can be used immediately or held
5. The frosting can be made 3 hours in advance
6. For longer storage , refrigerate the frosting , covered , and let it stand at room temperature for 1 hour before using

title: mean chef s welsh rarebit
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a saucepan over low heat , add the flour and whisk to make a roux
2. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes
3. Whisk in the ale and boil the mixture for 3 minutes while whisking
4. Reduce heat to low , add the cheddar cheese , mustard , worcestershire , and tabasco pepper sauce , and cook , stirring , until hot but not boiling
5. Spoon the cheddar mixture over the toasted muffins , garnish with parsley and serve with crispy bacon

title: white chocolate pumpkin dreams
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , cream butter and sugars
2. Beat in egg , vanilla and pumpkin
3. Combine dry ingredients
4. Gradually add to the creamed mixture
5. Stir in chips and pecans
6. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheets
7. Bake at 350 degrees f for 12-14 minutes or until firm
8. Remove to wire racks to cool
9. For frosting:
10. Combine brown sugar and butter in a saucepan and bring to a boil
11. Cook over medium heat for 1 minute or until slightly thickened
12. Cool for 10 minutes
13. Add milk
14. Beat until smooth
15. Beat in enough confectioners' sugar to reach desired consistency
16. Frost cookies

title: chickpea and tomato curry
steps:
1. In 3-quart saucepan , heat oil over medium heat
2. Cook onion , garlic , ginger root and curry powder in oil about 2 minutes , stirring frequently , until onions are tender
3. Stir in chickpeas and tomatoes and heat to boiling
4. Reduce heat
5. Simmer uncovered 15 minutes , stirring occasionally
6. Stir in cilantro , lemon juice and salt
7. Serve over rice
8. Top each serving with yogurt and for vegan simply omit the yogurt

title: low carb cheese crackers
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 400 degrees
2. You can buy already cheddar , monterey jack and colby finely shredded cheese by kraft at the grocery store , however up here in northern quebec where i live , they don't sell it
3. If you can't find finely shredded , buy a rotary grater from startfrit- it does the trick perfectly
4. Once you have your cheese finely shredded , place small to medium sized mounds of it onto a non-stick cookie sheet- it must be non-stick for this to work
5. Place the cookie sheet into the oven and watch your cheese mound melt and start to bubble
6. You know they are done when they start to bubble more slowly and they look less moist in the center of the mound- this can take practice
7. Take them out of the oven when you think that they are done , and let them rest until they stop bubbling
8. Slide one off the sheet and see if it's texture is hard and crispy or if it still feels flexible , if it is flexible then pop the sheet back into the oven for another 30 seconds to a minute
9. These taste nice and crunchy and you store them in an airtight container on top of a paper towel
10. I eat them with my other recipe for shrimp dip- which is low carb when made with cream
11. O carbs for the cheese i use , look on your package of cheese for how many carbs your cheese contains per serving

title: fiesta black bean quesadillas
steps:
1. Make the salsa by combining all the ingredients together
2. Store in the refrigerator until ready to use
3. Heat oven to 200 f
4. Combine the beans , cilantro , onions , tomatoes , garlic , cumin , adobo , salt and pepper in a bowl and toss to combine
5. Lay tortillas flat
6. Place 1 / 8 of the cheese on one half of each tortilla
7. Top with 1 / 4 of the bean mixture , then with 1 / 8 of the cheese
8. Fold tortilla in half to cover filling
9. Heat a large non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat
10. Cook one quesadilla at a time , taking care not to spill while cooking or turning , until lightly browned on both sides and cheese is melty
11. Transfer each quesadilla to oven when finished to keep warm while cooking the remaining quesadillas
12. Cut quesadillas into 4 wedges
13. Serve hot with sour cream and salsa

title: no crust low calorie strawberry pie
steps:
1. Rinse and hull strawberries
2. Distribute evenly in a 10 inch pie pan
3. In a medium saucepan combine pudding mix , gelatin mix and water
4. Stir well and bring to a full boil
5. Pour mixture over strawberries and refrigerate for 6 hours
6. Top with light fat free frozen whipped topping if desired

title: orange walnut  coffee cake with orange glaze
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Grease an 8-inch spring form pan
3. Flour lightly , tapping out excess flour , or use pan release recipe #78579
4. Combine cake mix , orange zest , orange juice and water in a large mixer bowl
5. Beat the batter according to package directions
6. Stir in walnuts
7. Pour into prepared pan
8. Bake in preheated oven for 50 minutes , or until top springs back when lightly pressed with finger
9. Cool in pan on a wire rack 10 minutes
10. Loosen cake around edge with a knife
11. Release spring , and carefully lift off side of pan
12. Place cake on a wire rack
13. Cool completely
14. Remove cake from metal base
15. Place on a serving plate
16. Glaze:
17. Blend sifted icing sugar and orange juice together
18. Stir in 1 tablespoon more orange juice , a little at a time , until glaze is thin enough to pour from a spoon
19. Spoon over top of cake , letting mixture drizzle down side
20. A slotted spoon is great for drizzling
21. Sprinkle thin orange peel strips , or grated orange zest , over top of cake for garnish

title: sesame salmon
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , whisk together soy sauce , sherry , rice vinegar , sesame oil , sugar , and red pepper flakes
2. Place salmon in a glass baking dish and pour soy sauce mixture over salmon
3. Cover , and chill for at least 2 hours , turning once halfway through
4. Once salmon has chilled , place on a heated broiler pan and broil 4" from the heat for about 5 minutes on each side , or until the fish is cooked through
5. Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds and chopped green onion just before serving

title: sweet pumpkin dip
steps:
1. Beat cream cheese and pumpkin in large mixer bowl until smooth
2. Add sugar , cinnamon and ginger
3. Mix thoroughly
4. Cover
5. Refrigerate for 1 hour
6. Serve with fresh fruit , bite-size cinnamon graham crackers , gingersnap cookies , toasted mini-bagels , toast slices , muffins and / or english muffins

title: grilled arepas with cheese
steps:
1. Place corn kernels and chicken stock in a blender or food processor and process until smooth
2. Pour the cornmeal into a large bowl
3. Stir in the sugar and sour cream
4. Stir in corn mixture
5. Add cheese
6. Form mixture into a ball
7. Separate dough into 8 pieces
8. Roll each piece into a ball and then flatten into a pancake about 1 / 4-inch thick and 2 inches in diameter
9. Preheat grill
10. Brush the arepas lightly with the melted butter
11. Grill the arepas until golden , about 3 minutes on each side
12. They should be toasted on the outside , but soft in the middle
13. Let cool to room temperature
14. Before serving , top with a spread of the farmer's cheese

title: teriyaki beef or chicken   hawaiian
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients
2. Soak beef 4 hours or overnight in sauce
3. Bake in shallow pan
4. Turn pieces over and marinate with sauce
5. Ten minutes before turning heat off , pour off rest of shoyu mixture
6. Serve with chopped green onions and chinese parsley
7. Bake 325 degrees for 1 hour or less depending on how well you like your meat
8. Medium is best
9. This is also a great for grilling on the bbq
10. Makes about 6 servings
11. Grilled teri-beef and teri-chicken sticks: a great way to make teriyaki beef or chicken when grilling is to slice the meat into thin strips before marinating
12. Then put on bamboo skewers and grill for 2-3 minutes per side
13. The meat comes out tender tasty and is easy to eat right off the stick

title: sour cream apple cardamom quick bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Butter and flour two 6- to 8-cup loaf pans and reserve
3. In a mixer , cream together the butter , oil and sugars
4. Add the eggs , vanilla and sour cream
5. Sift together the cardamom , salt , baking powder , baking soda and flour
6. Mix into the creamed ingredients , a little at a time , until incorporated , taking care not to overmix
7. Stir in the walnuts and apple
8. Divide batter between the prepared pans
9. Tap pans on the counter to remove any air bubbles
10. Bake for approximately 60 to 65 minutes , or until a toothpick poked in centers comes out clean
11. Rotate pans halfway through baking
12. After 45 minutes , place sheets of foil loosely over loaves to prevent overbrowning
13. Cool in pans for 10 minutes , then remove to a rack and turn right-side-up to cool completely

title: cuban slow cooker pork chops
steps:
1. Layer the pork chops in a crock pot
2. Combine sofrito , tomato sauce and water in a bowl
3. Pour over the chops
4. Set the crock pot for 6 hours on the low setting
5. Add the olives to the sauce before serving

title: enchiladas rojas
steps:
1. The sauce: heat a dry skillet or griddle over medium
2. Tear the chiles into flat pieces , then toast them a few at a time: use a metal spatula to press the chile pieces flat against the hot surface , skin side up , until they are aromatic and have lightened in color underneath , about 10 seconds
3. Place in a bowl , cover with about 3 cups very hot tap water , lay a small plate on the chiles to keep them submerged and soak for 20 minutes
4. Use a pair of tongs to transfer the rehydrated chiles to a food processor or blender
5. Measure 1 1 / 2 cups of the soaking liquid and add it to the chiles along with the garlic
6. Blend to a smooth puree , then push through a medium-mesh strainer into a pie plate
7. The consistency should be like that of canned tomato sauce
8. Taste and season highly with salt , usually about 1 / 2 teaspoon
9. Other preliminaries: set out the grated cheese and sliced onion
10. If using the optional chicken , warm it in a microwave or in a small skillet over medium-low heat
11. Finishing the enchiladas: heat the oven to 350f place the sauce and tortillas near the stove , with a baking sheet beside them
12. Set a small skillet over medium heat and add 1 tablespoon of the oil or lard
13. When the oil is hot , dip both sides of a tortilla into the sauce , then lay it in the oil
14. Let is sear and sizzle for about 20 seconds , then use a small spatula to flip it over
15. Sear the other side for about 20 seconds
16. Transfer to the baking sheet , folding it occasionally and then heating another tablespoon of oil or lard to fry a new batch
17. Arrange the fried , folded tortillas in groups of three , overlapping them
18. Pop them into the oven to heat through , about 5 minutes
19. While the enchiladas are heating , in a small bowl , toss the lettuce with the vinegar and a good sprinkling of salt
20. Divide the warm enchiladas among four dinner plates and sprinkle liberally with the grated cheese
21. Top with the sliced onion , chicken and a generous portion of the dressed romaine
22. These wait for no one

title: sticky bun noodle kugel
steps:
1. Melt the whole stick of margarine and add 1 cup brown sugar to it
2. Pour in the sugar mixture into the bottom of a bundt pan , and press pecan halves into the mixture
3. Mix together all the remaining ingredients except for the noodles , then add them to the cooked noodles
4. Carefully spoon everything into the bundt pan
5. Bake for 1 hour at 350
6. Invert to serve

title: texas delight
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 325 degrees
2. Mix pecans , butter , and flour together and spread in a layer at the bottom of the pan
3. Bake for 10-15 minutes until crust is light brown
4. Set aside and let cool completely before adding other layers
5. Mix cream cheese and one tub of cool whip together and spread on as the bottom layer
6. Make pudding according to directions , when firm , spread it on top of the bottom layer
7. Repeat with other pudding
8. For the top , spread the other tub of cool whip on and put it in the refridgerator to chill
9. Enjoy !

title: southside of morocco smoothie summer drink
steps:
1. Add each ingredient to a blender or food processor and mix until well blended
2. Serve in a glass , with or without ice , and garnish with a mint sprig

title: green fatoush
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f
2. Put the scallions and chile slices into a bowl
3. Discard the outer leaves of the lettuce and then tear it into pieces , adding to the bowl
4. Whisk the lime zest and juice and oil in a small bowl or jug and add a sprinkling of salt
5. Open the pita breads up lengthways so that you have 4 very thin halves , and lay them on a baking sheet
6. Toast them in the oven for about 5 minutes to give them a bit of crunch
7. They will turn a golden brown color , but keep an eye on them as they might burn
8. Take the pita breads out and leave them to cool
9. Halve the avocado , remove the stone and then using a spoon , scoop pieces of avocado out onto the bowl of lettuce
10. Dress the salad with the lime and oil dressing and add most of the chopped herbs before tossing with your hands to combine
11. Snip with scissors or break the crispy pita bread with your hands into rough triangles , and add most of the pieces to the salad and toss again before decanting to a serving bowl or platter
12. Scatter with remaining herbs and toasted pita

title: mexican bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Cook rice as described on the package
3. In a medium baking pan , spread , in layers: refried beans , rice , black beans , guacamole , salsa , and cheese
4. Top with crushed tortilla chips
5. Bake for 15-20 minutes
6. Serve and top with sour cream , if desired

title: way too sinful caramel crunch bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f line a 13 x 9-inch baking pan with parchment paper for easier extraction and cleanup
2. Beat together the butter and sugar until light and fluffy
3. Add the egg yolks , 1 at a time , beating well after each addition
4. Beat in the vanilla
5. At low speed , beat in flour , 1 / 2 cup at a time , until a dough forms
6. I cannot stress enough how important it is to follow this step correctly , otherwise you will end up with flour all over your counter and a tough dough
7. Press the dough into the prepared pan
8. Bake the dough until golden , about 20 minutes
9. Transfer the pan to a wire rack to cool slightly
10. To prepare the topping , in a small , heavy saucepan , cook the sugar , butter , and corn syrup over medium heat until the sugar is dissolved and bubbles appear around edges of pan
11. Reduce the heat to low
12. Cook without stirring until the mixture turns a deep golden color , about 1 minute
13. Watch carefully , it can go from golden to burnt and ruined very quickly
14. Remove from the heat
15. Stir in the cream
16. Sprinkle the almonds evenly over the prepared cookie base
17. Pour the cream mixture over the almonds
18. Return the pan to oven
19. Bake cookies until the topping bubbles , about 10 minutes
20. Transfer the pan to a wire rack to cool completely
21. Cut the cookies into bars

title: quick   easy cashew chicken
steps:
1. Dice chicken into small pieces , approx 1 / 2" to 3 / 4" cubed
2. Cut up onion into small pieces
3. Heat wok at high heat on stove , add a small amount of sesame oil to coat bottom of pan
4. When oil is hot , begin browning chicken by stirring continuously with chopped onion , garlic , onion and cumin
5. When cooked through , remove from pan and set aside
6. In same pan , empty can of vegetables into pan and stir fry for about 2 minutes
7. Then , return chicken and onion mixture to pan
8. Add seasoning packet and just enough water to dissolve
9. Stir fry for three minutes
10. Serve with steamed white rice

title: thai coconut fish
steps:
1. Place stock , coconut milk , fish sauce , sugar , lime leaves , lemon grass and chili in a large saucepan over medium heat
2. Boil for ten minutes , then lower the heat and bring to a simmer
3. Add the fish and poach for about three minutes , until fish is just done
4. Remove the fish , cover and set aside
5. Reduce the sauce over high heat , until slightly thickened
6. Strain and stir in the lime juice
7. Serve the fish with cooked rice , covered with the sauce
8. Enjoy !

title: easy pumpkin muffins  ww 4 points each
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Spray a 6-cup muffin tin with nonstick cooking spray , then sprinkle lightly with flour
3. In a large bowl , combine the all-purpose flour , whole-wheat flour , sugar , raisins , wheat germ , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
4. In a medium bowl , whisk the pumpkin puree , egg , orange juice , pumpkin pie spice , and vanilla
5. Add to the flour mixture
6. Stir until just combined
7. Spoon the batter into the cups , filling each about 2 / 3 full
8. Sprinkle with the walnuts
9. Bake until a toothpick inserted in a muffin comes out clean , 25-30 minutes
10. Cool in the pan on a rack 10 minutes
11. Remove and serve warm

title: lost soul s tuna salad
steps:
1. Chop radish , green onion , and lettuce very fine
2. Mix tuna , onion , and garlic in bowl
3. Mix in mayo and jalepeno sauce
4. Mix in chopped veggies
5. Slice avocados and season with tony's
6. Make a bed of lettuce , add a scoop of tuna mixture , top with a cherry tomato , arrange avocado slices around scoop of tuna and serve

title: warm and creamy crab dip
steps:
1. Pick through crab to remove any stray shells
2. Mix together all ingredients and place in a small glass casserole dish
3. Bake at 325f 30-35 minutes , or until hot and bubbly
4. Serve warm , with cracker or toast

title: french green beans with lemon and dill
steps:
1. Trim and wash green beans
2. Set beans in a collander over boiling water
3. Cover and steam until just tender
4. Don't over cook !
5. Add butter , lemon juice , dill , salt and pepper and stir until butter has melted
6. Serve immediately and enjoy !

title: tomato lime vegetable dip
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients and refrigerate , covered , for 1 / 2 hour
2. Serve with raw vegetables cut into decorative pieces
3. Use carrots , broccoli , cauliflower , celery etc
4. Along with unusual vegetables such as fennel , endive and various colored peppers

title: spinach and avocado soup
steps:
1. Blanch the spinach in boiling water for a minute , then drain
2. Place spinach in a liquidiser with all the other ingredients and whizz together until smooth
3. Chill til needed to serve pour into bowls and top with a dollop of yogurt and sprinkle with parsley
4. A sprinkle of cayenne pepper also looks pretty !
5. It serves 4 but i often double it

title: 8 layer fiesta dip
steps:
1. Spread unheated beans in the bottom of a 9x11 size glass dish or glass baking pan
2. Pour enchilada sauce evenly over the beans
3. Spoon on guacamole and spread evenly
4. In a separate dish , mix together the taco seasoning and the sour cream until well blended
5. Spoon this sour cream mixture over the guacamole and spread around evenly
6. Sprinkle cheese on top of these layers until you have a complete "layer" of cheese
7. Drain the cans of black olives and sprinkle them evenly on top of the cheese
8. Do the same with the green onions , and then finally with the diced tomatoes
9. Cover tightly and chill in refrigerator for about 2 hours
10. Now , invite a few friends over , set it on the table with some tortilla chips , and watch it disappear !
11. This dish will keep for about a week if tightly covered in the refrigerator
12. Combine a few spoonfuls of this dip with taco meat and place in tortillas or taco shells for an amazing ready to eat meal !

title: old bay creamy shrimp pasta
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to directions on package
2. During the last minute of cooking add the peas
3. Drain and reserve 1 / 4 cup of the cooking liquid
4. In a large skillet over medium heat , melt the butter
5. Add the shrimp and sprinkle with 1 / 2 tablespoon of old bay
6. Cook for 3 minutes or until they start to turn pink
7. Reduce heat to medium-low
8. Stir in the half-and-half , reserved cooking liquid , parmesan cheese and the rest of the old bay
9. Simmer for 5 minutes or until the sauce begins to thicken
10. Remove from heat and add the pasta , peas and green onion
11. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving
12. Serve with extra grated parmesan cheese

title: fat free chocolate zucchini muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Combine and beat egg whites , applesauce , sugar and vanilla extract
3. Stir in zucchini
4. Mix dry ingredients and add to wet mixture
5. Mix well
6. Line muffin tin with muffin / cup cake papers
7. Fill 2 / 3 the way up
8. Bake for 19 minutes

title: singapore fried rice noodles
steps:
1. Soak the rice vermicelli in hot water for 15-20 minutes
2. Drain and rinse in cold water
3. Heatabout 1 tbsp oil and scramble the beaten eggs , remove and reserve
4. Heat the remaining oil , fry the onions until opague
5. Add the bean sprouts and rice vermicelli with the curry powder and the sugar
6. Blend well
7. Add the soy sauce , meat , prawns , peas and scrambled eggs
8. Continue stirring for 2-3 minutes
9. Add the spring onion and chilles ,
10. Mix gently and serve

title: spicy sweet potato wedges
steps:
1. Cut potatoes into wedges
2. Toss in oil to coat , then sprinkle over spice
3. Toss again
4. Bake in preheated oven , 400f , for 20-25 minutes , turning occasioinally
5. Serve with your choice of dip

title: good and easy cake
steps:
1. Mix instant pudding with milk and set aside
2. In medium size bowl pour cake mix , eggs and pudding
3. Mix well and pour into 9x13 inch pan
4. Sprinkle with chocolate chips and nuts
5. Bake at 350 for 30-40 minutes
6. No frosting is needed
7. Variation: can do the same with yellow cake , butterscotch chips and butterscotch pudding
8. I used mini m&m's instead of nuts

title: fresh picked strawberry ice cream
steps:
1. Puree all ingredients in a blender
2. Chill mixture for 1 / 2 to 1 hour until cold
3. Process according to the freezing instructions for your ice cream machine

title: oriental drumsticks
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , except chicken , into a large covered tupperware
2. Cover and shake till combined
3. Add chicken
4. Chill 24 hours , turning often
5. Discard marinade and place drumsticks onto 1 or 2 cookie sheets
6. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 45 minutes , or till cooked through
7. Either serve immediately , or place into a crock pot and keep on low to stay warm

title: salsa for canning
steps:
1. Dip tomatoes in hot water for 20 seconds then in ice cold water
2. Peel off skins
3. Cut into about 8 pcs
4. We then fill a quart jar full of tomatoes like for canning and then dump into large pan
5. We prepare 4 quarts worth for each batch
6. Chop up all veges except tomatoes in a food processor and put into large pan with tomatoes
7. Add the vinegar , brown sugar , and salt
8. Simmer over low heat for 3-4 hours until reach desired consistency
9. Stir often to keep from sticking and burning to bottom of pan
10. Can in pint sized jars by water bath method
11. Check your current canning instructions for length of time in water bath

title: irene s red potatoes
steps:
1. Clean and slice or chunk potatoes
2. Add seasonings
3. Cut butter over top of potatoe
4. When ready to bake
5. Add 1 1 / 2 inch of water
6. Cover with tin foil
7. Bake @ 400f x 1 hr

title: a w whistle dog
steps:
1. Cook bacon until crisp / tender and set aside
2. Split the hot dogs lengthwise but not all the way through
3. Butterfly the hotdogs on a lightly buttered pan or griddle
4. Cook on medium heat for about 3 minutes
5. Flip the hotdogs over
6. Fold cheese slices in half on the diagonal and put on top of the hotdogs
7. Add the bacon on top of the cheese
8. Cook until cheese melts slightly
9. Lightly butter the hotdog buns and add to the pan
10. Lightly toast both sides
11. Remove buns and add relish , top with the hotdogs

title: green chile chicken alfredo
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat 2 tablespoons of the olive oil and brown the chicken pieces until lightly browned and cooked through
2. Remove the cooked chicken to a plate and keep warm
3. If necessary , add the remaining 2 tablespoons oil to the skillet and saut the garlic and green chile over medium heat until the garlic is soft
4. Reduce the heat to medium low , add the alfredo sauce and mix well
5. Add the cooked chicken and heat through
6. Serve over hot fettuccine and garnish with chopped jalapenos if desired

title: halloween pumpkin patch oreo pie
steps:
1. Place sherbet in a bowl
2. Stir until smooth
3. Stir in 1 / 2 of the whipped topping until well blended
4. Spoon into premade oreo cookie crust
5. Sprinkle with chopped oreos , pressing firmly into sherbet
6. Cover with remaining whipped topping
7. Freeze 4 hours or until firm
8. Let stand at room temperature 10 minutes before serving
9. Garnish with finely chopped oreo cookies and candy pumpkins , if desired

title: chocolate chip eggnog muffins
steps:
1. In bowl , combine dry ingredients and chocolate chips
2. In large bowl , whisk together cup sugar , eggs , eggnog and oil
3. Stir in flour mixture until just combined
4. Spoon batter into prepared muffin cups
5. Sprinkle with remaining sugar
6. Bake at 375 for 20-25 minutes
7. Let cool on rack for 5 minutes before removing from pans

title: fried green beans with slivered almonds
steps:
1. In a frying pan , heat up olive oil over medium heat
2. Once hot , add green beans and saute until wrinkly !
3. Add almonds and continue saute-ing until the almonds start to brown
4. Remove from heat and drizzle with lemon juice
5. Recipe can easily be doubled or tripled , depending on the number of people to feed !

title: king s arms tavern like creamed onions
steps:
1. Cook the onion in boiling salted water until tender
2. Drain
3. Melt the butter over medium heat and stir in the flour and salt
4. Add the milk and continue to cook , stirring constantly , until the sauce is smooth and slightly thickened
5. Put the onions in a greased 1-quart casserole and pour the sauce over them
6. Stir in the whole peanuts
7. Top with the crumbs and chopped peanuts
8. Bake at 400 approximately 15 minutes until bubbly and lightly browned

title: good night moon milk
steps:
1. Mix vanilla , cinnamon and splenda in a large mug
2. Pour in milk
3. Stir
4. Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes , depending on your microwave
5. Making sure you are in your most comforatble pjs , sip as you slowly fall asleep

title: beef stroganoff casserole
steps:
1. Saute onion and butter in skillet
2. Add and saute beef until cooked through
3. Add flour , spices , and mushrooms
4. Simmer for 5 min
5. Add soup and water
6. Simmer for 10 min
7. Remove from heat and stir in sour cream
8. Add parsley and extra paprika for garnish
9. Serve over noodles , pasta , rice or serve as a main dish by itself
10. Easy and fast !

title: autumn  fall  glory soup
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 180c / 350f
2. Cut the top off the pumpkin with a large sharp knife and scoop out and discard the seeds
3. Using a small sharp knife and a tablespoon , cut and scrape out as much of the flesh from the shell as possible , then chop the flesh into rough chunks
4. Bake the pumpkin with its lid on for 45 minutes to 1 hour until inside begins to soften
5. Meanwhile , make the filling
6. Gently fry onion , garlic and pumpkin flesh in olive oil for about 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
7. Add the sliced courgette and the mushrooms and cook for a further 3 minutes , then stir in the tomatoes , pasta shells and stock
8. Season well , bring to the boil , then cover the pasta and simmer gently for about 10 minutes
9. Stir the fromage frais and basil into the pasta and spoon the mixture into the pumpkin

title: low fat roasted veges
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 190c if using a fan-forced oven or 210c if using no fan
2. Spray an oven tray / cookie sheet with cooking oil
3. Wash potatoes , dry and cut in half
4. I like to leave the potato skins on
5. Peel the kumera and slice into 2-3 cm thick slices
6. Place the veges in a single layer on the tray
7. Sprinkle over the herbs and spices
8. Spray again lightly with the cooking spray
9. Place in pre-heated oven and cook 30 minutes remove the veges from the oven and turn them over
10. Re-season and spray again lightly with cooking spray
11. Return veges to oven and cook another 20 minutes
12. Check veges and cook longer if required
13. Serve plain or drizzled with lemon juice , gravy or sauce of your preference

title: mushroom stuffed onions  midwest
steps:
1. To make onion cases: peel 6 medium or 3 large onions
2. Boil / simmer until tender
3. Remove from water and cool
4. If using medium onions , cut a slice from the top and hollow out , leaving a 3 / 4-inch shell
5. If using large onions , cut in half
6. Remove the centers , leaving a 3 / 4-inch shell
7. Chop the centers
8. Preheat oven to 400f
9. Saut the chopped mushrooms in 2 t of the butter until tender
10. Sprinkle with 1 t of the flour and mix
11. Stir in 1 / 3 c milk or cream and stir until thickened
12. Season with salt and lots of paprika
13. Fill the onion cases with mushroom mixture
14. Make white sauce by melting 2 t butter
15. Stir in 2 t flour until blended
16. Slowly stir in 1 c milk or cream
17. Stir until thickened
18. Add the chopped onion centers and any of the mushroom mixture that didn't fit in the onion cases
19. Season the sauce well with salt , paprika , and worcestershire sauce or sherry
20. Pour the seasoned white sauce into a shallow baking dish
21. Add the stuffed onion cases , stuffing side up
22. The tops may be sprinkled with bread crumbs dotted with butter or sprinkled with cheese -- or not
23. Bake the onions until they are well-heated
24. Garnish with parsley
25. They may be served on toast
26. For vegetarian do not use worcestershire sauce option use the sherry or use a vegetarian worcestershire sauce

title: pot sticker or dumpling sauce
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Mix well
3. Serve with potstickers or dumplings

title: stuffed pork tenderloin
steps:
1. In a large frying pan on medium-high heat , add olive oil , sliced leeks and mushrooms and saute' until the leeks are tender , about 3 minutes
2. Stir in thyme , salt and pepper and cook for 1 - 2 minutes
3. Let cool slightly , then transfer to a food processor and process until the leeks and mushrooms are finely chopped
4. Add bread crumbs , parmesan cheese and parsley and process just to blend
5. Preheat oven to 350f
6. Cut each tenderloin lengthwise about 3 / 4 of the way through the thickness of the meat
7. Open meat like a book and using a food mallet , flatten each tenderloin to about 1 / 2 inch thickness
8. Divide the stuffing mixture in half and cover each tenderloin with the stuffing mixture , pressing it firmly into an even layer over the entire surface of the meat
9. Beginning at one of the shorter ends , roll the tenderloin up to enclose the stuffing
10. Tie each rolled tenderloin with kitchen string in at least 3 places to secure the roll
11. Brush each tenderloin with mustard and sprinkle with salt and pepper
12. Place tenderloins side by side in a small roasting pan
13. Roast in preheated 350 f oven for 35 to 45 minutes or until a meat thermometer inserted into the center reads 155f
14. Remove from oven and let stand for 10 minutes before slicing into spirals about 3 / 4 inch thick
15. Serve warm or at room temperature with roasted garlic mayonnaise

title: caprese quiche
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Spray 9 inch pie plate with cooking spray
3. Beat eggs and half-and-half until well blended
4. Fold in remaining ingredients and pour into pan or pie crust
5. Bake 35 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean
6. Let stand 10 minutes before serving

title: creamy tortellini with ham and asparagus
steps:
1. Cook tortellini in boiling water for 3 minutes
2. Add asparagus and cook for 2 minutes more
3. Drain well and add ham , alfredo sauce and pesto to the pot
4. Cook over low heat for 2 to 3 minutes or until all ingredients are warmed
5. Serve with parmesan cheese

title: copenhagen salad
steps:
1. Cut cheese into inch cubes , this is easy if the cheese is well chilled
2. Mix with halved and seeded black grapes , halved walnuts and mandarin oranges
3. Just before serving , sprinkle with a little white wine
4. Enjoy !

title: 30 day health muffins
steps:
1. Whisk the oil , eggs , sugar , vanilla essence and milk together
2. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well
3. Allow to stand overnight in the refrigerator in an airtight container
4. Spoon into well greased muffin tins and bake at 180c (350f for 10-15 minutes
5. Or microwave in a 6 muffin ring for 3
6. 1 / 2 minutes on medium and 30 seconds on high
7. Stir well each time before using

title: tangy cucumber salad
steps:
1. Place cucumbers in a strainer , sprinkle with 1 / 2 tsp salt and toss
2. Let stand for 30 minutes
3. Rinse and drain well
4. Place in a large bowl , add tomatoes and onion
5. In a small bowl , whisk together the remaining ingredients
6. Pour over cucumber misture and toss
7. Cover and chill for several hours
8. Serve with a slotted spoon

title: chocolate supreme
steps:
1. Mix together flour , butter and pecans until well combined
2. Press into the bottom of a lightly greased 9x13 baking dish
3. Bake at 375 for 10 - 12 minutes , until golden
4. Remove from oven and let cool
5. Beat cream cheese and powdered sugar until smooth
6. Fold in 2 cups cool whip
7. Spread over crust and chill for about 1 hour
8. Mix the pudding mixes and milk
9. Beat until thick
10. Spread over cream cheese layer
11. Top with another layer of cool whip , and pecans if desired
12. Keep covered in refrigerator

title: pasta with kalamata olives and roasted grape tomato sauce
steps:
1. Position rack in center of oven and preheat to 375f combine tomatoes , oil , garlic ,
2. Vinegar , and crushed red pepper in 13x9x2- inch glass baking dish
3. Season to taste with pepper and a tiny bit of salt
4. Roast until tomatoes are tender and juicy , stirring occasionally , about 45 minutes
5. Stir in oregano
6. Measure and get ready capers , olives , and feta cheese
7. Rinse both capers and feta cheese to remove excess salt
8. Gently pat dry
9. Toast pine nuts for just a few minutes in a 300 oven if using watch the nuts as they toast so they dont burn this happens very quickly
10. Cook pasta in large pot of boiling salted water until just tender but still firm to bite
11. Drain
12. Return to pot
13. Add tomato mixture , olives , and capers
14. Stir over medium heat until heated through , about 2 minutes
15. Add feta and stir until melted and creamy , about 2 minutes
16. Divide pasta among plates
17. Sprinkle with pine nuts and serve

title: macaroni and cheese with vegetables
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to boil
2. Cook pasta until al dente
3. While pasta is cooking , in med saucepan , melt 2 t of the margarine
4. Remove from heat
5. Add flour and stir until blended
6. Whisk in stock and milk , stirring over med heat until mixture comes to a boil and thickens
7. Reduce heat to low
8. Stir in cheeses and seasonings
9. Continue stirring until cheese is melted
10. Remove from heat and set aside
11. In a large skillet , melt remaining 1 t margarine
12. Add remaining ingredients
13. Cook vegetables , stirring constantly , for about 5 minutes , until tender / crisp
14. Reduce heat to low
15. When noodles are done , drain well
16. Toss with vegetables
17. Stir in cheese sauce
