18. Garnish with scallion curls

title: brown sugared ribeyes
steps:
1. Whisk together first 3 ingredients in a large shallow dish or zip-top plastic freezer bag
2. Add steaks , turning to coat
3. Cover or seal , and chill 24 hours , turning once
4. Preheat grill to 350 to 400 heat
5. Remove steaks from marinade , discarding marinade
6. Sprinkle steaks with salt and pepper
7. Grill , covered with grill lid , 5 minutes on each side or to desired degree of doneness
8. Remove from grill , and let stand 5 minutes

title: old fashioned homemade ice cream
steps:
1. Beat egg yolks with half of sugar and all of flour
2. Mix until creamy
3. Add evaporated milk then add rest of sugar and vanilla
4. Beat egg whites until fairly stiff
5. Fold into above mixture
6. Put in ice cream freezer and add whole milk , leaving about 1 1 / 2 inches at top of freezer
7. Freeze in ice cream freezer
8. Makes 1 gallon

title: chicken lasagna roll ups
steps:
1. In a bowl combine the cottage cheese , mozzarella , egg and 2 tbsp of the parmesan cheese
2. Cover and chill
3. Heat large non-stick skillet over medium high heat , add chicken broth , onion , and garlic and saute until tender
4. Add tomato sauce , tomato paste , mushrooms , parsley , wine , oregano , and pepper
5. Bring to a boil
6. Cover and reduce heat
7. Simmer for 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions
9. Drain well
10. Spread 1 cup of the tomato mixture in the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish
11. Stir chicken into remaining sauce
12. Spread 1 / 4 cup of the cheese mixture down a noodle
13. Top the cheese with 2 tbsp of the tomato mixture
14. Roll up and place seam side down in the pan over the tomato sauce
15. Continue until all noodles are rolled
16. Spoon remaining sauce over the rolls and sprinkle with remaining 2 tbsp parmesan cheese
17. Cover and bake in preheated 350 degree oven for about 30 minutes or until heated through

title: plantation ribs
steps:
1. Combine first 6 ingredients in a saucepan
2. Bring mixture to a boil
3. Remove from heat , and set aside
4. Cut ribs into serving size pieces
5. Place meaty side down in a large shallow baking pan
6. Bake uncovered , at 450 degrees for 30 minutes
7. Drain off excess drippings
8. Reduce heat to 350
9. Turn ribs over , and bake an additional 50-60 minutes
10. Brush ribs with sauce during the last 15 minutes of cooking

title: tuscan rice salad
steps:
1. Bring large saucepan of water to boil
2. Stir in rice and salt
3. Reduce heat to medium and simmer uncovered until rice is tender , stirring occasionally , about 15 minutes
4. Drain rice well
5. Whisk vinegar and oil in large bowl
6. Add warm rice and toss to coat
7. Whisk egg and parmesan cheese in small bowl to blend
8. Spray medium nonstick skillet with vegetable oil spray and heat over medium-high heat
9. Add egg mixture and stir constantly until scrambled and curds are set , about 1 minute
10. Remove from heat and cool
11. Cut egg into small pieces
12. Season to taste with pepper
13. Stir egg pieces , pork , peas , red onion and parsley into rice
14. Season salad to taste with salt and pepper
15. Line shallow bowl with lettuce leaves
16. Spoon rice salad onto leaves
17. Surround with tomato wedges
18. Serve at room temperature
19. Serves 4

title: tastee s onion chip dip
steps:
1. Place cottage cheese in a bowl , add half the milk
2. Mix thoroughly with an electric mixer , adding remaining milk while mixing , until the cottage cheese has lost it's identity
3. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix quickly until the sour cream has had time to whip up to its limit
4. Be sure not to whip too long as it will start to drop in volume

title: pudding ice cream
steps:
1. Stir sugar , pudding , and cocoa together
2. Stir in first amount of milk
3. Heat , stirring often , until mixture comes to a rolling boil that cannot be stirred down
4. Remove from heat
5. Set saucepan in cold water in sink
6. Stir
7. Lay plastic wrap or waxed paper on pudding to stop crust from forming
8. Cool
9. Add evaporated milk and vanilla
10. Stir well
11. Chill until very cold
12. Turn into ice-cream maker
13. Freeze according to directions

title: savory party mix
steps:
1. Combine pretzels , potatoes , peanuts , croutons and onions
2. Pour margarine over the combined ingredients
3. Sprinkle with cheese , mix well
4. Spread mixture on a ungreased 15 1 / 2 x 10 1 / 2 jelly roll pan
5. Bake at 250 for 1 hour , stir twice during baking

title: amazing low fat turkey lasagna roll ups
steps:
1. Cook lasagna noodles according to package
2. When done rinse and separate
3. Best if on wax paper
4. In pan heat olive oil
5. Add onion and garlic , saute til brown , then carrot
6. Add tomatoe sauce and paste
7. Add all herbs , bring to boil
8. Simmer for 20 minutes
9. While sauce simmers brown turkey meat with beef broth
10. This will keep it nice and moist
11. Pre heat oven to 400 degrees
12. In a 9x14 pan put tin foil , and spray with cooking spray
13. Add half sauce
14. Take lasagna noodle and put one tbs of ricatta
15. On top of ricatta add tsb of mozzarella
16. Add 2-3 tbs turkey meat on top of cheeses
17. Add 1 tbs of sauce on top of everything
18. Fold noodle in half then over again
19. Place all roll ups in pan , then put rest of the sauce on top of noodles
20. Back at 400 for 20 minutes covered
21. Take out add rest of mozzarella cheese on top
22. Bake uncovered for 10 more minutes

title: sausage and corn quesadillas
steps:
1. In a bowl , mix first 5 ingredients together
2. Mix well
3. Spread evenly on 6 tortillas
4. Place sausage , cheese , chilies and corn evenly over the 6 tortillas
5. Sprinkle with salt
6. Top with remaining tortillas
7. Press down gently
8. Bake at 350 degrees on a lightly greased baking sheet for 10 minutes , turning after 5 minutes
9. Cut each quesadilla into wedges
10. Serve warm

title: quick and easy shrimp scampi
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Shell the shrimp leaving the tail on
3. Use a small knife and split each shrimp down the back lengthwise
4. Remove any black veins , rinse shrimp under cold water and pat dry
5. In a small pan , heat butter , olive oil , garlic , lemon juice , salt and pepper just until butter is melted
6. In a 13x9 inch pan , arrange shrimp in a single layer with the split side opened and down , tails up
7. Pour butter mixture over all
8. Bake for 15 minutes

title: egg in a basket grilled cheese with asparagus
steps:
1. This is probably the most important part of making this dishthe size of the hole
2. You want the hole big enough to hold the egg and fry it in the bread but not so big that it doesnt fill the hole
3. Making the hole too small has the opposite affect , and the egg overruns
4. Add the butter to your frying pan and melt it over a medium-high heat
5. I add in the bread and toast both sides before adding the egg , but this isnt required
6. It is just a preference
7. If you do this , you might need a bit more butter for frying the egg itself
8. Crack the egg into the basket and let it cook until the white are set
9. Or you can flip it
10. Place the asparagus in a steamer and steam 3-5 minutes
11. You want it crisp tender
12. Take your slice of bread , pile on the 5 spears of asparagus and the 1 / 3 cup of gruyere
13. Place it on a parchment-lined baking sheet and put it in the broiler until the cheese fully melts
14. This should take about 2 minutes or so
15. When the cheese is melted and the egg in the basket is made , transfer the bottom half of the sandwich to the frying pan , melting the butter in the pan first
16. Fry it all up , carefully flipping it to melt the cheese into the egg in a basket
17. Enjoy !

title: sarasota s green chili mexican burger
steps:
1. Mayonnaise -- in a small bowl , add the green chilies mayonnaise , garlic and lime juice and mix well
2. If you want , you can blend this in a small food processor or blender , but i actually like a little texture to mine
3. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use
4. This can easily be made ahead of time
5. Burgers -- in a medium size bowl , add the salsa , chili powder , cumin , grated onion , pinch of salt and pepper
6. If you use a mild salsa you can add a bit more chili powder , but i use a medium heat salsa which works just fine for this
7. Mix everything well
8. Then add in the turkey and mix lightly , i prefer to use my hands
9. And make sure not to over work the burgers
10. Make 4 nice size burgers and place on a small sheet pan lined with either foil or parchment
11. Make a small indentation in the center of the burger with your thumb
12. Not too deep , just a little indent
13. This helps the burger not to shrink up as it grills
14. Season with salt and pepper and put in the freezer
15. We are not freezing them , just firming them up
16. They cook better after they rest a bit and are chilled
17. About 15-20 minutes in the freezer
18. These also can be made a head of time
19. Garnish -- prepare your avocado slices and drizzle with the remaining lime juice , lettuce leaves and cheese
20. Grill -- i prefer an outside grill , but a inside grill pan or even a heavy saute pan will work just fine
21. Spray the pan or grill with a non stick spray and cook the burgers on the first side until you get a nice sear and golden brown , depending on how thick you make them , about 5 minutes
22. Flip , and make sure when you flip , the burger releases from the pan or grill easily
23. If you have to scrape to flip it , it isn't ready to be flipped
24. The second side again will take about 5 minutes , maybe a bit less
25. Add 2 slices of cheese per burger and melt
26. As the cheese melts , add the burger rolls either to a broiler or grill to lightly brown
27. Finish -- top the bottom bun with a thin slather of the mayonnaise , then a lettuce leaf
28. Then the burger with melted cheese , another lettuce leaf , avocado slices and top with the second bun slathered with the mayonnaise
29. Serve -- enjoy ! a crisp green salad goes great with this
30. Fries of course or chips and a pickle

title: banana popsicle
steps:
1. Pour vanilla vodka and banana liqueur over ice in a shaker adding equal parts of orange juice and pineapple juice to the spirits
2. Shake and strain over ice cubes into a collins glass

title: molasses prune muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Coat 18 muffin cups with nonstick cooking spray
3. Combine first 8 ingredients in a large bowl
4. Combine remaining ingredients and stir well with a whisk
5. Add to flour mixture and stir just until moist
6. Spoon batter into 18 muffin cups
7. Bake 18 minutes or until done
8. Remove from pan immediately and cool on wire rack

title: poppy seed cake  low fat
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients and beat about 2 minutes
2. Pour into greased bundt pan
3. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour or until done
4. Cool 2-3 minutes before removing from pan

title: sweet potatoes a l orange
steps:
1. Slice the sweet potatoes into 1 / 2 inch slices
2. Spray baking dish with non-stick spray , then spread potatoes in layers and cover with foil
3. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes , until potatoes are tender to the touch
4. Spoon orange fruit spread over the potatoes , cover with foil and bake an additional 15 minutes

title: cool chinese noodle in peanut sauce
steps:
1. Cook noodles in a large pot of boiling water over medium heat
2. Cook until barely tender and still firm
3. Drain immediately and rinse with cold water until cold
4. Drain well and toss noodles with dark sesame oil so they don't stick together
5. For dressing: combine all ingredients except hot water in a blender and blend until smooth
6. Thin with hot water to consistency of whipping cream
7. For garnish , peel flesh of carrot in short shavings about 4" long
8. Just before serving , toss noodles with sauce
9. Garnish with cucumber , green onion , and carrot
10. Serve cold

title: ginger honey glazed shrimps
steps:
1. Make sure shrimps are completely thawed and drained
2. Preheat the oven to broil
3. In a bowl , whisk together the soy sauce , honey , vinegar , ginger , garlic , and pepper
4. Add cornstarch and whisk
5. Pour over shrimps , turning to coat
6. Marinade for 30 minutes or longer
7. When finished marinating , transfer marinade to a small saucepan , add cornstarch and simmer
8. Lightly grease the foil with sesame oil on the oven-proof dishpan before placing the marinaded shrimps
9. Broil shrimps for about 6 mins , brush shrimps often with sauce
10. When shrimps are cooked , place the shrimps on a bed of rice , pour over with the rest of the marinade , sprinkle with fresh lemon juice if desired

title: turkey meatball and escarole soup
steps:
1. In a 3 quart or larger slow cooker , combine the carrots , broth and escarole
2. Cover and cook on low for 4 hours
3. In a medium bowl , combine the turkey , onion , eggs , bread crumbs , grated parmesan , salt and pepper
4. Mix well and make 1 inch meatballs and carefully add to the slow cooker at the 4 hour mark
5. Cover and cook 4 hours longer , or until the meat and veggies are cooked through
6. Serve sprinkled with the additional cheese
7. I would separate the leaves from the stems of the swiss chard and add them first
8. The leaves of the chard and spinach should be added right at the end - you can raise to high for the last few minutes

title: grilled pineapple with basil
steps:
1. Clean the pineapple and cut it lengthwise in slices of circa 1 cm
2. Grill the slices until golden brown
3. Whip the mascarpone with the honey and lemon juice
4. Cut the basil into thin ribbons and mix with the icing sugar
5. Distribute the pineapple over four plates , and garnish with the mascarpone mixture and the sugar / basil mixture

title: rich pancakes and waffles
steps:
1. Seperate eggs and beat whites till fluffy but not dry , set aside
2. Mix all dry ingredients together , set aside
3. Beat yolks and milk
4. Slowly add dry ingredients beat till smooth
5. Mix in melted butter
6. Do not overbeat
7. Fold in egg whites
8. Cook over medium heat till golden

title: cherokee indian curry aaa steak sauce
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan and add 1 / 2 cup water
2. Cook over medium heat for 15 mins
3. Let cool
4. Place your steaks in a large shallow pan in 1 layer
5. Add 2 cups steak sauce and marinate for 30 mins
6. At room temp
7. Turn and marinate for 30 mins
8. More
9. Grill , broil , or panfry steaks to desired doneness
10. Season with salt and pepper and serve

title: hearty lamb and lentil stew
steps:
1. In a slow cooker , combine all ingredients but the parsley , salt and black pepper
2. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours or on high for 3 to 4 hours
3. Just before serving , remove bay leaves , stir in parsley and season , to taste , with salt and black pepper

title: refreshing raspberry drink
steps:
1. Make syrup: place raspberries in medium bowl
2. Add sugar and lime juice and mash with back of wooden spoon
3. Let sit for 10 minutes
4. Strain mixture through fine sieve to remove seeds and set aside
5. Make drink: fill 4 large glasses with ice and pour 1 / 4 cup syrup in each glass
6. Add 3 / 4 cup sparkling mineral water
7. Stir to combine
8. Top with 1 / 2 cup sparkling water
9. Garnish glasses with fresh raspberries or lime wedges if desired

title: authentic big easy red beans and rice
steps:
1. Prepare your rice as directed while meal is simmering
2. Olive oil in dutch oven or large skillet , medium-low heat
3. Add minced garlic and cook 1-2 minutes
4. Add chopped onion , bell pepper , and celery , saute for 6-8 minutes
5. Add spices and broth , stirring well
6. Add sausage and washed red kidney beans and fold in until well mixed
7. Simmer for 15-20 minutes - cooking out most liquid
8. Taste test - this is the time to add a little more cajun spice
9. Remove bay leaves
10. Spoon mixture over 3 / 4 - 1 cup cooked rice

title: smoked sausage and cornbread pie
steps:
1. Brown sausage in skillet
2. Drain and put sausage in greased pie pan
3. Pour drained can of corn over sausage
4. Salt and pepper to taste
5. Prepare corn bread mix according to package directions
6. Pour over sausage / corn mixture
7. Bake at 400 for 25-30 minutes , or until corn bread is golden

title: acorn squash feta casserole
steps:
1. Cut squash in half
2. Discard seeds
3. Place squash cut side down in a greased 15-in
4. X 10-in
5. X 1-in
6. Baking pan
7. Bake at 375 for 35-40 minutes or until tender
8. Cool slightly
9. Carefully scoop out squash
10. Place in a bowl and mash
11. In a skillet , saute onion and garlic in butter until tender
12. Add peppers
13. Saute until crisp-tender
14. In a large bowl , whisk eggs and yogurt until blended
15. Stir in squash , onion mixture , feta cheese , salt , pepper and cayenne if desired
16. Transfer to a greased 11-in
17. X 7-in
18. X 2-in
19. Baking dish
20. Sprinkle with sunflower kernels
21. Cover and bake at 375 for 25 minutes
22. Uncover
23. Bake 25-30 minutes longer or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean

title: quick and easy cinnamon toast
steps:
1. Take a slice of bread
2. Spread a light coat of butter on it
3. In a small cup , mix sugar with cinnamon powder and sprinkle it on the bread
4. Toast the bread
5. Serve hot

title: manwich jambalaya
steps:
1. Brown meat and onion flakes in the oil
2. Add the can of manwhich and broth
3. All also the veggies
4. Add all spices
5. Stir well and add water till pot is full
6. Simmer over low heat for two hours
7. Add rice and simmer untill tender

title: spring broad beans in yoghurt
steps:
1. Cover the beans with water and simmer until tender , the time can vary from a few minutes for very small beans or 20 minutes for more mature beans
2. Drain and slip any outer shells off any tough beans
3. Mix garlic and yoghurt together
4. Stir yoghurt mixture into the beans and season with the salt and pepper
5. Warm through gently and serve

title: crock pot mexican orange chicken  pollo con naranja
steps:
1. Set crock pot to high
2. Add orange juice , garlic , pepper , cumin , cayenne , jalapeno and salt to blender or food processor and blend until smooth
3. Place chicken pieces in crock pot and pour orange juice mixture over chicken
4. Top with onions and potatoes
5. Cook for 6 hours on high
6. Internal chicken temperature should reach 160 before serving , and the meat should fall off the bone
7. Great served over rice !

title: swedish pancakes with lingonberry butter
steps:
1. Make batter combine flour , sugar , and salt in large bowl
2. Slowly whisk half-and-half , club soda , 4 tablespoons butter , eggs , and yolks into flour mixture until smooth
3. Cook pancakes brush surface and sides of 10-inch nonstick skillet with 1 teaspoon butter and heat over medium heat
4. When butter stops sizzling , pour 1 / 3 cup batter into skillet , tilting pan to evenly coat bottom with batter
5. Cook until golden brown , 1 to 2 minutes per side
6. Transfer to plate and cover tightly with aluminum foil
7. Repeat with remaining butter and remaining batter
8. Serve
9. Make ahead: swedish pancakes can be refrigerated for 3 days or frozen for up to 1 month
10. Layer cooled pancakes between parchment paper , wrap in plastic , and transfer to zipper-lock bag
11. To serve , microwave stack of 3 pancakes on 50 percent power until heated through , 10 to 20 seconds

title: pulled pork bbq
steps:
1. Rub pork loin with salt and pepper
2. Mix all dry ingredients in bowl
3. Mix all wet ingredients in seperate bowl except for water and cornstarch
4. Place all ingredients into crockpot
5. Place on low setting for 5 hours
6. After cooked , drain juices into bowl
7. Mix cold water and cornstarch , add to juices and mix well
8. Pull pork apart with a fork until desired texture is reached
9. Add cornstarch mixture back to crockpot and cook for another hour on low
10. Lightly stir the ingredients every 15 minutes to avoid lumps in the bbq
11. Serve alone or on a buttered toasted bunn with sliced pickles
12. Serve with "hot mama's mac-n-cheese , " baked beans and coleslaw

title: low fat low calorie dutch chocolate cake
steps:
1. Mix all of the dry ingredients together
2. Then add the remaining ingredients
3. Mix with an electric mixer set on low
4. Increase the speed to medium-high and beat for another 3 minutes ,
5. Spray a muffin tray with fat free butter flavor pam
6. Pour the batter into the cups and bake at 350 degrees f for 20 minutes

title: enchiladas pollo with green chilies cream sauce
steps:
1. Place breasts in dutch oven
2. Add water to cover , half of onion , bay leaf , peppercorns and salt to taste
3. Simmer- mer 45 min
4. Cool and drain
5. Shred chicken
6. Mix with 1 / 2 onion , parmesan and 4 oz
7. Jack
8. Set aside
9. In blender , combine ortegas , tomatillos cream and egg
10. Blend till smooth
11. Salt to taste
12. Set aside
13. Preheat oven to 350
14. Soften tortillas in oil
15. Place 1 / 8 chicken mixture in each tortilla
16. Roll and place in baking dish
17. Pour chile-cream mix- mixture over enchiladas
18. Sprinkle evenly with 4 oz
19. Jack
20. Bake 20 minutes at 350
21. Top enchiladas with guacamole and serve
22. - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

title: buttered balsamic asparagus
steps:
1. Trim the tough ends off the asparagus and discard
2. Blanch in a pot of boiling water for no longer than five minutes , then drain and set aside in a shallow dish
3. Keep warm
4. Melt the butter over a low heat in a large frying pan
5. Add the balsamic vinegar then toss in the asparagus
6. Stir to coat and let the aspargus cook gently for just a couple minutes
7. Put on a serving plate , pour over the lovely juices and season with salt and pepper
8. Sprinkle with the cheese shavings and serve immediately

title: chicken guadalajara
steps:
1. In a plastic bag combine flour , salt and pepper
2. Add chicken pieces and shake bag to coat evenly
3. In a large skillet heat 2 tablespoons of the butter over medium heat until hot
4. Add coated chicken pieces and cook about 8 minutes or until chicken is tender and no longer pink , and coating is golden brown , stirring occasionally
5. Remove chicken from skillet and keep warm
6. Heat remaining butter in the same skillet until hot
7. Add chili peppers , onion , and crushed red pepper
8. Cook and stir about 5 minutes or until tender but not brown , stirring up any browned bits
9. Add cream to the skillet and bring just to a low boil
10. Return chicken to skillet , and stir until combined
11. Simmer , uncovered , for 1 minute more or until sauce is slightly thickened
12. Spoon the creamy chicken mixture over hot , cooked fettucine , then spinkle with cheese

title: green chile chicken and pink bean stew
steps:
1. In a medium soup pot , heat the vegetable oil until shimmering
2. Season the diced chicken thighs with salt and pepper and cook over moderately high heat until browned on both sides , about 5 minutes
3. Add the onion and garlic and cook over moderate heat until softened , about 4 minutes
4. Stir in the cumin and cook until fragrant , about 1 minute
5. Add the pink beans , green chiles and stock to the chicken and bring to a simmer
6. Cook over moderately low heat until the stew has thickened , about 10 minutes
7. Stir in the cilantro and season with salt and pepper
8. Ladle the chicken and pink bean stew into bowls with rice and serve with lime wedges

title: broccoli salad with bacon and craisins
steps:
1. In a large bowl use a whisk to combine mayo , sugar , vinegar , salt , and pepper
2. Add vegetables and miss thoroughly
3. You can substitute regular raisins for golden raisins , but the golden color is a nice contrast to the craisins

title: amazing chicken tortilla soup
steps:
1. Saut onion , garlic , jalapeo and green pepper with olive oil in a large pot until soft
2. Add all the rest of the ingredients to the large pot and bring to a boil
3. After about 15 minutes , remove the chicken breasts and shred
4. Return shredded chicken to the pot and simmer an additional 45 minutes
5. Serve , topped with crushed tortilla chips if desired

title: chocolate sybil cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease and flour a 13 x 9 by 2" pan
3. For the cake: using an electric mixer , cream the butter and sugar together until fluffy
4. Add eggs , one at a time , beating after each addition
5. Sift flour , baking powder , and salt together in another bowl
6. Add to creamed mixture , continuing to beat
7. Add vanilla and chocolate syrup to batter and mix well
8. Pour into prepared panand bake for 25-30 minute just before cake is done , prepare frosting
9. For the frosting: put butter , chocolate syrup and evaporated milk in a saucepan over med
10. Heat and bring to a boil
11. Stirring ingredients together , boil for 2 to 3 minute remove from heat and stir in vanilla and nuts
12. Pour over warm cake

title: secret  deviled  eggs
steps:
1. Boil 6 eggs until hard boil stage and allow to cool
2. After removing from heat place in cold water so egg white will not become discolored
3. Peel and cut into halves
4. Place yokes into small bowl and mash out all lumps
5. Beat yokes by hand until fluffy
6. Add mayonnaise , durkee's famous sauce , pickle relish , salt and pepper
7. Stuff eggs
8. Sprinkle top with paprika
9. Can be found in most grocery stores

title: vietnamese meatballs
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients until well blended
2. Make 1" meatballs
3. Put them on wooden skewers
4. Broil until thoroughly cooked

title: healthy gumbo  dont know why its called gumbo
steps:
1. Fry the sausage in its own juices with 1 / 2 cup water until water is evaporated
2. Add all the ingredients to the sausage except rice
3. Let boil and reduce heat to medium for about 10 min
4. Turn off and add rice
5. Cover and let sit for 10 more minutes
6. Voila
7. It's healthy and soooo good

title: jamaican mocha rum cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300f butter a 12-cup bundt pan and dust with cocoa powder , knocking out excess
2. In a bowl whisk together flour , baking soda , and salt
3. In a large metal bowl set over a saucepan of barely simmering water melt chocolate and butter , stirring until smooth
4. Remove chocolate from heat and stir in rum , coffee , and granulated sugar
5. With an electric mixer beat in flour , 1 / 2 cup at a time , scraping down side , and beat in eggs and vanilla until batter is combined well
6. Pour batter into the prepared pan
7. Bake cake in middle of oven until a tester comes out clean , about 1 hour and 40 minutes
8. Let cake cool completely in pan on a rack and turn it out onto rack
9. Dust cake with confectioners' sugar and serve with whipped cream

title: texas best cheese dip  chile con queso
steps:
1. Melt cheeses together in microwave or on stove top
2. Stir in all other ingredients
3. Serve warm

title: fried catfish bites
steps:
1. Rub fish with hot sauce , salt and pepper
2. Set aside for 1 hour or more
3. Cut fish into bite-size pieces and dip into eggs
4. Roll in cornmeal
5. Fry quickly in deep fat for 2 or 3 minutes , or until golden brown
6. Drain

title: friandisis
steps:
1. Beat together eggs , cream , salt and pepper
2. Melt butter in omelet pan over medium to med / high heat
3. Pour large kitchen spoon of beaten egg mixture into the pan and swirl to cover bottom completely
4. When cooked on the bottom , flip or cover with a lid to cook completely
5. Slide out of pan and roll up with ham slice
6. Repeat with remaining batter
7. Pack rolled crepes tightly into a 9x13 pan
8. Cover with grated cheese
9. Dot with butter and refrigerate
10. 1 / 2 hour before cooking , pour 1 cup of cream over all
11. Bake at 300 degrees until cheese starts to bubble
12. Brown cheese briefly under broiler
13. Serve

title: amish chicken corn soup
steps:
1. Simmer chicken in boiling water until tender
2. Remove bones and skin
3. Strain the stock
4. Return stock and chicken to pot
5. Add onions , celery , corn and parsley
6. Simmer till vegetables are tender
7. Mix flour with egg and milk
8. Rub mixture with fork till it crumbles
9. Drop crumbs in soup
10. Cook 10 more minutes covered

title: dot s special brownies
steps:
1. Grease a 9" round cake pan and preheat oven to 375f
2. Mix shortening , brown sugar , and egg together thoroughly
3. Stir in milk and mix well
4. Sift the flour , baking soda and salt together then stir into the batter
5. Add the chocolate chips and the oats and blend well
6. Spread the batter into the prepared pan and bake for 30 minutes
7. Five minutes before brownies are finished baking -- mix the glaze ingredients together in a saucepan and bring to a boil , stirring constantly until glaze is smooth
8. Take brownies out of the oven and pour glaze over the top immediately
9. Cool completely on a wire rack then cut into pie shaped wedges

title: tomato  cucumber   mozzarella salad
steps:
1. Combine 1st 5 ingredients and toss
2. Mix oil& vinegar , add seasoning and whisk thoroughly
3. Pour over salad
4. Drain& set aside dressing that runs off

title: pork verde soup
steps:
1. Saute pork and onion in a large skillet over medium high heat until onion is tender and pork is cooked through
2. Add salsa verde , chicken broth , beans and cumin and mix
3. Cover and simmer 15 minutes

title: drunken pinto beans
steps:
1. Combine beans and water in a large pot
2. Cover , bring to a simmer and cook over low heat 1 1 / 2-2 1 / 2 hours , until beans are tender
3. Add more warm water if needeed to prevent scorching
4. Remove from heat
5. Heat the olive oil in a large heavy saucepan or skillet over medium high heat
6. Saute the onions until lightly browned
7. Stir in tomatoes , chiles , celery , carrot and cilantro and cook for 1 minute
8. Add the cooked beans , salt and beer
9. Cook uncovered , over low heat , until the juices have thickened , about 30 minutes
10. Move the hot beans to a nice ceramic dish and serve
11. Enjoy !

title: classic waldorf salad
steps:
1. In medium bowl , combine mayonnaise , sugar , lemon juice and salt
2. Add apples and celery
3. Toss to coat
4. Cover and chill to blend flavors
5. Just before serving sprinkle with walnuts

title: stuffed lychee
steps:
1. Drain lychees
2. In small bowl of electric mixer , beat cream cheese with sherry and salt until mixture is smooth
3. Stir in remaining ingredients
4. Stuff lychees

title: raspberries and ricotta mousse
steps:
1. Mousse: in a food processor , mix ricotta and lemon juice until very creamy and homogeneous
2. In a bowl , whisk egg whites and tartar cream with a mixer until you have soft picks
3. Add sugar gradually while whisking until firm and straight picks , around 5 minutes
4. At low speed , incorporate the mixture of ricotta until all is homogeneous
5. Raspberry garnish: in a bowl , mix raspberries with jam
6. Distribute the mousse in 4 parfait glass or ramequin and add raspberry garnish
7. Put in the fridge
8. It's better if it's eaten the same day

title: simple cucumber salad
steps:
1. Cut strips off the peel , so that it is striped
2. Fancy ! pretty food is good food
3. Cut the cucumber lengthwise into fourths
4. Seed and slice into 1 inch lengths
5. Mix both vinegars
6. Add sugar and salt to taste
7. Pour over the cucumber
8. Mound the cucumber on a plate
9. Top with ginger

title: fast  easy apple cobbler
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350-degrees f
2. In a mixing bowl , whisk together the baking mix , the flour , baking powder , 2 tablespoons of the sugar , the beaten egg , the salt , the canola oil , the vanilla , and the milk
3. The batter will be pretty thin
4. Spray a 9" x 9" baking dish with the cooking spray and spread the apple pie filling in the bottom
5. Pour the batter over it and place into the preheated oven
6. After 25 minutes , remove the cobbler from the oven and sprinkle the remaining sugar and the cinnamon over the top
7. Return it to the oven right away and bake for 15-20 more minutes until it is light brown on top
8. You can test the top with a toothpick at the end of this time to see if it comes out clean
9. If so , it's done
10. If not , bake for a few more minutes

title: string green beans w ginger and garlic
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil
2. Fill a large bowl with ice water
3. Working in two batches , boil beans until just tender but still crisp and bright green
4. Start testing after 4 minutes or so , being careful not to overcook
5. When done , plunge beans into ice water to stop cooking , lift out immediately when cool and drain on towels
6. When ready to cook , heat 2 tablespoons oil in a wide skillet over high heat
7. Add half the beans , half the ginger and half the garlic , and cook , stirring and tossing constantly , until beans are heated through and ginger and garlic are softened and aromatic
8. Sprinkle with salt , and remove to a serving dish
9. Repeat with remaining oil , beans , ginger and garlic
10. Serve

title: creamy tortellini salad
steps:
1. Set a large pot of water on to boil according to package directions
2. Next , make the dressing , in a small bowl , using a wooden spoon , mix together the cream cheese , yogurt , dill , chives and garlic until smooth
3. Season with salt and pepper
4. Set the dressing aside
5. Next , add pasta to water when it is boiling and cook according to package directions
6. Meanwhile , shred the carrot set the shredded carrot aside
7. When pasta has about 3 minutes to go add the green beans to the pot
8. When the pasta has about 1 minute to go add the carrot to the pot
9. Drain and rinse the pasta and vegetables with cold water and drain well again
10. Dump the drained pasta and vegetables into a serving bowl
11. Add the dressing and the milk
12. Gently toss the salad with the wooden spoon until well blended
13. Season with salt and pepper
14. Serve warm or chilled

title: kecap manis  sweet soy sauce
steps:
1. Carmelize the sugar in saucepan over low heat , stirring frequently
2. When the sugar has melted , add the remaining ingredients
3. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly until the sugar has completely dissolved
4. Lower heat and cook for 10 minutes more
5. Removed from heat and allow to cool
6. Pour into a bottle and store in the fridge
7. This can be stored for several months
8. I do not strain it as the flavor improves with time

title: easy fried rice
steps:
1. Melt oleo in large non-stick skillet
2. Add onion , celery , and carrots
3. Saute until onions are transparent and carrots are crisp tender , about 5 minutes
4. Add peas and cook one minute more until peas are thawed
5. Push veggies to one side of skillet
6. Scramble eggs in empty side of skillet after the oleo spreads from veggies
7. Mix eggs into veggies and season with pepper
8. Then put in small amount of rice and then
9. Add soy sauce
10. Then slowly mix in rice by the spoonful until all rice is added and all ingredients are well blended
11. Fry until steamy hot stirring often

title: tangy green beans fit for a diabetic
steps:
1. Cook beans and red peppers in a steamer basket over water until crisp-tender
2. Whisk together all remaining ingredients in a small bowl
3. Transfer beans to a serving bowl
4. Add dressing and stir to coat

title: whole wheat parker house rolls
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix the yeast into the lukewarm water and allow to stand 5 minutes or until frothy
2. Add in the eggs and 1 / 4 cup of melted butter or oil
3. Beat in 2 cups of the roll mix
4. Let rest 2 minutes
5. Stir in enough of the remaining mix to make a soft dough
6. Turn out on a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth , 7 to 10 minutes
7. Clean and lightly grease the bowl , place dough in bowl , turning to grease all sides
8. Cover dough with a damp towel and let rise in a warm place , free from drafts , until doubled in bulk
9. Grease a large baking sheet
10. Set aside
11. Roll out dough to 1 / 2 inch thick , cut with a floured , round biscuit cuter
12. Dip both sides of dough into the melted 2 tablespoons butter
13. Fold in half , stretching slightly
14. Arrange on prepared baking sheet , not touching and let rise until double , 20 to 30 minutes
15. Preheat oven to 375 degrees and bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown
16. Variation for pan rolls: grease a 9-in round cake pan , punch down dough
17. Divide into 12 equal portions
18. Shape each into a smooth ball
19. Dip tops of each into the remaining melted butter
20. Arrange in prepared pan , dipped side up , not touching
21. Cover and let rise until doubled in bulk , 20 to 30 minutes
22. Bake as directed above

title: colorful chicken casserole
steps:
1. In a large skillet , saut green pepper , celery , and onion in butter until tender
2. Add broth , peas , corn , salt and pepper
3. Heat through
4. Stir in chicken and spaghetti
5. Divide between 2 greased 8 inch square baking pans
6. Top with the mushrooms and cheese
7. Cover and freeze one casserole for up to 3 months , if you only need to serve 4
8. Cover and bake the second casserole at 350 for 20 minutes
9. Uncover and bake for 10 minutes longer
10. To use frozen casserole , cover and bake at 350 for 35 minutes
11. Uncover and bake for 15 minutes longer

title: watermelon cantaloupe salad with mint basil vinaigrette
steps:
1. Scoop 2 cups each from the watermelon and the cantaloupe using a melon baller
2. Carve the remainder of the watermelon out and reserve shell
3. Add to a blender the chopped mint , chopped basil , lemon juice , simple syrup and amaretto
4. Blend until smooth
5. Add the watermelon and cantaloupe balls to the carved out watermelon half
6. Add the vinaigrette to the balls and toss to combine
7. Garnish with the mint and basil sprigs and taste

title: tossed avocado orange salad
steps:
1. Peel the avocado and cut into bite size pieces
2. Peel the orange , remove seeds , and cut into bite size pieces
3. Chop up the iceberg lettuce into bite size pieces
4. Blend the mayonnaise with the orange juice to thin
5. More orange juice may be added , if necessary
6. Put all ingredients into a salad bowl and toss until well blended

title: spiced peach bread
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients together by hand until moistened
2. Bake in a greased and floured bread pan at 350-375 for 60-70 minutes

title: simply elegant steak and rice
steps:
1. Cut steak into thin strips
2. In a large skillet , brown meat in oil , using high heat
3. Add onions
4. Saute until tender crisp
5. Blend soup , liquid from mushrooms and garlic salt
6. Pour over steak
7. Add mushrooms
8. Reduce heat , cover and simmer for one hour or until steak is tender
9. Serve over bed of fluffy rice

title: star shaped sugar biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to gas mark 4 / 350f / 180c
2. You will need a 10 cm / 4 inch star-shaped biscuit cutter
3. Prepare a baking tray lined with parchment paper
4. Sift the flour alongwith the sugar in a bowl and add in the butter and work with your finger
5. Add the beaten egg and a teaspoon of cold water and mix again until the mixture forms a ball leaving the sides of the bowl clean
6. On a lightly floured surface , roll out the dough to about 1 / 3 cm thickness
7. Cut out the biscuits using a 10 cm star-shaped cutter
8. If you would like to use it as a decoration , using a skewer , make a hole in each one to thread a wire after baking
9. Transfer the biscuits onto the baking tray and bake them in the middle shelf for 15-20 minutes
10. Remove them from the oven and cool them on the tray for 5 minutes before transferring onto a wire rack to let it cool
11. Meanwhile , make the icing sugar glaze by mixing the icing sugar with the cream till smooth
12. When the biscuits are cold enough to handle , brush the top of the biscuits with the glaze to give it a thin coat and leave it on the rack to dry completely
13. If using as a decoration , once completely cool and dried , thread a thin wire through the holes and hang them on the tree
14. If not , then store in an airtight container

title: super funghi mushroom risotto
steps:
1. Bring the stock and wine to a boil in a small sauce pan , reduce heat and keep at a simmer
2. Heat the oil and butter in a pan and add the leeks and cook for five minutes
3. Add the crimini mushrooms to the pan and cook until soft
4. Add the rice to the pan and give it a stir until it becomes translucent
5. Add one cup of the stock mixture to the pan and stir until all of the liquid is absorbed
6. Add the liquid 1 / 2 a cup at a time , each time stirring
7. Stir in the button mushrooms and the last 1 / 2 cup of liquid , stir until liquid is absorbed
8. Stir in the parmesan and parsley
9. Enjoy !

title: no fail sugar cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar
2. Add eggs and vanilla
3. Mix dry ingredients and add to butter mixture
4. Mix well
5. Chill for 1 to 2 hours or see hint below
6. Roll to desired thickness and cut into desired shapes
7. Bake on an ungreased baking sheet at 350 degrees for 8-10 minutes or until just beginning to turn brown around the edges
8. Hint: rolling out dough without the mess-rather than wait for the dough to chill , take freshly made dough and place a glob between two sheets of parchment paper
9. Roll it out to the desired thickness then place the dough with paper on a cookie sheet and pop it in the refrigerator
10. Continue rolling dough between paper until you have used it all
11. By the time you finish preparing the dough , the first batch will be chilled and ready to cut
12. Reroll left over dough and repeat the process
13. An added bonus is that you aren't adding any more flour to the cookies by rolling them out the old fashioned way

title: celery and peanut butter
steps:
1. Clean the celery and cut into 4-inch lengths
2. Spread peanut butter as to fill the "furrow" of the celery
3. Some people like the "crunchy" peanut butter
4. Serve to kids with an ice cold glass of 2% milk

title: mep s easy  tasty tilapia
steps:
1. Melt butter and add lemon juice to taste
2. Lay tilapia filets in a broiler-safe pan
3. Brush each side with butter / lemon mixture
4. Broil , turning often and basting with butter till fish begins to flake easily
5. On last round , add pepper and a sprinkling of old bay seasoning on each side
6. Eat
7. It's yummy and good for you !

title: provencal seasoning salt
steps:
1. Add salt to a coffee grinder , herb mill or small food processor
2. Process until the granules are of table salt size
3. Pour in the herbes de provence and process until the pieces are small enough to pass through a salt shaker
4. Again , time will vary
5. Store in a salt shaker or spice container with shaker top
6. Voila ! you've made your own special seasoning salt

title: dove s nest turkey  red grape   bleu cheese salad with honey
steps:
1. To make dressing , combine the oil , onion , wine vinegar , honey and tabasco sauce in a blender container
2. Process until smooth
3. Season with salt and pepper
4. To make salad , combine turkey , bleu cheese , pecans and grapes in a salad bowl and mix gently
5. Add the dressing , tossing to coat

title: navy bean soup in the crock pot
steps:
1. Place all of the ingredients in the crock pot
2. Add enough water to generously cover the beans
3. Cook on low for 8-10 hours or on high for 5-6
4. Remove ham hock
5. Discard fat and bones and return the meat to the soup

title: breakfast strata with spinach and mushroom
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 225 degrees
2. Arrange bread slices in a single layer on 2 large baking sheets and bake until dry and crisp , about 40 minutes , turning slices over halfway through drying time
3. When cooled , butter slices on one side using 4 tablespoons of butter
4. Set aside
5. Heat 3 1 / 2 tablespoons butter in large nonstick skillet over medium heat
6. Saut shallots and mushrooms until shallots become fragrant and translucent , about 3 minutes
7. Add spinach to skillet
8. Season with salt and pepper to taste and cook , stirring occasionally , until spinach and shallots are combined , about 3 minutes
9. Transfer to medium bowl
10. Set aside
11. Add wine to skillet , increase heat to medium-high , and simmer until reduced to 1 / 2 cup , 3 to 4 minutes
12. Set aside
13. Butter a 9x13-inch baking dish with remaining 1 1 / 2 tablespoons butter
14. Arrange half the buttered bread slices , buttered-side up , in single layer in dish
15. Spread half of spinach mixture , then lay half of the cheese evenly over bread slices
16. Arrange remaining bread slices in single layer over cheese
17. Spread remaining spinach mixture and the remaining cheese evenly over bread
18. Whisk eggs in medium bowl until combined
19. Whisk in reduced wine , half-and-half , 2 teaspoon salt , and pepper to taste
20. Pour egg mixture evenly over bread layers
21. Cover surface flush with plastic wrap , weigh down , and refrigerate at least 1 hour or up to overnight
22. Remove dish from refrigerator and let stand at room temperature 20 minutes
23. Meanwhile , adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 325 degrees
24. Uncover strata and bake until both edges and center are puffed and edges have pulled away slightly from sides of dish , 60 to 65 minutes
25. Cool on wire rack 5 minutes
26. Serve
27. To weigh down the assembled strata , two 1-pound boxes of brown or powdered sugar , laid side by side over the plastic-covered surface , make ideal weights
28. A gallon-sized zipper-lock bag filled with about 2 pounds of sugar or rice also works
29. This recipe halves easily
30. Use one 8x8-inch baking dish greased with only 1 tablespoon butter and reduce the baking time as directed in step 8
31. A word about substituting fat-free half-and-half: the second time i made this recipe , i used fat-free half-and-half
32. The strata was soggy , not like the original recipe , even though i baked it longer
33. I think the custard needed more fat from the half-and-half in order to set properly
34. If you try this with fresh spinach , cook it first , squeeze it dry , then use it in place of frozen

title: white cheddar corn chowder
steps:
1. Heat oil in a saucepan over medium heat
2. Add onion , and cook until softened , about 4 minutes
3. Add celery , and cook until tender , about 4 minutes
4. Add coriander , cumin , and cayenne
5. Raise heat to medium-high , and add wine
6. Cook until most of the liquid has evaporated , 2 to 3 minutes
7. Add potatoes , stock , and milk , and bring to a boil
8. Reduce heat , and simmer until potatoes are tender , about 15 minutes
9. Add corn , and cook until tender , 3 to 4 minutes
10. Remove from heat
11. Transfer 2 cups soup to a blender
12. Let cool slightly , then puree
13. Return puree to pan , and stir
14. Reheat if needed
15. Season with salt and pepper
16. Pour into bowls , and top with cheese
17. Chowder can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 3 days

title: baked egg in ham cups with parmesan and green onion
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Oil your ramekin
3. Place the ham inside of it , making a nice cup
4. Crack your egg into the center
5. Top with green onion and cheese
6. Salt and pepper to taste
7. Bake for 15-20 minutes
8. I prefer the yolk still runny -- less time
9. Pop onto your plate and serve

title: australian ground beef rarebit
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a deep skillet over medium heat
2. Add onions and peppers and saute 5 minutes
3. Add meat and cook until browned , stirring almost constantly
4. Add salt , cayenne and beer
5. Add cheese , stirring until melted
6. Serve over toasted english muffins

title: eggplant  aubergine  matzo lasagna
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Heat oil in saucepan over med-high heat
3. Add mushrooms , garlic and onions
4. Saut 7-8 minutes
5. Stir in parsley , wine , seasoning , peppers and pure
6. Partially cover , reduce heat to medium-low
7. Simmer 30 minutes
8. Remove from heat
9. Arrange the eggplant slices in a single layer on baking sheet coated with cooking spray
10. Bake for 30 minutes , turning the slices after 15 minutes
11. Remove from baking sheet , and let cool
12. Cut the eggplant slices into 1 / 2" pieces , and set aside
13. Combine 1 / 4 cup parmesan cheese and ricotta cheese
14. Stir well , and set aside
15. Spread 1 / 2 cup tomato mixture in the bottom of an 11x7" baking dish coated with cooking spray
16. Arrange 1-1 / 2 slices matzo over tomato mixture , and top matzo with half of ricotta cheese mixture , half of eggplant , and half of tomato mixture
17. Repeat the layers , ending with the tomato mixture
18. Sprinkle with remaining 2 tablespoons of parmesan cheese
19. Cover and bake for 45 minutes
20. Uncover and bake an additional 15 minutes
21. Let stand 5 minutes before serving

title: take out tabbouleh
steps:
1. Place the bulgur in a large bowl and pour enough warm water over to cover generously
2. Let it stand until the bulgur softens , about 15 minutes
3. Drain well , pressing down gently to extrude any excess liquid
4. In a large bowl , combine the parsley , mint , green onions , tomatoes , lemon juice , olive oil , cumin , salt & pepper
5. Add the bulgur and toss
6. Taste and reseason with salt and pepper if necessary
7. Make ahead: tabbouleh can be made up to 3 hours ahead and kept at room temperature

title: super moist ginger cake
steps:
1. Melt butter and golden syrup , set aside
2. Into a large bowl , sift flours , bi-carb of soda , ginger , cinnamon , mixed spice and sugar
3. Stir to combine
4. Add eggs and milk
5. Beat well
6. Add melted butter and syrup and mix well to combine
7. Grease and line 2 loaf tins
8. Divide mix evenly between the 2 tins
9. Bake in a moderate oven for about 50 mins or until top is golden brown and an inserted skewer comes out clean
10. Allow to cool in the tins for 10 mins before removing

title: yu hsiang eggplant
steps:
1. Cut eggplant in half then in about 2 inch chunks
2. Deep fry until golden
3. Deep fry tofu until golden
4. Stir fry green onions and garlic in sesame oil and oil
5. Add ground pork if you are using meat
6. Mix chili bean paste , soy sauce , sugar , salt , rice vinegar in a bowl
7. Add to veggies
8. Add eggplant and tofu
9. Stir
10. Add cornstarch mixed with water
11. Cook until thick

title: carrots in raspberry chambord sauce
steps:
1. Boil the carrots in water to cover with 1 tablespoon brown sugar and 1 tablespoon salt in a large pot until fork tender , about 10 minutes
2. Drain well
3. To prepare the sauce , drain the juice from the thawed raspberries into medium saucepan
4. Stir in cornstarch and heat over medium heat , stirring constantly , until the juice thickens
5. Stir in the chambord and gently fold in the raspberries
6. When ready to serve , reheat the carrots by sauteing in butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat for about 2 minutes
7. Sprinkle with remaining 1 / 4 cup brown sugar , remaining 1 teaspoon salt , white pepper and lemon zest
8. When finished cooking , mound the carrots attractively on a platter , leaving a border around the edge
9. Spoon the bright red raspberry sauce into the border around the carrot mound and serve hot

title: summer fruit coleslaw
steps:
1. In small mixing bowl , combine mayo with whipped topping , orange peel and sugar
2. Blend well
3. In large mixing bowl , combine slaw mix with orange segments , grapes , and sunflower seeds
4. Add mayo mixture and toss to coat
5. Stir well before serving

title: pineapple apricot cheese spread
steps:
1. In a sieve over a bowl , drain the pineapple , reserving 3 tablespoons of the juice
2. In a small saucepan , combine pineapple , reserved juice , dried apricots , chutney , apricot brandy & ginger , then bring to a boil , reduce the heat & simmer 5 to 7 minutes or until thick , stirring frequently
3. Place in a bowl & chill thoroughly
4. Put cheddar cheese , cream cheese & margarine in a food processor & process until smooth , scraping sides of the bowl occasionally
5. Combine cheese mixture & cooled pineapple mixture , then spoon into a serving bowl , cover & chill

title: brainy brownies
steps:
1. If using raw spinach , thoroughly wash it , even if the package says prewashed
2. Bring spinach or collards and water to boil in a medium pot
3. Turn heat to low and allow to simmer for 10 minutes
4. If using frozen blueberries , quickly rinse them under cold water to thaw a little , and then drain
5. Fill the bowl of your food processor with the blueberries and cooked spinach , along with the lemon juice and 2 tablespoons of water , and puree on high until as smooth as possible
6. Stop occasionally to push top contents to bottom
7. If necessary , add the rest of the water to make a fairly smooth puree
8. This amount of spinach and blueberries makes only about 1 cup of puree
9. Double the recipe if you want to store another cup of the puree
10. It will store in the refrigerator up to 2 days , or you can freeze 1 / 4 cup portions in sealed plastic bags or small plastic containers
11. Combine this purple egg mixture with the cooled chocolate mixture
12. Combine the flours and wheat germ in a bowl
13. This blend can be stored in a sealed , labeled plastic bag for months
14. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
15. Butter or spray only the bottom , not the sides , of a 13-by- 9-inch or 9-inch square baking pan
16. Melt the butter and chocolate chips together in a double boiler or metal bowl over simmering water
17. Remove from heat and allow mixture to cool a bit
18. Meanwhile , in another bowl , stir together the eggs , vanilla , sugar , and purple puree
19. In a mixing bowl , stir together flour blend , cocoa powder , oats , and salt
20. Add this to the chocolate mixture and blend thoroughly
21. Mix in the chopped walnuts , if using , then pour the entire mixture into the baking pan
22. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes , until a toothpick comes out clean
23. Allow to cool completely in pan before cutting the brownies and use a plastic or butter knife
24. Dust with powdered sugar , if desired
25. Keeps for a week in the refrigerator , covered tightly

title: ballymaloe apple cake
steps:
1. Filling- peel apples , and cut into 1 / 2 inch pieces
2. In bowl , toss with lemon juice
3. Add raisins , cinnamon , allspice , cloves and nutmeg
4. Stir well
5. Add honey and mix throughly
6. Set aside
7. In large bowl , sift together flour , baking powder
8. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse meal
9. Stir in sugar
10. Make well in center
11. Pour in egg and milk
12. Using fork , stir briskly to make a sticky dough
13. Divide in half
14. Roll out one half between 2 sheets of waxed paper to 1 / 4 inch thickness
15. Fit into lightly greased 9 inch pie plate
16. Spoon filling over dough
17. Place other half of rolled dough on top of filling
18. Press edges together
19. Using sharp knife , cut small slit in centre of pastry top to allow steam to escape
20. Bake in 350f oven for 45 minutes or until cake is golden brown and firm to touch and tester inserted in centre comes out clean
21. Cut into 8 wedges while hot
22. Serve warm and pass whipped cream and brown sugar separately

title: skillet beef   onion hamburger noodles
steps:
1. Brown hamburger in skillet , once browned drain excess grease
2. Add the 2 packets of the lipton beef & onion soup mix and the 2 1 / 2 cups of water to the hamburger in skillet
3. Season with mrs dash and garlic powder , then add the egg noodles , bring to a boil , then simmer for 10 minutes for the noodles to cook and thicken the sauce
4. Stir frequently to prevent sticking
5. Season with salt & pepper to taste

title: berry bliss cake
steps:
1. Add milk to dry pudding mix in medium bowl
2. Beat with wire whisk 2 minute or until well blended
3. Stir in 1 cup of the whipped topping
4. Cut cake horizontally into three layers
5. Brush with juice
6. Place bottom layer on serving plate
7. Top with 3 / 4 cup of the mixed berries , half of the pudding mixture and middle cake layer
8. Repeat layers of mixed berries and pudding mixture
9. Cover with top cake layer
10. Top with 1 / 2 cup whipped topping and all remaining berries
11. Cover loosely with foil
12. Refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight
13. Store any leftovers in refrigerator

title: pork chops with mushroom cream sauce   low carb
steps:
1. Combine herbs , salt , and pepper
2. Apply liberally to chops on both sides
3. Let sit on counter for 30 minutes
4. Heat olive oil in large cast-iron skillet until medium-hot
5. Set chops in the pan , and leave them alone
6. Otherwise , you will tear the herbs off
7. Cook each side until golden brown
8. Lower the heat if necessary
9. Approximately 4 minutes each side
10. Cover the pan with a tight fitting lid
11. Turn the heat off
12. Let sit for 10-12 minutes
13. If the chops are less than 1 inch thick , reduce time to 6-8 minutes
14. While chops are cooking , add olive oil to a small non-stick skillet and begin sauting mushrooms
15. Sprinkle with salt and pepper , and add the garlic
16. When mushrooms begin to wilt , add wine
17. You are not trying to cook the mushrooms completely , just start the process
18. Remove chops to serving platter , cover to keep warm
19. Add mushrooms and cooking liquid to the pan the chops were cooking in , turn heat to medium-high
20. Stir up any brown bits from the bottom of the pan
21. Allow mushrooms to finish cooking
22. Add heavy cream , and simmer until reduced by half
23. You may return chops to the pan to reheat , or pour sauce over chops
24. Serve with your favorite green vegetable , and enjoy !

title: filet mignon steaks with merlot sauce and wild mushrooms
steps:
1. To prepare the sauce , heat the oil in a saucepan
2. Add the garlic , onion , carrot , and celery , and saut over medium heat for about 7 or 8 minutes , until the onion is lightly browned
3. Stir in the tomato paste and cook for about 2 minutes
4. Deglaze the pan with the wine and then stir in the bay leaves , thyme , and peppercorns
5. Bring the sauce to a boil over medium-high heat and reduce by half
6. Add the stock and return to a boil
7. Lower the heat to a simmer and cook the sauce , stirring occasionally , for about 30 minutes , until reduced to about 2 cups of liquid
8. Strain through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean saucepan and keep warm
9. Season the steaks on both sides with salt and pepper
10. Heat the oil in a saut pan , add the steaks to the hot pan , and sear over medium-high heat for about 5 to 6 minutes per side for medium-rare or about 7 minutes per side for medium
11. Remove the steaks from the pan and keep warm
12. Add the shallots and mushrooms to the same pan and saut over medium-high heat for about 5 minutes , until lightly brown
13. Add the merlot sauce and bring to a simmer
14. Reduce the liquid by half and stir in the butter until thoroughly incorporated
15. Add the parsley just before serving
16. Place the steaks in the center of warm serving plates or shallow serving bowls and spoon the mushrooms and sauce over and around the filets
17. Serve immediately
18. Serve with garlic mashed potatoes

title: broccoli cheese soup   20 minute fast and low fat
steps:
1. Place broccoli and 3 / 4 cup water in microwave safe dish , microwave broccoli until fork tender
2. Meanwhile in sauce pan , saute shallots until clear
3. When clear , add flour to pan and stir until flour cooked add broth and 1 / 2 cup of broccoli water and 1 / 4 of broccoli spears
4. Mash entire mixture with a potato masher
5. Bring to a rapid boil
6. Boil for about 3-5 minutes
7. Decrease heat , add rest of broccoli spears , half and half and cheese
8. Stir until cheese melts
9. Season to taste with salt and pepper and enjoy

title: orange and mozzarella towers with orange balsamic vinaigrette
steps:
1. To make each portion:
2. Place 3 baby lettuce leaves on each of 4 salad plates
3. On each plate , place 1 mozzarella slice on lettuce , top with 1 orange slice and 1 basil leaf
4. Repeat process with a second mozzarella slice , second orange slice and second basil leaf
5. Finish with a third mozzarella slice , orange slice and basil leaf
6. Drizzle with 1 tablespoon orange balsamic vinaigrette , sprinkle with fresh black pepper to taste and 1 / 2 teaspoon fresh orange zest
7. Orange balsamic vinaigrette:
8. Combine orange juice and balsamic vinegar and whisk to blend
9. Continue whisking and slowly add olive oil into mixture until smooth
10. Season with salt and pepper
11. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve

title: chilli chicken stir fry
steps:
1. Slice the chicken into thin bite-size strips
2. In a bowl , mix soy sauce , oyster sauce , five-spice powder and black pepper and add in the chicken strips and give it all a good mix till the chicken pieces are coated evenly
3. Leave to marinate for atleast 30 minutes
4. Heat a wok over high heat , and when hot , add the oil
5. Stir-fry the garlic and ginger for about 30 seconds before adding the chicken and its marinade and cook for about 6-8 minutes or so stirring constantly
6. Add the vegetables and chillies to the wok , and fry briskly for a minute
7. Pour in the hot chicken stock and add the dark soy sauce and give it a good stir
8. Mix cornflour in hot water till dissolved and pour into the wok
9. Stir until the sauce is thickened , season to taste , and serve straight away

title: easiest penne with vodka
steps:
1. Heat butter in large skillet over medium-low heat
2. Stir in vodka , seasoned or crushed red pepper , and cayenne
3. Heat gently for two minutes
4. Carefully add tomatoes and salt
5. Increase heat to high and cook until mixture thickens , about 5 minutes
6. Lower heat , and stir in heavy cream and parmesan cheese
7. Add the penne , and toss with sauce

title: pantzarosalata   pureed beet salad
steps:
1. Cover the beets well with water and boil till tender for about 40 minutes
2. Drain and chop coarsely
3. In a food processor , combine all the ingredients and blend till soft
4. Pureed beet salad is ready
5. Serve with pita wedges

title: white chocolate frosting recipe
steps:
1. Melt the chocolate in a double boiler
2. Let cool a bit
3. Put it in a bowl with cream cheese and butter
4. Beat it till smooth and blended
5. It should be nice and thick now
6. The taste is very good

title: garlic ranch shrimp fettuccine
steps:
1. Heat 2or 3 tblsp good extra vigin olive oil in a large non stick pan
2. Saute shallot and garlic till slightly golden
3. Add mushrooms and saute till they start to wilt
4. Add shrimp and cook till nice and pink
5. Deglaze pan with wine and let reduce
6. Add oregano , basil and cream , reduce heat and let simmer about 10 min or till it starts to thicken
7. Stir in veggie dip , parmesan cheese and paprika and let heat through
8. Remove from heat and stir in parsley
9. Serve over noodles with some good garlic bread and fresh ground black pepper

title: juicy fruit pie
steps:
1. Combine fruit in a medium bowl , then transfer 2 cups of the fruit mixture to a smaller bowl & mash with a fork
2. Set aside
3. In a medium saucepan , mix together the cornstarch & apple juice until cornstarch is completely dissolved
4. Add mashed fruit & cook over medium heat about 7-10 minutes , until mixture is thickened
5. Stir in lemon juice & remaining fruit
6. Pour fruit mixture into pie crust & chill at least 4 hours , until set
7. Serve with vanilla yogurt or frozen yogurt

title: inside out chocolate bundt cake
steps:
1. Cake
2. Combine pudding mix , cake mix , chips , chips , milk and eggs
3. Mix by hand until well-blended--about 2 minutes
4. Pour into a greased and floured bundt pan
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 50 to 55 minutes , or until cake springs back when lightly pressed with finger
6. Cool 15 minutes in pan , then remove
7. Continue cooling
8. Frosting
9. Melt margarine in medium saucepan
10. Remove from heat
11. Stir in sugar and chocolate
12. Add vanilla
13. Stir enough hot water to make desired consistency
14. Drizzle over cake

title: fruit filled muffins  light
steps:
1. Coat twelve muffin cups with nonstick cooking spray or line with paper bake cups
2. Set aside
3. In a medium bowl , stir together flour , sugar , baking powder , cinnamon , baking soda and salt
4. Make a well in the center of the flour mixture
5. Set aside
6. In a small bowl , stir together buttermilk , egg and oil
7. Add buttermilk mixture all at once to flour mixture
8. Stir just until moistened
9. Spoon batter into prepared muffin cups , filling each about one-fourth full
10. Place 1 teaspoon of the spreadable fruit in center of each
11. Add remaining batter
12. Bake in 400f oven for 18 to 20 minutes or until golden
13. Cool in muffin cups on a wire rack for 5 minutes
14. Remove from muffin cups
15. Serve warm

title: fat cat spicy sauce
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a heavy bottomed pot
2. Bring to a low boil and then let the sauce cook for about 10 minutes
3. Turn off the heat and serve or chill
4. This sauce keeps about a year refrigerated

title: bo s breakfast casserole
steps:
1. Spray a 2 quart size baking dish with non stick spray
2. Arange potatoe's evenly in the bottom of the dish
3. Sprinkle with cheese and green onion and a little salt and pepper
4. In a bowl combine eggs , milk , your choice of meat salt and pepper
5. Pour over potato mixture
6. Bake , uncovered , in a 350 oven 40-45 minutes or until knife comes out clean
7. Let stand about 5 minutes before serving
8. I have also doubled this for a larger crowd that serves about 12
9. Just bake in a 3qt and bake for about 45-55 minute

title: make your own fresh lemonade concentrate syrup
steps:
1. In saucepan , bring sugar and water to a boil
2. Cook just until sugar dissolves
3. Remove from heat and cool
4. Stir in lemon juice
5. Store in refrigerator in covered container until ready to use
6. To make lemonade by the pitcher: combine full recipe with 5 cups of cold water
7. Add ice and stir
8. Garnish with lemon slices and fresh mint
9. To make lemonade by the glass: combine 1 / 3 cup of concentrate with 1 / 4 cup of cold water
10. Stir and add lots of ice
11. Garnish with fresh lemon wedge

title: sausage stuffed acorn squash
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Cut squash in halves , remove seeds , place cut side down in 13 x 9 baking dish filled with 1 inch or so of water , bake until squash is tender , about 40 minutes
3. The squash can also be microwaved until tender , approx 15 minutes
4. While squash is baking , crumble sausage along with onions , celery , and mushrooms and fry until sausage is browned
5. Drain fat
6. Mix together egg , sour cream and parmesan cheese , stir together with sausage mixture
7. Scoop mixture into acorn halves , place back in oven , bake 20 minutes

title: coconut milk ice cream
steps:
1. Shake can of coconut milk to mix well
2. Pour into large chilled bowl or pitcher
3. Stir in cream , sugar and coconut rum until sugar is dissolved
4. Pour into ice cream maker and freeze according to manufacturers directions
5. Spoon into container , cover well and place in freezer to harden off
6. If desired , stir in flaked or toasted , flaked coconut before placing in freezer to harden

title: ranch chicken sliders  rsc
steps:
1. Heat an outdoor grill or griddle pan to medium high
2. Place a skillet over medium-high heat
3. Add a drizzle of olive oil and the bacon to the pan and cook until crisp , about 5 minutes
4. Drain on paper towels to cool , then dice
5. While the bacon cooks , place the chicken in a large bowl
6. Grate the shallots on top of the chicken
7. Add the hot sauce , poultry seasoning , salt and lots of pepper
8. Stir in the cooked bacon , mix and form 8 slider patties , about 2- 1 / 2 to 3 inches wide
9. Drizzle with olive oil to coat lightly
10. Cook on the grill or griddle , turning once , until cooked through , 8 to 10 minutes
11. While the sliders cook , heat the broiler
12. Place the avocado in a food processor
13. Add the yogurt , lemon juice , ranch seasoning mix and process into a smooth , thick sauce
14. Butter the buns and place on a baking sheet and toast under the broiler
15. Serve the ranch slider with the lettuce , tomatoes and avocado-ranch sauce between the toasted buns

title: omega 3 casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f
2. In a large bowl , flake apart the salmon and remove any large bones
3. Mix in the flax meal , walnuts , lemon juice , jalapenos , celery , onion , cardamom , and lawry's
4. In a little bowl , beat your egg then mix in mayonnaise and dijon mustard
5. Add mayo mix to the salmon mix and blend well
6. Pour the salmon mix into a lightly greased 8x11 glass baking dish
7. In a medium bowl
8. Mix the breadcrumbs , cheese , paprika , and melted butter then sprinkle over the salmon
9. Bake , uncovered , for 40 minutes or until heated through

title: pumpkin praline cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees
2. Place gingersnaps in bowl of food processor fitted with metal blade and pulse until coarsely ground
3. In a small saucepan over medium heat , saute pecans in butter until toasted and golden brown
4. Add pecans and butter to food processor
5. Add 1 / 4 cup of the brown sugar to the food processor and pulse a few times to blend ingredients
6. Press mixture into the bottom of a 10-inch springform pan and refrigerate while preparing the filling
7. Place the cream cheese , 1 / 2 cup brown sugar and white sugar in a large bowl and beat until smooth
8. Add pumpkin , spices and vanilla to bowl and mix to combine
9. Add eggs , one at a time , beating after each addition until incorporated
10. Pour into prepared crust and bake 1 hour and 30 minutes
11. Remove from oven and let cool at room temperature
12. Praline pecans 2 tablespoons butter 2 tablespoons brown sugar 2 teaspoons cream or half and half 2 cups pecan halves melt butter in a medium-sized skillet over medium heat
13. Add brown sugar and cream and bring to a boil
14. Add pecans , stirring well until well coated in butter mixture
15. Spread on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper to cool
16. Use to garnish praline pumpkin cheesecake

title: strawberry romaine salad with creamy poppy seed dressing
steps:
1. For the salad: wash heads of lettuce and let drain extremely well
2. Wash and slice strawberries
3. Tear lettuce into pieces , add strawberries and onions
4. For the dressing:put all of the ingredients in a container with a lid
5. Whisk quickly , place the lid on and shake well
6. Just before serving , pour the dressing over the salad and toss well

title: oven ranch chicken
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f prepare baking dish
2. In a shallow bowl , combine bread crumbs and salad dressing mix
3. Mix well
4. Place sour cream in another shallow dish
5. Dip chicken in sour cream , coating well
6. Roll coated chicken in bread crumb mixture
7. Place chicken in baking dish
8. Discard any remaining bread crumb mixture and sour cream
9. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until chicken is tender and juices run clear

title: nutty chicken fingers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. In a shallow dish combine cornflake crumbs , pecans , parsley , garlic powder and optional salt
3. Dip chicken strips in milk , then roll in crumb mixture
4. Place in a 15x10x1-inch baking pan
5. Bake for 7-9 minutes or until chicken is tender and no longer pink
6. If desired , serve with ranch-style dressing

title: maple mustard salmon
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingredients in a large zip-top bag
2. Add salmon
3. Seal and marinate in refrigerator 20 minutes
4. Prepare grill or broiler
5. Remove salmon from bag , reserve marinade
6. Place salmon on grill rack or broiler pan coated with cooking spray and cook for 5 minutes on each side or until salmon flakes easily when tested , baste occasionally with the reserved marinade

title: macadamia maple granola
steps:
1. Preheat oven at 350 and coat a cookie sheet with cooking spray or line with parchment paper
2. Combine butter and syrup in saucepan over medium heat until butter is melted , but not boiling
3. Remove from heat
4. Combine oats , salt , orange zest and nuts in small bowl
5. Pour in the maple-butter mixture and stir well , coating the oats evenly
6. Spread thinly on the baking sheet and pop in the oven for about 12 minutes , stirring once or twice as it bakes
7. Remove after 12 minutes , stir again , and let it sit and cool
8. Store in an airtight container once cooled
9. The granola keeps well at room temperature

title: rich n  creamy hot chocolate
steps:
1. In 3 quart saucepan melt chocolate chips over low heat , stirring constantly
2. Stir in sugar , water and salt
3. Cook over med
4. Heat , stirring constantly with wire whisk , until mixture comes to a full boil
5. Boil , stirring constantly , 2 minute
6. Stir in milk and whipping cream
7. Continue cooking over med
8. Heat , stirring occasionally , until heated through
9. Do not boil
10. Add vanilla
11. B
12. Eat with wire whisk or rotary beater until frothy
13. Pour into mugs

title: dunkley s famous macaroni salad
steps:
1. Bring 2 quarts of water to a boil
2. Add macaroni and cook until it is al dente , approximately 7-9 minutes
3. Do not overcook the pasta or it will fall apart when the salad is tossed together
4. Rinse macaroni until cool
5. Drain well and let it dry out slightly
6. Place pasta in a large bowl
7. Carefully fold in celery , onion , cheddar , swiss cheese , parmesan , dill pickles , salami , and black olives
8. Refrigerate the mixture , covered , overnight
9. Mix the garlic salt , minced garlic , white pepper , black pepper , cayenne pepper , dry mustard and celery salt together
10. Add to the salad
11. Fold in pimentos
12. Mix 1 cup of mayonnaise and horseradish
13. Fold into the salad
14. Refrigerate for another 30 minutes to 1 hour before serving

title: caramel chocolate peanut butter pretzel bites  like take 5
steps:
1. Line two baking sheets with waxed paper
2. Arrange pretzels on baking sheets in rows
3. Put a teaspoon of peanut butter on each pretzel
4. Melt caramels with butter in saucepan over med
5. Heat until melted
6. Put 1 / 2 - 1 tsp of caramel on each pretzel
7. Put in fridge one hour or until hardened
8. Melt chocolate according to package directions
9. Dip each pretzel into chocolate and return to waxed sheets
10. Refridgerate an additional hour
11. Serve

title: herby hamburgers
steps:
1. Mix the ground beef , egg , herbs , salt and freshly ground black pepper and soy sauce together in a large bowl
2. Saut the onion in the butter until golden
3. Stir into the ground beef mixture
4. Add enough breadcrumbs to hold the mix together
5. Shape into flattened patties and broil or barbecue until cooked through
6. Serve on a seeded bun with crisp lettuce , fresh tomato and mayonnaise
7. Enjoy !

title: indian curry with potatoes  chicken  and eggplant
steps:
1. Cut all of the vegetables and the chicken accordingly
2. Put all ingredients into a large pot
3. Cook over high heat for approximately 10 minutes
4. Turn heat to low and let slow cook for approximately 7 hours
5. Serve with hot basmati rice or naan / chapatis / roti

title: strawberry rhubarb irish crumble with irish whiskey butter
steps:
1. Irish whiskey butter: place 1 / 2 cup of room temperature unsalted butter in a mixing bowl and whip until fluffy
2. With mixer running , gradually add 3 / 4 cup powdered sugar
3. Slowly add 1 / 4 cup irish whiskey until combined
4. Mixture may look separate and curdled at first , but if you keep whipping , it will come together
5. Use at room temperature or chilled
6. Preheat oven to 365 degrees
7. Lightly grease 11x7" baking dish and set aside
8. In a medium bowl , combine strawberries , rhubarb , sugar , cornstarch , and lemon juice
9. Toss to coat
10. Pour strawberry mixture into prepared baking dish
11. In a medium bowl , add the flour , oats , light brown sugar , and salt , stirring to combine
12. Add the diced butter to the flour mixture , and using your fingers , work the mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs
13. Pour crumb mixture evenly over top of strawberry mixture
14. Place baking dish in the oven and bake for 40 minutes , or until filling is bubbly and topping is golden brown
15. Serve warm with spoonful of irish whiskey butter

title: cranberry pecan muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Combine flours , cranberries , pecans , sugar , baking powder and salt in large bowl
3. Melt butter in small bowl
4. Stir in egg and milk
5. Add wet ingredients to large bowl and stir just until moistened
6. Pour into 12 greased or paper-lined muffin cups
7. Bake for 16-18 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
8. Cool on a wire rack

title: baked chicken poupon
steps:
1. Mix mustard , oil garlic powder and italian seasoning in a plastic bag or large bowl
2. Add chicken breasts , mixing well to coat
3. Bake 375 for 20 minutes

title: turkey hash quesadillas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 500
2. Simmer potatoes in a pot of boiling salted water until barely tender
3. Drain and set aside
4. In a heavy skillet , cook the bacon and onion in 1 / 2 tablespoon oil over medium heat , stirring , for 5 minutes
5. Add the potatoes and cook , stirring , until crisp and golden
6. Cool slightly , and stir in turkey , cheese and parsley
7. Put 2 tortillas on a baking sheet and brush with some of the remaining olive oil
8. Turn tortillas over and top each with half the turkey hash , spreading out evenly
9. Cover with remaining 2 tortillas and brush tops with remaining oil
10. Bake in a preheated 500 oven until golden , about 8-10 minutes
11. To serve , cut into wedges and top with cranberry sauce

title: original pantry cafe coleslaw
steps:
1. Blend together mayonnaise , sugar , vinegar , and oil
2. Add garlic and onion powders , mustard , celery salt , pepper , lemon juice , half-and-half , and salt
3. Stir until smooth
4. Pour dressing over cabbage in large bowl and toss until cabbage is well coated

title: guilt free chocolate pudding cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Spray a 9 inch square pan with nonstick spray
3. Combine the flour , granulated sugar 1 / 3 cup of cocoa , baking powder , instant coffee powder , baking soda and salt in a large bowl
4. Make a well in the center and pour in milk , melted butter and vanilla
5. Stir just until blended
6. Pour the batter evenly into prepared pan
7. Mix brown sugar and the 1 / 4 cup cocoa in a small bowl
8. Sprinkle evenly over the batter
9. Gently pour the boiling water over the top in a zig zag pattern
10. Do not stir
11. Bake until the top of the pudding is set
12. About 35 minutes
13. Cool on a rack at least 30 minutes before serving
14. Cut into squares and serve warm or at room temperature

title: grapefruit vinaigrette
steps:
1. To make the vinaigrette , place all the ingredients in a jar
2. Cover and shake well
3. Refrigerate until needed

title: chocolate single serve cake  eggless  microwave
steps:
1. Mix bilk , butter , and sugar in a small microwave safe bowl
2. Add flour , cocoa and baking soda to the bowl
3. Mix so that there are no lumps
4. Microwave on high for 1 - 1:30 minutes
5. The cake will spring back on touch when done
6. Let stand for couple of seconds
7. Serve with chocolate sauce or just plain ice-cream
8. Enjoy

title: baked ham
steps:
1. Unwrap ham and place in roasting pan with lid
2. Place your pineapple rings on top , securing with toothpicks
3. Pour the can of coke over top of the ham , cover and bake approximately 4
4. 5 hours or until internal temp reaches 140f
5. Remove from oven and let rest at least 15 minutes
6. Slice and serve

title: banana caramel cake
steps:
1. Prepare the cake:
2. Preheat oven to 350f
3. Using a small brush , lightly coat two 9-inch cake pans with softened butter or vegetable-oil cooking spray
4. Dust with flour , tap out any excess , and set aside
5. Over a surface covered with a large sheet of waxed or parchment paper , sift the flour , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
6. Into a medium bowl , resift the flour mixture and set aside
7. In a large bowl , using a mixer set on medium-high speed , beat the butter until light -- about 1 minute
8. Add the sugar and continue to beat for 2 more minutes
9. Add the eggs , one at a time , beating thoroughly after each addition , and mix in the vanilla
