10. Reduce mixer speed to low and add the flour mixture by thirds , alternating with the buttermilk and bananas and ending with the dry ingredients
11. Mix just enough to blend the batter after each addition
12. Bake the cake:
13. Divide the batter equally between the pans and bake on the middle rack of the oven until a tester inserted into each cake layer comes out clean -- 25 to 30 minutes
14. Cool in the cake pans on a wire rack for 15 minutes
15. Using a knife , loosen the cake layers from the pan sides and invert the layers onto the wire rack to cool completely
16. Prepare the icing:
17. In a medium saucepan with a candy thermometer attached , stir sugar , heavy cream , and lemon juice together
18. Cook the mixture , without stirring , over medium-high heat to soft-ball stage
19. Remove from heat and cool the caramel mixture to 140 f
20. Place the butter on top of the cooled caramel mixture
21. Remove the thermometer and , using a handheld mixer set on medium-high speed , beat the caramel until it thickens enough to hold its shape , lightens in color , and changes from translucent to opaque -- about 5 minutes
22. Ice the cake:
23. Use a serrated knife to trim the mounded side of the cake layers , if necessary
24. Line the edges of a cake plate with 3-inch-wide strips of waxed or parchment paper and place a cake layer , trimmed side down , on top
25. Place 1 cup caramel icing on top of the layer and spread evenly
26. Place the second layer , trimmed side down , on the first and cover the top and sides with the remaining icing
27. Apply icing immediately
28. Enjoy !

title: new zealand pasties
steps:
1. Sift together flour and salt
2. Cut in crisco and butter until a sandy texture is reached
3. Make a hollow in the middle and add water
4. Mix to make pastry , handling as little and lightly as possible
5. Wrap in greeseproof paper and refrigerate for 24 hours
6. Roll out pastry to approx 1 / 8" thick , and cut into 5" rounds
7. Moisten the filling with a little water and place a generous spoonful in the middle of each round , making sure it's in a pile and not flattened out
8. Moisten edges with beaten egg , fold in half and flute the edges to seal
9. Brush pasties with beaten egg and bake 275f for 45 minutes to 1 hour until nicely browned

title: spinach and strawberry salad with feta cheese and balsamic vinai
steps:
1. Whisk vinegar and olive oil in small bowl
2. Add basil and season with salt and pepper
3. Combine spinach or romaine and strawberries in large bowl
4. Add vinaigrette
5. Gently toss to evenly coat
6. Divide salad among 4 plates
7. Sprinkle each salad with cheese and pine nuts

title: tuna casserole renaissance of
steps:
1. While pasta cooks to al dente , heat in a deep skillet over medium heat with evoo
2. Saut garlic and onions until tender , 4-5 minutes
3. Add tuna and sun-dried tomatoes and stir to heat through , another 1-2 minutes
4. Add wine and cook down a minute then add cream and season sauce with salt & pepper
5. Toss hot pasta and peas with sauce and cheese
6. Top with shredded basil

title: t j  cinnamon s cinnamon rolls
steps:
1. For dough , dissolve yeast in water with 1 / 2 tsp sugar , let stand 5 minutes
2. In mixing bowl combine , 3 cups flour , 1 / 3 cups sugar and salt
3. At low speed gradually beat in milk , oil , eggs and yeast mixture
4. Beat until well blended
5. Beat in additional flour , about 1 1 / 2 cups until dough pulls away from sides of bowl
6. On floured surface , knead dough until smooth and elastic 8-10 minutes
7. Place in greased bowl , turning to grease top
8. Cover and let rise in a warm draft free place until doubled in bulk , about 1 hour
9. For filling , combine all ingredients till smooth , set aside
10. Grease 2 round cake pans
11. Punch down dough and place on lightly floured surface
12. Roll dough into an 18 x 10 inch rectangle
13. Spread filling all over
14. Roll tightly from long side
15. Cut into 14 slices
16. Place 1 roll cut side up in center of each pan and arrange remaining rolls in a circle of 6 around each center roll , cover and let rise doubled in bulk , 30-40 minutes
17. Preheat oven to 350 degrees and bake 22-27 minutes , until golden brown
18. Cool in pans 10 minutes and invert to wire racks , invert again to cool
19. For icing , whisk all ingredients till smooth drizzle over cooled rolls

title: nutella frosted cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f line 12 muffin tins with paper liners
2. Cream together butter and sugar until light and fluffy , about 2 minutes
3. Add in eggs one at a time , until fully incorporated
4. Dont worry if the batter doesnt look smooth
5. Add vanilla
6. Stir in flour , salt and baking powder until batter is uniform and no flour remains
7. Using an ice cream scoop or spoon , fill each muffin liner with batter
8. They should be 3 / 4 full , if youre not using a scoop
9. Top each cake with 1 heaping teaspoon of nutella
10. Swirl nutella in with a toothpick , making sure to fold a bit of batter up over the nutella
11. Bake for 20 minutes or until a cake tester comes out clean
12. Remove to a wire rack to cool completely

title: joe s killer pancakes
steps:
1. Mix flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda and salt
2. Set aside
3. In a separate bowl mix egg , buttermilk and oil
4. Pour egg mixture in to flour mix
5. Stir until just blended but still lumpy
6. Cook till golden brown on a hot griddle

title: holiday brie en croute
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Line a 15-1 / 2x10-1 / 2-inch jelly-roll pan with parchment paper
3. Combine cranberries , brandy , lemon peel , and salt
4. Cut puff pastry sheet into a 6x9-inch rectangle
5. Roll out into a 14-inch square
6. Place wheel of brie in center
7. Cut off top rind of brie and discard
8. Top with cranberry mixture
9. Gather pastry around brie
10. Twist in center
11. Secure twist with kitchen string
12. Trim excess dough
13. Place on jelly-roll pan and bake for 25 minutes or until golden brown

title: beef pot roast  crock pot style
steps:
1. Rub both sides of the chuck roast with flour
2. Spray the insides of the crock with non-stick cooking spray
3. Place the roast in the crock and press it down firmly so it rests snugly on the bottom
4. In a separate bowl mix v-8 juice and the mccormick seasoning until seasoning is dissolved
5. Add frozen stew vegetables to the slow cooker
6. Pour the vegetable juice / seasoning mixture over the roast
7. The liquid should just cover the contents of the pot
8. If it doesn't add a little water or vegetable juice
9. Cover and cook on low heat setting for 8 hours , or on high heat setting for 5 hours
10. Turn off , allow to cool in the crock for up to half an hour
11. Serve with corn bread , buttered toast , or rolls

title: lumpia   lumpias
steps:
1. Begin thawing the frozen spring roll wrappers 30 minutes before using
2. When thawed , cover the stack with a moist towel so they don't dry out
3. I keep a spray bottle of pure water on hand to spritz it periodically
4. Spring rolls are very fragile , so handle carefully
5. Combine meat , carrot , onion , water chestnuts and cabbage in a large bowl and mix well
6. Add soy sauce , pepper and garlic , and mix thoroughly again
7. Over medium heat , cook this mixture , breaking up meat as it browns , for about 10-12 minutes or until cooked through
8. Drain
9. Gently peel one wrapper from the stack and place it on a flat surface with one of the corners pointing toward you
10. Place a loosely-packed 1 / 4 cup of the meat filling in a horizontal line across the wrapper leaving about 2 inches of wrapper on the left and right ends of the filling
11. Roll the corner nearest you up over the filling , very gently tucking the
12. Roll as tightly as possible about halfway up
13. Then tuck in the left and right corners and continue rolling the lumpia as tightly as possible , but gently , away from you until it's a complete cylinder
14. Moisten the last corner furthest from you to seal the wrapper , and then place it on a plate until cooking
15. You can also just dip your fingers in water and seal that way as well
16. Continue rolling all lumpias in this fashion until the meat mixture is finished
17. Heat oil to about 350f
18. Turning once halfway through cooking , fry no more than 3 lumpia at a time , or the temperature change will be too drastic to cook them properly
19. Too low and they'll become too greasy
20. Too high and they'll burn
21. As demonstrated rather skillfully in my photographs
22. Lol
23. Total fry time is entirely dependent on the color you want your lumpias to have
24. Since the filling is actually already cooked , you don't need to worry about under-cooking ! it's almost idiot-proof , unless you're me and believe , despite all evidence to the contrary , that you can multitask
25. <insert eye roll here> i like a medium-dark golden color which was achieved after about 2 minutes per side
26. Drain on paper towels and serve with dipping sauce

title: crab and cream cheese bake
steps:
1. Combine the cream cheese , green onions and dill in a bowl and mix well
2. Unroll the crescent roll dough on a greased baking sheet
3. Do not separate the triangles
4. Press the dough into an 8 x 11-inch rectangle
5. Spoon the crab meat lengthwise down the center of the rectangle
6. Spread the cream cheese mixture over the crab meat
7. Fold the long edges of the rectangle over the cream cheese mixture , slightly overlapping
8. Pinch the edges to seal
9. Arrange seam side down on the baking sheet
10. Brush the top lightly with the egg yolk and cut slits
11. Bake at 350 degrees f for 20 to 22 minutes or until golden brown and flaky
12. Cut into 12 slices
13. Serve warm

title: wild rice bread
steps:
1. In a saucepan boil rice in 4 cups water and cook until rice is tender
2. Drain and cool
3. Dissolve yeast in 1 / 2 cup of lukewarm water and 1 teaspoon sugar
4. Add enough flour to make a thin paste
5. Set in a warm place for about 10-15 minutes
6. In a large bowl mix: 4 cups warm water
7. 1 / 4 cup sugar , molasses , shortening , salt , natural bran , sunflower seeds
8. Add yeast mixture , the cooled rice , sunny boy cereal and rolled oats
9. Add approximately 10 cups white flour , or sufficient to make bread dough and knead the dough well
10. Let rise until double in size
11. Punch down and form into loaves and again let rise until double in size
12. Bake in 375degreef for 25-30 minutes or until bread is done
13. Check by tapping on the base of the loaf with knuckles
14. If bread sounds hollow it will be done
15. Recipe should make about 4-6 loaves depending on size and shape
16. Prep time includes cooking and standing time , approx

title: stuffing in puff pastry
steps:
1. Thaw puff pastry at room temperature for 30 minutes
2. Heat oven to 375f
3. Mix one egg with 1 tablespoon water
4. Set aside
5. Mix together sausage , stuffing , remaining egg , onion , and mushrooms
6. Unfold puff pastry onto a lightly floured baking sheet , creating 3 sections
7. Do not separate the sections
8. Cut 9 strips in the two outer sections , about 1 inch apart , cutting just to the fold line in the pastry
9. These strips will be criss-crossed over the stuffing
10. Spoon sausage mixture in the center of the pastry
11. Starting at one end , fold the pastry strips over the sausage mixture , alternating sides
12. Brush with egg mixture
13. Bake 35 minutes or until golden
14. Slice and serve warm

title: leftover spaghetti pie
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Place spaghetti , velveeta , chicken , sauce , oregano , basil , garlic powder and sugar in resealable plastic bag
3. Seal
4. Shake and press until combined
5. Press mixture into 9-inch pie plate sprayed with cooking spray
6. Sprinkle with parmesan and asiago
7. Bake 15-20 minutes or until heated through
8. Let stand 5 minutes

title: real deal sloppy joes   remember these  so good
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat
2. Add the onion and saut , stirring frequently , until softened and translucent , about 3 minutes
3. Add the ground beef to the skillet , breaking it up well with a spoon , and cook until the meat has lost its raw color , about 10 minutes , stirring frequently to break up any clumps
4. Pour off and discard any juices and fat that have accumulated in the skillet
5. Add 2 cups ketchup , the chili powder , garlic powder , pepper flakes , and salt and stir well to mix
6. Cook , uncovered , until the meat is cooked through and the flavors are blended , about 20 minutes , stirring frequently
7. The mixture should be loose , with enough sauce to bind the meat
8. If it gets too dry , add more ketchup or a bit of water and cover the skillet during the last 5 minutes of cooking
9. Stir in a splash of vinegar , then remove the skillet from the heat
10. Taste and adjust the seasoning , then spoon onto hamburger buns and serve

title: raspberry gelatin ring
steps:
1. In a bowl , dissolve gelatin in boiling water
2. Stir in the raspberries , pineapple and salt
3. Pour half into an 8-cup ring mold coated with nonstick spray
4. Refrigerate for 30 mins or until firm
5. Let remaining gelatin mixture stand at room temperature
6. In a mixing bowl , beat cream cheese and sour cream until smooth
7. Carefully spread over gelatin in mold
8. Top with remaining gelatin mixture
9. Refrigerate for 6 or more hours before using
10. Store in fridge

title: mixed seafood saute
steps:
1. Melt butter and oil in lg skillet
2. Add all the seafood and cook and stir for 2 minutes
3. Add seasonings , mix well
4. Mix cream and sherry
5. Add to skillet
6. Bring to a boil
7. Cook 1 minute
8. Remove from heat and stir in the parmesan cheese

title: watermelon  cherry tomato  red onion and cucumber salad
steps:
1. Combine watermelon , tomatoes , onion , cucumber , lime juice and oil in a large bowl
2. Season with salt and pepper
3. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour

title: homemade brown rice hot cereal
steps:
1. In clean , dry skillet toast brown rice on medium heat
2. Lower heat if rice starts to smoke
3. Toast rice for about 10 minutes , stirring constantly so that grains do not burn
4. Rice should turn a medium brown
5. Set aside to cool slightly
6. In blender fitted with steel blade , or in grain mill or food processor grind browned rice to the consistency of medium coarse cornmeal
7. The grinding process will have to be done in 3 / 4 cup portions to allow the rice grains to grind effectively
8. To store: place ground rice cereal in airtight container or "ziploc" bag
9. The cereal must be kept either refrigerated or frozen
10. Brown rice goes rancid quickly if stored in cupboard
11. To prepare hot cereal:
12. In small saucepan with 1 cup of rapidly boiling , salted water gradually add 1 / 3 cup scant of prepared brown rice cereal using a fork to stir well
13. For thinner consistency cereal , either increase amount of water , or reduce amount of cereal
14. Continue to cook rice on high for about 30 seconds breaking up any lumps
15. Reduce heat until boiling subsides , cover pan tightly and simmer for 10 minutes
16. Serve with your favorite toppings if desired
17. Season with salt if necessary
18. My favorite additions are toasted nuts , raisins and cardamom !

title: country brunch skillet
steps:
1. In a large skillet over medium heat , cook bacon until crisp
2. Remove bacon
3. Crumble and set aside
4. Drain , reserving 2 tablespoons of drippings
5. Add potatoes , green pepper , onion , salt and pepper to drippings
6. Cook and stir for 2 minutes
7. Cover and cook , stirring occasionally , until potatoes are browned and tender , about 15 minutes
8. Make six wells in the potato mixture
9. Break one egg into each well
10. Cover and cook on low heat for 8-10 minutes or until eggs are completely set
11. Sprinkle with cheese and bacon

title: favorite chocolate chip pumpkin bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease and flour three 9x5 inch loaf pans
3. In a medium bowl , mix flour , cinnamon , nutmeg , baking soda and salt
4. In a large bowl , combine sugar , pumpkin , oil , water and eggs
5. Beat until smooth
6. Blend in flour mixture
7. Fold in chocolate chips
8. Pour evenly into 3 pans
9. Bake for one hour , or until toothpick comes out clean
10. Let cool on wire racks before removing

title: whipped sweet potato and toasted walnut casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 spray large skillet with cooking spray and toast the walnuts well , stirring frequently
2. Don't allow them to blacken
3. Boil the peeled / quartered sweet potatoes just as you would regular potatoes for mashed potatoes
4. Pour into strainer and allow to drain well
5. Place potatoes into xtra large mixing bowl along with all other ingredients except the marshmallows then use a hand blender to puree just like mashed potatoes
6. Taste , add more brown sugar and / or sweetened condensed milk if you prefer them sweeter , make sure the walnuts are well distributed
7. Turn the mixture into a casserole dish
8. Layer the marshmallows over the top pressing down lightly into the mixture
9. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes or until marshmallows are melted and browned

title: almond milk
steps:
1. After the almonds have soaked overnight , drain and discard soaking water
2. In a blender , blend almonds with 2 cups of fresh water and dates
3. Once well blended , strain the mixture to remove any almond particles that may be left
4. The best way is to strain through a fine mesh strainer lined with cheesecloth
5. Once prepared , the milk should be refrigerated
6. Can keep for up to 4 days

title: japanese noodle and mushroom salad
steps:
1. Cook noodles according to packet directions
2. Drain well and set aside
3. Heat fry-pan and toast sesame seeds
4. Set aside
5. Heat oil over medium heat and add mushrooms and ginger cook for 2 minutes
6. Remove from heat and set aside
7. Peel carrot and using vegetable peeler cut into long ribbons
8. Mix wasabi , mirin and soy sauce together well
9. Place noodles , mushroom mixture , carrot and water chestnuts in a large bowl
10. Drizzle with dressing and toss to combine
11. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve immediately

title: pennys stuffed bell peppers
steps:
1. Cut the tops off of the peppers and scoop out seeds and membranes
2. Chop tops of peppers and onions , & garlic
3. Saut until limp , 6 or 7 minutes
4. Add crumbled up meat and brown
5. Salt and pepper all the way through the process
6. Add herbs and of the parsley and stir , cook on low to absorb herb flavors then set aside to cool
7. In a large bowl combine meat mixture , rice , cheeses , 1 cup of marinara , chopped spinach , remainder of parsley , and eggs
8. Mix and spoon into peppers
9. Put remainder of marinara in saucepan with red wine and stir then place stuffed peppers in the sauce
10. Make sure the peppers fit snugly
11. Cover and cook on low simmer until the peppers are soft , about 30 minutes
12. Spoon sauce over peppers just before serving

title: gloria s lofthouse sugar cookies
steps:
1. With mixer on medium speed , combine the egg , margarine , mayonnaise , sugar and flour
2. Divide into 24 pieces and roll into balls
3. Place 2-inches apart on lightly greased baking sheets
4. Flatten each with the bottom of a glass dipped in sugar
5. Bake at 375 for 10- 12 minutes , or until cookies are done
6. Frost as desired

title: spaghetti with tomato and aubergine  eggplant  sauce
steps:
1. Cut aubergine into cubes and sprinkle with salt
2. Drain and pat dry after 15-20 mins heat oil for frying aubergine in a frying pan and shallow fry till golden brown drain and set aside heat virgin olive oil in a pan , add garlic , chilli flakes or chillies and cook for a minute or till garlic just begins to turn colour
3. Mix in olives , capers , tomatoes , puree and dried seasoning or fresh herbs season with salt and pepper to taste cover pan and cook sauce on low heat for 30-35 minutes
4. Or till tomatoes are cooked through and sauce has thickened add fried aubergine cubes and remove from heat
5. Cook spaghetti according to packet instructions
6. Drain and add spaghetti to sauce add basil leaves and toss pasta in sauce till well coated serve immediately with grated parmesan on the side

title: yummy yogurt berry muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Grease 18 large muffin tins
3. In a large bowl , mix flour , sugar , cinnamon , salt and baking powder
4. In another bowl , whisk eggs , and add the rest of the ingredients
5. Pour wet ingredients over dry and mix until moistened
6. Bake for about 25 to 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean
7. Remove from muffin tin and let cool
8. Glaze:
9. Stir orange juice into 1 / 3 cup of icing sugar and pour over muffins

title: herb garden vegetables
steps:
1. In large skillet or wak , melt butter over medium heat
2. Add broccoli , cauliflower and carrots
3. Stir to coat with butter
4. Cover
5. Cook 4-6 minute or until crisp and tender , stirring occasionally
6. Stir in bell pepper and the remaining ingredients
7. Cook and stir 2-3 minute or until throughly heated
8. Grill method:
9. Tear off 6 large pieces of foil
10. Place all the ingredients , except butter into a large bowl and mix well
11. Seperate the vegetable mixture out onto the pieces of foil , making sure you leave enough room to close up the packets
12. Place 1 teaspoons of butter onto the top of each packet
13. Seal each packet and place on grill
14. Grill for about 10 minute or until vegetables are tender

title: caribbean jerk chicken breasts
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except chicken and rice in a shallow dish until well blended
2. Add chicken
3. Turn to evenly coat both sides of each breast
4. Refrigerate 1 hour
5. Heat greased grill to medium-high heat
6. Grill chicken 30 minutes or until done , turning occasionally
7. Serve with rice
8. Kraft kitchen's
9. Use your broiler: cook chicken under the broiler instead of on the grill

title: fall apart tender pork chops
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat add chops and brown all over
2. Arrange chops in a 13" x 9" baking dish
3. Add mushrooms to drippings in the skillet and cook over medium-high heat without stirring for 3 to 4 minutes
4. Stir in garlic , salt , oregano , basil and pepper
5. Sprinkle flour over mushrooms and stir to moisten
6. Pour in wine and bring to a boil
7. Add cream and chicken broth , simmer , stirring , to thicken
8. Pour over chops
9. Cover tightly with a double layer of foil
10. Bake at 350 for 2 to 2 1 / 2 hours until pork chops are fork tender

title: easy moist chocolate cupcakes
steps:
1. Mix ingredients
2. Fill muffin cups 3 / 4 full
3. Bake at 350 for 13-15 , until it springs back when lightly touched

title: tlayuda with black bean puree  aka mexican unpizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. If using dried beans , add salt , pepper , garlic , onion , chili powder and cumin in last few minutes of cooking
3. Place mixture in blender or food processer with enough liquid to allow machine to do its work and roughly puree
4. If using canned beans , add seasonings and warm mixture gently in a saucepan , stirring , to take the edge off of the garlic and onion
5. Then roughly puree with a little of the liquid as necessary
6. Place the tortillas on pizza peel or baking sheet and evenly spread with the bean mixture and then the cheese
7. Bake for 5 minutes , then sprinkle with cabbage and cilantro if using
8. Bake another 5 minutes until the topping is hot and tortilla is crisp on the edges
9. Cut into wedges if desired

title: smothered pork chops with thyme
steps:
1. Combine 1 / 4 cup broth , milk , flour , mustard , salt , and pepper in a small bowl
2. Stir with a whisk
3. Set aside
4. Sprinkle one side of each pork chop with paprika and thyme
5. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
6. Coat pan with cooking spray
7. Add half of the pork to pan
8. Saute 1 1 / 2 minutes on each side or until pork is done and lightly browned
9. Remove pork from pan
10. Repeat procedure with remaining pork
11. Reduce heat to medium
12. Add chopped onion
13. Saute 4 minutes or until lightly golden
14. Add remaining 3 / 4 cup broth
15. Bring to a boil
16. Cook 2 minutes
17. Add milk mixture , stirring with a whisk
18. Add pork , turning to coat
19. Cook 1 minute
20. Sprinkle with minced parsley

title: red lentil puree
steps:
1. Bring water , lentils and thyme to boil
2. Reduce heat to low and cook for 10-15 minutes until lentils are soft and water is absorbed
3. Remove thyme sprigs and mash lentils
4. Add salt , lemon juice , olive oil , garlic and pepper to taste
5. Mix well
6. Serve warm or cold
7. Decorate with black olives , capers , cherry tomatoes and onion rings
8. Thank you mirj , i think this is a great idea to support a fresh

title: garlic bread   abm
steps:
1. Add ingredients in the order stated by your bread machine manufacturer
2. Choose medium crust
3. Use white , rapid , or delay bake cycles

title: shrimp  mango  and avocado salad with sweet   spicy dressing
steps:
1. To make the dressing , combine vinegar , lime juice , sweetener , and pepper in a small bowl
2. Mix well , and set aside
3. In separate large serving bowl , combine all salad ingredients
4. Pour dressing over salad , and toss until all ingredients are coated
5. Enjoy !
6. Points value 3

title: onion bibb salad
steps:
1. Place chilled , dried greens , onion , and cucumber in a salad bowl
2. Zigzag a stream of salad oil over , then a mixture of the vinegar and worcestershire
3. Sprinkle with salt and sugar
4. Grind pepper over generously
5. Toss gently and serve

title: lemon tea cookies with lemon curd filling
steps:
1. In large bowl , beat butter , 1 / 3 cup powdered sugar and the vanilla with electric mixer on medium speed until well blended
2. Stir in flour until dough forms
3. Cover
4. Refrigerate 30 minutes for easier handling
5. Heat oven to 350f shape dough into 1-inch balls
6. On ungreased cookie sheets , place balls 2 inches apart
7. Press thumb into center of each ball to make indentation
8. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until light golden brown
9. Immediately remove from cookie sheets to cooling racks
10. Cool completely , about 30 minutes
11. Fill cookies with lemon curd
12. Sprinkle powdered sugar over cookies

title: another garlic chicken
steps:
1. In a large shallow glass dish , combine the first seven ingredients
2. Add chicken
3. Turn to coat
4. Cover and refrigerate for 3-4 hours
5. Place cracker crumbs in a shallow bowl
6. Roll chicken in crumbs until coated
7. Transfer to a greased 13x9 baking dish
8. Combine butter and oil
9. Pour over the chicken
10. Bake , uncovered , at 350 for 50-60 minutes or until chicken juices run clear

title: green mountain granola
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a 9"x13" pan
2. Add the 1 / 3 cup maple syrup
3. Now mix together in a bowl the oats , coconut , walnuts , almonds or pecans , and cinnamon , then add to syrup , mixing all together , then pressing into one layer in pan
4. Bake at 325f
5. For 15 to 25 mins
6. , remove from oven , cool , break up into chunks , and then add: cup to 2 / 3 cup dried cranberries , apricots , or any dried fruit and 1 cup raisins
7. Enjoy !

title: cuban ground beef hash
steps:
1. In a skillet , cook the beef , green pepper and onion over medium heat and drain
2. Stir in the tomatoes , tomato paste , raisins , olives , vinegar , garlic , cumin , salt and pepper and bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat , cover and simmer for 5 minutes
4. Add peas , cover and cook 5 minutes longer or until heated through
5. Serve over rice

title: chock full of clam sauce with farfalle
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions and drain
2. Meanwhile , in a large nonstick skillet , heat olive oil over medium-high heat
3. Add garlic and cook , stirring , until fragrant , about 30 seconds
4. Do not let it brown !
5. Stir in tomatoes with their juices , canned clams with their juices , breadcrumbs , parsley , salt , and fresh clams
6. Cook for just 2 minutes to allow flavors to blend
7. Stir in pasta and cook , stirring occasionally , until the fresh clams open and mixture is hot , about 3-5 minutes
8. Discard any clams that do not open

title: barley  turkey and butternut squash casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Coat a 4-quart baking dish with cooking spray
3. In a large pot of rapidly boiling water , boil squash halves 5 minutes or until not quite tender
4. Drain
5. When cool enough to handle , scoop flesh from each half and dice
6. Set aside
7. In a large saucepan , heat oil over medium heat
8. Add green pepper , onion and diced squash
9. Saut 3 minutes
10. Add sage and pepper and stir to coat
11. Add broth and bring to a boil
12. Add barley and return to boil

14. Mix in diced turkey

16. Bake , uncovered , 30 minutes , or until cheese is golden

title: chili spice mix
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a bowl

3. Makes about 1 / 3 cup
4. Rub all over meat
5. Let stand for 10 minutes

title: shepherd s pie  low carb
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Chop cauliflower and steam it until very tender

steps:
1. In a large saucepan heat oil over medium heat cook carrots , onion , garlic , basil and bay leaf
2. Stirring occasionally for 5 minutes

steps:

title: fried morel mushrooms done right
steps:
1. Using a small , sharp knife , cut morels in half "long ways
2. " for exceptionally large mushrooms , cut them in half long ways , then again long ways , so that you get 4 equal pieces
3. Fill a bowl with hot tap water
4. As hot as your sink will make it
5. Add roughly 1 cup of salt to the water and stir well until salt dissolves
6. Soak the morels in the hot salt water for about 4 minutes
7. Everyone will tell you that you need to soak them overnight , but don't believe them
8. This step is intended to kill and remove the bugs from the mushrooms
9. There are no forest bugs that can survive under hot salt water for 4 minutes
10. If you soak them overnight , it damages the flavor of the mushrooms , adds too much salt water , and leaves them soggy
11. 4 minutes is all you need
12. Fill a shallow bowl with cake flour
13. Add about 1 tablepoon of salt and 2 tablespoons of pepper
14. Sift and mix well
15. This is your dry batter bowl
16. In a second bowl , beat 4 eggs and add in about 1 tablespoon of milk and about a quarter cup of club soda
17. This will give the batter a light , crispy , tempura style
18. This is your wet batter bowl
19. At your sink put a sieve / colander / strainer in one side of the sink and get your soaking morel bowl to the left of that
20. Turn your sink on cold , at the lowest stream you can without it just dripping
21. The sink should just barely be on
22. Individually take each mushroom piece out of the salt water , and gently rinse it off under the old sink to remove and dirt or dead bugs
23. Then put the piece in the sieve to drip dry
24. Mushrooms should go first into the wet batter , second into the cake flour , and then third knock off all the excess clumps and repeat until all mushrooms are coated with the flour batter
25. For that third step , there are plastic tubs that you can buy that helps you batter almost anything
26. This works the best , but if you don't have that , just use a big ziplock bag to shake the mushrooms up in to get them well coated with the flour
27. Put your floured mushroom bowl in the fridge for about 30 minutes if you have time
28. This allows for the batter to stick better to the mushrooms
29. Fill your grease pan with lard and heat to about 360 degrees
30. Don't use vegetable oil or anything besides lard
31. I know , it's unhealthy and no one uses lard anymore , but it's the only way to make your mushrooms not taste like oil
32. Vegetable oil , peanut oil , and shortening will all leave your mushrooms tasting like oil
33. Use lard ! you only get this once a year , so forget about "healthy" and do 'em up right !
34. To test if your oil is hot enough , toss a little bit of flour in the pan
35. If it bubbles , then the oil is hot enough
36. Toss the 'shroom in the oil
37. Let it fry for about a minute , then flip it and fry for another minute
38. Don't put more than 5 or so in the oil at one time because tossing cold mushrooms in the oil will cool it down
39. Allow the mushrooms to cool on paper towel
40. Add salt or garlic salt , or lawry's seasoned salt as desired and eat
41. My personal favorite is tony chacheres cajun creole salt , a little bit of garlic and coarse ground black pepper

title: uncommon ramen bbq chicken pizza bake
steps:
1. Remove ramen noodles from packages and cook in boiling water just until al dente
2. Discard flavor packets or save for another use
3. Meanwhile , beat egg and whisk together with milk and parmesan cheese
4. Drain noodles very well and mix into egg mixture
5. Line a sheet pan or pizza pan with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray
6. Spread noodle mixture onto pan making sure to spread it out evenly
7. Form the crust so the edges are thicker than the middle
8. Bake at 350 for 10 minutes

steps:
1. Cook chicken breasts until done

steps:

steps:

7. Serve immediately

title: do ahead fries
steps:
1. Peel potatoes and cut into french fry strips
2. Drop into a bowl covered with water in which the salt has been added
3. Drain and pat dry
4. Heat oil to 400
5. Fry the potato strips for 1 minute
6. Drain on paper towels
7. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use
8. To finish , fry the potatoes an additional 2-3 minutes at 400 , until golden

title: jordanian chicken wraps
steps:
1. Cook chicken in water flavored with a bay leaf , carrots , and additional coriander , ground pepper , and sumac until done

9. Add chicken pieces and more oil to coat , if necessary

11. Add about a cup or two of the broth and mix
12. Keep adding spices , oil , and / or broth as needed to let the chicken become very soft and moist with a rich yellow color and flecked thoroughly with sumac
13. This may take awhile
14. Add toasted almonds and stir
15. Cut lavash bread in half , or use tortillas
16. Place one cup of filling on bread
17. Fold like a burrito , wrapping fully
18. Stack in a pile on a plate
19. Leave to cool until comfortable to touch
20. Eat with your hands

steps:
1. If the cactus is in big chunks dice to 1 / 2-1 / 4 inch pieces

3. Whisk together the dressing ingredients and toss with the salad
4. Serve

steps:
1. Set oven to broil
2. Spray broiler pan with nonstick cooking spray
3. Place fillets on pan
4. Mix remaining ingredients and spread evenly over fish
5. Broil with tops about 4 inches from heat for 5-8 minutes until fish flakes easily with fork

title: shrimp etouffee with roasted corn
steps:
1. Directions:
2. Measure out all spices and set aside
3. Chop , roast all veggies and set aside
4. Using your favorite pan on medium high make the roux
5. When it starts to smoke a little cut back the heat and cook flour until a reddish brown
6. Add the onion , bell pepper and celery and saut for a few minutes until tender

steps:
1. In large fry pan , heat oil over medium heat
2. Cook the onion , celery , red or green pepper , jalapeno , and garlic until softened
3. Add garbanzo beans , spices , and a couple tsp of salsa
4. Stir until heated through

title: rhubarb pie
steps:
1. Mix egg , water , flour , sugar and butter together in a bowl
2. Add rhubarb to mixture and mix well
3. Pour filling into a pie crust and top with second pie crust
4. Cut air vents in top crust

title: farfalle with prosciutto  spinach  pine nuts and raisins
steps:
1. Plump raisins by soaking in boiling water , about 10 minutes , then drain
2. Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat
3. Add garlic and cook , stirring , for 1 minute
4. Add spinach and cook , stirring for about 2 minutes or until just wilted
5. Cook farfalle as directed on package and drain
6. Toss with pine nuts , raisins , garlic , spinach and prosciutto
7. Add parmesan cheese
8. Add salt and pepper to taste

title: marinated stuffed cherry peppers
steps:
1. Wash cherry peppers and place whole , stems intact , in 1 gallon jar
2. Fill jar with white vinegar
3. Let stand at least one week
4. I've let them soak as long as 3 weeks
5. You may need to add more vinegar to keep the jar full as the peppers soak it in

8. Remove stems and seeds
9. Expect to lose 3 or 4 peppers during soaking
10. Cut provolone to the appropriate size to fill the peppers
11. Cut the proscuitto slices in half
12. Wrap the provolone with a 1 / 2 slice of proscuitto and stuff into pepper
13. Add some olive oil to the jar
14. Add onion , rosemary , 2 or 3 bay leaves , dill weed , basil and chopped garlic to oil
15. Place the peppers in the jar and fill the jar with 50% olive oil and 50% canola oil
16. Top off the jar with a sprikle coating of parmesan cheese
17. Let soak a minimum of one week
18. I let them soak and store them at room temperature
19. You may want to refrigerate for longer shelf life
20. Enjoy !

title: bistro onion jalapeno pizza
steps:
1. Fit he prepared pizza dough in the baking dish to cover bottom and halfway up the side
2. Set oven to 425 degrees f
3. Bake the crust for 8 minutes or until a golden brown
4. Remove to cool and set aside
5. In a large skillet melt butter with olive oil over medium heat
6. Add in the onion slices and jalapeno pepper with sugar , cook stirring with a wooden spoon for about 20-25 minutes , adding in the garlic the last 5 minutes of cooking , season mixture with salt and black pepper to taste
7. Spread the onion mixture on top of the pizza crust
8. In a bowl whisk egg then add in half and half cream , then the shredded cheese
9. Pour evenly over the onion mixture
10. Bake in a 425 degree oven for about 15 minutes
11. Remove and let cool slightly before slicing

title: imitation crab  surimi  and avocado salad
steps:
1. Shred surimi and place in bowl
2. Slice avocado in half and twist to open
3. Carefully lodge a knife in the seed and twist to remove
4. Score avocado into 1 inch by 1 inch sections and spoon into bowl
5. Add tomato , onion slivers , and cilantro
6. Squeeze 1 / 2 lime over the salad
7. Salt and pepper to taste
8. Stir well and serve

title: overnight casserole
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix together macaroni through onions
2. In separate small bowl , mix together the soup and milk till well blended
3. Pour milk mixture into large bowl and stir all ingredients together till blended
4. Pour into a 9 x 13 baking dish
5. Top with grated parmesan cheese
6. Sprinkle paprika over the top and cover with aluminum foil
7. Store overnight in frig
8. Get casserole out of frig one hour before baking
9. Preheat your oven to 350f bake , covered with foil , for 45 minutes
10. Uncover and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes
11. Serve with salad and bread / rolls
12. If you like your food to be spicy feel free to add hot sauce , peppers , celery , etc to your liking
13. I serve this dish to older relatives when they come to visit and take it to potlucks where it disappears quickly
14. Simple , old fashioned comfort food
15. Feel free to adjust to your taste

title: citrus teriyaki salmon
steps:
1. Combine orange juice , ginger , onion , teriyaki , lime juice , and garlic , and mix well
2. Marinate salmon in mixture for at least 3 hours
3. Grill or broil salmon
4. While salmon is cooking , strain solids from the remaining marinade , and heat in a small saucepan
5. Bring the marinade to a boil and cook 5-10 minutes
6. Spoon the sauce over the salmon and serve

title: turkey roast
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. Place turkey breast in a roasting pan
3. Combine sugar , ketchup , water , oil , vinegar , soy sauce , and onion
4. Pour over turkey
5. Bake , covered for 1 hour
6. Reduce heat to 350 and bake , uncovered , for 30-40 min or until done

title: an elbow in the boobs
steps:
1. Add rum , cointreau , vermouths and lemon juice to a cocktail shaker
2. Shake thoroughly and pour in to a 3 oz cocktail glass garnish with a marachino cherry and serve

title: creamy cheesecake with pecan crust and sour cream topping
steps:
1. To make crust , preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Process graham crackers in a food processor until they become fine crumbs or put them in a plastic bag and crush with a rolling pin
3. Measure out 1-1 / 2 cups
4. Chop pecan halves
5. Mix cracker crumbs with pecans and sugar
6. Add melted butter and mix well
7. Lightly butter a 9-inch springform pan
8. Press mixture in an even layer on bottom and about 1 inch up the sides of pan
9. Bake in oven for 10 minutes
10. Let cool completely
11. Leave oven set at 350 degrees
12. To make filling , beat cream cheese with sour cream at low speed until very smooth
13. Gradually beat in sugar
14. Beat in eggs , one at a time
15. Beat in lemon zest
16. If using vanilla bean , scrape its seeds with point of a knife into cheese mixture , or stir in vanilla extract
17. Carefully pour filling into cooled crust and bake for about 45 minutes or until firm in center
18. Remove from oven and cool for 15 minutes
19. Raise oven temperature to 425 degrees
20. To make topping , mix together sour cream , sugar and vanilla
21. Carefully spread topping on cake in an even layer without letting it drip over crust
22. Return cake to oven and bake for 8 minutes or until topping sets
23. Remove from oven and cool to room temperature
24. Refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving
25. Remove sides of springform pan just before serving

title: z tejas dos xx s pork carnitas
steps:
1. Place the pork , water , orange juice , achiote , beer , bay leaves , ancho chilies , onion and garlic in a large roasting pan
2. Place pan over low heat
3. Cook about 1 hour or just until the meat is about to fall apart
4. Using a slotted spoon , remove meat to a sheet pan
5. Let cool slightly
6. Drain the juices from the pork
7. Reserve for later use
8. Discard the onions and remaining solids in the roasting pan
9. In a large saucepan , heat corn oil to about 350 degrees
10. Being careful not to burn the meat , slowly and carefully add the chunks of meat to the hot oil
11. Fry until crispy
12. Using a slotted spoon , place the meat in the reserved sauce
13. Cover the pan with aluminum foil and cook in a 300-degree oven for 30 minutes

title: baked fried chicken with pan gravy
steps:
1. To make the chicken: place the chicken pieces in a in baking dish , and pour buttermilk over to cover , turing with hands to coat all evenly
2. Refrigerate for 45 minutes
3. Set oven to 400 degrees
4. Spread the 1 / 2 cup melted butter in a large baking dish
5. Using a heavy plastic freezer bag place the flour and all seasonings together and shake bag to mix
6. Reserve 2 heaping tablespoons of flour mixture
7. Set aside
8. Shake one piece of chicken at a time in the seasoned flour , then place skin-side down in the baking dish
9. Bake for 20 minutes , turn over and continue baking for another additional 20 minutes , or until crispy and cooked
10. Remove the chicken
11. Set aside in a warm place
12. For the gravy: pour the pan drippings from the cooked chicken into a skillet , and saute the onions and mushrooms on medium high heat until soft
13. In a small cup whisk together the 2 tablespoons reserved flour with the 1 cup milk or cream until smooth
14. Whisk the milk mixture into the onion / mushroom mixture
15. If you think you need to add in the bouillon powder then add it in at this point , if not just omit it
16. Simmer until thickened , adding in more milk or cream to desired consistancy is reached
17. Serve the gravy with the chicken

title: panamanian tortillas  thick corn cakes
steps:
1. Mix the water , mix , salt , rice flour , and sugar with a spoon
2. Knead with wet hands in bowl
3. It will form into a mixture called "masa"
4. Get bunches of the masa and form them into circles
5. Make sure the edges are pinched , and that the thickness is consistent
6. To bake , put some of the butter in the pan and spread evenly
7. Heat the butter on med high
8. When butter is heated , place masa circles on the pan and let bake
9. Flip them every 2 or 3 min to evenly cook without burning
10. They will start to puff up and get golden
11. It should take about 10 min to cook thoroughly , but make sure not to overdo them--no one likes a burned tortilla !
12. Repeat the steps until all the circles are baked through

title: vegan jam almond cookies
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients
2. Mix wet ingredients
3. Mix both mixtures
4. Flatten cookies onto a pan
5. Add a bit of jam on each cookie
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 15-20mins , until bottoms are lightly browned
7. Enjoy

title: tangy leftover pork hoagies
steps:
1. Melt margarine in a large sauce pan over medium heat
2. Add onions & mushrooms
3. Saut till onion is golden
4. Add worcestershire sauce , lemon juice , sugar , paprika , mrs dash , cayenne
5. Stir to blend
6. Bring to a boil
7. Stir often
8. Add pork allow to simmer until pork is heated through
9. Divide pork & sauce on to 3 hoagies
10. Serve

title: shrimp over linguine
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package , drain
2. Heat oil in large skillet , over medium high heat , add garlic and onion , saute until soft , about 3 minutes
3. Add shrimp and cook until opaque , about 2 minutes
4. Add wine and cook until reduced by 1 / 2 , about 2 minutes
5. Add tomatoes , artichokes and capers
6. Add basil and pasta , toss to coat well
7. Transfer to serving platter and top with grated cheese

title: lemon cranberry pie
steps:
1. Heat oven to 325 degrees
2. Prepare pastry
3. In small sauce pan , combine cranberry sauce , cornstarch , and sugar over medium heat until thickened and bubbly
4. Spoon into pastry shell
5. In small mixing bowl , beat the condensed milk , lemon , and egg yolk until well-blended
6. Spoon evenly over cranberry mixture
7. Bake 30 minutes , cool , then chill thoroughly before serving

title: accordion potatoes
steps:
1. Heat the oven to 375f190c
2. Cut slices into the potatoes without going all the way through
3. Insert a few herbs into each
4. Lay them on a baking sheet , and season with salt and pepper
5. And drizzle with oil
6. Bake until brown , crisp on the outside and soft inside , 45 minutes to an hour

title: fresh corn soup
steps:
1. Saut onion and peppers in butter in a large saucepan for 3 minutes , stirring occasionally
2. Add corn
3. Cook 3 minutes , stirring constantly
4. Stir in chicken broth , sugar , salt and white pepper
5. Cover , reduce heat to low and simmer 10 minutes
6. Stir in half and half
7. Cook until thoroughly heated
8. Do not boil

title: shrimp bilbaina
steps:
1. Shell and devein shrimp
2. In a skillet heat oil and butter
3. Saute shrimp over moderately high heat for about 2-3 minutes , until they turn pink
4. Turn them once during cooking
5. Do not overcook
6. Remove shrimp from skillet and keep warm
7. Add all other ingredients to skillet
8. Blend well and cook over high heat while stirring , for about 2 minutes , until sauce is smooth and reduced by about half
9. Add shrimp and toss quickly to coat
10. Spoon into middle and around side of rice ring , sprinkle with parsley and serve immediately

title: mike and carla s turkey loaf
steps:
1. Mix upper set of ingredients and refrigerate
2. Saute carrots in olive oil
3. After 10 minutes , add the onions and cook until soft
4. Add the garlic and spices and cook for another minute or two , stirring constantly
5. Mix all ingedients together and fold into a loaf pan
6. Cover top with about 1 / 4 inch of ketchup and bake at 350 degrees for 1 1 / 2 hours
7. Optional: mix barbeque sauce with the ketchup to jazz it up

title: fabulously simple asian dipping sauce
steps: 1. Mix well and serve on the side

title: creamed bratwurst
steps:
1. Cook onion and mustard in margarine till tender
2. Stir in bratwurst , beer , mushrooms , beef broth , sugar and 1 / 4 teaspoons pepper
3. Simmer 5 minutes
4. Stir flour into sour cream
5. Stir some pan juices into sour cream mixture to thin
6. Stir into bratwurst mixture
7. Cook and stir till thickened and bubbly
8. Cook and stir 1 minute more
9. Serve over noodles
10. Sprinkle with parsley

title: orzo primavera
steps:
1. Heat oil in medium skillet and saut shallots , garlic , carrot and red pepper
2. Add squashes and cook until just tender
3. Turn the heat to high and add stock , tomato sauce , salt and pepper
4. When the sauce comes to simmer turn the heat down to low and stir well
5. Add the cooked orzo and half and half and stir until all of the sauce is absorbed
6. Remove from heat and add parmesan cheese
7. Serve with french bread

steps:
1. Prepare your ingredients: pre-cook the potatoes in a bowl covered with water in the microwave
2. Cut boneless , chicken breast into thin strips
3. Wash and cut onions into cubes
4. Separate all the pieces
5. --
6. In a wok on medium heat add oil and curry paste
7. Add 1 / 3 of the coconut milk
8. Stir until it forms a thin gravy
9. Add chicken , galangal , lime leaves
10. Cook for about 5 minute
11. Turn the heat to high , add the rest of the coconut milk , potatoes and onions , fish sauce , sugar , and mix well
12. Set to boil for about 2 minutes

title: italian pita crisps
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Split the pitas and open completely
3. Combine first 4 ingredients
4. Stir well
5. Brush margarine evenly over each pita half
6. Sprinkle evenly with cheese mixture
7. Cut each pita half into 8 wedges , and place on a baking sheet
8. Bake for 8 minutes or until crisp
9. Let cool
10. Store in an airtight container

title: easy boneless honey marinated butterflied leg of lamb
steps:
1. In a large heavy plastic ziploc bag combine the honey vegetable oil , lemon juice , dijon , onion , garlic , fresh rosemary , salt and black pepper
2. Add in the lamb and turn to coat in the marinade
3. Seal the bag tightly and place in a large bowl
4. Refrigerate for 24 hours turning the bag occasionally to coat evenly in the marinade
5. When ready to cook , remove the lamb from the plastic bag and discard marinade
6. Let the lamb sit out a room temperature for 1 hour and 15 minutes before cooking or grilling
7. Set oven to 425 degrees
8. Pat the lamb dry with paper towel
9. Heat oil in a large frypan , then sear lamb on both sides for 5 minutes per side
10. Transfer the lamb to a large greased baking sheet
11. Cook the lamb for about 20-25 minutes for medium-rare
12. Let rest 15 minutes before slicing
13. Delicious !

title: tvp mushrooms  rice casserole
steps:
1. Combine tvp , water and ketchup
2. Set aside
3. In a skillet saute onion in oil until translucent
4. Add cooked rice , tvp , and mushrooms
5. Place all ingredients and seasoning in a 2 quart casserole
6. Cover and bake at 350 for 30-35 minu

title: smokey salmon spread
steps:
1. Drain salmon and flake with a fork
2. Combine with remaining ingredients
3. Blend well
4. Chill and serve

title: crock pot sweet   sour meatballs
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients and cook on high on crockpot on high for 2 hours or on low for 4 hours
2. Serve over hot rice
3. Enjoy

steps:
1. Measure honey and peanut butter into a microwave safe bowl
2. Heat in microwave for about 30 seconds

4. Add the remainder of the dry ingredients mixing thoroughly

1. Mix the dry ingredients in a thick sauce pan
2. Mix in the milk , a tbsp at a time until it becomes smooth and then add the rest of the milk at a faster pace
3. Heat mixing all the time for about 5 minutes until thick
4. Pour into 2 cups and serve steaming hot with a spoon on the side

steps:
1. Brown ground beef with onions
2. Add bbq sauce and brown sugar
3. Spray muffin tin with pam and press biscuits into pan like a crust
4. Spoon beef mixture into cups

steps:
1. In a medium size saucepan , add cubed potatoes , cover with water and cook until tender
2. About 15 minutes
3. Drain potatoes when cooked
4. Mash and set aside
5. In the meantime , in a large frying pan , add oil and butter and heat to melt on medium heat
6. In a bowl , combine ground beef , ground lamb , onions , garlic , beaten eggs , worcestershire sauce and mix well to incorporate
7. Add mixture to frying pan and cook until beef is browned , about 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. Now add carrots , petite peas , cauliflower florets , chopped zucchini , mushrooms , tomato paste , chili powder , seasoning salt , garlic salt , spaghetti seasoning and dry mustard
9. Mix well and cook for about 5 minutes stirring often
10. Prepare a 7" x 10" or a 8" x 8" casserole dish by rubbing interior with butter or spraying with a vegetable oil
11. Preheat oven to 325f
12. Transfer beef mixture to prepared casserole dish , level and pat down slightly with a spatula
13. Spread mashed potatoes evenly over the top
14. Bake in preheated 325f oven for 30 minutes or until potatoes are lightly browned
15. Now sprinkle the grated cheese over the potatoes and return to oven and bake until cheese melts , about 5 minutes
16. Remove from oven and let sit for about 5 minutes to set before cutting into 2 1 / 2 by 2 1 / 2 inch squares
17. Serve with a dollop of ketchup if desired
18. Refrigerate any unused portions
19. Reheat 2 squares at a time in a microwave proof dish , on high for 3 minutes or until nice and hot

title: chocolate cashew truffle bars recipe
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Line a 9-by-13-inch cake pan with nonstick foil
3. Set aside
4. Bottom brownie layer:
5. Whisk in the chopped unsweetened chocolate , stirring until smooth
6. Beat in sugar until combined
7. Add eggs , one at a time , beating on medium speed with an electric mixer until well-mixed
8. Mix in flour and vanilla
9. Fold in cashews and mini chocolate chips
10. Pour batter into prepared pan
11. Bake 25 minutes
12. Do not overbake
13. Cool on a rack to room temperature before adding the topping
14. Truffle topping:
15. Pour 1 / 2 inch of water in the bottom section of a double-boiler and bring to a simmer
16. Place chopped dark or semi-sweet chocolate in the top section of the double-boiler and place on top of simmering water
17. Remove from heat and stir chocolate until melted and smooth
18. Set top bowl of chocolate aside
19. Empty water from bottom section , add heavy whipping cream and corn syrup
20. Bring slowly to a boil , mixing to combine
21. Pour cream mixture into melted chocolate , whisking until smooth
22. This is the ganache
23. Let the ganache cool 5 to 7 minutes until it thickens to a custard consistency
24. Whisk in softened butter
25. Let cool completely to room temperature , then briskly whisk the ganache until it lightens in color
26. Lift brownies from the pan using the foil
27. Peel down the sides
28. Cut the brownies into 1-inch squares and separate the squares about 1 / 4-inch apart
29. Mix white chocolate chips and cashews together
30. In a hand chopper or food processor , chop until pieces are no more than 1 / 4-inch in size
31. Pour chocolate ganache evenly over cut brownies so that it drips down the sides in between each square
32. Sprinkle with chopped white chocolate and cashews
33. Let rest at room temperature until chocolate ganache sets up
34. Store chocolate cashew truffle bars in a covered container to keep them from drying out
35. Serve these truffle squares at room temperature for best flavor and texture
36. Yield: about 72 squares

title: honey spiced nut mix
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350-deg
2. F
3. Line a rimmed sheet pan with parchment paper and set aside
4. In a large bowl , combine sugar and salt and set aside
5. Combine honey , black pepper , cumin , coriander , paprika and cayenne in a bowl and mix well
6. Add mixed nuts and stir to thoroughly coat
7. Spread nut mixture evenly in a single layer on prepared sheet pan and bake until toasted and fragrant , about 10 to 11 minutes
8. Remove from oven and let cool until barely warm , then transfer to sugar mixture and toss to evenly coat
9. Return to sheet pan and cool completely
10. Transfer to airtight container or divide nuts into two portions and package for gift giving
11. Nuts will keep 5 days at room temperature , tightly sealed

title: michigan german baked oatmeal
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Coat 3-quart casserole or baking pan with cooking spray
3. In mixing bowl , combine all ingredients
4. Transfer to baking dish
5. Sprinkle top with additional almonds
6. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes
7. Serve hot

title: easy freezer sweet pickles
steps:
1. Mix cucumbers and onions together and sprinkle with salt , mix well and let stand 2-3 hours
2. Rinse and drain well
3. Mix vinegar and sugar till sugar is dissolved
4. Put cucumbers and onions in freezer containers or freezer bags , pour vinegar / sugar mixture over cukes and onions
5. Freeze 3 weeks before eating , the longer you let them sit the sweeter the pickles
6. Thaw in refrigerator or in cold water

title: curried shrimp and polenta  ragu
steps:
1. Place water and milk in a large pot on high , cook till boiling
2. When boiling add the salt and polenta and whisk for five minutes
3. Lower heat and simmer covered for 45 minutes , whisking occasionally
4. When polenta has finished cooking , pour onto a cutting board to cool
5. When it is cooled , cut into rectangles
6. Add olive oil to a frying pan and crisp the polenta on both sides
7. You will need to let it cook for about five minutes on each side
8. When finished cooking on both sides remove from the hear and plate the polenta
9. Cook bacon in a sauce pan , when finish remove from pan and shop into fine pieces
10. Add garbanzo beans to the saucepan and cook in the bacon drippings for two minutes
11. Add jar of ragu spicy italian sauce and bring to a simmer
12. In a frying pan heat olive oil on low heat
13. After two minutes add the shrimp and season with salt and curry powder
14. Cook the shrimp for a several minutes on each side , till it turns pink
15. Finish the dish by pouring sauce over the fried polenta and topping with the cooked shrimp

title: poppy seed bread
steps:
1. Mix together all ingredients and beat for 2 minutes
2. Pour into 2 greased loaf pans
3. Bake at 350 for 1 hour and 15 minutes
4. Enjoy !

title: bob evans sausage gravy  copycat
steps:
1. Crumble and cook sausage in large skillet over medium heat until browned
2. Stir in flour until dissolved
3. Gradually stir in milk
4. Cook gravy until thick and bubbly
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Serve hot over biscuits
7. Refrigerate leftovers

title: quick and easy chicken and dumplings
steps:
1. In a 5 quart dutch oven , combine chicken stock , vegetables , and seasonings
2. Bring to a boil
3. For dumplings , combine biscuit mix and seasonings
4. Stir in milk just until combined
5. Drop by tablespoonfuls into boiling broth mixture
6. Cook uncovered for 10 minutes
7. Cover , and cook 10 minutes longer
8. With slotted spoon , remove dumplings from broth and keep warm
9. Bring broth back to a boil and add chicken or turkey
10. Reduce heat
11. Serve when meat is warmed through
12. Remove bay leaves
13. Spoon over dumplings

title: shaved brussel sprouts
steps:
1. 1
2. Cut out the core of the brussel sprouts and shave them so that they look like thin ribbons
3. 2
4. Saute the brussel sprouts in olive oil for 2 to 3 minutes
5. 3
6. Season with salt and pepper and add the crushed red pepper flakes
7. 4
8. Add the water and continue to cook for 5 to 8 minutes , until the brussel
9. Sprouts are tender
10. 5
11. Mix in the cheese

title: absolutely awesome bbq sauce
steps:
1. In a saucepan over low heat , mix the brown sugar , chili sauce , rum , soy sauce , ketchup , worcestershire sauce , garlic , dry mustard , and pepper
2. Simmer 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
3. Cool , and refrigerate until ready to use

title: baked salmon  with lime  jalapeno chive and sour cream sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 500 degrees
2. Butter baking dish
3. Place salmon in dish skin side down
4. Mix lime juice and butter
5. Brush over salmon
6. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
7. Let stand 15 minutes
8. Bake until fish is almost opaque , about 9 minutes per inch of thickness
9. Meanwhile prepare sauce:
10. Melt butter in heavy small saucepan over medium-low heat
11. Add chilies and cook until tender , stirring occasionally , about 3 minutes
12. Add sour cream and stir until heated through
13. Do not boil
14. Mix in lime juice
15. Add salt and pepper
16. Transfer fish to platter
17. Spoon sauce over
18. Sprinkle generously with chives
19. Garnish with lime wedges

title: dijon chicken breasts
steps:
1. Combine bread crumbs , cheese , and spices in a bowl
2. Brush both sides of chicken pieces with mustard
3. Dredge through bread crumb mixture
4. Heat oil and margarine in a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until melted
5. Saute chicken 6-8 minutes on each side , until done

title: godiva raspberry martini
steps:
1. Shake or stir all ingredients
2. Pour into a chilled martini glass
3. Sit back and enjoy

title: creamy seafood dip
steps:
1. In a medium saucecpan over medium-low heat melt the cream cheese , butter and half and half together and whisk until warmed through and smooth
2. Whisk in the sour cream
3. Cook for 3 minutes
4. Whisk in the worcestershire sauce , salt , and tabasco
5. Fold in the onion , tomato , artichoke hearts , lobster , and crab
6. Cook gently for 5 minutes
7. Place in a chafing dish and sprinkle parmesan cheese evenly over top
8. Place in a 450 degree oven for 8-10 minutes to brown the top to a nice golden color
9. Remove from oven and place on stand
10. Serve with toast points or crackers
11. I like this on new year's morning over toasted english muffins and poached eggs with steamed asparagus on the side

title: broccoli and cheese stuffed chicken breast
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. To prepare broccoli stuffing , combine broccoli , miracle whip , parmesan and mozzarella cheeses in a bowl
3. Lightly mix and place in a baking dish that has been sprayed with non-stick cooking oil
4. Place in oven and bake for 15 minutes
5. To prepare chicken , cut a slit down the middle of the breast almost all the way through
6. Take your extra virgin olive oil , garlic , and spices and place them in a frying pan
7. You will want to cook the chicken in the pan for at least 10-12 minutes on each side until the breast are no longer pink
8. Let chicken breast and stuffing cool
9. Stuff chicken breast with the broccoli and cheese stuffing
10. Place in a baking dish that has been sprayed with non-stick cooking oil , and sprinkle the colby-jack cheese over them
11. Cover with foil and place in oven for 35-40 minutes

title: chicken blue cheese salad with grapes and walnuts
steps: 1. Mix together and serve on lettuce or bread

title: erin s chili con carne with beans
steps:
1. Brown beef and drain fat
2. Add in remaining ingredients
3. Cook on low-medium heat for 2-3 hours
4. For faster cooking , cook on medium and add only one cup of water for about a hour

title: lemony stir fry sauce
steps:
1. Stir all ingredients together in a measuring cup
2. Once you have cooked your veggies and / or chicken in a wok / skillet , add the sauce and cook on medium-high heat until thickened to your liking

title: roasted red pepper puree w  prosciutto and linguine
steps:
1. Cut the red peppers in half , remove and discard the seeds and inner membranes
2. Flatten the pepper with the heel of your hand and place skin side up on a baking sheet , repeat with other peppers
3. Broil the peppers until they are completely charred and blackened
4. The skin will not peel off easily unless its burned ! remove the peppers to a plastic or paper bag and close tightly , place in the freezer until the peppers are cool enough to handle , about 10 minutes
5. With your fingers , peel and discard the loosened skin from the peppers , rinse under water
6. Roughly chop the peppers and combine them with the oil , parsley , basil and garlic in a food processor
7. If using a food mill or a blender , puree the vegetables first , then add the other ingredients
8. Spray an 8 inch skilled with cooking spray , and saut the prosciutto over high heat , just to heat through
9. Stir the meat into the red pepper puree , add salt and pepper and taste to adjust seasoning and toss with linguine , or pour over bed of linguine and serve hot
10. Yummy !

title: coffee toffee ice cream tart
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Butter 9-inch tart pan with removable bottom
3. Mix cookie crumbs and cinnamon in medium bowl
4. Add melted butter and stir until crumbs are very moistened
5. Press crumb mixture onto bottom and up sides of prepared pan
6. Bake until crust is set about 9 minutes
7. Cool completely
8. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons chopped toffee over cooled crust
9. Spread ice cream evenly in crust
10. Freeze for at least 4 hours or until firm
11. Combine cream and butter in a medium saucepan
12. Bring to simmer
13. Remove from heat and add white chocolate
14. Let stand 1 minute
15. Stir until chocolate is melted and smooth
16. Mix in vanilla
17. Let topping stand until cool and slightly thickened but still pourable about 15 minutes
18. Pour white chocolate topping over ice cream tart
19. Tilt pan to cover top of tart completely
20. Freeze until topping is firm , about 1 hour
21. Sprinkle remaining toffee over
22. Freeze until tart is firm for about four hours
23. Use small knife carefully loosen crust from pan sides
24. Gently push up tart bottom to release tart and serve

title: prezel hugs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cover favorite cookie sheet with a layer of mini prezel knots
3. Set 1 hug on each pretzel center
4. Bake for 3 minutes
5. As soon as time is up , remove the pan and immediatly press one m&m on each hug top gently
6. Allow to cool completly
7. When completly cooled , remove with a spatula and store in an airtight container

title: cherry cantaloupe smoothie south africa
steps:
1. Put all ingredients into blender
2. Blend until desired consistency is reached
3. Pour into a glasses and enjoy !

title: tangy sliced  pork sandwiches
steps:
1. Melt butter or margarine in a large saucepan over medium heat
2. Add the worcestershire sauce , lemon juice , sugar , paprika , salt and cayenne pepper
3. Mix together and bring mixture to a boil , stirring often
4. Add the cooked pork and let simmer just until pork is heated through
5. Divide into 4 equal portions onto the bottom of each hamburger bun
6. Serve and enjoy

title: dilled carrot sticks
steps:
1. Simmer the carrots in the dill pickle juice
2. Covered until they are just beginning to get tender
3. Cool in the pickle juice overnight in the fridge
4. Drain well , dab dry
5. Sprinkle with parsley or dill weed
6. Serve chilled

title: italian mussels
steps:
1. Cook onion and garlic in oil for 5 minutes
2. Stir in tomatoes , wine and seasonings
3. Simmer 5 minute
4. Add mussels
5. Cook covered until the shells open
6. Sprinkle with parsley
7. Serve the broth as a soup if desired

title: whoopie pie cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease and dust two 9-inch cake pans with cocoa
3. Beat butter and sugar together until fluffy
4. Add eggs and beat until smooth
5. Sift dry ingredients together
6. Add alternatively with buttermilk to the egg batter and beat for two minutes
7. Pour equally into prepared cake pans
8. Bake for 25 minutes or until cakes test done
9. Let rest in cake pans for 10 minutes , then turn out onto cooling rack to complete cooling
10. While the cake is cooling , make the frosting: add milk to flour slowly , avoiding lumps
11. Cook flour and milk until very thick , stirring constantly
12. Cool completely
13. Cream sugar , butter and vanilla until fluffy
14. Add to cooked mixture
15. Beat , high speed , until very fluffy
16. Looks and tastes like whipped cream
17. Place one layer on cake plate and liberally frost top
18. Place second layer on top of first and frost top and sides
19. Sift cocoa powder lightly over the top for garnish , if desired

title: croatian cabbage stew   prisiljeno zelje
steps:
1. Cut the cabbage to narrow strips approximately 5mm wide and 2-5 cm long
2. Heat water with vinegar and when it boils put cabbage in it
3. Cook for 3 minutes
4. During this put sliced bacon on fat until transparent , add flour and brown it
5. Add cold water , tomato juice
6. Take out cabbage with hollow spoon , and throw the water out
7. Add caraway seeds , season with salt and pepper
8. Cook about 30 minutes or until cabbage softens
9. Serve as a side dish to sausages , pork chops , and similar meat and mashed potato

title: slow cooked mac  n  cheese
steps:
1. Cook macaroni according to package directions and drain
2. Place macaroni in crockpot and add margarine
3. In a bowl , combine the eggs , evaporated milk , soup , milk and 3 cups cheese
4. Pour over macaroni and stir to combine
5. Cover and cook on low for 4 hours
6. Sprinkle with the remaining cheese
7. Cook 15 minutes longer or until cheese is melted
8. Sprinkle with paprika if desired

title: sun dried tomato pesto and feta stuffed chicken breasts
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 180 degrees celsius
2. Slice breasts and open out , using a meat mallet pound breasts , until of approximate even thickness
3. Spread pesto down center of each breast , place sliced sun-dried tomato down the center , top with feta , roll chicken breasts up and secure with prosciutto slices
4. Place breasts in an oven proof dish , drizzle olive oil over breasts and bake for about 30-35 min's or until cooked through

title: crazee simple saffron tomato clam sauce and linguine
steps:
1. Over medium high heat , heat olive oil in heavy skillet
2. Add mushrooms and cook until brown
3. Add onion , garlic and bell pepper cook stirring occasionally until wilted
4. Stir in saffron , basil , oregano and red chili flakes , cook 1 minute
5. Add diced zucchini and cook until zucchini begins to wilt
6. Stir in sauce and bring to a boil over medium high heat
7. Reduce heat to low , stir in clams and diced olives
8. Cook until heated through
9. Serve over hot linguine and sprinkle with cheese

title: spicy black bean garlic burgers
steps:
1. Combine black bean-garlic paste , thai seasoning , srirachi and red onion in small bowl
2. Add to beef , and gently work in using hands
3. Add enough bread crumbs to give beef desired consistency , being careful not to overwork
4. Shape into 1 patty
5. Sprinkle salt and pepper on both sides
6. Grill or fry to desired degree of doneness
7. Grill or toast your buns , add cheese , tomato , or any other desired condiments and enjoy !

title: gluten free cream of chicken soup  adapted from bette hagman s c
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a sauce pan
2. Heat over medium until thickened

title: spinach and feta omelet  ww
steps:
1. In a small bowl combine first 5 ingredients
2. Spray a small skillet with pam and head over medium heat
3. Add egg mixture to skillet , cooking until bottom of eggs is firm
4. Flip omelet and cook other side until set
5. Put cheese on one half of omelet and flip over other half
6. Cut in half to serve

title: gluten free chocolate chip brownies
steps:
1. In a large bowl , blend almond butter until smooth with a hand blender
2. Blend in eggs , then blend in agave and vanilla
3. Blend in cocoa , salt and baking soda , then fold in chocolate chips
4. Grease a 9 x 13 pyrex baking dish
5. Pour batter into dish
6. Bake at 325 for 35-40 minutes

title: broccoli cheese bites
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f
2. Cut broccoli into tiny floret buds , 1 / 4-inch long or smaller , trimming away stems
3. Stir together broccoli , cheese and dressing
4. Spread about 1 / 2 cup mixture on each bagel or inside each pita
5. Place on baking sheet and bake for 5 minutes or until cheese mixture is melted
6. Remove from oven and cool slightly
7. Cut pita into wedges , if desired

title: ultimate easy marinade
steps:
1. Tenderize meat with fork
2. Cover completely with marinade in stainless steel bowl or ziplock baggie
3. Refrigerate for 24 hours
4. Grill over medium heat

title: mango margaritas
steps:
1. Fill blender with ice
2. Add all other ingredients
3. Blend until smooth
4. Dip rim of glass in water or mango nectar
5. Then dip in salt
6. Pour margarita into glass and serve

title: double chocolate dream bars
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. In 13x9-inch baking pan combine graham-cracker crumbs and melted butter until crumbs are moistened
3. Pat into bottom of pan
4. In medium bowl , stir together condensed milk and cocoa powder until smooth
5. Pour over graham-cracker crust and spread evenly
6. Sprinkle with coconut , pecans and chocolate morsels , pat down lightly
7. Bake 25-30 minutes or until center is set
8. Transfer pan to wire rack and cool completely
9. Cut into 24 bars

title: chicken caesar tetrazzini
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti and drain
2. Combine with chicken , broth , dressing and mushrooms in a large mixing bowl
3. Place mixture in a 2 quart casserole
4. Mix together cheese and bread crumbs , sprinkle over spaghetti
5. Bake at 350 for 25 minutes or until hot and bubby

title: navy bean soup with ham and vegetables
steps:
1. Rinse beans
2. In a large sauce pan , add beans and 5 cups room temperature water
3. Bring to a boil then reduce heat and let simmer for 2 minutes
4. Remove from heat , cover and let stand for 1 hour
5. Drain and rinse the beans
6. In the same pot , add 5 cups of fresh water to the beans
7. Add the pork , onion , celery , chicken bullion , parsley , thyme and black pepper
8. Bring to a boil
9. Reduce heat to simmer , cover the pot and cook for 1 3 / 4 hours
10. Remove the pork to a plate to cool off
11. Add the carrots
12. Add the rutabaga or turnip or parsnip and simmer covered for 15 minutes or until tender
13. While the soup is simmering for the last 15 minutes , cut , pull or chop the pork into course pieces then add it back into the soup and turn off the heat
14. Let it rest for as long as you can hold out , then serve with some nice warm bread with butter on it
15. Yum

title: ham and cheese muffins
steps:
1. Mix all dry ingredients into a large mixing bowl
2. Stir in eggs , milk and oil
3. Add ham and cheese and mix well
4. Grease or paper line 1 muffin tin
5. Bake @ 350 for approx 20-30 min until golden brown
6. The ol' tooth pick trick works great here as all ovens vary

title: cocotini
steps: 1. Shake in a shaker and pour in martini glass

title: roasted sweet potato spears
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. In a large bowl , stir together all ingredients add potatoes and mix until evenly coated
3. Place potatoes on baking sheet and bake 20 minutes
4. Then turn cook for another 10 minutes

title: coffee cream frosting
steps:
1. Combine the cream cheese , hot water , coffee and choco-bake blending well
2. Add salt and the powdered sugar gradually and whip till light and fluffy
3. Fills and frosts two 8 inch cake layers or one 9x13 inch cake

title: boston creme trifle
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Grease and lightly flour 13x9 pan
3. Mix cake using first 4 ingredients
4. Bake according to cake mix box
5. Cool completely
6. Meanwhile , in medium saucepan , combine flour , sugar and salt
7. Mix well
8. Gradually stir in milk until smooth
9. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until mixture comes to a boil
10. Boil one minute , stirring constantly
11. Remove from heat
12. In a small bowl , beat eggs
13. Stir in 1 / 4 cup hot mixture into eggs
14. Gradually stir egg mixture into hot misture
15. Cook over low heat until mixture boils and thickens , stirring constantly
16. Remove from heat
17. Stir in butter and vanilla
18. Place plastic wrap directly on custard
19. Refrigerate until cool
20. In large bowl , combine remaining ingredients
21. Beat until stiff peaks form
22. To assemble , break one third of cake into small pieces and place in trifle dish
23. Spoon 1 / 3 of custard over cake pieces
24. Spoon 1 / 3 of topping over custard layer
25. Repeat , making 3 layers
26. Garnish with chocolate curls if desired

title: mushrooms in cranberry reduction
steps:
1. In a non-stick pan saute the garlic and shallots in the olive oil
2. Do not brown them
3. When the shallots and garlic are soft , add the mushrooms
4. Stir gently until mushrooms soften and give up their liquid
5. Turn up the heat to medium and add the juice , vinegar , tarragon , salt , and pepper
6. Bring to brisk boil and reduce the liquid to about 1 / 3 cup , stirring to keep ingredients from sticking
7. Either spoon over sliced steak or serve separately

title: hearty steak soup with noodles
steps:
1. In a large kettle , over medium heat , cook and stir steak , onion , bell peppers and garlic in oil until vegetables are tender
2. Add water , tomatoes , bouillon , basil and pepper
3. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer , covered for 40 minutes
4. Add noodles
5. Cook 5 minutes or until noodles are tender

title: to die for carbonara sauce
steps:
1. In a saucepan over low-medium heat mix first 3 ingredients together until butter is melted
2. Next start adding ingredients in the order they appear
3. The most important thing is to keep stirring so that all that cheese melts
4. Add more cream if desired
5. When everything tastes great , pour over your favorite pasta
6. Try adding in cooked chicken , red pepper , bacon , mushrooms , use your imagination

title: delicious skin baked potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Do not puncture potatoes !
3. Place potatoes individually on squares of tin foil
4. Pour 1 tbsp cooking oil over each potato
5. Season with jojo potato seasoning , or any seasoning of your liking , to taste
6. Bake at 400 degrees for approx 1 hour , depending on size / thickness of potatoes
7. For the grill: about 45 minutes cooking time

title: my famous outrageous brownies
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 180 degrees
2. Line bottom and sides of a brownie pan with aluminum foil , lightly grease with some extra butter
3. Melt butter over medium heat , whisk until just melted
4. Remove from heat and add cocoa powder , whisk until smooth and no lumps remain
5. Add sugar and continue stirring until well blended
6. Let mixture cool 2 minutes
7. Transfer to larger bowl
8. Add eggs and vanilla and mix until well blended
9. Add flour and salt , using rubber spatula stir until batter is blended
10. Scrape into prepared pan
11. Spread evenly and bake until toothpick comes out clean , about 20 minutes
12. Let cool and cut

title: japanese ginger dressing
steps:
1. Put all ingredients in a blender and blend until emulsified
2. Stir and shake before each use

title: belgian carrots
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , cover carrots with 1 inch of water & bring to a simmer for 10-12 minutes , until carrots are tender
2. Drain water from pan & toss carrots with remaining ingredients
3. Over low heat , stir carrots until sauce is heated through & serve

title: chesapeake bay classic crab cakes
steps:
1. Add the yolk , old bay , mustard , lemon zest , lemon juice , and vinegar to the bowl of a food processor or blender
2. Process until smooth
3. Gradually pour in the oil with the machine running until the mixture emulsifies and forms a mayonnaise
4. Season with the salt and pepper
5. Transfer the mayonnaise to a bowl and , using a rubber spatula , fold in the scallions and the crabmeat until well combined
6. Combine the bread crumbs and the parsley in a shallow container
7. Form the crab mixture into 8 patties about 3 inches wide and 3 / 4 inch thick and drop them into the bread crumb mixture
8. Dredge the crab cakes on both sides
9. If you have time , leave the crab cakes in the container of bread crumbs , cover with plastic wrap , and chill for an hour or so
10. When you are ready to fry the crab cakes , put 2 large nonstick skillets over medium heat
11. Add about 2 tablespoons butter to each pan
12. When the butter is melted , add 4 crab cakes to each pan , patting off excess crumbs first
13. Slowly fry the cakes until they are golden brown on both sides and hot through , turning once with a spatula , about 4 minutes per side
14. If the crab cakes are browning too quickly , reduce the heat
