15. The internal temperature of a cooked crab cake should be 155 on an instant-read thermometer
16. Transfer the crab cakes to plates , 2 per person , and serve with your choice of sauce and lemon wedges

title: tex mex rice and beans
steps:
1. Heat olive oil
2. Add onion , peppers and garlic
3. Cook until transparent
4. Add rice and toast
5. Add chicken stock and rotel
6. Bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat and simmer covered for 20 mins
8. When 20 mins is up add beans

title: pork   green chile stew  high altitude
steps:
1. Trim fat from exterior of roast
2. Cut into slices 1 inch thick
3. Trim and discard excess fat
4. You will lose about 3 / 4 lb
5. To trimmings
6. Cut trimmed pork into 1-inch cubes
7. Heat oven to 250f move top oven rack to lower-middle position
8. In 4-quart or larger dutch oven , heat 2 tablespoons oil on high until shimmering
9. Add half the cubed pork
10. Brown on all sides , about 8 minutes
11. Transfer browned pork to a bowl
12. Brown remaining pork , adding 1 tablespoon oil if needed
13. Transfer to bowl
14. Reduce heat to medium-high and add onion
15. Saute until onion begins to soften , about 4 minutes
16. Add garlic and saute until fragrant , about 30 seconds
17. Add 2 cups water , return heat to high and deglaze pan
18. Add the browned pork , tomatoes , bouillon , black pepper and remaining water
19. Bring to a boil
20. Cover dutch oven and transfer to oven
21. Bake 1 hour
22. Add green chiles and bake for another hour
23. If potatoes are desired , first separate out any green chile stew that will be frozen
24. Then add cubed boiling potatoes to remaining stew , transfer pan to stovetop and simmer until potatoes are tender
25. Serve potato-free stew over cooked rice
26. Freeze leftovers for up to 6 months

title: rosemary chicken salad sandwiches
steps:
1. Combine first 9 ingredients , stirring well
2. Spread about 2 / 3 cup of chicken mixture over each of 5 bread slices , and top with remaining bread slices
3. Cut sandwiches diagonally in half

title: saucy skillet bratwurst
steps:
1. Pre-cook the bratwurst--punch holes with a fork on all sides , then boil for about 15 minutes
2. Remove from water , and cut into small circle pieces
3. For softer , plump cooked onions--coarsely chop , put in microwave-safe bowl , add enough water just to cover onions , then cover with plastic wrap , and microwave on high for about 5 minutes , then drain
4. Put all the ingredients into a frying pan , mix thoroughly , then heat through about 5 minutes
5. Add more ketchup if necessary , based on the size of your bratwurst , enough to coat evenly and give you a bit of extra "sauce"
6. I serve this with rice , or on hamburger buns and it's good with cold salads
7. Works great !

title: jalapeo ham pinwheels
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Unroll the croissants and press perforations back together
3. Do not separate croissants
4. Spread cream cheese all over the croissants
5. Layer ham on top of cream cheese
6. Roll it all up like a roll of newspaper
7. Slice rolled loaf into 1 1 / 2 inch slices
8. Lay slices about 2 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet
9. Bake at 350f for 15-25 minutes or until bread is lightly browned
10. Enjoy !

title: chicken breasts with cranberry salsa and cilantro cream
steps:
1. Combine green onions , jalapeno , vinegar and cranberry sauce in a medium sized bowl
2. Stir in 1 tbsp of the cilantro , and 1 tbsp of the lime juice
3. Set aside
4. Combine the remaining cilantro and lime juice with the cream cheese in a small bowl , combining well
5. Set aside
6. Put each chicken breast half between plastic wrap , and flatten to about 1 / 2 inch thickness using a mallet or rolling pin
7. Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper
8. Heat medium skillet over medium high heat , cook chicken 4-5 minutes on each side , till done
9. Spoon cranberry salsa evenly into 4 serving plates
10. Top with chicken breasts , and add a dollop of cilantro cream over each chicken breast , then serve

title: buttermilk wheat pancakes
steps:
1. Put the 1 1 / 2 tablespoons lemon juice in a measuring cup and fill with milk to make 1 1 / 2 cups
2. Combine all dry ingredients and whisk together to remove any lumps and to combine everything
3. Lightly beat the egg , then add to dry ingredients
4. Add the buttermilk and mix until just combined
5. Some lumps are fine , careful to not over mix
6. Cook on hot griddle
7. Serve hot

title: simple grilled lamb chops
steps:
1. About 4 hours before you wish to serve dinner , prepare marinade: in a mixing bowl , whisk together the vinegar , fresh herbs and garlic , oil , salt and pepper
2. Pour this mixture into a large zip-lock freezer bag , add lamb chops , squeeze out all the air and seal
3. Place in a glass dish and refrigerate , turning it over at least once
4. Let marinate for three to four hours
5. Alternatively , if you don't have a zip-lock bag , marinate lamb chops in a covered glass dish
6. Shortly before you wish to serve dinner , grease grill rack and preheat grill to medium-high heat
7. Reserve marinade and place chops on preheated greased grill and cook , with a closed lid , for about 15 minutes for medium-rare-- baste with reserved marinade and turn once during cooking

title: caramelized onion and portobello mushroom soup
steps:
1. Melt 1 tablespoons butter in heavy large pot over high heat
2. Add onions and thyme
3. Saute until onions begin to soften , about 8 minutes
4. Reduce heat to low
5. Cook until onions are caramelized , stirring occasionally , about 20 minutes
6. Transfer onion mixture to medium bowl
7. Melt remaining 2 tablespoons butter in same pot over medium-high heat
8. Add mushrooms
9. Saute until soft , about 12 minutes
10. Add cognac and garlic
11. Stir 20 seconds
12. Stir in onion mixture , then broth and wine
13. Bring to boil
14. Reduce heat to low
15. Simmer until onions are very tender about 45 minutes
16. Discard thyme sprigs
17. Season soup with salt and pepper
18. Preheat broiler
19. Place baguette slices on large baking sheet
20. Spread goat cheese on baguette slices , dividing equally
21. Broil goat cheese croutons until cheese begins to brown in spots , about 30 seconds
22. Divide soup among 6 bowls
23. Top with croutons and serve

title: braised beef liver
steps:
1. Cut liver into 1 in strips
2. Soak in milk for one hour
3. Remove from milk and dredge in flour / salt mixture
4. Saute in hot oil until browned on all sides
5. Remove and set aside
6. Brown onions in same pan
7. Remove onions and set aside on top of liver
8. Add beef broth , lemon juice and sugar to hot pan and deglaze
9. Place liver and onion back into pan and cook for 5 minutes
10. Turn off heat and add sour cream
11. Serve with parsley whipped potatoes and your favorite green vegetable

title: chorizo and halloumi skewers
steps:
1. Preheat a bbq plate or chargrill to a medium heat
2. Cook chorizo for 1 minute on each side
3. Combine the lemon zest , parsley and garlic in a small bowl and set aside
4. Thread the chorizo , halloumi and olives onto the skewers and brush the skewered ingredients with oil
5. Cook the skewers , turning them occasionally , for 4-5 minutes or until the chorizo and halloumi are browned and heated through
6. Sprinkle the skewered chorizo and halloumi with the lemon mixture and serve

title: rosti with bacon  mushrooms  onion  and havarti
steps:
1. Boil the potatoes in their skins for 20 minutes , drain and leave to cool
2. Peel them and using a cheese grater , grate them into a large mixing bowl and sprinkle with salt
3. In a frying pan saute the bacon and onions and thyme
4. Add mushrooms and cook for about 5 minutes until soft
5. Combine with the potatoes and mix gently , taking care not to mash them too much
6. Heat oil in a frying pan and add 3 or 4 spoonfuls of the mixture
7. Using a spatula , pat the mixture into a round flat cake
8. Brown it over a high heat
9. When the bottom side is cooked flip it over
10. Repeat with remaining potatoes to make 6 cakes
11. Put 1 / 2 tablespoon of butter and a slice of cheese on each cake and melt under a hot grill or broiler
12. Cook's

title: crock pot hot apple cider
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a crock pot
2. Cover and simmer on low for 2-4 hours
3. Strain before serving hot
4. Serves 8

title: roast chicken with dried fruit and almonds
steps:
1. Heat 6 tablespoons olive oil in heavy large skillet over medium heat
2. Add onions and saut until deep golden brown , about 20 minutes
3. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
4. Transfer onions to large bowl
5. Mix in prunes , dates , apricots , sugar , and cinnamon
6. Do ahead can be made 1 day ahead
7. Cover and chill
8. Preheat oven to 350f spread fruit mixture over bottom of large roasting pan
9. Tuck chicken wing
10. Rub each chicken with 1 / 2 tablespoon remaining olive oil and 1 / 2 teaspoon turmeric
11. Sprinkle each with salt and pepper
12. Place chickens , side by side , atop fruit mixture
13. Pour 11 / 2 cups water around chickens
14. Roast chickens 1 hour
15. Turn pan around
16. Add more water to fruit mixture by 1 / 4 cupfuls if beginning to dry
17. Continue to roast chickens until brown and juices run clear when thigh is pierced , about 45 minutes
18. Transfer chickens to carving board
19. Let stand 10 minutes
20. Spoon fruit onto platter
21. Top with chickens and any accumulated juices
22. Sprinkle with almonds and serve

title: creamy leek   pasta dish
steps:
1. If using pasta in place of cabbage
2. Cook pasta as per package directions in salted water , drain
3. Meanwhile: in large frying pan cook leeks and bacon in butter until leeks are tender
4. If using cabbage: wedge 1 / 2 head cabbage into 4 pieces , then slice thinly
5. Place in pan with bacon , butter and leeks
6. Cook uncovered over medium heat until desired tenderness is reached , stirring occasionally
7. Add milk , seasoning to frying pan , heat through
8. Add topping if desired , serve warm
9. Also good cold !
10. For vegetarians- omit bacon
11. Gluten free- replace pasta with cabbage

title: chocolate banana bundt cake
steps:
1. Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 350f coat bundt pan with baking spray
2. Combine butter , cocoa powder , espresso powder , and water in medium saucepan and bring to boil over medium-high heat , stirring , until mixture is homogenous , about 2 minutes
3. Whisk flour , brown sugar , baking powder , baking soda , and salt together in large bowl , then , mix in cocoa mixture
4. Whisk in bananas and sour cream , then eggs and vanilla
5. Stir in walnuts
6. Scrape batter into prepared pan and bake until tester inserted in center of cake comes out clean , about 45 minutes
7. Transfer cake to cooling rack and cool 10 minutes , then invert directly onto rack and cool to room temperature , about 1 hour
8. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar and serve

title: slow cooker pasta fagioli soup
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except for pasta in crock pot
2. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours or on high for 4 hours
3. Cook pasta in a pot of boiling water according to package directions , drain , then combine with soup and serve

title: fresh salmon cakes
steps:
1. Using sharp knife , cut flesh off skin , then discard skin
2. Chop salmon flesh into 1 / 4- to 1 / 3-inch pieces and mix with chopped bread , mayonnaise , onion , parsley , salt , and lemon juice in medium bowl
3. Scoop a generous 1 / 4-cup portion salmon mixture from bowl and use hands to form into a patty measuring roughly 2 1 / 2-inches in diameter and 3 / 4-inch thick
4. Place on parchment-lined baking sheet and repeat with remaining salmon mixture until you have 8 patties
5. Place patties in freezer until surface moisture has evaporated , about 15 minutes
6. Meanwhile , spread flour in pie plate or shallow baking dish
7. Beat eggs with 1 1 / 2 teaspoons vegetable oil and 1 1 / 2 teaspoons water in second pie plate or shallow baking dish , and spread bread crumbs in a third
8. Dip chilled salmon patties in flour to cover
9. Shake off excess
10. Transfer to beaten egg and , using slotted spatula , turn to coat
11. Let excess drip off
12. Transfer to bread crumbs
13. Shake pan to coat patties completely
14. Return now-breaded patties to baking sheet
15. They can be frozen at this point , then bagged together to cook from frozen when you want them
16. Double cooking time if frozen
17. Heat remaining 1 / 2 cup vegetable oil in large , heavy-bottomed skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering but not smoking , about 3 minutes
18. Add salmon patties and cook until medium golden brown , about 2 minutes
19. Flip cakes over and continue cooking until medium golden brown on second side , about 2 minutes longer
20. Transfer cakes to plate lined with paper towels to absorb excess oil on surface , if desired , about 30 seconds , and then serve immediately

title: mushrooms and watercress in mustard dressing
steps:
1. For the dressing , mix together the oil , vinegars , mustard , tarragon , salt and pepper , and chives
2. Add the mushrooms to the dressing , mixing lightly
3. Add several sprigs of watercress
4. Chill briefly
5. Arrange the remaining watercress or butter lettuce on a platter and and mound the mushroom salad on top

title: spice rubbed tilapia with tomatillo  black bean and mango salad
steps:
1. Put a heatproof serving platter on a rack in the center of the oven and heat the oven to 200 degrees f
2. In a medium bowl , combine the beans , tomatillos , mango , red onion , lime juice , 1 / 3 cup vegetable oil , cilantro , and a few grinds of black pepper
3. Toss gently
4. Let the salad sit at room temperature while you cook the fish
5. Mix 1 / 4 teaspoons black pepper with the chili powder , cumin , oregano , and 1 teaspoons salt
6. Rub both sides of the fillets with the mixture
7. In a large nonstick skillet , heat the remaining 2 tablespoons oil over medium-high heat until hot
8. Cook two of the fillets until lightly browned and the flesh is opaque and cooked through , about 2 minutes on each side
9. Transfer the fish to the platter in the oven to keep warm while you cook the remaining fish
10. Transfer the fillets to the platter , and spoon half of the salad on top
11. Serve with the remaining salad on the side

title: dump coke bbq chicken  oamc
steps:
1. Mix barbecue sauce , garlic powder , onion powder , coke , salt and pepper in large freezer bag
2. Add chicken
3. Freeze
4. When ready to serve thaw in fridge
5. Cook in oven or grill
6. In oven , place in pan sprayed with pam
7. Cook at 350 for about 30 minutes
8. Baste with marinade during cooking

title: slice  n  go oatmeal
steps:
1. Coat a 9" x 5" loaf pan with nonstick cooking spray
2. In a large saucepan , bring the water and salt to a boil over high heat
3. Stir in the oats , and cook for 1 minute
4. Remove from the heat and stir in the brown sugar and raisins
5. Pour the oat mixture into the loaf pan , cover , and chill for at least 6 hours , or overnight
6. Remove loaf from the pan and cut into 1-inch-thick slices
7. In a large skillet , melt 1 tablespoon butter over medium heat
8. Cook the oatmeal slices for 2 to 3 minutes per side , or until golden and heated through , adding more butter as necessary
9. Serve:
10. Topped with additional brown sugar or warm maple syrup

title: me mas scouse
steps:
1. In a large saucepan heat oil over medium heat
2. Fry carrot & onion in heated oil until onion is soft & translucent
3. Add mince & stir gently until browned , taking care not to break mince up too much
4. Barely cover with water and add stock cubes
5. Add potatoes and more water if necessary to barely cover
6. Simmer for as long as possible , stirring regularly and adding more water if necessary
7. Serve with bread and butter

title: jana s church enchiladas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Brown ground beef and onion
3. After meat is finished , add taco seasoning
4. In a saucepan , combine soup , milk , green chilies , velveeta and onion dip
5. Heat on low till creamy
6. Fill tortillas with spoonful of meat , roll and put seamside down
7. Pour creamy mixture over tortillas in a 9x13 pan
8. Cook at 350 for 20-30 minutes

title: the renowned mr  brown
steps:
1. The night before you plan to barecue , combine the rub ingredients in a small bowl
2. Massage the pork well with about half of the rub
3. Transfer to plastic bag and refrigerate over night
4. Before you begin to barbecue , remove pork from refrigerator , and let sit at room temp for 30-45 minutes
5. Prepare the smoker for barbecuing , bringing the temp to 200-225 degrees
6. Stir remaining rub together with the sop ingredients , and 1 cup of water in a saucepan , and warm the mixture over low heat
7. Transfer the pork to the smoker and cook it for about 1 and 1 / 2 hours per pound , or until it's falling-apart tender
8. Mop the pork every 1 and 1 / 2- two hours , or as appropriate for your smoking method
9. [ihad a six pound butt which took about 12 hours to cook- when ready , it was black and burnt looking on the outside , and the internal temp was almost 180-degrees
10. ]remove the pork from the smoker , wrap tightly in tinfoil , and let sit for at least 30 minutes
11. Remove from foil , and roughly chop or'pull' the pork , mixing well the black , crispy extrior , with the butter-soft interior meat
12. Add a small portion of your favourite bbq sauce and mix well- you generally will need much less than you would think
13. Place into holding container , cover with foil , and place back into smoker for 20 or so minutes
14. This is so good , a cwb would take away from the pure pork pleasure
15. Serve with your favourite cole slaw and icy cold beer

title: cardamom carrots
steps:
1. Place carrots and salt in large saucepan and add enough water to just cover carrots
2. Bring to a boil and reduce heat
3. Cover , and simmer for 7-9 minutes or until crisp-tender
4. Drain and set aside
5. In large skillet melt butter
6. Whisk in brown sugar , cardamom and orange peel
7. Cook , and stir over medium heat for 1-2 minutes or until sauce is thickened
8. Add carrots to skillet , toss to coat , and serve hot

title: corn  n  chicken bake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375f coat a 9" x 13" baking dish with nonstick cooking spray
2. Place the chicken breast halves in a single layer in the baking dish , and season with the garlic powder , salt , and pepper
3. In a large bowl , combine the stuffing mix , corn , water , and melted butter
4. Mix well and spoon over the chicken
5. In the same bowl , combine the soup , milk , and parsley
6. Mix well
7. Pour over the stuffing , then cover with aluminum foil and bake for 35 minutes
8. Uncover and bake for 8 to 10 more minutes , or until no pink remains in the chicken and the stuffing is golden

title: honey water
steps:
1. Combine the wine and the honey in a bowl and mix well
2. Add the cinnamon stick
3. Cover and let stand in the sun for 3 days
4. Remove the cinnamon
5. Pour into a glass jar and seal
6. Let stand 3 more days in the sun

title: three cheese shortbreads
steps:
1. Beat the butter until light and fluffy
2. Stir in the three cheeses , cayenne pepper , mustard powder , and flour
3. Mix well
4. If the dough is too crumbly , add milk tablespoon by tablespoon , until the dough holds together
5. Pat the dough into a disc and refrigerate for 1 hour
6. Preheat the oven to 300f
7. Roll the dough out into a large 1 / 4-inch thick circle
8. Use a scalloped cookie cutter to cut out the shortbreads
9. Place on a greased cookie sheet and bake 30 to 35 minutes until golden brown

title: grilled tomato sauce with garlic
steps:
1. Toss the tomatoes with a little oil to coat them , then grill , broil , or sear in a heavy skillet until wrinkled and charred in places
2. Toast the oregano in a dry skillet until fragrant , then remove to a dish
3. Toss the garlic cloves with enough oil to coat lightly , then put them in the same skillet
4. Cover and cook over medium heat , shaking the pan occasionally , until browned on the outside and tender when pressed
5. Peel the garlic when cool enough to handle
6. Puree the tomatoes and garlic in a blender until smooth
7. Heat 2 tbls
8. Oil in a wide , deep skillet over medium high heat
9. Pour in the tomato sauce and add the oregano
10. Simmer the sauce , stirring frequently , until it's thickened , about 10 minutes
11. Season with salt to taste
12. Variation:
13. Grilled tomato sauce with chiles
14. Toast 2 ancho chiles in a 300f
15. Oven until puffed and fragrant , about 3 minutes
16. Remove the stems , seeds , and veins , tear the pods into pieces , and puree in a blender with the tomatoes and garlic

title: grandmother johansen s buttermilk biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f stir together all dry ingredients add lard or shortening and mix with dry ingredients until crumbly
2. Add 1 pint buttermilk as needed and mix in carefully until dry ingredients are wet
3. Don't overmix
4. Flour hands , and mix 8 to 10 times until a ball forms
5. Don't overhandle
6. Roll dough out 3 / 4" to 1 1 / 2" thickness
7. Cut into shape , and squash together into a well greased pan
8. Place in oven and reduce heat to 375 degrees f or 350 degrees
9. Bake for 25 minutes to 35 minutes until golden
10. Brush with butter when done

title: healthier baked oatmeal
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Combine all ingredients and pour in 9x13 dish
3. Bake 30-45 minutes

title: rikki s beef and leeks
steps:
1. Saute onions in oil and butter for about 5 minutes
2. Add ground beef and brown
3. Add leeks , stock , mustard , salt and paprika
4. Cover and simmer on low heat for about 15 , stir often
5. Add half and half and simmer for about 2 more minutes
6. Season to taste
7. Serve over egg noodles

title: 7 minute frosting
steps:
1. Combine egg whites , water , sugar , cream of tartar and salt in top of double boiler
2. Set over simmering water and beat with an electric mixer for about 5 minutes
3. Until soft peaks are formed
4. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla
5. Keep beating until frosting is stiff enough to spread
6. Use immediately
7. Plenty enough to fill and frost he 2-layer devil's food cake

title: irish sour cream bread
steps:
1. Sift first 3 ingredients together in large bowl
2. Mix next 5 ingredients in smaller bowl
3. Slowly mix bowl #2 ingredients into bowl #1 until well blended
4. Mix in 2 cups of raisins
5. Pour into 9" greased and floured round cake pan and shape into round loaf
6. Sprinkle the top with cinnamon and / or sugar , if desired
7. With a sharp knife , make an "x" in the top of loaf
8. Bake for 50-55 minutes at 350 degrees
9. When toothpick comes out clean , the bread is done

title: vegetarian hearty soup
steps:
1. In dutch oven heat oil over medium heat
2. Add onions , carrots , celery , garlic , cumin , salt , hot pepper flakes
3. Saute until onions are soft
4. Add water and bring to a boil , reduce heat to low-medium
5. Add sweet potatoes , tomatoes , chickpeas , beans , bay leaves , cinnamon , paprika
6. Simmer for 10 minutes covered
7. Add pasta , stir , cover and simmer for another 15 minutes
8. Before serving , give it a good stir
9. Remove bay leaves , and cinnamon stick
10. Serve with bread

title: grilled asparagus medley
steps:
1. In a disposable foil pan , combine the veggies , olives , and garlic
2. Drizzle with oil and toss to coat
3. Sprinkle with parsley , salt , peppers , and dill
4. Toss to coat
5. Grill over indirect medium heat for 20-25 minutes or till veggies are crisp tender , stirring occasionally

title: ricky skaggs best ever  cake
steps:
1. Cake:
2. Mix all ingredients together by hand
3. Pour into a greased and floured 9x13x2 inch pan
4. Bake at 350 for 35 minutes
5. Frosting
6. Mix all ingredients together by hand
7. Frost cake when cooled
8. Sprinkle frosted cake with pecans

title: warm lamb and pasta salad
steps:
1. Combine lamb , oil , 1 tsp of the sugar , juice , wine , sauce , garlic and rosemary in bowl , cover , refrigerate 3 hours or overnight
2. Drain lamb , reserve marinade
3. Place tomatoes in single layer on an oven tray , sprinkle with remaining sugar
4. Bake , uncovered , in moderate oven for 20 minutes
5. Meanwhile , add pasta to large pan of boiling water , boil , uncovered , until just tender
6. Drain
7. Coat non-stick pan with cooking oil spray , add lamb in batches , cook until browned and tender
8. Return lamb to pan , add reserved marinade , stock and parsley , stir until mixture boils
9. Gently toss with pasta , tomatoes and spinach

title: south beach diet bacon egg muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In an x-large muffin pan , spray each muffin cup with olive oil cooking spray
3. Place one piece of canadian bacon in the bottom of each muffin cup
4. Crack an egg over the piece of bacon in each muffin cup
5. Sprinkle the italian seasoning and pepper over the egg in each muffin cup
6. Sprinkle the cheese over the egg in each muffin cup
7. Place in preheated oven and cook for 15 minutes or until the cheese is slightly brown on top

title: el cheapo quesadilla
steps:
1. Spray a grill pan with nonstick spray
2. Cube up the deli meat
3. Place tortilla into grill pan and sprinkle cheese over half the tortilla , then add cubed meat and the jalapeno's
4. Fold tortilla in half to cover the cheese so you have a half moon
5. Grill on both sides till browned , crispy and heated thru
6. Serve with salsa

title: sam s ramen soup
steps:
1. Boil water in sauce pan
2. Cook pot stickers until tender
3. Usually 10 minutes
4. Add ramen noodles
5. As soon as noodles begin to slightly soften , add egg and stir
6. Turn heat up to high
7. Add ramen seasoning , black pepper , soy sauce and saffron
8. Season to taste
9. Cook until noodles are tender and egg has cooked through

title: really easy make ahead lasagna for two
steps:
1. Mix all the filling ingredients together reserving 1 / 2 cup of mozzarella for the top of the lasagna
2. Put 1 / 2 cup of sauce in the bottom of an 8 x 8 brownie pan or casserole dish
3. Layer noodles over sauce and spoon 1 / 3 of the cheese mixture onto the noodles and then spoon on more sauce
4. Layer noodles for the second layer in the opposite direction , add 1 / 3 of the filling on top and then more sauce
5. Repeat until the pan is full
6. Cover the top layer of noodles with remaining sauce and 1 / 2 cup of mozzarella cheese
7. Cover with plastic wrap and store in the refrigerator for up to 2 days
8. To bake:
9. Remove the lasagna from the fridge 1 / 2 hour before baking
10. Remove plastic wrap and cover the dish with foil
11. Preheat the oven to 350 and bake about 45 minutes to an hour until the lasagne tests hot
12. If you like a crunchy top just uncover for about 15 minutes

title: broccoli bread
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients well
2. Spoon into round cast iron skillet sprayed with pam
3. Bake at 425 degrees for 25- 30 minutes
4. Let stand for 3-5 minutes after cooking to ease in cutting and pan removal

title: bacon tater tots bake
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine soup , sour cream and onion
2. Add the bacon and tater tots
3. Stir until combined
4. Transfer to a greased 13-in
5. X 9-in
6. X 2-in
7. Baking dish
8. Cover and bake at 350 for 50 minutes
9. Uncover and bake 8-10 minutes longer or until golden brown

title: basil pistachio pesto  raw recipe
steps: 1. Place all ingredients in a blender , and process until smooth

title: tex mex brisket
steps:
1. In a large dutch oven , place brisket , sprinkle both sides with the spices and coat generously with liquid smoke
2. Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight
3. The next day , preheat oven to 250 degrees
4. In a saucepan , bring all ingredients for sauce to a boil and simmer until sugar is dissolved
5. Discard any remaining marinade
6. Generously coat brisket with sauce
7. Cover with foil
8. Bake 5 to 6 hours
9. Let the brisket'rest' at least 15 minutes before slicing
10. Remember to always slice a brisket across the grain
11. The grain always runs across the short side of the brisket

title: peppery grilled chicken
steps:
1. Combine the ingredients in a large zip lock bag and add the chicken
2. Marinade for a minimum of 2 hours or up to 1 day
3. Grill or bake the chicken until cooked

title: crab broccoli bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Spray 8x8-inch baking dish with cooking spray
3. Place broccoli in bottom of dish
4. Add flaked crab and onion
5. Combine mayonnaise , mustard and italian seasoning
6. Spread over top of crab mixture
7. Sprinkle with cheese
8. Bake for 20 minutes , or until heated through

title: custard with kiwi
steps:
1. In a saucepan combine 1 / 3 cup of the sugar and the cornstarch
2. Stir in the milk and ook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until mixture thickens and comes to a boil
3. Reduce heat to low
4. Add egg yolks , one at a time , beating after each one
5. Simmer for one more minute
6. Remove from heat and add vanilla
7. Cool custard and refrigerate until cold
8. To prepare meringue , in a saucepan , combine egg whites , remaining sugar , water and cream of tartar , beating with portable beaters or a whisk
9. Cook over low heat until egg whites reach 160 degrees f but do not boil
10. Pour into bowl of electric mixer and continue beating until softr peaks form
11. To serve: line dessert dishes with sliced kiwi , spoon custard over fruit and top with merinque

title: strawberry tea
steps:
1. Combine tea bags and boiling water in a large pitcher
2. Cover and steep 10 minutes
3. Remove and discard tea bags
4. Add sugar and lemon juice , stirring until sugar dissolves
5. Cover and chill thoroughly
6. Stir in cranberry-strawberry drink
7. Serve over ice

title: my favorite taco salad
steps:
1. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add ground beef and onions and cook , breaking up any lumps of meat until no longer pink
3. Add taco seasoning mix and 1 / 4 cup water
4. Stir and cook for 1 minute more
5. Mix in black beans and cook until beans are heated
6. Combine lettuce , tomatoes , avocado and cheese in a large salad bowl
7. Add meat mixture to salad bowl and toss ingredients well with salad dressing
8. Add in chips , toss and serve immediately
9. Serve with additional salad dressing if desired

title: grilled rosemary garlic pork chops
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients for marinade in a shallow pan
2. Add chops and toss well with mixture to coat evenly
3. Let marinate refrigerated for 4 hours , then return to room temperature before grilling
4. Grill over medium high heat for about 20 minutes

title: the works steak burger
steps:
1. Mix together ground beef , steak seasoning , ketchup and bacon
2. Shape into 4 patties
3. Brush onion slices with oil and place patties and onion on grill
4. Grill for 8 to 12 minutes or until burgers are done , turning once
5. Add cheese slices to burgers one minute before cooking time is done
6. Place on rolls and top with onions , lettuce and tomato slices

title: peanut butter and tomato toast
steps:
1. Toast bread
2. Spread with peanut butter
3. Top with tomato
4. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
5. Eat and enjoy

title: ham relish for tea sandwiches
steps:
1. Soak the raisins in warm water for 10 minutes and then chop in food processor until no raisins remain whole
2. Add the ham and continue processing for 1 minute longer , until mixture is smooth and no ham pieces are left whole
3. Place mixture in a mixing bowl and add the remaining ingredients
4. Will keep in the refrigerator for up to 3 days

title: aloha smoothie
steps:
1. Place ingredients in blender and blend until smooth
2. Serve immediately

title: buttermilk mixed berry muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Grease a 12 - 2 3 / 4 x 1 1 / 2 inch muffin cups
3. In a large measuring cup or bowl whisk together the egg , buttermilk , oil , and vanilla extract
4. In another large bowl combine the flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda , salt , and orange zest
5. Gently fold in the berries
6. With a rubber spatula fold the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir only until the ingredients are combined
7. Do not over mix the batter or tough muffins will result
8. When filling the muffin cups , trying using two spoons to prevent the batter from dropping outside the cup
9. Place in the oven and bake until a toothpick inserted in the center of a muffin comes out clean , 20 to 25 minutes
10. Transfer to a wire rack and let cool for about 5 minutes before removing from pan

title: red potatoes with butter and chives
steps:
1. Bring a 2 quart sauce pot half full of water to a boil
2. While water is coming to a boil dice potatoes to 1 / 4 inch cubes
3. Add cubed potatoes to boiling water and cook on a slow boil until just fork tender
4. Drain in a colander and return potatoes to pot
5. Add butter cubes and gently stir until butter has melted
6. Stir in minced chives and season to taste with salt and pepper

title: herbed monkey bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Lightly butter a 12-cup bundt pan
3. Set aside
4. In a small bowl , combine cheese and italian seasoning
5. Roll each individual biscuit into a ball
6. Dip each piece in the 1 stick of melted butter , then coat with the cheese mixture
7. Place dough into prepared pan
8. Overlapping will occur
9. Bake bread , 30 to 35 minutes
10. Cover with aluminum foil during the last 10 minutes of baking to prevent excess browning , if needed
11. Let cool in pan , 10 minutes
12. Invert bread onto a serving plate
13. Drizzle remaining 1 / 4 cup melted butter on top and sprinkle with grated parmesan

title: smoked tomatoes
steps:
1. Drizzle the tomatoes with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper
2. Prepare a stovetop smoker according to the manufacturer's instructions
3. Smoke the tomatoes for 20 to 30 minutes
4. They will keep , covered , in the refrigerator for up to 5 days

title: cornmeal cake
steps:
1. Pre-heat the oven at 200c
2. Lightly oil a non-stick 30 cm cake pan
3. Mix the eggs yolk with sugar and oil
4. Boil the milk and pour on the cornmeal , on a separated bowl , mixing well
5. Mix this to the eggs mixture
6. Sift the flour with the baking powder and add to the mixture
7. On a clean bowl whisk the eggs white and fold into the mixture
8. Pour this to the prepared pan and bake for 30 minutes or until the tester come out clean

title: caramelized apple and toasted walnut brie
steps:
1. Melt butter in 10" non-stick skillet over medium heat
2. Add apples and sugar
3. Saute' , tossing occasionally , until apples are soft and golden brown , about 12 minutes
4. Let apples cool slightly
5. Carefully place chopped apples over cheese
6. Sprinkle with walnuts
7. May be served right away , or chill if it is to be served later
8. May be prepared several hours in advance
9. Serve at room temperature
10. Accompany with assorted crackers and bread slices

title: sloppy moms
steps:
1. In a medium skillet , heat olive oil over medium heat
2. Add sirloin and brown , breaking up with a fork as it cooks
3. Add onion , bell pepper , tomato , salt , and red pepper flakes
4. Cook for 10 minutes , stirring occasionally , until liquid is almost absorbed but mixture is still moist
5. Remove from heat and stir in the peanut butter
6. Serve on toasted hamburger buns

title: beef   mozzarella bake
steps:
1. In skillet over medium-high heat , cook beef , basil , pepper and garlic until meat is browned
2. Stir in soups , water and 1 cup of the cheese
3. Add macaroni
4. Pour into a 2 quart baking dish and cover with remaining cheese
5. Bake at 400 degrees for 25 minutes

title: light lemon tart
steps:
1. Place flour and butter in a food processor and process until mixture resembles coarse breadcrumbs
2. Add icing sugar , oil , egg yolk and 1 1 / 2 to 2 tablespoon cold water and process until mixture just forms a ball
3. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface , knead lightly and shape into a disc and roll out to a 25cm round and ease into a 2cm deep 23cm loose base flan pan and trim edges and lightly prick base with a fork and chill for 10 minutes
4. Preheat oven to 190c to 170c fan force and place pan on a baking tray and line pastry with baking paper and fill with pastry weights , rice or dried beans and bake for 15 minutes and then remove paper and weights and bake for another 5 minutes or until pale golden in colour
5. Meanwhile , to make filling , whisk eggs and eggwhites until well combines
6. Sift icing sugar into a bowl and then gradually whisk in egg and stir in lemon rind and juice
7. Strain through a fine sieve and add sour cream and whisk until smooth
8. Carefully pour into warm pastry case
9. Reduce oven to 150c or 130c fan forced and bake tart for 25 to 30 minutes until just set and still wobbly in centre
10. Cool for 1 hour and dust with extra icing sugar
11. Serve chilled or at room temperature

title: briam  new and improved      melt in your mouth good
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In a casserole dish layer half of the ingredients in order except for the oil , seasoning with salt and pepper as you layer repeat with remaining half of the ingredients
3. Top with oil and bake uncovered for about 1 1 / 2 hour
4. The top will be crisp and the inside soft and melt in your mouth !

title: cheesy beef and bean enchiladas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Stir the soup , sour cream , picante / salsa and chili powder in a medium bowl , set aside
3. Stir 1 cup of soup mixture , beef , beans and 1 / 2 cup cheese in a large bowl
4. Divide the beef mixture among the tortillas
5. Roll up the tortillas and place them seamside up on a 11 x 8" shallow baking dish
6. Pour the remaining soup mixture over the filled tortillas
7. Top with remaining cheese
8. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes or until the enchiladas are hot and bubbling
9. Top with the tomato and onion , if desired

title: cream cheese pastry
steps:
1. In a large bowl cream together cream cheese and butter
2. Slowly sift in flour and salt
3. Shape into 2 balls , wrap in plastic and chill for at least 3 hours or overnight in the fridge
4. Roll out on a floured board and use as you will

title: betty crocker liver with piquant sauce
steps:
1. Liver instructions:
2. Cut liver into serving pieces
3. Place flour , garlic salt , paprika and pepper in plastic or paper bag
4. Shake liver in bag until well coated
5. Melt shortening in medium skillet
6. Brown liver quickly on both sides , about 5 minutes
7. Remove to warm platter
8. Keep warm while preparing piquant sauce
9. Add liver to sauce
10. Heat through
11. Piquant sauce instructions:
12. In same skillet , cook and stir onion in shortening until onion is crisp-tender , about 2 minutes
13. Blend water , cornstarch , and soy sauce
14. Pour into skillet
15. Cook , stirring constantly , until sauce thickens and boils
16. Boil and stir 1 minute

title: apple  cranberry and walnut bread
steps:
1. Place oats into a bowl , pour over milk and soak for 30 minutes
2. Preheat oven to 180 degrees
3. Sift flour and baking powder into a large bowl
4. Add the oat mix , cranberries , apple , sugar , spices , honey and mix well
5. Spoon into a 900gm non-stick or greased loaf tin and sprinkle with the walnuts
6. Bake for 45 minutes or until golden brown and skewer comes out clean
7. Remove form oven and place on cooling rack

title: gram s chinese pepper steak
steps:
1. Sear steak strips in oil in a large skillet or dutch oven
2. Add celery , peppers , and onion to the meat in the skillet and stir fry for 5 minutes
3. Add the black pepper , pepper flakes , ginger , salt , brown sugar , thyme , and water
4. Turn the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes
5. Then add the can of tomatoes
6. Mix the brown sugar , cornstarch , soy sauce , and 1 / 4 cup of water together and then add to the meat and vegetables
7. Stir gently while the sauce thickens
8. Serve over rice or mashed potatoes

title: hot molasses cider
steps:
1. Insert cloves into lemon slices
2. In a medium pan , bring lemon slices , apple cider , molasses and cinnamon stick to a boil
3. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes
4. Discard cinnamon stick --
5. Stir in lemon juice
6. Serve immediately

title: maple   orange chicken with peppered pecans
steps:
1. Mix orange juice , mustard , garlic , maple syrup , sunflower oil and vinegar in a bowl
2. Marinade chicken for at least 4 hours , but overnight is even better
3. For the pecans , melt the butter , and stir in tabasco , pepper flakes and garlic
4. Stir in the pecans
5. Spread onto a flat baking sheet and bake on a really low temp - approx 120c for an hour
6. Be careful that the pecans don't burn though
7. After marinading , remove the chicken and pour marinade into a small pan , bring to the boil , stirring until the marinade reduces to a sticky glaze
8. The oil will stop the maple syrup from burning
9. Grill or barbecue the chicken breasts , turning and brushing with the glaze regularly until the chicken is cooked but still juicy
10. Serve the chicken with the remaining glaze as a sauce , along with the peppered pecans and whatever else takes your fancy

title: caraway cheese loaf
steps:
1. In a small mixing bowl , toss together the swiss cheese and the first bread flour add the swiss cheese mixture and the remaining ingredients to the machine according to the manufacturer's directions
2. Select the basic white bread cycle

title: greek skordaila
steps:
1. Place all ingredients except oil and pepper in a food processor and pulse a few times to mix
2. Add oil 1 t
3. At a time , pulsing to smooth
4. When smooth and all the oil is incorporated into the potato mixture taste and add pepper
5. Place in a bowl and chill for a few hours , remove and bring to room temp to serve

title: the essential chewy sugar cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Lightly grease two baking sheets
3. In a big bowl , beat the butter , sugar , brown sugar , corn syrup , vanilla , nutmeg , baking powder , baking soda , salt , and egg together
4. Stir in the flour
5. Add coarse sugar to a shallow dish
6. Drop the dough by the tablespoonful into the sugar , rolling the balls to coat them
7. Place them on prepared cookie sheets
8. Bake for 10 minutes , until the edges are just barely beginning to brown
9. They will look soft
10. If you bake the cookies too long , theyll be crunchy , not chewy
11. Remove from oven and cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes , then transfer them to a rack to cool completely

title: pizza tarts
steps:
1. Mix first 2 ingredients together to form a dough
2. Roll out and cut 12 circles with a round cookie cutter or glass
3. Put 1 circle of dough into each section of a muffin tin
4. Mix remaining ingredients together
5. Fill cups evenly with mixture
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes or until biscuits brown around edges and cheese in the filling melts
7. To freeze: flash freeze on a cookie sheet
8. Transfer to ziploc bag , and label
9. To serve: heat in microwave or oven until warm

title: italian pasta supper
steps:
1. Cook pasta in boiling salted water for 6 minutes
2. Drain and set aside
3. Meanwhile , in a dutch oven or large skillet , saute the italian sausage over medium heat until browned
4. Remove from the skillet and reserve 1 t of the drippings
5. Saute the onion and garlic in reserved drippings until soft
6. Stir in drained olives and mushrooms
7. Return meat to the skillet
8. Turn heat to low
9. Stir in the jar of pasta sauce , the italian seasoning , and the drained noodles
10. Add the ricotta cheese and stir until creamy
11. Spoon into a greased 3 quart baking dish
12. Bake , covered , at 350 degrees for 20 minutes
13. Uncover , sprinkle with mozzerella , and bake for 15 minutes more or until cheese is melted

title: ginger apple chicken stir fry
steps:
1. Heat sesame oil in nonstick skillet or wok
2. Add garlic and ginger , and stir for about 30 seconds
3. Add chicken and cook in hot oil 4 to 5 minutes , or until chicken is no longer pink
4. Remove chicken from skillet
5. Add pea pods , red pepper , and mushrooms , and cook , stirring , until tender-crisp , about 3 minutes
6. Sprinkle with pepper
7. Combine applesauce , vinegar , soy sauce , cornstarch , and chicken broth
8. Add chicken to vegetables , add sauce mixture and sliced apples , and cook until sauce is thickened and clear , about 4 minutes
9. Serve over steamed rice

title: butternut squash and barley risotto
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , bring the broth to a boil
2. Cover , and reduce heat to low
3. Heat oil in a medium sized pot over medium heat
4. Add onion and saut until tender
5. Add squash and saut for another 3 minutes
6. Add barley and stir for 2 more minutes
7. Add 1 / 2 cup of the boiled broth , and chopped sage
8. Simmer , stirring often until broth is absorbed , about 5 minutes
9. Add remaining broth slowly , about 1 / 3 cup at a time , allowing it to be absorbed each time
10. Cook barley until tender but still firm , about 35-40 minutes
11. Remove from heat and stir in parmesan cheese and parsley
12. Season with salt and pepper to taste

title: best ever broccoli cheese casserole bake
steps:
1. Steam broccoli until tender and place in casserole dish
2. In mixing bowl stir together mushroom soup , salt and pepper and cheese , spread over broccoli
3. In separate mixing bowl cut margarine into bread crumbs and then sprinkle over the mushroom soup and cheese mixture
4. Bake at 350 degrees for 25-30 minutes

title: 7 layer jello
steps:
1. Very lightly grease a 9"x12" pan
2. Mix 1 box jello and 1 package gelatin with 1 cup boiling water
3. Pour into pan and refrigerate until set , about 20 minutes
4. While first layer is setting , dissolve 2 packages gelatin in 1 / 4 cup cold water
5. Add 1 can sweetened condensed milk and 1 3 / 4 cup boiling water
6. Cool to room temperature
7. Pour 1 cup milk mixture over the first jello layer
8. Refrigerate until set
9. Repeat step 1 with the next jello flavor , making sure it's at room temperature before carefully pouring over the milk layer
10. Alternate jello and milk layers , ending with the last jello flavor
11. Keep in mind that as you add more layers it will take longer to set
12. The jello layers can be mixed up before they are needed to save time , but don't do them all at once at the beginning or they may start gelling before you have a chance to pour them into the pan
13. Once all the layers are set , cut the jello into 2" squares or , for fun shapes , use small cookie or canape cutters

title: stuffed french bread sandwiches
steps:
1. Cut loaf of bread in half lengthwise
2. Hollow out bottom of loaf , leaving a 1 / 2 inch shell
3. Cut removed bread into small cubes
4. Set aside
5. In a large skillet , over medium-high heat , cook ground beef , onion , and garlic until meat is no longer pink and veggies are translucent
6. Add soup , celery , worcestershire sauce , salt and pepper to taste
7. Cook and stir for 3-4 minutes
8. Add in reserved bread crumbs
9. Stir to combine
10. Spread mixture into bread shell
11. Top with cheese slices
12. Replace bread top
13. Place on an ungreased baking sheet
14. Bake at 350 degrees for 6-8 minutes or until cheese is melted
15. Slice and serve

title: mama s fried chicken
steps:
1. Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper
2. Place chicken in shallow dish or ziploc plastic bag
3. Add buttermilk
4. Cover or seal , and chill at least 2 hours
5. Remove chicken from buttermilk , discarding buttermilk
6. Dredge chicken in flour
7. Pour oil to a depth of 1 1 / 2 inches in a deep skillet or dutch oven
8. Heat to 360f
9. Add chicken , a few pieces at a time
10. Cover and cook 6 minutes
11. Uncover chicken and cook 9 minutes
12. Turn chicken
13. Cover and cook 6 minutes
14. Uncover and cook 5 to 9 minutes , turning the chicken the last 3 minutes for even browning , if necessary
15. Drain on paper towels
16. Test chicken with meat thermometer or by piercing thickest portion with fork
17. When juices run clear it is done

title: tanya s tortilla pie
steps:
1. Fry the ground beef in a medium-sized skillet
2. Add the onion , green pepper and jalapeno once the ground beef is light gray
3. Shred the cheese and mix the two cheeses together
4. Make sure the beef is cooked thoroughly and then turn off the heat and stir in 1 cup enchilada sauce
5. Put one tortilla on the bottom of a non-stick 8" cake pan
6. Spread half of the refried beans evenly on the tortilla
7. Sprinkle 1 / 4 of the cheese on top and then cover it with a tortilla
8. Spread the beef mixture on top and then cover it with a 1 / 4 of the cheese
9. Add another tortilla , cover it with the rest of the refried beans and 1 / 4 of the cheese
10. Add the last tortilla
11. Spread 1 / 4 cup enchilada sauce evenly on top
12. Add the rest of the cheese
13. Cook at 350 degrees for 20-25 minutes or until your pie is hot and bubbly
14. Cut into quarters
15. Let diners add their own combination of sour cream , salsa , and guacamole on top

title: yosi s israeli salad
steps:
1. Finely chop the vegetables
2. Lightly mix with the remaining ingredients
3. Serve at room temperature

title: cinco de mango chicken quesadillas
steps:
1. Cook chicken on lightly oiled grill over medium heat for about 5 minutes on each side or until lightly charred and cooked through
2. Let chicken cool slightly and cut into strips
3. Puree the tomato sauce and dried pepper in food processor or blender
4. Transfer to small saucepan and simmer over medium heat for 15 minutes
5. Add grilled chicken to the pan and toss well to coat
6. Season to taste with salt
7. Place flour tortillas on a flat surface
8. Top half of each tortilla with equal amounts of cheese , mango , bell pepper , green onion and chicken
9. Fold over tortilla
10. Cook in large skillet on both sides until cheese is melted and tortilla is crisp
11. Serve with mango salsa

title: sweet spice blend
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a small bowl
2. Store in an airtight container

title: english apple cinnamon coffee cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease a 9x13 springform pan
3. Beat butter and brown sugar until fluffy ,
4. Add lemon juice & eggs , beat well
5. In another bowl , stir together the flours and cinnamon
6. Fold flour mixture into brown sugar mixture , add milk & raisins
7. Pour batter into 9 x 13 springform pan
8. Arrange apples on top
9. Bake 1 hour
10. After taking cake out of oven brush with warm honey and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar

title: shredded beef soft tacos  crock pot
steps:
1. Put meat in slow cooker
2. Add onions and bell pepper
3. In a medium bowl , whisk together wine , ketchup , vinegar , garlic , bouillon granules , bay leaves , liquid smoke , tsp cumin , hot pepper sauce and pepper
4. Pour wine mixture into slow cooker , cover tightly and cook on low setting for 9 hours , or until meat is tender
5. Shred meat using two forks , and return it to slow cooker
6. Discard the bay leaves
7. Add tsp cumin and sugar
8. Let mixture stand for 1 hour to allow flavors to blend
9. Warm the tortillas according to package directions
10. Spoon the meat mixture along the center of a tortilla
11. If you want to add garnishes such as chopped tomatoes , salsa , shredded lettuce , cheese and sour cream , do it now
12. Roll and repeat with remaining tortillas
13. Serve immediately

title: sticky balsamic tomato salad
steps:
1. Place vinegar and sugar in saucepan over medium heat
2. Bring to boil , cook 8 - 10 minutes till thickened
3. Watch carefully though
4. Set aside to cool
5. Arrange tomato , feta and basil on serving plate
6. Drizzle with oil and dressing , season

title: 5 minute  no cook marinara sauce
steps:
1. Place all ingredients into your blender and blend smooth
2. Use to top zucchini or seaweed noodles
3. Top with basil and chopped rosemary

title: shortcut sticky rice
steps:
1. Mix the ingredients together in a saucepan and bring to a boil , stirring frequently
2. When it turns milky , cover , turn to low and cook for 20 minutes

title: pixie magic confetti snowballs
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Beat butter , sugar and vanilla in large bowl until well blended
3. Gradually blend in flour
4. Stir in candies
5. Shape mixture into 1-inch balls
6. Place on ungreased cookie sheet
7. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until set but not browned
8. Cool slightly
9. Remove from cookie sheet to wire rack
10. While still slightly warm , roll in powdered sugar
11. Cool completely
12. Store in tightly covered container
13. Roll again in powdered sugar just before serving

title: honey lime chicken skewers
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine soy sauce through the cilantro
2. Mix thoroughly
3. Cut the chicken into large chunks and marinate for at least 30 minutes - 1 hour
4. For convience place the chunks in a small ziplock bag , pour in the marinade and squeeze out the air
5. Message the marinade around the chunks to coat
6. Remove the chunks from the marinade and lightly season kabobs with salt , if desired
7. Skewer onto bamboo sticks that have been soaked in water for about 10 minutes
8. Grill on medium high heat for 6 to 8 minutes per side , until juices run clear

title: okra gumbo with chicken   andouille sausage
steps:
1. Mix your onion , celery , and bell pepper together: the holy trinity
2. Heat the oil in a cast iron dutch oven over medium heat , whisk in the flour to make a milk chocolate colored roux
3. Add the andouille , 1 tbsp of seasoning , and 3 / 4 of the holy trinity , cook , stirring often , for about ten minutes or until the vegetables soften , add the cold stock , remaining seasoning , okra , remaining trinity , and garlic
4. Bring to a boil then bring this down to a simmer , add the thigh meat and let it go for at least 2 hours , stirring occasionally
5. About 10-15 minutes before you're ready to serve add the worcestershire , hot sauce , and 1 / 2 of the green onions
6. Serve with creole boiled rice , crusty french bread
7. Garnish with green onions , and the parsley

title: white bean  garlic  and rosemary dip
steps:
1. In a food processor , process garlic till minced
2. Add remaining ingredients to food processor and process until smooth
3. Season to taste
4. Optional: may steam spinach , squeeze out liquid , chop , and add to dip

title: chipotle corn muffins
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 425 degrees
2. Spray muffin tins lightly with oil
3. Mix together baking soda , baking powder , salt , and cornmeal in a small bowl
4. In a separate bowl , beat the eggs with yogurt
5. Stir in the chipotles& cheese
6. Then gently stir the egg mix into the cornmeal mix just until combined
7. Fill the muffin tins with the batter& bake for 10-15 minutes for regular sized muffins or 7-10 minutes for mini-muffins

title: dalmatian pot roast  pasticada
steps:
1. In a large pot or crock pot / slow cooker , marinate the beef , in one piece , overnight in 1 bottle of red wine
2. Add onions and rosemary
3. Remove the beef , and every inch cut a small hole and insert one or two of the garlic "sticks" , around the whole piece of beef
4. Save the marinade and put on the stove on medium heat
5. This will now be made into your sauce
6. Brown the beef on all sides in a pan with your olive oil , on medium-high heat
7. While browning the beef add the can of tomato paste to the marinade and mix well
8. As the marinade starts to boil , return the beef to the sauce and add the carrots
9. Boil for 15 minutes , stirring often
10. Lower the heat to a simmer and add the remaining ingredients
11. Slow cook until the meat softens , about 3 hours
12. Stir occaisionally and add water as needed or if needed , to keep the meat covered and moist
13. When the meat is very tender and the sauce has thickened , your pasticada is ready ! serve in slices , topped with the sauce , with gnocchi or mashed potatoes
14. Enjoy !

title: bacardi classic
steps:
1. Pour the ingredients into a cocktail shaker with ice
2. Shake vigorously
3. Strain into a cocktail glass
4. Garnish with a cherry on a cocktail stick across the glass

title: asparagus with goat cheese sauce
steps:
1. Add asparagus to boiling water and cook until crisp tender , approx 2-4 minutes
2. Combine remaining ingredients , pour over asparagus

title: southwest baked corn
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Lightly grease or spray a baking dish
3. Spread stuffing crumbs on the bottom of the baking dish
4. In a bowl , mix melted butter and flour until smooth
5. Add corn , onion , chiles , and cheese
6. Stir well
7. Pour this mixture over stuffing crumbs in baking dish
8. In another bowl , combine beaten eggs and milk
9. Pour over corn mixture in the baking dish
10. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes or until set

title: b stilla
steps:
1. In a large pot , melt cup of butter over moderate heat and add chickens , parsley , onion , saffron and 2 cups water
2. Bring mixture to boil and simmer , covered , for 45 minutes
3. Transfer chicken to cutting board , reserving liquid , and let cool
4. Shred chicken and return meat to liquid
5. Bring to boil and cook , stirring , until almost all liquid is evaporated
6. Let cool
7. In a bowl , combine almonds and 1 cup of sugar
8. Add of almond mixture to chicken , stir in beaten eggs , pepper and 2 tsps cinnamon
9. Preheat oven to 330f and place rack in middle of oven
10. Line a buttered 13 x 14 inch ovenproof dish with 1 sheet of phyllo
11. Brush generously with butter
12. Layer 5 more sheets of phyllo in the same way , brushing each one generously with butter
13. Sprinkle remaining almond mixture over phyllo and top with chicken
14. Cover with remaining 4 sheets of phyllo , buttered , folding in edges to enclosed filling and brushing more butter over top
15. Bake pastry for 25-30 minutes , or until crisp and golden
16. Sift remaining cup sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon over top

title: easy pecan german chocolate fudge
steps:
1. Butter a 9 x 13 inch baking pan
2. Place in a large bowl the nuts , both chocolates , vanilla , and marshmallow creme
3. Place in a saucepot on medium heat the butter , sugar
4. Evaporated milkand salt
5. Bring to a boil , when it is at a full rolling boil , boil for exactly 6 minutes from this point
6. Remove and pour over items in bowl , stir with a wooden spoon until all chocolate is melted and incorporated smoothly and evenly
7. Pour into prepared pan
8. Let set for three hours then cut into bite size pieces
9. Refrigerate

title: veronica s sweet n tangy chicken
steps:
1. Brown 4 boneless chicken breasts in oil
2. Mix together the can of tomato soup , 1 tbs brown sugar , 1 tbs vinegar and 1 / 4 cup water
3. Pour over chicken , cover and simmer until done

title: flourless orange and chocolate cake
steps:
1. Put the orange in a microwave safe bowl
2. Add 250ml water , cover with clingfilm and microwave on high for 20 minutes , turning halfway through
3. Leave to cool , still covered
4. Heat oven to 180c
5. Line a 20cm round springform tin with baking parchment
6. Cut the orange in half and remove pips
7. Put in a food processor with 5 tbsp of orange liquid left in the bowl and blitz to a smooth puree
8. Add the sugar , melted chocolate , egg yolks and baking powder and whiz again to mix thoroughly
9. Beat the egg whites until stiff , but not dry and fold into chocolate mixture
10. Spoon into lined tin
11. Put the tin on a baking sheet , then in the oven
12. Bake for 1 hour covering with a piece of foil or baking parchment halfway through to stop the top burning
13. Cool in the tin

title: cinnamon coffee crinkles
steps:
1. Heat the oven to 400f
2. Stir the eggs and instant coffee in a small bowl until well blended
3. Set aside
4. Mix the flour , cream of tartar , baking soda , cinnamon and salt in a medium bowl , set aside
5. Beat the butter , shortening , granulated sugar and egg mixture in a large bowl with an electric mixer set on medium speed until light and fluffy
6. Stir in the flour mixture
7. Shape the dough into 1 inch balls
8. Roll the balls in the powdered sugar
9. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheets
10. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until set
11. Remove the cookies from the baking sheets
12. Cool completely on wire racks
13. Store in a tightly covered container

title: roasted pecan goat cheese chicken
steps:
1. In a food processor combine pecans , goat cheese , garlic , olive oil , lemon juice and pepper to taste
2. Process until mixture forms a paste
3. Preheat oven to 400f
4. Coat a 13x9x2" roasting pan with nonstick cooking spray
5. Carefully loosen skin on chicken breast by gently working fingers under the skin starting from both the neck and body cavity ends
6. Be careful not to pierce or tear the skin
7. Push cheese mixture in an even layer on chicken breasts , underneath the skin
8. Secure skin with wooden picks
9. Tie legs together
10. Place lemon and onion slices in bottom of roasting pan
11. Arrange chicken in roasting pan on onion and lemon slices
12. Add wine and 2 / 3 cup broth
13. Roast , uncovered , for 1 1 / 4 to 1 1 / 2 hours until thermometer inserted between leg and thigh registers 180f
14. Baste occasionally with pan juices during baking
15. If necessary , tent with foil toward end of cooking to prevent overbrowning
16. Remove chicken from pan and keep warm
17. Strain pan juices , discarding lemon and onion slices
18. Skim fat from pan juices
19. To make gravy: stir cornstarch into water until mixed
20. Add 2 / 3 cup broth to pan juices and bring to a boil
21. Stir in cornstarch mixture and cook , stirring , until thickened
22. Carve chicken and serve with gravy

title: basil cheese loaf
steps:
1. Combine the cream cheese and roquefort in a bowl
2. Mix until smooth
3. Set aside
4. Combine the spinach , parsley , basil and garlic in a bowl of a food processor
5. With the motor running , slowly drizzle the oil through the food tube
6. Continue processing until smooth
7. Transfer the mixture to a bowl
8. Add walnuts and parmesan and mix well
9. Line a 5--x2--loaf pan with plastic wrap , leaving extra wrap to hang over the sides

14. Then take the chicken out and turn it over once more , with the breast side up now , and continue to roast for a further 15 minutes until crispy and golden brown
15. To check that it is cooked , pierce the fattest part of the thigh with a fine skewer
16. If the juices are pink or show traces of blood , cook the chicken a further 10-15 minutes , then check again

7. Add the sausage to the potatoes
8. Cook until potatoes and onions are cooked through and tender
9. Season to taste with salt and pepper
10. Top with cheese if desired
11. Serve and enjoy !

title: baked barbecued spareribs
steps:
1. Brown spareribs well
2. Pour off excess fat
3. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over ribs
4. Bake covered at 350 for approximately 2 hours , turning 2 or 3 times
5. Remove cover
6. Bake for 15 minutes longer
7. Enjoy

title: salt free sweetened rice vinegar
steps: 1. Mix the sugar and vinegar well until the sugar has disolved

title: baked sliced apples
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray a large baking pan with cooking spray
3. In a large bowl combine all ingredients , mixing well
4. Transfer to baking pan and bake 45 minutes or til a golden crust forms
5. Serve warm

title: creamed leeks with tarragon  tomatoes  and bacon
steps:
1. In a skillet cook the bacon until it is crisp and transfer it to paper towels to drain
2. In the fat remaining in the skillet cook the leek , covered , over moderately low heat , stirring occasionally , for 10 minutes , or until it is softened , and stir in the tomato , the tarragon , the half-and-half , the broth , and salt and pepper to taste
3. Bring the liquid to a boil , cook the mixture over moderate heat , stirring occasionally , for 5 minutes , or until it is thickened , and stir in the bacon

title: dad s grilling steak marinade
steps:
1. Combine ingredients
2. Pour over steak / chops
3. Marinade for at least 4 hours
4. Grill

title: angel hair pasta w garlic   sun dried tomatoes
steps:
1. Cook pasta in boiling water for 3-5 minutes
2. Drain
3. In a small saucepan , heat olive oil until warm
4. Add sundried tomatoes& garlic
5. Saute for 4 minutes
6. Add italian seasoning and saute for 1 more minute
7. Toss drained pasta with desired amount of sauce
8. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese

title: chocolate mocha cream cheese icing
steps:
1. Beat butter , whipping cream , liqueur and cream cheese in medium bowl on medium speed until fluffy
2. Gradually beat in cocoa , coffee and powdered sugar on low speed until smooth

title: basil pesto    lighter version
steps:
1. Add nuts and garlic to blender and pulse until minced
2. Add olive oil , pulse a few time more
3. Add basil leaves , cheese , salt and blend until smooth
4. Scrape sides of blender as you go to make sure everthing mixes well
5. Serve with your favorite pasta

title: rebecca s olives  olives baked in cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Drain olives and pat dry
3. Thoroughly combine cheese and butter
4. Add flour and cayenne , stirring to fully mix
5. When thoroughly combined but crumbly , work mixture together with your fingers to form dough
6. Roll a tablespoon-sized clump of dough into a ball
7. Press it flat between the palms of your hands
8. Put an olive in the center and press dough around sides to enclose
9. Roll it between your palms to smooth surface , if you like
10. Bake 15 - 20 minutes
11. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: seasoned hamburgers
steps:
1. Combine the ingredients , mixing thoroughly
2. Shape the meat into about 10 grill-ready hamburger patties
3. If the meat is fresh , you can make these up ahead of time and freeze them , individually wrapped and ready to cook

title: mexican tortilla chicken soup
steps:
1. Place a stockpot over medium heat and coat with 2 tablespoons of the olive oil
2. Add the onion , garlic , jalapeno , and tomatoes
3. Cook , stirring for 15 minutes until the vegetables are cooked down and pulpy
4. Pour in the stock , season with salt and pepper , and simmer for 20 minutes
5. Ladle the hot soup into 4 soup bowls and put a pile of shredded chicken on top of each
6. Top with the diced avocado and crushed tortilla and cheese if using
7. Garnish with cilantro and serve with lime wedges

title: oven chicken and rice
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Combine soup , water , rice , 3 / 4 teaspoon dillweed , and pepper in 13x9 baking dish
3. Arrange chicken pieces on top of rice mixture
4. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 45 minutes
5. Sprinkle chicken with crackeers , paprika , and remaining 1 / 4 teaspoon dillweed
6. Drizzle with butter and bake 5 to 10 minutes or until chicken is tender
7. Season to taste with salt and pepper

title: japanese fruit cake my mom used to make
steps:
1. To make cake: cream butter
2. Gradually add sugar beating w / mixer on medium speed
3. Add eggs 1 at a time , beating well after each addition
4. Combine flour& baking powder
5. Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk , beginning& ending w / flour mixture , mixing well after each addition
6. Stir in vanilla extract
7. Pour 1 / 3 of batter into well buttered& floured 9" round cake pan
8. Stir cinnamon& next 3 ingredients into the remaining batter
9. Pour into 2 well-buttered& floured 9" round cake pans
10. Bake at 350 degrees f for 20 to 25 minutes or until knife blade inserted in center comes out clean
11. Cool in pans 10 minutes , remove& cool completely on racks
12. Spread frosting between layers , on top& sides
13. Stack white layer between the 2 spiced layers
14. Garnish with pecan halves
15. Frosting: dissolve cornstarch in 1 / 2 cup water
16. Set aside
17. Bring remaining 1 cup water to boiling in medium saucepan
18. Stir in the sugar , rind& juice
19. Return to a boil
20. Cook to soft ball stage , stirring often
21. Gradually add to cornstarch mixture& continue
22. Stirring
23. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until thick& bubbly
24. Remove from heat , stir in coconut
25. Cool
26. Stir frosting before spreading on cake

title: general tso s chicken  le piment rouge
steps:
1. For the best results use skinned deboned legs of capon
2. Cut the chicken into pieces no larger than 1 inch square
3. Prepare marinade by combining egg white , cornstarch and 1 tablespoon soy sauce in a large bowl
4. Add chicken pieces and set aside for two hours
5. In a deep pot , heat the oil until it reaches 350 degrees
6. In a basket , or with a slotted spoon , lower several marinated chicken pieces into the fat
7. Fry about one or two minutes or until the chicken becomes crisp
8. Test for doneness before completing the batch
9. Continue until all pieces have been fried
10. Set oil and cooked chicken pieces aside
11. In a wok , on high heat , reheat two tablespoons of the reserved oil
12. Add prepared ginger , scallions , garlic and chili peppers
13. Stir to prevent burning
14. Add the fried chicken and stir quickly
15. Add sugar , soy sauce , vinegar and cornstarch mixed with chicken stock
16. Remove from the heat and stir sesame oil into the sauce
17. Spoon the mixture on to a hot platter and serve immediately with steamed rice

title: smashed kalamata olive dip with garlic and herbs
steps:
1. Put all ingredients except olive oil in food processor and pulse until it is fairly finely chopped up but not mushy
2. If you don't have a food processor , just use a knife and finely chop
3. Add olive oil to cover
4. Serve with slices of hearty bread or crackers
5. It will keep for 3 days

title: creamy enchilada mannocotti
steps:
1. Boil noodles half way drain and rinse with cold water , sit aside
2. Shred chicken in mixing bowl , add sour cream , chopped tomato , cilantro and garlic powder and 1 tbs of smoked paprika and fill noodles and place in casserole dish
3. Heat the whipping cream on medium heat add shredded cheddar , melt cheese and add the remainder smoked paprika and pour over the noodles and bake in pre-heated oven for 30 min at 350 degrees
4. Let this sit for 10 min before serving to cool down

title: whole wheat honey banana muffins
steps:
1. Stir together dry ingredients
2. Beat oil and honey together
3. Add eggs and beat well
4. Add bananas and beat to combine
5. Add dry ingredients to wet , alternating with hot water
6. Mix well after each addition
7. Spoon batter into 24 greased muffin cups
8. Bake at 325 degrees for 15 minutes , or until muffins are golden brown and test done
9. Remove from oven and cool on rack

title: noodle salad with peanut lime vinaigrette
steps:
1. To make dressing: in a food processor , process everything except the oil
2. Slowly drizzle in the oil until emulsified
3. Scrape into a bowl and wait for half an hour for the flavours to develop
4. To make salad: toss all together , dress with just enough dressing to moisten and flavor , and garnish with scallions , red bell pepper and peanuts
5. Serve at room temperature

title: oopah   greek potato wedges
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Melt butter and lemon juice in microwave bowl and drizzle small amount to cover bottom of baking dish
3. Reserve butter mixture
4. Peel and quarter baking potatoes
5. In plastic bag , combine flour , oregano , salt and black pepper
6. One at a time , place potato wedges in remaining melted butter
7. Save remainder for possible use later
8. Place 1 or 2 wedges at a time in flour bag and shake to coat
9. Place potato wedges in baking pan and sprinkle lightly with lemon pepper
10. Bake for 45 minutes and check for doneness
11. If potatoes are not as brown as you'd like , drizzle with a small amount of leftover lemon butter
12. Bake until tender and brown
13. Enjoy !

title: gluten free pizza  hertzberg   francois crusty boule
steps:
1. Making the dough --
2. Use a 5+ quart lidded container , that can close but isn't airtight
3. Mix together the dry ingredients
4. In a separate container , mix together the liquid ingredients
5. Gradually mix the liquids into the dry ingredients -- you can use a spoon , a food processor with dough attachment , or a stand mixer with paddle
6. If you mix by hand , incorporating the last bit of flour may need some extra hand work !
7. Cover and allow the dough to rise for at least 2 hours at room temperature
8. At this point , you can use the dough immediately , or you can refrigerate and use over the next 7 days --
9. When ready to bake --
10. Prepare a pizza peel , either sprinkled with cornmeal or rice flour or lined with parchment paper
11. In your oven , put the rack in the middle space and put a baking stone on it in the middle space if you have one
12. Otherwise use a cookie sheet , pizza pan , or a silicone mat
13. Thirty minutes before baking , preheat the oven to 500 degrees f
14. Wet your hands slightly -- keep your hands moist so you can work with the dough , but not so wet that the dough becomes soggy
15. Take an orange-sized piece of the dough and quickly shape it into a ball
16. Dust as needed to keep it from being sticky , but no so much that you're working lumps of flour into the dough
17. This dough will be sticky , so use a metal dough scraper and be generous in dusting the peel , the roller , the dough , etc
18. Roll out the dough 1 / 8 - 1 / 16 inch thich , directly on the pizza peel or silicone mat
19. Add toppings of your choice
20. Slide the pizza onto the stone or into the oven
21. Check for doneness in 10-12 minutes
22. May need to be turned to brown evenly
23. May need up to 5 more minutes to complete baking
24. Cool slightly on a rack before serving

title: canadian spaghetti carbonara
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti in boiling salted water
2. While pasta is cooking , heat olive oil in a skillet
3. Add chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet
4. Chop cooked bacon and add to skillet as well
5. Chop red pepper into small pieces and add to skillet
6. Sprinkle generously with pepper
7. Cook until onion is soft
8. Drain cooked spaghetti and return to pot over a medium heat
9. Quickly add beaten eggs and toss well until noodles are coated
10. Add parmesan and skillet mixture , tossing until mixed well
11. Move to pasta bowl and top with more shredded parmesan
12. Enjoy !

title: chopped salad with couscous
steps:
1. Put the couscous in a heat-resistant bowl and add the boiling water
2. Let stand 5-10 minutes to fluff
3. Check consistency and add more couscous or water to desired consistency
4. While waiting for the couscous to cool , chop and mix together the remaining ingredients
5. Add the couscous and mix well
6. Serve immediately or let chill ahead of time

title: oreo doughnuts
steps:
1. Combine the flour , sugar , baking powder , and salt in a medium bowl
2. Set aside
3. Beat the milk and eggs until well blended
4. Add to the flour mixture
5. Blend well
6. Let batter stand for 10 minutes
7. Meanwhile , heat 3" of oil in a deep fryer or deep saucepan
8. Dip the oreos , one at a time , into the batter , allowing the excess to drip back into the bowl
9. Fry 3-4 cookies at a time , until golden brown , turning to cook both sides
10. Drain on paper towels
11. Dust with powdered sugar , and serve warm

title: the punch coco
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients well ,
2. Serve over crushed ice
3. Repeat until you have trouble measuring :)

title: cheeseburger broccoli chowder
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , cook beef with onion and green pepper until the beef is browned and vegetables are tender
2. Drain
3. Stir in soup , milk and worcestershire sauce
4. Add broccoli and potatoes
5. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer , covered about 30 mins or until potatoes are tender
6. Great with a little cheese shredded on top !

title: latin connection
steps: 1. Blend all ingredients with crushed ice

title: gianduia pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Process cookies and nuts in a food processor until finely ground
3. Add melted butter , sugar , salt and vanilla and pulse to moisten cookie mixture
4. Press the mixture across the bottom and up the sides of a 9 inch pie plate , packing it tightly with your finger
5. Bake until crisp , 6 to 8 minutes
6. Cool completely before filling
7. Place the nuts in a food processor and chop finely
8. Set aside
9. With an electric mixer , whip the cream and vanilla until stiff peaks form
10. In a separate bowl , combine 1 / 4 of the whipped cream with the nutella
11. Stir until smooth
12. Gently fold nutella mixture back into the remaining whipped cream
13. Fold in the reserved hazelnuts
14. Scrape into prepared pie shell and smooth the top with spatula
15. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until firm , about 6 hours

title: carrie s yummy skillet fried cabbage
steps:
1. Cut and core cabbage
2. Cut cabbage like you
3. Would for coleslaw
4. Rinse cabbage
5. Cut onion into thin slices
6. While cabbage is draining cook bacon , leaving the fat in the skillet , reserve bacon to a dish
7. Layer cabbage , onion , salt , pepper , sugar , and butter until all of the cabbage is in the pan
8. Cook under med to low heat until cabbage begins to
9. Shrink
10. Every 5-10 minutes , stir cabbage
11. When cabbage has shrunk , turn heat up to high and fry
12. Cabbage will caramelize a little , that is ok
13. Crumble reserved bacon on top serve hot !

title: parsley peppercorn ground beef steaks
steps:
1. Mix meat mixture ingredients until well blended
2. Shape into four 1 1 / 4-inch thick patties
3. Press pepper into flat sides
4. Let stand 15 minutes
5. Lightly sprinkle salt over bottom of a large nonstick skillet
6. Place over medium high heat until hot
7. Add patties and cook until well browned on both sides and no longer pink in centers , about 15 minutes
8. If not making the sauce , sprinkle with the parsley and serve
9. If servinig with sauce , remove patties to warm plates
10. Remove any excess fat in skillet , leaving brown bits
11. Add brandy or broth and cook and stir until reduced to about 2 tbls
12. Add cream and butter
13. Stir over high heat until reduced to 3 tbls
14. Spoon over meat
15. Sprinkle with remaining parsley
16. Enjoy !
17. Makes 4 servings

title: cream cheese tuna dip
steps:
1. Stir milk , one tablespoon at a time , into cream cheese
2. Mix in mayonnaise , onions , horseradish , pepper sauce and worcestershire sauce
3. Stir in tuna
4. Sprinkle with paprika
5. Cover and refrigerate at least one hour
6. Serve with favorite crackers or veggies

title: barbecued zucchini two ingredients
steps:
1. Cut zucchini lengthwise into 1 / 2 to 3 / 8 inch thick slices
2. Place in oval casserole dish and add dressing
3. Flip slices around to coat with dressing
4. Cook directly on outdoor barbecue on medium heat for approximately 8-10 minutes or until zucchini is golden with grill marks
5. Baste frequently with leftover dressing , turning often

title: linda s red and green cabbage salad
steps:
1. Combine all dressing ingredients , except mayonnaise , in a small pan
2. Cook over medium heat just until sugar is dissolved , stirring frequently so it doesn't stick
3. In a lg
4. Bowl , combine all salad ingredients , and mix well
5. Add dressing , and mix well
6. Let cool
7. Add mayonnaise and mix well
8. Refrigerate at least 2 hours
9. Stir about every 1 / 2 hours so flavors meld

title: kahlua ice latte
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a shaker with ice
2. Pour into a chilled glass , over ice

title: ranch garlic dill snack crackers
steps:
1. Put both packages of crackers in a large bowl
2. Combine all dry ingredients together
3. Add vegetable oil to dry ingredients and whisk together
4. Pour mix over crackers and mix well , making sure to coat all the crackers
5. Cover and let stand for at least one hour
6. Enjoy !

title: farmer s chops
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Slice potatoes lengthwise into 3 slices each
3. Place in a 2-quart greased casserole dish
4. Saut garlic in olive oil , then add pork chops and brown lightly on both sides
5. Place browned pork chops and garlic on top of potatoes
6. Place thin sliced onions over pork chops
7. Mix sour cream , dry mustard and salt
8. Pour mixture over onions
9. Bake uncovered for 90 minutes , or until pork chops are well done

title: turkish potato salad
