steps: 1. Mix all the ingredients together and refrigerate for at least an hour then serve

title: jazzed up frozen green beans
steps:
1. Cook frozen green beans according to package directions , using the lowest time given
2. In a large skillet , fry bacon until desired doneness
3. Drain on paper towel and return to skillet
4. Add cooked green beans , chicken broth , and onion powder to the skillet
5. Stir to combine
6. Bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat to medium and cook for ten minutes or until most of the liquid is evaporated , stirring occasionally

title: strange carrots
steps:
1. Cook the carrots and bell pepper in the olive oil till tender , about 10 minutes
2. Add the remaining ingredients , heat till warmed through , and serve

title: stir fried green beans   from chinatownconnection com
steps:
1. Blanch green beans in boiling water for 3 minutes and drain
2. Run under cool water to stop cooking and pat dry
3. Heat wok over medium high heat
4. Add sherry , garlic and ginger and stir for a few seconds
5. Add green beans and stir for a minute
6. Add stock , soy sauce and sesame oil
7. Combine sherry and cornstarch and add to wok and stir
8. Reduce to simmer and cook for another 3 minutes until sauce is thickened
9. Stir in scallions and serve

title: golden grahams treats
steps:
1. Grease an 11x7 baking pan
2. Heat corn syrup , butter or margarine and chips just to boiling , stirring constantly
3. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla
4. Pour over cereal in a large bowl
5. Toss quickly
6. Fold in marshmallow and press into pan

title: nutty cucumber salad
steps:
1. Combine first five ingredients in a medium bowl
2. Toss to coat cucumber
3. Sprinkle with onions and peanuts

title: sunny spring lemonade
steps:
1. Stir together all ingredients in a 1-gallon pitcher
2. Serve over ice

title: kimke s grilled cheese
steps:
1. Heat a frying pan over medium heat
2. Place two and a half slices of cheese on a slice of bread , distributing the cheese as evenly as possible
3. Place the other slice of bread on top of the cheese
4. On top of the bread , spread butter
5. Sprinkle season salt on top of the butter
6. Cook for about a minute per side , till golden brown
7. Best served with cream of tomato soup

title: thai curry
steps:
1. Heat small amount of oil in skillet and cook onion over moderate heat until translucent
2. Add garlic , stir until it starts to color
3. Add curry paste and a little coconut milk , stirring until smooth
4. Add rest of coconut milk and the cubed chicken
5. Simmer for five minutes
6. Add rest of ingredients except for the lime , and simmer for about 10 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked
7. Serve over cooked rice with lime quarter and more basil if you want

title: fannie farmer griddlecakes
steps:
1. Mix together the dry ingredients
2. Add the beaten egg and melted butter and stir vigorously , adding more milk , if necesary , to make the batter just thin enough to pour
3. Drop by spoonfuls or pour from pitcher onto heated and greased griddle or frying pan using medium heat
4. When full of bubbles and the underside is browned , turn and brown the other side
5. Serve with maple syrup and additional butter

title: fluffy pudding frosting
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a deep narrow bottom mixing bowl
2. Beat slowly with electric mixer until blended , then beat at high speed until frosting forms soft peaks
3. Spread on cake

title: peaches   cream dream muffins
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f
2. In large bowl mix the flour , sugar , baking powder , and baking soda
3. Add the peaches and gently toss mixture
4. In small bowl , combine the eggs , sour cream , oil , and extracts
5. Mix well
6. Stir into the dry ingredients just until moistened
7. Fill greased muffin cups 2 / 3 full
8. Bake approximately 25-30 minutes or until done

title: peach salad with balsamic dressing
steps:
1. Combine vinegar , oil , salt and pepper
2. Cover peaches and onion with dressing mixture
3. Dress salad greens with peach mixture and serve immediately

title: lemon chicken stir fry with walnuts
steps:
1. In a non-stick wok , cook the chicken until browned all over
2. Remove and keep warm in a bowl
3. Add onions , bell peppers' and lemon grass
4. Cook until veggies are crisp tender
5. Add walnuts , stir-fry for a minute or two , add chicken , lime juice , sauce , rind , stock cube and garlic and rosemary
6. Stir-fry until it has heated through
7. Serve hot !

title: summertime italian green beans
steps:
1. Drain the green beans
2. Add beans and onion to a container with a tight lid
3. Add enough dressing to cover and put lid on the container
4. Give it a good shake and refrigerate at least 2 hours

title: barcelona style pork tenderloin with sherry   peppers
steps:
1. Set out a sheet of wax paper on a hard , flat surface
2. Place pork rounds on the wax papper and cover with another sheet
3. Pound flat using a meat mallet
4. Place flattened slices into a large ziptop type plastic bag
5. Mix paprika , rosemary , salt , and pepper and add to plastic bag- seal and shake bag to coat pork evenly with spices
6. Heat about 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
7. Cook pork slices briefly on both sides- about 1-2 minutes per side , then remove to a covered dish and keep warm
8. Add a little more oil if needed and saute pepper and garlic and saute about 2 minutes or until bell pepper starts to get tender
9. Add sherry or wine and bring to a boil
10. Let boil until reduced by 1 / 3
11. Return pork to the skillet and cook until heated through , about another minute or two
12. Make sure pork is cooked all the way through , but still moist
13. Remove pork to plates and ladle sauce on top

title: crescent cheese rolls
steps:
1. Roll out crescent rolls and flatten into 2 rectangles , sealing all perforations
2. Spread chilies and cheese over dough
3. Sprinkle with garlic powder and parmesan cheese to taste
4. Roll up each rectangle , jelly-roll style , starting at the long ends
5. Cut both rolls into 1 inch slices
6. Place slices on a lightly greased baking sheet
7. Bake at 375 for 12 to 15 minutes

title: raspberry amaretto latte
steps:
1. Combine ingredients in a 12 oz cup
2. Mix well

title: chitterlings   chitlins
steps:
1. Wash chitterlings very thoroughly and cover with boiling salted water
2. Add cloves and red pepper
3. Cook until tender , about 90 minutes
4. Drain
5. Cut in pieces the size of oysters
6. Heat oil or fat to 370f in a fryer or large skillet
7. Dip each piece in egg beaten with water followed by a dip into the cracker crumbs
8. Fry until golden brown

title: herbed rice with currants in olive oil and balsamic vinegar
steps:
1. Mix the currants , vinegar , oil , thyme and garlic
2. Season with a generous amount of pepper
3. Let stand at least 4 hours before serving
4. Toast the pine nuts in 1 / 2 tablespoon olive oil in a small skillet over low heat until lightly browned , 2 minutes
5. Watch them carefully
6. They burn easily
7. Cook the onions in oil until golden , stirring often
8. Add the rice and cook , stirring , an additional minute
9. Add the water and season with salt , pepper and cinnamon
10. Bring to a boil , lower heat and cook covered over low heat until the water is absorbed , 20 minutes
11. Remove from heat and let sit undisturbed for 10 minutes
12. Stir in the rest of the ingredients with a fork
13. Transfer to a serving bowl or platter and garnish with seasoned currants

title: lemon dressing on greens
steps:
1. Whisk dressing ingredients in a large bowl
2. Add greens
3. Sprinkle with parmesan and salt and pepper
4. Toss to coat thoroughly

title: skillet beef and shells
steps:
1. Cook beef , onion , and garlic in skillet until browned
2. Drain off fat
3. Add soup , water , salt , and worcestershire sauce
4. Heat to a boil
5. Stir in pasta
6. Cover and cook over low heat 20 minutes or until done
7. Sprinkle with cheese

title: meatballs in spicy tomatillo sauce  albondigas en salsa verde
steps:
1. In batches , puree tomatillos , onion , garlic and chipotles in blender or food processor
2. Pour into saucepan large enough to hold sauce and meatballs
3. Stir in beef broth and bring to boil on medium-high heat
4. Lower heat and simmer for 10 minutes
5. Season with adobo
6. Season beef and turkey with adobo
7. In bowl , combine meat , soaked bread crumbs , eggs , onion , minute , cilantro and oregano
8. Mix thoroughly
9. To form meatballs , put 1 heaping tablespoon of meat in palm of hand and roll into ball , about the size of a walnut
10. Continue until all meatballs are formed
11. Add meatballs to sauce , cover and simmer for 25 minutes
12. Ths sauced should just cover meatballs
13. Stir occasionally , adding water if necessary
14. Served in heated dish , sprinkled with chopped cilantro

title: asian pork kofte with sweet limed slaw
steps:
1. Crush and finely chop the garlic
2. Grind the star anise into powder
3. Combine both with the minced pork
4. Add half of the coriander and half of the mint , the red dried chili , and mix well
5. Add salt and pepper
6. Form meat mixture into four long patties
7. Heat oil in deep frypan
8. Place patties in frypan and cook , turning when done
9. Don't press them as they cook because this dries out the meat
10. While they cook , do the salad
11. Thinly slice the cabbage until you have a cup of it
12. Thinly julienne the spring onion on the diagonal
13. Peel the carrot and grate it into straws , or chop it very finely
14. Finely slice the red capsicum
15. Place vegetables with the rest of the coriander and the mint in a large bowl
16. Add some salt and pepper
17. Mix lime juice and palm sugar in a mortar with a pestle
18. Dress the salad with the sweet lime juice
19. Serve the patties with the salad on the side

title: calamares a la plancha
steps:
1. Clean the squid , removing the outer purplish skin by rubbing under cold water
2. Reserve tentacles
3. Combine 3 tablespoons oil , the parsley and garlic with salt and pepper to taste in a bowl
4. Heat remaining 3 tablespoons oil over high heat in frying pan
5. Cook squid in batches , 2-3 minutes each , then cook tentacles , about 1 minute
6. Serve squid very hot , drizzled with the parsley-garlic mixture

title: strawberry fruit pizza
steps:
1. 1
2. Heat oven to 350 degrees
3. Press dough into greased 12-inch pizza pan
4. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes or until golden brown
5. Cool in pan on wire rack
6. 2
7. Beat cream cheese and sugar in large bowl with wire whisk or electric mixer on high speed until well blended
8. Gently stir in whipped topping
9. Spread cream cheese layer over cooled crust
10. Top with sliced strawberries
11. 4
12. Serve immediately or cover and refrigerate until ready to serve

title: danish browned cabbage with caraway
steps:
1. Melt bacon dripping in a saucepan
2. Add cabbage
3. Cook on low heat for 30 minutes
4. Add caraway seeds , continue cooking for at least another 1 1 / 2 hours
5. I have had it on for 4 hours
6. Give the pot a stir every time you pass by the stove
7. The cabbage will be golden brown when it is done

title: jamilah s basic dough recipe
steps:
1. Dissolve the sugar in the cup water
2. Sprinkle the yeast over the water and let ferment and bubble
3. In a large bowl combine the yeast , flour , salt , olive oil , egg , and warm milk
4. Knead until a soft dough is formed
5. Dough will be slightly sticky , so always make sure your hands have a little olive oil on them
6. Lightly grease the same bowl with olive oil
7. Return the dough to the bowl , cover with a clean cloth and leave in a warm dry place for at least 2 hours , until doubled

title: chili rice
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and pour into a lightly oiled baking disk
2. Bake in oven , uncovered at 350 degrees for 30 minutes

title: torta   a spanish influenced breakfast
steps:
1. Slice potatoes thinly
2. Add olive oil to a deep 10" frying pan , add potatoes , chopped garlic , and red or white chopped onions
3. Make sure there is enough oil to cover potatoes
4. Saute uncovered until the potatoes are soft , but not brown
5. Drain oil
6. Save a couple tablespoons , discard the rest
7. A little before the potatoes are cooked , mix the eggs and milk
8. When potatoes are cooked and drained , add them to the eggs and milk mixture
9. Let sit for 10-15 minutes
10. Season mixture with a bit of salt and lots of black pepper
11. Heat a 10" non-stick frying and add the two tablespoons of olive oil
12. Add the potato and egg mixture and cook on low heat until the egg is set
13. Flip the tortilla using the lid of a large pan: place lid over the frying pan
14. Turn pan over
15. Slide the tortilla cooked side up back onto the frying pan to finish cooking , just a couple of minutes longer
16. Remove from heat and let tortilla rest for 15 minutes before serving
17. May be served warm or at room temperature
18. Serve in pie like slices or cut into cubes if serving it to a larger crowd

title: pesto grilled mushrooms
steps:
1. Trim stalks from mushrooms and place a spoon of pesto into each one
2. Top with bocconcini and grill until warm
3. Season to taste and garnish with parsley

title: taco rice
steps:
1. Brown ground beef in skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add onion and garlic when it is almost cooked through , or not very much pink left
3. Cook till meat is done
4. Add taco packet seasoning
5. Follow directions on packet as to how much water to add and how long to simmer
6. When meat is done put over rice in either one big bowl or in individual bowls
7. Top with salsa and sprinkle with cheese , lettuce , and tomatoes , and whatever other toppings you wish
8. Enjoy !

title: korean fried chicken  soy and garlic
steps:
1. Make sauce with:
2. 1 / 4 small onion , 2 cloves garlic
3. 1 / 2 cup soy sauce
4. 1 / 4 cup mirin
5. 2 tablespoons brown sugar
6. 2 tablespoons ginger
7. Cook sauce 2 minutes
8. Dredge wings in corn starch fry in batches until they start to brown
9. After all wings have been fried the first time fry them again until they are golden brown
10. Coat wings with sauce

title: maple oatmeal bread
steps:
1. Place in bread machine according to mfrs recommendation
2. Can make into rolls also
3. I usually butter the tops after taking out of the oven

title: rhubarb delight
steps:
1. Crumble together the flour , baking powder , salt and butter
2. Mix egg and milk together and stir into crumbled mixture
3. Cover the bottom and 2 / 3 of the sides of a greased 7x11 inch baking dish
4. Spread rhubarb over crust
5. Sprinkle jello over rhubarb
6. Mix together the topping ingredients and crumble over the jello
7. Bake 350 degrees for 50 minutes

title: all round insecticide
steps:
1. Chop four large onions , two cloves of garlic , and four hot chillies
2. Mix them together and cover with warm , soapy water and leave it to stand overnight
3. Strain off that liquid and then add it to five litres of water to create an all-round insecticide
4. Pour mix into a spray bottle to use -- dont store in a drink bottle if children are around !

title: citrus baklava
steps:
1. Preparation:
2. Grease a 9 x 13-inch baking pan with butter
3. Unroll the first roll of phyllo pastry sheets
4. Lay two sheets of phyllo in the bottom of the pan
5. Lightly brush the top layer with melted butter
6. Add two more sheets and brush the top with butter
7. Continue adding sheets two at a time until you've laid down a total of 18
8. Distribute with a spoon half the nut mixture evenly across the top layer of phyllo
9. Add four more sheets , two at a time as before on top of the nut mixture
10. Spoon the remainder of the nut mixture on top of that
11. Continue building the baklava with the remaining phyllo sheets , two at a time , brushing the top of each pair with melted butter
12. Drizzle any remaining butter over the top
13. With a sharp knife , make five lengthwise cuts , cutting through only the top layers
14. Do not cut through the nut mixture
15. Make a series of diagonal cuts to form diamonds , again cutting only through the top layers
16. Bake at 400f
17. For 15 minutes , then at 300f
18. For 40 minutes until golden
19. While the baklava is baking , make the syrup:
20. Combine the syrup ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil
21. Allow to boil gently for about 10 minutes , then reduce the heat , and let simmer until syrup begins to thicken
22. Set aside to cool
23. Remove the cinnamon stick
24. Pour the cooled syrup over the hot baklava
25. With a sharp knife , cut the baklava along the scoring marks , slicing through to the bottom
26. This dish is best if made the day before you serve it
27. Enjoy !

title: baby s rolled up sandwiches
steps:
1. Place slice of bread of the counter and roll flat with a rolling pin
2. Continue rolling out bread until very thin
3. Spread or layer with desired toppings
4. Roll into a long tube shape and secure with two tooth picks
5. Place sandwich roll into toaster oven and toast until lightly browned
6. Remove tooth picks and cut into pieces , if desired
7. For vegetarian option omit meat or ham

title: blazin  buttermilk wings
steps:
1. In a large bowl , stir together buttermilk , wing seasoning and hot sauce
2. Add drummettes and be sure all are coated
3. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 3 to 4 hours , preferably overnight
4. Set up grill for direct cooking over medium-high heat
5. Oil grate when ready to start cooking
6. Remove wings from refrigerator and let sit at room temperature for 30 minutes
7. Grill 12 to 18 minutes , turning occasionally , ending with skin-side down
8. Serve with ranch dressing , celery sticks , and cucumber slices
9. Indoor: prepare wings as directed
10. Preheat broiler
11. Place wings on foil lined baking sheet or broiling pan
12. Broil 15 to 20 minutes turning occasionally or until cooked

title: creamy potato salad   fresh tasting
steps:
1. Bring a large pot three-fourths full of salted water to a boil over high heat
2. Add the potatoes and boil until tender when pierced with a fork , 15 to 20 minutes
3. Drain and let cool completely in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour
4. Cut the potatoes into 3 / 4-inch dice
5. In a large bowl , stir together the yogurt , mayonnaise , sour cream , mustard , lemon juice , green onions , celery , and the chopped parsley , mint and basil
6. Add the potatoes
7. Season with salt and pepper and toss gently to mix
8. To serve , transfer the salad to a large serving bowl and garnish with parsley , mint and basil sprigs

title: iced yellow tomato soup
steps:
1. In a food processor bowl or blender container combine half of the broth , yellow tomatoes , sweet pepper , banana pepper , garlic , and onion
2. Cover and process or blend mixture until smooth
3. Repeat
4. Transfer soup to bowl
5. Chill , covered , for 4 hours
6. Top with diced roma tomato and garnish with fresh whole chives , if desired
7. Makes 8 servings

title: hearty bacon potato chowder
steps:
1. In 3-quart saucepan , cook bacon over medium heat for 5 minutes
2. Add potatoes and onions
3. Continue cooking , stirring occasionally , until potatoes are tender
4. Add remaining ingredients
5. Continue cooking , stirring occasionally , until heated through

title: homemade window cleaner
steps:
1. Pour the conditioner into the 5 gallon bucket
2. Run hot water over it
3. Rub hand over bottom of bucket to ensure that none stuck and to stir
4. Using a rag wash outside windows
5. Dry with newspaper
6. Wash inside windows first
7. Then wash the outside windows

title: famous barr s french onion soup
steps:
1. Peel onions and slice 1 / 8 inch thick , preferably in a food processor
2. Melt butter in a 6-quart stockpot
3. Add onions
4. Cook , uncovered , over low heat for 1 1 / 2 hours , stirring occasionally
5. Stir in pepper , paprika and bay leaf
6. Saute over low heat 10 minutes more , stirring frequently
7. Pour in 6 cans broth and wine
8. Increase heat and bring to a boil
9. Dissolve flour in remaining 1 can broth
10. Stir into boiling soup
11. Reduce heat and simmer slowly for 2 hours
12. Adjust color to a rich brown with caramel coloring , season with salt
13. Refrigerate overnight
14. To serve , heat soup in microwave or on stove top
15. If desired , pour into ovenproof crocks or bowls
16. Top with a slice of bread and a sprinkling of grated cheese
17. Heat under the broiler until cheese melts and bubbles , about 5 minutes
18. Leftover soup can be frozen

title: bread machine cinnamon buns
steps:
1. Put yeast in bread machine first on bottom , then flour , sugar and salt
2. Then melt butter in microwave
3. Add beaten egg , milk and water
4. Pour onto dry ingredients in bread machine on the dough setting
5. When dough is done , put it onto a lightly floured surface
6. Knead in enough flour to make it easy to handle
7. If it is too elastic , cover and leave 10 minutes
8. Use floured rolling pin to roll out dough on floured surface
9. Roll out into rectangular shape to approx 1 / 4-inch thick
10. Use filling and spread over entire surface of dough with spoon
11. Roll up dough
12. Cut into circle with a sharp knife about 1-inch thick
13. Place these in a greased 9x13-inch pan
14. Cover with a tea towel and leave in a warm place for approx 30 minutes , until double in size
15. Bake in a 350 oven for about 25 minutes , light brown on top
16. When done , make glaze and swirl over buns

title: blackberry lassi
steps:
1. In a food processor , combine the blackberries , yogurt , orange juice , sugar , and lemon juice , and puree
2. Taste and add more sugar or honey , as necessary
3. Strain the mixture through a sieve to remove the seeds , and reserve the liquid
4. To serve , place 3 ice cubes into each of 2 serving glasses
5. Pour over the lassi and garnish with a mint leaf
6. Enjoy !

title: blackberry martini
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , combine 1 cup of sugar and 1 cup of water
2. Bring to a boil and stir until sugar is dissolved
3. Remove from heat and cool
4. In a food processor or blender , combine 1 tablespoon sugar , the berries and the cassis and process till smooth
5. Rub the rims of 4 martini glasses with lemon
6. Spread the superfine sugar on a saucer
7. Twirl the rims of the glasses in the sugar
8. Place glasses in freezer
9. Add gin , triple sec , lemon juice , 2 tablespoons of the cooled simple syrup and 1 / 4 cup of the berry puree to a shaker filled with ice
10. Shake vigorously
11. Strain into chilled glasses and garnish with lemon and , if you like , a whole berry in each glass
12. To quote mr
13. Reynolds , "serve immediately but sip slowly
14. "

title: hot potatoes and egg tacos
steps:
1. Peel and boil the potato
2. You can slice before boiling if you are in a hurry
3. Chop the potato when done
4. Combine all the ingredients
5. Cook and stir until potatoes are brown
6. Scramble eggs til done
7. Place the potato mixture on the taco shell , top with eggs and roll up
8. Enjoy !

title: cream cheese icing
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Enjoy

title: nut burgers vegetarian
steps:
1. Grind onion in food processor
2. Add nuts and oats , pulse to chop
3. Add everything but the oil and process more , but not too finely
4. Add liquid as needed
5. Mixture should be moist but not loose
6. Let mixture rest a few minutes then shape into 4 burgers
7. Put oil in a nonstick skillet and turn fire to medium
8. When hot , add burgers
9. Cook 5 mins each side or until browned
10. Do not poke at them or they will fall apart
11. Lower heat a bit and cook another 3-4 mins so that they firm up
12. Serve on buns as you like
13. Chutney is suggested
14. I'm a blue cheese lover myself
15. Voila !

title: salad asian salad  crunchy salad  tsunami salad   it s all good
steps:
1. Dressing: combine ingredients and shake well
2. Shred 1 head of napa cabbage and add 4 green onions , sliced thin
3. Set aside
4. Melt 1 stick of butter in a frying pan on medium heat and break up the 2 packages of ramen noodles , add to butter and cook until golden brown
5. Add 1 / 2 cup slivered almonds and 1 / 2 cup sesame seeds
6. Drain on paper towels
7. Just before serving , add noodle mixture and dressing to cabbage and toss together

title: poori
steps:
1. Sift all purpose flour and salt
2. Add 1 / 2 tbsp oil
3. Knead lightly
4. Add water and knead well till becomes soft
5. Water should be added gradually
6. Keep aside covered for about 20 minutes
7. Divide into about 10 portions
8. Roll out each portion into a round size of about four inch diameter
9. Heat oil to very hot in a deep frying pan
10. Fry one at a time with light tapping so that it puffs , turn over till light golden
11. Drain and remove
12. Serve hot with any curry or can be taken as it is
13. Too much kneading with oil will make very crunchy luchis
14. But luchis should be soft and puffed

title: a 1 chicken
steps:
1. Season the leg quarters with the pepper , garlic powder and italian seasoning to your taste
2. Place in casserole dish and almost cover with beer
3. Spread the a-1 sauce on top of the chicken
4. Bake at 375 for 45 minutes then take dish from oven and drain the juices
5. Leave enough juice in bottom of casserole dish to cover the bottom about 1 / 2 inch
6. Turn chicken over and spread more a-1 on top of quarters
7. Bake an additional 20-30 minutes at 400

title: cappuccino fudge
steps:
1. Line 8" square baking dish with aluminum foil
2. Set aside
3. In a 2 qt saucepan , combine marshmallow cream , sugar , cream , margarine , coffee powder , cinnamon and salt
4. Bring to a boil over medium heat , stirring constantly
5. Continue to boil 5 minutes , stirring constantly
6. Remove from heat
7. Stir in chocolate chips until smooth
8. Stir in nuts
9. Pour into prepared pan
10. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight
11. Using foil , lift fudge onto cutting board
12. To serve , cut into 36 squares

title: big ol cowboy cookies
steps:
1. Heat over to 350
2. Mix flour , baking soda , cinnamon and salt in bowl
3. Beat butter on medium speed until smooth and creamy , gradually beat in sugars , beat to combine
4. Add eggs one at a time , add vanilla
5. Stir in flour mixture until just combined
6. Add chocolate chips , oats , coconut and pecans
7. For each cookie drop 1 / 4 cup dough onto ungreased baking sheet
8. Bake at 350 for 17-19 minutes or until edges are lightly browned
9. Cool cookies on rack

title: old chicken curry recipe  authentic
steps:
1. Heat oil until hot , saut ground spices until fragrant
2. Add in cinnamon stick , cloves and star anise
3. Fry for 12 minutes
4. Add onions , tomato paste and potatoes
5. Stir-fry well
6. Mix in water and tomatoes
7. Cook until mixture starts to boil
8. Reduce heat and simmer until chicken is tender and gravy turns thick
9. Add seasoning to taste and serve this spiced curry dish with bread slices or with plain rice

title: crock pot spaghetti and meatballs
steps:
1. Break spaghetti in half and put in crock pot
2. Add remaining ingredients and stir
3. Cover , cook on low 4-6 hours , or on high 2 hours
4. Stir once at "halftime"
5. The can size was 681 ml
6. Also , i never measure the pasta , i just use two handfuls
7. But the recipezaar editors could not computer such a measurement

title: roasted vegetable pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Use 1 tsp of olive oil to coat cooking stone or pizza pan
3. Spread out pizza dough and bake at 425f for 7 minutes
4. Combine 1 tsp olive oil , thyme , salt , garlic , squash , zucchini , bell pepper , and onion in a baking dish , and mix well
5. Bake at 500f for 7 minutes
6. Stir the vegetables and bake for another 7 minutes
7. Sprinkle half the cheese over the pizza crust
8. Spread the vegetables over the cheese
9. Top the vegetables with the remaining cheese
10. Bake at 425f for 15 minutes , or until the crust is lightly browned

title: crostini with fig spread   bubbled brie
steps:
1. Combine figs , wine , honey and lemon slices in medium suacepan
2. Bring to boil , then reduce heat and cook , covered over low heat for about 30 minutes
3. Let cool , remove lemon slices , then puree in blender
4. Brush baguette slices with olive oil , and place oil side down on large baking sheet
5. Spread about 1 / 2 tbsp fig spread on each baguette , top with brie slices , and sprinkle with fresh thyme
6. Bake at 450 degrees for 10-12 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly

title: tea loaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease and flour a 9x5x3-inch loaf pan
3. In bowl mix dry ingredients
4. Cut in butter until mix looks like coarse crumbs
5. Add in orange rind and pecans
6. In separate bowl combine egg milk and jack daniels
7. Now add to dry mix
8. Place in loaf pan
9. Sprinkle about 1 / 4 cup chopped pecans on top
10. Bake for 1 hour or till it test done
11. Cool 10 minutes in pan
12. Turn out on rack to cool
13. Makes about 14 to 18 slices

title: grilled citrus salmon
steps:
1. Preheat the grill to medium-high and grease well
2. Pierce a piece of nonstick foil several times with a skewer and place on a baking sheet
3. Stir the sauce with the lemon juice , chives , butter , honey , lemon zest , salt , pepper , and hot pepper flakes ,
4. Set the salmon , skin-side-down , on the prepared foil
5. Brush half of the sauce mixture over the salmon fillet
6. Slide the foil onto the grate
7. Cook , covered and without turning , for 15-17 minutes or until the salmon is cooked but still slightly coral in the center
8. Brush with the remaining glaze during the last 5 minutes of cooking
9. To serve , slice salmon into portions
10. Use a thin metal spatula to lift each portion off the foil , leaving the skin behind
11. Garnish with additional chives

title: marshmallow cream nut fudge
steps:
1. In a heavy-bottomed saucepan combine marshmallow cream , sugar , evaporated milk , butter or margarine and salt
2. Bring to a full boil , stirring constantly , over medium heat
3. Boil for 5 minutes
4. Remove from heat
5. Add the vanilla chips and 1 tsp vanilla extract
6. Stir rapidly until the vanilla chips are completely melted
7. Add in nuts
8. Pour into an 8" x 8" square baking pan lined with foil
9. Chill in refrigerator until firm
10. Remove from fridge , lift out of pan by the ends of foil
11. Remove foil , cut into small squares

title: dense  fudgy vegan brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 and lightly spray an 8 x 8 baking pan
2. Mix pumpkin , splenda , sugar and vanilla in a medium bowl
3. In another bowl , whisk flour , cocoa , baking powder , baking soda , and salt together
4. Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients and add the pumpkin mixture
5. Mix until just combined , adding boiling water if required
6. Spread in prepared pan and bake 28 minutes , until center is firm
7. Cool completely before slicing

title: halibut steaks   maine style
steps:
1. Rinse halibut steaks in cold water and pat dry on paper towellling
2. Set aside
3. In a small bowl , beat together eggs , milk and mustard until blended
4. Crush corn flakes
5. In a shallow mixing bowl , combine crushed corn flakes , granulated garlic powder , dried dill weed , parmesan cheese and italian herb seasoning mix
6. Preheat oven to 450 f degrees
7. Dip halibut in egg mixture
8. Now dip halibut in corn flakes mixture to coat all surfaces well
9. With floured fingers , press the cornflakes firmly into the halibut
10. In a shallow 8" x 10" oven-proof casserole dish , in preheated 450 f oven , heat butter and olive oil until butter melts
11. Place coated halibut steaks in a single layer in the buttered casserole dish
12. Bake in preheated 450 f oven for 5 minutes
13. Turn halibut steaks over and continue to bake for 5 to 6 minutes or until fish flakes when tested with a fork
14. Do not overcook
15. Serve immediately with tartar sauce , lemon wedges or both

title: wasabi lime dressing
steps:
1. Place all of the ingredients into a clean lidded jam jar , screw the lid on firmly and shake to mix
2. Alternatively , place all the ingredients into a bowl and whisk until completely combined
3. Taste , you might want to adjust the wasabi or salt

title: super chocolate weight watchers 2 point muffins
steps:
1. Combine cereal and water and allow to sit and soften while you get the dry ingredients together
2. Add vanilla and egg white to softened cereal
3. Stir the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients
4. It will look dry , but keep stirring and it will eventually soak up all the dry ingredients
5. Bake at 375 for 15-18 minutes or until fully cooked (use a toothpick to double check since the outside always looks done on these

title: cheese mexican cornbread
steps:
1. Heat oven to 230c
2. Grease bottom and sides of a 8x8 inch or 9x9 inch square pan , or a 22 or 23 cm or 25 cm oven proof skillet
3. Mix all ingredients
4. Beat vigorously 30 sec
5. Pour batter into pan
6. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown
7. Serve warm

title: rachael ray s  chili garlic roasted broccoli
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Place extra-virgin olive oil , garlic , chili powder and grill seasoning in the bottom of a large bowl and add the broccoli spears
3. Toss to coat broccoli evenly then transfer to a large nonstick baking sheet
4. Roast the broccoli until ends are crisp and brown and stalks are tender , 17 to 20 minutes

title: mango banana juice
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in the blender
2. Add 1 / 2 cup of ice
3. If juice is too thick , add 1 / 2 cup of water

title: saucy short ribs
steps:
1. Set oven to 325 degrees
2. In a saucepan , combine all ingredients , except the meat
3. Bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat , cover and simmer for 15 minutes
5. Set aside 1 cup for basting
6. Place ribs in a greased roasting pan
7. Pour remaining marinade over ribs
8. Cover , and refrigerate for at least 2 or more hours
9. Drain , and discard marinade
10. Bake , uncovered for 1 hour , or until meat is tender , basting frequently with reserved marinade

title: moroccan peach roasted chicken
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees
2. In a glass measuring cup , combine the margarine , honey , rose water , salt and pepper
3. Heat in the microwave until margarine has melted , about 30 seconds
4. Place chicken in a baking dish and pour the margarine mixture over it
5. Stir to coat the chicken completely
6. Place the dish of chicken into the oven
7. Cook uncovered in the preheated oven until chicken pieces have browned , about 15 minutes
8. Reduce the oven temperature to 350 degrees
9. Add the peaches to the dish and sprinkle with sugar
10. Continue to roast until chicken is cooked through , about 20 more minutes
11. Remove chicken pieces to a serving dish and pour the juices from the pan over them
12. Garnish with slivered almonds

title: raspberry chambord cheesecake
steps:
1. Crust: set oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray a 9" or 10" springform pan with non-stick cooking spray
3. Process cookies in food processor until crumbs are the size of graham cracker crumbs
4. Mix crumbs and melted butter in a bowl
5. Add 2 tbs
6. Water and mix
7. Press crust into the bottom of the prepared pan
8. Bake for 10 minutes
9. Remove and cool completely to room temperature
10. Filling: puree thawed raspberries in food processor
11. Strain out seeds
12. Place 2 tbs
13. Cornstarch in small bowl
14. Add 3 tbs
15. Of raspberry puree and mix to make a slurry
16. Pour remaining raspberry puree in sauce pan on medium heat
17. Heat until boiling
18. With whisk , stir in the cornstarch slurry and bring sauce just to a boil , stirring until thickened
19. Set aside
20. In small bowl combine gelatin and cold water and let stand until gelatin is softened
21. Add boiling water and stir until gelatin is completely dissolved and liquid is clear
22. Set aside
23. Beat cream cheese , sugar , 2 tbs
24. Raspberry liqueur , and food coloring until well blended
25. Slowly add thickened raspberry puree and gelatin mixture and beat until very creamy
26. Pour into crust and refrigerate several hours until cake is completely firm
27. Sauce: microwave raspberry jelly just until softened
28. With whisk , blend in raspberry liqueur
29. Remove springform rim from pan and slice cheesecake into 12-16 slices
30. Garnish: place slice of cheesecake on plate , spoon a little raspberry sauce on top
31. Drizzle a little chocolate over cheesecake getting some on plate to decorate

title: potato clover rolls
steps:
1. Preparing the dough: lightly coat a large bowl with vegetable oil and set aside
2. Place the peeled potatoes and 1 1 / 2 cups water in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat
3. Bring the water to a boil and cook the potatoes until they are easily pierced with a fork -- about 15 minutes
4. Important:drain but reserve the cooking liquid
5. Mash the potato and 3 / 4 cups of the cooking water in a large bowl
6. Stir in buttermilk , butter , sugar and salt
7. Cool to room temperature
8. Add the yeast and stir to dissolve
9. Stir in the flour until a stiff dough forms
10. Transfer the dough to a lightly floured work surface and knead until smooth and elastic
11. About 10 minutes
12. Shape the dough into a ball , place it in the prepared bowl , cover with a clean damp towel and let rise until doubled in volume for about 1 hour
13. Shaping the dough: preheat oven to 375 degrees
14. Lightly coat the cups of two 12-cup muffin pans with oil and set aside
15. Next punch the risen dough down , remove from bowl and knead the dough lightly on a floured surface
16. Divide the dough into 60 uniform pieces and form each into a small ball
17. Place 3 balls in each muffin cup , cover with a damp clean towel , and let dough rise until doubled in size , about 1 hour
18. Bake until the tops of the clover rolls are golden brown
19. Approximately 30 minutes
20. Serve warm

title: guilt free ground turkey gyros
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Put all of the ingredients in a bowl , and spend a few minutes kneading the resulting mixture with your hands so everything is combined well
3. Pour the mixture onto a lightly oiled 9x13 pan
4. Smash it down with your hands a bit until it looks like a very large hamburger patty
5. Bake it for 35 minutes
6. Remove , then cut the meat into thin slices and serve
7. If you want a crispier , more authentic gyros texture , lay the sliced meat down on the pan and place in the broiler for 5 more minutes

title: another chicken in tarragon mustard cream sauce recipe
steps:
1. In a very large skillet , heat 2 tbsp of the olive oil
2. Season the chicken with salt and pepper and add to the skillet in a single layer
3. Cook over high heat , turning once , until browned but not cooked through , 4-5 minutes
4. Using a slotted spoon , transfer the chicken to a plate
5. Pour any fat off the skillet
6. Add the remaining 1 tbsp of oil to the skillet
7. Add the mushrooms and cook over high heat , stirring occasionally , until browned , 4 - 5 minutes
8. Add the shallot and cook , stirring , for 2 minutes
9. Add the wine and cook until reduced to 2 tbsp , about 4 minutes
10. Add the stock , cram and mustard and bring to a boil
11. Cook until the sauce has reduced by half , about 6 minutes
12. Return the chicken and any accumulated juices to the skillet and simmer over moderate heat until the chicken is cooked through , 2 to 3 minutes
13. Season with salt and pepper
14. Stir in the tarragon

title: thai basil chicken
steps:
1. Heat oil in wok
2. Stir-fry onions , peppers , and white part of bok-choy until crisp tender
3. Remove and keep warm
4. Add oil to wok if needed and stir-fry chicken , garlic , and pepper flakes until chicken is done
5. Add sauces in order , stirring between each addition to coat
6. Add cooked vegetables back and stir to coat
7. Add green part of bok choy and basil , stirring just unti hot-crisp , and beginning to wilt
8. Serve immediately

title: sugar gems
steps:
1. Mix sugars , margarine , oil and egg
2. Stir in rest of ingredients
3. Roll in small walnut sized balls
4. Flatten with the bottom of a beverage glass that has been sprayed with vegetable oil and dipped in sugar
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 12 to 15 minutes
6. They will not be brown when finished
7. Do not over bake
8. Leave on cookie sheets for 5 minutes and then remove to cool

title: cheesy beefy tortellini
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Cook pasta according to package directions
3. In large skillet add ground beef
4. With beef , mix in soup mix , garlic powder , and italian seasoning
5. Mix well
6. Cook until no longer pink
7. Drain
8. Return to skillet
9. Add pasta
10. Mix together milk and soup
11. Fold gently into meat mixture
12. Pour into sprayed 8 x 8-inch square baking dish
13. Sprinkle cheese over top
14. Sprinkle bread crumbs over cheese
15. Drizzle with melted margarine
16. Bake at 350f for 20 minutes or until bread crumbs are browned

title: caramel  banana    date loaf
steps:
1. Grease a 14cmx21cm loaf pan , line base and long sides
2. Combine flour , bicarb , and nutmeg in a large bowl
3. Stir in dates and brown sugar
4. Make a well in the centre , add juice , butter , egg , and bananas
5. Mix with a wooden spoon until smooth
6. Pour mixture into prepared pan
7. Cook at 180c for about 1 hour
8. Stand cake in pan for 5 minutes before turning out on a rack
9. Serve warm or cold , with a little butter

title: shrimp imonelli
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in large skillet over medium high heat until hot
2. Add shrimp and saute' for 2 minutes
3. Add nutmeg , salt , black pepper , white pepper , oregano , garlic and wine
4. Bring to a boil and cook for 1 minute
5. Remove shrimp from skillet with a slotted spoon and set aside
6. Simmer until liquid is reduced by half
7. Add cream and parmesan cheese to skillet
8. Bring to a simmer and cook until slightly thickened
9. Add shrimp and simmer for 2 minutes

title: veggie burgers  veggie steaks  veggie sausages  the lot
steps:
1. Add butter beans to a pan , and cover with boiling water , with an inch of water to spare
2. Leave to soak 24 hours
3. Add onions and garlic to a food blender and pulse until finely chopped
4. Add beans and pulse again for 10-20 seconds
5. Add other vegetables , nuts , etc and pulse until thoroughly mixed
6. Add salt and chicken stock and stir thoroughly
7. Fold in flour until mixture becomes a thick , sticky dough
8. To cook , form into 12-15 patties , of heaped tablespoon size
9. Alternately , roll into 2 large loaves
10. For the smaller patties , fry or grill these in a griddle until golden brown and firm
11. For larger loaves , bake or roast until cooked through
12. For "sausages" , roll into sausage shapes and shallow fry , turning regularly
13. When using "meat" for food , the patties / loaves can be sliced into slivers for stir fries , chopped , sliced for sandwiches , thick-cut and fried as steaks , or slapped between buns to make "burgers"

title: luscious hot chocolate
steps:
1. Combine the chocolate chips and milk in a heavy saucepan
2. Place over medium heat until bubbles form
3. Reduce the heat slightly and simmer until the chocolate melts , whisking constantly
4. Before serving , raise the heat until the chocolate just boils , still whisking
5. Enjoy !

title: mashed super skins with steak and pepper hash
steps:
1. Cut potatoes , skins-on , into small chunks
2. Place potatoes in a pot and cover with cold water
3. Cover the pot and bring up to a boil over high heat
4. Uncover , add salt to season up the potatoes and cook until tender , about 15 minutes
5. Place a small pot over low heat and add butter , garlic and scallions
6. Let the mixture melt together and infuse
7. Cook over low heat , about 5 minutes
8. Turn off heat and let stand
9. Heat a large nonstick skillet over high heat
10. Season up the sliced steak with salt and pepper then add a tablespoon of vegetable oil , one turn of the pan , the oil will smoke
11. Don't freak out , just add the meat and start searing it up
12. Brown the strips on all sides hit it with some worcestershire sauce then push it off to one side of the pan
13. Add another tablespoon vegetable oil to the pan then the chiles and onions
14. Season up the veggies with salt and pepper then toss them around , searing up the edges , for another 1 to 2 minutes before combining all the meat and veggies together
15. Add in thyme and cook another 2 to 3 minutes , keeping everything moving around like a stir fry
16. Turn off heat and squeeze the juice of 1 lime over the steak and veggies
17. Taste for seasoning
18. Drain potatoes then return them to the hot pot to evaporate some of the water content
19. Add the reserved garlic and scallion mixture to the potatoes along with the sour cream and start smashing away with a masher
20. Add in 1 / 4 cup to 1 / 2 cup milk to get potatoes to desired consistency then mash in cheese
21. Season-up the mashed super skins with salt and pepper , to your taste
22. Pile up the mashed super skins on a platter , top with steak hash
23. Yum-o !

title: buffalo cauliflower sandwich
steps:
1. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and preheat your oven to 450&deg
2. F
3. Cut your head of cauliflower in half and then cut 2 x 1 / 2 inch steaks from each of the sides
4. Trim off an green leaves at the base , but leave most of the stem in tact
5. You can use the remaining cauliflower to make buffalo wings or just use it in another recipe like our mushroom sage cauliflower risotto
6. Also roasting it in the oven with sea salt , pepper , and olive oil is really nice too
7. Mix the flour , non-dairy milk , water , spices , and seasoning into a bowl with a whisk until well combined
8. Transfer this mixture to a wide shallow baking dish that will fit your cauliflower steaks
9. Dredge the steaks through the batter and use your hands to coat them quite well getting in all the crevices
10. Place the battered cauliflower steaks onto the parchment lined baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes meanwhile , prepare the ranch sauce and buffalo sauce
11. For ranch dressing:
12. In a bowl whisk all the ingredients together
13. Refrigerate until you're ready to assemble the sandwiches
14. Just before the cauliflower is finished baking , melt the vegan butter and whisk it into the hot sauce in a shallow dish you can dredge the cauliflower steaks in once again
15. Remove the cauliflower from the oven
16. You may want to let them cool so you can handle them
17. Also you might need to replace your parchment paper if it's really soaked through or burned quite a bit
18. Dredge the cauliflower steaks through the buffalo sauce making sure to coat them evenly
19. Bake again on a parchment lined baking sheet for 25 mins at 450&deg
20. F
21. To assemble the sandwiches spread ranch on both sides of a toasted kaiser , then lay down the buffalo cauliflower steak on the bottom , add red onion slices , lettuce , and thick cut tomato slices

title: smores krispie treats
steps:
1. 1
2. Butter a 13 x 9 x 2 pan and a sheet of wax paper
3. 2
4. Rub sides of a very large , light colored stainless steel saucepan or dutch oven with butter to prevent sticking
5. 3
6. Set over medium heat and melt the butter until it just starts to brown
7. This will happen at a different rate of speed depending on your stove
8. If it starts browning too quickly , remove from heat , swirl the pan , and put the butter back on at a very much reduced heat
9. Be careful not to burn it
10. 4
11. Stir in only 4 cups of mini marshmallows and reduce heat to low
12. Stir marshmallows until they begin melting
13. 5
14. When melted , add the salt and vanilla
15. Then remove from heat and quickly stir in cereal and broken graham squares until coated
16. 6
17. Quickly stir in remaining 1 cup of mini marshmallows and milk chocolate chips until combined
18. 7
19. Transfer mixture to prepared baking pan and press down with prepared sheet of wax paper
20. 8
21. Let the treats cool completely , then cut into squares
22. It may be easier to remove to a cutting board to do this

title: 1995 1st place  swedish spice cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 degrees
2. Have ungreased baking sheet ready
3. Sift together the flour , baking soda , spices and salt
4. Set aside
5. Beat the butter and 1 cup of the granulated sugar in large bowl of an electric mixer on high speed until light , 1 minute
6. Add the egg and molasses
7. Mix well
8. Stop the mixer and add the flour mixture
9. Mix just until combined
10. Using about 1 1 / 2 teaspoons dough for each , roll dough into balls
11. Roll in the remaining 1 / 2 cup granulated sugar so they are fully coated
12. Arrange on baking sheet , spacing them 2 inches apart
13. If you prefer a thin , crisp cookie , they may be flattened with a glass that has been dipped in sugar
14. Bake until set , 9 to 10 minutes
15. Transfer to a wire rack and let cool

title: mexican noodle bake  meatless
steps:
1. Cook macaroni according to package directions , drain and rinse in cold water , set aside
2. In a large skillet , saute onion , pepper and celery in oil until softened
3. Stir in taco seasoning , beans , tomatoes and tomato sauce
4. Simmer for 10 minutes
5. Remove from heat and stir in cooked noodles
6. Spread mixture in a 9 x 13 pan
7. Bake , uncovered at 375 for 45 minutes
8. Sprinkle cheese on top and bake five more minutes or until cheese is melted

title: farmhouse pork and apple pie
steps:
1. Cook bacon in an ovenproof 12 inch skillet until crisp
2. Remove with a slotted spoon to paper towels to drain
3. In drippings , saute onions until tender
4. Remove with a slotted spooon and set aside
5. Dust pork lightly with flour
6. Brown a third at a time in drippings , adding oil if needed
7. To pork , add bacon , onions , apples , sage , nutmeg , salt and pepper
8. Stir in cider and water
9. Cover and bake at 325 for 2 hours or until pork is tender
10. In a saucepan , cook potatoes in boiling water until tender
11. Drain , and mash with milk and 3 tablespoons butter
12. Add salt and pepper to taste
13. Remove skillet from oven and spread potatoes over pork mixture
14. Melt remaining butter
15. Brush over potatoes
16. Broil 6 inches from the heat for 5 minutes or until topping is browned
17. Sprinkle with parsley if desired

title: banana express
steps:
1. Place 1 / 2 banana into a bowl
2. Top with honey and sprinkle with cinnamon
3. Cook the banana mixture in a microwave oven for about 1 minute or until soft
4. The juices from the banana will make a watery syrup with the honey
5. Add the frozen yogurt on top of the warm banana syrup
6. Top with toasted coconut

title: steven s world famous to die for sour cream chicken
steps:
1. Clean chicken and pour sour cream over it and let marinate for about an hour in the refrigerator
2. Meanwhile , take crackers and crush into medium course crumbs , mix in parmesan cheese and tarragon / marjoram
3. Melt half of the butter and pour on the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish
4. Dredge chicken in the cracker mixture and set in baking dish
5. Repeat until complete
6. Melt rest of butter and pour on top of chicken
7. Bake@ 350 for 35-45 minutes or until golden brown

title: calypso shrimp skewers
steps:
1. Cut prosciutto into 1 / 2 inch wide by 7 inch long strips
2. Soak thirty 6-inch skewers in water for 30 minutes
3. Meanwhile , in a shallow dish combine honey and ginger and set aside
4. In another shallow dish combine peanuts and coconut and set aside
5. Drain skewers
6. Thread shrimp lengthwise on skewers at tail end until they are straight
7. Brush each shrimp with honey mixture
8. Roll in coconut mixture wrap a piece of prosciutto around each shrimp
9. If grilling , cook shrimp until opaque
10. If cooking in oven , preheat to 375 degrees and bake 4 to 6 minutes
11. Stir together crme frache , lime peel , and enough lime juice to make the desired consistency

title: courtney s cream soda coconut delight  alcoholic
steps:
1. Mix cream soda and coconut rum
2. Drink

title: mexican style bow tie salad
steps:
1. Prepare bow tie pasta according to package directions
2. Drain
3. In a skillet , heat oil over medium heat
4. Cook chicken , bell peppers , and onions until chicken is no longer pink and vegetables are tender
5. Add , beans , cumin , and chili powder
6. Heat through
7. In a mixing bowl , combine pasta , chicken mixture , tomato sauce , corn , and cheddar cheese
8. In another bowl , combine yogurt and taco sauce
9. Add to salad mixture and toss well

title: caramel   coconut and almond latte
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a 12 oz mug
2. Mix well

title: raspberry and pistachio eton mess
steps:
1. For the meringue: preheat the oven to 225 and place parchment paper on two large baking sheets
2. Beat the egg whites to the soft peak stage
3. As you continue to beat the egg whites on medium speed , gradually add sugar
4. When stiff glossy peaks form , reduce speed to low and add cornstarch and vinegar
5. Beat mixture for 20 seconds on high
6. Spread the mixture in 9" rounds on the baking sheets
7. Rounds will be about 1 / 2" high
8. Bake until the meringue is dry and crisp , about 3 hours
9. Let meringue cool before making the eton mess
10. Prepare the whipped cream by whipping the cream to soft peak stage
11. Add 1 / 2 cup powdered sugar and vanilla seeds
12. Whip the mixture until firm peaks form
13. Reserve one quarter of the raspberries
14. Combine the remainder with 1 / 4 c powdered sugar , and coarsely mash
15. Gently fold the raspberry mixture into the whipped cream
16. Crumble the cooled meringue
17. Reserve 1 cup of meringue and mix the remainder into the raspberry whipped cream mixture
18. Spoon the whipped cream mixture into individual bowls
19. Top each with some of the remaining meringue , the whole raspberries , pistachios , and mint

title: old time tuna bake
steps:
1. Cook noodles as directed on package , adding peas during last minute of cooking time
2. Drain
3. Meanwhile , heat oven to 350f in ungreased 2-quart casserole , mix soup , milk , dried onion and seasoned salt
4. Stir cooked noodles and tuna into soup mixture
5. Cover
6. Bake 30 minutes
7. Uncover
8. Stir mixture well
9. Sprinkle with french-fried onions
10. Bake uncovered about 5 minutes longer or until onions are golden brown

title: sausage  gruyere and onion strata
steps:
1. Over medium heat in large skillet , heat sausage , stirring with wooden spoon to crumble , until lightly browned , about 5 minutes
2. Strain sausage of fat , and set aside
3. Return skillet to medium heat
4. Add onion and bell pepper and cook , stirring , until golden , about 8-10 minutes
5. Add garlic and cook for another minute
6. Stir in parsley , salt , and a good grind of black pepper
7. Add sausage and stir to combine
8. Set aside
9. In a large bowl , whisk eggs until foamy
10. Add milk and blend
11. Add 1 teaspoon salt and a grind of black pepper
12. To assemble: lightly coat a 2 quart shallow baking dish with oil
13. Use half the bread slices to make a single layer
14. Cut , if necessary , so they fit in tightly together
15. Spoon sausage mixture over bread
16. Sprinkle with 1 cup of cheese
17. Make a second layer of bread , and pour the egg mixture evenly across , using a spatula to press down on the bread for even absorption
18. Top with remaining cheese
19. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 4 hours , or overnight
20. Preheat oven to 350-degrees
21. Uncover strata and bake until puffed and browned , about 45 minutes

title: blueberry preserves
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large stainless pot
2. Cook to the jell point or until desired thickness is reached
3. Stir frequently
4. Ladle into clean hot jars leaving 1 / 4 inch head space
5. Process for 15 minutes in a boiling water bath at altitudes up to 1000 feet

title: beef n beer   crock pot
steps:
1. Coat beef cubes with the 1 / 2 cup flour
2. Brown in melted butter
3. Drain off excess fat
4. In crock pot , combine browned meat with onion , salt , pepper , garlic and beer
5. Cover and cook on low 5-7 hours until meat is tender
6. Turn control to high
7. Dissolve remaining 1 / 4 cup flour in small amount of water
8. Stir into meat mixture , cook on high 30-40 minutes
9. Serve with rice or hot noodles

title: two   bean turkey chili
steps:
1. In a skillet over medium heat heat oil for about 30 seconds or so
2. Add onions to skillet , cook stirring for 5 minutes
3. Stir in garlic and cook stirring for another minute
4. Stir in oregano , celery seed , pepper , zest of the lime and cumin , and cook for another minute
5. Stir in cornmeal
6. Stir in chicken broth and cook until mixture boils
7. Stir in tomatoes
8. Transfer mixture to crock pot
9. Stir in turkey , pinto beans and green beans
10. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours
11. Combine chili powder and lime juice in a cup and add to crockpot along with bell peppers , green chilies and jalapeno
12. Cover and cook on high for 30 minutes

title: sauce haskel
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 475
2. When i say 1 / 4 cup of anchovies i mean a tin
3. The recipe wizard won't let me say that
4. Exact measurements are not critical here
5. Put all ingredients , except pepper and parsley , in a one quart covered casserole and bake for one hour
6. Carefully remove the garlic and squeeze out the cloves into the oil and butter
7. Mash the garlic and anchovies into the butter and oil
8. Stir in the pepper and parsley
9. Serve with pasta fresca as a sauce or with crusty bread as a dip
10. For an extra zing , add a few pinches of crushed red pepper flakes

title: vegan pizza shells  for bread machine
steps:
1. Combine wet ingredients in breadmaker
2. Add dry ingredients to breadmaker
3. Sprinkle yeast on top of dry ingredients
4. Process in breakmaker on dough cycle
5. When dough has risen , remove from the breadmaker
6. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
7. Divide the dough into 5 pieces
8. Spread the 3 tablespoons flour on table
9. Roll each of the dough pieces in to a 8 1 / 2 inch circle
10. Put dough pieces on to baking sheet and pierce dough liberally with fork
11. Spray dough lightly with cooking spray
12. Place in oven for 8 minutes , just to brown the dough
13. Remove from oven

title: bettys  ultimate spaghetti
steps:
1. Saute the ground beef , diced onions and diced bell pepper together until meat is browned
2. Add all spices , tomato sauce , stewed tomatoes and water
3. Simmer for twenty minutes
4. Because of the bullion cubes make sure you taste before adding salt
5. Add cup grated parmesan cheese and stir
6. Boil four quarts of water
7. Add 1 lb
8. Spaghetti to boiling water and stir vigorously until water returns to boil
9. Turn heat down and simmer 8 to 9 minutes to desired tenderness
10. Drain and pour directly in to sauce and serve

title: onion mushroom potato kugel
steps:
1. Place potatoes in a large pot and cover with salted water
2. Bring to a boil , then cover and simmer for 35 minutes or until very tender
3. Drain and cool slightly
4. Preheat oven to 350f
5. Heat oil in a large skillet
6. Saute onions over medium heat approximately 7 minutes or until lightly browned
7. Add mushrooms and saute until browned
8. While onions and mushrooms are cooking , cut potatoes into large pieces and roughly mash
9. Stir broth in with potatoes , then add beaten eggs
10. Stir in 1 / 2 cup mushroom onion mixture , salt and pepper
11. Spoon half of the potato mixture into a 8 x 8 square casserole dish sprayed with cooking spray
12. Top with remaining mushroom onion mixture , then with remaining potato
13. Smooth top of potatoes and sprinkle with paprika
14. Bake uncovered for 50 minutes or until top is firm and light golden at edges

title: chicken with fettuccine
steps:
1. Flatten chicken to 1 / 2-in
2. Thickness
3. In a skillet , brown chicken on both sides in butter and oil
4. Remove and set aside
5. In the same skillet , saute onion until tender
6. Add basil , garlic , salt and pepper
7. Cook and stir for 2-3 minutes
8. Stir in broth , cream , parsley and tomatoes
9. Return chicken to pan
10. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until chicken juices run clear
11. Meanwhile , cook fettuccine according to package directions
12. Drain
13. Arrange chicken over fettuccine
14. Top with sauce
15. Yield: 6 servings

title: beef massaman
steps: 1. Put all ingredients together in a saucepan and simmer for 20 minutes

title: buttermilk fruit salad
steps:
1. Combine vanilla pudding and buttermilk
2. Mix well
3. Add all of the fruits and cool whip
4. Most all fruits taste good in this , so add whatever fits your personal preferences
5. Also good with mini-marshmallows
6. Mix all ingredients together and chill for at least an hour
7. I prefer to make the night before
8. Enjoy !
9. If you are making for a large crowd , recipe doubles very easily !

title: oriental cashew crunch
steps:
1. Heat oven to 250 degrees f
2. Combine the first 3 ingredients in a 13x9 pan
3. Set aside
4. Combine remaining 4 ingredients in a small bowl
5. Quickly pour over the cereal mixture and stir to coat
6. Bake 1 hour
7. Stirring every 20 minutes
8. Cool and enjoy !

title: solo chicken pineapple pilaf
steps:
1. First saute the onion in the olive oil until limp , add the curry powder and raw rice
2. Stir until all the rice gains are coated with the oil , add the chicken pineapple and the peppers
3. Add the stock and juice and cover with a tight fitting lid
4. Cook over very low heat for 15 minutes , then remove from the heat leave covered and let sit for additional 10 minutes

title: greek roasted chicken and potatoes
steps:
1. Place chicken on a rack in a roasting pan
2. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and half the oregano
3. Arrange potatoes around the chicken
4. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and the remaining oregano
5. Pour butter and lemon juice over the chicken and potatoes
6. Add chicken broth to pan bottom
7. Bake at 350f for 2 to 2 1 / 2 hours or until chicken is browned and tender
8. Baste frequently with pan juices during roasting

title: sooz s semi homemade  salsa
steps:
1. This recipe makes a big batch , so put several of the items above in a food processor and blend until fairly smooth
2. Dump the contents of the food processor into a very large bowl and stir until blended
3. Store in individual mason jars or large plastic containers with lids
4. If you want this spicier , you can use a couple of chipotle chilies in adobo sauce
5. This adds a smoky , spicy taste to the salsa

title: wild mushroom and goat cheese tartlets
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven 350
2. Saute mushrooms in a large pan over high heat until all moisture has evaporated
3. Add butter , shallots , lemon zest and garlic
4. Cook for 1-2 minutes
5. Remove from heat and stir in goat cheese and herbs
6. Season with salt and pepper to taste
7. Let cool
8. Once cooled , place a spoonful into phyllo tart shells and bake about 5 minutes or so ,

title: pasta salad with poppy seed dressing
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Rinse with cold water and drain
3. Place in a large bowl
4. Add cheese , broccoli , carrots , cucumber , tomatoes an onions
5. In a blender , combine vinegar , sugar , garlic , onion , mustard and salt
6. Gradually add oil , blending until smooth
7. Add poppy seeds
8. Pour over pasta mixture and toss
9. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour

title: macadamia parmesan sole
steps:
1. Put a 10- by 15-inch rimmed baking pan in oven as it preheats to 425 degrees f
2. In a 9- or 10-inch-wide pan , beat eggs to blend
3. On a piece of wax paper , mix parmesan cheese and flour
4. Rinse sole and pat dry
5. Dip in egg to coat , drain off excess , then coat fish in cheese mixture
6. Set fish in a single layer on wax paper
7. Remove heated pan from oven
8. Add oil and butter and swirl until butter is melted
9. Lay a piece of fish in pan
10. Turn to coat with butter
11. Repeat with remaining fish , arranging pieces slightly apart in pan
12. Sprinkle fish evenly with macadamia nuts
13. Bake , uncovered , in a 425-degree f
14. Oven until fish is just opaque in thickest part , 7 to 10 minutes
15. With a wide spatula , transfer fish to a platter
16. Garnish with watercress and lemon halves

title: key lime spritz cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Beat butter with an electric mixer on medium to high speed for 30 seconds
3. Add sugar , salt and baking powder
4. Beat until combined
5. Beat in lime juice and egg
6. Beat in flour
7. Stir in lime peel
8. Place unchilled dough in cookie press and form shapes one inch apart on ungreased cookie sheets
9. Top with coarse sugar , if desired
10. Bake for 6-8 minutes until edges are firm but not brown
11. Transfer to wire racks to cool
12. If desired , drizzle with lime icing and let stand 20 minutes or until set , or dip cookies in icing and top with green sugar
13. Lime icing: stir together 3 / 4 cup powdered sugar , 1 1 / 2 teaspoons lime juice and 2-3 teaspoons of milk to make a drizzling consistency
14. Tint with green food coloring if you like
15. Makes about 1 / 3 cup

title: salmon rissoles patties
steps:
1. Boil the potatoes in your usually way until tender and then drain
2. Mash well
3. Do not use any butter or milk
4. Drain salmon well , combine in bowl with the mashed potato , parsley and lemon rind
5. Melt butter in a pan , add finely chopped onion , cook until transparent
6. Add onion , salt and pepper to salmon mixture , mix well
7. Shape into 8 rissoles
8. Combine beaten egg and milk and dip rissoles in this mixture , then into the dried breadcrumbs
9. Fry in deep , hot oil for a few minutes until golden brown
10. Drain on absorbent paper
11. Please

title: halibut w chipotle cream sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Place halibut in an ovenproof baking dish , and place in preheated oven , and bake for 20 minutes
3. Meanwhile , combine milk , canned chipotles , garlic , cumin , onion powder , and salt in a blender or food processor and puree until smooth
4. Heat butter and flour in a large skillet and blend until smooth
5. Add milk and sour cream , whisking until smooth
6. Stir in chipotle puree , and stir constantly until mixture comes to a boil and thickens
7. Remove from heat
8. After halibut has baked 20 minutes , remove from oven and drain any fat
9. Pour chipotle cream over halibut and replace halibut in oven and bake for about 20 minutes more ,
10. Remove from oven and serve with extra sauce spooned over halibut

title: monterey chicken
steps:
1. Make stuffing mix according to directions on the box , using 1 / 4 cup less water
2. Spread stuffing in the bottom of a 9 x 13 in baking dish that has been sprayed with non stick spray
3. Spread sour cream over stuffing
4. Spread california blend vegetables over sour cream
5. Lay raw chicken over vegetables
6. Sprinkle shredded cheese over chicken
7. Sprinkle parmesan cheese over all
8. Cover with foil and bake at 350 for 45 minutes
9. Uncover foil and bake 15 minutes until browned

title: kimikaze
steps:
1. Half fill a shaker glass with ice
2. Add vodka , cointreau , lemon juice and lime cordial
3. Shake well and strain into a chilled cocktail glass
4. Garnish with a cocktil umbrella

title: slice  n  bake lemon gems
steps:
1. In a small mixing bowl , cream butter and confectioners' sugar until light and fluffy
2. Beat in lemon peel
3. Combine flour and cornstarch
4. Gradually add to creamed mixture and mix well
5. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour or until easy to handle
6. Shape into a 1 3 / 4 inches diameter roll
7. Roll into non-pareils
8. Wrap in plastic wrap
9. Refrigerate for 2-3 hours or until firm
10. Unwrap and cut into 1 / 4 inch slices
11. Place 1 inch apart on ungreased baking sheets
12. Bake at 375 for 9-11 minutes or until set and edges are lightly browned
13. Cool for 1 minute before removing to wire racks to cool completely
14. In a small bowl , combine icing ingredients
15. Spread over cookies

title: soda bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Stir flour , baking soda and salt together
3. Cut in butter , until mixture resembles crumbs
4. Pour in sour milk
5. Knead dough , cut cross at center and bake for 40 minutes

title: european cabbage rolls  holishkes
steps:
1. For the filling: in a large mixing bowl , combine all the filling ingredients
2. Place 1 heaping tablespoons in center of each leaf , folding in end and sides and rolling up to form a snug roll
3. Continue till all filling and leaves are used
4. Shred smaller remaining leaves
5. For the sweet and sour sauce combine ingredients in small bowl
6. If you can't find mushroom tomato sauce , then use tomato sauce
7. In large pot or roasting pan , layer shredded cabbage , place stuffed cabbage rolls and sauce on top of shredded cabbage
8. Continue till all are in pot
9. Simmer for 2 hours on stove top tightly covered , or cook in preheated 275 oven for 2 hours
10. Yield: 30 cabbage rolls
11. Variations:
12. The meatless way: substitute 3 cups cooked mixed beans , peas and lentils as you like
13. ( a good combination is cooked garbanzos and brown lentils)
14. Use 1 cup raw rice
15. Crush them as you combine with other ingredients
16. Continue as above
17. Season to taste
18. Hungarian layered cabbage: use savoy cabbage for this dish as it softens when cooked
19. In a baking pan layer cabbage leaves , meat filling , and sauce , ending with sauce on top
20. Bake in preheated 350f oven for 1 hour
21. Keep warm till serving , cut in squares to serve
22. The meatless way: try this same method as for hungarian layered cabbage using grated raw potatoes instead of meat filling
23. Season with finely minced browned onions , salt and pepper
24. Top casserole with sauce
25. Bake 1 hour
26. Middle east cabbage rolls: use ground lamb , cooked rice , and season with allspice and cinnamon
27. Layer rolls with lemon juice flavored chicken broth instead of sweet and sour sauce
28. Cook as in main recipe
29. To life !

title: zesty beef and cole slaw soup
steps:
1. Cook onion , garlic and ground beef in a separate pan till beef is no longer pink
2. Drain fat
3. Add all to crock pot
4. Cook on low 8-10 hours or high 4-5 hours

title: now  this is french toast   the best i have ever made
steps:
1. Add the eggs to a large bowl , then whisk until they are frothy
2. Now add the creamer , vanilla and salt , mixing well
3. Place a pan on medium / low heat and add the butter to the pan
4. Dip the bread into the egg mixture , making sure to soak both sides , the bread will absorbed all the egg
5. Cook in prepared pan for 4 - 6 minutes per side
6. Watch closely to keep bottom from burning
7. You may need to flip the bread more than once to get a lovely golden brown color
8. Check to make sure the french toast is completely cooked before removing from heat
9. Garnish with the powdered sugar and enjoy , enjoy , enjoy

title: mama s easy banana cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c or 375f
2. Put milk , butter , and sugar in a medium pot and stir over small fire until just melted
3. Remove pan from fire
4. Add mashed banana to lower the temperture , then stir in beaten eggs
5. Combine all dry ingredients and stir into the pot
6. Bake appx
7. 30 minutes for cupcakes , and appx
8. 50 minutes for loaves depending on the size of your pans
9. Watch out for color and check for doneness by sticking in a wooden stick , should come out dry

title: strip steak with rosemary red wine sauce
steps:
1. Season steaks with salt
2. Press pepper on surfaces
3. Heat oil in large heavy skillet over high heat
4. Add steaks
5. Lower heat to medium
6. Cook , turning once , 4 minutes per side for rare , 6 minutes per side for medium-rare , and 8-10 minutes per side for well-done
7. Remove to warm platter
8. Keep steaks warm
9. Add onion to skillet
10. Cook until browned , stirring , 2 minutes
11. Add half the rosemary , half the garlic and cook , stirring , 20 seconds
12. Add wine
13. Increase heat to high
14. Boil vigorously 2 minutes
15. Add broth , sugar and meat juices that have collected on platter
16. Boil 10 minutes or until liquid is reduced by half , about 1 cup
17. Add remaining rosemary and garlic
18. Pour over steaks and serve

title: mini fruit mince cheesecakes
steps:
1. Line a 12-hole muffin pan with plastic wrap
2. Process the biscuits in a food processor to fine crumbs
3. Add butter and process until just combined
4. Press biscuit mixture into base and sides of prepared muffin holes , using a spoon to press down firmly
5. Place muffin pan in freezer while you make the filling
6. Combine cream cheese , creme fraiche , sugar and vanilla in the bowl of an electric mixer and beat until smooth
7. Fold in whipped cream using a metal spoon
8. Fill muffin pan with spoonfuls of filling
9. Freeze for a further 30 minutes
10. Meanwhile , for topping , place cranberries and brandy in a saucepan over low heat
11. Heat gently over low heat for 2-3 minutes to plump fruit , then add mince and warm through for a further 3 minutes
12. Remove from the heat
13. To serve , carefully remove cakes from pan and serve with fruit mince topping

title: save the stems broccoli  carrot   cabbage stir fry
steps:
1. Peel the broccoli stems , but don't cut off the ends
2. Grate the stems down to the end stubs , and discard the stubs and any stringy bits that didn't grate well
3. Peel and grate the carrot
4. Discard the thick cabbage stems , and finely shred the rest of the leaves
5. Finely chop the green onions
6. Heat the oil in a large skillet , and add all the prepared vegetables
7. Sprinkle the water over the top
8. Cook the vegetables over medium-high heat for 3 or 4 minutes , stirring frequently , until the water is evaporated
9. Sprinkle the soy and worcestershire sauces over the vegetables , and continue to cook and stir for 3 or 4 more minutes until the vegetables are crisp-tender

title: chocolate walnut squares
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f degrees
2. Base layer
3. Measure all base layer ingredients into bowl , crumble together until mealy
4. Press into ungreased 9 x 9 inch oven proof dish
5. Set aside
6. Middle layer
7. Beat eggs until foamy
8. Add the rest of the ingredients and stir well
9. Spread over bottom layer
10. Bake in 350f degree oven for 30 minutes
11. Top layer , icing
12. Beat together well in small bowl all icing ingredients
13. Add more liquid if needed to spread easily
14. Spread over cooled squares
15. Place one whole , half walnut to indicate squares for cutting , so that the half walnut is in the middle of each square
16. Cut into squares

title: italian ranch chicken
steps:
1. Cut chicken into bite sized pieces
2. Saut chicken pieces in a little olive oil until browned
3. While chicken is browning , combine the ranch and italian dressings in measuring glass or bowl
4. When chicken in browned , pour dressing mixture in and cook on low heat until mixture is just beginning to boil and beat throughout
5. Pour chicken mix over egg noodles or pasta
6. Sauce can easily be doubled

title: habanero mango hot sauce
steps:
1. In the food processors add the first 7 ingredients and pulse till small pieces
2. Add to pot with remaining ingredients
3. Then when soft about 10 minutes of cooking add to a blender to puree
4. Carefully place in blender , place a towel over the top , and start blender at the slowest setting and increase slowly so you`ll have no splatter
5. You can also run your sauce through a hand crank food mill
6. If one is not available , a kitchen sieve will also work
7. The objective is to remove or crush any solid matter left in the sauce and squeeze out every drop
8. Run the pulp through the blender adding 1 tablespoon vinegar and then press again
9. I ended up with 1 tablespoon pulp
10. Which you can refrigerate the pulp and use to add to whatever you want to kick up
11. Bring sauce back to a boil
12. Hot pack instructions:
13. To sanitize and prepare your bottles for filling , place the empty bottles in a pot , and cover and fill the bottles with water
14. Bring the pot of water to a boil and boil the bottles for 5 minutes
15. Turn off heat
16. Remove the bottles using tongs and hold upside down to remove the water
17. Do not boil the dropper fitments or caps
18. Hold the hot bottle with a dry towel and fill it with the hot cooked sauce using the funnel
19. It may help to first pour the cooked sauce into a clean measuring cup with a spout and then pour into the funnel from the measuring cup
20. Place the dropper cap on the bottle and screw the cap on tight
21. Turn the bottle upside down and let set for 5 minutes
22. This will sanitize the lid
23. If you choose to use the tamper proof seals , you can use a hairdryer to shrink them in place over the cap
24. At this point your bottled sauces should be stored refrigerated
25. If canning , pour hot liquid in hot bottles place in a water bath cover the plastic tops
26. The plastic restrictors and the liners in the caps cannot be boiled separately
27. Aging:
28. The longer the sauce ages , the more complex the flavor will become
29. Properly packed hot sauce will last six to nine months unopened
30. Take
31. Thoroughly wash lids and smaller sized jars in hot sudsy water , then rinse
32. Heat jars and lids in hot water , approximately 180 degrees , prior to filling
33. Fill canner with water as indicated below , position rack and begin to heat
34. Fill hot jars with prepared recipe
35. Leave recommended headspace according to recipe
36. Wipe jar rims with a clean damp cloth
37. Position heated lid on jar and screw it on
38. Place each jar into canner rack , prior to water reaching a boil and lower rack
39. Water should be 1 to 2 inches over jar tops
40. Add additional hot water if needed
41. Cover canner
42. Process jars according to your recipe
43. Start timing when water begins to boil
44. After processing , lift rack and hook over rim
45. Remove jars from canner with your jar lifter
46. Do not carry jars in canner rack
47. Set jars on a towel to cool for 12 to 24 hours
48. When jars are cool , test for a seal by pressing down on center of lid
49. If lid center is flexible , either reprocess immediately or store refrigerated
50. Label and store in a cool , dry , dark place

title: extreme herbed breaded red tilapia
steps:
1. The fillets are usually big , so if they are start by cutting each in half
2. Mix the melted butter with the lemon juice in a bowl
3. Mix all the herbs in another bowl
4. Mix the bread crumbs and parmesan in a bowl
5. Coat the fillet with flour
6. Dip the fillet in the butter and lemon juice mixture first
7. Then season it with the herbs
8. Don't coat it with the herbs , because then you won't taste anything but spice
9. So with your fingers , sprinkle the herbs onto the fish
10. After that dip the fillet into the egg white , coating them
11. Then press the fillet in the parmesan and bread crumb mixture
12. Repeat for all fillets
13. Put the thin strips of mozzarella on top of the fillets
14. Place them on a greased cooking tray , and cook for 10-12 minutes at 400 degrees f
15. Broil the fillets for 2 minutes to melt the mozzarella
16. Serve immediately , and enjoy

title: homemade seitan steaks   wild mushroom gravy
steps:
1. To make the seitan , combine the whole wheat and white flours in a large mixing bowl
2. Mix with enough water to form a stiff dough
3. Gather into a ball and knead vigorously on a floured surface for at least 13 minutes
4. Place in a bowl and cover the dough with cold water
5. Let stand for 30 minutes or up to overnight in the refrigerator
6. Pour off the water and cover with fresh water
7. Knead the dough under the water to wash out the starch and some of the bran
8. Pour off the milky white water and cover with fresh water
9. Keep washing and rinsing while kneading the dough until the water becomes almost clear
10. Divide the dough in half , place the halves in a large stockpot , and cover with the 6 cups of broth
11. Bring to a boil , then turn down the heat and simmer for 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours
12. Remove from the heat and set aside to cool
13. Slice the dough into "steaks" and place in a large baking dish
14. To make the marinade , place the 2 cups of olive oil , 1 cup tamari soy sauce , dijon mustard , garlic , pepper , and hot sauce in a blender and blend until smooth
