15. Pour over the seitan and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours
16. Prepare the steaks by grilling them on a charcoal , gas or stovetop grill over medium-high heat until golden brown
17. They may also be broiled instead of grilled
18. To make the gravy , saute the mushrooms and onions in 3 t of olive oil
19. In a medium saucepan , heat the remaining 3 t of olive oil and add the brown rice flour to make a roux
20. Stir in 2 cups of water , 1 / 2 c tamari soy sauce , and the herbs and mix well
21. Bring to a boil and simmer until gravy is thickened
22. Stir in the mushroom-onion mixture and cook over low temperature until heated through
23. If the gravy is too thick , add water 1 t at a time until desired consistency is reached
24. Serve over steaks

title: chiles rellenos   tucson s el charro
steps:
1. Stuff each chile with cheese , and set aside
2. Separate eggs and beat the whites until stiff
3. Beat yolks and fold into whites , along with flour , salt and pepper
4. Meanwhile , heat oil in a large skillet
5. Dip stuffed chiles , one at a time , into egg batter , then remove with a large spoon
6. Carefully lower coated chiles into hot oil , 3 or 4 at a time
7. Fry until golden brown on both sides
8. The chiles may be made ahead to this point
9. To serve immediately , arrange on platter or individual plates and pour warm taco sauce over each chile
10. Garnish with more cheese and run under broiler to melt cheese , if desired
11. May be made in advance up to the point of topping with cheese , and reheated in a 400-degree oven about 10 minutes

title: chocolate cranberry fudge cake
steps:
1. Line a round 8 inch cake pan with foil
2. Spray the foil with cooking spray and dust with flour
3. Melt chocolate chips for the cake
4. Stir untill smooth
5. Add the cranberry sauce and the sugar
6. Mix
7. Then add the remaining ingredients for the cake
8. Put the cake mixture in the cake pan and bake in the oven at 325f for about 40 minutes
9. You can check with a toothpick if the cake is ready when there is nothing stuck to the toothpick it is done
10. Let the cake cool in the pan for 30 minutes and then let it cool completely outside of the cake pan
11. To make the glaze , melt the chocolate chips
12. Stir until smooth and add the remaining ingredients
13. Spread glaze over the cake
14. Needs to chill until the glaze is firm

title: fried sauerkraut
steps:
1. Melt margarine in frying pan
2. Add drained sauerkraut
3. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
4. Saute until browned
5. Add the bacon or weiners

title: mincemeat cookies with coffee icing
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f line 2 cookie sheets with parchment paper
2. For dough , whisk together flour , baking soda and salt in a medium bowl
3. Set aside
4. Beat shortening and granulated sugar in a large mixer bowl on medium-high speed 2 minutes , until light and fluffy
5. Beat in the eggs one at a time , beating well after each addition
6. Reduce speed to low and gradually add flour mixture just until combined
7. Stir in mincemenat until well mixed
8. Drop dough by measured tablespoons onto prepared cookie sheets , 2 inches apart
9. Bake 10 - 12 minutes , until golden brown
10. Cool cookies on cookie sheets for 1 minute
11. Transer cookies to wire racks and cool completely
12. Meanwhile , for coffee frosting beat together confectioners sugar , coffee and melted butter in a large mixer bowl on medium speed until smooth
13. Frost each cookie with about a teaspoon of icing
14. Top each cookie with 1 pecan half

title: zesty  italian casserole
steps:
1. Brown meat and onions , then drain
2. Stir in spaghetti mix and tomato sauce
3. Combine cheese and sour cream
4. Pour hot meat mixture into 9x13" greased baking dish
5. Spoon cheese mixture over the top
6. Seperate rolls into two rectangles and place on top
7. Combine parmesan cheese and butter and crumb evenly over dough
8. Bake at 375 degrees for 18-25 minutes
9. Great served with french bread and a salad

title: vegan breakfast sandwiches
steps:
1. Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a skillet over medium heat
2. Fry the sausage on both sides until browned
3. Place on a plate with paper towels to drain and keep the plate in a warmed oven
4. On another plate , combine the soy flour , garlic powder , turmeric , salt and pepper
5. Dredge the drained tofu in the mixture and make sure all sides are evenly coated
6. Heat the remaining oil in the pan and in 2 batches , fry the coated tofu until browned , about 3 minutes on each side
7. When they are done , add to the plate of sausages in the oven to drain excess oil and to keep warm
8. Toast and butter the english muffins
9. Assemble the sandwiches with the sausage on the bottom , tofu in the middle , and slice of soy cheese on the top

title: houston junior league candied pecans
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Prepare a large jelly roll pan by lining it with foil and spraying with no-stick spray
3. Combine the sugar , salt and cinnamon in a bowl , set aside
4. Combine the egg white and the liqueur in a large bowl , stir well with a whisk
5. Add the pecans , and stir well
6. Add sugar to bowl , and stir well to coat
7. Spread onto prepared jelly roll pan in a single layer
8. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until pecans are lightly toasted and browned , stirring every 10 minutes
9. It will look like the coating is coming off
10. Stir from the outside in to keep pecans on the edges from burning , and watch closely since sugar burns easily
11. Remove from oven , transfer immediately to wax paper to cool
12. Pecans keep for two weeks in an airtight container
13. Makes 4 cups

title: lemongrass gyoza  pot stickers dumplings
steps:
1. Heat wok and stir-fry lemongrass , garlic , and ginger in a bit of oil for one minute
2. Throw in onion and miso soup and simmer for 5 minutes
3. Add carrot , bean sprouts , red bell pepper , and tempeh and cook for 2-3 minutes , stirring to prevent sticking
4. Add soy sauce , rice vinegar , red pepper flakes , and maple syrup
5. Stir , then add cellophane noodles and mix thoroughly to coat
6. Add scallions and cook for one minute
7. Place about 1 tbsp of mixture into each wrapper , moisten edges , and seal
8. Steam for about 3 minutes

title: squirrel fricassee
steps:
1. Wash squirrel thoroughly inside and out in warm water
2. Drain well and cut into serving pieces
3. Never wash after cutting up
4. Combine salt , pepper , and flour
5. Dredge meat in mixture and coat well
6. Heat shortening in a heavy skillet
7. Brown meat slowly on all sides to a rich brown , about 15 minutes
8. Add 1 / 4 cup of water , cover tightly
9. Reduce heat and simmer gently until tender , approx about 30 minutes
10. Add remaining water as needed
11. Squirrel should be very tender when done
12. Remove squirrel to a hot platter , cover and keep warm
13. Blend leftover seasoned flour into the fat remaining in skillet
14. Add milk gradually and cook until gravy boils and thickens , stirring constantly
15. Serve at once with squirrel
16. Add the minced onion for additional flavor , if desired

title: lemon yellow squash
steps:
1. Steam the squash until just tender , drain
2. Toss the squash with the butter , lemon , salt and pepper
3. Serve

title: sri lanka chicken curry
steps:
1. Heat oil in large saucepan and fry curry leaves until they start to turn colour
2. Add onions , ginger and garlic , cook on medium heat until soft
3. Add all the spices , salt and vinegar and stir well
4. Add the chicken and stir to coat meat
5. Add whole spices and the tomatoes , stir and cover
6. Simmer , stirring occasionally for 40 minutes
7. Add the coconut milk or even a small amount of cream if coconut milk is not available
8. Stir through and thicken if necessary
9. Serve with rice
10. The curry can always be made hotter by serving sambal olek for those who like their curry hotter
11. This dish freezes well

title: bacon and rotel quiche
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Bake pie crust for about 10 minutes or until lightly browned
3. Sprinkle crumbled bacon , onions , rotel and cheese over crust
4. Whisk together the eggs and milk in a separate bowl
5. Salt and pepper to taste
6. Pour egg mixture into crust
7. Bake until knife inserted into center comes out clean , about 45 minutes

title: polynesian ginger dip
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients
2. Serve with your favorite chips or crackers

title: pearl s granola muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Mix all ingredients together and beat for 1 minute
3. Line a muffin tin with paper liners and fill each liner about 2 / 3 full
4. Bake at 400 degrees for 15-18 minutes or until done in the middle
5. Serve warm

title: spicy chicken chili
steps:
1. Cut chicken into cubes , put into a medium size pot on medium-high heat for 5-10 minutes or until lightly brown
2. When lightly browned stir in the last 5-9 ingredients , reduce to medium-low heat , and cook for about 15-20 minutes
3. Serve 1 cup portions and top with about an 1 / 8 cup of cheese
4. Or eat with some natural peanut butter on whole wheat

title: chili   authentic texas red
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat
2. Sear the stew meat in the oil for 2 minutes
3. Pour meat into bowl and combine chili powder , cumin and flour
4. Mix with the meat until evenly coated
5. Pour in broth
6. Add the salt and ground black pepper pour into crock pot , add garlic put on high for an hour then reduce to low for six to seven hours stirring occasionally

title: banana health loaf
steps:
1. Mix together flour , coconut , baking powder , baking soda and salt in a bowl
2. Combine banana , oil and honey
3. Stir into flour mixture quickly but gently until just combined
4. Do not overmix
5. Spread batter evenly in a lightly greased 8 x 4 inch loaf pan
6. Bake in 350 degree oven 45 to 50 minutes until tester inserted in center comes out clean
7. Cool in pan 10 minutes , turn out of pan and cool completely on rack
8. Wrap in waxed paper and store overnight before slicing
9. If keeping for longer than 2 days , refrigerate

title: heavenly baked alaska
steps:
1. In a small bowl , beat egg whites and salt until soft peaks form
2. Gradually add sugar , 1 tablespoons at a time , and continue beating until stiff and glossy
3. Place cake slices on ungreased baking sheet ,
4. Top each with ice cream and quickly cover with meringue , being sure to seal edges completely
5. Swirl meringue into peaks
6. Keep in freezer until ready to bake
7. Freeze for at least 1 hour
8. Preheat oven to 475f bake 2-4 minutes or until meringue is delicately browned
9. Serve at once
10. Choose ice cream that contrasts in color and flavor with cake , i
11. E
12. Vanilla ice cream on brownies
13. Peppermint on chocolate cake
14. Fruit sherbet on jelly roll

title: nutty pineapple nibbles   stuffed celery
steps:
1. Rinse the celery , them trim off the leafy parts , and cut into 10-inch pieces
2. In a medium-sized bowl , combine the drained pineapple , cream cheese , peanut butter , and honey
3. Stir with a rubber spatula until well mixed
4. Stir in the raisins or fruit bits and hot sauce , if desired
5. Using a table knife , fill the groove of each celery stalk with the cheese mixture
6. Sprinkle the crushed nuts over the stalks

title: sunny apple cider
steps:
1. In dutch oven combine all ingredients
2. Cook over medium heat until heated through and flavors are blened , about 15 minutes

title: applesauce barbecue pork chops
steps:
1. Sprinkle room-temperature chops with salt , pepper , and thyme
2. Place oil in heavy skillet and heat until medium hot
3. Brown chops slowly on both sides until golden brown
4. This should take about 5 minutes per side
5. Combine barbecue sauce , chunky applesauce , and chili powder
6. Cover chops with sauce
7. Cover pan
8. Simmer chops til tender , about 10 minutes

title: lemon bar trifle
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine flour and pecans
2. Stir in butter
3. Press into an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish
4. Bake at 350 for 18-20 minutes or until light golden brown
5. Cool on a wire rack
6. In a small heavy saucepan , combine the sugar , cornstarch and flour
7. Stir in water until smooth
8. Cook and stir over medium-high heat until thickened and bubbly
9. Reduce heat
10. Cook and stir 2 minutes longer
11. Remove from the heat
12. Stir a small amount of hot mixture into egg yolks
13. Return all to the pan , stirring constantly
14. Bring to a gentle boil
15. Cook and stir 2 minutes longer
16. Remove from the heat
17. Gently stir in the lemon juice , butter and lemon peel
18. Transfer to a bowl
19. Cool to room temperature without stirring
20. Cover surface with waxed paper
21. Refrigerate until chilled
22. In a large mixing bowl , beat cream cheese and confectioners' sugar until smooth
23. Fold in whipped topping
24. Crumble the baking pecan mixture
25. Set aside 1 / 2 cup for topping
26. Just before serving , in a 3 quart trifle bowl , layer 1 cup each pecan mixture , lemon mixture and cream cheese mixture
27. Repeat layers twice
28. Sprinkle with reserved pecan mixture
29. Refrigerate leftovers

title: joshua s favorite tilapia with jasmine rice
steps:
1. Pour your dressing straight from the bottle into the pan , i usually make sure the bottom is covered but not too much , i gave approximate measures here
2. Place the fillets on top of the dressing in the pan
3. Sprinkle with all 4 seasonings
4. I usually just sprinkle a generous amount on each filet
5. Don't leave out the cumin it is a wonderful addition to the fish
6. Saute the fillets on med-low heat approximate 4-5 minutes each side until fish flakes easy with a fork
7. While the fish is slowly cooking , cook the rice , using 2 1 / 2 cups water and 1 cup rice , with butter , bring to a boil and simmer 15 minutes on low
8. Serve the fillet on top of the jasmine rice
9. I will usually add more s&p and cumin according to my taste

title: baked herby tomatoes
steps:
1. Wash tomatoes , dry , then cut in half horizontally
2. Remove the seeds
3. Sprinkle the cut sides with salt and place cut side down on paper toweling to remove some liquid
4. Leave to stand for 20 minutes
5. This will help to prevent tomatoes from getting mushy , and concentrate tomato flavor
6. Rinse and pat dry with paper toweling
7. Preheat the oven to 400f place the shallot in a mini food processor along with the garlic , thyme , oil , and anchovies
8. Process to a smooth paste
9. Transfer paste to a bowl and fold in the parsley , chili flakes and breadcrumbs until well combined
10. Season with salt and pepper to taste , remembering that the anchovies are salty in themselves
11. Spoon the mixture into the tomato cavities
12. Bake for about 15 minutes or until golden
13. Transfer to a serving dish and serve hot or at room temperature , drizzled with olive oil and / or balsamic vinegar , if desired

title: clamato empanadas
steps:
1. Saut ground meat and onions on medium-high heat
2. When starting to brown , add seasoning packet and garlic , stir to combine
3. Add green pepper and clamato and let simmer for 10 minutes
4. Let cool
5. Take a pie crust and cut twelve , 3-inch rounds
6. Place spoonful of mixture on the center of a round
7. Fold in half and pinch closed then flute edge with a fork
8. Repeat with remaining dough and mixture
9. Bake in a 350 oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden and crisp
10. Serve warm
11. Enjoy !
12. )

title: south african brandy squares
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a large bowl , cream butter and sugar until soft and fluffy
3. Add eggs and beat well
4. In a separate bowl , combine flour , baking powder and salt
5. Stir into egg mixture
6. Fold in the nuts
7. In small bowl , pour boiling water over dates
8. Add baking soda and let it bubble
9. Pour date mixture into batter and mix well
10. Pour batter into a greased 11 x 9-inch baking dish and bake for 30 to 40 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted in tart comes out clean
11. Meanwhile , to make syrup , in a saucepan combine sugar , water and butter
12. Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes , or until syrup is a golden colour
13. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla and brandy
14. When bubbles disappear , pour syrup over tart just as it comes out of the oven
15. Serve cold with whipped cream
16. Serves 10
17. Impossible pie
18. Recipes compiled by lucy waverman for the hospital for sick children centre

title: fried chicken rollups
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat
2. Add the onion and garlic and cook , stirring , until softened , about 6 minutes
3. Add the chicken , 1 teaspoon salt and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper and cook , stirring , until heated through
4. Transfer to a bowl and stir in the cheese
5. Wipe out the skillet
6. In the same skillet , warm the tortillas over low heat to soften , about 15 seconds on each side
7. Place on a work surface , then spoon 1 / 4 cup chicken mixture down the center of each
8. Roll up the tortillas
9. In the same skillet , heat the remaining 2 / 3 cup oil over medium-high heat
10. Working in batches , add the chicken rollups seam side down and cook , turning once , until golden , about 2 minutes
11. Drain on paper towels

title: broiled chicken breasts with chutney glaze
steps:
1. Preheat oven to broil
2. Place chicken in large foil-lined baking dish
3. Mix coriander , salt and chutney together
4. Brush chicken with chutney mixture
5. Broil approximately 10 minutes
6. Turn chicken over and brush remaining side with the rest of the chutney glaze
7. Broil another 10 minutes or until chicken is done and is a rich golden color
8. Squeeze lime juice over chicken to taste

title: braised cabbage with bacon
steps:
1. Instructions
2. In a heavy pot , cook the bacon until slightly crispy and add onions
3. Cook over low heat until softened
4. Add cabbage , water , and seasonings and cook over medium heat for 45 minutess until cabbage is very tender

title: clipper ship casserole
steps:
1. In skillet , cook onion , celery and green pepper in oil until tender
2. Stir in tomato sauce , mayo , tuna and seasonings
3. Simmer 5 minutes
4. In a 2 quart casserole , layer half the macaroni , half the tuna , half the cheese and
5. Half the corn chips
6. Repeat layers
7. Bake at 350 for 30 minute serves 6

title: shepherd s pie   calgary style
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Cook potatoes in boiling salted water until tender , about 20 minutes
3. Drain potatoes and mash
4. Add 2 tablespoons of the butter and enough milk to have a firm but not runny consistency
5. Season potatoes with salt and pepper to taste
6. Heat 1 tablespoons butter in saute pan
7. Add onion , and saute for 5 minutes
8. Add ground beef , and cook until beef is lightly browned
9. Drain off any excess fat
10. Add carrots and mushrooms to beef and cook until tender , about 10 minutes , adding 1-2 tablespoons water to keep beef from drying out , as needed
11. Add worcestershire sauce
12. Stir together and add beef broth and cornstarch
13. Bring all to a boil , stirring constantly
14. Add nutmeg
15. Remove from heat
16. Place meat mixture into ovenproof casserole dish
17. Cover with mashed potatoes
18. Sprinkle with paprika if you like
19. Bake at 400f for 25-30 minutes , or until potatoes are light golden
20. Serve

title: banana cake with caramel frosting
steps:
1. Cream margarine , sugar and eggs until fluffy
2. Stir in mashed bananas and milk
3. Combine flour , soda and salt
4. Add dry ingredients to banana mixture and blend thoroughly
5. Pour batter into greased and lightly floured 9x13 pan
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 min or until done
7. Cool and top with penuche caramel frosting
8. Penuche caramel frosting:
9. Boil butter , brown sugar and milk over medium heat for 2 minutes
10. Cool
11. Beat in powdered sugar until you obtain the desired consistency
12. Pour over cake and spread

title: crab aroni salad
steps:
1. Prepare shells , drain
2. In a large bowl , combine shells , flaked crab and cucumber
3. In a small bowl , blend mayo , sour cream , horseradish sauce , onion , seasoned salt and pepper
4. Add to shells mixture
5. Toss to coat
6. Chill thoroughly
7. Toss gently before serving

title: lime ginger butter cookies
steps:
1. To prepare the cookies , whisk together the first three dry ingredients in a small bowl , set aside
2. With an electric mixer on medium speed , beat the butter and granulated sugar in a mixing bowl until fluffy
3. Beat in the limeade concentrate the lime zest
4. Reduce the speed to low and blend in the flour mixture , beating until just incorporated
5. Divide the dough in half
6. Roll each half into a ball and flatten to a disk
7. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate until firm , about 2 hours over overnight
8. When ready to bake , preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
9. Spray 2 baking sheets with nonstick spray or line with parchment paper
10. Divide dough disk into 24 tablespoon sized pieces
11. Roll each into a ball and place 2 inches apart on the baking sheets
12. Use the bottom of a glass to flatten the balls into 2-inch rounds
13. Refrigerate for 15 minutes
14. Bake , rotating the baking sheets halfway through , until the cookies just beginning to turn golden around the edges , 10-12 minutes
15. Cool completely on a rack
16. Let the baking sheets cool , then repeat with the remaining dough
17. To prepare the glaze: combine the confectioner's sugar , lime zest and juice , the water , and food coloring , if using , in a small bowl
18. Stir , adding a little more water , if necessary , to make a smooth glaze
19. Spread a thin layer onto each cookie
20. Let stand 15 minutes to allow the glaze to set

title: overnight buns
steps:
1. At 5 pm mix 1 cup water and 1t sugar sprinkle on yeast and sit until bubbly
2. Mix everything else in a large bowl , beating in flour a bit at a time
3. Knead till smooth and elastic
4. Oil top of dough and cover with tea towel to rise
5. At 7 pm punch down
6. At 9 pm pan and cover with a cloth
7. Let rise overnight
8. Bake at 350f until light brown
9. Not sure about the yield as i never paid attention

title: rice flour scones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f
2. Line baking sheet with parchment paper
3. Place flours , baking powder , baking soda , xanthum gum , salt and sugar in food processor
4. Pulse on and off just enough to combine ingredients
5. Add butter and pulse 15-20 times until the mixture resembles coarse meal
6. With a fork or whisk , combine eggs and yogurt in a small bowl
7. Pour over flour mixture in the food processor and process for about 10 second or until dough forms large curds
8. Turn dough onto counter , form into circle and cut into triangles
9. It will not be as stiff as"normal" doughs , so you have to treat it very gently
10. Bake about 12-15 minutes until a light golden brown
11. You can add a variety of things to this basic recipe to make them taste pretty decent
12. Just about any flavorings , fruits , etc
13. Can be added
14. Just be prepared to adjust accordingly for the difference you will find with the moisture of the batch
15. Do not handle this dough any more than you have to-- its one of those doughs that needs to be done just so
16. Too much of one thing will give you sand , too much of another will give you goo

title: lebanese eggplant jam  murabba mhashee batindshan
steps:
1. Cover eggplant cubes with water and bring to a boil
2. Let cook 10 min and drain
3. Dissolve sugar in 2 cups water
4. Place cloves in small square of cheesecloth , pull corners together and tie with thread to make a bag
5. Place in sugar water , bring to a boil , add to the eggplant and remove from heat
6. Let stand 24 hours
7. Drain the eggplant , reserving the syrup
8. Boil the syrup 20 minutes , add the eggplant back in and boil 30 minutes more
9. Remove the bag of cloves
10. Stir in the lemon juice and pour jam into hot sterilized jars
11. Let cool completely and store in a cool dark place

title: easy  decadent  incredibly chocolatey chocolate torte gluten fre
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f
2. Butter at 9 round cake pan , line the bottom with a round of parchment paper cut to fit , butter the paper and dust the pan with cocoa powder , shake out excess
3. Place broken up chocolate and melt with the butter in a heavy saucepan over lowest possible heat & cover
4. Or , you can place the pan in another pan containing simmering water
5. Remove cover when partially melted & stir
6. When fully melted , remove from heat and stir in sugar , stirring until no sugar granules are visible
7. Add the eggs one at a time , whisking after each addition
8. Pour into pan and place in a jelly roll pan , adding a small amount of hot water
9. Bake about 1 hour
10. Remove from the oven and let cool
11. Refrigerate overnight
12. Run a sharp knife around the rim , place a cake plate or cutting board over the top of the pan , and turn it over , bang several times if you need to dislodge the cake
13. Let stand for 30-45 minutes until sides are soft enough to be smoothed with a knife
14. Remove parchment round
15. You can serve the whipped cream on the side
16. I spread all of it in a thick layer , as thick as the torte , on the torte
17. It looks spectacular ! if you do this , refrigerate the iced torte
18. If you dont ice , sprinkle the entire top with cocoa powder
19. Sometimes , the top can look a little messy , but this makes it look beautiful
20. Easy ? the best things are

title: soy mustard vinaigrette
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except for the oil
2. When well blended add the oil slowly
3. Chill before using

title: sweet n tangy freezer pickles
steps:
1. In a large container , combine cucumbers , onions , green and red peppers and 2 tablespoons salt
2. Cover with ice , mix well
3. Refrigerate for 8 hours
4. Drain , rinse and drain again
5. In a sauce pan , combine sugar , vinegar , celery seed , pickling spice and remaining 1 tablespoon salt
6. Bring to a boil , cook and stir for 1 minute
7. Spoon over cucumber mixture and mix
8. Spoon into jars or freezer containers , dividing remaining juices into containers
9. Cool
10. Top with lids
11. Cover and freeze up to 1 year
12. Thaw at room temperature for 4 hours before serving

title: vietnamese fish and tomato soup
steps:
1. Combine fish stock , fish sauce , palm sugar , garlic and 2 cups water in a large saucepan
2. Heat and simmer for 5 minute
3. Add fish and cook for 3-5 min , until the fish is just cooked through
4. Stir in tomato , chillies and lime juice
5. Cook for 1-2 min , or until tomato is soft
6. Season to taste and garnish with vietnamese mint , coriander and bean shoots

title: simple spinach side dish
steps:
1. Thaw and drain the spinach
2. Mix spinach , onion and sour cream
3. Place in greased casserole dish
4. Cover with grated cheese , fresh bread crumbs , and parm
5. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes

title: chocolate gingerbread men
steps:
1. Position racks in the top & bottom thirds of the oven , then preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. With shortening to grease several large baking sheets , then set aside
3. In a large mixing bowl , whisk together flour , cocoa powder , ginger , cinnamon , baking soda , salt , baking powder & cloves until spices & coca are evenly distributed , then set aside
4. In a 2nd large bowl , & using an electric mixer on medium speed , cream shortening & brown sugar until smooth & airy , about 1 minute
5. Beat in egg & then the molasses
6. Turn off mixer & add prepared flour mixture , then at very low speed beat just until crumbly bits of dough form , but not until the mass begins to cohere into a ball
7. With flour lightly dust a clean , dry work surface as well as your hands
8. Turn dough out & knead just until it forms a smooth mass , about 30 seconds
9. Divide into thirds & cover them with a clean kitchen towel
10. With flour lightly dust the work surface again & roll one of the thirds to a rectangle about 1 / 4 inch thick
11. Flour the dough & a rolling pin only as necessary
12. Use a large gingerbread-man cookie cutter to cut the dough into the desired shapes , then use a metal spatula to transfer them carefully to the prepared baking sheet
13. Gather any scraps , lightly dust again with flour & roll out a 2nd time , creating additional gingerbread men
14. Decorate the cookies with the raisins & red hots , using one for the eyes & the other for the mouths
15. Additional red hots can be used as buttons on their coats
16. Bake for 4 minutes , then rotate sheets top to bottom & front to back
17. Bake another 4 minutes , or until cookies feel dry but still are a little soft
18. Remove from oven & cool on the baking sheets for 2 minutes before transferring the cookies to wire racks to cool completely
19. Cool the baking sheets for 5 more minutes , then regrease them before baking additional batches , as necessary , or work with 2 additional baking sheets , preparing them while the others are in the oven
20. Keep no longer than 2 days at room temperature , several more days in the refrigerator , or up to a month in the freezer

title: bleu cheese cold cole slaw
steps:
1. Put shredded cabbage in bowl with tight-fitting cover
2. Whisk together the mayonnaise , lemon juice , vinegar , salt , sugar and pepper
3. Pour over cabbage and mix well
4. Add bleu cheese and stir
5. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving

title: chilled mushroom salad
steps:
1. Mix ingredients for the vinaigrette in a small bowl
2. In a large bowl , toss mushroom slices with vinaigrette
3. If you want you can garnish with a little parsley
4. Chill before serving

title: party pinwheels
steps:
1. Mix first 3 ingredients together , and then spread on tortillas
2. Sprinkle remaining ingredients on the top
3. Roll the tortillas , and then wrap tightly in plastic wrap
4. Chill for 2 hours
5. Cut off rolled ends , and then slice into 1 inch slices

title: creamy chicken gumbo
steps:
1. Cook the white rice according to package directions , but remove from heat about 15 minutes before it's done
2. Drain the excess liquid , and set aside
3. In a stock pot over high heat , combine the chicken and the fresh or canned chicken stock
4. Bring to a boil , and then reduce heat to low
5. Simmer for 40 minutes , or until chicken is cooked and tender
6. Remove chicken from the pot , and allow it to cool
7. Reserve liquid stock from pot for later
8. When chicken is cool , remove the meat from the bones , cut into bite size pieces , and reserve
9. Discard the fat and the bones
10. In the same stock pot over medium heat , saute the celery and onion in the a tablespoon of butter for 5 minutes
11. Add the ham , and cover
12. Cook for 5 to 10 minutes , stirring occasionally , until everything is tender
13. Return the liquid stock in the stock pot , and add the partially cooked white rice
14. Stir in the tabasco , white pepper and any creole seasoned salt
15. Simmer , uncovered , for 15 minutes
16. Meanwhile , melt the rest of the butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat
17. Stir in the flour until smooth
18. Whisk in the milk , and continue cooking until mixture is bubbly and thick
19. Add some of the stock mixture to the milk mixture , continuing to stir , then stir all of the milk mixture into the stock mixture
20. Mix in the reserved chicken meat and the white wine
21. Allow this to heat through for about 15 minutes

title: summer squash salad with lemon  capers and parmesan
steps:
1. Mash garlic to a paste with a pinch of salt , put in a small bowl and whisk in lemon juice
2. Let sit for 10 minutes and then whisk in olive oil
3. Using a mandoline or sharp chef's knife , cut squash into very thin ovals
4. Put into a medium bowl and toss with 2 / 3 of the vinaigrette
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Combine arugula , parsley , chives and capers in a separate bowl , season with salt and pepper , and toss with just enough vinaigrette to lightly coat
7. Layer about 1 / 3 of squash in a shallow bowl or platter , scatter 1 / 3 of arugula mixture on top and sprinkle with 1 / 3 of the grated parmesan
8. Repeat layering two more times
9. For garnish , shave long strips of parmesan with a vegetable peeler onto the salad
10. Serve immediately

title: delicious breaded pork chops
steps:
1. Combine crushed saltines , parmesan cheese , italian seasoning and garlic powder together and mix well
2. Dip each chop in melted butter and then dredge in cracker crumb mixture , coating all sides thoroughly
3. Place chops in a 9x13 baking dish
4. Bake at 425 degrees for 30-40 minutes or until done

title: bbq kiwifruit lamb kebabs
steps:
1. Scoop flesh from inside the kiwifruit and mash well until smooth
2. Mix with remaining ingredients and cubed lamb
3. Stir , cover and leave at room temperature for about 20 minutes- maximum 1 hour
4. Drain lamb and thread on skewers
5. Barbecue or grill kebabs on high heat for 5- 7 minutes , turning skewers to brown lamb on all sides
6. Do not overcook

title: low carb mock cinnabon
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f spray two ramekins with cooking spray
2. Spoon the cottage cheese into a small bowl , add the liquid sugar & cinnamon
3. Using the back of a spoon mash the cheese chunks until almost smooth
4. Stir in the egg , baking powder , & cream then add the chopped pecans
5. Pour the mixture into the ramekins then place them on a baking sheet
6. Bake for 25 minutes or until the middle is done
7. Cool slightly before eating
8. If using the one that is 2 drops per serving cut the amount in half

title: oven fried pecan chicken breasts
steps:
1. Heat oven to 450f
2. Lightly coat with cooking spray a wire rack large enough to hold chicken in 1 layer
3. Set rack in a jelly roll pan or roasting pan
4. Mix stuffing and pecans on a piece of waxed paper
5. Spread flour on another piece of waxed paper
6. Roll chicken in flour to coat , shaking off excess , then dip in egg white
7. Press in pecan mixture to coat well
8. Lightly coat chicken with cooking spray , sprinkle with salt and place on rack
9. Bake 25 minutes , turning once , or until lightly browned and no longer pink at center

title: pineapple   green pepper spread  weight watchers
steps:
1. Mix together all ingredients except cream cheese
2. In a microwave safe bowl , soften cream cheese and then mix in pineapple mixture
3. Mix well and chill over night

title: quick sausage stuffed acorn squash
steps:
1. Cut squash in half and remove seeds
2. Place squash cut side down on microwave safe dish with 1 / 4 inch water and microwave on high for 10-12 minutes , or until just tender
3. Meanwhile , crumble sausage into large skillet and add celery and onion
4. Cook over medium heat until meat is no longer pink , drain
5. Remove from heat and stir in sour cream
6. Spoon sausage into squash halves
7. Cover and microwave on high for 1 minute or until heated through

title: tortilla ranch chopped salad
steps:
1. After all the veggies are chopped to be about the same size pieces place them all in a large bowl
2. Add the cheese and chips
3. Top with the seasoning and dressing
4. Cover and shake the salad until everything is evenly coated

title: pork chops with cheese and ale
steps:
1. Grill the chops under a moderate grill / broiler for 7-10 minutes depending on the thickness
2. Turn them over and grill for a further 7-10 minutes , until cooked through
3. Mix together the cheese , mustard and brown ale
4. Spread over the chops and grill / broil until the cheese has melted
5. Serve immediately

title: the great burrito stack
steps:
1. Brown ground beef , add onion and sautee 4 min more , add paprika , chili powder , pepper , bouillon and flour and stir well
2. Slowly add water and stir until thick
3. Mix cream cheese , 1 / 4 cup salsa and 1 / 4 cup shredded cheddar
4. Grease 10 inch pie plate and layer with 1 tortilla , spread with 1 / 2 the refried beans , 1 / 2 the hamburger , 1 cup lettuce , 1 tomato and 3 / 4 cup cheese , top with tortilla spread this layer with cream cheese mixture and also add an extra 1 / 4 cup grated cheddar sprinkled on top place on top another tortilla and repeat with rest of beans , hamburger , lettuce , tomatoes and another 3 / 4 cup of cheese
5. Top with the last tortilla , 1 / 4 cup of slasa and 1 / 2 cup of cheese
6. Bake at 300 for 30 minutes on middle oven rack

title: cheese and olive balls
steps:
1. Blend cheese , butter and paprika
2. Mix in flour until smooth
3. Let stand covered for 15 minutes
4. Shape by teaspoonsful into 1-1 / 2-inch circles
5. Wrap to enclose olives
6. Chill 10 mintues
7. Bake at 375 for 20 to 25 mintues

title: garlic lover s chicken  potatoes  and carrots
steps:
1. Place potatoes , carrots , and onion in greased or sprayed 13x9-inch baking dish
2. Top with chicken
3. Combine tarragon , sage , salt , and pepper and sprinkle over chicken
4. Cut the top off of garlic bulb so that each clove is exposed
5. Place cut side up in baking dish
6. Drizzle oil over garlic and chicken
7. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 60 minutes
8. Uncover and bake 10-15 minutes longer or until chicken juices run clear and garlic is soft
9. Transfer chicken to serving platter and keep warm
10. Cool garlic 5 minutes
11. Gently squeeze garlic into small bowl and lightly mash with fork
12. Toss garlic with potatoes , carrots , and onion
13. Arrange around chicken
14. Sprinkle with dried parsley

title: artichoke avocado shrimp salad
steps:
1. Mix the lemon , olive oil , vinegar
2. Add the vegetables and shrimp
3. Serve with pita , sour dough , or french bread

title: kittencal s easy seasoned home fries
steps:
1. Cube the potatoes in about 3 / 4-inch squares
2. Place into a large bowl then cover with cold water , rinse then cover once again with water
3. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours or up to 48 hours
4. Drain very well in a colander
5. Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat , then add in garlic powder , seasoned salt and cayenne pepper
6. Place the potatoes in the skillet and stir to coat with the butter
7. Cover with a lid and cook for 8-10 minutes
8. Remove the lid and cook for another 10 minutes , turning frequently with a spatula for even browning and crisping
9. Season with more seasoned salt to taste and black pepper
10. Delicious !

title: broccoli   cornbread casserole
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together in a large mixing bowl
2. Pour into a greased 9x13 pan
3. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes to 1 hour until lightly browned on top

title: margarita jello shots of the jello masters
steps:
1. Mix boiling water and jello
2. Stir for a minute until dissolved
3. Add rest of ingredients , stir
4. Pour into small paper dixie cups , cool on one or two cookies sheets stacked in the refrigerator
5. Unless you use ice and water for the cold water , allow 5 or more hours for jello to cool and set
6. For every party i throw , i'll make this recipe and one more from hazel's site to satisfy the partygoers

title: mousetraps
steps:
1. Preheat a grill on medium-high heat
2. Place toast , in a single layer , on a baking tray
3. Top with ham
4. Beat egg yolks in a bowl until well combined
5. Stir in cheese and season with salt and pepper
6. Using an electric mixer , beat eggwhites in a clean , dry bowl until stiff peaks form
7. Stir half the eggwhites into cheese mixture
8. Using a large metal spoon , gently fold in remaining eggwhites
9. Spoon mixture over ham
10. Place mousetraps under hot grill
11. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes or until egg mixture is golden and cooked through
12. Serve

title: double almond biscotti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f and line baking sheets with parchment
2. Grate almond paste and butter into a medium bowl
3. Add sugar , flour , baking powder and salt and mix with fork until crumbly and stir in almonds
4. Whisk together egg whites and vanilla and add to mixture and mix until dough holds together
5. Turn out onto a lightly floured counter roll into 2 inch thick log
6. Cut into 2 pieces
7. Roll each 10 inches long and flatten to 3 / 4 inches
8. Transfer to ungreased or parchment lined sheets and bake 35 minutes until golden
9. Cool sheets on rack for 10 minutes and then slice into 3 / 4-inch diagonal slices
10. Return to cookie sheet , cut side down and bake 12 minutes: flip and bake 12 minutes more
11. Cool completely on racks and store in air-tight container

title: tato sauce
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Chill
3. Serve on baked potatoes , as a dip for french fries or tator tots
4. Also good on hot dogs and hamburgers , or most anything else !

title: garlic kissed tomatoes
steps:
1. Heat oil and add crushed garlic
2. Wait for a few seconds and turn the heat off
3. Toss tomatoes , hot oil with garlic , salt and black pepper powder and spread on greased baking tray
4. Keep in the preheated oven for 7-10 minutes
5. Serve warm with any dish of your choice !

title: jill samwiches
steps:
1. Butter each slice of bread with butter on one side only
2. Place one slice of bread butter side down in skillet
3. Add one slice of cheese , cream cheese and then another slice of cheese
4. Top with other slice of bread butter side up
5. Grill like you would a grilled cheese sandwich
6. After taking out of the pan , open up and spread with mayo

title: spinach stuffed portobello mushrooms
steps:
1. Line a baking sheet with heavy-duty foil
2. Coat the foil with nonstick cooking spray and set aside
3. Remove stems from mushrooms
4. Set caps aside and chop stems
5. Saute the stems and onion in a small amount of water until soft
6. In a small bowl , combine the eggs and sour cream
7. Stir in the spinach , stuffing , feta cheese , garlic salt and onion mixture
8. Spoon into mushroom caps
9. Place on prepared baking sheet
10. Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes
11. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese , bake 5 to 10 minutes longer or until mushrooms are tender and cheese is melted

title: extra cheesy lasagna for roy
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a bowl , combine 1 lb mozarella , parmesan and eggs
3. Mix well
4. On bottom of greased 13x9 baking dish , spread 1 cup pasta sauce
5. Top with half each of the uncooked lasagna noodles , egg mixture , ground beef , remaining pasta sauce and mozzarella
6. Repeat layering
7. Top with parsley
8. Cover tightly with aluminum foil
9. Bake 1 hour or until hot and bubbly
10. Let stand covered 15 minutes before serving
11. Refrigerate leftovers

title: curried chicken salad with grapes
steps:
1. Place chicken on rack inside a 9"x13" pan
2. Rub breasts with olive oil
3. Season with salt , pepper and mrs
4. Dash
5. Roast until no longer pink , about 45 minutes
6. Cool until easy to handle
7. Remove skin and bones
8. Shred meat into bite-sized pieces
9. Meanwhile , combine dressing ingredients
10. Taste often to reach desired outcome
11. Combine chicken , celery and grapes
12. Toss with enough dressing to coat , allowing for a little extra as the chicken will absorb some while melding in the refrigerator
13. Best chilled overnight , but it is still great if you can't wait that long
14. Serve alone or with rolls for sandwiches

title: chicha de arroz
steps:
1. Directions
2. Wash the rice in 2 cups of water and let it soak overnight
3. Discard the water and put the rice into a pot with the remaining 7 cups of water and the cinnamon stick
4. Let the mixture boil for 35 minutes
5. Remove from heat and blend everything on high speed until well-blended
6. Let it cool down and serve with a lot of ice
7. Add or garnish with cinnamon to taste as desired

title: roast chicken and onion tacos
steps:
1. Peel onions and cut lengthwise into 1 / 2 inch-thick wedges
2. Place in a 12-by 17-inch roasting pan with 2-inch sides
3. In a small bowl , mix oregano , 1 teaspoon salt and pepper
4. Add half the orengano mixture and 1 tablespoon olive oil to onions
5. Mix well
6. Set one or two wire racks over onions , extending beyond pan sides so racks are not resting directly on onions
7. Remove giblets from chicken: discard or reserve for other uses
8. With poultry scissers , cut along one side of backbone of chicken
9. Pull bird open and lay , skin side up , on a flat surface
10. Push down to crack bones slightly so bird lies reasonably flat
11. Pull off and discard lumps of fat
12. Rinse bird well , pat dry
13. Rub remaining 1 tablespoon oil and oregano mixture over bird
14. Set skin side up , on racks over onions
15. Roast in a 425 degree oven until thermometer reaches 170 degrees when inserted through the thickest part of chicken breast to bone and 180 degrees when inserted through thickest part of thigh at joint , 50 to 60 minutes
16. Set chichen on platter or cutting board and let rest 5 to 10 minutes
17. Remove racks from pan
18. If onions are not browned , stir and continue roasting until browned , 5 to 10 minutes longer
19. Scrap browned bits off pan bottom and stir into onions
20. Spoon onoins into bowl
21. Wrap tortillas in plastic wrap and heat in microwave oven until just hot and steamy , about 45 seconds
22. Serve chicken with onions , tortillas , and salsa
23. To eat , cut chicken off bones in chunks or slices and let guest wrap chicken in tortillas , with onions , salsa and salt to taste

title: classic deep dish chicken pot pie
steps:
1. Prepare pastry , set aside
2. In a large saucepan cook leek , mushrooms , celery , and sweet pepper in hot butter over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender
3. Stir in the flour , poultry seasoning , salt , and pepper
4. Add broth and half-and-half all at once
5. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly
6. Stir in chicken and peas
7. Pour into a 2-quart rectangular baking dish
8. Place pastry over chicken mixture in dish
9. Turn edges of pastry under
10. Flute to edges of dish
11. Brush pastry with some of the egg
12. If desired , place cut-out pastry shapes on top of pastry
13. Brush again with egg
14. Bake , uncovered , in a 400 degree f oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until crust is golden brown
15. Let stand for 20 minutes before serving
16. Makes 6 servings
17. Pastry topper:
18. In a medium bowl stir together 1-1 / 4 cups all-purpose flour and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt
19. Using a pastry blender , cut in 1 / 3 cup shortening until dough pieces are pea-size
20. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon cold water over the mixture 1 tbsp at a time , gently toss with a fork until all dough is moistened
21. Form into a ball
22. On a lightly floured surface , roll dough into a 13x9-inch rectangle
23. Using a sharp knife , cut slits in pastry to allow steam to escape , or , if desired , use a small cookie cutter to cut shapes from pastry

title: simple  spectacular spinach
steps:
1. Heat the spinach in a skillet or in the microwave
2. Mix in the chickpeas , feta and pimientos and serve

title: broccoli cheese noodle soup
steps:
1. Bring water and chicken bouillon to a boil
2. Stir in broccoli and let boil for 3 minutes
3. Add noodles and boil for another 3 minutes
4. Add milk and cheese
5. Cook on low until cheese is melted and soup is creamy
6. Enjoy !

title: hearty sausage bean chili
steps:
1. Saut sausage with onions , peppers , and celery until sausage is browned and crumbly
2. Add beans , brown sugar , cumin and tomatoes
3. Bring to a boil , reduce heat , and simmer , uncovered , for about 30 minutes , or until thickened , stirring occasionally

title: food network nuevo latino chipotle beef
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
2. Place the beef , water , tomato paste , sugar , vinegar , chipotle pepper , cumin , salt and black pepper in stockpot
3. Cover and bake in 325 degrees f oven 1 3 / 4 to 2 1 / 4 hours or until beef is fork-tender
4. Meanwhile , cut squash lengthwise into quarters and remove seeds
5. Place squash cut side down in a 13 by 9-inch glass baking dish , overlapping if necessary
6. Add water
7. Bake in the preheated oven for 1 to 1 1 / 4 hours or until fork-tender
8. Place each baked squash quarter onto serving plate
9. Fill with equal amounts of beef mixture
10. Top with tomato and avocado , if desired
11. Sprinkle with cilantro
12. Cook's
13. Cook's
14. Bring beef mixture to a boil
15. Reduce heat
16. Simmer , covered , 1 3 / 4 to 2 1 / 4 hours or until beef is fork-tender

title: baby food pasta
steps:
1. By hand: put flour into a mixing bowl making a well in the center for the baby food
2. Incorporate flour into baby food by mixing in the well slowly pulling in the flour
3. If using a kitchen aide mixer use the dough mixer and it will do this for you
4. You should get a ball after a while
5. It should feel like play dough
6. If it does not start to ball you may need to add more water
7. If it is too sticky add more flour
8. By food processor: put flour into a food processor bowl add the wet ingredients and 1 tsp oil to the flour in the food processor
9. Turn on the processor and mix until ingredients are evenly distributed
10. Mixture will be sandy and crumbly
11. With the processor running , add another 1 tbsp cold water through a feed tube
12. At this stage the mixture should start coming together into a ball
13. If you are not getting a ball after 30 seconds of mixing , open the processor and squeeze a chunk of dough with your fingers
14. If it comes together and feels like play dough , it's done
15. If not , restart the processor and drizzle in a little more water , 1 tsp at a time
16. Turn the dough out onto a work surface and gather into a ball
17. Knead for 8 minutes
18. The dough should be soft , pliable , and slightly tacky , but not sticky
19. It should not stick to the work surface or your hands
20. If it sticks , add a little flour and continue kneading
21. Don't short cut this step
22. Kneading is what develops gluten and makes your dough elastic and workable later
23. Let dough rest 1 or more hours
24. If you have a pasta machine divide the dough into thirds and follow the directions for your pasta machine
25. If you are making it by hand roll out very thin and cut as desired
26. Dry
27. Remember when you go to cook it , fresh pasta only takes a couple minutes to cook
28. The longer it is dried the longer it needs to cook

title: paradise s sensual salad

steps:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees

steps:
1. Mash bananas and mix with salt , sugar , and ufa

steps:
1. Place some bamboo skewers in water one hour before to soak

title: classic risotto  plus tips for perfect risotto
steps:
1. Heat water and broth in 2-quart saucepan over medium heat until it comes to a simmer
2. Reduce heat to low and keep warm
3. Meanwhile , melt 2 tbsp butter in large saucepan over medium heat
4. Add onion and cook until soft
5. Add rice and stir for 2 to 3 minutes
6. Add wine
7. Stir until absorbed

9. Stir in 1 cup water-broth mixture
10. Cook uncovered , stirring frequently , until liquid is absorbed
11. Continue stirring and adding remaining water-broth mixture , 1 cup at a time , allowing each cup to be absorbed before adding another
12. Cook for approximately 25 to 30 minutes or until rice is tender and mixture has a creamy consistency
13. Stir in cream , cheese , tomatoes , salt , pepper and remaining butter
14. Stir until mixture is creamy , about 2 minutes
15. Serve immediately
16. Makes 6 servings
17. 10
18. Choose the right rice
19. Risotto is best with u
20. S
21. Arborio or medium grain rice
22. The starch in these grains absorbs flavors easily and takes on a creamy texture
23. Use a heavy pan with a thick bottom and sides to help distribute heat evenly
24. Make sure it's large enough to hold the cooked rice
25. The rice will expand to about three times its original volume
26. Don't rinse the rice
27. This removes the starch which gives risotto its wonderful creamy consistency
28. Saut the rice in butter or oil
29. This coats each grain , allowing the rice to slowly absorb moisture and resulting in a creamier risotto
30. Use a simple , dry white wine
31. Sauvignon blanc or chardonnay always works well in risotto recipes
32. Risotto dishes also pair well with these wines
33. Keep the broth at a simmer when adding to the rice
34. Hot broth keeps the temperature at a more constant level , ensuring even and continuous cooking
35. Add broth one cup at a time , allowing the broth to fully absorb before adding more
36. The gradual addition of broth and slow cooking helps produce creamy risotto
37. Stir often
38. This keeps the grains in contact with the liquid for even cooking , prevents the rice from sticking to the bottom of the pan , and helps to develop a creamy consistency
39. Get creative ! stir in additions such as asparagus , peas , cooked shellfish , ham or mushrooms at the end for a hearty , delicious risotto
40. Risotto is done when the rice is al dente -- creamy , yet firm in the center
41. Never let rice dry out when making risotto
42. For a creamy texture , the rice should always -- from start to finish -- be kept under a "veil" of broth

7. Beat the batter by hand , about 25 strokes
8. Spread batter evenly into a greased 8x3 or 9x4 inch loaf pan
9. Smooth out the top of the loaf by patting it with your floured hand
10. Cover pan , and let batter rise again until dough has reached the top of the pan
11. Bake in a preheated 375f oven for 45-50 minutes , or until the loaf sounds hollow when the top is lightly tapped
12. Remove from pan
13. For a softer crust , brush the top of the hot loaf with butter
14. Cool on a wire rack
15. Bread slices best when it is cooled

title: americano
steps: 1. Combine in glass

title: soft shell steak tacos with creamy lime coleslaw
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , mix together the chili powder , salt , black pepper and oil
2. Toss with the steak strips
3. In another medium bowl , mix together the coleslaw , lime juice , mayonnaise , sour cream , honey , garlic , cumin , jalapeno , cilantro and salt and pepper to taste
4. In a skillet over medium-high heat , add the steak and cook to desired doneness
5. To assemble , place equal amounts of steak on tortillas , top with coleslaw and cheddar , if using
6. Roll up

title: five vegetable stir fry
steps:
1. Make vegetable pieces attractive
2. Cut broccoli florets from stem to bloom into 1 / 3 slices
3. Cut onion into 8ths then separate slices
4. Carve and slice carrot into clover leafs
5. Slice cabbage in 1 / 2 strands
6. Cut red pepper into squares , then diagonally halve the squares
7. Make green onion flowers
8. Spray large nonstick skillet with vegetable oil spray
9. Heat 1 teaspoon oil in skillet over medium-high heat
10. Add carrots , onion , and bell pepper
11. Saute 6 minutes
12. Add 1 teaspoon oil , broccoli and cabbage
13. Add broth
14. Stir-fry until cabbage wilts and vegetables are crisp-tender , about 8 minutes
15. Stir in mint
16. Season with salt and pepper

title: armenian stuffed grape leaves
steps:
1. Saute onions in olive oil until soft , not brown
2. Remove from heat
3. Mix in everything else except grape leaves and lemon , cool
4. If using fresh grape leaves , blanch quickly in boiling water
5. If using canned or jarred , no need for this step
6. Rinse canned or jarred leaves to remove brine
7. Lay out one leaf , pointy side up , shiny side down , cutting off stem
8. Put a teaspoon of filling in the center , in a line
9. Fold up bottom of leaf to cover filling and then fold in sides and roll up to point of leaf
10. Don't roll too tightly because rice will expand
11. Similar to rolling a burrito or cigar
12. Dolma can be cooked in a double boiler to prevent scorching , or line a pot with broken leaves
13. Place all rolls in pot lined up neatly and stacked up until all are in pot
14. Cover with a plate to prevent floating
15. Squeeze 1 lemon into pot and add 2 cups of water
16. Cook over low heat for about an hour and check
17. If liquid is not absorbed keep cooking until no more liquid remains
18. Cool in pot without removing plate
19. Refrigerate until chilled and serve with lemon wedges

title: peach cream pie
steps:
1. Combine , sugar , butter , and flour
2. Add beaten egg and vanilla
3. Mix together
4. Pour over peaches
5. Pour into pie crust
6. Bake in a 300 oven for 1 hour

title: smoky and rich venison stew
steps:
1. Lightly pound the cubed venison just to break it down , not to flatten
2. Season the meat with salt and pepper , dried thyme , and garlic powder
3. Then season the flour with creole seasonings , cinnamon , and cumin
4. Dredge the meat in the seasoned flour
5. Heat a large , heavy pot and add the bacon grease
6. Brown the venison and remove
7. Add to the hot grease the onion , celery , bell pepper , carrots and garlic and sautee until softened
8. Be sure to scrape off the bottom of the pan as you saute
9. Add the red wine and deglaze the pan , stir for 2 minutes and add the olive oil to make the stirring easier
10. Add the consomme , water , tomatoes , bay leaves and ham shank
11. Return the venison to the pot
12. Simmer , uncovered for 2-3 hours stirring occasionally and adding water as needed
13. In the last 1 / 2 hour add the celery root , pearl onions , and peas
14. Serve hot over noodles

title: chipotle orange glazed pork chops
steps:
1. In a small cup combine first 4 ingredients
2. Spray grill with pam and preheat to medium high
3. Sprinkle pork chops with salt and then brush with glaze
4. Cook pork chops over medium high heat until cooked through

title: slow cooked beer braised beef
steps:
1. To use a slow cooker , omit oil and place beef directly into cooker
2. Top with remaining ingredients
3. Cook on high for 1 hour
4. Reduce heat to low and cook for 5 hours or until roast is very tender
5. If you don't have a slow cooker , heat a large pot over high heat
6. Add oil
7. Brown roast on all sides
8. Add beer , onion , soy sauce , pepper and basil
9. Bring to a boil
10. Cover and place pot in 275 degree oven for 7-9 hours , or until meat is tender
11. Leftovers can be stored in the refrigerator , sliced , with juices , for up to 3 days

title: tangy citrus cole slaw
steps:
1. Put the chili in a small saucepan with the pineapple juice
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce to 1 / 4 cup
4. Remove and discard the chili
5. Mix remaining dressing ingredients and set aside until cool
6. Toss cabbage and carrots in the dressing

title: puerto rican pina colada
steps:
1. Blend ice and pineapple juice
2. Add cream of coconut , rum , the milks and vanilla
3. Top with a cherry and ground cinnamon

title: mediterranean black bean lettuce wraps
steps:
1. Set beans and chives in separate shallow bowls
2. Combine rice , salad dressng and cheese in small bowl
3. Set leaves on plate and allow guests to create own lettuce wraps or assemble and serve
4. Wheat crackers may be substituted for lettuce wraps
5. Spoon bean mixture onto crackers just before serving

title: chocolate mint cookies
steps:
1. Combine flour , baking soda and cocoa together in a bowl and combine
2. In a separate bowl , combine brown sugar , sugar , butter , applesauce , vanilla , mint extract and egg white
3. Beat with a hand mixer until well blended
4. Combine flour mix with sugar mix to form dough
5. Roll into a log and cover with plastic wrap
6. Place in freezer for about 1 hour until firm
7. Slice into quarter inch pieces and place on a baking sheet that has been sprayed with baking spray
8. Bake at 350 for about 10 minutes
9. Cool on wire rack

title: cabbage potato soup
steps:
1. In a large soup pot , melt the butter
2. Add chopped onion , shredded cabbage and garlic
3. Sautee for about 5-7 minutes or until onion is soft and transparent
4. Add broth to soup pot
5. Add finely diced potatoes , parsley , celery seeds and pepper
6. Bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat and simmer for about 15 minutes
8. Using a potato masher , coarsley mash the potatoes to thicken the soup
9. Make as smooth or chunky as desired
10. Stir in the half and half and shredded cheese
11. Heat over low heat , stirring often until cheese is melted
12. If using the ham , add it here and heat through
13. Taste and season with salt and / or more pepper as needed

title: turkey   quinoa meatloaf
steps:
1. Bring the quinoa and 1 / 2 cup of water to a boil in a saucepan over high heat
2. Reduce heat to medium-low , cover , and simmer until the quinoa is tender , and the water has been absorbed , about 15 to 20 minutes
3. Set aside to cool
4. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
5. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat
6. Stir in the onion
7. Cook and stir until the onion has softened and turned translucent , about 5 minutes
8. Add the garlic and cook for another minute
9. Remove from heat to cool
10. Mix the turkey , cooked quinoa , onions , garlic , zucchini , yellow peppers , tomato paste , 1 1 / 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce , egg , salt , and pepper in a large bowl until well combined
11. The mixture will be very moist
12. Shape into a loaf on a foil lined baking sheet or place into a loaf pan
13. Combine the 1 1 / 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce , and 1 / 2 cup of ketchup in a small bowl
14. Rub the ketchup mixture over the top of the meatloaf
15. Bake in the preheated oven until no longer pink in the center , about 50 minutes
16. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 160 degrees f
17. Let the meatloaf cool for 10 minutes before slicing and serving
18. Bon apptit !

title: zesty lemon chicken   prep time includes marinating
steps:
1. Pour the entire 8 oz bottle of italian dressing into a casserole dish , or something large enough to marinate the chicken inches
2. Cut the lemon in half and squeeze the juice into the dressing
3. It's fine if you don't have a juicer , just get as much of the juice as you can into the dressing
4. Next you'll want to grate the lemon peel into the dressing / lemon juice mixture
5. Just think , the more the better !
6. Rinse your chicken thoroughly and put it in the dressing / juice / peel mixture
7. That's it ! allow the chicken to marinate for about an hour
8. Grill for 15-20 minutes or until chicken is completely cooked through

title: tomato sauce with ground beef  and variations
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large heavy saucepan
2. Add onion
3. Saut over low heat , stirring , until tender and golden , about 5 minutes
4. Add the garlic , saut 1 minute
5. Meanwhile , brown the ground beef in a skillet , stirring to crumble meat
6. Drain off fat
7. Add the onion mixture
8. Optional: now is when you would add the mushrooms , vegetables or red wine
9. Saut until tender or until the wine is reduced by half
10. Add the tomatoes , tomato sauce and paste , 1 tsp salt , the basil , oregano , pepper and bay leaf
11. Heat over medium-low heat to simmering
12. Simmer , uncovered , over low heat , stirring occasionally until sauce is thickened and flavourful , about 1 hour 15 minutes

title: berry yummy smoothie shake
steps:
1. Add the yogurt , fruit , juice , ice , and splenda into the blender
2. Blend until free of fruit or ice chunks
3. Enjoy !

title: keema bhutuwa
steps:
1. In a non-stick pan , heat four tablespoons of oil
2. Add fenugreek seeds and red chilies and fry till dark
3. Add turmeric , garlic , ginger , cumin and chili powder
4. Fry for another 30 sec
5. Add chopped onions and stir fry until light brown
6. Put chopped tomatoes and cook for about five minutes
7. Add ground meat to the pan
8. Stir to break up into lumps
9. Salt and pepper the meat mixture
10. Set heat to medium and continue to stir fry the meat until cooked
11. It may require some broth or water to moisten , if it starts to burn
12. Add green peas and spring onion
13. Stir for another two minutes
14. Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper
15. Garnish with fresh cilantro
16. Drain excess oil , if necessary
17. Serve with stir-fried vegetables and rice , or roti

title: coca cola cake with broiled peanut butter frosting
steps:
1. To make the cake: preheat the oven to 350f grease and flour a 9 x 13 x 10 inch sheet cake pan
2. Combine the flour and sugar in a large bowl
3. In a separate bowl , combine the butter , cocoa and coke , and pour over the flour and sugar mixture
4. Stir until well blended
5. Add the buttermilk , eggs , baking soda and vanilla
6. Mix well
7. Stir in the marshmallows
8. Pour into the prepared pan , and bake for 40 minutes
9. Remove the cake from the oven and frost while still barely warm
10. To make the frosting: in a bowl cream the butter , sugar and peanut butter
11. Beat in the milk
12. Fold in the peanuts
13. Spread over the cake
14. Place the frosted cake under the broiler about 4 inches from the heat source
15. Broil just a few seconds , or until topping starts to bubble
16. Watch comstantly , being careful not to scorch the frosting
17. Let cool at least 30 minutes before serving

title: slightly smokey and spicy taco meat
steps:
1. Saute onion and garlic until soft
2. Add ground beef and spices and cook until meat is no longer pink
3. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 15 minutes
4. I served these using hard taco shells , asedero cheese , and shredded lettuce
5. The asedero cheese really makes it ! i found it in the refrigerated section of the supermarket by the cream cheeses , string cheeses , and laughing cow brand cheese

title: spicy gumbo
steps:
1. Combine 1 1 / 2 cups oil and 1 3 / 4 cups flour in a heavy skillet or pan over low heat
2. Stir constantly until the flour thickens and turns light brown
3. Add more flour if needed to absorb oil and make a smooth paste
4. It takes approximately 15 minutes or so , but be careful to not burn the flour
5. Set the roux aside
6. Mix together all spices in a bowl and set aside
7. In a large 12 quart pot , saut onions , garlic , bell pepper and celery in 3 tbsp olive oil
8. Cook for approximately 3-4 minutes
9. Add the chicken , shrimp , cat fish and okra
10. Cook for approximately 4-5 minutes
11. Add the peppers , tomatoes , seasonings , chicken stock , v-8 and clam juice
12. Simmer , uncovered for approximately 1 hour
13. With a wire whisk , slowly incorporate the roux into the mixture to desired consistency
14. Add more chicken stock if necessary
15. Add the rest of the seafood to the mixture
16. Turn down heat , cover and simmer on low for about 10 minutes
17. In a shallow bowl , mound 1 / 2 cup rice and ladle the gumbo on top
18. Serve with oyster crackers and a dash of tabasco sauce

title: grilled green tomatoes   onions
steps:
1. Brush tomato and onion slices with oil and grill over medium-low heat turning once or twice , until lightly charred and soft
2. Cover bottom of shallow dish with grilled tomato slices in overlapping rows
3. Separate grilled onion slices into rings and scatter over tomatoes
4. In saucepan heat vinegar with water , sugar , caraway seeds , salt and hot pepper flakes , stirring , just until sugar is dissolved
5. Let cool
6. Stir again and pour over grilled tomatoes and onions
7. Cover and let stand 2 hours at room temperature , or up to 8 hours in refrigerator

title: honey wheat zucchini bread
steps:
1. Beat zucchini , eggs , honey , applesauce , oil , and vanilla until frothy
2. Add remaining ingredients and mix until blended
3. Grease and flour two bread pans
4. Pour batter evenly into the pans
5. Bake at 325 for 1 hour

title: mexican bean spread dip
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients in a food processor or blender until almost smooth
2. Adjust seasonings to taste

title: cauliflower parmigiana bake
steps:
1. Set oven to 375 degrees
2. Butter an 11 x 7-inch baking dish
3. Sprinkle about 2-3 tablespoons seasoned bread crumbs on the bottom of the dish
4. Place half of the cauliflower florets on top of the bread crumbs
5. Pour 1-1 / 2 cups marinara sauce over the florets
6. Sprinkle half of the mozza cheese and remaining bread crumbs over sauce
7. Repeat the layering
8. Cover with foil
9. Bake for about 40 minutes
10. Remove foil , and sprinkle with parmesan cheese
11. Return to oven uncovered and bake another 10-15 minutes or until the florets are soft and the parmesan cheese is golden brown
12. Let stand for 15 minutes before serving

title: divine chicken rolls with wine sauce
steps:
1. In a bowl , stir together well drained spinach , chopped artichoke hearts , softened herb & garlic cream cheese , asiago cheese , lemon zest and salt
2. Preheat oven to 350'
3. Place a chicken breast between 2 sheets of waxed paper and pound meat out to about 1 cm of thickness
4. Repeat for all chicken breasts
5. Season chicken liberally with greek seasoning on both sides
6. Divide cream cheese mixture into 4 equal portions
7. Place a portion of the cream cheese mixture and spread evenly over the pounded chicken
8. Roll the chicken breast up and secure it with a toothpick
9. Place the chicken in a glass baking dish
10. In a pot on the stove , melt butter
11. Add flour and chicken bouilon powder
12. Cook and stir for 1 minute on medium
13. Add milk & wine to the flour mixture , stir over medium heat for approximately 2 minutes
14. Pour the wine sauce over the chicken and bake for 45-50 minutes

title: apple praline bubble bread
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f spray with cooking spray or grease with shortening a 12-cup fluted tube cake pan
2. In small microwavable bowl , microwave butter on high about 30 seconds or until melted
3. Stir in brown sugar
4. Spread mixture evenly in pan
5. Sprinkle with half of the pecans
6. In small bowl , mix sugar and cinnamon
7. Roll biscuit quarters in sugar mixture until evenly coated
8. Place half of the coated biscuit quarters in pan
9. Sprinkle remaining pecans and apple on top of biscuit quarters
10. Arrange remaining coated biscuit quarters on top
11. Bake 35 to 38 minutes or until golden brown
12. Carefully turn pan upside down onto serving platter
13. Let stand 1 minute before removing pan
14. Cool slightly
15. To serve , pull apart or slice

title: zucchini stuffed pork chops   mustard sauce
steps:
1. Toss the zucchini and salt well in a colander and let it drain for about 30 minutes
2. Squeeze the zucchini dry
3. In a large non-stick skillet heat 3 tbsp of the oil and cook the garlic and the zuchini over a fairly low heat , stirring until it's just tender
4. Stir in the parmesan and let cool
5. Cut a deep pocket in each chop and stuff with the zucchini
6. Heat the remaining oil in another large non-stick skillet over medium high heat until it is hot but not smoking
7. Pat the chops dry with a paper towel , and coat them in the sesame seeds
8. Press the seeds in -- and saute , turning them once , til they are firm to the touch
9. Keep warm on a platter in the oven
10. Meanwhile , make the mustard sauce: in the oil remaining in the skillet that you cooked the pork chops in , saute the onion over medium high heat until it is soft , about 2 minutes
11. Add the wine and de-glaze the pan
12. Whisk in the cream
13. Add the mustard , the parmesan cheese , and any juice that may have accumulated on the platter , and stir to combine
14. Add salt and pepper to your liking
15. I spoon it over the chops or you could serve them on top of a pool of sauce
16. Goes very well with spinach btw !

title: warm potato and avocado salad
steps:
1. Cook potatoes until tender and quarter them
2. Grill bacon then chop into small pieces
3. Add everything to a pan and cook lightly for three minutes
4. Toss and serve on salad leaves

title: blueberry pie a la dr weil
steps:
1. Heat the blueberries in a saucepan over medium heat until they begin to boil
2. Simmer gently for 10 minutes
3. Add the sugar , lemon juice , and cinnamon , and cook for another 2 minutes
4. Mix the cornstarch or arrowroot well with the water , and pour mixture into the simmering blueberries while stirring
5. Cook , stirring , until mixture becomes clear and thick
6. Continue to cook for 1 minute
7. Remove from heat and cool
8. Spoon mixture into the pie crust and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving

title: grilled bacon burgers
steps:
1. In small bowl , combine the egg , cheese , onion , soy sauce , ketchup and pepper
2. Crumble beef over mixture and mix well
3. Shape into five patties
4. Wrap a bacon strip around each
5. Secure with a toothpick
6. Grill patties , uncovered , over medium-hot heat for 5-6 minutes on each side or until meat is no longer pink
7. Discard toothpicks
8. Serve on buns with lettuce , tomato and onion , if desired

title: not just another cream of mushroom soup
steps:
1. Slice enough mushrooms to measure 1 cup
2. Chop remaining mushrooms
3. Cook and stir sliced mushrooms in 2 tbls of butter in a 3qt
4. Saucepan over low heat until golden brown
5. Remove with slotted spoon
6. Cook and stir chopped mushrooms and onion in remaining butter until onion is tender
7. Stir in flour , salt and pepper
8. Cook over low heat stirring constantly , about 1 minute then remove from heat
9. Stir in broth and water
10. Heat to a boil , stirring constantly
11. Boil and stir for 1 minute
12. Stir in half-and-half and sliced mushrooms
13. Garnish with parsley

title: caesar chicken pasta salad
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl
2. Toss well to coat

title: crunchy pound cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Grease and flour bundt pan
3. Combine butter and shortening in mixer bowl
4. Add eggs and blend well
5. Add other ingredients
6. Beat on medium speed for 10 minutes
7. Pour into pan
8. Bake 70 minutes or until golden brown
9. Cool in pan 10 minutes

title: lentil and sweet italian sausage soup
steps:
1. In a soup pot , cook sausage until brown , about 5 minutes
2. Stir in onion , celery , carrot , and garlic and cook for about 5 minutes
3. Add tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes
4. Stir in lentils , broth , and black pepper
5. Simmer for 40 minutes

title: bob s red mill wheat biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Sift together flours , sugar , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
3. Using your fingers , rub cubes of cold butter into the flour until it resembles coarse crumbs
4. Add buttermilk and stir until moistened , then knead a few times , just enough to make the dough come together
5. Drop about 1 / 4 cup dough onto parchment paper and flatten slightly , or you may choose to roll about half inch thick and cut them , placing them on a parchment paper lined baking sheet
6. Bake for about 12 minutes , or until tops are golden brown and a toothpick comes out clean

title: green beans with garlic and sun dried tomatoes
steps:
1. Trim beans
2. Heat oil in large skillet
3. Add garlic , anchovy and tomatoes
4. Cook on low heat until very fragrant , about 2 minutes
5. Add beans and coat with garlic mixture
6. Add water and bring to boil
7. Cook , uncovered until water evaporates and beans are glazed with garlic mixture -- about 10 minutes
8. Stir occasionally during cooking
9. Taste and add salt only of necessary

title: pumpkin glazed pumpkin cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar
2. Beat in eggs and pumpkin until light and fluffy
3. Stir in vanilla
4. Measure flour , baking powder , salt , cinnamon , allspice and ginger and mix in bowl
5. Stir into creamed mixture to make a rather soft cookie dough
6. Stir in nuts
7. Spoon out onto greased cookie sheets , about 2-inches apart in rounded teaspoonfuls
8. Bake at 375 for 12-15 minutes
9. Remove while hot onto rack
10. Cool slightly
11. Spoon glaze over while cookies are still warm
12. Spicy pumpkin glaze: stir together powdered sugar , butter , cinnamon , and allspice
13. Blend in pumpkin to make a smooth glaze

title: cool carlito
steps:
1. Stir together in a drink glass with ice
2. Garnish with fruit , if desired

title: prosciutto pinwheels
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Roll out thawed pastry sheet on counter
3. Spread the aloue
4. Tte cheese on pastry sheet - leaving a 1 / 2" border
5. Arrange spinach and then prosciutto slices over cheese spread
6. Starting at one end , roll up pastry sheet jelly-roll style , keeping the roll as tight as possible
7. Wrap in plastic
8. Refrigerate until firm or freeze for future use
9. When ready to bake , thaw in fridge for several hours , remove from fridge , cut into thin 1 / 4"-1 / 2" slices with a sharp , serrated knife
10. Spray cookie sheet with cooking spray or line with parchment paper
11. Lay each slice onto cookie sheet 1" apart
12. Brush with egg to coat each piece
13. Bake 10-12 minutes until golden brown
14. Serve warm

title: green tea thumbprints with three different fillings
steps:
1. First combine all of the dry ingredients in a big bowl
2. Then add all of the wet ingredients at once and knead everything into a smooth dough
3. Divide dough into 24 portions and roll them into balls
4. Using one of your fingers or a spoon make an indentation into each thumbprint
5. Fill 8 cookies with 1 / 2 ts of marmalade each , 8 with peanut butter and the other 8 with the red currant jam
6. Place them on a paper-lined baking sheet and bake in the pre-heated oven at 180c / 350f for about 15 minutes or until cookies are slightly browned around the edges and cooked through

title: dried cranberry chutney appetizers
steps:
1. Combine dried cranberries , water , sugar , and ginger in a small saucepan
2. Bring to boiling
3. Cover and remove from heat
4. Let stand for 15 minutes
5. Snip any large pieces of mango chutney
6. Stir chutney into cranberry mixture
7. Cover and chill at least 2 hours
8. Serve cranberry chutney with soft cheese or cream cheese , apple slices , and crackers , or with toasted baguette slices
9. Makes about 1-1 / 3 cups chutney
10. Make-ahead

title: deep dish taco pizza
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f
2. Heat a medium skillet over medium-high heat and add the olive oil
3. When the oil is hot , add the ground beef and cook , crumbling it with a wooden spoon , until well browned and cooked through , about 6 minutes
4. Drain off and discard any excess fat
5. Return the skillet to the heat , add the chili powder , garlic powder and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and stir to incorporate
6. Add the adobo sauce and 2 tablespoons water
7. Cook 1 minute to blend the flavors , then remove from the heat
8. Meanwhile , combine the beans and salsa in a small saucepan
9. Bring to a simmer and cook until thickened , 4 to 5 minutes
10. Keep warm
11. Brush a 12-inch cast-iron skillet with oil
12. Cut six 2-inch snips in the pizza with scissors , spaced evenly around the edge
13. Fit the pizza into the oiled cast-iron skillet , pressing the edges to make a deep-dish-type crust
14. Bake the pizza until heated through and the cheese is just melted , about 10 minutes
15. Remove the pizza from the oven , top with the beans and ground beef and sprinkle with the cheddar
16. Return to the oven and bake until the edges of the crust are golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly , 5 to 6 minutes more
17. Let stand for 5 minutes
18. Top with dollops of sour cream and guacamole and sprinkle with cilantro leaves
19. Cut into wedges in the skillet and serve with a pie server

title: caramelized onion rolls  with  herb butter
steps:
1. Herb butter
2. Combine in a small bowl , softened butter with 1 tbsp each of finely chopped , fresh parsley and thyme
3. Mix well , cover and refrigerate until needed
4. Dough
5. Combine milk , 1 / 4 cup butter , oil and salt in pot over medium heat
6. Bring to a boil then remove from heat and cool
7. Pour warm water into small bowl
8. Sprinkle yeast over warm water and let stand 5 minutes , until foamy
9. Add remaining 2 tsps of butter to frying pan and melt over medium low heat
10. Add onions and cook 20 minutes until browned
11. Take pan off heat and cool onions
12. Once the onions are cooled chop and set aside
13. In large bowl whisk together 1 egg , 3 tsps parsley , thyme , milk and yeast mixtures
14. Stir in 3 cups flour until just combined
15. Stir in remaining flour slowly until dough is no longer sticky
16. Knead dough 3-5 minutes on a floured surface
17. Form dough into disk
18. Add half of the chopped onions ontop of the disk
19. Fold disk in half and knead in onions
20. Place in a greased bowl , cover and let rise until doubled
21. Punch down the dough
22. Cut dough in half with knife
23. Cut each piece into four pieces
24. Now cut each piece into thirds
25. You should have 24 pieces when finished cutting
26. Roll each piece into 7" long rope
