27. Spiral each rope , pinching the end into the roll to seal
28. Place on baking sheet , cover and let rise until almost double in size
29. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
30. Lightly beat remaining egg and brush over rolls
31. Top with remaining onion and parsley
32. Bake 18-20 minutes
33. Serve with herb butter and enjoy

title: white chicken and ham lasagna
steps:
1. Cook noodles in boiling water , according to package directions
2. Drain
3. In large saucepan , melt butter
4. Into butter , blend flour , onion , garlic and pepper
5. Add broth and milk
6. Cook , stirring until bubbly and thickened
7. Stir in 1 / 2 of the parmesan cheese
8. Spread 1 cup sauce in the bottom of a greased 9x13-inch pan
9. Stir mushrooms into remaining sauce
10. Place layer of 3 noodles over sauce in pan
11. Then top with chicken , 1 / 2 spinach , 1 / 3 shredded mozzarella cheese , and 2 cups of sauce
12. Next , layer 3 more noodles , followed by ham , 1 / 2 spinach , 1 / 3 mozzarella cheese , and 2 cups of sauce
13. Next , layer final 3 lasagna noodles , followed by 2 cups sauce , and final 1 / 3 mozzarella cheese
14. Sprinkle remaining parmesan cheese over top
15. Bake in 350f oven until heated through

title: apple and cabbage salad
steps:
1. Combine the walnuts , apples , cabbage and salt
2. Add just enough miracle whip to coat everything
3. Refrigerate till ready to serve
4. Serve cold

title: emeril lagasse s perfect pizza dough
steps:
1. In the bowl of your heavy-duty mixer , stir together the water , yeast and sugar
2. Let sit until the mixture is foamy , which takes about 5 minutes
3. Add 1 1 / 2 cups of the flour , the oil and salt into the yeast mixture and , using the paddle attachment , combine until mixture is smooth
4. Switch to the dough hook
5. With the machine running at low , add remaining flour , 1 / 4 cup at a time
6. Make sure each addition of flour is incorporated before adding the next
7. Once all the flour has been added , turn up the speed and let the machine knead the dough for about 3 minutes
8. It should be very smooth and perhaps a bit tacky
9. Feel free to add an extra minute or two of kneading if you wish
10. It won't hurt the dough at all
11. Rub the insides of a large mixing bowl with a little olive oil
12. Remove dough from machine , form into a ball , and place into oiled bowl , turning dough over to make sure all sides are oiled
13. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and place in a warm , draft-free area to rise
14. The dough should nearly double in size , which will take about 60 to 90 minutes
15. An old habit of mine is to place a towel around the bowl , just to make sure no drafts get to the dough
16. When dough is ready , lightly punch it down and knead it a bit , still right in the bowl
17. Lightly flour your work surface and place dough ball on it
18. Let it rest for 10 minutes
19. This makes one large pizza
20. If you prefer two smaller pizzas , cut dough in half , then form into two balls and let rest , as above
21. After dough has rested , form into a 16-inch round and you're ready to make pizza , using your favourite toppings
22. The biggest trick here , when stretching out the dough , is not to get frustrated
23. If you find you're stretching the pizza and it's resisting and is too elastic , bouncing right back from each stretch , just walk away for a few minutes
24. After you let the pizza rest again , you'll find the dough will let you stretch it out
25. You might even want to try flipping it into the air a bit !
26. Warning: let it come down on your knuckles , not your finger
27. The best way to bake your prepared pizza is on a baking stone on your lowest oven rack
28. Emeril suggests 8 to 10 minutes at 475f , but a little lower temperature for a little longer works just fine too

title: peanut butter chow mein cookies
steps:
1. Melt chips and peanut butter in pan
2. Add chow mein noodles and marshmallows
3. Stir thoroughly on low heat
4. Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper
5. Cookies will harden quickly , so move fast !

title: buttermilk doughnuts donuts
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast in warm water in a large bowl
2. Let stand 5 minutes
3. Add buttermilk , shortening , sugar and 1 1 / 2 cup flour , baking powder and salt
4. Mix well
5. Add enough remaining flour to make a soft dough
6. Turn dough onto a floured surface and knead several times
7. Roll dough to 1 / 2 inch thick and cut with a 2 1 / 2 inch doughnut cutter
8. Place doughnuts on lightly floured surface , cover and let rise 45 minutes or until double in bulk
9. Heat 2-3 inches of oil to 375f
10. Drop in 4 or 5 doughnuts at a time
11. Cook about 2 minutes or until lightly golden in color , turning once
12. Drain well on paper towels
13. Combine 2 1 / 2 cups powdered sugar with 1 / 4 cup milk , stir until smooth
14. Dip each doughnut in glaze while still warm
15. Allow excess glaze to drip off
16. Cool on wire rack or serve warm

title: stir fried fresh aspargus
steps:
1. Snap off the tough ends of the asparagus
2. Cut asparagus into 1 inch pieces
3. Set aside
4. Saute minced garlic in melted butter in a large skillet for 1 minute
5. Add asparagus pieces , stirring well to combine
6. Add chicken broth , salt , and sugar , stirring well to combine
7. Cook over high heat 3-4 minutes or until asparagus is crisp-tender , stirring frequently
8. Sprinkle the asparagus with slice almonds or sesame seeds
9. Serve immediately

title: cheesy corn toasties
steps:
1. Toast bread until lightly brown on both sides
2. Mix the egg , corn , cheese and spring onion in a bowl with a fork
3. Spread the mixture over the toast right to the edges
4. Grill , not too close to the heat , until golden brown and bubbly

title: flounder cordon bleu
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Place 1 slice each of ham and cheese in the center of each fillet
3. Cut to fit if needed
4. Sprinkle orange rind and pepper evenly over each fillet
5. Roll the fillets and secure with toothpicks
6. Gently dip rolls in beaten egg , then coat with bread crumbs
7. Place in 12x8x2 inch baking dish
8. Melt margarine in sauce pan over medium-heat
9. Blend in flour
10. Slowly stir in milk and cook until thickened
11. Pour sauce over fish and top with parmesan cheese
12. Bake for 20 minutes or until fish flakes easily

title: meatless spaghetti pie
steps:
1. Toss hot spaghetti in large bowl with the butter
2. Combine eggs and 1 / 2 cup grated parmesan in a small bowl and stir into spaghetti
3. Pour spaghetti mixture into a lightly greased 10 inch pie plate and form into a crust
4. Bake approximately 10 minutes in a 350 oven
5. Remove from oven and spread ricotta evenly over crust , but not to the edge
6. Top with spaghetti sauce
7. Bake uncovered for about 20 minutes at 350
8. Top with with shredded mozzarella , and bake until cheese melts - about 5 minutes longer
9. Remove from oven and sprinkle with remaining 2 tablespoons of parmesan cheese
10. Cool 10 minutes before cutting

title: tomato and garlic bread soup
steps:
1. Garlic bread croutons:
2. Preheat oven to 300f
3. In a large bowl , mix 1 / 2 cup olive oil and 3 minced garlic cloves
4. Add bread pieces and toss to coat
5. On a large baking sheet , arrange coated bread in a single layer
6. Bake in preheated oven until golden , stirring once
7. Set baked croutons aside
8. Tomato soup :
9. In a large heavy-duty pot , heat 2 tbs
10. Olive oil over medium heat
11. Add onions and saut for approximately 25 minutes , or until very tender
12. Add remaining six minced garlic cloves and cook for one minute
13. Add chicken stock , crushed tomatoes and 1 / 2 cup grated parmesan
14. Simmer uncovered for about 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
15. Season with salt and fresh ground pepper
16. Add garlic bread croutons to soup and cook for one minute more
17. Ladle soup into bowls and garnish each serving with basil slices and parmesan shavings

title: scallops charlotte
steps:
1. If you are using large sea scallops , cut them in half horizontally
2. If you have tiny bay scallops , they can be left whole
3. In a large skillet over medium heat , melt 1 tablespoon of the butter
4. Add shallots and mushrooms
5. Saute over medium-high heat for 2 minutes
6. Remove to a bowl and set aside
7. Melt remaining butter in skillet
8. Add scallops
9. Saute 2 to 3 minutes , until scallops are opaque
10. Using a slotted spoon , remove scallops from skillet and add them to mushroom mixture
11. Set aside
12. Add cream and wine to liquid in skillet
13. Add any juices that have accumulated in bowl of scallops
14. Cook , stirring constantly , over medium heat until sauce reduces to 2 / 3 to 3 / 4 cup and thickens enough to lightly coat a spoon
15. Add mushroom and scallop mixture
16. Cook to heat through
17. Season to taste with salt and pepper
18. Serve garnished with chives

title: spaghetti sauce to die for
steps:
1. In a large skillet cook the meat , onion , green pepper and garlic until meat is brown and vegetables are tender
2. Drain off fat
3. Stir in tomatoes , tomato paste , brown sugar , oregano , salt , basil , thyme and bay leaf
4. Stir in water
5. Pour into large pot
6. Bring to boiling
7. Reduce heat
8. Simmer , uncovered , for l to 2 hours or till sauce is of desired consistency , stirring occasionally , the thicker the better
9. Add lemon juice during last 5 minutes of simmering
10. Remove bay leaf
11. Serve over hot cooked pasta
12. Pass grated parmesan cheese , if desired
13. Makes 6 servings

title: easy date and pecan ice cream
steps:
1. Soak dates in milk for 15 seconds
2. Soften ice cream
3. Add dates , milk and the rest of the ingredients into the ice cream
4. Mix well
5. Set in a ring jelly mold and freeze
6. Before serving drizzle honey and garnish with whole pecans

title: pork and beef broccoli wontons
steps:
1. Steam the broccoli florets until just tender
2. Drain and then chop very small
3. In a medium bowl combine ground beef and pork with chopped broccoli and all remaining ingredients
4. Mix well to combine
5. Chill for a minumum of 4 hors
6. Place several wrappers on a surface
7. Brush edges lightly with water
8. Place 1 heaping teaspoon of the meat mixture into the center of each wrapper
9. Fold the warppers diagonally in half , pressing edges to seal
10. Place wontons on waxed paper
11. Repeat with remaining meat mixture and wrappers
12. Heat oil in a large heavy skillet
13. Add in the wontons and fry until they are golden and the filling is cooked through
14. You can keep them warm in a 250 degree oven while frying the remaining wontons

title: cracker barrel old country store carrot cake
steps:
1. Mix together flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt , cinnamon , nutmeg and cloves
2. Set aside
3. In a large bowl mix with beater oil , sugars , vanilla and eggs until smooth and fluffy
4. Add pineapple , walnuts , coconut , carrots , and raisins and blend well
5. Gradually add flour mixture a half at a time until blended through
6. Pour batter into a greased and floured 9"x13" pan and bake at 350 for about 40-50 minute test with toothpick for doneness
7. When cool frost with cream cheese frosting
8. Frosting:
9. Blend cream cheese and butter until light and fluffy
10. Add vanilla and a little powder sugar at a time until all has been blend well
11. Turn mixer on high and beat until frosting is light and fluffy
12. Spread frosting over the cooled cake and sprinkle with pecans

title: murray s poor man s breakfast
steps:
1. In a large frying pan , melt half of butter over medium heat
2. Place the bread slices into pan , and crack an egg into the center hole
3. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
4. Cook about 2-3 minutes depending on how well done you want your yolks
5. Add remaining butter , and carefully flip over the bread with the egg center
6. Cook an additional 2-3 minutes

title: oh  fudge  choco peanut butter fudge
steps:
1. In medium saucepan , mix together first four ingredients
2. Cook over medium heat until mixture has risen high in the pan and then come down , about 10 minutes
3. Drop a little bit of the mixture into a small saucer of cold water
4. If it forms a ball , it is ready for the next step
5. Or , use a candy thermometer to check mixture for doneness
6. The thermometer should register 232 degrees
7. Add vanilla and butter
8. Stir well
9. Fold in peanut butter
10. Fudge will harden quickly , so immediately spoon thick mixture into greased 8-by-8 inch glass or metal pan and smooth down with back of spoon
11. Cool on counter for about 30 minutes , the cut into bite size pieces and serve
12. Store any extra , covered , in cool , dry place

title: bacon and rice creole
steps:
1. Simmer vegetables and spices in a saucepan
2. At the same time , fry the bacon
3. When bacon is done , remove from pan and crumble into small pieces
4. Drain off all fat
5. Let rice brown lightly
6. Add the vegetables and bacon
7. Let simmer over very low heat for 30 minutes
8. Check after 20 minutes to see if it is drying out
9. If so , add more tomatoes , or some water , or a combination of both

title: quick and easy yunnan potatoes
steps:
1. Heat wok or heavy skillet over high heat
2. Add oil and swirl to coat bottom of pan
3. Add chiles and cook , stirring , until they begin to puff up , about 30 seconds
4. Add potatoes and stir-fry for about 3 minutes , pressing them against the pan to brown them
5. Add scallions and salt and stir-fry another 2 minutes
6. I prefer to remove the chiles before serving
7. Serve hot , cold or at room temperature

title: tebasaki  japanese style deep fried chicken wings
steps:
1. Make a cut along the bone of each chicken wing
2. Lightly coat the chicken wings with the flour
3. Shallow fry the chicken wings in 1cm of vegetable oil over a low heat for 8 minutes or until they are light brown
4. Remove the wings and turn up the heat on the pan
5. Add the wings and fry for a further 2 minutes until crisply
6. Remove and place on a paper towel
7. Mix the sake , mirin , soy sauce , sugar , and garlic powder and heat , either in a bowl in the microwave or on the stove in a pot
8. Coat the wings with the sauce
9. Season with salt and pepper , and coat with the white sesame seeds

title: yemeni chai  chai adani
steps:
1. Add all the spices , milk and water to medium saucepan , cover with a lid
2. Place on stove on medium heat
3. When milk mixture is almost at a boil add sugar and tea
4. Allow chai to come to a boil
5. For a minute
6. Strain into a mug and enjoy
7. I normally don't strain it , just fish out the spices and pour into my mug

title: cranberry nut energy bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Toast oatmeal on large baking sheet 13 x 9 pan or 15 x 10 jellyroll pan for 10 minutes
3. Add raisins and rice krispies and toast another 5 minutes
4. Add peanuts and dried fruit and set aside
5. In a large pan , melt butter , peanut butter and marshmallows over low heat
6. When smooth and combined , add oatmeal mixture
7. Stir to coat
8. Press firmly into 9x13 pan
9. Cool and cut into 20 bars
10. You can also reduce or eliminate butter if you want to lower the fat

title: ham and noodle skillet
steps:
1. Cook noodles according to package directions
2. Drain
3. In large skillet , melt butter and saute onion until soft
4. To skillet , add light cream , cheddar cheese , cream cheese , peas , ham and parsley
5. Reduce heat to low
6. Cook , stirring frequently , until cheese melts and mixture is hot and thickened
7. Toss with hot cooked noodles
8. Season to taste with salt and pepper

title: prawn   chicken orzo paella
steps:
1. Cut chicken into 2cm-3cm dice
2. Heat sesame oil in deep frying pan over medium heat
3. Gently fry shallots and , ginger and garlic for a few minutes until softened and lightly coloured
4. Add cubed chicken to pan , season lightly with salt and pepper and fry until browned on all sides but not cooked through
5. Add orzo and stir to coat with oil and let it start to absorb flavours
6. Season with paprika and cover ingredients with stock
7. Allow to simmer for about 15 minutes , adding more stock when necessary and stirring occasionally
8. When orzo is just cooked , add the prawns , lemon juice and soy , stir and taste for seasoning , adjust if necessary
9. Rest for 3 to 5 minutes in pan with lid on to allow chicken to tenderise
10. Stir through the chopped coriander and serve scattered with extra leaves

title: yolie s unique tuna salad
steps:
1. Combine all the ingredients , and serve on
2. Bread or alone

title: easy and healthy dark chocolate mousse
steps:
1. In a blender , process tofu until smooth
2. Combine chocolate , cocoa , water and brandy in a small saucepan over medium heat
3. Stir until melted
4. Remove from heat
5. Mix in sugar , a little at a time , until smooth
6. Add chocolate mixture to tofu
7. Process until smooth
8. Spoon mousse into champagne glasses
9. Cover and refrigerate for at least one hour
10. Top with whipped cream and shaved chocolate , if desired , and serve !

title: white frosting
steps:
1. Put sugar , water , and unbeaten egg whites in double boiler over hot water
2. Beat constantly for 4 minutes
3. Add flavoring and continue cooking until frosting is of consistency to spread
4. Remove from hot water and continue beating until cool

title: picnic chicken potato salad
steps:
1. Mix mayo , vinegar , relish , mustard , sugar , salt , pepper and red onion together in a bowl
2. Let stand while your potatoes and eggs are cooking
3. While potatoes and eggs are still warm , mix all potatoes , eggs , chicken , bell pepper and vegetables together with mayo mixture
4. Mix gently , you don't want mashed potatoes , but just be gentle enough so that the ingredients are well incorporated together
5. Adjust salt , pepper and sugar according to taste
6. Can be served warm or cold , best when refrigerated overnight
7. Lightly sprinkle paprika and parsley over before serving

title: grilled stuffed mozzarella tomatoes
steps:
1. Halve tomatoes and scoop out insides leaving 1 / 2-inch thick shell
2. Chop pulp and set aside
3. Combine breadcrumbs , butter , basil , salt and pepper
4. Stir in cheese and tomato pulp
5. Fill tomato halves with cheesy breadcrumb
6. Spray cooking spray lightly on the bottom of aluminum pan
7. Place tomato halves in disposable pan and wrap top loosely with foil
8. If grilling , set over grill for at least 10 minutes
9. If oven baking , bake at 350 for 15 minutes and broil until cheese is browned and bubbly
10. Uncover and serve on pan with large sprigs of parsley or curly parsley

title: chamorro latiya dessert
steps:
1. Prepare the cake portion by slicing the cake into 1 / 4-inch thick by about 3-inch long slices
2. This is just approximate -- layer the slices onto a platter , overlapping each piece just a bit
3. Make sure that the platter has a little lip to contain the custard and keeping it from spilling over
4. Completely cover the platter with the sliced cake
5. Cover and set aside
6. Make the custard by combining in a sauce pan , 1 1 / 3 cups water , bring this almost to a boil
7. Add the evaporated milk and the sugar
8. Mix the remaining water with the cornstarch and vanilla
9. Gradually add this to the milk mixture , making sure to stir constantly so not to scorch the custard
10. Once thickened , remove from heat and add the butter
11. Whisk in the beaten eggs a little bit at a time , making sure to stir constantly and combine well
12. Pour the hot custard over the prepared cake and spread over to completely cover the cake slices
13. Sprinkle the cinnamon over the entire custard and let set
14. The amount depends on how much you like cinnamon
15. You could place this in the refrigerator or keep at room temperature , and once cooled completely , it's ready to serve
16. I hope you enjoy this dessert as much as the islanders do --
17. Variation: this dessert can also be prepared using pound cake or the recipe for brojas cake , that i also have posted

title: west african peanut stew
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a medium saucepan
2. Add the onions , garlic and ginger
3. Cook until the onion is translucent
4. Add the chili pepper , heat for several more minutes
5. Add the chicken , turmeric , berbere , and cloves
6. Cook over medium heat until the chicken is done
7. Add the tomatoes , grated carrot and any other vegetables you want to use
8. Cook for 5 more minutes , stirring occasionally
9. Add the water or broth to the saucepan and bring to a boil
10. Add the peanut butter and reduce heat to medium-low
11. Stir well for 5-10 minutes , or until the peanut butter dissolves
12. Add the sugar and lemon / lime juice
13. Taste , and adjust any ingredients to taste
14. Simmer for 5-10 minutes longer
15. Serve hot with toasted bread

title: shrimp and asparagus saute for two
steps:
1. Over high heat , bring a large saucepan of salted water to a boil
2. Add asparagus and cook for 5 minutes or until crisp-tender
3. While asparagus cooks , heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
4. Add shrimp and cook for 2 minutes , turning once
5. Drain asparagus and add to shrimp
6. Combine remaining ingredients in a bowl
7. Add to shrimp
8. Cook and stir for 3 minutes or until the sauce thickens and turns glossy
9. Remove cinnamon stick and serve

title: pizza tomatoes
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine flour , basil , oregano , salt and pepper
2. Dip tomatoes in flour mixture
3. In a frypan , fry tomatoes in oil , a few at a time , until golden on both sides
4. Sprinkle with chopped green pepper if desired
5. Top with cheese , broil in oven for a few minutes
6. Until cheese is melted

title: country fried steak and milk gravy
steps:
1. Season meat with 1 / 4 teaspoon of the salt and 1 / 4 teaspoon of the pepper
2. Set aside
3. In a shallow dish , mix flour with 1 teaspoon of the pepper
4. Dredge each steak in flour
5. Dip in beaten egg , then dredge in flour again
6. Heat lard in a large , heavy skillet over medium-high heat
7. Fry steaks 3 to 4 minutes on each side , or until golden brown
8. Drain on paper towels
9. Pour off all but 2 tablespoons of the fat
10. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons of the dredging flour into oil
11. Cook over medium heat for 1 minute , scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of skillet
12. Gradually whisk in milk
13. Cook , stirring frequently , 3 to 4 minutes , or until thickened and bubbly
14. Add 1 / 4 teaspoon salt , and 1 / 4 to 1 / 2 teaspoons pepper
15. Gravy should be quite peppery

title: best sausage balls ever
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Using your hands , mix all ingredients until thoroughly combined , and roll into half dollar size balls
3. Place sausage balls on a nonstick cookie sheet and bake for 15-18 minute
4. Do not over bake
5. These balls can be frozen for 30 days and still taste great !

title: cocoa banana muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Butter or put paper cups in muffin pan
3. Mash bananas
4. Whisk in eggs , buttermilk , vegetable oil and vanilla
5. Mix the dry ingredients
6. Be sure to sift the cocoa
7. Mix wet and dry ingredients until just blended
8. Spoon the batter into the muffin cups
9. Bake for 20-25 minutes , until done
10. If you like , lay a slice of banana over each muffin before baking

title: nancy s prayer bars
steps:
1. For the first layer:
2. Melt butter and cocoa together over hot water or in a saucepan over very low heat
3. Add powdered sugar , egg and vanilla
4. Continue to cook for a minute or two longer over low heat
5. Set aside
6. Mix nuts , crumbs and coconut if desired and add to first mixture
7. Mix well and press into a 13x9 pan
8. Chill for about 30 minutes
9. For the second layer:
10. Melt butter , cream and vanilla
11. Add pudding mix and cook for one minute , stirring constantly
12. Remove from heat and add powdered sugar
13. Blend and spread over first layer
14. For the third layer:
15. Melt hershey's chocolate bar and spread carefully over the top
16. Chill for 30 minutes
17. Bring to room temperature before cutting into 2 inch squaresthis helps to prevent crumbling
18. Store in refrigerator until ready to serve
19. Makes approx 60 bars
20. Cook time is actually chilling time

title: yummy honey biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Mix flour , baking soda , and cinnamon
3. Mix in butter , honey , and eggs
4. On an ungreased cookie sheet , spoon dough on cookie sheet
5. Bake for 10 minutes
6. Enjoy !

title: onion herb bread  bread machine
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in machine in manufacturer's recommended order
2. Set on medium crust or white bread setting
3. When done , remove from pan and cool on wire rack 30 minutes
4. Slice and serve with butter

title: dreamsicle creamsicle cake
steps:
1. Cake: blend all ingredients& pour in 2 9" greased& floured pans
2. Bake at 350 for 20-25 minutes
3. When cool slice each layer to make 4 layers
4. Frosting: combine sour cream& coconut , if used[i don't]
5. In separate bowl mix sugar& orange juice til disolved
6. Combine with sour cream
7. Fold in cool whip
8. Spread between each layer& remaining on top
9. Refrigerate

title: brandy apricot stuffing
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Lightly oil a 2 quart casserole
3. In a small saucepan
4. Heat brandy and the apricots to boiling , stir well
5. Remove from heat and set pan aside
6. Heat vegetable oil over medium high heat in a large saute pan , add the celery , onion and garlic , saute until lightly brown , about 2 minutes add the brandy and apricots to the saute pan , cook until half the liquid reduces
7. Remove from heat and cool in a large mixing bowl , combine the brandy / apricot sauce , stuffing cubes , vegetable or chicken broth , almonds , cranberries , thyme and pepper- taste to adjust seasonings , add whisked egg
8. Toss gently to mix spoon into oiled casserole dish , cover with lid
9. Bake for 45 minutes or until throughly heated
10. Serve

title: rich praline cream cheese bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix butter , 1 / 2 cup of sugar and 1 / 2 teaspoon vanilla extract with electric mixer on medium speed
3. Mix until light and fluffy
4. Gradually add the flour
5. Mix on low speed until blended
6. Press on bottom of 13x9-inch pan for 20-23 minutes or until lightly browned
7. Combine cream cheese , remaining sugar and vanilla extract with electric mixer on medium speed
8. Mix until well blended
9. Add eggs , combining well
10. Blend in the chips and pour over crust
11. Dot top of mixture with caramel topping and then with a knife , cut through batter for marbled effect
12. Bake 30 minutes , then cool in pan
13. Chill before cutting into bars

title: rosemary roasted potato salad
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. In a large mixing bowl combine potatoes , onion wedges , 2 tablespoons of the olive oil , rosemary , garlic , salt , and black pepper
3. Toss potato mixture to coat well
4. Arrange in a single layer in a greased shallow roasting pan
5. Roast , uncovered , for 25 to 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender and lightly browned , stirring mixture twice
6. Transfer roasted potato mixture to a large bowl
7. Set aside
8. In a small bowl whisk together balsamic vinegar and remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil
9. Pour mixture over roasted potato mixture
10. Add red pepper pieces
11. Toss gently to coat
12. Turn potato salad into serving bowl
13. Sprinkle with pine nuts
14. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: pretty red velvet cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven 350 degrees f
2. Sift together flour , baking soda , salt , and cocoa powder into a bowl and set aside
3. In a mixer fitted with paddle attachment , mix oil , sugar , and buttermilk until combined
4. Add eggs , food coloring , vinegar , vanilla and water and mix well
5. Add the dry ingredients a little bit at a time and mix on low , scraping down sides occasionally , and mix until just combined
6. Be sure not to over mix , or the batter will come out
7. Tough
8. Line a 16-cup cupcake pan with paper liners , scoop the batter into the liners and bake at 350 degrees f for 20 to 30 minutes or until the toothpick comes out clean
9. Let cool
10. Decorate with desired frosting when cool

title: sweet ho yin  bread for bread machine
steps:
1. Combine in your machine according to your manufacturer's directions
2. Success hints: add orange extract with water , away from yeast
3. This is a great"beginner bread" for kids to make
4. It's deceptively simple and everyone loves it !
5. Top this bread with the sweet guava-raisin spread for a real dessert treat !
6. This recipe can be made using the regular , rapid and delayed time bake cycles

title: chili beef soup
steps:
1. In a soup pot , brown ground beef and onion over medium heat 5 to 7 minutes
2. Add remaining ingredients
3. Mix thoroughly
4. Reduce heat to low and simmer , uncovered , for 30 minutes , or until thoroughly heated

title: super bowl burgers
steps:
1. Preheat grill for high heat
2. In a medium bowl , mix together potato , cheese , and mushrooms
3. In a large bowl , mix hamburger with onion soup mix
4. Form into patties
5. Make a pocket in each hamburger , stuff with potato mix , and seal
6. When ready to grill , brush grate with oil
7. Cook over high heat for 3 to 5 minutes on each side
8. Serve hot

title: low calorie strawberry  pretzel  salad
steps:
1. Combine crust ingredients and pat in the bottom of a 9x13" pan
2. Add a little more water if necessary
3. Bake 8 minutes in preheated 375 oven
4. Let cool completely
5. Combine splenda and cream cheese in medium bowl for 3 minutes over low speed
6. Mixture will be thick
7. Gradually add cool whip , do not over beat
8. Pour over cooled pretzel crust
9. Cover and chill 1 hour
10. Combine jello and hot water in medium bowl
11. Gradually add berries , stirring a few minutes until mixture has slightly cooled
12. Carefully pour over cream cheese mixture
13. Cover and chill at least 2 hours

title: ww 0 points   calm down juice
steps:
1. Trim carrots
2. Cut apple into wedges
3. Process all the ingredients
4. 0 points per serving

title: zucchini tomato frittata
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. In a medium bowl , whisk together the eggs , parmesan cheese , salt , pepper and chives
3. Set aside
4. In a 10-inch ovenproof non-stick skillet , heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat
5. Cook half the zucchini slices until tender , about 3 minutes , then move them to a small bowl
6. Repeat with the rest of the zucchini and reserve
7. Add the remaining tablespoon of oil to the skillet and cook the onions , tomato and garlic for 5 minutes , or until the onions are tender
8. Return the zucchini to the skillet , evenly distributing it
9. Add the egg mixture , and cook for 3 minutes , or until the bottom of the frittata is just set
10. Place the frittata in the oven and bake for 12 to 15 minutes , or until it is completely set and golden brown
11. Invert it onto a plate , cut into slices and serve

title: onion squares
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Spray a non-stick 9 x 9 inch pan with non-stick cooking spray and set aside
3. Saute the onion slices in a nonstick skillet until soft and slightly browned
4. Add yogurt , dill weed and salt
5. Mixing well
6. In a medium size bowl , combine the flour , cornmeal , sugar , baking powder , oil , fat free milk and egg
7. Mix well
8. Add corn and a few dashes of tabasco sauce
9. Pour the batter into prepared pan , spread with onion mixture and sprinkle with grated cheese
10. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly brown
11. Cut into 9 squares and serve

title: baked tofu with mushroom gravy
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Dry the tofu and cut it into 4 thick slices
3. Coat the tofu thinly with oil and sprinkle with salt , pepper , and thyme to taste
4. Lay the tofu slices on a baking sheet sprayed with nonstick spray and place in oven
5. Bake for 35 minutes , flipping pieces after 20 minutes
6. While the tofu cooks , melt the butter in a medium skillet on medium-low heat
7. Saute the onions and mushrooms in the melted butter until softened , about 10 minutes
8. Do not brown the vegetables
9. About 5 minutes before the tofu finishes , add the flour to the mushrooms and onions and continue to cook on medium-low for another minute or two
10. Add the milk and yogurt to the sauteed mixture and bring to a simmer
11. You may need to raise the heat to medium
12. Once the gravy simmers , remove from the heat and season to taste with salt , pepper , and thyme
13. Spoon over baked tofu
14. Serve with a hot veggie like green beans or broccoli and with cubed potatoes roasted in the oven while the tofu baked

title: yummy chunky potato soup
steps:
1. Peel potatoes and cut into 1 inch cubes
2. Boil in water until done , about 15 minutes
3. Drain & set aside , but save 1 cup of the cooking liquid for later
4. Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat
5. Add onion , celery , and mushrooms , stirring frequently until onion is soft and translucent
6. Add flour , bacon , red and black pepper to saucepan
7. Mix well , cook 3- 4 minutes
8. Slowly add potatoes , reserved cup of liquid , milk , and sugar
9. Stir well
10. Add cheese and ham
11. Simmer over low heat 30 minutes , stirring frequently

title: buffalo sweet potato   blue cheese pizza
steps:
1. Mix the flour and salt in a big bowl , mixing well
2. Sprinkle the top of the flour with the yeast , then add the wet ingredients and mix together into a big clump
3. Flour a surface , and dump contents of bowl onto it
4. Knead everything together until all the ingredients are mixed well
5. Super lazy mel
6. You may hurt your knuckles a bit , but the clean up is much easier
7. Pick the dough up , then lightly oil the bowl and place the dough ball inside , coating all sides with oil
8. Cover the ball tightly with plastic wrap and let the dough rise for at least 2 hours
9. I let it sit out on the counter all day while im at work and that seems to be fine as well
10. Knead the dough for a bit to remove the air bubbles
11. Cover with plastic wrap and let stand for 30 more minutes
12. If you have a pizza stone , preheat it under your ovens broiler
13. If you dont , preheat the cookie sheet youll use
14. While your pizza stone heats , grate the potato with a box grater , or simply mash it up with a fork
15. Roll out your dough as thinly as possible
16. Sprinkle the cornmeal on the heated stone or cookie sheet , then top it with the dough
17. Brush on half of the buffalo sauce , then cover the pizza with the sweet potato as evenly as possible
18. Brush on the remaining buffalo sauce and sprinkle evenly with mozzarella
19. Pop that into the oven for 6 8 minutes under the pre-heated broiler
20. Watch it closely
21. Its done when the dough is crisp and the cheese is browned
22. Remove from oven and immediately sprinkle with the blue cheese as evenly as possible
23. Slice and serve immediately

title: chai spiced cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. In large bowl , beat butter and 1 / 2 cup powdered sugar with electric mixer on low speed until well blended
3. Stir in remaining cookie ingredients
4. Shape dough by tablespoonfuls into balls
5. On an ungreased cookie sheets , place balls 1 1 / 2 inches apart
6. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until very lightly browned
7. Remove from cookie sheets to cooling rack and cool for 5 minutes
8. In medium bowl , mix coating ingredients
9. Working in batches , gently roll warm cookies in coating mixture
10. Cool on cooling rack 5 minutes
11. Fluff up coating mixture with wire whip and roll cookies in mixture again

title: tuna noodle salad my way
steps:
1. Boil water in a 5 quart pan and cook egg noodles to al dente
2. Drain and let cool
3. Drain tuna and combine with onion , celery mayonnaise , dill pickle relish add chopped boiled eggs
4. Mix well
5. Add season salt and ground pepper and mix well
6. Taste
7. Add more seasoning or mayonnaise to your liking
8. Best if chilled for at least 1 hour
9. Serve cold

title: rosanne s chicken spaetzle soup
steps:
1. In a large kettle , combine 1 cup water , water off of chicken , onion , celery and carrots
2. Bring to a soft boil and cook until carrots are tender
3. Add chicken , salt , pepper and broth
4. Simmer on low
5. Start making spaetzle
6. In a separate saucepan combine 4 cups water
7. Bring to a boil
8. In a mixing bowl combine eggs , flour , 1 / 2 cup water salt and baking powder
9. Beat well
10. Drop small teaspoons of batter into boiling water , cook until spaetzle floats on top of water
11. Scoop spaetzle out with a slotted spoon and add to soup
12. Simmer soup on low for 30 minutes to flavor through
13. Enjoy !

title: easy mexican layered dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Brown ground beef , add taco seasoning package and prepare according to directions spread refried beans in oven safe pan
3. Spread with ground beef mixture
4. Layer velveeta , salsa and marbled cheese in that order
5. Top with sliced olives and jalepenos
6. Cover with foil and bake in oven for 10-15 minutes
7. Remove from oven and top with sour cream , if desired
8. Can be served with corn / tortilla chips as a dip or as a filling for soft tortillas

title: italian marinated zucchini
steps:
1. Wash , slice , pat-dry and fry the zucchini in oil
2. When golden brown remove from oil and rid of excess fat on paper towel
3. Wash mint leaves
4. Need about 6
5. Chop them up
6. Arrange zucchini in a serving platter and flavor with vinegar mixed with chopped mint , and garlic cloves
7. Place in refrigerator once cooled off to chill
8. Salt and pepper to taste

title: green tomato casserole
steps:
1. Arrange one layer of tomatoes in the bottom of 1 quart casserole
2. Sprinkle with sugar , salt and pepper 1 / 3 of bread crumbs and 1 / 3 cheese
3. Repeat layers twice omitting the cheese from the top
4. Dot butter over the bread crumbs on top
5. Cover and bake at 400 degrees for one hour
6. Add remaining cheese , bake uncovered until cheese melts

title: healthy crepes
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients in large bowl
2. Stir in wet ingredients and mix until smooth
3. Preheat pan on med
4. Heat on stove
5. For each crepe , lightly spray pan and pour 1 / 4 cup of batter into pan
6. Rotate pan so that crepe is thin and even and flip once crepe is golden brown , depending on your preference
7. When other side is also golden brown , your crepe is done

title: double strawberry banana shake
steps: 1. Process all ingredients in a blender until smooth , stopping to scrape down sides

title: parmesan chicken cutlets
steps:
1. Combine ingredients for breadcrumb mix and set aside
2. Cut chicken into 1-inch thick slices
3. Place slices between 2 sheets of heavy-duty plastic wrap , and flatten to 1 / 4-inch thickness with a meat mallet or rolling pin
4. Coat both sides of the chicken with cooking spray and dredge in breadcrumb mixture
5. In 2 tablespoons of hot olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat , cook half of the chicken slices , about 1 minute on each side , or until golden brown
6. Repeat with remaining pieces
7. Serve with lemon wedges

title: italian spaghetti meat sauce
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a heavy sauce pan
2. Saut garlic and onion , until onion is transparent
3. Then add bay leaf , ground meat , cook until meat is no longer pink
4. Stir in diced tomatoes , water and tomato paste , tomato sauce
5. Add all the spices and then lemon juice
6. Bring to a boil then reduce to simmer , uncovered for 1 to 2 hours or til sauce is desired consistency , stirring occasionally
7. Remove bay leaf and then add brown sugar to taste

title: spicy asian green beans
steps:
1. Boil some water
2. Srop green beans in for 2 minutes
3. Srain and blanch
4. Heat oil and pepper flakes in a pan until oil starts to smoke
5. Add beans and stir fry for 2 minute
6. Turn off heat , toss in sesame seeds , season with salt , and serve

title: caribbean sweet potato   bean stew
steps:
1. If cooking in the slow cooker- combine all ingredients , except for almonds , in the slow cooker
2. Cover
3. Cook on low for 5 to 6 hours or high 2-3 hours until vegetables are tender
4. Then adjust seasonings and serve with almonds and hot pepper sauce if desired
5. To toast almonds spread in a single layer on a baking sheet and toast at 350 degrees for 8-10 minutes
6. To cook on the stove , if you add any meats , cook those first , then add all ingredients to a large pot , bring up to a boil , then reduce heat and cover , simmer for 1-2 hours or until vegetables are tender
7. Use same directions for seasonings and hot sauce , but you can also toast your almonds in the microwave for 20-30 seconds in a bowl

title: crock pot pinto beans
steps:
1. Rinse dried pintos under cool water and drain
2. Put them into a large bowl and cover with hot water and let sit over night
3. This helps cut down on cooking time and take some of the "gas" out
4. They will swell quite a bit so you need a large bowl
5. In the morning , rinse beans well with cool water , drain and then put in crock pot
6. Add chicken broth and all other ingredients
7. Fill with water till water is about an inch or 2 above beans
8. Cook on low all day for about 8-9 hours
9. Cook up some cornbread and you are ready to eat !

title: fake it   easiest ever banana nut bread
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients well
2. Pour into 2 large or 4 small greased loaf pans
3. Bake at 350 f for 40 to 45 minutes

title: grilled corn  avocado and tomato salad
steps:
1. Combine the corn , avocado , tomatoes and onion in a large glass bowl
2. Mix together the dressing ingredients in another bowl , pour over the salad , and gently toss to mix

title: grilled lemon chicken and moroccan couscous salad
steps:
1. For couscous:
2. Bring chicken broth , 1 tablespoon oil , ginger , garlic , 1 teaspoon salt , turmeric , cinnamon , and cumin to boil in heavy large saucepan
3. Stir in couscous and remove from heat
4. Scatter raisins over , cover , and let stand until couscous softens , about 10 minutes
5. Fluff couscous with fork , breaking up any lumps with finger
6. Transfer couscous to large bowl
7. Add cucumber , red bell pepper , carrot , green beans , and lemon peel
8. Whisk remaining 1 tablespoon oil , 1 teaspoon salt , and lemon juice in small bowl
9. Add to couscous
10. Toss to coat
11. Season to taste with salt and pepper
12. Do ahead: can be made 1 day ahead
13. Cover and chill
14. Bring to room temperature before serving
15. For chicken:
16. Place 2 1 / 2 tablespoons oil , lemon juice , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , and 1 / 2 teaspoon pepper in large resealable plastic bag
17. Add chicken and seal bag , releasing any excess air
18. Turn several times to coat
19. Let stand at room temperature 30 minutes
20. Alternatively , chill 1 to 3 hours and bring to room temperature before continuing
21. Prepare barbecue
22. Brush grill rack with oil
23. Transfer chicken from bag to barbecue with some marinade still clinging and grill until slightly charred and just cooked through , about 4 minutes per side
24. Transfer chicken to platter and let rest 10 minutes
25. Stir 3 / 4 cup chopped cilantro into couscous
26. Sprinkle almonds over , if desired
27. Drizzle chicken with oil , sprinkle remaining 1 / 3 cup chopped cilantro over , and garnish with lemon wedges
28. Serve with couscous

title: how to peel a head of garlic in less than 10 seconds
steps:
1. Smash the head of garlic with the heel of your hand
2. Sweep the cloves into one bowl
3. Invert the second bowl over the top of the first bowl
4. Hold the bowls together where the rims meet and shake the dickens out of them

title: swedish brown beans
steps:
1. Pick over and rinse the beans
2. Add the water and soak the beans at least 12 hours
3. Bring the beans and soaking water to a boil
4. Cover the pan and simmer for 1 1 / 2 hours
5. Add the salt , vinegar , syrup , brown sugar , butter and cinnamon stick
6. Stir to mix
7. Simmer , uncovered , for 1 hour , or until the beans are tender
8. The liquid should be as thick as a sauce at the end of the cooking period
9. If the liquid is not thickened , turn up the heat for 10 minutes , or until the liquid is reduced
10. Remove the cinnamon stick
11. Serve hot

title: weight watcher s general tsao s chicken
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , whisk together broth , cornstarch , sugar , soy sauce , vinegar and ginger
2. Set aside
3. Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat
4. Add scallions , garlic and pepper and cook 2 minutes
5. Add chicken and cook until browned all over , about 5 minutes
6. Add reserved sauce and simmer until sauce thickens and chicken is cooked through , about 3 minutes
7. Serve chicken and sauce over rice
8. Yields about 1 cup of chicken and sauce and 1 / 2 cup of rice per serving

title: blackberry balsamic chicken
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium-high heat until hot
2. Add onion and saute till translucent
3. Sprinkle salt , pepper , and thyme over the top of the chicken
4. Add chicken to skillet and saute 6 minutes on each side or until done
5. Remove chicken from skillet and keep warm
6. Reduce heat to medium low
7. Add preserves , vinegar , and salt and pepper , stirring constantly until the preserves melt
8. Spoon the sauce over chicken to serve

title: tuna fiesta
steps:
1. Wash the rice and boil
2. Peel and slice the onion and fry it gently in the butter or oil in a saucepan , until soft
3. Wash and slice the mushrooms and pepper
4. Add them to the onion and fry gently , until soft
5. Add the peas , tomato soup , salt , pepper and garlic gently stir in the drained tuna and cook for a few minutes , until hot
6. Drain and fork the rice
7. Spoon the rice onto a plate , press into a ring and pour the tuna sauce into the middle

title: sauteed leeks
steps:
1. Thinly slice leeks
2. Use white and light green parts of leeks
3. Separate rings and place in colander
4. Rinse well and drain well
5. Try to get leeks as dry as possible
6. Heat olive oil and butter on med-high in frying pan large enough for all the leeks
7. Remember that they will wilt down !
8. Add leeks to frying pan
9. Stir until all the leeks are coated with oil and butter
10. At this time , add tarragon , coriander and salt and pepper
11. Reduce heat to medium
12. Stirring frequently , cook until leeks are close to caramelized , approximately 25 minutes
13. Serve and enjoy

title: cuban meat stew  ropa vieja
steps:
1. Season steak with adobo
2. In large skillet , heat oil on medium high , brown meat on both sides , remove and keep warm
3. Lower heat to medium , add garlic , onion and green pepper , cook-stirring often for about 10 minutes
4. Stir in black pepper and tomato sauce and cook , stirring often for about 5 minutes
5. Stir in the sofrito , water , sazon and bouillon and bring to a boil
6. Return the meat to the pan , cover , lower the heat , and simmer for 45 minutes , stirring it occasionally
7. Add in the capers and olives , continue to simmer covered , until the meat is tender and shreds easily
8. This should take about 1-1 / 2 hours
9. You can add more water 1 / 4 cup at a time if the sauce gets too dry
10. To serve , shred the meat with 2 forks and mix back into sauce

title: 6 vegetable mediterranean stew
steps:
1. Heat a bit of olive oil in a large saucepan and saut the onion , mushrooms and chilli pepper for a couple minutes
2. Add the eggplant and continue cooking over a medium-low heat for about five minutes , until the eggplant starts to soften
3. Add in the cumin , balsamic vinegar , bacon and red pepper
4. Cook until the bacon starts to colour , then add in the chopped tomatoes , sundried tomatoes , red wine and stock
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Bring to a boil , then turn the heat down , three-quarters cover the pot and simmer for about 20 minutes or until you are happy with the thickness of the sauce
7. Check the seasoning and serve with a dollop of yogurt or over some cooked basmati rice

title: steamed lemony shrimp dumplings
steps:
1. Make the dough : combine all ingredients , adding boiling water as needed until you get a sticky but workable dough
2. Roll out into a thin sheet , cutting into 3 inch rounds
3. Make the sauce: in a small bowl , combine the soy sauce with the water , lemon juice , fish sauce and scallion
4. Make the dumplings: very coarsely chop two-thirds of the shrimp and transfer to a food processor
5. Add 1 1 / 2 tablespoons of the cornstarch , the soy sauce , lemon juice , egg , lemon zest , salt and pepper and process until very finely chopped
6. Scrape into a large bowl
7. Cut the remaining shrimp into 1 / 3-inch pieces and add to the bowl
8. Mix in the jicama and scallions
9. Dust a baking sheet with cornstarch
10. Lay 4 gyoza wrappers on a work surface
11. Keep the rest covered with plastic wrap
12. Moisten the edges of the wrappers with water
13. Place a level tablespoon of filling on one side of each wrapper and fold in half to form half-moons
14. Press all around the filling to release any air pockets and to seal
15. Lift each dumpling by the sealed edge , transfer it to the baking sheet and press down lightly to flatten the bottom
16. The dumpling should be standing with the sealed side up on the baking sheet
17. Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling
18. Fill a wok or a very large skillet with 2 inches of water and bring to a boil
19. Line a double-tiered bamboo steamer with lettuce leaves and arrange half of the dumplings in the steamer without crowding
20. Cover and steam over moderate heat until firm and cooked through , about 12 minutes
21. Steam the remaining dumplings
22. Serve the dumplings right away , passing the dipping sauce at the table

title: apple butter    grandma style
steps:
1. In an 8 or 10 quart pot combine apples and cider or juice
2. Bring to boiling
3. Reduce heat
4. Cover simmer for 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Then puree in a food processor or blender
6. Return to pot
7. Stir in sugar , cinnamon , cloves , and allspice
8. Bring to boiling
9. Reduce heat
10. Cook uncovered , over very low heat 11 / 2 hours or till very thick , stirring often
11. Ladle into hot , sterilized half-pint jars , leaving a 1 / 4-inch headspace
12. Wipe jars rims
13. Place lids on jars and screw on the jar rings
14. Process in boiling-water canner 5 minutes
15. Remove jars and cool on racks
16. Makes 5-6 half-pints

title: busy day salad
steps:
1. Dissolve jello in boiling water
2. Add sherbert , stirring until melted
3. Add drained oranges
4. Pour into an 8x8 square pan
5. Sets up in 30 minutes !

title: corn and shrimp soup
steps:
1. Cook the first 6 ingredients on low to medium heat until soft and wilted
2. Add shrimp , cream of shrimp soup and 1 soup can of water
3. Cook about five minutes on low to medium heat , and add corn , salt and pepper
4. Cook on low to medium heat , stirring occasionally , for about 10 minutes
5. Stir in 1 pint half & half
6. Reheat
7. Try not to boil after adding half & half
8. Garnish with parsley and green onions

title: fluffernutter
steps:
1. Spread peanut butter onto one slice of bread , use as much as you want
2. Cover with marshmallow fluff , use as much as you want
3. Top with second slice of bread and enjoy !

title: baked garlic green beans
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine the oil , vinegar , onion , garlic , salt and pepper
2. Add the beans and toss to coat
3. Transfer to a greased 3-cup baking dish
4. Combine the bread crumbs , parmesan cheese and butter and sprinkle over beans
5. Bake , uncovered , at 350 for 10-15 minutes or until heated through

title: lighter macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil with about 2 teaspoons of salt
2. Add macaroni and cook until al dente , about 5 minutes
3. Drain and set aside
4. In same pot , add evaporated milk , salt , mustard , garlic , and 1 / 2 cup milk
5. Bring to a boil and then simmer about 2 minutes
6. Combine 1 / 4 cup milk and cornstarch
7. Add to saucepan
8. Simmer about 5 minutes or until thickened
9. Remove from heat , add cheese , and stir until cheese is melted
10. Add macaroni and let sit for about 5 minutes until thickened

title: spiced almonds for the tapas bar
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Grind salt and paprika in a mortar and pestle or a coffee grinder till fine
3. Place almonds on cookie sheet and toast for 5-10 minutes
4. Pour into a glass bowl and toss in 1 tablespoon oil to coat using more if needed
5. Add seasonings stirring to coat
6. Serve at room temperature

title: nashville eggnog
steps:
1. Stir booze with the egg yolks
2. Mix cream and sugar , then blend with booze
3. Beat egg whites until stiff , fold gently into the other mixture
4. Garnish with cloves and nutmeg
5. Serve in small mugs

title: low carb chicago syle hot dogs
steps:
1. Grill hot dogs in a cast iron pan over medium heat until brown on all sides with grill press
2. While dogs are cooking dice tomatoes , jalapenos , onion and pickle
3. Place toppings in bowl
4. Rinse romaine lettuce and pick out the best leaves
5. Trim bottom white off of leaves and place leaves on plate
6. Top leaves with one hot dog , tablespoon mustard and 2 tablespoons of topping mixture
7. Garnish with celery seed and cheese

title: pan roasted salmon steaks with sherry vinegar  honey glaze
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 400 degrees
2. In a small sauce pan over high heat , reduce the vinegar to 1 / 4 cup
3. In a mixing bowl , combine the vinegar syrup with the mustard , honey and ancho chile powder and season to taste with salt and pepper
4. Let mixture rest at room temp , about 30 minute
5. Heat the oil in a saute pan until almost smoking
6. Brush salmon on both sides with glaze and place in pan
7. Cook until lightly golden brown
8. Place pan in oven and continue cooking , about 5-6 minute for medium doneness
9. Remove from oven and brush again with glaze

title: velveeta nachos
steps:
1. Brown the meat then drain afterwards
2. Arrange the chips on a microwaveable platter
3. Top evenly with velveeta
4. Microwave on high for 2 minute or until velveeta is melted
5. Add the meat along with the other remaining ingredients

title: potatoes with leeks and rosemary
steps:
1. In a wok , heat olive oil and butter over medium-high heat until hot , swirling to coat sides of pan
2. Add potatoes and leek and cook , stirring and turning potato slices until hey turn translucent , 6 to 8 minutes
3. Add chicken broth , wine , rosemary , salt , and pepper
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat to medium-low , cover , and cook until potatoes are tender , 20 to 25 minutes
6. Uncover and cook , stirring occasionally , until most of liquid is absorbed , about 4 minutes

title: santa fe chicken chili
steps:
1. In a 5-6 quart pot , saute first 4 ingredients in oil over medium heat , until chicken is not pink and vegetables are tender
2. Add in chili powder , cumin , and cayenne
3. Stir and cook for 1 minute
4. Add in the tomatoes and chicken broth
5. Bring mixture to a boil
6. Lower heat and simmer , uncovered , for 15 minutes
7. Add in beans , salsa , corn , salt and pepper
8. Return mixture to a boil
9. Lower heat , cover , and simmer for 15 minutes

title: wonderful pickled asparagus
steps:
1. Place several slices of onion in the bottom of two 1-quart jars
2. Trim the asparagus to fit in the jars
3. Pack them in with the cut-end facing down
4. Place the pepper strips in between asparagus
5. Combine the remaining ingredients in a saucepan , and boil over moderate heat for 10 minutes
6. Pour into the jars , leaving 1 / 2-inch head space
7. Seal the jars according to the manufacturer's directions
8. Process for 20 minutes in boiling water bath

title: bennigans monte cristo sandwich
steps:
1. Place turkey and swiss cheese on one slice of bread and ham and american cheese on another slice of bread
2. Place third slice
3. In-between and secure the triple-decker sandwich in the corners with tooth picks
4. Place egg in mixing bowl , add water and beat together
5. Add salt , sugar , flour , and baking powder
6. Beat batter until smooth
7. Dip sandwich in batter and carefully cover all the sides and surface
8. Carefully place in hot oil and fry until golden
9. When sandwich has turned a warm gold color remove from hot oil and place on paper towel
10. Let cool for a few minutes before removing the tooth picks
11. Before serving slice into fourths and sprinkle
12. With powder sugar
13. Serve with raspberry jam

title: second time around    hot pork sandwich with gravy
steps:
1. Reheat leftover pork in microwave , stove-top or oven
2. Heat gravy slowly in small saucepan over low / med heat or in microwave at 50% power 3-4 minutes
3. Reheat leftover pork in microwave for 30 sec on high
4. Place one slice of bread on dinner plate , then sliced pork
5. Ladle a little gravy over pork , then top with second slice of bread
6. Spoon mashed potatoes on the side
7. Ladle rest of gravy over both , or just on top of the sandwich
8. Enjoy !
9. There is no recipe for the gravy

title: kelvain s pork loin marinade
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a bowl and thoroughly mix together
2. Place pork loin in ziplock bag and add marinade
3. Allow meat to marinade at least 1 hour before grilling
4. For best results , allow meat to marinade overnight
5. Yields enough marinade for a 2-3 pound pork loin

title: liptauer cheese
steps:
1. Cream the butter in a small bowl until light and fluffy
2. Add cream cheese and beat until smoothly blended
3. Chop the caraway seeds in a blender and then add to the butter mixture
4. Chop capers finely and add to mixture
5. Add mustard and paprika
6. Rinse , dry and chop the anchovy then stir into the cheese mixture and blend well
7. Shape into a neat rectangle on serving plate and border with pretzels

title: quick amish friendship bread or muffins  no starter required
steps:
1. Mix "starter" ingredients together
2. Mix oil , milk , eggs , and vanilla with the "starter"
3. In a separate bowl , mix flour , sugar , baking powder , cinnamon , salt , baking soda , vanilla pudding mix , and nuts
4. Add to liquid mixture and stir thoroughly
5. Pour into two large well-greased 9x5 inch loaf pans , one bundt pan , or 48 muffin tins
6. Bake at 325f for one hour or until done and enjoy !

title: mint chocolate peanut butter shake
steps:
1. Grind mint leaves and chocolate in a coffee grinder until finely powdered
2. Pour the mixture into a blender and add crushed ice + peanut butter
3. Give it a quick pulse
4. Pour in soy or hemp milk and blend

title: foolproof buttercream frosting
steps:
1. In mixer bowl at high speed , beat egg yolks until pale yellow , 4 to 5 minutes
2. Butter a 2-cup glass measuring cup
3. In a 2- to 3-quart pan , combine sugar and corn syrup
4. Cook over medium-high heat and stir until sugar is dissolved and mixture comes to a rolling boil
5. Immediately pour into the butter glass measuring cup
6. Beating constantly at medium speed , pour syrup in a thin , steady stream into egg yolks
7. Continue beating until mixture is at room temperature
8. Add butter and vanilla
9. Beat just until smooth

title: spicy country pancakes
steps:
1. Scald milk
2. Add sugar , salt , and oil
3. Cool to lukewarm
4. Dissolve yeast in water
5. Combine yeast mixture , eggs , and milk mixture
6. Sift flour and spices
7. Add to liquid mixture
8. Beat until smooth
9. Cover and let stand one hour or more in a warm place
10. Batter will be light and bubbly
11. Stir down batter
12. Bake on greased griddle

title: ultimate brisket   tyler florence
steps:
1. Heat oil in the bottom of a heavy dutch oven until it almost smokes
2. Season the brisket with salt and pepper
3. Carefully lay brisket in pot , fat side down
4. When browned , flip over
5. Cut garlic head in half across the cloves
6. Chop onion , celery and carrots into 2" pieces
7. Tie thyme , rosemary , parsley and bay leaf together with cotton twine to form a bouquet garni
8. When browned , remove meat to a plate
9. Put the onion , garlic , celery , carrot and bouquet garni into the pot and allow to caramelize and cook down , 10-15 minutes
10. Add tomatoes , beef broth and red wine to pot
11. Stir well , scraping up any browned bits at the bottom of the pot
12. Return meat to the pot
13. Cover tightly and bake in a preheated 325f oven for 3 hours
14. Remove brisket from pot to a platter
15. Let rest 10 minutes , then slice across the grain
16. Strain the juices from the pot , discarding the solids , and serve alongside the meat

title: kittencal s dill and sour cream potato salad with eggs
steps:
1. Wash and scrub the outside of the new potatoes
2. Place into pot and cover with cold water
3. Add in 2 tablespoons salt and bring to a boil over medium-high heat
4. Cook intil just fork tender
5. Remove to a bowl and cool to room temperature
6. Slice the cooled potatoes in half
7. Add in green onions and sliced eggs
8. Toss to combine
9. In a small or medium bowl bowl combine the sour cream with sugar , garlic powder , fresh dill and seasoned salt
10. Pour over the potatoes and toss to combine
11. Season with black pepper to taste if desired
12. Chill for a minimum of 3 or more hours before serving

title: stir fried potato with black vinegar
steps:
1. Bring a large saucepan of lightly salted water to the boil
2. Cut potatoes into 5mm thick slices , then finely julienne
3. Add the potato to the boiling water and cook for 1 minute , using a pair of long chopsticks to separate the pieces
4. Drain well and lay out to dry for a few hours on a clean tea towel
5. Heat a wok over high heat and add the oil , swirling to coat the wok
6. Add the potato and stir fry for 6 minutes , or until golden brown
7. Add the vinegar and soy sauce and 1 / 2 teaspoon of the sea salt
8. Stir fry for 2-3 minutes or until the potato slices have darkened and all liquid has evaporated
9. Sprinkle the remaining salt over the top and garnish with coriander and chilli flakes

title: how to boil a lobster
steps:
1. How to cook a lobster:
2. Place a steamer rack , pasta insert , or bed of seaweed in the bottom of a large pot
3. Add about 1 inch of water and bring to a boil
4. Add the lobsters and cook covered until done based on the size of the lobsters according to the above table
5. Serve with warm butter and lemon wedges
6. How to eat a lobster:
7. Twist off the claws from the body
8. Crack the claws with a cracker or pull apart small claw from large claw and pull meat out with hands or pick
9. Separate the tail from the body by twisting
10. Push tail meat up and out the other end with fingers
11. You will find a strip of meat on the outer part pull this off you can eat it
12. Underneath it is the lobsters digestive tract you dont want to eat this part
13. Pull the shell off the body of the lobster and underneath you will find the green tomalley you probably dont want to eat this part
14. Pull the small claws off the body and suck out the meat

title: tipsy mushrooms  with brandy
steps:
1. Slice the mushrooms into fours
2. Melt the butter in a skillet
3. Add to the pan and saut on high heat until soft for about 5 minutes
4. Remove from the heat and carefully add the brandy to avoid flame ups
5. Return to the heat and cook until pan juices have slightly thickened
6. Serve warm

title: nogales pie
steps:
1. Brown beef , garlic and onion and season with salt and pepper
2. Add tomato sauce , chilis and spices and simmer for 15 minutes
3. Put 2 tortillas , cut in wedges , in the bottom of a crockpot
4. Add 1 / 4 of the beef mixture and cheese
5. Add 2 more tortillas and top with 1 / 4 of the beans , cheese , corn , and olives
6. Repeat layering until all ingredients are in pot , ending with some cheese and olives on top
7. Cook on low for 5-7 hours

title: easy pound cake
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Mix on med
3. Speed for 20 minutes
4. Pour into greased & floured tube pan
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 80 minutes or until done

title: pasta with swiss chard
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions , except omit any oil or salt
2. Drain
3. Return pasta to saucepan
4. Cover and keep warm
5. Cut out and discard center ribs from swiss chard or remove stems from spinach
6. Coarsely chop greens
7. Set aside
8. In a large nonstick skillet cook garlic in hot oil over medium heat for 15 seconds
9. Add greens
10. Cook over medium-low heat about 3 minutes or until greens are wilted , stirring frequently
11. Stir in ricotta cheese , milk , basil , salt , pepper , and nutmeg
12. Cook and stir for 3 to 5 minutes more or until heated through
13. Add the ricotta mixture and tomato to cooked pasta
14. Toss gently to combine
15. Sprinkle each serving with parmesan cheese

title: ww 2 points   japanese grilled eggplant  aubergine
steps:
1. Preheat outdoor grill , stove-top grill pan or broiler
2. Coat eggplant with cooking spray
3. Grill or broil eggplant turning as needed until lightly charred and tender , about 7 to 9 minutes
4. Whisk soy sauce , lemon juice , vinegar , ginger and garlic in a small bowl until blended
5. Drizzle over grilled eggplant and sprinkle with scallions
6. 2 points per serving - yields about 3 / 4 cup per serving

title: mexican fiesta salad pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Unroll crescent dough
3. Separate into 16 triangles
4. Arrange 14 of the triangles in a circle on a lightly floured pizza pan with wide ends even with edge of pizza pan and points toward the center
5. Place the two remaining two triangles in the center , pinching seams to seal
6. Roll dough to create a smooth surface
7. Bake 15-18 minutes or until golden brown
8. Remove from oven
9. Cool completely
10. Combine the salsa , seasoning mix and garlic
11. Mix well
12. Add cooked turkey
13. Toss to coat
14. Microwave on high 2-3 minutes or until hot
15. Spread sour cream over crust
16. Spoon turkey mixture over sour cream
17. Top with lettuce , tomatoes , onions , cheese and olives
18. Serve immediately with additional salsa if desired

title: all purpose herbed butter
steps:
1. Whip room temperature butter with a fork in a bowl
2. Blend in parsley , chives or green onion , garlic if using , thyme , lemon juice , and white pepper to taste
3. On wax paper , shape mixture into a log
4. Wrap again in plastic wrap and chill until serving time
5. Or just use plastic wrap but wrap the log twice
6. Chill in refrigerator until serving time
7. Or bag , label with date , and freeze
8. To use , simply slice off as much as you need , then rewrap and store remainder in freezer until needed next time

title: smoky salmon spread   dip
steps:
1. Drain salmon
2. Beat cream cheese with lemon juice , milk and dill weed in mixer until light and fluffy
3. Beat in salmon and green onion until thoroughly combined
4. Season with liquid smoke to taste
5. Chill several hours before serving to allow flavors to blend
6. To serve , spread on crackers , bagels , or french bread rounds
7. Makes about 3 1 / 2 cups
8. Time does not include chill time

title: ultimate chicken cordon bleu   tyler florence
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Lay each breast between layers of plastic wrap
3. Carefully pound chicken out to 1 / 4" thickness
4. Remove top layer of plastic wrap
5. Place a slice of prosciutto on chicken , and top with gruyere
6. Roll chicken into a tight pinwheel using plastic to help
7. Twist both ends of plastic wrap in opposite directions to make a tight cylinder
8. Repeat until all 4 breasts are done
9. Refrigerate at least 30 minutes until chicken firms up
10. In a shallow dish , place flour
11. In a second dish , beat eggs
12. In a third dish , place panko
13. Add salt and pepper to each dish and stir well
14. Add thyme , garlic and melted butter to panko and stir well
15. Unwrap chicken rolls
16. Gently roll in flour , then tap off excess
17. Dip in egg on all sides , then roll in panko until well-coated
18. Place rolls in large casserole dish
19. Drizzle with olive oil
20. Bake at 350f for 20 minutes until golden brown
21. Let rest 3-5 minutes
22. Slice each roll into 4 slices before serving
23. Serve with roasted chicken jus

title: southwest blue corn sticks
steps:
1. Use 2 t of the cornmeal to coat greased cornstick pans , or 1 1 / 2-inch muffin pans
2. Set pans aside
3. Heat oil in a medium-size nonstick frying pan over medium heat
4. Add onion and chile
5. Cook , stirring often , until onion is lightly browned
6. Set aside
7. In a large bowl , stir together flour , sugar , baking powder and remaining 1 cup cornmeal until well blended
8. Set aside
9. In a medium-size bowl , combine milk and egg
10. Beat with a whisk until well blended
11. Add milk mixture , cheese and onion mixture to cornmeal mixture
12. Stir just until dry ingredients are evenly moistened
13. Spoon batter into pans , filling almost to rims
14. Bake in a 375 oven until cornsticks are lightly browned and feel firm when lightly pressed , about 25 minutes
15. Let cool in pans on a rack for about 10 minutes , then loosen carefully and remove from pans
16. Serve warm

title: grilled romano beans
steps:
1. Heat grill pan over medium heat for 4 or 5 minutes
2. In a shallow pan , lightly coat beans by rolling them in the olive oil
3. Place the romano beans on grill pan in a [single layer] and grill 4 minutes on each side
4. Transfer to a serving dish and garnish with the minced garlic , sprinkle with sea salt and cheese , if using
5. Servings are estimated

title: creamy mushroom sauce for pasta
steps:
1. Melt butter in a frying pan over medium heat
2. Add onions and mushrooms and cook while stirring until mushrooms are soft , about 4 minutes
3. Stir in stock , cream and black pepper to taste , bring to a gentle boil and simmer for 6 to 8 minutes or until sauce reduces and thickens slightly
4. Toss with your choice of pasta , sprinkle with parmesan cheese and serve

title: amarula day dream
steps:
1. Shake the amarula and milk with ice and strain into a highball glass
2. Add cola and stir gently

title: southern great northern beans   crock pot version
steps:
1. Start beans in morning
2. Wash beans and pick out any bad beans and toss away
3. Use a 4-6 quart crock pot
4. Pour washed beans into crock pot
5. Add water to about 1 inch over beans
6. Add butter , salt , hot pepper flakes and pork chop or ham bone
7. Cover and cook on high for 2 hours
8. Then turn cooker to low and cook the rest of the day stirring once in a while and adding water only if necessary
9. Do not add to much water at one time other wise your beans will turn out watery , you want a nice thick gravy with your beans
10. When done break up the pork chop or remove meat from ham bone toss bone
11. If using a whole red hot dried chili pepper remove it now and toss away
12. The beans will be tender in a thick gravy
13. If gravy is to thin move lid on crockpot so that one side is open to let steam escape , to thicken gravy
14. If gravy is to thick add 1 / 4 cup water at a time until it reaches the consistency you desire
15. Add salt and pepper to taste
16. Will take about 6-7 hours to cook
17. Serve with hot buttered cornbread and iced tea for a good southern rib sticking meal
18. I use this tea recipe #63785 southern sweet tea
19. And i use this cornbread recipe #116185 sweet cornbread
20. But if you want a more southern corn bread try my #195163 cracklin cornbread recipe

title: toni s teriyaki chicken
steps:
1. Wash and seperate chicken legs from thighs
2. De-bone chicken if desired
3. Combine remaining ingredients in pitcher
4. Place chicken in 2 gallon zipper-top bag
5. Pour marinade on top of chicken
6. Squeeze air out of bag and seal , place in refridgerator
7. Allow the chicken to marinade for at least tow hours , but up to two days
8. Turn bag over mul
9. Chicken can be frozen in marinade
10. Grill chicken as desired , discard marinade

title: andes chocolate mint cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Over low heat , combine butter , sugar and water
3. Heat until melted and add chocolate chips until partly melted
4. Remove from heat and stir
5. Pour into large mixing bowl
6. Let stand 10 minutes to cool slightly
7. Beat in eggs one at a time on high speed
8. Reduce mixer to low speed and add flour , salt and baking soda
9. Beat until well-blended
10. Chill one hour
11. Roll into balls , place two inches apart on parchment paper-lined baking sheets
12. Bake for 10 minutes
13. Place an andes mint half on top
14. Allow to melt slightly and spread with a spoon

title: oaxacan flan
steps:
1. In a saucepan , add the fist 4 ingredients
2. Heat on low for 10 minutes making sure that the mixture does not boil
3. In a mixing bowl place egg yolks , eggs and almond extract
4. Add mixture mixing slowly and let sit for 10 minutes
5. Now slowly add the gelatin while stirring
6. Caramel:
7. Cook sugar in saute pan at medium heat for 3 minutes or until lightly caramelized
8. Pour caramel in a 6" round ceramic dish and let sit for 2 minutes
9. Pour mixture prepared earlier in caramelized dish and place in refrigerator to cool
10. Before serving , you need to scrape the side of the ceramic with a spatula to loosen the caramel
11. Turn over into a serving plate

title: yummy fried chicken tenders
steps:
1. Mash garlic with flat side of knife
2. Place garlic in medium bowl
3. Add buttermilk , cumin , salt , pepper and cayenne and whisk to blend
4. Place chicken strips in 13 x 9-inch glass baking dish
5. Pour buttermilk mixture over
6. Turn chicken to coat
7. Cover and chill at least 8 hours or overnight , turning occasionally
8. Place rack over baking sheet
9. Remove chicken from marinade and set on rack
10. Drain 10 minutes
11. Mix flour , salt , pepper , cumin and cayenne pepper in large bowl
12. Toss chicken strips in batches in flour mixture , turning to coat
13. Shake off excess
14. Toss each piece again in flour mixture
15. Shake off excess
16. Transfer chicken to rack on baking sheet
17. Let stand at least 15 minutes and up to 45 minutes
18. Preheat oven to low
19. Line baking sheet with paper towels
20. Pour oil into heavy large skillet to depth of 3 / 4 inch
21. Heat oil over high heat to 375 degrees f or until small cube of fresh bread sizzles instantly when added
22. Add chicken strips to skillet
23. Adjust heat so that temperature remains between 340 and 350 degrees f or until small cube of bread sizzles slowly when added
24. Fry until chicken is golden brown and cooked through , about 10 minutes
25. Using tongs , transfer chicken to prepared sheet and drain
26. Transfer chicken to platter and serve

title: roast duck with cherry rhubarb sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. For sauce:
3. In a skillet melt butter
4. Add shallots and cook until softened
5. Add cherries , rhubarb , honey , sage , stock , bring to a boil
6. Lower heat and simmer for 15 minutes
7. Mix 1 / 4 c madeira and arrowroot in a small cup , add to cherry mixture , simmer 5 minutes until thickened
8. For duck:
9. Prick the duck pieces all over with a knife
10. Put skin side up in a roasting pan , season with salt and pepper
11. Roast 15 minutes , drain fat
12. Lower oven to 350 , turn duck and roast for 30 minutes
13. Drain fat , turn over , roast for 15-30 minutes more until desired doneness
14. Drain fat
15. Remove duck to a platter
16. Add balsamic vinegar and 1 / 4 c madeira to the roating pan , scraping up browned bits
17. Heat on stovetop and reduce by half
18. Add to the sauce and season with salt and pepper to taste
19. To serve pour sauce over duck , garnish with sage leaves if desired

title: oat pancake  waffle batter
steps:
1. Put whole oats through blender , food processor , or grain mill to make a course meal
2. Mix all dry ingredients
3. Stir in the buttermilk , eggs , and butter until well blended
4. Make pancakes or waffles immediately or store in fridge / freezer

title: thai poached salmon
steps:
1. Cook rice according to the packet instructions
2. Meanwhile , heat a medium frying pan
3. Add curry paste and cook , stirring , for a few seconds
4. Gradually stir in a coconut cream and bring to a simmer
5. Add salmon fillets , cover and simmer for 7-8 minutes , turning the fish over halfway
6. Meanwhile , blanch green beans in a pan of simmering water until just tender
7. Drain and divide between 2 hot serving plates
8. Stir some fresh cilantro leaves into the sauce
9. Top the beans with the salmon , spooning over the sauce
10. Garnish with cilantro and serve with the cooked rice

title: tuscan chicken cakes
steps:
1. Mix chicken , 1 / 2 cup bread crumbs , mayo , egg , pesto , honey mustard , peppers and red onion
2. Using 1 / 3 cup measure shape chicken into 8 cakes / patties
3. Lightly coat each cake in the remaining 1 / 2 cup bread crumbs
4. Heat oil in pan over high heat
5. Add cakes and cook until golden brown
6. About 3 minutes each side
7. Drain on paper towels and enjoy

title: cioppino  seafood soup  with fennel and garlic
steps:
1. In a large , heavy saucepan , heat 2 tablespoons of the olive oil over medium-low heat
2. Add the chopped fennel , onion , shallots , and garlic and saut for 4 to 5 minutes , until golden brown
3. Stir in the wine , then the tomatoes , parsley , red pepper flakes , clam juice , and water
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Bring to a boil over high heat , then decrease the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes
6. Add the butter and stir to melt , then remove from heat
7. In a large cast iron skillet , heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat and toss on the mussels and clams
8. Cook for 4 minutes
9. As the mussels and clams begin to open , add the fish , calamari , and shrimp , and sprinkle with salt and pepper
10. Saut for 2 to 3 minutes , until the shrimp turn pink
11. Discard any mussels or clams that don't open
12. Add 1 cup of the tomato mixture and simmer for 5 minutes
13. Transfer the contents of the skillet to the saucepan with the remaining tomato mixture and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes
14. Ladle into soup bowls
15. Sprinkle with the basil , garnish with the fennel fronds , and serve immediately

title: bedtime relax tea
steps:
1. Boil the water
2. Steep the remaining ingredients for 5-15 minutes
3. Strain , and drink before bedtime

title: pappasito s salsa
steps:
1. In a moderately hot skillet that has been sprayed with a cooking spray brown the coarsely chopped pablano pepper and jalapeno pepper
2. Brown and stir until the skins have turned dark on many sides of peppers
3. Add tomatoes and brown them until the skins on the tomatoes have turned a dark brown on several sides , remove pan from heat
4. Put onion in hot skillet that has been removed from the heat and stir
5. In a food processor add celery salt , oregano , cilantro , sugar , garlic salt and pepper
6. Pour peppers , onions and tomatoes and add water a little at a time
7. Process just enough to chop to a medium
8. Consistency but not to a smooth paste , leave a little chunky
9. Remove from processor and pour in hot skillet turn up heat quickly stir for 3 min and serve hot

title: spinach salad with scallops and apples
steps:
1. 1
2. Preheat broiler
3. Lightly a broiler pan with cooking spray
4. Rinse scallops to remove any bits of shell or sand
5. Pat dry with paper towels
6. Arrange the scallops on the broiler pan and lightly coat with cooking spray and broil , turning once , until opaque throughout , about 5 to 7 minutes
7. Keep warm
8. 2
9. In a small cup combine the oil , water , lemon juice and mustard
10. Set aside
11. 3
12. Place the spinach in a bowl
13. Add the apples and almonds
14. Toss with the dressing
15. Season with pepper
16. Divide between 4 plates and top with scallops
17. Serve immediately

title: eggplant  aubergine     olive truffles  vegetarian meatballs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Cut the eggplant in half lengthwise and brush with olive oil
3. Roast in the preheated oven for about 30 min , until golden and completely soft
4. Let cool
5. Peel off the skin and chop the rest of the eggplant finely
6. Reduce oven temp to 400f
7. Mix the eggplant , pine nuts , olives , bread crumbs , parsley , garlic , egg , and 6tbs of the parmesan cheese together in a bowl
8. Let rest for 10-15 minutes
9. Grease a large cookie sheet
