10. Form the mixture into bite sized balls and put on cookie sheet
11. Top each one with a pinch of the remaining parmesan cheese
12. Bake for 15-20 min until golden and puffed up
13. Serve hot

title: dolmathes  stuffed grape leaves
steps:
1. Saute onions in cup olive oil until translucent
2. Wash and drain rice well and add to onion along with 1 cup of water
3. Cook for 10 minutes
4. Add herbs , pine nuts , currants and salt and white pepper to taste
5. Set aside to cool
6. Prep leaves by rinsing well under running water and blanch in boiling water for 2-3 minutes
7. Cut off any tough stems by cutting a v around the stem , and discarding stem
8. Place 1 leaf on flat surface , shiny side down , add 1 teaspoon of filling and roll loosely , as rice will expand during cooking
9. Place seam side down on bottom of large saucepan which has been covered with a layer of thicker grape leaves
10. Repeat each grape leaf in same manner until all are used , packing them in tight- one next to the other- seam side down
11. Add 1 1 / 2- 2 cups water , dash salt , 3 / 4 cup olive oil and the juice of 1 lemon
12. Cover with a heavy plate to keep dolmathes immersed in liquid , and simmer for 45 minutes , or until rice is cooked
13. Serve cold or at room temperature as a'meze'
14. Nice served with a squeeze of lemon and / or a dollop of greek yogurt on top
15. For vegan option omit the yogurt

title: blueberry and apple pie
steps:
1. Mix all filling ingredients in a bowl and set aside
2. Pie crust: mix salt with flour
3. Cut shortening into flour mixture till crumbly
4. Beat lightly egg , water and vinegar and mix egg mixture into the flour just till dough is made
5. Do not over mix
6. Press the dough into pie plate and press the other half between plastic sheets for pie cover
7. Place both in freezer for 5 minutes
8. Then fill pie shell with fruit mixture
9. Cover pie with pastry in plastic making hole on top of pie crust
10. Bake at 425f for 30-40 minutes till golden , do not over cook

title: grilled tandoori chicken ala mareesme
steps:
1. Prick chicken pieces all over with a fork
2. Combine yogurt and garlic and marinate chicken for 5 hours in this mixture in non-metal pan covered with plastic wrap in refrigerator
3. Turn often
4. Mix remaining ingredients
5. Rub or spread this paste on chicken after it has been removed from marinade
6. Let stand for 2-3 hours in refrigerator
7. Grill over medium coals or on oiled grates of gas grill for 45-55 minutes , checking with thermometer to confirm doneness
8. If using gas grill , only light right burner and cook on left side

title: pomegranate chicken or duck
steps:
1. Combine pomegranate molasses , ground walnuts , sugar , cinnamon , nutmeg , turmeric , and saffron
2. Set aside
3. Clean chicken removing unnecessary bones and skin
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Place chopped onion and 3 tblsps olive oil in a pot and saute 3 minutes
6. Then add the chicken pieces , salt , pepper , and turmeric
7. Add 1 cup of water and simmer over low heat for 30 minutes
8. Add the pomegranate mixture and simmer on low heat for 30 minutes longer
9. Add a bit more sugar if you want the sauce sweeter
10. Transfer to a deep serving pot , cover , and place in a warm oven until ready to serve
11. Serve with rice

title: sugar free strawberry pie  not made with jello
steps:
1. Arrange half of the strawberries in the bottom of the pie shell
2. I usually put enough to cover the bottom
3. Mash remaining berries and combine with splenda in a medium saucepan
4. Place saucepan over medium heat and bring to a boil , stirring frequently
5. In a small bowl , whisk together cornstarch and water
6. Gradually stir cornstarch mixture into boiling strawberry mixture
7. Reduce heat and simmer mixture until thickened , stirring constantly
8. Pour mixture over berries in pie shell
9. Chill several hours before serving
10. Top with cool whip free and enjoy !

title: french toast bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Grease a 13" x 9" baking pan
3. Cut bread 2" cubes
4. Place half of the bread cubes in baking pan
5. Top with melted cream cheese
6. Add fruit on top of cream cheese if using fruit
7. Optional
8. Place remaining bread cubes on top
9. Beat together eggs , milk , 6 tbsp butter and pour over top
10. Press down with spatula to moisten evenly
11. Bake at 325 for 45 minutes or until bubbly
12. For syrup:
13. Cook all syrup ingredients in a saucepan until bubbly
14. Let stand at least 2 minutes before serving over french toast bake

title: chef lou s potato soup
steps:
1. In a dutch oven , cook the bacon over medium heat until done
2. Remove from pan and set aside
3. Drain off all but 1 / 4 cup of bacon grease
4. Saute celery and onion in bacon grease until onion begins to turn clear
5. Add garlic and continue cooking for 1-2 minutes
6. Add cubed potatoes and toss to coat
7. Saute for 3-4 minutes
8. Add enough chicken broth to just cover the potatoes
9. Add heavy cream
10. Cover and simmer until potatoes are tender
11. Add parmesan , cheddar cheese , and butter and stir until melted
12. Puree some if desired for thickening
13. Garnish with green onion and bacon crumbles

title: southern style green beans the porkless way
steps:
1. Cook all ingredients except butter in large heavy pot over medium heat until mixture is simmering
2. Reduce heat and simmer , covered
3. Cook for at least 20 minutes
4. When beans are tender and have reached desired tenderness (southerners eat them very overcooked :
5. Remove from stove and add butter
6. Stir to coat again and serve hot ! yummy !

title: jackleen s velvet carrots
steps:
1. Cook your carrots until very tender either by boiling in water or in a steamer or in the microwave
2. Place just 1 / 2 cup of the cooked carrots into a blender and set aside the remaining carrots
3. Add the melted butter , orange juice , vanilla , and cinnamon to the blender
4. Place cover on blender and blend on medium until smooth
5. Pour into medium saucepan and add remaining cooked carrots
6. Heat until warmed through over medium-low heat
7. Sprinkle with parsley before serving

title: grilled beer salmon packets
steps:
1. Preheat grill to medium high heat
2. Create a large aluminum foil packet for each fish fillet
3. Place salmon in center of foil
4. Season with garlic salt and brown sugar
5. Add pieces of butter , then onions
6. Carefully , pour some beer into foil packet and seal tightly
7. Grill for 8-10 minutes

title: blond toffee brownies
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , cream butter and sugars
2. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition
3. Combine the flour , baking powder and salt
4. Gradually add to the creamed mixture
5. Srit in toffee bits
6. Spread evenly into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-in pan
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 35-40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into center comes out clean
8. Cool on wore rack
9. Cut into bars
10. Enjoy !

title: salsa roja  salvadoran tomato sauce
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a saucepan over medium heat
2. Add the onion , garlic and chile and saute for 2 to 3 minutes , or until the onion is translucent
3. Stir in the tomatoes and oregano and simmer for about 10 minutes
4. Remove from heat and cool a bit
5. Puree the tomato sauce in a blender or with an immersion blender until smooth , adding a little water if needed
6. Add salt and pepper to taste , stir in cilantro if using and serve

title: steamed maine lobster
steps:
1. In a pot large enough to hold 2 lobsters , pour in 2 inches of seawater
2. If you don't have seawater , add 1 tsp
3. Salt to plain water
4. Pour in 4 oz
5. Of the beer
6. Bring the water to a boil over high heat
7. Place the 2 lobsters in the pot and cover tightly
8. Return to a boil as quickly as possible and then start counting the time
9. The 2 lb
10. Lobsters should steam for 16 minutes
11. Take them out with tongs , dump the water and start over with fresh water , adding the salt if no seawater and the beer
12. Serve with individual bowls of melted butter and cracking utensils
13. If you want to cook smaller or larger lobsters: it is 13 minutes per pound , for the first pound
14. Add 3 minutes per pound for each additional pound thereafter

title: sweet potato buffalo fries
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Peel and slice potatoes into 1 inch wedges
3. Toss with oil
4. Mix together seasonings , sprinkle over potatoes and toss to coat
5. Place on a baking sheet and roast 30 minutes , turning often , until golden
6. Sprinkle with salt if desired

title: chicken and spinach pesto lasagna
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 , spray a 13x9" casserole or lasagna pan with nonstick spray
2. Heat oil in skillet over med-high heat
3. Cook onions and garlic untill transparent
4. Add spinach
5. Cook and stir about 5 minute
6. Add chicken
7. Cook and stir about 5 minute
8. Season with salt and pepper
9. In large bowl , mix together ricotta , parmesan , egg , and pesto until thoroughly blended
10. Add chicken and spinach mixture to bowl and stir to combine
11. Spread 2 tbsp pesto in bottom of prepared pan
12. Layer 4 lasagna noodles , slightly overlapping
13. Top with 1 / 3 of spinach ricotta mixture and 1 / 3 of mozzarella
14. Repeat layers twice
15. Bake about 35 to 40 min or until hot and bubbly
16. Refrigerate any leftovers

title: cold weather hotpot
steps:
1. Cut each onion into 8 wedges
2. Roughly chop the carrots and cut the potatoes into large chunks
3. Put the kettle on
4. Heat a large non stick pan , add the ground beef and fry quickly , stirring all the time until evenly browned
5. Crumble in the stock cubes and mix well
6. Add the vegetables , stir them in and add 3 3 / 4 cups boiling water from the kettle
7. Bring to the boil
8. Reduce the heat , cover and simmer for 25-30 mins until the vegetables are tender
9. Stir in the baked beans and worcestershire sauce and heat through
10. Taste and season if necessary
11. Ladle into bowls and serve

title: chocolate  banana and peanut butter parfait
steps:
1. In a bowl , mix the yogurt , peanut butter and powdered sugar until smooth
2. Slice your banana
3. Mix the granola and chocolate chips together
4. You can also use m&m's for children
5. Assemble in layers starting with bananas , then chocolate granola , then yogurt
6. Top with chocolate granola
7. If you like , you can replace the chocolate chips with chocolate syrup
8. Enjoy !

title: pineapple and macadamia cheese
steps:
1. Chop nuts roughly and set 3 tablespoons aside for topping
2. Using a sharp knife , cut a thin top off the cheese and discard the rind
3. Using a teaspoon , scoop out the cheese and place in small bowl
4. Mix in the nuts , pineapple , cream cheese , herbs and curry powder
5. Stir until mixture is soft and creamy
6. Spoon the mixture into empty cheese shell
7. Sprinkle the reserved nuts on top
8. Serve at room temperature with crackers

title: stir fried garlic pork  or chicken
steps:
1. Mix marinade ingredients until smooth
2. Place pork in a small bowl with marinade and coat in mixture
3. Let marinate for at least 20 minutes
4. Heat the wok and add half the oil
5. When it's very hot and almost smoking , lift the pork out of the marinade with a slotted spoon , and put it in the wok
6. Stir-fry quickly it begins to brown
7. Remove from wok and drain well
8. Wipe the wok clean , re-heat it and add the rest of the oil
9. Quickly add the garlic , onions , and chili bean sauce , then a few seconds later add the
10. Rest of the ingredients
11. Bring the mixture to a boil and then return the pork to the wok
12. Stir-fry the entire mixture for another 5 minutes
13. Transfer to a serving plate and garnish with coriander leaves
14. Serve with rice

title: pan crisped potatoes  mark bittman
steps:
1. Bring the potatoes to a boil in salted water to cover , then lower the heat to simmer until nearly tender , 10-15 minutes
2. Drain well
3. Heat the oil over med-high heat in a 12-inch nonstick skillet for 3-4 minutes
4. You can use more oil for crisper potatoes or less oil to cut the fat
5. Add in the potatoes along with a healthy sprinkling of salt and pepper and cook , tossing and stirring from time to time , until they are nicely browned all over , 10-20 minutes
6. Add in the garlic and continue to cook for 5 minutes more , stirring frequently
7. Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary , then serve

title: mom s classic cranberry sauce
steps:
1. Dissolve sugar in boiling water
2. Add berries
3. Cover and bring to simmering
4. Let berries pop , about 10 minutes
5. Let cool to room temperature , then refrigerate

title: lagkage danish layer cake
steps:
1. Beat the four egg yolks until lemon colored
2. Add water and sugar and beat two minutes
3. Mix and sift the flour , cornstarch , baking powder and salt
4. Add to the egg yolk mixture
5. Beat well
6. Beat the egg whites until stiff and fold into the yolk and flour mixture
7. Add vanilla
8. Bake in four ungreased nine-inch cake pans , in a quick , hot oven preheated to 450f for 10 minutes
9. Fill with an assortment of fillings
10. Top with whipped cream

title: cheddar vegetable bake  ragu
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In large bowl add cooked potatoes , cauliflower , broccoli , garlic , onion , parmesan , jalapenos , pepper , cilantro , broth and cheese sauce
3. Toss to coat
4. Place into large baking dish
5. Add bread crumbs , sprinkling evenly across top of vegetables
6. Sprinkle with pine nuts
7. Pour melted butter on top
8. Cover and bake for approximately 45 minutes uncover and bake for additional 10-15 minutes

title: osman s weiner schnitzel
steps:
1. Wash and dry meat
2. Tenderize with meat hammer if necessary
3. Put flour in a bowl
4. Put beaten eggs in another bowl
5. Put breadcrumbs in a third bowl
6. Dredge each piece of meat into the flour , then the eggs and then the breadcrumbs until completely coated
7. Heat oil in frying pan
8. Fry pork on both sides
9. Ideally the coating will be medium brown when done
10. Watch the temperature of your oil--not too hot !
11. Squeeze a quartered lemon over the pork before serving

title: tropical pound cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 325
2. Grease a 12-cup bundt pan
3. Lightly dust with flour
4. Whisk together flour , baking soda , and salt in a medium bowl until mixed well
5. Beat together butter and sugar in a second bowl until light and fluffy , about 3 minutes
6. Beat in eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
7. Mix together sour cream , pineapple , and lime rind in a small bowl
8. On low speed , beat flour mixture into butter mixture in 3 additions , alternating with the sour cream mixture , starting and ending with the flour mixture
9. Add coconut and vanilla extracts
10. Beat on medium speed for 3 minutes
11. Pour batter into prepared pan
12. Bake in 325-degree oven for 60 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in the center comes out clean
13. Transfer pan to wire rack and cool for 20 minutes
14. Remove from pan and let cool completely
15. Glaze:
16. Whisk together lime juice and confectioners sugar in small bowl until good drizzling consistency
17. Drizzle over cake and garnish with desired toppings

title: german pancake  puff pancake
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 425 degrees
2. Melt butter in preheating oven in a 9" pie pan
3. Beat together the rest of the ingredients
4. Batter can be slightly lumpy
5. Pour over the melted butter in the pie pan
6. Bake for 15 minutes or until puffed up and golden ! sprinkle with powdered sugar and lemon juice

title: shepherd s cheddar pie
steps:
1. Make topping by combining 1 / 2 can condensed soup with hot mashed potatoes
2. Set aside
3. In non-stick frypan , brown ground beef at medium-high heat until coo ked through
4. Drain excess fat
5. Meanwhile , cook mixed vegetables according to package directions
6. Add to frypan and stir into beef with remaining soup , worcestershire sauce and pepper
7. Spoon meat mixture into 8 x 8 x 2 in
8. Square baking pan
9. Spread reserved potato mixture evenly over surface
10. Bake at 400 f for 20 minutes or until topping is light golden

title: warm cocoa coffee
steps:
1. Pour 1 cup coffee into cup
2. Add hershey's syrup
3. Stir in honey
4. Add cinnamon
5. Mix
6. Put cool whip on top
7. Sip and enjoy !

title: paula deen s senate bean soup
steps:
1. Rinse beans in hot water until they are white
2. Place beans in stockpot , add water and bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat and simmer for 3 hours
4. Heat butter in small skillet over medium heat
5. Add onion to butter and saute until lightly brown , then add to pot of beans
6. Remove 2 cups bean mixture , puree in blender , then return to stockpot
7. Add ham to soup
8. Just before serving , add salt and pepper to taste , then garnish with parsley

title: char siu  chinese sweet barbecued pork
steps:
1. Trim the fat from the pork and cut into chunks
2. Each chunk should be between 2-4 bites
3. Blend all remaining ingredients
4. The pork and marinade should be fairly bright red- add enough food coloring to give it a nice color
5. Marinate for at least 3 and preferable 24 hours
6. Broil or grill for 3-4 minutes on a side or until the pork is done through

title: make ahead mashed potatoes  lower fat
steps:
1. Place potatoes in a saucepan
2. Add water to cover and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt
3. Bring to a boil
4. Cover , reduce heat to medium and simmer for 25 minutes or until potatoes are tender
5. Drain
6. Peel potatoes
7. Place in a large mixing bowl , and mash with a potato masher
8. Add 1 tablespoons butter , cream cheese , yogurt , milk and 3 / 4 teaspoon salt
9. Adjusting the quantity of the yogurt to suit your personal taste and needs
10. Mix until all ingredients are blended
11. Spoon mixture into a lightly greased 12x8x2-inch baking dish
12. Brush top of mixture with melted butter
13. Sprinkle with paprika
14. Bake immediately , or cover and refrigerate
15. If refrigerated , let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes before baking
16. Bake at 350f , uncovered for 30 minutes or until hot

title: deviled eggs delight  atkins friendly   low carb
steps:
1. Split eggs lengthwise , take out yolk
2. Mix yolk with remaining ingredients except paprika
3. Fill eggs with mixture and sprinkle paprika on top

title: chargrilled prawns  shrimp  with coriander and lime
steps:
1. Place oil , lime juice , coriander leaves , ginger , garlic , and ground coriander in a food processor and process until smooth past consistency
2. Place prawns in a bowl and coat with 1 / 3 of the paste
3. Cover and chill 30 minutes
4. Thread prawns onto skewers
5. Cook on high heat on a preheated barbecue 2-3 minutes
6. Drizzle with remaining paste and serve

title: norwegian figure 8 cakes kringla
steps:
1. In large mixing bowl , dissolve yeast in the warm water
2. Add 1 tablespoon of the sugar and let stand until yeast foams , about 5 minutes
3. Add the remaining sugar , butter , cream , anise seed , and eggs
4. Beat well
5. Stir in the flour , 1 cup at a time , beating well to keep mixture smooth and satiny
6. All of the flour should be moistened
7. Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 24 hours
8. Cover a baking sheet with parchment paper or grease lightly
9. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured work surface
10. Cut it into pieces the size of large walnut
11. Roll out to strands about 8 inches long
12. Twist into figure-8s
13. Place on baking sheets
14. Let rise 1 hour until puffy
15. Preheat oven to 400 f
16. Bake for 15 minutes until golden
17. Brush baked kringla with melted butter
18. These are best served just out of the oven
19. The great scandinavian baking book

title: easy cornish game hens
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except hens
2. Clean & cut hens in half
3. Pour sauce over hens & bake 1 hour at 350f

title: nan s dumplings
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients together then stir in cheese
2. Mix egg , butter and milk together
3. Stir into flour mixture until well mixed
4. Drop into soup or stew , cover and simmer for 12 min
5. I sometimes drop 1 / 2 teaspoons into soup for mini dumplings
6. They also freeze well once cooked

title: chocolate marshmallow  cups
steps:
1. Put the paper liners in the muffin pans
2. Put 8 marshmallows in the bottom of each paper liner
3. Put chocolate chips , peanut butter and margarine in a saucepan
4. Put saucepan on the burner and turn on the stove to low
5. Stir until everything is mixed and melted
6. Remove saucepan from heat
7. Turn off burner
8. Spoon the chocolate mixture over the marshmallows
9. Put the pans in the refrigerator until the chocolate is hard

title: stuffed croissant french toast
steps:
1. In a shallow bowl wide enough to immerse croissant , whisk eggs until light yellow
2. Add milk , half& half , vanilla and seasonings and mix together
3. Slice croissant and spread cream cheese on bottom half
4. Lay sliced fruit on top of cream cheese and cover with top croissant half
5. Dip in egg mixture and fry in butter till brown
6. Flip over and brown other side

title: spaghetti with turkey meatballs
steps:
1. Make the sauce: in a large nonstick skillet , heat 3 tablespoons oil over medium-high heat
2. Add garlic , and cook , about 1 minute
3. Stir in tomatoes , oregano , and thyme
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Bring to a boil
6. Reduce to a simmer , and cook , covered , for 20 to 25 minutes
7. Make the meatballs: in a large bowl , whisk together egg , milk , 1 1 / 4 teaspoons salt , and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper with a fork
8. Stir in onion , breadcrumbs , cheese , and parsley
9. Add turkey , mixing until combined
10. Form into 1 1 / 2-inch balls
11. Add meatballs to skillet and spoon the sauce over to coat
12. Cover and cook over medium heat until meatballs are just cooked through , about 8 minutes
13. While meatballs are cooking , bring a large pot of salted water to a boil
14. Add spaghetti , and cook for about 12 minutes
15. Drain pasta and add tablespoon oil , stir
16. Add spaghetti to skillet , and toss to coat evenly
17. Serve with additional cheese , if desired

title: fish fillets
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Place fillets in a baking dish sprayed with cooking spray
3. Sprinkle with lemon juice , curry , cayenne , garlic , mrs
4. Dash , and boullion
5. Drizzle melted butter over the top
6. Bake for 10-15 minutes or until fish flakes with a fork

title: chuck s easy poached salmon
steps:
1. Place lemon slices , dill and ginger in a foil pan that has been sprayed with cooking spray
2. Place salmon on top
3. Add wine and then fill pan with water until the fish is completely covered
4. Cover with foil and poke knife holes all over the foil to allow steam to escape
5. Put in oven at 350 for approximately 25 minutes

title: plomeek soup
steps:
1. Do not add the butter until you reach the serving stage then taste and add to taste
2. Melt 1 / 2 cup butter in a saucepan and saute the onions over low heat until transparent
3. Add the remaining butter , melt , and add the carrots--cooking over low heat until browned , about 30 minutes
4. Add the celery and cook 10 more minutes on low heat
5. Pour in the stock , salt , and pepper , bring to a boil , then reduce heat and let soup simmer for about an hour
6. When ready to serve if you want kirk's version add the heavy cream
7. Ok the above is the "official recipe"
8. First lose the cream
9. It is no longer optional because you are using the tofu
10. I also lost the butter
11. I used butterbuds in place of it
12. If needed add more liquid or increase the amount of tofu
13. Add the seasonings to the soup when you simmer
14. That includes the braggs
15. When ready to serve , puree the soup with a stick blender then add the cut up tofu [cut for ease in the next part] and puree again
16. It should turn almost a dreamsicle color
17. It shouldn't need thickening however let simmer a bit more if it does then serve with garnish of greens and diced tomatoes or a bit of salsa

title: garlic lover s chicken
steps:
1. In a large resealable plastic bag , combine the first 5 ingredients
2. Place milk in a shallow bowl
3. Dip chicken in milk , then shake in the crumb mixture
4. Place in a greased 13x9x2 inch baking dish
5. Combine the butter , garlic and lemon juice
6. Drizzle over the chicken
7. Sprinkle with the paprika
8. Bake , uncovered , at 350 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes or until the juices run clear

title: easy pizzadillas
steps:
1. Place a flour tortilla on a large plate or cutting board and spread with a thin layer of spaghetti sauce
2. Season with oregano , garlic salt , parmesian , pepper flakes , or whatever herbs you prefer
3. Add a thin layer of shredded mozarella cheese
4. Layer your pizza toppings of choice
5. Add another thin layer of mozarella
6. Place another tortilla on top
7. Melt butter , parmesian , oregano , and garlic salt together in a
8. Microwavable dish
9. Brush the top tortilla with the herb butter and invert onto a grill with the butter side down
10. Brush the other side and cover the grill
11. Flip the pizzadilla when the cheese is melted and the bottom tortilla is crisp
12. Once the other tortilla is crisp , remove from the grill and slice into quarters with a pizza cutter
13. An easy dipping sauce can be made by mixing spaghetti sauce with the leftover herb butter and heating

title: cranberried meatballs
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl combine , eggs , corn flake crumbs , ketchup , soya sauce , parsley flakes , onion , salt , pepper and ground pork
2. Shape mixture into 1" meatballs
3. Place on cookie sheet and bake at 350 degrees for 20- 25 minutes
4. Remove from oven and drain on paper towels
5. In large pan combine cranberry sauce , ketchup , brown sugar and lemon juice
6. Cook , stirring often , until the cranberry sauce is melted
7. Add meatballs to sauce and heat throughly
8. Serve over hot cooked noodles

title: corned beef brisket
steps:
1. Fill 4 quart crock or plastic bag with 2 quarts water
2. Dissolve brown sugar in additional 1 / 4 cup warm water
3. Add kosher salt and vinegar , stir to dissolve and add remaining ingredients
4. Be sure the meat is beneath the surface of the liquid
5. Refrigerate for three weeks
6. After 3 weeks , remove brisket and rinse
7. Add to 8-10 quart pot , fill with water and add 1 teaspoon mustard seeds , 1 teaspoon peppercorns , 3 cloves garlic , smashed , 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar , 1 / 2 tablespoon kosher salt and 1 tablespoon of pickling spice
8. Bring to a boil , cover and simmer for 3 hours or until tender
9. Add potatoes , carrots and onions , turnips and parsnips , if desired
10. Continue to simmer covered for 15 minutes
11. Add cabbage wedges , simmer additional 6-10 minutes or until cabbage is soft and tender
12. Serve with nice mustard and a horseradish sauce

title: philly beef  n  pepper strata
steps:
1. Place a third of the bread cubes in a greased 13 x 9 inches baking dish
2. Layer with a third of the pepper / onion blend , roast beef , and cheese
3. Repeat layers twice
4. In a large bowl , whisk the eggs , milk , mustard , salt and pepper , pour over the top
5. Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight
6. Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes before baking
7. Bake , covered at 325 for 1 hour
8. Uncover and bake 15-20 minutes longer or until a knife inserted in the middle comes out clean
9. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving

title: chewy chocolate sugarsnap cookies
steps:
1. Sift together the flour , baking soda and salt
2. Set aside
3. In a medium saucepan over medium heat , melt margarine
4. Stir in cocoa , remove from heat and set aside to cool
5. In a large bowl , cream together the butter , 1 cup white sugar and brown sugar until fluffy
6. Beat in the eggs , then stir in the cocoa mixture and the vanilla
7. Blend in the sifted ingredients to form a soft dough
8. Cover dough and refrigerate for 30 minutes to an hour
9. Preheat oven to 350
10. Roll chilled dough into walnut-sized balls
11. Roll them into the sugar crystals and place them 2 to 3-inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheets
12. Bake for 8-10 minutes in the preheated oven
13. Take the cookies out of the oven once they look like they are starting to set
14. The key to making these cookies great is to not overbake them
15. Allow cookies to cool on baking sheet then remove to a wire rack to cool completely
16. If you don't have the crystals , go ahead and give rolling the cookies in granulated sugar a try !

title: the best cowboy calico beans
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Brown beef , bacon and onion in a large skillet or dutch oven over medium heat
3. Add beans and remaining ingredients , stirring to combine
4. Pour into two buttered baking dishes
5. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until beans reach desired thickness
6. Alternatively , place in a buttered crock pot and heat on low for about 4 hours , uncover during the last hour of cooking if you like your beans thick
7. Freezes / reheats well

title: grill pork  with rosemary and lavender
steps:
1. Combine salt , pepper , lavender , thyme , rosemary , garlic , lemon juice and olive oil
2. Rub mixture onto the pork chops
3. Cover the chops with plastic wrap and let sit 1 to 2 hours at room temperature
4. Preheat barbecue grill
5. Place pork chops onto hot grill
6. Cover barbecue with lid and grill 4 to 5 minutes
7. Turn and grill an additional 3 to 4 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 155f on a meat thermometer
8. Remove from barbecue and serve

title: chinese buffet crab casserole
steps:
1. Save half of cheddar cheese to sprinkle on top
2. Mix the other ingredients together in bowl
3. Spoon into greased casserole dish , top with cheese
4. Bake at 325f for 30 minutes

title: microwavable monkey bread
steps:
1. Place the butter , water , brown sugar and cinnamon in a glass pan and microwave for 2 minutes
2. Put biscuits into pan with mixture and stir everything so the biscuits are completely coated
3. Microwave for 5 mins at 70% power or until done

title: arizona champagne mustard
steps:
1. Mix dry mustard with vinegar and let stand in refrigerator overnight
2. The next day , bring to room temperature and cook with a mixture of the beaten egg , sugar , salt and cornstarch
3. Cook slowly , stirring , until mixture boils and thickens , 10-15 minutes
4. Let cool and add the mayonnaise
5. Stir well
6. Stay cool

title: curried mince macaroni
steps:
1. Take a deep pan and heat the 1& 1 / 2 tbsps oil
2. Add chopped onions and fry till transclucent
3. Lower the flame to medium heat and add the garam masala powder and fry for a couple of seconds
4. Add the lamb mince and fry till no longer pink and water has dried up
5. Keep breaking the lumps to ensure the meat is lump free
6. Now add the ginger-garlic paste , chilli powder and salt and fry for another minute
7. Add the yogurt and cook for 2-3 minutes , stirring now and then to get a uniform mixture
8. Now add the chopped tomatoes , green chillies , lime juice and the chopped coriander , and mix well
9. Cover the pan and let cook on low flame for 15 mins , till you can see some oil on the top of the curry
10. Cook the pasta as per instructions
11. Mix the pasta in the curry and let cook on the lowest flame for a further 5-10 minutes
12. The entire dish should be saucy-- garnish with a few coriander leaves
13. I usually serve it with some yogurt chutney
14. The yogurt might break up due to the heat , so please don't worry about it
15. It is just a process , that will make the curry , taste tangy rather than creamy
16. I wanted to add a few sugesstions to this recipe after reading the reviews -- the oil can be reduced if your mince is fatty , this is just an estimate , so go by your judgement -- as for the tomatoes , i usually add tin when fresh is not available , and personally i feel it doesnot alter the taste --

title: johnny  mazetti  panama
steps:
1. For the homemade arturo sauce:
2. Mix all ingredients together and saute` on low until bubbles begin
3. Yield is about 1 cup good for a recipe calling for 8 oz can
4. For the casserole:
5. Pre-heat oven to 350f
6. In a large skillet brown ground beef , drain , then put in large pot , add chopped peppers , onions , celery , olives and mushrooms
7. Then add the seasoning and garlic powder to the pot
8. Mix those ingredients well
9. Add sauces and tomato paste then mix again
10. Cook over medium low heat for about 25 to 30 minutes
11. In another pot , cook noodles -- when done , add them to the mixture and stir very well
12. Place mixture in long oblong pan in layers
13. On each layer , place shredded cheese but leave enough for the top
14. Place about 4 teaspoons of butter on the top with remaining cheese , and bake at 350f for about 35 minutes or until the cheese melts and it is a golden brown
15. Serve and enjoy
16. Leftovers freeze well

title: anything goes stir fry
steps:
1. Heat oil and add garlic and ginger
2. Cook half a minute in skillet or wok
3. Add carrots , cauliflower first& any other firm vegetable
4. Cook covered one minute or until it steams
5. Add medium veggies beans , onions , peppers , etc
6. Cook covered one minute or until it steams
7. Add meat
8. Cook covered two minute or until it steams
9. Add broccoli
10. Cook covered two minute or until it steams
11. Serve w / rice

title: jalapeno jack burgers
steps:
1. On the grill or under the broiler , roast the jalapeno peppers whole , until they start to turn black
2. Once they are black on all sides , put into a brown paper bag , close and let sit 5 minutes
3. Remove from bag and peel off skin
4. Using a knife , slit open jalapenos , and take the seeds out and remove the stem
5. Cut jalapenos in half so you have 4 total slices of jalapeno
6. Set aside
7. In a bowl combine ground beef , 1 egg , ketchup , salt , garlic , and onions
8. You may also use any other seasonings you like in your hamburger mixture
9. Mix well
10. Form 8 thin patties
11. Take one slice of jalapeno and one slice of pepper jack cheese and place on 4 of the patties
12. Top each patty with remaining four patties and seal the edges together so the cheese doesn't leak out
13. Grill burgers or cook as usual until done
14. Your burgers will have a spicy , cheesey surprise in the middle of each one
15. Delicious !

title: gingersnaps  pepparkakor
steps:
1. Bring sugar , syrup , ginger , and cloves to a boil in a medium saucepan
2. Place the butter in a large mixing bowl
3. Add the baking soda to the sugar mixture , then pour over the butter
4. Stir until the butter is melted
5. Add the egg and flour
6. Mix until thoroughly blended
7. Knead the dough , then place in the refrigerator to chill
8. Roll out the dough on a floured board to 1 / 16 inch thickness
9. Using a knife or fancy cookie cutters , cut the dough into shapes
10. Place cookies on a greased baking sheet
11. Bake at 325f for 8-10 minutes
12. Cookies will firm up as they cool
13. Re-roll the scraps and repeat until all of the dough is used

title: unbelievable lemon coconut pie
steps:
1. Coconut filling directions:
2. In small bowl mix all ingredients with a hand mixer til smooth , and refrigerate til set
3. Pie crust directions:
4. Mix all dry ingredients in a 9-inch pie pan
5. Mix oil and milk together , then add to dry ingredients in pan
6. With fingers mix til all just moist and press lightly into pie pan
7. With a fork poke holes along bottom and sides of the crust and bake at 350 degrees f
8. For 8-10 minutes
9. Set aside to cool
10. Pie directions:
11. Sprinkle gelatin over water in small saucepan , add lemon extract and vanilla extract
12. Heat until gelatin dissolves , stirring constantly
13. Remove and let cool some
14. In large mixing bowl , mix cream cheese , sugar , salt , and vanilla til fluffy
15. Gradually beat in warm gelatin mix until well mixed
16. It is very important to do this gradually or you will end up with lumps you can't get out later
17. Chill until thickened
18. Beat again to soften some , and add about 5 drops of yellow food coloring
19. Then add cool whip and beat until well mixed and fluffy
20. Put about half of the mix into baked pie crust , making a dipped area to hold the coconut filling in the center
21. Spoon about 1 1 / 2 cup of the coconut filling into the pie and spread it evenly
22. Top with remaining lemon filling until pie is as full as you can get it
23. Sprinkle toasted coconut on top and chill for at least 2 hours before serving

title: linda s perfect popovers
steps:
1. Pour milk into small bowl of electric mixer
2. Sift in flour and salt
3. Beat at medium speed until batter is smooth , about 1 1 / 2 min
4. , scraping bowl frequently
5. Add butter and eggs
6. Beat to mix thoroughly , about 1 min
7. Ladle batter into well-greased custard cups , filling cups half full
8. Place cups on baking sheet and place on rack in center of hot oven
9. Bake in hot oven about 40 min
10. Keep oven door closed until about 5-10 min
11. Before end of baking time or popovers may collapse
12. Remove popovers from oven , prick sides with kitchen fork to permit steam to escape
13. Lay popovers on their sides in custard cups and return to oven , heat turned off and door left ajar , for 5 min
14. To dry inside
15. Makes 7 popovers bakes in 5 oz
16. Custard cups

title: almond cream spritz cookies
steps:
1. Beat butter and cream cheese in a large mixing bowl until well combined
2. Add sugar , almond extract , and vanilla
3. Beat till combined
4. Beat in flour
5. Cover and chill dough for 30 minutes or till easily worked but not too stiff
6. Pack dough into a cookie press
7. Force dough through press onto ungreased cookie sheets
8. Sprinkle with almonds
9. Bake in a 375 oven for 8-10 minutes or till edges of cookies are firm but not brown
10. Remove cookies and cool on wire racks

title: beer bottom chicken   beer can
steps:
1. Preheat your outdoor grill
2. Remove chicken from packaging and rinse well with cold water
3. Don't forget to rinse out the hollow center of the bird also
4. Empty 1 / 4 of the beer into the sink or drink it
5. Put two tablespoons of the dry mesquite mix into the beer can
6. Rub the remainder of the package of dry mesquite mix onto the outside of the chicken
7. Place chicken onto the beer can so that the bird is standing upright and the beer can is in it's bottom
8. Turn one side of your grill to high , and turn the other side completely off
9. Place the bird standing upright onto the side that is"off"
10. The bird will be ready in about 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours
11. This method of indirect grilling and the beer can inside the bird will make the most tender chicken you'll ever eat !
12. Make sure to spin the bird around every so often so that it will brown evenly

title: cherry cola float
steps:
1. Chill the cherry cola and place 4 mugs or glasses in the freezer to chill
2. Once chilled , in a pitcher combine the cherry cola and vanilla extract
3. Place two scoops of fudge ripple ice cream in each of four chilled glasses
4. Pour the cola over the ice cream
5. Top each float with whipped cream and a maraschino cherry
6. Enjoy !

title: dorito mexican casserole
steps:
1. Brown together ground beef and onion until beef is brown and onion is tender
2. Drain well
3. Add the mushroom soup , cheddar cheese soup , ro-tel tomatoes and soup can of milk to beef / onion mixture
4. Stir until well mixed
5. Line a 13x9 baking dish with the doritos
6. Cover with the meat / soup mixture and sprinkle completely with the cheddar cheese
7. Bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for about 30 minutes or until heated through and cheese is melted

title: oven roasted  lemon parmesan okra
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Toss whole okra with oil , lemon juice , zest , 1 1 / 2 tablespoons grated cheese , salt and pepper
3. Place okra on a rimmed baking sheet and roast until tender , about 15 minutes
4. Remove okra from oven , and immediately top with additional grated cheese
5. Taste and season with additional salt and pepper , if necessary
6. Makes four servings

title: beaudacious crock pot pork roast
steps:
1. Season entire pork roast with salt and pepper or a seasoning blend
2. Put roast in crock pot and cover with sliced mushrooms
3. Mix all remaining ingredients and use this to top the roast and mushrooms
4. Cook on low for 10-12 hours
5. This produces a lovely gravy which may be used on potatoes , rice , whatever

title: red beans and rice  no way  this is too good
steps:
1. In a large , heavy saucepan , saute bacon until lightly browned
2. Remove all but 2 tablespoons fat
3. Add onion , green pepper and garlic , saute until soft
4. Add remaining ingredients except vinegar , sugar and rice
5. Simmer uncovered for 15-20 minutes
6. Stir in vinegar and sugar for last few minutes then serve over rice
7. Variations: omit sausage for side dish-also
8. After all steps , mix with rice and throw in crockpot on warm and rice will soak up juice
9. Instead of sausage use boneless chicken

title: delicious microwave peanut butter fudge
steps:
1. Grease an 8 x 8-inch baking dish
2. Place the butter and the peanut butter in a medium-size microwave-safe bowl and microwave for 2 minutes on high
3. Remove and stir with a spoon then return back and cook on high for another 2 minutes
4. Whisk / mix in the confectioners vigorously until combined and smooth
5. Mix in the chopped roasted nuts
6. Cool to about room temperature , then chill until firm
7. Cut into small squares

title: choc chip   oat slice
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c
2. Brush a 17 x 27cm pan with melted butter to lightly grease
3. Line the base and 2 opposite long sides with non-stick baking paper , allowing it to overhang
4. Sift the combined flours into a bowl
5. Add the oats , coconut , sugar , sultanas and choc bits , and stir to combine
6. Make a well in the centre and add the melted butter and egg
7. Use a wooden spoon to stir until well combined
8. Spoon mixture into prepared pan and use the back of a spoon to smooth the surface
9. Bake in oven for 20 minutes or until golden brown and firm to the touch
10. Remove from oven and set aside to cool completely
11. Cut into squares to serve

title: creamy gravy covered  beer braised country style pork ribs
steps:
1. Mix salt , pepper , garlic powder , and onion powder in small bowl or ziploc bag and then sprinkle liberally over ribs
2. Allow the seasoned ribs to sit for about 20 minutes at room temperature
3. Heat oil in large heavy-bottomed , oven-proof dutch oven
4. Brown the ribs on all sides
5. Do not crowd them while browning , if it takes two batches , let it take two batches
6. Once ribs have browned well , remove them to a plate
7. Preheat oven to 375f
8. There should be ample rendered fat , but if there is more than about 4 tablespoons , remove the excess
9. Place all sliced onions in the bottom of the pan and allow them to start to take on just a bit of color
10. Pour in about 1 / 4 can of beer to deglaze the bottom of the pan while the onions continue to cook
11. Once the bottom of the pan is deglazed , return ribs to the pan
12. Pour in the rest of the beer
13. This should just barely cover all of the ribs and onions
14. Cover and bake at 375f for 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours
15. When you remove the dutch oven from the oven , be prepared for the onions to have cooked down into gooey lusciousness , and the sides of the pan to look like a disaster
16. Dont worry it will taste great
17. Remove the ribs and the onions from the pan
18. Turn oven down to 325f
19. Use the water that you will be using to make the pork gravy mix with to deglaze the bottom on the pan , then add the mix according to the instructions on the packet
20. Once the gravy has thickened , mix in cream of mushroom soup , the dry onion soup mix and the mushrooms
21. Place ribs and onions back in the dutch oven and stir so that the gravy is covering the ribs
22. Cover the dutch oven again , and return to the oven heated to 325f
23. Cook for about 1 hour
24. Serve with mashed potatoes , noodles or rice

title: valentine bark
steps:
1. Turn oven onto "warm" or 170-180
2. Wrap a small oven-proof dish with foil
3. Smooth it as best you can so there isn't alot of ridges that the chocolate can grab ahold of
4. Sprinkle 1 / 2 the almond bark on the bottom
5. Then sprinkle the chocolate , and then the remaining almond bark
6. Put in the oven for 5-10 minutes
7. Take a butter knife , and "swirl" the chocolate until you get your desired design
8. But make sure it is level
9. Place the hearts evenly on the chocolate , phrase side up
10. Press down lightly to enrap the sides in chocolate
11. Put pan in the freezer for 10 minutes
12. Remove , and break into pieces
13. Great for gifts !

title: raw beetroot salad
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients together in a salad bowl
2. Sprinkle on garnish

title: oriental hamburger dish
steps:
1. Brown ground beef , add onion , green pepper , and mushrooms
2. Cook for 5 minutes
3. Mix water , cornstarch , and soy sauce
4. Stir into meat mixture until smooth and thickened

title: banana ice cream
steps:
1. Peel bananas , break into chunks and process with the lemon juice in food processor until smooth
2. Stir in the simple syrup and heavy cream
3. If your simple syrup was not chilled , chill entire mixture in refrigerator for at least an hour
4. Freeze according to ice cream freezer manufacturer's instructions
5. This will be a soft ice cream straight from the ice cream maker
6. It can be frozen to firm up , but use within a day or two for the best flavor

title: fried cabbage and carrots
steps:
1. Heat your skillet over medium heat coat with the olive oil
2. When hot put in the cabbage and carrots
3. Cook covered about 7-10 minutes then add soy sauce and finish cooking covered for 8 minutes

title: surprise  pumpkin bundt cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f and spray a 12-cup bundt pan with non-stick cooking spray
2. Prepare the streusel by combining brown sugar , cinnamon and allspice in small bowl
3. Cut in butter with pastry blender until mixture is crumbly
4. Set aside
5. Prepare the cake batter by combining flour , cinnamon , nutmeg , baking soda and salt in medium bowl , set aside
6. Beat granulated sugar and butter in large mixer bowl until light and fluffy
7. Add eggs one at a time , beating well after each addition
8. Add pumpkin , sour cream and vanilla extract
9. Mix well
10. Gradually beat in the flour mixture till smooth
11. Spoon half of batter into prepared bundt pan
12. Sprinkle prepared streusel over batter , not allowing streusel to touch sides or center of pan
13. Top with remaining batter
14. Making sure batter layer touches edges of pan
15. Bake for 55 to 60 minutes or until pick inserted in cake comes out clean
16. Cool for 30 minutes in pan on wire rack before inverting onto wire rack to cool completely
17. After cake has cooled prepare the glaze
18. Combine 1 1 / 2 cups sifted powdered sugar and 2 to 3 tablespoons orange juice in small bowl
19. Stir until smooth
20. Drizzle glaze over the completely cooled cake

title: 1 2 3 apple crisp
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Lightly grease a 13x9 glass pan
3. Cut fruit into slices and layer in bottom of pan
4. Mix dry ingredients in a medium sized bowl and then cut in butter with a pastry cutter
5. Sprinkle mixture over fruit
6. Bake for 30-35 minutes
7. Top should be browned
8. Serve with ice cream or whipped cream

title: egg pastry
steps:
1. Sift flour and salt into a mixing bowl
2. Using a pastry cutter , cut in shortening until until particles are the size of small peas
3. In another bowl , combine egg , water and lemon juice
4. Sprinkle over dry ingredients tossing and stirring with a fork until mixture is moist enough to hold together
5. Divide in half
6. Shape into 2 flat balls
7. Roll
8. Makes 1 8 or 9 inch 2-crust pie

title: another   sommer  smoothie
steps:
1. Place frozen banana slices , frozen mixed berries , and frozen whole strawberries in blender with the unsweetened soy milk
2. Blend , blend , blend , stopping to scrape sides occasionally
3. Blend until no more large chunks remain and mixture is smooth , but thick like soft-serve ice cream consistency
4. Add more milk if needed , but try to keep it thick
5. Add vanilla and blend a few seconds more
6. Add apple juice , cinnamon , and honey
7. Blend some more
8. Add in the 6 oz container of yogurt
9. Blend some more
10. Keep blending until everything is smooth but still thick
11. Serve immediately or refrigerate or freeze and partially thaw for drinking later
12. Mine is in the fridge right now and is still fairly thick , creamy , and drinkable
13. I just shake my container a couple times
14. I don't think i'll have enough left over for tomorrow , lol
15. Enjoy !

title: dreamy peach upside down cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Melt 1 / 3 cup of butter in 9x9-inch pan
3. Stir in brown sugar
4. Spread evenly in pan
5. Lay peaches covering bottom of the pan
6. Cream butter and sugar
7. Add eggs and beat
8. Add dry ingredients alternately with the milk
9. Pour over peaches
10. Bake 40 to 50 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean
11. Let cool 10 minutes , then invert on a serving platter

title: nutty chicken spanakopita
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Wilt the spinach in a saucepan over medium heat for one minute
3. Mix the spinach with the ground chicken breast
4. Add the eggs , crushed cashews , oregano and salt and pepper to taste
5. Mix thoroughly
6. Take one sheet of phyllo and brush it with olive oil
7. Repeat with 3 more sheets , brushing each one liberally with olive oil
8. Using 1 / 2 of the chicken / spinach mix , place it along the bottom of the phyllo sheets
9. Leave a 1 / 2 inch margin on each side
10. Fold the two sides in so nothing will leak out , and begin to roll the sheets up away from you
11. Repeat this process with the other 4 sheets and the other half of the chicken / spinach mix
12. Bend each roll to form a wide crescent , and place on a baking sheet covered with parchment paper
13. Brush each crescent liberally with the olive oil
14. Bake for about 1 hour
15. If it looks like the dough is browning too quickly , cover it with a sheet of silver foil
16. Remove from the oven when done , and let rest for about 10 minutes
17. Cut into slices and serve
18. Can be served as both an appetizer or as a main course
19. Servings are for an appetizer

title: kick butt spaghetti sauce  out of a jar
steps:
1. In a large skillet or saucepan , melt butter with olive oil over medium-low heat
2. Add chopped onion , mushrooms and garlic
3. Saute until soft
4. Add spaghetti sauce and seasonings , stir well
5. Simmer over low heat for at least 10 minutes , but the longer the better
6. Remember to stir occasionally to make sure it doesn't scorch
7. Serve over cooked spaghetti

title: orzo with brown butter and parsley
steps:
1. In a large heavy saucepan , bring broth to a boil
2. Add orzo and cook until broth has been absorbed , about 15 minutes , stirring often
3. Remove from heat
4. In a medium skillet , melt butter , stirring until golden , about 4 minutes
5. Remove from heat
6. Add garlic and nutmeg
7. Pour over orzo
8. Add parsley and toss to combine
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste

title: marmie s delicious asain flavor  low cal  low fat vegetable soup
steps:
1. Saute first 4 ingredients together for 5 min , add mushrooms for another few min untill almost tender
2. Add next 5 ingredients and set aside
3. Chop spinach and set aside
4. Mix water and corn starch in a seperate bowl or cup untill smooth
5. Replace pot on stove , add water & cornstarch mixture to soya and bamboo mixture , cook till somewhat thickened
6. Slowly add chicken stock and bring to boil
7. Add oriental vegetables , simmer about 4 minutes ,
8. Add spinach and simmer untill spinach is just wilted
9. Enjoy your guilt free soup !

title: rotisserie pesto chicken burgers
steps:
1. Pesto directions:
2. In blender or food processor , process basil , parmesan , garlic and pine nuts until all are minced together
3. With the machine running add the olive oil and process until smooth
4. Pour the mixture into a glass jar and float 1 / 2 inch of olive oil on top
5. When ready to use , pour off the olive oil and stir the pesto
6. It will keep in the refrigerator for up to 1 week or in freezer for up to two months
7. Burger directions:
8. In a large mixing bowl , mix together the chicken , pesto , bread crumbs and pepper
9. Form the mixture into 6 patties about 1 / 2 inch thick
10. Refrigerate the patties until ready to cook , up to 12 hours
11. Coat the rotisserie basket with nonstick cooking spray , load the patties into the basket and close the lid tightly
12. Load the basket onto the spit rod assembly and grill the burgers until cooked through , 15 to 18 minutes
13. Remove from the basket and serve immediately

title: carrot daikon pickle
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and let rest for 30 minutes before use
2. To store any leftovers , add an additional 1 / 4 cup rice vinegar to cover the vegetables , stir and store in a glass jar or covered plastic container for up to 1 month

title: english tea pastries
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees
2. Separate the crescent rolls into individual triangles
3. Cut each triangles in half lengthwise , making 16 long triangles
4. Spread about 1 / 2 t
5. Of preserves over each triangle
6. Roll each triangle from the wide end to the point , and place on a cookie sheet that has been sprayed with nonstick cooking spray
7. Brush with butter and sprinkle with chopped nuts
8. Bake for 15-17 minutes , or until golden
9. When cool , sprinkle with the confectioners' sugar and serve

title: orange  banana   honey smoothie
steps: 1. Place all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth

title: baked potato skins
steps:
1. Cut potatoes in half lengthwise
2. Scoop out pulp , leaving a 1 / 4-in shell
3. Place potato skins on a greased baking sheet
4. Combine oil , parmesan cheese , salt , garlic powder , paprika , and pepper
5. Brush over both sides of skins
6. Bake at 475 degrees for 7 minutes
7. Turn
8. Bake until crisp , about 7 minutes more
9. Sprinkle bacon and cheddar cheese inside skins
10. Bake 2 minutes longer or until the cheese is melted
11. Top with sour cream and onions
12. Serve immediately

title: cream fresh cauliflower soup
steps:
1. Saute onion in butter until tender
2. Break cauliflower into florets
3. Combine onion , cauliflower , chicken broth and bouillon
4. Simmer about 10-15 minutes
5. Return puree to pan and add milk , cheese and curry powder
6. Combine cornstarch and water
7. Stir into hot soup and heat slowly until slightly thick
8. Serve with seasoned croutons

title: forgotten cookies diabetic
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Beat egg whites until foamy
3. Gradually add sugar substitute and continue beating until they hold stiff peaks
4. Add salt and vanilla
5. Stir well
6. Stir in pecans and chocolate chips
7. Cover cookie sheet with foil and spray with a non stick spray
8. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto the foil
9. Put in oven then turn the oven off
10. Leave overnight in oven with door closed

title: corned beef and cabbage dinner for the slow cooker
steps:
1. Place potatoes , carrots and onion in 5 to 6-1 / 2 quart slow cooker
2. Top with corned beef brisket
3. Sprinkle with contents of seasoning packet
4. Add apple juice and enough water to just cover brisket
5. Cover
6. Cook on low setting 10 to 12 hours
7. About 40 minutes before serving , remove beef from slow cooker
8. Place on serving platter and cover to keep warm
9. Add cabbage wedges to vegetables and broth in slow cooker
10. Increase heat setting to high
11. Cover and cook 30 to 35 minutes longer or until cabbage is crisp-tender
12. Meanwhile , in small bowl , combine all horseradish sauce ingredients
13. Mix well
14. To serve , cut corned beef across grain into thin slices
15. With slotted spoon , remove vegetables from slow cooker
16. Serve corned beef and vegetables with sauce

title: pasta with caramelized onion trio  arugula  with mozzarella
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a skillet
2. Over medium heat cook the onions and leeks for 5 minutes , stirring frequently
3. Reduce heat to low and cover , cooking about 20 minutes or until the onions and leeks are golden brown , stirring frequently
4. Prepare pasta according to package directions
5. Bring the broth to boil in a saucepan add the vinegar
6. Add the onions , cream and salt to the broth and cook 2 minutes
7. Remove from the heat , stir in all ingredients
8. Then toss with the pasta
9. Serving size is 1 1 / 4 cups

title: mom s old fashion brisket and vegetables
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Place the brisket in a heavy roasting pan
3. In a small bowl , combine the salt , pepper , garlic , and oregano
4. Rub the mixture on the brisket
5. Pile the carrots , celery , onions , potatoes and bay leaves on the brisket and pour in enough tomato juice to come about 3 / 4 of the way up the meat and vegetables
6. Cover the top of the pan with 2 sheets of parchment paper , then with aluminum foil
7. Bake for 3 1 / 2 hours , or until the meat is tender
8. Remove the meat from the pan and keep it warm
9. Place the pan on 2 burners and boil the vegetables and sauce over medium heat for another 30 minutes , or until the sauce is thickened
10. To serve , remove bay leaves , slice the meat across the grain
11. Serve with the vegetables poured over top of the meat

title: jalapeno cheese bread for bread machine
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in bread pan in order according to your bread machine
2. Select light crust setting and press start
3. After baking cycle ends , remove bread from pan , place on cooling rack , and allow to cool 1 hour before slicing if you can control yourself !

title: leek puddings
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Over medium-low heat , saut the leeks and the onion in melted butter a medium skillet until onions are transparent but not browned , which will take about 10 minutes
3. Let cool
4. In a medium bowl whisk together the beaten eggs , cream , crushed garlic , salt , white pepper , and lemon juice
5. Add the cooled leek / onion mixture and mix well
6. Spray six 4-ounce ramekins with cooking spray and pour / divide the pudding mixture equally into all the ramekins
7. Bake the puddings at 350 degrees f for 15 to 20 minutes or until they have set and are lightly browned
8. Let stand for 4 minutes before serving
9. To serve , carefully unmold the puddings by inserting a small paring knife at the edge and circling around the ramekin wall , then invert onto warmed plates
10. Garnish with sliced leek sprigs
11. Makes six puddings

title: low cal mayonnaise
steps:
1. Soften gelatin in 1 / 4 cup cold milk
2. Add 1 / 2 cup hot milk and stir until gelatin is dissolved
3. Beat egg yolk lightly with vinegar , salt , mustard , and hot pepper sauce
4. Stir into milk mixture
5. Chill until mixture begins to thicken , then whip with a rotary beater
6. Store in refrigerator

title: pepper jack dipping sauce
steps:
1. Melt butter in a sauce pan
2. With a whisk , mix in flour and allow to cook for about 1 minute
3. Slowly whisk in milk
4. Cook for 1 minute
5. Add cheese , keep whisking until cheese melts
6. Serve with chips , veggies or whatever floats your boat

title: roasted beet borscht borsch
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees
2. Scrub the beets and put them on a large piece of aluminum foil
3. Season with salt and pepper , add 3 thyme sprigs , and drizzle with 3 tablespoons olive oil
4. Bake until the beets are tender , about 1 hour
5. Set aside
6. When the beets are cool enough to handle but still warm , slip off their skins , and chop them into large chunks
7. In a large heavy bottomed pot over medium heat , add the remaining 3 tablespoons olive oil
8. Put in the onion , carrots , garlic , and remaining 3 thyme sprigs and cook until softened and just starting to color , about 10 minutes
9. Add the chicken stock and simmer until the vegetables are tender , about 20 minutes
10. Remove the thyme sprigs
11. Put the chopped beets into a blender and add the cooked vegetables and most of the stock
12. Blend until smooth , add more stock if the puree is too thick
13. Add the vinegar and honey
14. Season with salt and pepper
15. Blend again to incorporate flavors
16. Borscht can be served hot or cold
17. To make the garnish , grate the apple on the large holes of a box grater and mix in the dill
18. Serve in bowls , garnished with a big dollop of sour cream and topped with the apple and dill mixture

title: quinoa couscous breakfast cereal
steps:
1. Boil juice and water
2. Rinse quinoa
3. Saute on med
4. Heat until they pop
5. Add quinoa dn fruit to boiling liquid
6. Simmer 12-15 minutes
7. Add cous cous remove from heat cover with lid and let sit for 5-7 minutes

title: blueberry risotto
steps:
1. Bring the stock to a boil
2. Meanwhile , melt the butter in another pan , add the onion and cook over low heat , stirring occasionally , for 5 minutes until softened
3. Add the rice and cook , stirring constantly , until the grains are coated in butter
4. Sprinkle in the wine and cook until it has evaporated
5. Set aside 2 tbsp of the blueberries and add the remained to the pan
6. Aadd a ladleful of the hot stock and cook , stirring , until it ahs been absorbed
7. Continue adding the stock , a ladleful at a time , and stirrung until each addition has been absorbed
8. This will take 18-20 minutes
9. When the rice is tender , stir in the cream and transfer to a warm serving dish
10. Garnish with the reserved blueberries and serve with parmesan

title: swedish sandwich from a summer place
steps:
1. Cook bacon until crisp , then place on paper towels
2. Add potatoes to pan
3. Saute until golden brown and crisp
4. Add tomatoes , dill pickle , and bacon strips and continue to cook , stirring carefully , just until heated through
5. Meanwhile , toast bread and butter as desired
6. Place toast slices on 4 plates
7. Top each with 1 / 4 of the potato mixture and keep warm
8. Fry the eggs in butter or cooking spray and place one egg on top of each sandwich
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste
10. Garnish plates with salad greens and serve warm

title: moms holiday punch
steps:
1. Mix first 3 ingredients first
2. Slowly add canada dry ginger ale
3. Chill until serving time

title: greek salad with mint
steps:
1. In a large bowl , whisk together olives , olive oil , vinegar , garlic and ground pepper
2. Let stand for 10 minutes
3. Add the remaining ingredients , and toss well

title: sukiyaki big bowls
steps:
1. Melt butter in 4 quart saucepan until sizzling
2. Add half of steak strips
3. Cook over medium-high heat , stirring occasionally , until lightly browned , about 3 to 4 minutes
4. Remove meat with slotted spoon
5. Set aside
6. Cook remaining steak strips
7. Return all meat to saucepan
8. Add all remaining ingredients except 1 / 4 cup water , cornstarch and rice
9. Cook , stirring occasionally , until mixture comes to a boil , about 4 to 5 minutes
10. Reduce heat to low
11. Cook until flavors are melded and mushrooms are tender , about 5-6 minutes
12. Increase heat to medium-high
13. Combine 1 / 4 cup water and cornstarch in small bowl
14. Stir into steak mixture
15. Continue cooking until mixture comes to a boil
16. Cook 1 minute
17. Remove from heat
18. Let stand to cool 15 minutes
19. Divide rice among 8 microwave-safe resealable plastic food bowls
20. Evenly divide steak and broth mixture over rice
21. Cover
22. Freeze until serving time
23. For 6 cups cooked rice , start with 2 cups uncooked rice

title: crunchy nut coleslaw
steps:
1. Put all the ingredients except walnut pieces in a blender and process until all ingredients are combined and vegetables are grated
2. A splash of milk can be added if the mixture is too dry and difficult to process
3. Mix in walnut pieces

title: cabbage apple cinnamon casserole  vegetarian too
steps:
1. Chop cabbage in pieces
2. Add to boiling water and cook for about 4 minutes
3. Drain
4. Spray casserole dish with canola oil spray or equivilent
5. Mix peeled apple slices and cinnamon together
6. Layer cabbage , apples , sugar and breadcrumbs in that order
7. Continue until finish layers
8. Make sure last layer breadcrumbs are on top
9. Melt butter and pour over top
10. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 180 degrees for about 50 minutes

title: nif s eggnog banana bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f grease a large loaf pan
2. Beat eggs in large bowl
3. Stir in sugar , oil , banana , eggnog , rum , and vanilla
4. In another bowl , combine the flour , pudding mix , baking powder , salt , and nutmeg
5. Stir into eggnog mixture , just until mixed
6. Pour batter into prepared loaf pan
7. Mix sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over batter
8. Bake bread for 40 to 60 minutes , or just until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
9. Let cool in pan for 10 minutes , then turn out onto a wire rack , and cool completely
10. Wrap tightly , and store in the refrigerator

title: earl grey hot chocolate
steps:
1. Boil some water , then place the tea bags in a microwaveable mug and add 1 cup of the boiling water
2. Let steep for 1 minute
3. Remove tea bags , add the melted chocolate , and whisk well
4. Heat in the microwave for 45 seconds , but don't allow the mixture to boil
5. Whisk again and serve immediately , topped with whipped cream

title: honey dinner rolls
steps:
1. Combine 2 cups flour and yeast in a large mixer bowl
2. Heat milk , honey , margarine and salt just until warm and margarine is almost melted , stirring constantly
3. Add to flour mixture
4. Add eggs
5. Beat at low speed of electric mixer for 30 seconds
6. Scrape sides of bowl constantly
7. Beat for 3 minutes at high speed
8. Stir in as much remaining flour as you can mix in with a spoon
9. Turn dough out onto lightly floured surface
10. Knead in enough remaining flour to make a moderately stiff dough that is smooth and elastic
11. Shape into a ball
12. Place dough in a greased bowl , then turn it once
13. Cover dough and let rise in a warm place till double
14. Punch dough down
15. Divide in half
16. Cover again
17. Let rest 10 minutes
18. Cut each dough half into 18 equal pieces
19. Roll into balls , and place in greased 2 1 / 2-inch muffin pans
20. Let rise until doubled
21. Bake in a 375f oven for 12 to 15 minutes
22. Remove from pan
23. Cool on a wire rack
24. Makes 36 rolls

title: grilled moroccan vegetable skewers
steps:
1. Soak 12" wooden skewers in water for at least 30 minutes
2. Combine parsley , oil , garlic , seasonings , and lemon juice in a bowl
3. Add vegetables and pineapple to the marinade
4. Let stand at least 10 minutes before skewering
5. Thread vegetables and pineapple onto soaked skewers
6. Preheat grill to medium-high
7. Spray grates with nonstick spray
8. Lightly coat both sides of vegetables with nonstick spray
9. If using a gas grill , turn off one side
10. On a charcoal grill , push the coals to one side
11. Lay the skewers on the grate with the vegetables over the hot side , handles over the cooler side
12. Grill , covered , until vegetables are cooked and lightly charred , about 3 minutes
13. Turn , baste with any remaining marinade , and grill 2-3 minutes more

title: easy avocado and tomato salad
steps:
1. Cut the tomatoes into large chunks , approximately 3 / 4" cubed
2. Cut the avocados in half and remove the pit
3. Cut the avocado flesh into chunks around the same size as the tomato chunks
4. This can either be done by removing the avocado from the skin and chopping it or it can be done by cutting the avocado while still in the skin and turning the skin inside out
5. Add olive oil , lime juice , and optional garlic , then salt and pepper to taste

title: cheese sambousek
steps:
1. First make the dough:
2. Combine the flour , salt , baking powder , and sugar in a food processor fitted with the metal blade and process for 5 seconds
3. Add the butter and pulse 10 times , or until the mixture is the consistency of fine meal
4. With the machine running , add the water in a steady stream , taking about 10 seconds to do so
5. Process for 1 minute
6. The dough will gather into a ball and form a mass that whirls around the blade
7. Feel the dough
8. It should be smooth , soft , elastic , and no longer sticky
9. If necessary , adjust the texture with droplets of water or small amounts of flour , processing a few seconds after each addition
10. If you want to add seeds to the dough , knead them in by hand on your work surface
11. Divide the dough into 24 pieces and shape into balls
12. Cover the balls of dough loosely with a kitchen towel and let stand for 30 minutes
13. Next , the filling:
14. Place the cheese , salt , cayenne , egg , and egg white in the work bowl of a food processor fitted with the metal blade and pulse very rapidly 20 to 30 times , until the mixture just begins to gather into a mass
15. Turn out onto a sheet of waxed paper or plastic wrap and pat into a 6 x 4inch rectangle
16. Cut the cheese mixture into 1-inch squares
17. Adjust two oven racks to divide the oven into thirds and preheat the oven to 350f
18. Line two 14 x 17inch baking sheets with silicone baking pan liners or cooking parchment
19. To shape the sambouseks , pat a ball of dough into a 4-inch circle on your unfloured work surface
20. Place a square of the cheese mixture slightly below the center of the circle and pat it into a semicircular shape , leaving a bottom border of dough a scant 1 / 2 inch wide
21. Fold the top half of the dough over the cheese and press the edges firmly to seal
22. Use a finger
23. Place the sambousek on the prepared sheet
24. Repeat with the remaining dough and cheese , placing 12 sambouseks about 2 inches apart on each sheet
25. Paint the sambouseks with the egg wash
26. Bake 30 minutes , or until golden brown
27. Rotate the pans top to bottom and front to back once during baking to ensure even browning
28. Use a wide metal spatula to transfer the sambouseks to wire cooling racks , and serve warm or at room temperature

title: cauliflower and brussels sprouts
steps:
1. Break the cauliflower into flowerets and cook , uncovered with the lemon juice in a small amount of boiling water for 5 minutes
2. Then , cover it , and continue cooking until just tender
3. Drain the vegetables
4. Arrange cauliflowerets , brussel sprouts , and tomato slices in a shallow casserole dish
5. Sprinkle with thyme , salt , and white pepper
6. Spoon the condensed soup on top and sprinkle with crumbs
7. Bake at 350 degrees until bubbly and heated through
8. Serves 6

title: no cook mints
steps:
1. Combine margarine , corn sryup , flavoring and salt in large bowl
2. Add sugar , mix well with hands until smooth
3. Tint with food coloring as desired
4. Store in cool palce

title: chili  family style
steps:
1. Heat the oil over medium heat in a large soup pot
2. Add the onions , bell pepper , chili powder , cumin and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt
3. Cook until onions and pepper are translucent
4. Stir in the garlic and cook for 15 seconds
5. Add the beef and increase the heat to medium-high
6. Cook until no longer pink , for about 10 minutes , breaking up the meat with a spoon
7. Stir in the beans , diced tomatoes and their juice , crushed tomatoes , beef broth and another 1 / 2 teaspoon salt
8. Bring to a boil , reduce to simmer , cover and cook for 45 minutes
9. Remove the lid and continue to simmer at least another 45 minutes , or longer to develop flavor
10. Serve , allowing each person to season their bowl to their liking with salt , pepper , hot sauce , sour cream , grated cheese , and / or chopped onions

title: blackberry basil vinaigrette
steps:
1. Pulse first 6 ingredients in a blender or food processor 2 or 3 times until blended
2. With blender running , pour vegetable oil through food chute in a slow , steady stream
3. Process until smooth
4. Makes 1 cup

title: chicken romano meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Line 13x9-inch metal baking pan with foil
3. Spray foil with nonstick cooking spray
4. In large bowl , stir romano , bread crumbs , egg , 1 / 2 cup marinara sauce , and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt
5. Add chicken and mix just until combined
6. Spoon chicken mixture into center of prepared pan
7. Shape into 9x5-inch loaf , pressing firmly
8. Spread remaining 1 / 2 cup marinara over top
9. Bake meatloaf 1 hour and 5 to 10 minutes or until temperature on instant-read thermometer inserted in center of meatloaf reaches 165 f
10. Let meatloaf stand 10 minutes for easier slicing

title: sunday s best rice pudding  traditional style
steps:
1. First , make your pot of rice
2. Boil 3 cups of water on high and add 1 tablespoon of butter to the water
3. Add the rice , and cover with a tight lid
4. Put the heat to low , leave covered and let cook for 15 minutes until done
5. When the rice is cooked , pour into a larger saucepan
6. Then add 1-1 / 2 cups milk , sugar and salt
7. Put heat at medium low to keep from burning on the bottom of the pan
8. Stir occasionally until thick and creamy for about 15 minutes
9. In a 1-cup measuring cup , blend the remaining 1 / 2 cup of milk with the egg
10. Stir into the rice mixture , and mix well
11. Then add the raisins
12. Cook for 2 more minutes , stirring constantly
13. Take the pot off the heat , and add the vanilla , nutmeg and cinnamon
14. Mix well
15. You can serve the pudding warm , or let cool in the refrigerator
16. Sprinkle with cinnamon before serving
17. Enjoy !

title: scrambled eggs soft crust pizza
steps:
1. Cook bacon until crisp
2. Drain and crumble
3. Set aside
4. Heat oven to 400
5. Unroll breadstick dough and separate
6. Starting in center of ungreased pizza pan , shape 1 breadstick into a coil
7. Add breadsticks to form a round pizza crust , pressing all seams together
8. Brush with topping that came with breadsticks
9. Bake 10-12 minutes until light golden brown
10. Meanwhile , beat eggs milk , salt and pepper until blended
11. Cook in same skillet used for bacon , stirring occasionally , until set but still moist
12. Stir in half of cheese
13. Remove from heat
14. Remove crust from oven
15. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 c of the cheese
16. Top with eggs
17. Sprinkle with bacon , remaining cheese and tomatoes
18. Bake 5-7 minutes until heated through and cheese is melted

title: schnitzel
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large dutch oven over medium-high heat
2. Add mushrooms , bell pepper , onion , carrot and garlic
3. Saute 10 minutes
4. Add tomatoes , cover reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes or untl vegetables are tender combine flour , paprika , and water in a small bowl
5. Stir into tomato mixture
6. Cook 3 minutes or until slightly thick
7. Keep warm
8. Trim fat from pork
9. Cut pork crosswise into 16 pieces
10. Place each piece between 2 sheets of heavy-duty plastic wrap , and flatten each piece to 1 / 4 inch thickness using a meat mallet or rolling pin
11. Sprinkle both sides of pork with black pepper and salt
12. Place in a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium-high heat until hot
13. Add pork , cook 4 minutes on each side or until done
14. Serve vegetable mixture over noodles
15. Top with pork slices
16. Garnish with parsley , if desired

title: laouli s bean dip
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Spread the softened cream cheese in a shallow 8 inch by 8 inch baking dish
3. I often use reduced fat cream cheese
4. Spread the refried beans in a smooth layer on top of the cream cheese
5. Pour the salsa on top of the refried beans and spread evenly
6. Sprinkle the shredded cheese on top of the salsa in an even layer
7. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for approximately 25 to 35 minutes or until the cheese is bubbly
8. Serve and enjoy !

title: jazzed up creole shrimp salad
steps:
1. Place all the remoulade sauce ingredients in a bowl and mix to combine well
2. Taste and adjust seasoning to your likings
3. Add the shrimp and stir to coat
4. Chill for 2 hour for flavors to meld
5. Plate over greens , stuff into half an avocado , or into a baguette
6. Enjoy !
7. Fyi: if you don`t enjoy a chunky salad like sauce by all means blend it for a smooth dressing

title: pork roast provencale
steps:
1. Cut tiny slits in the roast and push in some garlic
2. Place roast in small oven cooking bag
3. Combine chicken broth , all the lemon juice , oil , onion , bay leaves , thyme , and pepper
4. Pour over roast
5. Put tie around bag , refrigerate overnight , and turn occasionally
6. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
7. Remove bag from refrigerator , put into pan , and roast for 20 minutes per pound , or until a meat thermometer reads 145 degrees
8. Remove roast from bag-cover with foil and let rest
9. Skim and discard fat from juices in roasting pan
10. Remove both bay leaves
11. Put liquid into 3 quart saucepan and heat up over medium setting
12. Put cornstarch and cold water into small jar , put lid on , and shake it up
13. Add cornstarch mixture to liquid in saucepan
14. Bring to a boil and boil for 2 minutes , stirring constantly
15. Season with salt to your taste

title: pepperoni breadtwists
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Mix baking mix , cold water and pepperoni until dough forms
3. Beat 20 strokes
4. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and knead 5 times
5. Roll dough into a 10 inch square and cut in half
6. Cut each half crosswise into 14 strips
7. Twist ends of strips in opposite directions until pieces are twirled
8. Place on ungreased cookie sheet , pressing ends to sheet to fasten securely
9. Brush with melted butter and sprinkle with cheese
10. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until light golden brown
11. Heat pizza sauce and serve with breadtwists for dipping

title: killer brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix cake mix , butter , and half of the evaporated milk together
3. Press one-half to two-thirds of the cake mixture into a greased 9x13 pan
4. Bake for 18 - 20 minutes
5. While the cake is baking , unwrap the caramels and melt them over med-low heat with the remaining evaporated milk
6. When the cake is finished , take out of the oven and sprinkle the chocolate chips over the top
7. Pour the melted caramel over the chocolate chips
8. Take the remaining cake mix and dot the top of the brownies
9. Bake for an additional 13 minutes

title: roasted root vegetable hash
steps:
1. In a large , non-stick saute pan , cook the bacon over low heat
2. When crisp , remove from the fire and drain on paper towels
3. With the bacon drippings still in the pan saute the onion and garlic until soft
4. Add all of the vegetables and cook slowly until the vegetables are soft
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Right before serving , add the parsley and cooked bacon

title: scallop escabache with cucumber and sesame
steps:
1. Remove the scallops from their shells and reserve shells for serving
2. Place the scallops in a ceramic or glass bowl and pour over the lime juice and cover
3. Refrigerate for 2 hours
4. Place a small amount of the ginger and cucumber into the cleaned shells and top with a scallop
5. Drizzle 1 / 2 tsp of mirin over each scallop , followed by a couple of drops of sesame oil and lightly sprinkle with sesame seeds
6. Serve immediately

title: deep fried rosettes
steps:
1. First heat oil to cook the rosettes in and get your rosettes iron nice and hot
2. I heat my oil to 350
3. Mix all ingredients with a whisk and dip your rosettes iron in batter and dip in heated oil
4. Take off iron , i use a knife to help slide it off and then put them on foil and sprinkle with powdered sugar and place in boxes

title: poached eggs with mushrooms and tomatoes
steps:
1. Fill a large , deep skillet with 3 inches of water
2. Add the vinegar and bring to a bare simmer
3. Meanwhile , heat 1 teaspoon of the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
4. Season the tomatoes with teaspoon each salt and pepper and cook until just tender , 1 to 2 minutes per side
5. Transfer to a plate
6. Add the remaining tablespoon of oil to the skillet and heat over medium-high heat
