7. Add the mushrooms , thyme , teaspoon salt , and teaspoon pepper and cook , tossing occasionally , until golden brown and tender , 6 to 7 minutes
8. Meanwhile , poach the eggs in 2 batches: crack each of 4 eggs into separate custard cups , then , one at a time , slide gently into the water in the deep skillet
9. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes for slightly runny yolks and remove with a slotted spoon
10. Repeat with the remaining 4 eggs
11. Top the bread with the tomatoes , mushrooms , eggs , and parmesan
12. Season with teaspoon each salt and pepper and sprinkle with the chives

title: easy chili soup
steps:
1. Put everything but the cheese and sour cream in a pot and simmer for about 15 minutes
2. Add sour cream and grated cheese to soup in individual bowls

title: the best hot fudge sauce
steps:
1. Put first four ingredients into a pan and cook to soft ball stage 238 degrees
2. Remove from heat and add cream , vanilla
3. Serve hot on ice cream , pies , cakes , or whatever your imagination comes up with
4. Enjoy my friends
5. Store in refrigerator , jar and give as gifts !

title: spicy beans on baked sweet potato
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 210 degrees
2. Rinse the sweet potatoes , then pierce with a small sharp knife
3. Place them on a baking
4. Tray and bake for 1-1 hours , or until soft
5. Heat the oil in a large saucepan and cook the onion over a medium heat for about 5 minutes , stirring occasionally , until very soft and golden
6. Add garlic and spices , and cook , stirring , for 1 minute
7. Add the tomato and stock , stir well , then add the vegetables and beans
8. Bring to the boil , then reduce the heat and simmer , partially covered , for 20 minutes
9. Uncover , increase the heat slightly , and cook
10. For a further 10-15 minutes , or until the liquid had reduced and thickened
11. Stir in the coriander leaves just before serving
12. To serve , cut the sweet potatoes in half lengthways
13. Spoon the vegetable mixture over the top
14. Add a dollop of light sour cream and sprinkle with grated cheddar cheese

title: praline brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven 350 degrees
2. Grease the bottom only of a 13x9 inch baking pan
3. Place brownie mix into a large bowl
4. Stir in eggs , oil and water
5. Mix until well combined
6. Spread evenly over bottom of baking pan
7. In a separate bowl , mix together praline topping ingredients until crumbly
8. Sprinkle evenly over the top
9. A small corner may be left uncovered with the topping as a spot to test for doneness
10. Bake 28 - 30 minutes
11. Do not overbake
12. Check corner with a pick for doneness
13. It should come out clean with no crumbs attached
14. Cut into squares
15. Freezable

title: turkey  sopa
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Lightly oil or spray a casserole dish with non-stick cooking spray , set aside
3. In a heavy skillet , warm the oil and saut onion until limp , 2 to 3 minutes
4. Stir in turkey and warm slightly
5. Add the tomatoes and green chilies , bring to boiling , remove from heat and stir in sour cream or yogurt
6. Mix well
7. Place about 1 / 2 cup turkey mixture in the bottom of prepared casserole , top with half the cut tortillas , overlapping slightly
8. Divide the remaining sauce and pour over tortillas , top with 1 / 2 cup shredded cheese
9. Make another layer with cut tortillas , top with remaining turkey mixture and sprinkle with remaining cheese
10. Bake for 40 to 50 minutes

title: basted eggs
steps:
1. Heat butter until melted
2. Add eggs
3. Fry until white is starting to set
4. Salt and pepper to taste
5. Add water and cover immediately
6. Some people add less water but i like a little more
7. The steam will cook the top of eggs
8. It takes just a minute or so , depending on how well done you like your eggs
9. Hard will be just like hard boiled eggs , that yellow color
10. I serve these with toast and fried potatoes , just like over easy eggs

title: south beach style savory squash saute
steps:
1. Fry turkey bacon over medium-high heat in pan until crisp
2. Depending on the brand of turkey bacon you use you may need to coat the pan slightly with cooking spray
3. Remove bacon from pan and let drain on paper towels if oily , then crumble when cooled
4. In the same pan , over medium-high heat add olive oil and then onions
5. Saut onions until they start to become translucent
6. Add garlic , and yellow squash
7. Season with salt and pepper
8. Saut for 1-2 minutes until squash is still crisp-tender
9. Add white wine and bring mixture to a boil
10. Reduce heat to medium-low , add splenda and greek seasoning and stir to combine
11. Let simmer for 10 minutes or until your desired tenderness for squash
12. Just before serving , stir in crumbled bacon and serve

title: mama s mojito chicken
steps:
1. Combine all marinade ingredients together in a blender
2. Blend until smooth
3. Pour into a zipper seal bag
4. Add chicken breasts and allow to marinade in refrigerator for 2-4 hours
5. Discard marinade after that time
6. At this point the chicken may either be roasted in the oven at 425 f or cooked on a grill
7. Cook just until meat is no longer pink in middle , about 20 minutes
8. Turn once during cooking
9. Amount of hot pepper can be increased or omitted if you prefer

title: basic tahini sauce
steps:
1. Crush the garlic in a mortar and pestle
2. Add little bit of each the tahini , lemon juice and water alternating as you go , and stir to blend well , until it's all mixed inches
3. It should resemble a slightly thick sauce that can be poured but not over thin to be runny
4. Season with salt to taste
5. Use with any vegetable you like
6. It's traditionally used over fried cauliflower , or zucchini
7. Some like dipping flat bread in it , and others i've seen use it as a base for another recipe , such as hummus
8. If desired , you can add more lemon if you like it tart , or more garlic if you really like garlic as i do
9. Most families have their own mix , so it's up to you

title: honeydew compote with lime  ginger   a hint of serrano
steps:
1. Combine lime zest and juice , water , sugar , ginger and serrano in a small saucepan
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat to low and simmer until sugar is dissolved , about 5 minutes
4. Let cool to room temperature , about 25 minutes
5. Strain syrup into a large bowl , pressing on solids to extract maximum flavor
6. Add melon and toss to coat
7. Cover for at least 1 hour
8. Sprinkle with mint and garnish with fig slices
9. Makes 6 servings , 1 cup each

title: strawberry margarita popsicles
steps:
1. Set aside about 1 / 4 cup chopped strawberries
2. Combine the rest of the ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth
3. I suggest adding 1 / 2 cup sugar to start and then adding more sugar if you want more sweetness
4. Next pour the mix into popsicle molds
5. Skewer strawberry pieces on popsicle sticks and put into molds
6. Freeze for 4 hours or until solid

title: white chip orange cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine flour , baking soda and salt in small bowl
3. Beat butter , granulated sugar and brown sugar in large mixer bowl until creamy
4. Beat in egg and orange peel
5. Gradually beat in flour mixture
6. Stir in morsels
7. Drop by rounded tablespoon onto ungreased baking sheets
8. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until edges are light golden brown
9. Cool on baking sheets for 2 minutes
10. Remove to wire racks to cool completely

title: super tamale pie
steps:
1. Brown the ground beef
2. Drain
3. Add the onion and garlic , cover , and cook on medium heat for about 10 minutes
4. Add the cumin , coriander , oregano , enough water to prevent sticking , and the carrots , cover , and cook for 5 minutes
5. Add the bell peppers , cover , and cook for another 5 minutes
6. Stir in the tomatoes , salsa , beans and olives , cover , and simmer for 5 to 10 minutes
7. Remove from the heat
8. Stir in 1 / 2 box of the jiffy cornbread mix
9. Add salt and black pepper to taste
10. Preheat the oven to 400
11. Spray a 9x13 pan with cooking oil
12. Spread the mixture in the bottom of the dish
13. Sprinkle the cheese evenly on top
14. Set aside
15. In a separate bowl , mix together the eggs , milk and 1 1 / 2 box of the jiffy corbread mix
16. Pour the batter directly on top of the mixture , pressing it down a little with a spatula
17. Bake for 20 minutes , until the top is golden and a knife inserted into the topping comes out clean
18. Garnish with minced scallions , chopped cilantro and sour cream

title: chimichurri muy perfecto
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a food processor , and process until the parsley is finely minced
2. Alternatively , place all ingredients in a mortar and pestle , and grind until a paste forms

title: quick fresh sauerkraut
steps:
1. Heat oil in pan over medium-high heat and cook onion , stirring constantly , until it begins to soften and turn translucent
2. Add cabbage , cider , vinegar , water , salt and caraway seeds and bring to a boil
3. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer for approximately 30 to 45 minutes , until the cabbage is tender
4. Add a little water if it gets too dry
5. This can be kept in the fridge for 2 weeks

title: peach   banana smoothie
steps: 1. Place ingredients in a blender and blend together until smooth

title: asian  dipping sauce
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a small bowl and stir to combine
2. Refrigerate until needed

title: easy bisquick   buttermilk chicken pot pie
steps:
1. Position a rack in the center of the oven , and preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
3. Season the chicken as you see fit , and add it to the skillet
4. Cook , stirring quite often , just until it turns opaque and loses its raw look , about 8 minutes
5. Transfer the chicken to a plate
6. Add the butter to the skillet , and reduce the heat to medium
7. Add the onion and celery and cook , stirring often , until the vegetables soften , about 3 minutes
8. Sprinkle the flour over the mixed vegetables and mix well
9. Add the broth and half-and-half , and bring to a boil , stirring up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan with a wooden spoon
10. Cook until the sauce is slightly thickened , about 5 minutes
11. Stir in the reserved chicken , thawed mixed vegetables , and parsley
12. Season with salt and pepper as desired
13. Pour into an ungreased 2 1 / 2 to 3 quart round casserole , or , if you don't have one , pour into whatever casseroles you have
14. Mix the bisquick and buttermilk to make a soft , slightly sticky dough
15. Drop six large spoonfuls of the dough over the chicken mixture
16. Pop the casserole in the oven , and bake for 25 to 35 minutes , until biscuits are golden brown
17. You're done !

title: yogurt icing
steps: 1. In a food processor or mixer blend all ingredients together to smooth

title: bubbly pear cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a small bowl sift flour , baking soda and salt
3. Set aside
4. In mixer , cream butter and sugar until well mixed and airy
5. Add eggs , one at a time , making sure each one is full incorporated before adding next
6. Slowly add in flour mixture - i do it 1 / 3 at a time - making sure it is fully incorporated
7. Stir in vanilla and champagne
8. Stir in pears
9. Line a cupcake tin with cupcake liners
10. Scoop an even amount of dough into each cup - i filled them to the top
11. You should have enough for about 24 cupcakes
12. Bake for about 16 minutes
13. I started checking around 12 just to be safe
14. You want them to be golden in color
15. While cupcakes are baking , make frosting
16. Mix cream cheese and butter together
17. Add powdered sugar and whip until smooth
18. You can add more powdered sugar if desired
19. Remove cupcakes from oven and cool in tins for 2 minutes
20. Transfer to cooling rack
21. When cupcakes are completely cooled , top with frosting
22. Decorate if you have anything

title: diced potatoes with spinach
steps:
1. Bring 2 1 / 2 qts water to a boil
2. Peel potatoes and cut into 3 / 4 inch cubes , then add to boiling water with 1 t salt
3. Bring to a boil again
4. Cover , turn heat to low and cook potatoes till just tender , about 6 minutes
5. Do not overcook
6. Drain , spread out and leave to cool
7. If using fresh spinach , wash and drop into large kettle of boiling water to wilt
8. Drain and squeeze out as much liquid as you can and chop fine
9. Set spinach aside
10. Heat oil in a heavy , 12-inch , preferably nonstick skillet over medium high heat
11. When very hot , put in mustard seeds
12. As soon as the seeds begin to pop , add the onion and garlic
13. Turn heat to medium and fry for 3-4 minutes
14. Onions should turn very lightly brown on the edges
15. Put chopped spinach in skillet and keep stirring and frying for about 10 minutes
16. Add the cooked potatoes , garam masala and cayenne pepper and chickpeas
17. Stir and mix gently till potatoes are heated through

title: chocolate crunch squares
steps:
1. Spray bottom and sides of 8-inch square pan with cooking spray
2. Place butter and marshmallows in large microwavable bowl
3. Microwave on high 45 seconds
4. Stir with rubber scraper
5. Microwave additional 30 seconds or until marshmallows are melted
6. Measure 1 / 2 cup peanut butter
7. Remove 2 tablespoons peanut butter and set aside
8. Stir remaining peanut butter into marshmallow mixture
9. Immediately add cereal
10. Stir until well-coated
11. With wet hands , press cereal into pan
12. Place chocolate squares in small microwavable bowl with remaining peanut butter
13. Microwave on high 30 to 45 seconds , or until chocolate is completely melted and mixture is smooth when stirred
14. Pour chocolate mixture over cereal treats , spread with rubber scraper to cover
15. Refrogerate 15 minutes until frosting is set
16. Cut into 16 squares

title: linda s tip roast
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In a 9x13" pan , put 3 t
3. Garlic along with some of the juice from the jar , on the bottom of the pan
4. Place your roast into the pan
5. Cover with other 3 t
6. Of garlic all over the top and sides
7. Cut up the onion into thin slices , and put all over roast
8. I use tooth picks to hold them onto the sides of the roast
9. Completely
10. Cover roast with onion slices
11. Add salt and pepper
12. Put into oven , and bake for 60-90 mins
13. , depending on how you like it done
14. Check the middle of the roast in 1 hours for rare
15. Keep in mind the roast will continue to cook for awhile , once you remove it from the oven to rest
16. Remove the roast onto a serving platter , and cover with aluminum foil , for about 15 minutes
17. In the meantime:
18. If you want to make gravy , the garlic and onion pieces can be left in the pan
19. Deglaze the pan on top of the stove , then remove to a pot , and add water
20. I usually add about 2-3 cup depending on the size of the roast
21. I combine 1 cup water and 1 / 2 cup cornstarch into a bowl , and mix well , then pour into pan juices just before it starts to boil
22. I have also added mushrooms into the pan juices before i add the cornstarch and water , for mushroom gravy
23. I add all the juice that runs out of the roast while it is sitting , back into the gravy , and stir
24. Mix , stirring until it boils for a few mins
25. , and thickens
26. If it is too thick , add water a little at a time , until desired thickness
27. If too thin , add more water and cornstarch mix , and bring to a boil
28. Add salt and pepper , to taste
29. You can leave the onions and garlic in the gravy , or strain before putting into a gravy boat
30. When the gravy is done , depending on the color , i sometimes add gravy master , and mix in for a deeper color

title: black bean spread   dip with lime and cilantro
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in food processor and process until smooth
2. Serve with tortilla chips or anything else you can think of !

title: porterhouse steak with sauce rouille
steps:
1. Trim the fat from the edges of the steak , leaving a layer 1 / 4 inch thick , then slash the layer of fat at 1-inch intervals
2. In a small bowl , using the back of a spoon , mash together the garlic , anchovy paste , olive oil , and pepper until smooth
3. Rub into both sides of the steak
4. Cover and let stand at room temperature for 1 hour
5. When steak is close to be being done standing , make the sauce: in a saucepan over medium-low heat , combine the potato and chicken broth
6. Bring to a simmer and cook , uncovered , until barely tender , about 10 minutes
7. Add the bell pepper and cook until heated through , about 3 minutes more
8. Drain , reserving the broth
9. You should have 2 to 3 tbs
10. In a food processor , with the motor running , drop the garlic cloves through the feed tube and process until chopped
11. Add the cherry peppers , pimiento pepper , potato and bell pepper , thyme , vinegar , and hot pepper sauce
12. Proces until smooth
13. With the motor running , slowly add the olive oil , 1 tb at a time , and process until the mixture thickens
14. Transfer to a bowl and whisk in the reserved chicken broth
15. Season with salt and pepper
16. Cover and refrigerate until serving
17. Prepare a hot fire in a grill
18. Position the grill rack 4 to 6 inches above the fire
19. Place the steak on the rack and sear , turning once , until nicely browned , about 1 minute on each side
20. Using long handled tongs to hold the meat , sear the edges
21. Then grill over a medium-hot fire , turning once , 16-20 minutes total for medium rare , or until done to your liking
22. Transfer to a cutting board and cover loosely with aluminum foil
23. Let rest for 5 minutes
24. Cut meat from the bone , then slice the meat across the grain and serve on a warmed platter
25. Pass the sauce at the table

title: amish yum a seta
steps:
1. Brown ground beef with salt , pepper , brown sugar and onion
2. Add tomato soup
3. Cook egg noodles according to package directions
4. Drain
5. Add cream of chicken soup
6. Layer ground beef mixture and noodle mixture in a 13x9-inch casserole with processed cheese between layers
7. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes

title: zucchini  black bean  and rice skillet
steps:
1. Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat
2. Add zucchini and bell pepper
3. Cook 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Add beans , undrained tomatoes and water
5. Increase heat and bring to a boil
6. Add rice
7. Stir well
8. Cover
9. Remove from heat and let stand 7 minutes or until liquid is absorbed
10. Sprinkle with cheese

title: lasagne with five cheese
steps:
1. Make the bechamel sauce--melt the butter in a medium saucepan
2. Add flour , stir over low heat until smooth and golden , about 3 minutes
3. Stir in milk
4. Whisk over medium heat until smooth , about 5 minutes
5. Add chicken broth
6. Cook , whisking , until mixture boils and is thick and smooth , about 10 minutes
7. Add 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , or to taste , and 1 / 8 teaspoon nutmeg
8. Let stand , off heat , until ready to use
9. Cook lasagna noodles in plenty of boiling salted water until al dente , or firm to the bite , about 12 minutes
10. Drain
11. Let noodles sit in a bowl of cool water until ready to use
12. Heat oven to 350
13. Spoon about 1 / 2 cup bechamel sauce into the bottom of a 13 x 9 inch pan
14. Lift the noodles from the water individually and blot dry on paper towels
15. Arrange a slightly overlapping layer of 4 noodles on the bottom of the dish
16. In a bowl , stir the ricotta , parsley , 2 tablespoons of the parmesan cheese , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , the black pepper , and 1 / 8 teaspoon of the remaining nutmeg until blended
17. Spread in a layer over the noodles
18. Arrange 4 more noodles in an overlapping layer over the ricotta
19. Sprinkle with the crumbled gorgonzola and the shredded mozzarella
20. Top with remaining 4 lasagna noodles arranged in a slightly overlapping single layer
21. Arrange a single layer of smoked mozzarella slices over the noodles
22. Sprinkle with the shredded fontina cheese
23. Pour the remaining bechamel sauce over the top
24. Sprinkle with the remaining 3 tablespoons of parmesan
25. Bake until the top is browned and bubbly , about 50 minutes
26. Let stand at least 15 minutes before serving

title: soft sourdough bread
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together and knead dough for about five minutes
2. If dough is too sticky , add slightly more flour but dough should be soft and not dry and stiff
3. Place in oiled bowl and allow dough to rise for 3-4 hours or until nearly doubled in size
4. Divide dough into two pieces and shape into loaves and place in two greased bread pans or proving baskets
5. If a free form loaf is desired , place on greased baking sheet
6. Spray with oil and cover with plastic wrap to keep from drying out
7. Allow to rise for 2-3 hours
8. About 30min before the bread is ready pre heat your oven to 450f / 250c
9. When dough has risen , slash the top of the loaf
10. Place in pre heated oven at the high temp for 10min then reduce temp to 375f / 190c for a further 20 minute

title: asian fish and vegetable wrap
steps:
1. In a small bowl , add the oyster sauce , marmalade , soy sauce , orange zest , ginger , and cornstarch
2. Stir to combine
3. In a large non-stick skillet , heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat
4. Add the garlic
5. Saut for 30 seconds
6. Add in the bell pepper , cabbage , and water chestnuts
7. Cook , stirring occasionally for 2-3 minutes or until the cabbage wilts
8. Add in the oyster sauce mixture and stir to combine
9. Continue cooking until the sauce begins to boil
10. Remove from heat
11. Transfer the vegetable mixture to a large bowl
12. Clean out the skillet and return to the stove
13. Add in the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil over medium-high heat
14. Sprinkle the salmon evenly with the five spice powder , 1 teaspoon kosher salt , and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper
15. Add the salmon to the skillet and cook , stirring frequently , for 3 minutes or so , until it is firm and cooked through
16. Add the vegetables and rice to the salmon
17. Stir gently
18. Fold in the chow mein noodles
19. Season with additional salt and pepper if desired
20. Spoon mixture onto each tortilla
21. Roll-up / wrap burrito style
22. Serve immediately

title: lemon cake roll
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , beat eggs and sugar until thick and smooth
2. Add water
3. Combine flour , baking powder and salt
4. Stir into egg mixture just until moistened
5. Line a greased 15x10 inch baking pan with waxed paper
6. Grease the paper
7. Spread batter evenly in pan
8. Bake at 375 for 12-14 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched in center
9. Cool cake in pan on a wire rack for 5 minutes
10. Turn cake out onto a kitchen towel
11. Gently peel off the waxed paper
12. Beginning with short side , roll up cake , jelly roll style
13. Cool completely on a wire rack
14. For filling , in a saucepan , combine sugar , flour , egg , water and lemon juice
15. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil
16. Cook and stir 1 minute longer until thickened
17. Remove from the heat
18. Cool to room temperature
19. Unroll cake
20. Spread cooled filling to within 1 inch of edges
21. Roll up again
22. Cover and chill for 1-2 hours before serving
23. Sprinkle with powedered sugar before serving , if desired
24. Store in the refrigerator

title: spiced coconut coffee
steps:
1. Combine the ground coffee , red pepper , cloves , and cinnamon stick in a coffee filter set into a drip coffee brewer
2. Pour the water into the brewers water reservoir
3. Set the coffee brewer on to brew
4. While the coffee brews , gently warm the coconut milk in a small saucepan over medium-low heat
5. Stir in the honey until the honey is dissolved
6. Pour the brewed coffee into the mixture
7. Stir
8. Divide the liquid into two mugs to serve

title: chicken  almond and red grape salad
steps:
1. Combine chicken , grapes , celery , and almonds
2. Mix together mayonnaise and orange juice
3. Fold in chicken combo
4. Enjoy !

title: pennsylvania dutch sandwiches
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine everything but the bread and the butter
2. Chill overnight
3. Spread butter on one side of each bread slice
4. Top with cheese / ham mixture and another slice of buttered bread
5. Cut diagonally to serve

title: dawa
steps:
1. Place the lime slices , honey and sugar in a heavy-based rocks glass and crush lightly together with a spoon
2. Add some ice , and pour the vodka over it
3. Adjust the flavor by crushing the lime slices further , if desired

title: benji s jamaican curry chicken
steps:
1. Cut chicken into chunks
2. Peel potatoes , then dice
3. The smaller you dice the thicker the sauce will be in the end
4. Heat oil on medium heat in pot and add garlic until you can smell aroma , then add scotch bonnet pepper
5. Add chicken to pot , stir to brown slightly then add chicken boullion , stir until dissolved
6. Add remaining spices , mix until chicken is coated
7. Add water and potatoes , mix well
8. Cover pot and simmer until potatoes are tender
9. Remove cover and continue to simmer for another 20 minutes then remove from heat and let stand
10. The longer is stands the thicker the sauce gets
11. When you get the consistancy you want serve over rice !

title: milopitakia  greek apple filled cookies
steps:
1. Dough:
2. Sift the flour into a large mixing bowl
3. Cut in the diced butter with a pastry blender or two knives until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs
4. Lightly stir in the yogurt , mixing until the dough just begins to come together
5. Don't knead the dough , just gather all the crumbs and press them into a ball with your hands
6. Cover and chill for 30 minutes
7. Filling:
8. While dough is chilling , put the apples , lemon juice and superfine sugar in a small pan over low heat
9. Cook , stirring constantly , until all the liquid has evaporated
10. Remove from the heat and stir in all the remaining filling ingredients
11. Assembly:
12. Preheat the oven to 350 deg
13. F
14. Grease two large baking sheets with butter
15. Divide the dough into 30 pieces
16. Roll each piece into a ball , then press your thumb into the ball to form a large hollow
17. Spoon the filling mixture into the hollows and press dough around it to seal it inches
18. Very gently press the filled cookies down to flatten them out a bit , but not so much that your filling leaks out
19. Place the balls on the baking sheets , seam side down , and bake them for about 35 minutes , or until lightly golden
20. Remove cookies from oven
21. Sift confectioners sugar and cinnamon over warm cookies , then allow to cool
22. Cookies keep for about 3 days at room temperature , or they can be frozen for several months

title: crusty cheese and mustard damperettes
steps:
1. Pre heat oven to 450f / 220c / gas mark 6
2. Sift flour and mustard powder into a large bowl and rub in the butter
3. Stir in enough milk to mix to a soft , sticky dough
4. Turn dough onto a floured surface , knead until smooth
5. Press dough out to about 1
6. 5cm thickness
7. Cut into 7cm rounds
8. Place rounds onto greased baking trays , positioning them so that they are just touching
9. Make the topping by melting the butter in a small pan , then remove from heat and stir in remaining topping ingredients
10. Spread topping over the damperettes
11. Bake for about 15 minutes

title: real italian salad dressing little italy
steps:
1. In a small bowl mix all of the above until mixture is a creamy like consistancy
2. Pour over your salad or can be refriderated for later use
3. Just bring back to room temp before serving

title: roast apple pork
steps:
1. Preheat ove to 325 degrees
2. Combine ingredients for seasoning
3. Rub over roast
4. Cover and let stand 30 minutes
5. Bake fat side up uncovered for1 hour
6. Mix appesauce and brown sugar , spread over roast
7. Roast another hour
8. Let stand 15 minutes before slicing

title: devil s chocolate food cake
steps:
1. For the cake
2. Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit
3. Grease a 9 inch round baking dish , and dust it with flour
4. This is an excellent way to ensure that no part of the cake sticks to the dish when it is done
5. Beat the butter and sugar until creamy
6. Add one egg at a time to the creamy mixture and beat until fluffy
7. Sift the flour , cocoa , coffee and baking powder together
8. Mix the red food colouring and milk together
9. Combine all the mixtures in a large bowl and beat well till all the ingredients are well blended
10. Pour the batter into the prepared dish and bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour , or until a toothpick inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean
11. Remove the cake from the dish and allow it to cool
12. For the frosting
13. Mix the dark chocolate and the unsalted butter in a heat-proof bowl and stir over hot water till the chocolate dissolves into the butter
14. Remove from heat
15. Cool at room temperature
16. Stir occasionally while cooling
17. Once the cake has cooled sufficiently , spread the chocolate frosting over the cake and allow it to set

title: carrot apple salad
steps:
1. Peel and grate the carrots and apples
2. Place them in a salad bowl , then add the celery
3. Mix the yogurt , honey and lemon juice
4. Add salt , pepper , parsley and mix with the rest of the salad
5. Refrigerate for at least and hour , and serve

title: curried ground beef and beans
steps:
1. Brown the ground beef in a 2 1 / 2 to 3 quart pot
2. Drain fat
3. Stir in curry powder and heat for one minute
4. Add tomato soup and kidney beans
5. Simmer all for about 10 minutes stirring occasionally
6. Serve alone in a bowl like chili or over rice

title: tiki john s rum runner
steps:
1. Freeze in blender and serve in 12 oz glass
2. Enjoy !

title: bhindi gosht
steps:
1. Cut the chicken into 1 12 inch pieces
2. Put the onions , garlic , salt , chili powder , ground coriander , and meat in a heavy based pot
3. Cook for 20 to 25 minutes , or until the meat is half cook
4. Add tomatoes and ginger in the meat and cook for 5 minutes , stir all the time to mashed the tomatoes
5. Prepare bhuna gosht
6. Meanwhile wash okra under running water , dry with tea cloth or just spread in a tray for some time
7. Now cut okra by removing head and tail in to half inch slices
8. In a large pan heat oil over high heat , add onions and fry until change color and edges turn light brown
9. Remove onion from oil and keep aside
10. Fry okra in the same oil until it changes its color and edges start getting brown
11. Remove okra from oil and discard oil
12. Put okra , onions and green chilli into hot bhuna meat
13. Stir with care , cover the pan and cook for about 10 minutes over low heat

title: slow cooked beef short ribs with red wine sauce
steps:
1. Mix flour , salt & pepper
2. Coat ribs with the mixture
3. In a large skillet , heat olive oil over med-high heat and brown the short ribs on all sides
4. In a crock pot , combine onions , 1 cup of red wine , chili sauce , brown sugar , vinegar , worcestershire , dry mustard & chili powder
5. Add ribs to the mixture
6. Cover & cook on low for 6 hours
7. Remove ribs to a platter and keep warm
8. Turn crockpot to high and add remaining flour and red wine
9. Cook 10 minutes or until thoroughly combined and sauce has thickened
10. Pour sauce over ribs and serve immediately !

title: sequilhos de coco coconut and cornstarch cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 f
2. Sift together cornstarch and sugar
3. Add coconut , salt , egg and margarine
4. Mix with your finger
5. Roll dough into 2-inch cylinder
6. Cut into 1 inch slices to form cookies
7. Place cookies on greased cookie sheet
8. Use the tines of a fork to make grooves on the top of the cookies
9. Bake for 15 minutes
10. Let cool completely and keep in a tightly closed tin

title: ralph s pancakes
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients
2. Mix wet ingredients
3. Combine all and let stand 10 minutes
4. Pour on a preheated griddle and cook as for most pancakes
5. You can add your favorite fruit to the uncooked side of the pancake , such as blueberries then flip !

title: meatball taco soup   crockpot
steps:
1. Combine meatballs , onion , green pepper , garlic , beef broth , salsa or picante sauce , chili powder , and cumin in a 3-4 quart crockpot
2. Cover and cook on low for 5-7 hours
3. Add pasta and seasonings , stir well , cover , and cook on low an additional hour or until pasta is tender
4. Sprinkle with cheese , dollop with sour cream , sprinkle with cilantro , and serve

title: skillet  enchiladas
steps:
1. Brown ground beef together with onion and garlic
2. Drain grease
3. Mix in cream of mushroom soup , chiles , enchilada sauce and tortilla chips
4. Cook over medium heat until heated through , about 4 minutes
5. Sprinkle with cheese and cilantro
6. Cover and cook just until cheese is melted , about 2-3 minutes

title: moses  salad dressing
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients into the oil
2. Stir well
3. Refrigerate for 2 days before using
4. Shake well and pour liberally over salad

title: baked fudge
steps:
1. In mixing bowl , beat eggs on medium speed till lemon-colored , or 2 minutes
2. Combine next three ingredients and add to eggs
3. Combine well
4. Add butter , vanilla , and salt
5. Blend thoroughly
6. Fold in nuts
7. Pour into greased 8x8" baking dish
8. Put this dish into a larger dish filled half way with water
9. Bake at 325 for 45 minutes or until crust forms on top
10. You may serve it warm or chill overnight

title: gluten free pie crust
steps:
1. Stir dry ingredients together , making sure xanthan gum is evenly distributed
2. Cut in butter or oil and add honey
3. Add cold water a little at a time until a ball is formed
4. Roll dough to 1 / 8" thickness between two sheets of aluminum foil
5. Peel top sheet of foil off , and invert dough onto a 9" pie pan
6. Peel off other foil sheet
7. Prick dough with fork , and bake at 350 for 15 minutes until brown

title: orzo with tomato  green beans and feta cheese
steps:
1. Fill a large pot with salted water and bring to a boil for beans and orzo
2. Chop onion and mince garlic
3. Core and seed tomatoes
4. Cut into quarters lengthwise , and then into 1 / 4 inch thick slices
5. In a large skillet cook onion and garlic in oil over medium high heat until onion is softened
6. Add tomatoes and cook , stirring , until tomatoes are softened , about 2 minutes
7. Remove from heat
8. Have a bowl of ice and cold water ready
9. Drop beans into the boiling , salted water and blanch 1 minute
10. With a large slotted spoon or mesh colander , transfer beans to ice water to stop cooking
11. Drain beans well and pat dry
12. Add beans to tomato mixture and return the water in pot to a boil
13. Boil orzo until al dente and drain
14. Add orzo to the vegetable mixture and combine with vinegar , parsley , feta , and salt and pepper to taste
15. Toss to combine well

title: duchess soup
steps:
1. Cut veggies into chunks and saute in the 1 tablespoon of butter
2. In large soup pan , heat milk to a weak boil
3. Thicken with a roux made from 2 tablespoons butter and 2 tablespoons flour
4. Blend in cheese , stirring constantly
5. Add chicken broth and sauteed veggies
6. Simmer 20 minutes
7. Great served with french bread !

title: chocolate pecan pie bars
steps:
1. For crust: grease 15x10-inch baking pan
2. Preheat oven to 350f
3. In large bowl with mixer at medium speed , beat flour , cup sugar , butter and salt until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
4. Press firmly and evenly into pan
5. Bake for 20 minutes
6. For filling: stir corn syrup and chocolate in saucepan over low heat until chocolate melts
7. Remove from heat
8. Stir in sugar , eggs and vanilla until well-blended
9. Stir in pecans
10. Pour filling over hot crust
11. Spread evenly
12. Bake for 30 minutes , or until filling is firm around edges and slightly soft in center
13. Cool in pan

title: lemon yogurt cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Combine flour , baking soda , baking powder and salt
3. Set aside
4. In a large bowl , combine sugar , yogurt , eggs , oil , lemon peel and lemon juice
5. Stir until well blended
6. Add dry ingredients
7. Stir until dry ingredients are moistened
8. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls , 2 inches apart on baking sheet coated with non-stick spray
9. Bake for 9 to 12 minutes or until edges are slightly brown
10. Cool 1 minute
11. Remove from baking sheet to wire rack and cool completely

title: blueberry pancakes  low gi with oats
steps:
1. Put the blueberries in a sieve and rinse under cold water
2. Grate the zest from the orange into a small saucepan
3. Squeeze the juice and add the sugar
4. Bring to a boil and boil for 1 minute
5. Add blueberries , bring back to the boil and then turn down the heat
6. In a medium bowl blend together the water and corn flour and add to the blueberry mixture
7. Stir over medium heat until the syrup thickens and the blueberries release some juice and begin to soften
8. Remove from the heat and set aside
9. For the pancakes , put the flour , baking powder , oats and sugar into a large bowl
10. Separate the eggs , putting the yolks into a measuring jug and the whites into a bowl
11. Add the milk and vanilla to the yolks and then whisk into the dry ingredients
12. Beat the egg whites until stiff and then fold into the batter carefully
13. Brush a heated skillet with the melted butter and drop 2 or 3 tbs of the batter into the pan , leaving space in between , as the pancakes will spread
14. Cook for about 2 minutes , then turn over and cook 2 minutes longer until golden
15. Repeat with the remaining batter , brushing the pan each time with the melted butter , to make 8 pancakes altogether
16. Serve topped with the blueberry sauce

title: simple tuna noodle meal
steps:
1. Cook pasta , drain
2. Stir in soup mix & tuna
3. Heat until all is hot & serve --
4. You can add many things like peas & carrots , salt & pepper , etc

title: sweet potatoes and black walnuts
steps:
1. Peel , boil and mash sweet potatoes
2. Add hot milk , sugar and 3 tablespoons butter
3. Add black walnuts and salt
4. Mix thoroughly
5. Place in greased baking dish
6. Pour melted butter on top of potato mixture
7. Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350 degrees

title: bavarian party dip
steps:
1. Heat oil in small fry pan and saute the minced onions 8-10 minutes over medium-low heat , stirring frequently until softened
2. Remove from heat and drain
3. Set aside
4. Remove braunschweiger from its wrapper and mix it in a bowl with the softened cream cheese
5. Once combined well , add in sauteed onion and black pepper
6. Serve along side your choice of crackers or cocktail bread
7. Enjoy !

title: cajun stir fry
steps:
1. In a large nonstick skillet , stir-fry the chicken , kielbasa , onion and garlic in oil until onion is tender
2. Add the peppers , mushrooms , tomatoes , herbs , cajun seasoning , salt and pepper
3. Cook and stir until chicken juices run clear and vegetables are crisp-tender
4. Combine cornstarch and cold water until smooth
5. Add to the skillet
6. Bring to a boil
7. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
8. Serve over spaghetti

title: crock pot lamb stuffed green bell peppers
steps:
1. Cut the tops off the peppers , remove seeds and fiber
2. Brown the lamb and onion in the oil
3. Mix in rice and the seasonings
4. Fill the peppers with this mixture
5. Put pepper tops in the bottom of crock pot and place the peppers on top
6. Pour in the broth
7. Cover and cook on low for 6 hours
8. Remove peppers
9. Mix in cornstarch , tomato paste , lemon juice and sour cream with the broth remaining in the crockpot
10. Return peppers to cooker cover and cook on high for 30 minutes
11. Serve the sauce with the peppers

title: sunset passion colada
steps:
1. Place rum and pina colada mix in blender with ice
2. Blend until smooth
3. Pour into a tall glass and top with the strawberry daquiri mix
4. The daquiri mix sits on top for a pretty presentation
5. Serve with straws

title: chocolate weetabix fudge
steps:
1. Mix all dry ingredients together
2. Add melted butter
3. Add milk as required to keep mixture moist
4. Press into a greased tray
5. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes at 180 degrees celcius
6. Ice with favourite icing
7. Leave to set in fridge

title: tuna casserole edited  without soup
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit
2. Butter a medium baking dish with 1 tablespoon butter
3. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil
4. Add egg noodles , cook for 8 to 10 minutes , until al dente , and drain
5. Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a skillet over medium-low heat
6. Stir in the onion , celery , and garlic , and cook 5 minutes , until tender
7. Increase heat to medium-high , and mix in mushrooms
8. Continue to cook and stir 5 minutes , or until most of the liquid has evaporated
9. Melt 4 tablespoons butter in a medium saucepan
10. Whisk in flour until smooth
11. Gradually whisk in milk , and continue cooking 5 minutes , until sauce is smooth and slightly thickened
12. Season with salt and pepper
13. Stir in tuna , peas , mushroom mixture , and cooked noodles
14. Transfer to the baking dish
15. Melt remaining 2 tablespoons butter in a small bowl , mix with bread crumbs , and sprinkle over the casserole
16. Top with shredded cheddar cheese
17. Bake 25 minutes in the preheated oven or until bubbly and lightly browned

title: chocolate sprinkle milk
steps:
1. Dip the edges / rims of 4 glasses into melted chocolate and then dip them quickly into hundred and thousands
2. Stand upright until set , then pour in milk and serve

title: essence of vanilla
steps:
1. Put the vanilla shreds into a bottle with the brandy , and cork the bottle
2. Shake the bottle occasionally , and in the course of three months time the essence will be ready for use

title: pork chops hunter s style
steps:
1. Brown pork chops and place in shallow baking dish
2. Mix together remaining ingredients and pour over chops
3. Bake , uncovered , in preheated 350 oven for 45 minutes

title: cilantro lime leftover turkey stew
steps:
1. This recipe takes two days to make , not continuous work mind you , but short periods of intense activity , separated by many hours of slothful relaxation
2. There are two main phases , the first is to make the meaty turkey broth base , the second , to make the complete stew
3. Phase - i
4. Secure a large crock pot or conventional pot of at least six quarts capacity
5. If you do not have one , procure one from a neighbor
6. A handgun may be helpful if they are not very cooperative
7. Take the turkey carcass and violently rip it limb-from-limb until it fits into your pot
8. If you are timid , find another more "pc" recipe , you pretender !
9. Fill the pot with ordinary water to cover the turkey
10. I typically use five to six quarts
11. No fancy froo-froo water from places like france is needed
12. If you think you need it anyway , then get the hell out of dodge and find another recipe !
13. Slice the carrot into less than 1 / 8" slices and put into the pot
14. Strain the garlic cloves finely and put in pot
15. Add 1 tbsp of the dried celery leaves
16. Put the pot on the stovetop on low heat for 3 to 4 hours , or until the meat simply falls off the bone
17. Do not boil , just use slow heat with a few bubbles rising
18. Boiling will kill the flavor
19. A large crockpot can also be used
20. After truning off the heat , let the pot cool down for an hour , and then place it into the fridge overnight
21. I do this so the fat in the broth will rise to the top and harden , so it can be easily removed in the morning
22. Leaving the fat in this stew will inflate your waistline -- as if the beer you drink isn't doing enough !
23. Phase - ii
24. The next morning , get the pot from the fridge and skim off the fat from the top with a large spoon
25. Then you will have to get your hands dirty
26. If you have recently changed the oil in your bike , you better scrub up but good
27. Clean hands are a must
28. Separate the meat from the bones by hand
29. I set up two large bowls , one for bones and gristle , the other for cleaned turkey meat
30. Remove the meat and bones from the pot and separate into the two bowls until there is only broth left in the pot
31. Put the remnants of the skin , the carrot slices , and anything that looks funny to you in the bone bowl
32. Toss what is in the bone bowl into the trash or out the window if you have no trash can
33. Next go through the meat bowl and cut up any large chunks of meat with a knife
34. I like to chop it in the direction of the muscle fibers so you leave long shreds of meat
35. That makes things interesting in the bowl when eating , unlike the factory-made stuff you get in cans
36. For six quarts of soup use about 1-1 / 2 quarts of shredded turkey
37. If you have more meat than that , set it aside and use it for burrito filling
38. If you use more meat it becomes too thick
39. Place the pot of broth on the stove and start to heat it slowly
40. Put the burner on medium heat to start , no hurry now
41. Toss in the turkey from the meat bowl , open the cans of sweet corn , drain them of water , and put the corn into the pot
42. Then open the can of tomatoes and put it all into the pot without draining
43. Slice the onions and peppers into strips , less than 1 / 4 inch wide and at least 1-1 / 2 inches long
44. Do not finely chop , unless you want to make a bland uninteresting chowder
45. Brown the onions and peppers in a large pan in oil
46. Hey ! don't use a lot of oil , this is a low fat recipe
47. Turn the sliced veggies so they don't burn , yet get a bit brown on the edges
48. Then dump them into the pot
49. Next add the rest of the dried celery leaves , the ancho chili powder , the coriander , and cayenne
50. Stir well
51. Then wait for the pot to start bubbling
52. Not boiling -- just slowly bubbling
53. While you are waiting for this , squeeze the juice from the limes into a bowl
54. Then thoroughly wash about 2 / 3 of the bunch of cilantro and strip the leaves from the stems with a knife
55. The remaining 1 / 3 bunch will be used later as garnish when serving
56. When the pot starts to bubble , turn the heat down to low and add 3 / 4 of the lime juice and the cilantro leaves
57. Do not boil
58. If your pot is not full to six quarts capacity , now is the time to add more water
59. This recipe is for six quarts of stew
60. Now add salt to taste
61. I usually end up adding about 1+ level tbsp , but you might like it different
62. Cover the pot and let it very slowly bubble for 1 to 1-1 / 2 hours
63. If it bubbles vigorously , turn the heat down even more
64. Stir it up about every ten minutes or so so it all gets well mixed together
65. Then about 10 minutes before the end add the remaining lime juice
66. This is the time to taste it to see if you need more salt , lime or other ingredients to taste
67. After you take the pot off the heat , let it sit about 30 minutes to let the flavors blend and develop more
68. With this stew , the longer you wait , the better it gets
69. Serve it up in large bowls
70. I like to add a few tbsp of salsa verde and a large dollop of sour cream in the middle of each bowl
71. Don't stir it in , just plunk it into the bowl
72. This adds a bit of temperature and flavor contrast to the stew
73. Then garnish with the rest of the cilantro
74. And hey , there is not need to eat it right away ! this stew is even better after you cool it in the fridge for a day and reheat
75. If you don't have hungry guests that need to eat right away , set it aside , and go for a ride instead
76. It will be even better the next day

title: speedy gingerbread oatmeal
steps:
1. Mix the oats , cinnamon , ginger , nutmeg , salt , raisins and water in a microwave-safe bowl
2. Microwave on high for 1-1
3. 25 minutes , stirring every 15-30 seconds until the oatmeal has reached the desired consistency
4. Stir in the brown sugar , walnuts and a few drops of milk , serve warm

title: st  vincent sweet potato chips
steps:
1. Wash and peel potatoes
2. Slice thinly
3. Soak in cold salted water for 1 hour
4. Drain and dry on paper towels
5. Fry until browned in deep oil @370 degrees
6. Drain on paper towels
7. Salt and keep warm , till ready to serve

title: lemon curd tartlets
steps:
1. In a small , heavy saucepan over medium heat , whisk eggs , sugar , lemon juice , and lemon peel until blended
2. Add butter and cook , whisking constantly , until mixture is thickened and coats the back of a metal spoon
3. Transfer lemon curd to a small bowl and cool for 10 minutes
4. Cover and refrigerate until chilled
5. Just before serving , spoon lemon curd into tart shells
6. Garnish with raspberries , mint leaves , and / or whipped cream , if desired
7. Refrigerate leftovers

title: mrs  mango s hibiscus flower tea
steps:
1. Place all ingredients into water and steep 5-8 minutes then strain
2. Serve hot or iced , with honey

title: mexican hot dogs
steps:
1. Heat pan on medium high heat
2. Wrap bacon slices tightly around franks
3. Insert toothpicks on both ends to hold bacon in place
4. Make sure that the toothpicks are not sticking out of frank on both sides , just on one side
5. Place franks with flat side on hot pan
6. Let cook until bacon appears done
7. Meanwhile , chop onions and cilantro
8. Also if desired , toast hot dog buns on separate warm pan or grill or toast them
9. When bacon appears done , carefully lift franks up with tongs and pull toothpicks out and reinsert them with the uncooked side flat and the toothpick sticking out of cooked side
10. Place them back in pan and cook other side of franks
11. Once the bacon is done , check for any uncooked spots and angle the franks in a way that will cook the bacon
12. Once all sides of bacon appear cooked , remove from pan and pat down on paper towel
13. Place the done franks onto hot dog buns
14. Sprinkle with diced onions and cilantro
15. Add ketchup and / or mustard if desired and serve ! enjoy these yummy new hot dogs ! :d

title: deceptively delicious yellow cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Spray your cakepan with non-stick spray
3. Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl
4. Beat until smooth , 1 to 2 minutes
5. Pour batter into the cake pan
6. Bake about 20 minutes , until a toothpick inserted into the middle comes out clean
7. Chocolate cake variation: use a chocolate cake mix with plain or vanilla yogurt

title: south african  chocolate crunchies
steps:
1. Mix all the dry ingredients for the crunchies , except for the baking soda
2. Melt the butter and syrup together
3. Add the baking soda and stir
4. Pour into the dry ingredients and mix well
5. Press into a medium sized greased baking pan , about 10 by 8 inches
6. Use the back of a spoon to press the mixture together and smooth the top
7. Bake for 20 minutes at 350dgrees f
8. Mix together all the ingredients for the icing
9. Microwave 1 or 2 minutes until mixture is smooth
10. Pour the hot icing over the hot crunchies , tilt pan to cover the entire surface of the crunchy
11. Cut into squares when cool

title: our favourite lemon loaf
steps:
1. In a large bowl , cream butter and sugar
2. Add eggs , one at a time , beating until creamy
3. Blend in milk
4. In another bowl , mix together flour , baking powder , salt and lemon rind
5. Pour into batter
6. Stir to moisten
7. Scrape into greased 9 x 5 inch loaf pan
8. Bake in 350f degree oven for 55 to 60 minutes
9. Cool in pan for 5 minutes
10. Remove to rack and while still hot , with a toothpick poke holes all over the top of the loaf , and spoon glaze evenly over
11. Cool
12. Glaze: combine lemon juice and sugar in saucepan
13. Stir and heat till sugar is dissolved
14. Spoon evenly over top of hot loaf

title: magic meltdown bran muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. In a large mixing bowl , combine the dry ingredients
3. In another large bowl combine the wet ingredients
4. Pour the wet into the dry and mix until just combined
5. Gently stir in the carrots and fruit
6. Scoop batter into muffin tins , filling each cup to the top
7. Baking time seems to vary and i'm not entirely sure why but set the timer for 20 minutes and check on the muffins every 5 minutes after that
8. It'll probably take about 40 minutes
9. Basically , you want your muffins to pass the old toothpick test
10. Keep in mind though , a little underdone is ok as these freeze and reheat wonderfully

title: elegant tater tot hotdish
steps:
1. Brown the hamburger in a large skillet
2. Drain off any grease
3. Into same pan , add the soups , butter , half & half , and the bag of vegetables
4. Bring to a boil while stirring to mix all the ingredients
5. Add salt and pepper to taste
6. Pour into a buttered casserole dish and top with the tater tots
7. You may not need all the tater tots , it depends on the casserole dish size
8. Bake at 400 degrees until bubbly and the tater tots are crisp
9. About 30-35 minutes
10. Enjoy -- even if you're not from minnesota !

title: pecan weet bix cookies
steps:
1. Cream the butter and sugar together until light and fluffy , then add all the dry ingredients excepts the pecan halves
2. Roll into balls and place on greased cookie sheets , pressing a pecan half into each cookie center
3. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes
4. Cool and serve

title: ham and egg salad sandwiches
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , mix together all but the bread
2. Blend well
3. Cover and chill 30 minutes
4. Spread egg salad evenly on 3 slices of toast , top with remaining slices of toast

title: halvas fourno
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Grease a 12 x 8 cake tin
3. In a saucepan , dissolve the sugar in the water over high heat
4. Add the lemon juice and bring to a boil
5. Reduce the heat to medium and simmer for 20 minutes
6. Remove from heat and leave to cool
7. While the syrup is cooking , cream the butter , sugar and lemon rind with an electric mixer until light and fluffy
8. Add the eggs one at a time , beating well after each addition
9. Sift together the semolina and flour and then fold into the butter mixture alternately with the milk
10. Mix in the chopped almonds
11. Spread the mixture in the cake tin and arrange rows of flaked almonds on top
12. Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the cake is golden and shrinks slightly from the sides of the tin
13. Prick the surface with a fine skewer and then pour the cooled syrup over the hot cake
14. When the cake is cool , cut into squares or diamonds

title: gramma   grampa fjerstad s lefse
steps:
1. Peel the potatoes , cut into quarters and boil until tender
2. Mash the potatoes with the cream , butter and salt
3. Place the potatoes in the refrigerator to cool completely
4. Begin stirring in the flour , a cup or so at a time
5. Divide dough into 1-2 inch sized balls and roll each out into paper thin rounds on a floured board
6. Bake on a hot , dry griddle
7. Lightly brown one side and then carefully flip the pancake to brown the other side
8. Wrap and store in refrigerator or freezer
9. Serve with butter at dinner instead of rolls or as dessert with butter , cinnamon and sugar or jam

title: apple scone cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees and place rack in center of oven
2. Prepare a 9 inch glass pie plate with cooking spray
3. In a small bowl whisk together one egg and 1 tablespoon from the 1 / 2 cup milk
4. Set this aside as it will be used as a glaze for the top of the cake
5. In a large bowl , whisk together the flour , sugar , baking powder , and salt
6. Cut the butter into small pieces and blend into the flour mixture with a pastry blender or two knives
7. You should have a coarse crumbly texture
8. In a separate small bowl whisk together the remaining egg , remaining milk , and vanilla extract and add to the flour mixture , stirring just until the dough comes together
9. Do not overmix the dough as it will make the final product tough and dry
10. Transfer to a lightly floured surface and knead dough gently four or five times and then divide the dough in half
11. Pat one half of the dough onto the bottom and up the sides of the pie plate
12. In a separate bowl toss together the cut apples , sugar and cinnamon
13. Spread the apples evenly over the bottom of the dough in the pie plate
14. Roll the remaining dough into a 9 inch circle , on a lightly floured surface , and gently place the dough over the apples
15. With your fingers seal the edges of the top and bottom crusts
16. Brush the top of the dough with the egg and milk glaze , and sprinkle with white sugar
17. Cut a slit in the center of the dough to allow the steam to escape
18. Bake in the preheated oven for about 40 - 45 minutes or until the pastry is nicely browned and a toothpick inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean
19. Cool on a wire rack
20. Serve warm with a dollop of frozen vanilla yogurt

title: chicken   chile pepper stew
steps:
1. In a large stockpot , bring the chicken , onion , carrots , celery , dill , parsley , bay , peppercorns , cayenne pepper , salt , and water to a boil
2. Decrease heat to low and simmer until the chicken is tender
3. Remove chicken from pot and set aside to cool
4. Let stock continue to simmer for another 15 minutes , then strain into a clean stockpot and set aside
5. Using two forks , shred the chicken
6. In a small mixing bowl , combine the orange juice and lime juice
7. Break the chiles into pieces and soak in the juice mixture for 20 minutes
8. Transfer to a blender and blend until smooth
9. Set aside
10. In a large skillet , melt the butter , then saut the onions with the turmeric until the onions are soft and translucent
11. Add the garlic and cumin and saut for another minute
12. Soak the bread in the evaporated milk
13. Add the blended chile mixture to the skillet and cook until the liquid cooks off
14. Skim off any fat that may have risen to the surface on the cooling stock
15. Add the soaked bread to the skillet and cook , stirring constantly for 30 seconds
16. Add the contents of the skillet to the stock along with the walnuts , potatoes , and cheese , and cook , stirring occasionally , until thick enough to coat the spoon
17. Add the chicken meat , and let simmer 10 more minutes
18. Ladle the stew into bowls and garnish with the sliced eggs

title: low carb meatballs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Grease a 12 cup muffin pan and set aside
3. Mix together ingredients thoroughly
4. Using a 1 / 3 cup ice cream scoop , scoop up mixture and place in holes in muffin tin
5. Bake for 45 minutes or until cooked through
6. Allow to cool for 5-10 minutes before removing from pan
7. Place on paper toweling to absorb any excess fat

title: french pepper steak  steak au poivre
steps:
1. Press pepper into both sides of steaks
2. Heat butter and oil in a large skillet over high heat
3. Add steak and sear on both sides
4. Reduce heat to medium high and cook an additional 6 to 7 minutes on each side , more for well done
5. Remove steak to serving platter and keep warm
6. Season lightly with salt to taste
7. Add brandy to pan with drippings and heat until bubbly
8. Add a small amount of cream
9. Pour sauce over steaks
10. Garnish with parsley

title: peanutty coleslaw
steps:
1. Whisk together first 10 ingredients in a large bowl
2. Add coleslaw mix , stirring to coat
3. Cover and chill 1 hour
4. Stir in peanuts just before serving

title: mashed yams with avocado
steps:
1. Bake yams at 350 for 40-60 minute until soft
2. Let cool
3. Scrape cooled yams into bowl
4. Mash
5. Add yogurt
6. Whip
7. Quickly chop and blend in avocado
8. Move mixture to casserole
9. Top with crushed pistachios
10. Bake at 350 for about 20 minute

title: chicken paprika
steps:
1. Coat chicken with flour , and brown in olive oil in a heavy skillet
2. Drain off excess fat
3. Stir in gravy , chopped onion , garlic salt , paprika , and cayenne and black pepper
4. Cover , and cook over low heat for 35-40 minutes or until chicken is done
5. Remove chicken and set aside
6. Add sour cream to gravy , and stir until combined
7. Return chicken to pan , cover , and continue cooking until heated through , about 5-10 minutes , but do not allow to boil
8. Serve over buttered noodles

title: peachy coffee smoothie
steps:
1. Place nectar , peaches , ice cream , cream , water , coffee granules and vanilla extract in blender
2. Cover
3. Blend until smooth
4. Serve in chilled glasses

title: low carb supreme pizza casserole
steps:
1. Brown meats with italian seasonings and drain off fat
2. Add onions , peppers , garlic and mushrooms and saute until tender
3. Remove from heat and add pizza sauce and most of the pepperoni , mix well
4. Spray a 13x9 pyrex baking dish with pam , add meat mixture
5. Top with most of the black olives
6. Mix mozzarella and cheddar together and spead over the black olives
7. Sprinkle with parmesan and decorate the top with the remaining pepperoni and black olives
8. Bake 425 degrees for 15-20 minutes
9. Let rest 10 minutes , cut and serve

title: italian sausage frittata
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Brown sausage in sauce pan and drain
3. Spread evenly over bottom of 9 x 13 baking dish
4. Saut mushrooms and garlic in butter until almost all liquid is absorbed (you can add a few dashes of white wine at this stage if you prefer
5. Spread mushrooms over sausage
6. Layer swiss chard and cheese over mushrooms
7. In bowl beat the eggs , milk and dijon mustard and pour evenly over all
8. Place in oven on middle rack , bake uncovered for 1 hour ,
9. Remove from the oven , cover loosely with foil , and let stand 15-18 minutes
10. Divide and cut into serving sizes
11. Top with green onions or sour cream if you desire

title: cappuccino chocolate cake
steps:
1. Mix all wet ingredients together and beat for 4 minutes with electric mixer
2. Mix all dry ingredients together and add to wet mixture , mix well
3. Spread into greased and floured tube pan
4. Bake at 325~f for 1 hour 10 minutes
5. Coffee kahlua cream glaze: beat all ingredients until desired consistency and spoon over cool cake

title: marra s low fat sugar lemon loaf
steps:
1. Beat butter in a big bowl with sugar , splenda and apple sauce and 1 / 4 cup egg substitute
2. Add the rest of egg substitute and beat
3. Add the milk
4. In another bowl , mix flour , baking powder , salt and lemon peel as well as almond extract if using
5. Pour into egg mixture
6. Mix only to wet
7. With a spoon , pour in a greased loaf pan of 8 x 4 inch
8. Cook in the oven at 350f for 45 minutes to 1 hour until the loaf is cooked
9. Remove from oven and put on glaze
10. Glaze: put lemon juice and splenda in a small saucepan
11. Heat and stir to dissolve sugar
12. Spoon over warm loaf
13. Let cool in the pan for 10 minutes
14. Remove from the pan , cool and wrap

title: sweet and spicy kidney beans
steps:
1. Spray non stick skillet with olive oil to lightly coat when hot , add onions
2. After those just start to wilt , add garlic and dry spices
3. Continue until aromatic and golden
4. Add tomatoes and cook until they soften and release liquid
5. Reduce heat and add remaining ingredients
6. Simmer until slightly thickened
7. If mixture gets too thick , add water
8. Serve as a side dish or with noodles or rice
9. I had them as a main course with no-yolk egg noodles and it was surprisingly good

title: al andalus paella
steps:
1. Season the chicken thighs with salt and pepper
2. Add 1 tbsp oil to each of two 12-14 inch skillets or paella pans set over medium-high heat
3. When oil is hot , add half of the chicken thighs to each pan and brown on both sides , 15-20 minute transfer to platter
4. While the chicken is browning , toast the saffron threads in a 2 qt saucepan
5. Remove from heat and crush the threads with the back of a spoon
6. Add 1 / 2 cup chicken broth and bring to a simmer over medium heat
7. Remove from heat and let steep for 10 minutes
8. Add 5 1 / 2 cups additional broth to the saffron infusion and bring to a simmer , hold until needed over low heat
9. If using turmeric instead of the saffron threads , pour 6 cups chicken broth into a 2 qt sauce pan , add the turmeric , and bring to a simmer , hold until needed over low heat
10. Divide the green beans and artichoke hearts between the two pans and saute for 5-6 minutes
11. Transfer beans and hearts to the platter with the chicken
12. Remove all but 1 tbsp of fat from each pan and divide the onion and garlic between the pans
13. Saute until the onion is translucent
14. Divide the pepper flakes and the smoked paprika between the two pans and saute for 30-60 seconds
15. Add the tomatoes between both pans and saute until the liquid from the tomatoes has evaporated and the mixture is thickened , about 5-7 minutes more
16. Sprinkle 1 1 / 2 cups of rice over the onion mixture in each pan
17. Pour 3 cups of the hot broth evenly over each pan of rice , then arrange the chorizo , green beans and artichoke hearts on the rice
18. Nestle the chicken thighs into both pans and bring to a boil
19. Reduce heat and simmer rapidly until the rice appears on the surface of the mixtures , about 5-6 minutes
20. Arrange the roasted red pepper slices over both pans
21. Divide the shrimp between both pans and push the shrimp down into the rice
22. Continue simmering until all the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is al dente , another 8-10 minutes
23. If all the liquid has been absorbed but the rice is not done , add a little more broth and cook a few minutes more
24. Cover the pans with aluminum foil and cook gently for another 2 minutes to ensure that the top layer of rice is cooked evenly
25. With the pans still covered , raise the heat to medium high and cook until the bottom layer of rice begins to brown
26. You may hear rice crackling , which is normal , but if the rice begins to burn , remove the pans from the heat immediately
27. Check the chicken for doneness
28. Sprinkle the peas over each pan and let stand , covered , for 5-10 minutes
29. While the paella is standing , bring the remaining chicken broth to a boil in a medium saucepan and add the clams or mussels
30. Cover and simmer for 3-4 minutes or until the clams / mussels have opened
31. Arrange the opened clams / mussels over each pan of paella , discarding any that did not open
32. Serve directly from the pan with wedges of lemon to squeeze over the rice

title: romaine salad with raspberry dressing
steps:
1. Salad ~ combine lettuce , onion , feta cheese , pecans , and bacon
2. Serve with raspberry salad dressing
3. Dressing ~ microwave raspberry spread in a microwave-safe bowl at low power 1 minute or until melted
4. Whisk in vinegar and olive oil until blended
5. Let cool
6. Serve at room temperature

title: potato  zucchini and onion slices with fresh herbs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Grease or oil 13x9-inch pan
3. Combine herbs in small bowl
4. Using a food processor or a knife , slice potatoes , zucchini , green pepper and onion into thin slices
5. Toss vegetables
6. In prepared pan , place one layer of vegetables , sprinkle with olive oil , add some herbs and salt and pepper
7. Repeat layers
8. Cook in preheated oven for 20 minutes
9. Turn vegetables
10. Continue turning vegetables until all are turned over
11. Continue cooking for 20-30 minutes or until vegetables are cooked and potatoes are golden brown

title: exotic mango white chocolate brownie muffins  healthier
steps:
1. In a medium sized pot cover parsnip chunks with water and bring to a boil
2. Reduce heat to medium and simmer for about 15 minutes or until very tender
3. Drain and blend into a very fine mash
4. Measure out 15 oz of puree and allow to cool
5. In a large bowl combine chocolate cake mix , ground allspice , mango pieces and chocolate chips
6. Using a wooden spoon fold in the 15 oz of parsnip puree and enough tea to make a stiff , very thick , but not dry dough
7. You might need more or less than the 6 tbs i listed , that really depends on the type of cake mix you use , the parsnips and the weather
8. Lol
9. Spoon batter into a greased or paper-lined muffin tin
10. Sprinkle with the sugar if using and bake in the preheated oven at 175c / 350f for 15-20 minutes or until tester inserted in the center comes out clean
11. If you prefer a fudgier brownie muffin aim for 15 minutes
12. Allow to cool in the tin for 5 minutes , then remove to a wire rack to cool completely

title: red wine and herb lamb shanks
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c
2. Heat the oil in a large non-stick pan over high heat and cook the shanks , in batches , for 1 to 2 minutes on each side or until browned , set aside
3. Add the leeks , onion , garlic , thyme and oregano to the pan and cook for 2 to 3 minutes
4. Add the flour and cook for 1 to 2 minutes and then add the wine and stock and bring to the boil and then return the shanks and cover with aluminium foil or tight fitting lid
5. Place in the oven and roast for 2 1 / 2 hours , turning every 30 minutes
6. Serve with polenta or mashed potatoes and steamed vegetables
7. To freeze - shred meat of the bone and divide the meat and sauce into 4 portions and place in zip-lock bags or airtight containers and freeze for up to 3 months
8. To defrost - place in the refrigerator overnight and allow to thaw completely

title: pulled pork mexican style
steps:
1. Roast peppers under broiler till blackened
2. Remove from oven and cover with plastic wrap this till the skins loosen
3. After that , peel skins from peppers and chop
4. Cut some fat off pork butt--not all--you need this for flavor
5. Use a large pot with lid , add small amount of oil to sear the meat , heat pan to hot
6. Add pork butt and sear for 9 minutes each side or till browned
7. Remove pork to a plate
8. While the pan is still hot , chop onion and add to pan
9. Add broth and chopped peppers
10. On medium low heat , cook for 4 hours till pork is tender
11. Remove from pan and using 2 forks , pull meat apart
12. Add a handful of cilantro
13. You are ready to make tacos or sandwiches

title: turkey enchiladas
steps:
1. Mix the cream soups , sour cream , milk and green chilies in a bowl
2. Put about 1 / 3 of the mixture in the bottom of a pan
3. Add the turkey and cheese to the rest of the mixture
4. Put 2 tortillas in the pan , add some mixture , and keep alternating until through with mixture
5. Cook at 350 until warm through
6. About 20 minutes

title: brown sugar pecans
steps:
1. Arrange pecan halves in an aluminum foil lined 13x 9 baking dish ~ reynolds release foil works great here ~ set pan aside
2. Melt butter in saucepan over medium heat and add brown sugar , vanilla , salt
3. Stir one minute and remove from heat
4. Continue stirring until brown sugar dissolves
5. Pour over pecans , stirring to coat
6. Bake at 325 for 25 to 25 minutes
7. Stirring every 10 to 15 minutes
8. Remove from oven and spread on wax paper to cool
9. Store in an airtight container

title: dutch apple pie
steps:
1. Combine crust mixture
2. Reserve 1 cup and press the rest in a pie tin
3. Put apples in crust
4. In a small pan mix water , sugar , salt , and cornstarch
5. Cook while stirring until mixture gets thick
6. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla and bitters
7. Pour hot custard over apples
8. Sprinkle reserved cup of crumbs over pie
9. Bake at 350f for 50 to 60 minutes until crust is crunchy

title: mom s divine coffee cake
steps:
1. Combine nuts with the 1 / 4 cup sugar and cinnamon
2. Set aside
3. Blend together flour , baking powder & soda
4. Set aside
5. Cream butter with the 1 cup sugar until light and fluffy
6. Add eggs and vanilla
7. Beat well
8. Add dry ingredients and sour cream
9. Beat until well blended
10. Pour half batter into greased and lightly floured 9 inch square pan
11. Top with half of cinnamon-nut mixture
12. Cover with remaining batter
13. Top with last of cinnamon-nut mixture
14. Bake at 375 for 30 minutes or until golden brown

title: russian tea ii
steps: 1. Steep tea , remove tea bags , add sugar to dissolve , add other ingredients , keep refrigerated

title: african chicken
steps:
1. Brown chicken in vegetable oil in large frying pan
2. Set aside
3. Remove all but 2 tablespoons of oil and drippings in pan
4. Stir in curry powder and salt , onion , red pepper , tomato and rice
5. Cover and simmer 5 minutes
6. Return chicken to pan
7. Cover
8. Simmer until chicken is tender
9. Remove chicken to large platter
10. Blend peanut butter and water
11. Stir into vegetables
12. Heat to boiling
13. Spoon over chicken

title: 500f eye of round roast
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 500f
2. Season roast to your taste
3. Place on rack in shallow roasting pan
4. Do not add water or cover the pan
5. Place roast in the preheated oven and lower the temperature to 475f
6. Roast at 475f for 7 minutes per pound
7. Turn the oven off and leave roast in oven 2-1 / 2 hours
8. Do not open oven door until time is up
9. Remove roast and slice thinly

title: pork and sauerkraut with dumplings
steps:
1. Rub pork with salt and pepper
2. Place in a pot and cover with water , adding onion cut into pieces
3. Boil meat until tender , remove excess fat
4. Add sauerkraut and simmer about 20 minutess
5. Mix dry dumpling ingredients together
6. Add milk gradually mixing well then add the melted butter
7. Drop by spoonsful into boiling pork and kraut
8. Cook 15 minutes covered

title: horiatiki salata  greek salad
steps:
1. Wash and dry the tomatoes , cucumber , and green pepper
2. Clean off the outer skin from the onion , wash , and dry
3. Cut the tomatoes into bite-sized irregularly shaped chunks , removing the core
4. Salt lightly
5. Slice the cucumber into 1 / 4-inch slices , cutting slices in half
6. Salt lightly
7. Slice the pepper into rings , removing the stem and seeds
8. Salt lightly
9. Slice the onion into thin rings
10. Combine the tomatoes , cucumbers , green pepper and onion in a large salad bowl
11. Sprinkle with oregano , pour olive oil over the salad , and toss
12. Just before serving , place the feta on top of the salad , either as a slice or crumbled , and toss in some olives
13. Sprinkle the cheese with oregano , mix the oil and water and drizzle over the top , and serve , garnished with hot peppers

title: breakfast salsa croissant
steps:
1. Spread 3 tbsp of salsa on each half croissant
2. Cover with cheese slices
3. Cut the slices of cheese so they do not overhang the croissant too much
4. Put in toaster oven or under broiler for 5 minutes until the cheese has melted- enjoy

title: sloppy joe bbq mix
steps:
1. Brown and drain ground beef
2. Mix onion flakes , pepper , ketchup , brown sugar , mustard and vinegar together
3. Mix ground beef and ketchup mixture together in a large roaster oven
4. Cook at 250 degrees until heated through
5. Serve on hamburger or cocktail buns

title: chris s reuben sandwich
steps:
1. Spread one slice of bread with horseradish , adjusting for the "hotness" you prefer
2. Spread dijon mustard on the remaining slice of bread
3. On horseradish slice of bread add the sauerkraut
4. On dijon slice , add corned beef and provolone slices
5. Toast both sides of sandwich in the oven for 5-10 min -- watching carefully
6. Put sandwich together and enjoy !

title: turbo hummus by alton brown
steps:
1. Place the garlic in a food processor and finely chop
2. Add beans and 1 / 2 of the reserved liquid
3. Process finely or to desired consistency
4. Add parsley , lemon juice and zest , black pepper , and salt
5. Process until it forms a paste
6. Drizzle with olive oil and process until consistency of a mayonnaise

title: cheesy sloppy joe pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. In large skillet , heat oil over medium heat , add beef and cook , breaking up , for 5-10 minutes
3. Until no longer pink
4. Drain off fat
5. Stir in yellow onion and peppers
6. Cook 5 minutes
7. Stir in tomato sauce , salt and pepper
8. Simmer for 5 minutes
9. Place 1 pizza crust on baking sheet , spread half of the meat sauce over crust
10. Sprinkle 1 / 2 of the green onion and 1 / 2 the cheese over top
11. Bake for 20 - 25 mins , or until cheese is bubbly and golden
12. Repeat with other crust

title: honey ginger limeade
steps:
1. In a small saucepan combine 2 cups of the water and the finely chopped ginger
2. Bring to boiling
3. Reduce heat
4. Boil gently , uncovered , for 3 minutes
5. Remove from heat
6. Stir in lime peel
7. Cover and let stand for 15 minutes
8. Strain into a pitcher
9. Discard solids
10. Add brown sugar and honey to ginger liquid in pitcher , stirring to dissolve sugar
11. Stir in lime juice , jalapeno pepper , and the remaining 1 cup water
12. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours
13. Before serving , add the reserved squeezed lime halves to pitcher
14. Slowly pour sparkling water into ginger liquid in pitcher
15. Stir gently to mix
16. Serve in brown sugar-rimmed glasses over ice cubes
17. Garnish with lime wedges and ginger slices
18. Serving
19. Place brown sugar in a shallow dish
20. Rub a lime wedge around the edge of each glass and dip the edge into the sugar

title: crock pot chicken   rice 2 die 4
steps:
1. Add all ingredients except rice and cook on low for 6-8 hours or high for 4 hours
2. Add rice and cook on low for 30 minutes
3. Serve with garden salad , warm bread and white wine

title: persimmon bundt cake
steps:
1. Position rack in center of oven and preheat to 350f
2. Butter and flour bundt pan
3. Peel persimmons
4. Press pulp through coarse sieve into medium bowl
5. Measure 1 1 / 3 cups persimmon puree into small bowl
6. Mix baking soda into puree and set aside
7. Beat sugar and butter in large bowl until blended
8. Add eggs , 1 at a time , beating well after each addition
9. Mix in vanilla
10. Sift flour , cinnamon , salt , allspice and cloves into butter mixture
11. Blend well using rubber spatula
12. Mix in persimmon mixture , walnuts and currants
13. Transfer batter to prepared pan
14. Bake cake until tester comes out clean , about 55 minutes
15. Cook cake in pan on rack 5 minutes
16. Turn out cake onto rack
17. Cool completely
18. Sift confectioners sugar over cake

title: banana blondies with chocolate chips and walnuts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f grease a 13x9 inch metal baking pan
2. In a medium bowl , combine flour , baking powder and salt
3. In a large bowl , using electric mixer , beat butter and granulated and brown sugars until light and fluffly
4. Beat in vanilla
5. Add eggs and bananas , beating well
6. Add flour mixture and beat just until combined
7. Fold in chocolate chips and walnuts
8. Spread batter in prepared pan
9. Bake in preheated oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until light golden brown and starting to pull away from sides of pan
10. The center will be slightly soft to the touch
11. Let cool completely in pan or rack
12. Cut into bars

title: dad s easy cherry cobbler
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Empty pie filling into an 8x8 or 9x9 pan
3. Evenly sprinkle the cake mix over the pie filling
4. Don't worry about clumps
5. Drizzle the melted butter over the cake mix
6. Drizzle the milk over the cake mix
7. Put the pan in the oven and let it bake for 35 to 40 minutes until golden brown and bubbling on top
8. Let rest on the stovetop for about 10 minutes and then serve warm with a scoop of vanilla ice cream

title: lemon waffles
steps:
1. Sift together the flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt into a bowl
2. Stir in the lemon zest
3. In another bowl , whisk together the milk , melted butter and the egg yolks until smooth
4. Make a well in the dry ingredients and gradually stir in the wet until just combined
5. Do not continue to stir
6. Cover with plastic wrap
7. Let stand covered , about 30 minutes
8. Preheat waffle iron according to manufacturers instructions
9. In a clean , dry bowl whisk the egg whites until fluffy
10. Gradually add the icing sugar while continuing to beat until whites hold soft peaks
11. Fold gently into batter
12. Ladle batter into prepared waffle iron and cook according to manufacturers instructions

title: pasqua pork seasoning
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and rub onto any pork cut
2. Cook as required
3. Enjoy !

title: eight in one sugar cookies
