steps:
1. To make the cookie dough: cream together butter and sugars until smooth and fluffy
2. Stir in unbeaten eggs , one at a time
3. Sift together dry ingredients
4. Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk
5. Mix thoroughly
6. Divide dough in eight 1-cup lots
7. Wrap each tightly in foil or plastic wrap
8. Freeze
9. Then place in plastic bag
10. To use , thaw dough just enough that you can shape or drop it
11. This dough , tightly wrapped , will keep several days in refrigerator
12. Place about 2" apart on greased baking sheet and bake in moderate oven 375f for
13. 10-15 minutes
14. Spread cookies on racks to cool
15. Mix makes 8 cups dough
16. Each cup makes 2-3 dozen cookies , depending on the kind you bake
17. Chocolate chip balls: knead into 1 cup cookie dough , 1 tbsp cocoa and 1 / 3 cup semisweet chocolate pieces
18. Shape into about 24 round balls
19. Flatten slightly with spatula
20. Bake as directed
21. Coconut / almond cookies: knead into 1 cup cookie dough , 1 cup flaked coconut and 1 / 4 to 1 / 2 tsp almond extract
22. Shape into about 24 balls
23. Place on greased baking sheet and press flat with spatula
24. Top each with a piece of candied cherry
25. Bake as directed
26. Pecan balls: knead into 1 cup cookie dough , 1 / 2 cup finely chopped pecans and 1 / 4 tsp
27. Vanilla
28. Shape into 24 round balls
29. Bake as directed
30. Ginger cookie balls: stir into 1 cup cookie dough , 1 tbsp dark molasses and 1 / 4 tsp ground ginger
31. Shape into about 24 balls
32. Bake as directed
33. Gumdrop cookie balls: mix into 1 cup cookie dough , 1 / 2 cup finely cut gumdrops
34. Shape into 24 balls
35. Cross-cross with a fork
36. Bake as directed
37. Fruit'n' spice drop cookies: stir into 1 cup cookie dough , 1 / 2 cup cooked and drained , chopped dried fruit , 2 tbsp brown sugar , 1 / 4 tsp ground cinnamon and 1 / 8 tsp , ground cloves
38. Drop by teaspoonfuls 2" apart onto greased baking sheet
39. Bake as directed
40. Makes 30
41. Orange wafers: stir into 1 cup cookie dough , 1 / 4 tsp grated orange peel and 1 / 4 cup sugar mixed with 4 tsp orange juice
42. Drop by teaspoonfuls 2" apart onto greased baking sheet
43. Bake as directed
44. Makes 24 thin cookies
45. Banana / lemon drops: stir into 1 cup cookie dough , 1 / 4 cup mashed ripe banana , 1 / 2 tsp
46. Grated lemon peel and 1 / 4 tsp lemon juice
47. Drop 1 teaspoonful at a time into finely rolled corn flakes
48. Coat by turning gently with spoon
49. Place 2" apart on greased baking sheet and bake as directed
50. Watch carefully so cookies do not scorch
51. Makes 2 dozen

title: runza sandwich   bieroc
steps:
1. Prepare dough in bread machine following steps below
2. Prepare the meat filling while dough is rising
3. Filling - brown beef , onions and seasonings in a large stock pan
4. Stir the beef often while it is browning - to break it into very small pieces
5. Drain grease and return beef to pan and add shredded cabbage
6. Cover and simmer 15 minutes until the cabbage is tender - stirring occasionally
7. Drain juices and cool
8. Dough - place dough ingredients in the bread machine in order according to manufacturer directions
9. Program for dough mode and remove dough when cycle is complete
10. Turn out onto floured marble board and divide the dough in half
11. Roll the dough approximately 3 / 8 inch thick and cut into 5-6 inch squares
12. If you prefer , you can instead break off small pieces of dough - approximately the size of a large egg - and roll them out individually
13. Place 1 / 4 -1 / 3 c cooled meat mixture in the center of dough
14. Bring corners of dough up to the center , pinching to seal the seams
15. Place seam side down on greased cookie sheet and let rise until doubled
16. Bake 350 degrees for about 20 minutes
17. Serve with mustard
18. Wrap / seal leftover runzas and freeze
19. Great for sack lunches !

title: asiago sun dried tomato dip
steps:
1. Mix all the above together
2. Chill and serve with crackers and veggies

title: lemon dilled tuna salad   melts
steps:
1. In small bowl , combine well the first 8 ingredients
2. Set aside
3. Toast bread
4. Top with tuna
5. Top with tomato slices
6. Top with cheese slices
7. Place on cookie sheet and bake in 400f oven until cheese melts , about 3-5 minutes
8. Serve warm
9. Makes great regular sandwiches on bread , croissants or bagels
10. Or stuffed summer tomatoes , too !

title: saag paneer  panir    indian spinach and cheese
steps:
1. Fry the onions , garlic , ginger and spices in oil for around 5 minutes
2. Add the chopped tomatoes and continue to cook for another 5 minutes , making sure the heat is down to a simmer
3. Add the spinach and continue to simmer for a further 5 minutes
4. Add the paneer and yogurt and simmer for around 5 minutes

title: moroccan spice rubbed pork chops
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine garlic , oil , cinnamon , coriander , cumin and paprika to form a paste
2. Press spice mixture onto both sides of each pork chop
3. Light coat a grill or grill pan with cooking spray and heat to medium high
4. Grill pork until there is no trace of pink near the bone , 6-8 minutes per side
5. Sprinkle with salt and season with pepper to taste

title: mustard baked chicken
steps:
1. In a lightly greased , flameproof 9" x 13" baking dish , arrange the chicken pieces skin side down in a single layer
2. Combine the mustard and jam
3. Brush half of the mixture over the chicken
4. Bake at 375 degrees f for 20 minutes
5. Turn the chicken pieces over
6. Brush with the remaining mustard mixture
7. Bake for 20 minutes longer or until golden and the juices run clear when the chicken is pierced
8. Transfer to a serving plate and keep warm
9. Pour off the excess fat from the baking dish
10. Add the wine
11. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat , stirring to scrape up any browned bits
12. Transfer to a small saucepan
13. Cook for 5 minutes or until reduced by half
14. Add the cream and cook , stirring , for 4 to 5 minutes or until thick enough to coat the back of a spoon
15. Season with salt and pepper to taste
16. Pour the sauce over the chicken
17. Sprinkle with parsley
18. Garnish with the lemon slices

title: red lobster cheese biscuit loaf
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a 95 loaf pan with oil
3. In a bowl , whisk together the first 5 ingredients
4. Carefully stir in cheese cubes until covered in flour mixture , this will help prevent your cheese sinking to the bottom of your loaf of bread
5. In a different bowl , whisk together the remaining ingredients
6. Fold the wet mixture into the flour and cheese mixture , stir until just combined , do not over stir
7. Spread the mixture into the loaf pan
8. Bake for 45-50 minutes
9. Let cool 10 minutes and then remove from pan
10. Allow to cool for one hour before slicing and serving

title: that chocolate cake
steps:
1. For the frosting:
2. In a small sauce pan , combine the sugar and the cream and bring to a boil over medium heat , stirring occasionally
3. Reduce the heat and simmer for 6 minutes
4. Add the chocolate and the butter and stir until melted
5. Pour into a bowl and stir in the vanilla
6. Let the frosting cool , whisking gently from time to time
7. Do not over whip , or you will create air bubbles
8. For the cake:
9. Position the rack in the center of the oven and preheat to 350f lightly butter the bottom of two 9 inch round cake pans
10. Line the bottom with parchment paper then butter and flour the parchment paper
11. And the sides of the pans
12. In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment , combine the sugar , flour , cocoa , salt , baking powder , baking soda , mixing on low spead
13. Mix in the eggs , oil and milk
14. Increase the spped to medium , and beat for 2 minutes , reduce the speed to low and mix in the water
15. The batter will know be soupy
16. Divide the batter evenly between the cake pans
17. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until skewer inserted in the center comes out clean
18. Remove from the oven and cool on a cooling rack for 5 minutes , then turn the layers out onto the rack and cool completely
19. When the cakes have cooled , check the frosting
20. It should have the consistency of mayonnaise
21. If it is still too thin , let it cool longer
22. To frost the cake:
23. Place one cake layer on a serving plate
24. Spread the frosting with a hot palette knife or icing spatula to give the frosting a beautiful shine: run the knife under hot tap water and dry with a towel
25. Spread about 3 / 4 cup of the frosting over the top of the first layer
26. Top with the second layer
27. Spread the remaining frosting over the top and sides of the cake , heating the knife again as necessary

title: mom s ham bone bean soup
steps:
1. Soak beans according to package directions , either overnight , or quick 1 hour soak
2. Drain and rinse beans
3. Add water , ham bone and broths to beans in stockpot
4. Cut 1 stalk of celery into 3 pieces and add to beans along with chopped onion and bay leaves
5. Bring to boil , cover partially , lower heat and simmer 90 minutes , or until beans are tender
6. Remove bay leaves and celery
7. Add tomatoes , chopped carrots and other two stalks of celery , chopped finely
8. Remove bone and take off any remaining ham and chop finely
9. Add additional ham if needed to make 2 cups and add to soup
10. Use a potato masher or immersion blender to blend slightly , thickening the soup with the mashed beans
11. Great served with a dolop of horseradish

title: gluten free 5 minute chocolate cake in a mug
steps:
1. Also required: 1 large coffee mug
2. Add dry ingredients to mug , and mix well
3. Add the egg and mix thoroughly
4. Pour in the milk and oil and mix well
5. Add the chocolate chips
6. Add vanilla extract , and mix again
7. Put your mug in the microwave and cook for 3 minutes at 1000 watts
8. The cake will rise over the top of the mug , but don't be alarmed !
9. Allow to cool a little , and
10. Eat !

title: cheddar cauliflower soup
steps:
1. In large dutch oven over medium-high heat , warm oil
2. Add onion
3. Cook , stirring occasionally , until tender , 5-7 minutes
4. Add cauliflower
5. Cook , stirring occasionally , until light golden brown , about 5 minutes
6. Add broth , cream , 2 teaspoons salt , and freshly ground pepper to taste
7. Bring to boil
8. Reduce heat to low
9. Simmer until cauliflower is easily pierced with a fork , about 10 minutes
10. Using immersion blender , blend soup to a fine puree , 3-5 minutes
11. Add cheese
12. Stir until melted and well-combined with soup
13. Adjust seasonings with salt and pepper
14. Ladle soup into individual bowls
15. Serve immediately with toasted bread

title: sherry fudge
steps:
1. Melt the chocolate and butter in the sherry over hot , not boiling water
2. Add yolk to the sugar
3. Add chocolate mixture to the sugar and mix well
4. You may need to add more sherry at this point if needed , try a tsp at a time
5. Add nuts
6. Spread in a 8x8 buttered pan
7. Cool , cut into squares and place in fridge

title: 1 minute breakfast sandwich
steps:
1. Whisk together egg , milk , a pinch of salt , and a few grinds of pepper
2. Spray a 4-oz
3. Ramekin with cooking spray
4. Pour egg mixture into ramekin , microwave on high until done
5. About 1 minute 30 seconds
6. Split one english muffin and toast both sides
7. Add cooked egg to one side of the english muffin and top with a slice of cheese
8. Top with other desired ingredients
9. Top with other half of english muffin
10. Serve

title: kahk
steps:
1. Heat the samn balady until almost boiling
2. In seperate bowl , add the baking powder and the spices to the flour
3. Slowly add the flour mixture to the hot samn balady and stir thoroughly
4. When the mixture cools , add the instant yeast to the milk with a teaspoon of sugar , then stir gently into the dough
5. Knead it for a short while , cover and let it rest for an hour
6. Shape dough into balls , then flatten them
7. Inserts nuts , honey , sugar , agwa , or other filling when you are making it into balls
8. Put them on a cookie tray and let them rest
9. Bake in preheated oven until golden
10. Cool and sprinkle with powdered sugar just before eating

title: shrimp florentine with caramelized garlic
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. To prepare garlic: combine 1 / 2 t kosher salt and garlic in a bowl
3. Place garlic mixture on a jelly roll pan coated with cooking spray
4. Bake at 350 for 25 minutes or until browned , stirring occasionally
5. To prepare shrimp: heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
6. Add shrimp
7. Saute' 3 minutes or until done
8. Remove shrimp from pan
9. Melt butter in pan over medium heat
10. Stir in half and half , broth , cheese , 1 / 4 teaspoon salt , red pepper , and black pepper
11. Cook 1 minute or until cheese melts , stirring constantly
12. Stir in shrimp and spinach
13. Cook 1 minute
14. Combine shrimp mixture , garlic mixture , and pasta in a large bowl
15. Toss well

title: creole stuffing
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the first 10 ingredients
2. Add enough chicken broth to moisten
3. Transfer to a greased 2 quart baking dish
4. Cover and bake at 325 for 60 minutes
5. Uncover and bake 10 minutes longer or until lightly browned

title: chinese noodle salad
steps:
1. Combine salad ingredients in a large bowl and mix well
2. Combine dressing ingredients in a jar and mix well
3. Immediately before serving pour dressing over salad and mix well

title: bourbon shrimp flambe
steps:
1. Melt butter in skillet
2. Add shrimp , cook for 1 minute
3. Add bourbon
4. With a long match ignite and shake pan until flames die down-be careful
5. Remove shrimp to a warm platter
6. Add cream and tomato paste to pan
7. Bring to a boil and reduce until thickened
8. Add lemon juice , salt , pepper
9. Return shrimp to pan
10. Add chives
11. Garnish with pecans if desired
12. Serve over wild rice

title: chocolate swirl marble pound cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f grease a 10" tube pan
2. Beat sugar and butter until blended
3. Then increase speed to high and beat until light and fluffy
4. Add flour and remaining ingredients except cocoa
5. Beat at low speed until well mixed , scraping bowl often
6. Then increase to high and beat 4 minutes longer , scraping bowl as needed
7. Scoop out 2 1 / 2 cups of batter into a small bowl
8. Whisk in cocoa powder
9. Alternately spoon vanilla and chocolate batters into prepared tube pan
10. Using a knife , cut and twist through batter to create a marble effect
11. Bake 60 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean
12. Cool in pan on a wire rack for 10 minutes
13. Then run a spatula or knife around the pan to loosen the cake
14. Remove cake and cook on a wire rack

title: 4 pepper deviled eggs alton brown
steps:
1. Slice the eggs in half from top to bottom
2. Scoop the yolks into a medium mixing bowl and lay the whites aside
3. Place all of the peppercorns , except 1 / 4-1 / 2 teaspoon of the pink peppercorns , into a spice grinder and process until ground well
4. Add the ground peppers , caper liquid , mayonnaise , mustard , salt and sugar to the egg yolks and using a fork , stir to thoroughly combine
5. Place the mixture into a zip-top plastic bag and cut a small hole at one of the corners
6. Pipe the mixture into each of the white halves
7. Coarsely grind the remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon of pink peppercorns and use to garnish the top of each egg
8. Chill for at least 1 hour in the refrigerator before serving

title: arroz con frijoles a l espanola
steps:
1. In a saucepan , heat chicken broth and saffron to a boil
2. Reduce heat to low to
3. Keep warm
4. In a large saucepan or dutch oven , heat the olive oil over medium heat
5. Add the onions , green pepper , jalapeno pepper , and garlic and cook until the onion begins to soften , stirring
6. Occasionally , about 5 minutes
7. Add mushrooms and stir
8. Add wine and cook until almost evaporated , 1 to 2 minutes
9. Stir in chicken broth , with saffron , tomato sauce then season with salt and
10. Pepper
11. Cover ,
12. Reduce heat , and let cook until rice is tender , about 20 minutes (there should
13. Still be a little liquid , if not you can add a little water or broth)
14. Stir in peas and carrots and chopped tomato
15. Cook 5 minutes , covered
16. Garnish with red pepper strips , olives , capers , and fresh parsley

title: sugar free cooke
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Combine flour , salt , and baking soda in a small bowl
3. Combine butter , stevia , erythritol , vanilla , and beat until smooth
4. Add eggs one at a time , while continuing to stir
5. Combine dry and wet ingredients and stir
6. You may add 1 cup and / or 1 / 2 cup of coconut , but know , doing this will increase sugar count
7. On a buttered pan , place as many possible 2 cubic inches of batter
8. Bake 9-11 minutes

title: passionfruit and guava bellinis
steps:
1. Pour guava juice evenly between 6 champagne flutes
2. Spoon a little pasionfruit pulp into each glass
3. Fill flutes with sparkling wine to serve

title: whole wheat bread 100
steps:
1. Place about three cups of the 5-6 cups of whole wheat flour in the bowl of your stand-type mixer
2. Add the yeast
3. Carefully measure 2 cups room temperature water
4. The water should feel cool to the touch
5. Mix the water with the flour with a dough hook for 30 seconds or until the yeast is dissolved and the ingredients begin to combine
6. Add the salt , egg , sugar , and butter and continue mixing
7. Add most of the remaining flour and continue mixing at a medium speed for at least four minutes adding more flour as needed to reach a soft dough consistency
8. The dough should clear the sides of the bowl but will be soft , not firm , to the touch
9. Once the dough is mixed , place it in a large greased bowl , turning once to coat both sides , and cover with plastic wrap
10. Refrigerate overnight or for up to three days
11. On the day that you would like to bake your bread , remove the dough from the refrigerator and let it warm to room temperature--about three hours
12. The dough should rise to nearly double in size
13. Once the dough has risen , form the loaves
14. Coat your hands with flour and gently form a loaf by pulling the dough around itself to create a slightly stretched skin
15. You may need to coat your hands several times if the dough is sticky
16. If necessary , pinch the seams together on the bottom of the loaf
17. Lay the loaf gently in a well-greased loaf pan and cover with plastic wrap
18. Repeat with the second loaf
19. Let double again in size , about 1 1 / 2 hours
20. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
21. Once the dough has doubled , place the two loaves on a shelf in the top half of the oven , well-spaced so that air can circulate between the loaves
22. Bake for thirty minutes or until done
23. The interior of the loaves should register at least 185 degrees f when an insta-read thermometer is inserted through the bottom crust
24. Remove the bread from the pans and cool on wire racks
25. Let it cool completely before cutting

title: sweet southern cornbread ala nita
steps:
1. Preheat a 8 or 10 inch heavy skillet in 375f oven
2. Or , grease an 8x8x2-inch baking pan
3. In a large bowl , combine boiling water with cornmeal mix
4. Stir in well
5. Allow to sit about 3 to 5 minutes to absorb the water and burst the corn meal
6. Combine this mixture well with the remaining ingredients except baking soda
7. Add buttermilk slowly
8. Batter should be smooth and wet , but don't over mix
9. When mixed , just before pouring batter up , mix in the pinch of baking soda
10. Immediately pour batter into preheated oven and hot skillet or pan
11. Bake for about 40 minutes or until golden brown
12. Remove from pan and serve

title: banana bead for the bread machine
steps:
1. Combine bananas and sour cream or buttermilk into a small bowl and mash together with a fork until well blended and creamy
2. The mixture can be used immediately or stored in a refrigerator overnight
3. Place the banana mixture and the rest of the ingredients in the bread pan in the order listed
4. Set the program to the quick bread / cake cycle
5. Set the crust setting to medium if offered
6. Press start
7. The batter will be thick and smooth
8. After the first kneading cycle is finished , use a spatula to scrape any gathered flour mix from the corners and sides
9. When the bread machine beeps that it is finished , you can check that the bread is done by verifying that the bread has shrunk slightly from the sides of the pan , and the top is firm to gentle pressure
10. A toothpick or metal skewer will come out clean when inserted into the center of the bread
11. When done , immediately remove the pan from the machine
12. Let the bread stand in the pan for 15 minutes before turning it out , right side up , to cool completely
13. Wrap tightly in plastic wrap to store in the refrigerator

title: microwave layered pepperoni pizza dip
steps:
1. In a small bowl combine cream cheese with garlic , oregano and basil until well combined
2. Spread the mixture onto a microwave-safe glass 9 or 10-inch pie plate or a shallow baking dish
3. Sprinkle 1 cup of the mozzarella cheese on top of the cream cheese mixture , then 1 / 2 cup parmesan cheese
4. Spread all the pizza sauce over
5. Sprinkle with remaining mozzarella and parmesan cheese
6. Top with jalapeo pepper , green bell pepper , pepperoni then olives
7. Chill for a minimum of 1 hour or more
8. Cover with waxed pepper and microwave for 5-6 minutes , then sprinkle green onions over top before serving if desired

title: bierkutscher rouladen  beer coachman roulade   pork roulade
steps:
1. Peel the apples , remove core and chop into small cubes
2. In a large bowl , mix wine sauerkraut , crme frache and apples together
3. Lay flat the pork fillets , lay two pieces of bacon on the fillets and top with sauerkraut mixture
4. Roll up lengthwise , and put together toothpicks , usually 3 work , one on each end and one in the middle , but you might need more for bigger pieces
5. Heat oil in a pan and light fry on all sides
6. Meanwhile , heat up the malzbier and vegetable broth in a large pot
7. After fried , put in pot with malzbier and vegetable broth , add water or more malzbier to cover rouladen
8. Cook for about an hour at a simmer
9. Remove rouladen and put some of the liquid in a small sauce pan
10. Heat and whisk in sauce thicker until thick , add more sauce thicker , if necessary
11. If you are using cornstarch , dissolve first in cold water and then add to sauce
12. Serve rouladen with sauce on top and with kndel or sptzle

title: caesar salad dressing  cook yourself thin
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients into a small mixing bowl and whisk together
2. Taste and season

title: skinny dipper
steps:
1. Mix the first four ingredients in a pitcher and stir
2. Pour over ice and add a splash of grenadine

title: mold remover
steps:
1. In a spray bottle , combine the ingredients and spray generously on moldy surfaces
2. Wipe clean with a damp sponge
3. For shower walls , floors & corners i leave it on until the next shower

title: chili manicotti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cook manicotti shells as directed on package
3. Drain
4. Meanwhile , add oil to a large skillet and saute onion and garlic until tender
5. Stir in chili and water
6. Bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat and simmer 2 minutes
8. In a small bowl combine egg , cottage cheese and cheddar cheese
9. Stuff into manicotti shells
10. Spoon half the chili sauce into the bottom of a greased casserole dish
11. Place manicotti on top and cover with remaining sauce
12. Cover and bake for 30 minutes
13. Sprinkle with additional cheddar cheese and bake another 5 minutes

title: mom s sugar  n spice pork chops
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Sprinkle pork chops on both sides with salt and pepper
3. Spread mustard on both sides
4. Spread miraclewhip on one side , placing this side down in a 9" x 13" baking pan
5. Press brown suagar on top of chops
6. Pour milk evenly over chops
7. Bake 45-60 minutes , or until tender

title: gingerbread spelt waffles
steps:
1. Combine all the dry ingredients
2. Whisk together egg , milk , and melted coconut oil
3. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and combine well but do not over mix
4. Pour about 1 / 3 cup onto hot waffle iron and cook to desired brownness
5. Enjoy with maple syrup poured on top

title: halloween pumpkin soup with breadstick broomsticks
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a large pan , add the onion and garlic and cook for a few minutes to soften
2. Add the pumpkin and sweet potato and cook for a couple of mins , then add the water or stock
3. Season with salt and ground black pepper , cover and bring to the boil , then simmer for 25 mins until the pumpkin and sweet potato are really tender
4. Meanwhile , preheat the oven to 400f cut the breadstick dough in half lengthways , then make several cuts one third of the way up the length to look like broom bristles
5. Repeat with the other bread , put onto a large baking sheet and drizzle with olive oil
6. Bake for 5-8 mins until golden
7. Stir the milk into the soup , whiz everything together in blender or processor in batches until smooth
8. Return to the pan and gently warm through
9. Pour into bowls and finish with a swirl of cream

title: coffee barbecue sauce
steps:
1. Place all sauce ingredients in a saucepan
2. Bring to a full boil
3. Reduce heat to simmer and cook for 5 to 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. To cook raw chicken wings:
5. Pour sauce over raw wings
6. Bake for 1 or 2 hours at 350 degrees fahrenheit until done , basting occasionally

title: pheasant
steps:
1. Saute pheasants in butter 10 minutes
2. Remove from skillet and saute mushrooms in butter remaining in skillet 10 minutes return pheasant to skillet
3. Add wine , lemon juice , onions , salt and pepper
4. Cover and simmer 1 hour or until tender

title: original tater tot hotdish
steps:
1. Brown ground beef in a skillet
2. Preheat oven to 350f and spray a casserole with nonstick spray
3. Mix veggies , cream soup , and meat in casserole
4. Top with tater tots
5. Bake for 1 hour
6. Enjoy !

title: easy but elegant broccoli soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , melt the butter over medium heat
2. Cook the onion , carrot and garlic for 5 minutes
3. Stir in the stock and bring to a boil
4. Add the broccoli
5. Reduce the heat and simmer , covered , until the broccoli is tender , 15 to 20 minutes
6. In a blender or food processor , puree the soup in batches and transfer to a glass bowl
7. Stir in the cream
8. Season with salt and pepper to taste
9. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or until chilled
10. Sprinkle with parsley just before serving
11. If you prefer hot soup , serve when ready with a sprinkling of chopped parsley on each serving

title: pizza skillet
steps:
1. Cook noodles as package directs , drain
2. Set aside
3. In skillet brown beef and onion
4. Drain
5. Add tomato sauce , spaghetti sauce mix and water
6. Bring to a boil
7. Cover , reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes
8. Stir in cooked noodles
9. Top with cheese , cover and cook on low for 5 minutes , until cheese melts

title: turkish  kofte  sandwich
steps:
1. Chop onions , 1 clove of garlic and parsley
2. Mix the onions , garlic and parsley with the ground beef and a bit of salt and pepper
3. With your hands make walnut shaped little meatballs
4. You can either grill the meatballs , or cook them in some olive oil
5. In the meantime , mix the yoghurt with garlic and mint
6. Slice tomatoes , lettuce and cucumber
7. Now take a turkish bread cut in 4 squares , open them and 'butter up' the bread with the yoghurt dressing
8. Put in lettuce tomatoes , cucumbers and meatballs , and finish with some extra yoghurt dressing

title: balsamic marinade yum
steps: 1. Mix all ingredients , stir until brown sugar is dissolved

title: chicken   peppers
steps:
1. Toss chicken in the flour until lightly coated
2. Heat the oil in a skillet and fry the chicken quickly until lightly browned , then remove from the pan
3. It's ok if not cooked through yet
4. Add the onion to the pan and fry until translucent
5. Add the garlic , bell peppers , tomatoes and oregano , and bring to a boil
6. When boiling , arrange the chicken over the vegetables , season with salt and pepper , and cover tightly and simmer for 20-25 minutes
7. Enjoy !

title: hippie big sur brownies
steps:
1. Grease one 8x8 pan and preheat oven to 350
2. Melt chocolate and butter together in microwave
3. Remove from microwave and put in mixing bowl and stir
4. Add balance of ingredients and mix until everything is incorporated and smooth
5. Place in prepared pan
6. Bake 25-30 minutes and enjoy !

title: a quick and easy salad
steps: 1. Mix all together and serve

title: glazed carrots with pecan  apricot    raisin sauce   p c
steps:
1. Pour orange juice into a pressure cooker
2. Stir in carrots , preserves , raisins , brown sugar , and nutmeg
3. Secure lid
4. Over medium-high heat , develop steam to medium pressure
5. Reduce heat to maintain low pressure and cook 3 minutes
6. Quickly release pressure according to manufacturer's directions
7. Remove lid
8. Gently stir carrots
9. Sprinkle cornstarch into 1 / 2 cup of cooking liquid and stir to mix thoroughly
10. Cook over medium heat 1 minute
11. Stir in pecans

title: crepe cake with espresso chocolate glaze
steps:
1. Combine all crepe ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth
2. Allow batter to rest in the refrigerator at least half an hour
3. In a small bowl , dissolve espresso powder in water
4. In a medium saucepan , melt chocolate over medium-low heat
5. Add remaining ingredients and whisk thoroughly until smooth
6. Heat until just boiling , then remove from heat and scrape glaze into a bowl
7. Refrigerate until batter has finished resting
8. Bring an 8" non-stick pan to medium heat
9. Spray pan with cooking spray
10. Pour in a few tablespoons of batter and quickly tilt the pan so that the batter covers the bottom of the pan in a very thin layer
11. Cook crepe until edges barely start to peel away from pan
12. Gently slide a long metal offset spatula under the crepe and flip it over
13. Cook crepe just another minute and slide onto a plate
14. Spread crepe with a thin layer of glaze
15. Cook another crepe , stack on top of the first , and spread with a bit of butter
16. Cook another crepe , add to the stack , and sprinkle with powdered sugar using a sifter or strainer
17. Repeat this sequence until batter runs out , leaving top crepe bare
18. Spread remaining glaze over top crepe and allow it to drip down the sides
19. Slice with a sharp knife and serve
20. The cake will keep in the refrigerator for at least a day

title: minted apple fool
steps:
1. In a saucepan combine the apples , water , sugar , lemon juice and half the mint leaves
2. Cover and simmer for approximately 15 minutes or until the apples are soft
3. Puree mixture
4. Cool , refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours , fold in the cream and serve in glass bowls decorated with the remaining mint leaves

title: green chilies stuffed and fried  set your mouth on fire
steps:
1. Take 1 / 2 a tsp of oil and add the asafoetida , besan and the cumin , red chilli , dry mango powder and turmeric and cook on a very low flame , till the flour and cumin turn a golden brown in colour
2. Fill this mixture in the deseeded and slit green chillies
3. Heat 2 tsp oil in a fry pan , put the stuffed green chillies and cook for a while till the chillies get a little soft
4. Cry me a river !

title: pork spread
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a saucepan with enough water to make mushy
2. Simmer on low heat , stirring occasionally for 2 hours until water is evaporated
3. Put in bowl and keep refrigerated
4. Serve in a sandwich , on crackers , or on toast

title: emily s chex snack mix
steps:
1. Melt butter in a small saucepan and add garlic powder , seasoned salt and worcestershire sauce
2. Just to warm heat only
3. Using a large roasting pan with tall sides , pour in pretzels , cereals , crackers , cheerios and mix well
4. Drizzle butter mixture over all
5. Using a large spoon mix well to coat
6. Heat in a 250 degree oven for 45 minutes
7. Stir every 15 minutes
8. Let cool completely
9. Add cashews and peanuts
10. Store in air tight container

title: gordon ramsay s sticky lemon chicken
steps:
1. In a large skillet pan , add the oil to med / high heat
2. Season the chicken well with salt and pepper
3. Add the chicken to the skillet and cook for about 5-6 minutes , turning each piece
4. Add the garlic cloves , soy sauce , and honey to the pan , making sure to get all the chicken in the sauces
5. Coninue to cook for a 5 minutes
6. Add the water and lay the slices of lemon on top of the chicken in the pan
7. Put a lid on the pan and continue to cook for about 10-15 minutes
8. Season the chicken with thyme and parlsey
9. Continue to cook until the chicken cooked through and no longer pink

title: caramel apple cider
steps:
1. Fill a coffee cup with the apple juice and add the caramel syrup
2. Microwave on high 1 to 2 minutes
3. Stir until the caramel is fully mixed in with the juice
4. Top with whipped topping and sprinkle with cinnamon

title: chinese steamed chicken  and chinese sausage
steps:
1. Chop chicken into 1 1 / 2 to 2 inch pieces
2. In a large bowl , mix chicken with soy sauce , sugar , salt , cornstarch , sherry wine , and ginger juice
3. Remove stems from mushrooms that have been soaked and softened
4. Slice into long pieces
5. Stir mushrooms and larp chong into chicken
6. Put mixture into a 9 inch glass pie plate
7. Steam over boiling water for 25 minutes or cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high power for 13 - 16 minutes
8. Serve with steamed white rice

title: cherry chimichangas
steps:
1. Reserve one cup cherry pie filling for topping
2. Mix remaining pie filling with grated orange rind
3. Spoon onto centers of tortillas
4. Sprinkle a few almonds over pie filling
5. Fold in opposite sides of each tortilla and roll up covering pie filling
6. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
7. Fry chimichangas , two at a time , seam-side down , until golden brown
8. Drain on paper towels
9. Sift powdered sugar over each fritter and top with remaining cherry pie filling and almonds before serving

title: fruit stuffed pork tenderloin
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Place dried fruit mix in bowl and add boiling water
3. Set aside to rehydrate
4. Trim all fat and silverskin from tenderloin
5. Slit tenderloin lengthwise making a pocket for the stuffing
6. Sprinkle the inside with salt and pepper
7. Drain the fruit mix
8. Peel and core the apple and mix with fruit and place in meat pocket
9. Tie the meat with cord at 1-1 1 / 2 inch intervals
10. Place meat in 13x9x2 ungreased pan and roast uncovered for 20 minutes
11. Lower heat to 350f and roast for 20 minutes longer
12. Remove from oven and let stand for 20 minutes
13. Cut into 1 / 2 - 1 inch slices and serve

title: two step crunchy chicken strips
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Line a 15x10x1-inch baking pan with foil
3. Lightly coat foil with cooking spray
4. Set aside
5. In a shallow dish place the crushed crackers or pretzels
6. In another shallow dish place the ranch dressing or mustard
7. Dip chicken tenderloins into the dressing or mustard , allowing excess to drip off
8. Dip into cracker crumbs or crushed pretzels to coat
9. Arrange chicken in prepared pan
10. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink
11. Serve with additional ranch dressing or mustard

title: california rolls
steps:
1. Put sushi rice on a seat seaweed
2. Spread on seaweed evenly
3. Now turn the seaweed so that it comes up and the sushi rice comes down
4. Put the cucumber , avocado and crabstick in the center of the seaweed
5. Roll it up tightly
6. This becomes easy if you use plastic wrap
7. Put tobiko on top and cut into 6 pcs

title: aunt lee s oriental noodles
steps:
1. Add noodles to boiling water and then return to a boil for 1 minute
2. Drain and cut once or twice through the noodles so they are in slightly smaller pieces
3. Brown hamburger , add the garlic and sesame oil , and then saut for 1 minute
4. Add the remaining vegetables and stir fry with the meat
5. Remove pan from heat and add the salt and soy sauce before mixing in the noodles
6. Stir to mix and then serve

title: musetto
steps:
1. Put pork ribs , onion , peppers , tomatoes , potatoes , garlic , ginger and 3 cups of water in the crockpot
2. With one more cup of warm water , mix in the peanut butter and the turmeric until it forms a paste
3. Add this to the crockpot
4. Cook on low for 3 1 / 2 to 4 hours or cook in a regular pot on slow heat until the pork falls off the bone
5. Add the cilantro shortly before serving

title: low fat potato skins
steps:
1. Wash potatoes and wrap them each in foil
2. Bake on 425f for 1-1 1 / 2-until they feel soft
3. Cool a bit so they can be handled and then cut in half long ways
4. Scoop out the insides leaving just a bit of potato
5. Spray potatoes inside and out with pam and put back into 425f oven for 10 minutes or until a little crisp
6. Divide cheese and bacon bits evenly and fill the skins
7. Place back into oven for about 8 minutes or until cheese melts
8. When all cooked add what ever garnish that you would like and share !

title: corn souffle
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Melt the 1 / 2 cup of butter in a large casserole dish in the microwave
3. Mix the remaining ingredients in a large bowl until moistened
4. Pour into the casserole dish
5. Bake for 45 minutes to an hour or until it is golden brown on top
6. Bake a little longer for a more cake-like consistency or a little less if you want it more like a pudding

title: spinach and roasted garlic tart
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Add quinoa to medium pot and cover with water
3. Bring to a boil and cook for 5 minutes
4. Drain and remove to large bowl
5. In a food processor , process the tofu , roasted garlic , and oil until completely smooth , about 2 minutes
6. Add tofu mixture to the quinoa and stir in the spinach , herbs , salt and pepper
7. Prepare a 9-inch pie pan by coating with cooking spray
8. Pour in the quinoa mixture and place in oven for 30 minutes
9. Serve

title: croissants a l orange
steps:
1. Spray two 3-quart glass baking dishes with non-stick pan spray
2. Or grease baking dishes with butter
3. Cut croissants lengthwise with bottom being about 2 / 3 and top sliver 1 / 3 and arrange six in each baking dish
4. Thin marmalade with orange juice and spoon some over each bottom half of croissant
5. Replace croissant tops
6. Beat eggs , cream , extract and rind
7. Pour over croissants
8. Spoon remaining thinned marmalade on top as a glaze
9. Allow to soak overnight
10. Bake at 350f for 45 minutes or until firm
11. Serve hot , garnished with orange slices and strawberries
12. May also be topped with a spoonful of whipped cream
13. However , i found that the ones i get are very large so i have to cut them to fit in a baking dish and may not get all 6 in , but it will work fine as long as you fill the pan even if you need to use less than 6 croissants , also if i'm taking these to a friends house i will use those throw away aluminum baking tins

title: quick sourdough bread   overnight   for your bread machine
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine 1 cup water , 1 cup bread flour , 1 / 4 teaspoon sugar and 2 teaspoons yeast
2. Mix well
3. Cover with plastic and let sit in a warm location for 6 to 8 hours , or overnight
4. The next day , pour overnight starter into the pan of bread machine
5. Add remaining ingredients in the order recommended by the manufacturer
6. Select cycle
7. Press start
8. My machine from start to finsh is 2 1 / 2 hours

title: macaroni bean salad
steps:
1. Drain beans and place in a small bowl
2. Cover with vinegar and let sit 1 hr
3. Cook and drain rotini according to pkg directions
4. In a large bowl combine next 8 ingredients
5. Combine salad dressing , half and half , sugar , and mustard
6. Mix well and pour over all
7. Chill and serve

title: irish potatoes
steps:
1. Cream the butter and cream cheese
2. Add the vanilla
3. Add the 10x sugar a little at a time
4. Knead by hand
5. Refrigerate
6. Form into small balls and roll into cinnamon , sugar
7. Enjoy !

title: simple crock pot chicken with green beans
steps:
1. Place chicken breasts in bottom of cooker , sprinkle salt and pepper and garlic seasoning on breasts
2. Place potatoes over top chicken , then green beans on top
3. Pour dressing over top beans
4. Place lid on cooker and cook on low for 5 hrs

title: deconstructed sushi  vegetarian  vegan actually
steps:
1. Rinse and drain the rice two or three times
2. Combine the rice , water , and salt in a heavy saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat , cover , and simmer gently until the water is absorbed , about 45 minutes
3. Toast the nori in a preheated 300f degree oven or a medium-hot skillet for a few minutes
4. Crumble or chop coarsely
5. Drain the tofu and pat it dry
6. Cut the block of tofu lengthwise through the middle to make four 1 / 4-to 1 / 2-inch thick sheets of tofu
7. Two at a time , cook in a dry skillet or well-seasoned skillet over medium-high for a few minutes until browned on one side
8. Flip gently , then continue cooking for another minute or so , until the tofu is firm , golden , and bouncy
9. Let cool , enough to handle , then cute crosswise into matchsticks
10. Repeat with the remaining sheets
11. To make the dressing , combine the orange juice lemon juice , and sugar in a small saucepan and bring to a gentle boil
12. Cook for 1 or 2 minutes , the add the shoyu and vinegar
13. Return to a gentle boil and cook another 1 or 2 minutes , until slightly thickened
14. Remove from the heat and stir in the zests
15. When the rice is done , stir in 1 / 3 cup of the dressing and add more to taste
16. Scoop the rice into individual bowls and top with the toasted nori , green onions , tofu , avocado slices , and a sprinkling of sesame seeds

title: milk chocolate frosting
steps:
1. Instructions
2. Combine the chocolate chips , butter and salt in a medium microwave-safe bowl
3. Microwave the mixture on medium-high power for 1 minutes , stir
4. The morsels may retain some of their original shape
5. If necessary ,
6. Microwave at additional 10-15 seconds intervals , (to prevent burning
7. Of the chocolate) stirring just until smooth
8. Alternatively , you can
9. Melt the chocolate on a hot water bath
10. Transfer the mixture to a large mixer bowl
11. Stir in the vanilla
12. Extract
13. Gradually beat in the sugar , alternating with the milk until
14. You get a smooth frosting

title: rasagulla sweet milk balls
steps:
1. Mix both type of milk and spoil it with the lemon juice
2. Drain out the water from it and put the milk consistency in a cheese cloth
3. Press the milk consistency in the cheese cloth with some heavy weight , so that all the remaining water comes out completely
4. It will take about 45 minuts
5. Take out the milk consistency and rub finely with your hand or in a powerfull morter mixer
6. As fine as you can
7. Make samll walnut size round balls
8. For sugar syrup
9. In a pressure cooker or in a large pan mix the sugar and water and allow to just boil
10. When the syrup starts boiling , drop in the balls
11. If you are making in a pressure cooker close the lid and allow to cook for 15 minutes under medium heat
12. Do not allow the pressure cooker to whistle
13. So keep the flame of gas on medium
14. If you are making in a sauce pan , drop in the balls when the syrup boils and simmer it for about 25 minuts on medium flame of gas
15. Allow to cool it completely
16. When it is cold enough mix the rose syrup and put the milk balls in the fridge
17. It remains fresh for 1 week
18. But in usa fresh milk is impossible to find

title: creamy pasta and sausage
steps:
1. Take sausage out of casings and crumble
2. Put olive oil and chopped garlic in a skillet and turn the heat to medium
3. When the garlic becomes pale gold , add the sausage
4. Turn from time to time , until nicely browned all over , about 15 minutes
5. Add the tomato and cook , uncovered , stirring occasionally , adjusting the heat if necessary so it will cook at a gentle simmer
6. After about 20 minutes , when the fat separates from the other juices and floats free , add the cream and turn up the heat
7. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes , stirring frequently , until the cream is reduced
8. Add salt and a liberal grinding of pepper
9. Turn off the heat and stir in the chopped parsley
10. Cook pasta in pot of boiling salted water
11. When tender , but firm to the bite , drain
12. Toss immediately with sauce
13. Serve at once with freshly grated parmesan cheese
14. It should be reheated gently when the pasta is almost cooked
15. I always double the sauce because in my house there never seems to be enough
16. My family loves this sauce
17. Double everything except the sausage , pasta and parmesan cheese to double the sauce

title: prayer bars
steps:
1. 1st layer :
2. Melt butter and cocoa
3. Add graham crackers , vanilla , egg , 1 / 2 cup powdered sugar , coconut , and chopped nuts
4. Press mixture into a 9x13 pan
5. Put in refrigerator to set while making 2nd layer
6. 2nd layer:
7. Cream butter until light and fluffy
8. Mix in milk and pudding
9. Beat in 2 cups powdered sugar until smooth
10. Spread over first layer
11. Put in refrigerator to set
12. Top:
13. When set , melt chocolate bar and spread over top

title: hoisin glazed chicken with cabbage slaw
steps:
1. Heat broiler on high
2. Rinse the cutlets and pat dry with paper towls
3. Pound the cutlets to an even thinness
4. Place on a broiler pan
5. In a small bowl , whisk together the hoisin sauce , soy sauce , 1 t
6. Of the rice vinegar , and the fish sauce
7. Transfer 2 t
8. Of the glaze to a large bowl and stir in the remaining rice vinegar
9. Add the cabbage , peppers , scallions , and cilantro and toss
10. Cover and refrigerate
11. Pour about 1 t
12. Of the remaining glaze into a small bowl
13. Set aside as a finishing sauce
14. Brush the chicken with the glaze that remains
15. Broil , brushing occasionally , until cooked through , 5 to 8 minutes
16. Spoon the reserved glaze over the top
17. Serve with the slaw

title: shrimp scramble
steps:
1. Beat eggs with milk in a bowl
2. Add shrimp , salt , pepper and mustard and stir
3. Toast the muffins , butter them and keep them warm
4. In a skillet over medium heat , melt 1 tablespoon of butter
5. Add egg mixture and cook , stirring lightly with a fork
6. When eggs are set and creamy , spoon them over the toasted muffin halves and serve immediately

title: white beans with sage
steps:
1. Let the oil get heated in a large nonstick skillet over med-high heat
2. Add in onion , fennel , and garlic
3. Stir / saute 3-5 minutes or until softened
4. Add in the cannellini beans and sage
5. Cook 1 minute
6. Add in the lemon juice
7. Cook 1 minute
8. Remove from heat and stir in the lemon zest , salt , and pepper

title: parsley salad ala nigella lawson
steps:
1. Place drained capers in a small bowl of cold water and let soak about 10 minutes
2. Meanwhile , wash , stem , and drain parsley well
3. Set parsley on a large plate or small platter in a big mound
4. Slice as many red onion slivers as you like and sprinkle over the parsley
5. Drain capers again and sprinkle over the salad
6. Squeeze the juice of 1 / 2 a fresh lemon over the salad
7. Drizzle with a spalsh of good quality extra virgin olive oil and a few grinds of black pepper
8. No need to add any salt- the capers are salty enough
9. Do not toss
10. Wait 5 minutes , then serve

title: nioise steak salad
steps:
1. Stir together the vinaigrette and mustard
2. Set aside 1 / 2 cup
3. Combine flank steak and remaining vinaigrette mixture in shallow dish or resealable plastic bag
4. Cover or seal and marinate in the refrigerator at least 2 hours
5. About 30 minutes before you plan to eat , start preparing the salad
6. Bring the cold water and eggs to a boil
7. Remove from heat , cover and let them sit off the heat for about 15 minutes
8. Rinse eggs in cold water until they have cooled
9. Peel eggs , slice , and set aside
10. While eggs are cooking , place potatoes and cold water in a heavy saucepan
11. Bring to a simmer and cook , uncovered , for about 10-15 minutes depending on the size of the potatoes , until they are just tender , being careful not to overcook
12. When they are cool , peel the potatoes , quarter them , and set aside
13. Then , in a medium saucepan bring salted water to a boil , and cook the beans until crisp-tender , about 5 minutes
14. Drain beans in a colander , rinse under cold water to stop the cooking and drain again
15. Pat dry and set aside
16. Drain steak and discard marinade
17. Grill , covered , over medium-high heat 6-8 minutes on each side or to desired doneness
18. Slice diagonally across the grain
19. Prepare the salad by combining the eggs , potatoes and beans
20. Mix them with the mixed greens and olives
21. Toss the steak slices gently with the salad and drizzle with the remaining 1 / 2 cup vinaigrette mixture

title: south beach thai shrimp soup with lime and cilantro
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large pot
2. Add ginger and onion
3. Cook , stirring frequently for about 3 minutes
4. Add broth and red pepper flakes and bring to a low boil
5. Add cabbage and cook for approximately 2 to 3 minutes
6. Add shrimp , lime zest and lime juice
7. Cook just until shrimp turns pink
8. Serve hot sprinkled with cilantro or scallions

title: the only carrot cake recipe you will ever need
steps:
1. Grate the carrots into the medium bowl
2. Combine grated carrots and brown sugar
3. Set aside for 60 minutes
4. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
5. Grease and flour two 10 inch cake pans
6. In large bowl , beat eggs until light
7. Gradually beat in the white sugar , oil , and vanilla
8. Stir in the pineapple if using
9. Combine the flour , baking soda , salt and cinnamon , stir into the wet mixture add the walnuts if using
10. Finally stir in the carrot mixture and the walnuts
11. Pour evenly int the prepared pans
12. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes in the preheated oven , until cake tests done with a toothpick come out clear
13. Cool for 10 minutes before removing from pan
14. When completely cooled , frost with cream cheese frosting

title: potato salad with mustard dressing and bacon
steps:
1. Whisk mayonnaise , mustard , vinegar and garlic in medium bowl to blend
2. Season to taste with salt and pepper
3. Cover , chill
4. Cook bacon in large skillet until crisp
5. Drain on paper towels
6. Crumble
7. Boil potatoes in large pot until just tender
8. Drain and transfer to a large bowl
9. Cool for 15 minutes or so
10. Mix bacon , celery , green and red onions , eggs and dressing into potatoes
11. Season with additional salt and pepper if needed
12. Chill
13. While chilling the potatoes soak up a good bit of the dressing and if not careful it can become dry
14. If this happens just moisten with a small amount of milk and stir to encorporate

title: smoky waldorf salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl , toss the diced apples and pears in the lemon juice
2. Add the celery , onion , pecans , and smoked gouda
3. Stir together the dijon mustard , sugar , black pepper and mayonnaise
4. Gently fold into the salad and mix well
5. Add salt , if needed , to taste
6. Chill until ready to serve
7. Serve on a bed of baby spinach or other greens

title: mamie eisenhower s favorite million dollar fudge
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , combine the sugar , salt , milk , and butter
2. Bring to a vigorous boil , stirring often
3. Then reduce heat and simmer 6 minutes , stirring continuously
4. Meanwhile , place the chocolate , marshmallow creme and vanilla into a large bowl
5. Gradually pour boiling syrup over the chocolate-marshmallow mixture and beat until chocolate is melted
6. Stir in nuts
7. Pour into a buttered pan and store in a cool place several hours to harden before cutting into 1-inch squares
8. Store in a covered tin
9. Keeps up to 6 months in a cool place

title: crab dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Mix cream cheese with horseradish , worcestershire , tabasco , and lemon juice
3. Gently fold in minced onion and crab
4. Bake for 30 min or until bubbly and edges start to brown
5. Serve with pita chips or crackers

title: sara lee   pound cake   copycat
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Spray 8-1 / 2" pyrex loaf dish with pam
3. Cream butter with sugar on high speed of mixer for 5 minutes
4. Add 1 egg and then a little flour , beating 2 minutes
5. Add 2nd egg and half of remaining flour and beat 2 minutes
6. Add sour cream , rest of flour and extracts , beating 2 minutes
7. Spread batter evenly in dish
8. Bake for 65 minutes or until tester comes out clean
9. Remove from dish
10. Slice 1 / 2" thick
11. Be sure to slice before freezing loaf
12. Thaw to use within 6 months

title: ring around the meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Fill large saucepan with water & pinch of salt
3. Put on high heat to boil
4. In large bowl , combine all meatloaf ingredients - mix well with your hands
5. When water is boiling , add peeled potatoes
6. Boil potatoes for 20-25 minutes or until tender
7. Place meatloaf in shallow 2 quart baking dish sprayed with cooking spray
8. Form mixture into a ring , leaving an open center
9. Top with ketchup , if desired
10. Bake meatloaf ring at 400 degrees for 30 minutes
11. While meatloaf is baking , drain cooked potatoes & place in medium bowl
12. Add remaining ingredients
13. Mix well with mixer
14. Remove dish from oven when done
15. Spoon mashed potatoes into the open center of the dish
16. Return dish to oven for 7-10 minutes
17. Add a bit of italian herb seasoning & parsley flakes to top of potatoes when finished

title: crawfish pasta
steps:
1. Melt butter and saute onion , bell pepper and green onions until tender
2. Add garlic , crawfish , seafood seasoning , crab boil , and wine
3. Saute for a few minutes
4. Add soup and stir until blended
5. Simmer until smooth and heated through
6. Toss with bowtie pasta , a little at a time until coated how you like

title: maple leaves
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl beat butter with an electric mixer on medium to high speed 30 seconds
2. Add brown sugar , soda , and salt
3. Beat until combined
4. Beat in egg , maple syrup , and vanilla
5. Beat in whole wheat flour and as much of the all-purpose flour as you can with the mixer
6. Stir in remaining flour
7. Divide dough in half
8. Cover
9. Chill 3 hours or until easy to handle
10. On a lightly floured surface , roll each portion of dough to 1 / 8-inch thickness
11. Using 2 1 / 2- to 3-inch leaf cookie cutters dipped into flour , cut into leaf shapes
12. Place 1 inch apart on an ungreased cookie sheet
13. Bake in a 375 degree f oven 7 to 8 minutes or until edges are firm
14. Remove from cookie sheet and cool on a wire rack
15. For the maple frosting , beat together sifted powdered sugar and softened butter or margarine
16. Beat in enough maple syrup or maple-flavored syrup to make easy to spread
17. Frost with maple frosting
18. Let frosting set
19. Place in an airtight container
20. Store at room temperature up to 3 days

title: green tomato hot dog relish
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine green tomatoes , onions and pickling salt
2. Cover and let stand overnight
3. Steriloize 6 1 / 2 pint jars
4. Rinse tomatoes & onions well , drain and rinse out excess moisture
5. In a large saucepan combine vinegar , garlic , brown sugar , mustard , sal t& ginger
6. Tie cloves , cinnamon stick & celery seed in a square of cheese cloth , add to the pickling liquid
7. Bring to a boil , add tomatoes , onions , & peppers simmer for 1 hour stirring frequently
8. Ladle relish into hot sterilized jars to within 1 / 2" of top , release air bubbles by running a spatula around the inside of the jar , cover with heated snap lid , screw on band
9. Bring water in a large pot to a boil , place jars in and water process for 10 minutes

title: black bean and rice soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan cook onion , celery , bell pepper and carrots in chicken broth till tender
2. Stir in beans , rice , salsa and seasonings
3. Bring to a boil , turn off heat , cover and let stand 5 minutes

title: soy mirin glazed tofu fried rice
steps:
1. For the tofu:
2. Heat 1 teaspoons oil over medium heat in non-stick pan
3. Add tofu and cook till seared on all sides , about 10 minutes
4. Stir tamari and mirin together and pour over tofu , stirring to coat well
5. Leave over heat till sauce bubbles up and glazes
6. Remove pan from heat and set aside
7. For the fried rice:
8. Heat 1 t
9. Oil in a large wok over high heat
10. When oil is hot , add garlic , scallions , and ginger and cook for 1 minute , stirring often
11. Add bell peppers , peas , broccoli , and carrots and cook till veggies have softened a bit , about 3 minutes
12. Add rice and stir to mix evenly
13. Cook till rice is heated through , about 3 minutes
14. Push rice up the sides of the wok to clear a spot in the middle of the pan
15. Add remaining 1 teaspoons oil and heat for a few seconds , then add beaten eggs and cook till scrambled
16. Stir everything in the wok together well , then add tamari
17. Stir in glazed tofu and serve

title: mom s cranberry walnut bread
steps:
1. Mix cranberries and 1 cup sugar and let stand overnight
2. Mix together flour , 1 cup sugar , baking powder , baking soda and salt
3. Sift together
4. In a bowl , mix together eggs , orange juice , hot water , melted butter , orange rind and chopped walnuts
5. Add to dry ingredients
6. Stir in cranberries and pour mixture into two greased and floured bread pans
7. Bake for 1 hours at 325 degrees

title: easy trifle
steps:
1. Slice chocolate roll / cake and arrange to cover 9" x 13" glass dish
2. Drain the peach slices and sprinkle about 2 to 3 tbs of its syrup on the cake
3. Custard
4. Mix milk , sugar and custard and stir over slow heat until thicken
5. Mix vanilla and egg yolk , stir
6. Remove from heat , mix butter
7. Pour custard over the cake and spread out the custard all over the cake so that there is no gap
8. Arrange the peaches slice on custard
9. Make the jelly according to the packing instructions
10. Pour over the custard and peaches
11. Cool in the refrigerator

title: parmesan fettuccine
steps:
1. Cook fettuccine according to package directions and drain
2. In a large skillet , melt butter over low heat
3. Add fettucine and toss until coated
4. Sprinkle witih parmesan cheese and pepper
5. Toss to coat

title: curried chicken and artichoke hearts casserole
steps:
1. Heat olive oil and saute garlic and drained artichoke hearts together
2. Put mixture in a greased 9 x 13 pan
3. Mix together mayonnaise , soup , lemon juice and curry powder and pour over the chicken and artichoke hearts
4. Top with bread cubes and cheese then drizzle melted butter over top
5. Bake at 350 for 25 minutes or until bubbly

title: super double chocolate cookies
steps:
1. Cream together first 5 ingredients
2. Add remaining ingredients
3. Arrange on cookies sheet , bake at 350 for 8-9 minutes

title: hot dog on a stick
steps:
1. Preheat fryer to 375
2. Dry hot dogs with paper towels and put on stick , set aside
3. Combine flour , cornmeal , sugar , salt , and baking soda in a mixing bowl
4. Combine milk and egg yolk to dry ingredients , mix until smooth
5. Dip hot dog with batter and put in oil , spinning it slowly so it cooks evenly
6. Cook for 5 minutes or till brown

title: roasted asparagus with browned butter
steps:
1. Preheat over 450 degrees
2. Place asparagus in a roasting pan
3. Drizzle iwth olive oil
4. Sprinkle evenly with salt and pepper
5. Bake for 8 minutes or until tender-crisp
6. In the meantime , melt butter and minced garlic in a small skillet over medium-high heat
7. Cook 3 minutes or until lightly browned and foamy , shaking pan occasionally
8. Do not burn
9. Remove from heat
10. Stir in lemon juice
11. Drizzle butter mixture over roasted asparagus , toss well to coat
12. Srinkle lemon zest over asparagus

title: sweet and sour skillet chicken
steps:
1. Cut chicken in strips
2. In large skillet bring chicken and stock to simmer over medium high heat
3. Add celery , onion and sweet peppers
4. Cook , stirring often , for about 5 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink and vegetables are tender crisp
5. Mix together juice , vinegar , brown sugar , corn starch and soya sauce until blended stir into skillet and bring to a boil
6. Cook , stirring , for about 2 minutes until glossy and thickened
7. Add pineapple
8. Simmer for about 2 minutes or until heated through

title: speedy gonzales chicken soup
steps:
1. Heat half of the oil in a good-sized saucepan , cook chicken until lightly browned and cooked right through
2. Remove chicken from pan and shred into small strips
3. Heat remaining oil in same pan , cook onion 3-4 minutes or until soft
4. Add flour to pan and stir for 1 minute
5. Add stock and juice 1 cup at a time , waiting until mixture thickens slightly after each addition
6. Add chicken , corn and chilli
7. Stir until heated through
8. Serve topped with cilantro

title: asparagus omelet w shrimp hollandaise sauce  for andi
steps:
1. For sauce - place egg yolks , lemon juice & pepper in blender container & blend till lemon-colored
2. Turn blender to high & very slowly add butter
3. Blend till thick
4. Pour sauce into top of a dbl boiler , stir in baby shrimp & set aside
5. For omelets - whisk eggs w / water , salt & pepper till well-mixed
6. Melt 1 tbsp butter in an omelet pan or suitable non-stick skillet
7. Pour in half the egg mixture & cook , lifting the edge of the omelet to let the egg mixture run onto the pan
8. When the omelet is well-set , gently slide the omelet onto a plate , place 4-5 asparagus spears in the center , fold over & keep warm while you prepare the 2nd omelet in the same way
9. To serve - heat shrimp hollandaise sauce slowly in top of dbl boiler over hot water , spoon sauce over omelets , sprinkle w / parsley if using & serve immediately
10. These are lrg omelets & the recipe stated it served 2
11. However , if you serve w / bread , fruit or other breakfast / brunch item , this recipe definitely serves 4 imo

title: broccoli slaw manicotti with roasted red pepper sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cook manicotti shells according to package directions and be sure to salt your water
3. Drain the manicotti shells and let cool
4. Meanwhile , saute the broccoli slaw and garlic in the olive oil until softened
5. In a mixing bowl , combine eggs , ricotta cheese , mozzarella cheese , parmesan cheese , italian seasonings , salt and pepper
6. Add the broccoli slaw mixture and combine
7. I put the cheese mixture in a large freezer bag and cut off a corner
8. Place stuffed manicotti shells in a 13x9 baking dish sprayed with cooking spray
9. Next combine the diced tomatoes with the chopped red peppers
10. I use a blender to combine them together because my family doesn't like "chunky" sauces
11. Top the manicotti with the sauce and bake covered for 30 minutes
12. You can uncover the dish add extra mozzarella on top for the last 10 minutes of baking
13. Yum !

title: vanilla and coconut muffins
steps:
1. In large bowl mix together flour , coconut , baking powder and brown sugar
2. In separate bowl mix together butter , milk , egg and vanilla
3. Make well in centre of dry ingredients and add milk mixture
4. Stir to just combine
5. Spoon batter into prepared muffin pans and bake at 190 c for 10-15 minutes
6. Top with vanilla icing and sprinkle with coconut
7. To make icing mix ingredients together

title: pumpkin fluff dip
steps:
1. Beat with an electric mixer until smooth and perfectly melded
2. Let sit for 1 minute
3. Serve with sliced fruits like apples and pears , dried pears and dates , graham crackers , pieces of pound cake , etc

title: st  patrick s day rice krispie treats
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , melt butter over low heat
2. Add the marshmallows and continue to stir until the marshmallows have completely melted
3. Add the green sprinkles , stir well
4. Remove from heat
5. Stir in the kellogg's rice krispies cereal coating them well with the melted marshmallow mixture
6. Using a buttered or silicone spatula , press the mixture evenly into a 13 x 9 x 2 inch pan which has been buttered or sprayed with non-stick spray or lined with wax paper
7. Cut into squares when the mixture cools

title: chicken lime chopped salad
steps:
1. Combine lettuce , tomatoes , avocado , celery , radishes and cucumber in a salad bowl
2. Blend lime vinaigrette ingredients together
3. Lime juice , olive oil , garlic , salt and pepper
4. Mix chopped cooked chicken with lime vinaigrette
5. Toss chicken vinaigrette mixture with vegetables and serve

title: aubergine  eggplant   courgette and chickpea stew
steps:
1. Cut the top off and wash the aubergines
2. Prick them with a fork and microwave on high for 5 minutes each
3. Fry the onions , garlic and chili in the oil for a few minutes
4. Add the spices and continue to fry
5. Add the courgettes and chickpeas
6. Chop the baked aubergine and add
7. Add the tomatoes , tomato puree and stock and season as required
8. Bring to the boil and then simmer for around 15 minutes
9. Serve with crusty bread , rice , bulghar wheat--whatever you want and enjoy !

title: oreo cream cheese cookies
steps:
1. Cream together butter and sugar
2. Blend in the cream cheese and vanilla , then mix in flour , and add chocolate chips last
3. Chill dough for 1 hour
4. Preheat oven to 375
5. Create 1 inch round balls of dough , roll them in the oreos , and place on cookie sheet
6. Bake on center rack about 14-15 minutes
7. Allow to cool before serving

title: skillet biscuit bread
steps:
1. Combine flour , buttermilk , and oil in a large bowl and stir with a fork
2. Using floured hands , gently knead dough in bowl to form a ball
3. Dough will be sticky
4. Generously oil a straight sided , heavy 8 or 9 inch skillet and set over medium heat
5. Pat dough into skillet
6. Cook over medium heat until set and browned in spots on the bottom , 7 to 8 minutes
7. Using a spatula , slide or lift onto a plate
8. Invert into a skillet and cook until other side is browned in spots and bread is thoroughly cooked , 5 to 6 minutes
9. Transfer to a plet and cut into wedges
10. Serve hot , warm or at room temperature

title: frozen peanut butter chocolate pie  no bake
steps:
1. In bowl , stir wafer crumbs with butter until thoroughly moistened
2. Pat onto bottom only of 9-inch pie plate
3. Freeze for 20 minutes
4. Filling: in bowl , whisk together sour cream , sugar and whipping cream
5. Whisk in peanut butter until smooth
6. Spread evenly over crust
7. Freeze for 1 hour
8. Topping: meanwhile , in small saucepan , melt chocolate with cream over medium-low heat , stirring until smooth
9. Let cool for 15 minutes
10. Spread chocolate mixture evenly over filling
11. Sprinkle peanuts around edge of pie
12. Freeze for about 1 hour or until completely set
13. Let stand at room temperature for 10 minutes before serving

title: john hinterbergers clam spaghetti
steps:
1. Put 1 / 2 cup olive oil in a large cast iron skillet and heat slowly
2. Add the dried chili pepper , chopped onion and garlic cloves
3. Cook slowly for about 30 minutes or until the onions are very soft
4. Add to pan the basil , oregano , salt and pepper , wine and liquid from the clams
5. Continue to simmer until some of the liquid is reduced down
6. Keep warm
7. In the meantime , saut the mushrooms in a tablespoon of butter and add to the mixture
8. Bring kettle of water to a boil
9. Add a tablespoon of salt and 1 tablespoon of oil
10. Cook spaghetti until just al dente
11. As pasta is cooking , add the clams , parsley and 3 tablespoons of cheese to the sauce and simmer at low heat for about five minutes
12. Add olives
13. After draining the pasta , stir into the sauce and toss
14. Sprinkle generously with grated cheese and serve directly from the skillet

title: naan style flatbread
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
2. Lightly spray a baking sheet with cooking spray
3. Set aside
4. Remove pizza crust from can and unroll onto baking sheet
5. Using your hands , press out the dough until it is approximately 1 / 4-inch thick
6. Brush the dough with melted butter and sprinkle with seeds
7. Bake until lightly golden , about 10 to 12 minutes
8. Cut into serving size pieces

title: cheesy chipotle chops
steps:
1. Cook macaroni according to directions on the box , set aside , keeping warm
2. Brown chops in oil over medium / high heat for 10 minutes , or until almost cooked
3. Time depends on the thickness of the chops
4. Lower heat to medium / medium-low and remove chops , set aside keeping warm
5. Sprinkle flour into pan , just like you are going to make a roux
6. Allow to cook for two or three minutes so that you don't get a floury taste in your sauce
7. Slowly add milk , go slowly , you might want to use a whisk
8. Bring sauce just to a boil and add chipotles
9. Start adding cheese a little at a time and stir well until melted
10. Put chops back in pan and cook over low heat until chops are done about 5-10 minutes
11. Right before serving , stir in cilantro
12. Serve over elbow macaroni and top with chopped tomatoes
13. I actually never removed the chops , sprinkled the flour directly over them and made my sauce around the them
14. I also threw the macaroni into the pan for the last few minutes and stirred it in so that each noodle would be totally coated with cheesey sauce

title: godiva liqueur coupe
steps:
1. Put 1 tablespoon of chocolate liqueur into the bottom of each of 4 parfait glasses or large wine goblets
2. Top with a couple of peach slices and a spoonful of ice cream
3. Repeat until there are 3 layers of godiva , peaches , and ice cream
4. Top with remaining godiva and whipped cream

title: wild blueberry muffin peach cobbler
steps:
1. In a 2-quart baking dish add 1 can of peaches and juice and 1 can without juices
2. Next add can of blueberries from muffin mix and juices , do not drain , mix fruits well
3. In a large bowl combine muffin mix , water& oil , just until mixed
4. Pour over fruit and place in a 425f preheated oven
5. Bake for about 20 minutes

title: turtle brownies
steps:
1. Grease 9 x 13 glass dish well
2. Mix cake mix , butter and 1 / 2 of evaporated milk
3. Pour 1 / 2 of cake mix into baking dish , mixture will be thick
4. Bake cake at temperature on box for 18 minutes
5. While cake is baking-- peel paper from caramels
6. In microwave bowl put other 1 / 2 of evaporated milk and caramels
7. Melt on medium stirring after 30 seconds intervals till caramels are melted
8. Mixture will be very hot careful !
9. Remove cake from oven and pour caramel mixture over cake
10. Spread chocolate chips over and then sprinkle pecans over chocolate
11. Pour rest of batter over the filling and bake again 18 minutes
12. Let cool before cutting into squares

title: japanese take out ginger salad dressing
steps:
1. Combine the vinegar , tomato paste , soy sauce , salt , ginger , sugar , sesame oil , celery , and onion in a blender
2. Pulse several times , until the celery and onion are finely chopped
3. When the blender running , slowing drizzle in the canola oil

title: chili soup
steps:
1. Brown beef and onion
2. Stir in chili powder
3. Add kidney beans , tomatoes and water
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce to simmer and cook covered for 1 1 / 2 hours
6. Fold in cooked macaroni and simmer for 15 minutes more
7. May be prepared ahead and refrigerated
8. Serves 10

title: spaghetti frittata
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine pasta , half of the marinara sauce , and torn basil
2. Toss together
3. Heat oil in a large , broilerproof nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
4. Add pasta and marinara sauce mixture and cook , stirring , about 3 minutes or until heated through
5. Pour beaten egg mixture over spaghetti
6. Reduce heat to medium-low
7. Cook , without stirring , until eggs start to set on the bottom
8. Using a spatula , push in sides occasionally to let uncooked egg run underneath , about 8 minutes
9. Heat broiler
10. Remove skillet from heat
11. Sprinkle top of frittata with asiago cheese
12. Place skillet under broiler until cheese melts , about 1 minute
13. Slide frittata out of skillet onto cutting board
14. Cut into 6 wedges
15. Heat remaining marinara sauce in microwave and serve alongside frittata for dipping
16. Garnish with basil sprigs or arugula leaves , if desired

title: hg s stuffed chick cordon bleu   ww points   5
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Put chicken in a large sealable plastic bag , squeeze out as much air as you can , and seal
3. Using a meat tenderizer or a can , carefully pound chicken through the bag until it is about 1 / 4-inch thick
4. Remove chicken from the bag , and season to taste with salt and pepper on both sides
5. Lay the chicken flat and spread the cheese wedge over it
6. Evenly layer the ham slices on top of the cheese
7. Starting with one of the longer sides , tightly roll up the chicken breast cutlet , and secure with toothpicks
8. Place chicken roll in a baking dish lined with foil and / or sprayed with nonstick spray , and then cover the baking dish with foil
9. Bake in the oven for 20 minutes
10. Carefully remove the foil covering the dish
11. Continue to bake for an additional 15 minutes , or until chicken is cooked through
12. Enjoy !

title: diabetic pizza pockets
steps:
1. Open dough can and place on a work surface
2. Roll out and cut two 6-inch circles
3. Rework scraps , roll out , and cut out another two 6-inch circles for a total of 4 circles
4. Discard remaining scraps
5. Place the dough circles on the work surface
6. Spread each circle with 1 tablespoon pizza sauce to within 1 / 4 inch of the edge
7. Place 1 / 4 cup of the mozzarella cheese near the center of each circle
8. Top each with 1 tablespoon ricotta cheese and sprinkle with 1 / 4 teaspoon oregano
9. Dampen the edges of each circle with a little water
10. Fold circles in half , enclosing the cheese filling
11. Crimp the edges by pressing down with the tines of a fork along the edge
12. Cut two small slits in the top for steam vents
13. Cover and refrigerate until ready to bake
14. Preheat oven to 425f
15. Lightly coat a baking sheet with cooking spray
16. Place pizza pockets on prepared baking sheet
17. Bake until golden brown , about 10 minutes
18. Allow to cool for a few minutes before eating

title: pink adobe french apple pie
steps:
1. Set oven rack in lowest position and preheat to 450
2. Roll out half the pastry and use to line a 9-inch pi plate
3. Place apples in pastry shell , mounding them toward the center
4. Sprinkle with lemon juice , nutmeg , and cinnamon
5. Spread 6 tablespoons of the granulated sugar and all of the raisins evenly over apples
6. In a separate bowl , mix brown sugar , flour , and butter until well blended and spread this mixture over the apples
7. Sprinkle with pecans , and add 3 tablespoons of the milk
8. Roll out remaining pastry and place on pie
9. Seal and flute the edges
10. Cut steam vents
11. Brush top crust with remaining milk , and sprinkle with remaining granulated sugar
12. Bake 10 minutes , and then reduce oven temperature to 350 and bake an additional 30 minutes until crust is golden brown and filling is bubbly
13. Meanwhile make the hard sauce
14. In a medium bowl , cream butter until fluffy , add powdered sugar and boiling water , and beat until well blended
15. Beat in rum or brandy
16. Set aside
17. Cool pie briefly then cut in wedges
18. Serve on warmed pates topped with hard sauce
19. Let each slice stand a few minutes before serving so sauce has time to melt down into the filling

title: aunt roxie s perfect pumpkin pie
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients
2. Pour into pie shell
3. Bake at 425 for 15 minute then reduce heat to 350 and bake for 40 to 50 minutes longer , until done

title: lemon cheesecake pie
steps:
1. Bake refrigerated piecrusts in 425 oven for 5- 8 minutes or until light golden brown
2. Cool crusts completely on wire racks
3. Beat cream cheese , sugar and egg at low speed with an electric mixer until smooth
4. Spread cream cheese mixture evenly over both cooled crusts
5. Whisk together the ingredients for the lemon chess pie filling
6. Pour immediately over the cream cheese mixture in crusts
7. Bake at 350 for 35 minutes or until set
8. If needed , shield crust edges with foil to prevent excess browning
9. Cool completely on wire racks
10. Garnish with whipped cream , if desired

title: crunchy ranch chicken wings
steps:
1. Remove wing
2. Cut or separate wing portions
3. If wet , pat dry with a paper towel
4. In a small bowl combine onion powder , italian seasoning , bread crumbs , cornmeal and parmesan cheese
5. In separate small bowl pour ranch dressing
6. Sprinkle wings with salt and pepper
7. Dip wing portions into ranch dressing , then coat with crumb mixture
8. Place chicken wings onto a sprayed or greased 9 x 13 baking pan
9. Bake uncovered in a 375 degree oven for 45 minutes or until light brown
10. Enjoy !

title: lemon parsley rice
steps:
1. Bring broth to a boil , stir in rice , cover , reduce heat to low and cook 20 minutes
2. Remove pan from heat , add butter , lemon , salt and pepper and fluff with a fork to combine
3. Add parsley , toss gently to combine and serve

title: cherry pecan spread
steps:
1. Place cottage cheese in a blender or food processor
2. Cover and blend or pulse until smooth
3. Transfer cottage cheese to a medium bowl
4. Stir in sour cream , brown sugar , pecans , cherries and lemon zest
5. Serve immediately or cover and refrigerate for up to 8 hours
6. Serve as a spread for muffins , bagels , english muffins or toast
7. To toast the pecans - preheat oven to 350f
8. Spread nuts in a single layer on a baking sheet
9. Bake for 5-7 minutes or until lightly toasted
10. Serving size = 1 tablespoon

title: yellow lentil dal
steps:
1. In a saucepan add lentils and chicken stock , ginger and turmeric
2. Bring to boil cover partially and cook for 20 minutes on medium heat until lentils are tender
3. Puree 1 c of lentils in a blender , add back to pan and cook 15 minutes more
4. In a skillet heat oil
5. Add mustard seed and shake pan until they start to pop , 20 seconds
6. Add the onion and cook until softened , 5- minutes
7. Add serrano chile , and garlic , cook 1 minute
8. Add cumin and bay leaves , and tomato , cook minutes more
9. Stir this mixture into the lentils , add lemon juice and salt to taste , simmer for 5 minutes
10. Serve over basmati rice

title: asian chicken and rice
steps:
1. Prepare 1 cup brown rice according to package directions
2. Meanwhile , in a large skillet or wok , saut chicken , carrots , garlic , chopped scallions and red bell pepper in oil until chicken is opaque and white , about 4 minutes , stirring constantly
3. Add soy sauce , celery , leftover veggies , white pepper and cilantro
4. Mix all ingredients together , cover and simmer for 5 minutes
5. Serve on brown rice
6. Sprinkle with toasted almonds , if desired

title: aloo talkari
steps:
1. Heat oil
2. Add the potatoes and cook for two minutes browning them on all sides
3. Stir in the green beans and cook for 4 to 5 minutes or until they begin to brown and blister
4. Add the onions and cook for 1 to 2 minutes
5. Next add the garlic and stir well
6. Cook for about 30 seconds
7. Mix in the curry powder and cook a few minutes unti the curry begins to release it's aromas
8. Add the broth and salt
9. Partly cover the pot and simmer for 20 minutes
10. Remove the lid and simmer until the liquid is reduced by half

title: chicken broccoli stuffing
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
