2. Spray 4 large sheets of heavy-duty foil with oil
3. Combine stuffing mix and water
4. Spoon 1 / 4 of the stuffing mixture onto the center of each foil sheet
5. Top stuffing with a chicken breast
6. Top chicken with 1 celsius broccoli
7. Sprinkle with 1 / 4 of the cheese and 1 slice of crumbled bacon
8. Top with 1 tablespoon ranch dressing
9. Bring up sides of foil sides and fold to seal , leaving space for heat circulation
10. Place packets on a cookie sheet and bake 30 minutes
11. Let stand for 5 minutes
12. Open carefully

title: minestrone
steps:
1. In soup pot , put beef , and the next 9 ingredients
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour
4. Add tomatoes and sauce , simmer for 10 minutes
5. Add green beans , kidney beans and pasta
6. Bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat and cook , stirring often until pasta is tender

title: java walnut sauce
steps:
1. In a heavy 10" skillet , melt the sugar slowly over low heat until golden in colour , stirring constantly
2. Remove from heat
3. Dissolve coffee crystals in hot water
4. Slowly stir into melted sugar
5. Heat over low heat until the sugar re-dissolves
6. Combine cold water and cornstarch
7. Stir into the sugar mixture
8. Cook and stir until thick and bubbly
9. Cook and stir 2 minutes more , then stir in the butter and walnuts
10. Pour into jars , cover and store in refrigerator
11. Should be used in 2 weeks time

title: see s fudge  copycat
steps:
1. Put butter , chocolate and vanilla in medium bowl
2. In med saucepan , mix sugar , milk and marshmallows
3. Bring to a boil over med heat , stirring
4. Reduce heat to low and cook for 6 minutes , stirring constantly
5. Pour hot mixture over chocolate in bowl
6. Beat with mixer until thick and dull ,
7. Stir in nuts
8. Pour into buttered 8x8 pan
9. Refrigerate until firm

title: sesame noodles with kale
steps:
1. While you are bringing a large pot of water to a boil , hold bunch of kale together , slice off and discard thickest part of stem
2. Still holding kale in a bunch , slice remaining stems and leaves as thin as you can
3. Set kale in sinkfull of water and swish vigorously to remove any grit
4. Lift out kale , place in colander and rinse thoroughly
5. When water has come to a rolling boil , add pasta and cook for 5 minutes less than cooking time indicated on package
6. Add kale stems and leaves in a few batches , pressing down with back of large spoon to submerge each batch
7. Continue cooking , uncovered , over high heat until kale and pasta are tender , about 5 minutes
8. Drain pasta and kale and return to pot
9. Add sesame oil and tamari and toss with fork
10. Taste and add more sesame oil and tamari if necessary
11. Add sesame seeds and toss again
12. Serve hot or at room temperature

title: nuts and berries baked oatmeal
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f degrees
2. Coat a 10-13 in square pan with nonstick spray
3. In a large saucepan , bring the milk , brown sugar , salt , butter to almost a boil , remove from heat and add vanilla and cinnamon
4. Meanwhile , in a large mixing bowl , mix together the oats , apple sauce , cranberries , and nuts
5. Spread evenly into the prepared pan
6. Pour milk mixture evenly over the oatmeal mixture
7. Bake uncovered for 30-35 minutes , ore until the liquid has been absorbed and the oatmeal is tender
8. Cut the mixture into 6 servings , scooping each out into a cereal bowl
9. Enjoy !

title: bread machine caesar bread
steps:
1. Place all ingredients except yeast in the bread machine bowl
2. Place yeast in yeast hopper
3. Press start and walk away

title: mashed potatoes twice baked
steps:
1. In a small skillet , saute onion and red pepper in oil until tender
2. In a large bowl , combine the onion mixture , mashed potatoes , 1 / 2 c cheese , bacon , salt and pepper
3. Spoon into a lightly sprayed / greased 2 quart baking dish
4. Sprinkle with remaining cheese
5. Bake uncovered at 350f for 20-25 minutes or until cheese is melted

title: alphabet chicken soup  crock pot
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except pasta , salt and pepper in slow cooker
2. Cover and cook on low 6-8 hours
3. Add pasta during the last 20 minutes
4. Discard bay leaf
5. Season to taste with salt and pepper

title: cherry tomato spaghetti
steps:
1. Place pasta in large pan of salted boiling water and cook until al dente
2. Halve the tomatoes and place in a large bowl with the herbs , olive oil , garlic and vinegar season to taste
3. Squash some of the tomatoes with the back of a spoon
4. When cooked , drain the pasta and while still hot mix well with the tomatoes

title: apple walnut pie
steps:
1. In bowl , combine the walnuts , brown sugar , egg , milk 1 t butter , vanilla and 1 / 4 t lemon juice
2. Line a 9-inch pie plate with bottom pastry
3. Trim even with edge of plate
4. Spread nut mixture over crust
5. In large bowl , toss apples with remaining lemon juice
6. Combine the sugar , flour , cinnamon , nutmeg and salt
7. Toss with apples
8. Spoon over the nut mixture
9. Dot with remaining butter
10. Roll out remaining pastry
11. Make lattice crust , if desired
12. Trim , seal and flute edges
13. Brush top with additional milk , if desired
14. Bake at 375 degrees for 50-60 minutes or until golden brown
15. Serve warm

title: shrimp bisque
steps:
1. In large saucepan melt butter and saute shrimps until just cooked through about 4 minutes
2. Using slotted spoon transfer shrimps to a bowl
3. Add celery , onions , carrots and lemon juice to saucepan
4. Saute until vegetables are soft , about 10 minutes
5. Add white wine and boil 2 minutes
6. Add chicken broth , rice and tomato paste
7. Cover pot and simmer until rice is tender about 20 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. Add cream and puree
9. Add shrimps and blend until shrimps are coarsely chopped
10. Be careful not to overprocess them
11. Season with salt and pepper
12. Top each bowl with extra shrimp

title: vietnamese coffee granita
steps:
1. Stir sugar and hot coffee until sugar has dissolved
2. Pour into a 8 x 13" glass baking dish
3. You want the liquid to be no more than about 1 1 / 2 " high
4. Freeze at least 3 hours or up to 8 hours , raking the mixture with a fork periodically
5. Before serving , scrape frozen coffee into shavings using a fork
6. When ready to serve spoon coffee shavings into serving dishes
7. Serve with condensed milk drizzled over top
8. Enjoy !

title: sweet bacon and cheese meatloaf
steps:
1. Mix the hamburger , turkey , pork , and eggs
2. In 3 tbsp of olive oil saut your onions
3. Let onions cool then mix in with your meat
4. Shake a 1 / 2 cup of bread crumbs over meat
5. Add salt and pepper to the meat mixture
6. Shape the meat into a loaf and place in a pan
7. To make the sauce , mix together ketchup , soy sauce and brown sugar
8. Spoon the sauce onto the meatloaf poke holes in the loaf so that the sauce will soak into the meat
9. Place the bacon strips on the meatloaf lengthwise
10. Bake for 1 hour at 375f
11. Remove from oven put the cheese on top and place it back in the oven until cheese melts

title: peanut butter pie  vegan
steps:
1. Combine all of the ingredients in a food processor or blender
2. Blend / process until desired texture is reached
3. Spoon into pie crust
4. Refrigerate before serving

title: uncle bill s light vegetable soup
steps:
1. In a large cooking pot , add broth , water and chicken soup base and bring to boil
2. In the meantime , in a frying pan on medium-high heat , melt butter , add onions and saute for 5 minutes or until translucent
3. Add tomatoes and cook until reduced and sauce starts to thicken , about 10 minutes
4. Set aside
5. To the cooking pot , add carrots , potatoes , garlic , white pepper , salt , chili powder , hot red pepper flakes , dried dill weed and pasta and cook until pasta is el dente , about 10 minutes
6. Add onion / tomato sauce , celery and tiny peas and cook for another 5 minutes
7. Adjust seasonings to taste
8. Serve soup hot
9. Refrigerate any unused portions
10. You can use all water instead of chicken broth or vegetable broth
11. Use 1 vegetable bouillon cube or 1 teaspoon of chicken soup base for each 2 cups of water
12. You can also use a small penne pasta of your choice , or pearl barley , macaroni or basmati rice instead of small shell pasta

title: dianne s eggplant parmesan
steps:
1. Peel and thinly slice the eggplant lengthwise
2. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 teaspoon of the salt
3. Place a colander in a shallow pan
4. Place the eggplant slices in the colander and place a similar size and shaped bowl on top of the slices to press
5. Allow the slices to drain for 45 to 60 minutes
6. Meanwhile , in a large skillet over medium heat , cook the meat until no longer pink
7. Add the onion , bell pepper , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , black pepper
8. Stir and continue to cook until the onion and pepper are tender
9. Add the spaghetti sauce and brown sugar
10. Reduce the heat , cover and simmer for 30 minutes
11. Preheat oven to 375 degrees and coat a glass baking dish with cooking spray
12. Spread about 1 / 2 of the meat sauce on the bottom of the dish
13. Layer eggplant slices on top of the sauce and sprinkle with both cheeses
14. Repeat until all the sauce and eggplant have been used , ending with a layer of sauce
15. Sprinkle the top layer generously with the remaining cheese
16. Loosely cover the dish with foil and bake for 30 minutes
17. Remove the foil and bake for 10 to 12 minutes longer , or until the cheese is golden brown

title: spinach pies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Prick pie shells all over with a fork and bake 15 minutes until lightly browned
3. In skillet , melt butter , add onion and cook until soft
4. Squeeze spinach to remove excess water
5. Add spinach to onion and toss over heat until water evaporates
6. Remove from heat
7. Mix remaining ingredients in bowl
8. Add spinach / onion mixture and mix until it resembles green and white "marble
9. "
10. Divide mixture evenly into two pie shells
11. Reduce oven temperature to 350 and bake about 45 minutes
12. Cool pies to room temperature and serve

title: chicken sandwiches with lemon mayonnaise
steps:
1. Lemon-caper mayonnaise: mix mayonnaise , lemon juice , zest , and capers in a small cup or bowl and set aside
2. Sandwich: split rolls in half
3. On the bottom half of each roll , spread the lemon caper mayonnaise
4. Add the cucumber slices , baby lettuce , tomatoes , shredded chicken , slivered onion and grated carrot
5. Season with salt and pepper and top with the last two slices of rolls spread with dijon mustard

title: blueberry buckle coffee cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 degrees
2. Grease spuare pan , 9x9x2 inches , or round pan , 9x1 1 / 2 inches
3. Blend flour , sugar , baking powder , salt , shortening , milk and egg
4. Beat 30 seconds
5. Carefully stir in blueberries
6. Spread batter in pan
7. Sprinkle with crumb topping
8. Bake 45-50 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
9. Drizzle with glaze
10. Serve warm
11. Crumb topping:
12. Mix all ingredients until crumbly
13. Glaze:
14. Mix all ingredients until drizzling consistency

title: pressure cooker beef barley vegetable soup
steps:
1. Brown the beef in the pressure cooker
2. Drain off any fat
3. Add the tomatoes , water and barley
4. Close pressure cooker and bring up to full pressure
5. Reduce heat to stabilize and cook for 10 minutes while the soup is cooking , split the carrots in half lengthwise , then cut into 1 / 2" thick slices
6. Peel and dice the potato
7. Dice the onion and mince the garlic
8. When the soup has cooked for 10 minutes , realease pressure and add the vegetables , basil , thyme , rosemary , marjoram , salt and pepper to taste
9. Close pressure cooker and bring up to full pressure
10. Reduce the heat until pressure is stabilized and cook and cook 10 minutes longer
11. Release the pressure
12. The soup can be refrigerated for up to 4 days or frozen

title: tomato and cucumber salad
steps:
1. Place tomatos , onions , cucumbers , spices and dressing in a bowl and toss
2. Put in fridge for at least 30 minute
3. Toss with cilantro salt and pepper to taste and serve

title: white air cookies
steps:
1. In a small mixing bowl , beat egg whites , salt and cream of tartar until soft peaks form
2. Gradually add sugar
3. Beat until stiff peaks form
4. Gently fold in morsels 1 / 2 cup at a time
5. Drop by level t
6. Onto greased baking sheets
7. Sprinkle lightly with sugar if desired
8. Bake at 300 degrees for 20-25 minutes or until merinques are dry and crisp
9. Cool on baking sheets for 2 minutes
10. Remove to wire racks to cool completely
11. Store in airtight containers

title: drunk noodles
steps:
1. Soften noodles by soaking in hot water
2. Drain and set aside
3. Add oil to hot pan or wok
4. Cook garlic
5. Add precooked chicken
6. Add soy sauce and oyster sauce , and noodles , stir until everything is mixed well
7. Move noodles to side of pan and crack eggs , mix to scramble , move noodles over egg until cooked
8. Add sugar
9. When everything cooked and ready to serve , add bean sprouts , peppers and basil
10. Add crushed red pepper or pepper sauce to taste

title: chicken thighs in a wine and lemon sauce
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Season thighs well on both sides with lemon pepper
3. Place the flour in a shallow dish
4. Then dredge the chicken in the flour and place on a separate plate
5. In a deep oven proof skillet or dutch oven , add oil and heat over medium-high heat
6. When the oil is hot but not smoking , add the thighs and brown well on both sides , about 5 or 6 minutes
7. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside
8. Add the onions to the oil and cook , stirring to scrape up any browned bits at the bottom of the pan
9. Cook for about 5 minutes
10. Add the garlic , and season with salt and pepper
11. Cook for another minute or two
12. Add the wine , lemon juice , and chicken broth
13. Let mixture simmer for a few minutes
14. Add the butter and allow it to melt
15. Add the chicken thighs to the sauce
16. Top with chopped chives
17. Cover with lid , and place in the middle of the oven
18. Bake for 20 minutes , remove the lid and cook an additional 20 minutes
19. Before serving sprinkle with a garnish of fresh chopped chives and the cup of parmesan cheese

title: fried rice   oamc
steps:
1. --- freezing day ---
2. In a large bowl , combine the peas and carrots , rice , onion and parsley flakes
3. Mix well
4. Pour into 2 quart size freezer bags
5. Seal , lable and freeze
6. --- serving day ---
7. Thaw bag of rice mixture overnight in fridge or run warm water over bag
8. Heat 2 tsp oil in a large skillet
9. Dump rice mixture into the skillet
10. Cook and stir over medium heat , breaking up any chunks of rice , until hot , about 5 minutes
11. Push rice mixture to the side of the skillet
12. Add 1 tsp oil to the empty side of the skillet and add the eggs
13. Cook and stir until eggs are thickened but still moist
14. Mix rice in with egg breaking up egg into bite size pieces
15. Turn off heat
16. Stir in soy sauce and pepper

title: best ever egg rolls
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together in a bowl and referate one to three hours
2. Drain extra liquid from mixture and place a tablespoon of filling on wrapper roll away from you to half way and fold ends in , continue rolling sealing the end with a little water and cornstarch mixture
3. Fry in a skillet with 1 / 2 inch cooking oil until golden brown on all sides
4. Don't be afraid to experment , substitute shredded chicken for port , add bamboo shoots and / or mushrooms , and yes you can add shredded cabage if you must

title: mini thanksgiving dinner cupcakes
steps:
1. Bake and cool your favorite cupcake recipe
2. Place frosting on the cupcake and top each with a cookie while the frosting is soft to 'adhere' the cookie-plate to the cupcake
3. Slice the maple nut candies thin and layer them as 'turkey'
4. Dab some white frosting next to it for 'mashed potatoes' followed with a little dab of yellow gel food color as 'butter'
5. Melt your butterscotch or chocolate chips and thin with a little vegetable oil
6. Drizzle over the 'turkey' as gravy
7. Finish it off with the 'cranberries' and little green 'peas' or 'beans'

title: zwiebelfleisch  onion beef
steps:
1. Cut the meat into thin strips
2. Heat butter in dutch oven or large saucepan
3. Fry onions slowly , until deep yellow but not quite brown
4. Add meat , salt , pepper , marjoram , garlic , thyme , vinegar lemon peel and 1 / 2 cup water or beef stock
5. Cover and simmer slowly 1 / 2 hour , adding more water as necessary , keeping the meat in liquid
6. When meat is tender , dissolve flour in just enough cold water to make a smooth paste and stir into gravy
7. Check seasoning and add more salt and pepper if needed

title: peanut butter power shake
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth
2. Pour into 2 serving glasses and serve

title: bacon egg salad croissants
steps:
1. In a bowl , cominbe the eggs , celery , mayonnaise , mustard , salt and pepper
2. Fold in bacon
3. Place lettuce leaf , tomato slice and 1 / 2 cup of the egg salad on each croissant
4. Enjoy :)

title: pig  n  shrooms  pork medallions with mushroom sauce
steps:
1. Clean up the pork tenderloin as much as possible , removing membranes and fat
2. Slice into 1 1 / 2-inch thick slices and slice these almost in half , butterflying them
3. You should have about 5 steaks
4. Fry the sliced mushrooms in 1 / 2 tbsp olive oil until they're dark and crisp
5. Set aside , but do not clean the pan
6. Mix the sliced onions with the minced garlic
7. Sprinkle some salt and pepper on the pork steaks , then fry them in the mushroom pan in 1 / 2 tbsp of olive oil and 1 tbsp of butter on high heat , about 4 minutes per side , until they're nicely browned
8. Move to a plate
9. Cover with foil
10. Add another 1 / 2 tbsp of butter to the pan and fry the onions and garlic briefly on high heat until they start to brown
11. Then add the cream to deglaze , and add the mushrooms and rosemary
12. Let the sauce reduce on high heat until it's very thick
13. Add juice from the pork steaks towards the end , stir , then add the pork to the pan to heat
14. Eat while on the treadmill

title: rowdie chipotle salsa
steps:
1. Combine ingredients through sea salt and refrigerate until ready to serve to allow flavors to mingle
2. I used a food processor to combine everything so that it gets diced fairly small
3. Remove salsa from refrigerator , add diced avocado and midori , if using
4. Serve !
5. Keeps very well in the fridge for at least 24 hours

title: blueberry sauce
steps:
1. Combine first 4 ingredients in a medium saucepan& bring to a boil
2. Reduce heat& simmer gently for 3 to 4 minutes until blueberries become tender
3. Combine cornstarch& water in a small bowl until smooth
4. Add to blueberry mixture& cook , stirring until thickened , about 5 more minutes
5. Serve warm or cold

title: tofurkey  tofu turkey
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In a large bowl , prepare the marinade by whisking together all the ingredients except the tofu
3. Set aside
4. Slice the tofu into desired shapes , about 1 / 4 inch thick
5. Lay each slice on a cookie sheet or a lasagna pan , cover with marinade , and let sit in the refrigerate for at least an hour -- the longer , the better
6. Turn the slices over a few times as they marinate
7. Bake for 1 hour , turning slices over after 30 minutes
8. To serve , fry cutlets on a nonstick frying pan until both sides are browned

title: fresh lime soda
steps:
1. Mix lime juice and sugar together till the sugar dissolves
2. Add the club soda and stir lightly just to mix
3. Place crushed ice in 4 glasses and pour the soda over it
4. Garnish with mint leaves and serve at once

title: wild irish rose
steps:
1. Fill an old-fashioned glass 3 / 4 full of ice
2. Pour the whiskey , lemon juice , and grenadine over the ice
3. Top off with sparkling soda water
4. Stir & serve garnished with a lemon slice or maraschino cherry

title: vegan waldorf salad
steps:
1. Start with thawed chicken strips and cut up into bite size pieces
2. Chop apples , celery and walnuts
3. Mix with chopped chicken
4. Mix together soy yogurt and mayonaisse
5. Mix with chopped ingredients
6. Slice and add the greens that you chose
7. And add dried cranberries on top for an extra color before it is served if you want
8. And voila !

title: crock pot posole
steps:
1. Cube ribs and brown pork in lightly oiled skillet
2. Add onion and saute until limp
3. Drain fat
4. Combine pork , onion and remaining ingredients in crock pot
5. Cook on low heat for 5 hours to 6 hours

title: pickled cherries
steps:
1. Put everything but the cherries in a saucepan , and bring to the boil , simmer gently for about 10 minutes
2. While the mixture is simmering , prick each cherry three or four times with a sharp wooden skewer
3. Add the cherries to the simmering liquid and remove from heat
4. Allow to cool
5. Put the cherries and liquid in a jar and allow to stand at room temperature overnight
6. Store in the fridge until use

title: baked corn in creamy cheese sauce
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees f
2. Butter a 2-quart casserole dish
3. In a large skillet melt butter over medium heat
4. Add in chopped onion and bell peppers
5. Saute until tender
6. Stir in flour and mix / whisk for 1 minute
7. Add in half and half cream
8. Cook stirring / whisking constantly until thickened and smooth
9. Remove from heat then add in the shredded cheddar cheese and parmesan cheese mix until all the cheese has melted
10. Whisk in eggs then add in the corn , salt and pepper
11. Mix to combine
12. Transfer into prepared dish then top with bread crumbs
13. Bake for 40-45 minutes
14. Serve immediately

title: spiral stromboli
steps:
1. Unroll the dough and pat in to a 14x12-in rectangle
2. Sprinkle with mozzarella and cheddar cheese to within 1 / 2 in of edge
3. Top with meat and red peppers
4. Roll up jelly roll style , starting with a short side
5. Seal seam and tuck under
6. Place seam side down on a ungreased baking sheet
7. Brush with butter and sprinkle with parmesan cheese
8. Bake at 375 for 25-30 min or until golden brown
9. Slice with a serrated knife

title: rye bread for the bread machine
steps:
1. Add ingredients to your bread machine according to manufacturer's directions
2. Use whole wheat cycle for baking
3. Or use the dough cycle , and bake it in the oven
4. If doing this let bread rise again in greased bread pan in a warm place and cover with a damp cotten towel till the dough almost doubles
5. Bake for 35 minutes at 350 till golden
6. I usually remove it from the pan after 25 minutes and continue baking it on a baking stone for a crusty crust !
7. Rub cold butter on the warm loaf to make it extra yummy

title: breaded pork chops
steps:
1. In small bowl , combine flour , salt , paprika and pepper
2. Mix well
3. In another small bowl , combine egg and worcestershire sauce
4. Coat pork chops with seasoned flour
5. Dip in egg mixture and coat with crumbs
6. In large skillet , heat oil over medium-high heat until hot
7. Add chops
8. Cook until browned on both sides
9. Reduce heat to medium
10. Cook 5-7 minutes or until pork is no longer pink in center
11. For oven-baked pork chops: prepare as directed above
12. Place in a shallow baking pan that has been sprayed with a cooking oil such as pam
13. Bake at 425 degrees f
14. For 30-35 minutes or until no longer pink in center
15. To make a cheese-topped pork chop: decrease bread crumbs to 1 / 4 cup
16. Mix crumbs with 1 / 4 cup grated parmesan cheese
17. When chops are thoroughly cooked , top each with a slice of mozzarella cheese and tomato slice
18. Cover
19. Heat until tomato is hot and cheese begins to melt

title: blue cheese pasta
steps:
1. While the pasta is boiling: melt butter in sauce pan over med-low
2. Add onion and garlic saute about 5 minutes
3. Pour in half& half , let heat through
4. Wisk in blue and parmesan cheeses
5. Salt and pepper to taste
6. Sauce will thicken a bit upon standing
7. Toss with cooked pasta

title: chicken stew with roasted balsamic vegetables
steps:
1. Lightly grease a large roasting pan
2. Add potatoes , carrots , onions , vinegar , oil , garlic , 1 tsp thyme , 1 tsp rosemary , tarragon , salt , and pepper
3. Mix well
4. Roast , uncovered , at 425 degrees f for 30 minutes minimum , stirring after 15 minutes
5. Add green beans and roast 10 minutes longer
6. Meanwhile , put wine and balsamic vinegar with remaining thyme and rosemary into a large saucepan
7. Bring to a boil
8. Add chicken cubes
9. Reduce heat to medium-high
10. Cook , uncovered , for about 12 minutes , or until chicken is cooked
11. Add roasted vegetables to saucepan
12. Stir in 2 1 / 2 cups broth
13. In a small bowl , stir together flour and remaining broth until no lumps remain
14. Add to saucepan
15. Cook for about 3 minutes , until stew is bubbly and thickened
16. Serve hot

title: agios fanourios cake   fanouropita  spiced raisin cake no eggs
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 170 degrees
2. Hidrate the raisins in water or cognac
3. Butter and flour a 10-11 inches round cake pan or use silicon lining
4. Mix the oil and the sugar in a bowl
5. With a mixer / electric blender beat it for 3-4 minutes
6. Add the orange juice and beat for 1 more minute
7. Add to the liquid mix the raisins , walnuts , ground clove , cinnamon , orange peel , cognac
8. Add to the preparation the flour previously mixed with the baking powder and mix making sure there are no lumps
9. Pour mixture in baking pan and place in oven for 55 / 60 minutes in 170 degrees
10. Check if the cake is ready with a toothpick in the middle of the cake
11. Should come out clean

title: banana cream brownie dessert
steps:
1. Prepare brownie batter according to package directions for fudge-like brownies
2. Stir in 1 / 2 cup chocolate chips and 1 / 4 cup peanuts
3. Spread into a greased 13x9x2-inch baking pan
4. Bake at 350 for 28-30 minutes
5. A toothpick inserted in the center should come out clean
6. Slice bananas and arrange in a single layer over cooled brownies then sprinkle with 1 / 4 cup chocolate chips and 1 / 4 cup peanuts
7. In a large mixing bowl , beat the milk and pudding mixes on low speed for 2 minutes
8. Fold in whipped topping and spread on top of all
9. Sprinkle with remaining chocolate chips and peanuts , chopped

title: hot mulled apple cider
steps:
1. Combine brown sugar , allspice , 1 teaspoon cloves , salt , nutmeg , cinnamon and apple cider in large saucepan
2. Bring to boiling
3. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes
4. Strain to remove spices
5. Serve in mugs with clove-studded orange wedges

title: gingered blueberry melon toss
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine honey , lime juice , lime peel and ginger until well blended
2. Add blueberries and cantaloupe
3. Toss to coat
4. Serve at room temperature or chilled over ice cream , pound cake , cut up fruit , etc

title: rigatoni with swiss chard and bell peppers
steps:
1. Boil rigatoni until al dente
2. While the rigatoni is cooking , heat the oil in a large nonstick saut pan over medium-high heat
3. Add the bell pepper , onion , and garlic
4. Cook , stirring occasionally , until the bell pepper is crisp-tender , about 5 minutes
5. Reduce the heat to medium
6. Stir in the chicken broth , chard , butter , and pepper
7. Cover and cook until the chard and the bell pepper are tender , about 5 minutes
8. Remove the pan from the heat
9. Stir in the balsamic vinegar and salt
10. When the rigatoni is done , drain well
11. Return to the pot
12. Add the chard mixture and toss
13. Add the parmesan cheese and toss again
14. Taste and adjust the seasoning

title: midori melonball  alcoholic drink
steps: 1. Mix and serve over ice

title: pecan and honey bars
steps:
1. Lightly grease a 14x11-inch swiss-roll tin
2. Sift flour and salt into a bowl , stir in sugar , then rub in butter until mixture resembles breadcrumbs
3. Blend egg and lemon zest
4. Press mixture into tin and prick pastry all over with a fork
5. Chill for 10 minutes
6. Preheat oven to 375f
7. Bake pastry for 15 minutes , then remove from oven , leaving oven on
8. Heat butter , honey and sugars in a saucepan until melted , then bring to a boil without stirring for 2 minutes
9. Remove saucepan from heat and stir in cream and nuts
10. Pour over base , return tin to oven and bake for 25 minutes
11. Cool in tin
12. Run a knife around pastry edge , invert on to a baking tray , place another tray on top and invert again
13. Cut into squares

title: s more bites
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 deg
2. In a small bowl , combine cracker crumbs and sugar
3. Add melted butter and egg white , stirring to combine
4. Press mixture on bottom and half way up the sides of 2 mini muffins pans
5. Bake for 3 minutes
6. Set aside
7. In a medium bowl combine brownie mix , vegetable oil , egg and water
8. Stir to combine well
9. Evenly divide into prepared crusts
10. Bake for 30 minutes
11. Press chocolate pieces , pointy side down into center of each brownie
12. Bake for 2 minutes remove from oven
13. Preheat broiler
14. Place one marshmallow horizontally on top of each brownie
15. Broil for 2 to 3 minutes , or until golden brown
16. Remove from pans

title: lime in de coconut macaroons
steps:
1. Place racks in upper and lower thirds of oven
2. Preheat to 325f
3. Whisk egg whites and sugar in a large bowl just until frothy
4. Whisk in lime zest and salt
5. Add coconut and fold to coat
6. Drop heaping tablespoonfuls of coconut mixture onto 2 silpat lined baking sheets
7. Bake , rotating pans halfway through from top to bottom and back to front , until golden brown , 18-22 minutes
8. Let cool on baking sheets

title: shrimp etouffee
steps:
1. Melt butter , add flour and make a roux-cook until light brown
2. Add onions , pepper , celery , salt pepper& cayenne , saute until vegetables soften add garlic , water , spices and lower heat to medium
3. Add tomatoes , wine , parsley and thyme
4. Reduce to simmer , until thickening
5. Add shrimp , cook 3-4 minutes until they turn pink
6. Add scallions , remove from heat

title: my  best ever  breadmaker pizza dough
steps:
1. Measure all ingredients except cornmeal into bread pan in order listed
2. Select dough setting
3. Remove dough to lightly floured surface and cover with plastic wrap
4. Let rise in a warm place for 30 minutes
5. Sprinkle cornmeal on large 16 inch pizza pan or on a pizza stone and press dough into pizza shape
6. Cover with a towel and let rise for another 30 minutes
7. Spread with desired sauce , seasonings and toppings
8. Bake at 425f for 20-30 minutes
9. I like to partially bake the pizza on a pan for about 8 minutes and then transfer it to a hot pizza stone sprinkled with the cornmeal for the remainder of the cooking time
10. I find by baking it initially on the pan it is easier to transfer to a pizza stone thus maintaining its large size

title: grilled tomato   cheese
steps:
1. On 1 piece of bread , layer a heaping 1 / 4 cup grated cheese , 4 tomato slices , 4 basil leaves and another heaping 1 / 4 cup grated cheese
2. Top with another slice of bread , brush with melted butter
3. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat
4. Place sandwich , butter-side down , in pan and brush top slice of bread with butter
5. Press with spatula
6. Cook for about 3 minutes or until golden brown
7. Flip and cook for another 3 minutes
8. Remove from skillet and serve immediately
9. Repeat with remaining sandwiches

title: cape seed loaf
steps:
1. Mix all the dry ingredients in a bowl
2. Pour the water and oil and knead for about a minute
3. Place the dough in an oiled loaf pan brush with the egg and decorate with alternate lines of sesame and poppy seeds
4. Cover the dough with a tea towel and let it rise for about 30-60 minutes
5. Pre heat the oven to 180 degees c and bake for 45 to 50 minutes
6. Cool on rack

title: tropical twinkie delight
steps:
1. Line the bottom of a 13 x 9 pan with twinkies
2. In a medium bowl mix the pudding mix with the milk
3. Let stand to thicken
4. Spread the crushed pinepple , undrained , over the twinkies
5. Spread the pudding over the pineapple layer
6. Spread the cool whip on top
7. Chill for 4 hours

title: creme candy
steps:
1. Beat cream cheese , butter and vanilla until fluffy and well combined
2. Slowly add sugar 1 cup at time , when mixture gets too thick to mix turn out onto counter and knead in the rest of the sugar
3. Place in a bowl and refrigerate for 1 hour
4. Form into small balls and refrigerate for two hours
5. Dip in melted chocolate
6. Place on waxed paper until set
7. Will keep in refrigerator or freezer

title: cooking light sloppy joes
steps:
1. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat
2. Add the onion , pepper and ground round
3. Cook until beef is browned , stirring to crumble
4. Stir in tomato sauce and the rest of the ingredients except the rolls
5. Cover and cook 15 minutes , stirring occasionally
6. Spoon onto rolls

title: dad s cheesy bacon wrapped meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. In a large bowl combine ground beef with eggs and 2 tablespoons ketchup
3. Once beef mixture is well mixed , add dry ingredients: breadcrumbs , parmesan cheese , garlic , salt , oregano , basil , and pepper
4. Followed by the diced onions
5. Set mixture aside
6. In 9x13 pan , line the bottom of the pan with the strips of bacon-- the width , not the length of the pan
7. Take half of the meat mixture and pat it across the top of the bacon
8. This should be the bottom part of your loaf
9. Take three of the four pieces of cheddar cheese and place them across the center of the meat mixture
10. Take the second half of the meat mixture and add it on top of your cheese
11. Mold the meat into a loaf shape
12. The cheese should be completely covered and in the center of the loaf
13. Finally , pull the bacon and wrap it around the loaf
14. Take your final tablespoon of ketchup and thinly spread it across the top of meatloaf
15. Put meatloaf in oven and cook for 60 minutes
16. Take final quarter of cheddar cheese and cut in to slices
17. Place these final cheese slices on top of the meatloaf , and put meatloaf back into oven until the cheese is melted let meatloaf sit for a few minutes to cool before serving

title: cilantro lime mayonnaise
steps:
1. Blend first 5 ingredients in food processor until cilantro is chopped
2. Add mayonnaise and process just to blend
3. Season with salt and pepper and refrigerate until ready to use

title: smashed peas and ricotta
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat
2. Add the butter and onion and saute onion for 2 minutes
3. Add the frozen peas and stir the peas to heat them through and allow their water to evaporate
4. Once the peas are heated , add the ricotta and parsley to the pan and smash cheese everything together
5. Add the lemon zest or extract , season with salt and pepper and serve

title: chicken lime taquitos
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingredients for marinade
2. Marinate chicken in mixture for at least 2 hours
3. Drain chicken well and grill until done
4. Allow to cool and shred into 1 / 8 inch by 3 inch pieces
5. Place chicken in bowl and sprinkle with salt and minced garlic
6. Mix well
7. Add red pepper , pasilla , onion , cheese and 1 / 2 ounce lime juice
8. Mix thoroughly
9. To assemble , warm tortilla on griddle until soft and pliable
10. If necessary , add a little oil to the pan to help soften the tortillas
11. Spoon 2 ounces of chicken filling over tortilla and roll tightly , securing with toothpick
12. Deep-fry in oil at 350f for 2 minutes or until golden brown and crispy
13. Drain well
14. Serve with guacamole , sour cream , and or salsa

title: baked maple oatmeal
steps:
1. In a greased , square baking dish of 8 inches , mix oatmeal , almonds , maple sugar , maple syrup and salt
2. Add milk and stir
3. Cook in a preheated oven of 350 f for about 40 minutes or until oatmeal is tender and milk is absorbed
4. When ready to serve , sprinkle with cinnamon , if wanted

title: leek  asparagus  smoked salmon terrine
steps:
1. Blanch the asparagus in boiling water for 2-3 minutes until bright green and just tender
2. Remove and plunge into cold water , drain well
3. Finely chop the white section of the leeks to give 1 cup
4. In a large pan , melt the butter , add white leeks and cook for 2 minutes or until soften , cool
5. Slice the green section lengthwise into long ribbon like leaves
6. Blanch in boiling water for 1-2 minutes or until softened , then plunge into cold water , drain well
7. Combine with the philly , salmon , rind , juice , horseradish , and seasonings in a large bowl until combined
8. Line an 11cm x 21cm loaf pan with plastic wrap
9. Layer the leek ribbons across the pan ensuring they overlap by 1 cm
10. Spoon half the philly mixture evenly into the pan , top with the asparagus spears , then spoon in the remaining philly
11. Fold the leek ends over the filling to enclose , trim if necessary
12. Chill until firm
13. Invert onto a serving plate
14. Serve sliced

title: low fat chocolate chip muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Coat a 12-hole muffin tin with cooking spray
3. Whisk together the flour , baking powder , and salt in a medium bowl
4. Set aside separate the egg , placing the whites in a medium bowl and the yolk in a large bowl
5. Set the whites aside
6. Add the brown sugar , applesauce , oil and vanilla to the yolk
7. Mix w / a wooden spoon until well blended
8. Add the flour mixture and stir until well combined
9. With an electric mixer on medium speed , beat the whites until soft peaks form
10. Add whites to the batter along with 4 tbsp of the chocolate chips
11. Stir until well blended
12. Divide batter equally among the 12 muffin cups
13. Sprinkle 1 / 2 teaspoon chocolate chips on the top of each muffin
14. Bake until toothpick comes out cleam , about 23 minutes
15. Cool 5 minutes in the tins- then remove muffing to a rack and cool 10 minutes more

title: caramel  peanut and chocolate ice cream
steps:
1. For caramel: cook sugar and water in medium saucepan over low heat , swirling pan occasionally , until sugar dissolves
2. Increase heat and boil until mixture turns deep golden-brown , about 30 minutes
3. Remove from heat
4. Slowly pour in whipping cream
5. Whisk over medium h eat until cream is incorporated
6. Set pan into bowl filled with ice
7. Cool
8. For ice cream: bring milk to boil
9. Beat yolks and sugar until pale yellow
10. Slowly beat hot milk into yolk mixture
11. Return to saucepan
12. Stir over low heat until mixture thickens , about 7 minutes
13. Strain through a fine sieve into a metal bowl
14. Set bowl into a larger bowl filled with ice
15. Cool custard completely , stirring occasionally
16. Fold whipped cream into custard , then fold in caramel
17. Process according to ice cream makers manufacturers instructions , until almost set
18. Add chocolate and peanuts and process until set
19. Let ripen several hours in freezer
20. If frozen solid , allow to soften in refrigerator for 30 minutes

title: chermoula
steps:
1. Pound all ingredients together in a large mortar and pestle or buzz in a food processor
2. You want a rough-textured paste
3. Chermoula will keep several days in the fridge

title: jamie oliver crunchy garlic chicken nuggets
steps:
1. To prepare your chicken: peel the garlic and zest the lemon
2. Put your crackers into a food processor with the butter , garlic , parsley sprigs , lemon zest and a pinch of salt and pepper
3. Whiz until the mixture is very fine , then pour these crumbs on to a plate
4. Sprinkle the flour on to a second plate
5. Crack the egg into a small bowl and beat with a fork
6. Lightly score the underside of the chicken breasts
7. Put a square of plastic wrap over each one and bash a few times with the bottom of a pan until the breasts flatten out a bit
8. Dip the chicken into the flour until both sides are completely coated , then dip into the egg and finally into the flavored crumbs
9. Push the crumbs on to the chicken breasts so they stickyou want the meat to be totally coated
10. To cook your chicken: you can either bake or fry the chicken
11. If baking , preheat your oven to its highest temperature , place your chicken on a sheet pan and cook for 15 minutes
12. If frying , put a frying pan on a medium heat , add a few good lugs of olive oil and cook the chicken breasts for 4 to 5 minutes on each side , until cooked through , golden and crisp
13. To serve your chicken: either serve the chicken breasts whole , or cut them into strips and pile them on a plate
14. Beautiful and simple served with a lemon wedge for squeezing over , and a tiny sprinkling of salt
15. Great with a lovely fresh salad or simply dressed veggies

title: center cut ham on the grill
steps:
1. Mix together the basting sauce ingredients and stir until smooth
2. Cover and let sit in refrigerator at least 1 hour
3. Prepare your grill medium to medium-high heat
4. Place ham slices on prepared grill and baste with some of the sauce
5. Grill for 1 hour , basting and turning every 15 minutes

title: garlic parmesan eggplant slices
steps:
1. Place eggeplant slices on a 15x10x1 " jelly roll pan , sprinkle with salt
2. In a 9' pie pan , stir together flour , breadcrumbs , parmesan cheese and basil
3. In 10' skittle cook olive oil , pepper and garlic over med heat until sizzling
4. Meanwhile , dip eggplant slices in egg , coat with flour mixture
5. Fry 1 / 2 of eggeplant slice in olive oil until golden brown 2-3 minutes on each side
6. Remove to serving platter , keep warm
7. Repeat with remaining eggplant slices
8. Remover to serving platter
9. Sprinkle with tomato
10. Cover with aluminum foil
11. Let stand 2 minutes or until tomato is heated through

title: fast microwave brownies
steps: 1. Mix all the ingredients in a small bowel and heat in microwave for 30 seconds

title: japanese style quick pickled cabbage slaw
steps:
1. Whisk first 6 ingredients in a medium saucepan
2. Bring to boil
3. Pour into a large bowl
4. Add cucumber , carrot and red bell pepper
5. Add cabbage to vegetable mixture
6. It can be made up to 4 hours ahead

title: prune whip or prune fool
steps:
1. Mix prunes and sugar and cook together in a double boiler until very prune mix is tender-- mush the prunes so sugar will mix well as the mixture cooks
2. After the prunes are cooked , put mixture into blender and blend well , then cover and refrigerate
3. When prune mixture is thoroughly chilled , fold in the beaten egg whites
4. Cover and return to the refrigerator until needed
5. When ready to serve , put prune mixture into small bowls
6. Whip the cream until it forms peaks , then spoon onto each dish of prune whip and serve

title: roasted winter root vegetables
steps:
1. Oven to 400 degrees
2. Cover a sheet pan with foil
3. Toss the vegetables with the thyme , rosemary , olive oil and salt and pepper to taste
4. Pour into the sheet pan , spreading them out so they lay in a single layer
5. Pour the water into the pan , cover with foil , bake for about 30 minutes
6. Take the foil off the pan , and continue to roast , stirring once , until softened and beginning to brown , probably another 20 minutes
7. Serve warm

title: cucumber slaw
steps:
1. Cut the cucumbers in quarters lengthwise , remove and discard the seeds
2. Coarsely grate the cucumber and place it in a bowl add the salt and stir well
3. Refrigerate for 2 hours then drain and rinse in a sieve , pressing to remove excess moisture
4. Mix the chives , dill and yogurt well and add to the cucumbers , stir to mix

title: nutella blondies
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees
2. Line a 7x11 pan with parchment paper
3. In a pan , melt all the butter over medium heat , taking care that it doesnt burn
4. Set aside to cool slightly
5. In a mixing bowl , stir together the eggs , demerara sugar , and granulated sugar
6. Stir in the melted butter , salt , vanilla , flour , baking soda , and baking powder
7. Spoon the batter into the prepared pan in an even layer
8. Dollop the nutella over the surface of the batter , and swirl the
9. Bake for 25-30 minutes , checking frequently to make sure the blondies dont overbake
10. The blondies are done when the batter is puffed and golden , and is still a little moist in the middle
11. The blondies will collapse slightly once they come out of the oven , and will harden into slice-able pieces in about an hour

title: bff spinach and artichoke dip
steps:
1. Drain spinach
2. Press between layers of paper towels
3. Squeeze out as much of the water as you can
4. Drain and chop artichokes
5. Combine spinach , artichoke hearts , garlic , and next 4 ingredients , stirring well
6. Spoon into lightly greased 11 x 7 x 1 1 / 2 inch baking dish
7. Sprinkle with breadcrumbs
8. Bake at 375 degrees for 25 minutes
9. Serve with assorted crackers or bread sticks , or my favorite is tortilla chips

title: german chocolate sandwich cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. To toast coconut: spread coconut in even layer on baking sheet and bake 6 to 8 minutes , stirring occasionally , until golden
3. For cookies: combine flour , sugar , butter , cocoa , baking soda , salt , 2 eggs , milk and vanilla in large bowl
4. Beat at medium speed of mixer until blended
5. Stir in pecans
6. Shape batter into 1-inch balls using slightly floured hands
7. Place on ungreased cookie sheet
8. Flatten slightly
9. Bake 9-11 minutes or until almost set
10. Cool slightly
11. Remove from cookie sheet to wire rack
12. Cool completely
13. Spread about 1 tablespoon coconut pecan filling onto bottom of one cookie
14. Top with second cookie to make sandwich
15. Serve warm or at room temperature
16. Microwave at high 10 seconds or until filling is warm
17. For coconut pecan filling:
18. Melt butter in medium saucepan over medium heat
19. Add brown sugar and corn syrup
20. Stir constantly , until just bubbly
21. Do not overcook , it makes filling to hard to spread
22. Remove from heat
23. Stir in coconut , pecans and vanilla
24. Use warm for spread-ability
25. About 2 cups filling

title: tsr version of olive garden limoncello lemonade by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Make lemon syrup by combing hot water , sugar and lemon juice
2. When syrup is cool , make drink by combining 1 / 4 ounce of lemon syrup with citrus vodka , limoncello , lemonade and ice in a blender
3. Blend on high speed until ice is crushed
4. Start with one cup of ice and add additional ice , if needed , to make drink slushy
5. Serve in a 16-ounce glass with a straw and a thin slice of lemon on the rim of the glass

title: pagliacci s new york cheesecake
steps:
1. Mix crumbs , 1 / 4 cup sugar and butter and press into a 10" spring form pan
2. Refrigerate until ready to use
3. Preheat oven to 500
4. Beat cream cheese with electric mixer in large bowl until very smooth
5. Blend in lemon juice and vanilla
6. Sift sugar , flour and salt together and gradually beat into cheese
7. Beat until creamy , smooth and light , about 5 minutes
8. Beat in eggs and yolks one at a time
9. Blend in cream
10. Pour into crust
11. Bake 12 minutes
12. Reduce oven temperature to 200
13. Continue baking until tester inserted in centre comes out clean
14. The original recipe said for 45 minutes but i find that it takes about 90 minutes
15. Run a sharp knife around the edge of the pan
16. Cool cake completely and refrigerate at least 24 hours before serving

title: cinnamon  pecan rolls   burrito style
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix together cinnamon and sugar , set aside
3. Lightly grease a medium sized cookie sheet and set aside
4. On a lightly floured cutting board or counter , with a rolling pin flatten each biscuit into a six inch round
5. Spread 1 1 / 2tablespoons of margarine on each round
6. Sprinkle with desired amount of cinnamon / sugar mixture
7. Top each round with 1 1 / 2 tablespoons of pecans , making sure pecans are evenly spread out
8. Tightly roll each round into a log , making sure you pinch the ends shut
9. Place rolls seam side down , on cookie sheet
10. Bake for 15 to 18 minutes
11. And last but not least , enjoy :)

title: shirley s dilly bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 & grease a large round casserole dish
2. Warm the cottage cheese a little in the microwave
3. Put yeast in 1 / 4 c warm water & then mix with the warmed cottage cheese
4. In a large mixing bowl , mix all other ingredients together
5. Then put into the casserole
6. Let sit & rise over the top
7. Back at 325 for about 25 minutes , until crust is browned to your preference

title: mocha polka
steps:
1. Combine ice cream , coffee , rum in a blender container
2. Blend until smooth
3. Pour into glasses and top with whipped cream
4. Sprinkle with nutmeg and serve immediately

title: chewy chocolate coconut macaroons
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 250
2. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper
3. Place unsweetened chocolate in a small microwave-safe bowl
4. Microwave at high for 1 minute or until almost melted
5. Remove from microwave
6. Stir until chocolate is completely melted
7. Combine flour , cocoa , and salt in a large bowl
8. Add coconut , and toss well
9. Stir in melted chocolate , vanilla extract , and sweetened condensed milk
10. Drop by level tablespoons 2 inches apart onto prepared baking sheet
11. Bake for 45 minutes or until edges of cookies are firm and center of cookies are soft , rotating baking sheet once during baking time
12. Remove from oven , and cool 10 minutes on pan
13. Remove the cookies from the pan and cool completely on rack
14. Store in an airtight container

title: buttermilk and herb mashed potatoes
steps:
1. In a large pot , boil the potato chunks in salted water over high heat
2. Cook until the potatoes are tender , 10 - 15 minutes
3. Drain
4. Return the potatoes to the pot
5. Add the butter and buttermilk and mash well
6. Add in the remaining ingredients and mix / mash to desired smoothness

title: no sugar added iced coffee
steps:
1. Combine all the ingredients in food processor or blender
2. Blend until smooth
3. Top with a bit of whipped cream if you want to indulge

title: sun dried tomato and basil feta spread
steps: 1. In food processor blend: garlic add milk and cream cheese until smooth add feta untl smooth lastly add sundried tomatoes and basil mix until loose chill about an hour then serve serve with pita , crackers or vegetables

title: pear breeze martini
steps:
1. Combine ingredients in a shaker over ice
2. Shake , and strain into a martini glass
3. Garnish with lime -- or pear slices if you are so inclined !

title: creamy spaghetti with beef and veggies
steps:
1. Saute onions and green peppers in butter in skillet until tender
2. Add tomatoes , mushrooms , olives , oregano , and beef
3. Simmer for 10 minutes
4. Transfer to slow cooker
5. Add spaghetti
6. Mix well
7. Combine soup and water
8. Pour over casserole
9. Sprinkle with cheeses
10. Cover
11. Cook on low 4-6 hours
12. It keeps it from sticking together

title: razzberry truffles
steps:
1. To make centers , melt 8 ounces of chocolate
2. Meanwhile , heat butter and cream in small saucepan over medium heat until butter is melted and small bubbles form around edges
3. Pour into medium bowl
4. Stir in melted chocolate
5. Whisk in jam and lemon juice , blending until smooth
6. Cover loosely , refrigerate 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours or until firm
7. Line baking sheet with parchment or waxed paper
8. Spoon truffle mixture into mounds on parchment paper
9. Use about 2 teaspoons per truffle to make 36 truffle centers
10. Refrigerate 15 minutes or until firm
11. Dust hands with comstarch and roll mounds into balls , coating hands with comstarch as needed
12. Arrange on another lined baking sheet
13. Let stand , uncovered , at room temperature at least 2 hours or overnight until thin crust forms
14. Line another baking sheet with parchment or waxed paper
15. For shell , melt 1 1 / 2 ib
16. Chocolate in medium bowl
17. Stir until smooth
18. Temper using 6 oz
19. Chocolate
20. Place bowl of tempered chocolate on folded towel doubled in back so bowl tilts slightly forward
21. Place truffle centers on one side of bowl and lined baking sheet on the other
22. Immerse truffle center in chocolate , rounded side up
23. Using dipping fork or regular fork , remove truffle from chocolate
24. Tap fork several times to drain excess chocolate
25. Lightly scrape fork on rim of bowl
26. Place truffle on lined baking sheet using toothpick or skewer to slide it off fork
27. Repeat with remaining truffle centers
28. Sift cocoa powder over tops of dipped truffles or sprinkle with nuts before chocolate dries
29. Refrigerate10 minutes or until set
30. To 70f
31. If room is warm , dip and refrigerate 12 centers at a time
32. Centers should be at room temperature when dipped
33. A cold dipped center will expand when it warms to room temperature , causing chocolate shell to crack and filling to ooze out
34. Their shelf life when stored in a cool place
35. The comstarch makes the mixture easier to roll into balls and forms a thin , flavorless crust , enabling you to dip them at room temperature
36. It's not necessary to temper the chocolate that's used to make the truffle centers
37. For professional results , however , truffle centers should be dipped in tempered chocolate
38. It is thicker than untempered chocolate , clings better and is less likely to form a puddle at the bottom of the truffle
39. Best of all , the truffles will remain shinyeven at room temperature

title: homemade bleu cheese dressing
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except the bleu cheese in a medium sized bowl
2. Beat with a hand mixer until creamy and smooth
3. Add bleu cheese and mix by hand
4. Serve

title: made from scratch broccoli cornbread
steps:
1. In a large bowl mix together the corn meal , flour , salt , baking powder , and sugar together
2. Make a well in the center of the bowl
3. Melt butter in a small fry pan
4. Add onion and saute until onions are translucent
5. In a separate bowl , combine the eggs , thawed broccoli , cottage cheese , and melted butter with onions
6. Pour into well of flour mixture
7. Stir until just combined
8. Pour batter into a greased 9x13 inch baking dish
9. Bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven for 30 minutes , or until golden brown

title: fried chicken breast without breading
steps:
1. Slice chicken breasts into strips or flat rounds , whichever you like
2. Sprinkle all seasonings over one side of the chicken lightly , then flip and sprinkle the other side
3. In a large frying pan , pour in just enough vegetable oil to coat the bottom
4. Heat the vegetable oil until good and hot
5. Turn the heat to medium
6. Add chicken and cook for 3 minutes on one side then flip
7. Turn heat to low and cover
8. Continue to cook for 5-10 minutes until the chicken is done

title: snowy snack
steps:
1. Melt the chocolate in a heavy saucepan on low heat or melt it in the microwave , stirring often
2. Combine all the other ingredients in a large roasting pan
3. Pour the melted chocolate over the ingredients in the roasting pan and stir to mix well
4. Turn out on to wax paper and let it cool

title: complete veggie crock pot chili
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat the olive oil add the onions
2. Saut the onions until nearly transparent , and pour into a crock pot
3. Add all the beans , diced tomato and sauce , celery , peppers and spice
4. Cook on the low setting for 8 hours
5. Or if you are in a hurry , 4 hours on the crock pot's high setting will be enough
6. About an hour prior to serving , melt the butter in a small frying pan , add the flour and stir until a brown paste has formed
7. Add to the crock pot and stir
8. About 10 minutes before serving , add the rice and stir
9. Recipe # 83626 can be used for the same chili using meat

title: my neighbor renee s perfect chili
steps:
1. Brown meat in skillet and then meanwhile heat up a dutch oven
2. In dutch oven , saute onion and peppers in olive oil til softened , about 5 minutes
3. Add garlic and cans of tomatoes , cook for about 5 minutes
4. Add cans of beans to tomato mixture and when meat is done browning , add as well
5. Add salt , pepper , and other seasonings to taste
6. Simmer 2 hours before serving
7. This is great frozen in 4 serving portions to reheat later
8. Yummy with cornbread !

title: yummy eggnog scrambled eggs
steps:
1. Heat your seasoned iron skillet to medium heat
2. In a bowl , crack 4 eggs and beat / mix well
3. Add eggnog , and beat together well
4. Once skillet is good and hot , slowly pour egg mixture into skillet and let sit for a few seconds until the bottom is set
5. With a metal spatula , scrape the cooked egg off the bottom of the pan and create a pile in the center making room for more liquid egg to cook
6. Over stirring leads to smaller pieces of eggs , and reduces the fluff dramatically
7. Continue this way until all the liquid egg has cooked
8. Continue tossing egg bits until throughly cooked
9. Serve topped with a few dashes of ground cinnamon , pinch of nutmeg and a quick swirl of honey
10. Enjoy !

title: aimbrulee s ultimate pumpkin cheesecake
steps:
1. If you are using homemade gingersnaps for your crumbs , i recommend chopping them up and baking at 350f for about 10 min , then let cool and dry out
2. To make them into a finer crumb , use your food processor , or put them in a ziploc bag and beat with a mallet
3. Also before you get started , you will need to start a pot of boiling water , for the water bath you will be baking your cheesecake in
4. You will need a large baking or roasting pan large enough to fit your springform pan inside
5. Preheat your oven to 350f
6. To make crust: in a bowl , mix together the graham cracker crumbs , the gingersnap crumbs the butter , melted , and the heaping tablespoon of sugar
7. Press the crumbs into a 9 or 10 inch springform pan about halfway up the sides of the pan
8. Bake for 5 minute
9. Cut your pumpkin bread slices very thin , and then cut them into strips and lay them on the bottom of your pan , over your crust however they can fit , you might not need to use all of the bread , and don't worry about completely covering the crust it's not necessary
10. In your mixer bowl combine 4 of the bricks of cream cheese , 1 cup of sugar , and vanilla , beat together until smooth
11. Add the pumpkin , eggs , cinnamon , nutmeg , and allspice , continue beating until creamy
12. Pour into the springform pan
13. Pull out a large sheet of foil and place your springform pan into the center of it , wrap the foil up the sides carefully , because you are trying to waterproof your cheesecake
14. Do this with one or 2 more sheets of foil to be safe , if your foil is too high over the cheesecake , just carefully fold it down a little
15. Place your foiled springform pan into your large baking pan , and carefully fill it with the boiling hot water until the water is about halfway up the sides of the springform pan
16. Very slowly place into the oven
17. Bake 60- 70 minutes
18. The top will turn darker by this point
19. Remove from oven and cool completely
20. When it is room temperature , you may refrigerate
21. Do not remove cheesecake from the springform pan until after you have finished adding the topping
22. For the top: in your mixer bowl combine 8 oz cream cheese , and 1 / 3 c sugar , beat until smooth , add the 1 cup of sour cream and mix , scraping the sides of the bowl until blended well
23. Spread over the top of the cheesecake until completely covered
24. Then make straight lines of caramel sauce across your cheesecake topping , in the opposite direction , carefully run a knife across your lines of caramel , to make a nice swirl like design
25. Run a thin knife carefully along the sides of your cheesecake to help loosen from the pan
26. Remove from pan , and place on your favorite cake stand
27. The best way to cut cheesecake cleanly , is to use a knife that has been dipped in very hot water
28. For extra garnishes on your slices try standing a piece of pecan praline into the center of your slice and decorate with whipped cream

title: mexican  spaghetti
steps:
1. In large pan saute chicken , peppers , and onions until done
2. Add soups , tomatoes , chilies and olives
3. Simmer 20 minutes on low
4. Serve over spaghetti

title: sugar free marshmallows   marshmallow creme
steps:
1. Sprinkle gelatin over cold water in a mixing bowl
2. Set aside for 5 minutes to soften
3. Add to boiling water in saucepan
4. Cook and stir until gelatin is dissolved
5. Remove from heat
6. Cool to consistency of thick syrup
7. Stir in splenda and vanilla
8. Beat egg whites till soft peaks begin to form
9. Very slowly , trickle a small stream of gelatin mixture into egg white , beating until all gelatin is mixed in
10. Continue beating until light and fluffy if you're making marshmallow crme , pour into a jar and refrigerate
11. If making marshmallows , continue-- for mini marshmallows-- pour into greased and floured pan , cool to set , and cut into size desired
12. For larger marshmallows , or marshmallow"eggs"-- fill large square pan with a mixture of 2 parts vanilla protein powder to 1 part dried milk powder the pan should be about two inches filled
13. Take a dry raw egg and make indentations in the powdery bottom with the fuller base of the egg for making marshmallows , or with the oval side of the egg for making marshmallow"eggs" then pour the marshmallow creme filling into the little"moulds" , sprinkle a dusting of the powder mixture over tops of marshmallows , and allow to set if you make the"eggs" and want to cover them with chocolate , melt the dark chocolate low-carb bars in the microwave till very soft and almost liquid dip each formed marshmallow egg into the chocolate quickly to coat and place flat side down onto waxed paper to set
14. The mini ones are perfect to sprinkle over puddings or berries and divine over pumpkin pie or mock sweet potato casserole !
15. Or use the marshmallow crme wherever your creative mind takes you !
16. 5 carbs in entire recipe for marshmallow crme
17. Adjust as needed when making formed"eggs" , etc

title: easy italian beef stew  crock pot
steps:
1. Trim fat from roast and cut into 1" cubes
2. Layer beef , onions , and peppers in crock pot
3. Pour spaghetti sauce on top
4. Cover and cook on low 9-10 hours
5. Serve over hot cooked pasta

title: mel s salt   pepper squid
steps:
1. Dry roast spices in a pan over a low heat until salt starts to turn golden and spices fragrant
2. Place into a mortar and pestle and cool
3. Once cool , grind with the mortar and pestle to a fine consistency
4. Mix through the rice flour
5. Heat oil in a wok or saucepan to 180 degrees celsius
6. Cut squid into thin strips
7. Dust lightly in the flour mix and cook a small batch at a time to retain the heat in the wok to give your squid crunch
8. Drain on absorbent paper and place onto your plate
9. To serve sprinkle some chopped coriander over the top , a bit more salt if you wish and add some lime wedges
10. Great with an asian beer !
11. I hope that you give it a try'cause it's not stringy and not too fishy- it ends up really tender

title: warm french apple crisp
steps:
1. Cut butter into cake mix until it resembles coarse cornmeal
2. Reserve 1 cup of mixture
3. Pat remaining mixture into ungreased 13" x 9" dish
4. Pat mixture up 1 / 2 inch side of dish
5. Spread pie filling over cake mixture
6. Sprinkle reserved mixture over top
7. Bake 45-50 minutes
8. Serve warm with a wedge of cheddar cheese

title: holiday cashew nut loaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to broil
2. Brush eggplant slices with 2 tbls
3. Oil , and sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste
4. Place on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray , and broil 5 to 7 minutes
5. Turn eggplant slices , and broil 5 more minutes , or until slices are tender and light brown
6. Set aside , and lower oven heat to 350f
7. Cook rice , following package directions , and set aside
8. Meanwhile , heat remaining 4 tbls
9. Oil in a large skillet over medium heat
10. Saute cashews , onion and garlic in oil 5 to 7 minutes , or until onion is soft and brown
11. Chop one tomato , and add to skillet
12. Cook 3 more minutes
13. Transfer cashew mix to large bowl
14. Stir in cooked rice , breadcrumbs , broth , brewer's yeast , basil , thyme and lemon juice
15. Season to taste with salt and pepper
16. Coat a 9"x13" oval baking dish with cooking spray
17. Line the bottom of the dish with half of the broiled eggplant slices
18. Spoon in cashew mixture
19. Top with remaining eggplant slices
20. Slice remaining 2 tomatoes , and layer down center of casserole to form a broad , bright red stripe
21. Bake 40 to 45 minutes , or until the top is brown and filling is hot
22. Serve immediately
23. Enjoy
24. !

title: orange emeril
steps:
1. Combine 2 cups orange juice , 2 cups ice , 1 / 4 cup plus 2 tablespoons honey , 1 / 3 cup cream , 1 tablespoon orange zest and 1 / 2 teaspoon vanilla in a blender and process on high speed until smooth and frothy , pour into pitcher
2. Repeat with the remaining ingredients
3. Pour into tall glasses , garnish each with an orange slice , and serve immediately , enjoy

title: jimmy dean hearty sausage and potato soup
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat
2. Add onions
3. Saute until tender
4. Stir in flour
5. Cook 1 minute , stirring constantly
6. Gradually stir in chicken broth
7. Bring to a boil
8. Stirring frequently , until thickened and smooth
9. Stir in milk , cream , thyme , sausage and potatoes
10. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes
11. Stir in parmesan cheese
12. Serve hot

title: tipsy overnight belgian waffles
steps:
1. Mix yeast with 1 cup of the flour
2. Whisk in the lukewarm water and beer and let sit for about 10-15 minutes until frothy
3. Meanwile , beat together the eggs , sugar , salt until well combined
4. In yet another bowl , mix together the melted butter , oil , and vanilla
5. Combine all three mixtures , as well as the remaining flour , and beat for 2 minutes
6. Cover and chill overnight , or at least 4 hours
7. Heat up your waffle iron according to manufacturer's directions , greasing if needed
8. Stir the batter to remix the ingredients
9. Ladle batter ontp the hot waffle iron and cook waffles until steaming stops or according to the manufacturer's directions

title: sudbury chicken marinade
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients and marinate chicken in it for several hours in the refrigerator
2. Remove chicken to a plate and discard the marinade
3. Grill until done

title: southern sweet potato casserole
steps:
1. To make:
2. Wash the sweet potatoes and put them on a foil or parchment lined baking sheet
3. Bake in a preheated 350 f
4. Oven for 1 - 1 1 / 2 hours until they are very tender
5. Remove from the oven and allow to cool briefly before peeling
6. Put the peeled sweet potatoes into the large bowl of an electric mixer fitted with beaters or a whip attachment
7. Mix the hot sweet potatoes on low speed to begin mashing them
8. Add the butter and mix until it is absorbed
9. Add the salt , nutmeg , honey , and both sugars and mix until they are thoroughly blended
10. Add the lightly beaten eggs and vanilla and beat on medium speed for 2 minutes
11. Reduce mixer speed to low and slowly add in the heated milk
12. When the milk is incorporated , taste carefully for seasoning and add more salt , nutmeg , or sugar as needed
13. Thoroughly butter a 9x13x2 baking dish with the softened butter and pour the sweet potato mixture into it
14. The topping:
15. Put the brown sugar , flour , baking powder , cinnamon , nutmeg , and salt into a mixing bowl and mix well
16. Use your fingers to work the chilled butter into the mixture until it resembles oatmeal with some large pea size pieces of butter in it
17. Stir in the pecan pieces and mix well
18. Sprinkle the mixture evenly over the top of the sweet potatoes and bake in a preheated 375 f
19. Oven for 30 to 45 minutes until the topping is golden brown and crisp and the sweet potatoes are set but still slightly loose in the center
20. Serve hot

title: quick  egg noodle lasagne
steps:
1. Cook noodles according to package directions
2. Cook beef on top of stove , drain
3. Spread 1 / 4 spaghetti sauce in ungreased pan or slow cooker
4. Layer with 1 / 3 noodles , 1 / 3 beef , 1 / 3 sauce , 1 / 3 cheese
5. Repeat layers twice
6. Cover and bake 30-45 min at 350 degrees or 4 hours in a slow cooker

title: dreamsicle  punch
steps: 1. Combine the two and stir

title: beef and onion pinwheels
steps:
1. Blend with hand mixer and spread on tortillas , roll up and refrigerate for a few hours
2. Then cut into 1 1 / 2 inch pieces
3. Good finger food

title: chocolate raspberry clafouti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f with rack in middle
2. Butter a 1 1 / 2-quarts shallow baking dish
3. Toss berries with granulated sugar and let stand 15 minutes
4. Blend milk , butter , eggs , brown sugar , flour , cocoa , and salt in a blender until smooth
5. Scatter berries evenly in baking dish , then pour batter over top
6. Bake until slightly puffed and firm to the touch , about 35 minutes
7. Remove from oven and immediately sprinkle with chopped chocolate
8. Cool to warm , about 20 minutes
9. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: potato and corn chowder
steps:
1. Add onion to bacon drippings after bacon has been removed
2. Cook until lightly browned
3. Add water , diced potatoes , salt and pepper
4. Cook until potatoes are tender
5. Add corn , milk , and butter
6. Simmer until heated through or until ready to serve
7. Add cooked bacon when ready to serve

title: simple raspberry sauce
steps:
1. Thaw raspberries , drain and reserve 1 / 2 cup of the juice
2. Press berries through sieve over bowl to remove seeds
3. Stir in enough of the reserved juice to make it the consistency you want
4. Stir in sugar
5. Cover and refrigerate for up to 5 days

title: raspberry streusel muffins
steps:
1. Batter: in a large mixing bowl , combine flour , sugar , brown sugar , baking powder , salt and cinnamon
2. Add egg and milk and continue beating just until all ingredients are blended
3. Mix in melted butter , and continue beating again just until butter is completely incorporated
4. Divide batter between 12 muffin cups
5. Poke 3 to 5 berries into the center of each muffin and top each muffin with 1 scant teaspoon of sour cream
6. Streusel topping: in a small bowl , combine pecans , brown sugar , flour , cinnamon , and lemon peel
7. Add melted butter and stir together until all ingredients are combined
8. Divide the topping between the 12 muffins , placing it on top of the sour cream
9. Bake muffins in a 350 degree oven for approximately 20 to 25 minutes
10. Remove muffins from oven , and allow to cool for approximately 10 to 15 minutes
11. Glaze: in a small bowl , combine powdered sugar and lemon juice , stirring until sugar is dissolved
12. Drizzle glaze on top of cooled muffins
13. If making a coffee cake , omit the sour cream

title: cherry tomato mozzarella saute
steps:
1. In large skillet , saute the shallots , garlic and thyme in oil until tender
2. Add the tomatoes , salt and pepper
3. Heat through
4. Remove from the heat
5. Stir in cheese

title: chipotle pork and potato chili
steps:
1. Return half of hash browns to freezer for another use
2. Cook remaining hash browns according to package directions
3. Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-low heat
4. When oil is hot , add onion and garlic
5. Cook , stirring , until onions become translucent
6. Add spices and stir to mix well
7. When spices are fragrant , 1 or 2 minutes , add pork
8. Cook at medium-high heat until meat is no longer pink
9. Add honey , chipotles and vinegar
10. Stir well
11. Add hash browns and almonds
12. Stir again
13. Pour 2 cups water into pot and stir
14. When liquid in pot comes to boil , reduce heat , cover and cook for 30 to 45 minutes

title: aubergine  eggplant  and broccoli laksa
steps:
1. Place the chillies , garlic , coriander and ginger in a food processor
2. Peel away the tough outer leaves of the lemon grass and roughly chop the inner leaves
3. Put the lemon grass and lime leaves in the food processor
4. Blitz the ingredients in the food processor with the turmeric
5. Add a drop of oil if the mixture needs it to go round
6. Place a fairly deep pan over a moderate heat
7. Add half the spice paste and fry it , moving round the pan so it does not scorch
8. Do this for a minute or two , then pour in the stock and coconut milk and bring to a boil
9. Wipe the aubergine and cut it into thick bite-sized pieces
10. Add it to the pan together with the fish sauce
11. Turn the heat down to a simmer and cook 7-10 minutes
12. Bring a deep pan of water to a boil , then simmer the broccoli briefly
13. Lift out and add to the pan with the aubergine
14. Bring the water back to the boil , salt lightly and add the noodles
15. Let them boil for 2-3 minutes
16. Chop the mint and stir it into the dish along with any leftover coriander and the drained noodles

title: beef pho
steps:
1. Tie up the stewing beef nicely
2. Put all the meats for the stock into a pan together with the fat , the sliced onion , star aniseed , cinnamon stick and ginger
3. Roast in a hot oven for about 40 minutes , stirring occasionally , until everything is well browned
4. Move everything to a large pot
5. Cover with water and bring to a boil
6. Skim
7. Add coriander seeds and white pepper
8. Let simmer for at least three hours
9. Take up the stewing beef and let cool , then slice thinly
10. Strain the stock
11. If made one day in advance
12. Keep cool and remove the fat on the second day
13. Prepare the garnish: slice the fillet of beef thinly
14. Boil the noodles according to instructions on the package , then drain and rinse with cold water
15. Arrange the garnish nicely on a big plate
16. Bring the stock to a boil , add fish sauce to taste
17. When serving , put noodles and stewing meat either into a large serving bowl , or into individual soup bowls
18. Add stock and heat to boiling point
19. Serve devilishly hot
20. The guests put the garnish into their soup and the raw meat will be partially cooked from the heat of the stock

title: marinade for grilled beef
steps:
1. Mix together and pour over beef
2. Marinate all day in the refrigerator or over night
3. Grill until desired doneness

title: old timey kentucky chess pie
steps:
1. Combine granulated sugar , light brown sugar , and corn meal
2. Beat in eggs one at a time
3. Stir in whipping cream , cider vinegar , vanilla extract , and melted butter
4. Pour into unbaked pie shell
5. Bake on middle rack at 400 f for 10 minutes
6. Lower heat to 325 f and continue baking for 45 minutes more

title: red capsicum marmalade
steps:
1. Grill the red capsicum under a searing hot heat until they blacken
2. Halve , remove the seeds and core
3. Chop 6 capsicums finely and cut the remaining 2 into fine julienne slices
4. Place all the ingredients into a saucepan and stir over a low heat until the sugar has dissolved
5. Bring to the boil then reduce to a gently simmer
6. Cook 10 minutes until the mixture is thick and the consistency of jam
7. Bottle into hot sterilised jars and seal

title: bonefish winter white cosmo
steps:
1. 1
2. Mix juice and liquor together in a shaker with ice
3. 2
4. Shake well
5. 3
6. Pour into martini glass
7. 4
8. Add cranberries as garnish

title: pop in the mouth meatballs
steps:
1. Coat a 10 by 15 inch jelly roll pan with cooking spray
2. In a large bowl , combine ground turkey , scallions , bread crumbs , currants , parsley , mint , egg white , salt , cinnamon , and cayenne
3. Mix lightly to combine
4. Shape in to 1 inch balls and place on prepared pan
5. Refrigerate 1 hour
6. Preheat oven to 350
7. Bake meatballs for 10 minutes
8. Transfer pan to broiler and broil 3-4 inches from the heat for 3-5 minutes , until lightly browned

title: 4 cheese spinach dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Mix first 4 ingredients with hand or stand mixer on medium until softened and well mixed
3. Add next two ingredients and mix on med-low until just incorporated
4. Add spinach and mix on low until just incorporated
5. Transfer mixture to a small ovenproof dish and sprinkling cayenne on top to taste
6. Top with cheddar
7. Bake for 15 - 18 minutes or until bubbling around the edges
8. Remove from oven and allow to set for 5 - 7 minutes before serving
9. Serve with fried or baked pita wedges and tortilla chips

title: honey garlic roast chicken
steps:
1. Place chicken in greased 9" x 13" dish
2. Combine milk , cornstarch , soy , honey , vinegar and garlic
3. Pour over chicken , tossing to coat
4. Bake at 425 for 25 min , stirring twice
5. Addd green onions and sesame seeds
6. Bake 10 minutes until chicken is done and sauce thickened
7. If desired , spice this up with asian hot chili sauce

title: lazy mom s faux lasagna
steps:
1. Prepare water to boil and pre-grease a deep casserole dish
2. Brown beef , onions and garlic in a medium sized sauce pan
3. Add spaghetti sauce and spinach to the beef , onion and garlic
4. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes
5. Pre-heat oven to 350 , and add noodles to boiling water and cook until al dante
6. Drain noodles and return to pot
7. Pour the sauce mixture into the noodles , reserving two or so cups , and mix thoroughly
8. Set remaining sauce aside
9. Pour half of the pasta mixture into the pre-greased casserole dish , layer with 6 slices of provolone cheese , pour in the remaining pasta , break the remaining provolone into pieces , layer , and sprinkle mozzarella cheese on top
10. Finally , pour on the reserved sauce
11. Bake , covered , on 350 for 35 minutes
12. Uncover , sprinkle parmesan cheese on top , and bake for an additional 5 minutes

title: shrimp and spinach casserole
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f
2. Squeeze all water from the spinach
3. Combine all ingredients , except bread crumbs and butter , in a bowl and stir carefully
4. In a casserole dish that has been sprayed with pam , pour in the mix
5. Mix the bread crumbs with the melted butter and sprinkle them on top of the casserole
6. Bake for 45 minutes or until the casserole is firm
7. A substitution of 1 tablespoon of chopped fresh thyme for the dried thyme will make this dish slightly better

title: garden cottage crunch
steps:
1. Place cottage cheese in a sieve and press to remove some of the moisture
2. Mix the bell pepper , carrot , tomato , lemon juice , green onion , basil , lemon zest , and onion salt in a medium bowl
3. Add black pepper to taste
4. Gently fold cottage cheese into the vegetable mixture
5. Place a lettuce leaf on each tortilla
6. Divide the cottage cheese mixture among the lettuce leaf lined tortillas and wrap
7. Enjoy immediately !
8. How to wrap:
9. If tortilla is stiff , warm slightly to make more flexible
10. Fold the right and left edges of the tortilla over the filling , toward the center
11. Fold the bottom edge of the tortilla toward the center and gently roll until the tortilla is completely wrapped around the filling

title: light turkey schnitzel
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200 degrees
2. In a shallow dish beat together egg whites and milk with a fork
3. Add 2 tablespoons flour , cheese , salt , pepper and nutmeg , and mix well
4. Coat a large non-stick skillet with cooking spray and add 1 teaspoon butter
5. Place over medium heat until butter sizzles
6. Put remaining 3 tablespoons flour in plastic bag
7. Add 2 turkey slices at a time to bag and shake to coat
8. Dip into milk mixture , turning to coat and letting excess mixture drip off
9. Add coated turkey to skillet and cook about 3 minutes per side or until golden brown and no longer pink in center
10. Transfer to a heat-proof serving platter and keep warm in the preheated oven
11. Repeat with remaining turkey and butter
