12. If desired , after all turkey is cooked , add lemon juice and broth to skillet
13. Boil 1 to 2 minutes , stirring constantly
14. Pour over turkey

title: baby s first applesauce cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Line twenty-four 2-1 / 2-inch muffin cups with foil bake cups or paper bake cups
3. Set aside
4. In a medium mixing bowl , combine flour , baking powder , apple pie spice , and baking soda
5. Set aside
6. In a large mixing bowl , beat butter with an electric mixer for 30 seconds
7. Add sugar and vanilla
8. Beat until well combined
9. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
10. In a large measuring cup , combine applesauce and buttermilk
11. Alternately add applesauce mixture and flour mixture to butter mixture , beating on low speed after each addition just until combined
12. Spoon batter into prepared muffin cups , filling each about one-half to two-thirds full
13. Bake in preheated oven for 18 to 20 minutes or until a wooden toothpick inserted near centers of cakes comes out clean
14. Cool cakes in pans on wire racks for 10 minutes
15. Remove cupcakes from pans and cool thoroughly on racks
16. Tint frosting with liquid food coloring or paste as desired
17. Frost cupcakes and decorate with candy sprinkles , nonpareils , and candy-coated chocolate pieces , as desired
18. Makes 24 cupcakes

title: easter bunny
steps:
1. Shake crme de cacao and vodka with ice
2. Strain over ice in an old-fashioned glass
3. Float chocolate syrup and cherry brandy

title: pork hocks with chilli caramel sauce
steps:
1. Combine chicken stock , hoi sinh sauce and powdered ginger
2. Bring to boil for 1minute
3. Simmer the pork hocks gently in the stock mixture for 3 to 4 hours
4. Remove the hocks from the stock and drain well
5. Refrigerate
6. Flake the meat away from the bone prior to final step
7. For the sauce , place half the water in a saucepan , add the palm sugar and boil until the sugar caramelises
8. Add the ginger , chillies and the remaining water and stir constantly to prevent the sauce from seizing or solidifying
9. Add the lime juice and fish sauce then simmer , stirring constantly , for 1 minute
10. Keep warm
11. Heat the oil in a deep pot or wok to very hot and deep-fry the pork meat until golden brown
12. Remove and drain on paper towel
13. Serve by placing the pork in the middle of a plate and pour over the warm chilli caramel sauce
14. Garnish steamed whole baby bok choy

title: bacon  cheese  and chive mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Cut potatoes in fourths and cut off all black spots
2. Put in large pot with cold water and add 2 cloves of garlic , slightly crushed , on stove on high
3. When water boils add 1 tbs of salt
4. Cook till when poked with knife it easily comes out
5. Mince and saut remaining garlic with evoo till brown and caramelized
6. Drain potatoes and remove garlic cloves
7. Mash and add sauted garlic and remaining ingredients

title: baked breaded  yummy catfish
steps:
1. Line baking dish with foil and spray with cooking spray
2. Combine egg and italian dressing in shallow dish
3. Combine breadcrumbs , cheese , pepper , and garlic powder in second shallow dish
4. Dip fish in egg mixture , followed by bread crumb mixture
5. Drizzle remaining egg mixture over fish
6. Add remaining breadcrumbs to fish
7. Coat lightly with cooking spray
8. Bake at 350 degrees for forty-five minutes

title: chicken soup for the lazy
steps:
1. To the chicken stock , add the carrots , rice , and cubed cooked chicken
2. Simmer over a low heat for about 20 minutes or until the carrots and rice are cooked
3. Season with salt and pepper and serve immediately

title: high protein greek chicken salad
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 400f and coat a baking sheet with low fat cooking spray
2. Season both sides of the chicken with salt and pepper
3. Place the chicken on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes until it's cooked through
4. Cut the chicken into two-inch pieces
5. In a large bowl , toss the cucumber onion and feta cheese
6. In a small bowl , whisk together the vinegar oil and mustard
7. Add the mustard to the cucumber mixture and stir to coat
8. Stir in the chicken
9. Season to taste with salt and black pepper
10. Serve the chicken salad over the romaine lettuce

title: p b j  sandwich shaped   cookies
steps:
1. In medium-size bowl , with electric mixer on medium speed , beat brown sugar , butter & peanut butter until light & fluffy
2. Beat in egg & vanilla until well mixed
3. Reduce mixer speed to low
4. Gradually beat in flour , baking powder & salt
5. Gather dough into a ball: form into a 12-inch long log , with fingers , press dough to resemble a loaf of bread by making top round & squaring off bottom
6. Wrap & refrigerate dough several hours or until firm enough to slice
7. Heat oven to 350f
8. Lightly grease 2 baking sheets
9. With sharp knife , cut dough crosswise into 1 / 4- inch thick slices
10. Place slices , 1 inch apart , on greased baking sheet
11. If necessary , reshape cookie slices to resemble a slice of bread
12. Bake cookies 8-10 minutes ot until just golden brown at edges
13. Cool cookies 2 minutes on baking sheet , than transfer to wire rack & cool completely when cookies are cool , turn half side down on work surface
14. Spoon 1 / 4 teaspoon grape jelly on each and top with another cookie , right side up
15. Gently press cookies together to spread jelly evenly
16. Store in airtight container

title: fantabulous garlic bread pizzas
steps:
1. Preheat oven if baking directions on garlic bread call for this
2. Remove garlic bread from packaging , place the 2 halves of bread garlic side up on cookie sheet
3. Open can of pizza sauce , use spoon to spread along garlic bread halves
4. Top with your favorite pizza toppings
5. Cover with cheese
6. Cook until garlic bread is heated thoroughly and cheese is melted

title: butternut squash chocolate chip muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Spray muffin tins with low-fat cooking spray or line with cupcake papers
3. In medium bowl , mix together wet ingredients
4. Let sit for 5 minutes
5. In large bowl , whisk together all dry ingredients
6. Add wet ingredients to dry and mix until combined
7. Put into muffin tins
8. Bake 20 to 25 minutes

title: cheeseburger   fries casserole with veggies
steps:
1. Brown turkey in a large skillet
2. Drain
3. Add garlic powder , onion powder , carrots , broccoli
4. Saute about 5 minutes or until carrots are tender
5. Add mushrooms and zucchini
6. Saute about 3 minutes
7. Stir in soups
8. Pour into a greased 9 x 13 pan
9. Arrange fries on top
10. Bake uncovered at 350 for 50-55 minutes or until fries are golden brown
11. Let stand 5 minutes before serving

title: reuben spread
steps:
1. In a 1 1 / 2 quart slow cooker , add the sauerkraut , cream cheese , swiss cheese , corned beef , and dressing
2. Stir well to mix together
3. Cover and cook on high for 2 hours or until cheeses are melted , stirring occasionally
4. Turn temperature to low or warm setting on crock pot and serve with rye bread rounds or crackers

title: creamy mostaccioli with bacon and mushrooms
steps:
1. In medium skillet , cook bacon until crisp
2. Remove from fat and set aside
3. Add mushrooms to bacon fat
4. Cook until golden
5. Drain
6. Set aside
7. Prepare mostaccioli according to package directions
8. Drain
9. In same saucepan , combine half-and-half , butter , parsley flakes , salt , garlic and hot pepper sauce
10. Heat just until butter melts , stirring frequently
11. Combine bacon , mushrooms , hot mostaccioli , half-and-half mixture and parmesan cheese
12. Toss to coat
13. Place on warm serving platter
14. Garnish with green onions
15. Serve immediately
16. Refrigerate leftovers

title: authentic hummus
steps:
1. Drain and rinse garbanzos
2. Do not use can juices for the liquid in this recipe
3. They 'muddy' the flavour of the end result
4. Put garlic , tahini and salt in a blender or food processor and buzz until ingredients are well mixed
5. Add garbanzo beans and blend after each addition
6. You can reserve a few whole beans for garnish
7. Add lemon juice and blend
8. Add as much water as you need for the consistency you like
9. I usually use it all , unless the lemon is ultra juicy
10. Spread hummus on a flat plate
11. Create a bowl shape by elevating the edges with hummus
12. Drizzle olive oil over the hummus , sprinkle with paprika and garnish with reserved whole beans and chopped parsley
13. Serve with flat arabic bread
14. It's nice to toast the bread lightly in the oven

title: chocolate arrowroot cookies  no gluten  no sugar
steps:
1. Melt the butter and honey in a medium saucepan
2. Remove from heat and stir in remaining ingredients
3. Allow to stand
4. If after 5-10 minutes the dough is not firm , add a bit more arrowroot
5. Roll into small balls and bake at 350f / 170c for 10-15 minutes

title: kal iflower stoup
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil , 3 turns of the pan as she would say , in a pot over medium high heat
2. Add the potatoes , onion and garlic as you chop them
3. Season with rosemary , salt and pepper
4. Cook stirring frequently , until the vegetables soften a bit , 7-8 minute
5. Add the cauliflower and cook for a few minute
6. Stir in the peppers and broth
7. Cover and bring to a boil
8. Add the kale to the pot by the handful , letting each handful wilt before adding the next
9. Season with the nutmeg and cook for 5 min , then adjust the salt and pepper , to taste
10. Ladle the stoup into bowls and sprinkle with the grated parmesan cheese

title: pork   prune dumplings
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , mix thoroughly
2. Use approximately 1 tablespoon filling per dumpling
3. Place filling in middle of wrap and crimp to seal
4. Steam on a rack or in a bamboo steamer for about 10 minutes or until cooked through , or pan-fry till done

title: blt lettuce wraps 4 points
steps:
1. Carefully remove 2 large outer leaves of a head of lettuce
2. If you rip or tear one , just save it for the 3rd leaf you need to shred
3. Shred the 3rd leaf and set aside
4. Dice tomato and set aside in a bowl
5. Combine diced tomato with mayo and fresh black pepper
6. Place lettuce cups on a plate , top with lettuce shredded lettuce
7. Add tomato --
8. Then bacon and roll it like a wrap and dig in !

title: green tea buns
steps:
1. Sift together flower and baking powder
2. Stir in water
3. Knead 10 times and divide into 25 balls
4. Steam for 20 min until tender

title: bailey s hot fudge sauce
steps:
1. Over medium low heat melt butter and chocolate squares , take off heat
2. Add 1 / 3 of the sugar and 1 / 3 of the evaporated milk , mix with a whisk until smooth
3. Add remaining sugar and milk , stir until smooth
4. Return to heat and simmer for 8 to 10 minutes
5. Pour into canning jars or other container , let cool and close jar
6. Recipe can be doubled

title: hungarian stuffed sauerkraut
steps:
1. Squeeze out all excess liquid from sauerkraut into sink from and place in a bowl
2. Cook the rice
3. Put ground meat into another large bowl - you will need the space !
4. In a large deep saucepan , in which you will be cooking the meal
5. Braise the onion in plenty of oil , so it won't burn - until glassy
6. When done , pour off the oil , using spatula to keep onion in saucepan
7. Divide the cooked onions , leaving one half in saucepan
8. Place the other half on the meat
9. Turn off the heat and put in plenty of paprika and the tomato sauce on onion left in pan
10. Pour in some water , just as much so the mixture gets creamy
11. Let cool a little , then pour on sauerkraut and mix together
12. Take the bowl with the meat and onion
13. Make a well in the middle of the meat mixture , add the egg and mix together with your hands
14. Mix in cooked rice
15. Add paprika for nice red color , salt and pepper to taste and marjoram
16. Knead until smooth
17. Make sure to taste while you are working with it
18. This meal should be quite spicy ! but not too spicy !
19. Place one third of the sauerkraut mixture into your sausepan and place half of the speck / ham / lean bacon on top
20. Make meatballs about the size of a kiwi - don't need to make them hard
21. Place in the pan , next to each other to make a "meatball layer"
22. Put a second layer of sauerkraut mixture on top of it , then another layer of meatballs
23. Top it with the remaining sauerkraut
24. Place other half of speck on top
25. You must completely cover the meat layers with sauerkraut leaving no holes
26. Pour in water only until you can see it appear on the side - to about 3 / 4 of the pan
27. Cover , and cook on low heat
28. Do not stir !
29. Occasionally lift pan up and move back and forth sideways , like you were steering your car
30. It is done when sauerkraut is so soft it melts in your mouth
31. You don't need to taste the meat , because it cooks sooner than the sauerkraut , so it is 100% done if your sauerkraut is cooked
32. Serve with sour cream

title: whole wheat date and nut bread
steps:
1. Heat to 350f grease interior of loaf pan
2. Place dates in food processor along with 1 cup of the water
3. Pulse into a coarse puree , then add the egg , vanilla , baking powder , baking soda , salt , and the remaining 1 / 2 cup water
4. Pulse until mixture is thoroughly blended
5. Sprinkle the flour over the date puree , and pulse until mixed
6. Add raisins and nuts to mixture and stir to mix
7. Pour batter into the prepared loaf pan , and bake 40-45 minutes , or until a toothpick can be removed clean
8. Cool in pan on wire rack about 15-20 minutes , then turn out bread to cool completely
9. Wrap in plastic wrap and store for one day before slicing

title: refrigerator lime pie
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine limeade concentrate , sweetened condensed milk and lime zest together
2. Add in the dry pudding mix
3. Let sit on the counter for about 5 minutes
4. Fold in thawed cool whip until completely combined then mix in the food colouring
5. Pour into prepared pie crust
6. Cover the top of the pie with plastic wrap and chill for a minumum of 3 or more hours
7. Before serving dollup with cool whip or whipped cream and garlich with lime slices if desired
8. Process 14 regular size oreo cookies in a processor until finely crushed
9. Place the crumbs into a bowl and add in 1 / 4 cup melted butter or margaine mix well
10. Pat into the pie plate
11. Chill while making the rest of the recipe
12. This amount is enough crumbs for a 9-inch pie crust

title: breaded steak  bistec empanizado
steps:
1. Sprinkle steaks with chopped onion , minced garlic , "sour" orange juice or alternative mix , and salt
2. Rub into meat and cover
3. Place in the refrigerator & allow to marinate overnight
4. In bowl , beat the eggs - place flour on a plate , & breadcrumbs on another plate
5. Season with the seasonings and dip the steaks into eggs , then roll into flour cover lightly , then back into egg mixture and then into breadcrumbs and cover both on sides
6. Heat oil in skillet on medium heat and fry steak on both sides , until golden brown - don't overcook

title: curried meatballs
steps:
1. Heat oil over medium heat and stir-fry the onions
2. Add cinnamon stick and water , then add tomato sauce , garam masala , turmeric , ginger paste , salt , starseed petal and vinegar
3. Mix well and leave to simmer on low
4. To prepare the meatballs , place breadcrumbs , parsley , ghee , tomato and ground beef in a bowl and mix well but lightly
5. Form into medium-sized balls
6. Add meatballs to simmering sauce and add more water if necessary
7. Reduce heat and add bay leaves , sugar , all spice and breadcrumbs - it is important that you do not stir at this stage
8. Simmer , covered , until done

title: pork ribs with apple barbecue sauce
steps:
1. Cut the ribs into manageable pieces
2. Place in a large stock pot
3. Pour apple juice over ribs , cover and simmer for 1 hour
4. Drain , reserving cooking liquid
5. Keep ribs warm
6. Strain the liquid
7. Skim off as much fat as you can from the reserved liquid
8. Then reduce what remains to about 2 cups in volume
9. Add the remaining ingredients , bring to a boil , reduce heat , and simmer until the consistency of a thick sauce
10. Stir often so it doesn't stick to the bottom of the pan
11. Taste and adjust seasonings
12. Paint sauce on ribs and either run under your over broiler or cook on the barbecue for a few minutes per side to finish
13. Serve with your favourite potato salad and coleslaw

title: buttermilk  cheese  shallots   potato scones
steps:
1. In a small frying pan , melt butter and add shallots , cook on medium low heat until , soft and tender
2. Remove from pan , cool and set aside until needed
3. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f
4. In a large bowl stir together flour , baking powder , baking soda , sugar and salt
5. Cut in the shortening until it resembles fine bread crumbs , then stir in the cheese , cooled shallots and the mashed potatoes
6. Beat the egg and buttermilk together and pour into the flour , cheese and potato mixture all at once , stirring lightly until you have a soft sticky dough
7. Add the dough to a lightly floured surface and pat into a large circle about 3 / 4 to an inch thick
8. I use a water glass to cut out the dough
9. Place the scones on an ungreased cookie sheet and bake in a 425 degree oven for 10 - 12 minutes , until golden brown

title: drunken sweet potato pie
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f
2. Place pie crust in 9 1 / 2" deep dish pie pan
3. Crimp edges
4. Line crust with foil , fill with pie weights
5. Bake 15 - 20 minutes or until pale brown on edges and set
6. Remove foil and weights
7. Cool on wire rack
8. Increase oven temperature to 425f mash sweet potatoes in medium bowl
9. Place in large bowl , along with sugar , salt , cinnamon and nutmeg
10. Beat at medium speed until combined
11. Add eggs one at a time , beating just until blended
12. At low speed , beat in evaporated milk , butter , rum and vanilla until smooth
13. Pour mixture into crust
14. Cover edge of crust with foil and bake at 425f for 10 minutes
15. Reduce oven temperature to 300f and bake 50-60 minutes or until knif inserted in center comes out clean
16. Cool completely before cutting

title: creamy picante dip
steps:
1. Mix together cream cheese and picante salsa together with a hand mixer until smooth
2. Chill for a few hours
3. Serve with fritos

title: low fat vegetarian cheeseburger salad
steps:
1. Put your salad greens into a bowl
2. Microwave your veggie burger on a plate for about 1 minute on high
3. Check the burger
4. You want hot and about ready , but not getting tough
5. Then add the slice of cheese and microwave for 30 seconds on high
6. If the cheese is not melted at that point , put it back in the microwave for 5-10 more seconds
7. Cut the cheeseburger into strips
8. Put it on top of the lettuce
9. Drizzle your ketchup on top like salad dressing , or put out a little cup to dip into

title: vanilla chai cheesecake
steps:
1. Simmer 1 cup oregon chia original concentrate until reduced to 1 / 2 cup
2. Cool
3. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
4. Mix together crust ingredients
5. Press well into the bottom of a greased 9-inch springform pan
6. Bake for 12 minutes
7. When you take pan out of the oven , reduce heat to 290 degrees
8. Beat cream cheese with mixer until smooth
9. Add chai reduction and vanilla , blend just until smooth , scraping down sides as you go
10. Add sugar , cornstarch , and spices
11. Taste to adjust flavors , but be aware that spices will intensify in the oven
12. Add eggs , stir by hand until just incorporated
13. Pour into springform pan , sprinkle a little cardamom on top
14. Put a baking dish with 1 inch water in the bottom of your oven
15. Cook cheesecake on middle rack for 55 minutes
16. Turn off oven , just barely crack oven door until steam stops coming out
17. Close it back up and let it go for another 55 minutes
18. Take out of oven , slide knife around the edges of the pan to release cake and allow for contraction while cooling
19. Place on a cooling rack and cover with a large bowl
20. Let cool until it's room temperature , then move to refrigerator
21. When cold , you can freeze it for longer storage

title: metric jester s beef  barley and onions
steps:
1. Brown beef and onions together in dutch oven until onions are soft , season as desired
2. Stir in barley , onion soup mix and boiling water
3. Bring to boil , then reduce and simmer for 30 minutes

title: mixed salad
steps:
1. Break pita round into small pieces and place in a large bowl
2. Chop cucumber , onion , tomatoes and lettuce into bite-size chunks and combine with bread in a large bowl
3. Chop parsley , mint and purslane finely and add to salad
4. Crush garlic and salt together into a small bowl
5. Stir lemon juice and olive oil into garlic and salt mixture for the dressing
6. Add the dressing to the salad , toss well and serve

title: mock sour cream topping for baked potatoes
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together with electric mixer till smooth
2. Chill until serving time

title: healthy chicken francaise
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a bowl mix flour , garlic powder , onion powder , salt and pepper
3. In another bowl mix the eggs with water and add a pinch of salt and pepper
4. Heat olive oil in a medium sauce pan on medium-low heat
5. Pat dry chicken cutlets and dredge in flour mixture , coating both sides evenly shaking excess flour off
6. Place chicken into egg wash mix , coat both sides
7. Allow the chicken to drip excess egg coating and place fully coated chicken into hot oil
8. Let chicken cook for ]4 to 6 minutes until lightly brown , flip chicken and cook for another 4 minutes
9. Remove chicken and allow to rest
10. Turn stove off and add lemon juice , earth balance buttery spread and lemon zest to sauce pan
11. Stir until butter is melted
12. Remove butter lemon sauce from pan
13. Place chicken in an oven safe dish and pour sauce on top of chicken
14. Arrange lemon rounds and sprinkle parsley evenly throughout the dish
15. Place chicken in oven for 7 minutes or until sauce has been absorbed by chicken and breading is not wet

title: ruby tuesday s buffalo chicken wontons
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 325f
2. Place the wonton wrappers on a work surface and brush lightly with the oil
3. Mold the wontons , oiled-side up , into the bottoms of miniature muffin tins
4. Bake until light brown , about 5 minutes
5. Remove from oven , let cool slightly and remove from the muffin tins
6. Cool on a wire rack
7. Place on a baking sheet and cover tightly with plastic wrap until ready to assemble
8. Cook the chicken at a simmer until cooked through , about 12 minutes
9. Cool the chicken slightly , then finely chop and shred with a fork
10. Season with a little salt
11. In a medium bowl mix together the hot sauce , liquid margarine , garlic powder , and cayenne pepper
12. Add the chicken and mix well
13. Refrigerate until slightly chilled
14. To assemble:
15. Place 1 heaping teaspoon of the chicken mixture in each wonton cup and garnish with bleu cheese dressing and crunchy celery sticks for dipping
16. Serve at room temperature
17. The chicken mixture can be made up to 1 day in advance
18. Let sit at room temperature for 30 minutes before serving
19. The wonton cups can be filled up to 1 hour in advance

title: sugar free mock lemon or fruit pie filling
steps:
1. Directions:
2. Boil water----- whisk in lemonade mix
3. Whisk in the cold water and cornstarch mixture s-l-o-w-l-y , until mixture begins to boil again and thicken
4. Remove from heat when it is thick
5. Add salt , splenda , nutrasweet , lemon juice , yogurt and whisk to blend thoroughly
6. Add food coloring of your choice a drop at a time , until you are happy with the color
7. Pour 2 cups of filling into each of three gram cracker crusts and cover each with saran wrap
8. Refrigerate
9. When they are firm , cover pie or individual slices with sugar-free cool whip or a diet , canned whipped topping
10. Cut into 6 or 8 pieces to serve
11. You can also use individual tart shells to for great finger food !
12. Or you can refrigerate in tupperware for burrito pie filling
13. Put cup of chilled filling in a large flour tortilla and roll into a tight burrito that is well sealed
14. You can spray it with i cant believe its not butter spray but it is not necessary
15. Bake it / them seam side down on a rack in a toaster oven on medium toast or until brown
16. Put something under it like foil in case it / they leaks (if you roll it / them well , it / they wont ! toaster ovens vary , so watch them closely until you figure out your oven
17. You can use a regular oven for 2 or more at a time , i suggest 350-375fs and watch them carefully until they are golden brown

title: mexican pasta salad with salsa
steps:
1. Cook and drain pasta according to package directions , rinse with cold water
2. In large bowl combine mayonnaise , salt , pepper and garlic
3. Add pasta , salsa and green onions
4. Toss with large spoon coat
5. Cover and chill 1 hour to blend flavors

title: easy peasy bisquick cherry cobbler
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Melt butter in microwave safe bowl
3. Stir together milk , sugar , bisquick , vanilla and butter
4. Pour batter in 9 x 9 inch glass dish
5. Pour cherry pie filling in and press down gently with spoon so that most of the filling is covered with your batter
6. Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour
7. Important - as soon as the cobbler is done cooking place on towel inside refrigerator and cool for at least 4 hours
8. This step is very important for your crust to turn out buttery

title: grandma clay spice cookies
steps:
1. Cream together sugar , egg , shortening , and molasses
2. Mix together dry ingredients
3. Add to sugar ingredients
4. Mix well
5. Drop by teaspoonful on greases cookie sheet
6. Bake at 350 for 8-10 minutes or until done

title: grilled chicken with spinach and pine nut pesto
steps:
1. Heat a grill pan on medium high heat
2. Lightly oil the grill pan
3. Sprinkle the chicken with salt and pepper
4. Grill the chicken until cooked through , about 5 minutes per side
5. Combine the spinach , pine nuts , lemon juice , and lemon peel in a processor
6. Lightly pulse
7. With the machine running , gradually add 1 / 3 cup of the oil , blending until the mixture is creamy
8. Add salt and pulse
9. Put half of the pesto into ice cube trays and store in the freezer for future use
10. Transfer the rest of the spinach mixture to a medium bowl
11. Stir in the parmesan
12. Season the pesto with salt and pepper , to taste
13. Spread the pesto over each piece of chicken and serve

title: lentils with anchovies  capers  and a fried egg
steps:
1. Saute onion & garlic in olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat for about 3 minutes
2. Add celery , carrots , and anchovies , and saute for 2 minutes longer
3. Add lentils and stir well
4. Add stock / water , bay leaf , capers , and cloves
5. Cover , lower heat , and simmer gently for 25-30 minutes , or until most of the liquid has been absorbed and the lentils are tender
6. Just before lentils are done , melt butter in a separate pan , then crack the eggs into it and cook until whites are firm and yolks are runny , about 3-5 minutes
7. Once the lentils are done , add salt and pepper if you wish
8. Serve lentils with fried egg on top

title: you can t beat  em healthy blender muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Blend the apple , prunes and dates until pureed
3. Add the bananas , eggs , butter , vanilla , salt and juice and blend again
4. Mix together the remaining ingredients in a large bowl
5. Add the blender mixture to the ingredients in the bowl and mix well
6. Pour into greased or lined muffin tins and bake for 20-25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center of a muffin comes out clean

title: endive lettuce with walnut gorgonzola dressing
steps:
1. Wash the lettuce thoroughly and pat dry
2. Place the lettuce in a salad bowl and keep chilled until you are ready to serve
3. Whisk together the oil , vinegar , lemon juice , and mustard
4. Pour over the lettuce and mix gently
5. Place on chilled plates and sprinkle with the cheese , apples , walnuts and parsley
6. Toast some great bread and enjoy !

title: yummy pork steak
steps:
1. Put pork steaks in bottom of crockpot or slow cooker
2. Sprinkle onion soup mix over steaks
3. Pour soup over the top
4. Cover
5. Cook on high setting about 4 hours

title: pierogi filling
steps:
1. For the cabbage filling: cut the cabbage into quarters
2. Steam until very tender , about 15 minutes
3. Drain and cool
4. Wrap cooled cabbage in a towel , and squeeze out as much liquid as possible
5. Simmer finely chopped onions in butter and chicken broth until the onion is translucent - add the cooled cabbage salt and pepper
6. Let simmer until heated
7. Stir in the cream cheese and dill
8. Instant potato and cheese filling: sautee the onion and butter in a small pot until the onion is translucent
9. Add enough water based on the instant mashed potato package directions and add the chives
10. Once the water has boiled , remove the pot from the heat and add the potato flakes , cheese and cream cheese
11. Ground beef filling: in a large frying pan , simmer the finely chopped onions in the butter and cook until the onions are translucent
12. Prepare the ground beef by combining and kneading it with the hunters seasoning
13. Add it to the onion mixture , chopping it with your spatula so it doesn't cook together
14. Cook until all of the pink is gone
15. Hunters seasoning recipe: make as much or as little as you want using this ratio
16. This will make more than the 3 tablespoons amount , but i don't know what the ratio would be for exactly that amount
17. I always make a jar full and keep it on hand since it's a good general meat seasoning for beef or poultry
18. 2 teaspoons marjoram , 1 teaspoons peppercorn , 1 teaspoons caraway , teaspoons garlic powder , 1 teaspoons onion powder , 1 teaspoons allspice to taste , cloves to taste , 1 crushed bay leaf , 1 teaspoons juniper berries

title: grilled banana leaf fish w  sauteed veggies
steps:
1. Preheat the grill
2. In a small mixing bowl , add the oil , lemon juice and thyme
3. Season with salt and pepper
4. Mix well
5. Season the fish with salt and pepper
6. Brush both sides of the fish with the lemon mixture
7. Lay the lemon slices and thyme over the top of each fish
8. Cross two of the banana leaves , forming a cross
9. Place the fish in the center of the leaves
10. Wrap the fish in the leaves , securing the fish with toothpicks
11. Place the fish pouches on a low grill
12. Cook for 4 to 6 minutes on each side
13. In a saute pan , over medium heat , add the oil
14. When the oil is hot , add the vegetables
15. Season with salt and pepper
16. Saute for 3 to 4 minutes
17. To serve , place the fish in the center of each plate
18. Remove the toothpicks , exposing the fish
19. Serve the vegetables around the fish

title: spicy shrimp or chicken wraps
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine salsa , mango and ketchup
2. Set aside
3. Ina large resealable plastic bag , combine taco seasoning and oil
4. Add shrimp or chicken
5. Seal bag and skae to coat
6. In a nonstick skillet , cook shrimp or chicken over medium-high heat until cooked top tortillas with coleslaw mix , salsa mixture and chicken or shrimp
7. Serve with sour cream

title: chocolate brownies with hot fudge sauce
steps:
1. Brownies: preheat oven to 180c or 350f
2. Cook the sugar , margarine and cocoa powder on stove over medium until the margarine is melted
3. Remove from heat , add eggs and vanilla
4. Stir
5. Add remaining ingredients
6. Stir in nuts
7. Put in greased 20cm square pan
8. Bake at 180c or 350f for 25 minutes
9. Sauce: combine melted margarine , sifted cocoa and water in a microwave proof bowl
10. Blend in condensed milk with wire whisk
11. Microwave on high for 1 minute , then whisk to blend
12. Microwave 1 1 / 2 minutes more on high
13. Add vanilla and blend with whisk completely
14. Serve hot with brownies and ice-cream of choice
15. To preserve: leave to cool , put in jar with lid and refrigerate
16. To reheat: remove lid from jar and microwave
17. If the sauce is too thick , add some water

title: toffee cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Lightly grease 2 baking sheets combine sugars , vanilla , egg , butter and shortening in a large mixing bowl
3. Beat until fluffy
4. In a separate bowl , combine flour , oats , salt and baking soda
5. Add to sugar mixture , and blend completely
6. Add toffee bits and chocolate chips to dough , and mix well
7. Drop teaspoons of batter onto baking sheets , spacing dough about 1 inch apart
8. Bake until golden brown , about 8 minutes
9. Cool on a wire rack
10. Store in an airtight container in a cool place
11. Makes about 40 cookies

title: creamy chicken  vidalia  and cheese soup
steps:
1. Saute onions gently in butter and olive oil until soft and golden
2. Keep heat low to avoid excessive browning
3. Add chicken stock , meat , thyme , salt , and pepper
4. Bring to boil then turn down to simmer
5. Add cream cheese and allow it to melt inches
6. Whisk cornstarch into the cold milk then add to soup
7. Heat to a simmer again , stirring regularly to prevent lumps
8. Taste and correct seasonings if necessary
9. Stir in sharp cheddar until melted
10. Serve , garnished with parsely if desired
11. Alternately , use ham and ham broth instead of chicken and chicken stock

title: orange cranberry quinoa salad
steps:
1. Peel orange , remove white pith and cut into 1 / 2 inch pieces
2. Heat oil over medium heat , cook onions 2 minutes or until softened but not browned
3. Add curry powder , stir while cooking 30 seconds
4. Be careful not to burn
5. Add broth , quinoa , and 1 / 4 tsp salt
6. Bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat to low , cover and simmer 15 minutes or until water is absorbed and quinoa is translucent
8. In a medium bowl , combine carrots , cranberries , orange , orange peel and 1 / 4 tsp salt
9. Carefully stir mixture into quinoa
10. Cover and let set 3 minutes
11. Sprinkle with parsley

title: hoisin glazed bok choy
steps:
1. - in a cup , combine the soy sauce , hoisin sauce , water , sesame oil and flour
2. - in a wok , heat oil and fry the garlic and ginger
3. - add the mushrooms and stir-fry for 2 minutes
4. - add the bokchoy and the mixture and simmer for 3 minutes
5. - add the tofu and simmer again for another 1 minute

title: pasta with shrimp and cilantro lime pesto
steps:
1. Blend 1 1 / 4 cups cilantro leaves and next 4 ingredients in processor until coarse puree forms
2. With machine running , gradually add 1 / 2 cup oil
3. Season generously with salt
4. Cook linguine in large pot of boiling salted water until tender , but still firm to bite , stirring occasionally
5. Drain
6. Meanwhile , heat remaining 1 tb oil in heavy large skillet over medium-high heat
7. Add shrimp and cook until almost opaque in center , about 3 minutes
8. Remove skillet from heat
9. Add tequila
10. Return skillet to heat and stir until sauce is syrupy , about 30 seconds
11. Add pesto
12. Stir to coat
13. Remove from heat
14. Add pasta to sauce in skillet
15. Toss to coat
16. Season with salt and pepper
17. Divide pasta and shrimp among 4 plates
18. Sprinkle cotija cheese and chopped cilantro over and serve

title: hearty country style beef ribs
steps:
1. Place onions and carrots on bottom of crockpot
2. Top vegetables with ribs , and sprinkle pepper evenly over the ribs
3. In a medium bowl combine soup , 1 / 2 cup water , brown gravy mix , garlic , and thyme
4. Pour over ribs
5. Cover and cook on low for 7 hours
6. Remove meat to platter and keep warm
7. Skim fat from cooking juices
8. Transfer juices to a small pan , and bring to a boil
9. Combine cornstarch and 2 tablespoons water until smooth
10. Gradually stir into meat juices , and bring to a boil
11. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
12. Serve with meat and mashed potatoes

title: season s crock pot chicken rice soup
steps:
1. Pour two soup cans into crock pot , fill the soup cans each with water and pour into the crock pot
2. Mix together well
3. Add spices , onion , chicken and chilis , mix again
4. During the last hour of cooking add the rice
5. Cook on low for 6-8 hours or high for 3-4 hours
6. You can also let this thicken up and serve in tortillas

title: macaroni and cheese bites
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425f
2. In a large pan of boiling salted water , cook the macaroni until al dente
3. Drain well , shaking off any excess water
4. Brush mini muffin tins with butter
5. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of the parmesan
6. In a large saucepan , melt the 1 1 / 2 tablespoons of butter
7. Whisk in the flour and mustard over moderate heat for 2 minutes
8. Whisk in the milk and cook , constantly whisking , until boiling , about 5 minutes
9. Add the cheddar and american cheeses and whisk until melted
10. Mixture will be very thick
11. Remove from heat , and whisk in the egg yolk and paprika
12. Fold in the macaroni
13. Spoon slightly rounded tablespoons of the macaroni into the prepared muffin cups , packing well
14. Sprinkle the remaining parmesan on top
15. Bake for about 10 minutes , until golden and sizzling
16. Let cool for 5 minutes
17. Carefully loosen the mini macs , remove from pan to a platter , and serve
18. These can be prepared through step 4 and refrigerated overnight

title: rustic country flatbread with added goodies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees
2. In large bowl combine all of wheat flour / about 3 1 / 2 cups white flour , butter and water
3. Let stand until cool
4. Stir in remaining ingredients using enough flour to make dough easy to handle
5. Turn dough onto lightly floured surface and knead about 5 minutes
6. Divide dough in quarters
7. Roll out each quarter on floured surface as thin as possible
8. Flat breads will be irregular in shape
9. Place on ungreased cookie sheets
10. Bake 20 minutes , depending on thickness , or until golden brown
11. This makes 4 8-10" rounds
12. Cut into wedges and enjoy !

title: east west barbecued chicken
steps:
1. Place chicken in zip lock bag
2. Season with salt and pepper
3. Place mustard in small bowl
4. Whisk in orange juice , oil and pepper flakes
5. Pour over chicken , turning chicken to coat
6. Let stand 20 minutes
7. Combine chili sauce and hoisin sauce in small bowl
8. Prepare barbecue medium-high
9. Grill chicken until just cooked through , about 10 minutes per side
10. Brush one side with chili-sauce mixture and grill until beginning to brown , about 3 minutes
11. Brush second side with sauce and grill until beginning to brown
12. Serve hot

title: cold asparagus with walnuts
steps:
1. Cook the tender
2. Drain
3. In a medium bowl , combine honey , soy sauce , and rice vinegar
4. Whisk until blended and stir in walnuts
5. Combine asparagus and dressing and toss gently
6. Refrigerate until ready to serve
7. Arrange on a platter and sprinkle with black pepper
8. Serve

title: roasted pork loin with cider and chunky applesauce
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f
2. In a food processor , combine the chopped herbs with the garlic , crushed red pepper , a generous pinch of salt and enough olive oil to make a paste
3. Brush the paste all over the outside of the pork rib roast
4. Toss the onions with olive oil and salt , and place in the bottom of a roasting pan
5. Add the thyme , bay leaves and 2 / 3 of the cider
6. Place the pork on top of the onions and then in the preheated oven
7. Roast the pork at 425 degrees f for 20 to 25 minutes or until the pork has developed a lovely brown crust
8. Check the pork , stir the onions and cider if they are starting to burn
9. Add more cider if the fluid level starts to go down
10. Lower the oven to 375 degrees f and roast for another 30 to 35 minutes or until an instant-read thermometer reads 150 degrees f
11. If the crust on the pork starts to get too dark while cooking , cover it with foil
12. When done , place the pork loin on a plate , cover loosely with foil and let rest for at least 15 minutes before carving
13. Remove 1 1 / 2 cups of the cider from the bottom of the roasting pan and reserve for the applesauce
14. When ready to carve , cut the pork from the bone and cut the loin into thin slices
15. Serve with the onions braised in cider and chunky applesauce
16. For the applesauce , melt the butter in a saucepan large enough to accommodate the apples
17. Add the apples and saute over medium-low heat until the apples start to soften
18. Add the reserved cider , apple cider and cinnamon and cook over low-medium heat until most of the cider has evaporated and the apples are cooked and very soft
19. Add the heavy cream and walnuts , and cook until the cream has reduced by half

title: marinated eggplant
steps:
1. Wash and pare the eggplant
2. Slice 1 / 2" thick , then cut the slices into 1 / 2" strips
3. Drop strips into a pan of boiling water
4. When the water returns to a boil , remove the pan from the heat and let stand for 15 minutes
5. Drain into a colandar and and place a small plate on top of the eggplant , adding a heavy weight , such as a gallon jug of water
6. Let it drain for at least an hour
7. Put the eggplant in a bowl and add garlic , red pepper , salt , oregano , vinegar and olive oil
8. Stir gently but , well
9. Pack into small ball canning jars and process in a hot water bath for 5 minutes

title: pierogi beef skillet
steps:
1. In large skillet , cook beef and onion over medium heat until meat is no longer pink
2. Drain , reserving 3 t drippings
3. Sprinkle flour over beef and drippings
4. Stir until blended
5. Gradually add beef broth
6. Bring to a boil
7. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
8. Stir in the pierogies , vegetables and seasonings
9. Cook , uncovered , for 4-5 minutes or until heated through
10. Sprinkle with cheese

title: brunch bubble ring
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease 12-cup bundt pan
3. Combine first 3 ingredients in small bowl and mix well
4. Separate dough
5. Cut each biscuit in half
6. Dip in melted butter , then roll in cereal mixture , coating generously and pressing into dough
7. Layer in bundt pan
8. Sprinkle with remaining cereal mixture and drizzle with remaining butter
9. Bake 30 mins
10. Turn out immediately onto plate
11. Serve warm

title: slow cooked southwest stuffed peppers   vegetarian
steps:
1. Cut tops off peppers and remove seeds and white pith
2. Set aside
3. In large bowl , combine the beans , cheese , salsa , onion , corn , rice , chili powder and cumin
4. Spoon into peppers
5. Place in 5-quart slow cooker coated with cooking spray
6. Cover and cook on low for 3-4 hours or until peppers are tender and filling is heated through
7. Serve with sour cream if desired

title: barbecued monterey chicken sandwiches
steps:
1. Take your breasts and cut them lengthwise right down the middle
2. You want them to be about half as thick as they are out of the package
3. Season the chicken with your salt , pepper , and garlic to your taste
4. Cook bacon and set aside for later
5. Grill chicken over medium heat until done
6. While chicken is still on grill , lightly brush on barbecue sauce on face of chicken
7. Place 2 pieces of bacon over bbq sauce on chicken
8. Generously cover bacon with cheese
9. Leave for about 2 more minutes
10. Toast your crossaints during step 8
11. Make and enjoy your barbecued monterey chicken sandwiches

title: vegan peanut butter oatmeal cookies  healthier
steps:
1. In a big bowl combine flours , baking powder , baking soda , cinnamon , salt and oats
2. Add in peanuts or chocolate chips and pb chips and stir to combine
3. In a second bowl beat together applesauce , peanut butter , sugars , ground flax seeds and vanilla
4. Add the liquid to the dry ingredients and stir to combine
5. If your dough seems too wet to handle , add in more flour , if its too dry , add a tad more milk
6. Drop generous tbs full of dough per cookie onto a paper-lined or greased baking sheet leaving some space between the cookies
7. Flatten cookies slightly using moistened fingers or a spoon
8. Bake in the preheated oven at 350f / 175c for about 15 minutes or until toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
9. These cookies are more cake-like , so they wont crisp up
10. Allow to cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes and then remove to wire racks to cool completely
11. Enjoy ! :)

title: caramel cereal crisps
steps:
1. In a large heavy pan melt butter and add corn syrup over low heat
2. Add sugar , water and salt
3. Cook until mixture comes to a full boil , stirring occasionally
4. Boil 3 minutes or to a firm ball stage
5. While still over low heat add all of the cereal
6. Stir until evenly coated
7. Spread mixture in a buttered 9x13-inch pan
8. If needed slip a sandwich bag over your hand and finish spreading
9. Cut in pieces right away
10. When cool , remove from pan

title: macadamia and pineapple rice pilaf
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 375 degrees f
2. In an oven-proof and flame-proof casserole , set over medium heat , melt the butter and add the rice
3. Stir for a few seconds , until the butter coats the rice
4. Add the garlic and stir for a few seconds
5. Add the red and yellow peppers and cook for a few seconds
6. Add the stock and bring the mixture to a gentle boil
7. Add the raisins , nuts , sage and salt
8. Cover and place in the oven
9. Bake for about 18 minutes
10. Remove from the oven and let rest for about 10 minutes
11. Add the chopped cilantro and pineapple
12. Season if necessary and serve

title: green tea ginger sparkler
steps:
1. Combine chopped ginger & tea concentrate while still hot & refrigerate for at least 3 hours
2. Strain & discard ginger
3. Combine ginger ale w / tea concentrate & pour into 4 ice-filled glasses
4. Enjoy !

title: crispy rice  chicken  and sweet potatoes  rsc
steps:
1. In a skillet , cover the chicken breasts , shallots , lemon juice , and turmeric with water
2. Bring to a boil on medium-high heat
3. Reduce temperature and simmer for one hour
4. Reserve the stock
5. Cool and cut the chicken into small pieces
6. Wash and drain the rice
7. Bring six cups of water and 1 / 4 teaspoon turmeric to a boil in a large pot
8. Add rice and boil uncovered for ten minutes
9. Drain and rinse the rice in cool water
10. In a food processor , combine yogurt , egg yolks , hidden valley original ranch seasoning mix , lemon zest , chives , salt , and pepper
11. Process for 30 seconds or until all ingredients are thoroughly combined
12. Add 2 cups of the rice to the yogurt mixture
13. Process for 15- 20 seconds
14. Dissolve the saffron into 3 tablespoons of the chicken stock
15. Lightly brush one side of the sweet potato slices with a tablespoon of olive oil
16. Cover the bottom of a large non-stick skillet with two tablespoons of olive oil and 1 / 2 teaspoon of the saffron mixture
17. Layer 2 / 3 of the rice and yogurt mixture in the bottom of the pan
18. Line the edges of the pan with the sweet potatoes
19. Layer the chicken on top of the mixture
20. Spoon on the rest of the yogurt mixture
21. Spread it as evenly as possible
22. Add the remaining rice
23. Flatten the rice with the back of a spoon
24. Combine three tablespoons of chicken stock with the remaining saffron mixture
25. Drizzle over the top of the rice layer
26. Cook covered on medium heat until it begins to steam
27. Reduce temperature to low and cook for one hour
28. Cool , then place a large plate over the top of the pan
29. Carefully invert the pan
30. Garnish as desired
31. Top with a dollop of greek peach on the bottom yogurt and sweet mango chutney

title: chilled leek and potato soup  vichyssoise
steps:
1. Special equipment suggested: a heavy-bottomed 3-quart saucepan with cover
2. Simmering the soup
3. Bring the leeks , potatoes and water to the boil in the saucepan
4. Salt lightly , cover partially , and simmer 20-30 minutes , or until the vegetables are tender
5. Puree the soup if you wish
6. Taste , and correct seasoning
7. After chilling the soup , you may wish to stir in a little more cream
8. Taste carefully again , and correct the seasoning
9. Top each serving with a sprinkle of chives or parsley

title: rum drunk cranberry hazelnut cookies
steps:
1. Combine the cranberries and rum and microwave for about a minute
2. Let it sit for about 15 minutes so that the cranberries can get a nice , steady buzz
3. In a food processor combine the hazelnuts with the margarine until it has a rough paste consistency
4. Stir together the sugars in a large mixing bowl
5. Beat together the egg and vanilla extract and mix them with your hazelnut 'butter'
6. Sift together the flours , baking soda , salt , and spices
7. Add the dry stuff to the wet stuff a little bit at a time
8. Do some light stretching and get ready for a really good workout
9. When all of the flour mixture has made it into the sugar mixture , pop your dough ball in the fridge for about an hour or so
10. Roll the dough into little balls
11. Mix the reserved sugar , crushed hazelnuts , and cranberries in a small dish and press the dough spheres into dough patties in the mixture
12. Put the dough patties on a cookie sheet lined with parchment or a silpat if you've got it and bake each batch for roughly 8-10 minutes at 375f you don't really need to worry about too much spreading as the nuts hold the melting point of the dough up pretty high
13. Cool the finished product completely on a cooling rack
14. Dunk these babies in some milk and revel in the deliciousness you've just created
15. Good job !

title: shrimp mick jagger
steps:
1. Wash shrimp
2. Peel completely and devein
3. Or leave shells partially on for easy handling at the table
4. Combine shrimp , half of ginger , green onion , salt and sugar in a bowl
5. Mix well
6. Heat large frying pan or wok and add oil
7. When oil is hot , add other half of ginger and fry , stirring for a minute
8. Immediately add shrimp mixture
9. Stir and fry for two minutes
10. Add chinese rice wine or vermouth
11. Stir
12. Reduce heat and cover pan
13. Continue to cook for two more minutes over low heat
14. Remove shrimp from pan
15. Sprinkle with green onion
16. Serve with rice and kiwi slices

title: lemon buttermilk shake
steps:
1. In a blender , combine buttermilk and honey
2. Blend for 25 seconds
3. Add ice cream and sorbet , then pulse several times to begin breaking them up
4. With blender off , use a silicone spatula to mash mixture onto blades
5. Continue pulsing and stoppng to mash until mixture is thick , smooth and moves easily in blender , about 1 minute

title: everyday vegan choco brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f coat 9x13-inch baking dish with cooking spray
2. Combine sugar , flour , cocoa powder , baking powder , baking soda and salt in large bowl
3. Combine applesauce , tofu , soymilk and vanilla in food processor , and process until well blended
4. Add tofu mixture to dry ingredients , and mix well
5. Scrape batter into prepared pan
6. Bake until batter is set and top is dry , 45 to 50 minutes
7. Cool in pan
8. Cut into bars and serve

title: maggie beer s sour cream shortcrust pastry
steps:
1. Chop the cold butter and put it in a food processor bowl with the flour
2. Pulse this mixture until the butter resembles chunks the size of olives
3. Add the sour cream and pulse again until 'just' incorporated
4. The mixture does not have to be perfectly smooth and uniform
5. Turn onto a well-floured , cool surface and roll the dough into a rectangle
6. Cover and leave to rest in the fridge for 20 minutes
7. Roll into the desired shape
8. Rest again in the fridge
9. Bake

title: lighter chocolate fondue  or ganache
steps:
1. Cut angel food cake into bite size wedges
2. Peel and cut banana into one inch chunks
3. Core and slice the pear or apple
4. Place the bananas , pears and strawberries on a serving platter
5. Squeeze orange wedge over banana and pear and mix gently
6. In a medium saucepan , whisk together cocoa powder and sugar
7. Slowly pour in evaporated milk , all the while whisking , to make a paste
8. Place the saucepan over low to medium heat and cook , stirring constantly , until chocolate base is simmering
9. Remove pot from heat and whisk in vanilla and chocolate
10. Keep stirring until chocolate is completely melted
11. The mixture will be quite thick
12. Transfer chocolate to a fondue pot to keep warm
13. If you do not have a fondue pot , try serving the fondue in a warmed ceramic bowl
14. Dip fruit in chocolate
15. Spoon chocolate over angel food cake and enjoy !
16. Store leftovers in the refrigerator
17. Rewarm by microwaving 35-45 seconds , stirring every 10 seconds

title: delicious apple walnut dessert
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Butter a 13" x 9" baking pan
3. Place the sliced apples in prepared baking pan
4. Sprinkle with 1 / 4 cup brown sugar and 2 tsp cinnamon
5. In a mixing bowl cream butter and remaining 2 cups brown sugar
6. Add eggs
7. Stir in flour and 3 / 4 cup walnuts
8. Spread over apples
9. Sprinkle with remaining 3 / 4 cup walnuts
10. Bake for 45-50 minutes , or until apples are tender

title: chicken   pasta with marinara sauce
steps:
1. In large , heavy skillet , heat the oil over medium heat until it is hot but not smoking
2. Add the garlic and onions
3. Saut until golden-- about 3 to 4 minutes
4. Add spices and chicken chunks
5. Cook through--about 10 minutes
6. Add stewed italian style tomatoes to chicken / marinara sauce
7. Simmer while cooking pasta according to package directions
8. Toss marinara sauce gently with cooked pasta
9. Serve immediately , sprinkled with parmesan cheese

title: my favorite italian salad
steps:
1. Rinse cooked pasta with cold water and drain completely
2. In a large bowl , toss together pasta and next nine ingredients {through provolone)
3. Season to taste with salt and pepper
4. Mix dressing ingredients--oregano , vinegar and oil
5. Pour over salad and mix well
6. Refrigerate for an hour before serving

title: sweet potato and chickpea curry
steps:
1. Chop the onions if using a blender
2. In food processor or blender , combine onions , garlic , hot pepper and ginger
3. Pulse until finely chopped
4. Pour oil into large saute pan over medium-low heat
5. Add chopped onion mixture and saute until softened , about 5 minutes
6. Add hot pepper flakes , ground ginger , ground coriander , cumin , turmeric , cardamom , and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt
7. Stir to mix
8. Add sweet potatoes and stir until well covered in spices
9. Stir in coconut milk
10. Dissolve tamarind paste in hot vegetable broth and add to pan
11. Bring to boil , reduce heat and simmer , partially covered , until sweet potatoes are just tender , about 30 minutes or more
12. Taste potatoes to make sure they are cooked all the way and allow additional cooking time of necessary
13. Add chickpeas and simmer until heated through , about 5 minutes
14. Adjust salt to taste
15. Transfer to bowl and sprinkle with chopped cilantro
16. Serve with white rice if desired

title: warm bacon vinaigrette
steps:
1. Cook bacon in large skillet until crisp
2. Remove bacon and drain on paper towels
3. Reserve 2 t drippings in skillet
4. Cook shallots and garlic in hot drippings for 3 minutes , or until tender
5. Add brown sugar and cook stirring constantly for one minute or until sugar is dissolved
6. Process garlic mixture , orange juice , and remaining ingredients in blender until combined
7. Fyi the cooked bacon is not actually used in this recipe , but you can top your salad with it if desired

title: chilli cheese bocconcini
steps:
1. Season breadcrumbs with lemon zest , dried chilli , italian herbs & black pepper
2. Deep fry briefly in hot oil
3. Drain & serve

title: suz s sweet poppy seed dressing recipe
steps:
1. Put everything in your blender , except the poppy seeds and the canola oil , and process until the onion has been pureed
2. On the lowest speed of the blender , pour in the canola oil and the poppy seeds
3. Refrigerate and enjoy !

title: peanut buster bar dessert
steps:
1. Mix crushed cookies and melted butter-- pat into a 9x13 pan
2. Freeze for one hour
3. Spread ice cream evenly over crust , pour peanuts over the ice cream and using the back of a spoon press peanuts into ice cream
4. Freeze for one hour again
5. Place topping ingredients in a pan over medium heat
6. Stir till melted together , cook 8 minutes stirring constantly
7. Spread over ice cream filling-- freeze overnight
8. Let soften slightly before serving

title: afghani naan  flatbread
steps:
1. Sift the flour with the salt into a large bowl
2. Stir in the yeast
3. Add the vegetable oil , if using , and rub it in wih your hands
4. Gradually add in the warm water and mix with your hands to form a smooth , round , soft dough
5. Knead for 7 to 10 minutes until dough is elastic and smooth
6. Roll dough into several round balls , cover with a damp cloth , and let rest in a warm spot until dough has doubled in size
7. Preheat the oven to 500 degreesf
8. Line a baking tray with aluminum foil and place in the oven to get hot
9. Once the dough has risen , divided into about 4 equal portions
10. On a lightly floured surface , shape or roll the dough out into an oval 1 / 2 inch thick
11. Wet your hands and use your finger
12. Remove the hot tray from the oven and place a prepared dough on it and bake until golden brown , 8 to 10 minutes being careful not to over cook or burn it
13. Repeat with remaining dough
14. Wrap each bread with a clean tea towel or tin foil to prevent them from drying out

title: reuben wraps
steps:
1. Spread tortillas with dressing
2. Top each with 3 slices corned beef
3. Add 1-1 / 2 slices cheese each
4. Add coleslaw and onions
5. Roll up and wrap in damp paper towel
6. Microwave on high for 4 minutes

title: awesome appys
steps:
1. Spread each ham slice thinly with mustard
2. Top with cheese
3. Roll tightly
4. Secure with 3 toothpicks
5. Heat oil in skillet
6. Dip rolls in egg , then in crumbs
7. Fry briefly until golden brown , about 3 minutes
8. Drain on paper towel , cut between toothpicks to make 3 pieces

title: goop
steps:
1. Beat all ingredients until smooth
2. Keep refrigerated
3. Great on toast , crackers dabbed on grilled steaks -- or placed inside baked potatoes !

title: homemade sweet dill yum yum pickles
steps:
1. Slice the washed pickles into about 1 / 4 to 1 / 3-inch slices , then place in a medium bowl
2. Pour 2 cups sugar over the slices and toss / stir to coat with the pickle slices
3. Allow to sit out at room temperature for 24 hours tossing several times with a spoon during the 24 hours
4. After the 24 hours in a medium saucepan combine 2 cups sugar , vinegar , water , pickling spice
5. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring until the sugar is dissolved
6. Make certain that the bowl is pyrex or heat-proof or it might crack when you pour the boiling water into it -- pour the water mixture over the sugared pickles and the sugar juice that has gathered in the bowl
7. Mix very well with a spoon
8. Allow the mixture to stand at room temperature for about 8 hours or overnight
9. Drain pickles
10. Transfer pickles to clean glass jars and store covered or uncovered in refrigerator
11. Serve cold

title: chicken strips with scallions white sauce
steps:
1. Cut the chicken in strips or fingers
2. Make a mix using all the ingredients listed for that purpose , mix well until reaching a consistency similar to honey
3. If too liquid add some flour
4. If too dry add some milk
5. Put inside of the mix the chicken strips and be sure coat the meat properly
6. Take piece by piece and fry until golden brown
7. Afix the chicken on a large serving platter and cover it with the following sauce
8. Mix in a sauce pan the 2 cups of milk add the corn starch and stir continuosly add 1 by 1 all the ingredients listed for the sauce
9. When reach a creamy consistency is ready
10. If too dry ,
11. Add some milk , cover the chicken strips with sauce
12. Serve hot

title: pollo con chorizo   chicken with chorizo
steps:
1. Coat the chicken with the paprika , make sure they are covered evenly , then season with salt and pepper
2. In a large skillet heat the olive oil and cook the chicken pieces until golden brown
3. Transfer chicken to a plate
4. Add the onion , garlic and chorizo to the pan and cook for 2 to 3 minutes
5. Add the tomatoes , bay leaves , and sherry and bring to a boil
6. Place the chicken in the pan with the sauce
7. Cover and simmer for about 40 minutes
8. After the 40 minutes uncover and season to taste with salt and pepper
9. Cover again and let it simmer for another 20 minutes
10. Cool 5 minutes before serving

title: ultimate hot chocolate
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a medium saucepan and place over low heat
2. Stir regularly to prevent burning the chocolate
3. A whisk will provide the best results
4. Hot chocolate is ready when the chocolate chips have melted completely and the mixture has reached your desired temperature

title: moroccan tagine with chicken and dates
steps:
1. For sugared walnuts: melt 1 t butter in a small saucepan and cook the walnuts over low heat until they are a shade darker and fragrant
2. Set aside to cool
3. When cool , remove from the pan into a bowl and toss with the 1 t sugar
4. Set aside
5. In the tagine cooking vessel , heat 1 t olive oil over medium-high heat until hot
6. Salt and pepper the chicken thighs on both sides and sear until just golden brown , but not cooked through
7. Set them aside
8. The thighs will have rendered some fat
9. Remove enough fat to leave only 1 t fat in the pan
10. Lower the heat to medium and saute the onion until translucent , about 5 minutes
11. Stir in the garlic , cumin , coriander , cayenne , cinnamon , and ginger and continue to saute until the garlic is softened and the spices are toasted , about 2 minutes
12. Add the cider , chicken broth , and honey and bring to a boil
13. Boil the liquid for about 5 minutes , until liquid has reduced slightly
14. Meanwhile , preheat the oven to 375 degrees
15. To the broth mixture , add the sweet potato , half of the chickpeas and half of the dates
16. Nestle the chicken thighs in the pan and toss the remaining dates and chickpeas over the top
17. Cover the vessel and place it in the 375-degree oven for 50 minutes to 1 hour , until the sweet potato and chicken thighs are cooked though
18. When cooked , remove from the oven and taste for seasoning
19. Add more salt , pepper , or honey as desired
20. Serve over cous-cous with sugared walnuts and yogurt on the side

title: flour tortillas  sun dried tomato  red bell pepper  garlic
steps:
1. By hand:
2. Combine the flour , baking powder , salt , and optional dried pasta sauce mix
3. Either by hand or with a pastry cutter , cut in the shortening till the mixture is crumbly
4. If the mixture looks more floury than crumbly , be sure to add just one or two more tablespoons of shortening till it is crumbly
5. Add about 3 / 4 cup hot water to the mixture , or just enough to make the ingredients look moist
6. With your hand or a large fork , knead the mixture making sure to rub the dough against the sides of the large mixing bowl to gather any clinging dough
7. If the dough still sticks to the side of the bowl , add a couple more tablespoons of flour until the dough forms a soft round shape
8. The dough is ready to roll out now , but it is best to let it rest
9. Cover it with a dish towel , and let it sit for about an hour or so
10. Take the dough , and pull it apart into 10 to 12 balls
11. Lightly flour your rolling area , and roll each ball with a rolling pin to about 1 / 8 inch thickness
12. Place each tortilla on a medium hot cast iron skillet
13. Cook for about 1 to 2 minutes on each side , or until the tortilla does not look doughy
14. Bread machine:
15. Combine flour , baking powder , optional dried pasta sauce mix , and salt in bread machine
16. Cut shortening into pieces about the size of olives , and drop inches
17. Start mix cycle and slowly add tap water
18. Let cycle run five or six minutes , then stop machine
19. Remove dough from bread machine , cover with a warm wet towel and let sit for 15 minutes , so dough can relax
20. Pinch off egg-sized pieces of dough and roll into balls
21. Use a rolling pin to roll them into thin rounds
22. Heat a dry cast-iron skillet to medium
23. Transfer tortillas to skillet and cook until spots on the bottom are dark brown
24. Flip tortillas and cook on second side until spots are dark brown
25. Serve immediately
26. Keep warm in the folds of a kitchen towel if necessary

title: noodles and stir fried shrimp medley
steps:
1. Cook noodles according to package directions
2. Drain
3. Keep warm , set aside
4. While noodles are cooking , pour mushroom and orange liquids into a measuring cup add water to equal 1 cup
5. Blend in cornstarch and set aside
6. In a large skillet , melt butter and saute mushrooms , shrimp , pea pods , green onions , and garlic powder until shrimp turn pink
7. Add reserved liquid , stirring until slightly thickened
8. Toss shrimp mixture with hot cooked noodles , gently blend in orange segments and soy sauce to taste

title: v s white chocolate cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to temperature 350f
2. Combine crumbs and 1 / 3 cup sugar stir in butter and mix thoroughly
3. Press mixture
4. Around bottom and sides in bottom of a 9 inch
5. Springform pan
6. Set aside
7. Place cream cheese
8. In a large mixing bowl and beat with an electric mixer 3-5 minutes
9. Until fluffy
10. Add vanilla and almond extracts
11. Slowly add remaining
12. Sugar and beat 5 minutes
13. Add melted white chocolate and beat 5
14. Minutes
15. Add sour cream and beat 3 minutes
16. Pour into prepared
17. Springform pan
18. Tap pan on counter to release any air bubbles
19. If
20. Using an electric oven , bake 35 minutes
21. If using a gas oven , 30
22. Minutes
23. Without opening oven door , turn off oven
24. Let cheesecake
25. Stand in oven another 15 minutes if using electric , 10 minutes if
26. Using gas
27. Transfer to wire rack to cool
28. When cooled , chill in
29. Refrigerator at least 6 hours or overnight for best results

title: one muffin recipe7 different ways
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine the flour , sugar , baking powder , and baking soda in a mixing bowl and stir together
3. Make a well in the center of the flour mixture and pour in the remaining ingredients
4. Stir together until well blended , but dont over beat
5. The batter should be medium-thick
6. If it seems too stiff or dry , add a small amount of additional milk
7. Stir in the additional ingredient or ingredients of your choice , then divide the batter among 12 oiled or foil-lined muffin tins
8. Bake for 20 minutes , or until the tops of the muffins are golden and a toothpick inserted into the center of one comes out clean
9. Let cool until just warm to touch , then transfer muffins to a plate
10. I would store these in the refrigerator so they dont get moldy from the moist fruit

title: sri lankan eggplant  aubergine  curry
steps:
1. Wash the eggplants , remove the stalk , and slice lengthwise into quarters
2. Cut each quarter lengthwise into 1" wide strips and then crosswise into 1" cubes
3. Heat 1-2 inches of peanut oil in a wok to medium-high heat and deep-fry the eggplant cubes in batches until golden brown
4. Drain thoroughly on kitchen paper
5. In a medium-sized pan , heat the extra oil and saute and stir the onion until golden brown
6. Add the turmeric , cumin , coriander and mustard and stir for a couple of seconds before adding the garlic , ginger , chillies and curry leaves
7. Stir and saute for 30 seconds
8. Add the vinegar , coconut milk , salt to taste and the sugar and stir until well mixed
9. Bring slowly to the boil before adding the deep-fried eggplant cubes
10. Stir , then simmer gently on low heat until most of the liquid has evaporated , about 10 minutes
11. Taste and season with a little more sugar and / or salt as desired

title: bbq and cheddar foil chicken dinner
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Place a foil sheet , approximately 12x12 inches , on a work surface
3. Spoon about 1 teaspoon of the barbecue sauce in the center of the foil sheet
4. Place one chicken breast half over barbecue sauce and spread another teaspoon of sauce over chicken
5. Top with a quarter of the potato , bell pepper and onion
6. Sprinkle with a little of the salt and pepper
7. Fold foil in half to cover contents
8. Make narrow folds along edges to seal
9. Repeat with remaining ingredients to assemble three more packets
10. Place packets on a baking sheet and bake for 35 minutes
11. Open foil packets with scissors and carefully pull back edges
12. Sprinkle a quarter of the cheese over the top of each chicken breast half and return to oven , unsealed , for 2 minutes or until cheese is melted
13. With a spatula , transfer the contents of each packet onto individual serving plates , if desired

title: spicy pickled vegetables
steps:
1. Dissolve cubes in water , then add vinegar , sugar and pepper
2. Add vegetables , put in jar for at least one day

title: 1960 tomato gravy
steps:
1. Heat bacon grease
2. Add onion and fry until golden
3. Add flour , salt and pepper and cook until light brown , stirring constantly
4. Add canned tomatoes , sugar , bay leaf and celery leaves or celery salt
5. Cook for another five minutes
6. Remove bay leaf
7. Rub through a strainer or serve without straining for chunkier sauce
8. Adjust seasonings to taste

title: spicy coconut shrimp stew with tomatoes and cilantro
steps:
1. Lightly season shrimp with salt
2. Set aside
3. Heat oil in 5- to 6-quart dutch oven over medium-high heat
4. Add pepper
5. Cook , stirring , until almost tender , 4 minutes
6. Add scallion whites , 1 / 4 cup cilantro , garlic , and pepper flakes
7. Continue to cook , stirring , until fragrant , 30-60 seconds
8. Add tomatoes and coconut milk
9. Bring to a simmer
10. Reduce heat to medium
11. Simmer to blend flavors and thicken sauce slightly , about 5 minutes
12. Add shrimp , partially cover and cook , stirring often , until just cooked through , about 5 minutes more
13. Stir in lime juice and adjust seasonings , adding salt , if necessary
14. Serve shrimp stew over rice
15. Garnish with scallion greens and remaining cilantro

title: slovenian peasant soup
steps:
1. Place all of the above in 2 quarts of water
2. Cook slowly for 1 1 / 2 hours , than mash thru a coarse strainer and add sour cream , serve
3. Sprinkle chopped chives on top for garnish

title: here s my heart cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter , gradually add sugar , at med speed
2. Add flour and vanilla
3. Mix well
4. Shape into ball , wrap in wax paper
5. Chill 2 hours
6. Roll dough to 1 / 4 inch thick on floured surface
7. Cut with 2 inch heart shaped cookie cutter
8. Bake at 300 for 25 minutes or until just turning brown at the edges
9. Cool on rack
10. Melt chocolate on low heat
11. Dip half of each cookie in chocolate
12. Sprinkle with nuts

title: lemon sprouts
steps:
1. Cook sprouts , either steamed , boiled or microwaved , until just tender
2. Mix altogether the lemon juice , rind , garlic and melted butter
3. Pour over sprouts and stir to coat
4. Serve and enjoy

title: tangy peas and cauliflower
steps:
1. Place cauliflower in a saucepan with a small amount of water
2. Bring to a boil
3. Cook 6-8 minutes
4. Add peas , cook 2-4 minutes longer , until vegetables are crisp-tender
5. Drain
6. Combine remaining ingredients
7. Pour over vegetables and toss to coat

title: low fat black and white cookies
steps:
1. Cookie: preheat oven to 375f
2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper
3. Set applesauce in a fine sieve to drain while you prepare the other ingredients
4. In a medium bowl , whisk together flour , baking powder and salt
5. In a large bowl , cream together butter and sugar until smooth , 1-2 minutes
6. Beat in applesauce , vanilla and lemon juice
7. Add in egg whites and beat until well combined
8. Stir in flour mixture until batter is smooth
9. Drop batter two tablespoonfuls at a time onto the prepared baking sheet
10. Smooth slightly to form nice , round circles
11. Bake for 10 minutes , until set but not browned
12. Allow to cool for a few minutes on the baking sheet , then remove to a wire rack to cool completely
13. Icing: when cookies are cool , prepare the icing
14. Sift 3 / 4 cup confectioners sugar into two small bowls
15. Add 1 tbsp milk and the almond and vanilla extracts to one bowl and stir until smooth
16. Add cocoa and 2 tbsp milk to the other bowl and stir until smooth
17. Using a small knife and working over the bowls to catch drips , spread each icing over half of each cookie
18. Set on a rack until icing is set , then store cookies in an airtight container

title: vegan greek quinoa salad
steps:
1. Bring 3 cups water to a boil and add quinoa
2. Cover and reduce heat to medium / high
3. Let simmer about 20 minutes or until all water is absorbed
4. Once quinoa is done , put in a bowl and refrigerate until completely cool
5. While quinoa is cooking , prepare fresh ingredients
6. Chop tofu into inch cubes , and then gently crumble slightly into bowl
7. To tofu add 1 / 3 cup vinegar , half to juiced lemon , half of lemon zest , and 1 clove of grated garlic
8. Let marinate
9. Chop basil , parsley , cilantro , scallions and red onion
10. Coarsely chop spinach and add veggies into large bowl
11. Cut kalamata olives into quarter rings , add to bowl
12. In a bowl , whisk together reserved vinegar , lemon juice , lemon zest , grated garlic , and tahini , set aside
13. Add marinated tofu with marinade into bowl with veggies
14. When quinoa is cooled , add to veggie mixture , pour in dressing , and mix thoroughly
15. Mix in pine nuts
16. Eat immediately or refrigerate a few hours for best results

title: crock pot black beans and rice soup
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except rice in crockpot
2. Cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours
3. Add cooked rice before serving

title: spinach  n onions
steps:
1. Heat oil in a skillet
2. When it is hot but not smoking add onions
3. Saute , stirring constantly , until the onion is carmelized , about 15 min let some of the onion get quite dark and crisp
4. Add spinach , but only for a minute or two , stir until just wilted
5. Add lemon juice and salt& pepper
6. Serve

title: mean chef s grilled salmon with red currant glaze
steps:
1. Preheat an outdoor grill and oil the grill grate
2. Melt cup jelly in a small saucepan over low heat
3. Season salmon with salt and pepper and brush both sides with melted jelly
4. Grill until fish is opaque in the thickest part , about 8 minutes
5. Turn the pieces halfway through cooking time
6. While salmon is cooking , melt remaining cup jelly over low heat
7. Add lemon juice , vinegar and mustard
8. Whisk in the olive oil and season with salt and pepper
9. Keep warm
10. Set the grilled salmon on individual plates , spoon the sauce partly over and around the fish , and garnish with fruit if using
11. Place a heavy , oven-proof 12-inch skillet on medium heat 5 minutes
12. Pour about 2 teaspoons olive oil into pan
13. Put salmon into the pan and brown
14. Turn and pour melted jelly over salmon
15. Season with salt and pepper
16. Place skillet in oven and bake a total of 12 minutes per inch of thickness
17. Or brown the salmon in 2 batches , transfer to a baking dish and bake

title: spiced rum raisin ice cream
steps:
1. Combine raisins , ginger and rum in small bowl
2. Cover and stand 1 hour
3. Strain rum
4. Dissolve sugar into rum raisin mixture
5. Place all ingredients in a large bowl and mix thoroughly
6. Pour into an ice cream maker and follow manufacturers instructions

title: broccoli pesto
steps:
1. Place broccoli in container of blender
2. Add basil , garlic , pine nuts , salt , pepper , and oil
3. Process until smooth
4. Transfer to a bowl and stir in cheese
5. To serve , toss into warm buttered pasta
6. Can be refrigerated in a tightly covered jar for a week
7. May be frozen , but then it is best not to stir in cheese until after defrosting

title: sweet baked pumpkin
steps:
1. Mix apples , raisins , walnuts , brown sugar and pumpkin pie spice together in a bowl
2. Stuff the hollowed out pumpkin with the apple mixture and place in a shallow baking dish
3. Bake at 325 degrees for 1 1 / 2 hours or until the apples and pumpkin are soft
4. Serve hot from the pumpkin over ice cream

title: carnation caramel latte
steps:
1. Place ingredients in blender
2. Process until smooth and butterscotch chips are melted

title: maple oat w glaze muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease or line 8 muffin cups / tins
3. Combine the margarine sugar and salt
4. Add the dry ingredients
5. Blend with a pastry cutter until crumbly
6. Mix in the rolled oats
7. Blend milk and the maple syrup together
8. Pour over dry mixture and stir just until combined
9. Bake 20 minutes or until cooked
10. When lightly cooled , glaze the muffins with prepared glaze

title: ginger drop cookies
steps:
1. In a large bowl of an electric mixer , cream butter , sugar and molasses
2. Beat in eggs one at a time
3. Beat in remaining ingredients but don't over mix
4. Refrigerate dough , covered , for one hour
5. Preheat oven to 400-degrees f
6. Line baking sheets with parchment paper or wax paper
7. Form dough into 1 1 / 2 inch balls
8. Arrange balls on prepared cookie sheets , spacing one inch apart
9. Flatten cookies with a floured fork
10. Bake for 8-10 minutes or until done and firm to touch
11. Let cool on cooling rack before serving

title: incredible  pimento cheese
steps:
1. Process half of all ingredients in a food processor until cheese mixture is blended
2. Remove processed cheese mixture to a large bowl
3. Repeat procedure with remaining half of all ingredients
4. Serve with assorted crackers , or use as a sandwich spread

title: hale koa macadamia nut muffins
steps:
1. Cream sugar and butter
2. Mix in eggs , one at a time , cake flour , baking powder , salt and finely chopped macadamia nuts
3. Mix in water last
4. Pour batter into muffin pan and sprinkle with coarsely chopped nuts
5. Bake about 25 minutes at 350

title: red plum sauce
steps:
1. Halve and stone plums and crush the garlic and put into a pan with the remaining ingredients
2. Cover and simmer for 50 minutes , or until the fruit is very soft and has really flavoured the vinegar
3. Sieve the sauce and pour into hot sterilized bottles and seal
4. N
5. B
6. Make sure bottles are well sterilized before filling and when cold a vacumn seal has formed

title: rosy berry soup
steps:
1. Combine first 4 ingredients in a deep , ceramic , heatproof casserole or stainless steel saucepan
2. Bring mixture to a boil
3. Reduce heat , and simmer 15 minutes
4. Press raspberry mixture through a sieve , and return to casserole or saucepan
5. Discard seeds
6. Combine cornstarch and 1 / 4 cup raspberry liquid
7. Stir well
8. Bring remaining liquid to a boil
9. Reduce heat to low , and stir in cornstarch mixture
10. Cook , stirring constantly , until slightly thickened
11. Chill 6 to 8 hours
12. Drizzle whipping cream in soup , and swirl in with a knife
13. Garnish with fresh berries , mint or lemon balm and maybe even a thin curl of citrus zest

title: spicy black bean  meat balls
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 350 degrees
2. In a mixing bowl , combine red onion , jalapeno , bread crumbs , salt , chili powder , and pepper
3. Set aside
4. Drain black beans and rinse thoroughly in a colander
5. In a food processor , combine black beans and egg until completely pureed
6. Add this mixture to the remaining ingredients
7. Combine all ingredients together
8. The mixture should not be sticky and should be easily formed into balls
9. Form mixture into 1 1 / 2 inch balls , making 12
10. Place them on a nonstick cookie sheet and place in the preheated oven
