11. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until lightly browned and firm
12. Enjoy !

title: deep fried shrimp cakes  taud man goong
steps:
1. Chop shrimp and lard together until fine
2. Add salt , sugar& bread crumbs and shape into small patties
3. Deep fry until golden brown& fragrant
4. For the accompaniment: bring vinegar and 1 / 2 cup sugar to a boil- then cool
5. Add all vegetables , chilis& shallots- set aside
6. Serve with fried patties

title: w w    cheese cornbread
steps:
1. In a bowl , mix cornmeal , flour and all dry ingredients
2. '
3. Next mix in dry ingred
4. Cheese , corn , and jalepeno
5. Mix buttermilk and egg in separate bowl to mix well
6. Add to dry ingredients and mix just until moistened
7. Bake in muffin tin sprayed with pam at 425 degrees for 20-25 minute

title: chicken bonnie prince charlie  chicken with drambuie sauce
steps:
1. Flour and season the chicken breasts and saute in hot butter in both sides
2. When they are well browned , sprinkle with drambuie , add the chicken stock , cover and simmer for ten minutes: remove to platter and keep warm
3. While the chicken is cooking , peel and core the apples
4. Cut them into thick slices and cook gently until tender in butter- avoid mashing
5. Make the sauce by adding a little more drambuie to the stock left in the pan and gently stir in the cream
6. Heat just until hot
7. Add the roasted flaked almonds
8. Cover the chicken with sauce and garnish with the sliced apple

title: rosti with sausage and onion
steps:
1. Grate potatoes
2. Brown sausage in a non-stick skillet until no pink is left , drain grease from sausage
3. Add grated potatoes to sausage in hot skillet
4. Cook and turn regularly on medium to high heat for 30 to 45 minutes
5. Salt liberally , add pepper if desired
6. Dice one or two onions
7. Add to mixture
8. Continue to turn and brown for 15 minutes , flattening into the skillet
9. Traditional swiss rosti is served as a big flat brown cake on a round plate
10. To serve , invert a plate on top of potatoes in skillet , then turn the skillet upside down
11. Wala !

title: artichoke and ham strata
steps:
1. Arrange muffin pieces , crust sides down , in an 8-inch square baking dish coated with cooking spray
2. Drizzle with butter
3. Arrange ham and next 4 ingredients over muffin pieces
4. Combine nutmeg and remaining ingredients in a bowl
5. Stir well with a whisk
6. Pour over muffin mixture
7. Cover
8. Chill 8 hours or overnight
9. Bake in oven preheated to 375 for 50-55 minutes , or until set
10. Let it rest for 10 minutes and serve warm

title: chocolate dipped bananas
steps:
1. Peel and cut the bananas in half crosswise , so that you have 8 pieces
2. Place peeled bananas on sticks
3. Line a cookie sheet with waxed paper
4. Place bananas on cookie sheet in the freezer , keeping them there as long as possible--at least 10 minutes
5. Heat chocolate bits with butter in a double boiler over low heat until the melted chocolate and the butter are incorporated
6. Dip the chilled bananas in chocolate and roll with your favorite topping
7. Chill or freeze until ready to serve
8. If frozen , allow 30 minutes to thaw before serving

title: cottage broccoli casserole
steps:
1. Mix all together in bowl and place in baking dish
2. Bake at 375 for 1 - 1 1 / 2 hours , making sure that middle is set

title: sa kahlua
steps:
1. Simmer the water , sugar and coffee for at least 2 hours
2. Stir occasionaly
3. It will be a runny syrup
4. Allow to cool
5. Add 2 cups vodka
6. Add vanilla
7. It is good now but will be better in about 2 weeks

title: norwegian potato soup
steps:
1. Add all vegetables to meat stock
2. Season to taste and simmer for one hour
3. Combine beef , egg , milk and seasonings
4. Form into very small meatballs
5. Drop meatballs into boiling soup and cook 10 to 15 minutes

title: low carb almond bread machine bread
steps:
1. Place room temperature water and wet ingredients into bread machine
2. Add flour and dry ingredients on top (if you are doing a delayed start , place yeast on top of the flour
3. Use 2 tbs sugar , alternatively , 2 tbs of splenda
4. Bake bread using white cycle , 1
5. 5 lb loaf , medium crust

title: doubly chocolate cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven 350
2. In large mixing bowl beat butter , sugar , eggs and vanilla until light and fluffy
3. Stir together flour , cocoa , bakiung soda , and salt
4. Add to butter mixture
5. Stir in chocolate chips , and if desired , nuts
6. Drop bu rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets
7. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or jsut until set
8. Cool slightly
9. Remove from cookie sheet to wire rack
10. Cool completely
11. Makes about 4 1 / 2 dozen cookies

title: rich thick meat sauce for a crowd
steps:
1. Heat a dry , large , heavy bottom pot add ground beef to brown mixing to separate cooking for 3 minutes
2. Add onion , celery , peppers , carrots , and jalapeno cook for 5 minutes
3. Add garlic , mushrooms , herbs and spices cook for 5 minutes
4. Add the sauce and paste bring to a boil then reduce heat and let simmer for 1 hour or till thickness desired
5. Before serving add some fresh herbs to bring freshness to the home made delish sauce

title: blueberry streusel muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Toss rinsed blueberries in 2 tablespoons flour until they are coated
3. Gently mix all ingredients for muffins
4. Separately , mix streusel ingredients until crumbly
5. Grease a 12 cup muffin tin and fill with muffins batter
6. Top muffin batter with streusel
7. Bake for 25-30 minutes
8. Cool 10 minutes before removing from pan

title: corn  cheese and chili soup
steps:
1. Melt butter in large saucepan over medium heat
2. Add onion and saute until soft , about 5 minutes
3. Stir in garlic and saute 1 minute
4. Add flour and stir for 2 minutes
5. Add corn , chiles , tomatoes and broth
6. Bring to a boil , reduce heat to low and simmer 15 minutes , stirring occasionally
7. Slowly stir cheese into soup and heat , stirring frequently until cheese melts , about 5 minutes
8. Do not bring to a boil
9. Add salt and cayenne pepper to taste and serve

title: muhammara
steps:
1. Using a deep skillet , saut the onions gently in the oil until soft and golden
2. Add the walnuts , the breadcrumb pure , the pepper , cumin and salt to taste
3. Continue to saut gently on a low heat until the ingredients are well blended- about 12 minutes
4. Remove from the heat , place in a bowl and garnish with pine nuts

title: no bake sugar free jell o cheesecake
steps:
1. Dissolve jell-o in boiling water and set aside until cooled
2. Mix together cream cream and splenda , until smooth
3. Add eggs , half-and-half and syrup
4. Blend well
5. Slowly stir in jell-o water mixture
6. Pour mixture into 8x8 pan , cover with plastic , then place in refrigerator at least 4 hours or overnight

title: crispy black bean tacos with feta   cabbage slaw
steps:
1. Place beans and cumin in small bowl
2. Partially mash
3. Mix 2 teaspoons olive oil and lime juice in medium bowl
4. Add coleslaw , green onions , and cilantro and toss to coat
5. Season slaw to taste with salt and pepper
6. Heat 3 teaspoons olive oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
7. Add tortillas in single layer
8. Spoon 1 / 4 of bean mixture onto half of each tortilla
9. Cook 1 minute
10. Fold tacos in half
11. Cook until golden brown , about 1 minute per side
12. Fill tacos with feta and slaw
13. Pass hot sauce alongside

title: firefighter s honey muesli
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients and eat immediately
2. Optional: mix several servings of dry ingredients , cover and use within 1-2 weeks
3. When ready to eat , add honey and milk to amt of serving of dry ingredients then serve

title: vegetable chips
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Run a vegetable peeler along the length of the sweet potato to create ribbons
3. Cut the beetroot into paper thin slices with a vegetable peeler , or knife
4. Cut the potato into thin slices using a mandolin slicer
5. Heat oil until cube of bread browns in 10 seconds
6. Cook the vegetables in batches for about 30 seconds , or until crispy
7. Drain on paper towels , and season with salt
8. Place the chips on a baking tray , and keep warm in the oven , while cooking the remaining vegetables

title: mom s marshmallow brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease / flour an 8 x 8" square baking pan
3. In a saucepan melt the chocolate morsels , baking chocolate and butter
4. When melted add the vanilla
5. Beat the eggs'til light and foamy
6. Mix in the sugar and beat'til thick and lemony color
7. Add melted chocolate mixture to eggs and beat'til blended
8. Mix in the flour and blend thoroughly
9. Stir in the marshmallows , and if you're using the pecans stir them in too
10. Spread the batter in the prepared pan
11. Bake 30 minutes
12. Makes 16 2" brownies or 20 smaller ones

title: backcountry apple dump cake
steps:
1. For conventional oven:
2. Spray bottom of a 9x13 inch pan with cooking spray and pour in the apple pie filling
3. Pour in the spice cake mix ontop
4. Cut up butter or margarine and place in dollops ontop of the cake mix
5. Pour 1 / 2 cup of water slowly overtop
6. Bake at 350 degrees about 20 minutesimportant after the first five minutes or so take the pan out and stir the mixture so that the water gets evenly distributed throughout the cake , otherwise the top will burn
7. For dutch oven:
8. Spray the bottom of a 10 or 12 inch dutch oven with cooking spray and pour in the apple pie filling
9. Pour the spice cake mix overtop
10. Cut up the butter or margarine and put dollops ontop
11. Slowly pour 1 / 2 cup of water overtop
12. Place in the coals of a small / medium fire and shovel coals ontop of the oven for even baking
13. After about 5 minutes of baking , remove oven from fire and stir well the contents
14. Rotate the dutch oven approximately every 5 to 10 minutes to prevent one side from burning
15. Depending on heat it takes 25-45 minutes to cook
16. Pull the dutch oven out of the fire when the center of the cake is springy but not hard , as the cake will continue baking until it is served

title: tuxedo cake
steps:
1. To make the cake: for a three-layer cake , place one baking rack one-third from the bottom of the oven and the second two-thirds from the bottom
2. Preheat the oven to 350
3. Line the bottom of three 9-inch or two 10-inch pans with parchment paper rounds , grease with butter , and dust with flour
4. Combine the butter , water and canola oil in a medium saucepan set over medium heat
5. In a large bowl , stir together the sugar , cocoa and flour
6. Pour the butter mixture into the sugar mixture and whisk until smooth
7. Whisk in the eggs , one at a time , then whisk in the buttermilk
8. Whisk in the baking soda , salt and vanilla all at once
9. Transfer the batter to the prepared pans
10. For a three-layer cake , stagger the cake layers on the oven racks so that no layer is directly over another
11. Set two layers on one rack and the third on the other
12. For a 2-layer cake , stagger the layers on the middle rack with one placed more toward the front of the oven and one toward the back
13. Bake for 35-40 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted in the middle comes out clean
14. Monitor the layers carefully for doneness
15. Each one may be done at different times
16. Remove the cakes from the oven and cool on racks for about 15 minutes before inverting onto baking racks
17. Cool the cakes completely , at least two hours , before frosting
18. To make frosting: using a mixer fitted with a whisk attachment , whip the cream in a large bowl on high speed until soft peaks form
19. Add the powdered sugar and whip until thoroughly combined
20. Place one cake layer on a plate and spread some of the frosting over the top
21. Top with the remaining layers , thickly coating the top and sides of each with frosting
22. Refrigerate the cake until the whipped cream frosting has stabilized , at least one hour
23. To make the glaze: place the chocolate in a medium bowl
24. Heat the cream in a small saucepan over medium heat until it is very hot and just beginning to steam
25. Pour the hot cream over the chocolate and stir until it has melted completely
26. Stir in the syrup and the vanilla
27. Pour the glaze into a medium pitcher or measuring cup and let cool for ten minutes
28. Do not let the glaze sit longer because it will stiffen and become difficult to pour over the cake
29. Slowly pour the glaze over the cake , ensuring that it covers the top of the cake entirely , but make sure some of the cream frosting shows through the drizzles on the sides
30. Refrigerate the cake until the glaze is set and the whipped cream frosting is firm , at least one hour
31. Slice the cake with a long serrated knife , dipping it in a tall glass of hot water between each slice
32. The refrigerated cake will keep for about 2 days
33. Please
34. Other time is spent on the frostings etc and there are lots of periods where the cake is resting or cooling

title: baked five spice lamb cutlets
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius for conventional oven , or 160 degrees celsius for convection or fan-forced ovens
2. Line a baking tray with baking paper
3. Combine breadcrumbs , sesame seeds , five spice and chives in a large , shallow bowl
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Whisk egg in a bowl
6. Dip lamb in egg , then breadcrumb mixture
7. Place on prepared tray
8. Spray cutlets lightly with oil
9. Bake for 30 minutes or until browned and cooked through , turning halfway during cooking

title: vegan coffee buttercream frosting
steps:
1. For the coffee: i just use a bit of instant and brew it about double or triple strength
2. For best results , pre-measure the ingredients
3. You can pour the vanilla in with the coffee
4. Place the vegan butter sub in a med-large mixing bowl
5. Set hand mixer on low speed and beat till 'fluffy'
6. Gradually add the powdered sugar , stopping the mixer to scrape down the sides of the bowl as needed
7. You can also begin to add dribbles of coffee as needed to moisten
8. Continue until it has reached your desired consistency
9. Should be light and fluffy
10. Frost your cupcakes / cake / biscuits and enjoy !

title: moroccan chicken with couscous
steps:
1. Slice chicken into thin strips about an inch long and 1 / 2-inch wide
2. Combine ginger , cumin , turmeric , salt and pepper
3. Sprinkle over chicken pieces and set aside
4. Heat olive oil in a large skillet
5. Add chicken and garlic and saute for 5 minutes , until chicken is light brown on all sides
6. Add the chicken broth and broccoli
7. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat to low , cover and simmer 10 minutes , or until chicken is cooked through
8. Stir in couscous , cover , remove from heat and let stand 5-7 minutes , until liquid is absorbed
9. Serve sprinkled with parsley

title: vasilopita  new year bread
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast in 1 / 4 cup of the milk
2. Add remainder of milk , eggs , orange rind and sugar
3. Sift 3 cups flour , salt and spices into a warm bowl and make a wellin the centre
4. Pour in yeast mixture and stir to blend in flour , gradually adding warm melted butter
5. Mix dough with hands until it comes away from sides
6. Turn on to a floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic , adding remaining flour as required
7. Knead for 10 minutes
8. Place ball of dough in a clean bowl brushed with melted butter
9. Turn dough over to coat top with butter and cover bowl with a cloth or plastic wrap
10. Leave to prove in a warm place until doubled in bulk
11. Punch down and turn on to lightly floured surface
12. Knead lightly and shape into a round loaf
13. Place on a large greased baking sheet or in a greased 10 inch deep cake tin
14. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled about 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours
15. Glaze with well-beaten egg and arrange blanched almonds in numbers to de
16. Bake in a moderately hot oven for 45 minutes until golden brown and cooked when tested
17. If bread browns too quickly place a piece of greased brown paper on top
18. Cool on a wire rack

title: sourdough starter mix
steps:
1. Pour the water into crock or a wide mouth gallon jar
2. Pour in the yeast and let it dissolve
3. Add vinegar and flour , mix well
4. Cover with cloth and set in warm place to sour
5. When activity stops , the mixture flattens out
6. An amber colored liquor comes to top
7. And it smells-- that's it
8. Mix it up
9. It will look like whipping cream
10. Put it in a glass jar with screw type lid , place in refrigerator
11. It will keep for months growing better as it continues to age at a very slow pace
12. It's super in pancakes , waffles , coffee cake , rolled biscuits , quick drop biscuits , cinnamon rolls , cobblers , bread , cake , etc

title: blue cheese columbine dip
steps:
1. Set blue cheese aside
2. Combine remaining ingredients in a bowl
3. Add blue cheese
4. Cover and let stand at room temperature 2 hours
5. Serve on crackers

title: hazelnut waffles
steps:
1. Melt butter with honey in a small saucepan over low heat
2. Whisk flour , baking powder , salt , and baking soda in large bowl to blend
3. Whisk eggs , milk , and sour cream in another large bowl until well blended
4. Gradually whisk dry ingredients into wet ingredients until batter is smooth
5. Whisk honey-butter mixture into batter and sprinkle with hazelnuts
6. Preheat oven to 250f heat waffle iron and spray with pam
7. Pour 1 cup batter over 8 inch square of wallfe iron
8. Spreat batter evenly over grid and close
9. Cook until golden brown on both sides
10. Keep cooked waffles on a oven safe plate in the oven
11. Repeat until all waffles are cooked
12. Serve with confectioners sugar and maple syrup

title: chicken 1 2 3
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Wash chicken and pat dry
3. Place in baking pan and top with cheese slices
4. Pour marinara sauce over chicken
5. Cover pan with foil
6. Bake 30 minutes
7. Remove foil and bake an additional 10 minutes
8. Spoon pan juices over chicken and serve

title: raspberry crescent squares
steps:
1. Unroll 1 tube of crescent dough
2. Press into the bottom of a greased 9 x 13 in baking pan sealing seams and perforations
3. In a bowl , combine curd , cream cheese , and egg yolks
4. Beat until smooth
5. Spread cream cheese mixture over crescent dough
6. Drop preserves over cream cheese mixture and swirl with a spatula
7. Unroll remaining crescent dough , flatten dough , sealing seams and perforations
8. Lay flat on top of cream cheese mixture
9. Beat egg white until foamy and brush over dough
10. Bake at 350 for 25-35 minutes or until dough is golden brown
11. Cool on a wire rack
12. Combine confectioners' sugar and water
13. Drizzle over crust
14. Chill well before cutting

title: 7 up pancakes
steps:
1. Beat egg and oil
2. Add pancake mix
3. Add 1 cup 7-up
4. Stir until most lumps have disappeared
5. Gently stir in additional 7-up
6. Bake on medium heat griddle , turning once

title: devils food cake 1948 version
steps:
1. Mix water , cocoa and baking soda , let stand while preparing the rest of the ingredients
2. Cream butter and sugar , beat in eggs , add half the flour and half the milk beat well
3. Add the cocoa mixture and remaining flour and milk and vanilla
4. Bake in two greased and floured cake pans , at 350f for 30 minutes or until cake tests done
5. Frost with icing:2 cups powdered sugar , 1 tsp vanilla , 1 / 2 to 3 / 4 cup milnot
6. Beat milnot canned milk into powdered sugar a little at a time until spreadable
7. Add vanilla

title: tofu omelet indonesia
steps:
1. Drop the bean sprouts in boiling water and boil for 30 seconds
2. Drain and refresh with cold water
3. Mash the tofu or chop very small
4. Combine tofu , eggs and salt in a bowl
5. Heat the oil in a 10-inch nonstick skillet or cast iron skillet
6. Add half of the egg mixture , tilting the pan to make a thin layer
7. Cook over medium heat until set
8. Turn the omelet over
9. Remove from the pan
10. Make another omelet the same way
11. Top each with sprouts and chiles
12. Combine the soy sauce and vineger
13. Drizzle over the omelets
14. Garnish with peanuts , shallot flakes and parsley leaves

title: spinach artichoke potato cakes with shrimp scampi
steps:
1. In a skillet over medium heat , brown bacon along with onion and 1 tablespoon of minced garlic
2. About 5-6 minutes
3. Remove bacon and onion mixture to a plate and reserve bacon fat in skillet for potato cakes
4. In a large bowl combine the following ingredients: artichoke hearts , spinach , 1 / 4 cup minus 2 tablespoons of the fresh basil , red bell pepper , bacon and yellow onion mixture , goat cheese , beaten eggs , flour and mashed potatoes
5. Fold generously to incorporate well
6. Using the skillet from the bacon , over medium low heat
7. Spoon generous amounts , about 1 / 2 cup of the potato mixture
8. Flatten out gently with the back of a spatula
9. Allow cakes to brown on each side , approximately 2 minutes each side , flipping the cakes once
10. Repeat this process , recipe yields about 8 yummy potato cakes
11. Season with a sprinkling of salt and pepper
12. In a small bowl , combine diced tomato with the remaining fresh basil
13. Season with salt and pepper , and set aside for garnish
14. In a medium skillet over medium low heat , melt butter with remaining minced garlic
15. Add in raw shrimp , and sautee turning shrimp frequently , until fully cooked
16. About 6-8 minutes
17. To serve , plate 2 potato cakes and about 1 / 4 of the shrimp scampi
18. Garnish with fresh diced tomatoes and serve

title: crock pot roast  oamc
steps:
1. For oamc place all ingredients in the oven bag and into a plastic freezing bag , and freeze
2. When ready to cook , take straight from the freezer - no need to thaw - add salt and pepper and place in prewarmed crock pot in oven roasting bag only
3. Make sure top of oven bag is next to crock pot lid
4. Cook on high for 4 hours , and reduce to low for another 3 -4 hours
5. Remove carefully from crock pot and place into a container that will hold juices of meat
6. Split bag , remove roast , drain juices into a saucepan , and thicken with a little cornflour to suit
7. If cooking a thawed roast , reduce cooking time by 2 hours
8. Please use your own judgement for cooking times , as every one's crock pot is different

title: my mexican chicken
steps:
1. Boil chicken in salt , pepper and tony's until done
2. When chicken is done drain and cut into bite size pieces when cool
3. In a large bowl , mix well the cut up chicken , taco seasoning , corn , mushroom soup and milk
4. Pour into a greased 9 x 13 baking dish
5. Top with chips that have been crushed
6. Cover and bake at 350 for about 30 minutes
7. Uncover and sprinkle with cheese and bake until cheese melts

title: betty crocker 1950s savory lima beans
steps:
1. Cook beans as directed on the package with mustard , sugar and salt [or steam with mustard , sugar and salt sprinkled over the beans
2. Drain
3. Mix in butter and lemon juice
4. Serve immediately , garnished with a half-slice of lemon

title: roasted carrots and parsnips
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Place parsnips , carrots , onions , oil and thyme in prepared baking dish , toss until veggies are well coated with oil
3. Roast in oven for 30 minutes
4. Meanwhile , in a small bowl , combine maple syrup and mustard
5. Pour over veggies , toss to coat
6. Roast for another 20 to 25 minutes or until veggies are tender and golden , stirring once

title: oyster dressing to die for
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f to make cornbread , combine first 5 ingredients and pour into a greased shallow baking dish
2. Bake for 20-25 minutes
3. Remove from oven and cool
4. To make dressing , crumble dried white bread slices , cornbread , and crackers
5. Mix together and set aside
6. Saut chopped celery and onion in butter until transparent , approximately 5-10 minutes
7. Pour over corn bread mixture
8. Add stock , mix well and add salt , pepper , sage , and poultry seasoning
9. Add beaten eggs and mix well
10. Add oysters and mix
11. Pour into a greased pan
12. Bake for about 45 minutes

title: chinese style orange almond chicken
steps:
1. Place the almonds in a large non-stick pan and , shaking the pan often , toast over a medium heat for 5 minutes or until fragrant
2. Set aside
3. Warm the oil in the same pan over a medium-high heat , add the chicken and , turning occasionally , cook for 5 minutes or until it is cooked through
4. Set aside , and keep warm by covering loosely with foil
5. Add the shallots to the pan and cook for 5 minutes or until they have softened
6. Add the mushrooms to the pan and cook for 5 minutes or until they have softened
7. Stir in the marmalade , soy sauce and freshly ground black pepper , and return the chicken to the pan
8. Reduce the heat to low , cover and simmer for 10 minutes or until the juices run clear
9. Serve over a bed of steamed rice , topped with the almonds and orange slices

title: balsamic tomato sauce
steps:
1. Heat oil in heavy large saucepan over medium-high heat
2. Add onion and garlic and saute until soft
3. Stir in tomatoes , balsamic vinegar , wine , and basil
4. Simmer 15 minutes

title: coconut poppy seed cake
steps:
1. Prepare cake according to package directions , adding poppy seeds and coconut extract if desired to batter
2. Pour into a greased 9x13 inch baking pan
3. Bake at 350 degrees for 20-25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
4. Cool completely
5. In a mixing bowl , beat milk and pudding mix on low speed for 2 minutes
6. Spread over the cake
7. Spread with coolwhip
8. Sprinkle with coconut if desired

title: chocolate caramel mocha cheesecake
steps:
1. Chocolate cookie crust in a small bowl stir together crushed cookies and melted butter or margarine till well combined
2. Press mixture evenly onto the bottom of a greased 9" springform pan
3. Caramel mocha filling in a large bowl combine cream cheese , brown sugar and cornstarch
4. Beat with an electric mixer till smooth
5. Add eggs and egg yolk , one at a time , beating well after each addition
6. Now stir in sour cream and vanilla to the cream cheese mixture and set aside
7. Stir together instant coffee and hot water , set aside
8. Place 3 / 4 cup of the cream cheese mixture in a small bowl
9. Add dissolved coffee
10. Stir in sugar
11. Stir melted chocolate chips and corn syrup into remaining cheese mixture
12. Pour half of the chocolate mixture over the crust
13. Spoon 1 / 2 cup of the coffee mixture over the chocolate mixture
14. Pour the remaining chocolate mixture over the coffee mixture
15. Spoon on the remaining coffee mixture , without distrubing the crust , swirl the blade of a knife thru the filling to create a marbling effect
16. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minute
17. Lower the temperature to 225 degrees and bake for 1 hour and 15 minute
18. , or until the center no longer looks wet or shiny
19. Remove the cake from the oven and run a knife around the inside edge of the pan , to loosen
20. Turn the oven off and return the cake to the oven for an additional 30 minute
21. Chill , uncovered , overnight in fridge
22. Mocha sour cream topping in small bowl stir together hot water and coffee crystals
23. Stir in brown sugar
24. Add melted chocolate chips and sour cream
25. Stir until well combined
26. Spread the warm sour cream mixture over the cheese cake
27. Leave cake in springform pan until ready to serve
28. Chill till serving

title: mom s apple stack cake
steps:
1. Mix together cookie layer ingredients and add enough flour to roll out nicely
2. Take a piece of dough about the size of your fist and pat it out in pie tins
3. It will be thin
4. Bake 2 at a time at 375 degrees about 10 minutes
5. Makes about 9 pie size cookies
6. Spread filling between each layer and on top of assembled cake
7. Sometimes you can make 2 cakes from this recipe
8. This cake improves with age after the filling has soaked into the cookie layers
9. Best if eaten a day or 2 after it is made

title: blueberry peach streusel cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease and flour 2 8x8x15 / 8 foil pans
3. In a food processor pulse ingredients for topping pulse quickly till crumbly
4. Remove and set aside
5. In food processor add batter ingredients and rest of cake mix pulsing till well combined
6. Set aside
7. Mix blueberries , peaches , and flour
8. Set aside
9. Pour batter into prepared pans topping with fruit mixture pressing in gentle
10. Then top with strusel
11. Splitting everything equaly between each pan
12. Bake for 40-45 minutes
13. Cool and keep one for yourself and bring the other to a picnic

title: currant jelly
steps:
1. Wash and pick over currants
2. Heat in a large kettle with water until thoroughly heated through
3. Mash with a potato masher and turn into a jelly bag to drip into container
4. Measure resulting juice and add one pound of sugar to every pint of juice
5. Boil about 20 minutes or until jelly reaches 220f on a candy thermometer
6. Skim , pour into hot sterilized jelly glasses and seal in a boiling water bath for ten minutes

title: wake up your tastebud pork chops
steps:
1. Mix cumin , salt , sage , garlic powder , pepper , cayenne pepper , and paprika in medium bowl
2. Heat oil and butter in skillet or electric skillet to 350f
3. Coat chops in mixture and add to skillet
4. Cook 5 minutes on each side , then check
5. If still pink , cook longer , turning chops and checking as you go

title: herbed spinach stuffed mushrooms
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Mix stuffing mix and hot water in a large bowl
3. Set aside
4. Remove stems from mushrooms
5. Chop mushroom stems and set aside
6. Melt butter in large skillet on medium heat
7. Add chopped stems , garlic and onion
8. Cook and stir until tender
9. Add stem mixture to prepared stuffing along with the spinach , cheeses , and bacon bits
10. Mix well
11. Spoon evenly into mushroom caps and place filled side up in a shallow baking pan
12. Bake 20 minutes or until mushrooms are tender and the filling is heated through

title: shanghai pork and shrimp spring rolls
steps:
1. Combine sugar , 1 / 2 teaspoon cornstarch , soy sauce , pork , and shrimp in a bowl and stir
2. Set aside
3. In a bowl , rehydrate shitake mushrooms in hot water just enough to cover until softened
4. Depending on mushrooms used this can take anywhere between 15-30 minutes to soften
5. Reserve the liquid for dissolving cornstarch
6. Cut off the stem and cut into very thin match stick pieces
7. In a small cup dissolve 1 1 / 2 t cornstarch with 3 t of reserved mushroom soaking liquid
8. This will be used to thicken the filling mixture
9. Heat 1 1 / 2 t oil in a large skillet over medium high heat and add ginger and garlic
10. Cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant but not browned and add pork and shrimp mixture
11. Stir constantly to separate the pork pieces and shrimp into nuggets and cook for about 2 minutes
12. Do not overcook
13. Transfer to a dish
14. Add the remaining 1 1 / 2 t oil to the skillet on medium high heat
15. Add shitake mushrooms , bamboo shoots , bean sprouts , salt and pepper
16. Cook 5 minutes stirring constantly
17. Return the pork and shrimp mixture to the skillet and stir to combine
18. Lower the heat and give the cornstarch mixture a stir and pour over the filling
19. Cook for about 30 seconds to bind the mixture
20. Transfer to a bowl to cool completely
21. In a small cup combine 1 t cornstarch with 1 / 2 c water to seal spring roll skin
22. Lay a spring roll skin on the work surface making sure one of the pointy corner is facing you
23. Put about 2 t of filling slightly below the center towards you and form into log shape using your fingers
24. Lift the bottom edge towards you up and over the filling tucking the point under it
25. Fold in the sides and brush the upper edges with cornstarch and water mixture
26. Roll away from you to seal
27. Set the finished rolls seam side down on the baking sheet covered with wax paper or aluminum foil and keep covered with a kitchen towel to prevent drying
28. Heat 1 inch of oil in a deep skillet over medium high to about 350f degrees
29. Slide in a few spring rolls and fry , turning as needed for about 3 minutes or until golden brown and very crisp
30. Remove from the oil and drain
31. Continue with the remaining rolls
32. To serve , cut diagonally in half
33. Serve with a vinegar or dipping sauce of your choice

title: leprechaun pie
steps:
1. Mix thoroughly the whipped topping , pudding powder and drained pineapple
2. Pile into crust , chill or freeze and enjoy !

title: cheesy volcano meatball sandwiches
steps:
1. In large bowl , mix meat , cracker crumbs , parmesan cheese and 1 / 4 cup of the spaghetti sauce in medium bowl
2. Shape into twelve meatballs , using about 2 tablespoons meat mixture for each
3. Place , 2 inches apart , in shallow baking pan sprayed with cooking spray
4. Press 1 cheese cube deeply into center of each meatball
5. Bake in preheated 400 degree oven for 15 minute or until meatballs are cooked through
6. While meatballs are baking , microwave remaining 1 / 2 cup spaghetti sauce in small microwaveable bowl on high 30 sec
7. Or until heated through
8. Spoon sauce evenly into buns
9. Fill each with three meatballs

title: canadian kebabs  eh    zwt ii
steps:
1. In a lrg resealable bag , combine vinegar , garlic , syrup , onions , whiskey , cloves , salt & pepper
2. Set aside 4 tbsp of marinade for basting
3. Trim fat from steak
4. Cut into 1" cubes & add to the bag
5. Seal tightly & refrigerate for 30 min or overnight
6. Discard marinade used on steak
7. Thread steak & orange chunks onto metal or soaked wooden skewers
8. Place skewers on a greased grill over med-high heat
9. Close lid & cook 4-5 min per side or till browned but still pink inside

title: black currant milk
steps:
1. Add the syrup to the milk
2. Serve in tall glasses right away !

title: chicken apple sausage  sweet corn and rice salad
steps:
1. Start long grain rice
2. Make mustard vinaigrette
3. In a glass bowl , add mustard and red wine vinegar , slowly add olive oil as you whisk
4. Add s & p
5. Set aside
6. In a skillet , fry sausage over med
7. Heat , crumble as it cooks
8. Add the corn and cook for 3 minutes stirring occasionally
9. Place cooked rice in a large bowl , add the hot sausage mixture and the cheese
10. Toss lightly
11. Add the spinach and toss
12. When ready to serve , place on plate , top with pine nuts and mustard vinaigrette
13. Enjoy

title: rice flour cake
steps:
1. Coat an 8-inch square or round cake pan with olive or canola oil spray
2. Set aside
3. Preheat oven to 350 deg f
4. Cream the butter with the sugar until well blended
5. Add eggs and vanilla , beating with a wire whisk
6. Add flour and baking powder and continue to beat until well mixed
7. Pour batter into prepared pan
8. Bake the cake for 40 to 45 minutes or until done when tested with a toothpick

title: fried sweet plantains  platanos maduros fritos
steps:
1. In a large skillet , melt the butter with the olive oil over medium heat
2. Add the plantain slices and fry for about 4 minutes on each side , moving the slices with a spatula occasionally to prevent sticking
3. Remove the plantains from the skillet with a slotted spoon and let drain on paper towels
4. Transfer to a large , warm serving platter , sprinkle with lemon juice and salt and serve warm
5. Unripeplantains are green and hard , as they ripen they turn yellow and then get mottled with dark spots
6. Ripe plantains are sweet and soft and are brownish-black in color and resemble overripe bananas
7. To ripen a plantain , keep them in a warm place until they turn yellow , then brownish-black

title: honey sriracha chicken appetizer toasts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Make sauce: whisk equal parts honey and sriracha sauce
3. Make toast: brush baguette slices with olive oil , and season with salt
4. Toast in oven until golden and crisp
5. Spread mayonnaise on toasts
6. Top with shredded chicken
7. Drizzle sauce over chicken
8. Top with chopped cilantro

title: nif s cheesy garlicky smashed potatoes  bbq or oven
steps:
1. Poke holes with a fork in the potatoes and microwave until cooked through
2. Meanwhile , lay out 4 large pieces of tin foil
3. I always use the nonstick kind but you can use nonstick spray
4. Stir garlic into melted butter
5. When the potatoes are done cooking , place 1 on a piece of foil
6. With the side of a mallet or with a rolling pin , smash the potato ! not too hard , or you will redecorate your kitchen but hard enough to make it about 1" thick
7. Spoon on 1 / 4 of the garlic butter , sprinkle with seasoning salt and sprinkle with 1 / 4 cup of cheese
8. Fold foil over the potato , enough to completely wrap it up
9. Repeat steps 5 and 6 with the remaining potatoes
10. Place foil wrapped potatoes over low heat on the bbq
11. I find it hard to list a cooking time because grills cook at such different speeds
12. You might want this to end up crunchy on the bottom or just heated through
13. You decide ! just take a peek ever few minutes
14. If you have other items on the grill that you are waiting for , you can put the potatoes on the top grate
15. They also stay hot for quite some time
16. If you're cooking these in the oven , i wouldn't put them in there for any temperatures higher that 375f take a peek after 10 minutes and remove when you see how you like them done

title: marinated  grilled new york strip steaks
steps:
1. Mix all marinade ingredients together in a shallow glass baking dish
2. Pierce steaks on all sides with a fork and place in marinade
3. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours
4. Grill over high heat and cook to desired doneness

title: cheesy hamburger potato soup  crock pot
steps:
1. Put onion , potatoes , hamburger , and water into crock pot and cook on low heat for 4-5 hours , or until potatoes are tender
2. Then add in the rest of ingredients and let cook for another 2 hours , or until you are ready to eat
3. Use salt and pepper at the table for taste

title: smoked pork chops with pineapple
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a medium-sized skillet over low-medium heat , melt the 4 tablespoons of butter , add the sugar and stir until dissolved
3. Add the sweet onions , stir
4. Cook the onions until tender
5. Stirring often , don't let them brown
6. Add the pineapples with their juice and arrange in a single layer
7. Reduce heat to low and allow them to caramelize , 5-7 minutes
8. Remove from heat
9. In a large skillet add 1 1 / 2-2 cups of water and bring to a boil , place pork chops in the boiling water and cook until no longer pink , 5-6 minutes remove from the water
10. In a separate large skillet over medium-high heat , melt the 2 tablespoons of unsalted butter , add the garlic and cook for 1 minute , add the mustard and stir into the butter
11. Sprinkle both sides of each chop with pepper and salt and add to the skillet with the garlic and mustard
12. Cook on each side for 5-7 minutes
13. Don't move them while cooking
14. Remove from heat
15. Allow them to rest in skillet for 2 minutes
16. Transfer pork chops to a large ungreased glass baking dish , arrange the porkchops in a single layer
17. Put one pineapple slice on top of each chop and spoon the onions from the pan over them
18. Bake for 15-20 mins or until done enjoy !

title: spaghetti with olive oil  garlic and chillies
steps:
1. Combine the oil , garlic and chilles in a small frying pan and cook over very low heat until garlic becomes a very pale golden , about 10-15 minutes
2. If things are moving too fast , use a simmer mat or flame tamer
3. Meanwhile cook the spaghetti in plenty of salted boiling water until cooked
4. Drain the pasta , reserving a small jugful of the cooking water
5. Turn the pasta into a heated dish
6. Pour over the hot oil with garlic and chillies , add the parsley and toss thoroughly
7. Add a little of the cooking water if necessary
8. Serve immediately

title: german bavarian chopped green salad mit borretsch
steps:
1. Wash the lettuce and watercress well and spin dry
2. Prepare the dressing in a non-reactive container and set aside
3. Best prepared at least 1 hour in advance
4. Combine the salad ingredients together in a large salad bowl with the dressing
5. Toss to coat
6. Garnish with additional borage leaves and flowers
7. Fyi: a sprinkle of freshly grated black pepper tasted really good on the salad

title: baked  rice
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a greased casserole dish , add in all ingredients
3. Cover with a lid and bake for 30 minutes
4. Enjoy

title: pan fried potatoes
steps:
1. Microwave the potatoes or use leftover baked potatoes and set aside until cool enough to handle
2. Peel the potatoes and slice about 1 / 3 inch thick in rounds
3. Heat oil and butter in pan and when butter stops sizzling start cooking the onion but don't let them brown much
4. I use a 9" preheated cast iron pan for this recipe
5. Add potatoes to the pan and put a lid on it over medium low heat until the potatoes are starting to brown on the bottom , and then remove the lid and continue browning
6. Add salt and pepper on top of the potatoes
7. When the bottom of the potatoes are brown enough for you put a plate over the pan and flip the potatoes out
8. Slide the potatoes back into the pan and brown the potatoes
9. Do not replace the pan lid
10. Slide potatoes onto a platter and sprinkle with paprika
11. Cut into wedges and serve with eggs , beans , what you like

title: curtido
steps:
1. Place the cabbage in boiling water for no more than one minute
2. Discard the water
3. Put the cabbage in a large bowl and add grated carrots , sliced onion , cayenne , oregano , olive oil , salt , brown sugar , vinegar , and water
4. Let chill in refrigerator at least two hours before serving

title: ww greek inspired scrambled egg wraps
steps:
1. Spray a non-stick skillet with a little cooking spray
2. Finely dice the red onion and set aside
3. Shred / grate the zucchini and lay the flesh on a paper towel to soak up any moisture
4. Quarter the cherry tomatoes , scrape out the seeds and finely dice the flesh
5. Lay the flesh on a paper towel also to soak up any moisture
6. Finely chop the black olives and the feta cheese
7. Set both aside , separately
8. Beat the eggs with the cavenders greek seasoning
9. Saute the chopped onion in the non-stick skillet for 2 minutes over medium heat , stirring
10. Add the zucchini , tomatoes and olives and cook for a further minute
11. Add the beaten eggs and cook , still stirring , for 3-4 minutes or until done
12. On each wrap , place some of the egg mixture and top it with feta cheese
13. Fold over the wrap and enjoy !

title: south of the border steak rolls
steps:
1. Take the cuts of steak you have made and place between two sheets of plastic wrap and pound with a meat mallet to thin them out
2. Don't pound too thin , or meat will tear
3. In a large skillet , in the butter or olive oil , saut the garlic , onion , chili pepper , green pepper , mushrooms and black olives over medium- heat until vegetables soften and onions become translucent
4. Add the cubed cream cheese , and stir constantly until cheese melts and mixture comes together
5. Take off the heat and cool slightly
6. Add 1 1 / 2 cups of the shredded cheese
7. Spoon vegetable cheese mixture down the center of each cut of steak
8. Roll up jellyroll style and secure with toothpicks
9. In a skillet , saut steak rolls in a little oil or butter on all sides till brown over medium heat , about 5 minutes
10. In a medium bowl combine the tomato sauce , cinnamon , cumin , and cocoa powder
11. Pour over steak rolls in skillet
12. Cover and simmer on medium-low for 15-20 minutes until sauce thickens somewhat and meat is cooked through and tender
13. Meanwhile , cook linguini according to package directions
14. Drain , and place onto a large serving platter
15. Place steak rolls over pasta , pour sauce over rolls and pasta
16. Sprinkle with the reserved shredded cheese

title: gus s incredible chicken taco filling
steps:
1. Boil and bone the chicken , reserve two cups of the broth
2. Finely chop the chicken and set aside
3. I use a food processor to do this
4. Take all the vegetable and mince or chop in a food processor
5. Sautee the minced peppers , onion , garlic and cumin until everything is nice and tender , then add the canned tomato
6. Add salt and pepper to taste
7. Mix in the chicken , stirring well to mix evenly with the veggies
8. Add one cup of broth and simmer for about ten minutes to let the flavors mix
9. If it gets too dry , add the second cup of broth
10. Once it is heated , add the chili powder , stir in well , remove from heat and you are ready to serve in whatever way you choose
11. If you leave out the mild banana wax peppers or the chili powder , you will lose 99 percent of the flavor
12. Never overcook chili powder or it will get bitter
13. Gebhardt's is a very mild chili powder , so if you can't find it , try to substitute with the mildest you can find

title: low carb cauliflower spanish rice
steps:
1. Grate or process the head of cauliflower to the texture of rice
2. Chop the garlic , onion , peppers , zucchini and celery
3. You can do all of this in the food processor
4. Heat the oil in a large saute pan
5. Saute the vegetables together until heated through
6. Add stock and lower the heat , stirring often
7. When cauliflower starts to soften , add the tomato paste and spices and cook over low heat until the texture of cooked rice
8. Adjust seasonings to taste
9. Add more stock or broth as neecessary as the vegetables cook to maintain the rice texture
10. This can be made ahead and it freezes well
11. You may add cooked chicken or sausage or cheese to this to make a one-dish meal

title: cuba libre cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Line or grease and flour 1 12 cupcake cupcake pan
3. In a small saucepan , heat butter , coca cola and rum to boiling
4. Remove from heat and allow to cool
5. Mix together lime juice and milk in a small bowl or measuring cup and set aside
6. Meanwhile , whisk together cocoa , flour , sugar , baking soda , baking powder and salt
7. Add the cooled butter / coke mixture and beat until well combined
8. Add egg , beat then pour in the milk
9. Mix until combined
10. The batter will be rather thin
11. Fill each well 2 / 3 of the way full
12. Bake 20 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean
13. Remove cupcakes to wire racks as soon as possible to cool
14. Frost with chocolate rum cream cheese frosting when cool
15. Garnish with a wedge of lime
16. This will sour the milk a bit
17. Do not worry if it looks slightly curdled

title: strawberry surprises
steps:
1. Line a large baking sheet with wax paper
2. In a microwave safe bowl microwave chocolate chips until melted
3. Add peanut butter , whisk until smooth
4. Stir in sugar
5. Halve strawberries
6. Spread peanut butter filling on one half , stick other half back on
7. Place on baking sheet
8. Refrigerate 30 min
9. Melt white chocolate
10. Dip bottom half of strawberry in white chocolate
11. Dip in chopped nuts
12. Place back on baking sheet
13. Refrigerate until ready to serve

title: backyard taco dip
steps:
1. Ensure cream cheese is at room temperature
2. Whip in a large bowl until smooth
3. Mix in salsa
4. Add in peppers and cheddar
5. Serve with taco chips

title: bacon wrapped feta stuffed dates
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425f
2. Cut slit in long side of each date , being careful to not cut completely through date
3. Remove and discard pits
4. Cut cheese into 16 sticks
5. Stuff each date with cheese
6. Wrap 1 bacon piece around each date , completely enclosing cheese
7. Place on rack of broiler pan
8. Bake 14 to 15 minute or until bacon is crisp , turning after 8 minute cool 5 min
9. Transfer to plate
10. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: polish fire vodka  krupnik   spiced honey vodka
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , combine all ingredients except for vodka and bring to a boil
2. Cover and reduce heat to a simmer
3. Simmer for 5 minutes
4. Add the vodka , and when heated through , sreve immediately in irish coffee cups serve chilled later in juice glasses

title: baklawa  lebanese  version of baklava
steps:
1. Unwrap and carefully unfold thawed phyllo dough
2. Cover with plastic wrap or wax paper and a damp cloth to keep the dough from drying out
3. For the filling -- grind the walnuts coarsely , mix with sugar and orange blossom water until well blended
4. Butter a 12 x 16 inch baking pan
5. Render the butter
6. For the assembly -- layer one package of the phyllo sheets in the pan , buttering generously between each sheet with a pastry brush or cloth dipped in butter
7. Mix 2-3 tablespoons of water with the walnut mixture and put over the top of the last sheet , making sure to keep the layer of walnuts level
8. Repeat the same procedure with the second package of dough , buttering generously between each sheet , and butter the top
9. Cut into diamonds , dipping the knife into hot water as you go for easier cutting
10. Pour over any remaining butter
11. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until bottom is done and top is golden brown
12. If top does not brown nicely , put the baklawa under the broiler for a few seconds , watching constantly , as it will burn very quickly
13. For the syrup -- mix sugar and water together and bring to a boil
14. Boil about 15-20 minutes
15. Remove syrup from heat , add lemon juice and orange blossom water
16. Stir and let cool
17. Shortcut -- butter pan and place one whole package of phyllo dough in pan , butter top , and add nut filling
18. Place second package of phyllo dough over nuts and butter the top
19. Cut into diamonds and pour all the rendered butter into the pan , making sure it settles into all the cuts and around edges
20. Bake as directed above

title: balsamic cherry ice cream topping
steps:
1. Simmer together balsamic vinegar , apple juice , water and sugar until sugar is completely dissolved
2. Add lemon zest , cinnamon and cherries
3. Simmer on low heat until cherries are plump
4. Wonderful drizzled over real vanilla ice cream

title: chinese beef   pea pods
steps:
1. Thinly slice flank steak diagonally across the grain
2. Combine strips in crockpot with consomme , soy sauce , ginger and onions
3. Cover and cook on low for 5 to 7 hours
4. Turn control to high
5. Stir in cornstarch that has been dissolved in cold water
6. Cook on high for 10 to 15 minutes or until thickened
7. Drop in pea pods the last 5 minutes
8. Serve over hot rice

title: hawaiian chicken burgers
steps:
1. In a medium bowl combine egg , bread crumbs , water chestnuts , ginger , salt and pepper
2. Add ground chicken and mix well
3. Shape into 4 inch thick patties
4. To grill , cook for 15 to 18 minutes or until no longer pink , turning once and brushing with sweet and sour sauce during last 5 minutes of cooking
5. Meanwhile , place pineapple slices on grill rack
6. Cook for 5 minutes , turning as needed
7. To serve , sprinkle bottom half of each bun with shredded spinach
8. Top with patties
9. Brush patties with sweet and sour sauce and top with pineapple slices

title: grace s light   fluffy cupcakes
steps:
1. Instead of buttermilk , you can use milk with a teaspoon of vinegar added as part of the amount
2. Heat the oven to 325f
3. Line a 12 cup cupcake pan with 12 liners
4. Place the flour , salt , baking powder and baking soda in a medium size bowl
5. Use a whisk and mix together well
6. In another bowl , place the eggs and vanilla- whisk together well
7. Pour in the sugar while whisking and then add the butter and buttermilk- whisk well until mixed
8. Add the flour mix to the egg mix in small amounts while just mixing enough to get the flour moist with no large lumps
9. Don't over mix or it won't be as tender as you might like
10. Use a 2-inch ice cream scoop to fill the cupcake liner 2 / 3 full
11. Bake in the middle rack of the oven until the tops just start to brown
12. A toothpick should come out clean after about 18-20 minutes
13. Cool for about 5 minutes before removing cupcakes from the pan
14. Make sure that the cupcakes are completely cool before you frost or they will be crumbly !

title: artichoke guacamole
steps:
1. Place artichoke bottoms in a small saucepan , cover with water , and bring to a boil over high heat
2. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook until the artichokes are very soft , about 20 minutes
3. Drain
4. When cool enough to handle , finely chop the artichokes and place in a medium-size mixing bowl
5. Add the onion , tomato , lemon juice , olive oil , sesame oil , scallions , cilantro , salt , and pepper and gently mash with a fork
6. Enjoy !

title: steamed greens with toasted almonds
steps:
1. Heat a small non stick fry pan over medium heat
2. Add almonds and toss for 5 minutes or until lightly toasted
3. Set aside
4. Place asparagus , broccoli , zucchini and beans in a steamer and steam for 5 minutes , add snow peas for a further minute or until tender
5. Transfer to a bowl and toss gently with oil and balsamic vinegar
6. Scatter with almonds and serve immediately

title: corn and kidney bean soup
steps:
1. In a 6-quart dutch oven , heat the oil over moderate heat for 1 minute
2. Add the bell pepper , onion , and garlic and saute for 5 minutes , or until the onion is translucent
3. Add the beans , tomatoes , stock , tomato juice , and corn
4. Stir in the chili powder and cumin
5. Bring the soup to a boil over high heat
6. Reduce the heat to low and cook , uncovered , stirring occasionally , for 15 minutes
7. Ladle soup into individual soup bowls and sprinkle each with some of the cheese
8. Serve immediately with tortilla chips or warm flour tortillas , if desired

title: low carb lemon velvet chicken
steps:
1. Preheat large skillet on medium-high 2-3 minutes
2. Place flour and seasoned salt in zip-top bag
3. Add chicken
4. Shake to coat
5. Place butter in pan
6. Swirl to coat
7. Place chicken in pan
8. Cook 5-6 minutes , turning occasionally until chicken begins to brown
9. Stir in capers
10. Cut lemon in half and squeeze juice over chicken
11. Stir in alfredo sauce and reduce heat to medium-low
12. Simmer 6-8 minutes
13. Serve

title: big apple mojito
steps:
1. Crush mint leaves and lime juice in a tall glass
2. Cover with simple syrup and fill glass with ice
3. Add rum and lemon lime soda , stir well
4. Add mint to garnish

title: 20 000 prize winning chili con carne
steps:
1. In large saucepan or dutch oven , brown half the meat
2. Pour off fat
3. Remove meat
4. Brown remaining meat
5. Pour off all fat except 2 tbsps
6. Add onion , garlic
7. Cook and stir until tender
8. Add meat and remaining ingredients except flour , cornmeal and warm water
9. Mix well
10. Bring to boil
11. Reduce heat and simmer covered 2 hours
12. Stir together flour and cornmeal
13. Add warm water
14. Mix well
15. Stir into chili mixture
16. Cook covered 20 minutes longer
17. Serve hot

title: blue hawaii cocktail
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and mix well
2. If using ice , mix the ingredients in a blender
3. Serve in a tall glass
4. Garnish with a slice of pineapple and a cherry

title: apple   almond teacake
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 180 deg c
2. Grease then line a 20cm deep round cake pan with baking paper
3. Using an electric mixer cream butter and sugar in a small bowl , until pale in colour and light and fluffy
4. Beat in eggs , one at a time , until combined
5. Transfer mixture to a large bowl
6. Stir in half of the milk and half of the sifted flours
7. Then stir in the remaining milk and flour
8. Spread into prepared pan
9. Sprinkle evenly with the apple then top with the almonds
10. Bake for about 45 minutes or until a skewer inserted into the cake comes out clean
11. Stand for 5 minutes then carefully turn onto a wire rack to cool

title: potet  potato  klub
steps:
1. Mix potatoes , flour , baking powder and salt together to make a stiff dough
2. Form dough into dumplings , placing a small cube of ham in center of each dumpling
3. Add enough flour to keep from sticking
4. Drop into boiling ham broth or stock
5. Cook one to one and a half hours
6. Serve with hot butter and ham

title: ina garten s rack of lamb
steps:
1. In bowl of a food processor fitted with a steel blade , process the salt , rosemary , thyme and garlic until they're as finely minced as possible
2. Now add the mustard and balsamic vinegar and process for about 1 minute
3. Put the lamb in a roasting pan with the ribs curving down , and coat the tops with the mustard mixture
4. Allow to stand for 1 hour at room temperature
5. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f
6. Roast lamb for exactly 20 minutes for rare or 25 minutes for medium-rare
7. Remove from oven and cover with aluminum foil
8. Allow to sit for 15 minutes , then cut into individual ribs and serve
9. Frenching is the technique of cutting meat away from the top of a rib or chop before cooking to expose part of the bone
10. Ask your butcher to trim and french the rack for you
11. If a butcher is unavailable , follow these steps for presentation-worthy chops: remove the thick layer of fat from bone side of rack by pulling it away with your hands and using a thin sharp knife to cut through the end
12. Discard
13. Remove meat between the ribs to 1 to 2 inches of the eye of the meat by cutting down and up along the bones
14. Scrape remaining bits of meat from the bone

title: creamy chipped beef chip dip
steps:
1. Chop chipped beef fine
2. Mix all ingredients together well
3. Cover and chill

title: roasted gourmet vegetables
steps:
1. Cut the vegetables into large chunks and place into a very large mixing bowl
2. Pour the olive oil , and then the herb seasoning over the vegetables and use your hands to coat them all over
3. Pour the vegetables on to a large baking sheet and cover with aluminum foil
4. Bake in a pre-heated 375-degree f
5. Oven for 90 minutes
6. Remove the aluminum foil and broil on high for about 12 minutes , just until you get some brown
7. Serve

title: canned fresh tomatoes
steps:
1. Peel the tomatoes by dropping them in boiling water for 15 seconds
2. Core each tomato and leave it whole
3. Put salt , sugar , and lemon juice into hot jars
4. Pack the tomatoes tightly into the jars
5. You should have plenty of juice to cover the tomatoes by pressing them down
6. Remove the air bubbles and clean the rim of the jars
7. Seal and process in water bath for 45 minutes

title: chicken casserole
steps:
1. Cook chicken in water until tender
2. Cook broccoli
3. Mix soup , mayonnaise , curry powder and lemon juice
4. Spread broccoli over bottom of greased pan remove chicken from bones and lay over broccoli
5. Pour soup mixture over all and cover with grated cheese
6. Mix melted butter with dressing mix and sprinkle over all
7. Bake at 350: for 45 minutes

title: smoky cheese log
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , combine the first seven ingredients
2. Mix well
3. Shape mixture into a log
4. Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight
5. For topping , combine the bacon , sesame seeds and chives
6. Roll cheese log in topping
7. Serve with vegetables or crackers

title: peachy office bread
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. In a mixing bowl mash the bananas and then cream the apple sauce and sugar
3. Mix in the water and extracts
4. Stir in peaches
5. Combine flour , baking soda , salt and baking powder
6. Gradually add to the cream mixture
7. Stir in the quick oats
8. Pour into a greased 9 by 5 by 3 loaf pan
9. Combine topping ingredients
10. Sprinkle over the batter
11. Bake at 350 degrees for 50-55 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
12. Cool for 10 minutes before removing from pan to a wire rack

title: kona k s sweet   spicy bbq chicken wings
steps:
1. Combine dressing , teriyaki sauce , brown sugar , garlic , chili powder and pepper
2. Stir until it's well-combined
3. Add the chicken wings and toss until all wings are evenly-coated with the marinade
4. Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours
5. When ready to cook: heat up the grill
6. Cook on each side for at least 3-4 minutes
7. Pierce to check the inside for doneness

title: glen s yummy baby back ribs
steps:
1. Place ribs bone side down in a large roasting pan
2. Combine garlic powder , lemon / pepper and salt , sprinkle over ribs
3. Top with chopped onion and minced garlic
4. Cover tightly and bake 350 degrees for 2 1 / 2 to 3 hours
5. In a bowl , combine the remaining ingredients
6. Drain fat from pan
7. Brush ribs with half of the barbecue sauce
8. Cover and bake 30 minutes longer or until ribs are tender
9. Serve with remaining sauce
10. Enjoy !

title: teresa dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Evenly coat the bottom of a 9 inch glass pie pan with the cream cheese
3. Add the chili on top of the cream cheese
4. Top the dip with your favorite shredded cheese
5. Bake dip for 5 minutes or until the cheese is melted

title: the best ever lemon tart
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 190c , gas mark 5
2. Melt the butter gently and mix together with the flour , icing sugar and water
3. Press the soft dough into the base and up the sides of a fluted flan ring
4. Pierce the base several times and bake blind on a baking tray in the oven for 20 minutes until golden
5. Reduce the oven temperature to 150c , gas mark 2
6. Grate the rind of the lemon and then juice
7. Place caster sugar , eggs , cream , in a bowl with the lemon rind and juice
8. Whisk together until blended , then carefully pour into the cooked pastry case
9. Return to the oven and cook for a further 35-40 minutes until set
10. Enjoy !

title: creamy coleslaw
steps:
1. In medium bowl , combine mayonnaise , vinegar , and sugar
2. Season with salt and pepper
3. Add cabbage , carrots , and scallions
4. Mix to combine
5. Let stand at least 15 minutes at room temperature to soften cabbage , or cover and refrigerate up to 1 day

title: squash and red lentil soup
steps:
1. Peel , seed and dice the squash and roast with the rosemary sprigs and olive oil in a 200 c oven for 45 minutes
2. You want the total amount of diced squash to be about 2 pounds or 900g
3. Meanwhile , clean the lentils and then boil them for about 10 minutes
4. Drain the lentils , add the stock and the onion and simmer for five minutes
5. Mash the squash and stir into the soup
6. Season with salt and pepper and serve with a sprig of the roasted rosemary on top

title: ginataang mais  sweet rice with corn and coconut milk
steps:
1. In a pan , combine all the ingredients except for the corn
2. Let it simmer for 20 minutes or when the rice is almost cooked
3. Add corn
4. Let it simmer for another 10-25 minutes
5. Serve hot or cold

title: coffee fizz
steps:
1. Fill brandy sniffer or highball glass with ice
2. Squeeze one of the orange wedges over ice , twisting rind to release oil
3. Discard rind
4. Add coffee liqueur and vodka
5. Stir in ginger ale
6. Garnish with remaining orange wedges

title: breaded cauliflower
steps:
1. Cut apart the florets of your cauliflower
2. Don't cut them too small
3. Leave the smaller ones together with the stem to make them as large as your bigger ones
4. Rinse , and dry slightly with a paper towel
5. Pour about 1 / 2" to 1" oil in your frying pan and begin prheating the oil
6. Careful don't make it too hot , you don't want to burn the crumbs
7. In a bowl , beat eggs slightly with a whisk , slowly adding a little flour at a time
8. You want a thick enough batter to cling to the cauliflower
9. If you have made it too thick , you can always add milk , or too thin , more flour
10. Salt and pepper the florets , or use the"essence" for variance
11. Coat each cauliflower in the batter , then in the bread crumbs
12. Then proceed to put them in your preheated oil to fry
13. Turn to brown all sides
14. Drain on paper towels
15. Serve hot
16. Easy !

title: shrimp in green mayonnaise
steps:
1. Mix mayonnaise , parsley , capers , and oregano in medium bowl
2. Add shrimp to bowl and gently stir until completely mixed
3. Refrigerate until ready to serve

title: orange rice   rice cooker
steps:
1. Place 2 cups of rice into your rice cooker - using the cup provided
2. Fill up with water to the 2 cup level in the rice cooker
3. Add the saffron , onion , salt , pepper & butter to the rice & water
4. Stir gently mixing it all together
5. Turn the rice cooker on to the cook cycle
6. When ready to serve , fluff and serve

title: couscous flax seed porridge
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together in bowl
2. And microwave for 2mins on high
3. Stir and further cook if required

title: low carb snickerdoodles
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl beat butter with an electric mixer on
2. Medium to high speed for 30 seconds
3. Add about half the flour , the 1 cup splenda , the egg , vanilla , baking soda , and cream of tartar
4. Beat until thoroughly combined
5. Beat in the remaining flour
6. Cover and chill for 1 hour
7. Combine the 2 tablespoons splenda and the cinnamon in a small bowl
8. Shape dough into 1 inch balls
9. Roll balls in the splenda-cinnamon mix and place 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet
10. Bake at 350f for 10 to 12 minutes

title: indonesian fried rice   nasi goreng
steps:
1. Stir the rice with a fork to separate the grains
2. Pour a small amount of oil in a wok and fry the egg to make a thin omelet
3. Cool , then shred
4. Heat the remaining oil in the wok and fry the shallots , garlic , chilies and shrimp paste until the shallots are tender
5. Increase the heat to high and add the rice , salt and soy sauce , adding a little oil if necessary , stirring constantly until well mixed and heated through
6. Garnish with shredded egg , cucumber , and tomato
7. Serve with fried egg , fried chicken , satay , and shrimp crackers , , if desired

title: sugee  suji  cake
steps:
1. Cream butter and 120g sugar for 1 minute in a mixer
2. Add milk and semolina flour
3. Mix well
4. Set aside covered for an hour
5. Preheat oven till 180 degrees celsius
6. Grease sides and bottom of 7-inch round cake tin
7. Line bottom of tin with paper
8. Beat eggs and yolks in a mixer till frothy
9. Add 120g sugar slowly
10. Beat for 5 minutes
11. Add vanilla essence and stir
12. Sift flour , baking powder and salt
13. Add ground almonds and chopped almonds
14. Mix well
15. Add 1 / 2 of egg mixture to butter mixture
16. Fold gently
17. Then add 1 / 2 of flour mixture to butter mixture and fold
18. Repeat above step
19. Do not overmix or the cake will turn out densely textured
20. Pour mixture into cake tin and bake for 45 minutes
21. Allow cake to cool for 10 minutes before removing from tin
22. Recipe

title: guatemala n ceviche
steps:
1. Blanche shrimp in boiling water for 5 minutes , then shock in ice cold water
2. Strain when cooled
3. Add shrimps to the a bowl
4. Add lemon juice and marinate for 2 hours
5. Add salt , pepper , ketchup , worcestershire sauce , onion , tomatoes , chilies and cilantro , marinate for 2 more hours
6. Remember to always refrigerate when your marinating !
7. Serve with some nice crackers --

title: chicken chimichangas  baked
steps:
1. Mix chicken base ingredients in mixing bowl - set aside to use as filling
2. Warm tortilla's between paper towels for 20 - 30 seconds in microwave to make pliable for folding
3. Place 2oz of chicken mixture and 1oz cheese in center of tortilla - fold burrito style
4. Place on greased baking sheet and rub tops of each with olive oil
5. Bake 400 5 -10 minutes per side or until golden brown and crispy on both sides
6. Serve immediately or refrigerate for a "grab & go" meal
7. For a beautiful presentation
8. Serve topped with a dollop of sour cream chopped cilantro sprinkled over top and avocado slices on the side

title: granny s banana cream pie
steps:
1. In a saucepan , combine sugar , flour , and salt
2. Stir in milk and mix well
3. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until the mixture thickens and comes to a boil
4. Boil for 2 minutes
5. Remove from the heat
6. Stir a small amount of cream mixture into egg yolks
7. Return all to saucepan
8. Cook for 2 minutes , stirring constantly
9. Remove from the heat
10. Add butter and vanilla
11. Mix well
12. Allow to cool slightly
13. Slice the bananas and place evenly in pastry shell
14. Pour cream mixture over bananas
15. Cool
16. Before serving , garnish with whipped cream or cool whip and bananas
17. Refrigerate any leftovers

title: sausage macaroni supper
steps:
1. Cook macaroni according to package directions
2. Meanwhile , in a dutch oven , cook sausage and onion in oil over medium heat until meat is no longer pink
3. Drain
4. Stir in the soup , milk , parmesan cheese and italian seasoning
5. Bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat
7. Drain macaroni
8. Add to sausage mixture
9. Stir in broccoli
10. Heat through

title: mandarin orange upside down cakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Lightly brush muffin tins with melted butter
3. Reserve remaining butter
4. In a small bowl combine remaining butter and brown sugar
5. Divinde mixture evenly among muffin cups
6. Drain mandarin oranges , reserving 1 / 2 cup juice
7. Place 1 cherry in bottom of each muffin cup
8. Arrange 3-4 orange segments around each cherry
9. In a large bowl , combine cake mix , egg and reserved juice
10. Mis until smooth
11. Divide batter evenly among cups
12. Bake 25-30 min until golden brown
13. Immediately loosen cakes from sides of muffin cups

title: baklava minis
steps:
1. Melt butter in microwave in small mixing bowl
2. Add sugar and cinnamon and mix with a spoon
3. Add nuts and mix again
4. Place shells on a baking sheet lined with foil
5. Put enough nut mixture to fill shell
6. Bake at 350 for 15-20 minutes
7. Let cool
8. Add a drop of honey to each shell

title: chipotle salsa
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. Line baking pan with foil
3. Lightly oil pan with olive oil
4. Broil tomatillos , tomatoes , garlic , and onion until browned on all sides , turning frequently
5. Remove skins from garlic
6. Place vegetables in food processor or blender and add remaining ingredients
7. Chop coarsely or pulse lightly
8. Season to taste

title: beef roll up
steps:
1. Sprinkle meat with salt and pepper
2. Marinate in french dressing 30-60 minutes , at room temperature
3. In saucepan , simmer vegetables , covered , in water until tender-crisp , about 7-8 minutes
4. Drain
5. Drain steaks
6. Place about 1 / 3 cup vegetable mixture on each steak
7. Roll up jelly roll fashion
8. Cut bacon slices in half , crosswise
9. Wrap two half pieces bacon around each roll-up
10. Secure with wooden toothpicks
11. Grill steaks over hot coals , or broil 3-4 inches from heat , 20-25 minutes , turning steaks occasionally

title: strawberry jello ice cream mold
steps:
1. Combine gelatin , salt and jello
2. Add water and dissolve
3. Add ice cream
4. Stir well
5. Rinse mold with ice water before adding mixture
6. Chill until firm

title: pollock with three pepper salsa
steps:
1. Pollock:
2. Combine tequila , the juice and zest of lemon and lime , garlic , oil and pepper
3. Marinate pollock one hour
4. Remove pollock from marinade
5. Drain
6. Charbroil allowing about 10 minutes per inch of thickness measured at its thickest part or until fish flakes when tested with a fork
7. Serve two fillets per plate
8. Place three pepper salsa over 1 / 3 of fish
9. Garnish with red pepper , cilantro , lime slices and sour cream
10. Three pepper salsa:
11. Combine roasted , peeled and diced peppers ,
12. Seeded and chopped jalapeo , chopped tomatillos , chopped cilantro , olive oil , balsamic vinegar , minced green onion , and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt
13. Makes about 1 1 / 3 cups

title: baby greens salad with cranberry balsamic vinaigrette
steps:
1. In a small bowl , mix the vinegar , cranberry sauce and shallot
2. Slowly whisk in the olive oil and season with salt and pepper
3. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
4. Place the walnuts on a baking sheet and toast for 5 to 7 minutes
5. Set walnuts aside
6. To serve the salad , toss the greens with enough of the vinaigrette to moisten and arrange on plates
7. Sprinkle each salad with goat cheese , dried cranberries and toasted walnuts

title: julie s baked chicken korma   rice
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. In a large saucepan saut the chopped onion and sliced mushrooms in butter and olive oil until onions are opaque
3. Add spices and the remaining sauce ingredients except for one of the cans of broth
4. Simmer for 5 minutes
5. Turn off heat and add cubed chicken
6. Stir
7. Put uncooked rice in the bottom a large lightly-oiled lasagne pan and carefully pour the chicken / sauce mixture over
8. Bake in 375 degree oven for 30 minutes , add the remaining can of chicken broth into the pan and stir well , then bake for an additional 30 minutes until rice is cooked through
9. Makes about 10-12 potluck servings

title: buttermilk loaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Optimally , have the buttermilk between 80 degrees f and no warmer than 105 degrees f
3. This is important for the yeast to activate
4. Too low a temperature and it won't activate
5. Too high and it will kill the yeast
6. In the measuring cup in which you've measured the buttermilk , add the yeast to the milk
7. Stir to dissolve the yeast and set aside for now
8. In a medium bowl , combine all the dry ingredients
9. To the dry ingredients , slowly add the oil and then slowly add the milk / yeast mixture
10. Mix well
11. Dough will look wet , thick , and pasty
12. Place dough into your well-greased 9- x 4-inch loaf pan
13. Wet hands and smooth out the top of the dough , then make an indentation down the center lengthwise of the loaf
14. I use the back of a wet spoon for the indent
15. Bake for 25-28 minutes
16. Loaf will just begin to brown
17. Test for doneness with a long toothpick , much as you would for a cake
18. Cool briefly before removing from pan
19. Finish cooling on a cooling rack
20. Refrigerate or freeze extra servings

title: shrimp in sauce
steps:
1. Place flour and milk in a blender and blend until well mixed and smooth
2. Saute onion in oil on medium heat until tender
3. Add shrimp and cook , stirring until translucent , about 2 - 3 minutes
4. Pour liquid in and cook over medium heat stirring until thickened , making sure the shrimp is done , but not overcooked (a total cooking time of 3 to 5 minutes is usually enough for shrimp depending on the size
5. Add , salt and pepper to taste
6. Use over pasta or rice and add parmesan cheese or flakes of red pepper if desired
7. Fat in a sauce helps prevent this , but if you use skim milk as i do , keep the sauce from boiling if possible and add the salt at the end

title: hominy grits
steps:
1. Pour grits into boiling salted water and stir until it reaches the boiling point
2. Lower heat and simmer slowly for an hour , stirring frequently
3. When ready to serve , add butter and beat well for a few minutes

title: honey cucumber salad
steps:
1. Place thinly slice cucumbers in a bowl and sprinkle with salt
2. Toss well
3. Allow to sit in the refrigerator while you prepare dressing
4. To prepare dressing: combine the vinegar , water , honey & red pepper flakes in a small saucepan
5. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat to medium
6. Cook over medium heat for about 10 minutes , until liquid is reduced to about 1 / 3 cup
7. Remove mixture from heat & stir in diced red onion
8. Let cool to room temperature
9. Combine sauce and cucumbers , stirring well to coat
10. Refrigerate until well chilled or at least an hour

title: coco coffee smoothies
steps:
1. Put all in a blender
2. Serve right away

title: open faced crab sandwiches
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. In a bowl , combine crabmeat , green onions , cheese , mayonnaisse and cayenne
3. Slice tomatoes into eight slices
4. On a baking sheet or broiler pan place english muffin halves and broil 3-4 inches from heat until golden
5. Remove from oven
6. Place a tomato slice on each muffin half and top with crab mixture and then sprinkle with extra shredded cheese , if desired
7. Return to oven and broil until cheese browns

title: bete noire chocolate cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees with the rack in the center of the oven
2. Butter a 9 cake pan and place a circle of parchment or wax paper on the bottom , covering it completely
3. Butter the paper
4. Chop both the chocolates into fine pieces and set them aside
5. Combine the water with 1 cup of the sugar in a heavy 1 1 / 2 quart saucepan
6. Bring to a rapid boil over high heat and cook about 2 minutes
7. Remove the saucepan from the heat and immediately add the chocolate pieces , stirring until they are completely melted
8. Then add the butter , piece by piece , stirring to melt it completely
9. Place the eggs and the remaining 1 / 3 cup sugar in either the bowl of an electric mixer or a regular mixing bowl
10. For a cake with a crunchy crust: beat the eggs and sugar in the electric mixer until they have tripled in volume
11. For a smooth top : mix the eggs and sugar only until the sugar dissolves
12. Add the chocolate / butter mixture to the eggs and mix to incorporate completely
13. Do not overbeat ! this causes nasty air bubbles
14. Spoon and scrape the mixture into the prepared pan
15. Set the pan into a slightly larger pan or a sturdy jellyroll pan
16. Set both in the oven and pour hot water into the larger pan
17. Bake for 2530 minutes
18. Let cool in the pan for 10 minutes and then run a sharp knife around the sides to release the cake
19. Cover with plastic wrap and unmold onto a cookie sheet
20. Invert a serving plate over the cake and flip it over , so the plate is on the bottom and the cake on top
21. Ganache:
22. Scald the cream
23. Add the chocolate off the heat , and stir very gently until smooth
24. Cool slightly and pour over cake

title: eier schuh aka irish stew
steps:
1. Cut cabbage into thin slices , put into bowl of salted water , set aside
2. Peel and slice potatoes
3. Put large handfuls of cabbage into a dutch oven until the bottom is covered
4. Cover cabbage with a layer of potato slices
5. Crumble ground beef over potato layer
6. Season beef with celery salt , salt and pepper
7. Continue making layers until ingredients are used up
8. End with a layer of cabbage
9. Cook on low heat until cabbage and potatoes are tender
10. Mash everything together with potato masher
11. Check that ingredients do not stick to bottom of pan - periodically add a little water
12. Continue to cook until flavors are blended - taste !

title: telegraph alert
steps:
1. Pour the juices , vodka , honey and ginger slices into a shaker with ice
2. Shake
3. Strain into a highball glass filled with ice
4. Garnish with a thin wedge of apple if desired

title: devil s food cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Prepare baking sheets with cooking spray
3. Set aside
4. In a mixing bowl , combine margarine , buttermilk , vanilla extract , and egg whites
5. In another mixing bowl , combine flour , cocoa powder , sugar , baking soda , and salt
6. Mix wet ingredients with dry ingredients just until moistened
7. Drop dough by tablespoonfuls , 2" apart onto prepared baking sheets
8. Bake for 7 minutes
9. Sprinkle with powdered sugar

title: jesse s favorite beef stroganoff
steps:
1. Brown the ground beef with the onion and diced bacon
2. Drain
3. Stir in the mushroom soup , paprika , salt and pepper
4. Simmer 10-20 minutes , stirring often
5. Stir in sour cream and heat through
6. Cook the noodles according to the package directions , then drain
7. Add butter to the noodles
8. Serve the stroganoff over the noodles , and enjoy !

title: pastrami fajitas
steps:
1. Slice pastrami , peppers , cabbage , and zucchini into thin strips
2. Chop mushrooms
3. Heat oils in nonstick copper pan on medium
4. Add cabbage , lemon-pepper and italian seasonings
