5. Cook 3 minutes covered , toss occasionally
6. Add peppers cook 3 minutes more covered tossing occasionally
7. Add zucchini cook 2-3 minutes covered tossing occasionally
8. Add pastrami cook 2 -3 minutes keep covered tossing occasionally
9. Turn off heat add spinach , toss
10. Cover for 30 seconds , toss , cover for 1 minute more
11. Roll 6 ounces of this mixture into a multi-grain flat bread wrap or in a multi-grain tortilla warmed
12. Serve plain or with a dipping sauce such as fat-free greek yogurt lime zest
13. Makes 3 6 ounce servings

title: chili rubbed salmon with cilantro avocado salsa
steps:
1. Place tomatillos in a saucepan and cover with water
2. Bring to a boil , then simmer for 5 minutes
3. Remove tomatillos and when cool enough to handle , roughly chop them
4. Combine the tomatillos , onion , cilantro and lime juice
5. Gently fold in the avocado and add jalapeo
6. Season with salt to taste
7. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
8. Combine chili powder , cumin , sugar and salt
9. Sprinkle fish with spice mix
10. Heat a large oven-proof nonstick skillet over medium heat
11. Cook the salmon rub side down for 2 minutes then flip and place pan in the oven for about 5-6 minutes or until cooked through
12. Transfer fish fillets to plates and top with the cilantro avocado salsa

title: spinach and ham quiche
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 230c
2. Chop shallots and ham , and saut in olive oil with garlic
3. Remove from heat and allow to cool
4. In a bowl mix the flour with a little milk until a smooth paste forms
5. Add rest of milk , eggs , paprika , salt and pepper
6. To the milk mixture , add the sauted shallots and ham , cheese and spinach
7. Mix well
8. Prick the base of the pastry with a fork and gently pour in the filling mixture
9. Spread out evenly
10. Bake for 30 minutes
11. If necessary , cover with foil for the last 10 minutes to prevent over-browning
12. Remove from oven and leave for 5 minutes before serving

title: scallops and pasta with pistachio parsley pesto
steps:
1. Place first 9 ingredients in a food processor
2. Process until smooth , scraping down sides of processor bowl occasionally
3. Combine scallops , flour , and 1 / 8 teaspoon salt in large zip-lock plastic bag
4. Seal , and shake to coat
5. Heat butter or margarine in nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
6. Add scallops
7. Cook 3-1 / 2 minutes on each side or until scallops are done
8. Combine pesto mixture and pasta in a large bowl , tossing well
9. Arrange 1 cup pasta on each plate , and divide the scallops evenly between plates
10. Sprinkle with pepper
11. Garnish with parsley , if desired

title: un chocolate cake  raw foods
steps:
1. Combine the crust ingredients and mix well
2. Form into a 1-inch layer on a flat plate
3. Spread ground prunes between layers and form as many layers as you want
4. Blend the topping ingredients well
5. Adding a little bit of water if needed
6. Spread over the crust , or use a decorating bag to apply it
7. Decorate with fruits , berries , and nuts
8. Chill

title: grilled salmon with tangy cucumber sauce
steps:
1. Combine first 6 ingredients , chill at least 30 minute
2. Heat grill and spray with cooking spray
3. Sprinnkle fish filets with salt and pepper , and grill 5-6 min
4. , turn over and cook another 4 minute or until fish reaches desired doneness
5. Serve with chilled sauce and drill sprigs for garnish

title: fruit and yogurt parfait
steps:
1. Layer 2 oz
2. Yogurt , 2-3 sliced strawberries , 1 / 8 cup blueberries and 1 / 8 cup chopped pecans in parfait glass
3. Repeat layers
4. Top with remaining yogurt
5. Garnish with a few chopped pecans and / or a strawberry if desired

title: grilled savory brussels sprouts
steps:
1. Cut brussels sprouts in half
2. Place sprouts in the middle of a large piece of aluminum foil
3. I usually put 10 sprouts in each packet
4. Dot butter over the sprouts , then sprinkle with the seasoning salt , bacon and garlic powder
5. Drizzle small amount of olive oil over the top and close up the foil packet
6. Grill packets for 10 minutes over medium-high heat
7. After cooking is complete , place the veggies in a bowl and mix them up so that the butter / flavorings coat all the tasty brussels sprouts

title: basque tuna   potato casserole
steps:
1. Cut the fish into large , chunky pieces
2. Heat the olive oil in a large stove-top safe casserole dish or pot
3. Add in the onion , garlic , peppers and tomatoes and fry over a low heat for about ten minutes
4. When the onion is looking cooked , add the paprika , cayenne , salt and pepper and cook for another few minutes
5. Add in the potatoes then add just enough water to cover the potatoes and veggies
6. Bring up to a gentle boil
7. When the potatoes are nearly done , add in the tuna and the white wine and cook for a further 15 minutes all depending you may need to add a little more liquid if it's drying up , or let some cook off if it's too runny
8. Garnish with the parsley if using
9. Serve with crusty bread and a salad !

title: sauteed zucchini and garlic
steps:
1. Heat half the oil in a large skillet over medium high heat
2. Add half the zucchini and cook , stirring only occasionally , until golden brown , 10-12 minutes
3. Transfer the cooked zucchini to a plate
4. Repeat with the remaining oil and zucchini
5. Return the first batch to the skillet
6. Stir in the garlic , marjoram , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper and cook , stirring , for 2 minutes

title: bisteeya
steps:
1. Place chicken thighs with onion , garlic , parsley , salt , turmeric and ginger
2. Toss well , rubbing chicken with the spices
3. Marinate 2 hours at room temperature or overnight in the refrigerator
4. Cook chicken with the marinade , chicken broth and cinnamon sticks
5. Bring to boil , reduce heat , cover and gently simmer for 1 hour
6. Remove chicken from broth and set aside
7. Strain broth , and boil it on high heat about 10 minutes , until reduced to 1 3 / 4 to 2 cups
8. Toast almonds in the microwave for 3 minutes on high
9. Add powdered sugar and ground cinnamon
10. Set aside
11. After broth is reduced , add lemon juice and gently simmer another 10 minutes
12. Increase heat to medium and , stirring constantly with a wooden spoon , slowly stir in beaten eggs
13. Cook , stirring , until eggs are set but not dry
14. Most of the liquid should evaporate
15. About 8-10 minutes
16. Add salt if necessary , cool to room temperature
17. When chicken is cool , shred the meat and set aside
18. Preheat oven to 425f
19. Unroll phyllo
20. Spray bottom and sides of a 14 inch deep dish pan with butter flavored spray
21. Arrange 6 sheets phyllo so that half the sheet covers the bottom of the pan and half extends over sides
22. Spray with butter flavored spray
23. Fold 4 sheets in half and let them air dry
24. Place shredded chicken on bottom of phyllo in pan
25. Cover with egg mixture then the 4 dry phyllo sheets
26. Sprinkle almond / sugar mixture over pastry
27. Cover with all but 2 remaining pastry leaves
28. Spraying each with butter flavored spray
29. Fold the overlapping leaves over the top and spray with butter flavored spray
30. Bake 20 minutes or until golden
31. Dust top with cinnamon and powdered sugar before serving

title: goulash casserole
steps:
1. Spray large skillet with cooking spray
2. Heat over medium heat until hot
3. Add ground beef and cook until browned
4. Add onions , bell peppers , and garlic and cook until tender , 8 to 10 minutes
5. Stir in flour , paprika , and caraway seeds
6. Cook 1 to 2 minutes longer
7. Stir in water , sauerkraut , tomato , and sour cream
8. Season to taste with salt and pepper
9. Spoon mixture into 11 x 7 inch baking dish or 2-quart casserole
10. Bake , covered , at 350 degrees until hot through , 20 to 30 minutes
11. Sprinkle with parsley before serving

title: strapatsada
steps:
1. In a small skillet over medium heat saute the chopped onion in the olive oil
2. In a bowl whisk the eggs and add them into the skillet along with the chopped tomato and season to taste
3. Mix well and cook until the juices evaporate
4. Transfer to a plate and serve topped with crumbled feta cheese and parsley

title: feta and herb stuffed shells
steps:
1. For sauce , heat oil in heavy large saucepan over medium heat
2. Add onion and saute 5 minutes
3. Add garlic and saute until onion is tender , about 5 minutes
4. Add crushed red pepper and saute 30 seconds
5. Add tomatoes , simmer until sauce is reduced to 5 cups , stirring occasionally , about 1 hour
6. Season to taste with salt and pepper
7. Remove from heat and mix in basil
8. For filling , combine ricotta , 1 1 / 3 cups feta , 1 / 2 cup chopped basil
9. And the chives
10. Season to taste with salt and pepper
11. Mix in eggs
12. Cook shells in large pot of boiling salted water until just tender but still firm to bite
13. Drain
14. Rinse with cold water until cool
15. Drain thoroughly
16. Preheat oven 350f spread 3 / 4 cup sauce over bottom of each of two 13 x 9 x 2-inch glass baking dishes
17. Fill 30 shells and divide between dishes
18. Top with remaining sauce
19. Sprinkle with remaining feta
20. Bake shells until heated through , about 30 minutes
21. Garnish with basil sprigs and serve on a nice platter
22. Enjoy , lets see if you can have only 3 or 4
23. Lol

title: macaroni and cheese for 20 25
steps:
1. Melt butter in 3 quart or larger kettle , cook onion in butter until soft
2. Add flour mixed with salt , mustard , and ginger , and cook , stirring constantly until bubbly
3. Remove from heat , add milk , stirring or whisking continuously
4. Put back on heat and continue stirring until sauce thickens
5. Remove from heat , stir in worcestershire sauce and cheese
6. Stir until cheese is melted
7. Mix with elbow macaroni cooked according to package directions
8. Bake in a 400f oven in two buttered 11x15 shallow pans , or three buttered 2 quart casseroles , or two 3 qt casseroles
9. Bake uncovered for 20 minutes , then covered for an additional 15-20 minutes
10. Cover with aluminum foil is you don't have lids
11. If baked frozen , bake an additional 20 minutes

title: bajan coconut ice
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , scald milk
2. Place 2 cups coconut in a sieve
3. Pour hot milk over coconut while holding sieve over large bowl to catch liquid
4. Use the back of a spoon to squeeze all of the milk out of the coconut
5. In a large saucepan , combine coconut milk , sugar , and cream of tartar
6. Cook over low heat , stirring constantly , until sugar has dissolved
7. Remove pan from heat and add beaten egg yolk
8. Beat well with a spoon
9. Stir in remaining coconut and add 2 or 3 drops almond extract
10. Taste and add more extract if desired
11. Pour into 2 pie pans or pyrex dish
12. Cover with plastic wrap and place in freezer
13. Remove coconut ice from freezer after 4 hours and break apart with a fork
14. Serve immediately

title: rosemary chicken   potato pizza
steps:
1. To make garlic-shallot butter: melt 1 tablespoon butter in a non-stick saucepan over medium-high heat
2. Add the shallot , garlic and thyme and cook , stirring occasionally , until the shallot softens and begins to turn golden brown
3. Add the salt and pepper , the stock and lemon juice
4. Cook until the mixture is reduced to 1 / 2 cup
5. Remove the pan from the heat
6. Quickly whisk in the remaining butter
7. Set aside
8. To make the potatoes: preheat the oven to 325f
9. Combien the potatoes with the remaining ingredients and toss to coat thoroughly
10. Transfer the slices to a sheet pan and spread them out in a single layer- do not overlap
11. Discard the leftover marinade- do not pour over the potatoes
12. Bake the potatoes for about 45 minutes
13. Some of the slices may need to be flipped over to promote even browning
14. Remove the potatoes from the oven when they begin to brown
15. Use a steel spatula to remove the potatoes from the pan and let them cool to room temperature
16. Do not refrigerate
17. To make the chicken: combine the garlic , soy , salt and olive oil
18. Marinate the chicken in this mixture for about 15 minutes
19. Grill until done , about 5 to 7 minutes per side
20. Remove the chicken , let rest 10 minutes , then cut into cubes and set aside
21. To make the pizza: preheat the oven to 500f if using a pizza stone or tiles put them in the oven now
22. Spread 2 tablespoons of the garlic shallot butter over the surface
23. Cover the butter with the mozzerella , then the chicken
24. Sprinkle with the rosemary , then the oregano , then layer the potatoes on top
25. Bake the pizza until crisp and golden and the cheese at the center is bubbly , about 8 to 10 minutes
26. When done , sprinkle the parsley over top , slice and serve

title: buttermilk oatmeal bread
steps:
1. Sprinkle the yeast over the water in a small bowl
2. Do not stir
3. Set aside for at least 5 minutes to proof to a foamy consistency
4. Stir together the flour , oats , sugar and salt in a large bowl
5. Add the butter , buttermilk and yeast mixture and beat with an electric mixer until the ingredients are well blended
6. Turn out the dough onto a floured surface and knead for about 5 minutes or until the dough is smooth and elastic
7. Lightly oil a large bowl and transfer the dough to the bowl
8. Cover with a tea towel and let the dough rise in a warm place until it is doubled in size , about 1 hour
9. Pun the dough down and let it rise again , covered with a tea towel , for 45 minutes
10. Preheat oven to 350 and oil a 9x5x3-inch loaf pan
11. Punch the dough down again and place it in the loaf pan
12. Bake for 35-40 minutes or till the loaf pulls away from the side of the pan and loaf sounds hollow when you thump it

title: chicken and sour cream enchiladas
steps:
1. In a large bowl , stir together chicken , 1 / 2 cup sour cream , and 1 1 / 2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese
2. Set aside
3. Saute onion in hot oil over medium-high heat 5 minutes
4. Add to chicken and cheese mixture
5. Spoon chicken mixture evenly at one end of each tortilla , and roll up
6. Arrange , seam side down , in a lightly greased 13x9 baking dish
7. Set aside
8. Whisk together 8 oz green chiles , milk , and flour in a saucepan over medium heat
9. Gradually add remaining cheese , stirring constantly , until cheese is melted
10. Pour sauce evenly over top of enchiladas
11. Spread remaining sour cream over sauce
12. Bake enchiladas at 400 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes or until bubbly
13. Top with remaining green chiles and serve

title: wonderful chocolate  oat  chip cookies
steps:
1. Combine flour , baking soda and salt in small bowl
2. Beat brown sugar , butter and granulated sugar in large mixer bowl until creamy
3. Beat in eggs , milk and vanilla extract
4. Gradually beat in flour mixture
5. Stir in oats , morsels and nuts
6. Drop by rounded tablespoon onto ungreased baking sheets
7. Bake in preheated 375 oven for 8-10 minutes for chewy cookies or 12-13 minutes for crispier cookies
8. Let stand for 1 minutes
9. Remove to wire racks to cool completely
10. Makes about 4 dozen cookies

title: sage and pancetta shrimp
steps:
1. Clean and devein shrimp
2. Stuff one sage leaf inside shrimp
3. Wrap with pancetta
4. Use a toothpick to secure
5. Drizzle olive oil on shrimp
6. Grill on grill pan about 4 minutes per side or until shrimp is cooked

title: roasted veggies with pasta
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Load all of the veggies and garlic into a roasting pan
3. Add the olive oil and seaon with salt and pepper to taste
4. Toss to coat
5. Roast veggie for 25 min or until done
6. While the veggie are cooking , cook pasta according to package directions and drain
7. Return to the same pan
8. When veggies are done , carefully squeeze the garlic cloves into a small bowl and mash
9. Add the sour cream and mustard and mix
10. Mix the veggies , sour cream mixture and cheeses into the pasta
11. Pour into the roasting pan and return to the oven for 5 min or until heated through
12. Serve hot

title: cheeseburger macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. In dutch oven or electric skillet , heat oil
2. Add onion , saute 2 min , add beef , cook and stir until done
3. Add flour , cook and stir 1 minute
4. Add milk , butter and spices , stir until creamy
5. Fold in macaroni
6. Top with cheese , cover and heat until cheese melts

title: parkin
steps:
1. Soak oats in milk for hour
2. Mix together the flour , baking powder , ground ginger , and sugar
3. Melt butter / margarine and add molasses and honey mixture
4. Combine wet ingredients and add to dry
5. Pour into a 9" x 11" pan
6. Bake at 325f for 45 minutes or until it starts to come away from the sides of the pan

title: white lily chocolate dipped peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375
2. Coat baking sheet with no-stick cooking spray or parchment paper
3. Whisk together flour , baking soda , and salt in medium bowl
4. Combine butter flavored shortening , peanut butter , sugar , brown sugar , egg , and vanilla in large bowl
5. Beat 2 minutes
6. Stir sour cream into wet ingredients as well as half the dry ingredients
7. Stir in remaining dry ingredients
8. Roll into 2" balls with oiled hands
9. Place on prepared baking sheet about 3" apart
10. Flatten in crisscross pattern with floured fork to about 1 / 2" thickness
11. Bake 9-11 minutes or until cookies begin to look dry on top
12. Cool 2 minutes
13. Remove to cooling racks
14. Cool completely
15. Melt chocolate chips in microwave safe bowl in microwave
16. Add crisco
17. Stir until blended
18. Dip half of each cookie in chocolate dip
19. Cool on waxed paper in refrigerator until set

title: jennifer millar s chocolate budini
steps:
1. Position a rack in the lower third of the oven and heat to 375f
2. Melt the chocolate and butter with 6 tablespoons of sugar and the salt in a medium stainless-steel bowl placed in a skillet of hot , not simmering , water , stirring frequently
3. Remove from the heat and cool slightly
4. Whisk in the egg yolks and vanilla
5. In a medium bowl combine egg whites and cream of tartar
6. Using a hand-held electric mixer on high speed , beat until soft peaks form
7. Add the remaining 6 tablespoons of sugar gradually , beating constantly , until the whites are stiff and glossy
8. Fold 1 / 4 of the beaten whites into the chocolate mixture to lighten it
9. Scrape the chocolate mixture into the bowl of whites and fold just until combined
10. Divide the batter evenly among 6 12- to 16-ounce oven-proof serving dishes
11. Place the bowls on a large baking sheet
12. Bake until the budini are puffed with crusty , deeply cracked tops and a toothpick inserted in the centers comes out quite gooey , 20 to 25 minutes
13. Serve within 10 minutes , topping each serving with a scoop of ice cream

title: throw together crock pot cabbage soup
steps:
1. Reserve 1 tablespoons of the lemon juice
2. Place remaining ingredients into crock pot and cook on low 6-8 hours
3. Just before serving , add the remaining lemon juice

title: mexican bloody mary
steps:
1. Fill a tall glass with ice
2. Add tomato juice , tequila , l&p worcestershire sauce , tabasco and celery salt
3. Stir
4. Garnish with lime wedge and chilli pepper

title: sour cream sugar cookies
steps:
1. In a med
2. Bowl , combine the flour , baking powder , baking soda , nutmeg , and salt
3. In a large bowl , cream sugar and butter , beating until fluffy
4. Add the sour cream , egg , and the lemon extract and beat well
5. Stir in the flour mixture
6. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour or until thoroughly chilled
7. Preheat the oven to 375f
8. Take out 1 / 3 of the dough
9. Return rest to fridge
10. On a lightly floured surface , roll out dough to 1 / 4-inch thickness and cut into shapes with cookie cutters
11. Using a spatula , transfer the cookies to ungreased cookie sheets , placing them 2 inches apart
12. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes or until the edges are lightly browned
13. Remove cookies and cool on wire racks
14. Repeat with remaining dough
15. Store cookies in an airtight container
16. These freeze well also

title: chocolate coca cola cake with chocolate coca cola icing
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Make the cake:
3. Combine first 3 ingredients in a medium saucepan over medium heat , stirring until butter melts
4. Remove from heat
5. Combine flour , sugar , and baking soda in a large bowl , stir in butter mxiture
6. Add eggs , and stir until well blended
7. Stir in buttermilk , vanilla , and marshmallows
8. Pour into a lightly greased 13x9" baking pan
9. Bake for 25-30 minutes or until a pick inserted in the center comes out clean
10. Remove from oven
11. Spread icing over warm cake
12. Icing:
13. Combine first 3 ingredients in a medium saucepan over medium heat , stirring until butter melts
14. Remove from heat
15. Stir in powdered sugar , vanilla , and pecans
16. Spoon immediately over warm cake

title: chinese velvet chicken
steps:
1. Peel and grate ginger
2. Finely mince garlic cloves
3. Mix ground chicken with ginger , garlic , soy sauce , 1 / 2 cup chicken stock
4. Lightly beat and gently fold in egg whites
5. Thinly slice mushrooms
6. Chop water chestnuts
7. Heat peanut oil in wok to frying temperature of 375
8. Drop chicken mixture by rounded spoonful 5 or 6 at a time
9. You should taste test to be sure seasoning is to your liking
10. Finish frying chicken
11. Drain oil from wok
12. Stir fry snap peas , mushrooms , water chestnuts
13. Return chicken to wok
14. Add chili paste & soy sauce
15. Stir corn starch and chicken stock together
16. Pour into wok and toss to coat meat & vegetables
17. Allow to thicken
18. Serve over white rice
19. Ground chicken , chili paste , mushroom soy sauce and fresh shiitaki mushrooms can all be found in asian markets

title: dragon s blood punch and hand ice mold
steps:
1. You will also need: 1 lb coffee , can washed and rinsed
2. To make the hand , fill rubber glove with water
3. Tie at the wrist with string and freeze one or two days
4. Unmold
5. Sometimes a finger will fall off when unmolding , this only adds to the ghoulish effect
6. To make a base for the hand , fill coffee can about 1 / 3 full with water
7. Insert the hand and freeze until firm
8. To remove , run water on the outside of can
9. When ready to serve pour half the chilled juices and ginger ale into the punch bowl
10. Insert hand ice mold in the center
11. Fill bowl with remaining juices and soda
12. For added effect , place a few drops of red food coloring on the

title: sausage and bows
steps:
1. Slice garlic and add to pan in olive oil
2. Cook about one minute
3. Cut sausage in bite size pieces and add to garlic
4. Cover with water
5. Cook with a lid but not completely covered
6. Add basil
7. Cook over medium heat until sausage is fully cooked
8. Do not let all the water boil out of the pan
9. Boil water in seperate pot
10. Add bows and salt
11. Cook according to package diretions
12. Add squash to sausage the last few minutes of cooking so they are still firm
13. Spoon sausage mixture over bows , serve with salad and nice european crusty bread
14. You can't go wrong with wine

title: baked penne with roasted vegetables courtesy giada de la
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f
2. On a baking sheet , toss the peppers , zucchini , squash , mushrooms , and onions with olive oil , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , 1 / 2 teaspoon pepper , and dried herbs
3. Roast until tender , about 15 minutes
4. Meanwhile , bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over high heat
5. Add the pasta and cook for about 6 minutes
6. Since you will be cooking the pasta a second time in the oven , you want to make sure the inside is still hard
7. Drain in a colander
8. In a large bowl , toss the drained pasta with the roasted vegetables , marinara sauce , cheeses , peas , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , and 1 / 2 teaspoon pepper
9. Using a wooden spoon , gently mix , until all the pasta is coated with the sauce and the ingredients are combined
10. Pour the pasta into a greased 9 by 13-inch pan
11. Top with the remaining 1 / 3 cup parmesan and butter pieces
12. Bake until top is golden and cheese melts , about 25 minutes

title: forevermama s spinach  feta  and tarragon fritata
steps:
1. In a 12" ovenproof nonstick frying pan , melt 1 tablespoon of the butter over moderate heat
2. Add the scallions and cook , stirring , for 1 minute
3. Add the spinach , dried tarragon , if using , and 1 / 8 teaspoons each of the salt and pepper
4. Cook , stirring frequently , until the liquid evaporates , about 3 minutes
5. Remove the spinach mixture and let cool
6. Wipe out pan
7. In a large bowl , beat the eggs with the remaining 1 / 8 teaspoon each salt and pepper
8. Stir in the spinach mixture and fresh tarragon , if using
9. Heat the broiler
10. In the same frying pan , melt the remaining 1 tablespoon butter with the olive oil over moderate heat
11. Pour in the egg mixture and reduce the heat to low
12. Sprinkle the feta over the top and cook until the bottom is golden brown and top is almost set , 6 - 7 minutes
13. Broil the frittata 6 inches from the heat , if possible , until the eggs are set , 2 - 3 minutes
14. Lift the upper edge of the frittata with a spatula and slide the frittata onto a plate
15. Cut into wedges and serve
16. Don't squeeze out the liquid
17. The liquid is evaporated in the sauteing process while cooking in the skillet
18. Use the whole frozen and then cut into s
19. If using the finely chopped it will distribute more through egg mixture , but it's still fine if that's what you want

title: mexican swiss steak
steps:
1. Form patties from hamburger
2. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
3. Sprinkle top with green pepper and onion
4. Mix salsa and cream of mushroom soup
5. Pour over meat
6. Cover with foil
7. Bake for 2 hours at 300 degrees fahrenheit

title: nasu dengaku  broiled japanese eggplants with miso
steps:
1. Mix sake or wine with sugar and boil for a few minutes
2. Add miso to wine and cook just until miso is mixed in
3. Lightly brush or rub cut side of eggplants with sesame oil
4. Place eggplants cut side down under a broiler on high for 3 minutes
5. Turn eggplant over and broil another 3 minutes
6. Spread sesame mixture thinly over cut side of eggplant and return to broiler for about 1 minute
7. Remove from oven and sprinkle eggplants with sesame seeds and green onion

title: sweet somen noodles
steps:
1. Follow directions on package for cooking somen noodles
2. After straining in colander , pour the noodles into a mixing bowl
3. Add ingredients and stir - voila and enjoy !
4. Adjust amounts to your taste
5. For sweeter taste , add more honey

title: cream cheese apple crisp
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large bowl combine the dry topping ingredients
3. Cut in butter until crumbly
4. Press half of the mixture into the bottom of a 13x9 dish
5. Reserve the rest of the crumb mixture for the top
6. In large bowl toss together the apples and other ingredients for the apples until the apples are coated evenly
7. Spread over the crust
8. In another bowl cream together the cream cheese and sugar until smooth
9. Add eggs , flour and milk
10. Beat until combined and then spread over the apple layer
11. Then sprinkle with reserved crumb mixture
12. Bake 40-45 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the apples are tender
13. Cool completely on wire rack

title: pfaffenglueck   parson s luck   german cold pizza
steps:
1. Mix together creme fraiche and slivered onions well and season to taste with salt , pepper , and apple cider vinegar- using an ordinary eating teaspoon to measure the vinegar
2. Add a small pinch of sugar to taste- just a small amount- you don't want this to be a sweet dish
3. Chill 10 minutes while you prepare the bread and get out your toppings
4. Try to have your kraeuterfladbrot slightly warm - and split them horizontally - into 2 flat rounds each
5. Spread each of the 4 rounds with an equal portion of the creamy onion mixture- you might not need it all
6. Sprinkle each pizza with shredded cheese evenly , to taste
7. Sprinkle mushrooms , corn or diced ham over the top , to taste
8. Sprinkle with bacon rather heavily , to taste- about a tbsp on top of each
9. Sprinkle with fresh chopped parsley , trying to get a small mound of it in the center
10. Serve immediately- these are not heated

title: vegetable fettuccine
steps:
1. Saut first 5 ingredients in butter in a large skillet for 5 minutes
2. Stir in basil , salt & pepper- set aside
3. Cook fettuccine separately in two dutch ovens according to package directions , drain
4. Combine fettuccine and vegetables in one dutch oven , toss gently
5. Simmer mixture until heated , stirring occasionally
6. Stir in 3 / 4 cup parmesan cheese
7. Beat egg yolks and whipping cream until foamy , add fettuccine mixture , tossing gently
8. Cook over medium heat until thickened
9. Place on a serving platter and sprinkle with 1 / 4 cup parmesan cheese

title: emeril s broccoli and cheese soup with croutons
steps:
1. In a medium pot , melt the 3 tablespoons butter over medium-high heat
2. Add the onions , salt , pepper , and nutmeg and cook , stirring , until soft , 3 minutes
3. Add the garlic and thyme cook , stirring , until fragrant , for 20 seconds
4. Add the flour and cook , stirring until the mixture is well blended and smells fragrant , 2 minutes
5. Slowly add the chicken stock , whisking constantly , and bring to a boil
6. Reduce the heat and simmer until thickened , about 5 minutes
7. Add the broccoli and cook , stirring , until tender , for 10 minutes
8. Remove the pot from the heat and puree with a hand-held immersion blender
9. Add the cream and bring to bare simmer to heat through
10. Add the cheese and cook over low heat , stirring , until melted
11. Add the remaining 2 tablespoons butter , stirring to blend
12. Remove from the heat and ladle the soup into bowls
13. Sprinkle croutons over the top of the soup and serve immediately
14. Croutons:
15. 1 cup 1 / 2 to 3 / 4-inch cubed french bread
16. 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil
17. 1 / 4 teaspoon essence or creole seasoning , recipe follows
18. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
19. Place the bread in a medium bowl and toss with oil and essence
20. Spread evenly on a small baking sheet and bake , stirring twice , until light golden brown on top , about 6 minutes
21. Remove from the oven and cool slightly before serving
22. Emeril's essence creole seasoning :
23. 2 1 / 2 tablespoons paprika
24. 2 tablespoons salt
25. 2 tablespoons garlic powder
26. 1 tablespoon black pepper
27. 1 tablespoon onion powder
28. 1 tablespoon cayenne pepper
29. 1 tablespoon dried oregano
30. 1 tablespoon dried thyme
31. Combine all ingredients thoroughly

title: buttermilk buckwheat pancakes  gluten free
steps:
1. Combine dry ingredients in large bowl
2. Whisk remaining ingredients together
3. Stir into dry mixture just until moistened
4. Pour batter by cupfuls onto a hot nonstick griddle coated with nonstick cooking spray
5. Turn when bubbles form on top of pancakes
6. Cook until second side is golden brown

title: apple toasts
steps:
1. Peel the apple and cut it into slices or pieces
2. Spread butter to the bread
3. Place the apple slices on top of the bread
4. Put the bread in the oven , on broil
5. And when the apples look golden and the bread looks toasted , take it out of the oven and enjoy
6. :)

title: malibu chicken bundles
steps:
1. Spread 1 tablespoon mustard on each flattened breast
2. Next layer ham , cheese and pineapple
3. Fold chicken over pineapple , tightly and secure with a toothpick to form a bundle
4. Refrigerate for 30 minutes - this is optional , but the coolness will allow the bundles to somewhat "set" and they are easier to handle
5. In a shallow bowl combine the bread crumbs and salt and pepper
6. Brush all sides of bundles with the remaining mustard
7. Roll in the bread crumbs and place in a prepared baking dish
8. Bake uncovered at 350 for 45-50 minutes or until done
9. You may want to broil them the last minute or two to add a nice brown crispiness
10. While chicken is cooking , in a small saucepan , combine the soup with the sour cream and tarragon
11. Simmer until sauce like consistency
12. You may add water if it is too thick
13. I don't usually add water and i simmer it approximately 15 minutes on low heat
14. Serve over chicken
15. Approximately 1 / 3 cup sauce per bundle

title: orange danish
steps:
1. Mix yeast and warm water together to proof yeast
2. Cream shortening and margarine with sugar
3. Add yeast and water mixture
4. Add three cups flour and mix
5. Continue adding flour until soft dough forms
6. Turn out on a lightly floured surface and knead until dough becomes smooth and elastic
7. Place in an oiled bowl , cover with plastic wrap and let rise until double
8. Punch down
9. Roll out into a rectangle on a lightly floured surface
10. Mix all of the filling ingredients cutting the butter or margarine in until it is well blended
11. Spread evenly over the dough and roll , jelly roll style from the long side
12. Cut into 1 inch slices , place on lightly greased baking pan

16. Pour over rolls while they are still slightly warm
17. It gives a better texture to the frosting
18. If you choose to do this , i recommend having the"homemade" part slightly thicker than the desired end product
19. If you are adding the store bought frosting , the margarine / butter is not necessary

title: sweet pumpkin pickles
steps:
1. Prepare pumpkin by peeling , cubing and discarding seeds and inner pulp
2. Place pumpkin cubes in colander and set over boiling water
3. Make sure water does not touch pumpkin
4. Cover and steam until just tender , 5 to 7 minutes
5. Drain
6. Simmer vinegar , sugar and cinnamon for 15 minutes
7. Add pumpkin and simmer 3 minutes
8. Set aside for 24 hours
9. Heat and simmer 5 minutes more
10. Remove cinnamon sticks
11. Pack boiling hot in hot canning jars , leaving 1 / 2-inch headroom
12. Adjust lids and process in hot water bath for 10 minutes

title: 100  spelt bread  bread machine
steps:
1. Please ingredients in loaf pan in order suggested by manufacturer
2. Set to rapid bake , light crust

title: z tejas  avocado and tomato chopped salad
steps:
1. Add 1st 6 ingredients in large stainless steel bowl
2. Mix well with a rubber spatula
3. Add avocado and mix well
4. Add shredded iceberg and ranch dressing
5. Mix well and serve immediately to say fresh and crispy

title: sally minahan s maple baked beans
steps:
1. Pick through beans and soak overnight in water to cover
2. Preheat oven to 300f
3. Combine mustard , maple syrup , molasses and beer
4. Cut slab bacon in half if using and place both halves in the bottom of a casserole dish
5. Drain the beans and add them to the casserole
6. Add the syrup / beer mixture plus sufficient water to cover the beans with one inch of liquid
7. Cover the casserole and bake for approximately 6 hours
8. Check periodically and add liquid to cover if necessary
9. When the beans are tender , remove the bacon and set it aside to cool
10. Stir salt into the beans
11. Dice the bacon into 1 / 2 inch pieces and sprinkle on top of beans
12. Cover again and bake 30-40 minutes until the bacon is crisp
13. Stir bacon into beans
14. Serve either hot or at room temperature

title: egyptian baked beef patties  saniyit kufta
steps:
1. Finely chop the onions and add to the ground beef
2. Add tomato paste , spices and seasonings
3. Mix well , then spread on an oven pan or baking dish , to form a layer 1
4. 5 to 2 inches thick
5. Cut into 4" square sections and release sides
6. Peel tomatoes , slice and place on meet
7. Bake in center of preheated 350f oven for 30 minutes or until done

title: texas barbecue shrimp with bleu cheese slaw
steps:
1. ---to prepare the texas barbecue sauce---
2. Combine the first 5 ingredients in a small saucepan and warm over medium heat , stirring until the sugar is completely dissolved
3. Bring to a boil , reduce the heat to medium-low , cover , and simmer 5 minutes
4. Remove from the heat
5. In another saucepan , bring the cream to a boil
6. Reduce the heat to medium-low and cook until the cream is thickened enough to coat the back of a spoon
7. Stir in some of the barbecue sauce base , adding more base until the flavour is to your taste
8. Bring the mixture back to a boil over medium heat , and then reduce to medium-low and simmer again until it coats the back of a spoon
9. Set aside
10. The sauce may be made ahead , covered and refrigerated , and then re-warmed over medium heat when ready to use
11. ---to prepare the mayonnaise---
12. In a food processor combine the egg , lemon juice , mustard , and vinegar
13. Turn on the machine and combine for 30 seconds
14. With the machine running , slowly add the oil in a thin stream
15. When the mayonnaise has emulsified , season with salt and pepper and add the blue cheese
16. Pulse the machine for 5 seconds
17. Press through a fine-mesh sieve and store , covered , in the refrigerator until ready to use
18. ---to prepare the slaw---
19. Toss the cabbage with enough mayonnaise to coat
20. Add the green onion and bleu cheese
21. Season to taste with salt and pepper
22. Toss again
23. ---to prepare the shrimp---
24. Season the shrimp with salt and pepper
25. Heat the oil in 2 large saut pans or skillets until almost smoking
26. Add the shrimp , being careful not to crowd the pan
27. Cook until golden brown on the outside and opaque throughout , about 1 minute per side
28. Remove and drain on paper towels
29. ---to serve---
30. Pile slaw in the center of each plate and lean 5 shrimp against the slaw
31. Place another shrimp on top
32. Baste each shrimp with the sauce and drizzle more sauce around the plates
33. Sprinkle each plate with bleu cheese and onions
34. Dust the rims of the plates with black pepper

title: raspberry fudge smoothie
steps:
1. Using a blender , mix the boiling water , chocolate chips and sugar until the chocolate is melted , about 30 seconds
2. Add the raspberries and sour cream and blend on high speed until smooth
3. Add the ice cubes and blend on high speed until slushy , about 15 seconds
4. Top with frozen raspberries

title: yummy    vegan pumpkin cookies
steps:
1. Pour oil in mixing bowl
2. Add sugar and pumpkin
3. Mix well
4. Add vanilla , flour , salt , baking powder , cardamon , coriander
5. Mix well
6. Bake for 375 degrees f

title: easy ice tea  clone copycat of lipton ice tea
steps:
1. Boil water in a pot and add tea bags and allow to steep for one hour
2. Pour into pitcher when cool and add sugar
3. Mix well until dissolved and then add lemon juice
4. Chill and serve

title: blueberry torte squares
steps:
1. In a small mixing bowl , cream butter and 2 t sugar
2. Gradually add flour and mix well
3. Press onto the bottom of a 13-in x 9-in x 2-in baking dish coated with cooking spray
4. Bake at 350 degrees for 12-14 minutes or until set and edges are lightly browned
5. Cool on a wire rack
6. In a large mixing bowl , beat cream cheese and confectioners' sugar until smooth
7. Fold in whipped topping
8. Spread mixture over crust
9. Refrigerate for 20 minutes
10. Meanwhile , in a large saucepan , combine cornstarch and water until smooth
11. Stir in blueberries and remaining sugar
12. Bring to a boil
13. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
14. Cool to room temperature
15. Spoon topping over cream cheese layer
16. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours
17. Cut into squares

title: greek pasta salad i
steps:
1. In a large bowl , whisk together olive oil , vinegar , garlic powder , basil , oregano , black pepper , and sugar
2. Add cooked pasta , mushrooms , tomatoes , red peppers , feta cheese , green onions , olives and pepperoni
3. Toss until evenly coated
4. Cover , and chill 2 hours or overnight

title: oatmeal porridge  crock pot
steps:
1. Mix all 3 ingredients in a 3 1 / 2 quart slow cooker
2. Cover
3. Cook on low for 7 to 8 hours overnight

title: mexi itali casserole
steps:
1. Add tomato puree and black beans to double batch of recipe #217644 , perfectly seasoned taco meat
2. Simmer a few minutes and then remove from heat
3. In a large baking dish layer as follows: 1 / 2 portion of meat bean sauce , partially cooked pasta , 1 / 2 portion of meat bean sauce , 1 / 2 portion of green and jalapeno peppers , cheese , and top with remaining green and jalapeno peppers
4. Bake in 350 deg f oven for 40 minutes covered with foil
5. Remove foil and bake additional 5 minutes

title: beans and greens soup
steps:
1. Over med-high heat , saut the pancetta in the oil
2. Add the onions , garlic and red pepper flakes
3. Cook 3-4 minutes
4. Start wilting the greens into the pan
5. Adding a little at a time
6. Once all of the greens are in the pan , add the nutmeg and salt and pepper

title: wanted dead or alive  killer tex mex casserole
steps:
1. Saut all ingredients , except tortillas and cheese , over medium heat
2. Cut the tortillas into -inch by 2-inch portions
3. Spray an 11-inch by 7-inch heatproof casserole dish with non-stick cooking spray
4. Layer the tortillas to cover the bottom and then add half of the sauted ingredients

title: farmer s pie  vegetarian shepherd s pie
steps:

4. Vegetable base: in a large skillet combine red pepper , celery , onion , mushrooms and worcestershire sauce

title: pumpkin layer cheesecake
steps:
1. Mix together the cream cheese , sugar , and vanilla until well mixed

3. Separate one cup of the batter from the rest
4. Pour the rest of the batter into the crust

steps:
1. Bruise the root ginger with a rolling pin , then heat it with the cider and lemon peel in a small pan until the liquid begins to bubble

steps:
1. Combine struesel ingredients in a small bowl until blended

title: uncle bill s graham and vanilla wafer pie crust
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , combine graham wafer and vanilla cookie crumbs and almonds , mix well to combine
2. Cut in butter using a pastry blender or a fork until mixture is crumbly
3. Prepare a 9 inch oven-proof pie dish by spraying with some vegetable oil , then dust with flour , shake off any excess flour off the pie dish and discard

6. Press evenly to the bottom and sides using a rounded soup spoon

10. Bake for 15 minutes in a preheated 400 f oven to set the crust
11. Cool baked pie crust and continue with your pie filling mixture of your choice

title: toasty baked onion dip
steps:

title: imo s pizza recipe  st  louis style pizza
steps:
1. Crust: mix until thoroughly combined - dough will be very stiff
2. Makes enough for two 12" pizza pies
3. The dough is ready to use "as-is" no need to rise or kneed
4. Divide the dough in half , shape into a round ball and roll out paper thin
5. In order to move the crusts around a pizza peel sprinkled with cornmeal works well
6. After the crust , it's the sauce that begins the first real steps towards forming the total imo's pizza experience
7. Imos uses a tomato sauce mixture that has a sweet taste , but it's not so overly sweet to hide the rich tomato flavor or spices
8. Sauce:combine together and it's ready to use - do not pre-cook the sauce ! this makes enough sauce for about four 12" pizza pies , so that should give you some idea of how much to use on each pizza
9. On top of the sweet sauce imo's uses provel cheese , which is simply a blend of cheddar , swiss and provolone cheeses with some liquid smoke flavoring
10. If you can't find provel in your local market , it can be easily created
11. Cheese:toss until cheeses and smoke flavoring are completely incorporated
12. Typically it's enough cheese for two 12" pizza pies , but if you like extra-cheese you'll want to make more
13. Authentic imo's pizza toppings include: extra-cheese , onion , green pepper , sausage , hamburger , pepperoni , anchovy , bacon , black olive , mushroom , canadian bacon , jalapenos , pineapple , banana peppers , and tomatoes
14. In a professional pizza oven the meat toppings can usually be put on raw , but at home you'll want to fully precook the meat before assembling the pizza
15. Now you have the correct style crust , sweet sauce , smoky cheese , generous toppings , it's now ready to be lightly sprinkled with some italian seasonings
16. Seasonings: combine all the ingredients in a small mixing bowl and blend well
17. While in the restaurant the pizza is baked in a pizza pan , at home you'll have the best results using a pizza stone and an oven temperature around 450 degrees
18. If you don't have a pizza stone , use the thinnest baking sheet you have and the lowest over rack position
19. The pizza is done when the underside of the crust is a dark golden brown , and the cheese is has a slight golden tint to it
20. Underbaking the crust will result in a limp crust , overbaking will result in a hard , tough , burnt-tasting crust , getting the right baking time to produce a crisp crust will require a bit of experimentation
21. The amount and type of toppings you use will also affect the total baking time
22. A rule-of-thumb is to check the pizza after about 10-12 minutes and adjust baking time from there accordingly
23. And , as a final touch to truly replicate imo's pizza at home , is to cut the pizza into tile-like squares instead of the traditional triangle slices

title: chicken with indian spice yogurt
steps:

title: rack of lamb  with lemon rosemary baste
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 470 degrees
2. Combine lemon juice , rosemary , oregano , salt& pepper in a small bowl

5. Place rack of lamb , fat side up , in a roasting pan , uncovered , & roast in the middle of the oven for 15 minutes for medium-rare
6. You can test for doneness with a meat thermometer that should read 130 to 140
7. Remove from oven& transfer to a warm plate& allow to rest for 10 minutes before serving

title: easy  elegant chicken and sherry
steps:

steps:

5. Stir cereal into peanut putter butterscotch mixture

7. Spread evenly
8. Refrigerate about 30 minutes or until set before cutting

title: shih tzu tou   lion s head casserole
steps:
1. Cover mushrooms with boiling hot water in a small bowl and let stand 30 minutes , then squeeze excess water from mushrooms and reserve 1 cup mushroom-soaking liquid
2. Discard mushroom stems and cut caps into very thin slices
3. Meanwhile , mix together pork , scallions , water chestnuts , rice wine , sesame oil , sugar , 1 tablespoon ginger , 1 tablespoon soy sauce , and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt in a large bowl with your hands
4. Gather together pork mixture and throw against bottom or side of bowl 5 or 6 times to firm texture , then chill , covered , until ready to use
5. Remove and reserve 4 large cabbage leaves
6. Halve cabbage head lengthwise , then cut out and discard core
7. Cut cabbage leaves crosswise into 2 inch pieces
8. Heat wok over high heat until a drop of water evaporates instantly
9. Swirl 2 tablespoons oil to coat bottom and sides of wok , then stir-fry mushrooms , half of cabbage , and remaining tablespoon of ginger until cabbage begins to wilt , about 1 to 2 minutes
10. Add remaining cabbage and 3 / 4 teaspoon salt and stir-fry until all of cabbage has begun to wilt , about 3 minutes
11. Add reserved soaking liquid and continue stir-frying until cabbage is wilted , about 3 minutes
12. Transfer mixture to a 4 to 5 quart heavy pot , arranging evenly on bottom
13. Wipe wok clean with paper towels
14. Stir together cornstarch , pepper , and remaining soy sauce in a small bowl until smooth
15. Divide pork mixture into quarters , then coat your hands with some of cornstarch / soy sauce mixture
16. Form 4 large meatballs , transfering each as formed to a large plate and then recoating your hands
17. Heat wok over high heat until a drop of water evaporates instantly , then pour in remaining oil , enough to measure a scant 1 / 4 inch in wok
18. Reduce heat to moderately high and gently arrange meatballs in wok
19. Fry meatballs , turning gently until deep golden on all sides , about 5 minutes total
20. If meatballs stick , add a little more oil
21. Transfer with a slotted spoon to paper towels to drain , then arrange on top of cabbage in pot
22. Add broth , then cover meatballs completely with reserved 4 cabbage leaves
23. Bring liquid just to boil , then reduce heat and gently simmer , covered , 1 hour
24. Check frequently to make sure liquid is not boiling vigorously
25. Season broth with salt , then move large cabbage leaves around the edge of pot to resemble a lion's mane
26. Serve in individual shallow bowls over rice , if desired

title: king s hawaiian bread  copycat
steps:
1. Beat the eggs

3. Place 3 cups of flour in a large bowl
4. Stir in the egg mixture until well-combined
5. Sprinkle in the yeast , one packet at a time , and mix

9. Cover the bowl with a cloth and set in a warm place to rise for 1 hour

13. Place in greased and floured loaf pans or shape into rolls

title: make ahead turkey breast with herb stuffing  cooking light
steps:

4. Return to a boil
5. Reduce heat , and simmer for 1 1 / 2 hours or until turkey breast reaches 170
6. Carefully remove the turkey breast from stock
7. Cover the turkey breast , and refrigerate
8. Strain stock through a colander into a large bowl
9. Discard solids , and return stock to pot
10. Reduce heat , and continue to simmer stock until reduced to 2 quarts
11. Cover and chill stock for 8 hours
12. Skim solidified fat from surface of stock , if necessary
13. Preheat oven to 250
14. To prepare turkey , rub poached turkey breast with oil
15. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 teaspoon thyme , 1 / 4 teaspoon salt , 1 / 4 teaspoon garlic powder , and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper
16. Wrap the turkey in heavy-duty plastic wrap and foil
17. Bake at 250 for 2 hours or until thoroughly heated
18. To prepare the stuffing , melt 1 / 4 cup butter in a large dutch oven over medium-high heat
19. Add the diced onion and diced celery
20. Saut 3 minutes
21. Stir in bread cubes and the next 7 ingredients
22. Stir in 2 1 / 2 cups turkey stock
23. Place in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish

27. Stir in flour
28. Reduce heat , and cook 15 minutes or until lightly browned
29. Gradually add reserved 5 1 / 2 cups turkey stock , stirring with a whisk until blended
30. Bring to a boil
31. Reduce heat , and simmer until reduced to 3 cups
32. Uncover turkey
33. Remove turkey breast halves from bone
34. Slice turkey , and serve with stuffing and gravy

3. Add the flour , baking soda , and nutmeg and beat until smooth

4. Add to powdered sugar mixture and beat on low speed until combined

8. Softened butter to grease a 9x9-inch square baking pan
9. Spread evenly into baking pan and refrigerate until stiff
10. Once set , slice into 1x1-inch squares
11. Store refrigerated for up to two weeks or at room temperature for one week

title: cinnamon drop cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f and grease / flour 13 x 9 cake pan
2. Prepare cake mix according to package
3. Pour batter into prepared cake pan
4. Sprinkle , cinnamon & sugar mixture over the cake batter
5. With your stick of margarine~ cut up into 8 tablespoon
6. Drop margarine on top of cake batter ~ one in each corner & the other 4 in middle of cake
7. Bake according to cake directions
8. The margarine while baking will pull the cinnamon & sugar mixture down through the cake !

title: raisin pie
steps:
1. Melt margarine
2. Beat eggs
3. Add sugar , vinegar to the eggs
4. Then add margarine vanilla , salt and raisins
5. Pour into unbaked pie shell
6. Bake 1 hour at 350

title: un refried beans
steps:
1. In a large soup pot , saute the onions in the olive oil over medium-high heat until the onions are soft
2. Stir in the chili powder , cumin , salt , and cayenne powder , and continue sauteing for 1 minute or so - just until the spices are fragrant
3. Add the beans , oregano , and 1 to 2 cups water
4. Stir in the bouillon
5. Bring the mixture to a boil , then reduce the heat and allow to simmer , stirring occasionally and adding more water if needed to keep the beans from sticking to the bottom of the pan , until the beans are very soft - approximately 1 hour
6. Using a potato masher , mash the beans until most of them are mashed , and the texture is mostly smooth

title: sweet potato and black bean burrito
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350
2. Place the sweet potatoes in a medium saucepan with the salt and water to cover
3. Cover and bring to a boil , then simmer until tender , about 10 minutes
4. Drain and set aside
5. While the sweet potatoes are cooking , warm the oil in a medium skillet or saucepan and add the onions , garlic , and chile
6. Cover and cook on medium-low heat , stirring occasionally , until the onions are tender , about 7 minutes
7. Add the cumin and coriander and cook for 2 to 3 minutes longer , stirring frequently
8. Remove from the heat and set aside
9. In a food processor , combine the black beans , cilantro , lemon juice , salt , and cooked sweet potatoes and puree until smooth
10. Transfer the sweet potato mixture to a large mixing bowl and mix in the cooked onions and spices
11. Lightly oil a large baking dish
12. Spoon about 2 / 3 to 3 / 4 cup of the filling in the center of each tortilla , roll it up , and place it , seam side down , in the baking dish
13. Cover tightly with foil and bake for about 30 minutes , until piping hot
14. Serve topped with salsa

title: baked rosti potatoes
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f
2. Brush oil onto bottom and up sides of 13x9-inch baking dish
3. Combine all remaining ingredients except egg
4. Add egg
5. Mix lightly
6. Press onto bottom of baking dish
7. Bake 55 minute to 1 hour or until golden brown
8. Let stand 10 minute before cutting to serve

title: mom s curry chicken
steps:
1. Fry green peppers and onions in butter until tender
2. Stir in soup and water and bring to a boil
3. Add curry powder and simmer for 5 minutes
4. Add chicken and continue simmering until chicken is heated through

title: partridge pot roast
steps:
1. In a large frying pan melt the butter over moderate heat
2. When the foam subsides , add the onions and carrots and cook stirring occasionally , for 5 to 7 minutes , or until the onions are soft and translucent , but not brown
3. Using a slotted spoon , transfer the vegetables to a large flameproof casserole
4. Set aside
5. Add the bacon and mushrooms to the pan and cook , stirring frequently , for 5 minutes , or until the bacon is crisp and has rendered most of its fat
6. With a slotted spoon , transfer the bacon mixture to the casserole
7. Place the partridges in the pan and cook , turning them occasionally , for 6 to 8 minutes , or until they are lightly and evenly browned
8. Remove the pan from the heat and transfer the partridges to the casserole
9. Add the salt , pepper and bouquet garni
10. Pour the beef stock and red wine over the partridges
11. Place the casserole over high heat and bring the liquid to the boil
12. Reduce the heat to low , cover the casserole and cook , stirring occasionally , for 1 hour , or until the partridges are tender when pierced with the point of a sharp knife
13. Remove the casserole from the heat
14. Using tongs or two large spoons , remove the partridges from the casserole
15. Cut each partridge into 4 pieces , and keep warm
16. Strain the cooking liquid and set the vegetables aside to keep warm
17. Remove and discard the bouquet garni
18. Return the strained cooking liquid to the casserole
19. Return the casserole to high heat and boil , stirring occasionally , for 5 to 7 minutes , or until the cooking liquid has reduced by about one-third
20. Reduce the heat to low
21. Gradually stir in the beurre manie , a small knob at a time and continue cooking , whisking constantly , for 2 to 3 minutes , or until the sauce is smooth and has thickened
22. To make beurre manie: mix together equal amounts of softened butter and flour replace the partridges and vegetables in the casserole and stir in the chopped parsley
23. Cook for a further 2 to 3 minutes or until the pot roast is piping hot
24. Remove the casserole from the heat and serve immediately

title: veal amaretto
steps:
1. Start by setting the butter in a shallow saut pan over med-high heat
2. Set the flour on a plate
3. Take the veal cuts and set them in the flour and put a thin coat over each side
4. Place the veal into the pan to saut
5. You want to lightly brown the bottom of the veal , don't let it get too dark
6. Turn the veal in the pan
7. Then add the sliced strawberries , arranging them so they are touching the pan , not on top of the veal because they won't cook properly
8. Once the other side of the veal is brown and the strawberries begin to get soft , add the amaretto slowly to the pan
9. Be careful , it could flame up , but it won't be hot enough to burn you
10. Let the alcohol catch , it will take most of the bitterness out and leave the sweet taste of the amaretto for your sauce
11. Once the flame dies out , add your heavy cream and cinnamon and stir
12. Reduce heat to medium and let the sauce thicken for about a minute or two
13. While the sauce is thickening , take your two whole strawberries and , using a paring knife , slice them a quarter inch from the green down and all the way across leaving about 5 to 6 slices
14. You want the green stem to stay attached to hold your slices together
15. Lay the strawberry on it's side and press on the stem with your finger
16. It should fan out evenly leaving a beautiful garnish
17. Arrange the veal on two plates and pour the sauce over top
18. Garnish with the fanned strawberries , either on top of the veal or alongside
19. You can also use freshly chopped parsley and sprinkle it around the outside of the plate , or a sprig of mint leaf , to add color to the dish

title: pork chops with cranberry horseradish sauce
steps:
1. Combine the cranberry horseradish sauce , chili sauce , sugar mustard , garlic powder and onion powder
2. Set aside
3. Put the flour , salt , and pepper in a bag
4. Heat a large covered skillet , add the oil
5. Shake pork cutlets in the bag with flour , one at a time , and add to the skillet
6. Brown pork on both sides , 2-3 minutes
7. Add the sauce from step one and coat the pork with it
8. Cover and cook on med-low for 10 minutes
9. I served with white rice and carrots

title: glazed wings
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Arrange chicken wings in single layer on greased foil-lined baking sheet
3. Bake in oven for 30 minutes
4. Measure remaining 5 ingredients into a small saucepan
5. Heat and stir on medium-low until simmering
6. Remove wings from oven and brush with the sauce
7. Bake for 15 to 20 additional minutes , turning and brushing with sauce 2 or 3 times , until tender and no longer pink inside

title: peanut better gingersnap cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f spray a large cookie sheet with cooking spray and set aside
2. In a medium bowl , stir together both flours , baking soda , 1 tsp cinnamon , ginger , allspice and salt
3. Set aside
4. Combine granulated sugar and remaining 1 tsp cinnamon in a small bowl
5. Set aside
6. In another medium bowl , beat together brown sugar , peanut butter and butter on medium speed of electric mixer for about 1 minute
7. Add molasses , egg and vanilla
8. Beat again until smooth
9. Using a wooden spoon , stir flour mixture into peanut butter mixture
10. You will be making a stiff dough
11. Using your hands , shape dough into 1 1 / 2-inch balls
12. Roll balls in reserved cinnamon-sugar mixture
13. Place on cookie sheet at least 2 inches apart
14. Flatten cookies slightly using a fork
15. Bake cookies for 7 minutes
16. They may appear undercooked , but thats okay
17. Remove cookies from oven and immediately transfer from pan to a wire rack to cool

title: chicken casserole ii
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , mix all ingredients together
2. Pour into a greased 9x13 baking pan
3. Cover with a lid or aluminum foil and refrigerate for at least 8 hours , so macaroni can absorb liquids
4. Bake , uncovered for one hour at 350 degrees (or until heated throughly

title: savory french toast
steps:
1. In a large , shallow bowl crack eggs and add milk as desired to create enough egg mixture to saturate 8 pieces of texas toast
2. Whip the mixture with a fork until combined
3. Heat a griddle or frying pan to medium high heat
4. Soak 1 or 2 pieces of toast fully with egg mixture , flipping in the bowl to fully saturate each piece
5. Meanwhile melt approx 1 tsp of butter in the spot of each piece of toast , as soon as it melts place piece of toast in the spot
6. Watch toast carefully and when the down side is getting brown , flip the toast to cook opposite side , it shouldn't take very long if your pan is hot
7. Once both pieces are fully cooked and browned transfer to a plate and serve , two pieces topped with about a tbsp of soft butter , serve with syrup or jam as desired , i like mine with just the butter
8. Repeat steps 3 on until all toast is cooked

title: garlic and lemon vinaigrette
steps:
1. Add the vinegar , garlic , lemon juice , zest , salt and pepper to a food processor bowl
2. With the processor running , slowly drizzle in the oil
3. Serve immediately or place in a glass container and refrigerate

title: yummy beans n  greens in a bowl  kale soup
steps:
1. Heat a dutch oven and spray with cooking spray
2. Add olive oil and then the onion and garlic
3. Saute just until it begins to soften , add chicken broth and allow to continue cooking while you begin the next steps
4. Wash whatever greens you choose to use and remove any hard stalks
5. Stack the leaves one on top of the other , roll like a cigar and slice into 1 / 4 inch slices , then cut the pieces in half
6. This will give you nice ribbons that are not too wide or long
7. Add greens , sugar and nutmeg to the pan
8. Stir to combine
9. Rinse and drain beans and add to pan
10. Stir gently
11. Simmer for 20 minutes or until greens are al dente or as soft as you would like
12. Toss in spinach just to wilt
13. Ladle each serving into a bowl and top with a generous sprinkling of freshly grated parmesan cheese and additional cracked pepper if desired
14. Crusty bread is also a great accompaniment for all the yummy broth that is swimming in the bowl
15. Enjoy !

title: garlic cheese noodles
steps:
1. Put milk and garlic in a saute pan
2. Cook on medium for 2 minutes
3. Add the cheese and cook 5 minutes , or until
4. The cheese is melted
5. Add the butter and let it melt
6. Put in the noodles
7. Enjoy !

title: fake  n bake oven ranch chicken
steps:
1. Place cleaned and dried chicken pieces in a large flat glass dish , dredge each piece in the ranch dressing , cover dish with plastic wrap and marinate in the fridge for 30-45 minutes
2. Meanwhile , preheat oven to 450
3. Coat 9 x 13 inch baking sheet with pam
4. Mix potato flakes , paprika , parsley flakes and garlic powder in a flat dish
5. Remove marinated chicken pieces from ranch marinade , then roll in potato flake mixture , coating thoroughly
6. Arrange on baking sheet , then salt and pepper to taste
7. Important: turn down oven to 350
8. Bake approximately 35-45 minutes , or until the juices run clear when chicken pieces are pierced with a fork and the crust looks golden brown

title: saucy stuffed manicotti
steps:
1. Cook manicotti to desired doneness
2. In large skillet brown sausage , onion and mushrooms
3. Drain on paper towel
4. In large bowl , combine sausage mixture , egg yolks , turkey , spinach , mozzarella and 1 / 2 cup parmesan cheese
5. Mix well
6. Pour half of spaghetti sauce into ungreased 13x9 baking dish
7. Fill manicotti with sausage mixture
8. Place over sauce in baking dish
9. Melt butter in medium saucepan over medium heat
10. Stir in flour cook until smooth and bubbly
11. Gradually stir in whipping cream , cook until slightly thickened , stirring constantly
12. Stir in parmesan cheese , garlic powder and nutmeg , blend well
13. Pour white sauce over manicotti
14. Pour remaining spaghetti sauce over top
15. Bake at 350f for 35-40 minutes

title: hamburger potpie with homemade crust
steps:
1. Flaky crust:
2. In the bowl of your stand mixer add the flour , sugar and salt
3. Do not scoop the flour to measure because this will pack it and result in to much flour
4. Stir flour to loosen and spoon into a measuring cup
5. Level off with the back of a knife
6. Put this in the freezer
7. In a separate bowl cube the butter and put in the refrigerator to keep ice cold
8. Measure your water and put it in the freezer to get ice cold
9. Do not freeze
10. The key to a flaky crust is keeping the ingredients cold and not over mixing
11. Using the paddle attachment on low speed mix your flour mixture just to incorporate
12. Add the cold butter and mix on medium low speed until your mixture is sandy looking with some chunks of butter left
13. It will resemble sand that's drying out with the chunks of butter throughout
14. With the mixer off add 1 / 2 cup of the cold water and mix on low
15. Add remaining water 1 tablespoon at a time until the mixture is crumbly and still some chunks of butter
16. You may not need the entire cup of water so stop adding and mixing when you can form a crumbly dough in your hand
17. Lightly flour your work surface
18. I use a pastry mat that has pie measurements on it but it's not required
19. Dump your crumbly dough pieces onto your floured surface and bring pieces together by patting them down , not kneading
20. Flatten the mixture with your hands and fold
21. Do this a few times until you have a solid dough with some chunks of butter throughout
22. Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour
23. While your dough is resting start on the filling
24. Hamburger filling:
25. In a large skillet brown hamburger meat until no pink is left and drain
26. Peel the potatoes , dice them into small chunks and put them in a bowl with cold water
27. Rinse potatoes well to remove the extra starchyness and boil
28. Do not cook them all the way because you dont want mashed potatoes
29. You want them to stay in small chunks , so remove them and drain right before they are fully cooked
30. They will finish cooking in the oven
31. Put them in a bowl and place in the refrigerator so they stay firm and stop cooking
32. Next chop the onion and celery and mince the garlic
33. In your skillet with a little butter sautee the onion and celery until translucent
34. Add the matchstick carrots and sautee about 2 more minutes , then add the garlic and sautee on low about 3 more minutes
35. In the same skillet with the onion mixture add the cooked hamburger meat and combine
36. Add the soup mix , water , salt , pepper and garlic powder and stir
37. I use lipton recipe secrets , beefy onion soup mix
38. The box contains 2 envelope and i add both to the meat mixture
39. Once this is all combined remove from heat and add your potatoes and lightly stir
40. You can leave this in the skillet until ready to use or put it in a bowl , as long as it cools down
41. Rolling your pie crust:
42. Remove dough from the refrigerator and remove plastic wrap
43. Cut dough in half with a bench scraper or knife
44. Starting with 1 half , on a lightly floured surface roll your dough
45. Roll dough away from you and turn it to roll in another direction
46. Do not continue to roll by turning your body
47. Roll and turn dough , this will keep it from sticking to your work surface
48. Continue rolling until the dough is big enough for a 9 inch deep dish pie pan , so about 11 inches
49. Repeat this step with the other half of your dough
50. Assembling your potpie:
51. Lightly spray a 9 inch deep dish pie pan with cooking spray
52. Lay half of your pie crust in the pie dish and lightly form crust to dish with your hands
53. You will have some over hanging and that's what you want
54. Add your meat filling to the pie dish then carefully place the top crust over the filling
55. Cut off extra dough if any by leaving about 1 / 4 inch overhang
56. This will give you a nice thick , buttery outer crust
57. Using your fingers , gently fold top crust over bottom crust to seal the pie
58. Make sure it is sealed all the way around your dish to prevent the filling from bursting out
59. Once it is completely sealed you can flute the edges with a fork or use your fingers to flute
60. Since i make a thick outer crust for this pie i like to use my fingers instead
61. Using your index finger press against the pie edge and use your thumb and index finger on the other hand to push the dough up around your index finger on the other hand
62. Do this around the entire edge of your pie to form a bigger flute for thick crust
63. Cut 4 small slits in the top of the dough to allow steam to escape during cooking to prevent the pie from bursting out of the sides
64. Place the pie in your freezer for about 20 minutes prior to cooking
65. This will keep your pie crust flaky and soft
66. Cooking your potpie:
67. With your oven rack on the bottom position closest to the burner preheat your oven to 350f
68. Beat 2 eggs in a small bowl
69. Remove your pie from the freezer and brush the entire top crust with the egg wash with a basting brush
70. Bake on bottom rack just until top crust starts to slightly brown
71. Turn oven up to 375f and move oven rack to middle position
72. Finish baking pie on middle rack until top crust is done and golden brown
73. Remove from oven and let cool about 10 minutes , slice and enjoy !

title: brown butter green beans in the microwave
steps:
1. Microwave butter in a 2-cup glass measuring cup at high 1 1 / 2 to 2 minutes or until butter is brownish in color
2. Remove from microwave , and immediately add minced garlic
3. Place green beans , onion , and 3 t water in a microwave safe bowl
4. Cover bowl tightly with plastic wrap , folding back a small edge to allow steam to escape
5. Microwvae on high 4 to 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender
6. Drain
7. Toss together hot beans and sliced onion , brown butter mixture and salt
8. Sprinkle with freshly ground black pepper and for extra kick -- crushed red pepper flakes

title: holiday every day berry fruit salad
steps:
1. Wash and drain all the fruit separately - pat dry if needed
2. Stir the yogurt and cool whip together thoroughly
3. In an appropriate size tall glass bowl , start with a layer of the yogurt mixture , then alternate layers of the fruit and yogurt , making sure the colorful fruit is visible along the edges
4. End up with a layer of yogurt
5. Sprinkle the coconut on top like snow , then sprinkle the almonds over the coconut
6. Add a few berries on top , if desired
7. Refrigerate until serving time
8. You're done

title: sea bass with sicilian pepper sauce
steps:
1. For pepper sauce: heat large saute pan to med high
2. Add oil
3. Add all peppers , onion , and garlic
4. Saute until translucent
5. Add prosciutto , tomato paste , tomato sauce , salt and pepper
6. Simmer for 30 minutes to 1 hour
7. Stir in sugar and vinegar , adjust salt and pepper to taste
8. Heat oven to 400 degrees and heat oil in saute pan on high
9. Season fish on both sides with salt and pepper
10. Sear fish on one side only when is golden brown place saute pan in oven for 5-8 minutes until fish flakes , but still moist
11. Serve fish with sauce over it and enjoy with a glass of pinot grigio

title: hearty hamburger stew
steps:
1. Add oil to large dutch oven type dish
2. Brown the ground meat until cooked through
3. Add onions , celery , and carrots
4. You can add other vegetables to this dish , but these are the main ones that i remember from the original recipe
5. Cook until the vegetables get nicely carmelized
6. Add remaining ingredients
7. Simmer for about an hour
8. We've rushed this and it's still good , but the longer it simmers the richer the flavor
9. This tastes good with nice , fresh cornbread
10. I've even made cheddar-dill bisquick drop muffins as well
11. Crusty bread would work great too !

title: chicken roni casserole
steps:
1. Cook& drain macaroni
2. Combine with all other ingredients except bread crumbs
3. Put into 1 1 / 2 quart casserole
4. Top with bread crumbs and dot with butter
5. Bake at 350 for 35 minutes

title: diabetic pumpkin cream cheese squares
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees
2. Grease a 9x13 pan
3. For the filling , whisk together cream cheese , splenda and egg until well blended
4. Set aside
5. For the batter , combine the pumpkin , splenda , egg , and oil
6. Mix well
7. Stir in flour , cinnamon , nutmeg , and ginger
8. Pour into prepared pan
9. Drizzle cream cheese mixture over batter
10. Cut through batter with knife several times for a marbled effect
11. Bake 25-30 minutes or until a tester inserted into the center comes out clean
12. Cool
13. Cut into squares

title: kittencal s extra crispy fried chicken breast
steps:
1. In a large resealable bag place the crushed cracker crumbs with the next 7 dry ingredients
2. Mix well to combine
3. Place the egg in a shallow dish
4. Heat oil in a heavy skillet over medium-high heat , using enough oil to generously cover the bottom of the skillet
5. Dredge the chicken breasts one at a time into the egg allowing any excess egg to drip off
6. Place the breast into the bag and shake to coat with the crumb mixture
7. Place the coated breasts onto a plate
8. Reduce the heat to medium
9. Cook the breasts in the skillet for 12-15 minutes turning frequently until golden brown and cooked through

title: yummy  spicy black beans and rice
steps:
1. Heat oil in large skillet over med-high heat
2. Add onions and peppers and saute until onions are soft and translucent
3. Add garlic , cumin , chili powder , cayenne pepper , oregano , salt , tomato paste
4. Cook for about 2 minutes , or until fragrant
5. Add black beans , mix to combine
6. Add chicken broth
7. Bring to a boil , then lower heat and simmer about 20 minutes or until most of liquid has been absorbed
8. Serve over rice topped with a dollop of low-fat sour cream , shredded cheddar cheese , and chopped green onions
9. Yum !

title: hearts of palm and chickpea salad
steps:
1. Toss together all salad ingredients
2. Whisk dressing ingredients in a small bowl
3. Toss vegetables with dressing until thoroughly combined

title: crock pot venison in beer
steps:
1. Place venison roast in large bowl
2. Pour 1 pint of beer over roast
3. Place bowl with roast and beer in refrigerator to marinate for one day
4. Next day , remove roast from marinade and place in crock pot
5. Add sliced carrots , leeks and sprinkle with italian herb seasoning
6. Pour 3 / 4 cup beer into crock pot , over roast and carrots
7. Cover and turn crock pot on low
8. Let cook on low for at least 8 hours
9. Remove roast and carrots from crock pot and serve

title: too sick to cook cheese sandwich
steps:
1. Toast the bread
2. When it comes out , butter each piece on one side
3. Put cheese on one of the buttered slices , with butter on the inside
4. Top with the other buttered slice
5. Again with the butter on the inside
6. Microwave for 15 seconds until cheese is melted

title: tomato   spinach pasta toss
steps:
1. Cook past as directed
2. Meanwhile , crumble meat into large deep skillet
3. Cook on med-high until cooked through , stirring occasionally , drain
4. Add spinach , and tomatoes
5. Cook for 2 minutes , or until spinach is wilted , stirring occasionally
6. Remove from heat , cover to keep warm
7. Drain pasta and place in a large serving bowl
8. Add meat mixture , then top with cheeses , mix lightly

title: bubblegum infused vodka drinks
steps:
1. To make bubblegum infused vodka:
2. Quarter the 16 pieces of bubblegum and place them in a sealable glass jar
3. Add the 2 cups of vodka and seal and place in a cupboard
4. Stir every 4 hrs for the next 24 hrs
5. After 24 hrs strain through a paper coffee filter into a clean pretty jar
6. Enjoy !
7. Drinks:
8. Russian bubblegum :
9. 1 oz bubblegum vodka
10. 1oz kahlua
11. 3 oz's milk
12. Ice cubes
13. Mix and enjoy
14. Bazooka frosty:
15. 1 oz bubblegum vodka
16. 1 1 / 2 oz godiva white chocolate liqueur
17. 4 oz milk
18. Hard bubblegum lemonade
19. 1 cup crushed ice
20. Put everything in a blender and whizz till smooth
21. Hard bubblegun lemonade:
22. 1 1 / 2 oz bubblegum vodka
23. 3 oz pink lemonade concentrate
24. 6 ice cubes
25. 6 oz club soda
26. Mix in a tall glass and garnish with a lemon slice or wedge and 2 yellow straws

title: linny s breakfast potatoes
steps:
1. Over medium-high heat melt olive oil & butter in large non-stick skillet
2. Add potatoes , bacon , peppers & onions
3. After about 3 minutes add basil , hot sauce , italian seasoning , red pepper , salt & pepper
4. Saute until potatoes are beginning to brown
5. Turn off heat and add cheeses
6. Stir again after cheese is melted and serve

title: heart healthy harvest pancakes
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together in a medium bowl
2. Preheat skillet to med-high heat
3. As long as your skillet is preheated properly you should not need to add any fat to the pan
4. Using a small ladle , ladle mix into skillet and let cook 4-5 minutes per side , until golden brown
5. Enjoy topped with maple syrup , or for a healthier version , you can top with warmed cinnamon applesauce

title: toasted pasta
steps:
1. Pan-fry the coils in oil until golden brown , remove from pan and set aside
2. In original pan bring tomatoes , water and salt to a boil
3. Return pasta to pan with boiling tomatoes
4. Simmer , semi covered , for about 10 minutes
5. Stir occasionally with a fork to separate coils and keep noodles from sticking
6. Liquid should be absorbed and pasta tender
7. Remove from heat , cover and let sit 10 minutes before serving

title: glazed honey bars
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f lightly grease an 8x8x2-inch pan
2. In a mixing bowl , beat the oil , honey , granulated sugar , and egg until well blended
3. Stir the cinnamon into the flour , then stir this into the egg mixture and mix well
4. Stir in the nuts
5. Spread the batter in the prepared pan and bake for 25-30 minutes
6. Remove from oven and let stand while you make the glaze
7. In a bowl , stir together the confectioners' sugar , mayonnaise , milk and vanilla
8. Pour the glaze over the cake and spread it with a metal spatula
9. Let cool , then cut into bars

title: turkey and barley chowder  crock pot
steps:
1. In a dry skillet over medium heat , toast the cumin seed , stirring until fragrant and they start to brown
2. Transfer them to a mortar and grind seeds
3. Set aside
4. In the same skillet heat oil over medium heat and then add onions and cook until softened
5. Add garlic , oregano , peppercorns , celery seed , chili powder and reserved cumin and cook for another minute
6. Transfer to crock pot
7. Add chicken broth to crock pot
8. Add barley , turkey and corn to crock pot , stir to combine
9. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours
10. Stir in green pepper and chili pepper and cook for high for 20-30 minutes
11. Spoon into bowls and garnish with cilantro if desired

title: easy bake oven tropical punch cake mix
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine sugar , flour , baking soda , salt and drink powder
2. Stir with a wire whisk until blended
3. With a pastry blender , cut in shortening until evenly distributed and mixture resembles corn meal
4. Spoon about 1 / 3 cup mixture into each of 10 small containers or ziploc bags
5. Seal bags tightly
6. Label with date and contents
7. Store in a cool dry place
8. Use within 12 weeks
9. Makes 10 packages cake mix
10. ----------------------------
11. To use:
12. 1 pkg
13. Children's tropical punch cake mix
14. 4 teaspoons water
15. Preheat oven for 15 minutes
16. Grease and flour a 4 inch miniature cake pan
17. In a small bowl , combine cake mix and water
18. Stir with a fork or spoon until blended and smooth
19. Pour mixture into prepared pan
20. Bake 12 to 13 minutes in play oven
21. Remove from oven
22. Cool in pan on rack for 5 minutes
23. Invert cake onto a small plate
24. Remove pan
25. When cool , frost with children's white frosting if desired

title: easy crock pot shrimp creole
steps:
1. Preheat crock pot on high
