2. In fry pan , heat olive oil
3. Add peppers , onions and celery
4. Cook until softened
5. Add chili powder and saute until caramelized
6. Remove from heat and pour into crock pot
7. Add tomatoes , tomato sauce , hot sauce , worcestershire , white sugar , salt and pepper
8. Cook for 3 hours
9. Add shrimp and cook for about 3 minutes
10. Serve over rice
11. Top with chopped green onions

title: chicken hearts
steps:
1. Marinate : combine the garlic , olive oil , and salt / pepper in a bag and add the chicken hearts
2. Marinate for 2-3 hours
3. Saute the leek or onion and additional garlic and ginger in olive oil until soft
4. Add the chicken hearts and saute over medium heat until done , stirring occasionally
5. Alternatively , saute chicken hearts halfway and finish in the broiler
6. Can also be cooked on skewers on the grill
7. Be sure to soak the skewers in water first
8. Time does not include optional marination time

title: potato  leek and onion soup
steps:
1. Trim off tops and roots of leeks , discard tough outer layer
2. Split lengthways and chop finely , wash and drain
3. In a large saucepan , gently melt the butter
4. Add the leeks , potatoes and onion
5. Stir to coat the veggies well in the butter
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Cover pan and let vegetables sweat over very low heat for about 15 minutes or so
8. Then add the chicken stock and milk , bring to simmer and leave simmering gently for further 20 minutes or until veggies are soft
9. Then either liquidize or puree in a food processor or blender
10. Return to pan and reheat gently , check seasoning as required
11. Stir in chives
12. Add a swirl of cream just before serving

title: mashed potatoes with cucumber
steps:
1. Mash cooked potatoes with butter , 2 tbsp milk and sour cream
2. Add salt and pepper
3. In a small bowl , combine cucumber , onion , 2 tablespoons milk , vinegar and sugar
4. Stir into mashed potatoes
5. Serve immediately

title: tex mex cheese fondue
steps:
1. Place both cheese in a large bowl and add flour , toss
2. Rub inside of fondue pot with garlic
3. Discard garlic
4. Add wine and tequila to pot and warm over medium heat until tiny bubbles appear
5. Add one handful of cheese mixture to wine mixture and stir constantly until cheese melts
6. Adjust heat so mixture does not boil
7. Repeat with remaining cheese
8. Stirring until thick
9. Stir in cilantro and chilies and season with salt and pepper
10. Set pot over candles or sterno on serving table
11. Serve with skewers of bread cubes , sausages and / or vegetables
12. Serve with tortilla chips if desired

title: veal osso buco
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Preheat a dutch cast iron oven over medium heat
3. Season the veal shank liberally with salt and pepper
4. Add the diced pancetta to the preheated pan , and cook , stirring occasionally
5. When the pancetta is crispy and most of the fat has rendered , remove the pancetta to a plate covered with some paper towel
6. If necessary , drain off all but two tablespoons of the fat from the pan add olive oil
7. Dredge the veal shanks through some flour , shake off any excess and add the meat to the hot fat in the pan
8. Turn the heat under the dutch oven to medium high and cook the meat on each side until well browned
9. Remove the shanks to a plate
10. Add the mirepoix to the dutch oven
11. Cook the mirepoix , until the onions are translucent and toss in the garlic , thyme , capers , olives and anchovies
12. Continue cooking until the vegetables just begin to brown
13. Add the pancetta & shanks back to the pan
14. Pour in the wine , and then add enough stock or broth to come about half way up the side of the shanks
15. Cover the pan and put it in the oven to cook until the meat is as tender
16. The more braising time , the more tender the meat
17. It should take at least 2 hours , at which point you'll have a fine dish
18. More time is better , but make sure to add more wine if needed
19. Optional: remove meat and cover add the slurry to the liquid stir in completely and cook 5 more minutes stove top till thickened
20. Top with gremolata

title: orange honey vinaigrette
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a small bowl
2. Blend with a wire whisk
3. Can be stored in the refrigerator for up to one week

title: malted milk chocolate chip cookies   wow
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , combine the first five ingredients
2. Beat for two minutes
3. Add egg
4. Combine the flour , baking soda and salt
5. Gradually add to creamed mixture , mixing well after each addition
6. Stir in chocolate chips& chunks
7. Shape into 2" balls
8. Place 3" apart on ungreased cookie sheets
9. Bake at 375 for 12-14 minutes or until golden brown
10. Cool for 2 minutes on the tray before removing to wire racks

title: cuban garlic salad dressing
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients throughly with wire whisk
2. Serve at room temperature

title: garlic chicken n gravy
steps:
1. Melt butter in skillet
2. Add garlic & chicken seasoned with salt & pepper
3. Cook over medium-high heat until browned
4. Add 1 / 2 c broth , wine , basil and oregano
5. Bring to boil , cover & simmer until chicken is no longer pink
6. Remove chicken from pan & keep warm
7. In small bowl combine 2 tbsp chicken broth & 1 tbsp flour until smooth
8. Add to pan juices
9. Bring to boil , cook & stir until thickened
10. Serve over chicken

title: garbanzo hot pot
steps:
1. Saute onion in butter until soft
2. Stir in rest of ingredients
3. Cook , uncovered , 15 minutes
4. Remove bay leaf and serve

title: proper bloke s sausage pasta
steps:
1. Bash the fennel seeds and chiles in a flavor shaker , pestle and mortar , or a spice grinder until coarsely crushed
2. Set aside
3. Heat 2 tb good olive oil in a pan over medium high heat
4. Put the sausage filling in the pan , breaking it up
5. Fry for a few minutes until the meat starts to color and the fat starts to render out of it , then break it up again until it resembles coarse ground beef
6. Add the bashed up fennel and chiles , and cook over medium high heat for about ten minutes , until the meat becomes crisp , golden brown , and slightly caramelized
7. Stir in the oregano , then add the white wine and stir until it is reduced by half
8. Add the lemon zest and juice
9. Turn down to low while you cook your noodles al dente
10. When pasta is al dente , drain it in a colander , keeping 1 / 2 cup of the pasta water aside
11. Toss the pasta with the meat in the pan until coated , add the butter , parmesan , fresh thyme and spoonfuls of the reserved pasta water until you have a lovely , shiny , loose sauce
12. Check for seasoning and top with parmesan , server immediately

title: mexican chicken enchiladas  restaurant style
steps:
1. Place thawed chicken into a 7-10 qt pot
2. Pour fresh water into pot until the water covers all the chicken + 6 inches more of water
3. Place pot on burner
4. Put in the 5 bay leaves , 3 tbsp garlic , 1 / 2 of a onion , 2 1 / 2 tsp salt , 1 tbsp red pepper flakes
5. Boil on medium-high for 1 hour 20 min or until chicken falls off bone easily
6. Once chicken is cooked , place into a very large bowl
7. Place in fridge for 20 min to cool down for easy handling
8. While cooling down , drain half the broth and boil the rest uncovered
9. Take chicken out of fridge , begin shredding apart each piece by hand , discarding fat , bones , and knuckles
10. Make sure you have discarded all of the bones and knuckles
11. Add the lettuce , 2 whole chopped onions , 1 1 / 2 c pepper jack and 1 1 / 2 c colby jack cheese , powdered garlic , pepper , salt , chili powder , 1 can olives
12. Mix until well incorperated
13. Set aside
14. Spray lightly 3 13x9 inch pans with cooking spray
15. Pour in all enchilada sauce into pot with boiled broth , mix , turn down heat to medium-low
16. Get another person to assist you
17. Place and single corn tortilla on a wide spatula , place lightly into sauce , leave in no more than 5 seconds
18. Place tortilla into greased pan , fill with 1 / 4 c chicken mixture , roll up as tightly as you can without tearing
19. Repeat process until all tortillas and pans are used
20. Make sure each enchilada is place tightly , and close to eachother
21. Pour remaining sauce , cheese , and olives all over prepared enchiladas , cover with tin foil
22. Place in oven at 350 f for 35 min , broil hi the last 5 minutes uncovered
23. Cool , uncovered for 10 minutes
24. Serve with sour cream , salsa , green onions

title: pressure cooker pozole
steps:
1. Set your salted water on to boil in your pressure cooker pot so it can be heating up while you prep your ingredients
2. Cut the pork into bite-size cubes and add to the water in the pressure cooker
3. Be sure to include any bone from the roast
4. Add the bay leaves , then put the lid on and bring up to pressure per your cooker's instructions
5. Once the cooker is up to pressure , turn the heat down a bit until the stopper is rocking gently and set your timer for 10 minutes
6. During all that waiting time , chop your onion , drain and rinse your hominy , open your cans of green chillies , and measure out your seasonings
7. Read a book
8. Watch a video on youtube
9. Finish tidying up and set the table
10. Whatever you like , just don't get out of earshot of the cooker's hiss
11. You want a nice gentle rocking
12. After ten minutes at pressure , take your pressure cooker off the heat , douse it under cold water in your sink until the pressure is released , and open the pot
13. Add the remaining ingredients , being careful not to fill above the max fill line on your cooker
14. Stir , put the lid back on , and bring back up to pressure , and again cook at gently-rocking pressure 7 minutes
15. After 7 minutes at pressure , douse cooker under cold water in your sink until the pressure is released , stir , and adjust any seasonings for taste
16. Serve with a sprinkling of fresh cilantro , and garnish with pico de gallo , avocado slices , and lime wedges
17. Yum !

title: breaded oysters
steps:
1. Whisk water and eggs in bowl until light in colour
2. Mix bread crumbs salt and pepper in a flat dish
3. Place oysters on 6 paper towels and then pat dry with another 6 paper towels
4. Line a cookie tray with wax paper and make room in your freezer for the tray to sit level
5. Dip oysters in egg and then dredge in the bread crumb mixture
6. Set oysters on cookie tray and freeze
7. Move frozen oysters to a sealable container and keep in freezer
8. When you want a pan fried oyster , heat a frying pan with a tight fitting lid to medium heat and add 2 tbsp margarine
9. Take out as many as you want , place in the pan and let brown for 3 minute flip the oysters , turn up the heat to high , pour in 2 tbsp water and cover with the lid
10. Fry for 4 minute take off the lid their should be a cloud of steam when you take off the lid
11. The oysters will now be soft
12. Cook for another 3 min on each side
13. Serve with tartar sauce and lemons

title: roaring fork tomato salad
steps:
1. Puree ricotta , garlic , and spices
2. Mix in minced basil leaves
3. Cover and refrigerate overnight
4. Line platter with lettuce leaves
5. Overlap tomato slices around platter , leaving space in the middle
6. Spoon ricotta mixture into center of platter
7. Garnish with whole basil leaves

title: dad s famous lasagna
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Cook noodles
3. Saut onions and garlic
4. Add sausage and hamburger to onions and garlic
5. Cook thoroughly
6. Add tomatoes , paste , and basil to sausage mixture
7. Stir to blend
8. Salt to taste
9. Simmer 5-10 minutes
10. In a separate bowl , lightly beat eggs
11. Blend cottage and parmesan into eggs
12. Add pepper and blend thoroughly
13. In a 9 x 14 lasagna pan , lightly oil bottom with olive oil
14. Layer 1 / 2 noodles , 1 / 2 cheese sauce , 1 / 2 mozzarella cheese , and 1 / 2 tomato sauce
15. Repeat ending with tomato sauce
16. Sprinkle parmesan cheese on top
17. Bake for 30-40 minutes
18. If previously refrigerated , bake 50-60 minutes

title: lemon ice sherbet  in ice cream maker
steps:
1. Stir everything together
2. Pour into ice cream maker and prepare according to ice cream maker directions
3. Variation: substitute orange juice or lime juice for lemon

title: tuna artichoke melts
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine the tuna , artichokes , mayonnaise , 1 / 4 cup cheese , lemon-pepper , and oregano
2. Spread over english muffin halves
3. Place on a baking sheet
4. Broil 4-6 inches from the heat for 3-5 minutes or until heated through
5. Sprinkle with remaining cheese
6. Broil 1-2 minutes longer or until cheese is melted

title: grandma s southern fried chicken
steps:
1. Wash chicken pieces and place in a deep bowl
2. Cover with buttermilk and hot sauce , and refrigerate at least 2 hours
3. Melt shortening in a cast iron skillet to a depth of about 1 inch
4. Heat to about 370
5. If it starts to smoke , turn it down immediately a bit
6. In a doubled brown paper lunch sack , mix together all of the dry ingredients
7. Remove chicken from bowl
8. Using additional seasoned salt and pepper , lightly coat to season chicken
9. Place chicken in bag , one piece at a time
10. Shake well until thoroughly coated
11. Dip each piece in the buttermilk and coat with flour once again
12. Shake off excess
13. Place on waxed paper for 15 minutes or until dry
14. Place chicken , skin side down , in hot shortening
15. Do not crowd skillet
16. Brown until golden on bottom side
17. When chicken pieces are golden on one side , turn pieces over , cover with tight fitting lid , and reduce heat to a simmer , turning chicken pieces ocaisionally , for 35 to 40 minutes or until juices run clear and chicken is tender
18. When lid is placed on , and heat is reduced to a good simmer , the good side of pieces are the top sides
19. After about 10 minutes , turn back to skin-side down
20. After another 10 minutes or so , turn back to skin-side up for the last 10-15 minutes
21. )
22. Uncover and cook 5 minutes longer for "crispy on the outside" crust
23. Remove at once , skipping this step , if a softer outside is preferred
24. My grandma and great aunts always drained their fried chicken on brown paper grocery bags
25. This seems to work best for me , too
26. Paper towels work "ok" , too
27. If doubling or making alot of chicken , or just wanting to keep it warm til the rest of your side dishes are done and ready to serve , place chicken on brown paper bag-lined cookie sheet in very low oven
28. Great cold , too !
29. 4-6 servings
30. To make chicken fingers:
31. Use 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts , cut into strips about a 1 / 2-3 / 4 " thick
32. I skipped the buttermilk and hot sauce part , and dipped them into the flour mixture first , then into 1 egg beaten with about a half of a cup of half and half cream and a little hot sauce
33. Then back into the flour mixture
34. Worked out perfectly
35. I lightly browned them in hot oil on one side , turned them , then put a lid on them
36. I then only cooked them for 8 minutes
37. I removed the lid , turned them and cooked them another minute
38. Drained them on paper towel
39. Yum !
40. One extra
41. Always use tongs and have a sharp spatula handy to get underneath just in case a little bit wants to stick
42. You don't want to lose that good breading ! :)

title: easy low fat mushroom sauce
steps:
1. Saute the mushrooms in a non stick pan for 2-3 minutes until softened
2. Add the sour cream , yoghurt and black pepper
3. Mix well and heat through
4. Serve warm as required
5. I sometimes sprinkle with a little chopped parsley for added colour and flavour

title: buca di beppo italian wedding soup
steps:
1. Sausage meatball procedure: preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Roll 5 oz
3. Of sausage into miniature meatballs
4. Place on a well-oiled cookie sheet and bake in oven for 5 minutes
5. Remove and let cool
6. Set aside
7. Pastina procedure: bring 6 cups of water to a boil
8. Add 1 lb
9. Pastina
10. Cook until al dente
11. Strain and set aside
12. Chicken tender procedure: slice 4 oz
13. Of boneless chicken breast into strips
14. Brush cookie sheet with olive oil , and lay out chicken strips
15. Sprinkle with salt , pepper and oregano
16. Bake in preheated oven at 350 degrees for 5 minutes
17. Remove and let cool
18. Set aside
19. To serve -- heat chicken stock
20. When boiling add cooked chicken , sausage meatballs , chopped escarole and pastina
21. In a separate bowl mix 2 fresh eggs and 1 / 2 cup of romano cheese
22. Add the egg / romano cheese mixture to the boiling soup and stir gently
23. Cook one more minute until egg mixture is firm
24. Pour into bowls and garnish with diced red peppers and romano cheese

title: goat cheese   green onion scones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Mix first 5 ingredients in large bowl
3. Add cheese and green onions and toss with fork
4. Beat half and half and egg to blend in small bowl
5. Stir egg mixture into dry ingredients and mix gently until dough forms
6. Divide dough in half
7. On lightly floured surface , flatten
8. Each piece into 3 / 4-inch thick round
9. Cut each round into 6 wedges
10. Transfer wedges to baking sheet , spacing evenly
11. Bake scones until tops are brown , about 25 minutes
12. Cool 10 minutes
13. Serve warm

title: lemon jewel marmalade
steps:
1. Rinse unpeeled lemons
2. Remove thin outer peel of lemons with a vegetable peeler or lemon zester
3. If necessary , cut peel into thin strips
4. Squeeze juice from the lemons
5. You should have 1 and 1 / 2 to 1 and 3 / 4 cup of the peel and 2 cups of the juice
6. Place water , all the lemon peel , and 1 / 2 cup of the lemon juice in a heavy-bottomed 6 to 8-quart pan
7. Bring to a boil over high heat
8. Then reduce heat , cover and simmer , stirring occasionally , until peel is tender
9. Stir in sugar and remaining 1 and 1 / 2 cups lemon juice
10. Bring to a full rolling boil over high heat , stirring
11. Remove from heat , cover , and let stand for 18 to 24 hours at room temperature
12. Bring marmalade to a full rolling boil over high heat , stirring constantly
13. Quickly stir in pectin and return to a full rolling boil
14. Boil , stirring , for one minute
15. Remove from heat and skim off any foam
16. Ladle hot marmalade into hot , sterilized half-pint jars , leaving 1 / 4-inch headspace
17. Wipe rims and threads clean
18. Top with hot lids , then firmly screw on bands
19. Process in boiling water canner for 5 minutes

title: cheddar tarts
steps:
1. Roll out pie dough on a lightly floured surface into about a 12 inch circle
2. With a round 3" cookie cutter , cut dough into circles
3. Using a muffin pan with cups 1 3 / 4" in diameter , press each circle into the bottom and sides of the muffin cups
4. Continue to reroll and cut pastry scraps to make a total of 15-18 tart shells
5. Mix together the rest of the ingredients , and fill each shell with about a tbsp of the mixture
6. Bake uncovered at 400f for 25 minutes or until top is set when lightly tapped
7. Serve warm or cooled

title: swedish nut torte glomminge torte
steps:
1. Line an 11 x 17- inch jelly-roll pan with parchment and butter the paper
2. Preheat oven to 350 f
3. In a large bowl , cream the butter and 1 cup of the sugar until fluffy and light
4. Add the egg yolks and beat until very light in texture
5. Stir in the flour , baking powder , and milk
6. Spread the batter in the prepared pan
7. Sprinkle half of the nuts on top
8. In a medium-sized bowl , beat the egg whites and the remaining sugar until stiff , to form a meringue
9. Spread the meringue over the batter
10. Top with the remaining nuts
11. Bake for 25 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted in the center of the cake comes out clean
12. Remove from the pan , peel off the parchment paper , and cool
13. Cut the cake into two equal halves
14. To prepare the filling , in a large bowl , whip the cream and sugar until stiff peaks form
15. Spread half of the whipped cream over one half of the torte , meringue--side up
16. Cover with the other half of the torte , meringue--side up
17. Before serving , top with the remaining whipped cream and the chopped nuts
18. Garnish with strawberries , if desired
19. 16 servings
20. Scandinavian feasts

title: linguini with garlicky shrimp and fresh tomatoes
steps:
1. Cook the linguine as per directions , drain
2. Meanwhile , melt 2 tsp butter in large skillet over med-high heat
3. Sprinkle the shrimp with 1 / 4 tsp of salt and add to skillet
4. Cook until pink and opaque , 1 1 / 2 -2 min each side
5. Transfer to a plate
6. Melt the remaining butter in the same skillet over med-high heat
7. Add garlic and crushed red pepper , soak stirring until fragrant about 30 seconds
8. Add the tomatoes and remaining salt , cook striirring occassionally , until the tomatoes just begin to wilt , 1-2 minutes
9. Add shrinp and cook until heated through , about 1 min longer
10. Add the cooked linguini , parsley , and lemon juice , cook , tossing until combined

title: tandoori chicken wings
steps:
1. Put the onion , ginger , garlic , lime juice , yogurt , vegetable oil , cumin , coriander , salt , cayenne and turmeric in a blender and blend until smooth
2. Pour the mixture into a resealable plastic bag and put in the refrigerator
3. This can be done the night before
4. It lets the flavors blend together before the chicken even touches it
5. About 8 hours or so before cooking , score each chicken wing at least twice each , about 1 / 4 inch deep , and then add them to the marinade
6. Close the bag and knead until the wings are evenly coated with the marinade
7. Refrigerate them for about 8 hours
8. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
9. Place the wings in one layer on a rack on a rimmed baking sheet
10. Bake for about 25 to 30 minutes
11. Make sure to turn them halfway through the cooking time
12. Bake until the chicken is cooked through and done

title: kittencal s meatball sandwich
steps:
1. For the meatballs
2. In a large bowl mix all ingredients together using clean hands
3. Shape into 15 meatballs then place on a baking sheet
4. Bake at 350f for about 25 minutes or until the meatballs are completely cooked through
5. Meanwhile using a serrated knife slice the baguette in half lenghwise and remove some of the bread from the inside to make a "pocket" to hold the meatballs inches
6. In a small bowl mix the soft butter with garlic powder and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt , spread over the inside slices of both breads , then sprinkle with black pepper to taste
7. Place the bread inside the oven the last 4-5 minutes of the meatball baking time and bake until the bread is lightly toasted
8. In a medium saucepan warm the pasta sauce over medium heat
9. When the meatballs are cooked add them into the sauce and toss to coat
10. Spoon the sauce and meatballs over one slice of toasted baguette bread , then top with mozzarella cheese slices
11. Top with the other half of baguette slice
12. Cut into servings

title: frozen cappuccino bars
steps:
1. Arrange graham crackers in the bottom of a 13 x 9 pan , breaking crackers to fit if necessary
2. Beat cream cheese in a large bowl with an electric mixer on low speed until smooth
3. Beat in 1 cup of the milk
4. Add remaining milk , pudding mixes , instant coffee and cinnamon
5. Beat 1 to 2 minutes or until well blended
6. Gently stir in 2 cups of whipped topping
7. Spread 1 / 2 of the pudding mixture over the crackers in pan
8. Arrange more crackers over the pudding or cover the pudding with crushed graham crackers
9. Top with remaining pudding mixture
10. Cover with remaining whipped topping
11. Sprinkle with grated chocolate or sprinkles
12. Freeze 3 hours or overnight
13. Let sit out of freezer for 20-30 minutes before serving

title: pumpkin cream cheese layer pie
steps:
1. Mix cream cheese , sugar , egg and vanilla well
2. Pour into uncooked pie crust
3. Place in refrigerator to chill and thicken for approximately 30 to 45 minutes
4. In a separate bowl mix pumpkin , sugar , eggs , cinnamon , nutmeg , salt and milk
5. Pour on top of chilled cream cheese layer
6. In a small bowl combine pecans , butter and brown sugar
7. Set aside
8. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 45 minutes
9. Edge of pie may be covered with a foil protector for one-half of baking time to prevent crust from getting too brown
10. Carefully remove from oven and sprinkle pecan mixture around in a circle on top of pie
11. Place back in oven for approximately 10 to 15 minutes
12. Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly
13. Chill in refrigerator for approximately 3 to 4 hours before cutting into serving pieces

title: tomato caper tapenade
steps:
1. Process all the ingredients until smooth
2. Spoon into hot sterilised jar and seal jar immediately
3. N
4. B
5. This is best made a day ahead and can be stored in refrigerator for about 4-6 weeks
6. This recipe makes approx 250ml of tapenade

title: yummy round steak with rich gravy
steps:
1. Cut steak into 5 or 6 serving pieces
2. Place in a slow cooker
3. Add dry onion soup mix , water and condensed mushroom soup
4. Cover and cook on low 6-8 hours or on high about 4-5 hours
5. If making the pork chops , brown in oil and then put some of the sauce on the bottom of a 9x13 pan , then layer pork chops and add more sauce
6. Then bake for an hour and a half at 350

title: sheila s peppered lamb chops
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and marinate at least 1 / 2 hour
2. Broil or grill to desired doneness

title: sweet fruit pizza that looks like a regular pizza
steps:
1. Make pizza dough according to directions but add about 1 / 2 cup extra sugar to make it sweet
2. Bake the dough empty
3. Cool
4. Spread with jam / jelly
5. Using a potato peeler or grater , add enough white chocolate shavings to look like cheese
6. Sprinkle on walnuts to look like sausage
7. Slice strawberries to look like pepperoni slices
8. Sprinkle with green sugar or other green cookie sprinkles if you want to simulate oregano
9. I find that it looks best the first day
10. But tastes great even if the strawberries dry out a little --
11. Enjoy !

title: kathy s  cran oatmeal toffee jumbles
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Lightly grease cookie sheets
3. Beat butter , eggs , brown sugar and vanilla until well blended
4. Add flour , baking soda , cinnamon and salt
5. Beat until blended
6. Stir in oats , toffee and coconut
7. Add cranraisins
8. Drop dough by small cookie scoop about 2 inches apart onto cookie sheet
9. Bake 12 minutes or until edges are lightly browned
10. Cool 1 minute on pan , then remove to a wire rack
11. Makes about 3 1 / 2 dozen cookies

title: hot curried fruit
steps:
1. Drain all fruits and placed them in a 2 qt
2. Buttered baking dish
3. Combine cornstarch , curry powder , cinnamon , and sugar in small bowl
4. Sprinkle the sugar mixture over fruit
5. Combine melted butter and brandy and pour over fruit
6. Gently toss to coat all the fruit
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes

title: jule s white bean puree
steps:
1. Combine beans and stock in med saucepan , bring to a boil , simmer , covered for 20 minutes uncover and simmer stirring occasionally about 10 mins or until the liquid is absorbed
2. Blend with remaining ingredients until just smooth
3. With motor running add oil to make a smooth puree

title: congealed pepper jelly mold
steps:
1. With a mixer , beat cream cheese until smooth
2. Add jelly
3. Blend well
4. Soften gelatin in cold milk , add boiling milk
5. Stir until dissolved
6. Combine with cream cheese mixture
7. Pour into 3 1 / 2 cup mold
8. Chill
9. Unmold and serve with crackers
10. Can be done up to 2 days before serving

title: creamy chicken stuffed crescents
steps:
1. Cook chicken as desired
2. I usually boil boneless , skinless breast - then shred / chop
3. Unfold cresent triangles & fill with chicken & cheese
4. Fold & roll up cresents & place seam down in small greased baking dish
5. Empty soup into small mixing bowl & then fill empty soup can half full with milk & mix into soup
6. Pour soup / milk mixture over chicken cresents
7. Top with shredded cheese
8. Bake 375 for 20-30 minutes
9. Enjoy !

title: pillsbury pizza triangles
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425f
2. Remove pie crusts from pouches
3. Place flat on cutting board
4. Cut each crust into 4 wedge-shaped pieces , making 8 wedges
5. In medium bowl , mix filling ingredients
6. Spread 1 heaping tablespoon filling on half of each crust wedge
7. Fold unfilled sides of wedges over filling
8. With fork , press edges to seal
9. Place on ungreased cookie sheet
10. Bake 11 to 14 minutes or until crust is golden brown

title: snickerdoodle sundaes
steps:
1. Prepare and bake cookines according to package directions
2. Set aside 8 cookies
3. Place 2 cookies in each serving bowl
4. Top with 1 / 2 cup ice cream
5. Drizzle with 2 tablespoons caramel topping

title: nonna marfisa s ravioli
steps:
1. Heat 1 tbs
2. Oil in large skillet , add meat and brown well
3. Drain fat from meat and add salt , pepper , garlic powder and nutmeg
4. Set aside
5. Drain thawed spinach , squeezing to eliminate excess water
6. Saute spinach with 3 tbs
7. Oil sprinkled with garlic powder
8. Add spinach to meat and stir well
9. Continue sauteing for 5-10 minutes
10. Cool , then add egg and paresan cheese mixing well
11. Place 2 teaspoons filling into center of won ton wrapper
12. If using less filling - fold wrapper over and seal edges using a bit of water
13. If using more filling- place a second wrapper over filling and seal using a bit of water
14. Then put the filling on top of the bread
15. She let that sit in the refrigerator to absorb any excess fat drippings
16. Then she would place filling into pasta
17. Place pasta in boiling water until float to top
18. Ravioli may be frozen

title: widmer brothers beer cheese
steps:
1. At least four hours before making the beer cheese , open up the bottle of hefeweizen beer , pour it into a glass , and allow it to go flat
2. Later , with an electric mixer with a paddle attachment , combine the cheeses , onion , worcestershire , mustard , and salt , and mix thoroughly
3. With mixer running , gradually and slowly add the beer and mix until it is entirely incorporated
4. Chill and serve

title: maui style ahi poke
steps:
1. Cut the ahi , place in a mixing bowl
2. Add all the rest to a separate bowl and mix
3. Let stand about 10 minute and stir again
4. If using frozen ahi add chili sauce to above bowl
5. Add to the ahi and very gently mix , not to break up ahi
6. Place on a platter , garnish with the rest of the green onion
7. Platter
8. Coconuts split in half for bowls , pineapples cut in half and scooped out , save
9. " cut the long way top to bottom" leave top leaves in place
10. Save scooped pineapple for another beachbumlahaina dish

title: buddha jumps over the wall cream pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit
2. Mix graham cracker crumbs , almonds , and melted butter in a bowl
3. Press into a 9" deep dish pie pan
4. Bake for 10 minutes and cool
5. Mix cream cheese and powdered sugar until smooth and creamy
6. Pour into pie crust
7. Fold 1 / 2 cool whip into chocolate pudding
8. Place on top of cheesecake mixture
9. Refrigerate for 2 hours
10. Spread remaining cool whip over top of pudding layer
11. Refrigerate for 2 more hours
12. Garnish with broken cookies just before serving

title: potato and turnip bake
steps:
1. In a skillet over medium-high heat fry bacon until golden , stirring frequently
2. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels
3. Pour off bacon fat from skillet and reserve
4. Heat 1 tablespoon of the bacon drippings in the skillet over medium heat
5. Add leeks to skillet cooking until softened and starting to brown
6. Transfer to a bowl
7. Heat another tablespoon of the bacon dripping in the skillet over medium-high heat
8. Add half of the potatoes and cook until tender and golden brown , tossing and seasoing with 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and 1 / 8 teaspoon pepper
9. Add potatoes to bowl
10. Repeat with remaining potoates
11. Heat 1 tablespoon bacon drippings in skillet over medium high heat
12. Add turnips and cook until tender and starting to brown , seaoning with 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and 1 / 8 teaspoon pepper
13. Add to bowl
14. Add carrot to skillet , stirring for 2 minutes before adding to bowl
15. Add remaining salt and pepper and fennel seeds to bowl and toss
16. Spread half of the vegetables in a 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish
17. Sprinkle with bacon and cover with remaining vegetables
18. Chill to room temperature and then cover and chill overnight
19. Preheat oven to 425-degrees f
20. Bring vegetables to room temperature
21. Pour wine over all
22. Bake until wine has evaporated and top is browned
23. Sprinkle with parsley

title: incredible edible cheese biscuits
steps:
1. Cut shortening into dry ingredients with a pastry blender
2. Add milk and cheese
3. Mix and turn out on a floured board
4. Knead 8 - 10 times
5. Cut with round cutter
6. Bake at 400 degrees f for 12 - 15 minutes

title: guardians famous donuts
steps:
1. Mix together the shortening , sugar and egg yolks
2. In a second bowl , sift together the flour , baking powder , salt and spices
3. Stir into the first mixture alternating with 1 cup milk
4. Hand dough as little as possible , stir until dry ingredients are just moistened
5. Roll dough to 3 / 8-inch thickness on a floured cloth covered surface and let
6. Stand for about 15 minutes
7. Heat fat to 370 degrees
8. There should be at least 1 1 / 2 inches of fat in the deep fryer
9. The fat is ready when a doughnut center browns in about 1 minute
10. Keep the temperature as steady as possible
11. Cut the doughnuts out with a floured 2 1 / 2 or 3-inch doughnut cutter
12. Fry the doughnuts in the hot fat , turning carefully with a wooden spoon handle when the first crack appears
13. Continue cooking and turning until nicely browned , this will take about 1 1 / 2 minute total frying time
14. Drain doughnuts on brown paper or on paper towels
15. This recipe makes about 2 dozen doughnuts
16. Roll in your favorite topping or serve plain

title: poor knights
steps:
1. Cut off the bread crusts and cut into quarters
2. Be careful not to cut off your hand
3. Place the bread in a deep dish
4. Mix eggs with wine , cinnamon , and sugar in a bowl
5. Pour the mixture over the bread and leave to soak for 3 minutes
6. Heat the oil[ inch deep]
7. Drain the bread and slide it into the hot oil{watch your hands as it spits}
8. It would definitely be to your advantage to wear a gauntlet whilst performing this procedure
9. Fry until golden brown on both sides
10. Drain on medieval kitchen paper
11. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar and ground cinnamon
12. Feed the hungry

title: big soft hamburger buns
steps:
1. Stir together potatoes and boiling water
2. Allow to cool at least 5-10 minutes
3. Meanwhile , sprinkle yeast over warm water
4. Let stand about 5 minutes until foamy
5. Stir together potato mixture , yeast mixture , cottage cheese , sugar , oil , egg , and salt
6. Gradually stir in flour until a soft dough comes together to form a smooth ball
7. Knead 9-10 minutes until dough is smooth , elastic , and no longer sticky
8. Add more flour , one tablespoon at a time during the kneading process , if necessary to reduce stickiness
9. Place dough into oiled bowl
10. Cover bowl and place in a warm place
11. Allow dough to rise until doubled
12. Punch down dough and knead a few strokes to release air
13. Divide dough into 9 equal portions
14. With lightly oiled or floured hands , shape each dough portion into a ball , gently pulling and tucking top surface under until smooth
15. Place formed buns 2 or more inches apart , tucked sides down , on a greased baking sheet
16. Cover and allow buns to rise until puffy
17. Bake at 350 for 20-25 minutes , or until buns are light golden-brown
18. Remove from oven and transfer to cooling rack

title: holiday almond brittle
steps:
1. In a heavy skillet , heat the sugar over low heat until it has melted and is slightly browned , making sure it doesn't burn
2. Add the honey and butter
3. Simmer for 20 minutes
4. Stir in the nuts and cook for 10 minutes
5. Line a platter or pan with wax paper and drop tablespoonfuls of the brittle onto the paper
6. Let it harden , break into pieces and serve

title: indiana succotash
steps:
1. Cut beans in rounds the size of corn
2. Cook with 1 / 2 teaspoon salt about 15 minutes or until tender
3. Drain
4. Saute green onions in butter until transparent
5. Add corn , salt , paprika , celery salt and sugar , then beans
6. Simmer , covered about 10 minutes

title: crabmeat enchiladas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 250 degrees
2. Saute onion in oil , add flour , milk and chili
3. Cook until medium thick
4. Reserve 1 / 4 cup of cheeses to sprinkle over top of sauce
5. Heat 1 / 2 to 1 tsp of canola oil at a time in skillet
6. When oil is warm quickly dip tortillas in oil until soft and warm
7. Immediately put 1 tablespon each of cheese , crabmeat and sauce in tortilla and roll up
8. Place seam side down in a 11x7 inch pan
9. Repeat until all tortillas are used
10. Pour the remaining sauce on top and sprinkle with reserved cheeses
11. Bake in preheated oven for 10 to 15 minutes

title: simple pasta and cheese bake with veggies for two
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit
2. Grease a casserole dish
3. Combine everything except the mozzarella cheese
4. Place mixture into a casserole
5. Top with the mozzarella cheese
6. Bake until bubbly and heated through , or microwave until done

title: west indes baked bananas   guineos al horno
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425f
2. Place peeled bananas in a baking pan
3. Cover each with lemon juice and vanilla
4. Sprinkle each banana with brown sugar and cinnamon
5. Bake for 7 minutes
6. Serve hot

title: hash browns pizza
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375
2. Grease round pizza pan
3. Stir together hashbrowns and cheddar cheese soup
4. Press into pizza pan
5. Bake for about 20-25 mins , or until hashbrowns start to brown a little
6. Meanwhile , cook ground beef , then add 3 / 4 can tomato sauce simmer for about 15 minutes
7. Spread remaining sauce over the hashbrown crust
8. Load ground beef onto hashbrown crust
9. Top with shredded cheese place back in oven until cheese completely melts

title: italian lentil    vegetable stew  crock pot
steps:
1. Mix lentils and 3 cups water in a 3-quart or larger crock pot
2. In a large bowl , mix together remaining ingredients except olive oil
3. Place mixed ingredients on top of lentils in crock pot
4. Cook on low 8 to 10 hours until vegetables and lentils are tender
5. Stir in olive oil , serve in soup plates or bowls
6. Pass the parmesan cheese at the table

title: pressure cooker pumpkin bread pudding
steps:
1. Line a strainer with paper toweling or cheesecloth
2. Add pumpkin and let drain at least 30 minutes
3. Butter a 6 cup pudding mold or baking dish that will easily fit inside the pressure cooker
4. Spread one side of each slice of bread with butter
5. Stack the slices and cut into cubes
6. Place them in the baking dish
7. Whisk the sugar , eggs and egg yolks until light
8. Add milk , pumpkin , brandy , vanilla , salt and nutmeg to taste , and mix well
9. Pour over bread
10. Gently push the bread into the liquid to moisten it
11. Cover baking pan with aluminum foil so no water can get inside
12. Add 2 cups water to the pressure cooker
13. Put the baking dish in the steamer basket and place in the pressure cooker
14. Close pressure cooker and bring up to full pressure
15. Reduce heat to stabilize pressure and cook for 20 minutes release pressure and remove steamer basket from pressure cooker
16. Carefully pour off any water that has accumulated on top of the foil , then remove the foil
17. Serve warm or at room temperature
18. Bread pudding can be refrigerated for several days
19. Let stand at room temperature for about 15 minutes before serving

title: asian spicy chicken thighs
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients in a small bowl
2. Pour the mix into a ziplock plastic sandwich bag
3. Place one thigh in the bag and coat thouroughly by massaging the mix around the thigh
4. Place the second thigh in the bag withg the first and coat thoroughly
5. Refrigerate chicken in the bag for a minimum of 30 minutes or overnight
6. On a tinfoil covered cookie sheet , bake the chicken for 45 minutes or until no longer pink
7. Alternate microwave instructions: cook in bag in a microwavable dish at 1 / 2 power for 5 minutes
8. Flip the bag over and cook for 5 minutes at 1 / 2 power for 5minutes
9. Remove chicken from bag and dish and broil on the top shelf at high setting for 5 minutes

title: pork chops with orange mustard sauce
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large skillet
2. Season chops with salt and pepper , cook over medium high heat browning chops on both sides
3. In a small bowl , combine ginger , orange juice , soy , honey , mustard and garlic and pour over chops
4. Cover and simmer 10 to 15 minutes or until chops are tender

title: stir fried cellophane noodles
steps:
1. Soak mushrooms in water for 30 minutes
2. Discard tough stocks
3. Cut mushrooms into thin slices
4. Soak cellophane noodles , in a separate bowl , in hot water for 5 minutes
5. Drain
6. Slice ginger , green onion , and pork
7. Heat oil in skillet
8. Stir fry ginger , pork , and mushrooms for 2 minutes
9. Add green onions , chicken broth , bouillon cube , and soy sauce
10. Bring to boil
11. Simmer for 5 minutes
12. Add noodles , vinegar , salt and pepper
13. Stir to mix
14. Simmer another 5 minutes

title: swissed steak
steps:
1. Pour 1 cup of crushed tomatoes into bottom of the crock pot
2. Add 1 tbs celery , 1 / 4 of an onion , 1 / 4 of a bell pepper
3. Cut the cube steaks into 8 pieces
4. Sprinkle the salt and pepper over the cube steak
5. Place the cube steak in the crock pot
6. Add the onions and then the bell peppers on top of the meat
7. Pour the remaining crushed tomatoes over the top of the mixture
8. Do not stir
9. Turn the crock pot on high for 6 hours
10. When the tomatoes , peppers , and onions have cooked down it should be done
11. Gently serve several meat portions to each person
12. Serve it on rice
13. Then spoon some of the sauce over the rice and meat

title: yayla corbasi  turkish yogurt soup
steps:
1. In a large pot boil the water , rice , salt and bouillon
2. Cook on medium high , until the rice is done
3. Meanwhile in a bowl , mix yogurt , milk , egg yolk and flour
4. After the rice is cooked , take a few spoons of liquid from the pot and mix into the bowl
5. Then slowly pour your mixture into the pot while stirring very slowly
6. Cook for 10 more minutes on low heat
7. Place the butter in a frying pan
8. When it begins spitting , stir in the mint and pour into your soup
9. Serve immediately

title: savory corn muffins
steps:
1. Adjust over rack to middle position and heat oven to 450 degrees
2. Put a 12 cup muffin tin in oven to heat while preparing batter
3. Microwave creamed corn in a 1-quart pyrex type measuring cup to a full boil stir in 1 cup of the cornmeal to make a very thick pasty mush
4. If the mush is not stiff , microwave an additional 30 seconds or so
5. Whisk in buttermilk , then eggs , and finally butter
6. Mix remaining cornmeal with flour , salt , baking powder and soda in medium mixing bowl
7. Pour wet ingredients into dry and stir until just combined
8. Remove muffin tin from oven
9. Coat with non-stick cooking spray
10. Divide batter evenly among cups bake until golden brown on sides and bottom , about 15 minutes
11. Turn onto wire rack
12. Let cool 5 minutes
13. Serve
14. For picnics can be cooled to room temperature , wrapped in plastic and stored up to a day

title: sausage  penne  and peppers
steps:
1. Saute onion and peppers in oil
2. Add garlic , tomatoes , sugar , salt and pepper
3. Reduce heat and simmer
4. Add sausage and simmer covered about 20 minutes
5. While sausage and tomatoes are simmering , cook penne according to package directions
6. Add basil , parsley and penne to sausage mix and toss to combine

title: ultimate dipping sauce
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a bowl and stir until well mixed
2. If flavor seems too salty , add a touch more chili sauce
3. Chill at least 20 minutes before serving

title: chewy sour cream chocolate chip walnut squares
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Set oven rack to second-lowest position
3. Grease a 15 x 10-inch baking sheet / pan
4. Line bottom with waxed or parchment paper
5. In a small cup dissolve the coffee granules in warm water until thoroughly combined
6. Set aside
7. In a large bowl , beat butter and brown sugar at medium speed until creamy and combined
8. Add in corn syrup
9. Beat until smooth
10. Beat in eggs , coffee / water mixture , vanilla and maple extract
11. Mix until thoroughly combined
12. In a bowl combine flour , baking powder , cinnamon and salt
13. On low speed on the electric mixer add in flour alternately with sour cream
14. Fold in chocolate chips and nuts
15. Spread on the prepared baking sheet
16. Bake for about 30 minutes , or until the center is set
17. Cool completely before frosting
18. Cut into about 2-inch squares and serve

title: sweet   tart creamy fruit salad
steps:
1. In a small mixing bowl , whisk together the light sour cream , lime juice and splenda until creamy and well-blended
2. Add the crushed pineapple and the mandarin orange slices to the sour cream mixture and wisk again
3. The orange slices will probably break up a bit while you wisk them , which is fine
4. Set the sour cream mixture in the refrigerator to chill
5. Core and slice the granny smith and fuji apples into bite-sized chunks and place them in a large bowl
6. Add the chilled sour cream dressing to the sliced apples and stir well , until all of the apple chunks are well-coated with dressing
7. Sprinkle 1 teaspoons to 1 tablespoons of each of the toasted almonds and pecans on top of each serving immediately before eating
8. This salad keeps well covered in the refrigerator for a few days
9. Just remember to stir well right before each time you serve it

title: krispy kreme bread pudding ii
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine ingredients , except ice cream , in a large bowl
3. Let sit for 15 minutes
4. Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until bread pudding has browned

title: chocolate nut torte
steps:
1. Blend in a blender eggs and sweetener for 45 seconds
2. Add other ingredients in the order listed
3. Blend 2 minutes
4. Pour mixture into greased 9" round pan
5. Bake at 350f for 20 minutes or until skewer inserted in the centre comes out clean

title: easy asian appetizer
steps:
1. Place cream cheese in a shallow bowl
2. Pour soy sauce over the top
3. I usually use enough to come one third of the way up the side of the cream cheese
4. Sprinkle with seeds
5. Serve with plain crackers or pretzels

title: paximathakia portokaliou or orange sesame biscotti  greece
steps:
1. Dissolve baking soda in orange juice , then pour into large mixing bowl
2. In the same large mixing bowl , add olive oil , lemon juice & zest , cinnamon , water & sesame seeds
3. With electric mixer , beat at medium high for 5 minutes until thoroughly combined & oil & juices are not separating
4. [if mixing by hand , use a whisk & beat until thoroughly blended
5. ]
6. In a separate bowl , whisk together 8 cups of the flour , along with the sugar & baking powder
7. Slowly add dry mixture to liquid mixture , using either dough hooks or wooden spoon
8. As it the dough get stiffer , knead with hands until dough holds together , then turn out onto a floured surface
9. Knead well for about 10 minutes , adding more flour as needed , until dough is smooth & soft
10. [dough will be softer & oilier than other cokie doughs
11. ]
12. Divide dough into 4 parts to make 4 small loaves
13. Preheat oven to 390 degrees f
14. For each of the 4 small loaves , knead dough until dense & holding together tightly , then form it into a loaf shape about 14 inches long & 1 / 2" to 3 / 4" high
15. Place seam side down
16. Then , using a floured knife , slice loaf almost all the way through into 1 / 2" to 3 / 4" slices
17. Place loaves on non-stick or lightly oiled cookie sheet & bake 15 minutes , about 3-4 inches above the bottom of the oven
18. The bottom should be golden & the top should be just starting to brown
19. Remove loaves from oven & cut all the way through the slices , then allow to cool completely
20. Preheat oven to between 200 degrees & 210 degrees f
21. When sliced loaves are completely cooled , place all slices upright in a very lightly oiled or non-stick baking sheet
22. Return to cooler oven & bake for at least another 1 1 / 2 hours [for 2 hours if you want the biscotti to be really dry]

title: apple pie stuffed soft pretzels with streusel
steps:
1. To prepare dough:
2. Proof yeast and the 1 tbs sugar in the 1 cup of warm water and allow to rest for 5 minutes until foamy
3. Mix the flours with 1 / 2 teaspoons salt and 2 tbs oil in bowl and then add proofed yeast mixture
4. Stir to form a shaggy dough
5. Place onto lightly floured surface and knead for 2-3 minutes until a smooth , but slightly sticky dough is formed
6. Place into a greased bowl , covered with plastic wrap , and let sit until doubled
7. While waiting for the dough to rise prepare filling and streusel
8. To prepare filling:
9. Peel , core , and thinly slice the apples and then cut each slice into 8 pieces
10. Saute the apple pieces with 1 / 2 of the tbs of butter , the 1 / 2 teaspoon cinnamon , and the pinch of cloves until the apples are tender , but not mushy
11. Remove from heat and stir in the additional 1 / 2 tbs of butter
12. To prepare streusel:
13. Mix the flour , sugar , and cinnamon together
14. With fork cut in the 4 tbs of butter to a crumb consistency
15. Stir in the chopped pecans
16. When dough has risen , punch down , place on lightly floured board , and cut into 8 equal pieces
17. With hands , roll each piece into a 15" long cylinder
18. Flatten the cylinder down with a rolling pin to measure 3" wide by 17" long
19. Place 1 1 / 2 tbs of the filling mixture along the length of each piece and fold the long edge over to meet the other side
20. Pinch along the seam to thoroughly enclose the filling
21. Roll the dough with your hands to form an even cylinder and fully encapsulate the filling
22. Take the two ends of each filled cylinder and form into a circle that is overlapped by a couple of inches of dough on either side , twist the ends and lay over the opposite side to form a pretzel shape and press to seal
23. Play with the shape a bit to get the right form and then place each one on a parchment or silpat lined cookie sheet
24. Repeat for all 8 pieces
25. Allow to rise on cookie sheet for 15 minutes
26. While they are rising , boil 2 cups of water and add 1 / 3 cup of baking soda
27. Preheat oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit
28. Beat 1 egg white with 1 tbs water and lay it on a flat plate
29. Lay the streusel topping on a flat plate , too
30. When the pretzels have fully risen , drop one at a time into the boiling water and count to 10
31. Remove with a large slotted spatula / spoon to slightly drain and then drop onto the egg white , turn to coat , then drop into the streusel and turn to coat
32. Lay each completed pretzel back on the lined cookie sheet
33. Repeat this procedure until all pretzels are done
34. Place into the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes
35. Immediately remove from cookie sheets and place on racks to cool
36. The first is 45-60 minutes and the second is 15 minutes
37. The recipe is written to make use of the rising times for preparing the filling and streusel

title: chris s pueblo green chili sauce
steps:
1. In large stainless kettle , brown pork in bacon fat or vegetable oil
2. Cook on medium heat till meat is slightly pink
3. Add diced onion and garlic , cook till soft
4. Add flour and stir , browning flour as you would a roux
5. Add some of your water if flour is too thick , keep stirring till it bubbles
6. Add chicken broth
7. Add the rest of the ingredients and bring to a bubble , then turn heat to low
8. Cook uncovered for 2-3 hours , stirring occasionally
9. If your chile is too thin , add more flour
10. If your chile is too thick , add more chicken broth
11. Taste often and add more spices or peppers to your liking !
12. If you do not like chunks of tomato or peppers , place the rotel , tomatoes and canned diced green chile's into a blender and puree them !

title: bavarian sausage and kraut supper
steps:
1. Cook noodles according to package directions , omitting salt and fat
2. Drain and set the noodles aside
3. While the noodles are cooking , heat the olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
4. Add sliced onion and caraway seeds , and cook 4 minutes or until lightly browned , stirring constantly
5. Add apple , sauerkraut , and sausage , and cook 5 minutes
6. Stir in the chicken broth and sherry , and bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat to medium , and cook 5 minutes
8. Serve over the noodles

title: honey cake  lekach
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Beat sugar , honey , oil , eggs , lemon zest , juice and brandy in large mixer bowl on medium speed 2 minutes
3. Mix flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt , cinnamon , ginger , nutmeg , allspice , cloves and instant coffee
4. Stir into sugar mixture alternately with water
5. Beat on high speed , scraping bowl occasionally , 2 minutes
6. Fold in 1 / 2 cup of the nuts and the raisins
7. Pour into greased 10-inch tube pan or 12-cup bundt pan
8. Bake until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean , about 1 hour 10 minutes
9. Cool in pan 15 minutes
10. Remove from pan
11. Prick top of cake carefully with fork
12. Drizzle with lemon sugar
13. Sprinkle with remaining nuts
14. For lemon glaze , just combine sugar and lemon juice

title: crackaroni  macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Cook and drain macaroni slightly al dente
2. Place in greased 2 qt casserole dish
3. Melt butter over medium heat
4. Add flour for a light roux
5. Stirring constantly , gradually add the milk , cooking until thickened
6. Add pepper , salt and sugar , mixing thoroughly
7. Add velveeta cubes and stir until melted
8. Add sour cream and cottage cheese , stirring until well combined
9. Pour over macaroni and mix well
10. It will look "cheesy" but will soak into the macaroni during cooking
11. Spread cheddar cheese over the top
12. Sprinkle with paprika
13. Bake at 350 for 45-50 minutes

title: pasta with three peas great for summer
steps:
1. Cook pasta in large pot of boiling salted water until tender but still firm to bite , stirring often
2. Drain , reserving 1 cup cooking liquid
3. Transfer to large bowl
4. Meanwhile , saut bacon in heavy large skillet over high heat until crisp , about 5 minutes
5. Using slotted spoon , transfer bacon to paper towels
6. Drain off 1 / 2 of the bacon fat and add shallots to skillet
7. Saut over medium-high heat until golden brown , pressing with spoon to separate layers , about 5 minutes
8. Add snap peas
9. Stir until bright green and crisp-tender , about 1 minute
10. Add pea tendrils and petite peas , stirring just until tendrils wilt , about 1 minute
11. Add pea mixture , bacon , mint , and enough cooking liquid to moisten pasta
12. Stir in 1 cup cheese
13. Serve , passing additional cheese alongside

title: portobello burgers with green sauce and smoked mozzarella
steps:
1. Heat a nonstick skillet over med-high heat
2. Add in oil and mushroom caps
3. Season mushrooms with steak seasoning and saute 5 minutes on each side
4. Add in vinegar and coat the mushrooms in it
5. When the vinegar has evaporated , turn mushrooms cap side up and cover with sliced cheese
6. Turn off heat and cover pan with foil
7. Let stand 2-3 minutes for cheese to melt
8. To make the sauce: add basil , parsley , capers , pignoli , garlic , and lemon juice in a food processor
9. Pulse grind , until finely chopped and scrape into a bowl
10. Stir in oil , salt , pepper , and cheese
11. Slather bun tops with green sauce
12. Pile portobellos on bun bottoms and top with red onion slices and lettuce
13. Cover with bun tops and serve

title: rice a la hungarian
steps:
1. Wash rice well with water to remove starch
2. Add some water to prevent burning
3. Saute onion , celery and carrots in butter
4. Add paprika , parsley , rice and soup mix , and seasonings
5. Cook adding water to equivalent of 2 1 / 2 cups
6. Simmer approx 3 / 4 hour

title: esalen brown rice breakfast cereal
steps:
1. Combine cooked brown rice and all other ingredients in a bowl or large tupperware
2. Stir to combine
3. Put in the fridge for 12 hours or overnight
4. Warm and serve
5. This is good with a dollop of yogurt !

title: wasabi mayonnaise for crab  fish or clam cakes
steps:
1. In a small bowl whisk together ingredients
2. Serve with crab , fish or clam cakes

title: buca di beppo tiramisu
steps:
1. Whip mascarpone cheese until light and airy
2. Dip ladyfingers in espresso rum mixture and place in serving bowl 3 inches deep by 7 inches wide
3. Top with 1 oz of zabaglione
4. Using a 3 oz scoop , layer one-third of whipped mascarpone over ladyfingers
5. Repeat process 2 more times with remaining ladyfingers , zabaglione and mascarpone
6. Chill in refrigerator
7. Prior to serving , sprinkle with cocoa powder and crumbled biscotti
8. Espresso rum mixture: mix espresso and rum together
9. Zabaglione: whisk egg yolks and whole egg together with sugar until eggs are thick and lemon colored
10. Whisk in marsala wine
11. Microwave on high for 30 seconds , whisk , and repeat microwaving and whisking 4-6 times , until pudding is thick
12. Alternatively , whisk ingredients in the top of a gently simmering double boiler until thickened

title: open face corned beef and cheese sandwiches with pickled onions
steps:
1. Combine onion , vinegar , water , sugar and red pepper flakes in a small bowl
2. Cover and refrigerate until needed
3. Heat broiler
4. Drain onions
5. Spread thin layers of mayonnaise and mustard on bread slices
6. Top with a portion of drained onions
7. Top with corned beef and cheese
8. Broil 6-8 inches from heat until sandwiches are heated through and cheese is melted , about 3 minutes

title: simple iced tea
steps:
1. I use a little tea kettle for this
2. I put water in the kettle , and then add the tea bags and get the water to boiling
3. Take the kettle off the heat , and add the baking soda
4. Let it set and cool off
5. I put mine in a pitcher in the fridge
6. It's almost black in color , and very strong
7. You need maybe 1 tbs
8. In a glass of water / ice , depending on how strong you want your tea
9. It keeps , without having that nasty taste , for well over a week
10. Just remember it's very strong , and you need very , very little added to your water

title: best ever white bread   abm
steps:
1. Place ingredients in bread maker following your manufacturers guidelines
2. Personally i only mix it up in the bread maker
3. When it is done proofing i turn it out onto a floured surface shape it and place it in a greased loaf pan
4. Let rise for approx 1 hour , til doubled
5. I bake for 30 minutes at 350 degrees

title: chocolate cheesecake strawberries
steps:
1. Wash strawberries and pat dry
2. Place on paper towels until they reach room temperature
3. Mash cheesecake with a mixer until the graham cracker crust in mixed throughout
4. Cheesecake mixture should be soft and workable , like a cookie dough
5. With your fingers , pick up a small ball of cheesecake and press against the strawberry , leaving the stem and leaves visible
6. Bottom 1 / 2 to 2 / 3 of the strawberry should be covered with the cheesecake
7. Set aside on waxed paper
8. May need to be chilled until ready to dip
9. Melt chocolate chips , corn syrup and butter in a double boiler , stirring occasionally
10. Remove from heat and dip each cheesecake-covered strawberry into chocolate , coating of strawberry
11. Allow excess chocolate to drip off , then return strawberry to the waxed paper covered baking pan or cookie sheet
12. Refrigerate until set , about 15-20 minutes
13. Strawberries should be stored in refrigerator until ready to serve

title: healthy raspberry chocolate shake
steps:
1. Just throw everything in the blender and blend on full speed
2. Becomes a delicious rich , milkshake-like shake ,

title: high roasted chicken and potatoes
steps:
1. Dissolve salt and sugar in 2 quarts cold water in large container
2. Immerse chicken and refrigerate until fully seasoned , minimum 1 hour , maximum 4 hours
3. If you're planning on cooking immediately adjust oven rack to lower-middle position and heat oven to 500 degrees
4. Line bottom of broiler pan with aluminum foil and spray with spray
5. Remove chicken from brine , rinse with water
6. Butterfly chicken , flatten breastbone and smeer on flavored butter
7. Place chicken on the top of the broiler pan
8. For the crispest skin the bird should be placed , uncovered in the fridge for 8 hrs or overnight , toss potatoes with oil , salt , and pepper in medium bowl
9. Spread potatoes in even layer in foil-lined broiler pan bottom
10. Place broiler pan rack with chicken on top
11. Rub chicken with remaining 1 1 / 2 teaspoons oil and sprinkle with pepper
12. Roast chicken until spotty brown , about 20 minutes
13. Rotate pan and continue to roast until skin has crisped and turned deep brown-- 20-25 minutes longer
14. A thermometer should registers 160 degrees in thickest part of breast transfer chicken to cutting board and tent with foil
15. Remove hot broiler pan rack
16. Soak up excess grease from potatoes with paper towels
17. Carefully peel back foil , using a metal spatula to help scrape potatoes off foil as needed
18. With additional paper towels , pat off remaining grease
19. Cut chicken into serving pieces and serve with potatoes

title: easy espresso whipped cream
steps:
1. Chill your beaters and bowl in the freezer for about 5 minutes or until very cold
2. Beat all ingredients in a stainless steel or glass bowl to soft peaks

title: toffee topped fudgy brownies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease 13x9x2 baking dish
3. Melt butter in saucepan over low heat
4. Remove from heat
5. Stir in sugar and vanilla
6. Set aside
7. Measure and sift dry ingredients in large bowl
8. Beat eggs and add to butter mixture
9. Pour over into dry ingredients and mix just until blended
10. Pour into prepared pan
11. Sprinkle top with bit o'brickle and mini chocolate chips
12. Bake 35 minutes

title: chicken with sherry ala orange sauce
steps:
1. Lightly spray a skillet with pam and brown the thighs on both sides
2. Season with salt & pepper
3. Place thighs in an oven proof dish and sprinkle with the paprika
4. Cover the thighs with the shallots , mushrooms , garlic and jalapeno set aside
5. In a saucepan combine the water , orange zest , orange juice & brown sugar
6. Mix the corn starch with the 3 tbsp of water and add to the sauce
7. Bring sauce to a boil & simmer for apprx 5 minutes
8. Mix in the sherry and grand marnier
9. Cut each slice of orange into 4 pieces
10. Place 2 pieces of orange on each thigh
11. Spoon the sauce over the chicken
12. Bake in 375 oven for apprx 35 minutes or until done
13. Baste a couple of times during baking
14. Use parsley as a garnish if you wish

title: cheesy potato and broccoli casserole
steps:
1. Set oven to 350f
2. Grease an 8-inch square pan
3. In a saucepan over medium-low heat , melt the 2 tbsp butter
4. Whisk in flour , salt , pepper and nutmeg
5. Whisk and cook for 1 minute , add in the half and half cream
6. Whisk until thickened and bubbly
7. Add in the parmesan cheese , cream cheese and the cheddar or swiss cheese
8. Stir until the cheese are completely melted
9. Stir in the hash brown potatoes
10. Mix until combined
11. Spoon half of the mixture into a prepared baking dish
12. Top with the broccoli , spoon the remaining mixture over the broccoli
13. Cover and bake for 25-30 minutes
14. In the meantime , in a small bowl , combine the bread crumbs with the parmesan cheese , mix to combine
15. Add in melted butter , mix well
16. Remove the casserole from the oven
17. Sprinkle the breadcrumb mixture just around the edges of the casserole
18. Bake 10 minutes longer
19. Remove from oven
20. Let sit for 10 minutes before serving

title: african piri   piri kabobs
steps:
1. Peel sweet potatoes , if desired and cut into 1 1 / 4 inch cubes
2. Cook potatoes in lightly salted boiling water for 5 minutes or until slightly tender
3. Drain , cool slightly
4. Alternately thread the sweet potato , venison or beef and sweet pepper pieces on 4 long metal skewers , leaving a 1 / 4 inch space between pieces
5. Brush with olive oil and sprinkle generously with piri-piri spice
6. Place kabobs on the lightly oiled rack of the grill directly over medium heat
7. Grill for 25 to 35 minutes or until sweet potatoes are tender , turning occasionally

title: candied carrots
steps:
1. Bring water to a boil in a large skillet
2. Add next 4 ingredients
3. Reduce heat
4. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes
5. Add honey and lemon juice
6. Bring to a boil
7. Boil uncovered , for 4 minutes or until the liquid evaporates and the carrots are tender

title: whiskey pretzels
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 250 deg f
2. Add butter , whiskey , brown sugar , garlic and cayenne to saucepan and cook over low heat until melted
3. Spread pretzels on a baking sheet and pour butter mixture over pretzels
4. Toss to coat
5. Bake 10 minutes
6. Stir mixture and bake 10 more minutes
7. Allow to cool and enjoy !

title: champagne leek and lemon cream
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , melt butter over medium-high heat
2. Add leeks and shallots
3. Cook until leeks are tender
4. Add champagne and reduce until 2-3 tablespoons remain
5. Add lemon juice and cook until liquid evaporates
6. Add cream and simmer until slightly reduced
7. Season with salt and pepper
8. Garnish with fresh dill

title: easy greek shake  n bake drumsticks
steps:
1. 1
2. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
3. Line a shallow baking pan with foil
4. 2
5. Add breadcrumbs , seasoning , and cheese to a ziploc bag
6. Close and shake up to mix
7. 3
8. Rinse chicken in water
9. Do not pat dry
10. Add 1 drumstick at a time to ziploc bag
11. Shake to coat
12. 4
13. Bake for approximately 45 minutes or until juices run clear

title: classic blt
steps:
1. Fry bacon 6-10 minutes or until desired crispiness
2. Put the cooked bacon onto paper towels to dry
3. Meanwhile , slice one bagel in half and toast the halves
4. Spread both sides of bagel with mayo
5. Layer one side of bagel with five slices of the bacon and cover with half the shredded lettuce
6. Top with a couple slices of tomato
7. Sprinkle salt and pepper on other side of bagel and sandwich together
8. Make the other bagel the same way

title: spiced brown rice with peanuts
steps:
1. In a large heavy saucepan heat the oil over moderate heat until it is hot
2. Add the cuminseed , cloves and the bay leaf and cook the spices , stirring , for 5 to 10 seconds or until the cuminseed is a few shades darker and fragrant
3. Add the chili pepper flakes , the onion and the garlic and cook the mixture , stirring , until the onion is softened
4. Add the rice and cook it , stirring , for 2 minutes , or until it is coated well with the oil
5. Add chicken stock
6. Bring it to a boil , and simmer the rice , covered , for 35 to 40 minutes , or until the water is absorbed and the rice is tender
7. Fluff the rice quickly with a fork
8. Remove the pan from the heat
9. Discard the bay leaf
10. Let rice stand , covered , for 10 minutes
11. Stir in the peanuts and serve

title: aunt nancy s peanut butter fudge
steps:
1. Mix in bowl- peanut butter and marshmellow cream and set to side
2. Mix sugar , butter , milk in saucepan and bring to a boil
3. Boil for 5 minutes
4. Remove from heat
5. Mix everything together
6. Put in cookie sheet
7. Let cool and harden

title: royal hot chocolate
steps:
1. In top of double boiler over hot , not boiling , water melt chocolate
2. Stir in sweetened condensed milk
3. Gradually add water , stirring until well blended
4. Stir in salt and vanilla
5. Serve hot , topped with whipped cream , if desired
6. Garnish with cinnamon

title: lamb shank dinner
steps:
1. Heat butter , oil & curry powder in a heavy pan & slowly brown lamb shanks on all sides
2. Add onion , stock , carrots & potatoes
3. Bring to the boil , then cover & simmer for 1 hour or until shanks are tender
4. Stir in fruit chutney & peas and heat through , add salt & pepper to taste and sprinkle with parsley to serve

title: liquid cocaine
steps: 1. Mix together in a shaker , strain into shot glasses !

title: slow cooker chuck roast barbecue
steps:
1. Chop onions and place in bottom of 4 quart slow cooker
2. Trim all visible fat off of roast , cut in half to ensure even cooking , and place on top of onions
3. Mix cola , worcestershire sauce , vinegar and minced garlic
4. Reserve 1 / 2 cup for use later , and pour the rest over the meat
5. Cover and cook on high for 6 hours or on low for 10 hours
6. When meat is done cooking and is very tender , remove meat and onions from the slow cooker with a slotted spoon
7. Discard cooking liquid in slow cooker
8. Add reserved sauce mixture and 1 / 2 cup bottled barbecue sauce to slow cooker and cook uncovered on high for 10 minutes
9. Meanwhile , shred roast with two forks
10. When sauce is finished , return shredded beef and onions to slow cooker , stir well , cover , and cook until heated through--about 10 minutes on high

title: fantastic meatloaf
steps:
1. Add all ingredients for meat loaf and mix well
2. Shape into loaf and put in loaf pan
3. Rough the top of meat with a fork and cover with the sauce ingredients which have been combined
4. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour

title: hot chicken sandwich
steps:
1. Mix together and cook in crock pot on low for 4-6 hours
2. Serve on hamburger buns or bread
3. May be frozen

title: jamaican easter bun
steps:
1. Measure all ingredients in a bowl and mix well
2. Pour into bun shaped baking pans , and bake in a moderate 350 degree oven until well done
3. Glaze with sugar and water or pancake syrup and serve

title: peanut butter silk pie ii
steps:
1. Filling
2. Beat cream cheese , sugar , peanut butter , butter and vanilla in a large bowl until creamy
3. Gently fold in half the beaten heavy cream , then fold in remaining cream until blended
4. Spread this mixture onto the crust , smoothing the top
5. Topping
6. Combine chocolate chips and coffee in a microwave proof dish
7. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high 1 1 / 2 to 2 minutes
8. Stir until smooth
9. Cool slightly
10. Pour the topping over top of the filling
11. Refrigerate the pie at least 1 hour till firm , then cover loosely and refrigerate over night
12. Sprinkle with chopped peanuts

title: chicken  cashews  red pepper and scallion stir fry
steps:
1. Now , it looks like a lot , but it is very easy
2. Just start each step and honestly it doesn't take any time
3. Chicken marinade -- in a small bowl , add the egg white , corn starch and soy sauce and whisk well
4. Add the chicken and toss well to combine
5. Just set off to the side on the counter
6. The chicken will come to room temp as it marinates
7. I like to let it set 30-45 minutes
8. This gives you time to prepare everything else
9. Cashews -- this only takes a few minutes
10. In the same large pan you are going to cook the chicken in , add the oil and bring to medium heat
11. Add the cashews and cook 2-3 minutes until golden brown
12. Once they are done , remove to a plate lined with a paper towel to drain
13. They don't need chopping , so they are ready to go
14. Wipe out the pan as you will be using this to make the chicken
15. Sauce -- in a small bowl or even a measuring cup , add the chicken broth , soy sauce , sherry wine , sugar , red pepper flakes and set to the side
16. Don't add the scallions yet
17. Rice -- start the rice as the chicken only takes a few minutes to cook
18. I use a quick cooking rice , but feel free to use your favorite
19. Right at the end of cooking , add in the water chestnuts
20. I make this ahead and just cover and set off to the side
21. Chicken -- time to stir fry ! this is quick so make sure you have the sauce nearby , the cashews and the rice is done
22. Heat that large pan up one more time
23. Now a wok is great if you have one , but not necessary
24. Add 1 tablespoon each peanut and sesame oil (don't leave out the sesame oil and bring to medium / high heat - high heat
25. Scoop the chicken out of the marinade , but use a slotted spoon , you don't want to get extra marinade in the pan
26. You can also strain it in a colander if you want
27. A slotted spoon works great and much easier
28. Add it to the hot oil and stir fry on each side until golden brown
29. It won't take more than 4-5 min tops
30. They cook very quick and you don't want to over cook them
31. Right before they are done , add in the scallions , red pepper strips and cashews
32. Stir to combine and then add in the sauce
33. Cook just a minute or two until the sauce is bubbly and thick
34. The pepper will still be a bit crunchy but tender and the chicken will be tender and done
35. And cook just a minute -- this will thicken it up quickly
36. Serve -- just top this wonderful chicken and sauce over the water chestnut rice
37. As i mentioned , i love a napa cabbage salad with carrots and a sesame dressing for a side , but add your favorites
38. This really may look like a lot , but they are all simple steps
39. Just follow the steps for a quick nice dinner
40. Enjoy !

title: quick baked fish fillets
steps:
1. Mix bread crumbs and spices from stuffing mix in one bowl
2. Mix egg and milk together in separate bowl
3. Add to bread crumb mixture red pepper flakes and cheese
4. Dip fish fillets in milk and egg mixture , then in stuffing mix
5. Place in lightly greased 9x13
6. Sprinkle the leftover stuffing mix on top of fish , and drizzle with 1 / 2 c butter
7. Bake 15 minutes at 400f

title: sausage stew
steps:
1. Brown sausage and onion- drain
2. Simmer until potatoes are tender
3. Heat through and serve

title: ham pot pie soup
steps:
1. Put ham in about 8 cups of water
2. Bring to a boil , turn down and simmer gently for 4 hours
3. Remove ham , chunk it up , then return back into the broth
4. Add onions and potatoes
5. While that is simmering , mix your flour , eggs and water to make a dough
6. Roll out to approximately 1 / 4" thick on a floured surface
7. Cut into 2" squares
8. Add these to the pot and simmer an additional 45-60 minutes or until dough squares are done !
9. You can also throw in some green beans if you like ! i add them closer to the end so they don't mush up too much :)

title: wheat germ posset
steps:
1. Heat milk in a pan to near boiling point
2. Remove from heat & stir in other ingredients
3. Sprinkle with cinnamon

title: tacos deluxe
steps:
1. For tacos , brown ground beef and onions in a skillet
2. Drain
3. Return beef and onions to skillet and add next 12 ingredients
4. Simmer uncovered for 10-15 minutes , or until moisture evaporates , stirring occasionally
5. Meanwhile , combine all ingredients for sweet and sour sauce and mix until well blended
6. Heat taco shells in oven
7. Fill taco shells with meat and top with shredded cheese , lettuce , tomatoes and sweet and sour sauce

title: pasta with spinach  sun dried tomatoes   artichoke hearts
steps:
1. Soak the sun-dried tomatoes in hot water for 30 minutes
2. Drain , and slice into thin strips
3. At the same time , take the spinach from the freezer and allow to semi-defrost in a colander
4. Cook pasta according to package directions
5. Saute onion and garlic in oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-low heat 2 to 3 minutes
6. Add mushrooms , soy sauce , and pepper and saute for another 3 minutes until vegetables are tender
7. Add tomatoes , artichoke hearts , olives and pine nuts
8. Mix well
9. Add spinach , mixing well until everything is combined and heating through
10. Add vegetable mixture to drained pasta
11. Add feta , and mix well
12. Serve !

title: sweet and sour sauce  china
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , the 2 ingredients , stirring constantly until melted & combined
2. Use as a dip or marinating sauce for chicken or other meat

title: butter   sage sauce over pasta
steps:
1. Put the butter in a skillet over medium heat
2. When the butter foam subsides and the butter is golden but not brown tear the sage leaves into 2 or 3 pieces and add to the butter
3. It is important that the butter reach this point
4. Resist the desire to add the sage too soon
5. Cook for about a minute while stirring , careful not to let the sage burn but it should take on a little color
6. Toss the with hot cooked pasta
7. Pass the cheese at the table

title: honey graham muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Place cupcake liners in muffin pan and set aside
3. In a medium mixing bowl combine crackers , sugar and baking powder
4. In a separate bowl lightly beat milk , egg whites , honey , and cinnamon
5. Add the milk mixture to the cracker mixture and stir just until moistened
6. Spoon batter into muffin pan and bake for about 15 minutes
7. Let stand 5 minutes
8. Remove from pan

title: ice cream sandwich birthday cake
steps:
1. Grease a 9x13 pan
2. I used coconut oil
3. Place ice cream sandwich bars in a single layer
4. Break them up to fill in all the space of the pan , as needed
5. Prepare pudding mix with milk , using a hand held electric mixer
6. Add 1 small container of frozen whipped topping and continue to beat until smooth
7. Spread pudding mix evenly over ice cream sandwich bars
8. Crush the cookies , leaving some of the cookies as chunks
9. I use a gallon freezer bag and a rolling pin , but you could pulse them in a food processor
10. Sprinkle cookies over pudding layer , reserving a cup or two for the final step
11. Spread the second container of frozen whipped topping over the cookie layer
12. Top with remaining cooking crumbs
13. Freeze at least several hours before serving

title: corn muffins with jalapenos and lime butter
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat
3. Add onion and garlic to pan
4. Cook 2 minutes stirring occasionally
5. Add corn , jalapeno and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt
6. Cook 2 minutes
7. Remove from heat
8. Add 2 tablespoons butter , tossing to melt
9. Combine flour , remaining 3 / 4 teasopon salt , cornmeal , and next 4 ingredients in a large bowl
10. Combine buttermilk , eggs and egg white in a large bowl
11. Add onion mixture to buttermilk mixture
12. Add buttermilk mixture to flour mixture , stirring just until moist
13. Spoon batter into 15 muffin cups coated with cooking spray
14. Bake for 20 minutes or until lightly browned
15. Cool in pan 5 minutes on a wire rack
16. Remove from pan
17. Cool completely
18. Combine remaining 3 tablespoons butter , juice and honey in a small bowl
19. Stir until well blended
20. Serve with muffins

title: abby s peaches  n cream oven puffed pancakes
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425f
2. Mix flour , sugar , salt , milk and eggs
3. Beat with a wire whisk or eggbeater until smooth
4. Place margarine or butter in a 9 inch pie pan
5. Melt at 425f for 2-4 minutes or until the butter sizzles
6. Remove pan from oven , tilting the pan to coat bottom
7. Immediately pour batter into the hot pan
8. Top with peach slices , pecans and cinnamon
9. Bake at 425f for 16-20 minutes or until puffed and golden brown
10. Meanwhile in a small bowl , combine cream sauce ingredients , mixing well
11. Cut pancake into wedges
12. Serve immediately with cream sauce

title: turkey cutlets with tomato olive relish
steps:
1. Prepare outdoor grill for barbecuing
2. With a meat mallet , pound each turkey cutlet to 1 / 4-inch thickness
3. Rub cutlets with 1 tsp salt and set aside
