4. Prepare tomato-olive relish: chop tomatoes and olives
5. Place in a bowl
6. Stir in capers , vinegar , sugar , 1 tablespoon olive or salad oil , and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt
7. In a small bowl , mix minced basil and 1 / 4 cup olive or salad oil
8. Place cutlets on grill over medium heat
9. Brush with oil mixture
10. Cook 5 minutes or until lightly browned and tender , turning cutlets occasionally and brushing with oil mixture , cook until no longer pink inside
11. Place turkey cutlets on platter
12. Top with tomato-olive relish and garnish with basil leaves

title: sourdough chicken pesto panini
steps:
1. Pound the chicken breast to a uniform thickness
2. Sprinkle both sides with the grill seasoning
3. Grease pan with cooking spray
4. Grill up the chicken till cooked through
5. Slice chicken into 1 inch strips
6. Next get your bread ready , you will need 2 slices , butter both slices on one side
7. And spread pesto on one side of one slice
8. Cut 2 1 / 2 inch thick slices off of fresh mozzarella ball
9. Now we are ready to layer
10. Start with one slice bread then add chicken strips , mozzarella and the top slice of bread with the pesto on it
11. Press and enjoy !

title: honey butter shanachie
steps:
1. Warm the butter -- don't need to melt it
2. Add the honey to the butter
3. Form into a block and chill to reform the shape
4. Alternately , you can form a log , chill into molds , cut pats , etc

title: choc ripple cake
steps:
1. Add sugar and a drop of vanilla essence to the cream and whip until very stiff
2. Join biscuits together by standing a biscuit on its side and sandwich with the next biscuit using a generous spread of cream
3. Continue until all the biscuits have been used and resemble a log
4. Cover the log / ring thickly and entirely with the remaining cream
5. Place in refrigerator for at least 6 hours to set
6. Before serving , decorate with crushed pepermint crisp
7. When serving , cut cake at a slight angle to ensure alternate layers of chocolate biscuit and cream are in each slice

title: sticky date pudding with caramel sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180oc
2. Grease and line the base of 23cm deep round cake tin
3. Put the dates in a pan with 1 3 / 4 cups water , bring to the boil then remove from the heat
4. Add the bicarbonate of soda and ginger and leave to stand for 5 minutes
5. Coarsley mash with a potato masher
6. Cream together the butter , sugar and 1 egg
7. Beat in the remaining eggs one at a time
8. Once the eggs are well beaten , gently fold in the sifted flour and spices , add the date mixture and stir until well combined
9. Pour into the tin and bake for 55-60 minutes , or until a skewer comes out clean when inserted into the middle
10. Cover with foil if over browning during cooking
11. Leave to stand for 5 minutes before turning out onto a serving plate
12. To make caramel sauce: put all the ingredients in a pan and stir over low heat until the sugar has dissolved
13. Simmer uncovered , for about 3 minutes , or until thickened slightly
14. Brush some sauce over the top and sides of the pudding until well glazed
15. Serve immediately with the sauce and a dollop of cream

title: crazy chicken   rice noodle stir fry
steps:
1. Fill up a large bowl with warm water
2. Add the noodles and soak them until they are tender , about 20 minutes
3. Drain and set aside
4. While the noodles are soaking , you can combine the fish sauce , lime juice , sugar and sambal - in a small bowl
5. Stir until dissolved
6. Heat up a wok or large skillet over high heat
7. Add the oil and swirl to coat the pan
8. Add the shallots and stir-fry until brown - about 1 minute
9. Add the chicken and stir-fry , breaking up the meat , until cooked through - about 3 minutes or so
10. Add the noodles and sauce mixture and heat through , stirring
11. Add the scallions and basil ribbons and give them a toss
12. Garnish with the lime wedges and basil sprigs and serve immediately

title: smashed  roasted red potatoes
steps:
1. Wash and scrub potatoes
2. Leave skin on
3. Place in large pot filled with water until potatoes are covered and add salt
4. Bring to boiling , boil until knife goes through potato easily
5. Drain and lay potatoes on clean dish towel until dry and cooled enough to handle
6. Mean while line a baking sheet with foil and drizzle a small amount of olive oil over foil
7. Heat oven to 375f
8. When potatoes are cooled place potato on pan and smash with palm of your hand or heavy spatula until potato is flattened repeat with all potatoes
9. Season with salt and pepper
10. Drizzle with olive oil
11. Top with herbs and parmesan
12. If using other cheeses wait until last few minutes of cooking to melt cheese
13. Bake until golden about 15 to 20 minutes
14. Remove with spatula

title: weight watchers santa fe rice and beans
steps:
1. In crock pot , add cooked rice , then add corn , pinto beans then chunk up cheese
2. Cook on low until all cheese is melted and the mixture is thoroughly heated

title: armenian spinach plum salad
steps:
1. Combine spinach , cucumber , onion , parsley , pistachios , and plums in a salad bowl
2. Combine dressing ingredients
3. Pour dressing over salad mixture and toss well to blend

title: orange blossom yogurt dressing with fruit
steps:
1. Peel and chop apple , slice each date into 3 or 4 slivers , wash and halve grapes and wash berries
2. Arrange fruit on a plate or in a bowl
3. Top with sliced almonds and finely chopped pistachios
4. Mix balkan yogurt with unpasteurized honey and orange blossom water
5. Drizzle dressing over fruit
6. Enjoy !

title: the easiest egg drop soup
steps:
1. Boil water with boullien cubes until dissolved
2. Crack eggs into a seperate bowl
3. Whisk eggs with a fork until blended
4. Slowly pour eggs into water , breaking up the pieces with a fork when they hit the water
5. Eggs will cook immediatley once in the water
6. Turn heat on stove to medium / low
7. Add pinch of sugar , drop or two of soy sauce and optional veggies
8. Stir
9. Spoon into bowl and serve

title: pork with gorgonzola sauce
steps:
1. For pork:
2. Oil large rimmed baking sheet
3. Whisk dijon mustard , olive oil and thyme in small bowl to blend
4. Sprinkle pork tenderloins with salt and pepper
5. Heat heavy large nonstick skillet over high heat
6. Add pork and sear until brown all over , turning occasionally , about 10 minutes
7. Transfer seared pork to prepared baking sheet
8. Spread dijon mustard mixture over all sides of pork
9. Preheat oven to 425f roast pork until thermometer inserted into thickest part of meat registers 150f , about 30 minutes
10. Remove from oven and let stand 5 minutes
11. Meanwhile , prepare sauce:
12. Melt 1 tablespoon butter in heavy small saucepan over medium heat
13. Add 1 tablespoon flour and whisk 1 minute
14. Gradually whisk in whipping cream , white wine and chicken broth
15. Boil until mixture is thick enough to coat spoon , whisking frequently , about 1 minute
16. Add crumbled gorgonzola and whisk until cheese is melted and smooth and sauce is reduced to desired consistency , about 5 minutes
17. Slice pork and transfer to plates
18. Ladle some sauce over pork
19. Serve , passing additional sauce separately

title: hash i   biksemad
steps:
1. Cook main ingredients separately
2. Saut each in butter , seasoning lightly
3. Then stir together
4. Serve very hot

title: candied grapefruit peel
steps:
1. With peel still on fruit , quarter peel lengthwise then remove , keeping pieces of peel intact
2. Reserve fruit for another use
3. Diagonally cut pieces of peel into 1 / 3-inch-wide strips
4. Put peel in a 3-quart saucepan filled with cold water and bring slowly to a boil over moderate heat
5. Boil 1 minute and drain
6. Repeat procedure 4 times to remove bitterness
7. Have ready a lightly oiled large rack set in a shallow baking pan
8. Bring regular granulated sugar and water to a boil in a large heavy skillet , stirring until sugar is dissolved
9. Add peel and boil , stirring , until most of syrup is absorbed , about 10 minutes
10. Turn out peel onto rack , separating pieces
11. Dry candied peel , uncovered , at room temperature until only slightly sticky , 4 to 8 hours
12. Toss , a few pieces at a time , in superfine sugar , shaking off excess
13. Cooks'
14. Peel will still be good but will have a different appearance and wont need a sugar coating
15. Candied peel keeps in an airtight container at room temperature 1 week or chilled 1 month
16. If chilled peel becomes too moist , pat dry and reroll in sugar

title: summer smoothie
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Blend until smooth

title: lemon  orange and dill salad dressing
steps: 1. Put all of the ingredients into a jar , replace the lid and shake well to mix

title: peanut butter chocolate bars
steps:
1. Sift the confectioners sugar into a mixing bowl
2. Add melted buter and peanut butter
3. Mix on medium speed of electric mixer until well mixed
4. Add graham cracker crumbs to the peanut butter mixture
5. Use your hands to squish it together until the crumbs are well mixed
6. Dump the mixture into the pan
7. Use your hands to spread it around
8. Press very hard to make it one big flat piece
9. Melt chocolate chips in saucepan over very low heat
10. Stir until creamy and completely melted
11. Pour the melted chocolate over the peanut butter layer
12. Use the spoon to spread it evenly like frosting
13. Wait until the chocolate hardens and cut it into tiny squares

title: greek spaghetti   ww core
steps:
1. Cook pasta , drain and set aside
2. Heat oil in large skillet
3. Add onion and garlic , saute over medium heat for about 2 minutes
4. Drain artichokes and chop in half
5. Add olives , oregano and lemon juice to the onion and garlic mixture
6. Heat for 2 minutes , then add artichokes
7. Cook for an additional minute
8. Combine pasta , artichoke mixture and cheeses
9. Toss to coat pasta and serve immediately

title: bagel tuna melt
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Have ready an ungreased baking sheet
3. In a mixing bowl , combine tuna , onion , pepper , mayo and worcestershire
4. Taste and add salt and / or pepper if you wish
5. In the toaster , toast bagel halves
6. Place all 4 on baking sheet
7. On a bagel half , place one slice tomato , then one-quarter of tuna mixture , then 1 slice cheese
8. Repeat with other bagel halves
9. Bake for 5 minutes , or until cheese melts
10. If you wish , quickly broil to brown melted cheese

title: new york cheesecake with lorna doone cookie crust
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. For crust:
3. Finely crush entire pkg of cookies , mix in the butter
4. This can be done in a food processor on pulse
5. Butter the sides of the springform pan
6. Press the cookie mixture into bottom of 9 inch springform pan
7. Do not bake
8. For filling:
9. Beat together cream cheese , sugar , flour and zests
10. Add the 5 eggs and 2 egg yolks one at a time
11. Add the vanilla into the cream , and then add the cream to the cheese mixture
12. Beat on low speed until all ingredients are incorporated
13. Place the springform pan with crust in the center of a shallow baking pan
14. Pour filling into crust , it will be completely full
15. Place in the middle of oven for 12 minutes
16. Reduce oven temp to 250f and continue baking until the center is mostly firm but still has a slight jiggle
17. After removing from oven , run a knife around the edge and cool on a rack for 6 hours remove side of springform pan and transer to a flat plate
18. It can be kept refrigerated for up to 2 weeks , but is best served after allowing to return to room temperature

title: stuffed with love shrooms
steps:
1. Arrange mushrooms in a large glass casserole dish , set aside
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
3. In a pan , saut mushroom stems , garlic , and olive oil for about 3- 4 minutes
4. Add wine and continue to saut for about 5-10 minutes
5. Remove mixture from heat and place in a bowl
6. Stir in bread crumbs , chopped bacon , parsley , mayo and gorgonzola cheese
7. Mix well
8. Scoop small amounts of mixture into each mushroom cap
9. Bigger caps will need more of the mixture
10. Sprinkle tops with salt and pepper
11. Cut provolone cheese into fourths
12. Place small pieces of provolone onto each mushroom cap
13. Cook in oven uncovered for 20-35 minutes
14. The bottom of the casserole dish will be wet when mushrooms are ready , and the cheese on top should be brown and bubbly
15. Rice complements this nicely !

title: delicious cinnamon popcorn
steps:
1. Place the popped popcorn in a large bowl
2. Place the butter with sugar and cinnamon in a microwave-safe bowl , then microwave for 1 minute on high
3. Remove and stir then place back and microwave for 1 more minute or until the butter is melted
4. Pour over the popcorn and toss well to coat
5. Divide the mixture between two 15 x 10-inch baking sheets
6. Bake at 300 degrees f for 10 minutes
7. Cool then store in an airtight container

title: fresh fruit salad with poppy seed dressing
steps:
1. Combine dressing ingredients in small bowl
2. Arrange fruit in bowls and top with dressing
3. Enjoy

title: shortbread cookies with jam or jelly centers
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar
2. Beat in extract
3. Gradually blend in flour
4. Cover and refrigerate for an hour
5. Roll into one-inch balls and place one inch apart on un-greased cookie sheet
6. With the end of a wooden spoon make a indention in the ball and fill with jam
7. I have used variety of jams and jellies raspberry being the best ! but apricot is yummmie too , along with apple , blackberry , blueberry the possibilities are endless
8. Bake at 350 for 14 to 18 minute

title: frito chili dog casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Heat nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
3. Add beef , hot dogs , onion and seasoning mix
4. Cook , stirring , until beef is browned and onion is just tender , 4-5 minutes
5. Stir in diced tomatoes with their juices , tomato sauce and water
6. Transfer to 2-quart baking dish
7. In bowl , combine muffin mix , milk , egg and 1 / 4 cup cheese
8. Spread over beef mixture , leaving 2" border
9. Sprinkle with chips and remaining cheese
10. Bake until bubbly and topping is cooked through , 20-25 minutes

title: grilled chicken breasts with lime and dill
steps:
1. Combine all marinade ingredients in heavy ziplock bag and mix
2. Add chicken breasts , seal
3. Turn bag to coat
4. Let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes
5. Cover grill with foil
6. Place breats on foil and cook on grill at low heat setting
7. Cook for 20-30 minutes depending on size of breasts
8. Meanwhile melt the butter
9. Baste the breasts with butter when done
10. Can serve with buttered noodles

title: creamy meatballs crock pot
steps:
1. Saute the onion in half the butter until golden brown
2. Put the onion in the crock pot
3. Mix together the beef , eggs , salt and pepper
4. Form into meatballs , and brown in the same pan the onions were cooked inches
5. Sprinkle on a mixture made of the flour , tarragon and marjoram
6. Shake the fry pan to turn the meatballs and coat them with the flour mixture
7. Put into the crock pot
8. Mix together the tomato paste , beef stock , worcestershire sauce and the vinegar in the fry pan , scraping the bottom of the pan
9. Cook for 2 minutes
10. Pour over meatballs
11. Cover and cook on low 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours
12. Melt remaining butter and saute the mushrooms
13. Add the mushrooms and the sour cream to the meatballs and heat through

title: asian sticky chicky
steps:
1. Heat sesame oil in a skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add chicken thighs to the skillet
3. Quickly brown on both sides
4. Add all remaining ingredients except the chopped scallions
5. Bring just to a boil
6. Reduce heat
7. Cover and gently simmer for about 30 minutes
8. Remove lid and turn over thighs
9. Continue to cook uncovered until sauce is a thick glaze
10. This may take only a few minutes
11. Careful not to let it burn
12. Place on a platter or plates and sprinkle with the scallions

title: chili roasted peanuts with dried cherries
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a small sauce pan
2. Coat the raw peanuts with the melted butter
3. Mix together all remaining ingredients
4. Toast the peanuts in a 300-325f oven for about 10 minutes shaking the pan occasionally
5. Transfer the peanuts to a large bowl and toss to coat with the mixed dry ingredients
6. Mix in cherries until uniformly blended
7. Cover and store at room temperature

title: thanksgiving turkeys  cookies
steps:
1. Spread chocolate icing on sugar cookies
2. Unwrap peanut butter cups
3. Place pb cup on lower half of frosted cookie
4. Fan 5-6 candy corns around top of pb cup to make the "feathers
5. "
6. Make the eyes and gobbler on the neck with the red gel icing
7. Enjoy !

title: balsamic glazed cracked pepper salmon
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat
2. Season both sides of salmon with salt and cracked pepper
3. Add salmon to skillet and cook 1 to 2 minutes per side , until golden brown
4. Meanwhile , in a small bowl , whisk together vinegar and honey
5. Add vinegar mixture to skillet and simmer until fish is fork tender and liquid reduces and thickens , about 2 minutes

title: beer marinated grilled skirt steak
steps:
1. In a wide , shallow glass baking dish , scatter half of the orange slices , half of the onion slices and half of the garlic pieces on the bottom of the dish
2. Sprinkle the steak all over with salt and pepper and put in the dish on top of the orange and onion slices
3. Scatter the remaining orance , onion and garlic over the steak and pour in the beer and soy sauce
4. Cover with plastic wrap and marinate for 1 hour at room temperature or up to overnight in the refrigerator
5. Prepare a barbeque on medium-high heat or prepare a broiler
6. Remove themeat from the marinade and discard the marinade
7. Grill the steak to desired doneness , about 4 minutes per side for medium rare
8. Serve as desired
9. Grilled skirt steak sliced into strips is a great filling for tacos
10. Top with shredded cheese and beans , or use your favorite taco fillings

title: chicken fried rice   restaurant style
steps:
1. Wash rice and cook with a couple pinches of salt
2. Then , put it on a plate and cover with saran wrap and allow to cool in fridge for at least 1 hour
3. Slice the chicken to the size of 3 quarter dollars put together , or cut to your preference
4. Partially freeze the meat to make meat easier to cut small
5. Put the chicken in a small bowl
6. Add the cornstarch , garlic powder , 1 / 2 the salt , 1 / 2 the sugar , 1 / 2 the white pepper , 1 / 2 the msg and 2 teaspoons of water
7. Mix by hand to coat the meat
8. This step keeps the meat juicy while cooking in hot oil
9. Heat 3 tablespoons oil in your wok at 80% heat
10. Add the chicken and cook until white
11. Drain off the oil and set meat aside
12. Add the remaining tablespoon of oil to the wok
13. Heat to 60% heat and add the beaten egg
14. Allow the egg to cook before stirring it
15. Stirring the egg while it is setting will make the egg more fluffy , like scrambled eggs
16. Turn the heat up to 80% and add the onion
17. Cook for 30 seconds and then add the cooled rice
18. Keep flipping or turning the rice over to heat it evenly in the pan for 1 minute
19. Add the remaining salt , sugar , white pepper , and msg
20. Continue turning the rice for another minute
21. Add the chicken , oyster sauce , soy sauce , and peas and carrots
22. Continue turning and flipping for 3 minutes

title: jan s marinara sauce
steps:
1. In 3 quart saucepan heat oil
2. Chop garlic , onions and parsley finely
3. Add to saucepan and saute
4. Add chopped pepper to onions and saute over medium heat for about 10 minutes
5. Chop tomatoes coarsely and add
6. Stir in seasonings
7. Simmer uncovered until thick , about 2 hours
8. Freeze in 2 cup containers
9. For spaghetti sauce: 1 lb ground beef 2 cups marinara sauce 1 cup tomato sauce

title: preston county raised buckwheat cakes
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix 1 cake fleishman's yeast or 1 envelope dry yeast and 1 teaspoon salt into one quart lukewarm water
2. Let stand a few minutes and then add 3 cups , or enough buckwheat flour to make a stiff batter ,
3. Cover and let stand overnight
4. When ready to bake the cakes , dissolve 1 / 2 teaspoon baking soda , 1 / 2 teaspoon baking powder , and 2 teaspoons sugar in 1 cup hot water
5. Stir into batter , then add about 1 cup or enough warm water to make a thin batter
6. Bake on a hot , greased griddle
7. Use a long thin metal turner to lift edges and check bottom , it should be golden brown and bubbles should form on top , flip a cook on other side till done
8. We usually serve stacks of 2-4 cakes each
9. Save at least 1 cup of the batter for the next baking
10. To renew , add 1 pint lukewarm water , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and enough buckwheat flour to make a stiff batter
11. Cover and let stand overnight

title: lentils with garlic and rosemary  crock pot
steps:
1. Combine first 11 ingredients in an electric slow cooker
2. Cover with lid , and cook on high-heat setting for 3 to 4 hours , or until lentils are tender
3. Discard bay leaf
4. Garnish with parsley , if desired

title: spinach  mushroom omelet w feta cheese
steps:
1. Heat oil in a small skillet on med heat
2. Add spinach and mushrooms , saut until spinach is wilted but a bright green color and mushrooms are warmed all the way through
3. Add eggs
4. Cook until eggs are firm , can flip to make sure the eggs are cooked all the way through
5. Add feta cheese , fold in half and serve

title: sugar free apple almond cake topping
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together and spread onto cake
2. Place whole apple on top for looks

title: smoked corn and pepper chowder
steps:
1. Prepare charcoal or gas grill or traditional smoker for indirect smoking on low heat
2. Use one layer charcoal for smoker and place food on top grate
3. For best results for this recipe , use hickory or mesquite wood chips or chunks
4. Place corn and peppers on cooking grate of fully smoking grill or smoker
5. Smoke 1 to 1-1 / 2 hours over charcoal or 20 minutes over gas
6. Remove corn and pepper
7. Allow to cool
8. Cut corn kernels from the cob with a sharp knife
9. Remove seeds from jalapeno
10. I like to keep some in and diced
11. In a dutch oven , cook bacon over low heat until crisp
12. Add onions and cook 2 minutes or until transparent
13. Add green and red peppers and continue to cook for 6 minutes , until peppers are tender
14. Add flour
15. Stir and cook for 3 minutes
16. Add chicken stock gradually , stirring to combine
17. Bring to a boil , stirring frequently
18. Add smoked corn kernels , peppers , potatoes , and bay leaf
19. Simmer 20 minutes
20. Add heavy cream , salt , worcestershire sauce , white pepper , and hot pepper sauce
21. Return to a simmer for 1 minute

title: chocolate nut   craisin clusters
steps:
1. Melt chocolate chips in microwave for about 2 minutes
2. Chips will not appear melted
3. However , stir them to distribute the heat and get them melted
4. Add nuts and craisins , stirring until well coated
5. Drop teaspoonfuls onto a wax-paper lined cookie sheet
6. Place into refrigerator for about 1 hour
7. Check chips at about 2 1 / 2 minutes and add small amounts of time until chips are melted
8. It takes a bit under 3 minutes for a double recipe in my microwave

title: chunky vegetable lentil soup  gluten free  vegan
steps:
1. In a large pot , heat olive oil , add chopped onions and saut until onions are translucent and soft
2. Add minced garlic and saut 2 more minutes
3. Add celery , carrots , potato , kale , paprika and herbs and saut for a few more minutes stirring frequently
4. Add lentils , water , crushed tomatoes and tomato paste
5. Bring to a boil , cover and simmer over low heat for 25 minutes
6. Add salt , infuse love and serve !

title: sweet and spicy garden relish  chow chow
steps:
1. Grate all the vegetables equalling 4 quarts , in a food processor then place in a large container
2. Add salt , cover with water and allow to stand for 1 hour
3. While the vegetables are soaking , in a large pot , add the sugar , vinegar and pickling spice
4. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer
5. Drain and rinse the vegetables well squeezing out all liquid
6. Add to the pot and bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat
8. Simmer 30 minutes
9. Stir frequently
10. Pour the relish into hot , sterilized pint jars
11. Wipe rims , place lids and screw bands on finger
12. Remove to a protected surface to cool , undisturbed , for 24 hours

title: garden frittata
steps:
1. Pre heat oven to 400
2. Mix all ingredients in a large mixing bowl
3. Spray an 8x8-inch baking dish with a nonstick cooking spray and pour all ingredients into the dish
4. Bake for 30-45 minutes depending on your oven
5. When done let the frittata sit for 15 minutes and then slice and serve
6. Use your imagination and use different vegetables or whatever you have on hand

title: stuffed mexican chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f
2. Combine bread crumb ingredients in a ziplock bag
3. Dip chicken breast into melted butter then shake in bread crumb mixture
4. Lay chicken pieces flat and put cheese and chopped jalapeno slices on top
5. Fold and fasten with toothpick
6. Place in 13x9 inch baking dish
7. Bake , uncovered for 40 minutes

title: silver spoon fruity chutney
steps:
1. Sterilise canning jars by putting them on an oven tin in a cold oven , and heating oven to 325 deg f / 160 deg c for at least 10 - 15 minutes
2. Handle carefully when taking them out -- take out the entire tin with the bottles
3. Less mess
4. Combine all the prepared ingredients in a large dutch oven or heavy-bottomed pot
5. Bring to boil over high heat , then turn heat down and simmer , stirring now and then
6. Simmer open until the fruits are tender and the mixture has the consistency of a preserve or relish
7. Ladle into the hot sterilised jars , and seal
8. Well-sealed , this will keep almost forever

title: chihuahua chili
steps:
1. In large pot , heat oil
2. Saute onion until transluscent , about 3 to 4 minutes
3. Add garlic and saute 2 minutes more
4. Add tomatoes , enchilada sauce , beer , beans , cumin and chili powder
5. Bring to boil
6. Simmer , partially covered , until slightly thickened and flavors have mingled , about 1 hour on the stovetop
7. Serve with toppings
8. If freezing , divide into dinner portions suitable for your family
9. Cool , label and freeze
10. To serve: defrost and reheat
11. Serve with cheddar cheese , sour cream and chopped cilantro
12. Shepherds bread with butter is a great accompaniment
13. If youd like , you can omit the beer , just add water or broth if the chili is too thick without the beer

title: waldorf astoria red velvet cake  1920s recipe
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350f
2. Butter three 9" round cake pans and line them with parchment paper or waxed paper
3. Melt chocolate in a metal bowl set over a saucepan of boiling water or in the top of a double boiler
4. Meanwhile
5. Place the sugar , eggs , oil and vanilla in the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with a paddle attachment and mix on low speed for two minutes
6. In a mixing bowl , sift together the flour , baking soda and salt
7. Add the dry ingredients to the egg mixture and continue to mix on low speed , scraping down the sides of the bowl with a spatula so everything is well incorporated
8. Add the melted chocolate to this mixture and continue to mix on low speed
9. Add the pureed beets and food coloring
10. Continue to mix on low speed until everything is thoroughly combined
11. Evenly divide the batter between the three prepared pans and tap down to remove air bubbles
12. Bake in the middle of the oven for 20 25 minutes or until center of cake springs back when touched , or when an inserted toothpick comes out clean
13. Remove the pans from the oven and transfer to a cooling rack
14. Let cool for ten minutes in the pans , then turn the layers out onto the rack and let cool completely
15. Icing: pour cream into a small bowl and whip to soft peaks
16. Set aside in the refrigerator
17. Place the cream cheese in the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with a paddle attachment and mix on low speed until it is soft and smooth
18. Add the mascarpone and continue to mix on low speed until the cheeses are well combined
19. Add the vanilla and powdered sugar and mix until everything is just combined
20. Turn off the mixer and fold in the whipped cream by hand with a spatula
21. Keep refrigerated until ready to assemble
22. Chefs
23. Original posters

title: fat free brownies
steps:
1. Combine the flour , cocoa , sugar , salt , stir to mix
2. Stir in the applesauce , vanilla , egg whites
3. Fold in the nuts if desired
4. Spray an 8 x 8 pan with cooking spray , spread the batter evenly in the pan , and bake in a preheated 325 oven for 23-25 minutes , or until the edges are firm and the center almost set
5. Cool to room temp , cut into squares and eat

title: fluffy 2 step cheesecake  courtesy of cool whip
steps:
1. Beat cream cheese and sugar in a large bowl with an electric mixer on high speed until smooth
2. Gently stir in whipped topping
3. Spoon into crust
4. Refrigerate 3hrs or until firm
5. Garnish with fruit of your choice or leave plain with a dollop of cool whip on top

title: savory lemon fish
steps:
1. Press or finely chop garlic cloves , then saute in a saucepan sprayed with cooking spray
2. It may stick , that's okay
3. When garlic starts to brown , add chicken stock and stir
4. Mix lemon juice and cornstarch , then add to chicken stock
5. When mixture begins to thicken , add enough sugar to balance the tartness , then add cayenne
6. Place on low heat
7. Rinse fish and spray with cooking spray
8. Mix remaining spices and sprinkle half over fish
9. Broil fish until it flakes easily , flipping once and applying the rest of the spices
10. Put fish on plates and pour sauce over top

title: mary s peanut butter squares
steps:
1. Mix the first 4 ingredients together
2. Pat into the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish
3. Melt the chocolate chips in double broiler
4. Pour over pressed mixture
5. Let cool completely and cut into squares

title: grilled mediterranean bread crisps
steps:
1. Heat gas or charcoal grill
2. In small bowl , mix butter and cheese
3. Set aside
4. Place bread on grill over medium heat
5. Cover grill , cook 3-5 minutes or until lightly toasted
6. Spread cheese mixture over toasted sides of bread
7. Sprinkle with olives
8. Place bread , olive sides up , on grill
9. Cover
10. Cook 3-5 minutes or until cheese is melted
11. Garnish with oregano leaves

title: peach  ginger upside down cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. To make the topping , heat the butter , honey , and brown sugar in a small saucepan , stirring , until the butter and sugar melt
3. Pour into a deep 9 inch cake pan , then lay the peach slices over it in attractive concentric circles
4. To make the cake , sift together the flour , baking powder , baking soda , ginger , cinnamon , cloves , and salt
5. Meanwhile , in a bowl , beat together the butter and sugar until light and fluffy
6. Add the eggs , one at a time , beating well after each
7. Stir in the molasses and vanilla
8. The batter may look curdled-don't worry !
9. Add the flour mixture , mixing until just incorporated
10. Spread the batter over the peaches in the prepared pan
11. Bake the cake for 45 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center emerges clean
12. Cool for 5 minutes in the pan , then invert to finish cooling
13. Serve with a dollop of whipped cream or ice cream on the side , if desired
14. The skin will easily slip off

title: tried and true potato salad
steps:
1. In the bottom of large serving bowl , whisk together vinegar , salt , pepper , sugar , and mayonnaise until well combined
2. Add in celery , onion , potatoes , and eggs
3. Stir to combine well
4. Refrigerate until serving time

title: speckkartoffel  potatoes with bacon
steps:
1. In a skillet , melt the lard and briefly fry the onions and bacon
2. Add the sliced potatoes and saute until golden brown
3. Add salt and pepper to taste , and gently stir in the sour cream
4. Serves 4

title: thai style crab cakes
steps:
1. Gently toss the crabmeat with lemon juice and ginger
2. Set aside
3. In oil , saute' onions , pepper , and garlic until it is all soft
4. Let cool and toss with crabmeat
5. Add remaining ingredients , except for breadcrumbs
6. Form into small patties , about 2
7. 5" in diameter
8. Place on wax paper in freezer for 30 minutes
9. Remove from freezer and pat with bread crumbs on both sides
10. Palace on parchment-covered baking sheet and bake for 2 minutes at 350 , or until browned
11. Top with 1 t sweet chili sauce and serve

title: the best mocha buttercream frosting   icing
steps:
1. In your mixer , beat the softened butter with the powdered sugar until it is creamy
2. Add in the cocoa powder , vanilla extract & coffee
3. Beat with the mixer until it's nice and fluffy
4. This makes a perfectly spreadable frosting
5. The nice thing about it is that you can put it in the fridge to make it a little more firm if you would like

title: orange cardamom currant bread
steps:
1. Add ingredients to bread machine pan in the order suggested by manufactuer , adding yogurt with water and currants with flour
2. Recommended cycle , basic / white bread cycle
3. Light or medium / normal color setting

title: best cheesecake in the world recipe
steps:
1. Mix 1st 5 ingredients together well and keep aside
2. Crush graham crackers
3. Mix in butter and icing sugar
4. Pour into pie plate
5. Cook crust for 5-10 minutes at 300f
6. Let cool
7. Pour cheese mixture over crust and bake in 300f oven for 40 minutes

title: red lentil   caramelised onion soup
steps:
1. Rinse the lentils and rice in cold water and drain
2. Combine the 4 cups of stock and the water in large saucepan and bring to boil
3. Add the lentils , rice and cumin and return to the boil
4. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered , stirring occasionally until just tender , approx 15 minutes
5. Meanwhile , melt butter in large fry pan , add onion and cook until softens , add sugar and vinegar and cook stirring until onion caramelises , remove from heat
6. Stir the cayenne , coriander and parsley into the lentil mixture and bring to the boil
7. Stir in the caramelised onion mixture and the extra cup of stock , cook , stirring , until heated through

title: roasted summer veggies
steps:
1. Wash zucchini , carrots and potatoes , leaving stems and skins intact , dry well
2. Arrange on greased grill or place in shallow foil baking dish
3. Brush with oil and sprinkle with salt
4. Cook over medium hot coals or on medium setting or bake in 375f oven for about 30 minutes or until veggies are slightly browned and shriveled
5. Garnish with parsley , if using

title: mango otai
steps:
1. Peel and chop mangos into small chunks
2. In a large container or bowl add mangos , heavy cream , pineapple juice , coconut cream , sugar and crushed ice
3. Mix with a large spoon to blend ingredients and dissolve sugar
4. Refrigerate or serve immediately
5. Drink must be stirred before serving if it is held in the refrigerator

title: brainless banana pancakes
steps:
1. In a large bowl , sift the flour and baking powder together
2. In a small bowl , mash the banana with a fork and add 1 / 4 cup of the milk , mixing together until there are no lumps
3. Add the banana mixture , sugar or honey , and remaining soy milk to the dry mix and stir together until "just mixed
4. "
5. Portion out about 3 / 4 to 1 cup of batter onto a hot non-stick pan or a lightly oiled frying pan and cover with a lid
6. Let sit on medium heat until the center starts to bubble and become sturdy
7. Flip pancake over and cook other side until golden brown
8. Repeat process until all the batter is gone
9. Garnish with fresh fruit and maple syrup

title: iced louisiana apricot tea
steps:
1. In a heatproof pitcher , pour just-boiled water over the tea bags & rosemary , & let steep for 10 minutes before removing & discarding the tea bags
2. Let tea cool , then chill in the refrigerator for 1 hour before removing & discarding the rosemary
3. Stir in the apricot nectar & apricots & pour into 6 tall glasses with 2 ice cubes in each glass
4. Top each drink with some of the sparkling water & enjoy !

title: grilled pineapple with basil and mint
steps:
1. Cut the tops off the pineapples and set aside some of the leaves for garnishing later
2. Carefully peel of the skin with a serrated knife and cut off the bottoms
3. Slice into 4 , 1 inch thick circles , then with an apple corer , remove the core of each round of pineapple
4. Together place the brown sugar , butter , mint , basil into a small saucepan and melt together
5. Bring to the boil for 1-3 minutes or until syrupy then set aside
6. Heat a griddle until it gets so hot it begins to smoke
7. With a pastry brush , brush a thin layer of the sauce onto each piece of pineapple and griddle in 2 batches for 4-5 mins on each side or until the pineapple rings are slightly charred
8. Serve 2 rings per person with a drizzle of the hot sauce and a scoop of vanilla ice cream

title: veal zurich
steps:
1. Saute veal and pork in oil , set aside
2. Saute mushrooms , until brown , add to veal
3. Heat butter in skillet , add shallots
4. Add wine , reduce to almost gone , add chicken broth and meat drippings
5. Cook down by 1 / 3 , add spices and sour cream
6. Add meat and mushrooms back to pan to heat through
7. Serve with noodles

title: quick red chicken chili  with chocolate
steps:
1. Prepare the chickens by pulling all the meat from the bones and tearing into bite sized pieces
2. Reserve the bones and skin
3. Combine the chicken bones and skin , chicken broth and 4 cups of water in a large pot and bring to a boil over a medium-high heat
4. Reduce heat to low , partially cover and simmer until the bones release their flavour - about 30 minutes
5. Strain the broth into a large bowl , now discard the bones and skin
6. Heat oil in a large roasting pan set over 2 burners on medium-high heat
7. Add onions and saute until soft - about 5 minutes
8. Add chili powder , cumin and oregano , reduce heat to a medium-low & cook , stirring until spices are fragrant
9. 1-2 minutes
10. Stir in chicken , tomatoes and broth
11. Bring to a simmer
12. Reduce the heat to low and simmer uncovered , stirring occasionally to blend the flavours , for about 30-40 minutes
13. Stir in the beans , garlic and chocolate , simmer to blend flavours for about 5 minutes
14. Sprinkle the cornmeal over the chili , stir in and simmer for a further 2-3 minutes or until it has thickened up
15. Turn off the heat , cover and let stand for about 5 minutes
16. Ladle into bowls and serve immediately with your choice of accompaniments

title: chicken wow soup
steps:
1. Put the chicken broth in a large pot
2. You can use store-bought or home-made chicken stock
3. Cook the chicken breast in the stock 15 or 20 minutes
4. Remove and cool
5. Cut into bite sized pieces
6. Put chicken , veggies and basil into the stock and simmer 30 minutes
7. Add noodles , dumplings or rice if you wish

title: pollo relleno
steps:
1. Place each chicken breast half between 2 pieces of plastic wrap
2. Pound lightly into a rectangle about 1 / 8 inch thick
3. Remove plastic wrap
4. In a bowl combine cornmeal and taco seasoning mix
5. Place egg in another bowl
6. Beat lightly
7. For each roll , place a spoonful of chili pepper half on a chicken piece
8. Place a cheese stick atop chili pepper near an edge
9. Sprinkle with some of the cilantro or parsley , black pepper , and red pepper
10. Fold in sides
11. Roll up jelly-roll style , starting from edge with cheese
12. Dip rolls into egg and coat with cornmeal mixture
13. Place rolls , seam sides down , in a shallow baking pan
14. Bake , uncovered , in a 375 degree f oven for 25 to 30 minutes
15. Serve with taco sauce or salsa
16. If desired , garnish with cilantro sprigs
17. Goes great with zatarains yellow rice !

title: penne with tomato herb cream sauce
steps:
1. Saute onion and garlic in oil
2. Add tomatoes , sugar , basil , oregano , salt
3. Bring to a boil , then simmer 20-25 minutes
4. Meanwhile , cook pasta
5. Stir cream into sauce and heat through

title: nut and poppy seed roll   hedeg kelet
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast in lukewarm milk
2. Add 1 teaspoon sugar and 1 tablespoon flour
3. Set aside
4. Melt butter
5. Add 1 / 2 and 1 / 2 cream and beaten egg yolks
6. Add this mixture to the yeast mixture
7. To the combined mixture add salt , 1 tablespoon sugar and flour
8. Mix together , and divide into 4 parts
9. Put in refrigerator overnight
10. Roll each part 1 / 2 inch thick
11. Spread with filling
12. Sprinkle with butter
13. Roll into loaves as for a jelly roll
14. Let stand 2 hours
15. Brush with egg white slightly beaten
16. Bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for 35 minutes

title: grilled pineapple
steps:
1. Prepare pineapple by removing the tops and the skin
2. Cut pineapple crosswise into six 3 / 4-inch-thick slices , remove the core
3. Stir together melted butter , brown sugar and curry powder
4. Grill pineapple slices on an uncovered grill directly over medium coals for 6 to 8 minutes or till heated through , turning once and brushing once or twice with butter mixture
5. Combine yogurt and coconut
6. To serve , cut pineapple slices in half
7. Serve warm with yogurt

title: malai kofta curry
steps:
1. Boil the potatoes , cool , peel and grate them
2. Grate paneer
3. Wash all green chillies , deseed and chop them fine
4. Peel onions , cut them into halves and boil with a cup of water for ten minutes
5. Drain excess water , cool onions and grind them into a smooth paste
6. Mix mashed potatoes , paneer , two chopped green chillies , cornflour and salt
7. Mix well
8. Divide into sixteen equal sized balls
9. Stuff raisins into them
10. Deep fry in hot oil until slightly coloured
11. Drain and keep aside
12. Heat oil in a kadai
13. Add boiled onion paste and cook for five minutes
14. Add ginger paste , garlic paste , chopped green chillies , coriander powder , turmeric powder and salt
15. Cook for a minute
16. Add tomato puree and red chilli powder and cook on medium flame for eight to ten minutes or till oil separates from the masala
17. Mix mawa in two cups of water and add to the gravy
18. Bring it to a boil and simmer for ten minutes on a slow flame
19. Stir occasionally
20. Stir in fresh cram and garam masala powder
21. Place warm koftas in a serving dish and pour hot gravy on top and serve

title: southern fried chicken with cream gravy
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine 1 / 3 cup oil , lemon juice , garlic salt , and pepper
2. Place chicken in a shallow baking dish , pour marinade over chicken
3. Cover dish , and let marinate for 30-60 minutes
4. Dry chicken pieces on paper towels
5. Place 1 / 2 cup flour in a plastic bag
6. In a small bowl , beat together eggs and milk
7. Place bread crumbs in a shallow bowl
8. Place several pieces of chicken in the bag of flour and shake to coat thoroughly
9. Remove from bag , dip each piece in egg mixture
10. Then , roll in bread crumbs
11. In a large frying pan , heat remaining 2 tablespoons oil with butter , over medium heat , and brown chicken , turning frequently
12. Remove chicken as it browns , and drain on paper towels
13. Whisk remaining 1 / 3 cup flour into juices remaining in pan
14. Reduce heat to low , and stir constantly for 3 minutes
15. Whisk in milk and cream , and season with paprika , cayenne pepper , salt , and pepper
16. Cook until thickened

title: three chocolate fudge
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , combine first four ingredients
2. Cook and stir over medium heat until sugar is dissolved
3. Bring to a rapid boil
4. Boil for 5 minutes , stirring constantly
5. Remove from the heat
6. Stir in marshmallows until melted
7. Add chocolate bars and baking chocolate
8. Stir until melted
9. Fold in vanilla and pecans
10. Mix well
11. Pour into a greased 15-inch x 10-inch x 1-inch baking pan
12. Chill until firm
13. Cut into squares

title: chocolate coconut phyllo triangles
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. In a food processor add the chocolate , coconut , almonds and butter
3. Process until smooth
4. Place one sheet of dough on the counter and brush with oil
5. Place another sheet on top and cut lengthwise into 4 long equal strips
6. Spoon 1 tbsp of the chocolate nut mixture onto the end of one strip and fold flag style into a triangular shape
7. Place on a baking sheet and repeat using the remainder of the phyllo sheets and chocolate mixture
8. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until golden brown
9. Cool slightly and serve with ice cream or cool completely

title: zucchini rice pilaf
steps:
1. In a skillet , saute basil and butter for one minute
2. Then add chicken stock and bring to a boil
3. Stir in the rice and carrot
4. Reduce heat
5. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes
6. Add zucchini slices and simmer another 10 minutes or until zucchini is tender

title: pasta with tomato and peas
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over high heat
2. Add the pasta and cook until tender but still firm to the bite , stirring occasionally , about 8 to 10 minutes
3. Drain the pasta , reserving 2 cups of the pasta water
4. Meanwhile , heat the oil in a large nonstick frying pan over medium heat
5. Add the shallots , garlic , carrots , salt , and pepper
6. Cook until tender , about 8 minutes
7. Add the tomato paste and 1 / 2 cup of the hot pasta water
8. Stir to melt the tomato paste and create a sauce , adding more pasta water if necessary
9. Stir in the oregano , thyme , and parsley
10. Gently fold in the cooked pasta , peas , and the cheeses , adding more reserved pasta water if necessary
11. Transfer to a platter and serve immediately

title: cheese nips
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Grate the cheese
3. Set aside
4. Place butter in bowl of mixer and beat until creamy
5. Add egg , salt , and pepper
6. Beat until blended
7. Beat in cheese one-third at a time until completely combined
8. Stir in flours and xanthan gum until thoroughly blended
9. Work the dough into a ball
10. If dough doesn't stick together , add cold water , 1 t at a time , until a ball can be formed
11. Don't worry about overworking
12. Divide dough in half
13. Place one half on a baking sheet , cover with plastic wrap , and roll out as thin as possible
14. Repeat with the other half
15. Sprinkle with salt , if desired , and cut with a pastry wheel into 1-inch squares
16. Bake for 4 to 6 minutes , until deep golden

title: neapolitan cookies
steps:
1. Line the bottom of a loaf pan with waxed paper
2. With an electric mixer combine flour , sugar , butter , egg , baking powder , vanilla , and salt
3. Beat for 3 minutes
4. Divide the cookie dough into 3 equal parts
5. Part 1: mix in the almond or hazelnut extract and 5 drops red food coloring
6. Part 2: mix in the chopped walnuts or pistachios
7. Part 3: mix in the cocoa
8. Preheat the oven to 350
9. In the loaf pan , spread each part of the dough one on top of the other , pink , white , and chocolate
10. Cover the pan and refrigerate for at least 4 hours
11. After chilling , turn out the dough from the pan and cut loaf lengthwise in half , then crosswise , then cut pieces of dough to make about 15 cookies from each piece
12. Bake each batch for 8-10 minutes
13. Makes about 60 cookies

title: lemon pie pecan crumb crust
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In a processor add grahams , pecans , sugar-- add butter and process until combined press into a pie plate , bake until brown about 8 minutes , cool
3. In a large bowl beat eggs and condensed milk
4. Stir in lemon juice
5. Pour into crust
6. Bake 15 minutes until filling is set , cool , refrigerate at least 1 hour

title: sylvia s chicken scaloppine
steps:
1. With a meat mallet , pound chicken breast to 1 / 2 inches thick
2. In a small bowl , combine flour and cheese
3. Dredge both sides of chicken breast in flour mixture
4. In a large saut pan , saut chicken breasts in 1 teaspoons olive oil for 3-5 minute on each side or until cooked through
5. Remove from pan
6. Heat butter and remaining olive oil together over medium-low heat
7. Add garlic and cook 1 minute
8. Add wine and simmer for about 3 minute or until wine is evaporated
9. Add remaining ingredients except salt , pepper and parsley
10. Simmer sauce for 5 more minute
11. Add salt and pepper
12. Serve over chicken breast with 2 tablespoons sauce and 1 / 2 cup cooked angel hair pasta and parsley

title: simple roast beef and gravy
steps:
1. Place roast in a slow cooker , cut in half if necessary
2. In a bowl , combine the soup , mix , and water
3. Pour over roast
4. Cover and cook on low 8-9 hours until meat is tender

title: spicy coconut shrimp  spicy mango basil salsa  lime jasmine rice
steps:
1. For the salsa: combine all ingredients together in a mixing bowl
2. Make up to a day in advance
3. Keep covered in the refrigerator
4. For the shrimp: in a mixing bowl , combine jalapenos , garlic , ginger , brown sugar , soy sauce , lime zest , coconut milk , basil , vegetable oil , salt and pepper
5. Add the shrimp and marinate for at least 30 minutes and up to 4 hours , refridgerated
6. Heat a nonstick skillet over high heat
7. You don't need any kind of oil
8. Use tongs or a fork to remove the shrimp from the marinade and place in an even layer in the pan , reserving the marinade
9. Cook the shrimp until well browned on each side , turning once , about 3 to 4 minutes total
10. Transfer cooked shrimp to a serving plate
11. Add reserved marinade to pan , bring to a boil and cook until slightly thickened , about 5 minutes
12. Pour over the cooked shrimp and serve with lime jasmine rice and mango salsa
13. Put the rice , coconut milk , water , and salt in a saucepan and bring to a simmer
14. Cover and gently simmer until liquid is absorbed , about 12 to 15 minutes
15. Fluff with a fork and stir in the lime zest
16. Serve immediately

title: baked vegetarian chimichangas  warm or cold
steps:
1. Saut the chopped onion , garlic , and mushrooms in olive oil until onion is soft
2. Add the chopped chilies , flatten mixture in bottom of pan and saut , not stirring , until the onions begin to caramelize a little , then remove from heat
3. In a large bowl , mix remaining ingredients except tortillas
4. To put together the chimichangas , place about 3 / 4 to 1 cup of filling on a tortilla , fold the bottom over the filling , fold the sides in , then carefully fold / flip it over to close
5. Repeat until you have as many chimichangas as you want to bake at one time
6. Place the chimichangas on a cookie sheet , brush each one with 1 / 2 teaspoon of olive oil , and bake at 400 degrees f for 15 minutes
7. Sprinkle each with grated cheddar , serve with extra sour cream , guacamole , and salsa , and enjoy !
8. Makes 8 to 10 large chimichangas , depending on the amount of filling you put in each
9. It's very popular ! :)

title: sloppy joes in a pocket
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. In a skillet , cook beef thoroughly
3. Drain
4. Stir in barbecue sauce
5. Cook 1 to 2 minutes
6. Stir in cheese
7. Unroll dinner rolls
8. Separate into 4 8x4-inch rectangles
9. Cut each in half crosswise , making 8 squares
10. Place about 2 tablespoons beef mixture on to each square
11. Fold dough over filling , forming triangles
12. Press edges with fork to seal
13. With knife , cut small slits in tops
14. Place on ungreased cookie sheet
15. Brush with egg
16. Sprinkle with sesame seed
17. Bake 20 minutes or until golden brown
18. Immediately remove from cookie sheet
19. Serve warm

title: pork curry   for the ladies
steps:
1. Heat a pot and melt the butter
2. Fry the onions and garlic for 3 minutes
3. Add the cinnamon , chili powder , coriander , cumin and turmeric , stir and fry for 2 minutes
4. Add the pork and cook for 3 minutes stirring to coat the meat with the spices
5. Add the chopped tomato and puree with the water , mix well and add the chopped chili coconut cream and paprika
6. Cover pot and cook on low heat till the meat is tender , approx 30 minutes
7. Season with salt to taste
8. Serve with rice and a vegetable curry for a complete meal

title: cinnamon crepes with caramel sauce and pecans
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine 1 tbls
2. Of the milk , the cornstarch , and baking soda
3. Set aside
4. In a large heavy saucepan , bring the remaining milk to a boil over moderate heat
5. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the cornstarch mixture
6. Return to the heat , reduce the heat to low , and stir in the sugar and cinnamon
7. Simmer , uncovered , for 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. Remove the cinnamon stick and continue to simmer , stirring frequently , until the sauce is very thick-about 30 minutes more
9. Set aside
10. Meanwhile , melt the butter in a 7-inch skillet over moderate heat
11. Add the pecans , and saute , stirring frequently , until the nuts are toasted and the butter is browned-about 10 minutes
12. Remove from the heat
13. With a slotted spoon , remove the nuts and set aside
14. Reserve the butter
15. Preheat the oven to 325f
16. Place a crepe with the more attractive side down , brush with the browned butter , and put 1 tbls
17. Of caramel in the center
18. Fold the crepe in half , pressing gently to spread out the filling
19. Then fold it in half again to form a wedge
20. Brush the edges with butter and place the crepe in a buttered , 13"x9"x2" baking dish
21. Repeat , overlapping the crepes slightly in the pan
22. Atthis point the dessert can be stored
23. Cover the crepes with foil and place the nuts in a tightly covered container
24. Cool the sauce to room temperature , then cover tightly
25. Refrigerate all for up to 24 hours
26. Bake the crepes , uncovered , until heated through-8 to 10 minutes
27. Meanwhile , heat the remaining sauce over low heat , stirring frerquently , until warmed through-about 5 minutes
28. Drizzle the caramel over the crepes , then sprinkle with the pecans
29. Serves 6
30. Enjoy !

title: broken leg
steps:
1. Combine apple juice , raisins , cinnamon sticks , and lemon slices in a saucepan and bring to a boil
2. Pour bourbon into 6 mugs
3. Remove the cinnamon sticks and fill mugs with apple juice mixture

title: olive paste and blue cheese canapi
steps:
1. Place the olives , garlic , pine nuts , and olive oil in the bowl of a processor and chop as finely as possible
2. [may be prepared ahead]
3. Spread thinly on bread slices
4. Cover with blue cheese
5. Decorate with a piece of black olive
6. Makes 2 canapis per serving

title: rosto  beef and pasta casserole
steps:
1. Put the lard into the stewpan and brown the beef in it
2. When beef is well browned take it out and in the same lard fry the rounds of onion , carrots , turnips , celery , tomatoes and mushrooms
3. Wikth the water you used to wash the mushrooms , add the cloves and some pepper , and add to the lard mixture
4. Cook until all is nicely browned , add the beef and add water in sufficient quantity to cover all
5. Allow to simmer slowly for about 2 and a half hours , ading water if necessary
6. Prfepare the macaroni to serve as follows
7. Break up the macaroni and put them into boiling water , adding a pinch of salt
8. When tender , drain and dish upmas follows
9. Place the macaroni in a hot dish , sprinkle over them grated cheese and pouring over a little of the beef sauce
10. Then add another layer of macaroni , with grated cheese and sauce from the beef
11. Garnish with the cooked mushrooms
12. Serve the beef in its own sauce in a separate dish
13. Serve very hot

title: pumpkin bread pudding  low fat
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Lightly oil a 2-quart casserole dish and set aside
3. Crumble the bread by hand or food processor to make bread crumbs
4. Combine the egg substitute , milk , pumpkin , brown sugar , cinnamon , spices and vanilla
5. Fold in raisins and bread crumbs
6. Pour mixture into prepared casserole and set dish in larger baking dish which has been partially filled with hot water
7. Bake 1 hours or until knife inserted in center comes out clean

title: posole  vegetarian
steps:
1. Add several tablespoons of powdered broth to boiling water
2. Stir until dissolved
3. Add textured vegetable protein chunks
4. Cover and remove from heat
5. Let the chunks absorb the liquid while you prepare the rest of the soup
6. In a large soup pot , saute onion until soft
7. Add garlic and continue sauteing until fragrance is released
8. Add chili powder to sauteed vegetables and mix well
9. Add 6 cups of water and bring to a boil
10. Stir in chilies , hominy and tomatoes
11. Add textured vegetable protein chunks and additional broth powder to taste
12. Simmer for 10-20 minutes to blend flavors
13. Add fresh cilantro to bowl
14. Add a squirt of lime juice to taste
15. Serve with corn chips or tortilla chips

title: tropical indulgence
steps:
1. For the sorbet:
2. Combine sorbet ingredients in blender and process till smooth
3. Place in freezer container and freeze
4. For the papaya:
5. Place the papaya ingredients , except rum , in saucepan
6. Bring to a boil and simmer till fruit is soft
7. Remove fruit and chill
8. Raise heat under poaching liquid and reduce by half
9. Add rum and reduce till syrupy
10. Strain and reserve
11. For the coconut:
12. Hull and skin coconut
13. Shave chips using mandoline or vegetable peeler
14. Place on cookie sheet and scatter sugar over the chips
15. Bake for about ten minute in 350 degree oven
16. For the dessert:
17. Mound two or three papaya slices on each of four plates
18. Scoop sorbet onto plates
19. Garnish with coconut chips
20. Drizzle syrup over the dessert

title: samurai mojito
steps:
1. Muddle sak and mojito mix with mint leaves , and then add club soda
2. Serve in a 16-oz
3. Glass garnished with a mint sprig or lime wheel

title: papet vaudois    pork sausage   leek hotpot
steps:
1. Melt the butter over low heat and fry the onions , garlic and leeks for 3 minutes
2. Then add the bouillon , white wine and potatoes , bring to a boil and reduce heat and season with salt and pepper
3. Place the sausage on top of the vegetables , cover and cook on low heat for 45 minutes
4. Now remove the lid and boil off some of the liquid
5. To serve , arrange the vegetables on a warm platter and top with the sausages

title: sweet carrot souffle
steps:
1. Remove tops from carrots and set aside in refrigerator until ready to serve
2. Peel carrots and cut into chunks
3. In 3-quart saucepan , place carrots and enough water to cover
4. Heat to boiling
5. Reduce heat to medium
6. Cover
7. Cook about 20 minutes or until soft
8. Drain
9. Cool slightly
10. Preheat oven to 350f
11. Line a 9 x 13 baking dish with a single piece of heavy-duty aluminum foil that is longer than the pan by 3-inches on both ends
12. Grease the foil with butter or cooking spray
13. In food processor , place carrots , butter , sugar , flour , baking powder , vanilla , salt , and eggs
14. Cover
15. Process until pureed
16. Spoon mixture into the foil-lined pan
17. Carefully start to lift the sides of the foil to create the carrot shape , pinching to seal the pointed end of the carrot
18. Use thin strips of wood to square-up the sides of the carrot and hold in place with crumbled up pieces of foil
19. [alternatively , bake souffl in a greased 2-quart casserole
20. ]
21. Pecan topping:
22. In medium bowl , mix grated carrots , pecans , and brown sugar
23. Sprinkle evenly over carrot mixture
24. Bake uncovered 55 to 65 minutes or until center is set and a knife inserted comes out clean
25. Remove from oven and unmold souffl onto serving platter
26. Insert reserved carrot tops in to the top of the carrot shape
27. Serve warm

title: sunday gravy and baked ziti
steps:
1. To make the sauce , heat the oil in a large heavy pot over medium heat
2. Add the garlic and cook for about two minutes or until golden
3. Remove and discard the garlic
4. Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute
5. With a food mill , puree the tomatoes , with their juice , into the pot
6. Or , for a chunkier sauce , just chop up the tomatoes and add them
7. Add the water and salt and pepper to taste
8. Add the pork , veal , and sausages and basil and bring the sauce to a simmer
9. Partially cover the pot and cook over low heat , stirring occasionally , for 2 hours
10. If the sauce becomes too thick , add a little more water
11. Meanwhile , make the meatballs
12. Combine all the ingredients except the oil in a large bowl
13. Mix together thoroughly
14. Rinse your hands with cool water and lightly shape the mixture into 2-inch balls
15. Heat the oil in a large heavy skillet
16. Add the meatballs and brown them well on all sides
17. Transfer the meatballs to a plate
18. After two hours , add the meatballs and cook for 30 minutes or until the sauce is thick and the meats very tender
19. Cook the ziti al dente , adding salt to taste
20. Drain ziti and toss in a large bowl with three cups of the sauce and half of the grated cheese
21. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
22. Spoon half of the ziti into a shallow baking dish
23. Spread the ricotta on top and sprinkle with the mozzarella and half of the remaining grated cheese
24. Pour on 1 cup of the sauce
25. Top with the remaining ziti and another cup of sauce
26. Sprinkle with the remaining grated cheese
27. Cover with foil
28. Can be refrigerated at this point for later baking
29. Bake the ziti for 45 minutes
30. Uncover and bake for 15 minutes longer until the center is hot and the sauce bubbles around the edge
31. Cover and let stand for 15 minutes before serving

title: peanut butter french toast
steps:
1. In a shallow bowl or pie plate , whisk together the egg , milk , peanut butter , cinnamon and honey until smooth
2. Add the bread and soak on both sides
3. Coat a large non-stick frying pan with cooking spray
4. Place over medium heat and melt the butter
5. Add the bread and cook for 3 to 4 minutes per side , or until golden
6. Serve topped with the applesauce and maple syrup

title: italian easter rice pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees and line 2 9" pie pans with the crusts , refrigerate and reserve
2. In a large mixing bowl , mix the next 6 ingredients with a large spoon until thoroughly combined
3. Divide filling between 4 prepared pie crusts , sprinkle with cinnamon
4. Bake about 45 minutes or until filling is set in the middle
5. Allow to cool completely before serving , this actually tastes best when refrigerated overnight

title: tripe soup
steps:
1. Directions:
2. Ask your butcher to give you already clean and bleached tripe
3. Rinse it three times under hot water
4. The last time let the tripe rest in water for 10 minutes , adding 3 tablespoons of white vinegar
5. Cut all vegetables in small cubes and in a large pot cook the tripe alone for three minutes , mixing continuously , then add all the vegetables and spices
6. Cover with cold water
7. Cook over low flame for about two hours
8. Serve steaming hot accompanied , if you wish , by polenta , cut into wedges

title: chicken fiesta chili mac
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f cook macaroni as directed on package
2. Meanwhile , cook chicken in large nonstick skillet sprayed with cooking spray 5 to 7 minute or until cooked through , stirring frequently
3. Drain macaroni
4. Add to chicken in skillet
5. Stir in chili , peppers , garlic , velveeta and salsa
6. Spoon into 13x9-inch baking dish sprayed with cooking spray
7. Bake 20 minute or until heated through
8. Stir before serving
9. Jazz it up: for added heat , add 1 teaspoons hot pepper sauce to the chicken mixture before spooning into prepared baking dish

title: spelt cocoa brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease 8"x8"x2" pan -- i use the butter wrapper for this
3. Sift dry ingredients together and set aside
4. Cream butter and sugar until fluffy
5. Add eggs and vanilla and beat at low speed until well blended
6. Add the dry ingredients and mix just until fully blended
7. Spread in pan
8. Bake about 30 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean
9. Cool in pan for about 15 minutes before cutting into 1" squares

title: autumn gold butternut squash soup   with thai inspired flavors
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a large soup pot
2. Add carrot , celery and onion , and stir in the curry paste and the chopped ginger
3. Cook until vegetables are tender and ginger is aromatic , 3 to 4 minutes
4. Add butternut squash , stirring to combine
5. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat and simmer until squash is fork-tender , about 30 minutes
6. Stir in chicken broth and light or regular coconut milk
7. Season with salt and pepper
8. Taste and adjust seasonings , if necessary
9. Use an immersion blender to puree soup
10. Alternatively , let the soup cool slightly and carefully puree in batches in a traditional blender
11. Garnish each serving with 1 or 2 pappadums , a tablespoon toasted coconut flakes and a tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro
12. A squeeze of fresh lime juice is also good
13. Enjoy !

title: low carb brownies with chocolate frosting
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f spray a 13 x 9-inch baking pan with baking spray
2. In a large bowl , beat the cream cheese and butter until smooth
3. Beat in the chocolate and sweetener
4. Beat in the eggs , 1 at a time , scraping the bowl well after each addition
5. Add the coffee and extracts
6. Beat until combined
7. Add the almond meal , cocoa , salt , and baking powder to the chocolate mixture and beat well
8. Stir in the chopped pecans
9. Scrape into the prepared pan and smooth the top
10. --bake for 35 to 40 minutes , until the top is firm
11. Cool on a wire rack before frosting
12. Frosting:
13. Mix all ingredients ina bowl , and beat combined
14. Spread over brownies
15. Be sure they are cool before frosting

title: chicken green curry with basil
steps:
1. Bring 4 ounces of coconut milk to a boil with the curry paste , sugar , stock and fish sauce
2. Simmer for 15 minutes
3. Add the remaining cocnut milk , basil , bamboo , and chicken and simmer another 10 minutes
4. Just before serving , stir in the snow peas
5. Serve over rice
6. This recipe also works well with fish or shrimp

title: scallop  zucchini  artichoke skewers
steps:
1. Heat grill to high
2. Soak 8 bamboo skewers in water for 30 minutes , if using
3. Thread zucchini , scallop , & artichoke on skewer , 4 times per skewer
4. Drizzle with oil , squeeze with lime juice , grill until scallops turn opaque , about 3-4 minutes per side

title: cranberry tuna salad wrap
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients
2. Put a tablespoon or two in the center of a tortilla
3. Fold bottom up , midpoint
4. Repeat with the top and then fold / roll in the sides
5. Cut diagonally down the middle and enjoy !

title: strawberry delight punch
steps:
1. In 2 1 / 2 quart punch bowl , combine instant tea and water
2. Set aside
3. In blender container , combine strawberries lemonade concentrate , and sugar
4. Process at high speed , about 15 seconds or until smooth
5. Pour into tea mixture
6. Mix well
7. Serve over ice with lemon slice , if desired

title: yes it s another tuna casserole recipe
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a large bowl , combine all ingredients , except bread crumbs and shredded cheese
3. Mix until well blended
4. Pour into a lightly oiled 2 quart rectangular pan
5. Spread evenly in dish
6. Sprinkle cheese evenly over top
7. Then sprinkle bread crumbs evenly over cheese
8. Bake at 350f for 30 minutes or until lightly browned
9. Serve with your favorite green salad

title: not your mama s cranberry sauce
steps:
1. Combine the first seven ingredients in a medium saucepan
2. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat
3. Boil , stirring occasionally , for 5 to 10 minutes or until the cranberry skins pop open
4. Remove from the heat and stir in the orange peel and crystallized ginger
5. Put into a bowl and set into refrigerator until ready to serve
6. You can heat this up if you like a hot sauce to put over a ham , or serve chilled to serve along with a turkey

title: creamy mustard vinaigrette
steps:
1. Whisk shallots , mustard , and vinegar together and season with salt and pepper
2. Mix well and slowly incorporate sour cream
3. Whisking constantly
4. Add paprika , mix and correct seasonings if desired
5. Thin with vinegar if desired
6. Serve over salad

title: spiced basmati rice with fruit and pine nuts
steps:
1. Heat the ghee in a heavy-bottomed medium saucepan over medium heat
2. Add the onion , ginger , garlic , cloves , cardamom pods and cinnamon stick and saut for 5 minutes
3. Stir in the rice and turmeric and continue to saut for about 3 minutes , or until the rice is shiny
4. Raise the heat and add the water , coconut milk and salt
5. Bring to a boil
6. Immediately reduce the heat to low and cover the saucepan
7. Cook for 10 minutes
8. Then stir in the raisins and apricots
9. Cover again and cook , without lifting the lid , for 10 more minutes
10. Remove the pan from the heat and , without lifting the lid , allow the rice to steam for 5 minutes
11. Remove the lid and stir in the pine nuts
12. Remove the whole spices if you wish before serving

title: mejillones antonio
steps:
1. Remove the top shell from the mussels and arrange them on a platter
2. Sprinkle the mussels evenly with the peppers and onion
3. Drizzle liberal amounts of extra virgin olive oil over the platter
4. Generously squeeze lemon juice over the ingredients
5. Season to taste with salt and pepper

title: grands  grilled cheese sandwiches
steps:
1. Separate dough into 8 biscuits
2. Press or roll each biscuit into a 5 1 / 2-inch circle
3. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat 5 minutes
4. Add biscuit circles
5. Cook 3 minutes
6. Turn
7. Continue cooking 3 minutes or until light golden brown
8. Remove from pan
9. Place 2 slices of cheese on 4 biscuit circles
10. Top with remaining biscuit circles
11. Return to skillet
12. Cook 2 to 3 minutes
13. Turn
14. Cook 2 minutes or until cheese melts

title: best popovers
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in large bowl
2. Half fill greased muffin tins w / mixture
3. Put in cold oven and set temp to 450 degrees f
4. Bake 15 minutes
5. Reduce heat to 350 degrees f
6. Bake for another 15-20 minutes
7. Test one: make sure it is crispy outside and moist inside

title: crispy potatoes and leeks
steps:
1. Melt 1 tbls
2. Of butter in a heavy large nonstick skillet over medium heat
3. Add leeks
4. Cook 3 minutes or until soft
5. Place in a large bowl and cool
6. Reserve skillet
7. Shred potatoes using food processor or grater , working quickly to avoid discoloration
8. Rinse potatoes under cold water
9. Pat dry with paper towels
10. Place in the bowl with the leeks
11. Add green onions , salt , pepper and thyme
12. Toss to combine
13. Spray a 11"x7" baking dish with nonstick cookiing spray
14. Heat 1 1 / 2 tbls
15. Of the butter and 1 1 / 2 teaspoons of the oil in the same skillet over medium high heat until melted and hot
16. Spoon half of the potato mixture into skillet , and cook 5-8 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown , stirring frequently
17. Spread evenly in baking dish
18. Repeat with remaining butter , oil , and potato mixture
19. Heat oven to 350f
20. Bake 20 minutes or until heated through
21. Heat broiler
22. Broil 4-6 minutes or until top is browned and slightly crisp
23. Sprinkle with fresh chopped parsley
24. Enjoy !

title: garlic beef sandwich
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. In a 3 quart glass baking dish with a cover , layer meat , minced garlic , bay leaves , onion slices , and black olives
3. Pour the crushed tomatoes evenly over the top , then top with olive oil
4. Cover with foil or glass lid and bake for 3 1 / 2 hours , stirring occasionally
5. Serve as sandwiches on kaiser or french rolls

title: mock apple crisp  gluten   sugar free
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Combine crust ingredients in a medium bowl , cutting in the margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
3. Add vanilla and mix gently
4. Press 1 / 2 of dough evenly on bottom and 1 / 4-inch up sides of an 8x8-inch glass baking dish
5. Bake until slightly browned , about 10 minutes
6. Cool on wire rack
7. Meanwhile , combine zucchini and lemon juice in a pot and simmer until just barely cooked , about 2-3 minutes
8. Remove from heat , add stevia , cinnamon and nutmeg and let cool
9. Spoon cooled zucchini mixture over crust and sprinkle the remaining crust mixture on top
10. Bake for 45 minutes

title: chamorro bistek
steps:
1. The best way to handle slice the beef is partially frozen
2. Slice thinly , about 1 / 4-inch thick and 2-3-inches long
3. Combine the rest of ingredients except for the oil , water , cornstarch
4. Marinate for about 30 minutes
5. Heat oil in skillet and remove the garlic and onions from the marinade
6. Carefully saut in hot oil for about 5 minutes
7. Drain the beef from marinade and add to the skillet
8. Stir-fry on medium-high heat , stirring often until cooked and browned
9. This should roughly take about 8 minutes , depending on your stove and thickness of meat
10. Add the water and cornstarch to marinade and bring to a boil , stirring often
11. Mixture should start to thicken up but not too much
12. Slightly less than thick gravy consistency
13. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed
14. Lower temperature down and simmer for about 15 minutes more , careful not to burn
15. Serve over hot rice

title: warm apple and goat cheese salad
steps:
1. Using a glass jar with a tight lid , combine the vinegar , mustard , garlic , salt , and pepper , and shake well to blend
2. Add the oil and parsley and shake
3. On 4 plates , arrange the endive leaves like spokes around each plate
4. Arrange the watercress or spinach in the center
5. Preheat the broiler , and arrange the sliced apples slightly overlapping in 4 fan shapes , place in broiler pan
6. Cut the cheese into 4 slices and top each apple fan with slices of cheese
7. Broil until golden for approximately 5 minutes
8. Using a spatula , carefully place the apple slices and cheese on top of the endive
9. Drizzle the dressing over the salads and sprinkle with walnuts
10. Enjoy !

title: cherry cheesecake shot
steps:
1. Combine stoli vodka and grenadine in a shaker with ice
2. Add a splash of pineapple juice
3. Shake , strain into a shot glass , and serve

title: hearty vegetable and bean soup
steps:
1. In pot on medium heat , melt butter
2. Add flour to thicken
3. Add 1 box of vegetable stock
4. Boil all beans , tomatoes , onions and celery
5. After 10 minutes , add other box of vegetable stock
6. Add all spices
7. Cook for about an hour
8. Then add potatoes and pasta
9. Cook until tender
10. Add salt to taste

title: ice cream cake roll
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f coat a 15 x 10 x 1-inch jelly-roll pan with nonstick cooking spray
2. Line bottom of pan with waxed paper
3. Spray paper
4. Stir together flour , cocoa powder , baking powder and salt
5. In a large bowl , beat eggs with an electric mixer on medium speed for 5 minutes , until very light yellow
6. Gradually add granulated sugar , beating until smooth
7. Beat in vanilla extract
8. Fold flour mixture into egg mixture until no lumps remain
9. Pour into prepared pan , spreading level
10. Bake at 350f for 12 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched
11. Dust a clean kitchen towel with confectioners' sugar
12. Turn cake out onto towel
13. Roll up towel and cake from short end
14. Cool completely
15. Unroll
16. Spread with softened ice cream to within 1 inch of edges
17. Reroll cake without towel
18. Wrap in plastic wrap
19. Freeze at least 4 hours or overnight
20. If frozen overnight , let stand at room temperature 20 minutes before serving
21. To serve , carefully remove plastic wrap and drizzle cake with chocolate syrup

title: koolmoes   cabbage and potatoes
steps:
1. Cook potatoes and cabbage separately in boiling , salted water
2. Drain and mash together with butter
3. Season
4. If mixture is too dry , add hot cream to moisten , about 1 / 2 cup

title: peanut butter chocolate chip banana bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray three 4x8 loaf pans with non-stick spray
3. In a small bowl , mash bananas
4. Set aside
5. In a medium bowl , mix together flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
6. Set aside
7. In a large bowl , cream together margarine , crisco and sugars
8. Beat in eggs and vanilla
9. Slowly add flour mixture
10. Add bananas and mix thoroughly
11. Mix in chocolate chips by hand
12. Pour half of the batter into the three pans
13. Add 1 / 2 cup of peanut butter per pan , evenly distributing over the top of the batter
14. Top with remaining batter and bake for 45-55 minutes
15. Let cool in pans on wire racks for 15 minutes before removing
16. Then cool completely on wire racks

title: pumpkin and rice soup
steps:
1. Cook onion and garlic in oil in a large saucepan or dutch oven over medium heat until onion is tender
2. Stir in broth , pumpkin , coriander , pepper flakes and nutmeg
3. Bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat , simmer uncovered 5 to 10 minutes
5. Top each serving with 1 / 2 cup rice

title: spinach and walnut stuffed mushrooms with three cheeses
steps:
1. In a skillet , cover and cook shallots in oil and butter for about 3 minutes , until tender
2. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
3. Add walnuts , garlic and spinach to onions
4. Cook another 10 minutes , stirring constantly , then remove fromheat and add swiss and feta cheeses , thyme , oregano , salt and pepper to taste
5. In a large baking dish , arrange mushroom caps cavity-up
6. Spoon spinach-walnut-cheese mixture evenly into caps
7. Sprinkle parmesan cheese on tops and bake uncovered for about 10 minutes or until filling is browned a little and mushrooms are hot

title: hamburger steak and gravy
steps:
1. Mix ground beef , salt , pepper , onion powder , and milk
2. Form into patties , they will be loose
3. Mix flour with as much pepper as you like
4. Dredge patties in flour mixture on both sides
5. Place in hot buttered pan
6. Cook for 3 minutes on each side
7. Remove patties
8. Save any drippings that remain and add enough butter to make a 1 / 4 cup of drippings
9. Add flour and cook for a couple minutes
10. Add water and bouillon
11. Add patties back to gravy and cook on med-low for 20 minutes

title: roast beef  rolls
steps:
1. In a small bowl , mix together relish and mayonnaise
2. Spread over tortillas
3. Top each with 1 / 2 of roast beef and tomatoes
4. Roll up and enjoy
5. Add easy to layer foods such as lettuce or spinach for different touch

title: electric smurf
steps:
1. Put three ice cubes in glass then add malibu and blue curacao
2. Fill glass half with sprite half with pineapple juice
3. Stir and serve

title: skillet beef enchiladas
steps:
1. Brown meat and onion in large skillet
2. Drain fat
3. Stir in chilies , cream of mushroom soup , enchilada sauce , and milk
4. Bring to a boil and then simmer for 20 minutes
5. Soften tortillas in the microwave wrapped in paper towels
6. Place grated cheese inside each tortilla and roll up
7. Place tortillas in sauce in skillet and spoon sauce over tortillas
8. Top with any remaining cheese
9. Cover and heat on medium for 5 minutes

title: egg fried rice   easy
steps:
1. Heat your wok until smoking before adding 1tbsp groundnut oil
2. Add the eggs and scramble for 1-2 minutes
3. Transfer to a warm plate and put to one side
4. Wipe any excess oil from the wok with a kitchen towel then bring back up to temperature before adding the remaining groundnut oil
5. Add the rice , stirring well , then add the tomatoes and cook for 1-2 minutes
6. Stir in the egg and season to taste with pepper , sesame oil and soy sauce , then stir through the onion before serving

title: icelandic hot shot
steps:
1. Pour 1 ounce galliano liqueur in cordial glass
