2. Pour one ounce coffee machine dripped espresso slowly so as not to mix galliano and espresso
3. Any coffee can be used , espresso is suggested which should be resting on top of the galliano
4. Top off with a squirt of whipped cream then shoot it down in one gulp

title: peeps sunflower cake
steps:
1. Prepare and bake cake according to package directions , using two greased and waxed paper-lined 9-inch round baking pans
2. Cool 10 minutes before removing from pans to wire racks to cool completely
3. Carefully remove waxed paper
4. Level tops of cake
5. Spread frosting between layers and over top and sides of cake
6. Without separating peeps , and curving slightly to fit , arrange chicks around edge of cake for sunflower petals
7. For sunflower seeds arrange chocolate chips in center of cake
8. Yield 12 servings

title: janet s onion rice
steps:
1. In a skillet , with a tight fitting lid , saute the rice in the butter until a light golden brown
2. Stir frequently during this process
3. Add onion soup and the can of water and cover and simmer until the water is nearly all absorbed
4. Add the peas and water chestnuts and continue to simmer until the water is completely absorbed
5. If you like the rice alittle more salty , add soy sauce to your taste

title: carne en su jugo  meat cooked in it s own juice
steps:
1. In a large frying pan cook all the bacon to a nice crispy texture
2. While the bacon is frying place the onion , garlic , tomatillos , bouillon and cilantro in a blender
3. Squeeze the lime wedges into the blender and mix well so everything inside forms a frothy uniformed consistency
4. Remove bacon from the drippings and sear the roast on all sides in the bacon fat
5. This will ensure that the juices in side the meat are sealed in side
6. So make sure every raw spot is well browned
7. After browning the meat return the bacon to the pan and pour the contents from the blender over the roast
8. Or transfer everything to a crock pot
9. Cover and allow to simmer for 1 hour on the stove
10. If using a crock pot set for 6-8 hours but add 2 cups of water of beef broth
11. Serve over black or pinto beans with grilled corn tortillas and enjoy

title: broccoli pasta bake
steps:
1. Boil the broccoli and dried pasta in the same pan as per the pasta instructions
2. Use the sunflower spread flour and milk to make a white sauce and add 20g of the cheese and mix until melted and the cottage cheese and mix again
3. Add the cooked pasta and broccoli and the sauce to a oven proof dish and stir to cover all of it
4. Mix the remaining cheese and the bread crumbs and cover the top with them , grill for 5 mins until browned

title: crunchy cheeseroni
steps:
1. Cook macaroni according to package directions , drain
2. Brown ground beef
3. Drain
4. Then add to beef soups , green pepper , pimento and cooked macaroni
5. Place half the mixture in a greased 2 quart casserole
6. Sprinkle with half the cheese and onions
7. Top with remaining macaroni mixture and cheese
8. Bake at 350 for 25 minutes
9. Sprinkle with remaining onions and bake 5 minutes longer

title: oven pork chops with hominy
steps:
1. Place butter in large , oven-safe skillet and heat until melted
2. Add the chops and brown them quickly
3. Remove to a platter
4. Add the onion and green pepper to the skillet and saute until they start to brown
5. Blend together remaining ingredients in skillet with the drippings and veggies
6. Return the chops and any accumulated juices to the skillet , placing on top of the veggies mix
7. Bake covered at 350 degrees for 1 hour
8. Remove cover and bake 15 minutes longer

title: italian chicken cacciatore
steps:
1. Sprinkle the chicken with the salt , pepper , and flour , shaking to remove the excess flour
2. Heat 4 tablespoons of the olive oil in a large non-stick high-sided frying pan set on high heat
3. Add the chicken to the pan and cook until well-browned , about 3 minutes per side
4. Transfer the chicken to a plate and set aside
5. Save the chicken fat left in the pan , adding enough of the oil to make 4 tablespoons cook the onion and bay leaves over medium heat till tender
6. Add the garlic , pancetta , red pepper flakes , and half of the parsley
7. Cook for 3 minutes
8. Pour in the wine and cook for 3 minutes , stirring and scraping the bottom of the pan
9. Add the tomatoes and their juice , the chicken stock , tomato sauce , and browned chicken pieces
10. Break the tomatoes into smaller pieces
11. Bring to a boil , reduce heat , simmer uncovered for 15-20 minutes
12. Transfer the chicken to a serving dish
13. Cook the sauce 5 more minutes
14. Taste for salt and pepper
15. Pour the sauce over the chicken
16. Sprinkle the remaining parsley on top and serve

title: inside out cheese sliders   clean eating
steps:
1. Place oven rack 6 to 7 inches from broiler and preheat to high
2. Cover a baking sheet or broiler pan with foil
3. In a large bowl , combine beef , salt and pepper
4. Divide meat into 8 equal balls , about 2 inches in diameter
5. Divide cheese into 8 equal portions
6. With your thumb , make an indentation in 1 of the meatballs and insert a portion of cheese cubes
7. Push the edges of the meatball over the indentation to completely cover the cheese , then flatten the meatball into a 1 / 2-3 / 4-inch-thick patty
8. Place on prepared baking sheet
9. Repeat with remaining meatballs and portions of cheese
10. Broil until tops of patties are deeply browned , 6 to 7 minutes
11. Flip and broil until the second side is browned and patties are firm to the touch with no pink remaining in the center , about 5 more minutes
12. In a small bowl , stir together mustard and honey
13. To serve , split open each roll and spread on 1 tsp mustard mixture
14. Top with 1 patty and spinach leaves , dividing equally among all sliders
15. Option: if you prefer to cook the sliders in a skillet rather than the broiler , mist the skillet with olive oil cooking spray and cook the burgers in 2 batches over medium heat for 5 to 6 minutes per side
16. By cooking in batches you eliminate overcrowding the pan , which would cause the patties to steam instead of developing a flavorful golden exterior

title: french toast from alton brown
steps:
1. In medium size mixing bowl , whisk together the half-and-half , eggs , honey , and salt
2. You may do this the night before
3. When ready to cook , pour custard mixture into a pie pan and set aside
4. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
5. Dip bread into mixture , allow to soak for 30 seconds on each side , and then remove to a cooling rack that is sitting in a sheet pan , and allow to sit for 1 to 2 minutes
6. Over medium-low heat , melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a 10-inch nonstick saute pan
7. Place 2 slices of bread at a time into the pan and cook until golden brown , approximately 2 to 3 minutes per side
8. Remove from pan and place in oven on rack for 5 minutes
9. Repeat with all 8 slices
10. Serve immediately with maple syrup , whipped cream or fruit

title: mud cake
steps:
1. Put coffee , hot water and fruit juice into a saucepan and bring to a simmer
2. Add the broken chocolate and butter and stir until melted
3. Add the sugar and stir until the sugar has dissolved
4. Remove the mixture from the heat and allow to cool
5. Sift the flour and baking soda together into a large bowl and make a well in the centre
6. Beat the eggs together with the vanilla and stir into the chocolate mixture
7. Pour the chocolate mixture into the well in the dry ingredients and stir to mix
8. Pour the mixture into a well greased and floured ring tin
9. Bake at 140c for 1 1 / 2 to 1 3 / 4 hours until the cake has shrunk from the sides of the tin and is firm to the touch
10. Cool in the tin for 20 minutes before turning out onto a cake rack
11. Dust with icing sugar before serving

title: ravioli bake  ww
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Spray a 2 quart baking dish with pam
3. Set aside
4. Cook ravioli according to package directions and drain
5. In prepared dish pour in half of the pasta sauce , then add half of the ravioli , top with half the spinach and then half of the mozzarella
6. Repeat layer
7. Sprinkle with parmesan
8. Cover dish with foil and bake for 20-30 minutes or until bubbly
9. Uncover and bake until cheese melts

title: crispy  crunchy waffles
steps:
1. Use a whisk to combine the dry ingredients in a large mixing bowl
2. Separate eggs , leaving the whites in a bowl where you can beat them easily
3. In a separate bowl , beat egg yolks until frothy and add oil and milk
4. Combine with flour mixture
5. Add lemon rind , if desired
6. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form , then fold into batter
7. Bake until crisp in a hot waffle iron

title: uncle bill s blueberry filling for perogies
steps:
1. If you are using frozen berries , thaw first before using
2. In a bowl , mix together sugar and tapioca starch , mix well
3. Place blueberries in a large bowl and pour sugar / tapicoa mixture over and mix well to coat
4. Now add lemon juice and mix well
5. In a smaller mixing bowl , mix together 1 / 2 cup granulated sugar and 1 / 4 cup tapioca starch
6. Prepare dough rounds to use in your mini form
7. Place dough over mini form
8. Sprinkle 1 / 4 teaspoon of sugar / tapioca starch mixture over the middle of the dough in the mini form
9. Now add 1 tablespoon of blueberries and close mini form , remove excess dough
10. Continue with the remainder of the blueberry mixture

title: slow cooker beer chicken
steps:
1. Place chicken in crock pot
2. Mix all other ingredients , pour over chicken in the crock pot
3. Cook on high for 4-5 hrs , or low for 6-8 hours

title: easy peanut clusters
steps:
1. Microwave chocolate and butterscotch chips in a 2 quart glass dish for 5-6 minutes on 60% power , or until melted
2. Watch carefully !
3. Add peanuts and mix well
4. Drop by tablespoons on waxed paper
5. Cool in refrigerator
6. Store in covered container in refrigerator
7. I have used different chocolate chips other than toll house , and they do not work well

title: emeril s stewed black eyed peas
steps:
1. With a sharp knife score the fat on the ham hocks 1 / 4-inch deep
2. Heat the vegetable oil in a large heavy stockpot over medium high heat
3. Add the tasso and cook , stirring often , until heated through , about 3 minutes
4. Add the onions and bell peppers and cook , stirring often , until softened , about 4 minutes
5. Add the ham hocks , garlic , salt , pepper , cayenne , and bay leaves
6. Cook , stirring often for 2 minutes
7. Add the black-eyed peas and chicken stock
8. Bring to a boil over high heat
9. Reduce heat to medium low
10. Simmer uncovered until the peas are tender , about 45 minutes to 1 hour , stirring often and skimming off any foam that forms
11. Remove the bay leaves and discard
12. Cut the meat from the hock , discarding the skin and bones
13. Return meat to the pot
14. Stir in the parsley
15. Serve

title: honey and lemon salad dressing
steps:
1. Combine lemon juice with olive oil in a small jar and shake well
2. Combine honey and vinegar in small bowl or cup and stir until honey is dissolved and then add to lemon juice / oil mixture in jar
3. Add remainder of ingredients and shake well to combine
4. Refrigerate
5. Shake well before using

title: super easy no bake cheesecake
steps:
1. Mix softened cream cheese , sweetened condensed milk , and vanilla with an electric mixer until thouroughly blended
2. Spoon into graham cracker crust
3. Chill and serve !

title: spicy flank steak
steps:
1. Mix salsa , orange juice , oil , sugar , soy , mustard and ginger in shallow nonmetallic dish , or plastic bag
2. Add steak and turn to coat
3. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hours or up to 24 hours grill or broil steak until desired doneness , turning and brushing often with salsa mixture
4. Heat remaining salsa mixture in saucepan to a boil
5. Cook over low heat 10 minute slice steak into thin diagonal slices
6. Serve with rice and salsa mixture
7. Top with parsley

title: super easy  and inexpensive  chicken pot pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix together veg-all , soup and chicken in large bowl
3. Season with salt and pepper
4. Spoon into frozen pie crust and top with second pie crust
5. Bake at 350 for 35 minutes or until top crust is brown
6. All ingredients are already cooked

title: martha stewart s potato salad
steps:
1. Place potatoes in a large stockpot
2. Fill with enough cold water to cover by 3 inches
3. Add salt
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat , and let simmer until potatoes are just tender when poked with a fork , 40 to 45 minutes
6. Remove from heat , drain , and sprinkle with vermouth
7. Let stand until cool
8. In a medium bowl , whisk together the vinegar , sugar , creme fraiche , and celery seeds
9. Season to taste with salt and pepper
10. Cut potatoes into bite-size pieces , and transfer to a serving bowl
11. Pour dressing over the potatoes
12. Add chopped cornichons , scallions , and parsley
13. Toss to combine
14. Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper , and serve at room temperature

title: honeydew mimosa
steps:
1. Combine first 3 ingredients in a blender
2. Process until smooth
3. Pour mixture into a large pitcher
4. Add sparkling wine
5. Pour into glasses
6. Garnish , if desired

title: creamy polenta for 2
steps:
1. Pour chicken stock , fat free milk and coarse ground corn into a cold pot
2. Turn burner on medium / medium-high
3. Bring contents of pot to a simmer
4. Simmer until contents are no longer "wet" - corn has absorbed most of the liquid
5. Turn burner off and add cheddar cheese , cream cheese , salt and pepper
6. Whisk to combine
7. Serve warm

title: spiced pumpkin nut bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f grease two 9 x 5-inch loaf pans
2. Sift flour , pumpkin pie spice , cinnamon , baking powder , baking soda and salt into medium bowl
3. Combine pumpkin , sugar , juicy juice , eggs , oil and vanilla extract in large bowl
4. Stir well
5. Stir in flour mixture and 3 / 4 cup nuts just until moistened
6. Spoon into prepared loaf pans
7. Sprinkle remaining 1 / 4 cup nuts over top of loaves
8. Bake for 60 to 70 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
9. Cool in pans on wire racks for 10 minutes
10. Remove to wire racks to cool completely

title: malay pineapple curry  pajri nenas
steps:
1. Heat oil in deep saucepan an fry crushed ingredients , cinnamon , star anise , cloves and curry leave till fragrant
2. Add curry paste and dried shrimp and continue frying for few min , add water if too thick
3. Add pineapple and 1 cup of water
4. Bring to boil and cook till pineapple tender , about 10 minute
5. Add coconut milk , coconut paste , salt and sugar and cook for another 5 min till sauce thick
6. Add more water if prefer thin sauce

title: teriyaki shrimp    broccoli with pasta
steps:
1. Prepare teriyaki sauce: combine soy sauce , water , molasses , corn starch , garlic powder and chinese five spice in a sauce pan and simmer on low until thickened
2. Prepare broccoli: in sauce pan covered with water
3. Bring to a boil and immediately remove from heat let stand for 2 minute and drain
4. Place shrimp in a bowl with very hot tap water and let stand for five minutes
5. Prepare linguine per package directions
6. Place sauce , broccoli and shrimp in a large medium high fry pan , cook for two minutes
7. Add linguine and toss reduce heat to low and let stand for five minutes
8. Serve

title: jeweled apple tart
steps:
1. For crust , 1 / 4 cup of the butter
2. Lay one sheet of phyllo dough on an 11- to 13-inch pizza pan , brush with melted butter
3. Lay a second sheet on top , perpendicular to first , and brush with butter
4. Repeat for a total of eight sheets , placing each sheet perpendicular to the previous one
5. Fold outside edges toward the center , forming a shell about 10-inches in diameter
6. Brush phyllo lightly with remaining melted butter
7. Bake in a 400f oven for 15 to 18 minutes or until phyllo is golden
8. Poke a few holes in the crust with a fork if it puffs , gently flattening the center
9. Let cool completely
10. For filling:
11. Melt remaining 1 / 4 cup butter in a saucepan
12. Stir in brown sugar , apple juice concentrate , cinnamon , apples , and cherries
13. Cook about 12 minutes or until apples are tender
14. Remove fruit with a slotted spoon , reserving juices
15. Add nuts to juices , if desired
16. Toss fruit with flour and spoon into prepared crust , set aside
17. Gently boil reserved juices in a small saucepan about 5 minutes or until reduced to about 1 / 4 cup
18. Add half-and-half or light cream , cook and stir over low heat until well combined
19. Pour over apple mixture in crust
20. Bake in a 350f oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown
21. Let stand 20 minutes
22. Serve warm with ice cream or whipped cream , or sprinkle with powdered sugar , if desired

title: fig and pistachio loaf cake
steps:
1. Soak the figs and pistachios for 1 hour in the boiling water
2. Grease a standard loaf pan
3. Preheat the oven to 350f
4. Cream the butter and the sugar , then beat in the egg and vanilla
5. Mix the flour with the soda and salt
6. Mix it into the butter mixture and then add the figs and the pistachios in their soaking liquid
7. Scrape into the loaf pan and bake for 1 to 1 1 / 4 hours

title: brats  our style
steps:
1. Grill the brats on your bbq grill over medium heat , turning occasionally and monitoring carefully so that you don't split the skins
2. We like ours a little on the darker side , but grill to your own preference
3. This typically takes us about 15 minutes
4. Pour two of the bottles of beer into a 9 x 13 cake pan , and place on the grill
5. Add onions , garlic , and brats to the cake pan
6. Add as much of the third bottle of beer as possible , leaving a little room at the top so it won't boil over
7. Simmer on the grill while cooking the veggies or anything else for your meal on the other side of the grill
8. Start out at medium heat , and adjust down as necessary to avoid cooking too hard and splitting the brats open
9. They should just simmer lightly for 30-45 minutes for great flavor
10. Add additional beer as necessary
11. We usually boil until the beer is almost gone , but do not allow to boil completely dry !
12. Remove the brats from liquid to serve as needed , allowing remaining brats to 'hang out' and stay hot in the liquid until needed
13. Serve on buns with desired toppings and garnishes
14. My favorite is with ketchup and mustard and cold sauerkraut , but my husband likes pickles or relish on his , and the kids are content with just ketchup , sometimes with a bun , sometimes without
15. Leftover brats reheat well if you do so slowly in the microwave
16. 100% power will blow them up , so procede with caution and use appropriate settings for your microwave
17. Enjoy !

title: hamburger noodle stroganoff
steps:
1. Brown beef with onion , drain fat
2. Mix all ingredients together in a greased 2 quart cassreole bowl
3. Bake at 400 degrees for 25 minute or until hot

title: grilled marinated chicken with tomato bread salad  panzanella
steps:
1. Vinaigrette: mix all the ingredients together in a bowl , and season with salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
2. Chicken: set aside 1 / 2 cup of the vinaigrette
3. Put the chicken pieces in a bowl , and add enough of the remaining vinaigrette to cover , or place the chicken in a plastic bag with the vinaigrette
4. Allow to marinate for 2 to 3 hours in refrigerator
5. Bring to room temperature before grilling over medium coals
6. Sear on all sides , then move to a cooler spot on the grill to avoid flare-ups
7. Tomato-bread salad : cut the tomatoes into 1-inch chunks , and season with salt , pepper and a pinch of sugar
8. Let the mixture sit for 10 minutes , then add the onions and bocconcini , basil and cubed bread to a bowl
9. Add 1 / 3 cup vinaigrette , toss together , and allow salad to sit for 20 minutes , adding more vinaigrette if necessary

title: 3 finadene sauces  guam
steps:
1. To make the soy and vinegar finadene: place the onion in a non-reactive bowl
2. Add remaining ingredients and stir to mix
3. This will keep , tightly covered , in the refrigerator for several days
4. To make the coconut finadene: combine the coconut milk , garlic , ginger , and lemon juice in a non-reactive bowl and stir to mix
5. Add the onions , jalapenos , salt and pepper
6. This can be made several hours ahead
7. To make the lemon finadene: combine the lemon juice , salt and water in a non-reactive bowl
8. Whisk until the salt dissolves
9. Stir in remaining ingredients
10. This can be covered and refrigerated for several days

title: carrots with caramelized ginger
steps:
1. Arrange carrots in single layer in heavy large skillet
2. Add 1 1 / 2 cups water and 2 tablespoons butter
3. Sprinkle with sea salt
4. Bring to boil , cover , and reduce heat to medium-low
5. Simmer until carrots are tender , about 10 minutes
6. Using slotted spoon , transfer carrots to plate
7. Add 2 tablespoons honey and ginger to skillet and bring to boil , stirring occasionally
8. Boil until juices are syrupy and pale golden brown , 4 to 5 minutes
9. Whisk in remaining 1 tablespoon butter , 1 tablespoon honey , and lemon juice
10. Season to taste with salt and freshly ground black pepper
11. Spoon ginger sauce over carrots and let stand 10 minutes to cool slightly
12. Scatter parsley leaves over and serve

title: apricot almond orange tart with white chocolate cream
steps:
1. Place apricots in a shallow dish and cover with boiling water
2. Allow to sit and soften , they will become raisin-like
3. Meanwhile , combine flour , cinnamon , brown sugar , and salt in a bowl
4. Add butter in small pieces and mix until mixture looks like coarse sand
5. Beat together egg yolk and lemon juice and pour into flour mixture while mixer is running
6. Mix well , and if dough seems a little dry , add a little extra lemon juice
7. Now knead mixture gently by hand and form into a ball
8. Flatten into a disc shape and chill for 10 minutes before using
9. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
10. Roll out pastry on a floured surface and place in a 9 inch tart or pie pan , forming it up the sides
11. Prick pastry with a fork , line with tinfoil and place a pie weight on top
12. If you don't have a pie weight , simply line with foil , and place a heavy baking dish right on top of the foil
13. This will prevent the pastry from puffing up while baking , and keep it tart-like
14. Bake 15 minutes , remove foil and weight and bake for 5 minutes longer
15. Reduce oven temp to 375 degrees
16. Place ground almonds on a cookie sheet and bake for 3 minutes , cool
17. Drain water off apricots
18. If using whole apricots , cut each apricot into 6-8 small pieces
19. Combine almonds , butter , sugar and chopped apricots in a bowl
20. Add salt , eggs and reserved egg white and mix well
21. Pour onto cooled baked tart shell and bake 25 minutes or until set
22. Place orange slices on top
23. Melt jam on stove and brush top of tart with glaze
24. Bring whipping cream to a slow boil in a pan , stirring often
25. Pour over chopped white chocolate and stir until chocolate is smooth and melted
26. Cool completely in refrigerator to let mixture become thicker
27. Cut and serve tart , stir cold chocolate cream mixture again and drizzle over tart portions on plate

title: crock pot country captain chicken
steps:
1. Place chicken in the bottom of the crock pot , you may brown the parts if you wish
2. Heat olive oil and briefly saute garlic , onions , green bell pepper , celery and curry powder
3. Add all remaining ingredients except the almonds
4. Stir to combine then pour over the chicken
5. Cook on low setting for 6 hours or less
6. Serve over basmati rice and sprinkle with almonds

title: cinnamon cream cheese oatmeal
steps:
1. Combine oats and water , microwave for 1 1 / 2 - 2 minutes
2. Meanwhile , with a fork or whisk , combine whipped cream cheese , vanilla , and brown sugar
3. Top the cooked oatmeal with the cream cheese mixture
4. Sprinkle almonds on top

title: rachel s fancy macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375
2. Mix swiss and mozzarella cheeses together
3. Melt butter in medium saucepan
4. Stir in flour , salt , mustard , and pepper until smooth
5. Remove from heat and slowly stir in milk until mixture is smooth
6. Place back on heat and stir constantly until mixture is thickened
7. Remove from heat and stir in 2 cups of cheese
8. Combine the cheese mixture with prepared noodles and place in a greased 2 quart casserole dish
9. Sprinkle the remaining cup of cheese on top
10. Bake at 375 for about 25 minutes or until slightly browned on top

title: low carb chocolate peanut butter cheesecakes
steps:
1. 1) spray 12 muffin tins with non-stick spray or line with foil liners
2. 2) combine all of your ingredients in a large bowl and mix together using an electric mixer until creamy
3. About 3 minutes
4. Taste for sweetness - add more stevia if needed
5. 3) fill muffin cups evenly with all batter
6. Spread evenly with your fingers so there is no mounding of the batter
7. 4) place in the over and bake for 18-19 minutes
8. Test with a toothpick in center
9. It should not come out clean - but with some batter , just not liquid
10. 5) remove from oven and let cool on wire rack for 1-1
11. 5 hours
12. Place in refridgerator for 6 hours uncovered , then you may cover them

title: crock pot maple dijon chicken
steps:
1. Place chicken into crockpot and toss it with thyme , dijon mustard and maple syrup
2. Peel and slice sweet potato and onion
3. Place onion , sweet potato and minced garlic on top of chicken
4. Add chicken broth and bay leaves
5. Cook on low for 6-8 hours
6. This is done when the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables reach desired tenderness

title: very veggie soup
steps:
1. Wash your veggies as you go
2. Saut mushrooms in oil
3. When mostly cooked , add onions , zucchini and garlic
4. Saut until crisp-tender
5. Add mixed veggies , stock and tomatoes
6. Heat on high until boiling
7. When pot boils , remove from heat and leave to cool
8. Season with mrs
9. Dash

title: sugarplum cake
steps:
1. Combine sugar and oil
2. Mix in eggs
3. Sift flour , spices , baking soda , and salt into a separate bowl , then add to sugar mixture , alternating with buttermilk , and ending with the flour mixture
4. Add nuts and baby food and mix well
5. Pour into a bundt pan that has been greased and floured and bake at 325 degrees for one hour
6. Let rest on cooling rack 20 minutes
7. Turn out to cool completely
8. Combine icing ingredients and drizzle over top

title: roasted pumpkin seeds with a kick from kim
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together and place on a cookie sheet pan in a single layer
2. Cook in a 350 oven until butter is melted
3. Lower oven to 275 degrees , mix and spread seed into single layer and bake till crisp about 30-40 minutes
4. 40 minutes

title: boboli pizza crust clone
steps:
1. Add all ingredients to breadmaker in order listed by your manufacturer
2. Set breadmaker on dough setting
3. When cycle is done , form two crusts on pizza pans , sprinkle with parmesan cheese , cover and let rise again
4. Bake 5-10 minutes at 450 f until light brown
5. Cool
6. Wrap tightly in foil and freeze

title: honey cheesecake bubble bread with chocolate sauce  rsc
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Line a 15x10-inch jellyroll pan with reynolds wrap foil
3. Spray with no-stick cooking spray
4. Place almonds in a large bowl
5. Stir egg white , water and vanilla together in a small bowl
6. Pour over almonds
7. Stir to evenly coat
8. Stir sugars and salt together in a small bowl
9. Pour over almond mixture
10. Toss to evenly coat
11. Spread evenly on foil-lined pan
12. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until almonds are glazed , stirring occasionally
13. Remove from oven
14. Allow to cool before removing from foil and breaking apart any large clumps
15. Place in a small bowl
16. Set aside
17. Meanwhile , for biscuits , line bottom and sides of a 13x9x2-inch baking dish or pan with a large sheet of reynolds wrap foil
18. Spray with no-stick cooking spray
19. In a small deep mixing bowl , beat cream cheese and cup of sugar on low speed until smooth
20. Add honey , cream and extract
21. Beat on low speed until combined
22. Spread each biscuit to a 3-4 inch circle
23. Add a scant tablespoon of cream cheese mixture in center of each biscuit
24. Enclose biscuits around mixture and seal
25. Arrange 15 biscuits in foil-lined dish
26. Drizzle with half of melted butter then sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of remaining sugar
27. Add remaining 15 biscuits and drizzle with remaining butter then sprinkle with remaining sugar
28. Bake for 25-35 minutes until biscuits are done and tops are golden brown , covering with another sheet of reynolds wrap foil during last 10 minutes of baking time to prevent overbrowning
29. Cool for 5 minutes before inverting onto a large serving platter
30. Meanwhile , for sauce , whisk chocolate , cream , salt , and vanilla together in a small deep mixing bowl
31. Place in a small bowl
32. Cover with reynolds wrap foil to keep warm
33. Arrange bowls of almonds and sauce on edge of platter
34. For each serving , place 2-3 biscuits on each serving plate and drizzle with warm sauce as desired then sprinkle with a few almonds
35. Serve warm
36. Serves 10-12

title: moroccan spiced fava bean stew
steps:
1. Place the dried fruit and raisins in a small heatproof bowl
2. Add boiling water to cover and soak for 20 minutes to soften
3. Drain and set aside
4. Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat
5. Add the onion and carrot , cover , and cook until softened , about 5 minutes
6. Add the garlic , cumin , and cinnamon and cook , stirring , for 30 seconds
7. Add the tomatoes , green beans , and stock and bring to a boil
8. Reduce the heat to low , cover , and simmer until the vegetables are tender , about 20 minutes
9. Add the favas , peas , fruit , salt and pepper to taste
10. Simmer , uncovered , until the flavors are blended and the desired consistency is achieved , about 10 minutes
11. Sprinkle with cilantro and serve

title: vegetable breakfast pizza
steps:
1. Spray a large skillet with cooking spray
2. Preheat skillet over medium heat
3. Add in potatoes , mushrooms , carrot , zucchini , and onion
4. Cook / stir 3 minutes or until vegetables are tender
5. In a bowl , stir together eggs and milk
6. Pour over vegetables
7. Cook , without stirring , until the mixture begins to set on the bottom and around the edge
8. Using a spatula or large spoon , lift and fold the partially cooked egg mixture so the uncooked portion flows underneath
9. Continue cooking and folding about 4 minutes or until egg mixture is cooked through but sill glossy and moist
10. Remove from heat
11. Assemble pizza: place pizza crust on a 12-inch pizza pan
12. Sprinkle with half of the cheese
13. Top with egg mixture , tomato , and remaining cheese
14. Bake in a preheated 375 oven for 8-10 minutes or until cheese is melted

title: crock pot chicken dinner
steps:
1. Place potatoes and carrots in crock pot
2. Lay chicken on top of vegetables
3. Mix soups together and pour over chicken
4. Cover and cook 6-8 hours on low
5. If you'd like to thicken sauce , stir in some instant potato flakes at the end of the cooking time

title: grandma s christmas sugar cutout cookies
steps:
1. Sift dry ingredients together
2. Add shortening or margarine using a fork to combine with dry ingredients
3. Add unbeaten eggs and vanilla
4. Mix well
5. Add ground pecans for added flavor
6. Whisk the dry ingredients together , add alternately with the eggs and vanilla
7. Mix well
8. Roll out thin on floured board and cut with floured cookie cutters
9. Decorate with sugar
10. Bake at 375f for 8 minutes
11. Makes about 6 dozen

title: pizza tater casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Make potatoes according to box directions
3. Meanwhile brown ground beef with onion
4. Stir everything , except the cheese , together in a greased 13x9 in dish
5. Top with cheese
6. Bake for about 30 min -- or until cheese is melted

title: blue ribbon coffee cake farmhouse style in the midwest
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Spray a 10-inch fluted pan
3. Set aside
4. In a small bowl , mix streusel ingredients
5. Set aside
6. In medium bowl , mix dry cake ingredients
7. Set aside
8. In large bowl , stir together wet cake ingredients except sour cream
9. Add dry ingredients , stir just until moistened , then add sour cream and stir until smooth
10. Spoon one third of batter into prepped pan , spread evenly
11. Sprinkle one third of streusel over this
12. Repeat with remaining batter and streusel
13. Use a buttered spatula to assist with the spreading
14. Bake for 45-50 minutes
15. Cool in pan for 10 minutes
16. Invert onto serving plate
17. Serve warm
18. But leave some for the next day (it improves with aging at room temp

title: onion pie
steps:
1. Saute onion in butter until golden
2. Season with half the salt and pepper
3. Set aside
4. Stir together flour , baking powder and remaining salt
5. Cut shortening into mixture until you have the texture of coarse crumbs
6. Add milk to from dough
7. Spread dough into 10x10 baking dish
8. Spread onion mixture over the dough
9. Beat together egg and sour cream and pour over the onions
10. Bake at 450 degrees for 20 minutes
11. Remove and cut into squares after slightly cooled

title: cracked black pepper salmon
steps:
1. Spread 1 / 2 the black pepper on a plate
2. Smear 1 tsp olive oil over one side of the salmon fillets
3. Lay the fillet , oiled side down in the pepper
4. Lift and put on a baking sheet , peppered side up
5. Repeat the process with the second fillet
6. Bake at 350 f or 180 c for around 20 minutes , or until the fish flakes easily

title: quick   easy applesauce
steps:
1. Put water and apples in pot
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat to low
4. Simmer approx 25 minutes , or until soft -- stirring occasinally
5. Slightly mash apples
6. Add sugar , cinnamon and all spice
7. Mix well , and let simmer about 5 more minutes
8. If you want a smoother texture sauce , pour into a blender , and puree until desired texture

title: moroccan chicken soup with apricot couscous
steps:
1. Soup:
2. Saut onion in oil in a large pot over medium heat until onion is soft , 5 minutes
3. Add gingerroot , garlic , paprika , coriander , cumin , cinnamon , cardamom , turmeric , nutmeg , and pepper flakes
4. Cook 1 minute
5. Deglaze pot with wine , reduce until liquid is nearly evaporated
6. Stir in broth , chicken , chickpeas , tomatoes , artichoke hearts , and olives
7. Bring to a boil
8. Reduce heat to medium-low
9. Simmer soup for 10 minutes
10. Season with salt and pepper
11. Garnish soup with cilantro and almonds
12. Serve with apricot couscous and e n j o y !
13. Apricot couscous:
14. Bring water honey , oil , lemon juice , zest and salt to a boil in a saucepan
15. Remove from heat
16. Stir in couscous and apricots: cover and let stand until water is absorbed , about 5 minutes
17. Fluff couscous with a fork before serving with soup

title: pineapple curry meatballs
steps:
1. Put the meatballs in a crock pot
2. Put everything else into a pot on the stove , bring to a boil
3. Pour over meatballs
4. Cook on high for a few hours , longer the better with this one

title: fresh lemonade syrup
steps:
1. In 2 quart bowl , add 1 cup water and microwave for 1 minute
2. Add splenda for baking and stir to dissolve
3. Add lemon juice and grated peel
4. Stir
5. To prepare lemonade: for 1 serving , mix 1 / 4 cup syrup and 3 / 4 cups water in glass
6. Add ice
7. For 1 / 2 gallon , add 2-2 / 3 cups syrup and 5 cups water
8. Stir
9. To freeze: when lemons are plentifyl , make syrup and freeze in ice cube trays
10. Pop cubes out and store in a freezer-safe zip-style bag , removing as much air as possible
11. For 1 serving , place 2-3 cubes in glass , add 3 / 4 cups warm / not water and stir to dissolve cubes
12. Add ice and serve

title: pan dulce  dome shaped sweet rolls
steps:
1. For dough: in a small bowl , dissolve the yeast and 1 tablespoon sugar in warm water
2. Let stand 6-8 minutes
3. In a large mixing bowl , combine 3 cups bread flour , salt , sugar and shortening and blend thoroughly
4. Add yeast mixture and 2 eggs
5. Mix completely
6. Add remaining eggs and mix
7. Add remaining bread flour and mix until the dough forms a loose , soft , and elastic dough
8. It should be a little sticky but firm enough to shape easily with buttered hands
9. Butter the work surface into a 4x6-inch rectangle , 1 1 / 2 inches thick
10. Cut into 16 medium or 24 small squares
11. Cover lightly with plastic wrap for 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours and let dough rise
12. Shape each dough square into a dome-shaped circle
13. On a lightly greased cookie sheet , place rolls 2 inches apart
14. For topping: in a food processor using a metal blade , add the butter , shortening , powdered sugar , 1 cup flour and vanilla
15. Process until smooth , then divide into 3 equal parts
16. Leave one part plain and shape into a log
17. With the 2nd piece , process in the food processor with lemon peel and shape into a log
18. Process the 3rd piece with cocoa and cinnamon and shape into a log
19. Chill the 3 logs until ready to use
20. Cut off 2 tablespoons of topping from the log and flatten with palms into a circle
21. Place topping circle on top of dough circle
22. It should completely cover dough
23. Use a sharp knife to cut a crisscross or shell design on top
24. Let rolls rise again in a warm place for about 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours
25. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
26. Bake 12-15 minutes until lightly browned

title: oven grilled steak  mark bittman
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to its maximum , 500 or more , for at least 20 minutes
2. If it is equipped with a pizza stone , so much the better
3. About 10 minutes before you are ready to eat , put a cast-iron or other ovenproof heavy skillet large enough to hold the steaks over high heat
4. Wait 2-3 minutes , until the pan is beginning to smoke
5. Add the steaks and let them sit on top of the stove as long as you can before the smoke is intolerableprobably no more than 1 minute
6. Immediately transfer the pan to the oven
7. Roast the steaks for about 4 minutes , or until nicely browned on the bottom , then turn and cook on the other side for another 3-4 minutes , until done
8. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and serve immediately

title: cinnamon chocolate cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In large bowl , combine sugar , chocolate chips and butter
3. Cover w / papertowel
4. Heat in microwave oven on high for 2 minutes or until mixture is melted
5. Stir once during melting
6. Set aside
7. Cool 5 minutes
8. In a medium bowl , combine dry ingredients
9. Mix well
10. Add the egg and vanilla to chocolate mixture
11. Beat at medium speed with electric mixer for about 1 minute
12. Gradually add dry ingredients
13. Mix well
14. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls on an ungreased cookie sheet
15. Bake 9-11 minutes
16. Remove cookies from cookie sheet after 1 minute
17. Cool on wire racks
18. Eatttt ! :)

title: deluxe hot cocoa drink
steps:
1. Dissolve the cocoa and sugar in 3 cups water in a medium saucepan
2. Whisk in the evaporated milk and peanut butter and then bring to boil
3. Heat for 10 minutes , stirring continuously
4. Pour into four mugs to serve

title: pumpkin raisin walnut quick bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix together: flour , sugar , baking powder , cinnamon , nutmeg , baking soda , ginger , cloves and salt
3. Stir until combined
4. Stir in walnuts and raisins
5. Set aside
6. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl
7. Stir in the pumpkin , brown sugar , vanilla and melted butter
8. Combine both mixtures together until the dry ingredients are moistened
9. Pour batter into greased and floured loaf pan
10. Bake until loaf is browned and wooden pick inserted in the center comes out clean
11. Approximately 50 - 55 minutes
12. Cool in pan approximately 10 minute cool completely before serving

title: indonesia inspired salad dressing
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients with the food processor
2. Use as dressing and top with the crushed peanuts left

title: sesame raised cornmeal muffins
steps:
1. Dissolve the yeast in the warm water
2. Place the cornmeal , sugar , salt and butter in a large bowl
3. Add heated milk and stir occasionally , until the butter melts
4. Cool to lukewarm
5. Beat in 1 cup flour and eggs , then add the yeast
6. Beat in the remaining flour
7. Mixture will very stiff
8. Cover and let rise in warm place until doubled
9. Stir down and fill 24 oiled medium muffin cups 3 / 4 full
10. Cover and let rise in a warm place for about 45 minutes , or until nearly doubled in bulk
11. Sprinkle with sesame seed
12. Bake at 400 degrees f for 15 minutes , or until golden brown

title: sunday  game day     roast beef dinner
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Place roast in large roasting pan or baking dish
3. Arrange vegetables around roast
4. Sprinkle meat and vegetables generously with basil , dried garlic , garlic powder , salt and pepper
5. Place in oven and allow to cook for about 15 minutes
6. Add water to pan about 1 / 2 inch to an inch up
7. About every 20 minutes or when water is diminishing and turning darker , add a little more water so it doesn't steam away completely
8. You can pour this over the roast if if is getting too dry on top
9. Allow to cook 20-30 minutes per pound or until your desired doneness and when veggies are tender
10. Remove roast to carving platter and remove veggies with a slotted spoon to their own serving dish
11. To make gravy , either prepare gravy mix as directed on package but use liquid from pan as substition for all of some of the water indicated
12. Or , in a sauce pan , whisk together 1 / 4 cup of pan drippings and 1 / 4 cup flour until smooth
13. Heat over low heat until mixture starts to bubble
14. Add 2 cups of water or a combination of water / dripping adding to 2 cups very slowly to flour mixture
15. Simmer 5 minutes , remove from heat and add 1 tsp
16. Of gravy master
17. Stir in some salt and pepper to taste and serve with sliced beef
18. Slice beef after it has sat for about 15 minutes to retain juices

title: pasta and meatballs for kids
steps:
1. Set slice of bread in a medium bowl and pour milk over it to soften
2. Add ground meat , salt and egg and combine well
3. Form meat mixture into small meatballs - about 1 / 2 teaspoon each
4. Drop into boiling water and cook for 5 minutes
5. Drain and set aside
6. Cook pasta according to package directions and drain well
7. Set aside with meatballs
8. Combine soup , water and parmesan and heat through
9. Add pasta and meatballs and serve

title: lemon roasted potatoes  greek style
steps:
1. Place peeled and quartered baking potatoes in a pan just big enough to hold them in one layer
2. Place lemon juice in a one-cup measure
3. Add enough water to make one cup liquid
4. Pour lemon and water over potatoes
5. Drizzle oil over potatoes
6. Bake uncovered at 400 degrees for 45 minutes to an hour , adding more water as needed , until potatoes are golden brown and soft
7. Salt and pepper to taste

title: world s best    and easiest   teriyaki chicken wings
steps:
1. Mix sauce and sugar together , brush on both sides of the wings , then pour over wings in pan
2. Cook in a roasting pan / cookie sheet with a"lip" so the sauce doesn't spill and make a mess of the oven 350 degrees cook for 1 hour
3. I usually cook face down for about 40 minutes and then flip over
4. Then when done throw all the gooey sauce into the crock pot with the wings and simmer on low heat for as long as you want
5. This is what makes them fall apart in your mouth , but you don't have to do it to cook them
6. They should be done after an hour in the oven

title: lemon sponge pudding
steps:
1. Pudding----------------
2. Combine sugar , flour and salt in large bowl
3. Stir in lemon rind , lemon juice , egg yolks and evaporated milk
4. Beat egg whites in a small bowl until stiff peaks form
5. Fold into lemon mixture
6. Pour into lightly greased 8 cup baking dish
7. Place dish in larger pan and fill with hot water to 1 inch depth
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 40 to 45 minutes , or until top is set and golden brown
9. Serve warm with raspberry sauce
10. Sauce------------------
11. Press raspberries through sieve to remove seeds and puree berries
12. Combine raspberry puree and corn starch in a small saucepan
13. Cook , stirring constantly , over medium heat until mixture boils and thickens
14. Spoon warm sauce over individual servings of pudding

title: best fluffy pancakes
steps:
1. Beat eggs with wire whisk
2. Add 1 cup milk and oil and whisk until frothy
3. Preheat lightly greased griddle to 300
4. Add flour and sugar and mix well
5. There will be little lumps left - those are okay
6. When griddle is hot , pour batter on by 1 / 3 cupfuls
7. Cook for about 1 1 / 2 minutes per side , or until golden brown
8. Best when served immediately with butter and syrup

title: myra s vegetarian chili
steps:
1. Saut garlic briefly in a big dutch oven or pot
2. Stir in the undrained tomatoes , water , tomato paste , chili powder , mustard , basil , oregano , cumin and pepper
3. Drain each can of beans , rinse them , and add to the pot
4. Reduce heat and simmer , covered for 15 minutes
5. Stir in the carrots , corn , and zucchini and the hot pepper sauce
6. Simmer , covered for 15 minutes
7. Serve with grated cheese
8. Add more water or tomatoes if mixture is too thick

title: red wine and onion brisket
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine thyme , oregano , salt and pepper
3. Rub over both sides of brisket
4. In flameproof roasting pan heat oil over medium-high heat
5. Add brisket
6. Cook , turning once , until browned , 3-4 minutes per side
7. Remove from heat
8. Add onions , garlic and bay leaves to pan around brisket
9. Pour in wine
10. Cover
11. Roast 1 hour , 30 minutes
12. Turn brisket over
13. Roast , covered , until very tender , 1 hour , 30 minutes
14. Transfer brisket and half onions to serving platter
15. Cover with foil
16. Transfer drippings and remaining onions to blender
17. Pulse until smooth
18. Slice beef against the grain of the meat and serve with sauce

title: holiday date roll
steps:
1. Put the first 6 ingredients into a large bowl
2. Add 2 / 3 of the graham cracker crumbs
3. Mix well-- using clean hands like you would mix a meatloaf
4. If loaf seems too dry add the saved cherry juice a little at a time until the mixture is sticky but firm enough to form into a loaf about the texture of a thick cooky dough
5. Divide the dough into two sections
6. Sprinkle 1 / 2 of the saved graham cracker crumbs on a large sheet of waxed paper
7. Place one of the dough sections on the waxed paper
8. Roll up the dough into a log like a thin jelly roll so that the crumbs are around the outside of the log
9. Pull the paper tightly around the log and secure by wrapping a second time with plastic wrap
10. Repeat steps 6 through 9 with the other section of dough
11. Place the two logs into a large ziplock plastic bag to keep moisture in and refrigerator odors out
12. Refrigerate several weeks before eating
13. To serve slice crosswise and enjoy
14. Number of servings vary according to thickness of slices

title: honey chocolate chippers
steps:
1. Beat honey and butter until creamy but not fluffy
2. Beat in egg yok and vanilla
3. Combine four , oats , baking soda , and salt
4. Stir dry ingredients into wet mixture until well blended
5. Mix in pecans and chocolate chips
6. Chill dough for 30 minutes
7. Drop dough by rounded tablespoons onto ungreased cookie sheets
8. Flatten each cookie with a spoon
9. Bake at 350 for 15 to 20 minutes or until tops are dry
10. Cool on wire racks

title: a nudge  a coffee nudge
steps:
1. Put the scoope of ice cream in the bottom of a tall mug
2. Pour the creme de cacao , kahlua , brandy and frangelica over the ice cream
3. Slowly pour in the coffee , add the whipped cream and sprinkle the ground coffee beans on top
4. Sit back , relax and enjoy

title: sweet n  sour brisket
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Mix together the onion soup mix , water and the jellied cranberry sauce , mixing and smashing until mixed well
3. Put brisket in a roasting pan
4. Pour cranberry mixture over the brisket
5. Season with pepper
6. Cover and bake for 3 hours or until tender , stirring sauce once
7. Skim fat from sauce and serve with noodles

title: bailey s chocolate chip cheesecake
steps:
1. For crust: preheat oven to 325f
2. Coat a 9-inch spring form pan with cooking spray
3. Combine crumbs and sugar in bowl
4. Stir in butter
5. Press mixture into bottom and 1 inch up the sides of the springform pan
6. Bake until light brown , approx 7 minutes
7. Filling: beat cream cheese until smooth with electric mixer
8. Gradually add sugar , then eggs one at a time
9. Add bailey's and vanilla
10. Make sure well mixed
11. Sprinkle half of the chocolate chips over crust
12. Spoon in filling
13. Sprinkle the rest of the chocolate chips on the top
14. Bake approx 1 hour & 20 minutes or until cake is puffed and springy in the centre and golden brown
15. Cool in fridge
16. For cream: beat cream , sugar and coffee powder until peaks form
17. Spread over cooled cake
18. Garnish with chocolate curls

title: avocado and tomatillo dip
steps:
1. Remove husks and rinse tomatillos under warm water to remove stickiness
2. Heat a well-seasoned cast-iron skillet or griddle over medium-high heat until hot and lightly brown tomatillos and garlic , careful not to burn
3. Cool to room temperature
4. In a food processor pure tomatillos and garlic until smooth
5. Halve and pit avocados and scoop into tomatillo mixture
6. Pulse until coarsely chopped
7. Stir in cilantro , lime juice , onion , salt and pepper
8. Serve with tortilla chips

title: creamy chicken broccoli bisque
steps:
1. In a 3 quart saucepan over medium heat , add butter and cook mushrooms and pepper strips until they are tender , stirring frequently
2. Stir in soup , milk , broccoli , chicken , pepper and nutmeg
3. Heat to boiling , stirring occasionally
4. Reduce heat to low
5. Cover
6. Simmer 5 minutes or until broccoli is tender

title: pineapple ambrosia
steps:
1. Drain pineapple well
2. Chop ginger roughly
3. Combine pineapple , ginger , sour cream and honey in a medium sized non-metal bowl
4. Mix well
5. Cover with plastic wrap and leave overnight for the mixture to set and the flavours to mingle

title: a   peri peri chicken wings
steps:
1. Cook your wings your favorite way , whether it be on the grill , baked in the oven or deep fried !
2. Mix all the ingredients in a sauce pot , bring to a boil ! reduce the heat to simmer for 10-15 minutes
3. Remove from heat and let cool
4. In a large bowl put the wings in first making sure your wings are hot off the cooking method that you used
5. Add the sauce to the wings mixing very well in the sauce
6. Serve with blue cheese , ranch , cole slaw or you favorite side ! enjoy

title: sneak in the veggies taco soup
steps:
1. Cook the ground meat in a skillet seasoning w / salt and pepper to taste and drain
2. Put all ingredients in the crock pot
3. Add water until everything is just covered
4. Be careful , my crock pot is pretty full by now !
5. Give it a stir , put on the lid , and cook on low
6. Cooking time depends on your crock pot
7. Some cook at a higher temp than others and will take less time
8. I have an old rival and i put my soup on in the morning and it's perfect by dinner time
9. You can also make this on the stove in about an hour
10. Right before serving adjust seasonings and salt and pepper to taste

title: pesto alla genovese
steps:
1. In a food processor , mince the garlic and basil with the salt
2. With the machine running , add the oil in a thin stream and continue processing until well blended
3. Add pine nuts and butter , process until the nuts are chopped
4. Makes one cup pesto , or enough to dress one pound of pasta

title: ruth s simple glazed ham steaks
steps:
1. Trim the fat around the edges of the ham steaks
2. Melt the apple jelly in a large skillet over medium heat for about 1-2 minutes
3. Add mustard and pepper
4. Mix in well
5. Place ham steaks into skillet and spoon sauce over them to cover
6. Cook , uncovered , about 5 minutes per side , basting often
7. Turn out ham to a serving platter
8. Cut into serving size pieces as desired

title: pickled hot peppers
steps:
1. Combine vinegar , water , oil , salt and spices in a stainless steel pan
2. Bring to a boil , turn off heat , cover and and let flavors develop while you do the rest
3. Wash and dry peppers , trim stems but leave some on
4. Put 2 cloves of garlic in each canning jar
5. Alternate peppers and sliced onions
6. Pack tight with 1 inch headspace
7. Bring liquid back to a boil , and pour over peppers leaving one inch for air space
8. Top with lids , screw on bands , and process in waterbath canner for 10 minutes

title: frankfurter gruntz
steps:
1. Slice pound cake into 1 / 2 inch horizontal layers
2. Set aside
3. Filling: combine pudding mix , milk and salt and cook until thickened
4. Cover and refrigerate for 1 / 2 hour
5. Cream butter and sugar until fluffy
6. Stir into cooled pudding
7. Almonds: in a skillet melt 1 / 4 cup butter
8. Add almonds and cook until golden brown
9. Cool
10. Grind until consistency of corn meal
11. To assemble cake:
12. Cover cake layers with pudding
13. Frost top and sides of cake with pudding
14. Top with ground almonds
15. Store cake covered in refrigerator

title: 15 minute fat free cheesecake
steps:
1. Mix , splenda , cream cheese and whip cream in a mixing bowl till smooth
2. Pour filling into pie crust and smooth over with a rubber scraper
3. Place in freezer for 10 minutes to stiffen the filling
4. You may top with fresh fruit or cookie crumbs

title: baked applesauce oatmeal
steps:
1. Mix all wet ingredients and combine with dry ingredients
2. If raisins are use , plump by letting raisins sit in warm water for 10 minutes
3. May add more cinnamon to taste
4. Pour into greased 9 x 9 inch baking dish
5. Place in refrigerator overnight for oatmeal to dissolve into liquid
6. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 30 minutes
7. Top with brown sugar and milk when served

title: chicken rice   veggie casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Stir the rice , onion , garlic , broccoli , cauliflower , chicken broth , tomato soup , brown sugar , vinegar and worcestershire together in a 9x13 baking dish
3. Combine the flour , garlic powder , salt and pepper together then toss the chicken in that mixture
4. Place the seasoned chicken on the rice mixture and cover the baking dish with foil
5. Bake covered for 45 minutes
6. Remove foil and sprinkle with shredded cheese , bake uncovered for 10-15 minutes , until most of the liquid is gone and the cheese is bubbly

title: etto s goof ball candy
steps:
1. Spread the oleo in the bottom os sausepan
2. Mix dates , sugar and eggs in sausepan and cook on low heat , stirring constantly for about 8-10 minutes
3. Take off heat and add rice krispies , stir and add pecans
4. Using a teaspoon , drop into coconut and then put on cookie sheet that is covered with wax paper and then let cool
5. Since this recipe came from my grandmother and she did not wtire down how much this yields
6. I am gussing

title: ham and cheese with coleslaw
steps:
1. Microwave margarine uncovered in custard cup on high (100%0 until softened , 15 to 30 seconds
2. Blend in mustard
3. Spread margarine on one side of each toast lsice
4. Place slices buttered sides up on serving plate
5. Top with ham tomato and cheese slices
6. Microwave uncovered until cheese begins to melt , 1 1 / 2 to 2 minutes
7. Top each sandwich with a spoonful of coleslaw

title: peanut butter   jelly thumbprint cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300
2. In a large bowl , mix sugar and butter
3. Add vanilla and egg , mixing well
4. Stir in flour and salt
5. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet
6. Make indent in cookie with finger
7. First put about 1 / 4 tsp peanut butter in cookie
8. Top peanut butter with about 1 / 4 tsp strawberry jam , filling indentation
9. Bake at 300 for 20-25 minutes or until edges are golden
10. Remove immediately from cookie sheet and cool on wire rack

title: pan di spagna  italian sponge cake
steps:
1. Place egg yolks and sugar in a mixing bowl and beat until lemon colored
2. Add vanilla and lemon rind
3. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry and then fold into the egg yolk mixture
4. Sift the flour in a separate bowl and slowly incorporate it into the egg mixture with a mixing spoon
5. Butter and flour a 18inch square cake pan
6. Pour cake batter into prepared pan and bake at 375f for 40 minutes , or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
7. Remove cake from oven and turn out onto a cake rack to cool
8. When completely cool , cake may be sliced horizontally to form 2 or 3 thin layers
9. Cake can be tightly wrapped and frozen for future use
10. Please check your oven size , to make sure pan will fit properly

title: scalloped mushrooms ala jeff
steps:
1. Wipe whole mushrooms with damp paper towels to clean , cut off stem ends and then in half , reserving 8 whole mushroom caps for garnish
2. Saute mushrooms in butter over medium heat until just tender
3. Add cream and seasonings
4. Continue to cook until liquid is 3 / 4 absorbed , stirring as needed
5. Adjust seasonings if desired
6. Scoop into a 2 quart casserole
7. Cover mixture with shredded cheese and garnish with reserved whole mushroom caps
8. Bake uncovered at 400 dg until cheese is melted and lightly browned , about 10 minutes

title: elegant vegetable rolls
steps:
1. Saut 1 tablespoons oil , garlic and red pepper flakes over high heat 1 minute , stirring constantly
2. Add cole slaw mix and mushrooms and saut 3 more minutes
3. Season with 1 1 / 2 teaspoons salt and pepper
4. Separate dough into 4 rectangles
5. Firmly press perforations to seal
6. Place 1 / 4 of vegetable filling on short side of rectangle
7. Fold up long sides to cover mixture and then roll like and egg roll
8. Place on a baking sheet , folded side down
9. Bake at 400 for 13-18 minutes , or until golden
10. Meanwhile , saut 1 teaspoons oil , tomatoes , cumin and 1 / 2 teaspoons salt 3 minutes , or until tomatoes are soft
11. Puree mixture in food processor or blender until smooth
12. Set aside
13. When rolls are removed from oven , spoon 1 / 4 of sauce onto 4 plates
14. Cut veggie rolls in half on diagonal and place 2 halves standing upright on plate
15. Garnish with cilantro

title: slow cooker quick chick
steps:
1. Place chicken and gravy into a slow cooker
2. Season with paprika , seasoning blend and soy sauce
3. Cook on high for 4 hours or for 6-8 hours on low
4. Tear chicken into pieces
5. Serve over rice , noodles or potatoes

title: chicken rice pilaf
steps:
1. Melt margerine in a casserole dish
2. Brown orzo
3. Add boiling water and chicken broth , and stir
4. Add rice and stir
5. Cook in 350 degree oven for 30 minutes
6. For variation , try adding 1 / 2 cup mixed vegetables , 1 can mushrooms , or 1 small can peas
7. Use your imagination

title: copper river king salmon with berry ginger salsa
steps:
1. Salsa:
2. Using a food processor , puree 1 / 2 the fresh berries
3. Add whole berries and pureed berries into a mixing bowl
4. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix well
5. Salmon:
6. Brush fillets lightly with oil
7. Position on broiling pan , and place 4 to 5 inches from heat
8. Broil approximately 11 minutes per inch of thickness
9. Serve with blueberry salsa

title: mrs  goldman s brisket
steps:
1. The amount of vegetables listed in the ingredients are estimated based on the size pan i use
2. Cut up enough of the vegetables to cover the bottom of the pan
3. Green bell peppers can be used but i prefer a variety of different colors and use at least one green , one red and one orange -- sometimes i also use a yellow pepper
4. Put the brisket on top of the vegetables fat side up
5. Season with garlic powder and ground pepper to taste
6. Sprinkle one packet of onion soup mix
7. Be sure to check that the goodman's soup mix is marked kosher for passover as they make one that is for use year round
8. You can add a small can of tomato sauce on top if desired
9. I like using this as it makes for a thicker gravy
10. Pour water into the pan almost to the top of the meat and cover with foil , shinny side down
11. Cook in the oven at 350 degrees
12. After about two hours take a fork and stick it into the meat
13. If the fork goes in easily remove it from the oven and cut
14. Return the beef to the pan
15. Puree the vegetables and pour over the meat
16. Cook again for another hour
17. It may take 3 hours for the meat to be tender enough to be cut but don't let it get too tender because then it will fall apart
18. The remaining liquid can be used as a gravy for the meat and other dishes at your meal
19. Serving size is dependent upon the size of your brisket

title: buttered and herbed new potatoes
steps:
1. Place a pot of water on to boil
2. Heat a vegetable dish
3. Pop the potatoes into the boiling water with a pinch of crystallized salt
4. Cover with a tightly fitting lid
5. Boil for 20 minutes on high heat
6. Drain and submerge in cold running water
7. Put them between your hands and the skin will come away easily
8. Melt butter in the bottom of a pan
9. Place potatoes in the pan , roll to coat with butter , and cover with a clean cloth
10. Place over the lowest heat , using a heat pad to deflect direct contact , until potatoes are ready to serve
11. Wash the mint and parsley and chop
12. Remove the cloth and dust with the chopped mint and parsley
13. Place in the vegetable dish and serve
14. Enjoy !

title: shake
steps:
1. Put everything in the blender
2. Process until smooth

title: tomato sauce for chicago style pizza
steps:
1. Place the tomatoes , including the juice from the cans , into a large stockpot
2. Crush the tomatoes using the back of a large spoon , or just squish them with your hand
3. Stir in the oregano and salt
4. Simmer the tomatoes , uncovered , over medium-low heat until the sauce is thick and all the liquid has evaporated , about 50 minutes
5. Remove from the heat and let cool
6. Stir in the garlic and basil
7. Add the red pepper flakes , if desired
8. Use immediately , or refrigerate in a tightly covered container for up to 3 days , or freeze for up to 2 months
9. Bring to room temperature before using

title: chicken cordon bleu pockets
steps:
1. Assembly directions:
2. Remove rolls from package and connect triangles to form rectangles
3. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
4. In a mixing bowl , mix the sour cream , parmesan cheese , and swiss cheese
5. Add the diced chicken and ham and toss until coated
6. Evenly divide the filling between the pockets using about 1 / 4c of mixture per pocket
7. Fold one side of the pocket over the other side
8. Seal the edges by pressing with the tines of a fork
9. Transfer the pockets to a cookie sheet
10. Bake at 375 for 12 minutes or until golden brown
11. Freezing directions:
12. Allow to cool on the baking sheet
13. Place in rigid containers or freezer bags
14. Seal , label and freeze
15. Serving directions:
16. Thaw in the refrigerator overnight
17. Microwave on high for 2 to 4 minutes or until the pockets are hot
18. Place in a warmed thermos and close lid
19. You can use the flaky biscuit dough
20. Peel each biscuit in half and flatten with palm of your hand
21. Fill with stuffing and fold in half

title: bread and butter pickles my way
steps:
1. I recommend using a cuisinart fitted with a slicing blade to make the preparation of the vegetables less tedious
2. In a very large container , combine sliced cucumbers and onions , and salt
3. Cover with a generous amount of ice cubes
4. Cover and let sit for approximately four hours
5. Drain well and remove any ice
6. Lightly rinse with cold water and drain well again
7. In a large preserving kettle , combine sugar , vinegar and spices and bring to a boil
8. Add drained vegetables and bring back to a boil
9. Fill hot sterilized canning jars with mixture and seal
10. Please

title: holiday honey cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease the pan you're using and add parchment paper , greased
3. Mix flour and next 6 ingredients in a large bowl
4. Make a well in the center
5. Add the oil and the next 8 ingredients , mixing well
6. Spoon into prepared pan and sprinkle with almonds
7. Place pan on a baking sheet to ensure even cooking
8. Bake 60-80 minutes for a tube or bundt cake , 45-55 minutes for loaf pans or 40-45 minutes for a sheet cake
9. Let cake cool in pan on a wire rack for 20 minutes , before removing
10. Cool completely on wire rack

title: shredded veggie bread
steps:
1. You can use a mashed banana for part of the three cups , too
2. Preheat oven to 350
3. Mix flour , baking powder , soda , salt , and cinnamon in large bowl
4. Combine juice or milk , eggs , oil and sugar in med bowl
5. Add wet to dry ingredients
6. Stir just till moistened
7. Fold in shredded veggies
8. Pour into greased 9" loaf pan
9. Bake 55-65 minute

title: buttermilk cheese biscuits
steps:
1. At least 30 minutes or up to 2 1 / 2 hours before serving: in a medium bowl , stir together flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
2. With a pastry blender or two knives , cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
3. Stir in cheese and buttermilk just until dry ingredients are moistened
4. Place on a lightly floured surface
5. Gently knead ten to twelve times
6. Roll or pat to 1 / 2-inch thickness
7. Cut with a 2 1 / 2-inch biscuit cutter dipped in flour
8. Place biscuits on an ungreased baking sheet
9. If making ahead , cover and refrigerate up to 2 hours
10. About 25 minutes before serving: preheat oven to 425-degrees for 10 minutes
11. Bake biscuits for 12-14 minutes or until golden brown

title: bloomin  sugar cookies
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , beat margarine or butter and cream cheese with an electric mixer on medium-to-high speed about 30 seconds or until softened
2. Add about half of the flour , the sugar , egg , baking powder , and vanilla to the margarine mixture
3. Beat until thoroughly combined , scraping sides of bowl occasionally
4. Then beat or stir in the remaining flour
5. Divide dough in half
6. Cover and chill for 3 to 24 hours , until easy to handle
7. On a lightly floured surface roll each portion of dough to 1 / 4" thickness
8. Cut into 2 1 / 2 to 3 1 / 2 inch shapes
9. Place 1 inch apart on an ungreased cookie sheet
10. Bake at 375 for 9-10 minutes or until edges are firm and bottoms are very lightly browned
11. Carefully remove cookies and cool on a wire rack
12. Frost with meringue powder glaze

title: vietanamese chicken and rice noodle salad
steps:
1. In a large pot of boiling water , cook noodles for 5 - 8 minutes or until tender
2. Drain
3. Rinse under cold water
4. Drain
5. Transfer to a large bowl
6. Add chicken , cucumbers , carrots , peppers and cilantro
7. Dressing: in a small bowl , blend together fish sauce , vinegar , lime juice , curry paste , sugar , garlic and sesame oil
8. Add dressing to noodle mixture , toss to combine
9. Sprinkle with peanuts of using

title: frozen mango daiquiri
steps:
1. Place all the ingredients in a blender and process with a small scoop of crushed ice until smooth
2. Serve in a large glass and garnish with slices of ripe mango

title: ohio river bottom sludge cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Sift the dry ingredients from the first list together
3. Add the liquid items from the first list and blend well
4. Pour the mixture in the an 8-inch square greased glass baking dish
5. Combine ingredients from the second list and sprinkle over the cake mixture
6. Pour the boiling water over everything but do not stir !
7. Bake for 40 minutes
8. A fudgy crust will form on top and a thick sauce forms underneath
9. Let it stand for 15 minutes before serving
10. Goes great with some ice cream on the side !

title: mexican stew
steps:
1. In large skillet brown meat and drain well
2. Put in crock pot add taco seasoning and mix well
3. Add pureed stewed tomatoes , beans , hominy and ranch dressing mix
4. Cook on low 4-6 hours
5. Good with cornbread

title: holiday cherry bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f prepare 9x13 pan by spraying with non-stick cooking spray
2. Mix cracker crumbs in bowl with melted butter and press into bottom of pan
3. Pour chopped cherries and juice over crust
4. Layer white chocolate chips , coconut , and nuts and pour sweetened condensed milk over top of all
5. Bake 25 minutes
6. Do not over bake
7. Delicious !

title: cream cheese and olive everything
steps:
1. If my cream cheese is not at room temperature , i put it in a bowl and microwave it just a little to soften it--don't cook it
2. On a bread board , cut the olives up
3. If you want more or less , use what you like
4. Put in the olive juice and milk and mix well
5. If you want it for a dip , add the sour cream--adding more if you want
6. Keep refrigerated

title: quick pasty pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Place crust in an 8-inch pie pan and press into bottom of pan
3. In a large bowl , thoroughly combine hash browns , ground beef , shredded onion , garlic , salt and pepper , and carrots
4. Place filling into the pie pan and top with second pie crust
5. Seal edges of crusts together and cut vents into the top crust
6. Bake for 50-60 minutes or until meat is cooked through
7. Serve topped with beef gravy or ketchup , if desired

title: delicious   easy pasta puttanesca
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti to very al dente
2. Drain , and set aside
3. To the empty pasta pot , add the olive oil , garlic , red pepper flakes and anchovy paste
4. Heat on medium heat , stirring occasionally until garlic starts to sizzle and anchovy paste begins to melt into the oil
5. Add the olives and capers , stirring occasionally until heated through and fragrant
6. Add the tomatoes and stir , allowing them to heat through
7. Add the basil , oregano , pecorino , and freshly cracked black pepper
8. Stir to combine and let simmer for about 2 to 3 minutes
9. Add the reserved pasta , toss to heat-through , and serve with additional grated cheese
10. Then enjoy an authentic italian meal !

title: emeril s mole sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f place the nuts , peppers and onions on a baking sheet
2. Drizzle with 1t olive oil
3. Roast for 10-15 minutes
4. Remove from the oven and peel , seed and chop the peppers
5. In a food processor combine the nuts , peppers , onions , chili powder , cumin , salt , tamarind paste , 1t dark cane syrup , vinegar and olive oil
6. Puree until creamy , stopping once to scrape the sides of the bowl
7. Turn the sauce into a saucepan
8. Whisk in the chicken stock and cream
9. Bring the sauce up to a boil and reduce to a simmer
10. Cook for two minutes
11. Remove from heat and keep warm

title: country french chicken with herb and butter noodles
steps:
1. In large skillet over medium high heat , warm the olive oil
2. Season the chicken , brown it in the oil for 2-3 minutes on each side , and remove to a plate
3. Return pan to stove and reduce heat to medium
4. Add butter to the pan and saute the shallots , carrots and mushrooms
5. Saute for 3-5 minutes until mushrooms darken and carrot bits are fork tender
6. Add tarragon and parsley and stir
7. Add wine and reduce liquid for 1-2 minutes
8. Add tomatoes to the sauce and stir to combine
9. Add chicken back to the pan and simmer chicken in sauce for 6 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and juices run clear
10. Serve chicken with herb and butter noodles and sugar snap peas , if desired
11. To make noodles , toss the cooked noodles with butter bits and herbs in a bowl until butter melts , about 1 minute
12. Season noodles with salt and pepper

title: spanish tomato bread with jamon serrano  serrano ham
steps:
1. Mix together the chopped tomatoes , garlic glove , olive oil , salt and pepper
2. Keep in the fridge until needed
3. To serve , toast 20 slices of baguette
4. Spoon a little tomato topping on to each piece of toast
5. Tear 5-6 slices of jamn serrano into pieces and put one piece on each slice of bread

title: mushroom flatout pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Place the flatout on a baking sheet spray top side with cooking spray
3. Bake for 7 minutes
4. Remove from oven
5. Put all your goodies on the flatout
6. Bake again for 5 minutes or till cheese melts

title: strawberry dessert sauce
steps:
1. Mash strawberries
2. Set aside
3. In a saucepan , combine the sugar , cornstarch and water until smooth
4. Bring to a boil
5. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
6. Stir in strawberries
7. Remove from the heat
8. Stir in lemon juice
9. Transfer to a small bowl
10. Cover and refrigerate until chilled

title: ronald reagan s rancho rice
steps:
1. Saute onion in butter until limp , add rice , cottage cheese , bay leaf , salt & pepper , mix well
2. In a greased casserole dish , layer rice mixture , chilies , 1 / 2 cup cheese
3. Repeat ending with a layer of rice
4. Bake for 25 minute at 375f
5. Remove from oven top with 1 / 3 cup cheese and bake 10 minutes longer

title: hocus pocus cottage cake

2. If you are trying to recreate the full cake , you'll need to make this recipe 6 times - which will yield 60 servings

8. Lastly , mix in the oreo cookie crumbles into batter then pour into two buttered and floured 10x10 square baking pans
9. Bake 35 minutes until a toothpick inserted comes out clean
10. Wrap and chill well before cutting and assembling cake
11. Cookies and cream buttercream frosting:

16. Chocolate cookie wood trim:
17. Additional tools: parchment paper , cardboard cutout stencils , large cookie sheets
18. In a stand mixer beat butter and sugar until creamy , add chocolate syrup and eggs
19. In another bowl , mix all dry ingredients
