49. Advice and pointers: because you're using raw egg whites andsalmonella is a risk , always use fresh eggsfrom a reliable source and don't allow unused frosting to sit out for more than an hour or so
50. Anyunused frosting can be covered with a damp towel to prevent drying and retain freshness
51. Keep in mind thelonger you work with a single batch the darker the colorwill become , so wheninitially mixing , keep that in mind
52. I usually make one batch at a time , mixing more as needed
53. Royal icing fall leaves:
54. In a stand mixer beat egg whites until frothy and incorporate sugar until smooth
55. Separate into three bowls and add color to each in a fall array of your choice
56. Take a basting brush and paint a thin layer of each color onto a large parchment lined baking sheet
57. Allow each color to dry at room temperature
58. Once completely dry , crumble all colors together making sure nothing is too large
59. If the final product is too vivid you can add a bit of coca powder to it to give it a more natural appearance
60. Additional materials needed:
61. Cake board , wooden dowel rods , battery operated tea lights , electrical tape
62. The light stays lit for roughly three days and should be removed before cutting and serving
63. Various colors of powder paints and ice-cold vodka
64. I used these minimally on this project to give the house some deeper tones and shading where needed
65. Purple smoke bombs -- this was an adventure ! i ordered them off amazon and used roughly 12 until i got all the shots i needed
66. One at a time they were placed in the chimney cavity and lit
67. They emit smoke for only about 10 seconds or so and the chimney portion shouldnotbe served , but instead discarded
68. Assembly of cake:
69. I kept all cake elements cold at all times
70. This was an extremely heavy cake and allowing it to fully come to room temperature would have caused it to sag and lose it's correct shape
71. After studying the house from the movie , i cut out cake board sheets in the necessary shapes using a craft blade
72. Every third layer got a sheet of the board between and 4-5 cut dowel rods placed variously through the layer to give the needed support
73. Once the structure was built , it received a generous crumb coat before getting a polishing final coat of buttercream
74. It was then allowed to chill fully over night before the next step
75. The following day , the large window frames were placed in their respective places using royal icing to 'glue' all cookie pieces to the house
76. I used a bread knife to cut small pockets in each window and door frame to allow for a light to be placed before photographing
77. Once these pockets were cut out , i coated all their inner walls with a bit of butter cream to prevent the cake from drying out
78. My secret weapon for cookie sculpting: i used a dremel tool to perfect each edge and to cut every accent and roof strip to align with the next
79. Once the cake was fully assembled it received a few accents and shading done with powder paints and then the surrounding ground was coated with brown sugar and a sprinkling of the royal icing leaves
80. As an additional touch i used shredded wheat to add bails of hay in the front and used the remaining cookie dough to create surrounding trees
81. As a final step i hand painted a large tri-fold presentation board as a background landscape :d

title: beef tenderloin with mustard tarragon cream sauce
steps:
1. Heat a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray
2. Sprinkle steaks with 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and pepper
3. Add steaks to pan
4. Cook 3 minutes on each side or until desired degree of doneness
5. Remove from pan
6. Keep warm
7. Add dry white wine , sugar , and dijon mustard to pan
8. Bring to a boil 1 minute stirring constantly
9. Remove from heat
10. Stir in 1 / 4 teaspoon salt , sour cream , and chopped tarragon
11. Spoon sauce over warm steaks
12. Garnish with tarragon sprigs , if desired

title: confectioner s custard
steps:
1. Cream the egg yolks and the sugar together until thick and pale in colour
2. Beat in the flour , cornflour , and a very small amount of the milk taken from the 300 ml total , just enough to make a smooth paste
3. Heat the remaining milk until almost boiling and pour it into the egg mixture , sirring constantly
4. Stir mixture over a low heat until it boils , then remove
5. Beat egg white until stiff and fold it into the custard
6. Return to the heat again and add vanilla essence and cook for another few minutes
7. Use as choux pastry fillings etc

title: spicy pepper chicken pasta
steps:
1. If fresh chop fine a small amount of coriander & basil
2. If dry add coriander & basil into mortar & crush with pestle
3. If fresh put chopped herbs into mortar , regardless now add desired amount of black peppercorns & crush , now add some nuts to the mixture & crush
4. Chop up 1 red pepper , half the onion & the garlic cloves roughly and put in food processor
5. Now add the pasta sauce , a sensible amount of pesto , a generous amount of lime juice & the spice / nut mix within the mortar
6. Now process well & leave
7. Chop the other half of the onion very finely & also cut the chicken breasts into bite size cubes
8. Fry the onion in some olive oil until golden then add the chicken
9. After the chicken turns white add your desired amount of chilli powder then add a generous amount of lime juice to the wok / pan
10. Put the spaghetti on to boil while pan-frying the chicken , also finely chop the second red pepper and after a few minutes of the coated chicken being in the pan / wok add the chopped pepper
11. Wait a few more minutes then add a little more lime juice while continuing to stir on a medium / high heat
12. Put the sauce from the processor into a saucepan & heat gently
13. When chicken is almost cooked add a little more lime juice if necersary to insure moist , turn up heat on sauce to insure it is heated through properly
14. When chicken is cooked well , put aside , when sauce is hot put aside , when spaghetti is cooked put aside then mix all together in large bowl & serve immediatly with warm ciabatta bread

title: pumpkin spice muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Combine dry ingredients in a large bowl
3. Set aside
4. In a separate bowl , whisk together pumpkin , carrots , buttermilk , honey , butter or margarine , egg , vanilla , and orange zest
5. Add to flour mixture , stirring just until moistened
6. This is a thick batter
7. Fold walnuts into batter , gently
8. Spoon batter into 12-cup muffin pan
9. Bake for 20 minutes , or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
10. Remove from pan and cool on a wire rack

title: spicy tomato   bacon soup
steps:
1. Remove rind from bacon and tear into bite sized pieces
2. Place bacon , oil , garlic , and onion flakes into medium saucepan and cook over medium heat until bacon is browned and cooked through
3. Add all remaining ingredients apart from bread and slowly bring to boil over medium temperature
4. Reduce temperature to low and simmer for 10 minutes
5. Meanwhile toast bread and cut into small squares as croutons
6. Serve soup in bowl with croutons sprinled over the top

title: interesting fruity popcorn balls
steps:
1. Place popcorn in lightly buttered large bowl
2. Mix sugar and syrup in saucepan and bring to a boil
3. Remove from heat and add jello
4. Stir in peanuts
5. Pour over popcorn , mix well and then cool for about 5 minutes
6. Shape into 2" balls and eat them up !

title: crock pot thai chicken with vegetables
steps:
1. Whisk coconut milk , flour , and curry base in slow-cooker until smooth
2. Whisk in garlic and salt
3. Add chicken , onion , and carrots
4. Stir to mix
5. Scatter bell pepper over top
6. Cover and cook on low 6 to 8 hours until chicken and vegetables are tender

title: coconut banana pudding
steps:
1. For the pudding , heat coconut milk and whole milk in a saucepan over medium until it steams
2. Whisk together 1 c cream of coconut , cornstarch , egg yolks , and salt until smooth
3. While whisking , gradually pour in half of the hot milk mixture
4. Pour egg-milk mixture back into pan and cook over medium heat until thick
5. Boil pudding 1 minute more , whisking constantly , to eliminate any starchy taste
6. Off heat , stir in butter and vanilla until butter melts
7. Transfer pudding to a bowl and cover with plastic wrap , pressing it on the surface
8. Chill pudding until cool
9. To assemble , layer banana slices on bottom of a 5 qt trifle dish , top banana with a third of the pudding and a layer of wafers
10. Repeat layering two times , top with final layer of bananas , cover and chill until cold
11. For the whipped cream , beat heavy cream and 1 / 2 c cream of coconut with a mixer on medium speed until soft peaks form
12. Top dessert with whipped cream and garnish with toasted coconut

title: t v  eggs   kids favorite fun to eat breakfast
steps:
1. 1
2. Prep bread by cutting circles into centers of each piece of bread about the size of an egg yolk
3. Butter each piece of bread with 1 / 2 tablespoons butter
4. Set aside
5. 2
6. Grease a medium frying pan with non fat no stick cooking spray and crack 1 egg into pan as if you are making a sunny side up egg
7. Let cook very slightly until the egg is stable
8. Add salt and pepper onto egg
9. 3
10. Cover the egg with the piece of buttered bread , buttered side up , so that the yolk polks up un-broken through the whole in the bread
11. After egg has cooked sufficiently , flip over onto other side of pan and let cook for an additional 30 seconds
12. 4
13. Repeat with other egg
14. Enjoy !

title: quinoa with spices
steps:
1. Boil quinoa in water for 15 minutes to remove bitter taste
2. Drain
3. Mix all ingredients
4. Serve hot or cold

title: sweet corn tomalito
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Mix together the margarine / butter , masa harina and sugar
3. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix together well
4. Spread out the mixture onto a 9x13 baking dish
5. Place the dish with the mixture on top of another dish that is filled halfway with water
6. Cover the dishes with aluminum foil
7. Carefully place the dishes into the oven and bake for ~1 hour and 15 minutes
8. Check with a toothpick if the dish is done
9. When done , the toothpick will come out clean
10. Scoop into serving dish or tupperware or serve directly onto plates !

title: iced oatmeal applesauce cookies  martha stewart
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix the butter and both sugars until combined
3. Add the egg and applesauce , mixing until well blended
4. Mix in oats , flour , baking soda , baking powder , and salt
5. Fold in raisins
6. Using a 1 1 / 2-inch ice cream scoop , drop dough onto baking sheets lined with parchment paper , spacing 2 inches apart
7. Bake cookies until golden , 13 to 15 minutes
8. Let cool on sheets 5 minutes
9. Transfer cookies to a wire rack set over parchment paper
10. Let cool completely
11. To make icing: whisk confectioners' sugar , syrup , and 3 tablespoons water until smooth
12. Drizzle over cookies , let set

title: crock pot apple pie
steps:
1. Toss the apples in a large bowl with the cinnamon , nutmeg and allspice
2. Place in lightly greased crockpot
3. Combine milk , softened butter , sugar , eggs , vanilla and the 1 / 2 cup bisquik
4. Spoon over apples
5. Combine 1 cup bisquik and brown sugar
6. Cut the cold butter into mixture until crumbly
7. Sprinkle this mixture over the top of the apple mixture
8. Cover and cook on low 6-7 hours

title: individual chocolate indulgence cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
2. In the top of a double boiler , melt the chocolate , then add the butter and sugar until just melted
3. Add eggs and whisk until well combined
4. Add flour and mix only until combined
5. Do not overmix or the cake will be rubbery
6. Lightly grease four 4-ounce disposable aluminum cups , muffin molds , or ramekins with vegetable baking spray
7. Distribute batter among the four molds
8. Place molds on a sheet pan and bake for 10 to 12 minutes
9. Do not overbake
10. For the chocolate sauce: pour the milk into a 2-quart heavy-bottomed saucepan , place over medium-high heat , and bring to a boil
11. When it boils , remove the milk from the heat and make a ganache by adding the chopped chocolate
12. Whisk well , stirring into the edge of the saucepan to combine
13. The ganache should be homogenous and smooth
14. Set the ganache aside
15. In a 1-quart heavy-bottomed saucepan , combine the heavy cream , butter , and sugar
16. Place the saucepan over medium-high heat and bring to a boil , stirring occasionally
17. The butter should be completely melted and the sugar completely dissolved
18. Once the mixture has come to a boil , pour it into the warm ganache
19. Place the sauce over medium-high heat and bring to a boil , stirring constantly with a whisk
20. As the chocolate sauce cooks , it will begin to thicken slightly
21. When it reaches a boil , remove it from the heat , and pour it into a clean , dry bowl
22. Cover by placing plastic wrap directly on top of the sauce to prevent a skin from forming
23. Let the chocolate sauce cool to room temperature before storing in the refrigerator
24. When cold , the sauce will become thick enough to be scooped with a spoon
25. Invert molds onto individual serving plates
26. If you would like to decorate the plate , do so with fresh raspberries or fruit or chocolate sauce , and serve immediately
27. The sauce can be reheated whenever needed
28. If using a microwave , simply place the chocolate sauce in a microwaveable bowl and heat it at medium-high power in 30-second intervals until it becomes liquid
29. On the stovetop , place in a heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium heat and stir occasionally until it becomes liquid
30. If you store it in a squeeze bottle , you can easily drizzle it over a dessert or decorate a plate
31. It will keep in the refrigerator for up to three weeks
32. It can also be frozen for up to two months if stored in an airtight container
33. Thaw in the refrigerator and heat as described above until liquid

title: southwestern spinach salad
steps:
1. Cook bacon and let cool on paper towels
2. Hard boil , peel , and slice eggs
3. Combine picante sauce , dressing , and cumin
4. Slice pepper and onion
5. Crumble bacon
6. Toss bacon , pepper , onion , spinach , and mushrooms in a salad bowl
7. Rinse and drain black beans , add to salad
8. Drizzle with dressing and toss again
9. Garnish with egg slices

title: pear date compote
steps:
1. Melt butter over low heat
2. Add pear slices and toss to coat
3. Add dates and saute 3-5 minutes , until tender
4. Add water , lemon juice and honey , and stir well

title: little caesar s crazy sauce by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Combine all the ingredients in an uncovered saucepan over medium heat
2. When the sauce begins to bubble , reduce the heat and simmer for 30-40 minutes , stirring often
3. Remove sauce from heat
4. Cool
5. Store the crazy sauce in an air tight container in the refrigerator , it will keep 3-4 weeks
6. Warm up when ready to use
7. Serve hot

title: grilled artichokes with creamy butter dip
steps:
1. Prepare the artichokes:
2. Fill a large bowl with cold water and squeeze the juice of 1 lemon half into it
3. Remove the stems and pointy
4. Rub all cut areas with the remaining lemon half
5. Place each trimmed artichoke into the bowl of lemon water until ready to steam
6. Steam the artichokes:
7. Drain the artichokes and place stem side up in a steamer basket over about 1" of water and 1 / 4 cup lemon juice
8. Cover , reduce heat to low , and simmer until tender-about 30 minutes
9. Drain and transfer to a large bowl to cool
10. Grill the artichokes:
11. Heat the grill to medium
12. Cut the artichokes in half lenthwise
13. Scoopout the inner pink leaves and the fuzzy choke
14. Toss the cleaned artchokes with the oil , salt , and pepper and grill until golden-4 to 6 minutes on each side
15. Stir the remaining lemon juice , butter , mayonnaise , red pepper , and basil , if using , together and serve as an acconpanying dip
16. Enjoy !

title: baked manicotti with meat sauce
steps:
1. Make filling by mixing first 8ingredients and 1 cup parmesan cheese
2. Blend thoroughly
3. Cook meat with garlic and onions
4. Sprinkle with salt and drain grease
5. Stuff cooked noodles with filling
6. Butter 12x15 baking dish
7. Spoon tomato sauce in bottom of dish to cover
8. Place stuffed shells in dish to completely fill
9. Sprinkle meat over and around shells
10. Spoon tomato sauce over shells generously
11. Sprinke with 1 / 2 cup parmesan
12. Cover with foil
13. Bake at 350f for 45 minutes

title: scrambled eggs with a greek flair
steps:
1. Warm olive oil in frying pan over medium / high heat
2. Once sizzling hot put onions , garlic and bell peppers into pan , saut until lightly browned
3. Add zucchini and cook until zucchini is slightly softened but still firm
4. Mix in tomatoes and olives
5. Add eggs , salt and pepper to taste , then cook until eggs are no longer "wet"
6. Remove from pan and sprinkle with feta to taste
7. I frequently serve this with bacon or sausage and whole grain toast

title: new york times chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Sift flours , baking soda , baking powder and salt in a bowl
2. Set aside
3. Using a mixer fitted with paddle attachment , cream butter and sugars together until very light , about 5 minutes
4. Add eggs one at a time , mixing well after each addition
5. Stir in the vanilla
6. Reduce speed to low , add dry ingredients and mix until just combined , 5 to 10 seconds
7. Drop chocolate pieces in and incorporate them without breaking them
8. Press plastic wrap against dough and refrigerate for 24 to 36 hours
9. Dough may be used in batches and can be refrigerated up to 72 hours
10. When ready to bake , preheat oven to 350 degrees
11. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a nonstick baking mat
12. Set aside
13. Scoop 6 3
14. 5-ounce mounds of dough onto baking sheet , making sure to turn horizontally any chocolate pieces poking up
15. It will make for a more attractive cookie
16. Sprinkle lightly with sea salt and bake until golden brown but still soft , 18 to 20 minutes
17. Transfer sheet to a wire rack for 10 minutes , then slip cookies onto another rack to cool a bit more
18. Repeat with remaining dough , or reserve dough , refrigerated , for baking remaining batches the next day
19. Eat warm , with a big napkin

title: chicken fajita pot pie
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f in large skillet , heat oil over medium heat
2. Cook bell pepper in oil , stirring occasionally , until crisp-tender
3. Stir in chicken , salsa and water
4. Cook 1 to 2 minutes , stirring occasionally , until bubbly
5. Pour into ungreased 1 1 / 2-quart casserole
6. Set aside
7. In small bowl , stir together remaining ingredients and pour over chicken mixture
8. Carefully spread almost to edge of casserole
9. Bake uncovered about 30 minutes or until light golden brown

title: gingerbread castle
steps:
1. Gingerbread castle:
2. For my gingerbread structures , i like to build their general shape out of cardboard first
3. This is a great way to address any structural issues before it's too late
4. They also give you an amazing stencil to use to cut out your cookie shapes and then later they're great for preventing any mess when you're pouring candy glass windows into your finished cookies
5. In a stand mixer beat butter and sugar until creamy , add molasses and eggs
6. In another bowl , mix all dry ingredients
7. Once done slowly mix into wet ingredients and stir until dough ball forms
8. Wrap softball sized portions in foil and chill until ready to use
9. Heat oven to 360 degrees fahrenheit
10. Line cookie sheets with parchment and roll dough directly onto cookie sheets
11. Using flour to prevent sticking
12. Cut out shapes using homemade stencils and save scraps for the next sheet
13. Baking time varies depending on how large your cookie is
14. Large cookies can take 18 minutes and small decorative pieces can be done in as little as 5 minutes
15. So keep an eye on them
16. Once baked , remove from oven (and here's my secret to getting a smooth cookie -- immediately after removing a batch from the oven , place a sheet of parchment over the top and using a slightly smaller baking sheet press , slide and swivel the smaller sheet on top until perfect
17. Allow cookies to cool before removing and place on paper towels
18. Do any candy glass windows before assembling
19. Advice and pointers: assembling is my personal favorite part , but be sure to have a lot of patience and go slowly
20. Don't let go of any pieces unless you're positive they're secure and if you're unsure , use various kitchen items as supports -- things get pretty jenky in my kitchen during this process
21. Know that cookies will break here and there , make extra of critical pieces if you have the time and keep in mind you're doing something fun and when things go wrong , it's just a lesson for the future -- at least that's what i tell myself when i'm facing a kitchen catastrophe :d
22. Candy glass:
23. Mix sugar , water , corn syrup and tartar in a large pot on medium / high heat
24. Stir constantly until mixture begins to boil
25. Stop stirring and place candy thermometer on the edge of the pot with the temp gauge submerged into sugar syrup
26. This part takes forever so set up a chair next to the stove and grab a magazine / book / laptop and keep an eye on the thermometer
27. Allow to heat to 300 degrees and immediately remove from heat
28. Stir and mix in two drops blue food coloring
29. Have cookies clean and resting face up on a very flat surface covered in a aluminum foil
30. Use your cardboard stencil over your cookie and pour candy glass into your cutouts using a bent tea spoon or small ladle
31. Once poured , immediately lift stencil off and clear any sugar strands that occur
32. Advice and pointers: this is one of those things you should set a lot of time aside for and prepare yourself with a lot of patience
33. Having a plate warmer to set the pot of hot sugar on near your workstation is a great way to give yourself a bit more time to work with each batch
34. Depending on how many windows you have to do , you'll be needing to make several batches
35. As soon as one batch begins to harden , you need to cut your losses and discard it
36. This stuff is also insanely hot so be very careful and make sure no pets , children or other obstacles are around when working with candy glass !
37. Royal icing for gingerbread castle:
38. In a stand mixer beat egg whites till frothy and incorporate sugar until smooth
39. Then mix in the rest of the ingredients little bits at a time until the color you desire is achieved
40. Advice and pointers: because you're using raw egg whites and salmonella is a risk , always use fresh eggs from a reliable source and don't allow unused frosting to sit out for more than an hour or so
41. Any unused frosting can be covered with a damp towel to prevent drying and retain freshness
42. Keep in mind the longer you work with a single batch the darker the color will become , so when initially mixing , keep that in mind
43. Royal icing for holly , wreaths and christmas trees:
44. Using any used gingerbread dough , cut out and shape christmas trees and bake
45. Using a small star

title: olive oil mayonnaise
steps:
1. Put egg , salt and spices into a food processor
2. Add lemon juce and pulse a couple of times to blend
3. Turn the processor onto continuous mode and sloooowwwly pour the olive oil into the processor tube
4. Stream should be no larger than a pencil thick
5. When the stream is done continue to the count of five
6. Your done
7. Use in salads , sandwiches and anything calling for mayonnaise

title: skillet apple pie     america s test kitchen
steps:
1. 1
2. For the crust: pulse flour , sugar , and salt in food processor until combined
3. Add shortening and process until mixture has texture of coarse sand , about ten 1-second pulses
4. Scatter butter pieces over flour mixture and process until mixture is pale yellow and resembles coarse crumbs , with butter bits no larger than small peas , about ten 1-second pulses
5. Transfer mixture to medium bowl
6. 2
7. Sprinkle 3 tablespoons ice water over mixture
8. With blade of rubber spatula , use folding motion to mix
9. Press down on dough with broad side of spatula until dough sticks together , adding up to 1 tablespoon more ice water if dough does not come together
10. Turn dough out onto sheet of plastic wrap and flatten into 4-inch disk
11. Wrap dough and refrigerate 30 minutes , or up to 2 days , before rolling out

13. For the filling: adjust oven rack to upper-middle position and heat oven to 500 degrees
14. Whisk cider , syrup , lemon juice , cornstarch , and cinnamon together in medium bowl until smooth
15. Heat butter in 12-inch heatproof skillet over medium-high heat
16. When foaming subsides , add apples and cook , stirring 2 or 3 times until apples begin to caramelize , about 5 minutes
17. Remove pan from heat , add cider mixture , and gently stir until apples are well coated
18. Set aside to cool slightly
19. 4
20. To assemble and bake: roll out dough on lightly floured work surface , or between 2 large sheets of plastic wrap , to 11-inch circle
21. Roll dough loosely around rolling pin and unroll over apple filling
22. Brush dough with egg white and sprinkle with sugar
23. With sharp knife , gently cut dough into 6 pieces by making 1 vertical cut followed by 2 evenly spaced horizontal cuts
24. Bake until apples are tender and crust is a deep golden brown , about 20 minutes
25. Let cool 15 minutes
26. Serve

title: warm bacon and cabbage salad
steps:
1. Toast the walnuts and set aside
2. Cook the bacon over medium heat until crispy
3. Set aside to drain and cool
4. Drain off all bacon fat except for 1 tablespoon
5. Add the garlic and onion to the pan and saute over medium heat for about 2 minutes
6. Next add the sherry and cook until reduced by half , approximately 3-4 minutes
7. Add the cabbage and {{lightly}} cook until wilted but still crunchy , about another minute
8. Remove pan from heat
9. Transfer the cabbage mixture to a salad bowl and toss with the wine vinegar , olive oil , thyme , walnuts and crumbled bacon
10. Season to taste with salt
11. Serve warm

title: grilled chipotle marinated pork loin
steps:
1. Heat oil over medium heat in a large saucepan and add onion and garlic until onion is translucent
2. Add chipotle peppers that have been removed from the sauce and finely chopped
3. Beware ! add only amount needed for your taste
4. Add to onions along with the adobe sauce
5. Add coffee through worcestershire sauce and whisk to combine
6. Bring to a simmer and cook for 5 to 6 minutes
7. Remove from heat and refrigerate until chilled
8. Place pork loin in a deep bowl or large plastic ziploc bag
9. Marinate for at least 12 hours up to 2 days
10. Turn the pork occasionally
11. About 2 hours before grilling , remove pork from marinade
12. Bring the marinade to a boil until slightly thickened
13. Season with salt if desired or needed
14. Use 1 / 2 cup marinade to baste the pork and use remaining marinade to serve with the pork
15. Heat grill to medium-hot and set pork , fat side down on grill
16. Turn and baste with the sauce until meat reaches an inernal temperature of 150 degrees f
17. Careful not to overcook
18. Let stand for juices to settle
19. Reheat sauce to serve with the meat

title: vincent price vegetable rice   shellfish   pilaf a la valenc
steps:
1. In a saucepan , melt the butter
2. Add the eggplant , zucchini , mushrooms , garlic , pimientos , salt , and pepper and cook over medium heat , stirring occasionally , for 10 minutes
3. Stir in the rice , then add the broth and bring mixture to a boil
4. Reduce temperature to low , cover tightly , and cook for 30 minutes
5. While the vegetable stewed rice is cooking , scrub the shellfish thoroughly under running water
6. Put the shellfish into a pan with the water , cover , and cook on high for 5 minutes until shells open
7. Set aside and keep warm
8. To serve , pour the cooked vegetable rice onto a warm serving platter and top with the cooked shellfish in their shells - traditionally served with brochette des corsaires and scupions a la nicoise

title: slow cooker chicken barley soup
steps:
1. Heat the chicken broth and pour into slow cooker
2. Place chopped vegetables
3. Onions , garlic , celery and carrots in microwave container
4. Microwave 5 minutes
5. Spoon into slow cooker and cook on high for 2 hours ,
6. Heat up mushrooms in microwave
7. Add rinsed barley , chicken and mushrooms , salt and pepper to the slow cooker
8. On high cook another hour
9. Serve with crackers

title: greek style lemon potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. Remember to boil the chicken broth
3. Spray a 9- by 13-in
4. Baking dish with cooking spray
5. In a large bowl , toss potato cubes with lemon juice , olive oil , oregano , lemon zest , salt , and garlic
6. Layer slices in baking dish
7. Pour 1 cup boiling chicken broth over potatoes and bake , uncovered , until most of the broth has evaporated and potatoes are tender , about 30 minutes
8. Top with feta and bake until golden , about 15 minutes more

title: topsy turvy nutty rhubarb cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Lightly spray a 9" x 1 1 / 2 " round cake pan with cooking spray
3. Chop the rhubarb into 1 / 2" chunks
4. In a large bowl , toss the rhubarb with 1 cup sugar and 1 / 4 cup flour until the pieces are well coated
5. Spread the rhubarb mix over the bottom of the prepared cake pan
6. In another bowl , beat the ricotta cheese with the egg until smooth and creamy
7. Add the almond extract and 1 / 4 cup sugar and mix well
8. Add 1 cup flour and the baking powder and mix well
9. The batter will be thick , almost like biscuit dough
10. Spread the dough over the rhubarb in the pan , making sure it goes all the way to the edge
11. Be careful not to let the juice from the fruit mix into the dough
12. Put the cake in the oven with a piece of foil under the pan to catch any drips that might bubble over
13. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes
14. While the cake is baking , coarsely chop the macadamia nuts
15. Melt the butter in a small bowl
16. Add the brown sugar , chopped nuts , and cornflake crumbs and toss until blended and crumbly
17. Remove the cake from the oven and allow to cool for 30 minutes
18. Put a serving plate over the pan and invert onto the plate
19. Tap the bottom of the pan to release the cake onto the plate
20. Sprinkle the nut topping over the fruit and press lightly
21. Allow the cake to cool before serving
22. Serve at room temperature or chilled

title: grandma johnson s pecan sandies
steps:
1. Cream together the butter and 1 / 4 cup sugar
2. Add the flour , vanilla , water and pecans , mix until well combined
3. Form into rolls about 3 / 4 inch thick
4. Cut into pieces about 1 1 / 2 inches long
5. Bake on ungreased cookie sheets in 300 degree oven for 20 minutes
6. While still hot roll in the 2 cups confectioners' sugar
7. Let cool , but do not store in refigerater

title: white chocolate chunk macadamia nut brownie cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Combine shortening , brown sugar , water , and vanilla
3. Beat eggs into creamed mixture
4. Combine flour , cocoa , baking soda and salt
5. Mix into creamed mixture at low speed just until blended
6. Stir in white chocolate and nuts
7. Drop rounded tablespoonfuls of the dough 2 inches apart onto an ungreased baking sheet
8. Bake 1 baking sheet at a time for 7-9 minutes
9. , or until cookies are set
10. Do not overbake
11. Cool for 2 minutes on a baking sheet
12. Place sheets of foil on countertop
13. Remove cookies to foil to cool completely

title: dirk s birthday cheesecake
steps:
1. Topping: in a small bowl blend together cup of sour cream and 2 tablespoons granulated sugar
2. Set aside
3. Base: preset oven to 325 degrees f
4. Blend together melted margarine , graham cracker crumbs and 1 tablespoon sugar
5. Press firmly on the base of a 9" sprayed springform pan and bake for 10 minutes
6. Cool completely then cover the base of the pan on the outside with heavy tin foil set aside and prepare the filling
7. Cheesecake filling: in a blender blend until smooth cream cheese , 1 / 2 cup sour cream , condensed milk , cornstarch or custard powder , eggs , lemon zest and juice and vanilla extract
8. Pour gently over cooled crumb base
9. Water bath: place springfoam pan in a large enough shallow roasting pan and fill with enough water to come up the sides to about half an inch
10. Baking: reduce oven heat to 300 degrees f and bake cheesecake in the water bath for 1 hour
11. Pour over the topping and continue to bake a further 10 to 15 minutes
12. Remove cheesecake from the oven and from the water bath
13. Cool completely on a wire rack then refrigerate

title: blueberry mustard
steps:
1. Combine the tbsp of mustard seeds with the tbsp of white wine and set aside
2. Whisk together the cornstarch and water
3. Set aside
4. Press the half-cup of blueberries through a sieve-- you want a yield of 1 / 2-cup sieved berries so you may need another tbsp or two of blueberries to get that
5. In a saucepan , place the sieved berries , the whole blueberries , port wine , shallots and sugar
6. Whisk in the cornstarch mixture
7. Over medium-high heat , bring to a simmer , then let it cool
8. Whisk in the mustards and softened mustard seeds well , then refrigerate until needed

title: powder puffs
steps:
1. Heat oven to 190c
2. Heat trays
3. Beat egg whites until stiff
4. Gradually add the sugar , beating well
5. Add egg yolks
6. Sieve all dry ingredients together twice and fold into mixture
7. Fold in boiling water
8. Place heaped teaspoonfuls of mixture on hot greased trays and bake in oven for 5 minutes
9. Remove to a wire rack and cool before storing in an air-tight container until required
10. Six hours before serving , sandwich pairs together with whipped cream , and dust tops with icing sugar

title: atole
steps:
1. Put the masa harina in a bowl and whisk in the milk , little by little
2. Pour the milk mixture into a pot and add the brown sugar and cinnamon
3. Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes , stirring constantly , to keep it from becoming lumpy
4. Stir in the vanilla extract
5. Serve in mugs
6. Variations:
7. Pineapple atole
8. Follow the basic recipe , but omit the cinnamon
9. After the mixture has thickened and has been removed from the heat , add 1 small can crushed pineapple , undrained
10. Strawberry atole
11. Follow the basic recipe , but omit the cinnamon
12. After the mixture has thickened and has been removed from the heat , add 2 cups fresh strawberries that have been hulled , washed and crushed

title: double chocolate banana muffins  healthy
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Spray 8 wells of a 12 hole muffin pan with butter-flavored cooking spray or line with paper liners
3. In a large bowl , combine flour , splenda , cocoa , baking powder and baking soda
4. In a small bowl , combine bananas , egg , oil / applesauce and sour cream
5. Add banana mixture to flour mixture
6. Mix gently to combine
7. Fold in chocolate chips
8. Evenly spoon batter into prepared muffin wells
9. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until a tooth pick inserted in center comes out clean
10. Place muffin pan on a wire rack and let set for 5 minutes
11. Remove muffins from pan and continue cooling on wire rack

title: cheddar potatoes and onions
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Pierce potatoes with a fork
3. Arrange on paper towels in microwave oven
4. Microwave at high for 5 to 6 minutes , turning once
5. Let stand 1 minute
6. Cut potatoes lengthwise into quarters
7. Place potatoes and onion wedges in an 8-inch square baking pan coated with cooking spray
8. Lightly coat tops of vegetables with cooking spray , and sprinkle evenly with lemon pepper and salt
9. Bake at 350f for 30 minutes
10. Sprinkle with cheese
11. Cook an additional 3 minutes or until cheese melts

title: broccoli and cheese bake
steps:
1. Steam or cook broccoli in boiling water for just a few minutes until crisp / tender
2. Drain broccoli
3. Beat eggs in a large mixing bowl
4. Add broccoli , flour and cheeses to eggs and mix well
5. Grease large casserole dish cooking spray
6. Add broccoli mixture to casserole dish and bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for 30 minutes

title: broccoli with east west sauce
steps:
1. Boils the broccoli in salted water until it's crisp-tender
2. Meanwhile , cook the butter in a small saucepan over medium heat , stirring often , until it's lightly browned
3. Remove from heat and stir in soy sauce , vinegar and pepper
4. Pour butter mixture over broccoli and mix well
5. Serve hot

title: dulce de leche  latin american caramel spread
steps:
1. Add all the ingredients to a heavy-bottomed saucepan and stir well to dissolve the sugar completely
2. Set the saucepan over medium heat and bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat to very low and simmer , stirring frequently , until thickened and caramelized , about 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours
4. Transfer to a clean glass jar and refrigerate
5. Will keep for 1-2 weeks

title: maple glazed barbcue chicken
steps:
1. Heat grill
2. In a small bowl , stir together all glaze ingredients
3. Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper
4. Brush chicken generously with glaze
5. Place chicken on gas grill over medium or on charcoal grill 4 to 6 inches from medium coals
6. Cover grill
7. Cook 8-12 minutes or until juices run clear , turning once and brushing occasionally with glaze

title: blue cheese and portabella mushroom ragout
steps:
1. Add butter to 12-inch non-stick skillet
2. Saute shallots over low heat until transparent , approximately 10-15 minutes
3. Add sherry , chicken broth , salt , fennel and pepper
4. Simmer 2-3 minutes to allow flavors to blend
5. Add mushrooms
6. Cook until liquid is absorbed
7. Remove pan from heat
8. Crumble blue cheese over mixture and lightly toss
9. Spread mixture over vegetables or pasta
10. Garnish dish with chopped parsley
11. Spread out vegetables on pan in single layer , lightly drizzle with olive or canola oil and sprinkle with salt
12. Roast under broiler 10-15 minutes until blackened spots appear on vegetables

title: cranberry sauce bundt cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large mixing bowl , cream together butter and sugar
3. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
4. Stir in extract
5. Combine flour , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
6. Add to the creamed mixture alternately with the sour cream , beating well after each addition
7. Spoon one-third of the batter into a greased and floured 10-inch bundt pan
8. In a small bowl , pour out whole berry cranberry sauce and stir ingredients together as in the can they are separated
9. Top the cake mixture with one-third of the cranberry sauce
10. Repeat layers two times
11. Sprinkle top with finely chopped pecans
12. Bake at 350 degrees for 65-70 minutes or until toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
13. Cool for 10 minutes before removing cake from pan onto a wire rack
14. Cool completely then place on cake plate
15. Combine icing ingredients until smooth
16. Drizzle icing over cake
17. Let set before serving

title: white chocolate cranberry cookies
steps:
1. 1
2. Preheat oven to 375
3. Line cookie sheets with parchment paper
4. 2
5. In a large bowl , cream together the butter , brown sugar , and white sugar until smooth
6. Beat in the egg and vanilla
7. Combine the flour and baking soda
8. Stir into the sugar mixture
9. Mix in the white chocolate chips and cranberries
10. Drop by heaping spoonfuls onto prepared cookie sheets
11. 3
12. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes in the preheated oven
13. For best results , take them out while they are still soft , being careful not to overcook
14. Allow cookies to cool for 1 minute on the cookie sheets before transferring to wire racks to cool completely

title: apricot crisp
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Slice apricots in half and discard stone
3. Cover bottom of a shallow , buttered oven proof dish with two layers of apricots
4. Place flour , walnuts , sugar , butter , cloves , cardamom , and ground cinnamon into a food processor and blend until it is like breadcrumbs
5. Spread mixture on top of apricots
6. Bake in preheated 375f oven for approximately 50 minutes or until lightly browned on top
7. Serve with custard or cream

title: ham taquitos
steps:
1. Heat oil in a medium sized sauce pan
2. Place tortillas in a zip lock bag and microwave for 30 seconds or until tortillas are soft and flexible
3. Take 2 slices of ham and place them on one tortilla
4. Roll tightly
5. Hold in place with toothpicks if desired
6. Place rolled taquitos in hot oil and fry until slightly browned and crispy
7. Drain on plate lined with paper towels
8. Place on serving plate and top with shredded lettuce , cheese , salsa and sour cream

title: frozen blender mojito
steps:
1. Place enough sugar on a small plate to reach depth of 1 / 4 inch
2. Run lime wedge around the rim of 4 martinin glasses to moisten
3. Dip rims into sugar on plate
4. Blend rum or vodka and 1 / 3 cup sugar in blender until sugar dissolves
5. Add ice , blend until smooth , adding up to 1 cup more ice , if desired
6. Add 12 mint leaves and blend until green flecks appear
7. Pour into prepared glasses
8. Garnish with mint sprigs
9. Sit back and enjoy

title: catalan aubergines eggplants
steps:
1. Prepare the eggplants / aubergines by peeling them and cutting into cubes
2. Heat the oil in a frying pan add the cubes and saut for a few minutes
3. Add the chopped onion , crushed garlic and paprika to the eggplant / aubergine in the frying pan and fry over a low heat for a further 5 mins
4. Add the chopped tomatoes
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Cover the frying pan and cook for a further 15 minutes
7. Place in a serving dish and garnish with a chopped fresh parsley

title: orange chili chicken with black beans
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Arrange chicken in a 13" x 9" baking dish
3. Sprinkle with the chopped onion , red pepper and garlic
4. In a small bowl , combine the orange juice , chili sauce , beans , rum , cumin , pepper , salt , and cilantro
5. Mix well
6. Pour evenly over chicken mixture
7. Cover and bake at 350 for 30 minutes
8. Uncover and bake for an additional 30-35 minutes or until chicken is done

title: boeuf a la hatienne  haitian beef with tomatoes   peppers
steps:
1. Place the beef , water to cover , and salt in a large pot
2. Bring to a boil , lower heat , and simmer uncovered , until beef is tender and water is completely evaporated , 45 minutes to an hour
3. While the beef is simmering , heat the oil over medium flame in a skillet
4. Add onion , peppers , garlic and chile pepper and saut till onions and peppers are wilted
5. Add tomatoes , vinegar , salt & pepper
6. Reduce heat to low and simmer until almost all liquid is evaporated , about 20-25 minutes
7. Add the beef to the peppers and onions and simmer another 20-30 minutes
8. Add a little water if necessary
9. Adjust seasonings and serve with rice , & fried green plantains

title: roasted eggplant and tomato salad
steps:
1. Arrange rack at center position and preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Oil a large , heavy baking sheet generously with olive oil
3. Cut each eggplant into 1-inch cubes and place them on baking sheet
4. Drizzle with 1 / 2 cup olive oil , then toss to coat all the eggplant well
5. Spread diced eggplant in a single layer in pan and season with 1 teaspoon salt
6. Roast , stirring every 5 minutes , until golden and tender , about 15 minutes
7. Watch carefully so that eggplant does not overcook
8. Remove and cool 10 minutes
9. Transfer to large non-reactive mixing bowl and add tomatoes , onion and garlic
10. Whisk lemon juice with cumin , paprika and cayenne pepper in a small bowl
11. Pour mixture over eggplant and tomatoes , and toss very gently , taking care to keep eggplant intact
12. Add parsley to bowl with eggplant
13. Mix gently
14. Taste and season with more salt , and a squeeze or two more of lemon juice if desired
15. Spoon salad into a serving bowl or onto a platter
16. Makes 4 to 6 servings

title: italian macaroni and cheese with tomato parmesan topping
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Butter a 13 x 9-inch baking dish
3. Cook the pasta in a large pot of boiling water until just tender
4. Drain and place in a large bowl , toss with 2 tablespoons butter
5. Set aside
6. Sprinkle 1 / 4 cup breadcrumbs into the bottom of the dish
7. Tilt the dish to coat the sides evenly
8. Layer 1 / 3 of the cooked macaroni , then 1 / 3 of the white cheddar , then 1 / 3 of the mozza cheese , then 1 / 3 of the parmesan cheese , then remaining 1 / 4 cup breadcrumbs
9. Repeat the layer twice ending with breadcrumbs
10. In a bowl whisk the eggs with half and half cream , salt and black pepper
11. Pour evenly over the layered mixture in the baking dish
12. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes minutes or until golden brown and set
13. Remove from oven then layer the tomato slices on top , then sprinkle with about 1 / 4 cup parmesan cheese on top of the tomatoes
14. Return to oven for another 20-25 minutes

title: skillet mini meatloaves
steps:
1. Crumble meat into a large bowl
2. Peel and finely chop the onion and add it to the bowl
3. Add the egg , beat it slightly
4. Add the bread crumbs , milk and parmesan cheese
5. Mix all together with your hands
6. Tear the parsley into smaller pieces with your fingers , then add them and the remaining ingredients , except for tomato sauce , and mix again with your hands
7. Heat a 12 inch nonstick skillet that has a lid over medium high heat
8. Meanwhile , form the meat mixture into 6 patties no more than 1 inch thick
9. Place in the hot skillet and cook until the meat is browned and cooked through , 4-6 minutes on each side
10. Pour the tomato sauce evenly over the patties and cover the skillet , reducing heat to medium low
11. Continue to cook for 1 minute to heat the tomato sauce through
12. Remove from the heat and serve

title: quick rise whole wheat bread
steps:
1. Add ingredients in the order listed to bread mixing bowl
2. Using a dough hook , mix well and add more flour if needed so that the dough cleans the sides of the bowl (dough should be slightly tacky
3. Knead for 10 minutes
4. Shape into 2 to 3 loaves depending on the size of your pans
5. Add dough to sprayed pans
6. Cover with tented plastic or cloth and let rise for about 1 hour
7. Preheat oven to 400 for the last half hour of rising
8. It is ready to go in the oven when the dough is doubled in bulk
9. Turn oven down to 350 and bake for 25 to 30 minutes
10. Take out of pans and let cool on wire rack
11. Brush tops with melted butter to keep crusts soft
12. Additional ingredients may be added:
13. Eggs:
14. Decrease water by 1 / 4 cup and add two beaten eggs
15. Eggs add flavor , liquid , color , structure , nutrients and tenderness to breads
16. Cracked wheat:
17. Add 1 / 2 cup uncooked cracked wheat for each 4 cups of flour
18. If using uncooked cracked wheat the bread will be somewhat crunchy
19. Cooking the cracked wheat first will add a variety of texture without the crunch feel
20. Many people like to put oatlems or other cooked cereals into their bread
21. As a guidelin , use 1 / 2 cup or less per 4 cups of flour
22. Potatoes:
23. They add a sweet , rich flavor to breads
24. Add 1 / 2 cup to 4 cups flour and reduce water by 1 / 4 cup

title: rainbow trout  tilapia  baked
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray 13x9 inch pan with cooking spray
3. Sprinkle with parsley , lemon juice and salt
4. Heat oil in small skillet
5. Fry onion and garlic till limp
6. Place tomatoes in pan and top with fish
7. Pour onion and garlic mixture over fish , sprinkle the wine evenly on top
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 30-40 minutes

title: thai ginger chicken
steps:
1. Place the cilantro , jalapeos , ginger , and 1 tablespoon of the oil in a food processor and pulse until combined
2. Heat the remaining oil in a large saucepan over medium heat
3. Add the onion and eggplant and cook until softened , about 5 minutes
4. Add the coconut milk , soy sauce , and 1 / 2 teaspoon of the salt
5. Bring to a simmer
6. Add the reserved cilantro mixture , the remaining salt , and the chicken
7. Simmer gently until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce thickens slightly , about 7 minutes
8. Serve over the rice

title: cranberry apple stuffing
steps:
1. Saute the carrots , onion , and celery in butter or margarine until tender but not brown
2. Add the poultry seasoning , salt , and cinnamon and stir
3. Add sauted mixture to the bread cubes along with the cranberries and apples
4. Pour in enough broth to moisten bread
5. Stir mixture with spoon or clean hands
6. Use to stuff turkey or chicken
7. Bake the rest of stuffing in a lightly greased casserole dish for 30 to 40 minutes at 350 degrees
8. If you use a thermometer to measure temperature of stuffing , bake to 150 degrees in center of casserole

title: ice queen
steps:
1. Shake alcohol with ice
2. Pour into chilled cocktail glass
3. Splash of ginger ale
4. Drop in cherry

title: moroccan couscous  or rice
steps:
1. Vegetable mixture:
2. In stirfry pan , heat oil , add onion , garlic , and ginger
3. Saute 1-2 minutes
4. Add vegetable broth , squash , carrots , pepper , coriander and chili pepper
5. Cover and bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat , simmer 5-7 minutes or until vegetables are tender crisp
7. Add zucchini and undrained chick peas
8. Cook until zucchini is tender crisp , about 2-3 minutes
9. Stir in tomato and parsley
10. Couscous:
11. In separate bowl pour 1 cup boiling water over couscous
12. Cover and let stand 5 minutes
13. Fluff with a fork
14. If you are having rice , cook according to directions
15. Put some couscous in your bowl and than put the vegetable mixture on top
16. The vegetables are very soupy / watery but the broth is soaked up by the couscous / rice

title: flax muffins
steps:
1. Mix it all together until thoroughly blended
2. Spread evenly
3. Nuke for 50 seconds

title: ricotta omelet with swiss chard
steps:
1. Crack the eggs into a small mixing bowl
2. Add the milk or water , salt , and pepper
3. Briskly stir with a fork until well beaten
4. Set aside
5. In an 8-inch nonstick skillet , melt 2 tablespoons of the butter over medium-high heat
6. Add 4 or 5 of the swiss chard leaves and saut until just wilted
7. Remove from the pan and set aside
8. Melt the remaining butter in the skillet , then slowly pour in the egg mixture , tilting the pan to spread it evenly
9. Let the eggs firm up a little , allowing some of the remaining liquid to flow to the sides of the pan
10. Continue to cook for about another minute , but while the center is still a bit runny , spoon in the ricotta
11. Tilt the pan to one side and , using a spatula , fold about 1 / 3 of the omelet over the ricotta filling
12. Shake the pan gently to slide the omelet to the edge
13. Holding the pan near the serving plate ,
14. Serve with the swiss chard

title: tofu  fish  or not fish
steps:
1. Cut the tofu into cm thick slices
2. Wrap the slices in thick paper towels and pat to remove excess moisture
3. Beat the egg replacer and soy sauce together in a small bowl
4. Combine the wheat germ / flax meal , polenta , nori , paprika , and herbs on a plate
5. Heat the oil in a large frypan
6. Dip each slice of tofu into the egg replacer mixture , then coat both sides in the polenta mixture
7. Fry the slices until golden brown on both sides
8. Place on absorbent paper
9. Sprinkle with extra lemon pepper and serve with tartare sauce

title: mrs  cubbison s bread stuffing
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large pot
2. Add celery , onion , and mushrooms
3. Simmer about 5 minutes to slightly soften vegetables
4. Toss in dressing mix to spread butter evenly
5. Stir in liquid and toss
6. Place in a greased casserold dish , cover , and bake at 350 degrees for about 45 minutes
7. Uncover the last 15 minutes for a crisper top

title: pennsylvania dutch soft sugar cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Line cookie sheets with baking parchment paper for best results , but you can grease or use non-stick spray if necessar-- i use the non-stick spray all the time
3. Sift together flour , baking soda , baking powder and salt
4. Set aside
5. Cream together sugar and butter
6. Add eggs one at a time and beat
7. Then add the vanilla and beat
8. Stir the flour mixture , alternating with the buttermilk , into the sugar mixture , stirring until smooth
9. Drop by tablespoons or a small scoop onto the prepared cookie sheet
10. Sprinkle the tops of the cookies with additional granulated sugar and bake for 7-10 minutes , until just firm
11. Wait just a minute and then remove from the cookie sheets and cool on a rack
12. Asa substitute for the buttermilk , add 1 tablespoon vinegar or lemon juice to a measuring cup and add milk to make 1 cup
13. Let stand for 10 minutes before using

title: sloppy bows
steps:
1. Brown beef and onions in hot skillet
2. Drain grease
3. Cook noodles in boiling water for 10 minutes
4. Drain and set aside
5. Combine soup , water , chili powder , brown sugar , dry mustard , and vinegar
6. Stir into cooked meat
7. Add drained noodles to meat mixture , stirring gently to avoid tearing noodles
8. Spoon beef-noodle mixture into a 9 x 13" baking pan
9. Sprinkle cheese over top
10. Bake , uncovered , at 300 for about 30 minutes

title: baked seitan log
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. In a large bowl , combine all dry ingredients well
3. In a smaller bowl , combine all liquid ingredients well
4. Add the liquids to the dry mix and combine well , then knead for a few minutes
5. If there's dry ingredients floating around , add extra cold water 1t , at a time until it's like a moist sponge
6. Roll in a piece of foil making a log shape , twisting the ends
7. Bake for 90 minutes , flipping half way through
8. Let cool before using as desired

title: veggie patties
steps:
1. Mix the seasonings with the chick pea flour
2. Slowly mix in the water , working well to remove all lumps
3. Stir in the vegetables
4. It is best to let the batter sit for 1 hour or more , although they can be cooked at once
5. Heat a tablespoon of oil in a heavy skillet over medium heat , and spoon in the batter to form patties
6. Fry until browned on each side , about 5 minutes per side
7. Do two or three at a time
8. Add 1 tbsp more oil for the second batch
9. These are nice served with tamarind sauce or even a steak sauce like h
10. P

title: pina colada cake
steps:
1. For cake , preheat oven to 350 f
2. Mix all ingredients well
3. Pour batter equally into 3 greased and floured round cake pans
4. Bake for 25 minutes
5. Cool and frost
6. For frosting: mix dry pudding mix and pineapple , then add cool whip
7. Frost cooled cake , and sprinkle with coconut and refrigerate until serving
8. Warning , since the frosting has cool whip in it , exposure to heat will make it runny

title: sicilian pasta skillet
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat olive oil over medium-high heat
2. Brown chicken
3. Add peppers and onions and saute until tender
4. Stir in chicken broth and tomatoes , bring to a boil
5. Add pasta and reduce heat to medium low , cover and cook 10 minutes or until pasta is tender
6. Stirring occasionally , serve

title: chicken parmesan  oamc
steps:
1. Combine first four ingredients in a shallow bowl
2. Dip each chicken breast in beaten egg , then roll in bread crumb mixture to evenly coat
3. Place chicken on a greased cookie sheet or jellyroll pan
4. Bake in preheated 375' f
5. Oven for 10 minute turn chicken over
6. Bake 10-12 minute or until chicken is thoroughly cooked
7. Freeze in 1 gallon bag with separate bags of sauce and shredded cheese
8. To serve: thaw overnight in the refrigerator
9. Reheat chicken in 375' f oven until heated through and crust is crispy
10. Spoon tomato sauce over chicken & sprinkle cheese over top
11. Bake an additional 3 minutes or until cheese is melted

title: easy mashed potatoes
steps:
1. 1)
2. Put potatoes into a saucepan
3. Add 1 / 2 teaspoon salt
4. Add water until potatoes are covered
5. Bring to boil , reduce heat and simmer , covered , 15-20 minutes , or until done - a fork can easily be poked through them
6. 2)
7. Warm cream and melt butter , together , either in microwave or in a pan on the gas
8. Drain water from potatoes
9. Put hot potatoes into a bowl
10. Add cream and melted butter
11. Use potato masher to mash potatoes until well mashed
12. Use a strong spoon to beat further , adding milk to achieve the consistency you desire
13. Add salt and pepper to taste

title: cranberry walnut crescent rolls
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Unroll dough
3. Separate into 12 triangles
4. Sprinkle with sugar , craisins and walnuts
5. Press craisins and walnuts lightly into dough
6. Roll up loosely towards pointed end
7. Place rolls point-side down , onto ungreased cookie sheet
8. Curve into crescent shape
9. Bake at 375 for 11-13 minutes or until golden brown
10. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and serve warm

title: swiss honey cake  lebkuchen
steps:
1. Blend honey with the coffee , cream , kirsch , sugar and spices
2. Sift the flour with the baking powder and soda
3. Add it to the first mixture
4. Beat until smooth
5. The dough should be sticky
6. Put into a well-buttered 15x10 baking pan , spreading evenly to the corners
7. It should be about 1 / 4 to 1 / 2 inch thick
8. Bake at 350 for 30-40 minutes
9. Cut into bars

title: roasted red pepper   green onion dip
steps:
1. Mix mayo , sour cream , cheese and salad dressing until well blended
2. Add peppers and 2 t of the onions , mix well and cover
3. Refrigerate several hours or until chilled
4. Sprinkle with remaining 1 t onions
5. Serve with chips and assorted cut-up fresh vegetables

title: acadia s crock pot chicken cacciatore
steps:
1. In 3-quart crock-pot add in this order: chicken , tomatoes , olive oil , onion , carrot , bell pepper , black pepper , salt , italian spices , basil , parsley and sugar
2. Place lid on , cook on low for 6-8 hours

title: stuffed chicken rolls
steps:
1. Flatten chicken to 1 / 8 inch thickness
2. Place ham and cheese on each breast
3. Roll up and tuck in ends
4. Secure with a toothpick
5. Combine the flour , parmesan cheese , sage , paprika and pepper
6. Coat chicken on all sides
7. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour
8. In a large skillet , brown chicken in oil over medium-high heat
9. Transfer to a 5 quart slow cooker
10. Combine soup and broth
11. Pour over chicken
12. Cover and cook on low for 4-5 hours
13. Remove toothpicks

title: red pepper  asparagus    shrimp penne pasta
steps:
1. Thaw shrimp and set aside
2. Pour all 3 sauce jars into a large pot and stir together well
3. Heat sauce covered over medium heat stirring frequently until heated thoroughly
4. Reduce heat to low and add shrimp
5. Stir frequently while covered on low
6. Chop both peppers into small bites
7. Place into a well greased skillet and and sprinkle garlic powder over the pieces
8. Cook over medium-high heat until tender and slightly blackened
9. Cut asparagus spears into 3 equal parts and steam them until tender
10. Do not overcook the asparagus
11. It should be slightly tender , but in no way mushy
12. Cook pasta according to their directions on the label and drain well
13. Add pasta , asparagus , and peppers to the sauce and shrimp mix
14. Stir well and continue to heat on low for five more minutes
15. Serve with garlic bread and a salad and enjoy !

title: english fish mornay
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a large pan , fry the onions until tender
2. Add the flour and cook for a full minute , add the milk and milk
3. Reduce the heat and whisk
4. Add the mustard and mix through
5. Add the fish and simmer for 5 minutes stirring carefully
6. Add the cream and pour into a well buttered pie plate or shallow ceramic baking dish
7. Top with the potato topping very carefully in small spoonfuls
8. Top with the cheese and breadcrumbs and bake for 40 minutes at 180oc
9. Serve with bread and butter and steamed seasonal veggies
10. To make topping:
11. Mash the potatoes in a large bowl with the milk and butter
12. I like to use my hand beater to get it really smooth

title: magic strawberry ice cream
steps:
1. Chill mixing bowl and beater / whisk in freezer
2. Process strawberries in food processor until smooth , about 30 seconds
3. Microwave sweetened condensed milk , white chocolate chips , and vodka in large bowl until chocolate melts , about 1 minute , whisking halfway through cooking
4. Whisk in strawberry puree , vanilla , and salt
5. Using stand mixer fitted with whisk , whip cream on medium low speed until foamy , about 1 minute
6. Increase speed to high and whip until soft peaks form , 1 to 3 minutes
7. Whisk one-third of whipped cream intro strawberry mixture , then gently fold in remaining whipped cream , 1 scoop at a time , until combined
8. Freeze in airtight container until firm , 6 hours or up to 2 weeks

title: chicken bean burritos  crock pot
steps:
1. Place chicken and beans in crock pot
2. Pour salsa over chicken and beans
3. Cover and cook on low-heat for 5 to 6 hours or on high for 2 to 3 hours
4. Transfer chicken to cutting board
5. Using two forks , shred the chicken
6. Use a potato masher to mash beans in crock pot
7. Return chicken to cooker , stir in cheese to combine
8. Divide chicken among tortillas , top with lettuce , tomato , sour cream , etc

title: prize winning almond bundt cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease and flour a bundt pan
3. Beat sugar , egg , almond extract , milk and softened butter together
4. Gradually add flour , baking powder and cinnamon
5. In bottom of greased bundt pan , sprinkle almonds and raw sugar to make a nice crunchy topping
6. Pour cake batter over almonds / sugar
7. Bake for 50 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean from center of cake
8. Cool for 15-20 minutes , then remove from pan
9. Cool on wire rack
10. Serve warm or cooled - your preference

title: gooey rice krispy treats
steps:
1. Grease a 13x9 pan and set aside
2. Melt butter in large pot over medium heat
3. Add mini marshmallows and marshmallow creme and melt , careful to stir often to avoid burning
4. Take off the heat and add the cereal and stir to coat
5. Press into your prepared pan
6. You can use waxed paper to push down
7. Cool for 30 minutes or so until cutting

title: chesapeake clam chowder
steps:
1. Boil water and add potatoes and onion
2. Cook until tender
3. Add bacon drippings , salt and sugar and pepper
4. Cut up clams and add
5. Cook 10 minutes
6. Slowly pour in milk and stir until soup begins to thicken

title: blt cheeseburgers are smokin
steps:
1. Mix all the burger ingredients together and form 4 patties
2. Oil the grate on your grill
3. Preheat grill to a high temperature
4. Quickly place all the patties on the hot grill and close the lid
5. Wait about 2 to 3 minutes
6. With a metal spatula test to see if the burger easily lifts from the grate
7. If not continue grilling , until it does
8. Flip all the patties provided they lift easily
9. If you enjoy the heat lightly spread some adobo sauce on the cooked side
10. Close lid and continue grilling for another 2 to 3 minutes
11. Check the patties to make sure they have released from the grate and flip one more time
12. Spread some adobo sauce if wanted and top with cheese
13. Continue grilling until juices from the burgers run clear and the patties have a solid feel
14. Or if you trust your meat source make it rare as you like
15. Spread rolls with mayonnaise
16. Place burgers on roll topping with the remaining ingredients

title: pork chops diane
steps:
1. Heat butter in skillet
2. Cook tenderloins 3-4 minutes on each side
3. Remove to a serving platter and keep warm
4. Add lemon juice , salt , pepper , garlic , worcestershire sauce and mustard to the pan juices
5. Cook until heated through
6. Pour sauce over pork and sprinkle with parsley
7. Serve immediately

title: sweet and juicy baked ham
steps:
1. If possible , have your butcher remove the shank from your ham and package the shank meat separately
2. Most will do this at no extra charge
3. You can use the shank meat as a base for other recipes
4. If you can find the brown sugar flavor of karo corn syrup , use it rather than regular corn syrup
5. Grocers sometimes only carry this flavor during the holiday season
6. Make sure your ham is completely thawed before cooking
7. Remove the wrapper from your ham , and rinse your ham under cold water
8. To make your glaze pour your can of fruit cocktail into your blender
9. Puree it into liquid , then pour it into a large bowl
10. Add your brown sugar and coca cola
11. Hand stir gently for a few minutes until the glaze is consistent
12. Protect your baking pan by spraying it with cooking spray then covering the bottom with heavy duty tinfoil
13. Place your rack in the pan , then place your ham on the rack
14. If you have a food injector , load your syringe about 5 times and inject your glaze into the fatty pockets of your ham
15. This will ensure the inside of your ham is as tasty as the outside
16. Drizzle about half your glaze over your ham , then cover the ham loosely with a tent of aluminum foil
17. Bake your ham for 18 min per pound at 350 degrees
18. One hour before cooking is done , pour the remainder of your basting mix over your ham , re-cover it with the tent and allow it to finish cooking
19. When your ham is done , remove from the oven , wrap tight in your tinfoil , and let it stand for 20 to 30 minutes
20. Your guests will be amazed at the flavor
21. Try to be modest when you are complimented about your culinary excellence

title: evelyn s sweet and sour meatballs
steps:
1. Sauce:
2. Mix all ingredients
3. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer while preparing meat
4. Drop in meat and simmer at least 30 minutes more
5. If i'm not in a hurry , this sits and cooks on all day on the stove top
6. Meatballs:
7. Combine all ingredients and blend thoroughly - hands work best !
8. Roll into small balls and drop into sauce , or cook first then add to sauce
9. Serve over rice

title: yummy beef vegetable stew
steps:
1. Brown ground beef with worcestershire sauce in soup pan
2. Drain well , and wipe out the pan to remove extra grease
3. Return ground beef and add remaining ingredients , except water
4. Cook , stirring occasionally , until vegetables are done
5. Skim any fatty spots in the soup
6. Add water to make the soup as soup-y as you like

title: creamy poblano chicken with cornbread waffles
steps:
1. In dutch oven , melf butter over medium heat
2. Add onions , poblanos , & garlic
3. Saute for 5 minutes , or until soft
4. Add chicken , salt , and pepper
5. Cook , stirring often , 8-10 minutes , or until chicken is cooked through
6. Stir in soup and sour cream until smooth
7. Stir in cheese , cook & stir until melted and smooth
8. Serve over cornbread waffles
9. To prepare waffles , combine cornmeal , flour , baking powder , salt , and sugar in a large mixing bowl
10. Stir in egg , milk , and melted butter , stirring just until just moistened
11. Batter will be somewhat lumpy
12. Bake batter in a lightly buttered , preheated waffle iron until golden brown & crispy

title: broccoli with bacon and pine nuts
steps:
1. Place broccoli in a steamer basket over boiling water
2. Cover pan and steam 5 minutes
3. Heat a heavy nonstick skillet or wok over medium high heat
4. Add bacon and cook 2 minutes
5. Add broccoli and pine nuts and stir-fry 3-4 minutes , or until broccoli is just tender
6. Stir in chives

title: old fashion chocolate pie
steps:
1. Bake your pie crust and set aside to cool
2. Filling:
3. In a medium saucepan over medium high heat , mix sugar , cornstarch , and cocoa together with a whisk
4. Add evaporated milk whisking well
5. Stir constantly
6. When heated through , add the 3 egg yolks after tempering them with some of the warm milk mixture
7. Whisk to incorpoate the yolks then stir constantly until thickened and bubbly
8. Remove from heat and set aside to cool
9. Meringue topping:
10. After filling has cooled , make the topping
11. In a clean cold bowl , add the egg whites , cream of tartar , and sugar
12. Whip on high until stiff and soft peaks form
13. Assembly:
14. Add cooled pudding to the baked pie shell
15. Spread the top with your merinque making sure the meringue touches the sides of the pie shell
16. Broil until the meringue is lightly golden brown

title: chunky slow cooker applesauce
steps:
1. Put all ingredients into slow cooker
2. Cover and cook on low for 4-8 hours , until soft and juicy

title: meatballs and gravy  spaghetti sauce
steps:
1. Place ground beef , pork , bread crumbs , romano cheese , eggs , milk , seasoned salt and basil into a large bowl
2. Mix well with hands
3. Shape into 24 balls
4. Brown meatballs in pan , making sure to keep a thin layer of water on the bottom of the pan at all times to prevent burning
5. While meatballs are cooking , start the gravy
6. Brown onion lightly in olive oil in a large pot
7. Add garlic and cook 1 or 2 minutes
8. Add tomato paste and water
9. Stir until tomato paste is thinned
10. Add remaining ingredients and mix well
11. Bring to a slow boil and reduce heat
12. When meatballs are done , add to sauce
13. Simmer , covered loosely , over low heat about 2 hours , stirring frequently to prevent burning
14. If sauce is too thick water may be added

title: hamburger hash brown casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. In a frying pan , cook onion in olive oil over medium high heat until translucent
3. Add in ground beef and cook until browned
4. Drain fat from ground beef
5. Return the mixture to medium heat
6. Sprinkle flour over the ground beef and mix inches cook for one minute , stirring constantly
7. Add in ketchup , broth , worcestershire , salt and pepper and veggies
8. Cook for 5 minutes
9. Stir occasionally
10. Spread mixture in bottom of greased 9"13" baking pan
11. In a medium bowl , mix together the potatoes , cheese and butter
12. Spread potato mixture over mixture in the pan
13. Bake until hash browns are golden brown
14. Serve hot
15. To reheat , microwave until hot then transfer to broiler to recrisp hash browns

title: triple vanilla bean cookies
steps:
1. Cookies:
2. Mix the first 4 ingredients together
3. Blend in morsels
4. Chill for 1 hour
5. Shape in 1" balls
6. Place on parchment lined baking sheet
7. Bake 10-12 minutes at 375f
8. Cool on a wire rack
9. Icing:
10. Mix sugar and vanilla extract , slowly adding water to make a smooth creamy consistency
11. Drizzle over cooled cookies and let harden
12. Enjoy !

title: oven fried cheesy italian chicken
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425
2. Heat margarine in 9 x 13 pan in oven until melted
3. Mix remaining ingredients except chicken
4. Coat chicken
5. Place skin side down in pan
6. Bake 35 minutes
7. Turn
8. Bake until done
9. About 15 minutes

title: stouffer s macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Whisk flour into skim milk is a small saucepan
2. Place it over medium low heat
3. Added shredded cheddar cheese , margarine and salt
4. Stir often with a spoon until the cheese begins to melt
5. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes
6. Stir the sauce with a whisk every couple of minutes so it becomes smooth and thick
7. While sauce thickens , boil macaroni according to directions and strain
8. Once cheese sauce has simmered for 30 minutes , pour pasta into a medium bowl
9. Gently stir in cheese sauce
10. Pour mixture into a loaf pan or casserole dish
11. Cover and freeze
12. When ready to eat , preheat oven to 350 f and bake macaroni for 50 minutes or until cheese begins to brown slightly

title: my favorite goulash
steps:
1. In a large skillet combine hamburger , onion , salt , pepper and chili powder
2. Brown it until pink is gone
3. While the meat is browning , cook the pasta according to package directions
4. When the hamburger is done , drain any fat
5. Drain the pasta when done
6. In a large pan , combine hamburger , pasta and all remaining ingredients
7. Heat
8. Serve with garlic bread !

title: hearts of romaine salad
steps:
1. In a small non-reactive bowl whisk together the vinaigrette ingredients except for the oil
2. Slowly pour in the olive oil while whisking
3. Set dressing aside
4. Remove the root ends from each head of lettuce and cut the heads in half crosswise
5. Then cut the heads in three parts lengthwise
6. Arrange the slices neatly on a serving platter
7. Garnish with the kalamata olives and spoon the vinaigrette over the salad
8. Sprinkle the myzithra cheese on top and serve
9. Add a sprinkle of cracked black pepper
10. Or cover and chill until ready to serve

title: my very favorite apple crumb pie
steps:
1. Arrange a rack in the lowest slot of your oven
2. Heat oven to 375 degrees f
3. Prepare pie crust and fit into a 9-inch deep dish pie plate
4. Refrigerate until you are ready to add filling
5. For crumb topping , combine flour , brown sugar , cinnamon , salt and cloves in bowl
6. With pastry blender or your finger
7. For filling , in a large bowl , toss together apples , brown sugar , flour , cinnamon and cloves
8. Spoon filling into pie shell , mounding slightly in the center
9. Top filling with crumb topping
10. Place on foil-lined baking sheet
11. Bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes
12. Reduce temperature to 350 degrees f
13. Bake 30 minutes more , or until fruit is tender
14. Loosely tent pie with aluminum foil during last 20 minutes of baking
15. Let the pie cool for at least 1 1 / 2 hours
16. This pie can be made a day ahead
17. Cover pie and store at room temperature
18. To serve , dust with confectioners' sugar , if desired

title: green rice chile bake
steps:
1. Cut jack cheese into 1 / 2-inch squares
2. Combine with sour cream , chiles , cooked rice , and black pepper
3. Top with cheddar cheese
4. Place in baking dish and bake at 375 f
5. For about 25 minutes , or until bubbly hot
6. May be frozen

title: baked whiting with bok choy and vermouth
steps:
1. Oil the baking pan with the canola or sesame oil and wipe off any excess
2. Lay lay down individual leaves from the bok choy
3. Place the whiting in the pan on top of the bok choy
4. Presentation need not be formal
5. Splash with the vermouth , and then the teriyaki sauce
6. Squeeze the lemon over the fish
7. Add ground pepper to taste
8. Bake in pre-heated 350 degree f oven for 10-12 minutes
9. Sprinkle with scallion and serve

title: mango dipping sauce guilt free
steps:
1. Puree mangoes , honey , vinegar , lime juice , pineapple juice and salt in a food processor or blender until smooth
2. Add any or all of your choice of additional yummy delights
3. And blend till smooth and incorporated
4. Sauce can be refrigerated in an airtight glass container up to 1 day
5. Serve at room temperature with your choice of dippers

title: easy guinness stew
steps:
1. In large bowl , add 1 tablespoon of oil to beef
2. Pour in flour , salt , black pepper , cayenne pepper
3. Mix well throught beef
4. Heat rest of oil in pan and brown beef
5. Drain
6. Add sliced onions into oil beef was browned in and garlic
7. Cover and cook for 5 minutes on medium heat
8. Pour 1 / 2 cup guinness into pan til boiling and scrape bits of food with a wooden spoon
9. Pour in rest of stout
10. In a pan big enough , place beef , stout mixture , carrots and thyme
11. Can be simmered on the stove for 2 hours or in an oven at 150 degrees c / 300 f for 2 hours
12. Stir approximately every half hour until meat almost melts in your mouth
13. Enjoy !
14. Garnish with parsley

title: new york strip steak lavished with tomatoes and olives
steps:
1. Heat your grill --
2. Combine tomatoes and olives in a small bowl and season with salt and pepper
3. Add the vinegar , olive oil and 1 / 4 cup of the parsley
4. Toss to mix
5. Set the mixture aside
6. Arrange the steaks on the hot grill
7. Cook for about 3-4 minutes per side , for med-rare
8. Let the meat rest for 5 minutes before carving into 1 / 4 inch-thick slices
9. Arrange on a serving platter and spoon tomato and olive mixture over and beside the steak
10. Sprinkle remaining 1 / 4 cup of parsley and serve immediately

title: salmon burgers with tartar mayonnaise
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine mayonnaise , tomatoes , parsley , capers , lemon juice and tabasco
2. Set aside
3. Put salmon fillet , skin side down , on a cutting board
4. Beginning by the tight side , with a knife , do a light incision between the skin and the flesh , to be able to hold the skin
5. Holding the skin firmly and putting the knife down and inclined , pull on the skin from the exterior in a movement of backwards and forwards
6. Cut the salmons in pieces
7. In food processor , mix salmon , 1 / 4 cup of the reserved tartar mayonnaise , onion , breadcrumbs , salt and pepper until salmon is finely chopped
8. Shape the mixture in 4 burgers of 3 / 4 inch thickness
9. Set the barbecue to medium heat
10. Put the salmon burgers on an oiled grill and close the cover
11. Cook for about 10 minutes or until golden
12. Meanwhile , put the slices of bread on the grill of the barbecue and cook 3 minutes or until lightly crispy
13. Put 4 slices of bread on a work surface
14. Garnish each one with a lettuce leaf , then with the salmon burger and remaining of tartar mayonnaise
15. Cover with the other slices of bread

title: hearth bread
steps:
1. Mix warm water , sugar and yeast together to proof
2. Add salt and butter or oil
3. Add flour to make a good dough
4. Knead for 10 minutes
5. Put in oiled bowl and let rise till double
6. Make either 2 italian loaves , or pat out your 4 medium pizzas , or 8 6"x1 / 8" pitas
7. Italian bread--form and rise again till double
8. Slash and bake at 450 degrees for about 15 minutes
9. Pizza--bake at 450 degrees for about 15 minutes
10. Pitas--form into 8 6"x1 / 8" rounds
11. Rise for 15 minutes
12. Bake 500 degrees for l minute on the lowest rack of oven , and 3-7 minutes on a higher rack
13. Enjoy !

title: tater tot green bean casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Brown and drain ground beef and chopped onions
3. Return ground beef to pan
4. Mix in 1 can cream of mushroom soup , 1 can of french-style green beans , milk , salt , and pepper
5. In a small casserole dish , place mixture evenly spread on bottom of dish
6. Evenly spread cheese on top
7. Evenly spread tater tots on top of cheese
8. Bake in preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes , until tater tots are browned well

title: broccoli with herbed bread crumbs
steps:
1. Cook broccoli until tender-crisp and drain
2. Combine remaining ingredients and spoon over the broccoli
3. Serve

title: savory microwave rice
steps:
1. In a 3 quart casserole combine all ingredients
2. 4 tablespoons salsa can be added for spanish rice
3. Cover and cook on 100% power for 3 to 5 minutes
4. Let stand five minutes before serving
5. Stir to fluff

title: taftoon   persian wholemeal flat bread
steps:
1. Sift the flours into a large mixing bowl
2. Dissolve the yeast in 1 / 4 cup of the warm water
3. Add 1 1 / 2 cups of the remaining water and the salt
4. Pour the yeast mixture into the center of the flour and gradually work in
5. Beat with your hands for 20-30 minutes , or use the dough hook on an electric mixer and beat for 20 minutes , gradually adding in as much of the remaining 3 / 4 cup water as the dough will take
6. Preheat oven to high , and place a griddle on the center shelf to preheat for 10-15 minutes
7. When hot , lightly oil with a small cloth dipped in oil
8. Turn the dough out onto an oiled board
9. Oil your hands and divide the dough into 6 parts , rolling each piece into a ball
