10. Roll out each ball as thinly as possible with an oiled rolling pin and prick all over with a fork or pinwheel , in 3-4 vertical lines across the surface
11. Take the round of dough and stretch it a little across the backs of your hands , and place dough on the smooth side of a cushion or pad
12. Pull the rack out where the heated griddle is on , and turn the cushion over and press down onto it
13. Close the oven and cook 1 minute , then pat down dough to prevent bread from puffing up
14. Bake until surface is bubbly , then turn bread over and cook 2 minutes more
15. Remove bread from oven and wrap in a towel
16. Allow oven temperature to reheat before starting another
17. Do not allow rolled dough to rest before baking
18. Prepare just before putting in oven

title: cookies and cream parfaits
steps:
1. You'll need four 6-oz dessert glasses
2. Prepare pudding as package directs , using milk
3. After cooking , scrape into a medium bowl and press plastic wrap directly onto surface of pudding
4. Refrigerate pudding until cold , at least 1 hour
5. To make parfaits: put 1 / 4 cup pudding into each glass
6. Top each with 2 tablespoon nondairy whipped topping , then crumble 1 / 2 a cookie onto each
7. Top with 1 / 4 cup more pudding and 2 tablespoon topping
8. Garnish if desired

title: yam and chard curry
steps:
1. In dutch oven , saute onions , jalapeno , garlic and ginger in oil , until onions are transparent
2. Stir in curry powder and yams
3. Reduce heat and cover to allow yams to simmer until they are very soft , stirring often to avoid sticking
4. Stir in chard -- 2 cups at a time and cover again until just wilted
5. Season with salt and add lemon juice just before serving
6. Enjoy !

title: trout with fennel
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. In a skillet over medium heat cook bacon until crisp
3. Remove bacon from skillet , reserving drippings
4. Drain bacon on paper towels and crumble bacon
5. Add fennel and onion to pan
6. Sprinkle with salt and cook until browned
7. Transfer to bowl and season with pepper and stir in the cilantro
8. On a greased and foil-lined baking sheet , place two trout fillets , cover with the vegetable mixture and then cover with the remaining fillets
9. Roast for 15 minutes or until opaque
10. Serve with lemon wedges and crumbled bacon

title: crock pot cranberry pork roast
steps:
1. Place roast in slow cooker
2. In medium bowl mash cranberry sauce
3. Stir in sugar , juice , mustard and cloves
4. Pour over roast
5. Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours or until meat is tender
6. Remove roast and keep warm
7. Skim fat from juices
8. Measure 2 cups of the cooking liquid adding water if necessary
9. Pour in a saucepan
10. Bring to a boil and thicken with mixture of cornstarch and water
11. Season with salt and pepper
12. Serve with sliced pork

title: garlic lettuce salad
steps:
1. Make dressing and set aside
2. Put all salad ingredients in a bowl and pour dressing over
3. Serve and enjoy

title: chicken and lentil stew  south beach diet phase 2
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , heat oil over medium heat
2. Add onion , garlic , basil , oregano , pepper , and a pinch of salt
3. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook , stirrring occasionally , 4 minutes
4. Stir in tomato paste and cook 3 minutes longer
5. Stir in chicken breasts and cook for 1 minute
6. Add lentils , tomatoes , and their juices , and broth
7. Bring to a gentle simmer , reduce heat to low , cover and cook until chicken is cooked through , 7 to 10 minutes
8. Stir in spinach , cover , and cook 1 minute longer or until spinach wilts
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve warm

title: slow roasted herb and garlic lamb shanks
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 170c
2. Arrange rosemary across base of a large roasting pan and sprinkle with half the oregano , turn and sprinkle with remaining oregano
3. Arrange shanks in a single layer , in pan and add garlic and season with salt and pepper
4. Pour white wine and stock into pan and cover pan with foil and bake for 1 hour and then remove from oven and turn shanks and re-cover and bake for 1 hour 20 minutes or until tender
5. Remove shanks from pan and skim fat from pan juices and serve pan juices drizzled over the shanks

title: jamaican curry chicken
steps:
1. Cut chicken into 8 pieces , or more if you so desire , wash with vinegar and water in a pot or kitchen sink
2. Combine chicken with all ingredients and rub together until curry powder is wet and sticks to the chicken
3. Turn your heat on high , heat the cooking oil in a large iron skillet with 2 tablespoon of curry powder until the oil is hot and curry powder changes color
4. Add chicken to the hot oil , then turn down the heat to medium , add the water immediately
5. Add diced potato then cover the pot and simmer
6. Stir the ingredients in the pot then taste the gravy , after fifteen minutes
7. If you need to add anything more like salt to bring it to taste , now is the time
8. Add the 1 sprig of thyme and black pepper to the ingredients in the pot
9. Allow to simmer until chicken is moist and tender
10. Option 1: you can thicken the curry chicken gravy with bread crumbs or cornstarch
11. I prefer to thicken the gravy by using evaporation
12. Option 2: remove the chicken from the skillet and place in a bowl
13. Turn up the fire to high and allow gravy to boil
14. Using a spoon , stir the gravy slowly and pay close attention to the consistency of the stew , turn off the stove when it becomes thick enough
15. Then add curry chicken back to the stew
16. Your food is ready !

title: lemon stir fry sauce
steps:
1. Dissolve cornstarch and subsequently bouillon in water and blend with remaining ingredients
2. Add to your recipe instead of prepared stir-fry sauce
3. Cook , stirring until thick and clear

title: crispy cheesy tortilla chip pan fried chicken
steps:
1. Sauce -- make the avocado sauce ahead of time and set in the refrigerator to chill
2. I like to use my mini food processor for this , or a blender will work fine
3. Add the avocado , milk , lime juice , sour cream , jalapeno and cilantro
4. Blend until smooth
5. Check for seasoning salt and pepper and adjust as needed
6. Remove to a small bowl and cover and chill until ready to serve
7. This sauce is serve cold
8. Chicken -- remove to the counter , along with the salsa and eggs
9. You want them to be room temp or at least have the chill taken off them
10. Tortilla chips -- add the tortillas to the food processor and grind until fine chopped
11. The finer chopped the easier it is
12. A rough chop or hand chop will not work
13. Dredging stations -- 1: flour , salt and pepper
14. 2: eggs , lightly beaten mixed with salsa
15. 3: ground tortilla chips
16. Cheese -- cut a thin slice about 1 / 2 of the way through one side of the chicken breast as you will be stuffing it with the cheese
17. Make sure not to cut all the way through to the other side
18. But make a nice slice so you can stuff it with a fair amount of cheese
19. About 2 tablespoons per chicken breast
20. Stuff the chicken breast and secure with a single toothpick
21. Chicken -- dredge the chicken in the flour and make sure to shake off any extra
22. Next , dip in the egg and salsa mix and last into the tortilla chips
23. Saute -- in a large non stick pan and heat to medium high heat
24. Add enough oil to just lightly cover the bottom of the pan
25. Saute on each side until golden brown
26. I transfer the pan to the oven , if not , transfer to a pie plate and finish cooking in a 400 degree oven until the juices run clear
27. Approximately 10 minutes
28. It really depends on the thickness of your chicken
29. Serve -- garnish the chicken with the avocado sauce , some beans , rice , anything you want
30. The avocado sauce is really good with this
31. Even serve this over some crisp romaine , onion and black beans and use the avocado sauce as the dressing
32. You can really serve it lots of way
33. Enjoy !

title: banana and cream of wheat  muffins  low fat
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , mix first 4 ingredients together
2. In another mixing bowl mix the rest of the ingredients together
3. Combine both mixtures , until moistened and then pour into muffin tins
4. Bake at 400 for 20 minutes

title: low carb roman meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Mix up all ingredients except the hard-boiled eggs
3. Pat just under half of the meat mixture into a loaf pan
4. Lay the hardboiled eggs on top and form remainder of meat around them
5. Bake for 10 minutes at 450 , then reduce heat to 350 and bake another 1 hour and 15 minutes

title: key lime pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 250-degrees
2. Combine milk and egg yolks in a blender on low speed
3. Slowly add lime juice , mixing until blended
4. Pour into pie shell and bake 20 minutes
5. Let cool and refrigerate
6. Top with whipped cream& lime slices

title: apricot fizz
steps:
1. Chill the apricot nectar and the ginger ale
2. When ready to serve , combine the nectar and ginger ale
3. Dip rims of glasses into lemon juice , then into sugar
4. Pour in the apricot fizz and serve

title: im a poor student breakfast sandwich
steps:
1. Brown sausage over medium heat
2. Drain sausage and let cool
3. Meanwhile , make scrambled eggs to desired consistancy
4. Set aside and cool
5. Once sausage and eggs are cooled completely begin making breakfast sandwich
6. Cut apart english muffins , top with eggs and sausage
7. Then place one slice of cheese on top of mixture
8. Place other side of muffin on top
9. Place one sandwich in a plastic bag and store in fridge
10. Easy to reheat in microwave

title: energizing raw soup
steps:
1. Mash the avocado into the stock until it forms a thick and smooth consistency
2. Squeeze in the juice from the lemon and throw in the rest of the ingredients
3. This soup could be served hot or cold

title: cafe rio creamy tomatillo dressing
steps:
1. Mix buttermilk dressing as directed on package
2. Combine all other ingredients and mix in a blender until creamy and smooth
3. Seal in airtight container in refrigerator
4. Enjoy !

title: vegetarian vegan  lucky chili  crock pot yummy
steps:
1. Put all ingredients into the slow cooker , and cook on low for 8-12 hours
2. To serve , top with coriander , cheddar cheese , sour cream and salsa
3. The recipe could probably feed about 8-10 people
4. No fat , and very healthy

title: cronuts
steps:
1. In deep fryer or 2-quart heavy saucepan , heat oil over medium heat to 350f
2. Separate crescent dough into 4 rectangles
3. Firmly press perforations to seal
4. Stack 2 rectangles on top of one another
5. Fold in half widthwise to make tall stack
6. Repeat with remaining 2 rectangles
7. To make 2 doughnuts , use 3-inch biscuit cutter to cut 1 round from each stack
8. Use 1 / 2-inch biscuit cutter to cut small hole in center of each round
9. Reroll remaining dough to cut third doughnut
10. Fry doughnuts in hot oil 1 1 / 2 minutes on each side or until deep golden brown and cooked through
11. Drain on paper towels
12. Cool 5 minutes
13. Carefully split doughnuts in half
14. Place pudding in decorating bag fitted with
15. Top each with some of the caramel sauce
16. Sprinkle with salt
17. Cover each with top of doughnut
18. In small bowl , mix powdered sugar and enough milk for spreading consistency
19. Spread on tops of doughnuts
20. Drizzle with additional caramel sauce

title: chewy oatmeal peanut butter bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease 15 1 / 2" by 10 1 / 2" jelly-roll pan
3. In microwave-safe large bowl heat butter in microwave oven on high until butter melts , stirring once
4. Stir in oats , sugar , and corn syrup until well combined
5. With fingers , press oat mixture evenly into prepared pan
6. Bake 20 to 23 minutes or until edges are set and center is slightly jiggly
7. Cool completely on wire rack
8. In a 1-quart sauce pan , heat chocolate chips and peanut butter over low heat until chocolate is melts and mixture is smooth , stirring frequently
9. Spread chocolate mixture evenly over oat crust
10. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and refrigerate 1 hour or until chocolate is firm
11. Cut lengthwise into 4 strips , then cut each strip crosswise into 10 bars--40 bars
12. If bars are difficult to remove from pan
13. Place pan on a very hot damp towel for a few minutes to warm slightly
14. Store bars in covered container , with wax paper between layers , in refrigerator up to 1 month or in freezer up to 3 months

title: easy cheesy salsa chicken
steps:
1. Cut chicken breasts into 1-2 inch chunks or slices
2. Heat oil in a skillet and add chicken and onion
3. Saute over medium high heat until chicken is browned on one side and onion is fragrant but not burnt
4. Turn chicken pieces to brown on the other side for 1 minute
5. Add raw rice and stir to coat with pan juices
6. Immediately add chicken broth , salsa and tomato paste
7. Stir to combine
8. Bring mixture up to a boil , then reduce heat to low , cover and cook for 10 minutes
9. Stir mixture
10. If rice has absorbed all of the liquid , add up to 1 / 2 cup more broth and stir
11. Top with shredded cheese , cover and cook another 10 minutes
12. Turn off the heat and stir the cheese into the rice mixture
13. Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve

title: lemon curd and cream cheese muffins
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 170c / 325f and line a muffin pan with paper cases
2. Sift flour , baking powder and caster sugar together
3. Add lemon zest
4. Mix together the milk , egg , butter , lemon curd and vanilla essence
5. Mix together the cream cheese and icing sugar in a seperate bowl
6. Make a well in centre of the dry ingredients , quickly stir in the wet ingredients using no more than 12 strokes
7. Put 1 tablespoon of the muffin mix into the base of the muffin pans
8. Pop a fraction of the cream cheese mixture on top and then cover with the remaining muffin mixture
9. The tins should be almost full to the top
10. Bake in the centre of the preheated oven for 20 minutes
11. Prepare the glaze by mixing the icing sugar and lemon juice together
12. Remove the muffins from their tins , cool for five minutes and then drizzle with the glaze

title: peanut butter apple cake
steps:
1. Oven@ 350
2. Beat egg until fluffy
3. Beat in brown sugar
4. Add peanut butter , milk , and vanilla
5. Mix well
6. Stir in flour , cinnamon , and apples by hand just until combined
7. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes in a 13x9 which has been lined with greased aluminum foil
8. Cool completely before cutting into squares

title: grilled lime chicken  sandwich  salad  wrap or main dish
steps:
1. Mix together seasoning blend
2. Set aside
3. Mix lime juice , seasoning blend , oil and honey in small bowl
4. Place chicken in large resealable plastic bag or glass dish
5. Add marinade
6. Turn to coat well
7. Refrigerate 15 minutes or longer for extra flavor
8. Remove chicken from marinade
9. Discard any remaining marinade
10. Grill over medium heat 6 to 8 minutes per side or until chicken is cooked through , turning frequently
11. Serving suggestions:
12. Grilled chicken: serve along side your favorite vegetable
13. Chicken club sandwiches: serve grilled chicken on toasted buns with cheddar cheese , cooked bacon , tomato , lettuce and ranch dressing
14. Chicken wrap: place grilled chicken on a warmed flour tortilla layering with choice of additions , such as grilled sweet bell peppers , grilled onions , cheddar cheese , etc
15. And choice of sauce or mayo
16. Gently roll until tortilla is completely wrapped around the filling
17. Grilled chicken salad: place grilled chicken on top mixed salad greens , cherry tomatoes , red onions , etc
18. Topping with dressing and cheddar cheese

title: tangy round steak strips
steps:
1. In a large skillet , saute beef and onion in french dressing until the meat is no longer pink
2. In a small bowl combine sauce mix and water until blended
3. Stir into the beef mixture
4. Add the mushrooms , celery , and worcestershire sauce
5. Bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat
7. Cover and simmer for 60 minutes or until the meat is tender
8. Serve over noodles

title: tender tasty cornbread
steps:
1. Combine all dry ingredients in a large bowl
2. Set aside
3. Beat egg till thickened
4. Add water to the egg
5. Add to dry ingredients& mix till just combined
6. Add butter , and stir gently to blend
7. Pour batter into a greased 9x13 pan- bake at 425 for 20-25 minutes

title: chilli pork sausage rolls
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200c
2. Cut each pastry sheet in half
3. Mix together pork mince , coriander , chilli sauce , chilli , ginger , breadcrumbs , egg , soy sauce , spring onions and garlic until combined
4. Divide the mix into 8 portions and roll each portion into a sausage shape
5. Place along the centre of each pastry sheet
6. Roll to enclose , placing the pastry seam underneath
7. Cut each roll into 4 sausage rolls and place on a greased and lined baking tray
8. Brush with beaten egg
9. Bake for 25 minutes or until golden and cooked through
10. Serve with extra chilli sauce
11. These can be frozen uncooked and stored for later
12. Just defrost and cook when needed

title: jamaican chicken
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine all ingredients except chicken
2. Add chicken to bowl , cover with plastic wrap , and refrigerate at least one hour
3. Heat oven to 350 degrees
4. Remove chicken from marinade and place in spray-coated 9 by 13 inch pan
5. Pour remaining marinade over chicken and dot with butter
6. Bake for 45-50 minutes , basting occasionally

title: orange sauce beans
steps:
1. Combine orange juice , cornstarch , salt and onion
2. Cook and stir until mixture boils and thickens
3. Add vinegar and drained beans and heat thoroughly
4. Small orange or tangerine segments can be added to the sauce along with the green beans for additional color and flavor

title: roasted eggplant and garlic with pasta
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Slice garlic head in half , horizontally , and sprinkle with olive oil then wrap entire head in aluminum foil
3. On a baking sheet , roast the whole eggplant and garlic until soft , about 45 minutes
4. Remove from oven and let cool
5. Squeeze out soft garlic cloves , peel and chop eggplant into bite size pieces
6. Heat skillet and add remaining olive oil , lightly saut garlic and eggplant , season with salt and pepper
7. Add chicken broth , parsley and lemon juice and simmer until reduced by half
8. Rough chop basil
9. Add butter and basil leaves and stir well
10. Cook pasta according to package directions , drain and toss with eggplant mixture
11. Top with freshly grated parmesan cheese and serve

title: taco filled pasta shells   oamc
steps:
1. Cook beef until no longer pink
2. Drain
3. Add taco seasoning and prepare according to package directions
4. Add cream cheese , cook and stir for 5-10 minutes or until melted
5. Transfer to a bowl and chill in fridge for 1 hour
6. Cook pasta according to package directions
7. Drain
8. Gently toss with butter
9. Fill each shell with about 3 tablespoons of meat mixture
10. To freeze: place shells in a freezer bag
11. Cover and freeze for up to 3 months
12. To cook immediately: spoon salsa into a grease 9 inch baking dish
13. Top with shells and taco sauce
14. Cover and bake at 350 for 30 minutes
15. Uncover , sprinkle wit cheeses and chips
16. Bake 15 minutes longer
17. Serve with sour cream and onions
18. To use frozen shells:
19. Thaw for 24 hours in fridge and follow cook immediately directions but bake for 40 minutes covered

title: chocolate mairibars  gluten free energy bar
steps:
1. Put dates in a saucepan , add water and boil until the water is absorbed and the dates are soft
2. Remove from heat and smooth the mixture with a wooden spoon until you have a soft , thick paste
3. Place mixture in a large mixing bowl
4. Add cocoa powder and mix thoroughly with dates
5. Add ground almonds and stir into paste
6. Add coconut and chopped nuts
7. Knead these last two ingredients into the mixture either by hand or use a bread hook
8. When thoroughly mixed transfer to a 8 x 13 pan
9. Smooth mixture out and cover it
10. Place in the refrigerator and let it set for an hour before cutting into squares

title: amazing beef ribs
steps:
1. Mix all the dry spices for the rub
2. Rub on beef ribs and slow cook in a 250f oven for 3-4 hours
3. Whisk all the bbq sauce ingredients together
4. Baste with bbq sauce and grill for 10-15 minutes

title: best ever cocktail sauce
steps: 1. Combine all and chill at least 2 hours

title: picnic pasta and ham salad
steps:
1. In large bowl , stir together mayonnaise , salt and pepper
2. Add ham , cooked macaroni , cucumber , peas and onion
3. Toss to coat well
4. Cover and refrigerate until well chilled

title: 5 minute cranberry sauce
steps:
1. Puree cranberries w / orange juice & water in food processor until cranberries are almost smooth but still retain some texture , 1 - 2 minutes
2. Stir in mango

title: summer melon mix   berry honey dressing
steps:
1. Prepare berry honey dressing
2. Cover and refrigerate while preparing the salad
3. Peel the cantaloupe and honeydew melon
4. Cut into thin wedges
5. To serve , arrange cantaloupe , honeydew and strawberries on salad plate
6. Drizzle the dressing over fruit

title: chicken salad in a whole wheat bread bowl
steps:
1. Cook chicken in sauce pan with enough water to cover until done
2. Drain
3. Cut chicken into 2-inch pieces
4. In a large bowl mix together the mayo , celery , parsley , mustard , oregano , pimento and pepper
5. Add chicken and mix well
6. Spoon 1 / 2 cup chicken salad into rolls
7. Enjoy !

title: hawaiian kailua pork
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Line a 9 x 13 pan with one layer heavy duty aluminum foil or two sheets regular foil
3. Place half the spinach on the bottom where the roast will sit
4. Rub the roast with the salt
5. Place on spinach bed then pour the whole bottle of liquid smoke over it
6. Layer the rest of the spinach on the top and roll the foil up around the pork to cover it entirely like a package
7. Bake in the oven for 5 hours
8. When done it will fall apart and it is shredded easily with a couple of forks
9. Excellent with sticky rice

title: apple cinnamon cake with 5 ingredients
steps:
1. Pour the dry cake mix in a bowl
2. Add eggs and apple pie filling
3. Mix with mixer for 2 minutes
4. Pour 1 / 2 the batter in a lightly greased 9x13-inch pan
5. Sprinkle with cinnamon / sugar mix
6. Repeat with remaining batter and end with
7. Cinnamon / sugar mix
8. Bake at 350 for approximately 35 minute or until toothpick comes out clean

title: easy pumpkin brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease and flour a 9 x 13 inch baking pan
3. Mix together pumpkin , oil , eggs , and sugar with an electric mixer
4. Stir in the remaining ingredients
5. Pour into prepared pan
6. Bake for 30 minutes , or until center springs back when touched
7. Serve with whipped topping or frost with a cream cheese frosting
8. Garnish with candied corn or sprinkle with nuts if desired

title: tomato   eggplant focaccia bread
steps:
1. To prepare dough , dissolve yeast in warm water in a large bowl
2. Lightly spoon flour into dry measuring cups
3. Level with a knife
4. Add 3 1 / 2 cups of flour , 3 tablespoons basil , 1 tablespoon oil , and 1 teaspoon salt
5. Stir just until moist
6. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface
7. Knead until smooth and elastic
8. Add enough of remaining flour , 1 tablespoon at a time , to prevent dough from sticking to hands
9. Place dough in a large bowl coated with cooking spray , turning to coat top
10. Cover and let rise in a warm place , free from drafts , 1 hour or until doubled in size
11. Punch dough down
12. Cover and let rest 5 minutes
13. Divide dough in half
14. Working with 1 portion at a time , roll each half into a 10-inch circle on a pizza pan or baking sheet coated with cooking spray
15. Cover and let rise 30 minutes or until doubled in size
16. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
17. To prepare tapenade , heat 1 tablespoon oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat
18. Add garlic
19. Cook 30 seconds
20. Add eggplant
21. Cook 8 minutes or until tender , stirring occasionally
22. Place eggplant mixture in a food processor
23. Add 1 tablespoon oil , 2 tablespoons basil , and next 4 ingredients basil through olives)
24. Pulse 1 minute , scraping sides of bowl once
25. Uncover dough
26. Spread 1 / 4 cup tapenade over each focaccia
27. Arrange tomatoes evenly over tapenade
28. Spread remaining tapenade over tomatoes
29. Bake at 425 degrees for 20 minutes or until crust is golden brown

title: dracula s eyes
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl stir together peanut butter and butter
2. Gradually add powdered sugar , stirring until combined
3. Shape into 1-inch balls
4. Place on waxed paper
5. Let stand about 20 minutes until dry
6. In a small sauce pan melt candy coating over low heat
7. Dip balls , one at a time , into coating
8. Let excess coating drip off peanut butter balls
9. Place on waxed paper
10. Immediately press an m&m into center of each peanut butter ball
11. Let stand until coating is firm
12. Add a dot of black gel to the center of candy pieces for pupils
13. Drizzle red gel onto balls for bloodshot eyes

title: chickpea  spinach  and pasta soup
steps:
1. Combine all but pasta and spinach
2. Bring to a boil and then simmer for about 20 minutes
3. Use an immersion blender to puree about half of the soup
4. Add cooked pasta and spinach
5. Simmer for a few minutes until spinach is wilted

title: vegan cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f and line muffin pan with cupcake liners
2. Whisk the soy milk and vinegar a measuring cup and set aside a few minutes to get good and curdled
3. In a large bowl , sift the flour , cornstarch , baking powder , baking soda and salt
4. Stir to combine
5. In a separate large bowl , beat together the soy milk mixture , oil , sugar and vanilla
6. Stir the dry ingredients and mix until no large lumps remain
7. Fill cupcake liners two-thirds full and bake for 20-22 minutes till done
8. Transfer to a cooling rack and let cool completely before frosting

title: borecole dutch kale and potatoes
steps:
1. Wash the kale thoroughly by submerging it in a tub of cool water
2. Spin in a salad spinner or let drip-dry in a colander
3. Roll the leaves together and slice into thin strips
4. Set aside while cooking the potatoes
5. Wash , peel and dice the potatoes
6. Fill a large pot with water and add the diced potatoes
7. Bring to a boil and cook until soft , about 10 minutes
8. Drain the potatoes and return to pot
9. While mashing the potatoes , add the butter , half and half , salt and pepper to taste
10. Stir in the sliced kale and cover
11. Heat the kielbasa in a bit of boiling water until the sausage is hot throughout , about 8 minutes
12. Brown gravy is often served over the mashed potatoes
13. Serve a section of the kielbasa and the mashed potatoes and enjoy !

title: rita s recipe from felina in italy
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300f
2. Heat the oil in a skillet and gently fry the eggplant , peppers and garlic for about 15 minutes
3. Cut the bread in half lengthwise
4. Divide the eggplant mixture , tomatoes , and escarole between the bread halves
5. Place in oven and bake for 15-20 minutes
6. Sprinkle with wine vinegar , capers , olives and basil

title: carrot   applesauce muffins
steps:
1. Combine cake mix , applesauce , egg , sugar , and cinnamon in a mixing bowl until well blended
2. Spoon into lined muffin tin
3. Top with chopped nuts
4. Bake for 17 - 20 minutes in 350 degree oven
5. Cool , serve

title: creamy chicken pies
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan stir flour into soup
2. Stir in milk and pepper
3. Cook and stir over medium heat till mixture is thickened and bubbly
4. Cook for 1 minute more
5. Stir in chicken and cream cheese
6. Heat through , stirring to melt cream cheese
7. Pour hot chicken mixture into three 10-ounce
8. Custard cups
9. Separate the biscuits and arrange 2 biscuits atop each custard cup
10. Bake in a 375 degree oven for 12 to 15 minutes or till biscuits are golden brown

title: healthy chicken fried rice  low g i
steps:
1. In saucepan , bring 1 1 / 4 cups of the chicken stock , rice and salt to boil
2. Reduce heat to low , cover and cook for 25 minutes or until liquid is absorbed
3. Fluff with fork and set aside
4. In large non-stick skillet heat sesame oil over medium high heat and cook chicken and mushrooms for about 8 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink
5. Add green onions , carrot , celery , and cooked rice
6. Cook , stirring for 2 minutes , to combine
7. Add remaining chicken stock and soy sauce and cook for 5 minutes
8. Add bean sprouts and toss to combine

title: rachael ray turkey and bean burrito burgers
steps:
1. Combine rice , meat and beans with spices and grill seasoning
2. Form 4 big patties from the meat and bean mixture then heat 1 tablespoon oil , a turn of the pan , in a large skillet over medium-high heat
3. Cook patties 7-8 minutes on each side
4. While burgers cook , combine avocado with garlic , lime zest and juice , jalapeno and red onion
5. Mash to roughly combine , then stir in the sour cream
6. Place burgers on buns with lettuce and tomato and top with sour cream guacamole

title: three bell pepper slaw with chipotle dressing
steps:
1. Puree first 6 ingredients in blender
2. Toss sliced bell peppers and dressing together in a large bowl
3. Cover and refrigerate about 4 hours

title: infallible rice
steps:
1. Melt butter in skillet
2. Add onions and saut until soft
3. Add any herbs or spices of choice put chicken broth , rice , and onion mixture into a a casserole dish
4. Cover and bake at 350f for 45 min to 1 hours

title: easy potato latkes
steps:
1. Preheat oven 425
2. Add 1 / 2 cup of oil to each pan and put in oven for 10min
3. Peel and grate potatoes and onions
4. Remove moisture from potatoes
5. Mix in eggs , salt , baking powder , flour
6. Drop batter 1 / 4 cup of batter into the hot oil and press down until tray is full
7. Bake 15-20 min or until golden brown then flip latkes and cook for 10-15 minute
8. Use 2 9x13 pans

title: penne with tomato prosciutto sauce
steps:
1. Heat oil in a wide heavy medium pot over medium-high heat until it shimmers , then saut onion until golden , about 10 minutes
2. Add garlic and saut until golden , about 1 minute
3. Add prosciutto and saut until golden , about 4 minutes
4. Add tomatoes with reserved juice , sugar , and 1 / 4 teaspoon each of salt and pepper and simmer , uncovered , stirring occasionally , until thickened , 45 minutes to 1 hour
5. Cool , uncovered , then chill , covered , at least 8 hours
6. Cook penne in a pasta pot of boiling salted water until al dente
7. Drain well
8. While pasta cooks , reheat sauce over medium heat
9. Toss pasta with some of sauce in a serving bowl and serve remaining sauce on the side
10. Cooks'

title: irish american corned beef and cabbage
steps:
1. Place beef in a large dutch oven and cover with water
2. Add onion , optional beer , thyme and parsley
3. Bring to a boil over high heat
4. Meanwhile , place bay leaf , peppercorns , mustard seed and cloves into herb ball or piece of tied cheesecloth
5. Add to pot
6. Reduce heat to simmer
7. Cover and cook for about 3-1 / 2 hours or until meat is very tender
8. Add cabbage , carrots and parsnips
9. Simmer for 20-30 minutes until vegetables are tender
10. Remove the meat and cut into slices
11. Place on center of a large platter
12. Strain the vegetables and place around beef
13. Add pepper over all
14. Pass horseradish sauce and , if desired , some of the broth

title: pork loaf
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Melt butter in a medium saucepan over medium-low heat
3. Add in onions and bell pepper / s
4. Cook until veggies are tender , stirring occasionally then cool the mixture completely
5. In a large bowl mix together ground pork , ham , crushed crackers , milk , eggs , pepper , salt and the cooled onion / pepper mixture
6. Mix well to combine
7. Shape into an approx 9x5-inch loaf , and place onto a shallow greased baking pan
8. Using a long knife , make shallow criss-cross pattern in the top of of loaf
9. Bake for 30 minutes
10. Meanwhile for the glaze blend the orange marmalade , dijon mustard and brown sugar in a small bowl
11. After 30 minutes of baking remove from oven and drizzle about 1 / 3 cup glaze over loaf and return to oven to bake for another 15 minutes
12. After 15 minutes , drizzle the remaining glaze over loaf and bake for about another 22-25 minutes or until a thermometer inserted in the center of the loaf reads 165f
13. Transfer the loaf to a platter
14. Let stand for 10 minutes
15. Pour the pan juices into a small bowl and whisk to blend
16. Slice the loaf and serve with the pan juices
17. Delicious !

title: hershey s chocolate chocolate cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f grease and flour two 9-inch round baking pans
2. Stir together sugar , flour , cocoa , baking powder , baking soda and salt in large bowl
3. Add eggs , milk , oil and vanilla
4. Beat on medium speed of mixer 2 minutes
5. Stir in boiling water
6. Pour batter into prepared pans
7. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
8. Cool 10 minutes
9. Remove from pans to wire racks
10. Cool completely
11. Frost with "perfectly chocolate" chocolate frosting
12. 10 to 12 servings

title: melody s amazing bean dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spread evenly 1 can re-fried beans onto bottom of 8 x 11 baking dish
3. Sprinkle of your shredded taco cheese package onto the re-fried beans
4. Bake for 10 minutes or until cheese is melted
5. Do not over heat the re-fried beans
6. Cool for 30 minutes and then add the 2 cups of lettuce onto the top of the melted cheese
7. Mix in your 1-chopped jalapeno pepper for an extra added bite
8. Add chunky salsa on top
9. Add 1 container of sour cream on top
10. Sprinkle the rest of your taco cheese on top of sour cream and refrigerate until ready to serve
11. Serve with restaurant style taco chips

title: french vanilla tiramisu
steps:
1. Beat cream cheese in large bowl with mixer on medium speed until creamy
2. Slowly add milk , beating well after each addition
3. Add dry pudding mix
4. Beat on low speed until well blended
5. Dust cut sides of ladyfingers with coffee
6. Place half of the ladyfingers on the bottom and up side of 1 quart serving bowl
7. Top with layers of half each of the pudding mixture , whipped topping , and grated chocolate
8. Cover with remaining ladyfingers
9. Repeat layers of pudding mixture , whipped topping , and grated chocolate
10. Refrigerate 3 hours

title: jiffy corn crab soup
steps:
1. I place the first 3 ingredients in a food processor
2. Pulsing for a second or two just until the onion is chopped
3. Pour mixture into a saucepan
4. Add cream , crab and corn and cook on low for 5 to 10 minutes
5. Heat and serve !
6. Freshcrabmeat can be substituted for the canned variety

title: asparagus sour cream muffins
steps:
1. Toss asparagus with 1 tbs of the oil in a baking dish
2. Roast in the oven at 200c / 400f for about 10 minutes
3. Let cool slightly , then cut asparagus into pieces
4. Combine flour , baking powder , salt and pepper in a big bowl
5. Make a well in the centre
6. In a second bowl beat eggs lightly
7. Add sour cream and remaining oil
8. Pour into the well and mix until dry ingredients are just moistened
9. Fold in asparagus
10. Fill dough into prepared muffin tins
11. If you like sprinkle with grated cheese
12. Bake in the preheated oven at 200c / 400f for 20 minutes or until slightly browned and tester comes out clean

title: papaya avocado salad
steps:
1. Wash and dry lettuc , tear into bite sized pieces place in a salad bowl or platter
2. Halve and peel papaya
3. Scoop out seeds and save 2tbsp
4. Slice papaya
5. Combine dressing ingredients in a blender untill papaya seeds have the appearance of ground pepper
6. Store dressing in fridge for an hour or 2
7. Just before serving add papaya avocado and red onion slices to lettuce
8. Pour dressing over salad and toss

title: gingerbread dough
steps:
1. Oven 180oc / gas 4 for 8 / 10 mins at top of oven
2. The syrup mixture must cool for about half an hour and the dough must rest also for a half an hour so allow some time in advance for this
3. Melt sugar / syrup / butter and spice slowly and cool
4. In a large saucepan
5. Beat an egg and mix the bicarb with water
6. Mix this into the syrup mixture
7. Start adding the flour slowly and mixing it all inches
8. It will start to get hard towards the end but just keep going
9. If the mixture is too still at the end part of the mixing , put your bowl over a bowl of warm water and this will loosen the mixture slightly to enable you to mix in the last amount of flour
10. Chill the dough in cling film for about half an hour and its ready to use
11. This dough is extremely versatile and will take on any shape or indentation , shape or pattern
12. See edible birthday cards

title: rainbow vegetable stir fry
steps:
1. Heat oil in a medium wok over medium-high heat until hot
2. Add peppers to wok and stir fry until tender-crisp , about 3 minutes
3. Stir in gourmet sauce and cook until sauce boils , about 30 seconds

title: heart healthy chicken bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Brown chicken in skillet in olive oil and poultry seasoning , removing skin from thighs
3. Arrange chicken pieces in a shallow 2-quart baking dish
4. Combine all remaining ingredients and spoon over the chicken
5. Bake uncovered , basting often , until chicken is well done or fork tender
6. Baking time varies , but is usually 30 to 45 minutes
7. Add water if sauce tends to boil away
8. Serves: 6 , but if folks are hungry , serves 3

title: cabbage and butter bean soup
steps:
1. Place all ingredients except herbs and bean in a pot with enough water to cover
2. Bring to the boil and then lower the heat and simmer for half an hour , adding more water as needed
3. Add the butter beans and cook another 5 minutes or until everything is piping hot
4. Divide between warmed soup bowls and serve with the herbs sprinkled on top

title: cream of potato and onion soup
steps:
1. In a medium pot , saute the bacon over medium heat until browned
2. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside
3. Next , add the white onion and saute over medium heat until onions become translucent
4. Add the diced potatoes along with the olive oil and continue to saute for about 6 or 7 minutes , stirring frequently
5. When the potatoes begin to soften , add the chicken broth and stir , scraping the bottom of the pan
6. Reduce heat to low and allow to simmer for about 15 minutes , checking on it every 5 minutes or so
7. Next , add the evaporated milk , salt , nutmeg , and pepper
8. Stir so that ingredients are well mixed
9. At this time , you can use a hand held blender to puree the soup
10. If you don't have a hand held blender , use a food processor and pulse blend for a couple of minutes
11. You may add a bit more chicken stock if it seems too thick
12. When the soup is well blended and velvety , add back the bacon as well as the parsley and stir well
13. Simmer for a couple more minutes and then taste for proper seasoning
14. Remove from heat and stir in 1 tablespoon of butter until melted
15. Serve hot , adding some of the scallions for garnish and a small pad of butter
16. Serve with a hearty bread on the side
17. Enjoy

title: philadelphia jewish apple cake
steps:
1. Mix apple slices with cinnamon and 1 cup sugar
2. Set aside
3. Combine dry ingredients in a medium bowl
4. Set aside
5. Beat eggs with 1 1 / 2 cups sugar and light brown sugar
6. Alternately add the dry ingredients and the oil to the wet ingredients , then add the orange juice and lastly the vanilla and beat for 1 minute
7. Pour 1 / 3rd of the batter into a greased and floured tube pan
8. Layer 1 / 3rd of the apple slices and nuts over the batter
9. Repeat with layer of batter , then apples and nuts , then batter , then final layer of apples and nuts
10. Drizzle the cake with a bit of the remaining cinnamon-sugar "syrup" from the apple bowl
11. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 1 / 4 hours or until tester comes out clean
12. Allow cake to cool in pan on wire rack for 20-25 minutes , then turn cake out onto wire rack to cool completely

title: virgin margarita
steps:
1. Combine the ingredients in a cocktail shaker filled with ice and shake vigorously
2. Pour into a glass
3. Pour into a glass
4. Garnish with a lime wedge

title: tofu chili
steps:
1. First stir fry tofu cubes and keep aside
2. Heat oil in a pan sauteed cumin , fenugreek , and onion seeds add chopped onion and fry till it turns golden brown
3. Add green chilly , bell pepper and tofu stir frequently to stop sticking
4. Add ginger garlic paste say suce lemon juice and termeric powder
5. Add salt and fry in low heat
6. Decorate with cilantro and chopped tomato
7. Serve hot with your favorite dish

title: mussels italiano
steps:
1. When you bring your mussels home from the market , discard any that are chipped , broken or otherwise damaged
2. Discard any mussel that is open
3. If you are not using right away , cover with damp paper towels in a container that can be tightly closed and store in the refrigerator
4. Just before cooking , wash the mussels in several changes of cold water
5. Using a small knife or a dry towel , remove the beards by pulling out towards the hinged side of the mussel
6. To remove any remaining sand , soak mussels for about 30 minutes in cold water containing a handful of salt and a handful of flour
7. Take each mussel from the bowl and using a firm brush , remove any barnacles before placing into another bowl of clear water
8. Melt butter in a medium sized pot
9. Saute onions til clear
10. Add garlic& stir for another minute
11. Add tomato , oregano , salt& pepper and cook until tomato is soft
12. Add wine& bring to a slow boil
13. Dry the mussels with a clean towel , place into pot , cover & steam for 4 minutes
14. Remove the lid & stir the mussels
15. At this point , most of the mussels should be open
16. Replace the lid and steam for another 2 - 4 minutes
17. Discard any that don't open
18. Divide into serving bowls& cover with broth
19. If you increase the serving size for this recipe , don't add too many mussels to the pot at once or stack them on top of each other as it will make it difficult for the mussels to open due to the weight

title: lemon parmigiano chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Whisk together the lemon juice , vermouth , mustard , butter , sage and garlic
3. Place the chicken thighs in a baking dish
4. Pour the lemon mixture over all
5. Sprinkle with the parmesan , salt and pepper
6. Bake until done , about 45 minutes , basting occasionally with the pan juices
7. Serve immediately

title: beef olives
steps:
1. Lightly pound beef steaks with a rolling pin over some plastic to tenderise
2. Mix stuffing mix with water and divide between steaks
3. Roll up and secure with a toothpick
4. Sear the steaks with a little cooking spray
5. Remove from pan
6. Saute onions in the same pan until soft
7. Return the beef rolls and add the crushed tomatoes , red wine , herbs and sugar
8. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until tender
9. When cooked , slice the beef olives diagonally and serve on a bed seasoned vegetables
10. Pour some of the sauce over the top and place some crusty bread smeared with olive oil and rubbed with a little garlic on the side

title: spinach   cranberry salad
steps:
1. Put the spinach and mushrooms in a large bowl
2. Crumble the cheese over the spinach
3. Cook the bacon in a medium skillet over medium heat until crispy , 8 to 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Drain the bacon in a sieve set over a heatproof measuring cup , reserving the rendered fat
5. You will need 1 / 4 cup for the dressing
6. Pour the fat back into the pan and add the shallot and cook until light brown , about 30 seconds , stirring occasionally
7. Add the thyme and let it crackle in the fat for about 10 seconds
8. Add the vinegar , and season with salt and pepper and sugar to taste
9. Cook for about 30 seconds to lower the acidity of the vinegar
10. You should see tiny drops of vinegar dispersed throughout the fat
11. Add the dried cranberries and stir
12. Add bacon back into dressing
13. Pour the dressing over the spinach and cheese
14. Toss to coat the leaves evenly and melt the cheese a little
15. Serve immediately

title: dry curry sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Put sweet potatoes into a shallow casserole
3. Sprinkle with curry and salt
4. Drizzle with olive oil
5. Bake , turning once or twice , for 45 minutes , until evenly browned
6. Serve immediately

title: popcorn seasoning mixes
steps:
1. Place all of the ingredients in a medium bowl
2. Stir until they are combined , and transfer to an airtight container for storage
3. Season popcorn to taste

title: gingery banana waffles
steps:
1. Preheat waffle iron
2. In large bowl , combine flour , baking powder , cinnamon , ginger , and salt
3. In medium bowl , beat eggs with brown sugar until light and fluffy
4. Puree extra-ripe bananas in blender
5. Beat pureed bananas , milk , molasses or dark corn syrup , and melted butter into egg mixture
6. Add to dry ingredients
7. Stir until just moistened
8. Pour 3 / 4 cup batter in middle of waffle iron and cook until golden
9. Dust with powdered sugar and serve with additional sliced bananas and maple syrup

title: healthier pineapple   cheesecake
steps:
1. In blender , combine gelatin , boiling water , vanilla , lemon juice and cottage cheese
2. Blend until smooth
3. Stir in pineapple , including juice
4. Fold in whipped topping
5. Pour into 9 x 13" baking dish
6. Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs on top
7. Refrigerate 2 hours before serving

title: eggplant salad with miso ginger dressing
steps:
1. Preheat broiler or barbecue
2. Whisk rice vinegar , miso paste , basil , ginger , garlic , red pepper together
3. Gradually add in vegetable oil
4. Season with salt and pepper and set aside
5. Brush eggplant with olive oil and season with salt and pepper
6. Grill or broil until golden and just tender , about 3 minutes per side
7. Toss the greens with just enough dressing to coat
8. Divide among 4 plates , top with eggplant and drizzle remaining dressing

title: applesauce cinnamon muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Coat 12 medium-size cups with vegetable oil or line with paper baking cups
3. In a medium bowl combine oat bran cereal , cinnamon , baking powder , soda , and salt
4. In a large bowl combine applesauce , honey , oil , egg , and vanilla
5. Stir in dry ingredients
6. Mix well
7. Stir in nuts
8. Fill prepared muffin cups almost full
9. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown
10. Serve warm

title: sea salt ice cream
steps:
1. Separate the eggs into two good sized bowls
2. Beat the egg whites until stiff
3. Mix the egg yolks and sugar until thick
4. Slowly bring the milk to a boil over medium heat , stirring occasionally
5. Pour the hot milk into yolk / sugar mixture and mix well
6. Pour milk / yolk / sugar mixture back into pot and heat on medium until thicker to make a custard
7. Pour custard in with beaten egg whites and mix well
8. Add sea salt
9. Put mixture in fridge to cool
10. Once cool , add cream and vanilla
11. Add 12 drops of blue coloring , and 3 drops of green coloring
12. Freeze , following your ice cream makers instructions
13. If you don't have an ice cream maker pour mixture into 1 or 2 metal cake pans and set in freezer
14. Let sit until edges become firm , then remove and mix
15. Repeat until uniformly frozen

title: old el paso layered bean dip
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , mix together refried beans , green chilies , and taco seasoning mix
2. Spread on a 12-inch round serving platter
3. Blend avocados , lemon juice , and 1 / 2 cup taco sauce until smooth
4. Spread on top of refried bean mixture
5. Spread sour cream on top of avocado mixture
6. Top with shredded cheddar cheese , shredded lettuce , diced tomato , olive slices , and taco sauce
7. Serve with tortilla chips

title: nutella mocha
steps:
1. Brew espresso
2. In a saucepan , combine all ingredients including brewed espresso
3. Slowly bring to a boil , stirring constatly , then reduce heat and simmer for 1 minute , still stirring
4. Pour the hot mix into blender and blend on high for 5 seconds
5. Serve , maybe garnished with whipped cream
6. Enjoy !

title: papoutsakia   little shoes    stuffed eggplant  aubergine
steps:
1. Brown onions and meat lightly in butter , stirring constantly
2. Add tomatoes , salt and pepper
3. Cook covered for about 15 minutes
4. Remove from heat
5. Add parsley , egg , 1 / 4 cup cheese and breadcrumbs
6. Wash and dry eggplant
7. Heat oil in a large frying pan
8. Cook slowly , over medium heat about 6 eggplant at a time until soft and light brown , turning occasionally and carefully
9. Remove carefully from pan with spatula and place in baking pan
10. Make a slit along length each eggplant with a sharp knife blade
11. Spread apart enough to make a 'pocket' and stuff with meat mixture
12. Prepare one cup of bechamel sauce
13. Melt butter in a small saucepan and whisk in flour
14. Cook for a minute and slowly add milk , whisking all the while
15. Allow to cool 15 minutes and add 1 egg and remaining cheese
16. Pour about a tablespoon on top of each eggplant
17. Sprinkle with additional grated cheese and dot with butter
18. If desired , add tomato sauce to the pan
19. Bake in a moderate oven for about 40 minutes until piping hot
20. Very good at room temperature too

title: shrimp stir fry for one
steps:
1. Rinse and drain the shrimp
2. Heat the soy sauce , rice vinegar , and 2 tbsp of chicken brother in a pan over medium heat
3. Add the garlic and ginger and cook until tender
4. Add the vegetables to the pan and continue to cook , adding more broth as necessary and turning the vegetables so that they are evenly cooked throughout
5. When the vegetables are halfway cooked , add the shrimp and continue to cook until the vegetables are tender and the shrimp are opaque in color
6. Serve over rice

title: thai coconut pumpkin soup
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , stir-fry onion in oil until golden brown
2. Add shrimp , chiles , and shrimp paste
3. Fry for 1 minute
4. Add water and bring to a boil
5. Add pumpkin , reduce heat , and simmer for 10 minutes
6. Add coconut milk and salt
7. Return to a boil and cook until pumpkin is tender
8. Serve garnished with lemon juice , basil leaves , and cilantro

title: savory crispy polenta
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Grease and flour 8x8 or 7x11 baking dish
3. Carmelize the onions in 1-2 tablespoons of oil
4. Do not allow to burn
5. Set aside
6. Stir cornmeal and salt into 1 cup warm water
7. Add 1 cup boiling water and bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly
8. Lower temperature and continue stirring until the consistency of heavy batter
9. Remove from heat and stir in 2 / 3 of the onions and 3 / 4 of the cheese
10. Mix well
11. Pour into baking dish and smooth to level
12. Top with reserved onions and cheese
13. Drizzle remaining olive oil over top
14. Sprinkle with freshly grated black pepper and red pepper flakes
15. Bake 40-45 minutes or until top is golden and sides have pulled away from dish
16. Allow to sit for 10 minutes to set , then cut into servings

title: strawberry and spinach salad
steps:
1. Put all dressing ingredients together in a smalll jar , shake well and set aside to let the flavors blend
2. Lay spinach on a platter and mound berries in the middle
3. Before serving , shake dressing and pour carefully over the salad

title: grilled salmon with blackberry cabernet coulis
steps:
1. In a food processor or blender , combine wine and 2 cups berries
2. Whirl until pured
3. Rub berry mixture through a fine strainer into a 1 1 / 2- to 2-quart pan
4. Discard residue
5. Add shallots , ginger , and 2 tablespoons sugar
6. Bring berry mixture to a boil over high heat , and stir often until reduced to 1 cup , about 10 minutes
7. Remove from heat , and stir in butter and more sugar to taste
8. Rinse salmon and pat dry
9. Coil belly strips of fish into center of steaks and secure each portion with a small skewer
10. Lay salmon on an oiled grill over a solid bed of hot coals or high heat on a gas grill
11. Close lid on gas grill
12. Cook fish , turning once , until opaque but still moist-looking in center of thickest part , 7 to 10 minutes
13. Set a salmon steak on each of 6 warm plates
14. Spoon berry coulis equally over steaks
15. Garnish with remaining 1 / 2 cup whole berries
16. Add salt and pepper to taste

title: three garlic pasta
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Wrap garlic head in foil , or place in garlic roaster
3. Roast until soft and golden , about 1 hour
4. Let cool , trim
5. Transfer to small bowl
6. Set aside
7. Cook pasta until al dente
8. Drain , and run under cold water to stop cooking
9. Thinly slice five cloves of unroasted garlic
10. Finely chop remaining three cloves
11. Heat oil over medium heat in large skillet
12. Add sliced garlic
13. Toast until golden and crisp
14. Remove garlic with slotted spoon
15. Set aside
16. Add chopped garlic
17. Saut until translucent , about 1 1 / 2 minutes
18. Add roasted garlic and white wine
19. Let simmer about 3 minutes
20. Add pasta , parsley , red pepper , and salt and pepper to taste
21. Toss
22. Serve sprinkled with toasted garlic slivers
23. Grate parmesan over each serving

title: ham   cheese muffins
steps:
1. Heat the oven to 400f in a bowl , mix together the flour , sugar , baking powder and baking soda
2. In a separate bowl , mix the yogurt , cooled butter and eggs
3. Add the yogurt mixture to the flour mixture and mix just until combined
4. Fold in the ham , cheese and basil
5. Spoon into greased muffin cups and bake for 15 to 20 minutes , remembering to check after the first 15 minutes are up

title: turp salatsi  radish salad
steps:
1. Taste first then decide if the salt is necessary
2. Cut the radishes into thin slices
3. Arrange the radishes and onions or chives on a pretty plate
4. Sprinkle the lemon juice , sumac and salt all over the radishes
5. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour
6. When ready to serve , garnish with the parsley
7. Lemon zest and lemon slices
8. Can be served chilled or at room temperature
9. Good with kebabs , bean dishes , grilled chicken , etc
10. Yield is estimated

title: brown sugar graham crust  quick and easy recipe
steps:
1. Melt the butter in the microwave
2. In a mixing bowl , stir the crumbs and sugar together , then stir in the melted butter
3. Pat into a 9" pie pan , spreading the crumbs so the sides of the pan are not too thick
4. '
5. Bake at 375 for 6 min
6. S
7. Cool to room temp before filling

title: bunder gerstensuppe  swiss barley soup
steps:
1. Heat butter and olive oil in a soup kettle over medium-high heat
2. Add onion and leek and cook until they begin to soften , about 10 minutes
3. Add the carrots , celery , bay leaf and bacon and lower heat to medium
4. Cook for 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Add stock , barley and potatoes
6. Simmer for 1 hour
7. Add salt and pepper to taste
8. Stir in cream and bring back to heat , without boiling
9. Ladle into bowls and garnish with parsley

title: warm salad of zucchini and tomato
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat
2. Add shallots and cook 1 minute , stirring so that they do not burn
3. Add cream and basil
4. Heat to boiling , then reduce heat to simmer
5. Simmer , stirring occasionally , until thickened
6. Add lemon juice , vinegar , tabasco , salt and pepper
7. Stir in the zucchini and mix till well-coated
8. Add in the tomatoes , and mix well
9. You are not cooking the zucchini and tomatoes , only coating them in the warm sauce
10. Sprinkle with 1 tbs fresh basil garnish , if using
11. Serve immediately

title: sauteed shrimp and tomato pasta
steps:
1. Bring water in a large pot to a boil , add 1 tbsp olive oil and pasta
2. Allow to simmer for approx 10 minutes , or until al dente
3. Drain pasta once fully cooked
4. Melt butter in a large skillet with extra virgin olive oil
5. Add the chopped tomatoes , shrimp , italian seasoning , garlic salt , ground pepper
6. Sautee uncovered for approximately 8-10 minutes
7. Place pasta in serving bowl , spoon shrimp mixture over pasta , add grated parmesan over top and serve immediately

title: gluten free corn dogs
steps:
1. Pat hot dogs dry with a paper towel
2. Insert a wooden skewer into each hot dog
3. In a pie pan , combine the rice flour , tapioca starch , potato starch , corn flour , sugar , baking powder and dry mustard
4. In another bowl combine the egg , milk and 2 tbsp oil
5. Add to the dry ingredients and mix well
6. The batter will be thick
7. Roll the hot dogs in the extra rice flour and then coat in the batter
8. Deep fry and dry on paper towels

title: paula deen s green bean casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Bring the chicken broth to a boil in a saucepan
3. Boil the green beans in the broth for 10 minutes
4. Meanwhile , in a large skillet , melt the butter and saute the onions and mushrooms
5. Drain the green beans and add to the mushroom and onions mixture
6. Add the mushroom soup , onion rings , and seasonings to this mixture as well
7. Stir until well combined and pour into a greased 1 1 / 2 quart baking dish
8. Bake for 20 minutes , then top the casserole with the cheddar and bake for 10 minutes longer , or until the casserole is hot and cheese is melted

title: walnut basil pesto
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a blender or food processor
2. Start with just a little soy milk , and add until the pesto reaches the desired consistency

title: pie crust pizza pockets
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425
2. Unroll one of the pizza crusts onto a cutting board
3. Cut it in half
4. On one part of the crust put enough sauce to your liking and to cover most of the crust , leaving a ring around the sides uncovered
5. Add cheese to taste and toppings , but not so much that you cannot close the crust
6. Fold the crust in half and seal with a fork
7. Repeat with the other 3 halves of crust
8. Bake at 425 for 10-15 minutes or until the crust is flaky and done
9. Let cool a bit and serve

title: 15 bean soup  crock pot
steps:
1. Place beans in strainer and rinse
2. After rinsing , place beans in bowl and cover completely with water
3. After a couple of hours , rinse and refill water level
4. Soak overnight
5. Next day , rinse beans and place in crock pot
6. Combine all ingredients except sausage
7. Cover
8. Cook on low heat for 6 hours
9. Saute cubed sausage in pan
10. Put sausage and drippings , if any , in soup
11. Continue cooking on low for another 2 hours
12. Enjoy !

title: spiced cabbage with coconut
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a pan and fry the cumin seeds and red chillies for 30 seconds
2. Add the onion and fry for 3 minutes
3. Add the cabbage , carrot , and the coconut
4. Stir till the contents of the pan are heated through
5. Add the salt and lemon juice
6. Serve with any meat curry

title: korean pork tenderloin
steps:
1. Wrap bacon around tenderloins
2. Fasten with toothpicks
3. Place meat in a baking dish
4. Combine remaining ingredients
5. Pour over meat
6. Let stand in refrigerator for 4 to 5 hours , turning meat at least once while marinating
7. Roast in a preheated 300 degrees oven 1 1 / 2 hours or until meat thermometer reaches 170 degrees
8. Baste occasionally , turning meat once
9. Serve pan juices separately to spoon over meat

title: penne with ricotta
steps:
1. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil , add the penne and cook for 10 minutes or until tender but still firm to taste
2. In the meantime , finely slice the onion and cook in a small pot with some olive oil or butter
3. Heat a 1 / 2 cup of water , add in the vegetable bouillon
4. Once the onion is properly cooked , add everything else in , including the bouillon -- salt and pepper to taste
5. Stir the sauce frequently over low heat , should turn into a nice even mixture
6. Once the pasta is finished cooking , drain and add to the sauce
7. Stir a few times , turn off the heat , cover the pot , and let set for 5 to 10 minutes

title: simple hot roast beef sandwiches with mushroom au jus
steps:
1. In a large skillet , saute mushrooms in olive oil
2. While they are sauteeing , season with garlic , mccormick's , salt , and pepper
3. Add beef broth , worcestershire sauce , and onion
4. In a small bowl , mix 1 / 2 cup beef broth with cornstarch
5. Add to the mushroom mixture
6. Bring to a bowl , then reduce heat and let simmer about 5 minutes
7. Add roast beef to mushroom au jus and cover , simmering about 10 minutes
8. Meanwhile , cut your italian bread into 8 slices
9. If not already split go ahead and cut them , so you have 16 total slices of bread
10. Place bread on cookie sheet
11. On 8 of the slices place about 4 or 5 pieces of roast beef on each , then spread mushrooms evenly among each sandwich
12. Top each sandwich with a slice of swiss cheese
13. Place sandwiches in oven and broil just until cheese is melted and bread is a bit toasted , about 5 minutes
14. Serve sandwiches with a side of au jus to dip in !

title: lemon angel hair pasta with spinach and walnuts
steps:
1. 1
2. Cook pasta according to directions on box and strain
3. Keep warm
4. 2
5. While pasta is cooking , heat 2 tbs
6. Oil in large skillet over medium heat
7. Add garlic and saute 3 minutes
8. 3
9. Add spinach and cook until it wilts
10. 4
11. Season with salt and pepper
12. 5
13. Add the nuts and pasta to the skillet of garlic and spinach and toss
14. 6
15. Remove from heat and add cheese , lemon juice and remaining oil
16. 7
17. Serve and enjoy !

title: ranch picnic pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Prepare italian dressing mix according to directions
3. Mix ranch dressing with vinegar and oil
4. Drain pasta well and rinse with cold water , drain well again
5. Place all ingredients into large bowl and toss well
6. Refrigerate 12 hours
7. Toss before serving
8. Can use 1 / 2 of a green , yellow , and orange bell pepper to add more color
9. You can add other raw hard vegetables such as julienne carrots , blanched asparagus , sliced radish , anything you like

title: easy pineapple dessert
steps:
1. Preheat oven to broil
2. Place 4 pineapple rings on a baking sheet
3. Cover each slice with 1 tbsp of brown sugar
4. Broil until sugar is bubbly and carmelized
5. Top each slice with a scoop of sorbet
6. Variation:
7. You could use any fruit / sorbet combo that sounds good to you
8. For example: apples w / vanilla ice cream , orange slices w / passion fruit sorbet , pears w / raspberry sorbet

title: australian stuffed cucumbers
steps:
1. Skin the cucumbers , cut in half lengthwise
2. Scoop out the seeds
3. Sprinkle with salt and leave to drain
4. Beat the cream cheese , pecans , hot sauce and salt together
5. Dry the cucumbers and spoon the cheese mixture into the center of each half
6. Sprinkle with chopped parsley and refrigerate
7. When firm cut into slices to serve

title: awesome pistachio cake
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a 13" x 9" baking pan
3. In a mixing bowl , combine first five ingredients
4. Beat on medium speed for 2 minutes
5. Stir in walnuts
6. Pour into prepared baking dish
7. Bake for 45-50 minutes , or until cake tests done
8. Cool on wire rack
9. For the frosting: in a mixing bowl , beat milk and the pudding mix on low speed for 2 minutes
10. Fold in whipped topping
11. Spread over cooled cake
12. Sprinkle with pistachio nuts
13. Refrigerate for about 30 minutes before cutting
14. Refrigerate any leftovers

title: savoury olive bread
steps:
1. Preheat the oven at 180c / 350f
2. Brush a 20x10 cm loaf tin with olive oil and line with greased greaseproof paper
3. Beat the eggs until frothy and stir in the chopped olives , oil and milk
4. Sift the flour , sugar , baking powder and salt together and add the egg mixture , stirring lightly just until the flour is combined
5. Be careful not to over mix
6. Spoon into the prepared loaf tin and bake in the oven for 1 hour , or until hollow when tapped
7. Leave in the tin for a minute , then turn onto a wire rack to cool
8. Serve sliced with a salad , or make into sandwiches with slices of cheese between

title: cherry pie with canned cherries
steps:
1. Drain cherries , erserving 1 cup liquid
2. Mix sugar and conrstarch in small sauce pan
3. Gradually stir in reserved liquid until smooth
4. Heat over medium heat , stirring constantly until mixture bubbles
5. Cook one more miinute until thick and clear
6. Remove from heat
7. Stir in butter , cherries , almond extract and food coloring
8. Pour into prepared pie crust
9. Cover with vented or lattice top curst
10. Bake at 425 for 10 minutes
11. Reduce heat to 350 and bake 35 more minutes until golden brown

title: coffee bonbons
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy
2. Add vanilla
3. Combine coffee granules and flour
4. Stir into creamed mixture
5. Mix well
6. Cover and refrigerate until easy to handle
7. Roll into 3 / 4 inch balls
8. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheets
9. Bake at 350 degrees for 18-20 minutes or until set
10. Remove to wire racks
11. Meanwhile , for glaze , melt butter and chocolate together
12. Add melted mixture to the sugar along with the milk
13. Beat until smooth
14. Frost the cookies while still warm

title: low country boil savannah style
steps:
1. Boil up to a gallon of water in a stock pot
2. Add the first 5 ingredients to the water
3. Next add in your sausage and potatoes and boil until almost tender
4. Next add your corn on the cob and crab heat thru for 5 minutes
5. Lower your water to a simmer and add your shrimp and simmer until shrimp turn pink - don't over cook the shrimp
6. You're all done and if you so desire , you can add your pepper sauce
7. Goes great with cole slaw and crusty bread on the side
8. Hope you enjoy

title: crock pot venison
steps:
1. Layer ingredients in crock pot in order listed above
2. Cover and cook on low 10-12 hours , or on high 5-6 hours
3. I used to add 1 / 2 cup brown sugar , and a small can of tomato paste , but decided , over time , i really liked it better without those 2 ingredients
4. Serve with crusty bread and a robust red wine

title: bread bowl chili buns
steps:
1. In a large pot , saut the beef with onions , garlic , chili flakes , salt and pepper for about 10-15 minutes , or until the beef is browned
2. Drain any fat
3. Add in the crushed tomatoes , kidney beans , onion soup mix and chili powder
4. Mix well to combine and bring to a boil , stirring frequently
5. Reduce the heat , cover and simmer for 1 hour or up to 3 hours
6. Meanwhile from the top of the bun hollow out leaving about 1 / 2-inch bread all around , creating bowls
7. Spoon the chili into the buns , allowing them to overflow slightly
8. Top sour cream , onions , peppers and cheese , or as desired
9. Delicious !

title: appy wappy crab balls
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients
2. Mix well , cover and chill for 1 hour
3. Using about a rounded teaspoon for each , roll the mixture into 36 balls
4. Roll the balls in the crushed potato chips
5. Heat oven to 425f
6. Place balls on a baking sheet and bake for 10-12 minutes or until hot and golden serve with seafood cocktail sauce on the side or some other sauce of your choice

title: scrumptious beef brisket
steps:
1. Mix cola , chili sauce and onion soup
2. Place brisket fat side up in a dutch oven or 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish pour liquid mixture over brisket and cover tightly with lid or aluminum foil
3. Bake at 325 degrees for 30 minutes per pound , about 3 1 / 2 hours or until tender or u can cook the brisket 8-10 hours at 220 degrees
4. Trim off fat after cooking pour barbecue sauce over top and warm in oven
5. Makes 8 to 10 servings

title: fish florentine sorta
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Prepare a jelly roll pan by lining with foil and spraying with pam
3. Rinse and dry fish
4. Get as much of the water out of the fish as possible if it has been frozen
5. Place in the jelly roll pan
6. Combine the old bay and the lemon pepper
7. Sprinkle over fish
8. Slice the lemons and place the slices on the fish
9. Bake at 350f for appoximately 20 minutes or until fish flakes
10. In the meantime , slice the onion into thin rings
11. Heat butter and oil on med-high
12. Saute onions until carmelized , stirring frequently
13. Add garlic and saute quickly until golden
14. Very quickly add spinach and keep turning until just wilted and hot , mixing with onion
15. Divide among 4 serving plates and place fish on top

title: zucchini scallion fritters
steps:
1. Place zucchini in a colander set in sink , and toss with the 1 teaspoon coarse salt
2. Let drain 10 minutes
3. Press out as much liquid as possible
4. Whisk egg in large bowl
5. Mix in zucchini , scallions , flour and the pepper until combined
6. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat
7. Cook fritters in batches
8. Drop mounds of batter into skillet
9. Flatten slightly , cook , turning once , until browned , 4 to 6 minutes
10. Transfer to a paper-towel-lined plate
11. Sprinkle with salt to taste
12. Repeat with remaining batter , serve immediatly , with sour cream

title: triple batch beef  oamc
steps:
1. Trim fat from beef
2. Cut beef into 3 / 4" pieces
3. In dutch oven heat oil over medium heat until hot
4. Add beef , about a quarter at a time , and brown evenly , stirring occasionally
5. Remove beef from pan
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. In the same pan , add onions and garlic
8. Cook and stir until onions are lightly browned
9. Pour off drippings , and return beef to pan
10. Add water , bring to boil , then reduce heat to low
11. Cover tightly and simmer 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours or until beef is tender
12. Place about 2 cups beef mixture into 3 1-quart freezer containers
13. Cover tightly and freeze

title: eggplant  aubergine  parmigiana
steps:
1. Trim ends and peel skin from eggplant
2. Slice eggplant into 1 / 4" rounds
3. Sprinkle with salt and layer in colander
4. Place a plate with a weight on top and let drain 35-40 minutes
5. Pat slices dry with paper towels
6. Spread flour on a flat plate or sheet of wax paper
7. In a wide shallow bowl , beat eggs and water until well blended
8. On another plate or paper , combine bread crumbs with salt and pepper
9. Dredge eggplant slices in flour
10. Dip in beaten egg , then dredge in seasoned bread crumbs
11. Pat gently to help crumbs adhere
12. In a large frying pan , heat 1 / 2 c olive oil over medium heat
13. Add 3-4 slices of eggplant at a time and cook 3-4 minutes , or until golden brown on both sides
14. Remove eggplant to drain on paper towels while cooking remaining slices
15. Add remaining oil to pan as needed
16. Spread 1 / 2 c marinara sauce over bottom of 13x9" baking dish
17. Place a single layer of eggplant on sauce
18. Spread 1 / 2 c besciamella sauce over eggplant
19. Top with 1 cup marinara sauce , 1 / 4 c mozzarella , and 2 tbls parmesan cheese
20. Make 3 more layers , ending with the parmesan cheese
21. Bake 30 minutes at 350 , until bubbly and brown on top
22. Let stand 5 minutes before serving

title: spice rubbed roasted salmon with lemon garlic spinach
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. To prepare salmon , combine first 6 ingredients
3. Rub spice mixture evenly over fish
4. Place onion in an 11 x 7-inch baking dish coated with cooking spray
5. Place fish on top of onion
6. Bake at 400 for 20 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork or until desired degree of doneness
7. To prepare spinach , heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat
8. Add garlic to pan
9. Cook 1 minute
10. Add half of spinach
11. Cook for 1 minute , stirring frequently
12. Add remaining spinach
13. Cook 4 minutes or until wilted , stirring frequently
14. Sprinkle spinach mixture with rind and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt
15. Stir in juice
16. Remove from heat
17. Place salmon on a platter
18. Arrange onions and spinach evenly around salmon
19. Sprinkle salmon with chopped fresh cilantro
20. Serve with lemon wedges , if desired

title: chinese buffet style crab
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Break crab into smallish bite-size chunks into a bowl
3. Stir in mayonnaise to coat
4. Bake for about 10 to 15 minutes until bubbly , but not brown
5. Enjoy !

title: ranch cupcake meatloaf with hidden gems  rsc
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray 2 jumbo 6-cup muffin pans
3. Place carrots , mushrooms , onion and garlic in a food processor and process till very fine
4. In a large pan melt butter add the processed duxelle mixture and cook over medium heat 10 minutes , stirring when needed add the tomato paste and cook 5 more minutes
5. Toss in thyme and the frozen corn and set aside to cool
6. In a large bowl mix the meats , eggs , worcestershire sauce , hot sauce , and 1 / 2 of the ranch seasoning together add the duxelle with corn to the meat mixture and mix with clean hands
7. Divide the mixture in half and place in 9 of the muffin cups place in one ounce cheese in each half filled muffin
8. Top with the reminder of meat
9. Pressing down to smooth top
10. Bake in preheated oven 25 minutes when meat registers 155 degrees
11. Meanwhile mix the glaze ingredients together adding the other half of the seasoning
12. Set aside
13. Remove from oven
14. Set oven to broil
15. Brush all the glaze on the muffins
16. Broil till bubbly
17. Enjoy

title: peach party smoothie
steps:
1. Place all ingredients except for the ice in a blender
2. Cover blender and process until smooth
3. Gradually add the ice through the blender feed tube and blend until almost smooth
4. Each serving is equal to 1 cup

title: sweet and spicy grilled chicken
steps:
1. Place marinade in ziplock bag massage to mix together then add chicken
2. Chill for 1-4 hours
3. Grill over medium heat turning once halfway through grilling time
4. Depending on thickness grill for 8-12 minute

title: ceylonese biscuit pudding
steps:
1. Combine chocolate , rum , 1 / 4 cup water , and the vanilla in a heat-proof bowl
2. Set it over a pan of simmering water just until the chocolate melts
3. Cool completely to room temperature
4. Whisk butter until combined
5. Set aside
6. Place egg whites , the salt , and 1 tablespoon of the sugar in a bowl
7. Beat on high speed until firm but not dry
8. Place the egg yolks and the rest of the sugar in a bowl
9. Beat on high speed until pale yellow
10. With the mixer on low speed , add the chocolate mixture
11. Whisk 1 / 4 of the egg whites into the chocolate mixture
12. Then fold the rest in carefully with a rubber spatula
13. Fold the whipped cream into the chocolate mixture
14. Soak the biscuits in milk slightly
15. Layer a bottom of a square pan with them
16. Next layer with chocolate mixture
17. Sprinkle with cashew nuts
18. Follow with another layer of soaked biscuits and then the chocolate mixture and cashew nuts
19. Continue layering until all of the chocolate mixture is over
20. Make sure that the top layer is chocolate mixture and cashew nuts
21. Chill for at least 2 hours

title: ajvar  roasted red pepper spread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to broil
2. Halve each pepper , discarding stems and seeds
3. Place peppers , cut side down , on an old baking sheet or one lined with foil
4. Cut eggplant in half lengthwise and score with a knife , drizzle it with about 2 tablespoons olive oil and a little salt and place it on a second baking sheet
5. Place one of the oven racks roughly 3 to 4 inches below the heat
6. Place peppers on this rack
7. The eggplant should sit on a lower rack
8. Broil the peppers and eggplant , turning the peppers occasionally until they are well roasted on all sides , roughly 15 to 20 minutes
9. The eggplant may be done first
10. If so , remove it and set it aside to cool
11. To test eggplant for doneness press on it with a fork to make sure it's soft all the way through
12. I use an an outdoor grill to cook the peppers and eggplant , no oil
13. I make sure most of the skin on the peppers are blackened
14. When you remove the peppers from the oven , place them in a bowl , sprinkle them with a little water , and cover with a clean dishcloth
15. Leave it for about 10 minutes
16. This step steams and lifts the skins , making it easy to peel the peppers once they've cooled
17. While waiting for the red pepper skin to lift
18. Use a large spoon to remove the pulp of the eggplant , leaving the skin behind
19. Discard the thickest seeds , but don't get nit-picky
20. Put eggplant in a food processor or a blender with olive oil and smashed and chopped garlic cloves
21. Pulse the eggplant a few times so that it's chopped with the other ingredients but not totally pureed
22. Put this in a bowl and set aside
23. Once peppers are cool enough to handle , peel them with your fingers or a knife
24. Add peppers to the food processor or blender and pulse 5 to 8 times to chop coarsely
25. Add the eggplant mixture to the chopped peppers , season to taste with salt , pepper , vinegar and dried chili flakes , pulse 3 or 4 times to mix
26. If you wish , garnish it with more finely diced garlic and a few scattered basil leaves
27. Serve ajvar with toasted bread slices drizzled with olive oil and sprinkled with salt

title: easy 5 star chicken
steps:
1. Cut chicken breast in small pieces
2. Coat with corn starch and fry until done
3. I a small sauce pan add kethup , vinegar , brown sugar , soy sauce , water , sesame oil and red pepper flakes
4. Bring to boil when it starts to boil add 1 tbs of corn starch with water to thicken sauce
5. Salt and pepper to taste
6. After sauce is thick add chicken to it and heat chicken in it
7. Serve with white rice

title: hash brown bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Thaw potatoes between layers of paper towels to remove excess moisture
3. Press into bottom and up sides of an ungreased 9-inch pie plate
4. Drizzle with butter
5. Bake for 25 minutes until lightly browned
6. Cool on wire rack for 10 minutes
7. Combine ham , cheese and red and green peppers
8. Spoon into potato shell
9. Combine eggs , milk , salt and pepper , stirring well
10. Pour over ham mixture
11. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes or until set
12. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving

title: completely different tuna   egg salad  no mayo
steps:
1. Combine tuna , eggs , capers , pepper , onion and tarragon gently in a bowl
2. Whisk together vinegar , oil , salt and pepper in another small bowl
3. Fold the dressing into the tuna mixture
4. Taste for seasoning , and add more salt or pepper as needed
5. Chill for 1 hour for flavors to combine , then serve

title: weight watchers spiced chicken cacciatore
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large saucepan or stock pot over medium-high heat
2. Add onion , garlic , green pepper and mushrooms
3. Saut until vegetables are tender and mushrooms release juice , about 4 minutes
4. Add chicken and saut until golden brown on all sides , about 5 minutes
5. Add basil , curry powder , salt and black pepper
6. Stir to coat
7. Add tomatoes and bring mixture to a boil
8. Reduce heat to low , partially cover and simmer 15 minutes
9. Remove from heat and stir in parsley
10. Meanwhile , cook spaghetti according to package directions
11. Transfer spaghetti to four shallow bowls and spoon chicken mixture over top
12. Yields about 1 cup of chicken mixture and 1 cup of spaghetti per serving with a points value of 8

title: fantastic salmon loaf  salmon party log
steps:
1. Drain and flake salmon , removing skin and bones
2. Combine salmon with next six ingredients
3. Mix thoroughly
4. Chill several hours
5. Combine pecans and parsley
6. Shape salmon mix in 8x2 inch log
7. Roll in nut mix
8. Chill well
