9. Serve with crackers

title: momoo s norwegian thin egg pancakes
steps:
1. Break a dozen eggs into a blender jar and blend until just barely foamy
2. Gradually add the 2 cups of flour
3. Blend on high until the batter smooths out
4. You may have to add a bit more flour to accomplish this
5. Add the evaporated milk and blend on low until thoroughly mixed
6. Add the water sugar and vanilla: blend on low until well mixed
7. To cook the pancakes , melt a lump of butter or margarine on the bottom of a well-seasoned cast iron skillet over medium heat
8. You may have to turn the burner down if the pancakes start getting too dark
9. Ladle between 1 / 2 to 2 / 3 cup batter into the heated skillet
10. Quickly and carefully rotate it so that the batter evenly covers the bottom of the pan
11. The pancake is ready to flip when its surface becomes dull
12. I use a metal icing spatula to get underneath and flip it over
13. The second side needs just a few seconds to cook , then the pancake can be removed to a waiting plate
14. Proceed with the next pancake
15. The skillet will need to be rebuttered about every 5 pancakes or so
16. I keep the waiting pile of pancakes warm on a plate covered with a clean dishtowel
17. To serve , butter the pancake and sprinkle with granulated sugar
18. Roll up , cut into bite-sized sections and eat !
19. Once you get used to doing this , you develop a rhythm
20. I can cook an entire recipe's worth of these in about 15 minutes
21. Recipe yield can be variable depending on the size of the skillet used
22. These look a lot like crepes , and are cooked in essentially the same way , but are quite a bit more substantial on account of the number of eggs used in the recipe

title: linguini alla critzos
steps:
1. Bring pot of water to boil
2. Salt heavily
3. Add linguini
4. Cook to al dente , drain
5. Drizzle oil in large skillet , aprx
6. 4 rotations
7. Throw in onions and saute on medium for about 2 minutes
8. Add garlic , basil , salt to taste and 1-2 tsp butter and saute until onions are soft
9. You do not want to burn the garlic so watch temp accordingly
10. Add tomatoes and linguine , toss until heated then add mozzarella
11. Heat until cheese begins to soften

title: the best roast beef sandwich
steps:
1. Brush the rolls with a little olive oil and toast under a low broiler
2. Heat oven to 400 degrees f
3. Heat soup , water , worcestershire sauce and kitchen bouquet in a 2 quart saucepan over medium-high heat to a boil
4. Add beef and heat through , stirring occasionally
5. Divide beef among rolls , top with the onion , pepper rings and cheese , and place subs onto a baking sheet
6. Bake 3 minutes or until subs are toasted and cheese is melted
7. Spoon soup mixture onto subs
8. Chow !

title: peach and blueberry pound cake
steps:
1. Generously grease and sugar a 10-inch tube pan
2. Set aside
3. Beat butter and cream cheese at medium speed for about 2 minutes or until creamy
4. Gradually add the sugar and beat for 5 to 7 minutes
5. Add the eggs one at a time and beat until the yellow just disappears
6. Stir in the brandy
7. Combine the flour , baking powder , and salt
8. Add to the butter mixture beating at low speed just until blended
9. Gently fold in the peaches and the blueberries
10. Pour into pan bake for 325f for 1 hour and 25 minutes
11. Cool in the pan for 15 minutes remove and cool completely on wire rack

title: basil mint infused honey
steps:
1. Place honey and mint in a double boiler with water in bottom
2. Bring water to a boil , and bring honey to 185f and keep at 185f for 10 minutes
3. Remove from heat and let stand 10 minutes
4. Strain while still warm
5. Place in sterilized jars and cap
6. Label and decorate the jar as needed

title: janos  maple syrup gravy
steps:
1. Place the grease in a heavy skillet over medium high heat
2. It will sizzle and spatter as the water cooks off leaving only the grease , this will take about 3-4 minutes
3. Stirring constantly add the flour to the hot grease to form a roux
4. Cook the roux over the heat about 5-7 minutes stirring constantly being careful not to burn the flour
5. Slowly stir in the maple syrup and then the chicken stock stirring constantly , being certain not to add any more chicken stock until the previous addition of stock is fully incorporated
6. At the beginning the gravy will be very thick and pasty , but as all the chicken stock is added the consistency will become smooth and slightly thickened
7. Simmer over low heat for about five minutes after all the chicken stock has been added
8. Correct seasoning with salt and pepper

title: sunshine state sandwich
steps:
1. Grill the chicken
2. Slice the olives , tomatoes , and artichokes
3. Place the chicken breasts on the roll and layer all of the ingredients
4. Cut the sandwich and half and share with a friend , if you can resist eating it yourself !

title: root beer barbecue sauce
steps:
1. If you are adding in onion and garlic , then saute first in a couple tablespoons oil in a heavy saucepan for about 5 minutes until soft
2. Add in the remaining ingredients , except salt and pepper
3. Bring to a boil , stirring occasionally
4. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for about 25-30 minutes
5. Season with salt and pepper to taste
6. Cool to room temperature , cover then chill overnight or tightly covered for up to 2 weeks

title: cold sesame pak choi
steps:
1. Steam or boil pak choi to desired doneness
2. Drain choi in a colander and use a wooden spoon to push the choi against the sides of the colander and squeeze out as much water as possible
3. Once choi is as dry as possible , whisk together soy sauce , vinegar , sugar and green onions in a glass or ceramic bowl
4. Add choi and toss to coat
5. Allow to chill in the fridge for one hour
6. Just before serving , add the sesame oil and sesame seeds and toss to coat
7. Enjoy !

title: jungle gems snack mix
steps:
1. Mix and munch
2. Store unused portions in an airtight container

title: italian style chili
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat
2. Add in ground beef , italian sausage meat , onion , garlic , chili flakes and bell pepper
3. Cook until the meat is browned breaking up meat with a spoon while cooking
4. Drain fat
5. Add in spaghetti sauce , beef broth or water , tomatoes with juice , mushrooms , pepperoni , bouillon powder and chili powder and cumin
6. Bring to a simmer over medium heat
7. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 1 hour , stirring occasionally
8. After 1 hour of cooking season with salt and pepper and add in kidney beans , continue cooking for 30 minutes more
9. At the end of cooking stir in the cheddar cheese or you may sprinkle on top in place of the parmesan cheese
10. Ladle on top of cooked spaghetti , then sprinkle with parmesan cheese to taste

title: baked ham   noodle supper
steps:
1. Combine the butter , flour& mustard in a saucepan
2. Add milk gradually , stirring constantly
3. Cook until thick
4. Add the ham , salt , pepper& celery
5. Then stir in the noodles
6. Pour into a greased baking dish
7. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and dot with butter over the top
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 to 45 minutes

title: grilled basil salmon
steps:
1. Place salmon filet , skin side down , in pan ,
2. Mix the next 6 ingredients
3. Pour over fish
4. Sprinkle with parmesan and pepper
5. Put pan on grill , cover grill , and cook over med heat for 20 minutes

title: zucchini cream
steps:
1. Cut off stem and blossom ends of the zucchini and peel
2. If the zucchini are very large , cut in half lengthwise and remove the seeds
3. If small , leave whole
4. Boil in a small quantity of water until tender or you may microwave in a covered dish until tender , about 10 minutes
5. In either case , drain well , then mash or process to a smooth pulp
6. Cook in the top of a double boiler over hot water with sugar , butter , lemon juice and zest
7. Stir frequently , until thick and creamy , about 15 minutes
8. Ladle into hot sterilized jars , leaving 1 / 4 inch headspace
9. Wipe rims clean , put lids and rings in place and tighten down
10. Invert jars for a few minutes , then return to upright and cool completely
11. Check seals , label and store in cool , dry place
12. I processed my jars in a hot water bath for 5 minutes

title: tres leche cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f grease and flour a 13 x 9-inch baking dish
2. Combine butter and 1 cup sugar in a large bowl
3. Beat with a mixer at medium speed until fluffy
4. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla
5. Beat in eggs one at a time , mixing well
6. Combine flour , baking powder and cream of tartar
7. Add to butter mixture slowly and beat well
8. Spread batter in pan
9. Bake 25 to 30 minutes , until a wooden pick inserted in the center comes out clean
10. Set aside to cool
11. Stir together milk , evaporated milk and condensed milk
12. Pour 3 cups over cake
13. Reserve remaining milk mixture to serve with cake
14. Refrigerate cake
15. Combine heavy cream , remaining cup sugar , remaining teaspoon of vanilla and rum
16. Beat until thick and spread over cake
17. Refrigerate until ready to serve
18. Pour leftover milk mixture onto dessert plates
19. Slice chilled cake into squares and place on dessert plates
20. Garnish with fresh berries , if using

title: cinnamon streusel blueberry muffins  einstein bagels
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Grease a 12-cup muffin pan , or line with muffin liners
3. Combine flour , sugar , salt and baking powder
4. Place vegetable oil into a 2 cup measuring cup
5. Add the egg and enough milk to fill the cup
6. Mix this with flour mixture
7. Fold in blueberries
8. Fill muffin cups right to the top
9. To make crumb topping: mix together sugar , flour , butter , and cinnamon
10. Mix with fork , and sprinkle evenly over muffins before baking
11. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes

title: quick tuna and clam pappardelle
steps:
1. Heat a large pot of water to a boil
2. Combine onion and butter in a large skillet
3. Cook over medium-high heat until onion is softened , about 5 minutes
4. Add pappardelle to boiling water
5. Cook according to package directions , drain , place in a large serving bowl
6. Meanwhile , add parsley , dill weed , capers and pepper to the onion and butter in skillet
7. Cook 1 minute and stir in clam chowder and tuna
8. Cook , stirring occasionally , until hot throughtout , about 5 minutes
9. Season to taste , if necessary
10. Pour over pasta
11. Toss to coat and serve with lemon wedges

title: apple salsa
steps:
1. For chips , preheat the oven to 400 degrees
2. Spritz or brush a small amount of water onto the tortilla
3. Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar
4. Cut into 8 wedges
5. Place on baking sheet
6. Bake for 8-10 minutes or until lightly brown
7. Cool and store in air tight container
8. Coarsely chop the apples
9. Add the remaining ingredients
10. This can store in the fridge for several days

title: pork and cabbage stew
steps:
1. Place flour in medium bowl , add celery seed , then place pork in bowl and mix until meat is throughly covered with flour
2. Heat olive oil in skillet , add pork and sautee , shaking time to time until pork is lightly browned about 10 minutes
3. Add paprika and sliced onions
4. Toss a few more minutes , then add cabbage , tomato puree , vinegar and water
5. Season with salt
6. Simmer on low heat for about 1 1 / 2 hours or until meat is done
7. Add a dollop of sour cream on each -- and enjoy !

title: roast chicken for les paresseux
steps:
1. Center a rack in the oven
2. Preheat to 450
3. Rub the inside of a dutch oven or other large high-sided casserole with oil and place the bread in the
4. Center of the pot
5. Season the chicken inside and out with salt and pepper
6. Put half a sprig of each herb and half of the garlic inside the cavity
7. Put the chicken in the pot , resting it on the bread
8. Put the other garlic half in the pot , along with the remaining herbs , and pour in a few tablespoons of oil and the wine
9. Slide the pot into the oven
10. Roast chicken for 45 minutes
11. Toss the potatoes , carrots , and shallots with enough olive oil to give them a shine , season generously with salt and pepper and scatter them around the chicken
12. Roast the chicken undisturbed for about 45 minutes more , a total of about 90 minutes or until the skin is crackly and crisp and the juices run clear when you pierce the thickest part of the thigh with the top of a knife
13. Remove the chicken from the oven
14. Leave the chicken in the pot for 5-10 minutes to rest
15. Transfer chicken and vegetables to platter
16. Carve and serve

title: flynn s garlic  beer can chicken
steps:
1. Marinade the chicken in the garlic sauce for two or three hours
2. Place a 1 / 2 aluminum can of beer on a baking tray
3. Cover the beer can with the chicken
4. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 1 to 2 hours depending on weight

title: feta dill biscuits
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingredients in a bowl
2. Add butter and cut in until crumbly
3. Stir in cheese and then milk and water until dough forms a ball
4. Turn out onto counter and knead 6 - 8 times
5. Roll out to 3 / 4 inch thickness and cut out biscuits with a 2 inch cookie cutter
6. Place on ungreased baking sheet and bake at 425 degrees for 12 to 15 minutes , until tops are golden

title: bloody mary pot roast
steps:
1. Place 22 x 18-inch piece of aluminum foil in an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan
2. Place beef in pan , and add bloody mary mix and wine
3. Sprinkle with flour , pepper , and onion soup mix
4. Arrange vegetables around beef
5. Fold foil over and seal
6. Bake at 350f for 2 hours or until tender

title: apple cinnamon french toast
steps:
1. For the toast: mix all ingredients except bread
2. Spray a skillet with non-stick spray and heat to medium-high
3. Dip bread in batter to coat , and place in skillet
4. Cook until browned , flip , and cook the other side
5. For the sauce: melt butter and sugar in saucepan
6. Add water , cinnamon , and apples
7. Cook on low heat for 8 to 10 minutes , until tender
8. Serve on top of or on the side of the toast

title: banana oat breakfast smoothie
steps: 1. Put it all in the blender and blend until smooth

title: citrusy shrimp and thin spaghetti
steps:
1. Cook pasta until al dente , drain
2. Meanwhile , saute shrimp in butter until pink , about 4-5 minutes
3. Add all other ingredients
4. Simmer and stir until garlic and peas are cooked
5. Serve shrimp mixture over pasta

title: fantastic korean style marinade for beef pork or chicken
steps:
1. In a bowl whisk together all marinade ingredients together until the sugar granules are completely dissolved
2. Pour the marinade over the meat and turn to coat
3. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 8-24 hours
4. Remove the meat and shake off excess marinade
5. Place the meat in a pan and allow to come down to room temperature
6. Grill as desired

title: honey and whisky glazed sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Butter 2-quart casserole dish
3. In small saucepan over med-high heat , combine butter , honey , whisky , and sugar
4. Bring to simmer , whisking until butter and sugar are melted , reduce the heat to med-low and simmer , uncovered for 10 minutes
5. In large bowl , toss potatoes with butter mixture , salt , and pepper
6. Transfer to prepared dish and bake , tossing occasionally , until tender and glazed , about 45 minutes
7. Serve warm
8. Optional , add chopped nuts mixed throughout or sprinkle on top for last half of baking

title: chin jao ro su  bamboo and bell pepper stir fry
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingredients in a bowl
2. Stir fry in oil with the garlic and ginger until brown
3. Add bell peppers and bamboo shoots
4. Stir fry until done , about 5 minutes
5. Add sauce during the last minute or so of cooking time

title: pot of pizza
steps:
1. In a large skillet sprayed with cooking spray , brown meat , onion and green pepper
2. Stir in mushrooms , tomato sauce , italian seasoning , and splenda
3. Pour mixture into a slow cooker sprayed with pam
4. Spread noodles over meat mixture
5. Layer cheddar and mozzarella evenly over the top
6. Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours
7. Mix well before serving

title: mary s pineapple cake
steps:
1. Mix all the cake ingredients together with a spoon
2. Bake in a greased 9 x13 inch pan for 35 to 40 minutes at 350 degrees fahrenheit
3. While the cake bakes make the topping
4. Bring margarine , sugar and evaporated milk to a boil
5. Stirring occasionally
6. Boil for 5 minutes
7. Remove from heat
8. Stir in coconut and nuts
9. Pour this mixture over the cake as soon as it comes from the oven

title: shenandoah chicken
steps:
1. Heat a large skillet to medium high and add half of oil
2. Saute peppers and onions until tender crisp
3. I like mine to slightly caramelize on the edges
4. Remove and set aside
5. Add rest of oil to skillet and add chicken , sprinkle with creole seasoning
6. I season the chicken until it is slightly more spicy than i like it because the sweet and sour sauce along with the pepper / onion mixture greatly cuts the spice
7. But by all means , go conservative , you can always add more later
8. Brown the chicken until cook and no longer pink
9. Add the peppers and onions back in and then the sauce
10. Cook until sauce is heated through
11. Taste and add more creole seasoning if necessary

title: raspberry cream cheese pie
steps:
1. Combine graham cracker crumbs , sugar , melted butter , and cinnamon
2. Press into a 9-inch pie pan , set aside
3. Beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth
4. Whip cream and gently fold into cheese mixture
5. Soak gelatin in water 5 minutes in the top of a double boiler , over hot water
6. Stir gelatin mixture until completely dissolved
7. Stir gelatin into cream cheese mixture
8. Fold in raspberries
9. Pour into prepared crust
10. Chill for 2 to 3 hours
11. Before serving , decorate with whipped cream

title: hamburger hotdog bun french toast
steps:
1. In a shallow bowl , beat together all the ingredients except the buns with a fork until well blended
2. Dip both sides of buns in mixture
3. Spray a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray
4. Heat over medium heat
5. Place the buns in the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side , until browned
6. Serve warm with syrup

title: impossible quiche
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Lightly grease a 9-10 inch pie plate
3. Sprinkle mushrooms , cheese , and onion evenly over bottom of pie plate
4. Place remaining ingredients in blender , cover , and blend on high for 1 minute
5. Pour into pie plate
6. Bake until golden brown and knife inserted in center comes out clean
7. Let stand 5 minues before cutting
8. Refrigerate leftovers

title: sausage crumble
steps:
1. Pre heat the oven to 180c
2. Grill the sausages until brown all over and put in an oven proof dish
3. Heat the beans with the soup and pour over the sausages
4. Mix the breadcrumbs , crushed crisps , sunflower seeds and season
5. Sprinkle this mix on top of the the soup and sausages mixture and bake in the oven for 30 minutes
6. Serve with some nice bread or vegetables , if you kids will eat them

title: chocochai cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. In a large mixing bowl combine butter , egg , vanilla extract and brown sugar until creamed
3. In another bowl , combine flour , chai mix , soda , and salt
4. Gradually add flour mixture to the creamed mixture
5. Fold in the chocolate chunks and chips
6. Roll dough into 2-inch balls , placing them a few inches apart on baking sheets lined with parchment paper
7. Bake for 12-15 minutes until lightly browned
8. Remove from oven , cool momentarily and then transfer to wire racks to cool thoroughly

title: sumac lime crisps
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200 deg c
2. Place bread onto a baking tray , lightly spray with olive oil and sprinkle with other ingredients
3. Bake 8 minutes or until golden and then roughly break into pieces

title: hard rock  n roll chili
steps:
1. In 5 quart saucepan , stir together ground beef , onion , and minced garlic , and cook until meat is browned
2. In small bowl , combine tomato paste , worchestershire , barbeque sauce , chili powder , brown sugar , soy sauce , cumin , salt , minced onion , pepper , and celery salt
3. Drain fat from beef , then stir in seasoning mixture
4. Bring to simmer over medium high heat , and cook , stirring , 5 minutes
5. Add tomatoes , chili beans , green pepper , and celery
6. Reduce heat to low , and cook , covered 1 hour , stirring occasionally

title: raisin nut butter
steps:
1. In a medium-size bowl , whip 1 / 2 cup unsalted butter until fluffy
2. Combine the softened butter and other ingredients together until they are completely blended
3. The butter must first be brought to room temperature and softened by beating it
4. The flavoring ingredients must be very finely chopped or pureed
5. If any extra liquid develops , it should be drained off thoroughly before mixing in the butter
6. For the flavor to better penetrate the butter , allow it to stand at cool room temperature for a few hours before refrigerating
7. Compound butters may be stored in freezer , tightly wrapped
8. Use a sharp knife dipped in hot water for cutting the frozen butter
9. Before refrigerating , you can roll the butter into logs with wax paper
10. Press it into molds to create stars or other shapes
11. Create balls with butter paddles
12. Or simply press it into ramekins for serving

title: portabella pizzas
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Lightly grease a baking sheet
3. Remove stems from the portabellos
4. Arrange stem side up on the baking sheet
5. Divide and layer garlic , tomatoes , meat , cheese , and seasonings among the 12 caps in that order
6. Bake for 5 minutes
7. Place under broiler until cheese is bubbly and browned

title: curried chicken livers
steps:
1. In a small bowl , whisk together: flour , curry powder , tumeric , garlic powder and pepper
2. Roll chicken livers one by one in flour mixture and place on a plate
3. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat
4. Place chicken livers in a single layer in skillet
5. Sprinkle garlic salt over the chicken livers
6. Let cook about 5 minutes and flip livers over
7. Sprinkle them with more garlic salt
8. Let cook about 5 more minutes more and test for doneness
9. Some people like them pink in the middle
10. I like them well done and browned through
11. I usually flip them one more time and cook them until the coating is browned all over and no more blood seeps out
12. Some of the coating will crumble off or stick to the pan
13. I just scoop it up and serve it all together
14. Yum !

title: chocolate sponge cake  german style
steps:
1. Measure dry ingredients by spooning lightly into a cup and leveling off
2. Do not pack flour or it will be the wrong amount
3. Mix dry ingredients together in a bowl and set aside
4. Grease a 9 inch springform pan and line the bottom with wax paper , cut to fit
5. Flour the sides of the pan
6. Turn the oven on to 350f to preheat
7. Break 4 eggs into the bowl of a mixer , mix for 1 minute , medium speed
8. Turn to high speed and drizzle the hot water into the eggs while mixing
9. Add the sugar and vanilla and keep mixing on high for about 5 minutes , or until eggs are creamy yellow and very thick , like a sauce
10. Remove from mixing stand and switch to a hand spatula for the next step
11. Sift half of the dry ingredients over the egg mixture and fold in until almost gone
12. Repeat with the other half
13. Do not over mix but scrape the bottom of the bowl several times , to make sure you have incorporated all the dry ingredients
14. Pour batter into the springform pan and smooth top
15. Place in oven , on the second shelf from the bottom for 20 to 25 minutes
16. Remove from oven and cool completely before frosting

title: luscious lemon pie
steps:
1. In a saucepan , combine the sugar and cornstarch
2. Stir in milk until smooth
3. Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly
4. Reduce heat
5. Cook and stir 2 minutes more
6. Remove from the heat
7. Stir a small amount of hot filling into egg yolks
8. Return all to the pan
9. Bring to a gently boil
10. Cook and stir for 2 minutes
11. Remove from heat
12. Stir in butter and lemon peel
13. Gently stir in juice
14. Cool to room temperature
15. Fold in sour cream and whipped cream
16. Pour into pastry shell
17. Chill at least 1 hour before cutting

title: autumn stew
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , cook and stir meat until brown
2. Drain off fat
3. Cook and stir onions with meat until onions are tender , almost 5 minutes
4. Stir in all remaining ingredients
5. Heat to boiling
6. Reduce heat
7. Cover and simmer at least 40 minutes or till vegetables are tender

title: creamy ham spaghetti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Melt 2 t
3. Butter in skillet , add mushrooms , and saute until done
4. Remove to large bowl
5. Bring large pot of salted water to boil and cook spaghetti according to package directions
6. While spaghetti is cooking , melt remaining 6 t
7. Butter in skillet you used for the mushrooms
8. Add flour and stir to make a roux
9. Slowly add chicken broth , stirring to avoid lumps
10. Add milk , and stir to combine
11. Cook and stir until thickened , then add parmesan cheese
12. Add sauce to bowl of mushrooms along with cooked spaghetti and ham
13. Stir to combine well
14. Pour into 9x13 pan
15. Sprinkle with cheese and bake , uncovered , for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly

title: sweet and sour hot onion salsa
steps:
1. In a saucepan combine the onions , orange juice , water and sugar
2. Bring to a boil , reduce heat , cover and simmer for 10 minutes
3. Uncover and cook for 3 minutes or until most of the liquid is almost evaporated , stirring frequently
4. Place the onion mixture in a bowl and cool to room temperature
5. Stir in the plums and remaining ingredients
6. Cover and chill for a minumum of 3 hours before serving

title: bok choy and chicken
steps:
1. Wash bok choy very well
2. Slice across the leaf at about 1 / 2 inch intervals
3. Discard the bottom when you get to the part with no green on it
4. Drain thoroughly
5. Chop chicken breasts into 1 / 2 to 1 inch chunks
6. Heat oil in a wok or large , high-sided frying pan with a lid over medium heat
7. When oil is hot , add garlic
8. Saute for a few seconds , then add chicken
9. Saute until slightly browned all over
10. Add bok choy and stir-fry for about half a minute , until just wilted
11. Add soy sauce and sherry
12. Cover and cook until chicken is done
13. About 10 to 15 minutes
14. Serve over steamed white rice with soy sauce or teriyaki sauce

title: ham and chicken rolls
steps:
1. Place one chicken breast between plastic wrap or freezer bags and bash it until it is nice and thin -- repeat with the other breast
2. Mix the pepper , five spice and crushed garlic
3. Sprinkle the mixture over both breasts
4. Roll up one slice of ham and place it on the chicken breast
5. Roll the chicken up firmly and fold the ends under
6. Whisk the egg and milk together
7. Coat the chicken with flour shake off the excess
8. Dip in the egg mixture -- shake of the excess
9. This step will stop the chicken from separating from the spring roll wrapper
10. Place the chicken "roll" diagonally across the spring roll wrapper
11. Brush some of the egg mixture on the ends of the wrapper
12. Roll the chicken , tucking the ends in as you roll
13. Deep fry in oil until golden brown and cooked through
14. Don't have the oil too hot -- otherwise the spring roll wrappers will brown before the chicken is cooked
15. Drain on paper towels and then cut on the diagonal
16. Serve on a bed of lettuce with dipping sauces
17. Serve with your favourite sauce

title: very easy chicken with orange sauce
steps:
1. In skillet with shortening , brown chicken on all sides
2. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon salt
3. Add paprika
4. Arrange onion over top of chicken
5. Combine juice , brown sugar , parsley , soy , ginger and 1 / 4 cup of water
6. Pour over chicken and onion
7. Cover and simmer until chicken is tender , 35-50 minutes
8. Serve over hot rice

title: garlic shrimp pasta
steps:
1. Boil pasta in water till tender , save 1 cup of pasta water for use later
2. I always put some oil , salt , and fresh herbs in with my pasta when i boil it
3. Drain and set aside when done
4. While pasta is boiling , wash shrimp
5. Melt butter over medium heat
6. Add shrimp
7. Let cook till a little pink and starting to curl
8. Then add garlic
9. Cook 5-7 min
10. , add oil
11. Continue to stir till shrimp is pink and curled
12. Add pasta to skillet
13. Add seasonings
14. Add just enough saved pasta water till it is not dry but not swimming in liquid either
15. Depending on amount of pasta this requires 1 / 2 the cup or all of it
16. Start with adding 1 / 4 of it then work up from there
17. Keep tossing all ingredients around in skillet till all is incorporated and hot
18. Enjoy !

title: shaye s super easy and delicious chicken noodle soup
steps:
1. Make the bouquet garni
2. Bundle peppercorns , parsley , thyme and bay leaf in cheesecloth , and tie with kitchen twine
3. Heat butter in a stockpot over medium high heat
4. Add onion and leek
5. Cook until soft and translucent
6. Add broth and bouquet garni and bring to a bare simmer
7. Add chicken and poach uncovered until chicken is cooked through
8. Take cooked chicken out , and place it on a plate
9. When it is cool enough to handle , cut into small cubes or shred , then set aside
10. Meanwhile add carrots and celery
11. The vegetables will need to cook for about 18 minutes , so check the directions on your egg noodles , and let your veggies cook by themselves until you have just enough time on your timer for the noodles to cook
12. Return chicken to pot until heated through
13. Serve with crackers or crusty bread

title: birthday dinner meatloaf
steps:
1. In a bowl , beat the eggs and milk
2. Stir in the cheese , onion , oats and salt
3. Add the meat and bbq sauce and mix well with your hands
4. Shape into 6 equal size loaves and place in a greased 8 x 8 inch pan or glass dish
5. Sauce: combine all sauce ingredients and stir well
6. Spoon sauce over each loaf so it is well covered
7. Leave a little sauce for putting over the rice
8. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 45 minutes
9. Serve over rice -- enjoy !
10. I always double the sauce ingredients so i can have extra to pour over the rice after it is cooked

title: balsamic glazed broccoli
steps:
1. Steam broccoli until crisp tender
2. Place broccoli in a serving bowl
3. Keep warm
4. In a small saucepan , cook balsamic vinegar over medium heat until reduced by half
5. Stir in butter , brown sugar , salt and pepper
6. Pour over broccoli , tossing gently to coat

title: coconut lentils and rice  arroz con lentejas y coco
steps:
1. Heat oil in a skillet , then saut onion until it is softened and begins to color , 5 to 8 minutes
2. Add lentils and 1 cup of water
3. Cook , covered , about 30 minutes until lentils are tender
4. Stir in rice and salt , add coconut milk
5. Cover and simmer about 20 minutes until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed

title: old smoothie
steps:
1. 1 large box orange jello
2. 1 small box lemon jello
3. Prepare both boxes together following the package directions for amount of water , boiling and cold
4. Put into large bowl or container , and into the refrigerator to set
5. 1 can lemon pie filling
6. After jello is set , mix in a can of lemon pie filling
7. It takes a lot of mixing to get the "old smoothie" effect , so i put this into the kitchen aid and let it mix 7 to 10 minutes
8. It is almost liquid by the time i'm satisfied
9. Then back into the bowl or mold until set
10. Side
11. So i mix up a package of lemon jello pudding following the directions for pie filling
12. I cool this before mixing it into the other jello mixture

title: kali mirch murg  chicken curry with black pepper
steps:
1. Heat the sunflower oil in a wok
2. Add the bay leaf , cloves and peppercorns , and fry briefly , stirring in the ginger and garlic pastes
3. After 30 seconds , add the chicken and mix well
4. Add the turmeric , chilli powder and salt and allow the chicken to cook in its juices
5. Meanwhile , place the tomatoes in a serving dish
6. Season with a sprinkling of salt and lemon juice
7. Sprinkle with coriander leaves
8. Stir the yoghurt into the chicken , mixing well
9. Heat the chicken curry through , check the seasoning and serve with boiled rice and the tomato salad

title: easy chicken and stuffing casserole
steps:
1. Boil chicken and reserve 1 cup broth
2. Tear cooled chicken apart and set aside
3. Preheat oven to 350
4. Butter 9 x 13 casserole dish and put half of stuffing mix in the bottom of the dish
5. Combine broth , soups , margarine and chicken pieces
6. Mix well and pour into casserole dish
7. Top with remaining stuffing mix
8. Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes , until bubbly

title: russian garlic cheese spread
steps:
1. I put my carrots through the food processor , but you can use a hand grater also
2. Stir the carrots and cheese together
3. Add the pressed garlic
4. Add mayo until it is spreading consistancy , it's not a dip so you don't want it to get too soupy
5. I put it in strong ziplock bags , or tupperware over night then serve it on crackers , clubs are good or a whole grain type , or rye -- personally , i used the 10 cloves of garlic
6. I like it strong
7. But you can work your way up
8. I have no idea how long it will keep , we tend to inhale it in a few days

title: homemade turkey breakfast sausage
steps:
1. Lightly coat a 10-inch skillet with cooking oil spray and set aside
2. Place 3 or 4 paper towles on a plate and set aside
3. In a medium bowl , combine onion , apples , egg white , oats , parsley and spices
4. Add the ground turkey and mix well
5. Shape mixture in eight 2-inch wide patties
6. Preheat the skillet over medium heat
7. Place patties in skillet and cook over medium heat for 10-12 minutes , turning once , until sausage is browned and completely done
8. Transfer patties to paper-towel-lined plate to pat off excess grease
9. Transfer to plates and enjoy with your pancakes or eggs

title: apple butter pork chops
steps:
1. Place pork in a casserole dish
2. In a bowl mix applebutter and garlic
3. Spoon mixture on top of pork
4. Place in oven at 350 degrees
5. Cook for 20-35 minutes or until done
6. Serve with extra applebutter on the side

title: coffee frozen yogurt parfaits
steps:
1. Warm hot fudge topping either in microwave or in a double-boiler
2. Place 1 / 2 cup frozen yogurt in each of 4 parfait glasses
3. Layer with kahlua , dessert topping , hot fudge , sprinkling of pistachios , and flaked coconut
4. Serve and enjoy !

title: kittencal s low fat oven baked zucchini sticks
steps:
1. In a bowl combine bread crumbs , parmesan cheese , garlic powder , salt and pepper
2. Mix well
3. In another bowl , beat egg / s lightly
4. Dip zucchini sticks into eggs , then into breadcrumb mixture
5. Transfer to a greased baking sheet that has been coated with nonstick spray
6. Bake at 425 degrees f for about 20-25 minutes , or until lightly browned

title: angel hair with roasted vegetables and red wine tomato sauce
steps:
1. Mix veggies with marinade
2. Place with the foil wrapped garlic in a jelly roll pan at 400 for about 45 minutes , depending how small your veggies are cut
3. After veggies are cooked , mash garlic with fork and mix half in with the veggies and save half for the tomato sauce
4. Mix sauce ingredients in large saucepan
5. Add red wine after tomatoes have cooked down a bit
6. Simmer for about 30 minutes
7. Ladle sauce over hot noodles
8. Top with veggies and grated parmesan cheese

title: lemon fruit tart
steps:
1. Position rack in lower third of oven , preheat 375 degrees f
2. Roll pastry dough to fit 9-inch tart pan with removable bottom , press into pan and trim overhang
3. Bake in preheated oven for 10-12 minutes , or until surface of dough no longer looks raw or shiny
4. Remove from oven to a cooling rack while preparing filling
5. Place eggs in small bowl and whisk to combine
6. Pour in the sugar and whisk
7. Add lemon juice , whisk again
8. Add cooled melted butter and lemon zest , blend
9. Pour filling into partially baked pastry shell
10. Return to 375-degree oven , bake for 16-18 minutes longer , or until crust is golden and filling is set
11. Remove and cool on a rack for 10 minutes
12. Carefully release metal rim , and finish cooling to room temperature
13. Heat the apricot jam just until melted but not bubbly hot
14. Pour into a large bowl and toss gently with fresh fruit
15. Spread fruit over cooled tart
16. Best served the same day

title: texas goulash
steps:
1. In a 3 quart saucepan , heat 2 cups of water on medium heat
2. While the water is heating , in a deep cast iron skillet or other large pot , crumble the ground chuck
3. Stirring and breaking up the meat , cook over medium high heat until no longer pink
4. Remove the meat from the skillet and drain the fat
5. Set meat aside
6. Add 1 tablespoon of olive oil to skillet and heat over medium heat
7. To the oil , add onion , bell pepper , and celery
8. Cook and stir the vegetables until softened , then add the minced garlic cloves and continue cooking for 2-3 minutes
9. Add the meat to the vegetables , the two cups of hot water , and the rest of the ingredients , except the macaroni
10. Let sauce cook for 30-40 minutes , adding additional water , if needed
11. While the sauce simmers , refill the saucepan with water and cook macaroni according to package directions
12. Drain macaroni and add to meat / sauce mixture and stir
13. Serve with warm , crusty homemade or french bread

title: cheese rolls
steps:
1. Butter thin slices of white bread , cut off crusts
2. Spread with grated tasty cheese and sprinkle with a little pepper
3. Roll up as for asparagus rolls
4. Bake in oven until crisp

title: jello eggs in a basket
steps:
1. Your will also need: jello eggs--2 sets---follow instructions on box and use the free mold
2. Use various colors and flavors
3. Make jello eggs per instructions that come with the mold
4. Chill overnight
5. Mix coconut , in a ziploc , with 1 drop green food color
6. Shake to bits-- if not happy with grass green color , add 1 drop and shake till pleased with results !
7. Spread cool whip thickly over the edges of a plastic or glass bowl
8. Sprinkle green coconut over cool whip
9. Add chilled , jelled eggs at last minute before serving--kids love it !

title: three cheese spinach orzo bake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees
2. Lightly coat a 9-inch glass pie plate with nonstick spray oil
3. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over medium-high heat
4. Add the orzo and cook according to package directions
5. Drain and transfer to a medium bowl
6. Add 1 / 2 cup of the pasta sauce and the parmesan cheese
7. Spread the mixture in the prepared pie plate
8. In a medium bowl , add the spinach , eggs , ricotta cheese , nutmeg and salt and pepper to taste and stir to combine
9. Spoon the mixture evenly to cover all of the pasta
10. Top with the remaining 1 / 2 cup of the pasta sauce and sprinkle with mozzarella cheese
11. Bake for 30 minutes or until the cheese is slightly melted
12. Serve hot

title: chavrie chilled avacado and cucumber soup
steps:
1. Split the avocado in half , remove the pit and scoop pulp into a blender
2. Add cucumber pieces
3. Puree until smooth
4. Add coconut milk , lime juice , cumin , tabasco , ginger and chavrie , blend well
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Chill well before serving

title: goat cheese souffles in phyllo cups with frisee salad
steps:
1. Special equipment: a muffin pan with 12 muffin cups
2. Make cups: preheat oven to 375f
3. Cover stack of phyllo with 2 overlapping sheets of plastic wrap and a dampened kitchen towel
4. Put 1 phyllo sheet on a work surface and brush with some butter , then top with 2 more sheets of phyllo , brushing each with butter
5. Cut buttered stack into 6 squares with a sharp knife , trimming sides as needed
6. Line each of 6 muffin cups with a square
7. Make 6 more phyllo cups in same manner with remaining pastry sheets and butter
8. Bake cups in middle of oven until golden , about 8 minutes , then cool completely in pan on a rack
9. Make filling: increase oven temperature to 400f
10. While cups are cooling , melt butter in a 3-quart heavy saucepan over moderately low heat , then whisk in flour
11. Cook roux , whisking , 3 minutes
12. Add milk in a stream , whisking , and bringto a boil , whisking
13. Reduce heat and simmer , whisking occasionally , 5 minutes
14. Remove from heat and whisk in mustard , yolks , and 1 / 4 cup parmigiano-reggiano until combined , then fold in goat cheese
15. Beat egg whites in a large bowl with an electric mixer until they just hold stiff peaks
16. Fold one third of whites into sauce to lighten , then fold in remaining whites gently but thoroughly
17. Spoon batter into 8 phyllo cups and sprinkle with remaining parmigiano-reggiano
18. Bake in middle of oven until souffls are puffed and golden , about 15 minutes
19. Make salad while souffls bake: whisk together vinegar , mustard , and salt in a bowl , then add oil in a slow stream , whisking until emulsified
20. Just before souffls are ready , toss frise and radishes in a large bowl with just enough dressing to coat
21. Mound salad onto 8 plates and sprinkle with chives , then make a small nest in center of each
22. Place a souffl cup in each salad and serve immediately
23. Cooks'
24. Souffl filling can be made 1 day ahead and chilled , covered
25. Bring to room temperature and stir before proceeding
26. You can make the souffls 4 hours ahead
27. Put in a 375f oven for 8 minutes to reheat

title: five hour beef stew
steps:
1. Mix ingredients well in dutch oven and cover
2. Bake at 300 degrees for five hours
3. Do not peek

title: no bake chocolate fudge cake
steps:
1. Heat butter in a non-stick pan , add chocolate , coffee powder and brown sugar and let it melt
2. Grind digestive biscuits to a fine powder
3. Grease an aluminium cake tin
4. Switch off the heat and add ground powder along with almonds , walnuts and raisins and mix well
5. Pour the chocolate mixture into a cake tin and spread it evenly
6. Refrigerate for 1-1 hours
7. Remove the cake from cake tin , cut the cake in wedges , arrange on a serving plate and serve immediately

title: fresh spinach and roasted garlic custards
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f butter six 3 / 4-cup ramekins or custard cups and place in 13x9x2-inch metal baking pan
2. Fill large bowl with ice and water
3. Bring cream to simmer in medium saucepan
4. Remove cream from heat
5. Add spinach , salt , and white pepper and stir until spinach wilts , about 1 minute
6. Place saucepan over ice water
7. Stir to cool mixture quickly
8. Pour cooled spinach mixture into blender
9. Add eggs and roasted garlic
10. Blend until spinach is pureed and custard is smooth
11. Divide custard among prepared ramekins
12. Pour enough hot water into pan to come halfway up sides of ramekins
13. Bake custards until gently set in center , turning pan after 30 minutes , about 55 minutes total
14. Do ahead: can be made 1 day ahead
15. Cool custards in water
16. Remove from water , cover , and chill
17. Rewarm custards 2 at a time , uncovered , about 1 minute in microwave at 50 percent power
18. Cut around custards to loosen and turn out onto plates
19. Drizzle with extra-virgin olive oil and serve

title: pork and green chili stew
steps:
1. Potato soup base: heat oil in 2 quart saucepan , add all ingredients , cover and simmer for 5 minutes
2. Set aside
3. Pork dredge pork chunks in the flour mixture , heat vegetable oil in a sturdy dutch oven or soup pot , and cook the pork in batches till browned
4. Once you're done , place all the pork back in the pot
5. Add the soup base , and potatoes , chilies , chicken broth , and hominy
6. Bring to a boil , then simmer for 45 minutes to an hour
7. Creative additions-- for a richer flavor , add sour cream to the soup base
8. Use shredded cheddar or monterey jack for garnish
9. Serve with tortilla chips or saltines
10. I sometimes add frank's hot sauce to my bowl

title: spinach mushroom pasta
steps:
1. Boil 2 qts
2. Water in a large pot and cook pasta according to package directions
3. Drain and transfer to a large serving bowl
4. Heat olive oil in a large frying pan , add garlic and mushrooms , and cook until softened , about 5 minutes
5. Add cream cheese and milk and heat until boiling , stirring often
6. Add spinach and cook until wilted , about 3 minutes
7. Season to taste with salt and pepper , then pour over pasta
8. Sprinkle with chives and serve with parmesan on the side

title: roasted potatoes with rosemary  lemon and thyme
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , combine the lemon zest and oil
2. Set over medium-low heat and cook until the lemon zest bubbles steadily for about 30 seconds
3. Remove from the heat and let cool briefly , about 3 minutes
4. Stir in the herbs and let sit at least 20 minutes before using
5. Position a rack in the center of the oven and heat the oven to 475f line a heavy-duty rimmed baking sheet with parchment
6. In a medium bowl , toss the potatoes with the infused olive oil , the salt , and a few grinds of pepper
7. Turn the potatoes out onto the baking sheet and arrange the pieces so that they are evenly spaced and lying on a cut side
8. If the pieces cover the baking sheet sparsely , arrange them toward the edges of the baking sheet for the best browning
9. Pick out and discard the pieces of lemon zest
10. Roast the potatoes until browned on bottom , 10 to 15 minutes
11. Flip and continue to roast until tender , 5 minutes
12. Return the potatoes to the bowl in which you tossed them with the oil , or put them in a clean serving bowl
13. If they seem a bit dry , drizzle them with a little more olive oil
14. Season to taste with salt and pepper

title: teriyaki pineapple chicken
steps:
1. In skillet cook chunked chicken until almost done
2. Add carrot slices and pineapple
3. Cook until carrots reach desired tenderness
4. Add teriyaki sauce
5. Cook until sauce thickens
6. Serve over rice

title: grilled chicken marinated in cumin  lemon and garlic
steps:
1. In a skillet , toast peppercorns , cumin , coriander and cinnamon over medium heat , stirring , until fragrant , about 1 minute
2. Finely grind in small food processor
3. Add garlic and 2 teaspoons salt
4. Pulse until paste forms
5. Transfer to a large bowl
6. Add the onion , zest , juice , oil and parsley
7. Add chicken quarters
8. Turn to coat
9. Cover , refrigerate 8 hours or overnight
10. Prepare outdoor grill with medium hot coals
11. Remove chicken from bowl
12. Scrape off excess marinade
13. Sprinkle chicken with remaining salt
14. Grill , turning 20 to 25 minutes , or until cooked through

title: german style green kale  gruenkohl
steps:
1. Wash the kale in lukewarm warm very well several times to remove all grit and dirt- do not dry them off- leave them dripping wet
2. Remove the hard stems from the leaves and then place the kale into a pot , put the lid on , and let it cook over medium heat until it wilts- this won't be terribly long
3. Drain in colander and then dry the leaves completely
4. Coarsley chop the kale
5. Heat the bacon grease in a skillet , add onion and cook until brown , stirring often
6. Add the kale to the pan , along with salt and pepper to taste , a pinch of freshly grated nutmeg , and a pinch of sugar
7. Add the beef broth to the vegetables and stir to mix
8. Cover and let cook 45 minutes- it should get very , very tender and will be very , very soft
9. If you prefer , briefly cook some bratwurst in hot water according to the package directions , then add them to the pot in the last 15 minutes of cooking time
10. Check seasonings again before serving

title: saucy cranberry cake
steps:
1. For the cake:
2. Mix all ingredients together
3. Spread evenly in a greased 9x13 pan and bake at 350 f for 20-25 minutes
4. For the sauce:
5. Mix all sauce ingredients together
6. Stir over medium heat until it reaches a full boil
7. Boil for three minutes
8. Serve while it's warm !

title: southwest surprise bread
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , dissolve yeast in warm milk
2. Add the beans , sugar , butter , salt and 2 cups of flour
3. Beat until smooth
4. Stir in enough remaining flour to form a firm dough
5. Turn onto a lightly floured surface
6. Knead until smooth and elastic , about 6-8 minutes
7. Place in a bowl coated with cooking spray , turning once to coat the top
8. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled , about 1 hour
9. Punch dough down
10. Turn onto a lightly floured surface
11. Divide in half
12. Shape into loaves
13. Place in two 9 x 5 x 3 inch loaf pans coated with cooking spray
14. Cover and let rise until doubled , about 30 minutes
15. Bake at 350f for 40-45 minutes or until golden brown
16. Remove from pans to wire racks to cool

title: coonass filet mignon
steps:
1. Mix egg and mustard
2. Add ground chuck , breadcrumbs and onion
3. Add seasonings (generally , a layer of salt , black pepper and
4. Garlic powder is added to each side then a pinch or two of red pepper)
5. Weigh out 5 oz of the mixture and make into a meatball then flatten slightly
6. Wrap a slice of bacon or two around the meat and
7. Fasten with toothpick
8. Fry up in pan -- a few minutes on each side
9. Serve up

title: pretty green butter mints
steps:
1. Beat butter until creamy
2. Beat in sugar until blended completely
3. Add the cream , extract , and a few drops of food coloring- just enough to tint the mixture a pale pastel green
4. Beat until well combined
5. Do not chill !
6. Put directly into a cookie press fitted with a star
7. Press star shapes onto waxed paper and let stand 30 minutes
8. Press a red hot candy into the center of each star and let harden completely
9. Store in an airtight container in a cool place

title: clone of a cinnabon
steps:
1. Place ingredients in the pan of the bread machine in the order recommended by the manufacturer
2. Select dough cycle
3. Press start
4. After the dough has doubled in size turn it out onto a lightly floured surface , cover and let rest for 10 minutes
5. In a small bowl , combine brown sugar and cinnamon
6. Roll dough into a 16x21 inch rectangle
7. Spread dough with 1 / 3 cup butter and sprinkle evenly with sugar / cinnamon mixture
8. Roll up dough and cut into 12 rolls
9. Place rolls in a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking pan
10. Cover and let rise until nearly doubled , about 30 minutes
11. Meanwhile , preheat oven to 400f
12. Bake rolls in preheated oven until golden brown , about 15 minutes
13. While rolls are baking , beat together cream cheese , 1 / 4 cup butter , confectioners' sugar , vanilla extract and salt
14. Spread frosting on warm rolls before serving

title: chicken curry sauce for pasta
steps:
1. In skillet , heat oil over medium-high heat
2. Saute garlic and onion for 2 minutes or until softened
3. Add curry powder , paprika and ginger
4. Cook stirring , for one minute
5. Add chicken
6. Saute for 3 minutes or until lightly browned
7. Stir in 1 / 4 cup chicken stock
8. Cook for one minute or until liquid has evaporated
9. Add remaining stock& tomato paste and bring to a boil
10. Reduce heat and sprinkle with raisins
11. Simmer for 5 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink inside
12. Remove from heat
13. Stir in yogurt , salt and pepper
14. Top with nuts and parsley
15. Serve over penne or spagetti

title: stuffed cabbage soup
steps:
1. Saute onion and ground beef in a large soup pot until meat is browned
2. Do not drain
3. Add sugar and cabbage and mix well
4. Add next 4 ingredients and bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat and simmer 1 - 1 1 / 2 hours
6. Add rice and simmer 10 more minutes
7. Season to taste with salt and pepper

title: maw maw s oatmeal cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Pour boiling water over quick oats and let stand for about 15-20 minutes , while you begin mixing up the cake
3. In a mixing bowl , combine sugar , brown sugar , shortening , and eggs , mixing well
4. Sift together flour , baking soda , cinnamon , and salt
5. Add to sugar mixture
6. Add oatmeal and mix well
7. Pour batter into a 9x13-inch greased cake pan
8. Bake for about 30 minutes , or until cake tests done
9. For topping , combine all topping ingredients
10. Prick holes in the top of the cake with a toothpick or ice pick
11. Spread icing over the top of warm cake
12. Place cake under the broiler for just a minute or two until topping starts to brown

title: grilled banana s mores
steps:
1. Spray cold rack with cooking spray
2. Grill bananas , uncovered , 2-4 minutes on each side or until golden
3. Slice into thin pieces
4. Top one graham cracker half with marshmallows and chocolate pieces
5. Add sliced bananas and top with another graham cracker half
6. Repeat with the rest of the crackers and serve right away
7. Enjoy !

title: sweet and sour mango chicken  s c j
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat the vegetable oil until hot
2. Add onion and saut for 1 minute
3. Add the mushrooms , carrots , scallions , celery , and bell pepper
4. Saut for 3 minutes
5. Add the chicken and salt , cook for 6-8 minutes until the chicken is done , no pink juices
6. Add the mango , water chestnuts and sweet and sour sauce
7. Continue to cook for 1 minute until hot
8. Serve over rice
9. If you would like this dish juicier so it soaks into the rice , use more than 1 / 2 cup of the sweet and sour sauce
10. Or , make extra sauce and serve it as a dip for fresh vegetables or chicken fingers

title: roasted chickpeas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Lightly coat a rimmed cookie sheet with the pam
3. Spread chickpeas on baking sheet
4. Mix the seasonings and sprinkle it on the chickpeas , toss to coat
5. Roast on the bottom rack of the oven , shaking pan every 15 minutes or so , until brown and crunchy , about 45 to 50 minutes
6. Store in a tight lidded container

title: fiesta brunch bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Place prepared vegetables on a baking tray in a single layer , and drizzle the olive oil on top
3. Lift and coat the vegetables with the oil
4. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste
5. Roast the vegetables for 25 minutes , or until lightly charred on the edges
6. Cool slightly
7. Reduce oven temperature to 350f after removing the roasted vegetables
8. Meanwhile , coat the bottom and sides of an 11x7 baking pan with oil , and arrange the tortillas on the bottom of the pan
9. Set aside
10. Mix the eggs and cream and whisk until incorporated
11. Add the cheese and stir
12. Set aside
13. Using a spoon , or tongs , gently lift the roasted tomatoes and place evenly on the tortillas in the baking pan
14. Stir the remaining vegetables , breaking the onions apart and mixing them with the other vegetables
15. Spoon evenly onto the tortillas with the tomatoes
16. Pour the egg and cheese mixture over the vegetables and spread to cover , allowing some of the colorful vegetables to peek out the top
17. Bake at 350f for about 25 minutes , or until the custard is set
18. Cool and slice into 6 portions , garnishing each with cilantro , avocado slices , and / or fresh salsa

title: rolls
steps:
1. Add all ingredients into bread maker
2. Set bread machine to "dough" method
3. When cycle is done , break dough into 12 balls
4. Smooth and place on baking sheet
5. Let rise to desired size , 15-30 minutes
6. Bake in preheated 350 oven for 15-18 minutes
7. Remove rolls from oven
8. Butter tops of rolls while still warm

title: grilled lemon sole with lemongrass butter
steps:
1. First make the lemongrass butter: put everything into a food processor and season well with black pepper
2. Blend until smooth , then spoon the mixture into the centre of a large sheet of clingfilm , shape into a roll 4cm / 1in thick , wrap and chill in the fridge or freezer until firm
3. When the butter is firm , preheat the grill to high
4. Trim the fins and tails of the fish with kitchen scissors
5. Brush the fish on both sided with the melted butter and season with a little salt and pepper
6. Depending on the size of your grill , cook them 1 or 2 at time , dark side up , on a buttered baking tray or the rack of a grill pan for 4-5 minutes
7. Keep warm while you cook the rest
8. Unwrap the lemongrass butter and slice into thin rounds and serve on top of the fish

title: crock pot pasta with lentils and chard
steps:
1. Rinse and drain chard well
2. Trim off coarse stem ends
3. Then cut stems crosswise into 1 / 4-inch-wide strips and set aside
4. Cover chard leaves and refrigerate
5. In a 3-quart or larger electric cooker , combine chard stems , lentils , onion , garlic , cumin seeds , red pepper flakes , and black pepper
6. Pour in water
7. Cover and cook at low setting until lentils are tender when mashed with a fork
8. Cut chard leaves crosswise into 1 / 2-inch-wide strips
9. Stir into cooker
10. Increase heat setting to high
11. Cover and cook until chard is wilted and bright green
12. Meanwhile , in a 5 to 6-quart pan , cook linguine in 3 quarts boiling water just until tender to bite
13. Or cook according to package directions
14. Drain well , pour into a warm wide 4-quart bowl
15. Season lentil sauce to taste with salt
16. Add lentil sauce and neufchatel cheese to linquine , mix lightly to coat well
17. Offer parmesan cheese to add taste , if desired

title: spaghetti with coconut spinach
steps:
1. Prepare pasta according to package directions
2. Meanwhile heat oil in a large skillet
3. Add garlic , ginger , chili pepper , cinnamon and curry powder
4. Sautee for a minute or two
5. Add coconut milk and bring to a boil
6. Season with salt to taste
7. Add spinach , reduce heat to low and allow spinach to wilt
8. Remove from heat
9. Drain pasta , return to the pot and add the sauce
10. Spoon into bowls and top each serving with 1 / 2 tbs of desiccated coconut

title: red sweet pepper and artichoke pat
steps:
1. Make this a day ahead as the flavour needs to develop
2. Combine first 7 ingredients in a processor
3. Add the vinaigrette , and pulse -- on-off -- to process until roughly mixed
4. Add just enough olive oil in a thin stream , while processing further , until pat has a rough texture
5. You may need less than 1 / 4 cup: it will depend on the other ingredients
6. Do not process too much
7. Taste: you might want to add salt or seasoning salt
8. Turn into a bowl , cover with clingfilm , and keep in fridge overnight
9. Serve with cheeses and breads as suggested

title: fried yucca  cassava root  with green sauce
steps:
1. Start making making the green sauce
2. Combine lettuce , mayonnaise , lime juice , cilantro , peppers , garlic , and salt in a blender
3. Blend until smooth
4. Put into a serving dish
5. Next , we fry the yucca
6. Peel the yucca with a knife and throw away the hard skin
7. Cut the flesh into 1 / 2 inch thin strips about 4 inches long
8. Heat a large iron skillet or nonstick frying pan to medium high heat with about half your oil
9. I like grape seed oil because it gives a nice crispness to the yucca and it's healthy
10. Reserve the remaining oil for the 2nd half of your yucca
11. Organize the yucca in the frying pan into a single layer
12. Fry half the yucca until light golden brown and then flip it over to fry on the other side
13. Remove when it's golden brown on both sides and place onto a paper towel to drain
14. Cook the 2nd batch the same way
15. Serve the yucca on a plate , and give each person a small bowl or cup of the green sauce for them to dip their yucca into

title: blackened chicken breasts
steps:
1. Mix the seven spices
2. Save for future use
3. Sprinkle over chicken to cover both sides
4. Heat oil in cast iron skillet for 15 minutes
5. I do this on low heat and turn up last few minutes
6. Place chicken in hot pan and cook till dark in color , about 4 minutes per side , till juices are clear

title: everything potatoes
steps:
1. Boil potatoes until fork tender
2. Drain and place into an 8 x 8 shallow baking pan
3. Mix garlic , onion , heavy cream , cream cheese , and butter in a large bowl and spread evenly over potatoes
4. Top with pepper , paprika , and cheese
5. Bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for 25 minutes
6. Serve hot and enjoy !

title: hazelnut meringues
steps:
1. Beat the egg whites until stiff , add caster sugar and beat the mixture until glossy
2. Add brown sugar and beat again for 1 minute then fold in ground hazelnuts
3. Spoon on to a lightly oiled baking sheet and bake in a cool over for just over an hour until they are crisp

title: asian style chicken breasts and bacon
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , mix the stock and 5-spice powder and simmer over low heat for 3 minutes
2. Set aside
3. In a large skillet , heat 1 tablespoon of the peanut oil
4. Add the bacon and cook over low heat until most of the fat is rendered and the bacon is browned
5. Add the garlic
6. Saute for 2 minutes
7. Add the chicken
8. Season with salt and pepper
9. Cook over medium heat until the chicken is brown and just cooked through
10. Remove from skillet
11. Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon peanut oil in skillet
12. Add mushrooms and saute over medium heat until all of their liquid has evaporated and they start to brown
13. Remove mushrooms to plate
14. Add wine to skillet and simmer over medium-high heat until it is reduced by half
15. Add the soy sauce , spiced stock , bacon , garlic , chicken and mushrooms
16. Cook , stirring , until heated through
17. Add scallions
18. Serve

title: vegetable and cheddar soup
steps:
1. Add potato , zucchini , carrot , celery , and scallions to slow cooker ,
2. Add stock and season with salt and pepper
3. Cook on high 3-4 hours
4. Just before serving , add creamed corn , cheese and parsley
5. Serve when cheese has just melted

title: grandma brenda s sour cream coffee cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease and lightly flour 10 inch bundt pan
3. In large bowl cream sugar and butter , add vanilla and eggs
4. Mix well
5. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup , level off
6. Combine flour , baking powder , soda and salt
7. Add flour mixture alternately with sour cream , beginning and ending with flour mixture
8. In small bowl combine remaining ingredients , mix well
9. Spread half of batter in prepared pan
10. Sprinkle with half of brown sugar mixture
11. Repeat with remaining batter and sugar mixture
12. Bake at 350 degrees for 35-40 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
13. Bon appetit !

title: mandarin chicken salad with orange juice dressing
steps:
1. Mix the first 6 ingredients together
2. Chill
3. Mix the dressing ingredients together and chill
4. Serve on lettuce leaves
5. Decorate with fruit around the edges
6. Spoon salad dressing over the salad mixture when served

title: hcg phase 3 turkey meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Combine all ingredients except the ground turkey in a large mixing bowl
3. Mix well
4. Add in gound turkey , and using your hands , incorporate the mixture into the turkey without over-working it
5. Evenly divide the meatloaf into a muffin tin with 12 servings
6. Place the muffin tin on a larger baking sheet to protect oven from possible juices overrunning
7. Bake in oven at 375 , 20-30 minutes
8. Meatloaf is done when juices run clear and internal temo is 170

title: tuna salad pitas
steps:
1. Combine tuna , mayonnaise , celery and onion
2. Butter pitas- this acts as a seal so the pita doesn't get soggy , and it tastes good too
3. Fill pitas with tuna salad , sprouts , tomato and cucumber slices
4. Sprinkle generously with minced parsley
5. Wrap and enjoy

title: pesto omelet in a pita pocket
steps:
1. Scramble the egg , and cook in med-hi skillet , flipping once midway through
2. Leaving it in a single piece , "omelet style" makes assembly and eating easier and neater
3. While the egg is cooking , wrap pita in a slightly damp dishtowel , and microwave for 20-40 seconds , until warm and pliable
4. You can leave the pita wrapped in the towel until ready to use it
5. Cut / tear the pita to make a flap of half the diameter of the pita
6. Fold the flap back
7. Fold the egg in half
8. Melt the cheese on the egg , or make a cheese omelet if you wish
9. Slide the egg / cheese into the warm , waiting pita , stuffing it gently into the pouch of the bread ,
10. Spread the pesto onto the inside of the "flap"
11. Fold pita closed , and roll , if desired

title: chicken with balsamic succotash
steps:
1. Mix together 1 tablespoon chili powder , salt and pepper
2. Sprinkle on the chicken pieces
3. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat
4. Add chicken pieces and cook 7-8 minutes per side until browned and juices run clear
5. Remove from skillet and tent loosely with foil
6. In the same skillet , add remaining olive oil and onions
7. Saute for 3 minutes then add red peppers and garlic
8. Continue cooking until onion is tender
9. About 5 minutes
10. Add corn , lima beans , remaining 1 teaspoon chili powder and the vinegar
11. Cook for 5 minutes
12. Add broth and parsley
13. Heat through
14. To serve , place a bed of succotash on a plate and top with whole or sliced chicken breasts

title: frozen fruit pops
steps:
1. Several hours or day bdfore serving prepare fruit purees: place bananas , kiwifruit , and fresh strawberries in freezer until partially frozen and firm
2. Pour orqnge juice into glass dish or pie plate
3. Freeze until almost solid
4. In food processor with chopping blade or blender , combine 2 banana halves , 1 tbls
5. Corn syrup , and the orange juice
6. Process until mixture is smooth and pureed
7. Divide between two 3-ounce metal timbale molds , two 5-ounce paper cups , or any 3-ounce popsicle molds
8. Puree kiwifruit with 1 banana half and 1 tbls
9. Corn syrup
10. Divide mixture between 2 molds or cups
11. Puree strawberries with remaining banana and corn syrup
12. Divide between 2 molds or cups
13. Place all fruit-filled molds in freezer
14. After 45 minutes , insert popsicle sticks in center of pops
15. Freeze pops several hours or overnight until completely frozen
16. To serve , remove pops from molds by quickly dipping molds into hot water
17. Then , holding stick , pull pop out of mold
18. If using paper cups , paper can be peeled off
19. Enjoy !

title: low carb high fiber high protein muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 and spray 12 cup muffin tin with non-stick spray
2. Combine all dry ingredients in a large bowl , stir and make a well in the middle
3. In a different bowl combine all wet ingredients
4. Pour wet ingredients into well in dry ingredients
5. Stir to combine , but don't over mix
6. Batter will be lumpy
7. Divide equally into muffin tins
8. Bake for 20 minutes
9. Remove from oven and let stand 5 minutes then remove muffins and place on cooling rack

title: riley s thumbprint cookies
steps:
1. Cream together softened butter and sugar
2. Add in dry ingredients
3. Shape into small balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet
4. Press dent into each cookie with thumb
5. Bake at 375 degrees for 7 minutes
6. Fill center with icing made from powdered sugar and milk
7. Use food coloring in icing as desired
8. Do not substitute margarine for butter , the texture will not be the same

title: hot tuna sandwiches
steps:
1. Combine first 8 ingredients and spread on top of each bottom bun half
2. Put on tops and wrap in waxed paper
3. Microwave on high for 25-40 seconds or until cheese melts

title: syrian feta spread
steps:
1. Process feta until it is crumbly
2. Add garlic , dill , parsley , scallions , lemon juice and process until almost smooth
3. By hand , blend in the ricotta and butter
4. Mix well
5. Can be served at room temperature or chilled

title: west s mango bramble
steps:
1. Pour mango liqueur into the bottom of an old fashioned glass
2. Carefully fill the glass with crushed ice
3. In a cocktail shaker filled with ice , add the vodka and lemon juice , shaking until very cold
4. Strain the vodka and lemon over the crushed ice and top with a splash of soda
5. Garnish with a wheel of kiwi
6. Cheers !

title: italian bean soup
steps:
1. In large pot , brown sausage , onion and garlic
2. Add tomatos , beans , beef broth and water
3. Cook until hot

title: maple pork and peach skewers
steps:
1. If using bamboo skewers , soak them in one cup of chardonnay for 30 minutes prior to use
2. Rub pork all over with garlic-pepper seasoning
3. Cut chops into bite-size pieces and place in a glass utility dish
4. Blend maple syrup and chardonnay
5. Pour over pork and let marinate for 15 minutes
6. Drain marinade into a small saucepan and bring to a boil
7. Cook one minute
8. Alternate pork with pieces of peach and onions on skewers
9. Grill over moderate for about 10 minutes , turning occasionally and brushing with marinade
10. Serve over couscous , garnished with fresh herbs , if desired

title: summer veggie burritos
steps:
1. Heat oil over medium in the largest skillet you own
2. Add squash , zucchini , and onion
3. Cook , stirring occasionally , til tender
4. Add frozen corn
5. Cook til corn is tender
6. Add black beans
7. Cook til heated through
8. Warm tortillas
9. Spread some sour cream onto a tortilla
10. Spoon some veggies onto sour cream
11. Top veggies with salsa
12. Fold and enjoy
13. I drain the veggies before i put away any leftovers
14. The last time i made these i served them to my toddlers as quesadillas with some monterey jack
15. It was easier for them to hold that way , and my husband decided he loved the quesadilla version , too
16. :)

title: greek feta cheese spread  htipiti
steps:
1. In food processor , combine cheese , oil , lemon juice , garlic , green onions , tomatoes and red peppers
2. Blend well to form a nice smooth paste
3. If too thick , thin with a little more oil
4. Serve with pita bread , crackers or crusty bread

title: domino brownies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Spray a 13x9 baking pan with nonstick cooking spray
3. In a large bowl beat sugar and butter together with an electric mixer
4. Stir in melted chocolate
5. Beat in eggs until well combined , then mix in flour and salt
6. Add vanilla
7. Scrape batter into prepared pan
8. Bake until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean , about 25 minutes
9. Cut into rectangles measuring about 3 in long by 1 1 / 2 wide
10. Place on wire rack to cool
11. Add frosting lines
12. Top with white chocolate chips to resemble domino patterns

title: the best and easiest banana nut bread
steps:
1. Place sugar , crisco , eggs and bananas into mixing bowl
2. Beat until smooth
3. Add flour , salt , baking soda
4. Beat until smooth and blended
5. Pour into 2 large or 3 small loaf pans that have been greased and floured
6. Bake at 325 for 65-70 minutes for 2 loaf pans , 55-60 minutes for 3

title: lavender angel food cake with fresh strawberries
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. On a piece of wax paper , sift the powdered sugar and flour together 3 times
3. Stir in the lavender buds
4. In a large , chilled bowl on medium speed , beat the egg whites , cream of tartar and vanilla extract
5. Beat until soft peaks form
6. Gradually add the sugar and beat until stiff peaks form
7. Sift 1 / 4 of the flour / sugar mixture over the beaten eggs
8. Fold in {{gently}}
9. Repeat , adding another 1 / 4 of the flour / sugar mixture at a time
10. Fold in gently each time
11. Transfer the cake batter to an ungreased 10" tube pan
12. Bake on the lowest rack in the preheated oven for 40-45 minutes , or until the cake springs back when lightly touched
13. Once the cake is done baking , invert but leave in pan
14. Cool thoroughly
15. Loosen sides of cake from the pan and remove to a cake platter
16. Top with your favorite fresh berries and add a dollop of whipping cream to each serving

title: kitchen kouture carnitas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees
2. Place roast on heavy duty foil inside a roasting pan
3. Cut slits into top of the meat so seasoning can slip into the meat
4. In a bowl combine all ingredients and spread on top of the roast
5. Seal foil securely and place roasting pan in the oven
6. Cook for 3
7. 5-4 hours
8. Use 2 forks and shred roast while still warm
9. In a skillet warm up a small amount of oil and crisp meat up for a few minutes
10. Serve with corn tortillas , guacamole , salsa & grilled onions

title: fruity grilled cheese sandwich
steps:
1. Spread apricot spread on top of one slice of bread , top with cheese and the second slice of bread
2. Apply light coat of cooking spray to the exterior of bread slices
3. Place on indoor grill or panini press for 2-3 minutes until bread is crispy and cheese is melted
4. Serve

title: zesty zucchini relish
steps:
1. Place the brine soak ingredients in a glass or stainless steel container
2. Sprinkle with canning salt and cover with cold water
3. Let stand for 1 hour or refrigerate overnight , rinse well and drain
4. Squeeze out excess water
5. You`ll have 4 cups of well packed veggies
6. In a large heavy bottom pot prepare vinegar solution by adding all it`s ingredients bring to a boil then add the drained vegetables and simmer for 10 minute add food coloring if desired
7. Fill jars , leaving 1 / 4-inch head-space
8. Process pints for 10 minute in boiling-water canner

title: william sonoma warm pear cake with walnut caramel topping
steps:
1. Position a rack in the middle of an oven and preheat to 350 degrees
2. Spread the walnuts on a baking sheet and place in the oven until lightly toasted and fragrant , about 7 - 10 minutes
3. Watch them closely , they burn easily !
4. Let cool and chop coarsely
5. Set aside
6. Leave the oven set at 350 degrees
7. Butter and flour a 9-inch springform pan with 2-inch sides
8. Flour mixture: in a medium bowl , sift together the flour , cinnamon , baking soda , nutmeg and salt
9. In a large bowl , using any electric mixer set on medium speed , beat together cup of the brown sugar , the 5 tablespoons melted butter , eggs and nectar until blended
10. Stir in the flour mixture just until combined and then the pear cubes
11. Transfer the batter to the prepared pan
12. Bake until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean , about 25 minutes
13. Transfer pan to a rack
14. While this cools:
15. In a medium-sized , heavy saucepan over medium-high heat , combine the toasted walnuts , the remaining cup of brown sugar , the cup butter and the milk
16. Bring to a boil , stirring frequently , until the mixture is reduced to a thick sauce consistency , about 3 minutes
17. Pour the hot mixture over the hot cake in the pan
18. Let stand for 3 minutes
19. Slowly , release the pan sides and place the cake on a plate
20. Cut into wedges and serve warm
21. From : cakes , cupcakes and cheesecakes by williams-sonoma

title: slow simmered italian sauce
steps:
1. Place the italian sausage in a large , nonstick skillet or dutch oven
2. Drizzle with the 1 / 4 cup olive oil and saute over very low heat for 5 minutes , turning occasionally
3. Add the tomato paste and stir
4. If necessary , to avoid sticking , add another drizzle of olive oil and stir well
5. Simmer , covered , stirring occasionally , for approximately 30 minutes , until the tomato paste darkens and looks almost black
6. Meanwhile , put the remaining vegetables in a blender and add the 2 cups tomato juice
7. Blend until the vegetables are no longer solid
8. Add the two tablespoons of sugar , the salt and the red pepper flakes
9. Pour this mixture over the sauce and stir well to blend
10. Simmer , partially covered , for 2-1 / 2 hours , stirring occasionally
11. Add the red wine in the last hour of cooking
12. Continue to simmer at least one hour , partially covered , stirring occasionally , until sauce reaches desired consistency
13. At this point , you can add any additional meat that has been pre-cooked , such as ground beef , sausage , or any vegetables such as mushrooms , as desired
14. This makes a large amount so you can freeze extra sauce in ziplock bags for the freezer
15. Simply thaw and reheat to use in lasagne , as pizza sauce , for spaghetti & meatballs , etc

title: bonbon balls
steps:
1. Mix ingredients , make into balls , chill in refrigerator 1 hour or longer
2. Coat with melted semi-sweet chocolate and then cool slightly
3. You can add about 1 / 2 block parafine to chocolate

title: microwave brownie lava cake
steps:
1. Empty brownie mix into large bowl
2. Whisk to remove large lumps
3. Coat 8 custard cups with cooking spray
4. Add a small amount of dry brownie mix to each cup and rotate cups until completely coated and set aside
5. In separate bowl , whisk together wet ingredients called for in brownie mix instructions , plus 1 additional egg
6. Add wet ingredients to brownie mix and stir until well combined
7. Add 1 / 2 cup batter to each custard cup
8. Stack two dove candies and press them down into the center of the batter
9. Spoon batter over candy so it is completely covered
10. Place in microwave and cook at full power for 1 minute for 1 cake
11. May cook up to 4 cakes at one time , adding 1 / 2 minute to cooking time for each additional cake
12. To remove cake from bowl: run a thin knife around the edge of the cooked cake
13. Place a small plate on top of the cake cup
14. Flip the plate and bowl over , so the cake is inverted on top of the plate
15. Gently lift the bowl , leaving the inverted cake on the plate
16. Serve with whipped cream or ice cream
17. Garnish with berries
18. Cakes may also be eaten directly from the custard cup they are cooked in
19. May also be cooked and served in half-pint mason jars
20. If eating cakes directly from bowl or jar , it isn't necessary to spray or coat them before adding batter and cooking
21. Make ahead: batter may be mixed and added with chocolate pieces to custard cups or jars in advance
22. Cover and refrigerate up to a week
23. Remove from refrigerator and warm to room temperature 30 minutes before cooking

title: leaf salad
steps:
1. Wash and tear up lettuce into bite size and put in large bowl
2. Wash and chop into bite size , both red and green cabbage and add to lettuce
3. Wash and tear spinach into bite size chunks and add to lettuce , cabbage mixture
4. Toss and refrigerate until ready to serve
5. Dressing:
6. Mix in a bowl mayo and honey
7. Add salt and pepper
8. When ready add dressing to salad and serve

title: lemony rice pudding
steps:
1. In a heavy medium saucepan over high heat , bring water & salt to a boil
2. Add rice & 1 tablespoon of the zest , then reduce heat to low
3. Cover & cook for 20 minutes , then remove pan from heat & let the rice stand , covered , for 10 minutes
4. When rice has stood for 10 minutes , add milk , the remaining zest & the sugars to the rice & bring the mixture just to a boil over medium heat
5. Then , reduce heat to low & cook , stirring frequently , for about 30 minutes , or until mixture is thick & creamy & the rice is very soft
6. Spoon pudding into serving bowl & let cool to room temperature , stirring occasionally
7. Refrigerate , loosely covered , for at least 4 hours or overnight , until thoroughly chilled
8. Before serving , let stand at room temperature for 10 minutes , then enjoy !

title: make ahead cheesy mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Place potatoes in a 6-qt saucepan
2. Add enough water to cover potatoes
3. Heat to boiling over high heat
4. Reduce heat to medium
5. Cook uncovered 15 to 18 minutes or until tender
6. Drain
7. Mash potatoes in saucepan with potato masher or elecric mixer on low speed
8. Meanwhile , in medium bowl , beat cream cheese , cheddar cheese and parmesan cheese with elecric mixer on low speed until smooth
9. Beat in sour cream and garlic salt
10. Heat oven to 350
11. Stir cheese mixture into mashed potatoes until well blended
