12. If potatoes are too still , stir in milk , 1 tablespoon at a time , until desired consistency
13. Spoon into ungreased 13x9 inch glass baking dish
14. Bake uncovered 35 to 40 minutes or until hot and top is lightly browned
15. Sprinkle with paprika and chives

title: barbecue deviled eggs
steps:
1. Place eggs in a single layer in a large saucepan
2. Add water to a depth of 3 inches
3. Bring to a boil
4. Cover , remove from heat , and let stand 15 minutes
5. Drain and fill pan with cold water and ice
6. Tap each egg firmly on the counter until cracks form all over the shell
7. Peel under cold running water
8. Cut eggs in half lengthwise , and carefully remove yolks
9. Mash yolks with mayonnaise
10. Stir in pork , and next 4 ingredients
11. Blend well
12. Spoon yolk mixture evenly into egg white halves
13. Garnish with a shaking of paprika

title: chocolate twinkie cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease a 13x9 pan
3. In a mixing bowl , combine sugar , shortening , vanilla and eggs
4. Beating until very smooth
5. In a separate bowl , combine remaining dry ingredients
6. Set aside
7. Pour milk into a measuring cup
8. In three or four portions , alternate adding flour mixture and milk to the sugar mixture in the mixing bowl , beating well after each addition
9. Scrape sides of bowl , and beat for one more minute
10. Pour into prepared pan , smooth out the top , smack pan firmly against countertop , two or three times
11. Pop it into the oven
12. Bake for 25-30 minutes
13. Cool 5-8 minutes on rack
14. While cake is cooling , prepare filling: cream butter & shortening , then add sugars , then milk , vanilla and lemon extract
15. Beat until very fluffy & creamy
16. Set aside
17. When cake is cooled , use bread-cutting knife and slice in half , depth-wise
18. Remove top half of cake
19. Liberally spread filling over the bottom section , keeping edges clean
20. Place top half of cake on filling , press gently
21. Cover and allow to sit for a day to develop flavors
22. Altho' we've had good results eating right away !
23. This recipe is easily halved and made in an 8- or 9-inch pan , too
24. Cut into rectangles to sort-of resemble the traditional twinkie-cake shape

title: sushi vinegar
steps:
1. Combine the vinegar ingredients in and a sauce pan and heat slowly till the sugar has dissolved , stirring constantly
2. Remove from heat

title: caramel corn pops
steps:
1. Place an 28x18 inch piece of foil on a heat proof surface
2. Coat with a cooking spray - set aside
3. In a heavy 12 inch fry pan , over medium heat cook margarine , brown sugar , corn syrup and molasses , stirring constantly , until the mixture starts to boil over entire surface
4. Cook and stir about 6 minutes longer
5. Carefully stir in vanilla and butter flavoring
6. Remove from heat and add corn pops cereal and quickly and carefully stir to coat cereal
7. Spread the mixture thinly on prepared foil
8. Seperate cereal into clumps as it cools
9. Store in an airtight container

title: black pepper and onion scones
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees
2. In a small skillet , saute onions in margarine until crisp tender
3. Set aside
4. Cool slightly
5. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup and level off with a knife
6. In a medium bowl , combine flour , sugar , baking powder , pepper and salt
7. Blend well
8. Add whipping cream , egg and sauteed onions
9. Stir just until moistened
10. On floured surface , knead dough gently 5 or 6 times
11. Place on ungreased cookie sheet
12. Press into an 8" circle about 1 / 2 inch thick
13. Cut into 8 wedges
14. Separate slightly
15. Bake at 400 degrees for 12-16 minutes or until very lightly browned
16. Brush with melted butter or margarine
17. Serve warm
18. Wonderful with soup !

title: honey roasted vidalia onions
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Peel onions and cut in half crosswise
3. Place onions , cut sides down , in an 8 inch square baking dish , drizzle with water
4. Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes
5. Combine honey and remaining ingredients
6. Turn onions over
7. Brush half of the honey mixture over the onions
8. Bake , uncovered , an additional 30 minutes or until tender , basting with remaining honey mixture after 15 minutes

title: savoury baked fish fillets
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. In a bowl , mix the mayo , sour cream and the evelope of ranch dressing and black pepper to taste if desired
3. Mix well to combine
4. Brush on or dip the fish fillets in the mixture to coat all sides
5. Then dip in crushed onions to coat
6. Transfer to a shallow greased baking dish
7. Bake until fish is cooked

title: bust your lips southern potato salad
steps:
1. Peel and dice potatoes , put in large pot of water , bring to a boil , cook approx , 20 to 30 minutes
2. Drain right away and let cool
3. Put eggs in a small pot of water , put 3tsp
4. Salt in water , bring to a medium boil for 5 to 7 minutes
5. Drain , let cool , peel and chop
6. In a large bowl combine , thinly chopped onion , celery , mayonaise , mustard , relish , salt and pepper
7. Mix together all ingredients
8. Add cooked , diced potatoes , and chopped eggs
9. Stir well , but not so much to damage the diced potatoes
10. Serve warm or chilled
11. Also please

title: pumpkin coconut cream cheesecake
steps:
1. Cake
2. Beat together sugar and oil
3. Mix in eggs and pumpkin
4. Stir in dry ingredients
5. Then add nuts and coconut
6. Pour into greased 9x13x2 pan and bake in 350 over for 25-30 minutes until cake tests done with toothpick or cake tester
7. Frost with cream cheese frosting when cooled
8. Frosting
9. Cream butter and cream cheese
10. Gradually add in sugar and vanilla
11. Stir in nuts and coconut
12. Spread evenly over cake when completely cooled

title: creme anglaise
steps:
1. In a 3-quart pan over medium heat , stir milk and sugar often until mixture begins to bubble around edges of pan , 10 to 12 minutes
2. Remove from heat
3. Whisk about 1 / 2 cup of the hot milk mixture into egg yolks , then pour mixture into pan and whisk to blend
4. Stir with a flexible spatula over medium-low heat until custard coats the spatula in a smooth , velvety layer , 10 to 14 minutes
5. Remove from heat and pour through a fine strainer set over a bowl
6. Set bowl in a container of ice water and stir often until cool
7. Stir in vanilla
8. Serve cool or cold

title: rhubarb pancake dessert
steps:
1. Mix bottom layer ingredients together and put in 9x13 pan that has been sprayed with non-stick cooking spray
2. Mix together first 3 ingredients of the top layer until crumbly and put on top of the rhubarb layer
3. Drizzle melted butter over the top
4. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour

title: spaghetti  tuna and capers
steps:
1. Drain oil from tuna and place in a heavy based frypan
2. Add diced onion and saute until soft and clear
3. Meanwhile , in a large pot , boil salted water and cook spaghetti
4. Dice tomatoes and add to pan
5. Stir the mixture over low heat
6. Add salt and peppercorns to taste
7. Add tuna to mixture and stir
8. Drain spaghetti
9. Add capers to mixture
10. Place spaghetti on warm plates
11. Place tuna mixture over top of spaghetti
12. Sprinkle parmesan cheese
13. Garnish with a few basil leaves
14. The secret of success is to work quickly and make sure that the mixture is not overcooked
15. As a variation , olive oil can be substituted with butter
16. Fettucine can be used instead of spaghetti

title: modified mas macho meatballs
steps:
1. Mix turkey , oat flour , onion , garlic and flaxseed
2. Roll into golf ball sized meatballs
3. In a nonstick skillet over medium heat , cook the meatballs until browned all the way around
4. Drain fat and add tomato sauce
5. While sauce is warming scoop out some of the bread in the rolls to form shallow trenches
6. Spoon meatballs and sauce into each trench , sprinkle with mozzarella , and top with top half of roll

title: gluten free spinach pie rolls
steps:

2. Heat olive oil in skillet , add onions , dill , salt and pepper , heat for about 5 minutes , just to soften onions and mix flavors
3. Remove from heat and let cool for a couple minutes

title: flax morning glory muffins
steps:
1. Crush cereal with a rolling pin
2. Mix with milk and let stand 5 minutes
3. Combine flour , flax meal , brown sugar , carrot , sugar , coconut , baking powder , cinnamon and salt
4. Stir in apple
5. Beat eggs
6. Stir in vanilla
7. Stir oil into cereal mixture
8. Stir egg mixture into cereal mixture
9. Stir in dry mixture , just until combined
10. Spoon into a gresed or paper cup lined 12-cup muffin pan
11. Bake in a preheated 375f oven for 22 minutes or until done
12. Immediately remove from pan

title: tomato free ketchup
steps:
1. Process all ingredients in a blender until smooth , about 30 seconds
2. Store in refrigerator

title: cornflake cakes
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a saucepan over a low heat
2. Add the golden syrup stirring constantly until mixed
3. Add the chocolate and vanilla extract and stir until blended then remove from the heat
4. Add the corn flakes and stir to coat evenly
5. Place in baking cases and place in a fridge
6. Allow to set before serving

title: buttermilk apple apricot noodle pudding
steps:
1. Butter a 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish
2. Cook noodles in a pot of boiling salted water until al dente
3. Drain noodles and return to the pot
4. Add the 1 / 2 c butter and toss until melted and noodles are coatedl beat eggs and sugar in a medium bowl to blend and mix into the noodles
5. Fold in apple , apricot , and raisins
6. Spread noodle mixture into the prepared pan
7. Pour buttermilk evenly over noodles
8. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight
9. Preheat oven to 350^f
10. Remove plastic wrap from noodles and bake uncovered 45 minutes
11. Combine the cornflake crumbs , brown sugar and 5t melted butter in a bowl
12. Remove dish from oven and spoon topping evenly over noodles
13. Return to oven and continue baking until top is golden brown and crisp , about 30 minutes longer
14. Let stand 10 minutes
15. Cut into squares and serve with sour cream

title: traditional 4 cheese manicotti
steps:
1. Boil manicotti according to pkg directions , adding oil to water so they don't stick
2. Meanwhile , mix all cheeses , salt , pepper , parsley and eggs
3. Drain manicotti
4. Run cold water over it
5. Preheat oven to 350
6. Stuff each manicotti with cheese mixture
7. Place them in a 3 qt casserole after treating with nonstick spray , pour sauce around and over the manicotti
8. Cover and bake for 45 minutes
9. Uncover and bake for another 15 minutes

title: corned beef surprise
steps:
1. Heat a large skillet , over medium heat , and lightly saute onion and bell pepper in the oil about 2 to 3 minutes
2. Add the corned beef and combine with the onion and peppers by breaking the beef up with a wooden spoon and stirring
3. Flatten mixture evenly in the bottom of the pan , then pour the tomato sauce evenly over top
4. Reduce heat , if needed , to prevent sauce bubbling out of the pan
5. Season with salt and pepper and other seasonings as desired , to taste
6. Simmer , uncovered , over medium low heat , until liquid has mostly evaporated , about 15 minutes
7. Place about 1 cup of rice on each of 4 serving dishes , then divide beef mixture into 4 and use a spatula to place each portion on top of the rice

title: almond brown sugar brownies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Heat shortening and chocolate in a 3 quart saucepan , until melted
3. Remove from heat
4. Stir in remaining ingredients , in this order : flour , sugar , almond paste , almonds , eggs , baking powder , and salt
5. Spread into a greased 13x9x2 baking dish
6. Bake until brownies start to pull away from sides of pan
7. After 20 minutes , you need to check every 2 minutes
8. It should not be longer than 30 minutes
9. Do not overbake
10. When done take them out and let cool for 6-8 minute
11. Cut into 2x1 bars

title: pineapple pie from barbados
steps:
1. Drain pineapple chunks - keep syrup , add water if necessary to make one cup
2. Heat syrup and add gelatine , stir till dissolved - divide in half
3. Keep one half in the pot
4. To the half in the pot , add cream cheese
5. Stir over heat till melted and smooth
6. Pour into graham cracker crust
7. Chill until firm
8. Once firm , place pineapple chunks on top , and pour on remainder of syrup to glaze
9. Keep pie chilled
10. Alternate method: i had a problem with getting the syrup evenly distributed , and i think that the next time i make this , i will mix the pineapple chunks with the syrup and put it on as a mixture once the pie is firm
11. Just use a little gentleness when you're putting the pineapple on top
12. Alternate crusts: digestive biscuits , marie biscuits , cornflakes or rice krispies can be substituted for the crust zaar has several variations of a graham cracker crust available
13. Use one of these to make the crust if you don't like premade crusts or as a template for using the other things mentioned

title: apricot tart   layered shot
steps:
1. Layer all ingredients in a shot glass in order given
2. The secret is to pour slowly , barely dribble the liqueurs into your glass
3. Start with your first liqueur and pour it into your glass , now take your spoon and place the

title: sausage with spinach  ww and crockpot
steps:
1. Spray skillet with pam and set over medium high heat
2. Add sausages and brown , turning
3. Remove from skillet and set aside
4. Add broth to skillet and cook for 2 minutes
5. Transfer to crockpot
6. Stir in onions , raisins , salt and pepper and top with the sausages
7. Cover and cook for 8-10 hours on low
8. Transfer sausages to a cutting board and cut each diagonally into 5 slices
9. Put half of the spinach into crockpot cooking just until wilted and then repeat with remaining spinach
10. Stir in sausages and vinegar
11. Serve with rice

title: masaman  massaman  mussuman curry tofu
steps:
1. In a saucepan , stir fry curry paste with half the can of coconut milk until combined
2. Add remaining coconut milk and heat until boiling
3. Add remaining ingredients and cook until potatoes and carrot soften and start to absorb flavors
4. About 20 minutes
5. Remove bay leaves and cinnamon stick , add sugar and lime juice and gently stir until combined
6. Serve over jasmine rice and top with crushed peanuts

title: crock pot chicken fajitas
steps:
1. Place chicken and onions in crockpot
2. Sprinkle spices over all
3. Add the lime juice and stir well
4. Cook on low for 4-6 hours
5. If you start with frozen chicken breast , you might need to cook for longer than 6 hours
6. Serve in warm tortillas with your favorite fajita toppings

title: parmesan sauce  super easy
steps:
1. Melt butter in small skillet or sauce pan over medium heat
2. Whisk in flour to make a roux and gradually stir in milk
3. Heat to a boil stirring frequently
4. Reduce heat to thicken and add parmesan cheese and stir till melted
5. Season with garlic , salt and pepper to taste

title: nectarine relish for chicken
steps:
1. Wash and dry nectarines and bell pepper , cut nectarines from pit
2. With a potato peeler thinly peel the pepper
3. Cut peppers and nectarines in 1 / 8-1 / 4 inch dice
4. Wash and trim scallions , cut into 1 / 8 inch rings
5. Warm honey in a small pot over medium low heat
6. Add nectarines , scallions and bell pepper and cook for 2 minutes , stirring frequently
7. Add all the other ingredients , adjust taste and put in a serving bowl
8. Serve cold or slighly warm with chicken and rice

title: edamame salad
steps:
1. Toss the edamame , vinegar , oil , saly , pepper , radishes , and cilantro together in a largr bowl
2. Serve chilled or at room temperature

title: nutty oven fried chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a shallow dish , combine biscuit mix , pecans and seasoning
3. Mix well
4. Dip chicken pieces in milk
5. Coat generously with pecan mixture
6. Place in a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish
7. Drizzle butter over chicken
8. Bake , uncovered for 1 hour or until juices run clear

title: pasta e fagioli casserole
steps:
1. Saute sausage , beef , onions , garlic , oregano and thyme
2. Add tomatoes , juice , paste and cayenne
3. Simmer for 5 minutes , then add beans
4. Combine with pasta and parmesan
5. Spoon into casserole dish and top with mozzarella or fontina and bake , covered , at 375 degrees for 45 minutes
6. This dish may be frozen prior to baking , but be sure to thaw it in the fridge for 24 hours before baking

title: light strawberry fool
steps:
1. Puree strawberries and cottage cheese in a blender
2. Put yogurt in a bowl
3. Fold in strawberry mixture
4. Add honey and vanilla , and mix gently but thoroughly
5. Chill
6. When ready to serve , place in 4 individual dishes and , if desired , swirl a teaspoon of strawberry spread into each one

title: peanut butter filled chocolate peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Make the filling: in a small bowl , cream together the peanut butter and powdered sugar until smooth
2. Roll the mixture into 30 3 / 4" balls
3. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes
4. Meanwhile , make the cookie dough: in a large mixing bowl , cream together the butter and peanut butter until smooth
5. Add both sugars
6. Blend well
7. Blend in the egg white and vanilla
8. Combine the flour , cocoa powder , and baking soda
9. Gradually add to the creamed mixture , stirring just until combined
10. Shape the dough into 30 1-1 / 2" balls
11. Using floured hands , flatten each cookie and shape each one around a peanut butter ball , sealing the edges
12. Place cookies 2" apart on ungreased cookie sheets
13. Flatten with the bottom of a glass that has been dipped in sugar
14. Bake at 375f
15. For 7-9 minutes , or until the cookies are just set and the tops are cracked
16. Cool for 1 minute on the cookie sheets before transfering the cookies to wire racks
17. Cool completely
18. Make the icing: in a small bowl , cream together the butter and powdered sugar
19. Beat in the vanilla and enough milk to reach desired spreading consistency
20. Spoon the icing into a zip-lock bag with the corner snipped off
21. Pipe the icing over the cookies in a zig-zag pattern

title: low fat south of the border chicken chili
steps:
1. In a 2 1 / 2 quart casserole dish , combine all ingredients
2. Cover and bake 1 hour , stirring occasionally , until chicken is tender and no pink remains
3. Remove from oven and sprinkle with cheese
4. Cover and bake 5 minutes more

title: maple cornbread
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine flour , cornmeal , baking powder and salt
2. In another bowl , beat egg
3. Add milk , syrup and oil
4. Stir into dry ingredients just until moistened
5. Pour into a greased 9-in
6. Square baking pan
7. Bake at 400 for 20-22 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
8. Cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes
9. Cut into squares
10. Serve warm

title: pear gingerbread pudding
steps:
1. Grease an 8 inch square glass baking dish
2. Spread pears in dish and drizzle honey over it
3. Set aside
4. In a large bowl beat butter with sugar until fluffy
5. , then beat in molasses and egg
6. In a separate bowl , whisk together flour , ginger , cinnamon , ground cloves , baking soda and salt
7. Stir into molasses mixture and alternately with hot water , making three additions of dry ingredients , and two additions of water
8. Pour over pears
9. Bake in a preheated 350 f degree oven until straw or cake tester inserted in center of cake comes out clean
10. Serve warm
11. They say it takes about 30 minutes , but from my personal experience , in order for the straw or cake tester to come out clean it has to be in the oven between 40-45 minutes

title: clares winter vegetable cobbler
steps:
1. Pre-heat the oven to 200c / 400f / gas 6
2. Place the vegetables and sage in a roasting tin , drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper
3. Roast for 30 minutes until nicely browned
4. Meanwhile , place the flour , salt , cayenne , butter and three quarters of the cheese in a food processor and whiz until well blended
5. Beat together the egg and 2 tablespoons of the milk then add to the food processor
6. Pulse to form a smooth , soft dough
7. Mix together the stock , cream and mustard , and pour over the vegetables
8. Then , with floured hands , roll the cobble mixture into 6 balls and flatten slightly with the heel of the hand
9. Brush the tops of the cobbles with the remaining milk , then scatter over the reserved cheese
10. Carefully place the cobbles on top of the vegetables and sauce and bake for 20 minutes until risen and golden brown
11. Serve immediately

title: the wise tomato  sage that is
steps:
1. Saute the leeks& garlic until the leek is golden
2. Add tomatoes and seasoning , cook about 3-4 minutes

title: sopa seca de fideo
steps:
1. Place noodles in a plastic bag , arranging in one layer
2. With a rolling pin , break into small pieces , set aside
3. Heat butter and oil in a large pot or frying pan
4. When butter is melted , add onion , garlic and chiles and cook , stirring until soft
5. Add noodles and stir well continue to cook , stirring constantly , for 2 more minutes
6. Add tomatoes , tomato sauce , oregano , peas and 2 cups of broth and bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat to low , cover and simmer until liquid is absorbed
8. Check occasionally to see if you need to add more broth
9. When the fideo is tender and the liquid is absorbed , add in the cilantro and season with salt and pepper
10. Portion into bowls and top with grated cheese , if desired

title: amaretto stone sour
steps: 1. Shake and serve over ice

title: afghan ambrosia   haf miwah
steps:
1. Pour boiling water over pistachios , almonds and walnuts
2. Let sit for five minutes to loosen their skins
3. Drain and set aside to cool
4. When cool , rub off skins in a tea towel
5. Rinse raisins and apricots
6. Place all ingredients in a large saucepan and cover with water
7. Bring to a boil , stirring
8. Take off heat and let cool
9. Store in the refrigerator until you are ready to eat

title: butternut squash ravioli
steps:
1. Steam squash until easily pierced with a fork
2. Mash squash , and add spices , cheese and salt and pepper
3. Cool , and prepare dough
4. For dough: mix flour and salt together
5. In a separate bowl , mix the cilantro , eggs , and 1 / 4 cup water
6. In a food processor , pulse cilantro mixture until the cilantro is fine
7. Add flour mixture gradually until well mixed
8. Add water if necessary to obtain a stiff dough
9. Knead dough by hand , and leave rest in a covered bowl for 20 minutes
10. Knead again , and roll dough into a thin sheet , approximately 1 / 8 inch
11. Cut out an even number of circles in the dough
12. Drop a spoonful of filling in the center of each circle , moisten edges with water , and cover with a separate circle
13. Pinch edges together , and leave ravioli dry for about 2 hours , and refrigerate until needed
14. Cook ravioli in boiling salted water for about 15 minutes , drain , and serve with preferred sauce

title: diana s avocado salsa
steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together and toss well

title: oatmeal apple pear crisp
steps:
1. While peeling apples and pears , keep them in the lemon juice so they don't turn brown
2. Place apples in a greased shallow 9 square baking dish
3. Sprinkle brown sugar , ground cinnamon , ground nutmeg and water
4. Combine remaining dry ingredients in a separate bowl
5. Add melted butter , mixing until crumbly
6. Sprinkle crumb mixture on top of the apples
7. Bake at 375f for 30-40 minutes or until apples are tender
8. Serve with vanilla ice cream or yogurt , great by itself too

title: all american apple pie
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees
2. In a large bowl , combine the sugar , flour , cinnamon and nutmeg
3. Mix well , add the apples and toss to coat completely
4. Line a 9" pie plate with pie crust
5. Pour the apple mixture into the pie plate
6. In a small bowl , combine the butter and vanilla and pour over the apples
7. Cover the apples with the pie crust , pressing against the pie plate to seal , and flute , if desired
8. Spray the crust with nonstick cooking spray and bake for 50-55 minutes , or until the crust is golden and the apples are tender

title: soft gingerbread biscotti
steps:
1. Position a rack in the middle of the oven & preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper
3. In a large bowl , whisk together the flour , baking powder , salt , just 2 teaspoons of the ginger & 2 teaspoons of the cinnamon , as well as the cloves , the 3 / 4 cup of granulated sugar & all of the brown sugar
4. In a medium bowl , whisk together the eggs , butter & vanilla extract , then pour this egg mixture into the flour mixture , stirring with a wooden spoon until dough comes together in a soft & slightly sticky mass
5. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured work surface & knead several times until smooth
6. Divide dough in half , then shape each piece into a log about 8 inches long & 2 inches wide before setting each log some 3 inches apart on the prepared baking sheet
7. In a small bowl , stir together the remaining 1 teaspoon of ginger , 1 teaspoon of cinnamon & the 3 tablespoons of granulated sugar
8. Brush the logs with the egg white & sprinkle each log with 1 / 3 of the spiced sugar mixture
9. Bake logs 25 to 30 minutes or until they are puffed & golden brown , then set the baking sheet on a wire rack to cool for 10 minutes
10. Reduce oven temperature to 300 degrees f , then using a serrated knife , cut each log into 1 / 2-inch-slices
11. Arrange the biscotti , flat-side down , on the baking sheet & sprinkle with another 1 / 3 of the sugar mixture , then bake for 6 minutes or until biscotti are light golden brown
12. Turn the biscotti over , sprinkle with the remaining sugar mixture & bake another 6 minutes
13. Cool biscotti on the baking sheet set on a wire rack for 5 minutes before removing them to the rack to cool completely
14. Store in an airtight container or in a zip-lock bag for up to 4 days

title: crabby  bread
steps:
1. For the body , join 2 rolls together and press into a flat football shape
2. Place body on a large sprayed baking sheet
3. With the next roll , cut enough dough off to form 2 small eyes
4. Roll each piece into a round ball and place on front of body
5. To secure eyes , stick a small piece of toothpick in each ball and then stick it into the body
6. Cut the rest of the roll in half to form 2 arms
7. Place each arm to the side of the eyes but before the ends of the body
8. Cut another roll in half to form 2 claws
9. Then cut each claw off-center almost in half and place at the end of each arm , putting the small part of the claw closest to the body
10. Roll the last roll into a 12-inch rope
11. Divide rope into 6 equal lengths for the legs
12. Arrange 2 legs curving forward and 1 leg curving back on each side
13. Tuck legs slightly under the body
14. Brush crab with melted butter , cover loosely with plastic wrap and let rise for 30-45 minutes , or til doubled
15. Brush crab with beaten egg and sprinkle lightly with paprika
16. Bake at 350 for 20 minutes
17. Toothpick olive halves onto ends of eyes of dough
18. Cut-side facing outward
19. Place crab onto lettuce-lined platter
20. Place mound of your favorite crab dip between claws
21. Surround with decorative shells , crackers and fresh dill sprigs if desired !
22. I made this for me and my hubby for a "special treat" lunch ! i'm allergic to crustaceans , so we had it with my lemon-dilled tuna salad and had a ball ! it was so much fun tearing off the pieces and spreading them with tuna , instead of the plain 'ol plain 'ol tuna sandwiches !
23. You could make a nice seafood appetizer platter with this , too ! shrimp cocktail and fried oysters would be a great addtion !
24. Hope ya try it ! :) it's really easy ! and fun !

title: barbecued chicken breasts with spicy peach glaze
steps:
1. Preheat grill to medium hot
2. In a medium mixing bowl , combine preserves , garlic , olive oil , soy sauce , dry mustard , cayenne pepper , salt and black pepper , and mix well to combine
3. Sprinkle chicken breasts with addditional salt and pepper , and place , skin side down , on the grill
4. Cook the chicken about 10 minutes on each side before brushing the upturned side wirh glaze
5. Continue cooking chicken for another 10-12 minutes , turning it every 3-5 minutes and brushing each upturned side with glaze every time , until the chicken is cooked through
6. Move chicken to the oven or a cooler part of grill if it gets too dark before it is cooked through
7. Place peach halves on the grill , cut side down , and grill 2 minutes
8. Turn , and brush tops with glaze
9. Grill 3-4 minutes more , until the peaches are soft and the cavities fill with juices
10. Transfer the cooked chicken and peaches to a serving platter

title: turkey waldorf salad
steps:
1. To prepare salad , mix together turkey , apples , celery , walnuts , and green onions in a large mixing bowl
2. To prepare dressing , in a small bowl , stir together yogurt , mayonnaise , apple juice concentrate , and salt
3. Mix dressing over salad ingredients , tossing to combine
4. Serve waldorf salad on plates lined with lettuce leaves , or mixed baby greens and herb type salads , if desired

title: super tender lamb shoulder roast
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 170c
2. Lightly cover bottom of baking pan with some cooking oil , i find it easier to do using a pastry brush
3. Completely cover oiled pan with fresh rosemary branches , leaving about 5 or 6 branches to put on top of the roast
4. Peel all the outer skin of the whole garlic knob and break off the cloves
5. Do not peel garlic cloves
6. Spread about 3 / 4 of them over the rosemary on pan bottom
7. Place roast on top of this and lightly paint it with some more of the cooking oil , lightly sprinkle about 1 tablespoon of flour over the top of roast and gently rub it in with your fingers
8. Cover with the remainder of the rosemary and the garlic cloves
9. Completely cover pan with cooking foil and tuck it in firmly all around
10. Place into preheated oven and cook for approx 4 hours
11. Do not remove foil during cooking time , when cooked properly meat should be moist and tender and should also fall away from bone very easily
12. About 1 hour before roast is cooked peel potatoes and carrots
13. Cut into large cubes , put into saucepan with salt to taste and cook until it is soft enough to roughly mash
14. Whilst potato is cooking prepare silverbeet or spinach leaves
15. Cut off most of the white stalks and roughly chop green leaves
16. Place into cold water salted to taste
17. Bring to boil , turn heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes
18. When potato and carrot are cooked , drain off all the water & roughly mash
19. Mix with 3 / 4 tablespoon of butter , finely chopped fresh parsley and finely chopped mild onion
20. Place in warm serving dish
21. Place in warm oven (at 100 - 150 degrees celsius to keep warm whilst preparing remainder of meal
22. Drain silverbeet or spinach of all water , mix in 1 / 4-tablespoon butter and 1 / 4 teaspoon of cracked pepper
23. Take 2 garlic cloves from the meat and gently squeeze until garlic comes out of its skin , mash it and put into silverbeet or spinach and mix thoroughly
24. Place into warm serving bowl and put into warm oven along side of potato & carrot
25. Remove roast from pan and place on warm serving dish , pull out all the bone that can easily be removed
26. Place rosemary around meat to garnish
27. Remove all garlic cloves and put them to one side
28. Cover roast with cooking foil
29. Put into oven with vegetables to keep warm whilst making gravy
30. Pour off all but 1 tablespoon of juice from baking pan
31. Pick garlic cloves up in your fingers gently squeeze them and the cooked garlic will come out of the outer shell
32. Mash some of it put into baking pan , mix in rest of flour , gently mix in the chicken stock so that you do not get any lumps
33. When this is done , place all the fresh mint into the gravy and put pan over a light to medium heat and stir continuously until it thickens
34. Turn heat down to lowest level and allow to simmer for 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
35. Serve your meal on warmed dinner plates and enjoy !

title: rotisserie chicken salad
steps:
1. Debone and skin rotisserie chicken before dicing
2. Chop celery , onion , apple , and olives and mix with the chicken
3. Add mayonnaise and salt to the chicken salad and mix thoroughly
4. Enjoy !

title: healthy smoothie
steps:
1. Place all ingredients into blender
2. Mix until well blended and serve in a tall glass
3. Enjoy !

title: moroccan style chicken
steps:
1. Squeeze the juice from 1 lemon , peel and crush the garlic , peel and grate the onion
2. And mix the chopped herbs - parsley , mint and coriander - together so that they are well combined
3. Mix the oil , lemon juice , garlic , onion and two tablespoons of the herbs together
4. Stir in the paprika and cumin
5. Place the chicken in a shallow dish , pour the oil mixture over the chicken and turn , to coat , and marinate for 30 minutes
6. Heat the remaining oil with the unsalted butter in a non-stick pan
7. Remove the oil from the marinade and reserve half of the marinade
8. Saut the chicken for 40-50 minutes , turning occasionally , until golden brown and cooked right through
9. Cut the remaining lemon into wedges , halve the olives , and add both to the pan with the reserved marinade , and cook for 2-3 minutes , or until the lemon wedges start to change colour
10. Mix the tahini and the remaining herbs
11. Divide the chicken between 4 warm plates , and serve with the tahini / herb mixture garnished with parsley and paprika
12. Variation: if you cannot find tahini , use hummus mixed with 1-2 tablespoons of olive oil or lemon juice

title: spicy grilled chicken wings
steps:
1. Place the pepper and salt in a medium bowl
2. Add the garlic cloves and crush into the salt and pepper to make a thick paste
3. Add the lemon juice , crushed red pepper , and hot sauce
4. Whisk in the olive oil slowly until well combined
5. Place the chicken wings in a large sealable plastic bag
6. Add the marinade and seal the bag tightly
7. Shake the bag well to coat
8. Refrigerate for 12-48 hours
9. Remove the chicken wings from the refrigerator and let sit at room temperature for 25-30 minutes while heating the grill
10. Grill over medium-high heat , flipping frequently and brushing with the marinade for 15-20 minutes or until cooked through
11. Do not brush the wings with the marinade for the last five minutes to make sure the juices all cook thoroughly
12. Throw away the marinade
13. Serve hot , at room temperature , or chilled
14. The wings can be refrigerated for up to 2 days before serving chilled , or reheated

title: crock pot italian sausage and peppers
steps:
1. Cook turkey sausage in heavy skillet over medium heat until browned , turning occasionally
2. Layer half of the onions on bottom of 3-4 quart crockpot , then add half of the peppers
3. Add all of the browned turkey sausage , then the rest of the onions and peppers
4. Add bay leaves and other spices
5. Combine diced undrained tomatoes , tomato paste , and red wine in small bowl and mix well to blend
6. Pour over mixture in crockpot
7. Cover slow cooker and cook on low for 6 hours

title: bbq d spice rubbed chicken breast
steps:
1. Spice mix: blend all dry ingredients , coriander and bay leaf can be ground in a spice or coffee grinder
2. Chicken: rinse chicken in cold water and pat dry , season chicken liberally with spice rub
3. To cook: start gas grill or charcoal bbq
4. If using gas grill , turn one side down to a low heat while keeping the other side on med / high , if using charcoal grill push coals to one side
5. Place chicken breast on the grill skin side up
6. Cover and cook for 20-25 minutes
7. Turn chicken over onto direct heat , cover and cook for 5 minutes more or until chicken is well browned , and cooked through , enjoy

title: simple chutney cheese spread
steps:
1. Mix well and store int eh refridgerator
2. Makes about 2 cups

title: easiest ahi tuna ever
steps:
1. Rub the steak with one tbs of the olive oil
2. Put the peppercorns on a plate and press the tuna steak into the peppercorns until it is coated
3. Sprinkle the steak with salt to taste
4. Heat the other tbs of olive oil in a non-stick pan on medium high heat
5. Cook the steak 2-3 minutes per side
6. Slice the steak into 1 / 4" slices and serve over salad or rice
7. Cooking a tuna steak for 2-3 minutes per side will leave the middle quite rare , and barely warm
8. You could cook the fish longer until it is well done , but then you would basically spending a lot of money on a cut of fish that is meant to be served rare or raw

title: chicken relleno
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Flatten chicken breasts between wax paper to 1 / 4-inch thickness using a meat mallet or rolling pin
3. Place 1 / 2 green chili and 1 ounce cheese in the center of each chicken breast
4. Roll chicken lengthwise and secure with wooden skewers or toothpicks
5. Combine breadcrumbs and next 4 ingredients
6. Dip rolls in milk , then dredge in breadcrumb mixture to evenly coat
7. Place chicken in a baking dish sprayed with nonstick cooking spray
8. Bake uncovered 30 minutes or until tender

title: simple   delicate fettuccine alfredo
steps:
1. Cook fettuccine until al dente , drain and set aside
2. Melt butter in a large saucepan
3. Add heavy cream & pepper
4. When butter & heavy cream are almost boiling , slowly start adding cheese
5. Lower the heat to medium
6. Continue to whisk until all grated cheese has melted
7. About 5 minutes
8. Sauce will be slightly thin
9. The sauce will probably not be thicker than a thin gravy consistency
10. It won't matter
11. Slowly add pasta into the alfredo sauce
12. Toss liberally !

title: garden vegetable omelette braid pampered chef copycat
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. In a bowl , whisk cream cheese and milk
3. Add the flour and whisk until smooth
4. Separate 1 egg , reserving egg white
5. Add the yolk , remaining 7 eggs , dill weed , salt and pepper to cream cheese mixture , whisking until smooth
6. Add asparagus , bell pepper , and onion to the bowl , mix well
7. Melt the butter or margarine in a 12" skillet over medium heat
8. Add the egg mixture and cook , stirring occasionally , 4-6 minutes or until eggs are set but still moist
9. Remove pan from heat
10. Set aside
11. Unroll the 2 packages of crescent rolls , do not separate
12. Arrange dough on a cookie sheet with longest sides of rectangles across the width of the cookie sheet
13. Roll the dough with a rolling pin to seal seams
14. Startin on longest sides of cookie sheet , cut sides of dough into eight strips , about 1 1 / 2" wide and 3" long
15. Using an ice cream scooper , scoop filling evenly over center of dough
16. Starting at one end , lift one strip of dough
17. Twist one turn and lay across the top of the filling
18. Repeat , alternating strips of dough to form a braid
19. Fold the bottom edges of the dough up at the ends of braid
20. Brush top of braid with the remaining lightly beaten egg white
21. Bake 25-30 minutes or until golden brown
22. Enjoy !

title: breaded chicken legs
steps:
1. In a large bowl , whisk together , horseradish sauce and yogurt
2. Add the chicken , turning to coat , and let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes
3. Position a rack in the upper third of the oven and preheat to 400 degrees
4. Line a baking sheet with parchment and grease with 2 tbs
5. Olive oil
6. In a large bowl , toss together the panko , salt and pepper
7. Working with 1 chicken piece at a time , coat in the panko mixture and transfer to the prepared baking sheet
8. Drizzle with the remaining 2 tbs
9. Olive oil , then bake until golden and cooked through , about 40 minutes

title: omelet with lavender and chvre
steps:
1. Prepare omelet recipe up to the beginning of step #5 and proceed as follows:
2. Distribute the chvre cheese on top of the omelet
3. Add a sprinkle of cracked black pepper and garnish with a sprig of lavender
4. If desired , garnish the top of the omelet with a light sprinkle of fresh herbs of choice: chives , french tarragon , italian parsley , etc

title: dark  rich  creamy  dense chocolate peanut butter pie
steps:
1. Peanut butter layer:
2. Heat peanut butter in micro just to soften
3. Stir in powdered sugar till smooth
4. Pour and spread into prepared pie shell
5. Stir together sugar , cornstarch and salt in 2 quart pyrex measuring cup
6. Combine egg yolks and milk add to dry ingredients
7. Cook in micro , whisking occasionally , until mixture comes to a boil and thickens
8. Microwave for 1 minute more
9. Remove from micro , whisk pie mixture smooth
10. Whisk in butter and vanilla
11. Add 1 cup chocolate chips , stir until chips are melted and mixture is well blended
12. Pour over peanut layer
13. Refrigerate for 3 hours or overnight
14. Garnish with your choice and do enjoy ! :)

title: corn chowder   rosie daley
steps:
1. Preheat a large , heavy saucepan over medium heat for about 1 minute
2. Spray it twice with the vegetable oil
3. Saute the onion for about 5 minutes , until translucent
4. Add 4 cups of corn and saute for 4-5 minutes , until it softens a bit
5. Add 2 cups of chicken stock and cook until the corn can be mashed easily with a fork , about 20 minutes
6. Transfer the contents of the pan to a blender and puree until smooth
7. Return the puree to the saucepan over medium-low heat
8. Add the bell pepper , rosemary , thyme , black pepper , cayenne pepper , and the remaining 1 cup chicken stock and 2 cups corn
9. Stir and cook for about 10 minutes more , until the chowder is thick and creamy
10. Garnish with the chopped basil

title: herbed peas
steps:
1. Saut onion and celery in butter in saucepan until tender
2. Add peas , salt , pepper , marjoram , and water
3. Cover tightly
4. Cook just until peas are tender , about 10 minutes
5. Stir occasionally

title: emeril s philly cheese steak sandwich
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 200 degrees f
2. Then warm the sliced rolls or buns in the oven while cooking the meat and vegetables
3. Heat a cast-iron skillet or griddle over medium-high heat
4. When hot add the oil , onions and bell peppers , and cook , stirring , until caramelized , about 6 minutes
5. Add the garlic , salt , and pepper , and cook , stirring , for 30 seconds
6. Push off to 1 side of the griddle
7. Add the meat to the hot pan and cook , stirring and breaking up with the back of 2 metal spatulas , until almost no longer pink , about 2 minutes
8. Mix in the sauteed vegetables
9. Top with cheese slices and melt
10. Spoon the cheesy meat mixture into the warm buns and serve immediately with condiments of choice or put the meat in the bun and dip the spatula in the cheese whiz and then wipe the spatula down the inside of the bread

title: prawn and chicken stuffed calamari   thai style
steps:
1. Calamari:
2. Mix the prawn chicken and garlic together
3. Stuff the calamari with the mixture until full , but taking care not to over-stuff as the calamari will expand when cooked
4. Secure the open end of the calamari with toothpick / s
5. In a steamer , steam the calamari for about 25- 30 minutes
6. Use this opportunity to make sauce
7. When the steaming is completed , roll the calamari tube in a shallow dish containing the fry powder
8. Once coated , remove the calamari tube and add water to the fry powder to make a paste as per the packets instructions
9. Heat oil is a wok so that it is just starting to smoke
10. Add calamari tube and fry quickly on all sides the coating should be a light , crisp batter
11. Remove calamari from oil , and cut into slices / discs
12. Place the discs on a plate , pour / drizzle sauce over the top and sprinkle coriander leaves over the dish
13. Sauce:
14. Add oil to small saucepan and saut capsicum , garlic and chilli until the capsicum is soft
15. Add the fish sauce , vinegar and sugar to the saucepan
16. Cook until sauce starts to thicken , being careful not to burn

title: harira soup
steps:
1. Season lamb with salt and pepper
2. In 1 tablespoon olive oil , brown the lamb just until browned on all sides
3. With a slotted spoon , remove lamb to a plate and set aside
4. Add the onion and garlic to the juices that the lamb has released until translucent , 2-3 minutes
5. Add carrot and saut for 1-2 minutes
6. Add diced tomatoes , tomato paste , and spices
7. The moroccan blend , has el hanout , which is arabic for "head of the shop" which implies that the spices used are the best the shop has to offer , is a spice blend of over 30 spices
8. Spices may vary but tend to include cardamom , clove , cinnamon , coriander , cumin , paprika , turmeric , peppercorn , to name a few
9. Add the lamb broth , chick peas and lentils to the pot
10. Add the lamb back to the pot and simmer until lentils are tender
11. If using lamb loin , which does not have a lot of fat , add it toward the end of the cooking process
12. If using shoulder , add it in the beginning so it can stew and become tender
13. Cilantro makes this dish ! chop a big bunch and add it to the soup a few minutes before the soup is done
14. Save some to the side to use as garnish

title: chesapeake crab strata
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Place butter or margarine in baking dish and heat in oven until melted , tilting to coat dish
3. Remove dish from oven and sprinkle croutons over melted butter and sprinkle with cheese
4. Set aside
5. Combine the milk , egg and all 4 seasonings and mix well
6. Pour over cheese / crouton mixture and sprinkle with crabmeat
7. Bake for 45 minutes or until mixture is set
8. Let it stand for 10 minutes before serving

title: almond chocolate cake with ganache
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 , grease and flour a 9x13 pan
2. Sift the flour , baking soda and salt into a large mixing bowl , add the almonds , combine with a whisk and set aside
3. With an electric mixer on low speed , beat the butter for about 1 minute , or until the butter is lighter in color
4. Slowly add the sugar , about 2 tbls at a time
5. When all of the sugar is added , continue to beat for 2-3 minutes , scraping down the sides of the bowl as needed
6. The mixture will look fluffy like something between mayonnaise and whipped cream
7. Add the eggs one at a time , beating for 10 seconds between each addition
8. Add the melted chocolate and honey and beat for a few seconds until smooth
9. With a rubber spatula , fold the sifted ingredients into the batter in 3 segments , alternating with the buttermilk which is added 1 / 2 cup at a time
10. Beat with an electric mixer on low speed until the mixture looks smooth
11. Transfer the batter to the prepared pan and smooth the top
12. Bake for about 30 minutes or until a cake tester comes out clean
13. Cool the cake on a wire rack
14. Ganache:
15. Heat the cream on the stove until just under a boil
16. Pour the heated cream over the chopped chocolate and let sit for 30 seconds
17. Stir until the chocolate is all melted and thouroughly combined into the cream
18. Frost the top of the cake only with the ganache while the cake is still warm
19. Serve at room temperature

title: aloo paratha  indian potato stuffed flatbreads
steps:
1. Boil potatoes in salted water to cover , until tender
2. While potatoes cook , mix the flours , cumin , and 1 teaspoon of salt
3. Add 2 tablespoons of oil , then water
4. Mix until this becomes a defined ball of dough
5. Remove and knead until smooth , adding flour or water as necessary
6. Cover dough with plastic wrap and set aside while preparing potatoes
7. When potatoes are finished , remove , drain and mash them with cayenne , salt , pepper , citrus juice , olives and 1 tablespoon of oil
8. Taste and adjust seasonings as necessary
9. On a lightly floured surface , roll dough into 12-inch long snake and cut into 12 pieces
10. Roll each piece into about 4-inch round
11. Spoon 1-2 tablespoon of potato mixture into round , then fold over edges to enclose completely
12. Pinch dough closed and press down to distribute filling evenly
13. Heat a large cast iron pan over medium-high heat for 2-3 minutes
14. Add another tablespoon of oil to skillet , then pour out
15. Cook each bread for about 3 minutes per side , until brown spots appear
16. Repeat until all are done
17. Serve hot or room temperature

title: sarasota s simple pear and apple tart
steps:
1. Crust -- let the crust come to room temp or at least take the chill off
2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or you can use a baking pad , but parchment is so easy , just too when done and no clean up
3. Also heat your oven to 425 degrees
4. I like to sprinkle just a pinch of flour on the pie crust before i put it on the parchment
5. Then press out the fold lines
6. Filling -- in a medium bowl , add the pears , apples , cranberries , sugar , flour , nutmeg , salt and cinnimon
7. Mix well
8. Pie -- put all the filling directly in the center of the pie crust
9. Leave a couple of inches around the edge
10. Topping -- mix the flour , brown sugar butter and put over the filling
11. Finish the pie -- fold over the edges to make a rustic tart and leave a 5 or 6" center open with the filling and topping
12. Brush with the milk and sprinkle with the white sugar so it makes a nice shiny crispy crust
13. Bake -- 425 for 10 minutes and then reduce to 350 and add the almonds and cook 20-30 minutes until golden brown
14. Cool before slicing

title: fruit critters with peanut butter yogurt dip
steps:
1. In a food processor or blender , combine yogurt , peanut butter and dark brown sugar and puree
2. Pour into a pretty bowl and chill in the refrigerator , about 20 minutes
3. While the dip is chilling , make fruit"critters" using the fruits for bodies , pretzel sticks for legs , and raisins for eyes
4. Here are some suggestions , but use your imagination !
5. Quarter and core an apple
6. Place the flesh side down so the peel is facing up
7. This will be the shell for a"beetle"
8. Cut 1 raisin in 1 / 2 , place the inside down towards 1 end of the apple to make"eyes" for your beetle
9. Break 4 pretzel sticks in half and insert into the bottom for legs
10. Carefully thread grapes onto a pretzel stick to make a caterpillar
11. Stick 2 sunflower seeds into one of the end grapes to make eyes
12. You can also use 2 kinds of grapes to make a multi colored caterpillar
13. For a fly or bee: cut off the last 2 inches of a banana , so you have a piece with a slight curve and a tapered end
14. This will be the body
15. Carefully stick a pretzel stick into the cut surface so half is in the banana and half is sticking out
16. Core a strawberry and carefully stick in onto the other half of the pretzel stick to attach the"head"
17. Cut a raisin in 1 / 2 and stick the cut side onto either side of the strawberry to make"eyes"
18. Cut 2 slices of apple and carefully stick into the banana to make wings
19. Have fun using different fruits !
20. Dip the critters in the dip and enjoy !

title: mighty good moussaka
steps:
1. Peel the zucchini and slice into 1 / 2-inch rounds
2. Heat a skillet and spray with the veggie oil
3. Quickly brown the zucchini slices on both sides , spray with oil as necessary arrange half the zucchini slices in an oiled 9x12x2-inch baking dish
4. Heat the olive oil in the same skillet and saut the onion and garlic until translucent
5. Add meat , stir to break up any lumps , and cook for about 5 minutes
6. In a saucepan heat the tomato sauce , tomato pieces , bay leaf , beau monde , honey , oregano , chili pepper and black pepper
7. Simmer gently for 10 minutes
8. Meanwhile , in a separate pan , heat a little oil and brown the mushrooms , then add them to the meat and mix well
9. Pour all of the meat mixture over the zucchini slices
10. Top with cinnamon , allspice and cottage cheese
11. Cover with remaining zucchini slices , then the tomato sauce and wine
12. Sprinkle with the cheese and bake for 1 hour in a 350f oven
13. Remove from oven , sprinkle with the parsley , serve

title: winter cookie pops
steps:
1. Spread peanut butter onto the flat side of the cookies
2. Place an ice cream stick into the peanut butter on half the cookies
3. Top with another cookie so the stick is sandwiched between the two cookies
4. Melt chocolate chips
5. The best method is using a double boiler
6. If you don't have a double boiler , you can use a heat proof bowl which is large enough to be suspended over a pot without its bottom touching the simmering water
7. Simmer the water over low heat and stir the chocolate often
8. Remove from the heat as soon as the chocolate is melted and stir until smooth
9. Dip cookie pops in the melted chips , covering completely
10. Roll pops in red and green sprinkles and lay or stand on waxed paper or paper plates
11. Place in refrigerator to chill
12. Variations: you can make flags , faces , hearts-- here are a few suggestions snowmen-- using a licorice whip , while chocolate is still warm on pop , form headband and position two regular sized m&m candies as ear muffs
13. Lie pop flat on waxed paper and let cool
14. When cool , use black decorator gel for eyes and mouth and orange for the nose
15. Gently wrap a fruit roll up around the bottom of the cookie at the stick
16. Santa-- while chocolate is still warm , dip top of pop into red sprinkles for santa's hat
17. Lie flat on waxed paper and let cool
18. When cool , dot top of hat with white decorator icing using flower
19. Use flower
20. Use black decorator gel to dot on eyes
21. Holly-- while chocolate is still warm , position to red mini m&m candies off center in the chocolate
22. Let cool
23. When cool , use green decorator gel to draw on holly leaves , fill in

title: vegan carrot ginger muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Mix dry ingredients
3. Add wet ingredients
4. Stir until combined
5. Bake for 12-15 minutes

title: pancakes  clone of pancake parlour
steps:
1. Beat eggs and then add baking powder , sugar , salt and milk
2. You can use a hand-held mixer if you wish
3. Then add flour all at once and mix with a wooden spoon only until batter is fairly smooth
4. Set aside until you see small bubbles forming on top of the dough
5. Heat a frying pan with a light coating of oil and test temperature by dropping a teaspoon of batter into the centre of the pan
6. When it turns golden brown the temperature is right
7. Add a ladle full of batter in the centre of the pan and cook until bubbles appear , then flip and cook other side until golden brown
8. Keep warm and serve with warmed maple syrup or honey and ice-cream
9. You can also serve this with grated cheese and ham , which you place over the pancake while the second side is cooking until it melts

title: nana s hamburger potato hot dish
steps:
1. Brown hamburger , chopped onion and pepper together in a skillet
2. Wash and slice the potatoes with the skins left on
3. Stir together all the soups & corn in a large casserole pan
4. Add browned hamburger and potatoes to the soup mixture and stir well
5. Bake at 375 degree oven for approximately 2 to 2 1 / 2 hours
6. Stir a couple times during baking
7. I usually have it covered the 1st hour , then leave it uncovered the remaining time
8. This is one of those recipes that i never had a recipe to follow , i just knew the ingredients from my mom making it when i was a child
9. The hamburger amount could vary from 1 to 2 lbs & the potatoes could be anywhere from 4-8 depending how much you want to make
10. Also could add an extra can of cream corn if making a larger amount of hamburger & potatoes
11. I have also made it in my crock pot
12. Starting out the 1st hour in the oven , then finishing it off in the crockpot on low for 3-4 hours because i brought it to work for a potluck

title: hellas relish
steps:
1. Combine cucumber , tomato , onion and parsley in a mixing bowl
2. Add remaining ingredients and toss to mix
3. Best if eaten within 2 hours of making

title: candy cane cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 degrees
2. Mix the crushed peppermint candy and granulated sugar together and set aside
3. Mix shortening , sugar , egg and flavorings together
4. Add flour and salt and mix
5. Divide dough in half
6. Add food coloring to one half and mix well
7. Make one cookie at a time by: rolling a 4" strip from each color
8. Place strips side-by-side , press lightly together and twist like a rope
9. Place on ungreased baking sheet
10. Curve top down to form handle of the cane
11. Bake about 9 minutes
12. Remove from baking sheet
13. While still warm sprinkle with the candy / sugar mixture

title: totally tempestuous tater tots
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Lightly coat 10" pie pan with cooking spray
3. Distribute tater tots evenly on pie pan
4. Sprinkle salt and pepper over tater tots
5. Sprinkle tabasco over tater tots
6. Lightly spray tater tots with cooking spray
7. Bake at 400f for 25 minutes
8. Lightly tap tray on counter top until all tater tots are loose
9. Enjoy

title: badda bing pizza with pesto esque sauce
steps:
1. Prepare the pizza dough as indicated in recipe above , up until the point before baking the dough
2. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
3. First , saute the onion , mushrooms and garlic for about 2 minutes or just until softened
4. Add the spinach and "cook down" for about 2 minutes , but no longer , stirring often
5. You don't want the spinach slimery or soggy
6. Set aside to cool slightly
7. Make the pesto sauce by whirling the ingredients in a blender about 30 seconds
8. Set aside
9. Prick the dough in random places all over with fork tines
10. Begin by spreading the pesto sauce onto the dough , making sure the edges of the dough are covered witht the pesto to avoid drying out
11. Spread on the sauteed mushroom / spinach mixture and finally add 2 / 3 of the grated cheese
12. Arrange the tomatoes on top , then the olives , pine nuts , oregano , black pepper , and remaining cheese
13. Drizzle with a tablespoon of olive oil
14. Bake in preheated over at 425 degrees for about 18 minutes , turning 1 / 2 turn after 9 minutes for even cooking
15. Remove from oven and let sit for 5 minutes
16. Cut up into squares and serve
17. Cooking time does not include preparing the pizza dough

title: chili cornbread
steps:
1. Sprinkle in greased 13x9-inch baking pan 1 tablespoon corn meal
2. Set aside
3. In a bowl combine salt , baking soda , and remaining cornmeal
4. In another bowl , beat eggs
5. Add corn , milk and oil
6. Stir into dry ingredients , just until moistened
7. Pour half the batter into prepared pan
8. Layer with beef , cheese , chilies , and onion
9. Top with remaining batter
10. Bake at 350f for 45 to 50 minutes or until golden brown
11. Let stand for 5 minutes before cutting

title: hearty taco soup
steps:
1. Cook beef and onion in a large skillet until meat is done
2. Transfer meat mix to a large pot
3. Add ranch dressing mix , taco seasoning , and 1 cup water and stir well
4. Add remaining ingredients
5. Simmer for 1 hour , stirring ocassionally
6. Top with shredded cheese and serve with corn bread
7. Yum !

title: beef ramen stir fry
steps:
1. Fill a large saucepan 2 / 3 full of water
2. Bring to a boil
3. When water boils , add ramen noodles and cook 3 minutes
4. Drain
5. Meanwhile , in a wok or large frying pan , heat oil on high heat
6. Add beef , vegetables , teriyaki sauce , garlic , ginger , and seasoning packets from ramen noodles
7. Stir fry until beef is cooked through
8. Add noodles and toss to combine

title: pork chop  pierre
steps:
1. Place all vegetables on bottom of crockpot
2. Add pork chops
3. Blend rest of ingredients and pour over top
4. Cook low for 5-6 hours or high 2 1 / 2-3 hours
5. Serve over white rice

title: pork chops vesuvio for two
steps:
1. Add garlic powder , 1 tablespoon oregino and 2 table spoons of basil to italian breading
2. Dreg chop in breading coating well on both sides
3. Melt butter and heat olive oil in large skillet
4. Add and saute garlic until it turns golden brown
5. Brown chops on both sides
6. Remove chops and set aside
7. To skillet , add stock , wine 1 table spoon oregino , 1 table spoon basil , lemon juice and crushed red peper
8. Deglaze pan scrapping the bottom to get all the goodies
9. Bring to a boil , turn down heat to med
10. Low
11. Re-add chops and spoon sauce over the top
12. Close lid , simmer 10
13. Minute
14. Turn chops over and repeat step
15. Serve over angle hair pasta
16. Garnish with remaining table spoon of basil

title: pesto chicken breast with summer squash
steps:
1. In a large nonstick skillet cook chicken in hot oil over medium heat for 4 minutes
2. Turn chicken
3. Add zucchini and / or squash
4. Cook for 4 to 6 minutes more or until the chicken is tender and no longer pink
5. And the squash is crisp tender , stirring squash gently once or twice
6. Transfer chicken and squash to 4 dinner plates
7. Spread pesto over chicken
8. Sprinkle with asiago or parmesan cheese

title: pumpkin toffee cheesecake
steps:
1. Crust:
2. Preheat the oven to 350f
3. In a small bowl , combine the cookie crumbs and butter
4. Press onto bottom and 1" up the sides of a 9-inch springform pan
5. Bake for 6-8 minutes
6. Do not let brown
7. Cool on wire rack for 10 minutes
8. Cheesecake:
9. In a large mixing bowl , beat the cream cheese and brown sugar until it's creamy
10. Add the pumpkin , milk , eggs , cornstarch and cinnamon
11. Stir well and pour into the crust
12. Bake for 60 to 65 minutes , or until the edge is set and the center jiggles just a little
13. Remove it from the oven
14. Immediately top it with toffee candy pieces
15. Don't turn off the oven
16. Topping:
17. Combine the sour cream , sugar and vanilla
18. Mix well and spread over the top of the warm cheesecake
19. Bake for 8 minutes
20. Cool completely in pan on a wire rack
21. Refrigerate for several hours or up to overnight
22. Remove the outside of springform pan
23. Drizzle with caramel sauce before you serve
24. Enjoy !

title: pallini fresco
steps:
1. Chill all ingredients overnight before making this
2. Add all ingredients to small glass and garnish with a lemon or lime slice

title: masala chai powder
steps:
1. Powder all the above ingredients and mix
2. Store in an airtight container
3. Will keep well for years

title: ice cream sticky buns
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine the ice cream , butter and sugars
2. Pour into a greased 13x9 baking pan
3. Cut dough into 36 pieces and arrange in dish
4. Cover and let rise until doubled , about 1 hour
5. Bake at 375 for 18-22 minutes or until golden brown
6. Cool for 2 minutes before inverting onto a serving platter
7. Serve warm

title: russian orange drop cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease cookies sheets
3. Mix together flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
4. Stir 1 / 2 cup orange juice and 1 teaspoon orange zest into the flour mixture
5. Cream shortening and sugar together
6. Mix egg into the sugar mixture thoroughly
7. Slowly blend flour mixture into the egg and sugar mixture
8. Drop by teaspoonful onto greased cookie sheet
9. Bake for 8 - 10 minutes
10. Make the icing: mix confectioners' sugar and 2 tablespoons butter together until smooth
11. Pour 2 tablespoons orange juice and 1 teaspoon orange zest into the sugar and butter mixture , mix well
12. When the cookies have cooled , spread the icing generously over the tops of the cookies
13. When using fresh orange zest , i usually double the amount to 2 teaspoons

title: virgin strawberry colada
steps:
1. Combine the strawberries , pineapple juice , coconut cream and crushed ice in a blender , and blend well at high speed
2. Pour into a collins glass , garnish with a cherry and pineapple wedge , and serve

title: cappuccino cupcakes with cream cheese mascarpone frosting
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Mix flour , powder , and salt together and set aside
3. Cream butter and sugar till light and fluffy in mixer
4. Add eggs , one at a time , mixing well after each addition
5. Add coffee extract
6. Alternately add dry ingredients and half and half , beating till smooth
7. Pour into prepared tins and bake 25 minutes or till tester comes out clean
8. Cool completely
9. Frost with cream cheese-mascarpone frosting and dust with cinnamon
10. Frosting:
11. With an electric mixer , beat the butter and mascarpone cheese together until fluffy
12. Add the vanilla paste and the sugar incrementally , until fully incorporated

title: cantaloupe melba
steps:
1. In a blender or food processor , whirl raspberries until pureed
2. Pour through a sieve to remove seeds
3. Stir sugar and liqueur into puree and mix well
4. Cover and chill
5. Halve cantaloupes and remove seeds
6. Peel and cut into thin slices
7. Line each of 8 small dessert bowls or goblets with 3 or 4 melon slices
8. Top melon with a scoop of sherbet and pour 2 tablespoons chilled raspberry sauce over sherbet
9. Raspberry sherbet in goblets lined with sliced cantaloupe and topped with melba sauce would make a memorable finale for a menu featuring an egg and cheese dish

title: maple roasted pork tenderloin
steps:
1. Trim pork of all visible fat
2. Whisk together all remaining ingredients
3. Pour over pork and marinate in refrigerator for 1 hour
4. Put pork and marinade it a small roasting pan or baking dish
5. Roast uncovered for 40 minutes at 350 f
6. Pork should still be slightly pink in the middle
7. Let pork stand for 10 minutes
8. Cut into thin slices
9. Drizzle sauce over pork
10. Serve

title: the greasemeister
steps:
1. Cut holes in the bread like you're making one-eyed egyptians and butter one side of each slice
2. Cover a skillet with nonstick cooking spray and put down the bread
3. Drop an egg into each hole , salt and pepper to taste and cook on high heat until the bottom half of the egg has cooked
4. In the meantime , fry the bacon in a separate skillet to your desired doneness
5. When the eggs have half cooked , flip the bread to briefly cook the other side for 30 seconds
6. Flip it back over , put the bacon on and turn off the heat
7. Now , put the deli meat in the bacon skillet and fry briefly
8. Flip once and put down the cheese on the meat
9. As the cheese is melting , make sure you get as much leftover bacon grease and bits ontop of the cheese
10. When it has melted well around the edges and just a tad in the middle , use a spatula to flip the meat and cheese combo onto the bread , so the cheese is facing the inside part of the one-eyed egyptian
11. Now spread the grey poupon on the deli meat , put the two sides together , and enjoy !
12. Also , if you want to make this a "healthy" greasemeister , you can use some weight watchers bread
13. It's only 45 calories a slice !

title: pork chops and apple bake
steps:
1. In bowl whisk egg
2. In separate bowl mix together wheat germ , basil , rosemary , garlic powder
3. Rinse and pat dry pork chops
4. Dip chops in egg wash
5. Dredge through wheat germ mixture
6. Put into 9x13 roasting pan , add water to pan
7. Drizzle with balsamic vinegar
8. Put in oven at 350 degrees for 1-1 1 / 2 hours
9. In the meantime , quarter apple and remove cores
10. In a separate bowl , mix together cinnamon and nutmeg
11. Put apple in bowl and stir to cover apple with mixture
12. 1 / 2 hour after chops are in oven , flip chops over and put apples on top of chops , return to oven and continue to bake
13. Serve with side dish and vegetables
14. Au jus from baking can be dripped over chops and apples on a platter or can be made into a tasty gravy

title: pastitso  macaroni and meat
steps:
1. Brown onion in the butter then add the meat
2. Keep stirring until the meat is browned
3. Add salt , pepper , cinnamon , tomato paste and water
4. Cook , uncovered , over medium heat for about 20 minutes , stirring occasionally until the water is absorbed
5. Remove from the heat and allow this to cool
6. Beat 1 egg very well and add it to the meat mixture
7. Macaroni:
8. Cook the macaroni as per the package directions
9. Then rinse under hot water , drain and put into a large bowl
10. Toss the macaroni with the 3 beaten eggs and the 1 3 / 4c grated romano cheese
11. White sauce:
12. Melt the butter and add the flour , mix well
13. This should be done on med-low heat , so you don't burn the butter
14. Gradually add the cold milk , stirring well
15. Cook this until it's thick , stirring often
16. Be patient , it needs to thicken up ! remove from heat
17. After about 5 minutes , while sauce is cooling , beat the 5 egg yolks very well and blend into the sauce
18. Add the cheese and mix
19. Butter a 10" x 14" pan
20. Put 1 / 2 of macaroni mix in pan
21. Put meat mixture over the macaroni , spreading evenly
22. Put the rest of the macaroni mixture on top , also spreading evenly
23. Put white sauce all over the top
24. Bake at 375 degrees f
25. For about 45 minutes or until golden brown

title: lemon garlic chicken  greece   kotopoulo skorthato
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 355f
2. Rinse the chicken and pat dry
3. Peel the potatoes and cut into quarters , lengthwise
4. Salt and pepper the chicken and potatoes
5. Transfer chicken to a roasting pan , and add potatoes , on and around the chicken
6. Add oregano , garlic , olive oil , and lemon juice , distributing evenly across the pan
7. Add water and roast uncovered at 355f for a total of 1 hour and 40 minutes
8. Half way through , turn the chicken
9. If needed , add 1 / 4 to 1 / 2 cup more

title: cinnamon pumpkin custard
steps:
1. In a medium bowl combine pumpkin , eggs , brown sugar , cinnamon , and allspice
2. Stir in evaporated milk and pour into a 9-inch quiche dish
3. Bake in a 300 degree f oven for 40 to 45 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean
4. Cool on a wire rack
5. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours or up to 24 hours
6. Before serving: let custard stand at room temperature for 20 minutes
7. Meanwhile , for caramelized sugar , in a heavy 8-inch skillet heat the granulated sugar over medium-high heat until sugar begins to melt , shaking skillet occasionally to heat sugar evenly
8. Do not stir !
9. Once sugar starts to melt , reduce heat to low
10. Cook about 5 minutes more or until all of the sugar is melted and golden , now stirring as needed with a wooden spoon
11. Quickly drizzle caramelized sugar over the custard
12. Serve immediately

title: couscous with eggplant  aubergine
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a saucepan , add the shallots , onions , turmeric , coriander , eggplant , salt and pepper
2. Cook over medium-high heat , stirring , until wilted , but do not brown
3. Add the water , bring to a boil , add the couscous and blend well
4. Cover tightly , remove from the heat and let stand for 5 minutes
5. Add the butter and lemon juice , stir and blend with a fork to separate the grains
6. Keep warm

title: whole wheat pasta salad with walnuts and feta
steps:
1. Cook the pasta according to the directions on the package
2. Drain the pasta , rinse it under cold water , and put it in the refrigerator to chill
3. In a dry saute pan , toast the walnuts over a medium-high flame until they are fragrant , about 2 minutes
4. Set the walnuts aside to cool then chop them coarsely
5. In a large bowl , toss together the chilled pasta , walnuts , feta cheese , onion , and spinach
6. In a small bowl whisk the oil , vinegar , garlic and mustard
7. Pour the dressing over the pasta salad and toss to combine
8. Season with salt and pepper , to taste

title: butter mint candies
steps:
1. In large bowl , beat butter until creamy
2. With mixer on low , beat in sugar , cream and extract until creamy and smooth
3. Turn sugar mixture out onto a work surface lightly dusted with confectioners sugar
4. Knead until smooth and satiny
5. Divide mixture into thirds: tint one pastel pink , one pastel green and leave remaining portion white
6. Cover each portion with plastic wrap to keep it from drying out
7. Line 2 baking sheets with nonstick foil
8. Lightly dust work surface with confectioners sugar
9. Working with one color at a time , roll out 1&#8260
10. 4 cupfuls of the mint mixture , using your fingers , into a 1 / 2-in
11. -thick rope
12. Cut rope into 1 / 2- to 3 / 4-in
13. Pillows
14. Transfer mints to prepared baking sheet with a spatula
15. Repeat with remaining mint mixture
16. Let air-dry at room temperature for 1 to 2 days until firm enough to handle
17. Transfer mints to covered containers
18. Can be stored in an airtight container at cool room temperature up to 2 weeks , or keep in refrigerator up to 1 month

title: honeyed carrots with cumin
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , whisk together all ingredients except carrots
2. Bring to a boil over high heat , add carrots , stir , and reduce heat to medium
3. Cook , stirring frequently , until most of the liquid has evaporated and carrots are tender , 10 to 12 minutes
4. Remove from heat and set aside to cool to room temperature
5. Serve , room temperature , in a bowl with toothpicks on the side

title: uncle bill s green split pea with hambone soup
steps:
1. Rinse peas well in cold water and add to a large cooking pot
2. Measure 8 cups of water and add to cooking pot
3. Bring to boil , remove from heat , cover and let sit for 1 hour
4. Return to stove and bring back to boil
5. Add ham bone , carrots , onions , celery , bay leaf , beef bouillon , salt , peppercorns and dried thyme
6. Reduce heat to simmer , cover and cook for about 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours , stirring occasionally
7. Remove ham bone and cut off any remaining ham , cut into bite size pieces and return to soup
8. Discard ham bone
9. If there are big pieces of ham in the soup , remove , cut into bite size pieces and return to soup
10. Remove bay leaf and discard
11. Adjust seasonings to taste
12. If you desire a smooth soup , then puree' in batches in a food processor or blender
13. Or eat the soup without puree'ing
14. If soup is too thick , add more water to your desired consistency
15. Beef broth or chicken broth may be added , just reduce the water by the amounts used
16. Smoked ham hocks are excellent to use instead of a ham bone
17. If there is not enough ham on the ham bone , then add additional ham of your choice
18. You may also use about 1 / 4 teaspoon of liquid hickory smoke , to get a smokey flavor
19. You may also use whole peas , but it will take a bit longer to cook these peas so that they are tender

title: green beans with lemon peel
steps:
1. Wash and drain beans
2. Trim ends and break or cut beans into 1" pieces
3. Cut peel from lemon
4. Remove white pith
5. Cut lemon into narrow strips
6. Boil beans 5 minutes
7. Pack hot beans into hot jars , leaving 1" headspace
8. Add 1 or 2 pieces of lemon peel to each jar
9. Ladle boiling water over beans , leaving 1" headspace
10. Remove air bubbles
11. Adjust 2 piece caps
12. Process pints 20 minutes , quarts 25 minutes at 10 pounds pressure in a steam pressure canner

title: littlemafia s yogurt cooler
steps:
1. Mix everything in a mixer
2. Serve

title: mediterranean chicken and potato salad
steps:
1. Cut the chicken into 1 / 2 inch cubes or shred , depending on your preference
2. Set aside in refrigerator
3. Rough chop the garlic and anchovy on a cutting board
4. Sprinkle with salt and mash into a paste with the side of your knife
5. Add paste to a small bowl , and whisk together with parsley , yogurt , mayonnaise , olives , capers , vinegar , mustard , and pepper to form the dressing
6. Place chicken , potatoes , and tomatoes in a large bowl , add the yogurt dressing , and toss gently to combine
7. Let rest 20 minutes to allow flavors to develop and meld

title: vegetarian barley vegetable soup
steps:
1. In a large pot , melt butter over medium-high heat
2. Add onion , carrot and celery and saute until softened
3. Add water , tomatoes , salt , basil , thyme and pepper
4. Bring to a boil
5. Stir in barley
6. Lower heat and cover
7. Gently simmer for 1-1 / 2 hours or until barley is tender
8. Stir in frozen green beans during the last 10 minutes of cooking
9. Remove from heat and stir in dill weed
10. Serve warm

title: rich and creamy mashed cauliflower
steps:
1. In a 3-quart saucepan , bring the water to boil
2. Add cauliflower and garlic and cook covered for 15 minutes or until florets are tender then drain
3. In a food processor or blender , process cauliflower , garlic , mayonnaise , and salt until creamy , scraping down sides as needed
4. Stir in basil leaves and serve immediately

title: crusty yummy biscuits
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine the flour , baking powder , and salt
2. Combine milk and oil , pour over the dry ingredients and stir just until moistened
3. Turn out onto a floured surface
4. Knead dough 5-6 times
5. Roll out dough to 1 / 2 inch thickness
6. Cut with a floured biscuit cutter
7. Place on a greased baking sheet
8. Bake at 425 degrees for 13-15 minuted or until golden brown
9. Brush with melted butter to prevent hardening of the biscuits
10. Serve warm with butter , honey , or preserves

title: charmoula grilled chicken sandwiches
steps:
1. Mix oil , lemon juice , 1 / 2 teaspoons salt , the spices , garlic and cilantro together in a medium bowl
2. Set aside 1 / 4 cup of the marinade
3. Add chicken to bowl , turning to coat evenly
4. Let chicken marinate , chilled , at least 30 minutes and up to 4 hours
5. Blend mayo , red peppers and remaining 1 / 2 teaspoons salt in a food processor until smooth , about 1 minute
6. Chill until ready to use
7. Prepare grill for high heat
8. Brush bottom halves of each roll with 1 teaspoons of reserved marinade mixture
9. Cook chicken , turning once , until grill marks appear and meat is cooked through , 7-10 minutes
10. Grill rolls , cut side down , until warmed and grill marks appear , about 2 minutes
11. Let both cool
12. To assemble: set 1 chicken thigh on bottom half of a roll
13. Spread 2 tablespoons mayo onto cut side of top half
14. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 cup arugula and set top of roll on chiclen
15. Repeat for rest of sandwiches

title: herb rolls
steps:
1. Put 2 cups flour , sugar , salt , powdered milk , and undissolved yeast in bowl
2. Stir
3. Add 2 1 / 2 cups very warm water and melted butter to flour mixture
4. Mix with mixer for 2 minutes
5. Add remaining flour 1 / 2 cup at a time until dough clings to hook and cleans sides of bowl
6. Continue mixing 5 minutes place in a greased bowl
7. Turn to coat both sides with oil
8. Let rise 20 minutes
9. Once risen , roll out to 1 / 2 inch thick in a large rectangle
10. Top rectangle with half of butter mixture then sprinkle with 3 / 4 cup cheddar cheese
11. Roll like cinnamon rolls , cut about 1 / 2-1 inch thick , then place on a pan
12. Coat with remaining butter
13. Let rise until double in bulk
14. Bake at 425f for 10-12 minutes or until golden brown

title: protein shake  low in fat  vegan  delicious
steps:
1. Throw it all in a blender
2. Mix it up
3. And drink it down

title: sooz s chili  ground beef and beans
steps:
1. In a dutch oven or large saucepan brown ground beef
2. In the last few minutes drain off the excess fat
3. Add cumin , garlic , paprika , oregano , onion powder , chili powder , worcestershire sauce , black pepper , salt , sugar , tomato sauce , tomato paste , and diced tomatoes and mix well
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat
6. Cover and simmer for 1 hour
7. Add both cans of beans with their liquid
8. Cover and simmer for an additional hour
9. Serve in bowls over crumbled corn bread topped with shredded cheese and onions
10. Sometimes i just brown the ground beef , add all of the rest of the the ingredients and then dump everything in a crock pot to simmer on low all day

title: really good brussels sprouts
steps:
1. Trim the bottoms off of the brussels sprouts and then cut in half vertically
2. Fry bacon in a large pan until crispy
3. Remove from pan and reserve the fat
