4. Add the brussels sprouts to the bacon fat and fry on medium
5. Do not stir too often as they need to brown
6. Sprinkle with the salt
7. Once the brussels sprouts are browned , add the green onion
8. Crumble the bacon and add to the brussels sprouts
9. Stir together the juice of the lemon and the sugar
10. Pour juice over the brussels sprouts and cook until evaporated

title: amaretto eggnog bread pudding
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Tear bread into chunks
3. Beat the eggs into the eggnog and then add the amaretto and vanilla
4. Pour over bread
5. With hands , mix until it has texture like very wet , soft stuffing
6. You may need to add more amaretto , for proper texture
7. Add the raisins
8. Bake about 45 minutes , uncovered
9. You may serve warm or cold

title: pineapple marinated chicken
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients in a medium mixing bowl , except chicken
2. Place chicken in a sealable rectangle bowl
3. Pour marinade over chicken
4. Seal bowl
5. Place in fridge 1-2 days
6. Mix often to blend flavors
7. Place chicken on heated grill
8. Cook till no longer pink basting with marinade& turning often
9. 45-50 minutes
10. Serves 4

title: lentil soup in 10 minutes  pressure cooker
steps:
1. Heat the oil in the pressure cooker over medium heat
2. Add the onion and saut until soft , about 2 minutes
3. Add the carrots and saut for another minute
4. Add the bay leaves , thyme , savory as desired , water or broth , lentils , and potato
5. Stir well
6. Lock the lid in place on the cooker and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat until you achieve high pressure
7. Reduce the heat to maintain pressure for 6 minutes
8. Remove from the heat and let the pressure come down naturally
9. Remove the lid , tilting it away from you
10. Remove the bay leaves and thyme stems , and add salt and pepper to taste
11. Top with grated parmesan as desired

title: super easy chocolate nut fudge
steps:
1. Line an 8 inch square baking dish with foil
2. Spread foil with butter
3. In a medium saucepan combine chocolate chips , marshmallows , and frosting
4. Cook and stir over medium low heat until marshmallows and chips are melted
5. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla and pecans
6. Pour into prepared pan
7. Refrigerate about 2 hours
8. Using foil , lift fudge out of pan
9. Discard foil
10. Cut fudge into 1 inch squares
11. Store in the refrigerator
12. Makes about 2 lbs

title: buttery cherry drop cake
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , cream together the butter and sugar
2. Add eggs and beat until light and fluffy
3. Add almond extract
4. Mix in flour and baking powder
5. Mix until smooth
6. Grease a 9 x 13 pan
7. Spoon mixture into pan and spread evenly
8. Spoon cherry pie filling onto cake batter in 1 / 4 cup allotments
9. I usually put about 6- 1 / 4 cup dollops of cherry pie filling around the entire cake
10. No need to stir the pie filling in as it will settle into the batter as baking
11. Bake at 350 degrees for 45-50 minute
12. Remember , you can substitute any other kind of pie filling , blueberry , apple , etc
13. Dust with powdered sugar

title: fruit salad with pepper  yes pepper  dressing
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , combine 1 cup water , half of the mint leaves , the sugar , vinegar and pepper
2. Bring to a boil , then lower the heat and simmer for 5 minutes
3. In a small bowl , stir together the cornstarch and 4 t
4. Water
5. Stir into the saucepan and bring to a boil
6. Remove from the heat and let cool for 10 minutes
7. Strain
8. In a large bowl , toss the dressing with the fruit
9. To with remaining mint leaves

title: maria s garlic rice with spinach
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a 2-quart saucepan with a tight-fitting lid
2. Add the onion and saute until softened but not browned
3. Add the rice and cook , stirring , until the rice has absorbed the oil and is lightly golden
4. Add the wine and cook until the rice has absorbed the wine
5. Add the stock , cover , and turn the heat to low
6. Cook without peeking until the rice is done , about 15 minutes
7. Keep warm
8. While the rice is cooking , chop the garlic with the salt until it is almost a paste
9. The salt will bring the juices out of the garlic and help with the chopping as well as season the rice
10. When the rice is done , fluff it with a chopstick or fork
11. Stir in as much of the garlic paste as you have the nerve for
12. Stir in the spinach and replace the lid for 5 minutes
13. The spinach will steam with the heat from the rice
14. Serve as soon as possible

title: spinach  mushroom   bacon stuffed flank steak
steps:
1. Lightly score steak with a knife in a diamond pattern
2. Make sure that you do not cut through the meat
3. With a meat mallet , pound steak into a rectangle , as large as possible
4. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
5. Arrange bacon lengthwise on steak
6. Spread spinach over bacon
7. Top spinach with mushrooms and parmesan cheese
8. Roll up steak from short side
9. This will give you a long stuffed flank steak
10. Secure with toothpicks in 1-inch sections , starting 1 / 2 inch from one side
11. Cut between picks into 8 or more slices
12. Place steaks on a broiler pan
13. Broil 3 inches from the heat for 6 to 8 minutes
14. Turn
15. Broil other side , until medium doneness
16. Serve with hollandaise sauce or bearnaise sauce

title: spicy chickpea samosas with raita
steps:
1. To make samosas , heat oil in a skillet over medium heat
2. Add carrot
3. Cook 3 minutes , stirring frequently
4. Add 1 / 2 cup onions , ginger , and garlic
5. Cook 1 minute , stirring constantly
6. Add tomato paste and next 5 ingredients
7. Cook 1 minute , stirring constantly
8. Add peas , water , and chickpeas
9. Cook 1 minute
10. Remove from heat
11. Stir in cilantro and juice
12. Cool
13. Preheat oven to 400
14. Place 1 phyllo sheet on a large work surface
15. Coat with cooking spray
16. Place another phyllo sheet on coated phyllo
17. Coat with cooking spray
18. Fold layered sheets in half lengthwise
19. Spoon 2 tablespoons filling onto bottom end of rectangle , leaving a 1-inch border
20. Fold bottom corner over mixture , forming a triangle
21. Keep folding back and forth into a triangle to end of phyllo strip
22. Tuck edges under
23. Place seam side down on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray
24. Brush with melted butter
25. Repeat procedure with remaining 22 phyllo sheets , cooking spray , filling , and butter
26. Bake at 400 for 10 minutes or until crisp and golden
27. To make raita , combine yogurt and remaining ingredients
28. Serve with samosas

title: cheesy oven fries
steps:
1. Wash potatoes and cut into wedges or slices
2. Combine cheese , salt , garlic , paprika and stir well
3. Arrange potatoes in lightly greased 15x10x1 pan
4. Brush margarine on potatoes and sprinkle cheese mixture on top
5. Bake 375f , uncovered for 40 minutes till tender

title: hot fudge ice cream sundae cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees , and grease & flour a 13x9x2 inch pan
2. Prepare , bake , and cool the cake following the package directions
3. Remove cake from pan , and split cake in half horizontally
4. Place bottom layer back in pan
5. Cut ice cream into even slices and place evenly over bottom cake layer
6. Place remaining cake layer over ice cream
7. Cover and freeze
8. For fudge sauce:
9. Combine evaporated milk and sugar in medium saucepan ,
10. Cook , stirring constantly , on medium heat until mixture comes to a rolling boil
11. Boil and stir for 1 minute
12. Add unsweetened chocolate and stir until melted
13. Beat over medium heat until smooth
14. Remove from heat and stir in butter , vanilla extract , and salt
15. Cut cake into squares
16. For each serving place a cake square on plate and spoon hot fudge sauce on top
17. Garnish with whipped cream and a cherry

title: chicken and ham casserole
steps:
1. Melt butter and saute onions until soft
2. Sift flour and seasonings into the mixture and cook for 1 minute
3. Add milk and cream
4. Stir until the sauce thickens
5. Cook 2 minutes
6. Fold chicken and ham and turn into a greased casserole dish
7. Top with bread crumbs and cheese
8. Bake at 190 degrees c until top is golden brown
9. When making this meal for my family , i usually double it

title: seasoned rice vinegar
steps:
1. Combine
2. Enjoy !

title: snowballs in a jar
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine the confectioners' sugar and flour
2. Place into a 1 quart canning jar
3. Put the chopped pecans on top
4. Close the lid and attach a tag with the following instructions:
5. Snow balls
6. Makes 4 dozen
7. Preheat the oven to 325f grease cookie sheets
8. In a medium bowl , cream together 3 / 4 cup of shortening and 1 / 4 cup of margarine
9. Stir in 2 teaspoons of vanilla
10. Add the entire contents of the jar and mix well
11. Roll dough into 1 inch balls and place them on the prepared cookie sheet
12. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes , until lightly browned
13. Cool , and roll in confectioners' sugar

title: thai zucchini
steps:
1. Cook garlic , ginger , and red pepper in oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat for 1 minute , stirring constantly
2. Add peanuts and next 4 ingredients , stirring well
3. Add zucchini , and cook , stirring constantly , for about 5 minutes , or until crisp tender
4. Serve immediately

title: ww turkey chili
steps:
1. Brown ground turkey with onion , pepper and garlic until no longer pink
2. Do not drain
3. Add tomatoes , chile powder , salt and worcestershire sauce
4. Stir to combine
5. Bring to a boil and then cover and simmer for 1 hour
6. Stir in kidney beans and simmer another 15 minutes

title: nutella butterscotch sandwich
steps:
1. Spread nutella on 1 slice of bread
2. Sprinkle butterscotch chips evenly across the nutella covered slice
3. Place other slice on top and press down to combine
4. Cut diagonally
5. This can also be microwaved , grilled or fried for a gooey treat

title: bratwurst and rice
steps:
1. Bring a cup of water to a boil in a skillet that has a lid
2. Add the brats
3. Don't pierce their skins
4. Simmer'til the water evaporates
5. Cut into 3 / 4 inch pieces
6. Heat olive oil in pan
7. Add brats
8. When brats are almost browned , add onions
9. Cook till they're translucent
10. Mix ale and mustard , add to skillet
11. Stir in rice
12. Bring to a simmer
13. Cover , simmer 20 minutes
14. Don't cheat ! no peeking !
15. Keep the lid on the skillet , let the rice cook !
16. Remove from heat , let rest 15 minutes
17. Fluff with a fork
18. Serve with a baguette and a pint or two of ale

title: ci shrimp fra diavolo
steps:
1. Peel and devein shrimp
2. Reserve shrimp shells for step 3
3. Check the ingredients listing on the shrimp bag
4. If shrimp have been treated with salt , go directly to step 2
5. Otherwise , toss shrimp with 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and set aside until step 11
6. Pour tomatoes into a colander set over a large bowl
7. Release the tomato juice from the tomatoes by piercing the tomatoes with the edge of a rubber spatula
8. Stir briefly to release juice
9. Transfer drained tomatoes to small bowl , until step 9
10. Reserve tomato juice for step 5
11. Do not wash colander
12. In 12-inch skillet over high heat , heat 1 tablespoon vegetable oil until shimmering
13. Add shrimp shells and cook , stirring frequently , until they begin to turn spotty brown and skillet starts to brown , 2-4 minutes
14. Remove skillet from heat and carefully add wine
15. When bubbling subsides , return skillet to heat and simmer until wine is reduced to about 2 tablespoons , 2-4 minutes
16. Add reserved tomato juice from step 2 and simmer to meld flavors , 5 minutes
17. Pour contents of skillet into colander set over bowl
18. Discard shells and reserve liquid for step 10
19. Wipe out skillet with paper towels
20. Over medium heat in now-empty skillet , heat remaining 2 tablespoons vegetable oil , garlic , pepper flakes and oregano
21. Stir occasionally , until garlic is straw-colored and fragrant , 1-2 minutes
22. Add anchovies and stir until fragrant , about 30 seconds
23. Remove skillet from heat
24. Add drained tomatoes from step 2 and mash with potato masher until coarsely pureed
25. Return skillet to heat and stir in reserved tomato juice from step 6
26. Increase heat to medium-high and simmer until mixture has thickened , about 5 minutes
27. Add shrimp to skillet and simmer gently , stirring and turning shrimp frequently , until they are just cooked through , 4-5 minutes
28. Remove pan from heat
29. Stir in basil , parsley , and pepperoncini and pepperoncini juice and season with salt to taste
30. Drizzle with extra-virgin olive oil and serve

title: chinese chicken casserole
steps:
1. Fry chicken in oil with celery and onion until chicken is done
2. Add mushrooms and peas and carrots
3. Stir in milk and soup
4. Add soy sauce , salt , pepper , and parsley
5. Mix well
6. Pour into 1 1 / 2 qt casserole
7. Melt butter
8. Add almonds and bread crumbs to butter and mix well
9. Sprinkle bread crumb mixture over top of casserole
10. Bake , uncovered , for 40 minutes at 350 degrees f

title: pere beaudry s tourtiere
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450'f
2. In a skillet , cook the onion , garlic and spices on medium low heat in the oil
3. When onion is transparent , add the meat
4. Let simmer stirring occasionally until meat is no longer pink
5. Make a gravy by adding the flour to the water
6. Stir well and add to the cooking meat to thicken the mixture
7. Put the bottom pie crust in the pie pan and add the cooked meat
8. Put on the top crust
9. Brush the top of the crust with the cream
10. Pere beaudry says that the meat can dry out in the pie , so the gravy helps keep it moist
11. In the 450'f oven bake the pie for 10 minutes
12. Then turn it down to 350'f and bake for a further 20 minutes until golden brown
13. Bon apetit !

title: dolma  stuffed grape leaves
steps:
1. Saut onions in olive oil in pan , add rice and add hot water to cover
2. Cover and simmer until rice is half cooked , about 10 minutes
3. Turn off heat , add tomato paste , currants , nuts , and spices
4. Let mixture cool
5. To prep the grape leaves , rinse in warm water and remove the stems
6. When rice mixture is cool , place 1 teaspoon or less in center of leaf , fold in right and left sides , then roll the leaf until you have a tiny 'cigar'
7. Place the dolma in a steamer pot
8. Repeat until all grape leaves and / or stuffing is finished
9. Add water to steamer cover and simmer for 30-45 minutes or until the rice inside the dolma is totally cooked
10. Traditionally this is served cold
11. Squeeze lemon over the dolma immediately before serving

title: hot ham and cheese sandwiches with a kick
steps:
1. Mix together the spread
2. Spread it on the bun
3. Make up your sandwich
4. Brush butter on top of bun if you like
5. Put in the oven for 7-8 minutes at 350 degrees

title: creamy blue cheese dressing
steps:
1. In a small mixing bowl , beat together the oil and mayonnaise until completely blended
2. Add the lime juice and beat some more
3. Add vinegar and beat again
4. Stir in sour cream , blue cheese , salt and hot sauce
5. Serve over your favorite salad
6. Will keep in the refrigerator for several weeks

title: latin style pork roast
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees
2. Sprinkle adobo seasoning on the roast and rub in using the back of a fork
3. Open the packet of sazon and rub into the pork
4. Rub the oregano into the roast and at this point you can allow the roast to"marinate" for deeper flavor or cook right away
5. Place the roast in a shallow baking pan that has been coated with non-stick spray
6. Roast , and check the temperature after 45 minutes , if the temperature is at least 160 degrees , remove from the oven and cover the pan with aluminum foil and allow to sit for 15 minutes
7. Slice as desired

title: gg s crawfish bisque
steps:
1. Saute onions in butter
2. Add all of the remaining ingredients to a crock pot and simmer several hours of blend flavors

title: curried potato salad
steps:
1. Wash and peel the potatoes
2. Boil in a large pot of salted water until cooked , approximately 20 minutes
3. Meanwhile , heat 2 t
4. Peanut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
5. Stir-fry the cashews until they are toasted and slightly browned , about 5 minutes
6. Remove the cashews , season them with salt and pepper , and set aside
7. Add the remaining oil to the pan and heat it to medium
8. Add the celery and onion and saute until the vegetables are almost tender , about 8 minutes
9. Add one chile pepper , garlic , ginger , curry powder , tumeric , and cayenne
10. Saute the mixture until the spices are toasted and the garlic is cooked , about 2 minutes
11. Remove from heat and stir in the sugar and 1 / 2 of the cashews , reserving the other half for garnish
12. When the potatoes are cooked through , drained , and cool enough to handle , cut them in half and then into half-rounds
13. Toss the warm potatoes with the warm curry mixture
14. Allow the potatoes to cool thoroughly
15. Gently stir in the chopped egg , 1 / 4 cup chopped parsley , mayonnaise , and salt and pepper
16. Taste for seasoning and adjust accordingly
17. Add more mayonnaise if the mixture is too dry
18. Garnish with the remaining ingredients: one sliced chile pepper , 1 / 2 cup toasted cashews , 2 sliced eggs , 1 / 4 cup chopped parsley , and the reserved celery leaves
19. Sprinkle with paprika if desired

title: pretzel crust
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Crush pretzels in a blender
3. Add sugar and butter and mix well
4. Press into a 9 inch pie plate
5. Bake at 350 for 8 minutes and cool
6. Add desired filling

title: stroganoff sauce for meatballs
steps:
1. Melt butter in frying pan
2. Add mushroom and onions and saut until soft
3. Stir in flour and water
4. Mix in remaining ingredients and simmer for about 5 minutes , until slightly thickened , stirring often
5. Add meatballs and simmer until heated through
6. To freeze: double or triple sauce and divide into 3 cup containers or freezer bags
7. Label and freeze for up to 3 months
8. Defrost in fridge overnight or in microwave
9. Add cooked meatballs and cook or bake until heated through

title: strawberry leather
steps:
1. Pure strawberries with sugar in a blender until smooth , then strain through a fine-mesh sieve into a large heavy saucepan
2. Bring pure to a boil , then simmer over medium-low heat , stirring occasionally , until thick enough to mound slightly and reduced to 1 to 11 / 4 cups , 45 minutes to 1 hour
3. Preheat oven to 200f with rack in middle
4. Line a large baking sheet with nonstick liner
5. Pour hot pure onto liner and spread thinly into a 15- by 10-inch rectangle using spatula
6. Dry pure in oven until it feels drier but is still slightly tacky , 2 to 3 hours
7. Cool on liner on a rack until completely dry , at least 3 hours and up to 24
8. Place a sheet of parchment paper over leather , then peel leather off liner and roll up in parchment

title: couscous with roast pumpkin  raisins and almonds
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius cut pumpkin into 2 cm cubes and place in an oven pan
2. Drizzle with a little olive oil , season with salt and pepper and toss well
3. Roast for 30 minutes , tossing once during cooking , until pumpkin is tender and golden
4. Meanwhile heat 2 - 3 tblsps olive oil in a large saucepan and cook onion and garlic over a moderate heat for 5 - 10 minutes , until soften but not coloured
5. Add stock and bring to boil
6. Stir in couscous , then remove pan from heat , cover and leave to steam for 10 minutes to soften
7. Remove covering and fluff up couscous with a fork
8. Season well with salt and pepper to taste
9. Combine couscous with raisins , toasted almonds , corriander and hot pumpkin and toss well
10. Enjoy

title: fish steamed in packets
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Tear 4 lengths of parchment paper or foil , each about 18 inches long
3. Fold each length across in half and unfold
4. On 1 / 2 of each piece of paper place 1 / 4 of the fish
5. Top each piece of fish with 1 / 4 of the scallions
6. Whisk together the sesame oil , rice vinegar , soy sauce and honey until the honey is dissolved
7. Drizzle over the fish
8. Sprinkle with sesame seeds
9. Crimp or fold over the edges to form a sealed packet
10. Repeat forming 4 packets
11. Place them on 2 baking sheets
12. Bake in the center of the oven for about 13 minutes , depending on the thickness of the fish , until the packets are puffed
13. Remove from the oven and transfer a packet to each plate
14. Cut the top of the packets and open carefully to avoid the escaping steam and serve the fish in the open packets
15. Or , if you serve the fish with a side dish that will benefit from the addition of the tasty fish juice , empty the fish and sauce onto your plate !

title: amazing beef enchilada casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cook beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat , stirring until browned and crumbly
3. Drain
4. Add seasoning mix and stir
5. Grease an 8-inch round casserole
6. Place half of tortillas over bottom
7. Layer with beef , 2 cups monterey jack and onion
8. Place remaining tortillas over onion
9. Pour enchilada sauce over tortillas
10. Bake until tortillas are soft and juices bubble , about 35 minutes
11. Layer remaining cheese over tortillas
12. Bake until cheese is bubbly , about 10 minutes
13. Top with green onions

title: ev s wings sauce
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients- press garlic over bowl so that any juices run into bowl
2. Whisk until sugar dissolves
3. Wash wings and pat dry , place in a large zip-loc bag or glass / earthenware container and pour sauce over
4. Turn to coat
5. Marinate for a minimum of 3 hours or up to 1 day
6. Preheat oven to 400f
7. Roast wings until done , about 20 minutes , and sauce is thick and syrupy
8. Stir 3-4 times during roasting to redistribute sauce

title: sore a  e sushi
steps:
1. Use a rolling pin to rool the bread as flat as you can get it
2. Spread the slices with the soft cheese
3. Cut the cucumber into strips and place about half an inch from the edge of the sandwich
4. Roll up the sandwich like a swiss roll and cut into 1 inch segments
5. Eat

title: chewy almond chex mix
steps:
1. In a large bowl add the rice chex , shredded coconut and sliced almonds , put to the side
2. In a dutch oven combine the karo corn syrup , butter , sugar , and salt and cook on medium heat , stiring constantly until the mixture comes to a boil
3. Remove the mixture from the heat and add the baking soda and almond extract , stir until combined
4. Add your reserved dry ingredients to your wet mixture and stir lightly until the ingredients are combined
5. Spread the combined mixture onto waxed paper on your counter top
6. Allow mixture to cool for 1 hour or until the mixure is able to be packaged

title: fat free whole wheat pancakes
steps:
1. Combine dry ingredients
2. Combine wet ingredients
3. Add wet to dry and stir until just combined
4. Pour 1 / 4 cup onto hot greased skillet

title: indoor s mores
steps:
1. Break graham cracker in half
2. Spoon fluff on one of the halves
3. Spoon nutella on the other half
4. Put the two halves togeter and enjoy !

title: bloody mary
steps:
1. Rub lemon or lime around rim of glass and then put the rim in margarita salt or tony chachers , if desired
2. Add ice to glass
3. Mix vodka , tomato juice , lemon juice , worcestershire sauce , tabasco , salt , pepper , celery salt and horseradish and pour in glass
4. Garnish with lemon or lime wedge , celery stalk , green onion or pickled green bean

title: orange pork  chop skillet for 2
steps:
1. In 10-inch skillet , brown chops over medium heat
2. Drain off fat
3. Sprinkle salt on chops
4. Arrange onion slices on chops
5. Mix orange juice concentrate , sugar , allspice , lemon juice and water
6. Pour into skillet
7. Heat to boiling
8. Reduce heat
9. Cover and simmer 30 minutes
10. Place sweet potatoes and orange slices on chops
11. Cover and cook until potatoes are hot , about 10 minutes

title: raisin sheet cake
steps:
1. In a small bowl , soak raisins in boiling water for 5 minutes
2. Drain , reserving 1 cup liquid
3. Set raisins and liquid aside
4. In a large mixing bowl , cream butter and sugar
5. Add eggs and mix well
6. In another bowl , combine flour , cinnamon , baking soda and salt
7. Add to creamed mixture alternately with the reserved raisin liquid
8. Fold in raisins by hand
9. Pour into a greased 15" x 10" x 1" pan
10. Bake at 375f for 15-20 minutes , or until a toothpick comes out clean
11. Cool for 5 minutes
12. Meanwhile , combine glaze ingredients in a small bowl
13. Pour over warm cake , and spread evenly
14. When cool , cut into bars

title: spinach  olive and chilli tomato sauce for pasta
steps:
1. Heat the oil and cook the garlic and onion gently until the onion is transparent
2. Add the tomatoes , paste , chillies , herbs and pepper and heat stirring until the tomatoes soften and release their juices
3. Add the olives , and heat until the sauce reaches desired consistency
4. Stir through the spinach until warmed through
5. Serve over any pasta you enjoy
6. I sometimes add maybe 200g of chicken breast strips at the stage where you fry the onions

title: creamed chicken on cornbread
steps:
1. Instructions for cornbread: preheat oven to 425f and grease an 8" square pan
2. Mix cornmeal ingredients together until smooth
3. Turn into prepared pan
4. Bake 20 to 25 minutes , or until done
5. For the chicken , melt butter in saucepan
6. Combine with flour , nutmeg , salt & pepper
7. Stir in broth
8. Add milk & cook until thick
9. Add chicken
10. Serve over squares of corn bread

title: mac and cheddar cheese with chicken and broccoli
steps:
1. Place a pot of water on to boil for macaroni
2. To boiling pasta water , add pasta and salt to season the cooking water
3. Cook 5 minutes , then add broccoli and cook 3 minutes more or until pasta is cooked to al dente and florets are just tender
4. Heat a medium pan over medium high heat
5. Add extra-virgin olive oil and chicken and season with salt and pepper
6. Saute a couple of minutes then add onion and cook another 5 to 7 minutes until onions are tender and chicken is cooked through
7. Turn off heat and reserve
8. While pasta cooks , heat a medium sauce pot over medium heat
9. Add butter and melt , then add flour , cayenne and paprika and whisk together over heat until roux bubbles then cook a minute more
10. Whisk in milk and stock and raise heat a little to bring sauce to a quick boil
11. Simmer sauce to thicken about 5 minutes
12. Drain macaroni or pasta and broccoli florets
13. Add back to pot and add chicken to the pasta and broccoli
14. Add cheese to milk sauce and stir to melt it in , about a minute or so
15. Stir in mustard and season sauce with salt and pepper
16. Pour sauce over chicken and broccoli and cooked pasta and stir to combine
17. Adjust seasonings , transfer to a large serving platter and serve

title: napa cole slaw with dill
steps:
1. In a bowl combine the cabbage , the carrot , and the dill
2. Sprinkle the mixture with the sugar , the salt , and the oil , tossing it to combine it well , and sprinkle the cole slaw with the vinegar , tossing it to combine it well

title: bobby flay s moules frites  mussels and fries  from throwdown
steps:
1. For the mussels:
2. Directions
3. Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat
4. Add the onions and cook until soft
5. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant
6. Add the poblano puree and clam broth and cook until reduced by half , stirring occasionally
7. Add the coconut milk and honey and cook until reduced by half
8. Transfer the mixture to a blender add the spinach , salt and pepper , to taste , and blend until smooth
9. Place the pan back on the stove over high heat
10. Add the wine to the pot , bring to a boil and reduce by half
11. Add the green chile broth and bring to a boil
12. Stir in the mussels , cover the pot and cook until the mussels open , discarding any that do not , about 4 to 5 minutes
13. Add the butter and parsley and season with salt and pepper , to taste
14. Spoon into bowls , garnish with more parsley , if desired , and serve with bread on the side
15. For the french fries:
16. Cut the potatoes into 1 / 4-inch thick slices then cut each slice into 1 / 4-inc thick fries
17. Place the fries in a large bowl of cold water
18. Heat the oil in a large , straight-sided skillet to 325 degrees f
19. Drain fries in batches on paper towels
20. Fry each batch for 3 to 4 minutes until a pale blonde color and remove to a sheet pan lined with paper towels
21. Increase the heat of the oil to 375 degrees f and fry the potatoes again , in batches , until golden brown
22. Remove to a sheet pan lined with paper towels and season liberally with salt and freshly ground black pepper
23. For the aioli:
24. Combine the mayonnaise , pepper , chipotle , salt and pepper in a food processor and process until smooth
25. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving
26. Serve the fries with the aioli alongside the mussels

title: girly girl chicky chicken salad
steps:
1. With a hand blender , whip cream until it forms stiff peaks
2. Be sure to do it long enough or your salad will be runny
3. Carefully combine all other ingredients with whipped cream
4. Chill at least an hour
5. It's best chilled overnight

title: crunchy corn medley
steps:
1. In a large serving bowl , combine the first 8 ingredients
2. In a small bowl , combine vinegar , sugar , oil , salt and pepper
3. Whisk until sugar is dissolved
4. Pour over corn mixture
5. Mix well
6. Cover and chill for at least 3 hours
7. Stir just before serving
8. Serve with a slotted spoon

title: carob juice
steps: 1. Mix all 3 ingredients and then refrigerate

title: chutney dip
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together with an electric hand mixer
2. Done !
3. Serve with corn chips or julienne vegetables

title: cream of tomato   pumpkin soup
steps:
1. In a large pot , heat the oil over a medium flame
2. Add onion and saute until limp , but not browned , about 6 to 8 minutes
3. Stir in 3 cups of the stock , and let simmer , partially covered , about 15 minutes
4. Pour tomatoes and maple syrup into the food processor and puree
5. Add to pot above
6. Add the pumpkin and remaining 1 cup stock
7. Season with the pepper and salt to taste
8. Reheat
9. Garnish with finely chopped chives

title: pharaonic chicken
steps:
1. Stir together the allspice , 1 1 / 2 tsp salt , cumin , cinnamon , sugar and olive oil in a medium bowl
2. Add chicken and marinate for 15 minutes
3. Preheat oven to 425f
4. Boil the potatoes in water to cover , plus the remaining tsp salt , for about 10 minutes or until tender but not soft
5. Drain
6. Place the chicken in a single layer in a large baking dish
7. Bake for 20 minutes at 425f
8. Remove chicken from oven and arrange potatoes between pieces
9. In a small dish , mix together the garlic and lemon juice
10. Pour this over the chicken and potatoes
11. Return chicken to oven and bake an additional 12 minutes
12. Sprinkle with cheese and return to oven until cheese melts
13. Serve

title: carrot curry with shallots and chiles
steps:
1. In a heavy medium pan add the oil and set over medium heat
2. Add shallots and chiles to hot oil
3. Stir and fry for 2 minutes , or until the shallots have softened a bit
4. Add the carrots , cumin , coriander , fennel , cayenne pepper , turmeric , curry leaves , and salt and continue to stir and fry over medium , heat for 2-3 minutes
5. Add coconut milk and bring to simmer
6. Cover , reduce heat to low , and simmer very gently for 5 minutes

title: shelly s garlic cheese dip
steps:
1. Mix together ingredients until well blended
2. Chill
3. Serve with assorted crackers
4. 3 cups

title: rosy garlic sauteed cabbage
steps:
1. In a large nonstick skillet , heat the oil over medium heat
2. Add the garlic and saute for 3 minutes , stirring constantly
3. Pour in 1 / 2 cup of chicken broth
4. Stir , cover , and cook for 15 minutes
5. Remove the cover and cook until all liquid has evaporated , stirring constantly as the last few tablespoons of liquid evaporates
6. Stir in the cabbage
7. Sprinkle with the remaining chicken broth , paprika , and pepper to taste
8. Cook for 3-5 minutes or longer , until cabbage is wilted or to your liking , stirring constantly
9. Move to a serving bowl and serve immediately
10. Enjoy !

title: baked passionfruit cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 160oc
2. Place the biscuits in a food processor and process until fine crumbs are formed
3. Press into the bottom and 2cm up the sides of a 22cm lined and buttered spring form pan
4. Chill
5. In a medium bowl beat the cream cheese , sugar , vanilla essence and passionfruit until smooth
6. Add the eggs one at a time beating lightly after each addition and stir in the cream
7. Pour into the prepared pastry shell and bake for 1 hour or until set
8. Remove from the oven and place on a rack to cool
9. Chill for 4 hours or overnight

title: caramelized onion  green bean  and cherry tomato tian
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Cook beans in boiling water 3 minutes
3. Drain and rinse under cold water , set aside
4. Heat nonstick fry pan coated with veggie spray over medium high heat
5. Add onion and next 4 ingredients , saute 8 minutes or until lightly browned , stirring frequently
6. Stir in vinegar , basil and oregano , cook 2 minutes
7. Remove from heat
8. Arrange beans in a 11 x 7 inch baking dish coated with veggie spray
9. Top with onion mixture
10. Arrange tomatoes on top of onion mixture and sprinkle with cheese
11. Bake at 400 degrees for 35 minutes or until the cheese is lightly browned

title: chewy spicy oatmeal raisin cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350~
2. In a large bowl , cream together the butter , butter flavored shortening , brown sugar , white sugar , eggs , and vanilla until smooth
3. Combine the flour , baking soda , cinnamon , cloves , and salt
4. Stir into the sugar mixture
5. Stir in the oats and raisins
6. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets
7. Bake 10 - 12 minutes until light and golden
8. Do not overbake , you want them to be a little chewy

title: red kidney bean salad
steps:
1. Mix mayonnaise , oil vinegar , sugar , salt and pepper
2. Add onions and stir well
3. Then add the celery , beans and relish
4. Chill overnight

title: vegetarian lumpia from the philippines
steps:
1. Saute chopped carrots , leeks , shallots and salt in sesame oil til the carrots are tender and soft
2. Use the lumpia skins at either full size or 1 / 4 size
3. Moisten a lumpia skin in water and roll the vegetable mixture into the skin
4. Repeat with the remaining skins
5. Bake at 375 on a lightly oiled baking sheet for approx 20-25 minutes or until lightly browned- keep an eye on them , as ovens vary
6. Serve hot with plum or duck sauce
7. Enjoy !

title: chili sauce i
steps:
1. Combine all vegetables
2. Cook until some of the liquid has evaporated
3. Place cloves and broken cinnamon sticks in a cheese cloth , tie
4. Add vinegar , salt , sugars , spice bag , celery and mustard seed to vegetable mixture
5. Cook until thickened
6. Seal in pint jars and process 15 minutes in hot water bath

title: light baked butternut squash
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Place the squash halves on a cookie sheet
3. Spray each half of the squash 5-10 times with the butter spray
4. Sprinkle each half of the squash with brown sugar
5. Bake at 350 for an hour or until soft
6. Serve in shell

title: devilled chicken
steps:
1. Mix ingredients except chicken well
2. Coat chicken well
3. Allow to stand for 2 hours
4. Bake in top 1 / 3 of 400f oven for 30 minutes

title: curried chicken and peanut stew
steps:
1. In a large non-stick saute pan , sear chicken breasts on each side for 1 minute
2. Set aside
3. In the same pan , saute shallot , celery and carrot in 2t oil on low for about 5 minutes or until softened
4. Sprinkle with curry powder
5. Mix well
6. Slowly add beer and stir as curry begins to thicken
7. Remove from heat and set aside
8. In a 8qt stockpot , saute garlic in remaining 1t olive oil over med heat for 1 minute
9. Add chicken , bay leaves& tomatoes
10. Cover& simmer for 20 minutes , stirring occasionally
11. Add curry mixture to the chicken and tomatoes , along with the chile pepper , parsley , and peanut butter / water
12. When all is well combined , add stock and simmer , covered , for 30 minutes
13. Remove bay leaves
14. Remove chicken breasts , cool and dice the meat
15. Return chicken to stockpot
16. If desired , add sugar and cilantro
17. Taste , adjust seasonings , and serve

title: pasta with tuna  bacon  and broccoli
steps:
1. Heat olive oil and saute onion and garlic until soft
2. Add broccoli and tuna , cook until broccoli is tender
3. Add bacon , italian seasoning , black pepper and wine
4. Heat through
5. Add to pasta and toss with remaining olive oil and cheese

title: if give a kid a candy    they always come back  for more  fruit
steps:
1. Cut fruit
2. Put sugar in one bowl and coconut in another
3. Roll fruit pieces in sugar and then roll in coconut
4. Place on cookie sheets in the freezer and fast freeze
5. Once frozen , you can place each type frut in a zip loc freezer bag and take out as needed
6. Do not thaw--eat within 5-8 minutes of taking them out of the freezer
7. Delish !

title: south beach chilled espresso custard
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , whisk together all the ingredients until well blended
2. Pour into four 6 ounce custard cups or ramekins and place in a 10" skillet
3. Fill the skillet with water to 1 / 2" from the top of the custard cups
4. Bring the water to a boil overhigh heat
5. Reduce the heat to low
6. Cover , and simmer for 10 minutes
7. Remove the cups from the skillet , cover with plastic wrap touching the surface of the pudding , and refrigerate for 3 hours , or until chilled
8. Garnish with cinnamon if desired

title: chocolate chip challah
steps:
1. In a large bowl , dissolve the yeast and 1 tablespoon of sugar in the water
2. Whisk until completely combined
3. Add vegetable oil and whisk
4. Then add 4 of the eggs , whisking for about one minute after each egg is added
5. Whisk in remaining sugar and salt
6. Add flour one cup at a time , mixing with a sturdy spoon after each cup
7. When all of the flour has been added , turn dough onto floured surface and knead the dough to remove all lumps
8. Clean out bowl and grease it
9. Form dough into a ball and return it to the bowl
10. Let dough rise for one hour in a warm
11. The dough should approximately double in size
12. Punch it down and then put chocolate chips in center of dough and reform dough into a ball so that the chocolate chips are encased in the center of the dough
13. Allow to rise for another 30 minutes
14. Remove dough from warm spot and place dough ball onto floured surface
15. Using a long serated knife , cut the dough in half and then cut each halve into thirds
16. Reform all six dough balls so that the chocolate is encased in the center of each ball
17. Then , using your hands , roll out each ball into a strand approximately 15 inches in length
18. Take three strands and pinch them together at one end , tucking the pinched ends under the bread
19. Braid the three strands together
20. When you get to the end of the strands , pinch the strands together and tuck under loaf
21. Repeat for remaining three strands to create a second loaf
22. Lightly grease a large baking sheet
23. Gently transfer the challahs to the baking sheet
24. Whisk remaining egg in a small bowl and brush generously onto each challah
25. Return loafs to warm spot to rise for another 30 minutes
26. Preheat oven to 375
27. Brush challahs with second round of egg wash
28. Be sure to get egg wash into all the cracks and crevices
29. Place loaves into oven on middle rack
30. Fill a baking dish or roasting pan with about two inches of water
31. Place dish on the rack below the challahs
32. Bake the challahs for thirty minutes , rotating the baking sheet once in the middle of baking time
33. Challahs should have a medium golden brown crust and sound hollow when tapped
34. Be sure to check challahs near end of baking time in order to avoid over cooking
35. Continue cooking past 30 minutes if challahs aren't golden brown yet
36. Cool challahs completely on wire baking rack

title: myers s planter s punch
steps:
1. Mix first 3 ingredients in shaker or blender
2. Add sugar and grenadine
3. Shake or blend until frothy
4. Serve over shaved ice in a highball glass
5. If desired , garnish with a slice of orange , a cherry , and a sprig of mint

title: slow cooker white chili
steps:
1. Add the first 10 ingredients to a large slow cooker
2. Stir to combine
3. Cover and cook 8-10 hours on low
4. Crush tortilla chips to roughly 1-inch pieces and add to individual serving bowls
5. Ladle chili on top
6. Serve with lime wedges , cilantro , and sour cream

title: pineapple upside down bundt cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Melt butter in bundt pan in oven
3. Spray cooking spray on the parts of the pan that aren't covered by the melted butter
4. Sprinkle brown sugar over melted butter
5. Place maraschino cherries on top of sugar
6. Spread crushed pineapple over all
7. Mix cake ingredients according to the package directions regarding time and mixer speeds
8. Pour cake mix over topping ingredients in pan
9. Bake for 40 minutes , until golden brown
10. Test for doneness , knife or toothpick inserted should come out clean
11. Immediately invert onto serving platter and remove pan carefully so none of the topping stays in the pan
12. Cool completely before serving

title: forget applesauce  serve apples
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine apple slices and lemon juice
2. Toss gently but well
3. In a skillet , melt butter over medium-high heat and add apples and honey
4. Cook for 2 or 3 minutes , stirring gently , until apples are glazed , and tender
5. Serve immediately

title: zucchini bread made with brown sugar and molasses
steps:
1. Prepare bread pans ,
2. I just use pam cooking spray
3. In large mixing bowl: beat eggs until frothy , add sugar , oil , molasses , vanilla , and zucchini , mix well
4. Combine flour slowly , add soda , baking powder , cinnamon , nutmeg , and salt
5. Also add nuts if desired
6. Pour into bread pans , bake at 325f for 40 to 45 minutes or until you can stick a toothpick in and it comes out clean
7. This recipe makes 3 large or 6 small bread pans
8. This may vary

title: ham and pickle wraps
steps:
1. Spread cream cheese on room temperature tortillas
2. Spread 1 / 2 c chopped pickles on top of cream cheese on each tortilla
3. Lay out slices of ham over pickles
4. If using turkey too lay out your slice over the ham
5. Roll tortillas tightly and place toothpicks ever 1 1 / 2 inches or so
6. (do not
7. Use colored toothpicks as the color will bleed into your wraps ! )
8. Slice between toothpicks
9. Serve cold

title: lemon pepper boneless pork country style ribs with bacon
steps:
1. Spray a glass 8 x 10 flat dish with pam
2. Preheat oven to 375
3. Place the bonless country style ribs in the glass dish
4. Sprinkle the top with all seasoning
5. Then sprinkle the lemon pepper all over , tops and sides
6. Lay the bacon strips over the top of the ribs
7. Push the ribs together so the bacon strips cover all of the ribs
8. Sprinkle lemon pepper over the slices of bacon
9. Cover tightly with alumimum foil
10. Cook for 45 minutes
11. Then peek , should be fork tender , if not a few minutes longer
12. I wrap up medium potatoes , coat with margarine , foil and cook at the same time
13. Serve with coleslaw , or other salad
14. I have never had any leftovers
15. There is something about the flavor of lemon pepper and bacon with pork that is tantalizing to the taste buds

title: chocolate peanut butter cereal treats
steps:
1. In a large pot over medium heat , melt butter and peanut butter
2. Coat a 9-inch x 13-inch baking pan with cooking spray
3. Set aside
4. Add marshmallows and stir constantly until mixture is melted and smooth
5. Then add cocoa powder and vanilla and stir until fully incorporated
6. Remove from heat
7. A little at a time , stir in cereal until marshmallow mixture is fully incorporated
8. Pour into prepared baking pan
9. Using your hands , lightly-sprayed with cooking spray , press cereal mixture into baking pan
10. Allow to cool
11. With a sharp knife , slice into desired-sized pieces and enjoy !

title: lemon walnut pesto stuffed cherry tomatoes
steps:
1. Put all pesto ingredients in food processor and process until slightly chunky , or desired consistency
2. Taste and adjust seasonings , as necessary
3. Cut tomatoes and remove seeds and juice
4. Fill tomato with pesto using a pastry bag or ziploc bag
5. Sprinkle with paprika just before serving
6. Serve chilled or room temperature

title: always successful fast eggs benedict
steps:
1. Put 8 small plates in oven set on lowest temperature to warm
2. In a small saucepan over medium heat , melt butter
3. Whisk in contents of hollandaise package
4. Only use knorr brand , and do not use the package instructions
5. Slowly whisk in milk a little at a time so as to avoid lumps
6. Turn heat down to medium low and watch carefully , whisking occaisonally as it thickens
7. When it's the right consistancy , gently stir in 1 tsp lemon juice
8. Add canadian bacon slices
9. Cover and set on low until needed
10. Split english muffins and toast lightly
11. Set one on each plate in oven to keep warm
12. Gently fry eggs over medium heat
13. I usually crack 4 eggs into a small bowl and add all at once to a small skillet
14. Once the whites start to set up , i add about 2 tbs water , lightly salt , and cover with glass lid so you can watch the eggs
15. They will steam or boil gently
16. While eggs are cooking , place one piece of canadian bacon onto each piece of english muffin on plates in oven
17. Place one egg on each prepared plate
18. If cooking 4 eggs at a time , leave the first 4 plated in the oven
19. Spoon hollandaise over each plate and sprinkle lightly with paprika and serve

title: salmon and pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook the pasta according to package directions
2. Drain and set aside
3. In a mixing bowl , combine yogurt , mayonnaise , lemon juice , basil , oregano , salt , and pepper
4. In a separate bowl mix remaining ingredients , add it to the first mixture
5. Toss to coat pasta
6. Transfer to a container , and chill for at least 1 hour before serving
7. Before serving , make sure to gently stir it all up again well
8. Don't be afraid to experiment !

title: crock pot french onion soup for the lazy
steps:
1. Slice or chop onions , then mix all of the above in a crock pot and set it for 8 hours
2. Eat
3. Or if you want to get fancy , serve it this way: add one slice of dry crusty french bread into each bowl and pour soup over the bread into the bowl
4. Cover with gruyere or jarlsberg cheese and put under the broiler for about 2 minutes until cheese bubbles and gets a little brown

title: praline topped oatmeal cake
steps:
1. Grease 9x13 pan
2. Preheat oven to 350
3. Combine oatmeal and boiling water in small bowl
4. Cover and set aside 10 minutes
5. Cream butter and sugars till fluffy
6. Beat in eggs and vanilla
7. Add oatmeal to mixture stirring to incorporate
8. Add dry ingredients , blending well
9. Pour into pan
10. Bake 30-40 minutes
11. While cake bakes , prepare topping: combine all topping ingredients in bowl
12. When cake tests done spread topping evenly over cake
13. Broil till just bubbly , about 5-6 minutes
14. Watch this last step carefully to prevent over browning

title: 10 grain sorta healthy cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix all ingredients
3. Roll into small balls
4. Place on a cookie sheet
5. Bake for 10 minutes
6. Cool for one minute , put on cooling rack
7. Give them to kids with a little less guilt

title: broccoli rabe with garlic and pasta with vegetarian sausage
steps:
1. Cut broccoli rabe all the way down to end of stems
2. Cut in about 1 / 2 inch sections on top and get smaller as you go down
3. When stems get very tough towards bottom stop cutting and discard
4. Wash thoroughly and drain
5. Place in large pot cover with water add salt
6. Bring to boil uncovered and then reduce heat
7. Simmer until all is soft about 45 minutes
8. Drain when cooked set aside
9. At the same time broccoli is cooking , cook pasta in rapidly boiling salted water
10. Drain when cooked and put aside
11. While pasta and rabe are cooking fry the sausage in about 1 / 2 tablespoons olive oil until brown
12. Set aside
13. Chop garlic
14. Place olive oil in pan heat and then add garlic
15. When you smell the garlic add the hot pepper and slowly add brocoli rabe
16. Toss oil and garlic through all broccoli rabe
17. Toss in pasta and sausage
18. Cover with generous sprinkle of parmasian cheese
19. Serve
20. Enjoy !

title: bibingka  sweet rice flour
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees and butter or spray a 9 x 13 glass dish
2. Cream the butter , sugar and eggs in a bowl
3. Add remaining ingredients and blend well
4. Pour into glass dish and bake for 40-50 minutes
5. Edges should have a nice light brown color while the middle is a nice cream color
6. Eat hot or cold
7. I like to add the shredded coconut to the batter
8. For the last 15 minutes of baking , i also like to take some of the shredded coconut and sprinkle it to the top of the cake to toast the coconut
9. Very delicious !

title: pesto goat cheese dip
steps:
1. Spread the desired amount of goat cheese into a shallow dish
2. Spread pesto over the top- just enough to coat it nicely
3. Sprinkle with pine nuts
4. Heat in 350 degree oven or microwave until heated through
5. Serve with crackers

title: caldo verde
steps:
1. In a large stockpot or dutch oven , heat 1 tablespoon of the oil
2. Brown the sausage over high heat until charred on all sides , about 4 minutes
3. Remove to a bowl
4. Add the remaining oil and saut the onion until translucent , 5 minutes
5. Stir in the garlic , paprika , chili flakes and salt
6. Cook one minute more
7. Add the cherry tomatoes and cook until theyve begun to blister , soften , and release their juices , about 5 minutes
8. Return the sausage to the pot , along with the potato , stock or water , and bay leaf
9. Bring to a boil over high heat , then reduce to medium-low
10. Simmer the soup until the potatoes are tender , about 15 minutes
11. Fold in the kale and beans and continue to simmer until soft , another 10 minutes
12. Taste for seasoning and add more salt as necessary
13. Ladle the portuguese kale soup into bowls and enjoy alongside crusty bread
14. You can mash a few of the potatoes or beans to create a thicker broth

title: creole artichoke olive cole slaw
steps:
1. Combine oil , vinegar , mustard , shallots , sugar , and cayenne pepper in a large bowl , mix well
2. Add cabbage , artichoke hearts and olives , mix well
3. Cover and chill at least 1 hour or up to 24 hours before serving

title: beyond grilled chicken salad
steps:
1. Dressing: in a small container with a lid , combine dressing ingredients
2. Cover and shake well
3. Set aside for about 1 hour
4. Salad: sprinkle breasts with steak sauce
5. Let rest for 15-30 minutes
6. Toast the pine nuts in a cast-iron skillet or in the oven--to golden brown
7. Set aside
8. Grill or broil chicken breasts until tender and no longer pink--turning once
9. Cool slightly
10. Arrange greens on four plates , top with grapes , cheese and nuts
11. Slice each breast width-wise , arrange on each salad
12. Shake dressing agrain and drizzle over each salad
13. Substitutions: other nuts will do fine for the pine-nuts
14. Try bleu cheese instead of the feta--it's a whole different salad then !

title: farmhouse beef casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Lightly coat a 2-qt
3. Casserole with cooking spray
4. Peel and grate the potato into a bowl
5. Stir in 1 / 4 cup of the cheese
6. Spread evenly over the bottom of the prepared casserole
7. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes , until the potato is browned and crispy
8. Meanwhile , brown the ground sirloin , onion , and garlic in a large non-stick skillet , breaking up the beef with a wooden spoon as it browns
9. Discard any excess fat
10. Stir in tomatoes with their juice , chili powder , and the cabbage
11. Season with pepper to taste
12. Saute , stirring , for a minute or two
13. If mixture seems too dry , add a tablespoon of the bottled taco sauce , adding up to 2 tablespoons more
14. When potatoes are done , spoon beef mixture on top of potatos
15. Top with remaining cheese and jalapeno slices
16. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes , until cssserole is hot and bubbly
17. Serve at once

title: pudina  mint  roti
steps:
1. Sift flour and salt
2. Rub ghee evenly
3. Add water& make a stiff dough
4. Add mint paste
5. Mix well
6. Keep aside for 30 minutes
7. Divide the dough into 10 parts
8. Shape them with your palm and flatten them
9. Roll each part into a round
10. Place one at a time on a hot griddle
11. Shallow fry with ghee
12. Serve hot with a raita of your choice

title: beat the clock stir fry
steps:
1. Bring 1 1 / 2 cups water and 1 cup of the beef broth to a boil in a medium saucepan
2. Add the rice , cover the pan and take the pan off the heat until ready to serve
3. Let the vegetable oil get hot in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat
4. Add in the onion and stir / saute for 2 minutes
5. Add in the carrots and mushrooms to the skillet
6. Stir / saute 1 minute
7. Add in the bee strips and increase heat to medium-high
8. Stir-fry for about 3 minutes
9. Add in the water chestnuts , broccoli , sherry , garlic , ginger , and soy sauce
10. Stir-fry 2-3 minutes
11. Add 1 / 2 cup broth to the skillet
12. Mix together the remaining 1 / 4 cup broth and cornstarch in a small bowl
13. Add the mixture to the skillet along with the sesame oil
14. Stir / saute for about 3 minutes or until the liquid thickens
15. Serve over hot rice

title: best ever rich chocolate fudge cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease and flour 3 9-inch cake pans
3. In a large mixing bowl , cream the butter until smooth
4. Gradually pour in the brown sugar , then eggs
5. Beat with mixer until light and fluffy , approx 5 minutes
6. On low speed , beat in the vanilla extract , melted chocolate , baking soda and salt
7. Add flour alternately with sour cream , beating at low speed until smooth
8. Pour in boiling hot water and stir until blended
9. Pour into the prepared pan
10. Bake about 25 minutes or until done
11. Remove from oven , let cakes cool about 10-15 minutes , then place on wire racks

title: oreo banana split pie
steps:
1. Mix 22 oreo crushed cookies and butter in medium bowl for crust
2. Press firmly on bottom and sides of 9-inch pie plate
3. Finely chop 8 cookies
4. Set aside
5. Halve remaining 4 cookies
6. Set aside
7. Spread chocolate ice cream into pie crust
8. Freeze 30 minutes or until ice cream is firm
9. Drizzle half the fudge sauce over ice cream
10. Top with finely chopped cookies and half the banana slices
11. Carefully spread strawberry ice cream over banana slices
12. Stand cookie halves around edge of pie
13. Top with remaining fudge sauce and remaining banana slices
14. Freeze at least 1 hour or until firm

title: stir fry with scallops   jumbo asparagus
steps:
1. Trim or break off asparagus spears at tender point
2. Rinse and cut into 2-inch diagonal pieces
3. Cook asparagus until crisp-tender , about 3 to 5 minutes
4. Do not overcook
5. Drain and rinse under cold water
6. Combine chicken broth , cornstarch and soy sauce and set aside
7. Stir-fry halved scallops and mushrooms in oil with garlic until scallops are just cooked through , about 4 minutes
8. Stir in cornstarch mixture
9. Cook , stirring , until sauce thickens
10. Add drained asparagus , tomatoes and green onions
11. Heat
12. Pepper to taste
13. Serve over rice

title: cherry chicken salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the chicken , cherries , celery , onion , apple , egg and sliced almonds
2. In another small bowl , combine the mayo and lemon juice
3. Add to chicken mixture and mix well
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste
5. Refrigerate for 1 hour to allow flavors to blend
6. Serve on croissants or crackers

title: unsweetened spiced vinegar
steps:
1. Tie the spices in a spice bag or piece of cheesecloth
2. Place vinegar and spice bag in non-reactive pot
3. Bring to a boil and cook about 10 minutes
4. Cool
5. Store vinegar and spice bag in air-tight plastic or glass container
6. After about 1 month , remove the bag from the vinegar
7. Sweetened spiced vinegar: to sweeten this recipe , add 3 1 / 2 cups granulated sugar
8. Good for pickled beets or pickled peaches

title: pistachio dream cake
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , combine dry cake and pudding mixes , yogurt , egg whites and vanilla
2. Beat on low speed for 1 minute
3. Gradually beat in soda
4. Pour into a 13-in
5. X 9-in
6. X 2-in
7. Baking pan coated with nonstick cooking spray
8. Bake at 350 for 20-25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
9. Cool
10. For frosting , combine milk and dry pudding mix in a mixing bowl
11. Beat on low for 2 minutes
12. Fold in whipped topping
13. Spread over cake
14. Store in the refrigerator
15. Yield: 20 servings

title: hand me an omelet muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Prepare a 12-muffin pan with paper liners
3. Spray liners with non-stick spray
4. In a large bowl , mix together all of the ingredients
5. Spoon egg mixture into liners to about 3 / 4 of the way
6. Place in oven and bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until tops are golden brown
7. Cool on wire rack for about 5 minutes before removing from tins and serving , or cool completely before storing or freezing

title: aprs ski holiday hot chocolate with  brandy and cream
steps:
1. Gently boil the milk in a large heavy based saucepan , remove as boiling point is reached
2. Place chocolate in a small pan and add 2 tablespoons of the milk
3. Stir over a low heat until melted , then add the melted chocolate mixture into the remaining milk , stirring well
4. Add the sugar , cinnamon and brandy
5. Adjust to taste at this point
6. Serve the brandy hot chocolate in tall heatproof glasses or mugs , top with a dollop of whipped cream lightly dusted with cocoa powder or cinnamon
7. Serve with a cinnamon stick for a "stirrer" !
8. Salut !

title: healthier avocado smoothie
steps:
1. Put all ingredients into a blender
2. First pulse blender to aid in crushing the ice well
3. Blend until a smooth consistency
4. Taste to see if it is sweet enough
5. Depending on the size of the avocado , you may need more
6. Pour into cups and enjoy promptly
7. This recipe is best not left sitting because of the ice and the avocado

title: jolean s killer spaghetti sauce
steps:
1. In a large stockpot or dutch oven , saute' onion , celery , green pepper and garlic in oil until partially tender
2. Push aside in the pot
3. Add ground meats and brown
4. Chop meat into rather large chunks -- not too small
5. Mix meat and saute'd vegetables well
6. Add tomato paste , tomato sauce and stewed tomatoes and stir , mixing well
7. Add sliced mushrooms and whole mushrooms with liquid
8. Stir
9. Add all the spices including the grated parmesan cheese
10. Mix thoroughly
11. Bring to a boil
12. Stir and simmer for at least 1 1 / 2 hours , stirring frequently
13. Serve sauce over cooked , drained and buttered vermicelli pasta
14. Sprinkle additional grated parmesan cheese on top , if desired

title: soaked grain muffins or quick bread
steps:
1. Put first 4 ingredients into blender in order and blend for 3 minutes on high
2. Cover and let stand on counter for at least 7 hours , overnight , or 12 hours
3. After soaking , add salt , soda , powder and eggs
4. Blend until mixed
5. Stir in any additions
6. Put into prepared muffin pans and bake at 400 degrees for 20-25 minutes
7. Mini muffins: bake at 400 degrees for 10-15 minutes
8. Loaves: bake at 350 degrees for 55 minutes or until tests done
9. Additions:
10. ~for blueberry / millet: 2 c blueberries , 2 t cinnamon , 1 / 2 c millet
11. ~for banana: 4-6 mashed bananas , 2 t cinnamon , , 1 / 2 c - 1 c walnuts
12. ~for carrot or zucchini: 2 c grated carrot or zucchini , 2 t cinnamon , 1 / 2 c - 1 c oats
13. ~ for chocolate: 6-7 t cocoa powder , 1-2 c chocolate chips
14. ~ for apple: 2 diced apples , 2 t cinnamon , 1 t nutmeg , optional
15. ~ for poppyseed: 4 t poppy seeds , 2 t vanilla
16. ~for pumpkin: 2 c pureed pumpkin , 2 t cinnamon , 1 / 2 t nutmeg , 1 / 4 t ground cloves

title: grilled asparagus with lemon   mint
steps:
1. About 30 minutes prior to grilling , combine olive oil , lemon juice , and mint
2. Brush fresh asparagus with olive oil marinade and allow to sit
3. Heat up grill and place asparagus on grill with tongs
4. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and cook for about 5-7 minutes
5. Serve immediately

title: dump cake iii
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f and lightly grease a 13 x 9 pan
2. Spread each of the ingredients evenly in oblong pan or pyrex dish , one on top of the other , in the order listed
3. Do not mix
4. Bake 1 hour
5. Deluxe dump cake: same as before with the additional ingredient of 1 can cherry pie filling as the first ingredient

title: white bean mash
steps:
1. Bring chicken broth to a boil in medium saucepan
2. Add beans , thyme , and pepper
3. Reduce heat and simmer for about 10 minutes
4. Stir in spinach and salt
5. Continue simmering for another minute
6. Pour bean mixture into food processor , reserving about 1 / 3 of the liquid , and blend until fairly smooth
7. Add more liquid if necessary to achieve desired consistency while blending

title: coq au vin  chicken in wine
steps:
1. Heat oil in large skillet
2. Brown chicken pieces lightly and place in large pot
3. Add to skillet and brown lightly , smoked meat , scallions , carrot and garlic
4. Add flour , parsley flakes , majoram , bay leaf , salt , pepper , and wine and bring to a simmer
5. Pour over chicken
6. The chicken should be covered
7. Simmer over low heat for 1 hour
8. Add mushrooms during last 5 minutes
9. Your house will smell great
10. Serve with rice

title: turtle  squares
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Spray a 13 x 9 baking pan evenly with non-stick cooking spray
3. Beat 1 cup brown sugar with 1 / 2 cup melted butter with an electric mixer on medium for 2-3 minutes
4. Add the flour mixture and mix until smooth
5. Press the flour mixture evenly and firmly into the prepared baking pan
6. Sprinkle the pecans evenly oven the flour mixture in the pan
7. Mix the 2 / 3 cup butter and 1 / 2 cup brown sugar in a saucepan and bring to a boil over a medium heat
8. Stir constantly while boiling for about 1 minute
9. Spread the boiling mixture evenly over the pecans
10. Bake for about 20 minutes
11. Cool
12. Melt the chocolate chips in the microwave , stirring ever 30 seconds or so until almost smooth
13. Remove the chocolate chips , stir thoroughly to smooth and spread evenly over the top of the squares
14. Chill for 15 minutes until the chocolate sets and then remove from fridge
15. When squares have returned to room temperature cut into 36 squares

title: delicious yeast rolls
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast in the warm water
2. Sift flour and sugar together
3. Add oil
4. Add yeast mixture and mix well
5. Shape into rolls or roll out and cut
6. Let rise for 1 1 / 2 hours
7. Bake at 400 degrees for about 12 minutes

title: spicy tex mex meatballs
steps:
1. Peel and grate the onion , peel and crush the garlic , deseed and chop the red capsicum , drain and chop the beans
2. In a bowl , mix together the beans , onion , garlic , red capsicum , chillies , beef , seasoning and half the coriander , until they are well-combined
3. Divide the beef mixture into 32 pieces , then roll them into balls
4. Place the balls on a baking sheet and chill for 30 minutes
5. Meanwhile , halve the avocados and remove the stones , peel and chop the flesh and put in a bowl
6. Stir in the chilli sauce , lemon juice and the remaining coriander
7. Heat the oil in a pan , fry the meatballs in batches for 6 minutes , turning occasionally , until cooked and tender
8. Lightly toast the pita breads and split open , fill with mixed salad leaves and meatballs , spoon over the avocado mixture and sour cream and serve immediately
9. Chef's
10. Thaw at room temperature before frying

title: lemon garlic roast chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Sprinkle salt and pepper in cavity of chicken
3. Combine garlic , onion and celery and stuff into the cavity
4. Combine lemon juice and zest with the olive oil and brush over the skin of the chicken
5. Season generously with salt and pepper
6. Place chicken in roasting pan and roast for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until done
7. Remove from roasting pan and let rest for 15 minutes before serving

title: pineapple upside down cake for two
steps:
1. Place rack in the center of the oven and preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Place 1 1 / 2 tsps butter in two muffin cups
3. Bake until butter is bubbly and beginning to turn golden , 1 minute
4. Remove them from the oven and add 1 / 2 tbsp of brown sugar into the butter in each muffin and then sprinkle half of the pineapple tidbits into each one
5. In a small bowl , combine buttermilk , pineapple juice , egg yoke and vanilla and whisk to blend
6. In a separte bowl combine flour , sugar , baking soda and salt
7. Add remaining 2 tablespoons of butter and half of the buttermilk mixture
8. Beat with a handheld mixer on low speed until the dry ingredients are moistened
9. Increase speed to medium and beat until the batter is lightened and has slightly increased in volume , 45 seconds
10. Scrape down bowl
11. Pour in remaining buttermilk mixture and beat mixture on medium speed until well blended , 20 seconds
12. Divide batter evenly between the two cups and then fill remaining cup 1 / 2 with water to prevent warping
13. Bake the cakes until a toothpick comes out clean , 20 to 24 minutes
14. Remove the muffin pan from the oven and place it on a wire rack to cool for 5 minutes
15. Carefully pour the water out of the pan and keep it away from the cakes
16. Using a large plate and pot holders , invert cakes onto plate and enjoy warm with ice cream if desired

title: preserves  frozen berries  strawberry  cherry  blueberry
steps:
1. For the strawberry
2. Roughly chop strawberries
3. Mix all other ingredients and cook in a nonstick pan over meduim heat
4. Stir frequently , cook at least 20 to 30 minutes
5. This will thicken as it cooks and a bit more after it cools
6. You will know when it is ready when it has greatly reduced and is thick
7. Patience
8. For the blueberry and cherry
9. Mix all ingredients and stir over meduim heat for 20 to 30 minutes
10. This will thicken as it cooks and a bit more after it cools
11. You will know when it is ready when it has greatly reduced and is thick
12. Each will produce about 2 cups of preserves and can be frozen or stored in the refrigerator for a couple weeks

title: oatmeal school cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Cream together the butter and sugar with electric beaters
3. Add the egg , vanilla , and salt and beat well
4. Stir flour , baking powder , wheat germ , and rolled oats together with a fork
5. Add raisins so they get rolled in flour and don't stick together
6. Blend well with other ingredients
7. I usually end up using my hands
8. Add a little water if necessary to hold mixture together
9. Place by tablespoonful on greased cookie sheets
10. Flatten them slightly
11. Bake for 10-12 minutes

title: no mayo potato salad
steps:
1. Scrub the potatoes , or peel them if you don't like skins
2. Cut into 1-inch cubes and cook in boiling water about 15 minutes or until almost starting to fall apart
3. While the potatoes are cooking , slice the spring onions very finely , including the green part
4. Drain the potatoes and transfer to a bowl
5. While they're still hot , pour in the olive oil and mix well
6. They should start to loose their shape a bit- this is the secret of this salad !
7. Add the spring onions , vinegar , salt and black pepper
8. Taste as you go along and adjust the amounts of salt , pepper , vinegar and oil to your taste
9. Leave to cool
10. Chill if you wish , and serve

title: minted baby carrots
steps:
1. Put 6 cups of water into a large pan
2. Boil carrots until tender crisp
3. About 10 minutes
4. Drain
5. In a small pan , stir cornstarch into apple juice
6. Over moderate heat , cook , stirring , until sauce consistency
7. Stir in mint and cinnamon
8. Pour sauce over carrots and toss to coat

title: african couscous salad
steps:
1. To toast slivered almonds , cook on a baking sheet at 375f for 5 to 10 minutes , checking and stirring frequently
2. Or , cook in a small skillet over medium heat for about 5 minutes , stirring frequently until golden brown
3. Bring broth to a boil in a large saucepan
4. Stir in couscous , butter and cinnamon
5. Cover and remove from heat
6. Let stand for 5 minutes , then fluff with a fork and let cool
7. Place remaining salad ingredients in a bowl
8. Drizzle with dressing and toss well to coat
9. Cover and chill for at least 1 hour
10. Tangy orange dressing: in a medium bowl , whisk together orange juice , extra virgin olive oil , white wine vinegar , honey , salt and pepper

title: four chip fudge
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large saucepan over low heat
2. Stir in condensed milk and regular milk
3. Add all morsels , stirring constantly until smooth
4. Remove from heat
5. Stir in marshmallow cream and extracts
6. Spoon mixture evenly into a large pan , or several smaller ones , depending on how thick you want the fudge to be
7. I recommend not making it too thick , it's very sweet
8. Cover and chill
9. Cut into squares , store in fridge

title: cedar plank salmon
steps:
1. Soak a 10 inch long , 6" to 8" wide , construction grade cedar plank 3 / 4" thick , in water for at least 24 hours before making the recipe
2. Make sure you keep the wood submerged by weighing it down with cans
3. Start your barbecue and heat it to high
4. Rub the salmon filets all over with the oil , sprinkle each one with some of the shallots , top with a few sprigs of fresh dill and a squirt of lemon juice
5. Finish with the crushed peppercorns
6. Put the plank on the bbq and sprinkle with a little coarse salt
7. Close the cover for a couple of minutes or just until the top of the plank is nearly dry
8. Place the filets on top of the plank
9. If your bbq has two burners , turn off the one beneath the wood
10. If not , turn the heat to the lowest setting
11. Close the cover and cook for about 10- 12 minutes or until nearly cooked all the way through
12. Don't overcook
13. Squeeze some lemon juice over the top , serve and enjoy
14. The plank can only be used once
15. Make sure it has stopped smoking and is well extinguished before disposing of it

title: baked carrots in creamy horseradish sauce
steps:
1. Boil carrots in chicken broth for 10 minutes
2. Drain well
3. Mix together carrots and horseradish sauce until carrots are well coated
4. Place carrot mixture in 9x13 baking dish
5. Top with crushed potato chips
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes or until chips are golden brown
7. Let stand for at least 5 minutes before serving

title: dry fried green beans
steps:
1. Wash green beans and dry thoroughly
2. Snap off stems
3. Heat oil in large skillet or wok over medium high heat until almost at the smoking point
4. Add the dry beans to the hot oil and stir-fry until the beans start to get some dark brown spots
5. Add the walnuts and continue to stir-fry to cook all sides of the beans and toast the nuts
6. Sprinkle on the chili flakes and toss to distribute evenly
7. Remove from heat , salt and pepper to taste

title: orange balsamic glazed chicken
steps:
1. In a large pan , heat the extra-virgin olive oil over medium-high to high heat
2. Season the chicken liberally with salt , pepper and poultry seasoning
3. When the oil is hot , add the chicken and brown for 5 minutes , then turn and sprinkle with the chopped rosemary
4. Cook about 5 minutes more , until done
5. In a small bowl , stir together the marmalade , vinegar and stock and pour over the chicken
6. Add the scallions and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until the sauce has thickened and becomes a thin glaze
7. Drizzle sauce over chicken and top each piece with arugula greens

title: sausage and egg breakfast casserole   simply recipes
steps:
1. 1 heat a skillet on medium high
2. Break up the sausage into chunks and cook , working in batches if need be , until browned all around
3. Make sure the chunks of sausage have some space around them or your meat will steam and not brown
4. Remove the cooked sausage from the pan and let sit on some paper towels on a plate to soak up the excess fat
5. Crumble into smaller pieces
6. 2 place bread in a well buttered 9x13 inch baking pan
7. Sprinkle with cheese
8. Combine the eggs , milk , dry mustard , onion powder and pepper
9. Pour evenly over the bread and cheese
10. Sprinkle sausage and optional ingredients over the top
11. 3 at this stage you can cover and chill overnight , if you want to prepare ahead
12. If not , let sit for 10 minutes before putting in the oven
13. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
14. Bake uncovered for about one hour
15. Tent with foil if top begins to brown too quickly

title: mozzarella portobellos  american heart association
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400f
2. Lightly spray a nonstick baking sheet with vegetable oil spray
3. Lightly spray both sides of the mushrooms with vegetable oil spray
4. Place with the stem side up on the baking sheet
5. Bake for 12 minutes , or until fork tender
6. Set aside
7. Meanwhile , heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
8. Remove from heat and lightly spray with vegetable oil spray
9. Cook the zucchini , bell peppers , onion , and basil for 5 minutes , or until the zucchini is tender
10. Stir in the tomato sauce , sugar , salt , and red pepper flakes
11. Cook for 4 minutes , or until thickened , stirring frequently
12. Spoon 1 / 2 cup zucchini mixture over each mushroom
13. Top with the mozzarella cheese
14. Bake for 5 minutes , or until the mozzarella has melted
15. Remove frome oven
16. Sprinkle with the parmesan

title: crudites with roasted garlic and red bell pepper dip
steps:
1. Roasted garlic:
2. Preheat the oven to 350f
3. Place the garlic on foil-lined baking sheet and rub 1 teaspoon of oil into the top of each head
4. Sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper and place cut sides down , on baking sheet
5. Bake until the cloves are soft and golden , about 1 hour
6. Remove from the oven and let sit until cool enough to handle
7. Squeeze each head of garlic expel the cloves into a bowl
8. Mash into a paste
9. Set aside until needed
10. Prepare dip:
11. Roast the pepper by placing them on an open glas flame , turning them frequently with tongs until all sides are charred black , 7-10 minutes
12. Place in a plastic or paper bag , and cool for about 15 minutes
13. Peel the peppers , remove the seeds and stems , and discard
14. Coarsley chop the peppers
15. Transfer the peppers and garlic to a food processor and process until smooth
16. Add the cheese and process until smooth
17. With the machine running , add 1 / 4 cup of the extra-virgin olive oil and lemon juice in a steady stream through the feed tube
18. Add the basil , oregano , red pepper flakes and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt , and process until smooth
19. Adjust the seasoning , to taste
20. Transfer to a decorative bowl and refrigerate for 1 hour
21. Before serving , drizzle with the remaining 1 teaspoon of extra-virgin olive oil and sprinkle with the parsley
22. Serve cool or at room temp , with assorted crudites for dipping

title: two summer squash saute
steps:
1. Melt butter in non-stick skillet
2. Add squashes , salt and pepper and saute until tender crisp
3. Remove from heat and sprinkle with cheese
4. Keep warm until ready to serve

title: sweet bbq chicken dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Spread cream cheese into bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking dish
3. Stir together chicken , cranberry sauce , chili sauce , worcestershire sauce , vinegar , mustard and red pepper flakes in medium bowl
4. Spoon mixture over cream cheese in baking dish
5. Sprinkle with cheese
6. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes or until heated through
7. Sprinkle with onions
8. Serve with crackers for dipping

title: glazed pineapples
steps:
1. Melt sugar and lemon juice add pineapple top with ginger , jalapeno and optional raisins simmer till tender flipping half way through
2. About 5-7 minutes
3. Serve hot or chilled

title: macaroni cheese without the pot of water
steps:
1. Heat oven to 325f / 160c , and grease an oven dish
2. Peel the tomatoes and chop into pieces
3. Heat the water to boiling , and add the macaroni little by little
4. Also add the tomatoes , salt , pepper and basil , stir now and then , and cook without a lid until the macaroni is tender and the mixture is sort of saucy
5. While that is cooking , fry the onion and bacon in a little oil until softened and cooked
6. Add the ground beef , and stir with a fork to loosen the meat
7. Stir until cooked through
8. Ladle the macaroni mixture into the greased oven dish
9. Spread half the meat mixture over the top , and then half the grated cheddar
10. Add rest of the meat , then the last of the cheddar
11. Bake , open , in the preheated oven until heated through and the cheese is melted

title: dandelion  mushrooms
steps:
1. Dredge the moist flowers in flour
2. Heat the butter in a heavy frying pan
3. Add flowers and fry quickly , turning to brown all sides
4. Batter version:
5. If using batter version , dip the flowers into the batter and fry till golden brown
6. Serve hot
7. Enjoy !

title: chocolate luster glaze
steps:
1. In a small microwave safe bowl
2. Microwave the chocolate on 50% power for 1 minute
3. Stir well
4. If necessary , continue microwaving on 50% power , stirring at 30 second intervals
5. Stop microwaving before the chocolate completely melts and let the residual heat finish the job
6. If the glaze thickens upon standing , stir in a few more drops of hot water until thoroughly blended
7. Be sure to blend in thoroughly , so the glaze maintains its luster
8. Using a table knife , spreader or small palette knife , cover the top of each cookie witha smaooth even layer of glaze
9. Let the cookies stand on wire racks until the glaze completely sets , at least 1 1 / 2 hours and preferably several hours
10. Store in a single layer or layered with wax paper in an airtight container
11. Makes enough glaze to dip 25 5" cookies or 50 medium cookies
12. 3"

title: torta de frango   brazilian chicken pie
steps:
1. Take a chicken breast or two and shred it while it cooks
2. Still cooking add tomato sauce , onion , garlic , salt , oregano , pepper , canned corn , and of coarse chopped cilantro
3. Cook until sauce thickened a bit , and all of the chicken is shredded
4. Adjust to taste
5. Preheat oven to 350 f
6. Put all dough ingredients for the dough into a blender and beat until smooth
7. Adjust salt and pepper to taste
8. Grease and flour a 9 x 13 inch baking pan
9. Put the pie together for baking: pour half of dough mixture into pan
10. Add filling
11. Pour rest of the dough on top
12. Bake until a toothpick comes out clean
13. Let it cool , slice and serve with a nice green salad with vinaigrette dressing !
14. You can also change the recipe using tuna instead of chicken ! if you like it hot , add a pinch of chili

title: greek pasta with meatballs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Cook orzo pasta according to package directions
3. Drain
4. Keep warm
5. Combine breacrumbs and next 6 ingredients in a medium bowl
6. Stir in 1 1 / 2 tablespoons parsley
