7. Add egg whites , stirring mixture until just combined
8. Shape mixture into 12 meatballs
9. Cover and chill meatballs 5 minutes
10. Heat oil in a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat
11. Add meatballs to pan
12. Cook 8 minutes , turning to brown on all sides
13. Drain well
14. Wipe pan clean with paper towels
15. Return meatballs to pan
16. Spoon marinara sauce over meatballs
17. Sprinkle with cheese
18. Bake at 375 degrees f
19. For 11 minutes or until meatballs are done
20. Sprinkle with remaining 1 1 / 2 teaspoons parsley
21. Serve over orzo

title: waffle topping
steps:
1. Melt butter in sauce pan
2. Stir in cornstarch slowly
3. Add honey
4. Stir constantly over low heat for 8 minutes
5. Serve over hot waffles , pancakes or biscuits

title: garlic lover s chicken tetrazzini
steps:
1. Place chicken in a large pot or dutch oven and cover with water
2. Bring the pot to a boil , then reduce heat and let chicken simmer for approximately 1 1 / 2 hours , or until the chicken is done
3. Remove the chicken from the pot and place on a plate to cool
4. When cooled , skin and debone , placing chicken meat in a bowl for later
5. Remove 1 cup broth from pot and set aside for later
6. Do not discard the rest of the broth
7. Will use later to boil the noodles for extra flavor
8. While chicken is boiling , melt butter in saute pan and add minced garlic
9. Let it saute for just a minute or so , then add mushrooms
10. If you like you can add a splash of white wine here for a special taste
11. Cook mushrooms until tender and set aside for later
12. The above steps can be done ahead of time and kept in refrigerator for assembly the day of the meal
13. Next , in a separate bowl , mix the cream of chicken soup , cream of mushroom soup , and 1 cup of broth -- stir together until blended
14. Bring remaining broth to a boil once again and place the pasta in the boiling water
15. When the noodles are cooked , drain , and put back in the pot
16. Now , add in the rest of the ingredients , except for garnish: chicken meat , mushrooms , soup mixture , cheese , and seasonings
17. Mix well and pour into a greased deep / large casserole dish
18. The size of the dish depends on how much chicken you use and thicker noodles vs
19. Thinner noodles , but generally a 9x13 dish is sufficient
20. You can also put some of the mix , if there is too much , in a freezer-safe container to save for a quick dinner later on
21. Sprinkle with your garnish , and bake covered in a 350f oven for about 30 minutes
22. Serve with sour cream on the side for a very creamy version of this entree

title: soft boiled eggs with saltines
steps:
1. Bring a pot of water to boil and carefully lower the eggs into the water
2. Once water boils again , boil the eggs for approximately 3 1 / 2 minutes
3. Drain
4. Use a clean towel to handle the eggs and gently tap in half
5. Scoop out the egg using a spoon and place into a small bowl
6. Repeat
7. For each soft-boiled egg serving , i would guess that we used about 3-4 saltines
8. If you wish you can lightly butter the saltines , in which case you would break the crackers up with a knife
9. For unbuttered saltines , crush the saltine crackers lightly with your hands and place in the bowl with the shelled eggs
10. Using a fork , mix well
11. Breaking up the eggs into small pieces
12. Season to taste with cracked black pepper and serve immediately

title: grilled leg of lamb with hot  red pepper relish
steps:
1. Cut lamb into 2 pieces where there is a natural separation in meat and put each piece into a large sealable plastic bag
2. In a food processor , pure all remaining ingredients until smooth and divide marinade evenly between plastic bags
3. Seal bags , pressing out excess air , and put in a shallow baking pan
4. Marinate lamb , chilled , turning bags once or twice , at least 8 hours or overnight
5. Prepare grill
6. Discard marinade and grill lamb in batches if necessary on an oiled rack set 5 to 6 inches over glowing coals 7 to 10 minutes on each side for medium-rare
7. Transfer lamb to a cutting board and let stand 10 minutes
8. Serve lamb , thinly sliced across the grain , with relish
9. Hot red pepper relish:
10. In a heavy saucepan , stir together ingredients and simmer , stirring occasionally , about 1 hour , or until reduced to about 3 cups
11. Relish may be made 1 month ahead and chilled , covered
12. Serve relish chilled or at room temperature

title: strawberry   cream cheese sandwich cookies
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , smash cream cheese with a fork
2. Combine the rest of the ingredients together with the cream cheese
3. Mix well
4. Let chill in the refridgerator for at least 30 minutes
5. On the flat side of the wafer , spread 2 tsp of mixture
6. Then top with another wafer to make a sandwich
7. Sprinkle with powdered sugar
8. Serve immediately

title: chilean tortilla
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a non-stick saute pan over medium heat
2. Add the potatoes and cook until golden brown
3. This is best achieved by allowing the potatoes to sit on the bottom of the pan for a few minutes before stirring to create a browning
4. Once potatoes are cooked , 5-10 minutes , remove from pan and place on a plate lined with a paper towel to cool
5. In a large bowl , combine all the ingredients except for the additional 2 tablespoons oil
6. Add the potatoes and stir to combine
7. Wipe out the pan and heat a the pan over medium heat
8. Add the fat and allow to coat the entire pan
9. Add the potato mixture and cook stirring gently until it begins to set
10. At this point , turn the heat up to medium-high and allow the bottom to brown
11. Cover with a lid for a few minutes to set the top and remove from heat
12. Turn out onto a plate and serve with sour cream or thick yogurt and green onions for garnish

title: zesty greek couscous salad
steps:
1. Can be served hot or cold
2. If served hot , put zucchini in with couscous as it is being cooked
3. If served cold , chill for 4 hours before serving
4. Prepare couscous according to box directions using chicken broth or water , adding the black pepper , lemon juice , and olive oil
5. Once couscous has reached proper consistency , add remaining ingredients

title: bacon ranch green beans
steps:
1. In a skillet , saute the green beans in butter until tender
2. Add the salad dressing mix and toss to coat
3. Just before serving , sprinkle on the bacon and mix in , if desired

title: ham and barley bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray pan with cooking spray
3. Melt buttery spread in a skillet on medium high heat
4. Add barley , carrots , onions , celery and garlic
5. Cook 3 minutes
6. Remove from heat and stir in ham , basil , oregano and pepper
7. Then pour this mixture into the baking pan
8. Bring broth to a boil in a saucepan and then pour over the ham mix
9. Cover tightly with foil and bake 20 minutes
10. Remove from oven , stir in green beans
11. Recover and bake another 30 minutes or until barley is tender

title: cauliflower cheese patties
steps: 1. Cut cauliflower into florets cook in boiling water for 10 minutes drain and mash stir in eggs cheese panko and cayenne add salt to taste coat grill pan with olive oil heat on medium heat form cauliflower into patties cook until golden brown about 3 minutes per side makes 8 patties

title: baked beans rice and chicken
steps:
1. In a saucepan , heat oil over medium heat
2. Add chicken
3. Stir and cook until browned
4. Set aside
5. Add rice , onions , bell pepper and garlic in same saucepan
6. Stir and cook 2 minutes
7. Combine all ingredients into a large bowl
8. Mix well
9. Spoon mixture into a greased 13x9x2 inch glass baking dish
10. Cover with foil
11. Bake 50 minutes or until rice is cooked

title: louisiana pecan pie
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Put pecans inside of the pie shell , put on sheet pan and set aside
3. Beat eggs well
4. Mix the salt , butter , corn syrup , brown sugar , and vanilla extract well
5. Add this to the egg mixture
6. Pour this entire mixture over top of the pecans in the pie shell
7. Bake for about 45 minutes at 350 degrees

title: herb roasted whole chicken
steps:
1. Combine oil , water , herbs , salt and pepper
2. Stir
3. Pour or brush over the whole chicken before baking
4. The oil and water dosen't mix very well but thats ok
5. The water keeps it moist and the oil makes it crisp
6. Any other herbs you like can be used in place of these
7. Cover with foil and bake at 350 about an hour or until crispy and brown

title: lemon zest   cranberry muffins
steps:
1. Combine first 4 dry ingredients in a small bowl , sifting well
2. Combine egg , milk , oil honey , and lemon rind in a large bowl
3. Add dry ingredients
4. Stir just until dry ingredients are moistened
5. Fold in cranberries
6. Spoon batter into greased muffin tins
7. Bake at 400 f for 20-25 min or until golden

title: minted green bean salad
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , bring the water and sugar to a boil , and cook the green beans 6-10 minutes , or until tender but crisp
2. Drain
3. In same pan , heat olive oil
4. Add garlic and scallion , and saute briefly until limp , 2-3 minutes
5. In a medium bowl , combine green beans , garlic , scallion , and mint
6. In a small container with a lid , mix olive oil , cider vinegar , garlic , basil , mustard , salt , and pepper
7. Shake until well blended
8. Toss into the green bean mixture while hot
9. Serve hot , room temperature , or cold

title: parmesan breaded chicken  so easy
steps:
1. Combine breadcrumbs and parmesan cheese in a bowl
2. In a separate bowl , place one cup of mayo
3. Season chicken with salt and pepper
4. Liberally coat each chicken breast with mayo , then coat liberally with breadcrumb cheese mixture
5. Place on a nonstick sheet pan and bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes to an hour , depending on the size of chicken
6. Enjoy !

title: aunt kathleen s caramels
steps:
1. Put butter , sugar , brown sugar , and karo into pan
2. Cook over medium heat , stirring occasionally until it starts to boil
3. After it starts to boil , turn down to med-low heat , and let boil for 10 minutes , stirring constantly so it doesn't stick or burn on the bottom of the pan
4. Remove from heat , and add condensed milk
5. Stir well
6. Put back on stove , and bring the temperature to the hard ball stage ,
7. Remove from stove , and add nuts and vanilla
8. Mix well
9. Pour into a buttered pan
10. Cool completely , and then cut with a sharp knife
11. Cut wax paper into 2x2" squares
12. Wrap each caramel in wax paper and twist ends
13. Refrigerate in a plastic container

title: blueberry bread pudding  wonderful and easy
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Melt the butter in a saucepan
3. Place the bread cubes in a large mixing bowl
4. Pour the orange juice and melted butter over the bread
5. Sprinkle on the sugar , cinnamon and nutmeg and using your hands , toss to coat the bread
6. Pour the eggs over the mixture and mix all together with a wooden spoon
7. Scrape the bread into a pie dish coated with baking spray and flatten the top with the back of a spoon
8. Place the blueberries on top in an even layer
9. Sprinkle with brown sugar , lemon juice and the cointreau
10. Place in the oven and bake for 30-40 minutes
11. To serve:
12. Cut into pie shaped wedges and serve warm or cool
13. Garnish with the whipped cream and any additional fresh blueberries

title: all hallows eve soup
steps:
1. Cut the rind off the orange in one long strip
2. Scrape off all of the excess pith from the back and set aside
3. Squeeze the juice from the orange and reserve
4. Place the olive oil in a large , heavy pot over low heat
5. Add the onions and carrots and cook , stirring occasionally , until wilted , about 15 minute sprinkle with salt , pepper and marjoram
6. Add the tomatoes , tomato paste , brown sugar , broth , reserved orange peel and juice , and the lentils
7. Bring the mixture to a boil , reduce the heat to medium and simmer , partially covered , for 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. Remove the orange peel and discard
9. Adjust seasonings and stir in the parsley
10. Serve steaming hot with warm crusty bread
11. From sender:

title: cosmo de san jose
steps:
1. Combine ingredients in a shaker filled with ice
2. Strain into a chilled martini glasses

title: sausage flowers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Lightly grease a miniature muffin pan
3. Place ground italian sausage in a large , deep skillet
4. Cook over medium high heat until evenly brown
5. Drain and remove from heat
6. Stir monterey jack cheese and colby cheese into the warm sausage to melt
7. Stir in salsa
8. Gently press wonton wrappers into the prepared miniature muffin pan so that the edges are extending
9. Bake for 2-3 minutes , just to lightly crisp
10. Place a heaping tablespoon of the sausage mixture into each wonton wrapper
11. Bake 10 minutes in the preheated oven , or until wonton edges begin to brown
12. Transfer baked filled wontons to a serving platter
13. Dollop each with approximately 1 tablespoon sour cream
14. Sprinkle with green onions

title: bean and chicken crockpot tacos
steps:
1. In 3-4 quart crockpot , place chicken thighs and sprinkle with taco seasoning mix
2. Top with chilies , tomato sauce , onion , chili powder , and drained beans
3. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours
4. Remove chicken from crockpot and shred with two forks
5. Using potato masher , mash some of the beans in the crockpot
6. Return chicken to crockpot and mix well to blend
7. Make tacos with chicken filing , taco shells , and toppings

title: emaw s goulash
steps:
1. Prepare elbow macaroni according to directions on package till al dente
2. Save a little of the pasta water in case you need it later to loosen the sauce
3. Brown meat in a large skillet , drain the fat and add the onion and bell pepper half way through cooking
4. Drain any ramaining fat when onion and pepper is done and add garlic , stir it about
5. Add the meat mixture to the cooked macaroni , add the canned tomatoes , corn and sauce
6. Mix all this together and add seasoning to taste
7. You may need to add some of the pasta water to loosen the sauce if it is too dry
8. This is really good the next day too

title: lightened up chocolate pound cake
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine all ingredients
2. Mix on low for one minute , then scrape sides of bowl
3. Mix on medium for two minutes or until batter is nicely blended
4. Grease a 10-inch tube pan then lightly dust with flour
5. Pour batter into pan
6. Bake for 58-62 minutes , or until cake springs back when pressed and begins to pull away from sides of pan
7. Cool 20 minutes , then turn cake out of pan

title: spiced eggnog cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. For crust combine crumbs , sugar , ginger , nutmeg , cinnamon , and butter in small bowl until well blended
3. Press over bottom of 9-inch springform pan
4. Bake 10 minutes , transfer pan to wire rack to cool , leave oven on
5. For filling , beat cream cheese in medium bowl until smooth
6. In small bowl mix sugar , flour , nutmeg , cinnamon , and cloves
7. Add cream cheese , beat until smooth
8. Beat in egg , then add eggnog slowly , beating continuously , finally beat in vanilla
9. Pour onto crust in assembled pan
10. Tap lightly to release air bubbles
11. Bake in preheated oven 1 hour
12. Remove , spread sour cream over top and bake for 5 more minutes
13. Let cool on rack until cake is cool to touch , refrigerate
14. For curls , line loaf pan with foil , leaving overhangs
15. Melt chocolate in top of double boiler over barely simmering , not boiling water , stirring until smooth
16. Stir in nutmeg , then pour into pan spreading evenly
17. Refrigerate until firm
18. Lift chocolate bar out of pan
19. Then using veggie peeler scrape into loose curls and arrange on top of cake !
20. Enjoy !

title: mocha yogurt coffee cake
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine brown sugar , nuts , cocoa powder , cinnamon , and coffee crystals
2. Set aside
3. In a mixer bowl , beat butter on medium speed of an electric mixer for 30 seconds
4. Add the sugar and vanilla
5. Beat until fluffy
6. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
7. Add bisquick and yogurt alternately to beaten mixture , stirring just until combined
8. Spoon about half of the batter into a greased 8-inch square baking pan
9. Sprinkle nut mixture on top
10. Spoon remaining batter over all
11. With a narrow spatula , swirl to marble
12. Bake in a 350f oven for 35 to 40 minutes , or until done
13. Cool slightly on a wire rack
14. Dust lightly with powdered sugar

title: garlic parmesan roasted brussels sprouts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 f
2. Toss together brussels sprouts , garlic cloves , olive oil , lemon pepper , and salt
3. Spread on a baking sheet
4. Roast for 20-25 minutes or until garlic and brussels sprouts are tender
5. Toss with parmesan cheese and serve

title: spinach  cucumber  feta and red onion salad
steps:
1. Mix dressing ingredients in a small jar and shake until blended
2. Let rest in fridge for at least an hour before serving salad
3. Assemble salad ingredients and pour dressing over

title: baked onion rice with mushrooms
steps:
1. Sautee rice in butter
2. Place in casserole dish with other ingredients
3. Bake covered in a 375 degree oven for 45 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed by rice

title: roasted radishes
steps:
1. Wash , trim and quarter radishes
2. Toss radishes in small bowl with olive oil
3. Spread on cookie sheet
4. Sprinkle with salt
5. Roast at 375 for 20 to 25 minute

title: sunset beach
steps:
1. Pour first 5 ingredients into a tall glass
2. Add ice
3. Top with grenadine

title: otai
steps:
1. Grate the pineapple into a large container
2. Finely chop the watermelon , or scrape the melon and the juice into the pineapple
3. Sprinkle with sugar
4. Add the fresh coconut flesh directly to the fruit or by making a rich coconut cream from the grated coconut and adding the cream to the fruit juices
5. Dilute with the water
6. Chill and serve

title: shrimp chowder with fennel
steps:
1. Peel the shrimp , reserving the shells
2. Split the shrimp lengthwise in half down the back , cover and refrigerate until needed
3. Remove the fronds from the fennel , coarsely chop and reserve for garnish , covered and refrigerated
4. Trim off the tops and tough outer layers of the fennel and coarsely chop , reserve for the stock
5. Quarter the fennel bulb lengthwise , cut away the core and cut very thinly across into 1 / 4- to 1 / 3-inch slices
6. Add 2 tablespoons of the olive oil and the 2 crushed garlic cloves to a 10- or 12-inch high-sided skillet or saute pan and heat over medium-high heat until the garlic begins to brown
7. Add the shrimp shells and saute for 5 minutes , or until the shells turn red and are very aromatic
8. Add the fennel trimmings , the wine and the water , bring to a simmer , and simmer for 20 minutes
9. Season lightly with salt
10. Strain the stock
11. You should have 3-1 / 2 cups
12. Heat a 4- to 6-quart heavy pot over low heat to medium and cook until the bacon is a crisp golden brown
13. Pour off all the fat except 1 tablespoon , leaving the bacon in the pot
14. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil and the chopped garlic and cook for 30 seconds
15. Add the onion , sliced fennel , fennel seeds and crushed red pepper and saute , stirring occasionally with a wooden spoon , for about 10 minutes , until the onion and fennel are softened but not browned
16. Add the potatoes and reserved shrimp stock
17. The stock should just barely cover the potatoes
18. If it doesn't , add enough water to cover
19. Turn up the heat and bring to a boil
20. Cover the pot and cook the potatoes vigorously for about 8 minutes , until they are soft on the outside but still firm in the center
21. If the broth hasn't thickened lightly , smash a few potatoes against the side of the pot and cook a minute or two longer to release their starch
22. Reduce the heat to medium , add the tomatoes , and simmer for 5 minutes more
23. Stir in the shrimp and cook for 1 minute , then remove the pot from the heat and stir in the cream
24. Let sit for 10 minutes while the shrimp finish their slow cooking
25. Taste the chowder and season with black pepper and more salt if needed
26. If you are not serving the chowder within the hour , let it cool a bit , then refrigerate
27. Cover the chowder after it has chilled completely
28. Otherwise , let sit at room temperature for up to an hour , allowing the flavors to meld
29. When ready to serve , reheat the chowder over low heat
30. Don't let it boil
31. Ladle into cups or bowls , making sure the shrimp , fennel , potatoes and bacon are evenly divided
32. Sprinkle with the reserved chopped fennel fronds

title: green sauce  grne sauce
steps:
1. Wash the herbs in cold water , dry , and chop finely
2. Mix with other ingredients
3. You may want to add a lettuce or leeks
4. This sauce is good with cooked beef , fish , poultry , hard or soft boiled eggs , and is a real delicacy with cooked asparagus

title: chicken cannelloni  with or without spinach
steps:
1. In a large skillet , simmer the chicken breasts , onion , broth , wine , and thyme , until chicken is done
2. Remove the chicken breasts to a plate and allow them to cool slightly
3. While the chicken breasts are cooling , strain the chicken broth to remove the onions and thyme
4. Reserve the broth into a large saucepan
5. Put the onions and thyme into your food processor
6. Chop or tear the chicken into big chunks , and put into food processor with the onions and thyme
7. Pulse the chicken in the food processor until finely chopped
8. Prepare spinach , if using
9. Wash well , chop , and lightly saut in a saucepan with 2 tbs olive oil until done to your preference
10. I personally don't like "mushy" spinach
11. You may also substitute frozen chopped spinach , but be sure to squeeze it out really well
12. In a large bowl , mix the chicken / onion mixture with the ricotta and cottage cheese , spinach , 1 / 2 c parmesan , nutmeg , and white pepper
13. Mix thoroughly
14. Set aside
15. In a large saucepan , melt butter
16. Whisk in flour , stirring constantly so it doesn't burn
17. Whisk in the reserved chicken broth , stirring constantly
18. Add the wine , and then the milk , stirring constantly , until sauce is velvety-smooth
19. Simmer , stirring frequently , about 20 minutes , while you start to assemble the canneloni
20. Assemble the canneloni: lay 4-5 egg roll wraps out on the counter
21. Place approx 1 / 2 to 1 cup of chicken / cheese filling on center of wrap , and roll up , setting aside
22. Repeat until you're done
23. When sauce is done simmering , pour approx 1 cup sauce on the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish
24. Tilt , to make sure it's spread evenly
25. Arrange canneloni in dish , and top with remaining sauce
26. Sprinkle with remaining 1 / 2 cup parmesan
27. Cover with foil , and bake at 350 for about 30 minutes
28. During last 10 minutes , take the foil off so that the parmesan browns
29. Allow to sit for about 10 minutes before serving

title: caramel spice pear butter
steps:
1. Wash the pears but do not peel or core them
2. Slice pears into a heavy saucepan
3. Add water , cover , and cook until tender
4. Remove from heat and press the pears through a colander or a food mill
5. Measure the pear pulp and return to the pan
6. Using a frying pan , heat 1 1 / 2 cups of the sugar , stirring until it melts and caramelizes to a medium brown color
7. Pour immediately into the pear pulp
8. Add the remaining sugar , cloves , cinnamon , and ginger
9. Cook uncovered , until thick
10. Stir frequently as it begins to thicken to prevent it from sticking
11. Stir in lemon juice just before removing it from heat
12. Pour hot mixture into steralized 1 / 2 pint jars , put on lid , and crew band tightly
13. Process in boiling water bath for 15 minutes

title: pork chops with browned garlic butter
steps:
1. Combine the salt , onion powder , garlic powder , white pepper , dry mustard , sage , cumin , and thyme in a small bowl
2. Mix well
3. Sprinkle each side of the chops with 1 / 4 teaspoons of the seasoning mix
4. Rub the seasoning into the chops with your finger
5. In a pie plate , combine the flour and the remaining seasoning mix and coat the chops on both sides
6. Shake off the excess
7. In a large skillet , heat the oil
8. Cook the chops over medium heat for 4-5 minutes per side or until golden brown
9. Drain on paper towels
10. Place on serving platter and set aside
11. Meanwhile , in a 1 quart saucepan , heat the butter until almost melted
12. Add the garlic and cook over medium-high heat for 2-3 minutes or until the foam on the surface is light brown
13. Stir in the parsley , hot pepper sauce , lemon juice , and black pepper
14. Cook until the sauce is lightly browned and immediately drizzle over the pork chops

title: smoked cheddar waffles
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix together the two flours , baking soda , baking powder and salt
2. In a separate bowl , beat the eggs lightly and stir in the buttermilk , butter , scallions , mustard and grated cheese
3. Add teh egg mixture to the dry ingredients and stir just till combined
4. Let the waffle batter sit for about 10 minutes , till you see some bubbles on top
5. Meanwhile , preheat the waffle iron
6. Use 1 / 3 cup batter for each waffle and bake according to instructions that came with waffle iron
7. Serving option: top with scrambled eggs and salsa - though i'm sure there are other good ideas out there !

title: spaghetti sauce with meat   slow method
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , combine bouillon and reserved tomato skins and juice
2. Bring to a boil , and simmer for 15 minutes , stirring occasionally and mashing pulp against side of pan
3. Reserve
4. Heat 1 / 4 cup olive oil in large skillet
5. Add garlic and chopped onions , and saute over medium-high heat until soft
6. Add peppers , and continue cooking until onions are slightly browned
7. In a large pot , combine chopped tomatoes and onion mixture
8. Strain bouillon mixture into pot , pressing on pulp to maximize liquid , discarding pulp
9. Add tomato sauce , tomato paste , wine , and spices
10. Bring to a boil , reduce heat to low , and simmer covered , stirring regularly to prevent sticking and burning
11. In a large skillet over medium heat , break up 2 pounds ground beef into small pieces
12. Season to taste with salt , pepper , granulated garlic , and optional msg
13. Cook until browned , continuing to break up meat with a large fork
14. Drain excess grease , and add meat to tomato mixture
15. Continue cooking sauce , covered , for about 1 hour
16. In a large bowl , combine thoroughly 1-1 / 2 lb ground beef , egg , onion , garlic , italian seasoning , msg , salt , and pepper , and breadcrumbs , adjusting to a firm consistency by varying amount of breadcrumbs
17. Form into 3 / 4" meatballs
18. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in large skillet
19. Add half of meatballs , and brown well over high heat
20. Remove meatballs from pan , and reserve
21. Repeat with remaining meatballs
22. Drain grease from pan , but do not clean it
23. Pierce skins of italian sausages with a sharp fork
24. Place in the skillet with about 1 / 2" of water
25. Simmer over medium heat for about 10 minutes to render excess grease , turning several times
26. Do not scrape bottom of pan while turning
27. Drain water , and return pan to heat
28. Continue cooking , turning sausages regularly , until skins are browned
29. Remove from heat , and cool until sausages can be handled
30. Cut each sausage crosswise into 1 / 4" slices
31. Return to pan , and brown over medium-high heat
32. Reserve sausage , and drain all but 2 tbsp grease from pan
33. Do not clean the pan
34. Alternately , sausage can be removed from casing and cooked with the ground beef
35. Add 2 tbsp butter to pan , and heat until sizzling
36. Add mushrooms , and toss to coat with butter
37. Saute over medium heat until mushrooms start releasing juice
38. Add 1 / 2 cup wine , and simmer about 5 minutes , scraping bottom of pan thoroughly to deglaze
39. Remove from heat , and reserve
40. After tomato mixture has simmered for 1 hour , add meatballs , sausage slices , fresh basil , parsley , and mushroom mixture to sauce
41. Continue cooking for about 15 minutes
42. Adjust seasoning , adding more italian seasoning , sugar , and salt and pepper as needed
43. If sauce is too thick , thin with tomato juice or wine
44. If sauce is too thin , continue cooking , uncovered , until desired consistency is reached
45. Cover , and continue cooking for 1 additional hour , stirring regularly
46. There should be little or no grease on top of the sauce
47. If there is , skim or blot off and discard
48. Toss 2-3 cups of the sauce with hot pasta that has been cooked until al dente
49. Divide into serving portions
50. Top each portion with about 1 cup of additional sauce
51. Pass freshly grated parmesan cheese on the side
52. This may seem like a very large recipe , but it obviously takes quite awhile to prepare , so make the full recipe , and freeze the excess in fairly small containers
53. It will keep for 6-8 months easily , and in my opinion , tastes better after aging
54. If desired , and if you have a big enough pot , double the recipe , and pack in 1 quart ziploc freezer bags for freezing
55. One quart of sauce and 1 lb of uncooked dry spaghetti , cooked until al dente , will serve 4 people

title: lancashire hot pot
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 315f degrees
2. Brush a 4 litre overproof casserole with melted butter or oil
3. Trim the meat of excess fat and sinew
4. Coat the chops and kidneys with seasoned flour shaking off and reserving any excess
5. Heat the butter in a large frying pan and brown the chops quickly on both sides
6. Remove the chops from the pan and set aside , then cook the kidneys until browned
7. Layer half the potato slices into the base of the casserole , then top with the chops and the kidneys
8. Add the onion , pepper , if using and carrot to the frying pan and cook until the carrot begins to brown
9. Layer on top of the chops and kidneys
10. Sprinkle the reserved flour over the base of the pan and cook , stirring , until dark brown
11. Gradually pour in the stock and bring to the boil , stirring
12. Season well with salt and cracked black pepper , and add the thyme and bay leaf
13. Reduce the heat and simmer for 10 minutes , then pour the mixture into the casserole
14. Layer the remaining potato over the top , covering the meat and veggies
15. Cover and cook in the oven for 1 1 / 4 hours
16. Remove the lid , brush the potato with butter and cook for a further 30 minutes , or until the potato is brown

title: mozzarella tomato chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 475
2. Combine garlic , tomato , basil , 1 cup , mozzarella , balsamic vinegar , salt , and pepper in a small bowl
3. Cut a slit in the side of chicken breasts and fill with mixture
4. Make an eggwash with the egg and milk
5. Roll breasts in eggwash
6. Roll breasts in bread crumbs
7. Bake for 45 minutes
8. Remove and spoon tomato sauce , and remaining cheese over breasts
9. Bake until cheese is bubbly

title: italian potted beef pressure cooker
steps:
1. Heat the cooker , add oil and brown roast on all sides
2. Add veggies and seasonings
3. Blend the paste with the broth and wine
4. Pour over meat and veg
5. Close cover securely
6. Place pressure regulator on vent pipe and cook 35 minutes at 15 pounds pressure
7. Let pressure drop of its own accord
8. Thicken gravy if desired

title: bacon ranch potato casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease a shallow casserole dish
3. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl , then spoon into the casserole dish
4. Bake uncovered 30-35 minutes or until bubbly

title: peachipolte sauce
steps:
1. Place ingredients in a food processer or blender and pulse to puree
2. Place puree in a saucepan over low heat and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
3. Refridgerate sauce until ready to use

title: spicy chicken and peppers
steps:
1. In non-stick skillet , cook chicken , green peppers , onion and garlic in oil until chicken juices run clear
2. Stir in tomato sauce , tomatoes , and seasonings
3. Bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat and simmer , uncovered for 5 minutes

title: sunday ham
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Pour orange marmalade into a bowl and add about 1 / 2 can of the coke
3. Let it set while you prepare the ham
4. Remove visible fat from ham and make crisscross cuts in the ham
5. Place in a 9x13 baking pan and pour the marmalade / coke mixture over the ham
6. Place in oven uncovered and bake for 20 minutes
7. This allows the marmalade to set or crisp on the ham
8. After 20 minutes , cover the ham with foil and bake an additional 30 to 45 minutes
9. Baste with pan drippings every 15 minutes
10. If there are not enough pan drippings , mix up more marmalade mixture to baste the ham
11. Uncover the ham the last 20 to 30 minutes and baste every 7 or 8 minutes
12. Allow the marmalade mixture to brown until dark brown in color
13. Remove from oven and place ham onto a platter to cool before cutting
14. Total cook time is about 1 hour 5 minutes to 1 hour 35 minutes

title: best lemon cheesecake ever  sour cream cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Using your hands or the back of a spoon , mix all crust ingredients in a bowl until well combined
3. Press into bottom of an 11 to 12-inch spring form pan
4. Bake for 5 minutes
5. Let cool
6. Refrigerate until needed
7. Using an electric mixer , beat cream cheese at high speed until completely smooth
8. Add eggs one at a time , beating until smooth after each addition
9. Beat at medium speed as you gradually add the sugar , then flour , lemon juice and 1 teaspoon vanilla , mixing until well blended
10. Stir in lemon zest
11. Pour into crust
12. Bake at 350f for 35 minutes
13. Blend sour cream with remaining teaspoon vanilla and 3 tablespoons sugar
14. Set mixture in warm place
15. Remove cake from oven , and gently spread sour cream mixture on top
16. Return to oven and bake for another 12 minutes
17. Cool on rack for 30 minutes
18. Refrigerate until topping is cool , but not completely chilled
19. Combine all glaze ingredients and blend until smooth
20. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly until thickened
21. Chill until cool , but not set
22. Spread on top of cheesecake
23. Chill overnight

title: marks twice baked potatoes
steps:
1. Bake potatoes until slightly softened or microwave 12 minutes
2. Slice in two lengthwise
3. Mix shredded cheese and remaining ingredients together in a mixing bowl , reserving 1 tablespoon of parmesan and the paprika
4. Scoop out potatoes and put hot scoops in with cheese mixture
5. Cut in well with a knife until well blended
6. Fill potato shells with mixture , top with remaining parmesan and paprika
7. Place in a well greased casserole dish and bake at 350 for 30 minutes or until browned
8. Mmmmm mmmmm----- recipe via meal-master v8
9. 06

title: chicken estafao
steps:
1. Brown the onion in a frying pan with very little olive or canola oil
2. Add chicken and cook at medium heat until brown then add the water , vinegar , soy sauce , black pepper , garlic , bay leaves and hot peppers if you want it spicy
3. Cook at high heat until it start boiling then turn down to medium heat until fully cooked

title: estonian cabbage
steps:
1. Put the chopped cabbage into a foil grill bag (or make your own with heavy duty aluminum foil doubled over
2. Add butter , cream , salt and pepper
3. Seal up the ends of foil or the foil bag
4. Place on the slowest side of the grill and let it cook for 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours or until it tests done

title: fresh prawns in coconut milk
steps:
1. Place fresh prawns in a bowl , and squeeze lime juice over them
2. Add a pinch of salt , and marinate for 5 minutes
3. Remove half of the juice , and add the onion , tomatoes , parsley , coconut milk
4. And pepper to taste
5. Garnish with scallions , and serve

title: greek mojito
steps:
1. Muddle the sugar , some soda water , lemon juice , lime wedge and mint in a low or highball glass
2. Fill with crushed ice and metaxa and fill with soda water - stir it up and

title: licorice mint iced tea
steps:
1. In a large pot bring water to a boil over high heat
2. Stir in the licorice and cinnamon
3. Lower to a simmer , partially cover the pot , and simmer for 10 minutes
4. Remove from heat , stir in peppermint , cover and let steep for 10 minutes
5. Place a large strainer lined with cheesecloth or damp paper towel over another pot or heat-proof bowl
6. Strain tea
7. Stir in honey until dissolved and let cool completely , about 1 hour
8. Serve over ice

title: sunday dinner mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Place potatoes in a dutch oven and cover with water
2. Cover and bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat and simmer 20-25 minutes until potatoes are very tender
4. Drain well
5. In a large mixing bowl , mash potatoes
6. Add sour cream , cream cheese , 3 tablespoons butter , onion salt and pepper
7. Beat until nice and fluffy
8. Transfer to a greased 2-qt
9. Baking dish
10. Dot with remaining butter and bake uncovered in a 350 degree oven for 15 minutes
11. Remove from oven
12. Sprinkle with the frenches fried onion then return to oven
13. Bake an additional 5 minutes

title: gabuya salad
steps:
1. You can use pears instead of apples but must eat salad quickly before pears get mushy
2. Toss everything together in a bowl and enjoy !

title: mediterranean meatball skewers
steps:
1. Heat grill to medium-high heat
2. In a bowl , whisk together vinegar , oil , garlic , thyme , mustard , 1 / 8 tsp of the salt and 1 / 8 tsp of the pepper until well blended
3. Set aside
4. In another bowl , mix together beef , egg , parmesan , bread crumbs , remaining salt and remaining pepper until well combined
5. Form into 24 meatballs , about 1 1 / 2 inches in diameter
6. Slice off stem and top third of each artichoke
7. Discard
8. Peel and discard the few top layers of leaves until artichokes are light green
9. Slice in half
10. Thread meatballs , artichokes , and tomatoes on eight 10-inch skewers
11. Brush generously with dressing
12. Grill on medium-high 12 minutes , rotating a few times , until meatballs are cooked through

title: beef   yellow spanish rice stuffed bell peppers
steps:
1. Set oven to broil
2. Brown beef in a large pan with the spices
3. While beef is browning , prepare yellow rice as instructed on bag or box in another large pan
4. While beef and rice are cooking: rinse , halve , and seed your bell peppers and place them hollowed-side up in a 13 x 7 inch baking dish
5. When beef is done browning , add the beef , diced tomatoes , and 1
6. 5 cups of cheese in with the rice pan and stir till thoroughly mixed
7. Put a heaping spoonful of rice mixture into each bell pepper
8. They'll probably overflow --
9. Sprinkle remaining shredded cheese over the top of the stuffed peppers
10. Broil the stuffed peppers until cheese on top is just melted and bubbly
11. Enjoy !

title: italian berry salad
steps:
1. Over medium heat , bring 1 / 4 cup balsamic vinegar to simmer until reduced to thin syrup consistency
2. It should coat the back of a spoon
3. Remove reduction from heat to cool
4. In a large bowl gently mix fruit , careful not to smash raspberries
5. Add 2 tablespoons of the cooled vinegar reduction and sugar to fruit
6. Stir to coat , again careful not to smash berries
7. Cover and place in refrigerator for 30 - 45 minutes
8. May be served plain in small bowl or with a dollop of cool whip , or as a topping spooned over plain cake or ice cream

title: goan style seafood curry
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large skillet , over high heat , and cook the mustard seeds , while stirring , until they pop , about a minute
2. Stir in curry leaves
3. Add shallots and garlic , stir occasionally , until golden , about 5 minutes
4. Stir in turmeric , coriander , chili powder , and stir 30 seconds
5. Stir in the coconut cream , bring to a boil , reduce heat and stir for 2 minutes
6. Reduce the heat to low , add fish , and simmer , spooning the sauce over the fish to cook , about a minute
7. Add shrimp and cook until fish flakes easily and shrimp turns pink , about 4 to 5 minutes
8. Grate the peel from the lime and juice
9. Add half the juice to the skillet , taste , and add more as needed
10. Sprinkle with the lime peel and serve

title: seitan log 3  chick n version
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. In a large mixing bowl mix dry ingredients
3. Mix the rest of the ingredients in a smaller mixing bowl
4. Whisk well until mixed
5. Add the liquid ingredients to the dry ingredients
6. Mix well , then knead for a minute or two
7. It doesn't need long
8. Form into a log , wrap tightly in foil , twisting ends
9. Bake for 80 minutes , turning once or twice
10. When done baking , unwrap and leave out to cool all the way
11. Then wrap it foil or plastic and refrigerate
12. Slice to use as desired

title: peanut energy bars
steps:
1. Coat a 9x13 inch baking pan with cooking spray
2. Combine peanuts , sunflower seeds , raisins , oats , rice cereal and wheat germ or flax seed meal in a large bowl
3. Combine peanut butter , brown sugar and honey in a large microwaveable bowl and microwave on high or boil on stove top until bubbling
4. Add vanilla and stir until blended
5. Pour the peanut butter mixture over the dry ingredients and stir until covered
6. Transfer mixture to the prepared pan
7. Press down firmly
8. Let stand for about 1 hour to harden
9. Cut into bars

title: golden praline ham
steps:
1. Bake ham according to package directions
2. Combine jams and brown sugar over medium heat in a saucepan on the stove
3. Heat until well liquified , stirring often
4. Carefully spread mixture over ham for the last half hour of baking
5. When ham is finished , garnish with alternating rows of pecans and cherry halves

title: yummy cinnamon   brown sugar cream cheese
steps:
1. Whip up cream cheese to help soften
2. Add brown sugar , sugar and cinnamon
3. Remember you can add less or more until you get that certain taste you are looking for
4. Whip together and store in a sealable container for storage in the fridge

title: greenfield village dandelion soup
steps:
1. Saute the celery , carrot , onion , basil , oregano , cumin and garlic in the vegetable oil until tender
2. Add the stock , bay leaf , corn , beans and potatoes and simmer until the potatoes are tender
3. Season with salt and pepper

title: parkalucci s crispy fire shrimp
steps:
1. Using a deep fryer or deep pan , heat approximately 3 inches of oil to 400 degrees
2. Mix enough franks red hot sauce into the tempura batter mix to make it thinner than beer batter
3. Dip shrimp into flour , then into the franks / tempura batter , then coat with panko japanese style bread crumbs
4. Allow to sit for 5 minutes or so
5. Deep fry 4 to 6 shrimp at a time until golden brown , approximately 2-3 minutes
6. As a dipping sauce , i mix franks red hot sauce with ranch dressing , it's awesome
7. Enjoy

title: baked potato
steps:
1. Bake potato as you would a normal baked potato
2. Cut open slightly in 4 different directions , 4 triangle shapes
3. Fill with topping and enjoy

title: oogely bluegely  berry pretzels
steps:
1. Make the dough: place the blueberries , 1 tbsp of sugar , and 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in the bowl of a food processor , and pulse to make a thick paste
2. Set aside
3. Combine the yeast , remaining sugar , and oil in the bowl of an stand mixer fitted with a dough hook
4. Add the milk to the bowl , and with the mixer on low speed , beat the mixture for 4 minutes to dissolve the yeast
5. Add the flour , salt , and blueberry paste to the bowl , and mix on low speed until the dough begins to come together
6. Increase the mixing speed to medium and beat until the dough pulls away from the sides of the bowl and forms a tight ball , about 2 minutes
7. Remove the dough from the mixer and place it in a mixing bowl which has been lightly oiled or sprayed with cooking spray , turning once to coat
8. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap or a damp kitchen towel , and set in a warm , draft-free place
9. Let the dough rise until doubled in size , about 2 hours
10. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
11. Remove the dough from the bowl and turn it onto a smooth countertop surface
12. Cut the dough into about 10 pieces
13. Gently roll and pull each one into a long thin ribbon , about 12 inches in length
14. Cut the strips into 2" nuggets
15. If you wish to make pretzel shapes , bring the ends up to form a u-shape and twist to form a wreath , bringing the ends down and across as though making a bow , pressing down to seal the ends
16. Place onto a parchment lined baking sheet 1 / 2" apart
17. Spray the pretzels liberally with non-stick cooking spray and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar
18. Bake 12-15 minutes
19. Meanwhile make the dip: mix cream cheese and honey together well
20. Add several drops of food coloring and blend to well to desired 'blueness'
21. Once thoroughly blended , add a few more drops of food coloring and using a toothpick , swirl thru the dip
22. Remove the pretzels from the oven and place onto baking racks
23. Immidiately spray with more non-stick cooking spray and sprinkle generously with remaining cinnamon / sugar
24. Place the warm pretzels on a serving tray along with the dip
25. Best eaten right away
26. Store dip in the fridge , and the pretzels in a ziploc bag

title: blueberry crunch coffee cake
steps:
1. Mix together milk and vanilla extract
2. Set aside
3. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
4. Grease 9-inch springform pan
5. Coat inside evenly with flour
6. Tap out excess flour
7. Praline crunch: in small bowl , stir together brown sugar , flour and cinnamon
8. Add butter
9. Using a rubber spatula or your fingers , mash in butter until well blended
10. With fork , stir in chopped pecans
11. Cake: in large bowl , with electric mixer on high speed , beat together butter and sugar until creamy , about 2 minutes
12. Beat in eggs , 1 at a time , until blended
13. Continue to beat 2-3 minutes , until light and fluffy
14. In small bowl , mix flour , baking powder and salt
15. With mixer on low speed , alternately beat flour mixture and milk mixture into butter mixture until well blended
16. Spread two thirds of the batter in prepared pan
17. Crumble 1 / 3 cup praline crunch evenly over batter
18. Scatter frozen blueberries evenly over top
19. Carefully spread remaining batter over berries
20. Crumble remaining praline crunch evenly over top
21. Bake 65-70 minutes , until a wooden pick inserted into center comes out clean
22. Let cake cool completely in wire pan on wire rack
23. Remove sides and bottom of pan
24. Place cake on platter , top side up
25. Dust top with confectioners' sugar

title: oatmeal crumb topping  for pies
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl combine all the ingredients except the butter
2. Cut butter into mixture with a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse bread crumbs
3. Spread crumbs over prepared fruit mixture of your favorite fruit pie
4. Do not add top crust
5. Bake as directed in your fruit pie recipe
6. If crumbs become too dark while baking , cover loosely with foil , but remove foil the last few minutes of bakings so the topping will crisp

title: kicked up carrots
steps:
1. Peel and thinly slice carrots
2. About a quarter of an inch or so
3. Place carrots in a sauce pan with plenty of water to cover
4. Cook carrots at a boil over medium high heat till they are tender
5. About a minute before removing the carrots from stove add your raisins to the water to allow them to hydrate
6. Remove the pan from stove when the carrots are done and drain the water , returning carrots and raisins to the pan afterward
7. Drop the heat to low and return the pan to the stove adding the butter to the pan
8. Once the butter is melted add the brown sugar and cyanne pepper gently mixing in the flavors
9. Finally add the salt and pepper to your own personal preference

title: simple baked fiori
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 350 degrees f
2. Cook the pasta according to the directions on the box
3. Drain and set aside
4. Spray a medium sized saucepan with the cooking spray , or if you want you can use a tsp of olive oil
5. Add the minced garlic and cook for a minute or so over medium heat
6. Add the ground beef and cook until browned , breaking up the meat as it cooks , and drain the liquids
7. Keep the pan at medium heat
8. Add the thyme , oregano , rosemary , salt and pepper
9. Stir to coat the beef , and cook for another minute or so
10. Add the tomatoes and bring the mixture to a boil
11. Then , reduce the heat and let the mixture simmer for 5 minutes spoon a small amount of the mixture into the bottom of a 4- quart casserole dish
12. Top with half of the cooked pasta , and then layer half of the tomato mixture over the pasta , then layer half of the cheese
13. Layer the remaining pasta on top , and top the pasta with the remaining sauce and cheese
14. I always just use enough cheese to make each layer , so it is probably going to be more than the 1 cup
15. Cover the dish with foil and bake until the cheese is golden and bubbly , about 30 minutes
16. Enjoy !

title: gramma beaton s baked beans
steps:
1. Soak beans over night
2. Place beans in bean pot or casserole with bacon , onion , and brown sugar
3. Cover with water
4. Bake at 325 deg f until beans are done
5. Add more water if needed during cooking
6. Uncover last 30 minutes of cooking

title: giada s limoncello cheesecake squares
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Spray the bottom of a 9 by 9 by 2-inch baking pan with nonstick cooking spray
3. Finely grind the biscotti in a food processor
4. Add the melted butter and 1 tablespoon of lemon zest , and process until the crumbs are moistened
5. Press the crumb mixture over the bottom of the prepared pan
6. Bake until the crust is golden , about 15 minutes
7. Cool the crust completely on a cooling rack
8. Blend the ricotta in a clean food processor until smooth
9. Add the cream cheese and sugar and blend well , stopping the machine occasionally and scraping down the sides of the work bowl
10. Blend in the limoncello , vanilla , and remaining 2 tablespoons of lemon zest
11. Add the eggs one at a time , and pulse just until blended
12. Scrape down the sides of the bowl as needed
13. Pour the cheese mixture over the crust in the pan
14. Place the baking pan in a large roasting pan
15. Pour enough hot water into the roasting pan to come halfway up the sides of the baking pan
16. Bake until the cheesecake is golden and the center of the cake moves slightly when the pan is gently shaken , about 1 hour
17. Transfer the cake to a rack
18. Cool 1 hour
19. Refrigerate until the cheesecake is cold , at least 8 hours and up to 2 days
20. Cut the cake into squares and serve

title: pecan chicken saute
steps:
1. In a food processor , combine pecans and flour
2. Pulse until nuts are finely chopped but not oily
3. Transfer to a plate
4. Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper and dredge in pecan crumbs , pressing so coating adheres
5. In a large skillet , melt 2 t butter over medium heat
6. Add chicken and cook , turning once , until crust is browned and meat is white but still moist inside , about 8 minutes total
7. Remove with tongs to a warm platter , leaving drippings in pan
8. Melt remaining 1 / 2 t butter in skillet
9. Add shallots and sage and cook , stirring , until fragrant , about 30 seconds
10. Add wine , raise heat to high , and boil until slightly reduced , about 2 minutes
11. Pour sauce over chicken to serve

title: orange cream cheese brownies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Grease bottom of 13x9-inch rectangular pan
3. Stir brownie mix , chocolate syrup , water , oil and 2 eggs for fudgelike brownies in medium bowl , using spoon , until well blended
4. Spread in pan
5. Bake 27 to 29 minutes or until toothpick inserted 2 inches from side of pan comes out clean or almost clean
6. Cool completely
7. Stir cream cheese , powdered sugar , orange juice , 4 drops yellow food color and 2 drops red food color until smooth and spreadable
8. Spread over brownies
9. Place chocolate chips and shortening in small microwavable bowl
10. Microwave uncovered on medium about 2 minutes or until mixture can be stirred smooth
11. Drizzle over brownies
12. Refrigerate about 30 minutes or until cream cheese and chocolate are set
13. For 36 brownies , cut into 6 rows by 6 rows
14. Cover and refrigerate any remaining brownies

title: carrot orange soup
steps:
1. Skin and cut into 1 / 4 inch rounds approximately 5 cups of carrots
2. Add to slow cooker
3. Chop one onion finely and add to cooker
4. Add broth and orange juice
5. Add optional ginger if desired- makes soup tangy
6. Heat on low for 10-11 hours or high for 4-6 hours
7. When carrots are tender , blend to a smooth consistency
8. Add whipping cream , s and stir until creamy

title: taste of home lemon bbq chicken
steps:
1. Whisk together the first 10 ingredients
2. Add onion
3. Set aside 1 / 4 cup
4. Pour remaining marinade into a large resealable plastic bag
5. Add chicken
6. Seal bag and turn to coat
7. Refrigerate at least 8 hours or overnight , turning occasionally
8. Drain and discard marinade
9. Grill the chicken , covered , over indirect medium heat for 45 minutes or until juices run clear , turning and basting with reserved marinade every 8-10 minutes
10. To bake chicken: after marinating , place chicken in a greased 15-in
11. X 10-in
12. X 1-in
13. Baking pan
14. Pour the remaining marinade over the chicken
15. Bake , uncovered , at 350 degrees for 1-1 / 4 hours or until juices run clear , basting occasionally
16. Yield: 6 servings

title: caramel apple squares
steps:
1. Arrange crackers in bottom of 12x8 baking dish , cutting crackers to fit if necessary
2. Microwave 15 of the caramels and 2 tbls of the milk in a small microwaveable bowl on high 1-1 1 / 2 minutes or until caramels are melted and mixture is smooth , stirring after 1 minute
3. Spread over crackers , sprinkle with 1 / 3 cup of the walnuts
4. Refrigerate
5. Pour 1 cup of milk into large bowl , add pudding mix , beat with wire whisk 1-2 minutes
6. Gently stir in 1 cup of whipped topping
7. Spread over caramel layer
8. Refrigerate at least 3 hours or until ready to serve
9. Garnish with remaining cool whip , 1 / 3 cup chopped walnuts , apples and marshmallows
10. Microwave remaining 7 caramels and 1 tbls milk in small microwaveable bowl on high 1 minut or until caramels are melted and mixture is smooth , stirring after 30 seconds
11. Drizzle over top of dessert
12. Store leftover dessert in refrigerator

title: layered salad
steps:
1. Layer in order given
2. Then frost with mixture
3. Let meld overnight in frig , then , just before serving put cherry tomatoes and crumbled cooked bacon on it

title: simple blackened chicken
steps:
1. Marinate chicken overnight in italian dressing and garlic
2. I like to make sure they are no more than 1" thick , but that's just me
3. Heat non-stick skillet for at least 2 minutes on high heat
4. Place chicken in single layer on hot skillet
5. Add seasoning , quickly flip over and add to other side as well
6. Cook until 165 or until white and flaky in the middle of the thickest piece and somewhat black on the outside

title: thanksgiving latte
steps:
1. In an 8-ounce cup , combine syrups , honey and espresso
2. Fill cup with steamed milk and top with whipped cream
3. Sprinkle with cinnamon and garnish with cinnamon stick
4. Serve immediately

title: ruby
steps: 1. Fill a glass full with ice , pour desired amount of absolut ruby red vodka , add fresca , leave some space for cranberry juice

title: mushroom stuffed turkey breast
steps:
1. Heat 4 t
2. Butter in large skillet over medium heat
3. Add onion and garlic and saute until very soft , but not browned , about 5 minutes
4. Add mushrooms
5. Saute until tender and juices have evaporated , about15 minutes
6. Stir in bread crumbs
7. Cook , stirring to blend , about 3 minutes
8. Add dried fruits , 2 t
9. Lemon juice , and half the salt and pepper
10. Let stand until cool enough to handle
11. Heat oven to 350 degrees
12. Rinse turkey breast and pat dry
13. Trim any veins or tendons
14. Using fingers and
15. Place turkey in baking dish just large enough to hold it
16. Sprinkle all over with remaining lemon juice , salt , and pepper
17. Spoon all but 1 cup stuffing under skin and in neck cavity
18. Secure skin to flesh with small skewers
19. Fold under skin at neck end
20. Spoon remaining 1 cup stuffing onto underside of breast and turn skin side up in dish
21. Rub skin with remaining 1 t
22. Butter
23. Roast , basting every 15 minutes with pan juices , until meat thermometer inserted in thickest part of breast registers 160 degrees , about 1-1 / 4 to 1-1 / 2 hours
24. Pour pan juices into liquid measuring cup
25. Let turkey rest for about 15 minutes
26. Spoon off fat from pan juices and add enough water to measure 1-1 / 2 cups
27. Strain into small saucepan and heat to simmering
28. Dissolve cornstarch in cold water
29. Stir into pan juices
30. Simmer , stirring constantly , 1 minute
31. Remove from heat and adjust seasonings
32. Carve turkey into 1 / 2-inch-thick slices
33. Serve with gravy

title: smart cookie   the best chocolate chip cookies ever
steps:
1. Combine flour , baking soda , cinnamon , and salt in medium bowl
2. Whisk together oil , granulated sugar , and brown sugar in large bowl
3. Whisk in egg whites and vanilla until smooth
4. Stir in dry ingredients until blended
5. Fold in oats and then chocolate
6. Cover and chill dough at least 15 minutes
7. Meanwhile , heat oven to 375 degrees f
8. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper
9. Shape dough into 16 balls with hands , using a little pressure
10. Place 8 balls on each prepared sheet
11. With fingers , press each into a patty about 3" in diameter , allowing about 2" between patties for slight spreading
12. Bake 7 to 10 minutes or until desired brownness , switching position of sheets halfway through
13. Let cool a few minutes before moving to rack to cool completely
14. My own
15. You will think something is wrong with it because it will crumble and fall apart and kind of look greasy
16. But just squeeze them together into palm size balls and you will get lovely big puffy cookies ! make sure there is plenty of space for them to expand !

title: fresh peach   n kiwi fruit
steps:
1. Arrange romaine leaves on 4 plates
2. Place peach slices and kiwi alternating the slices on the leaves
3. Whisk together the oil , vinegar , cilantro broccoli and oregano
4. Just before serving drizzle the dressing and sprinkle the nuts over the 4 salads

title: rainforest cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f combine sugar and soft baking butter with canola oil in large bowl
2. Beat at medium speed until creamy
3. Add pineapple and vanilla
4. Continue beating until well mixed
5. Reduce speed to low
6. Add flour and baking powder
7. Beat until well mixed
8. Stir in nuts and 1 / 4 cup coconut by hand
9. Shape dough into 1-inch balls
10. Dip top of each cookie into remaining coconut
11. Place 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheets
12. Bake in oven 12-15 minutes or until set

title: wakey wakey
steps:
1. Use a 50ml sherry glass
2. Sambuca first , then layer with espresso and finish off with a top layer of cream

title: kickin  sweet potato fries
steps:
1. Preheat oven 400f
2. Line a baking sheet with foil , and arrange fries
3. Drizzle oil on top
4. Sprinkle seasoning , salt , and pepper
5. Bake about 40-50 minutes , depending on fries thickness
6. A thicker steak fry will need a lower baking temperature , and longer cooking time
7. Fries should be golden and crispy

title: snacking carrot cake   3 point
steps:
1. In large mixing bowl , combine flours , splenda , baking powder , salt , cinnamon , nutmeg and ginger
2. Lightly beat eggs , yogurt , applesauce , oil and vanilla
3. Add carrots and raisins
4. Mix well
5. Stir into flour mixture until blended
6. Spread into 9 inch square lightly greased baking pan
7. Bake in 350 f oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until toothpick inserted in centre comes out clean
8. Allow to cool
9. May be served with topping such as cool whip

title: crescent squares
steps:
1. Remove 1 package of crescent rolls from container unroll on an ungreased baking sheet
2. Press perforations together to seal
3. Cream together cream cheese , 1 cup sugar and vanilla
4. In a separate bowl combine 1 / 2 cup of sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon
5. Spread cream cheese mixture evenly on top of crescent rolls
6. Open the other container of crescent rolls
7. Unroll , and place on top of cream cheese filling
8. Press and pinch to seal edges of dough together
9. Brush top of pastry with melted butter and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar
10. Bake ate 350 degrees for 45 minutes or until golden brown

title: remoulade sauce
steps:
1. Mix all ingrediants together in a quart jar and chill
2. Serve cold

title: new england soup factory s sweet potato chicken barley soup
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a large heavy stock pot
2. Saute garlic , onions , celery and carrot for 8 minutes
3. Add parsnips , barley , chicken and chicken stock
4. Bring to a boil
5. Simmer on medium-high heat for 30 minutes
6. Add the sweet potatoes and cook an additional 30 minutes
7. Add dill and season

title: parmesan grilled sweet onions
steps:
1. Place each onion half , cut side up on a square of heavy-duty aluminum foil
2. Dot each with butter
3. Sprinkle with cheese , salt and pepper
4. Wrap onions tightly in foil
5. Grill 20 to 30 minutes or until tender

title: applesauce chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar together
2. Add eggs and applesauce , mix well
3. Mix baking powder , soda , salt , cinnamon , cloves and vanilla
4. Add to creamed mixture
5. Blend in flour
6. Add chocolate chips
7. Can also add 3 / 4c chopped nuts if desired
8. Drop by teaspoons onto greased cookie sheet
9. Bake at 400 degrees for 8-10 minutes , until lightly browned

title: soft chewy raisin cookies
steps:
1. Put raisins and water in small saucepan
2. Bring to a boil , cook on low 4 min , set aside
3. Cream shortning , gradually add sugar
4. Add eggs and vanilla
5. Mix dry ing
6. Gradually add to creamed mixture
7. Blend well
8. Stir in nuts and raisins with juice
9. Drop by teaspoons on greased sheets
10. Bake at 350f degrees for 12 minutes

title: sunday dinner pot roast
steps:
1. Place meat in 4 quart baking pan and sprinkle with steak seasoning
2. Combine beef broth with basil , oregano and thyme and add to pan
3. Cover and bake at 350 for 1 1 / 2 hours
4. Uncover meat and scatter potatoes , carrots and onion around roast
5. Cover and bake for 1 1 / 2 hours more or until meat is tender
6. Remove meat from pan and slice
7. Arrange on serving dish and surround with vegetables
8. If desired , thicken pan juices with flour

title: arare dofu no aemono
steps:
1. Cut the tofu into 1 / 2 inch cubes or 2 inch matchsticks
2. Cut the carrots into matchsticks
3. You can also use 1 3 / 4 ounces narazuke pickles
4. You can use diced pickled red gingerroot in place of the cucumber pickles
5. Combine first four ingredients in bowl
6. Make dressing
7. Add to vegetables
8. Toss lightly

title: day   after   thanksgiving turkey sandwich
steps:
1. Soak 1 slice bread in gravy about 2 minutes
2. Spread other 2 slices with mayonnaise mixed with the seasoning
3. On bottom slice of bread , layer the lettuce , turkey , the gravy-soaked slice of bread , stuffing& the top slice of bread

title: fish and chips
steps:
1. Half-fill a deep pan with melted fat or oil
2. Heat until a faint haze rises from it
3. Sift the flour and salt into a bowl
4. Beat to a smooth batter with unbeaten egg , butter and milk
5. Coat 2 pieces of fish with batter
6. Lift into the pan with a fork or kitchen tongs
7. Fry until crisp and golden , allowing about 6-8 minutes for large pieces and 4-5 minutes for medium
8. Remove from the pan and drain on unprinted newspaper
9. Garnish with lemon wedges , and serve with fish and chip shop curry sauce

title: goat cheese  greens  and walnut salad
steps:
1. Mix salad greens , diced red pepper , diced scallions , sliced goat cheese , and walnuts together in salad bowl
2. Toss well with vinaigrette dressing , and serve

title: sandy s chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray a glass baking pan with non-stick cooking spray
3. Place chicken in glass pan and sprinkle the tops with seasoned salt
4. Spread cream of chicken soup over the chicken
5. Top each piece of chicken with a slice of swiss cheese and cheddar cheese
6. In a small bowl , combine stuffing mix and butter and mix
7. Spread stuffing mix over the chicken pieces
8. Bake uncovered for 50-55 mintues or until browned and bubbly

title: broiled pork chops
steps:
1. Ina a saucepan , combine the first nine ingredients
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat
4. Simmer for 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Set aside half of the sauce
6. Place chops on broiling pan rack
7. Broil about 4 inches from the heat for 4 minutes on each side
8. Brush with remaining sauce
9. Continue broiling , turning and basting occasionally , for 3-4 minutes or until juices run clear
10. Serve with reserved sauce

title: black bean salsa with pineapple
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a bowl
2. Toss and serve wtih blue tortilla chips which are higher in protein and fiber than regular white chips

title: bulgarian yogurt cake
steps:
1. Cream butter in large bowl
2. Add sugar
3. Beat with mixer until creamy and light
4. Add eggs one at a time , then lemon rind
5. Beat again
6. Stir in yogurt
7. Stir flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt into yogurt mixture
8. Beat until smooth
9. Pour into greased cake pan 9" square
10. Bake at 350 f for 35 minutes or until toothpick tests done
11. Cool for five minutes
12. Sprinkle with powdered sugar
13. Serve warm

title: spicy crunchy chickpea snack
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 200c / 400f
2. Peel and chop the garlic cloves rather coarsely
3. Toss all the ingredients together thoroughly
4. Spread evenly over a baking sheet
5. Bake for 30 minutes , stirring around midway through
6. Take out and let cool
7. [edit: this baking time turns out peas that are a mix of crunchy ones and ones that are still a bit soft - i like this variety
8. Since all ovens vary , you will need to test the doneness
9. If you like your peas to be a bit soft , bake them for a shorter time
10. If you like them very crunchy leave them in longer
11. ]
12. Store this in an airtight container in the refrigerator
13. Makes a great beer snack
14. You can make it sweet-spicy by sprinkling over some brown or raw sugar to while it's still hot from the oven

title: filipino beef stew  sinigang na carne
steps:
1. Saute onion , garlic , and tomatoes in hot oil in big pot until onion browns
2. Add beef , pork , and enough rice wash or cold water to cover the meat
3. Bring to a boil , lower heat and simmer until meat is tender
4. Add salt
5. Bring to a boil for 10 minutes
6. Simmer , and add cabbage & radishes
7. Taste for seasonings and add salt & pepper if needed
8. Add more water if necessary and the string beans
9. Simmer until veggies are tender
10. Just before serving , add lemon juice
11. Serve with rice

title: celebrity chef celestino drago s lobster spaghetti
steps:
1. Cut lobster in two , under running water and remove dark membrane from inside the head
2. In a saut pan , add garlic , shallots , chili flakes , olive oil and lobster
3. Saut for a few minutes
4. Add white wine and brandy
5. Let evaporate then add tomato , salt and vegetable broth
6. Cover and cook for about 5 minutes
7. In a pot with boiling salted water cook spaghetti al dente&#769
8. About 6 minutes
9. Drain and add to sauce
10. Let pasta cook into sauce for about 1-2 minutes
11. Add parsley and the extra virgin olive oil and serve immediately

title: family circle s lean chicken turkey pot pie
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f coat a 3-quart baking dish with nonstick cooking spray
2. Heat 2 teaspoons of the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
3. Season chicken with 1 / 4 teaspoon of the salt and 1 / 4 teaspoon of the pepper
4. Cook 8 minutes , turning halfway through cooking time
5. Transfer to a plate
6. Add remaining oil , onion and celery
7. Cook 3 minutes
8. Stir in garlic , and flour and cook , stirring constantly , 1 minute
9. Gradually stir in broth and milk
10. Cook , stirring , until mixture comes to a boil
11. Add potatoes , carrots , green beans , remaining salt and pepper
12. Cover
13. Cook on medium-low , stirring occasionally , 10 minutes
14. Stir in chicken , parsley , and sage
15. Spoon mixture into prepared baking dish
16. Unroll phyllo
17. Place 1 sheet on top of chicken mixture
18. Lightly coating with cooking spray
19. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of the cheese
20. Repeat layering
21. Tuck edges of phyllo inside rim of baking dish
22. Place baking dish on a baking sheet
23. Bake at 350f for 35 to 40 minutes or until filling is bubbly
24. Let stand 10 minutes before serving

title: creamy lemon sauce
steps:
1. Mix the cream and flour in a saucepan
2. Cook for 3 minutes , stirring constantly
3. Mix the lemon peel into the sauce and season with pepper
4. Serve hot with steamed vegetables

title: just another chocolate cake
steps:
1. Combine cocoa , hot water and baking soda in a small bowl
2. Let stand while mixing other ingredients
3. Cream the shortening and sugar together in a mixing bowl , using an electric mixer set on medium speed , until light and fluffy
4. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
5. Beat in vanilla and cocoa mixture
6. Add flour alternately with the buttermilk to creamed mixture beating well after each addition
7. Pour batter into 3 greased and wax paper lined 8-inch round cake pans
8. Bake in a preheated 350 degree f
9. Oven for 25 minutes or until cakes test done
10. Cool in pans on racks for 10 minutes
11. Remove from pans
12. Cool completely on racks
13. To assemble cake , place one cake layer on serving plate
14. Spread with frosting of your choice
15. Top with second cake layer and spread a layer of frosting
16. Top with third cake layer and frost sides and top with remaining frosting

title: sauted yellow squash with onions
steps:
1. Cut squash into thin slices
2. Spread slices out onto paper towels
3. Salt and allow to "sweat"
4. After 10 minutes blot with paper towel
5. Flip slices over and repeat with salt and blot after 10 minutes
6. This allows salt to flavor squash and releases water for better sauting
7. In a 10 inch saucepan combine olive oil and butter
8. Lightly saut onion first and set aside into small bowl
9. In same saucepan saut squash on low heat until tender
10. Before removing from heat add sauted onions and sprinkle with lawry's seasoned salt , garlic powder and black pepper

title: simple caffe latte  cafe quality at home
steps:
1. Pour cold milk into a saucepan and heat on medium heat just until too hot to put your finger into it
2. Pour espresso into 2 mugs
3. Pour the steamed milk into mugs over the brewed espresso
4. Enjoy !

title: brown butter gnocchi with spinach and pine nuts
steps:
1. Cook gnocchi according to package directions , drain
2. Heat butter in a large non stick skillet over medium heat
3. Add pine nuts to pan
4. Cook 3 minutes or until butter and nuts are lightly browned , stirring constantly
5. Add garlic to pan
6. Cook 1 minute
7. Add gnocchi and spinach to pan
8. Cook 1 minute sor until spinach wilts ,
9. Stirring constantly
10. Stir in salt and pepper
11. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese

title: nat s easy marinated asparagus
steps:
1. Dip asparagus in boiling water and drain immediately
2. Pour italian salad dressing over asparagus , cover , and marinate overnight
3. Serve on lettuce leaf and sprinkle with fresh black pepper and fresh grated parmesean

title: double berry super sodas
steps:
1. Strawberry puree:
2. Rinse and hull the strawberries for puree
3. Place in blender or food processor and puree until smooth
4. Strain and refrigerate until ready to make sodas
5. For each soda:
6. Rinse berries for sodas
7. Hull and halve or quarter , if using strawberries
8. Frost very tall glasses as follows:
9. Spread 1 / 4 cup sugar evenly on small plate , measure 1 / 4 cup water into small bowl
10. Dip rims of glasses first in water , then in sugar to coat rims
11. Keep glasses in freezer until ready to prepare sodas
12. Layer berries and ice cream in frosted glasses: about one-fourth of berries , small scoop ice cream , and another one-fourth of berries , second scoop of ice cream , another one-fourth of the berries , etc
13. In large pitcher gently blend puree , sparkling water , lemon juice and brandy
14. Pour into prepared frosted glasses
15. Garnish with mint leaves and remaining berries

title: capone s chicken  broccoli and ziti
steps:
1. If using fresh broccoli , blanch it first in boiling , salted water for 1 minute
2. Drain and let cool before using
3. Thaw frozen broccoli before using
4. In a saute pan over medium high heat , melt the butter
5. Add the chicken and saute , turning , until it browns on all sides
6. Add the garlic , broccoli and chicken stock
7. Let simmer 8-10 minutes
8. Add the pasta and toss

title: tuscan dip
steps:
1. Mix cream cheese and sour cream in a medium bowl until well blended
2. Add remaining ingredients , mix well
3. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour for the flavors to blend before serving

title: caramel crunch cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Mix cake flour and sugar together
3. Add egg yolks , water , lemon juice and vanilla and beat until smooth
4. In a large bowl beat egg whites , cream of tartar and salt until a fine foam forms through
5. Gradually add sugar and continue beating until meringue is firm and stands in peaks
6. Fold batter gently into meringue until just blended
7. Do not stir
8. Gently spoon batter into ungreased tube pan
9. Cut through batter with a knife to break up bubbles and level mixture
10. Bake in preheated oven for 50-55 minutes or until top springs back when touched
11. Remove from oven
12. Immediately turn over and place tube over neck of funnel or bottle to cool
13. Let stand until cool , then loosen with spatula and place on plate
14. Split cake into four layers
15. While cake is baking , combine sugar , coffee and syrup in a deep saucepan
16. Stir and bring to a boil and cook until hard crack stage or 310 degrees on a candy thermometer
17. Remove from heat and immediately add soda and stir vigorously just until topping thickens and pulls away from sides of pan
18. Immediately pour into ungreased shallow metal pan
19. Do not stir or spread
20. Let cool without moving
21. Knock out of pan and crush into coarse crumbs between sheets of waxed paper with rolling pin
22. Whip cream , sugar and vanilla until stiff
23. Spread half of cream between layers and remainder on top and sides
24. Refrigerate until ready to serve
25. Just before serving , cover cake with crushed caramel candy

title: ultimate chili
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat
2. Add onions and garlic , cook 5 minutes , stirring often
3. Add ground beef and cook until no longer pink
4. Add the next 7 ingredients and cook 4 minutes
5. Add undrained plum tomatoes , and the undrained rotel tomatoes
6. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer uncovered for about 1 hour or until thickened , stirring occasionally
7. Add kidney beans and cook an additional 10 minutes

title: mini spinach calzones
steps:
1. Mix spinach , cream cheese , green onion , parmesan cheese and pepper
2. Set aside
3. On lightly floured table roll dough out into a 15-inch square
4. With a knife cut into 25 three-inch squares
5. Spoon a heaping 1 teaspoon of filling on the middle of dough
6. Brush edges of dough with some water
7. Lift a corner of each square and stretch dough over filling to the opposite corner , making a triangle
8. Press edges of dough to seal
9. Prick calzones with a fork , brush with milk
10. Bake on a greased baking sheet 425 for 8-10 minutes or golden brown
11. Serve with spaghetti sauce

title: pineapple gooey cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Combine the cake mix , egg , and butter and mix well with an electric mixer
3. Pat the mixture into the bottom of a lightly greased 13 by 9-inch baking pan
4. To make the filling: in a large bowl , beat the cream cheese and pineapple until smooth
5. Add the eggs , vanilla , and butter , and beat together
6. Next , add the powdered sugar , cinnamon , nutmeg , and mix well
7. Spread pineapple mixture over cake batter and bake for 40 to 50 minutes
8. Make sure not to overbake as the center should be a little gooey
9. Serve with fresh whipped cream

title: peanut butter burgers
steps:
1. In a large bowl , with fork , lightly mix peanut butter , ground chuck , salt and pepper just until combined divide into 5 burgers , about 1 / 2 cup for each one
2. Flatten gently
3. Arrange in large skillet , not overlapping
4. Cook over medium heat about 4 minutes to a side or until done to desired doneness
5. Serve in buttered buns

title: cranberry mincemeat squares
steps:
1. Combine flour , oats , 3 / 4 cup brown sugar and butter until crumbly
2. Reserve 1 1 / 2 cups crumbs
3. With remaining crumbs press into greased 15x10 pan
4. Bake 15 minutes at 350
5. Beat cream cheese and milk
6. Add eggs
7. Mix well
8. Spread on cooled crust
9. Top with mincemeat
10. Combine 1 tablespoon brown sugar and cornstarch
11. Stir in with cranberry sauce
12. Spoon over mincemeat
13. Top with remaining crumbs
14. Bake 40 minutes
15. Cool and cut into squares
16. Refrigerate in airtight container

title: hot ham and pineapple sub
steps:
1. Place the french loaf dough seam side down on a lightly greased baking sheet
2. With a sharp knife , cut six slashes , about 1 / 2 inch deep on top of dough
3. Bake at 350 for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown
4. Combine the oil , italian seasoning and garlic salt
5. Brush over hot bread
6. Cool on wire rack for 8 minutes
7. Split bread in half lengthwise
8. Hollow out bottom half , leaving a 1 / 4 inch shell
9. Spread 2-3 tablespoons of pizza sauce over shell
10. Top with ham , pineapple and cheese
11. Replace bread top
12. Bake for 6-8 minutes or until cheese is melted
13. Heat the remaining pizza sauce and serve with sandwich

title: vegetarian lemon rice with artichokes and chickpeas
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in very large pan with a lid
2. Add rice and saut until golden brown
3. Add onions and red bell pepper and saut until soft and onions are translucent
4. A couple of minutes before onions and red pepper are soft , add the garlic
5. Stir in broth , lemon juice , salt and pepper
6. Bring to a boil
7. Cover and reduce heat
8. Simmer for 40 minutes or until rice is tender
9. Remove from heat
10. Stir in artichokes and chickpeas
11. Cover for about 5 minutes to make sure they get warm
12. When serving , sprinkle with parmesan cheese

title: pork medallions over noodles  low fat
steps:
1. Sprinkle both sides of the pork slices with oregano and pepper
2. Add the oil to a large no-stick skillet and heat over med heat
3. Add pork to skillet and cook for 2 minutes
4. Turn the slices over and cook 2-4 more minutes or until pork is no longer pink
5. Transfer to a plate and cover to keep warm
6. Add the onions to the skillet and cook & stir for 2 minutes
7. Add the tomatoes , broth , lemon peel , garlic , cinnamon , and nutmeg
8. Cook and stir for 4-5 minutes or until the liquid has evaporated
9. To serve , place the noodles on a large platter
10. Sprinkle with the parsley and arrange pork on top
11. Spoon the tomato mixture on top of the pork

title: tuscan chicken in lemon wine sauce  scaloppine al limone
