steps:
1. Flatten each chicken breast by pounding gently with a flat meat mallet
2. Sprinkle flattened breasts with salt and pepper
3. Then dredge chicken in flour
4. Shake off excess
5. Heat butter and oil over high heat
6. Just before butter starts to brown , add the chicken pieces and saute quickly to brown , about 3 minutes
7. Flip and brown other side
8. It doesn't need to be totally cooked through because it will cook more in the sauce later
9. Remove chicken to platter but leave all browned bits in the skillet
10. Add wine to browned bits in skillet and boil to reduce wine by almost half
11. Add chicken broth and bring to a boil
12. In a small bowl , whisk together egg and lemon juice
13. Stir egg / lemon mixture into simmering wine and broth , whisking constantly until sauce is smooth and a little thickened
14. It will thicken more when you put in the chicken breasts which have a flour coating
15. Add chicken and any juices back into the sauce
16. Allow to simmer about 5 minutes until chicken is cooked through , turning chicken once
17. Add chopped parsley
18. Place chicken on platter and pour sauce over top
19. Garnish with lemon slices and additional parsley sprigs
20. Hint: please use fresh lemons and parsley
21. It has a big impact on the flavor of the dish , and besides , no aspiring italian chef would consider using otherwise !

title: lobia   black eyed peas curry
steps:
1. In pot soak beans overnight in water to cover generously
2. Next day , drain beans , cover with fresh water and bring to boil
3. Add salt , coriander , cumin and turmeric
4. Simmer until beans are just tender , about 30 to 45 minutes
5. Heat oil in deep saucepan
6. Add onion , garlic , ginger and cumin
7. Fry 10 minutes and add tomato
8. Cook another 5 minutes and add lobia and cooking liquid
9. Continue to simmer , uncovered , until lobhia are soft but not completely dissolved
10. Mixture should be soupy

title: butter rum bundt cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease and flour a 12-cup bundt pan
3. Beat dry cake mix , pudding mix , water , butter , eggs and 2 teaspoons rum extract in large bowl on low speed for 30 seconds
4. Beat on medium speed 2 minutes
5. Pour into bundt pan
6. Bake 50 to 60 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
7. Cool 30 minutes
8. Remove from pan
9. Cool completely
10. About 2 hours
11. Frosting:
12. Place frosting in small microwavable bowl
13. Microwave uncovered on medium for approximately 15 seconds
14. Stir in 1 / 2 teaspoon rum extract
15. Spread over top of cake , allowing some to drizzle down side
16. Sprinkle pecans over top of cake
17. Serve
18. Cook time does not include 2 1 / 2 hour cooling time

title: thai coconut curry soup
steps:
1. Scoop the thick coconut cream from the top of just one of the cans into a large stockpot set over a medium-high heat
2. Melt the cream , add the curry paste and stir for a few minutes until they begin to sizzle
3. Add the chicken and saut until the chicken is cooked through , about 5 minutes
4. Add the coconut juice from the first can and all the contents of the second can along with the chicken broth , carrot , lime leaves , lemon grass , fish sauce and lime zest and juice
5. Grate the frozen ginger into the broth with a microplane grater or standard box grater
6. Simmer for 20 minutes or so
7. Stir in the bean sprouts
8. Add the rice noodles , gently pushing them beneath the surface of the broth
9. Turn off the heat and let stand until the noodles soften , about 5 minutes
10. Rice noodles dont need to simmer like pasta to cook
11. They simply need to rehydrate in the hot liquid
12. Stir in most of the cilantro leaves
13. Remove the lemon grass stalks
14. Taste and season with a touch more salt as needed
15. Ladle into large bowls and garnish with the green onions and remaining cilantro leaves

title: thai tofu w red curry sauce over coconut scallion rice
steps:
1. If using lime leaves , soak in hot water for 30 minutes
2. Bring coconut milk , 2 1 / 2 cups water , 1 tsp salt to a boil , then add rice
3. Cover the pan and reduce heat to lowest setting
4. Cook for 25 minutes
5. Pan fry tofu until golden brown
6. Drain on papertowel & set aside
7. Chop lime leaves in small pieces
8. In a food processor or blender , combine lime rind / leaves , 2 / 3 cup cilantro , garlic , & peanuts
9. Run the machine in spurts
10. With the machine running , add the fish sauce & 3 tbsp oil , then the chili sauce
11. Transfer mixture to bowl
12. Put broccoli and 1 / 2 cup water in pan
13. Cover and steam for 2 minutes
14. Add sauce , stir for 1 minute , then add tofu
15. Stir scallions into rice
16. Serve tofu curry over rice

title: texas iron skillet cornbread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Mix all ingredients together
3. Pour into a pre-heated , oiled or greased 8-9" iron skillet
4. Bake for 20 minutes
5. Add corn , jalapenos , bacon , etc
6. For variety
7. Pouring the batter into the hot skillet gives it a crisp crust

title: grandpa s strawberry lemonade
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , bring the water and sugar to a boil
2. Reduce the heat and simmer , stirring occasionally until the sugar dissolves
3. Add lemon peel and lemon juice , stir and remove from heat
4. Let cool completely , then strain into a clean pitcher
5. In a blender , puree the pint of strawberries and add to the lemon juice
6. Stir well and refrigerate
7. Add sparkling water and stir well when ready to serve

title: border town refried beans or bean dip
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a saucepan
2. Over medium heat , stir until the beans are heated through , about 5-10 minutes
3. For dip , transfer beans to a fondue pot to keep warm
4. Serve with tostitos

title: everyday french breakfast  baguette and jam with chocolate milk
steps:
1. If possible , buy a french stick that is part-baked so you can bake it at home for that truly fresh texture
2. Cut the french stick in half vertically , then halve each part horizontally
3. Spread a thin layer of butter over each piece of bread , then top with strawberry jam
4. Serve with a glass of chocolate milk , or if you want to have a really authentic breakfast , pour the chocolate milk into a bowl and dunk the bread and jam before savouring each bite !

title: lazy eggs
steps:
1. Heat oven to 170
2. Lightly grease inside of a muffin tray with butter
3. Line 1 muffin well per person with ham ,
4. Place approx 1 tsp chopped tomato in each well ,
5. Top with grated cheese & crack an egg on top
6. Season with salt & pepper
7. Place into the oven for 18 to 20 mins until egg white is cooked and
8. Yolk is as firm as you like

title: pumpkin waffles with orange syrup  low fat
steps:
1. In a medium bowl stir together the flour , brown sugar , baking powder , salt , and pumpkin pie spice
2. Make a well in the center of the flour mixture
3. In another medium bowl combine the milk , pumpkin , egg substitute , and oil
4. Add milk mixture all at once to flour mixture
5. Stir just until moistened
6. Pour about 3 / 4 cup batter onto grids of a preheated , lightly greased waffle baker
7. Close lid quickly
8. Do not open until golden brown
9. Bake according to manufacturer's directions
10. When done , use a fork to lift waffle off grids
11. Repeat with remaining batter
12. For orange syrup: in a small saucepan stir together the orange juice , honey , cornstarch and cinnamon
13. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly
14. Cook and stir for 2 minutes more
15. Serve warm
16. Makes about 1 cup

title: cherry oat muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Line muffin tins with paper liners
3. In large bowl , combine oats , oat bran , brown sugar , flour , baking powder and baking soda and mix well
4. In another bowl , combine oil , buttermilk , and eggs and mix with fork until blended
5. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and mix 20-30 strokes just until dry ingredients disappear
6. Gently stir in cherries
7. Batter should be lumpy
8. Fill prepared muffin tins 2 / 3 full with batter
9. Bake for 17-20 minutes until light golden brown
10. Remove from pan and cool on a wire rack

title: the almost original branston pickle recipe
steps:
1. Combine all the ingredients in a large saucepan and bring them to the boil
2. Then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook until the swede is cooked , but still remains firm , about 2 hours
3. Stir well to redistribute all of the vegetables
4. Bottle and seal in sterile and hot jars
5. Allow the pickle to age for a few weeks before using , this improves the taste and it will become more "mellow"
6. Serve with cheese , ploughman's lunches , in sandwiches , with cold cuts and meats
7. This pickle is also wonderful when added to curries and stews

title: cheddar stuffed black pepper crusted burgers
steps:
1. Combine ground meats in a large bowl
2. Season with worcestershire , dry mustard , 2 tsp salt and mix until combined
3. Divide the meat into 6 equal portions and gently shape into a patty around a cube of cheese
4. Brush the patties all over with olive oil and make an imprint in the center of each patty with your thumb
5. Spread the pepper on a shallow plate and roll the edge of each burger in the pepper until coated
6. Preheat grill
7. Place burger on the cooking grate over direct medium heat
8. Cover and grill for 4 minutes
9. Turn and continue grilling for 3 to 4 more minutes for medium rare burgers
10. Top each burger with a slice of cheddar
11. Butter both sides of buns and grill over direct medium heat until lightly toasted
12. Serve burgers on rolls with desired toppings

title: korma afghanistan meat sauce
steps:
1. Heat oil in a heavy pan , saute the onion until transparent
2. Add garlic and meat cubes , stir frequently and continue cooking until the meat browns
3. Add water , salt , pepper , chili flakes , split peas& cumin
4. Cover and simmer gently for 1 1 / 2 hours or until the meat is very tender and the peas are soft
5. Add coriander and continue cooking for 10 miutes
6. Serve over a mound of steamed rice

title: 5 minute delicious artichoke dip  food processor  make ahead
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Coarsely chop the onion in the food processor
3. Add drained artichoke hearts
4. Coarsely chop
5. Don't over chop
6. Add lemon juice , parmesan cheese , mayonnaise , cream and pepper
7. Briefly pulse processor to mix or mix with the spatula
8. Don't over chop
9. Spoon into an ovenproof casserole
10. You may refrigerate it for a day or so until you are ready to bake it
11. Bake uncovered at 400 degrees f for about 25 min until bubbly and top is golden
12. Serve with sliced french bread

title: shrimp in love pasta
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Meanwhile , cook and stir shrimp , tomatoes and cream cheese in a large skillet on medium to high heat 3-4 minutes , or until shrimp are cooked through and sauce is well blended
3. Drain pasta
4. Place in a large bowl
5. Add spinach and mix lightly
6. Add shrimp mixture and toss to coat

title: southwest smoothie
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in food processor workbowl fitted with steel blade or in blender container
2. Cover and process on high speed until smooth
3. Strain if using mango

title: avocado  n  honey
steps:
1. Cut the avocado in half , take out the pit
2. Pour 1 tablespoon of honey into each center of the avocado
3. Eat with a dessert spoon and enjoy !

title: italian chicken and peppers
steps:
1. Saut peppers , onions , mushrooms and garlic in a large skillet until the peppers are slightly tender
2. Remove vegetables from skillet and set aside
3. Add vegetable oil to warm skillet
4. Place cubed chicken into the skillet and cook on medium heat until browned
5. Approximately 15 minutes
6. Return sauteed vegetables to skillet with chicken
7. Add sauce to the skillet and heat through
8. Add salt , pepper and additional spices if needed
9. Serve over cooked pasta

title: tropical fruit smoothies
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients in a blender
2. This recipe is very versatile , try your own ideas or change the amounts if you like
3. This is the way i make them , and they are so good
4. We also freeze them sometimes to make smoothie popsicles !
5. Very kid-friendly

title: sticky rice
steps:
1. Place your preferred amount of rice in the rice cooker and wash three times by filling pot with water and draining it off just until the rice is about to spill out of the pot
2. After washing , fill pot with water until the water reaches the first line of your middle finger when you stick your middle finger down and just touch the rice
3. Cook rice using cooker , which automatically shuts off or clicks to warm setting depending on your cooker
4. Your rice should be nice and sticky and soak up the great flavors of anything you are adding to it , and it should also be great by itself

title: little vanilla pound cake for 2
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease and flour pan very well
3. I designed this to go in a petit loaf pan that measures about 5x3x2 but you can use 2 mini bundts , 4 cupcake cups , 2 jumbo muffin cups or whatever small pan you like
4. When doubled it works nicely with the 6 cup bundt pan , a 5 inch springform , 4 mini bundts or a 7x4x3 loaf pan
5. Whisk together flour and sugar in small mixing bowl
6. In another small bowl , whisk together sour cream and baking soda
7. Add egg and vanilla ex , gently whisk to combine
8. Add the butter and 1 / 2 of the sour cream mixture to the flour mixture and mix with electric mixer until moistened
9. Beat on low for about 45 seconds
10. Add remaining sour cream mixture and beat on medium until well blended , 30 seconds
11. Don't over mix or you'll ruin the texture
12. Pour into prepared pan and bake until browned well and toothpick inserted in center comes out clean , about 25-30 minutes for the petit loaf pan
13. When doubled bake 40 minutes in the small loaf pan
14. Baking times vary slightly depending on which pan you use
15. The important thing is that the cake is browned and toothpick comes out clean when inserted in center
16. Cool in pan 10 minutes on rack
17. Remove from pan and cool completely

title: classic honey flan
steps:
1. Combine eggs , milk , 1 / 4 cup honey and vanilla
2. Beat until mixed but not foamy
3. Combine remaining 1 / 4 cup honey and cinnamon in small bowl
4. Mix well
5. Place 4 custard cups in 8-inch square baking dish
6. Spoon 1 tablespoon honey-cinnamon mixture into each custard cup
7. Divide egg mixture into each custard cup
8. Place baking dish on middle rack of oven
9. Pour boiling water into baking dish around custard cups to 1-inch depth
10. Bake at 325 degrees f 30 to 45 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean
11. Serve warm or cold
12. Loosen edges of individual custards with spatula or knife
13. Invert onto dessert plates

title: tomato and cheese egg noodles
steps:
1. Boil noodles in salted water 7 to 8 minutes
2. Drain noodles
3. Return to saucepan and add butter , cheese and tomato sauce
4. Heat over low until cheese melts

title: honey bread   bread machine
steps:
1. Put ingredients into bread maker in manufacturer's suggested order
2. Select light crust setting
3. Delay timer ok

title: caramel pudding pumpkin cupcakes  hungry girl
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine all cupcake ingredients in a mixing bowl with 1 / 3 cup of water
3. Whip with a whisk or fork for 2 minutes until well blended
4. Spray a 12-cup muffin pan with nonstick spray or line with baking cups
5. Evenly spoon batter into muffin cups
6. Place pan in the oven and cook for about 12 minutes
7. Once cupcakes are cool enough to handle , arrange them closely on a plate so that the edges are touching
8. Place caramel and soymilk in a tall microwave-safe glass or dish
9. Microwave at medium power for 1 1 / 2 minutes
10. Stir mixture vigorously until smooth and thoroughly blended
11. Immediately drizzle caramel sauce over cupcakes

title: grilled linguine and clam sauce
steps:
1. Preheat grill to high
2. Place a large aluminum baking pan directly on grate
3. In the pan place butter and chopped onion and saute , stirring frequently until onion is translucent
4. Add the garlic , half the parsley , and half the basil and saute for a few minutes more until the garlic just starts to turn color
5. Add wine , 1 can of the chicken broth , salt and pepper and the clams
6. Lower heat to medium , close the grill checking every few minutes and tossing the clams around for about 15 to 20 minutes , until clams open
7. Add pasta the remainder of the parsley , basil , and broth , grated cheese and shake in as much hot pepper flakes to the heat you desire
8. Mix well , close the grill and cook a few minutes more untill everything is heated through

title: brisket supreme  crock pot or not
steps:
1. Place brisket in a roasting pan
2. Combine all other ingredients in a bowl and pour over the meat in the pan
3. Bake , covered , at 350 degrees f
4. For 3 hours
5. Carve the meat against the grain and put meat back into the sauce and heat another 30 minutes and serve
6. For the crock pot:
7. I put fresh baby carrots in the bottom of a crock pot
8. Next mix all ingredients except for the meat in a bowl
9. Put the meat , fat side up , on top of the carrots and pour the sauce over it
10. Cook on low for 8 hours or until the meat is fork tender
11. Remove the meat to a cutting board and let it cool there a bit
12. Trim the fat off the meat
13. Slice the meat against the grain and serve with the carrots and gravy
14. I skim the gravy in one of those gravy skimmers

title: lemon lavender layer cake
steps:
1. For the cake: preheat oven to 350 degrees and grease 2 round baking pans
2. In a medium mixing bowl stir together flour , baking soda , and salt
3. Set aside
4. In medium saucepan heat butter , milk , and lavender over low heat just until mixture is hot and butter is melted
5. Remove from heat
6. Meanwhile , in a large mixing bowl with an electric mixer on medium speed beat eggs and sugar until thickened and lightened to a cream color
7. Beat in vanilla and lemon zest
8. On low speed gradually add flour mixture and mix until blended
9. Slowly add hot milk mixture and beat until combined
10. Divide batter evenly between prepared pans
11. Bake until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean , about 30 minutes
12. Cool cakes in pans for 10 minutes then carefully invert cakes onto cooling racks to cool completely
13. For the frosting: in a medium mixing bowl with an electric mixer on medium speed cream butter and cream cheese until smooth
14. On low speed gradually add powdered sugar and beat until smooth
15. Beat in honey and lemon zest just until blended
16. To assemble: place one of the cooled cake layers top side down on a serving plate and spread about a cup of frosting over it
17. Top with remaining cake layer top side up and frost the top and sides of the cake with the rest of the frosting
18. Garnish cake with long strips of lemon zest and some crumbled lavender flowers
19. Keep cake in the refrigerator and bring out to room temperature when ready to serve

title: ww 2 points   cream cheese swirl brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f
2. Coat an 8-inch square pan with cooking spray
3. Combine flour , 3 / 4 cup of sugar , cocoa and baking powder in a medium-size bowl
4. Mix well
5. Add canola oil , water and egg whites
6. Mix just until dry ingredients are moistened
7. Spoon and spread batter evenly into prepared pan
8. Combine cream cheese , remaining sugar and vanilla in a small bowl
9. Blend well
10. Drop small spoonfuls of cream cheese mixture over brownie batter
11. Swirl gently with a knife to create a decorative pattern
12. Bake until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean , about 20 minutes
13. Allow to cool for 20 minutes before cutting into 16 bars
14. 2 points per brownie

title: cooked broccoli salad  healthier alternative to potato salad
steps: 1. In a large bowl mix the salt , pepper , garlic , sour cream and mayonnaise then add the remaining ingredients , stir well and refrigerate for at least 1h before serving

title: moroccan eggplant  aubergine  salad i
steps:
1. Peel the eggplants and cut into 1 inch slices
2. In a 10-inch skillet fry the eggplant slices in olive oil until soft
3. Remove eggplant from skillet and transfer to a separate bowl
4. Rustically mash the eggplant
5. Add onions , garlic , lemon juice , salt , freshly ground black pepper and sugar
6. Blend thoroughly
7. Chill eggplant mixture in refrigerator 1 to 2 hours
8. Place a 1 / 2 cup serving of the eggplant mixture on to a salad plate and pat it down to form a circle within 1 inch of the salad plate edge
9. Place tomato slices ornately over the eggplant mixture and top with sliced black olives
10. Drizzle with a bit of olive oil and garnish with sprigs of fresh parsley

title: peachy muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Spray 12 muffin cups with cooking spray
3. Make the topping , blending all ingredients with pastry blender or fork , for a course consistency
4. Set aside
5. In a large bowl , combine all dry ingredients
6. In a smaller bowl , combine egg , sour cream , milk , vanilla and oil
7. Gently stir in the peaches
8. Add the peach mixture to the dry ingredient mixture , stirring just until moistened
9. Do not overmix or you will have tough muffins
10. Fill the muffin cups with batter , and sprinkle each muffin generously with topping
11. Bake 20-25 minutes

title: zucchini pizza crust
steps:
1. For the zucchini crust: shred two medium zucchini
2. Salt and drain at least 15 minutes
3. Rinse and pat dry
4. Mix with two eggs , 1 cup shredded reduced fat mozzarella , 2 cloves minced garlic , and fresh ground black pepper
5. Spread on a greased baking sheet and bake at 375f for 12 to 15 minutes , until light brown
6. I topped with sliced tomatoes , green onions , and crumbled herbed goat cheese before broiling for a few minutes
7. Then i added a few fresh basil leaves

title: meat filled dumplings  pelmeni
steps:
1. Using a food processor , blend the flour with the salt
2. With the motor still running , add the egg through the feed tube , then pour in the water in a slow , steady stream , until the dough forms a ball around the blade
3. Transfer the dough to a floured surface and knead until smooth , about 2 minutes
4. Cover with a cotton cloth and let stand for 30 minutes
5. Combine all the filling ingredients in a large bowl , stirring until they are thoroughly mixed
6. Divide the dough in half and shape into two balls
7. Keep one covered with the cloth while working with the other
8. On the floured surface with a floured rolling pin , roll out the dough to a very thin sheet , about 1 / 16th inch thick , making sure it doesnt tear
9. With a round cookie cutter , cut out circles about 2 inches in diameter
10. Gather the scraps together into a ball and set aside , covered
11. In a small saucepan , bring 2 cups of salted water to a boil over high heat
12. Set a bowl of the beaten egg white near you
13. Place a scant teaspoon of the filling toward the bottom of one circle
14. Fold the empty half of the dough over the filling to form a semi-circle
15. Brush the edges with the egg white and press the edges firmly together with the tines of a fork to seal
16. Boil the one dumpling for 10 minutes to taste the filling for seasoning
17. Fill and shape the remaining rounds , arranging the dumplings as they are made on a lightly floured baking sheet , about 1 inch apart
18. The pelmeni are usually frozen at this point
19. Cover the baking sheet with aluminum foil or plastic wrap and place in the freezer until they are completely frozen
20. When frozen , transfer the pelmeni to a plastic bag
21. To cook the pelmeni , bring 6 quarts of salted water to a boil in a large pot
22. Drop in half the pelmeni and cook , stirring occasionally with a wooden spoon to prevent sticking , until they rise to the surface and are cooked through , about 8 minutes
23. With a slotted spoon , carefully remove the pelmeni to a colander and drain well
24. Transfer to a deep serving bowl and toss with the butter
25. Cook the remaining pelmeni the same way

title: fried eggs with kansas city style barbecue sauce for 1
steps:
1. Heat up a skillet on medium heat then add the olive oil
2. Arrange the arugula leaves on a plate
3. Gently crack the egg and lightly fry for 3 minutes , or to your preference
4. Carefully arrange the fried egg on the arugula leaves
5. Spoon barbecue sauce on and around the egg and greens
6. Grate cheese on top followed by a garnish of fresh cilantro
7. Season with cracked black pepper

title: saint barbara cookies  lebanese
steps:
1. In mixer bowl , beat cooking oil into butter until blended , beat in sugar
2. Add orange juice , baking powder and baking soda , mix well
3. Add flour , a little at a time , to make a soft dough
4. Shape dough into 2-inch ovals and place on an ungreased baking sheet
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden
6. Cool pastries on rack
7. Meanwhile prepare natif topping: in a saucepan , combine the 3 / 4 cup sugar , honey and 1 / 2 cup water , bring to a boil
8. Boil gently , uncovered for 5 minutes
9. Dip cooled pastries into the warm syrup
10. Sprinkle immediately with nuts
11. Dry on wire rack

title: oriental stir fry sauce
steps:
1. Combine the first 6 ingredients
2. Place the cornstarch into a bowl
3. Whisk the liquid mixture into it
4. Set aside , but keep the whisk handy , as you will need to whisk the sauce again just before you use it
5. Add this sauce to a wok , full of vegetables , meat , or seafood about 2 / 3 of the way through cooking
6. Stir well to ensure a thorough coating

title: quick and easy chicken quesadillas
steps:
1. In a small bowl , mix chicken , cheese and cream cheese
2. Evenly divide chicken mixture over each of 4 tortillas
3. Top with remaining 4 tortillas
4. Lightly spray each side of quesadilla with nonstick cooking spray
5. Place quesdillas on baking sheets
6. Bake at 400 degrees f for 12 minutes or until golden brown , turning once halfway through heating
7. Cut into wedges

title: roasted potatoes with rosemary and sea salt
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Toss potatoes with oil , salt and pepper in medium bowl to coat
3. Transfer potatoes to small baking sheet
4. Roast 20 minutes , stirring once
5. Add garlic and rosemary to potatoes
6. Toss
7. Roast until potatoes are just tender , about 10 minutes
8. Transfer to plate
9. Serve
10. Makes 2 servings

title: cranberry caramel bars
steps:
1. Combine 2 cups flour and the next 4 ingredients
2. Stir in butter until crumbly
3. Reserve a cup of this mixture
4. Press remaining mixture into lightly greased 13x9" pan
5. Bake 350f for 15 minutes
6. Sprinkle with cranberries and pecans
7. Stir together caramel and 1 / 3 cup flour
8. Spoon over cranberries
9. Sprinkle with reserve 1 cup mixture
10. Bake 25 more minutes

title: parve whipping cream   not my healthiest version
steps:
1. Pour soy milk and 1 / 4 c canola oil into a mixing bowl
2. Mix with an immersion blender
3. Slowly add the rest of the oil as you continue to blend
4. You can drizzle in some more oil if you need to thicken it up
5. Blend in the maple syrup and vanilla extract

title: spinach  onion tofu stir fry
steps:
1. Place the oil and tofu in a large frying pan and cook about 5 minutes on medium heat
2. Add peanuts and onion and cook until onions are translucent
3. Add garlic , basil , black pepper and red pepper and cook about 2 minutes
4. Add the soy sauce and spinach and cook just until spinach is wilted
5. Serve over rice

title: winooski river summer vegetable melange
steps:
1. Mix herbs together
2. Coat the bottom and sides of a large dutch oven or casserole with 1 tablespoons olive oil
3. Layer each zucchini , summer squash , tomato and onion in that order
4. Top with 1 tablespoon herbs , salt and pepper and tablespoon olive oil
5. Then add 1 / 3 of the grated cheddar
6. Repeat with a second and third layer
7. Put cover on casserole and bake at 350f for 1 hour and 15 minutes
8. Check onions and squash for doneness
9. Serve immediately !

title: grace s almond chicken stir fry
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in wok
2. Fry onions till slightly browned
3. Stir fry garlic and ginger until a strong aroma emits
4. Add chicken , stir fry till cooked
5. Add celery , bell pepper , and water chestnuts , one by one
6. Stir fry for 30 seconds before adding next vegetable
7. Add sauces , stir fry to mix well , then serve immediately with rice

title: guinness cheddar fondue  crock pot
steps:
1. In a 4 quart crock pot , combine all ingredients and mix thoroughly
2. Cover and cook on low setting for 3-4 hours , stirring occasionally
3. Serve hot with cubed whole grain bread or other crudites

title: onion toasties
steps:
1. Stir together mayonnaise , onion , and cheese
2. Spread 1 teaspoon of mixture on each bread slice
3. Bake on a baking sheet at 450 degrees for 4 to 5 minutes until browned
4. Serve immediately

title: monterey jack casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In skillet , brown ground beef
3. Add onion
4. Reduce heat and saute 5 minutes
5. Drain excess fat
6. Place 2 cups of crushed corn chips in bottom of greased 1 1 / 2 quart dish
7. Layer ground beef over chips
8. Pour enchilada sauce over beef
9. Top with cheese
10. Bake 20-30 minutes or until bubbly and heated through
11. Sprinkle remaining corn chips over top of casserole
12. Bake additional 5 minutes
13. Top individual servings with sour cream , if desired

title: pork chops with onion and mushroom gravy
steps:
1. Heat oil in heavy pan over medium heat
2. Add pork chops and brown on both sides
3. Remove pork chops and set aside
4. Add onions to pan and cook until limp
5. Sprinkle 1 tbsp flour over onions and stir until flour starts to brown
6. Stir in 2 cups water and the mushrooms with their liquid
7. Heat to boiling and then reduce to simmering
8. Add 1 / 2 cup water to 1 / 4 cup brown gravy mix , mix well and add to water in pan , stirring well
9. Add pork chops to pan , cover and simmer 45 minutes
10. Use the additional water to thin the gravy , if needed
11. Serve over mashed potatoes or rice

title: brazilian iced chocolate
steps:
1. Melt chocolate in top of double boiler over hot water
2. Stir in sugar
3. Gradually stir in hot coffee , mixing thoroughly
4. Slowly add milk and continue cooking until all particles of chocolate are dissolved
5. And mixture is smooth , about 10 minutes
6. Pour into jar , cover and chill
7. When ready to serve , stir in chilled coca-cola
8. Serve over crushed ice in tall glasses
9. For a beverage , top with whipped cream
10. For a dessert , add a scoop of ice cream

title: grilled salmon with corn  tomato  and avocado relish
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , add corn , tomatoes , avocados , onions , parsley , olive oil , lemon juice , 1 tsp salt , and 1 / 4 tsp pepper
2. Toss to combine and set aside
3. Preheat grill to medium high
4. Lightly brush the fillets with olive oil and season flesh side with 1 / 8 tsp of the essence , 1 / 4 tsp salt and a pinch of the remaining pepper
5. Add to grill , skin side down , and cook until skin is crisp about 4-5 minutes
6. Turn and cook until the salmon is opaque and medium rare about 4 minutes , or how ever you like your fish cooked
7. Serve with relish on top with the grilled asparagus

title: maria s greek chicken salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine chicken , cucumber , cheese , and olives
2. In a smaller bowl , stir together parsley , miracle whip , yogurt , oregano , and garlic
3. Add to chicken mixture
4. Toss to coat
5. Cover and chill
6. Serve on lettuce leaves

title: healthy whole wheat bread
steps:
1. Add ingredients in order they are listed into your bread machine and use dough setting
2. Remove dough from machine once cycle is done form into a loaf
3. Place in greased loaf pan and cover
4. Let rise in a warm place until almost doubled in size , about 30 minutes
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 30-35 minutes
6. If loaf starts browning too soon , lightly lay a piece of foil on top of the loaf to prevent too much darkening
7. Remove bread from oven and allow to rest in pan for a few minutes
8. Remove to a wire rack and cover with a cloth
9. Slice and enjoy while still warm !
10. If you do not have agave nectar or applesauce , you can use the same amounts of honey and oil , respectively
11. The above is a healthier alternative

title: homemade self raising flour   baking powder   substitute
steps:
1. To make your own baking powder , add the ingredients to a jam jar or similar and shake well to mix
2. To make the self raising flour , add 1 tsp of the baking powder to 200g or 8 oz of plain flour and mix
3. That's it !

title: honey dijon mustard curry chicken nibbles
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 190c degrees
2. Arrange chicken nibbles on a lighlty greased baking sheet in a single layer
3. Bake uncovered in oven for approx 30 minutes
4. Drain off any juices and turn them over
5. Mix honey , mustards and curry powder in a small bowl
6. Pour over chicken
7. Bake a further 20-30 minutes or until they are tender , basting once
8. Transfer to a platter and serve with sauce spooned over

title: licorice ice cream
steps:
1. Beat eggs and add sugar 1 / 2 cup at a time , beating after each addition
2. Add whipping cream , anise flavoring , lemon flavoring , salt and food coloring if desired
3. Pour into canister and fill to full line with milk
4. Freeze in 1 gallon ice cream freezer according to manufacturer's directions

title: portabella mushroom and dried tomato bruschetta
steps:
1. In a small saucepan simmer tomatoes in water , uncovered , until tender , about 10 minutes
2. In a blender puree tomatoes , cooking liquid and vinegar until smooth and season with salt and pepper
3. Cut mushrooms into 1 / 4" thick slices and mince garlic
4. In a large skillet heat 2 tbs
5. Oil over moderate heat until hot but no smoking and cook mushrooms and garlic with salt and pepper , to taste , stirring , until liquid mushrooms give off is evaporated , about 5 minutes
6. Remove skillet from heat and toss mushrooms with remaining tbs
7. Oil
8. Keep mushrooms warm , covered
9. Toast bread and spread with tomato puree
10. Top with mushrooms

title: just for jane layered monterey pumpkin dip
steps:
1. Combine pumpkin , cream cheese and jalapeo juice in medium bowl
2. Spread into 8-inch square baking dish
3. Combine sour cream , chiles , jalapeos and garlic salt in small bowl
4. Spread over pumpkin mixture
5. Top with tomato , olives , green onions and red onion
6. Cover
7. Refrigerate for 2 hours
8. Serve with tortilla chips

title: spicy raisin quick bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Lightly grease an 8 x 4 inch loaf pan
3. In a large mixing bowl , whisk together whole wheat pastry flour , oat flour , baking powder , ground allspice , ground cinnamon , and salt
4. In a medium mixing bowl , whisk together egg , nonfat milk , light brown sugar , melted butter , and vanilla extract
5. Add wet ingredients to dry , and mix until just combined
6. Then gently stir in dark seedless raisins
7. Spoon batter into prepared loaf pan , and level the top
8. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes , or until a wooden toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean
9. Let bread cool in pan for 10 minutes
10. Then remove from pan and transfer to a wire rack to cool completely before serving

title: the ultimate chocolate mousse cake
steps:
1. For the cake:
2. Preheat oven to 425f
3. Wrap the outside of an 8-inch spring form pan with a double layer of tin foil to prevent seepage
4. Butter the inside of the pan and cut a circle out of parchment paper the size of the bottom of the pan
5. Place it in and butter it too
6. Combine the chocolate and butter in a double boiler over simmering water
7. Stir until the chocolate and butter are smooth and lump free
8. You can also microwave the mixture on 100% or high
9. Make sure you stop and stir the mixture every 15 seconds
10. Remove the chocolate when all the lumps are gone
11. Put the eggs in a large mixer bowl over simmering water and stir constantly until warm to the touch , about 3 minutes
12. Remove from the heat
13. If using an electric mixer , beat the eggs until triple in volume and form soft peaks when the beater is lifted , 5-8 minutes
14. To ensure maximum volume when using a hand mixer continue to beat the eggs over simmering water until hot to the touch , about 5 minutes , then removed from heat until cool
15. Fold half the eggs into the melted chocolate until partially incorporated
16. Add the remaining eggs and fold until just blended but no streaks remain
17. Pour at once into your prepared spring form pan and smooth the surface with an off-set spatula
18. Place the spring form pan into a larger pan and carefully pour boiling water into the larger pan until the water is about 2 / 3 of the way up the side of the spring form pan
19. Don't get any water on the chocolate ! this method of a water bath is often referred to as a "bain marie"
20. Bake the cake for 5 minutes
21. Then cover the spring form pan loosely with lightly buttered tin foil and bake for 10 more minutes
22. Remove the cake from the oven and let cool on a wire rack for 45 minutes
23. Then cover it again and refrigerate it for at least 3 hours
24. To remove the cake from the spring form pan: run a small spatula around the edge of the spring form until the sides of the cake come loose
25. Place the cake on a round plate that the cake fits nicely on and invert the plate and open the spring form pan up and remove from the cake
26. Remove the bottom metal part of the spring form pan and the parchment
27. Cover it again with tin foil and leave for another 6 hours or over night
28. It needs to be really chilled to set
29. If you are making the ganache , set the cake on a metal rack and put wax paper under the cake
30. Pour the tepid glaze over the center of the cake and allow the ganache to dribble down the sides of the cake
31. Using a metal off set spatula run it around the top of the cake to ensure that the g
32. Ganache won't be too thick on the top
33. Patch any bare spots at this point
34. If any air holes occur , use a pin to break them
35. Remove the strips of wax paper from under the cake and let this stand undisturbed for 2-3 hours at room temperature , or 30 minutes in the fridge
36. Bon appetit !

title: apricot citrus scones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Butter a baking sheet
3. In large bowl , combine flour , sugar , baking powder , salt and baking soda
4. Using your finger
5. Add the orange zest , apricots and pecans and toss to combine
6. Stir in the buttermilk until the dough is rough and shaggy
7. Gather the dough together and place on a liberally floured work surface
8. Gently knead about 10 times
9. Divide the dough in half and pat each piece into a circle about 7 inches in diameter and 1 / 2 inch thick
10. Glaze each by brushing with cream and sprinkling on sugar
11. Cut each round into eight pie-shaped wedges
12. Place the scones , barely touching , on the prepared baking sheet
13. Bake 15-18 minutes , until puffy and golden

title: pink   orange sunrise smoothie
steps: 1. Blend all ingredients until smooth

title: a taste of africa   kenyan chicken curry
steps:
1. Combine half the ginger , half the garlic , half the turmeric , half the lemon juice and half the oil in a large bowl with all the cumin , garam masala , ground coriander , paprika , chilli flakes and yoghurt
2. Add the chicken , turn to coat in marinade
3. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes
4. Preheat oven to very hot
5. Cook chicken in lightly oiled shallow flameproof baking dish , uncovered , 10 minutes
6. Heat remaining oil in large saucepan , cook onion , chilli powder , fenugreek , remaining ginger , garlic and turmeric , stirring , until onion softens
7. Add tomatoes , cinnamon , green chillies and remaining lemon juice
8. Simmer , covered , for 10 minutes
9. Stir in cream and honey , simmer , uncovered , for one minute
10. Add chicken to curry , simmer about 5 minutes or until chicken is cooked through
11. Remove from heat , stir in fresh coriander , serve over basmati rice , garnish with fresh coriander

title: whipped cappuccino
steps:
1. Dissolve espresso powder in hot water
2. Allow to cool to room temperature
3. Combine cooled espresso mixture , sweetened condensed milk and ice in a blender
4. Blend on high for one minute until no visible chunks of ice are left
5. Serve with a spoon and a straw
6. Makes 2 tall or 4 short drinks

title: carrot pineapple cake with cream cheese frosting
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Butter 2 round cake pans
3. Line with parchment paper , then butter and flour the pans
4. Whisk the sugar , oil , and eggs together until the color changes to light yellow
5. Add the vanilla
6. In another bowl , sift together 2 1 / 2 cups flour , cinnamon , baking soda , and salt
7. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients
8. Toss the raisins and walnuts with 1 tablespoon flour to keep them from sinking to the bottom of the pan during baking
9. Add to the batter and mix well
10. Fold in the carrots and pineapple
11. Pour the batter equally into the 2 pans
12. Bake for 55 to 60 minutes , or until a toothpick comes out clean
13. Allow the cakes to cool in the pans on a wire rack
14. Whisk the cream cheese , butter and vanilla until combined
15. Add the sugar and mix until smooth
16. Once cooled , remove the cakes from the pans and peel the parchment paper off of them
17. Place the first cake layer on a cake pedestal
18. With a spatula , spread the top with frosting
19. Place the second layer on top and spread the frosting evenly on the top and sides of the cake

title: crock pot chicken and sausage cassoulet
steps:
1. Combine the beans , tomato juice , carrots , celery , garlic , bay leaves , and spices
2. Cut the sausages in half lengthwise and slice , stir into beans
3. Place the frozen chicken thighs on top of the bean mixture
4. Cover
5. Cook on low-heat for 8 to 10 hours
6. Remove bay leaves , stir , adjust seasonings as desired and serve

title: thai chicken saute
steps:
1. Cook rice according to package directions and keep warm
2. Toss chicken with cornstarch and fish sauce
3. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
4. Add chicken to pan
5. Saut 5 minutes
6. Remove chicken from pan
7. Heat remaining 1 teaspoon oil in pan
8. Add onion , garlic , and ginger to pan
9. Saut 1 minute
10. Return chicken to pan
11. Cook 1 minute or until done
12. Stir in coconut milk , sriracha , sugar , and juice
13. Cook 45 seconds or until thoroughly heated
14. Sprinkle each serving with 1 1 / 2 teaspoons cilantro
15. Serve chicken mixture over rice with lime wedges

title: three seed bread
steps: 1. Place all ingredients in bread machine and set on whole wheat cycle

title: ww 1 pt  chocolate brownie cups
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Thoroughly mist two 12 cup nonstick mini-muffin tins with cooking spray or use paper liners
3. Mix the applesauce , vanilla , eggwhites , and sugar until well combined in a large mixing bowl
4. Add the flour , baking powder , cocoa , espresso powder and salt
5. Stir until just combined and smooth
6. Using half the batter , fill each m uffin cup until just barely full
7. Sprinkle half of the chips evenly over the top
8. Bake 10-12 minutes
9. Transfer the pans to a rack to cool for 5 minutes
10. Using a knife , gently remove the bronwies from the muffin tins
11. Let cool another 10 minutes
12. Repeat with the 2nd half of the batter and remaining chips

title: cheddar chicken casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Pour cream of chicken and cream of mushroom soup into a 3-quart casserole dish
3. Stir in the chicken broth a little bit at a time until completely blended
4. Add rice , onion powder and chicken
5. Stir well
6. Cover and cook for 45 minutes
7. Sprinkle with cheese and cook 5 minutes more

title: koushari
steps:
1. Fry onions in olive oil till golden brown
2. Add garlic , just to toast
3. Add tomato puree
4. Mix well
5. Keep aside
6. Cook lentils in 2 cups water for about 30 minutes
7. Cook rice in 2 cups water for 15 minutes
8. Cook macaroni in plenty of boiling salted water for 6-7 minutes
9. Mix well
10. Add chickpeas and stir
11. Add tomato onion mixture and mix thoroughly
12. Season with salt and pepper and serve

title: easy lettuce wraps with dipping sauce
steps:
1. Add vegetables to food processor until roughly diced
2. Add to skillet with sesame oil and saute until tender
3. Add pork and cook through , adding soy sauce as it cooks
4. Serve with lettuce , rice and dipping sauce
5. If you have extra meat filling leftover , it freezes very well

title: globally inspired  fully loaded rolled mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Preparation:
2. Cook the bacon ahead of time
3. Fry until crispy , and create little bacon bits to suit your preferred size and texture for the topping
4. Filling:
5. Cook the simply potatoes traditional mashed potatoes according to the directions on the package
6. Once heated and ready to eat , you must add the other filling ingredients to the mashed potatoes
7. The cream and butter add just that extra traditional flavor and keep the potatoes very moist
8. Mix all the filling ingredients together
9. Spring rolls:
10. I like use fresh spring roll wrappers about 4 inches wide x 6 inches long , however it is up to you how big or small you want your rolls to be
11. Add about 1 1 / 2 tablespoons of the mashed potato mix to each spring roll
12. Roll the spring roll
13. Secure the ends by adding a bit of water to one end and firmly pressing down onto the other end
14. Repeat until you have either no more mashed potato mix , or no more spring roll wrappers
15. Cook:
16. I prefer to use a deep pan
17. Add enough olive oil to fill 4 inches of the bottom of the pan
18. Heat olive oil until it starts to bubble
19. Add a few spring rolls at a time to the oil , cook for about 1 minute on each side
20. The trick is , you want the wrapper to stay somewhat soft and easy to bite into
21. Frying for more than a minute or two will make the wraps too crunchy
22. Drain the rolls by placing them onto paper towels
23. Assemble fully loaded rolled mashed potatoes:
24. Place the potato rolls on a serving plate
25. Here is where you can get fancy
26. Garnish with sour cream , green onion , cooked bacon , sundried tomatoes , and shredded goat cheese
27. I promise , you will love it ! enjoy !

title: grilled eggs with vietnamese seasonings
steps:
1. Preheat grill to medium
2. Pierce a tiny hole in the end of each egg
3. Place eggs on grill and cook until shell is browned and eggs are cooked through , 10-12 minutes , turning frequently with tongs
4. Combine fish sauce , lime juice , sugar , garlic and chile in a small bowl and stir until sugar is dissolved
5. Shell eggs and cut into quarters
6. To eat , place one egg quarter on a lettuce leaf with a sprig of mint and roll up
7. Dip in sauce

title: beer cheese spread
steps:
1. Mix first five ingredients together
2. Slowly add beer
3. Check salt level
4. Put in tightly sealed container or crock and refrigerate for 24 hours

title: montreal salsa chicken
steps:
1. Directions:
2. Salt and pepper chicken breasts to taste in a 9x13 dish
3. Sprinkle chicken with grill mates montreal chicken seasoning and allow to set for 30 minutes
4. In a small bowl , stir together remaining salsa , preserves , lemon juice , and chili powder
5. Grill chicken over medium coals 6-7 minutes per side or until done
6. Brush with salsa mixture during the last 3 minutes of grilling

title: mint chocolate chip muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Grease 12 large muffin cups
3. Set aside
4. Combine flour , sugar , cocoa , baking powder , baking soda and salt in large bowl
5. Combine sour cream , butter , milk and eggs in small bowl until blended
6. Stir into flour mixture just until moistened
7. Fold in mint chips
8. Spoons into prepared muffin cups , filling half full
9. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
10. Cool in pan 5 minutes
11. Remove from pan
12. Cool on wire rack 10 minutes
13. Serve warm or cool completely

title: pork chops and cheesy potatoes
steps:
1. In a 1 1 / 2 quart buttered dish , place alternate layers of potatoes , onions ,
2. And cheese
3. Combine soup , milk and seasonings , pour over all
4. Top with browned pork chops , cover and bake at 350 for 1 1 / 2 hours

title: eggnog muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Makes 12 muffins combine flour , sugar , baking powder , salt and nutmeg in a large bowl
3. In a smaller bowl , combine remaining ingredients
4. Add liquid to dry ingredients and mix until just moistened
5. Pour batter in lined or greased muffin cups and bake about 15 minutes until toothpick inserted comes out clean

title: low fat ranch dressing
steps:
1. Using a food processor or blender , puree all ingredients together until smooth
2. Chill before serving
3. The serving size is approximately 2 tablespoons and the recipe yields about 1 cup

title: crispy beef tostadas
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine flour and baking powder
2. Add milk and form a soft dough
3. Knead until mixed thoroughly
4. Cover and let rest 30 minutes
5. Meanwhile , brown beef and garlic in large skillet until meat is no longer pink
6. Drain well
7. Add chilies , taco seasoning , salt and pepper if desired , and water
8. Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes
9. Stir in beans and heat through
10. Keep warm
11. In a deep fat fryer or skillet , preheat oil to 375
12. Separate dough into 6 equal portions
13. Roll over lightly floured surface into a 7 inch circle
14. Fry tostadas in hot oil until golden , turning once
15. Drain on paper towels
16. Immediately top each tostada with meat mixture and desired toppings

title: brownie in a mug
steps:
1. Whist together dry ingredients in a coffee mug
2. Add oil , water , & vanilla and mix thoroughly , making certain to scrape bottom and sides so that all is incorporated
3. If desired mix in the chocolate chips
4. Microwave on high 1 - 1 1 / 2 minutes
5. The finished product will be softish and chewy
6. Cool for 1 minute eat right out of the mug

title: red bell pepper and sweet potato soup
steps:
1. Heat the oil
2. Saute the onions and garlic for about 10-15 minutes on medium heat , or until the onions are soft and very lightly browned
3. Add the bell peppers and saute for another 10-15 minutes , until the bell peppers are soft and everything is lightly browned
4. Add the sweet potato , vegetable broth , bay leaves , salt , and butter and simmer for 10-15 minutes , until the sweet potato is soft
5. Remove the bay leaves and blend the soup until mostly smooth
6. Enjoy !

title: baked garlic tomatoes
steps:
1. Core tomatoes and slice in half crosswise
2. Place in baking dish , cut side up
3. Mix olive oil , garlic , basil or rosemary , salt and pepper
4. Pour over tomatoes , and bake at 325 degrees for 2 hours

title: purple gecko
steps:
1. Shake with ice and pour into a salt-rimmed cocktail or margarita glass
2. Garnish with a lime wedge
3. Serve in:
4. Margarita glass

title: margie s chicken and sausage
steps:
1. Brown sausage in frying pan
2. Drain grease , set sausage on plate , and wipe pan with paper towel
3. Cook chicken 4-6 minutes each side in frying pan
4. Set chicken in oven proof casserole dish
5. Put sausage back in pan
6. Add soup , milk , and nutmeg
7. Warm and stir
8. Pour sausage mixture over chicken
9. Bake in 350f oven for 30-40 minutes
10. Serve over rice or egg noodles

title: mock sliders  white castles
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine ground beef , bread crumbs , water , pepper , egg and onion soup mix
2. Mix thoroughly
3. Roll mixture out 1 / 2-inch thick , to a 10-by-6-inch rectangle between 2 sheets of waxed paper
4. Turn out onto cookie sheet , removing paper from both sides
5. Using finger or spoon handle , poke holes in meat
6. Bake in preheated 400-degree oven 10 minutes
7. Remove
8. Pour off any fat
9. Cut meat into 20 squares to fit rolls
10. Place one piece of meat into a roll and top with hamburger dills if desired
11. Serve hot
12. Makes 5 hearty servings

title: easy horseradish sauce with mixed vegetables
steps:
1. Cook mixed vegetables according to package directions
2. Drain and chill
3. Meanwhile , combine mayonnaise or salad dressing , milk , horseradish , dry mustard , and pepper
4. Stir until smooth
5. Cover and chill
6. Just before serving , combine mixed vegetables and mayonnaise mixture

title: greatest grilled salmon recipe ever
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine peanut oil , balsamic vinegar , lemon juice , green onions , soy sauce , brown sugar , ginger , paprika , pepper , pepper flakes , salt , sesame oil , and garlic cloves
2. Once properly mixed , combine salmon fillets with marinade
3. Cover and place into refrigerator for 2-24 hours
4. The longer the better
5. Place fillets on outdoor grill
6. Cook fillets 4 minutes on each side
7. Enjoy

title: peanut butter onigiri rice ball
steps:
1. Place the rice in a thick patty shape on a sheet of cling film
2. Put the peanut butter in the middle , put a little around the edges too so it spreads well inside when shaped
3. Pick up the cling film and shape the rice into a triangle , keeping the peanut butter inside
4. Peel off the cling film , enjoy !

title: miller s taco seasoning mix
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and mix thoroughly
2. Place 7 teaspoons of the mixture in a small plastic food storage bag , eliminate as much air from the bag as possible , and seal
3. Repeat to make as many packages as desired
4. Label each package as follows: cook 1 lb
5. Ground beef in skillet , and drain off fat
6. Add 1 package of miller's taco seasoning mix and to cup water , and bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat and cook uncovered about 10 minutes , stirring once or twice

title: wheat free  milk free  egg free  tasty chicken nuggets
steps:
1. Crush garlic cloves and stir into 1 / 4 cup of oil - set aside
2. Cut up chicken into nugget size pieces
3. In a bowl , mix the no-egg and water to make a paste - add more water if the paste is too thick to coat the chicken , more no-egg if its too watery
4. Fill a second bowl with the polenta
5. Dunk the chicken into the no-egg paste , then into the polenta bowl , ensuring the chicken is fully covered
6. When all chicken is coated , heat the "garlic oil" in a pan , add the nuggets and cook until golden
7. Great on their own for nibbles or with a salad and veges for a meal

title: brussels sprouts hash with caramelized shallots
steps:
1. Melt 3 tablespoons butter in medium skillet over medium heat
2. Add shallots
3. Sprinkle with coarse kosher salt and pepper
4. Saut until soft and golden , about 10 minutes
5. Add vinegar and sugar
6. Stir until brown and glazed , about 3 minutes
7. Halve brussels sprouts lengthwise
8. Cut lengthwise into thin slices
9. Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat
10. Add sprouts
11. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
12. Saut until brown at edges , 6 minutes
13. Add 1 cup water and 2 tablespoons oil
14. Saut until most of water evaporates and sprouts are tender but still bright green , 3 minutes
15. Add shallots
16. Season with salt and pepper

title: maple nut goodie bars
steps:
1. Line 15x10x1-inch baking pan with foil
2. Butter or spray foil with nonstick cooking spray
3. In large saucepan , melt chocolate chops and 1 cup of the margarine over low heat , stirring frequently
4. Remove saucepan from heat
5. Add peanut butter
6. Mix well
7. Spread half of mixture in buttered foil-lined pan
8. Freeze 10 minutes or until set
9. Place pan in refrigerator
10. Meanwhile , stir peanuts into remaining chocolate mixture
11. Set aside
12. Melt remaining 1 cup margarine in large saucepan over low heat
13. Gradually stir in evaporated milk
14. Stir in pudding mix
15. Cook until mixture is slightly thickened , stirring constantly
16. Do not boil
17. Remove saucepan from heat
18. Add powdered sugar and maple flavor
19. Mix well
20. Cool about 10 minutes or until slightly cooled
21. Carefully spread pudding mixture over chilled chocolate layer
22. Refrigerate 30 minutes
23. Stir reserved chocolate-peanut mixture
24. Drop by spoonfuls onto chilled pudding layer
25. Spread to cover
26. Refrigerate at least 3 hours or until firm
27. Cut into bars
28. Store in refrigerator

title: zucchini  pineapple  ginger jam kicked up with habanero s
steps:
1. Place zucchini , pineapples , habanero`s and crystallized ginger in a food processor and puree
2. Add to a heavy bottom pot with sugar and boil for 20 minutes
3. That`s a rolling boil
4. Stirring all the while
5. Add certo and bring to a full rolling boil for 1 more minute add jello and stir to blend
6. Add some red food coloring and more yellow to produce a color to your liking
7. Ladle hot jam into hot jars leaving 1 / 4 inch head space
8. Wipe rim
9. Center lid on jar
10. Apply band until fit is finger
11. Process in a boiling water canner for 10 minutes , adjusting for altitude
12. Remove jars and cool
13. Check lids for seal after 24 hours
14. Lid should not flex up and down when center is pressed
15. Label , decorate , and gift !

title: tagarini
steps:
1. Cook noodles and drain
2. Place in large bowl
3. Brown and drain hamburger
4. Add to noodles in the bowl
5. Saute onion and green pepper in a small amount of oil
6. Add the peppers and onions to the bowl
7. Add all the rest of the ingredients to the bowl , except the cheese and bread crumbs
8. Mix well
9. Place in a large casserole dish and heat at 350 till bubbly
10. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and cheese , continue heating till cheese is melted
11. If you have any leftover to freeze , place in an disposable tin pan and put in a ziploc bag and freeze
12. Add the bread crumbs and cheese at the end of the cooking cycle

title: indian samosa casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Whisk together flours and salt in bowl
3. Stir in oil until clumps form
4. Add 6 to 10 tbs
5. Cold water , 1 tbs
6. At a time , until dough holds together
7. Shape into ball , cover with damp towel , and set aside
8. To make filling:
9. Stir together mustard seeds , curry , ginger , cumin , and red pepper flakes , if using , in bowl
10. Set aside
11. Cook potatoes in boiling salted water 15 minutes , or until tender
12. Drain , return to pot , and mash , leaving small chunks
13. Heat oil in skillet over medium heat
14. Add onion , carrot , and garlic , and saut 5 minutes , or until carrot is tender
15. Move onion mixture to side of pan , and add mustard seed mixture in center
16. Toast 30 seconds
17. Stir in peas and broth
18. Fold onion mixture into potato mixture
19. Stir in agave nectar
20. Season with salt and pepper , if desired
21. Spread filling in 9-inch pie pan
22. Set aside
23. Roll out crust dough to 11-inch circle on floured work surface
24. Cover filling with dough , pressing down to make sure no air pockets remain
25. Trim away excess dough , and crimp edges with fingers
26. Cut x in center to vent steam
27. Brush with soymilk just before baking
28. Place pie on baking sheet , and bake 40 to 50 minutes , or until crust is golden
29. Let stand 5 minutes before serving
30. Frozen cooking instructions: preheat oven to 375f place casserole on baking sheet , and bake 75 to 90 minutes , or until filling bubbles and crust is golden
31. Let stand 5 minutes before serving

title: roasted vegetables with chicken sausage
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Cut vegetables and place in a 13 x 9 inch baking dish that has been sprayed with non-stick cooking spray
3. Toss in the garlic and sausages
4. In a small dish combine the oil , mustard and honey
5. Pour over vegetables and toss to thoroughly coat
6. Sprinkle with salt and fresh ground pepper
7. Place in the preheated oven and cook for 30 to 40 minutes or until vegetables stick fork tender
8. Stir at 15 minutes and then again at 30
9. Serve with corn muffins or cornbread for a delicious meal

title: watermelon and rose water granita dessert
steps:
1. Combine the sugar with the water in a small pan and bring to the boil , stirring until the sugar has dissolved
2. Remove from the heat and leave to cool
3. Puree the watermelon flesh in a blender
4. Combine the watermelon puree , rosewater and cooled sugar syrup and pour the mixtures into a plastic container and place in the freezer
5. Leave for 30 - 60 minutes - depending on the strength of your freezer - until it starts to freeze around the edges
6. Remove and stir well , breaking up the ice crystals , scraping the hard bits from the side
7. Return to the freezer and repeat the process every 30 minutes , for three or four times
8. The mixture will become increasingly thick and almost gluey with very fine crystals
9. Rinse the rose petals to remove any trace of chemicals and gentrly pat dry
10. Divide the granita between four small glasses or glass dishes , scatter with rose petals and a few reserved waterelon seeds and serve

title: rotel rice
steps:
1. Drain rotel , reserving liquid
2. Add vegetable broth or water to rotel juice to make 3 cups of liquid
3. Combine rice , rotel and liquid in large saucepan
4. Cover and bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat to the lowest setting and simmer 20 minutes
6. Fluff rice with fork before serving

title: potato pagachi
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Cool mashed potatoes to room temperature
3. On floured work surface , roll a biscuit out to a 6 inch circle
4. Place 2 heaping tablespoons of potatoes in center of bicuit
5. Draw up dough and pinch edges together using a fork , to cover filling
6. Repeat to form 8 pagachi
7. Place pagachi on lightly greased baking sheet
8. Prick each with a fork a few times and brush lightly with egg whites
9. Bake for 20 minutes
10. Meanwhile , place butter in a small skillet over medium heat and lightly brown
11. Remove pagachi from oven and brush with the browned butter
12. Serve warm

title: simple thai chicken spinach salad
steps:
1. In a large skillet or wok , stir fry the chicken pieces in oil until juices run clear
2. Remove and keep warm
3. In the same pan , stir fry the carrots and bell pepper until crisp-tender
4. In a large serving bowl , toss the spinach , green onions , and cilantro
5. Set aside
6. In a blender , combine the dressing ingredients and process until well blended
7. Add chicken , carrots , bell pepper , and dressing to the spinach bowl and toss to coat evenly
8. Serve immediately

title: tex mex chicken pot pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Mix all ingredients together except pie crusts
3. Line pie plate with first crust , deep dish is best
4. Add chicken mixture
5. Top with second pie crust
6. Cut slits into top crust
7. Bake for 45-50 minutes , until golden
8. Serve with sour cream and guacamole

title: fast  yummy and low fat  double strawberry sauce
steps:
1. Mix together sugar , 1 / 4 cup water and jelly in a saucepan
2. Stir over medium heat
3. Do so until the sugar dissolves and the mixture begins to boil
4. Mix lemon juice with cornflour
5. Stir into the sugar mixture
6. Cook on medium flame until slightly thickened
7. Mix in strawberries until just heated
8. Serve over slices of poundcake , if you like to !
9. Enjoy !

title: guinness burgers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f degrees
2. Combine meat , pepper , tabasco sauce , garlic , chili sauce , dry onion soup mix , and 1 ozs guinness
3. Shape into 4 patties
4. Bake at 400f until brown , about 10 minutes
5. Baste with the remaining guinness
6. Continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes , until well done
7. Add your favourite burger garnishes and trimmings

title: north carolina sausage and grits casserole
steps:
1. Bring water and salt to boil
2. Stir in grits
3. Return to boil , reduce heat , then cook for 4 minutes
4. In large bowl combine grits and cheese and stir until cheese is melted
5. Stir in cold milk , thyme , and garlic powder
6. Mix well
7. Stir in eggs , mixing well
8. Stir in sausage
9. Pour in 13 x 9 inch pan
10. Cover and refrigerate overnight
11. Remove from refrigerator and let stand 15 minutes
12. Bake at 350 degrees for 50-55 minutes

title: norma s quick rolls
steps:
1. Mix all and knead on a floured surface for about 10 minutes
2. Let rise 20 minutes and knead again
3. Make into rolls , using a floured glass to cut out , and place on a lg
4. Greased pizza pan
5. Let rise 20 minutes or until double in size
6. Bake at 375 , for 20 minutes

title: angel hair pasta with chicken   mk
steps:
1. Heat 1-tablespoon oil in a medium skillet over medium heat
2. Add chicken
3. Cook , stirring , until chicken is cooked through , about 5 minutes
4. Remove from skillet drain on paper towels
5. Heat remaining oil in same skillet
6. Begin heating water for pasta
7. Add carrot to skillet
8. Cook , stirring for 4 minutes
9. Add broccoli and garlic to skillet
10. Cook , stirring , for two minutes longer
11. Cook pasta according to package directions
12. While pasta is cooking , add chicken broth , basil to skillet
13. Stir to combine
14. Return chicken to skillet
15. Add parmesan to skillet and reduce heat and simmer for 4 minutes
16. Drain pasta
17. Place in a large serving bowl
18. Top with vegetable mixture

title: marvelous marble cake   parve
steps:
1. Cream sugar and margarine
2. Mix in eggs and vanilla
3. Mix flour and baking powder
4. Add flour mixture and water , alternately in small amounts
5. Pour 2 / 3 of mixture into a 9x13 inch pan , pour on melted chocolate , pour on remaining batter
6. Swirl with a knife
7. Bake at 350 degress for 1 hour

title: cousin judys deviled eggs
steps:
1. Combine the thoroughly mashed yolks with the mayonnaise and mustard
2. Add in worcestershire sauce , old bay , vinegar , and pepper
3. Stir to combine
4. Taste and if needed , add salt
5. Fill the whites evenly with the mixture and garnish each egg half with a sprinkle of paprika

title: bird s creamy egg noodle and beef casserole  lite bleu
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f saute' ground beef with italian seasoning
2. Drain and add chopped tomatoes
3. Set aside
4. Begin making the egg noodles
5. While egg noodles are cooking place in a large bowl the butter , salt , pepper , cream cheese , cottage cheese , and sour cream
6. Set aside
7. As soon as the noodles are cooked , drain in colander , shake water out , and immediately pour into bowl with cream cheese mixture
8. Mix to coat noodles and melt cheese
9. Place 1 / 2 of noodle mixture into a greased 9x13x2 casserole pan
10. Follow with 1 / 2 the beef mixture , then sprinkle with 1 / 2 of cheddar cheese
11. Repeat layers
12. Bake for 30 minutes or until cooked thru

title: church supper spaghetti
steps:
1. Cook meat , onion , pepper
2. Add tomatoes , water , chili powder , cook 30 minutes
3. Prepare spaghetti
4. Preheat oven 350f
5. Add corn , peas , mushrooms
6. Stir in spaghetti
7. Layer half into greased 4 quart baking dish , sprinkle with 1 cup cheese
8. Put in rest , and rest of cheese
9. Bake at 350f for 20 minutes

title: grandma best s chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Mix thoroughly shortening , butter and sugars , salt , eggs and vanilla
3. Blend in remaining ingredients
4. Bake 8- 10 minutes until golden brown
5. Do not overbake
6. If using self rising flour , omit baking soda and salt

title: how to bake the perfect potato
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Wash and dry off as many potatoes as you plan to serve , and count on each person eating 1-2 halves
3. Pierce potatoes using a fork work your way around each potato stabbing deeply into it's flesh
4. 3-4 stabs should do it depending on the size of the potatoes you are using
5. This allows steam to escape during the cooking process
6. Rub potatoes with oil to lightly coat
7. Sprinkle with salt if desired
8. Bake 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours depending on size on the middle rack in oven
9. The skin will be puffed up , golden-brown and crispy , and the potato should squish easily and be very soft on the inside

title: broccoli  grape and chickpea salad
steps:
1. Mix first 6 ingredients in a large bowl
2. Whisk remaining ingredients in a small bowl
3. Combine dressing with salad , and stir again before serving
4. Best served at room temperature

title: delicious smashed potatoes
steps:
1. Cook the potatoes in boiling salted water for about 13-15 minutes or until just fork-tender drain well and place in a large bowl
2. While the potatoes are still hot add in butter and lightly mash
3. Add in the sour cream and whipping cream
4. Mash but leave chunks in the potato mixture
5. Add in the chopped green onions mix to combine
6. Season with salt and lots of pepper to taste

title: lemon cutout cookies
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , beat together butter and sugar until creamy
2. Add egg and lemon juice
3. Beat well
4. In seperate bowl , combine flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
5. Gradually beat flour mixture into creamed mixture
6. Beat until well-mixed
7. Dough will be soft !
8. Divide dough in half
9. Wrap each half in wax paper then plastic wrap and chill at least 2 hours in freezer
10. After dough has chilled , preheat oven to 375
11. Roll dough on to lightly floured surface to 1 / 8"-1 / 4" thickness
12. Cut out shapes with cookie cutters and place on ungreased cookie sheets
13. Bake @ 375 for 8-10 minutes or until edges slightly golden brown
14. Makes about 4 dozen , depending on size and shape of cutters used

title: hot apple pie sandwiches
steps:
1. Combine apples and cinnamon
2. Place cheese on the outside of 4 slices of toast
3. Spoon apples onto cheese
4. Top with remaining bread slices
5. Brush outside with butter
6. Broil on each side until golden brown

title: stuffed asian cabbage rolls
steps:
1. Cut the core out of the cabbage
2. Chop the mushrooms and walnuts
3. Microwave cabbage for 5 minutes , set aside
4. Cook the rice in 2 cups of the vegetable broth according to package directions
5. Saute the chopped mushrooms , onion , and walnuts in the margarine for about 5 minutes
6. Stir mixture into the cooked rice
7. Dissolve the cornstarch in the water
8. Heat the remaining 2 cups vegetable broth in a small pan
9. Add sesame oil and cornstarch / water mixture
10. Heat and stir until slightly thickened
11. Season with white pepper to taste
12. Spread a thin layer of sauce in 13x9 casserole dish
13. Peel outer leaves off of the cabbage
14. Fill each with 2-3 tablespoons of the rice mixture
15. Fold sides over and roll up leaf
16. Place seam side down in the prepared casserole dish
17. Pour the remaining sauce over the cabbage rolls
18. Cover and bake at 325 degrees for 30 minutes

title: pepperoni rolls
steps:
1. Dissolve sugar , yeast , salt in the warm water
2. Stir in the flour , using extra flour or water as needed to make a soft dough that isn't too sticky
3. Turn out onto a floured board and knead for a couple of minutes
4. Shape into a ball and let raise in a bowl for 30 minutes to an hour , covered with a towel
5. Volume should double
6. Turn the raised dough back onto the floured board , and cut it into 12 pieces
7. Take each piece , flatten it lightly on the board with your hand , and place 4-5 slices of pepperoni in the middle , overlapping but not stacked
8. Add cheese
9. Roll it up like a jelly roll , and then crimp it with your fingers to seal the ends into an oval , with no pepperoni sticking out
10. Place on an ungreased baking sheet with at least an inch between each one
11. Beat in an egg and add a tablespoonful of water
12. Brush rolls lightly with this glaze
13. You don't need to let the rolls raise further , but you can if you want to
14. Bake rolls at 425 degrees until golden brown

title: two second ginger  cream   grape dessert
steps:
1. Place a 1 / 2 cup of green grapes and a 1 / 2 cup red grapes in an individual serving dish
2. Add a quarter of the our cream on top
3. Drizzle 1 1 / 2 tbs of chopped ginger on top
4. Repeat 4 times
5. Serve

title: chinese melon soup  dong gwah jong
steps:
1. For fancy presentation - remove top of melon
2. Scoop out melon and seeds , reserving 3 cups melon balls
3. Scallop edge of melon
4. In a large pan , heat stock , bamboo , mushrooms , ham , chicken , ginger , sugar , salt , and pepper and bring to a boil
5. Reduce the heat to low , half cover the pan , and simmer for 15-20 minutes
6. Just before serving add reserved melon balls and pour soup into the melon shell
7. Sprinkle with almonds and serve immediately

title: south west cauliflower with a zing
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Steam cauliflower just until tender
3. Drain
4. Melt butter in a medium size saucepan over medium heat
5. In a jar with a lid combine
6. Flour , red pepper , salt , pepper , garlic and milk
7. Shake until blended
8. Slowly add to butter or margarine in saucepan , stirring constantly until smooth
9. Add cheese and continue stirring until smooth and thickened
10. Add more milk to make a roux
11. Stir in chilies
12. Arrange cauliflower in a 2 quart baking dish
13. Pour sauce over cauliflower , then sprinkle with bread crumbs if desired
14. Bake 5 to 10 min or until bubbling

title: easy mocha fondue
steps:
1. Combine first 4 ingredients in a medium saucepan
2. Cook , stirring constantly , over medium-low heat until chocolate melts and mixture is smooth
3. Stir in kahla
4. Pour mixture into fondue pot
5. Place over fondue burner
6. Serve with cake cubes and fruit as dippers

title: blt casserole
steps:
1. Fry bacon and set aside
2. Scramble eggs and set aside
3. Toast bread and spread with mayonnaise
4. Cut toast into cubes with a pizza cutter
5. Lay cubes in a 8-in square greased baking dish
6. Try to keep mayo side up
7. Place crumbled bacon on toast cubes
8. Lay american cheese slices on top of bacon
9. Place scrambled eggs on top of the cheese
10. Cover eggs with the diced tomatoes
11. Set aside
12. In a saucepan , melt butter
13. Stir in gravy mix until smooth
14. Graduallly add milk
15. Bring to a boil: cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
16. Pour gravy over casserole
17. Sprinkle with shredded cheese and onion
18. Bake , uncovered at 325 for 10 minutes
19. Cut into squares
20. Serve on lettuce

title: baked buffalo chicken pasta
steps:
1. Cook the pasta according to directions
2. While pasta is cooking , preheat the oven to 375 degrees f
3. Heat a medium saucepan over medium heat
4. Add the butter , and once its melted and bubbly add the flour
5. Whisk together to create a roux and cook for 1-2 minutes until mixture gets a bit golden in color
6. Add milk
7. Continue stirring until milk thickens
8. Add in grated cheeses and continue to stir until mixture is smooth
9. Stir in buffalo wing sauce
10. Taste and season with salt and pepper if needed
11. Spray a 9x13 baking dish with non-stick spray
12. Add pasta and chicken , then pour cheese sauce over and mix thoroughly until everything is coated
13. Sprinkle with additional grated cheese and bread crumbs
14. Bake for 25 minutes or until cheese is golden brown
15. Remove from oven and immediately top with desired garnish

title: pasta and pine nut salad   with gluten free option
steps:
1. Combine salad ingredients , mix well
2. In another bowl , whisk together all of the dressing ingredients
3. Toss the dressing through the salad and serve

title: chewy toffee pecan chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Line baking sheets with parchment paper
3. In the work bowl of a food processor , add flour , pecans , baking soda , cream of tartar , and salt: process until nuts are finely ground into flour
4. In a large bowl , beat butter , shortening , white and dark brown sugars at medium-high speed with an electric mixer until fluffy , about 3 minutes
5. Add molasses , eggs , and vanilla
6. Beat on low speed just until blended
7. Gradually add flour mixture , beathing just until dough forms
8. Stir in chocolate morsels and toffee bits
9. Roll dough into 1-inch balls
10. Then roll balls in turbinado sugar
11. Do not flatten
12. I ended up with probably closer to 2 cups
13. Place 2 inches apart on prepared baking sheets
14. Bake 10-12 minutes , or until lightly browned and slightly flattened
15. Let cool on pans for 15 minutes
16. Remove from pans , and cool completely on wire racks

title: black forest stuffed cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Prepare cake batter as directed on package
3. Set aside
4. Mix cream cheese , egg and sugar until well blended
5. Remove 3 / 4 cup of the pie filling for garnish
6. Set aside
7. Spoon 2 tablespoons of the cake batter into each of 24 paper-lined medium muffin cups
8. Top each with 1 tablespoon each of the cream cheese mixture and the remaining pie filling
9. Cover evenly with remaining cake batter
10. Bake for 25-30 minutes or until toothpick inserted in centers comes out clean
11. Cool 5 minutes
12. Remove from pans to wire racks
13. Cool completely
14. Top cupcakes with whipped topping and remaining pie filling just before serving

title: lemon mint herb marinade
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and stir well
2. Put meat into a zipper plastic bag and pour marinade over
3. Seal and place in refrigerator for desired marinating time
4. I usually pour marinade from meat into a small saucepan and bring to a boil
5. Use as a sauce for meat after it has been grilled

title: zucchini  roasted
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Cut zucchini in half or quarters lengthwise , then slice
3. Spray with olive oil and toss
4. Place skin side down in the middle of a metal baking sheet
5. Sprinkle with seasoning to taste
6. Spread out on baking sheet
7. Bake for 20 minutes or so

title: pierogi chicken bake
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the chicken , chicken gravy , pierogis , frozen vegetables , and salt / pepper to taste
2. Mix well
3. Transfer to a 13x9 inch baking dish
4. Cover with foil and bake at 350 for 50 minutes
5. Take out of the oven , uncover , and top with french-fried onions
6. Bake , uncovered , 5 more minutes or until onions are golden brown

title: chicken  red wine and bacon casserole  oamc
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 275f
2. Put a heavy-bottomed ovenproof casserole dish over a medium heat with 2 tbsp oil
3. Once hot , add the chicken , a few pieces at a time , and fry on all sides until golden brown
4. Remove and set aside in a large dish
5. Add the shallots to the pan and saut for 10-15 minutes until golden and beginning to soften
6. Add to the chicken
7. Add the diced bacon to the pan and fry until it begins to colour
8. Add the carrots and continue cooking until they begin to soften
9. Mix in the mushrooms and cook until lightly coloured
10. Add all the contents of the pan to the chicken , leaving any juices in the pan
11. Reduce the temperature to low , pour another 1-2 tbsp oil into the pan , add the flour and stir into the pan juices
12. Cook for a couple of minutes or until it starts to look cooked and lightly coloured
13. Immediately , stir in the garlic and the wine , followed by the broth
14. Return to the boil , and cook briskly until it has thickened slightly
15. Meanwhile , pour the brandy over the chicken mixture
16. Set alight and once the flames have gone out ,
17. Add the herbs and lemon zest , and season to taste
18. Once the casserole returns to the boil , cover and place in the oven for 45 minutes , or until the chicken is tender and cooked through
19. It is then ready to serve , or to cool and freeze

title: barbecued lobster tails
steps:
1. Split the tails lengthwise with a large knife
2. Thoroughly mix all the other ingredients
3. Brush meat side of tail with marinade
4. Place the tails meat side down over medium coals and grill for 5-6 minutes
5. Turn over lobster and cook for another 5-6 minutes , brushing often with the remaining marinade
6. Do not overcook- lobster is done when it is opaque and firm to the touch
