7. Serve with drawn butter and hunks of fresh lemon
8. Drool

title: charmaqine s oatmeal cookies with raisins  dates  and walnuts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper and spray with nonstick spray
3. Mix first 5 ingredients in medium bowl
4. Using electric mixer , cream butter , shortening , and both sugars in large bowl until fluffy
5. Add honey , eggs , and vanilla , then gradually beat in flour mixture
6. Stir in oats , raisins , dates , and walnuts
7. Drop batter by tablespoonfuls onto prepared sheets , spacing mounds 2 inches apart
8. Flatten cookies slightly with the bottom of a buttered glass
9. Bake cookies 10-12 minutes at 350f or until until golden brown
10. Cool completely on sheets
11. When cool , store in airtight containers

title: baked gnocchi with chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f
2. Heat your skillet over medium high heat , add the oil , then mushrooms , season with salt and pepper , and cook , stirring occasionally , until lightly browned , about 4 minutes or so
3. Transfer mushrooms to a plate and wipe out the skillet
4. Reduce the heat under the skillet to medium and melt the butter in the skillet
5. Stir in the flour and cook , whisking , for about 3 minutes
6. Whisk in the milk and chicken broth , simmering while whisking , until slightly thickened , about 5 minutes
7. Season with 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and the nutmeg
8. Add in the chicken , mushrooms , gnocchi , and spinach
9. Stir to coat everything and wilt the spinach
10. Sprinkle with parmesan , then transfer the whole shebang to the oven
11. If using a separate casserole , transfer everything to the casserole , then sprinkle with the parmesan
12. Bake until bubbling , about 20 minutes
13. If you like , turn on the broiler and brown the top for about 3 minutes

title: upside down raisin carrot cake
steps:
1. Drain pineapple , reserving 1 / 2 cup of the juice
2. Melt 1 / 4 cup butter in a 10-inch ovenproof skillet
3. Blend in brown sugar
4. Arrange pineapple over brown sugar / butter mixture and top with 1 / 2 cup raisins
5. Beat remaining 1 / 4 cup butter with sugar until light and fluffy
6. Beat in eggs , vanilla and carrots
7. Combine dry ingredients in a separate bowl
8. Beat 1 / 3 of the dry ingredients into the creamed butter and sugar
9. Beat in half of reserved pineapple juice till blended
10. Beat in another 1 / 3 of dry mixture , followed by remaining pineapple juice
11. Beat in remaining third of dry ingredients
12. Fold in remaining 1 / 2 cup raisins
13. Pour batter over pineapple in ovenproof skillet
14. Bake in 350 oven 40-45 minutes
15. Let stand 5 minutes before inverting on serving plate

title: delicious london broil with beefy gravy
steps:
1. Turn broiler on
2. Brush meat with worcestershire and season with onion and garlic powder and salt and pepper
3. I like to massage this all into the meat and let it rest while the broiler preheats
4. Cook london broil on top rack for 6 minutes on each side , for rare to medium rare , longer for medium
5. Remove meat from broiler and let it rest 5 minutes
6. Important- do not skip this step
7. The juices will redistribute throughout the meat during this rest time and continue to cook
8. This will give you a very juicy steak
9. Place a small skillet over medium heat
10. Melt 2 tablespoons butter , add finely chopped shallot , cook 2 minutes , then whisk in flour and cook 1 minute
11. Add 2 cups beef broth to the pan and bring to a bubble
12. Cook for 2 minutes to allow the broth to reduce a little
13. Add 1 / 4 cup steak sauce and black pepper , to taste
14. Very thinly slice the meat on an angle against the grain
15. The degree to which you can slice thinly slice the meat will determine how tender it is to cut and chew , so make sure the carving knife is sharp the thinner the better !
16. Transfer the slices to a platter keeping them lined up as you sliced them , forming a whole steak , just sliced
17. Pour gravy down the center and serve any remaining gravy on the side
18. We like this with egg noodles or a baked potato , a green salad and some crusty bread
19. Oh and of course a nice glass of wine !

title: poppy seed coffee cake   bundt
steps:
1. Cream together butter and sugar , then add the egg yolks , mixing well
2. Sift tog dry ingredients and add alternately with buttermilk to the creamed mixture
3. Add poppy seeds and almond extract
4. Beat egg white in a small bowl until stiff peaks form
5. Fold egg white into the batter
6. Bake at 350 degf in a greased and floured 12 cup bundt pan for 60 minutes or till cake tests done
7. Cool in pan for 10 minutes , then turn out onto a cooling rack or serving plate
8. Cool and top with a lemon glaze or sifted confectioner's sugar

title: guilt free mandarin orange  n kahlua
steps:
1. Combine cream cheese , sugar substitute , whipped topping , & kahlua in a food processor , whip until smooth arrange orange slices in 8 parfait glasses
2. Top with equal amounts of cream cheese mixture , sprinkle with chocolate shavings

title: spiced chicken and sweet potatoes
steps:
1. In a small bowl , mix together the first 7 ingredients
2. Set aside
3. Place chicken , breast side up , on a rack in a shallow roasting pan
4. Brush the chicken with 2 tablespoons olive oil
5. Reserve 2 tablespoons rub mixture for later use
6. Rub chicken with remaining rub mixture
7. Roast chicken in a 375 oven for 20 minutes
8. While chicken is roasting: add sweet potatoes , 1 tablespoon olive oil , and reserved rub mixture to a mixing bowl
9. Toss to coat
10. Pour apple juice into the roasting pan around the chicken
11. Add the potatoes
12. Continue to cook uncovered for 40-55 minutes or until meat thermometer reads 180-185 and potatoes are tender
13. Let chicken stand , covered , for 10 minutes before carving

title: north african flank steak
steps:
1. In small bowl , combine all ingredients except steak and oil
2. Rub spice mixture on both sides of steak
3. If you like , place steak on plate
4. Let stand at room temperature 15 minutes meanwhile , in nonstick 10-inch skillet , heat oil over medium-high heat until hot but not smoking
5. Add steak to skillet and cook 14-16 minutes for medium-rare or until desired doneness , turning steak over once
6. Transfer steak to cutting board
7. To serve , thinly slice steak diagonally against the grain

title: walnut upside down cake
steps:
1. In an 8"x8" glass baking dish , mix first four ingredients
2. Add walnuts and golden raisins
3. Stir in the milk
4. When blended , smooth mixture in the pan
5. Stir brown sugar , water , and butter until sugar dissoves , then gently pour over the cake
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 30-35 minutes

title: ann s lentil soup
steps:
1. Just put everything into a 6-8 qt stockpot , add water to about two inches from the rim and simmer
2. I ended up simmering mine for about 1 hour
3. I cooked some small shells for those who wanted a little heartier soup
4. I served some extra pesto sauce and some grated parmesan for those who wanted it
5. Any type of tomatoes will do
6. Diced , crushed , sauce , pizza sauce , marinara in a pinch
7. Just use what you've got !

title: family reunion casserole
steps:
1. Mix the first four ingredients together
2. You can add a cooked vegetable to this to make a complete meal in one dish
3. Crush the ritz crackers
4. Spray a casserole or baking dish with non-stick cooking spray
5. Add 1 / 3 of ritz crackers
6. Put in half of chicken mixture
7. Add 1 / 3 of ritz crackers on top of chicken
8. Put in the other half of chicken mixture and top with remaining ritz crackers
9. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes
10. Makes 8 servings

title: namora  semolina cake   baklava
steps:
1. Cream the butter and one cup sugar
2. Stir in a 1 / 2 cup water
3. Sift together the semolina , baking powder , and stir into the butter mixture to form a smooth batter
4. Preheat the oven to 350f
5. Lightly grease an 8-by-12-inch cake pan and pour in the batter
6. Spread it evenly with the back of a spoon and then score across the top of the cake
7. Place an almond in the center of each diamond
8. Bake in the preheated oven for 35-40 minutes , when the cake should be firm and lightly browned
9. Combine three cups sugar , lemon juice , and water in a small saucepan
10. Bring to a boil
11. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes or until slightly thickened
12. Cool
13. Pour cooled syrup , spoonfuls at a time , over the hot cake
14. Stop when the cake will not absorb any more and set the cake aside to cool before serving

title: sweet onion salad
steps:
1. Remove peel from oranges , and slice 1 / 8 inch slices across to make discs
2. Clean onion and slice into discs also
3. Seperate onion slices into rings
4. Put oranges and onions together in a medium to large bowl
5. Sprinkle powdered sugar on top
6. Toss to mix evenly
7. Let sit a few minutes before serving
8. Best if it can sit at least an hour
9. Can be eaten as is , or used as a topping for a green salad

title: emeril s mexican breakfast casserole
steps:
1. Roast the peppers by placing them on an open gas flame , turning them frequently with tongs until all sides are charred black , about 7 to 10 minutes
2. Place the blackened peppers in a plastic or paper bag , and let rest until cool enough to handle , about 15 minutes
3. Peel the peppers , split in half lengthwise , and remove the seeds and the stems
4. Butter a 9 by 13-inch baking dish
5. Spread the chiles in a flat layer across the bottom of the dish
6. In a large skillet , cook the sausage over medium-high heat , stirring to break up the meat , until browned
7. Add the onions and bell peppers , and cook , stirring , for 4 minutes
8. Add the garlic and chili powder , and cook , stirring , for 1 minute
9. Remove from the heat
10. In a large bowl , whisk the eggs and half-and-half with the hot sauce , salt and black pepper
11. In another bowl , combine the green onions , cilantro , jack , and cheddar , and mix well
12. Spoon 1 / 3 of the sausage mixture over the chiles in the dish , top with 1 / 3 of the tortilla quarters , and 1 / 3 of the grated cheese mixture
13. Repeat layering , ending with a cheese layer
14. Pour the egg mixture over the ingredients
15. Let rest , covered , in the refrigerator for at least 6 hours , or overnight
16. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
17. Bake until bubbly and golden brown , and a knife inserted into the custard comes out clean , about 1 hour and 10 minutes to 1 hour and 15 minutes
18. Remove from the oven and let rest 10 minutes before serving
19. Serve with sour cream and picante sauce

title: wine and black olive pate
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a medium sized saucepan , add the cumin seeds and allow them to sizzle for a few seconds
2. Add the onions and garlic and saute gently for 3-5 minutes , or until soft
3. Add the tomatoes , olives , honey , a pinch of celery salt and honey
4. Mix together and cook gently for 10 minutes
5. Pour in the red wine , bring to the boil and simmer for another 20 minutes , uncovered
6. Turn up the heat and stir vigorously until the mixture has reduced to the consistency of a soft pate
7. This final stage will take about 5 minutes , but cooking time will depend on the thickness of the juice the chopped tomatoes are packed in
8. Turn into a serving dish and allow to cool
9. The flavours will intensify , the longer you leave the pate before eating

title: turbo mojito
steps:
1. Tools: 10oz measured bar glass
2. You'll also need a bar muddler
3. Measure 2oz of rum into the bar measure , toss in the mint leaves , and press the leaves with the muddler for at least 30 seconds
4. The point is to get as much flavor out of the leaves as you can without tearing them to bits
5. Measure in your simple syrup
6. I like about 1
7. 5oz of syrup in my mojitos , but you'll find what level of sweetness you like
8. The syrup is heavy and will sink immediately to the bottom of the mix
9. Add in about 4oz of sparkling lime water and stir- gently- to loosen the syrup at the bottom of the glass
10. Pour- leaves and all- into a tall glass that's already filled with ice
11. Top off with sparkling lime water , stir gently , and serve
12. Simple syrup: boil 2 parts sugar and 1 part water together until sugar is well-dissolved
13. Let cool and pour into a sealable container
14. Keeps well in the fridge for months
15. This is what makes this recipe shine above mojito recipes made with syrup made with white sugar
16. Turbinado syrup gives a much richer flavor to drinks , and a beautiful golden color too
17. I know some people will disapprove of my using sparkling lime water instead of the traditional sparkling water and fresh-squeezed lime juice
18. If you buy a sparkling water that has no artificial ingredients it tastes just as good and it makes it so much faster and easier to prepare this drink
19. Don't knock it 'till you try it !

title: brunch b t on english muffins
steps:
1. Toast muffins and spread each muffin half with 1 tbs miracle whip
2. Cut bacon slices in half
3. Lay 3 bacon slice halves on top of each muffin half
4. If including onion , top each with a slice of onion
5. Top onion with a slice of tomato
6. Sprinkle basil over the top

title: low fat coffee cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Prepare streusel topping by combining first 2 ingredients in a bowl until crumbly
3. Set aside
4. Combine remaining ingredients in another bowl and stir until blended
5. Spread in a greased 9 inch round pan
6. Sprinkle with streusel topping
7. Bake 18-23 minutes or until golden brown

title: kelly s rice pudding pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Pie: place bread in mixing bowl
3. Add milk
4. Add rice , mix well by hand
5. Add sugar , applesauce , eggs& vanilla , mixing well each ingredient
6. Add oil , reserving enough to grease pie pan
7. Beat by hand for 1 minute
8. Pour mixture into greased 9" pie pan
9. Bake for 40 minutes
10. Glaze: cream together ingredients
11. Remove the pie from the oven , spread with glaze and return to oven for 5 minutes more

title: peanut butter criss  cross cookies
steps:
1. Mix all together in one bowl
2. Pinch of some of the dough and roll into "1" inch diameter balls
3. When all on cookie sheet , take a table fork and smash it down and then go the other way to make a criss cross
4. Bake on an ungreased cookie sheet in 450f oven about 10 minutes

title: mandarin orange grilling sauce
steps:
1. In a saucepan , combine cornstarch , brown sugar , ginger , cinnamon and orange peel
2. Stir in the orange and lemon juices and bring to a boil
3. Stirring constantly
4. Boil for 1 minute and then remove from heat
5. Stir in orange segments
6. Cover and keep warm until ready to serve with main dish
7. Microwave directions:
8. In a 4-cup measure , combine cornstarch , brown sugar , ginger , cinnamon and orange peel
9. Gradually stir in orange and lemon juices
10. Microwave on high for 3-4 minutes or until mixture boils , stirring each minute
11. Keep microwaving to boil it one full minute
12. Stir in orange segments
13. Cover and keep warm until ready to serve with main dish
14. Grilled chicken dish:
15. Pound 4 boneless chicken breasts to a 1 / 4 inch thickness
16. In a small dish combine 2 tbls
17. Melted butter with 1 / 4 tsp cinnamon and use this to baste the chicken while grilling

title: littlemafia s romanian fudge
steps:
1. Mix water and sugar together
2. Cook for about 10 minutes , till becomes a syrup
3. Remove from heat add margarine
4. Then add cocoa and stir slightly
5. Add powder milk and mix well
6. Pour into 13"x9" pan and let cool
7. We usually add nuts , raisins and whatever we find in our kitchen

title: chicken with cranberries and orange
steps:
1. Place the chicken pieces in the cooker
2. In a small bowl mix together the garlic , soy sauce , orange zest , juice , tomato paste , cinnamon and marmalade and spoon over the chicken pieces in the cooker
3. Cover with the lid and cook following the times and settings in the description above
4. Thirty minutes prior to the end of cooking turn the control to high if cooking on low
5. Stir in the cranberries
6. Mix the cornflour to a smooth paste with the brandy and stir into the juices in the cooker
7. Cover with the lid and continue to cook for the final half hour
8. Serve sprinkled with chopped mint

title: spudini bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Chop garlic in a food processor
3. Add all other ingredients , except for bread and mozzarella
4. Process in short bursts , until spread is rough and lumpy
5. Slice bread into 3 / 4 inch slices , not all the way through , leave bottom crust connected
6. Spread each side of each slice with the butter spread
7. Place a piece of mozzarella between the slices
8. Brush top and sides of the loaf with butter spread
9. Wrap the loaf in foil
10. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes , or until the cheese is melted throughout
11. Open foil and return to oven for 5 minutes

title: old fashioned homemade vanilla ice cream
steps:
1. Combine sugar , salt and milk in saucepan and cook over medium heat , stirring occasionally until mixture almost boils
2. Reduce to low
3. Gradually stir about 1 / 2 cup of hot mil into the beaten eggs
4. Add eggs to remaining hot mixture
5. Cook over low heat , stirring constantly until slightly thickened , about 5 minute
6. Remove from heat and refrigerate at least 2 hours
7. Combine whipping cream , vanilla and chilled mixture , stirring with a wire whisk to combine
8. Pour into canister and churn

title: bacon  n tomato dip
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and chill
2. Serve with crackers or toasted bread triangles

title: ww 6 pt  buffalo chicken strips
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees , and spray a baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray
2. Wash and cut chicken breasts into strips that are approximately 1 1 / 2 inches wide
3. You can even pound the breast a little thinner first and then cut
4. Set aside
5. In a food processor , combine cereal , salt , garlic powder , onion powder , paprika and pepper and mix to a fine powder or consistency like breadcrumbs
6. Pour mixture into a shallow bowl or onto a small plate
7. Set aside
8. In a small saucepan , melt butter and then add in 3 / 4 cup of the hot sauce
9. Mix well and warm until heated , but not bubbling or boiling
10. Pour into a small , shallow bowl , and set aside
11. In a small bowl , mix egg whites with the remaining 1 / 4 cup of hot sauce
12. Now take each chicken strip , and coat with egg and hot sauce mixture
13. Shake off all excess egg from the meat
14. Coat chicken in cereal mix until strip is fully breaded
15. Lay strip on baking sheet
16. Repeat until all pieces of chicken are breaded and on the baking sheet
17. Now , with a brush or spoon , drizzle about 3 / 4 hot sauce and butter mixture over all the chicken pieces
18. Make sure to coat well
19. Bake chicken at 400 degrees until breading becomes crispy and chicken is cooked through
20. Serve with remaining hot sauce mixture for dipping

title: mussels in spicy coconut broth
steps:
1. Combine first 7 ingredients in a dutch oven , and bring to a boil
2. Add mussels
3. Cover and cook 5 minutes or until shells open
4. Remove from heat
5. Discard any unopened shells
6. Spoon 1 1 / 2 cups broth mixture into each of 2 soup bowls
7. Divide mussels evenly among each soup bowl
8. Garnish with chopped basil

title: partridges with orange and vermouth sauce
steps:
1. Sprinkle the partridges , inside and out with half the salt and peper
2. In a large saucepan , melt all but 1 tbsp butter over moderate heat
3. When the foam subsides , add the partridge halves and cook for 6 to 8 minutes , or until they are lightly and evenly browned
4. Cover the pan and cook for a further 12 to 15 minutes on each side , or until the partridges are tender when pierced with the point of a knife
5. Using tongs , or two large spoons , transfer the partridge halves to a warmed serving dish
6. Keep warm while you make the sauce
7. To make the sauce: pour off all but 1 tbsp of fat from the pan
8. Add the onion and fry , stirring occasionally , for 5 to 7 minutes , or until it is soft and translucent , but not brown
9. Pour in the chicken stock and vermouth and add the remaining salt and pepper
10. Increase the heat to high and boil for 5 to 7 minutes , or until the liquid has reduced by about one-third
11. Reduce the heat to moderate and add the orange juice , cream and chives
12. Gradually stir in beurre manie , a small piece at a time
13. Mix together equal amounts of softened butter , from the reserved 1 tbsp and flour
14. Add in small knobs to the boiling liquid
15. Whisk constantly until the butter melts and sauce is thickened
16. Continue cooking stirring constantly , for 2 or 3 minutes , or until the sauce is smooth and thick and hot- but not boiling
17. Remove the pan from the heat and pour the sauce over the partridges
18. Garnish with the orange slices and serve immediately

title: goddess blessed vegetarian chocolate clusters with orange rind
steps:
1. Place the honey-nougat chocolate and white chocolate separately in heat-proof bowls
2. Place each bowl over a pan of simmering water
3. Stir and melt the chocolate until smooth
4. Set aside to let it cool
5. Mix the orange rind into the honey-nougat chocolate
6. Mix in the walnuts into the white melted chocolate
7. Place a spoonful of mixtures{of the dark and white chocolates} separately into the small paper baking cups
8. You need 35-40 small baking paper cups
9. Leave to set in the refrigerator for sometime
10. Store in an airtight container in a cool and dry place
11. Serve with tea or coffee
12. I think , personally , these are the best thing to have after a japanese bath !
13. They make you feel like a queen after an already soul-cleansing dip !

title: independence day pink lemonade
steps:
1. Mix the watermelon vodka and lemonade in a pitcher
2. Add ice
3. Serve in 8 oz highball glasses over ice

title: thomas jefferson s sweet potato biscuits 1774
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Combine the dry ingredients
3. Add butter with fork , food processor or pastry cutter until the texture is small crumbs
4. Combine milk and sweet potatoes
5. Add to flour mixture
6. Add pecans
7. Knead dough with your hands until it is a smooth mass
8. Roll out on a floured surface to 1 / 2" thickness and cut with a 2" biscuit cutter
9. Place on a greased baking sheet 2" apart
10. Bake for about 10-15 minutes , or until lightly browned

title: vegan spiced cookies
steps:
1. Cream together the margarine and sugars until smooth
2. Add vanilla and soy milk and mix well
3. Add flour , baking soda and spices until well mixed , then stir in oats and cranberries
4. Spoon 1 1 / 2 inch balls onto an ungreased cookie sheet and bake 10-15 minutes at 350 degrees , or until done
5. Enjoy your vegan oatmeal cookies

title: wedding punch
steps: 1. Mix together in large punch bowl

title: chicken salad with fruit and toasted pecans
steps:
1. Core and dice the apple and pear
2. Sprinkle the fruit with 1 or 2 teaspoons of fresh lemon juice to keep it from discoloring
3. In a large bowl , combine the diced chicken , apple , pear , grapes and chives
4. To make the dressing , in a small bowl , whisk together all of the dressing ingredients
5. Just before serving , add all of the dressing to the chicken salad and toss well to combine
6. Adjust seasonings , adding additional salt if necessary
7. Top with the toasted pecans

title: heavenly chocolate honey dip
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine all ingredients until well blended
2. Cover and chill until ready to serve
3. Serve with assorted fresh fruits , assorted dried fruits , and / or with chunks of angel food cake

title: basic oatmeal
steps:
1. Place 3 / 4 cup of the rolled oats into a blender and process until a flour
2. Add all rolled oats , water , cinnamon and vanilla to pan and bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat and cook for 3 minutes
4. Add honey and applesauce and stir for 1 minute
5. Add to bowls
6. Enjoy

title: chilli sauce
steps:
1. Heat the oil and grate in the garlic and cumin- fry for a minute or so , being careful not to burn them
2. Add the tomatoes and lemon juice and seasoning
3. Simmer for 5- 10 minutes
4. Put in the blender with the coriander and blitz
5. You can serve it warm or cold

title: chocolate cinnamon scones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f mix flour , sugar , cinnamon , baking soda and salt in large bowl
2. Cut in butter with pastry blender or 2 knives until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
3. Beat eggs , sour cream and vanilla in medium bowl with wire whisk until well blended
4. Add to flour mixture
5. Stir until a soft dough forms
6. Stir in chopped chocolate
7. Place dough on lightly floured surface
8. Knead about 1 minute or until smooth
9. Place dough on greased baking sheet and pat into a 10-inch circle
10. Score top of dough with sharp knife into 12 wedges
11. Bake 30 minutes or until golden brown
12. Cool slightly on wire rack
13. Melt and drizzle additional semi-sweet chocolate over scones , if desired
14. Cut into 12 wedges to serve

title: szechuan bok choy
steps:
1. In a wok , stir-fry bok choy in oil for 3 minutes
2. Add ginger and 1 / 4 tsp of salt
3. Stir-fry 2 minutes more
4. Add paste and hoisin sauce
5. Stir-fry 1 minute more

title: durkee onion ring and mushroom canapes
steps:
1. Toast party rye on both sides under broiler
2. In a bowl , stir together mayonnaise , parmesan , mushrooms , and onion rings
3. Spread on toasted party rye
4. Place on baking sheet on lowest rack in oven
5. Broil until browned and bubbly

title: fast italian skillet dinner
steps:
1. Brown ground beef and drain
2. Add tomato paste , water , seasoning mix , onions , green peppers , and macaroni
3. Bring to a boil
4. Cover and simmer for 20-25 minutes
5. Top with shredded cheese

title: chinese short ribs  crock pot
steps:
1. Season ribs with salt and pepper
2. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and add half of ribs
3. Cook , turning often , until browned on all sides , about 10 minutes
4. Transfer to a slow cooker
5. Repeat with remaining ribs
6. Add onion , ginger and garlic to skillet
7. Cook over medium heat , stirring , until onion is slightly softened , 3 to 5 minutes
8. Stir in flour and cook for 2 minutes
9. Add soy sauce and broth
10. Increase heat to high and bring to a simmer , stirring to pick up browned bits
11. Pour over ribs and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours or on high for 4 to 6 hours
12. Transfer ribs to a platter and cover to keep warm
13. Strain cooking liquid into a saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat
14. Boil until liquid has thickened slightly , 10 to 15 minutes
15. Season with salt and pepper
16. Ladle sauce over ribs
17. Serve hot with vegetables and steamed white rice , if desired

title: sensational beef stroganoff
steps:
1. Slice beef across grain into strips
2. Cook beef until browned
3. Set aside
4. Cook onions until soft
5. Add soup , paprika , and a little milk
6. Add beef
7. Mix together adding a little more milk if too thick , heat through
8. Add sour cream , stir to mix
9. Serve over hot noodles

title: peruvian  sauteed beef tenderloin  lomo saltado
steps:
1. Preparation:
2. Heat cup oil in a large skillet over high heat
3. Add beef and quickly saut until beef is seared and browned on all sides
4. Remove pan from heat and transfer beef to a plate
5. Save covered
6. Return pan to medium-high heat and add 1 tablespoons oil
7. Add onions and saut until edges are seared and they begin to soften , about 2 minutes
8. Add aji amarillo , tomatoes , parsley , salt , pepper , soy sauce and vinegar
9. Saut until tomatoes have softened , about 2 minutes
10. Add beef and toss gently
11. Optional: for a special taste pour cup pisco over boiling meat and ignite
12. Cover and set aside
13. Heat cups oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat
14. Add potatoes and saut until browned and tender , about 15 minutes
15. Drain on paper towel
16. Unmold rice in center of serving dish
17. Place beef and french fries on each side
18. Sprinkle with finely chopped parsley

title: christmas jelly candy
steps:
1. In 1 1 / 2 quart saucepan combine gelatin and sugar
2. Add fruit juice
3. Wait 5 minutes
4. Bring to boiling
5. Reduce heat
6. Cook and stir till gelatin dissolves
7. Add lemon juice
8. Pour into shallow pans or paper bake cups
9. Cool
10. Chill till firm
11. Cover pans or store cutouts in single layers , between waxed paper , in airtight containers up to 5 days

title: rice mix up
steps:
1. Put first 5 ingredients into sauce pan
2. Cook covered until tender
3. Mix soup , broccoli and cheese together
4. Add rice mixture
5. Stir
6. Pour into 2 quart casserole dish
7. Cover
8. Bake 350 f oven for 40 - 50 minutes

title: pig eyes
steps:
1. Heat frying pan on medium-high , and coat pan with about half of the butter
2. Spread each slice of bread with butter on one side and place in pan , buttered side up
3. Cut a hole in the middle of each slice of bread using a small sized glass about 2 inches in diameter
4. Remove cut-outs and place in pan
5. If they don't fit , then save to cook afterwards
6. Crack one egg into each slice of bread , and sprinkle with cheese , garlic powder , salt and pepper
7. Cook about one minute , or until egg white is almost cooked through
8. Flip each slice over and cook until desired doneness
9. Served with fried egg-hole cut outs to dip into yolk

title: lenten lentils  oaxacan style
steps:
1. Bring lentils and water to a boil , with 2 halved garlic cloves and 1 / 2 white onion
2. Reduce heat , then cover and simmer over low heat about 20 minutes or until lentils are tender but not mushy
3. Drain and reserve lentil cooking liquid
4. At this point , i like to fish out the garlic halves but leave the onion , which breaks down in the lentils
5. Season with salt
6. Heat oil in large saucepan and saute chopped white onion and the 2 minced garlic cloves until onion is soft
7. Add plantain , pineapple and tomatoes
8. Cook until plantain is soft , anywhere from 15 to 25 minutes
9. Add lentils and some reserved lentil cooking liquid
10. Continue cooking until mixture thickens a little
11. Add more cooking liquid or even some vegetable or chicken broth if necessary so lentils aren't dry
12. Serve garnished with fried plantain slices

title: chicken and black bean green enchilada rice bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. And spray a 913-inch baking dish with non-stick cooking spray
3. Cook rice according to package directions
4. Place chicken , enchilada sauce , olives , tomatoes , sour cream , salt , pepper and cumin into a large bowl , mixing to combine
5. Pour cooked rice into prepared baking dish and layer beans on top of rice
6. Pour chicken mixture over rice and top evenly with cheddar cheese
7. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes , until cheese is melted and rice is hot

title: picnic dip
steps:
1. Mix ketchup , mustard and sour cream in a bowl , then slowly add , a teaspoon at a time , the horseradish until you get the right amount of heat for your taste
2. Remember , cooking is a creative sport
3. This mixture will be still enough to use as a dip for chips , and it is also very good on hot dogs

title: creamy corn and potato mash
steps:
1. If using frozen corn , prepare as per packet instructions
2. Cook the potato in a pot of lightly salted boiling water until tender , drain and mash with the cream
3. While the potato is cooking , melt the butter in a small pan over low heat
4. Add the onion and cook , stirring , for about five-ten minutes , until very soft but not browned
5. Blend the cooked corn with the cooked onion in a food processor until smooth , adding salt and pepper to taste
6. Stir into the mashed potato and cream , checking the seasoning for taste

title: marshmallow brownie bites with chocolate ganache
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Line 48 mini muffin cups with liners
3. Empty mix into a large bowl
4. Add oil , water and eggs
5. Mix with a wooden spoon until moistened
6. Fill liners 2 / 3 full with brownie batter - a small scoop works well
7. Bake for 10 - 15 minutes , checking at 10 minutes and again at 12 minutes
8. Cool in pans on wire rack for 5 minutes
9. Remove from pans to wire rack
10. Cool completely
11. Remove top and inner seal from marshmallow creme
12. Heat in microwave on high for 15 seconds
13. Stir
14. Return to microwave and heat 15 seconds longer or until smooth and easy to spoon out
15. Stir
16. With small spoon , top each brownie cup with marshmallow creme - dividing evenly between cups
17. Allow to cool completely
18. Remove lid and inner seal from tub of frosting
19. Heat in microwave on high for 30 seconds
20. Stir well
21. Frosting should be of pourable consistency
22. If it is not , heat on high in 10 second intervals , stirring after each
23. As with marshmallow , watch closely as it will separate if overheated
24. Spoon frosting ganache evenly over cooled marshmallow creme , covering completely
25. Allow ganache to set up before storing brownie bites
26. Store covered in a cool place

title: cabbage  souflee  pudding
steps:
1. Rinse cabbage , core and shred coarsely like wide noodles
2. Cover with boiling water , add salt and bring to a boil
3. Simmer until tender , about 20-25 minutes
4. Drain well and spread out to cool on a baking sheet
5. Squeeze dry , by handfuls , and place in a large mixing bowl
6. Add apples , raisins , orange juice , lemon juice , apple juice concentrate , and broth and mix gently
7. Sprinkle matzo meal and cinnamon over the cabbage mixture and combine
8. Beat egg whites & cream of tartar in a separate bowl until stiff
9. Fold egg whites into cabbage mixture and turn into a 2-quart rectangular casserole that has been sprayed with non-stick spray
10. Sprinkle lightly with cinnamon & nutmeg and bake 1 hour in a 350 degree f preheated oven

title: mexican beef casserole
steps:
1. Brown meat with garlic , cumin and basil
2. Add rotel , beans , and corn
3. Simmer a few minutes
4. Spread a layer of chips in a casserole dish
5. Layer 1 / 2 meat mixture
6. Cube or slice velvetta over the meat mixture
7. Layer more chips & meat mixture
8. Top with cheddar cheese
9. Bake at 375 until cheese melts and bubbles
10. Serve with sour cream

title: abm italian breadsticks  grissini
steps:
1. Pour the water and olive oil in the bread machine pan , sprinkle over the flour , make sure you cover the water completely
2. Add the salt in corner of the pan , make a small dent in the flour and add the yeast
3. Select the basic dough setting and press start
4. Ligtly oil two or more baking sheets
5. When dough cycle has finished , remove from the machine and knock it back on a lightly floured surface
6. Roll out into a rectangle of approx 9x8 inch
7. Cut into three 8 inch long strips , cut the strips widthways into ten
8. Roll and stretch each piece to 12 inch approx if you like them crispy , make them shorter / thicker if you like more bread structure
9. If using the poppy seeds or salt , scatter some on the work area and roll them into the dough , this is best done halfway through the rolling process , later on they do not want to stick
10. Be careful with the salt , its quickly too much
11. Space apart on the baking sheets , brush lightly with some olive oil , cover with clear film and leave in a warm place for 10 to 15 minutes
12. Preheat oven to 400f
13. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown , turning once
14. Transfer to a wire rack to cool

title: easy lower sugar banana flax bread
steps:
1. Grease a loaf pan with a margarine butter substitute blend
2. Preheat oven to 350
3. Combine all ingredients in bowl , and stir well to combine
4. Pour into loaf pan , bake 55 minutes , or until toothpick inserted comes out clean

title: nutty creamsicle pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In food processor , chop the pecans until very fine
3. Transfer to a 9 inch pie plate
4. Stir the sugar into the pecans and add the melted butter
5. Mix until the pecans are completely moistened
6. Press the nuts evenly into the pan with your fingers to create even crust
7. Bake until crust is golden , 6 to 8 minutes
8. Set aside to cool
9. For the filling , mix the cream cheese together with the orange juice until smooth
10. Open the gelatin packet , add 1 / 2 teaspoon to the cream cheese mixture and stir vigorously until well mixed
11. Pour the mixture into the chilled crust and spread evenly
12. Pour the heavy cream and remaining gelatin into a clean bowl
13. With an electric mixer , beat the cream mixture until soft peaks form
14. Pour the cream over the cream cheese filling and spread it over the top
15. Sprinkle orange zest over the pie and refrigerate at lease 2 hours

title: thai inspired pork kabobs
steps:
1. If hot chili oil is not available , combine 2 teaspoons vegetable oil and 1 / 2 teaspoon red pepper flakes in small microwavable cup
2. Microwave at high 30 to 45 seconds
3. Let stand 5 minutes to allow flavor to develop
4. Combine soy sauce , lime juice , water , chili oil , garlic and ginger in medium bowl
5. Reserve 1 / 3 cup mixture for dipping sauce
6. Set aside
7. Cut pork tenderloin lengthwise in half
8. Cut crosswise into 4-inch-thick slices
9. Cut slices into 1 / 2-inch strips
10. Add to bowl with soy sauce mixture
11. Toss to coat
12. Cover
13. Refrigerate at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours , turning once
14. To prevent sticking , spray grid with nonstick cooking spray
15. Prepare grill for direct cooking
16. Remove pork from marinade
17. Discard marinade
18. Alternately weave pork strips and thread bell pepper and onion chunks onto eight 8- to 10-inch metal skewers
19. Grill , covered , over medium-hot coals 6 to 8 minutes or until pork is no longer pink in center , turning halfway through grilling time
20. Serve with rice and reserved dipping sauce

title: holiday french toast
steps:
1. Pour the eggnog into a pie plate
2. Sprinkle with the cinnamon and stir to blend
3. Heat a griddle over medium heat until hot
4. Add about 1 / 2 table
5. Of butter and let it melt
6. Dip one slice of bread into the eggnog mixture and place on the griddle
7. When the first side has browned , flip over and brown the second side
8. Serve with warm maple syrup
9. You can also make up a french toast batter using flavored coffee creamers

title: raspberry  delite
steps:
1. Mix ingredients for crust and press into a cookie sheet bake 375 for 20 minutes or till golden brown
2. For layer 1 mix powdered sugar and cream cheese till smooth and fold in dream whip
3. For layer 2 mix prepared danish dessert w / frozen raspberries while it is still warm
4. Break up crust and press 1 / 2 of it into 9 by 13 pan
5. Spread cream cheese mixture carefully over crust and then spread raspberries over that
6. Sprinkle w / remaining crust and refrigerate till served

title: pumpkin rolls
steps:
1. Beat eggs at hi speed 3 minutes
2. Then stir in sugar , pumpkin and lemon juice
3. Sift dry ingredients and add to pumpkin mixture
4. Spread into greased and floured waxed paper lined 15x10x1" pan
5. Bake 15 min at 375 deg
6. Sprinkle kitchen towel with powdered sugar
7. Invert
8. Roll roll and towell together tight while still warm
9. Leave to cool
10. Beat filling ingredients until smooth
11. Spread and roll up , then chill

title: nougat glace
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 230 c or 450 f and line a terrine dish with wax paper
2. It's also a good idea at this point to make sure there is room in the freezer for your dish
3. Warm the hazelnuts in the oven for 3-4 minutes or until golden brown
4. Skin and roughly chop
5. Heat one third of the sugar in a heavy pan , until it starts to carmelise
6. Stir in the warm hazelnuts and pour onto an oiled tray
7. Leave to cool and set
8. When cool , crush into small pieces using a rolling pin
9. Meanwhile , whip the egg whites and the rest of the sugar together to make a stiff meringue
10. In a separate bowl , whip the cream to stiff peaks and then fold together with the meringue and crushed hazelnut mixture
11. Fill the terrine dish to the top and place in the freezer until hard-- at least 24 hours
12. To serve , remove from the freezer and from the dish
13. Slice and serve on top of a pool of strawberry or raspberry sauce

title: ww loaded baked potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Bake potatoes for 1 hour or until tender
3. Let cool slightly
4. Cut each potato in half lengthwise
5. Scoop out pulp into a large bowl , leaving a 1 / 4-inch-thick shell
6. Mash pulp with a potato masher
7. Add milk and next 5 ingredients
8. Stir well
9. Spoon potato mixture into shells
10. Place on a baking sheet
11. Bake for 15 minutes or until thorougly heated
12. Sprinkle each potato half with 1 1 / 2 teaspoons green onions
13. Top evenly with crumbled bacon

title: fresh enchilada sauce
steps:
1. Roast whole peppers in 350 degree oven until the scent permeates the room
2. De-seed , de-vein , and slice peppers and place them in a large pot with just enough water to boil
3. Boil peppers covered for 30 minutes
4. Remove peppers from boiling water and wait until they are cool enough to handle
5. Holding on to one end of the slice of pepper , gently rub the pulp side with a fork until only the skin remains
6. Return pepper pulp to water and remove from heat
7. Saute onion and garlic in butter
8. Add flour and chicken stock
9. Stir until mixture begins to thicken
10. Add spices and water / pulp mixture
11. Puree and serve

title: applesauce oatmeal bread
steps:
1. In microwave , heat cider to 110-120
2. In bread machine pan place warmed cider , brown sugar and yeast
3. Allow yeast to bubble for 10 minutes
4. Add applesauce , butter , salt , spice and oats to pan
5. Add flour last
6. Set machine to dough cycle and after it runs through , remove dough and form into a loaf
7. Place in greased loaf pan and turn to coat
8. Cover with plastic and a towel and let rise in a warm place till doubled , about an hour
9. Bake 350 for 25-30 minutes till golden and hollow sounding
10. Cool in pan for 10 minutes and remove

title: vegetable bars
steps:
1. Preheat the over 350f lay out the rolls on a jellyroll pan to make a crust
2. Bake in a preheated oven for 8 to 10 minutes
3. Cool
4. Combine the cream cheese , mayonnaise , and ranch dressing
5. Spread the cream cheese mixture over the crescent crust
6. Chop the veggies into small pieces
7. Press the black olives and your choice of veggies into the cream cheese mixture
8. Top with shredded sharp cheddar cheese
9. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight , cut into bars and serve

title: blueberries and orange muffins
steps:
1. Grease and flour 12 muffin cups , or use paper liners
2. In a large bowl , mix flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda and salt
3. In a measuring cup , with a whisk , mix yogurt , orange juice , oil , orange zest and eggs
4. Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients , pour liquid ingredients and stir until mixture is creamy
5. Sprinkle with blueberries and stir well
6. Spread the dough in the muffin cups
7. Sprinkle with remaining sugar , if wanted
8. Bake in the center of the oven , in a preheated oven of 400 f for about 25 minutes or until muffins are firm when touched and the tops are golden
9. Let cool on a grill for about 5 minutes
10. Remove from muffin tins and cool completely
11. You can put the muffins in an hermetic container
12. They will be good 2 days in room temperature or until 1 month in the freezer

title: coconut cream banana nut bread
steps:
1. Thoroughly grease the bottoms and sides of 2 loaf pans
2. Set aside
3. Combine flour , baking powder , baking soda , cinnamon and salt
4. Set aside
5. Beat butter on high speed for about 30 seconds
6. Add 1 / 2 cup brown sugar , beaten eggs and vanilla
7. Beat until well mixed
8. Add flour mixture and banana alternately to beaten mixture
9. Beating on low after each addition
10. Stir in nuts
11. In a separate bowl , beat cream cheese , 1 / 4 cup brown sugar and the 1 egg until smooth
12. Stir in coconut
13. Pour 1 / 4 of the banana batter into each pan
14. Spoon 1 / 4 of the cream cheese mixture over each loaf
15. Marble each by using a spatula to cut cream cheese into the banana batter
16. Repeat the 2 layers as above but do not marble them
17. Bake in a 350f oven for about 50 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
18. Cool in pans for 10 minutes
19. Remove loaves from pans and cool completely

title: creamy grits
steps:
1. In large pot , heat milk and butter until simmering
2. Add grits , whisking to prevent sticking to pan
3. Season if desired with salt and pepper
4. Add water when grits begin to bubble
5. Cook until consistency of oatmeal
6. Stir in cream cheese and heavy cream until incorporated
7. Otherwise , enjoy as you usually do grits !

title: grilled french bread
steps:
1. In a medium skillet combine margarine or butter , parsley , garlic , and , if desired , red pepper
2. Heat over medium heat until margarine is melted
3. Stir in parmesan cheese
4. Cut french bread in half lengthwise
5. Place bread , cut side down , on an uncovered grill directly over medium coals
6. Grill about 2 minutes or until toasted
7. Turn cut side up
8. Brush with margarine mixture
9. Grill for 1 to 2 minutes more
10. To serve , cut into 2-inch slices

title: mixed berry romanov
steps:
1. Place strawberries and blueberries in a medium bowl
2. Sprinkle with sugar and toss gently
3. Combine orange juice and orange extract
4. Spoon over berries and toss again
5. Let berries sit at room temperature for 1 hour , mixing occasionally
6. Divide berries and juice evenly into four individual serving bowls
7. Top each serving with 1 / 4 cup of yogurt
8. Serve right away

title: warm  gooey  yummy chicken casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine soups , mayo , lime juice , and red curry first , then add the chicken and broccoli
3. Pour mixture evenly into a 9x13-inch glass pan , top with entire bag of cheese and bread crumbs soaked in the melted butter
4. Bake for one hour in the oven at 350f yum !

title: surf   turf kabobs
steps:
1. Cut the steak into bit size pieces and place in a zip-lock bag or a
2. Nonmetallic dish
3. Peel and devein the shrimp , leaving the tails attached
4. To make the marinade , whisk the oyster sauce , soy sauce , lemon juice and safflower oil in a small bowl until well combined
5. Pour the mixture over the meat , turning to coat and marinate for 15 minutes
6. Add the shrimp to the marinade , toss to coat and marinate for 5 minutes
7. Remove the meat and shrimp from the marinade
8. Thread meat onto metal or presoaked wooden skewers , alternating the steak with the shrimp
9. Broil the kabobs over hot coals for 5-10 minutes turning frequently
10. Transfer to a warm serving plate and serve immediately

title: grilled honey mustard chicken
steps:
1. In a bowl mix mayonnaise , mustard , honey , salt and pepper
2. In a ziplock bag , place chicken and pour honey mustard mixture over chicken , reserving 1 / 2 cup
3. Let marinate at least 2 hours , overnight is even better
4. Remove chicken and discard the marinade
5. Grill chicken about 10 minutes on each side
6. The last few minutes brush with reserved honey mustard

title: old stand by   easier than pie
steps:
1. Mix the yogurt and coolwhip together and pour into pie shell or pie dish
2. Freeze
3. Serve and watch it disappear before your eyes !

title: microwave broccoli and cauliflower with mustard sauce
steps:
1. Combine broccoli and cauliflower in a microwave-safe baking dish
2. Cover
3. Stirring once , microwave on high power for 8 to 12 minutes or until tender
4. Drain
5. In a medium bowl , combine remaining ingredients
6. Stirring after each minute , microwave on high power for 3 to 4 minutes or until sauce is thickened
7. Pour sauce over vegetables

title: mash   onion muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c / 160c fan forced
2. Lightly grease a 6-hole texas muffin tray
3. Place potato , eggs and butter in a mixing bowl
4. Gradually add milk and mix , using a fork to break up lumps , until combined
5. Season with salt and black pepper
6. Stir in onion and dill
7. Stir in flour until just moistened
8. Spoon into prepared tray , filling almost full
9. Bake for 30-35 minutes or until muffins are cooked when tested with a skewer
10. Serve warm

title: copycat pace picante sauce
steps:
1. Bring all ingredients to a boil in saucepan over med-high heat
2. Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes or until thick
3. Remove from heat and cool
4. Store in an airtight jar in refrigerator until serving

title: fresh orange slices with honey and cinnamon
steps:
1. Using small sharp knife , cut off peel and white pith from oranges
2. Thinly slice oranges into rounds
3. Arrange orange slices in shallow bowl
4. Combine honey , cinnamon stick , and orange flower water in heavy small saucepan
5. Stir over low heat until mixture comes to simmer , about 2 minutes
6. Pour hot syrup over oranges
7. Cool
8. Sprinkle almonds over oranges
9. Serve cold or at room temperature , with a dollop of yoghurt or sour cream on the side , if desired
10. A flavoring extract available at liquor stores and in the liquor or specialty foods section of some supermarkets

title: pasta caponati
steps:
1. Heat oil in large saute pan
2. Add celery , green peppers , olivers , capers , garlic and eggplant
3. Saute until tender
4. Add tomatoes , salt , pepper and hot pepper
5. Cook for 15 minutes
6. Toss with cooked pasta and serve
7. Enjoy !

title: breadsticks for dips  bread machine
steps:
1. Put ingredients in the bread maker in the order listed
2. Set to dough setting
3. After the machine has finished , punch down dough and divide into 16 equal pieces
4. Roll each piece into a breadstick shape
5. Place onto a cookie sheet lightly dusted with cornmeal to prevent sticking
6. Let rise for 30-45 minutes - till doubled
7. Bake at 400 degrees for 12-15 minutes - till golden brown

title: gai lan  chinese broccoli   with oyster sauce
steps:
1. Wash the gai lan and trim the ends of stalk and discard the ends
2. Mix the chicken stock , sake , and sugar in a small bowl and set aside
3. In a large wok or pan heat 1 1 / 2 t vegetable oil over medium heat
4. Add the garlic cloves and cook until lightly golden about 1 to 2 minutes
5. Be careful you do not burn the garlic
6. Turn the heat to high and add the ginger and cook for 15 to 20 seconds and add gai lan stalks
7. With a large spoon or spatula scoop up the oil and bathe the gai lan stalks for about 1 minute
8. Pour the chicken stock mixture and immediately cover the wok or the pan with a tight fitting lid
9. Turn down the heat to medium and let gai lan steam for about 3-4 minutes
10. You should be able to easily pierce with the stalks with a fork
11. Remove the gai lan to a plate , leaving any remaining stock mixture in the wok or the pan and add oyster sauce and sesame oil
12. Cook for about 1 minute on medium high and pour the sauce over the cooked gai lan and serve

title: italian beef with a kick
steps:
1. Cut beef into fist size pieces and put into crockpot
2. Add au jus mix , italian seasoning mix , french onion soup mix , beer and onion flavored beef broth to crockpot
3. Stir until all seasonings are well incorporated
4. Cover and cook on high for about 3 hours
5. For very robust flavor , pour the entire jar of pepperocini's with the juice into the crockpot
6. Do not drain , the vinegar in the juice helps tenderize the beef and gives a good flavor
7. For a more mild or less tangy flavor , remove the seeds and stems from the peppers and use half of the vinegar
8. I prefer this taste
9. It will still have lots of flavor , just not quite as spicy
10. Cover and continue to cook on high for 2-3 hours
11. Cut onions into small strips and add to crockpot
12. Cover and cook until meat begins to tenderize and fall apart
13. Remove the beef and tear into small pieces
14. Return beef to crockpot and continue cooking until meat is done and onions are soft which is usually about 2-3 more hours
15. I've tried them all and this is my personal favorite because of the flavor and the bread doesn't get as soggy
16. Sliced provolone cheese is completes the sandwhich

title: agurlce salat or medieval cucumber salad
steps:
1. Place your thin sliced cucumbers on a baking pan in a single layer and sprinkle the salt evenly over all the cucumber slices
2. Place another pan on top of the pan of cucumbers to press out the natural juices of the cucumbers , adding a heavy bowl if needed for weight
3. Press at least 6 hours or over night !
4. In the morning drain the liquid and toss the cucumbers into the marinade
5. Place in a refrigerator and marinade for 2 hours then serve and enjoy !

title: chinese bbq marinade
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a small bowl and mix well
2. Marinate for about 2-3 hours ~ any longer than that will result in a very salty product

title: roasted red bell pepper dip
steps:
1. Line a baking sheet or jelly-roll pan with aluminum foil , using enough foil so that there is extra on the sides
2. Place peppers on the foil
3. Broil 6 to 8 inches below the broiler element
4. Rotate to char on all sides
5. Remove from oven and draw up sides of foil to enclose the peppers
6. Allow to rest 5 minutes
7. Open the foil , and when the peppers are cool enough to handle , remove stem and peel and seed the peppers
8. Place all ingredients into a food processor and process until smooth

title: jello drink
steps:
1. Mix prepared jello and milk in a blender for about 5 seconds
2. Pour in to two glasses and enjoy

title: caramel sauce  for dipping apples
steps:
1. Combine sugar , sweetened condensed milk , and corn syrup and cook until sugar is thoroughly dissolved and cooked
2. Add water and cook until bubbly
3. Add butter and vanilla and cook 5 more minutes
4. Be careful not to burn the sugar

title: spinach and potato soup
steps:
1. Heat the oil
2. Saute the onione till translucent
3. Add the ginger and garlic and saute add the spices and cook over medium heat for 2-3 mins stirring now and then add the spinach , potatoes and coconut and stir till the spinach has wilted
4. Take care not to overcook the spinach
5. Pour in the stock and heat until it boils
6. Lower the heat and simmer for 15 mins till the potatoes are well cooked
7. Take off fire
8. Cool
9. Blend in a mixer until smooth
10. Return to the vessel and re cook
11. Adjust the consistency to what you like
12. Serve in bowls with a swirl of the yoghurt

title: roast mary spice mix
steps:
1. Place all in a food processor or blender and processes till powdery
2. Use within 1 year

title: healthy black bean vegetable soup
steps:
1. Put carrots in pot and cover with water
2. Cover and cook on medium heat until carrots just start turning soft
3. Add onion and red bell pepper
4. Cook , uncovered , on low heat for a couple minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Throw in garlic and spinach
6. Continue stirring occasionally on low heat until spinach is mostly cooked down
7. Add ginger
8. Remove from heat once spinach is cooked
9. Strain vegetable mixture into bowl
10. Reserve juice
11. Place vegetable mixture in microwave to keep warm
12. Place black beans and reserved vegetable juice in pot on stove
13. Cook , covered , on medium heat until black beans are no longer frozen
14. Add turmeric and cumin
15. Stir and simmer briefly
16. Add milk , reduce heat , and stir
17. Mash some of the beans using fork or spoon , if desired
18. Cover and cook 1 minute
19. Return vegetable mixture to bean soup base in pot
20. Cook uncovered 1 minute longer , stirring occasionally
21. Serve
22. Try with hunk of whole wheat bread or some plain nonfat yogurt

title: barbecued corn with roasted garlic butter    bbq
steps:
1. Bring a pot of water to a boil , then simmer corn for 15 minutes
2. Drain , then baste each cob with olive oil
3. Place directly on hot grill for 10 minutes , turning every few minutes
4. Meanwhile , nuke the roasted garlic , salt , worcestershire and butter for about 12 seconds
5. This will enable the ingredients to gravitate to the bottom of your blender instead of clinging to the sides
6. Blend well
7. I use my magic bullet -- love it !
8. Spoon roasted garlic butter over corn and enjoy !

title: wilted dandelion salad with feta cheese
steps:
1. Fry bacon in skillet until crisp , drain on paper towels , crumble
2. Pour off bacon fat leaving behind 1 / 3 cup in the skillet
3. Put vinegar , mustard and honey in the skillet mixing with a whisk
4. Add the olive oil
5. Add salt and pepper , keep this dressing warm
6. Toss the greens with bacon , olives , onions and cheese in a bowl
7. Pour the warm dressing over greens and serve
8. Garnish with flowers
9. Yield: 4-6 servings

title: zucchini molasses raisin bread
steps:
1. Beat eggs in a large mixing bowl at medium speed until foamy
2. Gradually add sugar , beating well
3. Add oil and beat until blended
4. Add the zucchini , molasses and vanilla , strirring well
5. Combine flour and the next 7 ingredients until blended
6. Add flour mixture to zucchini mixture and stir until well combined
7. Add raisins and stir well
8. Pour batter into 2 greased and floured 9x5x3 inch loafpans
9. Bake at 350 for 55 to 60 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
10. Let cool in pans 10 and then remove from pans and cool completely on wire racks
11. Makes 2 loaves

title: carbonada criolla   argentina meat  veg  fruit stew
steps:
1. Heat oil in heavy pot
2. Brown beef in separate batches so that all of it gets cooked
3. Remove from the pot and set aside
4. In that same pot , cook tomatoes , pepper , onion , and garlic until soft
5. Add bay leaves , oregano , and chicken stock , and bring to a boil
6. Return beef to the pot , and add potatoes and sweet potatoes
7. Cover and simmer 15 minutes , or until potatoes are almost soft
8. Stir in zucchini and corn
9. Simmer 10 more minutes , or until vegetables are almost soft , then add the peaches and pears
10. Cook 5 more minutes
11. Serve hot

title: my mother s enchiladas
steps:
1. Prepare filling: over medium heat , saute beef with garlic , salt , vinegar , cognac , and chili powder until meat is brown
2. Add drained kidney beans and set aside
3. Prepare tomato sauce: heat oil and saute garlic and onion
4. Remove from heat
5. Stir in flour until smooth
6. Dissolve bouillon cube in boiling water
7. Add to onion / garlic mixture , then add tomato puree and vinegar
8. Return to heat and bring to a boil
9. Add green chiles , cumin , salt and pepper
10. Simmer , uncovered , about 5 minutes
11. Preheat oven to 350
12. Place 1 / 3 cup of meat filling in tortilla
13. Roll up and place in a 13x9x2 baking dish
14. Pour tomato sauce over all , and sprinkle with cheese
15. Bake for 25 minutes

title: bourbon glazed ham
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
2. Place ham fat side down on rack in shallow roasting pan
3. Bake for 2 hours , without basting , or until meat can be pierced easily with a fork
4. Remove ham from oven and let cool
5. When ham is cool enough to handle , cut away rind with a sharp knife
6. Score ham by cutting deeply through fat until you reach the meat
7. Make incisions about 1 inch apart , crosswise and lengthwise
8. Baste ham on all sides with 1 / 2 cup of bourbon
9. Combine dark brown sugar , dry mustard and 1 / 4 cup of bourbon and pat the mixture into the fat
10. Stud intersections with whole cloves
11. Arrange orange sections attractively
12. Baste ham with pan drippings and bake undisturbed for 15 to 20 minutes , to melt sugar and glaze

title: michaels hard lemonade
steps:
1. Fill a large pitcher with ice
2. Pour in vodka , sugar , lemon zest and juice
3. Stir well to dissolve the sugar
4. Fill the pitcher with water and stir again

title: osso buco with gremolata
steps:
1. In a large flame proof casserole , melt the butter in the oil over moderate heat
2. Dredge the veal in the flour and shake off any excess
3. Working in batches , saute veal on all sides until golden brown
4. Do not crowd the pan
5. Remove to a bowl
6. Add the onions , carrots , celery and garlic
7. Cover and cook until vegetables are tender , about 15 minutes
8. Place the veal on top of the vegetables , making sure the bones are upright
9. Sprinkle the marjoram , basil and thyme on top
10. Add the tomatoes , tomato paste , white wine , chicken stock , strips of lemon zest , bay leaf and parsley sprigs
11. If necessary , add enough water to cover the shanks
12. Bring to a boil , reduce heat to low and simmer , covered , until the meat is tender , about 2 hours
13. Transfer the veal shanks to a heated platter , remove the strings and cover with foil to keep warm
14. Increase the heat to high and boil , stirring frequently until the sauce is reduced by half , about 20 minutes
15. Pour the sauce over the meat
16. Just before serving , combine the parsley , garlic and lemon zest to make the gremolata
17. Sprinkle over the top of the osso buco

title: layered salmon and avocado dip
steps:
1. Using an electric mixer-beat the cream cheese until smooth
2. Stir in the remaining 'salmon layer' ingredients
3. Place the ring moulds onto a plate
4. Spoon the salmon mixture into the bottom of the moulds
5. Use a spoon to smooth the surface over
6. Chill while you make the next layer
7. To make the avocado layer- combine all avocado layer ingredients and season with salt and pepper to taste
8. Layer over the salmon mixture and top with herbs of your choice
9. Chill another 30 minutes or until required
10. Carefully remove rings to serve
11. You can cut them with scissors to make the removal easier
12. Serve with crackers of your choice
13. Enjoy !

title: zucchini couscous
steps:
1. Cut zucchini into 1 / 4-inch dice
2. In a large non-stick skillet cook zucchini in oil with cumin and salt and pepper to taste over moderate heat , stirring until just tender , about 5 minutes
3. Add water and bring to a boil
4. Stir in couscous and remove skillet from heat
5. Let mixture stand , covered , for 5 minutes
6. Fluff couscous with a fork
7. Cover for 5 minutes

title: cheesiest fried chicken empanadas with queso dip
steps:
1. Preheat vegetable oil in a deep-fryer to 350 degrees f
2. In a large bowl using a rubber spatula , combine the chicken , colby and monterey cheese , cream cheese , red pepper , jalapeno , cumin , salt , and pepper
3. Remove 1 pie crust from pie tin onto a lightly floured surface and roll into a 15-inch circle
4. Cut out rounds , using a 3-inch cookie cutter
5. Re-roll dough as needed
6. Repeat procedure with remaining pie crusts , making 12 to 15 circles total
7. Arrange 1 round on a clean , flat surface
8. Using a pastry brush , lightly brush the edges of crust with water
9. Place 1 heaping teaspoon of chicken mixture in the center of the round
10. Fold the dough over the filling , pressing the edges with a fork to seal
11. Repeat with the remaining rounds and chicken mixture
12. Place empanadas in deep-fryer for 3 to 5 minutes or until golden brown
13. Top with queso dip
14. Sauce:
15. In a medium sauce pot , slowly heat cheese over medium / low heat
16. When cheese is fully melted add tomatoes , stirring with spoon until combined well
17. Pour cheese dip into a small casserole dish and serve as a dip for the cheesy empanadas or pour on top for a real cheesy effect

title: authentic  russian ukrainian borscht
steps:
1. To a large pot , add the meat and enough water to fill up the pot to halfway
2. Remove all froth that comes up from the meat
3. Continue to boil on med-high until no more froth comes up
4. Reduce heat to low and add consomme mix , whole onion , dill , beats , cabbage , and tomato sauce
5. Fill with water , cover partially with lid , and let cook for 90min
6. After that hour and a half of cooking , make sure meat is soft - then add the carrots , and squeeze all the juice you can possible juice from the lemons into the soup
7. You can add the rice and / or potatoes at this point , if you like
8. Cook , partially covered , for another 30-45 minutes , until making sure the potatoes and carrots are tender , and the rice is ready
9. The soup is great on day 1 , but tastes much better on days 2-3
10. Enjoy the soup while it's very hot

title: garlic  string   green beans
steps:
1. Bring a saucepan of water to a boil
2. Add the green beans and blanch for 2 minutes
3. Drain
4. Heat the oil on high heat and add the beans when oil is hot
5. Stir fry for 2 minutes
6. Add the garlic powder and thyme
7. Stir for 1 minute
8. Add the parmesan cheese
9. Stir for another minute
10. Your green beans are ready to eat ! enjoy !

title: tangy fish from south india
steps:
1. Marinate the fish in lime juice and salt for 1 / 2 an hour
2. In a pan heat the oil and add the mustard and fenugreek seeds
3. When they sizzle add the rest of the ingredients except the tamarind and fish
4. Stir in the fish slices and cook on high heat till the fish is half done
5. Extract the pulp from the tamarind , and add the strained pulp to the pan
6. Simmer on low till the fish cooks and all the liquid is absorbed
7. Serve hot

title: tequila and lime sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Cut the potatoes into 3 / 4" thick slices
2. In a large saucepan , bring the water to a boil and then add the potatoes -- when they begin to re-boil , allow them to go for 6 minutes , uncovered , and then drain them with a colander
3. Mix the lime juice , honey and tequila together in a small bowl
4. Set up a large baking sheet on which there is a metal grill-type rack
5. Lay the potatoes out on the rack and brush them with the lime-honey-tequila sauce
6. Broil the potatoes until they brown on one side , flip them and when they brown on the second side , they're done

title: chocolate candy macaroon cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Combine flaked coconut , sweetened condensed milk , almond extract , and salt in a large mixing bowl
3. Gently fold beaten egg whites into the coconut mixture until well incorportated
4. Using your palms , surround each m&m candy piece firmly with coconut mixture
5. Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper
6. Alternatively , you can use greased mini muffin pans , or regular sized muffin pans for larger candy pieces
7. Simply fill 2 / 3 of the way with coconut , then push candy piece down into the center , but not all the way to the bottom
8. Cover with a bit more coconut mixture
9. Also , you could use an 8x8 pan , half coconut mixture , then candy pieces , then remaining coconut mixture
10. Bake , cool , and cut into bars
11. Bake for 12-14 minutes or until edges are very lightly browned

title: spinach parmesan meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In a big bowl , combine all the ingredients
3. Mix well
4. Transfer mixture to a lightly sprayed 9 x 5 inch loaf pan
5. Gently pat down
6. Bake about 1 hour , until the loaf is firm and the top is lightly browned
7. Let stand in pan for 5-10 minutes before serving
8. Remove loaf from the pan
9. Slice to serve
10. Garnish with black olives , if desired

title: cinnamon drop doughnuts
steps:
1. In an electric fry pan or heavy skillet , heat approximately1 inch of fat or oil to 375
2. Combine pancake mix , 2 tablespoons sugar , water and egg
3. Stir just until pancake mix is moistened
4. Drop from a teaspoon into hot fat
5. Brown on both sides , then drain on paper towels
6. Blend sugar and cinnamon together inplastic or paper bag
7. Add a few doughnuts at a time
8. Shake to coat
9. Serve warm

title: lemon rosemary cookies
steps:
1. In large bowl , beat butter , 1 / 2 cup sugar , 1 tablespoon lemon zest , the rosemary and egg with electric mixer on medium speed , or mix with spoon
2. Stir in flour , baking soda and salt
3. Divide dough in half
4. Shape each half into 9-inch roll , 3 / 4 to 1 inch in diameter
5. Wrap and refrigerate about 2 hours or until firm
6. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
7. Mix 3 tablespoons sugar and 1 teaspoon lemon zest
8. Roll dough in sugar mixture to coat
9. Cut rolls into 1 / 4-inch slices
10. Place about 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet
11. Bake 5 to 8 minutes or until edges are light brown
12. Immediately remove from cookie sheet to wire rack
13. Cool completely

title: spinach and sun dried tomato bechamel lasagna
steps:
1. Grease a 13 x 9-inch lasagna pan
2. Make the cream sauce in advance as 1-1 / 2 cups will need to be slightly cooled before adding into the ricotta cheese filling mixture
3. For the bechamel sauce
4. Melt the butter in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat
5. Add in the flour
6. Stir for 1 minute
7. Slowly add in the cream and milk , then cook over medium heat whisking constantly until bubbly and thickened
8. Remove 1-1 / 2 cups of the sauce and refrigerate until slightly cooled
9. To the remaining sauce mix in 1 / 3 to 1 / 2 cup parmesan cheese and season with salt and black pepper to taste
10. Set aside to spread on top of the lasagna
11. In a bowl combine the cheese filling ingredients until well combined
12. Mix in the cooled 1-1 / 2 cups bechamel sauce to the cheese mixture
13. Reserve the remaining cheese sauce to spread on top of the lasagna noodles before baking
14. To assemble
15. Place 4 noodles into the bottom of the greased baking dish
16. Spread half of the cheese filling over the noodles , then sprinkle 1-1 / 2 cups of shredded mozzarella over cheese filling , then 1 / 2 cup grated parmesan cheese
17. Repeat with 4 noodles , remaining half of ricotta mixture , 1-1 / 2 cups mozzarella cheese , then 1 / 2 cup parmesan cheese
18. Top with remaining 4 noodles
19. Spread the remaining reserved bechamel sauce over the top of the noodles
20. Set the baking dish onto a baking sheet then cover with foil
21. Bake uncovered in a preheated 350 degree f oven for 30 minutes
22. Remove from oven then sprinkle 1 cup grated mozzarella cheese over the top then continue to bake for another 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly
23. Allow to sit for at least 30 minutes or more before slicing

title: creamy iced tomato soup
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a blender except sour cream
2. Puree until smooth
3. Refrigerate until cold
4. Just before serving , stir in sour cream
5. Serving suggestions: to keep the soup cold while serving , place a smaller bowl inside a large bowl and add ice to the larger bowl
6. Place the cold soup in the smaller bowl
7. Serve the soup in small bowls or single serving "shot glasses"

title: carrot  pecan and liqueur dessert
steps:
1. Boil the carrots in a little water until soft , then drain very well in a sieve or colander
2. While carrots boil set oven at 375 deg f or 190 deg c
3. , and grease a 9" pie dish or some similar oven dish
4. Whisk together well: eggs , brown sugar , salt , cinnamon , milk , cream , kahlua and vanilla
5. Mix very well , or do this step in a blender or processor
6. When carrots are soft and have been drained , simply crush them with a fork -- don't make a pure but don't leave large pieces in the mash: just evenly break them up
7. Add the milk-egg mixture to the mashed carrots , then fold in the pecans
8. Ladle or pour the dessert mixture into the greased oven dish
9. Bake for about 40 - 45 minutes , until set
10. Cool pie until lukewarm
11. Put the ingredients for the topping in a bowl , and beat with an electric mixer until the cream holds soft peaks
12. Grate the zest from a lemon and keep
13. Each serving needs about 1 / 2 teaspoon or more , as it adds to the flavour of the dessert -- if your lemon does not yield enough zest , use a second one as well
14. If you used a pie plate for the dessert you should be able to cut neat wedges when serving , otherwise divide dessert into squares to serve
15. Top each serving with a spoonful of cream , and the lemon zest as suggested in the step above

title: creamy peas and pasta
steps:
1. In saucepan combine water , chicken bouillon , celery , carrot , onion , parsley , salt , pepper , dill weed and butter
2. Cover and simmer until veggies are tender
3. Add 1- cups of milk and heat until hot
4. Blend flour with cup milk stirring till smooth , then stir into saucepan
5. Cook , stirring constantly until smooth and bubbly
6. Stir in peas and pasta

title: yardena s pickle chips
steps:
1. Slice the cucumbers into thin slices
2. Slice the onions into thin slices
3. Place alternate layers of onion and cucumber in a colander with salt between each layer
4. Let sit 3 hours- rinse , drain and squeeze dry
5. In a large pot mix the sugar , vinegar , turmeric , whole cloves , allspice berries , cinnamon and mustard seeds
6. Bring to a boil
7. Reduce the heat , add the cukes and onions and mix very well
8. Simmer for 3 minutes
9. Don't drain
10. Pour the mixture into a large jar and refrigerate
11. It's ready the next day and keeps for weeks

title: chocolate heaven cake   sugar free
steps:
1. Preheat oven 350f grease a 8" springform pan
2. Separate eggs and bring
3. To room temperature
4. Melt chocolate and butter in microwave or on top of double boiler
5. Beat egg whites til stiff
6. In separate bowl beat yolks , splenda ,
7. And vanilla
8. Add chocolate mixture , then almond flour
9. Gently fold into egg whites
10. Pour into pan and bake 20 - 25 minutes
11. [center will spring back when touched] cool 10 minute and remove ring
12. To make sauce melt chocolate
13. , stir in cream , vanilla and splenda
14. Slice cake and pour sauce on top
15. Keep refrigerated

title: ground beef and spinach pasta bake
steps:
1. Saute the onion in a deep frying pan for 1-2 minutes , then add the ground beef
2. Cook until beef is browned , then add the tomatoes , spices , salt and pepper to taste
3. Simmer for 3-4 minutes , then add the spinach and simmer 3-4 minutes more
4. Adjust seasonings to taste
5. Meanwhile , boil and drain the pasta according to directions on the package
6. Combine the two and place in a baking tray
7. Sprinkle the cheese over the top and bake in a hot oven until melted and the dish is pipping hot , about 5 minutes
8. Serve with a salad and garlic bread

title: mock  jambalaya with chicken
steps:
1. Place chicken in a large bowl , sprinkle with sage and salt and pepper , rub over all
2. Heat oil in nonstick large frypan
3. Add chicken and brown on all sides , about 10 minutes
4. Add one half of the chicken broth , bring to simmer , cover , reduce heat and simmer for about 30 minutes , 'til meat starts to fall off the bone
5. Without removing chicken from pan , scrape meat off bone
6. Discard bones
7. Add onion slices , mix and add the other half of the chicken broth and the can of tomatoes
8. Add cajun seasoning if using
9. Add the rice and stir to mix
10. Cover and simmer lightly for about 45 minutes until rice is tender
11. Line 4 plates with lettuce , decorate one side with sliced mushrooms and cherry tomatoes
12. Grind sea salt and fresh pepper over mushrooms and cherry tomatoes
13. Spoon hot chicken jambalaya mixture on top of lettuce on the other side

title: macaroni and pesto with tofu
steps:
1. For best results , drain tofu by wrapping in paper towels and placing under heavy object for at least 30 minutes
2. For extra flavor , marinate for 30 minutes in italian dressing
3. Boil pasta for 7 minutes or until al dente
4. Meanwhile , saut tofu in olive oil for about 5 minutes or until brown
5. You can add a little chopped garlic and / or onion while sauting for extra flavor
6. Drain pasta
7. Toss with pesto and tofu
8. Serve with cheese , if desired
9. For vegan use the vegan cheese option

title: thai pandan chicken
steps:
1. Cut chicken meat into 7cm x 2
2. 5cm thick slices
3. Combine ground ingredients with the seasoning ingredients and marinate the chicken pieces with it
4. Leave to stand for two to three hours
5. Add coconut milk and mix well to blend
6. Wrap two pieces of chicken with a pandan leaf
7. Secure with a toothpick
8. Deep-fry pandan-wrapped chicken in hot oil until chicken is cooked through
9. Serve immediately

title: winter squash  chickpea   red lentil stew
steps:
1. Soak chickpeas in enough cold water to cover them by 2 inches for 6 hours or overnight
2. Drain when ready to use
3. If you like a very soft chickpea , use the quick method and let the chickpeas boil for five minutes in order to speed up the cooking process
4. Chef's
5. Combine the soaked chickpeas , squash , carrots , onion , lentils , broth , tomato paste , ginger , cinnamon , cumin , salt , saffron and pepper in a 6-quart slow cooker
6. Put on the lid and cook on low until the chickpeas are tender and the lentils have begun to break down , about 5 1 / 2 to 6 1 / 2 hours
7. Chef's
8. Reserve the rest of your lime to add after reheating the leftover stew
9. Stir in lime juice
10. Season with salt to taste
11. Serve over rice sprinkled with peanuts and cilantro
12. Place additional lime wedges on the side for diners to add as they wish

title: pesto artichoke stuffing w tomatoes and pine nuts
steps:
1. In 2 quart saucepan , bring to a boil the undrained tomatoes , butter , pesto , artichoke hearts and water
2. Stir in stuffing mix and pine nuts
3. Cover , turn off heat , and let stand 5 minutes
4. Fluff with a fork
5. For moister stuffing , add 1-2 tbl
6. More water

title: apple nut loaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine carrots , applesauce , oil and vanilla
3. Add eggs and sugar and mix together
4. In another bowl , mix the rest of the dry ingredients
5. Stir dry ingredients into applesauce mixture until blended
6. Do not over mix
7. Divide mixture into 2 loaf pans
8. Bake for 55 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
9. Remove from the oven and allow to cool before removing from bake ware

title: raisin  date and fig filling  use with 1 2 3 4 bar recipe
steps:
1. Cook over low heat , stirring constantly , until thickened
2. Cool

title: cajun tuna salad
steps:
1. Combine eggs and dill relish
2. Add the rest of the ingredients , except tuna , and mix well
3. Then add tuna
4. If mixture is dry , add more miracle whip / mayo

title: motanjen khoreshe
steps:
1. In a bowl combine the lamb , onion , salt and pepper
2. Form small meatballs with your hands and saut in 2 tbs oil in a skillet over medium-high heat until nicely browned on all sides
3. Add the broth and split peas and bring to a boil
4. Lower the heat to low , cover and simmer 40 minutes
5. Meanwhile , heat 2 t oil in smaller skillet and saut the nuts and fruits until lightly browned
6. After meatballs have simmered 40 minutes , add the nuts and fruits to the meatballs and simmer , uncovered , 40 minutes more
7. Transfer to a serving dish and serve with rice

title: delicious and simple baked salmon with  fancy  sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In an 8x8 glass baking dish add all ingredients to make the "sauce"
3. With a wire whisk , combine all ingredients
4. Place salmon in the glass dish , nicely coating both sides with the sauce before positioning for baking
5. Bake for 18-20 minutes , depending on thickness of salmon
6. Remove from oven and serve
7. Hope you enjoy this one !

title: lebanese cabbage salad
steps:
1. Cut the cabbage in half
2. Cut away the hard core and slice the cabbage crosswise into 1 / 2-inch strips , then crosswise into 3 / 4-inch pieces
3. There should be 4 cups
4. If there is extra , set it aside to add to soup or another salad
5. Place the cabbage in a mixing bowl
6. Add the tomatoes , parsley and scallions , and toss with a fork to combine
7. In a small bowl , whisk the lemon juice , garlic and salt until the salt dissolves
8. Mix in the oil
9. Season the dressing to taste with pepper
10. Pour the dressing over the salad , toss for 1 minute to coat it well , then let sit 10 minutes for flavors to meld
11. Serve immediately

title: spinach   pear salad with dijon mustard vinaigrette
steps:
1. In a small bowl , whisk together the water , orange juice , olive oil , honey , dijon mustard , and black pepper
