2. In large bowl , add the pear slices and 2 tablespoons of the vinaigrette and toss to coat
3. Add remaining dressing , spinach and onion and toss to coat

title: taco casserole for the crock pot
steps:
1. Spray inside of 3 1 / 2 or 4-quart slow cooker with nonstick cooking spray
2. In large skillet , brown ground beef with onion and garlic over medium-high heat for 8 to 10 minutes or until thoroughly cooked , stirring frequently
3. Drain well
4. Stir in taco seasoning mix , salt and pepper
5. Place 3 tortillas in bottom of crock pot
6. Top with beef mixture , broth , tomato sauce and enchilada sauce
7. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 cup of the cheese
8. Layer 3 more tortillas
9. Top with beans , corn , green chiles , half of the olives and 1 / 2 cup cheese
10. Top with remaining 3 tortillas
11. Sprinkle with remaining 1 / 2 cup cheese and olives
12. Cook on high setting for 2 1 / 2 to 3 hours or on low setting for 6 to 7 hours
13. Uncover crock pot for last 30 minutes of cooking time
14. Top individual servings with sour cream

title: heath bar ice cream pie with hot fudge sauce
steps:
1. Mix together the chocolate crumbs and the butter and pat onto the bottom of a 13x9x2 inch pan
2. Place in freezer to firm up while preparing filling
3. Remove heath bars from refrigerator and crush into smallish pieces
4. Soften ice cream and mix with the crushed candy bars
5. Carefully spread the ice cream over the crumb crust , cover with foil and freeze overnight
6. Sauce: in a double boiler , melt chocolate chips and butter , stirring often
7. Add sugar and evaporated milk and cook until thickened , stirring , about 8 minutes
8. Remove from heat and add vanilla
9. Serve warm over squares of ice cream pie
10. Sauce can be made ahead
11. Refrigerate until needed and slowly warm again to serve

title: cheese on the cob
steps:
1. Prepare grill
2. Mix cheese , chili powder , salt and pepper together and spread out on flat plate
3. Brush a thin layer of mayonnaise on cleaned and dry corn
4. Roll in cheese mixture until coated
5. Wrap in layer of aluminum foil and place on grill for 10 minutes , turning occasionally

title: poached pears with grand marnier custard sauce
steps:
1. Make grand marnier custard sauce
2. For pears: squeeze juice from 1 of the lemons
3. Measure and reserve 3 tblsps of the juice
4. Add remaining juice to large bowl of cold water
5. Using corer or small , thin-bladed knife , core one pear , leaving stem intact , through the blossom end
6. Pare and place in acidulated water
7. Repeat with remaining pears
8. Mix 3 cups water and sugar in saucepan large enough to hold all the pears
9. Heat , stirring frequently , over medium heat until sugar dissolves and liquid begins to boil
10. Stir in reserved lemon juice
11. Drain pears and place in simmering syrup
12. Cook uncovered , turning carefully occasionally , over medium heat until tender , 35-45 minutes
13. Remove from heat
14. Cut 4 very thin slices from remaining lemon half
15. Add vanilla and lemon slices to poaching liquid
16. Cool to room temperature
17. Refrigerate , covered , until cold
18. Remove pears with slotted spoon to individual dessert plates
19. Spoon custard sauce over pears
20. Garnish with orange zest

title: easy smashed potatoes with roasted garlic and corn
steps:
1. Place frozen potatoes in a microwaveable safe bowl with the milk
2. Cover
3. Cook on high in microwave for 12 minutes , stirring half-way through
4. When potatoes are done , whip with wire whip or electric beater
5. Add the butter , sour cream , garlic , and salt& pepper to taste
6. Fold in the corn
7. Place in casserole dish which has been greased with vegetable oil spray
8. Sprinkle the cheese on top
9. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes or until heated through

title: cecily s amish asparagus in a bacon cheese sauce
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a saucepan and then add flour stir and cook until smooth and bubbly
2. Carefully whisk in milk
3. Cook , whisking constantly until sauce is thickened
4. Stir in salt and cheese until cheese is melted
5. Then a couple spoonfuls of bacon drippings
6. Cook asparagus in salted wateruntil crisp tender , 3-4 minutes
7. Drain and add cheese sauce
8. Top with bacon

title: breakfast pick me up juice
steps: 1. Juice together all ingredients and serve !

title: grilled honey garlic pork chops
steps:
1. Combine all but chops in a baking dish
2. Add chops to marinade , cover and refrigerate overnight , turining once to "marry" the flavors
3. Remove chops from marinade and grill for about 10 minutes per side or until done
4. Discard excess marinade

title: oil free oven fried rice
steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together in a casserole dish and bake at 350f for 1 1 / 2 hours , stirring frequently

title: parmesan crusted chicken in cream sauce
steps:
1. Cook rice as directed on package , using 1 cup of the both and 1 / 2 cup water
2. Meanwhile , mix cracker crumbs and parmesan cheese on plate
3. Rinse chicken with cold water
4. Shake off excess
5. Dip chicken in cracker mixture , turning to coat
6. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet on medium heat
7. Add chicken
8. Cook 5 to 6 minutes on each side or until chicken is golden brown and cooked through
9. Place chicken on serving plate
10. Set aside
11. Keep warm
12. Add remaining 1 / 4 cup broth , 1 / 4 cup water and the cream cheese spread to same skillet
13. Cook on medium heat until mixture just comes to a boil , stirring constantly
14. Simmer 3 minutes or until sauce thickens
15. Spoon sauce over chicken
16. Serve with rice and aspargus

title: smoked sausage and three bean stew
steps:
1. Cut sausage down the middle lengthwise
2. Then cut across in about one-half to one inch sections
3. Heat oil in pan , add sausage and brown
4. Open all the cans
5. Add entire contents of all the cans
6. Salt and pepper to taste
7. Lightly simmer until heated through
8. This is great reheated and can be frozen
9. Recipe can easily be doubled or tripled
10. Good with crunchy cornbread
11. This is a one-pan recipe
12. Easy clean-up !

title: hawaiian pineapple cobbler
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease a 9-inch square baking pan
3. In a large mixing bowl , mix the biscuit mix , sugar , and zest together
4. Add in the pineapple chunkcs
5. Mix together
6. Spoon mixture into prepared pan
7. To make the topping: in a bowl , mix the biscuit mix , sugar , and egg together
8. Sprinkle over fruit
9. Drizzle with melted butter
10. Bake for 40-45 minutes or until the topping is browned
11. Serve warm and at room temperature

title: vanilla souffle
steps:
1. Butter and sugar eight 6-ounce souffl dishes , including the rim of each dish
2. In a medium saucepan over high heat , combine milk and vanilla bean with scrapings
3. Bring to a boil , and remove from heat
4. Cover , and let steep for 1 hour
5. Remove bean from milk , and reserve for another use
6. In a medium bowl , combine flour , 1 / 3 cup granulated sugar , and salt
7. Add 1 / 2 cup steeped milk , whisking to combine and form a paste
8. Transfer paste to saucepan with milk , and cook over medium heat while whisking constantly until thickened and smooth , about 5 to 8 minutes
9. If the mixture begins to get lumpy , remove from heat , and whisk until smooth
10. Remove saucepan from heat
11. Prepare an ice-water bath: fill a large bowl with cold water and ice
12. Add egg yolks and vanilla extract to milk mixture , and whisk to combine
13. Transfer souffl base mixture to a shallow 1-quart container
14. Cover surface directly with plastic wrap to prevent a skin from forming
15. Set saucepan in the ice-water bath to cool completely
16. Refrigerate until ready to use
17. Remove souffl base from refrigerator , and bring to room temperature , about 1 hour
18. Preheat the oven to 375 with rack in center
19. In the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the whisk attachment , whip 5 egg whites on low speed with cream of tartar until foamy
20. Gradually add remaining 1 / 4 cup sugar while slowly increasing the speed of the mixer until it is on high
21. Whip until egg whites are stiff and shiny
22. Gently fold egg whites into the souffl base in three additions
23. Divide between prepared dishes , gently tap on each dish on the work surface , and place on a baking sheet
24. Transfer to oven , and bake until dark golden and the sides appear spongelike , 16 to 20 minutes
25. Remove from oven , and dust with confectioners sugar
26. Serve immediately with vanilla bean ice cream

title: rustic greek farmer s salad
steps:
1. Cut the tomatoes and cucumber into bite-sized pieces
2. Place into bowl and add , spring onion , capers and olives
3. Add the olive oil , vinegar and season with salt , freshly ground black pepper and oregano to taste
4. Set aside and let flavours fuse for about ten to fifteen minutes , carefully stirring once or twice
5. Add the feta and stir once more
6. If you want you can sprinkle the salad with freshly chopped basil leaves
7. Serve immidiatly
8. Kali orexi !

title: bejeweled chicken and saffron rice
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Rinse and drain the rice
3. Place two cups warm water in a large saucepan
4. Pulverize the saffron and let it steep in the warm water for ten minutes
5. Add 1 / 2 teaspoon kosher salt and rice
6. Bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat to low
8. Cover and simmer for twenty minutes
9. While the rice is cooking , melt the coconut oil over medium high heat in a large skillet
10. Cook the chicken breast until no longer pink
11. Remove chicken from skillet and place in a lightly greased covered casserole
12. Place the casserole in the oven
13. In the hot skillet , saute the carrots until crisp tender
14. Add the garlic , pimentos , and sliced olives
15. Add chicken stock , orange juice , zest sugar , salt , and all other spices
16. Bring to a boil
17. Stir corn starch in 1 / 8 cup cold water
18. Add cornstarch to skillet and reduce heat until the sauce thickens
19. Adjust seasonings if needed
20. Pour sauce over the chicken
21. Serve with saffron rice

title: out of this world skinny cinnamon rolls
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Have a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper
3. Keep the tube of crescent rolls in fridge until ready to use and you have all your ingredients ready to go
4. In a small bowl combine the sugar and cinnamon
5. Set aside
6. Melt the butter in microwave safe bowl and set aside
7. Now , take the tube out of fridge and roll out on a cutting board
8. You want to flatten the dough out with your hands to make a rectangle
9. You don't need to use a rolling pin but you can use one if you want to make the same thickness throughout
10. Spread the butter with a pastry brush over the entire dough
11. Save a little butter for when you have rolled up this up after the filling is inches
12. Sprinkle the sugar / cinnamon mixture over the butter
13. Save a little for when it's rolled up
14. Starting with the shorter end , roll the dough up into a log
15. Brush the remaining butter over the outside of the log and sprinkle the remaining sugar mixture over the butter
16. With a sharp knife cut the roll into 8 slices
17. To do this , start by cutting the roll in half then half again until you have 8 slices
18. Place the slices on the baking sheet
19. You will probably still have extra cinnamon sugar mixture so sprinkle that over the cut slices
20. Bake for about 10-12 minutes
21. Turn the pan around after 5 minutes and check after 10 minutes
22. They should look puffed , light brown and the bottoms will look light to medium brown as well
23. Remove from the oven and place on a cooling rack
24. To make glaze: in a small bowl blend the powdered sugar with the milk and mix up until you have a glaze consistency
25. If you have a mini whisk this makes for easier mixing
26. You can use a spoon or small fork as well
27. When the rolls are slightly cooled , drizzle the glaze over each roll
28. Enjoy these yummy treats !

title: woodstock  cocktail
steps:
1. Shake all ingredients with ice
2. Strain into chilled martini glass

title: rhubarb strawberry ice
steps:
1. If using frozen rhubarb , thaw slightly
2. In medium saucepan combine rhubarb , 1 / 2 cup of the cranberry juice and sugar
3. Bring to boiling , reduce heat , cover and simmer for 5-8 minutes or until sugar is dissolved and rhubarb is tender
4. Remove from heat and stir in remaining cranberry juice and strawberries
5. Cool
6. Place half mixture in blender process until smooth
7. Transfer mixture to 9x9x2 inch nonmetal freezer-proof container
8. Repeat with remaining rhubarb mixture
9. Cover and freeze for 4-5 hours or until nearly firm
10. Break frozen mixture into small chunks and place in chilled large bowl
11. Beat with electric mixer on low to medium speed until smooth but not melted
12. Return mixture to container
13. Cover and freeze for at least 6 hours or until firm
14. To serve , scrape frozen mixture with small ice cream scoop
15. Scoop ice into dessert dishes
16. If desired , pour a little champagne or ginger ale around the fruit ice

title: not so fried  refried beans
steps:
1. In a medium sauce pan , add beans and pour in enough water to cover turn to high and bring to a boil turn to low , cover and simmer for about 1 hour add more water to cover and continue to repeat these 2 steps until until the beans are very soft drain beans and add them to a food prosesser or blender add about 1 / 4 cup chicken broth and blend until smooth in a large saute' pan , add 1 tablespoon olive oil over medium high heat and saute the onions until brown
2. Add garlic and stir remove from the heat and add the beans , chili powder , salt , chicken boulion , and hot sauce stir together and add more chicken broth to get it to the texture you like
3. Serving suggestions: corn chips , burritos , tacos , fish , or chicken

title: tapas  bacon wrapped dates and sweet red bell pepper sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Soak round toothpicks in water for 15 minutes , this will prevent burning when baking
3. Red pepper sauce:
4. Place garlic cloves w / peels on a baking dish and bake for 15 minutes
5. Rub pepper and onion with olive oil
6. After baking the garlic cloves for 15 minutes , add the red bell pepper and onion to the baking sheet and bake for an additional 15 minutes , or until tender and roasted
7. It may take a bit longer
8. Squeeze the roasted garlic out of it's paper into a blender along with the roasted onion and bell pepper
9. Use a blender or small food processor
10. Blend until smooth
11. Slowly add olive oil until blended
12. You may use more or less
13. Add salt
14. Slowly add half and half until creamy while blending
15. Serve immediately or cover and refrigerate until ready to serve
16. Warm in the microwave before serving
17. Bacon wrapped dates:
18. Cut bacon strips in half
19. Microwave the strips for 2 minutes
20. Wrap each date with a 1 / 2 strip of bacon and secure with a toothpick
21. Spray a 4 sided cookie sheet with nonstick spray
22. Place all prepared dates in the cookie sheet
23. This is my preferred method
24. Bake for approximately 15 minutes , turning once
25. Important to turn
26. After turning , continue baking for an additional 10 minutes or until bacon brown and crispy or as desired
27. Baking time may vary
28. Just be sure to watch carefully
29. Serve with sweet red pepper sauce for dipping or puddle the sauce on a plate and place the wrapped dates in the sauce
30. Just warm through in the microwave for about 30 seconds

title: gooey caramel brownies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease bottom and sides of square 9x9 inch pan with shortening
3. Mix sugar , 1 / 2 cup shortening , vanilla and eggs in medium bowl with wooden spoon
4. Stir in flour , cocoa , baking powder and salt
5. Spread batter in pan and bake 20-25 minutes until toothpick inserted in center come out clean
6. Heat camamels and milk in saucepan over low heat , stirring frequently until caramels melt
7. Driszzle over warm brownies and sprinkle with pecans
8. Place chocolate chips and 1 tsp shortening in small microwavable bowl
9. Microwave uncovered on 1 / 2 power 1-2 minutes , stirring halfway through until chocolate is meleted
10. Drizzle chocolate over pecans
11. Leave to cool completely
12. Cut brownies into 4x4 rows

title: carol s brownie drops  chocolate cookies
steps:
1. Melt chocolate and butter over hot water
2. Cool
3. Beat eggs in mixer until foamy , , then add the sugar , two tablespoons at a time
4. Beat in mixer until it thickens , about 5 minutes
5. Blend in chocolate
6. Add flour , baking powder , salt and cinnamon
7. Stir in vanilla and nuts
8. Using a regular cereal spoon , drop the mix balls on to a greased cookie sheet
9. Bake in a pre-heated oven at 350 degrees for 8-10 minutes
10. The cookies should feel "set" when done
11. Cool slightly on sheet before storing / eating

title: garlicky baked chicken marinade
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , mix together the mayonnaise , italian dressing , garlic powder , italian seasoning , and kitchen bouquet
2. Place the chicken in the marinade
3. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 20 minutes
4. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
5. Shake off the marinade from the chicken
6. Discard excess marinade
7. Place the chicken in a baking pan coated with non-stick spray
8. Bake for 15 minutes or until the chicken is fork-tender and no pink remains
9. Sprinkle with parsley before serving
10. Libby's
11. When i make it next i'm going to freeze the chicken in the marinade
12. I think there's enough dressing to keep the mayonnaise from separating too badly but since the marinade is discarded anyway , it shouldn't make much difference

title: beer simmered brats
steps:
1. Prepare grill for direct grilling and preheat to medium
2. Place beer , seasoning , onion and brats in medium pot and bring to gentle boil over medium heat
3. Let brats simmer gently until partially cooked , 6 to 8 minutes
4. Do not let brats boil , or they will burst
5. Drain brats well
6. After removing brats drain and reserve onions also
7. Place brats on grill parallel to grates and grill 5 to 7 minutes per side
8. Internal temperature of brats should be about 170 degrees when serving
9. Serve on buns with reserved onions and mustard

title: mexican white rice  arroz blanco
steps:
1. Bring about 6 cups water to a boil and pour over rice in a bowl
2. Soak rice until it has turned a more opaque white , 2 to 3 minutes
3. Drain well and spread out on a kitchen towel to dry , at least one hour
4. Cook onion and garlic in oil in a wide 4-5 quart heavy pot or deep skillet over med
5. Heat , stirring , until softened , about 3 minutes
6. Add rice and cook over med-high heat , stirring , until pale golden , about 5 minute add broth , water , and 2 teaspoons salt and bring to a boil
7. Cover tightly and cook over low heat until rice is tender , 18-20 minutes
8. Let stand covered 5 min
9. , then fluff with fork and serve

title: grilled shrimp with garlic butter dipping sauce
steps:
1. Combine marinade ingredients- cover and chill for 2 hours
2. Combine butter sauce in small saucepan over low heat until melted and well combined- can also be done in the microwave
3. Remove shrimp from marinade and grill until no longer pink and they turn an opaque color
4. For large shrimp this usually takes about 12-15 minutes
5. Serve with garlic butter sauce for dipping- yum !
6. The servings are approximate- as we have used this both as an appetizer and as a meal
7. Prep time is only good if your shrimp are already peeled / deveined- add additional time if you need to do this yourself

title: fluffy coconut dream pudding
steps:
1. Beat dream whip mix , 1 / 2 cup skim milk and vanilla for 4 minutes
2. Add remaining milk and pudding mix and beat for 2 mores minutes
3. Fold in coconut
4. Put in serving dishes and refrigerate for at least 1 hour

title: pan fried salmon with mango cucumber salsa
steps:
1. To make salsa , first whisk lime juice and honey in medium sized bowl
2. Add mango , cucumber , onion , and jalapeno , and stir until well blended
3. Seal container and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving , to allow the flavors to mix
4. Season with salt to taste
5. To prepare salmon , mix cumin , 1 / 2 tsp salt , and pinch of cayenne pepper in a small bowl
6. Lightly coat both sides of the salmon in olive oil
7. Sprinkle spice mixture on both sides of salmon
8. Heat a small non-stick skillet over medium-high heat
9. Cook the salmon fillets until the outsides are lightly browned
10. Then lower heat and cook until the fillets are pale-pink throughout
11. Season with salt , pepper , cayenne , to taste
12. Transfer fillets to a plate , and top each with 2 tbsp of salsa mixture

title: tuna crunch
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , cover and chill
2. Serve over your favorite lettuce with a good bread roll or crackers

title: johnsonville holiday brat stuffing  bratwurst stuffing
steps:
1. In a large skillet , brown and cook crumbled sausage until no longer pink
2. Drain
3. Remove from skillet
4. Set aside
5. In the same skillet , melt butter ansd saut onion , celery and green pepper until tender
6. In an extra large mixing bowl , combine sausage , vegetable mixture , bread stuffing and seasonings
7. Add eggs and broth
8. Toss gently
9. Salt and pepper to taste
10. Spoon into a buttered 3 to 4 quart baking dish
11. Cover with foil and bake at 325 for 60 minutes
12. Uncover and bake 10 minutes longer or until lightly browned
13. Check internal temperature with a meat thermometer , it should read 165f when done

title: vegan rainbow trout
steps:
1. Drain the tofu and place it on a cutting board , drying it off with paper towels and squeezing out extra water very carefully
2. Cut into 8 length-wise chunks , then put them into a tossing bowl
3. Make a marinade out of the other ingredients
4. Layer the marinade over the tofu and toss well to coat
5. Let it sit for 20-30 minutes to absorb the flavors
6. Heat up a frying pan over medium heat , and cook each piece for about 5-6 minutes on each side until nicely browned

title: brownie fudge sauce
steps:
1. In a saucepan bring brownie mix and water to a boil
2. Reduce heat simmer for 1 to 2 minutes
3. Always stirring to prevent burning
4. Will thicken

title: asian spring asparagus
steps:
1. Trim woody ends of asparagus spears
2. Slice asparagus into 3-inch lengths
3. Heat oil in large skillet until a piece of asparagus sizzles
4. Add asparagus , ginger and pepper
5. Stir-fry over medium-high heat for 2 minutes
6. Add soy sauce and stir-fry 2 minutes longer
7. Add almonds and stir-fry briefly just to heat through

title: thanksgiving brussels sprouts
steps:
1. Bring brussels , lemon juice , salt and water to cover sprouts to boil
2. Cover , reduce heat and simmer until tender , 5-7 minute drain and keep them warm ,
3. Melt 2 tbsp butter in the large skilet over medium-high heat , add onion and saute until caramel color
4. Add apple juice and cook for 2 minute
5. Add apple , garlic , sugar
6. Cook stirring constantly for 5-6 min or until apple is tender
7. Add water chestnuts , raisins , lemon rind , pepper , nutmeg , more salt to taste and 2 tbs butter
8. Cook , stirring constantly , for 3-4 minute gently toss in brussels sprouts
9. Enjoy

title: spinach   rice casserole
steps:
1. In large saucepan , cook onion & garlic till tender in oil-do not brown
2. Add undrained tomatoes & oregano & basil
3. Bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat
5. Simmer , uncovered about 3 minute
6. Meanwhile , place tofu in food processor or blender-process until smooth
7. Add to tomato mixture
8. Stir in cooked rice , spinach , half of swiss , salt & pepper
9. Lightly grease an 8x8-inch or 9x9-inch casserole
10. Spoon in mixture & top w / remaining cheese & a tbsp or 2 of sesame seeds
11. Bake , uncovered at 350f for 30-40 minute

title: spicy stove top orange pork tenderloin
steps:
1. Prepare the pork tenderloin by removing the white membrane
2. Heat the frying pan to medium and add the olive oil
3. Mix all of the remaining ingredients together in a small dish
4. Add salt and pepper to the tenderloin
5. When the frying pay is hot , add the tenderloin and brown on each side , approximately 5 minutes each side
6. Remove the tenderloin from the pan
7. Add the sauce to the pan and stir to mix
8. Reduce the heat slightly
9. Return the tenderloin to the pan and cook covered for approximately 15 minutes or until no longer pink inside , turning occasionally
10. You might have to add a bit of white wine to thin the sauce a bit
11. Let the pork rest for approximately 10 minutes
12. Slice the pork horizontally and pour the juices over the meat

title: chicken spinach bake
steps:
1. The evening before making this dish , allow spinach to thaw and drain in the fridge for 12-24 hours
2. After it thaws , press remaining water out and assemble the ingredients
3. In medium saucepan over medium heat combine cream cheese , sour cream , lipton soup and dip mix , and thawed and drained spinach
4. Heat just until these ingredients begin to melt together
5. It doesn't have to be warmed all the way through or blended perfectly
6. Place boneless chicken breasts on bottom of casserole
7. Cube the chicken if you'd like but i prefer to leave them whole
8. Pour cream cheese / spinach / soup mixture over the chicken
9. Place in a 350 oven on center rack
10. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes
11. Remove from oven and turn on broiler
12. Sprinkle the casserole with grated cheddar and return to broiler just until browned
13. For best results , remove from oven and let the casserole rest for at least 10 minutes before serving

title: sweet potato soup  world class
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 deg f
2. Bake sweet potatoes for 45 minutes or until soft
3. Cool potatoes until they can be handled
4. Remove skin from potatoes and place potatoes in a large soup pot
5. Mash to semi-smooth
6. Add remaining ingredients to pot and stir to combine
7. Bring mixture to a boil over med / high heat , then reduce heat to a simmer
8. Simmer covered for 1 hour
9. Stirring occasionally
10. Cashews should be soft
11. If not , simmer for another 15 minutes
12. Serve hot

title: coriander scented baby potatoes
steps:
1. Boil the potatoes until they are nearly fork tender , about 10 to 15 minutes
2. Drain , then cut in half once they are cool enough to touch
3. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat
4. Once the oil begins to shimmer add the cumin and coriander seeds and cook until they begin to sizzle , 30 seconds
5. Add the garlic and cook 30 seconds
6. Stir in the potatoes and let brown a minute or two
7. Stir in the bell peppers , turmeric , cayenne , and salt
8. Cook 2 minutes and stir to distribute the spices
9. Cover the skillet and cook 5 minutes
10. Uncover and remove the pan from the heat
11. Squeeze the lemon juice and toss
12. Garnish with peanuts and cilantro

title: uncle bill s vegetarian lasagna
steps:
1. Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large frying pan
2. Add chopped onion , chopped garlic and saute for 5 minutes , stirring often
3. Add chopped celery , diced green pepper , sliced mushrooms , chopped zucchini , and saute until vegetables are softened
4. About 4 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Add grated carrots an continue to saute until carrots are limp , about 3 minutes
6. Transfer ingredients to a large pot
7. Add mashed tomatoes and liquid , tomato sauce , parsle , oregano , basil bay leaf , white pepper , red hot pepper flakes and allspice
8. Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 1 / 2 hour , stirring occasionallhy
9. Blend in wine and simmer for an additional 15 minutes
10. Adjust spices to taste
11. Thaw spinach , squeeze out liquid and discard , chop spinach small
12. Combine spinach with ricotta cheese , 2 tablespoons of olive oil , padano cheese , and set aside
13. To assemble
14. Preheat oven to 500f
15. Aluminum foil baking pans are provided with
16. Use two - 8" x 8" x 2" aluminum pans and 10 sheets of lasagna
17. Spoon about 1 / 2" layer of the sauce into each 8" x 8" x 2" baking pans and press one lasagna sheet into the sauce
18. Add another 1 / 2" layer of sauce , then layer another lasagna sheet with grooves turned in opposite direction and press into the sauce
19. Add a 1 / 2" layer of the spinach / cheese mixture and press another lasagna sheet with grooves turned in opposite direction , press down firmly
20. Add another 1 / 2" layer of sauce and place another lasagna sheet with groovs in opposite direction and press down firmly
21. Add another 1 / 2" layer of spinach / cheese mixture and press another lasagna sheet down firmly
22. Cover the last lasagna sheet with another 1 / 2" layer of sauce
23. Sprinkle top generously with mozzarella cheese and padano cheese
24. Cover the aluminum baking pan tightly with aluminum foil , being careful not to let the foil touch the lasagna
25. Bake in preheated 500 f oven on the middle rack for 20 minutes
26. Uncover and continue to bake for another 10 minutes or until cheese melts
27. Remove from oven , cover with foil and let rest for about 5 minutes before cutting and serving
28. Cut into 4" x 4" squares for each serving
29. The lasagna is pre-cooked and is used as is
30. You can also use regular lasagna strips and cook as per instructions on package
31. Also , you can use fresh lasagna

title: fast and easy pita pizza in less than 10 minutes
steps:
1. Ok ready ? here's the "hard" part
2. Pre-heat oven to 350 degrees
3. Split open the pita bread to make two flat round halves
4. Spread spaghetti / pizza sauce with a spoon
5. Drop the sauce with the spoon and use the flat back-end of the spoon to spread
6. Spread mozzarella cheese on top
7. Dash of your favorite spices
8. Cook 5-7 minutes , depending on how toasty you want the bread
9. Enjoy !

title: black eyed peas   spinach
steps:
1. In a dutch oven or large stir fry pan / wok over medium heat , saute the onions and garlic in vegetable oil until onions are barely translucent
2. Add the coriander and chili flakes
3. Mix in spinach
4. If using fresh spinach , stir gently until wilted and dark green
5. Crush the tomatoes by hand and add , with liquid , to the rest of the ingredients
6. When dish begins to bubble , reduce heat to simmer for about 30 minutes
7. Serve with rice

title: salt free seasoning
steps: 1. Combine all spices & store in an air-tight container

title: sweet potato wedges with rosemary
steps:
1. Wash and cut sweet potatoes into sticks or wedges
2. Place potatoes in a bowl and toss with oil , then spread out onto a baking sheet and sprinkle with rosemary
3. Bake about 30 minutes at 375&#65533
4. F , or until browned and tender
5. You may want to turn potatoes over half way through baking time
6. Sprinkle with lemon juice , if desired

title: pocket pies
steps:
1. In the bowl of a food processor , combine the flour , baking powder and salt
2. Pulse for a few seconds and then pour into a large mixing bowl
3. Add the shortening and knead it into the flour with your hands until it is crumbly
4. Add the milk all at once and mix in with a spatual until it begins to come together
5. Lightly flour your hands and the countertop and turn the dough out onto the countertop
6. Knead the dough ball , folding over 10 to 20 times
7. Using a rolling pin roll the dough to 1 / 3 to 1 / 2 inch thickness , then cut into rounds using a 2 1 / 4 inch ring
8. Roll each round as thinly as possible or to 5 to 6 inches diameter
9. Spoon 1 to 2 tablespoons of filling onto the dough , brush the edges of half of the dough lightly with the egg wash , fold over being sure to press the air out around the filling and seal the edges together with the tines of a fork , dipping it into flour as needed
10. Gently press down to flatten and evenly distribute the filling and snip or cut 3 slits in the top of the pie
11. Dock pies that are going to be deep fried
12. To pan-fry pies , place a medium saute pan over medium low heat along with 1 to 2 tablespoons vegetable , canola oil or butter
13. Once heated , place 2 to 3 pies at a time into pan and saute until golden on both sides , approximately 3 to 4 minutes per side
14. Allow to cool 4 to 5 minutes before serving
15. To deep-fry pies , heat vegetable oil in a deep fryer or a large heavy pot to 375 degrees
16. Once hot , add 1 to 2 pies at a time and fry until golden brown approximately 3 to 4 minutes
17. To bake pies , preheat the oven to 350 degrees
18. Place finished pies onto an ungreased cookie sheet and bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown
19. Mango filling:
20. Place all of the ingredients into a small saucepan over high heat and bring to a boil
21. Reduce the heat to low , cover and simmer for 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
22. Transfer to a bowl and place in refrigerator to cool completely before using as filling
23. Chocolate filling:
24. Place the sugar , cocoa powder , salt and butter into a large zip-loc bag and squish to combine
25. Cut a hole in the corner of the bag
26. For each pie pipe 1 to 2 tablespoons of mixture onto the center of the dough
27. For a lunch type of pie , use left over stew , or hash instead of the sweet fillings , and cook as desired

title: cambodian grilled corn
steps:
1. Preheat grill to med-high heat
2. Oil if necessary
3. On the stovetop , combine coconut milk , sugar , bay leaves , salt and pepper
4. Simmer uncovered for 5-7 minutes , until sugar is dissolved
5. Carefully peel back the corn husks and remove the silk from each ear of corn
6. Using a long strand of husk , tie back the ends of the husks this creates a handle with which to eat the corn
7. Fold a piece of aluminum foil a few times to create a grill guard
8. Place each piece of corn on the grill
9. The husks should sit on the foil so they dont burn
10. Grill the corn , rotating every 2 minutes to ensure its evenly browned
11. Baste the corn with the coconut milk mixture , rotating every minute or so until each ear has been coated twice
12. Remove corn from the grill , baste one more time and serve with cilantro garnish

title: sweet potato mash with caramelised onions
steps:
1. Peel onions , cut in half and finely slice so you have half moon shaped circles
2. Put into a medium frypan and drizzle with oil and massage the oil in to break up the half rings
3. Cover frypan and cook over a low to moderate heat giving a stir occasionally until a nice golden colour , the longer you take the sweeter the onion will be
4. Put sweet potatoes in a pot of cold water and season with a little salt and bring to the boil and cook till tender
5. When potatoes are cook , drain and give a good shake , put in butter and mash till you get the consistency you like
6. Add your caramelised onions and mix in well and season with salt and pepper to taste

title: creamy  cheater  bolognese
steps:
1. In a large skillet , brown and drain the beef
2. Stir in the marinara sauce , mushrooms , black pepper , cayenne pepper and sugar
3. Mix well
4. Add the cream cheese and stir constantly until it melts into the sauce
5. Taste for seasoning
6. Toss with the cooked pasta and serve immediately

title: ginger infused vodka
steps:
1. Combine the vodka and ginger root in a clean container
2. Seal the container and store in a cool , dark place for 3 days , shaking occasionally
3. After 3 days , pour the vodka through a strainer and discard the ginger solids
4. Return the strained , infused vodka to its original bottle
5. Store infused vodka in the refrigerator or freezer for up to 1 month

title: johnny jalapeno s mexican bacon and cheese hors d oeuvres
steps:
1. Mix all filling ingredients well
2. Spread filling over each tortilla , spreading to the edges
3. Tightly roll up tortillas to form a log
4. Wrap each tortilla securely with plastic wrap and chill for 30 minutes to set
5. Preheat oven to 400f place a sheet of parchment paper onto a baking sheet and set aside
6. Unwrap the rolls from the plastic wrap and trim off ends and discard
7. Slice the rolls into 8 slices
8. Cut bacon slices in half and wrap around each appetizer overlapping just a bit
9. Secure the bacon to the wraps with toothpicks going thru just to the other side
10. If the bacon slice does not go all the way around the roll , place the loose ends facing down onto the parchment paper
11. Bake for 30 minutes , until the bacon is crisp
12. Remove from the oven and arrange on a serving platter

title: tropical coconut and banana shrimp
steps:
1. Drain juice form pineapple can into bowl with shrimp in it and set aside
2. Prepare rice as directed on box and add 1 / 4 cup of coconut to water while cooking
3. Cut banana in half long ways but do not seperate
4. Then slice banana across in 1 / 2 inch thick pieces
5. Add vegetable oil , banana slices and crushed pineapple to frying pan
6. Toss fruit to coat it and cook on low heat
7. Mix constantly until banana begins to break up
8. Transfer shrimp and pineapple juice into clean frying pan and add 1 / 2 cup coconut
9. Begin to cook on medium to high heat for 5 minutes
10. Add banana and pineapple mixture to shrimp and cook until juice is nearly evaporated
11. Serve over rice

title: light and creamy fruit salad
steps:
1. Place marscapone cheese , splenda , strawberry preserves and lemon juice in a food processor and pulse until smooth
2. Add whipped topping and vanilla and puree until nice and smooth and getting thick
3. In a large bowl , mix fruit lightly together
4. Place half of the fruit in a large bowl or trifle dish
5. Spoon half of whipped topping mixture over top , spreading to edges
6. Place remaining fruit on the topping
7. Top with remaining whipped topping mixture almost to edge of bowl
8. Garnish with strawberries
9. Serve and enjoy !

title: easy cheesy biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Open package and lay out biscuits on a cookie sheet
3. Sprinkle mozzarella cheese on each biscuit
4. Sprinkle parmesan cheese over the mozzarella
5. Bake biscuits for 10 minutes or until golden on top

title: chocolate banana nut pie
steps:
1. Mix the 2 cups of ground nuts , cup of ground graham cracker crumbs , 2 t
2. Melted butter and 2 tablespoons brown sugar well
3. Using a 9 to 10 inch pie pan , press mixture evenly on the bottom and sides
4. Bake at 350f for 10 minutes
5. Cool and set aside
6. Blend 2 cups powdered sugar , the cream cheese and vanilla with electric mixer until smooth
7. Add unflavored gelatin / water mixture and set aside
8. Put the cup brown sugar into a pan with the 2 tablespoons of water and 1 tablespoon of butter
9. Heat on low heat until sugar is melted
10. Add the gelatin water mix to the brown sugar and stir
11. Add the chocolate chips to the brown sugar and gelatin mix , and continue stirring until well blended and chocolate is glossy
12. Slowly mix the hot mixture , a little at a time , into the cream cheese and mix well
13. Slowly add the 1 cups of whipping cream to the mixer and after blending well mix at high speed for about 2 minutes
14. Cover and chill in a very cold place for at least 30 minutes
15. Bring out the chilled mixture and beat at high speed until soft peaks form
16. Gently fold in the cup of broken walnut pieces and chunks of bananas
17. Pour into the cooled pie crust , mounding on top since this makes a deep pie
18. Chill well
19. Top with the whipped cream from the topping ingredientsand garnish with the 2 tablespoons of broken walnuts sprinkled on the top and serve

title: ww taco soup  weight watchers
steps:
1. Saute onion with vegetable oil cooking spray
2. When softened , combine all other ingredients
3. Cook until heated through
4. Serve immediately

title: cheddar cornbread ring
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400f
2. Mix the dry ingredients
3. Stir in the milk , oil , and chillies until just combined
4. Grease a large ring mould and dust it with cornmeal
5. Pour the batter into the pan
6. Bake at 400 f for 20-25 minutes
7. Cool for 10 minutes
8. Remove from pan

title: low sodium pizza
steps:
1. In a small pot , mix together sauce ingredients
2. Simmer on low for 15 minutes , stirring occasionally
3. Remove sauce from heat and set aside to cool
4. Shred cheese , prepare vegetable and meat toppings , and set aside
5. Spray pizza pan with non stick cooking spray , and set aside
6. Stir yeast and sugar into warm water
7. Let sit for 8 minutes
8. Mixture should start to foam slightly
9. In a large mixing bowl , add flour , olive oil , and yeast mixture
10. Mix until blended
11. In order to keep the mixture dry or moist enough to work with , you may need to add flour or water ,
12. Once mixed well , form into a ball
13. On a floured surface , pick dough ball up and throw down hard several times
14. With floured hands kneed for 2 minutes
15. Place dough in center of pizza pan
16. Using the palm of your hand , press dough out to edges of pan
17. Thumb print outside edge of crust
18. Place pan in preheated 425 f oven for 10 minutes , then remove
19. In a small bowl mix melted margarine and small amount of garlic powder
20. Brush margarine and garlic mixture on outside edge of crust
21. Spread sauce , sprinkle crushed red pepper flakes , then add shredded cheese , and toppings of your choice to pizza
22. Bake in pre-heated oven at 425 f for 20 to 25 minutes

title: pineapple casserole
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease a medium-size casserole dish with butter
3. In a large bowl , stir together the sugar and flour
4. Gradually stir in the cheese
5. Add the drained pineapple chunks , and stir until ingredients are well combined
6. Pour the mixture into the prepared casserole dish
7. In another medium bowl , combine the cracker crumbs , melted butter , and pineapple juice , stirring with a rubber spatula until evenly blended
8. Spread crumb mixture on top of pineapple mixture
9. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes , or until golden brown

title: peas and beans with lemon dressing
steps:
1. Bring a large suacepan of salted water to the boil
2. Cook the peas for 4 minutes
3. Add the beans and cook for 2 more minutes
4. Drain and keep warm
5. Combine the oil , lemon juice , lemon rind , sugar , salt and pepper in a small saucepan
6. Cook , stirring , over a low heat for 2 minutes
7. Remove lemon mixture from the heat and stir through the mint
8. To serve toss in the peas and beans with warm lemon dressing
9. If using frozen peas then only simmer for 2 minutes before adding the beans

title: grilled scallions
steps:
1. Herb vinaigrette:
2. Place all ingredients except oils , in a jar and shake well
3. Add oils and shake again
4. Or , place in food processor and add oil slowly with motor running to make this creamy
5. Set aside
6. To grill scallions:
7. Trim both ends of scallions and leave whole
8. Brush liberally with vinaigrette
9. Place directly on grill and barbecue 5 minutes on each side or until slightly charred and crispy
10. Serve as a side dish
11. Enjoy !

title: carrot and raisin salad with fennel
steps:
1. In a food processor combine carrots fennel and green onion
2. Process until coarsely grated
3. Add mayo , cream , oil , vinegar , sugar
4. Continue processing until well mixed
5. If to dry add more mayo
6. Transfer to bowl , add raisins and mis well
7. Refrigerate 2 hours for flavours to blend
8. You can add 1 cup chicken if desired
9. Consider omitting salt if on a low sodium diet

title: miyabi japanese onion soup
steps:
1. Combine beef and chicken stock in a pot
2. Add carrot , onion and garlic
3. Bring to a boil , lower heat , cover pot and simmer for 30 minutes
4. Discard the carrot , onion and garlic and strain the soup through cheesecloth
5. Place a small amount of each of the green onions , mushrooms and french fried onions in serving bowls and ladle the broth over them
6. Serve

title: eggplant parmigiana and italian meats casserole
steps:
1. Cook ground round in a skillet until browned , stirring to crumble meat
2. Drain , reserving 3 tbsp drippings
3. Set meat and drippings aside
4. Cook sausage in skillet until browned , stirring to crumble meat -- if in casings , remove casings
5. Drain , set aside
6. Combine ground round , reserved drippings , tomatoes , and next 9 ingredients in a dutch oven
7. Cook , uncovered , over medium-low heat 2 hours
8. Remove and discard bay leaves
9. Cut eggplant into 1 / 4 inch slices
10. Saute eggplant in olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until almost tender
11. Drain
12. Spread 1 1 / 2 cups tomato mixture in a 13x9x2 inch baking dish
13. Layer half each of eggplant slices , shredded mozzarella cheese , grated parmesan cheese , reserved sausage , and tomato mixture
14. Repeat layers
15. Top with mozzarella cheese strips
16. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes or until lightly browned and thoroughly heated

title: pork tenderloin with stilton and port
steps:
1. Heat the butter in a large skillet over high heat and brown the
2. Tenderloins on all sides
3. Transfer to a covered roasting pan
4. Deglaze the skillet with the port and reduce by half
5. Add the chicken
6. Stock and bring to a boil
7. Pour the mixture over the tenderloins and
8. Roast covered in a preheated 450f oven until done , about 15
9. Minutes
10. Remove the pork and keep warm
11. Add the cream to the liquid
12. In the roasting pan and reduce by half over a moderate flame
13. Add the
14. Stilton , reserving some for garnish , and stir to blend
15. Spoon the
16. Sauce over the pork and garnish with the reserved stilton

title: tsr version of el pollo loco avocado sauce by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a blender & puree
2. Optional: for chunkier salsa , after pureeing , place in bowl
3. Mix in one diced avocado into pureed mixture

title: pumpkin and tomato bake
steps:
1. Remove any seeds from the pumpkin and cut into 3 / 4 inch strips
2. Cook in boiling salted water for 2 or 3 minutes
3. Drain and dry thoroughly on paper towel
4. Dice strips into about 1 / 2 inch cubes
5. Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a large fry pan
6. Brown the onions slowly
7. Stir in the sugar
8. Add the pumpkin , fry it gently until it starts to turn transparent
9. Place evenly in the bottom of a shallow baking dish
10. Heat the remaining oil
11. Add the tomatoes , garlic , herbs and half of the parsley to the pan
12. Season well with salt and cayenne
13. Cook gently , just until the tomatoes start to collapse , turn once being careful to keep tomato slices unbroken
14. When the moisture has reduced somewhat , spread the tomatoes , in neat rows , over the pumpkin pieces
15. Add a tablespoon of wine to the pan , whisk up the pieces and pour carefully over the tomatoes and pumpkin
16. Mix the remaining parsley with the crumbs and sprinkle evenly over the tomatoes and pumpkin
17. Dot with butter
18. Preheat oven to 400 degrees and bake for 20 minutes or until nicely browned

title: brandi s cheesy potato casserole
steps:
1. Place potatoes in a large pot
2. Cover with water
3. Add 1 / 2 teaspoons salt
4. Cook until tender
5. Drain
6. Mash potatoes until smooth
7. Add in the butter , 1 1 / 2 cups of cheddar cheese , cream cheese , and sour cream
8. Mix until combined on a low speed
9. Fold in beaten eggs and green onions or chives pour into a greased baking dish
10. Top with remaining cheddar cheese
11. Bake uncovered at 350f for about 45 minutes or until bubbly and puffy
12. Sprinkle with more chives or green onions

title: scottish salmon with herb butter
steps:
1. In a small bowl , add butter , lemon rind and juice , chopped dill and seasoning and stir together with a fork until well blended
2. Place this herb butter on a piece of greaseproof paper and roll up , smoothing into a sausage shape
3. Twist the ends tightly
4. Wrap in clear film and place in freezer for 20 minutes until firm
5. Preheat oven to 190c / 375f / gas 5
6. Prepare four squares of foil large enough to wrap salmon steaks in by greasing lightly
7. Place a salmon steak in the center of each one
8. Remove herb butter from freezer and allow to sit for a few minutes
9. With a sharp knife , slice butter into 8 rounds
10. Top each salmon steak with 2 rounds
11. Top the butter with a halved lemon slice and a sprig of dill
12. Lift up foil and crinkle edges together to seal
13. Place these packets on a baking sheet and bake for about 20 minutes
14. Remove from oven , open packets and slide the contents on to warmed plates along with the juices
15. Serve hot , with new potatoes and a crisp green salad

title: colonel sanders  bean salad
steps:
1. Drain all beans well
2. Rinse the kidney beans
3. Combine vegetable oil , cider vinegar , sugar , salt and pepper
4. Pour dressing mixture over beans in a bowl and toss well
5. Let marinate in the refrigerator overnight
6. Serve

title: barbecue ham slices
steps:
1. Combine the pineapple juice , brown sugar , mustard , lemon juice , onion salt , and soy sauce in a medium saucepan , stirring well
2. Bring to a boil , reduce heat
3. Simmer , uncovered for 5 minutes
4. Stir frequently
5. Remove sauce from heat , and set aside
6. Trim any excess fat from the ham slices
7. Grill over medium coals for 20 to 25 minutes or until desired degree of doneness
8. While cooking , turn ham slices and baste every 5 minutes with the reserved sauce
9. Grill the pineapple slices over medium heat for 1 minute on each side
10. Garnish each slice of ham with two pineapple slices , and serve with the remaining sauce

title: quick shrimp chowder
steps:
1. Melt butter in a dutch oven over medium heat
2. Add onion
3. Saute for 8 minutes or until tender
4. Stir in cream of potato soup , milk and pepper
5. Bring to a boil
6. Add shrimp , reduce heat and simmer , stirring often , 5 minutes or just until shrimp turn pink
7. Stir in cheese until melted
8. Garnish if desired with parsley
9. Serve immediately with oyster crackers

title: cretons
steps:
1. In a large sauce pan add all the ingredients except the bread crumbs
2. Using 2 knives mince the meat mixture as it beging to cook over medium heat
3. Cook for 1 hour stirring often and breaking up-you really want this minced fine
4. When the hour is up , add the bread crumbs and cook for 10 minutes more
5. Remove from heat , cool and place in the fridge in a clean container

title: bourbon butternut squash soup
steps:
1. Place butter in 4-quart saucepan and saut onions over medium heat until onions turn opaque
2. Add squash , ginger , garlic and saut an additional 2 minutes
3. Add bourbon and ignite with a lighter until alcohol has burned off
4. Add chicken stock and simmer for 20 minutes
5. Add all other ingredients and simmer for 5 or more minutes
6. Blend all ingredients in saucepan with a handheld immersion mixer or blender until all of the soup has been pureed very fine , then add salt and pepper to taste

title: grama bonnie s pizza crust
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl and set aside
2. Combine the yeast and sugar in a small bowl and add warm water
3. Warm means hot enough that you can only hold your finger in it for about 2 or 3 seconds but not so hot that you have to jerk your hand away
4. Allow the yeast and water to get bubbly , about 8 minutes
5. Add the yeast / water / sugar mixture and the olive oil to the dry ingredients
6. Gently mix with a wooden spoon and then switch to your hands
7. Dump the dough on a wooden board or counter top and knead until smooth and elastic
8. You may need to add more flour
9. When kneaded place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl and cover with a towel
10. Set in a warm place and allow to rise until double
11. After the dough has risen gently punch it down , knead again and then divide into two equal pieces
12. Each piece is enough for an approximately 11inch pizza

title: braised lamb with vegetables
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Heat oil in skillet
3. Sprinkle lamb with salt& pepper and brown in skillet , in batches
4. Transfer to a large baking dish
5. Pour fat out of skillet , add onions and celery and cook until softened
6. Add garlic , cumin and coriander
7. Add water and bring to boil scraping up bits in the skillet , add to the lamb break up the canned tomatoes with your hands and add to the lamb with the juices cover and place in oven , cook for 1 1 / 2 hours
8. Add carrots and cook for 1 / 2 hour
9. Put pot back on stovetop and add spinach , stirring until wilted about 5 minutes season with salt& pepper

title: lebanese rice with sharia  vermicelli   gluten free
steps:
1. Rinse rice in a sieve gently until water runs clear , set aside
2. Put butter in a large pot and melt over medium heat
3. Add broken up rice vermicelli turn up heat to medium high and toast until medium brown watching as it starts to turn dark quickly
4. Add rice and cinnamon and toss to coat
5. Add the amount of water according to the normal way you cook rice and add sea salt to taste
6. Bring to a boil uncovered
7. Once boiling turn heat to almost low and cook until done
8. Fluff rice with a fork and serve

title: healthy oatmeal banana chocolate muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Add the oil , brown sugar , apple sauce and egg to the mashed bananas and stir thoroughly
3. In a second bowl sift the flour , baking soda and powder , and salt together
4. Fold these ingredients into the wet mix
5. To the batter , add the oats , flax , and chocolate chips and fold evenly into the batter
6. Put desired amount of batter into lined muffin tins and bake for 20-25 minutes

title: homemade watermelon ice cream
steps:
1. Remove the black seeds from the cubes if needed
2. Puree the watermelon cubes
3. Press the watermelon puree through a sieve to remove any chunks or seeds
4. Add the remaining ingredients and whisk until the sugar is fully incorporated
5. Put into your ice cream maker and follow manufacturers instructions

title: spicy hot taco soup chili
steps:
1. Brown meat and onion together
2. Add water and seasoning envelopes
3. In a large pot , combine all five cans with the meat and mix thoroughly
4. Simmer for 30-45 minutes

title: mommy s instant oatmeal
steps:
1. Pour all ingredients into an air tight container and mix well to distribute them evenly
2. Store in your freezer or pantry
3. To make single servings: pour cup of mixture and 1 cup of water , milk , or soy milk into a bowl
4. Microwave on high 1-2 minutes
5. Stir and let stand for one minute before serving
6. Stir in add-ins , serve
7. I make the recipe according to directions , it thickens as it cooks
8. After it has cooked i add additional milk to thin it

title: whole wheat molasses bread  bread machine
steps:
1. Add ingredients to bread machine pan in order suggested by manufacturer
2. Use light setting , no timer

title: yummers zucchini soup
steps:
1. Put all ingredients in pot , cook on medium low heat until tender
2. Let cool slightly
3. Blend soup mixture in blender
4. Reheat
5. Serve with dab of sour cream / parmesan cheese or both on top
6. One word of caution , do not fill the blender too full with hot soup , the lid will explode from heat expansion
7. , i know i learned this the hard way

title: mushroom sauce for bbq meats
steps:
1. Melt butter in a frypan and saute the mushrooms for about 3 minutes
2. Blend in the flour , salt , pepper , thyme& chives
3. Meanwhile dissolve the beef cube in the boiling water and stir into the frypan mixture keep stirring until the mixture comes to a boil and thickens
4. Take pan off the heat and stir in the cottage cheese
5. Keep warm and serve with bbq meats , chicken

title: best ever oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Cream together sugar , eggs and butter
2. Set aside
3. Sift together flour , salt , baking soda , & cinnamon and add to the creamed sugar mixture
4. Next add milk , vanilla , oatmeal & pecans
5. Drop by tablespoon onto a nonstick cookie sheet
6. Bake on 350 10-12 minutes
7. Cookies should be cake-like , not gooey or runny like most oatmeal cookie recipes
8. This recipe makes a lot of cookies
9. Dough can be split into three batches
10. I add peanut butter to one third and crushed pineapples to the other third and i have three kinds of cookies and all are delicious

title: beefy rice pilaf with lentils
steps:
1. In a heavy-bottomed pot heat the olive oil and butter on medium to medium-high heat
2. Add the rice , onions , carrots , and seasonings
3. Keep stirring as the rice loses the translucency that it got from the oil and goes white again
4. Be very careful not to burn it because scorched grain reeks and tastes horrible
5. Once most of the rice is white add the lentils and the beef stock
6. Bring to a boil then simmer about 20 minutes , stirring several times , or until all liquid is absorbed and the lentils are tender
7. Let sit covered for another 5 minutes before serving

title: beef in red wine   brandy
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Place all ingredients in a 3 quart csserole
3. Cover tightly
4. Bake for 3 hours and 30 minutes
5. Stir in mushrooms and brandy
6. Cover again and bake 30 minutes longer
7. Serve over rice or noodles

title: potatoes   tuna casserole   no pasta added
steps:
1. Butter lightly an oven pan 9x13 size
2. Heat the oven at: 375f
3. Layer the bottom of pan with first layer of raw , sliced potatoes
4. Add layer of sliced , raw onions and first tin of tuna , carefully spreading the tuna evenly all over
5. Add a second layer of sliced , raw potatoes , then add last of the onions
6. Salt & pepper in between
7. Add the rest of the second can of tuna evenly
8. Cover with last row of potatoes
9. In a separate bowl , mix together the celery soup with milk , mixing well
10. Pour the soup mixture evenly over dish
11. Cover all potatoes
12. Cover tightly with foil or dutch oven cover
13. Bake for 1 hour at 375f in center of oven
14. Uncover , and bake 15 minutes more at 350f and the sauce / gravy will become just the right thickness--not too thick and not too watery
15. Do enjoy ! please do comment on the recipe afterwards

title: saudi arabian kabsa  one dish chicken dinner
steps:
1. Sautee onion in oil over medium-high heat until it begins to brown
2. Turn heat to low and add chicken pieces , tomato puree , chopped tomatoes and garlic and stir for about five minutes
3. Add hot water , grated carrot , orange rind , spices , salt and pepper to taste
4. Turn up heat to medum and cook , covered , for about 20-25 minutes , until chicken is done
5. Remove chicken
6. Set aside to keep warm
7. Stir rice into the liquid in the pan , and cook , covered over low heat for about 35 - 40 minutes , or until liquid is absorbed
8. Remove cinnamon , cloves and cardamom or warn your guests to look out for them !
9. Put rice on a serving with chicken pieces arranged around the circumference
10. Sprinkle raisins and almonds over all

title: easy  basic waffles
steps:
1. Sift flour , baking powder , salt and sugar
2. Mix the eggs , oil and milk
3. Combine dry and wet ingredients
4. Pour onto hot skillet , and cook for 3-4 minutes

title: all the frills egg sandwiches
steps:
1. Beat eggs
2. Add onions , ham and seasonings
3. Mix well
4. Cook over medium heat
5. As mixture begins to set , draw in to center with your pancake turner till all is set
6. Turn and cook for a very short time and then cut into 4ths
7. Put each serving on a piece of buttered toast and top with another slice of toast
8. Serve at once

title: beef tenderloin with three spreads
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Brush meat with olive oil
3. Sprinkle with rosemary , salt , and black pepper , if using
4. Insert meat thermometer into center of one of the roasts
5. For beef , roast uncovered for 35-45 minutes or until thermometer registers 140f
6. For pork , roast uncovered , 25-35 minutes or until thermometer registers 160f
7. Allow meat to stand covered loosely with foil , about 10 minutes , to allow juices to reabsorb and meat to firm for easier slicing
8. Cut into 1 / 4 to 1 / 2-inch slices
9. Horseradish mayo:
10. In a bowl stir together all the ingredients
11. Makes 2 / 3 cup
12. Black pepper-olive relish:
13. In a bowl stir together all the ingredients
14. Makes 1-2 / 3 cups
15. Blue cheese-parsley crumble:
16. In a bowl stir together all the ingredients
17. Makes 3 / 4 cup
18. Serve steak slices with one or all three spreads , potatoes , a tomato vinaigrette with greens , a loaf of french warm bread for steaks as well as sopping up the three spreads , and of course some merlot
19. Enjoy !

title: company salad
steps:
1. In a pan lightly toast walnuts
2. Lightly toss apples with a little lemon juice in a large bowl , combine salad greens , walnuts , cheese , and apples
3. Sprinkle with cranberries if desired
4. Toss with raspberry vinaigrette , and serve

title: huachinango enchilado  snapper fillets cuban style
steps:
1. Saute onion , garlic , and peppers in olive oil over medium heat
2. Cook 6 to 8 minutes until tender
3. Add tomatoes , tomato paste , bay leaf , capers , olives , wine , salt , and pepper
4. Cook sauce for about 10 minutes over low to medium heat
5. Add snapper fillets and cook for about 4 minutes then flip the fillets and cook for another 4 minutes
6. Serve fillets over white rice and cover with sauce

title: moroccan lamb in pita
steps:
1. Add all the seasoning mix ingredients to a dry heavy sauce or saute pan over medium heat
2. Stir for approximately 1 minute or until fragrant
3. Remove from heat source
4. In a big mixing bowl , add the lamb , seasoning mix , and 3 tablespoons cold water
5. Gently mix together with your hands
6. Wet your hands and shape mixture into 4 patties , approximately 3 / 4 inch thick each
7. Cover and chill in the refrigerator until you are ready to grill
8. Right before you are ready to grill: whisk together the sauce ingredients in a bowl
9. Lighty spray or brush the patties with olive oil
10. Grill over medium direct heat for 7-9 minutes , turn once half-way through gill time
11. Place lamb patties inside pita pockets and add a large spoonful of yogurt sauce
12. Slip in a little lettuce and tomato and serve

title: walnut brittle
steps:
1. Mix sugar and corn syrup in a microwave-safe dish
2. Microwave mixture for three minutes
3. Stir again and place in the microwave for an additional four minutes
4. Stir in walnuts , salt , vanilla and butter
5. Mix with electric mixer until mixture is well blended and fluffy
6. Grease a cookie sheet with butter
7. Spread mixture on cookie sheet in any desired thickness
8. After candy cools slightly stretch the brittle to your desired thickness
9. Cool at least one hour
10. When cooled break into pieces and store in covered container

title: bread pudding with orange caramel sauce
steps:
1. To make the pudding
2. Heat the milk , sugar , cinnamon stick , and orange zest in a medium saucepan over medium heat until the sugar dissolves
3. Let cool , cover , and refrigerate overnight to steep
4. Preheat the oven to 350f put the bread cubes in a large bowl
5. Reheat the milk mixture and remove the cinnamon stick
6. In a large bowl , lightly whisk together the yolks and eggs
7. Pour the milk mixture into the eggs and mix thoroughly
8. Pour this mixture over the bread and allow to soak for a few minutes
9. Butter the insides of eight 5-ounce ramekins
10. Divide the mixture among the ramekins and place them in a roasting pan or on a large , deep sheet pan
11. Pour about 1 inch of water into the pan to create a water bath
12. Bake until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean , about 1 1 / 4 hours
13. To make the sauce:
14. Bring orange juice to a simmer over medium-high heat in a medium saucepan , then reduce to 1 / 4 cup , about 10 minutes
15. Strain through a fine sieve into a bowl , add cream , and set aside
16. In another saucepan , melt butter over medium heat
17. Add sugar and continue to cook , stirring frequently until sugar is lightly caramelized , about 3 minutes
18. Add the orange juice mixture , stirring constantly
19. Simmer for 5 minutes and strain through a fine sieve
20. Serve the pudding warm , either turned out onto individual plates or left inside the ramekins
21. Top with the sauce , a dollop of whipped cream , and a dusting of powdered sugar

title: spicy cajun rub
steps:
1. In a small bowl , mix all ingredients together
2. Use 1 tbsp spice mixture per pound of uncooked beef or pork , 2 tsp per pound uncooked fish or chicken
3. Store in airtight container
4. Makes about 1 / 3 cup

title: baked breaded cod
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f degrees
2. Spray jelly-roll pan with nonstick vegetable cooking spray
3. Combine mayo , parmesan cheese , lemon juice , anchovy paste and salt and pepper
4. Combine bread crumbs and parsley
5. Spoon mayonnaise mixture on one side of the cod and dip the coated side in the breadcrumb mixture
6. Place fish on pan with crumb side up
7. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until fish is cooked through and bread crumbs begin to brown
8. Serve with lemon wedges

title: pumpkin walnut cake
steps:
1. Grease bottom and side of 10 inch tube pan with removable bottom and tube
2. Line bottom with parchment paper
3. Set aside
4. In bowl , beat butter with sugar until fluffy
5. Beat in eggs , one at a time , beating well after eaach addition
6. Beat in vanilla
7. In a separate bowl , whisk tobether flour , baking powder , salt , nutmeg , cinnamon , ginger , cardamon , cloves and baking soda
8. Stir in walnuts
9. Alternately stir flour mixture and pumpkin puree into butter mixture making 3 additions of flour mixture and 2 pumpkin puree
10. Scrape batter into prepared pan
11. Streusel: in small bowl , stir together , flour , sugar and cinnamon
12. Using pastry blender or 2 knives , cut in butter until mixture clumps together
13. Stir in walnuts
14. Sprinkle over batter in pan
15. Bake in centre of 325f degree oven until streusel is golden bown and cake tester inserted in centre comes oout clean , about 1 3 / 4 hours
16. Let cool in pan on rack for 15 minutes
17. Loosen side of cake with knife
18. Holding onto centre tube , lift cake from pan
19. Let cool completely on rack
20. Run knife around tube
21. Using wide spatulas , gently lift out cake and peel off paper
22. Or overwrap in heavy duty foil and freeze for up to 2 weeks

title: orange punch
steps: 1. Combine all ingredients

title: tilapia with creamy lemon sauce
steps:
1. Heat the dressing in a medium skillet on medium heat
2. Coat the fish with flour and then add to the pan
3. Cook 4-5 minutes on each side or until fish flakes easily with a fork
4. Remove from skillet , cover and keep warm
5. Add broth and lemon juice to the pan
6. Cook 3 minutes , until it is reduced by half , stirring frequently witha whisk
7. Add cream cheese and cook until melted , stirring constantly
8. Pour over fish , sprinkle with parsley

title: heavenly banana oatmeal chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Mix together the flour , sugar , salt , baking soda , cinnamon , and nutmeg
3. Beat in softened butter until the mixture is crumbly
4. Add egg , banana , and quick oats to bowl and mix well
5. Add chocolate chips and walnuts
6. Spoon onto greased cookie sheets
7. Bake for 13-15 minutes , then place on a rack to cool

title: grilled mussels with shallot sauce
steps:
1. Whisk together shallots , red wine vinegar , 1 / 4 cup of the lemon juice and the olive oil in a small bowl
2. Lightly coat a grill wok or grill basket or aluminum foil lined grill rack with nonstick cooking spray
3. Preheat grill to medium high heat
4. Scrub mussel shells with a stiff brush , removing beards
5. Discard any opened shells
6. Sprinkle mussels with salt , pepper , and remaining lemon juice
7. Place on the grill wok , grill basket or grill rack
8. Grill mussels , covered with grill lid , 7-10 minutes or until shells open
9. Discard and unopened shells
10. Transfer mussels to a large dish and pour the shallot mixture over the mussels , stirring gently to coat
11. Sprinkle with parsley
12. Serve immediately

title: sopranos  baked chicken with potatoes  lemon   oregano
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees
2. Squeeze the juice from 1 lemon
3. Slice the other one
4. Put the chicken and potatoes in a baking pan large enough to hold them in a single layer
5. Sprinkle the lemon juice , oil , oregano , garlic , and salt and pepper to taste
6. Turn the pieces to coat evenly , then turn the chicken skin side up
7. Tuck the lemon slices and potatoes in between the chicken pieces
8. Bake the chicken for 45 minutes
9. Baste with the pan juices
10. Continue to bake , basting occasionally , for 15 to 30 minutes longer or until the chicken is browned and the potatoes are tender
11. Transfer the chicken , potatoes , and lemon slices to a serving platter
12. Pour the juices over the chicken and serve

title: zucchini garden chowder
steps:
1. In a dutch oven or soup kettle over medium heat , saute zucchini , onion , parsley and basil in butter until vegetables are tender
2. Stir in flour , salt and pepper
3. Gradually stir in water
4. Add the bouillon and lemon juice
5. Mix well
6. Bring to a boil
7. Cook and stir for 2 minutes
8. Add tomatoes , milk and corn
9. Bring to a boil
10. Reduce heat
11. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes or until corn is tender
12. Just before serving , stir in cheeses until melted
13. Add sugar and garnish with parsley if desired

title: peaches and cream coffee cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. In ungreased 8-9 inch cake pan , melt butter in oven
3. Stir in preserves
4. Separate dough into 10 biscuits
5. Cut each into 4 pieces
6. Arrange bicuits pieces over preserves
7. Combine topping and cinnamon
8. Spread over biscuits
9. Bake for 25-30 minutes until deep gold brown
10. Immediately invert onto serving plate
11. Serve warm

title: potato and cucumber soup
steps:
1. In a large pot , heat oil over medium heat and cook onions until they begin to soften , about 5 minutes
2. Add potatoes , chicken broth , and water
3. Cover and simmer until potatoes are tender , about 15 minutes
4. Working in batches , puree potato mixture with cucumbers and return to pot
5. Stir in cream
6. Meanwhile , heat a heavy skillet over medium high heat , and add the corn and cook until golden
7. Scrape corn from cob and add to soup
8. Stir in parsley , salt and pepper
9. If desired , chill soup in refrigerator before serving

title: chinese five spice powder
steps: 1. Mix the spices together and store in an airtight jar

title: basil roasted chicken with garlic sauce
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Remove the fat , neck , liver and gizzards from the body cavity , then rinse and pat the chicken dry
3. Gently separate the skin from the flesh , running your fingers from the front to the back of the chicken and along the leg and thigh , being careful not to rip the skin or detach it from the bird
4. Mix the butter , chopped basil , parsley , salt and pepper together in a small bowl
5. Rub half of the butter mixture under the loosened skin and then tuck 1 / 2 of the whole basil leaves under the skin
6. Be sure to get it under the skin around the leg and thigh
7. Put 4 of the garlic cloves into the body cavity of the chicken and scatter the rest in the roasting pan
8. Add the lemon juice and stock
9. Place the chicken , breast-side up , on top of the garlic and stock
10. Roast in the oven , basting occasionally with the pan juices for 1 hour , or until the juices run clear when the thickest part of the thigh is pierced
11. Transfer the chicken to a heated platter and tent with foil to keep warm
12. Pour the juices with the garlic cloves into a blender and puree the mixture
13. Strain the puree through a sieve into a medium-sized saucepan , pressing on the garlic skins with the back of a spoon
14. Bring the liquid to a simmer over medium heat , stirring occasionally , about 3 minutes , and add salt and pepper to taste
15. Carve the chicken and serve drizzled with the sauce and garnished with fresh basil leaves

title: neely s gorgonzola creme sauce
steps:
1. Heat a medium size saucepan over medium heat
2. Add butter to melt
3. Throw in the shallots and saute until tender
4. Add the heavy cream and let reduce by half
5. Turn heat to low , add the gorgonzola and stir until it melts
6. Season , to taste , with salt and pepper

title: zucchini tomato kugel
steps:
1. Slice or chop zucchini and cook in microwave or steam
2. Drain well
3. Partially mash with a masher after it is cooked
4. Add onion soup mix and mix well
5. Add slightly beaten eggs and mayo and mix
6. Pour into a greased pie plate , quiche pan , or pan
7. Slice tomatoes and arrange in a circular ring on top of kugel until covered
8. Sprinkle with italian seasoning
9. Hint: i always score the top of this before i bake it since i find it easier to cut through the tomatoes when they are uncooked
10. Bake at 350f for 45 minutes

title: maple bacon tater puffs  sp5
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. In a large skillet , cook bacon pieces until crisp
3. Remove from skillet
4. Reserve the bacon fat
5. Place potatoes into a large bowl
6. Add egg yolks , 1 cup cheddar cheese and 1 / 2 of the cooked bacon
7. Mix well
8. With a pastry brush , brush the insides of a 6 cup jumbo muffin tin with some of the reserved bacon fat
9. Divide potato mixture between the 6 cups
10. Bake for 25 minutes
11. Remove from oven and sprinkle the 6 puffs with the remaining cheese and bacon
12. Bake an extra 5 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the puffs are pulling slightly away from the edges of the pan
13. Serve each maple bacon tater puff with 1 to 2 tablespoons maple syrup

title: canned sugared lemon slices in syrup
steps:
1. Slice lemons as thin as you can get without breaking the rind
2. Save all the juice when you are slicing the lemons
3. Wash and sterilize 8 pint jars , wide mouth if you have
4. Heat the jars in the oven upside down in a pan with water 250 heat seals in water
5. In large kettle , add water , sugar and salt
6. Turn heat to medium and dissolve sugar , do not burn , stir
7. Have a hot water bath canner ready with water heating
8. Pack lemon slices in jars , about 4 lemons per jar
9. Pack tight
10. Add syrup carefully
11. Make sure there are no air pockets , stick knife gently down the sides
12. Wipe each jar rim with a hot damp cloth , place seal and ring on jar
13. Place jars in canner and process in hot water bath 20 minutes
14. Make sure boiling water is over the tops of the jars
15. Take out of the canner and place on a towel out of drafts until they seal
16. You can also turn upside down if you wish
17. Makes 16 half pints
18. Excellent christmas gifts
19. Attach a card listing the uses

title: bronco bread
steps:
1. Combine butter , water , orange juice and rind in a bowl
2. Add egg and mix well
3. Add dry ingredients and fold in blueberries by hand
4. Bake at 325 degrees in greased 9x5 inch baking pan for 1 hour and 10 minutes
5. Cool on rack

title: rockin  smores bars
steps:
1. Grease an 8-inch-square baking pan
2. Heat the oven to 350 degrees
3. In a large mixing bowl , cream the butter and sugar until fluffy
4. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract
5. Add the crushed graham crackers , flour , salt , and baking powder and beat until well mixed , stopping occasionally to scrape the sides of the bowl
6. Spoon half the dough into the pan and spread evenly with your finger
7. Break the chocolate into pieces and arrange over the dough
8. Spread a layer of marshmallow creme over the chocolate
9. Flatten the remaining dough into pancakes and lay them over the marshmallow
10. Bake until golden brown , about 30 minutes
11. Let the bars cool before serving

title: my fake pasta carbonara
steps:
1. Heat an empty 9 x 12 baking dish or serving dish in an oven at 250 f
2. Fry the bacon until well done , crumble into a medium to large bowl
3. Reserve the fat for later use if you'd like
4. Either by hand or with a food processor , finely mince the black olives and combine with the bacon
5. In a medium skillet , brown the sausage over medium heat until cooked through
6. Combine with the bacon / olive mixture and set aside
7. Beat the eggs and cream together until well combined but not frothy
8. Meanwhile , boil the fettucini in about 6 quarts of boiling water , 6 minutes for fresh fettucini , about 12 for dried
9. Drain well
10. Remove the baking dish from the oven
11. The next step sort of has to be done quickly: dump the pasta into the baking dish and toss immediately with the butter
12. Pour the egg and cream mixture over the pasta and toss to coat , enjoying the sizzling sound you hear
13. Add the sausage / olive / bacon mixture and parsley , and toss to combine
14. Add the parmesan cheese and toss again to combine
15. Serve immediately
16. This pasta keeps well in the fridge for about 3-4 days
17. This is a good thing , because as everyone knows , the thing about italian food is , you eat it and you're hungry again 20 days later

title: red cabbage with apples and spices   crock pot
steps:
1. Place all ingredients into a large crock pot
2. It will be full but will cook down to about 1 / 5
3. Cook for 5 hours on low
4. Stirring occasionally adding water if needed
5. Optional: or you can cook stove top saute onions in some butter till softened add rest of ingredients and simmer 1-2 hours or bake at 350 degrees

title: okinawan goya champuru
steps:
1. Cook bacon in wok or saucepan on high heat
2. Remove bacon and leave grease
3. Lightly salt goya , let sit for 3 minutes
4. Add sliced goya to heat and grease and cook about 3-5 minutes , or until slightly flimsy
5. Add tofu and cook til just browning
6. Add egg and cook til done
7. Serve with soy sauce and cooked cabbage if desired

title: salmon with crabmeat and rice blend stuffing
steps:
1. Portion the salmon , cutting off any very thin ends of the filet
2. Slash the salmon along the long axis down to but not through the skin
3. Cook the rice in the microwave per directions
4. Mix the rice , crabmeat , mayonnaise , parsley and chives
5. Place the salmon on a sheet pan on silpat or parchment paper
6. Spread open the slash in the center of the salmon and press in the rice and crabmeat mixture , mounding it up above the fish fillet
7. Mix the corn syrup and lemon juice and lightly brush the exposed salmon flesh with the mixture
8. Sprinkle paprika over the stuffing in the center and dill over the salmon
9. Bake in a hot oven for about 20 minutes or until fish flakes easily
10. Serve with steamed asparagus--yum !

title: luxembourg potato soup  gromperenzopp
steps:
1. Cut up the green stalks and roots from the leeks and wash well
2. You should have about 1 1 / 2 cups
3. In a heavy saucepan or dutch oven , melt the butter over low heat
4. Add leeks and saute until soft and translucent
5. Add diced potatoes and 3 cups boiling water
6. Season with 2 teaspoons salt
7. Cook 30 minutes so that potatoes and leeks are very soft
8. Strain mixture through a sieve or put through a food mill , and return to pot
9. Meanwhile , in a separate saucepan , heat milk to boiling
10. Blend egg yolks into the cream or sour cream
11. Stirring constantly , add milk , 1 teaspoon butter , then the egg and cream mixture
12. Season with salt and pepper
13. Garnish with parsley if desired
14. Add salt and pepper and finely chopped parsley if desired

title: easy italian chicken
steps:
1. Put a pan on medium heat
2. Fill the bottom of the pan with olive oil
3. Chop the onions and add to the pan
4. Add garlic cloves , chopped very small
5. Add chicken pieces and sprinkle with rosemary
6. Leave for 30 minutes - until reduced ,
7. Add wine , then turn the heat up full and leave until cooked

title: a very special pot roast for the crock pot
steps:
1. Trim fat from meat and if need be , cut the meat to fit the cooker
2. Brown meat on top of stove in a dutch oven
3. Brown on all side using the 1 tablespoon of cooking oil
4. Sprinkle meat with salt and pepper
5. Cut up any large pieces of dried fruit
6. Place the fruit in the slow cooker
7. Add the onion wedges
8. Place the meat on top of the fruit and onion
