9. Sprinkle with allspice and pour in the apple juice
10. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours or on high for 4 to 5 hour

title: creamy vanilla tapioca pudding
steps:
1. Mix the tapioca pearls with the milk in a large pot and let them soak for at least an hour
2. Add the salt and bring the mixture to a boil
3. Simmer on low heat for five minutes while adding the sugar gradually
4. Beat the egg in a separate bowl and mix in about half of the hot mixture
5. Pour the egg back into the pot and mix well
6. Bring the mixture to a boil again and then cut it down to low heat
7. Mix in the vanilla extract
8. Simmer for another ten minutes , stirring constantly

title: shakey s famous chicken   mojos  copycat
steps:
1. : rinse and blot chicken
2. Wash and scrub potatoes
3. Cut potatoes between 1 / 4-inch to 1 / 3-inch rounds (about the width of a mcdonald's french fry
4. Discard potato ends
5. Mix the chicken and potato brine ingredients in a 3 quart saucepan until dissolved
6. Place potato slices in a smaller saucepan with an accompanying lid
7. Pour enough prepared brine to just cover potatoes , then cover
8. Place chicken pieces into 3 quart saucepan with remaining brine and cover
9. Transfer marination saucepans into refrigerator
10. Marinate chicken and potatoes between 2-4 hours
11. Meanwhile , combine the breading ingredients well , in a large sealable container , such as a glad food storage container or a ziploc bag
12. Break up clumps with a wire whisk
13. Seal the container with mixture
14. Shake well until thoroughly combined
15. Remove a handful of potatoes from brine
16. Place potatoes into the breading mixture container
17. Seal container firmly
18. Shake gently in all motions to thoroughly coat until evenly and generously breaded
19. Transfer breaded potatoes onto a platter
20. Repeat procedure with remaining potatoes
21. Add the manufacturer's recommended amount frying oil for deep-frying
22. Place deep-fryer basket into place in deep-fryer
23. Preheat fryer to 350f
24. Elevate and secure the deep-fryer basket
25. Place breaded potatoes into basket
26. Lower basket
27. Fry potatoes for 2 minutes
28. Raise basket to drain
29. Using tongs , remove hot potatoes
30. Add potatoes in increments into the breading once again
31. Seal and shake until potatoes are evenly / thoroughly coated
32. Transfer re-dredged potatoes onto previous platter to absorb breading again , until all chicken is fried
33. Remove 1-3 pieces chicken from brine
34. Place chicken into breading container
35. Seal container firmly
36. Shake container gently in all motions to thoroughly coat chicken until evenly and generously breaded
37. Repeat wit remaining chicken
38. Transfer onto another platter
39. Allow breaded chicken to absorb the breading for a few minutes
40. Carefully drop each piece breaded chicken one at a time , gently into the deep-fryer with basket immersed , without crowding , turning once halfway through frying duration)
41. Fry chicken about 13-15 minutes , until golden brown and fully cooked , depending on chicken portions / sizes
42. Drain chicken on paper towels
43. Maintain frying fat temperature for each new batch until all chicken is fried
44. Keep chicken warm in preheated 170f oven
45. Raise and secure deep-fryer basket
46. Add the potatoes once again into basket
47. Lower basket slowly into hot oil
48. Fry potatoes until golden brown and crispy , about 3 minutes
49. Serve chicken and potatoes with desired condiments and enjoy !

title: yellow broth
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a large stock pot
2. Add the onion , celery and carrot and stir to coat with the melted butter
3. Cook for about 2 minutes until the onion is beginning to soften
4. Stir in the flour and cook gently for 1 minute more , stirring constantly
5. Pour in the chicken stock , bring to a boil , and cover
6. Reduce the heat and simmer for 30 minutes until the vegetables are tender
7. Stir in the oatmeal and chopped spinach and cook for 15 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. Stir in the cream and season well with salt and pepper
9. Serve hot , garnished with chopped fresh parsley

title: amazing chocolate dessert sauce
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a small saucepan over low heat
2. Stir for 4 to 5 minutes or until everything is melted and smooth
3. If serving hot pour over ice cream or cake immediately

title: pork and vegetable lo mein  easy and delicious
steps:
1. Already shredded--a real time saver
2. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet or wok
3. Saut pork , onion , garlic and pepper flakes until meat is no longer pink
4. Remove this mixture from pan and keep warm
5. Add remaining tbsp of oil to pan and saut cabbage , bok choy or celery , carrots and peppers until crisp tender
6. Add spaghetti to cooked veggies in the pan
7. Stir in soy sauce and add pork mixture back to the pan
8. Cook for 5 minutes or until heated through

title: wato s chilli sauce
steps:
1. Roughly chop chillies
2. Take out the seeds before chopping if you like a mild chilli sauce
3. Place the chopped chillies in a blender with a little bit of vinegar , blend on high speed for a minute
4. Then place all the ingredients , including the chillies , into a sauce pan and bring to the boil , reduce to a simmer
5. Simmer for approximately 30 minutes or until the chillies and sultanas are very soft
6. Let cool
7. Then in a clean blender blend the chilli sauce until smooth and creamy
8. You should end up with approximately 1
9. 5 litres of chilli sauce
10. Bottle into sterilised jars

title: garbanzo nosh
steps:
1. Beans should be cooked at least four hours before preparing , drained and left out on tray or large bowl to dry completely
2. Even better overnight
3. Prior to serving , mix all ingredients together and place on baking sheet with sides
4. Roast in preheated 375 degree oven until golden brown , stirring once or twice
5. Put out in serving plate -- and don't forget a scoop !
6. I personally do not use any butter at all but season while they are just slightly damp and then roast
7. By the way , this is really not half as good with canned beans

title: toblerone fondue
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , bring the cream to a simmer
2. Remove from heat and add chopped chocolate
3. Let stand long enough for the chocolate to begin to melt , about 3 minutes
4. Add the liqueur and whisk until smooth
5. Transfer mixture to a ceramic fondue pot or chafing dish and keep warm
6. Serve with dipping ingredients such as pound cake , angel food cake , strawberries , sliced peaches , or bananas

title: fish and tomato curry
steps:
1. Spice mixture:
2. Heat the oil in a wok or skillet over medium heat
3. Stir-fry the spice mixture ingredients until fragrant
4. Add the tomatoes with their juice , salt and sugar
5. Reduce heat to low , cover and cook for 5 minutes
6. Add the fish , cover and cook a further 5 minutes or until the fish is just cooked
7. Remove from the heat , divide into serving bowls and sprinkle with the fresh coriander
8. Serve with rice and the lemon wedges

title: curry in a hurry grilled chicken with salsa and sugar snap peas
steps:
1. Salsa: in bowl , combine salsa ingredients
2. Add salt , if desired
3. Chicken: heat grill
4. In a separate bowl , mix paste and dressing
5. Brush half of paste mixture over chicken
6. Grill 10 minutes , or until 170 degrees fahrenheit , brushing with remaining paste mixture
7. Sugar snap peas: meanwhile , in a greased skillet over medium-high heat , cook last three ingredients 2 minutes , or until tender
8. Serve peas with chicken and salsa

title: apple glazed stuffed pork chops
steps:
1. For stuffing , in a large skillet , cook bacon over medium high heat until crisp
2. Remove with a slotted spoon and rain on paper towels
3. Reserve 2 teaspoons drippings in skillet
4. Cook leeks in reserved drippings for 3 to 4 minutes or until almost tender
5. Add the wine , thyme , salt , and pepper
6. Cook and stir until liquid is evaporated
7. Remove from heat
8. Stir in cooked bacon
9. For glaze , stir together the apple jelly and mustard
10. Set aside
11. Trim fat from chops
12. Make a pocket in each chop by cutting from fat side almost to , but not through , the opposite side
13. Spoon stuffing into pockets with chops
14. If necessary , secure with wooden toothpicks
15. Sprinkle with additional salt and pepper
16. Place chops on rack of an uncovered grill directly over medium coals or medium low flame on your gas grill
17. Grill about 20 minutes or until juices run clear , turning once , and brushing with glaze the last five minutes of grilling
18. Remove toothpicks before serving

title: steak and portabella soup
steps:
1. Cut steak into 1 cubes
2. Clean off mushroom caps with a wet paper towel
3. Cut mushrooms into thin slices
4. Saute steak and mushrooms in 2 t
5. Olive oil
6. Meanwhile spray poblano pepper with cooking spray
7. Bake in oven at 325f on a cookie sheet , turning once until charred on all sides
8. Remove and place into a paper bag
9. Let cool
10. Once cool , remove skin and seeds and dice
11. Dice onions and red pepper
12. Add onions , red pepper and poblano to saut pan
13. Saute 4 minutes
14. Add 2 t red wine to deglaze the pan
15. Remove from heat
16. In a deep saucepan or soup kettle , add the two broths , 2 cups water , steak sauce , worchestershire , finely chopped garlic and chili powder
17. Peel potatoes and cube into small cubes
18. Add to soup pot
19. Add steak and portabella mixture to soup pot
20. Cook on low heat 20-30 minutes until potatoes are crisp tender
21. Whisk 2 t flour with c milk in a small bowl until combined
22. Add slowly to soup to thicken
23. Add salt and pepper to taste
24. Serve

title: malva pudding  south african baked dessert
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 deg f / 180 deg celsius
2. Grease an oven dish
3. I used a 7 x 7 x 1 1 / 2 inch pyrex dish
4. Beat or whip the sugar and eggs
5. It's quickest in a food processor , or use electric beaters
6. Beat until thick and lemon coloured , then add the jelly and mix through
7. Melt the butter and add the butter and vinegar to the wet mixture
8. Sieve , or simply mix together: the flour , soda and salt
9. Add this mixture with the milk to the egg mixture in the processor or mixing bowl
10. Beat well
11. Pour into an oven-proof dish and bake until pudding is brown and well-risen -- depending on your oven and oven dish this will be between 30 - 45 minutes
12. In a pot , melt together the ingredients for the sauce , and stir well
13. Pour it over the pudding as soon as it comes out of the oven
14. Leave to stand awhile before serving
15. Serve warm
16. Because it's rich it does not really need enhancement , but if you want , serve with vanilla ice cream

title: bread pudding with apples  pecans and raisins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Melt the butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat
3. Add the bread and cook for 2 to 3 minutes , or until well coated
4. Add the sugar , pecans , orange zest and juice , cider , and vanilla extract
5. Cook an additional 2 to 3 minutes until a sauce begins to form
6. In a 9 x 13-inch baking dish , layer the bread mixture with the apples and dot the top with the jam or jelly
7. Bake 30 to 40 minutes , or until bubbly

title: texas sheet cake   lighter version
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. To prepare cake , coat a sheet pan with cooking spray and dust with the 2 teaspoons flour
3. Combine 2 cups flour , granulated sugar , baking soda , cinnamon , and salt in a large bowl
4. Stir well with a whisk
5. Combine water , 1 / 2 cup butter , and 1 / 4 cup cocoa in a small saucepan
6. Bring to a boil , stirring frequently
7. Remove from heat , pour into flour mixture
8. Beat with a mixer at medium speed until well blended
9. Add buttermilk , 1 teaspoon vanilla extract , and eggs
10. Beat well
11. If you do not have buttermilk , you can substitute nonfat milk and mayonnaise
12. In a half cup measuring cup , fill halfway with milk and then spoon in mayonnaise until full
13. Pour batter into prepared pan and bake at 375 degrees for 17 minutes or until a wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
14. Place on a wire rack
15. To prepare icing , combine 6 tablespoons butter , milk , and 1 / 4 cup cocoa in a medium saucepan
16. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly
17. Remove from heat
18. Gradually stir in powdered sugar , pecans , and 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
19. Spread over hot cake
20. Cool completely on wire rack
21. You can also make this cake in a 13x9 baking pan
22. Bake at 375 degrees for 22 minutes

title: fudge layer bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease 13x9 pan
3. In a large bowl mix cake mix , butter , nuts and egg until crumbly
4. Reserve 1 1 / 2 cups for topping
5. Press remaining mixture evenly into pan
6. In a small saucepan mix condensed milk and semi sweet morsels
7. Cook on low heat untl morsels are melted
8. Stir well
9. Pour over base
10. Sprinkle with crumbs
11. Bake at 350 for 25-30 minutes until filling is set and crumbs are golden brown

title: honey mustard cashew nuts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Line a cookie sheet with aluminum foil and lightly spray with cooking spray
3. Set aside
4. In a bowl , wisk together the honey , vegetable oil and mustard powder
5. Add in the cashews and toss to coat
6. Spread evenly on prepared cookie sheet and bake for 15-20 minutes
7. Check after 10 minutes to stir regularly to ensure even toasting
8. Remove from oven , allow to cool , and store in an airtight container

title: pecan cinnamon muffins
steps:
1. Sift together flour , baking powder , salt and cinnamon into mixing bowl
2. Add white and brown sugar
3. Stir in pecans
4. Combine egg , oil and milk and vanilla in small bowl
5. Blend well
6. Add all at once to dry ingredients , stirring just enough to moisten
7. Batter will be thick
8. Spoon batter into 12 greased 2 1 / 2-inch muffin-pan cups or 6- 3 1 / 2 muffin cups
9. Bake in 375f oven about 20 minutes for 12 muffins or about 30 minutes for 6 -3 1 / 2 inch muffin cups or until tester comes out clean

title: cauliflower cheese soup
steps:
1. Place potato , cauliflower , carrot , garlic , onion , salt and chicken broth in a large saucepan and bring to a boil
2. Simmer until all of the vegetables are very tender
3. Use an immersion blender or put small batches into a food processor or blender and blend until smooth
4. Steam the reserved 2 cups of cauliflower just until tender
5. Add the steamed cauliflower to the puree along with the rest of the ingredients
6. Heat gently and serve topped with cheese shreds

title: pineapple curry soup
steps:
1. Melt butter and saute onion until golden brown
2. Blend in curry and flour then add the broth slowly
3. Bring to boil then reduce heat
4. Beat egg yolks cream and 1 tbs soup together
5. When soup is no longer boiling slowly stir in yolk mixture
6. Do not allow soup to boil again
7. Add pineapple and cognac to taste
8. Serve immediately

title: pumpkin streusel pie
steps:
1. Chill prepared crust for 30 minutes
2. Preheat oven to 350f degrees
3. Puree all filling ingredients in a food processor or blender
4. Pour into prepared crust
5. For topping stir first 7 ingredients together in a bowl
6. Stir in oil until dry ingredients are lightly coated
7. Sprinkle evenly over pumpkin filling
8. Bake until crust is golden and filling is set , about 45 minutes
9. Let cool
10. Serve at room temp or chilled

title: super nachos with the works
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Place bag of chips spread out on a large cookie sheet
3. Cook stew meat or chicken in a pot until cooked through
4. When meat is ready shred the meat and mix with taco seasoning
5. Mix cheese soup and nacho cheese soup with a 1 / 2 can milk to make it creamy
6. Set aside
7. Spoon refried beans over chips and then sprinkle meat on top of beans
8. The beans hold things on a little
9. Drizzle cheese mixture over meat and beans covering all areas of the pan
10. Sprinkle olives , tomatoes , and onion on top of the cheese
11. Place in oven for 5-7 minutes and let it heat through
12. Serve with your favorite mexican side dish or serve as is
13. Enjoy !

title: breadstick dippers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Into medium mixing bowl sift together 2 cups of flour , the sugar , baking powder
3. And salt
4. Add milk and , using a wooden spoon , mix to form dough
5. Using 2 tbsp of the remaining flour , lightly flour work surface
6. Turn dough out onto floured surface and knead , adding remaining 2 tbsp flour as needed , until dough becomes
7. Smooth and elastic , about 5 minutes
8. Using rolling pin , roll dough into 12x8" rectangle , about 1 / 2 " thick
9. Cut dough in half lengthwise
10. Cut each half crosswise into 18 equal slices
11. Dip dough slices into margarine - be sure to use all of the margarine
12. Place on a baking sheet , leaving a space of about 1 inch between each
13. Bake until golden brown , 10 to 15 minutes

title: beverly s favorite beef kebabs
steps:
1. Make the marinade:
2. Pour the oil into a 2-cup measure
3. Add the soy sauce
4. Squeeze the lemon juice through a small strainer into the measuring cup
5. Add the worcestershire sauce , mustard and black pepper
6. Whisk to blend well
7. Peel and coarsely chop the garlic
8. Stir it into the oil mixture
9. Place the beef cubes in a 1-gallon freezer-weight , zipper-top plastic bag
10. Whisk the marinade again to recombine
11. Pour the marinade into the bag with the beef
12. Seal the bag and gently shake to coat the meat with marinade
13. Place the bag flat in the refrigerator to marinate 8 to 24 hours
14. Turn the bag over once halfway through , or more often if possible
15. Place about four cubes on each skewer , leaving a little space between the cubes for even cooking
16. Place the kebabs on a plate or tray
17. Discard the marinade
18. Turn on a gas grill to medium-high
19. Grill the kebabs , turning frequently , to desired doneness
20. Cooking times will vary depending on the size of the meat cubes and the grill
21. Serve at once
22. The number of skewers you will need depends on the size of your meat cubes
23. Cubes typically weigh about 1 ounce each , and we serve four cubes of meat per person for average appetites
24. Start to finish: 15 minutes preparation , plus 8 to 24 hours unattended marinating time and 7 to 8 minutes grilling time

title: balsamic green beans
steps:
1. Place green beans in microwave safe dish with the butter
2. Cover and cook on high for five minutes
3. Add vinegar and parmesan cheese
4. Cook on high five more minutes
5. Stir to make sure the beans are well coated with the vinegar mixture
6. Serve and enjoy !
7. These would work well with fresh green beans too
8. You would just need to adjust the cooking time
9. Ingredient amounts can be adjusted to suit your taste
10. I will sometimes increase the parmesan cheese and use 2 tablespoons of butter

title: sammy s beef and sausage meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In a large bowl , combine beef , sausage , egg , crumbs , onion , water , garlic powder and seasoned salt
3. Mix together until all the ingredients are incorporated
4. Lightly spray baking dish
5. Move meat mixture to baking dish , and press to the sides
6. Squirt ketchup across the top , or spread with a brush
7. Transfer to oven , and bake for 1
8. 25 hours
9. Let stand for 5-10 minutes

title: roasted sweet potato corn chowder
steps:
1. Set the oven rack in the center and preheat the over to 425f oil a large roasting pan
2. Scatter the sweet potatoes in one layer in the roasting pan and drizzle with 1 tb of the oil
3. Season well with salt and pepper
4. Roast until tender , tossing once or twice , 15-20 minutes
5. Reserve 1 cup of corn kernels
6. In a blender , puree the remaining corn with the water until very smooth , about 2 minutes
7. Set aside
8. In a heavy soup pot , heat the remaining tb of oil
9. Cook the celery , onion , and shallots over medium-high heat , stirring frequently , until the onions are slightly softened , about 3 minutes
10. Add the tomato paste and thyme and cook another minute , stirring frequently
11. Add the broth , pureed corn , bay leaf , 1 tsp salt , and pepper to taste
12. While bringing the chowder to a boil , peel the potato , cut it inch inch dice , and add it to the pot
13. Cover the pot and simmer until the potato is tender , 25 to 35 minutes
14. Remove the bay leaf
15. Add the reserved corn kernels , roasted sweet potatoes , and parsley
16. Adjust seasonings

title: raw lasagna  zucchini and tomato
steps:
1. Lemon-filbert ricotta
2. Place the filberts , lemon juice , nutritional yeast , and salt in a food processor , and pulse a few times , until thoroughly combined
3. Gradually add 6 tablespoons water , and pulse until the texture becomes fluffy , like ricotta
4. Place in a bowl , cover with plastic wrap , and set aside
5. Tomato sauce
6. Place all ingredients in a blender , and process until smooth
7. Basil-pine nut pesto
8. Place all ingredients in a blender , and process until smooth
9. Lasagne
10. Using a mandoline or vegetable peeler , shave zucchini lengthwise into very thin slices , then cut in half crosswise
11. Cut the tomatoes in half , and each half into thin slices
12. Line the bottom of a 9-by-13-inch baking dish with two layers of zucchini slices
13. Brush the zucchini lightly with olive oil , spread 1 / 3 of the tomato sauce over it , and top with small dollops of ricotta and pesto , using 1 / 3 of each
14. Layer on 1 / 3 of the tomato slices , and sprinkle with 1 / 3 of the oregano and thyme
15. Add another double layer of zucchini and repeat twice more with the tomato sauce , pesto , ricotta , tomato slices , and herbs
16. Serve immediately , or cover with plastic and let sit at room temperature for a few hours
17. Garnish with basil

title: lighter eggnog pudding
steps:
1. Combine dry pudding mix with milk using a whisk to beat well
2. Fold in cool whip and brandy extract to blend
3. Spoon into 4 glass goblets or custard dishes and grate a bit of fresh nutmeg over the top of each
4. Chill at least 20 minutes

title: brown rice stir fry with flavored tofu and vegetables
steps:
1. In a large skillet or wok , heat the olive oil over medium-high heat
2. Add garlic , ginger , & red pepper flakes
3. Stir-fry until fragrant , about 30 seconds
4. Add tofu
5. Stir-fry until golden brown , about 2 minutes
6. Add red and yellow peppers
7. Cook , stirring , until peppers are crisp-tender , about 3 minutes
8. Add rice and soy sauce
9. Cook , stirring occasionally , until rice is heated through , about 3 minutes
10. Stir in sesame oil & sesame seeds , if using
11. Season with salt and pepper
12. Garnish with scallions
13. Serve hot

title: surprisingly sweet tortilla dip
steps: 1. Beat ingredients together until fluffy , this takes a few minutes

title: broccoli and cheddar frittata
steps:
1. Preheat the broiler
2. Combine the whole eggs , egg whites , and water in a medium bowl and whisk well
3. In a medium ovenproof nonstick skillet , heat the oil over medium heat
4. Add the onion and cook , stirring until it begins to soften , about 3 minutes
5. Add the broccoli and cook for another 2 minutes
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Pour the egg mixture over the vegetables in the skillet , covering them evenly
8. Reduce the heat to medium-low , cover , and let cook until the egg mixture has set around the edges of the pan but is still somewhat liquid in the middle , about 8 minutes
9. Sprinkle with the cheese
10. Place the skillet under the broiler about 2 inches from the heat until the surface is set and golden brown , 1 to 2 minutes
11. Be careful not to overcook or the egg mixture will become tough
12. Cut the frittata into 8 wedges and serve

title: apple tea
steps:
1. Sprinkle lemon juice on peels
2. Dry the peels in a dehydrator or warm oven on parchment paper with oven door ajar
3. They are ready when they are brittle and lightly browned
4. Crumble peelings and store in airtight container

title: spinach and bulgar salad
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine bulgur and 1 and a 1 / 2 cups boiling water
2. Let stand until bulgur is tender to bite , about 15 minutes
3. Meanwhile , stack spinach leaves and cut into 1 / 4-inch-wide strips
4. Place spinach , onions , dill , and cheese in a wide bowl
5. Pour bulgur into a fine strainer and press out the excess water
6. Add bulgur to bowl with spinach
7. Mix vinegar and oil
8. Add to salad and mix
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste

title: apple spice cake with caramel sauce
steps:
1. In mixer , put in oil , sugar , eggs
2. Mix
3. Sift together the flour , cinnamon , baking soda and salt
4. Add to the oil mixture and mix well
5. Chop the apples and walnuts
6. Stir in the apples and walnuts
7. Bake at 350 about 80 minutes
8. Sauce: cook the brown sugar , butter and pinch of salt on top of stove until thick
9. Pour over cooled cake

title: red wine couscous
steps:
1. Combine garlic and olive oil in small saucepan with tight-fitting lid
2. Add red pepper flakes if desired
3. Cook briefly over medium heat , until garlic becomes fragrant
4. Add couscous to pan
5. Saute over medium heat until golden brown , approximately 5 minutes
6. Add capers , red wine , and water
7. Season with salt and pepper to paste
8. Bring mixture to a boil
9. Cover and remove from heat
10. Let stand 4-5 minutes
11. Fluff with a fork before serving

title: orange roughy
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Spray pan with nonstick cooking spray
3. Arrange filets in a single layer
4. Mix cheese and margarine
5. Spread over filets
6. Sprinkle with onion
7. Bake for 10 minutes or until fish flakes

title: easy custard
steps:
1. Heat cream , 6 t
2. Sugar and salt in a heavy saucepan over medium heat until simmering , stirring occasionally to dissolve sugar
3. Meanwhile , whisk egg yolks in medium bowl until thoroughly combined
4. Whisk in remaining 2 t
5. Sugar until sugar begins to dissolve
6. Whisk in cornstarch until misture is pale yellow and thick , about 30 seconds
7. When cream mixture reaches full simmer , gradually whisk half into yolk mixture to temper
8. Return mixture to saucepan , scraping bowl with rubber spatula
9. Return to simmer over medim heat , whisking constantly , until 3 or 4 bubbles burst on surface and mixture is thickened , about 1 minute
10. Off heat , whisk in butter and vanilla
11. Transfer mixture to bowl , press plastic wrap directly on surface and refrigerate until set , at least 3 hours or up to 2 days

title: glhwein  non alcoholic version
steps:
1. Slowly heat the apple juice and tea in a pan
2. Squeeze the juice from the lemon and orange , keeping the peels
3. Add the lemon and orange juices , sugar , peels , and spices to the pan and heat without boiling
4. Carefully strain the mixture through a sieve and serve

title: scallops with fruit salsa
steps:
1. In bowl combine all salsa ingredients and mix well
2. The sweet vs tart balance can be adjusted to your taste by adding more sugar or lime juice
3. Sprinkle each side of the scallops with salt , pepper and sugar
4. In skillet , melt butter over medium high heat
5. Right when butter starts to turn color , add scallops and cook 1 1 / 2-2 minutes on each side or until they are lightly browned
6. Transfer scallops to plate and serve with salsa

title: crispy vanilla caramel popcorn
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300f
2. In a 4-quart dutch oven , heat and stir the brown sugar , granulated sugar , vegetable oil spread , and salt over medium heat until just boiling and sugar is dissolved
3. Stir in vanilla
4. Add popcorn and toss to coat
5. Spread coated popcorn in a shallow roasting pan
6. Bake , uncovered , for 15 minutes , stirring once
7. Transfer popcorn to a large piece of foil or a large roasting pan to cool

title: lentil and sausage soup
steps:
1. Rinse and drain lentils , but do not soak
2. Place all ingredients in a slow cooker , stir together
3. Cover and cook on low for 6-7 hours
4. Stir well before serving

title: sauerbraten  karl ratzsch s old world restaurant style
steps:
1. Trim meat of all but a thin layer of fat
2. Place in a glass bowl
3. Add water , vinegar , sugar , onions , celery , salt , pepper and pickling spices to bowl
4. Stir to mix
5. Cover with plastic wrap
6. Refrigerate 3 to 5 days , turning meat each day
7. Remove meat from marinade
8. Reserve marinade
9. Pat meat dry with paper toweling
10. Heat shortening in dutch oven
11. Brown meat on all sides
12. Remove fat from pan
13. Pour marinade over meat
14. Roast uncovered at 350 degrees for 30 minutes
15. Cover
16. Continue roasting 2 1 / 2- 3 hours , or until meat is tender
17. Remove meat to platter
18. Strain marinade
19. Remove fat and return marinade to pan
20. Stir in gingersnap crumbs
21. Heat until thickened
22. Strain again
23. Slice meat and serve with gravy

title: low fat ambrosia salad
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Toss to mix well
3. Chill at least 2 hours to allow flavors to blend

title: orange street inn oatmeal souffle
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Butter a 1 1 / 2 quart souffle dish or casserole , then cover the butter with a little sugar to coat it , like flouring a greased cake pan
3. Scald milk and the 2 tablespoons of butter by heating together in a small saucepan until just below boiling
4. Slowly add the oatmeal , stirring constantly and continue cooking until thick , stirring often
5. Remove from heat and then add neufchatel , salt , sugar , and spices , stirring briskly until cheese is melted
6. Beat the 3 yolks slightly and add to oatmeal mixture , stirring constantly
7. Stir in raisins and nuts
8. Beat egg whites until stiff but still moist
9. Fold into oatmeal mixture with a rubber spatula
10. Do not over-fold , fold only until no large lumps of whites remain
11. Spoon the mixture into the prepared souffle dish
12. Bake 35 to 40 minutes until mostly set but the center still trembles a little
13. Serve immediately with cream or warm milk
14. Variation: for a more savory oatmeal bacon souffle , omit sugar after buttering dish
15. Omit spices , raisins , and nuts
16. Instead , add 1 cup crisp , crumbled bacon , 1 1 / 4 teaspoon prepared mustard , and tabasco to taste

title: santa fe beans and rice
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In a large bowl , combine beans , corn , tomatoes , salsa , sour cream , 1 cup cheese and cooked rice
3. Season with salt and pepper
4. Transfer to a greased 2 quart baking dish and top with onions and olives
5. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes
6. Sprinkle with remaining 1 cup cheese and bake 5-10 minutes longer until cheese is melted

title: real spanish gazpacho from spain
steps:
1. Rinse well the tomatoes , take off the stems
2. Peel the garlic clove
3. Peel the onion , chop in 3-4 pieces
4. Rinse the pepper , get rid of any single seed , chop coarsely
5. Peel well the cucumber , no green left
6. Place the piece of bread in a bowl with water in order to soak it
7. Once soaked , put all water away , squeeze the soaked bread with your bare hands as much as you can and set aside
8. In a good blender or food processor put the tomatoes , the garlic , onion , pepper , cucumber , squeezed bread
9. Add remaining ingredients and crush all up at the highest speed and power your machine can work
10. No temperature please ! go on until no minimum little piece of anything can be noticed when you try the gazpacho
11. It must be creamy and with some consistency , not watery like
12. Pour it in a jar or bowl and let it chill in your fridge
13. The chilliest the better
14. Do not freeze ! serve it in bowls as a first course for any meal
15. Always try the cucumber before adding it
16. If it is sour , your gazpacho will be ruined
17. For the best results , use spanish olive oil
18. Italian could suit , but believe me ours is much better , though not so well known
19. Keeps well in fridge for a week , guess it won't last you a day , so good it is !

title: tri colour sweet pepper soup
steps:
1. Sometimes , however , i like to "mix things up"
2. For my second version , i reduce the chicken broth to 4 cups , add 1 can diced tomatoes , 1-2 teaspoons of dijon mustard , and 1 cup of sour cream
3. It is a thicker , heartier soup that is equally enjoyable , just different
4. Melt one tablespoon of the butter over medium heat in a large dutch oven
5. Sweat the onions for 5 minutes until translucent and slightly yellow
6. I keep them covered during this process
7. If necessary , add additional tablespoon of butter so the onions do not burn
8. Add the three different coloured peppers , stirring well , to mix the soft onions and butter with the peppers
9. Set timer for 15 minutes
10. Every 5 minutes , stir the peppers and onions and "taste test" the peppers to your degree of doneness
11. We really enjoy a very soft pepper so it takes the full 15 minutes to achieve that texture
12. Add the six cups of chicken broth and the teaspoon of paprika and stir well , until combined
13. Bring the soup to a boil , reduce down to a simmer and cover
14. Every 5 minutes , gently stir the soup
15. Simmer for 30 minutes
16. If you choose to make this a richer soup , use an immersion stick blender to blend up the soup until it is coloured flecks of the peppers
17. Add the sour cream and dijon mustard , stir well until heated
18. Do not boil !
19. Serve immediately

title: ragout of veal with mushrooms marsala
steps:
1. On high heat brown veal in 1 t each oil and butter
2. Set aside
3. To hot pan add remaining oil and butter
4. On med heat cook onion , mushrooms and thyme for 4 minutes
5. Add marsala
6. Stir in soup , water , paprika , salt and pepper
7. Return veal and juices accumulated to pan
8. Reduce heat to low , cover and simmer for 1 hour , , stirring occasionally
9. Uncover and simmer for 20 minutes more , until veal is very tender and sauce has thickened to desired consistency

title: ann s penne pasta salad
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients and toss with dressing
2. Add extra dressing if it gets dried out

title: lemon pickle   jamie oliver s
steps:
1. Wash and deseed the lemons and cut into bite size pieces , leaving the skin on
2. Fry the mustard seeds in the hot oil
3. As they begin to pop add the curry leaves and the urad dal
4. Lower the heat and cook until brown , then add the vinegar
5. Cook until the dal is soft - test one as they will be really hard if not cooked through
6. Stir in the lemon , cook for a bit and then remove from the heat and allow to cool
7. This can be stored in the fridge for a few days if you wish

title: quick cioppino
steps:
1. Heat oil in large , heavy pot over medium-high heat
2. Add next 4 ingredients
3. Saute 6 minutes
4. Add tomatoes , clam juice , and wine
5. Bring to boil
6. Reduce heat to medium
7. Simmer 18 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. Add all seafood and 2 tablespoons parsley
9. Simmer until seafood is opaque in center , about 3 minutes
10. Season to taste with salt and pepper
11. Ladle into bowls and sprinkle with parsley

title: pillsbury crescent rolls
steps:
1. In large bowl dissolve yeast in warm water with the honey to proof
2. Stir sugar , salt , eggs , lard and 1 / 2 flour into yeast mixture
3. Add remaining flour and blend till smooth
4. Cover with wet towel in warm place till doubled , about 1 1 / 2 hours
5. Divide dough in half and roll each into 12 inch circle , 1 / 4 inch thick
6. Spread with butter and cut into 16 wedges
7. Roll up each wedge beginning at the largest end
8. Put on baking sheet
9. Cover until double , about 1 hour
10. Bake at 400 for 12 to 15 minutes
11. Brush with butter

title: schweinsteak   grilled pork filets
steps:
1. In heavy plastic ziplock bag mix vinegar , ketchup , oil , onion , garlic , mustard , pepper and sugar
2. Add herbs and tabasco
3. Marinade steaks for at least 4 hours , then grill 4-5 minutes each side
4. Serve on hard-crust broetchen
5. Try this one with dijon , or duesseldorf mustard

title: chicken peanut soup
steps:
1. In a large pot , saute the chicken , onion , and garlic in sesame oil until the chicken is cooked
2. Add the curry powder , salt , pepper , and red pepper flakes and saute 1 minute more
3. Add the chicken broth , tomato paste , and tomatoes
4. Simmer about 30 minutes to combine flavors
5. Add peanut butter , stirring until well combined
6. Heat until very hot but not boiling

title: harvest pear crumb pie
steps:
1. Mix together brown sugar , cornstarch , cinnamon , ginger , salt , nutmeg , pear slices and lemon juice
2. Mix well
3. Pour into pastry shell
4. Bake at 400 degrees for 25 minutes
5. Topping: mix together flour and brown sugar
6. With a pastry blender , cut in butter until mixture is crumbly
7. Sprinkle over pie filling
8. Bake 40 minutes longer
9. Cover edges of pie crust with foil during last 15 minutes to prevent getting too brown

title: veggie loaded tuna salad
steps:
1. Combine mayo , honey mustard , relish , s alt and pepper , and mix well
2. Then stir the tuna into this mixture
3. Finally , fold in all the veggies
4. If you like , season to taste with some more salt and pepper
5. Mmmmmm !

title: greek spinach pie  spanakopita
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Lightly oil a 9x9 inch square baking pan
3. Heat 3 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat
4. Saute onion , green onions and garlic , until soft and lightly browned
5. Stir in spinach and parsley , and continue to saute until spinach is limp , about 2 minutes
6. Remove from heat and set aside to cool
7. In a medium bowl , mix together eggs , ricotta , and feta
8. Stir in spinach mixture
9. Lay 1 sheet of phyllo dough in prepared baking pan , and brush lightly with olive oil
10. Lay another sheet of phyllo dough on top , brush with olive oil , and repeat process with two more sheets of phyllo
11. The sheets will overlap the pan
12. Spread spinach and cheese mixture into pan and fold overhanging dough over filling
13. Brush with oil , then layer remaining 4 sheets of phyllo dough , brushing each with oil
14. Tuck overhanging dough into pan to seal filling
15. Bake in preheated oven for 30 to 40 minutes , until golden brown
16. Cut into squares and serve while hot

title: weight watchers maple mustard pork tenderloin with caramelized
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Trim fat from pork
3. Place pork on a broiler pan coated with cooking spray
4. Combine mustard , 2 tbsp maple syrup , rosemary , salt and pepper in small bowl
5. Brush over pork
6. Insert meat thermometer into thickest part of pork
7. Bake at 425f for 25 minutes or until thermometer registers 160f
8. While pork is baking , heat nonstick skillet over medium-high heat untilpar hot
9. Add apples , and saute 5 minutes or until lightly browned
10. Reduce heat to low , and add 4 tbsp maple syrup
11. Simmer 10 minutes or until apples are tender , stirring occasionally
12. Cut pork crosswise into slices
13. Spoon cooked apples over pork

title: goulash ala marlin
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to directions on package , drain and set aside
2. Brown meat , bell pepper , onion and garlic until meat is browned
3. Season with lawry's and pepper
4. Drain off any fat
5. Add next six ingredients to skillet and let simmer a few minutes
6. Combine pasta , and meat / tomato mixture in a large pot and let simmer over very low heat for about 1 / 2 hour to let flavors meld

title: curried butternut soup
steps:
1. Simmer butternut in chicken stock in a covered pot until soft , then pure
2. Melt butter in pan and fry the onion and mushroom in the butter until soft
3. Add flour and curry powder and stir over low heat for about four minutes
4. Add butternut to the onion and mushroom mix and bring to a gentle boil
5. Add salt , black pepper and sugar
6. Stir in the yoghurt and the brandy , but don't let it boil
7. Serve in heated soup dishes

title: hamburger barley vegetable soup
steps:
1. In 6 quart stock pot , brown ground beef
2. Stir in remaining ingredients
3. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat , cover , and simmer approximately 1 hour
4. Remove bay leaves before serving
5. Keeps well
6. Easy to reheat

title: macaroni bake  low cal
steps:
1. Preheat oven 350f
2. Saut onions in margarine , add flour
3. Stir in milk , little at a time until thick
4. Add spices
5. Add cheese
6. Add macaroni
7. Pour into shallow pan
8. Top with crumbs and paprika
9. Bake 45 minutes

title: lemon coconut squares
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine flour and confectioners' sugar
2. Cut in the butter until crumbly
3. Press onto the bottom of a lightly greased 13-in
4. X 9-in
5. X 2-in
6. Baking pan
7. Bake at 350 degrees f for 15 minutes
8. Meanwhile , in a mixing bowl , beat the eggs , sugar , lemon juice and baking powder until well mixed
9. Pour over crust
10. Sprinkle coconut evenly over the top
11. Bake at 350 degrees f for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown
12. Cool on a wire rack
13. Cut into bars

title: southwestern bean soup  crock pot
steps:
1. Combine broth , beans , undrained tomatoes , corn , carrot , onion , chili peppers , chili powder , and garlic in a crock pot
2. Cover and cook on low-heat setting for 10 to 12 hours or on high-heat setting for 5 to 6 hours
3. Dumplings:
4. Stir together flour , cornmeal , baking powder , and pepper in a medium sized bowl
5. Mix together egg white , milk , and oil in a small bowl
6. Add to flour mixture and stir with a fork just until combined
7. Divide dumpling mixture into 6 mounds and drop on top of the bubbling soup
8. Cover and cook on low-heat setting for 30 minutes more or on high-heat setting for 20 minutes more or until a wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
9. Serve in bowls with 1 dumpling for each serving

title: parmesan cream sauce
steps:
1. Melt butter in sauce pan with cream cheese
2. Add whipping cream mix well bring to a simmer
3. Add 3 / 4c of parmesan cheese
4. Let simmer for 30 minutes

title: cranberry sauce   sugar free
steps:
1. Combine cranberries , water and splenda in a pan over medium-high heat
2. Bring to a boil , and boil hard until cranberries pop
3. Keep in a tightly covered jar in the fridge

title: quick hamburger stew soup
steps:
1. Cook the ground beef , onion , garlic
2. Puree tomatoes in blender , or puree half and leave some in pieces
3. Put cooked beef , tomatoes , water , bouillon , and pepper in large pot
4. Bring to a boil and reduce to low
5. Simmer uncovered 20 minutes
6. Add orzo and vegetables , simmer 15 more minutes
7. Adjust seasoning to taste
8. Serve with french bread or crusty rolls !

title: basic cheese toast
steps:
1. Place 2 pieces of bread on a cookie sheet
2. Cover each slice with one slice of cheese
3. Be careful to align the square shape of the cheese with the square shape of the bread so that no cheese drips off the bread
4. Place in the oven under the broiler and broil for 2 to 3 minutes
5. Watch for the cheese to bubble but not brown
6. Remove from oven
7. Carefully move the toast so that it is propped up on one side (fork , plate , pan edge
8. This allows the steam to escape from the bottom of the bread so that it isn't soggy toast
9. Do not flip the toast over , the cheese is still melty and sticky
10. For toddlers , allow to cool until the cheese is no longer stringy or oozy
11. Cut into diagonal quarters
12. Great served with fresh fruit or tomato soup

title: brussels sprouts with frizzled prosciutto
steps:
1. Heat oil in a skillet over med-high heat
2. Add prosciutto to skillet , half at a time , and cook until crisp
3. Remove from skillet
4. Reduce heat to medium
5. Add butter and shallots to skillet
6. Cook and stir about 2 mins or until shallots begin to soften
7. Add brussels sprouts , salt , and pepper and cook for 6-8 mins or until heated through
8. Add vinegar and stir to coat
9. Transfer brussels sprouts to a serving bowl , top with prosciutto and serve

title: best ever meatballs in tomato sauce
steps:
1. To make meatballs: in a bowl , stir rice into 4 cups boiling water
2. Set aside for 30 minutes to soak
3. Drain well
4. Return rice to bowl
5. Add remaining ingredients , except oil , and mix well
6. Form into 16 balls , each about 2 inch in diameter
7. In a large nonstick skillet , heat oil over medium high heat
8. Add meatballs , in batches , and brown on all sides
9. Transfer to slow cooker
10. Drain all but 1 tablespoon fat from pan
11. To make tomato sauce: reduce heat to medium
12. Add onions to pan and cook , stirring until softened
13. Add garlic , oregano , salt , peppercorns and cinnamon stick and cook , stirring , for 1 minute
14. Stir in tomatoes and lemon juice and bring to a boil , breaking up tomatoes with a spoon as they cook
15. Pour sauce over meatballs
16. Cover and cook on high 4 hours or on low for 8 hours , until meatballs are no longer pink inside
17. Discard cinnamon stick

title: coffee concentrate
steps:
1. Mix the coffee and the water
2. Leave it on the counter overnight
3. Strain in the morning , preferably through cheesecloth
4. For hot coffee just add hot water to taste to 1 / 4 cup of the concentrate mixture
5. To make iced coffee , stir together 1 / 4 cup each of coffee concentrate and water
6. If desired , stir in milk and sugar
7. Serve over ice
8. It should keep for 2-3 weeks in the fridge

title: walk tall
steps:
1. Mix the vermouth , gin , campari , orange liqueur and orange juice well and pour into a highball glass full of ice cubes
2. Top with a splash of club soda if you like and decorate with a twist of orange peel

title: butter brickle cookies
steps:
1. Cream sugars , shortening , eggs , and vanilla
2. Spoon flour into measuring cup , level off , add dry ingredients to creamed mixture
3. Mix well
4. Stir in mini chocolate chips and bits of brittle
5. Drop on greased cookie sheet
6. Bake at 350f for 12-15 minutes
7. Makes 5 dozen

title: asian fetish
steps:
1. Pour gin into a tall glass filled with ice
2. Add grenadine , and fill to the top with sweet and sour mix and sprite or 7-up
3. Top with a generous dash of chambord liqueur , garnish with a cherry , stir , and serve

title: maple apple dip
steps:
1. In a blender or food processor , blend together the tofu , cinnamon , vanilla , and maple syrup until smooth
2. Spoon into a small bowl and use as a dip for the slices of apple and other fruit

title: most refreshing lemonade you will ever taste    quick   easy
steps:
1. Combine lemon juice , sugar and club soda stirring well to dissolve sugar
2. Add sliced lemon to pitcher
3. Chill
4. Enjoy !

title: chicken  mozzarella   pepper tarts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f
2. In a non-stick skillet , stir cook the chicken just until it turns white
3. Add the onion , pepper , tomatoes and basil
4. Continue to stir cook until the onions are tender
5. Remove from the heat and let cool
6. Stir the mozzarella into the cooled chicken mixture then fill the tart shells
7. Bake in the oven for 20-25 minutes or until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is bubbly

title: caribbean jerk turkey meat loaf
steps:
1. In small cup or bowl , combine water and couscous
2. Cover and allow to stand 5 minutes plus or until couscous has absorbed all water
3. In small non-stick skillet , over medium-high heat , saute red bell pepper , thyme , curry powder , cumin , allspice , ginger , salt , black pepper , paprika and cayenne pepper in oil 1 to 2 minutes
4. Allow to cool
5. In medium bowl , combine turkey , bell pepper mixture and couscous
6. Shape mixture into a round loaf using a 9-inch pie plate or a rectangular loaf using a 8-by-4-by-2-inch pan
7. Spray pan with vegetable cooking spray
8. Bake at 350 degrees f for 35 to 45 minutes or until meat thermometer reaches 165 degrees f when inserted in the center of the loaf and juices run clear

title: mock tuna salad sandwich
steps:
1. Rip nori into smaller pieces and place in a food processor
2. Process until finely chopped
3. Add in chickpeas and pulse until coarsely chopped
4. Place chickpeas in a bowl
5. Chop green onions and add to chickpeas
6. Add in vegenaise , kelp , and season to taste with salt and pepper
7. Keep cold until ready to serve
8. Spread on whole grain bread

title: long grain rice  crock pot
steps:
1. Pour all ingredients into a greased slow cooker and cover
2. Cook on high 2-3 hours or until rice is tender , but not overcooked
3. Stir occasionally

title: pumpkin bread with crumble nut topping   gluten free
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a large loaf pan
3. Beat together butter , sugar , egg and pumpkin
4. Add remaining bread ingredients
5. Pour into prepared loaf pan
6. Combine topping ingredients
7. Sprinkle over bread
8. Bake for 50-60 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean

title: parmesan bean fettuccine
steps:
1. Bring water to a boil
2. While water heats , steam beans until they are tender crisp , about 3 minutes
3. Melt butter in a saute pan and saute canadian bacon until browned , 2-3 minutes
4. Add beans and toss to coat
5. Keep warm
6. Cook pasta in boiling water until al dente
7. Drain well and toss with beans and bacon in a large bowl
8. Add parmesan cheese and cream to hot pasta and toss
9. Season to taste with salt and pepper
10. Serve immediately

title: empanada
steps:
1. Mix beaten eggs , water , salt and sugar and mix well
2. Add this to the flour and knead well until very smooth
3. Let rest for 10-15 minutes
4. Roll on board slightly dusted with cornstarch until very thin
5. With pork lard brush surface thoroughly
6. Start rolling tightly as jelly roll
7. Cut very fine around 2 mm
8. Set aside
9. On the same dough , pinch a portion and make as many as the ojadre put the ojadre on top of the small ones , brush with melted lard , cover with banan leaf as thin as posible to a round form
10. Put 1 tbsp filling in the center , put 1 sliced of hard boiled eggs , form the empanada , as turnover , flute the edges and fry in deep hot fat until golden brown
11. To prepare filling: heat lard , add garlic , onions and ground pork
12. Cook for a while
13. Add diced potatoes and all the ingredients , cook until all ingredients are tender
14. Season to taste
15. Add 4 tbsp flour , stir very welll until all ingredients have blended
16. Let cook until ready to use

title: mandarin sorbet over lychees
steps:
1. Combine sugar and water and heat over low heat until sugar has dissolved
2. Bring to boil before cooling
3. Make mandarin puree by blending or pushing mandarin orages through sieve
4. Add puree with juice and liqeur to sugar syrup
5. Combine well
6. Pour into pan and freeze till firm
7. Stir occasionally
8. To serve , place a few extra mandarin segments in a glass , followed by a few chilled lychee on top , 2 tbsp of the canned lychee syrup , and a scoop of mandarin orange sorbet
9. Place a sprig of mint on top of you like !

title: corn  pops snack mix
steps:
1. Pour melted butter in a large mixing bowl
2. Add the worcestershire sauce , onion salt , oregano , dill and corn pops
3. Mix well to coat the cereal
4. Pour into a 12 x 9 pan and bake for 15 minutes at 350 , stirring every 5 minutes
5. You may also add pecans or peanuts to this mix !

title: angel cake with tipsy raspberries
steps:
1. Mix thawed berries with grand marnier
2. Marinate in the refrigerator for 2-3 hours
3. Puree about 1 / 3 of the berries
4. Stir in the whole berries and bring to room temperature
5. Cut angel cake into desired number of slices
6. Spoon berries mixture over angel cake and serve

title: creamy cabbage soup
steps:
1. In a stockpot or dutch oven , saute onions and garlic until softened
2. Add cabbage , potatoes , ham and paprika
3. Pour in chicken broth , and add a little water if needed to cover ham and vegetables
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat and simmer , covered , until potatoes are tender , about 20 minutes
6. Drain , reserving liquid
7. Set aside cabbage , potatoes and ham in a bowl
8. With the butter and flour make a roux in your stockpot or dutch oven
9. Slowly add reserved liquid , stirring constantly over medium heat until sauce thickens slightly
10. Add salt and pepper to taste
11. Stir in the cooked vegetables and meat and simmer a few minutes to heat through

title: creamy pumpkin vanilla milkshake
steps:
1. In blender , combine all ingredients
2. Blend until well mixed
3. Serve

title: super soft snickerdoodle cookies
steps:
1. Mix butter , 1 1 / 2 cups sugar , and eggs in a bowl
2. In a separate bowl , mix flour , cream of tartar , baking powder , and salt
3. Mix the two bowls together
4. Roll together and wrap in cling film
5. Freeze for at least 10-15 minutes
6. To cook: heat oven to 350 degrees
7. Unwrap and slice off as many 1 / 2 inch disks as you feel like eating
8. Mix together 1 tablespoon sugar and 1 tablespoon cinnamon
9. Coat cookies with cinnamon sugar mix and bake for 10 minutes
10. Enjoy !

title: chicken yeffa
steps:
1. Combine mustard , pineapple juice , and brown sugar in a small bowl until sugar is dissolved
2. Slice each chicken breast to create two evenly sized pieces from each breast
3. Wrap each chicken breast with a slice of bacon , and secure with a small skewer or toothpicks
4. Brush the mustard sauce over the bacon and the chicken
5. Grill over hot coals about 10 minutes , turning frequently and brushing with additional sauce
6. Remove chicken from grill when cooked through
7. In a small saucepan , heat remaining sauce until boiling , then spoon over chicken to serve

title: easy cherry tarts
steps:
1. Place crescent dough on a lightly floured surface
2. Seal seams
3. Cut into 2 inches circles
4. Place in greased mini muffin cups
5. In a small mixing bowl , beat cream cheese and confectioners' sugar until smooth
6. Place about 1 / 2 teaspoons in each cup
7. Combine pie filling and extract
8. Place about 2 teaspoons in each cup
9. Bake 375 degrees for 12-14 minute or until edges are lightly browned
10. Remove to wire racks to cool
11. Refrigerate until serving

title: beef and potato moussaka
steps:
1. Cut the potatoes in quarters and boil in water until almost soft
2. Let cool , then slice into 1 / 4 inch slices
3. Heat the oil in a large skillet , and saute the onion and garlic for 4-5 minutes
4. Add the beef to the skillet and brown for 5 mins , stir in the wine , tomato paste , oregano , and parsley , reduce the heat and simmer for 15 minutes remove from heat
5. To make the sauce , melt the butter in a small saucepan
6. Stir in the flour and cook over low heat for 2-3 mins
7. Slowly whisk in the milk , cooking for 6-8 mins until thickened
8. Remove from the heat and add the parmesan
9. Grease an 11x7 inch casserole
10. Put in the beef mixture , then cover with potato slices
11. Pour the sauce on top
12. Mix together the parmesan and breadcrumbs and sprinkle over the top of the casserole
13. Bake in a 350 oven for 30 mins or until golden

title: irishman s omelet
steps:
1. Fry the bacon until crisp and remove to a plate
2. Drain most of the bacon grease from the pan
3. Fry the onion in the remaining bacon fat until translucent
4. Add potatoes , bacon , herbs
5. Salt & pepper to taste
6. Pour in the eggs cover and cook over medium heat until the eggs are set
7. Flip onto a plate and serve

title: crocked bacon wrapped chicken
steps:
1. Wrap each chicken breast with a slice of bacon and secure with a toothpick
2. Combine the sour cream and mushroom soup and mushrooms
3. Pour over the chicken breasts
4. Cook on low in the crock pot or 8-10 hours or on high for 6-8 hours

title: hawaiian wrapped chicken livers
steps:
1. Cut livers and bacon slices in half
2. Wrap 1 / 2 slice bacon around piece of chicken liver and pineapple chunk
3. Secure with wooden pick
4. Arrange on broiler pan
5. Combine soy sauce , brown sugar and mustard in small bowl
6. Brush over bacon rolls
7. Broil , 6-inches from heat , 15 to 20 minutes turning and brushing with soy / dijon mixture occasionally until bacon is crisp and chicken livers are done

title: flatbread with zaatar
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 160c
2. Brush pita or lebanese bread with garlic flavoured olive oil and sprinkle generously with zaatar
3. Warm in the oven for 5 minutes
4. Cut into wedges and serve with dips or as an accompaniment to a main meal

title: honey spice cake with rum glaze   emeril lagasse
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease and flour 1 tube pan or 1 fluted tube or bundt pan
3. Sift the cake flour , baking powder , baking soda , ginger , cinnamon , cloves , and salt together , then sift again into a large bowl
4. In another large bowl , beat the butter with an electric mixer on high speed until creamy
5. Gradually add the honey and 1 / 4 cup of the sugar to the butter and beat on high speed until well mixed , 2 to 4 minutes
6. Beat in the egg yolks , 1 at a time
7. Beat on low and add the flour mixture in 3 parts , alternating with the yogurt in 2 parts
8. Beat until smooth , scraping down the sides of the bowl as necessary
9. In another large bowl , beat the egg whites until soft peaks form
10. Gradually add the remaining 1 / 4 cup sugar , beating on high speed , until stiff
11. Fold the egg whites into the batter
12. Pour the batter into the prepared pan and bake until a tester comes out clean , 45 to 55 minutes
13. Let the cake cool in the pan on a wire rack for 10 minutes and then invert the cake onto the rack and allow to cool completely
14. In a small bowl combine the powdered sugar and rum and stir to combine
15. Mixture should be a stiff glaze
16. If the glaze is too thick , thin with a bit of milk
17. Using a spoon , drizzle the glaze all over the cake in a random pattern
18. Let the cake sit until the glaze has hardened
19. Serve

title: fantastic feta chicken
steps:
1. Arrange chicken in 13x9-inch baking dish
2. Drizzle with 1 tablespoon of the juice
3. Sprinkle with oregano and pepper
4. Top with cheese
5. Drizzle with remaining 1 tablespoon juice
6. Bake at 350f for 30 to 35 minutes or until cooked through

title: sauted mushrooms in cream sauce  german style
steps:
1. Slice the mushrooms in half if they are large , set aside
2. Fry bacon in a large pan until lightly browned
3. Remove from pan and set on a papertowel lined plate to drain
4. Add the butter to pan drippings along with the onions
5. Saute until lightly browned
6. Next add mushrooms and cook until tender , stirring often
7. Stir in wine & spices , cover with lid and simmer over low heat for 15 minutes
8. Take off the heat then stir in the cream , lemon juice , & bacon
9. Reheat until just warm
10. Do not let the mixture come to a boil ! garnish with parsley

title: james beard s baking powder biscuits
steps:
1. Sift flour into mixing bowl with baking powder and salt
2. Using fingers , two knives , or a heavy fork , blend butter and flour into very fine particles
3. Add milk and stir just enough to ake particles cling together -- it will be a very soft dough
4. Turn on to floured surface and knead for about 1 minute
5. Drop dough by large spoonfuls on to a baking sheet spritzed with baking spray
6. Bake at 450 for 12-15 minutes

title: korean beef
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in container to marinate
2. Cover and refrigerate overnight
3. To barbeque , bbq on high heat one minute each side
4. Or indoors , get skillet very hot
5. Toss in meat and cook over high heat 2 minutes each side
6. Quick fry the onions and add marinade
7. Serve over rice cooked as usual using two cups uncooked rice

title: gluten free blueberry dumplings
steps:
1. Place berries , water , sugar and lemon juice in 4-quart saucepan on stove
2. Bring to gentle boil while preparing dough
3. In mixing bowl , cream sugar and butter
4. Beat in the egg
5. Stir in buttermilk alternately with sifted dry ingredients
6. Do not overbeat- this will be a fairly stiff dough
7. Drop dough by 8 small spoonfuls onto the boiling fruit sauce
8. Cover , turn down to simmer , and cook without removing lid for 20 minutes
9. Serve hot in small bowls with fruit sauce spooned over the dumplings
10. Top with cream , whipped cream , or ice cream

title: chicken  oporto
steps:
1. In a hot frying pan heat half of the butter
2. Add in the mushrooms and onion cook for about 5 minutes along with the garlic
3. Remove and set aside in a bowl or deep dish
4. In a bowl combine the flour salt and pepper to coat chicken breasts on both sides
5. In the same frying pan add in the remaining butter and cook the chicken breasts over medium-high heat , careful not to burn , cook till browned on all sides
6. Now stir in the cream and the port wine , and the mushrooms , bring to a boil , and then reduce heat to low , cover and simmer for 15 minutes or till cooked
7. Pour into a platter and sprinkle chopped parsley over top

title: dad s mazola no roll pie pastry shell
steps:
1. Sift dry ingredients into pie pan
2. Combine mazola and milk in measuring cup
3. Whip with a fork and pour all at once over flour mixture
4. Mix with fork until flour is completely dampened
5. Press evenly and firmly with fingers to line bottom of pan
6. Then press dough up to line sides and partly cover rim
7. Be sure dough is pressed to uniform thickness
8. To flute , pinch dough lightly with fingers
9. Do not use a high fluted edge
10. For baked shell:
11. Prick entire surface with a fork
12. Bake in hot oven 12-15 minutes
13. Cool
14. Fill as desired
15. For unbaked shell:
16. Fill as desired and bake in hot oven 15 minutes
17. Then reduce heat to moderate and bake until filling tests done

title: memphis pork ribs  steven raichlen
steps:
1. Set up your grill for indirect heating at 350 degrees f
2. Place a drip pan in the middle of your coals
3. Remove the silver skin from the ribs with your hands
4. Combine all the rub ingredients and rub 2 / 3 of it on both sides of ribs
5. Place ribs on the grill and close the cover
6. Combine all the ingredients for the mopping sauce
7. After 30 minutes of cooking , mop the ribs with the sauce
8. Repeat mopping every 20 minutes thereafter
9. Continue to cook the ribs until they are tender and the meat has shrunk a bit from the bones , about 1 1 / 2 hours
10. Remove ribs from the grill , once they are done , and place on a cutting board
11. Mop ribs one last time and sprinkle with remaining dry rub
12. Cut into serving size pieces as desired

title: creamy tex mex polenta
steps:
1. In pot , bring 4 cups salted water to boil
2. Reduce heat to medium-low
3. Slowly stir in cornmeal
4. Stir until mixture is thick and creamy , about 5 minutes
5. Stir in butter , 1 cup cheese , scallion , chipotle and salt until cheese and butter are melted
6. Serve sprinkled with remaining 2 t cheese

title: parmesan chive popcorn muffins
steps:
1. Sift flour , measure and sift with baking powder , salt , and sugar
2. Add milk , popped corn , eggs and melted butter
3. Stir in cheese , garlic and chives
4. Fill well-oiled muffin tins 2 / 3 full
5. Bake in pre-heated oven for 20- 25 minutes
6. Makes 12 regular size muffins

title: veal ragout
steps:
1. In 4-quart dutch oven over medium-high heat , in hot oil , cook half of the veal until browned , stirring often
2. Remove
3. Set aside
4. Repeat with remaining veal
5. Pour off fat
6. In same dutch oven , combine soup , water , wine , lemon juice , rosemary , pepper and garlic powder
7. Add carrots
8. Heat to boiling
9. Return veal to dutch oven
10. Reduce heat to low
11. Cover
12. Cook 45 minutes , stirring occasionally
13. Uncover
14. Add mushrooms
15. Cook 15 minutes or until slightly thickened and veal is fork-tender , stirring occasionally
16. If desired , garnish with fresh parsley

title: simmered beef and mushrooms  core
steps:
1. In large skillet , cook beef , onions , mushrooms , and garlic over medium heat for 5-7 minutes
2. Add consommes , worcestershire sauce , and basil
3. Simmer for 50-60 minutes
4. Add fat free sour cream and serve

title: turkish brussel sprouts  bruksel lahanasi
steps:
1. Bring brussel sprouts up to the boil
2. Cook 3 minutes
3. Drain
4. Saute onion in oil
5. Add garlic
6. Add crushed tomatoes , paprika , cubanelle pepper , diced tomato , mushrooms , water , basil , salt , and pepper
7. Cook 10 minutes on medium heat
8. You can add more water if needed

title: boston fruit salad
steps:
1. Tear lettuce into pieces and line bowls
2. In seperate bowl mix fruit , yogurt and sour cream
3. Season with lemon juice and pepper , mix again
4. Spoon fruit over torn lettuce and sprinkle with grated coconut before serving

title: blueberry oat squares
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a saucepan , combine sugar and cornstarch
3. Gradually whisk in water and lemon juice until smooth
4. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly
5. Stir in blueberries
6. Cook and stir for two minutes longer or until thickened and bubbly
7. Remove from the heat and set aside
8. In a bowl , combine the dry cake mix and one cup of the oats
9. Cut in six tablespoons butter until crumbly
10. Set aside one cup of crumb mixture for topping and stir egg into remaining crumb mixture
11. Press into a 13" x 9" x 2" baking dish coated with non-fat cooking spray
12. Spread blueberry mixture to within 1 / 4 inch of edges
13. Combine the brown sugar , remaining oats and reserved crumb mixture
14. Cut in remaining butter until crumbly
15. Sprinkle over top of blueberry mixture
16. Bake at 350 degrees for 30-35 minutes or until golden brown
17. These are best served warm but if you want the bars to stick together it's best to cool before cutting them
18. Enjoy !

title: easy thai satay appy  beef or chicken
steps:
1. Soak bamboo skewers in water for 2 hours
2. Pierce meat strips onto bamboo skewers
3. Combine turmeric powder w / 350 ml of the coconut milk & marinate for at least 60 min
4. Grill satays & use the remaining 50 ml of coconut milk & turmeric mixture to baste during grilling
5. Serve w / heated satay sauce
6. As an entree to serve 2 persons , i'd increase the amt of meat to get 10 skewers to marinate & keep all other ingredients the same

title: beer cheese fondue
steps:
1. Have the cheese at room temp
2. Combine cheeses with cornstarch and mustard
3. Toss to coat
4. Add worcestershire and hot sauce
5. Mix well
6. Heat beer in a sauce pan until just warm
7. Gradually add cheese mixture , stirring constantly over med heat until melted
8. Quickly transfer cheese mixture to a fondue pot
9. Place over fondue burner
10. Spear a bread cube with a fondue fork , piercing the crust last
11. Dip the bread into the cheese mixture , swirling to coat and to keep the mixture in motion so it doesn't set
12. If the mixture thickens while standing , stir in more warm beer

title: canada day banana split milkshakes
steps:
1. Combine bananas , ice cream and milk in blender on high speed until smooth
2. Set aside
3. To decorate glasses , drizzle smucker's strawberry sundae syrup from top inside rim vertically , allowing the syrup to pool in the bottom of the glasses
4. Continue the pattern around the rim of the glass to create a striped effect
5. Pour milkshake into the center of glasses , being careful not to touch the sides
6. Fill almost to the rim
7. Top with whipped cream and maraschino cherry

title: plum tart
steps:
1. Heat oven to 450 degrees
2. With a rolling pin , roll almond paste between two sheets of wax paper into an 8 inch diameter circle
3. Unroll pie crust directly onto baking sheet
4. Peel paper from almond paste and center on top of pie crust
5. Arrange plums over almond paste in a circular pattern -- fill in center ,
6. Mix sugar nutmeg and sliced almonds and sprinkle over top
7. Fold edges of pie dough over plums , crimping dough along the top to hold in place
8. Bake 15 minutes , reduce oven to 375 degrees and bake another 25 minutes
9. Cool on a wire rack
10. Serve warm or at room temperature
11. Spectacular with cinnamon ice cream !

title: hawaiian banana bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees farenheit
2. Cream sugar and margarine
3. Add bananas and eggs
4. Sift cake flour , salt , and baking soda 3 times
5. Blend flour mixture into banana mixture , making sure not to overmix
6. Turn batter into 2 greased 9x5x3-inch loaf pans
7. Bake for 55 minutes , or until toothpick inserted in center of loaf comes out clean
8. Turn out immediately to cool on wire rack

title: port wine jelly
steps:
1. Heat sugar and port wine in top of double boiler over rapidly boiling water , stirring constantly , until sugar is dissolved , about 3 minutes
2. Remove from heat
3. Quickly stir in 1 / 2 bottle liquid pectin
4. Immediately pour jelly into hot sterilized jars , leaving 1 / 2-inch headspace
5. Wipe rims of jars
6. Seal as directed

title: cabbage and onion salad
steps:
1. Alternate layering cabbage and onions in a bowl , with onions for the top layer
2. Combine sugar , vinegar , salt , celery seeds , mustard and pepper in a saucepan
3. Bring to a boil
4. Remove from heat , add salad oil
5. Drip hot mixture over the cabbage and onions , do not stir
6. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours

title: pineapple sesame chicken
steps:
1. Cut chicken into bitesize chucks
2. Drain pineapple , reserving juice
3. Melt butter in large skillet over medium heat
4. Add chicken
5. Saute until browned , about 5 minutes
6. Add pineapple , sesame seeds , corn syrup , soy sauce , lemon juice , ginger and salt
7. Mix well
8. Dissolve cornstarch in reserved pineapple juice in a glass measure
9. Add enough water to equal 2 cups
10. Pour over chicken mixture
11. Simmer mixture over low heat , stirring occasionally , until sauce is thickened and chicken is cooked through , about 20 minutes
12. Serve over rice
13. Garnish with pineapple rings and parsley

title: lamb kebabs with coriander yogurt sauce
steps:
1. Make sauce:
2. Mix , then chill and set aside to serve with meat
3. Stir marinade ingredients together , set aside
4. Cube lamb and lay out in shallow dish / pan
5. Pour marinade over the lamb , and toss to coat
6. Place in fridge , and let marinate for several hours or overnight
7. Drain the meat , skewer , and grill for about 10 minutes , until browned , turning occasionally
8. Grill lemon wedges at the same time
9. Serve kebabs on a platter , garnished with the grilled lemons and extra rosemary sprigs and the bowl of coriander yogurt sauce for dipping

title: creamy cauliflower garlic soup
steps:
1. With a sharp knife , cut top 1 / 2 off garlic head
2. Set garlic on a sheet of foil and top with butter
3. Gather sides of foil up and pinch together to form a loose , sealed pouch
4. Bake garlic in a 400 oven until garlic is soft when pressed , 45 to 50 minutes
5. Unwrap and let stand until cool enough to handle
6. Meanwhile , cut cauliflower heads into 1-inch florets , discard leaves and stems
7. In a 4 to 5-quart pan , combine cauliflower and broth
8. Cover , bring to a simmer over high heat , then reduce heat and simmer until cauliflower is very tender when pierced , 12 to 15 minutes
9. Squeeze garlic cloves from papery skins into pan with cauliflower and broth
10. Pour in cream
11. Working in batches , transfer to a blender and whirl until smooth
12. Return soup to pan and add the nutmeg and salt and pepper to taste
13. Set pan over medium-low heat and stir occasionally until hot
14. Pour into a large bowl or tureen and sprinkle with chives

title: almond tart
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients well
2. Spread in 8 x 8 or pie plate
3. Bake 30 minutes at 350

title: lorilyn s spaghetti sauce
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in dutch oven or large soup pot
2. Bring to a low boil , reduce heat , cover & simmer for 35-40 minutes
3. Add extra water if necessary to achieve the desired thickness
4. I added fully cooked meatballs at the last 5 minutes of simmering & served over cooked spaghetti noodles

title: gizzards and noodles
steps:
1. Rinse and cut in half each gizzard
2. Simmer in water and 2 tsp salt for about 3 hours or until very tender
3. Cook noodles until done , drain and add gizzards , butter and salt and pepper to taste

title: mom s banana bread or muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Either grease and flour a 9" x 5" loaf pan or place 12 cupcake papers in a muffin pan
3. Cream sugar and shortening , beat in eggs then bananas
4. Combine baking soda with milk , stir into creamed mixture
5. Sift flour with salt and spices
6. Add a little at a time to the creamed mixture , beating well after each addition
7. Stir in nuts
8. Pour into prepared pan
9. For muffins , bake for 22 minutes at 350 degrees , or until knife in center comes out clean
10. For loaf , bake for 35 minutes at 350 degrees , then cover with aluminum foil and continue to bake for 25 additional minutes or until knife in center comes out clean

title: diabetic bread and butter pickles
steps:
1. Combine cucumber , onion and garlic in a bowl
2. Sprinkle with pickling salt , cover with ice cubes and let stand at least 6 hours or overnight
3. Drain well
4. Combine vinegar , water , mustard seed , celery seed and tumeric in a large saucepan
5. Bring to a boil and add drained cucumber mixture
6. Return to boil and cook 2 minutes
7. Discard garlic clove
8. Stir in sweetner and put in sterilized jars

title: ragu bolognese
steps:
1. In a large heavy pot heat oil and butter
2. Add onions , celery , carrots , garlic and cook until vegetables are translucent
3. Add the meats and stir , cooking until no longer pink 10-15 minutes
4. Drain excess fat from pan and return to heat
5. Add milk and cook until almost dry , about 10 minutes
6. Add tomatoes and herbs and simmer about 15 minutes
7. Add wine and broth , bring to a boil
8. Lower to simmer , and cook partially covered for 2 1 / 2 hrs , stirring every 30 minutes
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste

title: mashed potato dinner rolls
steps:
1. Mix together yeast , 1 / 2 cup lukewarm water , and 1 tbsp sugar
2. Set aside until foamy
3. Mix together all remaining ingredients in order , except for the flour
4. Stir in one cup of the flour and beat well
5. Add the yeast mixture and another cup of the flour , mixing well
6. Keep adding flour util the mixture forms a smooth , not sticky , ball , adding as much or as little flour as needed to achieve the proper texture
7. Knead well for about 10 minutes , until elastic
8. Place in a greased bowl , flip dough over to coat top , cover tightly with plastic wrap and let dough rise until doubled in a place free of drafts and somehwat warm
9. It may take 1-2 hours to double , depending upon the temperature in your home that day
10. Punch dough down and roll into 25-30 rolls
11. Set rolls into a greased pan , cover with plastic wrap and let rise again until almost doubled , perhaps 40 minutes-1 hour
12. Bake int a preheated 375 f oven for 12-15 minutes

title: low fat panini
steps:
1. Lay bread slices out spread honey dijon mustard on one slice and spray the other with the butter flavored cooking spray
2. Layer the turkey , ham , and cheese slices on the buttered slice of bread and top with the other slice , mustard side down
3. Spray one outer side of sandwich with olive oil cooking spray and place it face down onto a grill pan and put a heavy frying pan on top and press down for a few minutes
4. Spray the top side of sandwich with olive oil cooking spray and flip the sandwich
5. Press again with heavy frying pan for a few minutes , until cheese is melted
6. And enjoy !

title: candy bar squares
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. In medium bowl , stir together all crust ingredients
3. Press on bottom of 9" square baking pan
4. Bake for 12-14 minutes or until edges are very lightly browned
5. Meanwhile , in medium bowl , stir together coconut and sweetened condensed milk
6. Pour over hot crust
7. Continue baking for 12-17 minutes or edges are lightly browned and center is set
8. Place candy bars on top of baked filling to cover entire surface
9. Continue baking for 4-5 minutes or until chocolate is melted
10. Spread chocolate over bars
11. Cool completely , until chocolate is set
12. Cut into squares

title: exotic fruit salad
steps:
1. In a nonreactive bowl , combine all the fruit
2. Add the papaya nectar and lime juice , toss to coat
3. Divide the salad among 4 chilled serving plates and garnish with mint spring , serve immediately

title: thanksgiving leftover pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a greased casserole dish , put in stuffing
3. Layer with turkey , chopped into bite sized pieces
4. Pour gravy over top
5. Top with assorted leftover cooked vegetables
6. Finish with mashed potatoes
7. Bake in 350f oven for 25 minutes
8. Top with fried onions and bake for 5 minutes more
9. Serve with cranberry sauce

title: banana pound cake with a caramel glaze
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 325f
2. Mix the flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt together
3. Cream the butter and shortening together , then beat in the brown and white sugars gradually , beating constantly for 5 to 7 minutes
4. Add the eggs one at a time , beating until the hellow dissappears
5. Add the flour mixture alternately with the milk , beating at low speed until blended after each addition , beginning and ending with the flour mixture
6. Stir in the banana , pecans and vanilla
7. Pour into a greased and floured 10 inch tube pan
8. Bake for 65 minutes or until a woodenpick inserted in the center comes out clean
9. Cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes before removing from the pan to cool completely on a wire rack
10. To make the glaze , bring the butter , brown sugar , white sugar and cream to a boil in a heavy saucepan over high heat , stirring frequently
11. Boil for 1 minute , without stirring
12. Remove from the heat
13. Stir in the vanilla
14. Cool until slightly thickened , then drizzle over the cooled cake

title: bulgur wheat tabbouleh with chickpeas
steps:
1. Pour boiling water over the bulgur to cover , and let sit for 1 hour
2. Drain , and fluff with a fork
3. Combine the bulgur and the cooked chickpeas
4. Add olive oil , lemon juice , salt and pepper to taste
5. A good ratio is 2:1 olive oil : lemon juice
6. Cut each tomato in half through the stem
7. Cut off the stem , and scoop out the seeds
8. Chop the flesh into 1 / 4 inch cubes
9. Dice the cucumber into 1 / 4 cubs
10. Add the tomatoes , cucumber and the parsley to the bulgur
11. Stir to combine
12. Taste , and correct seasoning as necessary to taste
13. A nice addition is 1 oz of feta cheese , chopped very fine just before serving

title: cheesy shrimp quesadillas
steps:
1. Chop the shrimp
2. Saute the spinach in the olive oil and set aside
3. Drain the chilis
4. Combine the chilis , shrimp , spinach , pepperjack cheese , cheddar cheese , and cilantro
5. Heat a small skillet over medium heat
6. Spray one of the tortillas with cooking spray and place , spray side down , in the skillet
7. Top with 1 / 6 of the shrimp mixture
8. Spray another tortilla with cooking spray and place , spray side up , on the shrimp mixture
9. Cook for about 2 minutes until golden
10. Gently flip the quesadilla and cook another 2 minutes
11. Repeat for remaining tortillas
12. To serve , cut each quesadilla in quarters and serve with sour cream and salsa for dipping

title: santa fe blue cornmeal waffles   harry s roadhouse
steps:
1. Mix the dry ingredients first , cornmeal , flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt and sugar
2. Mix the wet ingredients separately , buttermilk , eggs and melted butter , then fold into dry
3. Do not over mix the batter , or your pancakes and waffles will be tough
4. Mix until the ingredients are just barely combined
5. Preheat your waffle iron and brush with butter , add batter and cook according to manufacturer's directions
6. Top with butter and maple syrup and serve with your favorite topping such as sliced bananas or strawberries

title: red wine poached pears with mascarpone filling
steps:
1. Peel pears and leave stem intact
2. In a large pan , bring wine and an equal amount of cold water to a simmer
3. Split vanilla bean lengthwise and add to wine & water
4. Add cinnamon sticks , bay leaves and sugar , to taste
5. Add pears to liquid and simmer for about 20 min or until tender
