6. Cool pears in wine mixture to room temperature
7. Refrigerate in poaching liquid
8. Remove pears from poaching liquid
9. Remove stems from pears and set stems aside
10. Core pears with apple corer , leaving pear whole
11. Whisk together mascarpone cheese , whip cream , pinch cinnamon and icing sugar until smooth
12. Transfer to piping bag
13. Pipe into cored pears and finish by putting stems into filling at top of pear
14. Refrigerate
15. Bring sauce to simmer and reduce by half
16. Add butter to reduced sauce and stir until combined
17. Spoon generously over pears
18. Cool to room temperature before serving

title: one dish chicken supper
steps:
1. Place chicken in slow cooker
2. Combine soup and milk , pour over chicken
3. Combine stuffing and water , spoon over chicken
4. Cover , cook on low 6-8 hours

title: corn  ham and potato scallop
steps:
1. In a 3 1 / 2 to 4 quart slow cooker , combine potatoes , ham , corn , and onion
2. Mix well
3. In a small bowl , whisk together soup , milk and flour until smooth
4. Pour soup mixture over potato mixture
5. Stir gently to mix
6. Cover
7. Cook on low for 7-9 hours or until potatoes are tender

title: smart ones banana muffins  copycat recipe  by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine sugar , banana , milk , buttermilk , egg substitute , oil , vanilla , banana flavoring and lemon extract in a large bowl
3. Mix well with electric mixer on high speed
4. In a medium bowl combine flour , baking soda , baking powder , and salt
5. Mix the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients with the electric mixer
6. Pour batter into muffin cups in a muffin pan until each cup is about 2 / 3 full
7. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until muffins turn light brown on top

title: chocolate oh henry squares
steps:
1. Line a 9x9 inch pan with whole crackers , trimming to fit
2. Set aside
3. Put butter , sugar and milk in saucepan
4. Bring to boil
5. Remove from heat and stir in chocolate chips
6. When chips have melted , add the crumbs and nuts
7. Stir to mix
8. Pour over crackers in pan
9. Cover with whole graham crackers trimming to fit
10. Cool before frosting
11. Icing: beat ingredients together in small bowl , adjusting liquid as needed
12. Spread over squares
13. Cover and allow to stand a few hours before cutting so the crackers will soften
14. Cut into 36 squares

title: blackberry grunt
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Place a piece of foil on the bottom rack of the oven to catch any drippings
3. Place the flour , baking powder , salt and baking soda into the bowl of a food processor and process for 3 to 4 pulses
4. Pour the mixture into a large mixing bowl and , using your hands , work the butter into the flour mixture until about half of the fat disappears and the rest is left in pea-size pieces
5. Make a well in the center of the mixture and add the buttermilk and stir with a rubber spatula or wooden spoon just until it comes together
6. Turn the mixture out onto a piece of parchment or waxed paper that has been lightly dusted with flour , shape into a ball and wrap and store in the refrigerator while you prepare the filling
7. Combine the blackberries , sugar , water and ginger in a large mixing bowl
8. Pour the mixture into a 10-inch cast iron skillet and place over medium heat
9. Bring this to a simmer decrease the heat to medium low and continue to cook , stirring occasionally , for 15 minutes , or until the liquid is thick enough to coat the back of a spoon
10. Retrieve the dough from the refrigerator and gently drop it on the fruit mixture using a 1-ounce disher or large spoon , evenly distributing it over the top
11. Bake in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes , or until the top is just starting to brown
12. Remove from the oven and allow the grunt to cool for 15 to 30 minutes before serving

title: savory lentil stew
steps:
1. Put the water in a large pot with the lentils , onion , carrot , celery , potatoes , parsley , thyme , pepper , cloves and liquid smoke
2. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and cover , and simmer for 35-45 minutes
3. Meanwhile , place the 2 tbsp water , shallot , and garlic in a small pan
4. Cook , stirring , until tender , about 5 minutes
5. Mix in the cumin and coriander
6. Continue to cook , stirring , for another minute
7. Add to the soup and stir
8. Remove 3 cups of the soup to a blender
9. Puree until smooth and recombine with the rest of the soup
10. Serve with a splash of soy sauce

title: sour cherry pie with pistachio crumble topping
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425f
2. On a well-floured surface , roll the prepared pastry dough out to an even circle about 12-inch diameter
3. Carefully fold the dough in half and transfer it to a 9-inch pie pan
4. Unfold the dough and press gently so that it lines the bottom and sides of the pan - there should be some dough overhanging the edges
5. Leaving about 1 / 2-inch overhang , cut off any dough in excess of that
6. Tuck the overhang under and pinch the edges decoratively to make a fluted edge
7. In a large bowl , combine the sugar and cornstarch
8. Add the cherries and vanilla and stir until evenly coated
9. Place the pistachios in the bowl of a food processor
10. Chop coarsely using on / off pulses
11. Remove to a bowl
12. Add flour , butter and brown sugar to the processor and process , using on / off pulses until it form a crumble mixture that sticks together in clumps
13. Return the chopped pistachios to the processor and process briefly just until mixed
14. Spoon the cherry filling into prepared pastry crust , and sprinkle evenly with pistachio crumble topping
15. Place the pan on a pizza pan or a cookie sheet and place in the preheated oven
16. Bake at 425f for 15 minutes , then lower the heat to 375f and continue baking for about 60 minutes or until the filling begins to bubble through the crumble topping and the cherries are tender when pierced with a sharp knife
17. Let cool slightly before serving with vanilla ice cream

title: old fashioned peach cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Combine first 7 ingredients in a large mixer bowl
3. Blend at low speed til moistened
4. Beat 2 minutes and medium
5. Spread into a greased and floured 13x9 pan
6. Combine remaining ingredients , sugar , flour and butter , in a bowl with a fork until crumbly
7. Sprinkle over the batter
8. Bake at 350 for 40-50 minutes until center springs back when touched
9. Serve slightly warm , with whipped cream

title: odd  n  ends snack mix
steps:
1. In large bowl , combine the first 6 ingredients
2. In small bowl , combine the butter , worcestershire sauce , seasoned salt and cayenne
3. Pour over cereal mixture and stir to coat
4. Spread into two greased 15 x 10 x 1 inch baking pans
5. Bake at 300 for 1 hour , stirring every 15 minutes
6. Spread on paper towels to cool
7. Store in airtight containers

title: grilled basil and garlic stuffed chicken
steps:
1. Preheat outdoor grill
2. For sauce , in a small bowl combine lemon zest , lemon juice and one tablespoon melted butter
3. Set aside
4. For stuffing , in a small bowl , combine parmesan , basil , one tablespoon butter , and garlic
5. Set aside
6. Place each chicken piece between 2 pieces of plastic wrap
7. Use the flat side of a meat mallet to pound chicken into rectangles about 1 / 8-inch thick
8. Remove plastic wrap and spread stuffing on chicken
9. Fold in sides of each chicken breast and roll up , securing with a toothpick
10. Grill over medium heat for about 20 minutes or until juices run clear and chicken is no longer pink
11. Brush sauce over chicken during the last 10 minutes of grilling

title: scrambled salsa egg sandwiches
steps:
1. Whisk eggs together with milk and salt
2. Spray a nonstick skillet with vegetable cooking spray or a small amount of butter
3. Heat skillet to medium heat and add eggs
4. Cook , stirring occasionally , until set
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. While eggs are cooking , toast english muffins
7. Top muffin halves with scrambled egg mixture
8. Spoon salsa over eggs and serve
9. If you're want to try the tomatoes or mushrooms or other add-ins , fry them in the butter in a frying pan for 2 to 3 minutes before adding the egg mixture

title: delicious water
steps:
1. Pour the water
2. Delicious

title: maple pots de creme
steps:
1. Bring the cream , maple syrup and salt to a simmer in a sauce pan
2. Mix the egg yolks and vanilla in a large bowl
3. Mix the cream mixture into the egg yolks a little at a time
4. Strain the mixture through a fine sieve
5. Pour the mixture into 4 ramekins
6. Place the ramekins in a baking dish and fill the baking dish with hot water until it come halfway up the ramekins
7. Bake in a preheated 300f oven until set , about 50-60 minutes
8. Remove from hot water bath and let cool to room temperature

title: parmesan cheese crusted roast pork
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Wash and thoroughly dry pork
3. Rub with thyme
4. Mix flour , parmesan cheese and savory
5. Dredge roast in flour mixture
6. When oven preheats , turn down to 325
7. Place roast fat side up on a rack in a shallow , greased pan
8. Roast for 40 minute per pound for boneless roast
9. Meat should be 170

title: cinnamon devil s food cupcakes
steps:
1. Set oven to 325 degrees
2. Prepare regular muffin tins and line with paper liners
3. In a bowl sift together flour , cocoa , cinnamon , baking powder , baking soda and salt
4. In a extra large bowl combine sugar , coffee , buttermilk , oil , eggs , egg yolks and vanilla
5. Beat well with an electric mixer until thoroughly combined
6. Add in the dry ingredients
7. Beat on medium speed until blended , scraping bowl occasionally
8. Stir in the mini chocolate chips
9. Spoon the batter evenly between the prepared muffin tins
10. Bake for about 20-25 minutes , or until puffed and the center is just firm to the touch
11. Transfer the cupcakes to racks and cool completely before frosting

title: cowboy caviar
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except cream cheese , eggs , and green onion
2. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours
3. Spread cream cheese on serving plate
4. Spoon bean mixture evenly over cream cheese
5. Arrange eggs on bean mixture in ring around the edge of the plate
6. Sprinkle with green onion

title: walnut orange salad dressing
steps:
1. Place walnuts , garlic , vinegar , lemon juice , honey , dill , pepper , salt and orange juice in a blender container
2. Process until smooth
3. With blender running , slowly pour the oil through hole in lid
4. Process until emulsified
5. Serve over salad
6. Enjoy !

title: sevilla tapas salad
steps:
1. In a bowl combinethe tomatoes , onion , capers , oil , and pepper
2. Season with salt and add parsley
3. Toss gently with a fork
4. Serve within 1 hour for the freshest taste

title: bbq pork for sandwiches
steps:
1. Pour can of beef broth into slow cooker and add boneless pork ribs
2. Cook on high for 4 hours or low for 8 hours-or until meat shreds easily
3. Remove meat & shred with two forks
4. It will seem that's not working right away , but it will
5. Preheat oven to 35o degrees
6. Transfer shredded pork to an oven proof dish & stir in bbq sauce
7. Bake for 30 minutes , or until heated through

title: pink jello mold
steps:
1. Dissolve jello in boiling water
2. Blend in cream cheese stir in pineapple and nuts
3. Fold in cool whip
4. Pour into jello mold
5. Place in fridge until firm
6. Dip into hot water a few seconds to loosen
7. Invert onto a plate
8. Ready to serve

title: tuna rice cakes
steps:
1. Thaw peas
2. Place rice in a large mixing bowl drain tuna and add to rice with the egg , soy sauce , peas and flour
3. Mix to combine
4. Shape mixture in to 6 patties
5. Heat oil in skillet , cook patties in batches for approx five minutes each side
6. Edit i have recently made this by just putting the whole mixture in a skillet and browning both sides , very tasty
7. Eve

title: healthy sesame ginger kale salad w  flax oil
steps:
1. Briefly steam kale then rinse with cold water to stop and set aside to drain
2. Mix garlic , garlic and wet ingredients , then pour over well drained kale greens
3. Sprinkle sesame mix and over and let sit for at least half an hour

title: lime coconut triangles
steps:
1. Crust: in a medium mixing bowl , stir together flour , powdered sugar , pecans and 1 / 4 cup of the coconut
2. Stir in butter or margarine
3. Press mixture into a greased 8 by 8 inch baking pan
4. Bake in a 350 degrees oven for 20 minutes
5. Filling: meanwhile , in a bowl , beat eggs slightly
6. Stir in granulated sugar , peel , juice , and baking powder
7. Stir in remaining coconut
8. Beat until combined
9. Pour over baked crust
10. Bake in a 350 degrees oven for about 20 minutes or until edges are light brown and center is set
11. Cool in pan on wire rack
12. Cut into triangles and dust lightly with powdered sugar and lime peel , if desired

title: barley  shiitake  and spinach pilaf
steps:
1. Add the barley and water to a medium saucepan
2. Cover and simmer over low heat for approximately 1 hour
3. Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat
4. Add both types of oil and saute the onions , stirring occasionally , until brown
5. Add garlic and mushrooms
6. Saute for approximately 3 minutes
7. Add spinach , cooked barley , and sesame seeds
8. Saute for 5 minutes , or until barley is heated through
9. Season with tamari and cayenne

title: golden roast chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c
2. Place chicken in non metallic dish
3. Combine onion , salt and yogurt , spoon over chicken and marinate in refrigerate for several hours
4. Remove excess marinade
5. Combine remaining ingredients and season to taste
6. Stuff the chicken with the mixture
7. Truss and bake for 1-1 / 2 hours or until tender

title: chili s guiltless grill chicken sandwiches by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Prepare the chicken marinade by combining the ingredients in a medium bowl
2. Add the chicken fillets , cover , and refrigerate for several hours
3. Overnight is even better
4. When the chicken has marinated , cook the fillets on a preheated barbecue or indoor grill set to a high temperature for 4-7 min per side or until done
5. While the chicken is grilling , make the fat-free dressing by mixing together the ingredients in a small bowl
6. Build each sandwich by first stacking 1 / 4 of the lettuce on the bottom hamburger bun
7. Stack the tomato slice on the lettuce
8. Stack the chicken fillet on the tomato
9. Cover each sandwich with the top bun and serve with honey mustard on the side
10. 8 points per serving

title: bang bang shrimp   copycat from bonefish grill
steps:
1. Mix mayo and sauces for coating
2. Bread shrimp in cornstarch
3. Deep fat fry the shrimp until lightly brown
4. Drain on paper towel , put shrimp in a bowl and coat with the sauce
5. Serve in a lettuce lined bowl , top with chopped scallions
6. -----------------------------------------------------

title: brie or camembert appetizers
steps:
1. Dip the wedge of brie or camembert in milk and dredge in flour
2. Then dip in egg and breadcrumbs
3. Let cheese'sit' for 10-15 minutes to allow coating to set
4. Melt butter in a large skillet
5. When hot , add as many brie / camembert slices as will fit without crowding
6. Fry until golden-brown , turn over carefully and fry on other side
7. Put a handful of the lettuce chiffonade on each serving plate
8. Centre a golden brie / camembert slice on the plate
9. Top with a spoonful of fruit chutney or preserves
10. Cranberry sauce is wonderful with this !
11. Serve immediately with plenty of crusty bread to spread the molten cheese on
12. Enjoy !

title: double chocolate marshmallow brownies
steps:
1. Melt the chocolate and butter together over double boiler
2. Once melted , add both sugars and mix in until well blended
3. The sugars will not melt all the way , it will look gritty
4. Take off double boiler and let cool about 15 minutes or until room temperature
5. Using wire whisk , mix in eggs , one at a time , until well blended
6. Add the vanilla , salt , and flour , and whisk until completely free of lumps
7. With a rubber spatula , fold in chocolate chips and marshmallows , and pour into greased 9 x 13 pan
8. Bake at 350 f for 35 to 38 minutes
9. Do not test for doneness , as the marshmallows will be melted at the top
10. Dust with powdered sugar if desired

title: jasmine   green tea   fresh lemonade
steps:
1. Place the water in the reserve of the coffee maker
2. In the coffee filter place an unbleached filter then place sugar , zest and the tea bags
3. All the sugar will dissolve and the lemon zest flavor will be picked up as the heated water goes through
4. Pour the tea into a pitcher and cool
5. Add the lemon juice and fill pitcher with ice cubes
6. Pour into ice filled tall glasses and garnish with jasmine flower or lemon rind or mint leaves
7. Enjoy and stay cool !

title: kid friendly sloppy joes   no green stuff
steps:
1. In a skillet , over medium heat , sautee onion until slightly translucent
2. Use cooking spray if desired
3. Add ground beef or turkey , add salt and pepper
4. Cook until no longer pink
5. In the mean time: in your 2 cup measuring vessel , combine ketchup , vinegar , mustard , brown sugar
6. Stir into meat once it is fully cooked
7. Simmer 15-20 minutes
8. Serve hot on soft rolls or buns

title: strawberry salad with chocolate balsamic dressing
steps:
1. Divide the rocket between the plates
2. Slice the cucumber lengthways , seed and slice into halfmoons
3. Arrange the stilton , cucumber and strawberries on the rocket
4. Drizzle dressing on top
5. To make the dressing: place balsamic vinegar in a saucepan , add caster sugar and dissolve over a gentle heat
6. Remove from heat and stir in 2 squares of chocolate
7. Leave to cool at room temperature
8. Do not refrigerate or dressing will solidify

title: lemongrass chicken bnh m bowls
steps:
1. Mix together the lemongrass , garlic , soy sauce , and sesame oil
2. Rub it all over the chicken and let the chicken marinate in the fridge for half an hour
3. Immediately make the slaw
4. For the slaw , combine all ingredients in a large bowl , cover , and then refrigerate until ready to use
5. Once the chicken is done marinating , slice it thinly and then cook in a little olive oil over medium heat
6. To assemble your bowls , drain the slaw , and then on a bed of rice , layer the chicken , slaw , and remaining fixins as desired

title: love potion latte  9   alcoholic or not
steps:
1. Pour the syrups into 2 12 oz latte mugs
2. Pour the hot espresso into the mugs
3. Steam the milk until almost doubled in volume
4. Put the frothed milk into the mugs and garnish

title: uncle bill s stuffed sweet peppers
steps:
1. Carefully cut out the stem portion of the peppers
2. Remove seeds and membranes carefully and discard
3. Place peppers in a large saucepan
4. Add 1 / 2 cup water , cover and bring to boil and parboil for 5 minutes
5. Drain well
6. Set aside covered
7. In a medium saucepan , add rice and chicken broth and bring to boil
8. Reduce heat and simmer for about 20 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed
9. In a large frying pan , add olive oil , ground beef and chopped onion and saute' until mixture is lightly browned , about 5 minutes
10. Add chopped celery , sliced mushrooms , grated carrots , garlic powder , italian herb seasoning mix , salt , pepper , crushed tomatoes including liquid , cooked rice , dill weed
11. Mix well and bring to boil
12. Reduce heat to medium-low , cover and cook for about 15 minutes , stirring occasionally
13. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
14. Carefully stuff peppers with mixture
15. Place stuffed peppers in a deep , oven-proof casserole dish
16. Spoon any remaining mixture over peppers
17. In a small mixing bowl , mix together ketchup and water
18. Pour this sauce equally over the stuffing in each pepper
19. Cover casserole dish with a lid or tightly with aluminum foil
20. Bake in preheated 350 f oven for 20 minutes
21. Remove lid or foil , sprinkle grated mozzarella cheese on top of the stuffed peppers
22. Continue to bake uncovered at 350 f for another 10 minutes or until cheese melts
23. Serve hot
24. You may use a combination of red , orange , yellow or green peppers for a colorful presentation and a variety of taste

title: flourless chocolate walnut cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Spread the walnut halves on a large-rimmed baking sheet and toast in the oven for about 9 minutes , until they are golden and fragrant
3. Let cool slightly , then transfer the walnut halves to a work surface and coarsely chop them
4. Position two racks in the upper and lower thirds of the oven and lower temperature to 320
5. Line two large-rimmed baking sheets with parchment paper
6. In a large bowl , whisk the confectioners sugar with the cocoa powder and salt followed by the chopped walnuts
7. While whisking , add the egg whites and vanilla extract and beat just until the batter is moistened
8. Spoon the batter onto the baking sheets in 12 evenly spaced mounds , and bake for 14 to 16 minutes , until the tops are glossy and lightly cracked
9. Shift the pans from front to back and top to bottom halfway through to ensure even baking
10. Slide the parchment paper onto 2 wire racks
11. Let cookies cool completely , and store in an airtight container for up to 3 days

title: debbie s cranberry gelatin mold
steps:
1. Pour cranberries , water , and honey in a pot and bring to a boil
2. While pot is boiling , dissolve 4 packets unflavored gelatin in 1 / 2 cup cold water
3. When all the berries start popping , remove from heat and stir in the dissolved gelatin
4. Allow to cool
5. Once cool , add grapes , pecans , and pineapple
6. Pour into a gelatin mold and chill several hours
7. Serve with the dressing: just mix up the mayo , yogurt , and cinnamon
8. This is really simple , the hardest part is waiting for it to cool , and then waiting for it to chill / set

title: healthy baked bean omelet
steps:
1. Sautee broccoli in a skillet until tender
2. Add egg whites to the broccoli and let cook until semi-firm
3. Flip and cook until the eggs set
4. Add the baked beans in the center and fold
5. Enjoy !

title: crab   preserved lemon risotto
steps:
1. Pick meat from crabs and set aside
2. Heat stock in a saucepan until simmering , then maintain at this heat
3. Heat olive oil in a large pan and fry onion over medium heat until soft but not coloured
4. Add the rice and stir over a high heat until grains are well coated in oil and warmed through
5. Add white wine and stir until most of the liquid has been absorbed
6. Reduce heat to medium , add stock , a ladleful at a time , stirring constantly and allowing each ladleful to be absorbed before adding the next
7. Continue until rice is tender , with a slight bite , and has a creamy consistency
8. Add a final ladle or 2 of stock , preserved lemon , crabmeat , butter , parmesan , salt and pepper and beat vigorously with a wooden spoon until all the butter is incorporated and the crab has broken up into thin wisps
9. The finished risotto should be quite soupy , the venetians call it all'onde
10. Taste , add extra salt if needed , stir through chives and serve immediately
11. Vialone nano is the preferred rice in the veneto , where this soupy style of risotto is most popular , use arborio or carnaroli rice if it isn't available

title: mystery pudding dessert
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Mix together the nuts , butter & flour , blending well , then press the mixture in the bottom of a 13x9" baking dish
3. Bake for 20 minutes , until golden brown , then remove from oven and allow to cool to room temperature
4. When the crust has cooled , beat together cream cheese and powdered sugar
5. Then add about 1 cup of the cool whip , mixing well
6. Carefully spread this cream cheese mixture over the cooled crust
7. Whisk together vanilla pudding mix and 1 3 / 4 cups of milk , blending well
8. Carefully spread it over the cream cheese layer , and let it set , several minutes
9. When vanilla pudding is set , whisk together chocolate pudding mix and 1 3 / 4 cups of milk , blending well
10. Carefully spread this chocolate mixture over the vanilla pudding layer and let it set , several minutes
11. Spread remaining cool whip over chocolate pudding and refrigerate

title: blond brownies in a jar
steps:
1. Mix together flour , salt and baking powder
2. Set aside
3. Layer ingredients in order given in a 1 quart sized wide mouth canning jar
4. Add flour mixture last
5. Press each layer firmly in place
6. Attach this message to jar: butterscotch brownies empty jar of brownie mix into large mixing bowl
7. Use your hands to thoroughly blend mix
8. Add 3 / 4 cup butter or margarine , softened at room temperature
9. Do not use diet margarine
10. Mix in 2 eggs , slightly beaten and 2 tsps vanilla
11. Mix until completely blended
12. Spread batter into greased 13 x 9 inch metal pan
13. Bake at 375 degrees f for 25 min
14. Cool 15 minutes in pan
15. Cut brownies into 1 1 / 2 inch squares
16. Cool completely in pan
17. Makes 2 doz
18. Brown ies

title: herbed tomato tart
steps:
1. Roll one pastry sheet into a 14-inch square on a lightly floured surface
2. Place on an ungreased baking sheet
3. Cut 4 strips from remaining pastry sheet , and place along edges on top of pastry square , forming a border
4. Reserve remaining pastry for another use
5. Bake at 400 for 10 minutes or until golden
6. Transfer pastry shell to a wire rack to cool
7. Place tomato slices in a single layer on paper towels
8. Sprinkle evenly with salt
9. Let stand 20 minutes
10. Place baked pastry shell on baking sheet
11. Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese and next three ingredients
12. Arrange tomato slices in a single layer on top
13. Sprinkle with herbs
14. Drizzle with oil
15. Bake at 400 for 15 minutes or until cheese melts
16. Serve immediately
17. You can substitute 1 tablespoon mixed dried herbs for fresh

title: strawberry bread pudding
steps:
1. In a small sauce pan combine undrained strawberries and cornstarch
2. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture thickens and bubbles
3. Spread evenly over bottom of 11 x 7 baking dish that has been sprayed with cooking spray
4. In a mixing bowl combine eggs , milk , sugar , butter , vanilla and salt
5. Add bread cubes to moisten
6. Spread evenly over strawberry mixture
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 50-55 minutes
8. Serve warm with cream

title: key lime margarita pie
steps:
1. Mix crushed pretzels , sugar and butter
2. Press firmly onto bottom and up side of 9-inch pie plate
3. Refrigerate until ready to fill
4. Combine condensed milk , lime juice , and drink mix powder in large bowl until well blended
5. Gently stir in whipped topping
6. Pour into crust
7. Freeze 6 hours or overnight
8. Let stand at room temperature 15 minutes or until pie can be cut easily

title: chocolate meringue christmas cookies carrie sheridan
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Melt chocolate in a pan or bowl set over hot water on the stove
3. Let cool
4. Beat egg white and salt until stiff , but not dry
5. Gradually beat in sugar until the mixture is very stiff and satiny
6. Fold in the almonds , vanilla and melted chocolate
7. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets
8. Bake for 15 minutes
9. It's best to take these off with a spatula while still warm]
10. If you want to cheat , these can also be baked on brown paper or parchment paper

title: crispy carrots
steps:
1. Combine eggs and onion
2. Mix in carrots
3. Make 8 to 9 patties about 1 / 2 cup each
4. Flatten in nonstick skillet and cook until crisp and golden brown
5. Turn only once

title: celery tofu florentine
steps:
1. Spray saute pan w / cooking spray& saute onion until just starting to brown
2. Add thawed& drained spinach , spices& saute until all moisture is evaporated
3. In food processor: puree tofu& cream of celery soup , then add spinach / onion mixture& process until smooth
4. Mix w / chopped celery , place in baking dish& top w / parmesan cheese
5. Bake , uncovered@ 350 degrees for 40 minutes makes 6 servings , ~ 150 cals each serving

title: new england squares
steps:
1. Blend crumbs , mincemeat and condensed milk together
2. Turn into a well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan
3. Bake at 350 degrees for about 30 minutes or until lightly browned
4. Let cool in pan before cutting

title: italian pot stickers from the stinking rose restaurant
steps:
1. To make filling: in heavy skillet , heat sesame oil over medium heat
2. Add pork , celery , ginger and garlic , and cook , stirring occasionally , for 5 to 7 minutes , until pork is browned and celery is crisp-tender
3. Remove skillet from heat and drain off fat , then add mushrooms and return to medium heat for 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Stir in bell pepper , vinegar and soy sauce , and season with salt and pepper
5. Cook for 3 minutes , stirring frequently
6. Stir in cilantro and green onions , then remove from heat and let cool to room temperature
7. On work surface , lay wrappers flat and place 1 tablespoon filling in the center of each wrapper
8. Fold each wrapper in 1 / 2 , sealing edges with the tines of a fork
9. Dip a pastry brush in cold water and brush lightly over the top of each pot sticker
10. Arrange in a single layer on a small baking sheet and refrigerate for about 20 minutes to chill
11. Pour about 1 / 2 cup water into a heavy , nonstick saute pan and put pot stickers in the pan
12. The water level should be at about 1 / 4 the height of the pot stickers
13. Cover pan and place over medium heat
14. Bring water to a rolling boil and cook for 3 minutes , or until pot stickers are browned on the bottom and shiny on top
15. The water will evaporate during cooking , so watch carefully so that the pot stickers don't burn
16. Remove from heat
17. To make dipping sauce: in small saucepan , combine vinegar , water , sugar , ginger , garlic and pepper flakes
18. Bring to a boil over medium heat , then decrease heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes
19. Remove from heat and add sesame oil and soy sauce
20. Strain through a sieve lined with cheesecloth into a small bowl
21. Refrigerate for at least 10 minutes

title: banana raisin muffins
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f grease bottoms only of 12 regular-size muffin cups
2. Crush cereal
3. In large bowl , stir together cereal , flour , brown sugar and baking powder
4. Stir in remaining ingredients just until moistened
5. Divide batter evenly among muffin cups
6. Bake 18 to 22 minutes or until golden brown

title: fudge filled dessert strips
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , cream the butter & cream cheese until fluffy , then gradually add the flour , mixing well
2. Turn the dough onto a lightly floured surface , then knead until smooth , about 3 minutes
3. Divide the dough into fourths , cover & refrigerate until easy to handle , from 1 to 2 hours
4. In a microwavable container , combine chocolate chips & milk , then set microwave to melt the chocolate , stirring several times until smooth
5. Stir in walnuts then set aside to cool to room temperature
6. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
7. Roll out each portion of dough onto an ungreased baking sheet , rolling each into an 11-inch by 6 1 / 2-inch rectangle
8. Spread 3 / 4 cup of the chocolate filling down the center of each rectangle , then fold the long sides to the center
9. Press to seal all the edges before turning over so the seam sides are down
10. Bake for 27 to 32 minutes or until lightly browned , then remove to wire racks to cool completely
11. Cut into 1 / 2-inch slices before serving

title: turkish marinade  beef   lamb kabobs
steps:
1. Add all except the olive oil to a food processor or blender
2. Blend on high and slowly drizzle in the olive oil to create an emulsion
3. Marinate your favorite meat and enjoy

title: hawaiian hash browns
steps:
1. Oven bake the hashbrowns on a lined baking tray until brown and crisp
2. Remove hashbrowns from the oven for a couple of minutes and top each with a slice of ham , pineapple and cheese
3. Return to the hot oven for a further 10 minutes until toppings are heated through and cheese has melted

title: portabella and provolone
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. In a small bowl , whisk the oil , vinegar , salt , and pepper together
3. Set aside
4. Moisten a paper towel and wipe the mushrooms to remove dirt
5. Cut out the stems and the gills
6. Place the mushrooms in a glass dish , round side up
7. Pour the oil mixture over the mushrooms , rubbing it in with your fingers
8. Turn the mushrooms and lightly sprinkle the insides with salt and pepper
9. Marinate for 10 minutes
10. Remove the mushrooms from the marinade and place on a baking sheet , rounded side up
11. Bake 10-12 minutes or until they begin to brown and shrink a bit
12. Turn the mushrooms and bake 10-12 minutes , or until some of the liquid has surfaced and the mushrooms have browned further
13. Remove from oven
14. Let sit until cool enough to handle
15. Mix the cheeses and oregano together in a bowl
16. Scatter the cheese mixture evenly over the inside of 4 mushroom caps , followed by a tomato slice
17. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste , and place the remaining 4 mushroom caps on top , rounded side up
18. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat for 2 minutes
19. Put the mushroom sandwiches in the skillet , cover , and cook 3-5 minutes , or until the undersides are dark brown and the cheese has begun to melt
20. Uncover , and turn the mushroom sandwiches , pressing firmly with a spatula to flatten them slightly
21. Cover and cook 2-3 minutes or until the undersides have turned a shade or two darker and the cheese has melted completely
22. Let cool slightly and cut in half
23. Serve

title: birthday cake babka
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine warm milk , yeast and sugar and whisk to dissolve
2. Let sit for about 5 minutes until mixture becomes foamy
3. In the bowl of a stand mixer with a dough hook , combine yeast mixture , flour , salt , eggs and vanilla extract
4. Mix slowly to combine
5. Once combined , add in butter , one tablespoon at a time
6. When butter is incorporated , scrape down sides of the mixing bowl , and knead dough for about 5 minutes on medium speed , adding sprinkles in during the last half of kneading
7. Remove the dough to a greased mixing bowl
8. Cover with a clean kitchen towel or plastic wrap and let rise until doubled in size , about two hours
9. Grease two loaf pans and set aside
10. In a small bowl , mix together all filling ingredients
11. After two hours , punch down dough and divide into two even portions
12. Roll out one half of dough into a tall rectangle
13. Spread evenly with filling mixture to the edges
14. Roll up dough using the long side of the rectangle
15. Once rolled , cut the entire roll down the middle with a sharp knife , lengthwise
16. You should have two long pieces of dough with the layers of filling exposed
17. Braid the two pieces over one another , with the filling facing up
18. Twist the braid into a shape that will fit in the loaf plan and place it inches repeat process with second half of dough
19. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
20. Cover both loaves with a clean kitchen towel and let rise for about 20 minutes while the oven is preheating
21. Bake loaves for about 50 - 60 minutes
22. Remove from oven and let cool

title: mc mummys burgers
steps:
1. Mix all burger patty ingredients together well
2. Use hands to divide the mixture into 4 round flat spotty green patties
3. Heat a frypan on medium heat and brush with oil
4. Cook the patties about 4 minutes on each side
5. When burger patties are cooked place a cheese slice on each , and remove the frypan from heat
6. Place bottom half of the toasted burger bun on each dinner plate and top with ranch dressing , lettuce and tomato
7. Then add burger patty and tomato sauce and top with the bun lids
8. Serve immediately

title: polish creamed potatoes
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together except 1 / 2 cup cheddar cheese
2. Place in 1 1 / 2-quart casserole
3. Sprinkle top with remaining 1 / 2 cup cheddar cheese
4. Bake in 325 oven for 40 minutes

title: halvah shortbread
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375f
2. With a food processor , or by hand , cream the butter with the tahini
3. Add the salt and brown sugar
4. Blend until smooth
5. Sprinkle in the flour , blending well
6. Mix in the chopped nuts
7. The dough will be very stiff
8. Lightly butter 2 7-inch pie plates or shallow baking pans
9. Press the dough to evenly cover the bottom and sides of the pie plates so that the thickness is not more than 1 / 4 inch
10. Press a few whole nuts into the surface to decorate
11. Bake the shortbread for 15 minutes and then check it frequently , every couple of minutes , and remove it from the oven as soon as the edges are golden brown
12. Be careful not to overbake
13. While it's still warm , cut each shortbread into 8 or 10 wedges in the pan
14. Don't wait until it's cool or it will crumble

title: grilled copper river cod
steps:
1. Heat butter , brown sugar , garlic , lemon juice , pepper and soy in saucepan , warm over medium heat
2. Cool and add cod pieces
3. Marinade in refrigerator about 1-2 hours
4. Lighly oil heated grill grates and brush fish filets with brown sugar sauce
5. Cook for 5 minutes per side , and at the same time baste with sauce , continue cooking untill fish flakes easily
6. Do not overcook

title: eggs and chiles ole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Grease a 13x9 pan
3. Line bottom of the pan with chiles
4. Slice the cheese and place on top of the chiles to cover evenly
5. In a large bowl , beat eggs with sour cream until well blended
6. Add salt and pepper to taste
7. Pour egg mixture over chiles and cheese
8. Bake 30-40 minutes or until knife inserted into dish comes out clean

title: chicken fried steak on stick with whatsthishere sauce
steps:
1. Thread the sliced cube steak strips onto the skewers
2. In a baking dish whisk together the egg , buttermilk and hot sauce
3. In a second baking dish combine the flour , semolina flour , paprika , garlic powder , onion powder , cayenne , salt and pepper
4. Heat the canola oil in a medium pot over medium-high heat to 350 degrees f
5. Dredge the beef skewers in the flour mixture and shake off excess so they are lightly dusted
6. Dip them in the buttermilk and egg mixture coating both sides , then put back in flour mixture making sure to coat completely
7. Working batches of 6 fry the skewers in hot oil until the coating is golden brown and crispy , about 4 to 5 minutes
8. Remove to a plate lined with paper towels to drain
9. The skewers can be held in a preheated 250 degree f oven while frying the remaining skewers
10. Arrange the skewers on a serving platter and serve the sauce
11. Sauce:
12. Whisk all of the sauce ingredients in a small bowl until smooth

title: baked sweet potato sticks
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Lightly oil a baking sheet or spray with a nonstick cooking spray
3. Cut sweet potatoes into strips
4. Place on prepared baking sheet in a single layer
5. Spray lightly with nonstick cooking spray
6. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste
7. Bake 10 minutes , then stir potatoes and bake 10 minutes more , or until done to taste

title: baked jalapeno bacon poppers
steps:
1. 1
2. Preheat oven to 375f slice each sweet pepper in half lengthwise
3. Use your spoon to scoop out any seeds and some of the rib to make a nice , clean boat
4. 2
5. Cook bacon to crisp
6. Mince cooked bacon
7. In a bowl , mix together the bacon , cream cheese , cheddar cheese and cajun seasoning
8. Spoon cheese mixture into each sweet pepper
9. 3
10. Melt butter in microwave , stir in the bread crumbs
11. Hold each popper and dip cheese side down into bread crumbs
12. Bake 375f for 20 minutes or until cheese melty and bread crumbs crusty

title: three cheese polenta gratin alla genovese
steps:
1. Preheat oven on broil setting
2. Bring water , olive oil , and milk to a boil in 4-quart sauce pan
3. Add polenta in a thin stream , stirring constantly with a whisk
4. Lower heat and cook while stirring until polenta is thick as porridge , about 5 to 7 minutes
5. Remove from heat and whisk in ricotta evenly through polenta then fold in mozzarella and fontina
6. Cheeses will begin to melt
7. Season with salt and pepper
8. Butter an 8x12-inch casserole or gratin dish evenly
9. Pour hot polenta into casserole and spread evenly with a spatula
10. Sprinkle grated parmesan cheese evenly across top of polenta
11. Place in oven on broiler setting on middle rack and bake for 3 to 5 minutes , or until top of polenta is golden brown
12. Remove from oven , set aside for 5 to 7 minutes and then serve
13. Letting polenta rest will allow cheese to melt evenly inside casserole , which also needs to cool down because of it being so hot

title: chicken with mascarpone  capers   lemon
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 220c
2. Loosen skin on chicken breasts and put 2 tbsp of the mascarpone under each one , brush with the oil and sprinkle with fennel seeds , lemon zest and the salt and pepper
3. Place in a baking dish and add the cherry tomatoes , capers and lemon juice
4. Bake for 20-30 minutes , or until chicken is cooked through

title: baked bean hash
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 190c
2. Put the hash browns on the bottom of a baking dish
3. Spread the baked beans on top
4. Mix the remaining ingredients together and pour over the beans
5. Sprinkle with grated cheese
6. Bake at 190c for 35 to 40 minutes until the egg is set and it's all golden

title: pineapple cheese ball ii
steps:
1. Beat cream cheese with fork until smooth
2. Gradually stir in pineapple , 1 cup pecans , green pepper , onion and salt
3. Chill
4. Shape into ball
5. Roll in remaining nuts
6. Refrigerate until well chilled
7. Garnish with pineapple slices , cherries and parsley
8. Makes about 40 appetizer servings
9. The green pepper gets liquid when you process it in the food processor
10. I have to blot it with a paper towel
11. When i made the ball with the low fat cream cheese i either did not drain the green pepper and pineapple well or it was the cream cheese
12. Ever since i have used full fat cream cheese and have not had a problem

title: garlic parmesan chicken wings
steps:
1. Toss chicken wings with shake n' bake original coating mix in bags
2. Cook wings at 400 degrees f for 30-35 minutes or until done
3. In large bowl , toss still-hot wings with caesar dressing and sprinkle with fresh parmesan
4. Voila ! done !

title: frosting in the pie
steps:
1. Beat cream cheese until smooth
2. Add frosting and beat well
3. Fold in cool whip
4. Pour into pie shell and refrigerate

title: grilled zucchini
steps:
1. Peel and cut up zucchini and onion into bite size pieces
2. Pour olive oil into frying pan and heat on medium to high
3. After pan is heated , add the zucchini , onion , sesame seeds , soy sauce , butter , salt , and pepper
4. Grill until slightly tender and browned
5. Eat and enjoy !

title: my vinaigrette dressing  italian style
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a jar
2. Cap the jar tightly and shake well

title: gordon ramsay s scrambled eggs
steps:
1. Break eggs into a pan and add the cubed butter
2. Stir over a medium heat until the eggs start to cook
3. Remove from heat continue stirring eggs for about 20 second
4. Return to heat , continue to stir eggs until they start to clump , remove from heat and add the creme fraiche
5. Return to heat stirring in crme fraiche
6. Remove from heat when eggs are clumpy , but soft
7. Season with freshly ground black pepper and garnish with a sprinkling of chopped chives

title: a basque custard  natillas
steps:
1. In a saucepan , combine the cream and cinnnamon sticks , and bring them to a boil over medium-high heat
2. Reduce the heat to low , and cook gently for about 10 minutes , until the cream is infused with the cinnamon
3. Set the pan aside so the cream can cool
4. In a bowl , whisk together the eggs , sugar , and vanilla until they are well mixed
5. Add the cream and cinnamon sticks , and whisk well
6. Heat 1 to 2 inches of water in the bottom pan of a double boiler , and transfer custard mixture to the top pan , or set the bowl over a saucepan containing 1 to 2 inches of hot water
7. Bring the water to a boil , and cook the sauce , stirring constantly , for about 30 minutes or until it thickens , adding more hot water to the bottom pan if necessary
8. Remove the top pan or the bowl from over the hot water , and let the custard cool
9. Strain the cooled custard through a fine-mesh sieve into a glass or ceramic container , and refrigerate the natillas for at least 4 hours , until it is cool
10. Stir before serving , adding a little more heavy cream if necessary to smooth the natillas
11. Divide it among six custard cups or transfer it to a pitcher to use as a sauce
12. Serve the natillas sprinkled with cinnamon
13. This is also delicious served as a sauce for almond cake , and also with fresh raspberries -- !
14. Enjoy !

title: orange garlic shrimp
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in heavy skillet over medium high heat
2. Saute shrimp for 2 minutes or just until opaque
3. Reduce heat and add garlic and salt
4. Saute for 1 minute until garlic is soft
5. Remove from heat and toss with orange zest
6. Serve with crusty bread

title: easy meatball soup
steps:
1. In a pot combine the water , bouillon cubes , 1 teaspoon salt , 1 teaspoon pepper , green onions , green pepper , carrots and tomatoes
2. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer covered 30 minutes
3. Mix the meat , uncooked rice , 1 beaten egg , paprika , oregano , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper
4. Form into 1 inch balls
5. Add the meatballs to the broth , bring to a boil again , then lower heat and simmer , still covered , 30 minutes or until the meat is cooked and the rice is soft
6. Add parsely and tobasco sauce to taste
7. Just before serving , beat the second egg with the lemon juice
8. Stir two teaspoonsful of hot soup into the lemon mixture , then stir this mixture back into the soup pot

title: nutty noodles
steps:
1. Soak rice noodles according to package directions , drain
2. In a wok or frying pan heat oil
3. Add onion , garlic , curry powder , scallions , and stir
4. Add beef and stir until cooked through
5. Add carrots , cook for 1-2 minutes more , drain excess fat
6. Mix sauce ingredients in a large glass measuring cup , add to wok ,
7. Cook until heated through
8. Serve over rice noodles , garnish with scallions

title: king creole
steps:
1. Add the first 3 ingredients into a shaker filled with ice
2. Shake vigorously
3. Strain into a cocktail glass
4. Float the cream on top

title: chicken and vegetable soup
steps:
1. Put all ingredients in a large pot and cover with water
2. Cook for about one hour
3. Remove chicken and chop finely
4. Mash soup with a potato masher or blend with a hand held electric blender
5. Return chicken to soup
6. Taste and adjust seasonings as required

title: roasted halibut with fennel   potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Cut off roots and trim dark green top from leek
3. Discard any tough outer leaves
4. Thinly slice leek
5. Rinse thoroughly in a bowl of cold water
6. Swish to remove any sand
7. Transfer with hands to a colander and drain well
8. Spray 13"x9" glass baking dish with nonstick cooking spray
9. Add leek , potatoes , fennel , fennel seed , 1 tbsp oil , 1 / 2 tsp salt , and 1 / 4 tsp pepper to the baking dish
10. Toss to coat and spread evenly
11. Roast vegetables 35 minutes or until tender , stirring halfway through roasting
12. Remove baking dish from oven
13. Place halibut on vegetables , drizzle with liquor and 1 tsp oil
14. Sprinkle fennel seeds , 1 / 4 tsp salt , and 1 / 8 tsp pepper
15. Place lemon slices on halibut , return dish to oven and roast 10-12 minutes or just until halibut turns opaque in center
16. To serve , sprinkle with fennel fronds if using

title: stuffed bell peppers soup
steps:
1. In large pot , heat olive oil and garlic and brown ground chuck thoroughly
2. Add other ingredients and bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat , cover and cook for 30 minutes

title: grandma s cream of potato soup or broccoli soup
steps:
1. Empty cans of chicken broth in pot
2. Add cubed potatoes and bring to a boil
3. While potatoes are starting to cook pan fry bacon until crisp and add bacon grease to chicken and potato broth
4. Crumble bacon and add to broth
5. Add diced ham to broth
6. In a sauce pan melt butter and add diced onion , celery and carrots
7. Pan fry until soft
8. When potatoes are done add the celery , carrot and onion mixture with butter to broth
9. Reduce heat to medium and add about 1 / 4 to 1 / 2 of the quart of heavy cream
10. Be careful not to have soup at a heavy boil or cream will curdle
11. Add enough cream to make soup look creamy throughout
12. Add cheese
13. Mix corn starch with very cold water and add to soup
14. Continue medium boil until soup thickens
15. If it isn't thick enough repeat corn starch and add slowly
16. Remove from heat and enjoy
17. Soup will thicken when it gets cold
18. Can add milk or water to thin out

title: dried fruit cheese ball
steps:
1. Mix everything together except nuts and roll into a ball
2. Roll cheese ball into chopped nuts of your choice , walnuts or pecans
3. Chill until ready to use
4. Jean said the recipe called for 1- 8 ounce pack of cream cheese but she likes to use 2

title: hippie rito
steps:
1. Spread hummus thickly on tortillas
2. Chop tomato into chunks , place on the hummus
3. Chop cumumber into small chunks or slices , place on hummus
4. Shred the romaine , put on the top layer
5. Add more hummus if deisred
6. Dash lemon pepper over all if desired
7. Roll up and nosh ,

title: marie s italian sausage soup
steps:
1. Mix everything except pasta and garnish together in a large stock pot
2. Bring to a boil and let simmer 15-60 minutes
3. Add cooked pasta just before serving
4. Top with garnish

title: shanghai asparagus
steps:
1. Wash asparagus
2. Break off stalks as far down as they snap easily
3. Cut asparagus diagonally into 1-inch thick pieces
4. Heat oil in large skillet on high heat
5. Add asparagus , seasoned salt , ginger and pepper
6. Cook , covered , 3 minutes or until tender-crisp , stirring occasionally
7. Add soy sauce
8. Mix well

title: nyte s deviled eggs
steps:
1. Cut eggs in half lengthwise , remove yolks , and reserve whites
2. Mash yolks until about the texture of cornmeal
3. Combine yolks , mayo , worcestershire sauce , mustard , and 1 teaspoon of the vinegar mix until smooth
4. Slowly add more vinegar until tart and moist enough
5. If it gets tart enough but is not moist enough add a bit more mayonnaise
6. Add a dash of salt and mix in
7. Spoon mixture into center of egg whites
8. Sprinkle tops with paprika
9. Chill and serve cold

title: seared digby scallop caesar salad with low fat dressing
steps:
1. Whisk first 10 ingredients together well and set aside so the flavors can develop for 15 minutes
2. Dry off scallops and sear off in a little olive oil , a minute on one side , 30 seconds on the other side -- you don't want to overcook them ! toss lettuce with croutons and parmesan cheese
3. Top with scallops

title: basic seasoned flour for dredging
steps:
1. Sift all ingredients together to blend evenly
2. Store in a tightly covered jar
3. For a crumb coating , combine 1 tbsp of this mixture with 1 cup fine dry bread crumbs

title: almost instant baked apple
steps:
1. Wash , dry , and core the apple
2. Peel a strip of skin from around the cored center
3. Put apple in a microwave-proof bowl
4. Mix the brown sugar , cinnamon , and raisins , and fill the apple with the mixture
5. You could add chopped , nuts , too , if you wanted
6. Dot with the butter
7. Pour the water around the apple
8. Bake in the microwave on hi power for about two minutes and 30 seconds , and let it rest for a minute or two before eating
9. When it is done , a fork will prick into the apple easily
10. Pour cold cream over the top , if desired , and eat it up !

title: roasted pork loin with rosemary   lavender and garlic
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f 2
2. Rub the pork loin with rosemary , lavender , garlic , salt and pepper and place it in a roasting pan
3. Pour the wine into the bottom of the pan
4. Roast the pork for about 1 1 / 2 hours , basting occassionally with the wine and juices from the bottom of the pan
5. The pork is cooked when a meat thermometer measures 160f
6. Remove it from the oven and let the meat rest about 15 minutes before slicing

title: agua de valencia   knock your socks off spanish cava punch
steps:
1. Put some ice cubes into a large jug and pour over lots of orange juice
2. Now add the bottle of cava
3. Once the fizz subsides , stir in a good dash of the cointreau and its ready to serve
4. Makes about 2 pints

title: supreme burgers
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients together
2. Shape mixture into 8 patties , each about 3 / 4-inch thick
3. Broil or grill the patties 4-inches from the heat , turning once , to the desired doneness , about 10 to 15 minutes

title: toffee bits triangles
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f line a 15 1 / 2 x 10 1 / 2 inch rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper
2. Set aside
3. In a large bowl , beat butter with brown sugar until fluffy
4. Beat in egg yolk and vanilla until creamy
5. Stir in flour and 1 cup of the toffee bits until well combined
6. Press dough evenly into prepared baking sheet
7. Bake for 18-20 minutes or until light brown
8. Transfer pan to a cooling rack
9. Immediately sprinkle with chocolate chips over the hot cookie base
10. Let stand for 5 minutes or until chocolate is softened
11. Spread chocolate evenly over the base
12. Sprinkle remaining toffee bits evenly over chocolate
13. Cool until chocolate is set , about 2-3 hours
14. Cut into 3-inch squares
15. Cut each square diagonally to make 4 triangles

title: creamy ham fettuccine  quick and easy
steps:
1. Cook fettuccine according to package directions
2. Meanwhile , in a saucepan , saute onion in butter until tender
3. Stir in flour until blended
4. Gradually stir in cream
5. Bring to a boil over medium heat , stirring constantly
6. Add broccoli
7. Reduce heat
8. Simmer uncovered , for 7-10 minutes or until broccoli is crisp-tender , stirring occasionally
9. Stir in ham , 1 / 2 cup parmesan , garlic salt , pepper , oregano , and nutmeg
10. Drain pasta
11. Top with sauce
12. Sprinkle with remaining cheese

title: shepherd s hash brown pie
steps:
1. In skillet heat oil over medium heat
2. Cook onion and garlic , stirring for 3 minutes
3. Add beef , chili powder , oregano , salt and pepper
4. Cook , stirring to break up meat for 5 minutes
5. Add tomatoes , breaking up further with spoon
6. Bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat and simmer for about 15 minutes or until thickened
8. Stir in vegetables
9. Spoon into greased 10" pie plate
10. Topping: in a bowl , toss together potatoes , cheese , salt and pepper
11. Stir in egg and combine well
12. Spoon evenly over meat mixture
13. Bake in 400f oven for 30 minutes
14. Broil for about 3 minutes or until topping is golden

title: spicy tempeh fajitas
steps:
1. Heat the oil on medium high and add the onion , red pepper and jalapeno
2. Cook , stirring often , until the onion starts to soften
3. Add garlic and cook for another minute or two
4. Add the tempeh and cook , stirring often , about five minutes
5. Tempeh should get lightly browned
6. Add the taco seasoning and the oregano
7. Stir well , add the vegetable broth , and reduce hit to low
8. Heat until most of the liquid has evaporated
9. Place in tortillas and add chopped tomato and cheddar
10. Grill on a contact grill if desired

title: whole wheat blueberry bran muffins
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients together in one bowl
2. Mix wet ingredients together in a different bowl
3. Combine wet into dry with blueberries and just mix together
4. Grease bottom of muffin tin , and scoop in muffin mix
5. Bake at 350f and enjoy !
6. Will make 12 regular sized muffins or 6 large muffins
7. Muffins will be done about 20 mins for reg
8. And 30-35 mins for lg

title: grilled chicken banh mi
steps:
1. Mix the first six ingredients in a baking dish
2. Add the chicken breasts to the dish , cover , and refrigerate at least 1 hour
3. Longer is better !
4. Stir the hot tap water and sugar in a medium bowl , until the sugar dissolves
5. Add the vinegar , salt , red pepper , sliced carrots and radishes
6. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes
7. Heat the grill to medium
8. Grill the chicken breasts for 5 minutes per side
9. Remove from heat and cover them with foil to rest for 5 minutes
10. Open the sub rolls and grill the insides for about 1-3 minuteuntil toasted
11. Drain the pickled veggies
12. Slice the chicken into thin pieces
13. Spread mayo over in the sub rolls
14. Layer the cucumbers , chicken , pickled veggies , cilantro leaves and jalapeos in the rolls
15. Serve immediately !

title: mildred s casserole
steps:
1. Brown ground beef and onions
2. Combine all remaining ingredients
3. Put in a casserole dish
4. Cover with lid or foil
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes to an hour

title: irish creamy fudge
steps:
1. Grease an 8-inch square pan and line with parchment paper so that it hangs over the sides
2. Stir evaporated milk , brown sugar , white sugar , butter and salt in a heavy-bottomed saucepot
3. Bring to a boil over medium heat , stirring often , and cook until 238f
4. Remove from heat , stir in vanilla and irish cream and scrape into a bowl or mixer fitted with the paddle attachment
5. With the mixer on low speed or electric beaters , add in the icing sugar in three additions , mixing well after each addition
6. Scrape fudge into prepared pan and let cool completely before slicing

title: biscotti di pepe   taralli   italian pepper biscuits
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast in water
2. Sift flour salt and pepper onto mixing board
3. Make a well in the center and add yeast and oil
4. Blend together and gradually incorporate into flour
5. The dough will be stiff
6. Knead 10 minutes
7. Place in oiled bowl , turn to coat , cover with towel and let rise until doubled in bulk
8. Preheat oven to 375
9. Break off small pieces of dough and roll into ropes about 6 inches long
10. Form a ring and pinch edges together
11. Place on baking sheet and let rise 20 minutes
12. Brush with oil and bake 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned

title: penne with chicken and pesto
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil
2. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente
3. Drain
4. Heat butter and oil in large skillet over medium heat
5. Saute chicken and garlic until chicken is almost cooked through
6. Reduce heat and stir in salt , pepper , cream , pesto , and parmesan cheese
7. Cook until chicken is no longer pink inside ,
8. Stir in cooked pasta

title: sausage bread soup
steps:
1. In a large pot , saute onion in oil over medium-high heat for a few minutes
2. Add carrots , celery , garlic , and red pepper flakes , and continue to cook another few minutes
3. Add the drained tomatoes and cook about 8-10 minutes more , stirring well
4. Add sugar and basil and cook 3 more minutes , stirring frequently
5. Add reserved juices from the tomatoes , bread , and broths
6. Bring to a boil , stirring well
7. Reduce heat and simmer for about 1 hour , stirring every 10 minutes to prevent soup from sticking to the bottom
8. Add sausage and cook for an additional 30 minutes , stirring every 10 minutes to prevent sticking
9. Taste for seasoning
10. Add salt and pepper , if desired
11. Top with parmesan cheese and parsley , and serve

title: mona s mother s mother s best friends favorite cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Beat egg in a medium bowl
3. Add butter and both sugars
4. Cream well
5. Add remaining ingredients and mix to combine
6. Drop onto baking sheet and flatten slightly
7. Bake for 12-15 minutes , until golden

title: swiss chocolate squares
steps:
1. Break up the chocolate
2. Melt it , together with the butter , in a sauce pan
3. With a hand mixer , beat the egg yolks and sugar for at least 10 minutes until it becomes a light-colored thick mixture
4. Carefully fold in the liquid chocolate and butter
5. Flavor by adding the cognac
6. Beat the cream until it is stiff and fold into mixture
7. Line a 5 inch 5 inch mold with cling film
8. Pour the mixture into the mold and keep in the refrigerator for a minimum of 6 hours to set
9. Before serving , remove from the mold
10. Use a wet knife dipped in hot water to cut into 1 inch square pieces
11. Dust with cocoa powder
12. It is essential to keep this dish cool until it is served

title: cheesy sweet potato and cauliflower
steps:
1. Bake the sweet potatoes in a hot oven until tender
2. Set aside to cool for a few minutes
3. Put the cauliflower into a microwavable bowl , add a few tbs of water , cover with cling film and cook in the microwave for 5 minutes on high
4. Drain and set aside
5. Prepare the cheese sauce as below
6. Preheat your grill
7. Cut the sweet potatoes into wedges and lay them in the bottom of a greased oven proof dish
8. Drain the cauliflower and spoon it over the sweet potatoes
9. Spoon the hot cheese sauce over top
10. Sprinkle with the grated cheese and the snipped chives
11. Grill for three to four minutes until golden and bubbling
12. Enjoy !
13. To make the cheese sauce: melt the butter in a saucepan and stir in the flour , stirring until smooth
14. Let cook over low heat for one minute to cook the flour then slowly stir in the milk , whisking until smooth
15. Add the bay leaf and cook over medium low heat , stirring , for about 10 minutes until thickened
16. Remove the bay leaf
17. Stir in the cheese and season to taste with salt , pepper and nutmeg

title: tuna steak with dalmatian lemon garlic sauce
steps:
1. Season steaks with salt and soak them in olive oil 30 minutes before putting on grill
2. Grill steaks until done
3. Before prepare lemon juice , finely minced garlic , finely minced parsley leaves , pepper , olive oil and oregano , stir all ingredients well and leave 30 minutes until all flavors combine and get used to each other
4. Pour juice over fish before serving
5. That is it !

title: spicy chili salad
steps:
1. Cook beef , onion , and green pepper in a large skillet until meat is browned , stirring to crumble meat
2. Drain
3. Stir in tomato sauce , chili powder , and other seasonings
4. Cook over low heat 5 minutes
5. Cool slightly
6. Place lettuce on individual serving plates
7. Top with meat mixture
8. Sprinkle with cheese
9. Garnish with tomato wedges
10. We serve this with tortila chips

title: carolina pork bbq
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine salt , pepper and garlic powder and season pork roast on all sides
3. Bake roast in covered pan 4-6 hours , checking often during the last 2 hours
4. Roast should be falling apart when finished
5. While roast is baking start the sauce by sweating the onions and garlic in the olive oil
6. Add red pepper flakes and allow to cook for 3-5 minutes
7. Add all of the vinegar and 1 1 / 4 cups of the beer
8. Simmer over low heat , use remaining beer to maintain approximately 2 cups of liquid in the sauce
9. Sauce should cook at least 3 hours
10. You may not have to use all of the beer
11. When roast is falling apart , remove from the oven , pull meat into shreds , and pour the sauce over the shredded meat
12. Return to the oven for 30 minutes to an hour
13. Serve on hamburger buns with coleslaw and tabasco sauce

title: cheesy chili dog pie    bisquick
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f spray 9-inch pie plate with cooking spray
2. In medium bowl , stir bisquick mix , milk and eggs with wire whisk or fork until blended
3. Pour a thin layer of prepared bisquick batter to the bottom of the pie plate
4. Drop dollops of chili over bottom of pie plate , spread out a bit and top with sliced hotdogs and 1 / 2 of cheese
5. Pour remaining prepared bisquick batter over chili & cheese
6. Bake 45 minutes , top with remaining cheese then continue baking for 5-10 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean and center does not jiggle when shook
7. Depending on how deep your pie plate is , it may take close to 60 minutes to bake
8. And continue baking
9. Let stand 5 minutes before serving
10. Serve with desired toppings

title: avocado  banana and mango muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray medium-size muffin tins with non-stick cooking spray
3. Mash fruit and add together
4. Set aside
5. Sift flour , baking soda , and baking powder in bowl
6. In a separate bowl , cream butter , sugar , and beaten eggs well , then add fruit and vanilla
7. Mix
8. Add flour mixture
9. Mix well
10. Scoop batter into muffin tin , and bake at 350 degrees for approximately 35 minutes

title: pepper glazed steaks
steps:
1. In small bowl stir together paprika , pepper , garlic powder and salt
2. Cut sirloin steak into 4 pieces
3. Rub pepper mixture onto both sides of meat
4. Heat non-stick skillet over medium-high heat
5. Add meat
6. Cook , turning once , to desired doneness (6-8 minutes
7. Remove meat from skillet , set aside
8. Increase heat to high
9. Add green pepper and onion to skillet
10. Cook , stirring constantly , until vegetables are crisply tenter
11. Reduce heat to low
12. Stir in jelly and vinegar
13. Return meat to pan
14. Turn to coat w / glaze
15. Cover
16. Cook until heated through (2-3 minutes
17. To serve , place meat and glaze over rice

title: stevia chocolate syrup
steps:
1. Blend the cocoa and stevia in small saucepan
2. Over low - medium heat , gradually stir in the water
3. Simmer for a minute or two until mixture is smooth
4. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla
5. If mixture is too thick , gradually blend in warm water until desired consistency is reached

title: kasbah bites
steps:
1. Brown the ground chicken / turkey on a lightly oiled skillet , remove when browned
2. Brown the onions , turn heat down to medium
3. Add cooked rice , mix
4. Return the chicken to the pan& add the peas , then the almonds
5. Mix the honey& balsamic vinegar , stir well , add spices , stir again
6. Pour this over the chicken mixture , stir well cook 3 minutes longer and remove from heat
7. Melt butter in a small saucepan
8. Remove 3 sheets of phyllo pastry and lay them flat with the narrow end toward you
9. Flip up 2 sheets of phyllo and lightly paint the bottom layer with butter , flip the next sheet down and paint it with butter , then the remaining sheet and again paine it with butter
10. Cut the 3 layer sheet into 6 long strips
11. Put a generous tbsp of the chicken mixture on a corner of a strip nearest to you
12. Fold the corner with the filling on it up and to the right to form a small triangle , now continue to work your way up the strip by flipping and folding until you reach the top
13. Paint the outside lightly with butter and place on a cookie sheet
14. Continue until all the mixture and phyllo are used
15. Bake at 350f for apprx 15-20 minutes turning them once during the baking
16. Serve hot
17. Your other option is to freeze them unbaked
18. Place a single layer of"bites" on a cookie sheet and freeze them , remove from cookie sheet and place them in single layers with plastic wrap between layers
19. Bake from frozen state 350f oven for 20 minutes , turning them once or until they are golden on both sides

title: chicken enchilada
steps:
1. Prepare chicken anyway you would like
2. I place mine in the pressure cooker with chicken broth , onion , garlic , 1 / 2 teaspoon cummin and 1 / 2 teaspoons mexican oregano
3. Shred chicken , dice it or slice it , however you want it , place it in a bowl and combined cummin , pepper , mexican oregano and any other seasonings you would like
4. Mix seasoning well into chicken and set aside
5. In a bowl combine: both soups , diced chilies , sour cream , milk , all remaining seasonings and cilantro , 1 1 / 2 cups mexican mixed cheese
6. Mix well , set to the side
7. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f
8. In a 13x9 baking dish , cover the bottom of the pan with a thin layer of soup mixture
9. Lay a tortilla shell out and place a tablespoon of soup mixture on the shell spoon the chicken mixture into tortillas , and roll up
10. Place the rolls seam side down in a 9x13 inch baking dish
11. Continue till dish is full cover the tortillas with the remaining soup mixture to cover
12. Sprinkle pepper jack cheese on top
13. Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven , or until the enchiladas are golden brown on the top

title: cream cheese pecan pie
steps:
1. Set oven to 375 degrees
2. In a bowl , beat together the cream cheese , 1 egg 1 / 2 cup sugar , salt and 1 tsp vanilla , until well blended
3. Spread into unbaked pie crust
4. Sprinkle with chopped pecans
5. In another bowl , beat 3 eggs , corn syrup , 1 / 4 cup sugar and 1 tsp vanilla until well blended
6. Pour the mixture over the cream cheese and pecans
7. Place the pie on the lower rack in oven
8. Bake for 40-45 minutes , or until center is firm

title: kiwi commotion smoothie
steps:
1. Blend kiwis , banana , and frozen yogurt in a food processor or blender
2. Add limeade concentrate and process until smooth

title: agave sweetened cheesecake
steps:
1. Make the crust by mixing the last 2 or 3 ingredients , put them in the bottom of a greased cheesecake pan
2. Roll flat with a tiny roller , i use my pizza crust roller , or tamp down with an ice cream scoop
3. Put in the freezer
4. Preheat your oven to 475 degrees
5. In a large bowl beat the room temperature cream cheese , with a mixer until it is very creamy and smooth , with no lumps
6. Add the agave and the flour , continue to cream with the mixer
7. Add the fresh grated rinds , if you have none , don't even bother with the dry stuff in a jar
8. Maybe a dab of frozen juice concentrate ? keep mixing
9. Add the eggs , add 2 at a time and mix until well blended
10. Retrieve the crust , pour the batter in the pan
11. Bake at 475 degrees for 20 minutes
12. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes
13. Bake at 200 degrees for 60 minutes
14. Turn your oven off with out opening the door and wait 60 minutes
15. Stir the sour cream and vanilla , only until it is one color
16. Spread the mixture over the top of warm cake and bake 5-7 minutes , just until it is set
17. This bakes in mul
18. It seems like this takes forever , but it is so worth it
19. Optional: sometimes i make more topping , 12 oz sour cream , and 3 tbsp sugar

title: low fat potato salad
steps:
1. Cook potatoes , let cool
2. Combine with celery and onions
3. Mix together mayonnaise , vinegar , mustard , salt and pepper
4. Pour over potato mixture and combine to coat the vegetables
5. Refrigerate

title: shipwreck dinner
steps:
1. Brown meat in large nonstick skillet on medium-high heat
2. Drain fat , if necessary
3. Stir in macaroni , cheese sauce mix , tomatoes , peas and milk
4. Bring to boil
5. Reduce heat to medium-low
6. Cover
7. Simmer 12 minute or until macaroni is tender
8. Sprinkle with cheese
9. Let stand 5 minute or until cheese is melted

title: grilled pork tenderloin a la rodriguez with guava glaze
steps:
1. Preheat a grill to high
2. Brush pork with oil , and then season it with salt and pepper
3. Set aside a few tablespoons of the guava glaze for brushing the cooked pork
4. Grill for 4 to 5 minutes per side , brushing frequently with the guava glaze
5. Remove from the grill , brush again with glaze and let rest for 10 minutes
6. Slice into 1 / 2-inch thick slices , drizzle with the orange-habanero mojo , and serve immediately
7. Guava glaze: whisk jelly , mustard , and orange juice together in a small bowl
8. Season , to taste , with salt and pepper
9. Orange-habanero mojo: heat oil in a small saucepan over medium-high heat
10. Add onion and garlic and cook , stirring , until soft , about 5 minutes
11. Add lime juice , orange juice , and habanero chile and bring to a boil
12. Cook until reduced by half
13. Whisk in the cilantro and cumin and season , to taste , with salt and pepper
14. Drizzle over pork

title: classic baked ziti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a large skillet , cook ground beef , onions , and garlic over medium-high heat for 6 to 8 minutes or until beef is browned
3. Stirring frequently
4. Stir in spaghetti sauce , chicken broth , and oregano
5. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes
6. Stir 1 cup of the sauce into the cooked ziti noodles
7. Spoon 1 / 2 of the ziti mixture into a 13x9x2-inch baking dish
8. Sprinkle with 1 1 / 2 cups mozzarella cheese and 1 / 2 cup parmesan cheese
9. Top with 2 cups sauce , then remaining ziti mixture and remaining sauce
10. Cover and bake 20 minutes
11. Sprinkle with remaining mozzarella and parmesan cheese
12. Return to oven and bake uncovered for 10 minutes or until heated through

title: paneer palak kofta
steps:
1. Wash spinach in plenty of running water to get rid of any dirt , soil or impurities
2. Blanch spinach in boiling hot water and refresh in cold water
3. Chop and keep aside
4. Add chopped green chillies , salt , chopped garlic and corn flour
5. Mix well and divide into 12 equal portions
6. Grate paneer
7. Add salt and mash well
8. Divide it into 12 small balls
9. Take spinach , flatten it on your palm and stuff paneer balls in it
10. Shape it into a ball
11. Deep fry for 5 minutes in moderately hot oil
12. Heat butter in a pan
13. Add whole garam masala
14. Let it crackle
15. Then add ginger paste , garlic paste and chopped green chillies
16. Cook for 2 minutes
17. Add tomato puree , red chilli powder , garam masala powder , salt in one cup of water
18. Bring it to a boil
19. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes
20. Add sugar or honey or both and kasoori methi
21. Stir in fresh cream
22. Serve koftas cut into halves on top of makhani gravy
23. Do not boil koftas in the gravy

title: red cabbage with apple
steps:
1. Trim outer leaves from cabbage
2. Cut into fourths and remove the inner core
3. Slice cabbage thinly
4. Add enough water to cover bottom of large saucepan or dutch oven by about 1 inch
5. Cover and bring to a boil
6. Add cabbage
7. Cover and return to a boil
8. Then lower heat and simmer , covered , stirring occasionally until cabbage is tender , about 30 minutes
9. Add apples to kettle and cook 10 minutes more
10. Drain excess liquid from pan , if any
11. Stir in vinegar , butter , brown sugar , and pepper
12. Mix until well blended and serve

title: crab   shrimp in puff pastry
steps:
1. Melt butter , add onion and red pepper and saute until just softened
2. Add flour and stir to incorporate the flour with the butter / onion mixture
3. Slowly add the cream , stirring constantly until all cream has been added
4. Cook until thick and smooth
5. Add crabmeat , raw shrimp , mushrooms and sherry to the sauce and cook until shrimp are pink through
6. Stir in the grated cheeses
7. Let simmer until reduced and thickened a little more
8. Line a deep dish pie plate with the pastry
9. Add the crab / shrimp mixture
10. Put another sheet of pastry on the top , pinch edges together
11. Cut vent holes in the top and brush with a little melted butter
12. Sprinkle with more cheese if you wish
13. Bake at 350 for about 30 minutes or until the pastry is puffed and golden

title: uncle bill s crispy halibut steaks
steps:
1. Rinse halibut steaks in cold water , then pat dry on paper towels
2. In a bowl , whisk eggs , add mustard and whisk until blended
3. In a shallow dish , combine garlic powder , dill weed , crushed cornflakes , parmesan cheese , and italian seasonings
4. Mix well to blend
5. Dip halibut steaks in egg mixture
6. Now place halibut steaks individually in dry mixture and coal both sides well
7. Baking
8. Preheat oven to 450f
9. In a 13 x 9 inch oven-proof casserole dish add olive oil and butter
10. Place dish in heated oven until butter melts
11. Place coated steaks in casserole dish in a single layer
12. Bake in preheated 450 f oven for 5 minutes , then turn over and continue to bake for another 5 minutes or until fish flakes when tested with a fork
13. Do not overcook halibut steaks
14. Frying
15. In a large frying pan , melt butter with olive oil on medium high heat
16. Add steaks and fry for 5 minutes on each side or until fish flakes when tested with a fork
17. Do not overcook halibut steaks
18. Serve with with a nice homemade tartar sauce

title: out of this world scrambled eggs
steps:
1. Whisk lighlty the eggs with the milk
2. Melt butter in pan
3. Add whisked eggs
4. Leave for 1 minute to start to set
5. Very important: do not stir , you must lift
6. Lift the eggs gently until all of the egg is cooked
7. Serve on whatever toast you like , or muffins and splash some lee and perrins over it

title: hummus feta roasted red pepper sammie
steps:
1. To make the hummus place chickpeas , garlic , cumin , oil and water in a bowl and blend using a hand held blender or alternatively put everything into your blender and pulse until combined
2. Add enough water to get it to a smooth spreadable consistency
3. Spread this on all 8 slices of bread
4. On 4 of the slices , put roasted red pepper slices on top of the hummus layer
5. Mix feta cheese with rosemary , dill and chili flakes
6. Press it on top of the red pepper layer
7. This might become a little messy
8. Now top with the remaining bread slice to make a yummy lunch sammie
9. Enjoy !

title: potato topped casserole
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350f
2. Brown ground beef and pour off excess fat
3. Put meat in 9" square baking dish and pour vegetables over meat
4. Spread soup on top of vegetables and sprinkle with cheese
5. Top with potatoes
6. Bake for 45 minutes at 350

title: crunchy salsa sandwich
steps:
1. Toast both slices of bread in a toaster till they are as crisp as you want it
2. Spread the salsa evenly over one slice
3. If it appears too dry , feel free to double the amount of salsa that you use
4. This is a completely"taste-while-you-make" recipe
5. Now add a layer of potato chips to this salsa-covered slice , and cover it with the other slice of toasted bread
6. Your crunchy salsa sandwich is done and ready-to-munch into !

title: blackberry sage thumbprint cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a bowl combine flour , cornmeal , sage , and baking powder
3. Set aside
4. In a large mixing bowl cream butter and add brown sugar , beat until combined
5. Beat in egg yolks , lemon zest and vanilla
6. Mix in the flour mixture
7. Shape dough into 3 / 4 inch balls , place 1 inch apart on ungreased baking sheets
8. Lightly press the
9. Fill the centers with about 1 / 4 teaspoons of the blackberry preserves
10. Bake 10 minutes or until the bottoms are lightly browned
11. Cool on cookie sheet for 1 minute and then transfer to rack to cool completely

title: stuffed ham slices
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Melt butter in medium sized saute pan
3. Saute onion , celery , and green pepper in butter until vegetables are tender
4. Remove from the heat
5. Stir in bread crumbs , corn , and poultry seasoning
6. Place half the ham slices in a greased 13x9" baking dish
7. Spread stuffing over ham
8. Top with remaining ham
9. Bake , uncovered , at 350 degrees for 10 to 20 minutes , until everything is hot
10. Brush top slices with honey and thyme if you like
11. Return to the oven for 5 to 10 minutes or until heated through

title: strawberry pie
steps:
1. In a saucepan , combine sugar , cornstarch , and 7-up
2. Cook until thick
3. Add strawberry jello
4. Blend till smooth
5. Cool
6. Place slice strawberries into pie shell
7. Pour jello mixture over strawberries
8. Refrigerate
9. I have used diet 7-up to reduce the sugar content of the pie though i've not tried sugar-free jello

title: lemon pound cake atk
steps:
1. Adjust an oven rack to the middle position and heat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease an 8 1 / 2 by 4 1 / 2 inch loaf pan with 1 tablespoon of the softened butter
