3. Dust with 1 tablespoon of the flour , tapping our the excess
4. In a medium bowl , whisk together the remaining 1 1 / 2 cups flour , the baking powder and the salt
5. Set aside
6. Melt the remaining 16 tablespoons butter in a small saucepan over medium heat
7. Whisk the melted butter thoroughly to reincorporate any separated milk solids
8. In a food processor , pulse the sugar and zest until combined , about 5 pulses
9. Add the lemon juice , eggs and vanilla
10. Process until combined , about 5 seconds
11. With the machine running , add the melted butter through the feed tube in a steady stream [this should take about 20 seconds]
12. Transfer the mixture to a large bowl
13. Sift the flour mixture over the egg mixture in three additions , whisking gently after each addition until just combined
14. Pour the batter into the prepared pan and bake 15 minutes
15. Reduce the oven temperature to 325 degrees and continue to bake until deep golden brown and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean , about 35 minutes , rotating the pan halfway through the baking time
16. Cool in the pan for 10 minutes , then turn onto a wire rack
17. Pike the top and sides of the cake throughout with a toothpick
18. Cool to room temperature , at least 1 hour
19. [the cooled cake can be wrapped tightly in plastic wrap and stored at room temperature for 5 days
20. ]
21. For the glaze: while the cake is cooling , bring the sugar and lemon juice to a boil in a small saucepan , stirring occasionally to dissolve the sugar
22. Reduce the heat to low and simmer until thickened slightly , about 2 minutes
23. Brush the top and sides of the cake with the glaze and cool to room temperature

title: asparagus  ham and mascarpone tart
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180 c , line 2 trays with baking paper
2. Cut each pastry sheet into 4 squares , then lightly score a 2
3. 5 cm border around each square
4. Place squares on trays and chill
5. Melt butter in frypan and cook onion for 3 - 4 minutes
6. Finely chop ham in food processor
7. Add onion , mustard and mascarpone and pulse to combine
8. Season to taste
9. Spread mixture within pastry border on each square
10. Top with asparagus spears
11. Brush pastry borders with beaten egg
12. Bake 20 - 25 minutes till pastry is golden
13. Serve topped with parmesan

title: reese s peanut butter and milk chocolate chip cookie pie
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Beat butter in medium bowl
3. Add eggs and vanilla
4. Stir together sugar and flour
5. Add to butter mixture
6. Stir in chips and nuts
7. Pour into unbaked pie crust
8. Bake 50 to 55 minutes or until golden brown
9. Cool about 1 hour on wire rack
10. Serve warm with sweetened whipped cream or ice cream , if desired
11. To reheat: one slice at a time , microwave at high 10 to 15 seconds

title: cornbread that kills
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together and put in a greased 9 x 13 pan or greased muffin tin
2. Bake on 350f until the top is golden brown
3. I recommend that you let it sit for a few minutes before cutting

title: big batch chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In medium bowl sift together flour and baking soda
3. Cream together butter , oil , and sugar
4. Add eggs and vanilla until combined
5. Gradually add flour mixture to wet mixture
6. Stir in chocolate chips
7. At this point , you can either separate recipe into 3rd's and freeze some of the dough in rolls for later use or cook immediately drop by spoonful on parchment lined baking sheets and slightly flatten with a spoon
8. Bake for 7-10 minutes or until lightly golden
9. Allow to cool
10. To use frozen rolls , allow to thaw in refrigerator , slice and follow normal directions

title: low fat prune and fruit muffins
steps:
1. Mix bran , prune juice , skim milk and brown sugar
2. Set aside for ten minutes
3. Stir in beaten eggs , flours , baking powder , nutmet , cinnamon and salt
4. Blend thoroughly
5. Stir in apple sauce raisins and walnuts
6. Spoon equally divided into greased muffin tins
7. Bake in 425 degree oven for 15-20 minutes until lightly brown and springy to the touch

title: old mexican inn dip  serve with tortilla chips
steps:
1. Mix ingredients and refrigerate for 1 hour before eating
2. Eat with tortilla chips or scoops !

title: savory dry rub smoked ribs
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine all spices , except the sugar and the pepper flakes , and mix together thoroughly
2. Add the mustard , and mix the spices into the mustard , until it's almost a paste
3. Take your rack of ribs , and sprinkle the bone side with a little cajun seasoning
4. On the meat side of your ribs , spread the mustard / spices , almost like you were icing a cake
5. Cover entire meat side with your mustard / spice mixture
6. After the ribs are covered , sprinkle your pepper flakes on top , to add a little spice
7. Finally , sprinkle your sugar on top , to get that little twinge of sweetness !
8. Smoke on a charcoal bbq , for about an 1 hour and 30 minutes , bone side down the entire time
9. Adjust cooking time depending on how big your rack of ribs is , and how hot your fire is
10. The key to these ribs being perfect is low and slow

title: orzo   shrimp risotto
steps:
1. Saute the shallots in butter for 5 minutes or until tender
2. Saute garlic & red pepper flakes an additional 30 seconds to a minute
3. Add the steeped saffron in white wine and evaporate
4. Add the orzo and saute just enough to coat the pasta kernels
5. Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil and cook until the pasta has absorbed the broth , and is tender , about 10 minutes
6. Stir in the shrimp , cover and steep just long enough for the shrimp to gently warm through
7. Season to taste with salt and crushed red pepper
8. Garnish with parsley and scallions

title: cheesy pulled pork nachos
steps:
1. In a large skillet , combine shredded pork , red onion and 1 / 2 cup sliced jalapenos
2. Saute over medium-high heat for 10 minutes , after that , season with seasoned pepper and lime juice , saute for 5 minutes
3. In a large saucepan , combine soup , cream cheese , sour cream and cheeses over medium low heat , stir until mixture is thickened
4. Add pork mixture into cheese sauce , stirring constantly , 8 minutes
5. Add tortilla chips on the platter
6. Pour pork-cheese mixture on the tortilla chips
7. Top with remaining sliced jalapenos

title: chocolate dessert
steps:
1. Combine first three ingredients , mix well
2. Press into 8x8 baking dish
3. Bake at 350f for 20 minutes
4. Cool completely
5. Meanwhile , beat softened cream cheese with powdered sugar until smooth
6. Fold in 1 / 2 the whipped topping
7. Spread over cooled crust
8. Combine pudding mixes with milk , mix well
9. Spread chocolate mixture over cheese layer
10. Top with remainder of whipped topping
11. Garnish with grated chocolate , if desired

title: shrimp and scallop alfredo
steps:
1. In a large pot of boiling salted water , cook pasta for 10 - 12 minutes , el dente
2. Drain well and leave in pot to keep warm
3. Meanwhile , in a large saucepan , add olive oil , shrimp and scallops
4. Cover and cook for 5 minutes or until scallops are opaque and shrimp are pink
5. When cooked , remove scallops and shrimp and place on a side plate
6. In the same saucepan , bring cream and butter just to boil
7. Reduce heat and stir in parmesan cheese , salt , pepper , and nutmeg
8. Add scallops , shrimp and pasta
9. Toss well to coat
10. Transfer mixture to a large bowl and garnish with parsley sprigs

title: peanut ginger chicken
steps:
1. Rinse chicken thighs , pat dry
2. Place the chicken in a plastic bag set in a shallow bowl
3. In a small mixing bowl gradually stir hot water into peanut butter
4. Stir in chili sauce , soy sauce , the 2 t oil , the 2 t vinegar , garlic , ginger and red pepper
5. Pour marinade over chicken
6. Seal the bag and turn to coat chicken thighs with marinade
7. Chill for 12 to 24 hours , turning the bag occasionally
8. In a covered grill arrange medium hot coals around a drip pan
9. Test for medium hot by placing hand over coals
10. When hand gets too hot at 3 seconds the temperature is right
11. Remove chicken from marinade
12. Place chicken on the grill rack over the drip pan but not over the coals
13. Lower the grill hood
14. Grill chicken for 35 to 45 minutes or until no pink remains

title: spicy macaroni   cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Coat a 2 quart casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray
3. Cook the macaroni according to package directions
4. Drain and place in a large bowl
5. Add the remaining ingredents except for the corn chips
6. Mix well then pour into a casserol dish and sprinkle with corn chips bake for 30-35 minutes , or until hot and bubbly , and the top is golden

title: better than mom s chicken and noodles
steps:
1. In a 5-6 quart slow cooker , combine carrots , parsnips , onions , and celery
2. Add chicken , garlic , thyme , sage , salt , and pepper
3. Pour broth and sherry over chicken mixture in cooker
4. Cover
5. Cook on low for 7 hours or on high for 3 hours
6. Stir in noodles
7. Increase setting to high
8. Cover and cook for 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours more until noodles are tender
9. Transfer chicken to a cutting board
10. Using two forks , coarsely shred chicken
11. Discard bones
12. Return chicken to slow cooker
13. Turn off cooker
14. Stir in peas
15. Cover and let stand for 5 minutes
16. Garnish with fresh sage leaves

title: shrimp fra diavolo
steps:
1. In a large bowl , toss the shrimp with 1 teaspoon salt and the red pepper flakes
2. In a large , heavy skillet , heat the oil over a medium high flame
3. Add the shrimp and saute until just cooked through , about 2 minutes
4. Using a slotted spoon , transfer the shrimp to a large plate and set aside
5. Add the onion to the same skillet and saute until translucent , about 5 minutes
6. Add the tomatoes with their juices , wine , garlic , and oregano , and simmer until the sauce thickens slightly , about 10 minutes
7. Return the shrimp and any accumulated juices to the tomato mixture and toss to coat
8. Remove from heat and stir in the parsley and basil
9. Season with more salt to taste and serve over linquine or your favorite pasta

title: smoky chipotle chicken chowder
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 475f
2. Rinse chicken and pat dry , and stuff cavity with garlic , onion , lime , and cumin seed
3. Seal cavity with skewers or toothpicks
4. Fold wing
5. Rub exterior of bird with olive oil and season liberally with salt and pepper
6. Place on a roasting rack in a shallow roasting pan and roast , uncovered , at 475f for 15 minutes
7. Reduce oven temperature to 375f and continue to cook chicken , for 60-75 minutes or until temperature in the thickest part of thigh reads at least 160f
8. Allow chicken to rest for 30 minutes without carving
9. Cook bacon in a skillet until cooked through and crisp
10. Drain on paper towels , reserving 2 tbsp bacon drippings
11. Place bacon drippings into the bottom of a large dutch oven , and add onion and garlic
12. Cook until tender , then add chicken broth , potatoes , wine , bell pepper , ground cumin , salt , and pepper
13. Bring mixture to a boil and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until potatoes are cooked through and tender
14. Meanwhile , remove meat from chicken , discarding fat , skin , and bone
15. Chop chicken coarsely and set aside
16. Mix together dry milk with cold water until smooth in a small bowl and set aside
17. Heat oil several inches deep in a large skillet
18. Using a pizza cutter or kitchen shears , cut tortillas into thin strips
19. Fry tortilla strips until crispy and golden , then drain on paper toweling and set aside
20. When potatoes in chowder are tender , add cooked chopped chicken , milk mixture , chopped chipotles with adobo , and grated cheese
21. Cook , stirring over low heat just until cheese melts- do not boil or cheese will become grainy
22. Just before serving , stir in chopped cilantro , and top each bowl of chowder with tortilla strips

title: amaretto divine
steps:
1. To make the cake:
2. Preheat oven to 325f
3. Grease and flour three 8-inch baking pans
4. Mix together the cake mix , 1 cup amaretto flavored creamer , 1 cup amaretto liqueur , eggs and oil till blended
5. Distribute cake batter evenly between the three cake pans
6. Bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes , making sure the cake layers do not over bake
7. Allow to cool completely before icing
8. To make the amaretto whipped cream filling:
9. Combine pudding mix , 1 / 4 cup amaretto liqueur , and 1 cup amaretto flavored coffee creamer
10. Set aside for 5 minutes until thickened
11. Fold the whipped cream into the amaretto mixture , then stir in the crushed coffee toffee bars
12. Use to fill and frost top ,
13. Drizzle cake with melted chocolate bar and sprinkle with almonds
14. Refrigerate until ready to serve

title: festive cranberry and date biscotti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees fahrenheit
2. Line 3 large baking sheets with parchment paper
3. Sift flour , baking powder , and salt into medium bowl
4. Using electric mixer , beat butter and sugar in large bowl to blend well
5. Beat in eggs 1 at a time
6. Mix in orange zest , vanilla , ginger and nutmeg
7. Beat in flour mixture just until blended
8. Stir in cranberries , dates and pistachios
9. Turn dough out onto lightly floured surface
10. Gather dough together
11. Divide in half
12. Roll each half into 15-inch-long log
13. Carefully transfer logs to 1 prepared baking sheet , spacing 3 inches apart
14. Bake logs until almost firm to touch but still pale , about 30 minutes
15. Cool logs on baking sheet 10 minutes
16. Maintain oven temperature
17. Carefully transfer logs still on parchment paper to cutting board
18. Using serrated knife and gentle sawing motion , cut logs crosswise into generous 1 / 2-inch-thick slices
19. Place slices , one cut side down , on remaining 2 prepared sheets
20. Bake until firm and pale golden , about 10 minutes per side
21. Transfer cookies to racks and cool
22. Stir chocolate in top of double boiler over simmering water until smooth
23. Remove from over water
24. Using tines of fork , drizzle chocolate over biscotti or , alternatively , dip half of biscotti in the melted chocolate
25. Let stand until chocolate sets , about 30 minutes

title: indiana mexican lasagna
steps:
1. Brown ground beef and drain
2. Add to it the burrito seasoning mix , following directions on the back of the package
3. In 9 x 13 pan spread thin coat of enchilada sauce on bottom
4. Lay two tortillas in bottom of pan
5. Spread about 1 / 3 of seasoned meat over tortillas
6. Next , place about 1 / 4 of the cheeses you are using
7. Drizzle enchilada sauce here and there , not using more than 1 / 4 of your sauce
8. It will seem that you are not using enough , but you don't want it to get too saucy !
9. Repeat layers 2 more times
10. After placing the last 2 tortillas on top , "paint" remaining sauce over entire surface of tortillas , cover w / remaining cheeses
11. Cover pan w / lid and / or foil and bake at 350 for about 30 minutes
12. Take lid / foil off and bake until cheeses are melted and bubbly !
13. Let sit for about 10 minutes before cutting into
14. Offer lettuce , onion , olives , tomato , sour cream and sauces at table
15. I have also made this lasagna using seasoned chicken strips and spanish rice

title: banana chicken stew
steps:
1. In a saucepan , bring the chicken stock to a low boil
2. Slice the celery ribs down the center , then chop into thin pieces and add to the stock
3. Allow the celery to cook 5-10 minutes , or until it becomes tender
4. Turn off the heat and set aside
5. Place a large stockpot over medium heat and add the olive oil
6. When warm add the cubed chicken and cook through , allowing the bits to become slightly golden
7. Use a slotted spoon to remove the chicken
8. After removing the chicken , add the chopped onion to stockpot
9. Cook until the onion is beginning to turn golden , then add the garlic and cook for another minute
10. You're ready to add the bananas ! just slice the bananas into manageable chunks then plop them into the onion / garlic goodness
11. Use a fork or a potato masher to break down the bananas
12. There will probably be some lumps--that's perfectly fine
13. Once mashed , add the spices and seasonings
14. Make sure to start small and add more to taste
15. Remember that while you can always add more cayenne its near-impossible to remove !
16. Let the newly-spiced banana mixture warm for a minute then add the milk , garbanzo beans , and reserved cooked chicken
17. Once this is thoroughly mixed , also add the reserved celery and chicken stock and the butter
18. All the kiddies should now be in the pool
19. Bring this up to a very low boil , and if necessary allow it to reduce until the liquid has a texture that is slightly creamy
20. Serve warm over rice

title: coffee braised pot roast with onion sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. In a large dutch oven , heat 2 teaspoons olive oil over medium heat
3. Saut the onions and garlic until softened , about 10 minutes
4. Remove from pan and set aside
5. Heat the remaining oil over medium-high heat and brown the beef on all sides
6. Spoon the onions around the roast and pour in the coffee and broth
7. Add the salt , pepper , thyme and bay leaf
8. Bring to a boil and cover
9. Put the pot into oven and cook 1 hour and 40 minutes
10. Baste occasionally
11. Remove the roast from pan and let rest 15 minutes
12. Remove the onions from the pan with a slotted spoon and set aside
13. Discard the bay leaf
14. Degrease the liquid
15. Mash together the butter and flour
16. Bring the liquid to a boil and slowly whisk in the butter mixture
17. Simmer the sauce 10 minutes
18. It should be slightly thickened
19. Stir in the onions and vinegar
20. Check the seasonings
21. Carve the roast thinly and serve with the onion sauce

title: au gratin taco bake
steps:
1. Directions:
2. In a large skillet , cook beef over medium heat until no longer pink
3. Drain
4. Stir in the potatoes and contents of sauce mix , corn , tomatoes , milk , water and taco seasoning
5. Transfer to a greased 2-qt
6. Baking dish
7. Cover and bake at 350 for 65-70 minutes or until potatoes are tender
8. Sprinkle with cheese
9. Bake , uncovered , 5 minutes longer or until cheese is melted
10. Yield: 4-6 servings

title: butterball christmas cookies
steps:
1. Cream sofft butter , adding sugar gradually
2. Add egg yolks , slowing blending
3. Add flour gradually
4. Work dough around a cherry to form a balll
5. I make mine about 1 inch across , but you can make them smaller or larger
6. Place on greased cookie sheet and bake slowly at 325 for 20 minutes , or until golden brown
7. Cool completely
8. Then , shake in confectioners sugar
9. They are light , and melt-in-your-mouth good
10. Enjoy !

title: moroccan phyllo rolls
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Line a wide-rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper
3. Place bell peppers , zucchini , onion , fennel , apricots , and garlic on sheet , and toss with oil , ginger , cinnamon , cumin , paprika , salt and pepper
4. Roast in oven for 35-45 minutes , tossing once or twice , until veggies are caramelized in some spots and softened
5. Remove from oven , toss in chickpeas or white beans and basil , and let cool slightly
6. Reduce oven temperature to 375f
7. Line a baking dish or sheet with parchment paper
8. Place a lightly dampened dish towel over phyllo sheets to keep moist while preparing rolls
9. Lightly brush top of one sheet with oil
10. Place another sheet on top
11. Spread -1 cup roasted veggie mixture down the center of top sheet , leaving 1-2-in space from edges
12. Fold left side over filling and roll up , tucking in sides as you go
13. Brush with additional oil and place in lined baking dish or sheet
14. Repeat process until all phyllo and mixture are used
15. You will have 4-6 rolls
16. Bake for 24-28 minutes , until golden brown
17. Serve warm , drizzled with recipe #427818 , and garnished with almonds
18. Use 8 sheets to make generously stuffed rolls or 12 sheets for smaller ones
19. If the roll is quite full , it may tear while baking
20. This of course won't ruin them , but will affect the presentation
21. As appetizers: make smaller rolls or bite-sized phyllo triangles
22. For the latter , brush one sheet with oil
23. Then , with a sharp knife , cut 4 strips lengthwise down length of sheet
24. Place a small spoonful of filling at the base of one strip
25. Then , fold that corner over to form a triangle , and continue to fold back and forth until you reach the top
26. Repeat process until you have used up all the filling
27. Bake at 375f for 15-20 minutes , until golden
28. Serve with recipe #427818 as a dip

title: dried cranberry biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f , & coat a baking sheet with cooking spray
2. Mix flour & baking powder , then stir in corn oil , mixing until coarse crumbs form
3. Stir in milk to form a soft dough , then stir in cranberries
4. With floured hands , form dough into a ball , then press dough onto prepared baking sheet before evenly pressing it into a 6"x6" square
5. Cut dough into 12 biscuits , but do not separate them
6. Mix sugar with cinnamon & sprinkle over the cut dough
7. Bake 15-20 minutes or until lightly browned
8. Great served with a flavored butter

title: miniature meat balls
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. In a large bowl , combine soy sauce , water , minced garlic and ginger
3. Add ground beef and mix lightly , but thoroughly
4. Form into balls about 1 inch in diameter
5. Arrange on a lightly oiled baking dish
6. Bake , uncovered , for 15 minutes
7. Spear with toothpicks and serve from a chafing dish

title: kidney bean and corn salad
steps:
1. Drain canned beans and set aside
2. Make dressing by combining on oil , worcestershire , vinegar , mustard , salt and curry powder
3. Shake vigorously in a covered jar or blend well
4. Add green pepper and onion to dressing and set aside
5. Arrange beans in a shallow bowl and pour dressing over top
6. Cover
7. Refrigerate no less than 1 hour to allow flavors to blend

title: brown sugar cinnamon cream cheese
steps:
1. In a small bowl , blend the cream cheese , cinnamon , and brown sugar together until smooth
2. Serve immediately , or cover and refrigerate

title: egg drop soup  restaurant style
steps:
1. Reserve 3 / 4 cup of chicken broth , and pour the rest into a large saucepan
2. Stir the salt , ginger and chives into the saucepan , and bring to a rolling boil
3. In a cup or small bowl , stir together the remaining broth and cornstarch until smooth
4. Set aside
5. In a small bowl , whisk the eggs and egg yolk together using a fork
6. Drizzle egg a little at a time from the fork into the boiling broth mixture
7. Egg should cook immediately
8. Once the eggs have been dropped , stir in the cornstarch mixture gradually until the soup is the desired consistency

title: cheeey appetizer crackers
steps:
1. Mix together cheese , butter , flour and cayenne
2. Shape dough into 1 inch balls and place on a lightly greased cookie sheet
3. Flatten balls to about 1 / 4 inch thick with the bottom of a glass
4. Dip glass in flour if it sticks to the cheese mixture
5. Poke each cracker several times with the tines of a fork
6. Sprinkle lightly with paprika
7. Bake at 375f for 10 to 12 minutes

title: peanut lover s brownies
steps:
1. Line a 13 in x 9 in x 2 in baking pan with foil
2. Grease the foil
3. In a small mixing bowl , combine the butter , flour , cracker crumbs and sugar
4. Press into prepared pan
5. Bake at 350 for 10-12 minutes or until set
6. Cool on a wire rack
7. Sprinkle peanuts over crust
8. In a microwave , melt the butter and chocolate
9. Stir until smooth
10. In a mixing bowl , combine the eggs , sugar , vanilla and chocolate mixture
11. Add flour
12. Mix well
13. Spread over crust
14. Bake for 30-40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
15. Cool on a wire rack
16. For topping , warm peanut butter for 30 seconds in a microwave
17. Gradually fold in whipped topping
18. Spread over brownies
19. Refrigerate for 1 hour
20. Sprinkle with chopped peanut butter cups
21. Using foil , lift brownies out of pan
22. Remove foil
23. Cut into squares
24. Store in refrigerator

title: chambord spritzer
steps:
1. In a tall glass combine the chambord , the wine , the lemon juice , and 4 ice cubes
2. Fill the glass with the seltzer and stir the drink
3. Garnish it with the lemon peel

title: roesti potatoes
steps:
1. Heat butter in a skillet over medium high heat
2. Add onion and bacon and saute for 4 minutes
3. Add hash browns and press down
4. Brown well , flip , press and brown to crisp

title: chicken tenders with lemon spinach rice
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat
2. Add the chicken tenders and the garlic
3. Cook , turning , for 6 minutes or until the chicken is golden brown and the juices run clear
4. Transfer to a plate and keep warm
5. Add all the remaining ingredients except the spinach and bring to the boil over a high heat
6. Cover and reduce the heat to low
7. Cook for 10 minutes or until the liquid has been absorbed
8. Add the spinach to the skillet and toss to mix well
9. Place the contents of the pan on a large platter and top with the chicken

title: alsatian tempeh casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven 350f
2. Boil or steam potatoes 20 minutes , or until tender
3. Transfer to medium bowl and mash with potato masher adding tablespoonfuls of cooking water
4. Meanwhile , heat 1 1 / 2 oil in large skillet over medium-high heat
5. Add onion and cook stirring 5 to 7 minutes until soft
6. Stir in sauerkraut
7. Reduce heat to low
8. Cover and cook for 15 minutes
9. Stir in tempeh and cook 1 to 2 minutes until heated through season with pepper
10. Coat 1 1 / 2 quart casserole dish with cooking spray
11. Add tempeh mixture
12. Add potatoes on top and brush with the rest of the oil
13. Bake 30 minutes , then broil 1 to 2 minutes or until topped is lightly browned
14. Serve hot

title: spicy sweet deviled eggs
steps:
1. Cut eggs in half lengthwise
2. Carefully remove yolks
3. Mash yolks
4. Stir in mayonnaise , chutney , and red pepper until well blended
5. Spoon or pipe yolk mixture evenly into egg white halves
6. Sprinkle evenly with desired amount of salt
7. Garnish , if desired with either chives or paprika or both
8. Chill until ready to serve

title: chocolatier dark chocolate orange fondue
steps:
1. Heat cream in small , heavy-duty saucepan over medium-high heat , & bring just to a boil
2. Remove from heat , & add chocolate , stirring until smooth
3. Add liqueur & zest , mixing well
4. Transfer fondue to fondue pot , & place over low heat
5. Stir often while on heat , while serving

title: pink turkey sandwich
steps:
1. Spread strawberry cream cheese on one slice of bread
2. Put lettuce on other slice of bread
3. Put turkey in between the lettuce and cream cheese

title: easy skillet cheese topped chili macaroni
steps:
1. In a large skillet , brown onion and garlic with ground beef
2. Drain and return to pan
3. Add kidney beans , tomato sauce , water , chili powder , and salt
4. Cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes
5. Add cooked macaroni and stir
6. Add grated cheddar to top , cover and simmer just until cheese melts

title: herbed veggie casserole
steps:
1. Using some of the butter , grease 10 cup baking dish
2. Arrange half the potato slices in overlapping rows in dish
3. Dot with a little of the butter and sprinkle with a pinch of sage , tarragon and salt to taste , layer with half the red peppers , half the onion , half the rice and half the zucchini
4. Dot with butter , sprinkle with sage , tarragon and salt to taste
5. Repeat the layers
6. Arrange the tomatoes over the top
7. Cover with foil and bake in 350f degree oven for 1 1 / 2 to 1 3 / 4 hours or until potatoes are tender
8. Sprinkle with cheese , cover and bake for about 10 minutes longer or until cheese is melted
9. Let stand , covered for 10 minutes before serving
10. Garnish with sage sprigs ,

title: hendricks  cucumber martini
steps:
1. Muddle , shake
2. Serve straight uo in a chilled martini glass with a slice of cucumber as a garnish

title: elderberry cough syrup
steps:
1. Simmer the three above ingredients in 1 pint for 20 minutes
2. Let stand for 1 / 2 hour
3. Strain through a sieve pressing well
4. Then , add enough water to the simmered ingredients to bring the volume back up to 1 pint of liquid
5. Add the sugar and gently heat to dissolve the sugar in the hot liquid
6. Allow to cool and then pour into dark bottles and keep somewhere cool
7. Dosage: 2 teaspoons in a little water 3 times a day

title: succotash
steps:
1. Prepare lima beans according to package directions
2. Drain
3. Put corn in the container of a food processor and pulse 8-10 times or until coarsely chopped in a large saucepan , melt butter over medium heat
4. Add flour and stir until smooth
5. Continue cooking and stirring constantly for 1 minute
6. Add sugar , salt , and pepper
7. Gradually add milk , stirring until smooth
8. Add corn
9. Continue cooking and stir often for 12 to 15 minutes or until corn is tender and mixture is thick
10. Stir in lima beans
11. Serve immediately and top each serving with crumbled bacon if desired

title: aussie apricot chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 190c
2. Heat the oil in an oven-proof pan and cook onion and garlic over medium heat until onion is softened , stir
3. Mix the curry powder and flour together in a bag then add in the chicken and toss well
4. Add the chicken to the pan and cook it until it changes colour
5. Add the dry soup mix and stir to coat all the chicken , then the nectar stirring really well
6. Bring to the boil and simmer until the mix thickens
7. Put the lid on and place in the preheated oven
8. Cook for about 30 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through
9. Remove from the oven , stir through the parsley , then serve over plenty of mash or rice
10. You can add in dried or canned apricots , but we prefer it without

title: buttery garlic and sharp cheddar biscuits   low carb
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Line a cookie sheet with foil , and grease
3. Whisk together eggs , butter , salt , and garlic powder
4. Add coconut flour and baking powder and whisk until there are no lumps
5. Fold in cheese
6. Drop batter by the 1
7. 5 oz scoop onto greased cookie sheet
8. Bake for 15 minutes , or until lightly browned
9. Let cool in pan for 5-10 minutes before removing and serving
10. Make sure that biscuits are completely cool before storage or they won't stay crisp

title: easy potato bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f mix sour cream , cheese , soup and onions in large bowl
2. Add potatoes
3. Mix well
4. Spoon into greased 13x9-inch baking dish
5. Bake 45 minutes
6. Toss crumbs with butter
7. Sprinkle over potato mixture
8. Bake an additional 15 minutes
9. Variation southwest style easy potato bake
10. Prepare as directed , using kraft mexican style shredded cheese , adding 1 can undrained chopped green chilies to the potato mixture and substituting 1 cup crushed tortilla chips for the crushed corn flakes

title: strawberry rhubarb streusel muffins
steps:
1. Set oven to 375f
2. Line 12 muffin tins with paper liners , or sray with non stick cooking spray
3. To make topping: mix the sugar , cinnamon together , cut in the butter to make a crumbly mixture , mix in the finely chopped nuts
4. Set aside
5. In a large mixing bowl , combine the brown sugar , egg , oil and vanilla
6. Stir / whisk to blend well
7. Stir in orange juice and sour cream
8. Mix well to combine
9. In another bowl , mix together flour , salt , cinnamon , baking soda and baking powder
10. Mix well
11. Blend the dry ingredients into the wet mixture to partially combine , if still too thick add in some orange juice to loosen
12. Fold in the strawberries and rhubarb carefully not to overmix batter
13. Divide the batter evenly in prepared muffin tins
14. Sprinkle a generous amount of streusel mix over the batter
15. Reduce heat to 350f
16. Place the muffins immediately in the oven and bake for 25-30 minutes , or until muffins are golden and test done

title: grilled cha cha pork chops
steps:
1. Combine the orange juice , olive oil , garlic , cumin , cinnamon and salt and pepper in a large bowl
2. Add the chops and coat well with marinade
3. Cover bowl and marinate in refrigerator for 2-4 hours , turning once or twice
4. Heat a barbecue grill to high and grill the chops for about 6 minutes per side
5. -be sure not to overcook
6. Enjoy !

title: french canadian apple pie
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees
2. Place one crust into a pie pan
3. Sift the brown sugar and the flour together
4. Peel and core the apples , and cut into thin slices
5. Mix the apples and the raisins with the brown sugar / flour and pour into the pie crust , being sure to distribute the apples and raisins evenly within the crust
6. Dot the butter evenly over the apples and sprinkle with the cinnamon
7. Sprinkle the almonds evenly on top
8. Top with the second pie crust , folding the edge under the bottom crust edge
9. Flute and seal the edges
10. Make 3 or 4 small slits in the top crust to allow the steam to escape
11. Bske at 450 degrees for 15 minutes then reduce the oven temperature to 350 degrees and bake for 40 to 45 minutes more until golden brown

title: basil caper butter
steps:
1. Mix it all and let it sit a bit to mellow
2. If you're making it ahead , roll it up in plastic wrap so you end up with a nice log of compound butter
3. This freezes beautifully

title: baked hawaiian pineapple
steps:
1. Combine sugar , flour , salt , pineapple juice and egg in a saucepan
2. Mix until sugar is dissolved
3. Cook over medium heat until thick
4. In a 1 quart casserole , layer pineapple , cheese and marshmallows
5. Pour cooked mixture over the top
6. Bake covered at 300 degrees for 20 minutes

title: moroccan chickpea and spinach stew
steps:
1. Place chickpeas and cumin in large saucepan
2. Add enough water to barely cover chickpeas
3. Set aside
4. Saute garlic in olive oil in small pan over medium to low heat
5. Remove garlic when browned , about 3 minutes
6. Set aside
7. Toast bread until golden in same pan about one minute per side
8. Remove bread and turn off heat
9. Add paprika and saffron , followed immediately by vinegar to keep paprika from burning
10. Pound garlic and browned bread in a mortar or glass bowl to make a thick paste
11. Bring chickpeas to a low boil , then add spinach , and simmer for 5 minutes
12. Add paprika-saffron mixture and garlic bread paste to create a thick stew
13. Simmer for 5 minutes
14. Season with salt and pepper and serve immediately

title: roasted celery root
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Trim and peel celery root and cut into 1-inch pieces
3. In a large roasting pan toss celery root with oil and salt and roast in middle of oven 30 minutes
4. Stir celery root and reduce temperature to 375f
5. Roast celery root , stirring after the 30 minutes , 1 hour more

title: ham and sharp cheddar biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 500f
2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper
3. Combine onion and butter in a skillet over medium-low heat and cook until tender but not browned , about 5 minutes
4. Cool
5. In a bowl , combine flour , baking powder , salt and baking soda
6. Add butter and mix with your fingers until mealy in texture
7. Add the onions , buttermilk , ham and cheese , stirring in with a spatula until just incorporated , but it still should be a bit loose
8. Scoop out the batter with a large spoon to form 12 biscuits and lightly shape them with floured hands
9. Arrange close together on the baking sheet for soft biscuits , or spread them apart for crisper biscuits
10. Brush with hot melted butter
11. Bake 5 minutes then reduce temperature to 450f and bake a further 15 minutes or until deep golden brown
12. Cool in pan for several minutes then invert onto kitchen towel
13. Turn right side up and serve hot

title: quick brown rice with onions and mushrooms
steps:
1. Drain the liquid from the can of mushrooms into a measuring cup and add enough additional water to make one cup
2. Bring the liquid to a boil in a covered sauce pan , add the instant brown rice , cover , reduce the heat and simmer for 5 minutes
3. At the end of the 5 minute cooking period , remove from the heat , but do not peek
4. Set aside for at least 5 more minutes to rest
5. While the rice is resting , saute the onions and mushrooms in the olive oil and butter
6. When the onions are transparent , remove from the heat , add the finished rice to the saute pan , add salt and pepper and stir

title: delicious game day beef stew
steps:
1. Brown stew meat
2. Add 2 cans of cream of mushroom soup with one can of water
3. Put in oven safe stew pot
4. Bake at 250 degrees for 4-6 hours

title: emeril s green beans creole
steps:
1. Melt butter in a medium sauce pan over high heat
2. Add bacon and ham and cook , stirring for 2 minutes
3. Add onions and cook , stirring until soft , about 4 minutes
4. Add tomatoes and their juice and cook , stirring for 4 minutes
5. Add 2 cups of the water , salt , pepper and beans
6. Reduce heat to medium and cook , stirring occasionally , until beans begin to soften , about 20 minutes
7. Add remaining 1 cup water and cook until beans are very tender , about 10 minutes

title: quick   easy ramen stir fry
steps:
1. Cut beef into thin strips
2. Spray 12 inch skillet with cooking spray
3. Heat
4. Cook beef in skillet until brown
5. Remove beef from skillet
6. Heat water to boiling in skillet
7. Break noodles from soup into water
8. Stir until slightly softened
9. Stir in vegetables
10. Heat to boiling
11. Boil 5 minutes until vegetables are crisp-tender
12. Stir in contents of seasoning packet for soup mix , stir fry sauce and beef
13. Cook 2 minutes until hot

title: eggless tender flaky scones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Mix with a whisk in a big bowl the flour , baking powder , salt and sugar
3. Cut in butter with a butter knife in each hand until mix looks like coarse crumbs
4. Pour in cream and fold in everything until just incorporated
5. Do not overmix
6. If mixture seems a little dry , add a little more cream
7. Fold currants or cranberries into batter
8. Press the dough in 3 or 4 batches on lightly floured board 1 1 / 4-inch thick
9. Cut into triangles
10. All in all about 8-16 scones , depending on size
11. Place scones on ungreased cookie parchment
12. Brush tops with a bit of cream
13. Bake for 15-20 minutes until golden brown
14. Let cool on a rack

title: cooking light s seven layer salad
steps:
1. Layer lettuce , beans , tomatoes , cucumbers , and carrots in that order in a large bowl
2. Combine sour cream and ranch dressing
3. Spread dressing mixture over carrot layer
4. Top with shredded cheddar cheese
5. Cover and chill

title: lemon orzo soup
steps:
1. Bring chicken broth and water to boil in medium saucepan
2. Stir in orzo , basil and lemon
3. Return to boil , lower heat and simmer 10 minutes or until orzo is tender

title: weeknight orzo dinner
steps:
1. Bring chicken broth to a boil with 1 clove of minced garlic
2. Add orzo pasta , cook for 8 to 10 minutes , stirring occasionally , until al dente
3. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat , and stir in the remaining garlic and red pepper about 30 seconds
4. Stir in chicken , season with salt & pepper , and cook 5-6 minutes , until lightly browned and juices run clear
5. Reduce heat to medium , and mix in the parsley , spinach , cooked orzo with remaining broth and parmesan
6. Continue cooking 2-3 minutes , stirring until combined and spinach is wilted
7. Serve topped with additional parmesan cheese if desired

title: mounds haystacks
steps:
1. 1
2. Melt chocolate , add 1 / 8 cup coconut , coconut extract and fiber one cereal
3. Stir until well blended
4. 2
5. Spoon by tablespoonfuls onto waxed paper
6. Sprinkle a little coconut on top of each cookie
7. 3
8. Put in refrigerator until cool

title: tropical coffee cake
steps:
1. Preheat over to 350 prepare a 8"x8" square dish with cooking dpray and set aside in a mixing bowl , combine flour , sugar and baking powder , set aside in another mixing bowk , combine sour cream , oil , egg beaters and pineapple
2. Add to dry ingredients and mix until thoroughly combined pour batter into prepared dish
3. In a small bowl , combine remaining sugar and cinnamon
4. Sprinkle evenly on top of batter
5. Bake for 35 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean

title: super s peanut butter chocolate soda
steps:
1. Scoop icecream into a tall glass
2. Add syrups
3. Fill to the top with club soda
4. Stir
5. Enjoy
6. !

title: super simple chicken salad
steps:
1. Place chicken in a bowl and break up chunks
2. Add mayonnaise , celery and onion
3. Mix well
4. Serve on bread or desired way

title: barbecued fish steaks
steps:
1. Saut onion and garlic in butter or margarine until tender
2. Add ingredients through ground peppercorn and simmer for about 7 minutes , stirring occasionally
3. Cool
4. Pour liquid into a zip-lock type storage bag
5. Add salmon
6. Marinate in refrigerator 45 minutes , turning after about 20 minute intervals
7. Remove fish from marinade
8. Place on well-greased , hinged wire grill
9. Cook 2 inches from coals for 3 minutes , basting frequently with sauce
10. Turn and cook for about 5 minutes longer , or until fish is done

title: blueberry oat summer treat
steps:
1. In a saucepan , combine water and cornstarch over medium heat
2. Gradually whisk in sugar until smooth
3. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly
4. Stir in blueberries
5. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or longer , until thick and bubbly
6. Remove from heat and set aside
7. In a bowl , combine the cake mix and 1 cup oats
8. Cut in 6 tablespoons butter until crumbly
9. Set aside 1 cup crumb mixture for topping
10. Stir egg whites into remaining crumb mixture
11. Press into baking dish coated with nonstick cooking spray
12. Spread blueberry mixture on top of cake mix
13. Combine reserved cup of crumb mixture with remaining oats and brown sugar
14. Cut in remaining butter until crumbly
15. Sprinkle over top
16. Bake at 350 for 30-35 minutes or until golden brown
17. May serve with frozen yogurt or lowfat ice cream

title: hamburger beans
steps:
1. In a large frying pan , cook hamburger until no longer pink , 10-15 minutes
2. Break into small pieces with a spatula and drain off grease
3. While ground beef is cooking , chop onions and peel garlic cloves & crush
4. Melt butter in bottom of a large cooking pot on medium heat
5. Saute the onions 5 minutes
6. Add garlic to the onions and continue to saute until onions are translucent , another 2-3 minutes
7. Add beans , ground beef and brown sugar to pot and stir well
8. Heat on medium-low heat and simmer for 20-30 minutes , stirring occasionally

title: asian chicken broccoli slaw
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine the broccoli slaw mix , chicken , snap beans , red pepper , scallions , and cabbage
2. In another bowl whisk together the soy sauce , vinegar , peanut butter , sugar , minced garlic , and grated ginger
3. Slowly add the canola oil and sesame oil
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste
5. Toss the salad with the dressing
6. Top with sprinking of the chopped cashews if desired

title: soft and chewy chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. In large bowl , beat sugar , brown sugar and margarine until light and fluffy
3. Add vanilla and eggs
4. Blend well
5. Add flour , baking soda and salt
6. Mix well
7. Stir in chocolate chips
8. Drop dough by rounded tablespoonfuls 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheets
9. Bake at 375f for 8 to 10 minutes or until light golden brown

title: tapenade bread  a b m
steps:
1. Make the tapenade by processing the olives , anchovy fillet , capers , garlic , olive oil , and pepper in a food processor
2. Add all ingredients including the tapenade to your bread machine in the order recommended by its manufacturer , and select the bread cycle

title: cherry lattice pie  diabetic
steps:
1. For crust: combine flour and salt in medium bowl
2. Cut in margarine with pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
3. Mix in water , 1 tablespoon at a time , stirring lightly with fork after each addition until dough is formed
4. Wrap and refrigerate until ready to use
5. For pie: thaw cherries completely in strainer set in bowl
6. Reserve 3 / 4 cup cherry juice
7. Mix equal or splenda , flour , cornstarch and nutmeg in small saucepan
8. Stir in cherry juice and heat to boiling
9. Boil , stirring constantly , 1 minute
10. Remove from heat and stir in cherries
11. Stir in food color
12. Roll half of pastry on floured surface into circle 1 inch larger than inverted 9-inch pie pan
13. Ease pastry into pan
14. Pour cherry mixture into pastry
15. Roll remaining pastry on floured surface to 1 / 8-inch thickness
16. Cut into 10 to 12 strips , 1 / 2 inch wide
17. Arrange pastry strips over filling and weave into lattice design
18. Trim ends of lattice strips
19. Fold edge of lower crust over ends of lattice strips
20. Seal and flute edge
21. Bake in preheated 425f oven until pastry is browned , 35 to 40 minutes
22. Cool on wire rack

title: chicken caesar   vegetable lasagna
steps:
1. Cook noodles according to package directions
2. Drain
3. Preheat oven to 350f
4. Cook ground chicken in large non-stick pan along with chopped onion
5. Salt and pepper meat while cooking
6. Halfway through cooking add minced garlic
7. Cook until done
8. Remove from heat
9. In a large mixing bowl combine ground meat mixture , chopped spinach , chopped red peppers , chopped broccoli , chopped carrots , lemon juice , and alfredo sauce
10. Spray a 9x13 pan with non-stick spray
11. Lay three noodles on the bottom
12. Put 1 / 3 of the mixture on top of noodles
13. Repeat layers twice
14. Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese and then parmesan cheese
15. Bake uncovered for 40 minutes or until heated through
16. I usually put it under the broiler for a few minutes so the top gets a little brown

title: pan roasted portabellas
steps:
1. Spray a cooking pan with cooking spray
2. Add minced garlic and saut for a couple minutes either cut the portabellas into slices , or leave them whole
3. When i did it , i cut them into slices
4. Sprinkle portabellas with salt and pepper and saut a couple minutes on each side over medium heat , until they have softened
5. If the heat is too high , they will burn a little
6. I burnt mine , but they still tasted good

title: basic barbecue sauce
steps:
1. In a saucepan , heat oil and cook onion until tender
2. Stir in garlic and cook for about 1 minute
3. Stir in remaining ingredients
4. Reduce heat to a slow simmer and cook until reduced by half or desired thickness , stirring occasionally
5. Season with salt and black pepper if desired

title: grilled onion hash browns
steps:
1. Preheat grill to 350
2. Place a large piece of tin foil shiny side up on the counter
3. Brush the foil liberally with melted butter
4. Place cold , but not frozen potatoes in centre of foil
5. Add onion
6. Toss lightly and drizzle the remaining butter on top of the potatoes and season liberally with salt , pepper and paprika
7. Fold opposite ends of foil up and over potatoes to form a pouch
8. Place the foil pouch on the grill for approximately 25-30 minutes or until potatoes and onions are tender
9. Turn the pouch once during the cooking period
10. Once they are finished sprinkle with parsley

title: asparagus gratinata
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f cook the asparagus in a pot of simmering water until tender , about 5 minutes
2. Drain and place in an ovenproof serving dish , then drizzle with the oil
3. Whisk together the milk , cheese , egg , egg white , and salt
4. Pour over the asparagus
5. Bake until the gratinata is browned and bubbling , about 20 minutes
6. Makes 4 servings

title: pickled carrot   radish
steps:
1. Mix gently carrot , radish , and salt together in a medium bowl
2. Let stand for 10 minute
3. Transfer to a sieve or colandar and rinse
4. Squeeze the mixture to remove excess water
5. Place carrot and radish in a medium bowl
6. Add sugar and vinegar
7. Toss to coat
8. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 2 hours
9. This is best served chilled

title: koshari
steps:
1. Cook the lentils in just over a litre of salted water
2. Bring to a boil , reduce the heat and simmer , covered , for 15-30 minutes , depending on the type of lentils you are using
3. When the lentils are quite tender , add the rice to the lentils and continue simmering until the rice is cooked , adding water if necessary
4. Cook the macaroni in a separate pot
5. Rinse and strain when done
6. Meanwhile , fry the onions and garlic in the oil until golden
7. Add the tomatoes , chilli flakes , salt and pepper to taste and let it bubble for 10-20 minutes or until thickened and sauce like
8. You can now blitz the sauce in a food processor until smooth or just leave as is
9. Mix the lentils , rice and macaroni together in one pot
10. Place some of the lentil mixture on each plate and top with tomato sauce
11. Sprinkle with more hot chili powder or salt and pepper , if desired

title: mock chestnut torte  passover cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f line a 9-inch springform pan with baking parchment
2. Torte: in a mixing bowl , cream the unsalted margarine or butter with the 1 / 3 cup sugar
3. Blend in the egg yolks , then the mashed sweet potatoes , rum extract , and cooled chocolate
4. In another bowl , with clean beaters , whip the egg whites gently until they are a bit foamy
5. Then add in the salt and whip on a higher speed , slowly dusting in the two tablespoons of sugar to form stiff , glossy peaks
6. Fold one third of the egg whites into the sweet potato / chocolate mixture and work them in well to loosen the batter
7. Then , gently fold in the remaining egg whites , blending well but taking care not to deflate the mixture
8. Spoon the batter into the prepared pan and bake for about 40 minutes
9. The cake rises and looks dry , and slightly cracked on top when done
10. The middle should be soft but firm
11. Cool in the pan for 20 minutes , then remove to a wire rack
12. At this point , the cake can be frozen for up to a month
13. Even if serving it the same day , chill the cake for an hour or two before finishing it with the ganache glaze
14. Chocolate ganache glaze: in a double boiler , bring the water to a gentle boil and add the chopped chocolate all at once
15. Remove from the heat and stir briskly with a wire whisk until all the chocolate melts and you have a thick glaze or sauce-like topping
16. Refrigerate for an hour or so
17. Invert the cake onto a cardboard circle or cake board so that the smooth , flat bottom faces up
18. Do not be dismayed if this is not a high cake it is a torte and is meant to be a little less than statuesque
19. Pour the glaze over the cake and , using a metal spatula , even out the glaze and spread it along the sides
20. Instead of the glaze , you can also simply sift some cocoa over the top of the cake or decorate it with curls of chocolate
21. The cake can also be offered with a pureed raspberry or strawberry sauce , garnished with chocolate shavings , or left as is , with a citrus leaf , a sweetheart rose , or several berries in the center

title: oriental flank steak with asparagus and wild rice pilaf
steps:
1. Snap off tough ends of asparagus
2. Cook asparagus in boiling water for 2 minutes or until crisp-tender
3. Drain well and chill
4. Combine soy sauce and next 4 ingredients , reserving 1 / 3 cup soy sauce mixture
5. Set aside
6. Place remaining soy sauce mixture , asparagus , and steak in a zip-top plastic bag
7. Seal
8. Marinate in regrigerature 1 hour , turning occasionally
9. Remove asparagus and steak from bag , and discard mixture
10. Place a grill pan over medium-high heat
11. Add asparagus and steak and cook steak 3 minutes on each side or until desired degree of doneness , turning asparagus as needed
12. Place steak on a platter , and cover with foil
13. Let stand for 5 minutes
14. Cut steak diagonally across grain into thin slices
15. Combine 1 / 3 cup reserved soy sauce mixture , spinach , rice , celery , oil , and onions , toss to coat
16. Divide asparagus , steak , and wild-rice pilaf evenly among 4 plates

title: rhubarb pudding and ice cream topping
steps:
1. Combine everything
2. Place over medium heat , and cook until the mixture comes to a full boil , stirring constantly
3. Remove from heat
4. Cool , stirring occasionally
5. Chill fantastic as a pudding or over a good vanilla ice cream
6. My mom would add a few drops of red food coloring to make it more palatable to us as kids

title: slow cooker sweet bbq pork spareribs  or chicken
steps:
1. Spray your slow cooker with nonstick spray
2. Place the spareribs in bottom of slow cooker
3. Sprinkle w / salt and pepper
4. If desired to taste
5. Combine remaining ingredients in a bowl
6. Pour over meat
7. Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours or until done

title: zesty panko chicken stix
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine panko breadcrumbs , dry dressing mix , cheese , garlic powder , salt and pepper
2. In another bowl , toss chicken strips with egg to coat , shaking off excess
3. Toss chicken strips with breadcrumb mixture , pressing crumbs into meat to adhere
4. Place breaded chicken on a baking sheet coated with nonstick cooking spray
5. Bake at 350 for 10-15 minutes or until chicken is cooked through

title: oatmeal peanut butter sandwich cookies
steps:
1. Cream the butters and sugars
2. Add the vanilla and egg
3. Stir in the flour , baking powder , soda , and salt till well combined
4. Stir in the oatmeal
5. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheets
6. Press each cookie twice with a wet fork to make 1 / 4 inch thick cookies
7. I use a small bowl of water to keep the fork wet
8. Bake at 350 degrees f for 10 minutes or until light brown
9. Cool on wire racks
10. To make filling: cream all ingredients until smooth
11. Spread filling between two cookies to form sandwiches and hide from your husband

title: easy crock pot apple butter
steps:
1. Add applesauce , sugars , and cider together in crock pot
2. Cover and cook on low for 3 hours
3. Add spices and cook on low , covered , for 3 more hours
4. Uncover and continue cooking on low for 1-4 hours or until sufficiently thickened
5. May take longer , depends on how thick you like it and your crock pot
6. Ladle hot apple butter into 1 / 2 pint or pint size canning jars and process in a boiling water bath for 10 minutes
7. Makes about 6 pints
8. If you're not into canning , this would probably freeze very well

title: blueberry snack mix
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Spread the almonds and walnuts on a baking sheet
3. Bake 6 minutes , stir , and bake 4 minutes longer
4. When it's cool enough to handle , cut almonds in half crosswise
5. In a bowl , combine toasted nuts , soy nuts , blueberries and ginger
6. Enjoy !

title: luby s cafeteria italian chicken breast
steps:
1. Dry chicken breasts
2. In a medium bowl , combine shredded mozzarella cheese , 2 cups flour , dried parsley flakes , grated parmesan cheese and dressing mix and mix well
3. In a shallow bowl , whisk together milk and eggs until well blended
4. Place remaining 1 cup flour in a separate shallow bowl
5. Coat chicken with flour , shaking off excess
6. Dip into milk mixture , then into cheese mixture , coating evenly and pressing into chicken
7. Heat about 1 / 8 inch oil in a large skillet over medium heat
8. Add chicken and cook 5-6 minutes on each side or until cooked through
9. Garnish with cheese and parsley

title: currant glazed pork roast
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Pierce top of roast serveal times with a flork and place on a rack in a shallow roasting pan
3. Roast 1 hour and 45 minutes or until meat reaches 160
4. Combine next 5 ingredients in a bowl
5. Brush pork with mixture every 10 minutes during last 30 minutes of cooking time
6. Remove roast to a serving platter and let stand at least 10 minutes
7. Pour water into roasting pan , stirring to combine with pan drippings
8. Bring to a boil over high heat
9. Slice roast and serve with pan drippings

title: apple cider jelly
steps:
1. In a small bowl , mix together 1 / 4 cup of the sugar and the powdered pectin
2. Set aside
3. Pour the apple cider into a cooking pot
4. Add the pectin / sugar mixture to juice in the cooking pot
5. Stir vigorously and well
6. Bring mixture to full rolling boil stirring constantly
7. Stir in remaining sugar and the cinnamon
8. Return to full rolling boil and boil for one-minute , stirring constantly
9. Remove from heat
10. Skim off any foam
11. Ladle into sterilized jars to within 1 / 8 inch of tops
12. Seal and process five-minutes in boiling water bath

title: country pasta
steps:
1. In large skillet , saute the onion and garlic in the olive oil until soft
2. Add the mushrooms and tomato sauce , stirring to combine
3. Cook about 10 minutes , or until heated thoroughly and mushrooms are softened
4. Add the olives and crushed red pepper , cooking for a few more minutes
5. In serving bowl , toss the cooked pasta with the sauce , and sprinkle with the parmesan cheese

title: clementine s oatmeal chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. In a large bowl , beat butter with sugar and brown sugar at medium speed until creamy and lightened in color
3. Add vanilla and egg , mix on low speed until incorporated
4. Stir flour with baking soda , salt and spices
5. Add to cream mixture , mixing well
6. Stir in oats
7. Fold in chocolate chips and walnuts
8. Drop by rounded tablespoon onto ungreased cookie sheets
9. Bake 8-9 minutes for a chewy cookie
10. Bake 10-11 minutes for a crisp cookie
11. Cool one minute on a cookie sheet
12. Remove to wire cooling racks
13. Store in tightly covered container

title: apple nut bread pudding
steps:
1. Place bread cubes , apples , and pecans in a greased slow cooker , and mix together gently
2. Combine sugar , cinnamon , and nutmeg
3. Add remaining ingredients
4. Mix well , and pour over breadmixture
5. Cover , cook on low 3-4 hours or until knife inserted in center comes out clean
6. Serve with ice cream

title: reduced fat pecan oat bars
steps:
1. Heat oven 350f lightly grease bottom and sides of 13x9 pan
2. In large bowl , mix granulated sugar , butter , applesauce , and vanilla
3. Stir in flour
4. Mix well
5. Press dough in bottom and 1 / 2 up sides of pan
6. Bake 15-17 minutes or until edges are light brown
7. For filling: in a small bowl , sprinkle powdered milk over egg whites , then beat them with fork until smooth
8. Add food color , and beat until blended
9. Beat brown sugar , corn syrup , vanilla , the salt , egg and egg white mixture with a spoon
10. Stir in pecans and oats
11. Pour over crust
12. Bake 25-30 minutes or until set
13. Loosen edges from sides of pan while warm
14. Cool completely

title: spiked spiced berries
steps:
1. Clean and slice strawberries into pieces and place in a large bowl
2. Wash blueberries , drain and add to bowl
3. Add wine and spices
4. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and stir to dissolve and distribute
5. Refrigerate at least 2 hours prior to serving , stirring it up periodically to redistribute the juices and any powdered sugar that may have settled to the bottom
6. Just prior to serving , mix in raspberries and blackberries
7. Serve berries in a bowl or ladle onto pound cake

title: one pot weeknight beanie weenies
steps:
1. In large sauce pan , boil hot dogs in water for 1 minute
2. Discard water , slice hot dogs into bite-size pieces and return pan to stove on medium heat
3. Combine all ingredients in pan and allow to heat through

title: creamy apple dessert
steps:
1. Preheat over to 350f
2. Use a 1 / 1 / 2 quart baking dish and melt butter or margarine in the oven
3. Sprinkle the graham cracker crumbs over melted butter and mix well
4. Press into the bottom of the dish to make a crust
5. Mix sweetened condensed milk , cream cheese and lemon juice
6. Spread evenly over crust
7. Spoon pie filling evenly over creamy layer
8. Bake 25 to 30 minutes until set
9. Cool slightly
10. In small dish , mix together nuts and cinnamon
11. Sprinkle over pie filling
12. Serve warm or cold
13. Refrigerate leftovers

title: quick and creamy applesauce dessert
steps:
1. Combine all ingrediencts in a bowl and mix thoroughly
2. Serve right away or chill for a later serving

title: zucchini stuffing casserole
steps:
1. Cook zucchini & onion in boiling salted water for 5-10 minutes
2. Drain well
3. In large bowl combine soup and sour cream
4. Stir in carrots
5. Fold in zucchini mixture
6. Toss stuffing mix with butter
7. Spread 1 / 2 stuffing mixture in a 127 1 / 22" baking dish
8. Spoon zucchini mixture on top
9. Sprinkle with remaining stuffing mix
10. Bake at 350 for 25-30 minutes or until heated through

title: grandpa roy s fresh peach cobbler
steps:
1. Sift flour before measuring
2. Spoon lightly into measuring cup and level without shaking or packing down
3. Combine flour and salt in a mixing bowl
4. With a pastry blender cut in crisco until uniform
5. Mixture should be fairly coarse
6. Sprinkle with cold water , a little at a time
7. Toss with a fork
8. Work dough into a firm ball with your hands
9. Heat oven to 400 degrees
10. Mix sugar and cornstarch and gradually stir in water
11. Bring to a boil and boil 1 minute , stirring constantly
12. Add fruit and juices
13. Set aside
14. Press of the dough into a flat oval with smooth edges and roll out of pie crust dough between 2 sheets of wax paper that has been cut a little larger than the baking dish
15. Place in 9 x 13" baking dish and prick with a fork
16. Bake for about 8 to10 minutes
17. Do not brown
18. Pour fruit mixture over crust and spread evenly
19. Dot with butter and sprinkle with cinnamon
20. Roll remaining dough the same as above and carefully place over fruit
21. Cut slits in dough and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon
22. Bake until top crust is lightly browned and cobbler is bubbly

title: sweet   sour meatballs ii
steps:
1. Prepare basic meatballs and cook
2. Mix cornstarch and sugar in large skillet
3. Stir in pineapple with syrup , soy sauce and vinegar
4. Stirring constantly , cook until mixture thickens and boils
5. Add cooked meatballs
6. Cover and simmer 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
7. Stir in green pepper
8. Cover and simmer until green pepper is crisp-tender , about 5 minutes
9. Serve over rice

title: cheesy bacon brussels sprouts
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Remove any discolored outer leaves and trim stem portion of brussels sprouts
3. In a 3-quart saucepan , place brussels sprouts
4. Add enough water just to cover
5. Heat to boiling
6. Boil 6-8 minutes or until crisp-tender
7. Drain and return to saucepan
8. Set aside
9. Meanwhile , in a 10-inch skillet , cook bacon over medium heat , stirring occassionally , until crisp
10. Remove bacon and drain on paper towels
11. Set aside
12. Drain all but 1 tablespoon bacon fat from skillet
13. Add butter to bacon fat in skillet
14. Heat over medium-high heat until butter is melted
15. Add onion
16. Cook 2-3 minutes , stirring frequently , until crisp-tender
17. Add flour , thyme and pepper
18. Cook and stir until well-blended
19. Gradually stir in half-and-half and bouillon granules
20. Heat to boiling , stirring constantly
21. Boil and stir 1 minute
22. Remove from heat and stir in parmesan cheese
23. Pour sauce over brussels sprouts in saucepan
24. Mix gently
25. Spoon into 2-quart casserole
26. Bake uncovered 25-30 minutes , sprinkling with crumbled bacon and cheddar cheese for last 10 minutes of baking , until hot and bubbly
27. Serve right away

title: baked pork chops and sauerkraut
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Season chops with salt and pepper-brown in 1 tbs
3. Butter
4. Place in 9x13 baking dish
5. Melt remaining tbs
6. Butter-lightly brown diced apple-sprinkle over chops
7. Cover chops and apple with undrained sauerkraut
8. Separate onion into rings-sprinkle over kraut
9. Sprinkle on caraway seeds
10. Sprinkle on brown sugar
11. Pour onion soup over all
12. Cover with foil-bake for 1 hour

title: ice cream pretzel cake
steps:
1. Place crushed pretzels in a small bowl
2. Cut in butter until crumbly
3. Press onto the bottom of a greased 9-in
4. Springform pan
5. Cover and freeze for at least 30 minutes
6. Spread fudge topping over crust
7. Cover and freeze
8. Set aside 16 chocolate-covered pretzels for garnish
9. Place remaining pretzels in a food processor
10. Cover and process until crumbly
11. Transfer to a large bowl
12. Stir in ice cream
13. Spread over fudge topping
14. Drizzle with caramel topping
15. Garnish with reserved pretzels
16. Cover and freeze for at least 8 hours or overnight

title: kit kat ice cream cake
steps:
1. Have an 8-inch springform pan ready
2. Remove ice cream and gelato from freezer
3. Let stand at room temperature 15 minutes or until soft and spreadable but not melting
4. Meanwhile , with a long sharp knife , cut 9 kitkat bars in 4 sections each
5. Stand around sides of pan , narrower kitkat-inscribed side against pan
6. Coarsely chop remaining 9 kitkat bars
7. Make 3 equal piles
8. Spoon coffee ice cream into springform pan
9. Spread firmly and evenly to cover bottom
10. Sprinkle with 1 pile chopped kitkats
11. Continue layering , adding 1 pint chocolate ice cream , a pile of chopped kitkats , the hazelnut gelato , remaining chopped kitkats , then remaining 1 pint chocolate ice cream
12. (if at any time the bottom layer begin to melt , place cake in freezer until ice cream becomes firm
13. ) cover pan and freeze at least 8 hours until very firm or up to 1 month
14. Just before serving
15. Remove pan sides and garnish as shown
16. To make clean cuts , dip a long , sharp knife in hot water between cuts
17. Fyi kitkats are sold in several sizes
18. For this cake we used 3 1 / 2-in-long kitkat bars , each having 4 sections , often sold in 6-packs of 1 1 / 2 oz each

title: maple carrots with leeks
steps:
1. Trim the dark green leaves from the leeks , and save for another use
2. Split the leeks lengthwise , wash , blot dry and slice thinly
3. Youll have about 1 1 / 2cups
4. Melt the butter in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat
5. Saute the leeks , stirring often , just until softened , about 4 minutes
6. Remove and set aside half the leeks
7. Add carrots , 1 / 2 cup water and the maple syrup to the skillet
8. Simmer , covered just until the carrots are tender , 15 to 17 minutes
9. Add the salt
10. Stir in the reserved leeks and serve

title: grilled pizza
steps:
1. To make the seasoning: in a small ssaucepan combine all the seasoning ingredients
2. Whisk over low heat just until warm and oil becomes fragrant
3. Remove from heat and let rest for 2 hours at room temperature
4. The pizza bread: lightly flour the back of a 15 x 10 inch baking sheet and one of the pizza dough balls
5. Stretch out the dough to the size of the baking sheet
6. Place the stretched dough on the back of the baking sheet
7. Stir the seasoned oil and liberally brush the surface of the dough
8. Turn the baking sheet with the dough directly onto cooking grate
9. Remove the baking sheet and liberally brush the top side of the dough with the seasoned oil
10. Grill over direct medium heat until the underside of the dough is marked , 1 to 3 minutes
11. Don't worry if the crust bubbles , it will deflate when turned over
12. Slide the dough onto the baking sheet and flip the ungrilled side onto the grill
13. Brush the top with more oil and continue to grill for 3 to 4 minutes
14. Remove from grill and cool slightly on a cooling rack
15. Add toppings , return to grill , close lid and grill to desired doneness repeat grilling procedure for 2 remaining balls of dough

title: creamy penne pasta with ham and peas
steps:
1. Bring large pot of water to boil and add pasta , cooking to al dente
2. Add peas last 2-3 minutes to pasta
3. Scoop out 1 cup pasta water , then drain , and place in a large serving dish
4. Whisk flour into milk till mixed well
5. In skillet , pour olive oil in and add ham , cook over medium heat , stirring occasionally until ham is crispy
6. Remove to paper towel to drain
7. In sauce pan , melt butter and saute garlic over medium low for about 2-3 minutes
8. Whisk in milk / flour mixture and add chipped cream cheese , whisking till melted into sauce smoothly
9. Add parmesan cheese and whisk till incorporated
10. In large dish with pasta and peas , toss in crispy ham , and any other vegetables you want
11. Pour sauce over pasta and mix , pouring in pasta water till nice and creamy
12. Top with more parmesan and fresh ground pepper
13. Serve immediately with tossed salad and garlic bread
14. Yum !

title: frugtsalat  danish fruit salad
steps:
1. Mix lemon juice and sugar in a bowl
2. Cut up fruit into small pieces and place in bowl , mixing after each addition to coat fruit in lemon juice / sugar mixture
3. Add granola
4. Stir well and serve immediately

title: scrambled eggs with sliced hot dogs
steps:
1. Use 1 egg per 1 hot dog
2. Beat egg and add 1 tablespoon water
3. Slice hot dog into about 1 / 4 in slices and brown in a little vegetable oil
4. Add beaten egg and stir to scramble together
5. Add salt and pepper
6. Just before egg mixture is completely cooked remove skillet to a hot pad
7. This should keep the egg mixture from getting too dry

title: bread machine indian bread
steps:
1. Set up according to your bread machine directions
2. Makes a one and a half pound loaf

title: cinnamon coffee cake muffins
steps:
1. Combine the brown sugar , pecans and cinnamon
2. Set aside
3. In a large bowl , combine the flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda and salt
4. In another bowl beat the egg , milk and oil
5. Stir into dry ingredients just until moistened
6. Spoon 1 tbs
7. Of batter into paper-lined muffin cups
8. Top each with 1 teaspoon nut mixture and 2 more tablespoons of batter
9. Sprinkle with the remaining nut mixture
10. Bake at 400 degrees for 20-25 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean
11. Cool for 5 minutes before removing from pan to a wire rack
12. Combine glaze ingredients
13. Drizzle over cool muffins

title: fruity roast pork with fruity port sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 190c
2. Trim tenderloin of any fat and silver skin: cut a deep pocket the length of the fillet , being careful not to cut right through
3. Mix together apple , craisins , stuffing mix , zest , black pepper and enough water to make a moist stuffing
4. Fill the pocket in the filet with this stuffing , pressing the edges together as much as you can
5. Trim bacon to fit around the filet
6. Secure with wooden skewers , to hold the bacon in place and help keep the meat together
7. Place on a baking sheet and cook for 30 minutes , or until done to your liking
8. Allow to rest a few minutes before carving and serving with the sauce
9. 30 minutes will result in a nice pink juicy roast
10. Whilst the meat is cooking prepare your sauce
11. Sauce
12. Heat the oil in a fry pan , and cook the onion until golden
13. Add the port and chicken stock and reduce by half
14. Add the lemon juice , cream , cranberry sauce and craisins and reduce again until it reaches a nice sauce consistency
15. Add the black pepper and chopped parsley

title: parmesan tart w  arugula salad   braidwoods restaurant  scotland
steps:
1. Coulis:
2. Char peppers over gas flame or in broiler until blackened on all sides
3. Enclose in paper bag 10 minutes
4. Peel and seed peppers
5. Transfer peppers to blender and puree until very smooth
6. Season to taste with salt
7. Tart:
8. Roll out pastry sheet on floured surface to 1 / 8-inch thick square
9. Trim edges to form 11-inch diameter round
10. Transfer to 9-inch tart pan with removable bottom
11. Fold in overhang to form double-thick sides
12. Pierce pastry with fork
13. Cover and chill 1 hour
14. Preheat oven to 425f line pastry with foil
15. Fill with pie weights or dried beans
16. Bake crust until sides are set , about 20 minutes
17. Remove foil and beans
18. Bake crust until bottom is golden brown , pressing with back of fork if bubbles form , about 8 minutes
19. Transfer tart to rack
20. Reduce oven temperature to 325f
21. Whisk eggs , cream , parmesan cheese , and salt and black pepper in medium bowl to blend
22. Pour egg mixture into hot tart crust
23. Bake tart until custard is set , 30-40 minutes
24. Cool slightly
25. Salad:
26. Toss arugula with oil and lemon juice in large bowl
27. Season with salt and pepper
28. Cut tart into wedges
29. Drizzle with coulis
30. Serve warm with arugula salad

title: puerto rican eggnog  coquito
steps: 1. Mix all ingredients in a blender on low for about 1 minute , chill in the refrigerator serve cold

title: tortilla wraps from scratch
steps:
1. Sift together dry ingredients
2. Add shortening , cutting into tiny pieces with pastry blender or fork
3. Add water gradually , stirring , until dough forms ball
4. Divide into 8 balls
5. On floured surface , roll out as thin as you can
6. Dough may seem slightly elastic , just keep rolling from center outward
7. Heat skillet on medium heat
8. Lightly grease for each tortilla
9. Brown each tortilla briefly on both sides

title: corn and cheddar chowder
steps:
1. Cook bacon in a 3-quart heavy saucepan over moderate heat , stirring , until crisp and transfer with a slotted spoon to paper towels to drain
2. Add onion and butter to fat in pan and cook , stirring , until onion is softened
3. Add cumin and cook , stirring , 1 minute
4. Add flour and cook , stirring , 1 minute
5. Whisk in broth and bring to a boil , whisking occasionally
6. Add potato and simmer , covered , stirring occasionally , until just tender , 8 minutes
7. Stir in cream and corn and return to a simmer
8. Add cheddar , stirring just until cheese is melted , and season generously with salt & pepper
9. Serve topped with bacon
10. Serves 4

title: scallop and asparagus linguine
steps:
1. Heat olive oil over medium heat in large saute pan
2. While heating oil , bring salted water to a boil
3. Boil linguine acording to package directions
4. Add garlic to hot olive oil
5. Cook for 2 - 3 minutes until lightly browned
6. Add scallops to olive oil
7. Lightly salt and pepper to taste
8. Add half of the parsley
9. Cook until opaque
10. Add asparagus pieces and lightly salt and pepper again
11. Cover and cook for about 5 minutes to steam asparagus
12. Remove lid and add butter , lemon juice and remaining parsley
13. Stir until butter has melted
14. Remove linguine from water and add to scallops and asparagus
15. Add 1 / 2 to 1 laddle of pasta water and stir to coat the pasta
16. Once scallops , asparagus and pasta are well mixed , serve hot with salad and garlic bread
17. Enjoy !

title: dilly tuna zucchini patties
steps:
1. Heat the broiler
2. Shred the zucchini and make sure you have 1 / 2 cup
3. In a medium bowl , beat the eggs
4. Add the remaining ingredients , form 3 patties and broil 4" from heat
5. Cook for 3 minutes then turn carefully and broil 3 minutes more

title: cinnamon chicken stew
steps:
1. Season the chicken with the adobo
2. Refrigerate for 30 minutes
3. Heat the oil in a skillet and saute the recaito and ham over medium heat for 5 minutes
4. Add the tomato sauce , tomatoes , and water and bring to a boil
5. Add the chicken , cinnamon , salt , and pepper , and bring to a boil again
6. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes

title: cake mix sugar cookies
steps:
1. In a large bowl mix cake mix , butter , egg and milk
2. Do not over mix
3. Shape dough in a ball
4. Chill for 2 hours
5. Roll 1 / 8 inch on a floured surface
6. Cut out with a floured cookie cutters
7. Place 2 inchs apart on a cookie sheet that has been very lightly sprayed with cooking spray
8. Bake at 375 degrees for 6-10 minutes or until edges are lightly browned
9. Cool slightly
10. Move to rack to cool fully
11. Store in airtight container

title: glazed oatmeal craisin cookies
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 325f
2. Combine the flour and the next 6 ingredients in a bowl
3. Combine the brown sugar , granulated sugar , and butter in a large bowl , and
4. Beat with a mixer at medium speed until well blended
5. Add the vanilla and eggs and beat well
6. Gradually add the flour mixture and cranberries
7. Beat at low speed until combined
8. Shape the dough into 1-inch balls
9. Place balls 2 inches apart on baking sheets coated with cooking spray
10. Bake at 325f for 15 minutes or until almost firm
11. Cool completely on a wire rack
12. Glaze: combine the powdered sugar , lemon juice , and orange rind in a bowl , stirring with a whisk
13. Spoon the mixture into a small zip-top plastic bag
14. Snip a small hole in one corner of the bag and drizzle glaze over the cooled cookies

title: mexican date bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a large bowl , beat egg until fluffy
3. Add butter , honey , dates , and vanilla
4. Stir well with a spoon to coat dates
5. Stir in walnuts and almonds
6. Stir in the coconut , cocoa , and cinnamon
7. Stir in the krispie cereal , salt , lemon juice , then flour and mix well
8. Press the mix into a lightly greased 9 x 9 glass dish and bake for 30 minutes
9. Cool completely before cutting so the bars can set
10. Chill for even more chewiness !

title: rhett butler  cocktail beverage
steps:
1. Pour curacao , southern comfort & both juices into a shaker of ice
2. Shake & pour into an 8 oz highball glass
3. Top w / soda water & garnish w / orange slice & mint leaves as desired

title: pecan and rice patties
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and shape into 3-inch patties
2. Place on sprayed cookie sheet
3. Bake in a 350-degree pre-heated oven for about 40- 45 minutes , or until golden brown

title: multi grain dinner rolls   bread machine
steps:
1. Heat milk to 110 degrees
2. Beat egg
3. Put in bread machine in the order as listed above
4. Use dough setting
5. When ready pinch off enough dough to make 16 rolls
6. Can make larger for buns
7. Place on a greased cookie sheet
8. Let raise for 30 minutes
9. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes

title: fruit custard brulee  ultra light
steps:
1. For the custard: in a small saucepan thoroughly combine 2 tbsp of the sugar with the cornstarch
2. Add the milk and egg
3. Cook and stir with a wooden spoon over medium heat just until the mixture begins to bubble
4. Do not overcook
5. Immediately pour the custard into a small bowl
6. Let mixture cool about 5 minutes
7. Whisk the sour cream into the custard
8. Add the vanilla
9. Cover and chill the custard for up to 24 hours
10. To serve: divide berries evenly among four goblets or dessert dishes
11. Spoon chilled custard over the berries
12. Set aside and prepare topping
13. Optional topping : in a heavy small skillet or saucepan heat the remaining 2 tbsp sugar over medium high heat until sugar begins to melt , shaking the skillet occasionally to heat evenly
14. Reduce heat to low
15. Cook sugar until melted and golden , stirring as necessary with a wooden spoon
16. Quickly drizzle caramelized sugar over custard and serve immediately

title: mushrooms and artichoke hearts vinaigrette
steps:
1. Drain artichokes , reserving the marinade from jars
2. Place the artichokes in a medium bowl
3. Add water chestnuts , mushrooms , and scallions
4. Add olive oil , vinegar , salt , and hot sauce to reserved artichoke marinade
5. Whisk well to blend
6. Pour over vegetables and toss
7. Serve immediately or cover and marinate in refrigerator for up to 3 days
8. Enjoy !

title: chicken and andouille sausage with peppers  ww 5 points
steps:
1. Cut chicken into 1 inch or slightly smaller cubes
