2. Season with garlic powder and cajun spice mix
3. Place nonstick over medium high heat
4. Give a quick shot of cooking spray and add the seasoned chicken
5. Cook for a minute and add the andouille sausage
6. Continue to cook for three to four minutes until the chicken is opaque
7. Remove chicken and sausage from pan and cover to keep warm
8. Gently wipe the pan to remove the excess oil
9. Add the onions and peppers to the pan and cook for four to five minutes
10. Stir the canned tomatoes and tomato paste into the skillet
11. Return the chicken and sausage and simmer for six to eight minutes
12. Serve with hot cooked rice for additional points

title: yummy no bake chocolate peanut butter and oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Mix sugar , milk , butter , and cocoa in med sauce pan
2. Bring to a boil and let boil for 1 and 1 / 2 minutes
3. Remove from heat
4. Add peanut butter , oats , vanilla and stir
5. Spoon onto wax paper
6. Let stand until cookies are cool and harden

title: all aboard  snickerdoodle train
steps:
1. Also need:
2. 1 large cake , board or 1 piece , sturdy cardboard
3. Hot glue , gun for gluing train tracks
4. Heat oven to 325 degrees
5. Grease train pan and dust with flour
6. Set aside
7. In a large bowl , combine flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda , salt and cinnamon
8. Set aside
9. In medium bowl , combine melted butter , sour cream , eggs , vanilla and almond extract
10. Mix until well blended
11. Add sour cream mixture to flour mixture and blend on low speed , scraping bowl often
12. Beat on medium speed 1 minute
13. Carefully spoon batter into pan , dividing evenly among cups
14. Top pan firmly on countertop to remove any air bubbles
15. Spread batter out to top edges of each cup , so batter is lower in the center
16. Bake at 325 degrees for 20-27 minutes , until toothpick inserted come out clean
17. Cool 10 minutes in pan
18. Invert cakes onto cooling rack and cool completely
19. In large bowl , combine vegetable shortening , butter and vanilla
20. Gradually add powdered sugar , 1 cup at a time , scraping bowl often
21. Add milk , beating on medium speed , until light and fluffy
22. Remove 2 1 / 2 cups frosting and color as desired to decorate train cars
23. Decorate with assorted candies
24. To make train tracks: cut black licorice twists in half lengthwise
25. Using glue gun , pipe glue along cut side of licorice
26. Glue licorice to cardboard
27. Cotinue with licorice , shaping track as desired
28. Color remaining frosting green and spread onto cardboard around train track
29. Sprinkle with green sugar
30. Place decorated tan onto tracks
31. Makes 9 cake train cars

title: cheese toast ii
steps:
1. Mix first 5 ingredients
2. In large skillet melt butter over low heat
3. Add garlic to butter
4. Put 1 / 4 loaf of bread face down in butter
5. Be sure entire face of bread is coated
6. Brush the back of the bread with butter from the pan
7. Put the bread on a cookie sheet and spread cheese mixture over the face of the bread
8. Heat for 8-10 minutes in 450 degree oven until edges begin to turn brown
9. Broil quickly for 1-2 minutes if you like it crispier

title: blue cheese   rosemary scalloped potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Butter 9x13 baking dish
3. Toss sliced potatoes with 2 tsp salt , pepper and rosemary
4. Toss cheeses together
5. Layer half the potatoes in the dish and sprinkle with half the cheese then top with remaining potatoes
6. Whisk together sour cream , cream and 1 tsp salt
7. Pour cream mixture over potatoes
8. Tap dish on counter to settle ingredients and pop any air bubbles
9. Top with remaining cheese
10. Bake for one hour and fifteen minutes or until browned and tender
11. Do not refrigerate overnight
12. Trust me

title: sweetie ziti
steps:
1. Bring water to a boil with 1 tsp of the olive oil
2. Add pasta
3. Cook 7 minutes , then add broccoli florets and cook another 8-10 minutes
4. Drain and toss with other tsp olive oil in same pot
5. In a small saucepan , melt butter at low-medium heat
6. Add flour and 1 / 2 of the milk , stirring constantly
7. Add slices of cheese , one at a time , stirring after each addition
8. Add remaining milk and seasonings
9. Stir and keep cooking for another 3-5 minutes
10. Add reserved water by teaspoons to reach desired consistency
11. Pour over pasta broccoli mix , stir to coat , and serve

title: tasty mac and cheese  slow cooker
steps:
1. Mince or puree large onion
2. Boil noodles in water or in chicken broth
3. Add a dash of salt and the minced or pureed onion
4. Slightly beat together egg , milk , salt , and pepper
5. Set aside
6. Melt butter and then stir so all the solid is mixed well
7. Mix the butter and evaporated milk into the bowl with the egg and milk mixture
8. Pour drained noodles into the slow cooker or crock pot
9. Spread evenly
10. Lightly mix in the cubed velvetta cheese and vermont sharp cheddar , leaving some on the top
11. Pour the milk mixture over the noodles and cheese
12. Do not stir
13. Spread bacon bits over the top of noodles
14. Do not stir
15. Spread the 2 cups of shredded cheese over the top of the mac and cheese
16. Do not stir
17. Cook on high for 90 minutes and then stir together to blend the melted cheese
18. Then another 90 minutes on high or 3 hrs on low
19. Do not remove lid until the first 90 minutes has passed so that the mixture sets correctly
20. Stir well before serving

title: easiest ever  hollandaise sauce
steps:
1. Cut the butter into several pieces and bring to room temperature
2. In the top of a double boiler , combine egg yolks , lemon juice , salt and pepper
3. Add a piece of butter
4. Cook , stirring steadily with a wooden spoon or wire whisk , over , but not touching , boiling water
5. When butter melts and sauce begins to thicken , add remaining butter , stirring constantly until melted
6. Continue cooking as sauce thickens , about 2 more minutes
7. Immediately remove from heat

title: hot broccoli dip pampered chef
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Chop broccoli , onion and red pepper
3. Place in bowl
4. Finely grate parmesan cheese
5. Measure 4 tablespoons grated parmesan and add to vegetable mixture
6. Place garlic into bowl
7. Add remaining ingredients
8. Mix well
9. Spoon mixture into casserole dish
10. Bake about 25 minutes or until heated through
11. Sprinkle remaining parmesan cheese over top and surround with pita crisps for serving , if desired

title: lemonade cake  3
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease and flour a bundt pan
3. Dissolve jello in hot water and set aside to cool
4. Do not jell
5. In a large bowl , mix cake mix , eggs and applesauce
6. Add cooled jello
7. Beat until well mixed
8. Turn into bundt pan
9. Bake 40-45 minutes or until toothpick inserted comes out clean
10. Meanwhile: mix lemonade concentrate and sugar and let set , optional
11. While cake is still warm , loosen it from edges of pan
12. When completely cooled , turn out onto serving plate
13. You can top with the lemonade concentrate glaze or cool whip or just dust with the powdered sugar

title: authentic polish paczki
steps:
1. Beat egg yolks with the salt in the small bowl of an electric mixer at high speed until the mixture is thick and piles softly , about 7 minutes
2. Soften yeast in warm water
3. Cream butter , add sugar to it gradually , beating until fluffy
4. Slowly beat in the softened yeast
5. Stir one fourth of the flour into the yeast mix
6. Add rum / brandy and half of the cream
7. Beat in another fourth of the flour
8. Stir in remaining cream
9. Beat in half of the remaining flour and then the egg yolk mixture
10. Beat for 2 minutes
11. Gradually beat in the remaining flour until the dough blisters
12. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap
13. Set in a warm place to rise
14. When it has doubled in bulk , punch it down
15. Cover and let rise again until doubled
16. Punch it down again
17. Roll dough on a floured surface to about 3 / 4 inch thickness
18. Cut out 3 inch rounds using a cookie cutter or glass
19. Put 1 tablespoon of filling in the center of half the circles
20. Brush the edges with water
21. Top with the remaining rounds
22. Seal the edges very well
23. Cover the paczki on a floured surface
24. Let rise about 20 minutes
25. Deep fry in the hot fat until they are golden brown on both sides
26. Sprinkle with powdered sugar or drizzle with honey

title: authentic tacos
steps:
1. Brown ground beef with garlic salt and drain
2. Heat a griddle or large skillet on high
3. Lightly coat tortillas with extra virgin olive oil
4. Lightly fry tortillas so that they are still flexible , but slightly browned
5. Drain tortillas on paper towels
6. Put one spoonful of ground beef on each tortilla , top with serranos , onion , tomato , cilantro , avocado , lime juice and salt
7. Enjoy !

title: persimmon walnut coffee cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease and flour a 9" springform pan
3. Mix brown sugar and 1 tbs flour in a small bowl
4. Press persimmons into a pulp into the bowl and mix
5. In a medium bowl mix together 2 cups flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt
6. In a large bowl beat butter with an electric beater in medium-high for 20 seconds
7. Mix in sugar and vanilla
8. Add eggs , one at a time , beating after each
9. Add flour mixture and sour cream to the butter mixture , alternately , beating until just combined after each addition
10. Spread half of batter into pan , building up a 1" rim of batter around the edges
11. Pour persimmon mixture into this crust
12. Carefully spoon remaining batter in small mounds to cover persimmon mixture
13. For walnut streusel: in a medium bowl stir together flour , sugar and cinnamon
14. Cut in butter until mixture resembles course crumbs
15. Stir in walnuts
16. Sprinkle this over your batter
17. Bake about 1 hour or until toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean
18. The filling will sink as the cake bakes
19. Cool in pan on a rack for 10 minutes
20. Remove springform sides
21. Let cool completely on rack

title: south beach scrambled eggs
steps:
1. Whisk eggs , ricotta , and water in a bowl
2. Dice up peppers and canadian bacon , keep separate
3. Spray nonstick skillet with canola cooking spray and add peppers , sprinkle with some salt to soften
4. After a minute add canadian bacon and eggs
5. Stir continually until cooked through
6. Add salt and pepper
7. Serve with hot sauce if you like

title: my green salad
steps:
1. Tear romaine , slice cucumber , cube avocado
2. Combine
3. Add dressing
4. Eat

title: apple and chicken hash
steps:
1. Heat 1 1 / 2 teaspoon oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add in onion and apple
3. Stir / saute 7 minutes or until mixture begins to brown
4. Spoon mixture into a large bowl
5. Add potato and remaining 5 ingredients to the bowl
6. Toss well to mix
7. Heat 1 1 / 2 teaspoons oil in skillet over medium heat
8. Add apple mixture and pat into an even layer in skillet
9. Cook , without stirring , 2 minutes
10. Stir gently , cook 2 minutes or until potatoes begin to brown
11. Serve right away

title: roquefort sauce
steps:
1. You will need just a knob of butter
2. The cream must be double cream or it will split when being cooked
3. In a small saucepan melt the butter over a low heat and add the onion
4. Saute until soft but not coloured
5. Turn the heat up and add the brandy , stirring for a minute
6. Turn the heat back down and add the roquefort and stir with a wooden spoon when it starts to melt add the cream
7. Don't let it boil or it will go too runny and may curdle
8. Stir until heated through and serve immediately

title: red beans and rice  vegetarian
steps:
1. Cook the brown rice
2. Add the 1 / 2 can of light red beans to the cooked rice and set to one side
3. Melt the butter and add all the remaining ingredients
4. Simmer the bean mixture for 45 minutes
5. Stir every 10 mins or so and mash the light red beans with the back of a wooden spoon
6. After 45 mins remove from the heat and add the cooled cooked rice and the additional 1 / 2 can of beans mixture
7. Stir it all together until the rice is warmed through again and serve
8. Reheats really well if you would like to make this ahead of time
9. Serves 2 as a main course or 4 as a side

title: easy and delicious jambalaya
steps:
1. Cut chicken and sausage into 1 inch
2. Bite sizes
3. Place onion and meats in a large pot , brown
4. Add canned tomatoes , zattarain's and chicken broth in place of the water called for in the jambalaya mix
5. Bring to a boil
6. Cover and simmer for about 30 minutes , longer if you like to let flavors mesh
7. Add hot sauce if you desire , although this stuff is already spicy !

title: peanut butter brownies using a cake mix
steps:
1. Mix the first three ingredients together
2. Reserve one cup
3. Press into a 13x9 sheet pan
4. Bake for 10 minutes on 350+ --
5. After the ten minutes remove from oven
6. Mix the peanut butter , condensed milk and vanilla in a bowl
7. Pour over the partially baked dough , top with rest of dough in little pieces on top , bake for another 25 minutes until set --

title: fajita steak marinade
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients
2. In a casserole dish , roll steak in marinade until it is completely coated and marinate , covering the dish with cling wrap , overnight , turning the steaks at least once during the marinating process
3. Be sure to grill your steaks over high , direct heat , either on a gas grill or charcoal grill
4. It will probably only take about 4-5 minutes per side

title: banana everything cookies from vegan cookies take over the world
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees , lightly grease 2 baking sheets
2. In a mixing bowl mash the banana well
3. You can use a fork for this but your hands work well too
4. Add the oil sugar and vanilla , mix with a strong fork
5. Add the flour , baking soda and cinnmon and mix until the dry ingredients are just moistened
6. Add the oatmeal walnuts and chocolate chips and mix well
7. Isa recommends using your hands for mixing in the oatmeal to ensure that the oats get moist
8. If the dough is quite slippery you may wish to add a few tablespoons of extra flour
9. This just depends on how big your banana is
10. Clean your hands and roll the dough into balls slightly smaller than a golf ball , flatten it a bit in your hands and place each ball about 2 inches apart on the cookie sheet
11. Bake for 10-12 minutes until lightly browned
12. Let the cookies cool on the cookie sheet for 2 mins then transfer them to a cooling rack

title: frosted cookie brownies
steps:
1. Press cookie dough into a greased 13-in
2. X 9-in
3. Baking pan
4. Bake at 350 for 10 minutes
5. Meanwhile , in a large saucepan , combine the marshmallows , chips and butter
6. Cook and stir over low heat until melted and smooth
7. Transfer to a large bowl
8. Cool
9. Beat in eggs and vanilla
10. Combine the flour , baking powder and salt
11. Gradually stir into marshmallow mixture
12. Stir in nuts
13. Spread over cookie crust
14. Bake for 30-35 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
15. Cool on a wire rack
16. For frosting:
17. In a small saucepan , combine the marshmallows , milk , butter and chocolate
18. Cook and stir over low heat until smooth
19. Remove from the heat
20. Beat in confectioners' sugar until smooth
21. Frost brownies
22. Cut into bars

title: peach glazed spareribs
steps:
1. Position knife blade in food processor bowl
2. Top with cover
3. Drop garlic through food chute with processor running
4. Process about 3 seconds or until garlic is finely chopped
5. Add peaches , and process until smooth
6. Add soy sauce , oil , honey , brown sugar , sesame seeds , and ginger
7. Process 30 seconds
8. Set mixture aside
9. Cut ribs into serving-size pieces
10. Place in a large dutch oven
11. Cover ribs with water
12. Bring water to a boil
13. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 30 minutes
14. Drain well
15. Grill ribs , 5 inches from heat , over slow coals , 45 minutes or until desired degree of doneness , turning frequently
16. Brush ribs with sauce druing last 15 minutes of grilling
17. Serve with remaining sauce

title: baked corn casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Coat a 2-quart casserole dish with non-stick cooking spray
3. In a large bowl , combine all the ingredients
4. Mix well
5. Pour into the casserole dish
6. Cover and bake for 30 minutes
7. Uncover and bake for 30 to 35 minutes more , or until set and the top is golden
8. Also can be an oamc recipe
9. Just mix the batter , put in a freezer bag and freeze
10. Thaw , then cook per the listed directions

title: bacon and green onions rice
steps:
1. Slice bacon into small bite-size pieces
2. Fry them until crisp in a deep pan
3. Set bacon aside
4. Dispose of bacon fat but keep the residue on the pan
5. Chop green onions thinly
6. Add white rice to same pan over medium heat and keep stirring until golden
7. Do not cover rice while cooking
8. Once rice is golden , add the chopped green onions and stir together for a couple of minutes
9. Add bacon and stir for another 2 minutes
10. Add water and soy sauce
11. Stir and bring to a boil
12. Reduce the heat and allow to simmer for 20 minutes or until water is gone
13. Stick a fork all the way down and part it to see if theres any water left
14. If no water is left , taste to see if rice tastes done
15. Serve as side and enjoy it !

title: cheesy bacony chicken fajitas
steps:
1. Place pan over medium heat
2. Drizzle extra virgin olive oil into pan
3. Place both garlic cloves into pan
4. Let them soak in evoo until browned
5. While letting garlic cloves soak , cut bacon into small strips or into bacon bits
6. Slice onion into strips
7. Dice tomato
8. Once garlic cloves are browned , remove them from pan and discard
9. Place cut bacon strips or bacon bits into pan and start to cook them
10. Once bacon has begun to cook , add onion
11. Cook a bit longer then add the chicken
12. Begin to season to taste by adding salt , pepper , and garlic salt
13. On separate pan or grill , begin to heat tortillas
14. When each one is done , place them on a plate and fold them in a towel to keep them warm
15. Do this while cooking fajitas
16. Once bacon and chicken look like they are almost done and onions look golden , throw in tomato
17. Saute and stir all ingredients and squeeze half the lime into mix
18. Add more seasoning if needed
19. Once food looks ready , sprinkle the mozzarella cheese over fajitas
20. Cook another minute then turn off heat
21. Serve fajitas on plate
22. Also serve warm flour tortillas
23. If you'd like , serve the fajitas with salsa , sour cream , and / or guacamole on the side
24. Serve with lime wedges and enjoy !

title: whole wheat dinner rolls
steps:
1. Place all ingredients into the pan of your bread machine
2. Program the machine for manual or dough
3. Adjust the dough consistency as necessary with additional flour or water
4. The finished dough should be soft and supple
5. Allow the machine to complete its cycle
6. Transfer the dough to a lightly floured surface and divide it into 12 pieces
7. Shape each piece into a ball
8. Place 1 inches apart on greased baking sheets
9. Cover
10. Let rise until doubled , about 1 hour
11. Bake rolls in a preheated 375f for 15 to 20 min , or until golden brown
12. Remove from pans to wire racks
13. Brush with melted butter
14. Serve warm

title: chocolate ribbon cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Butter and lightly flour a 9x5" loaf pan
3. Grate or chop chocolate until you have slivers and small pieces
4. Set aside
5. In large bowl with mixer at medium speed , beat butter and sugar until light and fluffy
6. Reduce speed to low
7. Add flour , baking powder , baking soda , vanilla , sour cream and eggs
8. Beat well , scraping down bowl as necessary
9. Spread half of batter evenly into pan , sprinkle with half grated chocolate and 1 / 4 t
10. Cinnamon
11. Cover with remaining batter , chocolate and cinnamon
12. Draw knife through batter a few times to swirl chocolate
13. Bake 1 hour until toothpick comes out clean
14. Cool in pan on wire rack 10 minutes

title: fresh mozzarella salad w  avocado  roasted corn   tomato
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 f
2. Soak the corn in the sink or a bowl filled with cold water for 10 to 15 minutes
3. Place on a baking sheet with sides and roast for 20 to 25 minutes , until the kernels are tender
4. Cool to room temperature , then pull off and discard the husks and silks
5. Cut the kernels off the cob into a large bowl
6. Add the mozzarella , avocados , tomatoes , basil , salt and pepper to the bowl with the corn
7. Drizzle 1&#8260
8. 2 cup of the vinaigrette over the salad and toss gently
9. Be careful not to over-mix or mash the avocado
10. Season with more salt , pepper or vinaigrette to taste
11. Serve on a bed of the arugula or baby greens
12. Summer herb vinaigrette:
13. Combine the vinegar , mustard , lemon zest and juice , basil , oregano , and parsley in a small bowl , and stir to mix
14. Whisk in the olive oil in a slow , steady stream until all of the oil is incorporated
15. Season with salt and pepper
16. Use immediately or store refrigerated in an airtight container for up to three days

title: fudge filled chocolate chip thumbprints
steps:
1. Cream butter , salt & vanilla till fluffy
2. Beat in sugar
3. Blend in flour , milk , and mini chocolate chips
4. Shape into 1" balls
5. Place on ungreased baking sheet
6. With finger or thumb , poke depression in each
7. Bake in 375 degree f
8. Oven for 10-12 minutes
9. Roll while warm in confectioners sugar
10. Set aside while you make filling:
11. Melt chocolate chips with shortening
12. Stir
13. Cool a little
14. Blend in corn syrup , water and vanilla
15. Fill cooled cookies

title: spicy pan fried fish bombay
steps:
1. In a glass or ceramic baking dish , lay fish fillets next to each other in one layer
2. Stir together the yogurt , tomato paste , wine , garlic , gingerroot , coriander , cinnamon , cumin , curry powder , tumeric , and red pepper flakes
3. Pour the marinade over the fish , covering the tops and bottoms thoroughly
4. Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes and up to 2 hours , turning fish occasionally on a flat plate , mix together almonds , crumbs , paprika , and salt
5. Remove fish from marinade , retaining as much marinade on each fillet as possible
6. Pat crumbs on both sides of each catfish fillet
7. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat
8. When oil is very hot , add fish fillets without crowding
9. Cook fish 5-7 minutes , turn carefully , and cook another 5 minutes or until fish is done , just flaking
10. Cooking time will vary depending on the type of fish used , and the thickness of the fillet
11. Serve immediately

title: farm cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. In small bowl , mix together flour , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
3. Mixing well after each addition
4. Set aside
5. In large bowl , mix butter , both sugars , eggs , and vanilla
6. Mixing well after each addition
7. Add flour mixture and mix until blended
8. Add oatmeal , cornflakes , coconut , and nuts
9. Dough will be stiff
10. Roll dough into 1 inch balls and place onto ungreased cookie sheet
11. Slightly flatten balls of dough with bottom of glass
12. Bake for 8-10 minutes or until done

title: bacon lattice tomato muffins  rsc
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f line a rimmed baking sheet with reynolds wrap foil
2. Spray lightly with non-stick spray or use non-stick reynolds wrap foil
3. Cut bacon into 3" pieces
4. Make 8 bacon lattices about 3
5. 5" square
6. Arrange lattices on foil so they don't touch
7. Bake 8 - 10 minutes until browned
8. Remove to paper towel to blot grease
9. Reduce oven temp to 350f
10. Press biscuits into a muffin pan to form 8 cups or use 3
11. 5" oven proof ramekins
12. In a medium bowl , mix mayonnaise , cream cheese , rosemary , salt , and pepper
13. Mix in tomatoes and onions
14. Spoon mixture evenly into the 8 biscuit cups
15. Top with cheese
16. Wrap each loosely with classic reynolds wrap foil without touching the cheese
17. Bake 30 minutes
18. Remove foil and center a bacon lattice on top of each
19. Bake another 3-5 minutes until bacon sizzles
20. Remove from oven and allow to set 5 minutes

title: easy sticky rice  in a pasta pot
steps:
1. Rinse the amount of rice you're using three times , then fill a bowl with cool water and let the rice soak overnight
2. It takes 5-6 hours for the rice to fully expand and soften
3. When the water is cool , the rice will be soft
4. The water will turn murky and the rice grains slightly slimy , rinse once more in cool water
5. It might not be as soft and sticky as rice that has been soaked overnight , but it will do the job
6. Test to see if the rice is ready by pressing a grain lightly with your fingernails
7. If it breaks easily , it's ready
8. Line the steamer basket insert of a pasta pot with fresh corn husks or soaked dried corn husks
9. Spray the husks with oil to prevent the rice from sticking , then spread the soaked rice evenly over the husks
10. Fill the pot with water to just under the steamer basket insert
11. Put the steamer insert into the pot , cover and bring to a boil over medium high heat
12. Steam the rice for at least 20 minutes , or longer
13. Transfer the rice to a serving bowl when ready to serve
14. Cover the rice with some corn husks to keep it moist and warm

title: chicken in casserole
steps:
1. Place raw chicken pieces in casserole
2. Mix together the soups and vermouth
3. Pour over raw chicken
4. Place artichoke quarters around in the sauce
5. Cook at 350f for 1 hour
6. Then put the whole mushrooms around in the sauce and return to the oven for 10 minutes

title: italian chocolate truffles
steps:
1. Melt chocolate with the liqueur in a double boiler
2. Stir until well blended
3. Add the butter stir until melted
4. Stir in the almonds and sugar
5. Leave mixture in a cool place until firm enough to roll into balls
6. Put the grated chocolate on a plate and roll the balls in the chocolate to coat them
7. Put the truffles in paper candy cups and chill
8. Will keep for 2 weeks in a cool place

title: mom s banana bread recipe
steps:
1. In a liquid mixing cup , pour 1 tsp of vinegar and enough milk to make 1 / 2 cup
2. Mix together dry ingredients: flour , salt and baking soda in a separate bowl
3. In your blender , mix together vanilla and 3 bananas until they are soup like in texture
4. Cream together shortening and sugar in your mixing bowl
5. Add 2 eggs to creamed shortening and sugar mixture
6. Mix well
7. Slowly add dry ingredients and sour milk mixture
8. Be sure to alternate between the two
9. Slowly add in the souplike banana mixture and pecans
10. Spray bundt pan with cooking spray and flour
11. Bake at 350 for 1 hour
12. Check for doneness by inserting a toothpick
13. If it comes out clean , it's finished
14. If not , put back into the oven for 5 minutes and keep going that way until your toothpick comes out clean
15. Invert cake and allow to cool for 10-20 minutes

title: chocolate chip blonde brownies
steps:
1. Melt butter
2. Gently stir in the remaining ingredients , except chocolate chips , just until mixed
3. Do not beat !
4. Pat into greased 13x9 inch pan
5. Sprinkle with chocolate chips
6. Bake at 350f for about 20 minutes
7. Cool
8. Cut into bars

title: garlic piperade soup
steps:
1. Blanch the garlic in boiling water for thirty seconds
2. Run under cold water and drain
3. Peel and slice the cloves of garlic
4. Cook the onions and peppers in the oil for ten minutes until the onions are golden and the peppers are soft
5. Add the garlic and tomatoes
6. Cover the pan and cook over low heat for thirty minutes
7. Pour in the broth and bring to a boil
8. Tear the bread into large pieces and add to the boiling soup where it will disintegrate and thicken the broth
9. Adjust the amount of bread and broth to the desired thickness of the soup and salt and pepper to taste
10. Serve hot with grated cheese if you wish

title: frenchy popcorn
steps:
1. Melt the butter with the garlic
2. Remove from the heat and allow to infuse
3. Heat the oil in a large pot and add the popcorn , tossing to coat
4. Cover and shake the pot over high heat until all the kernels have popped
5. Remove the garlic from the butter and pour the butter over the popcorn
6. Toss
7. Sprinkle with the herbes de provence , celery salt and salt , and toss again
8. Voila

title: beef burrito dip
steps:
1. Brown and drain the hamburger
2. Add the onion and garlic and the rest of the sauce ingredients
3. Simmer for at least 1 / 2 hour
4. In a 13x9 pan , spread the refried beans
5. Pour the meat mixture over the beans
6. Layer:
7. Olives , ortega peppers , cheese , salsa
8. Bake for 30 minutes at 350

title: betty white s chicken wings
steps:
1. Arrange wings in shallow baking pan
2. Heat butter , soy sauce , sugar , water mustard and garlic powder if using , until butter and sugar melt
3. Cool
4. Pour over wings and marinate at least 2 hours , turning once or twice
5. Bake in same pan at 375f for 1-1 / 4 to 1-1 / 2 hours , turning occasionally
6. Drain on paper towels and serve

title: chex mix  booka booka
steps:
1. Heat oven to 250 degrees
2. In small saucepan , heat butter , seasoned salt , garlic powder on low heat
3. In large deep dish pizza pan or 11x14 pan mix together cerals and pretzels
4. Pour butter mixture over the chex mix and mix together
5. Place pan in oven and cook about 1 / 2 hour or until the butter has baked into the pretzels
6. Chex will be crispy when done

title: cashew and papaya crusted snapper
steps:
1. In a shallow dish , combine all the marinade ingredients
2. Add the fish fillets , turning to coat them
3. Cover and refrigerate , turning once , for 30 minutes
4. Meanwhile , in a food processor , process the bread cubes on high speed for one minute , until they're crumbly but not totally fine
5. Add the papaya , curry powder , salt and garlic
6. Pulse on low speed 15-20 times , until the papaya has been thoroughly incorporated into the bread
7. You should have coral-colored bread with tiny bits of fruit throughout
8. Coarsely chop one ounce of the cashews , then stir the coarsely chopped nuts and herbs into the bread coating
9. Preheat the oven to broil
10. Coat a baking sheet with non-stick cooking spray
11. Remove the fillets from the marinade and place them on the baking sheet
12. Discard the marinade
13. Using a spoon or knife , cover the top and sides of the fillets with the coating
14. Finely chop the remaining 1 / 2 ounce of cashews and sprinkle them over the top of the coated fish
15. Broil for five minutes , until the bread and cashews start to brown and get a crusty look
16. Reduce the heat to 500 degrees and bake an additional 3-5 minutes , until the fish flakes easily with a fork
17. Use a spatula to remove the fish from the baking sheet

title: one pan tomato basil chicken
steps:
1. In a large skillet , saute rice in margarine until golden brown over medium heat
2. Stir in water and special seasonings
3. Bring to a boil over high heat
4. Cover and reduce heat to low
5. Simmer 10 minutes
6. Stir in broccoli , chicken , tomato and basil
7. Cover , simmer 5-10 minutes more or until most of the liquid is absorbed
8. Sprinkle with cheese if desired

title: baked butternut squash and cranberries
steps:
1. In a bowl , toss squash and onions with 1 tablespoon of olive oil and seasonings
2. Combine with cranberries
3. Spread in a baking dish
4. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
5. Place in oven for 1 hour
6. Pour cranberry juice over squash and put back in oven for 15-20 minutes
7. Serve warm or cold

title: simple pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook pasta until al dente
2. Drain
3. Rinse under cold water until completely cool
4. Drain
5. Combine mayonnaise , pickle juice , garlic and mustard powder and whisk to blend well
6. Put all salad ingredients into a big bowl , pour dressing over and combine well
7. Season to taste
8. Chill several hours before serving

title: aww  marinated olives
steps:
1. Toast the fennel seeds and lightly crush them
2. Place all the ingredients in a bowl , stir well
3. Cover and leave to marinate
4. Keep refrigerated and use within 1 to 2 days

title: grapefruit bread
steps:
1. Beat butter and sugar until fluffy
2. Beat in eggs
3. Sift flour with salt , soda and baking powder
4. Add the batter alternately with milk
5. Add the grated rind and 4 tablespoons of the juice
6. Pour into a greased loaf pan and bake for 45 minutes or until loaf tests clean
7. For the glaze , combine the remaining 2 tablespoons grapefruit juice with powdered sugar
8. Remove bread from pan and poke holes in it
9. Pour the glaze over it
10. Let set , then wrap in foil or plastic wrap and let stand for a day for flavors to mellow

title: easiest greek salad dressing
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a small container and shake vigorously
2. Chill in refrigerator at least 1 hour prior to serving let dressing return to room temperature before serving
3. For the actual salad i use baby salad greens , kalamata olives , tomatoes , thinly sliced red onions , and goat cheese
4. Prepare the salad / salad bowls with all of the greens , tomatoes , etc
5. But wait to add the dressing until just before serving

title: parmesan and sesame crimple crackers
steps:
1. Heat oven to 160c , with the rack just below the middle
2. Measure the first five ingredients into a food processor or large bowl
3. Pour 1 / 2 cup warms water into a one cup measure , stir in the salt and sugar until dissolved , then add the oil
4. Process the dry ingredients in bursts , while you add the hot liquid mixture in a steady stream
5. Add as much of the remaining hot water as you need to form a ball of soft dough
6. Cut the dough into four parts and put three aside in a plastic bag
7. Roll out the other piece very thinly on a floured board , using extra flour to stop it sticking , making an oval shape bigger than an a4 size page
8. Cut in half , then cut each half into 10-12 tall , thin triangles , with alternate narrow bases and points on the cut edge
9. Perfect shapes aren't necessary and outside edges need not be trimmed
10. Prick crackers with a fork or skewer , place on a metal cake rack to bake , crumpling but not folding them
11. Bake them on the rack for 10-15 minutes , until pale gold but dry and very crisp
12. Lower heat and cook longer if necessary
13. Repeat with remaining pieces of dough
14. When cold , store in airtight containers , reheating if crackers soften or storage
15. Flavour develops fully after about 12 hours

title: pineapple party margaritas
steps:
1. Start a week before the party
2. First , make the pineapple tequila
3. In an appropriately large container , combine ingredients for pineapple tequila
4. Leave for at least a week , stirring occasionally
5. Strain the alcohol from the container
6. Separate the pineapple from the vanilla beans and put the pineapple in the freezer , in freezer bags , in 1 cup sized portions
7. At party time , make the margaritas
8. Using your blender , whir the margarita ingredients , including 1 cup of the pineapple chuncks and 1 cup of the tequila until smooth and frozen , adding ice as is necessary for your preferred strength and texture
9. Serve in glasses , rims encrusted with either sugar or salt , with plenty of chips and salsa nearby
10. Enjoy !
11. I originally found this recipe posted at gail's recipe swap , from richard in cincy

title: fresh berry and lemon parfait
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , add lemon pudding mix to 1-1 / 2 cups milk and beat with wire whisk until pudding is dissolved
2. Then fold cool whip cream into prepared lemon pudding
3. In 4 to 6 individual serving glasses , spoon a layer of the pudding mixture
4. Sprinkle lightly with cookie crumbs and a layer of raspberries , or strawberries and blueberries combined
5. Repeat layers one more time , ending with the pudding
6. Cover and refrigerate for about 30 minutes
7. Garnish with mint sprigs and some berries , if like

title: dutch apple pie cones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Peel , core , and cut the apples into 3 / 4" chunks
3. In a medium bowl , whisk the cornstarch , vanilla extract , apple juice concentrate , and brown sugar together
4. Add the apples and raisins and toss
5. Transfer to a 2-quart baking dish
6. Cover the dish with foil and bake for 20 minutes
7. Uncover and bake for 20 minutes more , stirring occasionally for even cooking
8. The mixture is done when the apples are just tender and the filling is clear and thickened
9. Set aside to cool a bit
10. Scoop warm filing into the ice cream cones and serve , topped with whipped cream

title: sudani rice
steps:
1. In pot , fry rice in butter / oil for 1 - 2 minutes
2. Pour stock into pot , covering rice
3. Add salt and turmeric or coriander or cardamom
4. Cover and cook until water evaporated

title: quick   easy  and yummy  apple tart
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 415 degrees
2. Place puffed pastry rectangles onto a baking pan thats been sprayed with nonstick spray
3. Add sugar and salt to apples
4. Stir to combine
5. Allow to sit for a few minutes
6. Arrange apple slices on the pastry rectangles in a straight line , overlapping as you go
7. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes , or until pastry is puffed and golden brown
8. Remove from pan immediately and place on a serving platter
9. Serve plain , with caramel topping , whipped cream , or a sprinkling of powdered sugar
10. Vanilla ice cream is good with it too

title: low fat low calorie ginger cherry oatmeal granola cookies
steps:
1. Mix , drop and flatten cookies on oiled cookie sheet
2. Bake for 10 minutes at 350 degrees

title: turmeric soup
steps:
1. Heat oil , and saute ginger and garlic
2. Add turmeric and fry for about one minute
3. Break the egg in , and saute until cooked
4. Add the water , and heat until it comes to a boil
5. Add salt to taste

title: popeyes  cajun battered fries
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat
2. Add 1 teaspoon salt
3. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees
4. Lightly mist a large nonstick baking sheet with oil spray
5. Set aside
6. Place the potato on a cutting board
7. Make straight cuts on the 4 long sides of the potato to remove some of the peel
8. Discard the trimmed pieces
9. Some skin will remain on the sides and the ends
10. With a knife , cut the potato lengthwise into 1 / 3"thick sticks
11. These can vary in length
12. On a scale , weigh 5 1 / 4 ounces of potatoes or measure 1 1 / 2 cups
13. Transfer the potato strips to the boiling water
14. Cook for exactly 3 minutes but no longer or they will break
15. Drain in a colander
16. Set aside for about 5 minutes to cool
17. Meanwhile , in a mixing bowl , combine the egg substitute , flour , paprika , black pepper , cayenne , garlic powder , and the remaining 3 / 4 teaspoon salt
18. With a fork , beat to mix
19. Add the potato strips
20. With hands , toss to coat well
21. Allow any excess egg-substitute mixture to drip off
22. Transfer to the reserved baking sheet
23. Arrange , not touching , in a single layer
24. Bake for 20 minutes , turning about every 5 minutes , or until crispy and golden

title: pumpkin spice cake in jars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Sterilize 8 ball quilted crystal canning jars , lids and rings by boiling them for 10 minutes
3. Leave the lids and rings in the hot water until you're ready to use them
4. Remove jars and allow the jars to air-dry and cool
5. Prepare the batter in the meantime
6. Using a pastry brush , brush the inside of the cooled jars with shortening
7. Set aside
8. Coarsely chop the raisins and walnuts
9. Set aside
10. Sift together the flour , baking soda , baking powder , salt , cloves , cinnamon and ginger in a large bowl
11. Add raisins and walnuts
12. Toss to lightly combine
13. In another large bowl , beat eggs at high speed until thick and yellow
14. Gradually beat in the sugar until thick and light
15. At low speed , beat in the oil and pumpkin
16. Blend well
17. Gradually stir in the flour mixture until well blended
18. Divide among the 8 canning jars (should be slightly less than 1 / 2 full
19. Wipe the sides of the jar off in case you slop or it'll burn
20. Place jars onto a cookie sheet or they'll
21. Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until a pick inserted into the center of each jar comes out clean
22. Have your lids and rings ready
23. Take one jar at a time from the oven
24. Place a lid and ring on and screw down tightly
25. Use heavy-duty mitts--the jars are hot ! place the jars onto your counter top too cool
26. You'll know when they've sealed , you'll hear a "plinking sound"

title: peanut brittles
steps:
1. Remove the skin of the roasted peanuts
2. Grease a metal plate with little oil and keep aside
3. In a heavy saucepan , add sugar and moist it with 5 tbsp of water
4. Cook and keep mixing on a low flame till the sugar turns into a light brown caramel
5. Add the peanuts into the caramel and mix them quickly
6. Drop in the pat of butter and stir
7. Quickly pour the sticky mixture onto the greased plate
8. Allow it to cool and set
9. Break into small pieces and serve

title: green bean and basil salad
steps:
1. Steam the green beans for about 10 minutes , until tender
2. You can also cook them in the microwave for about 4 minutes
3. Set aside in a bowl
4. Whisk together the oil , vinegar and seasonings
5. Pour this over the green beans
6. Add the scallions and toss gently
7. Cover and place in the fridge until cold
8. The flavor really intensifies if you let the salad chill for 24 hours

title: wonderful vegan brownies
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease a 13x9-inch baking pan
3. In a bowl combine flour , sugar , sifted cocoa powder , baking powder , salt and cinnamon
4. In a small bowl combine soy milk with oil and vanilla
5. Pour into the flour mixture and mix until well blended
6. Stir in nuts
7. Transfer to the prepared baking dish
8. Bake for about 30-35 minutes or until the top is no longer shiny
9. Let cool about 20 minutes or more before slicing

title: caribbean bar nuts   low carb   no salt added
steps:
1. It is not the splenda in little packets
2. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
3. Place pecans in single layer on baking sheet
4. Roast 15-17 minutes or until lightly golden brown and slightly crunchy
5. In large bowl , add the dry coating mix
6. Set aside
7. About 5 minutes before pecans are done , in a saucepan add all seasoning mix ingredients and bring just to boil
8. It may not seem like enough sauce
9. However , it should be enough to coat the outside of all the nuts
10. Immediately add hot nuts and stir continuously until all liquid has been absorbed and no liquid remains on bottom on saucepan
11. This will take about 1-2 minutes
12. Pour nuts into dry coating mix bowl and stir to coat nuts
13. Pour nuts onto a silpat silicone mat , parchment or waxed paper , separating nuts
14. Cool
15. Store in air-tight container
16. Would keep for weeks , but they won't last that long
17. Variation: mix these nuts with craisins , butterscotch chips , and mini-pretzels for a delicious bar mix appetizer

title: herb cheese stuffed chicken breasts with red pepper sauce
steps:
1. Sauce:
2. Char bell peppers over gas flame or in broiler until blackened on all sides
3. Wrap in paper bag and let stand 10 minutes
4. Peel and seed peppers
5. Puree peppers in processor until smooth
6. Transfer puree to heavy small saucepan
7. Add whipping cream and chicken broth
8. Boil until reduced to 1 cup , about 4 minutes
9. Season sauce to taste with salt and pepper
10. Chicken:
11. Preheat oven to 350f mix cream cheese and tarragon in small bowl to blend
12. Season to taste with salt and pepper
13. Pound chicken between sheets of plastic wrap to 1 / 4-inch thickness
14. Spread 2 t cheese mixture over each breast , leaving 1 / 2-inch border on all sides
15. Starting at 1 short end , roll up each breast
16. Secure seam and ends with toothpicks
17. Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper
18. Heat olive oil in heavy large oven-proof skillet over medium-high heat
19. Add chicken and cook until brown on all sides , about 4 minutes
20. Pour white wine around chicken
21. Transfer skillet to oven
22. Bake until chicken is cooked through about 10 minutes
23. Transfer chicken to work surface
24. Remove toothpicks
25. Cut chicken breasts into 1-inch-wide slices
26. Bring sauce to simmer
27. Spoon sauce onto plates
28. Arrange chicken atop sauce and serve

title: anzac biscuits  cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 160c or 180c line biscuit trays with a quality baking paper or lightly grease with butter
2. Using a large mixing bowl -- combine the oats , coconut , flour and sugars
3. Using a small saucepan or microwave -- melt the butter and golden syrup together
4. Set aside
5. Using a cup -- mix the boiling water and bicarb soda together
6. Add this mixture to the melted butter
7. The mixture will foam up
8. Add the butter to the dry ingredients and combine thoroughly
9. I've posted a photo of how i like my mixture to look
10. You should be able to get a tablespoon of the mixture and roll it together / push into shape of a cookie
11. Add too much water and your biscuits will flatten out totally during cooking
12. Using your hands
13. Roll into balls and flatten slightly
14. These cookies do spread whilst baking -- so i usually place 12 to a cookie sheet / baking tray
15. Place on baking trays and bake for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown
16. Cooking longer will give a crunchier biscuit or less time a softer biscuit
17. I like mine to be crisp
18. Total cooking time will depend on how many cookies / trays can fit in your oven at a time
19. Cool on trays for 5 to 10 minutes before moving to a rack to cool
20. If biscuits are too soft they can be returned to the oven and cooked further

title: new years cabbage and kielbasa
steps:
1. Heat oil and butter and fry kielbasa
2. Add cabbage and cook till tender
3. Add soy sauce , salt and pepper to taste and crushed red chilies if desired

title: new orleans style beignet recipe
steps:
1. Combine the yeast , water , and sugar in the work bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a dough hook
2. Let this sit until frothy , about 5 minutes , then add the salt , egg , and evaporated milk
3. Mix on low speed , then add half of the flour until it starts to come together , then add the shortening
4. When the shortening is incorporated start adding the remaining flour , a little at a time until most of it is incorporated
5. At this time i always turn the dough onto a floured bench to finish by hand , just like when i make bread
6. It's a touch thing
7. Knead the dough adding just enough flour as necessary to make a non-sticky , smooth dough
8. Place the dough into a large oiled bowl , loosely cover and let rise
9. After the dough has doubled in bulk , punch it down and turn it onto a floured surface and roll out into a rectangle that is about 1 / 2-inch thick
10. With a very sharp knife working at a diagonal to the rectangle , cut into 2-inch wide strips
11. Now cut into diamond shapes by making diagonal cuts in the opposite direction
12. Place the beignets on a floured baking sheet to let rise about 40 minutes in a warm place
13. When the beignets have risen , heat 2-3 inches of vegetable oil in a large saucepan to 350-360 degrees
14. Place 2-3 beignets into the hot oil at a time , being careful not to smash or deflate them
15. When they are golden brown , flip them over until golden brown on the other side
16. Remove to paper towel lined plates to drain
17. Serve hot topped with plenty of powdered sugar
18. Best served with cafe au lait
19. Enjoy !

title: tennessee whiskey pork chops
steps:
1. In a nonstick skillet , over medium-high heat , heat olive oil
2. Season pork chops with salt and pepper
3. Place chops in skillet , and cook about 5 minutes each side , turning once , until browned
4. Remove chops from skillet and keep warm
5. In the same skillet cook garlic , onion , and pepper flakes until tender , about 2 minutes
6. Stir in the apple juice , dark brown sugar , whiskey , teriyaki , and soy sauces
7. Turn heat to high and bring mixture to a boil
8. Reduce heat to medium , and cook sauce , stirring occasionally , until slightly thickened , about 10 minutes
9. Add pork chops to skillet and simmer , turning once , until no longer pink near bone and sauce is thickened and reduced to about 1 / 2 cup

title: buffalo wild wings spicy garlic sauce
steps:
1. In a small sauce pan combine first seven ingredients
2. Heat over medium heat until sauce begins to boil
3. Reduce heat and simmer for five minutes
4. Remove pan from heat and allow to cool for 10 minutes
5. Whisk egg yolk and water together
6. Add cornstarch and continue to whisk until cornstarch is completely dissolved
7. Slowly add warm hot sauce mixture to egg mixture
8. Continually whisk to create an emulsion
9. Cover sauce and chill until needed

title: connie s very fancy grape dessert
steps:
1. Wash your grape
2. Dry
3. Put them into ziplop bags
4. Freeze
5. Keep these in the fridge instead of klondikes

title: cherry tomato hors d oeuvres
steps:
1. Slice your cherry tomatoes in half
2. Scoop out the interior with a melon ball scoop , and place your tomatoes on a serving dish
3. Make sure your celery and onions are finely chopped
4. Using a fork and a folding motion , mix them in a bowl with your mayonnaise
5. Add 1 cup finely chopped cooked chicken to the bowl with your celery and onions
6. Mix with fork continuing your folding motion until you achieve the desired consistency
7. If you are not adding meat , substitute an additional 3 / 4 cup each of finely chopped celery and onions
8. Add more mayo if you like , but be careful
9. Too much will make your filling soggy
10. Using your melon ball scoop , fill each tomato with a scoop of your filling
11. When all are done , sprinkle with dried parsley flakes , cover , and place in your refrigerator to chill
12. Serve about 1 hour after making
13. This recipe makes 24 hors d'oeuvres
14. You can increase ingredients proportionately if you want to make more

title: strawberry trifle no cream cheese
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl beat , instant pudding mix , orange peel , sour cream , and milk
2. Beat at low speed until thick
3. Using a spatula fold in whipped cream and mix
4. In trifle bowl layer 1 / 2 of cake pieces
5. Next layer 1 / 3 strawberries
6. Next layer 1 / 2 pudding mixture
7. Repeat layers
8. Arrange strawberries on top
9. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours

title: strawberry shortcake ice cream cake
steps:
1. Following box directions , bake the white cake in two 9" cake pans
2. Allow it to cool
3. In a bowl , combine strawberry ice cream with fresh cut strawberries
4. Trim the tops off each cake , leaving a flat surface
5. Lay first cake layer into a 9" springform cheesecake pan
6. Pour the ice cream mixture to make an ice cream layer
7. Lay the 2nd baked cake on top
8. Place in the freezer for 3-4 hours
9. In a food processor , mix vanilla wafer cookies
10. Also food process the freeze-dried strawberries
11. Remove the springform cheesecake pan
12. Combine both the vanilla wafer cookies and freeze-dried strawberries in a bowl
13. Add white frosting on top of the cake , spread evenly to cover top and sides
14. Sprinkle the pulverized the vanilla wafer cookies and freeze-dried strawberries on top of the cake
15. Add pulverized the vanilla wafer cookies and freeze-dried strawberries to the cake sides
16. Pipe several icing mounds on top of the cake
17. Place fresh strawberries on the icing mounds

title: simple and good ham and split pea soup
steps:
1. In large saucepan , combine first 7 ingredients
2. Simmer covered , 1 hour , stir in celery and carrots and continue simmering for 1 / 2 to 1 hour or until peas are tender and soup thickens
3. Remove peppercorns and ham shank , cut meat from bone and return to soup
4. Heat through

title: seneca ghost bread
steps:
1. In a bowl combine all except the shortening or lard
2. Mix until batter is smooth
3. In a skillet heat shortening or lard on medium heat till melted
4. Using a wooden spoon scoop a large spoon full from the bread batter and place it in the shortening
5. Let cook about 30 seconds or until bottom is firm enough to slip spatula under and flip over
6. Carefully turn the dough over and press with spatula to flatten
7. You may have to press it down several times
8. When it gets light brown around the edges turn it over and cook till edges are browned
9. Serve warm or place in baggies after cooling and eat as desired

title: green bean and cashew nut thoran
steps:
1. Blanch beans in salted water for 1 minute , then plunge into cold water
2. Heat oil over high heat
3. As soon as oil smokes add mustard and cumin seeds and curry leaves
4. When seeds crackle add ginger and chillies
5. Stir fry for a moment then add beans and heat through
6. Add coconut , sugar , lime , coriander and nuts
7. Toss together and season with salt

title: philadelphia cream cheese pound cake
steps:
1. All ingredients must be at room temperature
2. Cream butter well , add cream cheese
3. Mix thoroughly
4. Gradually add sugar
5. Add eggs , one at a time
6. Add flour gradually , then add vanilla flavor
7. Place cake in tube pan in cold oven
8. Bake at 325 degrees f for 1 1 / 2 hours [from the time you turn on the oven]

title: cucumber onion raisin snack
steps:
1. Slice cucumbers into bowl
2. Slice onions into the bowl
3. Add raisins
4. Toss with fat free ranch

title: spicy turkey lasagna
steps:
1. Put olive oil and sausage in large pot and brown the meat
2. Add garlic , onion , dried seasonings , and mushrooms
3. Simmer until onions are softened , about 4 minutes
4. Add tomato paste , diced tomatoes , and parsley
5. Simmer , uncovered , for about 1 1 / 2 hours
6. While sauce is simmering , cook lasagna noodles according to package directions
7. Rinse with cold water
8. Preheat oven to 350f
9. Spread thin layer of sauce on the bottom of a 13x9-inch non-stick baking dish
10. Lay 3 noodles evenly over the sauce
11. Spread about half of the cottage cheese onto the noodles
12. Sprinkle about 1 / 3 of the mozzarella and parmesan evenly into the pan
13. Spread another thin layer of sauce
14. Repeat steps 8-11
15. Lay 3 more noodles evenly over the sauce
16. Spread out the rest of the remaining sauce
17. Sprinkle the rest of the parmesan and mozzarella
18. Bake , covered with aluminum foil , for about 45 minutes
19. Uncover , and continue to bake for 15 more minutes
20. Allow to cool for 10 minutes before cutting into squares

title: mini eggplant crust pizzas
steps:
1. Preheat the oven or toaster oven to 425 degrees f
2. Brush both sides of the eggplant with the oil and season with the salt and pepper
3. Arrange on a baking sheet and bake until browned and almost tender , 6 to 8 minutes , turning once
4. Spread 1 tablespoon of pasta sauce on each eggplant slice
5. Top with the shredded cheese
6. Bake until the cheese melts , 3 to 5 minutes
7. Serve hot

title: chili  kid friendly  big batch
steps:
1. Cook hamburger with peppers , celery and onions
2. Once hamburger is cooked put into colander and rinse off with hot water to remove fat
3. Put meat mixture into the pot again , add remaining ingredients
4. Bring to a simmer and cook until vegetables are soft
5. Can use a mixture of beans also
6. Freezes beautifully

title: crispy parmesan chicken strips
steps:
1. Cut the chicken breast into strips--the size is your choice
2. Crush the seasoned croutons and place in a dish
3. Add the parmesan cheese , parsley , and garlic salt--mix well
4. In a separate bowl whisk the egg whites and water together
5. Dip the chicken into the egg wash and then into the crumbs
6. Place on sprayed pan and bake at 450 degrees for 14-16 minutes
7. Serve with ranch dressing

title: bean   cheese taquitos w  guacamole
steps:
1. Make guacamole first by combining all ingredients except sour cream
2. Mash and stir until only small lumps of avocado remain
3. Garnish with sour cream piled in the center and refrigerate until ready to use
4. Combine beans , tabasco , cumin , corriander , salt and cheese stirring well
5. Microwave tortillas between 2 paper towels , 3 at a time on high for 30 seconds
6. Work with one tortilla at a time , keeping the others covered in paper towels so they stay warm and moist
7. Place 1 tablespoon of filling at the center edge of tortilla closest to you and roll tightly away from you like skinny cigar
8. Keep filling away from the edges , as it may leak out when frying and cause the oil to spatter
9. Put seam side down on a paper towel or wax paper and repeat the process until you've made all 24 taquitos
10. Using medium-thick cotton string , toothpicks , or bamboo skewers secure the center seam of each taquito
11. Heat oil in medium frying pan on medium-high and cook taquitos 4 at a time turning frequently until golden brown on all sides
12. Drain on cooling rack on top of paper towels
13. Serve hot with guacamole

title: mushroom and quinoa pie
steps:
1. Saut onion , green onions and garlic in the olive oil for 2 minutes until the onion is translucent
2. Add the mushroom and saut for 5 minutes
3. Add the stock and half the pine nuts and bring to the boil
4. Reduce the heat and simmer for 30 minutes
5. While the mushrooms are cooking , rinse the quinoa in water then add it to the pan with 2 cups of water
6. Bring to the boil then reduce the heat , cover and cook for 15 minutes or until the grain is tender and the water is absorbed
7. Remove from the heat
8. Chop remaining pine nuts and add to the pan
9. Mix the miso paste and kuzu in the water and stir until smooth
10. Pour into the mushroom mixture and stir until it thickens slightly
11. Stir through the parsley and remove from the heat
12. Pour the mushroom mix into an ovenproof dish
13. Top with quinoa and back in an oven for 20 minutes at 160c
14. Serve with stir fried spinach or asian greens

title: fresh tomato pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Separate crescent rolls
3. Form a crust by lining a deep dish pie pan with the rolls
4. Bake crust for 10 minutes or until slightly golden
5. Peel and slice tomatoes
6. Place in a single layer in a colander
7. Sprinkle with salt and allow to drain for about 10 minutes
8. Layer tomato slices , onions and basil in shell
9. Season with salt and pepper
10. Combine mayonnaise and cheese
11. Spread on top of the tomatoes
12. Bake for 30 minutes or until lightly browned
13. Cut into wedges and serve warm

title: chocolate scotchies
steps:
1. Melt honey , butterscotch chips , and peanut butter in microwavable dish for 30 sec
2. Stir
3. Cook another 30 sec until melted
4. Do not overcook
5. Add rice krispies to melted mixture - stir quickly
6. Press firmly into greased 9x13 pan using back of buttered spoon to prevent sticking
7. Melt chocolate chips in microwavable bowl spread melted chips on top of rice krispies
8. Allow chocolate topping to cool and harden
9. Cut into squares
10. Enjoy !

title: ukrainian grated potato bake
steps:
1. Saute the bacon in a medium-size skillet over medium heat until it renders its fat
2. Remove from the skillet and drain on paper towels
3. Pour off all but 2 tablespoons of the fat from the skillet
4. Add the onions and saute , stirring occasionally , over medium heat until deeply colored , about 15 minutes
5. Remove from the heat and set aside
6. Grate the potatoes coarsely by hand or in a food processor using a coarse grating blade
7. Wash in several changes of water
8. Squeeze the potatoes well in a clean linen or cotton kitchen towel to remove as much liquid as possible
9. Rinse and squeeze again
10. In a large bowl , thoroughly combine the potatoes , sauteed onions , bacon , cream , and egg yolks
11. Season generously with salt and freshly ground black pepper
12. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f
13. Beat the egg whites until stiff
14. Gently fold into the potato mixture , using a rubber spatula
15. Carefully transfer the mixture to a well-buttered round 10-inch baking dish or heavy oven proof skillet
16. Dot the top with butter
17. Bake until the top is browned and crispy and potatoes are tender , 45 minutes to 1 hour
18. Serves 6 to 8

title: lemon walnut green beans
steps:
1. Sprinkle beans with salt , and arrange in a steamer basket over boiling water
2. Cover and steam 8 to 12 minutes or until crisp-tender
3. Plunge beans into cold water to stop the cooking process
4. Drain
5. Melt butter in a dutch oven over medium-high heat
6. Add green onions , and saute until tender
7. Add green beans , walnuts , rosemary , and lemon juice
8. Cook , stirring constantly , until thoroughly heated
9. Sprinkle with lemon rind
10. Serve immediately

title: chocolate butter cream bars
steps:
1. Combine 1 / 2 c butter , 1 / 4 powdered sugar and cocoa in 2 qt saucepan
2. Cook over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until butter is melted
3. Remove from heat
4. Stir in 2 tsp vanilla , 1 / 4 c half&half , graham cracker crumbs , coconut and walnuts
5. Press mixture into bottom of ungreased 8" square baking pan
6. Combine remaining 1 / 2 c butter , remaining 1&3 / 4 c powdered sugar , remaining 1 tsp vanilla and 2 t half&half in large mixer bowl
7. Beat at medium speed , scraping bowl often , until light and fluffy(2-3 minutes
8. Spread evenly over crust
9. Refrigerate until firm
10. Combine 2 t butter , corn syrup , and 2 t half&half in 1 qt saucepan
11. Cook over medium heat , stirring occasionally ,
12. Until mixture comes to a boil
13. Remove from heat
14. Stir in chocolate melted
15. Stir in enough powdered sugar for desired spreading consistency
16. Spread evenly over filling
17. Cover
18. Refrigerate at least 2 hours or until serving time
19. Store in refrigerator

title: scrambled eggs with fines herbes and tomatoes
steps:
1. Break the eggs into a large mixing bowl , reserving 2 yolks in a smaller separate bowl
2. Add the herbs , salt and pepper to the large bowl of eggs
3. Mix with a whisk
4. In the smaller bowl of egg yolks , whisk in the mustard and creme fraiche
5. Mix well
6. Melt the butter in a large skillet
7. When melted , add the large bowl of eggs and cook , stirring constantly , until creamy and just barely thickened
8. Add the yolk mixture and the tomatoes to the skillet
9. Stir once or twice to incorporate , and remove from the heat
10. They will continue to cook off the heat
11. Prepare the plate , serve the eggs garnished with some of the herbs

title: sour cream frosting
steps:
1. Whip cream until soft peaks form
2. Combine sour cream with sugar and vanilla and stir gently to dissolve sugar
3. Carefully fold in whipped cream and ice cake !

title: crock pot normandy pork with apples  shallots   cider
steps:
1. Trim the pork of any thick fat
2. Cut into large cubes of about 4" square or even bigger - it shrinks with cooking & works better with larger pieces of meat
3. Peel the shallots and set to one side
4. Halve & core the apples and set to one side with the shallots
5. Turn the crockpot onto high
6. Mix the cider , cider apple vinegar , creme fraiche , salt & pepper , thyme & thickened chicken stock together in a large pouring jug & pour into the crockpot
7. Add the cored and halved apples and replace the lid whilst you brown the pork & shallots
8. Heat up half the butter & half of the olive oil in a large skillet or wok-type pan , one with fairly high sides
9. As soon as it is smoking but not burning , brown the shallots in batches - you want a deep caramelised colour & the shallots just softened on the outside
10. When all the shallots have been done , put them all back into the pan - turn up the heat & add the balsamic vinegar and stir briskly making sure all the shallots are well coated
11. Add the shallots & balsamic vinegar mixture to the crockpot
12. Heat up the remaining butter and oil , adding more if necessary & start to brown the pork pieces , again do not overcrowd the pan - they need to be well coloured & seared to seal in the juices
13. As the pork pieces are browned , add them to the crockpot
14. When all the pork is browned & added to the crockpot , give all the ingredients a good mix around in the crockpot with a wooden spoon
15. If using fresh thyme , pick about 4 large sprigs and place on top of the normandy pork - the leaves fall off during cooking & leave the bare branches for throwing away !
16. Cook on high for between 6 - 10 hours
17. Just before serving , pour in calvados and mix through
18. Serve each person with 2 -3 pieces of pork , a cooked apple half & 1 or 2 shallots
19. Add a dollop of creme fraiche on the side & garnish with thyme & a fresh apple sliver if desired
20. Decant the excess sauce into a gravy boat for extra saucy bits !
21. Great with spiced red cabbage , fluffy mashed potatoes or pommes dauphinoise
22. To cook in an conventional oven , follow recipe as above , but cook in a la creuset type oven proof dish
23. Pre-heat oven to 175 c or 350 f and cook slowly for about 6 hours , checking after 4 hours
24. It will cook quite happily for up to 8 hours if this helps in your time management , you may have to turn the oven down to about 125 c , 250 f after 4 hours for a long slow 8 hour cooking time

title: curly cue salad
steps:
1. Cook rotini according to package directions
2. Rinse in cold water and refrigerate until cold
3. Mix the rest of the ingredients and chill until the noodles are cold
4. Pour the vinegar dressing over the cold noodles
5. Keep refrigerated until serving

title: baked sesame marmalade chicken
steps:
1. Mix the garlic , ginger , orange marmalade and soy sauce together in a large bowl
2. Add the chicken thighs , stir , cover and set aside for 15min
3. Put the chicken in a roasting tin and roast at 425f for 35min , basting and moving the chicken around in the tin so that it cooks evenly and is cooked to the centre
4. Lift the chicken out of the tin and keep warm
5. Skim the fat off the juices in the roasting tin , discard the fat , bring the juices to the boil and bubble for 30sec
6. Spoon the juices over the chicken , sprinkle the sesame seeds over and serve with boiled white rice

title: apple chutney  from the new revised moosewood cookbook
steps:
1. Coarsely chop the apples , with or without peel
2. Place them in a medium sized saucepan with all remaining ingredients
3. Bring to a boil , then lower heat to simmer
4. Simmer uncovered about 45 minutes , stirring occasionally , or until everything is very soft
5. Enjoy the delicious smell wafting through your house
6. Cool and transfer to a sterile jar
7. Refrigerate
8. Sometimes the apples i use are harder and still chunky at the end of cooking , so i mash them with the potato masher

title: golden pecan bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray a 9x13in baking pan with cooking spray , set aside
3. In a large bow , combine the baking mix and brown sugar , mix well
4. In a small bowl , combine milk and egg , mix well
5. Pour the milk mixture into the dry ingredients and stir until smooth
6. Pat dough evenly into bottom of prepared pan
7. Bake until dough is firm , about 12 minutes
8. While dough is baking , prepare the topping
9. In a small saucepan , combine sugar , butter , orange juice and honey
10. Bring to a boil , boil for 3 minutes without stirring
11. Remove saucepan from heat
12. Pour syrup evenly over baked dough
13. Sprinkle with pecans
14. Bake until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean , about 20 minutes
15. Cool completely

title: spicy szechuan noodles  dan dan mian
steps:
1. Combine meat mixture ingredients in small bowl
2. Work together well and let rest while preparing other ingredients
3. Whisk together sauce ingredients except broth until smooth
4. Add broth and whisk well
5. Boil 4 quarts of water
6. Heat 12 inch skillet over high heat until hot , about 2 minutes
7. Add peanut oil and swirl
8. Add meat mixture and cook , breaking up into small pieces until pork is well browned , about 5 minutes
9. Stir in ginger , garlic and red pepper flakes , cook until fragrant , about 1 minute
10. Add sauce mixture
11. Whisk to combine and bring to a boil
12. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer while noodles are cooking
13. Just before serving stir in sesame oil
14. Drain noodles
15. Divide into individual bowls , top with sauce
16. Sprinkle with scallions and bean sprouts as desired while eating

title: mom florence s tacos
steps:
1. Shred the cheese in one bowl
2. Chop the onion into one bowl
3. Place the olives into one bowl
4. Put the sour cream in one bowl
5. Put salsa in one bowl
6. Put refried beans in microwave bowl and top with a little cheese and a little salsa
7. Heat until hot
8. In one pan , brown the ground beef and , of course , put in bowl when everyone is at table and all bowls are on table too
9. Heat about inch of oil oil in another fry pan and fry the corn tortillas about 1 second on each side
10. Use tongs to turn tortillas and put on plate with paper towels
11. These don't hold very long , so serve immediately
12. Cook should eat 1 taco first to get jump on everyone else--lol !

title: mexican hamburgers
steps:
1. Mix ground beef , taco seasoning mix , green chilies , finely chopped onion
2. Shape into patties and grill
3. Serve with salsa

title: shrimp dim sum
steps:
1. To make the filling:
2. Mix together all the ingredients except the cornstrach until the mixture is well blended and smooth
3. Stir in the cornstrach , mix
4. Divide into 30 portions
5. To make the dough:
6. Put 2 cups of flour in a medium size bowl
7. Reserve remaining flour and use on hands if they become sticky
8. Add the boiling water into the bowl
9. Add the cold water and oil into the bowl
10. Mix to form dough
11. Knead until smooth
12. Roll dough into a long rope shape and cut into 30 pieces
13. Use a rolling pin to roll out each piece into a thin 2 inch circle
14. Place a portion of the filling in the middle of a dough circle
15. Bring the opposite edges together and pinch them together to hold
16. Repeat with remaining circles and filling
17. Line a steamer with a damp cloth
18. Set the dumplings about 1 inch apart , steam over high heat for 5 minutes
19. Remove and serve

title: po de queijo    brazilian cheese puffs  gluten free
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 190c and grease a baking sheet
2. Sift the the tapioca starch into a large bowl
3. Set aside
4. Combine the vegetable oil , water , and salt in a saucepan and heat until almost boiling
5. You can use the mcrowave for this step if you wish
6. Pour the hot liquid into the bowl of tapioca starch
7. Mix and allow to stand for 10 minutes at room temperature cover the bowl with a clean cloth or tea-towel
8. Mix in the egg and cheese into the rested dough
9. Roll the dough using your hands into balls and place on a baking sheet
10. 1 to 2 teaspoons makes a good sized cheese puff
11. Place the balls approx one inch apart on your baking tray
12. Bake 20-25 minutes , until the tops of the balls begin to turn brown
13. Eat warm from the oven or cool and freeze to be reheated later

title: nuoc cham  vietnamese chili sauce for dipping
steps:
1. Mince chilies and garlic finely and place in a mortar
2. Mash with the heel of a cleaver or pestle
3. Add sugar and stir until it dissolves
4. Add fish sauce , vinegar and lemon juice , stirring between each addition

title: m m kahlua cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Cream the butter and the sugars until well blended on low speed
3. Add eggs , vanilla and kahlua
4. Measure the oatmeal and blend in a blender to a fine powder
5. Mix the flour , oatmeal , salt , baking powder and baking soda
6. Fold it gently into the butter mixture
7. Add m&m's
8. Roll into balls and place 2-inches apart on greased cookie sheet
9. Bake for 10-12 minutes at 375f

title: loaded baked potato soup
steps:
1. Peel and cut the baked potatoes into medium sized chunks
2. Place butter and onions in a large pot
3. Cook till onions are semi-clear
4. Reserve 2 cups of milk and pour the rest in the pot with the onions
5. Warm milk and while it is heating mix remaining milk with the flour , whisking till smooth
6. Whisk the milk / flour mixture into the heated milk , continuing to whisk till well blended and smooth
7. When milk has thickened add the potatoes , bacon , salt , pepper , and garlic
8. Finally mix in the sour cream just till melted inches
9. Garnish as desired
10. Cook time does not include time to bake potatoes

title: canned corn
steps:
1. Husk corn , remove silk and wash
2. Cut kernels from cob
3. Pack loosely into hot jars , leaving 1 inch headspace
4. Do not shake or press down
5. Add 1 / 2 teaspoon salt to each pint jar , 1 teaspoon salt to each quart jar , if desired
6. Ladle boiling water over corn leaving 1 inch headspace
7. Remove air bubbles and apply lids
8. Process pints 55 minutes , quarts 1 hour and 25 minutes at 10 pounds pressure in a pressure canner

title: greek rice with cabbage and tomatoes   lahanorizo
steps:
1. Over low heat in a large skillet , saut onion until just translucent
2. Increase heat to medium and add cabbage
3. Continue cooking until wilted
4. Add tomatoes and water
5. When in comes to a boil , add rice , parsley , salt and pepper
6. Reduce heat to simmer , cover and cook until very little liquid remains and rice is tender
7. Serve

title: my favorite open faced tomato sandwich
steps:
1. Spread butter , margarine , or pam on both sides of each piece of bread
2. Grill on a cast iron skillet , non-stick pan , or whatever it takes to get them toasted
3. In the meantime , slice each tomato into 8 slices
4. When the bread is toasted on both sides , spread boursin or goat cheese on one side of the bread
5. Top each bread slice with four tomatoes
6. Sprinkle each sandwich with kosher salt to taste

title: weight watchers tasty italian beef
steps:
1. Place roast in crock pot mix remaining ingredients and pour over roast
2. Cook on low 8-10 hours

title: maple glazed new potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f
2. Halve or quarter any large potatoes
3. In shallow dish large enough to hold potatoes in a single layer , toss potatoes with butter
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Spread in single layer and roast potatoes , uncovered , for 45 minutes , stirring once or twice during roasting
6. Meanwhile , in small dish , stir together vinegar , maple syrup , and sliced garlic
7. Drizzle potatoes with vinegar mixture , gently tossing with a spoon or spatula to coat
8. Continue to roast about 10 to 20 minutes more , until potatoes are fork-tender and glazed , stirring once or twice
9. To serve , sprinkle potatoes with green onions , thyme , and lemon peel
10. Makes 6 servings

title: spicy yoghurt chicken
steps:
1. Place chicken in shallow dish
2. Mix yoghurt , garlic , cumin , coriander and chilli together and pour over chicken
3. Coat well
4. Cover and leave to marinate in refrigerator for at least 1 hour
5. Remove excess yoghurt mix from chicken
6. Arrange drumsticks on foil line baking tray and bake in moderate oven 200deg c for 35- 40 minutes or until tender and cooked
7. Place remaining yoghurt mix into saucepan
8. Blend in cornflour and sugar
9. Bring to boil , stirring
10. Reduce heat and simmer for 2 minutes
11. Drizzle sauce over chicken

title: peanut butter s mores cookies
steps:
1. Cookies
2. Cream butter , brown sugar and white sugar , add peanut butter and stir till combined
3. Add egg , milk & vanilla , mix till smooth
4. Combine flour , baking soda and salt in bowl
5. Add peanut mixture mixing well
6. Roll tablespoon sized amounts into round balls
7. Arrange on cookie sheets
8. Bake at 180 degrees celsius for around 6 minutes , take out of oven and flatten with a spatula and return to oven for further 6 minutes
9. Remove from oven and turn over half the cookies and place a piece of chocolate on the overturned cookies , let sit for a minute till choc melts then place the marshmallow on top , press down with the other half of the cookies

title: pesto dell uomo povero  poor man s pesto
steps:
1. Take a leftover loaf of stale french or italian bread
2. Crush but not to small and toast in oven untill light brown not burnt
3. It is very important that the bread is dry to create the right consistency not mush
4. Tear and chop fresh herbs
5. Toast garlic cloves with skin on in a skillet until slightly tender , seven minutes
6. Remove skins
7. Fresh garlic is fine but toasting it seems to help rid some of its effects
8. Grate the cheese
9. Combine ingredients in a blender and pulse
10. While pulsing slowly drizzle oil in until consistency has reached a very thick sauce or to the consistency you desire
11. Add zest and salt to personal taste
12. Use fresh this does keep for a day or so
13. If kept to long bread crumbs get soggy and that makes a gross mushy mess

title: southern barbecue sauce
steps:
1. In skillet , brown the onion and celery in the butte
2. Add all ingredients and simmer on low for 10 to 15 minutes

title: homemade sun dried tomato paste
steps:
1. Put the tomatoes in a medium bowl
2. Add some very hot water to cover
3. Stir for a few minutes , then drain
4. In a food processor , combine the tomatoes , garlic , olive oil and seasonings
5. Puree until smooth
6. Refrigerate for up to 2 weeks

title: smoked chicken  wild mushroom and corn chowder
steps:
1. Cook bacon in soup pot , remove and reserve
2. Cook onions and bell peppers in bacon fat until soft
3. Stir in 2 cups corn , chicken , potatoes , mushrooms , salt and pepper to taste
4. Add water and bring to boil
5. Simmer 30 minutes
6. Puree remaining 1 cup corn and 1 cup cream in blender until smooth
7. Stir into chowder and add remaining i cup cream
8. Heat through and serve with crumbled bacon on top

title: applesauce cherry loaf    kit hansen s
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a large bowl , sift together dry ingredients
3. In another bowl , mix together wet ingredients
4. Mix the wet ingredients into dry until well blended
5. Pour into a loaf pan
6. Bake for 70 minutes

title: orange  strawberry  banana smoothie
steps:
1. Put everything in a blender and mix away until smooth and frothy !
2. Serve and enjoy !

title: beef and penne casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f
2. Cook beef and onion in large saucepan , stirring occasionally , until beef is no longer pink
3. Add water , tomato paste , wine , bouillon , and seasonings
4. Cook , stirring occasionally , for 10 to 15 minutes or until flavors are blended
5. Layer ingredients as follows in 13 x 9-inch baking dish sprayed with non stick cooking spray: 1 / 2 pasta , 1 / 2 sauce and 1 / 2 cheese
6. Repeat layers
7. Cover
8. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until heated through and cheese is melted
9. Season with salt
10. For freeze ahead: prepare as above
11. Do not bake
12. Cover
13. Freeze for up to 2 months
14. Thaw overnight in refrigerator
15. Preheat oven to 350 f
16. Bake for 45 to 55 minutes or until heated through and cheese is melted
17. Season with salt

title: scottish salmon on cabbage with mushroom vinaigrette
steps:
1. ----forthe mushroom vinaigrette----
2. Warm half the olive oil with the white wine and vinegar , season and remove from heat
3. Place the mushrooms in the mixture , and allow to cool
4. ----forthe salmon----
5. Brush the fillets with olive oil , season and place skin side up under a hot grill / broiler for about 3 minutes
6. ----tofinish the dish----
7. Fry the onion and pepper until soft , and then season and increase the heat
8. Add the cabbage until cooked- but still crispy
9. Place the cabbage mixture in the centre of the serving dish
10. Top with the salmon , surround with diced tomato and mushroom vinaigrette
11. Garnish with dill

title: pseudo italian german schnitzel dinner sandwich
steps:
1. Dip your pounded pork in the juice of your choice and then into the bread crumbs , pat the crumbs into the meat
