2. Spray your non stick fry pan lightly with oil brown the pork schnitzels on both sides and remove from the pan
3. Spray the pan again lightly with oil add all the remaining ingredients except cheese& bread
4. Saute until heated through and return snitzels to the pan , heat through and serve on toasted bread of your choice or without
5. Drizzle cheese on top , garnish with fresh tomatoes and enjoy

title: quick and easy baked pork chops
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. In a glass dish , coat the pork chops with the ranch dressing and allow to marinate for about 15 minutes
3. In a separate shallow dish , mix the remaining ingredients
4. Dredge each pork chop in the bread crumb mixture one by one
5. Place the pork chops on a metal rack and place on top of a cookie sheet
6. Bake for about 18-20 minutes , or until cooked through

title: potato goodie
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together in a large mixing bowl
2. Salt and pepper to taste
3. Place mixture in 9x13 baking dish and bake at 375 degrees for 1 hour

title: salsa baked goat cheese
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Spread the nuts on a baking sheet and toast them in the oven until lightly browned and very fragrant , 7-8 minutes should do it
3. Transfer to a medium bowl add the cheeses to the bowl and combine thoroughly with the nuts
4. Scoop the cheese mixture into the center of a baking dish , such as a decorative 9" pie plate , and form into a 5" disk
5. Spoon te salsa over and around the cheese
6. Bake until heated through , 10-15 minutes
7. Sprinkle with the cilantro and serve as a dip or a spread with tortilla chips or other crisps
8. Also , really good if the chips are heated !

title: lentil soup with andouille sausage
steps:
1. Combine both stocks and lentils in a large pot
2. Over high heat , bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat , cover and simmer for 30 minutes
4. In a skillet , over medium heat , add fennel seeds
5. Saute until light golden brown , about 2 minutes
6. Remove seeds from skillet
7. Heat oil in same skillet over medium heat
8. Add celery , carrot , and onion
9. Saute until onion is translucent and celery and carrot are tender , about 5-10 minutes
10. Add toasted fennel seeds , sauteen vegetables , sausage , thyme and creole seasoning to soup
11. Cover and simmer until lentils are very tender , stirring occasionally , about 45 minutes
12. Season soup to taste with salt and pepper

title: crock pot peach cobbler
steps:
1. Drain peaches , if using canned peaches
2. Place the peaches in the crock
3. Combine oats , flour , brown sugar , cinnamon , and nutmeg and pour over peaches
4. Add the butter or margarine and stir until crumbly
5. Cook on low for 3 hours

title: indian style lentils
steps:
1. Cook lentils in 4 cups water until tender
2. 15-25 minute meanwhile saute the garlic and onion in the oil
3. Transfer to a medium sized bowl and add the rest of the ingredients and stir very well
4. Once lentils are soft , combine the onion mixture with the lentils in a slow cooker and cook over low heat for at least two hours
5. Enjoy

title: summery light mango carrot smoothie
steps:
1. 1 scrape the carrot and chop it into chunks
2. Same goes for the mango
3. 2 combine all ingredients plus juice of 1 / 2 orange in a blender and blend well until smooth
4. Serve in a tall glass and enjoy

title: beef mole tamale pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Spray 11"x7" baking dish with nontick cooking spray
3. Brown beef with onion , bell pepper and garlic in large deep skillet or dutch oven over medium heat
4. Drain fat
5. Stir in corn , salsa , cocoa , cumin , 1 tsp salt , oregano and cinnamon
6. Bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat to medium-low
8. Simmer uncovered 8 minutes , stirring occasionally
9. Remove from heat
10. Stir in cheese and cilantro
11. Spread into prepared dish
12. Combine flour , cornmeal , sugar , baking powder and remaining 1 / 2 tsp salt in large bowl
13. Add milk , butter and egg
14. Stir just until dry ingredients are moistend
15. Drop by spoonfuls evenly over meat mixture
16. Spread batter evenly with spatula
17. Bake 15 minutes
18. Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees and bake 20 minutes or until topping is light brown and filling is bubbly
19. Let stand 5 minutes before serving
20. Garnish with cilantro , chile pepper and sour cream

title: turkey and sweet potato wraps
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , place onion , sweet potato , chicken broth , celery , salt , sage , and pepper , and bring to a simmer over medium heat , and cook 10 minutes , or until vegetables are softened
2. Stir turkey and stuffing mix into vegetable mixture and heat on mediumm for 5 minutes , stirring often , or until heated through and mixture has thickened
3. Heat 1 tortilla in a dry skillet over medium heat and sprinkle with 1 / 4 cup of cheese and top with 1 / 2 cup of the filling
4. Allow cheese to melt for 10 seconds and remove from skillet
5. Fold in two opposite sides of tortilla one inch each , and roll up
6. Repeat with remaining tortillas
7. Place seam side down on serving plate
8. Top with jalapeno peppers

title: pillsbury italian biscuit flatbread
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f
2. Combine all ingredients through garlic in a bowl
3. Separate the biscuits
4. Split the biscuits into the top and bottom half of biscuit
5. Flatten each biscuit on an ungreased cookie sheet
6. Spread about 1 tbl or more of cheese mixture over each flattened biscuit round
7. Top with a bit of mozarella cheese if desired
8. Bake at 400 f for about 10 to 13 minutes or until golden brown
9. Serve warm

title: mediterranean creamy cucumber salad
steps:
1. Toss the cucumbers and the green onions with the juice of lemon , the garlic and dill
2. Add pepper to taste
3. Blend the cottage cheese with the yogurt until you have a fairly smooth consistency
4. Crumble in the feta cheese and mix well
5. Add the cheeses to the cucumbers , and mix well with two forks
6. Taste , and add salt if needed
7. Chill well for at least a few hours , until ready to serve

title: carrot and date muffins   gluten free
steps:
1. Line 12 muffin cups with paper liners or oil with natural cooking spray and set aside
2. Preheat oven to 375f
3. Place carrots and dates in the bowl of a food processor
4. Pulse and then blend until finely chopped
5. Add walnuts and pulse to finely chop
6. Transfer to a bowl
7. Add oil , eggs and maple syrup , stir to combine completely
8. In a separate bowl , combine all remaining dry ingredients
9. Pour liquid ingredients over dry ingredients and stir until just combined
10. Spoon batter into prepared muffin tins and bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center of a muffin comes out clean
11. Cool on a wire rack

title: roasted chicken and root veggies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Place washed chicken in a large baking dish
3. Toss veggies in olive oil and then place around chicken
4. Pour the chicken broth over veggies and chicken , sprinkle with the italian seasoning
5. Add seasoned salt and lemon pepper to taste
6. Lay rosemary sprigs over all
7. Bake in preheated oven for 1-1 / 2 to 2 hours , basting frequently
8. Remove the rosemary sprigs before serving

title: super skins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Cut potatoes in half lengthwise
3. Scoop out centers , leaving 1 / 4-inch-thick shells
4. Cut shells in half crosswise
5. Place shells , skin sides down , on baking sheet
6. Brush insides of shells lightly with oil
7. Bake 15 minute or until golden brown
8. Top evenly with cheez whiz , bacon bits , sour cream and onions
9. Make it easy
10. Prepare as directed , substituting frozen waffle fries or french fries for the baked potato shells
11. Bake fries as directed on pkg
12. Place on serving plate
13. Serve topped with remaining ingredients
14. Serving suggestion:
15. Serve on a bed of shredded lettuce with bowls of toppings available
16. Such as extra chopped onions , salsa , sliced olives , sliced jalapeos , diced tomatoes , sour cram , etc
17. Nutrition without extras
18. Calories 100
19. Total fat 6g saturated fat 2
20. 5g cholesterol 15mg
21. Sodium 300mg
22. Carbohydrate 9g
23. Dietary fiber 1g
24. Sugars 2g
25. Protein 3g
26. Vitamin a 2%dv
27. Vitamin c 4%dv
28. Calcium 6%dv
29. Iron 6%dv

title: copycat arctic orange shake
steps:
1. Measure the ice cream into blender and allow to thaw about 6-8 minutes
2. Add the other ingredients
3. Mix on high speed until smooth
4. Pour into a 12 ounce cup
5. Enjoy !

title: zucchini buffalo chili
steps:
1. Heat a large soup pot over medium heat
2. Add oil , onion , zucchini , squash , and garlic and saut for 5 minutes , or until soft
3. Add buffalo , cook and stir until brown
4. Add diced tomatoes , tomato paste , beans , chili powder , cumin , cayenne and salt
5. If chili is too thick , add water or beer to achieve desired consistency
6. Simmer for at least 1 hour
7. Ladle into bowls and serve piping hot
8. Garnish with cilantro and / or whatever you usually like atop your chili

title: marshmallow cheesecake
steps:
1. Grease a 9 inch spring form pan
2. Crust: melt butter and combine with crushed cookies
3. Press into prepared pan
4. Set aside
5. Filling: combine milk or cream and marshmallows in a saucepot over low heat , and melt
6. Stirring all the while
7. Remove and cool
8. Beat cream cheese and lemon juice in a large bowl
9. Blend in the cooled marshmallow / cream mixture until smooth
10. Fold in the whipped whipping cream
11. Spoon into crust
12. Chill 3 hours or until set
13. Melt chocolate if desired and drizzle over the top of cake in a pretty pattern
14. Serve
15. If desired you may fold in along with the whipping cream , some fresh cut strawberries , or fresh raspberries
16. Or fresh diced peaches , or pineapple
17. The choice is yours
18. Then spoon into the shell and chill until set
19. Serve

title: spinach saute with garlic and parmesan cheese
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a 10" skillet over medium-low heat
2. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute
3. Add the spinach , salt and pepper and toss with the olive oil and garlic until the spinach just begins to wilt
4. Remove from the skillet , sprinkle with parmesan cheese and red pepper flakes and serve

title: green bell pepper rings
steps:
1. Remove ribs from pepper rings
2. Heat oil in large skillet
3. Add garlic , black pepper and pepper rings
4. Cook , over high heat and stirring frequently , until tender-crisp-----about 5 minutes
5. Sprinkle with sea salt
6. Serve at once

title: luby s cafeteria cheese enchiladas with chili sauce
steps:
1. To make sauce , brown ground beef in a large saucepan or dutch oven along with the onions , garlic powder , salt and pepper
2. Drain meat on paper towels
3. Return meat to saucepan and add broth , tomatoes , chili powder , paprika and cumin
4. Mix well , breaking up tomatoes with a spoon
5. Bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for one hour
7. In a small bowl , mix cornstarch and water until cornstarch is completely dissolved
8. Gradually add the cornstarch mixture to the chili sauce , stirring constantly
9. Continue cooking sauce for about 5 more minutes
10. For enchiladas , heat oven to 350f
11. Heat about 1 / 2-inch vegetable oil in a small skillet , until hot but not smoking
12. Quickly fry each tortilla in hot oil to soften , about 2-4 seconds on each side
13. Drain on paper towels
14. In a large bowl , combine cheddar cheese and onions
15. Mix well
16. Spoon 1 / 3 cup cheese mixture down the center of each warm tortilla
17. Roll up and place seam side down into two 11x7-inch baking dishes
18. Top enchiladas with chili sauce
19. Cover each dish with foil
20. Bake for 10 minutes or until hot
21. Remove foil
22. Sprinkle with american cheese and continue baking 2 minutes or until cheese melts

title: country chicken dinner
steps:
1. In round 3 qt microwaveable glass casserole , combine the water , milk and maragarine
2. Microwave , uncovered , on high for 4 to 5 minutes until boiling
3. Gradually add pasta while stirring
4. Stir in contents of seasoning packet , frozen vegetables , chicken and basil
5. Microwave , uncovered , on high 14 to 15 minutes , stirring gently after 7 minutes
6. Sauce will be thin , but will thicken upon standing
7. Let stand 4 to 5 minutes or until desired consistency
8. Stir before serving

title: chicken or beef flavored brown rice using pampered chef s rice c
steps:
1. Add all the ingredients into the rice cooker plus , microwave on high for 10 minutes
2. Stir
3. Then microwave at half power for 20 minutes
4. Let sit for 5 minutes after cooking , then fluff with fork and serve

title: basic fat burning soup
steps:
1. Season with salt , pepper , curry , parsley , if desired , or bouillon , or hot sauce
2. Cut vegetables in small to medium pieces and cover with water
3. Boil fast for ten minutes
4. Cut to simmer and continue cooking until vegetables are tender
5. This soup can be eaten anytime you are hungry
6. Eat as much as you want , whenever you want
7. This soup will not add calories
8. The more you eat the more you will lose
9. Warning - if eaten alone for indefinite periods , you would suffer malnutrition
10. Day one : all fruits except bananas
11. Cantaloupe and watermelon are lower in calories than most fruits
12. Eat only the soup and fruits
13. For drinks - unsweetened tea , cranberry juice or water
14. Day two : all vegetables
15. Eat until you are stuffed with all the fresh , raw or canned vegetables
16. Try to eat green leafy veggies and stay away from dry beans , peas , and corn
17. Eat along with the soup
18. At dinner time on this day , reward yourself with a big baked potato and butter
19. Do not eat fruits
20. Day three : eat all the soup , fruits , and veggies you want
21. Do not have a baked potato
22. If you have eaten for three days , as above , and have not cheated , you will find you have lost 5 to 7 pounds
23. Day four : bananas , oranges and cantaloupe , and skim milk
24. Eat as many as 3 bananas and drink as many glasses of water as you can on this day along with the soup
25. Bananas are high in calories and carbohydrates and so is the milk , but on this particular day your body will need the potassium and carbohydrates , proteins and calcium to lessen your craving for sweets
26. Day five : beef and tomatoes
27. You may have 10-20 ounces of beef and a can of tomatoes or as many as 6 fresh tomatoes this day
28. Try to drink at least 6-8 glasses of water this day to wash away the uric acid in your body
29. Eat soup at least once this day
30. Day six : beef and veggies
31. Eat at your hearts content of the beef and vegetables this day
32. You can even have two or three steaks if you like with green leafy vegetables , but no baked potato
33. Be sure and eat the soup at least once today
34. Day seven : brown rice , unsweetened fruit juice and vegetables
35. Again stuff yourself
36. Be sure to have the soup at least once today
37. The end of the seventh day , if you have not cheated on the above diet , you will have lost 10-17 pounds
38. If you have lost more than 15 pounds , stay off the diet for two days before resuming the diet again for day one
39. Definite no-no's : bread , alcohol , no carbonated drinks including diet drinks
40. Stick with water , unsweetened tea , black coffee , unsweetened fruit juices , cranberry juice and skimmed milk
41. Because everyone's digestive system is different , this diet will affect everyone differently
42. After day three , you will have more energy than when you began if you don't cheat
43. After being on the diet for several days , you will find your bowel movements have changed-eat a cup of bran or fiber
44. Although you can have black coffee with his diet you may find that you don't need the caffeine after the third day
45. The basic fat burning soup can be eaten anytime you feel hungry
46. Eat as much as you wish
47. Remember the more you eat the more you will lose
48. No fried foods are bread
49. You can eat broiled or baked chicken instead of meat

title: blackberry silk pie
steps:
1. Add the berries and 1 / 4 cup sugar in a food processor
2. Process for 30 seconds or long enough to make a smooth puree
3. Put a mesh sieve over a large bowl and pour the puree into the sieve
4. Using a rubber spatula , push or force the puree through the mesh , leaving the seeds
5. Throw away the seeds
6. In a big mixing bowl , whisk the eggs until frothy
7. Add in 3 / 4 cup sugar and the cornstarch and whisk until well blended
8. Blend in the heavy cream , light cream , vanilla , and 1 cup puree
9. Mix until evenly blended
10. Ladle the filling into the cooled pie shell
11. Put the pie on the center oven rack and bake in a 300 oven for 50-60 minutes , rotating the pie 180 halfway through the baking
12. When done , the filling will likely have puffed somewhat
13. The center may seem a little jiggly
14. That is fine
15. If after the alloted time , the pie seems overly puffy and the center a little underdon , turn the oven off and leave the pie in the hot oven for 10-15 minutes
16. I always cover pie crust edges with foil to prevent over-browning
17. Remove the foil the last 10-15 minutes of baking time and pie crust edges will be lightly golden brown

title: spicy parmesan green beans and kale
steps:
1. Warm the olive oil in a large , heavy saute pan over medium-high heat
2. Add the onions and cook until translucent , about 4 minutes
3. Add the mushrooms , green beans , salt , and pepper and cook for 2 minutes
4. Add the wine and continue cooking until the green beans are almost tender , about 5 minutes
5. Add the red pepper flakes and the kale and continue cooking until the kale has wilted , about 4 to 5 minutes
6. Add the lemon juice and the parmesan cheese
7. Toss to coat and serve immediately

title: flax pancakes
steps:
1. Combine dry ingredients in medium bowl
2. In another bowl , beat together the eggs , cream and vanilla , then pouring it into the bowl of dry ingredients
3. Stir well and let sit for 3 minutes until it begins to bubble and thicken slightly
4. Using about 1 / 8 cup , spoon batter onto a hot , buttered griddle and let cook until some bubbles appear on the surface of the pancake
5. Carefully turn and cook the other side for just a minute
6. Serve with your favorite syrup

title: costco muffins   copycat
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Spoon into prepared muffin cups
3. Bake at 375 for approximately 20 minutes or until tops are lightly browned
4. For almond poppyseed muffins: use a white cake mix , add 2 teaspoons poppyseeds , and 1 tsp almond extract
5. For chocolate muffins: use a chocolate cake mix and stir in 1 1 / 2 cup chocolate chips
6. Create your own: use whatever flavor cake mix you want and add your own goodies
7. Other suggestions:
8. + french vanilla cake mix and fresh raspberries
9. + lemon cake mix and poppyseed
10. + spice cake mix with cinnamon / sugar topping

title: polentina with bananas and maple syrup
steps:
1. Over medium heat , in a large , heavy saucepan , combine 1 2 / 3 cups of the water and milk along with the sugar and salt
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce the heat and when the liquid is barely simmering
4. Whisk , in the same circular motion , polenta in a slow , steady stream until all the grains have been absorbed and the mixture is smooth and free of lumps
5. Reduce heat to very low and with a wooden spoon stir thoroughly every 1 to 2 minutes or until the polentina is loose and creamy , about 10 to 15 minutes
6. Add additional water and milk as necessry
7. The mixture should be very liquid
8. Ladle into individual bowls , top with the sliced bananas and drizzle with the warmed syrup
9. Drizzle with melted butter if desired

title: bone building smoothie
steps:
1. Place ice , evaporated milk , berries and / or banana , yogurt and carnation instant breakfast in blender
2. Cover
3. Blend until smooth
4. Kid-favorite variations:
5. - use 1 / 2 cup berry or apple flavor juicy juice in addition to evaporated milk and proceed as above
6. - use 2 tablespoons nestl nesquik strawberry flavor syrup in addition to carnation instant breakfast and proceed as above

title: holiday chocolate snowball cookies
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Prepare a ungreased cookie sheet
3. In a bowl , combine butter and sugar , beat at medium speed until light and fluffy
4. Add the melted chocolate , egg , vanilla and milk
5. Mix well
6. Sift together the flour , baking powder , salt and baking soda
7. Add to the creamed mixture , mix well
8. Mix in the nuts
9. Chill the dough for 1-2 hours , or until firm enough to shape into 1-inch balls
10. Place balls about 2-inches apart on prepared cookie sheet
11. Bake for 8-10 minutes , tops will be soft
12. Remove carefully from cookie sheet , roll immediately in icing sugar to thoroughly coat cookie
13. Cool on wire racks
14. Then roll again in icing sugar

title: grown up tuna  now crab  casserole
steps:
1. Pick the crab meat , removing any shell or cartilage
2. Set aside
3. Cook and drain noodles
4. Set aside
5. Preheat oven to 350
6. Lightly coat four 1-cup-capacity baking dishes or one 9 round baking dish with 1 tablespoon butter and set aside
7. Melt remaining butter in a medium skillet over medium heat
8. Add shallots and cook until soft
9. Add tomato paste and garlic and cook , stirring continuously , for 5 minutes
10. Move pan away from the heat and add brandy or chicken broth
11. Return to heat and bring mixture to a boil , whisking continuously
12. Reduce heat to medium low , add 1 cup water , and simmer until thickened slightly about 10-12 minutes
13. Strain mixture and stir in cream , remaining salt , and pepper
14. Add egg noodles , crab meat , and lemon juice and toss to coat
15. Divide mixture evenly among the prepared baking dishes , cover with foil , and bake until cooked through and the noodles are hot about 20 minutes
16. Garnish with thyme sprigs and serve immediately

title: brown sugar and spice crusted ham
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Comvine first 6 ingredients
3. Trim fat and rind from ham
4. Rub ham evenly with sugar mixture
5. Place ham on a broiler pan coated with cooking spray
6. Cover loosely with foil
7. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes
8. Combine honey and juice in a small bowl , stirring with a whisk
9. Remove foil from ham
10. Brush honey mixture over ham
11. Bake uncovered , 30 minutes longer or until meat thermometer reads 140 degrees
12. Transfer ham to platter
13. Let stand 15 minutes before slicing

title: polynesian glazed meatballs
steps:
1. Heat oil in large skillet on medium-high heat
2. Add peppers and onions
3. Cook 5 minute or until crisp-tender , stirring frequently
4. Stir in barbecue sauce , ginger , garlic powder and about 3 / 4 of the reserved pineapple liquid
5. Add meatballs
6. Mix lightly until evenly coated
7. Cook 10 minute or until meatballs are heated through , stirring occasionally
8. Add pineapple
9. Mix well
10. Serve over the hot rice

title: potatoes with indian spices
steps:
1. Slice the potatoes into half-inch rounds , then dice these further into small , evenly-sized cubes
2. Using a wok or other non-stick pan , take the minimum amount of oil needed and fry these cubed potatoes over a high heat to start with and then turn the heat down and cover
3. When the potatoes are a little more than half done , add the turmeric , chili powder and some salt , closely followed by the remaining spices
4. Stir to combine and put the lid back on once again
5. When the potatoes are nearly ready , take the lid off , turn the heat up and stir-fry to enable any excess liquid to evaporate
6. Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve

title: lemon and anise biscotti
steps:
1. Make sure there is a rack in the middle slot of the oven
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
3. Butter 1 large nonstick baking sheet & have 1 ungreased baking sheet ready
4. Toast almonds on the ungreased baking sheet for 10 minutes , or until golden brown
5. In a small skillet , toast the aniseed , shaking the pan , over medium heat for 3 minutes or until fragrant
6. Process sugar & zest in a food processor until zest is finely ground
7. In a medium bowl , whisk together the flour , coriander , baking powder & salt
8. In a medium bowl with an electric mixer , beat butter & suger mixture together , beginning on low speed & increasing to medium-high , until combined well
9. Add the eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition , then reduce the speed to low & add flour mixture & aniseed , beating just until blended
10. With a rubber spatula , stir in the almonds
11. Halve the dough & place both portions on the buttered baking sheet
12. Quickly form each piece into a 12:x1" log , & place them at least 3 inches apart on the buttered baking sheet , then smooth the 2 logs with dampened fingers
13. Bake for 35 minutes , turning the baking sheet once , or until logs are golden brown & beginning to crack on top
14. Let cool on the baking sheet for 10 minutes , then transfer logs to a cutting board & with a sharp knife , cut each log into 1 / 8-inch slices
15. Arrange slices on the same baking sheet & return to the oven
16. Bake for about 16 minutes , turning the cookies over halfway through the baking , until crisp & golden brown on both sides
17. Let cool on a wire rack , then store in an airtight container for up to 1 month

title: hillbilly soup
steps:
1. Make the farfel recipe first
2. In a bowl , combine flour , ground flaxseed and salt
3. Mix well
4. Turn out onto counter
5. Make a space in the center of the dough , break eggs into well
6. Beat eggs with a fork , slowly bringing flour and flaxseed into mixture
7. As the dough starts to thicken , use your hands to form a ball
8. Knead 2 minutes
9. Dough will be stiff
10. Coverr under a bowl for 20 minutes
11. Move onto a floured surfaceand coat mixture with flour
12. Shake off excess flour
13. While the farfel is sitting under the bowl , begin the rest of the soup recipe
14. Brown the beef
15. Drain off fat
16. Add onion , basil , oregano , and garlic and simmer about 3 minutes on low heat
17. Transfer into a large pot the meat mixture and add the chicken stock on low heat
18. Stir in the farfel , cook until done for approximately 6-8 minutes
19. Add the beans and catsup
20. Allow to simmer another 5-10 minutes
21. Transfer to bowls and serve with parmesan or swiss cheese

title: salad with garlicky flatbreads
steps:
1. Mix dressing ingredients very well
2. Pour over salad right before serving

title: fruity pecan chutney
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , over medium heat , melt butter and add green onion until soft
2. Add orange juice , water , raspberry preserves , dried fruit bits , vinegar , and crushed red pepper flakes
3. Simmer until reduced by half , about 5-7 minutes
4. Add chopped pecans and honey
5. Simmer for an additional 2-3 minutes

title: bag end brown bread
steps:
1. Blend first five ingredients in large bowl
2. Add soda and salt
3. Mix well
4. Stir in flour and nuts
5. Pour into well-greased 9" or 10" bread pan
6. Aprinkle seeds on top , as much as you like
7. Cover loosely with tin foil , shiny side up , and bake at 350 degrees for 40-50 minutes until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
8. Serve hot !

title: traditional mango chutney
steps:
1. Mango: hard , ripe , peeled , seeded and sliced
2. Place all ingredients in heavy saucepan over medium heat
3. Bring to boil
4. Lower heat and simmer for about 20 minutes , stirring frequently
5. Remove from heat , cover , and let stand for about 12 hours
6. Again bring to a boil , lower heat , and cook for 15 minutes , stirring frequently
7. Remove from heat and immediately pour into hot sterilized jars
8. Vacuum seal

title: moosewood callaloo greens stew
steps:
1. In soup pot , saute onions for a minute or two
2. Add garlic and continue sauteeing for another 2 or 3 minutes , until softened
3. Add seasonings and saute another minute , stirring to prevent spices from sticking and scorching
4. Stir in water or stock and add sweet potatoes or squash
5. Bring to a boil and simmer 5 minutes
6. If you are using callaloo , turnip greens or kale , stir it in at this time
7. Add okra and simmer another 5 minutes
8. Stir in tomatoes , lime juice , salt and spinach , if you are using it
9. Cook for another 3 or 4 minutes until all vegetables are tender
10. Add more salt or lime juice to taste
11. Serve while hot

title: ensure pancakes extra protein for cancer  care
steps:
1. In a large bowl mix dry ingredients
2. In another bowl mix remaining ingredients
3. Add wet ingredients to dry just till mixed
4. Fry on a heated buttered griddle flipping when bubbles pop

title: coconut truffles with macadamia nuts
steps:
1. Finely chop white chocolate until fine and place in a bowl
2. Pulse nuts in food processor until finely ground bring cream to a simmer in a medium skillet
3. Remove from heat and stir in rum
4. Whisk in white chocolate until melted and smooth
5. Stir in nuts
6. Pour into a 8-inch square baking pan that has been lined with plastic wrap and chill , uncovered , for about 4 hours
7. Invert onto a work surface and remove plastic wrap
8. Cut into 64 squares and roll each piece between your palms to form a ball
9. When all balls are formed , roll in coconut to cover completely
10. Store truffles covered and in the fridge until ready to serve

title: fried onion rings
steps:
1. Cut onion into 1 / 2 inch slices
2. Separate into rings
3. In a bowl , combine the flour , cornmeal , baking powder , salt , baking soda and cayenne
4. Combine the egg and buttermilk
5. Stir into dry ingredients just until moistened
6. In an electric skillet or deep-fat fryer , heat 1 inch of oil to 375
7. Dip onion rings into batter
8. Fry a few at a time for 1 to 1 1 / 2 minutes on each side or until golden brown
9. Drain on paper towels

title: spelt with sesame and bok choy
steps:
1. Preparation: in a saucepan , heat one tablespoon of the canola or corn oil over medium heat
2. Add the onion , and saut for five minutes or until the onion softens
3. Add the three cups water and a pinch of salt , and bring the water to a boil
4. Add the spelt , turn the heat to low , and cover the pan
5. Simmer for 45 minutes
6. In a small bowl , stir together the sugar , soy sauce , vinegar , three tablespoons of water , the rice wine , and cornstarch
7. About ten minutes before the spelt is done , heat a wok or large skillet with the remaining tablespoon of canola or corn oil over medium heat
8. Add the minced garlic and bok choy and turn the heat to high
9. Stir for for two to three minutes , then add the red pepper and the soy-cornstarch mixture
10. Cover the pan , turn the heat back down to medium , and simmer the vegetables for eight minutes
11. Stir the vegetables , and add the tofu and the sesame oil
12. Toss gently
13. Spoon the spelt onto the plates , then spoon the choy- tofu mixture over the grain
14. Sprinkle the plates with the chopped cashews , and serve

title: deep dish cajun chicken pot pie
steps:
1. Prepare pie crust
2. In a large saucepan , melt butter
3. Stir in flour , cajun seasoning , salt , and pepper
4. Add broth and milk
5. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbling
6. Stir chicken , mixed vegetable , and potatoes
7. Pour into deap dish pie plate or tin
8. Brush edges of dish with beaten egg to help pie crust adhere
9. Place pie crust over mixture
10. Cut to fit and crump edges all around
11. Cut steam vents in the top
12. If desired , re-roll and cut the excess pastry into strips or decorative shapes and lay over the crust
13. Brush with remaining beaten egg
14. Bake at 400f for 30 to 40 minutes until crust is browned

title: steak bites with bloody mary dipping sauce
steps:
1. Heat a small saucepan over medium heat
2. Add oil and onions and saute 5 minutes
3. Add vodka and boil to reduce by half
4. Add worcestershire , hot sauce , tomato sauce and horseradish
5. Stir to combine the dipping sauce and return the sauce to a simmer
6. Add salt and pepper and adjust seasonings
7. Heat nonstick skillet over high heat
8. Coat meat bites lightly in oil
9. Season with steak seasoning blend or salt and pepper , to taste
10. Cook the meat until caramelized all over , about 2 minutes on each side
11. Transfer dipping sauce to a small dish and place at the center of a serving platter
12. Surround the dip with meat bites and set several bamboo "stakes" or skewers alongside meat

title: crock pot braised chicken with vegetables
steps:
1. Brush the inside of a 6-quart crock pot with melted butter
2. Place the onion slices in the bottom of the crock pot / slow cooker
3. Top with potato slices , carrots and peas
4. In a bowl combine the broth , wine , garlic , 1 teaspoon seasoned or white salt , black pepper and thyme
5. Pour the mixture over the vegetables
6. In a small bowl mix together 1-1 / 2 teaspoons paprika , 1-2 teaspoons seasoned salt and black pepper to taste
7. Rub on top of the skin on the chicken
8. Arrange the chicken pieces on top of the vegetables
9. Cover and cook on low setting for about 7-8 hours , or until the chicken is tender

title: sorta healthy chocolate cake or muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oves to 350
2. It is important to not follow cake mix directions
3. Mix everything in bowl , but powdered sugar
4. Spray 9x11 pan with nonstick spray
5. Pour into pan , and bake according to cake mix pan size directions on box
6. Cool cake at room temperature
7. Dust with powdered sugar , and serve
8. You can add mix ins if you're not too worried about calories
9. Or frost with regular frosting
10. This will make a moist rich dense cake
11. I might even do this with brownies

title: pizza stuffed pizza
steps:
1. Mix the strained tomatoes with the garlic powder and salt to taste to make your pizza sauce
2. Chop the vegetables to a pizza-topping state
3. Take 2 / 3 of the pizza dough and roll it out to about 14'' in diameter
4. Spread about half the sauce mixture out evenly on the rolled out dough , leaving about 1 1 / 2 inches from the edge
5. Top the dough with the white onions , green pepper and turkey bacon , then cover with cheese
6. Roll out the remaining dough until it is about 12'' in diameter
7. Place the 12'' dough on top of the first prepared pizza
8. Take the remaining sauce and cover the top layer completely
9. Carefully fold the edges of the bottom layer over the top , sealing the bottom
10. Cut some slits into the top crust , to allow for steam to escape
11. Top the second layer with the remaining red peppers and red onions , then cover with the remaining cheese
12. Place on a pizza pan or pizza stone in a 425f preheated oven and bake for 22 minutes
13. Sprinkle cornmeal on , or grease , the pizza pan or stone to prevent from sticking

title: roasted beets with horseradish cream
steps:
1. Cut the greens from the beets , leaving about 1 inch of the stems attached
2. S
3. Crub the beets , wrap them tightly in 2 foil packages , and roast them on a baking sheet in the middle of a preheated 350f oven for 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours , or until they are tender
4. Unwrap the beets carefully , discarding any liquid that may have accumulated in the foil , and let them cool until they can be handled
5. Peel and halve the beets and cut them into 1 / 4-inch slices
6. In a small bowl stir together the crme frache , the horseradish to taste , the zest , and salt and pepper to taste
7. In a large skillet , cook the beets with salt and pepper to taste in the butter over moderately high heat , stirring , for 2 to 3 minutes , or until they are hot
8. Portion out the arugula on six plates and place the beets atop the greens
9. Top the beets with the horseradish cream and sprinkle the cream with the chives and salt and pepper to taste

title: grandma s pecan pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix all ingredients , except pecans and pie crust , together
3. Pour into unbaked pie crust
4. Top with pecan halves
5. Bake until done

title: southwestern flat iron steak fajitas
steps:
1. Put marinade ingredients and steak in a large zip-lock bag or container with lid and marinate in refrigerator overnight
2. Combine all the ingredients for each sauce
3. Pico de gallo , guacamole & cilantro cream sauce
4. Do not mash the avocados in the guacamole - leave as cubes
5. Cover and put in refrigerator
6. To prepare the fajitas , preheat grill or broiler on high
7. If you have a cast iron fajita skillet , heat it in the oven for 20 minutes
8. Place steaks on grill or on broiler pan in oven
9. Grill or broil for 8 minutes
10. Flip and continue grilling for 6 minutes for a medium rare steak
11. Slice steak across the grain
12. Meanwhile , heat olive oil in a large saut pan over high heat
13. Add onions to pan and cook 1 minute , stir constantly
14. Add peppers to pan and saut for 1 minute , stir constantly
15. Season with 1 tsp of southwest chipotle seasoning
16. Remove pan from heat
17. Place vegetables on the heated cast iron fajita platter or on a serving plate
18. Place sliced flat iron steaks on top of the vegetables
19. Serve with tortillas , pico de gallo , cilantro cream sauce and guacamole
20. Top with shredded cheese , if so desired

title: asian style cucumber salad
steps:
1. Trim ends off cucumber and cut into 1 inch chunks
2. Combine rice vinegar with soy sauce , vegetable oil , sesame oil , salt , sugar , hot chili paste and garlic
3. Mix dressing with cucumbers and serve at room temperature

title: jamaican jerk chicken nuggets
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except chicken in 9x13 deep cake pan or casserole , blending each ingredient as it is added
2. Add chicken to mixture , mixing well , making sure all pieces are well coated
3. Press chicken firmly in pan , allowing ingredient mixture to cover all pieces of chicken
4. Cover and refrigerate for up to 2-24 hours
5. Bake covered @ 375 for one hour
6. Remove cover and bake @ 400 for 30 additional minutes
7. Mix well after removing from oven , drain , and serve hot , with red beans & rice

title: involtini di pollo alla salvia  chicken roulades with sage
steps:
1. Once you have thinly pounded out your chicken breasts , cut each breast into two strips {slightly wider than your bacon slices}
2. Season chicken strips with salt and pepper
3. Place 2 sage leaves onto each strip of chicken
4. Roll chicken strips
5. Roll bacon over chicken roll and secure with toothpicks
6. Continue until all pieces are rolled
7. Into a frying pan add olive oil and heat over medium heat
8. Once oil is hot , add chicken roulades and cook , turning frequently , until bacon has brown / crisped on all sides
9. Reduce heat to low and continue cooking for approximately 10-15 minutes until chicken has cooked through {cooking time will depend on thickness of chicken}

title: absolutely addicitve kale moti biryani   lunch that s complete
steps:
1. Soak the black urad dal overnight in plenty of water
2. The following morning , drain , and replenish with fresh water
3. Add baking soda and salt
4. Boil until cooked
5. Drain
6. Keep aside
7. Wash the rice and soak for 15 minutes in water
8. Drain
9. Boil rice in 3
10. 5 cups water with salt and garam masala powder
11. Lower flame , partially cover and cook till almost done
12. Keep aside
13. Now start preparing the urad dal mixture
14. For this , heat butter / ghee in a skillet
15. Add ginger-garlic paste and stir-fry till the raw smell is gone
16. Add red chilli and turmeric powders and 3 tbsps
17. Water
18. Mix well
19. Cook for 2 minutes
20. Add the chopped green chilli and chopped tomatoes
21. Cook on low flame till the gravy becomes thick and the fat leaves the masala
22. Stir in the urad dal , allowing the gravy to coat the same
23. Sprinkle chopped corriander leaves , slit green chillies , garam masala powder , quartered tomatoes and fried onions
24. Lightly toss
25. Add rice , evenly , over the garnished urad dal mixture
26. Place a moist cloth on top
27. Cover with a tight fitting lid and seal the lid with atta dough
28. Put the sealed skillet on'dum' on low flame on your gas stove for 15-20 minutes , so as to let all the flavours blend beautifully with the rice , and the rice be cooked thoroughly well
29. Break the seal once the time is up , remove the cloth and transfer the rice to a serving dish
30. Serve hot with raita or a dollop of yogurt on top and / or a curry of your choice
31. Do not blame me if you get addicted to this

title: smucker s apricot sweet and sour pork
steps:
1. Heat oil and saut garlic
2. Add pork and stir-fry until pork is lightly browned
3. Add vinegar , preserves , and chicken broth
4. Cover tightly and simmer until pork is tender
5. Add peppers and pineapple
6. Simmer till peppers are tender-crisp
7. Stir cornstarch into water
8. Gradually add to pork , and stir until thickened
9. Serve spooned over rice

title: red wine casserole
steps:
1. In a hot pan on the stove cook the bacon until browned
2. Add carrots and cook , stirring , until lightly browned
3. Add wine and simmer until liquid is reduced by half
4. Stir in mushrooms and thawed beef base
5. Simmer , covered for 10 minutes
6. Remove the lid and simmer another 5 minutes
7. Stir in thyme and serve
8. Goes well with mashed potatoes

title: tamale pie bake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350
2. Grease a large , deep casserole pan
3. In a skillet , heat the oil over medium heat and saute the onions until they are transluscent
4. Add the garlic and cook just until you get the aroma
5. Remove from the heat , drain , and place in the prepared casserole dish
6. Set aside
7. In the same skillet on medium heat , brrown the meat , breaking up any large pieces as it cooks
8. Drain and add the met , cornmeal , milk , drained tomatoes , creamed corn , olives , salt and pepper to the onion mixture and mix the whole thing very well
9. Smooth out and sprinkle with paprika
10. Bake , uncovered , for 1 1 / 2 hours , or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean
11. To prepare the sauce , melt the butter over a medium-low heat and add the flour , whisking constantly until smooth
12. Be careful not to brown the roux
13. Make a roux of the butter and flour , being careful not to brown
14. Add the reserved liquid from the tomatoes , then add the chili powder , cayenne , cum , and salt and pepper to taste , if desired
15. The sauce should be clos to the consistency of heavy cream
16. If you need to thin it out , use tomato juice or v8 juice
17. Spoon servings of the pie onto individual dishes
18. Top with the chili sauce , or pass the sauce at the table

title: garlic and herb mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Place potatoes and water to cover in a 6-qt
2. Stockpot
3. Bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat
5. Cook , uncovered , until tender , 10-15 minutes
6. Drain potatoes
7. Return to pot
8. Mash potatoes , gradually adding cream cheese and butter
9. Stir in remaining ingredients
10. Transfer to a greased 3- or 4-qt
11. Slow cooker
12. Cook , covered , to allow flavors to blend , 2-3 hours

title: german style fried potatoes
steps:
1. Cook potatoes in large pot of boiling salted water until just tender when pierced with sharp knife , about 25 minutes
2. Drain
3. Refrigerate potatoes overnight
4. Cut potatoes into 1 / 2-inch cubes
5. Whisk oil , vinegar , and mustard in small bowl to blend for vinaigrette
6. Heat 3 tablespoons lard in each of 2 large nonstick skillets over medium-high heat
7. Add half of potatoes to each skillet
8. Sprinkle with coarse salt
9. Saut until potatoes begin to brown , stirring frequently , about 7 minutes
10. Add 3 tablespoons beer , then 1 1 / 4 cups red onions to potatoes in each skillet
11. Cook until beer evaporates , stirring occasionally , about 1 minute
12. Reduce heat to medium and saut until potatoes are brown around edges , about 5 minutes
13. Pour half of vinaigrette over potatoes in each skillet and toss to coat
14. Remove from heat
15. Season to taste with salt and pepper
16. Transfer all potatoes to large bowl
17. Sprinkle with chives

title: curry citrus chicken
steps:
1. Place the chicken in a microwave-safe dish coated with non-stick cooking spray
2. Combine the onion , juices , soy sauce , curry powder , cumin , and poultry seasoning
3. Pour over chicken
4. Cover and microwave on high for 3 minutes
5. Turn chicken over
6. Cover and microwave 2-4 minutes longer or until chicken is no longer pink and a meat thermometer reads 180 degrees
7. Remove chicken and let stand for 1-2 minutes
8. Combine cornstarch and water until smooth
9. Stir into cooking juices
10. Microwave , uncovered , on highfor 1 to 1-1 / 2 minutes or until thickened , stirring every 30 seconds
11. Serve over chicken

title: grilled molasses pork tenderloin
steps:
1. Place all ingredients into a resealable bag and marinade for 2 hours
2. Remove pork and onions from marinade and grill or broil for approximately 10-12 minutes on each side or until meat thermometer registers 160 degrees f
3. You can thicken the marinade in saucepan to serve separately , if desired

title: french vanilla banana cream pie
steps:
1. Place banana slices in crust
2. Pour milk into bowl
3. Add pudding
4. Beat with wire whisk 2 minutes
5. Gently stir in one cup of cool whip
6. Spoon into crust
7. Refrigerate 4 hours
8. Top pie with remaining cool whip

title: karen s tortellini soup
steps:
1. Remove sausage meat from casing and brown in large pot until crumbly
2. Remove meat and reserve 1 t of drippings
3. With drippings , cook onion until tender , then add broth , water , carrots , tomatoes , basil , oregano , chilies , tomato paste and cooked sausage
4. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 30- 45 minutes
5. Add zucchini , peppers , parsley , garlic and tortellini
6. Simmer for another 30- 45 minutes
7. Serve with fresh parmesan sprinkled on top if desired

title: chicken breasts and broccoli with madeira sauce
steps:
1. Blanch broccoli spears in boiling water for a few minutes
2. Drain
3. Sprinkle each side of chicken breasts with lemon juice and pepper
4. Coat each chicken breast with flour
5. In large skillet , melt butter
6. Add chicken
7. Saute 5 to 6 minutes on each side or until chicken is tender
8. Set aside
9. Using large saucepan to prevent boiling over , combine chicken broth and wine
10. Bring to a rolling boil
11. Boil over medium heat about 6 minutes or until liquid is reduced to 2 / 3 cup
12. Add cream , salt and pepper
13. Continue to boil until liquid is reduced to 1 3 / 4 cups
14. About 8-10 minutes
15. Stir in lemon juice
16. Heat oven to 375 degrees f
17. In 12x8 inch baking dish , arrange broccoli spears
18. Place chicken breasts over broccoli , overlapping if necessary
19. Pour sauce over chicken and broccoli
20. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese
21. Bake at 375 degrees f
22. For 15-20 minutes or until hot and bubbly

title: smarty pants   chicken  sausage  okra gumbo   rice
steps:
1. -----gumbo--------
2. Follow recipe on gumbo base container to mix base
3. Using water is good , but some chicken broth is better
4. Bring base to a low boil
5. This is the critical step= stir well because the base wants to stick to the bottom of the pot , while it is being fully dissolved
6. Add meat , and bring to a low boil again , lower fire and simmer for thirty minutes , stirring occasionally while scraping bottom of pot
7. Stir in okra , and bring back to a low boil for 2-3 minutes , just enough to heat the okra , then serve with cooked long grain white rice
8. -----------boiled long grain regular white rice recipe----------
9. Add salt to water and bring water to boil
10. Add rice and stir well
11. The moment you add the rice to the water , start timing for 13 minutes
12. Stir occasionally during cooking process , while scraping bottom of pot
13. After 13 minutes , stir well , then drain rice using calendar , then run some hot faucet water over the rice in the calendar
14. Serve gumbo with rice added

title: chicken and vegetable casserole with puff pastry  pot pie
steps:
1. In medium saucepan , combine broccoli , beans , corn , and celery , and add enough water to cover the vegetables
2. Cover pan , and bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat to medium-low
4. Simmer until vegetables are tender-crisp
5. Remove from heat and set aside
6. Preheat oven to 350f
7. On a lightly floured surface , roll pastry out to a 12"x8" rectangle
8. Bake for 11-15 minutes on ungreased baking sheet
9. Then set aside
10. Thin the cheese soup by mixing it with the milk
11. In large saucepan , melt butter over medium-high heat
12. Saut chicken , garlic , onion , and mushrooms until onion and mushrooms are tender , stirring constantly
13. Stir in flour and seasonings , mixing well
14. Slowly pour in the chicken stock and cheese soup
15. Cook until mixture begins to boil
16. Cook 1 minute longer , stirring constantly
17. Stir in vegetables
18. Cook until heated through
19. Pour mixture into 12"x8" casserole dish
20. Layer sliced cheese on top
21. Top with hot puff pastry
22. Bake until top is golden-brown

title: curry chicken casserole
steps:
1. Cut chicken , sprinkle with pepper
2. Saute in oil until browned , approx 6 minutes
3. Cook broccoli
4. Arrange in a buttered casserole dish - broccoli first chicken on top
5. Mix soup , mayo , curry powder , lemon juice
6. Pour on top of chicken
7. Sprinkle cheese on top
8. Bake , uncovered , at 350 degrees f , 30-35 minutes
9. Serve on top of rice

title: key west pork and pineapple casserole
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine pork slices , scallions , 2 tablespoons oil , lime juice , worcestershire sauce , ginger , sage , allspice , and red pepper flakes
2. Toss well
3. Cover with plastic wrap
4. Marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes
5. Pick pork out of marinade , reserving marinade
6. Pat pork dry with paper towels
7. Preheat oven to 350
8. Grease a shallow 2 quart casserole
9. In a skillet , heat remaining cup oil over medium heat
10. Add in pork
11. Brown on both sides
12. Transfer pork to a plate
13. Add onion and bell pepper to skillet
14. Season with salt and pepper
15. Cook / stir until softened
16. Remove pan from heat
17. Arrange pork slices in prepared casserole
18. Layer half the sauteed vegetables over the pork
19. Top with half the pineapple chunks
20. Repeat layers
21. Pour pineapple juice and reserved marinade over the top
22. Cover and bake about 50 minutes , until the pork is tender
23. May serve over hot cooked rice

title: crock pot chile verde stew  caldillo
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , except for cilantro and jalapeno peppers , in a 6 quart crock pot
2. I prefer to use yukon gold potatoes , washed and skin left on
3. Stir to thoroughly combine the ingredients
4. Cover , turn on low and cook for approximately 5 to 6 hours or until meat and potatoes are almost tender
5. Add chopped cilantro , and if more heat is desired , the jalapeno peppers
6. Continue cooking an additional 30 minutes to 1 hour
7. Serve hot with tortillas of your choice
8. This is wonderful warmed over the next day

title: quick chicken chunks  bisquick
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except chicken and oil in 2-quart resealable plastic bag
2. Mix chicken and oil
3. Shake about 6 chicken piecesat a time in a bag until coated
4. Shake off extra crumbs
5. Place chicken pieces in a single layer on microwavable rack in microwave dish
6. Cover with waxed paper
7. Microvave on high for 3 minutes
8. Turn dish 1 / 2 turn
9. Microwave 4 to 5 minutes longer or until chicken is no longer pink in center
10. Serve with ranch , barbecue or honey mustard sauce

title: chicken rice stew  2 ways
steps:
1. In a large soup pot , bring chicken broth , onions , carrots , garlic , and chicken to a boil
2. Boil until chicken is done , usually 15 mins or so depending on thickness of breasts
3. Remove chicken , dice , and set aside in a bowl
4. Add rice to broth and veggie mixture
5. Bring to a boil and boil on med-high for 5 minutes
6. Reduce heat , partially cover , simmer until rice is done
7. Usually 15 minutes
8. Add chicken
9. Stir and serve !
10. If making cambodian style ,
11. Add the fish sauce and sugar
12. Stir
13. Taste and make adjustments as needed
14. If you're new to fish sauce , remember you can always add more sugar to counteract the saltiness
15. But measure ! a little goes a long way for both ingredients here !
16. Add chicken and stir
17. Place in serving bowl , top with shrimp , cilantro , and a section of lime !
18. Enjoy !

title: tomato soup  raw foods  rose lee calabro
steps: 1. Combine in the blender and blend until smooth

title: baked stuffed garden zucchini
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Brown ground meat in skillet
3. Cut zucchini lengthwise and scoop out the"meat" inside
4. In separate skillet , add olive oil and saute garlic and onion until tender
5. Add the cut up zucchini filling and cook until softened
6. Remove from heat and add grated cheese , parsley and browned meat
7. Stuff the shell of the zucchini and bake for approximately 30 minutes

title: romantic wild rice salad
steps:
1. Cook rice according to package directions
2. You could use chicken broth instead of water
3. In a bowl whisk together vinegar , oil , mustard , honey , salt , pepper , garlic and terragon
4. As soon as the rice is done , mix it with the dressing
5. Fold in the scallions
6. Chill in the refrigerator 30-60 minutes
7. This salad tastes great when it is not too cold
8. Taste and adjust seasonings
9. Mix in half of the walnuts
10. Sprinkle rest on top
11. You could roast them first if you wanted
12. Thinnly slice strawberries and arrange them on top

title: chocolate protein balls
steps:
1. Place all ingredients into a large mixing bowl
2. Mix until all combined
3. Make mixture into balls and roll in shredded coconut
4. Refrigerate in an airtight container

title: salmon casserole with noodles
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine first 4 ingredients and mix well
3. Add salmon and corn and mix well
4. Pour mixture into a baking dish and bake , covered , for about 25 minutes
5. While it's in the oven , cook pasta and keep warm
6. Serve casserole over noodles and sprinkle with parmesan cheese

title: 1947 date nut bread
steps:
1. Combine the first three ingredients in a bowl , cover and let cool
2. Grease a loaf pan
3. Sift dry ingredients together
4. Beat sugar and egg together and add to dates , alternatively with the sifted ingredients
5. Dredge nuts in a small amount of flour and stir into batter
6. Pour into prepared pan , let rise for 20 minutes
7. While batter is rising , preheat oven to 325f
8. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes
9. Turn out onto cooling rack to cool
10. Serve sliced very thin for sandwiches , spread with cream cheese or butter

title: fruit kolacky
steps:
1. In a small bowl , dissolve yeast in warm water
2. In a large bowl , combine flour and salt , cut in butter until crumbly
3. Stir in yeast , eggs , and whipping cream
4. Turn dough onto lightly floured surface , knead until smooth , about 2-3 minutes- place in a greased bowl , turn greased side up
5. Cover , refrigerate until firm- 6 hours or overnight
6. Heat oven to 375 degrees , roll out dough , on sugared or floured surface to 1 / 8 inch thickness
7. Cut into 2 1 / 2 inch squares
8. Spoon 1 tsp
9. Of filling in center of each square
10. Bring two opposite corners to center , pinch to seal
11. Wet finger
12. Fold sealed
13. Place 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheets
14. Bake 10-15 minutes or until lightly browned

title: russian fudge
steps:
1. Put sugar and milk into a saucepan
2. Heat gently , sitrring constantly until sugar dissolves
3. Add condensed milk , butter , salt and golden syrup
4. Stir until butter has melted
5. Bring to the boil and continue boiling until the soft ball stage , stirring occasionally to prevent burning
6. Remove from heat
7. Cool slightly
8. Beat until thick
9. Pour into buttered tin
10. Mark into squares
11. Cut when cold

title: toffee delight muffins
steps:
1. Mix together all except topping
2. Beat 2 minutes
3. Using 1 / 2 of batter , pour and fill each muffin cup 1 / 3 full
4. Mix together topping
5. Sprinkle 1 / 2 of topping on muffins
6. Add remaining batter to fill each muffin cup 2 / 3 full , then put rest of topping on
7. Bake 15-20 minutes at 350 degrees

title: low carb eggplant enchilada casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Wash and peel eggplant
3. Cut eggplant into 1 / 4" pieces
4. Brush eggplant pieces with olive oil , sprinkle with salt and pepper
5. Place eggplant on baking sheets in oven for 20-30 minutes
6. Remove from oven and let cool
7. Cook ground beef in stovetop skillet with onion , salt and pepper to taste
8. Remove from skillet and drain
9. Turn oven down to 350
10. To assemble casserole , oil a 9x9 baking dish and place a layer of eggplant in the dish
11. Spread 1 / 2 the ground beef over the eggplant and spread 1 / 2 the enchilada sauce over the ground beef
12. Spread 1 / 2 the sour cream over the ground beef
13. Sprinkle 1 / 2 of cheese over the top
14. Repeat steps with remaining eggplant , ground beef , sauce , sour cream and cheese
15. Bake in 350 degree oven for 30 minutes

title: bacon and veggie skillet scramble
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in skillet over medium heat
2. Add potatoes and saute for 5 minutes
3. Add in vegetables and saute for additional 20 minutes or until potatoes are browned and crispy
4. Meanwhile , whisk the eggs vigorously with the whipping cream , baking powder , salt and pepper until very well combined
5. Let stand
6. Add in cooked bacon
7. Move vegetable and bacon mixture to cover only half of the skillet
8. Whisk eggs again briefly and then add in 1 / 2 cup cheddar cheese
9. Pour into the empty half of the skillet
10. When the eggs start to set , start to scramble and stir entire mixture together until eggs reach the desired consistency
11. Season with salt and pepper
12. Sprinkle additional cheddar cheese on top , if using and allow to melt
13. Delicious !

title: eggs florentine breakfast menu  lite bleu
steps:
1. Spray a skillet with non-stick cooking spray
2. Add spinach and onion
3. Cook until spinach is wilted
4. Meanwhile , in a small bowl , beat egg with salt and pepper
5. Add egg to skillet and cook till desired doneness
6. Serve with pita bread and a glass of milk

title: champagne martini
steps:
1. Add 1 tablespoon of raspberry puree into the bottom of each of 2 well chilled martini glasses
2. Shake vodka in a cocktail shaker filled 3 / 4 full of cracked ice and strain vodka into each glass , dividing equally and taking care not to disturb the raspberry puree
3. Gently add champagne to each glass and garnish each with a raspberry
4. Enjoy !

title: broiled garlic mussels  moules gratiees
steps:
1. Scrub the mussel under cold running water
2. Remove beards and discard any opened ones
3. Put in a pan with the wine , cover and steam for 5-8 minutes
4. Strain and reserve the cooking liquid
5. Discard any that aren't open
6. Remove the top half of each mussel shell and discard
7. Preheat the broiler
8. Melt the butter in a large skillet , saute shallots until soft , add the garlic and cook an additional 1-2 minutes
9. Add bread crumbs and saute until lightly browned , remove from heat and stir in the herbs
10. Moisten with some of the reserved liquid
11. Season to taste with salt and pepper
12. Sprinkle the crumb mixture over the mussels and arrange on baking sheet
13. Top with shredded parmesan
14. Broil in batches , for 1-2 minutes until the topping is crisp and golden
15. Keep the first batch warm while you finish the rest
16. Garnish with basil leaves and serve

title: baked rotini
steps:
1. Cook first 3 ingredients in a large skillet over medium heat , until beef is no longer pink
2. Drain and return to skillet
3. Stir in crushed tomatoes and next 7 ingredients
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat , and simmer , stirring occasionally , 20 minutes
6. Stir in rotini and cheese
7. Spoon into a lightly greased 13x9 inch baking dish
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes

title: red lentil and tomato soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan heat oil and saute onion , garlic and spices
2. Add washed lentils , water , tomatoes and soup
3. Stir together , then bring to the boil
4. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes
5. Add zucchini and salt and simmer for a further 5 minutes

title: bourbon  brandy or rum balls
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together well
2. Shape into balls
3. Roll in additional powdered sugar
4. Store in tin can

title: mommies sauteed mushrooms
steps:
1. Clean and thin slice mushrooms
2. Set aside
3. In a heavy fry pan on medium heat , melt butter and oil and saute garlic and onion for 2 minutes
4. Stir in mushrooms , parsley , salt& pepper
5. Cover and cook until the mushrooms have wilted down and released their liquid , approximately 10 minutes
6. Uncover to reduce liquid by 1 / 2 to intensify flavors
7. Add heavy cream and cook till slightly thickened
8. Adjust seasoning to taste
9. Remove from heat
10. This can be prepared ahead of time and reheated without losing the freshness
11. This dish freezes well too

title: summery one pot dish with kale  tomatoes and cheese
steps:
1. Strip leaves from tough stalks and chop
2. Discard tough stalks
3. Chop leaves and tender stalks
4. Combine prepared kale with 1-1 / 2 cups water
5. Bring to a boil
6. Add potatoes and wine
7. Simmer for 30 minutes or until very tender
8. Only a little liquid will be left
9. Using a potato masher or electric mixer , beat until potatoes and kale are thoroughly blended
10. Set aside
11. While kale and potatoes cook , melt 2 t
12. Butter or margarine in saucepan
13. When butter is lightly browned , add onions and garlic
14. Cook until onions are translucent
15. Now add tomatoes and herbs
16. Cook until tomatoes are soft
17. Taste , and add sugar , salt , and pepper to season
18. Pour into a blender and blend to obtain a medium-thick sauce
19. To assemble , butter a 2-quart ovenproof dish and layer the ingredients , beginning with the kale mixture , then tomato sauce , then cheese
20. Repeat once more and top with cheese
21. Bake in preheated 350-degree oven until hot and bubbly , about 20 minutes

title: beef on weck
steps:
1. Put approximately 1 / 4 cup of oil in skillet , season roast with salt and pepper and brown on all sides
2. Put roast in crockpot and add 1 cup of water or beef broth
3. Cook on low for 8 hours
4. Remove roast from crockpot and let rest for 5-10 minutes while making gravy
5. Place buns on a cookie sheet and brush tops with egg wash , sprinkle each with caraway seeds and coarse salt
6. Bake on 350 degrees for 3 minutes or until tops are crusty
7. Cut rolls in half and stack with meat on bottom half
8. Put 1-2 tablespoons of gravy on the meat and as much prepared horseradish as you like
9. Put tops on and enjoy !
10. Gravy: put broth in small pot and add cornstarch
11. Bring to boiling and cook until thickened keep warm

title: microwave broccoli
steps:
1. Heat butter in pan
2. Add garlic powder , salt and pepper , to taste
3. Toss broccoli in a butter garlic sauce
4. Put into a plastic sandwich bag
5. Microwave for 90 seconds

title: chicken breasts  orange stuffed
steps:
1. Place breast halves , one at a time , between plastic wrap & using a rolling pin or the flat side of a meat mallet , flatten each piece until it is about 1 / 4" thick
2. Pull off the wrap & sprinkle lightly with salt & pepper , if desired
3. In a small skillet , saute the onion in 1 tbsp of butter until tender
4. Stir in the cubed orange , raisins , 1 / 4 cup of bread crumbs & thyme
5. Spread each breast evenly with the orange & crumb mixture , then roll up each breast with the stuffing inside
6. Tuck in the ends to help seal
7. Beat together the egg & milk , then dip the rolled up breasts into the egg mixture
8. Roll each breast carefully in the 1 cup of dry bread crumbs , & place in a baking dish with high sides
9. Cover loosely & refrigerate 30 minutes or until ready to bake
10. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f , & bake for 30 minutes until golden brown , basking several times with the melted butter during the last 15 minutes of baking time

title: pecan rolls
steps:
1. Melt butter in sauce pan
2. Add brown sugar , pudding , milk , cinammon and pecans
3. Stir til well blended
4. Grease a 9 x 13 pan with vegetable spray
5. Cut each loaf into 12 slices
6. Place on bottom of pan
7. Pour all of the sauce over
8. Cover with foil and let stand overnight in refrigerator
9. Remove foil
10. Bake at 350 for 25-30 minutes
11. Turn over onto a jelly roll pan
12. Be careful , the sauce is very hot !

title: onion soup with portabella swiss cheese topping
steps:
1. Clean portabella mushrooms and remove gills by gently scraping them out with a teaspoon
2. In a skillet melt 2 tablespoons of butter and saute mushrooms until tender
3. Slice each mushroom into bite sized pieces , divide into 4 piles
4. Clean and slice onions
5. In stock pot , melt 2 tablespoons of butter and saute onions until caramelized stirring frequently
6. Add sherry , cook for 4-5 minutes on medium high heat or until you can't smell the alcohol odor anymore
7. Add beef broth , barbeque sauce , worcestershire sauce , soy sauce , basil , thyme and bring to a boil for 1 minute , then reduce to simmer for 10 minutes
8. Use 4 oven proof bowls and ladle soup into each bowl
9. Place one pile of chopped mushrooms in each soup bowl and top with 1 / 2 cup swiss cheese
10. Broil until cheese is bubbly
11. Remove from oven
12. Salt & pepper to taste
13. Enjoy !

title: sweet and sour lentils over brown rice
steps:
1. In a large pot combine lentils , water , bouillon cubes , bay and salt
2. Bring to a boil and simmer 30 minutes
3. Add remaining ingredients and cook until lentils are tender
4. Remove bay leaves
5. Serve over brown rice for a complete , delicious and healthy meal

title: spicy steamed rice with cumin and lime juice
steps:
1. Heat butter in a medium to large saucepan until melted
2. Add rice and toast for a minute or so until the butter has been absorbed
3. Add cumin , cajun seasoning , and 1 / 2 teaspoon of the lime juice
4. Continue to cook , tossing rice constantly so it does not burn , until the rice absorbs the lime juice
5. Add the remaining lime juice and the soy sauce and repeat this process
6. When all liquid has been absorbed , add the chicken broth
7. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly so rice does not stick together
8. Reduce to low , cover , and let simmer for 25-30 minutes , or until all of the chicken broth has been absorbed by the rice
9. Serve hot

title: lemon trifle
steps:
1. Combine first 3 ingredients
2. Fold in whipped topping
3. Toss cake pieces with lemon juice
4. Layer 1 / 3 of cake pieces and 1 / 3 of whipped topping mixture in 6 quart trifle bowl
5. Top with sliced strawberries
6. Layer half each of remaining cake , whipped topping mixture , blueberries , and raspberries
7. Repeat layers once
8. Sprinkle with coconut
9. Cover and chill at least 8 hours

title: simple shrimp stir fry
steps:
1. Cook pasta as directed on packaging & do not rinse
2. Meanwhile toss shrimp with cornstarch in large bowl & let stand 10mins
3. Place veggies in strainer
4. Rinse under hot water 30 sec
5. Or until thawed
6. Drain
7. Heat oil in large nonstick skillet & add shrimp and ginger
8. Stir fry 8 mins or until shrimp turns pink
9. Add vegetables , dressing & hoisin sauce
10. Cook 2 mins to heat through , stirring frequently
11. Add drained pasta and shrimp mixture to mixing bowl & mix lightly

title: patout s hot crab dip
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat
2. Add the onions , bell pepper , and garlic and saute for 10-15 minutes , until wilted
3. Stir in the cream and bring to a simmer
4. Stir in the cream and bring to a simmer
5. Stir in the green onions , parsley , herbs , and seasonings and continue to simmer until the cream has reduced by about a quarter and the sauce is thick
6. Stir in the crab meat , return to a simmer , and let cook 2-3 minutes more
7. Pour into a chafing dish and serve as an hors d'oeuvre or as part of a buffet with crackers or melba toast

title: honeyed brussels sprouts with grapes
steps:
1. Cook sprouts in boiling water for 5-8 minutes or until just tender
2. Drain
3. Season with salt and pepper
4. Melt butter and honey in a saucepan
5. Add garlic , sprouts and grapes and heat through

title: maple glazed balsamic carrots
steps:
1. In a skillet add the carrots , broth , maple syrup , butter , salt and pepper
2. Over medium-high heat , bring the mixture to a boil
3. Cover and cook 3 minutes
4. Cook for 5 minutes if you want a soft , candied-style carrot
5. Increase the heat to high
6. Uncover the skillet and cook 5-6 minutes , stirring frequently , or until the carrots are just tender and the liquid has been reduced to 2 tablespoons
7. Add in the vinegar and stir / saut 1-2 minutes or until the liquid is reduced to a glaze
8. Serve while hot

title: rio grande mudslide dessert
steps:
1. Crumble brownie and cookies into a mixing bowl
2. Add ice cream
3. Mix together
4. Place into a serving bowl
5. Drizzle chocolate and caramel sauce over the top
6. Top with whipped cream

title: aunt helen s green congealed salad
steps:
1. Dissolve jellow in boiling water
2. Add vinegar
3. Chill til thickened
4. Whip evaporated milk
5. Fold into thickened jello together with remaining ingredients
6. Turn into buttered 8 cup mold and chill til firm

title: mexican meatloaf
steps:
1. Beat eggs in large bowl
2. Add bread , bouillon , c taco sauce , meat seasoning , 1 c cheese , garlic , sausage & ground turkey
3. Mix thoroughly
4. Scoop meat onto a 12" x 20" piece of foil
5. Pack meat into a 10" x 18" rectangle
6. Cut the meat into 3 rectangles , 6" x 10" each
7. Split chili's and pat dry , lay flat on center of meat
8. Top with remaining cheese , olives & cumin seed
9. Start from long side & roll together , pinch seam to seal in cheese
10. Peel off foil & place on a greased baking sheet then brush the tops with the remaining taco sauce
11. Bake 350 degrees for 45 minutes
12. Serve warm or chilled logs may be frozen up to 3 months

title: roasted cajun potatoes
steps:
1. Cut each potato lengthwise into eight wedges
2. In a large bowl , combine the oil , shallots , garlic , salt , paprika , cayenne and pepper
3. Add potatoes and toss to coat
4. Place in greased roasting pan
5. Bake , uncovered , at 450 degrees f for 45-50 minutes or until tender and golden brown , turning every 15 minutes
6. Sprinkle with parsley

title: grand marnier cranberry sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Place cranberries in 8x8x2-inch glass baking dish
3. Sprinkle sugar , then orange juice concentrate over
4. Cover tightly with foil
5. Bake until juices form and cranberries are very soft , about 1 hour
6. Uncover
7. Mix in liqueur
8. Cover and refrigerate until very cold , about 4 hours
9. (can be prepared 3 days ahead
10. Keep chilled

title: creamy caramel microwave popcorn
steps:
1. Mix the butter , brown sugar and corn syrup in a microwaveable bowl
2. Microwave on high for two minutes
3. Stir mixture and microwave for two more minutes
4. Add 2 / 3 cup sweetened condensed milk
5. Microwave three more minutes
6. Stir in 1 / 2 tsp vanilla
7. Mix the popcorn and peanuts in a large container
8. Combine the microwave mixture with the popcorn mixture
9. Mix well
10. Store in an airtight container

title: cheryl s boursin cheese spread
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , blending until smooth and thoroughly mixed
2. Cover and refrigerate overnight to allow flavors to blend
3. Serve at room temperature with crackers

title: easy turtle cheesecake
steps:
1. Crust:
2. Mix ingredients and press into 9 x13 inch pan
3. Caramel filling:
4. Combine all ingredients in saucepan , melt and bring to a boil for 5 minutes stirring constantly
5. Remove from heat and let cool 15 minutes
6. Spread over the crumb crust
7. Sprinkle with chopped pecans
8. Chocolate layer:
9. Mix instant jello with milk
10. Add 1 cup of cool whip and cream cheese and mix until smooth
11. Pour over caramel and pecan layer
12. Top with the rest of the cool whip
13. Chill

title: classic french ratatouille
steps:
1. Rinse and dice the aubergines
2. Place in a colander , sprinkle with salt
3. After 1 hour , rinse under running water and blot dry with paper towels
4. Peel and thinly slice the onions and garlic
5. And fry lightly in olive oil , in a deep cooking pan , over medium heat
6. After a few minutes , add the diced aubergines
7. Rinse the peppers , remove the seeds and membrane and cut into fine strips
8. Add to the pan when the onions and aubergines are nicely browned
9. Add the thyme and rosemary sprigs , and season with salt and pepper
10. Peel the tomatoes and remove the seeds
11. Chop roughly
12. Rinse but do not peel the courgettes and cut into evenly sized pieces
13. Add the tomatoes and courgettes about 20 minutes after the seasoning , stir the contents of the pan and continue cooking until the vegetables have released their juices and begin to break down
14. Remove the herbs and adjust the seasoning before serving

title: soofganiyot   hanukkah doughnuts
steps:
1. Pour 1 / 2 cup lukewarm water into a small bowl
2. Sprinkle yeast on top and add 1 teaspoon sugar
3. Let stand 10 minute
4. Spoon flour into mixer bowl or another large bowl
5. Make a well in center and add remaining sugar , eggs , yolks , margarine , brandy , remaining water , and salt
6. Mix with mixer dough hook or wooden spoon until ingredients are blended
7. Add yeast mixture and mix with dough hook at low speed or with spoon until ingredients come together to a dough
8. Beat at medium speed , scraping down dough occasionally , for 5 minutes
9. Or knead by hand for 5 minutes
10. If dough is very sticky , add 2 tablespoons flour
11. Knead 5 to 10 minutes more until very smooth
12. Put dough in a clean oiled bowl and turn to coat with oil
13. Cover with a damp cloth and let rise in a warm place 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours or until doubled in volume
14. On a floured surface roll out half the dough until 1 / 4 inch thick , flouring dough occasionally
15. Using a 2 1 / 2 to 3-inch cutter , cut the dough in rounds
16. Put 1 / 2 teaspoons apricot or strawberry preserves on center of half the rounds
17. Brush rim of round lightly with water , then set a plain round on top
18. With floured fingers , press dough firmly all around to seal it
19. Transfer this "sanwich" immediately to floured tray
20. If it has stretched out to an oval , plump it gently back into a round shape
21. Continue with remaining dough
22. Cover pastries with a slightly damp cloth and let rise in a warm place about 30 minutes
23. Knead the scraps of dough , put them in a n oiled bowl , cover with a damp cloth , and let stand for about 30 minutes
24. Heat oil to 350f degrees
25. If a deep-fat thermometer is not available , heat oil until it bubbles gently around a small piece of dough added to it
26. Add 4 doughnuts or enough to fill pan without crowding
27. Fry doughnuts about 3 minutes on each side or until golden brown
28. Drain on paper towels
29. Pat tops gently with paper towels to absorb excess oil
30. Make more doughnuts with scraps if you like
31. They won't be as lights but will still be good
32. Serve warm or at room temperature , sprinkled with confectioners' sugar
33. Don't serve these immediately because the jam is boiling hot

title: scrambled eggs with dates
steps:
1. Melt the butter on med heat
2. Add the chopped dates
3. Fry for 3-5 minutes stirring often
4. Beat the eggs in a seperate bowl and add to the pan
5. Fry all ingredients until the eggs are set
6. Serve with a drizzel of honey

title: creamy fruit parfait
steps:
1. Put a small spool of pudding in the bottom of your parfait glass
2. Then add a layer of bananas
3. On top of that put a layer of berries
4. Then a layer of pudding
5. Than a layer of whipped cream
6. Continue this prosses as desired

title: outback steakhouse aussie fries copycat
steps:
1. Divide the fries into half , and use the other half later
2. Heat oil to 350 degrees
3. If you do not have a thermostat , make sure the oil is hot enough , so that when you set a french fry in there it will cook immediately
4. If the french fry sinks to the bottom , and barely bubbles , it is not hot enough
5. Fry the potatoes in small batches , they are done when they are golden brown , and float to the top of the skillet
6. I like to use a dutch oven)
7. Be sure to drain the potatoes on paper towels
8. You can keep them warm in the oven while the other fries are done
9. When all french fries are done cooking , and drained place them onto a platter
10. Salt the french fries if you like , and sprinkle on cheese and cooked bacon
11. Pop these back into a warm oven until the cheese begins to melt
12. Directions for dipping sauce:
13. Combine all ingredients and mix well

title: dixie pineapple beans
steps:
1. Combine 1 / 4 cup molasses , cinnamon , ginger , nutmeg and salt in a 1 1 / 2 quart casserole
2. Add beans , pineapple , pineapple juice , lemon juice and 1 / 4 cup of the pecans
3. Mix well
4. In cup , combine remaining pecans , 1 tablespoons molasses and butter)
5. Spoon around edge of beans
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 40-45 minutes or until beans are bubbly

title: linguine with clams  white wine   tomatoes
steps:
1. Saute' onions in oil , when half cooked , add garlic
2. Cook 1 minute , add wine and reduce by 1 / 2 , add tomatoes , chili peppers , clams parsley & oregano , adjust seasonings to taste and cook 5 minutes
3. Cook linguine in salted boiling water
4. Spoon sauce over linguine

title: stoved potatoes
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large deep frying pan
2. Add the paprika and rosemary and then the potatoes
3. Take to a high heat and stir the potatoes for 2 or 3 minutes to make sure they are coated with the spices
4. Add the stock and the whole garlic and bring to the boil
5. Cover the pan and simmer for 20 minutes
6. Take off the cover and boil rapidly until the liquid has evaporated , stirring the potatoes occasionally to ensure they don't stick
7. Once cooked they will have an almost "roasted" appearance , similar to patatas bravas - minus the fat

title: cuban pork tenderloins
steps:
1. In a bowl whisk together first 11 ingredients and transfer to a large heavy ziploc plastic bag , add in the tenderlons to the marinade
2. Close bag tightly and turn to coat
3. Place the bag in a large bowl and refrigerate for 24 hours
4. Set oven to 400 degrees
5. Transfer the tenderloins to a baking dish and discard the marinade
6. Cook for about 25 minutes
7. Let stand for 5 minutes before slicing

title: low fat banana oatmeal chocolate chip muffins
steps:
1. Add sugar to mashed bananas and mix
2. Add beaten egg and mix
3. In a separate bowl mix all dry ingredients
4. Add dry ingredients to the banana mixture and mix well
5. Mix in applesauce
6. Add chocolate chips and stir
7. Spoon into medium size muffin tin and fill 3 / 4's full
8. Bake for 20-25 minutes at 350
9. Enjoy !

title: broccoli and cheese pie
steps:
1. Combine the first 5 ingredients and press into a 9-inch pie plate
2. Place broccoli in pie plate
3. Combine milk , onion , mushrooms , salt , nutmeg and pepper in a saucepan and simmer for a few minutes
4. Stir 1 / 2 cup of this mixture into the eggs , then add eggs into the hot mixture and pour over the broccoli
5. Bake at 400f for 15 minutes , reduce heat to 375f and continue baking for another 30 to 35 minutes or until firm
6. Sprinkle final 1 / 2 cup cheese on top of pie
7. Let stand 5 minutes and serve

title: fried chinese rice
steps:
1. Cook rice according to package directions
2. In a large skillet melt butter
3. Add onions , carrots and scallions
4. Saute until carrots are translucent
5. Set aside
6. Heat oven to 350 degrees
7. Place sesame seeds in a shallow pan
8. Bake until golden brown , shaking pan occasionally for
9. Even color
10. Lightly grease another skillet
11. Beat eggs
12. Pour into hot
13. Skillet
