14. Cook as you would scrambled eggs
15. Combine rice , vegetables ,
16. Sesame seeds and eggs
17. Add soy sauce
18. Stir
19. Salt and pepper to taste
20. You can add cook chicken-pork-or beef
21. 1-cup to recipe

title: matt s cinnama cookies
steps:
1. Mix together butter and sugar
2. Mix in egg
3. Sift salt , flour , and baking powder
4. Add to mixture
5. Add vanilla
6. Chill
7. Mix filling ingredients together in seperate bowl
8. Form dough into 6-inch strips about 1 / 2 inch wide
9. Cover one side of strips with thin layer of filling
10. Roll up into a cinnamon roll shape
11. Bake at 400 degrees for 8-10 minutes or until soft yet golden brown
12. Top with homemade icing

title: cherry couscous pudding
steps:
1. Heat milk , sugar and cherries in medium saucepan over medium heat
2. Bring to simmer , remove from heat , cover and let steep for 10 minutes
3. Scrape pulp from vanilla bean and add to milk
4. Whisk to combine
5. Pour mixture over couscous in bowl and add yogurt
6. Stir to combine
7. Divide evenly among 6 custard cups , sprinkle with cinnamon and refrigerate for 1 hour

title: lemon lust dessert
steps:
1. Cut margarine into flour until it forms a crumbly dough
2. Add the nuts
3. Spread into a 9x13 ungreased pan , and cook at 350f until lightly browned
4. Cool completely
5. In a bowl: add together 8 oz
6. Cool whip with confectioners sugar , lemon peel , and cream cheese
7. Blend
8. Spread over cooled crust and refrigerate for 1 hour
9. Mix pudding with the milk until smooth
10. Spread over the refrigerated layer of cheese mix
11. Refrigerate for another hour
12. Spread remaining cool whip on dessert and garnish with chopped nuts
13. Serve !

title: vegan two ingredient waffles
steps:
1. Blend - put oatmeal , banana , and two cups of water in a blender
2. Start blending
3. Add all other ingredients while it's blending to save time
4. Sit - once everything looks rather homogenous , let the batter sit for five minutes
5. At this point , i usually start heating up my waffle maker
6. Cook - using a ladle , place two scoops into your waffle maker
7. These take longer to cook than normal waffles
8. For mine it takes about six and a half minutes
9. Enjoy - they taste great fresh , but if you're not going to eat them while they're hot i suggest popping them in the toaster for a bit just to warm them up again

title: moroccan spiced chicken and fennel
steps:
1. Combine spices with pepper and 1 / 4 teaspoon of salt
2. Season chicken to coat both sides
3. Preheat large nonstick skillet , add olive oil
4. Cook chicken breasts about 5 minutes each side
5. Remove chicken and keep warm
6. Add the fennel and onions to the pan and saute for 7 mnutes or so
7. The fennel should be tender but not mushy
8. If the pan appears to be too dry , add a tablespoon of water
9. Should be enough to moisten without steaming the vegetables
10. Boil two cups of water with 1 / 4 teaspoon of salt
11. Add couscous to water and turn off heat
12. Cover and let sit for 5 minutes
13. Fluff the grains before serving
14. Add juice , broth and the last 1 / 4 teasppon salt and bring to a boil for about 1 minute
15. Add constarch mixed in 1 tablespoon of water
16. Stir until it just begins to thicken , about 2-3 minutes
17. Add chicken and chopped fennel , cook 2 more minutes
18. Spoon coucous onto plate , with chicken and fennel and onions
19. Spoon portion of sauce on top

title: garlic cream cheese corn
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix all ingredients together in small mixing bowl
3. Pour into a greased 3 cup baking dish
4. Bake uncovered for 20-25 minutes until bubbling around edges
5. Serve hot !

title: no crust zucchini pie
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , grate zucchini
2. Set aside
3. Combine bisquick , oil , eggs and mix well
4. Add zucchini , onion , cheeses , parsley , salt and pepper
5. Pour zucchini batter into a greased 9" x 14" baking pan , then place fresh tomato slices on top
6. Sprinkle with more mozzarella before placing in oven
7. Preheat oven to 350 degrees and bake for 45 minutes
8. Center will be slightly firm to the touch and color will be light golden in color

title: chi chi s mexican pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Fry the ground beef with the water , the cumin , oregano and salt , stirring until the water has evaporated
3. Drain excess grease
4. Cool
5. Rub each tortilla on each side with a bit of vegetable oil
6. Place tortillas on a baking sheet and bake for 4 minutes
7. Remove from oven , and top with the seasoned beef , veggies , then the cheese
8. Bake for 10 minutes , or until the cheese is melted

title: ty s winter toast
steps:
1. Toast the bread slices
2. Meanwhile , combine the sugar and the pumpkin pie spice
3. Spread butter on toast slices and sprinkle with the spice mixture

title: chicken connemara
steps:
1. Saute rosemary , garlic , onion , and mushrooms in olive oil over medium heat , 3-4 minutes
2. Add chicken and saute until chicken is almost done
3. Add bacon , wine and cream
4. Continue cooking and stirring over medium-low heat until the cream is reduced to a nice smooth sauce , about 7 to 8 minutes

title: salmon fillet with fresh tomato salsa
steps:
1. Combine salsa ingredients
2. Mix well and chill
3. Sprinkle salmon with salt and pepper
4. Heat a large non-stick skillet and coat it with olive oil
5. Saute salmon fillet , skin side up , until lightly browned
6. Turn fillet , cover , and cook over medium heat until it is opaque throughout
7. Cut fillet diagonally into 4 slices
8. Serve with tomato salsa

title: tomatoes crunchy  juicy  sweet    bursting tomato
steps:
1. Mix egg and water together
2. Set aside
3. Mix parmesan cheese an flour together set aside
4. Mix breadcrumbs and seasoning together set aside
5. Dust each sliced tomato with flour dip into egg mixture then into breadcrumbs mixture
6. Don`t worry if it doesn`t adhere to the sides
7. Place breaded tomatoes into refrigerator for one hour this help the breading adhere to the tomatoes
8. In a large fry pan heat oil over medium heat
9. Saute onions and garlic till translucent
10. Remove from pan leaving as much of the flavored oil as you can
11. Add more oil to just cover bottom of pan{if necessary} add breaded tomatoes to hot oil brown on each side
12. Just a couple of minutes per side
13. Remove to plate lined with paper towels
14. Plate on a couple basil leaves on a serving plate top with 3 tomatoes
15. Layering with 1 / 3 crumbled goat cheese and 1 / 3 sauteed onion and garlic mixture
16. Repeat 2 more times and serve

title: wintery white clusters
steps:
1. Place baking chips in freezer to chill
2. In large bowl , mix cereal , peanuts , pretzels and marshmallows
3. Set aside
4. In large microwavable bowl , microwave candy coating uncovered in high 1 minute 30 seconds
5. Stir , breaking up large chunks
6. Microwave about 30 seconds longer or until coating can be stirred smooth
7. Gently and quickly stir cereal mixture into coating with rubber spatula , stirring gently until evenly coated
8. Stir in chilled baking chips
9. Spread on waxed paper until cooled
10. Break into chunks
11. Store in airtight container in refrigerator

title: swedish leg of lamb
steps:
1. Make small slits in the lamb and insert the garlic slivers
2. Mix the salt and dry mustard and rub it into the meat
3. Bake the lamb at 350 degrees f
4. For 1 hour and then baste with a mixture of the coffee , sugar , the 4 tablespoons of cream , and the brandy
5. Bake another 2 to 2 1 / 2 hours , to your liking
6. To make the gravy , scrape the drippings from the roasting pan
7. Add flour , 1 cup of cream and the currant jelly and blend

title: grilled chili lime corn
steps:
1. Heat grill to medium
2. Pull husk and silk completely off corn
3. Melt butter and stir in chili powder and juice from 2 1 / 2 of the limes - mix well
4. Grill corn right on the bbq until soft and nicely browned
5. Start basting about 10 minnutes in , then baste often until finished cooking
6. When done , remove from grill to a bowl or platter , squeeze the last half lime on top and sprinkle lightly with kosher salt

title: moroccan eggplant salad
steps:
1. Toast cumin a a dry 10 inch heavy skillet over med heat , stirring occasionally , until fragrant and dark brown
2. Cool , then grind to a powder in a spice grinder
3. Pan roast whole eggplant in skillet over med heat , turning frequently with tongs until blackened and tender , 20 to 30 minutes
4. Transfer to a cutting board and cut off and discard stem
5. Scrape flesh from skin and coarsely chop
6. Toss with onion , vinegar , sugar , 1 tbls oil , 1 tbls of parsley , 1 / 2 tsp toasted cumin and 1 / 2 tsp salt
7. Serve in a shallow bowl drizzled with remaining tbls oil and sprinkled with remaining tbls of parsley and toasted cumin
8. Serve with toasted pitas

title: pickled ginger for sushi
steps:
1. Peel the ginger and slice it as thin as humanly possible
2. Rub the sliced ginger with the coarse salt until you do not feel the graininess of the salt
3. Place ginger in a mixing bowl and refrigerate for several hours
4. After ginger has sat for several hours , take it out and squeeze out as much liquid as possible
5. Put ginger in a clean jar
6. Put the vinegar , water , food coloring , and sugar in a small sauce pan and bring to a simmer
7. Stir until the sugar is dissolved
8. Pour over ginger and allow to cool slightly
9. Seal the jar and allow to"cure" in the refrigerator for at least 3 days

title: low fat jambalaya
steps:
1. Heat oil in a skillet and saute the onions , green pepper , celery& garlic
2. Cook until the veggies start to soften about 4 minutes add kielbasa , cook 2 minutes
3. Add all the remaining ingredients except scallops& parsley
4. Bring to a boil , simmer for 15 minutes
5. Stir occasionally or until the rice is cooked
6. Stir in the scallops& parsley cook for a further 3-5 minutes do not overcook the scallops

title: bourbon dogs
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in baking dish
2. Place in 300-degree f oven for 25 minutes
3. Serve on hot plate or in chafing dish with toothpicks to spear the dogs

title: stir fried beef with basil
steps:
1. Heat the oil in or skillet over medium heat until hot and stir-fry 1 / 2 of the basil leaves for 2 to 3 minutes until crispy
2. Remove and drain on paper towels
3. Set aside
4. In the same pan , heat the leftover oil over medium heat and stir-fry the garlic , shallots and chillies for 2 to 3 minutes
5. Add the beef and stir-fry for 2 to 3 minutes until just cooked
6. Add the green beans and ginger , and season with the fish sauce , oyster sauce and sugar
7. Continue to stir-fry for another 2 to 3 minutes until the green beans are tender and cooked
8. Stir in the remaining basil leaves and remove from the heat
9. Transfer to a serving platter , garnish with cashew nuts and the reserved crispy fried basil leaves , and serve hot with steamed rice

title: seared salmon with horseradish tomato vinaigrette
steps:
1. Season the salmon fillets with salt and pepper
2. Heat oil in a saute pan
3. Sear salmon on both sides for 1 to 2 minutes until golden brown
4. Fish should still be raw in the center
5. Combine the horseradish , bread crumbs , butter , rosemary , tarragon , thyme
6. Salt and pepper
7. Add the white wine and mix to paste
8. Spread the top of the salmon with equal amounts of the bread crumbs
9. Place fillets on an oiled sheet tray
10. Place tray in a preheated 375-degree oven
11. Bake for 5 to 7 minutes until the fish is cooked through and the crust is golden brown
12. Serve with horseradish-tomato vinaigrette
13. : combine horseradish , honey , vinegar , tomatoes , tomato paste , dijon mustard , black peppercorns and tarragon in a blender
14. Blend until smooth
15. While blender is running add oil in a thin steady stream until well mixed and thick
16. Cover and leave at room temperature
17. Makes 9 oz

title: chinese radishes
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Chill thoroughly

title: patty cakes   egg  dairy  gluten  nut and soy free
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c
2. Line 12 hole muffin trays or patty pans with paper cases
3. Beat the margarine and sugar together using an electric mixer until light and fluffy
4. Add the eggs or the eg replacer
5. Beat well
6. Sift the dry ingredients into a seerate large bowl
7. Fold the dry ingredients into the margarine alternately with the rice or soy milk
8. Spoon the mixture evenly into the patty cases and bake for 15-20 minutes , or until just cooked
9. Allow to cool in trays 10 minutes before moving to a wire rack to cool
10. Dust with the icing sugar or ice with a suitable icing or frosting

title: new orleans spinach garlic bread
steps:
1. Cook spinach according to package
2. Drain and pat dry , removing as much liquid as possible
3. Melt cream cheese and garlic cheese over a low fire or in microwave
4. Stir and blend into spinach , adding seasoning
5. Cut french bread loaf in half , length-wise
6. Place open-faced on a cookie sheet
7. Spread with spinach / cheese mixture
8. Cover with mozzarella and bake for 10 minutes , or until cheese is melted and bubbly , in a preheated 325 oven

title: make ahead mashed smashed potatoes
steps:
1. Scrub the potatoes while bringing a large pot of water to a boil on the stove
2. If you don't like the skins in your mashed potatoes , you can also peel them at this point if you would like
3. Add potatoes and simmer 30 minutes , or until potatoes are soft and ready to be mashed
4. Mash the potatoes and season with salt and pepper
5. Add the cream cheese and sour cream and mix well
6. Sprinkle with any other herbs , spices , or seasonings you like
7. Final decision-- if you like your potatoes more on the smashed / chunky side , enjoy
8. If you want them smooth and completely mashed , then use mixer to whip them to your desired consistency
9. When ready , bring to room temperature , tent with foil , and reheat in 350-375 degree oven until hot , about 40 minutes
10. Reportedly , it can also be reheated in microwave or crockpot , but we have only ever tried it in the oven , so if you use another method , would love to hear how it works out

title: velveeta chicken
steps:
1. Prepare stuffing according to box and set aside
2. Combine soup , cheese and milk in saucepan
3. Cook over low heat until cheese is melted , stirring constantly
4. Layer in 9x13 casserole dish chicken first then pour cheese over that and cover the top with the stuffing
5. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes

title: simple simon maple salmon
steps:
1. Cut salmon into serving-sized pieces , crosswise , about 3 inches wide or however you prefer
2. In small bowl , whisk rest of ingredients until well mixed
3. Put salmon pieces and maple mixture into a shallow dish or ziploc baggie to marinate
4. Refrigerate while marinating
5. I only got to marinate mine for about 5 hours , but next time , i'm going to marinate them overnight
6. Still good , but overnight would be even better !
7. When ready to cook , remove from fridge , and remove salmon pieces from baggie saving the marinade
8. Place salmon into a greased / sprayed shallow baking dish , skin-side down
9. Pour / spoon just a little marinade over each piece and pop into a pre-heated 375 degree oven
10. Pour the rest of the marinade into a small saucepan and bring to a boil
11. Reduce heat a tad , but keep at a nice steady boil , and stir occaisionally
12. Bake salmon for 30-35 minutes , depending on thickness , til done and flakes easily with a fork
13. Halfway through baking the fish , carefully spoon a little more marinade over the fish
14. Not from the saucepan , but what's in the baking dish
15. Keep the marinade in the saucepan boiling to reduce til thickened
16. When fish is done , remove from oven and baste with juices again while you get everything else done and ready
17. If adding pecans , stir into saucepan of reduced marinade just before serving , or sprinkle on top of fish during last 1-2 minutes of baking
18. 2-3 minutes if wanting to do pecan halves
19. Plate the fish and pour your thickened sauce over the top
20. We had this with my buttery herbed rice and what a great dinner ! nothing else was even needed !

title: tamale sauce
steps:
1. Cook and dice potatoes mix all ingredients together
2. Start with 3 or 4 peppers and just 1-2 tsp of juice
3. Then add more to taste
4. But let sit at least 20-30 minutes so you can tell how hot it is !

title: asian style kale
steps:
1. Set a lidded 6 - 8 quart saucepan of water , salted with 2 t salt , on stove to boil
2. Wash the kale thoroughly to remove all grit
3. Discard the tough ribs , and coarsely chop the kale leaves
4. Plunge the kale into boiling water and cook for 3 to 4 minutes & then drain
5. In a large skillet or heavy wok , heat the sesame oil over medium heat
6. Add the shallot , garlic , scallions and ginger root and cook for about 1 minute to release the aromas
7. Add the kale a bunch at a time and cook 3 to 4 minutes , or until the leaves have softened a bit but the kale retains its shape
8. Remove from heat and add the soy sauce
9. Divide among individual plates , sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds , if using , and serve hot

title: unbelievable mushrooms
steps:
1. Melt butter in iron skillet
2. Saute' onions
3. Add remaining ingredients
4. Simmer until done
5. Should be fairly dark in color now
6. Add more water if needed
7. Add vodka and stir -- simmer 3 more minutes
8. Serve as side dish -- especially steak
9. You can add to this recipe depending on amount of people and your enjoyment

title: grilled lemon and rosemary chicken
steps:
1. Prepare barbecue on medium-high heat
2. Place chicken in glass baking dish
3. Pour 1 / 2 cup dressing over chicken
4. Sprinkle with rosemary
5. Turn to coat
6. Let marinate at least 10 minutes and up to 2 hours
7. Remove chicken from marinade and place on grill rack
8. Dip lemon rounds into remaining 1 / 4 cup dressing and place on edge of rack
9. Grill chicken until cooked through and grill lemon until slightly charred , turning occasionally
10. Transfer chicken to plates
11. Top with lemon rounds and serve

title: my favorite apple pie
steps:
1. Place peeled and sliced apples in a large bowl
2. Mix all the rest of the ingredients with the apples
3. Place mixture into an unbaked pastry crust
4. Top with remaining pastry crust
5. Bake at 375 degrees for 40-45 minutes

title: pasta salad with grilled vegetables
steps:
1. Whisk dressing ingredients in a large bowl
2. Stir in tomatoes and let stand at least 20 minutes to extract juices
3. Meanwhile heat barbecue grill , ridged cast-iron grill pan or broiler
4. Spray vegetables with cooking spray
5. Grill or broil , turning as needed , until slightly charred and tender: peppers 16 to 18 minutes
6. Squashes 13 to 15 minutes
7. Onions 10 to 12 minutes
8. Remove to a cutting board
9. Cut peppers in 1 / 2-inch-wide strips , squashes in bite-size chunks and separate onion slices into rings
10. Add to bowl along with pasta
11. Toss to mix and coat
12. Serve at room temperature

title: chocolate crackles
steps:
1. Melt chocolate chips in a microwave safe bowl on medium for 2 minutes
2. Stir until smooth
3. Combine with brown sugar , oil and vanilla in medium bowl
4. Mix well
5. Add eggs , one at a time , mixing well after each addition
6. Stir in flour , cocoa , baking powder and salt
7. Cover and refrigerate about 3 hours
8. Heat oven to 350f
9. Lightly spray a baking sheet with no-stick cooking spray
10. Place powdered sugar in shallow dish or large resealable food storage bag
11. Shape dough into 1-inch balls
12. Roll in powdered sugar or add to bag and shake to coat
13. Place about 2 inches apart on prepared baking sheet
14. Bake 10 minutes , or until almost no indentation remains when touched lightly
15. Cool on wire rack

title: oysters mornay
steps:
1. Prep time is for oysters already halved
2. Heat milk in a pan , when hot , mix a little water with cornflour , add to milk and stir until mixture thickens , it should be quite a thick consistency
3. Add gruyere and 2 tablespoons parmesan stir until cheese has melted
4. Pour rock salt into an oven proof dish enough to cover the bottom , helps oysters to sit evenly , place oysters in dish , spoon sauce over oysters to cover , sprinkle remaining parmesan cheese over each oyster
5. Grill oysters until browned and bubbling

title: sea breezes
steps:
1. Put ice in pitcher
2. Pour in juices and vodka
3. Mix and serve over more ice if desired

title: low fat southwestern layered salad
steps:
1. Combine ranch dressing and salsa
2. Set aside
3. In large bowl , layer the romaine
4. Mix carrots , black beans , corn , red onion , tomato and cheese
5. Top with crushed tortilla chips before serving

title: roasted   caramelized apricots w greek yogurt   lemon
steps:
1. Heat the oven broiler
2. Mix sugars together in a sml bowl
3. Halve the apricots & discard pits
4. Arrange fruit in an oven-proof skillet or on a baking sheet
5. Broil until light golden
6. Remove from oven & turn the apricots over
7. Sprinkle sugar combo evenly over ea apricot half
8. Broil until centers are bubbly & beginning to caramelize
9. Divide apricot halves between 4 serving plates
10. Whisk yogurt , 1 tablespoons sugar & 1 tsp lemon zest together in a sml bowl
11. Spoon a little yogurt over ea apricot half
12. Sprinkle w / a little brown sugar & extra lemon zest for garnish

title: lighter oven fried pork chops
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Rinse pork chops under cold water and pat dry with paper towels
3. In a small bowl , combine mayonnaise and lemon juice
4. Whisk until smooth
5. Place dry ingredients in a shallow dish and stir
6. Lightly brush the pork chops with the lemon and mayonnaise mixture
7. Place in crumb mixture and coat evenly
8. Arrange chops on baking pan that has been lightly coated with canola oil spray
9. Bake on top rack of oven 20 to 25 minutes or until done
10. I carefully turned my chops over to brown the other side

title: ratatouille polenta bake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Spray 12-inch nonstick skillet with cooking spray
3. Heat over medium-high heat
4. Cook onion and bell pepper in skillet 2 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Stir in eggplant , zucchini , salt and pepper
6. Cook 3 to 4 minutes , stirring occasionally , until vegetables are tender
7. Stir in tomatoes , breaking up with spoon
8. Reduce heat to low
9. Cook 3 minutes , stirring occasionally
10. Spray rectangular baking dish , 11x7x1 1 / 2 inches , with cooking spray
11. Cut polenta into 1 / 4-inch slices
12. Arrange slices on bottom of dish , overlapping and cutting to fit where necessary
13. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese
14. Spoon vegetable mixture evenly over top
15. Cover and bake 30 minutes
16. Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese and parsley
17. Bake uncovered about 15 minutes or until cheese is melted and casserole is bubbly
18. Let stand 5 minutes before serving

title: rosenmunnar
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy
3. Add sifted flour , and mix well
4. Shape dough into 1 inch diameter balls and place on cookie sheets
5. Imprint your thumb in the center to make a 1 / 2 inch indentation
6. Fill with your favorite preserves
7. Bake 10 to 15 minutes or until golden brown at the edges

title: cheesy stuffed chicken in phyllo
steps:
1. Place chicken between 2 sheets of heavy-duty plastic wrap , and flatten to 1 / 8-inch thickness using a meat mallet or rolling pin
2. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
3. Set aside
4. In a large skillet over medium-high heat saut spinach and onion for 3-4 minutes , or until onion is tender
5. Remove from heat and stir in the cream cheese until blended
6. Add in the mozzarella cheese and the next 6 ingredients
7. Stir to combine
8. Spoon 1 / 4 cup of the spinach mixture on the center of each chicken breast , and roll up jellyroll fashion
9. Unfold the phyllo sheets on a lightly floured surface
10. Stack 2 phyllo sheets , brushing with melted butter between sheets
11. Place 1 chicken roll on short side of the phyllo stack and gently roll up , folding in long side
12. Repeat procedure with remaining pastry , melted butter and chicken
13. Place the rolls in a greased shallow baking dish / pan , and brush the chicken rolls with melted butter
14. Bake in a 350 oven for 35-40 minutes , or until done

title: mustard wrap
steps:
1. Mix:cream cheese , garlic , ranch , enough mustard to add color and to make it creamy
2. Take tortilla's and take the cream cheese mix and spread the entire tortilla
3. Lay down lettuce
4. Put carrots on lettuce
5. Sprinkle with bacon bits add onions put on your cheese
6. Lay down the meat , put on heavy or light next roll your tortilla wrap it on the bottom so the stuffing dosen't come out
7. I like to also wrap it with foil at the bottom and peel it as i get towards the bottom

title: grilled peach and goat cheese crostini
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees , or medium heat for the grill
2. Brush 2 tablespoons of the olive oil on the bread slices , and toast or grill until golden brown , about 4 minutes per side
3. Toss the remaining tablespoon of olive oil with the peach slices , the lemon juice , a pinch of salt , and pepper , string the slices on 2 or 3 skewers
4. Grill the peaches over a medium flame until slightly charred
5. Remove from the skewers and toss with the shallots
6. Spread the goat cheese on the toasted bread and top with 2 to 3 peach slices and a marjoram sprig
7. Serve warm

title: almond crusted shrimp
steps:
1. Stir together almonds , flour , parsley , seafood seasoning , salt and pepper
2. Dip each shrimp into egg white , then into almond mixture
3. Lay on baking sheet or platter until ready to cook
4. Preheat 1 tablespoon oil in large skillet over medium heat
5. Cook shrimp in skillet in batches , cooking 3 to 4 minutes until golden
6. Use remaining oil as necessary
7. Serve immediately , accompanied by lemon wedges , if desired

title: sweet petite tuna melt peppers
steps:
1. Preheat oven 350 degrees , cut and clean peppers , cut in half lengthwise
2. Mix the remaining ingredients into a bowl
3. Spoon tuna salad onto pepper halves , should make 12 with possibly some left over
4. Take 1 tablespoons of cheese and sprinkle over each tuna pepper
5. Bake in oven for 10 minutes or until cheese has completely melted
6. Serve on devilled egg platter , add olives or mixed greens in center for decoration if you like , not required for this dish

title: curried cauliflower and cashew casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 and grease a 1
2. 5 qt casserole dish
3. Microwave cauliflower with water and nuke for 4 minutes
4. Drain
5. You could also steam the cauliflower if you choose
6. In a small saucepan , melt 2 tbs of the butter
7. Stir in flour and curry and cook for about 2 minutes
8. It will make a thick paste
9. Whisk in milk and cook a few minutes , whisking periodically until the lumps disappear and the sauce starts to thicken
10. Season with salt and pepper
11. Put cauliflower in casserole and toss with cashews
12. Stir in milk mixture to coat
13. Sprinkle top with breadcrumbs and dot with the remaining butter
14. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes
15. Garnish with more cashews if desired

title: cabernet chocolate cake with strawberries
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease and lightly flour cake pan
3. Mix eggs and mayo with electric mixer until smooth
4. Add wine and beat until combined
5. Add cake mix , salt and vanilla and beat for 3 minutes
6. Pour into pan and bake according to box directions , but check 5-10 minute early as this cake tends to bake "fast"
7. When cake is almost cool make glaze as follows:
8. Melt chocolate chips in microwave or double boiler being careful not to burn
9. If microwaving , start with about 45 sec
10. , stir and continue in 10 sec
11. Increments
12. , stirring after each
13. Whisk in butter , cream , salt and vanilla one at a time
14. Cool slightly , then drizzle over cake
15. Arrange strawberries whole or sliced , whatever looks pretty to you , over and around the cake and drizzle a bit more chocolate over them if you like
16. The glaze and berries are a good combination on their own ! dust with powdered sugar if desired

title: chef allen s red hot key lime chicken
steps:
1. In a glass dish , marinate the chicken with the key lime mojo for 1 hour
2. Preheat a large pan over medium heat
3. Remove the chicken from the marinate and pat dry with toweling paper
4. Add the oil to the pan and add the chicken in batches browning both sides for 4-5 minutes each
5. Add the onion , garlic , ginger , scotch bonnet and remaining marinate to the pan
6. Simmer for 20 minutes over medium heat , until the chicken is tender
7. Season with salt and add the cilantro to finish

title: chicken and spinach noodles
steps:
1. In a dutch oven , bring carrots and chicken stock to a boil over high heat
2. Reduce heat and simmer until carrots are tender , about 5 minutes
3. Remove carrots from stock
4. In a blender , combine cottage cheese and lemon juice and blend until smooth , about 1 minute
5. Add warm stock to the cottage mixture
6. Blend 1 more minute
7. Combine cheese mixture and carrots , stir in chicken and cooked noodles
8. Sprinkle with pepper
9. Simmer , uncovered , about 20 minutes

title: chili queso real copycat chili s restaurant version bytodd wilbu
steps:
1. Cut the velveeta into cubes
2. Combine the cheese with the remaining ingredients in medium sauce pan over medium heat
3. Stir frequently until cheese melts then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes
4. Serve with hot tortilla chips for dipping

title: mexican ground beef tortilla layer casserole
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease an 11 x 7-inch baking dish
3. In a large skillet brown the ground beef with onion , garlic , green bell pepper and jalapeno until the beef is no longer pink
4. Drain any fat then return to skillet and add in one can of enchilada sauce , black beans , corn and cumin
5. Bring the ground beef mixture to a boil
6. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 20-25 minutes stirring occasionally , then season with salt and lots of black pepper
7. Arrange 3 corn tortillas in the bottom of the baking dish , cutting as needed to cover bottom of the dish
8. Spread 1 / 4 cup canned enchilada sauce over the tortillas in the baking dish
9. Cover the sauce with 1 / 3 of the cooked ground beef mixture , then about 1 / 3 of the shredded cheese
10. Repeat the layers twice but omitting the final cheese layer on top
11. Drizzle any remaining canned enchilada sauce on top
12. Cover with foil and bake in a 350 degree f oven for 25 minutes
13. Remove foil and sprinkle with more cheese then return to oven and bake for another 5 minutes or until the cheese has melted
14. Let stand 10-15 minutes before slicing
15. Top with sour cream and / or tomatoes , green onions and crushed tortilla chips if desired
16. Delicious !

title: delicious sweet tea
steps:
1. Bring four cups of water to a mild-moderate boil
2. Remove heat as soon as bubbles approach the surface of the water
3. Pour boiling water over tea bags in a glass pitcher
4. Let steep 1 hour
5. Remove bags and squeeze them on their way out
6. Be careful not to tear them
7. Add sugar to taste
8. Stir until dissolved
9. Add two cups of cold water
10. Stir well
11. Chill & serve !

title: french crepes
steps:
1. Put the flour and salt in a bowl
2. Make a well
3. Pour in the slightly beaten eggs into the well
4. Stir with a fork until mixed
5. Stir in the rum
6. Add the milk slowly , stirring constantly with a fork
7. The batter should be smooth , so any lumps need to the broken up and blended inches let the batter sit for 30 minutes before proceeding
8. Brush a crepe or heavy frying pan with melted butter
9. When the pan is hot , pour in just enough batter to thinly cover the bottom of the pan
10. Tilt the pan so the base is completely covered with batter
11. Cook crepe until golden on the bottom
12. Flip with a metal spatula , and cook until the second side is golden
13. Transfer crepe to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm
14. Repeat the cooking process until the batter is used
15. Unfilled crepes can be well wrapped and frozen
16. The recipe can be halved , but then use only two eggs

title: sunshine fruit salad
steps:
1. Drain pineapple juice into your serving bowl
2. Whisk the pudding into the juice until it thickens
3. Fold pineapple and oranges into pudding
4. Chill
5. Don't be afraid to experiment with different fruit

title: green beans with caramelized shallots and bacon
steps:
1. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat
2. Add evoo and chopped bacon and cook until crisp , about 10-12 minutes
3. Remove from pan to a paper towel-lined plate
4. Add sliced shallots to the pan and cook in the bacon drippings until caramelized , about 10 minutes
5. Add the green beans and chicken stock to the pan
6. Cook until desired tenderness , about 5 minutes
7. Toss with cooked bacon and salt and pepper

title: cajun popcorn spice
steps:
1. Chef's
2. If you are in the slightest bit timid , start with 1 / 2 teaspoon , blend and add more if desired
3. Mix all spices together in spice grinder or mini processor
4. Pulse quickly to mix spices and to break up the leaves of the herbs
5. Sprinkle on popcorn to taste
6. Hot stuff !

title: toffee rum cake
steps:
1. Combine the 1 / 2 c sugar and water in a saucepan and heat until it begins to simmer
2. Simmer for 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
3. While the sugar and water are simmering , put the cake on the serving platter and make holes 1" apart all through the cake with a wooden skewer
4. Remove the syrup made with the sugar and water from the heat and add in the rum
5. Stir well to combine and slowly pour the hot syrup over the cake
6. Chill the cake for 2 hours
7. Whip the heavy whipping cream and the 2 t sugar until stiff peaks form
8. Stir in the vanilla extract
9. Frost the top and sides of the cooled cake
10. Coarsely chop the toffee and sprinkle on top of the cake to garnish
11. Chill from 2 - 12 hours before serving

title: greek style tomato and onion salad
steps:
1. Cut tomatoes into wedges , slice the onion very fine , add to the tomatoes
2. Place in a shallow dish , add the vinegar , oil and oregano , sir to mix well , cover and leave for a few hours
3. Giving a sprinkle of salt before serving
4. With other salads at either a bbq or with lasagna , steak or lamb

title: vietnamese omelette
steps:
1. Place mushrooms in small heatproof bowl , cover with boiling water
2. Stand for 20 minutes
3. Drain
4. Discard stems , slice capsicums thinly
5. Meanwhile , whisk eggs , milk and mint in a medium bowl until combined
6. Heat half of the oil in medium frying pan
7. Cook onion , garlic and bamboo shoots , stirring until onion softens
8. Add carrot and capsicum
9. Cook , stirring , until carrot is just tender
10. Add mushrooms , sprouts , sauces and coriander
11. Cook , stirring , until heated through
12. Remove from pan
13. Keep warm
14. Heat remaining oil in pan
15. Add a quarter of the egg mixture
16. Cook over medium heat , tilting pan , until egg mixture is almost set
17. Place a quarter of the vegetable mixture evenly over half of the omelette
18. Fold omelette over to enclose filling , slide onto serving place
19. Repeat with remaining egg and vegetable mixtures

title: lobster   mango sandwiches
steps:
1. Brush honey over pancetta slices , heat a skillet over fairly high heat , add a tiny drop of oil and cook pancetta just a few seconds on each side until it gets crispy , drain on paper towels
2. Combine lobster , mango , cucumbers , mayo , salt and pepper to taste
3. In another bowl , mix together lettuce , sun dried tomatoes , and basil
4. Grab some long toothpicks and 2 plates -- you will be stacking 2 sandwiches
5. Spread a little extra mayo on 2 of the toast slices , then top each with the lobster mixture , another piece of toast on top of that , then the lettuce mixture , the pancetta , then the remaining toast pieces
6. Stick 2 long toothpicks into each sandwiches to hold them together , then use a serrated knife to cut each sandwich into halves
7. Remove toothpicks before eating

title: asian hoisin pork ribs
steps:
1. Combine the hoisin sauce , honey , oil , rice wine vinegar , garlic and black pepper in bowl
2. Cut the ribs into serving size pieces and place in extra large heavy plastic resealable bag , pour the sauce over the ribs
3. Seal the bag and place in a large bowl , refrigerate overnight
4. Set oven to broiler heat
5. Line a large baking sheet with heavy foil
6. Arrange the ribs bone side down on the foil
7. Transfer the marinade to a small saucepan and boil for about 7-8 minutes or until thick
8. Brush the ribs with the marinade
9. Broil for 4 minutes
10. Turn the ribs over and baste generously with marinade
11. Return to oven for another 4 minutes
12. After 4 minutes remove the ribs , turn over and baste again
13. Set the oven to 350 degrees
14. Bake the ribs for about 40 minutes or until cooked through
15. Sprinkle lightly with sesame seeds then serve

title: hawaiian wraps rollups
steps:
1. Wash tomato and slice thinly
2. Place tortillas on microwave-safe plate and microwave on high 30 seconds
3. Place tortillas on flat surface and spread each with 1 tablespoon cream cheese up to 1-inch from edge
4. Top each with 1 teaspoon honey mustard
5. Place 2 slices ham on honey mustard
6. Place 1 slice cheese on top of ham
7. Top with 1 tomato slice and 2 tablespoons lettuce
8. Fold one side of each tortilla up about 1-inch to form bottom and roll in the shape of a cylinder
9. Repeat process with remaining tortillas
10. Eat and enjoy !

title: polish sausage dinner
steps:
1. Put everything in a frying pan including the vegetable juices
2. Heat
3. Done in about 10 to 15 minutes

title: homemade pizza sauce
steps:
1. Saute onion , garlic and oregano in oil
2. Add tomato sauce
3. Mix in remaining ingredients
4. Simmer until thick
5. When cool , pour over 2 pizza crusts

title: orange cinnamon cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f
2. Line baking sheets with parchment paper
3. Beat 1 cup sugar with the shortening , egg , vanilla and orange zest
4. Add the orange juice , flour , soda and salt and stir until well combined
5. Combine 1 / 3 cup sugar with 3 tbs cinnamon
6. Shape dough into walnut sized balls
7. Roll in cinnamon sugar and press onto prepared cookie sheets with a glass dipped in cinnamon sugar
8. Bake 10-15 minutes until lightly golden

title: 100 stroke banana bread
steps:
1. Mash bananas with sugar , oil , and egg
2. Add other ingredients in order listed
3. Stir 100 strokes
4. Bake in oiled loaf pan for 1 hour at 325 degrees

title: crock pot curried split pea soup
steps:
1. In a 5- to 6-quart slow cooker , combine split peas , pork hocks , ham , celery , onion , carrot , curry powder , marjoram , bay leaves , and pepper
2. Stir in the water
3. Cover and cook on low-heat setting for 9 to 11 hours or on high-heat setting for 4 1 / 2 to 5 1 / 2 hours
4. Discard bay leaves
5. Remove pork hocks
6. When pork hocks are cool enough to handle , remove meat from bones
7. Discard bones
8. Coarsely chop meat
9. Return meat to soup

title: crawfish  shrimp  and corn soup
steps:
1. In a large pan , over medium heat , saut onions and mushrooms in butter and a little garlic powder until tender
2. Soften cream cheese in microwave , and add to onions and mushrooms
3. Lower heat to medium-low and add soups and corn , stir well
4. Add crawfish or shrimp and half-and-half
5. Season to taste with tabasco sauce and tony's creole seasoning
6. Cook for about 20 to 25 minutes

title: apricot pecan tassies
steps:
1. For base:
2. In food processor , combine flour , 1 / 2 cup butter and cream cheese
3. Process until mixture forms a large ball
4. Wrap dough in plastic wrap and chill for at least 15 minutes
5. For filling:
6. Combine brown sugar , egg , 1 tbsp buter , vanilla and salt in a bowl until smooth
7. Stir in apricots and nuts
8. Preheat oven to 325f shape dough into 2 dozen 1 inch balls and place in paper lined or greased miniture muffin tins
9. Press dough on bottom and up sides of each cup
10. Fill each with 1 tsp apricot-pecan filling
11. Bake 25 minutes or until golden and filling sets
12. Cool and remove from cups
13. Cookies can be wrapped tightly in plastic and frozen up to 6 weeks

title: italian olive bread
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , pour 2 cups flour and add the dry ingredients
2. Stir to blend
3. Form a well in the flour and pour in the hot water
4. With a wooden spoon , pull flour into the water to form a batter
5. Break the eggs and drop into the batter
6. Vigorously stir the eggs and batter together till the eggs have been absorbed
7. Cut the butter into 2 or 3 pieces and drop into the mixture
8. With a wooden spoon or mixer flat beater , mix till the batterlike dough is smooth and silky , about 2 minutes
9. Stir in flour , 1 / 2 cup at a time , till the dough is a ball and can be turned out of the bowl onto a floured surface
10. The dough should not be sticky because of the high fat content of the butter and eggs , but if it is , add sprinkles of flour
11. Knead by hand or under a dough hook till smooth and elastic , about 8 minutes
12. Knead with a strong push-turn-fold motion and occasionally lift the dough and throw it back onto the work surface
13. Be aggressive !
14. First rising:
15. Place the dough in a greased bowl and set aside at room temp to rise
16. Shaping:
17. Drain the olives and mix the green and black together so they can be uniformly scattered over the dough
18. Set aside
19. Punch down the dough and turn onto the floured work surface
20. Pat and push the dough into a 14 inch square
21. Allow it to relax for 3-4 minutes before scattering the olives
22. Press the olives lightly into the dough
23. Roll up the dough as for a jelly roll to enclose the olives and place seam side down on a baking sheet / stone
24. Tuck the open ends of the dough under to make a smooth surface
25. Pat the loaf to flatten and shape into an oval about 2 inches thick
26. Second rising:
27. Cover the loaf with waxed paper or plastic wrap and leave at room temp till puffy , about 30 minutes
28. Preheat oven to 350 20 minutes before baking
29. Uncover the loaf and brush with beaten egg yolk
30. Bake in oven till richly browned , about 45 minutes
31. Place on a rack and cool for at least 10 minutes
32. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: crock pot beef broccoli soup
steps:
1. Brown ground beef and garlic , crumbling very well
2. Drain off fat and add to crock pot
3. Add remaining ingredients to crock pot and give it a good stir
4. Cook on low 8-10 hours
5. Leftovers freeze well

title: smokey steak rub
steps:
1. Mix spices , salt and peppers
2. Rub over steak , chicken or fish
3. Extra spice rub can be stored in an air-tight jar

title: vanilla passion fruit mojito
steps:
1. Muddle mint springs , vanilla and sugar together
2. Place in cocktail shaker half filled with ice
3. Add rum and juices and shake 10 times
4. Strain into glass filled with ice
5. Garnish with mint
6. Serve

title: jenn s stromboli
steps:
1. Place dough on lightly greased baking sheet
2. Pat to a 15x10 inch rectangle
3. Arrange ham slices lengthwise down the center , follow with salami
4. Sprinkle with half of seasonings
5. Top with cheeses
6. Sprinkle rest of seasonings
7. Moisten all edges of dough with water
8. Bring long ends together at center and press securely to seal
9. Seal ends
10. Brush dough with butter and sprinkle with cornmeal
11. Carefully invert , seal side down , on baking sheet
12. Brush top with rest of butter
13. Bake at 375 for 20-22 minutes

title: asian tofu salad
steps:
1. Whisk canola oil , vinegar , honey , soy sauce , sesame oil , ginger and salt in a bowl
2. Place tofu and 2 tablespoons of the dressing in a large nonstick skillet
3. Cook over medium-high heat , turning every 2 to 3 minutes , until golden brown , 12 to 15 minutes total
4. Remove from the heat , add 1 tablespoon of the dressing to the pan and stir to coat
5. Toss greens , carrots and cucumber with the remaining dressing
6. Serve immediately , topped with the warm tofu

title: coffee soup
steps:
1. Break the bread or toast into bite-sized pieces
2. Mix together the coffee , half-and-half and sugar
3. Place the bread chunks in a soup bowl and pour the coffee mixture over all
4. Sprinkle extra sugar or cinnamon sugar over the top

title: batter dipped crunchy fried chicken
steps:
1. Place chicken pieces in a large saucepan or flameproof casserole
2. Add 2 cups water , bay leaves , cloves , garlic , and celery seed
3. Cover and bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat and simmer 45 minutes , until chicken is tender
5. Remove chicken from stock
6. Strain and reserve 1 1 / 3 cups of the stock
7. Refrigerate chicken for 15-20 minutes
8. Meanwhile , in a large saucepan or deep-fat fryer , heat all but 2 tablespoons vegetable oil over medium heat
9. In a large bowl , combine pancake mix , paprika , salt , pepper , 2 tablespoons vegetable oil , eggs , and reserved chicken stock
10. Generously coat each piece of chicken with batter
11. Fry chicken in batches without crowding 7-10 minutes , turning once , until golden brown and crisp
12. Remove and drain on paper towels

title: grandma lofftus  fig jam
steps:
1. Prepare first 3 ingredients and let stand in a bowl over night
2. Boil with sliced lemon and orange
3. After the mixture cooks a bit , add the cinnamon and cloves
4. Cook until clear
5. Set into prepared jars , per standard canning instructions

title: a great brisket  not smoked
steps:
1. Generously salt and pepper brisket and rub it in good
2. Put the brisket in the bag and pour the whole bottle of liquid smoke over it and rub it in good too
3. Pour the 2 cans of consumme over the meat
4. Pour bbq sauce over the whole mess and tie up the bag and follow bag directions
5. Bake at 250 or 300 degrees for 5 or 6 hours
6. Be sure that the fat side of the brisket is on top so it can baste itself

title: mile high biscuits  scones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Sift together flour , sugar , baking powder , cream of tartar and salt
3. Cut in shortening / butter with pastry blender or two knives until it resembles a coarse meal
4. Combine egg and milk
5. Add this to the flour mix all at once , stirring with fork just enough to make a soft dough that sticks together
6. Knead lightly on lightly floured surface 15 times
7. Roll out to 1" thickness
8. Cut with floured 2" cutter and place 1" apart on ungreased baking sheet
9. Bake in oven 12 - 15 minutes or until golden brown
10. Serve immediately

title: fresh texas guacamole
steps:
1. Peel the skin off the avocados
2. Slice it off the pit using a knife
3. Mash the avocados up in a bowl till smooth
4. I have seen many opinions on this subject here on zaar but here in tx i have only seen guacamole served smooth and creamy , that's the only way i've had it
5. Plus you get more !
6. Add garlic and salsa and mix together
7. Add salt and pepper to taste and combine
8. Add some lime juice if you prefer or if it will be sitting out for while
9. Enjoy !

title: tomato and eggplant  aubergine  parm
steps:
1. Heat oil in large skillet on med-high heat
2. Preheat oven at 350f
3. Peel eggplant and cut in 1 / 2 inch slices , lay flat and salt the eggplant , set aside
4. Cut tomato into 1 / 2 inch slices
5. Beat eggs in large shallow bowl
6. Set aside
7. Combine breadcrumbs with salt , pepper , basil , oregano , parsley and garlic powder , set in large shallow bowl
8. When the eggplant starts to sweat , blot up liquid with paper towel , this takes the bitterness out of the eggplant
9. Dip eggplant into egg , then into breadcrumbs
10. Pan fry the eggplant until golden brown
11. Repeat same process with tomato slices
12. When all slices are fried
13. Take large baking dish and cover bottom of pan with gravy
14. Place a layer of breaded eggplant on the gravy , followed by a thin layer of mozzarella cheese
15. Then place a layer of tomato slices on top the cheese
16. Next place a thin layer of gravy over the tomato followed by another layer of cheese
17. Repeat until casserole dish is full
18. The last layers should be gravy and cheese
19. Place full casserole into preheated oven
20. Bake for 25-30 minutes
21. Enjoy

title: braided coffee cake
steps:
1. In a large bowl , dissolve yeast in the 1 / 2 cup warm water
2. Stir in egg
3. In a small saucepan , heat and stir the 1 / 2 cup butter , 1 / 2 cup water , 1 / 4 cup sugar and salt until mixture is lukewarm and butter is almost melted
4. Stir butter mixture into the yeast mixture
5. Stir in flour
6. On a lightly floured surface , knead the dough for 4 to 6 strokes or until ingredients are combined
7. Transfer to a greased bowl
8. Cover with greased plastic wrap
9. Chill if you like for 8-24 hours
10. Let dough stand , covered , at room temperature for 1 hour
11. Meanwhile , lightly grease baking sheet
12. Divide dough in half
13. On a lightly floured surface , roll each half of dough into a 14x9 inch rectangle
14. Spread the melted butter over dough rectangles
15. In a small bowl , mix nuts , 1 / 2 cup sugar , brown sugar and cinnamon
16. Cut each rectangle into 3 14x3 inch strips
17. Sprinkle the mixture in the center of each strip
18. Using your fingers pinch dough to seal
19. To shape a loaf , place 3 filled ropes , seam side down , 1 inch apart
20. Starting at the middle , loosely braid by bringing the left rope over the center rope
21. Next bring the right rope over new center rope
22. Repeat to end
23. Press ends together to seal
24. Tuck under
25. Repeat to make a second loaf
26. Carefully transfer braids to cookie sheet
27. Cover and let rise for 1 hour
28. Preheat oven to 350f bake for 20-25 minutes or until loaves sound hollow when lightly tapped
29. Immediately remove loaves from baking sheet
30. Cool on wire racks
31. Meanwhile , in a medium bowl , combine 11 / 2 cup sifted powdered sugar , 1 tbsp milk , and 1 / 2 teaspoons vanilla
32. Stir in additional milk , 1 teaspoons at a time , until icing is easy to drizzle
33. Drizzle icing on loaves

title: granny s crumb coffeecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix flour , sugar , & salt
3. Cut in shortening
4. Save 1 / 3 cup of the crumbs for topping
5. Put the rest of the ingredients in a mixing bowl and beat well
6. Bake in square or rectangular baking pan for about 40 minutes or until top is golden brown
7. Could also use toothpick trick: insert toothpick into cake and if it comes out clean the cake is ready

title: hot buttered whiskey  or rum  batter
steps:
1. Melt butter and sugar until you have a syrup-like consistency
2. Stir in softened ice cream
3. Stir until creamy and smooth
4. Freeze
5. To serve , put 1 oz
6. Of whiskey in cup , add 2 heaping tablespoons of batter , top off with boiling water , and stir to combine
7. Enjoy !

title: crock pot chai tea
steps:
1. Combine water , tea , sugar , cloves , cinnamon & ginger in crock pot
2. Cover
3. Cook on high 2 to 2-1 / 2 hours
4. Strain mixture
5. Discard solids
6. Stir in milk just before serving
7. Serve warm or chilled

title: spinach chicken caesar wrap
steps:
1. Mix jarlsberg cheese , chicken and spring onion in a bowl and toss well with dressing
2. Set aside
3. Arrange 1 cup of spinach leaves on one side of a tortilla
4. Spoon on 1 / 4 chicken mixture
5. Roll up tightly , tucking in ends
6. Wrap in microwave-safe paper and refrigerate
7. Heat in microwave 1-1 / 2 minutes or until warm
8. Slice in half to serve

title: polynesian rice  rice cooker recipe
steps:
1. Spray the rice cooker bowl with pam or coat with vegetable oil
2. Put first 6 ingredients in rice bowl , stirring with paddle a few times
3. Close cover and set for regular cycle
4. When rice cooker switches to "keep warm" , srpinkle the green onion , pineapple , grapes , and green pepper on top of the rice
5. Close cover and let steam for 15 minutes
6. Stir rice with plastic rice paddle to combine
7. Garnish with cucumber and lime wedges

title: skylike chili   skyline chili copycat
steps:
1. Brown ground beef and onion
2. Drain
3. Add beef stock to beef mixture and simmer 10 minutes
4. Add remaining 13 ingredients , simmer uncovered 1 hour
5. Remove bay leaf , skim off extra fat
6. Serve over hot spaghetti , or hot dogs in buns for chili dogs
7. Top with plenty of cheese and other optional toppings

title: bacon filet mignon
steps:
1. Wrap bacon around each filet
2. Heat a heavy bottom pan on medium-high
3. Place the 4 filets on heated pan
4. Turn after 7 minutes
5. Remove from heat after another 7 minutes
6. Heat 9 minutes if you like it more well done
7. Do not use this recipe if you don't own a heavy bottom pan !
8. Go invest in one now !

title: smoked salmon quesadilla
steps:
1. Set up grill for direct cooking over medium heat
2. Oil grate when ready to start cooking
3. Lay out 4 tortillas
4. Spread each half with half of th herb cheese
5. Divide and top each tortilla with salmon , capers , and jack cheese
6. Top with remaining tortillas
7. In a small bowl , combine sour cream with dill
8. Set aside
9. Grill tortillas on hot oiled grill for 3-4 minutes per side or until cheese has melted
10. Serve hot topped with sliced avocado , cherry tomatoes , and onion rings
11. Garnish with creme fraiche

title: paleo ginger chicken breasts over green spinach
steps:
1. In a frying pan , melt coconut oil over medium-high heat
2. Saut onion , ginger and coconut aminos
3. Salt and pepper chicken breasts and add to pan
4. Reduce heat to low , cover and cook 30 minutes
5. Place chicken over spinach leaves and pour remaining sauce over it
6. Freezing directions:
7. In a frying pan , melt coconut oil over medium-high heat
8. Saut onion , coconut aminos and ginger
9. Salt and pepper chicken breasts and add to pan
10. Reduce heat to low , cover and cook 30 minutes
11. Place meat and sauce in freezer bags , label and freeze
12. To serve: thaw
13. Reheat and serve over spinach leaves

title: awesome butterscotch shortbread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees
2. In a large bowl , mis margarine , shortening , and sugars with mixer until blended and creamy
3. Stir in flour and salt
4. Roll dough out on lightly floured surface , about 1 / 8- 1 / 4 inch thickness , depending on how thin and crispy you want the cookies
5. Cut with cookies cutters and place about 1 inch apart on ungreased cookies sheet
6. Bake about 25 minutes or until set
7. Cookies will not expand or brown much , so make sure you watch them so they don't get too browned- they will taste slightly burnt
8. Remove cookies from sheet and let cool
9. Store once cooled

title: steak pinwheels stuffed with spinach and bacon
steps:
1. In a large skillet cook bacon just until done but not crisp
2. Drain on paper towels
3. Score steak by making shallow cuts at 1-inch intervals diagonally across steak in a diamond pattern
4. Repeat on second side
5. Place steak between 2 pieces of plastic wrap
6. Working from the center to the edges , pound meat lightly with the flat side of a meat mallet to form a 12x8-inch rectangle
7. Remove plastic wrap sprinkle the 1 / 2 teaspoon lemon-pepper seasoning and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt over top
8. Arrange the bacon lengthwise on the steak
9. In a mixing bowl stir together the spinach , bread crumbs , thyme , 1 / 4 teaspoon lemon-pepper seasoning , and dash salt
10. Spread the spinach mixture over the bacon
11. Roll up meat from a short side
12. Secure with wooden toothpicks at 1-inch intervals , starting 1 / 2 inch from one end
13. Cut between toothpicks into eight 1-inch slices
14. Cook 4 of the pinwheels immediately and freeze the remaining pinwheels as directed
15. Makes 4 servings
16. To eat two: to grill , horizontally thread two pinwheels onto each of 2 long skewers
17. Remove wooden toothpicks
18. Place pinwheels on the rack of an uncovered grill
19. Grill directly over medium coals 12 to 14 minutes or to desired doneness , turning once
20. Or to broil , place pinwheels , cut side down , on the unheated rack of a broiler pan
21. Broil 3 to 4 inches from the heat for 12 to 14 minutes or to desired doneness , turning once
22. Remove toothpicks
23. To freeze two: place two pinwheels into each of 2 individual freezer containers
24. Seal , label , and freeze for up to 3 months
25. To serve , thaw 2 or 4 of the pinwheels overnight in the refrigerator
26. Cook according to the directions above

title: backbone house salad  vegan friendly
steps:
1. Combine all dressing ingredients except oil in a blender
2. With machine running , slowly drizzle in oil
3. Whirl a minute to combine
4. This dressing will keep for 10 days in the refrigerator
5. Plate the salad ingredients on individual salad plates in the order written above
6. Drizzle each with about 1 tablespoon dressing and serve

title: dianne s fresh apple cake
steps:
1. Combine flour , cinnamon and baking soda and set aside
2. In a large mixing bowl , stir together apples and 1 1 / 4 c sugar
3. Add eggs , oil and vanilla , combining well
4. Gradually stir in flour mixture
5. Continue stirring until all flour has been mixed in
6. Do not use an electric mixer
7. Mixture will be very thick
8. Spread in 9x13 pan
9. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350
10. Cake is done when toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean
11. After cake has been baking for 25 minutes begin to make the topping
12. Heat butter sugars and water until melted in medium saucepan , stirring frequently
13. Add 2 tbs flour
14. Cook over low until it thickens and is less cloudy
15. Remove from heat and add 1 tsp vanilla
16. When cake is done , spread topping over all and allow to cool

title: easy bread and butter pickles
steps:
1. Combine cucumbers , onion , vinegar , sugar , salt , mustard seeds , dry mustard , turmeric , crushed red pepper , and celery seeds
2. Heat to boiling over high heat , stirring occasionally
3. Boil 1 minute , stirring frequently
4. Pour cucumber mixture into a large bowl
5. Cool to room temperature , stirring occasionally
6. Cover and chill overnight before serving
7. You can spoon cooled cucumbers and their liquid into jars with tight-fitting lids and refrigerate up to 4 weeks

title: nutcracker
steps:
1. Shake vigorously with ice in a cocktail shaker so that the milk builds up a foam
2. Strain into a highball glass with lots of ice

title: tikka chicken with pumpkin curry
steps:
1. Set the chicken breasts in a casserole with a tight-fitting lid
2. Mix the lime juice and honey together and pour over them
3. Season lightly with salt and pepper
4. Add dry spice to a heavy-bottomed frying pan on medium heat , stirring until they darken and become fragrantthis will take about 3-5 minutes
5. Remove the spices from the heat
6. Put this mixture into a medium sized bowl
7. Put the pan back on medium heat , and cook the shallots in the oil , stirring constantly until they turn deep golden
8. Add ginger , chili and garlic , and cook , stirring , until the shallots are a deep reddish brown , the garlic is golden
9. Remove the mixture from the pan , discard the chili and puree into a fine paste
10. Add to the spice mixture , then stir in the pumpkin and coconut milk
11. Using a whisk , beat the yogurt into the mix
12. Pour over the chicken pieces , and put a piece of foil over the top of the casserole before fitting the lid tightly over it
13. Allow chicken to marinate in the refrigerator
14. While chicken is marinating , preheat the oven at 450 degrees f
15. After marinating for an hour , put the casserole into the oven , and bake for 40 minutes
16. Scatter cilantro over the chicken
17. Best served over basmati rice

title: cauliflower steaks with red peppers   pesto
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f
2. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with foil and rub with 1 tablespoon oil
3. Cut the cauliflower into 1-inch slices from top to bottom , keeping the pieces together through the stems and reserving florets that fall off
4. Transfer to the baking sheet along with the pepper and arrange in a single layer
5. Rub all over with the oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper
6. Roast , carefully turning the cauliflower steaks once , until a paring knife pierces easily through a cauliflower stem , about 25 minutes
7. Dollop the pesto and red pepper on top and serve hot

title: ensalada de judias verdes
steps:
1. Prepare the vinaigrette by whisking the ingredients together in a non-reactive bowl
2. Whisk well again before serving
3. Best prepared several hours in advance if possible
4. Lightly blanch the green beans for about 3-4 minutes or until bright green
5. Immediately submerge in a bowl of ice water for a few minutes to lock in the color
6. Drain well
7. Divide the frisee on 2 salad plates
8. Place half of the green beans on each plate , followed by half of the red onion and half the tomatoes
9. Drizzle with the sherry vinaigrette
10. Garnish each serving with a lemon wedge
11. Don't forget the crusty bread !

title: sweet potato and coconut soup
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large saucepan and gently fry the onion , garlic and ginger for about 5 minutes until tender
2. Add the sweet potatoes and lemon grass and cook for a further 3 minutes
3. Add the stock and bring to the boil
4. Reduce the heat and simmer , covered , for 20 minutes until the vegetables are tender
5. Cool the soup slightly , then liquidise with half of the coconut cream and process until smooth
6. Return the soup to the saucepan , add the remaining coconut cream
7. And season with salt and pepper
8. Heat through without allowing the soup to boil , and add the lime juice
9. Ladle the soup into bowls and garnish with the lime zest

title: red beans and couscous
steps:
1. Bring first 6 ingredients to a boil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat
2. Remove from heat
3. Stir in couscous
4. Let stand 10 minutes
5. Fluff mixture with fork
6. Stir in kidney beans and remaining ingredients
7. Serve hot or slightly chilled

title: tangy summer salad
steps:
1. Dice and chop the peppers and onions
2. Place in a bowl
3. Place tomatoes in the bowl
4. Add the chopped pecans to the veggies
5. In a small bowl or tea cup mix the mustard , lemon juice and olive oil
6. Stir until emulsified
7. Pour over the salad
8. Mix and serve

title: spicy oven roasted potato wedges
steps:
1. Preaheat the oven to 525f
2. Scrub and quarter the potatoes and place them in a large bowl
3. Drizzle the olive oil over the potatoes and toss to coat
4. Sprinkle seasonings over potatoes and toss to coal well
5. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray the foil with cooking spray
6. Arrange the potatoes in one layer on the baking sheet
7. Roast for 20 minutes , turning once halfway through cooking

title: spooky eyeballs
steps:
1. Cut the eggs in half and scoop out the yolks
2. In a bowl mash the yolks with the cream cheese
3. Fill the eggs with the cream cheese mixture and push an olive into the middle of each one
4. Dip a wooden toothpick into the foodcolouring and draw bloodshot veins onto the cheese mixture , running from the olive to the outside

title: crusty parmesan flounder fillets
steps:
1. Combine in a small bowl , mayonaise and grated parmesan cheese
2. Toast one slice of whole wheat multi grain bread and let it cool til it is hard and grate it
3. Spread mayonaise and parmesan mixture on the top of the fillets and sprinkle bread crumbs on top of this mixture on the fillets
4. I used some oregano and greek seasoning on mine , but to each his own in taste with the spices and herbs
5. I broiled the fillets and this is tricky as to the thickness of your fillets , so i advise watching them carefully so as not to over cook
6. I served these with a baked sweet potato with cinnamon and nutmeg , sea salt , and cracked pepper
7. Also , sliced some tomatoes and seasoned them with some cracked pepper and apple cider vinegar
8. Bon appetite !

title: crab cakes from maryland governor s kitchen
steps:
1. Pick through crab meat twice to remove cartilage or shell
2. Try not to break up lumps of backfin
3. Keep crabmeat chilled during process by putting ice cubes in a large mixing bowl then placing a slightly smaller bowl inside to hold the picked meat
4. After the first picking , feel for missed cartilage while returning crab meat to the crab meat container
5. Chill crab meat until ready to mix
6. Put saltine crackers in a mini-food processor and process to a fine crumb
7. Alternatively , tear slices of bread into small pieces and put in mixing bowl
8. Add regular mayonnaise and yellow mustard to mixing bowl
9. For the eastern shore purists , the addition of old bay seasoning is controversial , but baltimore residents won't call it a crab cake without some
10. One teaspoon adds a subtle taste
11. Beat egg whites until stiff , then fold into filler mixture
12. Gently fold in reserved crab meat
13. Make 4 to 6 cakes , pressed gently together
14. Chill covered in refrigerator for at least 1 hour to set cakes
15. Fill frying pan to 1 / 4-inch with canola oil
16. Heat canola oil to 360 degrees fahrenheit
17. Gently place crab cakes in oil and fry for 2-3 minutes until golden brown
18. Use spatula to carefully turn crab cakes
19. Fry for another 2-3 minutes
20. Drain oil from crab cakes on paper towels , then serve hot with some saltine crackers on the side
21. To broil: since these crab cakes have the minimum amount of filler required to hold them together , you may broil them on a lightly oiled baking sheet 4-6 inches away from the heat source until golden brown
22. If you use low-calorie mayonnaise , this would be the preferred way to cook the cakes
23. To microwave: only use 1 / 2 tablespoon of oil to brush on a large flat plate
24. Microwave plate for 2 minutes on high to heat oil
25. Place cakes on plate and microwave for 7 minutes on high

title: chorizo  veggie version included
steps:
1. Mix well and cook through or add to your favorite recipe
2. This is great mixed up with scrambled eggs !

title: cuban black bean salad
steps:
1. Toss together beans , yellow and red peppers , celery , onion and parsley
2. Whisk together lemon juice , olive oil , garlic& cumin and toss into bean mixture

title: swiss chard   goat cheese frittata
steps:
1. Wash the swiss chard
2. Cut off stems , dice finely , and set aside
3. Chop the leaves
4. Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a nonstick 9-inch skillet with an ovenproof handle
5. Add onion , teaspoon of salt , and rosemary
6. Saut 10 minutes over medium heat , until the onions are very soft and just starting to brown
7. Stir in the swiss chard leaves and the remaining teaspoon salt , and saut 1 to 2 minutes , or until the greens are just wilted
8. Remove from heat , stir in garlic and swiss chard stems , and set aside
9. Whisk eggs in a bowl
10. Add the swiss chard mixture and goat cheese , and stir to combine
11. Wash and dry the skillet and return to stove top
12. Preheat the broiler unit in the oven
13. Heat the remaining tablespoon oil in the skillet over medium-high heat
14. When the oil is very hot , pour in the vegetable-egg mixture and cook for 3 to 4 minutes , or until the eggs are set on the bottom
15. Transfer the skillet to the preheated broiler and broil for about 3 minutes , or until the frittata is firm and golden on top
16. Loosen the frittata from the skillet and invert onto a large round plate
17. Cut into wedges and serve

title: creamy garlic penne pasta
steps:
1. Melt butter and add garlic in a medium sauce pan
2. Cook over medium for 1 minute
3. Add flour and cook 1 minute , stirring constantly
4. Stir in broth and milk and cook , stirring frequently , until sauce boils and thickens
5. Add parsley , salt , pepper and cheese
6. Stir until cheese is melted
7. Toss hot pasta with sauce and serve immediately

title: nana s tomato relish
steps:
1. Skin tomatoes with boiling water
2. Chunk tomatoes
3. Peel and slice onions
4. Place onions and tomatoes in a very large pan with vinegar and all seasonings
5. Stir and boil on medium heat for 1 hour
6. If needed at the end , thicken with a couple tablespoons of flour or other thickener and a little more vinegar
7. Let cool then place in jars and store in fridge
8. These make wonderful gifts !
9. Yum

title: tartar sauce for all tastes
steps:
1. Add to the work bowl of you food processor the relish , the rough chopped dill pickles , dried onion , mustard powder , dill and the old bay
2. Give it ten good pulses to chop and mix everything
3. Dump the relish mixture into a mixing bowl with the mayo and the salt and pepper
4. Stir to combine
5. Let it sit in the fridge for at least 30 minutes so all the flavors can combine and the onion can rehydrate

title: fiesta salad with avocado ranch dressing
steps:
1. To prepare the dressing , mash avocado in a mixing bowl then stir in the mayonnaise , sour cream , buttermilk , vinegar , salt and seasonings
2. Cover and chill until ready to serve
3. To serve , place chopped lettuce in a bowl and add all remaining ingredients
4. Toss lightly
5. Serve salad with the chilled avocado ranch dressing

title: seafood and portabella mushrooms
steps:
1. Saut seafood and shallots in 3 tablespoons butter and seafood seasoning
2. Cook 5 minutes
3. Sprinkle with 1 / 4 cup chicken broth , salt and pepper
4. Set aside
5. Saut mushrooms in 1 tablespoon of butter
6. Add to seafood
7. In another pan melt the remaining butter and add flour to make paste
8. Add milk , chicken broth , emeril's essence and tomato paste stir until smooth
9. Combine sauce and seafood mixture and place in a casserole or individual ramekins
10. Bake at 400f degrees for 30 minutes

title: iced coffee cream
steps:
1. Dissolve coffee and brown sugar in boiling water
2. Add cinnamon and mixed spice
3. Add cold water and stir well
4. Add milk , vanilla and whipping cream
5. Whisk lightly until evenly combined
6. Put 2 ice cubes into each glass
7. Half fill with coffee mixture
8. Add a scoop of ice cream to each glass and top up with remaining coffee
9. Sprinkle with unsweetened cocoa powder
10. Garnish with cinnamon sticks , lime slices and grated chocolate , if desired
11. Serve at once with long-handled spoons
12. Variation: for a sweeter version , increase brown sugar to taste
13. If desired , top each with a little whipped cream

title: trader joe s   simply the best mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Heat the potatoes and broth to a boil in a large pot
2. Cover and cook over medium heat 15 minutes or until the potatoes are tender
3. Drain and reserve cooking liquid
4. Mash potatoes with 1 / 2 cup reserved cooking liquid / broth
5. Add more liquid if necessary for desired consistency
6. Stir in chives or other herb of choice
7. Season with white pepper

title: chocolate cinnamon bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f grease two 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans and line bottom of pans with parchment paper
2. Chocolate batter: in bowl of electric mixer , cream together butter and sugar with paddle attachment on medium speed , until light and creamy about 5 minutes
3. Beat in eggs , one at a time , beating until each egg is completely incorporated before adding the next and scraping down sides of bowl several times
4. Meanwhile , in medium bowl , sift together flour , cocoa , cinnamon , salt , baking powder and baking soda
5. In another bowl , whisk together buttermilk , water and vanilla
6. With mixer on low speed , alternately add flour mixture and buttermilk mixture to butter , beginning and ending with flour and beating just until blended
7. Divide batter between the two pans , shake pans to even tops and set aside
8. Cocoa spice sugar crust: in another small bowl , whisk together sugar , cinnamon , cocoa , ginger and cloves
9. Sprinkle surfaces of both batters with decorating sugar
10. Sprinkle with cocoa sugar mixture , dividing evenly
11. Bake until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean , about 45 to 50 minutes
12. Let cool completely , run thin knife around sides to release breads and remove from pans

title: easy sweet and sour sauce for chicken or pork
steps:
1. Mix the vinegar , brown sugar , ketchup , and soy sauce together and bring to a boil in a small pot
2. Mix together the cornstarch and water , add to the other ingredients and stir to thicken
3. For a thicker sauce , increase the cornstarch to 5 teaspoons

title: chicken and spinach curry
steps:
1. Cut the chicken so that the legs are separated from the thighs , cut each breast in two lengthwise
2. Mix together in a bowl the turmeric , fennel , coriander and chili powder with 3 tbsp water to make a paste
3. Heat the oil over medium heat and fry the onions , ginger and garlic , till the onions are brown , 5 minutes
4. Turn the heat to low and fry the spice paste stir and cook for 5 minutes to the bowl in which the spices were mixed add 3 tbsp water , stir to remove all traces of the spices and add the water to the pan
5. Stir and cook 3 minutes
6. Turn the heat to medium and add the chicken , stir and fry for 4 minutes , till the chicken changes colour
7. Add 1 tsp of the salt and the water , bring to the boil , cover with a lid , reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes
8. Melt the butter in a separate pan and add the garlic , curry leaves , cumin , fennel and red chillies
9. Stir and add the spinach and 1 / 2 tsp salt
10. Fry for 5 minutes
11. Add the spinach to the chicken mix well , cover the pan and cook for 20 minutes
12. Mix in the yogurt and garam masala stir well to blend the yogurt with the chicken and spinach
13. Cook uncovered 6 minutes , stirring frequently

title: turkey breast crusted with hazelnuts and lemon
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180 c
2. Spread hazelnuts on a baking sheet and toast in oven for 5 to 10 minutes
3. When they are lightly toasted , remove from oven and roll hazelnuts between a few sheets of paper towel or in a dry tea towel to remove most of the skins
4. Sort nuts from skins , discard skins and set nuts aside
5. Zest and juice 1 lemon
6. Place zest , juice , hazelnuts and remaining ingredients , except remaining lemon , into a food processor and pulse until mixture resembles coarse breadcrumbs
7. Thinly slice second lemon and layer into bottom of a lightly oiled shallow baking dish
8. Place turkey breast on top of lemon slices and evenly press nut crust over top of entire breast
9. Bake in oven for 1 hour or until a meat thermometer registers 74 c
10. If crust starts to brown , cover lightly with a piece of foil or parchment paper
11. Let rest for 5 minutes after removing from oven , slice against grain and serve

title: melts in your mouth
steps:
1. Cream butter , powdered sugar and vanilla
2. Sift flour and cornstarch
3. Add to creamed ingredients
4. Roll into small balls and flatten with a wetted glass to prevent the dough from sticking
5. Bake at 350 for 12-14 minutes
6. Meanwhile , cream sugar , butter and vanilla for frosting
7. Add milk until thin enough to spread
8. Divide frosting into 2 bowls and color 1 bowl with red frosting and 1 bowl with green frosting

title: tropical tuesday smoothie shake
steps: 1. Add all ingredients to blender and blend until smooth

title: ooey gooey chocolatey puffed wheat squares
steps:
1. Melt butter in saucepan
2. Add syrup , sugar , cocoa , marshmallows and vanilla
3. When mixture begins to bubble , remove from heat
4. Add puffed wheat and mix well
5. Put in a buttered 9 x 12-inch pan
6. Press down with spoon
7. Cut in squares

title: senapsgrdde  mustard cream sauce
steps:
1. Combine mustard and sugar and whisk into cream
2. Whip until stiff

title: farfalle with creamy mushroom gorgonzola sauce
steps:
1. Melt butter in a 2 qt saucepan over medium heat
2. When the butter starts to sizzle , add the flour and whisk until smooth , about 2 minutes
3. Gradually whisk in the milk
4. Bring the sauce to a simmer
5. Simmer for 2 minutes , whisking constantly
6. Remove from the heat
7. Add the gorgonzola and stir until melted
8. Season the sauce with salt , pepper and crushed red pepper , to taste
9. Set aside and cover to keep warm
10. Heat the oil in a heavy large skillet over medium heat
11. Add the mushrooms and saut until tender and golden , about 12 minutes
12. Stir in the peas
13. Season to taste with salt and pepper
14. Cook farfalle according to pkg directions and drain
15. Transfer the pasta to a large bowl
16. Add the gorgonzola sauce and mushroom mixture , and toss to coat
17. Season the pasta with salt and pepper , if needed and top with chopped chives

title: amaretto french toast w amaretto butter and syrup
steps:
1. For butter , combine softened butter and 2 tbls
2. Amaretto until well blended
3. For syrup: in small saucepan , combine 1 / 4 cup amaretto and syrup
4. Heat to boiling
5. Remove from heat and allow to cool to warm
6. For french toast: in large skillet over medium high , melt some butter
7. In shallow bowl mix all remaining ingredients except bread
8. Dip bread slices in mixture until just soaked through
9. Cook in butter until both sides are golden brown
10. Serve immediately with amaretto butter and amaretto syrup

title: turkey salad loaded
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a bowl
2. You may want to add a bit more salad dressing
3. Let chill for at least an hour to let the flavours blend
4. You don't have to chill and can serve when made but the longer it sit the better the flavour
5. I just served this as a scoop with other salads but it could be used in a wrap or roll etc

title: chocolate peppermint crackle cookies
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine wehole wheat pastry flour , all-ourpose flour , cocoa and baking powder
2. Set aside
3. In a mixing bowl , beat margarine with splenda brown sugar blend until smooth
4. Beat in eggs and peppermint extract
5. Add melted chocolate and beat until smooth
6. Add flour mixrture to chocolate mixture and bveat ot combine
7. Divide dough into 4 equal parts , shape into discs , cover wirh plasric wrap and refrigerate for 2 hours
8. Preheat oven to 350f line cookie sheet with parchment paper
9. Working with one disc at a time , shape dough into 8x1-inch log on un-floured work surface
10. Cut each log into 8 equal pieces and shape each into a ball
11. Place balls on prepared cookie sheet , about 2-inches apart
12. Slightly flatten each ball with hand and bake until surface cracks , and is cooked through , about 15 minutes
13. Do not overbake
14. Cool cookie on baking sheet for 5 minutes before removing to rack and cooling completely

title: stir fried chicken with cashews
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine cubed chicken , one tablespoon of cornstarch , and two tablespoons of sherry
2. Mix thoroughly
3. Mix soy sauce , sesame oil , sugar , broth , and remaining 1
4. 5 tbs sherry
5. Set aside
6. Heat 2 tbs vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet
7. Add chicken and stir fry until lightly browned
8. Remove chicken from pan
9. Add the rest of the oil to pan
10. Stir fry the onions , garlic , and ginger root
11. For about 1 minute
12. Add cashews and stir to coat
13. Return chicken to pan and add soy sauce mixture
14. Bring to a boil and stir in the cornstarch mixture to thicken
15. Serve hot

title: apple raisin cobbler
steps:
1. Topper-------------
2. Sift together flour , sugar , baking powder and salt
3. Cut in butter until crumbly
4. Combine egg and milk
5. Add all at once to dry ingredients
6. Stir just until moistened
7. Set aside
8. Cobbler-------------
9. In sauce pan combine the brown sugar , cornstarch and ginger
10. Stir in water and raisins
11. Cook and stir till thickened and bubbly
12. Stir in apples , lemon juice and butter
13. Cook till apples are hot , about 5 minutes
14. Put into 2 quart casserole
15. Drop topper in mounds atop hot fruit
16. Bake , uncovered , at 400 until lightly browned , about 25 minutes

title: italian pound cake  food processor
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f coat a 9x5 loaf pan with nonstick cooking spray
2. Gind toasted pine nuts in food processer
