3. Add the flour , cormeal , baking powder and salt and process to sift , about 10 seconds
4. Remove to a bowl and set aside
5. Process butter , sugar and zest till creamy , scraping the sides of processer as necessary
6. In measuring cup combine the eggs , oil and vanilla extract
7. With processer running , gradually add the egg mixture untill incorporated
8. Add the dry ingredients evenly to the food processed work bowl and pulse just until combined about 4 to 5 times
9. Pour batter into loaf pan
10. Bake in the center of the oven for 1 hour 15 minutes or until a tooth pick inserted in center comes out clean
11. Cool 5 minutes in pan , then remove and finsh cooling on rack
12. Enjoy !

title: 2 minute carbonara
steps:
1. Cook the noodles as per the pack instructions
2. Finely chop the spring onion , garlic , ham and mushrooms
3. Splash olive oil into a hot frying pan and fry the chopped ingredients all together for 1 minute and then add the cream and heat thoroughly before adding the noodles into the sauce with a splash of the water the noodles were cooked inches
4. Crack in the egg and stir through and season with salt and pepper to taste
5. Finish with shredded basil and sprinkle with parmesan and serve

title: comfort soup  vegetarian chickpea
steps:
1. Saute onion , garlic and olive oil together until the onion is soft and translucent
2. Add the chickpeas , carrots , tomato paste , bay leaf and 1 1 / 2 quarts water
3. Season to taste
4. Bring to a simmer and cook , covered for 1 / 2 an hour
5. Add the pearl barley and simmer for another 40-60 minutes , or until the chickpeas and barley are cooked through and the soup is quite thick
6. This was a really satisfying meal with a tossed green salad and garlic bread

title: boomette  s american dream coffee
steps: 1. Place all ingredients in a large glass filled with ice cubes

title: caramel cream pie
steps:
1. Boil the cans of sweetened condensed milk in a large pot for 3 hours
2. Make sure the water stays above the cans
3. Let cool 1 hour
4. Carefully open the cans and pour into large bowl
5. Fold in marshmallow cream
6. Pour into pie shell
7. Chill in refrigerator overnight
8. Top with whipped topping and enjoy !

title: cowboy  mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Place potatoes , carrots , jalapeno pepper and garlic cloves in a large pot
2. Cover with water , and bring to a boil over high heat
3. Cook 15 to 20 mins or until potatoes are tender
4. Drain water from pot
5. Stir in butter
6. Mash this mixture using a potatoe masher until the butter is melted , and the potaotoes have reached the desired consisistency
7. Mix in cheese , corn , salt and pepper to taste
8. Serve hot , and enjoy !

title: sugar free arnold palmer
steps:
1. Dissolve the sweetner and the tea in the lemon juice
2. Stir in the water
3. Chill overnight to blend flavors

title: cake doughnuts
steps:
1. Combine potatoes , sugar , eggs , and butter
2. Sift together flour , baking soda , cream of tartar , salt , and cinnamon
3. Add to potato mixture alternately with milk , ending with dry ingredients
4. If dough is too wet to roll out , add a little more flour
5. Chill 1 1 / 2 hours in fridge
6. Turn out onto a well floured board and roll out 1 / 4" thick
7. Cut with a floured doughnut cutter
8. Fry doughnuts and holes in 360f
9. Deep fat
10. Turn only once
11. Drain on paper towels , then cool on a rack
12. Leave plain or roll in cinnamon sugar

title: blume s peruvian chicken
steps:
1. In a blender , blend cilantro leaves , chicken broth , cumin , salt and pepper
2. Set aside
3. In large pot , fry chicken breast pieces in 5 tbl
4. Olive oil until lightly browned
5. Take out and set aside
6. Add 1 tbl
7. Olive oil and add onions , garlic , chilies and fry until lightly browned
8. Turn off flame
9. Add raw rice , peas , corn and stir
10. Place chicken pieces on top
11. Add the blended cilantro mixture into pot and bring to a boil
12. Lower heat to simmer , cover and cook for 20 minutes
13. Remove from heat , let sit for 20 more minutes
14. Do not lift lid
15. Then stir with fork to fluff and serve

title: lemon curd butterfly cakes
steps:
1. Pre-heat the oven to gas mark 5 / 375f / 190c
2. You will need a 12-cup muffin tin lined with cupcake baking cases
3. To make the cakes , sift the flour and salt in a bowl
4. Then add in the rest of the ingredients in bowl and beat until absolutely smooth - 1-2 minutes
5. Then fill prepared muffin tin with the mixture and tap the tin two or three times to settle the cake mix
6. Bake on the centre shelf of the oven for 15-20 minutes or until the cakes are well risen and golden
7. Remove the cakes from the tin and transfer onto a wire rack and leave to cool
8. To make the lemon curd , place the grated lemon rind and sugar in a bowl
9. In another bowl , whisk the lemon juice together with the eggs , then pour the mixture over the sugar
10. Add the butter cut into small pieces , and place the bowl over a pan of barely simmering water
11. Stir frequently till thickened - for about 20 minutes
12. Cool the curd before using it for the filling
13. To assemble the cake , take a small sharp knife and cut the top off each at an angle in a circle about inch from the edge of the cake so that you remove a cone-shaped round , leaving a cavity in the centre
14. Cut the round in half , top to bottom , and set aside
15. Now fill the cavity of each cake with the lemon curd then sit the two cone-shaped pieces of cake on top like butterfly wings
16. Dust with icing sugar to serve

title: cheesy oats
steps:
1. Take the microwave safe bowl we all have somewhere
2. Combine your oats , water , baking soda and salt mixing it in a sloppy way
3. Place your slice of cheese on top
4. Or if your using the better suggestion of a stick cheese , place it in the middle
5. The stick or string cheese most kids love in their lunches for school is what i use
6. It can be any combination of the yellow or white or whatever you've got to try
7. Put a cover , just setting on top of the bowl and heat in the microwave for about 45 seconds
8. Take and stir the contents together until all looks like a gooey mostly oat concoction
9. Now you can let it cool or add what you wish to it and eat up
10. My suggestions include salt , pepper , crackers for dipping , salsa , peppers , and the list could go on

title: berry and mango smoothie
steps:
1. Place ingredients in blender & mix until smooth
2. Pour into 2 glasses & enjoy !

title: albndigas
steps:
1. For the soup: heat some oil in a large pot over medium heat
2. Add onion and garlic cook for 3 minutes being careful not to burn
3. Add chopped tomatoes , tomato sauce , stock , oregano , salt , pepper , carrots , potatoes , and celery and bring to a boil
4. When the soup has reached a boil , cover and bring down to low heat
5. Pour some oil into a pan and slightly brown the rice then add to the soup
6. For the albndigas: add the liquid from the canned salmon to the soup and place the salmon in a large bowl
7. Break up the salmon into very small pieces with a fork
8. In a medium bowl , mix the bread crumbs and the egg until well combined
9. Add the onions , garlic , salt pepper , cumin and cilantro
10. Add the salmon and incorporate with the other ingredients
11. Shape the mixture into one inch balls
12. You should have enough for 12-16 albndigas
13. Pour enough oil into a large pan to cover the bottom
14. Fry the albndigas until brown all over
15. Add to the soup
16. Simmer until the rice is cooked and vegetables are tender
17. If soup is too thick pour in some additional water or stock

title: sarma  cabbage rolls
steps:
1. Remove bruised leaves from cabbage and cut out center core
2. Pour boiling water over cabbages to soften
3. Meanwhile , saut bacon and onion until bacon is done
4. Add half the tomato soup
5. Beat eggs and add salt , pepper , paprika , worcestershire sauce , ground beef , pork and ham
6. Add bacon mixture and rice and mix thoroughly
7. Separate cabbage leaves and drain
8. Place heaping tablespoon of stuffing at core end of each cabbage leaf and roll carefully , tucking in ends
9. Place rolls in layers in dutch oven or heavy kettle
10. Chop small unused leaves and place over to
11. Pour remaining soup and add enough water to cover rolls
12. Cover and simmer 2 to 2-1 / 2 hours

title: southwest pasta
steps:
1. Cook pork and onions in a large skillet until pork is no longer pink
2. Add taco seasoning mix according to package directions
3. Stir in tomato sauce , corn , chilis , and pinto beans and simmer 10 minutes
4. Mix with hot , drained pasta , top with cheese and serve

title: acadia s marinara sauce
steps:
1. In a 3 quart dutch oven add the olive oil and onions
2. Saute on medium low until tender about 4 minutes stirring frequently
3. Add garlic and saute for an additional 1 minute stirring frequently
4. Slice up bell peppers , add to mixture and saute an additional 4 minutes stirring frequently
5. Add sherry
6. Add basil , oregano , parsley , italian seasoning and mix with other ingredients
7. Remove mixture and place in food processor or blender and blend until smooth
8. Place pureed mixture back into dutch oven
9. Add crushed tomatoes and bay leaf
10. Add salt
11. Bring to a low boil stirring frequently , then reduce to simmer
12. Cover and cook for 45 min on low / simmer , stirring every 5 minutes
13. Remove bay leaf before serving
14. Enjoy !

title: fruit filled coffeecake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Beat first 5 ingredients with mixer until well blended
3. Pour into greased and floured 13x9-inch pan
4. Top with spoonfuls of pie filling
5. Bake 35 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
6. Sprinkle with nuts
7. Cool 10 minutes
8. Mix sugar and milk
9. Drizzle over cake
10. Cool completely
11. If glaze is too thick , add milk by teaspoonfuls until thin enough to drizzle

title: chicken al tequila    texas style
steps:
1. Heat 2 tablespoons of butter in a small saucepan over medium heat
2. Add garlic and jalapeno , and saute until soft
3. Pour in chicken stock , tequila , and lime juice
4. Bring to a boil , then lower the heat and simmer until the mixture is reduced to a paste , about 15 minutes
5. Stir occasionally to make sure it is not sticking
6. While the sauce is cooking , place the chicken in a bowl , and pour soy sauce over it
7. Melt remaining butter in a skillet , and saute the onion , red bell pepper and green bell pepper until soft
8. Remove vegetables , and set aside
9. Add oil to the skillet , and cook the chicken over medium-high heat until lightly browned
10. Pour in the sauce and heavy cream , and add the peppers
11. Bring to a boil , and simmer until chicken is cooked through , about 5 minutes
12. Remove from heat , and stir in romano cheese and cilantro
13. Taste and adjust seasonings if desired
14. Serve immediately
15. Brenda's
16. The paste can be made ahead of time and stored in the fridge or freezer
17. Bring to room temperature before adding to the sauce

title: spinach cheese dip
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the cream cheese , salsa , spinach and 1 cup cheese blend
2. Spread into an ungreased 9 inch pie plate
3. Sprinkle with remaining cheese
4. Bake , uncovered , at 350 degrees for 20 minutes or until heated through
5. Serve with tortilla chips

title: lemon cream bread
steps:
1. Cream together butter , sugar and cream cheese until light and fluffy
2. Add eggs one at a time , beating well after each one
3. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk and water , blending well
4. Fold in nuts and lemon rind
5. Pour into greased and floured 9x5x3 inch loaf pan
6. Bake at 350 degrees about 1 hour or until golden brown
7. Stir sugar with lemon juice until dissolved
8. Drip over hot loaf and let stand in pan for 30 minutes
9. Turn out on rack

title: easy artichoke crescent squares
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Unroll dough into long rectangle in ungreased 13 x 9 inch pan
3. Seal perforations
4. Press over bottom and 1 / 2 inch up sides to form crust
5. Sprinkle with gouda cheese
6. Bake at 375f
7. For 5 minutes
8. In small bowl , beat cream cheese until smooth
9. Add sour cream , red pepper flakes , salt and egg
10. Blend well
11. Spread over partially baked crust
12. Top with shallots , artichoke hearts , and sundried tomatoes
13. Return to oven and bake an additional 13 to 19 minutes or until edges are deep golden brown and center is set
14. To serve , cut into squares
15. Serve warm or cold
16. Store in refrigerator

title: pusser s painkiller
steps:
1. Place rum , pineapple juice , orange juice and coconut cream into a cocktail shaker
2. Add ice , shake and strain into an ice-filled highball glass
3. Sprinkle with nutmeg

title: fruity bulgur wheat
steps:
1. Place bulgur wheat in a container , and cover with boiling water to a level of 1 / 2in above the bulgur wheat
2. Cover the container and leave for 8 minutes
3. Stir through all of the remaining ingredients and season to taste
4. Serve hot or cold

title: fabulous cut out cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar
2. Beat in egg and vanilla
3. Mix baking powder and flour and add it to the dough one cup at a time , mixing after each addition
4. If the dough is too stiff , add water one tsp at a time
5. Do not chill the dough
6. Divide dough into two balls
7. Between sheets of waxed paper , roll out each ball into a 12" diameter circle , 1 / 8" thick
8. Cut out cookies
9. Bake on an ungreased ccokie sheet at 400 for 6-7 minutes
10. Frost & enjoy !

title: low fat chicken tandoori chutney   banana  pizza
steps:
1. Cut chicken into slices
2. Place in ziploc bag to marinate overnight
3. Combine 1st 7 ingredients
4. Combine with chicken in ziplock bag
5. On wholegrain tortilla , spread chutney as a base , sliced chicken , banana sliced thinly , handful of rocket , crumbled feta and top with coriander
6. On flat tray lined with al foil , place pizza into oven for about 10 - 12 minutes until feta turns light brown
7. Enjoy !

title: slow cooked mushroom pork tenderloins
steps:
1. Place pork in a slow cooker
2. In a bowl , combine the soups
3. Stir until smooth
4. Pour over pork
5. Cover and cook on low for 4-5 hours or until the meat is tender
6. Serve with mashed potatoes if desired

title: mushroom   nut pate
steps:
1. Spread nuts in shallow pan and toast in oven until lightly browned
2. Melt butter or margarine in large frying pan / skilled on medium heat
3. Add onions , garlic , mushrooms , salt , thyme , and pepper
4. Cook , stirring occasionally , 'til onion is soft and most of the juices have evaporated
5. In food processor , whirl nuts to form paste
6. Add oil and whirl until creamy
7. Add mushroom mixture and whirl until smooth
8. Can be served hot , cold , or even at room temperature with fresh bread or your favorite crackers

title: chili roasted salmon
steps:
1. Place salmon on lightly greased baking sheet or broiler pan and season with salt
2. In small bowl , combine vinegar , honey and chili powder and mix well
3. Spread mixture evenly over fish
4. Roast at 400f for 10 to 15 minutes or until fish flakes when tested with fork

title: creamy corn  slow cooker
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in slow cooker
2. Cover and cook on low for 4 hours or until cheese is melted
3. Stir well before serving

title: linda s sugar cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter , sugar , egg and vanilla
2. Add flour
3. Roll out on floured board
4. Cut with desired cutter
5. Bake at 350 for 10-12 minutes
6. Frost / decorate as desired

title: beer mustard
steps:
1. In a small bowl combine the mustard seeds , lager , and malt vinegar
2. Cover and soak overnight
3. Strain the liquid and reserve in a separate container
4. Place the soaked seeds in a food processor and pulse 7 to 8 times
5. In a double boiler , place the cracked seeds and add the strained liquid , allspice , pepper , salt , sugar , dry mustard , garlic , and horseradish
6. Cook about 90 minutes , stirring occasionally
7. Remove from heat and let cool , then refrigerate

title: creamy zucchini quiche
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. Spread the bottom of the pastry shell with the mustard and bake for 10 minutes
3. Cool
4. Reduce oven heat to 350
5. Place zucchini in colander , sprinkle with salt and drain for 5 minutes
6. Saute the mushrooms in butter
7. Sprinkle one cup of jack cheese in the bottom of the pastry shell
8. Spoon mushrooms on top
9. Squeeze zucchini to remove the excess moisture
10. Place in the shell , separating and fluffing with fingers
11. Beat together the cream cheese , cream , egg yolks and egg , season with salt and pepper
12. Place the pastry dish on a baking sheet and carefully pour in egg-cream mixture
13. Sprinkle the remaining jack cheese on top
14. Bake in a 350-degree oven for 45 minutes , until top is puffed and golden and a knife inserted in center comes out clean
15. Let stand for 5 minutes before cutting

title: frozen  chicken in the crock pot
steps:
1. Spray inside of crock pot with cooking spray
2. Rinse chicken and place in cooker
3. Mix chicken gravy with water and wine
4. Pour over chicken
5. Cook on low approximately 6 hours
6. About 1 1 / 2 hours before end of cooking time add carrots and onions
7. When done , take chicken out and let rest on a cutting board at least 15 minutes
8. Take vegetables out of gravy
9. Strain the gravy and thicken to your preference
10. Enjoy with mashed potatoes and a tossed salad !

title: cinco de mayo chicken casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f lightly coat a 13x9 in baking dish with cooking spray
2. In a medium bowl combine cumin , onion powder , paprika , salt , and chili powder
3. Add chicken and toss to coat
4. Set aside
5. Heat a 12 inch saute pan over medium high heat and add 2 tbls oil
6. Saute red onion for 3 minutes
7. Add corn and bell peppers saute 5 minutes then add garlic
8. Saute until lightly browned , about 3 minutes more
9. Remove from pan and set aside
10. In same pan over medium low heat add chipotle pepper , adobo sauce , remaining olive oil , and rice
11. Saute rice until sauce and oil are absorbed
12. Add chicken broth , cream cheese , sour cream , and salsa
13. Heat to a simmer then add veggie mix
14. Cook for 5 minutes or until heat through and the cream cheese is incorporated
15. Prepare corn bread as directed on package
16. Add 1 / 4 cup shredded cheese
17. Add chicken to rice mixture and gently stir
18. Spoon chicken and rice into baking dish and top with remaining cheese
19. Spoon corn bread mix over the top of the cheese and spread evenly
20. Place in oven for 35 minutes or until corn bread , tested with a toothpick comes out clean

title: simple macaroni salad
steps:
1. Cook macaroni according to package directions
2. Drain and rinse with cold water
3. Place in large bowl
4. Add mayonaisse , and mix well to coat all noodles
5. Add more if neccesary
6. Mix in prepared mustard
7. Add green onions , olives and shrimp
8. Stir to combine
9. Cover and chill for several hours

title: blueberry crisp  diabetic
steps:
1. Filling:
2. Toss together flour and sugar
3. Mix together with blueberries and place in a 9x9 inch glass baking dish
4. Topping:
5. Mix all topping ingredients together
6. Sprinkle on top of blueberry filling
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes
8. Makes 6 servings

10. 110 calories 17 g

title: egg cheese souffle
steps:
1. Grease a 9 x 13 inch pan and line with bread to fit bottom
2. Spread bread with mustard
3. Sprinkle swiss cheese and cheddar cheese over bread
4. Beat eggs , milk and salt
5. Add ham and stir all together and pour over bread and cheese
6. Refrigerate overnight , garnish with bacon bits , if desired
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes

title: gazpacho adapted from barefoot contessa
steps:
1. Roughly chop the cucumbers , peppers , tomatoes and red onion into 1-inch cubes
2. Put each vegetable , separately , into a food processor fitted with the steel chopping blade
3. Pulse each until coarsely chopped
4. Do no overprocess !
5. After each vegetable is cut , combine them in a large bowl
6. Add garlic and mix well
7. Whisk together the olive oil and vinegar
8. Add salt and pepper
9. Combine with tomato juice then pour the combination over the vegetables
10. Mix well
11. Chill thoroughly before serving

title: martha stewart chewy chocolate gingerbread
steps:
1. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper
2. In a medium bowl , sift together , flour , ginger , cinnamon , cloves , nutmeg and cocoa
3. In the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the paddle attachment , beat butter and ginger on medium speed until lightened , about 4 minutes
4. Add brown sugar , beat until combined
5. Add molasses , beat until combined
6. In a small bowl , dissolve baking soda in boiling water
7. Beat half of flour mixture into butter mixture
8. Beat in baking soda mixture , then remaining flour mixture
9. Mix in chocolate , turn into plastic wrap
10. Pat out to 1" thickness , seal with wrap
11. Refrigerate until firm , 2 hours or overnight
12. Preheat oven to 325
13. Roll dough into 1 1 / 2" balls , place 2" apart on baking sheets
14. Chill 20 minutes
15. Roll in granulated sugar
16. Bake until surface just begins to crack , 10-12 minutes , rotating halfway through
17. Let cool 5 minutes
18. Transfer to a wire rack and cool completely

title: 7 up pork roast with glaze
steps:
1. In a plastic cooking bag place flour and shake it around to coat the inside of the bag
2. Place the pork loin in the bag
3. In a large bowl , combine the 7-up , red pepper , onion , garlic and soy sauce
4. Pour this over the pork loin
5. Seal the plastic bag and let marinate overnight
6. Turn the pork roast once while in the plastic bag
7. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
8. Place the cooking bag in a large baking dish
9. Cut 6 slits into the top of the bag
10. Let roast for 1 hour 45 minutes to 2 hours or until pork is done
11. Remove the pork roast from the plastic cooking bag and set aside
12. Drain the vegetables away from the liquid
13. Discard the vegetables
14. In a large microwave-safe bowl , combine 2 tbsps wonder flour and 2 tbsps cold water
15. Add 2 tbsps sweet and sour sauce
16. Combine
17. Add the cooking liquid from the pork
18. Microwave on high for 5 minutes or until mixture has thickened
19. Slice the pork roast and serve with the glaze

title: potato cakes with blue cheese and apples
steps:
1. Cook the potatoes in a pan of boiling water for 15 to 20 minutes , or until tender when pierced with a fork
2. Drain and mash potatoes
3. Place nuts and onion in food processor and chop finely
4. Add nuts , onion , apple , cheese and bread crumbs to the potatoes
5. Season with salt and pepper to taste
6. Mix well and shape into 6 equal sized cakes
7. Coat in the flour and let chill for one hour
8. Pan fry in a heavy bottom skillet in corn oil for 5 minutes per side
9. Serve hot

title: summer berry crisp
steps:
1. Preheat the oven 350f
2. Butter a 9-inch pyrex pie plate
3. Gently combine the berries with the sugar , flour , and the cinnamon
4. Place in the prepared pie plate
5. Prepare the topping
6. Combine the oats , flour , both sugars , and salt in a bowl
7. Use a pastry blender or 2 knives to work until topping resembles coarse meal
8. Sprinkle evenly over the berries
9. Place the pie plate on a baking sheet
10. Bake in the center of the oven until the fruit is bubbling and the topping is golden brown , about 1 hour
11. Remove the crisp to a rack to cool slightly
12. Serve in desert bowls with whipped cream or ice cream

title: lumpia  filipino egg roll
steps:
1. Brown beef and pork , until almost completely cooked
2. Drain fat
3. Cool and process in food processor or chop up into fine pieces with fork
4. Combine meats , vegetables , egg , sauces , pepper in a large bowl
5. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes to 1 hour for flavors to set inches i like to prepare my filling the day before so it can marinate all night
6. Prepare wrapper and place on a separate plate
7. Place 1 to 2 t of filling in the center of the wrapper
8. Fold left edge over all the way , then bring down top and bottom , then roll the rest of the way to the right , making a roll
9. Hard to explain without a picture , but you'll figure it out -- looks like an egg roll when done , only thinner and longer
10. Seal with with flour and water mixture
11. After you have assembled all the lumpia , heat your oil to 375 degrees
12. Cook until golden brown , turning often , approximately 3 minutes
13. Drain on paper towels
14. Serve with sweet and sour sauce
15. Times vary by experience and methods used

title: how to prepare salt cod
steps:
1. Rinse the salt cod thoroughly under cool running water
2. Place salt cod in a large container of cold water and soak it up to 24 hours prior to preparing the dish , changing the water several times during soaking
3. Rinse the cod again and measure the fillet at the thickest point
4. Place the soaked fish in a saucepan and add cold water to cover , then add the white vinegar , diced carrot , ribs of celery , quartered onion , any spices desired , half a bay leaf , and dried parsley or a few sprigs fresh parsley
5. Dont add any salt !
6. Bring the cold water to boiling then immediately lower the temperature and simmer the cod gently for 10 minutes per inch of thickness
7. When the time is up the cod is now ready to remove the skin and bones , and you can flake it and use it in any recipe calling for cooked cod

title: mango and spinach salad
steps:
1. Peel mangoes
2. Cut fruit away from the pit and then cut into slices
3. Squeeze juice of both limes into food processor or blender
4. Add one-fourth of the mango slices and the salt , pepper and oil
5. Process until smooth
6. Set aside
7. Preheat small saut pan on medium 2-3 minutes
8. Place pecans in pan
9. Cook 3-4 minutes , stirring often , or until golden and fragrant
10. Place spinach on serving plates , tearing any pieces that are large
11. Arrange remaining 3 / 4 of mango slices over spinach
12. Sprinkle with pecans
13. Drizzle with dressing and serve

title: moroccan saffron rice
steps:
1. Wash the rice in a sieve until the water runs clear , then drain well and set aside
2. Bring the water to a boil , remove from heat and add the saffron
3. Allow to infuse for 20 minutes
4. Heat the oil in a heavy saucepan and add the rice , stirring well so that all the rice is coated evenly in the oil
5. Add the saffron water and salt and stir well
6. Bring to a boil and boil for 1 minute
7. Cover with a tight fitting lid , then simmer for 10-12 minutes until the water is absorbed
8. Turn off the heat and let stand , covered , for at least 10 minutes
9. Add the butter and fluff lightly with a fork
10. Serve and garnish with pistachios

title: honey lacquered duck with sour cherry sauce
steps:
1. Put 10-12 sage leaves into a small saucepan with 1 cup of water and bring to the boil
2. Simmer for 7 minutes and remove from heat
3. Remove leaves and allow to cool
4. Wash the duck out and pat dry with paper towels
5. Season generously with salt and put on a plate in the refrigerator to air-dry for 1 hour )
6. In a small saucepan , combine sage infusion , honey , balsamic vinegar and soy sauce and bring to the boil
7. Boil at medium-high heat for 7-8 minutes until mixture becomes slightly syrupy and is reduced to 2 / 3 of a cup
8. Pour 1 / 3 cup+ 1 tblsp into measuring cup and keep remainder in saucepan
9. Preheat oven to 415f
10. Put duck in roasting pan , breast-side-down and roast for an hour
11. Turn duck breast-side-up and roast an hour longer
12. Brush duck with the honey glaze and continue roasting 15 minutes
13. After the 15 minutes , turn duck so that it is breast-side-down again and brush with more honey glaze , do this once more after 15 minutes then turn duck breast-side-up again , brush with glaze and roast for a final 15 minutes
14. In all , the duck will have roasted a total of 2 hours and have had 4 glazings , 1 up , 2 down , and the last one up again
15. Remove roaster from oven and allow duck to stand for 10 minutes while you finish the sauce
16. Pour off the fat you have retained into a small container and pour any accumulated duck juices into the saucepan containing the remaining honey glaze
17. Add the cherries and any accumulated cherry juices as well as the cinnamon and bring to a boil
18. Boil for 7-8 minutes , or until cherry sauce has become slightly-thickened and syrupy
19. Carve duck , and serve with the sour cherry sauce

title: authentic pasta sauce
steps:
1. Brown ribs in oil
2. Remove ribs from oil and saute the onions and garlic till transparent
3. Add tomatoes and water
4. Raise heat and allow sauce to boil , mixing occasionally so bottom doesn't burn
5. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 2 hours till meat is falling off the bones
6. Enjoy ! : )

title: finnish carrots
steps:
1. Boil rice in salted water until almost tender
2. Drain
3. Boil carrots
4. Let cool and grate
5. Butter a 2 qt casserole
6. Combine all ingredients and pour mixture into casserole
7. Dot with butter and sprinkle bread crumbs on top
8. Bake at 375 for 30-35 minutes

title: italian cauliflower salad
steps:
1. Put cauliflower in lightly salted boiling water for 3 minutes , remove and put in cold water for 30 minutes or more , drain well before mixing with dressing
2. In a bowl combine oil , lemon juice , capers , olives , onion , celery parsley , salt& pepper , mix well
3. Add well drained cold cauliflower , toss
4. Place in serving dish& serve

title: herbed chevre  craisin and walnut pinwheels
steps:
1. In medium bowl , combine softened cream cheese , chvre cheese , a pinch of herbes de provence , green onions , dried cranberries and chopped walnuts
2. Evenly spread 1 / 4 of the mixture onto each tortilla , all the way to the edges
3. Roll up tightly , being careful not to tear
4. Wrap each in plastic wrap
5. Refrigerate for several hours or overnight
6. Slice to serve
7. Makes about 32 appetizers

title: tropical berry smoothies
steps: 1. Add all ingredients and blend until smooth

title: oven fried lemon crumb fish
steps:
1. Using the pulse setting of your food processor , combine bread and lemon zest until coarse crumbs are formed
2. Mix mustard and lemon juice together in a small bowl
3. Spray a baking pan with non-stick spray
4. Sprinkle both sides of fillets with salt and pepper
5. Brush fillets with mustard mixture , then coat with crumbs
6. Pressing gently so that crumbs adhere
7. Place fillets on the baking pan , spray the top lightly with non-stick spray
8. Bake in a pre-heated oven until coating is golden and the fish just opaque in the center , about 8 minutes
9. Serve immediately

title: sweet cannelloni casserole
steps:
1. In a bowl combine ricotta cheese , 50 g sugar , cinnamon , raisins and 1 egg
2. Cut the apple into small chunks and add it
3. Use a piping bag to fill the canneloni with the ricotta mixture
4. Place them carefully in an oven-proof dish
5. Chopp the marzipane or marzipane chocolate finely
6. Mix with milk , remaining egg and remaining sugar
7. Pour over canneloni
8. Cover the dish with aluminium foil
9. Bake on the second lowest rack at 190c in the preheated oven for about 25 minutes
10. Then remove the cover and bake for another 15 minutes or until golden brown

title: ina s herbed basmati  rice
steps:
1. Combine the rice , 1 3 / 4 cups water , the salt , and butter in a small heavy-bottomed saucepan
2. Bring to a boil over high heat
3. Reduce the heat to low , stir once , and simmer , covered tightly , for 15 minutes
4. Turn off the heat , and allow the rice to sit covered for 5 minutes
5. Add the parsley , dill , scallions , and pepper
6. Fluff with a fork , and serve warm

title: honey pecan butter
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients into softened butter
2. Chill until ready to serve

title: gin soaked raisins  purported arthritis remedy
steps:
1. Before you get started , make sure to read the label of your gin to check that it is made from or includes juniper berries
2. This is critical !
3. Put the raisins in a shallow glass container and pour enough gin into it to just cover the raisins
4. Cover the container with cheesecloth and allow to stand until the raisins absorb the gin and the remaining liquid evaporates , about one week
5. Each day , eat nine of these "drunken" raisins
6. I have read that it might take six weeks for this remedy to work , so be patient

title: applesauce salad
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Serve hot or cold

title: super bowl nachos
steps:
1. Crumble beef and sausage into a wide frying pan over medium-high heat
2. Add onion and cook , stirring to break up meat , until meat is lightly browned
3. Spoon off fat
4. Season to taste with salt and hot pepper seasoning
5. Spread beans in a shallow 10x15-inch baking pan or oven proof dish
6. Top evenly with meat mixture , sprinkle with chiles and cheese , then drizzle with taco sauce
7. Bake , uncovered , in a 400 oven for 20-25 minutes or until very hot throughout
8. Meanwhile , prepare garnishes of your choice
9. Remove pan from oven and quickly garnish , mounding avocado and sour cream in the center , and adding other garnishes as desired
10. Quickly tuck tortilla chips around edges of bean mixture and serve immediately
11. If desired , keep platter hot on an electric warming tray

title: mediterranean sauce
steps:
1. Prepare tomatoesand set aside
2. Saute onion and garlic in olive oil untilonion is transparent
3. Add all remaining ingreients
4. Bring sauce to a boil and reduce heat , cover and simmer for about 15 to 20 minutes
5. Pour sauce over pasta , toss and serve

title: spinach and lemon rice pilaf
steps:
1. Bring the stock to a boil , add rice , reduce heat to low and simmer till done
2. Melt the butter in a frying pan , add spinach , carrot and green onions , saute over medium low heat till spinach is wilted and vegetables softened , about 2 minutes
3. Stir vegetable mixture and lemon juice into hot cooked rice , fluff with fork and serve

title: inside outs
steps:
1. Cookies:
2. Set racks in uper & lower thirds of oven & preheat to 325f
3. Cream butter & sugar on medium speed for 5 - 10 minutes until light , soft & fluffy
4. Fold in flour by hand
5. Place a handful of dough at a time on a lightly floured work surface
6. Use the floured palm of your hand to press out the dough until it is 1 / 2" thick - don't make the dough too thin
7. If the dough seems to be sticking , run a long , thin spatula underneath to loosen it
8. Do not use a lot of extra flour or your cookies will be dry & tough !
9. Cut out the shortbreads with a 2" - 4" round cookie cutter , that has been dipped in flour
10. With a spatula or pancake turner , transfer cookies to a parchment lined cookie sheet
11. Space about 1 1 / 2" apart
12. Continue until all the dough has been used
13. Bake 15 - 20 minutes until they are just a very pale golden color
14. Slide parchment onto cooling racks
15. When cool , remove cookies to an airtight container
16. Filling:
17. Beat butter until soft & light , gradually beat in sugar & cocoa powder
18. Beat in the vanilla & coffee and continue beating until the filling is very smooth
19. Use the filling immediately
20. Assembly:
21. Spread about 1 heaping tb filling between 2 shortbread cookies
22. Store in an airtight container

title: tomato florentine soup with pasta
steps:
1. Combine tomatoes , water , onion powder , basil , carrot , onion , bouillon cubes and salt in a large soup pot
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat to low and simmer , covered for 10 or 15 minutes
4. Add pasta
5. Simmer , covered , about 15 minutes longer or until pasta is tender
6. Stir in spinach
7. Heat through
8. Serve with grated parmesan cheese if desired

title: ribbon fantasy fudge
steps:
1. Combine 1 1 / 2 cups sugar , 6 tbsp
2. Butter , and 1 / 3 cup milk in heavy 1 1 / 2 quart saucepan
3. Bring to full rolling boil , stirring constantly
4. Continue boiling 4 minutes over medium heat , stirring constantly
5. Remove from heat
6. Stir in chocolate pieces until melted
7. Add 1 cup marshmallow cream and 1 / 2 tsp
8. Vanilla
9. Beat until blended
10. Pour into greased 13 x 9 pan
11. Repeat with remaining ingredients substituting peanut butter for chocolate pieces
12. Spread over chocolate layer , cool at room temperature
13. Makes 3 lbs

title: tofu whipped cream
steps:
1. Whip ingredients together in food processor until very smooth
2. Refrigerate for several hours before serving

title: roasted asian chicken wings
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Line a baking sheet with 1 inch sides with aluminum foil
3. In a large bowl season the chicken wings with the essence , salt and white pepper and toss to thoroughly coat
4. Spread the wings in baking dish evenly and roast until browned , about 35 minutes
5. While the wings are baking combine the remaining ingredients except sesame seeds and diaganolly sliced green onions in a large skillet
6. Heat over medium-high heat and bring to a boil
7. Stir occasionally until the sugar is dissolved and the liquid has reduced to a syrup , about 30 minutes
8. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm until ready to use
9. Place the wings in a large heat-proof bowl
10. Drizzle half of the sauce over the wings and toss to coat well
11. Sprinkle the sesame seeds over the wings and toss again
12. Place a wire cooling rack inside a large baking sheet lined with foil and arrange the coated wings on top of the rack
13. Return the pan to the oven and bake an additional 20 to 25 minutes or until cooked through and crispy
14. Arrange the wings on a serving platter and top with the diagonally sliced green onions
15. Sprinkle with kosher salt and serve immediately with the remaining sauce on the side

title: meat pie with phyllo dough
steps:
1. In a pan , heat the garlic with half of the olive oil
2. Add in the ground meat and small onion
3. When the meat is almost cooked through add in the tomato paste
4. Add in the salt , pepper , cinnamon and all spice to your taste
5. When cooked completely through , remove from heat and set aside in a bowl
6. Preheat the oven to 375f degrees
7. In a large lasagna size glass pan , spray the bottom of the pan with pam
8. Add one sheet of the phyllo dough
9. Spray that sheet and add another layer the same way until you have 5 sheets sprayed down with the pam and layered on top of each other
10. You can let it go over the sides if the pan is too small for the sheet
11. Once you have the 5 sheets , add the meat to the sheets and spread evenly
12. Add the feta cheese evenly on top of the meat mixture
13. Make sure it is crumbled small
14. You do not want large chunks in one spot
15. Once you are through with that , start to add the remaining sheets the same way you did to begin with , remembering to spray each sheet as you layer
16. On the top layer , i sprayed with the pam and also put the remaining olive oil on it spread evenly
17. You do not have to do this , i just like the extra taste
18. I also folded over the overlay to make it seal somewhat
19. Cook for about 15-17 minutes or until it is lightly golden on the top

title: ricotta filled brownie squares
steps:
1. Melt butter and stir in cocoa
2. Set aside to cool slightly
3. Beat eggs , sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy
4. Add combined dry ingredients and mix well
5. Add chocolate mixture and stir thoroughly
6. Pour half of the batter into a greased 8" square pan
7. Layer will be very thin but smooth to edges
8. Drop ricotta filling on top and smooth to edges
9. Drop remaining brownie batter by spoonfuls over ricotta filling to cover
10. Don't worry if ricotta is not entirely covered
11. Bake at 350 for 35-40 minutes or until toothpick tests clean
12. Let cool and cut into 2" squares
13. Ricotta filling: combine all ingredients and beat until creamy

title: microwave french toast
steps:
1. Whisk milk , egg , vanilla , and cinnamon together in a shallow bowl
2. Soak 1 slice of bread in egg mixture , then flip it over and soak the other side
3. Soak for no more than 30 seconds
4. Place eggy bread on a microwavable plate , and microwave on high for one minute
5. Repeat with other slices of bread
6. Garnish with syrup

title: water chestnut casserole
steps:
1. Saute onion in 3 / 4 stick of butter until translucent
2. Add all ingredients except topping and mix well
3. Pour mixed ingredients into a large greased casserole
4. Mix topping ingredients together and sprinkle over casserole
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes to 1 hour

title: low carb buttermilk bread  a b m
steps:
1. Place ingredients , in the order listed , in the bread pan fitted with the kneading paddle
2. Place the breadpan in the cuisinart convection bread maker
3. Presss menu and select low carb
4. Choose medium crust setting , or to taste
5. Select dough size
6. Press start to mix , knead , rise and bake
7. When cycle is complete , remove bread to wire rack to cool
8. Bread slices best when allowed to cool

title: mombasa coffee
steps:
1. Boil the cardamom , cinnamon , and cloves in the water in a pot for 10 minutes
2. Add the coffee and boil 5 minutes longer
3. Pour into a serving pot , but do not strain the spices
4. Allow to stand until the grounds settle , then pour into small cups
5. You can also make this by adding the whole spices and coffee to the basket of an automatic coffee brewer

title: delicious vegetarian gravy
steps:
1. In a medium sauce pan , melt the butter over medium heat
2. Add the onion , carrots , celery , celery leafs , peppercorns , and bay leafs
3. Cook until very dark but not burned
4. 40-50 minutes
5. Stir in the flour and cook for 2-3 minutes
6. Slowly pour in the broth while stirring constantly
7. Bring to a boil , and then drop the heat to low , cover , and cook for 20 minutes
8. Strain through a cheesecloth and serve immediately
9. Enjoy

title: spicy summer fruit salad
steps:
1. Combine blueberries , strawberries , raspberries , blackberries , peaches , plums , jalapeno pepper and sugar in a large bowl
2. Mix gently
3. Stir together jam , lime juice and mint in a small bowl until smooth
4. Pour over berry mixture and toss gently to combine
5. Let stand at room temperature 20-30 minutes before serving

title: chicken curry kerala style
steps:
1. Marinate the chicken in chilli powder , turmeric powder , black pepper powder and salt for 15-20 minutes
2. Then add in chopped onions chopped garlic chopped ginger slit green chilles and curry leaves and set aside for another 1 / 2 an hour
3. Meanwhile dry roast the corriander seeds and the chillies till lightly browned
4. Make a paste of this when at room temperature
5. Keep aside
6. Dry roast the scraped coconut till it is brown in colour
7. Make a paste of this too , when at room temperature , and set aside
8. Mix in the dry roasted corriander and chilli paste to the chicken and marinate for another 1 hour or more
9. Heat a thick bottom wok or a deep pan add the chicken and 1 cup of water and cook covered on high flame making sure the chicken doesn't scorch
10. Keep cooking on low after this , while stirring ocassionally
11. When the chicken is done add the coconut paste and cook for some more time
12. Finally heat some coconut oil and splutter the mustard seeds and add sliced onions , when they are light brown in colour add the curry leaves and 2 tbsp of scraped coconut
13. Fry till the coconuts are slightly browned
14. Pour this onto the chicken and mix
15. Cover and remove from flame
16. Serve after some time with kerala parottas

title: arborio rice coating
steps:
1. Put the rice in a blender and grind until very fine
2. Shake out into a large bowl and add the semolina , flour , salt , and pepper
3. Toss until well blended
4. Store in a sealed container in the freezer to maintain maximum freshness

title: simple chicken mole
steps:
1. In the 1 tbsp of oil place the chicken skin down , in a large sauce pan or frying pan
2. One large enough to make your sauce in later
3. Fry the chicken on both sides until skin is brown and slightly
4. Season with salt , pepper , and garlic to your own taste ,
5. After chicken is done , set aside and let cool while you make the sauce
6. Then shred the chicken with a fork or by hand
7. Removing any veins or fat and skin from the chicken
8. With the drippings in the pan from the chicken put your chili powder and flour , brown very slightly
9. Remove from heat and add the water about 1 / 2 cup at a time while whisking to keep it a smooth paste
10. Once you have it smooth , return to heat and continue to add water and whisk add about 8 oz
11. Of water then let cook for a few minutes , whisk then add more
12. Repeat water and whisking and heating until it is a thick gravy
13. Now you can add salt , pepper , cumin and garlic to your own taste
14. After you have the sauce to the desired consistency add the shredded chicken and serve with red rice and flour tortillas

title: babganoush hummus pasta  vegan
steps:
1. Heat a large pot of water to a boil , salt water and cook pasta to al dente
2. While water boils heat extra-virgin olive oil in a deep skillet over medium heat
3. Add garlic and cook 1 to 2 minutes then add the eggplant and chick peas and stir to coat
4. Season the chick peas and eggplant with cumin , coriander , red pepper flakes , salt and pepper , cover with lid and allow to cook for about 10 minutes
5. Stir in lemon zest and continue to cook until eggplant has broken down , about another 5 to 10 minutes
6. Remove the vegetables from the pan and place into a blender or food processor
7. Add the vegetable stock and tahini paste and process until a sauce consistency
8. Add the sauce back to the saucepan and heat over low heat until ready to serve
9. Add a ladle of starchy cooking liquid to the sauce , drain pasta and toss pasta with chickpea-eggplant sauce 1 minute then top with parsley and pine nuts
10. Place into a serving dish

title: bread and butter pudding   gluten free
steps:
1. Mix and whisk together the eggs , milk and cream in a medium sized bowls
2. Remove crusts from bread and butter each slice
3. Cut bread slices in half into traingles
4. Grease an oven-proof dish or ramekins
5. Layer the bread into the bottom of the dishes
6. Overlap the bread in layers so that it looks pleasing
7. Any bread that is above the custard layer will brown beautifully
8. Sprinkle the dried fruit over the bread
9. Pour the custard mixture over the bread and then sprinkle over cinamon
10. Bake at 180c for 20-30 minutes
11. Pudding is best eaten warm but can be eaten cold also

title: tgi friday s spinach and artichoke dip
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Place in shallow casserole dish
3. You can either bake the dip for about 15-20 minutes at 325 but it can also be heated in the microwave for a few minutes

title: roasted new potatoes with shallots
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees
2. Combine the potatoes with the shallots in a large bowl
3. Add all remaining ingredients
4. Toss to coat evenly
5. Pour the mixture into a shallow baking dish and roast for about 30 minutes , mixing about halfway through

title: delicious chilli con carne
steps:
1. Sweat the onion , garlic , chilli and thyme in 2 tablespoons oil in a large saucepan
2. At the same time , brown the mince in a separate pan over moderate heat in a little oil
3. Add the dried spices to the onion mixture and cook until they release their aroma
4. Then stir in the beef and mix well
5. Add the fresh and tinned tomatoes and leave to cook down a little for about 5 minutes
6. Pour in the chicken or beef stock and stir in tomato puree to taste
7. Drop the cinnamon and bay leaf in then bring to the boil and leave to simmer
8. Once the sauce is beginning to thicken add the kidney beans and leave to cook for another 5-10 minutes to allow the beans to soak up the flavours
9. Check for seasoning
10. Serve over steaming hot rice

title: crumpets with fruit  ricotta   maple syrup
steps:
1. Toast crumpets on both sides and spread tops liberally with ricotta cheese
2. Top with fruit and nuts and drizzle with maple syrup to serve

title: a bit of everything chicken salad
steps:
1. Whisk together dressing ingredients , whisking in oil in a slow stream
2. Dressing will be used for both marinating the chicken and for salad dressing
3. With one third of the dressing marinate chicken for 1 hour and then broil chicken , discarding the marinade
4. Shred or chop chicken
5. Mix together salad ingredients with shredded chicken
6. Toss
7. Garnish with cashews , sunflower seeds , raisins and green onion
8. Toss
9. Whisk dressing again and then toss salad with remaining dressing

steps:

title: margarita steaks
steps:
1. In a glass baking dish combine all the ingredients except steaks , mix well
2. Place steaks in mixture turning to coat both sides
3. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours to marinate , turning steaks over occasionally
4. Fire-up the grill , when ready , remove steaks from marinade , reserving marinade
5. Grill steaks to desired doneness , turning once and brushing occasionally with marinade

title: dessert sauce for fruit
steps:
1. Mix the honey and balsamic vinegar
2. Taste and then add pepper to taste
3. Mix with fruit and let sit for 15-20 minutes for the fruit to soak in the flavor
4. Enjoy

title: honeydew melon soup
steps:
1. Add first 5 ingredients to the bowl of a food processor
2. Pulse a few times to combine , then process until smooth
3. Refrigerate for a few hours before serving
4. To serve , divide soup among 4 bowls
5. Stir a tablespoon of the yogurt into each bowl
6. Toss a couple of the melon balls , mint , and pistachios into each

title: thai flavoured prawn salad  21 day wonder diet  day 14
steps:
1. Cook rice in large saucepan of boiling water , uncovered , until tender , drain , cool
2. Combine rice in large bowl with remaining ingredients

title: palomino chop chop salad
steps:
1. Make dressing in a mixing bowl
2. Whisk egg yolks for 2-3 minutes , then add vinegar , garlic , salt and pepper
3. Whisk 2-3 minutes
4. Slowly add oil to emulsify
5. Refrigerate until needed

7. Add cup dressing
8. Toss to combine
9. Add parmesan , turkey , and toss
10. Place salad on plate
11. Top with tomato
12. Serve with pepper mill
13. The restaurant offers this as 1 large serving but with crusty bread and a cold drink it is a very nice dinner for 2
14. Also great side for 4-6 servings

title: matzoh balls
steps:
1. Add salt , pepper and club soda to yolks
2. Beat yolks on high speed
3. Beat egg whites until stiff
4. Fold yolks into whites with a fork
5. Fold matzoh meal in with a fork , 1 / 2 cup at a time , until mixture is of medium consistency
6. You will need at least 2 cups matzoh meal
7. Cover the bowl with foil and refrigerate at least 30-40 minutes
8. Boil water in a large pot
9. Form balls of mixture with hands
10. Drop into the boiling water
11. Cook matzoh balls in a covered pot over low heat for 30-40 minutes
12. Add to soup when serving

title: pizza balls
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400'
2. Lightly grease a large cookie sheet
3. In a large bowl mix all the ingredients and mix well
4. Roll into balls and place on cookie sheet a inch apart
5. Bake 20 minutes or until browned and no longer pinkish color

title: banana baileys shake
steps:
1. Cut banana into pieces
2. Put all ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth
3. Pour into a chilled glass and serve

title: sweet   creamy butternut squash soup from disney s boma
steps:
1. In a small pot , melt the butter and pour over the squash
2. Season squash with salt and pepper and roast in 325-degree oven for 45 minutes
3. In a kettle , mix squash with water
4. Add heavy cream and milk and puree using an immersion blender
5. Add sugar , ginger , nutmeg , cinnamon , and coriander
6. Make a slurry with the cornstarch and add to the soup
7. Add the american cheese and continue mixing until smooth
8. Adjust seasoning

title: triple almond cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter and powdered sugar
2. Add almond paste , egg and extract
3. Beat at medium speed until smooth
4. Add baking soda , cream of tartar , salt & flour
5. Mix until well blended
6. Shape into walnut sized balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet
7. Place 1 whole almond firmly onto top of each ball but do not flatten too far
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 9-10 minutes
9. Cool on sheet for 1 minute , then move to wire racks to finish cooling

title: sformato di patate
steps:
1. Steam or boil whole unpeeled potatoes until not quite tender
2. When cool enough for handling , slice potatoes on a mandolin , no more than 1 / 8 inch thick , preferably thinner
3. Chop bacon into matchsticks or cubes
4. Slice the onions and saute' with bacon and olive oil in a large non-stick frying pan
5. Add the potatoes when the onions and bacon are about half cooked
6. Blend ingredients with 1 tbsp salt , being careful not to break up the potato slices too much
7. Whisk the eggs with the parmigiano and pour over the potato and onion mixture
8. Cover and cook over very low flame for 15 minutes
9. Here's the only tricky part:
10. Uncover and turn off flame
11. Place a plate or platter upside-down over the pan , keeping one hand firmly on the bottom of the plate , and the other on the pan handle , as close to the pan as you can - you need a strong grip
12. Now , flip the plate and pan in a single , decisive motion so that the plate is now on the bottom
13. You should now have the golden brown bottom of the sformato on top , and the uncooked top on the bottom
14. Remove the pan and replace on stove
15. Slide the 'sformato' , now a more or less cohesive unit , back into the pan so that the uncooked side is now in contact with the pan
16. Sprinkle browned side with black pepper
17. Cover and cook for 15 more minutes
18. Slide the finished 'sformato' onto a clean platter
19. Let cool for at least 30 minutes , slice into wedges and serve as a side dish or as a main course

title: fiesta chicken and bean burritos
steps:
1. Wrap the tortillas in foil and heat in the oven on low heat to make the tortillas pliable
2. Heat oil in a heavy , deep pot
3. Add onion , garlic , spices , oregano and bay leaf
4. Sautee until the onion is translucent taking care not to burn the garlic
5. Add the chicken , tomatoes , chilies stirring to heat throughout
6. Add the beans and rice to the chicken mixture , stir to combine and cover
7. Heat about 5 minutes or until heated thoughout , stirring occasionally to prevent sticking
8. Remove from heat
9. Remove the tortillas from the oven and unwrap
10. Fill the tortillas by placing about 1 / 2 of filling in a line down the center top with a sprinkling of cheese leaving an inch or so at the top and bottom
11. Fold the tortilla at the top and bottom then fold over one side and roll towards the other side
12. At this point the burritos can be frozen for future use
13. I wrap them in waxed paper then foil
14. If not freezing , place in an oblong casserole dish with the seam side down
15. Top with remaining cheese and optional toppings
16. Cover with foil and bake at 400of for about 10 minutes , until cheese is melted

steps:
1. Cook rice according to package directions
2. Meanwhile , slice steak 1 / 4-inch thick , then cut slices crosswise in half

title: haitian rice and beans
steps:
1. Bring water to boiling
2. Add red beans and cook covered for 1 1 / 2 hours
3. Drain beans , reserving liquid , and set aside
4. Add enough water to bean liquid to equal 2 1 / 2 cups of liquid
5. Set aside
6. In a mortar , pound together to form a paste the salt , parsley , scallions , garlic , and rosemary
7. Heat oil and seasoning paste in a dutch oven over medium heat
8. Put rice in dutch oven and stir until well coated with oil
9. Add reserved liquid and bring to a boil , stirring
10. Add beans and again bring to a boil
11. Reduce heat , cover , and cook undisturbed for 20 minutes
12. Remove cover , stir , and cook about 5 minutes longer , or until no liquid remains

title: tasty brown sugar pork chops
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Place the pork chops in a 9x13 inch baking pan
3. Place 1 tablespoon of brown sugar on top of every pork chop
4. Place 1 tablespoon of margarine on top of the brown sugar
5. Sprinkle the pork chops with soy sauce
6. Cover the pan with foil and bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes
7. Remove foil and bake for an additional 15 minutes , until browned

title: chorizo chicken stoup
steps:
1. Heat a large pot over high heat with 2 tablespoons olive oil
2. When you see a ripple in the oil , add in the sliced chorizo
3. Cook , stirring frequently , for 2 minutes
4. Remove the chorizo with a slotted spoon and reserve
5. Add in the chicken
6. Season with salt , pepper , and cumin
7. Brown chicken on all sides for 3-4 minutes
8. Add in the reserved chorizo , onion , garlic , bell pepper , and celery
9. Cook for 3 minutes , stirring often
10. Add in sherry vinegar
11. Stir
12. Then add the chicken stock , diced tomatoes , and chickpeas
13. Bring to a simmer , turn heat down to med-low and simmer for 10 minutes

steps:

3. Score underside of shrimp using a knife at several places to flatten

7. Place tempura sauce ingredients in a pan and bring to a boil and simmer 2-3 minutes
8. Keep warm
9. For batter , combine egg and ice water in a bowl , add flour combined with cornstarch and mix very lightly
10. Place two ice cubes in the mixture to keep it cool and to improve the batter texture
11. Do not over mix
12. Preheat oil to 350 degrees f

14. Fry few pieces at a time to keep the oil temperature constant
15. Tempura pieces are done when they are lightly colored and crisp looking
16. Do not over cook
17. Place approximately 1 1 / 2 c cooked rice each into 4 bowls and place tempura pieces evenly onto hot rice and sprinkle some sauce over the rice tempura bowl

title: whole wheat  honey sweetened oatmeal chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Cream the butter and honey together in the bowl of a stand mixer
2. Add the egg , vanilla and milk and stir until it's all combined and creamy
3. In a small bowl , whisk all the dry ingredients together and then add them to the wet batter
4. Stir to incorporate
5. Add oats , orange zest and chocolate chips
6. Mix
7. On a silpat or parchment paper lined cookie sheet spoon out the cookie batter
8. I use about a tablespoon per cookie
9. Bake at 350 degrees for 10 to 12 minutes , until the cookies are nicely browned

title: smoked and fresh salmon rillettes
steps:
1. Chilling time of 6 hours not included in cook time
2. Brush olive oil over fresh salmon
3. Wrap in aluminum foil and cook in oven preheated to 400 degreesf for 8 minutes
4. Remove and let cool
5. Break up cooked salmon by hand into smaller chunks of about 1 / 2 inch
6. Cut smoked salmon into similar-size pieces
7. Chop shallots , capers and chives and hand mix in a stainless steel bowl with cooked salmon , smoked salmon , yogurt , lime juice and clarified butter
8. Mix in tabasco , then place mixture in a 4-cup terrine mould and refrigerate , covered , 6 hours
9. Serve sliced 1 inch thick with pommeroy mustard mayonnaise

title: back yard barbecued breakfast
steps:
1. Fire up the grill
2. Take an aluminum foil cooking bag sprayed with pam or other non-stick cooking spray , sprinkle with seasoning salt and put some pats of butter in the foil bag
3. Open a bag of hash browns , beat the eggs , chop the onions , and pour all ingredients into the bag of hash browns , and mix by squeezing
4. Then pour this mixture into the foil cooking bag and spread it out
5. Add some seasoning salt and pepper to taste and a bit more butter on top of the hash brown mixture
6. Place the aluminum cooking bag on the grill over medium coals and turn the bag every five minutes
7. The bag will start to puff and you can open it to check for doneness

title: how to make texas roadhouse cheese fries
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 450f
2. Cook bacon in a medium-sized frying pan oven medium-high heat
3. Take out bacon when crisp and put on a paper towel to dry
4. Pour bacon grease into a bowl and allow to cool slightly
5. Add garlic salt , onion powder , and seasoned salt to the grease and stir to mix
6. Set aside
7. Arrange the fries on a greased baking sheet and bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until slightly golden
8. Set oven to broil
9. Brush the bacon oil an seasoning mix onto each fry
10. Place fries in an oven-safe bowl
11. Spread the cheddar cheese over the fries
12. Crumble bacon slices , then sprinkle over cheese
13. Place dish in oven for about 5 minutes , or until the cheese is bubbly
14. Remove from the oven and allow to sit for a few minutes , then serve

3. Put fries on a plate with hamburger meat on top of fries
