title: bobs italian sausage tortellini soup
steps:
1. Place the sausage in a large pot over medium high heat brown the sausage
2. Add the onions , garlic , peppers and carrots
3. When those ingredients have softened , add the beef broth , water
4. Next add the beef stock , water , wine , tomatoes , basil , oregano and tomato sauce
5. Bring to a boil , reduce heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes , skimming any fat that may surface
6. Add the zucchini , yellow squash , and tortellini , simmer for 10 minutes , or until tortellini is fully cooked

title: harvard beets
steps:
1. Combine sugar , cornstarch , butter , water and vinegar
2. Cook until smooth and thick
3. Add beets
4. Heat thoroughly and serve while hot

title: basic breakfast granola cereal
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f degrees
2. In a huge bowl , mix all ingredients together until well blended , evenly coating all pieces
3. Spread onto a cookie sheet
4. Bake for 15 minutes
5. Stir well
6. Bake for 15 minutes more
7. Cool completely
8. Store tightly covered in giant container or zip lock bags

title: sausage date balls
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Stir well and shape into 1-inch balls
3. Place on lightly greased baking sheets
4. Bake at 350f for 20 minutes or until browned
5. Serve warm or at room temperature
6. Yield: 4 1 / 2 dozen

title: sweet   sour hamburger
steps:
1. Brown hamburger in a frying pan until well crumbled
2. Rinse under hot water , to remove any excess grease , in a colander
3. Return to frying pan
4. While it is frying , add all other ingredients in a microwave safe bowl
5. Microwave for about 5 minutes or until sugar is melted and boiling , stirring occasionally
6. Add to rinsed hamburger and bring to a boil
7. Simmer for about 30 - 45 minutes until all of the liquid is gone and the hamburger has turned dark brown and is crystallized
8. Serve over rice

title: asian noodle soup
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients , except noodles , in a soup pot
2. Simmer about 20 minutes until vegetables are tender
3. Cook pasta according to package directions in a separate pot
4. Add drained noodles to soup right before serving

title: cuban garlic sauce
steps:
1. Crush garlic and salt in a mortar and pestle or in a food processor until it forms a smooth paste
2. Combine garlic , onion , and orange juice in a bowl
3. Heat oil in a skillet , add mixture , and stir for 3 minutes
4. This sauce can be used immediately or stored in refrigerator and reheated

title: grilled pizza with  hummus  veggies  goat cheese and olives
steps:
1. For the hummus:
2. Place the chickpeas , garlic , cayenne pepper , lemon juice , honey and tahini in the bowl of a food processor and process until smooth
3. With the machine running , slowly add the olive oil until emulsified
4. Season with salt and pepper , to taste
5. For the pizza:
6. Heat the grill to high
7. Brush both sides of the pizzas with olive oil and season with salt and pepper
8. Grill until golden brown on both sides , about 2 minutes per side
9. Top each pizza with the spicy hummus
10. Arrange desired veggies on top of the hummus and top with the goat cheese
11. Season with salt , pepper and ancho chili powder
12. Place the bread back on the grill , close the cover and grill for 5 minutes to heat through
13. Remove and add black olives and fresh basil
14. Pizza dough:
15. 2 / 3 cup lukewarm water
16. 2 1 / 2 teaspoons active dry yeast
17. 1 / 2 teaspoon sugar
18. 2 tablespoons olive oil , plus additional for oiling bowl
19. 1 3 / 4 to 2 cups all-purpose flour
20. 1 / 4 cup finely ground yellow cornmeal
21. 2 teaspoons coarse salt
22. In a large bowl stir together 1 / 3 cup water , yeast , and sugar and let stand until foamy , about 10 minutes
23. Stir in remaining 1 / 3 cup water , 2 tablespoons oil , 1 3 / 4 cups flour , cornmeal , and salt and blend until the mixture forms a dough
24. Knead dough on a floured surface , incorporating as much of remaining 1 / 4 cup flour , as necessary , to prevent dough from sticking , until smooth about 5 to 10 minutes
25. Form the dough into a ball
26. Lightly oil the sides and bottom of a large bowl with oil , add the dough , turn to coat in the oil , cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled in size , about 1 hour
27. Gently punch the dough down and divide into 4 equal pieces
28. Roll each piece on a lightly floured surface into a 10-inch circle that is 1 / 8-inch thick
29. Brush off excess flour and transfer the dough to a baking sheet , cover each circle of dough with plastic wrap and continue stacking rolled out pieces on top of each other
30. Wrap well with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to grill

title: delictably different  coffee  cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Lightly spray 9x13 inch baking pan with pam or baker's joy to keep cake from sticking
3. In large mixing bowl , prepare cake mix according to directions , using the 1 cup of butter , 3 eggs and 1 1 / 4 cup water
4. Pour into baking pan
5. In separate smaller bowl , blend cream cheese until fluffy , add one egg and continue to beat for approximately one minute
6. Add confectioner's sugar and blend well
7. Add coffee creamer and mix slowly until well blended
8. Pour this mixture over the top of cake mix and lightly blend in with a knife for a"marbled" texture
9. Bake at 350 degrees for 35-45 minutes , or until the middle no longer jiggles
10. Serve warm or when cool

title: chocolate meringue kisses
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees
2. Grease three cookies sheets and dust with cocoa powder
3. Melt the chocolate square and set aside to cool
4. Beat the egg whites with salt until soft peaks form
5. Add sugar slowly and beat until mixture very stiff and shiny
6. Fold in vanilla , melted chocolate , and the 1 tbsp cocoa powder
7. Drop by heaping teaspoonfulls onto prepared cookie sheets
8. They will have the shape of chocolate kisses
9. Bake 30 to 40 minutes
10. Remove cookies from sheets immediately
11. Cool completely and store in an airtight container

title: tavern on the green s chicken francais
steps:
1. Pound chicken breasts between two sheets of plastic wrap to make uniform thickness for even cooking
2. Dredge chicken breasts in flour , shaking off excess
3. Heat clarified butter in saut skillet over medium-high heat
4. Place chicken in pan and saut until cooked halfway through , about three minutes
5. Reduce heat to medium
6. Turn chicken over and add minced shallots and garlic
7. Cook for one minute until you can smell the aroma of garlic , and then add wine to deglaze pan
8. Season with salt and pepper
9. Add mustard and stir into sauce
10. Let sauce cook for two minutes to reduce , and then add heavy cream
11. Let sauce cook for another two minutes to thicken sauce slightly
12. Serve with chardonnay

title: grilled green or red tomato with herbs
steps:
1. Cut tomatoes crosswise into 1 / 2-inch-thick rounds
2. In a large zip lock bag , gently mix tomato slices , olive oil , tabasco or hot pepper flakes , sugar , salt and black pepper , garlic , oregano and the marjoram
3. Add salt and pepper to taste
4. Seal and chill at least 30 minutes or overnight
5. Remove tomatoes from marinade and lay on an oiled grill over medium heat cover gas grill
6. Cook , turning once , at this point you can top with cheese if you are using until tomatoes are nicely browned , 6 to 10 minutes total
7. For vegan omit the cheeses

title: barbecued recipes grilled shrimp
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients with shrimp and marinate in refrigerator for several hours
2. Place in wire grill basket or on skewers and grill about 5 minutes on each side

title: mousseline mayonnaise
steps:
1. Place egg yolks in bowl and add mustard , vinegar , curry , shallot and parsley and mix well
2. Add oil in a thin stream , mixing constantly with a whisk
3. Fold in whipped cream
4. Chill

title: easy tandoori marinade
steps:
1. Combine all the ingredients and mix until smooth
2. Coat meat or chicken and grill , fry or bbq until cooked

title: banana rum raisin smoothie
steps:
1. Plump the raisins by soaking them in the rum for at least 30 minutes , and as much as overnight
2. Put all of the ingredients in a blender or food processor and puree
3. Divide between two tall glasses and serve at once

title: cedar plank salmon with ginger sauce
steps:
1. In a shallow glass dish , combine the sherry , soy sauce , sesame oil , butter and ginger
2. Place the fish in the marinade for 30 minutes
3. Soak the cedar plank in water for 20-45 minutes
4. Preheat the grill at a medium-low setting
5. After removing the plank from the liquid , pat dry and coat with olive oil on both sides
6. Place the plank on the grill with the salmon and shut the lid
7. Leave for 15-20 mins
8. Check salmon on the thickest part of the fillet to ensure even cooking
9. The salmon should have an opaque colour and be flaky to the touch with a fork
10. Once done , serve with lemon or lime for squeezing over the fish

title: cheesy garlic cardiac arrest bread
steps:
1. Mix mayo , cheese , onion and garlic
2. Spread on bread halves
3. Sprinkle both sides with paprika and parsley , and put back together to form loaf shape
4. Wrap in foil and refrigerate for at least 2 hours , or freeze
5. Bake at 400 for 8 to 10 minutes if refrigerated , or 20 to 25 minutes if frozen

title: cherry dominos
steps:
1. Crust : cook at low heat in a saucepan with thick bottom : butter , cocoa , sugar , eggs , whisking continuously about 5 minutes , until its thick
2. Remove from the heat and add vanilla , graham cracker crumbs , coconut and almonds
3. Butter a square pan of 9 inches and spread the crust mixture pressing firmly
4. Freeze
5. Cherry garnish : in a bowl , with an electric mixer , mix powdered sugar , butter , cherry juice and almond extract , until mixture is creamy
6. Add cherries and stir with a wooden spoon
7. Spread the cherry mixture on the cold crust
8. Freeze while doing the chocolate glaze
9. Chocolate glaze : on the top of a double boiler , melt the chocolate with the butter
10. Spread the chocolate glaze on the cherry mixture
11. Let cool and cut in squares

title: fruity carrots
steps:
1. Rinse the oranges in water
2. Pour orange juice into a medium large sauce pan , & turn heat on to medium
3. Add carrots & curry powder , stirring well
4. Cover & cook about 10 minutes or until carrots are tender & liquid is absorbed
5. Add grapes , oranges & lemon juice , mixing well
6. Cover & heat throughout
7. Serve hot

title: cottage pie  authentic irish recipe
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 375 degrees
2. Brown the beef in oil
3. Remove from pan and set aside
4. Drain most of the accumulated fat from the pan
5. Saut onions until tender , and then add chopped tomatoes and cook for 2-3 minutes
6. Add broth and stir in herbs and seasonings
7. Return brown meat to skillet and continue cooking for 5 minutes
8. Transfer all ingredients to an ovenproof casserole
9. Top with mashed potatoes dot with butter and bake uncovered in 375-degree oven for 30-40 minutes

title: ham  cheese  and tomato pizza
steps:
1. Spread the sauce over the pizza crust
2. Combine cheeses in a small bowl , and scatter a little over the sauce
3. Scatter the ham and onion over the pizza , then arrange the tomato
4. Sprinkle with basil , and top with remaining cheese
5. Bake at 180c for 20 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly , and base is cooked

title: unknownchef86 s bread starter
steps:
1. Stir the yeast into the flour til well-mixed
2. In a medium bowl , whisk the flour-yeast mixture and sugar into the water til thoroughly incorporated
3. Store in a glass gallon jar to allow room for fermentation
4. Cover top with cheesecloth to allow for ventilation
5. Stir down occasionally with a wooden or plastic spoon -- don't ever use metal utensils or containers
6. Refresh the batter at least once a week with 1 / 2 cup water and 3 / 4 cup flour
7. If necessary , you can refresh it every three days

title: chicken  bacon alfredo bread boat
steps:
1. Instructions
2. 1) pre-heat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit
3. 2) cut the top of the french bread , off , and remove the bread inside to hollow it out
4. Place on a large baking sheet
5. 3) spread 2 / 3 of your alfredo sauce evenly inside the loaf
6. Cover with a layer of mozzarella cheese
7. Mix together italian seasoning , salt and garlic powder and sprinkle over cheese
8. 4) continue layering: chicken , bacon , tomatoes , remaining alfredo sauce , green onions and top with parmesan cheese
9. 5) bake for about 15 minutes or until cheese melts
10. 6) remove from oven , top with chopped parsley if desired , cut into slices and enjoy ! make sure to serve warm !

title: ling ling pot sticker soup
steps:
1. In a large pot combine broth and water
2. Bring to a boil
3. Add frozen ling ling pot stickers
4. Return to a boil and cook 4 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Add frozen vegetables , ginger and scallions
6. Cook 4 minutes
7. In the meantime , mix ling ling potsticker sauce with cornstarch in a small bowl
8. Add the sauce mixture to the soup and bring to a simmer
9. Season with salt and pepper
10. Garnish with a few more scallions

title: lithuanian cranberry pudding for christmas eve
steps:
1. Transfer cranberries into a pot
2. Pour in enough water to cover , add cinnamon sticks and whole cloves
3. Heat until cranberries begin to break up
4. Remove from heat , press mixture through a food mill
5. There should be about 4 cups [1 l] of juice and pulp
6. Chill a little of cranberry juice and mix sugar into remaining cranberry mixture
7. Dissolve potato starch into chilled cranberry juice and add to pulp and juice mixture
8. Return juice and pulp to pot
9. Bring to a gentle boil stirring constantly
10. Heat until the mixture becomes clear
11. Pour hot pudding into individual glass bowls
12. Refrigerate until set before serving

title: summer vegetable and orzo salad
steps:
1. Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large skillet until hot
2. Saute / stir onion for 10 minutes or until browned
3. Remove from heat source
4. Add in orzo and remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil , carrot , red bell pepper , zucchini , balsamic vinegar , honey , salt and pepper
5. Stir to combine
6. Cover and chill for 2 hours or more
7. Serve on a bed of lettuce leaves

title: beer braised green peppers  onions    potatoes
steps:
1. In large frying pan , add green peppers , onions and 2 tblsp olive oil
2. Heat to moderate heat
3. Stir a few times until onions and peppers are starting to get transparent
4. Add 6 oz of beer and cover , turn heat down and simmer about 10 minutes
5. Take out of pan and set aside in a bowl
6. To dry frying pan add 2 tblsp olive oil
7. Heat to moderate high , add shredded potatoes
8. Fry without turning
9. Use spatula to raise edges and raise slightly towards the middle
10. Turn heat down after the underside starts to turn medium brown
11. It is best to use non stick or heavy commercial skillet
12. Add the other 6 oz of beer ,
13. Add the salt and pepper sprinkling on the top of the potatoes
14. Add the reserved cooked peppers and onion mixture
15. Cover , cook low heat 10 to 15 minutes
16. Take frying pan to the table and cut in wedges and serve with spatula
17. Sprinkle with cheese for individual taste only
18. Use a very mild mellow lite beer

title: light twice baked potato casserole
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425 and bake potatoes for 40-60 minutes or till tender , let cool
2. Peel potatoes and cut into 1 inch cubes
3. Mix potatoes , salt , pepper , garlic powder , onion powder and sour cream
4. Place half of potato mixture in a greased 13x9 baking dish
5. Sprinkle with half of the cheese , bacon and green onions
6. Repeat with second half of the potato mixture
7. Top with second half of cheese and bacon
8. Bake , uncovered at 350 for 25 minutes
9. Sprinkle with remaining green onions

title: swedish cabbage rolls kaldolmar
steps:
1. Wash cabbage and remove any damaged outer leaves , cut out core
2. Bring a large pot of water to boiling
3. Add cabbage to wilt leaves while preparing stuffing
4. Turn off heat under cabbage , mix together potato , rice , meats , onion , the 1 teaspoon salt , pepper , allspice , sugar , and egg
5. Separate leaves from cabbage as they wilt and drain:
6. Return cabbage to water to wilt inner leaves
7. Shape stuffing into oblong patties and place on core end of cabbage leaf
8. Fold over sides of leaf slightly and roll up , tucking in sides of leaf if possible
9. It may be necessary to fasten rolls with toothpicks , if used , they should be removed before placing rolls in baking dish
10. Mix 3 tablespoons flour and the 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and roll cabbage leaves in mixture
11. Brown in large skillet
12. Remove cabbage rolls as they are browned and place in a large , flat , greased baking dish
13. Cover dish with aluminum foil
14. Heat over to 300 degrees
15. Bake 1 1 / 2 hours basting frequently with the 2 tablespoons melted butter
16. Remove baking dish from oven and place cabbage rolls on a warm platter
17. Mix the 1 tablespoon flour and cream in a small pan
18. Add the liquid from baking dish: cook and stir over moderately low heat until thickened
19. Season to taste
20. Pour gravy over cabbage rolls before serving

title: yogurt  homemade  from good eats  alton brown
steps:
1. Place yogurt in a bowl and bring to room temperature
2. Heat milk , dry milk and honey to 120 degrees
3. Pour into a very clean container that will be used to make the yogurt
4. It should cool back to 115 degrees
5. Whisk 1 cup hot milk into 1 / 2 cup room temperature yogurt
6. Add yogurt mixture back to warm milk
7. Wrap container with a heating pad and set on low or medium low
8. Be sure to have the pad wrapped around your container so that the heat is evenly distributed around the container
9. Place inside a stock pot
10. Monitor the temperature of the liquid , your target is 115 degrees and adjust heating pad accordingly
11. If it gets above 120 degrees you'll kill the active cultures , so use a temp alarm if you have one !
12. You can also do this on the heating element of your electric coffee maker , but it doesn't provide the heat as evenly as the heating pad and must be insulated with an oven mitt to prevent overheating
13. Allow to sit for 3-9 hrs depending on the consistency that you disire
14. The longer it sits the firmer it gets

title: homemade  fat free  pasta
steps:
1. Put the flour into the bowl of a food processor
2. Pulse while adding the egg substitute
3. This will produce a soft ball of dough
4. Turn out onto a floured towel or board and knead the dough into a single ball that is glossy and elastic
5. Put in plastic wrap and set aside for 30 minutes
6. Flour the rollers of a pasta machine
7. Cut the dough in quarters
8. Flour all over and flatten
9. Put the first piece of dough through the largest opening on the pasta machine 3 times , folding the dough in half after each time through
10. Then put it through each successively smaller opening until it has gone through the smallest
11. Repeat this process for the remaining 3 pieces of dough
12. Put each of the thin pieces of dough through the wide cutters on machine
13. Hang and dry 10 minutes

title: my first yellow crookneck squash fried
steps:
1. Slice squash into 1 / 8 in slices
2. Chop onion scapes and basil together
3. Crack egg into bowl add milk
4. Add in onion , basil , squash and turn to cover
5. In the paper bag , add flour , corn meal , cheese , salt , and pepper
6. Shake , shake , shake
7. Put into med hot skillet with butter and oil and fry up , turn when edges are turning brown
8. At this point sprinkle with remaining parm cheese
9. Take out and lay on a plate lined with paper towels to drain sprinkle with additional parm cheese or ther heat as you choose

title: eggnog  french toast
steps:
1. Combine eggnog and nutmeg in a shallow dish
2. Place bread slices in dish , turning to coat
3. Melt butter in a large skillet
4. Remove bread slices from eggnog mixture , allowing excess to drain
5. Cook in skillet 3 minutes on each side or until golden
6. Serve immediately with rum sauce
7. Rum sauce: combine ingredients in a saucepan
8. Cook over low heat until heated , stirring often

title: oatmeal apple cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 and grease cookie sheet
2. Combine shortening , sugar , egg , milk and vanilla in large bowl
3. Beat at medium speed until well blended
4. Combine flour , cinnamon , salt , soda and nutmeg in a small bowl and mix into creamed mixture at low speed until just blended
5. Stir in oats , apples , raisins and nuts
6. Drop rounded tablespoonfuls of dough about 2-inches apart onto prepared cookie sheets
7. Bake for 13 minutes or until just set
8. Cool for a minute or 2 on cookie sheets and then remove to a wire rack to cool completely

title: five bean vegetarian chili
steps:
1. In a large kettle , heat olive oil over medium-low heat
2. Add onions , garlic and peppers
3. Cook , stirring occasionally 8 to 10 minutes until vegetables are soft and fragrant
4. While vegetables are cooking , rinse lentils in a colander under running water
5. Add lentils and remaining ingredients to kettle
6. Bring to a boil and simmer 30 to 45 minutes , stirring occauntil lentils are tender and chili is rich and thick
7. Taste mixture for seasonings
8. If spicier chili is desired , add additional tabasco sauce
9. Serve with hot corn tortillas

title: towering brownie pyramids
steps:
1. Coarsely chop 14 cookies
2. Prepare brownie mix according to package directions using oil , water and eggs
3. Stir in chopped cookies
4. Spread batter into foil-lined and greased 13x9x3-inch baking pan
5. Bake at 350 for 28 to 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted 2 inches from side comes out almost clean
6. Cool in pan on wire rack
7. Cut brownies in half crosswise
8. Place 1 brownie half , upside down , on waxed paper-lined baking sheet
9. Spread ice cream over brownie to edges , top with remaining brownie half
10. Wrap with plastic wrap
11. Freeze 3 to 4 hours or until firm
12. Cut into 4 rectangles
13. Halve rectangles diagonally to form 8 triangles
14. Stand each triangle on its side on a serving plate
15. Halve remaining 4 cookies
16. Garnish triangles with cookie halves and chocolate syrup
17. Serve immediately or freeze until serving time

title: ham and swiss cheese frittata
steps:
1. In skillet cook onion and green pepper with salt& pepper in 1 tbls
2. Of olive oil over low heat until green pepper is tender
3. In a bowl whisk together the eggs , ham , 2 / 3 cup swiss cheese , and salt& pepper
4. Add onion and green pepper to egg mixture and stir until combined well
5. In skillet heat remaining 1 / 2 tbls
6. Olive oil over moderate heat until hot and pour in mixture , distributing ham and green pepper evenly
7. Cook frittata without stirring for 8 to 10 minutes or until edge is set but center is still soft
8. Sprinkle remaining 1 / 3 cup swiss cheese over the top
9. Broil frittata under preheated broiler about 4 inches from the heat for 2 to 3 minutes or until the cheese is golden
10. Cool in skillet for 5 minutes
11. Slide the frittata onto a serving plate and cut into wedges
12. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: crazy crust pie
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except pie filling with a mixer for two minutes
2. Pour into 9 inch pie pan
3. Make a hole in the center and pour the pie filling in
4. Sprinkle the cinnamon over the top and bake in a 350f
5. Oven for 40 to 45 minutes

title: flour tortillas diaz
steps:
1. Mix the dry ingredients
2. Add oil and mix with hands
3. Mixing with your hands , add water a little at a time , until you get a soft dough
4. You should be able to mix in all the dry ingredients , but the dough shouldn't be sticky
5. On a floured surface , knead the dough for 2- 4 minutes , adding flour if the dough is sticky
6. Form dough into a ball , cover with towel and place upside down bowl over dough
7. Let the dough rest for 15-20 minutes
8. Heat ungreased griddle to medium-high
9. Break off golf-ball sized pieces of dough and flatten into 5 inch circles
10. On a floured surface roll out tortillas using a back and forth motion , turning the tortilla 1 / 4 turn after each roll
11. Flip the tortilla at least once
12. Place tortilla on hot griddle and cook till bubbles rise
13. Flip and cook on the other side 20-25 seconds
14. Finished tortillas will be speckled with brown
15. Place cooked tortilla in a bowl covered and lined with a towels

title: stupid easy 3 ingredient nacho dip
steps:
1. Layer the 2 packages of cream cheese on the bottom of a glass square 8x8 baking dish
2. Cover evenly with the 2 cans of hormel chili
3. Cover with the shredded cheese
4. Put in microwave leave in until cheese in center is bubbly

title: sock it to me cake
steps:
1. Mix cake , white sugar and oil
2. Beat in beaten eggs and sour cream
3. Pour 1 / 2 cake mixture into well greased bundt pan
4. Mix brown sugar and cinnamon and put on top of cake batter
5. Add pecans
6. Pour the remaining cake batter over the pecan layer
7. Bake at 350 for 1 hour
8. Cool cake and then glaze
9. Glaze
10. Mix all glaze ingrediants together
11. Pour over a cood cake

title: spicy potato salad
steps:
1. Cube cooked potatoes and place in a large bowl
2. Whisk together oil , vinegar , sugar , salt , chili powder , cayenne , and hot sauce
3. Pour over potatoes and toss very gently
4. Cover and chill 1 hour , then stir in corn and olives
5. Serve and enjoy !

title: ted s pad thai
steps:
1. Cut chicken into 1 / 2 inch cubes and marinate in the 2 teaspoons of wine for 10 minutes
2. Prepare rice noodles according to package
3. Mince the garlic
4. Lightly beat the eggs
5. Cut the green onions into 2 inch lengths
6. Rinse the bean sprouts
7. Chop the peanuts
8. Cut the lime into wedges
9. Place a stir-fry pan or wok over high heat until hot
10. Add vegetable oil and swirl it around the sides of the pan
11. Add garlic and stir-fry till fragrant , about 15 seconds
12. Add chicken and stir-fry till done , about 3 minutes
13. Push the chicken to one side of the pan , then add the eggs and scramble on the other side
14. Add noodles , fish sauce , rice vinegar , brown sugar , and chili garlic sauce all at once
15. Continue stir-frying until everything is well mixed
16. Add the green onions and bean sprouts and continue cooking till heated through
17. Place pad thai in a serving dish or on separate plates and garnish with the peanuts and lime

title: new potato and green bean salad
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , add potatoes to enough water to cover
2. Bring to a boil , and boil for 8 minutes
3. Add green beans , return to a boil and cook for 2 minutes
4. Drain and cool slightly
5. Place potatoes and green beans in a serving bowl
6. In a small bowl , whisk together olive oil and next 5 ingredients
7. Pour over potato and green beans , tossing gently to coat
8. Cover and chill

title: mediterranean salad with lemon caper vinaigrette
steps:
1. Combine dressing ingredients in cruet or jar
2. Shake well to combine ingredients
3. This can be done in advance
4. Divide salad greens into four dishes
5. Top with tomatoes , olives , feta , and onion
6. Shake dressing and pour over salad

title: cacoila  portuguese stewed beef
steps:
1. The day before cooking , marinate meat with crushed red peppers in a plastic bag or covered dish , overnight
2. Place onion slices , parsley , garlic and bay leaf in the bottom of a large heavy dutch oven
3. Place meat on top , dot with butter , and pour combined wine and tomato sauce over all
4. Bring to a boil , then cover and simmer over very low heat for 3 to 4 hours , until meat is very tender and sauce is thickened
5. Serve with pasta , rice or boiled white potatoes

title: choucroute garni  hackse platter
steps:
1. In a 5 quart dutch oven or sauce pan cook onion in bacon drippings about 5 minutes or until tender
2. Remove from heat
3. Add pork hocks or spare ribs
4. Cut pork shoulder roll crosswise into 3 / 4 inch thick slices
5. Add shoulder pieces or loin chops to dutch oven
6. In a large bowl stir together the sauerkraut and next 7 ingredients
7. Spoon over meats
8. Pour wine over all
9. Cover and bake in a 375 degree oven about 1 1 / 2 hours or until meats are tender
10. Meanwhile , prepare desired combination of sausages
11. For bratwurst , bockwurst and thuringer , place in an unheated skillet wit 2 to 3 tbsp water
12. Cover and cook until water is evaporated and sausages are cooked
13. For knackwurst and frankfurters , add to boiling water in a saucepan
14. Cover and simmer for 5 to 10 minutes or until hot
15. Mound sauerkraut mixture into a deep wide serving platter or a large bowl
16. Arrange meats and sausages around and on top of the sauerkraut
17. Serve with boiled potatoes

title: roasted red bell pepper zucchini   yellow squash
steps:
1. Combine the first 4 ingredients in a large bowl
2. Drizzle with the oil and sprinkle with the salt and pepper
3. Toss well
4. Place in ungreased 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan and bake uncovered for 10 to 20 minutes
5. Remove the vegetables from oven and toss with the vinegar , pine nuts , and basil
6. Serve at once

title: toll house chocolate chip cookies  ca 1948
steps:
1. Cream butter
2. Add sugars
3. Add eggs
4. Sift flour and salt
5. Dissolve soda in water and add alternately with sifted flour mixture to butter and sugars
6. Add nuts and chocolate morsels
7. Stir in vanilla
8. Drop by half-teaspoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheet
9. Bake 10-12 minutes at 375f

title: easiest green beans ever
steps:
1. Cook or microwave beans according to package directions
2. Toss with dressing and serve warm

title: baby spinach salad
steps:
1. Whisk together the olive oil and the lemon juice
2. Toss the spinach in a large serving bowl with the olives and the combined olive oil and lemon juice
3. Season the salad with sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

title: koalslas  holland dutch cole slaw
steps:
1. Combine the first six ingredients in saucepan and heat to boiling
2. Add some hot mixture to egg and add back into mixture
3. Cook until it thickens
4. Take from heat and beat in cream
5. Pour over finely chopped cabbage
6. Chill and serve

title: pina coloda cake
steps:
1. Prepare and bake cake according to package directions in 9x13inch pan
2. Poke holes in cake with end of wooden spoon or fork
3. In a bowl mix cream of coconut and sweetened condensed milk
4. Pour over cake
5. Add crushed pineapple if desired
6. Top with cool whip and then coconut
7. Chill

title: no time to cook scalloped potatoes and kielbasa
steps:
1. In a 8x8 dish mix-all ingredients
2. Cover with saran wrap
3. Microwave on high for about4-5 minutes
4. Serve with saltine crackers or buttered bread
5. Oh my--a good supper in like 10 minutes

title: non dairy chocolate mousse
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , cream the margarine
2. Add the sugar , vanilla and melted chocolate and beat until fluffy
3. Add the eggs and beat for 3 minutes until smooth and thick
4. Refrigerate until serving

title: potatoes a l alsacienne
steps:
1. Peel the potatoes and cut into 1 inch pieces
2. Place in a pan of salted water , bring to the boil and cook for 5 minutes
3. Drain well and set aside
4. Melt the butter in a frying pan with the olive oil , add the onions and bacon and cook for about 5 minutes or until the bacon fat begins to run
5. Add the potatoes and cook for a further 10 minutes or until the potatoes are tender and crisp turning occasionally
6. Add the herbs , salt and pepper and mix well
7. Serve immediately

title: asian beef tikka
steps:
1. Add soy sauce , serrano chilis , onion , garlic , salt , pepper , & turmeric powder in the blender or food processor
2. Grind it up into a paste for about one minute
3. Pour the paste in a large mixing bowl
4. Add the ground beef to the paste and mix it in as thoroughly and evenly as possible
5. The meat will take on a brown color from the paste mix
6. Turn on the electric grill and let it heat up for about five minutes
7. While it is heating , take the meat and roll out little sausages
8. 1 lb of beef should make about one dozen little tikka sausages
9. When the grill is preheated and ready , place the tikka sausages on it
10. Let it cook on the grill for about 7 minutes or long enough for the tikka to cook completely
11. Place the tikka in a casserole dish with a lid to keep it hot , or serve it immediately
12. Use the cup of yogurt as a dip for the tikka
13. Toasted bread , roti , or any flat bread goes well with tikka
14. You can use not only yogurt , but ketchup and other dressings as dipping sauces

title: spinach gorgonzola walnut shells with parmesan cream
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Spray a 13x9 baking dish with cooking spray
3. Cook pasta shells to desired doneness as directed on package
4. Meanwhile , squeeze spinach to remove moisture
5. In food processor or blender , combine spinach , ricotta , gorgonzola , walnuts , 1 garlic clove and egg
6. Process 30-45 seconds in food processor or until well mixed
7. In large saucepan , melt butter over medium heat
8. Add minced garlic clove and stir 1 minute or until tender
9. Stir in flour , salt and pepper
10. Cook and stir until bubbly
11. Gradually add half-and-half , stirring constantly with wire whisk
12. Cook and stir 5-6 minutes or until mixture comes to a boil
13. Stir in parmesan cheese
14. Pour sauce into baking dish
15. Drain pasta shells
16. Rinse with hot water
17. Drain well
18. Spoon about 1-1 / 2 tablespoons filling into each pasta shell
19. Arrange stuffed shells in single layer over sauce
20. Cover tightly with foil
21. Bake at 350 for 20-25 minutes or until thoroughly heated and sauce is bubbly
22. To serve , spoon sauce over stuffed shells

title: billy s awesome makeshift ketchup
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients well and store in a jar or airtight container in the fridge
2. Stays good for about 2 weeks
3. Enjoy !

title: blueberry and raspberry cake
steps:
1. For topping: combine , sugar , flour , cinnamon and salt in medium bowl
2. Add butter and cut in until mixture resembles coarse meal
3. Set aside
4. For cake: preheat oven to 375
5. Grease and flour 9- by 13-inch baking pan
6. Sift flour , baking powder and salt into medium bowl
7. Using electric mixer , cream butter in large bowl until light
8. Add sugar and beat until light and fluffy
9. Mix in eggs 1 at a time
10. Mix in dry ingredients alternately with sour cream , beginning and ending with dry ingredients
11. Combine berries in small bowl
12. Pour half of batter into prepared pan
13. Spoon berries over
14. Spread remaining batter over berries
15. Sprinkle with topping
16. Bake until tester inserted in center comes out clean , about 1 hour
17. Cut into squares

title: portabella fajitas
steps:
1. Add 1 tsp oil to skillet and sautee peppers and onions
2. After the onion and pepper are cooked until they are slightly soft , add the mushrooms
3. Once the mushrooms are cooked add 1 / 3 cup of water and fajita seasoning to skillet
4. Slice mushrooms warm the tortillas and line with lettuce
5. Add mixture to each tortilla and roll up
6. Optional garnishments: sour cream , salsa , avacado

title: last minute carrots
steps:
1. In medium size saucepan melt butter with water and add salt and pepper
2. Add the carrots , cover tightly and cook over high heat until steam forms , then slowly for 4-5minutes or until carrots are tender
3. If desired add some finely chopped parsley before serving

title: crawfish or shrimp bisque
steps:
1. Melt the butter or margarine in a large saucepan and add the onion , red bell pepper , celery and garlic
2. Cook gently to soften
3. Stir in dry mustard , cayenne pepper , paprika and flour
4. Cook for about 3 minutes over low heat , stirring occasionally
5. Pour on the fish stock gradually , stirring until well blended
6. Add the thyme and bay leaf and bring to a boil
7. Reduce the heat and simmer for about 5 minutes until thickened , stirring occasionally
8. Add the crawfish and cook for about 5 minutes
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste
10. Serve over rice topped with snipped chives

title: the best brocolli casserole
steps:
1. Chop the broccoli
2. Mix together with the soup , mayo , cheese , egg , salt and pepper

4. Spread down the center of the on beef slices lenth wise
5. Sprinkle sliced leek
6. Roll and tie with thread or secure with small skewers or tooth picks
7. Place in ovenproof casserole closely together
8. In a small sauce pan combine cranberry and beef stock and boil over high heat
9. Pour over the beef rolls
10. Cover and bake in preheated oven for 1 hour , or until tender
11. Serve immediately

title: jade soup
steps:
1. Chop chicken very fine , or put in a blender or food processor
2. Soak chopped chicken in 1 / 2c of chicken stock
3. Beat egg whites stiff then gently fold in cornstarch , chicken , and 1 tsp of salt
4. Set aside
5. Cook spinach in a small amount of boiling water , drain well then squeeze out water and chop very fine
6. Heat oil in a wok over medium-high heat
7. Stir-fry spinach for 30 seconds
8. Pour remaining 4c chicken stock and sherry over spinach and bring to a boil
9. Add chicken mixture and bring to a boil , stirring rapidly
10. Season with 1 teaspoons salt
11. Thicken with dissolved cornstarch

title: grace s stabilized whipped cream
steps:
1. Make gelatin mix:
2. Soak plain gelatin in cold water for 5 minutes
3. Dissolve by placing it in a metal bowl placed over a small pot of simmering water
4. Let cool
5. Prepare stabilized whipped cream:
6. Using an electric mixer , beat cream in a large well-chilled bowl
7. Just before it becomes soft and billowy , slowly add the sugar and flavorings to the whipping cream at the sides of the bowl
8. Whip the cream until barely stiff
9. Add gelatin mis all at once to cream during whipping
10. Stop whipping when the cream forms soft peaks
11. Serve immediately or cover and refrigerate
12. Flavoring may be added as long as you add it before the gelatin sets up
13. Store the cake in the refrigerator until serving time !

title: tossed greens with pineapple  apple and feta cheese
steps:
1. Whisk together water , vinegar , mustard , garlic , salt , and pepper in a small bowl
2. Set aside
3. In a large bowl , combine greens , apples , pineapple , onion , and cheese
4. Pour dressing over the fruit and vegetables and toss gently to coat
5. Serve immediately

title: orange hot chocolate mix in a bag
steps:
1. In a small bowl combine all ingredients together and blend well
2. Store in a small baggie or a small jar
3. Attach a gift tag with these directions:
4. Orange hot chocolate
5. 1 1 / 2 to 2 tablespoons orange hot chocolate mix
6. 8 ounces hot milk
7. Marshmallows or whipped cream
8. Place the orange hot chocolate mixture in a mug
9. Pour hot milk over the mixture
10. Stir until the mix is completely dissolved
11. If desired , garnish with marshmallows or whipped cream

title: australian jack
steps:
1. Cream the butter
2. Add the sugar and beat until light and fluffy
3. Dissolve the baking soda in the water and add , stirring well
4. Add the oatmeal and ginger , mixing well
5. The mixture should be fairly firm
6. If necessary , add a little more oatmeal
7. Knead lightly on a floured surface
8. Preheat oven to 300 degrees
9. Press the mixture in a buttered baking dish , about 8 x 12 inches
10. The dough should be about 1 / 2 inch thick
11. Bake in the 300 degree oven for 35 minutes , or until brown on top
12. Cut into squares while hot

title: moussaka stir fry
steps:
1. Mix in bowl the ground lamb or beef , garlic powder , oregano , and pepper
2. In separate bowl , stir until blended the broth , tomato paste and sour cream
3. Set aside
4. Place dutch oven over high heat 3 minutes until very hot
5. Add 1 tbsp
6. Olive oil
7. Coat bottom
8. Add meat mixture and stir-fry , breaking up meat until no longer pink , about 1 minute
9. Spoon meat mixture and juices into a large bowl
10. Heat 2 more tbsp
11. Olive oil in the dutch oven
12. Add eggplant and stir-fry 2-3 minutes until slightly softened
13. Add bell pepper
14. Stir-fry 1 minute until pepper is crisp-tender and eggplant is crisp-tender
15. Add to bowl with meat mixture
16. Add frozen onion and green peas to dutch oven
17. Stir-fry 1 minute until thawed
18. Add broth mixture
19. Bring to a boil and boil 30 seconds until mixture thickens
20. Return meat and vegetables to pot
21. Add the cheese and stir 1 minute until mixture is evenly coated with sauce
22. Serve immediately

title: joe s screaming stuffed jalapeno poppers
steps:
1. Mix cream cheese with chopped garlic , sun-dried tomatoes and a dash of chopped basil
2. Add a pinch of salt
3. Mix until the mixture is soft and manageable
4. Slice each jalapeno lengthwise on 1 side , being careful not to cut the jalapeno in half
5. Remove the seeds if you don't want them too hot -- depending on your pepper , you may have to slice around the stem of the pepper to create a manageable opening to squeeze the filling inches
6. Fill either a pastry bag or tool of your choise with the filling
7. Use something that will allow you to squeeze the filling into the opening of the pepper with ease
8. Be careful not to overfill as the filling may spurt out while cooking
9. Wrap each pepper with 1 to 2 strips of bacon , securing the opening in the pepper
10. Secure the bacon with a toothpick
11. This also helps prevent the peppers from falling into the grill ! long metal or wood skewers work well for large amounts
12. Bbq the peppers until they are lightly roasted , or until the bacon is fully cooked
13. Use some foil to cook on if your peppers are cooking too fast or beginning to burn on a hot grill
14. Serve immediately

title: breakfast barley
steps:
1. Bring water to a boil in a large saucepan
2. Add the barley and the cinnamon stick
3. Cook slowly over low heat for about 45 minutes or until most of the water is absorbed , stirring occasionally
4. Add the lemon juice , apple cider and raisins , if you are using them
5. Continue cooking over low heat , stirring frequently , until most of the liquid is absorbed and the barley is thick , about 30 more minutes
6. Serve with milk or soy milk or eat plain

title: grilled portabella sandwich with gouda and red pepper aioli
steps:
1. Spray skillet and inside of buns with non-stick cooking spray
2. Grill in pan / skillet until lightly toasted
3. Heat olive oil in skillet
4. Grill mushroom until browned
5. Spread red pepper aioli on bottom of bun
6. Put portobello on top
7. Put gouda cheese on top of that
8. Put bean sprouts on top of that
9. Spread basil pesto on top of bun
10. You can also use panini bread and make these into paninis if you have a panini press
11. Red pepper aioli sauce
12. 3 garlic cloves , peeled and finely missed
13. 1 / 2 cup fat-free mayo
14. 1 / 2 tsp salt
15. 1 / 4 tsp crushed red pepper
16. 1 large red pepper , diced and cooked well
17. Mix all ingredients in a food processor or extremely well in bowl until combined
18. Enjoy !

title: mini turkey meatloaves wrapped in collard greens
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Cut the thick stems off of the collard greens
3. Steam the collards for 3 to 4 minutes until soft and pliable
4. Drain and set aside
5. In a large bowl , mix together the ground turkey and all of the seasonings in a bowl
6. Divide into 4 sections to form little logs
7. Wrap each log in 3-4 collard leaves overlapped and wrapped around the turkey like wrapping a burrito or eggroll
8. Place packets seam side down in a square 8x8 baking dish and top each with cup of salsa or enchilada sauce
9. Cover with foil and bake until turkey is cooked through , about 40 minutes
10. If you want to make this italian instead of mexican , omit the cumin and add 1 tsp italian seasoning instead
11. You can omit the red chili flakes or leave them in , whatever your personal preference is
12. Instead of topping with salsa , use marinara
13. You can also add a dab of pesto on top of each one if you like

title: best albondigas soup
steps:
1. Make the meatballs first: combine everything and mix thoroughly
2. Form meatballs and roll between your palms
3. You should make around 20 to 24 meatballs , set aside
4. Combine chicken broth , onion , celery , tomatoes and their liquid , cumin , oregano and cilantro leaves in a large pot
5. Bring to boil , and reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes
6. Drop meatballs in the soup
7. Return to simmer and cook another 10 minutes
8. Add zucchini and cook 10 minutes
9. Season with salt and pepper , to taste
10. You could top the soup with cooked rice , or just by itself

title: subway s chipotle southwest sauce
steps:
1. Combine mayonnaise , mustard , lime juice , chipotle and garlic
2. Add salt to taste
3. Cover and chill before sandwich preparation , or before using as a salad dressing

title: korean bean paste soup  chigae
steps:
1. In a large saucepan over medium heat , combine water , denjang , garlic , dashi and gochu jang
2. Bring to a boil and let boil 2 minutes
3. Stir in zucchini , potato , mushrooms and onions and boil for 5 to 7 minutes more
4. Stir in tofu and cook until tofu has expanded and vegetables are tender
5. Best served with rice and kimchi

title: lemon upside down cake
steps:
1. Make sure there is a rack in the middle of the oven & preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Trim ends from lemons & cut into slices 1 / 8" to 1 / 4" thick , discarding any seeds
3. In an ovenproof , nonstick 10" skillet over medium heat , melt unsalted butter with the brown sugar
4. Add lemon slices & increase heat to high
5. Boil & stir for 1 minute
6. Remove skillet from heat & arrainge slices in an attractive pattern in the bottom of the skillet
7. In a medium bowl , whisk together flour , baking powder & salt
8. In a large bowl , using an electric mixer on medium speed , beat the remaining 1 / 2 cup of butter until light & fluffy
9. Add granulated sugar & zest , again beating until light & fluffy
10. Add egg yolks & vanilla & beat just until blended , then reduce speed to low & add flour mixture alternately with the milk , scraping down the side of the bowl after each addition
11. Beat until just blended
12. In a large clean bowl , beat egg whites with clean beaters on medium speed until just foamy , then increase speed to medium-high & add cream of tartar , beating just until egg whites form stiff peaks
13. Add 1 / 4 of the whites to the batter & fold in using a whisk or rubber spatula ~ continue to gently fold in the whites , 1 / 4 at a time , being careful not to overmix
14. Pour batter over lemon slices & gently smooth the top , then bake 45-50 minutes or until top is golden brown & a wooden pick inserted in the center comes out clean
15. Let cool in the pan on wire rack for 10 minutes
16. Loosen edge of cake with a rubber spatula all around , then invert it onto a serving platter , leaving the pan over the cake for 5 minutes
17. Remove pan & serve cake warm , cut into wedges

title: vanillekipferln  german almond crescent cookies
steps:
1. Cut the vanilla beans lenthwise and scrape out the cream
2. Mix the vanilla cream together with the sugar
3. Sift flour and add salt , cut in butter , 70g of the homemade vanilla sugar and the almonds
4. Work to form a smooth dough
5. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours
6. Preheat oven to 175c or 350f roll the dough into a long sausage , approximately 1 cm thick
7. Cut off every 7 cm and bend to form a half-moon
8. Bake on a parchment paper lined baking sheet at 175c for 10-15 minutes or until golden brown
9. Carefully remove the kipferln from the baking sheet
10. While still warm roll in remaining vanilla sugar
11. Let cool
12. Sprinkle with sifted icing sugar

title: fat free molasses cookies
steps:
1. Puree raisins and hot coffee in blender until smooth
2. Transfer raisin / coffee mixture to a large bowl
3. Add egg substitute , molasses and sugar to raisin mixture and blend together
4. Add cinnamon , ginger , cloves to bowl and stir
5. Add flour , baking soda and salt to blended raisin mixture and stir together by hand until all ingredients are incorporated
6. Cover the mixture with plastic wrap and chill the dough for 2 - 3 hours
7. Preheat oven to 350f
8. Scoop dough by rounded tablespoons and roll into a ball
9. Roll the dough balls in the 1 / 4 cup sugar to coat and place on ungreased cookie sheet 2" apart
10. Bake for 8 to 12 minutes or until set , but still soft in the center
11. Cool for 1 minute , then remove from cookie sheets and let cool completely on a baking rack

title: milk   cookie cups
steps:
1. Spray a 24 mini muffin pan with nonstick spray
2. Set aside
3. In the bowl , mix butter and sugar until creamy
4. Add an egg and vanilla extract and mix until incorporated
5. In a bowl mix flour , baking powder , salt and add butter mixture
6. Continue mixing until its all combined
7. Scoop the dough into the muffin pan
8. Then press the dough in the middle and sides until it forms a cup shape
9. Place in refrigerator for 10-15 minutes
10. Pre-heat oven to 350f
11. Bake the cookie for 8-10 minutes
12. Remove from the oven and make an indent into the center of the cup using the back of a wood spatula or similar
13. Bake for an additional 5 minutes
14. For filling:
15. In a small bowl , add water and sprinkle in the gelatin powder
16. Set aside
17. Pour milk into a sauce pan then add sugar
18. Turn heat on medium and stir until the sugar is melted
19. Turn off the heat
20. Add gelatin mixture to the sauce pan
21. Stir until the gelatin is dissolved
22. Add heavy cream and stir
23. Strain panna cotta mixture into a bowl that rests in an ice bath
24. Stir until its thick
25. Pour the panna cotta into each cookie cup
26. Place in the refrigerator for 30 min - 1 hour

title: pancho villa baked tilapia
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Coat 4 pieces of aluminum foil with olive oil and center fillets in them
3. Spoon diced tomatoes with juices over fish and do the same with the chilies
4. Sprinkle with lime juice and cilantro
5. Add sprinkling of salt and pepper if preferred
6. Close and seal foil packets , and place on a baking tray
7. Bake for approximately 20 minutes , or until fish flakes easily with a fork

title: tuna  lime and cilantro baked potato
steps:
1. Scrub the potatoes , then dry and prick each one several times with a sharp knife
2. Microwave method:
3. Cook one potato for 6 minutes on full power , turn half way through cooking
4. Allow to stand for 1 2 minutes before serving
5. If cooking more than one potato at a time you need to increase the cooking time accordingly
6. Oven method:
7. Rub a few drops of olive oil into the potato skin , place the potatoes in a pre-heated oven at 400f on a baking tray with salt sprinkled around the potato
8. Bake for 1 hours or until soft
9. When potato is ready , open the tins of tuna , in a bowl mix with lime juice and fresh coriander
10. Serve the mix on top of the pototoes
11. Season with freshly ground black pepper

title: hearty sausage sandwich
steps:
1. In large skillet , cook the sausage , onion , green pepper and garlic over medium heat until meat is no longer pink
2. Drain
3. Add the cream cheese , mushrooms , parmesan cheese , water and oregano
4. Cook and stir until cheese is melted
5. Cut bread in half horizontally
6. Hollow out top and bottom , leaving a 3 / 4-inch shell
7. Place bread bottom on a baking sheet
8. Sprinkle with half of the mozzarella cheese
9. Top with sausage mixture and remaining cheese
10. Replace bread top
11. Bake at 375 degrees for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted

title: top to bottom ham   cheese sandwich
steps:
1. Cut the loaves of bread in half lengthwise as if youre going to make a sandwich
2. Combine the 1 cup mayo and 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese in a bowl and spread on both side of both loaves of bread
3. Place thinly sliced onion and ham in each sandwich to your liking
4. Wrap sandwiches in aluminum foil and and bake in 350 degree oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until until cheese is melted and the sandwiches are heated through

title: chile glazed pork chops
steps:
1. Red chile adobo paste: remove the seeds and veins from the chiles
2. Heat a skillet over medium heat and roast the chiles on both sides until they begin to release their aroma and soften a bit , about 1 minute
3. Transfer to a blender and fill with boiling water
4. Allow the chiles to soak for 30 minutes , making sure to keep them submerged under water
5. Roast the garlic on the same pan used to toast the chiles over medium heat , turning often until the skin blackens and the garlic begins to smell toasty , about 10 minutes
6. Remove from the heat and peel
7. Set aside
8. Pour the water out of the blender jar , leaving behind the rehydrated chiles
9. Add the garlic along with cinnamon , bay leaf , cumin , pepper , oregano , salt , and vinegar and puree until smooth
10. Marinate the pork chops: slather both sides of the pork chops with the chile paste and place in a large resealable plastic bag
11. Allow to marinate in the refrigerator for at least 10 minutes
12. Sear the pork chops: leave a light coating of the chile paste on the pork chops and season with salt and pepper
13. Place a large , well seasoned cast-iron or nonstick skillet over medium-high heat , and add the olive oil
14. When the oil is hot , add the pork chops in a single layer and sear for 2 minutes on each side , or until the meat turns golden brown
15. Braise in beer: pour in enough beer to barely cover the chops
16. Cover the pan and decrease the heat to a simmer
17. Cook for 15 minutes
18. Turn the pork chops over and cook for another 15 minutes
19. Reduce the liquid to a glaze: uncover the skillet and increase the heat to medium-high
20. Alow the liquid to reduce almost completely , flipping the pork chops over every few minutes to ensure that both sides become glazed with the reduced sauce
21. This should take about 10 minutes
22. Serve warm

title: chicken enchilada lasagna bundles
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease 13x9 baking dish
3. Cook noodles as directed on package and drain
4. Mix enchilada sauce , chilies and tomato
5. Mix chicken , monterey jack cheese , onions and 1 cup sour cream
6. Spread about 1 / 2 cup sauce mixture into baking dish
7. Spread about 1 teaspoon sauce mixture over each noodle
8. Spread evenly with about 1 / 4 cup of chicken mixture
9. Roll up each noodle
10. Place seam side down on sauce in dish
11. Spoon about 1 cup sauce over bundles
12. Sprinkle with the cheddar cheese
13. Cover and bake 40 to 45 minutes or until hot in center
14. Heat remaining sauce in saucepan
15. Spoon over bundles
16. Serve with additional sour cream

title: staff room brownies
steps:
1. Mix wet ingredients
2. Sift in dry ingredients
3. Bake at 350f for 30 minutes
4. Let them cool
5. Icing

title: asian salmon burgers with provolone  green onion and soy sauce m
steps:
1. For salmon burgers , in a food processor fitted with the metal blade , pulse the salmon until coarsely ground , scraping down the sides of the work bowl once or twice
2. Transfer the salmon to a medium bowl
3. Add the ginger , garlic , green onions , cilantro , salt , lemon juice and soy sauce
4. Using a rubber spatula , mix to combine
5. Mix in the cracker meal
6. Add the eggs
7. Stir to combine
8. Dividing the salmon mixture evenly , form into 4 1-inch-thick patties
9. Refrigerate for at least 20 minutes before cooking
10. In a large , heavy skillet , preferably cast-iron , heat the oil over medium-high heat and swirl to coat the pan
11. Add the salmon patties and cook until golden brown on one side , about 3 minutes
12. Turn and cook until opaque throughout and golden brown on the other side , about 3 minutes longer
13. Top each burger with a slice of cheese
14. Serve the salmon burgers on the toasted buns with the lettuce and green onion and soy sauce mayonnaise
15. For the green onion and soy sauce mayonnaise , in a small bowl mix the mayonnaise , green onion , lemon juice and soy sauce until well blended
16. Cover and refrigerate for up to 1 day
17. Makes about 2 / 3 cup
18. Source: recipe courtesy of diane morgan

title: pot stickers  you pick your protein
steps:
1. Dough:
2. Sift flour and salt into a large bowl
3. Make a well in the middle and begin pouring boiling water -- about 1 / 4 cup at a time
4. Mix with a spoon and continue to add boiling water until the dough begins to be sticky
5. Flour your hands and working surface well
6. Remove dough from bowl and hand knead about 5-10 minutes until it is pretty smooth and elastic
7. Once kneaded into a ball , place a glass bowl or plastic wrap over it and let sit for 30 minutes or so
8. Roll into long tube and cut into 24 equal sized pieces
9. Roll those pieces out with a rolling pin into about 3-4" rounds
10. Filling:
11. Combine all of the ingredients from above filling ingredients and mix well with a spoon
12. Assembly:
13. Scoop about 1 tbsp of mixture and place into the middle of the dough round
14. Pull up opposite sides of dough and fold over and pinch down
15. Pinch the ends and flute with your fingers
16. Cooking:
17. Heat oil in skillet over medium to medium high
18. Put pot stickers in batches into the hot oil and pan fry until the bottoms brown -- remove the batches as they finish and place on a plate
19. Once all are pan fried and over medium heat , place them all back into the frying pan with the remaining oil , add about 1 / 2 cup warm water into the pan
20. Cover and steam for about 5-8 minutes or until the pot sticker is well steamed
21. Serve immediately with a soy or sweet and sour dip of your choice

title: sausage rice stuffing casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cook sausage , celery , onion and mushrooms in a large skillet until meat is browned , drain
3. Combine with remaining ingredients and place in a greased 3 quart casserole dish
4. Cover and bake for 45 minutes

title: sally s stuffed bell peppers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Wash peppers , cut off stem and take out seeds
3. When cutting off the stem , make a big enough circular cut on the top of pepper for stuffing
4. Almost entire top of pepper is cut off
5. Mix beaten egg , rice and raw ground beef and stuff into peppers and place into a casserole dish
6. Cover with tomato soup , tomato sauce and add 1 / 2 soup can of water to dish
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour

title: grilled pork chops with vanilla scented apples
steps:
1. Grill pork chops until barely done
2. Place on a platter in a warm oven
3. Add butter , brown sugar and cinnamon to pan over medium heat
4. Stir to blend well and to allow to caramelize slightly
5. Add apple juice , licor 43 and apple slices
6. Cook apples just until done , then remove with a slotted spoon and set apples aside
7. Reduce the pan juices to two to three tablespoons
8. Remove from heat and add vanilla , salt and pepper
9. Add apple slices and return to heat until the apples are hot
10. Pour over the pork chops
11. Serve with rice or potatoes

title: southern broccoli casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Add 1 tablespoon margarine to a pan and lightly sautee onions until soft
3. Remove onions and set aside , reserving remaining margarine
4. Beat two eggs and set aside
5. Add broccoli , sauteed onion , mushroom soup , mayonnaise , cheese , and eggs to a medium bowl and mix together until well-blended
6. Add mixture to a 1
7. 5 to 2 quart casserole dish
8. Combine reserved margarine from pan and remaining 2 tablespoons of melted margarine and gently mix together with ritz crackers in a small bowl until crackers are coated but not saturated
9. Layer crackers as a topping over broccoli mixture
10. Bake at 350 degrees for 30-45 minutes

title: low sugar chocolate frosting
steps:
1. Cream softened butter on high speed until it turns pale , or a little over 1 minute
2. Add in sugar and beat until smooth
3. Then gradually add cocoa and vanilla
4. Make sure all ingredients are well blended and there are no lumps
5. Spoon in the milk , one tablespoon at a time
6. Beat thoroughly before adding in the next spoon
7. Yield is a guess

title: feijoada  brazilian black bean and mixed meat stew  with orange
steps:
1. Drain the beans and place in a very large clean pan fill with enough water to cover the beans by around 2 inches and bring to the boil
2. Do not add salt
3. Once boiling , reduce the heat to medium and cook for 45 minutes , stirring occasionally if you remember to
4. Now add the cubed steak and the bay leaves and reduce the heat to low
5. In a separate frying pan heat the oil over a high heat , fry the pork belly until browned all over and add to the pot
6. Fry the raw spicy sausages whole and once browned , slice and add to the pot
7. Fry the bacon and add to the pot
8. Lastly add the cooked smoked sausage slices
9. Cook over a medium heat for 15 minutes , if the mixture is looking a little dry , add more water but do not water log
10. Reduce the heat to low
11. Now take out a cup full of the beans and water leaving the meat in the pan
12. Put in the blender with the onion and garlic , whizz until almost smooth and add to the pot
13. Add the hot pepper sauce if using , season to taste with salt and pepper and cook over a low heat for an hour or two checking every 15 minutes or so
14. Do not let the mixture dry out
15. You should have a thick , meaty fragrant stew , if not continue cooking until the excess water has evaporated
16. Serve with white rice and the orange and coriander salad below
17. Freeze any leftovers within 24hours
18. For the salad , cut the onion into rings or half rings and soak in iced water for at least an hour
19. Cut the oranges on a plate to catch the juice
20. Slice the top and bottom off each orange and run a knife down under the skin and pith so you end up with a perfectly peeled orange with no white pith
21. Cut into rounds , remove any pips and arrange on a plate or platter
22. Season with salt and plenty of pepper
23. Drain the onions and pat dry , mix with the olive oil , lemon juice and coriander then season well
24. Sprinkle over the oranges and garnishing with a little extra coriander
25. Enjoy your feast ! in brazil they say that feijoada will induce sleep , so don't eat it on a busy day !

title: moroccan orange   date salad
steps:
1. Chill the oranges for at least 1 hour
2. Add the dates
3. Combine all the dressing ingredients , pour over the oranges , and toss to coat
4. Let stand for about 10 minutes
5. Divide the oranges between serving plates or arrange in overlapping sections on a serving platter
6. Sprinkle with the almonds

title: world s best grilled steak
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients , pour over steaks
2. Marinate 3 hours , turning frequently
3. Grill to your liking

title: southern style green beans
steps:
1. Combine ingredients in large saucepan
2. Cover and simmer for about 1 hour

title: nineteen forty eight cocoa cake
steps:
1. Mix water , cocoa , and baking soda first , set aside while mixing remaining ingredients
2. Cream butter and sugar add eggs
3. Add half the flour and half the milk beat then add rst of flour and rest of milk
4. Last , add the cocoa mixture and mix well
5. Stir in vanilla
6. Bake in two well greased and floured pans at 350f for 30 minutes or until cake test done
7. Frost with your favorite icing
8. Cake will take on a red color after cooling

title: small batch popovers
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine flour and salt
2. Whisk together eggs and milk
3. Stir into dry ingredients just until blended
4. Pour into four greased and floured 8-oz
5. Custard cups
6. Place on a baking sheet
7. Bake , uncovered , at 425 for 20 minutes or until puffed and edges are golden brown

title: toblerone adult milkshake
steps:
1. Put the ice cream and milk in a blender and blend till smooth add the honey , kahluha , and the bailey's-blend
2. Pour into tall glass and enjoy !
3. Recipe can be made with milk , chocolate syrup and blended with ice instead of ice cream

title: spiced whipped cream
steps:
1. Pour cream into chilled stainless steel bowl and beat on medium speed until frothy
2. Gradually add the sugar , vanilla and spices
3. Beat on high speed until the cream forms soft peaks but do not overbeat !
4. Store covered in the fridge
5. Serve on your favorite dessert or coffee

title: plum and blueberry crisp
steps:
1. Make topping first
2. Using a food processer and chopping blade , grind almonds using on / off turns
3. Add flour , sugar and butter through feed tube
4. Process until mixture starts to cling together
5. Transfer topping mixture to bowl and crumble with a fork
6. Chill at least 30 minutes while preparing fruit filling
7. To make filling: combine filling ingredients in a bowl
8. Let stand 30 minutes before proceeding
9. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
10. Pour fruit filling into 2 quart baking dish
11. I use a corning ware casserole dish
12. Crumble topping over fruit
13. Bake 40-45 minutes or until brown and bubbly

title: sausage and fennel soup
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a medium-sized saucepan
2. Add garlic and shallots
3. Cook 1 minute
4. Add sausage , cook until browned , about 3 minutes
5. Add leeks , fennel , carrots , tomatoes , parsley and sprinkle all with salt and pepper
6. Cook another 2 minutes
7. Add chicken broth
8. Cover and simmer over medium heat for about 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender
9. Serve immediately

title: pepper and pancetta batter bread
steps:
1. In skillet , fry pancetta over medium heat until crisp
2. Remove and crumble pancetta , reserving fat
3. In large bowl of stand mixer , combine 1 tablespoon pancetta fat with hot water , 1 tablespoon of the sugar , basil , salt and pepper
4. Let stand for 10 minutes
5. Meanwhile , in small bowl , mix remaining 1 teaspoom sugar with lukewarm water
6. Sprinkle yeast over top , stirring to dissolve granules
7. Let stand for 10 minutes
8. With fork , stir down yeast mixture , whisking to dissolve all yeast
9. Mix into pepper mixture
10. Blend in egg
11. Beat in flour in 2 additions , adding a few tablespoons more flour if necessary to form smooth , elastic wet batter
12. Beat for 4 minutes
13. Beat in pancetta
14. Cover and let rise until doubled in bulk , 45 to 60 minutes
15. Punch down batter
16. Grease 6-cup ovenproof casserole dish , preferably round
17. Sprinkle with cornmeal
18. Scrape batter into dish
19. Cover and let rise until risen to top of dish , about 1 hour
20. Bake in 400f oven until bread sounds hollow when tapped , 35 to 45 minutes
21. Remove from dish
22. Let cool on rack

title: spaghetti squash   turkey sausage casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mist a 9x13 baking pan with pam
3. Cut squash in half lengthwise , scoop out seeds and place cut side down in baking pan
4. Bake 45 minutes until tender
5. Remove squash from oven and let cool slightly
6. Remove squash from pan , and using a fork , scrape out flesh back into pan
7. Spread out slightly
8. Mist a large skillet with pam
9. Crumble sausage into skillet and cook over med-high heat until no longer pink , breaking into small pieces with spoon
10. Remove from heat
11. Sprinkle 1 tbsp parmesan cheese and 1 tsp mrs
12. Dash over squash
13. Top with tomato spinach and crumbled sausage
14. Sprinkle with remaining 1 tbsp parmesan and remaining 1 teaspoons seasoning
15. Lightly coat the mixture's surface with pam
16. Bake 20-25 minutes more , or until casserole heats through and cheese melts

title: island pancakes
steps:
1. Drain pineapple and reserve liquid
2. In a large bowl , mix the oats , milk , oil , banana , eggs , and 1 / 2 cup of the reserved pineapple juice
3. Mix flour , baking powder and salt
4. Add to oat mixture
5. Beat well
6. In a small saucepan , blend the cornstarch and syrup until smooth
7. Stir in 1 / 2 cup reserved pineapple juice
8. Cook , stirring constantly , for 2-3 minutes until syrup begins to thicken
9. Stir in pineapple pieces and remove from heat
10. Heat griddle
11. Spray lightly with cooking spray
12. Pour batter onto hot griddle , about 1 / 4 cup per pancake
13. Cook until batter bubbles and edges begin to look dry
14. Flip and cook until golden brown
15. Serve pancakes with warm pineapple sauce

title: lchows kartoffel klsse  potato dumplings  1
steps:
1. Scrub potatoes
2. Boil in salted water until just soft enough to mash
3. Drain and mash smoothly
4. Add egg yolks , cornstarch , cereal , pepper , salt , and nutmeg
5. Beat well
6. Shape into dumplings
7. Place few bread cubes in the center of each
8. Roll each dumpling lightly in flour
9. Cook in rapidly boiling salted water 15 or 20 minutes
10. Remove cooked dumplings from water
11. Serve hot
12. Make 12 or more dumplings , serves 6 to 8

title: hearty chicken and vegetable soup
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat
2. Add leek and garlic
3. Cook , stirring , for 2 minutes or until soft but not coloured
4. Add carrot , celery , zucchini and swede
5. Cook for 2 minutes
6. Stir in soup mix , stock , chicken and 1 cup cold water
7. Increase heat to high
8. Bring to the boil
9. Reduce heat to low
10. Simmer , partially covered , stirring occasionally , for 1 hour or until soup mix and vegetables are tender add a little more water / stock if required
11. Remove chicken legs from soup
12. Allow to cool slightly
13. Remove meat from bones
14. Roughly chop chicken meat and add to soup
15. Season with salt and pepper
16. Ladle soup into bowls
17. Serve

title: two potato soup
steps:
1. In a big soup pot over med heat , let the oil get warmed
2. Add in onion , garlic , and celery
3. Stir / saute for 5 minutes or until tender
4. Add in potatoes
5. Stir to mix well
6. Add in stock , thyme , salt , and pepper
7. Bring to a boil
8. Lower heat to med-low and simmer , covered , 15 minutes or until potatoes are soft
9. Transfer mixture to a blender or food processor in batches
10. Process until smooth
11. Return soup to pot and add buttermilk
12. Simmer 10 minutes or until heated through
13. Ladle into individual soup bowls
14. Top with chopped apples

title: haystack onions
steps:
1. Make egg wash by mixing egg and milk
2. Put sliced onions in a bowl and pour egg wash over them
3. Turn onion slices so that they're all thoroughly coated , then pour onions into a colander to drain
4. Put flour and seasoning salt in a plastic zip-top bag
5. Add onions and shake to coat
6. Slowly add onions to hot cooking oil in batches
7. They fry up quickly , so make sure not to burn them
8. My dh says these are so good they're "no ketchup needed
9. " i like eating them with ranch dressing

title: rotisserie chicken rub
steps: 1. Place all ingredients in air-tight storage container & enjoy !

title: hearty meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Process or crumble the bread and combine with the minced vegetables in a large bowl
3. Mix the meat , eggs and seasonings together in a bowl
4. Knead until thoroughly combined
5. Add meat mixture to the crumbs / veggie mixture
6. Combine , but don't over mix
7. Set a wire rack over an 11 x 17 baking pan
8. Cut a 5 x 11 piece of parchment paper and place it on the rack
9. Form the meat mixture into and elongated loaf on the parchment paper
10. Mix the next 2 ingredients together and baste the loaf--set aside
11. Heat the oil and saut the onion rings
12. When soft and golden in places , add water and cook until most of the water evaporates
13. Garnish the loaf with the onion rings
14. Bake 30 minutes , then sprinkle rosemary needles on top
15. Continue baking for another 25 minutes
16. Cool on rack for 15 minutes before serving

title: scandinavian almond bread
steps:
1. Beat sugar , egg , extract , and milk , add flour and baking powder , finally add margarine
2. Pour into bundt cake pan sprayed with cooking spray
3. Bake at 350 degrees for 40-50 minutes
4. Edges must be golden brown
5. Cool in pan before removing
6. Bread will break if removed too soon
7. Sprinkle with confectionary sugar
8. Cool cake in pan before removing as it can break apart
9. Variation: before pouring batter into pan , sprinkle sliced almonds on the bottom

title: easy minestrone
steps:
1. In a large pot , cook onions in 3 / 4 cup broth , over medium high heat until onions are translucent , about 5 minutes
2. Add another 1 / 2 cup broth and garlic
3. Cook for 5 more minutes
4. Stir in tomatoes , rest of broth , garbanzo beans , kidney beans , kale and pasta
5. Add italian seasoning , rosemary red pepper flakes
6. Bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat
8. Cover and simmer 10 to 12 minutes , or until pasta is tender
9. Season with salt and pepper before serving

title: snowball suprises
steps:
1. Cream the butter and sugar until fluffy
2. Add the vanilla and mix well
3. Add flour , combine well , and wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for half an hour
4. Preheat oven to 350f
5. Take dough out of refrigerator and break into balls large enough to cover a hershey's kiss
6. Insert the kiss and wrap dough around it , making sure it is completely covered
7. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet until cooked through , about 10 to 12 minutes
8. Remove cookies from baking sheet to wire rack
9. While still warm , sift powdered sugar on top
10. Cool completely

title: peanut butter  krispies bars
steps:
1. Measure and assemble all the ingredients and utensils
2. Grease the 8x8-inch square baking pan
3. Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat
4. Add marshmallows and stir until completely melted
5. Remove from heat and add peanut butter and stir well
6. Stir in the rice krispies until they are well coated
7. Press the mixture evenly into the prepared pan and cool on a cooling rack
8. Cut into squares

title: baked ambrosia
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f
2. Drain canned fruits well
3. Arrange all fruits in shallow 2-quart baking dish
4. Mix orange juice , sugar , zest & melted butter , then pour over fruit
5. Sprinkle coconut over top of fruit
6. Bake 15 minutes or until hot & coconut is toasted
7. Serve warm

title: salsa style green chile chicken bisque
steps:
1. In a large saucepan over medium heat , melt butter
2. Saute onion for 4 minutes
3. Add flour , stirring constantly for 2 minutes
4. Add cream , salt , pepper , toamtoes , corn , chicken and worcestershire sauce
5. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer for 15 minutes , stirring occasionally
6. Serve warm with cilantro sprinkled on top

title: oven stew
steps:
1. Place stew meat in bottom of large dutch oven
2. Peel and quarter potatoes
3. Layer potatoes on top of stew meat
4. Peel carrots and cut into sticks
5. Layer carrots on top of potatoes
6. Thinly slice onions and layer on top of carrots
7. Sprinkle salt , sugar , and tapioca over onions
8. Pour v-8 over all
9. Cover and cook at 300 degrees for 4 hours , or until potatoes are tender
10. Serve on plates , spooning sauce over potatoes , meat , and carrots

title: spicy oven baked catfish
steps:
1. For the fish
2. Wash the fish fillets under cold water , then pat dry with paper towels
3. In a shallow bowl mix together the dry breadcrumbs with seasoned salt , black pepper , garlic powder and cayenne pepper
4. In a bowl whisk or beat egg whites until foamy
5. Dip the fillets into egg whites , then dredge in the breadcrumb mixture
6. Place the fillets in one layer onto a well-greased wire rack that is set on a large baking sheet
7. Bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes or until fish is golden brown
8. Lemon cream sauce
9. In a bowl mix together one 8-ounce container of sour cream 1-2 tablespoons fresh chopped parsley , 1 / 2 teaspoon grated lemon rind , 2-3 tablespoons lemon juice and salt and pepper to taste
10. Cover and chill until ready to serve

title: easy ham with cranberry glaze
steps:
1. Set oven to 325 degrees
2. In a small saucepan combine the cranberry sauce , brown sugar , fresh orange juice , cloves , cinnamon , allspice and black pepper , if using
3. Heat slowly stirring until smooth
4. Place the ham on a rack in a shallow roasting pan with 1 / 3 cup water
5. Insert a meat thermometer in the ham
6. Bake until the thermometer reaches 125 degrees
7. Brush a third of the glaze on the ham 30 minutes before the end of baking time
8. Spoon on the remaining glaze every 10 minutes
9. After removing the ham from the oven , let stand for 15 minutes before carving
10. Delicious !

title: lemon chicken  chinese style
steps:
1. Cut chicken in half and pound to 1 / 2 inch thickness
2. Rub chicken with garlic , ginger , salt , and pepper
3. Coat chicken with flour , dip in beaten egg and press on panko
4. Deep fry at 350 degrees f , turning once or twice until golden brown on both sides
5. Combine sauce ingredients and bring to a boil
6. To serve , cut chicken into bite size pieces and pour sauce over

title: honey ginger ice cream
steps:
1. In a large sauce pan combine cream , milk , brown sugar , honey and freshly grated ginger
2. Warm over medium heat to infuse the honey and ginger into the cream
3. Place egg yolks in a stainless steel bowl and whisk to combine
4. Slowly whisk hot cream into egg yolks
5. Strain mixture through a fine sieve and chill over an ice bath
6. Once the ice cream base is chilled , process in an ice cream machine according to the manufacturers instructions and then freeze

title: eggless homemade ice cream
steps:
1. Mix together and put in ice cream freezer until done to desirable thickness
2. Fun for the kids: blend all ingredients in blender
3. Divide mixture among ziploc sandwich baggies
4. Seal the baggies
5. Then place them into gallon size baggies
6. Pour dry ice into the gallon baggies making sure to completely surround the smaller baggies
7. Seal the gallon baggies
8. Then let the children squeeze and punch on the baggies continuously
9. You'll have to fill up the dry ice a few times before getting it to desired consistency , but you do that in an ice cream freezer anyway
10. Besides this is an excellent learning tool for chemistry and it's fun for the kids , too !

title: boston market meatloaf
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together in first list until well blended
2. Place in a lightly greased bread pan and bake at 350 for 3 / 4hr
3. Remove from oven and drain excess grease from pan
4. Mix tomato sauce and sugar together and pour over the meatloaf and place back in the oven to finish baking until done about 1 / 2 hr depending on the oven

title: tea marbled eggs
steps:
1. 1
2. Cover eggs in saucepan with cold water and bring to a boil over medium heat
3. Hard boil the eggs
4. 2
5. Drain eggs and allow them to cool enough that you can handle them
6. 3
7. Using the back of a heavy spook , crack the eggs all over , but do not remove the shells
8. Try not to crack through the membrane under the shell
9. 4
10. Place the cracked eggs back in the saucepan
11. Add in the tea , cinnamon , star anise , tamari , salt , sugar , and enough water to cover the eggs
12. 5
13. Simmer for at least an hour and up to 2-1 / 2 hours or longer
14. 6
15. Drain and allow to cool to room temperature
16. You can refrigerate these little guys in their shells
17. Just peel them whenever you're ready to eat them
18. Great for a snack or a party platter

title: soy glazed butternut squash
steps:
1. Place squash in a lightly greased 13x9x2-inch baking pan
2. In a small bowl combine orange peel , orange juice , scallions , soy sauce , brown sugar , oil , and red pepper flakes
3. Drizzle over squash , tossing to coat
4. Roast , uncovered , in a 425f
5. Oven for 20-25 minutes or until squash is tender , stirring several times
6. Stir cubes again before serving
7. Place a toothpick in each squash cube , if using for appetizers
8. Serve warm
9. Makes about 48 appetizers

title: baked potato sticks
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Scrub and quarter potatoes
3. Melt butter in a 9- by 12-inch ovenproof baking dish in oven
4. Place potato quarters in dish and turn to coat with melted butter
