5. Arrange potatoes cut side down and sprinkle with salt and pepper
6. Bake until tender when pierced with a sharp knife

title: veggiegirl s low carb  lasagna
steps:
1. Layer these ingredients in a casserole dish
2. I put yellow zuke , spinach , tomato , tomato sauce , nutritional yeast , then more zuke , more spinach and topped with tomatoes and sauce bake at 325 uncovered for about 45mins or until the sauce in the bottom starts to bubble

title: chocolate tart with coconut macaroon crust
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. In a medium bowl , stir together all crust ingredients
3. Gently press mixture in bottom and up side of 9 in tart pan with removeable bottom
4. Bake 12-15 minutes or until golden brown
5. Cool completely on wire rack , about 30 minutes
6. Meanwhile place whipping cream and chocolate in med microwave safe bowl
7. Microwave on med 1 minute 40 seconds to 2 minutes or until chocolate is almost melted
8. Stir until smooth
9. Stir in almond extract
10. Pour into cooled crust
11. Refrigerate 45 minutes
12. Sprinkle almonds around edge
13. Refrigerated 4 hours or until set
14. Cover until ready to serve
15. Let stand at room temperature 15-30 minutes before serving

title: cottage pie with potato gnocchi
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven at 220c / 200c fan-forced
2. Cook gnocchi in a pot filled with plenty of boiling salted water
3. As soon as gnocchi has risen to surface of the boiling water , rinse under cold water and drain well
4. Toss in a little oil to prevent sticking
5. To make filling , heat oil in a large frying pan
6. Add onion , garlic , zucchini , carrot and bay leaves , cook , stirring , for 2 minutes or until softened
7. Add mince , cook until browned all over
8. Stir in flour , tomato paste and then worcestershire sauce until well combined
9. Gradually stir in stock , bring to boil and then cook over a med-high heat , uncovered for 5 minutes or until thickened
10. Season with salt and pepper
11. Spoon into an oven-proof dish
12. Top with gnocchi and cheese
13. Cook for 15 minutes or until cheese has melted and mixture is bubbling
14. Serve garnished with chives

title: healthy turkey bacon quiche
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Cook turkey bacon according to package , let cool
3. Coat a 9-inch pie pan with cooking spray
4. Overlap 2 of the tortillas in the bottom of the pan
5. Cut the third in half and cover the rest of the pan to form the crust
6. In large bowl , mix eggs , milk , and sour cream
7. Beat well
8. Salt and pepper to taste
9. Chop turkey bacon into small pieces
10. Combine turkey bacon , cheese , and broccoli into egg mixture
11. Pour mixture into pie pan and bake for 45 - 50 minutes
12. Allow to cool for 10 minutes before serving

title: mediterranean turkey bagelwiches
steps:
1. On bottom half of each bagel spread approximately 1 tablespoon of hummus
2. Begin layering turkey , cucumber , onion , and spinach on each of the 4 bagel halves with hummus
3. Place top of bagels on sandwiches and serve immediately

title: orange and almond spanish cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 180 c or 350 f
2. Line a 23 cm spring-form tin on the bottom and sides with greaseproof paper
3. Keeping 1 tbsp of caster sugar aside for later , mix the egg yolks and sugar together until pale
4. Then add the almonds and zest
5. Beat the egg whites and remaining tablespoon of sugar until stiff
6. Carefully fold into the sugar-egg mixture , trying not to knock the air out of the whites
7. The egg yolk / sugar mixture will seem quite stiff at first , but keep folding in the egg whites and it will soon loosen up
8. Gently ease the batter into the lined tin
9. Place on the middle shelf of your oven and bake for 60-70 minutes until it is golden on top and firm to touch
10. While the torte is in the oven , make the syrup by placing the orange juice , lemon juice and cinnamon in a saucepan with a handful of sugar
11. Bring to a gentle boil and simmer for about five minutes
12. Taste
13. The syrup should be quite tart
14. Cool and place in the fridge
15. When the torte is ready , remove from the oven and cool completely on a rack before opening the springform tin
16. Transfer to a plate and pierce four small holes in the top of the cake
17. Pour half the syrup over the top and serve with the rest of the syrup on the side
18. If you are making the cake ahead of time , i usually wait until a few hours before serving to pour the syrup over

title: oatmeal crunchies cookies
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375
2. Use ungreased cookie sheets
3. In a bowl , sift together the flour , granulated sugar , baking powder , soda and salt
4. Set aside
5. In another bowl , combine the brown sugar , shortening , egg and vanilla
6. Beat well
7. Stir the flour mixture into the shortening mixture , blend well
8. Stir in the rolled oats and walnuts , if desired
9. Form the dough into small balls about the size of a quarter , or a little smaller
10. Dip the tops of the cookies in a little additional granulated sugar
11. Place on the ungreased cookie sheets , sugared side up , about 2" apart
12. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes

title: chile relleno souffle
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees , layer 1 / 3 diced chiles in the bottom of a 4-quart baking dish
2. Cover these with a layer of cheddar cheese
3. Layer in another 1 / 3 of the green chiles
4. Cover this with a layer of jack cheese
5. Layer in the last of the green chiles
6. Separate the eggs
7. Beat the yolks then add the evaporated milk , flour , salt and pepper
8. Mix well
9. In a separate bowl , beat the egg whites until stiff
10. Fold the whites into the yolk mixture and pour over the layered chile / cheese mixture
11. Bake for 2 hours , uncovered
12. Pour enchilada sauce over the top and bake for an additional 30 minutes

title: chicken on lemongrass skewers
steps:
1. Cut approx 3cm from the lemongrass
2. Finely chop
3. Combine chopped lemongrass , peanut oil , lime rind and coriander in a shallow non-reactive dish
4. Cut each chicken breast into 4 , and thread onto lemongrass skewers
5. The lemongrass skewers may bend , if this happens carefully use a knife to cut a slit into the chicken - it should thread on easily now
6. Place skewers in with marinade and turn to fully coat
7. Cover and marinade for 3 hours or overnight
8. Cook skewers on lightly oiled bbq until chicken is browned and cooked through
9. Combine dressing ingredients in a screw top jar and shake to combine
10. Serve chicken skewers over rice and top with dressing

title: new york steak with garlic cheese sauce
steps:
1. Sear steaks in hot oil , until cooked to your preference
2. Remove steaks , cover and keep warm
3. In same pan saute onions for 2 minutes , add wine and cook over high heat until reduced to 1 tbsp
4. Add half and half cream
5. Boil until reduced by half
6. Stir in boursin cheese or garlic cream cheese until thick and hot
7. Pour sauce over hot steaks , garnish with parsley

title: pita pizza pocket  weight watchers  ww  4pts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Put sauce in pita salad pocket
3. Try to get it all on the inside
4. Place all ingredients / toppings remaining , making sure to top with cheese
5. Hint
6. I used a separate piece of alumunim foil to slightly prop up the open side so all the cheese didn't run out while baking it
7. Bake at 350 around 8 to 10 minutes , or until cheese is melted
8. I have made with onions , green peppers as well
9. You can add crushed red pepper or jalapenos if you like pizza hot

title: rosemary sourdough bread  bread machine
steps:
1. Add all ingredients to bread machine in order listed , or as recommended by your bread machine , beginning with 3 cups bread flour
2. Bake on the basic cycle
3. I always use the lightest crust setting
4. Check the dough about 5-10 minutes into the cycle and add up to another 1 / 2 cup flour if it seems too sticky

title: passionfruit and lemon slice
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c
2. Grease and line a square pan
3. Cream butter and icing sugar until creamy , add vanilla
4. Fold in flour and lemon rind
5. Press into tin and bake 15- 20 minutes until lightly golden
6. Filling: sift flour and add coconut
7. Lightly beat eggs and sugar , then add passion fruit pulp , juice and rind
8. Add dry ingredients and stir until combined
9. Pour over base and bake further 20 minutes , or until firm to touch
10. Cool in tin
11. Dust with icing sugar and cut into squares

title: savory crock pot roast
steps:
1. Cover both sides of roast with italian dressing mix and place in crock pot
2. Sprinkle thyme and basil over top of roast
3. Add salt and pepper
4. Gently pour red wine and water over and around roast being careful not to wash the spices off the roast
5. Sprinkle minced garlic over the roast
6. Top roast with baby carrots and mushrooms
7. Finish with a little more salt and pepper
8. Set crock pot on high for two hours , and then low for five to six more

title: homestyle hot tamales
steps:
1. Mix by hand in a large bowl the meat , onion , 2 ounces chili powder , 1 can tomato sauce , water , salt , garlic powder , black pepper , cayenne and cup corn meal
2. Prepare two shallow bowls , one with water and one with additional plain corn meal
3. Take about 1 tablespoon of the meat mixture at a time and shape into a small log
4. Roll lightly in additional corn meal
5. Roll in paper that has been passed through water
6. Close one end and roll up , folding remaining edge under
7. Put tamales in rows in opposite directions in a large roaster that can be covered and used on the stove
8. Bring two quarts water to a boil and add remaining tomato sauce and 1 ounce chili powder
9. Cover tamales with mixture , adding more water if needed
10. Cover and simmer for 2 hours on stovetop
11. Serve warm with buttered crackers
12. Tamales re-warm well in microwave

title: lovely smoked salmon and cream cheese entree
steps:
1. Line 4 holes of a muffin tin with cling wrap , using individual pieces for each hole
2. Line each opening with the smoked salmon slices so that it goes up the sides and overlaps a little
3. In a small mixer combine the remaining ingredients which have been finely chopped
4. Carefully fill in the cream cheese mixture into the salmon lined muffin tin
5. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours
6. Take out of the tin , unwrap and decorate with lemons slices , olives or capers
7. Serve with crackers

title: ricotta cheesecake low carb
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Line the outside of an 8" springform pan with tin foil
3. Combine crust ingredients , press onto bottom and up sides of the pan
4. Bake 12 minutes , cool on a wire rack
5. Meanwhile in a processor or blender mix ricotta and cream cheese until smooth
6. Add eggs , one at a time , blend
7. Add remaining ingredients , blend until well mixed
8. Pour into crust
9. Bake in a roasting pan filled half way with boiling water for 1 hour
10. Cool in oven 30 minutes then remove to wire rack and cool
11. Place in refrigerator to chill

title: better than kit kat bars
steps:
1. Line the bottom of a 10x15 cookie sheet with the crackers
2. Set aside
3. In a sauce pan over medium heat , add the filling ingredients , stirring to mix
4. Turn the heat up to medium-high , bring to a boil , continuing to stir , boiling five minutes
5. Pour half of the sugar-butter mixture over the crackers , spreading with a spatula
6. Add another layer of crackers , and then spread remaining sugar-butter over that
7. Melt topping ingredients in the microwave or on stovetop in same saucepan
8. When melted , spread over last layer in the pan
9. Cool for 10 minutes at room temp , then chill in fridge for about 30-45 minutes
10. Cut into serving portions
11. Substitution: this recipe can also be made in a 13x9 pan -- using the same amount of ingredients , to obtain a thicker bar

title: raspberry punch
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , except ginger ale in large punch bowl
2. Add gingerale just before serving

title: black and orange spook cups
steps:
1. You will also need: 10 7 ounce glasses or plastic cups
2. Pour 2 cups of the milk into large bowl
3. Add dry chocolate pudding mix
4. Beat with wire whisk 2 minutes or until well blended
5. Spoon evenly into the glasses , filling each glass half full
6. Set aside
7. Add remaining 2 cups milk to seperate large bowl
8. Add dry vanilla pudding mix
9. Beat with wire whisk 2 minutes or until well blended
10. Stir in food coloring until pudding is of desired shade of orange
11. Spoon evenly over chocolate pudding layers
12. Top with crushed cookies
13. Refrigerate at least 1 hour until ready to serve
14. Top with sprinkles
15. Pudding cups can also be served frozen
16. Prepare in plastic or paper cups and freeze for 3 hours or until firm

title: black bean and salsa soup
steps:
1. In a food processor with a metal blade or a blender container , combine the beans , broth , salsa , and cumin
2. Process 1 minute , or until smooth
3. Heat bean mixture in a medium saucepan over medium heat , until thoroughly heated
4. To serve , ladle soup into 2 individual bowls
5. Spoon 1 tablespoon of sour cream on top of each
6. Swirl gently
7. Sprinkle with green onions

title: rice lasagna with beef and sausage
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Cook rice according to package directions , remove from heat , stir in the provolone and set aside
3. Heat oil in a large skillet
4. Add beef
5. On the bottom of a 9x13-inch-baking dish , layer half of the rice and provolone mixture , half of the tomato sauce and half of the beef
6. Repeat the rice , sauce and meat layering and top with the shredded mozzarella and fontina cheese
7. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until hot and the cheeses have melted
8. Allow the dish to stand for 10 minutes , cut and serve

title: asian skirt steak
steps:
1. Mix together all ingredients in a bowl
2. Place steak in a plastic bag and add the marinade and refrigerate for half hour to and hour
3. Heat the grill to screaming hot and add the steak
4. Depending on thickness , grill for about 3 minutes on the first side , and 2 and a half on the second
5. Set the steak aside and let cool for 10 minutes
6. Pour the remaining marinade into a small sauce pan
7. Bring mixture up to a boil and let simmer for just a couple of minutes
8. Slice the steak and serve with the dipping sauce

title: super energy bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix all dry ingredients together
3. Add peanut butter , honey , and vanilla - mix well
4. Grease a 13x9 baking pan - spread mixture into pan
5. Bake for 15-20 minutes
6. Cool and cut into squares
7. I'm going to refrigerate them
8. Enjoy -- yummy & healthy !

title: rievkooche or reibekuchen  cologne style potato pancakes
steps:
1. Measure water into a large bowl and add lemon juice
2. Grate raw potatoes into the bowl filled with water
3. Place potatoes into cheesecloth and drain off liquid
4. Squeeze out as much liquid as possible from the potatoes , set aside
5. In a large bowl , beat the mashed potato with the egg , milk , and salt to form a batter
6. Add the grated potatoes and mix well
7. Using 3 tablespoons of oil for each batch , drop batter for 3 pancakes at a time into hot oil in large frying pan
8. When the pancakes are firm and golden brown on the bottom side , turn and brown the other side
9. Remove , drain on paper towels and keep warm in a preheated oven
10. Continue until all batter is used
11. Serve immediately with applesauce

title: faux pho   quick and easy vietnamese style noodle soup
steps:
1. Soak rice noodles in very , hot tap water
2. Heat oil in a large , deep skillet on medium hot
3. Saute garlic , ginger , and red pepper flakes , with the beef until the beef is 85% cooked through
4. Add broth , fish sauce , spices and sugar
5. Bring to a boil , then simmer for 10 minutes
6. Rinse rice noodles and chop into 4-5 inch pieces
7. Place noodles in bowls , pour broth and meat over noodles
8. Add any or all garnish desired
9. Personal
10. You can also do this with pork , fish , shrimp , or chicken , or use veggie stock and tofu if you want to keep it vegetarian

title: chilled crab dip
steps:
1. Shred the crab meat
2. In a large bowl combine sour cream and cottage cheese
3. Stir until well blended
4. Add the shredded crab meat
5. Sprinkle the powdered ranch dressing mix on top
6. Stir until well combined
7. Chill in fridge for several hours
8. Serve with veggies and / or wheat crackers
9. Watch it dissapear !

title: blackout cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease and flour 2 9-inch cake pans
3. Tap out excess flour
4. In a large bowl beat together butter and sugar until light and fluffy , about 1-2 minutes
5. Add eggs and vanilla extract
6. Beat till well blended
7. Add melted chocolate and beat 1-2 minutes
8. Mix together flour and baking soda and salt
9. Add to chocolate mixture in 2 additions alternately with the buttermilk
10. Beat till well blended
11. On low speed , add boiling water and beat till smooth
12. Pour into prepared pans
13. Bake for 35-40 minutes or until tester inserted in center comes out clean
14. Let cool in pans for 10 to 15 minutes
15. Turn out onto wire racks and cool completely
16. For ganache:melt chocolate chips and cream together and stir until smooth
17. Stir in butter and vanilla
18. Cover and refrigerate for 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours until ganache holds its shape and is thick enough to spread on cake layers
19. Cover one layer with a little more than 1 / 3 of the ganache
20. Top with second layer
21. Frost top and sides with remaining ganache
22. Press almond slivers into sides of cake
23. Refrigerate 3 to 4 hours for ganache to firm back up for easier slicing

title: chickpea salad on whole wheat pitas
steps:
1. Combine chickpeas , parsley , lemon juice , olive oil and half of garlic in large bowl
2. In another large bowl , combine salad greens , cucumber and onions
3. Whisk yoghurt , cumin , dash of tabasco and remaining garlic in small bowl
4. Add salad greens to bowl with the chickpeas and toss to combine
5. Season to taste
6. Cut 1 end off each pita bread and open to form a pocket
7. Using tongs , divide salad mixture among pitas
8. Drizzle some yoghurt dressing over salad in each pita and serve immediately cause these go soggy fast

title: caramel pecan clusters
steps:
1. On a greased baking sheet , arrange pecans in 6 clusters of 5 pecans , each
2. Place a caramel on each cluster
3. Bake at 300 degrees for 4-5 minutes or until caramels are melted
4. Top with a chocolate square
5. Bake 1 minute longer or until chocolate is melted
6. Spread the chocolate over caramel until smooth
7. Remove clusters from pan to cool on a wire rack

title: crawfish  shrimp etouffee
steps:
1. For shrimp stock , place 2 lbs of shrimp shells and tails into a stockpot , add 3-4 quarts of water
2. Add celery , onion , garlic , carrots , bring to boil
3. Lower to simmer and cook 3-4 hours , adding water if needed
4. Drain through a sieve , discarding solids
5. For the etouffee: heat 6 tbs oil and flour together in a heavy pan until it turns brown , stirring for 15-20 minutes
6. Add onion , stir , celery , peppers and seasonings , stirring , until vegetables are softened
7. Add shrimp stock and stir in slowly
8. Mixture will be very thick , so you can adjust the thickness to your liking by adding extra stock , simmer 10 minutes
9. Add shrimp , cook 5 minutes , add crawfish
10. Cook on simmer for 10 minutes until cooked through
11. Serve over rice

title: big red ice cream
steps:
1. Cooking time is approx
2. Freezing time
3. Add all ingredients to ice cream freezer and churn according to manufacturers instructions

title: pollinate tortillas
steps:
1. Mix ingredients , knead for a few minutes to form a dough
2. Put dough ball into a bowl and loosely cover with a cloth
3. Set in a warm place
4. Let rise for 20 minutes
5. Form into 8-10 rounds
6. Roll each round out , in turn , onto a floured surface
7. In a heavy bottomed pan , over high heat , cook each tortilla 1
8. 5 minutes on both sides

title: overnight butterscotch coffeecake
steps:
1. Layer in a greased bundt cake pan in the following order:
2. Frozen rolls
3. Powdered pudding
4. Brown sugar
5. Cinnamon
6. Melted butter
7. Pecans
8. Cover the pan with foil topped with a clean towel and allow to sit overnite
9. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 30 minutes

title: mini spinach souffle  cups  stouffers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Lay out 1 sheet of phyllo dough
3. Spray lightly with olive oil cooking spray
4. Repeat with 4 remaining sheets
5. Cut phyllo sheets into 6 pieces
6. Fit each section into a muffin cup
7. Bake for 10 minutes
8. Remove plastic cover from spinach souffl and microwave on high for 5 minutes
9. Remove from microwave and stir in lemon juice , salt , and cayenne pepper
10. Divide spinach mixture into baked phyllo cups
11. Sprinkle feta cheese over spinach mixture
12. Return to oven for 5 minutes

title: swedish rye bread
steps:
1. Place 1 / 4 cup warm water in small bowl
2. Sprinkle yeast over
3. Stir to dissolve
4. Let stand 5 minutes
5. Combine remaining 2 cups warm water , 1 cup all purpose flour and 1 cup rye flour in bowl
6. Add yeast mixture
7. Mix to blend well
8. Cover bowl with kitchen towel
9. Let sponge rise 1 hour
10. Mix sugar , corn syrup , shortening , aniseed , coriander , orange peel and salt into sponge
11. Gradually mix in enough all purpose flour , 1 / 2 cup at a time , to form slightly sticky dough
12. Knead on floured surface until smooth and elastic , adding more flour if sticky , about 10 minutes
13. Lightly oil large bowl
14. Add dough , turning to coat entire surface
15. Cover bowl with kitchen towel
16. Let dough rise in warm draft-free area until doubled in volume , about 1 hour
17. Grease 2 cookie sheets
18. Punch dough down
19. Turn out onto lightly floured surface and knead until smooth
20. Divide dough into 3 parts
21. Pat each piece into 5-inch-diameter round
22. Place on prepared sheets
23. Cover and let rise in warm draft-free area until almost doubled , about 40 minutes
24. Preheat oven to 350f pierce each loaf 5 times with fork
25. Bake until loaves are brown and sound hollow when tapped on bottom , about 1 hour
26. Transfer to racks
27. Brush with butter and cool
28. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: whipped cream cheese  homemade
steps:
1. Using your mixer , beat the cream cheese until whipped
2. At this point , you can gradually add in the milk until you get your desired "whipped" consistency

title: tam taeng   cucumber salad
steps:
1. Cut cucumber halves into 2-inch long sections , then cut each section into 1 / 4-inch thick strips or thick matchsticks
2. Place cucumbers in a bowl
3. Add the lime juice , sugar , and nam pla and toss gently until well combined
4. Add onion , chilies and tomatoes and toss gently until well combined
5. Garnish with whole chilies and coriander sprigs

title: raw spaghetti with marinara sauce
steps:
1. Process sweet potatoes or zucchini through a fine vegetable shredder so it looks like angel hair pasta
2. For sauce
3. Combine all ingredients in a blender and process until smooth and creamy
4. Add a little of the sun dried tomato soak water if needed

title: kfc  coleslaw  done  in  my  neck  of  the  woods
steps:
1. Chop cabbage , onion and carrot
2. Mix sugar , vinegar , celery seed , salt , pepper and oil in saucepan
3. Boil 3-4 minutes
4. Pour over slaw mix
5. Chill

title: 3 pepper quiche
steps:
1. In a large skillet , saut pepper strips and onions in margarine until soft but not limp
2. In a bowl , combine eggs , half-n-half , water , garlic , basil , and cayenne
3. Spoon peppers into unbaked pie shell
4. Pour egg mixture over peppers
5. Bake at 375f for 50-55 minutes until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean
6. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving

title: chicken thighs with lemon and garlic
steps:
1. Put the broth into a pan and bring to a broil
2. Add the garlic cloves , cover and simmer gently for 40 minutes
3. Heat the butter and oil in a saute pan , add the chicken thighs and cook gently on all sides until golden brown
4. Transfer them to an ovenproof dish
5. Preheat the oven to 375f
6. Strain the broth and reserve it
7. Distribute the garlic and lemon slices among the chicken pieces
8. Add the flour to the fat in the pan in which the chicken was browned , and cook , stirring for 1 minute
9. Add the wine , stirring constantly and scraping the bottom of the pan , then add the broth
10. Cook , stirring until the sauce has thickened and is smooth
11. Season with salt and pepper
12. Pour the sauce over chicken , cover , and cook for 40-45 minutes
13. If thicker sauce is required , lift out the chicken and reduce sauce by boiling rapidly , until it reaches the desired consistency
14. Scatter over the chopped parsley or basil and serve with boiled new potatoes or rice

title: peanut butter and apple bacon sandwiches
steps:
1. In a small bowl stir together preserves and cayenne pepper
2. Place 4 slices of bread on work surface
3. Spread slices with preserves
4. Top with apples and bacon
5. Spread one side of remaining bread slices with peanut butter
6. Place , spread side down , over apples and bacon
7. Spread sandwich tops with some of the butter
8. Preheat griddle or very large skillet over medium heat
9. Place sandwiches , buttered side down , on griddle
10. Carefully spread unbuttered bread with butter
11. Cook 2 to 3 minutes per side or until bread is golden and sandwiches are heated through
12. Makes 4 servings

title: christmas bean salad
steps:
1. Dressing: place the basic vinaigrette , mustard and crushed garlic in a screw top container
2. Whisk to combine
3. Seal with lid
4. Cut green beans into short lengths
5. Bring a small pan of water to the boil , add the beans and cook for 2 minutes
6. Drain and rinse under cold water then leave in a bowl of iced water until cold
7. Drain well
8. Place all the salad ingredients , including herbs in a large bowl
9. Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper , to taste , and mix until well combined
10. When ready to serve just shake container of dressing to refresh , drizzle over salad and toss to combine
11. Transfer to a large serving bowl or platter

title: caramelized garlic and garlic oil
steps:
1. Arrange the garlic cloves in a frying pan large enough to accomodate them in a single layer
2. Pour in the olive oil to cover the cloves , about 1 inch of oil
3. Place over medium heat and cook for 10 to 15 minute stir from time to time
4. Garlic is done when it turns a beautiful golden brown
5. Remove the pan from the heat
6. Using a slotted spoon , place the cloves in a bowl to cool
7. Return any oil that collects at the bottom to the frying pan
8. Once the garlic and oil have cooled , package the cloves in snack size freezer bags of 20 to 25 cloves
9. Freeze any bags that won't be used in 3 days
10. Transfer the garlic oil to a plastic container , cover and refrigerate
11. It will keep for several months
12. Makes 150 cloves and 1 cup oil

title: potted shrimps
steps:
1. In a pan melt the butter , stir the spices in then add the shrimp
2. Heat through , make sure the shrimps are all coated withe spicy butter
3. Take care not to overcook
4. Have individual ramekins ready , ladle the shrimps in along with the butter
5. Press down firmly
6. Use all the butter for topping off the pots
7. Let cool before serving
8. Will keep for several days in the fridge , perfect for drop in guests of a quick lunch

title: super easy and tasty creamy corn pudding
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a bowl
2. Pour mixture into a greased 8x8 pan for approximately 50 minutes at 350 degrees

title: garlic gravy for ham
steps:
1. After roasting ham , reserve about 3 tablespoons of drippings or fat
2. Discard any remaining fat from roasting pan
3. Return the 3 reserved tablespoons of drippings back to the roasting pan
4. Discard any crisp outer layers of onion , leaving the soft portions in the roasting pan
5. Place the roasting pan on the large element of the range
6. Add butter and garlic and cook over moderately low heat , scraping the onions and browned bits from the bottom of the roasting pan
7. Continue to cook until the garlic is fragrant and the butter is melted , about 2- 3 minutes
8. Add the wine and stir for 1 minute
9. Add 1 cup of water and stir to blend
10. Add flour and whisk until smooth
11. Add rosemary , salt , pepper and whisk again until smooth
12. Stir in chicken broth and mustard and bring to boil over moderate heat
13. Continue to boil , whisking occasionally until gravy is thickened , about 4 minutes
14. Adjust gravy consistency to your liking
15. Transfer the contents of the roasting pan to a food processor or blender and puree' until smooth
16. Pour gravy into a saucepan and keep warm over very low heat until ready to use

title: apple brown lennie
steps:
1. Make topping first: in a mixing bowl , combine flour and brown sugar
2. Using a pastry blender , cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
3. Set aside
4. Then make syrup: combine syrup ingredients in a small bowl and stir well
5. Set aside
6. Preheat oven to 350f degrees
7. Lightly grease a 12x8 baking pan
8. Peel , core and slice 10-12 medium-sized baking apples , preferably northern spy
9. Arrange apple slices in bottom of pan and sprinkle with the cinnamon
10. Drizzle with half the syrup , cover with all the topping mixture , then drizzle the remaining syrup over top
11. Bake for 1 hour
12. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream

title: simple wine biscuits
steps:
1. Add all ingredients in a bowl except flour
2. Mix well
3. Add flour one cup at a time to make moist dough
4. Take 3-4 tablespoons of dough and roll into a tube long enough to make a pretzel shape
5. Make into pretzel shape
6. Repeat with rest of dough
7. Bake on a cookie sheet , 2 inches apart , at 350 degrees for 20 minutes
8. Store in airtight container after cool

title: portuguese garlic steak sandwiches  prego no pao
steps:
1. Lay out steaks on a work surface and to be traditional , "nail" the garlic slices into the steak on both sides
2. If this isn't your style , just push the garlic slices in with your finger
3. In about 1-1 / 2 tablespoons of butter , fry each steak for 3 to 4 minutes , turning once
4. Remove to a dish and reserve
5. To the skillet add the other 1-1 / 2 tablespoon butter and the sliced onion
6. Saute until onion is golden , then transfer onions to the same dish as the steaks and reserve
7. Pour the red wine into the skillet used to cook the steaks and onions
8. Scrape up the browned bits and simmer over medium-high heat until liquid is reduced by about half
9. Return the steaks and onions to this skillet , season with salt and pepper , and cook another minute on both sides of steaks , until warmed through
10. Serve steaks and onions on warmed crusty sandwich rolls

title: spicy szechwan pork stew  low fat   low calorie
steps:
1. In a 4-quart dutch oven , brown meat and garlic in oil
2. Drain and add the white onion pieces , 2 1 / 2 cups water , soy sauce , sherry , ginger , red pepper , fennel , and five-spice powder
3. Bring to a boil , cover , and reduce heat to simmer
4. Simmer 30 minutes , add carrots and return to a boil
5. Reduce heat , cover , and simmer 35 minutes or til meat and carrots are tender
6. Skim off fat
7. In a small bowl , stir together 1 / 4 cup cold water and flour
8. Stir into the meat mixture and add green onion parts
9. Cook and stir til thickened and bubbly
10. Cook at stir 1 minute more
11. Serve over rice or noodles

title: oven roasted corn on the cob
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Rinse ears
3. Place corn cobs directly on middle rack in oven
4. Bake for 30 minutes
5. Remove corn cobs
6. Pull back husks and enjoy !

title: terbiyeli kereviz  poached celeriac
steps:
1. Place celeriac , parsley , 1 / 4 cup lemon juice , salt and water in a heavy 3-4 quart saucepan
2. Bring to a boil over high heat
3. Reduce heat to low , cover and simmer for about 20 minutes , or until celeriac is tender but still slightly resistant to the point of a knife
4. Remove and discard parsley
5. Transfer celeriac to a serving bowl with a slotted spoon
6. Cover and keep warm
7. Mix flour and cold water
8. Whisk into liquid remaining in pan
9. Cook , stirring , over high heat until liquid comes to a boil and thickens slightly
10. Combine egg and 2 teaspoons lemon juice in a small bowl
11. Beat in about 1 / 4 cup simmering sauce
12. Pour mixture into saucepan , stirring constantly
13. Pour sauce over celeriac , and top with chopped parsley

title: creamy corn and turkey soup
steps:
1. Cook onion in butter in large saucepan over medium heat until tender , stirring frequently
2. Reduce heat to low
3. Add cream cheese and cook until melted , stirring constantly
4. Add corn , broth , milk , turkey and red pepper and mix well
5. Add spices to taste
6. Cook until soup is heated through , stirring occasionally

title: upside down pepperoni pizza casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees and prepare baking dish
2. Over medium heat , combine the ground beef , onion and garlic in a large skillet until beef is browned
3. Add the mushrooms , olives , pepperoni and tomato sauce and heat through
4. Pour mixture into prepared baking dish
5. Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese
6. Top randomly with biscuit pieces
7. Bake 15-18 minutes until biscuits are browned and casserole is bubbly

title: vietnamese grilled steak wraps
steps:
1. Cut beef across the grain into thin slices
2. Combine lemon peel , juice , 2 tablespoons sugar , sesame oil , 1 teaspoon salt and black pepper in medium bowl
3. Add beef
4. Toss to coat
5. Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes
6. Combine water , vinegar , remaining 4 tablespoons sugar and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt in small saucepan
7. Bring to a boil
8. Boil 5 minutes without stirring until syrupy
9. Stir in crushed red pepper
10. Set aside
11. Remove beef from marinade
12. Discard marinade
13. Thread beef onto metal or wooden skewers
14. Grill beef over medium-hot briquets about 3 minutes per side until cooked through
15. Grill tortillas until hot
16. Place lettuce , beef , mint and cilantro on tortillas
17. Drizzle with vinegar mixture
18. Roll tortillas to enclose filling
19. Garnish with star fruit , bell pepper and orange peel strips

title: sourdough cornmeal bread
steps:
1. Add all ingredients to bread machine and set on basic cycle
2. Adjust consistency with milk while dough is kneading

title: low fat chicken corn chowder
steps:
1. In a large dutch oven or stockpot , saut onion in a small amount of the chicken broth over medium heat 5 minutes , or until onion is tender
2. To the dutch oven , add remaining chicken broth , corn , chicken , cream of chicken soup , orzo , rosemary , basil , sugar , salt , and pepper
3. Bring to a boil and turn heat to low
4. Simmer 10 minutes or until orzo is tender
5. In a small bowl , stir together milk and flour until smooth
6. Slowly add to pot and simmer 5 more minutes

title: mom s molasses cookies
steps:
1. Mix together brown sugar , crisco , molasses and egg
2. Add in flour , soda and spices , mix well
3. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour
4. Preheat oven to 375
5. Shape dough into walnut-sized balls
6. Dip tops in granulated sugar
7. Place sugar-side up about 3" apart on cookie sheet
8. Bake 10-12 minutes
9. Remove immediately from cookie sheet and let cool

title: elderberry vinegar
steps:
1. Rinse elderberries and pick out dirt , stems or dried out berries
2. Place berries in large bowl and mash them
3. Pour vinegar over and allow to stand 24 - 36 hours , covered with a clean tea towel or cheesecloth
4. Strain through cheesecloth
5. Allow to drain slowly for up to 24 hours
6. Pour juice into a non-reactive stockpot or preserving pan
7. Stir in the sugar , bring to a boil , adjust heat , simmer for about 15 minutes
8. Watch carefully as juice reaches the boiling point - it can boil over very quickly !
9. Let cool slightly , pour into clean bottles with corks , label and store in a dark , cool place

title: pineapple sweet and sour sauce
steps:
1. Drain both cans of pineapple over a bowl
2. Add / whisk in cornstarch until smooth and combined set aside
3. In a small saucepan heat oil over medium-low heat
4. Add in garlic and a small pinch cayenne pepper
5. Stir for 2 minutes
6. Add in ketchup , brown sugar , vinegar and soy sauce
7. Cook stirring until simmering
8. Add in the juice / cornstarch mixture
9. Bring to a boil , stirring or whisking constantly until thickened
10. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 3-4 minutes
11. Mix in the pineapple tidbits
12. Season with black pepper to taste if desired

title: swiss chard and bean soup
steps:
1. In a large pot , heat olive oil
2. Add onion and garlic , saute until onions are tender
3. Add all other ingredients , stir
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat , cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until chard is tender

title: corned beef   corned silverside for the crock pot
steps:
1. Take the meat out of it's packaging and rinse under the tap
2. Place in the crockpot
3. Add the remaining ingredients and enough water to barely cover the meat
4. I leave the peppercorns whole
5. Place on slow setting and cook for 8 to 8
6. 5 hours or on high setting for 4 to 4
7. 5 hours
8. When done , remove the meat from the crockpot and wrap in aluminium foil until ready to slice
9. Enjoy !

title: ghanaian peanut balls    african
steps:
1. Set oven to hot 400 degrees
2. Work the peanuts thru the fine blade of a grinder
3. Sift the salt with the flour
4. Cream the butter and beat in the confectioners sugar until soft and light fluffy , add in the vanilla
5. Stir in the sifted flour and the peanuts
6. Shape the dough into walnut sized balls , and set onto an ungreased parchment lined baking sheet and place a piece of slivered almond standing up on each ball
7. Bake in the preheated oven ten to twelve minutes or until the balls are just beginning to turn golden brown
8. Transfer to wire rack and cool completely
9. Store in an air tight tin for up to one week

title: sweet potato praline swirl
steps:
1. Place sweet potatoes in a large saucepan and cover with water
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat
4. Cover and cook for 10-15 minutes or until tender
5. Drain potatoes and place in a large bowl
6. Mash until smooth
7. Beat in the cream , eggs , brown sugar , vanilla , cinnamon and ginger
8. Fold in pecans
9. Transfer to a greased 8-in
10. Square baking dish
11. Combine sauce ingredients
12. Spoon over potato mixture
13. Cut through with a knife to swirl the sauce
14. Bake , uncovered , at 325 for 30-40 minutes or until a thermometer reads 160

title: orange angel cake
steps:
1. Sift the flour , icing sugar and salt together four times
2. Place the egg whites in a large bowl
3. Add the vanilla , orange extract and peel
4. Beat egg whites until foamy
5. Add the cream of tartar and keep beating until firm but still glossy
6. Add the granulated
7. Sugar 2 tbsp
8. At a time to the egg whites
9. Continue beating until the cling to the sides of the bowl and are stiff but not dry
10. Fold in flour mixture a little at a time
11. Do not stir ! spoon batter into ungreased tube pan
12. Cut through batter to release any air bubbles and gently smooth top
13. Bake at 350 degrees f for 45-50 minutes or top springs back when gently touched
14. Cool upside down
15. Top with orange glaze
16. Orange glaze 1 1 / 4 cup icing sugar 1 / 2 cup orange juice 1 tsp
17. Vanilla grated peel of one orange mix all ingredients together with a wooden spoon and spread on top of cake , allowing some to dribble down the sides
18. A family oriented website seasonal page topic - ice cream new appetizer recipes page

title: black licorice caramels
steps:
1. In a large heavy pan melt butter on low-med heat
2. Add sweet cond milk , karo syrup , sugar and salt
3. Place a candy thermometer on side of pan , be careful to not touch bottom of pan
4. Stirring constantly , cook on medium heat to 234 degrees
5. Remove from heat
6. Add anise extract and black food coloring paste
7. Pour into a buttered 9x13" pan
8. Cool and cut into desired pieces
9. Wrap in wax paper
10. It will be gone before ya know it !
11. This caramel is soft and chewy
12. If you would like it more firm , cook until about 244 degrees
13. I find that using the brand karo for the corn syrup works best , because some of the "off" brands contain water in the ingredients

title: east african curry
steps:
1. Melt butter in a 4 quart saucepan
2. Saut onion
3. Add garlic powder , curry powder , turmeric , salt and chili powder
4. Mix until aroma is released
5. Add 1 cup coconut cream , shrimp , potatoes , and water
6. Simmer until tender , about 20 minutes , covered tightly
7. Add lemon juice and 1 cup coconut cream and simmer until slightly thickened-about 10 minutes
8. Serve with hot rice , and bananas and coconut sauteed in butter and served on the side

title: pickled garlic with hot pepper
steps:
1. Combine vinegar & sugar over medium heat , stirring until the sugar dissolves , bring to a boil and boil 5 minutes add garlic and hot peppers , also add sweet red pepper if using
2. Bring to a boil and boil 5 minutes
3. Put a hot pepper into each sterilized jar , add the cloves of garlic to within 1" of the top of the jar fill with boiling sugar / vinegar mixture to within 1 / 4" of the top of the jar
4. Release air bubbles , ensure the rim is clean and seal the jars
5. Let the pickled garlic rest for 2 weeks and believe me you will enjoy

title: caroline s carrot salad
steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together and chill until served

title: bindy s bland meatballs
steps:
1. Crumble the beef into a large bowl
2. Mix in the grated parmesan , bread crumbs , parsley flakes , garlic powder , onion powder , salt and pepper
3. Mix in eggs , one at a time
4. If your eggs are jumbo , you probably only need 3 eggs
5. If they are smaller , you'll want 4 eggs
6. Add about 1 / 4 cup milk to help moisture
7. Use a little more or less as needed
8. You want the meat to be able to stick together when you form balls , but it shouldn't be so wet it is mushy
9. Lightly grease 2 912 baking dishes
10. Form meat mixture into balls
11. As mentioned in my intro , i use a medium size cookie scoop , so that i have uniform size
12. If you use a scoop , make sure to press the meat in tightly
13. You don't want a loosely packed meatball , or it will fall apart
14. Bake the meatballs at 375 f for 15 minutes
15. Turn the meatballs , and then bake for another 15 minutes
16. To further reduce any latent grease , i put them on absorbent paper towels for a few minutes before serving

title: halloween fudge
steps:
1. Beat cream cheese in a large bowl with electric mixer on medium speed until creamy
2. Gradually add sugar , beating until well blended after each addition
3. Add white chocolate , vanilla , pecans , and food coloring
4. Mix well
5. Spread in a foil-lined 8 inch square pan
6. Refrigerate 1 hour or until firm
7. Cut into squares

title: oreo pancakes
steps:
1. Sift together the flour , baking powder , salt , and sugar in a large bowl
2. Pour the milk in another bowl
3. Add the egg , stirring with a fork just to break it up
4. Stir in the melted butter
5. Add to flour mixture , stirring just until combined
6. Gently stir in the cookies
7. Let the batter rest for 10-15 minutes
8. Melt some butter in a frying pan
9. Ladle about 1 / 4 cup batter , for each pancake , into the pan and cook until bottoms are lightly golden and bubbles form on the surface--2-3 minutes
10. Flip pancakes over and brown the other side , about another 1-2 minutes
11. Serve immediately , dusted with powdered sugar and whipped cream

title: mock liver pt   green beans
steps:
1. Steam green beans for 12 minutes
2. Boil eggs
3. Saut onions in oil until lightly browned , 30 minutes
4. Pour all into food processor and pulse until thickened and pt consistency
5. Form and chill

title: kids  sweet potato fries
steps:
1. Dice the potato into 1 inch cubes and toss with the cinnamon and sugar
2. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray then spread potato cubes over it
3. Spray cubes again with cooking spray
4. Roast for 30 minutes in a 350f oven

title: garlic breakfast potatoes
steps:
1. Add potatoes to a medium frying pan , cook on medium heat , stirring occasionally , until potatoes begin to become soft
2. Add remaining ingredients
3. Cook , stirring occasionally , until potatoes are slightly browned and onions or peppers reached desired texture
4. Serve topped with ketchup or salsa ! yum !

title: little lemon pancakes
steps:
1. Combine flour , baking powder , sugar , and salt in large bowl
2. Add milk , club soda , egg yolk , lemon zest , vanilla and oil
3. Beat well
4. In a separate bowl , beat egg whites with electric mixer until stiff peaks form
5. Gently fold egg whites into batter
6. Spray a large nonstick frying pan with cooking spray
7. Over medium-high heat , drop batter by tablespoonfuls to make 2-inch pancakes
8. Cook until golden brown on both sides , turning once

title: oven fried bananas
steps:
1. Slice each banana in half lengthwise and in half crosswise to end up with 8 banana halves
2. Toss each half in melted butter and then in flakes
3. Place on baking sheet coated with nonstick cooking spray
4. Bake at 450 for 10 minutes
5. Drizzle with honey

title: moroccan fish and potatoes
steps:
1. In a heavy skillet or dutch oven-type pot , layer the sliced potatoes and sprinkle with 1 t paprika and oil
2. Place sliced peppers on top , then slices of fish
3. Sprinkle salt on next , then 1 tsp paprika
4. Spread coriander over everything
5. Add water up to middle of fish layers and boil on medium heat until water is reduced to just under fish layer , shaking pan occasionally

title: smoky sweet baked beans
steps:
1. In 13x9 baking dish that has been sprayed with cooking spray , combine all ingredients
2. Bake @ 350 for 1 hour

title: tostones  potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Bake the potatoes for at least 45 minutes
3. Allow them to cool so you can easily peel and cut them into 1 / 4 inch slices
4. Heat the oil in a 10-inch cast-iron skillet over medium heat
5. Brown the slices of potatoes , turning frequently
6. Meanwhile , prepare the gravy
7. Chile gravy: heat the additional 2 tablespoons oil in another skillet and blend in the flour
8. Cook until the flour is golden to make a roux , then stir in the garlic
9. Cook for just 1 minute
10. Add the cumin and oregano
11. Remove skillet from the heat
12. Combine the chile powder and water in a medium bowl , whisking until well blended
13. Add the chicken broth
14. Whisk this chile mixture into the flour roux
15. Place the skillet back over medium heat , and whisk the sauce to keep it smooth
16. Add the vinegar and salt and simmer for at least 15 minutes until the gravy thickens
17. To serve the tostones: arrange the potatoes in a shallow casserole or in 6 individual bowls and drizzle the gravy over the top
18. Garnish with the cheese and minced green onions , if desired

title: crispy crunchy  chicken
steps:
1. Combine soup , egg and seasoned salt in a bowl and set aside
2. Mix together flour , cornstarch , garlic powder , paprika , salt and pepper in a resealable plastic bag
3. Dip chicken pieces into soup mixture and turn so as to coat all over
4. Place chicken pieces in bag with flour mixture , seal bag and shake to coat chicken
5. Place coated pieces of chicken on a platter and allow to set until the coating becomes doughy
6. Heat oil in a deep fryer or in a skillet over medium heat , using enough oil to cover chicken pieces when fried
7. Once chicken is doughy , fry pieces in oil for approx 5-8 minutes or until cooked through and juices run clear
8. Drain pieces on paper towel and serve

title: chicken bombay  oamc
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , except chicken , in a small sauce pan
2. Heat over medium heat until smooth and slightly warmed
3. Roll each piece of chicken into the sauce and place in a greased , 9x13 inch baking pan
4. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes at 375f
5. Spread remaining sauce over chicken and bake for an additional half hour or until chicken is done
6. To freeze: after casserole has cooled , label and freeze for up to 4 months
7. To serve: thaw overnight and bake until heated through add an additional 30-45 minutes if baking from frozen

title: melanzana ricca  eggplant in meat sauce
steps:
1. Brown ground beef in large skillet with onion and garlic
2. Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes

title: anything goes fruit smoothie
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients in a blender until smooth
2. Enjoy !

title: sirloin tip crock pot roast with gravy
steps:
1. Put chopped onions on the bottom of the crock pot so the meat has something to rest on
2. Put meat in the crock pot and rub the salad dressing powder all over it , turning to get all sides
3. Open soup can and spread all over the roast with a butter knife
4. Do not add any liquid to the crock pot !
5. Cook on high for two hours , then on low for another four , at least
6. You don't want the roast to be falling apart , but you want it tender
7. Remove the roast and put on a platter
8. Cover with foil and let it rest in a warm place for about 20 minutes
9. Meanwhile , add the diluted flour to the juices in the crock
10. Turn the crock on high for 20 more minutes
11. Stir frequently
12. You can also make the gravy by adding the crock pot juices and flour mixture to a skillet over a med / high flame

title: deep chocolate raspberry ice cream pie
steps:
1. Place raspberries , sugar , and cornstarch in a medium saucepan and toss
2. Until cornstarch is completely dissolved
3. Place over medium-high heat , bring to a boil , and continue boiling 1 minute to
4. Thicken , stirring constantly
5. Remove from heat , stir in almond extract , and let cool
6. Completely
7. Meanwhile , place whipped topping in a medium bowl , sift cocoa over whipped topping , and gently fold in until well
8. Blended
9. Spoon half of raspberry mixture evenly over chocolate crust
10. Gently spoon ice cream
11. On top , being careful not to disturb raspberry mixture
12. Mound ice cream , then top
13. With whipped topping mixture , spreading evenly over all
14. Cover loosely with aluminum foil after placing wooden picks around top and sides to prevent wrap
15. From sticking to topping
16. Freeze until firm , at least 4 hours
17. Meanwhile , make chocolate hearts
18. Place chocolate chips into small resealable plastic bag
19. Place bag in a cup of hot
20. Tap water 60 seconds or until chocolate chips have melted , squeezing bag with fingers to heat evenly
21. Cut a very small
22. Piece from corner of bag
23. On a sheet of plastic wrap , squeeze chocolate from bag through cut corner to draw 8
24. Hearts
25. Then fill in heart with chocolate by squeezing and moving bag back and forth ,
26. Slightly mounding chocolate

29. Carefully remove
30. Chocolate hearts from plastic wrap
31. Place chocolate heart on slice or lean heart at an angle against wedge , with
32. Store any remaining raspberry sauce in refrigerator and ice cream pie and hearts inches
33. Freezer

title: garlicky braised cauliflower
steps:
1. Combine oil and anchovies in a skillet over medium-low heat
2. Cook , stirring , until anchovies begin to melt into the oil , about 1 minute
3. Add garlic and red pepper flakes
4. Cook until garlic softens , about 3 minutes
5. Add cauliflower florets and 1 / 2 cup water
6. Cover , cook on medium-low until the florets are soft enough to be pierced with a knife , but not so soft that they can be crushed , about 7 minutes
7. Uncover
8. Raise heat to high , cook , stirring , until water evaporates , leaving a thin layer of syrup in the bottom of the pan , about 5 minutes
9. Add capers and parsley and season with salt

title: cranberry salad mold
steps:
1. Bring cranberries and 1 cup water to a boil
2. Remove from heat when cranberries have popped open
3. Add splenda and stir , set aside to cool
4. Dissolve gelatin with 1 cup boiling water
5. Add cranberry sauce
6. Mix thoroughly
7. Add celery , pineapple and walnuts
8. Pour into mold or bowl
9. Place in refrigerator until set

title: caribbean kiss
steps:
1. Dip the rim of a cocktail glass into kahlua , and into brown sugar
2. Shake the liquors and cream with ice , strain into a frosted martini glass and sprinkle with cinnamon

title: hummus with raspberry vinegar
steps:
1. Heat oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add onion , and saut 5 minutes or until onion begins to brown
3. Add vinegar , bring to a boil , and cook 2 minutes or until vinegar evaporates
4. Cool to room temperature
5. Drain chickpeas , reserving cup liquid
6. Place chickpeas and chopped cilantro in a food processor , and process until mixture resembles coarse meal
7. Add onion mixture , cup reserved liquid , cumin , pepper , salt , and process until smooth
8. Garnish with cilantro sprigs if desired
9. Per serving : 44 calories , 2 grams protein , 1 gram fat , 7 grams carbohydrates , no cholesterol , 75 milligrams sodium , 1 gram fiber

title: cranberry crumble bars
steps:
1. In 1 1 / 2-quart saucepan , mix granulated sugar , orange juice and water
2. Heat to boiling
3. Stir in all remaining cranberry filling ingredients
4. Cook over medium heat about 10 minutes , stirring occasionally , until thickened
5. Cool
6. Heat oven to 400f
7. In medium bowl , mix brown sugar and butter
8. Stir in all remaining bar ingredients until crumbly
9. Press half of the crumbly mixture in ungreased rectangular pan , 13x9x2 inches
10. Spread with filling
11. Top with remaining crumbly mixture
12. Press lightly
13. Bake about 20 minutes or until light brown
14. For bars , cut into 8 rows by 6 rows while warm

title: spinach risotto
steps:
1. Heat oil in large pan
2. Cook onion , garlic , rind and mushrooms
3. Stir until mushrooms are browned lightly
4. Add rice , stock and wine , bring to boil
5. Simmer , covered 15 minutes , stirring midway through cooking
6. Remove from heat
7. Let stand , covered 10 minutes
8. Stir in spinach and thyme
9. Cover for 1 minute and serve

title: banana bars with toasted pecan frosting
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f combine sugar , 3 / 4 cup butter , brown sugar , sour cream and eggs in large bowl
2. Beat at medium speed , scraping bowl often , until creamy
3. Add bananas and vanilla
4. Continue beating until well mixed
5. Reduce speed to low
6. Add all remaining bar ingredients
7. Beat until well mixed
8. Spread batter into greased 15x10x1-inch jelly-roll pan
9. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
10. Cool completely
11. Melt 1 / 4 cup butter in 1-quart saucepan over medium heat
12. Cook , stirring constantly and watching closely , until butter just starts to turn golden
13. Remove from heat
14. Cool completely
15. Combine browned butter , powdered sugar , cream cheese and vanilla in small bowl
16. Beat at low speed , scraping bowl often , until smooth
17. Frost cooled bars
18. Sprinkle with pecans

title: old fashioned lemonade
steps:
1. In a small saucepan bring sugar and water to a boil , add peel and simmer for 5 minutes
2. Remove from heat , bring to room temperature and strain out peel
3. To a 2 quart pitcher add lemon juice and 1 / 2 cup of the syrup and 5 cups water stir , taste , adjust ratio of water and syrup
4. Serve over ice garnished with a mint sprig

title: tiramisu cheesecake cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Line 30 cupcake tins with paper baking cups
3. Place one vanilla wafer in the bottom of each cup
4. In a large bowl , beat cream cheese and sugar on medium speed until well blended , scraping frequently
5. Add sour cream and vanilla
6. Mix well
7. Add eggs , 1 at a time , mixing on low speed after each addition , just until blended
8. In a small bowl , dissolve 3 t
9. Coffee granules in 1 tbspp hot water
10. Remove 3 1 / 2 cups of cheesecake batter
11. Place in medium bowl
12. Stir in dissolved coffee
13. In a small bowl , dissolve remaining 2 tsp coffee granules in remaining 2 tbsp hot water
14. Lightly brush each vanilla wafer , just enough to moisten the entire cookie
15. Evenly divide coffee-flavored batter over wafers
16. Repeat wafer layering and brushing of coffee mixture
17. Evenly divide remaining plain batter over wafers
18. Bake 25-30 minutes , until edges are slightly puffed
19. Cool to room temperature
20. Spoon or pipe cool whip over each cheesecake
21. Dust each cheesecake with cocoa powder
22. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours
23. Store cheesecake in refrigerator

title: blue cheese french dressing
steps:
1. In a small bowl whisk together ketchup , sugar , vinegar , oil , lemon juice , salt , paprika and garlic until well combined
2. Add in the onions and blue cheese and season with black pepper if desired and add in more sugar if desired
3. Transfer to a glass jar with a tight-fitting lid
4. Seal and chill for a minimum of 6 hours before using
5. Shake well before using the dressing

title: udon and shrimp salad
steps:
1. Combine the shrimp , 2 tablespoons peanut oil , garlic , ginger , and vinegar in a heavy-duty plastic zip-lock bag
2. Seal bag and marinate mixture in the refrigerator for 1 hour
3. Cook noodles per package directions
4. Drain noodles in a colander and rinse briefly under cold running water
5. Shake the colander gently to drain
6. Set noodles aside
7. Drain shrimp and discard the marinade
8. Warm the remaining 1 tablespoon peanut oil in a skillet over med-high heat
9. Add the marinated shrimp and stir / saute about 4 minutes or until opaque throughout
10. Transfer to a bowl
11. Set aside
12. To make the dressing: in a small bowl , combine the garlic , lemon juice , vinegar , fish sauce , sugar , and pepper
13. Whisk until the sugar is dissolved
14. Slowly whisk in the 1 / 2 cup peanut oil until an emulsion forms
15. Place the noodles in a large bowl
16. Add the shrimp , cucumber , and green onions
17. Pour the dressing over the mixture
18. Toss gently but thoroughly
19. Serve at once , or cover and chill up to 8 hours
20. Garnish with cashews just before serving

title: warm potato salad with herbs
steps:
1. Steam potatoes until just tender , drain& set aside in a bowl
2. Add red onions and shallots to potatoes
3. In a seperate bowl whisk together the herbs , horseradish , white wine vinegar , oil of choice and salt and pepper
4. Pour over warm potatoes
5. Serve at room temperature
6. Enjoy

title: whiskey butter onions
steps:
1. In a small skillet saute onions in the butter until slightly softened
2. Add thyme , then stir in the whiskey and worcestershire sauce
3. Increase heat to brown onions a bit and cook to the doneness you like
4. Serve immediately

title: quick chinese noodles
steps:
1. Heat oil in skillet or wok
2. Add garlic , scallions , ginger , and stir-fry 1 minute
3. Add pork , stir-fry 2 minutes
4. Add chili bean paste , soy sauce , rice wine , hoisin sauce , salt , and sugar
5. Cook 5 minutes
6. Prepare pasta in boiling water and serve with meat sauce

title: roasted cauliflower with parmesan cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. In large bowl , combine cauliflower , oil , salt and pepper
3. Toss to combine
4. Transfer cauliflower to large baking sheet and spread into a single layer
5. Roast until cauliflower is golden brown , tossing occasionally , about 15 minutes
6. Remove from oven , place in serving bowl and sprinkle with cheese
7. Toss to mix
8. This is 1 point per each serving
9. Each serving is 3 / 4 cup

title: bacon blue cheese stuffed pork loin
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. To prepare the stuffing , place all ingredients in a bowl and stir until well mixed
3. Butterfly the pork loin
4. Butterfly again on the left side and on the right side
5. Spread the stuffing evenly over the loin
6. Roll the loin up like a jelly roll and tie securely at 2-to-3 inch intervals with kitchen twine
7. Place the loin in a shallow roasting pan
8. Sprinkle with garlic salt and black pepper
9. Roast for 45-60 minutes , or until internal temperature is 150-155f let stand for 1 minutes
10. Slice the pork , removing twine as necessary

title: applesauce jello
steps:
1. Following directions on the box , prepare the jello
2. Stir in the apple sauce and lemon juice , then gently fold in the cool whip
3. Pour into jello mould and chill until set

title: midsummer swedish strawberry compote   jordgubbskrm
steps:
1. Clean and hull strawberries
2. Cut large ones into bite-sized pieces or slice
3. In a saucepan , combine strawberries and sugar
4. Mix a little of the water into the arrowroot to create a thin paste
5. Add this mixture into saucepan
6. Add remaining water , and stir to combine
7. Bring to a gentle boil , stirring carefully & then take off the heat immediately
8. Pour the strawberries into a serving bowl , sprinkle with a little more sugar , and let them stand
9. Serve warm or cold with cream , milk or sour cream

title: slow cooker chicken chili
steps:
1. Turn a 3-quart slow cooker on high
2. Place cumin and coriander in a small , dry skillet
3. Stir over medium-low heat until it smells toasty and spicy- about 2 or 3 minutes
4. Combine it in a up with salt , pepper , oregano , paprika and cayenne
5. Put onion , garlic and green chilies into the slow cooker
6. Rinse beans , put them in slow cooker
7. Sprinkle chicken thighs with cumin mixture and pile the chicken into the pot
8. Add chicken broth / water
9. Cover and cook 8 hours or so until the beans are soft and the chicken falls apart when you stir
10. Serve with sour cream and spicy salsa

title: copycat don pablos salsa
steps:
1. Place tomatoes , onions , tomato paste , water , garlic powder , cilantro , cumin , salt and sugar in a blender or food processor
2. Puree until smooth
3. Add remaining measure of tomatoes and mix till blended
4. Add optional jalepeno peppers to taste

title: potatoes with hot sauce
steps:
1. Potatoes:
2. In a covered saucepan , cook the potatoes in a small amount of boiling salted water for 20 to 25 minutes or until tender
3. Transfer to a serving bowl
4. Keep warm
5. Meanwhile , separate the egg yolk from the white
6. Chop the yolk and white separately
7. Set both aside
8. Sauce:
9. In a saucepan , cook the onion and chili pepper in hot oil till tender but not brown
10. Stir in the flour and salt
11. Cook and stir for 1 minute
12. Add the evaporated milk all at once
13. Cook and stir till thickened and bubbly
14. Cook and stir 1 minute more
15. Add egg yolk , cheese , and lemon juice , stirring till the cheese is melted
16. Pour hot sauce over the potatoes
17. Garnish with hard-cooked egg white , peanuts , and olives , if desired

title: mexican fry bread  mexican fried gorditas
steps:
1. Combine flour , salt , baking powder and shortening
2. Mix until shortening is blended
3. Add water
4. Mix well
5. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured board
6. Knead until smooth , about 2 minutes
7. Roll dough into a ball
8. Place into a plastic bag
9. Separate and roll out enough dough to make six 4- to 6-inch thin , flat rounds
10. In a cast iron skillet , heat oil to 375 degrees f
11. Place rounds in oil
12. Cook each side 20 to 30 seconds or until light golden brown
13. Use a slotted spoon to remove rounds from skillet
14. Drain on paper towel
15. Fill with prepared fillings as desired

title: crock pot barbecued bbq ribs
steps:
1. Cut ribs into serving portions
2. I usually do two ribs together
3. Sprinkle both sides with salt and pepper
4. Place ribs on a broiler pan and broil 12 minutes per side or until browned
5. I like mine a bit 'crisp'
6. Drain if necessary
7. Place sliced onion in crock pot
8. Place rib sections on top of onions
9. Pour a little barabecue sauce over each section as you place them in the crock pot and the rest of the bottle over all the ribs
10. Cover and cook on low for about 8 hours

title: easy fruit cobbler
steps:
1. Read directions before you begin mixing
2. Preheat oven to 350f degrees
3. Put 1 / 2 cup butter in small flat baking dish and put in oven to melt butter
4. Remove dish from oven
5. Mix 1 cup sugar , flour , baking powder and milk
6. Pour into melted butter--do not stir
7. Pour 2 cups fruit on top and sprinkle with 3 / 4 cup sugar--do not stir--
8. Bake 35 to 45 minutes

title: fruit salsa and cinnamon chips
steps:
1. In a large bowl , thoroughly mix kiwis , golden delicious apples , raspberries , strawberries , white sugar , brown sugar and fruit preserves
2. Cover and chill in the refrigerator at least 15 minutes
3. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
4. Coat one side of each flour tortilla with butter flavored cooking spray
5. Cut into wedges and arrange in a single layer on a large baking sheet
6. Sprinkle wedges with desired amount of cinnamon sugar
7. Spray again with cooking spray
8. Bake in the preheated oven 8 to 10 minutes
9. Repeat with any remaining tortilla wedges
10. Allow to cool approximately 15 minutes
11. Serve with chilled fruit and spice mixture

title: fall time pumpkin cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Lightly grease a standard size bundt pan , 9 x 13-inch baking pan , or two 9-inch cake pans
3. In a large bowl , mix together the yellow cake mix , sugar , oil , pumpkin , water , cinnamon and eggs
4. Beat until well blended
5. Transfer to the baking dish or cake pans
6. Bake for 45 minutes
7. For glaze , cook together the butter , whipping cream and brown sugar for 3 minutes , stirring
8. When slightly cooled , pour over cake

title: irish baked eggs
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 160 c , 325 f , gas mark 3
2. Chop the celery , potato and carrot finely , place in a pot and add just enough water to cover the vegetables
3. Bring to the boil , simmer for 5 minutes then drain
4. Place vegetables into an ovenproof soup bowl
5. Slice the mushrooms and fry them in the butter until softened with the spring onion and garlic
6. Layer over vegetables in the bowl then place the tomato slices on top of that
7. Pour the milk into a saucepan
8. Mix the cornflour with a small amount of the vegetable cooking water and add to the milk
9. Bring to the boil stirring constantly , then season the milk and pour over the vegetables
10. Place the soup bowl in the oven and bake for 15 minutes or until the mixture starts to bubble
11. Remove from the oven and with the back of a spoon press down onto the mixture to make one dent for each egg
12. Crack the eggs into the dents
13. Sprinkle with a little grated cheese and return bowl to the oven for about 5 minutes until the cheese has melted and the eggs are set but not hard

title: slow cooked portuguese lamb
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 150c
2. Trim all the fat off the leg of lamb
3. Put the lamb into a casserole dish with the red wine , tomato juice , peeled tomatoes , spring onions , onions , garlic , rosemary , thyme , salt and pepper
4. Cover and heat in oven for 4 hours
5. After 4 hours add the chick peas and butter beans
6. Increase the heat to 200c and cook uncovered for another hour

title: creamy pesto dressing
steps:
1. In a small bowl stir together mayonnaise or salad dressing and pesto
2. Add enough buttermilk until mixture is desired consistency
3. Cover and store dressing in the refrigerator for up to 1 week

title: crisp grilled cheese sandwich
steps:
1. Spread each slice of bread on both sides with butter
2. Arrange four slices in large skillet and cook over medium heat until turning light golden , 2 to 3 minutes
3. Sprinkle slices with the 1 / 2 cup parmesan and , using a spatula , flip over
4. Sprinkle toasted sides of bread with 1 cup cheddar and cook until cheddar begins to melt and parmesan begins to brown and crisp , 2 to 3 minutes
5. Once cheddar is melted , turn 2 of the slices onto the other two and press together to sandwich
6. Transfer to cutting board
7. Allow sandwiches to rest about 3 minutes , then cut in half and serve

title: rocket pops
steps:
1. Combine dry cherry gelatin mix and 1 / 2 cup sugar in a medium bowl
2. Add 1 cup boiling water
3. Stir at least 2 minute until gelatin is completely dissolved
4. Add enough ice cubes to 1 cup cold water to measure 2 cups
5. Add to gelatin
6. Stir until ice is completely melted
7. Pour evenly into 16 paper or plastic cups , adding about 1 / 4 cup of gelatin to each cup
8. Freeze 1 hour
9. Meahwhile , combine dry blue gelatin mix and 1 / 2 cup sugar in a medium bowl
10. Add 1 cup boiling water
11. Stir at least 2 minute until gelatin is completely dissolved
12. Add enough ice cubes to 1 cup cold water to measure 2 cups
13. Add to gelatin
14. Stir until ice is completely melted
15. Refrigerate 1 hour
16. Spoon about 3 tbs
17. Of the whipped cream over red gelatin in each cup
18. Top evenly with blue gelatin , adding about 1 / 4 cup to each cup
19. Freeze 1 hour our until almost firm
20. Insert a wooden pop stick or plastic spoon into center of each cup for a handle
21. Freeze and additional 4 hours or overnight
22. To remove pops from cup , place bottom of cup under warm running water for 15 seconds
23. Press firmly on bottoms of cups to release pops
24. Do not twist or pull pop sticks
25. Store leftover pops in freezer

title: caramel pecan pound cake
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar add eggs one at a time
2. Then add vanilla
3. Next add a little at a time of the the flour mixed with the baking powder and salt
4. Then add buttermilk and pecans
5. Pour into a pre-greased and floured bundt pan or tube pan
6. Bake at 350f for 1 hour
7. Let cake cool
8. For the topping , add brown sugar and butter to a sauce pan and melt until smooth
9. Add syrup , whipping cream and pecans and bring to a slow boil remove from the heat and stir caramel mixture for a few minutes or until slightly cooled and pour over the cake
10. Enjoy !

title: melon with blueberries
steps:
1. Combine fruit
2. Mix together honey and lemon juice and pour over fruit
3. Toss to mix
4. Cover and refrigerate until serving time
5. Garnish with mint leaves

title: buttercrunch popcorn
steps:
1. Heat oven to 250 degrees f
2. Grease a 14x10" roasting pan
3. Pop the popcorn
4. Put the nuts and popcorn in a very large bowl
5. Bring the brown sugar , corn syrup and butter to boil , stirring until the sugar is dissolved
6. Reduce the heat and cook for 5 minutes
7. Remove from heat
8. Stir in the butterscotch chips , vanilla , baking soda and salt until everything is blended and smooth
9. Working quickly , and using two wooden spoons , pour the syrup over the popcorn and nuts
10. Stir to coat thoroughly
11. Pour the mixture into the pan
12. Bake for 45 minutes , stirring occasionally
13. Remove from the oven , cool mixture in pan for about 15 minutes
14. Turn the mixture out of pan onto foil to cool completely
15. Break the popcorn into smaller pieces
16. Store in an airtight containers in cool dry place

title: nutty funnel cakes
steps:
1. Combine powdered sugar and cinnamon
2. Set aside
3. Using a food processor , place knife blade in bowl
4. Add nuts
5. Process until finely chopped
6. Add flour and next 4 ingredients
7. Cover with lid , and process 30 seconds , or until mixture is smooth
8. Pour oil to depth of 1 / 2 inch in a large skillet
9. Heat to 375f
10. Over medium-high heat
11. Cover the bottom of opening of funnel with your finger
12. Pour 1 / 4 cup batter into funnel
13. Hold funnel over skillet
14. Remove your finger from funnel end to release batter into hot oil , moving funnel in a slow circle so batter forms a spiral
15. Fry each funnel cake 1 minute or until the edges are golden brown
16. Turn and fry until golden
17. Drain on paper towels
18. Repeat with remaining batter
19. Sprinkle powdered sugar mixture over warm funnel cakes using a sieve or shaker
20. Serve immediately
21. Enjoy !

title: saucy one pot pasta and beef supper
steps:
1. In dutch oven or large deep saucepan , cook beef over medium-high heat , breaking up with a spoon , until no longer pink , about 8 minutes
2. With slotted spoon , transfer to a bowl
3. Drain off fat in pan
4. Add mushrooms , green pepper , onion , garlic and herb seasoning
5. Cook , stirring occasionally , until onion is golden and no liquid from mushrooms remains , about 10 minutes
6. Add pasta sauce , 3 cups water and reserved beef
7. Bring to a boil
8. Add pasta
9. Reduce heat , cover and simmer , stirring occasionally , until pasta is tender but firm , about 12 minutes
10. Serve sprinkled with parmesan cheese

title: sun dried tomato creamy vegetable pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 190c
2. Dice sweet potato and cook in microwave for 2 minutes
3. Chop up your veggies
4. Heat big pan over medium / high heat and add oil , add garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant
5. Add chopped leek , mushrooms , zucchini and asparagus and cook until soft
6. Add sun-dried / semi dried tomatoes and 1 cup of white wine , reduce heat and simmer until tomatoes are soft and start to break up and wine has reduced by at least half
7. Add cream , sherry , mustard and rest of veges including sweet potato
8. Bring to boil , then simmer until thickened
9. Season with salt and pepper , pinch of sugar and your choice of herbs and shallots
10. Grease a quiche dish and line with frozen puff pastry , add mixture and cover with pastry
11. Egg wash top of pastry and cut two slits through top of pastry to let out hot air
12. Sprinkle with sesame or poppy seeds
13. Put pie in oven and bake for approximately 45 minutes or until crust is golden
14. Serve with salad and hot italian bread

title: salmon salad pita pockets
steps: 1. In bowl , stir together , salmon , mayonnaise , sour cream , dill , lemon juice and pepper cut each pita in half and open to form pocket , line with 1 lettuce leaf and stuff with in a quarter of the salmon mixture , cucumber and sprouts , if using

title: bacon cheeseburger rice  oamc
steps:
1. Brown and drain beef
2. While beef is cooking , mix together soup , onion soup mix , bacon pieces and cheese
3. Add to browned ground beef
4. Simmer on low until cheese is just melted
5. Add rice and mix well
6. Serve immediately or allow to cool and ladle into 1-gallon freezer bag
7. Label and freeze
8. To serve: allow to thaw overnight in refrigerator and reheat on stovetop or in microwave
9. You could also freeze this in a reusable casserole dish for easier thawing / cooking

title: vodka sauce parma rosa
steps:
1. In 3 quart saucepan , heat olive oil over medium-high heat and cook shallot , stirring occasionally , 4 minutes
2. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds
3. Stir in vodka and bring to a boil over high heat
4. Stir in parma rosa mix blended with milk and cream
5. Bring to a boil over medium heat , stirring constantly
6. Reduce heat to low and stir in cheese
7. Simmer 2 minutes or until cheese is melted and sauce is thickened
8. To serve , toss sauce with hot penne
9. Serve , if desired , with freshly ground pepper and additional grated parmesan cheese

title: crock pot chicken ala king
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a crock pot
2. Stir to mix well
3. Cover and cook on low 6-9 hours
4. Cook rice as directed
5. Serve chicken a la king over a mound of rice

title: healthy cinnamon baked tortilla chips
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Cut each tortilla into eight wedges
3. Mix splenda and cinnamon together
4. Place the wedges in a single layer onto a cookie sheet
5. If they are very dry , you can spritz some water over them
6. Sprinkle the cinnamon splenda mixture over the tortilla wedges
7. Bake for 10-15 minutes , or until crisp

title: stuffed corn fritters  sorullos de maz
steps:
1. In large bowl mix flour and milk until flour appers to be thick but smooth
2. You might need more or less milk , depending on the texture yo prefer
3. Flour / milk mix needs to be thick enough so that you can stuff with meat
4. Add remaining ingredients
5. For meat:
6. In hot pan , add sofito and tomato sauce
7. Add meat and season to taste with adobo
8. Using your hand or a fkat surface , use sufficient amount of mixture to cover the palm of your hand
9. Add about 3tbs of ground beaf
10. Add another layer of flour mixture
11. Fry with canola oil , on medium heat , for 10-15minutes

title: spinach sauce for pasta
steps:
1. In a 2-qt
2. Saucepan over medium heat , in hot butter , cook spinach and salt 10 minutes
3. Reduce heat to low
4. Add remaining ingredients
5. Mix sauce well
6. Cook sauce until just heated through , do not boil !

title: easy shepherd s pie  potato ring
steps:
1. Put cut potatoes into large pot with enough water to cover
2. Add salt to taste
3. Cook until fork can be inserted easily into cubes
4. While potatoes are cooking , heat extra virgin olive oil in heavy skillet
5. Add meat to brown
6. Pour off and reserve drippings
7. Add carrots and peas
8. Reduce to low heat
9. In a small sauce pan combine beef drippings with beef broth , flour , and 3 tbsp butter
10. Mix thoroughly and continue stirring until slightly thickened
11. Pour sauce into meat and vegetable skillet
12. Mix together thoroughly
13. Cover and continue simmering on low heat , stirring occasionally
14. When potatoes are softened , drain off in collander and return potatoes to cooking pot
15. Allow moisture from potatoes to evaporate over very low heat for two or three minutes
16. Be careful to keep the potatoes from sticking to the bottom of the pot and burning
17. Add reserved butter , salt , pepper , and milk to potatoes
18. Remove from heat and mash potatoes until smooth
19. Serve by "plopping" a few large spoonfuls of mashed potatoes in the middle of the dinner plate
20. Spoon meat mixture around the potatoes
21. Add a couple of extra pats of butter to the top -- and dig in !

title: shrimp w feta and orzo
steps:
1. Cook orzo according to pkge directions
2. Drain
3. Put tomatoes in skillet over med-hi heat cook until liquid is absorbed
4. Stir in remaining ingredients , heat , sprinkle with feta
5. Divide orzo into 4 serving bowls , spoon shrimp and sauce over orzo , serve

title: sweetly natural trail mix
steps:
1. Mix all the nuts together
2. Stick them in a plastic container in your snack cabinet
3. Watch the trail mix do a dissapeering act

title: shaytards quinoa salad
steps:
1. Boil water and add quinoa
2. Cover and lower heat to simmer for 10 to 15 minutes or until water has boiled away
3. Stirring not necessary
4. Careful not to burn quinoa
5. Chop all produce
6. Strain excess water from canned products
7. Mix the chopped produce and canned goods together in medium-sized bowl
8. Add cooked quinoa and mix
9. Mix sauce ingredients in small bowl and add to salad
10. Serve cold

title: best ever hush puppies
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients
2. Leave thick
3. Drop by teaspoons into hot grease
4. Cook until brown on both sides

title: caramel twix cookies
steps:
1. Melt caramels in a double boiler , or in microwave following package directions
2. Spread half of crackers with caramel , topping with remaining crackers as you go
3. Melt chocolate as directed
4. Coat sandwiches in chocolate
5. Cool on wax paper

title: olive oil bread
steps:
1. In a large bowl mix together the warm water , yeast , sugar , salt , and olive oil
2. Stir in 2 cups of the flour in order to make a soft ball
3. Knead in additional flour so that dough is soft and not sticky
4. Place kneaded dough in a medium size greased bowl
5. Cover and let rise until doubled in size
6. Punch down dough , and form into ball or loaf shape
7. Place onto a greased cookie sheet
8. Cover and let rise for 15 to 20 minutes
9. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f
10. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 to 40 minutes , until golden brown

title: protein pumped frappe
steps: 1. Blend all ingredients with blender and serve

title: dangerous choc chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven 180c prepare trays
2. Combine butter and peanut butter in small saucepan over medium head , stir until melted and well combined
3. Transfer to a large bowl , cool 5 mins , add brown sugar and eggs , mix well
