4. Add combined sifted flours , oats and choc bits
5. Mix well
6. Roll spoonfuls of mixture into balls , choose the sizing that suits you
7. Place onto trays , flatten slightly with palm of hand
8. I like to freeze half the mixture in balls ready for a superquick bikkie fix another day
9. Bake 12-14 mins or until golden and firm yet still some give
10. Stand 5 mins on tray before transferring to wire rack to cool

title: steamed clams on the half shell
steps:
1. In a large pan heat butter and oil
2. Saute shallots 2 minutes add garlic give a couple stirs then add white wine simmer 5 minutes or till reduced in half
3. Add can diced tomatoes
4. Add seasonings and bring to boil
5. Add frozen clams just to heat
6. Place on a platter and drizzle olive oil over clams
7. Garnish with parsley
8. Serve with a nice fresh crusty bread
9. Or toss clams into cooked pasta for a meal

title: egg mice
steps:
1. Remove a thin slice from the side of the egg , so the egg will not roll over
2. This will be the bottom of the mouse
3. Slice the salami down the middle
4. Cut 2 thin slices , lengthwise , from the inside of each salami half , this will be the tails
5. Cut the halves in two , this will be the ears
6. At the small part of the egg and in the center , cut a small slit , just big enough to insert the broccoli floret , this is the nose
7. Just above the nose , cut two holes for the raisins to be inserted , this will be the eyes
8. Starting at the smaller part of the egg , where the nose is , cut two slits on each side , 1 / 3 of the way down the egg and insert two triangular pieces of salami , this will be the ears
9. Slice cheese cube in half crosswise to form two cheese triangles , one for each mouse
10. Plate mice on a dark platform and decorate with cheese pieces and serve

title: radish chive tea sandwiches with sesame and ginger
steps:
1. Mix butter , 2 tablespoons chives , sesame seeds , ginger and oil in a small bowl
2. Season with salt and pepper
3. Spread butter mixture over each bread slice
4. Top with radishes , overlapping slightly
5. Sprinkle with remaining chives and fluer de sel , if desired

title: rooibos anise tea
steps:
1. Assemble all the ingredients and place in a tea ball
2. Com has forced me to list the rooibos as "rooibos tea bags" but i used loose leaf tea
3. Place tea ball in hot water and steep for 10 minutes

title: chicken with leeks  mushrooms and wine
steps:
1. In a large deep skillet heat the olive oil
2. Add the chicken and sprinkle generously all over with poultry seasoning ,
3. Brown the chicken and remove from pan
4. Keep the juices in the pan and saute the leeks for 3-4 minutes , add more oil if needed
5. Once the leeks are almost soft add the onion , garlic and mushrooms and saute for another 3 minutes
6. Add the half and half , chicken broth , wine , mustard stir , add kosher salt and pepper to taste
7. Bring to almost a boil and turn down to simmer
8. Add the chicken and cover , simmer for 15 minutes
9. Uncover and simmer for another 12 minutes , add more broth if needed , cook to desired thickness , making sure to have enough sauce to pour over noodles
10. Pour over cooked egg noodles and enjoy !

title: lasagna by bert
steps:
1. Cook ground beef and onion till juice gone
2. Add next 9 ingredients
3. Heat till boils
4. Stir to break up tomatoes
5. Turn down to low and simmer 30 minutes
6. Stir periodically
7. Cook lasagna noodles
8. Drain
9. In a small bowl: mix ricotta and eggs
10. In a 13x9 pan layer noodles , egg mixture and meat mixture till gone
11. Sprinkle the mozzarrella cheese on top
12. Bake at 375 for 45 minutes

title: good and plenty
steps:
1. In a large skillet with a lid , brown meat until pinkness is gone and crumble the meat
2. Stir in onion soup mix , pepper , mushrooms , and tomato sauce
3. Stir in the macaroni and bring to a boil , reduce heat
4. Cover and simmer slowly , stirring frequently
5. Cook about 20-30 minutes or until macaroni is tender
6. Add boiling water as needed

title: mother lode pretzels
steps:
1. With a sharp knife , cut pretzel rods in half
2. Set aside
3. In a large saucepan over low heat , melt caramels with milk
4. In a large shallow bowl , combine the chips , toffee bits and walnuts
5. Pour caramel mixture into a 2 cup glass measuring cup
6. Dip the cut end of each pretzel piece two-thirds of the way into the caramel mixture
7. Allow excess caramel to drip off , then roll pretzels in the chip mixture
8. Place on waxed paper until set
9. Store in an airtight container

title: floating four leaf clovers
steps:
1. Pour soda equally into 12 muffin cups 1 / 2 way full
2. Freeze until solid
3. Place four quarters of lime onto frozen soda as follows
4. Rotate each quarter slice clockwise until one end of outer edge touches the center
5. Place over frozen soda
6. To make stem , place one peel at one corner of the clover
7. Splash a little bit of cold water onto the clovers just enough to cover them
8. Freeze until solid
9. Remove clovers and place in a ziploc freezer bag
10. Make as many more as needed , adding to punch bowl before serving

title: ham and cheese pasta salad
steps: 1. Mix up chill may need more dressing to your taste

title: artichoke and fennel caponata
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large non stick skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add onions , celery , fennel and garlic
3. Saute 5 minutes or until tender
4. Stir in raisins and next 8 ingredients
5. Bring to a simmer and cook over medium-low heat 5 minutes or until liquid is almost evaporated
6. Sprinkle with parsley and serve chilled or at room temperature

title: barefoot contessa s  foolproof  crispy roasted kale
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Arrange 3 oven racks evenly spaced on the oven
3. Lay each kale leaf on a board and , with a small sharp knife , cut out the hard stem
4. Tear leaves in half
5. Place the kale in a large bowl of water and wash it well
6. Drain the kale and dry it in a salad spinner
7. Dry the bowl and put the kale back in the bowl
8. Toss the kale with the olive oil , 1 t kosher salt and 1 / 2 t black pepper
9. Divide the kale among 3 sheet pans or roast them in batches
10. If you put too much kale on one pan , it will steam rather than roast and will never become crisp
11. Roast for 15 minutes , until crisp
12. Sprinkle with fleur de sel and serve hot

title: cranberry pot roast
steps:
1. Combine 1 / 2c flour , salt & pepper and rub all surfaces of the meat
2. Heat oil in a heavy dutch oven or very large , deep skillet over medium to med-high heat
3. Gently brown roast on all sides
4. Add broth , wine , vinegar , cranberry sauce , carrots , onion , orange , celery , cloves , garlic , bay leaf , cinnamon , and thyme
5. Cover and simmer for approx 3 1 / 2hrs , or until tender
6. For gravy: measure out 4c pot roast broth from the pot or skillet
7. Adding water if necessary
8. Melt butter in heavy saucepan over medium heat
9. Whisk in remaining 1 / 4c flour
10. Cook for 1 minute , then add pot roast broth gradually , whisking often to be sure it's free of lumps
11. Cook until thickened
12. Season with salt & pepper to taste
13. Discard orange pieces
14. Serve pot roast with gravy & vegetables

title: salmon club sandwich
steps:
1. In bowl , combine salmon with next 4 ingredients
2. Blend well
3. Evenly spread salmon mixture on 2 slices of bread
4. Top each with a lettuce leaf and a slice of tomato
5. Stack on top of each other face up , then top with third slice of bread
6. Secure with toothpicks and cut into triangles
7. Makes one club sandwich

title: tex mex cheesy chicken
steps:
1. Mix soup , with salsa , sour cream , and spices in bowl
2. Place chicken in a 13x9in baking dish , top with cheese mixture and bake at 350f for 45-60 minutes

title: tasty german chocolate pie
steps:
1. For the pie
2. In a microwave-safe bowl , melt chocolate and butter together , stirring until smooth
3. Stir in vanilla and set aside
4. In a small saucepan , combine sugar , cornstarch , and milk until smooth
5. Cook and stir over medium-high heat until thickened and bubbly
6. Reduce heat
7. Cook and stir for 2 minutes longer
8. Then remove from heat
9. In a small bowl , stir a small amount of the hot filling into the egg yolks
10. Return all to the pan , stirring constantly
11. Bring to a gentle boil
12. Cook and stir 2 minutes longer
13. Then remove from heat
14. Gently stir in chocolate mixture into the hot filling mixture
15. Spoon all into the pre-baked pastry shell
16. For the topping
17. In a small saucepan , combine evaporated milk , sugar and butter
18. Cook and stir until butter is melted and mixture just comes to a boil
19. Then remove from heat
20. In a small bowl , stir a small amount of the hot liquid into the lightly beaten egg
21. Return all to the pan
22. Stirring constantly
23. Bring up to a gentle boil
24. Cook and stir 2 minutes longer
25. Remove topping from heat and stir in coconut and pecans
26. Pour over the pie filling
27. Cool on a wire rack then cover and chill for at least 3 hours
28. Leftovers have to be refrigerated

title: christmas cheesecake
steps:
1. Blend wafer crumbs and butter together , press into a 10" springform pan
2. Spread 1 cup mincemeat over the crust
3. Blend the melted marshmallows and orange juice together until smooth then chill
4. Add the cream cheese and orange zest to the chilled marshmallow mixture and beat until smooth and creamy
5. Fold into this mixture the nestle's marshmallow cream
6. Spread the cheese and marshmallow mixture over the mincemeat coated crust
7. Garnish modestly with mincemeat and prepared whipping cream

title: marhahus papprikas   creamed beef paprikas
steps:
1. Saute onion in fat
2. Pull pan aside and stir in paprika
3. Cube and season beef with salt and pepper
4. Put in pan with bay leaves
5. Cook until juices form
6. Then add water and continue cooking for 1-1 / 2 hours or until meat is tender
7. Just before serving , add sour cream
8. Serve with dumplings , mashed potatoes or rice

title: sweet  n  sour meatballs
steps:
1. In large bowl , combine beef , egg , onion , breadcrumbs , salt& pepper
2. Roll into balls 1-1 1 / 2 inches in size
3. In large skillet saute meatballs over medium heat until browned on all sides
4. In medium bowl , mix together water , vinegar , ketchup , cornstartch , brown sugar& soya sauce
5. Pour over cooked meatballs , allow sauce to thicken , heating just until sauce starts to bubble
6. Serve over white rice

title: lorilyn s dinner roll dough
steps:
1. In heavy duty mixer bowl , stir together yeast & 2 cups of flour
2. In small saucepan over med-high heat , combine salt , sugar , milk & shortening
3. Stir with wooden spoon until shortening is nearly melted & just has a couple tiny , pea-sized lumps floating around
4. Pour hot mixture into mixer bowl with yeast & flour , add both eggs & begin mixing on low to medium speed til mixture is all wet
5. Begin slowly adding spoonfuls of flour & mixing until dough forms into ball around the dough hook & bottom of mixer bowl is no longer sticky with wet dough
6. Ball of dough will be slightly smooth & spring back when touched with finger
7. Remove dough from hook & bowl & form into ball with hands
8. Spray inside of bowl with non-stick cooking spray & then drop dough ball into bowl with the smooth side down
9. Then turn ball over so the seam side is now down
10. Cover mixer bowl with it's lid , a towel or foil & place in warm area to rise for about an hour
11. Dough will be about double the starting size in an hour
12. When risen , use fist to "punch" dough down in center
13. Then remove from bowl & divide into two balls
14. Place both on lightly floured surface & cover loosely with foil
15. Let rest 10 minutes
16. Roll out one ball at a time into large circle about 1 / 2 inch or less in thickness
17. Use pizza cutter to slice dough like a pizza into about 12 or so triangles
18. Roll each triangle up starting at large end & ending with the "tail" end
19. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet with tail on bottom
20. Cover & let rise for another 15-20 minutes
21. Bake at 350 degrees for about 12 minutes
22. One ball makes about a dozen or more rolls & therefore i will quite often make one batch for dinner & freeze one of the balls
23. To freeze for later , instead of rolling out the dough ball wrap it in foil & then place in sealed ziplock freezer baggie
24. Freeze immediately
25. To use , thaw in fridge for approximately 8 hours or 3-5 hours on counter
26. When pliable , roll out & cut into wedges to roll & bake

title: tropical tot shake
steps:
1. Puree fruit with enough juice to make the blender run smooth
2. Add remaining juice and milks , blend well

title: whole roasted shallots and potatoes with rosemary
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c / 350f / gas 4
2. In a large baking tray mix the olive oil and balsamic vinegar , add the whole twigs of rosemary
3. Add the shallots and potatoes , stir so everything gets coated well
4. Season to taste with salt and pepper
5. Roast , uncovered , for approximately 1 hour or until the potatoes are tender
6. Depending on the size of the vegetables and your oven , they might take a little less or longer , according to some reviews it might be worth checking after about 45 minutes
7. Stir once or twice while roasting

title: hot chicken or turkey salad
steps:
1. Crush cereal into coarse crumbs and set aside
2. Combine poultry , celery , olives , pimento , onions , salt and miracle whip , put into casserole
3. Combine cereal with melted butter and sprinkle over casserole
4. Bake uncovered at 400 degrees for 15 minutes

title: soy and sriracha glazed brussels sprouts
steps:
1. Trim sprouts and then cut in half lengthwise
2. Whisk together olive oil , soy sauce , sriracha , mustard , ginger and garlic powder until well blended
3. Place brussels sprouts in mixture and let sit for 3 to 6 minutes
4. Preheat a large stovetop pan over medium high heat
5. Once heated , place brussels sprouts and sauce in the pan , flat side down , pouring any sauce over sprouts
6. Cook for about 7 to 9 minutes or until bottoms are browned
7. Stir sprouts around , cooking for about 5 more minutes or until they are tender when poked with a fork
8. Sprinkle with sesame seeds when serving

title: scalloped spinach
steps:
1. Combine spinach , onion , eggs , milk , cheese , salt , and pepper
2. Turn into 9x5x2" loaf pan
3. Top w / buttered crumbs
4. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes or til knife inserted halfway between the side of the pan and the center comes out clean

title: pineapple drop doughnuts
steps:
1. Combine flour , sugar , baking powder and salt
2. Mix well
3. Add the milk , eggs and pineapple , stirring until smooth
4. Heat 3 to 4 inches of oil to 375f
5. Carefully drop batter by heaping tablespoonfuls into hot oil
6. Cook about 1 minute or until golden brown on one side , turn and cook about 1 minute or until golden brown on the other side
7. Drain well on paper towels and sprinkle with powdered sugar

title: banana boats
steps:
1. Slit each banana lengthwise through the peel , making sure not to cut all the way through to the other side
2. Stuff the banana with marshmallows and chocolate chips
3. Wrap each banana in aluminum foil and cook over a fire , on the grill or in a 300 degree oven for 5 minutes , or until chocolate is melted
4. Eat with a spoon

title: cream cheese coffee cake muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven 375f
2. Grease and flour bottom and sides of 12 muffin tins
3. Combine flour and 3 / 4 cup sugar
4. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
5. Reserve 1 cup of mixture setting aside
6. To crumb mixture in bowl add baking powder , soda , salt , sour cream , 1 egg and almond extract blending well
7. Divide among 12 to 14 muffin cups
8. Combine cream cheese , 1 / 4 cup sugar , and 1 egg and pour over batter in pan
9. Sprinkle reserved 1 cup of crumb mixture over all
10. Bake 20 to 25 minutes

title: flounder baked in brown butter
steps:
1. Arrange fish in a single layer ub a greased baking dish
2. Sprinkle with vinegar and salt
3. Dot with butter
4. Bake , basting every 5 minutes with crisp brown butter scraped from the edges of the pan , coating each piece completely
5. Should be finished cooking at about 25-30 minutes

title: pork chops and spanish rice
steps:
1. Wipe chops with damp paper towel and trim off all fat
2. Rub the inside of a large pot with fat from the pork chops
3. Brown the chops in the pot and remove as they are browned
4. Pour off fat
5. Place 3 chops in the bottom of the pan
6. Top with half of the onion slices and green pepper strips
7. Repeat with the rest of the chops , onions and green pepper strips
8. In a bowl , combine consume , tomato juice , water , mustard , salt , and worcestershire sauce
9. Pour over chops
10. Sprinkle raw rice around meat
11. Cover and bring to a boil
12. Reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour

title: mexican layered appetizer
steps:
1. Soften cream cheese and spread in a round glass baking dish
2. Mix 6 tbs picante sauce with the refried beans
3. Spread over cream cheese
4. Spread sour cream over refried beans
5. Spoon remainder of picante sauce over sour cream
6. Sprinkle onions , celery and cucumbers over dish
7. Sprinkle cheddar cheese on top
8. Garnish with diced tomatoes
9. Ifusing sliced olives , sprinkle over tomatoes
10. Serve with corn chips or tostatoes

title: broccoli   egg parmesan
steps:
1. Divide broccoli into flowerets
2. Steam or cook in salted water until almost tender
3. Drain
4. Arrange in a single layer in a shallow baking dish
5. Drizzle a little oil over the top of the broccoli
6. Sprinkle a large clove of garlic that has been minced over the top
7. Sprinkle with salt& pepper
8. Beat the 4 eggs with a tablespoon of water
9. Pour over the top of the broccoli
10. Top with some grated parmesan cheese
11. Bake at 350 degrees 20 minutes or until tender
12. Enjoy !

title: lomo de cerdo a la caucana  milk pork
steps:
1. Mix together the milk and lemon juice then place the pork in a deep casserole pour over the milk mixture
2. Cover with a lid and leave overnight in a cool place
3. Preheat the oven to 180c , 350f , gas mark 4
4. Lift the pork out of the milk mixture , pat it dry with paper towels and seas with salt and pepper
5. Heat the butter in a large frying pan , add the pork and saut until lightly browned all over
6. Transfer the pork back into the casserole containing the reserved milk mixture
7. Add the onion and garlic to the frying pan and saut until softened
8. Add the contents of the frying pan to the pork dish , scraping up any pan drippings and bake , uncovered , for 2 hours or until the pork is tender
9. Transfer the pork to a serving platter and keep warm
10. Skim any fat from the sauce and transfer to a saucepan
11. Bring to the boil then continue to boil until it has reduced to 360ml / 12fl
12. Oz
13. Stirring from time to time
14. Adjust the seasoning and serve separately with the pork

title: cranberry raspberry relish
steps:
1. Chop cranberry sauce with fork or fork and knife
2. Mix jello by 1 / 2 according to the directions on package
3. Chill in fridge according to directions on package
4. Enjoy !

title: plum cobbler
steps:
1. Stir the corn syrup with the corn starch and cinnamon
2. Toss with the plums
3. Spoon the mixture into an 8"x8" baking dish
4. Bake at 400f for 15 minutes
5. Meanwhile , mix the baking mix , nuts , milk and sugar
6. Vigorously 20 strokes
7. Drop the batter by spoonfuls onto the hot plums and then bake for an addition 15 to 20 minutes

title: easy italian farmhouse chicken
steps:
1. Combine cornflour , dried italian seasoning and pepper in bowl or ziplock bag
2. Slice chicken breasts in half lengthways and then in 2 to 3 pieces across
3. Flour chicken
4. Shake excess off before
5. Heat pan
6. Then add oil
7. Brown chicken and remove
8. Saute garlic , onions , mushrooms and red or green pepper until soft
9. Add diced zucchini , can of diced tomatoes with juice , red wine , lemon juice , lemon rind and brown sugar
10. Bring to a boil , reduce to simmer
11. Add chicken back into large pot on stove and simmer for 1 hour until chicken is tender
12. When done , add black olives and
13. Enjoy !

title: chocolate low carb cookies
steps:
1. Melt butter and cream cheese in microwave add splenda and stir until smooth mix in remaining ingredients add nuts , if using
2. Bake at 325 for 9-11 minutes

title: beets in orange flavor
steps:
1. Heat 1 inch of water in a steamer basket and bring to a boil
2. Place beets in a colander or steamer basket , cover , and steam for 20 minutes or until tender
3. Cool
4. Peel and slice
5. Combine the brown sugar , orange peel , and orange juice in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil
6. Boil for 1 minute
7. Stir in the sliced beets and simmer for 5 minutes

title: double chocolate brownie pancakes
steps:
1. Combine pancake mix , cocoa and sugar in large bowl
2. Stir in water with wire whisk until large lumps disappear
3. Add walnuts and chocolate chips
4. Stir until evenly mixed
5. Let batter rest for five minutes
6. Cook according to package directions
7. Serve with warm syrup

title: easy after work meatloaf
steps:
1. Mix 1 / 2 the can of soup , with everything else except parmesan cheese
2. Shape mixture into a greased medium sized loaf pan
3. Bake at 350 for 30 minute
4. Remove loaf , and pour remaining soup , mixed with the parmesan cheese on top
5. Bake for an additional 30 minute
6. Dinners ready !

title: iced apple tea
steps:
1. Add tea bags to boiling water
2. Let stand 15 minutes
3. Remove and add allspice , honey and apple juice
4. Simmer over low heat until honey is blended , about one minute
5. Chill
6. Serve over ice with lemon slices
7. Makes 6 8-ounce servings

title: sweet  n  spicy pineapple chicken
steps:
1. Chop the onion and garlic and set aside
2. Season the chicken with the essence seasoning liberally , and place chicken in an open roasting pan with tall sides
3. Pour the pineapple juice and pineapple chunks over / inside the chicken
4. Throw the onions and garlic into the pan as well
5. Bake at 350 for about , an hour and 45 minutes , or until the juice runs clear
6. Remember to baste inside and out frequently for amazing juiciness !

title: creamed cabbage with walnuts
steps:
1. Cook cabbage in 1 quart
2. Of boiling water with 1 t
3. Salt for 7-8 minutes
4. In separate pan , melt butter over medium heat
5. Remove from heat
6. Blend in cornstarch , salt and pepper
7. Gradually blend in milk
8. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thick and comes to a boil
9. Drain cabbage well
10. Arrange layers of cabbage , walnuts , sauce and cheese in layers in greased 1 1 / 2-2 quart casserole , ending with layer of cheese
11. You can also add a cup of diced corned beef or pastrami for a wonderful change
12. Bake at 450f 15-20 minutes

title: tomato studded tuna salad sandwiches
steps:
1. Mix tuna , tomatoes , celery , carrot , mayo , onion , capers , and vinegar in bowl
2. Spread 3 / 4 cup of the salad on bottom of each roll , add the tops , and cut in half

title: crunchy asian sesame salad
steps:
1. Combine lettuces , cabbage , carrots , peppers and onions with cheese in a large bowl and toss together
2. When ready to serve , dish up a portion and add rice noodles , nuts and sesame to taste
3. Top with dressing and enjoy !

title: chicken with balsamic fig sauce
steps:
1. Sprinkle both sides of chicken evenly with 1 1 / 2 tsps thyme , 1 / 4 tsp salt and pepper
2. Heat oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat
3. Add chicken and cook for 6 minutes on each side or until no longer pink
4. Remove from pan and keep warm by covering plate with towel or placing in warm oven
5. Reduce heat to medium and add butter to skillet
6. Add onions and saute for 3 minutes
7. Add broth , vinegar , soy sauce and figs
8. Simmer until sauce is reduced to 1 cup
9. Add 1 tablespoon thyme and 1 / 4 tsp salt
10. Cut chicken breasts on the diagonal into slices
11. Serve sauce over chicken

title: ham and cheese rsti
steps:
1. Beat egg in a large bowl
2. Stir in ham , 1 / 2 cup cheese , shallot , rosemary , pepper , and salt
3. Add frozen potatoes and stir to combine
4. Heat 1 teaspoon oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat
5. When oil is hot , pat potato mixture into an even round in the pan
6. Cover and cook until browned and crispy on the bottom , 5 to 7 minutes
7. Remove pan from heat
8. Place a rimless baking sheet on top
9. Wearing oven mitts , grasp the pan and baking sheet together and carefully invert , umolding the rosti onto the baking sheet
10. Wipe out any browned bits from the skillet
11. Return it to the heat and add the remaining oil
12. Slide rosti back into the pan , browned side up
13. Top with remaining 1 / 2 cup cheese , cover and cook the second side until crispy and browned , 4 to 6 minutes
14. Slide onto a platter and let stand 5 minutes
15. Cut into wedges and serve

title: cha cha sandwich
steps:
1. Spread cream cheese on each slice of bread
2. Put avocado slices on one slice of bread
3. Put ham slices on the other slice of bread
4. Spread mustard in between ham slices , but not on the top slice
5. Put the sandwich together
6. You know what to do next !

title: garlic rosemary mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Scrub and pierce potatoes
2. Bake at 400f for 45-55 minutes or until tender
3. Meanhwile , remove papery outer skin from garlic bulb
4. Cut top off bulb
5. Place on a piece of heavy-duty foil
6. Drizzle with 1 / 2 teaspoons of oil
7. Wrap foil around bulb
8. Bake at 400f for 30 to 35 minutes or until softened
9. Cool for 10 minutes
10. Squeeze softened garlic into a large mixing bowl
11. Cut potatoes in half
12. Scoop out pulp and add to garlic
13. Discard potato skins
14. Mash potatoes
15. In a small saucepan , saute rosemary in remaining oil for 2 minutes
16. Add to potato mixture
17. Add milk and salt
18. Beat until fluffy

title: raspberry sorbet
steps:
1. If using fresh raspberries: puree them in a food processor or blender with half the syrup
2. If using frozen raspberries: allow them to thaw at room temperature or heat them & half the syrup just until the berries are soft , then puree
3. Strain the raspberries through a stainless steel sieve , pressing the seeds hard again the sieve with the back of a spoon
4. Discard the seeds then mix in the remaining syrup
5. Chill then freeze

title: apple strudel easy
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375f
2. Beat the egg and water in a small bowl with a fork or whisk
3. Stir sugar cinnamon , lemon juice , salt , nuts , vanilla , and flour together
4. Mix in apples gently
5. Unfold the pastry sheet on a lightly floured surface
6. Roll the pastry sheet into a 16 x 12-inch rectangle
7. With the short side facing you , spoon the apple mixture onto the bottom half of the pastry sheet to within 1 inch of the edge
8. Roll up like a jelly roll
9. Place seam-side down onto a baking sheet lined with parchment
10. Tuck the ends under to seal
11. Brush the pastry with the egg mixture
12. Cut several slits in the top of the pastry
13. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon sugar
14. Bake for 35 minutes or until the strudel is golden brown
15. Let the strudel cool on the baking sheet on a wire rack for 20 minutes

title: lemon infused fish and vegetables
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425 degrees
2. Tear four lengths of parchment paper or foil , each about 18 inches long
3. Fold each length across in half
4. Unfold
5. Divide lemon slices among parchment pieces , piecing them in a row
6. Top with fish
7. Place vegetables beside the fish
8. Whisk together the olive oil , lemon juice and salt
9. Drizzle over the fish
10. Crimp or fold over the edges to form sealed packets
11. Place packets on two baking sheets
12. Bake until the packets are puffed and fish is cooked through , 12-15 minutes
13. Transfer packets to serving plates
14. Cut the top of the packets open carefully
15. Serve

title: ida s  macaroni salad
steps:
1. Mix mayonnaise , vinegar , sugar , salt and mustard together
2. Add yellow food coloring to make it as yellow as you want
3. Add the macaroni , onion , celery , carrot and boiled eggs
4. Mix well

title: low fat turkey sloppy joes
steps:
1. In large heavy pan , cook turkey 3 to 5 minutes until no longer pink
2. Add onion and saute 3 to 5 minutes longer until softened
3. Add chili , celery , green pepper , corn , tomato sauce , honey and seasoning to turkey
4. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Serves 4

title: official blue thong martini
steps:
1. Rub rim of martini glass with lime and dip rim in sugar to coat
2. Chill glass
3. Fill cocktail shaker with vodka , rum , cointreau , blue curacao , sweet & sour and pineapple together with ice
4. Shake and strain into chilled martini glass
5. Garnish with orange slice
6. Should be sweet to taste with a deep turquoise color

title: panera bread tuna salad sandwich
steps:
1. Mix tuna , mayonnaise , relish and mustard in a bowl
2. Refrigerate for at least 15 minutes
3. Serve on honey wheat bread with leaf lettuce , slice red onion and sliced tomato

title: winter wonderland snowballs with variations
steps:
1. Peppermint snowballs: crush 3 / 4 cup hard peppermint candies in food processor or blender
2. Stir in 1 / 4 cup of the crushed candies with the flour
3. Reserve remaining candy
4. Bake as directed
5. Immediately roll baked cookies in powdered sugar
6. Wait 10 minutes , then roll in reserved crushed candy
7. Reroll if desired
8. Lemon snowballs: substitute lemon extract for vanilla
9. For more lemon zing , add 1 tsp grated lemon peel
10. Crush 1 / 2 cup lemon drop candies in food processor or blender
11. Stir in 1 / 4 cup crushed candies with flour
12. Reserve remaining candy
13. Bake as directed
14. Immediately roll cookies in powdered sugar
15. Wait 10 minutes , then roll in reserved crushed candy
16. Reroll if desired
17. Heat oven at 400 degrees
18. In large mixing bowl , combine butter , 1 / 2 cup powdered sugar , and vanilla
19. Beat at medium speed
20. Add flour and salt
21. Stir in chopped nuts
22. Shape dough into 1 inch balls
23. Put cookies on ungreased cookie sheet about 2 inches apart
24. Bake 8-9 minutes-- until set-- do not brown !
25. Immediately roll cookies in powdered sugar , and cool on wire rack
26. Roll in powdered sugar again after about 10 minutes

title: crock pot chocolate mud cake
steps:
1. Coat the inside of a 2 quart to 5 quart slow cooker or crock pot with cooking spray
2. Whisk together the flour and baking powder in a medium bowl and set aside
3. In a large bowl , melt the butter and chocolate in the microwave or over a pan of simmering water and mix well
4. Whisk in the 2 / 3 cup of sugar , 3 tablespoons of cocoa , vanilla , salt , milk , and egg yolk
5. Add the flour mixture and stir until thoroughly mixed
6. Pour the batter into the slow cooker and spread it evenly
7. In a medium bowl , whisk together the remaining sugar , cocoa and hot water until the sugar is dissolved
8. Pour the mixture over the batter in the slow cooker
9. Cover and cook on high for 1 to 2 hours , depending on size of the crock pot
10. Even when done , the cake will be very moist and floating on a layer of molten chocolate , but you will know it is ready when nearly all of the cake is set and the edges begin to pull away from the sides of the pot
11. When it is done , turn off the power and remove the lid
12. Let it cool for 25 minutes , then serve it in bowls topped with whipped cream or ice cream

title: tacheen  from the book rosewater and soda bread by marsha mehran
steps:
1. Bring water to boil in a large pot
2. Add rice and cover
3. Lower heat and simmer for 15 minutes , or until rice is tender
4. Drain any remaining water and set aside
5. Heat olive oil in a large frying pan
6. Add chicken , onions , and half the saffron water
7. Saute for 15 minutes on medium heat , stirring occasionally
8. Add turmeric and spinach and saute for 5 minutes
9. Set aside
10. In a non-metallic bowl , whisk eggs and remaining saffron water
11. Add yogurt , salt , and pepper
12. Add chicken and spinach mixture
13. Mix well
14. Preheat oven to 350f grease a 9x13 inch casserole
15. Spoon in 1 / 3 of the rice , patting it down evenly
16. Add half the chicken / spinach mixture
17. Layer again with 1 / 3 of the rice
18. Add remaining chicken
19. Add remaining rice
20. Mix almonds and honey
21. Layer over top of rice
22. Cover with aluminum foil
23. Bake for 1 1 / 2 hours
24. Remove from oven
25. Let cool for 15 minutes
26. Remove foil and cover with a large plate or platter
27. Carefully but quickly , turn the casserole upside down
28. Tacheen !

title: lemon filled dreams  cookies
steps:
1. In bowl , cream butter and powdered sugar
2. Then add vanilla
3. Mix well
4. Gradually add flour , mix well to combine --
5. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes --
6. Roll into 1" balls
7. Place 2" apart on ungreased cookie sheet
8. Using the end of a wooden spoon handle
9. Make an indentation in center of each cookie --
10. Bake at 350 for 12-14 minutes or lightly browned --
11. Remove to rack to cool completely
12. To prepare filling:
13. Combine sugar , cornstarch , lemon zest and salt in saucepan --
14. Stir in beaten egg , lemon juice and butter till smooth
15. Cook over medium heat till thickened
16. Reduce heat , cook and stir 2 minutes
17. Cool
18. Spoon 1 / 2 tsp of filling into each cookie
19. Dust with powdered sugar

title: perfect marinade
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients
2. If you marinate chicken , this recipe is plenty for 1-1
3. 5 lb
4. Of meat
5. Marinate 2-3 hours
6. Same for seafood
7. Enjoy ! :)

title: egg foo yung  fried rice with eggs and bean sprouts
steps:
1. Season the eggs and beat in the five-spice powder , if using
2. In a wok or large frying pan , heat one tablespoon of the oil and when quite hot , pour in the egg
3. Cook the egg , lifting the mixture away from the sides and allowing the liquid to slip underneath , until the omelette is firm
4. Then
5. Heat the remaining oil and stir-fry the onion , garlic , pepper and bean sprouts for about 2 minutes , stirring and tossing continuously
6. Mix in the cooked rice and heat throughly , stirring well
7. Add the soy sauce and sesame oil and adjust the seasoning if necessary
8. Add the omelette strips and mix in well
9. Serve hot

title: sin on a cracker
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Using a rolling pin , crush the crackers in a large sealed self-closing plastic bag
3. Mix all other ingredients in a large bowl
4. Spread mixture into greased bottom of a glass or ceramic 9x11" pan
5. Cover mixture with crushed crackers
6. Place pan in oven for 20 minutes or until mixture is bubbling
7. Serve warm with assorted crackers

title: almond baked halibut
steps:
1. Heat oven to 500 degrees f
2. Arrange fish in a shallow baking pan
3. Season with salt and pepper
4. Blend together lime juice , garlic and oil and brush over fish
5. Bake for 10 minutes
6. Turn over , baste with juice
7. Lower oven temperature to 425 degrees f and bake 15 minutes longer or until fish flakes easily with a fork
8. Baste several times during cooking
9. Saute almonds in butter until golden brown
10. Serve fish with almonds sprinkled on top and garnished with lime wedges

title: spectacular french onion soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan over low heat , melt butter with olive oil
2. Cook onions in mixture , stirring occasionally , for 30 minutes , until very soft , translucent and brown on the edges
3. Sprinkle the flour over the onions and stir to combine
4. Pour in beef broth , wine and water with bay leaves
5. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat and simmer , uncovered , 20 to 30 minutes
6. Preheat oven broiler
7. Toast the bread slices
8. Ladle the soup into 6 ovenproof bowls and place the bowls on a baking sheet
9. Place a toasted slice of bread over each bowl and top with swiss cheese
10. Place bowls under broiler until cheese is melted

title: sweetcorn pudding
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Melt butter in a pot and stir in flour and sugar
3. Gradually add milk and stir til sugar is dissolved
4. Remove from heat and add eggs and baking powder mixing well
5. Fold in sweetcorn
6. Turn into a flat greased dish and bake for 40 min

title: tripe di calabria
steps:
1. Clean all fat off of tripe under running water
2. Cut tripe into pot holder size pieces
3. Use large 16 quart pot and cover tripe with water
4. Boil tripe for 1 and a half hours
5. While tripe is cooking , chop your garlic , onions and celery
6. Once your tripe is cooked , reserve 2 quarts of tripe stock and set aside
7. Let the tripe cool by running under cold water
8. Using sharp food scissors , and cut your tripe into half inch strips and then half inch cubes
9. Once the tripe is completely cut , set it aside
10. Take your 16 quart pot and pour in your 1 / 2 cup of olive oil and chopped garlic
11. Over medium fire lightly brown the garlic
12. Add your chopped onions and chopped celery , then add your sweet basil , oregano , seasoning salt and crushed red pepper
13. Sweat this all together for 5 minutes
14. Now add your tripe and mix well and stir for 10 minutes
15. Next add your 2 quarts of reserved tripe stock , your 2 cans of crushed tomatoes and your 2 tbsp of sugar
16. Stir until all ingredients are well mixed
17. Cook on medium to low heat for 2 more hours , stirring occasionally
18. Serve with fresh italian bread
19. Buon appetite !
20. Freeze remaining dinners in medium zip-lock plastic bags and just microwave for 3 minutes or until hot

title: spicy chicken rice soup
steps:
1. In a large pot , combine first 9 ingredients
2. Bring to boil
3. Reduce heat
4. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until heated through
5. Garnish with toppings

title: sassy   spicy three bean dip
steps:
1. Place all ingredients except jalapenos into food processor and blend until smooth
2. Fold in diced jalapenos
3. Taste and adjust hot sauces to pleasant temperature
4. Garnish with cheese and cilantro leaves
5. Serve with chips or put inside a burrito or taco or on a tostada

title: gran s mushrooms in sour cream
steps:
1. Saute onion in butter until transparent , add mushrooms , cook until lightly brown
2. Add sour cream and seasonings
3. Cover and cook over low heat until heated through

title: very easy cheesy scalloped potatoes
steps:
1. Pre heat oven to 375 degrees
2. Boil potatoes and onions in saucepot until tender
3. In separate saucepot , melt butter
4. Add flour , salt , black pepper and cayenne pepper
5. Mix well
6. Cook on medium heat one minute while stirring
7. Gradually add milk , stirring until well blended
8. Add cheese
9. Cook until chesse is melted , stirring constantly
10. Lay potatoes and onions in 9 x 13 inch baking dish
11. Cover with cheese sauce
12. Cover with foil
13. Bake for 45 - 50 minutes , removing foil after 25-35 minutes

title: turkey hash or turkey shepherd s pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Heat a large skillet over medium heat , and melt 1 tablespoon of the butter
3. Add the onions , carrots and celery
4. Saute until the onions are translucent , 5 to 7 minutes
5. Add half the parsley and the salt and pepper , and cook another minute
6. Add the turkey and stir
7. Stir in the gravy , then 1 / 4 cup of the broth
8. Bring to a boil
9. Reduce heat
10. Simmer until thickened a bit , about five minutes
11. Add broth as needed to achieve a thin , stewy sauce
12. Melt the remaining butter in a saucepan and stir in mashed potatoes , stirring until warm
13. Scoop turkey mixture into individual tins or an 8x10 pan
14. Spread the mashed potatoes over the top
15. Bake 20 minutes or until golden

title: striped bass with browned hazelnut butter  lemon  and parsley
steps:
1. Sprinkle fillets with salt and ground peppercorns
2. Melt 1 tablespoon butter in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
3. Add fillets , flesh side down
4. Cook until browned , 2 to 3 minutes
5. Turn fillets over
6. Cook until opaque in center , 2 to 3 minutes
7. Transfer to plates
8. Cover to keep warm
9. Add hazelnuts to same skillet over medium heat
10. Toast until golden , 1 to 2 minutes
11. Add 3 tablespoons butter and cook until golden , 2 to 3 minutes
12. Season with salt and pepper
13. Divide sauce among fillets
14. Sprinkle with parsley and grated lemon peel
15. Serve with lemon wedges

title: versatile berry syrup
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , combine brown sugar and cornstarch
2. Gradually whisk in orange juice until smooth
3. Stir in berries and bring to a boil over medium heat , stirring constantly
4. Cook and stir 1-2 minutes longer or until thickened
5. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla

title: chicken and cashew nut curry
steps:
1. Heat oil in a wide saucepan and fry the onions gently , sprinkled with a little salt to stop them burning , until softened and then add the ginger , garlic , chillies , turmeric , cumin , and coriander and cook , stirring , for another minute or so
2. Stir the coconut milk and prepared chicken stock into the onion spice paste and when everything is incorporated add the cardamon and chicken pieces
3. Bring the curry back to the boil and then turn down the heat and simmer gently for about 10 minutes or until the chicken is just about cooked through
4. Check the seasoning and add the beans , cooking for another 5 minutes or so
5. While you're waiting for them to cook , toast the cashew nuts in a dry frying pan until colored a little , then
6. Ladle into bowls , sprinkling with more of the cilantro as you go

title: mother s pea salad
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Chill for several hours or overnight

title: garlic sun dried tomato pasta
steps:
1. In small frying pan , saute all ingredients except pasta
2. Do not let the garlic brown
3. If it does , remove from heat immediately and let sit off of burner
4. The longer it sits , the stronger the flavour in the oil
5. Boil the pasta according to directions
6. For a variation , you can add frozen peas to pasta water , or you can add broccoli flowerets to the last couple of minutes of boiling
7. Strain pasta and toss with oil mixture
8. Top with parmasan cheese and enjoy !

title: my mom s custard pie
steps:
1. Line unpricked pastry shell with a double thickness of foil
2. Bake shell at 450f for 8 minutes
3. Then remove the foil
4. Bake for 5 minutes more
5. Remove from the oven and set shell to the side
6. Separate one egg
7. Set the white aside
8. In a mixing bowl , beat the yolk and remaining eggs until combined
9. Then blend in sugar , salt and vanilla extract
10. Stir in the milk
11. Take remaining egg white and beat until stiff peaks form
12. Then carefully fold into egg mixture
13. Slowly and carefully pour into crust
14. Cover the edges of the pie with foil
15. Then bake at 350f for 25 minutes
16. Remove foil from edges and bake 15-20 minutes more or until you can insert knife in the middle and it comes out clean
17. Cool pie
18. Sprinkle on nutmeg and store in the refrigerator

title: wyoming coleslaw
steps:
1. In a deep bowl , alternate layers of cabbage and onion
2. Pour 7 / 8 cup sugar over the top
3. Let stand 2-3 hours covered or not , doesn't matter
4. Combine the rest of the dressing ingredients and bring to a rolling boil
5. Pour over cabbage and stir
6. Cover and refrigerate overnight , stirring once or twice
7. Serve with a slotted spoon
8. Cooking time is refrigeration time

title: chocolate chip cookie turtle
steps:
1. Set peanuts aside in bowl
2. Melt caramel down
3. Melt chocolate
4. Assembly-----------
5. Take cookie
6. Dip really good into semi cooled down caramel , so you'll get more caramel on cookie and peanuts will stick better
7. Dip directly into peanuts
8. Cool cookies until caramel and peanuts are set
9. Dip cookies in that tasty melted hersheys chocolate
10. Also: if you are going to melt the caramel and or chocolate in microwave you must make sure to not burn both of them

title: old fashioned gingerbread with molasses whipped cream
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Butter and flour 11 x7 metal baking pan
3. Using electric mixer , beat 1 cup butter in large bowl , until blended
4. Beat in 3 / 4 cup molasses -- then eggs , one at a time , sift in flour , baking soda , cinnamon , ginger and salt
5. Beat until blended
6. Beat in 1 / 4 cup cream , then 3 / 4 cup boiling water
7. Transfer to prepared pan
8. Bake cake until tester inserted near the center comes out clean
9. About 45 minutes
10. Cool cake in pan on rack
11. Till completely cooled
12. Beat 1 1 / 4 cups cream and 1 tbls sugar until peaks form
13. Fold in 2tbls molasses until streaks appear
14. Do not overmix
15. Cut cake into slices
16. Transfer to plates
17. Serve with molasses whipped cream'

title: apple pastries
steps:
1. Mix the flour and salt together
2. Add the margarine and rub in until resembles coarse breadcrumbs
3. Add vinegar
4. Add water slowly , mixing until it forms a soft dough
5. If it's not becoming a dough , be patient
6. If it still isn't , add a little more water but not too much or the pastry will become tough
7. Cover in cling wrap and refrigerate for at least two hours
8. Meanwhile , chop the apples up
9. It helps to chop them up finely or to throw them in a food processor
10. Place them in a large sauce pan with the water and lemon juice and cinnamon and sugar
11. Bring to the boil
12. Simmer on high heat for about 10 minutes , or until soft
13. When soft , sift in cornflour
14. If you like it thicker , add more cornflour
15. Stir in quickly , turn off heat and allow to thicken , still stirring
16. If using caramel , stir in now
17. Set topping aside to cool
18. Preheat the oven to 200c
19. Lightly spray 3 baking trays with vegetable oil spray
20. Take out the pastry
21. Break off a piece with your hand a bit larger than the size of a golf ball
22. Roll it with your hands gently so that it becomes soft
23. Flatten it into a small disc
24. Using a medium sized plate , place the dough disc onto it and gently stretch and push the dough in to make it become flatter , until it's about 1 / 4 inch thick
25. Remember it's supposed to be a circle
26. You don't really need to use the plate , i just find it helps a lot
27. Place about 1-2 heaped tablespoons of filling on one side of the disc
28. Brush the edges with egg , and fold over one side to create a semi-circle
29. Pinch shut gently , and press a fork into the edges for presentation
30. Repeat with the rest of the dough
31. Place evenly on the trays
32. I fit about four per tray , but yours might be different
33. Brush one side with remaining egg , and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar if so desired
34. Bake for about 15-20 minutes or until lightly golden

title: choco peanut butter cups
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease 24 muffin cups with cooking spray or butter
3. Cut cookie dough into 24 slices
4. Press 1 slice in bottom and up sides of each mini muffin cup , forming 1 / 4" rim above top of cup
5. Bake 10-15 mins or until edges are deep golden brown
6. Cool in pans on wire racks 5 minutes
7. With
8. Meanwhile , in 2qt saucepan , melt white chips and 3 / 4 cup of peanut butter over low heat , stirring constantly
9. Divide mixture evenly into cookie cups
10. Refrigerate 10 minutes
11. In same 2qt saucepan , melt semi-sweet chocolate chips and remaining 3 / 4 peanut butter over low heat , stirring constantly
12. Divide chocolate evenly on top of peanut butter mixture in each cup
13. Sprinkle granola(which you have crushed , while still in bags , with a rolling pin , on top of each cup
14. Refrigerate until set , about 1 hour
15. Remove from muffin cups before serving

title: mic s wonderful hot wings
steps:
1. Combine all dry ingredients and mix thourghly
2. Add vinegar and orange juice
3. Mix well
4. Wash and remove skin , fold wings
5. Place in a deep baking dish and cover with sauce
6. Refidgerate for 6-12 hrs
7. Remove wings from sauce and place on broiling pan , return sauce to a sauce pan
8. Place wings under broiler about 6 inc
9. Broil for 20-25 min , turning to stop burning
10. Bring sauce to a boil and cook till thinkened
11. Using a spoon , spoon thickened sauce over wings many times while broiling 10-12 more minutes
12. Remaining sauce can be used for dipping
13. Break out the napkins and finger bowls , enjoy

title: apple sweet potato bake
steps:
1. In a greased 1 1 / 2 quart baking dish , layer half of the sweet potatoes and apples
2. Combine brown sugar , nutmeg , allspice , salt , pepper , and walnuts
3. Sprinkle half over apples
4. Dot with half the butter
5. Repeat layers
6. Cover and bake at 350 for 15 minutes
7. Baste with pan juice
8. Bake , uncovered , 15 minutes longer or until apples are tender

title: easy baked ham n  egg casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a 9" x 13" baking pan or dish
3. Mix ingredients well
4. Pour into greased baking pan or dish
5. Bake for 45 minute

title: chicken corn chowder with bacon crumbles
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a large pot
2. Season the chicken tenders with salt , pepper , and poultry seasoning
3. Add chicken to pot and cook until chicken is no longer pink on the outside
4. While chicken cooks , put half of the frozen corn in a blender and add enough chicken stock to fill blender 3 / 4 full
5. Blend until mostly smooth
6. Set aside
7. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened
8. Melt the butter in the chicken and onions , sprinkle the flour over and stir 1-2 minutes to cook the flour
9. Add potatoes and non-blended corn to chicken and onion mixture
10. Pour the blended corn and the remaining stock into the pot
11. Heat over medium-high heat and bring to a boil
12. Reduce heat and simmer about 30 minutes , or until potatoes are tender
13. Stir in heavy cream and simmer about 5 minutes more
14. Season to taste with salt and pepper
15. Sprinkle bacon over individual servings

title: amazing chocolate cheesecake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit
2. Spray a 9 inch springform pan with cooking spray
3. In food processor , place cottage cheese , egg substitute , sugar , cream cheese , cocoa and vanilla
4. Process until smooth
5. Pour into prepared pan
6. Bake 35-40 minutes or until edges are set and center is not jiggly
7. Cool completely
8. Cover , refrigerate until chilled
9. Remove side of pan and serve

title: bisquick potato pancakes
steps:
1. Melt shortening in large skillet
2. Beat eggs with rotary beater , until fluffy
3. Stir in remaining ingredients
4. Drop mixture by tablespoonfuls into hot shortening
5. Cook about 3 minutes on each side or until golden brown
6. About 18 pancakes
7. Betty crockers bisquick cookbook

title: simple potato curry
steps:
1. Saute onions , ginger and garlic in melted butter til soft
2. Add potatoes
3. Sprinkle over curry powder , toss well
4. Stir in stock , bring to boil
5. Reduce heat , cover and simmer for 15 minutes
6. Add peas , cook 5 minutes
7. Add coriander , wine vinegar and lemon juice
8. Season to taste with salt and pepper
9. Heat through
10. I serve this with basmati rice , sliced banaas tossed in plain yogurt and chutney

title: thai chicken balls
steps:
1. Combine all the ingredients in a bowl and mix well
2. Roll into balls
3. Bake in the oven for 10-15 minutes- basically until they are cooked though and look cooked !
4. I line the tray with baking paper
5. Serve with extra sweet chilli sauce for dipping
6. I often add more breadcrumbs / coriander and chilli sauce-- just judge how wet / dry the mixture is

title: quick comfort pudding
steps:
1. Grease a 2 pint pudding basin , and spoon the syrup or honey into the base
2. Beat all the ingredients together and spoon into the basin
3. Microwave for 5-6 minutes until well-risen
4. Don't worry if the top looks a bit sticky
5. Leave to stand for 3 minutes before turning out

title: delicious golden mustard pickles
steps:
1. Trim the core off of cauliflower
2. Cut into bite-size florets to make 8 cups
3. Place in a large stockpot , along with cucumbers , onions , red and green peppers
4. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 cup pickling salt
5. Cover with cold water
6. Set aside in cool spot for 12 hours
7. Return the pot to element
8. Bring veggie mixture just to a boil , over med-high heat
9. Drain in large colander , discarding brine
10. Set the veggies aside
11. Rinse the pot
12. Add 4 cups of vinegar

title: split pea and barley soup
steps:
1. Place broth , split peas , onion , carrot , celery and garlic into a 3-quart pot

1. Combine balsamic vinegar , olive oil , rosemary , and garlic in dish , and stir to combine

steps:

2. Add all the sipping sauce ingredients to a pot on a low temperature

11. Bake bread until browned , about 50-55 minutes

steps:
1. Heat 10-12" saucepan over medium-high heat

6. Mix together the dried garlic and black pepper , sprinkle over the patties and cook an additional 2 to 4 minutes longer or until golden brown
7. Serve the patties on a bed of lettuce leaves topped with warm sauce and sliced red onion slices

title: halloween   candy bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Coat a 13x9-inch baking pan with a non-stick cooking spray
3. In a small bowl , combine the flour , baking soda and salt
4. Set aside
5. In a large bowl , beat the butter , granulated sugar , brown sugar , and vanilla until creamy
6. Beat in the eggs , then gradually blend in the flour mixture
7. Stir in 1-1 / 4 cups of chopped candy
8. Spread the batter into the baking pan , and sprinkle with the remaining 1 / 2 cup chopped candy
9. Bake for 25-30 minutes
10. I baked mine for exactly 25 minutes

title: cauliflower with mushroom cheese sauce
steps:
1. Rinse and remove leaves from cauliflower
2. Place whole head in a small amount of boiling salted water
3. Cover and cook for 20 minutes or until just tender
4. Drain thoroughly
5. Keep warm
6. Meanwhile , cook fresh mushrooms in butter until tender
7. Blend in flower , salt and pepper
8. Add evaporated milk all at once
9. Cook , stirring constantly until thickened and bubble
10. Stir in cheese and mustard
11. Heat until cheese melts
12. Place warm cauliflower on platter
13. Spoon some of sauce over it
14. Sprinkle with parsley
15. Pass remaining sauce

title: grilled tricolor bell peppers
steps:
1. Coat grill with cooking spray and heat on high
2. Toss bell peppers , onion , oil , salt and pepper in a bowl
3. Grill , turning occasionally , until vegetables soften , about 15 minutes
4. Serve immediately

title: moroccan orange blossom scented carrot salad
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of generously salted water to a boil over high heat
2. While you're waiting for your water to boil , stir together 1 tsp of the orange blossom water and all other ingredients except for the carrots and parsley in a medium mixing bowl
3. Set dressing mixture aside
4. Once your water is at a full rolling boil , add the carrots and cook until tender but still a bit crisp
5. When the carrots are done to your liking , drain them and add them to the dressing bowl , tossing to coat thoroughly
6. At this point , if you can fit the mixing bowl in your freezer , do so
7. If , like me , you can't even fit a cereal bowl in your freezer , dump the dressed carrots into a large freezer bag and seal tightly , and place in the freezer
8. Allow the mixture to chill for about 15 to 20 minutes , tossing once or twice
9. Remove from the freezer and pour into a serving bowl if using a freezer bag
10. Toss mixture once more with the remaining orange blossom water
11. Salt to taste , if desired
12. Serve either slightly chilled or at room temp , sprinkled with the parsley

title: moist pumpkin cranberry cornbread
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Lightly grease a 8" x 8" baking pan , or a 9-inch pie pan
3. In a bowl , toss together flour , cornmeal , sugar , baking powder , salt , nutmeg and mace
4. In another mixing bowl , mix with a wooden spoon , the pumpkin puree , sour cream or buttermilk , butter , eggs and honey , until well combined
5. Add the pumpkin mixture to the flour mixture just until combined
6. Mix in the cranberries
7. Transfer to a prepared baking dish
8. Bake for about 40 minutes , or until edges just begin to colour
9. Cool to room temperature

title: ww slow cooker bbq beef sandwiches
steps:
1. Place beef in slow cooker
2. Combine remaining ingredients
3. Except rolls
4. Pour mixture over beef
5. Cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours
6. Remove beef from slow cooker and place on cutting board
7. Gently pull beef apart using two forks
8. It should shred easily
9. Add beef back to slow cooker and toss to coated
10. Serve on buns using a slotted spoon

title: braised beef in red wine sauce
steps:
1. Season beef
2. Heat oil in large dutch oven over high heat
3. Add beef and brown on all sides , about 15 minutes
4. Transfer beef to platter
5. Reduce heat to medium
6. Add onion and bacon to pot
7. Saut until onion is golden , about 8 minutes
8. Mix in tomato paste , bay leaves , cloves and rosemary
9. Add wine
10. Return meat and any juices
11. Cover and simmer 30 minutes , turning meat once
12. M ix stock and tomatoes into sauce
13. Cover and simmer gently until meat is tender , turning occasionally , about 2 hours and 45 minutes
14. Transfer beef to platter
15. Cover with foil to keep warm
16. Strain sauce through fine sieve , pressing on solids
17. Degrease sauce
18. Return sauce to pot
19. Boil until reduced to 2 cups , about 1 hour
20. Add any beef juices from platter
21. Cut beef across grain into 1 / 3 inch slices
22. Arrange meat slices on a platter lined with pan-fried polenta and spoon sauce over
23. Serve sauted spinach alongside

title: butter barbecue sauce
steps:
1. Melt butter in a pan
2. Add onion and cook until tender
3. Stir in remaining ingredients
4. Simmer about 5 minutes

title: frangipani pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180 degrees c
2. Pineapple layer: pour the crushed pineapple into saucepan , add cornflour and bring to boil stirring constantly
3. Cook for 1 min then remove from heat
4. Quickly stir in egg yolks and put mix aside to cool
5. Coconut cream layer: heat the milk and sugar in a saucepan over gentle heat until sugar is dissolved
6. Add the cornflour / water mix , stirring constantly until mixture thickens and boils
7. Remove from the heat , then add the shredded coconut , butter / marg
8. And vanilla
9. Set aside to cool
10. Meringue: whip the egg whites until light and fluffy
11. Gradually add the sugar , beating well with each addition until the sugar is dissolved
12. Assembly: spoon half the coconut cream mix into the pie shell
13. Add the pineapple mixture , then the remaining coconut cream
14. Top with the meringue mix
15. Bake for 15 minutes or until the meringue is golden and cooked

title: oreo squares
steps:
1. In a separete bowl beat eggs lightly
2. Melt butter over med high heat
3. Add brown sugar and heat until just boiling
4. Remove brown sugar mixture from heat and stir gradually into egg mixture
5. Add vanilla , crumbs and pecans
6. Mix and put into 9x9 pan
7. Chill
8. Frost with your favorite vanilla frosting or cream cheese frosting
9. Enjoy !

title: fast start soup
steps:
1. Fry up ground turkey and set aside
2. Combine all other ingredients in 2 large pots
3. You can substitute other vegetables of your choice other than corn , dry beans or peas
4. Be careful not to overcook the garlic as it will turn bitter
5. Bring to boil
6. Reduce heat to med-low
7. Cover and simmer for 25 minutes , until potatoes are tender
8. Add turkey to soup mixture
9. Remove bay leaf before serving
10. Da-licious !

title: four cheese macaroni supreme bake
steps:
1. Cook the macaroni to only firm-tender
2. Drain
3. Grease a 2-1 / 2-quart casserole dish , or any size dish to hold the mixture
4. In a heavy-bottomed saucepan , melt butter over medium heat
5. Stir in flour and whisk for 1 minute
6. Add / whisk in half and half cream
7. Cook and stir / whisk constantly over medium heat until the sauce thickens
8. Add in salt , sugar and grated cheddar , cubed velveeta cheese
9. Mix to combine until cheese has melted
10. Remove from heat
11. Add / stir in the sour cream and cottage cheese into sauce
12. Mix well to combine
13. Pour over cooked macaroni and mix well
14. Transfer the mixture to a prepared casserole dish
15. Mix the bread crumbs with melted butter and parmesan cheese
16. Sprinkle evenly on top of the macaroni
17. Bake for 45-50 minutes , or until hot and bubbly
18. Delicious !

title: mexican chicken skillet dinner
steps:
1. Combine flour and seasoned salt in ziploc bag
2. Add chicken
3. Seal and shake to coat chicken
4. Brown chicken in large skillet in oil over medium high heat
5. Add remaining ingredients , except cheese , and bring to a boil
6. Cover , reduce heat and simmer 25 minutes until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed
7. Serve with sprinkled cheddar cheese

title: johnny jalapeno s sweet heat appetizers  or wraps
steps:
1. To tortillas , spread cream cheese all the way around to edges
2. Sprinkle with cranberries , and chopped jalapenos
3. Lay ham slices to cover top
4. Roll up tightly , wrap in plastic and refrigerate at least one hour
5. This is important so they hold together when cut
6. Appetizers: trim off the very ends of each log , then slice each log into 8 slices and lay flat
7. Place a half cherry onto the center of each pinwheel
8. Arrange decoratively onto a serving platter
9. As wraps: you can also serve as wraps as they make a great on-the-go lunch

title: beef   shrimp kabobs
steps:
1. Cut steak into 1" pieces
2. Place steak and shrimp in baggie
3. Combine remaining ingredients and marinate in refrigerator for at least 1 hour
4. Place on skewers and grill
5. Enjoy !

title: herb roasted pork tenderloin
steps:
1. Stir together first 11 ingredients in a shallow dish or heavy-duty zip-top plastic bag
2. Prick pork with a fork , and place in marinade , turning to coat
3. Cover dish , or seal bag
4. Chill 2 hours
5. Remove from marinade , discarding marinade
6. Place pork on a rack in a roasting pan
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes or until a meat thermometer inserted into thickest portion of pork registers 160 degrees

title: creamy spaghetti with veggies
steps:
1. In lg skillet , saute broccoli , zucchini , mushrooms , and carrots in oil until crisp-tender
2. Set aside
3. Cook spaghetti according to pkg directions
4. In another saucepan , saute onion and garlic in butter for 30 seconds
5. Stir in flour , boullion and thyme
6. Slowly add milk , bring to a boil
7. Cook and stir for 2 minutes
8. Reduce heat to low
9. Stir in cheeses
10. Add vegetables
11. Heat through
12. Drain spaghetti
13. Toss with vegetable mixture

title: cranberry raspberry salad
steps:
1. Dissolve jello in 2 cups boiling water
2. Add 1 can cranberry sauce
3. Stir until well blended
4. Add remaining ingredients in order given
5. Raspberries will thaw as they are stirred in hot jello

title: stick to your bones lamb stew in crock pot
steps:
1. Soak dried beans on boiling water for 1 hour
2. Wash barley in cold water
3. In a large hot fry pan , heat oil
4. Add 1 / 2 of onion , ginger and 2 cloves garlic
5. Fry untill starting to brown
6. Add cubed lamb , sprinkle salt and pepper on lamb
7. Cook until slightly browned
8. Turn on crock pot to high
9. Add meat to crock pot
10. Heat some more oil in fry pan , add chilli and remainder of garlic
11. Fry until garlic is well browned
12. Add to crock pot
13. Add all remaining ingredients to the crock pot except frozen peas
14. Add boiling water so that water covers everything
15. Put the lid on and find something else to do for 3
16. 5 hours don't open the lid to check it , just set it and forget it
17. After 3
18. 5 hours stir in frozen peas and let simmer for a few minutes
19. Taste and adjust seasoning if desired
20. The meat should be falling off the bones and potatoes soft , beans soft , barley plump surrounded by a thick savory gravy
21. Serve with garlic bread

title: easy cool cucumber salad
steps:
1. Peel the cucumber and slice very thin
2. Put in a bowl and toss with the salt
3. Chill one hour
4. Drain , then pat dry
5. Return to bowl and stir in the crema and onion , season with fresh ground pepper
6. Chill and serve
7. The original recipe called for re-constituted dried onion flakes and pickled cherry peppers , which i didn't have
8. It also called for some sugar , but the mexican crema was perfectly sweet enough for me
9. Should i ever find the pickled peppers , though , i'd like to try adding them

title: favourite red cabbage
steps:
1. Shred the cabbage and mix it with the apples , salt and pepper in a pan
2. Add a little bit of water to the cabbage mixture and heat till boiling
3. Reduce heat and let simmer
4. When it's pretty much cooked add the rest of the ingredients and heat through
5. Serve

title: sweet cheese ball
steps:
1. In a small mixing bowl , beat cream cheese and confectioners' sugar until smooth
2. Beat in the coconut and cherries
3. Shape into a ball
4. Roll in pecans
5. Cover and refrigerate until serving
6. Serve with fruit

title: sinfully simple truffles
steps:
1. Mix prepared frosting and powdered sugar in mixing bowl
2. Fold in 1 / 2 cup of nuts
3. Shape mixture into walnut size balls and place on wax paper lined cookie sheet
4. Place in refridgerator to chill
5. Melt semi-sweet chocolate chips in microwave on low in 30 second intervals , stir often
6. Stir 1-2 tablespoons of shortning into melted chocolate to give chocolate a dipping consistancy
7. Remove chocolate balls from fridge and dip into melted chocolate
8. Place dipped'truffles' on a wax paper lined cookie sheet until set
9. Arrange your fancy'truffles' on a serving platter and wow your friends !

title: sardines melt
steps:
1. Toast the bread lightly
2. Place a slice of cheese on each piece of toast
3. Put two sardines on each with tomato sauce
4. Put under the grill until cheese bubbles

title: ricotta baked with pesto
steps:
1. Make the pesto by blending the herbs with the nuts , lemon zest and a little olive oil , and season to taste
2. Combine the ricotta and eggs in a food processor until smooth , and fold in the pesto
3. Place the mix into a greased oven-proof dish or greased muffin tin , and bake in a moderate oven for approximately 15 minutes , or until ricotta mixture is slightly firm to touch
4. Allow to cool slightly before taking out of moulds

title: smash seasoning
steps: 1. Combine ingredients and store in an airtight container in a cool dry place

title: zucchini  courgette  and mushroom casserole
steps:
1. Peel zucchini if very large and slice
2. Dice onion
3. Cook both in salty water till zucchini slices are soft but not mushy
4. Butter bottom and sides of casserole dish
5. Pour in bread crumbs and swirl around till butter is coated
6. Bottom should have a heavier layer on it
7. Drain zucchini and onion thouroughly
8. Place in casserole dish on top of bread crumbs
9. Sprinkle with pepper to taste
10. Cover with mushrooms and pour soup over the dish
11. Sprinkle on grated cheese
12. Cook at 320f degrees till cheese melted

title: easy diabetic chocolate cake
steps:
1. In a bowl sift soy flour , cocoa powder , salt , and baking soda
2. Add egg , splenda , oil , and vanilla
3. Mix until combined
4. Line a small microwave safe bowl with a cup shaped coffee filter
5. Pour batter into bowl and microwave on high for aprox
6. 1 minute or until there are no wet spots
7. Take cake out of coffee filter and set on paper towl to cool
8. Combine frosting ingredients in a small bowl
9. Cut cooled cake across creating two layers
10. Frost bottom layer and replace top layer
11. Frost top of cake and sides and decorate with strawberry slices

title: garlic capsicum peas pulao
steps:
1. Put oil in cooker 1 teaspoonful and put jeera / blackpepper and cashewnuts and fry for minute
2. Put rice after draining water and fry for 2 minutes on heat
3. Put water in cooker and salt as per taste for rice only and close the cooker
4. Meanwhile put frying pan on heat and add oil , and put garlic in it , fry till it turns brown
5. Now put onion into the pan and fry for 6 minutes on high heat and then put peas into the pan
6. Now put some salt for this mixture and keep frying
7. After 5 minutes put capsicum pieces also and fry for 3 minutes
8. If you like green chillies put with capsicum
9. Side by side the rice are ready and mix the same in pan
10. Pulao is ready for serving
11. Serve this pulao with curd and enjoy

title: almond chocolate pudding cake
steps:
1. Position rack in center of oven and preheat to 350 degrees
2. Coat an 8x8 baking pan with cooking spray
3. In a large bowl , combine 2 / 3 cups of the sugar , all the flour , salt , and baking powder
4. Stir well to blend
5. Whisk in the oil , milk , and both extracts
6. Batter will be stiff
7. Scrape batter into oiled pan and smooth on top
8. In a small bowl , stir together the cocoa and remaining 2 / 3 cup sugar
9. Sprinkle this over the batter
10. Pour the boiling water over the batter , do not stir !
11. Bake 25 to 35 minutes , or until top of cake looks crisp and crackled
12. Cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes
13. Serve warm

title: chunky peach spread
steps:
1. Drop peaches in boiling water for 1 minutes or until peel has softened
2. Immediately dip fruit in ice water
3. Peel and chop peaches
4. In a lg saucepan , combine peaches , sugar and lemon juice
5. Bring to a boil
6. Mash peaches
7. Reduce heat
8. Simmer , uncovered for 5 minutes
9. Meanwhile , in a small bowl , sprinkle gelatin over cold water , let stand for 2 minutes
10. Remove peach mixture from heat
11. Stir in gelatin mixture until dissolved
12. Cool for 10 minutes , then pour into jars
13. Refrigerate for up to 3 weeks

title: super nachos delux
steps:
1. Crumble beef and sausage in a frying pan
2. Add onion and cook on high heat , stirring until meats are browned
3. Discard any fat
4. Season with salt and liquid hot pepper seasoning to taste
5. Spread beans in a shallow 10 x 15 dish / pan
6. Top evenly with meat
7. Sprinkle chilies over bean and meat mixture , cover evenly with cheese and drizzle with taco sauce
8. Cover and chill if made ahead
9. Bake , uncovered , in a 400 degree oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until very hot throughout
10. Remove from oven and quickly garnish with some or all of the garnishes
11. Serve with your favorite taco type chips

title: asparagus  chicken  wild rice casserole
steps:
1. Spread rice in a 7" x 11" baking pan
2. Add chicken broth and mushrooms
3. Dot with 2 tablespoons butter
4. Place chicken breast in the center
5. Sprinkle with garlic and onion powders
6. Spoon mushroom soup over all
7. Bake uncovered , at 350 degrees for 1 hour
8. Remove and arrange asparagus around outer edges of baking dish
9. Brush with melted butter and sprinkle with paprika
10. Bake 15-20 minutes more or until asparagus is tender

title: merle s muffins
steps:
1. Combine bran and milk and let stand for 5 minutes
2. Mix the flour , baking powder , sugar , salt and cinnamon
3. Make well in the center
4. Combine egg , oil , apple and raisins , bran and milk
5. Add all at once to dry ingredients
6. Stir quickly just until dry ingredients are moistened
7. Fill greased muffin pans 2 / 3 full
8. Sprinkle sugar and cinnamon on top
9. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes

title: key lime chicken
steps:
1. Marinate chicken in a glass dish with the key lime juice , fresh garlic and ginger-cover and let stand 2 hours turning once
2. Remove chicken and reserve marinade
3. Mix flour , ground ginger , garlic , salt and pepper
4. Heat oil over med-high
5. Dredge chicken in flour mixture and brown in oil
6. Transfer to a 9x13 casserole dish
7. Pour reserved marinade over chicken along with the broth
8. Sprinkle brown sugar on top and bake for 30 minutes in a 375 oven
9. Do not let broth totally evaporate
10. Remove to a serving platter and pour remaining broth over chicken

title: hot spiced wine
steps:
1. Place first 3 ingredients on an 8" square of cheesecloth
2. Tie with string
3. Place spice bag in a dutch oven
4. Add red wine and remaining 5 ingredients
5. Bring to a simmer over low heat
6. Keep at a simmer while serving
7. Ladle into mugs

title: forevermama s mediterranean red potato salad
steps:
1. Wash and boil the unpeeled potatoes until just tender
2. Drain and cool them completely
3. Cut into 1 / 2 inch dice
4. Place in a large serving bowl and set aside
5. In a small bowl , combine the mustards and olive oil
6. Add the red wine vinegar , minced red onion , diced bell peppers , chopped parsley , and salt and pepper to taste
7. Mix to blend
8. Pour the mustard mixture over the sliced potatoes and toss to coat
9. Serve or keep covered in the refrigerator
10. Return to room temperature before serving
11. Add ingredients to the potato salad while potatoes are still slightly hot / warm to help flavors penetrate more deeply

title: iced honey lemon cookies
steps:
1. In a small mixing bowl , cream butter and sugar together
2. Beat in egg
3. In a separate bowl , combine flour , baking powder and salt
4. In another separate bowl , combine honey , yogurt , lemon peel and lemon extract
5. Alternate between adding the dry ingredients and the honey mixture to the creamed mixture
6. Mix until well blended
7. Drop by tablespoonfuls , 2-inches apart onto greased baking sheets
8. Bake at 350 for 10-12 minutes or until a light golden color
9. Remove to wire racks
10. For the icing , in a small bowl combine the confectioners' sugar and lemon juice until smooth
11. Brush over the warm cookies and sprinkle with the grated lemon peel

title: pork teko teko
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. Stick a skewer down center of pork fillets from thick end season with salt and pepper and wrap with strips of bacon
3. Brush with oil and broil about 8 minutes each side
4. To serve , slide from skewer and slice into medallions
5. Serve in sauce garnish with lemon and parsley
6. Mushroom sauce:
7. Melt butter in saucepan over low heat
8. Add onion and cook until tender add mushroom stems and continue to cook
9. Mix in arrowroot and then white wine , hot water , and meat concentrate bring to a boil
10. Add sliced mushrooms , lemon juice , parsley and cayenne pepper at last moment

title: summer blt rotisserie chicken salad
steps:
1. In saucepan , cook bacon over medium heat 5-6 minutes or until browned
2. Using a slotted spoon , transfer bacon to paper towels to drain
3. Save 2 t bacon drippings from saucepan
4. With a wire whisk , add balsamic vinegar , dijon , maple syrup , oil , onions , garlic , salt and pepper to drippings in saucepan and heat to boiling over medium heat
5. Remove from heat
6. Place romaine in large salad bowl
7. Add tomatoes and carrots
8. Pour hot dressing over romaine , tossing lightly until coated
9. Add chicken and toss until well mixed
10. Crumble bacon and sprinkle over salad
11. Sprinkle pecans over salad

title: new mexico trail mix in a jar
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300f
2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or lightly spray with nonstick cooking spray
3. Combine the nuts , seeds , and cheese nips in a large bowl
4. Combine the butter , cumin and garlic powder in a microwaveable cup
5. Microwave on high for 30-45 seconds or until butter is melted
6. Place the chili sauce , chipotle , orange juice concentrate and butter mixture into a blender or food processor
7. Blend until smooth
8. Pour sauce over nut mixture , stirring to coat
9. Spread mixture in a single layer on prepared baking sheet
10. Bake for 1 hour , stirring every 15 minutes
11. Remove from oven and sprinkle with the cayenne pepper if using
12. Let cool before packing into jars or containers

title: inside cheesy hidden burgers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a bowl , combine the first 8 ingredients up to and including salt
3. In a seperate bowl , combine cheese , cayenne pepper , pimentos , and jalapeno peppers
4. Form beef mixture into 4 balls , and press well in center of each
5. Stuff each with equal amounts of cheese mixture , and press meat around filling to seal
6. Place on baking sheet , and press gently into thick patties
7. Bake 20 minutes or until well done
8. Place patties on buns , and add your favorite toppings

title: flourless peanut chocolate cookies  martha stewart
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a small bowl combine sugar , soda and salt
3. In a large bowl , stir together sugar-soda-salt-mix , egg and vanilla until well combined
4. I used a wire whisk for this step
5. Now add in the peanut butter , stir with a spoon til well combined and smooth
6. Fold in chocolate chips and roasted peanut pieces
7. With moistened hands , roll dough , about 1 heaping tablespoon at a time , into balls
8. Place 2 inches apart on two baking sheets
9. Bake for about 12-14 minutes
10. Cookies will still be slightly soft , but firm up while cooling
11. Allow to set on baking sheet for a couple of minutes and then transfer to wire racks to cool completely

title: chocolate almond cake roll
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f spray a 151 / 2 x 101 / 2-inch jelly roll pan with non-stick baking spray
2. Line with parchment paper or waxed paper and spray paper also
3. Beat eggs , preferably with a whisk , with baking powder and salt until thick and light-colored
4. Add the vanilla and mix
5. Stir together sugar , cocoa and flour
6. Gradually add the whisked egg mixture
7. Do not overmix
8. Turn into prepared jelly roll pan and spread evenly
9. Bake 10 minutes
10. Remove from oven
11. Immediately turn from pan onto a towel that has been dusted with confectioners sugar
12. Quickly remove the paper
13. Roll , jelly-roll fashion , , with the towel inside and enwrapping cake
14. Chill
15. Cream the cheese with the almond filling
16. Unroll the cake , spread with almond cheese and re-roll , jelly-roll style
17. Chill until cold

title: basic scrambled tempeh
steps:
1. Preheat a large , heavy-bottomed pan over medium heat
2. Saute the tempeh in 2 tablespoons olive oil for about 7 minutes , stirring often , until lightly browned
3. Add red bell pepper and onion and drizzle in remaining oil
4. Saute for about 5 minutes until veggies are softened but still slightly crunchy
5. Add garlic and thyme and saute for 2 more minutes
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Add greens and saute until just wilted
8. Serve immediately

title: best ever strawberry shake
steps:
1. Put all ingredients in blender
2. Blend until well mixed
3. If you can't wait , drink from blender container
4. Or pour into glass and drink
5. Enjoy !

title: tropical pops antigua and barbuda
steps:
1. Puree pineapple , banana , coconut milk and sweetener 1-2 minutes , until it is nice and smooth
2. Pour into ice pop molds , and freeze at least 4 hours
3. To unmold , run molds under warm water
4. Enjoy !

title: escabeche  pickled vegetables
steps:
1. Heat oil in large pan over medium-high heat until hot but not smoking
2. Add garlic and onions and saute for 3 minutes , stirring constantly
3. Reduce heat to medium and add carrots , peppercorns , thyme , oregano , marjoram and bay leaves
4. Cover and cook for 2 minutes
5. Season to taste with salt
6. Add cauliflower , jalapenos , vinegar and 1 cup water
7. Stir well , cover , and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes
8. Add zucchini and jicama
9. Cover and cook for 5 minutes more
10. Vegetables should remain crunchy
11. Do not overcook
12. Transfer to a bowl and discard bay leaves
13. Cover and refrigerate overnight
14. Serve at room temperature

title: roasted garlic asiago dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Cut the garlic head in half along the"equator"
3. Place the garlic , cut side down on a foil lined baking sheet and roast uncovered 40 to 45 minutes or until tender
4. To remove the garlic , turn heads upside down and gently squeeze the garlic out of the skins
5. Reduce oven temp to 350
