6. With a food processor or electric mixer , blend cream cheese , asiago cheese , heavy cream , sour cream and parsley until well-blended add garlic and blend again
7. Place mixture into a casserole or baking dish and top with shredded mozzarella
8. Bake about 20 minutes until bubbly and golden brown on top
9. Serve with firm crusty bread , crackers or other dippers of your choice
10. I have added artichoke hearts to the dip for a nice change
11. Update: i have been replacing the heavy cream with sour cream and it comes out fine

title: strawberry watermelon slush
steps:
1. Add the first 4 ingredients to the container of an electric blender
2. Blend until smooth
3. Gradually add in the ice cubes and continue to blend
4. Serve immediately in chilled glasses

title: vegetarian syrian pumpkin patties
steps:
1. Soak the bulgur in warm water for 20 minutes
2. Drain
3. Transfer the bulgur to a food processor with the remaining ingredients except the oil and puree
4. If the mixture is too thin , add a little more flour
5. Shape into patties about 2-inches long , 1-inch wide , and 1 / 2-inch thick
6. Heat 1 / 8-inch oil in a large skillet over medium heat
7. Fry the patties , turning once , until golden brown on both sides , about 2 minutes per side
8. Serve warm or at room temperature
9. Hint
10. To cook fresh pumpkin , cut it into eighths , place in a large pot of lightly salted water , cover , and simmer over low heat until tender , about 15 minutes
11. Drain , cut off the peel , and mash
12. Gently press in a strainer to remove the excess liquid
13. Variations: fritadas de calabaza : this batter will be looser than the bulgur version , and is dropped from a spoon
14. Omit the bulgur , 1 / 2 cup water , onion , garlic , coriander , pepper , allspice , cumin , and cayenne
15. Add 3 large eggs and 2 to 8 tablespoons granulated or brown sugar
16. If desired , also add 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon , 1 / 2 teaspoon ground nutmeg , and a pinch of ground ginger
17. Kibbet yatkeen bi seniyeh : spread the pumpkin mixture into an oiled 9-inch-square baking pan
18. Cut into diamonds or 1 1 / 2-inch squares
19. Drizzle with 1 / 4 cup vegetable oil
20. Bake in a 400-degree oven until golden brown

title: hot milk cake with lemon filling and boiled white frosting
steps:
1. For the cake:
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
3. Beat eggs thoroughly with electric mixer
4. Gradually ad sugar
5. Beat until fluffy
6. Sift flour 2 times
7. Add , beating thoroughly
8. Place milk and butter in small saucepan and let come to a boil
9. Add immediately to flour mixture and beat until cool
10. Batter will be quite thin
11. Sift in remaining 1 tablespoon flour , baking powder and salt
12. Add floverings
13. Beat 1 minute more
14. Pour into 3 well-greased and floured 9 inch cake pans
15. Bake approximately 30 minutes or until tester comes out clean
16. I get sneaky here cause i love kittencal's pan release , #78579
17. For the filling:
18. Mix dry ingredients
19. Beat egg yolks with water and juice
20. Add dry ingredients
21. Blend well
22. Cook in double boiler until clear
23. Remove from heat
24. Add rind and butter
25. Spread on layers and stack
26. For frosting:
27. Boil sugar and water until syrup forms thread about 3 inches long when dropped from a spoon , or cook until syrup has reached 238 degrees on candy thermometer
28. Beat egg whites with salt until stiff
29. While very hot , pour syrup in fine stream over egg whites
30. Beat until misture is creamy and reaches spreading consistency
31. Add cream of tarter and vanilla
32. Spread on sides and top of cake

title: hearts of palm guacamole
steps:
1. Place hearts of palm , cilantro , minced garlic , lemon juice and olive oil in a medium bowl
2. Use an immersion blender to puree
3. A food processor or blender could be used also
4. Mash the avocados into the puree mix with the back of a fork
5. Stir in spices
6. Stir in tomato and onion and jalapeno or cayenne if desired
7. Use it just as you would regular guacamole

title: polynesian pineapple turkey and noodles
steps:
1. Dip the turkey cubes in the egg and roll in 1 / 4 cup corn starch until coated
2. Heat the peanut oil in a skillet and brown the turkey cubes in the hot oil
3. Remove the turkey and set aside
4. Add enough water the reserved pineapple juice to make 1 cup
5. Add the juice / water mixture to the hot skillet and heat to boiling , stirring constantly
6. Reduce the heat , cover and simmer 2 minutes
7. Blend the 2 tablespoons of corn starch with the 1 / 4 cup water and then stir the slurry into the hot skillet
8. Heat , stirring constantly , until the mixture thickens and boils
9. Stir in the pineapple chunks , soy sauce , carrots and turkey cubes and heat
10. Serve over the hot egg noodles

title: rendang padang   indonesian beef curry  slow cooker
steps:
1. Put the beef in the slow cooker
2. In a blender or food processor combine the chilis , onion , ginger , garlic , lemongrass , tamarind paste , 1 cup warm water , and the spices
3. Puree until smooth , then pour over the beef
4. Stir in the coconut milk and cook , covered , on the low setting for 5-6 hours
5. The beef will be tender and the sauce will be dark brown
6. Ladle most of the sauce into a small saucepan and cook over medium high heat to reduce until slightly thickened , about 30 minutes
7. Pour the sauce back in the cooker and cook on high for 30 minutes to 1 hour longer
8. Stir in the sugar and season with salt to taste
9. Serve over steamed rice

title: best ever asparagus
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 500 degrees f
2. Wash the asparagus
3. Cut off the woody ends
4. Lay the asparagus out on a cookie sheet
5. Spray with olive oil making sure to coat the spears but not drench
6. Bake for 15 minutes
7. Salt or season as you like
8. My favorite is to use broiled steak season salt

title: coleslaw with apples and feta
steps:
1. Put cabbage , apple , carrot , onion , green peppers , and only 1 / 4 cup of the feta in large bowl
2. Toss to mix
3. Make dressing in a seperate bowl by combining oil , vinegar , mustard , sugar , celery seeds , salt and pepper
4. Whisk to blend well
5. Pour dressing over cabbage mixture and toss together to coat well
6. Cover with plastic wrap and chill for 2 - 3 hours
7. Toss again and sprinkle top with remaining 1 / 4 cup feta cheese

title: mushroom logs
steps:
1. Separate crescent dough into 8 rectangles
2. Press perforations to seal
3. Combine cream cheese , mushrooms , and salt
4. Mix well
5. Spread mixture over dough
6. Starting at long side , roll up jellyroll fashion
7. Pinch seams to seal
8. Slice logs onto 1-inch pieces
9. Place seam side down on ungreased baking sheet
10. Brush each log with beaten egg and sprinkle with poppy seeds
11. Bake at 375 for 10-12 minutes

title: easy  creamy mac and cheese
steps:
1. Prepare pasta according to package directions
2. Meanwhile , melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat
3. Gradually whisk in flour until smooth
4. Cook , whisking constantly , 1 minute
5. Gradually whisk in milk and next 3 ingredients
6. Cook , whisking constantly , 8-10 minutes or until thickened
7. Remove from heat
8. Gradually stir in cheddar cheese , stirring until cheese is melted and sauce is smooth
9. Stir in hot cooked pasta
10. Serve immediately
11. Kitchen express: prepare pasta according to package directions
12. Cook 2 containers refrigerated light alfredo sauce in a large saucepan over medium heat , stirring often , 3-4 minutes or until thoroughly heated
13. Gradually whisk in 10oz block 2% sharp cheddar cheese , shredded , until smooth
14. Stir in hot cooked pasta and 1 / 4 teaspoon ground red pepper
15. Southwest chicken mac and cheese: stir in 2 cups chopped cooked chicken and 10oz can diced tomatoes and green chilies , drained , into cheese sauce with pasta
16. Spinach-bacon mac and cheese: stir in 1 / 2 cup chopped cooked bacon and 6oz package fresh baby spinach into cheese sauce with pasta
17. Broccoli-ham mac and cheese: stir in 2 cups smoked ham and 12oz package frozen steam-in bag broccoli florets , cooked according to package
18. Directions , into cheese sauce with pasta
19. Chicken-asparagus mac and cheese: stir 2 cups chopped cooked chicken and 9oz package frozen asparagus cuts , cooked according to package directions , into cheese sauce with pasta
20. Pea-prosciutto mac and cheese: cook 1 / 2 cup thinly sliced prosciutto , pancetta , or bacon in a lightly greased skillet until crisp
21. Stir in prosciutto and 12oz package frozen sweet peas , cooked according to package directions , into cheese sauce with pasta

title: saucy stir fry
steps:
1. In a preheated skillet , stir-fry meat and ginger in oil , remove
2. Stir fry vegetables , cover , cook 3 minutes adding more oil if necessary
3. Stir in gravy and soy sauce
4. Return meat to skillet , heat through

title: christmas zucchini bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix oil , eggs , zucchini , and vanilla
3. Add sugar , flour , soda and cinnamon , blending well
4. Stir in coconut and pecans
5. Bake in greased loaf pans about an hour or until a toothpick tests "clean"
6. Cool 15 minutes in bread pans
7. Remove from pans-i wrap mine in foil and slice the loaves just before serving

title: st  paul s broiled tomatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Wash and stem tomatoes
3. Halve horizontally and arrange skin-side down in a single layer in a greased baking pan
4. In a food processor or small bowl , mix crumbs , sugar , margarine , parsley , pepper , dill and salt
5. Sprinkle over tomatoes
6. Bake in preheated oven until bubbly , 15 to 20 minutes
7. Then , just before serving , run under broiler for 1 minute
8. Makes 16 servings

title: crispy coconut chicken with a apricot curry dipping sauce
steps:
1. Combine coconut , pepper and garlic in a bowl
2. Dust breasts in flour shake off excess , dip breast into egg and then into coconut press mixture firmly onto breast
3. Place breasts in a lightly oiled oven proof pan , drizzle melted butter over and bake in a preheated oven 180-190c for 25-30 minutes or until chicken breasts are browned and cooked through , turn the pan once during cooking
4. Apricot dipping sauce
5. While the breasts are cooking combine all the sauce ingredients in a pan and heat and stir until well combined
6. You can leave the sauce on a low heat while the breasts finish cooking , just stir occasional
7. This also helps the curry flavour to come through
8. Serve with your favourite vegetables and fries or mash what ever you like

title: pink pillows
steps:
1. This requires strawberry nesquik powder , chocolatte just appeared
2. Pre heat oven to 375 f
3. Combine flour , salt and baking soda in small bowl
4. Beat butter , sugar , nesquik and vanilla extract in large mixer bowl until creamy
5. Add eggs one at a time , beating well after each addition
6. Gradually beat in flour mixture
7. Drop by rounded tablespoon onto ungreased baking sheets
8. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes
9. Cool on baking sheets for 2 minutes
10. Remove to wire racks to cool completely

title: mimi s cornmeal scones
steps:
1. Mix first 5 ingredients in a medium bowl
2. Cut in the butter using pastry blended till it looks like fine crumbs
3. Stir in buttermilk so dough leaves sides of bowl and forms a ball
4. Turn dough onto lightly floured surface and knead lightly about 10 times
5. Pat or roll into a 7-inch circle on ungreased cookie sheet that has been sprinkled with cornmeal
6. Score into 8 wedges , cutting down halfway to the bottom
7. Bake in 400 degree oven for 20-25 minutes or till light brown
8. Immediately remove from sheet and carefully separate wedges
9. Serve warm

title: low fat cheesy veggie bake  crock pot
steps:
1. Spray crockpot with butter-flavored nonstick cooking spray
2. Add thawed vegetables and onion to crockpot , then add mushroom soup and cheese and spices and mix well
3. Cover
4. Cook on low 4-6 hours
5. Mix well before serving
6. Serve over rice
7. Option: make in oven
8. Preheat oven to 350f
9. Combine all in a large baking dish
10. Bake for 30 minutes -- stir
11. Bake for an additional 20 minutes

title: sauted zucchini
steps:
1. Spray frying pan with olive oil spray or lightly coat with olive oil
2. Melt in a couple tablespoons of butter , add a little olive oil if you didnt use it to coat the pan
3. Slice up zucchini into thin slices
4. Add diced onions , about 1 / 2 cup
5. While cooking , add a little bit of chicken broth as needed , to keep food from sticking / burning
6. Sprinkle with garlic powder , pepper and paprika
7. Sautee until done

title: hey hey sauerkraut balls
steps:
1. In a large skillet , cook sausage and onion until sausage is brown , breaking sausage into small pieces
2. Drain fat
3. Drain sauerkrat , pressing out as much liquid as possible
4. In a large mixing bowl , combine sauerkraut , sausage mixture , the 2 tablespoons bread crumbs , cream cheese , parsley , mustard , garlic salt , and pepper
5. Cover and chill several hours or overnight
6. Put flour in a shallow container
7. In another shallow container , beat eggs and water until combined
8. Put bread crumbs in a third container
9. Using about 2 tablespoons for each , shape sauerkraut mixture into balls roll balls in flour , then in egg mixture , then in bread crumbs
10. Fry a few at a time in deep hot fat for about 2 minutes or until brown
11. Remove from fat with a slotted spoon
12. Drain on paper towels
13. Transfer to a baking sheet with sides
14. Keep warm in a 275 degree oven makes 24 to 30 balls

title: sunshine coast homemade granola
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300
2. In a large bowl mix all dry ingredients
3. Warm honey in microwave , mix in oil and vanilla
4. Pour over dry ingredients and stir well
5. Spread evenly on 2 or 3 baking sheets
6. Bake at 300 for 30 minutes , stir every 10 minutes
7. Spread on trays and cool
8. Mix in 1 cup raisins and 1 cup craisins if desired
9. Store in airtight container

title: elise s quesadilla pie
steps:
1. Brush butter on the bottom of the pan to keep the tortillas from sticking , and to the top of the last tortilla for flavor and to help it brown
2. Hint: do not skip the butter
3. Preheat oven to 350f butter the bottoms and sides of a pie dish , approximately the same size as your tortillas
4. Place one tortilla on the bottom of the pie dish
5. Sprinkle some shredded cheese over the tortilla
6. At this point , you will begin to add your chosen filling ingredients , and layering the tortillas
7. Make sure each layer has a generous sprinkling of cheese
8. Cover the dish with aluminum foil
9. Put in oven for 30 minutes on 350f
10. Then remove the foil and increase the heat to 400f
11. Cook for another 15-20 minutes , until the top is lightly browned and cheese is bubbly
12. Remove from oven
13. Let cool for 10 minutes before serving
14. Cut into quarters
15. Serve with chopped avocados , shredded lettuce , cilantro , salsa , and / or sour cream

title: cherry mash bars
steps:
1. Boil sugar , milk , butter and marshmallows for five minutes , stirring constantly
2. Remove from heat
3. Stir in cherry chips , half of peanuts
4. Spread in 9 x 13 pan
5. Allow to cool
6. Melt chocolate chips
7. Add peanut butter and remainder of peanuts
8. Spread on top of cherry layer
9. Chill , then cut into slices
10. Instead of using a 9 x 13 pan , you can also make these in individual minature or regular size cupcake papers
11. Use teaspoon to drop in cherry layer then chocolate layer

title: morisqueta con chorizo
steps:
1. Heat the lard or oil in a large frying pan
2. Crumble chorizo into the hot oil and cook over low heat , stirring occasionally , until it is well heated through and beginning to fry
3. Remove with slotted spoon and set aside
4. Drain all but 3 tablespoons of the oil
5. Add the onion and saut for 1 minute or until transparent but not browned
6. Add the chopped tomatoes and cook , stirring occasionally , over medium high heat until reduced , about 3 minutes
7. Stir in the chorizo and the rice
8. Add salt to taste
9. Continue to cook , turning the rice over carefully , until the rice is well heated through and all of the flavors are combined
10. Serve hot

title: chicken roulade
steps:
1. Place the spinach in a large nonstick skillet with the washing water clinging to the leaves or a tablespoon or two of water if dried
2. Cover and cook for 2 minutes , tossing occasionally , or until wilted
3. Drain and press firmly with the back of a spoon or squeeze to remove excess moisture
4. There should be 1 / 2 cup spinach
5. Wipe out the skillet
6. Meanwhile , in a medium nonstick skillet , combine the onion , 1 teaspoon oil , garlic , red-pepper flakes , and 1 tablespoon water
7. Turn the heat to medium
8. Cook for about 2 minutes , or until the onion sizzles
9. Reduce the heat to low
10. Cover and cook , stirring once , for about 3 minutes , or until softened
11. In a small bowl , combine the onion mixture , cheese , and spinach
12. Stir to mix
13. Set aside
14. Sprinkle the tomatoes evenly on the smooth side of the cutlets
15. Divide the spinach mixture among the cutlets
16. Spread to the edges of 3 sides , leaving about 1" at the narrow
17. Loosely roll up the chicken , ending with the narrow
18. Add the remaining 1 teaspoon oil to the large skillet and set over medium heat
19. Place the chicken in the pan
20. Cook , turning , for about 10 minutes , or until golden brown on all sides
21. Add the broth or wine , cover , and cook over low heat for about 7 minutes
22. Uncover and transfer chicken to a serving platter
23. Cover with foil to keep warm
24. Boil the skillet juices for about 5 minutes , or until reduced to a glaze
25. Diagonally slice the chicken into 1"-thick pieces
26. Drizzle with pan juices and serve

title: fruit paste
steps:
1. Peel and slice the orange and apple then put them and the grapes in to a medium size mixing bowl
2. Use a potato masher or a meat cleaver to start mashing the ingredients to a pulp
3. Once the ingredients are mashed put the smucker's in and mix well
4. Serve chilled
5. P
6. S
7. I love this spread on my egg salad sandwiches

title: company s comin  breakfast casserole
steps:
1. Butter a 13x9-inch baking dish
2. Cube bread into small pieces
3. Place in dish
4. Cube the cheese and place in dish
5. Add crumbled , cooked sausage
6. In a separate bowl , beat eggs
7. Add milk and seasonings and mix well
8. Pour mixture over bread and cheese
9. Refrigerate overnight
10. For breakfast , bake 1 hour at 325

title: halibut with garlic mayonnaise parmesan topping
steps:
1. To prepare the topping: combine mayonnaise , lemon juice , garlic , mustard , parmesan , green onion and tabasco
2. To prepare the halibut: place fish on a broiling pan
3. Sprinkle with lemon juice , salt and pepper
4. Bake in a preheated 450-degree oven 12 minutes per inch of thickness , or until fish tests done
5. Remove fish from oven and place a rack close to the broiling element
6. Turn the oven to broil
7. Spread the top of the fish with garlic topping
8. Broil about 1 minute , or until golden

title: rainbow drink  che ba mau
steps:
1. 1 can logan and i am not sure where to purchase them
2. Bring 2 cups water to a simmer in a pot over medium heat
3. Add the mung beans and 1 / 4 cup sugar
4. Cook , stirring constantly , until the water is completely absorbed , about 20 minutes
5. Remove from the heat and allow to cool
6. Refrigerate until ready to use
7. Bring 2 cups of water just to a boil in a pot over medium heat
8. Reduce the heat to low , add the azuki beans and 1 / 4 cup sugar
9. Cover and simmer until the beans are cooked through , about 3 hours
10. Remove from the heat and allow to cool
11. Refrigerate until ready to use
12. Meanwhile , bring the coconut milk and 1-1 / 2 cups water to a boil
13. Reduce the heat to low , add the remaining sugar and tapioca pearls , and simmer until the tapioca pearls have become completely transparent
14. Remove from the heat and allow to cool
15. Refrigerate until ready to use
16. In an ice cream soda glass , working in layers , place 2 tablespoons shaved ice in between 3 tablespoons each of everything else starting with shaved ice , coconut tapioca , shaved ice , azuki beans , shaved ice , coconut tapioca , and a few longans on top
17. Use ice cream spoons to eat and a straw to sip
18. I am guessing on servings time indicated is soaking time

title: crock pot chicken jambalaya
steps:
1. Cut chicken into 1 / 2-inch strips
2. Place frozen vegetables in a 3-1 / 2- or 4-quart slow cooker and top with chicken strips and turkey sausage
3. Add water , undrained tomatoes , and seasoning packet from rice
4. Cover and cook on low-heat setting for 5 to 6 hours or on high-heat setting for 2 1 / 2 to 3 hours
5. Stir in rice
6. Cover and cook about 45 minutes more , or until most of the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender

title: oriental cabbage
steps:
1. Slice onion
2. Place in bowl with water
3. Cover and microwave on high for 3 minutes
4. Put onion in large skillet with remaining ingredients
5. Cook , covered , over medium-low heat , stirring occasionally , until cabbage is tender , about 20 minutes

title: mango sorbet
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and place in a shallow metal container
2. Freeze until crystals appear throughout the sorbet so that it is semi-frozen
3. Scoop sorbet into a food processor and process until crystals are broken down
4. Return sorbet to the metal container and refreeze until frozen
5. Scoop sorbet into frood processor again and process until the crystals have broken down
6. Return once again to the metal container and freeze until required
7. For an icecream churn - combine splenda granular , mango pureem water and egg white , place in the churn and churn until frozen
8. Transfer to a container and store int he freezer till required
9. Serve scoops of sorbet with slices of mango and mint leaves if desired

title: southwestern cantaloupe salad
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients with the salad dressing and mix well
2. Looks lovely served in a wedge of the canteloupe shell !

title: low fat apricot noodle kugel
steps:
1. Cook noodles according to package directions
2. Drain and let cool for about 10 minutes
3. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
4. Lightly oil an 8-inch square baking pan or spray with a nonstick cooking oil
5. In a large bowl , combine jam , orange juice , egg whites and extracts
6. Beat with a fork or wire wisk until blended
7. Stir in raisins
8. Add noodles and mix well
9. Spoon mixture into prepared pan
10. Press the noodles down gently with the back of a spoon
11. Combine sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle evenly over the top of the kugel
12. Cover tightly and bake 15 minutes
13. Uncover and continue to bake 20 minutes more , until kugel is set
14. Let stand for 20 minutes before serving
15. Cut into squares to serve
16. Preparation & cooking time does not include 20 minutes to cool

title: egg mole tostada
steps:
1. Spray a small pan with cooking spray
2. Heat on medium for 1 minute , add tortilla , heat for about 30 seconds and turn over
3. Spoon sauce and salsa over tortilla
4. Crack egg over sauce
5. Cover
6. Cook for 3-4 minutes , until white is firm and yolk is soft-set
7. Top with cheese and cover for 1 minute , until cheese is melted
8. Put on a plate and allow to cool for a few minutes
9. Tortilla will be crispy , and will be easiest to eat with your hands , like a pizza

title: awesome gluten free chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. In mixing bowl , cream butter , sugars and pudding mix
2. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
3. Beat in vanilla
4. Gradually add flour mix , xanthan gum , and baking soda
5. Stir in chocoate chips
6. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto parchment paper lined cookie sheet
7. Bake at 350 for 8-10 minutes
8. Remove to wire racks and let cool
9. Enjoy !

title: mini seafood cakes with creamy lemon sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease or butter 18 cups of muffin pans
3. Set aside
4. In a bowl , combine the canned salmon , crabmeat , onion , eggs , bread crumbs , worcestershire sauce and liquid smoke
5. Mix thoroughly
6. With a large spoon , gather bits of the salmon mixture and drop into a cup of the prepared muffin pan
7. With your fingers or back of a spoon , flatten them into the muffin cup
8. Brush your fingers across the tops so they are smooth and even
9. Bake at 350 for 20-25 minutes , or until the edges are very lightly browned
10. While the cakes are baking , mix together the sour cream , lemon juice and lemon pepper until well blended and creamy
11. Store in refrigerator until ready to serve
12. Remove pan from the oven , and let cakes cool for about 15-20 minutes
13. Remove cakes and transfer to serving platter
14. Serve with creamy lemon sauce

title: piquant cheese salad  no mayo or pasta
steps:
1. In a serving bowl , mix cubed cheese , onion rings , diced salami , diced tomato & sliced gherkins
2. In a separate bowl , combine brown sugar , pineapple juice , tabasco , pepper , olive oil & diced pineapple chunks
3. Just b4 serving , toss salad in dressing & serve garnished w / chopped chives as desired
4. Store the cheese ready to use in a sandwich bag or refrigerator container & combine w / salad ingredients at the same time the dressing is added just before serving

title: grilled lamb chops
steps:
1. Trim lamb of excess fat
2. Mis all other ingredients to make marinade , including mint leaves , and marinate chops for 1 hour
3. Spray grill with vegetable oil or nonstick cooking spray
4. Remove chops from marinade and place on preheated grill
5. Grill chops without moving them for 4 minutes for medium rare
6. Baste chops with marinade and turn over to grill for another 4 minutes on other side
7. Remove to serving plate
8. Season with additional salt and garnish with additional mint leaves and mint jelly

title: prosciutto  brie and apple panini with scallion butter
steps:
1. In a bowl , beat 4 tablespoons of the butter until creamy
2. Stir in the scallion , lemon juice and mustard until smooth
3. Preheat a griddle over low heat
4. Spread the scallion butter on the cut sides of the rolls
5. Lay the prosciutto on the bottom halves
6. Top with the brie and the apple slices and close the sandwiches
7. Lightly spread the remaining 2 teaspoons of butter on the outside of the rolls
8. Put the sandwiches on the griddle
9. Cover with a heavy skillet and cook over low heat , turning occasionally , until toasted and the brie is melted , 10 minutes
10. Cut the panini in half and serve

title: chocolate lovers oatmeal delights
steps:
1. In a medium mixing bowl , combine flour , cocoa powder , baking soda and salt
2. Set aside
3. In a very large mixing bowl , beat butter with an electric mixer on medium speed for 30 seconds
4. Add the sugar and beat mixture till combined , scraping sides of bowl occasionally
5. Beat in egg , water and vanilla till combined
6. Beat in as much of the flour mixture as you can
7. Using a wooden spoon , stir in any remaining flour mixture and the rolled oats
8. Stir in chocolate pieces and peanut butter pieces
9. Drop dough by rounded tablespoon 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet
10. Bake in a 350 oven for 10 to 12 minutes or till the edges are set
11. Transfer cookies to a wire rack and cool

title: super easy crock pot chile verde
steps:
1. Turn the crock pot on to high while you chop the onions and slice the garlic
2. Dump everything in the pot
3. Cut the meat into 2-3 pieces so the sauce covers everything
4. Cover and cook on high for 5-6 hours
5. Degrease the sauce
6. Shred the meat
7. Serve with chopped avocado and a dollop of sour cream , if you like

title: hanky panky s
steps:
1. Brown meats together and drain well
2. Add tabassco and oregano
3. Cut velvetta into chunks and add to meat in large skillet
4. When cheese is melted , spread on rye bread
5. Put on cookie sheet and bake at 350 degrees until hot
6. You can also make ahead and freeze then heat in 350 oven

title: sarasota s ham and swiss cheese salad
steps:
1. Salad -- just rough chop the lettuce , add the ham , swiss cheese , whole olives and durkee onions (more or less depending on what you like
2. I save some for the top as well as a garnish
3. Now if you can't find the durkee fried onions , just use a regular white onion
4. I just like the crunch the durkee onions gives the salad
5. I like to lightly season with salt and pepper and then drizzle your favorite dressing over the top and toss well
6. I like to serve it with recipe #413903
7. The creamy mustard dressing goes perfect with this
8. You can also use a ranch dressing or your favorite vinaigrette
9. It is a simple classic recipe , but i absolutely love it
10. And feel free to add more or less ingredients as needed
11. Enjoy !

title: super simple clam chowder
steps:
1. Melt butter in dutch oven over medium heat
2. Add garlic and onion , and cook , stirring constantly , until tender
3. Add broth and next 3 ingredients
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat , and simmer 15 minutes
6. Stir in half and half , and cook over medium heat until thoroughly heated

title: 5 minute butter chicken
steps:
1. Mix together all the spices and toss through the chicken
2. Melt butter in skillet over medium high heat
3. Add onion and garlic and cook until soft
4. Add chicken
5. Stir until golden
6. Add tomato paste and garam masala
7. Stir in cream
8. Season and simmer for 5 - 8 minutes until rich and creamy

title: healthy egg salad sandwich
steps:
1. With the back of a fork , mash egg yolk with mustard to make a thick paste
2. Stir in chopped scallions and chopped egg white
3. Mix in salt and pepper as desired
4. Divide mixture on top of 2 slices of bread
5. Top with lettuce leaves , and cover with remaining slices of bread
6. Makes 2 sandwiches

title: pacific island garlic orange chicken
steps:
1. In 2c glass measure , combine yoshidas , orange juice , honey & orange zest to make marinade
2. Pour 1 / 2 the marinade into bowl and set aside other half
3. Add chicken to bowl and marinate for 10 to 15 minutes
4. This is a good time to start cooking your rice as directed
5. Remove chicken from marinade and discard marinade
6. Heat wok on high
7. Add olive oil until hot
8. Add garlic and cook for 20 seconds
9. Add onion , bell pepper , carrot and stir-fry until almost soft
10. Add chicken and continuing stir-frying until chicken 1 / 2 cooked
11. Add remaining marinade and continue cooking until chicken is no longer pink
12. Mix cold water & cornstarch in small glass
13. Pour into wok until sauce thickens , then remove from heat
14. Serve chicken mixture with gravy onto plates topped with a bed of jasmine rice
15. Top with mandarine oranges , chopped cashews , and cilantro
16. Bon apetite !

title: greek scramble with artichokes  black olives and feta
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , whisk eggs until light and frothy
2. Quarter artichokes
3. Place in a medium bowl with ricotta , mozzarella , aiago , nutmeg , and pepper
4. Coarsely chop basil and add to a bowl
5. Gently combine all ingredients in a bowl with a wooden spoon and set aside
6. Remove pits from olives , then coarsely chop
7. In a large , nonstick saut pan over medium heat , melt butter
8. When butter bubbles , add eggs
9. Cook over medium heat until eggs begin to set on edges of pan
10. With a rubber spatula , pull eggs at the edges of the pan to the center and gently shake the pan to redistribute the scramble
11. Continue this motion every few minutes until eggs are almost done but still wet
12. Add the cheese mixture in heaping tablespoons over the top of the scramble
13. Stir in cheese to combine and sprinkle with olives
14. Remove from heat and garnish with crumbled feta cheese

title: extra crispy hot wings
steps:
1. Take thawed chicken wing portions and place in ziplock bag
2. Pour hot sauce on wings for desired flavor and heat
3. Shake to coat chicken entirely
4. Marinate for at least 2 hours in the refrigerator
5. Beat eggs in a medium sized bowl
6. Pour flour into the spare ziplock bag
7. Mix old bay seasoning thoroughly with flour
8. Add cayenne pepper for extra heat
9. Coat wings with beaten egg and then place in the bag with flour
10. Shake until wings are completely coated with flour
11. Place wings back in the refrigerator for approximately
12. 15 minutes so the flour will stick to the chicken
13. Preheat deep fryer to 370f , or heat oil in a deep bottomed frying pan
14. Deep fry wings until a golden brown

title: pot roast with orange and dates
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Sprinkle roasts on each side with salt , pepper , and 1 teaspoon sugar
3. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in heavy wide ovenproof pot over medium-high heat
4. Add roasts
5. Cook until brown , about 8 minutes per side
6. Transfer to plate
7. Add 1 tablespoon oil and onions to pot
8. Saut until dark brown , stirring often , about 10 minutes
9. Mix in vinegar and allspice
10. Boil until reduced to glaze , scraping up browned bits
11. Add broth , orange juice , and tomato sauce
12. Bring to boil
13. Return roasts and accumulated juices to pot
14. Scatter dates around roasts
15. Sprinkle with parsley
16. Cover pot
17. Place in oven
18. Braise roasts 1 hour
19. Turn roasts over , cover , and braise until tender , about 1 hour
20. Tilt pot
21. Spoon off fat from top of sauce
22. Either eat roast now or see below for eating later:
23. Cool uncovered 1 hour
24. Do ahead can be made 2 days ahead
25. Chill uncovered until cold
26. Cover and keep chilled
27. If you made ahead--to re-heat roast:
28. Preheat oven to 350f
29. Transfer roasts to board , scraping sauce into pot
30. Cut crosswise into 1 / 2-inch-thick slices
31. Overlap slices in baking dish
32. Spoon sauce over
33. Cover
34. Rewarm about 25 minutes

title: simple tuna pasta salad
steps:
1. Combine the cooked and drained pasta with the drained tuna , chopped celery , peas , and mayonnaise , using only enough mayonnaise for the salad to be creamy
2. Chill at least 1- 2 hours before serving

title: dark rum brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Position oven rack in the lower third of the oven
3. Spray the bottom only of an 8-inch square baking pan with nonstick cooking spray
4. In a bowl , mix the brownie mix , melted butter , dark rum , eggs , and nutmeg with a wooden spoon until just blended and all dry ingredients are moistened
5. Stir in chopped chocolate
6. Spread batter into prepared pan
7. Bake 40-44 minutes or until toothpick inserted 2 inches from side of pan comes out clean or almost clean
8. Transfer to a wire rack and cool for 15 minutes
9. Chocolate rum glaze: in a small saucepan set over medium-low heat combine the brown sugar , butter , rum , and milk
10. Cook , stirring constantly , until the mixture comes to a boil
11. Boil , stirring constantly , 1 minute longer
12. Remove pan from heat and stir in the chocolate chips
13. Stir the mixture until the chips are completely melted and the mixture is smooth
14. Cool 5 minutes
15. Spread glaze over warm brownies
16. Cool completely
17. Cut into squares-9 large or 16 small brownies

title: elyse s chocolate cake
steps:
1. Place all dry ingredients in the mixer
2. Turn mixer on low and slowly add the wet ingredients 1 at a time
3. Pour into 2 greased round pans or 2 square pans
4. Bake 350 for 45minutes-1 hour
5. Freezes well
6. Hint: line the pans with baking paper for easy clean up

title: crock pot hearty pork stew
steps:
1. In a 4 to 5 quart slow cooker , mix together all the ingredients except the flour and margarine
2. Cover and cook on low heat 6 to 7 hours or until pork is no longer pink and vegetables are tender
3. Mix flour and margarine
4. Gradually stir into stew until well blended
5. Turn slow cooker to high and cook for an additional 30 to 45 minutes , stirring occasionally

title: carrot salsa salad side dish
steps:
1. Cook carrots till tender in microwave
2. Chop red onion and green bell pepper
3. For salsa: cut carrots into bite-sized pieces
4. For salad or side dish: leave carrots whole
5. Combine marinade ingredients in a medium bowl
6. Toss in the veggies , except the grape tomatoes
7. Now , smash each grape tomato over the bowl
8. For salsa or salad: cover and refrigerate at least an hour
9. For side dish: heat in the microwave for about 2-3 minutes

title: iced coffee latte
steps:
1. Place coffee in filter in brew basket of coffee maker
2. Add water to coffee maker
3. Brew
4. Cool completely
5. Pour coffee into pitcher
6. Add milk
7. Stir until well blended
8. Serve immediately or refrigerate until ready to serve
9. Serve over ice cubes
10. Add sugar to taste , if desired

title: chicken burgers with fresh fruit salsa
steps:
1. For salsa , in a medium bowl combine sweet-and-sour sauce , garlic , cilantro or parsley , lemon juice , and crushed red pepper
2. Stir in peaches , pear , and the 1 tablespoon chopped onion
3. Cover and chill up to 4 hours
4. In another medium bowl combine the chicken , remaining 1 / 2 cup onion , basil , seasoned salt , black pepper , and hot pepper sauce
5. Mix well
6. Shape into four 3 / 4-inch-thick patties
7. Grill meat on the grill rack directly over medium-hot coals for 14 to 18 minutes or until an instant-read thermometer inserted in side of patty registers 165 degrees f , turning once ,
8. Serve burgers with salsa

title: moist carrot cake muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Mix flour , baking powder , cinnamon and salt in a large bowl
3. Mix cereal and milk in another bowl , let stand for 3 minutes
4. Mix in carrots , sugar , egg and oil
5. Add to flour mixture until moist
6. Stir in raisins
7. Grease muffin pan and spoon batter into muffin pan filling each cup to 2 / 3 full
8. Bake for 25 minutes or until golden brown
9. Serve warm
10. Storage: cool leftover muffins and wrap each tightly with plastic wrap and freeze

title: drunken cherries aka cherry bomb
steps:
1. Cover cherries in a jar with rum
2. Serve in pina colada`s or straight up
3. You can pour the rum on a cooked chocolate devils food cake before icing

title: sesame chicken bits
steps:
1. Mix sesame seeds and bread crumbs together
2. Cut each chicken breast into 5 to 7 pieces
3. Dust pieces with flour , then dip into egg , then sesame and crumb mixture
4. Arrange in single layer on greased baking sheet
5. Pour melted butter over top
6. Bake at 350 for 20 minutes or until done and no pink remains
7. The bits can also be frozen ~ just thaw in the refrigerator and reheat in a 350 oven for 5 minutes or until hot

title: lamb khemma   kheema w  peas  potatoes   carrots
steps:
1. In a large pan with a lid heat the oil and add in the cumin seeds
2. Add the chopped onions and fry over a medium heat for a few minutes until golden
3. Blend together the garlic , ginger , chilli powder , turmeric , ground coriander and cumin , curry powder and salt
4. When the onions are ready add this mixture to the onions and stir fry for about 2 minutes
5. Add the lamb to the mixture and stir fry for about 7-10 minutes , breaking up any lumps of meat that may form
6. Finally , add the carrots , peas , potatoes and coriander leaves to the pan , stir and cover until the potatoes are cooked and the mixture is thick

title: rice  broccoli  and salmon casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Beat eggs in a large bowl
3. Whisk in cream of mushroom soup and milk
4. Add garlic salt , crushed red pepper , broccoli , rice , salmon , and 1 / 4 cup parmesan cheese
5. Mix well
6. Pour into greased casserole dish , 8 x 10 or larger
7. In a small bowl , mix together remaining cheese , panko , and parsley
8. Sprinkle over casserole
9. Cover dish with foil and bake 30 minutes
10. Remove foil and cook for another 15 minutes

title: bacon  lettuce    tomato dip
steps:
1. Place cream cheese in a bowl
2. Gradually stir in dressing
3. Mix well
4. Remove seeds from tomato
5. Dice tomato
6. Reserve 1 tablespoon for garnish
7. Chop bacon , celery and onion
8. Add tomato , bacon , celery , onion , and sugar to cream cheese mixture
9. Mix well
10. Cover
11. Refrigerate at least 3 hours to allow flavors to blend
12. To serve , line serving dish with optional lettuce leaves
13. Fill with dip
14. Garnish with reserved tomato
15. Serve with any variety of crackers desired

title: curried cream of broccoli soup
steps:
1. Cook onion , carrot , curry powder , mustard seeds and salt and pepper in butter over moderate heat , stirring , until onion is soft
2. Add broccoli , broth and water and simmer , covered , for 15-20 minutes , or until broccoli is very tender
3. Puree soup in batches until smooth
4. Whisk in lemon juice and season to taste
5. Heat over low heat and whisk in sour cream and heavy cream

title: fresh peach french toast cobbler
steps:
1. Slice bread into 8 slices and arrange in a shallow baking pan
2. In a bowl whisk together eggs , milk , baking powder and vanilla
3. Pour mixture over bread , turn slices to coat evenly , then cover with plastic wrap and let stand 2 hours at room temperature or refrigerate overnight
4. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
5. Grease a 9x13 inch baking pan
6. Mix sugar , cinnamon and cornstarch in a bowl and then fold in peaches , coating well
7. Ifusing frozen peaches that are sweetened you might want to add less sugar spread peach mixture in the greased baking pan and cover with the egg-soaked bread slices , wetter side up , wedging the bread in tightly
8. Brush the top of the bread slices with melted butter
9. Bake 20-25 minutes or'til toast looks golden and the peaches buble around the edges of the pan
10. Place toast on plates and spoon the peach sauce over the top and sprinkle with powdered sugar

title: walnut risotto with roasted asparagus
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Bring broth to simmer in medium saucepan
3. Cover and remove from heat
4. Heat 1-1 / 2 teaspoons olive oil in heavy medium saucepan over medium-high heat
5. Add onion and saut until light golden , about 4 minutes
6. Add rice and stir 1 minute
7. Add wine and stir until wine evaporates , about 2 minutes
8. Add 1 / 2 cup hot broth and cook until liquid is absorbed , stirring frequently
9. Continue adding more broth , 1 / 2 cupful at a time , until rice is tender and creamy , stirring frequently and allowing most of broth to be absorbed before adding more , about 25 minutes
10. Meanwhile , place asparagus and garlic in shallow baking dish
11. Drizzle remaining 1 1 / 2 teaspoons oil over
12. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
13. Toss to coat with oil
14. Bake asparagus until tender , turning occasionally , about 16 minutes
15. Mix walnuts and grated parmesan into risotto
16. Season with salt and pepper
17. Arrange roasted asparagus in center of 4 plates
18. Top with risotto

title: fragrant coconut lime   ginger fish bake
steps:
1. In a frying pan saute the garlic , onion , ginger and chillies until soft
2. Add the spices and more oil if necessary
3. Blend the fried food with the coriander and juice of one lime leaving out the fish and coconut cream
4. Leave overnight
5. Take your fish fillets and cut in half so you should have 8 serves
6. Smother the marinade over the fish generously
7. Leave to marinade at least for four hours best overnight
8. Take some aluminium foil , break off enough to make a loose parcel to hold the fish
9. Get your coconut cream and on the foil put 2 to 3 tablespoons of the coconut cream , place one fish fillet on top , join up the foil allowing for a lot of space
10. Cook on the barbq of in a hot oven for about 10-15 minutes the fish steams itself in the coconut cream - this is so yummy a great dinner party dish - serve with plain rice , mango salsa and a dry white wine

title: leprechaun soup
steps:
1. In large stockpot over medium-high heat , melt butter
2. Add peas , lettuce and green onions
3. Saute vegetables until onions are translucent , stirring frequently
4. Add broth and bring to the boil
5. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered about 8 minutes , or until peas are tender
6. Puree mixture in blender in 1-cup batches
7. Return to pan
8. Add corn and continue cooking for 2-3 minutes , until thoroughly heated
9. Season with salt and pepper
10. Serve with a 1 tablespoon dollop of sour cream

title: kir royale
steps:
1. Pour 1 ounce of creme de cassis into the bottom of the 8 flute glass
2. Top each with champagne and garnish with a twist of lemon

title: zippy tomato soup
steps:
1. Spray a medium saucepan with a little olive oil
2. Saute onion , celery , and garlic till onion becomes translucent and celery is still bright green
3. Reduce heat to low
4. Add crushed tomatoes , stock , paprika , cayenne , rosemary , and marjoram and simmer 15 minutes
5. Puree soup with an immersion blender
6. Serve with a dollop of sour cream

title: elaine s lemon frosted ginger cookies
steps:
1. In a large bowl , cream butter and sugar
2. Add molasses and egg and beat well
3. In another bowl sift together flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt , cinnamon , and ginger
4. Mix sifted ingredients into butter mixture alternately with buttermilk
5. Cover dough and chill for about 2 hours for easier handling
6. On lightly floured surface , roll dough to 1 / 4 inch thickness
7. Cut into 2-3 inch circles with cookie cutter
8. Lightly grease baking sheet
9. Bake at 375f for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned
10. Cool on cookie rack
11. For glaze , blend together confectioner's sugar , lemon juice and rind
12. Spread thinly over warm cookies
13. Cool

title: fabada austurianas
steps:
1. Soak beans overnight
2. Make sure they are fully covered in water
3. Cut ham into 1" cubes
4. Add ham , except 2 pieces of ham , and 6 chorizo into pot of water
5. Bring to boil and then reduce heat
6. Drain beans
7. Pour olive oil and onions in pot with beans and stir over medium high heat
8. Add 2 chorizos and 2 pieces of ham
9. Add water just to cover the beans
10. Let it boil then reduce heat to medium low- low
11. Stir in saffron
12. Cover pot , but not tightly
13. Cook for 2 - 2 1 / 2 hours or until beans are soft
14. Check often to ensure water is still covering beans
15. When the water level is too low , add the water from the pot of meats
16. Stir pot of beans with a wooden spoon occasionally
17. Check taste and salt and butter as desired
18. Drain pot of meats and then serve fabada with the meats
19. Enjoy !

title: spinach romaine salad
steps:
1. Toss together spinach , lettuce , bacon , cottage cheese , onion , swiss cheese , oranges , and mushrooms
2. Toss with dressing
3. Add as little or as much dressing as to taste

title: rosemary roast new potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Quarter potatoes and place in baking dish large enough to create a single layer
3. Sprinkle on salt and pepper to taste
4. Melt butter in a pan , with lemon juice and zest
5. Pour butter mix over potatoes , covering as much as possible and sprinkle with rosemary
6. Cook until slightly browned , turning in the butter mix occasionally

title: baked brussels sprouts au gratin
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Peel the outer leaves from the sprouts and cut an x into the bottom of each sprout
3. Boil and simmer the sprouts in water for 10 mins or until tender , drain and reserve 1 cup of the hot cooking liquid
4. Melt butter in a small skillet , add green onions and saute for 3 minutes
5. Stir in the flour and cook for 3 minutes add bacon , garlic and parsley and cook for a further 3 minutes
6. Pour in reserved water , add salt and pepper and bring to a boil , stirring constantly until thickened to consistency of heavy cream
7. Place sprouts in a buttered casserole
8. Pour the sauce over and top with grated cheese , then breadcrumbs
9. Bake for 30 mins until top is golden

title: my mom s homemade bread   bun recipe  no bread maker
steps:
1. In small bowl place the following ingredients:
2. 1 cup warm water
3. Yeast and 2 tbsp white sugar
4. Let stand for 10 minutes
5. In large mixing bowl do the following steps
6. Place 8 cups warm water in bowl
7. Place remaining 2 tbsp sugar in water
8. Place 4 tbsp margarine or veg
9. Oil in water
10. Place salt in water
11. Add 6 cups flour one at a time and mix as you are adding
12. Making sure to remove any lumps
13. Should be smooth before adding next cup
14. Pour yeast mixture in other bowl that you set aside into mixture
15. Mix until smooth
16. Continue to add flour mixing thoroughly until dough is sticky and forms a ball (
17. It should take only about a maximum of 17 cups of flour
18. Take dough out of bowl and place on a flat clean dry surface which was sprinkled with about 1 / 2 cup of flour
19. Knead dough with hands for about 15 minutes or so
20. Dough should be soft and feel light to to touch
21. Do not add more flour ! it will make your bread dough too heavy ! if you do
22. Separate dough in half
23. Place each half in a bowl
24. Place a light towel over it and let the dough rise for 1 hour or until doubled
25. For buns: take about the size of a baseball of dough in your hand roll into a ball and place it on an ungreased cookie sheet
26. Let rise for another 1 / 2 hour or until buns are double in size
27. For buns to rise tall place them close together almost touching
28. Bake at 375f
29. For loaves: take a large amount of dough and roll into a roll dough should not take up more than half of the loaf pan
30. Make sure dough roll is even or you will end up with a lopsided loaf or narrow loaf
31. Let rise for 1 to 2 hours
32. Or until dough is nicely formed above the rim of the loaf pan
33. Bake at 350f for 45 minutes or until golden brown
34. To test to see if done knock on top of the loaf
35. If it sounds hollow it is completed baking
36. It will be a dark golden brown color when finished
37. Take loaves out of oven and take them immediately out of the pans upside down
38. Brush melted butter over top of loaves to prevent from drying out
39. Yield: 4 loaves 2 dozen buns
40. Depends on size

title: easiest pumpkin spice cake
steps:
1. Stir all three ingredients together
2. Pour into 13 x 9 pan sprayed with non-stick spray
3. Bake at 350 degrees for 30-35 minutes

title: smashed garlic plantains   mofongo
steps:
1. Mix handful of salt into a bowl of cold water and soak plantain chunks
2. Place stock in saucepan over low heat to warm
3. Bring at least 1 inch of oil to about 350 f degrees in a deep skillet
4. Meanwhile , cook chicharrones or bacon until crisp
5. Remove from heat and drain
6. Remove plantains from water , drain and dry them on towels , then deep fry the pieces until golden brown and tender
7. Remove from oil
8. Flatten the plantains using the bottom of a flat-bottomed glass bottle or a tostonera if you have one
9. Fry the plantains again for 30 seconds on each side until slightly crispy
10. While the plantains are still hot use a wooden mortar and pestle to mash them with the garlic and the chicharrones
11. Add salt and pepper to taste
12. You can also use a food processor add the plantains to food processor with bacon , garlic and some salt and pepper
13. You may have to work in batches
14. Process to consistency of mashed not whipped potatoes
15. Do not over process !
16. Place the mixture in soup bowls or wooden pilons , douse with broth , garnish with cilantro and serve immediately

title: mujadarra
steps:
1. Mix the seasoning ingredients together
2. Set aside
3. In a heavy pot , fry the onions on med-high heat , stirring occasionally , until golden brown
4. Remove onions with a slotted spoon , and set them aside , leaving the oil in the pot
5. Reduce heat to medium , add the garlic and seasoning mixture
6. Stir for 2 minutes
7. Do not burn the garlic
8. Add the water and bring it to a boil , then add the lentils , stir gently and let simmer for 5 minutes
9. Add the rice , reduce the heat to low , cover and cook for 20 minutes
10. Remove from the heat let sit for five minutes , remove the lid and stir in the onions
11. Serve and enjoy !

title: kris kringle cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Beat butter and sugars in large bowl with electric mixer on medium speed until light and fluffy
3. Blend in eggs and vanilla
4. Add flour , baking soda and salt
5. Mix well
6. Stir in chocolate , pecans and cranberries
7. Drop dough by rounded tablespoonfuls , 1-1 / 2 inches apart , onto ungreased baking sheets
8. Bake 9 to 11 minute or until lightly browned
9. Cool 3 min
10. Remove to wire racks
11. Cool completely
12. Store in tightly covered container at room temperature

title: tilapia w lemon peppercorn sauce
steps:
1. Combine first 3 ingredients , set aside
2. In a saute pan melt 1 tsp butter and oil
3. Mix flour with salt and pepper and dredge fillets , shaking off excess
4. Add to hot skillet and saute 3 minutes per side until fish flakes easily
5. Remove from pan
6. Add broth mixture to pan , scraping up browned bits
7. Bring to boil and reduce to 1 / 2 cup
8. Whisk in 2 tsp butter
9. Serve sauce over tilapia , garnished with lemon wedges

title: italian pasta and bean soup
steps:
1. Saute first 3 ingredients in large pot until onions are very tender
2. Add next 6 ingredients and simmer for about 20-30 minutes
3. Cool and store in frig for at least a couple of hours
4. Reheat and simmer for about 30 minutes before serving
5. Place cooked penne noodles in bottom of soup bowl and ladle soup over noodles
6. Liberally sprinkle parmesan cheese on soup
7. Serve with french bread or rolls

title: beet and carrot whole wheat cake
steps:
1. Mix the flour , wheat bran , wheat germ , brown sugar , cinnamon and salt together with fingers until lumps in sugar are gone
2. Add beaten eggs , then oil
3. Stir in grated vegetables , nuts , raisins or dates and coconut
4. Finally , add the baking soda
5. Butter and wax paper line a 9 x 13 inch pan
6. Bake at 350f for 1 hour and for 15 minutes more at 300f
7. Store covered for a few days
8. Wheatland bounty

title: reese s snack mix
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together , being careful not to crush or smash the cereal
2. Store in a large ziplock bag , or an airtight container

title: blueberry yogurt cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In a large bowl , cream 1 / 2 cup butter with the granulated sugar until light and fluffy
3. Beat in eggs and vanilla
4. In a medium bowl , sift together flour , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
5. Stir into butter mixture
6. Add yogurt and mix
7. Gently stir in blueberries
8. In a small bowl , stir together the brown sugar , cinnamon , nutmeg , and walnuts
9. Pour half the cake batter into a buttered and floured 8-inch square baking pan
10. Sprinkle with half the brown sugar mixture and top with the remaining batter
11. Combine the remaining brown sugar mixture with 2 tablespoons butter and sprinkle over the top of the batter
12. Bake until toothpick inserted into center comes out clean , about 45 minutes

title: phad thai
steps:
1. Soak noodles in warm water until rubbery , at least 30 minute drain well
2. While noodles soak , prepare all the other ingredients
3. In a skillet or wok , cook eggs until done , breaking up as they cook
4. Set aside
5. In same pan , add a little oil and cook chicken , stir-frying until done
6. Set aside
7. Put 3 tbs
8. Oil in wok and heat until hot
9. Add noodles and stir-fry
10. Noodles will stick together forming a ball
11. When noodles appear blistered all over ,
12. Quickly add the tamarind / water mixture , stirring to soften noodles
13. Add all other ingredients
14. Tofu , chicken and eggs , the three sauces , sugar , peanuts and bean sprouts , stir-frying for 2 minute
15. Turn off heat
16. Add chives and mix well
17. Serve adding more bean sprouts , peanuts , sugar , dried chilies and squeeze lime wedges over to taste

title: lamb chops with white beans
steps:
1. Sprinkle the lamb with 1 / 4 teaspoons each of the salt and pepper
2. In a large ovenproof skillet , heat 1 tablespoons of the oil over medium-high heat and brown the chops
3. Transfer to a plate
4. Drain the fat from the pan and add the remaining oil
5. Cook the onion , garlic , rosemary and remaining salt and pepper over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until the onion is softened , about 3 minutes
6. Add the beans and the broth and bring to a boil
7. Place the chops on top of the beans and bake in a 425 degree f oven for 10 minutes
8. Add the tomatoes and bake for another 5 minutes
9. Sprinkle with parsley

title: entremes vegetariano mexicano
steps:
1. Peel cucumbers , optional: deseed
2. Slice in half and slice lengthwise in to 1 / 2 in wedges
3. Peel jicama and slice in to 1 / 2 in sticks
4. Peel carrots , slice in half and slice lengthwise in to 1 / 2 in sticks
5. Serve all veggies in a platter and top with salt , pepper and lemon juice
6. Enjoy !

title: mock angel cake
steps:
1. Heat milk to a boiling point
2. Mix and sift flour , sugar , and baking powder 3 times
3. Pour milk gradually into dry mixture , blending well
4. Fold in white eggs and add vanilla
5. Pour into ungreased pan and bake in slow oven for 45 minutes
6. Cool
7. Cover with the frosting of your choice

title: pork with apple butter sauce
steps:
1. Heat a nonstick skillet on medium high and spray with olive oil spray
2. Remove fat from pork and sprinkle with rosemary
3. Press rosemary into chops on both sides
4. Add to skillet and brown 2 minutes
5. Turn and brown second side 2 minutes
6. Sprinkle cooked side with salt and pepper to taste
7. Lower heat to medium low , cover and cook 2 minutes
8. A meat thermometer should read 160 degrees
9. Meanwhile mix apple butter , horseradish and cider vinegar together
10. Place pork chips on dinner plates and pour pan juices on top
11. Served seasoned apple butter on the side

title: italian tuna spread
steps:
1. Add the tuna , lemon juice , and balsamic vinegar to the bowl of a food processor
2. Process until combined
3. Add in the cream , butter , and salt
4. Pulse until well blended
5. Transfer to a serving bowl and keep chilled / covered until ready to serve
6. Top with the lemon slices as a garnish
7. Serve cold with crackers or baguette slices

title: broiled lobster tails for 2
steps:
1. In large saucepan , heat water and salt to boiling
2. Add frozen lobster tails
3. Heat to boiling
4. Reduce heat
5. Cover and simmer until done , about 12 minutes
6. Drain
7. Wearing a clean oven mitt or using a potholder , hold and cut down sides of lobster tails with kitchen scissors to remove thin undershell covering the meat
8. To prevent tails from curling , insert long metal skewer from meat side through tail to shell side , then back through shell and meat at opposite end
9. Set oven control at broil and / or 550 degrees
10. Place tails meat side up on rack in broiler pan , brush with butter
11. Broil with tops 3 inches from heat 2 to 3 minutes
12. Alternatively , they can be placed over a hot grill / barbecue for 2-3 minutes
13. Serve with lemon butter
14. Lemon butter:
15. 1 / 2 cup butter
16. 1 tablespoon lemon juice
17. 1 tablespoon snipped parsley
18. 1 / 4 teaspoon hot sauce
19. Melt butter , add remaining ingredients

title: cold ham salad sandwich spread  or appetizer
steps:
1. In a medium bowl combine the first 6 ingredients together
2. In a small bowl mix together the mayonnaise and yellow mustard until well combined
3. Add to the mixture in the ham mixture
4. Mix to combine
5. Season with black pepper to taste
6. Cover and chill a minimum of 2 or more hours before using

title: marquis potatoes
steps:
1. Peel and cut potatoes into small chunks boil in salted water till fork tender meanwhile , heat oil in a saucepan add green onions and saute 30 seconds add tomatoes and saute about 10 minutes or until moisture has evaporated set aside
2. Drain potatoes and cool for just a bit
3. Turn on broiler grease baking sheet mash potatoes with 2 egg yolks , butter and milk
4. Season with salt and pepper spoon potatoes onto pan into six little nests with indentions in the center
5. To make this fancy , use a pastry bag with a large star
6. Beat remaining egg with water and brush over potatoes
7. Broil 5 minutes or until golden brown
8. Spoon tomato mixture into potatoes , sprinkle with parsley and serve

title: breakfast enchilada ranchero
steps:
1. Heat butter over low heat in a large skillet and add scrambled eggs
2. Cook until set and set aside
3. Brown ground beef in skillet , season with cumin , chili powder , salt and pepper
4. Add broth and cook until liquid evaporates
5. Pour half the salsa in a 13 x 9 inch baking dish
6. Place about 1 / 8 cup ground beef and 1 / 8 cup scrambled egg in each tortilla
7. Roll up and place in baking dish seam side down
8. Top with remaining salsa , sprinkle with cheese , and bake at 350f until heated through and cheese is melted , about 20 minutes

title: z tejas cornbread
steps:
1. Mix all dry ingredients together
2. Mix wet ingredients in a separate bowl , add dry ingredients
3. Lightly grease a 10- or 12-inch cast iron skillet
4. Pour in batter
5. Bake at 375 for 25-30 minutes , rotating pan halfway through

title: peppy egg strata
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Butter 13-by-9-by-2-inch baking dish
3. Spread dish with nonstick vegetable spray
4. Line dish with bread slices
5. Layer monterey jack , cheddar and bacon
6. In large bowl , beat eggs
7. Add milk , salt and pepper
8. Beat until blended well
9. Pour over cheese-bacon mixture in dish
10. Bake in preheated oven for 45 to 50 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean

title: chicken tortilla soup iii
steps:
1. Mix first five ingredients together and heat
2. Sprinkle each serving with chips and cheese
3. Add hot pepper sauce for those who are so inclined

title: asian chicken burgers
steps:
1. Heat the oil and fry the onion , ginger , garlic and chili for a 2-3 minutes , add the mushrooms for the last minute
2. Set aside to cool
3. Mix the ground chicken with all the other ingredients and the cooled onion mixture , shape into 4 or 6 burgers
4. Fry them in some oil on a medium fire for several minutes on each side until done and browned
5. Serve as suggested in the recipe-intro or use your own ideas

title: agave marshmallows
steps:
1. Place first 3 ingredients in stand mixer with whip attachment on high
2. Marshmallows are approx 80% air
3. If a stand mixer or handheld is not used , i cannot vouch as to the results
4. Meanwhile , dissolve the gelatin in cold water
5. Lightly spray 8 x 8 inch pan with cooking spray
6. I use a silicon pan as it's much easier to remove the marshmallows
7. Sprinkle half of the cornstarch in the greased pan , tilting to coat evenly
8. Once the gelatin has dissolved , microwave on high for approx 30 seconds , in 10 second intervals , stirring after each
9. Add gelatin mixture to agave mixture and continue to whip on high for 10-20 minutes until fluffy and white
10. Spread evenly in pan with lightly greased spatula and let set for 3-4 hours or overnight
11. Dust top of marshmallows with remaining cornstarch , cut into squares , remove from pan and dust again

title: poinsettia sipper  with  cocktail  variation
steps:
1. In a large saucepan combine the juices , sugar , cloves , cinnamon sticks and water , stirring until the sugar dissolves
2. Bring to a simmer
3. Cover and simmer 30 minutes
4. Remove cloves and cinnamon sticks from the pan with a slotted spoon
5. Serve warm or chilled
6. Garnish with orange rind curls , if desired
7. Variation with alcohol:
8. For a poinsettia cocktail , add 1 tablespoon vodka to each serving

title: venison soup stock
steps:
1. Cut meat from bones
2. Melt bacon fat in a heavy fry pan and brown meat on all sides
3. Place browned meat and bones in large pot and cover with water
4. Add remaining ingredients
5. Cover , bring to a boil on top of stove , then reduce heat and simmer 3 to 4 hours
6. Strain , cool and remove the fat that has collected on surface
7. Strain again if necessary
8. Pour in airtight containers , store in refrigerator for up to 3 days
9. Can be frozen

title: dorothy smith gooden s rhubarb relish
steps:
1. Put the rhubard , onions& vinegar in a pot and boil until soft , about 1 / 2 hour
2. Add remaining ingredients and simmer until thickened
3. Place in sterelized pint sealers and seal

title: lemon cups
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease eight custard cups
3. Set aside
4. In a large bowl , beat sugar , flour and butter / margarine
5. Add lemon peel and lemon juice
6. Set aside
7. In a small bowl , mix egg yolks and milk
8. Add to cream mixture and stir
9. Fold in egg whites
10. Pour into cups
11. Place in baking pan and add one inch of water to pan
12. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until golden

title: medallions of beef tenderloin with cabernet reduction
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 500f
2. Combine the salt , pepper , and garlic powder in a zip closure bag
3. Very lightly oil the tenderloin with olive oil
4. Sprinkle the mixture liberally over all sides of the tenderloin and press into the meat
5. Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a heavy ovenproof skillet or roasting pan over medium high heat
6. Sear the tenderloin for a minute or so on all sides
7. Add cup of beef broth to the skillet and the sprig of rosemary
8. Transfer skillet to preheated oven and roast tenderloin for about 8 10 minutes
9. Remove skillet from oven
10. Transfer tenderloin to a cutting board , cover with aluminum foil and allow meat to rest
11. You can prepare up to this point and hold the meat under the foil for at least 30 45 minutes
12. Do not wash skillet or discard the roasting juices and bits
13. With skillet still hot , add the chopped shallot and cook for a minute or so
14. Add cup beef broth to the skillet , scraping all the caramelized juices and bits with a spoon
15. Add the cabernet sauvignon and bring to a boil to reduce the volume of the sauce by about half
16. If holding the final preparation , stop at this point , cover skillet , and turn heat off
17. Just before serving , slice the tenderloin into to 1 medallions
18. Return skillet to medium high heat , add about 2 tablespoons unsalted butter to the sauce and allow it to melt , taste and if needed adjust with a pinch or salt or pepper
19. Remove the rosemary sprig
20. Return the medallions to the hot pan and gently warm them in the sauce for 30 seconds to 1 minute on each side for medium rare or a bit longer until desired temperature
21. Remove the medallions to warmed platter or serving plate , pour sauce over them , and serve

title: grilled asparagus wrapped in prosciutto
steps:
1. Place asparagus and all of ingredients except for prosciutto , in a microwavable dish
2. Cook for 2 minutes
3. Preheat grill to high
4. When cool enough to handle , wrap each spear , including some of the seasoning with one slice of prosciutto
5. Repeat with all spears
6. Grill turning to brown and crisp each side
7. Enjoy !
8. No need for salt because the proscuitto is salty

title: german chocolate sauerkraut cake
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , cream butter and sugar
2. Add the eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
3. Beat in vanilla
4. Combine dry ingredients
5. Add to the creamed mixture alternately with water
6. Fold in sauerkraut , coconut and pecans
7. Pour into three greased and floured 9-in
8. Round baki ng pans
9. Bake at 350 degrees for 20-24 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
10. Cool for 10 minutes before removing from pans to wire racks
11. Cool completely
12. In a bowl , combine melted chocolate and mayonnaise
13. Set aside 1-1 / 4 cups for frosting
14. To the remaining chocolate mixture , add half of the coconut and pecans
15. Spread between cake layers
16. Spread reserved chocolate mixture over top and sides of cake
17. Combine remaining coconut and pecans
18. Press onto sides of cake
19. Store in the refrigerator
20. Slice with a serrated knife
21. Yield: 12-14 servings
22. Editors
23. Taste of home magazine

title: wish i made more  yeast potato lem orange rolls
steps:
1. First 4 ingredients- mix in a large bowl
2. Next 3 ingredients- stir into milk mixture
3. Set aside to cool to lukewarm
4. Soften yeast in warm water
5. Add 1 cup flour to cooled milk and beat until smooth
6. Add yeast- stir until dissolved
7. Add remaining flour
8. Add 2 eggs and beat until smooth
9. Beat in enough remaining flour to make a soft smooth dough
10. Cover , let rise until double- 1 hour
11. Stir down and let rise again- 45 minute
12. Turn onto a lightly floured surface
13. Divide dough into thirds
14. Roll out each third to a 9 inch circle- inch thick
15. Brush with melted butter
16. Cut circle into 8 wedges
17. Roll each wedge up
18. Place rolls points down on a greased cookie sheet
19. Curve to form crescent shape
20. Brush with melted butter
21. Let rise 30 minute
22. Bake 375 for 18 minutes
23. Cool
24. Additional info for oamc
25. To freeze dough: shape dough as directed
26. Place on a baking sheet and place in freezer
27. Freeze until firm
28. Transfer to a freezer bag
29. Seal , label and freeze
30. To serve: remove from freezer and place on a baking sheet
31. Cover lightly and allow to thaw / rise for about 2 hours
32. Bake as directed
33. You can also freeze the baked rolls
34. Wrap tightly , label and freeze
35. Thaw on counter and reheat as desired

title: chocolate orange cheesecake with orange tangerine glaze
steps:
1. Crust:
2. In a small bowl stir together wafer crumbs and butter until combined well
3. Pat crumb mixture onto bottom and 1 inch up side of a 9-inch springform pan and chill crust 30 minutes
4. Filling:
5. Preheat oven to 300f
6. In a bowl with an electric mixer beat cream cheese until light and fluffy
7. Beat in sugar gradually until mixture is combined well
8. Beat in sour cream , zest , orange juice , liqueur , salt , and flour
9. Beat in whole eggs and yolk , 1 at a time , beating well after each addition
10. Wrap bottom and side of springform pan with three 14- by 12-inch pieces of foil , 1 at a time , arranging each piece in a different position to make sure foil is at least 1 1 / 2 inches up side all around
11. Put pan in a large baking dish and pour filling into crust
12. Put dish in middle of oven and with a measuring cup slowly add enough water to it to reach 1 / 4 inch up side of springform pan , being careful not to let any water inside foil
13. Bake cheesecake 1 hour 15 minutes , or until edges are just set but middle still trembles slightly
14. Turn off oven and let cheesecake stand 1 hour
15. Remove dish from oven carefully and transfer cheesecake in pan to a rack to cool completely
16. Remove foil and chill cheesecake , covered loosely , 6 hours or overnight
17. Glaze:
18. In a small saucepan melt marmalade over moderate heat , stirring , and cool to warm
19. Remove side of springform pan and spread marmalade evenly on top of cheesecake
20. Chill cheesecake 2 hours

title: best ever fresh sweetcorn salad
steps:
1. Fill a large pot with salted water and bring to a boil
2. Break each ear of corn in half so it will fit in the pot , and cook until tender and the starchiness is just gone
3. Drain and immediately immerse the ears of corn in a bowl of ice water to stop the cooking and to set the color
4. When the corn is cool , cut the kernels off the cob , cutting close to the cob
5. Toss the kernels in a large bowl with the red onions , roasted red peppers , vinegar , olive oil , salt , and pepper
6. Just before serving , toss in the fresh basil
7. If you add the basil too early and let the salad sit for a long period of time before serving , it will wilt and darken
8. Taste for seasonings and serve cold or at room temperature

title: caesar s salad
steps:
1. Croutons: this is one of the keys to this recipe
2. Start with about 1 / 2 loaf of a crusty italian bread with a large cell-structure , e
3. G
4. Big holes
5. I really like to use pugliese or ciabatta
6. Cut the bread into cubes of about 1 inch square and lay out onto a a cookie sheet and toast in the oven , preferably under a broiler
7. Turn the croutons about half-way through to ensure both sides get toasted
8. The most important thing here is to not over-toast -- you want croutons that are crunchy on the outside and still soft in the center
9. Chop the romaine hearts into sections about 1 inch by the width of each leaf
10. Dressing: squeeze the juice of the lemon into a mixing bowl and add the anchovy paste
11. I know some people are squeamish about anchovy paste , but the taste really isn't strong here
12. Ive served this to anchovy haters who loved it
13. Finally , the paste serves as an important emulsifier in this recipe
14. Using a whisk slowly drizzle the olive oil into the lemon-anchovy mixture while whisking , all the ingredients should come together in a thick , greenish brown dressing
15. Assembly: place romaine in a large salad bowl
16. Add still warm croutons on top of lettuce
17. Pour grated cheese on top of pile and then drizzle dressing on top of whole
18. Toss and serve

title: chocolatey crunchies
steps:
1. Melt the chocolate chips in the microwave or on the stovetop on low heat
2. Stir in the peanut butter
3. Take the pot off the heat and stir in cereal until well coated
4. If your cereal is on the plain side , add a drizzle of maple syrup to flavor it up
5. Drop by big spoonfuls on a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper
6. Chill in the refrigerator for at least half an hour

title: aeden s apple spice almond cookies  scd
steps:
1. In a bowl mix together almond flour , cinnamon , nutmeg , baking soda and salt , set aside
2. Peel and finely grate the apple
3. Wrap the pulp in a paper towel and squeeze out the juice
4. Put the pulp in the bowl with the flour mix and discard the juice
5. Add the egg , butter and honey to the flour , mix well
6. Butter the cookie sheets and drop the dough in small mounds , 8 per cookie sheet
7. Place in oven preheated at 350 degrees f
8. For 10 minute or until edges are browned and center is still light in color
9. After baking place cookie tray in freezer for 5 minutes before removing the cookies
10. Cookies must be removed very carefully and placed single layered between sheets of wax paper
11. Cookies will be very flat and fragile
12. Once cooled keep in air tight container
13. Makes 18

title: polenta pancakes with warm berry sauce
steps:
1. Pancakes:
2. Place dry ingredients in a stainless steel bowl and whisk to combine
3. Fold in eggs and buttermilk with a spoon or rubber spatula
4. Stir in vegetable oil and set aside batter to rest for at least 1 hour
5. Heat a nonstick griddle over medium heat
6. Ladle pancake batter onto hot griddle , in batches as necessary , and cook until bubbles form around the edges
7. Flip pancakes and continue cooking on second side until set and golden brown
8. Keep warm in a 200 degree f oven until ready to serve
9. Sauce:
10. In a saucepan , combine berries , sugar , vanilla , cinnamon , and nutmeg and bring to a boil
11. In a small bowl , combine cornstarch and water , stirring until it dissolves
12. Add the cornstarch slurry to the sauce to thicken
13. Stir until smooth and simmer slowly for 2 to 3 minutes
14. To serve , stack 2 pancakes on a plate and top with 4 tablespoons of sauce

title: kielbasa and noodles or rice or whatever  oamc crock pot
steps:
1. Saute onions , celery , and chilies until onions are translucent
2. Remove from frying pan , set aside to drain on paper towels
3. Brown kielbasa
4. Mix all ingredients in a crock pot set on low
5. Cook for 6 hours
6. Serve over just about anything you can think of , noodles , rice , toast or croutons , hashbrowns or mashed potatoes , cous cous , i think you get the idea

title: corn with cream cheese
steps:
1. Cut cream cheese into small cubes and combine with milk , butter , salt and pepper in a saucepan
2. Cook over low heat , stirring constantly until cheese melts
3. Add corn and heat thoroughly

title: very shiny chocolate glaze
steps:
1. Melt all ingredients over a water bath
2. Stir constantly , avoiding bubbles
3. Cool to room temperature
4. Pour over cooled cake from the center and let spread itself , run a spatula along the cake side to distribute the glaze

title: mexi lentil rice
steps:
1. Spray inside of crock pot with non stick cooking spray
2. Add all ingredients except "toppings" and mix well
3. Cook on high for two to two and a half hours
4. Serve topped with additional cheese , sour cream and salsa if desired

title: easy pizza dough
steps:
1. To make the dough: dissolve the yeast in the warm water and set aside
2. Put the flour and salt in a food processor fitted with the steel blade
3. Process briefly to mix
4. With the machine running , add the water-yeast mixture in a steady stream
5. Turn the processor off and add the oil
6. Pulse a few times to mix in the oil
7. Divide the dough: scrape the soft dough out of the processor and onto a lightly floured surface
8. With lightly floured hands , quickly knead the dough into a mass , incorporating any bits of flour or dough from the processor bowl that werent mixed in
9. Cut the dough into four equal pieces with a knife or a dough scraper
10. Roll each piece into a tight , smooth ball , kneading to push the air out
11. To use dough that same day: if you want to make pizza as soon as possible , put the dough balls on a lightly floured surface , cover them with a clean dishtowel , and let them rise until they almost double in size , about 45 minutes
12. Meanwhile , turn your oven on , preferably with a baking stone in it , to let the stone fully heat
13. Pizza the next day: if you want to bake the pizzas the next day , line a baking sheet with a floured dishtowel , put the dough balls on it , and cover them with plastic wrap , giving them room to expand , and let them rise in the refrigerator overnight
14. To use dough that has been refrigerated overnight , simply pull it out of the refrigerator about 15 minutes before shaping the dough into a pizza
15. To shape , top , and bake the pizzas , see below
16. To freeze dough: dust each generously with flour as soon as youve made it , and put each one in a separate zip-top bag
17. Freeze for up to a month
18. Its best to thaw the dough in the refrigerator for at least 10-12 hours before you want to use it-- but in a pinch it'll defrost on the counter in about 1 1 / 2 hours
19. To shape pizzas: put the proofed or thawed ball of dough on a lightly floured surface
20. Dust the top with flour
21. Using your finger
22. Lift the dough and lay it over the back of the fist of one hand
23. Put your other fist under the dough , right next to your first fist
24. Now gently stretch the dough by moving your fists away from each other
25. Each time you do this stretch , rotate the dough
26. Continue stretching and rotating until the dough is thin , about 1 / 4 inch , and measures about 9 inches across
27. Alternatively , use a rolling pin to roll out the dough thinly on a floured surface
28. Rub a bit of flour onto a pizza peel
29. Gently lift the stretched dough onto the floured peel
30. Top the pizza , scattering the ingredients around to within inch of the border
31. To bake: put a pizza stone or unglazed quarry tiles on the lowest rack of the oven and heat the oven to 500f
32. Ideally , let the stone preheat in the oven for an hour
33. You should place your pizza on the peel before topping it so that it's ready to slide onto your stone
34. Shake the peel gently back and forth to make sure the pizza isnt stuck
35. Quickly slide the pizza onto the hot baking stone
36. Bake until the edges are golden , about 8 min
37. Using a peel , a wide spatula , or tongs , remove the pizza from the oven

title: deliciously versatile bean burgers   veggie burger
steps:
1. For the patties , chop in a food processor beans , onion , garlic , and chosen seasonings until beans are coarsely chopped
2. Stir in egg and enough breadcrumbs or flour to make the mixture workable
3. In a nonstick pan , spray with non stick spray or add a little oil
4. Take mixture and form into a patty approximately 1 / 2 inch thick
