5. Brown on each side over med - med high heat , taking care when flipping
6. In a small bowl , mix ingredients for sauce
7. Serve patty drizzled with sauce , in a tortilla , pita , bun or plain
8. Feel free to top with tomato , onion , lettuce , etc

title: sour cream white cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease and flour 9x13 cake pan
3. In large mixing bowl combine all the ingredients
4. In electric mixer beat on low 1 minute , scraping sides occasionally
5. Increase speed to medium and beat 2 minutes more
6. Pour into prepared cake pan and bake 35 to 40 minutes
7. Cool 20 minutes on wire rack
8. Remove from pan
9. Frost cake , if desired

title: romantic rosemary or lavender bread
steps:
1. Combine yeast and lukewarm water until well blended and let sit about 10 minutes- it should look foamy and thick
2. Combine buttermilk , oil , rosemary , 1 tbsp plus 1 tsp salt in a mixer bowl , then add the yeast mixture and combine well
3. Add flour gradually , beating slowly until enough flour has been added to form a dough ball that leaves the sides of the bowl in one mass
4. Dump any remaining flour onto a flat surface , dump dough onto that surface , and with floured hands knead dough until smooth and elastic , about 5-10 minutes
5. Set dough into a large greased bowl , flip dough over to grease both sides , cover with plastic wrap and set in a warm place to rise until doubled in bulk- about 1 1 / 2 hours
6. On dough has risen , place dough onto a floured surface and cut into equal halves and form each half into a round loaf shape
7. Set loaves onto a large greased baking sheet dusted with cornmeal
8. Cover with a clean , slightly damp towel and let rise 1 hour
9. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f
10. Using a serrated knife , slash the top of each loaf with an asterisk pattern and sprinkle each with a little coarse salt
11. Bake in center of the preheated oven for 15 minutes , spritzing occasionally
12. Continue baking another 45-55 minutes or until the loaves sounds hollow when rapped on the bottom and they appear golden brown
13. Let cool on racks completely

title: buttermilk fried chicken with a curry flair
steps:
1. Mix buttermilk , curry powder , 3 teaspoons salt and pepper in large bowl
2. Add chicken
3. Turn to coat
4. Cover
5. Chill at least 4 hours , but overnight is recommended
6. Remove chicken from refrigerator
7. Line 2 baking sheets with paper towels
8. Mix flour , chili powder and 3 / 4 teaspoon salt in shallow dish
9. Add enough canola oil to 12-inch skillet to reach depth of 1 / 2 inch
10. Heat over medium-high heat to 375f
11. Remove 6 chicken pieces from buttermilk mixture
12. Dip in flour mixture and turn to coat
13. Shake off excess
14. Add chicken , skin side down , to skillet
15. Reduce heat to medium-low
16. Cover , cook until brown , about 12 minutes
17. Turn chicken over
18. Cook uncovered until cooked through , about 5 minutes for breasts and 10 minutes for legs and thighs
19. Transfer to paper towels
20. Repeat with remaining chicken

title: herb vinaigrette dressing
steps:
1. In container with a tight-fitting lid , combine vinegar , chicken stock , lemon juice and seasonings
2. Shake well
3. Add oil and shake again
4. Refrigerate for up to two weeks

title: farmhouse barbecue muffins
steps:
1. Flatten biscuits into 5 inch circles
2. Press each into bottom and sides of greased muffin pan
3. Brown beef and drain
4. Mix other ingredients except cheese and stir
5. Add to meat
6. Pour into muffin pans
7. Sprinkle with cheese
8. Bake at 375 degrees for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown

title: north african vegetable ragout
steps:
1. Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil over medium heat in a deep saute pan or stock pot
2. Add onion and saute until beginning to soften , 2 minutes
3. Add garlic and chiles and saute until fragrant , 30 seconds
4. Add butternut squash and dry spices
5. Saute 2 minutes
6. Add 1 1 / 2 cups chicken stock and tomatoes with juices
7. Bring to a boil and reduce heat and simmer , partially covered , until squash is tender but firm , 15-20 minutes
8. Add chickpeas and 1 teaspoon salt
9. Continue to simmer , 10 minutes
10. Stir in kale and simmer until leaves are wilted and bright green , 2 minutes
11. While the ragout is simmering bring 2 cups chicken stock to a boil in a medium saucepan , add couscous , 1 tablespoon olive oil and 1 teaspoon salt
12. Cover and remove from heat
13. Let sit 5 minutes
14. Fluff with fork
15. To serve , spoon couscous into a bowl or shallow plate , leaving a well in the center
16. Ladle ragout into the center
17. Garnish with fresh cilantro or parsley leaves
18. To make with sausage:
19. As a first step , slice 8 ounces hot italian sausage into 1 / 2 inch pieces
20. Saute in deep saute pan until golden brown on all sides
21. Transfer sausage to a plate lined with a paper towel
22. Pour off all but 1 tablespoon rendered fat
23. Add onion and proceed with instructions above , substituting the sausage fat for the olive oil
24. Return sausage to the ragout with the chickpeas

title: sweet temptations snack mix
steps:
1. Mix together all ingredients
2. Store in an airtight container
3. The measurements don't have to be exact , as long as there are fairly equal amounts of all ingredients

title: stuffed red cabbage leaves  rotkohlrouladen
steps:
1. Clean cabbage , removing the main stem
2. Plunge cabbage in a large saucepan of boiling salted water
3. After 4 or 5 minutes , carefully remove outer leaves
4. Repeat 2 or 3 times or until all leaves have been removed
5. Melt margarine in a small skillet
6. Add half the onion
7. Saute until transparent
8. In a medium bowl , combine breadcrumbs , ground meats , sauteed onion , egg , salt and pepper
9. Divide stuffing into 8 portions
10. Taking 2 cabbage leaves at a time , roll or pound gently to soften ribs
11. Place leaves one inside the other
12. Spread one portion of stuffing over surface , stopping well short of edges
13. Roll leaves up neatly into a little package
14. Repeat with remaining leaves and stuffing
15. Heat fat or shortening in a large skillet
16. Add cabbage rolls
17. Saute gently
18. Add remaining onion and mushrooms , if desired
19. Dissolve flour in stock
20. Add to skillet
21. Cover and cook gently over low heat 40 minutes , stirring occasionally
22. Season with salt and pepper
23. Add half and half
24. Stir to blend
25. Place on a warm serving dish
26. Spoon sauce over cabbage rolls
27. Serve with creamed potatoes and a salad

title: cinnamon swirl coffee cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350
2. Butter and flour the tube pan
3. Make the cake: put the butter and sugar in a bowl and cream together using the electric mixer on medium speed until fluffy , about 5 minutes
4. Scrape down the bowl
5. Add the vanilla and eggs , 1 at a time , beating for 20 seconds after each addition
6. Scrape down the bowl again
7. In another bowl , whisk together the flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
8. Add this mixture to the butter mixture in thirds , alternating with the sour cream
9. Beat for 45 seconds after each addition , and begin and end with the flour mixture
10. Pour the batter into the prepared tube pan
11. Make the syrup: in a small bowl , stir together the melted butter , sugar , and cinnamon
12. Drizzle the syrup over the batter and with the blade of a knife or a skewer , swirl the syrup through the batter
13. Make the streusel: in a bowl , combine the sugar , cinnamon , and pecans
14. With a pastry cutter , cut in the butter , a few pieces at a time , until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs
15. Scatter the streusel over the batter in the pan
16. Bake for 50 to 55 minutes , or until a cake tester inserted in the center comes out clean
17. Remove the pan from the oven to a wire rack to cool for 15 minutes
18. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: sweet and spicy tomato dump chicken   oamc
steps:
1. For immediate cooking: reduce recipe to 4 servings
2. Pre-heat oven to 350f place all ingredients into a large baking dish , turn chicken to coat
3. Bake until chicken juices run clear
4. For freezing: place 1 / 4 ingredients into each 1 gallon freezer bag
5. Lay flat in freezer
6. To thaw and cook: take a bag out of the freezer the night before , make sure the baggie is completely closed
7. Place the bag on a refrigerator shelf to thaw
8. Preheat the oven to 350f empty the contents of the bag into a large baking dish and bake until the juices run clear

title: banana rum cake
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Butter and flour a 9-inch springform cake pan
3. Cream the butter and sugar together using an electric mixer
4. Add in the eggs , one at a time , beating well between additions
5. Mix in the mashed bananas
6. Sift together the baking soda , baking powder , flour and salt
7. Add in half of the flour mixture to the batter
8. Mix well
9. Add in the rum and buttermilk
10. Mix thoroughly
11. Add in the remaining flour mixture
12. Mix well to incorporate thoroughly
13. Fold in the chopped nuts
14. Transfer the batter to cake pan
15. Bake for 1 hour , or until cake tests done
16. Cool for 5 minutes before removing from the pan
17. Finish cooling completely on a wire rack
18. Serve with custard cream on top or icing

title: simple no bake banana cream pie
steps:
1. Line banana slices on the bottom of the graham crust
2. In a large bowl mix the milk and pudding mix until well blended
3. Then add one cup of the whipped topping and stir
4. Pour mixture over the bananas and refrigerate about 3 hours or until set
5. When ready to serve , cover with the remaining whipped topping and drizzle over caramel

title: peanut butter and cream cheese spread
steps: 1. Mix cream cheese and peanut butter together in a medium bowl with electric mixer , until smooth

title: mini vegan wellingtons
steps:
1. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper , spray with non-stick spray and set aside
2. Have a small bowl of water and a clean , floured pastry board ready
3. Chop walnut into very small bits
4. Scrape into large bowl
5. Chop brown rice and chickpeas in food processor until mixture forms a coarse mash
6. Add this to the mixing bowl along with oat bran , spices , soy sauce , mustard and peanut butter
7. Knead together until it holds its shape
8. Unfold the first sheet of puff pastry and roll into a 12x12 square
9. Cut into six rectangles about 6x4
10. Scoop up a handful of the nut loaf mixture and form it into a small rectangular loaf
11. Place in the center of a puff pastry
12. Dip your fingers in the water and lightly wet the top of the loaf
13. Fold the short ends of the pastry over the loaf , then fold up the long edges using some water to seal it shut
14. Place the mini wellington seam side down on the prepared baking sheet
15. Repeat with the other 5
16. Bake at 400f for 25 minutes
17. The crust should be puffed and golden and the inside heated through
18. The wellingtons can be made ahead and refrigerated until it's time to bake

title: apple braid
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Unroll crescent dough and place in bottom of 9x13 inch baker
3. Lightly sprinkle with flour
4. Roll dough until perforations are sealed and dough is flat
5. Peel , core and slice apples
6. Cut into quarters
7. Combine sugar and spices in bowl
8. Add apples and toss lightly
9. Place apple mixture down center of dough , approximately 2-inches wide
10. Cut 10 slits , about 3 / 4 inch wide on each side of dough surrounding apple mixture alternating dough strips from one side to the other
11. Fold ends over to seal
12. Melt butter in micro just until it liquefies
13. Do not boil
14. Brush with butter
15. Bake 30 minutes
16. Cut and serve warm
17. Combine sugar and milk for glaze
18. Stir until smooth
19. Pour over warm braid

title: kid friendly snack mix
steps:
1. Pour all ingredients into large zipper freezer bag and shake well
2. Serve in little zipper baggies for on the go or anywhere

title: kristi s gf old fashioned peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Preheat your lovely oven to 350 degrees f
2. Cream the butter , shortening and sugars together until fats are nice and fluffy
3. Add egg and combine
4. Switch to your paddle attachment and add flours , xanthan gum , salt , baking soda and baking powder a little at a time until combined
5. Dough will be thick ! add peanut butter last and beat until smooth
6. Portion out dough into 1 oz portions
7. Or , if you don't want to break out the scale , make 24 portions
8. Roll portion dough into a ball shape
9. On a plate or in a shallow bowl pour out about 1 / 2 cup granulated sugar
10. Roll the cookie dough balls in sugar until completely coated
11. Add more sugar as needed
12. Put sugared dough balls on an ungreased cookie sheet , leaving ample room for expansion
13. I got about 12 on an airbake sheet
14. Flatten balls with tines of a fork , then turn 90 degrees and do it again to form a criss-cross pattern
15. Bake for 10 minutes , being sure to rotate the cookies at 5 minutes to minimize burning
16. Allow to cool for 2 or 3 minutes on cookie sheet so cookies will set properly
17. Cool and devour

title: easy baked beans  tastes like you slaved for hours
steps:
1. Fry the pan of bacon
2. Remove the bacon and set aside
3. Keep 3 tablespoons of the bacon grease in the pan and saut the onion until soft
4. Add garlic and saut 2 minutes more
5. Cook beans in pot until well heated
6. Add all the ingredients to the beans , including the bacon grease , onion and garlic mixture
7. Blend well
8. Pour into 21 / 2 quart baking dish , or bean pot
9. Add the bacon strips to the top
10. Place in oven and bake at 450f for 30 to 40 minutes
11. If the beans look like they have to much liquid , it is okay--it will thicken as it sits

title: date oatmeal cookies with milk chocolate chips
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cream the shortening , butter and sugar together
3. Add the eggs and vanilla
4. Mix together well
5. Add flour , baking soda , spices and oatmeal
6. Mix in dates and chocolate chips
7. Scoop out a tbsp of dough onto a parchement paper lined cookie sheet
8. Get 2 plates one with a bit of water on it and one with sugar in the raw
9. Dip the bottom of a glass in the water then in the sugar in the raw
10. Press this on top of the cookie just to flatten , repeat with each cookie
11. Bake for 8-10 minutes
12. Option: instead of using milk chocolate chips get a chocolate bar break along the individual lines and lay on a cookie as it comes out of the oven
13. Top with another hot cookie and move to rack to cool

title: belizean baked rice pudding
steps:
1. Cook rice in plain water until rice is very soft
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
3. Drain hot rice and place in bowl
4. While stirring , add all other ingredients
5. Continue stirring until butter is melted and all ingredients are incorporated
6. Pour into pan that you have greased or sprayed with cooking spray
7. Rice mixture should be around 2 inches deep in the pan
8. Bake approximately 60 minutes , or until firm and knife inserted in center comes out clean

title: nell newman s marinated ginger tofu over crispy browned soba noo
steps:
1. Simmer the tofu in the soy sauce with the gingeroot , onion , and the 2 1 / 4 cups of water for 1 hours
2. Allow to marinate for at least 1 hours
3. Or up to 5 hours
4. Preheat the oven to 350
5. Place the red pepper , celery , bok choy , and zucchini in a large , shallow , ovenproof dish and pour the tofu and marinade over them
6. Braise for 30 to 60 minutes
7. , depending on how you like your tofu or how much time you have
8. I usually cook it until the tofu is browned and the sauce is bubbly
9. While the tofu is cooking , place the soba noodles in boiling water with 1 tbls
10. Of sesame oil and cook until al dente
11. Drain and place in nonstick pan over medium-high heat
12. Add the remaining 2 tbls
13. Of sesame oil and spread the noodles so they cover the pan evenly
14. Cook until darkly browned or lightly burned
15. To serve , spoon the tofu mixture over individual portions of the fried noodles

title: roasted winter veggies
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f
2. Cut the carrots , parsnips , sweet potato , and butternut squash in 1 to 1 1 / 4-inch cubes
3. All the vegetables will shrink while baking , so don't cut them too small
4. Place all the cut vegetables in a single layer on 2 baking sheets
5. Drizzle them with olive oil , garlic powder salt , and pepper
6. Toss well
7. Bake for 25 to 35 minutes , until all the vegetables are tender , turning once with a metal spatula
8. Sprinkle with parsley , season to taste , and serve hot

title: blue cheese bacon dressing
steps:
1. In a small bowl , whisk the mayonnaise , sour cream , milk , vinegar , sugar , salt , garlic powder and pepper until blended
2. Stir in the blue cheese , bacon and chives
3. Cover and refrigerate

title: chicken scampi
steps:
1. Cut chicken into 1 inch thick strips
2. In a large skillet , melt the butter with the oil over medium heat
3. Stir in the herbs , garlic and lemon juice
4. Add the chicken and saute about 5 minutes , until just starting to brown
5. Lower the heat and cook for about 10 minutes longer , until the chicken juices run clear
6. Salt to taste
7. Add more oil as needed
8. Serve chicken and sauce over linguine or fettucine noodles

title: bulk kfc original recipe seasoning  copycat
steps:
1. Msg is in the actual original recipe , but may be omitted if necessary
2. Egg white powder is sold in health food stores
3. You may substitute egg white powder with cornstarch
4. Finely grind required herbs and spices separately in a clean spice mill or coffee grinder
5. Use a pepper mill to medium-grind tellicherry peppercorns
6. I recommend mccormick brand tellicherry black pepper and ground ginger , spice islands brand ground sage and cardamom , spice appeal brand ground savory , and williams-sonoma brand ground tahitian vanilla bean
7. Measure the base mixture and 11 secret herbs and spices into a large re-sealable container
8. Break up any clumps using the back of a spoon
9. Seal the container
10. Shake container to mix well
11. Store container sealed and store in a cool dry place
12. When ready to use , measure 1 / 2 level cup of this mixture plus 2 cups unbleached breading flour into a large re-sealable container
13. Seal the container with flour and seasoning
14. Shake well until thoroughly combined
15. Follow link to recipe #393795 for complete brining , preparation and frying instructions
16. Enjoy !

title: carrot raisin bran muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Combine oat bran and baking powder
3. Mix in remaining ingredients
4. Add optional spices to taste--approximately 1 / 2 to 1 teaspoon each , in any combination
5. Pour mixture into 24 muffin tins
6. Bake about 15 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted into muffins comes out clean

title: weight watcher green bean casserole
steps:
1. Boil beans for 10 minutes
2. Drain and place into a 9x13x2 pan
3. Mix oil and seasoning packet , pour over beans and toss to coat
4. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes
5. Sprinkle with cheese
6. Serve immediatly

title: sausage and mushroom breakfast casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Brown and drain the sausage
3. Combine sausage and remaining ingredients in a bowl
4. Line the bottom of a 9x13 pan with the toast
5. Pour the meat and egg mixture over the toast
6. Bake 1 hour uncovered

title: margarita ice cream sandwiches
steps:
1. Place butter , and sugar in a large bowl , and beat with a mixer at medium speed for 5 minutes or until light and fluffy
2. Add egg , 1 tablespoon lime rind , and limejuice , and beat 2 minutes or until well combined
3. Weigh or lightly spoon flour into dry measuring cups , and level with a knife
4. Combine flour , bsking powder , and 1 / 8 teaspoon table salt , and stir with a whisk
5. Add flour mixture to butter mixture , and beat just until combined
6. Divide dough into 2 equal portions , and shape each portion into a 6 inch log
7. Wrap logs individually in plastic wrap , and chill 3 hours or until firm
8. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
9. Cut each log into 16 and place one inch apart on baking sheets lined with parchment paper
10. Sprinkle the cookies evenly with remaining 2 teaspoons lime rind , turbinado sugar , and sea salt
11. Bake 350 degrees for 10 minutes or until edges are lightly browned
12. Cool 2 minutes on pans on a wire rack
13. Remove from baking sheets , and cool completely on wire racks
14. Place vanilla ice cream and sherbet in a medium bowl , and lightly fold and swirl together
15. Scoop 1 / 4 cup ice cream mixture onto bottom of one cookie
16. Cover each sandwich with plastic wrap
17. Freeze for 4 hours or until firm

title: gorp my way
steps:
1. Mix ingredients together
2. Store in a plastic bag

title: spaghetti sauce in the crock pot
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in pan over medium heat
2. Add onions , bell peppers , garlic , and celery cook for 5 minutes
3. Pour into crock pot
4. Add tomato and juice from can , parsley , basil , oregano , rosemary , thyme , bay leaf and honey to crock pot
5. Cook on low for at least 4 hours or 2 hours on high
6. Remove bay leaf
7. Pour ingredients from crock pot into a blender and run until smooth
8. Enjoy

title: fluffy  no bake cheesecake
steps:
1. Beat cream cheese and sugar in a large mixing bowl until well blended
2. Gently stir in whipped topping
3. Spoon into crust
4. Refrigerate 3 hours or until set
5. Serve plain or with pie filling of choice

title: enchiladas
steps:
1. First make the sauce
2. Heat oil in a saucepan
3. Add flour , chilli powder , oregano and cumin and cook over a medium heat , stirring constantly , until golden brown
4. Add garlic and passata and mix to combine
5. Stir the stock into the tomato and chilli mixture and bring to the boil , reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes , or until sauce reaches the required consistency
6. Turn off heat
7. Make the enchiladas
8. Brown the mince in a dry frying pan and then put the mince in a colander to drain off any excess fat
9. In the same pan heat the oil and fry the onion and peppers until soft
10. Return the cooked mince to the pan and add approximately of the sauce and stir to combine the mixture
11. You can add more chilli powder to the meat at this point if you want to spice it up more
12. Add salt and pepper to taste
13. Assemble the enchiladas
14. Divide the meat and sauce mixture equally between the 8 flour tortillas , fold in the sides and secure with a cocktail stick to stop them from unfolding
15. Place in a lightly greased baking tin
16. You can usually only fit four in a tin
17. Use 2 tins or freeze some of the enchiladas
18. Pour the remaining sauce across the middle of the enchiladas and then remove the cocktail sticks
19. Put the grated cheese over the part of the enchiladas covered by the sauce
20. Cover loosely with tin foil and bake in the oven at gas mark 5 for 30 minutes
21. Serve with salad , saffron rice and french stick
22. To freeze individually place each enchilada on a piece of tin foil , add sauce , remove cocktail stick then wrap in the foil and place in the freezer
23. To cook unwrap the enchilada while still frozen and place in a baking tin , let the enchilada defrost and then add grated cheese , cover with foil and cook at gas mark 5 for 30 minutes

title: zesty rice and bean salad
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , whisk together the first 6 ingredients
2. Add rice , beans , green onions , cilantro , and mint
3. Toss ingredients to coat
4. Sprinkle with feta cheese
5. Cover bowl and refrigerate for 1 hour before serving

title: cranberries in port wine sauce
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in saucepan
2. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer for 5-10 minutes till cranberries "pop
3. "
4. Serve warm over turkey or pork !

title: cope s cauliflower casserole
steps:
1. Pour cooked cauliflower in a casserole dish for the oven
2. Mix water , mayo , onion , mustard , and salt with whisk
3. Poor mixture over cauliflower
4. Sprinkle cheese over cauliflower
5. Sprinkle seasoned bread crumbs over top of casserole to cover
6. Heat in a preheated oven at 350 for about 40 minutes depending on your oven
7. Very easy and very good !

title: cheesy potato casserole bread
steps:
1. Grease a deep round or oval 2-quart casserole and set aside
2. In a large mixing bowl , sprinkle the yeast over the milk and let dissolve
3. Add the shortening , egg , salt , pepper , and 1 cup of the flour and beat till smooth , about 2 minutes stir in the remaining 2 cups flour , the potatoes , and cheddar till well blended , scrape the dough in the prepared casserole , cover with plastic wrap , and let rise in a warm area till doubled in bulk , about 40 minutes
4. Preheat the oven to 375f
5. Sprinkle the parmesan evenly , over the top of the dough and bake till golden brown , about 45 minutes
6. Transfer the bread to a wire rack to cool , then cut into slices

title: super moist cake mix lemon pound cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f and grease bundt pan
2. Combine cake mix , pudding mix , eggs , water and oil in large bowl
3. Beat at medium speed with electric mixer for 2 minutes
4. Pour into pan
5. Bake at 350f for 50 to 60 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
6. Cool in pan 25 minutes
7. Invert onto heat resistant serving plate
8. Cool completely
9. For glaze , place frosting in microwave-safe bowl
10. Microwave on high power 10 to 15 seconds
11. Stir until smooth
12. Repeat if necessary
13. Do not over heat
14. Add lemon extract one teaspoon at a time until desired flavor is reached
15. Stir well
16. Drizzle over cake

title: gnocchi in tomato cream sauce
steps:
1. Chop the onion , carrot and celery
2. Melt the butter in a large frying pan or pot and add the onion , carrot and celery
3. Cook until tender , about 10 minutes
4. Preheat oven to 425 fahrenheit
5. Add the tomatoes , including the juice , to the pan along with salt and pepper
6. Simmer for about 30 minutes until thickened
7. Don't forget to stir occasionally
8. Put in the blender and puree
9. Pour it back into the pan , remove from the heat and stir in cream and nutmeg
10. Season to taste
11. Place the gnocchi in a large baking dish and cover with the sauce
12. Bake in preheated oven until very hot and starting to brown on top
13. About 7-10 minutes
14. Serve immediatly , sprinkled with parsley
15. The sauce can be made a day ahead up until adding the cream
16. Only add the cream and bake just before serving
17. This makes a great and very tasty vegetarian dish or side dish
18. I like to make it with spinach gnocchi
19. Serve with bread to mop up the delicious sauce

title: grated carrot and  raw  beet salad
steps:
1. Trim , peel , and grate the carrots and beets
2. Place the rest of the main ingredients , from garlic to black pepper , in a large salad bowl , add the grated carrots and beets , and toss until well combined
3. Add any desired add-ins and toss again
4. Taste , adjust the seasoning , and let stand for 30 minutes , if you can , before serving: the beets and carrots will render juices that will make the salad moister
5. If you don't have that kind of time and the salad does not feel quite moist enough , add a dash of citrus juice , tomato juice , or any sort of juice that may currently reside in the refrigerator door

title: sweet and spicy nuts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f
2. Spray large baking sheet with nonstick spray
3. Melt butter in large nonstick skillet over medium heat
4. Add next 8 ingredients
5. Stir until sugar dissolves , about 1 minute
6. Add all nuts
7. Stir until butter mixture coats nuts thickly , about 2 minutes
8. Spread nut mixture in single layer on prepared sheet
9. Bake until nuts are glazed and deep brown , stirring often , about 25 minutes
10. Cool nuts completely on sheet , stirring occasionally
11. Makes 6 cups

title: fresh clam chowder
steps:
1. Rinse and scrub clams well
2. Soak clams in a large bowl of water with 1 / 4 celsius salt and cornmeal
3. This helps to remove the sand from the clams
4. Combine water , onion , garlic , celery tops , bay leaf and a sprig of thyme & parsley in a soup pot
5. Cover and bring to a boil
6. Add clams and cover again
7. Bring to a boil and let cook 10-15 minutes manipulating the clams every few minutes to ensure they all get hit with the heat so they can open
8. As soon as there are clams that are open wide , remove them with thongs allowing any unopened ones to remain over the heat
9. Discard any clams that do not open as they are not safe to eat
10. Once all clams have been removed , set aside and let them cool enough to be handled
11. While the clams are cooling , strain the broth removing all sediments and set the broth aside in a separate bowl
12. In the soup pot that you used to make the broth , melt the butter over medium-high heat
13. Add potato , celery and carrot plus a pinch of salt and pepper
14. Saute for about 7 minutes and add the wine
15. Once wine is absorbed , add broth back into the pot
16. Add 1 / 2 t
17. Fresh thyme , cover and bring to a boil
18. Let cook until potatoes are tender , about 10-15 minutes
19. While this is boiling , mince the cooled clams that have been removed from the shell
20. When the potatoes are done turn the heat to low-medium , add clams and cream
21. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes
22. Season with salt and fresh pepper to taste
23. Garnish with chopped , fresh parsley and oyster crackers if desired

title: pb j zebra style
steps:
1. Spread desired amount of peanut butter on one slice of bread
2. Spread desired amount of jelly on the other slice of bread
3. Press together and serve
4. I use a sandwich cutter to get the crust off and make it fun for the kids

title: dry barbecue rub
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a bowl
2. Mix well
3. Store in a covered glass container in the fridge , or freeze in a plastic covered freezer-safe container
4. To use
5. Rub all over to coat the beef , pork or chicken
6. Marinate if desired

title: date delight
steps:
1. Boil dates in water with salt
2. Simmer for 3 minutes
3. Add marshmallows
4. Stir til marshmallows are melted
5. Add nuts and allow to cool for 15 minutes
6. Spread half of the oreo crumbs in a 10"x6" dish
7. Spread date mixture over crumbs
8. Top with whipped cream
9. Sprinkle with remaining crumbs
10. Chill for 3-4 hours

title: caulitators cauliflower   low carb mock mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Cut the cauliflower into small pieces , discarding the stems
2. Turn oven on 350 degrees
3. Place cauliflower in a pot with 1 cup chicken broth and bring to a boil
4. Turn heat on low so it simmers until the cauliflower is "mooshy"
5. Place contents of pot into a bowl , add cream cheese , garlic , green onions , parsley and salt
6. Mix with mixer until well blended
7. Place in a 8x8 or small casserole dish
8. Top with cheese
9. Bake in oven for 15 minutes

title: cappuccino cream
steps:
1. Beat cream cheese in large bowl with electric mixer on medium speed until creamy
2. Gradually add coffee and milk , beating until well blended
3. Add dry pudding mix and cinnamon
4. Beat on low speed 2 minutes
5. Let stand 5 minutes or until thickened
6. Gently stir in 2 cups of the whipped topping
7. Spoon into serving bowl or 10 dessert glasses
8. Refrigerate several hours or until ready to serve
9. Top with remaining whipped topping just before serving

title: rhubarb marmalade
steps:
1. Wash rhubarb and cut into 1 inch pieces
2. Cover with sugar and let stand overnight
3. Add remaining ingredients
4. Heat to the boiling point
5. Reduce heat and simmer about 40 minutes or until thick
6. Stir frequently to prevent burning
7. Pour into sterilized jars , seal and cool

title: the best cherry cheesecake
steps:
1. Crust: mix together graham cracker crumbs , sugar and melted butter
2. Press into bottom of 8"x8" pan
3. Bake at 375 degrees for 10 minutes
4. Then cool
5. Filling: cream cheese and vanilla together until light
6. Add whipped topping and milk and beat until well mixed
7. Pour into pan and chill
8. Spread cherry pie filling over cheese layer and chill well

title: chocolate chip cookies with espresso and cinnamon
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray 2 large baking sheets with nonstick spray
3. Whisk flour , cinnamon , baking soda , and salt in medium bowl to blend
4. Using electric mixer , beat sugar , butter , egg , espresso powder , and vanilla extract in large bowl until well blended
5. Beat in dry ingredients
6. Stir in all chocolate chips and walnuts
7. Drop dough by rounded tablespoonfuls onto prepared sheets , spacing 2 inches apart
8. Bake cookies until brown on top but still slightly soft to touch , about 14 minutes
9. Cool on sheets

title: chicken   dumplings
steps:
1. First prepare chicken as desired and set aside
2. In at least a 8-quart pot
3. Add: all ingredientsexcept chicken , corn , peas& biscuits
4. Once the carrots are half done add: chicken , corn , peas
5. Bring pot to a high boil
6. Break each individual biscuits into 5 pieces and drop into pot
7. Be sure to constantly , stop and stir the biscuits so they do not stick to each other , also use a spatula to mix the bottom of pan to prevent the dumplings from burning on the bottom
8. Once you've added your last dumpling continue to stir for 10-15min until each dumpling appears well formed , the broth will start to thicken
9. Be patient ! i will thicken ! may take awhile to get it to a thickness you desire , just continue to stir
10. Once you turn off the stove and let it sit , it will continue to thicken
11. If it gets too thick for your liking add more broth
12. If it's not thick enough add more biscuits
13. If you enjoy a kick to your food add another pinch of crushed red pepper , it's awesome !
14. As always salt and pepper to your taste
15. Enjoy !

title: giardiniera angelina
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and refrigerate in a closed glass container for two days
2. Stir occasionally
3. If you can't locate cracked green olives , you can use regular green olives and crack them the with the bottom of a heavy jar or cup

title: fire n brimstone chilli sauce
steps:
1. Grind all the ingredients , except oil , in a blender
2. Turn into a jar and stir in the oil
3. Store in the refrigerator

title: buckwheat pancakes
steps:
1. In a small bowl , whisk together the egg whites , canola oil and milk
2. In another bowl , combine the flours , baking powder and sugar
3. Add the egg white mixture and the sparkling water and stir until slightly moistened
4. Place a nonstick frying pan or griddle over medium heat
5. When a drop of water sizzles as it hits the pan , spoon 1 / 2 cup pancake batter into the pan
6. Cook until the top surface of the pancake is covered with bubbles and the edges are lightly browned , about 2 minutes
7. Turn and cook until the bottom is well-browned and the pancake is cooked through , 1 to 2 minutes longer
8. Repeat with the remaining pancake batter
9. Transfer the pancakes to individual plates
10. Top each with 1 / 2 cup sliced strawberries and serve immediately

title: leftover thanksgiving dinner sandwich
steps:
1. Smear mayo on both slices of bread
2. Layer turkey , onion , stuffing and havatti cheese on one piece of bread
3. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
4. Top with second piece of bread and butter both top and bottom
5. Place in panini maker and cook until nicely toasted and cheese is melted
6. Place on plate and drizzle with turkey gravy that was warming while sandwich was toasting

title: fruit salad with cannoli cream
steps:
1. Stir the ricotta and 2 tablespoons of cream in medium bowl to blend
2. Using an electric mixer , beat the remaining 1 / 3 cup of cream , powdered sugar , and cinnamon in a large bowl until semi-peaks form
3. Fold the ricotta cream into whipped cream
4. Place in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes to stiffen and yield a creamier filling
5. Toss the strawberries , raspberries , sugar and lemon juice in a medium bowl to combine
6. Let stand until juices form , tossing occasionally , about 15 minutes
7. Add the kiwi
8. Spoon the fruit mixture into 4 dessert bowls
9. Dollop the ricotta cream atop the fruit
10. Sprinkle with the pistachios & / or chocolate chips , if using

title: 20 min  sour cream chicken enchiladas
steps:
1. Heat tortillas in oil and drain
2. Place 1 t of mixture in the middle and roll up -- line them all up in a casserole and when done -- pour what's left over on top and cover with cheese
3. Bake 350 for 20 minutes
4. Top with salsa or any relish you like
5. P
6. S
7. I make my own soup
8. I melt butter or margarine and add enough flour to make a thin paste and some salt and pepper
9. I cook this about 2 min while stirring with a whisk as it thickens
10. Then i add 1 can of beef broth and some powdered chicken stock and when it gets to the consistency i want i add the 2 cans of chicken & the juice , sour cream and some chopped jalapenos
11. After rolling up the tortillas i bake- 5 min before done i top with mexican cheese and some chopped tops of green onion
12. We serve salsa on the side

title: oriental cucumber salad
steps:
1. Place cucumbers in bowl
2. Add salt , toss and chill 1 hour
3. Drain cucumbers and return to bowl
4. Combine remaining ingredients in another bowl
5. Pour over cucumbers and toss to coat
6. Can be prepared 1 day ahead and refrigerated

title: pork and apple casserole
steps:
1. In a large skillet , cook sausage over medium heat until brown
2. Drain
3. Stir in apples , stuffing mix , and dried onion
4. In a smaller bowl , whisk the apple juice and eggs together
5. Add egg mixture to the sausage mixture
6. Toss to coat
7. Transfer mixture to a greased 2-quart square casserole dish
8. Bake , covered , at 400f for 20 minutes
9. Stir stuffing mixture and sprinkle with cheese
10. Bake , uncovered , for 10 minutes or until heated through

title: chard and onion omelet  trouchia
steps:
1. Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a 10-inch skillet , add the onion , and cook over low heat , stirring occasionally , until completely soft but not colored , about 15 minutes
2. Add the chard and continue cooking , stirring occasionally , until all the moisture has cooked off and the chard is tender , about 15 minutes
3. Season well with salt and pepper
4. Meanwhile , mash the garlic in a mortar with a few pinches of salt , then stir it into the eggs along with the herbs
5. Combine the chard mixture with the eggs and stir in the gruyere and half the parmesan
6. Preheat the broiler
7. Heat the remaining oil in the skillet and , when it's hot , add the eggs
8. Give a stir and keep the heat at medium-high for about a minute , then turn it to low
9. Cook until the eggs are set but still a little moist on top , 10 to 15 minutes
10. Add the remaining parmesan and broil 4 to 6 inches from the heat , until browned
11. Serve trouchia in the pan or slide it onto a serving dish and cut it into wedges
12. The gratined top and the golden bottom are equally presentable

title: simple chicken and oat groat soup
steps:
1. Combine 2 1 / 2 c water and groats in a large sauce pan
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat , and simmer 45 mins or until tender
4. Drain
5. Wipe pan with paper towel
6. Heat oil in pan over med-high heat
7. Add onion , celery , and carrot
8. Saute 8 mins or until tender
9. Add zucchini and garlic
10. Saute 2 minutes
11. Add cooked groats , broth , and next 5 ingredients
12. Bring to a boil
13. Reduce heat , and simmer 10 minutes
14. Stir in peas and basil

title: easy to do aebleskiver
steps:
1. Combine cake mix , water , egg and flour
2. Blend on low speed
3. Beat two minutes at medium speed
4. Place a small amount of butter or margarine in each cup of aebleskiver pan
5. Heat pan slightly
6. Fill cups 2 / 3 full with batter
7. Cook until bubbly
8. Turn carefully with fork and finish baking on the other side
9. Remove from pan and place on paper towels
10. Sprinkle confectioners' sugar on top
11. If desired , serve with a favorite strawberry or blueberry sauce

title: banana chocolate chip oatmeal muffins
steps:
1. In one bowl mix all dry ingredients
2. Except chocolate chips
3. Adding softened butter last
4. In another bowl mash bananas until smooth , but not liquidy
5. Add all other wet ingredients to mashed banana bowl
6. Once wet ingredients are thoroughly mixed pour into dry ingredient bowl
7. Stir until completely combined
8. Then fold in chocolate chips
9. Fill pam sprayed muffin cups 2 / 3 way full
10. Bake at 375 for 18 minutes
11. Rotating halfway through
12. Enjoy deliciousness
13. :)

title: white crock pot chili  with tomatillo
steps:
1. Brown the chicken with the garlic and onion
2. Place in crock pot with the all the other ingredients
3. Cook on low for 6 hours
4. Adjust seasoning and serve with chopped cilantro , cheese and tortilla chips

title: garlic   chili prawns
steps:
1. Remove legs and antennaes from prawns
2. In a bowl , mix sprite , rock salt , pepper -- add prawns in the marinade , refrigerate for 30 minutes
3. For the sauce , heat olive oil in a non-stick pan , saute garlic red and green peppers
4. Add oyster sauce , red pepper sauce , honey , vinegar , liquid seasoning , sesame oil , 1 tbsp minced parsley , peppercorn , oregano , curry powder and basil
5. Whisk until well mixed
6. Put in a bowl and set aside
7. In another non-stick pan , heat olive oil
8. Stir fry prawns for a minute , then pour 1 / 2 cup of the marinade
9. Let marinade boil and simmer for 5 minutes
10. Then pour in garlic & chili sauce -- mix well
11. Serve hot !

title: scallops with tarragon butter
steps:
1. In a large nonstick frying pan , heat 1 tablespoon of the oil with 1 / 2 tablespoon of the butter over moderate heat
2. Season the scallops with 1 / 2 teaspoon of the salt and the pepper
3. Put half the scallops in the pan
4. Cook until browned , about 2 minutes
5. Turn and cook until browned on the second side and just done , 1 to 2 minutes
6. Remove
7. Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon oil with 1 / 2 tablespoon of the butter in the pan and cook the remaining scallops
8. Remove
9. Wipe out the pan
10. Put the pan over moderately low heat and add the wine
11. Boil until reduced to approximately 2 tablespoons , 1 to 2 minutes
12. Reduce the heat to the lowest setting
13. Whisk the remaining 4 tablespoons butter into the wine
14. The butter should not melt completely but just soften to form a smooth sauce
15. Add the remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , the lemon zest , and the tarragon
16. Pour the sauce over the scallops

title: butternut squash salad with curry dressing
steps:
1. Cook squash by your favorite method until just tender , not mushy
2. How we cook the squash: preheat oven to 400
3. Peel the squash , then cut in half to remove seeds
4. Cut in 1" slices
5. Spray baking pan with non-stick spray
6. Put slices on pan and spray them
7. Cover tightly
8. Bake 20 minutes until just tender when pierced with a fork
9. Cool squash , and cut into chunks
10. Combine remaining ingredients and toss with squash

title: orange colada from the virgin islands
steps:
1. In a blender combine
2. Cruzan rum , along with pina colada mix , pineapple juice and orange juice
3. Blend in crushed ice , when processed pour into glasses enjoy !

title: ww sour cream muffins 3pts
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 425 degrees f and lightly spray a muffin tin with cooking spray
2. In a large mixing bowl , combine sifted flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt , and
3. Sugar
4. Stir to blend dry ingredients
5. In a small mixing bowl , combine melted margarine , sour cream , egg substitute , and skim milk
6. Blend with a wire whisk until wet ingredients are thoroughly combined
7. Add liquid ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just blended
8. Spoon the batter into the muffin tins , equally distributing the batter to each well
9. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes until the muffins are golden brown
10. Remove the muffin tins to a wire rack and let cool for about 5 minutes
11. Invert tins and completely cool muffins
12. Store in an airtight container for up to 3 days

title: buttery pumpkin cake
steps:
1. Combine the cake mix , 1 egg and 8 tablespoons butter in a bowl
2. Mix well with an electric mixer
3. Pat the mixture into the bottom of a lightly greased 9- by 13-inch baking pan
4. Beat the cream cheese and pumpkin in a large bowl until smooth
5. Add the 3 eggs , vanilla and 8 tablespoons butter , and mix well
6. Stir in the confectioner's sugar , cinnamon and nutmeg
7. Spread the pumpkin mixture over the cake layer
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 40 to 50 minutes
9. Do not over bake , as the center should be gooey

title: potato stuffed meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f degrees
2. Coat loaf pan with olive oil or cooking spray
3. In a medium bowl , combine potato flakes , water , sour cream and parsley flakes
4. Mix well and set aside
5. In a large bowl , combine onion , green pepper , bread crumbs , chili seasoning , and 1 / 3 cup tomato sauce
6. Add to meat
7. Mix well to combine pat half of mixture into prepared loaf pan
8. Spread potato mixture evenly over top
9. Pat remaining meat mixture over potato mixture
10. Stir cheddar cheese and brown sugar into remaining tomato sauce
11. Spoon sauce mixture evenly over top bake for 55-60 minutes
12. Place loaf pan on wire rack and let set for 5 minutes cut and serve

title: authentic mexican   arroz roja
steps:
1. Saute garlic , onions and red chile in oil over medium heat for about 1 minute
2. Add in the rice and stir frequently until rice begins to brown
3. Add in the chicken stock and chile sauce and bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat and bring rice to slow simmer
5. Cook for 18-20 minutes without removing the lid

title: oatmeal honey waffles
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Bake oats in a single layer in a shallow pan 10 minutes or until lightly toasted , stirring after 5 minutes
3. Let cool on a wire rack 10 minutes
4. Process oats in a blender or food processor 30 seconds or until finely ground
5. Sift together flour , baking powder , and salt in a large bowl
6. Stir in ground oats
7. Beat egg whites at high speed with an electric mixer until soft peaks form
8. Whisk together egg yolks , milk , butter , and honey in a medium bowl
9. Gently stir into oat mixture
10. Gently fold in egg whites just until blended
11. Cook batter in a preheated , oiled waffle iron until golden
12. Serve immediately !

title: creamy chicken  basil  and sun dried tomato pasta bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Boil pasta according to package directions
3. Drain and place in baking dish
4. Rinse and pat chicken dry
5. Season both sides with salt and pepper
6. Heat large saute pan over medium heat
7. Add 1 teaspoon olive oil
8. Place chicken in pan , and cook 2 to 3 minutes per side , or until the chicken is browned
9. Remove from pan and place on a cutting board
10. In the same pan , melt butter , and add the rest of the olive oil
11. Add the garlic and onions
12. Cook for about 2 minutes , until the onions are soft
13. Stir in the tomatoes and 3 / 4 cup of the chicken broth or wine
14. Bring to a boil
15. Turn down and let simmer for about 10 minutes
16. Meanwhile , slice the chicken into 1 / 4-inch thick slices and place over pasta
17. Stir in cream and 1 / 2 cup cheese into the tomatoes
18. Simmer over medium heat until the sauce thickens
19. Add the rest of the broth or wine if the sauce gets too thick
20. Stir in basil
21. Add salt and pepper to tast
22. Pour sauce over chicken and pasta
23. Sprinkle with remaining cheese
24. Bake uncovered for about 20 minutes , or until bubbling and golden brown

title: double decker chocolate peanut butter fudge
steps:
1. Line an 8 inch square pan with foil , extending the foil over edges of pan
2. Place peanut butter chips and 2 / 3 cup sweetened condensed milk in a small microwavable bowl
3. Microwave on high 1 to 1 1 / 2 minutes , stirring after 1 minute , until chips are melted and mixture is smooth when stirred
4. Stir in 1 / 2 tsp
5. Vanilla
6. Spread evenly into prepared pan
7. Place remaining sweetened condensed milk and chocolate chips in another small microwavable bowl
8. Repeat above microwave procedure
9. Stir in remaining 1 / 2 tsp
10. Vanilla
11. Spread evenly over peanut butter layer
12. Cover
13. Refrigerate until firm
14. Remove from pan
15. Place on cutting board
16. Peel off foil
17. Cut into squares
18. Store tightly covered , in refrigerator

title: shadows chili con carne
steps:
1. Cut the meat into cubes about 1 / 2 inch square or use ground meat
2. Melt the suet or bacon grease in a large pot or pan with a cover
3. Put the chopped onion and garlic in the pot and brown
4. Mix the chilli powder and flour with enough cold water to form a thin paste , then mix with the onion and garlic after they are browned
5. Stir until smooth
6. Add meats to pan along with 4 tbls water or beer
7. Now add the other herbs , spices and tomatoes
8. Cook slowly for 2 to 4 hours
9. Add liquid as needed to just keep from burning but add as little as possible
10. When cooked serve in a bowl over beans prepared as follows:
11. Pick over the beans and discard any bad ones
12. Soak the beans in water over night or quick soak by covering the beans with water and bringing to a boil
13. Boil 1 minute , cover and let sit for 1 hour
14. Drain off the water and cover with fresh water
15. Add 1 teaspoons of baking soda
16. Add salt pork or bacon and oregano
17. Boil over medium heat for 3 to 4 hours or until tender
18. Add water as water boils away
19. Drain and serve the chilli over the beans
20. I prefer pinto beans in this recipe

title: coconut balls
steps:
1. Melt butter
2. Add marshmallows , cook and stir until melted
3. Remove from heat
4. Add cereal , stir until well coated
5. With buttered hands , shape into 1 inch balls
6. Roll in coconut , press gently to coat

title: low carb egg mcmuffins
steps:
1. Press sausage into 8 muffin tins , pressing up sides and pressing into bottom edges
2. Bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes
3. Break an egg into sausage cups and return to oven for 15 minutes
4. Place 1 / 2 slice american cheese over each cup and return to oven for 1 more minute

title: citrus marinated chuck roast for the grill
steps:
1. Sprinkle roast generously on both sides with salt , pepper and meat tenderizer
2. Mix remaining ingredients
3. Put roast in a large ziplock bag
4. Add marinade
5. Seal and refrigerate at least overnight
6. Grill over medium-hot coals , turning several times and basting with reserved marinade frequently
7. Cook approximately 35-40 minutes , until done to your liking
8. Allow roast to rest for 10 minutes before slicing

title: easy fresh smoothie
steps:
1. Whiz it all together in a blender
2. Serve with a black straw and salty peanuts - my own bizarre preference

title: mexican pizza   retro pizza hut style
steps:
1. Cook chicken , cube and simmer in ortega picante sauce
2. Roll out one can of premade pillsbury pizza dough , bake for five minutes flip dough and bake for five minutes more
3. I like my crust crispy and thin
4. Remove dough from oven spread refried beans onto dough like pizza sauce
5. Top with chicken , onion , and cheese
6. Cook for ten minutes
7. Remove from oven and finish by topping with lettuce , tomatoes , more ortega sauce , and black olives
8. Add sour cream if you need to
9. Slice and enjoy

title: garlic  chickpea and spinach soup
steps:
1. Heat oil and sautee garlic and onion until soft and translucent
2. Stir in the coriander and cumin powders and cook till aromatic
3. Pour in stock and add chopped potatoes
4. Bring to a boil and simmer 10 minutes , add chickpeas and simmer 5 more minutes
5. Blend cornstarch with cream , tahini , cayenne pepper , salt and pepper as desired
6. Stir into the soup along with the spinach
7. Bring to a boil while stirring frequently and let simmer another 2 minutes
8. Serve immediately

title: mushroom tarragon chicken
steps:
1. Dredge chicken in flour mixture and brown on all sides in butter
2. Remove and set aside
3. Add onions , garlic and mushrooms to pan and cook until limp
4. Stir in sugar , tarragon and wine
5. Return chicken
6. Cover and simmer for 25 minutes
7. Mix 1 teaspoon flour with sour cream and pour into pan
8. Stir over med
9. Heat until sauce thickens
10. Sprinkle with green onion

title: kelly s fresh peach cobbler
steps:
1. In large bowl , combine , peaches , cup sugar , and teaspoon cinnamon
2. Set aside
3. Melt butter and pour into an 8 square baking dish or pan
4. In another lg
5. Bowl , whisk together flour , baking powder , salt teaspoon cinnamon , and cup sugar til all mixed
6. Stir in milk and vanilla til just combined
7. Dont over mix
8. Pour batter over butter evenly
9. Top batter evenly with peaches ,
10. Bake at 375 for 45-50 minutes , til top is done
11. 4-6 servings

title: lanell s toll house cookie brittle
steps:
1. Combine first three ingredients and blend well
2. Gradually add sugar and flour
3. Add chocolate chips and 3 / 4 cup of the nuts
4. Press evenly into lightly greased 15 x 10 inch pan
5. Sprinkle with remaining nuts and press lightly
6. Bake at 375 degrees on top rack for 10 minutes
7. Turn off oven and leave in for a remaining 30 minutes

title: authentic buffalo wings
steps:
1. Mix the flour , salt , pepper , and cayenne in a large bowl
2. Run a whisk through the mixture to make it light and fluffy
3. Take the wings and dredge them through the flour mixture
4. Set dredged wings aside as you finish dredging all pieces
5. When you see moisture seeping through the breading , dredge them again
6. Heat the cooking oil to 350f in a large cast iron fryer
7. You will want enough oil to have the wings completely submerge when you place them in the oil
8. Dredge your wings one last time and fry in batches of ten to fifteen wings to an internal temp of 180f
9. Drain wings on a paper towel , or if you can get one , a grocery store paper bag to remove excess oil
10. Mix two sticks of melted butter with two cups of frank's redhot hot sauce or louisiana hot sauce
11. Heat the mixture to a slow simmer
12. Put your wings in a few at a time , and coat well with the hot sauce mixture
13. Serve immediately with bleu cheese or ranch dipping sauce and celery and carrot sticks
14. Enjoy !

title: caribbean grilled scallop salad
steps:
1. Prepare grill to high heat
2. Pat scallops dry with a paper towel
3. Sprinkle 1 1 / 2 teaspoons fish rub evenly over scallops
4. Coat scallops with cooking spray
5. Place scallops on grill rack
6. Grill 3 minutes on each side or until done
7. Remove scallops
8. Add pineapple to grill rack
9. Grill 2 minutes on each side
10. Remove pineapple from grill
11. Chop pineapple
12. Combine salad greens , lettuce , pineapple , and avocado in a large bowl
13. Chop large pieces of chutney
14. Combine chutney , lime juice , olive oil , and remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon fish rub in a small bowl
15. Add dressing to salad , and toss well
16. Place 1 1 / 2 cups salad into each of 4 bowls
17. Arrange 3 scallops over each salad

title: fat free flour tortilla
steps:
1. In large bowl , combine flour , baking powder , and salt
2. Stir well
3. Add fat-free mayonnaise and use pastry blender and blend until flour mixture appears to be coarse throughout
4. Add hot water and stir well
5. Knead in extra flour
6. Cover and allow to stand for 10 minutes
7. Set iron griddle over medium to medium-high heat
8. Tear off a piece of dough , roll into a ball
9. On well-floured board , roll dough out into a circular flat form as thin as possible approximately 6 inches in diameter
10. Add more flour if dough is sticky
11. Place tortilla on heated griddle and allow it to bubble slightly
12. Heat for approximately 1-2 minutes
13. Flip tortilla and brown other side approximately 1 minute longer
14. If tortilla has browned in variable spots and does not have a dough-like texture , then it is done

title: chicken and vegetable curry pie
steps:
1. Peel and dice all vegeatbles
2. Using a large saucepan , bring potatoes , sweet potatoes , pumpkin , carrots , onions and peas to boil in stock
3. Simmer until potatoes are tender
4. In a fry pan heat the oil
5. Add onions and cook until tender
6. Add flour and curry powder to onions and stir through
7. Add the onion mixture to the pot of vegetables and stir through
8. Mixture will start to thicken
9. Add chicken to pot and mix well
10. Place mixture into pie case and cover with puff pastry
11. Glaze with milk and egg mixture to make it brown and crispy
12. Cook for 15-20 minutes until golden brown

title: tonk s chicken and rice
steps:
1. Blend together the two soups in a casserole dish without adding the water or milk indicated in the directions
2. Add chicken and cover with soup , salt over soup to taste
3. Cover and microwave for 26 minutes , stirring at 18 minutes without scrapping the sides
4. Lift chicken and recoat with soup
5. Make rice as per package instructions
6. Plate chicken and rice and scoop soup sauce over both , scraping sides for crust

title: apple butter bars mix   gift in a jar
steps:
1. Mix flour , baking soda , and salt together
2. Cooking instructions: layer ingredients in a jar , in order given
3. Press each layer down before adding next
4. Instructions for apple-butter bars mix:
5. Spoon out nuts
6. Set aside
7. Empty bar mix into a large bowl
8. Add 1 cup melted butter or margarine
9. Mix well
10. Press half of batter into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch greased pan
11. Mix 1 1 / 2 cups apple butter with nuts
12. Spread over batter in pan
13. Add remaining mixture
14. Bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for 50-60 minutes or until browned

title: cabbage in milk
steps:
1. Heat milk in saucepan over medium heat
2. Add cabbage and zest to milk
3. Cook about 5 minutes , depending on how firm you like it
4. Stir occasionally
5. Remove from heat , stir in butter , salt and pepper
6. The type of pepper you use is for your choice
7. I have tried , fresh black pepper and chili pepper
8. Didn't care for the chili one

title: sesame linguine
steps:
1. Cook the pasta according to the package directions
2. Drain
3. Rinse the pasta with cold water , and drain again
4. Place the pasta in a large bowl
5. Combine the sesame oil and the next 3 ingredients
6. Stir well
7. Stir in the watercress
8. Pour this mixture over the pasta , and toss gently
9. Add the salt and pepper to taste
10. Cover and chill for 8 hours
11. Sprinkle with the green onions just before serving

title: peking duck
steps:
1. Wash& dry the duck inside and out
2. Rub salt into the cavity
3. Put duck on a large plate spoon the vodka over the duck& rub all over , turn the duck and make sure you rub the vodka all over the bird leave it for 4 hours
4. Dissolve the honey in the water and rub all over the duck
5. Do not miss any area truss the bird and tie a cord around it's neck and hang it in front of an electric fan leave it to dry for at least 4 hours
6. Preheat oven to 375f
7. Place the ginger inside the duck
8. Place duck on a rack in a pan with water in it
9. The duck must be well above the water
10. Cook for 30 minutes then turn heat down to 300f degrees and continue roasting for about 1 hour
11. Turn heat up to 375f and continue roasting until skin is crisp and brown all over

title: joel s jerk chicken pineapple pasta
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat
2. Cook and stir chicken until no longer pink and juices run clear , 7 to 10 minutes
3. Stir in the pineapple and its juice , coconut , brown sugar , jerk seasoning , cinnamon , chili powder , red pepper flakes , salt and pepper
4. Reduce heat to low and simmer 15 minutes
5. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil
6. Add pasta and cook until al dente , 8 to 10 minutes
7. Drain
8. Toss chicken mixture with drained pasta

title: potato hominy soup
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a medium-sized pot , and saute onion and garlic for 3 minutes
2. Add the cumin , stir well , then add the potatoes and green chilies
3. Cook over medium heat , stirring occasionally , another 5 minutes
4. Add the vegetable broth and hominy
5. Simmer the soup , covered , over low heat for 45 minutes
6. Stir in the cilantro and serve hot

title: harvest chowder
steps:
1. Fry bacon in heavy stock-pot
2. Remove , drain , crumble , then set bacon aside
3. Saute onion , celery , and carrots in stockpot in a small amount of reserved bacon fat
4. Add mushrooms and zucchini and continue sauteeing for 2 minutes
5. Add water
6. Cover stock pot and simmer until vegetables are tender
7. Add corn , peas , mashed potatoes , and milk and heat through
8. Add cheese and stir until melted
9. Season , and serve hot

title: sour cream cornbread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Spray 8-inch square casserole dish with non-stick cooking spray
3. Mix all ingredients together
4. Pour into prepared pan
5. Bake on shelf in lower 1 / 3 of oven for 25-30 minutes or until set in the middle and lightly browned on the top
6. Cut into nine squares

title: best homemade mac n cheese ever
steps:
1. Boil macaroni according to package directions
2. Cheese sauce
3. Melt butter in saucepan over low heat
4. Add flour gradually while whisking and cook for 1 minute , still whisking
5. Add a small amount of milk to start the sauce then add all the spices
6. Keep on whisking while adding the rest of the milk
7. Turn up the heat to high or medium high depending on your stove , just be careful not to scorch the sauce
8. The more you whisk , the creamier the sauce will be
9. As sauce approaches a boil , begin to whisk in cheese one handful at a time , ensuring all cheese is melted before adding another
10. Take off the heat and whisk vigorously one last time
11. Pour over cooked macaroni in 13x9 pan and stir together
12. The last 1 / 2 cup of sauce may be too much depending on type and amount of pasta
13. Sprinkle additional cheese over the top if desired
14. Microwave on 70% power for 15:00 minutes or until set
15. If you prefer baking , it comes out well at 350 after about 30-35 minutes

title: twice baked ham and cheese potatoes
steps:
1. Bake potatoes at 400 degrees fahrenheit for 1 hour until soft
2. Slice potatoes in half lengthwise
3. Scoop out insides , leaving a firm shell
4. Place potato pulp , cheddar cheese , milk , ham , sour cream , onion salt , pepper , and butter in a mixing bowl
5. Beat at high speed until smooth
6. Fill potato shells with mixture
7. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 20 to 30 minutes
8. Garnish with paprika or parsley

title: meat   veggie sloppy joes oamc
steps:
1. Heat saucepan over medium heat while preparing veggies
2. Spray with cooking spray and add carrots , celery and onion
3. Saute for 3-4 minutes then add ground hamburger & chopped bell pepper
4. Cook over medium high heat until veggies are tender and meat is browned
5. Drain , if needed
6. Return to medium heat and add mamwhich , bring to boil then reduce heat , cover and simmer for 30-40 minutes until veggies are completely cooked through and sauce is desired thickness
7. If you are in a rush , you can simply serve when hot or you could put into crockpot until serving
8. Store in fridge in covered container or freeze
9. Can be re-heated in microwave and stovetop

title: omm  ali  egyptian bread and butter pudding
steps:
1. Dry the roqaq or gullash , 1-2 sheets at a time , for 1-2 minutes in a hot oven , enough to make them dry and crisp
2. Crush with fingers and place in lightly greased oven dish
3. Mix nuts and coconut , and scatter on top
4. Warm the sweetened milk and pour over the dessert
5. Dab with butter or cream , and placed in moderately hot oven until top is browned

title: brazilian mocha
steps:
1. Stir the coffee and the chocolate in the top of a double boiler over direct heat until the chocolate is melted and completely blended into the coffee
2. Mix in a few grains salt and the sugar
3. Boil for 4-5 minutes , stirring constantly
4. Place the top of the double boiler over hot water in the bottom
5. Gradually mix in the scalding milk
6. When the mixture is near the boiling point , beat with an electric mixer until light and frothy
7. Pour into 4 cups or mugs and top with whipped cream if desired

title: tea room scones
steps:
1. Cut butter into flour , sugar and baking powder
2. Mix together egg , half n half and vanilla
3. Blend wet ingredients with dry ingredients
4. Place on floured board , knead ten times
5. Pat out and cut with a floured biscuit cutter or glass
6. Place on baking sheet and brush with a mixture of half n half and vanilla over tops
7. Bake at 350 degrees till brown on top and bottom like biscuits 15 - 20 minutes

title: spinach with ground beef
steps:
1. Saute the onion with olive oil and butter for about 2-3 minutes on medium heat in the medium sized pot
2. Then add the ground beef , salt and pepper , then stir
3. Cook together until the colour of the ground beef turns to light brown
4. Add the rice , tomato , red pepper paste and crushed tomato , stir again
5. Place the spinach all over and close the lid
6. Cook on medium heat until the rice is tender without adding water
7. Place the dish in a service plate and put a couple of spoons of garlic yogurt sauce over the top

title: titus chan s char siu bao
steps:
1. To make dough: dissolve sugar in warm water
2. Add yeast
3. Let stand 10 minutes as yeast foams and rises
4. Sift flours together twice
5. Place in a large bowl
6. Add shortening , then slowly add the yeast mixture , incorporating it into the flour gradually
7. Form into a ball
8. Turn onto a floured surface and knead 5 to 7 minutes , until smooth and elastic
9. Add more flour or water if necessary
10. Place in a clean bowl and cover with a damp cloth
11. Let rise in a warm place for 2 to 4 hours , until at least doubled in bulk
12. To make filling: heat vegetable oil in a wok
13. Add remaining ingredients , except the cornstarch slurry , and stir-fry until hot
14. Bring to a boil , then stir in slurry to thicken
15. Cool
16. To assemble bao: remove warm dough from bowl and knead on a floured surface 5 to 7 minutes , adding more water if too dry , or more flour if too wet
17. Form into a long roll and divide into 24 equal portions
18. Lightly oil a chinese knife or cleaver
19. Place a section of dough cut-side down on a flat surface and pound with the flat side of the knife
20. Then press down on the dough with the knife and turn the knife clockwise to form the dough into a thin circle , about three inches in diameter
21. Use the knife to lift the dough and place it in your hand
22. Place a heaping tablespoon of filling into the circle , gather up the edges and pinch closed in the center
23. Place on a square of paper
24. Let filled buns rise in a warm place 15 minutes
25. Oil steamer baskets and arrange buns 1 / 2-inch apart
26. Fill a wok 75 percent with water and bring water to a boil
27. Steam buns 15 minutes over high heat
28. If buns are in two stacked trays , switch the trays midway
29. Serve hot

title: barbacoa
steps:
1. Cut the tomatoes by half
2. Cut the potatoes by half
3. In a pressure dale , add the potatoes , tomatoes , onion , broth , water , salt , rice , chilies chickpeas
4. Add the nopal leaves like if you were covering the ingredients , like a cap
5. Then add the lamb leg , it wont fit so cut it in pieces , if you cut it cut it in big pieces
6. Put it on the fire for about 45-60 minutes
7. Check the meat if it is very well cooked
8. In mexico this is a very traditional plate , so people eat it in corn tortillas , with salsa , and some drops of lime juice
9. After you take the nopal leaves , and the lamb out of there , you'll see that looks like a soup but very greasy , so you can take the grease out with a spoon , and serve it , without the chillies , the tomato , and the potatoes
10. Add some lime juice and enjoy it

title: lamb with bell peppers  agnello con peperoni
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 425f
2. When the oven has reached temperature , cut peppers in quarters and lay them skin side up on a foil-covered baking sheet
3. Place in the oven and roast until the skins are blackened , about 15-20 minutes
4. Meanwhile , heat the oil in a large heavy-bottomed pot over moderate heat
5. Add garlic cloves and saute until they turn golden
6. Remove them and discard
7. Increase the heat slightly , then add the lamb to the pot and saute until all the pieces are well browned
8. Add the white wine and continue to cook until the alcohol has cooked off , about 5 minutes
9. Add the tomatoes , salt and pepper and cook for 10 minutes at a strong simmer and stirring often
10. Your liquid should be cooking down , but not completely disappearing
11. At this point , add enough boiling water just to cover the mixture
12. Cover the pot , and simmer for 20 minutes , or until the meat becomes tender
13. Remove peppers from the oven and place in a paper bag , or a bowl covered by a plate and allow to rest 10-15 minutes
14. After this time , carefully remove the skins from the peppers , as well as seeds and stems
15. Cut each quarter into three strips , and set aside
16. When the lamb is cooked , add the pepper strips to the pot and continue to cook only just until the peppers are warmed through and the sauce has considerably reduced
17. Check seasoning and add more if desired
18. Serve and enjoy

title: peach butter pecan dessert
steps:
1. Pour the peaches and juice of two cans in a 9x13 pan
2. Sift the cake mix over the peaches
3. Pour the melted butter over the cake mix
4. Pour the peaches and juice of third can on top of butter and cake mix
5. Sprinkle the coconut and nuts on top
6. Bake at 350 degrees f for 40 minutes or until brown and bubbling

title: katrina s broccoli casserole
steps:
1. Cook frozen broccoli according to package directions and drain
2. Grease a 2 quart casserole dish , and preheat the oven to 350 degrees
3. Mix the soup and the milk in a bowl
4. Layer the casserole dish in this order:
5. Bottom layer:
6. 1 / 2 broccoli
7. 1 / 2 soup mixture
8. 5 teaspoons pats of butter on top
9. Salt & pepper to taste
10. 1 / 2 cheddar cheese
11. 1 / 2 crushed ritz crackers
12. Top layer:
13. 1 / 2 broccoli
14. 1 / 2 soup mixture
15. 1 / 2 cheddar cheese
16. Salt & pepper to taste
17. 1 / 2 crushed ritz crackers
18. 5 teaspoons pats of butter on top
19. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 30 minutes

title: beef stroganoff with cremini   porcini mushrooms
steps:
1. Combine the beef broth and dried porcini in a small saucepan
2. Bring to a boil , remove from heat , cover , and let steep for 30 minutes
3. With a slotted spoon , lift the porcini out of the broth , chop coarsely and set aside
4. Strain the broth through a sieve and set aside
5. Heat 1 tbsp of the oil and the butter in a large skillet over medium high heat
6. When the oil is hot , add the cremini mushrooms and saute , stirring often until they are browned , 5- 6 minutes
7. Transfer to a bowl
8. Season the beef strips generously with kosher salt and pepper and dredge in the flour
9. Add 2 tbsp oil to the pan and heat over medium-high heat
10. When oil is hot , add the beef , spreading it in a single layer
11. After about a minute , turn each piece to brown the other side
12. Don't overcook !
13. Work quickly , the whole process only takes a couple of minutes
14. Remove beef to the same bowl with the cremini
15. Melt the remaining 3 tbsp butter in the pan over medium-high heat
16. Add the onion
17. Saute , scraping up the browned meat bits at the bottom of the pan
18. When the onions just start to brown , pour in the reserved porcini soaking broth
19. Stir in the mustard , worcestershire sauce , porcini , cremini and beef , along with any accumulated juices
20. Bring to a simmer while stirring
21. Cook just until the sauce thickens slightly , 1- 2 minutes
22. Reduce heat to low and stir in the creme fraiche , just until it's incorporated and heated through
23. Taste , and adjust seasonings
24. Serve over cooked noodles , sprinkled with parsley

title: homemade pancake mix
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine the first five ingredients
2. Store in an airtight container in a cool dry place for up to 6 months
3. Yield: 6-7 batches of pancakes
4. To prepare pancakes: in a bowl , combine egg and milk
5. Whisk in 1 cup pancake mix
6. Pour batter by 1 / 4 cupfuls onto a lightly greased hot griddle
7. Turn when bubbles form on top of pancakes
8. Cook until second side is golden brown
9. Yield: about 6 pancakes per batch
10. To prepare blueberry banana pancakes: in a bowl , combine egg , milk and banana
11. Whisk in 1 cup pancake mix
12. Fold in blueberries
13. Cook as directed above
14. Yield: about 8 pancakes per batch
15. Yield: about 6 pancakes per batch

title: chicken picquant
steps:
1. Dredge chicken breasts in flour and saute for 3-4 minutes on each side in oil until lightly browned
2. Arrange chicken breasts in a casserole dish and bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes
3. While chicken is baking , melt butter in a large skillet
4. Add onion , green pepper , garlic , jalapeno and celery
5. Saute until softened
6. Add crushed tomatoes , chicken broth and all of the spices
7. Simmer for 10 minutes
8. When chicken has baked for 20 minutes , pull from the oven and cover with the picquant sauce
9. Bake for an additional 10-15 minutes
10. Serve with yellow rice

title: tea chiller to knock you off your feet
steps:
1. Mix tea and peaches in the blender
2. Pour into a glass and enjoy !
3. You may love this so much that you may never drink hot tea again

title: smoking hot chili
steps:
1. In a skillet , fry bacon until brown
2. Drain and place in the slow cooker
3. Remove all but a small amount of fat from skillet and saute onions until slightly brown
4. Place onions in slow cooker
5. Cut pork loin and sirloin
6. Drain off fat and add meat to slow cooker
7. Add remaining ingredients except cheese
8. If you choose to use dried pinto beans , soak in water overnight , discard water , add beans to slow cooker and stir
9. Set cooker on low and cook for 6 to 8 hours
10. Meat should be very tender
11. Taste and adjust seasonings
12. If desired , sprinkle with cheese before serving

title: tipsy cake  trifle    1950 s
steps:
1. Place the milk and cream into a bowl and set over simmering water and heat until just on the cusp of boiling
2. Meanwhile whisk together eggs , sugar , cornflour and vanilla
3. Pour hot milk on to the eggs and whisk well
4. Return the bowl to the soft heat of the simmering water and stir constantlyu , but gently for 3 to 4 minutes
5. The custard is ready when it has thickened to a smooth , velvety consistency , do not allow it to boil , remove from the heat and place a piece of cling film on the surgace of the custard to stop a skin forming and chill until required
6. To assemble the trifle , using a retty bowl arrange sponge cake in the base and sprinkle with brandy , then top with half the cherries and a thin layer of cream
7. Form another thin layer of cake cubes , sprinkle with brandy , then top with jelly and half the custard
8. Add to the custard the remaining cherries , another splash of brandy and top with any remaining custard and cream
9. Decorate with cubes of cut jelly

title: italian sausage stew
steps:
1. In lg skillet over med heat , brown sausage
2. Add wine , oil , onions and garlic
3. Cook 5 minutes
4. Add basil , oregano , red pepper flakes , both cans of tomatoes , and potatoes
5. Bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat , cover and simmer for 20 minutes
7. Stir in parsley and salt

title: dagwood burgers
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except salt , pepper and buns in a very large bowl
2. Form into 12 to 15 patties
3. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
4. Place on a charcoal grill or in a skillet over medium heat
5. Cook burgers to desired doneness
6. Serve on buns , garnished as desired

title: patty melt with grilled onions
steps:
1. Arrange onion slices on a plate
2. Drizzle vinegar over onion slices
3. Heat a large grill pan over medium heat
4. Coat pan with cooking spray
5. Add onion to pan
6. Cover and cook 3 minutes on each side
7. Remove from pan
8. Cover and keep warm
9. Heat pan over medium-high heat
10. Coat pan with cooking spray
11. Divide beef into 4 equal portions , shaping each into a 1 / 2-inch-thick patty
12. Sprinkle patties evenly with salt and pepper
13. Add patties to pan
14. Cook 3 minutes on each side or until done
15. Spread about 1 teaspoon mustard blend over 4 bread slices
16. Layer each slice with 2 tablespoons cheese , 1 patty , 2 onion slices , and 2 tablespoons cheese
17. Spread about 1 teaspoon mustard blend over remaining bread slices
18. Place , mustard side down , on top of sandwiches
19. Heat pan over medium heat
20. Coat pan with cooking spray
21. Add sandwiches to pan
22. Place a cast-iron or other heavy skillet on top of sandwiches
23. Press gently to flatten
24. Cook 3 minutes on each side or until bread is toasted

title: rice balls
steps:
1. Cook sausage meat , chop meat and onions
2. Drain grease
3. Add peas and tomato paste
4. Add cheese
5. Mix with cooked rice
6. Shape into balls
7. Dip in egg
8. Roll in bread crumbs
9. Deep fry till brown 2-3 at a time
10. Drain on paper towel

title: millionaire pound cake
steps:
1. Freheat the oven to 300 degrees
2. Grease a 10-inch tube pan with butter , dust the bottom and sides with flour , and set aside
3. In a large mixing bowl , cream the butter and sugar with an electric mixer and add the eggs one at a time , beating after each addition
4. Alternately add the flour and milk , stirring till the batter is smooth
5. Add the two extracts and stir till well blended
6. Scrape the batter into the prepared pan and bake till a cake tester or knife blade inserted in the center comes out clean , about 1 1 / 2 hours
7. Cool the cake in the pan on a rack for 5 minutes , then turn it out on the rack to cool completely

title: green beans with balsamic shallot butter
steps:
1. Combine vinegar and shallots in heavy small saucepan
2. Boil over medium heat until most vinegar is absorbed , stirring frequently , about 6 minutes
3. Transfer mixture to small bowl
4. Cool completely
5. Add butter
6. Mix with fork until blended
7. Cook beans in large pot of boiling salted water until crisp-tender , about 6 minutes
8. Drain
9. Refresh under cold water
10. Drain
11. Pat dry with paper towels
12. Combine beans and balsamic-shallot butter in large nonstick skillet
13. Toss over medium heat until beans are heated through , about 5 minutes
14. Season to taste with salt and pepper and serve

title: sassy s pork schnitzel
steps:
1. Pound cutlets to 1 / 4 inch thin
2. Mix flour , salt and pepper , and coat meat
3. Combine egg and milk , and dip cutlets into this mixture , and then in the breadcrumbs that have been mixed with the paprika
4. In a large skillet , add 2 tbsp oil , and brown the pork for 3 minutes on each side
5. Remove from skillet and put in warm oven
6. Pour the broth into the skillet , scraping to loosen the drippings
7. Blend the flour and the dill into the sour cream
8. Stir the sour cream into the broth and mix well and cook until thick
9. Serve with cutlets

title: blueberry crepes  diabetic
steps:
1. Reserve crepes
2. Combine cornstarch , sugar replacement , salt , milk , lemon juice and vanilla in saucepan
3. Cook and stir over medium heat until slightly thickened
4. Remove from heat
5. Crush 1 cup of the blueberries and add to cream mixture
6. Return to heat , and cook and stir until thickened
7. Cool
8. Fold in remaining blueberries
9. Divide evenly between crepes , and fold or roll the crepes
10. Top each with heaping 1 tablespoon topping
11. Exchange 1 serving: 1 / 2 bread 1 / 2 fat

title: cheesy potato casserole  crockpot
steps:
1. Lightly butter the inside of your crockpot
2. Combine soup , sour cream , onion , 1 / 4 c butter and seasonings in crock pot
3. Add potatoes and cheese , mix well
4. Cover mixture with dry stuffing mix and drizzle with the remaining 3 t of butter
5. Cook on low for 4-6 hours or on high for 2 hours
