6. Do not stir while cooking
7. You can make a complete meal by adding cubed ham , frozen mixed veggies , and an extra can of soup

title: crock pot smokey black beans
steps:
1. Soak beans over night
2. Drain the black beans from their soaking water and place in a slow cooker
3. Fill with enough fresh water to cover them
4. Cover and set to high
5. Cook bacon in a skillet over medium heat until fat is rendered
6. Add onions
7. Cook and stir until onions are tender
8. Stir this into the beans along with the brown sugar , liquid smoke , molasses and jalapeno
9. Stir to blend , then cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours , or until beans are tender

title: creamy cheesy chili potato casserole
steps:
1. Layer sliced potatoes , chili , cubed cream cheese , cream of mushroom soup , and cheddar cheese in a greased casserole dish
2. Repeat layers
3. Bake covered in a 350 degree oven for 1 1 / 2 hours
4. Top with additional cheddar cheese and bake uncovered for 10 minutes
5. Allow casserole to set for 20 minutes and serve

title: tuscan white bean soup with ham and kale
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat
2. Add ham , onion and garlic and cook 3 minutes , until onion is tender
3. Add sage and cook 1 minute , until sage is fragrant
4. Add broth and beans and bring to a simmer
5. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer 10 minutes
6. Add kale and cook 1 minute , until kale wilts
7. Season to taste with salt and pepper

title: lower fat cream cheese and ricotta stuffed mushrooms
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix cream cheese , ricotta and garlic
3. Spoon cheese mixture into mushroom caps
4. Sprinkle shredded cheese on top
5. Bake for 10 minutes , or until shredded cheese is well melted
6. I suggest putting aluminum foil on a cookie sheet for easy clean-up , since the cheese may ooze over a bit

title: smoky grilled asparagus
steps:
1. Light a grill
2. In a shallow dish , whisk the mayo with the oil , lemon juice , garlic , paprika , salt and cumin
3. Add the asparagus and toss
4. Let stand for 30 minutes
5. Grill the asparagus over moderately high heat , turning , until tender and blistered in spots , about 6 minutes
6. Serve warm

title: grilled creole mustard ginger glazed salmon
steps:
1. Salmon:
2. Heat your grill to medium-high heat
3. Lightly coat your salmon with a little olive oil and lightly season with salt and pepper
4. Start cooking your salmon with the inner side down
5. Grill over medium-high heat for 2 minutes , then rotate 45 degrees and sear for 2 more minutes
6. Flip fillets and finish grilling
7. After 2 minutes turn fillets 45 degrees , then grill 2 minutes more until they are medium-rare
8. One minute before removing from the grill , spoon 1-2 tbsp of the creole mustard-ginger glaze over the crosshatched fillets
9. Glaze:
10. Combine all ingredients in a small mixing bowl until well blended
11. Makes 1 / 2 cup

title: goat s cheese and tomato salad wraps
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine all ingredients except tortillas
2. Divide mixture evenly between the 4 wraps , and enjoy !

title: oriental potato and beef soup
steps:
1. Put the vegetable oil in a soup pot
2. Add meat and brown
3. Add potatoes and beef broth
4. Bring to a boil
5. Cover
6. Simmer 15 minutes until potatoes are tender
7. Add scallions , soy sauce , and sesame oil
8. Simmer 5 more minutes

title: dried cherry and almond cookies with vanilla icing
steps:
1. For the cookies: in a large bowl , with an electric mixer , beat the butter , sugar , vanilla extract , almond extract , cinnamon , and salt until light and fluffy , about 2 minutes , then beat in the egg
2. Add the flour and beat on the lowest speed until just blended
3. Using a wooden spoon , stir in the dried cherries and almonds
4. Transfer the dough to a sheet of plastic wrap and shape it into a log , about 12-inches long and 1 1 / 2-inches in diameter
5. Wrap the dough in the plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours
6. Arrange an oven rack in the center of the oven
7. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
8. Line 2 heavy baking sheets with parchment paper
9. Cut the log crosswise into 1 / 2-inch thick slices
10. Transfer the dough slices to the prepared baking sheets , spacing them about 1-inch apart
11. Bake until the cookies are golden around the edges and puffed , about 15 minutes
12. Transfer the cookies to a wire rack to cool completely before icing , about 30 minutes
13. For the icing: put the powdered sugar in a medium bowl
14. Gradually whisk in the vanilla extract and water , adding more water , 1 teaspoon at a time , until the mixture becomes a drizzling consistency
15. Put the cooled cookies on a wire rack set over a baking sheet
16. Using a spoon or a fork , drizzle the cookies with the icing , allowing any excess icing to drip onto the baking sheet
17. Allow the icing to set before serving , about 1 hour
18. Cook's
19. Bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven for 6 to 8 minutes until lightly toasted
20. Cool completely before using
21. Cook's
22. Also , use 1 teaspoon vanilla extract and omit the almond extract

title: bird s orange chipotle bbq sauce
steps:
1. Using a small food processor or an immulsion blender , mix all ingredients well
2. Simmer over low heat in a small saucepan until reduced and thickened to your liking , about 20-30 minutes
3. Grill chicken , pork , ribs , or even burgers
4. Brush with sauce the last 5-10 minutes of cooking

title: gooey rolls
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Coat 8 muffin cups with pam
3. Mix sugar and cinnamon in small bowl
4. Dip each marshmallow in melted margarine and roll in sugar mix
5. Separate dough into triangles
6. Wrap one triangle around each marshmallow and pinch dough together
7. Place each one in a muffin cup
8. Drizzle extra margarine over rolls
9. Bake 8-12 minutes

title: broccoli lasagna bianca
steps:
1. In medium bowl , combine ricotta cheese , egg substitute and dried basil
2. Set aside
3. In large saucepan , over medium heat , saute onion and garlic in margarine until tender-crisp
4. Stir in flour
5. Cook for 1 minute
6. Gradually stir in milk
7. Cook , stirring , until mixture thickens and begins to boil
8. Remove from heat , stir in broccoli and mozzarella cheese
9. In lightly greased 13x9x2 inch baking dish , place 3 lasagna noodles
10. Tops with 1 / 3 each ricotta and broccoli mixtures
11. Repeat layers 2 times
12. Top with tomato
13. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese
14. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour or until set
15. Let stand 10 minutes before serving

title: caramelized onion  gruyere  and spinach crustless quiche
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. With a little canola oil in a frying pan over medium high heat caramelize the onions , stirring occasionally
3. This takes about 15-20 minutes
4. Squeeze the moisture out of the thawed spinach by wrapping it in a dish towel and squeezing
5. Beat the eggs and add the milk and whisk well
6. Season the egg mixture with salt and pepper and a few grinds of fresh nutmeg
7. Spray or wipe oil all over a deep pie dish
8. When the onions are well caramelized , place evenly over bottom of pie dish then evenly spread the spinach over the onions and follow up with the cheese
9. Pour the egg mixture over the top and pop into the oven
10. Bake until firm in the middle , about 40-45 minutes
11. Serve with fresh fruit and popovers hot from the oven !

title: pumpkin crisp plus lower fat variations
steps:
1. Mix together
2. Evaporated milk , pumpkin , eggs , sugar , cinnamon
3. Pour into a greased 9x13 pan
4. Sprinkle cake mix over top
5. Melt butter
6. Pour slowly over top of cake mix
7. Checker pattern works well
8. Cook 1 hour @ 350 degrees
9. Cool 2 hours before icing
10. Mix with a mixer , cool whip , cream cheese , and powdered sugar until smooth
11. Spread on top
12. Optional topping- pecans , or walnuts
13. Refrigerate
14. Not as good if made ahead of time
15. The cake mix becomes soft
16. Best the same day
17. Or make the night before
18. Less fat variations

title: coconut pralines
steps:
1. Mix together butter , sugar and flour until crumbly
2. Press evenly in the bottom of a 9"x9" baking pan
3. Bake in pre-heated 375 degree oven for 10 minutes
4. Remove from oven and lower temperature to 350 degrees
5. Mix filling ingredients until well blended
6. Spread over partially baked crust and bake at 350 for 30 minutes or until nicely browned
7. Cool before cutting into squares

title: pistachio orange asparagus
steps:
1. Steam asparagus until crisp tender and keep warm
2. In a skillet over medium-high heat , cook nuts in butter for 3-4 minutes until lightly browned
3. Add orange juice and orange peel and heat through
4. Pour over the asparagus and sprinkle with a dash of pepper
5. Garnish with orange slices

title: ww 6 points   sweet and sour pork
steps:
1. Combine the pork with 1 tablespoon of the cornstarch in a medium bowl
2. Toss well to soat and set aside
3. Combine the remaining 1 tablespoon cornstarch , the water , vinegar , sugar , ketchup , and soy sauce in a small bowl
4. Set aside
5. Heat a nonstick wok or a large , deep skillet ower medium-high heat until a drop of water sizzles
6. Swirl in the oil , then add the pork
7. Stir-fry until almost cooked through , 2-3 minutes
8. Add the ginger and garlic
9. Stir-fry until fragrant , about 30 seconds
10. Add the bell pepper and pineapple
11. Stir-fry until crisp-tender , about 3 minutes
12. Add the vinegar mixture and cook , stirring constantly , until the mixture boils and thickens and the pork is cooked just through , 1-2 minutes

title: bar  cheese
steps:
1. In a large sauce pan over low heat , melt the velveeta
2. Add the jar of horseradish and mix
3. Allow this to heat on low for 15 minutes , stirring often
4. Add the mayo , worcestershire , and tabasco
5. Mix and allow to heat another 10 minutes , stirring often
6. Cool slightly and pour into 4 or 5 containers
7. Refrigerate
8. Serve on your choice of crackers

title: spicy spaghetti chicken
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti
2. Sprinkle chicken with cajun seasoning
3. Coat skillet with non stick cooking spray
4. Cook chicken in skillet until lightly browned and juices run clear , about 7 minutes
5. Remove chicken from skillet and keep warm
6. In the same skillet saute mushrooms , green pepper , onions and garlic , until almost tender
7. In a bowl combine cornstarch , salt and pepper , and sprinkle over vegetables in skillet
8. Cook and stir for 1 minute gradually adding in the half and half
9. Bring to a boil on medium heat and cook til thickened
10. Return chicken to skillet and heat though
11. Pour over cooked and drained noodles

title: cucumber   onion salad
steps:
1. Combine slices of cucumbers and onions on wax paper on cookie sheet
2. Sprinkle 2 tsp of salt over top of mixture
3. Place ice cubes on top and let soak for an hour
4. When the hour is up , work mixture over with hands and place in strainer for 30 minutes
5. Once all water is drained , place cucumber & onion mixture in large bowl
6. Add mayo , milk , vinegar and pepper
7. Stir well
8. Refrigerate before serving

title: devilled chicken   low carb
steps:
1. Combine the oil , lemon juice and rind , garlic , chilli and seasoning in a shallow bowl
2. Add the chicken pieces and coat
3. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight
4. Thread the chicken onto 12 oiled skewers and cook under a preheated grill for 6-8 minutes , turning frequently
5. Delicious served with a mixed leaf salad with red capsicum added
6. I did not bother with a salad dressing as the chicken is so beautifully piquant
7. Prep time does not include marinade time of 4 hours

title: lemon poppy seed noodles
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Drain , reserving 2 tablespoons of the cooking water
3. Place the noodles in a large bowl
4. Add butter , lemon , poppy seeds , sugar , salt and the reserved water
5. Toss to combine
6. Serve hot

title: fresh plum or peach cobbler muffins
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Peel and slice fruit into 6 slices each
3. Sift the dry ingredients , making a well in the center
4. Pour wet ingredients into the well , and blend by hand
5. Scoop batter into lightly greased , large 6 muffin pan
6. Insert 2 plum or peach wedges into each muffin
7. Sprinkle muffin tops with cinnamon
8. Bake for 30 minutes , or until center of muffins is resistant to touch
9. Cool 5 minutes in pan , then turn out on rack to cool

title: kelly s tlc chicken noodle soup
steps:
1. Rinse chicken with cold water inside and out , and be sure to remove any "innards"
2. Place whole chicken in large pot
3. Add water to cover the bird plus an inch
4. Add bay leaves
5. Bring to a boil , skim off the "foamy stuff" with a large spoon , reduce heat , cover and simmer for about an hour and 30 minutes
6. You may need to carefully turn your chicken over halfway through if it wants to stick up a bit
7. Carefully remove chicken from pot onto a platter , cover loosely with foil til cool enough to handle
8. Remember there will be very hot water inside the cavity of the chicken
9. So please do this carefully , dumping that out into the pot as you remove it , so you don't burn yourself ! also give the pot a stir
10. The chicken will be very tender when done , and a wing or leg may fall to the bottom
11. Be sure to get that !
12. Remove 5 cups stock from pot into heat-proof pitcher or pan
13. Save rest of chicken stock for another use
14. Pour the 5 cups stock back into the pot
15. While chicken is cooling , add rest of ingredients except noodles
16. Bring to a boil and then reduce to a nice simmer and cook veggies about 4-5 minutes
17. Now add the noodles
18. Stir
19. Return to a boil to get it going again , then reduce to a nice simmer and continue to simmer til noodles are just about tender
20. About another 4-5 minutes
21. While veggies and noodles are simmering away , remove meat from chicken and add as you go
22. Now just continue to simmer , another 2-3 minutes til noodles are tender
23. Take one out and try it is the only way to know ! :)
24. Also , don't stir this very much ! you'll just break up the noodles
25. If using 4 chicken breasts instead , bring chicken breasts to a boil in pot , reduce to simmer , and simmer only 20 minutes
26. Serve with saltine crackers if desired
27. Makes about 3-4 quarts
28. But don't worry
29. Sounds like a lot , but the 2 of us go through this easily within only 3 days !
30. And it is really good ! but any good quality chicken base will work well
31. It comes in a jar next to the boullion
32. )
33. And one last thing , if you need to add more of the broth that you stewed the chicken in , just nuke 1-2 cups broth with 1-2 teaspoons of the boullion / chicken base til dissolved , then add to pot
34. Simmer just a few minutes longer
35. Hth ! :d

title: easy pecan chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In mixing bowl , combine cake mix , eggs , oil , water , and sugar
3. Mix well
4. Add in pecans and chocolate chips
5. Mix well
6. Drop by teaspoonfuls on slightly greased cookie sheet
7. Bake at 350 degrees for approximately 15 minutes or til lightly browned

title: summery stuffed red   yellow bell peppers
steps:
1. Place the couscous and boiling water in a large bowl , cover and let the couscous sit for 15 minutes
2. Fluff the couscous with a fork , then let it cool to room temperature
3. Meanwhile , slice the tops off the whole peppers
4. Core , seed , wash and drain the peppers
5. If necessary , slice a little off the bottoms of the peppers so they will sit on a plate without falling over
6. Combine the diced peppers , scallions , zucchini and cooled couscous in a large mixing bowl
7. In a small bowl , combine the lime juice , olive oil and dill and mix well
8. Pour the dressing over the couscous mixture and toss to coat
9. Spoon one-sixth of the couscous mixture into each cored pepper
10. Cover the peppers with plastic wrap and chill until needed

title: banana mug cake
steps:
1. Combine the mashed bananas , maple syrup , vegetable oil , and vanilla extract
2. Combine the flour , salt , sugar , and cinnamon
3. Beat into the wet ingredients
4. Pour the batter into a greased mug
5. Microwave on high for 1 minute or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
6. Cool slightly before consuming

title: best rice ever
steps:
1. Bring chicken broth to a boil , remove from heat
2. Add minute rice and let stand for 10-15 mins , until water is absorbed , fluff with fork
3. Meanwhile in a non stick skillet , sautee onions and green pepper with a pinch of salt and pepper in 1 tbsp of olive oil until lightly browned
4. Add mushrooms and sautee until cooked
5. Push all ingredients to the side of the pan and scramble eggs on the other side until cooked
6. Add rice , and soya sauce to taste
7. Enjoy !

title: creamed cucumber delight
steps:
1. Peel and slice cucumber and onions thinly
2. The best results are even slices
3. I use a mandolin for this step
4. Place sliced cucumber and onions in a medium bowl that has a lid
5. In a small bowl mix together the miracle whip , sugar , vinegar
6. Add salt and pepper if using
7. Pour over top of the cucumbers / onions
8. Place the lid on the bowl and give it a shake or two
9. Marinate 6 hours or overnight in the refrigerator
10. Do not add more liquid
11. Juice will keep for a long time
12. Just keep adding onions and cucumber as they get low until you no longer get the wonderful flavor on the cucumbers
13. Then it is time for a new batch

title: sunshine blueberry muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Line medium muffin pans with paper liners or grease bottoms only
3. For batter , combine flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda and salt in large bowl
4. Add blueberries
5. Toss to coat well
6. In small bowl , whisk egg and oil
7. Blend in yogurt and 1 teaspoon of the lemon zest
8. Add egg mixture to dry ingredients and stir just until moistened
9. Batter will be lumpy
10. Spoon batter into prepared muffin pans , filling each cup 3 / 4 full
11. Bake 12-14 minutes or until golden brown
12. Cool slightly
13. For glaze , combine the remaining lemon zest , powdered sugar and milk in small bowl and mix well
14. Drizzle glaze over muffins

title: caramelized onion skillet corn bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 500 degrees with a well-seasoned 10-inch cast iron skillet in it for about 10 minutes
2. Meanwhile , in a large mixing bowl , combine cornmeal , flour , salt and baking powder
3. Stir with a whisk to combine ingredients
4. In a separate small mixing bowl , mix eggs and buttermilk until combined
5. Add to dry ingredients
6. Carefully remove skillet from oven and melt one stick of butter in it
7. Add diced onion to pan and stir
8. Immediately pour batter into the cast iron skillet with the "instantly" caramelized onions and butter
9. Bake at 375 for 20 minutes until a knife inserted in middle comes out clean
10. Let rest for 10 minutes and then turn out onto a plate

title: ravioli in mushroom broth
steps:
1. Heat oil and saute onion , mushrooms , and garlic
2. Stir in flour and blend
3. Add broth , wine basil , parsley , and pepper
4. Bring the mixture to a boil , add the pasta , and cook until tender

title: ham casserole
steps:
1. Make a white sauce of butter , flour , milk and salt
2. Melt butter
3. Add italian seasoning and croutons and brown
4. Reserve a few croutons for topping
5. In baking dish that has sprayed with cooking spray , alternate layers of ham , eggs , mushrooms and croutons
6. Pour white sauce over layers and top with reserved croutons
7. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes

title: katsudon  japanese dish
steps:
1. Marinate pork chop with kumquats , soy sauce , pepper and onion for at least 30minutes --
2. Place flour , beaten eggs and panko on separate shallow dishes
3. Then , dip the marinated cutlets first in flour , then egg , then panko
4. Heat oil until it's really hot and ready for frying
5. Fry each side of the meat until golden brown , drain
6. Cut meat in 3 / 4 inch strips but make sure each shape is still intact
7. To make it easier , slice until before the skin so it would still hold it's shape
8. For the stock: mix and simmer all stock ingredients in a wok stirring occasionally
9. After 10 mins of simmering , increase the flame a bit and slide each cutlet using a spatula into the boiling stock keeping the shape intact and immediately pour beaten egg over it cooking until the egg is nearly set
10. Key is not to overcook the eggs and don't cook too long or tonkatsu will lose it's crispiness
11. Remove intact meat with egg and slide on top of a big bowl of steamed rice
12. Do this with the rest of the cutlets
13. Garnish with chopped green onions
14. Dish is served
15. Enjoy !

title: mixed apple salad over greens
steps:
1. To prepare dressing , combine first 5 ingredients in a small bowl , stirring well with a whisk
2. To prepare salad , combine apples , cheese , and bacon
3. Drizzle dressing over apple mixture
4. Toss gently to coat
5. Serve over mixed greens

title: oven roasted turkey with sage butter   tyler florence
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f and remove the top rack of the oven
2. Rinse the bird thoroughly inside and out with cold water , and pat dry with paper towels
3. Sprinkle the cavity and skin liberally with salt and pepper
4. Stuff the cavity with stuffing and , if required , truss the legs
5. Cover the turkey with olive oil and season well with salt and pepper
6. Push the sage butter under the skin of the turkey , being careful not to puncture the skin
7. Sage butter: combine 2 sticks softened butter , sage and salt & pepper
8. Put the turkey on a rack in a large roasting pan , and into the oven
9. Continue cooking until an instant-read thermometer inserted into the meaty part of the thigh registers 170 degrees f
10. The thigh juices will run clear when pricked with a knife , about 3 hours total
11. If the legs or breast brown too quickly during roasting , cover them with foil

title: mango couscous
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , bring the water to a boil
2. Add a pinch of salt and the couscous
3. Remove from the heat , cover
4. Fluff with a fork after 10 minutes
5. Transfer the couscous to a glass bowl
6. Add the remaining ingredients , toss gently and serve

title: shrimp stuffed puff pastries
steps:
1. Bake puff pastry shells according to package directions
2. When done , cut out the top and scoop out the dough
3. Discard the dough , keep the top to the pastry
4. Cream all remaining ingredients together
5. Spoon filling into pastry shells and replace lids
6. Bake for 10 minutes at 350 degrees

title: sausage quiches
steps:
1. Cook first 3 ingredients in a skillet over medium-high heat 8 minutes , stirring occasionally , or until sausage is finely crumbled and no longer pink
2. Combine sausage mixture , eggs , and next 6 ingredients in a medium bowl
3. Stir well
4. Spoon mixture evenly into shells
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes or until set
6. Garnish , if desired
7. Serve warm

title: easy bananas foster packets
steps:
1. Create a pouch out of aluminum foil , carefully folding and sealing the sides so no juices can leak out
2. Slice the banana into even slices and add to the pouch along with butter , kahlua , and sugar
3. Seal pouch and shake to combine
4. Grill or broil about 5-10 minutes or until bananas are soft and carmelized

title: pignoli cookies  italian pine nut cookies
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees , and line 2 cookie sheets with parchment paper
2. Crumble the almond paste into a mixing bowl and beat with handheld mixer until crumbled fine
3. Sprinkle the sugar over the almond paste while continuing to beat , until the sugar is incorporated
4. Beat in the egg whites , one at a time and continue beating until the dough is smooth
5. Spread the pine nuts out on a plate
6. Roll 1 tablespoon of the dough at a time , into a ball between your palms , and then roll it in the pine nuts to coat on all sides
7. Transfer to the prepared cookie sheets and press them lightly to flatten slightly and to help the nuts adhere to the cookies
8. Bake the cookies until they are lightly browned ans soft and springy , about 15 minutes
9. Cool completely on wire racks , and dust liberally with powdered sugar before serving
10. Enjoy !

title: beachcomber s prickly pear jelly
steps:
1. Harvest tunas wearing thick gloves
2. A 2 quart colander full to top should yield about 8 cups juice
3. Be sure to include a few that still are a wee bit green if possible
4. Do not handle these with bare hands
5. Rinse the fruits in a colander
6. Then put them in a large nonreactive kettle with the 2 cups of water
7. Cover & bring to rapid simmer
8. Simmer until fruit soft - about 30 minutes
9. Ladle now mushy fruits into blender & blend with enough water to make thick slurry
10. Ok to do this after fruits cool if this recipe has been too high risk up to this point
11. Otherwise blend when hot but be sure to hold down blender lid with a thick cloth between it & your hand because boiling brilliant magenta juice with tiny tiny spines really hurts !
12. Pour blended fruits back into pan with residual water & stir
13. Drape 4 layers of cheesecloth in colander & dampen
14. Pour or ladle then pour the brilliant magenta fruit slurry into the cheesecloth & gather the edges to twist and squeeze the juice out
15. Your hands will be stained brilliant magenta if you opt not to wear gloves but the cheesecloth effectively sieves out any little spines
16. Rinse out the initial kettle and pour the strained juice back into it
17. Add lemon juice
18. Heat to boil & add the 2 packets of powdered pectin
19. Bring to a hard boil for 1-2 minutes
20. Add 7 cups of sugar , blend well & bring to a hard boil for 2 minutes
21. Ladle into sterilized 1 cup jars , lid & process in covered hot water bath for 20 minutes
22. Leave 1 / 2 inch headroom when filling jars & be sure to have jars in hot water bath covered by at least 2 inches of water
23. Remove from bath & place on flat towel on counter
24. Jars should "pop" within 5 minutes
25. Enjoy !

title: pf chang s shrimp with candied walnuts
steps:
1. The the walnuts:
2. Prepare a piece of parchment paper or lightly grease a baking sheet
3. Set aside
4. Combine water and sugar in a saucepan
5. Bring to a boil
6. Stir until the sugar is dissolved
7. Add in the walnuts , stirring constantly
8. Cook for 5-10 minutes or until thickened
9. Place the walnuts on the parchment paper or baking sheet
10. Separating them carefully
11. Allow them to cool fully
12. An alternative to this is to simply toss the walnuts in a skillet with some white sugar and heat over medium-high heat , tossing constantly until the sugar is melted and caramelized
13. For the sauce:
14. Whisk this together over a low heat until warm
15. You want a very pale yellow color , if the color is too pale , add a dash more tumeric
16. Remove from heat
17. The the shrimp:
18. Clean and dry shrimp well
19. Whisk egg whites lightly in a bowl , add the shrimp and coat well
20. Combine the flour and cornstarch
21. Dredge the shrimp
22. Fry shrimp in hot oil , 3-5 minutes until the breading is golden and the shrimp are pink
23. Fry only a couple shrimp at a time , transferring to a paper towel to drain
24. Continue until all the shrimp are cooked
25. Toss the shrimp and honey dew and / or cantaloupe melon balls in the warm sauce
26. Top with candied walnuts
27. Serve over rice !

title: weight watchers  ww  strawberry mousse
steps:
1. Mix the strawberries with the cream cheese until the berries are slightly broken up and the cheese in pinky in hue
2. Make up the jello according to the packet and pour over the strawberry mix
3. Stir well and leave until just starting to set
4. Whisk the egg whites until stiff peaks and fold into the strawberry mix
5. Spoon the mix into glasses and chill for one hour

title: glazed chicken   pears
steps:
1. Drain pears , saving liquid
2. Whisk together the pear liquid , cornstarch , mustard , salt , pepper , water , lemon zest , lemon juice , and soy sauce
3. Heat enough oil in a large skillet to keep the chicken from sticking - no more than 2 tablespoons
4. Brown chicken on all sides , then add pear liquid mixture
5. Cover pan with lid , lower heat , and simmer on low 45 minutes
6. Remove chicken from the pan , reserving pan drippings
7. Keep chicken in a covered dish to keep warm
8. Add pears to the pan and cook , stirring often , over medium-high heat until liquid has reduced by half
9. Serve sauce spooned over chicken

title: rice cereal energy bars
steps:
1. Combine the sesame seeds and sunflower seeds in a dry skillet over medium heat
2. Cook , stirring until fragrant and toasted
3. Salt lightly , and set aside to cool
4. Combine the dates , raisins , apricots , cherries , chocolate chips and the toasted seeds in the container of a food processor
5. Pulse to chop until small but not pasty
6. Transfer to a large bowl , and mix with oats and crisp rice cereal
7. In a small glass bowl , mix together the corn syrup , sugar and peanut butter
8. Heat in the microwave until bubbly
9. Stir in the powdered milk , vanilla , and almond extract
10. Pour the peanut butter mixture over the bowl of cereal and goodies , and mix with a wooden spoon until everything is evenly coated
11. Press the mixture into a greased 10x15 inch jellyroll pan using wet hands
12. Cut into squares , and allow to cool completely before removing from the pan

title: wholesome cookies
steps:
1. Cover rasins with water and bring to a boil
2. Allow to soften and drain
3. Cream shortening and sugars
4. Add eggs
5. Stir in rest of ingredients , folding in cereal with a spoon
6. Bake on lightly greased cookie sheet
7. 350 deg
8. For 12 min

title: australian tropical tea
steps:
1. Bring orange juice to a boil in a saucepan
2. Remove from heat and add all other ingredients except lemon slices
3. Cover and let steep 5 minutes or until desired strength
4. Remove tea bags
5. Allow to cool , then chill
6. Strain and serve in small goblets , garnished with lemon slices

title: grilled steak with teriyaki mushrooms
steps:
1. Spray grate of outdoor grill and utensils with grilling spray
2. Preheat grill to medium heat according to manufacturer's directions
3. Spray large skillet with grilling spray
4. Heat over medium-high heat
5. Add mushrooms and onion
6. Cook 8 minutes or until tender , stirring occasionally
7. Remove from heat
8. Stir in stir fry sauce
9. Set aside
10. Sprinkle steaks with seasoned salt and pepper
11. Grill 10 minutes or until medium done , turning over after 5 minutes
12. Transfer steaks to serving plates
13. Spoon mushroom mixture evenly over steaks

title: pasta with tomatoes  broccoli and cheese
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package dirctions but add in the broccoli he last 2-5 minutes of the cooking time
2. Drain
3. While pasta is cooking , in a skillet heat oil over medium high heat
4. Add garlic and cook , stirring for 1 minute or until garlic is golden
5. Stir in tomatoes and cook stirring for another minute or so or until skin starts to blister
6. Add drained pasta and broccoli , salt and pepper and cook another 2 minutes , stirring
7. Transfer mixture to a large bowl , stir in cheeses

title: mexican chicken pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions , drain , rinse , and set aside
2. Combine all vegetables in a large bowl
3. Combine all dressing ingredients
4. Stir thoroughly
5. Pour dressing over salad
6. Toss to coat
7. Chill 1 hour , then serve

title: spinach  artichoke    pesto lasagna
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Lightly coat a 9" x 13" baking dish with cooking spray
3. Thaw and only partially drain frozen spinach if using no-boil noodles
4. If using traditional boiled noodles , completely drain spinach
5. Blend ricotta and tofu in medium mixing bowl
6. Season to taste with italian seasoning , basil , garlic powder , parsley , salt , and pepper and then stir in the spinach
7. Spread a small amount of pesto on the bottom of the baking dish , and cover with four slightly overlapping lasagna noodles
8. Spread about 1 / 4 of the spinach , ricotta , and tofu mixture on the noodles
9. Top with half the artichoke hearts and half the sliced garlic
10. Add four more noodles and spread about 1 / 3 of the remaining pesto on them , then repeat step 6
11. Sprinkle approximately 1 / 3 of the shredded mozzarella on this layer
12. Add four more noodles and spread with pesto and spinach , ricotta , and tofu mixture as above
13. Add last four noodles
14. Spread with remaining pesto and spinach , ricotta , and tofu mixture and top with remaining shredded mozzarella
15. Cover baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 45 minutes
16. Remove foil and bake an additional 10 - 15 minutes uncovered , until cheese is nicely melted and very slightly browned around the edges
17. Let stand 5 - 10 minutes before serving

title: thai thighs
steps:
1. Place salsa , chili sauce , peanut sauce , juice , fish sauce , scallions and ginger in a bowl mix thoroughly
2. Chill this mixture for 30 minutes , then taste and adjust spice / heat to taste
3. Place this mixture and the thighs in a gallon freezer bag or a covered plastic container
4. Shake well to thoroughly coat thighs and marinate overnight in fridge , turning once or twice
5. Dump the whole shootin match in ye olde crocke potte and cook on low setting for about 7 hours or till chicken is cooked thoroughly
6. Carefully remove chicken to a pre-warmed serving dish
7. Taste sauce again and adjust seasonings to taste
8. Place cashews in plastic baggie and bash em with a kitchen hammer / mallet
9. Serve chicken with sauce poured over and garnish with bashed cashews and chopped cilantro / parsley

title: forgotten kiss cookies
steps:
1. # preheat over to 375 degrees f
2. # in a large bowl , beat butter , sugars , and vanilla until well blended
3. # add the flour and blend until smooth
4. # stir in mini chocolate chips
5. # mold a scant tablespoon of cookie dough around each unwrapped kiss , covering completely
6. Shape into balls
7. # place into un-greased cookie sheet
8. # bake 10-12 minutes or until set
9. # cool slightly , move from cookie sheet to wire rack
10. Cool completely
11. # prepare chocolate drizzle , if desired , drizzle over each cooled cookie
12. # enjoy !
13. Chocolate drizzle = in a small microwavable bowl , place 1 / 4 cup mini chocolate chips and 1 teaspoon shortening
14. Microwave for 30 seconds to melt
15. Stir until smooth
16. Drizzle over cookies

title: cheesy sausage and egg enchiladas
steps:
1. In skillet over medium heat , crumble and brown sausage
2. Drain , reserving 2 tablespoons drippings
3. Return sausage and drippings to skillet
4. Add beaten eggs
5. Scramble until desired doneness
6. Add 1 / 2 cup salsa and 1 cup of cheese
7. Stir until well blended
8. Spread 1 cup of salsa in a 13 x 9-inch pan
9. Place 1 / 4 cup of meat mixture down the center of each tortilla
10. Roll up
11. Place tortilla seam side down on salsa
12. Top with remaining salsa and cheese
13. Bake at 350f for 20 minutes or until thoroughly heated

title: don t want to go to town fish sandwich longmeadow farm
steps:
1. Bake frozen fish fillets at 400 degrees , for 10 minutes , turn over once and bake 10 minutes more
2. Watch carefully , don't want them to burn
3. Mix up tartar sauce , or use what you have in fridge
4. Sliced cheese should be at room temperature
5. Toast bun in a non stick skillet until lightly grilled
6. After toasted , place cheese on bottom of bun
7. Let fish fillets cool a bit as they get crunchy-ier
8. Put fish fillet on each sandwich bun , topping the fillet with tartar sauce , and closing bun
9. Bubble bubble --

title: pasta e fagioli soup
steps:
1. Saut carrots in the olive oil for 2 minutes
2. Stir in garlic
3. Cook 1 minute
4. Add broth and pasta
5. Bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat
7. Simmer 10 minutes
8. Stir in tomatoes and beans
9. Cook 5 minutes more
10. Stir in peas
11. Cook till pasta is tender and heated through
12. Top with basil and cheese

title: millionaire s pecan pie
steps:
1. Mix first three ingredients in medium sauce pan and bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly
2. Continue to boil for four to seven minutes depending on altitude
3. Pour into baked pie shell and refrigerate for a minimum of three hours
4. Serve with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream

title: awesome sherbet punch   great for baby or wedding showers
steps:
1. Thaw the sherbet slightly , but not until it is melted
2. It just makes it easier to mix up this way
3. Add sherbet to punch bowl
4. Add pineapple juice
5. Add ginger ale
6. Then enjoy

title: cherry tomato salad
steps:
1. In a medium bowl whisk together balsamic vinegar , olive oil , coarse salt , ground pepper and sugar or sugar substitute
2. Add grape tomatoes cut in half , red onion and parsley
3. Toss to combine
4. Serve cold

title: chicken fingers with honey mustard sauce
steps:
1. In small bowl , stir together mayonnaise , dijon and honey
2. Cover and refrigerate up to 3 days
3. Between sheets of plastic wrap , pound chicken with flat side of meat pounder or with rolling pin until 1 / 2-inch thick
4. Cut lengthwise on diagonal into 4 x 1-1 / 2-inch strips
5. In bowl , whisk eggs and garlic
6. I used egg creations to replace the eggs
7. In shallow bowl , combine cheese , bread crumbs , oregano , salt , pepper and paprika
8. One at a time , dip chicken strips into eggs , letting excess drip back into bowl
9. Dredge in cheese mixture , coating generously and pressing to adhere
10. Arrange on greased baking sheets
11. Drizzle with butter
12. Bake in 425f oven until golden , crispy and no longer pink inside , about 15 minutes
13. Serve with dipping sauce

title: cinnamon pecan pie shell
steps:
1. Place nuts into a food processor or grinder / blender with chopping option
2. Process until the nuts are a fine meal like texture
3. Combine with the remaining ingredients , pat into a pie plate and bake at 350 degrees for 10-12 minutes
4. Makes one 9-10 inch pie crust
5. Fill with pie filling of your choice and bake according to instructions
6. This is also good with uncooked pie fillings too

title: howdy  pardner  tortillas chips  baked
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Cut the tortillas in half
3. Each half cut into triangles
4. Place the tortilla triangles in a large mixing bowl
5. Add the salt , chipotle powder , sugar , cinnamon and oil
6. Toss well with a fork until the tortilla triangles are evenly coated with the seasonings and oil
7. Place the triangles singly on a parchment-lined baking sheet
8. Bake about 15 minutes , turning the chips and rotating the baking sheet every 5 minutes
9. Due to the sugar content , you'll need to watch the chips carefully so they don't burn
10. Remove from oven , cool briefly and transfer to a serving bowl
11. Enjoy !
12. To store , place in a ziploc-type plastic bag or covered container
13. Servings are estimated

title: addictive yellow squash casserole
steps:
1. Boil sliced and peeled yellow squash and l onion until tender
2. Drain all liquid
3. Add 2 oz
4. Of butter and 1 egg
5. Crumble saltine crackers into mixture
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Add 6 to 8 0z
8. Of cheez-whiz
9. Mix together and put into casserole dish
10. Bake @ 350 degrees for 30 minutes
11. Just before finished baking , crumble fritos on top
12. Add grated cheese if you like

title: cranberry with apples and walnuts relish
steps:
1. Chop walnuts to the size you desire
2. It is total preference
3. Put 1 / 2 bag of cranberries in blender and fill with water until covered
4. Chop and drain
5. Take 2nd half and repeat
6. Drain all
7. Take chopped apples & walnuts and mix with berries
8. Add sugar and mix
9. Put in refridgerator overnight
10. I'm not sure on the size of cranberry bag
11. It's probably 8 - 10 oz

title: little chocolate cake with frosting
steps:
1. In mixing bowl , mix chocolate with boiling water , stirring until blended
2. After mixture cools , add sugar , shortening , egg and vanilla , and combine
3. Gradually add dry ingredients , alternating with milk
4. Add vinegar , and pour batter into a greased 8 x 8 inch square baking pan
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 to 35 minutes , or until cake tests done
6. Allow cake to cool completely before applying frosting
7. For frosting , combine all ingredients except vanilla and butter in a saucepan
8. Over medium heat , bring to a boil and cook for 1 and 1 / 2 minutes , then remove from heat
9. Set pan in ice bath and beat for 1 minute
10. Add butter and vanilla , and beat for 10 more minutes , or until it reaches desired consistency for spreading on cake
11. Frost completely cooled cake , and serve

title: italian orange cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 325
2. Generously spray bottom of 10-12 inch springform pan with baking spray
3. In a large bowl , beat cake ingredients on low speed 30 seconds
4. Increase speed to medium and beat 2 minutes
5. Pour batter into prepared pan
6. Bake a 10 inch pan 45-50 minutes , a 12 inch pan 35-40 minutes
7. Top of cake may appear very dark brown and rippled with a crack in center of cake
8. Cool completely , 1 hour
9. Carefully run knife around side of pan to loosen , remove side of pan
10. Transfer cake to serving plate
11. In medium bowl , combine frosting ingredients
12. Frost cake
13. Garnish with orange peel
14. Store loosely covered in refrigerator

title: wild addicting dip
steps:
1. Spread each layer evenly in order given
2. Cover and chill before serving
3. Serve with tortilla chips

title: crock pot teriyaki steak
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and pour over steak
2. Cook on low 4 to 6 hours in crock pot
3. Serve over rice

title: cheddar risotto
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a very large frying pan
2. Add the rice and saut it gently for about 3 - 4 minutes , until it looks glossy
3. Add the onion , leek and pepper and cook gently , stirring often , for a few more minutes
4. Add the wine to the frying pan and allow it to bubble up , then cook gently until it has been absorbed , stirring frequently
5. Ladle about one quarter of the stock into the rice , stir , then let the rice simmer gently until the liquid has been absorbed
6. Add the mushrooms to the risotto with another ladleful of stock
7. Cook gently , adding more stock as needed until the rice is tender , it will take about 20 - 25 minutes to cook in total
8. Stir in the peas and cheddar cheese , season to taste with salt and pepper , stir well and serve , garnished with basil

title: yummy cobblestone brownies
steps:
1. Brownies:
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
3. Beat brownie mix , oil , eggs and extract on medium until well blended
4. Set aside 1 cup for topping
5. Spread batter into greased 13x9 in baking pan and bake 12 minutes
6. Filling:
7. In a small bowl , beat cream cheese , eggs , extracts and sugar until smooth
8. Fold in coconut flakes
9. After brownies are baked for 12 minutes , spread cream cheese mixture over brownies in pan
10. Drop remaining cup of brownie batter over filling by teaspoons
11. Bake additional 45 minutes
12. Cool and enjoy !

title: baked felafel sandwich
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f
2. Combine all felafel ingredients except 1 tablespoon olive oil in the bowl of a food processor
3. Process for 10 seconds
4. Stop motor and scrape down sides of bowl , then pulse for another 10 seconds , until all ingredients are well incorporated but mixture is still slightly coarse and grainy
5. Form mixture into 16 felafel balls and brush with remaining tablespoon olive oil
6. Bake on a cookie sheet for 20 minutes , flip felafel balls and bake an additional 20 minutes , until felafel balls are crisp and browned
7. Combine tahini , lemon juice and water and stir to incorporate , adding more water to achieve desired consistency
8. Reserve
9. Toss together lettuce , tomatoes and cucumbers in a bowl
10. Warm pita breads for 2 minutes in oven
11. Fill each pita with 3 / 4 cup salad , 4 felafel balls and 1 / 4 cup tahini sauce

title: danish pickled red cabbage  roedkaal
steps:
1. Place cabbage , apple , vinegar , cranberry and salt in a pot
2. Simmer under lid for 1 hour
3. Remove the lid and cook for another 10 min to let some of the moisture steam off
4. Remove from heat and if needed strain lightly , you will need to have a bit of moisture left but the cabbage should not be swimming in it
5. Add sugar until desired tartness is achieved

title: grilled salmon with chive and dill sauce and cucumbers
steps:
1. Preheat grill to 400f
2. Coat a fish basket with non-stick spray
3. Sauce: place ingredients in a bowl and stir to combine
4. Fish: place fillets in basket , put on grill flesh side down , cover and cook 2 minutes
5. Turn basket over , cover and cook 2 minutes or until center of fish is opaque
6. Squeeze a bit of lemon juice on each fillet
7. Garnish: thin slice cucumber
8. To assemble: place each fillet on a serving dish , surround with cucumber slices and top fillets with sauce

title: yam yam honey buns
steps:
1. Soften compressed yeast in potato liquid
2. Let stand 5 minutes
3. Combine mashed potatoes , 3 tablespoons melted butter , 1 / 4 cup sugar , 2 teaspoons salt , vanilla , and unbeaten eggs in large bowl
4. Add the softened yeast
5. Gradually add flour to form a stiff dough
6. Cover with waxed paper or towel
7. Let rise in warm place until light and doubled in size , about 1 1 / 2 hours
8. Meanwhile prepare honey nut topping
9. Combine all topping ingredients except 1 / 2 cup chopped nuts in saucepan
10. Bring to boil and cook , stirring constantly , until a little syrup dropped in cold water forms a soft ball , about 1 1 / 2 minutes
11. Pour into greased 13x9x2-inch pan
12. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 cup chopped nuts
13. Toss dough on well-floured board until coated with flour and no longer sticky
14. Roll out to 24x8-inch rectangle
15. Brush with 2 tablespoons melted butter
16. Sprinkle with 1 / 4 cup brown sugar and 1 / 4 cup chopped nuts
17. Roll as for jelly roll , starting with 24-inch side
18. Cut or "tie off" with strong thread into twelve 2-inch slices
19. Place cut-side down over topping
20. Cover
21. Let rise in warm place until light and doubled in size , 30 to 45 minutes
22. Bake in moderate oven for 25 to 30 minutes
23. Cool 2 minutes , then invert on serving plate or on rack over waxed paper
24. Let stand 30 seconds before removing pan

title: scalloped potatoes with fresh green beans
steps:
1. Wash and peel the potatoes
2. Slice potatoes and put into a glass or tefal baking dish
3. Wash green beans , snip ends and cut each bean in half , add this to baking dish with potatoes
4. In a saucepan , melt 4 tablespoons butter , add 2 tablespoons of flour and stir until coated and cook to a light brown color
5. Remove flour from heat , add 2 cups of milk and stir with whisk until smooth
6. Add 1 cup of water , chicken boullion , salt & white pepper , return to a low heat to boil
7. Once boiled , should be a bit thick
8. Serve in 1 tablespoon of heavy cream and add this to oven dish of potatoes and beans
9. Sprinkle paprika on top
10. Put into a preheated oven at 350 degrees , bake for approximately 1 hour
11. Should have lost most of its liquid , and be browned on top and a bit crusty on sides
12. Serve next to your favorite dish !

title: pineapple pecan coleslaw
steps:
1. Place pecans in a small saute pan on medium high , cook and stir 3 to 4 minutes or until fragrant
2. Drain the pineable reserving 1 / 4 cup juice place the juice and the slaw dressing in a large bowl and whisk until blended
3. Stir in the remaining ingredients until evenly coated
4. Chill for 2hours , stirring often
5. If it seems dry add a bit more slaw dressing
6. It will create more juice the longer it chills

title: aunt viola s pumpkin cream pie
steps:
1. Mix softened cream cheese , 1 tablespoon half & half , and 1 tablespoon sugar together
2. Add whipped cream to mixture
3. Spread mixture on bottom of graham cracker crust
4. Mix 1 cup half & half with both packages of pudding with a whisk and let it stand for 3 minutes
5. Stir in pumpkin and spices
6. Put mixture on top of pie and spread evenly
7. Refrigerate 2-4 hours until set
8. Enjoy ! it's very rich , so take a small piece !

title: chickpea curry  vegan  pressure cooker
steps:
1. Heat the oil in the pressure cooker over high heat
2. Cook the cumin seeds for approx 30 seconds or until they start to crackle
3. Add the sliced onion and cook , stirring , for 5 minutes
4. The onion should be golden and soft
5. Reduce the heat and stir in the garlic and other spices
6. Add all remaining ingredients
7. Close and lock the lid
8. Bring to high pressure over high heat
9. Reduce heat to stabilise the pressure and cook for 15 minutes
10. Release pressure and serve with a sprig of coriander or a sprinkle of parsley
11. Serve with steamed basmati rice , naan or pappadums
12. Overnight soak , drain water , place into pressure cooker , cover with fresh water and cook on low pressure for 10 minutes
13. I soaked 2 cups dried chickpeas and result was a little over 4 cups cooked beans
14. Canned / tinned chickpeas can be used if desired- be sure to drain and wash them well

title: spinach dip with green onion
steps:
1. Thaw and squeeze spinach until dry
2. Chop
3. In mixer add all ingredients together and mix well
4. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours before serving
5. You may want to add only 1 cup of sour cream then see if you want to add the rest

title: easy chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Mix butter , eggs , brown sugar and vanilla together
2. Add flour to mixture
3. Next add baking powder and chocolate chips
4. Bake in oven at 350 degrees for about 15-20 minutes

title: pepperoni pizza pasta salad
steps:
1. Cut cheeses into 1 / 2" cubes
2. Combine all salad ingredients
3. Whisk together all dressing ingredients
4. Combine salad & dressing well

title: coconut ice   no cook easy version
steps:
1. Using extra icing sugar , dust a square pan
2. Mix the condensed milk , icing sugar and coconut together in a large bowl until it's fully mixed and stiff
3. Divide in half and tint one half of the mixture pink with the food colouring
4. Press one mixture into the pan gently then top and press with the other mixture
5. Leave to set then cut into cubes or fingers with an oiled knife
6. To store: wrap or layer with waxed or greaseproof paper and store in an airtight container

title: strawberries with cinnamon cream
steps:
1. In a small bowl , stir together cinnamon cream ingredients
2. Let diners dip strawberries in cinnamon cream , or put strawberries on small plates or bowls and spoon sauce over berries

title: simple steak
steps:
1. Tenderize meat slightly , with a mallet
2. Remove all outside fat , and slice into pieces about 1 / 4 inch long
3. Season both sides of meat
4. Heat oil in bottom of 12 inch skillet
5. Add steak , garlic clove , and sprinkle with rosemary
6. Saute at high heat just until meat is browned
7. Serve with au jus

title: quick easy  lite  coleslaw
steps:
1. In a bowl combine preparred coleslaw and all remaining ingredients
2. Stir until blended well
3. Refridgerate until ready to serve

title: don t be afraid green smoothie
steps:
1. Remove any stems from kale and spinach
2. Blend all ingredients in a blender
3. If you like your smoothie pretty sweet , add sweetner
4. I think it's fine , but husband likes it sweeter

title: sour cream and chives whipped potatoes
steps:
1. Place the potatoes in a large saucepan and cover with water
2. Cook until soft
3. Drain and place potatoes in a mixer bowl
4. Add the butter and sour cream
5. Whip on low
6. Gradually add the milk and increase the mixer's speed , whipping until the potatoes are smooth
7. Add the chives and check the seasonings , adding more salt and pepper as needed
8. Serve warm

title: cheese fondue dip
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a heavy pot and stir over low heat until cheese has melted
2. Keep warm in a fondue pot or refrigerate and reheat

title: apple pancake bake
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking pan
3. Melt the butter in the baking pan inside the oven
4. Arrange the apple slices evenly over the bottom of the pan
5. Bake for about 10 minutes , or until apples are soft
6. Remove apples from oven , and sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon
7. In a blender , combine all pancake ingredients , and pour over apples
8. Return to oven , and bake about 30-40 minutes
9. Sprinkle with icing sugar , and serve
10. Delicious !

title: mixed greens with berry dressing and toasted walnuts
steps:
1. Place all dressing ingredients in blender
2. Blend until smooth
3. Just before serving , in large bowl , toss greens , dried cherries and berries , and onion
4. Add enough dressing to lightly coat greens
5. Toss to coat well
6. Divide among salad plates
7. Sprinkle with walnuts
8. Pass remaining dressing
9. To toast walnuts , spread on baking sheet
10. Bake at 375f for 7 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned
11. Cool

title: bountiful breakfast muffins
steps:
1. Stir together flour , baking powder and spice in small bowl
2. In separate small bowl , toss fruit with 1 tablespoon of the flour mixture
3. Set both bowls aside
4. Add butter and sugar to large bowl and and beat at medium speed until light and fluffy
5. Beat eggs in , one at a time , until well blended
6. Beat in vanilla
7. At low speed , beat in reserved flour mixture gradually until just blended
8. Stir in reserved fruit and oats
9. Line 12 muffin cups with paper baking cups
10. Fill each cup a scant 1 / 3 cup full with batter
11. Bake in preheated 350 oven 20 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
12. Remove from pan
13. Cool on wire rack

title: heart attack cauliflower grits
steps:
1. Simmer the cauliflower in water with the milk added in
2. When very tender , drain well
3. With a hand masher , smash the cauliflower while mixing in the cream cheese , butter , and cheeses to the cauliflower
4. Salt and pepper to taste

title: cordially yours  homemade fruit liqueurs
steps:
1. In a small saucepan heat together the sugar and water , stirring until sugar dissolves
2. Remove from heat
3. Cool
4. Pour sugar syrup into a 2 quart glass jar
5. Add desired fruit and vodka
6. Stir gently
7. Cover the jar with a tight fitting lid
8. Let stand in a cool place for the suggested time
9. After steeping , use a wire strainer and strain liquid through several thickness of 100% cotton cheesecloth or coffee filter into a large bowl
10. Using a funnel , transfer mixture to a bottle
11. Seal and label
12. Store at room temperature
13. Orange cordial:
14. With a sharp knife or vegetable peeler , remove the thin orange layer of peel from 3 oranges , taking care to avoid the bitter white layer
15. Use peel to prepare cordial , reserving fruit for another use
16. Steep the mixture for 3 weeks
17. Banana cordial:
18. Peel and thinly slice 1 ripe banana
19. Steep the mixture for 1 week
20. Mango cordial:
21. Peel , pit and chop 2 ripe mangoes
22. Steep the mixture for 1 to 2 weeks
23. Pear cordial:
24. Peel , core and thinly slice 6 medium pears
25. Steep mixture for 3 weeks

title: berry cornmeal muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Butter muffin pan
3. Set aside
4. In a large bowl combine the flour , cornmeal , sugar , baking powder , salt , and lemon zest
5. In a separate bowl combine 2 tablespoons of this mixture with the berries
6. In a large measuring cup or bowl whisk together the egg , milk , oil , and vanilla extract
7. With a rubber spatula fold the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir only until the ingredients are combined
8. Gently stir in the berries
9. Evenly fill the muffin cups with batter
10. Sprinkle with the white sugar
11. Place in the oven and bake until lightly browned and a toothpick inserted in the center of a muffin comes out clean , about 15 - 20 minutes
12. Transfer to a wire rack and let cool for about 5 minutes before removing from pan

title: gram s garlic chicken strips
steps:
1. Cook chicken tenders in olive oil in skillet until golden brown on both sides
2. Place in baking dish
3. Add broth , white wine , garlic , parsley butter
4. Season to taste with salt and pepper
5. Bake at 350 for 25-30 minutes
6. Serve over white rice and enjoy !

title: holiday surprise muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease a 12-cup muffin tin
3. Using an electric mixer , beat butter , brown sugar and sugar in a medium mixing bowl until light and fluffy
4. Add molasses and eggs
5. Mix well
6. Stir baking soda into the buttermilk
7. Set aside
8. Combine flour , cinnamon , ginger , cloves and allspice in another mixing bowl
9. Add flour mixture and buttermilk alternately to the butter mixture
10. Mix well after each addition
11. Fill each muffin cup halfway with batter
12. Spoon about 1 teaspoon of cranberry sauce into each muffin cup
13. Top with remaining batter
14. Bake for 25 minutes or until golden brown and firm to the touch
15. Remove from pan
16. Cool on a wire rack

title: farfalle with tuna in a basil lemon dressing
steps:
1. Boil pasta in salted water
2. Mince garlic
3. Zest lemon to get one tablespoon zest
4. Juice the lemon
5. Shred basil into thin strips
6. Whisk together garlic , zest , lemon juice , olive oil in a large bowl and toss in tuna , breaking it up , add basil and tomatoes
7. Drain pasta well and add to bowl
8. Toss well
9. If pasta seems dry , add either a little pasta cooking water or more olive oil
10. Serve warm , or room temperature

title: round steak with beer marinade for the grill
steps:
1. The beer can be flat or fresh
2. Combine the beer , onion , pepper , soy sauce , honey , garlic and red pepper in a dish
3. Place the steak in and turn to marinate
4. Cover and marinate overnight or six hours at least
5. Drain and save the marinade
6. Boil the marinade for 2 to 3 minutes before spooning over the meat after grilling
7. Do not use unless you boil it
8. Grill the meat for about 12 mins over charcoal or until done to your taste
9. Let stand for 10 minutes before cutting

title: pumpkin seed no knead easy bread 12 18 hour recipe
steps:
1. Measure your flour using the same measure you use for liquids , rather than a dry measure
2. The flour can be loosely spooned or poured into the measure but don't pack it
3. Place flour into bowl , add salt and yeast , and stir lightly
4. Put honey into liquid measure , add water and stir to dissolve
5. Add pumpkin seeds and oat bran
6. Stir water and honey into bowl and mix the dough well enough with a spoon to make sure there are no dry spots
7. It's ok if the dough is sticky , but it shouldn't be excessively so
8. Add flour only if you can't avoid it
9. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and set it aside in a dark place , or cover the plastic with cloth
10. Take
11. 6 hours later , check your dough and see if you can discern bubbles at the surface
12. There should be some development , but probably not much
13. Check your dough again at the 12 hour mark--if the bubbles are all over the dough and it sinks in when you poke a damp finger into it , it is ready to start oven prep
14. If not you may wait longer , perhaps as long as another 6 hours
15. This is the hard part , because it's up to you and the bread
16. You can choose to go ahead but the dough will be less developed
17. When you and the bread are ready , remove it from the bowl onto a lightly oiled surface and shape it into a round
18. Let rest 15 minutes
19. Knead or shape the bowl into a loaf form and put into the oiled pan of choice--this can be a baking sheet or a regular loaf pan
20. Let rise for two or more hours , until it has appreciably filled the pan or risen significantly
21. You can check this again with a finger poke- when it doesn't fill in , the gluten is developed enough to hold the bread in shape
22. Bake at 425f for half an hour , lower temp to 375 and give it another 20-30 minutes , going by how dark the bread appears
23. When it is done , it should easily slide out of your pan
24. Cool completely before slicing if you can wait long enough for that !

title: peach and kiwi salad with peach dressing
steps:
1. Dip 2 peaches and banans in pineapple or lemon juice
2. Arrange dipped peaches and other fruit on lettuce
3. To make dressing , mix 2 unpeeled peaches , oil , orange juice , coconut , lime juice , and ginger in electric blender until smooth
4. Top fruit and lettuce with dressing

title: stuffed sopapillas
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast w / water and then combine all ingredients except flour
2. Add 2 c flour and mix , it will be soupy
3. Let this rise 1 hour
4. Then mix in 3 c flour till soft but not sticky dough
5. Let rise 1 hour
6. Roll out to 1 / 4 inch thickness on lightly floured surface to prevent sticking
7. Cut into triangles or squares about 3 inch by 3 inch
8. Let rise approx 1 / 2 hour
9. Deep fry in hot oil to golden brown on both sides
10. When you fry them you have to bump the sides of the dough against the deep fryer
11. This helps make the center puff up
12. Cut one side open and stuff with taco toppings
13. Frost any left overs w / maple frosting or honey and butter for dessert

title: herb butter for fish fillets  flounder  baked or broiled
steps:
1. Mix the lemon juice , tarragon , chives and the melted butter
2. Pour over the fish and either bake or broil to your liking
3. You could bake at 350 degrees f
4. For about 8 minutes

title: blackened trout
steps:
1. Preheat large , heavy skillet until very hot
2. Combine paprika , salt , onion powder , garlic powder , cayenne pepper , white pepper , black pepper , thyme , and oregano in a small bowl
3. Then place it in a shallow plate that's big enough to roll the fish inches
4. Dip fillets in melted butter , then in seasoning mixture , and place in hot skillet and cook 2-5 minutes on each side until blackened
5. Reheat melted butter to a simmer , and pour in small bowls to use for dipping

title: hot cherry fruit compote
steps:
1. In a buttered , large glass baking dish , arrange bing cherries , royal ann cherries , peach sliced , pineapple chunks , orange sections , raisins and ginger
2. Sprinkle grated lemon rind over all
3. Make a paste of the melted butter , brown sugar and curry powder and distribute over the fruit
4. Cover with pie filling and pour rum over all
5. Bake in 350f oven 45 minutes , or until hot and bubbly
6. Serve hot as an accompaniment to meat or poultry , or chilled as a dessert

title: vegetable scone
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Saute onion in 1 / 3 cup canola oil , until brown
3. Let cool
4. Beat eggs until mixed well , blend in milk , sauteed onions and oil mixture
5. Add flour , baking powder , oregano , and garlic powder
6. Mix well
7. Stir in spinach , broccoli , and cheese
8. Spoon onto a baking stone or greased pan
9. Bake 20 to 25 minutes

title: breaded pork chops in the pressure cooker
steps:
1. Season pork chops with salt and pepper dredge with corn flake crumbs , then dip in egg combined with milk , and again in the crumbs
2. Heat pressure cooker and add shortening
3. Brown chops on both sides
4. Add water
5. Close cover securely
6. Place pressure regulator on vent pipe and cook 12 to 14 minutes with pressure regulator rocking slowly
7. Let pressure drop of it's own accord

title: roasted scallops or shrimp with tomato
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 500 degrees
2. Have your shrimp or scallops drained and patted dry
3. You can also use frozen shrimp , thawed
4. Set the seafood aside in the refrigerator until the tomato layer is prepared and roasted through step 6
5. Seed and chop the fresh plum tomatoes
6. Mix them together with the rest of the ingredients for the tomato layer
7. Spread the mixture evenly in a gratin or other shallow baking dish suitable for high heat
8. Roast @ 500 degrees for 8-10 minutes , or until bubbly
9. Remove the gratin from the oven and layer your seafood on top
10. Return to the oven and continue roasting until the shrimp are pink , or the scallps are opaque on the outside but still translucent in their centers
11. About 5-10 minutes
12. Garnish with minced fresh parsley , and serve very hot with "sauce choron" and angel hair pasta if you like

title: celtic homemade eggnog
steps:
1. Separate eggs
2. Set egg whites in a metal bowl and place in the refrigerator
3. In a small mixing bowl , beat egg yolks until blended
4. Gradually add 3 tablespoons of sugar , beating at high speed until thick and lemon-coloured
5. Stir in the milk , rum or brandy , vanilla , and salt
6. Place egg yolk mixture in refrigerator to chill thoroughly , about 2 hours
7. Whip the cream
8. Remove the egg whites from the refrigerator and beat until soft peaks form
9. Add remaining sugar , beating the mixture into stiff peaks
10. Fold yolk mixture and whipped cream into egg whites
11. Mix in cinnamon , nutmeg , or pumpkin pie mix to taste

title: vegetable ribbons
steps:
1. Using a vegetable peeler , cut the carrots and courgettes into thin ribbon like slices
2. Bring the stock to the boil in a large saucepan and add the carrots
3. Return stock to the boil , then add the courgettes
4. Boil rapidly for 2-3 minutes , or until vegetables are just tender
5. Stir in parsley , season lightly and serve hot

title: frittata in a rice cooker
steps:
1. Coat the inner pot with nonstick cooking spray
2. In a medium bowl , mix together the spinach , mushrooms and onions
3. Add the eggs , oregano , thyme , salt , pepper and cheese
4. Mix well until all ingredients are combined
5. Spoon the frittata into the inner pot
6. Close the lid and press the white rice button and cook for 12-14 minutes
7. When done , the eggs should be firm on the bottom and almost set on the top
8. Use a plastic spatula to slice the frittata into wedges and serve

title: double carrot bread
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Grease and flour 8 1 / 2x4 1 / 2x2 1 / 2" loaf pans
3. Set aside
4. In a small bowl , sift together flour , sugar , baking soda , cinnamon and salt
5. Stir in nuts
6. Set aside
7. In a large mixer bowl , beat eggs
8. Blend in baby food carrots , shredded carrots and oil
9. Stir in flour-nut mixture until well combined
10. Pour into prepared pans
11. Bake for 55-60 minutes
12. Cool 10 minutes
13. Remove from pans and finish cooling on a wire rack

title: berry stuffed french toast with vanilla yogurt sauce
steps:
1. Place berries in a small bowl and sprinkle with powdered sugar
2. For the sauce , spoon about 1 / 4 of the berries , sweetened condensed milk and yogurt into a blender and puree until smooth
3. Set aside
4. Cut bread into twelve 1 1 / 2-inch pieces
5. Cut into each piece almost all the way through to create a pocket
6. Stuff the bread slices with remaining sweetened berries and press lightly to close
7. Set aside
8. Reserve any unused berries to garnish top at serving time
9. Whisk egg , egg white , milk , granulated sugar , vanilla and cinnamon in a medium bowl
10. Heat a large non-stick skillet over medium heat
11. Spray skillet with non-stick cooking spray
12. Dip stuffed bread slices in egg mixture to coat and cook until lightly browned on both sides , turning once
13. Spoon sauce onto serving plate , arrange french toast on top and garnish with any remaining berries

title: lobster stew
steps:
1. Fill a large stew pot with 2 inches of boiling water
2. Cover and cook lobsters for 12-15 minutes
3. Remove meat from shell and set aside
4. Stock: remove / rinse any red roe and tamale from bodies
5. Put lobster bodies and shells back into cooking water
6. Add onion , s&p , and chicken pieces
7. Over low heat reduce to 1 / 2 of original water level
8. Remove shells and chicken pieces
9. Strain stock
10. Pick fine meat from bodies and add to claw and tail meat
11. Add milk and butter to strained stock
12. Heat slowly
13. Add lobster meat
14. Taste and add more s& p if needed

title: brenda s cabernet soy tri tip
steps:
1. In a plastic food bag , combine wine , sugar , and soy sauce
2. With the flat side of a knife , crush ginger and garlic
3. Add to wine mixture
4. Wipe beef with a damp towel and put in bag , seal , and shake to mix
5. Set bag in a pan and chill , turning occasionally , at least 30 minutes or up to 1 day
6. Lift beef from bag , reserving the marinade
7. Lay meat on a grill above a solid bed of medium coals or on a gas barbecue on medium heat
8. Cover gas grill
9. Turning beef as needed to brown evenly , cook until a thermometer inserted in center of thickest part registers 125 for rare , 20 to 30 minutes total for a 1 1 / 2- to 2-inch-thick piece
10. Transfer meat to a carving board , keep warm , and let rest 5 to 10 minutes
11. Meanwhile , pour reserved marinade into a 1- to 2-quart pan
12. Over high heat , boil marinade until reduced to about 1 / 2 cup , about 5 minutes
13. With a slotted spoon , discard ginger and garlic
14. Pour marinade sauce into a bowl and add juices that have drained from meat
15. Slice meat thinly across the grain and accompany with sauce

title: pumpkin macaroons
steps:
1. Combine pecans , flour , lemon peel& coconut in a medium bowl
2. Gradually beat in the syrup& vanilla , then fold into pecan mix , adding pumpkin as you go
3. Line cookie sheet with parchment paper& drop rounded teaspoonfuls onto it
4. Let relax at room temp 30 min
5. Preheat the oven to 300
6. Bake mid-oven till just beginning to brown , 25-30 min
7. Let cool on rack till completely cool
8. Store tightly covered

title: cedar plank salmon with cucumber dill sauce
steps:
1. Soak cedar plank in water for several hours
2. In small bowl , combine shallots , garlic , dill , thyme , cilantro , lemon zest , lemon juice , green onion and olive oil
3. Cover and place in fridge for at least 1 hours
4. Place salmon on cedar plank and sprinkle with salt and pepper cover with herb mixture
5. Set plank on barbecue
6. Bake for 30 minutes on medium heat , until fish flakes easily with a fork
7. Cucumber dill sauce: finely chop cucumber , toss with salt and let stand for 15 minutes
8. Combine yogurt , sour cream , lemon juice , pepper , onion and dill
9. Drain water from cucumber and add to yogurt mixture

title: tastes like mounds bar    kahlua cake
steps:
1. Preheat over to 350f
2. Put all ingredients for the cake in a bowl
3. Mix on low for 1 minute to combine
4. Scrape bowl
5. Mix on medium high for a full 3 minutes to make it light and fluffy
6. Spray an angel tube pan or bundt pan with baker's spray
7. Pour batter in pan and bake for 45 to 50 minutes until done
8. Let cool in pan and then turn out onto you serving platter
9. While cake is cooling , make topping and frosting
10. Put chopped chocolate in heatproof bowl
11. Heat cream in a saucepan on medium high until it starts to boil
12. As soon as it starts to bubble , pull it off the heat and pour the hot cream over the chocolate
13. Stir immediately with a whisk to incorporate the cream into the chocolate
14. Stir until completely melted
15. Let it cool
16. When it gets to spreading consistency you want to coat your cake
17. For the topping , combine sugar , cornstarch and salt to a heavy saucepan
18. Add the coconut milk and cream of coconut
19. Heat on medium heat and stir until smooth and starts to boil
20. Stir until it thickens , about 5 - 7 minutes
21. Keep stirring so that it does not stick to pan
22. Take the pan off the heat and pour the mixture into a larger bowl and add shredded coconut
23. Stir to combine
24. Let this cool completely
25. Take about a half cup of the topping and stuff it into the middle of the cake
26. Fill it to the rim and flatten off with a table knife
27. Then frost cake , the frosting will be smooth and runny so the technique here is to place a dollop of frosting on the top of cake , coax it over to the side with knife so it starts to run down the side
28. Spread smoothly along the side of cake
29. Take cake and put it in the refrigerator until the frosting firms up just like the candy bar
30. This will take about 30 minutes or so
31. After that , take cake out of refrigerator and you are going to mound the remaining half of your coconut topping on the top of the cake
32. Place back in the refrigerator for about 30 to an hour
33. I know that this sounds like a lot of work , but this cake is truly decadent !

title: dippin  pizza strips
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. On greased baking sheet , roll pizza crust into 12x9-inch rectangle
3. Fold edges over to make 3 / 4 inch crust
4. Bake 7 minutes
5. Evenly top pizza crust with pepperoni , then cheese
6. Bake an additional 8 minutes or until cheese is melted
7. Let stand 2 minutes
8. Cut pizza in half lengthwise , then cut into 1-1 / 2 inch strips
9. Serve with warm marinara for dipping

title: clams a la campbell
steps:
1. Melt butter in pan
2. Add onion and saute lightly
3. Add clams with juice , cracker meal , and bread crumbs
4. Mix well
5. Remove from heat
6. Season with salt and pepper to taste
7. Add parsley
8. Place in a greased 1-quart casserole
9. Dot with butter
10. Pour cream on top
11. Bake for 25 minutes at 375 degrees
12. When finished , stir cream in well and serve with crackers
13. Enjoy !

title: blueberry strata
steps:
1. Spray a 9x13 baking dish with cooking spray
2. Spread half of the bread crumbs into prepared 9x13 dish
3. Cover with 1 cup of blueberries , cream cheese cubes
4. Top with the rest of the bread cubes
5. Whisk together eggs , milk , and cinnamon in a med bowl until well blended
6. Add 1 / 3 cup maple syrup and brown sugar and mix well
7. Pour over bread
8. Cover and refrigerate overnight
9. Bake , covered , at 350 for 45 minute
10. Uncover and bake 30 minutes longer or until center is set and top is browned
11. Meanwhile , bring remaining syrup and blueberries to a boil in a med saucepot , stirring constantly
12. Simmer on low 1 minute , stirring constantly
13. Serve strata topping with blueberry sauce

title: strawberry tapioca with custard
steps:
1. Mix the starch , sugar and salt in the top of a double boiler , and beat in the eggs
2. Make sure there are no lumps of cornstarch left
3. Beat the milk slowly into the egg mixture
4. Cook , stirring constantly , until thickened
5. Remove from the heat at once and beat in the vanilla
6. Divide the custard evenly amongst 6 serving dishes
7. Mix the strawberries , water , sugar , honey , salt and tapioca in a large pot and bring to a boil
8. Stir frequently
9. Simmer until the tapioca is clear , the strawberrries are soft , and the mixture is somewhat thickened
10. Stir in the lemon or lime juice
11. Spoon the strawberries evenly over the custard
12. Chill until set

title: brandy sauce
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients and then stir them into a cup of boiling water
2. Boil for 5 minutes and then add butter , brandy , and vanilla
3. Serve hot over mince pie or gingerbread

title: plain pilau
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a large , fireproof casserole and fry the rice in it over low heat until it just starts to color
2. Add the cinnamon and the crushed cardamom seeds
3. Stir and continue frying for a minute or two
4. Add the remaining ingredients and stir briefly
5. Bring the water to a boil , then lower the heat , cover the casserole tightly , and let the rice steam for about 20 minutes
6. All the water should be absorbed and the rice just tender but not mushy

title: nearly no fat fudge brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Mix chocolate , yogurt , and sugar
3. Sift flour , cocoa powder and baking soda into chocolate mixture and stir until just combined
4. Add water and stir until mixture comes together
5. Pour into a greased 8x8" pan and bake for 20-25 minutes until a toothpick inserted comes out clean

title: basic cookies recipe
steps:
1. Hopefully the cream together , stir in , and sift and add directions above will make sense to everyone
2. Bake in oven at 350 degrees for 10 minutes
3. Any one of the following could also be added: 1 / 2 cup chopped dates
4. 1 cup chocolate chips , 1 cup coconut

title: lebanese oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Lightly grease cookie sheets or line with parchment paper
3. Mix all the ingredients except water until dough is combined and crumbly
4. Add water and vanilla and knead until smooth
5. Roll dough into walnut size balls and place on cookie sheets about 2" apart
6. Flatten with a fork
7. Bake 10 minutes or until lightly browned
8. Transfer to wire racks to cool

title: crunchy pear and celery salad
steps:
1. Soak celery in a bowl of ice water for 15 minutes
2. Drain and pat dry
3. Cut into 1 / 2-inch pieces
4. Whisk together in a large bowl the vinegar , maple syrup and salt
5. Add pears and stir gently to coat
6. Add celery , cheese and pecans , stirring to combine
7. Season with pepper
8. Place the 6 lettuce leaves on plates and divide the salad , placing a portion on top of the lettuce on each plate
9. Serve either chilled or at room temperature
10. Variation: instead of cheddar and pecans , try a good parmesan and toasted walnuts

title: vegan  ricotta  cheese for lasagna  spanakopita  etc
steps:
1. Mash tofu to a fine consistency
2. Add yeast flakes and salt to taste
3. You want to go more "salty" than "yeasty"
4. Do not use brewer's yeast or baker's yeast they are not the same thing !
5. Use in recipes calling for ricotta such as lasagna , spanakopita , etc
6. You can add spices into the mix such as thyme , a little celery salt , etc

title: green peas   pork chow yoke
steps:
1. Stir fry pork in oil
2. Add onions , ginger and garlic
3. Add rest of vegetables
4. Add salt and pepper
5. Mix cornstarch and soy sauce into water
6. Pour into pan
7. Cook until thick

title: white chocolate  cranberry and coconut bar cookies
steps:
1. Mix the melted butter and graham cracker crumbs together in a bowl
2. Pat this crumb mixture into a 9"x13" aluminum pan lined with parchment paper
3. In a bowl , mix together the condensed milk , white chocolate chips , dried cranberries , and coconut
4. Carefully spread this mixture over the graham cracker crust
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 20-25 minutes until the top is firm and lightly browned
6. Let cool and cut into squares
7. Can be stored in a metal tin for up to two months
8. These cookies also freeze well

title: nutty flapjacks
steps:
1. Mix margarine and syrup together very gently
2. Mix the dry ingredients pour on the margarine mixture and mix well
3. Spread evenly in a greased swiss roll tin and press down firmly
4. Bake in a moderately hot oven 190c for about 20 minutes
5. Cut into fingers while warm

title: sesame meatball stir fry
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200c
2. Process mince , garlic salt , sesame seeds and half the onion
3. Roll into tablespoon size balls
4. Place on oven tray
5. Cook for 20 minutes or until browned all over and cooked through
6. Drain
7. Meanwhile rinse the noodles under hot water
8. Use hands to separate
9. Heat oil in the wok and add the veggies
10. Stir for about 2 minutes or until just soft
11. Add the noodles , meatballs , soy sauce and honey
12. Stir-fry until heated through

title: classic beef stroganoff
steps:
1. Cut the beef in very thin strips
2. The easiest way to do that is to put the meat in the freezer until slightly frozen
3. Add salt and pepper and 1 tbs oil to the beef strips and mix together
4. Melt 3 tbs butter and 1 tbs oil in a large skillet on medium heat
5. Increase heat and add strips of beef
6. You want to cook the beef quickly , browning it on each side
7. You may need to work in batches
8. When both sides are brown , remove the beef into a bowl and set aside while keeping warm
9. Add remaining butter and oil to the pan and saute the onions until golden , add the sliced mushrooms and cook for a few minutes , allowing them to soak up the pan drippings
10. Add the flour and continue stirring , add the broth and let it simmer until the sauce has thickened and the floury taste is cooked out
