11. Stir in the lemon zest , lemon juice and mustard , add salt and pepper to taste
12. Put the meat back in the sauce , heat through and add 1 / 2 a cup of sour cream , do not let the sauce cook anymore otherwise it will curdle
13. Serve on egg noodles , topped with a dollop of sour cream and garnish with chopped parsley
14. Enjoy !

title: rosemary garlic grilled steak
steps:
1. Marinate for 1 hour at room temp or 4 hours in fridge
2. Sprinkle with salt just before grilling
3. Grill 5-6 min per side for medium rare
4. Let stand 5 min before slicing on the diagonal
5. Good with rib grilling steaks as well

title: mexican taquitos  flautas
steps:
1. To make the sauce: add tomatoes , onion , garlic , salt , bullion cube , and chiles to a blender
2. Blend until smooth
3. In a sauce pan heat 1-2 teaspoons of vegetable oil over medium heat
4. Add sauce and simmer about 5-10 minutes
5. Reserve 1 / 4 cup of sauce for filling
6. To make filling: mix shredded meat and reserved sauce together will
7. Heat vegetable oil for frying in a deep fryer or tall saucepan to 350-375f
8. To make taquitos: wrap 12 of the tortillas in a kitchen towel and put in microwave for 2 minutes
9. Keep tortillas wrapped in towel while making taquitos so they don't dry out
10. Place one tortilla on the counter in front of you and add shredded meat mixture in a line across the tortilla on the side closest to you , but not all the way on the edge (about 2-3 tablespoons of mixture
11. Begin to roll tortilla around mixture , rolling away from you
12. Taquito should resemble a fat cigar
13. Pierce with a toothpick through the center of taquito to keep from unrolling
14. Add each taquito to oil as you go or they will dry out and crack
15. Do not crowd oil too much
16. I usually cook about 6-7 at a time
17. Feel taquitos with tongs as they cook
18. When they are hard , remove and drain on paper towels
19. I usually line a large bowl with paper towels and drain all of the taquitos vertically so that all of the excess oil can drain out
20. When those 12 tortillas are done , heat up the remaining 12 in the same towel and repeat
21. The reason i don't heat up all 24 at the same time is because the stack is so thick that the top and bottom few tortillas dry out and the middle ones are not cooked enough and will crack when you try to roll them
22. When all of the taquitos are finished , put as many as you want per serving on a plate
23. Top with sauce
24. Add shredded lettuce and sliced onion
25. Top that with a few spoonfuls of sour cream
26. Sprinkle with queso fresco
27. Yum !

title: superb christmas pudding  microwave
steps:
1. Combine all the ingredients in a medium bowl
2. Add a little browning sauce if you want it to be a little darker
3. Lightly butter a small pyrex bowl
4. Pack lightly into bowl
5. Butter some wax paper lightly and place over the mixing bowl
6. Place a second sheet over top and secure with elastic bands
7. Cook 5 minutes on high: rest for 5 minutes
8. Cook 3 minutes on high: rest for 5 minutes
9. Cook 30 seconds on high: rest for 5 minutes
10. Unmould and let cool
11. Brush all over with rum , brandy or whisky
12. Store at room temperature in greaseproof paper , or refrigerate in a plastic bag
13. This cake will keep well for several months
14. To serve: cut in thin slices with a sharp serrated knife

title: power oatmeal with blueberries and flax
steps:
1. Combine oats , flax and cinnamon
2. Add water and mix well
3. Don't add the protein powder or it will become overcooked-yick !
4. Microwave for one minute
5. Microwave times given are for a 1300wt microwave , you will probably need more time if you have a smaller wattage microwave
6. Remove bowl from microwave and stir in protein powder
7. Return to microwave and set timer for 2 minutes , stirring every 20-30 seconds until your desired consistency is reached
8. Watch carefully because the protein powder will puff and you don't want a mess !
9. Add blueberries and stir - i like warm blueberries so i return the bowl to the microwave for another 15-20 seconds
10. Sprinkle with a little cinnamon

title: marlboro country chicken fried steak  country fried
steps:
1. Trim steak , cut into 6 to 8 smaller pieces and pound thin
2. Combine milk , green tabasco sauce , and salt in one bowl
3. Add 1 cup of flour to a second bowl
4. Combine remaining flour , paprika , garlic , salt and pepper in a third bowl
5. Coat steak in first bowl of plain flour
6. Dip floured steak into milk mixture then coat with seasoned flour mixture
7. Set aside until all meat has been coated
8. Heat 1 to 2 inches of oil or fat in a heavy fry pan
9. Fry steaks approximately 2 min per side until golden brown
10. Drain on paper towels , serve with cream gravy , mashed potatoes and biscuits
11. For the cream gravy:
12. Pour off all but 6 tbsp of fat from the fry pan
13. Using the leftover seasoned flour first , add 6 tbsp flour and blend well
14. Gradually stir in milk
15. Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened , season with salt and pepper
16. Serve gravy over steaks

title: natalia s baked green beans
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Wash green beans throughout and drain
3. Snip stem edge of each green bean and place in a 7 x 14" casserole dish
4. In a small saucepan , add water , beef bouillons , adobo seasoning , garlic powder and black pepper
5. Let come to a rapid boil until bouillons are fully dissolved
6. Mix to distribute all seasonings
7. Pour seasoned water evenly over beans
8. Dot with bacon fat
9. Cover tightly with aluminum foil being careful not to leave any gaps so that steam can't escape
10. Place in oven and bake for 45 minutes or until tender
11. To serve , remove hot beans from pyrex with tongs
12. It should be salty like water from the sea
13. I've made this recipe so many times and don't measure the salt , therefore i don't have an exact amount so please use your best judgement
14. Once they are cooked with the beans the beans won't absorb the full amount of salt and they won't be as salty as you think
15. Therefore , you may need to increase the amount of bouillons if using the smaller version
16. On a personal level , i find that the knorr brand boosts the flavor of dishes better than most other brands

title: stir fried shredded beef with peppers
steps:
1. Trim fat from beef steak
2. Cut beef into very thin strips
3. Toss beef , 1 tbsp cornstarch , 2 tsp oil , the salt and pepper in ziploc bag
4. Refrigerate at least 30 minutes
5. Cut bell peppers into thin strips
6. Cut green onions into 1 inch pieces
7. Mix 2 tsp cornstarch , water , soy sauce and sesame oil
8. Set aside
9. Heat skillet or wok until very hot
10. Add 3 tbsp vegetable oil
11. Rotate skillet to coat bottom
12. Add beef and ginger
13. Stir-fry 1 minute or until meat is browned
14. Add bell peppers
15. Stir-fry 1 minute
16. Stir in cornstarch mixture
17. Cook and stir 15 seconds or until thickened
18. Stir in green onions
19. Serve over hot rice

title: broiled venison chops
steps:
1. Generously butter both sides of the chops and place them on a broiler pan positioned about 4 inches from the heat
2. Preheat the broiler and cook the chops for 5 minutes on each side
3. Serve on heated plates , adding salt and pepper at the table serve the chops with blackberry game sauce
4. --------blackberry game sauce---------
5. Place the berries in a saucepan over moderate heat and bring them to a boil
6. Add the sugar and lemon juice and simmer for another 20 minutes
7. Remove from heat and add the pectin
8. Cool and refrigerate for use with game
9. This recipe can be doubled
10. It can also be poured into sterilized jars and sealed with paraffin for long-time storage

title: colorado cache creamed broccoli w  almonds
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Arrange broccoli in 8x12 inch shallow baking dish
3. Melt butter and blend in flour
4. When mixture is smooth , add cream and hot water in which boullion cube has been dissolved
5. Stir constantly until mixture is smooth and thickended
6. Add sherry , lemon juice and pepper
7. When all are well blended , pour sauce over cooked broccoli and sprinkle with cheese and almonds
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes

title: grilled cheddar  bacon  and avocado sandwiches
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f cook bacon in the oven on a baking sheet with sides , turning strips over once , 12 minutes , or until crisp
2. Drain on paper towel
3. Place half the cheddar cheese on half the bread slices
4. Neatly arrange tomato slices , bacon strips , and avocado slices on top of cheese , then top with remaining cheese slices and bread
5. Heat 2 large heavy skillets or a griddle over medium-low heat
6. Carefully spread both sides of each sandwich with butter
7. Grill sandwiches , pressing down frequently with the back of a spatula , until bread is crisp and toasted to an even golden color and cheese is melted , about 2 minutes per side
8. Serve immediately , cutting sandwiches diagonally into halves

title: pork with prunes
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in skillet and saut the shallots for 3-4 minutes
2. Remove the shallots and brown the pork from all sides
3. Add the brandy and let stand 2-3 minutes , turning the pork to avoid burning
4. Then add the juices , cover with the lid and let simmer in very low heat
5. After 1
6. 5 hour add the shallots , salt and pepper
7. 10 minutes before the meat is done
8. Put the plums

title: pineapple cinnamon cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar together
2. Beat in egg and vanilla
3. Sift together the flour , baking powder and salt
4. Stir flour mixture into the batter
5. Add remaining ingredients
6. Combine well
7. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto parchment lined cookie sheets
8. Flatten slightly
9. Bake for 12-15 minutes at 350 degrees

title: crustless cheddar broccoli quiche
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Heat oil in small nonstick skillet on medium-high heat
3. Add onions
4. Cook 5 minutes or until onions are tender , stirring occasionally
5. Add broccoli
6. Mix well
7. Spoon into 9-inch pie plate sprayed with cooking spray
8. Mix remaining ingredients until well blended
9. Over broccoli layer
10. Bake 45-50 minutes or until center is set and top is golden brown

title: 6 point breakfast casserole ww
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Spray 8x8 inch baking pan with non-stick cooking spray
3. Arrange bread cubes in a single layer in prepared baking pan: sprinkle evenly with ham , then all but two tablespoons of the cheese
4. In medium mixing bowl , using a fork , beat eggs
5. Add milk , salt , and pepper
6. Beat well
7. Pour egg mixture over ingredients in pan
8. Sprinkle with remaining 2tablespoons cheese
9. Bake unil top is browned and knife inserted in center comes out clean , about 1 hour
10. Serve immediately

title: mexican bean soup
steps:
1. Spray the bottom of a soup pot with cooking spray and cook chicken breast
2. Cut in small chunks and set aside
3. Melt butter in bottom of soup pot and saute onion , carrots , and zucchini until tender
4. Add remaining ingredients and simmer
5. Serve with a warm tortilla and your choice of toppings such as
6. Cheese , salsa , cilanto , jalepinos , & avacados

title: coq au vin  chicken with wine
steps:
1. When cool , peel the outer skin
2. In a large saucepan , place the wine , broth , parsley sprigs , thyme and bay leaf
3. Bring to a simmer and cook for about 25 minutes or until reduced to about 3 cups
4. While the sauce is simmering , brown the bacon in a dutch oven , about 8 minutes
5. With a slotted spoon , transfer the bacon to a paper-towel-lined plate
6. Reserve 2 t
7. Fat in a small bowl and discard the rest
8. Season the chicken with salt and pepper and a little greek seasoning
9. Add 1 t
10. Of the reserved fat to the dutch oven and heat until just smoking
11. Add 1 / 2 the chicken in a single layer and lightly brown for about 2 minutes per side
12. Transfer chicken to a plate and repeat this step with the remaining chicken and fat
13. Melt 3 t
14. Butter in now-empty dutch oven over medium heat
15. When foaming subsides add the onions and mushrooms and cook about 7 minutes until lightly browned
16. Add garlic , tomato paste and flour and cook about 1 minute
17. Remove the bay leaf
18. Add the reduced wine mixture to the dutch oven , scraping the bottom to loosen the chicken bits and add 1 / 4 t
19. Pepper
20. At this point return the chicken and bacon to the dutch oven and bring to boil over high heat
21. Then , reduce heat , cover pot and simmer for 25 minutes or until chicken is tender
22. Stir occasionally
23. Transfer chicken to large bowl and tent with foil
24. Increase heat and simmer sauce until thick , about 5 minutes
25. Remove dutch oven from heat and stir in 2 t
26. Butter and 1 t
27. Wine
28. Add a little salt , return chicken to the pot and sprinkle with the minced parsley
29. Serve immediately over mashed potatoes

title: lemon ricotta pie
steps:
1. For pie pastry into a 9-inch glass pie plate , flute edges and chill while making the filling
2. To make the filling
3. In a large bowl place the ricotta , whipping cream , eggs , 1 / 2 cup plus 2 tablespoons sugar marsala , lemon zest , cinnamon , vanilla and almond extract and flour
4. Mix well to combine
5. Sprinkle the crushed amaretti biscuits over the unbaked pie shell
6. Spoon the ricotta filling over the crushed biscuits and spread out evenly
7. Place the unbaked pie in the fridge for 20-25 minutes
8. Set oven to 350 degrees
9. Place the pie plate on a baking sheet
10. Bake for about 1-1 / 4 hours or until firm to the touch
11. Turn the oven heat off and leave the door a little open
12. Leave the pie in the oven with heat off until oven is cool
13. Cool completely before slicing

title: lime pie la lechera
steps:
1. Beat sweetened condensed milk and lime juice in small mixer bowl until combined
2. Stir in lime peel
3. Pour into crust , spread with whipped topping
4. Refrigerate for 2 hours or until set

title: oven fried chicken from marcia adams
steps:
1. Place the oil and butter in a shallow cooking pan and put in preheated 375 degree oven to melt
2. Set aside
3. In large bowl or plastic bag , combine flour and seasonings
4. Mix well
5. Roll the chicken pieces , a few at a time , in the oil / butter mixture and then drudge in flour mixture
6. Place coated chicken pieces into pan , skin side down
7. Bake at 375 for 45 minutes
8. Turn over the chicken pieces and bake for another 5-10 minutes or until top crust is bubbly
9. Serve hot or cold

title: simple stove top stuffing
steps:
1. In a saucepan saut onion and celery in butter on medium for about 5 minutes until onion is soft
2. Mix next four ingredients in small bowl and add to onion mixture
3. Heat and stir for about 1 minute until fragrant
4. Add bread cubes and stir
5. Then add chicken broth slowly while stirring
6. Bread should be moist but not mushy
7. Fluff with fork to serve
8. If you want to make simple baked stuffing put stuffing into greased 2 quart casserole dish
9. Cover and bake at 325f for 30 minutes
10. Can buddy with chicken in oven

title: chicken tagine with lemon
steps:
1. Finely chop garlic , cilantro and parsley in food processor
2. Transfer to bowl
3. Add onions , lemon juice , olive oil ,
4. Paprika , lemon peel , ground cumin , salt , pepper , and saffron
5. Mix well
6. Pour over chicken in pan
7. Cover well and refrigerate for
8. Up to 24 hours
9. Preheat oven to 400
10. Add 1 c water
11. Cover and bake until chicken is cooked through
12. Serve on platter with juices

title: summer veggie salad
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , bring 4 inches of water to a boil
2. Add carrots , beans , and peas
3. Cook for 4 minutes
4. Drain and rinse in cold water
5. Place in a bowl
6. Add zucchini and yellow squash , onions , red pepper and olives
7. In a jar with a tight fitting lid , combine oil and next 7 ingredients
8. Shake well
9. Pour over vegetable mixture and toss to coat
10. Refrigerate for up to 1 hour
11. Just before serving , sprinkle with parmesan cheese

title: sweet potato supreme
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Peel , cube and boil potatoes until soft
3. Mash potatoes with butter , cinnamon , nutmeg , brown sugar and salt
4. Add enough milk to make mashed potatoe consistency
5. Pour into a 10 inch baking dish
6. Topping:
7. Combine butter , sugar , milk and salt in a saucepan and cook over low heat , stirring until thick and bubbly
8. When cool , add vanilla
9. Sprinkle chopped pecans over potatoes
10. Pour topping over the pecans
11. Bake 15-20 minutes

title: spicy mongolian beef
steps:
1. Combine cornstarch with vinegar and half of the sauces
2. Marinate beef in bowl with five spice , sugar , garlic , egg and sauce mixture for an hour
3. Heat half the oil in a wok
4. Stir-fry beef in batches , leaving the excess marinade in the bowl
5. Set cooked beef aside
6. Heat remaining oil in wok and stir-fry onion until soft
7. Add carrot and bell pepper and cook for a further minute , leaving the vegetables crispy
8. Return beef to wok with broccoli and snow peas
9. Add the saved marinade , the rest of the sauces and the stock
10. Cook , stirring often , until sauce biols and thickens slightly
11. Serve with your favourite type of rice or noodles

title: chocolate macaroon muffins
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine flour , sugar , cocoa , baking powder , salt and chocolate chips
2. Combine milk , egg and oil
3. Mix well
4. Stir into dry ingredients just until moistened
5. Spoon 2 tablespoonfuls into 12 greased or paper-lined muffin cups
6. Combine 1 cup coconut , condensed milk and extract
7. Place 2 teaspoonfuls in the center of each cup
8. Top with remaining batter
9. Sprinkle with remaining coconut
10. Bake at 400 degrees for 20-22 minutes or until muffins test done
11. Cool for 5 minutes before removing from pan to a wire rack

title: shredded salsa verde beef  crock pot
steps:
1. Place roast in crock pot
2. Sprinkle with salt , pepper and garlic salt
3. Pour salsa verde over roast
4. Cover , and cook on low for 8 hours
5. When done , the roast should shred easily with a fork

title: honey chicken thighs
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. Combine first 6 ingredients in a large bowl
3. Add chicken to bowl
4. Toss to coat
5. Place chicken on a broiler pan coated with cooking spray
6. Broil chicken 5 minutes on each side
7. Combine honey and vinegar in a small bowl , stirring well
8. Remove chicken from oven
9. Brush 1 / 4 cup honey mixture on chicken
10. Broil 1 minute
11. Remove chicken from oven and turn over
12. Brush chicken with remaining honey mixture
13. Broil 1 additional minute or until chicken is done

title: crepes suzette
steps:
1. To prepare crepes:
2. In blender , combine milk , flour and eggs
3. Process until smooth
4. Let stand 15 minutes so bubbles will subside
5. Lightly spray 6" non-stick skillet or crepe pan with non-stick cooking spray and heat
6. Pour 1 / 4 cup of batter into pan and quickly swirl batter so it covers the entire bottom of the pan
7. Cook over medium-high heat until edges and underside are dry
8. Using pancake turner , carefully turn crepe over
9. Cook other side briefly just to dry , about 30 seconds
10. Slide crepe onto a plate and keep warm in oven
11. Repeat procedure 7 more times using remaining batter and making 7 more crepes
12. To prepare sauce:
13. In 12 inch non-stick skillet , melt margarine
14. Add sugar , and stir until dissolved
15. Stir in orange juice , concentrated orange juice and brandy extract
16. Bring mixture to a boil
17. Mix cornstarch with a bit of water and add
18. Reduce heat to low
19. To prepare "crepes suzette":
20. Add on crepe to skillet , coating both sides with sauce
21. Fold crepe in half , then fold again to create triangular shape
22. Slide to side of skillet and repeat procedure with remaining crepes
23. Serve immediately sprinkled lightly with dusting of icing sugar

title: swedish melon with red raspberry puree  melon och hallendessert
steps:
1. Cut melon in half and scoop out seeds
2. Scoop out melon with melon baller , or you can cut into small bite-sized cubes
3. Place in a serving bowl
4. At this point you have a choice
5. You can marinate the melon in a little rum for an hour or more , or you can just continue
6. If you marinated them , pour off any extra rum
7. Now , place raspberries in sieve over small bowl , and force berries thru sieve to remove seeds
8. Add sugar and lemon juice to seived raspberry puree
9. Pour raspberry puree over melon and chill for several hours
10. Serve from bowl , or serve in individual dessert dishes
11. You can even serve this with a little ice cream or whipped cream
12. But it's just fine on it's own

title: garlic linguine
steps:
1. Cook linguine according to package directions in a large pot of boiling , salted water
2. Drain
3. Heat oil , garlic , pepper flakes in a saucepan over medium-high heat while pasta cooks
4. Cook until garlic begins to sizzle , about 1 minute , then toss linguine with garlic oil mixture

title: light rye
steps:
1. Load ingredients in the order give
2. Bake with regular , rapid or delayed time bake cycle

title: cheyenne   chicken
steps:
1. Cut steaks in 1 inch cubes
2. Mix egg and milk
3. Alternate pieces of veal and pork on 6 skewers
4. Dip in egg mix then crumbs
5. Brown in hot oil
6. Put in baking pan
7. Add 1 inch water
8. Cover and bake at 350 for 40 minutes

title: winter minestrone   giada de laurentiis
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a heavy large pot over medium heat
2. Add the onion , carrots , celery , pancetta , and garlic
3. Saute until the onion is translucent , about 10 minutes
4. Add the swiss chard and potato
5. Saute for 2 minutes
6. Add the tomatoes and rosemary sprig
7. Simmer until the chard is wilted and the tomatoes break down , about 10 minutes
8. Meanwhile , blend 3 / 4 cup of the beans with 1 / 4 cup of the broth in a processor until almost smooth
9. Add the pureed bean mixture , remaining broth , and parmesan cheese rind to the vegetable mixture
10. Simmer until the potato pieces are tender , stirring occasionally , about 15 minutes
11. Stir in the whole beans and parsley
12. Simmer until the beans are heated through and the soup is thick , about 2 minutes
13. Season with salt and pepper , to taste
14. Discard parmesan rind and rosemary sprig
15. Ladle the soup into bowls and serve

title: vinegar glossed chicken
steps:
1. Strip rosemary leaves from stems
2. Combine with vinegar and garlic
3. Let stand as long as possible , up to 2 hours , to allow flavors to mingle
4. Season chicken liberally with salt and pepper
5. Heat oil in heavy skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering
6. Add chicken pieces , skin side down
7. Sear without moving , 3-5 minutes , until browned
8. Turn over and sear off second side until browned
9. Drain and discard any excess fat
10. Add chicken broth and scrape up any fond from the bottom of the pan
11. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat and simmer 15-20 minutes , until reduced to 2-3 tablespoons add vinegar mixture and turn heat up to high
12. Cook until a thick glaze has formed , 6-8 minutes
13. Turn chicken to fully coat
14. Serve with polenta or rice

title: plum   date chutney
steps:
1. Preheat grill and line the grill pan with foil
2. Mix the onions and oil and spread them out in the pan
3. Grill for 12-15 minutes or until soft and charred
4. Put the plum slices into a large bowl and add the hot onions with all the reamining ingredients
5. Leave to marinate for 1 hour , then taste and add salt and pepper , plus a little extra sugar if you like
6. Goes great with cold meats or stuffed into a pitta bread with a strong cheese

title: marge hildebrand s beef stew
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients into crock pot cooker
2. Cook at low setting 250f for at least 5 hours

title: aubergine  tomato   parmesan bake  melanzane alla parmigiana
steps:
1. Heat oven to 360f
2. In a shallow pan , mix together the garlic , crushed red pepper flakes , and 4 tbsp of the olive oil
3. Cook over a high heat for 3 mins , pour in the tomatoes , then simmer for 8 mins , stirring every now and then
4. Stir in the tomato pure
5. Meanwhile , heat a griddle pan until very hot
6. Brush a few of the aubergines with a little oil , then add to the pan
7. Cook over a high heat until well browned and cooked through , about 5-7 minutes
8. Turn them halfway through cooking
9. Lift onto kitchen paper and do the next batch
10. When all the aubergines are cooked , lay a few of them in the bottom of an ovenproof dish , then spoon over some sauce
11. Sprinkle with parmesan and basil leaves
12. Add seasoning , then repeat this process with the remaining ingredients
13. Finally , pour the egg over the top , sprinkle over a little more parmesan , then bake for 20 mins or until the topping is golden

title: chilekeesh
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 deg f
2. In oven , melt butter in 8-inch square pan , tilting pan to grease sides
3. Beat eggs in a bowl
4. Add flour , baking powder , melted butter , chiles , cottage cheese and cheddar cheese
5. Mix well
6. Pour into prepared baking pan and bake for 35 minutes or until golden

title: old fashioned raisin bars
steps:
1. Combine raisins and water in a saucepan
2. Bring to a boil
3. Remove from heat
4. Stir in salad oil , cool to lukewarm
5. Stir in sugar and egg
6. Sift together dry ingredients
7. Beat into raisin mixture
8. Stir in nuts
9. Pour batter into greased 9 x 13" pan
10. Bake at 350 for 20 minutes or until done
11. When cooled cut into bars
12. Dust with powdered sugar

title: rice   almond pudding  ris a l amande
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , combine rice and milk
2. Cook over medium heat 45 minutes or until rice is tender
3. Set aside to cool
4. In a medium bowl , whip cream until stiff
5. Stir in vanilla
6. Stir whipped cream , sugar and chopped almonds into cooled rice mixture
7. Spoon into a serving dish
8. Refrigerate 3 to 4 hours
9. Sprinkle with toasted almonds
10. To make sauce: heat cherries with juice
11. Dissolve cornstarch in a little water
12. Stir into cherries
13. Gently stir over medium heat until thickened
14. Flavor with liquer , if desired
15. Serve rice pudding with hot cherry sauce
16. Interesting
17. The person who found it would receive the prize-a marzipan pig

title: low calorie tata cake
steps:
1. Spray cake pan with pam and preheat oven to 350f
2. Beat egg whites in a bowl until very thick
3. In a separate bowl , beat egg yolks with applesauce and flour
4. This is the step i added in the ground lemon peel and lemon juice
5. Fold in egg yolk mixture to egg whites , and transfer to cake pan
6. Bake in oven until toothpick comes out clean and let cool

title: vegan east coast chili
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a medium sized pot
2. Add the onion and cook covered until onions are soft
3. Add the chili powder , cayenne , oregano , all the tomato products , and water
4. Bring to a boil , then simmer covered for about 15 minutes
5. Add the kidney beans and burger crumbles and simmer for about 30 minutes
6. Serve on its own or over cooked macaroni

title: lemon cream cheese cookies
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 375
2. Beat cream cheese and butter until light and fluffy
3. Mix in 1 / 2 of the cake mix , the egg and the vanilla until smooth
4. Stir in remaining cake mix
5. Drob by teaspoons
6. On ungreased cookie sheet
7. Bake 8-10 minutes

title: tomates rellenos   tapas
steps:
1. Cut the tops off the tomatoes and maybe a slice off the bottom so you can stand them flat
2. Remove the insides of the tomatoes with a spoon or knife
3. Mix the eggs , aioli , salt , pepper and parsley
4. Fill the tomatoes
5. Replace the tops , sprinkle with some olive oil and black pepper
6. If you are using mayonnaise instead of aioli , season it with garlic

title: easy strawberry   banana milkshake
steps:
1. Chop banana
2. Put all ingredients in a blender
3. Blend for 35 seconds or until it's of the right consistency
4. Enjoy !

title: jarlesburglimpe
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200c
2. Combine meat , egg , seasoning , onion , capsicum and cheese in knead together
3. Form a log shape and place in a baking dish
4. Drape the sliced cheese over the meat and then cover with overlapping bacon rashers
5. Pour water in baking dish and place in oven
6. Bake for 1 hours
7. If the bacon starts to brown too much cover with a piece of foil

title: european kraut soup
steps:
1. Cook mushrooms in 1 quart of water for 30 minutes
2. Add kraut and cook for another 25 minutes
3. Lightly brown onion in 1 tablespoon butter and add to soup
4. In a saucepan , melt remaining butter
5. Whisk in flour and lightly brown
6. Add flour mixture to mushrooms , kraut and onions
7. Cook 1 -2 minutes longer
8. Add salt to taste
9. Top each serving with a dash of paprika

title: our favorite chili atk
steps:
1. Beans: combine 3 tablespoons salt , 4 quarts water , and beans in large dutch oven and bring to boil over high heat
2. Remove pot from heat , cover , and let stand 1 hour
3. Drain and rinse well
4. Adjust oven rack to lower-middle position and heat oven to 300 degrees
5. Chili paste: place ancho chiles in 12-inch skillet set over medium-high heat
6. Toast , stirring frequently , until flesh is fragrant , 4 to 6 minutes , reducing heat if chiles begin to smoke
7. Transfer to bowl of food processor and cool
8. Do not wash out skillet
9. Add rbol chiles , cornmeal , oregano , cumin , cocoa , and teaspoon salt to food processor with toasted ancho chiles
10. Process until finely ground , about 2 minutes
11. With processor running , very slowly add cup broth until smooth paste forms , about 45 seconds , scraping down sides of bowl as necessary
12. Transfer paste to small bowl
13. Chili: place onions in now-empty processor bowl and pulse until roughly chopped , about four 1-second pulses
14. Add jalapenos and pulse until consistency of chunky salsa , about four 1-second pulses , scraping down bowl as necessary
15. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in large dutch oven over medium-high heat
16. Add onion mixture and cook , stirring occasionally , until moisture has evaporated and vegetables are softened , 7 to 9 minutes
17. Add garlic and cook until fragrant , about 1 minute
18. Add chili paste , tomatoes , and molasses
19. Stir until chili paste is thoroughly combined
20. Add remaining 2 cups broth and drained beans
21. Bring to boil , then reduce heat to simmer
22. Meanwhile , heat 1 tablespoon oil in 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering
23. Pat beef dry with paper towels and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon salt
24. Add half of beef and cook until browned on all sides , about 10 minutes
25. Transfer meat to dutch oven
26. Add bottle lager to skillet , scraping bottom of pan to loosen any browned bits , and bring to simmer
27. Transfer lager to dutch oven
28. Repeat with remaining tablespoon oil , steak , and lager
29. Once last addition of lager has been added to dutch oven , stir to combine and return mixture to simmer
30. Cover pot and transfer to oven
31. Cook until meat and beans are fully tender , 1 to 2 hours
32. Let chili stand , uncovered , 10 minutes
33. Stir well and season to taste with salt before serving

title: quick and easy kung pao chicken for two
steps:
1. Combine the soy sauce , vinegar , sugar and ginger in a medium size bowl
2. Stir and set aside
3. Cut the chicken breasts into strips
4. Add to the bowl and marinate for 10 minutes
5. Wash the scallions
6. Trim 1 / 4 inch off the white root end and 2 inches off the top of the green stalks and discard them
7. Cut the remaining white and green parts into 1 / 2-inch pieces
8. Wash the red bell pepper
9. Remove and discard the stem and seeds
10. Then slice the pepper into 1 / 4-inch strips
11. Wash the snow peas and pull the strings off the sides by snapping 1 / 4 inch off each end and pulling firmly along each edge
12. Discard the ends and strings
13. Heat the oil in a large wok or frying pan over high heat
14. Add the red pepper flakes and cook for a few seconds
15. Add the chicken , plus the marinade in the bowl , and stir-fry for 3 minutes , or until the chicken has turned white on all sides
16. Add the scallions , red bell pepper and snow peas and stir-fry for 2 more minutes , or until the vegetables just begin to soften
17. Stir in the orange juice and ketchup and heat through
18. Add the peanuts and stir
19. Serve hot

title: iced orange coffee
steps:
1. Place the orange peel , water and sugar in a saucepan
2. Boil for 5 minutes
3. Remove the peel and let the syrup cool
4. Mix the orange juice with the coffee and syrup
5. Add the whipping cream
6. Pour over crushed ice in tall glasses

title: winter veggies
steps:
1. You may choose to use the full amount though
2. In a large pot fitted with a steamer basket , bring water to a boil and add cauliflower florets , cook for 3 minutes
3. Then the broccoli for 3 minutes
4. Add the snow peas for 3 minutes
5. Then the tomatoes for 3 minutes
6. Check for doneness
7. Transfer vegetables to a large mixing bowl and season with garlic powder and salt and pepper , to taste , and toss with melted butter
8. Place in a warmed bowl and serve family style

title: jalepeno cheddar chicken soup
steps:
1. Cook chicken , shred , and set aside
2. Melt butter in soup pot
3. Saute garlic and jalepenos
4. Add flour , 1 tablespoon at a time , stirring until the mixture is a paste , but you can still see bubbles from the butter
5. Add chicken broth slowly while stirring mixture
6. Same for milk and cream of chicken
7. Slowly raise temperature of soup to just below boiling point
8. Stir frequently
9. Whisk in about 1 / 4c of cheese until completely melted
10. Repeat until all cheese is melted into soup
11. Once cheese is melted in add chicken
12. Stir in sour cream , salt , and pepper until smooth
13. Enjoy !

title: pancakes with lemon and sugar for shrove tuesday   pancake day
steps:
1. You will also need a good solid 7 inch or 8 inch frying pan , some kitchen paper , greaseproof paper , a palette knife or flexible pan slice , and a ladle
2. Sift the flour and a pinch of salt into a large bowl
3. Make a well in the centre with the back of a spoon then break in the eggs and pour in half the milk
4. Whisk together , gradually incorporating the flour to make a smooth thick batter
5. Beat thoroughly to remove any lumps , then stir in the rest of the milk
6. Pour the pancake batter into a jug or a bowl with a pouring lip
7. Now get the pan really hot , then turn the heat down to medium and , to start with , do a test pancake to see if you're using the correct amount of batter
8. (i find 2 tablespoons about right for a 7 inch pan and 3 tablespoons for an 8 inch pan
9. ) pancakes should always be cooked in butter
10. Melt 2 oz of butter in a pan , pour the excess in to a bowl
11. Then add 2 tablespoons of the melted butter to the batter and whisk it inches
12. Pour the batter into the pan , tilting the pan as you pour , until the batter thinly coats the base
13. Cook over a moderate heat for 30 seconds to one minute until golden brown on the underside
14. Flip over the pancake with a palette knife , and cook the other side until it is golden brown
15. Slide the pancake out of the pan on to a plate , heat a little more oil or butter and cook the remaining pancakes one at a time in the same way
16. If preparing in advance , cook and stack the pancakes
17. Reheat in the microwave on medium for about 2 minutes
18. Alternatively , heat the oven to 180c / gas 4 / fan 160c wrap the pancakes in foil and warm them through in the oven for 10 minutes
19. To serve
20. To serve , sprinkle each pancake with freshly squeezed lemon juice and caster sugar , fold in half , then in half again to form triangles , or else simply roll them up into long tubes
21. Serve sprinkled with a little more sugar and lemon juice and extra wedges of lemon
22. To freeze
23. Pancakes freeze very well , stacked as above then placed in freezer bags
24. If frozen , it's best to defrost the pancakes before reheating

title: rigatoni al forno  baked rigatoni  with roasted asparagus and on
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Put a large pot of water on to boil
3. Pour olive oil into a 9x13 glass baking dish
4. Break up onion chunks , add to pan and stir to coat in oil
5. Leave pan uncovered , place in oven and roast onions 5 minutes
6. Add pasta to boiling water
7. After onions have roasted 5 minutes , add asparagus
8. Stir and sprinkle with the salt
9. Spread it all in a single layer and roast 5 more minutes
10. Drain pasta when al dente
11. Stir into vegetables and add vinegar , pepper and parmesan
12. Mix well
13. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top
14. Cover with foil and return to oven
15. Bake until bread crumbs are brown and crisp , 10-15 minutes
16. Serve hot with a cruet of balsamic vinegar

title: orange butter frosting
steps:
1. Beat powdered sugar and butter in mixing bowl
2. Add orange rind and enough juice to make of spreading consistency
3. Beat until smooth
4. Yield enough frosting for 1 cake layer --

title: zucchini pasta  baked
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a oven proof baking dish , with cooking spray
3. Grate zucchini , drain in colander removing excess water
4. Cook pasta in large saucepan , until al dente , drain well and set aside
5. Heat butter in frying pan , add spring onion and cook one minute
6. Add garlic and saute' for 1 minute
7. Add drained zucchini to pan , and cook for 4 minutes , or until soft
8. Cool slightly
9. Place eggs , cream , ricotta , mozzarella , ditalini , and half the parmesan in a bowl and mix together well
10. Stir in zucchini mixture , adding salt , pepper , and red pepper flakes if using
11. Place this mixture in dish , add sprinkle rest of parmesan
12. Bake 25-30 minutes , or until firm and golden
13. Add chopped parsley or cilantro for garnish after removing from oven

title: jalapeno cheese cornbread
steps:
1. Mix first 5 ingredients in large bowl
2. Mix eggs , oil , and milk well in separate bowl
3. Pour liquid into dry mixing lightly
4. Add jalapeno and cheese mixing just until blended
5. Pour into greased 13x9 baking dish
6. Bake at 400 for 40 - 45 minute until golden brown and a toothpick comes out clean

title: moroccan chicken and barley pilaf
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , saut onion and carrots in olive oil over medium heat for about 5-10 minutes until onion begins to soften
2. Add garlic , cinnamon , cumin , and barley
3. Stir to coat
4. Add chicken broth , sherry , and bay leaf
5. Bring to a boil , cover pan , and reduce heat to simmer for about 40-45 minutes , stirring occasionally , until liquid is absorbed
6. When barley is nearly done , heat butter in skillet
7. Add chicken , cherry tomatoes , apples , pecans , raisins , lemon zest , lemon juice , salt and pepper
8. Saut 5 minutes until heated through
9. Mix with barley
10. Serve with lemon wedges

title: chicken empanadas   colombia   empanadas de pollo
steps:
1. The chicken
2. - place chicken thighs in a large pot with 8 cups of boiling water
3. - add the celery , onion , garlic , kosher salt and cumin
4. - boil over medium heat for approximately 1 hour
5. - with a slotted spoon , carefully remove chicken from the pot , place it in a bowl and cover with a kitchen towel
6. Allow it to cool until safe to handle
7. - cover the pot and continue to cook the stock on low heat
8. - once the chicken has cooled , remove the skin and the bones
9. Drop the bones and skin into the stock pot , cover and continue to cook
10. With your fingers , pull the chicken meat apart so it resembles shredded meat
11. Put into a bowl , cover and refrigerate
12. - allow the chicken stock to boil on low heat for another hour
13. Using a sieve , separate the broth from all the rest of the ingredients and allow it to cool for about 30 minutes
14. Discard the stock ingredients
15. The dough
16. - mix all the dry ingredients together in a large bowl and begin to add the chicken broth until you have a smooth , humid , easy to work dough
17. I usually add two cups and work the dough with my hands
18. Then , i add the chicken stock 1 / 2 cup at a time until i get the consistency i need
19. - cover the bowl and let the masa rest for about one hour in the refrigerator
20. The filling
21. - in a frying pan , heat the butter , margarine or oil over medium heat and saute the onions and tomatoes
22. - in a large bowl , combine the chicken , potatoes , chopped cilantro , garlic powder and pepper
23. - add the sauteed onion-tomato mixture and stir until well blended
24. Check for salt and adjust spices to your liking
25. The empanada
26. - now , if you have a tortilla press , youre sitting pretty for the next step
27. If you dont have one , two pieces of 1 wood about 8 square will do just fine
28. Lacking that , anything flat and a counter top will work
29. Or , if you feel adventurous , you can use your own two little hands !
30. - roll the masa into little balls about 1 in diameter
31. Cover the bottom part of the tortilla press with a piece of plastic wrap
32. Place the masa ball on top of the plastic wrap
33. Cover with another piece of plastic and press it into a flat circle
34. Remove the top piece of plastic
35. Now add about one rounded tablespoon of the filling to the middle of the circle leaving about 1 / 2 of space on the sides
36. Using the plastic , fold the circle in half and press the edges together so it forms a half-moon
37. While still in the plastic , press the edges firmly together between your thumb and middle finger so the empanada is sealed
38. I like to make them pretty so , after the empanada is sealed , i remove it from the plastic and use the
39. - cook them in bunches but dont prepare too many at a time and let them sit while the others cook since this tends to dry out the masa too much
40. Also , as you are cooking , keep the bowl of masa covered with a humid towel to keep it from getting too dry
41. Cooking
42. - the traditional method , of course , is to fry the empanadas in a large , iron cauldron , on top of a wood fire , outdoors , in about twenty pounds of pork lard that was used to fry the empanadas for the last month and a half
43. - however , tradition does not always mean that it is right
44. Much of the time tradition simply means lack of technology and alternate methods
45. - i use a deep-fat fryer filled with canola or peanut oil
46. For even healthier empanadas , they can be baked in the oven at 350 degrees f on a greased cookie sheet
47. Baking them , of course , takes longer and you will have to turn the empanadas once
48. Bake or fry until golden brown
49. - if you fry them , make sure you place the finished empanadas on a cookie sheet whose bottom you have lined with a thick layer of paper towels
50. This will allow the excess oil to drain
51. - the tradition in colombia is to have an empanada in one hand and a wedge of lemon in the other
52. As you take a bite , you squeeze a few drops of lemon juice inside
53. A bowl of your favorite salsa and a teaspoon will also do the job quite well
54. This recipe should yield approximately 4 to 5 dozen empanadas

title: crusader cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large bowl mix all ingredients well , then mix on medium speed for 3 minutes
3. Grease and flour a bundt pan or use bakers joy spray
4. Bake for 50-60 until cake pulls away from the pan and toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
5. Cool in pan for 25 minutes
6. Then remove cake from pan and continue cooling on rack
7. Glaze:
8. In a small bowl mix all glaze ingredients and spread over top of cooled cake

title: swiss steak without tomato
steps:
1. Put flour , salt , and pepper in large ziploc baggie
2. Add pounded steak pieces and shake well
3. Do not remove from bag
4. In large dutch oven , heat oil over medium high heat until shimmering
5. Shake baggie to recoat steak pieces , shake each piece to remove excess flour , and add to skillet
6. Fry until browned on each side , approximately 2 minutes per side
7. Add onions to dutch oven , cover and cook for one minute
8. Add soup and broth , stir well , add steak pieces , cover , and place in 325 oven for 90 minutes
9. If using mushrooms , add after 60 minutes and replace in oven
10. This makes a lot of gravy that doesn't usually have to be thickened and is wonderful on boiled or mashed potatoes

title: gingered parsnip bisque
steps:
1. Melt butter in heavy pot over medium heat
2. Add next 5 ingredients and saute until vegetables are tender , about 5 minutes
3. Stir in broth and parsnips
4. Bring to boil
5. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer until parsnips are tender , about 20 minutes
6. Cool slightly
7. Working in batches , puree soup in blender until smooth
8. Strain into another large pot
9. Discard solids in stainer
10. Whisk in half and half
11. Simmer soup over medium heat until heated through , about 10 minutes
12. Season soup with salt and pepper to taste

title: seafood lasagne
steps:
1. Make roux with butter , garlic , flour , and salt
2. When bubbly remove from heat
3. Stir in milk and broth
4. Heat this until boiling
5. Continue to cook , while stirring constantly , for one minute or until thickened
6. Add onion , basil , and mozzarella
7. Cook over very low heat until cheese is melted
8. Spread 1 1 / 2 cups of this mixture on bottom of 9x13 inch pan
9. Top with 3 or 4 uncooked lasagne noodles
10. Spread cottage cheese over this
11. Repeat with another quarter of the sauce and 3 or 4 more noodles
12. Top this with crab and shrimp and another quarter of the sauce
13. Add 3 or 4 more noodles and top with remaining sauce
14. Sprinkle parmesan on top
15. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 35-40 minutes
16. Let stand 15 minutes before cutting

title: paula deen s fiery cajun shrimp
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
2. Stir together the butter , worcestershire sauce , lemon juice , pepper , hot sauce , garlic , and salt
3. Pour half this mixture into a large heatproof dish
4. Layer half the shrimp and half the lemon slices in the dish
5. Then form a second layer with the remaining shrimp and lemon slices , and pour remaining sauce into the dish
6. Bake , uncovered , for 20 minutes , or until the shrimp are pink , stirring twice
7. Pour off the sauce into individual serving dishes
8. Serve the shrimp with plenty of french bread for dipping in the spicy butter sauce

title: deep fried tofu with peanut sauce
steps:
1. Cut the tofu in 1- 1 / 2 inch square pieces
2. Set aside
3. Make a paste of the garlic , coriander , 3 seeded chili peppers , and salt
4. Add the vinegar and mix
5. Dissolve the 1 / 4 cup sugar in 1 / 4 cup hot water and add it to the paste along with the 1 / 4 cup of chopped peanuts
6. Mix well and put it in a serving bowl
7. Sprinkle with coriander leaves and red pepper flakes
8. Put the 2 cup of peanut oil in a wok or frying pan over medium-high heat
9. Deep-fry the tofu in hot oil for 5 minutes , until a light gold
10. Drain on paper towels
11. Place the tofu on a serving plate and the bowl of peanut sauce next to it
12. Use the peanut sauce as a dip
13. Serve either hot or at room temperature

title: ice cream party loaf
steps:
1. Preheat over to 350
2. Prepare cake as directed , b ut bake in a 9x5x3 inch loaf pan
3. Bake 55-60 minutes or until done with a toothpick
4. Cool 20 minutes then remove from pan
5. When completely cool , split into 3 layers using long serrated knife
6. Spread softened chocolate ice cream between bottom and middle layers
7. Spread softened strawberry ice cream between middle and top layers
8. Freeze until ice cream is hard
9. Whip cream until stiff then add sugar
10. Spread on sides and top of loaf
11. Garnish with cherries
12. Serve at once or stor in freezer up to 4 weeks

title: venetian calf liver and onions
steps:
1. Heat 3 tablespoons oil in heavy large skillet over medium heat
2. Add onions , 1 / 2 teaspoon thyme and 1 / 2 teaspoon sage and saut until onion is tender and brown , about 20 minutes
3. Transfer to bowl
4. Add remaining 1 tablespoon oil to skillet
5. Add garlic and cook until golden brown , about 2 minutes
6. Discard garlic
7. Combine flour , remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon thyme and remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon sage in bowl
8. Season with salt and pepper
9. Pat liver dry and add to flour mixture and toss to coat
10. Add butter to garlic oil and melt over medium-high heat
11. Add liver and stir until beginning to brown on outside but still pink inside , about 3 minutes
12. Add onions and saut until liver is just cooked through , about 5 minutes
13. Stir in parsley

title: banana date walnut muffins  low fat  vegan
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 and spray a muffin pan with non-stick spray or line with wax paper muffin cups
2. Sift together the flour , baking powder , salt , and cinnamon
3. In another bowl , mash the banana with the sugar , soymilk , apple sauce , and agave nectar
4. Pour the banana mixture into the flour mixture and stir just until combined
5. Add in the dates and walnuts , and pour into 12 muffin cups
6. Bake for 15-20 minutes , until a toothpick comes out clean

title: chicken a l orange
steps:
1. Preparation:
2. Cut each slice of bread in half
3. Brush with melted butter and overlap on the bottom of a 13-inch x 9-inch x 2-inch baking pan
4. In a bowl , whisk the eggs , frangelico , vanilla , sugar and salt
5. Add the cream and mix until thoroughly incorporated
6. Add cinnamon and nutmeg if desired
7. Pour over bread
8. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour
9. Set the pan inside a larger pan containing at least 1 inch of warm water
10. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour or until fully set
11. Cool
12. Cut into desired shape
13. Score the fat side of each chicken breast with a good knife
14. Season with salt , pepper and sugar
15. In a large saut pan over high heat , heat the oil
16. Add the chicken breasts , fat side down
17. Reduce heat to medium
18. Baste the chicken with the oil and chicken juices for 8 to 10 minutes
19. Remove from the heat
20. Add grand marnier and let it rest for 5 minutes
21. Remove the chicken and keep warm
22. Add sherry , sugar and orange juice to the pan
23. Cook until sauce is reduced
24. Strain through a fine sieve and return to the heat
25. Add the orange segments
26. In another pan , wilt the spinach
27. To serve , place bread pudding in center of plate
28. Place spinach around it
29. Slice chicken and fan on top of pudding
30. Cover with sauce and serve

title: herbed turkey burger
steps:
1. Saut the chopped onion in olive oil for 3 minutes over medium heat
2. Add the garlic and saut for another 2 minutes , or until the garlic begins to brown
3. Remove from heat
4. Transfer the onions , garlic , and oil to a large bowl to cool down
5. Once the onions are cool to the touch , add the ground turkey , salt , pepper , and herbs into the bowl
6. Using your hands , gently mix everything until well combined
7. You want the herbs mixed in without overworking the meat
8. Form the meat into patties
9. Here's a burger patty
10. When burger patties cook , the meat contracts from the edges
11. Having the middle part slightly thinner than the edges when raw will help the patties finish with a more even shape
12. Cook on a hot grill or in a hot cast iron frying pan for 5-6 minutes per side , until cooked through
13. If using a grill , coat the grill grates first with a little vegetable oil
14. If using a frying pan , put a little oil in the pan first to help keep the burgers from sticking
15. Serve with toasted buns , and the accompaniments of your choicesliced onions , lettuce , sliced tomatoes , bacon , mayonnaise , mustard , relish , ketchup

title: orange cranberry muffins for diabetics
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f coat a 12-muffin pan with nonstick cooking spray or line with paper cupcake cups
2. Mix dry ingredients in bowl until blended
3. Stir in remaining ingredients , and mix just until moistened
4. Fill muffin cups and bake 18-20 minutes
5. Allow to cool 5 minutes in pan and then turn out onto wire rack
6. May be frozen

title: festive frittata
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f , then use butter to grease 13x9-inch baking dish
2. In small skillet , saut onions & mushrooms in olive oil until tender
3. Spoon onions & mushrooms into baking dish
4. Add ham , potatoes & cheese to baking dish
5. Add beaten eggs to baking dish , & mix well
6. Salt & pepper to taste
7. Bake uncovered 25-30 minutes or until eggs have set
8. Nice served with toast & fresh fruit

title: crock pot pizza supreme
steps:
1. Spray crock-pot with vegetable cooking spray
2. Sprinkle ground beef with italian seasoning , mix well
3. Set aside
4. Place 1 cup dry pasta in crock-pot that has been sprayed with vegetable oil cooking spray
5. Cover with 1 can tomato sauce
6. Add 1 / 3 cup onion , 1 / 3 cup green pepper , 1 / 3 can mushrooms
7. Spread 1 / 3 the seasoned ground beef over vegetables
8. Top with 1 / 2 cup mozzarella cheese and 16 pepperoni halves
9. Repeat step 3 , layering ingredients two more times
10. Garnish with 1 / 2 cup parmesan cheese
11. Cover
12. Bake 1-2 hours on high or until noodles are tender
13. Reduce heat to low until ready to serve

title: best choc chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c
2. Beat butter and sugar until creamy , beat in condensed milk
3. Add flour , stir until combined
4. Add dark and white choc bits , mix well
5. Roll heaped teaspoonfuls of mixture into small balls , place on greased trays , press gently with fork
6. Bake for 15 minutes until golden

title: potato and green banana salad
steps:
1. Cook potato cubes in boiling , salted water until firm-tender , about 8 to 10 minutes
2. Add sliced bananas to the potato pot during the last minute of cooking
3. Drain and rinse with cold water
4. In a large serving bowl , combine the bananas and potatoes with sliced onions , and olives
5. In a small bowl , whisk together the oil , vinegar , mustard , sugar , salt and pepper
6. Pour this dressing over the salad
7. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving

title: german chocolate sheet cake
steps:
1. Beat cake mix and next 3 ingredients at medium speed with an electric mixer 3 to 4 minutes or until creamy
2. Pour batter into a 15x10" jellyroll pan coated with cooking spray
3. Bake at 350 for 15 minutes
4. Combine sweetened condensed milk , coconut and pecans
5. Spread over warm cake
6. Broil , on lowest rack in oven , about 2 minutes or until golden
7. Remove from oven and cool
8. Beat margarine and next 3 ingredients at medium speed with electric mixer until blended
9. Gradually add fat-free milk , beating until smooth
10. Spread over cake

title: sicilian spaghetti sauce  ragu  no sugar added
steps:
1. Add the olive oil
2. Chop cloves of garlic and add to the oil
3. Sautee and add the onions until they are clear or translucent
4. Try not to burn the garlic , as it will become bitter
5. Combine the meat and fry the meat , breaking it apart until it is browned and cooked
6. Add all to the sauce and continue to simmer for 40 minutes or more

title: broiled polenta with mushrooms and cheese
steps:
1. If you use the porcini mushrooms , pleace them in a bowl , cover with the boiling water , and set aside for about 10 minutes
2. In a saucepan , bring the 3 cups water and salt to a rapid boil
3. Add the cornmeal in a thin , steady stream , whisking to prevent lumps
4. Lower the heat to simmer for about 10 minutes , stirring often to prevent sticking until the polenta thickens
5. While the polenta cooks , strain the porcini mushrooms and rinse them
6. Heat the oil in a skillet and saute the 1 1 / 2 cups mushrooms , garlic , and porcini on medium heat until the oil is absorbed , stirring occasionally
7. Stir in the wine and add salt
8. Simmer gently for another minute or two
9. Preheat the broiler
10. Spread the polenta in and oiled pie plate or casserole dish
11. Sprinkle the mozzarella on the polenta
12. Spoon the sauteed mushrooms over the mozzarella and finish with a layer of the smoked cheddar and / or provolone
13. Add pepper to taste
14. Broil for 3-5 minutes until cheese is golden brown , and serve bubbling hot

title: fabulous beef stroganoff
steps:
1. Melt 1 / 3 of the butter
2. Add onions and saute until golden
3. Remove onions and set aside
4. Add 1 / 3 more of the butter and saute the mushrooms until lightly browned
5. Remove and set aside
6. Add remaining butter
7. Roll beef in flour and saute until browned
8. Add broth , salt and onions
9. Cover and simmer gently until beef is tender , about 1 1 / 2 hours
10. Add tomato paste , worcestershire sauce , sour cream , heavy cream and mushrooms
11. Heat through and enjoy served over rice or noodles

title: root beer frosty
steps:
1. Place all in a blender or food processor
2. Blend 30 seconds or until smooth
3. Pour into 2 glasses and enjoy

title: pepperoni cream cheese bagel pizza wedges
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Line a baking pan with foil
3. Split bagels and place halves face-up in the pan
4. Mix garlic powder and cajun seasoning into olive oil , and brush across the bagels
5. Bake 10-15 minutes , or until golden brown
6. Set your oven to broil
7. Prepare the spread: add all the ingredients to a food processor and blend until smooth
8. Slice warm bagel halves into 4 wedges each
9. Add spread to wedges , and top each with a sprinkling of cheese and a slice of peperoni
10. Broil 2-3 minutes , until pepperoni crisps and cheese is melted

title: cheese onion soup
steps:
1. Cook the onion in a pan with a small bit of butter until soft
2. Stir in the flour to create almost a roux for a minute or so
3. Stir in the milk , a little at a time , and then bring up to boiling point
4. Add the remaining ingredients and wait until the cheese has hit melting point
5. Taste and season accordingly , serve warm with bread

title: chickpea walnut burgers
steps:
1. In a colander rinse and drain chick-peas
2. In a food processor pulse garlic , onion , and rosemary until chopped coarse
3. Add chick-peas , parsley , and bread crumbs and pulse until just combined
4. Transfer mixture to a bowl and stir in walnuts , egg , and salt and pepper to taste until well combined
5. Form mixture into four 3-inch patties
6. Chill patties , covered , at least 1 hour and up to 1 day
7. Cook on the grill or skillet

title: country fried steak casserole
steps:
1. Heat about 1 / 2 inch of cooking oil in cast iron skillet
2. Bring to about 350 degrees
3. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
4. Cut large cube steak pieces into fist size pieces about 4x5"
5. Season both sides with salt , pepper and garlic powder
6. Dredge all pieces in about 2 cups of white flour
7. Take a large zip loc or paper bag and put flour in it
8. Put a few pieces of the steak in at a time and shake to thoroughly coat
9. Shake off excess
10. Place a few pieces in the heated oil at a time , don't crowd
11. Fry for about 5 minutes each side until dark golden brown
12. Drain on paper towels
13. Repeat until all steak pieces are fried
14. In large casserole empty both soup cans
15. Add two cans of water or to desired consistency and whisk together
16. Add soy and worcestireshire sauce and combine
17. Place all fried steak pieces in casserole submerging in the soup
18. On top , place all sliced onion pieces
19. Cover casserole and place in oven
20. Cook for about 1 to 2 hours until steak is tender , onions are cooked and gravy is bubbling
21. Serve with white cooked rice
22. Broccoli and corn on the cob is good with this dish
23. Reheated leftovers are even better

title: buddha s happy belly  curried lentils  cauliflower and tomatoes
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in large saucepan over medium heat
2. Add green onions and garlic , and saute until fragrant
3. Reduce heat , add curry and cumin
4. Cook 2 minutes , stirring frequently
5. Add cauliflower and tomatoes , and saute until cauliflower is tender
6. Add lentils
7. Cook 1-2 minutes to heat through
8. Add salt to taste , and garnish with sprinkling of paprika , if desired

title: lou s chayote soup
steps:
1. Peel , pit and quarter chayote , then cut into 1 / 2-inch pieces
2. Cook scallions , garlic , and chili in butter in a heavy 3 quart saucepan over moderately low heat , stirring , until softened
3. Stir in allspice and cumin
4. Cook 1 minute
5. Add chayote , oregano and half of the cilantro and cook , stirring , for 2 minutes
6. Add chicken broth and simmer , covered , until chayotes are very tender , about 20 minutes
7. Remove from heat and discard chili pepper
8. Stir in remaining cilantro
9. Pure soup in a blender until smooth
10. Season to taste with salt and pepper

title: sweet chili popcorn seasoning
steps:
1. Mix
2. Toss about 2 1 / 2 tbsp mix with 1 bag popcorn

steps:

2. Mince 3 cloves of garlic , and combine in a small bowl with mayonnaise , anchovies , 2 tablespoons of the parmesan cheese , worcestershire sauce , mustard , and lemon juice
3. Season to taste with salt and black pepper
4. Refrigerate until ready to use
5. 2
6. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat
7. Cut the remaining 3 cloves of garlic into quarters , and add to hot oil
8. Cook and stir until brown , and then remove garlic from pan
9. Add bread cubes to the hot oil
10. Cook , turning frequently , until lightly browned
11. Remove bread cubes from oil , and season with salt and pepper
12. 3
13. Place lettuce in a large bowl
14. Toss with dressing , remaining parmesan cheese , and seasoned bread cubes

27. Finally , i also added some extra lemon juice at the end- over the top of the salad

title: morning glory burgers
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and mix lightly
2. Grill , broil or pan fry until cooked through
3. Serve on toasted rolls with you choice of toppings

title: batter for fish
steps:
1. Soak fish in the buttermilk one hour or more
2. Heat oil to 350f
3. In paper or ziplok bag put in flour , salt and pepper
4. Shake
5. Drop each piece of fish into bag one at a time and coat by shaking
6. Drop fish a few at a time into hot oil and fry until crispy and done

title: crisscross roasted potatoes
steps:
1. Peel and cut each potato crosswise at 1 / 4" intervals to within 1 / 2" of the bottom of potato
2. Cut lengthwise in the same manner , creating the crisscross pattern
3. Be sure not to cut all the way to the bottom
4. Place potatoes in ice water for 30 minutes
5. Dry potatoes and place in a baking pan
6. Brush with melted butter
7. Mix spices together and sprinkle on top of potatoes
8. Bake at 425 , turning and basting every 15 minutes for 45 minutes or until tender

title: oven parmesan chips
steps:
1. Cut potatoes into 1 / 4-inch slices
2. Place on a greased baking sheet in a single layer
3. Mix butter , onion , salt , pepper and paprika
4. Brush on one side of potatoes , then turn and brush other side
5. Bake at 425 for 15-20 minutes or until potatoes are tender an golden
6. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese , serve immediately

title: tate s bake shop raspberry squares
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease a 9-inch square baking pan
3. In a large bowl , cream the butter and sugar until they are combined
4. Add the egg yolk and mix
5. Add the flour and almonds and blend them well , but keep the mixture a bit crumbly , and not too dry
6. Pat half the mixture , about 3 cups , into the prepared pan
7. Bake it for 20 minutes
8. Remove it from the oven and immediately spread it with raspberry jam , leaving about a 1 / 4 inch border along the sides
9. Crumble the remaining dough evenly over the jam
10. Pat lightly
11. Bake it for another 40 minutes
12. The bars should be golden brown on top

title: too tired    broke  yellow rice and chicken
steps:
1. Follow package directions on rice , using liquid from chicken can to comprise overall liquid measurement required for rice preparation
2. Add chicken to water first , then continue to cook according to directions on rice package , on your stove top
3. Serve , relax & enjoy

title: vegan chocolate cake with frosting
steps:
1. Mix cake ingredients and bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes
2. Frosting: mix sugar and cocoa powder in saucepan
3. Stir in soy milk , oil , salt , and margarine
4. Heat to boiling and let boil for 3 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Let cool , then add vanilla and powdered sugar until desired consistency is achieved

title: brown rice  basil  and gruyere garden stuffing
steps:
1. Bring a big pot of lightly salted water to a boil over high heat
2. Add in the brown rice
3. Lower the heat to medium
4. Boil , uncovered , for about 35 minutes or until the rice is barely tender
5. Drain rice in a sieve and rinse under cold running water
6. Transfer rice to a large mixing bowl
7. In a large non-stick skillet over medium heat , let the butter melt
8. Add in the onion , zucchini , carrots , celery , red pepper , mushrooms , and garlic
9. Cover and cook about 10-12 minutes until the onion is soft and translucent and veggies are barely tender
10. Stir often
11. Transfer the veggies into the mixing bowl with the rice
12. Stir to mix
13. Add in the cheese and basil
14. Stir to mix
15. Add in salt and pepper
16. Stir to combine
17. Transfer mixture to a lightly buttered casserole dish
18. Drizzle with broth
19. Cover and bake in a 350 over for about 30 minutes

title: sauteed green beans and red onion
steps:
1. In a large skillet , bring 1 cup water , oil , salt , and pepper to a simmer over medium heat
2. Add the green beans and onion
3. Cover , and cook until the beans are crisp-tender , 8 to 10 minutes
4. Uncover , and continue cooking , stirring frequently , until water has evaporated , beans are tender , and onions are beginning to brown , 5 to 8 minutes more
5. Stir in vinegar and serve

title: herring appetizer
steps:
1. You will need a glass jar that will hold one quart , must have a cover !
2. Bring the vinegar , water and sugar to a boil in a saucepan , stirring constantly until the sugar is dissolved
3. Take the saucepan off the heat and set the liquid aside to cool to room temperature
4. Open the jars of herring and drain them in a strainer
5. Pick out the herring fillets , rinse them in cold water , and throw everything else away
6. Cook the carrots according to the package instructions , but make sure they're still firm and not soft
7. Peel the red onions and cut them into thin slices
8. Arrange one-fourth of the onions in a thin layer in the bottom of the 1-quart glass jar
9. Top them with a third of the herring
10. Top the herring with a third of the carrots
11. Place 2 or 3 dill springs on the top and scatter on a third of the allspice and a third of the mustard seeds
12. Repeat the sequence until all the ingredients have been used , ending with a top layer of onions
13. Pour the cooled pickling liquid into the jar
14. It should just cover the contents
15. If there's not enough pickling liquid , top off the jar with a little white vinegar right out of the bottle
16. Place the cover on the jar
17. Refrigerate the herring for 3 days before serving

title: light chicken salad
steps:
1. Comine mayo and salt
2. Stir in remaining ingredients
3. Chill before serving

title: authentic cypriot taverna brandy sour cocktail
steps:
1. Add the angostura bitters to a tall glass , and then pour in the brandy followed by the lemon cordial
2. Stir before topping up with lemonade or soda water and add plenty of ice

title: drunken watermelon
steps:
1. With a knife , shave off the stem end of the watermelon , just enough so that it sits flat
2. Cut the top off the watermelon , about 3 inches down
3. Scoop out half of the watermelon with a melon baller and set aside
4. Scoop out remaining watermelon , leaving the rind-bowl
5. This will be your punch bowl
6. Transfer scooped out melon to a blender and puree
7. May be done in batches
8. Push watermelon puree through a strainer to remove pulp and any seeds
9. Return watermelon water to the watermelon punch bowl
10. Stir in tequila , triple sec , and melon balls
11. Top off with lemon-lime soda
12. Serve cold over ice

title: persian style basmati rice pilaf
steps:
1. Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat
2. Add in onions and almonds , saute for 6-7 minutes or until the onion are tender and the almonds are golden , adding in the fresh garlic the last 2-3 minutes of sauting
3. Stir in rice , raisins , turmeric , cinnamon , salt and broth
4. Bring to a boil
5. Cover and reduce heat
6. Simmer for about 20-25 minutes or until rice is tender
7. Season with black pepper

title: quick and easy beef and broccoli   yummy
steps:
1. Put meat in a bowl with 2 tbs soy sauce and ginger mix well
2. Heat your wok or frying pan to very hot
3. Add oil and coat the sides well
4. Add beef and broccoli and stir-fry until meat changes color
5. Dissolve cornstarch into the beef stock and stir in remaining soy sauce and sesame oil
6. Add to the beef and broccoli -- stir until the sauce thickens
7. Serve over rice or noodles

title: fire baked bananas
steps:
1. Heat up the bar-b-que grill
2. Whip the cream until stiff peaks are formed
3. Fold the amarula liqueur into the mixture
4. Cover and refrigerate until needed
5. Over medium coals place the bananas , still in peel , onto the grill
6. Heat bananas until the peel turns black
7. Remove the bananas from the grill and split the skin of the banana open
8. In a saucepan , melt the chocolate over medium heat
9. Once melted , add the walnuts and honey stirring constantly
10. Pour chocolate sauce over bananas and top with whipped cream mixture

title: strawberry spinach salad with candied pecans
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large heavy skillet over medium heat
2. Add pecans and sugar
3. Stir to combine
4. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly until sugar melts around pecans and is caramel-colored
5. Remove pecans with a slotted spoon and spread in a single layer on a sheet of lightly greased aluminum foil
6. Cool completely and break up pieces as needed
7. Remove and discard stems from spinach
8. Wash spinach and pat dry with paper towels
9. Tear into bite-size pieces
10. Combine spinach , celery and strawberries in a large bowl
11. Pour 1 cup dressing over salad mixture
12. Toss gently
13. Add reserved candied pecans
14. Toss gently
15. Serve immediately with remaining dressing
16. Dressing: combine first 5 ingredients in container of electric blender
17. Cover and process until smooth
18. With blender running , gradually add oil in a slow , steady stream through opening in lid
19. Process until thick and smooth
20. Transfer dressing mixture to a bowl
21. Stir in poppy seeds
22. Cover and chill

title: ground beef and potato casserole
steps:
1. Spray a baking dish with cooking spray
2. Preheat oven 375 degrees
3. Spray a large skillet with cooking spray and brown ground beef
4. Drain ground beef , if necessary
5. Add onions and celery to same skillet and cook until soft , adding rest of spice ingredients through pepper flakes
6. Stir well
7. But in a bowl and set to the side
8. In same skillet , melt butter
9. Add flour to butter , stirring for one minute over medium-high heat
10. Gradually add milk and cook till bubbly and thickened
11. Add cheese , nutmeg , salt , pepper , and chili powder continue to stir until melted
12. Spoon 1 / 4 cup of the ground beef mixture and spread evenly on bottom of a baking dish
13. Add 1 layer of potatoes
14. Alternate ground beef mixture , then potatoes until completely used
15. Pour cheese sauce over ground beef and potato mixture
16. Top with a pinch of paprika and grated cheese
17. Bake for 1 hour , or until potatoes and beef are bubbly and done

title: fiesta burrito burgers
steps:
1. In a saucepan , mix together the refried beans , the 1 / 2 cup onions , the chili powder , garlic powder , salt and black pepper
2. Heat over a med-low heat , stirring occasionally
3. In a large bowl , mix together the ground meat , the beaten egg , the taco seasoning , and the can of drained diced green chilies
4. Form into 4 equal patties
5. In a 12-inch skillet , cook burgers for about 8-10 minutes per side over med-high heat
6. Spread taco sauce on the bottom buns and sour cream on the top buns
7. Place a hamburger patty on each bottom bun
8. Spread some of the seasoned refried beans over each patty
9. Top the refried beans on each burger with equal portions of the shredded cheddar
10. Place tomato slices on each burger
11. Place some of the shredded lettuce on each burger
12. Top with the top bun
13. Enjoy !

title: frozen mud pie sandwiches
steps:
1. Combine first 4 ingredients in a small heavy saucepan and bring to a boil over medium-low heat , stirring frequently with a whisk
2. Cook 2 minutes or until thick , stirring frequently
3. Remove from heat and stir in margarine and vanilla
4. Cover and chill thoroughly
5. Let frozen yogurt sit out until slightly softened
6. Spread 2 tablespoons of yogurt onto each of 10 wafers , then top each with about a teaspoon of the syrup mixture
7. Top with remaining wafers and press gently to make sandwiches
8. Place in freezer for at least one hour before serving

title: aussie pumpkin scones
steps:
1. Combine all the ingredients in a large bowl and mix until well combined
2. Turn out dough onto a floured surface and lightly press dough down to approximately 2 cm thickness
3. Cut into rounds with a scone cutter
4. Place on a greased baking tray
5. Bake in a hot oven for approx 10-15 minutes or until golden brown

title: island shrimp and pineapple skewers with rum butter sauce
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine lime juice , oil , ginger , garlic , and pepper flakes
2. Add the shrimp and pineapple chunks , toss to combine
3. Let marinade while grill heats up , about 15 minutes
4. Prepare grill with medium coals
5. Wrap shrimp with prosciutto
6. Alternately thread the pineapple chunks and the wrapped shrimp onto skewers
7. Grill until shrimp are cooked and the pineapple chunks are brown around the edges
8. Make the sauce in a medium sauce pan by combining the rum , shallots , ginger
9. Bring to a boil
10. Reduce heat and simmer until reduces to 3 tablespoons in volume
11. With heat on low , whisk in the butter , 1 tablespoon at a time
12. Continue until all the butter is incorporated and the sauce coats the back of the spoon
13. Be careful to not allow it to get too hot and allow the sauce to break down
14. Season with salt and cayenne , stir and remove from heat
15. To serve: transfer shrimp and pineapple from the skewers to a platter
16. Sprinkle with cilantro and serve with rum butter sauce

title: easy pleasing extra lean meatloaf
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Place meat , stuffing mix , water , eggs and 1 / 4 cup ketchup in large bowl
3. Mix just until blended
4. Shape into loaf in 13x9-inch baking dish
5. Top with remaining ketchup
6. Bake 1 hour or until meatloaf is done

title: bhel puri
steps:
1. Take a bowl
2. Add puffed rice , both the chutneys , 3 / 4 of onions , 3 / 4 of tomatoes , puri's , half portion of sev , lemon juice
3. Mix well
4. Serve in 2 plates
5. Add the topping of coriander leaves , sev , green mangoes , balance onions , tomatoes & sev

title: creamy bean   tortilla soup
steps:
1. Saute onion and celery in bacon grease you get from frying your bacon strips
2. Combine all ingredients including the crumbled bacon and heat till hot
3. Add water to desired consistency
4. Soup should be creamy
5. Serve with tortilla chips

title: bacon and eggs anyone
steps:
1. Cook potatoes in salted water just until tender , but do not overcook , drain well
2. In a large saucepan , melt margarine , and stir in flour
3. Cook , stirring constantly for 1 minute , or till smooth
4. Gradually add cream and cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until sauce thickens
5. Add cheddar cheese , italian seasoning , salt , and white , and black pepper , stirring constantly until cheese melts , and remove from heat
6. In a buttered 9x13 inch baking dish , layer half of the egg slices , half of bacon , and half of cheese sauce
7. Spoon potatoes over cheese sauce and top with remaining egg slices , bacon , and cheese sauce
8. Combine breadcrumbs and 3 tablespoons melted margarine , and sprinkle over top of casserole
9. Cover and refrigerate overnight
10. Before baking remove casserole from fridge , and let stand for 20 minutes
11. Uncover and bake for 30 minutes
12. Bake at 350 degrees

title: fiesta casserole
steps:
1. Brown beef with chopped onion , drain
2. Combine with remaining ingredients , except the cheese
3. Place in large casserole
4. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325 degrees
5. Sprinkle cheese on top and bake an additional 15 minutes
6. Cornand olive juice may be added if mixture seems too dry towards the end of cooking time
7. I have made this with stuffed green olives , and with ripe black olives
8. You could even do half and half

title: curried pea salad
steps:
1. Briefly rinse frozen peas under water to thaw slightly
2. While peas sit ,
3. Mix all ingredients except almonds
4. Allow to sit at least 30 min for flavors to meld
5. Before serving , add crushed almonds
6. Mix some almonds in peas , sprinkle some on top
7. Store in covered container

title: hot vanilla for adults
steps:
1. Warm the milk in the microwave
2. Add the rest of the ingredients and enjoy !

title: curry apple carrot soup
steps:
1. Chop carrots and place in large pot with butter on medium / low heat
2. While carrots are sweating , core and dice apples
3. Add to carrots
4. Cover and simmer for about 30 minutes , or until apples and carrots are tender
5. Add remaining ingredients , cook another 10 minutes
6. Blend until smooth

title: adobo filipino style
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except cooking oil in pot and let stand for at least 30 minutes
2. Simmer covered for one hour until meat is tender
3. Drain and reserve sauce
4. Heal oil in skillet
5. Brown meat on all sides
6. Transfer to serving dish
7. Pour off remaining oil in skillet
8. Add reserved sauce and cook for a minute or two , scraping all brown bits sticking to the pan
9. Remove bay leaf
10. Pour sauce over meat and serve

title: jam jelly filled butter cookies
steps:
1. If using self-rising flour reduce the baking soda to 1 / 4 teaspoon and omit the salt
2. Beat together the shortening and butter
3. Beat in sugars well , then beat in the egg
4. Add the dry ingredients , and mix well
5. Shape the dough into two rolls 1 1 / 4" in diameter , sealing well in waxed paper
6. Refrigerate for a minimum of 3 hours or overnight
7. Heat oven to 400f
8. Slice dough into 1 / 8" thick disks
9. Put 1 / 2 teaspoon of jam / jelly on half the slices , keep it in the center of the disk
10. Top each disk with another slice and bake
11. You can sprinkle these with sugar for a crunchier cookie
12. Bake for 8 - 10 minutes
13. Store in an air tight container once the cookies have cooled

title: baked green beans with mushrooms   pine nuts
steps:
1. Saut the mushrooms & shallots in the oil for a minute or two , sprinkle in the thyme line a baking dish with foil
2. Pour the madeira into the bottom of the foil lined dish , add beans , top with mushroom mixture
3. Seal the foil
4. Bake in 375f oven for approx 30 minutes
5. Open foil and sprinkle with toasted pine nuts

title: southern fried oysters
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , add the first 3 ingredients
2. Stir to combine
3. In another bowl , combine the egg and milk
4. Whisk to combine
5. Dip oysters in egg mixture , then dredge in flour mixture
6. Add oil to 2-3 inch depth in a cast-iron dutch oven
7. Heat to 375 degrees
8. Fry oysters in oil until golden , turning once
9. Drain on paper towels and serve immediately

title: devilled beef
steps:
1. Cut chuck steak into 1 inches cubes
2. In a saucepan melt shortening , add the onions and meat and brown for 5 minutes , stirring frequently
3. Add the flour and mix well
4. Add the rest of the ingredients and bring to the boil , stirring constantly
5. Reduce the heat cover with a lid
6. Simmer very gently , stirring occasionally , for 2 - 2 1 / 2 hours or until the meat is tender
7. Season to taste
