8. Turn into a warm casserole and serve immediately
9. It suggests to serve this with either plain boiled or creamed potatoes and buttered cabbage or spring greens

title: ritz cracker cookies   no bake   candy coated
steps:
1. In ritz cracker box there are 4 sleeves of crackers
2. Take 2 sleeves of crackers and top each cracker with enough peanut butter to coat gently - then top with remaining 2 sleeves of crackers which makes cracker sandwiches
3. Microwave candy melts according to package directions
4. Drop cracker sandwich into melted chocolate , coat completely & remove with fork shaking off excess chocolate
5. Top immediately with mini m&m's or sprinkles , or colored sugar , etc
6. Cool completely before serving / storing

title: pork   rice
steps:
1. In a saucepan , saute the mushrooms , onion and garlic in butter until tender
2. Stir in tomatoes , pork , peppers , italian seasoning , salt if desired , and sugar
3. Bring to a boil
4. Stir in rice
5. Cover and remove from the heat
6. Let stand for 5 minutes
7. Stir before serving

title: fresh chinese cabbage salad
steps:
1. Combine all the ingredients in a large bowl
2. Toss well
3. That's it !

title: cheeseburger sandwiches
steps:
1. In a large skillet , brown ground beef and garlic-pepper blend until thoroughly cooked
2. Drain
3. In a 3 1 / 2 - 4 quart crockery pot , combine cooked ground beef and all remaining ingredients except buns
4. Mix well
5. Cover
6. Cool on low setting for 6-7 hours
7. To serve , spoon mixture onto sandwich buns

title: fresh green beans
steps:
1. Snap end off the beans
2. Add beans to boiling water
3. Cook only 5 minutes
4. Drain and run under cold water
5. In a skillet , melt butter and saute beans for 3 minutes
6. Add cheese , pepper and garlic salt and toss
7. Serve immediately

title: healthy exchanges creamy cucumbers
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine cucumbers and onions
2. Pour dressing over cucumbers and onions
3. Add salt and black pepper
4. Stir gently to combine
5. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours

title: black and whites
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f
2. In a medium bowl , combine flour , cocoa powder , baking soda , and salt
3. Mix well with a wire whisk
4. Set aside
5. Blend sugars in a large bowl using an electric mixer set at medium speed
6. Add butter and mix to form a grainy paste , scraping down the sides of the bowl
7. Add eggs and vanilla
8. Beat at medium speed until combined
9. Do not overmix !
10. Add the flour mixture and chocolates , and blend at a low speed until just combined
11. Do not overmix !
12. Drop by rounded tablespoons onto ungreased cookie sheets , 2-inches apart
13. Bake 23 to 25 minutes
14. Transfer cookies immediately to a cool flat surface upon removal from oven

title: durkee famous sauce clone
steps:
1. Put all ingredients , except for the butter , into your blender
2. Blend on high speed about 2 minutes or until mixture is smooth
3. Pour into top pan of a double boiler
4. Cook over gently boiling water
5. As sauce begins to heat , add butter , stirring often to incorporate
6. Cook for 12-15 minutes or until sauce becomes thick and smooth
7. Remove from heat and allow to cool
8. Cooled sauce may be run thru blender , again , on high speed for about a minute till smooth
9. Refrigerate sauce in covered container for several hours before using
10. Will keep , refrigerated , about 1 month

title: meringue buttercream frosting   1st generation
steps:
1. Whisk together egg whites and sugar in a double boiler pan
2. Heat over boiling water , "whisk"ing constantly , until the sugar is disolved and the egg begins to foam
3. Tranfer mixture to large bowl and beat until stiff peaks form
4. Add the butter 1 tbsp at a time
5. It is very important not to add it all at once , the meringe doesn't like it and gets all seperated
6. :0
7. After all the butter is added , scrape the edges of the bowl and continue mixing
8. It will act like a puddle of melty uck for a little while , but all of a sudden , it will thicken beautifully
9. Mix in the vanilla
10. Voila ! i've found that the frosting has lots of air bubbles from being whipped , so if you're going to pipe it , i would mix it by hand with a spatula a little bit
11. It is great for decorating ! but keep in mind it's about half butter so don't hold on to the bag for long periods at a time
12. Xd it tends to get melty
13. Enjoy !

title: ruby red grapefruit bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Line an 8 inch square metal pan with non-stick foil or parchment
3. Combine flour , salt and powdered sugar
4. Cut in butter until mixture is coarse and crumbly
5. It should be very dry
6. Press into pan and bake for 18 minutes or until golden brown around edges
7. Beat together eggs , sugar , grapefruit juice , and grapefruit zest
8. Add more zest for a more "grapefruity" flavor
9. Whisk in baking powder , making sure you whisk out any lumps , then whisk in flour
10. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until set
11. Cool completely , then sprinkle top with powdered sugar
12. Lift from pan and cut into squares

title: quick and easy nacho dip
steps:
1. Brown ground beef
2. Drain
3. Add salt , pepper , onion powder , and minced garlic
4. Combine beef , salsa , beans , sour cream , and 2 cups cheese in slow cooker
5. Cover
6. Heat on low 2 hours
7. Just before serving sprinkle with 1 cup cheese
8. Serve with tortilla chips

title: cod with fennel  mushrooms  tomato   dill
steps:
1. Season cod with salt and pepper and squeese 2 lemon wedges over
2. Set aside
3. Spray nonstick frypan with veggie spray , heat over high heat , add mushrooms , fennel and onion , reserving 4 onion slices
4. Cook stirring until onions are soft , about 5 minutes
5. Reduce heat to medium
6. Place the 4 pieces of cod on top of the veggies
7. Place one slice of tomato on top each piece of cod and one slice of reserved onion slices on top of tomato
8. Sprinkle with dill and squeese 2 more wedges of lemon over all
9. Cover and simmer until cod is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork , about 15 minutes
10. Garnish with remaining lemon wedges and sprigs of fennel leaves

title: buttery skor bars
steps:
1. Set oven to 300 degrees
2. Prepare an ungreased 8-inch square baking pan
3. Coarsley chop 1 chocolate bar into about 1 / 4-inch pieces
4. Set remaining chocolate bar aside
5. In a medium bowl using an electric mixer beat butter until smooth
6. Gradually beat in icing sugar until light and fluffy
7. Beat in vanilla and salt
8. Using a wooden spoon stir in 1 cup flour just until mixed
9. Stir in the remaining 1 / 4 cup flour with the chopped skor bar pieces just until mixed
10. Place the mixture into prepared baking pan , using lightly-floured fingers , pat mixture into an even thickness
11. Using a fork pierce the dough all over
12. Finely chop the remaining skor bar then sprinkle over the dough
13. Bake for about 35-40 minutes until edges are deep golden and center is pale golden
14. Remove from oven and immediately cut into 2-inch squares
15. Cool completely in the pan

title: choco banana magic bars
steps:
1. Combine graham crumbs with butter
2. Press evenly onto parchment paper-lined 13 x 9" baking pan
3. Combine condensed milk and bananas
4. Pour evenly over crumb crust
5. Top with chocolate , coconut and pecans
6. Press down firmly
7. Bake in preheated 350f oven 20-25 minutes or until top is lightly browned
8. Cool thoroughly and cut into bars

title: oaty chocolate caramel slice
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Melt butter , golden syrup and brown sugar in a saucepan , remove from heat
3. Mix dry ingredients in a bowl , pour in butter , syrup and brown , mix well
4. Press mixture into a 8" x 8" pan
5. Bake 20 to 25 minutes until golden
6. Melt 3 oz butter , brown sugar , condensed milk and golden syrup in a saucepan and simmer , stirring , until mixture thickens and becomes caramel coloured
7. Pour over the base and allow to set
8. Melt chocolate and spread over set caramel
9. Cut into squares once set

title: low fat bran muffins
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together and bake at 425 degrees for 17 minutes
2. I use the large muffin tins

title: assam spicy shrimp
steps:
1. Marinating: break tamarind apart , place in a small saucepan with water
2. Simmer , covered , for about 10 minutes or until pasty coating separates from seeds
3. Press through a sieve or food mill to extract all pulp and soupy liquid
4. Discard seeds
5. Rinse shrimps thoroughly , pat dry and marinate fro 1 hour with 1 tablespoon of this tamarind liquid , the oyster sauce and hot chili sauce
6. Cooking: meanwhile , cut young ginger into toothpick-sized slivers
7. If using mature ginger , peel and sliver
8. Peel and sliver garlic
9. Place blachan in a non-stick pan and heat gently fro 3 to 4 minutes to develop the flavors
10. Pell and cut red onions into wedges
11. Combine oyster , soy and chili sauces with blachan
12. Stir into remaining tamarind liquid
13. Heat a large wok over high heat
14. When a drop of water sizzles immediately into steam pour in 2 tablespoons of the oil
15. Swirl up sides of wok , and when just at smoking point , dump in ginger and garlic
16. Stir fry until golden , about 3 to 4 minutes
17. Adding more oil as needed , stir frey shrimp in batches until orange red , about 3 minutes
18. Pour sauces over all the shrimp in the wok and cook at a brisk bubble over high heat until shrimps are aromatic and sauces have reduced and thickened to enrobe the shells , about 8 minutes
19. Mix in sugar and onion wedges , taste to adjust seasoning , sweetening and spiciness

title: brown rice  baked
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Heat heavy skillet until hot
3. Add oil and then add uncooked brown rice
4. Stir rice in oil until golden brown , stirring constantly
5. In the meantime heat water and add bay leaves , bouillon cubes , poultry seasoning , black pepper , minced onion flakes , parsley , oregano , basil and pepper flakes
6. Bring to a boil
7. When rice is golden and ready , pour rice into a covered 2 quart casserole dish
8. Add the boiling liquid on top of the rice
9. Careful ! it will sputter
10. Cover casserole with aluminum foil and the cover for the casserole dish
11. Bake for 1 hour
12. Remove from oven and let sit covered for 15 minutes
13. Fluff with fork before serving

title: ww cheese crisps
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400
2. Spray 2 baking sheets with nonstick spray
3. Combine all the ingredients in a small bowl
4. Drop the cheese mixture by tablespoons onto the greased cookie sheets
5. You should have about 16
6. Bake 5- 7 minutes , until cheese melts and edges are a darker brown
7. Remove from the oven and let sit on the baking sheet for one minute , then remove and place on paper towels to finish cooling
8. Crisps can be stored in an airtight container up 2 days at room temperature

title: peanut butter bites
steps:
1. Cut each slice of bread diagonally so you have 4 triangles from each slice
2. Heat oven to 250 degrees f
3. Place the triangles on an ungreaded cookie sheet and bake for 50 minutes or until light brown , dry and crispy meanwhile in a saucepan combine
4. Peanut butter oil& brown sugar
5. Stir occasioally until the mixture is heated through
6. Spread the wheatgerm out on a large sheet of waxed paper
7. Add the toaster triangles , a couple at a time to the peanut butter mixture
8. Stir gently to coat the bread pieces
9. Roll triangles in the wheatgerm
10. Place on rack to dry

title: spring peas with pancetta
steps:
1. Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add the pancetta and saute for about 5 minutes or until the pancetta is crispy
3. Remove pancetta
4. Chop pancetta into pieces
5. Add onion and garlic to the drippings in the skillet
6. Saute for 2-5 minutes until tender
7. Add peas , broth , sugar , salt and pepper
8. Simmer , stirring occasionally , for about 5 minutes or until the peas are at the desired tenderness
9. Stir in chopped parsley and pancetta
10. Stir and heat through
11. Serve

title: puffy cheese n cauliflower  meatless meal
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f and lightly grease a 9x11" oven proof pan
2. Heat oil in a skillet , saute the onions for 5 minutes
3. Stir in salt & cauliflower , saute 7 minutes or until the florets are just heated through transfer to the prepared pan
4. Meanwhile in a blender or food processor blend the eggs , milk , flour & cheese , whip until you have a very smooth batter pour over the cauliflower
5. Place on middle rack of the oven & bake for apprx 40 minutes or until the casserole is beautifully puffy & golden serve hot or warm cut into squares or spoon it out

title: coconut daiquiri
steps: 1. Mix in blender until smooth

title: basil cheese polenta wedges
steps:
1. Heat broth , cornmeal , bay leaf and pepper in saucepan to a boil
2. Stir in oil
3. Cook and stir 10 minutes or until mixture thickens
4. Remove bay leaf
5. Stir in basil and hceese
6. Pour mixture into greased 9" pie plate
7. Cover and chill 2 hours or until firm
8. Cut polenta into 6 wedges
9. To grill: brush wedges on both sides with olive oil
10. Place on hot grill and cook 4 minutes , turning once
11. To bake: place wedges on greased baking sheet
12. Bake at 375 for 20 minutes or until browned and crispy , turning once
13. To pan-fry: heat oil in nonstick skillet
14. Add wedges and cook 10 minut4es or until browned and crispy , turning once

title: diabetic apple oat bran muffins
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Grease twelve 3-inch muffin cups or line with paper liners
3. In large bowl , combine both flours , cinnamon , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
4. In medium bowl , beat buttermilk , oat bran , brown sugar , oil , applesauce and egg until blended
5. Stir buttermilk mixture into flour mixture just until combined
6. Fold in apples
7. Divide batter among muffin cups
8. Bake 18 to 20 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in centers comes out clean
9. Cool muffins in pan 5 minutes
10. Remove from pan and cool on wire rack

title: lobster newburg
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , melt butter
2. Stir in flour and salt
3. Add the milk all at once
4. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly
5. Cook and stir 1 more minute
6. Stir about half the hot mixture into the beaten egg yolks
7. Return all to saucepan
8. Cook and stir until mixture is thickened and bubbly
9. Stir in lobster , dry sherry , white or black pepper , and ground red pepper
10. Heat through
11. Serve over english muffin halves
12. If desired , garnish with snipped chives

title: pork chops or pork ribs with apricot pineapple sauce
steps:
1. Mix the rub in a small bowl
2. Rub it in the meat on both sides and set aside
3. If the meat used does not have fat , heat two tablespoons of oil in a large fry pan
4. Lightly brown the meat
5. Place in a greased overproof dish or pan with lid
6. Saute the white sliced onions and set aside
7. Mix the sauce ingredients and add the one remaining tblsp of oil in a saucepan and heat until the sauce starts to simmer
8. Stir , turn low and taste
9. Add more hot sauce if desired
10. Preheat oven 350
11. Pour sauce over chops or ribs , turning them to cover with sauce
12. Pour onions over the meat
13. Cover
14. You may use foil for a cover if desired
15. Cook for 1 hour

title: easy parmesan garlic chicken and pasta
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f mix 1 / 3 cup of the cheese , the salad dressing mix and garlic powder
2. Moisten chicken with water
3. Coat evenly with the cheese mixture
4. Place in single layer in shallow baking pan sprayed with cooking spray
5. Bake 20 to 25 minute or until chicken is cooked through
6. Meanwhile , cook pasta in large saucepan as directed on package
7. Drain and set aside
8. Add sauce to same saucepan
9. Cook on medium-low heat 5 to 6 minute or until heated through , stirring occasionally
10. Remove 3 / 4 cup of the sauce
11. Set aside for later use
12. Add pasta to remaining sauce
13. Toss gently to coat
14. Spoon about 1-1 / 2 cups of the pasta mixture onto each of six serving plates
15. Top each with a chicken breast and 2 tablespoons of the reserved sauce
16. Sprinkle evenly with basil and

title: sweet potatoes and eggs
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f , then spray a 10-inch glass pie dish with a cooking spray
2. In a microwaveable container , cook the sweet potato in the microwave on high for 3-4 minutes or until cooked
3. In a large bowl , whisk together the eggs , then add the sweet potato
4. Fold in the green onions , the 2 cheeses , worcestershire sauce & parsley , before adding the salt & lemon pepper
5. Pour the mixture into the prepared dish , then sprinkle with bacon
6. Bake 30-35 minutes or until done

title: penne with butter  sage  and parmesan
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil , and salt it
2. Cook the pasta until it is tender but just short of the point at which you want to eat it
3. Meanwhile , place butter and olive oil in a saucepan large enough to hold the cooked pasta
4. Turn the heat to medium and add the sage
5. Cook until the butter and oil begin to brown and the sage shrivels
6. Turn heat down to low
7. When pasta is almost done , scoop out a cupful of the cooking water and set aside
8. Drain the pasta , immediately add it to the sage mixture , and raise the heat to medium
9. Add 1 / 2 cup of the reserved water , and stir
10. Cook about 30 seconds or until some of the water is absorbed and the pasta is perfectly done
11. Stir in the cheese until the sauce becomes creamy
12. Thin it with a little water if necessary
13. Season liberally with pepper , and salt to taste

title: jalapenos en escabeche  pickled jalapenos
steps:
1. In a pan , saute the chiles in the oil until the skin starts to blister
2. Add the onion and carrots and heat for an additional minute
3. Add 2 cloves and 3 peppecorns to bottom of each of the jars
4. Pack the chile mixture into sterilized pint jars leaving 1 / 2-inch head space
5. Add 2 cloves and 1 teaspoon salt to each of the jars
6. In a pan , combine the vinegar and water and bring to a boil
7. Pour over the chiles
8. Seal and process the jars in a boiling water bath for 15 minutes
9. Store for 4 weeks in cool , dark place
10. I always add more peppercorns and garlic to each jar

title: outstanding banana bread   super easy tasty recipe
steps:
1. Mix together sugar , baking power , baking soda , flour and salt in one bowl
2. In another bowl , mix together lemon juice , milk , eggs , oil , and bananas until well blended and bananas are mashed well
3. Then , mix together the contents of both bowls using a fork or large spoon
4. Your mixture should be similar to a runny cake batter
5. If adding walnuts , stir them in now
6. Pour mixture into bread pans and cook at 350 for 35-45 minutes or until a knife comes out clean when poked in the middle
7. When mixing the milk and lemon juice , pour lemon juice in a cup and and add the milk until 2 / 3 cup is reached
8. I normally have to cook my bread for up to an hour even though my very old recipe states 35 minutes

title: polenta quick bread with lemon and thyme
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Butter a 9-by-5-inch loaf pan
3. Dust with flour , and tap out excess
4. Set aside
5. Put butter and sugar into the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the paddle attachment
6. Mix on medium-high speed until pale and fluffy , about 3 minutes
7. Add lemon zest
8. Mix 1 minute
9. Add eggs , 1 at a time , mixing well after each addition
10. Mix in lemon juice and thyme
11. Add flour , cornmeal , baking powder , and salt , and mix until just combined
12. Stir in chopped pine nuts
13. Pour batter into prepared pan
14. Sprinkle with pine nuts
15. Bake until a pick inserted into center comes out clean , 50 to 55 minutes
16. Let cool completely on a wire rack
17. Garnish with thyme

title: kahlua grilled pork tenderloins
steps:
1. Combine kahlua and butter in a small saucepan , bring to a boil
2. Boil 4 minutes , stirring often
3. Remove from heat , and let cool slightly
4. Slice tenderloins crosswise at 1 1 / 2-inch intervals , cutting to , but not through , bottom
5. Sprinkle tenderloins with lemon-pepper seasoning and garlic salt
6. Place in a large shallow dish or large heavy-duty , zip-top plastic bag
7. Pour half of the kahlua mixture over tenderloins
8. Cover dish or seal bag securely and marinate in refrigerator 4 hours , turning occasionally
9. Cover and chill remaining half of kahlua mixture
10. Remove tenderloins from marinade , discarding marinade
11. Grill , covered , over medium-hot coals 18 - 20 minutes or until a meat thermometer inserted in thickest portion of tenderloin registers 160 degrees , turning once and basting occasionally with remaining half of kahlua mixture
12. Cover and let stand 10 minutes before slicing

title: zingerman s russian dressing  for ruben sandwiches
steps: 1. Combine all ingredients and whisk together

title: chocolate fantasy cake with chocolate ganache icing
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f grease a 9" springform pan with 1 tablespoon of the butter and dust with flour
2. In a metal bowl set over a pot of simmering water , melt the chocolate with the remaining 8 tablespoons of butter and stir occasionally until smooth and creamy
3. Remove from heat
4. Separate the eggs
5. In another bowl , use an electric mixer to beat the egg yolks together with the sugar and vanilla until thick , stopping to scrape the sides of the bowl once or twice , for about 3 minutes
6. In a third bowl , whisk the egg whites with the salt until stiff , for about two minutes
7. Slowly and gently fold the chocolate into the yolk mixture , adding just a little chocolate at a time to keep the eggs from scrambling
8. Fold in the egg whites
9. Pour the batter into the springform pan and bake in the center of the oven until spongy
10. For about 40 minutes
11. Remove from the oven , remove the springform ring and place the cake on a rack to cool completely
12. When the cake is cool , prepare the icing as follows
13. In a metal bowl set over a pot of simmering water , melt the chocolate with the cream , stirring constantly until smooth
14. Don't let the mixture boil
15. Remove from the heat
16. Use immediately or store , refrigerated in an airtight container , for up to 24 hours
17. Reheat in the top of a double boiler
18. To serve , spread the chocolate ganache icing over the cake
19. Top with raspberries or strawberries rolled in sugar and serve a small wedge of cake with a dollop of whipped cream
20. Enjoy !

title: pick your flavor blender slushies
steps:
1. Place all the ingredients in a blender place the lid on the blender and process the mixture on high for a full 1 minute
2. Stop the blender and mix with a long wooden spoon , look for any unchopped ice cubes , if all the chunks are grated up finely then go ahead and serve
3. You may need to process it for another full minute if there are any unchopped ice cubes
4. Serve immediately with a spoon to start as the mixture will be thick

title: homemade cough medicine
steps:
1. Mix ingredients
2. Take by the teaspoon as often as needed for cough
3. Do not give to infants under 12 months due to the honey

title: girl guide bananas boats
steps:
1. Peel the banana down just one side , leaving the skin attached at the bottom of the banana so you can fold it back up later
2. Give everyone a spoon and have them hollow out the banana like a canoe
3. Don't take out all the flesh , just create a little trough for the chocolate and marshmallows
4. You can eat what you hollow out
5. Break up the aero bar into small pieces and stuff the chocolate into the hollowed out bananas , along with the marshmallows
6. Fold the peel back up over the banana and wrap tightly in foil
7. Bury the bananas in hot coals for 2-3 minutes
8. Take out and let cool for a couple minutes
9. When they are still warm , but not so hot they burn your hands , unwrap and enjoy !

title: diet   lipton   green tea with citrus by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Pour water over tea bags and steep for 1 hour
2. Add remaining ingredients and chill
3. Cooking time is steeping time

title: summer pie anytime  make ahead fruit pie filling
steps:
1. Cut each of the apricots lengthwise into quarters , discarding pits ,
2. You should have about 8 cups fruit total
3. In a large bowl , gently mix fruit , 1 / 2 cup sugar , 1 / 4 cup flour , lemon juice , cinnamon , and salt
4. Taste fruit and add more sugar if desired
5. Line a 9-inch pie pan with 20-inch-long sheet of foil
6. Line the foil with a 20-inch-long piece of plastic wrap
7. Pour fruit into plastic wrap
8. Pull edges together and fold over to seal
9. Then repeat to seal foil over plastic
10. Freeze up to 3 months , removing from pie pan , after filling is hard , about 8 hours
11. From freezer to oven:
12. To bake pie , unwrap frozen filling and place in a 9-inch pie pan lined with an unbaked crust
13. Cover with top crust , crimp edges to seal , cut small slits in top to vent
14. Place on foil lined baking sheet , for easy clean-up , bake pie in a 375f oven or convection until top crust is browned and filling is bubbling in the center , 1 1 / 4 to 1 1 / 2 hours

title: italian style spinach
steps:
1. Saute the bacon in the olive oil
2. Add the onion , garlic , and spinach
3. Saute the spinach until limp
4. Season the spinach with the salt , parmesan cheese , and pepper
5. Serve immediately

title: marbled chocolate banana bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine flour , baking soda and salt , stirring with a whisk
3. Place sugar and butter in a large bowl and beat with mixer at medium speed until well blended
4. Add banana , egg substitute , and yogurt
5. Beat until blended
6. Add flour mixture , beat at low speed just until moist
7. Place chocolate chips in a medium microwave-safe bowl and microwave at high 1 minute or until almost melted , stirring until smooth
8. Cool slightly
9. Add 1 cup of batter to chocolate , stirring until well combined
10. Spoon chocolate batter alternately with plain batter into an 8 1 / 2 x 4 1 / 2-inch loaf pan coated with cooking spray
11. Swirl batters together using a knife
12. Bake at 350f for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
13. Cool 10 minutes in pan on a wire rack
14. Remove from pan
15. Cool completely on wire rack

title: dutch mayonnaise
steps:
1. Beat the eggs in a mixing bowl
2. Add the salt , pepper and mustard powder
3. Using an electric mixer , beat the egg yolk mixture at a consistent speed
4. Add a little oil and a little vinegar on an alternating basis
5. If the oil separates from the mixture , add a touch of warm water

title: lemon garlic lentil soup
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to directions
2. Drain
3. In a large pot , bring dal , water and broth mix to a boil , reduce heat to medium
4. Cook until lentils are at desired consistency
5. In skillet , saut celery , carrots and garlic
6. For 2-3 minutes
7. Add spinach and saut for another 1-2 minutes
8. Add vegetable mixture and pasta to dal
9. Simmer 5 minutes
10. Before serving add lemon juice
11. I also add another clove of crushed garlic , since raw garlic is quite good for you !

title: potato stuffed with egg  nafaqo
steps:
1. Boil the potatoes and egg until fully cooked
2. Heat the chicken stock
3. Add the flour and stir until smooth
4. Using a whisk will help make it smooth faster
5. Add the turmeric and stir well
6. Once the egg is fully cooked , remove the shell and cut it into 4 pieces
7. Once the potatoes are cooked , remove the skins and mash
8. Slowly add the rest of the flour
9. The potatoes should be like a dough
10. You may not need the full 1 / 2 cup of flour , it depends on how big the potatoes are
11. Once the potatoes are dough like , pinch some off and flatten
12. Add one piece of egg in the middle and bring the potato around it to fully cover the egg
13. Shape it into a circle or oval
14. Heat a pan of oil on the stove
15. Dip each potato ball into the stock mixture and coat well
16. Drop it into hot oil and fry until crisp , about 1-2 minutes

title: baigan choka  roasted eggplant  aubergine
steps:
1. Wash eggplant and make slits in it with a knife
2. Peel garlic cloves and stick into the slits made in the eggplant
3. Insert tomato wedges into the slits
4. Rub the eggplant with a teaspoon of oil
5. Roast over an open flame until soft
6. Do not grill because the taste will not be the same
7. The open flame imparts a smokey flavour which gives this dish it's signature flavour
8. To make roasting more manageable
9. I usually cut the eggplant in half making sure that the garlic is wedged deep inside so that it doesn't fall out
10. I use a long cooking fork to turn the melongene and make sure it roasts evenly on all sides
11. When eggplant is soft , slit the charred skin lengthways with a knife and scrape out the soft somewhat stringy pulp
12. Discard skin
13. Mash the pulp , tomato , and roasted garlic in a bowl with a fork or pop it into your blender if you want a nice smooth texture
14. Add 1 tsp oil to a non-stick frying pan and cook 1 / 4 cup onion until fragrant but not translucent
15. This is a personal preference some people prefer the raw onions
16. Add the barely cooked finely chopped onion , salt to taste , and scotch bonnet pepper to the eggplant pulp
17. Typically enjoyed as a side with curried meats and rice or in sada roti

title: spinach salad with gorgonzola croutons and bacon twists
steps:
1. Gorgonzola croutons: preheat oven to 375
2. Mash cheese and butter together with a fork and spread half on one side of each of the slices of bread
3. Cut into 1" pieces and place on a baking sheet , cheese side up
4. If not making bacon twists go ahead and bake croutons until golden , about 15 minutes
5. If making bacon twists , the croutons and bacon can be baked together , so prepare the bacon twists
6. Bacon twists: twist each slice of bacon tightly into a spiral and place on the rack of a broiler pan
7. Press ends of bacon onto the pan , the twists will unravel a bit as they cook
8. If baking both the croutons and bacon , put the croutons in the upper third of the oven and the bacon in the middle of the oven for 15 minutes , or until croutons are golden and bacon is crisp
9. Drain the bacon on paper toweling
10. Dressing: combine all the ingredients and whisk until emulsified
11. Salad: in large bowl toss together the spinach , croutons and onion
12. Plate and add the bacon twists and egg
13. Drizzle the dressing over the salad

title: dried blueberry muffins  gift mix in a jar
steps:
1. Creating the gift in a jar:
2. Wash and thoroughly dry a 1-quart wide-mouth canning jar
3. Layer the ingredients in the jar as listed above starting with the sugar , flour , baking powder , soda , salt and then dried blueberries - make sure to press firmly with a flat bottomed object after each addition
4. Make the layers as level as possible
5. Secure the lid and decorate as desired
6. Attach the instructions for making these cookies found below
7. Dried blueberry muffins gift tag:
8. Additional ingredients to be added by the recipient: 1 cup buttermilk , 1 / 2 cup melted butter , 2 eggs and 1 tsp vanilla extract
9. Dried blueberry muffin instructions:
10. Preheat oven to 375
11. In a large bowl , combine the buttermilk , butter , eggs and vanilla
12. Add the contents of the jar , and stir until just mixed
13. Do not overstir
14. Spoon the batter into greased or papered muffin tins , filling each cup two-thirds full
15. Bake for 15-18 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
16. Cool for 10 minutes in the tin , then transfer to a wire rack and cool completely
17. Serve immediately or store in an airtight container for up to 1 week

title: bluegill parmesan
steps:
1. Melt butter in a shallow dish
2. Mix remaining dry ingredients in a bowl
3. Dip fillets in butter then coat in bread crumb mixture
4. Spray a baking pan with non-stick spray
5. Place a single layer of fillets on pan
6. Bake 350 degrees , uncovered for 15 minutes
7. Turn fillets and bake another 10 minutes
8. Enjoy

title: weight watcher s baked potato soup
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f prick potatoes
2. Place on the oven rack and bake until tender
3. Let potatoes sit until cool enough to handle
4. Peel 2 potatoes and cut 2 into 2 inch pieces
5. Mash coarsely the remaining two potatoes
6. Stir mashed potatoes into the diced potatoes
7. Heat a large nonstick dutch oven over medium heat
8. Add the bacon and cook until crisp
9. Transfer to a plate lined with paper towels to drain
10. Crumble the bacon and set aside
11. Add the onions and garlic to the drippings in the dutch oven and cook , stirring occasionally until onions begin to brown
12. Combine the evaporated milk and flour in a medium bowl , beating with a whisk until smooth
13. Add the milk mixture , broth , potatoes , and pepper sauce to the dutch oven
14. Increase the heat and bring to a simmer
15. Reduce the heat and cook
16. Stirring , until the soup is thick and creamy , about 6-7 minutes
17. Remove the dutch oven from the heat
18. Stir in the sour cream , parmesan cheese , salt and ground pepper
19. Divide the soup among 12 bowls
20. Top each serving with cheddar cheese , scalions and reserved bacon
21. Serve at once

title: butter toffee cookies
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , cream together the butter , brown sugar , flavors , salt and baking soda
2. Add the egg and beat until fluffy
3. Add the flour and stir until well-blended
4. Stir in bits and / or chips , and the nuts , if you're using them
5. Drop the dough by generous tablespoonfuls onto ungreased or parchment-lined baking sheets , leaving about 2 inches between cookies
6. Bake the cookies in a preheated 375f oven for 10 to 12 minutes
7. 10 minutes will give you chewier cookies , 12 minutes crisper
8. Let the cookies cool for 5 minutes on the baking sheets before transferring them to racks to cool completely

title: sherried greens with fruit and blue cheese
steps:
1. In tightly covered container , shake all vinaigrette ingredients until sugar is dissolved
2. Arrange salad greens , pear , strawberries and onion on 8 salad plates
3. Pour vinaigrette over salads
4. Sprinkle with cheese

title: barbecue stuffed potatoes
steps:
1. Pierce potatoes with fork
2. Arrange in circle on microwavable paper towels in microwave oven
3. Microwave uncovered on high 5 minutes
4. Turn potatoes over
5. Microwave 5 minutes longer or until potatoes are tender when pierced in center with fork
6. Meanwhile , in small bowl , mix sour cream and 2 tablespoons of the onion
7. Set aside
8. Place chicken in microwavable bowl
9. Cover with microwavable plastic wrap
10. Microwave on high 2 minutes or until thoroughly heated
11. Cut potatoes open
12. Fluff with fork
13. Top potatoes with chicken , sour cream mixture , cheese and remaining 1 tablespoon onion

title: theresa s double tomato soup
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat
2. Add chopped onion , shredded carrot , garlic , and shallots to pan , and cook for 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender , stirring frequently
3. Add sugar , pepper , salt , and 4 basil leaves , and cook 5 minutes
4. Add sundried tomatoes , diced tomatoes , and broth , and bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat , and simmer 1 hour
6. Remove from heat
7. Place half of soup in blender
8. Remove center piece of blender lid
9. Secure blender lid on blender
10. Place a clean towel over opening in blender lid
11. Blend until smooth
12. Pour into a large bowl
13. Repeat procedure with remaining soup
14. Divide soup evenly among 6 bowls
15. Garnish each serving with 1 basil leaf

title: kate s loaded fried rice
steps:
1. In a 6-quart nonstick wok or 6-quart le creuset pot , heat the wok / pot over medium-high heat , and then heat oil until glistening
2. Add 1st bowl , and stir-fry over medium-high heat until softened , about 4 minutes
3. Add 2nd bowl and cook until fragrant , about 1 minute
4. Add soy sauce and 3rd bowl
5. Continue to cook , stirring occasionally , for about 3 minutes
6. Add 4th bowl , and mix
7. Push the fried rice to the outer edge of the wok or pot to create a well
8. Pour the slightly beaten eggs into the well , and cook , stirring gently , until nearly set
9. Toss rice and eggs together
10. Portion fried rice in bowls and garnish with the reserved 1 tablespoon of scallion greens
11. Serve

title: the creamiest crock pot chicken
steps:
1. Place chicken in a greased slow cooker
2. Mix remaining ingredients , except sour cream or cream cheese , and pour over chicken
3. Cover and cook on high heat for 4 hours or low heat for 6-8 hours
4. 30 minutes before serving , stir in sour cream or cream cheese
5. Serve over pasta or rice

title: moroccan seafood and broccoli salad
steps:
1. Steam broccoli 5 minutes , drain and refresh under cold running water
2. Place in large bowl
3. Add scallions through seafood
4. Bring the chicken broth to a boil in a medium saucepan
5. Add the couscous , parsley and thyme , and cook 30 seconds
6. Remove pan from heat , cover tightly and let stand 5 minutes
7. Make dressing: whisk the seasonings into the lemon juice
8. Gradually mix oil into the lemon juice until emulsified
9. Add the couscous , while still hot , to the vegetable mixture
10. Add the dressing and toss to combine well
11. Chill at least 1 hour
12. Sprinkle with chopped pecans , pine nuts or other nuts of your choice before serving

title: beef tenderloin steaks with smoky bacon bourbon sauce
steps:
1. Boil wine and garlic in heavy medium saucepan until reduced to 1 / 2 cup , about 15 minutes
2. Add next 5 ingredients
3. Boil until reduced by half , about 20 minutes
4. Set sauce aside
5. Cook bacon in a heavy large skillet over medium-high heat until crisp
6. Using slotted spoon , transfer to paper towels
7. Pour off all but 1 tablespoon drippings from skillet
8. Add flour to drippings in skillet
9. Whisk to blend
10. Cook 1 minute , whisking constantly
11. Gradually whisk in wine sauce made previously
12. Bring to a boil
13. Reduce heat
14. Simmer until sauce thickens , about 2 minutes
15. Meanwhile melt butter in another heavy large skillet over medium-high heat
16. Sprinkle steaks with salt and pepper
17. Add to skillet and cook to desired doneness , about 4 minutes per side for medium-rare
18. Transfer steaks to plates
19. Mix bacon and bourbon into sauce
20. Season with salt and pepper
21. Spoon over steaks

title: barbara s hot salsa
steps:
1. Sprinkle salt in bottom of crock
2. Add tomatoes , onions , peppers , sugar , spices , and lime juice
3. Daily , sprinkle just a little salt into crock and stir
4. On the 4th or 5th day , pack into hot sterile pint jars
5. Process in boiling hot water bath for 10 minutes

title: spinach stuffed tomatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Lightly grease a baking dish
3. Slice off the top 1 / 4 of each tomato , then remove seeds and pulp
4. Reserve pulp and discard seeds
5. Mix spinach , ricotta , bread crumbs , tomato pulp , oregano , and salt
6. Stuff tomatoes with mixture , and place each in baking dish
7. Cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes
8. Remove and drain , if necessary
9. Add mozzarella cheese to tops of tomatoes
10. Return to oven , uncovered for 15-20 minutes , or until cheese melts

title: chocolate cheesecake chunks
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Melt butter in 9-inch square baking pan
3. Stir in crumbs and 1 / 2 cup nuts
4. Press to cover bottom of pan
5. In a small bowl , beat cream cheese , sugar , cocoa , egg , and vanilla at medium speed until smooth
6. Pour over crust and sprinkle with remaining 1 / 2 cup nuts
7. Bake 20 minutes
8. Let stand at room temperature 2 hours
9. Cut into 1-inch squares with a sharp knife
10. Store covered , in refrigerator
11. These cookies are best presentted in a single layer

title: crock pot beef tips
steps:
1. Layer in crock pot starting with beef
2. Cook on low for 8 hours

title: frosty fruity smoothie
steps:
1. Combine blueberries or huckleberries , peaches and milk in a blender
2. Cover and process on high until smooth
3. Add yogurt , honey , cinnamon and nutmeg
4. Process until well blended
5. Serve immediately

title: kidney bean taco salad
steps:
1. In a large skillet , cook beef over medium heat until no longer pink , drain
2. In a large bowl , combine the lettuce , tomato , beans and beef
3. Drizzle with dressing and toss to coat
4. Arrange tortilla chips on a serving plate and top with the beef mixture

title: crock pot southwest chicken and rice
steps:
1. Place chicken in crock pot
2. Combine beans , red peppers , tomatoes , onion , salt and peppr
3. Pour over chicken
4. Cover and cook on high 2 to 3 hours or until chicken is no longer pink
5. Serve over rice

title: tutmanik  cheese bread
steps:
1. In medium bowl , mix together yogurt , eggs , oil , feta , salt , and sugar
2. Sift together flour , baking powder , and baking soda
3. Slowly add the yogurt mixture and stir well
4. Pour into a well-greased 9x9 inch baking dish
5. Lightly sprinkle with paprika and caraway seeds
6. Bake in a preheated 400 degree oven for 20 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean
7. Serve warm with butter

title: no muss no fuss italian drip beef
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , except roast , and mix well
2. Put roast in pan
3. Pour mixture over roast
4. Bake at 275 for 5-6 hours or until fork tender
5. Shred beef in pan
6. Serve on rolls or bread of choice
7. May top with favorite cheese and broil until cheese is golden brown , or --
8. Dip sandwich in aus juice

title: terri s best burger
steps:
1. Heat outdoor grill or grill pan
2. Gently mix ground meats and worcestershire sauce in medium bowl with a fork until blended
3. Shape meat into four patties about 1 inch thick
4. Sprinkle both sides of patties with salt and pepper
5. Coat burgers with nonstick spray
6. Grill , turning once , 8 to 10 minutes until instant read thermometer inserted from side to middle registers 160 degrees
7. Serve on buns with lettruce , tomato and onion

title: pakistani style turai ka salan  courgettes curry
steps:
1. Fry the onions in the oil till they turn dark brown
2. Then add tomato , ginger garlic paste , salt , red chili powder , coriander powder & turmeric powder
3. Saute the onion & tomato till the tomatoes become tender & the oil starts showing in the curry
4. Add courgettes , mix & let them tenderize for 20 minutes on low medium heat
5. Now add garam masala powder & cumin seeds
6. Cover & let it cook for another 5 minutes
7. In the end add the green chili & lemon juice
8. Let it simmer for additional 2 minutes
9. Serve warm with naan , roti or chapati

title: pappa al pomodoro   classic italian tomato soup
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large stock pot over medium heat
2. Add the onions , carrots , fennel , and garlic
3. Cook over medium-low heat for 10 minutes , until tender
4. Add the ciabatta cubes and cook for 5 more minutes
5. Place the tomatoes in the bowl of a food processor fitted with a steel blade and process until coarsely chopped
6. Add the tomatoes to the pot along with the chicken stock , red wine , basil , 1 t salt , and 1 1 / 2 t pepper
7. Bring the soup to a boil , lower the heat and allow to simmer , partially covered for 45 minutes
8. Meanwhile: preheat oven to 375f
9. Topping:
10. In a large bowl , put the reserved ciabatta bread cubes , pancetta and whole basil leaves in the bowl and drizzle with olive oil
11. Toss to coat
12. On a lined sheet pan large enough for all ingredients , place the ingredients in a single layer , be sure the basil leaves are flat
13. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
14. Bake until the cubes are toasted , pancetta crispy and basil leaves turn dark & crisp
15. This may take 15-20 minutes
16. Check on your soup
17. If the soup is too lumpy for you you can smash with a wooden spoon , potato masher or use a submersion blender to break up the bread cubes
18. Alternately you can puree in batches in a food processor or blender
19. Blend to desired consistency
20. I prefer a more rustic presentation
21. Take care to only fill the blender or food processor 1 / 3 when you puree hot soup
22. Turn up the heat to rewarm if necessary
23. At this point check for seasoning
24. Add more salt and pepper as needed
25. Stir in parmesan cheese , top with basil leaf , pancetta and bread cubes
26. Freezes well

title: broccoli   garlic pasta for one
steps:
1. Saute the onions and garlic in the olive oil until soft
2. Add wine , broth& broccoli
3. Cover and cook for 3 minutes
4. Toss pasta with broccoli and cook until both are heated through
5. Season to taste , put on a dinner plate and sprinkle with cheese

title: jim s country ribs
steps:
1. Fill a 12 quart pot 2 / 3 full with water
2. Add all ingredients except bar-b-que sauce
3. Bring to a boil over high heat
4. As soon as water begins to boil , lower heat to simmer and simmer for 45-60 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Drain off liquid
6. Place ribs in a baking pan
7. Pour bar-b-que sauce over ribs
8. Cover with foil and bake in a 350 degree oven for about 30-45 minutes
9. Option: instead of baking in oven , put ribs on the grill and baste with sauce

title: mushrooms with spicy spanish sauce
steps:
1. Add anchovies , garlic , paprika , parsley and olive oil to food processor or mini-chop and pulse to combine
2. Reserve
3. Heat a large skillet over high heat
4. Add oil then mushrooms and saut until mushrooms have softened and are turning golden , about 3 to 5 minutes
5. Reduce heat to medium-low and stir in spanish sauce
6. Cook together until sauce is hot
7. Remove from heat and season to taste with salt and pepper
8. Toast bread and place on individual serving plates
9. Brush with any sauce left in skillet
10. Divide mushroom mixture into 4 and heap onto toast
11. Toss arugula with balsamic and olive oil and surround toasts with salad
12. Sprinkle everything with a little maldon salt

title: carmen s tutti frutti smoothie
steps: 1. Place all ingredients in a blender and process until smooth

title: spiced beef and butternut squash stew
steps:
1. In a slow cooker , whisk together the tomato sauce , ginger , cumin , cinnamon , 1 / 2 c water , salt , and pepper
2. Stir in onion
3. Sprinkle beef with flour and add to the cooker
4. Toss to coat
5. Scatter the butternut squash over the top and cook , covered , until the beef is tender , 7-8 hours on low or 4-5 hours on high
6. Ten minutes before serving , prepare couscous according to package directions
7. Fold the chickpeas into the stew and cook , covered until heated through , about 3 minutes
8. Serve the stew over the couscous and sprinkle with cilantro

title: top secret recipes version of doubletree hotel s chocolate chip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grind oats in a food processor or blender until ground fine
3. Combine ground oats with flour , baking soda , salt and cinnamon in a medium bowl
4. In a separate bowl combine the butter , sugars , vanilla and lemon juice and mix with mixer until combined
5. Add the eggs and mix until smooth and creamy
6. Stir the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients and blend well
7. Add the chocolate chips and macadamia nuts to the dough and mix by hand until ingredients are well mixed
8. Spoon rounded 1 / 4 cups full onto ungreased , nonstick cookie sheet
9. Place scoops of dough 2" apart
10. Bake 16-18 minutes or until cookies are light brown and soft in the middle
11. Let cool
12. Store in sealed container to keep soft

title: bbq duck and ramen soup
steps:
1. Combine stock and water into saucepan and heat till liquid is simmering
2. Add , galangal , chillies and lime juice to saucepan
3. Bruise lemon grass and coriander , and add to saucepan
4. Simmer liquid for 20 minutes
5. Strain liquid , and return to saucepan
6. Heat liquid with duck and shallots
7. Boil ramen noodles in separate saucepan for 3-5 minutes or till tender
8. Drain noodles
9. Add noodles and bak choy to soup stock and simmer for 5 minutes
10. Ladle soup to serving bowls , garnishing with bean sprouts , chilli strips and coriander
11. Add salt and pepper to taste
12. Enjoy hot

title: soy sesame beef stir fry
steps:
1. Chop all the vegetables first , you won't have time if you start cooking first
2. Cut the steak into bite-sized pieces , or strips against the grain if you prefer
3. In a small bowl or measuring cup , mix sauce ingredients together well with a whisk
4. In a wok or huge skillet , melt the butter over medium-high heat until very hot , then add the garlic , onion , and steak pieces
5. Stir-fry 3-5 minutes , until meat is mostly browned
6. Add all the vegetables
7. Stir-fry 2-3 minutes
8. Pour the sauce over the entire pan , and continue stir-frying another 5-10 minutes , until steak is desired done-ness and vegetables are crisp-tender
9. Serve over rice

title: rose s easy but  yummy peach pie
steps:
1. Drain the peaches well and pour over the unbaked pie crust
2. In a small bowl combine the rest of the ingredients
3. Dump over the peaches and try to spread the mixture over the peaches as evenly as possible
4. Bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for 1 hour
5. Remove and cool slightly
6. Slice and serve with your favorite vanilla ice cream
7. Enjoy !
8. Make sure to use the shallow pie shells , if you use the deep dish pie shells , you may want to add more peaches

title: grandma anna s apple cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Lightly grease or spray a 9 x 9 cake pan
3. In a medium bowl , cream the shortening sugars & eggs together
4. In another bowl , sift together the dry ingredients
5. Add to the creamed ingredients , alternately with the sour milk
6. Beat on medium-high until smooth
7. Fold in the diced apples
8. Pour into greased pan
9. Topping:
10. Mix together 1 teaspoons cinnamon , cup white sugar & cup light brown sugar
11. Spinkle evenly over top of cake
12. Bake for 1 hour or until a toothpick , inserted in the center comes out clean
13. Enjoy !

title: poached nectarines
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , combine wine , sugar , cinnamon sticks , lemon peel , and 5 cups water
2. Place over medium heat , and stir until sugar is dissolved
3. Gently place nectarines in the liquid
4. Add more water if needed to cover nectarines
5. Place a square of cheesecloth over the fruit , and top with a small plate to keep fruit submerged
6. Increase heat to high , and bring liquid to a boil
7. Reduce to a simmer , and cook until nectarines are tender but not soft , about 5 minutes
8. Remove nectarines from liquid , and allow to cool
9. Return liquid to a boil , and cook until reduced to a syrup that will coat the back of spoon , about 20 minutes
10. Remove from heat , and cool
11. Cut nectarines in half , and remove pit
12. Place two halves on serving plate
13. Drizzle with syrup
14. Top each half with a dollop of crme frache and a sprig of mint

title: cookies with a hug
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients together
2. Mix well
3. Batter will be very firm
4. Drop on ungreased cookie sheet by the teaspoonsful
5. Bake in oven of 350 degrees
6. Bake for 8-13 minutes
7. Press a hug in the middle of each cookie
8. Chocolate will melt in the middle
9. Let cool
10. After thoroughly cooled , dust with a tiny bit of powdered sugar
11. Enjoy

title: winter squash pumpkin  pie
steps:
1. Wash-peel and cube fresh pumpkin or squash
2. Steam for one hour
3. Drain in a colander for a long time mashing the pumpkin periodically
4. This mixture freezes well in zip bags
5. In a large bowl combine the squash , milk , eggs , rum and vanilla , mix well
6. Stir in the rest of the ingredients
7. Pour the batter into the pie shell
8. Bake at 300f for one hour

title: homemade rice pudding
steps:
1. Wash rice and put into glass baking dish with milk and sugar bake at least 2 hours at 250-300
2. Stir two or three times during cooking
3. Serve hot from oven , or eat the leftovers

title: gyro burgers
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine lamb , beef , bread crumbs , minced onion , garlic , allspice , coriander , cumin
2. Add just 1 tsp of the salt and 1 / 8 tsp of the pepper and mix well
3. Form into 4 patties , cover and chill 2 hours
4. In another bowl , whisk together vinegar , oregano , 1 / 4 tsp salt , and 1 / 8 tsp pepper
5. Gradually whisk in the oil until blended well
6. Add tomatoes , sliced onions , and cucumbers and stir to coat
7. Cover and let marinate at least 2 hours
8. When you are ready to cook your burgers , oil& preheat your grill and grill as you would any hamburger
9. When burgers are fully cooked , slit pita pockets open on the sides to form open pockets and place a burger inside
10. Have bowls of the tomato topping , the shredded lettuce , and some tzatziki on the table for guests to add as desired
11. The yogurt sauce is available in the dairy case near dips or at the deli counter or some markets or you can prepare a homemade version

title: nee nee s old timey tea cakes
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar until fluffy
2. Add eggs and mix well
3. Add remaining ingredients and mix well
4. Drop by spoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheets , or a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper
5. Bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for about 10 minutes until lightly brown
6. You can also "roll" this mixture out and use cookie cutters to make shapes

title: cream of cantaloupe soup
steps:
1. In a food processor or blender blend the cantaloupe for 10 to 15 seconds
2. Add the orange juice , lemon juice , and cinnamon
3. Process for an additional 10 seconds
4. Add the cream and honey
5. Scrape down the sides and process an additional 10 seconds
6. Pour the cantaloupe mixture into a bowl and fold in the yogurt
7. Refrigerate for several hours
8. To serve place in a bowl and garnish with fresh strawberries

title: almost like dessert honey and brown sugar glazed carrot pennies
steps:
1. In a saucepan , boil carrots in lightly salted water about 8 to 10 minutes or until just tender
2. Drain well and place in serving dish
3. Melt butter in a small saucepan
4. Add honey and brown sugar
5. Stir in parsley , if desired
6. Heat thoroughly
7. Stirring until blended
8. Pour over carrots
9. Serve hot

title: oven baked parmesan chicken fingers
steps:
1. Shake bread crumbs and cheese together in plastic bag
2. Combine carlic and oil in a small bowl
3. Flatten chicken to 1 / 2 inch thickness , cut into one inch wide strips
4. Dip strips in oil mixture , coat with crumb mixture
5. Arrange on a greased baking sheet
6. Bake at 350 for 20 minutes , turning after 10 minutes

title: cilantro noodle bowl with cilantro pesto
steps:
1. Cook the soba in a big pot of rapidly boiling salted water just until tender - but about 20 seconds before the pasta is done cooking add the broccoli to the pot
2. Cook it until barely done
3. Now drain and rinse under cold running water
4. Sprinkle with lemon zest and set aside
5. Make the dressing by combining the cilantro , garlic , cayenne , salt , and olive oil
6. Blend in a food processor or chop by hand
7. Taste , adjust for more salt if needed and set aside
8. Drain the tofu , pat it dry , and cut it into rectangles roughly the size of your thumb
9. Cook the tofu in a dry nonstick skillet over medium-high heat for a few minutes , until the pieces are browned on one side
10. Toss gently once or twice , then continue cooking for another minute or so , until the tofu is firm , golden , and bouncy
11. Remove from skillet , let cool a bit and if desired cut into matchsticks , sometimes i don't bother and use larger pieces instead
12. In a large mixing bowl , combine the soba , broccoli , and a couple big splashes of the cilantro dressing
13. Toss until well combined
14. Add the tofu and gently toss again , add more dressing and a couple pinches of salt if needed
15. Turn out onto platter and crown with a couple pinches of cayenne and a squeeze of lemon juice

title: sunken chocolate cake
steps:
1. Set oven rack to lowest possible position in oven
2. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f
3. Have ready a greased 8-9" springform pan lined with parchment paper
4. Put chocolate pieces into a large microwaveable bowl and cook on high for 1 minute , stir , and continue cooking for 30 seconds , then stir again , repeat as needed until smooth& melted
5. Set melted chocolate- still in cooking bowl- over another bowl filled with hot water on counter
6. Meanwhile , beat egg whites , adding just 1 / 4 cup of the sugar gradually , until stiff peaks form- they will appear shiny
7. In another bowl , cream the butter and remaining 1 / 4 cup sugar until fluffy
8. Add egg yolks and beat for 1 minute
9. Add finely ground nuts and the brandy and beat for 2 more minutes
10. Now , your chocolate should still be slightly warm , but no longer burning hot- add just a bit at a time to the butter mixture , stirring with a rubber spatula to combine well until all is added
11. Fold just 1 / 4 of the chocolate butter mixture into the egg whites
12. Next , gently pour the now chocolatey egg white mixture into the remaining chocolate butter mixture and fold very gently- you don't want to crush down the egg whites
13. Pour carefully into the springform pan
14. Bake 40-45 minutes if using an 8" pan , slightly less for the 9" pan
15. Cake is ready when a toothpick comes out with thick , moist but not wet crumbs stuck to it- it should not come out clean
16. Let cake cool in pan 30 minutes- the cake will sink considerably
17. Remove outer ring of pan and invert cake onto a platter
18. -peel off the parchment
19. Sprinkle with some additional granulated sugar
20. This should be served warm , with a dollop of sweetened whipped cream on top , and a garnish of fresh berries in season
21. It is moist in texture- more like a fudgey brownie than a fluffy cake texture
22. Leftovers should be kept in the fridge
23. If you need to make this in advance , set the cake out on the counter about 30 minutes before serving to bring it to room temperature
24. Garnish just before serving or the whipped cream will weep and make a mess all over the cake

title: pork steak in wine sauce
steps:
1. Heat oil in large skillet
2. Brown pork on both sides
3. Remove meat from skillet
4. Add onions and mushrooms to skillet
5. Cook until onion and mushrooms are tender but not browned
6. Add pork back to skillet
7. Pour wine over pork
8. Cover tightly and simmer 1 hour or until pork steaks are tender
9. Garnish with parsley

title: really good rum balls
steps:
1. Line trays with waxed paper
2. Set aside
3. In a large bowl , whisk together icing sugar , almonds and bittersweet chocolate
4. Add 1 / 4 cup of the rum and vanilla , stirring until moist
5. Press together
6. Chill until firm enough to roll , about 15 minutes
7. Roll by rounded 1tsp into balls , moistening and wiping hands with damp cloth as needed
8. Place on prepared trays
9. Pour remaining rum into shallow bowl
10. Pour chocolate sprinkles into separate shallow bowl
11. Roll balls in rum then in chocolate , pressing lightly so chocolate sticks
12. Let dry on tray , about 1 hour
13. Refrigerate until firm

title: brown sugar butter cookies
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except flour in large bowl
2. Beat at medium speed until creamy
3. Reduce speed to low
4. Add flour
5. Beat until well mixed
6. Divide dough in half
7. Wrap each half in plastic food wrap
8. Flatten slightly
9. Refrigerate until firm
10. Heat oven to 350f roll out dough on lightly floured surface , one-half at a time , to 1 / 8-inch thickness
11. Cut with 3-inch cookie cutters
12. Place 1 inch apart onto ungreased cookie sheets
13. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes or until edges are very lightly browned
14. Cool 1 minute
15. Remove from cookie sheet

title: potato pancakes w katenspeck and cheese  german
steps:
1. Coarsely grate potatoes & squeeze dry w / your hands or a colander , pressing down w / the back of a ladle
2. Place in a bowl w / the grated onion & mix in the flour
3. Add salt , some freshly ground black pepper + herbs & set aside
4. In a lrg non-stick fry pan , fry chopped ham till crisp
5. Remove ham from pan , but leave rendered fat in pan
6. Stir crisped ham + cheese into the potato mixture
7. Heat 1 tbsp canola oil w / the rendered fat
8. When hot , drop in a rounded tbsp of potato mixture & flatten w / the back of a spoon to a round shape or as neatly as you can
9. Fry for 2-3 min over med-heat till golden brown & flip to cook the other side
10. Repeat w / the mixture in batches
11. Top up the oil as needed & make sure it is hot b4 frying ea batch
12. Drain on paper towels , keep uncovered in a warm oven till all batches are cooked & then have a feast
13. Since the pancakes are cooked in batches & w / o the yield , the cooking time was entirely guesstimated

title: baby artichoke gratin
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375f
2. Clean the artichokes by peeling the stems , chopping off the top third , and peeling off the outer , tough leaves
3. Keep the prepared artichokes in a bowl of water with a little lemon added to prevent discoloration while you finish cleaning the rest
4. In a small gratin dish large enough to hold them all , add the artichokes , the garlic , olive oil and white wine
5. Add a little water if needed to bring the level up to almost cover the artichokes , cover , and then bake them in the preheated oven until they are tender
6. Usually this will take between 20 to 30 minutes
7. Remove the artichokes from the oven , and increase the temperature to 425f
8. Pour off any excess liquid from the cooked chokes , and set aside
9. Mix together the ingredients listed for the topping , and sprinkle this over the artichokes in the casserole dish
10. Drizzle on a little additional olive oil , and bake the archokes just until the topping becomes golden brown
11. Serve immediately , or at room temperature

title: spicy shrimp and spaghetti ay oy
steps:
1. Boil the spaghetti in lots of salted water
2. When the spaghetti is almost done , toss the shrimp right into the pasta water
3. Drain shrimp and spaghetti in the same pan , combine the butter and olive oil
4. Add the garlic and lemon when the butter is melted
5. Add the cayenne pepper make it as hot as you like it
6. Toss the shrimp and spaghetti back into the butter sauce to coat
7. Serve with parmesan cheese , if desired

title: pisco sunrise
steps:
1. Pour everything in a long glass over ice
2. Stir
3. Garnish with slice of orange and 2 straws

title: pan seared herbed salmon
steps:
1. Rub the salmon steaks on all sides with olive oil
2. Combine all herbs and seasonings in a small bowl
3. Sprinkle mixture over salmon on all sides
4. Place salmon in a screaming hot frying pan and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side or until both sides are lightly browned and crisp
5. Keep pan covered
6. Do not overcook , as fish will turn out dry

title: leek and morel strata
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Greas a 9x13" bakig dish with butter
3. Soak and chop the mushrooms and strain the soaking liquid
4. Set aside 1 / 2 cup of the liquid for this recipe
5. While mushrooms soak , toast the bread cubes on a baking sheet in the oven until dry and crisp but not necesssarily golden , 5-10 minutes
6. Set aside to cool
7. Turn off the oven
8. Heat 2 tablespoons butter in a large , heavy skillet over medium high heat until it begins to brown
9. Add leeks and sprinkle generously with salt and pepper
10. Cook , stirring , until leeks are translucent , soft , and browned in places , 8-10 minutes
11. Stir in mushrooms and the reserved mushroom liquid
12. Raise heat to medium high and cook until liquid almost completely evaporates , 1-2 minutes
13. Remove from heat
14. Beat eggs in a large bowl
15. Whisk milk , cheese , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , and a few grinds of pepper
16. Arrange half of bread cubes evenly over bottom of buttered baking dish
17. Scatter half of the mushroom-leek mixture
18. Pour over half of the egg mixture
19. Top with the remaining bread , and then the remaining mushroom-leek mixture
20. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
21. Cover and refrigerate over night
22. Heat oven to 350 degrees
23. Let the strata sit at room temperature while the oven heats
24. Uncover and bake until eggs are set and top browns in places , about 45 minutes
25. Let rest for 10 minutes before serving

title: roasted garlic soup with parmesan
steps:
1. Melt butter in heavy large saucepan over medium-high heat
2. Add onions and thyme and cook until onions are translucent , about 6 minutes
3. Add roasted garlic and 18 raw garlic cloves and cook 3 minutes
4. Add chicken stock
5. Cover and simmer until garlic is very tender , about 20 minutes
6. Working in batches , pure soup in blender until smooth
7. Return soup to saucepan
8. Add cream and bring to simmer
9. Season with salt and pepper
10. Divide grated cheese among 4 bowls and ladle soup over
11. Squeeze juice of 1 lemon wedge into each bowl and serve

title: pizza chicken melts
steps:
1. Preheat the grill by turning it to high
2. Sandwich the chicken breasts between two plastic food bags and beat them firmly with a rolling pin or base of a saucepan to flaten them by a third
3. Heat the oil in a non stick frying pan , add the chicken and cook for 2 minutes on each side until golden
4. Grate the cheese and quarter the tomatoes and mix the two together
5. Take the chicken out of the pan and wipe out the oil so that it doesn't spit under the grill later
6. Return the chicken to the pan , spread each with a tsp of pesto , then pile the cheese and tomatoes on top
7. Put under the hot grill for a minute or so until the cheese has melted and is bubbly

title: para morirse para     mexican rice with my twist
steps:
1. Rice -- cook the rice accordingly to pkg directions
2. I cook mine ahead just to save time , but it is not necessary
3. You can use long grain , medium , quick cooking or boil in bags
4. Whatever works best for you
5. Make it easy on yourself
6. Vegetables -- to a medium saute pan , add the olive oil and heat to medium
7. Then add in the garlic and onion and cook until tender
8. Toss in the olives , chilies , tomatoes , broth , seasoning except for the parsley
9. And cook on medium low until well combined
10. Cook 5 minutes
11. Combine -- add the rice to the tomato and vegetable mixture just to reheat the rice and all the flavors are combined
12. Cook another 2-3 minutes
13. The last minute add the parsley
14. Serve -- serve family style and top with the grated cheese
15. You can also add some extra parsley if you want as a garnish
16. Enjoy !

title: glazed apple pork kabobs
steps:
1. Soak skewers in water for 60 mintes or make recipe #227473
2. Glaze:
3. In small saucepan , make glaze by mixing together the jelly , lemon juice and zest , cinnamon and butter
4. Simmer until well blended
5. Sprinkle lemon juice , zest and salt and pepper evenly over pork and apple cubes
6. Thread pork onto skewers and spoon glaze over all
7. Grill over hot coals 10-12 minutes
8. Turning frequently
9. Baste frequently

title: spicy ginger chicken
steps:
1. Put oil into wok or frying pan
2. When hot , add garlic and stir-fry until brown
3. Add onion and chicken
4. Stir-fry until chicken begins to turn white
5. Add ginger and red pepper , combine well
6. Add chilies and chicken stock / water , and stir-fry for 1 minute
7. Check chicken is white throughout , and then add spring onions
8. Cook for 30 seconds
9. Serve with rice

title: slow cooker spicy black eyed peas
steps:
1. Pour the water into a slow cooker , add the bouillon cube , and stir to dissolve
2. Combine the black-eyed peas , onion , garlic , bell pepper , jalapeno pepper , ham , bacon , cayenne pepper , cumin , salt , and pepper
3. Stir to blend
4. Cover the slow cooker and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours until the beans are tender

title: grandmother s super flaky pie crust
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f degrees
2. Pour flour into medium bowl , add margarine using pastry blender until lumps are slightly smaller than pea-size
3. Add water
4. Mix gently with fork until dough comes away from the sides of bowl
5. Be very gentle , and try not to mix too much
6. Transfer half of dough to a sheet of wax paper lightly sprinkled with flour
7. Sprinkle a little flour onto top of pie dough
8. Cover pie dough with another sheet of wax paper
9. Roll out so the pie crust is level , and not too thick in one place , or too thin in another
10. Peel off top layer of wax paper from dough , and place pie pan on top of dough
11. Carefully slide your hand underneath bottom layer of wax paper , and flip
12. Then , carefully peel the wax paper from pie dough , and ease into pan
13. Repeat steps 4-8 with other half of dough
14. Bake for 15 min , or so or until golden brown in color
15. Fill with any pie filling !

title: chicken breasts in cream sauce
steps:
1. Brown chicken breast
2. Place breasts in oven dish
3. Mix together the onion , garlic , cream , broth , salt , white pepper and worcestershire and mix well
4. Pour over the chicken and bake 2 hours at 300 degrees
5. After baking , remove breasts
6. Strain juices into saucepan
7. Add 2 tablespoons flour and 1 / 2 cup water
8. Mix with whisk until thickened
9. Add milk if too thick
10. Pour sauce over breasts and garnish with parsley

title: thai green curry with duck
steps:
1. Cut duck breast crosswise into -inch thick strips
2. Heat oil in a dutch oven over high heat until shimmering but not smoking
3. Cook duck , in a single layer , stirring once , until beginning to brown , about 1-3 minutes
4. Transfer duck to a plate
5. To the drippings in the pan , add the eggplant , bell peppers , coconut milk , broth , brown sugar , curry paste , fish sauce , and lime juice
6. Bring to a boil , stirring
7. Decrease heat to a simmer
8. Cover and cook , stirring occasionally , 8-10 minutes , until vegetables are tender
9. Return duck to pan
10. Stir to coat with the sauce
11. Cook until heated through , about 1 minute
12. Remove from heat
13. Stir in fresh basil and serve immediately over or with brown basmati rice

title: death by chocolate waffles
steps:
1. Preheat a waffle iron and grease it lightly with butter
2. Combine flours , cocoa , baking powder , cinnamon and salt in a large bowl
3. Toss to mix
4. Set aside
5. Combine butter , chocolate and sugar in a heavy-bottomed saucepan and melt over very low heat
6. Whisk to smooth , remove from heat , then whisk in milk and eggs
7. Make a well in dry ingredients , pour in chocolate mixture , and blend , just until everything is combined
8. Watch for dry clumps
9. Let batter stand for several minutes
10. It will thicken slightly
11. Cook batter in prepared waffle iron until crisp and golden , about 2 minutes
12. Keep warm
13. Repeat with remaining batter
14. Serve with ice cream and maple syrup

title: indian potato cakes  aloo tikki  with cilantro chutney yogurt
steps:
1. Heat oil in frying pan to medium heat
2. Mix simply potatoes mashed potatoes , red bell peppers , green onions , egg , flour , cumin , coriander , turmeric powder
3. Allow to stand for 10 minutes
4. In the meantime , blend the cilantro , jalapeno , pistachios , lime juice and yogurt into a smooth consistency
5. Add salt to taste
6. When oil is ready , use two tablespoons to make patties , smoothing one over the other , like making a cannelle
7. Drop into hot oil
8. Fry each side until golden brown
9. If doing in batches , you can keep warm in a 200 degree oven
10. Plate them with sauce and enjoy !

title: buffalo roast chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Sprinkle chicken with salt and paprika
3. Place on rack in a roasting pan
4. Chicken should roast for 2 to 2 1 / 2 hours until a meat thermometer registers 180 degrees when inserted in the thickest part of the thigh
5. Avoid touching the thigh bone when checking the temperature
6. While chicken is cooking , combine the butter , hot pepper sauce , vinegar , garlic powder , and cayenne in a small bowl
7. Brush this mixture over the chicken several times during the last 20 minutes of cooking
8. Let the chicken sit 10 minutes before carving

title: spicy dry rub elk tacos
steps:
1. In a small bowl add all spices and blend together
2. Place sirloin cuts on a cutting board and season with dry rub on both sides
3. If you have time , i recommend letting the meat sit and marinade at room temperature before cooking
4. I often suggest 30 minutes
5. Put the meat to the side and begin chopping up all of your taco ingredients: onions , bell peppers , tomatos , avocado and anything else you want to add
6. Cook your taco shells after your taco condimients are ready and set aside in a 250 degree oven to keep warm
7. Be sure before putting the meat on the grille that you get your cast iron grille good and hot
8. Place meat on grille and cook for 3-4 minutes turning diagonally and cooking for another 3-4 minutes before turning over and cooking on the other side
9. This will give you great criss-cross grille marks
10. Remove meat immediately and let rest for a few minutes before slicing in 1 / 4 inch slices across the grain

title: herb bread
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine first five ingredients
2. Spread butter mixture on one side of each bread slice
3. Either wrap loaf in foil and bake at 350f for 20-25 minutes or broil on medium until slightly browned to your preference

title: julie s instant breakfast
steps:
1. Slice banana and put all ingredients into the blender
2. Blend until smooth

title: marinated carrot salad with ginger   sesame oil
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , toss the shredded carrots with the garlic , vingear , 1 / 2 cup of the cilantro and 1 / 4 cup of the grapeseed or olive oil
2. Season the carrots with salt and pepper
3. Let the carrots stand for 15 minutes
4. Drain
5. Meanwhile , in a small saucepan , boil the carrot juice over moderate heat until it is reduced by half , about 5 minutes
6. Let the reduced carrot juice cool slightly , then transfer to a bowl
7. Whisk in the mayonnaise , sesame oil , ginger juice and the remaining 1 / 4 cup of oil
8. Season the carrot dressing generously with salt and pepper
9. Add the carrot dressing and the remaining 1 / 2 cup of cilantro to the carrots and toss the salad well
10. Transfer to a shallow bowl and serve immediately
11. Enjoy !

title: creamy mints
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in bowl , mixing well
2. Knead for 10 minutes
3. Roll small ball in granulated sugar and press in mold

title: amy s crock pot chicken and noodles
steps:
1. Cook egg noodles until barely tender , drain , mix with chicken and all other ingredients in a large bowl , make sure noodles are coated well
2. Pour mixture into greased crock pot , and cook on low for 6-10 hours

title: italian steak sandwiches
steps:
1. With a small amount of olive oil heated on medium high , saute mushrooms and onions until soft
2. Stir in peppers
3. Place in a bowl and keep warm
4. Divide shaved beef into two portions and shape generally into same shape as grinder roll
5. Meanwhile toast grinder rolls
6. In same skillet as mushrooms were cooked heat a little more olive oil
7. Place two meat portions in hot skillet and brown
8. Flip over and immediately place cheese on each meat portion
9. Heat until cheese is melted
10. Using spatula remove meat from skillet and place cheese side down in grinder rolls
11. Top with mushroom , onion , and pepper mixture
12. Can top sandwich with lettuce , tomato , mayo , etc

title: black bean soup with cumin and jalapeno
steps:
1. Heat oil in a heavy large pot over medium-high heat
2. Add onion , carrot , and garlic
3. Saute until vegetables begin to soften , about 6 minutes
4. Mix in cumin and 1 teaspoon jalapeno
5. Add beans , tomatoes with juice and broth
6. Bring soup to boil
7. Reduce heat to medium , cover , and cook until carrots are tender , about 15 minutes
8. Transfer 3 cups of soup to blender and puree until smooth
9. Return puree to pot
10. Simmer soup until slightly thickened , about 15 minutes
11. Season to taste with salt , pepper , and remaining 1 teaspoon jalapeno , if desired
12. Ladle soup into bowls
13. Pass cilantro , green onions , and feta cheese separately

title: cajun chicken pasta recipe
steps:
1. In a large pot with boiling water cook pasta until done then drain
2. Meanwhile , place chicken and cajun seasoning in a bowl and toss to coat
3. In a large skillet over medium heat , saut chicken in butter or margarine until chicken is tender , about 5 to 7 minutes
4. Reduce heat and green onion , heavy cream , tomatoes , basil , salt , garlic powder , black pepper and heat through
5. Pour over linguini and toss
6. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese

title: super spinach side
steps:
1. The key to this recipe is that it has to be prepared right before serving
2. Prepare the bacon and crumble it
3. Pour the olive oil into a frying pan and heat on medium heat
4. Add the spinach leaves
5. Once the spinach leaves have mostly wilted , add the bacon and the pine nuts
6. Just before serving , add the feta cheese crumbles
7. The ingredient amounts i have stated above are ballpark figures
8. I usually use a bag of baby spinach leaves for this recipe
9. You can use sunflower seeds instead of pine nuts and blue or gorgonzola cheeses instead of feta

title: hot black bean and sweet corn dip
steps:
1. Combine corn , beans , salsa , and spices
2. Stir in cubes of cream cheese
3. Bake 350 degrees for 25 minutes
4. Serve with tortilla chips

title: lil  smokey wraps
steps:
1. Slice bacon in half for how many you want
2. You can either slice the jalapenos in half or use whole
3. I sliced mine in half
4. Stick a lil smokey in the the middle and wrap with bacon and use a tooth pick to secure
5. When you place on baking pan , sprinkle brown sugar over the top and bake
6. I baked at 350 for about 20 or until bacon is crisp
7. I had to put numbers on the bottom , but it's just how many you want to eat
8. Enjoy

title: thai style corn fritters
steps:
1. For the dressing
2. 1 / 4 cup fish sauce
3. 1 / 4 cup lime juice
4. 1 tablespoon peanut oil
5. Place corn kernels , creamed corn , eggs , water chestnuts and basil in a large bowl , mix well
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Whisk in flour until well blended
8. Heat oil in a medium frying pan
9. Cook fritters in batches , adding 1 / 4 of a cup of batter to hot oil at a time
10. Fry until golden brown on both sides
11. Make sure fritters are heated through
12. Remove fritters from oil , drain on absorbent paper
13. To make dressing , combine all ingredients in a jug , mix well
14. Combine asian greens , basil leaves , bean shoots and capsicum in a bowl
15. Add dressing , toss well
16. Serve fritters topped with salad

title: pineapple ice cream
steps:
1. Combine sour cream and sweetened condensed milk
2. Add milk and pineapple
3. Pour into ice cream freezer canister
4. Freeze according to manufacturer's instruction

title: pizza hotdish or pizza casserole
steps:
1. Prepare egg noodles as directed on package , drain
2. Add cheddar cheese soup to egg noodles and mix
3. Meanwhile , brown hamburger with onion and garlic , drain grease
4. Add spaghetti sauce , water , garlic salt , tomato sauce , salt and pepper and oregano
5. Simmer about 5 minutes
6. While heat is still on , add in half the package of pepperoni one at a time to make sure the pepperoni doesn't stick to each other
7. Pepperoni will become limp , this will let you know its ready
8. Grease a 9x13 pan
9. Add meat mixture to noodle mixture and stir in 1 / 2 of the mozzarella and cheddar cheese
10. Place meat and noodles in greased pan
11. Cover top of casserole with remaining pepperoni like you top a pizza
12. And then sprinkle the rest of the remaining cheese on top
13. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes until bubbly and cheese melts and is starting to brown slightly

title: cheesecake   lemon
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine crumbs , butter and 1 tbsp sugar in a bowl
3. Stir well to coat all crumbs
4. Press the crumbs onto the bottom of an 8" springform pan
5. Bake crust for 5 minutes and set aside
