6. In large deep mixing bowl combine cream cheese , 1 cup sugar and the vanilla
7. Beat until smooth
8. Add key lime juice and beaten eggs and continue to beat until smooth and creamy
9. Pour filling onto baked crust
10. Bake for 60 to 70 minutes
11. If top turns light brown , it's done
12. Remove from the oven and cut cake loose where it is attached to sides of pan and cool until it reaches room temperature
13. Place in the fridgerator to chill
14. When chilled , remove the springform pan sides and cut
15. Serve with sweetened whipped cream and the lime strips is used

title: souffle au fromage  cheese souffle
steps:
1. Melt butter in a saucepan and add flour , salt , and cayenne
2. Gradually add milk , and cook until thick and smooth
3. Add swiss cheese , and blend
4. Separate the eggs
5. Beat the yolks and add to the cheese mixture
6. Beat the egg whites until stiff
7. Butter a 2 quart mold , and sprinkle all around in it the reserved swiss cheese
8. Add the parmesan to your cheese mixture
9. Fold cheese mixture into stiff egg whites
10. Pour into mold and bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 300 degrees fahrenheit

title: tandoori flounder
steps:
1. Combine the first 8 ingredients in a shallow dish
2. Add flounder and coat with marinade , refrigerate for several hours
3. Place broiler rack 4 inches from heat and heat broiler to high
4. Spray a broiler pan with cooking spray , place fillets in a single layer on pan , cook 3-4 minutes per side
5. Serve with rice , and vegetables

title: lots of berries pie
steps:
1. In a saucepan , combine sugar , salt , cornstarch , and cinnamon
2. Stir in berries
3. Add water and lemon juice
4. Cook over medium heat just to the boiling point
5. Pour into pie shell
6. Dot with butter
7. Top with lattice or full crust
8. If using a full crust , cut slits in the top , brush with milk and sprinkle with sugar
9. Bake in oven preheated to 350f for about 45 minutes or until the crust is golden

title: fire roasted tomato soup
steps:
1. Over medium heat , saut the onion and celery in a medium non-stick saucepan sprayed with no stick cooking spray
2. When the onion is translucent , add the tomatoes , broth , oregano , rosemary
3. Simmer on very low heat for 10 minutes
4. Transfer soup to the blender , add the roasted garlic , and puree until fairly smooth
5. Add the parsley and salt and pepper to taste , and simmer for about 10 minutes to allow the flavors to blend
6. Taste the soup , and if it is too acidic , add a little sugar to taste
7. Serve with some chopped fresh basil

title: phad thai  very simple version
steps:
1. Place noodles in large heatproof bowl
2. Cover with boiling water
3. Stand until just tender
4. Drain
5. Heat wok or large non-stick frying pan
6. Stir-fry chicken , garlic , ginger and chilli , in batches , until chicken is browned
7. Return chicken mixture to wok with sugar , sauces and juice
8. Stir-fry until sauce thickens slightly
9. Add noodles , onion and sprouts to wok
10. Stir-fry until hot
11. Serve phad thai sprinkled with coriander

title: savory ham and mushroom quiche
steps:
1. Saute ham , shallots and mushrooms in oil until mushrooms are wilted and shallots are clear
2. Beat eggs , add cream , salt and pepper
3. Option 1: quiche in tart shell
4. Brush pre-baked tart shell with 2 t dijon mustard
5. Scatter over ham mixture , then cover with 1 / 2 c shredded cheese
6. Pour over egg mixture , then scatter about 1 / 3 c shrdded cheese over the entire tart
7. Bake at 375 for 25-30 minutes , or until custard sets
8. Let sit before slicing
9. Option 2: mini quiches without pastry shell
10. Grease 10 muffin cups
11. Divide ham mixture evenly among cups
12. Divide half cup cheese evenly among cups
13. Divide custard mixture evenly among cups
14. Bake at 375 for 10-15 minutes or until custard is puffed up and browned on top

title: spider eggs
steps:
1. Cut eggs lengthwise into halves
2. Slip out yolks and mash well with a fork
3. Mix in remaining ingredients
4. Fill whites with yolk mixture , heaping it up lightly
5. To make spiders: cut each olive in half lengthwise
6. Set 1 / 2 olive on each egg
7. Cut the remaining olives in quarters to form the legs
8. Put 4 legs on each side to make spiders

title: thai chicken satay with peanut sauce
steps:
1. To prevent scorching , soak bamboo skewers in cold water for at least 30 minutes
2. Trim off any excess fat and tendons from chicken
3. Slice chicken into strips about 3 / 4 inch wide and thread onto skewers and place in a shallow glass dish
4. Mix the soy sauce , honey , and oil , and pour over the chicken , making sure all of the chicken is coated with the marinade
5. Cover dish with plastic and refrigerate for at least 2 hours
6. Sauce: heat oil in a small pan
7. Add onion flakes and cook over a low heat for 15 to 30 seconds
8. Add remaining ingredients , mix well , and cook until heated through
9. Set aside sauce to await the chicken
10. Drain the chicken
11. Cook chicken over a medium to high heat for about 8 minutes on the grill , turning often and brushing with marinade
12. Serve with the peanut sauce while hot

title: martha s chocolate covered bananas
steps:
1. Melt chocolate in a double broiler , just until melted
2. Line a baking sheet with wax paper
3. Insert a popsicle stick into one end of each banana piece
4. Dip bananas , one at a time , in chocolate , spooning extra chocolate to cover
5. Sprinkle each banana with peanuts
6. Set on prepared baking sheet
7. Refrigerate until chocolate is firm , 20 minutes to 3 days
8. If you have extra chocolate , spread onto wax paper until hardened , chop it up and save to put on top of ice cream

title: berries with banana cream  fat free
steps:
1. Peel the bananas and slice them into rounds
2. Keep the rounds frozen until you are ready to make and eat
3. In a blender or food processor put the yogurt and honey and blend until mixed
4. Then add the banana rounds and process until smooth
5. Put some banana cream in the bottom of each parfait glass
6. Add some sliced strawberries and some blueberries
7. Add more cream and more berries until all your supplies are used up
8. Eat right away !

title: caterers casserole
steps:
1. Brown and drain beef
2. Cook rice according to package directions
3. Drain corn
4. Mix all 5 ingredients together reserving some cheese for topping
5. Spread in 8" x 8" glass baking dish
6. Place in oven preheated at 300 deegrees and bake until heated through or cheese is bubbly

title: swordfish steak  a la henry
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl except the fish
2. Place fish in the mixture and marinate 2-3 hours
3. Grill 5 minutes per side until done

title: chicken phyllo packets
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except for the last four
2. Mix well , cover and let set for at least 15 minutes
3. In a small sauce pan heat the butter and 2 tablespoons of tabasco
4. Layer phyllo and butter using 4 sheets of dough and leaving the top of the last sheet dry
5. Cut crosswise into 2 inch strips
6. Place 1 teaspoons of the chicken mixture at one end of the strip and fold one corner diagonally over the filling and continue folding to make a triangle
7. Continue with the rest of the dough and chicken mixture
8. Brush the packets with the remaining butter and sprinkle with the sesame seeds
9. Bake in a 425 degree farenheit oven for 10-15 minutes or until golden brown

title: cornmeal molasses pancakes
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the egg , buttermilk , molasses and melted butter
2. Add the flour , salt , baking soda and baking powder
3. Add the cornmeal last , stirring just until combined
4. The batter will be slightly lumpy
5. Drop by tablespoons ful on a hot greased griddle until bubbles form around the outer edges
6. Turn and brown on the other side --
7. Serve with butter and sorghum molasses or maple syrup

title: creamy parmesan flans
steps:
1. Bring the milk and cream to a bubble
2. Add bay leaves and garlic , turn off heat , place lid on saucepan , and leave to infuse
3. Whisk together the eggs and egg yolks
4. Pour milk mixture over eggs very slowly while whisking
5. Strain through a sieve
6. Add grated parmesan and salt and pepper
7. Pour into 4 individual ramekin dishes and place in a bain-marie
8. Bake at 375f for 30-40 minutes until set at the edges but still slightly "jiggly" at the centres
9. Upend onto serving plates and serve with a side garnish of olive oil-dressed rocket leaves

title: spanish garbanzo beans and tomatoes
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil
2. Chop the onion
3. Chop the anchovy fillets
4. Mince the garlic
5. Halve the grape tomatoes
6. Saute the onion in the olive oil until soft and starting to take on color
7. Add the garlic , anchovy fillets and tomato halves and stir until tomatoes start to soften
8. Add the garbanzo beans and rest of the ingredients
9. Cover and cook on low until tomatoes are soft , the liquid has thickened slightly , and the flavors have melded: about 10-15 minutes
10. Taste for seasoning: add salt if needed
11. Add sliced sausages before covering , or add whole grilled sausages at the end

title: mediterranean slow cooker chicken
steps:
1. Season chicken with salt and pepper
2. Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat
3. Brown chichen on both sides
4. Remove from heat and set aside
5. Place onion , zucchini , and mushrooms in the bottom of the slow cooker
6. Place chicken on top of the vegetables
7. Spread chickpeas over the chicken
8. Combine tomatoes , olives , sundried tomatoes , garlic , lemon juice and oregano in a small bowl
9. Pour over the chicken
10. Sprinkle capers over the top of the mixture in the slow cooker
11. Cover and cook on high for 4 hours or low for 6-8 until done

title: creamy chicken pot pie     pies   pot pies  easy   yummy
steps:
1. Preheat an oven to 400f
2. In a large saucepan over medium heat , melt the butter
3. Add the flour and cook , stirring constantly , until the mixture smells fragrant and nutty , 1 to 2 minutes
4. Slowly add the broth , whisking until smooth , and bring to a boil
5. Add the thyme , bay leaf , shallot , celery , carrots , mushroom , peas , potatoes , and chicken
6. Sea salt and pepper
7. Simmer , covered until the potatoes are tender , 10-15 minutes
8. Thicken with cornstarch if necessary
9. Remove bay leaf and discard
10. Remove from heat and let cool for 5 minutes
11. Add heavy cream
12. Divide the filling among 4 ovenproof ramekins and place on a baking sheet
13. Brush the puff pastry squares with the egg mixture
14. Brush the rims of the bowls with water
15. Place 1 pastry square on top of each bowl , pressing lightly on the edges
16. Bake until the pastry is puffed and golden brown , about 15-20 minutes
17. Remove from oven
18. Let rest for 5-10 minutes before serving
19. Serves 4

title: cherie s caramel corn
steps:
1. Place popcorn , pretzels , and nuts into a large bowl , set aside
2. In a heavy saucepan combine sugars , butter , corn syrup , and salt
3. Cook over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until mixture comes to a rolling boil
4. Cook and stir until candy thermometer reads 238 degrees
5. Remove from heat and stir in baking soda
6. Quickly pour over popcorn mixture and mix thoroughly
7. Turn mixture into two 13x9 baking pans
8. Bake at 200 degrees for 20 minutes , then stir
9. Bake for an additional 25 minutes
10. Remove from over
11. Pour onto wax paper
12. Add m&m's , mix well and let cool
13. Break into clusters
14. Store in airtight containers for plastic bags

title: kid friendly tuna noodle casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a large bowl , combine mushroom soup , milk , tuna , onions , garlic and cheddar cheddar cheese
3. Toss with cooked pasta
4. Transfer to greased 9-inch square casserole pan
5. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese
6. Bake uncovered for 30-45 minutes

title: cocoa rice krispies treats with peanut butter topping
steps:
1. Melt the butter and marshmallows in the microwave on high for about 2 minutes

22. Meanwhile , place roasting pan over a burner set to medium heat

title: grilled maple cider glazed pork and squash
steps:
1. Glaze: in a saucepan , melt butter over medium heat
2. Add onion
3. Saute 2 minutes
4. Stir in syrup , vinegar
5. Boil until reduced to 1 cup
6. Scrape into bowl
7. Whisk in mustard and salt
8. Chill 30 minutes to thicken
9. Pork& squash: in cup , mix sage , salt and pepper
10. Rub over tenderloins
11. Cut squash crosswise into 1 / 2 inch rings
12. Discard seeds , leaving rings in one piece
13. Prepare outdoor grill with hot coals
14. If glaze is too thick , microwave to loosen , 30 seconds
15. Grill pork& squash 5 minutes
16. Turn over
17. Brush with glaze
18. Continue to grill , turning and brushing every 5 minutes , until pork registers 160 and squash is tender , about 20 minutes total

title: cheesy jam sandwich with a twist or two
steps:
1. Prepare the spiced cream cheese by combining all of the ingredients in a bowl and stirring until well blended
2. When youre ready for assembly spread cream cheese on 4 of the bread slices
3. You can add as much as you like , but id recommend about 1 tbs per slice
4. Top with a slice of havarti cheese
5. On top of the cheese put about 1 tbs of strawberry jam and spread it a bit
6. Finish your sandwich by topping it with the second slice of bread pressing down a bit
7. Enjoy !

title: homemade venison italian sausage
steps:
1. Mix together all spices and vinegar
2. Add to the ground meat
3. Stuff in hog casings or freeze in bulk

title: frosting for sugar cookies
steps:
1. Beat together butter , vanilla , 1 tablespoon cream , and a half cup powdered sugar
2. Stir in a few drops food coloring - the color should be somewhat darker than desired , because it will lighten up as you add more cream and sugar to the frosting
3. Add alternating portions of 1-2 tablespoons cream then a half cup powdered sugar
4. Beating after each addition until well blended
5. Continue adding and beating in portions of cream then powdered sugar until you have incorporated all the ingredients
6. Stir in additional cream or powdered sugar if necessary
7. You may vary the amounts of cream and / or powdered sugar to achieve desired frosting amount and consistency - your choice of a nice and thick frosting , a very thin glaze , or anything in between is possible
8. Spread finished frosting onto cooled sugar cookies
9. Candy sprinkles are best added as each cookie is frosted - they seem to adhere better that way

title: coconut mango rice
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , melt butter over medium heat
2. Add sweet onion , ginger and garlic , if using
3. Cook until softened , about 5 minutes
4. Add rice and stir until grains are coated with butter
5. Shake can of coconut milk
6. Add to rice along with water , salt and curry , if using
7. Cover and bring mixture to a boil
8. Stir and reduce heat to low
9. Simmer , covered , for 20 minutes
10. Meanwhile , peel mango and slice into thin bite-size strips or chop , then place in a bowl
11. Seed and chop pepper , slice green onions in half , lengthwise , then into 1-inch pieces
12. Add to mango and stir in lime juice
13. After rice has cooked 20 minutes , stir in mango mixture
14. Cover , remove from heat and let stand for 5 minutes to warm mango
15. Serve scattered with coriander , if you wish
16. A nice way to present this dish is to lightly pack rice mixture into a small rounded bowl or cup , then turn out onto a plate and top with coriander
17. Enjoy !
18. )

title: chocolate and graham cracker pie  4 ww pts
steps:
1. Prepare pie crust by combining graham cracker crumbs , sugar and butter with a fork until almost like a crumbly dough
2. Press firmly in bottom and sides of a 9 inch pie pan
3. Bake at 350f for 8-10 minutes
4. Cool
5. When pie crust is completely cooled , prepare pudding mix by mixing pudding mix and milk with whisk until it thickens
6. Stir in half of cool whip
7. Spread in pie plate
8. Cover with remaining cool whip
9. Refrigerate for about an hour or until thickens enough to slice

title: grilled halibut with spinach and spicy thai chiles
steps:
1. Mix first 7 ingredients in a medium glass bowl
2. Season sauce to taste with salt and pepper
3. Prepare barbecue
4. Place carrot in a medium bowl
5. Cover with ice water
6. Let stand 15 minutes , then drain well
7. Brush fish on all sides with 2 tbsp oil
8. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
9. Grill until just opaque in center , about 4 minutes per side
10. Meanwhile , heat 1 tablespoons oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat
11. Add shallot
12. Stir 1 minute
13. Add spinach
14. Sprinkle with salt
15. Toss until spinach is wilted but still bright green , about 2 minutes
16. Divide among 4 plates
17. Place fish atop spinach
18. Sprinkle each filet with carrot
19. Drizzle each with 2 tbsp sauce
20. Serve with remaining sauce

title: honey chive codfish
steps:
1. Spray a large skillet with nonstick spray , add butter and melt over medium-high heat
2. Season cod with a little salt and add to the pan and cook 4-5 minutes , or until golden brown
3. Carefully flip fish over using a wide spatula
4. Add water to the pan along the sides
5. Lower heat to medium or medium-low , cover , and cook another 4-6 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork
6. Meanwhile , in a small pan , combine chicken broth & cornstarch with a whisk until smooth
7. Set the heat to medium-high
8. Add lemon juice , honey , and pepper , whisking and cooking until thickened and clear , whisking the whole time
9. Add chives to the sauce and stir quickly
10. Serve fish with honey chives sauce ladled over each portion

title: orange infused mascarpone french toast
steps:
1. Make the mascarpone: in a small bowl , mix the mascarpone , marmalade , grated orange zest , honey and salt
2. Refrigerate until needed
3. Make the french toast batter: in a bowl , mix together the orange juice , milk , eggs , sugar , nutmeg , cinnamon and vanilla
4. Pour into a baking dish or pie plate
5. Melt a little butter in a large saute pan over medium-low heat
6. Dip the challah slices quickly into batter on both sides and place 6 slices into the pan
7. Let the infused mascarpone come to room temperature so it's easier to spread
8. Use a tablespoon or knife to spread some of the cream on each piece of bread in the pan , keeping a 1 / 2-inch border all around the bread free from the mascarpone
9. Cover each mascarpone-slathered piece of challah with another slice of bread that has been dipped in the batter
10. Cook the french toast"sandwiches" until golden brown on one side , carefully flip them over and cook until the second side is golden brown , adding more butter as needed
11. To serve , place a french toast sandwich on each plate
12. Enjoy !

title: baked tilapia
steps:
1. Saute the celery , onions and bell pepper in butter until the vegetables soften
2. Add flour , salt , pepper , tarragon , basil , and milk , stirring until blended
3. Cook sauce until it thickens , stirring constantly
4. Lower the heat and add cheese , stirring until the cheese just melts
5. Do not boil the cheese or it will get stringy
6. Rinse the tilapia fillets in cold salted water , then drain and pat dry
7. Arrange the fish in a single layer in an oblong baking dish
8. Spoon the sauce over all
9. Bake at 425f for 8 to 10 minutes or until the fish flakes easily when tested with a fork

title: box of chocolate refill
steps:
1. Mix room temperature frosting and melted chocolate
2. Refrigerate until stiff
3. For store bought frostings this may be as little as half an hour for home-made ones it could take as long as 3 hours or more
4. Scoop "truffle" mix out with a small melon baller or a teaspoon
5. Roll into a ball or shape as you wish
6. Roll balls in sprinkles , nuts or other toppings or dip in dipping chocolate
7. Place truffle in small paper candy cups and insert it into an empty chocolate candy box

title: mrs c s deliciously yummy   scrumptious carrot cake
steps:
1. Sift flour , baking powder , baking soda , cinnamon and salt together
2. Set aside
3. Beat eggs well together in a separate large bowl
4. Add sugar and oil , continuing to beat thoroughly
5. Add carrots , nuts and pineapple , mixing well after each addition
6. Incorporate flour mixture gradually and carefully
7. Divide batter between 2 very well buttered 9 inch round cake tins
8. Bake at 180c / 350f for 40 - 45 minutes until the sides of the cakes have started to shrink from the sides of the tin and a skewer inserted into the center comes out clean
9. Allow to settle for 15 minutes before turning out onto a wire rack to cool
10. Beat butter and cream cheese together for the frosting adding the vanilla essence and as much icing sugar to taste
11. This can be done in a food processor
12. Assemble cakes with a layer of frosting between , on top and around the sides

title: chicken caesar salad with asparagus
steps:
1. Toss lettuce , chicken breast , tomatoes , and asparagus in a large salad bowl
2. Add dressing and toss
3. Top with croutons and parmesan cheese
4. Serve immediately

title: sugar snap peas   mushrooms
steps:
1. In skillet or wok , heat sesame oil , teriyaki sauce , soy sauce and sesame ginger dressing
2. Add the peas and mushrooms and stir-fry until crisp-tender
3. Serve immediately

title: multi color frosting technique
steps:
1. Divide frosting into four separate bowls
2. Tint one bowl pink using several drops of red food coloring
3. Repeat with green , blue and yellow food coloring and remaining frosting bowls
4. Drop spoonfuls of frosting randomly over top of cake
5. Starting at edges , carefully spread frosting to cover cake , being careful not to overlap colors or smear too much
6. Cover with sprinkles

title: aromatic chicken rendang
steps:
1. Pulse the shallots , ginger , galangal root , chillies and sliced lemongrass , adding enough of coconut cream to make a thick paste
2. Heat oil in a thick-bottomed non-stick saucepan till medium hot
3. Stirfry the shallot paste for 2 minutes
4. Add turmeric and smashed lemongrass stalks
5. Cook for 2 minutes
6. Add meat pieces
7. Stir-fry for 5 minutes
8. Add rest of coconut cream
9. Cook on medium-low heat till meat is done and quite tender , and curry sauce is very thick
10. Scrape bottom of pan every 2 minutes with spatula to ensure curry does not burn
11. If curry is getting dry before meat is tender , add a bit of water
12. Cooking time varies with size and cuts of meat
13. When curry is thick and almost dry , add fried dessicated coconut , brown sugar , salt and kaffir lime leaves
14. Cook for another 5 minutes
15. Serve hot with plain boiled rice , preferably jasmine or basmati variety
16. Yummm !

title: wild yeast sourdough starter
steps:
1. I bought whole wheat berries at the health food store and ground my own flour in a coffee grinder from them because i wanted the yeast on the flour to be really fresh , but this probably isn't really necessary
2. The pre-ground flour at the health food store is probably quite fresh , also , and you can buy very small quantities in bulk
3. Day one: mix 2 tablespoons whole grain flour and 2 tablespoons pineapple juice
4. Stir well , cover and let sit for 24 hours at room temperature
5. Day two: add 2 tablespoons whole grain flour and 2 tablespoons pineapple juice
6. Stir well , cover and let sit another 24 hours at room temperature
7. You may , or may not start to see small bubbles at this point
8. Day three: add 2 tablespoons whole grain flour and 2 tablespoons pineapple juice
9. Stir well and let sit 24 hours at room temperature
10. Day four: stir mixture and measure out 1 / 4 cup--discard the rest
11. To the 1 / 4 cup , stir in 1 / 4 cup unbleached ap flour and 1 / 4 cup water
12. Let sit 24 hours at room temperature
13. Repeat day four until mixture expands to double its size and smells yeasty
14. Mixture may start to bubble after a couple of days and then go flat and look totally dead for a couple more days
15. If this happens , at about day 6 add the 1 / 4 teaspoons vinegar with your daily feeding
16. This will lower the ph and wake up the yeast , which will then start to grow
17. Once the yeast starts growing , starter should be fed equal parts of flour and water in a quantity sufficient to make enough starter for your recipe
18. Store the starter in the refrigerator when you are not using it
19. It needs to be fed equal parts flour and water once a week to keep it alive
20. Either use or discard at least half of it when feeding--this is very important to maintian a healthy starter ! if you forget to feed it for a few weeks , it probably will be fine but may take several feedings to get it back up to par

title: apple ginger mint iced tea
steps:
1. Combine tea bags , ginger , apple and mint in a tea pot
2. Fill with boiling hot water and steep for 5 minutes
3. Pour and strain into ice-filled pitcher
4. Add apple cider and honey as desired
5. Fill individual glasses with ice and serve

title: shrimp calzones
steps:
1. Roll pizza crust into 18 x 10 inch rectangle
2. Cut into 6 retangles
3. Combine tomato paste , water , and italian seasoning
4. Spread evenly over retangles , leaving a 1 / 2 inch border
5. Arrange shrimp evenly over half of eaach rectangle
6. Brush edges of rectangles with water
7. Fold rectangles in half crosswise over shrimp , press edges together with a fork
8. Place calzones on a large baking sheet coated with cooking spray
9. Coat tops with cooking spray , and sprinkle evenly with parmesan cheese
10. Bake at 400 degrees for 18 minutes or until lightly browned

title: country style soup  minestra di campagna
steps:
1. Place fava beans in medium saucepan
2. Place great northern beans in large bowl
3. Add enough cold water to each to cover by 3 inches and let soak overnight
4. Bring fava beans to boil in their soaking liquid
5. Boil 5 minutes
6. Drain fava beans and cool slightly
7. Using small sharp knife , make small slit in skin of each bean
8. Peel off outer skins and discard
9. Drain great northern beans
10. Bring 6 cups water to boil in large pot
11. Add all beans , onion , carrot and celery
12. Partially cover
13. Simmer over medium heat until beans are half cooked , about 30 minutes
14. Add cabbage and lettuce
15. Partially cover
16. Cook until beans are tender , stirring occasionally , about 1 hour
17. Season with salt and pepper
18. Ladle into bowls
19. Sprinkle with parmesan
20. Drizzle with oil

title: homemade miracle whip
steps:
1. In a blender combine vegetable oil , lemon juice , salt , dry or prepared mustard , and the egg / water mixture
2. Blend well
3. In a medium sauce pan cook together flour , sugar , water / egg / oil mixture and vinegar until stiff , stirring constantly
4. While hot , add to blender
5. Pulse a few times and then blend until smooth
6. Make sure you release the lid a few times during this pulsing to release any built up heat

title: salmon corn cakes with cilantro pepper vinaigrette
steps:
1. Make cilantro-pepper vinaigrette: combine first 6 ingredients in small bowl
2. Let stand at room temperature until ready to serve
3. Heat 1 t
4. Vegetable oil in medium skillet over medium heat
5. Add onion , bell pepper , corn , and garlic and cook , stirring occasionally , about 5 minutes
6. Let cool slightly
7. Combine salmon , bread crumbs , cilantro , lime juice , egg , salt , cayenne , and vegetables
8. Shape into 8 cakes , about 2-1 / 2 inches wide , then coat with cornmeal , shaking off excess
9. Heat 1 t
10. Each oil and buter in heavy medium skillet over medium heat
11. Place 4 cakes in skillet and cook , turning once , until golden brown , 6-8 minutes
12. Keep warm in oven
13. Repet with remaining cakes
14. Serve hot with vinaigrette

title: chocolate roll
steps:
1. Melt chocolate and butter over low heat
2. Add egg and beat well
3. In separate bowl , mix the sugar , nuts , and marshmallows
4. Add chocolate mixture to nut mixture and mix well
5. Sprinkle sheet of waxed paper with coconut
6. Put chocolate mixture onto waxed paper and shape into roll
7. Twist ends of waxed paper to seal
8. Wrap in additional sheet of waxed paper if desired
9. Place in freezer and keep there until ready to slice

title: jgerschnitzel  pork or veal cutlets in  mushroom gravy
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat
2. Pound cutlets with a meat tenderizer to flatten them
3. Season cutlets with salt and pepper , dredge them in beaten eggs and then coat evenly with the bread crumbs that have been combined with the flour
4. Place cutlets into skillet and fry until golden brown
5. Do not turn more than once as you will end up losing the coating if you turn too often
6. Remove the meat from the skillet and drain on paper towels
7. Keep the meat warm in the oven while you make the gravy
8. Saut bacon and onions until golden brown
9. Add tomato paste and mushrooms , and saut over a low heat until mushrooms are cooked
10. Add wine , water and seasonings
11. Let simmer for about 5 minutes
12. Stir in the sour cream
13. Pour gravy over schnitzel just before serving

title: bread and butter pudding with dates
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 170c , 325f , gas mark 3
2. Grease a 7
3. 5cm / 3 inch deep ovenproof dish
4. Remove the crusts from the buttered bread and cut into quarters
5. Place half in the bottom of the prepared dish sprinkle with the chopped dates then arrange the remaining bread triangles , buttered side up , over the dates
6. In a saucepan , heat the milk to hot but not boiling
7. In a large bowl , mix together the eggs , vanilla and sugar then add the hot milk , stirring well
8. Slowly strain over the bread and fruit , being careful not to dislodge the top layer of bread
9. Leave to stand for 10 minutes
10. Sprinkle with a little extra sugar and grated nutmeg then bake in the oven for 30-40 minutes until the top is browned and crispy

title: wild rice with dried apricots   w w
steps:
1. Saute carrots in butter until lightly browned
2. Add thyme , wild rice , apricots , broth and salt
3. Bring to a low simmer , cover and cook for 25 minutes
4. Stir in long-grain rice and simmer for an additional 20 minutes
5. Sprinkle with chives and serve

title: matchstick potatoes   barefoot contessa   ina garten
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Pour at least 1 inch of oil into a deep pot and heat it to 350 degrees
3. Slice the potatoes into thin matchsticks with a vegetable slicer or mandolin , dropping them into a bowl of cold water as you cut
4. Drain the potatoes and dry them thoroughly with paper towels
5. Drop the potatoes in batches into the hot oil and cook for 3 to 5 minutes , until golden brown
6. Remove from the pot with a wire basket skimmer or slotted spoon and drain on paper towels
7. Place on a baking sheet , sprinkle with salt , and keep warm in the oven while you cook the rest of the potatoes
8. Sprinkle the potatoes with parsley , if desired , and serve hot

title: eggs in a nest
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Grease muffin pan with cooking spray
3. Mix simply potatoes shredded hash browns , green onion , pepper , salt and oil
4. Divide potatoes between 12 muffin cups , pressing against sides and bottom
5. Bake 25 minutes
6. While contents are in oven fry bacon and red bell peppers for about 7 minutes over medium heat
7. Add bacon and pepper mixture with beaten eggs and milk
8. Season with salt and pepper to taste
9. Pour egg / bacon / bell pepper mixture over cooked hash brown / green onion cups
10. Sprinkle cheese on top
11. Cook for 15 minutes and cheese is melted
12. Enjoy !

title: chiles con queso  chilies in cheese sauce
steps:
1. Place the chilies in a dry frying pan over a medium heat until all the skin blisters and darkens
2. Be careful not to allow the chili flesh to burn
3. Place the chilies in a polythene bag for 20 minutes , and then remove the skins and seeds
4. Cut the chilies into thin strips and then cut the strips in half to make short strips
5. Heat the oil in a frying pan and cook the onion until it is beginning to soften
6. Add the cheese , creme fraiche and cream and continue heating over a low heat until the cheese melts
7. Add the chilies and stir continuously until the sauce becomes smooth
8. Dice the tomatoes into 1 / 2in pieces
9. Stir into the sauce , and then pour into a serving dish
10. Just before serving , stir in the tequila and mix well
11. Serve warm with tortilla chips

title: velvet mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. To roast garlic , slice bottom & place in aluminum foil with a little olive oil
3. Clean & prick potatoes & put in oven with garlic
4. Cook 35 minutes
5. Remove garlic
6. Continue to cook potatoes 20 minutes or until tender
7. Hold hot potatoes with towel & split & scrape flesh into sauce pan
8. Squeeze roasted garlic from the bottom to push cloves out & into potatoes
9. Add 2 tablespoons of butter , sour cream & cream cheese
10. Mash
11. Season with salt & black pepper
12. In large frying pan add 3 tablespoons butter
13. Add mushrooms & cook until browned
14. Add shallot , thyme & dried tomatoes
15. Add mushroom gravy to pan & heat
16. Gradually stir hot milk into potatoes until fluffy
17. Transfer to bowl & pour gravy mixture on top

title: beef and bean chili
steps:
1. Use cooking spray on a large heavy-bottomed saucepan and saute beef with 1 teaspoon chili powder over medium-high heat until no longer pink
2. Remove with slotted spoon
3. Add green pepper , celery , onion , and garlic to skillet and cook until tender
4. Return beef to skillet
5. Add tomatoes with juice , salsa , and beans
6. Bring to boil , then reduce heat
7. While simmering , add worcestershire and stir in remaining chili powder , cumin , and basil
8. Simmer for 20 minutes or until sauce thickens

title: coconut milk substitute
steps: 1. Mix ingredients well

title: cabbage  kielbasa and pierogies
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil
2. Add pierogies and boil for 5-7 minutes
3. Pierogies should float to the surface when they are done , but that's not always true with today's frozen products - some float right away or within a minute or two
4. Ignore that event and boil for at least 4-5 minutes to fully cook the filling
5. Remove pierogies with a slotted spoon and drain well
6. While the water is heating for the pierogies , melt butter in a large skillet over medium high heat
7. Add onion and saute until it softens , 3 - 5 minutes
8. Add cabbage and saute mixture 5 more minutes
9. Season generously with salt and pepper
10. Stir in sliced kielbasa and continue to cook until cabbage is done and kielbasa flavors have melded with the mixture
11. Reduce temperature to warm
12. Place cooked pierogies atop cabbage and season with pepper
13. Spoon some of the cabbage mixture over the pierogies to help them reheat
14. The dish is ready when the pierogies are heated through
15. Serve warm

title: beef and macaroni bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Cut up leftover roast beef in 2-inch cubes
3. Place cubes in small roast pan
4. Add beef broth , tomatoes , celery , onions , pepper and salt
5. Cover and bake 1 hour
6. Add macaroni and bake another 20 minutes
7. If you do not have a tasty lefover gravy , add worcestershire sauce , garlic etc to give the sauce a boost

title: sweet sour cucumber salad
steps:
1. Wash , peel and slice the cucumber finely
2. Skin and slice the onion finely as well
3. Deseed the chille and make fine slices
4. Take a shallow bowl , place the cucumber slices , then place the sliced onions and sprinkle the sliced chillies on top
5. Mix all the dressing ingredients together
6. Pour this over the onions and cucumbers
7. Refrigerate the salad for a few hours
8. Serve chilled

title: honey lemon boneless pork chops
steps:
1. Trim fat from chops and score
2. Heat oil in fry pan
3. Brown chops on both sides
4. Drain fat
5. Combine chili sauce , honey , lemon rind and juice , salt and pepper
6. Stir into pan
7. Cover and simmer over low heat about 30 minutes
8. Remove chops from pan and keep warm
9. Whisk together sour cream and flour
10. Stir into pan juices
11. Cook until smooth and thick
12. Spoon over chops

title: sweet spicy sticky wings
steps:
1. Preheat broiler and place oven rack 10 to 12 inches away from broiler element
2. Arrange a rack set over a rimmed baking sheet
3. Toss wings with oil and then season with salt and pepper
4. Arrange wings on prepared rack
5. Broil , turning occasionally , until wings are golden , crisp and cooked through , about 45 minutes
6. Meanwhile , in a blender , combine the vinegar , brown sugar , soy sauce , sweet chile sauce , sriracha , ginger and half of the green onions
7. Blend until very smooth
8. Transfer sauce to a large saucepan and boil , over high heat until thick and glossy , about 5 minutes
9. Add chicken wings and gently toss to glaze , about 3 minutes
10. Transfer wings to a serving platter and garnish with remaining green onions and sesame seeds

title: copycat californian rollwich
steps:
1. Spread the mayonnaise on the tortilla , making sure to leave at least 1 / 2 inch around the outside
2. Scoop the flesh from the avocado and mash , mixing with a dash of lemon juice to preserve color
3. You should end up with about 1 1 / 2-2 tablespoons mashed avocado
4. If your avocado is larger just save the rest for another sandwich !
5. Spread avocado over mayonnaise
6. Add the turkey and a thin layer of lettuce or sprouts
7. Place the 3 tomato slices in a line down the center of the tortilla , if using
8. Make sure you don't fill the tortilla too full or get too close to the edge , or it won't wrap properly !
9. Carefully roll the tortilla into a wrap
10. Cut into two pieces , if desired
11. Enjoy a taste of sunny california

title: zucchini lasagna with walnuts
steps:
1. Trim ends off zucchini
2. Thinly slice zucchini lengthwise
3. You should have 9 slices total , about 1 / 8 inch thick
4. Place in a single layer on a lightly greased baking sheet
5. Brush lightly with 1 teaspoon of the olive oil
6. Broil 3 to 4 inches from heat about 5 minutes until crisp tender , turning once
7. Cool
8. Grease a 2 quart square baking dish
9. In a large saucepan heat the remaining 3 teaspoons olive oil over medium high heat
10. Add the carrots , onion and garlic
11. Cook and stir about 5 minutes or until tender
12. Add marinara sauce , basil , and pepper
13. Bring to boiling
14. Reduce heat
15. Simmer , covered , for 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
16. In a small mixing bowl toss together the mozzarella cheese and parmesan
17. Set aside
18. In the prepared baking dish arrange 2 noodles
19. Spread with a third of the sauce
20. Sprinkle with a third of the nuts
21. Top with a third of the zucchini , then sprinkle with a third of the cheese mixture
22. Repeat layering , alternating the direction of the zucchini in each layer and finishing with the zucchini
23. Set remaining cheese aside
24. Bake covered , in a 375 degree oven for 20 minutes
25. Uncover and sprinkle with the remaining cheese
26. Bake , uncovered , about 20 minutes more or until heated through
27. Let stand 15 minutes before serving
28. Make ahead
29. Wrap and freeze for up to 1 month
30. Freeze cheese for topping separately
31. To serve , thaw in refrigerator overnight
32. Bake , covered , in a 350 degree oven for 1 hour
33. Sprinkle with reserved cheese
34. Bake , uncovered , about 15 minutes more , or until heated through
35. Let stand 15 minutes before serving

title: tuna noodle florentine
steps:
1. Combine noodles , spinach and remaining ingredients , reserving about 1 / 2 cup of the cheese to sprinkle on top
2. Cook in covered casserole in 350 oven until cheese is bubbly

title: herb cheese pizza
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425
2. Grease 12-inch pizza pan
3. Sprinkle with cornmeal
4. Unroll dough and press in pan
5. In small bowl , combine oil and garlic
6. Drizzle over dough
7. In small bowl , combine cheese , oregano and basil
8. Sprinkle over oil
9. Bake at 425 for 13 to 16 minutes or until crust is deep golden brown
10. Serve immediately

title: caramel apple upside down cakes
steps:
1. Combine 1 1 / 2 cups sugar and 1 / 4 cup water in heavy small saucepan
2. Stir over medium heat until sugar dissolves
3. Increase heat and boil without stirring until color is deep amber , occasionally swirling pan and brushing down sides with pastry brush dipped into water , about 8 minutes
4. Working quickly , divide hot caramel among six 1 1 / 4-cup custard cups
5. Using pot holders to protect hands , tilt and rotate custard cups to cover bottoms with caramel
6. Set aside
7. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in large nonstick skillet over medium heat
8. Add apple wedges and saut until just tender , about 12 minutes
9. Arrange apple wedges in bottoms of caramel-lined custard cups
10. Preheat oven to 325f sift cake flour , baking powder , and salt into medium bowl
11. Using electric mixer , beat remaining 1 / 2 cup butter and remaining 3 / 4 cup sugar in another medium bowl until well blended
12. Add eggs 1 at a time and beat until well blended after each addition
13. Mix in vanilla extract
14. Beat in flour mixture in 3 additions alternately with whole milk in 2 additions
15. Spoon batter over apples in custard cups , dividing batter equally
16. Bake cakes until light golden around edges and tester inserted into center comes out clean , about 35 minutes
17. Run small knife around cakes to loosen
18. Invert cakes onto plates
19. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream

title: peach crisp to make you swoon
steps:
1. Oven 350f
2. Combine peaches , almond extract , and water
3. Pour peaches into a 8x8-inch or similar sized pan
4. Using a food processor combine flour , sugars , salt , cinnamon , and 1 / 2 cup butter
5. Combine until mixture resembles coarse meal
6. Sprinkle flour mixture over the top of the peaches in the pan , dot with butter pieces and grate fresh nutmeg over the top to taste
7. Bake covered at 350f for 15 minutes , remove cover and continue to bake for 40-45 minutes
8. Let crisp stand for about 15 minutes or so before serving

title: marla s oven fried chicken with cashew crust
steps:
1. Spray a 9x13 baking dish with cooking spray
2. Finely chop cashews and corn flakes in blender or food processor and place in a ziplock bag along with season salt
3. Dip chicken in milk and put in bag with crumbs
4. Make sure that the chicken is well covered with crumb mixture
5. Place chicken in baking dish
6. Melt butter and drizzle over chicken
7. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees f for 30 minutes or until chicken juices run clear

title: balsamic cipolline onions
steps:
1. Cook onions in large pot of boiling water 3 minutes
2. Drain and cool
3. Cut off root ends , then peel
4. Combine peeled onions , beef stock , 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar ,
5. Butter and sugar in heavy large skillet
6. Bring to simmer over medium heat
7. Cover
8. Simmer until onions are crisp-tender , about 15 minutes
9. Add 1 / 2 tablespoon vinegar
10. Simmer uncovered until syrupy , stirring occasionally , about 25 minutes
11. Season with salt and pepper
12. Mix in 1 tablespoon parsley
13. Transfer to bowl
14. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon parsley

title: blueberry crisp cupcakes
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees f
2. Lighty grease 30 regular-size muffin tins or line with paper muffin liners
3. For the cupcake , in a bowl combine flour , baking powder and salt
4. Set aside
5. In another bowl beat sugar with softened butter and almond extract until fluffy using an electric mixer
6. Add in milk
7. Beat until combined
8. Gradually beat in the flour mixture
9. Beat at medium speed for 2 minutes
10. Add in egg whites
11. Beat at medium speed for 1 minute
12. Spoon / divide the batter between the prepared muffin tins about half full
13. Spoon the blueberries over the batter
14. Bake for 10 minutes
15. Meanwhile for the streusel , in a bowl combine 1 / 3 cup flour , oats , brown sugar and cinnamon
16. Mix well
17. Using a pastry blender or fingers cut in a 1 / 4 cup softened butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs
18. Stir in chopped nuts
19. After 10 minutes of baking time , remove the cupcakes from the oven
20. Sprinkle the batter over each cupcake
21. Return to over and bake another 18-20 minutes or until golden brown and a toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean
22. Cool in muffin tins for 10 minutes
23. Remove cupcakes to wire racks to cool completely

title: bulls eye bbq sauce  hickory
steps:
1. In a large pot , combine water , corn syrup , tomato paste , brown sugar , molasses , salt , onion powder , garlic powder , black pepper , ground mustard , paprika , and cayenne pepper
2. Whisk until combined and bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook uncovered for 15-20 minutes
4. Add vinegar , stir to mix and return to a simmer
5. Cook uncovered for another 15-20 minutes or until thick
6. Stir frequently to avoid burning
7. Add liquid smoke and whisk to combine thoroughly
8. Ladle hot mixture into hot , sterilized , sealable bottles and seal
9. Allow bottles to cool
10. Store in cupboard
11. Keeps 24 months or more
12. Refridgerate after opening
13. Remember to follow the instructions
14. Timing of added ingredients does make a difference
15. Single batch makes 500ml

title: cajun vegetable gumbo
steps:
1. Place the greens in a large soup pot with enough water to just cover the greens
2. Bring to a boil and cook for 15 minutes
3. Drain , reserving 2 cups of the cooking water
4. On a cutting board , coarsely chop the greens and set aside
5. In a small saucepan over medium-low heat , whisk 1 / 4 cup oil and the flour together and cook , stirring constantly , until the roux is a dark reddish-brown , about 15 minutes
6. Remove the pan from the heat and set aside
7. In the large soup pot , heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil and saut the onions , bell pepper , celery , and tomatoes for about 10 minutes or until the vegetables are wilted
8. Add the hot sauce , bay leaves , file powder , cayenne , thyme , oregano , basil , parsley , garlic , salt , and pepper and cook for 5 minutes
9. Add the roux , vegetable or faux chicken broth , and the reserved greens-cooking water , stirring well to blend in the roux
10. Reduce the heat and simmer , uncovered , for 15 minutes
11. Add the cooked collard greens , okra , kidney beans , and rice and cook for 5 minutes
12. Remove the bay leaves and serve warm

title: french onion macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Heat a skillet over medium high heat and cook onions , thyme , and bay leaf in butter for 5 minutes
2. Season with salt and pepper , lower heat and cook until onions are browned , about 10 to 15 minutes , transfer to a plate , discard bay leaf
3. Meanwhile , bring a large pot of salted water to a boil , add pasta and cook until al dente
4. Drain and return to pot
5. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in the skillet over medium heat
6. Whisk in flour for about a minute , then whisk in chicken stock and milk and bring to a boil
7. Season with salt , pepper , nutmeg , lower heat and cook until thickened , about 5 minutes
8. Stir in cheese to melt
9. Combine onions and cheese sauce with pasta and toss

title: beef picadillo
steps:
1. In a medium skillet , heat the olive oil over medium-high heat until hot but not smoking
2. Add the onion , bell pepper , olives and garlic and cook until the vegetables are tender , about 5 minutes
3. Crumble in the ground beef , using a wooden spoon to break up any large clumps
4. Increase the heat and cook until the liquid is reduced
5. Stir the tomato paste into the meat mixture and simmer over medium-low heat , stirring , for 2 minutes
6. Stir in 2 to 3 tablespoons water to loosen the sauce
7. Stir in the peas and carrots , cover and cook until just cooked through , 4 minutes
8. Stir in the cilantro
9. Season with salt and pepper

title: country apricot mustard glaze
steps:
1. Cook onion and ginger in butter until soft
2. Add remaining ingredients , stirring to blend
3. Heat to boil
4. Spoon over ham or chicken

title: shrimp with smoky chipotle sauce
steps:
1. Slit the shrimp in half lengthwise and mix with the garlic
2. Refrigerate until cooking time
3. Mix together sauce ingredients in a small bowl
4. Set aside
5. Heat oil in a large skillet over high heat
6. Add shrimp and cook until they start turning pink , 1-1 1 / 2 minutes
7. Pour in the sauce and stir until shrimp is glazed and sauce thickens , about 30 seconds
8. Garnish with cilantro and sprinkle with goat cheese
9. Serve hot

title: great american volumetric burger
steps:
1. Stir together the bulgur and 1 / 2 cup boiling water in a small bowl
2. Let stand 30 minutes or until water is absorbed and bulgur is tender
3. Meanwhile , in a nonstick skillet , heat the olive oil over medium heat
4. Add the onion and sugar
5. Saute until the onion is lightly browned , about 10 minutes
6. Stir in the vinegar
7. Saute about 20 seconds , stirring until vinegar evaporates
8. Remove the skillet from the heat
9. In a small bowl , mix the plumped bulgur , onion mixture , beef , carrot , garlic , worcestershire sauce , salt and pepper
10. Shape into 3 / 4-thick patties
11. Grill or broil the burger patties on a rack sprayed with vegetable cooking spray until browned and cooked , about 5 minutes per side
12. Serve on bun with desired condiments

title: chicken breasts with tomato basil cream
steps:
1. In 10-inch skillet melt butter until sizzling
2. Stir in garlic , salt and pepper
3. Add chicken breasts
4. Cook over medium-high heat , turning once , until golden brown
5. Add tomatoes , 1 / 4 cup basil and whipping cream
6. Continue cooking , stirring occasionally , until sauce is heated through
7. Serve with pasta and garnish with basil leaves , if desired
8. Makes 4 servings

title: orange  lemon  lime sangria
steps:
1. Mix corn syrup and orange liqueur in a large pitcher , add fruit slices and stir
2. Let mixture stand 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
3. Add wine and lemon juice , stir , and chill until serving time
4. To serve , add ice and club soda and garnish glasses with fruit

title: short ribs barefoot contessa style
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
2. Spray a sheet pan with pam , place the short ribs on it , sprinkle with salt and pepper and roast for 15 minutes
3. Remove from the oven
4. Reduce the oven temperature to 300 degrees f
5. Meanwhile , heat the olive oil in a large dutch oven and add the onion , celery , carrots and cook over medium-low heat for 20 minutes , stirring occasionally
6. Add the garlic and cook for another 2 minutes
7. Add the 3 tablespoons of tomato paste
8. Pour the wine over the vegetables , bring to a boil , and cook over high heat until the liquid is reduced by half , about 10 minutes
9. Add 1 tablespoon salt and 1 teaspoon pepper
10. Tie the rosemary and thyme together with kitchen twine or put in cheesecloth , add to pot
11. Place the roasted ribs on top of the vegetables in the dutch oven and add the beef stock and brown sugar
12. Bring to a simmer over high heat
13. Cover the dutch oven and bake in oven for 2 hours or until the meat is very tender
14. Carefully remove the short ribs from the pot and set aside
15. Discard the herbs and skim the excess fat
16. Take the veggies out and reduce the beef stock on stove top , about 20 minutes
17. Put the ribs back into the pot and heat through

title: mincemeat hermits
steps:
1. Sift flour , soda , salt , and spices
2. Cream butter and sugar
3. Add egg and beat until light
4. Add dry ingredients , mincemeat , and cream- mix well
5. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets
6. Bake in 400 degree oven , 10-12 minutes
7. Remove to racks to cool

title: toffee  banana rum bread
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease and flour two 8 1 / 2x4 1 / 2x1 / 2 inch baking pans
3. In large bowl , stir together flour , sugar , baking powder and salt
4. Add milk , oil , rum , egg and banana
5. Stir with spoon until well blended
6. Stir in nuts
7. Spread 1 1 / 4 cup batter into bottom of each prepared pan
8. Top each batter with 1 / 2 cup toffee bits
9. Gently spread about 1 cup remaining batter into each pan
10. Sprinkle remaning bits over batter
11. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until wooden pick inserted into center comes out clean
12. Remove from oven to wire rack
13. With knife , loosen bread from sides of pan
14. Cool 10 minutes
15. Remove from pans
16. Cool completely

title: oriental stir fry vegetables with oyster sauce
steps:
1. Prepare the vegetables
2. Heat the vegetable oil and the sesame oil in a wok
3. Add the garlic and stir fry a minute add the remaining vegetables except the bean sprouts and add the oyster sauce too
4. Stir fry for 3-4 minutes add the remaining ingredients including the bean sprouts but excluding the lime juice and stir to mix well for another 2-3 minutes
5. Sprinkle the lime juice and check the seasonings add more if reqd
6. Serve immediately

title: sticky sesame chicken tenders
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Line a large shallow baking pan with foil and spray with cooking spray
3. In a medium bowl , add the garlic , salt , soy sauce , hoisin , honey , oil and a pinch of cayenne
4. Add the chicken tenders to the sauce and turn to coat
5. Arrange the tenders in a single layer on the baking pan , turning over once , until cooked through , about 20 minutes
6. Sprinkle the chicken with the toasted sesame seeds and onions and serve

title: yogurt baked chicken
steps:
1. Mix together the yogurt , mustard , garlic , ginger , and salt and pepper
2. Spread the mixture on the chicken , rubbing it in
3. Place in a baking dish , cover , and let marinate for at least 2 hours
4. Preheat oven to 375 f degrees
5. Bake the chicken , uncovered , for 1 hour or until it is brown

title: pureed beets with yogurt   zaatar
steps:
1. Pre-heat the oven to 400f
2. Wash the beets and place them on a pan that has been lined with aluminum foil
3. Roast them uncovered for about an hour
4. Take the beets out of the oven and let them cool until you can handle them
5. Peel the beets , cut them into quarters and allow to cool completely
6. Put the beets , garlic , chili flakes and yogurt in a food processor and blend until into a smooth paste
7. Transfer the beet mixture to a large bowl and mix in the maple syrup , olive oil , zaatar and 1 teaspoon salt
8. Place the puree on a flat serving plate , using the back of a spoon to spread it evenly around the plate
9. Sprinkle the green onions , almonds and the goat cheese on the puree and drizzle with olive oil
10. Serve at room temperature

title: fresh mushroom fettuccini
steps:
1. Cook and drain fettuccini as directed on package
2. Return to pan
3. Add reamining ingredients and toss until fettuccini is coated with oil

title: pasta dorinda
steps:
1. Then :
2. 3 tbs pressed olive oil heated gently on med
3. Add diced onion , garlic and sausage together
4. Increase heat to med
5. -high -- if you know the cooker
6. Sweat the onions and sautee the sausage at the same time
7. Turning constantly
8. You want the "goody" to caramelize on the bottom and sides of the pan
9. Not "burnt offerings" !
10. When the onions are soft and browned and the sausages are too , add tomatoes and wine to deglaze the pan
11. Add all except two tbs
12. Basil and reserve the 2tbs for garnish
13. Add marinara sauce
14. Reduce heat to low and simmer until 'sheen' forms on the surface
15. Do not simmer so long that the diced tomatoes become blobs !
16. Then add vinegar and sugar
17. Add pepper flakes and coat everything well with the mixture
18. Simmer until pan starts to make it's own juices
19. Then add the salt , pepper and oregano
20. Blend
21. Adjust seasonings
22. Increase heat and let the sauce reduce and thicken a bit
23. Then add the butter and the cooked pasta
24. Coat well , plate , and garnish with remaining basil and serve
25. In the winter months , i add heavy cream or half and half for 'body'
26. Serve with a perfectly chilled white / or room temperature , aerated red wine of your choice
27. Focaccia bread and whipped butter
28. Lemon gelato or vanilla sorbet or hazelnut ice cream -- either one , with petite biscotti
29. Be daring with your choice of pasta ! maybe orechietti or torteloni or maybe even orzo -- it's all up to you !
30. Buon appetito !

title: fish fillets in sesame crust
steps:
1. Wash fillets carefully in water and dry thoroughly with some paper towel
2. Mix the flour , salt and pepper and the sesame seeds together in a bowl
3. Dip the fish into the milk and then into the flour / sesame mix
4. Chill for 10-15 minutes in the fridge before shallow or deep-frying

title: restaurant style white cheese dip
steps:
1. Tear cheese into pieces and place in the crockpot
2. Add other ingredients , stirring well
3. Cook on low for 3 hours , stirring every 30 minutes
4. Serve with tortilla chips

title: dad s frito pie
steps:
1. Put half of the corn chips in a cassserole dish
2. Brown hamburger
3. Mix everything but cheese and corn chips and spread over chips
4. Add remaining chips
5. Top with cheese and bake on 350 for 30 minutes

title: hot   healthy bean soup
steps:
1. Dice onion , garlic and jalepeno
2. Put in large pot and add all remaining ingredients
3. Be sure to thoroughly rinse all beans to reduce the amount of sodium
4. Bring to a boil , then reduce to a med-low heat and simmer uncovered for 45 minutes
5. Enjoy this as-is for a healthy treat , or serve with brown rice for a heartier meal

title: baked mediterranean salmon
steps:
1. Combine first 8 ingredients
2. Spread mixture over salmon
3. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes

title: glazed tofu with bok choy
steps:
1. Drain the tofu on paper towels
2. Heat half the canola oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
3. Add the bok choy and sliced garlic
4. Cook , stirring , until wilted , about 4 minutes
5. Add 1 1 / 2 cups of the broth
6. Simmer until reduced by half
7. Meanwhile , combine the minced garlic , ginger , fish and soy sauces , brown sugar , and sesame oil
8. Heat the remaining canola oil in another skillet over high heat
9. Add the tofu and brown , about 3 minutes per side
10. Add the soy mixture and coat the tofu with it
11. Simmer , uncovered , until the sauce is syrupy , about 4 minutes
12. Stir the cornstarch into the reserved broth
13. Add to the bok choy
14. Stir gently until thickened , about 2 minutes
15. Divide the bok choy onto 4 plates and layer the glazed tofu on top

title: apple walnut crisp
steps:
1. Set oven to 375 degrees
2. Butter a 10-inch deep-dish glass pie plate
3. For the topping
4. In a bowl stir together the flour , oats , brown sugar , cinnamon and pinch salt
5. Add in butter and blend with fingers until mixture resembles coarse meal
6. Add in the toasted walnuts
7. Set aside while preparing the filling
8. In a large bowl toss the apple slices with the lemon juice
9. Add in all remaining ingredients except the vanilla ice cream , toss well to combine and transfer to the prepared pie plate or baking dish
10. Sprinkle the prepared topping evenly over the apple mixture
11. Bake for about 30-40 minutes or until the topping is browned and the apples are fork-tender
12. Let the crisp stand for 15 minutes before serving
13. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream

title: carnivoro pasta sauce
steps:
1. In a large pot , brown the pork neckbones in a little olive oil
2. Set aside
3. Brown hot italian sausage , then add stew meat and brown
4. Set aside
5. Pour off some of the grease , then return all meats to the pot , with the 5 cloves of minced garlic
6. Cook garlic briefly with the meats
7. Add the two 28 ounce cans of crushed tomatoes , the 6 oz
8. Can of tomato paste , beef broth , oregano , basil and pepper
9. Simmer , partly covered for at least two hours- the longer , the better !
10. Stir occasionally to loosen a little meat from the pork neckbones
11. Add salt to taste
12. Correct seasoning
13. Serve with your favorite pasta , with sausage on the side

title: ice cream bar dessert
steps:
1. Arrange ice cream sandwiches in a 9x13 pan , trimming to fit if necessary
2. Cover with cool whip
3. Layer chopped candy bars on top of the cool whip
4. Place in freezer until 20- 30 minutes or so before serving

title: lattice chicken pot pie
steps:
1. In large bowl , combine vegetables , chicken , soup , milk , cheese , onions and seasoned salt
2. Transfer to a greased 13x9x2 baking dish
3. Unroll the crescent roll dough and separate into two rectangles
4. Seal the perforations
5. Cut each rectangle lengthwise into 1 / 2 inch strips
6. Form a lattice crust over the chicken mixture
7. Bake uncovered at 375 for 35-40 minutes or until golden brown

title: dijon vinaigrette salad dressing
steps:
1. Drop garlic into food processor , using the chopping blade
2. Add all remaining ingredients and process until smooth
3. Refrigerate till ready to use

title: hunters polish sausage sauerkraut stew
steps:
1. Soak the mushrooms in 1 / 4 cup water for 2 hours
2. Bring to boil and simmer for 1 / 2 hour
3. Slice
4. Wash the sauerkraut and squeeze it
5. Add mushrooms and the liquid in which they were cooked
6. Add the apples , the tomatoes , peppercorns , and bay leaf
7. Cover and simmer for 1 hour and 15 minutes
8. Add the meat and the bacon , simmer 1 hour longer
9. It is best reheated
10. Served with steamed potatoes or rye bread

title: cheddar cheese sauce with a bechamel base
steps:
1. Make a bechamel sauce as follows: heat clarified butter in medium size saucepan
2. Whisk in bread flour and stir and cook over low heat until light cream color , but at least 1 minute
3. Cool slightly
4. In another saucepan , scald the milk
5. Gradually add milk to the roux beating constantly with whisk
6. Bring sauce to a boil , stirring constantly
7. Reduce heat to a simmer
8. Stick the bay leaf to the onion with the clove
9. Place onion in sauce
10. Simmer at least 15 minutes stirring occasionally
11. Season very lightly with salt , nutmeg and white pepper
12. Strain through a china cap
13. Place plastic wrap on sauce to prevent formation of skin
14. Cool in cold water bath and store in freezer in ziplock bags for later use , or keep warm over warm water bath for use in dishes being currently prepared
15. To 1 qt of this bechamel sauce , add the cheddar cheese , dry mustard and worcestershire sauce
16. Whisk over low heat until the cheese is melted and sauce is smooth

title: oven chuck roast
steps:
1. Preheat oven 275f
2. Sprinkle 1 tbsp seasoning mix on bottom of 9 x 13 glass casserole dish
3. Rub minced garlic into roast
4. Put roast in middle of pan , surround with potatoes , onion , and carrots
5. Pour beer over everything , sprinkle other tbsp of seasoning mix over everything
6. Cover with aluminum foil , put in center rack for 5-6 hours

title: easy vegan white bean au pistou
steps:
1. Place the olive oil in a 4 qt saucepan over medium-high heat
2. Saute the onions , garlic , and squash for approximately 4 minutes
3. Add the beans , broth , tomatoes , spinach , and the olives and mushrooms , if using
4. Boil , then lower heat and simmer while covered for 15 minutes
5. Stir in the pesto and pasta
6. Continue to simmer for about another 5 minutes , until pasta is ready
7. Season with black pepper to taste
8. Salt probably won't be necessary , as canned vegetables tend to have enough sodium added

title: fusilli with toasted garlic breadcrumbs
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions reserving 3 / 4 cup of the cooking water
2. Meanwhile , in a large pan , heat the oil over medium heat
3. Add the garlic and saute just until turning color
4. Add the breadcrumbs , salt and pepper to taste , and toast to light golden
5. Drain the pasta and place in a hot bowl
6. Pour all but 1 cup of the crumbs on the pasta along with the water and toss
7. Divide between 4 hot plates and sprinkle reserved crumbs over each serving
8. Garnish with parsley if desired
9. Serve immediately

title: chocolate coffee
steps:
1. Mix syrup with the coffee
2. Whip the cream and beat into the coffee mixture

title: calzones with pasta sauce
steps:
1. Stir together first 5 ingredients until blended
2. Stir in pepperoni and chopped cheese slices
3. Divide each pizza crust into 2 portions
4. Roll each dough portion into a 7-inch circle
5. Spoon 1 / 2 cup cottage cheese mixture in center of each circle
6. Fold dough over filling , pressing edges to seal
7. Place on a lightly greased aluminum foil-lined baking sheet
8. Prick dough several times with a fork
9. Bake at 375 for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden
10. Let stand 5 minutes
11. Serve calzones with warm pasta sauce
12. Chopped cooked ham may be substituted for pepperoni slices
13. Pasta sauce:
14. Saut onion and garlic in hot oil in a dutch oven over medium heat 10 minutes or until onion is tender
15. Stir in diced tomatoes and remaining ingredients
16. Bring to a boil
17. Reduce heat , and simmer , stirring often , 2 hours
18. Divide into recipe portions
19. And freeze remaining portions

title: best layered salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl add lettuce to fill bowl 3 / 4 full
2. Layer with green onions , green pepper and mushrooms
3. Carefully spread mayonnaise over surface
4. Top with peas , cheese and bacon

title: rice crispy chicken
steps:
1. Place rice crispies in large ziploc bag , crush
2. In another dish , melt the butter in the microwave and then dip chicken in butter
3. Put each piece of chicken in ziploc bag , with rice crispies and shake until coated
4. Place chicken on baking sheet
5. Bake in preheated 350 degree oven for one hour

title: copycat dollywood holiday wassail
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients into a large saucepan
2. Bring to boiling , then reduce the heat , cover , and let simmer 10 minutes
3. Remove cinnamon sticks and serve hot in mugs

title: sauerkraut sausage bake
steps:
1. In casserole dish , mix together sauerkraut and chopped onion
2. Place sliced kielbasa over mixture
3. Prepare mashed potatoes and add 2 tbsp of cheese
4. Spread mashed potatoes over sausage
5. Sprinkle with remaining cheese
6. Bake uncovered at 400 degrees for 35-40 minutes

title: dipping oil for bread
steps:
1. In a jar with a lid , combine oil , vinegar , cheese , basil , salt , pepper and garlic
2. Stir , or cover and shake to blend ingredients
3. Pour into small , shallow bowls or rimmed plates
4. Slice or tear bread into pieces and dip into oil to eat

title: if you can boil water irish coffee
steps:
1. Make a cup of instant coffee using twice the recommend amount of instant coffee
2. Add sugar and instant cocoa
3. Stir until dissolved
4. Add a shot of good irish whiskey
5. Top with cool whip or whipped cream
6. Sprinkle with cinnamon

title: mixed seafood tagine
steps:
1. Mix the ingredients for the charmoula in a bowl then add the seafood & stir
2. Let marinate for 15-20 minutes
3. Mix the rest of the ingredients in a large tagine then heat , covered , over medium-low heat for 20-30 minutes
4. Stir the seafood & charmoula in to the tagine then recover & continue to cook for 15-20 minutes

title: three pea chicken salad
steps:
1. Place the tarragon sprigs , chicken , the halved shallot , and the smashed garlic into a medium saucepan
2. Add water to cover by 1 inch and season with salt and pepper
3. Bring the water to a boil
4. Remove the pan from heat , cover , and let it stand until the chicken is just cooked through
5. This takes 15 to 25 minutes depending on the size of your chicken breast
6. If i have a large one , i'll usually let it actually boil for 3 or 4 minutes before removing from the heat
7. Transfer the chicken to a plate and let it cool
8. Shred or dice the chicken
9. While the chicken is poaching , whisk the yogurt , oil , minced shallot , and minced garlic in a small bowl
10. Season the dressing with salt and pepper to taste
11. Combine all the peas in a medium bowl
12. Add the chicken , dressing , minced tarragon , parsley , chives , lemon zest , and 1 tbsp lemon juice
13. Toss to coat
14. Season to taste with salt , pepper , and additional lemon juice , if desired
15. Serve spooned over toasted bread and / or lettuce leaves

title: cauliflower confetti   rice
steps:
1. In a food processor , chop the cauliflower until it looks like 'rice' , remove and set aside
2. In food processor chop one seeded red pepper , the celery , garlic and the onion
3. If using the leek , slice the leek in 1 / 2 inch slices
4. Heat oil in non-stick saute pan , add the vegetables , and stir over medium heat until the vegetables start to 'weep' and release some of their liquid
5. Add the spices and set heat to low , cover and cook until 'rice' is the desired consistency
6. Add small amounts of water , if needed
7. Delicious on its own or as a base for curry or ragouts

title: raw cashew hummus   bean free
steps:
1. Soak cashews for at least 3 hours
2. Drain and rinse cashews a few times
3. Place cashews and all remaining ingredients in a food processor
4. Variations: add either the olives , or red pepper and paprika , or sun-dried tomatoes
5. Or , just leave those out for a simple plain "hummus
6. "
7. Puree in the food processor until well blended - it will be very thick
8. Add water 1 / 4 cup at a time until desired texture
9. Garnish with fresh parsley if desired

title: grammy s easy potluck mixed veggie casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 farenheit
2. Cook veggies according to package directions
3. Drain veggies
4. Combine veggies with cheese , celery , onion , mayonaisse and pepper
5. Turn mixture into 13x9x2 inch casserole dish
6. Combine the cracker crumbs with butter / margarine and sprinkle over the veggie mixture
7. Bake uncovered until heated through , about 20-25 minutes

title: monica s penne pasta salad
steps:
1. Boil pasta and cook till al dente
2. Drain and toss with a small amount of olive oil
3. Let cool slightly
4. Add vegetables , oil , vinegar , and toss with cooked pasta
5. Add romano cheese
6. Salt / pepper to taste
7. Add cooked chicken / turkey breast
8. Refridgerate for at least 15-30 minutes
9. You may need to add more oil or vinegar depending on how moist you desire the salad to be
10. You may also replace the balsamic vinegar with any vinegar you prefer

title: copycat bennigan s potato soup lightened version
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Poke potatoes with a fork several times and bake 1 hour or until tender when pierced
3. Let cool slightly , and when you can touch them without burning your fingers , peel potatoes
4. Melt butter in a large stockpot over medium-low heat
5. Add onions and garlic , cover and let sweat 10 minutes , or until soft- but not brown
6. Add 2 / 3 of the potatoes and mash using a potato masher right in the pot
7. Add chicken broth , milk , and season to taste with salt & pepper
8. Raise the heat slightly to bring mixture to a low simmer , stirring occasionally
9. Chop remaining potatoes into small cubes , add to soup , and stir gently
10. Keep heating until soup warmed through
11. Ladle into serving bowls and garnish with any or all of the optional toppings

title: rose water syrup
steps:
1. Combine water and sugar in small saucepan
2. Bring to boil , then simmer until syrupy , about 5 minutes
3. Stir in lemon juice and rose water
4. Cool completely

title: stuffed chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. In a small bowl pour stuffing mix and water
3. Open chicken breasts , and if they are too thick to fold in half flatten and stretch them by placing on cutting board and using heavy rolling pin roll out chicken until it is able to be folded in half
4. Give the stuffing a quick mix with a spoon
5. Spoon stuffing onto one half of the chicken and fold chicken breast over to cover
6. Place breasts in baking pan
7. Continue stuffing breasts until all breasts are used
8. If you have left over stuffing go back and open breasts and continue stuffing until all stuffing is used
9. Combine soup and sour cream
10. Spread over chicken breasts
11. Cover and bake for 45 minutes to an hour until chicken is thoroughly cooked

title: blackberry chocolate frozen yogurt
steps:
1. In a blender container or food processor bowl , combine half of the yogurt , 1 / 2 cup of the berries , half of the corn syrup and half of the sugar
2. Cover and blend or process until almost smooth
3. Pour mixture into ice cream freezer container
4. Repeat first step and pour into ice cream freezer container
5. Freeze mixture in an electric ice cream maker according to manufacturer's directions
6. Remove dasher from ice cream maker
7. Add remaining 1 1 / 2 cups berries and the chopped chocolate
8. Stir to distribute
9. Ripen
10. Plug hole in lid and replace lid
11. Pack outer freezer bucket with enough ice and rock salt to cover top of freezer can , using about 4 cups of ice and 1 cup rock salt
12. Ripen for about 4 hours

title: crock pot coca cola chicken
steps:
1. Salt and pepper chicken to taste
2. Put chicken in crock
3. Add onions
4. Add cola and ketchup
5. Cook on low 6-8 hours

title: healthy peanut butter cookie balls
steps:
1. Put all ingredients into a blender or food processor and combine well
2. Shape into bite sized balls , or bars if you prefer
3. Can be eaten immediately , refrigerated or frozen depending on the desired texture

title: allison s banana bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Combine flour , baking soda , salt
3. In a separate bowl , beat sugar and butter
4. Add eggs , one at a time
5. Add banana , yogurt , and vanilla
6. Add flour mixture until just moist
7. Pour into greased loaf pan
8. Bake 1 hour
9. Cool at least 10 minutes in pan before removing to rack to cool completely

title: salad greens with oranges  strawberries and vanilla vinaigrette
steps:
1. Mix oil
2. Vinegar , vanilla extract , salt , sugar and ground black pepper in small bowl with wire whisk until well blended
3. Toss greens with oranges , strawberries and pecans n large bowl
4. Serve with vanilla vinaigrette

title: apple topped cream cheese coffee cake
steps:
1. Set the oven to 350f
2. Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking pan
3. Dip apple slices in lemon juice to coat
4. Set aside
5. In a medium bowl , combine the butter and cream cheese
6. Add in the sugar , and beat on medium speed until light and fluffy
7. Add in the eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
8. Beat in the almond extract
9. In a bowl
10. Sift / mix together the flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
11. Add the flour mixture to the creamed mixture , alternately with the milk , beginning and ending with the flour mixture
12. Mix well after each addition
13. Pour the batter into prepared baking pan
14. Combine the 1 / 2 cup sugar , 2 tbsp flour and the cinnamon in a small bowl
15. Toss the apple slices in the flour / cinnamon mixture , tossing lightly to coat well
16. Arrange the apple slices evenly on top of the batter in the pan
17. Bake for 50-60 minutes

title: chocolate mocha pudding
steps:
1. Combine sugar , cocoa , cornstarch , cinnamon and coffee in an 8 cup measure cup or bowl
2. Gradually stir in milk
3. Microwave on high 5 to 6 minutes or until it starts to boil and thicken slightly
4. Stir in butter and vanilla
5. Place plastic wrap on surface of pudding
6. Refrigerate at least 2 hours
7. Whisk until smooth
8. Serve in individual bowls or wine glasses

title: tortellini with roasted garlic sauce  appetizer
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f cut 1 / 2-inch off top of garlic and remove papery outer skin , leaving cloves intact
2. Wrap garlic in foil and bake 1 hour , or until tender when pierced with a sharp knife
3. Let stand until cool enough to handle
4. Cook tortellini according to package directions
5. Rinse under cold water , drain well on paper towels
6. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in large nonstick skillet over medium heat
7. Add tortellini in batches to oil , cook and stir 3-5 minutes or until lightly golden
8. Add more oil if necessary
9. Drain on paper towels
10. Separate cooled garlic into cloves
11. Pinch each clove so roasted flesh comes out and place in blender or food processor
12. Add mayonnaise , sour cream , parmesan cheese and hot sauce
13. Cover and process until pureed and very smooth
14. Spoon into small saucepan
15. Cook and stir over low heat until hot and bubbly
16. Transfer to small serving bowl
17. To serve , arrange tortellini on serving platter
18. Dip into roasted garlic sauce

title: simple   delicious cranberry cream cheese pinwheels
steps:
1. Mix cream cheese and garlic salt together until well blended
2. Spread evenly on tops of tortillas
3. In small bowl , stir together cranberries and onions
4. Sprinkle evenly over cream cheese spread
5. Lightly press cranberry / onion mix into cream cheese
6. Roll up tortilla
7. Trim off ends
8. And cut each tortilla into 10 even pieces using a serated knife , like you would slice bread

title: parmesan mustard pork  south beach friendly
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350
2. In a small bowl , mix the breadcrumbs , butter , and 1 tablespoon of the dijon mustard , parmesan cheese , and parsley
3. Season the pork chops with salt and pepper
4. Spread the remaining dijon mustard on one side each chop and place the chops on a baking sheet
5. Divide the breadcrumb mixture among the chops and pat them onto the mustard
6. Bake the chops until they are fully cooked and the breadcrumbs are nicely browned , about 35-45 minutes

title: carrot potato boats
steps:
1. Bake potatoes in a 375 oven for 45 minutes or until done
2. Cool slightly
3. Cut potatoes in half lengthwise
4. Scoop out potatoes into small mixer bowl
5. Reserving shells
6. Add cheese , milk , salt and pepper
7. Beat till fluffy
8. Add more milk if necessary
9. Folk in carrot and green onion
10. Spoon potato mixture into potato shells bake on a baking sheet at 375 for 15 minutes

title: turkey kibbeh
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f coat an 8-inch-square baking dish with cooking spray
2. Place bulgur in a small bowl and cover with boiling water
3. Set aside for 15 minutes untilmost or all of the water is absorbed
4. Heat oil in a small nonstick skillet over medium heat
5. Add onion and cook , stirring occasionally , until softened , about 4 minutes
6. Remove from the heat and stir in the toasted pine nuts
7. Drain the bulgur , pressing on it to remove any exess liquid
8. Transfer to a large bowl and add turkey , zucchini , marjoram , cumin , salt , allspice and cayenne
9. Gently mix until combined
10. Pat half the meat mixture into the prepared baking dish
11. Top with the onion mixture , pressing it gently into the turkey layer
12. Cover with the rest of the turkey mixture , pressing gently into the onion layer
13. Cover baking dish with foil
14. Bake the kibbeh for 30 minutes
15. Remove the foil and continue baking until a thermometer inserted into the center registers 165 f , 10 to 15 minutes more
16. While the kibbeh is baking , combine yogurt , cucumber , tomato and pepper in a small bowl
17. Cover and chill until ready to serve
18. Cut the kibbeh into 6 squares and serve warm with the yogurt sauce

title: thai vegan fried rice  khao phad jay
steps:
1. To start with uncooked rice , start with 2 cups raw rice , cook , spread out on a baking pan to cool , and then refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight
2. Prepare the garnishes: cut the scallions on a slight diagonal into 1-inch lengths , cut the cucumber into very thin slices , cut the lime into wedges
3. Set aside
4. Heat a wok or large frying pan over high heat and add the oil
5. When the oil is very hot and slightly smoking , add the garlic , onion , and black pepper and stir-fry for 2 minutes
6. Add the green beans and corn and continue to stir-fry for 3 minutes
7. Add the cold cooked rice and stir-fry for 5 minutes
8. Add the soy sauce and curry paste and stir-fry for 2 minutes
9. Garnish with the scallions , cucumber , and lime , and serve hot

title: indian summer bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375o
2. Lightly grease a 9x13 shallow baking pan with one t
3. Olive oil
4. Cut the vegetables into very thin slices crosswise
5. Coarsely chop the garlic
