6. Lay sliced potatoes along the bottom of the pan , overlapping the slices by half
7. Drizzle w / 1 t
8. Olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper
9. Cover the potatoes with the zucchini
10. Drizzle with another t
11. Of olive oil
12. Sprinkle with salt , pepper , garlic , 1 / 4 c parsley and the lemon zest
13. Next , cover the zucchini with the sliced tomatoes , the remaining t
14. Of olive oil , pepper and the remaining parsley
15. Bake for 50 minute to 1 hr
16. , or until the potatoes are tender when pierced with a knife
17. Serve hot or at room temperature

title: southwest cowpoke chili
steps:
1. Saute jalapenos , beef , onion , garlic until meat loses its red color
2. Add remaining ingredients and water
3. Bring to boiling reduce heat , and simmer , covered utill you`ve finished a case of beer
4. Prepare roadrunners , let chili cool and feed to the roadrunners
5. Lean back , take it easy and enjoy the rest of the beer !

title: quick blueberry syrup
steps:
1. Dump blueberries into a small pot on high heat and add the other ingredients as you get them
2. Bring to a boil and reduce heat
3. Boil for 5 or 10 minutes
4. Serve over pancakes , waffles or as a topping on sweet biscuits with whipped cream
5. Store in the refrigerator for up to 5 days and reheat on the stove or in the microwave

title: chocolate raspberry cheesecake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Wrap outside of 9-inch springform pan with heavy-duty foil
3. Combine crushed cookies and melted butter in small bowl
4. Press into bottom of pan
5. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until slightly darker in color
6. Cool slightly
7. Gently spread preserves over crust
8. Puree thawed raspberries in food processor or blender until smooth
9. Strain through medium strainer , pressing with spatula to remove seeds reserve 1 / 2 cup puree
10. Beat cream cheese and 1 / 2 cup butter at medium-low speed until smooth beat in sugar and flour just until blended
11. Beat in sour cream , reserved raspberry puree and lemon juice
12. Beat in eggs one at a time
13. Pour over crust
14. Place springform pan in large shallow pan
15. Add enough hot tap water to come halfway up sides of springform pan bake 40 to 45 minutes or until edges are puffed and top is dry to the touch center should move slightly when pan is tapped but should not ripple as if liquid
16. Remove cake from water bath
17. Remove foil
18. Cool completely on wire rack
19. Refrigerate overnight
20. Place chocolate , corn syrup and 1 tablespoon butter in medium bowl
21. Bring whipping cream to a boil in small saucepan
22. Pour over chocolate mixture
23. Stir until melted and smooth
24. Let stand , stirring occasionally , until chocolate is cool but still pourable
25. Pour over cheesecake
26. Refrigerate until set
27. Garnish with raspberries
28. Store in refrigerator

title: szechuan dan dan noodles
steps:
1. Combine first 8 ingredients in small bowl , add water if thinner consistency is desired
2. Cook noodles in boiling water until tender but still firm , checking frequently to avoid overcooking
3. Drain and transfer to serving bowl
4. Add spinach / watercress and sauce
5. Toss lightly and serve

title: gingersnaps
steps:
1. Sift the dry ingredients together in a large bowl
2. Warm the molasses , and mix the molasses , oil and water
3. If the molasses is not warm enough to dissolve into the water , they can all be warmed a little together- the microwave is fine for this
4. Mix the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients
5. The dough should be quite stiff , and not particularly sticky
6. If it is too soft and sticky , add a little more flour
7. Preheat the oven to 350f
8. Roll out the dough to about 1 / 4" thick , and cut out with cookie cutters
9. Place cookies on cookie trays which have been lined with parchment paper , or lightly oiled
10. Re-roll and cut the scraps , until the dough is gone
11. Bake for 10 to 14 minutes , until lightly browned and set- they will harden up as they cool

title: easy chicken divan
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cook broccoli according to directions , arrange in greased 9 x 11 pan
3. Cut up cooked chicken into slices , arrange in pan
4. Mix soup , mayonnaise , curry , and lemon juice and pour over chicken
5. Sprinkle cheddar cheese over top
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minute may make ahead and refrigerate , extend bake time to 50-55 minute
7. Starting with raw chicken will extend the cooking time by 30-40 min , or the time it takes to cook the chicken

title: raspberry layer bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees mix melted butter , sugar and crumbs together
2. Press firmly into 13x9 inch baking pan
3. Pour sweetened condensed milk evenly over crumbs
4. Chill for 10 minutes
5. Layer in raspberry jam over condensed milk
6. Top with coconut and nuts and bake 25-30 minutes or until lightly browned
7. Cool in pan on rack
8. Chill if desired
9. Cut into bars and serve
10. Store loosely covered at room temperature

title: ham and macaroni bake
steps:
1. Cook macaroni
2. Drain
3. In large saucepan , melt 1 / 4 cup butter
4. Blend in flour , brown sugar , mustard , salt , and pepper
5. Add milk all at once
6. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly
7. Stir in cooked macaroni , ham , and apple slices
8. Turn into a 2-quart casserole dish
9. Combine bread crumbs and melted butter
10. Sprinkle over casserole
11. Bake uncovered at 350 for about 35 minutes

title: lemon honey ginger salad dressing
steps:
1. Add all ingredients to a food processor or blender and pulse until smooth and emulsified and ginger and garlic are minced well
2. Pour into an airtight container
3. Store in fridge
4. Will keep a few weeks
5. I love this with spinach salad

title: broccoli cheese salad
steps:
1. Combine broccoli , cauliflower , cheese , onion , bacon bits , raisins , walnuts and apple in a large salad bowl
2. Combine the mayonnaise and sugar in a small bowl
3. Let sit for 15 minutes for the sugar to dissolve
4. Add in the vinegar
5. Stir well to combine
6. Pour over the salad ingredients and toss to mix well
7. Refrigerate for several hours before serving

title: crispy salsa chicken
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
2. Coat chicken with coating mix as directed on package
3. Pleace the chicken on an ungreased baking sheet
4. Bake for 20 minutes or until chicken is cooked through [internal temperature of 170 degrees f]
5. Top each breast with 2 tbsp of salsa , then sprinkle evenly with cheese
6. Bake an additional 5 minutes or until cheese is melted

title: peppy shrimp
steps:
1. In large skillet , heat 3t butter , add jalapeno , onion , and garlic
2. Saute for 3 minutes
3. Add shrimp , cook and stir 2 minutes
4. Add chicken broth , cumin , oregano , and salt
5. Stir well
6. Slowly add cream , stirring until mixed well
7. Cook for 2 minutes on med-hi
8. Stir in the remaining butter and parsley
9. Mix well

title: pineapple ham spread
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine the cream cheese , pineapple and ham
2. Serve with crackers or bread

title: shrimp arrabbiata
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to the package directions , omitting salt and fat
2. Drain and keep warm
3. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
4. Sprinkle shrimp with salt
5. Add shrimp to pan
6. Cook 2 minutes on each side or until shrimp are done
7. Transfer shrimp to a bowl
8. Heat remaining 1 tablespoon oil in pan
9. Add onion , minced garlic , basil , and crushed red pepper to pan
10. Saut 1 minute
11. Add tomato paste and tomatoes
12. Bring to a boil
13. Cook 3 minutes or just until sauce begins to thicken
14. Return shrimp to pan
15. Cook 1 minute or until thoroughly heated
16. Add capers , kalamata olives , and parsley to the pan , stirring well to combine
17. Serve over pasta

title: chuy s restaurant hatch green chili salsa
steps:
1. Place water in large pot and add tomatillos , serrano chiles , sandia chiles , cilantro , garlic and onion
2. Bring to boil and simmer for 30 minutes
3. Strain liquid into a container and place solid ingredients in blender
4. Add 1 / 2 of the strained liquid to blender and blend until smooth
5. Add lime juice and salt and blend 30 seconds
6. Chill before serving
7. Presentation: serve with chips , tortillas or in recipes calling for salsa
8. Can be stored in a sealed container for 4 days in the refrigerator

title: pumpkin pecan pie
steps:
1. Combine the pumpkin , sugar , spices and salt in a bowl mixing well
2. Add the eggs and evaporated milk
3. Beat until smooth , using a rotary beater or an electric mixer
4. Pour into the unbaked pie shell
5. Bake in a preheated oven at 425 degrees fahrenheit for 15 minutes and then reduce the temperature to 350 degree and bake for an additional 45 minutes or until a knife inserted halfway between the center and edge comes out clean
6. Cool on a wire rack
7. Crunchy pecan topping: place the softened butter , brown sugar , and pecans in a bowl and mix until crumbly with a fork
8. Sprinkle over the cooled pie
9. Place the pie under the broiler until the mixture begins to bubble , about 1 minute
10. Cool to room temperature on a wire rack

title: gamma s swedish pancakes
steps:
1. Beat eggs
2. Add in milk and butter , stir well
3. Sift together salt and sugar with flour
4. Add dry to wet ingredients , slowly
5. Don't over-beat
6. This is a thin and runny batter
7. Cook up on a lightly greased griddle until golden brown on both sides
8. This doesn't take very long so watch it
9. I use 1 / 4 cup batter in a 9 inch saut pan

title: spinach and mushroom stuffing balls
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f
2. Mix stuffing , water and butter in a large bowl
3. Add all additional ingredients and mixed until well blended
4. Shape into 60 balls , about 1 inch across
5. Place in a single layer on a greased baking sheet
6. Chill 2 hours
7. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned

title: chorizo potato tostadas
steps:
1. Pan fry chorizo until it changes color and gives off some of its oil
2. Add cubed potato and continue sauteeing until potato absorbs chorizo color and flavor
3. Place a portion of this on each tostada
4. Top it with shredded lettuce , crumbled cheese and avocado slices
5. Season with salt to taste and your favorite chile salsa

title: dunkin donuts hazelnut coolata
steps:
1. Make coffee using double the amount of grounds with the same amount of water as normal
2. I use 4 cups of water and 8 scoops of hazelnut coffee- still using the hazelnut syrup
3. Mix all ingredients in blender and blend until smooth
4. Serve with whipped cream if wanted

title: cinnamon roasted apples
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. In a large bowl , combine sugar , lemon juice , and 1 / 4 cup water
3. Halve apples and core using a spoon or melon baller
4. Toss apples in the sugar
5. Arrange apples , skin up in a baking dish then pour sugar over them
6. Tuck in cinnamon sticks and cover with foil
7. Bake until apples are easily pierced about 15-20 minutes

title: traditional british victorian sandwich sponge cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to gas mark 4 , 180c , 350f then mix the sugar and margarine together until creamy
2. Beat the eggs then add one at a time , stirring until it is runny
3. At this point you could add flavour if you wanted
4. Sieve the flour into the bowl , then mix altogether until all the flour is gone
5. Grease the tins with margarine and then divide equally between two tins , and bake for 25 minutes
6. Take them out and put on a cooling tray for 10 minutes
7. Cut out both sides , and put them together like a sandwich
8. Oh , and be sure to add jam or something delicious between the two cake halves

title: supreme chicken
steps:
1. In a shallow dish or bowl , combine 4 tablespoons flour , paprika , 1 teaspoon salt and pepper
2. Coat chicken breasts with the flour mixture
3. In a large skillet , brown the coated chicken in 1 / 4 cup of butter or margarine
4. Add the water , cover and let simmer covered for 25 to 30 minutes
5. Meanwhile , preheat oven to 350 degrees f
6. When chicken breasts are done simmering , remove from the skillet and place in a 9x13 inch baking dish
7. Save drippings
8. Combine remaining 2 tablespoons flour , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and half-and-half
9. M
10. Ix together and stir mixture into reserved drippings in skillet
11. Bring to a simmer , stirring , and cook until thick and bubbly
12. Add mushrooms and lemon juice and stir together
13. Pour sauce over chicken and bake uncovered in the preheated oven for 30 minutes
14. Sprinkle with cheese and bake 3-5 minutes more until cheese melts

title: bruschetta topped with tomatoes and capers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Place bread slices on ungreased cookie sheet
3. Drizzle 1 teaspoon oil on each slice bread
4. Bake about 8 minutes or until golden brown
5. While bread is toasting , mix remaining ingredients
6. Spoon tomato mixture onto bread slices
7. Serve at at room temperature

title: chicken and peppers in phyllo
steps:
1. Broil peppers on all sides until black and blistered
2. When they're cool enough to handle , peel , halve and seed , and drain on paper towels
3. Heat oven to 350
4. Spray baking sheet with cooking spray
5. Put a sheet of phyllo on a work suface and brush with butter
6. Put a second sheet across the bottom of the first to form an upside-down t
7. Brush with butter
8. Put a third sheet on top of first , and brush with butter
9. Sprinkle 1 / 4 of bread crumbs centered near the bottom over an area the size of one chicken breast
10. Put a chicken breast on top , sprinkle with lemon juice , 1 / 4 teaspoon tarragon and salt and pepper
11. Top with pepper half and crumbled cheese
12. Fold over the bottom of dough
13. Fold in sides and roll , brushing with butter
14. Place on cookie sheets
15. Repeat for a total of four phyllo packages
16. Bake for 30 minutes , or until brown

title: pasta primavera with cherry tomato sauce
steps:
1. Put the tomatoes , sugar , onion , garlic , rosemary and stock into a large pan and bring to the boil
2. Simmer over a low heat for 15 minutes , stirring occasionally , until the tomatoes have broken down and the sauce has thickened
3. Meanwhile , cook the rigatoni in a large pan of slightly salted boiling water according to the packet instructions
4. Add the broccoli and green beans 3 minutes before the end of the cooking time
5. Drain the rigatoni and vegetables and toss with the cherry tomato sauce
6. Season to taste and serve immediately

title: cinnamon popcorn
steps:
1. In a saucepan combine all ingredients together
2. Bring to boil over medium heat , constantly stirring
3. Boil for 5 minutes , stirring once in awhile
4. Pour over popcorn and mix thoroughly
5. Pour on 2 greased cookie sheets
6. Bake 250f for 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes

title: bisquick shortcakes
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425
2. Grease cookie sheet or 8" pan
3. Mix ingredients until soft dough forms
4. Drop by spoonfuls to form 6 biscuits or put into 8" pan
5. Bake at 425 for 10 - 12 minutes
6. Cool slightly , split biscuits and fill with sweetened fruit and top with real whipped cream

title: jake s tuna dinner
steps:
1. Prepare the mac& cheese and directed on the package
2. Stir in the milk and mushroom soup
3. Stir in the tuna and peas
4. Heat over low heat until all ingredients are hot

title: cheesy egg  ham and mushroom casserole
steps:
1. Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking dish
2. In a bowl mix together 1-1 / 2 cups shredded cheddar with 3 / 4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese then sprinkle evenly into the bottom of the baking dish
3. In a large skillet melt butter oven medium heat
4. Add in sliced mushrooms and cook until they release there moisture
5. Add in green onions and red bell pepper
6. Saute for 3 minutes
7. Spoon the mushroom mixture over the cheese , then sprinkle the chopped ham over the mushroom mixture
8. In a bowl whisk together flour , eggs , 1 / 2 and 1 / 2 , salt , pepper and cayenne until thoroughly blended
9. Pour evenly over the ham
10. Cover and refrigerate for 8-24 hours
11. Remove from fridge 30 minutes before baking
12. Set oven to 350f
13. Bake for 35-40 minutes
14. Top with 1 cup cheddar cheese and return to oven for 2-3 minutes or until the cheese melts

title: hearty and delicious cholent for a crowd
steps:
1. In an 18 qt electric roaster , layer ingredients in order listed
2. Cover with water , cover pot , and cook at 250f for about a day and a half
3. Eat with lots of pickles , and a good shot of vodka
4. Shabbat shalom !

title: guinness braised beef with mushrooms
steps:
1. Arrange rack in lower third of oven
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
3. Heat 2 t
4. Oil in dutch oven over high heat
5. Add 5 or 6 meat cubes and sprinkle with salt and pepper
6. Brown meat on all sides , 5-6 minutes
7. Transfer to plate
8. Brown remaining meat in batches , adding oil as needed
9. Add onions , carrots , and garlic to dutch oven and stir to coat with oil
10. Reduce heat to medium and cook , stirring occasionally , until onions are light golden , about 15 minutes
11. Meanwhile , tie allspice , cloves , parsley and thyme sprigs , bay leaf , and chile pepper in a piece of cheesecloth
12. Add beef broth , stout , tomato paste , browned meat , and spice bag to dutch oven
13. Heat to boiling , scraping bottom of pan with wooden spoon
14. Cover dutch oven tightly with aluminum foil and lid
15. Bake , stirring occasionally , until beef is tender , 1-1 / 2 to 2 hours
16. If necessary , add water to keep solids covered with liquid while baking
17. Remove spice bag and store beef in refrigerator
18. Before proceeding , remove fat from surface and heat to simmering
19. )
20. Meanwhile , heat butter and 1 t
21. Vegetable oil in large skillet over medium-high heat
22. Add mushrooms and cook until light golden , about 4 minutes
23. Transfer dutch oven to top of stove
24. Remove spice bag and skim off fat from surface
25. Stir in vinegar and taste and adjust seasonings
26. Using slotted spoon , add mushrooms to stew
27. Simmer stew covered 5-10 minutes
28. Stir in chopped parsley
29. Serve hot over cooked rice or mashed potatoes

title: casserole italiano
steps:
1. Brown ground beef with onions and seasonings
2. Drain fat
3. Combine beef mixture , soup , and cooked noodles in a 1
4. 5 quart casserole dish
5. Sprinkle cheese over top of casserole
6. Bake 30 minutes at 350 degrees

title: best ever chili cheese fries
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Put frozen fries on metal pan or baking dish
3. Cover fries with chili
4. Add cheese on top
5. Bake 30 minutes
6. You're done !

title: grilled beef fajitas with avocado pico de gallo
steps:
1. Mix soy sauce and lime juice together
2. Pour over flank steak and marinate meat for 4-8 hours , turning meat over once
3. Grill the meat to medium rare or to your desired doneness
4. Slice thinly at an angle against the grain
5. An electric knife works great for this job
6. Pico de gallo:
7. Add all the above ingredients in a small bowl
8. Stir lightly to mix
9. Cover and let stand at room temperature for 2 hours before serving
10. Once you have your meat cooked and tortillas warmed you are ready to assemble !
11. Top tortilla with the desired amount of meat , some pico de gallo and a dollop of sour cream
12. Wrap and enjoy
13. Other taco or fajita type toppings can be added if desired

title: coffee ice cream pie
steps:
1. Melt chocolate and butter
2. Stir in milk and sugar
3. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly
4. Cook and stir until thickened
5. Remove from the heat and cool completely
6. Spoon ice cream into crust
7. Stir sauce and spread over ice cream
8. Top with whipped topping and sprinkle with pecans
9. Freeze until firm
10. Remove from the freezer 15 minutes before serving

title: sweet potato corn bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees and spray a 9 x9 inch pan with cooking spray
2. In a medium bowl , sift together the first 7 ingredients
3. With a pastry blender or 2 forks , blend in the margarine
4. Stir the sweet potato into the dry ingredients
5. Add the milk , egg and vanilla and stir with a whisk to combine
6. Pour batter in to prepared dish and spread evenly
7. Bake for 20 minutes or until a tooth pick inserted in the center comes out clean

title: tangy lemon drink
steps:
1. Extract juice of lemons , keep aside
2. Tie peel , seeds , in a small muslin bag
3. Bruise ginger , add to sugar and 1 / 2 cup water in a pan
4. Stir and cook over low heat till sugar dissolves
5. Add peel-bag to the boiling mixture
6. Once sugar is fully dissolved , boil on high for 2-3 minutes
7. Cool to room temperature , remove bag
8. Strain mixture and add juice of lemons
9. Add to chilled water
10. Add chopped mint leaves
11. Whisk well with a hand mixie or in liquidiser for a few seconds on high
12. Serve chilled

title: coffee crazy cake
steps:
1. Stir together flour , sugar , cocoa powder , baking soda and salt in an ungreased 12 x 8 inch baking pan
2. Make 3 wells in the mixture
3. Pour oil in 1 , vinegar in 1 and vanilla in 1
4. Pour in coffee and stir all with a fork until well mixed
5. Spread into even layer
6. Combine 1 / 3 cup sugar and cinnamon
7. Sprinkle half of cinnamon over batter
8. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 35 to 40 minutes
9. Sprinkle remaining cinnamon sugar over hot cake
10. Cool 15 or 20 minutes before cutting

title: outback s roasted garlic herb aioli
steps:
1. Place all ingredients into a mixing bowl
2. Whisk to combine
3. Place in a small container
4. Refrigerate aioli for a few hours before use to allow flavors to combine

title: soba noodle salad with tamari
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients for salad dressing and let it sit for 30 minutes
2. Meanwhile in a large pot of boiling water cook noodles about 4 minutes until tender , drain and rinse in cold water
3. Add 2 tbsp of dressing
4. In skillet add oil and saute mushrooms until cooked , season with salt& pepper and cool
5. In a large bowl add noodles , dressing , mushrooms , etc stirring to mix well
6. Garnish with extra sesame seeds and scallions

title: fried tempeh
steps:
1. Cut tempeh into strips approximately 1 to 1 1 / 2 inches thick
2. Place in plastic covered container with soy sauce and garlic powder for 2 hours in refrigerator
3. After 2 hours drain soy sauce and discard
4. Heat grape seed oil to medium in a large frying pan with lid
5. Place tempeh strips in oil and brown on each side , remove from oil , sprinkle with salt and drain on towels to remove extra oil
6. Sauce: mix veginase and black pepper , red pepper in small container , mix well use for dipping

title: crescent veggie tree appetizer
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375
2. Remove dough from cans in rolled sections
3. Do not unroll
4. Cut each section into 8 slices
5. Place slices , cut side down , on ungreased cookie sheets to form trees
6. To form each tree , start by placing 1 slice for top
7. Arrange 2 slices just below , with sides touching
8. Continue arranging a row of 3 slices , then a row of 4 slices , ending with a row of 5 slices
9. Use the remaining slice for the trunk
10. Refrigerate one tree
11. Bake one tree for 11 to 13 minutes or until golden brown
12. Cool one minute
13. Carefully loosen with spatula and slide onto wire rack to cool
14. Bake and cool second tree
15. Place each tree on a platter
16. In a small bowl , combine cream cheese , sour cream , dill and garlic powder
17. Blend until smooth
18. Spread the mixture over both trees
19. Decorate the trees with assorted vegetable pieces
20. Refrigerate until serving time
21. To serve , just pull apart the slices of the tree

title: fake french toast
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients well in blender
2. Spray a small non-stick frying pan with cooking spray
3. Pour batter into pan
4. Cook one side
5. Flip
6. Cook the other side
7. Top with sf syrup or powdered sweetener , if desired

title: egg  poblano and avocado scramble  ww
steps:
1. Heat oil in sillit over medium high heat
2. Add chilies and onion , stirring occasionally for 5 minutes or until vegetables soften
3. Meanwhile whisk together egg beaters , cilantro , cumin , salt and pepper in bowl
4. Pour egg mixture over chili mixture
5. Reduce heat and cook , stirring frequently until eggs are set
6. Remove from heat and stir in avocado

title: cheesy mashed potato bake
steps:
1. Cook the potatoes in boiling salted water until tender drain and transfer to a large bowl
2. Add in sour cream , butter , softened cream cheese and cream
3. Beat until smooth
4. Add in shredded cheddar
5. Mix to combine then season with salt and black pepper to taste
6. Transfer to a 2 or 3-quart casserole dish
7. Sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese
8. At this point you can cover and refrigerate or bake for about 20-22 minutes

title: greatest chips  french fries  on earth
steps:
1. Fill a saucepan with plenty of water and bring up the water temperature to 62c
2. I found on my electric stove top that medium was a good temperature to start with and as it approached dropping back to low held it there
3. Peel potato and cut into chips
4. I think around 12mm across is a good size , the recipe wouldn't be well suited to thin ones
5. Pre-cook in water at 62c for 30 minutes , drain well and allow to cool to room temperature
6. Deep-fry in warm oil at 130c for 5 minutes , drain and allow to cool to room temperature
7. Deep-fry in hot oil at 190c until golden and done to your liking , around 5 minutes
8. If doing a lot of chips either cook in small batches or crank up the burner if using a wok when adding so the temperature of the oil doesn't drop too much

title: cucumber martini
steps:
1. Mix gin and thick cucumber slices in pitcher
2. Cover and chill overnight or up to 3 days
3. Strain gin , discarding thick cucumber slices
4. Pour half of gin into cocktail shaker
5. Add 1 tablespoon vermouth , then fill shaker with ice
6. Shake vigorously
7. Strain into three glasses
8. Repeat with remaining gin and vermouth
9. Garnish with thin cucumber slices

title: shrimp and vegetable stir fry
steps:
1. In a bowl , mix 1 teaspoon cornstarch , ginger
2. Add garlic and shrimp and toss to coat
3. Cover and refrigerate
4. Remove tough ends from broccoli
5. Cut stalks into 3 / 4" pieces and head into flowerettes
6. Add broccoli to 1 quart boiling water
7. Cook 1 minute , uncovered
8. 1 minute covered
9. Drain and rinse immediately
10. Set aside
11. Heat 3 tablespoons oil in large skillet or wok over medium heat
12. Add shrimp mixture
13. Cook and stir until shrimp are opaque and white
14. Remove from pan and set aside
15. Combine cold water , soy sauce , remaining 2 teaspoons cornstarch and bouillon in small bowl
16. Heat remaining 1 tablespoon oil in same skillet or wok
17. Add broccoli
18. Cook until tender
19. Add pea pods
20. Cook 1 minute
21. Add cornstarch mixture
22. Cook until bubbly
23. Add shrimp and cook until sauce thickens
24. Serve over steamed rice

title: steamed leeks   spinach
steps:
1. Place the leeks in a steamer with the tarragon and steam for 7 minutes
2. Add spinach and continue to steam for 3 more minutes or until the spinach is wilted and hot whip the oil& lemon juice together
3. Place leeks and spinach on a platter and drizzle with the oil / lemon
4. Serve

title: spinach turkey wraps for 2
steps:
1. Spread 1 / 2 of the cream cheese over each tortilla
2. Sprinkle each with the garlic powder
3. Layer each tortilla with 3 / 4 cup of the spinach and equal amounts of the turkey , cheese , red pepper and onions
4. Top with remaining spinach
5. Drizzle with the ranch dressing
6. Roll up tightly jelly-roll style
7. Wrap in plastic wrap
8. Refrigerate until serving

title: special ham biscuits
steps:
1. Saute onion in butter till tender
2. Add mustard , worcestershire sauce and poppy seeds
3. Place in refrigerator until it reaches spreading consistency
4. Open the rolls , spread both sides with the mixture
5. Place small amount of ham and cheese on roll and replace the top of the roll
6. Cover with foil and heat at 425 degrees for 20 minutes

title: no bake chocolate peanut butter bars
steps:
1. Grease 9 x 13 baking pan
2. Beat 1 cups peanut butter and butter in large mixer bowl until creamy
3. Gradually beat in 1 cup powdered sugar
4. With hands or wooden spoon , work in remaining powdered sugar , graham cracker crumbs and cup morsels
5. Press evenly into prepared baking pan
6. Smooth top with spatula
7. Melt remaining peanut butter and remaining morsels in medium , heavy-duty saucepan over lowest possible heat , stirring constantly until smooth
8. Spread over graham cracker crust in pan
9. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour or until chocolate is firm
10. Cut into bars
11. Store in refrigerator

title: seasoned brown   wild rice
steps:
1. In small bowl , blend all seasoning ingredients
2. Set aside
3. In medium saucepan , bring water to a boil
4. Add margarine , brown rice & wild rice , and reduce heat
5. Cover & simmer 30 minutes
6. Water should be about half absorbed and brown rice beginning to soften
7. Stir in seasoning mix
8. Simmer additional 20-30 minutes
9. Let sit , still covered , 10 minutes
10. Mix in fresh parsley and fluff with fork before serving

title: almond kiss
steps: 1. Combine in stemmed mug with whipped cream

title: lobster thermidor a la julia child
steps:
1. Simmer all of the ingredients under step 1 in a large enameled or stainless steel pot for 15 minutes
2. Bring to a rolling boil and then add the live lobsters
3. You can tell when they are done because they are bright red and the long head-feelers can be pulled out pretty easily
4. While the lobsters are steaming , stew the mushrooms over low to medium low heat in a covered saucepan with all of the other ingredients from step 2 for 10 minutes
5. When the lobsters are cooked , remove them from the kettle
6. Pour the mushroom juices in the kettle lobster-juices pot and boil down rapidly until it is reduced to about 2 1 / 4 cups liquid
7. Strain the liquid into a large saucepan and bring to a simmer
8. Cook the first 2 ingredients from step 3 slowly together in another saucepan
9. Be sure not to brown it !
10. Remove from heat , and beat in the lobster-mushroom liquid
11. Boil , stirring constantly , for 1 minute
12. Drizzle the cream from step 3 on top of the sauce
13. Split the lobsters in half , lengthwise , making sure to keep the shell halves intact
14. Discard 'sand sacks' in the heads and intestines
15. Rub 'lobster coral' and 'green matter' through a fine sieve into a 3 quart mixing bowl , and blend it into the ingredients from step 4
16. Beat the lobster-mushroom sauce into this mixture in small spats
17. Return the sauce to the pan , and , stirring with a wooden spoon , bring it to a boil
18. Boil slowly for 2 minutes
19. Thin out with step 5
20. By now the sauce should be thick enough to coat a spoon pretty heavily
21. Set aside , top filmed with a spoonful of cream
22. Remove the meat from the lobster tails and claws , cut into 3 / 8 inch cubes
23. Set the skillet with the butter from step 6 over medium heat
24. When butter foam begins to dissipate , stir in the lobster meat and saute , stirring slowly , for 5 minutes , until the meat has turned a rosy color
25. Pour the cognac in and boil for a minute or two , shaking the skillet , until the liquid has been reduced by half
26. Preheat oven to 425f
27. Fold cooked mushrooms and 2 / 3 of the sauce into the skillet with the lobster meat
28. Arrange the split lobster shells on a shallow roasting pan or fireproof serving platter
29. Heap the lobster mixture into the shells , and cover with the remaining sauce
30. Sprinkle with cheese and dot with butter
31. Place in upper 1 / 3 of the oven for 10-15 minutes , until lobster is bubbling and sauce is a nice brown
32. Serve immediately !

title: chicken   spinach alfredo pizza
steps:
1. Roll dough out thin
2. Put on lightly greased cookie sheet and prick holes all over to minimize bubbling
3. Prebake the pizza dough at 425f for 5-7 minutes , remove from oven
4. Spread alfredo sauce to within 1" of edges
5. Top with chicken , spinach , onion , feta and olives , then mozzarella and parmesan last
6. If you like you can brush some olive oil around the edges of the crust
7. Return to oven and bake at 425f for 10-12 minutes or until done and bottom is browned
8. Remove from oven and let stand a few minutes before slicing
9. Delicious and even better warmed up the next day
10. I have also added mushrooms when i had them on hand

title: coconut pineapple cake
steps:
1. Make yellow cake mix according to directions on package
2. Bake in 9x13 pan
3. Cook undrained pineapple and sugar until sugar is well dissolved
4. Cook vanilla pudding mix as directed on package
5. After baking cake , poke holes with handle of wooden spook into cake
6. Pour pineapple mixture over top , then pudding
7. Put whipped cream on top , sprinkle nuts and coconut
8. Refrigerate overnight
9. Tastes even better two days later !

title: oat n  toffee cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugars
2. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
3. Beat in vanilla
4. Mix flour , oats , baking soda , baking powder and salt
5. Gradually add to creamed mixture
6. Stir in toffee bits
7. Drop by rounded tbs onto ungreased baking sheets
8. Bake at 375 for 10-12 minutes , until light golden brown
9. Cool 1 minute before removing from pans to wire rack

title: black forest spoon dessert
steps:
1. Preheat slow cooker on high for 10 minutes
2. Spray the cooker with nonfat cooking spray
3. In the cooker stir together the pie filling and cake mix until there is no dry cake mix visible
4. The batter will be very thick and lumpy
5. Place a paper towel on top of the slow cooker
6. Cook on high for 2 to 2 1 / 4 hours or until a knife inserted in the
7. Center comes out clean
8. Serve directly from the cooker
9. Do not invert this cake !

title: absolutely best hot slaw recipe
steps:
1. Fully cook bacon
2. While it is still hot , fill a food processor with bacon and chop it into coarse bits
3. Put hot chopped bacon in a strainer on a bowl to catch excess grease
4. Repeat until all bacon is chopped
5. Set bacon bits aside
6. Start with a gallon container with a large mouth
7. Add sugar , vinegar , water , oil , salt , garlic
8. Stir with a large mixing spoon , making sure you get all the sugar off the bottom of the container
9. Heat the amount of dressing you plan on using on the stove on low heat or a steam table , stopping short of a boil
10. Fill salad bowls with shredded cabbage
11. Sprinkle about 2 tbsp of the fresh bacon bits on top of cabbage
12. Refrigerate until ready to serve
13. Immediately before serving , stir hot dressing well , then use a ladle to pour about 4-6 oz on the slaw making sure you thoroughly wet all the cabbage and bacon
14. Enjoy !

title: game stew with cider and apples
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In an ovenprove casserole dish large enough to hold the 2 pounds of game , heat the olive oil and brown the game in batches
3. Set aside
4. Add onions , then parsnip and carrots and fry on medium heat for 5-10 minutes
5. Add cider , herbs and spices , bring to a boil , then add the browned game
6. Add just enough stock to cover the game and bring to a booil
7. Cover the casserole with the lid and cook in the oven for about 1-1 1 / 2 hours or until meat is tender
8. If the liquid is too thin , mix one tablespoon cornstarch with some cold water , then stir into the stew , bring to another boil and add the sliced apples
9. Simmer for another 15-20 minutes
10. Serve with white bread

title: pink prosciutto penne
steps:
1. Cook pasta per directions on package
2. Meanwhile , prepare sauce
3. Heat olive oil in large skillet
4. Add chopped prosciutto , onion , and dried red pepper flakes and saute until onions are golden
5. Remove pan from burner and add wine
6. Return pan to burner and stir , loosening up any browned bits from bottom of the pan and reducing liquid by half
7. Add tomatoes and bring to a boil reducing juices slightly
8. In a separate bowl , dissolve cornstarch in half and half and stir into the sauce
9. Simmer 5 minutes or until sauce is thickened slightly
10. Drain pasta , toss with sauce , and sprinkle with cheese

title: caramel scones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f line top sheet of doubled up baking sheets with parchment paper or line 8 tuna tins with muffin liners and spray inner sides with non-stick cooking spray
2. In a food processor , place the flour and butter and pulse to break up butter
3. Add sugar , baking powder , salt and nutmeg or cloves and pulse to combine
4. Turn out dough into a large bowl
5. Make a well in the center and stir in cream , vanilla , butterscotch extract and egg
6. Stir to make a soft dough
7. Fold in butterscotch chips
8. Scoop onto baking sheet or into prepared tins
9. Brush tops with egg white and add ground butterscotch chips
10. Bake until browned - 16-18 minutes
11. Dust with confectioner's sugar when cool

title: honey wholemeal scones
steps:
1. Combine dry ingredients in a bowl
2. Rub in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
3. Stir in honey and add as much milk as needed to form a soft dough
4. Turn out onto a floured surface and knead lightly
5. Pat down to desired thickness and cut out scones of desired size
6. Bake at 220 c for about 8 minutes

title: olde settler s beans
steps:
1. Brown bacon , ground beef and chopped onion till beef is no longer pink
2. Drain well
3. Preheat oven to 350
4. Mix sugars , ketchup , bbq sauce , molasses , dry mustard , garlic powder and salt and pepper
5. Drain all beans , and add to mixture
6. Pour into greased casserole dish and bake for 1 hour
7. Serve with crusty bread

title: savory beef and vegetable stew
steps:
1. In hot oil in dutch oven , brown beef cubes well on all sides
2. Remove and set aside
3. Add chopped onions , green peppers and celery to dutch oven and saute until tender- about 8 minutes
4. Return beef to pan
5. Add parsley , garlic , tomato sauce , wine , bouillon cubes , salt , pepper , thyme , bay leaf and 2 cups of water
6. Bring to boiling
7. Reduce heat and simmer , covered , 1 1 / 4 hours
8. Add vegetables and simmer , covered , 1 hour longer or until tender
9. Remove from heat
10. Skim off fat
11. Mix flour with 2 tablespoons cold water and stir into beef mixture
12. Arrange tomato wedges , skin side up , on top
13. Simmer covered , 10 minutes , until slightly thickened

title: easy petit fours
steps:
1. Spread 1 teaspoons chream cheese onto each cookie
2. Top each cookie with a strawberry half
3. Drizzle each with melted chocolate

title: easy chinese dumplings w dipping sauce
steps:
1. Dough: mix flour salt and boiling water with a wooden spoon
2. Add cold water and knead on a floured board , adding flour until a soft dough forms
3. Allow dough to rest 20 minutes , covered with a towel , while preparing filling
4. Filling: add all ingredients to food processor and chop fine
5. Roll dough very thinly and cut into 3 inch circles
6. If using wonton wrappers , you can cut into 3 inch circles or make triangles
7. Place 1 / 2 tsp of filling in center of dough
8. Wet edges and fold over pressing tightly , pushing all air out
9. Place dumplings on waxed paper , and cover with a towel , until ready to cook
10. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in frying pan
11. Cook dumplings in batches of 8-10
12. Brown in oil
13. Add 1 / 2 cup water carefully to pan and cover
14. Cook 10 minutes , uncover and cook another 3 minutes until water is gone
15. Remove from pan and keep warm in oven while cooking second batch , adding another 1 / 2 cup water to pan
16. Dipping sauce: mix all ingredients together and enjoy !

title: banana meringue delight
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees farenheit
2. In large bowl , beat egg whites until slightly stiff
3. Gradually add sugar and cream of tartar and continue to beat
4. Add vanilla and salt and continue beating until whites stand in stiff peaks
5. Spray 9 x 9- inch glass baking dish with non-stick cooking spray
6. Spread meringue over entire bottom and sides of dish to form a crust
7. Bake in 300 degrees fahrenheit oven for 45 minutes
8. Remove and cool
9. After crust has cooled , prepare pudding mix according to package directions and fold in sliced bananas
10. Pour pudding mixture into crust and sprinkle ground graham crackers on top
11. Chill and serve

title: salted boiled peanuts
steps:
1. Rinse all dirt off of peanuts inside of sink and drain
2. Place peanuts inside a large pot that leaves about 4 to 6 inches of room at the top of the pot
3. Cover peanuts with water leaving until the peanuts float to within 2 inches from the top of the pot
4. Add salt
5. A good hint is that all the salt you add will not be directly absorbed by the peanuts
6. So you can be generous
7. Bring to a rigorous boil and continue until soft
8. The time to boil depends on the peanuts and i think it is best done outside
9. Allow peanuts to absorb brine untill desired salty taste
10. About 1 hour +or -

title: pumpkin cheesecake crumble squares
steps:
1. For crust:
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
3. Generously butter 9x9x2-inch metal baking pan
4. Line rimmed baking sheet with parchment
5. Using on / off turns , blend first 4 ingredients in processor until coarse meal forms
6. Add pecans
7. Using on / off turns process until nuts are chopped
8. Add oats , process using on / off turns until mixture is moistened but not clumping
9. Press 3 1 / 2 cups crumbs onto bottom of prepared square pan
10. Transfer remaining crumbs to lined baking sheet
11. Bake crumbs on sheet until golden , stirring once , about 12 minutes
12. Cool crumbs
13. Bake crust until golden about 30 minutes
14. Remove from oven while preparing filling
15. Maintain oven temperature
16. For filling:
17. Blend all ingredients in same processor unti smooth
18. Spread filling over warm crust
19. Bake until set , dry in center , and beginning to rise at edges , about 20 minutes
20. Maintain oven temperature
21. For topping:
22. Mix all ingredients in small bowl
23. Spread evernly over hot filling
24. Bake until topping sets and bubbles at edges , about 5 minutes
25. Cool completely in pan on rack
26. Sprinkle crumbs over topping
27. Gently press into topping
28. Cover
29. Chill until cold , about 2 hours
30. Cut into squares
31. Can be made 2 days ahead
32. Enjoy !

title: mama head s chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Place the chicken breasts in a long casserole pan
3. Place a slice of cheese on each
4. Mix the chicken soup with the wine and pour over chicken and cheese
5. Sprinkle with stuffing
6. Pour melted butter on top
7. Cook at 350 degrees for 45 minutes to 1 hour , uncovered

title: italian poutine
steps:
1. Heat oil in a deep fryer or deep heavy skillet to 365 degrees f
2. Warm spaghetti sauce in saucepan or microwave
3. Place the fries into the hot oil , and cook until light brown , about 5 minutes
4. Remove to a paper towel lined plate to drain
5. Place the fries on a serving platter , and sprinkle the cheese over them
6. Ladle spaghetti sauce over the fries and cheese , and serve immediately
7. Top with a bit of parmesan cheese

title: blue cheese and pear salad
steps:
1. Cover each salad plate with a modest bed of baby green lettuce
2. Slice and core a half pear for each plate
3. Thinly slice pears from bottom to just before the very end and then fan out the slices over the lettuce
4. Top with toasted walnuts and a generous serving of crumbled blue cheese
5. Whisk dressing ingredients and spoon over the salad mixture

title: braised onion slices with bourbon
steps:
1. Heat butter and oil in a large heavy-bottomed saut pan
2. Add onions and sear on high for 2 minutes
3. Add salt , pepper and broth
4. Reduce heat and simmer 10-12 minutes
5. Add bourbon and cook down for 3 minutes
6. Add sugar , if using
7. Delish !

title: rosemaria salad
steps:
1. Drain juice from fruit and combine with first 4 ingredients
2. Cook 5 minutes until thick
3. Cook orzo according to package directions
4. Cool all ingredients , and mix together

title: awesome loaded baked potato salad
steps:
1. Combine sour cream and mayonnaise in small bowl
2. Chop bacon and red onion and add to sour cream mixture
3. Stir in salt and black pepper , cover and refrigerate
4. Preheat oven to 425
5. Bake potatoes for 50-60 minutes or until tender
6. Remove potatoes from oven and cool completely
7. Coarsely chop potatoes into 1 / 2-inch pieces
8. Place in large bowl and fold in sour cream mixture
9. Sprinkle sliced green onions and shredded cheddar cheese over the top
10. Cover and refrigerate 4-6 hours or overnight

title: orange coconut pie
steps:
1. Cream sugar and butter together until fluffy
2. Add eggs one at a time , beating after each addition
3. Stir in remaining ingredients
4. Pour into pie shell and bake at 350f until filling is firm , about 45 minutes

title: silverbeet with bacon  pumpkin and feta recipe
steps:
1. Heat the oil over moderate heat and add the garlic , onion , bacon and pumpkin , fry until the onion is soft and everything is browned
2. Add the silverbeet and season with salt and pepper
3. Fry gently , stirring occasionally , until the silverbeet is hot
4. Serve with the feta sprinkled on top
5. Good by itself with warm pita bread or as an accompaniment to barbecued or roast chicken or lamb

title: philly cheese steak
steps:
1. Add oil to a large non-stick skillet
2. Saute onions and 2 tablespoons of teriyaki sauce until the onions are soft
3. Add the sliced meat and cook until meat browns slightly , add remaining 1 tablespoon of teriyaki sauce and stir to combine
4. Place cheese on the meat and stir until melted , mixing meat , onions and cheese together
5. Scoop meat mixture onto sandwich rolls

title: blue cheese stuffed chicken breasts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Combine 1 tablespoons butter , thyme , and blue cheese in small bowl until blended
3. Season with salt & pepper and set aside
4. Cut a horizontal line in the thickest side of each chicken breast to form a pocket , but not cutting all the way through
5. Stuff blue cheese mixture into pocket with small spoon
6. Place chicken in a baking dish
7. Season with salt & pepper
8. Bake 15 minutes , uncovered
9. Meanwhile melt remaining 1 tablespoons butter
10. Stir in lemon juice and paprika
11. Turn chicken , brush with lemon mixture and bake additional 10 to 15 minutes or until chicken is cooked through

title: julie s easy chile relleno casserole
steps:
1. Butter a large rectangular baking dish
2. Mix cottage cheese , crackers , eggs , onion , and parsley and put half into dish
3. Top with layers of grated cheese and peppers , then cover with remaining cottage cheese mixture
4. Bake uncovered for 1 hour at 350 degrees

title: cauliflower and crab chowder
steps:
1. In a large saucepan combine cauliflower , broth , bell pepper and lemon peel
2. Bring to boiling , reduce heat
3. Cover and simmer 6 to 8 minutes or until cauliflower is crisp tender
4. Stir together half and half and flour
5. Stir into cauliflower mixture
6. Bring to boiling
7. Gently stir in crabmeat
8. Heat through
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste
10. Sprinkle with dill weed , if desired
11. Serve immediately

title: asparagus   zucchini crudi
steps:
1. Using vegetable peeler or dusty old mandoline , shave the zucchini into long thin ribbons
2. Thinly slice the asparagus on a diagonal
3. Toss the slices together and place the salad in a serving bowl
4. In a small bowl , combine the oil , the lemon juice , salt & freshly ground pepper to taste
5. Stir to combine and drizzle over the vegetables , tossing to coat
6. Garnish with the pecorino shavings
7. Chill or serve room temperature
8. Preparation time includes 20 minutes hunting for the mandoline
9. You now speak italian ! cioa !

title: zucchini and squash parmesan
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Coat the bottom of a glass dish or metal pan with olive oil
3. Place the cut zucchini and squash slices in the dish
4. Drizzle olive oil on top of the vegetables
5. Sprinkle grated cheese on top
6. Sprinkle italian seasoning , salt and pepper on top
7. Bake for 30 minutes

title: sweet and spicy jalapeno dip
steps:
1. Beat the softened cream cheese until its smooth
2. Add the apple jelly and lime juice and stir together until well blended
3. Gradually add the salsa , then stir in salt and minced jalapenos
4. Cover and chill for at least an hour before serving
5. Get out the corn chips and veggie dippers and dig in !

title: warm chocolate melting cake
steps:
1. Melt chocolate and butter in double boiler
2. Remove from heat
3. Mix four of the eggs with the sugar and whisk for a few minutes
4. Add flour and mix , then add the other three eggs
5. Add egg mixture slowly to the melted chocolate mixture
6. Pour the mixture into dessert ramekin cups
7. Bake directly in the oven at 400 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes
8. Serve with vanilla ice cream , or garnish with shaved sweet chocolate , chocolate sauce or powdered sugar

title: low fat sugar free zucchini bread muffins
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients in large bowl
2. Then mix other ingredients in smaller bowl
3. Gently mix other ingredients into dry ingredients , just until moist
4. Spoon into cupcake liners in pan
5. Bake about 15-18 minutes at 400f degrees

title: chocolate bread pudding wtih spiced whipped cream
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Butter a 6 cup loaf pan
3. Whisk eggs , sugar , cinnamon , nutmeg , vanilla , melted chocolate chips , and grand marnier
4. Add half-n- half
5. Add bread and let sit for 30 minutes
6. Pour 1 / 2 of mix into prepared pan , sprinkle with chocolate chips
7. Repeat with remaining bread and chocolate chips
8. Bake for approximately 1 hour or until set in center
9. Cut into 1 inch slices
10. Serve with spiced whipped cream: beat heavy cream for 2 minutes , add other ingredients

title: chuckwagon chili
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , cook beef over medium heat until browned
2. Drain
3. Add the remaining ingredients and bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat
5. Cover and simmer for 1 hour or until thick and bubbly

title: mushroom swiss chopped steak
steps:
1. Shape ground sirloin into patties
2. Season with salt and pepper to taste
3. Grill , broil or fry to desired doneness
4. Remove patties to a plate and keep warm
5. Top with a slice of swiss cheese
6. In same pan , saute mushrooms and sliced onion in butter until tender
7. Add the beef gravy and warm through
8. Top cheese covered patties with the sauteed onions , mushrooms and beef gravy

title: tomato and marinated baby bocconcini appetizers
steps:
1. Combine the oil , vinegar and basil in a medium bowl
2. Add the cheese and toss to coat in the marinade
3. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes
4. Drain cheese and discard the marinade
5. Wrap each cheese in a piece of rocket
6. Place on top of a tomato half and spear with a toothpick

title: soba and shrimp salad
steps:
1. Boil soba in boiling water for 5-8 minutes
2. Drain and rinse with cold water and then drain again
3. While noodles are cooking , mix together wasabi and 1 tablespoon cold water in a small bowl or cup
4. Let stand 5 minutes and then add the soy sauce and lemon juice and set aside
5. In a large salad bowl toss together the spinach , noodles , green onions , shrimp , ginger and dressing

title: grilled chicken pasta salad with artichoke hearts
steps:
1. Light the grill or heat the broiler
2. Coat the chicken with 1 tbsp of the oil and season with 1 / 4 tsp salt , 1 / 4 tsp garlic powder and 1 / 4 tsp pepper
3. Grill or broil until just done , 4-5 minutes per side
4. Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes and then cut crosswise into 1 / 4-inch slices
5. In a large pot of boiling salted water , cook the fusilli until just done
6. Drain , rinse with cold water , and drain thoroughly
7. In a large bowl , toss the pasta with 1 tbsp olive oil
8. Make sure to coat all the pasta thoroughly , so it won't stick together
9. Add the chicken , artichoke hearts , scallions , parsley , remaining 5 tbsp oil , the vinegar , remaining 1 tsp salt , 1 / 4 tsp pepper , and the parmesan to pasta and toss well
10. Serve with additional parmesan and enjoy !

title: corn pop enchiladas
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Melt butter in a bowl or glass measuring pitcher in microwave , about one minute on high
3. Add flour and stir until smooth , then gradually add cream , stirring constantly
4. Add broth and stir again
5. Put back in microwave and cook uncovered on high for six to eight minutes or until thickened , stirring often
6. In the meantime , heat olive oil in skillet and saut onion over medium heat until becoming see-through , approximately five minutes
7. Turn off heat and stir in chicken , corn and jalapeos
8. In each tortilla , place 1 / 8 of chicken filling
9. Fold ends over and roll up , placing seam side down in a 9 x 13 casserole pan
10. Pour sauce over filled tortillas and top with grated cheese
11. Bake for 30 minutes
12. Serve hot , garnished with sliced jalapeos

title: easy no chill sugar cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. In mixing bowl , cream butter with sugar until light and fluffy
3. Beat in egg and vanilla
4. Mix flour , baking powder , and salt in a separate bowl
5. Add to butter mixture 1 cup at a time , mixing after each addition
6. Do not chill dough
7. Divide dough into two balls
8. On a floured surface roll each ball into a circle approximately 12" wide and 1 / 8" thick
9. Dip cookie cutter in flour and cut out cookies
10. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet for 6 - 7 minutes or until cookies are lightly browned
11. It helps to line pans with parchment paper for easy cookie removal

title: bermuda johnny bread  caribbean
steps:
1. Mix sugar , flour , salt , and baking powder
2. Add egg and milk and mix until batter consistency
3. Melt butter in frying pan
4. Spoon a third of the batter into the pan
5. Fry on low heat until brown
6. Turn and brown the other side
7. Repeat twice with the remaining batter
8. Split bread in half and serve with plenty of butter and jam

title: delicious and healthier french fries
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Scrub potato , peel , and cut it into 1 / 4 inch pieces so it resembles shoestring french fries
3. Soak pieces in a bowl of cold water for 10 minutes
4. Dry the potatoes with paper towels
5. Coat with olive oil , then dust with wheat germ and sea salt
6. Place potatoes in a single layer on a cookie sheet and cook for 15 minutes
7. Remove from oven and reduce heat to 350
8. Flip potatoes and continue cooking for 15 minutes or until fries are golden brown and crisp

title: vanilla  cinnamon oatmeal
steps:
1. Add the cinnamon , cardamom , and ginger powder to the water to boil
2. Some people add their oatmeal to the water after it begins to boil , but i find that adding the oatmeal at the same time , before it begins to boil , actually gives the oatmeal a very smooth , rich flavor
3. Once you boil the oatmeal for about fifteen minutes and it boils down into a porridge , add a fruit of your choice
4. Great fruits to add are strawberries , blueberries , apples , or bananas while its still warm so that it cooks into the oatmeal
5. You may also add golden raisins and / or almonds
6. This adds a little crunchy texture to it
7. Other things that you can add to your oatmeal are granola and flax seeds or wheat germ
8. Again , that adds somewhat of a nutty taste to it and adds a little bit of texture

title: mel s caramel corn
steps:
1. Prepare each bag of popcorn in microwave according to package directions
2. Once popcorn is popped , mix it with nuts in a very large bowl
3. While popcorn is popping , you can put remaining ingredients in a saucepan
4. Bring to a boil over medium heat and boil for 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Pour mixture over popcorn & nuts and mix immediately and well
6. Spread on cookie sheet to dry

title: easy avocado burrito
steps:
1. Chop the tomatoes and avocados
2. Make sure there is about an equal amount of both avocado and tomato
3. Put the tomatoes and avocados in a bowl and mix in your favorite salsa
4. I like to use about 1 / 4 cup of salsa , but depends on your preference how much you add
5. Set aside
6. Heat tortilla on a pan
7. Flip and then sprinkle on some of the pepper jack cheese
8. Once the cheese has melted take off the pan and onto a plate
9. Spread a thick or thin amount of the avocado , tomato and salsa mixture
10. Roll like a burrito and enjoy !

title: no nut banana bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven for 350 degrees
2. Smash bananas in a bowl
3. Mix together butter , sugar , egg , and vanilla and then put the bananas in the mixture and stir
4. Mix flour , salt , and baking soda in a separate bowl and once both mixtures are stirred insert flour mixture into the sugar , butter , banana , egg , vanilla mixture
5. Stir thoroughly until all flour is mixed inches
6. Pour into greased bread pan
7. Bake for 1 hour

title: roasted mediterranean vegetables
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Prepare a shallow roasting dish with nonstick cooking spray
3. Combine potatoes , eggplant , both bell peppers , and the red onion slices and place in roasting dish
4. Whisk together the olive oil , balsamic vinegar , basil , oregano , chives , garlic and salt and pepper
5. Drizzle sauce over the mixed vegetables and toss to coat
6. Roast vegetables until tender , about 45 minutes
7. Stir halfway through the cooking time

title: sweet toffee pretzel mix
steps:
1. In a 9x13-inch glass dish , combine the pretzels and the nuts
2. In a large saucepan combine the butter , sugar , corn syrup and salt
3. Stir over medium heat until sugar dissolves
4. Bring to a boil and cook until thickened
5. Remove from heat and pour over your pretzel mixture and mix until everything is coated
6. Bake in a preheated 250 oven for about 20 minutes
7. Remove from oven and spread out to cool on a sheet of wax paper

title: fondants au chocolat
steps:
1. Melt the chocolate
2. Add 80 g of butter to the chocolate until it has melted and incorporated with the chocolate
3. Beat the egg yolks with 40 g of sugar until the mixture turns white
4. Beat the egg whites with a pinch of salt
5. Delicately first add the egg yolk mixture to the chocolate , then add the egg whites
6. Butter 4 small moulds and sprinkle bottom and sides with the remaining sugar
7. Put the chocolate mixture in the moulds and place in the fridge
8. Preheat the oven at 190 c
9. When oven is hot enough put the moulds in the oven for exactly 12 minutes
10. Demould the chocolate cakes and serve immediately
11. If you have beautiful moulds you could also choose to leave it in there and serve as it is
12. Enjoy !

title: sesame streusel coffee cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325-degrees f
2. Grease and flour 9 x 5-inch loaf pan
3. Cream 1 / 2 cup butter or margine , tahini and sesame oil in large bowl together
4. Beat in sugar and eggs
5. Blend in vanilla
6. Sift flour , baking powder and salt together in small bowl
7. Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with milk to creamed mixture , stirring until blended
8. Fold in 3 t toasted sesame seeds
9. In seperate bowl make streusel topping
10. Blend brown sugar , flour , butter , tahini and cinnamon in small bowl until mixture is crumbly
11. Turn batter into prepared pan
12. Sprinkle with streusel topping
13. Top with 2 tsp sesame seeds
14. Bake 75-90 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean

title: oven baked salmon soup
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Combine clam juice , soy sauce , garlic , ginger and coriander in a medium saucepan
3. Bring to a boil
4. Simmer for 5 minutes
5. Cover and keep warm
6. Scatter coleslaw mix over bottom of a 12x9 inch baking dish
7. Neatly arrange salmon fillets skin side down over vegetables
8. Pour the broth over salmon
9. Loosely cover baking dish with alumnium foil , and bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until salmon is just cooked through and flakes easily
10. Using a metal spatula , transfer each salmon fillet into a shallow soup bowl
11. Circle each serving with a portion of vegetables , and top with broth
12. Garnish with cilantro , scallions and sesame oil

title: grilled poblanos
steps:
1. Heat grill on low , about 250 degrees
2. Halve peppers and clean out seeds
3. Peppers should lay flat and wide
4. Cut 6 portions of foil , one for each pepper
5. Foil should be big enough to fold up edges around pepper , forming a "bowl" so juices and cheese don't drip
6. Drizzle 1 tbsp of olive oil onto each piece of foil
7. Divide cream cheese into 6 equal parts
8. Spread each pepper with one part of cream cheese
9. Place pepper on foil
10. Sprinkle 1 / 3 cup of mozzarella cheese , 1 teaspoons ground cumin , 1 / 2 tsp cayenne pepper on to each pepper
11. Fold and scrunch up sides of foil around pepper , forming a bowl
12. Place on grill
13. Peppers should cook for about 20 minutes or until cheese is melted and browned on top

title: chocolate cardamom brownies with chocolate pistachio icing
steps:
1. Preheat over to 350f
2. Grease two 8x8 glass pans or one larger pan
3. In a large bowl , combine the butter and cocoa powder
4. Add sugar , mix well
5. Add eggs and stir until well combined
6. Add vanilla , cardamom , and salt , stir well
7. Add in flour , but do not overmix
8. Spoon mixture into pan and bake for approximately 25 minutes , until toothpick inserted into middle comes out clean
9. Set brownies on rack to dry
10. Once brownies are out of the oven , to make the ganache icing , using a double boiler , combine the chocolate , cream , and butter
11. Keep stirring until combined
12. Remove mixture from heat
13. Stir occasionally until cool
14. Spread over brownies
15. Top with chopped pistachios

title: asparagus fries with smoky chipotle mayonnaise dipping sauce
steps:
1. Blanch asparagus in boiling water about 2 minutes
2. Immediately drain and put asparagus in ice water to stop cooking
3. This will help keep a slight crunch to the asparagus and keep it bright
4. Dry asparagus thoroughly with paper towels
5. Use a little of the reduced fat mayonnaise to coat each asparagus spear , then roll in panko breadcrumbs
6. You can refrigerate at this point if needed
7. Mix mayonnaise and chipotle together with a whisk or in blender
8. Use 1-2 depending on how spicy you like it
9. Heat about 1 inch of oil heat to 370 f in a frying pan , put in asparagus but don't crowd
10. Turn to brown on all sides
11. Drop some dip into the bottom of a champagne flute , add 3-5 asparagus and serve

title: margaret houston s white cake
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar , beating until smooth
2. Combine flour , baking powder and salt
3. Combine milk and water
4. Add flour mixture to creamed mixture , alternately with milk mixture , beginning and ending with flour mixture
5. Mix well after each addition
6. Stir in flavoring
7. Beat egg whites until soft peaks form and then fold into the batter
8. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9 inch round cake pans
9. Bake at 350 for 25 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted into the center comes out clean
10. Cool in pans 10 minutes before removing the layers to cool completely

title: blueberry raspberry pie
steps:
1. Line a 9-in
2. Pie plate with bottom pastry
3. Trim pastry even with edge of plate
4. Beat the egg white and 1 tablespoon water
5. Brush over crust
6. Set aside
7. In a bowl , combine 1 cup sugar , cornstarch , lemon peel , vanilla and cinnamon
8. Gently stir in the berries
9. Pour into the crust
10. Roll out the remaining pastry to fit top of pie
11. Place over the filling
12. Trim , seal and flute edges
13. Cut slits in top
14. Brush with remaining egg / water mixture
15. Sprinkle with remaining sugar
16. Bake at 400 for 40-50 minutes or until crust is golden brown and filling is bubbly
17. Cool on a wire rack
18. Store in the refrigerator

title: redfish with shrimp topping and mexican blend cheese over rice
steps:
1. Directions for the "shrimp topping for fish"
2. Heat olive oil in a saut pan over medium heat
3. When the oil is just hot enough add the onions and saut until translucent , about 10-15 minutes
4. Stir occasionally to prevent scorching
5. Add the garlic and saut another 1-2 minutes
6. Add tomatoes , cilantro , key lime juice , and poblano pepper
7. Heat over medium heat until bubbly , reduce to simmer
8. If you prefer to have less liquid then reduce without a lid
9. Sauce can simmer up to 20 minutes with lid on while preparing fish fillets
10. When the fish is just about ready add shrimp and leave in just long enough to cook through
11. Leave on low with lid on if necessary
12. Directions for the 'pan fried redfish"'
13. Season the fish with lemon pepper and magic seasoning
14. Put just enough olive oil in pan to coat the bottom of the saut pan
15. Heat the oil
16. Lightly dust the fish with the flour
17. Fry the fillets until done
18. Put on serving platter until served
19. To serve: this dish is best served over rice
20. The long cooking type of brown rice is best
21. Put rice on plate , top rice with fish fillets , and cover fish with the shrimp topping
22. Sprinkle mexican blend cheese on top
23. The heat from the shrimp topping should melt the cheese , but if not just put in microwave briefly
24. Top with cilantro
25. Serve
26. Excellent served with peach or blueberry margaritas

title: grilled rum peaches with mascarpone cheese   orange blossom
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients for the rum marinade in a stove-top pan on medium high heat
2. Reduce heat and let simmer for 7-8 minutes , stirring occasionally
3. Remove from heat and let cool
4. Prepare peaches by cutting them in half and removing the pits
5. Place the peaches in a glass dish top with rum marinade
6. Marinate for 30 minutes to 4 hours
7. Grill , cut side down for 3-4 minutes , then flip for another 5 minutes
8. Remove from grill and top with mascarpone cheese and drizzle with honey ! viola !

title: italian fresh fruit tart
steps:
1. Mix flour , sugar , butter lemon peel , lemon juice , vanilla and eggs in a medium bowl with spoon until dough forms
2. Place dough on lightly floured surface
3. Knead about 3 minutes or until dough holds together and is pliable
4. Shape dough into a ball
5. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate about 20 minutes or until firm
6. Preheat oven to 350f
7. Grease pan with butter
8. Lightly flour 11-inch round tart pan with removable bottom or 12-inch pizza pan
9. Pat dough evenly in pan
10. Bake about 35 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
11. Cool completely on wire rack , about 30 minutes
12. Heat apricot and raspberry preserves in 1-quart saucepan over low heat , stirring frequently until melted
13. Stir in amaretto
14. Spread over crust
15. Arrange fresh fruit on top
16. Drizzle with honey
17. Sprinkle with powdered sugar
18. Serve immediately , or cover and refrigerate

title: fresh peach cobbler w  blueberry muffin crust
steps:
1. Peach mixture:
2. Mix together peaches , sugar and flour
3. Melt butter in skillet over medium heat , add peach mixture , bring to boil , stirring often , for 5 minutes
4. Spoon into greased 13 x 9 baking dish
5. Set aside
6. Blueberry muffin batter:
7. Mix together flour , sugar , baking powder and salt
8. Set aside
9. In seperate bowl combine milk , vegetable oil and egg
10. Add to dry ingredients and stir just until moistened
11. Gently fold in blueberriess
12. Spread over peach mixture
13. Bake at 400 for 25-30 minutes or until crust is golden brown

title: chicken with white wine   fresh herb sauce
steps:
1. Season chicken with pepper and salt
2. In skillet , heat oil over medium-high heat
3. Brown chicken all over
4. About 8 minutes
5. Drain fat from pan
6. Add wine
7. Cover
8. And simmer over medium heat for about 8 minutes or until juices run clear when chicken is pierced
9. Transfer chicken to serving plate
10. Cover and keep warm
11. Add minced garlic to pan
12. Bring to boil and boil until liquid is reduced to 1 / 4 cup
13. Reduce heat to medium-low
14. Whisk in butter , piece by piece
15. Stir in herbs of choice
16. Pour over chicken

title: prize winning zucchini relish
steps:
1. In a large container , combine zucchini , onion , pepper , chilies and salt
2. Stir well
3. Chill overnight
4. Rinse thoroughly
5. Drain
6. In a large kettle , combine remaining ingredients
7. Bring to a boil
8. Add zucchini mixture
9. Simmer for 10 minutes
10. Ladle hot into hot jars , leaving 1 / 4-inch headspace
11. Adjust lids
12. Process for 10 minutes in a boiling-water bath
13. Serving suggestion: mix into tuna or macaroni salad

title: layered mint chocolate brownies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking pan
3. Combine all brownie ingredients in large bowl and beat until smooth
4. Pour batter into prepared pan
5. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until top springs back when lightly touched in center
6. Cool completely on wire rack
7. Prepare mint cream: combine all mint cream ingredients in a large bowl and beat until smooth
8. Spread evenly over brownies
9. Cover and refrigerate
10. Prepare chocolate glaze: melt butter and chocolate syrup in a large saucepan over very low heat
11. Remove from heat and stir until smooth
12. Cool slightly and then pour glaze over chilled brownies
13. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour before slicing and serving
14. Store leftovers covered in refrigerator

title: traditional german christmas fruit bread   kletzenbrot
steps:
1. Place the dried pears , figs , prunes , raisins or sultanas , candied orange and lemon peel , and the spices into a medium saucepan with a cup of water , the sugar , and the kirsch or rum
2. Bring just to a boil over high heat , stirring often
3. Immediately remove from heat and cover
4. Set aside to steep
5. Meanwhile , in a large mixing bowl dissolve the yeast in a half cup of the lukewarm steeping liquid , and let sit until bubbling
6. Gradually stir the flour into the yeast mixture , adding a little more liquid or flour if necessary to make a firm dough
7. Wrap the dough with a clean tea towel , and leave to rise for 30 minutes
8. Gradually add the nuts , candied orange and lemon peel , and the dried fruit and knead well into the dough
9. Form the dough into a loaf
10. Leave to rise for an hour again
11. Preheat the oven to 400f
12. Butter the baking sheet , and bake the loaf for about an hour
13. Let cool for 5-10 minutes before removing bread to rack
14. Allow to cool completely
15. Wrap bread in cling wrap and then in foil , and place in a cool spot or the refrigerator to mellow for up to several weeks
16. Allow bread to come to room temperature before serving
17. Serve sliced with or without fresh butter , as desired
18. Good with a cuppa
19. Frohes fest !

title: spicy chicken with carrot and herb salad
steps:
1. Cook the rice in a small saucepan of boiling water following packet directions and set aside for 15 minutes to cool
2. Preheat a barbecue grill to medium high
3. Put the ground coriander , cinnamon , turmeric and cumin in a medium shallow dish and add the chicken and turn to coat
4. Spray each side of chicken fillets with cooking spray and put on the barbecue grill and reduce the heat to medium and cook on each side for 5 to 6 minutes or until cooked through and transfer to a plate and cover loosely with foil and set aside for 2 to 3 minutes to rest
5. Carrot and herb salad - put the cooled rice , carrot , coriander , mint , beans and spring onion in a medium bowl
6. Add the orange juice and season with pepper and toss to combine
7. Slice the chicken and divide between plates and top with the yoghurt and serve with the salad , spinach and lemon wedges

title: lemon dijon cream sauce
steps:
1. Melt the butter over low heat , and add the dijon and lemon juice , mixing well
2. When slightly heated , stir in the cream , 1 / 4 cup at a time until it is the consistency you like
3. Serve over vegetables

title: easy stuffed pepper recipe
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Brown hamburger , and drain
3. Mix everything together except cheese in a greased casserole dish
4. Top with cheese
5. , cover with foil
6. Bake 30 minutes , remove foil bake additional 15 minutes to brown cheese

title: nayarit crab stuffed chiles
steps:
1. Stuffed chiles:
2. Make slit in 1 side of each roasted chili
3. Carefully devein & de-seed without tearing chiles
4. Soak chiles in a bowl of water with few drops vinegar and set aside
5. Heat butter and 1 1 / 2 teaspoons olive oil in saucepan
6. Add onion and cook until tender
7. Add crab meat and a tablespoon of the chives and cook 1 minute
8. Heat remaining 1 1 / 2 teaspoons olive oil in skillet
9. Add mango and saute until softened , about 2 - 3 minutes
10. Add crab mixture and stir to combine
11. Season with salt and pepper
12. Let cool
13. Drain chiles and stuff each one with about 1 / 4 cup of the filling
14. Vinaigrette:
15. Puree mangos in a food processor or blender
16. Place in saucepan and cook over low heat , stirring , until thickened , 5 - 7 minutes
17. Remove from heat and let cool
18. Blend puree , vinegar , stock , mango nectar , garlic and salt and pepper to taste in food processor or blender until smooth
19. Gradually add olive oil , blending until emulsified
20. Check seasoning and add sugar if needed
21. Chill
22. Place large spoonful of vinaigrette on 6 chilled salad plates
23. Top with stuffed chile
24. Bathe chiles with additional vinaigrette
25. Sprinkle remaining 1 tablespoon chopped chives over all and garnish with thyme sprig
26. Dust with freshly ground pepper

title: chocolate muddies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Line cookie sheet with foil or parchment paper
3. In a large bowl , beat cream cheese and margarine or butter with and electric mixer until fluffy , about 2 minutes
4. Add sugars , extracts , eggs , and ice cream topping
5. Beat about 3 minutes , or until fluffy
6. Mix flour , cocoa , baking soda , and salt in a separate bowl
7. Stir flour mixture into margarine mixture until evenly mixed
8. Stir in chips
9. Drop dough by heaping teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto cookie sheet
10. Bake 13-15 minutes , or until edges are set
11. Cool for 5 minutes , then remove to wire rack to fully cool

title: provoleta
steps:
1. Slice the cheese in 1 / 2 inch thick rounds
2. Mix together the oil , oregano , and aji to form a paste
3. Spread the paste over the cheese slices
4. There is a certain amount of technique to successfully grilling cheese
5. An essential is that the grill must be very hot
6. To cook directly on the grill , first set the prepared cheese slices out at room temperature for a couple of hours
7. As the surface dries out , a hard film starts to form
8. This is what will keep you from ending up with a gooey puddle in the bottom of your grill
9. If you don't quite feel up to cooking the cheese directly on the grill , you can use a pie plate or aluminum foil
10. Cook about three minutes on each side
11. Serve hot

title: rose s crunch dip
steps: 1. Mix all of the ingredients together and enjoy !

title: warm berry topping for ice cream
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Lightly grease a 8x8 baking dish
3. Add sliced strawberries and pecan halves
4. In a medium sauce pan , simmer raspberry preserves , honey , key lime juice , and 1 / 2 cup sugar for 5 minutes over medium heat
5. Pour raspberry preserve mixture over strawberries and pecans
6. Mix until evenly blended
7. In a separe bowl mix together butter , oatmeal , and brown sugar
8. Spread evenly over strawberry mixture
9. Bake for 45 minutes

title: rachael ray s antipasto pizza
steps:
1. Heat the oven to 425 degrees f
2. Press dough onto baking sheet and top with garlic , cheeses , and pepper flakes and freshly ground black pepper , to taste , and bake 15 to 18 minutes
3. Top the cooked pizza with lettuce , salami , roasted peppers , hot peppers , artichokes or mushrooms and olives , cut into squares and serve

title: lime and parsley fish with smashed potato
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 210c
2. Line a roasting pan with baking paper
3. Put the potato in a shallow microwave-safe dish and add 80ml water and cover and microwave on high for 4-5 minutes or until the potato is just tender
4. Drain well and pat dry with paper towel
5. Arrange , in a single layer in the roasting pan and slightly squash potato with the back of a spoon and then spray with cooking spray and bake for 10 minutes
6. Meanwhile , line a small ovenproof dish with baking paper and put the fish in the dish and sprinkle with the lime zest , capers and garlic and then drizzle the oil over
7. Add fish to the oven with potatoes and cook for a further 10-12 minutes or until the fish is cooked through and the potato is browned and crispy
8. Divide the fish between plates , then top with the shallot and parsley and sprinkle with pepper to serve
9. Accompany fish with the lime wedges , potato , green beans and carrots

title: muesli with pears and walnuts
steps:
1. In a big bowl combine grated pears , oats , mixed seeds , 1 tbs of the walnuts , syrup / honey , apple juice and milk / water
2. Cover and refrigerate over night
3. The next morning divide between two bowls and add 1 tbs of yogurt to each bowl , then top with reamining walnuts
4. Serve and enjoy !

title: littlemafia s apple cider
steps: 1. Mix together and boil for 10 minutes , then remove cinnamon sticks and cloves

title: caribbean connection
steps: 1. Blend at high speed until smooth

title: orange pineapple couscous
steps:
1. Add enough orange juice to the mandarin orange juice to make 2 1 / 4 cups liquid
2. Bring the juices and cumin to a boil in a saucepan
3. Remove from heat and add couscous
4. Cover and let stand 5 minutes
5. Pour into a large bowl and let cool
6. Combine oil , soy sauce and lime juice
7. Stir into couscous mixture
8. Stir in mandarin oranges , cilantro , basil , green onions , ginger and pineapple
9. Sprinkle with pine nuts

title: amarula swizzler
steps:
1. To a blender , add amarula cream liquor , rum , ice , vanilla ice cream and milk
2. Blend until slushy
3. Using a squeeze bottle , decorate the inside of a highball glass with butterscotch syrup
4. Pour contents from blender into highball glass , swirl on top with butterscotch syrup

title: ginger garlic paste
steps:
1. In a food processor , combine the garlic , ginger , salt and optional pinch turmeric
2. Pulse to blend , adding small amounts of olive oil to facilitate the blending , until it makes a smooth paste
3. Refrigerate or freeze

title: multiple orgasm
steps:
1. Fill glass half full of ice
2. Add all the rest of the ingredients filling the glass with milk
3. Add more alcohol for desired strength
4. I like mine strong !
5. Enjoy !

title: pasta w  pesto shrimp
steps:
1. Season shrimp with salt / pepper / garlic salt and set aside
2. Bring a large stock pot to a boil
3. Salt generously
4. Add pasta and cook for 6-8 minutes
5. Drain and rinse with warm water
6. Set aside
7. Heat a large non-stick skillet to med-high heat with 1 tbsp of oil
8. Add shrimp in a single layer and sear for 2-3 minutes on each side until shrimp turn a light pink and curl slightly
9. Remove from pan
10. To hot pan add remaining olive oil
11. Once oil is hot , add onions
12. Saute until tender
13. Add white wine and lemon juice , scraping the bottom of pan with back of spoon
14. Add pesto and stir until smooth
15. Replace shrimp and pasta to pan and heat through
16. Remove from heat and add tomatoes and fresh spinach tossing lightly until everything is coated with the sauce
17. Serve with some crusty garlic toast and enjoy !

title: salsa wraps    sandwich or appetizer
steps:
1. Combine cream cheese , sour cream , dressing mix , salsa and cheddar cheese in a medium sized bowl
2. Spread even amounts of this mixture onto tortillas , and top with a slice of ham
3. Roll tortillas and chill until serving time
4. If desired , cut into 1" slices before serving
5. If serving whole , a toothpick may be needed to keep the wrap together

title: brussels sprouts with sesame seeds
steps:
