1. Toast sesame seeds in large non-stick skillet and set aside
2. In a large non-stick skillet over medium heat , warm olive oil
3. Add garlic and brussels sprouts
4. Saute for 15 - 20 minutes , allowing to caramelize as that gives them a lot of flavor
5. When sprouts are brown and tender toss with sherry , sesame oil , and sesame seeds
6. Remove from heat and serve

title: california snowballs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cream butter and 3 tbsp powdered sugar
3. Add vanilla
4. Mix in flour and nuts
5. Roll into tiny balls
6. Bake for 20 minutes
7. Roll in powdered sugar while hot
8. Allow cookies to cool and roll in powdered sugar again
9. Pop one in your mouth and enjoy

title: whole grilled onions  a bacon topping  and a herb vinaigrette
steps:
1. Vinaigrette -- mix all the ingredients in a small baggie , bowl or tupperware container
2. Refrigerate until ready to serve
3. You need to heat slightly before serving
4. Just 10 or 20 seconds on medium in the microwave - just to warm it up
5. Onion -- cut the top off , just a small slice so you can peel easily
6. You can cut a small bit off the bottom if it doesn't set well
7. Peel the sides and it is ready
8. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper
9. Top with 4 half slices or 2 full slices of bacon and wrap well in foil , keeping the top with bacon standing up
10. Bake or grill -- a 400 degree oven takes around 40-50 minutes and the grill about 30-40 minutes
11. This really is dependent upon the heat of your grill or oven and the size of your onions
12. Make sure to close the foil pouch on the top so after 30 minutes or so , you can easily pull it open a bit and test to see if the onion is done
13. I just stick a knife in the onion and it should be tender
14. Serve -- remove from the foil , and i also remove the bacon -- it is more for the flavor , not presentation , and it has done it's job
15. As i said , i like using a small to medium onion , so everyone gets one , but the large onions are wonderful and can be sliced in half
16. Heat up the vinaigrette in the microwave for just a few seconds to warm up and drizzle over the onion
17. Enjoy !
18. Keep the leftover vinaigrette
19. Great over potatoes , any meat , even vegetables , or seafood

title: mexican bolillos  crusty oval rolls
steps:
1. Sprinkle yeast over the warm water in a large mixing bowl
2. Stir and let stand 5 minutes
3. When the yeast is working a bit stir the honey , lard and salt into the yeast mixture
4. Add 2 1 / 2 cups flour
5. Mix at low speed and then beat at medium speed until the dough is very elastic , about 5 minutes
6. Gradually stir in as much of the remaining flour as needed to make a soft dough
7. Knead on floured surface until dough is smooth in texture and very elastic , 15-20 minutes
8. Place dough in a greased bowl , turn the dough so all surfaces have a sheen of oil
9. Cover and let rise in a warm place until it has doubled in size , about 1 hour
10. Punch the dough down and knead briefly on a floured surface
11. Divide dough into 10 pieces and roll into balls
12. Work with the palms of your hands and start at the center of each ball to roll out into ovals
13. Each piece should be about 5 1 / 2" long and 2" in the middle , tapering to each end
14. Place rolls on a greased baking sheet , cover and let rise until almost doubled , about 25 minutes
15. Meanwhile heat oven to 375f degrees
16. Mix cornstarch and cold water , heat stirring constantly to boiling , boil until thickened and clear about 2 minutes
17. Brush each roll with the cornstarch mixture
18. Slash each roll down the middle stopping about 1 / 2" from each end and cutting about 1 / 2" deep
19. Bake until the rolls are brown and sound hollow when tapped , about 30-35 minutes
20. Remove from baking sheets and cool on racks
21. Serve warm & fresh from the oven

title: best healthy banana bread
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingredients in large bowl
2. Beat with mixer at medium speed until smooth
3. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup and level with knife
4. Add rest of dry ingredients to flour and stir with a whisk to combine
5. Add the dry mixture to banana mixture , stirring only until just moistened
6. Spoon batter into 8x4 inch loaf pan that has been coated on bottom and 1 / 2 inch up sides with cooking spray
7. Bake at 350 degrees f for 40 minutes or until toothpick in center comes out clean
8. Cool 10 minutes in pan on a wirerack
9. Then remove bread from pan and cool completely on rack

title: mexican chocolate tofu pudding
steps:
1. In a small pot , combine sugar and water
2. Bring to a boil and cook until sugar is dissolved
3. Let cool for a few minutes
4. In a blender , combine syrup , tofu , melted chocolate , vanilla , cinnamon and chili powder
5. Puree until completely smooth
6. Divide into 4-6 serving bowls and refrigerate at least 30 minutes
7. Garnish with chocolate shavings if desired

title: bar t 5 baked beans
steps:
1. Dice onions and saute
2. Cook bacon and crumble
3. Drain all grease
4. Add diced peppers and the rest of the ingredients
5. Simmer low until done

title: kathy s beef tips with mushrooms
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 275f
2. In a large saute pan or skillet melt butter and heat oil
3. Sear the meat with the garlic
4. Remove meat to a casserole and cover
5. To the same skillet , add the wine and saute' the mushrooms and onion for 1 minute , then add to the meat
6. Cover and bake for 1 hour or until the meat is tender
7. Meanwhile , add the broth , soy sauce , and worcestershire to the pan in which the meat was seared
8. Bring to a boil and de-glaze the pan
9. Blend together the mustard , cornstarch and cream then add to the pan
10. Simmer until reduced and thickened
11. When beef is done , pour off the juices into the sauce and boil , whisking until smooth
12. Add meat and stir to coat
13. To serve , plate up either buttered egg noodles or rice and pour beef
14. Sprinkle with parsley if desired

title: creamy horseradish potato salad
steps:
1. Whisk together mayonnaise , sour cream , horseradish , vinegar , sugar , salt , and pepper in a large bowl until smooth
2. Add chives and potatoes and stir to coat
3. Refrigerate until ready to serve
4. Cook time does not include boiling the potatoes or cooling them to room temperature

title: chicken broccoli rice and cheese casserole
steps:
1. Drain 2 cans of chicken breast meat
2. Boil broccoli till tender
3. Drain
4. Boil rice
5. Melt margarine in large frying pan
6. Saute onions till glassy
7. Add both soups and stir well
8. Add cheese and mix till melted
9. Remove from heat
10. Lightly grease a 13 x 9 glass dish
11. Spread rice evenly over bottom of dish
12. Spread broccoli over rice layer
13. Pour 1 / 3 of cheese sauce over the broccoli and rice and spread evenly
14. Spread chicken on top of cheese sauce and top with remaining sauce
15. If desired , sprinkle more shredded cheese on top
16. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes

title: simple baked french toast
steps:
1. Butter a 13-by-9-inch glass baking dish
2. Cut twelve 1-inch-thick diagonal slices from bread
3. Generously butter one side of each slice and arrange slices buttered sides up in one layer in buttered dish , squeezing them slightly to fit if necessary
4. Whisk together eggs , milk , and salt in a bowl until well combined , then pour evenly over bread
5. Refrigerate , covered , until bread has absorbed all of custard , at least 1 hour
6. Put a rack in middle of oven and preheat oven to 425f
7. Bring soaked bread to room temperature
8. Sprinkle bread with sugar
9. Bake until bread is puffed and top is golden , 20 to 25 minutes
10. Serve immediately , with maple syrup
11. Cook's
12. The soaked bread can be refrigerated for up to 24 hours
13. Cook time does not include refrigeration or bringing the bread back to room temperature before cooking

title: tipsy raisin pecan pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Toss together raisins , pecans and flour in a medium size bowl until raisins and pecans are well coated with flour
3. Beat together butter and brown sugar in a large bowl until well blended
4. Add divided egg yolks , one at a time , beating well after each addition
5. Add 2 tablespoons whiskey , vinegar , cinnamon , nutmeg and allspice
6. Blend well
7. Stir in raisin & nut mixture and set aside
8. Beat egg whites and salt in a medium size bowl with an electric mixer at high speed until soft peaks form
9. Fold whites into raisin & nut mixture
10. Pour into pie crust
11. Bake for 35 minutes or until slightly puffed and set
12. Serve warm or at room temperature with spiked whipped cream , if desired
13. To make spiked whipped cream: beat together one cup heavy cream , 2 tablespoons sugar and 2 teaspoons whiskey in a medium size bowl until soft peaks form

title: chinese pork soup
steps:
1. Rub five spice powder on pork and salt liberally
2. Fry the pork and ginger in a wok with a little oil till cooked through
3. Transfer pork onto a cutting board and slice into thin strips
4. Add 6 cups of water to the wok and bring to a boil
5. The wok does not need to be rinsed out unless you used too much oil
6. Add granuled chicken flavoring , mushrooms and carrots
7. Boil till the vegetables are cooked
8. Turn heat off
9. Add pork strips and sesame oil to taste
10. Lime juice can be added , too , if you want the soup to be a little sour
11. Serve into individual bowls with cilantro

title: mint chocolate chip breakfast cookies
steps:
1. Preaheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Place all dry ingredients in a large bowl
3. Place wet ingredients in plastic cup , whip with immersion blender until fluffy
4. Add egg mixture to dry ingrendients and mix well
5. Spray hands before forming each cookie
6. Place on cookie sheet , leave room between each cookie
7. Bake 7-8 minutes for soft cookies , 10 for chewy
8. Remove from pan and let cool on cookie rack
9. Place in tupperware with wax paper between each cookie

title: grandma linda s thanksgiving dressing
steps:
1. Albers corn muffin mix directions
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
3. Lightly beat eggs in a large mixing bowl
4. Melt 12 tbs butter , add
5. Add remainder of wet ingredients , mix well
6. In a separate large mixing bowl add dry ingredients
7. Add wet mixture to dry mixture , stir just until blended
8. Pour into two greased 9x13 baking pans
9. Bake 35 minutes or until golden brown and a toothpick inserted into the middle comes out clean
10. Place on metal cooling racks , let cool
11. Cut cornbread into 2 inch cubes , add to a large tin foil roasting pan , set aside
12. Broth directions
13. In a large pot , add bullion cubes to 8 cups water , boil
14. Add salt , garlic powder , garlic salt and pepper
15. Add more if desired
16. Stir occasionally until bullion is dissolved , set aside
17. Dressing mixture directions
18. Fry bacon in a skillet , crumble into bite-sized pieces , add to roasting pan
19. Finely chop celery , bell pepper , garlic , onion , mushroom , then using saved bacon grease , fry in a skillet , add to roasting pan
20. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
21. Add corn to roasting pan
22. Pour chicken broth into roasting pan
23. Melt 1 / 2 lb butter , pour into roasting pan
24. Mix all ingredients well
25. Cover with foil , bake in roasting pan for 45 minutes or until dressing turns golden brown on top
26. Cook longer if desired

title: paula deen s baked beef enchilada casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Lightly grease a 13x9x2-inch baking dish
3. In large skillet , melt butter over medium heat
4. Cook onion and garlic about 5 minutes , or until tender
5. Add ground beef , chili powder , salt and red pepper
6. Cook until beef is brown and crumbly
7. Drain
8. Stir in soup and green chiles
9. Set aside
10. Line prepared baking dish with 6 corn tortillas
11. In a medium bowl , whisk together one can of enchilada sauce and refried beans
12. Spread bean mixture onto tortillas
13. Evenly sprinkle with 1 cup cheese
14. Layer 6 more tortillas
15. Cover with meat mixture
16. Evenly sprinkle with 1 cup cheese
17. Layer remaining 6 tortillas
18. Evenly spoon remaining can of enchilada sauce onto tortillas
19. Sprinkle with remaining 2 cups cheese
20. Bake for 25 minutes or until hot and bubbly
21. Garnish with sliced black olives and bell pepper curls , if desired

title: tomato rice salad with avocado and corn
steps:
1. Combine the tomato , corn , and rice
2. In a second bowl , toss the avocado in one tsp lemon juice , and then add to the other ingredients
3. In a third bowl , combine the 2 tablespoons lemon juice , salt , garlic , ginger , and cilantro
4. Slowly whisk in the oil
5. Pour the dressing over the vegetables and rice , and toss gently

title: root beer ham
steps:
1. Put the ham in a 6 quart slow cooker
2. Pour the root beer over the ham until covered
3. Cover and cook on low for 3-4 hours

title: amazing low carb waffles
steps:
1. Take the cream cheese and add the sweetener to your liking
2. I used about 2 tablespoons
3. The sweeter you make the cheese , the sweeter your waffle will be
4. Mix in the melted butter and whisk until smooth
5. Add the eggs and mix well
6. Then you add both flours and the baking powder with the salt
7. Grease your waffle iron with some left-over melted butter but not too much
8. Then bake your waffles
9. Spread out the batter to make sure the entire area is covered
10. The waffles need to bake longer than regular waffles do so have patience and check once in a while to see if they are done
11. I have quite a bad waffle iron so mine didn't cook regularly on both sides , but they are still so yummy ! also be careful when you take them out
12. The waffles are very fragile when hot
13. Especially when they are under-cooked
14. Transfer the waffles to a plate and let cool

title: crab salad with orange vinaigrette
steps:
1. Vinaigrette:
2. Place a medium sauce pot over medium-high heat
3. Add the orange uice and reduce by half
4. Remove from heat and place in refrigerator to cool
5. Once the orange juice reduction is cool , place in a medium mixing bowl with champagne vinegar , olive oil , basil , thyme , and garlic
6. Whisk together and season to taste with salt and pepper
7. Set aside
8. Salad:
9. In a medium mixing bowl combine the spinach , toasted walnuts and red onion
10. Place the crab meat in the center of the spinach salad
11. Drizzle the vinaigrette around and lightly over the salad and serve

title: roasted bone marrow
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Put bones , cut side up , on foil-lined baking sheet or in ovenproof skillet
3. Cook until marrow is soft and has begun to separate from the bone , about 15 minutes
4. Meanwhile , combine parsley , shallots and capers in small bowl
5. Just before bones are ready , whisk together olive oil and lemon juice and drizzle dressing over parsley mixture until leaves are just coated
6. Put roasted bones , parsley salad , salt and toast on a large plate
7. To serve , scoop out marrow , spread on toast , sprinkle with a tiny bit of salt and top with parsley salad

title: cranberry spritzer
steps:
1. Refrigerate the cranberry juice , lemon juice and carbonated water until cold
2. In a large pitcher , mix together the cranberry juice , lemon juice , carbonated water , sugar and sherbet
3. Pour into tall chilled glasses and garnish with a lemon or lime wedge
4. Serve immediately

title: fondant for sculpting or making decorations for cakes
steps:
1. Sprinkle the gelatin over water in a small heatproof glass cup and allow to sit for 5 minutes
2. Set in a small pan of simmering water and stir until the gelatin is dissolved
3. Remove from heat
4. Combine the sugar , cornstarch and optional cream or tartar in a large bowl and make a well in the center
5. Add the gelatin mixture and stir with a wooden spoon until blended
6. Mix with lightly greased hands and knead vigorously in the bowl until the sugar is incorporated
7. Turn onto a smooth , lightly greased surface such as formica or marble and knead until smooth and satiny
8. If the pastillage seems very dry , add several drops of water and knead well
9. If it seems too sticky , knead in more powdered sugar
10. The pastillage will resemble a smooth , well-shaped stone
11. When dropped , it should not spread
12. Pastillage is easier to work with if it has rested for at least 1 hour
13. It dries very quickly , so it is important to cover to prevent drying
14. Wrap in a cloth rubbed with a bit of white shortening , then tightly in plastic wrap , and place it in an airtight container
15. When ready to roll out , spray the work surface and rolling pin with nonstick vegetable oil spray
16. Pastillage can be rolled as thin as 1 / 16-inch
17. It dries and holds it shape very quickly
18. If stored pastillage seems very stiff , a few seconds in the microwave make it pliable
19. To give it the look of real marble , dab it with a bit of coffee concentrate or brown food color and knead only until the color streaks

title: greek stuffed peppers
steps:
1. Prepare 12 peppers by carefully cutting out the tops and removing the seeds
2. You will use the tops to cover the peppers before they are baked
3. In a large bowl prepare the stuffing
4. Finely chop the onions and 1 bell pepper in a food processor
5. Add the rice , water , herbs , tomato paste , 1 / 2 cup of olive oil and salt and pepper to taste
6. If using pine nuts add them now
7. The mixture should be "liquidy" , like a gazpacho soup
8. Stuff the peppers about 3 / 4 full
9. If any stuffing is left over just go back and evenly distribute ! cover the peppers with their tops
10. Add the other 1 / 2 cup of olive oil to the top of the peppers
11. Bake at 425 for 30 minutes
12. Lower to 350 and cook for 1 more hour

title: greek travelling pie
steps:
1. Mix the sugar , butter , eggs and flour together in a bowl until well mixed
2. Shape the dough into about 15 mini balls , flatten them and place them on a cooking sheet
3. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
4. Place the tray in the oven and let them cook from 30-45 minutes or until brown

title: green tomato relish  hot dog relish
steps:
1. Combine tomatoes , onion , and pepper in large bowl
2. Sprinkle salt over vegetables , mix in , and let stand 1 hour
3. Drain vegetables
4. Combine drained vegetables , sugar , mustard , and celery salt in a large pot
5. Tie cloves in cheesecloth and add to mixture
6. Stir in vinegar and simmer for 20 minutes
7. Take out spice bag
8. Pack hot relish into hot jars
9. Leave 1 / 4 inch headspace
10. Place canning lids on jars
11. Process half pints for 10 minutes in hot water bath

title: penne with rustic lentil sauce
steps:
1. Boil the chicken stock in a large saucepan for 10 minutes , or until it has reduced to 2 cups of liquid
2. Meanwhile , cook the pasta in a large saucepan of rapidly boiling water until al dente
3. Drain and toss with 2 tablespoons of olive oil
4. Heat the remaining oil in a large deep frying pan , add the carrot , onion and celery and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes , or until lightly browned
5. Add two thirds of the crushed garlic and the thyme and cook for a further minute
6. Add the stock , and bring to boil and cook gently for 8 minutes , or until reduced slightly and the vegetables are tender
7. Gently add the lentils and stir until heated through
8. Stir in the remaining garlic and a little extra thyme , and season with plenty of cracked black pepper and sea salt
9. The stock should be slightly syrupy at this point
10. Combine the pasta with the lentil sauce in a large bowl , drizzle generously with olive oil and serve with grated parmesan if liked

title: grilled swordfish  green beans and spicy tomato salsa
steps:
1. Make the salad dressing by whisking the olive oil into the lemon juice , then adding the salt and pepper
2. Set aside
3. Make the salsa by mixing all ingredients together , season to taste
4. Set aside
5. Rub the swordfish steaks with some olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper
6. Put the swordfish on a pre-heated grill , medium flame , and cook for 2-4 minutes on each side
7. Remove from heat
8. Lightly dress the beans and salad greens with the olive oil and lemon juice dressing
9. Place the swordfish on top of a pile of dressed greens
10. Spoon the tomato salsa on top of the swordfish
11. Enjoy !

title: pizza on the grill w sausage   mozzarella
steps:
1. Dough:
2. Combine sugar , yeast and warm water and let sit for around 10 min until it starts to foam
3. Add the salt and oil , mix
4. Add flours and cornmeal and knead / mix until well combined and dough not sticky
5. You may have to add more flour to get the required texture
6. I use a kitchen aid for the kneading
7. Take out of bowl and knead for a bit on the table
8. Spray the bowl with cooking spray and sit in a warm place , covered , for 1 - 1 1 / 2 hours
9. Topping:
10. Mix all ingredients in a bowl
11. Pizza:
12. Divide the dough into the number of pizzas you wish to make
13. Roll out the dough as thin as possible
14. Prick the dough in a few places with a fork to prevent the dough from bubbling up when cooking
15. Heat grill to medium and place rolled out pizza dough directly on the grill
16. Let it cook for 1 min and flip and let the other side cook
17. The pizza should look sligthly browned
18. Remove add the topping mixture and spread on top of pizza
19. Cook on grill at low until cheese melts - again be careful to not have the grill too hot
20. Serve immediately

title: beef tips   crispy parsnip threads with horseradish cream sa
steps:
1. In medium mixing bowl , whisk together the plain yogurt , horseradish cream , half & half , beef broth and rosemary and set aside
2. Pour 2 tablespoons olive oil to a large frying pan and heat over medium heat
3. Add chopped onion and saute until translucent
4. Add beef
5. Sprinkle beef with flour and stir to coat
6. Add mushrooms to the pan and to cook over medium heat , stirring occasionally
7. Meanwhile , scrub and peel the outer layer from the parsnips and discard
8. Using your potato peeler , quickly peel strips of parsnips until you reach the woody center
9. Pour remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil in a skillet and heat over medium heat
10. Add parsnip threads in small batches and fry until golden brown and crispy
11. Transfer to a paper lined plate to drain
12. While parsnips and beef
13. When the noodles are down to their last five minuets of cooking , pour the horseradish cream sauce over the beef and mushrooms and stir well to coat
14. Simmer until sauce has slightly thickened
15. Drain noodles and place in a serving bowl
16. Pour beef

title: cheesy bacon wrapped jalapenos
steps:
1. Cut jalapeos from top to bottom on one side
2. Under the sink , wash out and gut the insides of the jalapeos
3. Cut and place pieces of cheese to fit inside the jalapeos
4. Wrap the jalapeos with a strip of bacon
5. Put a tooth pick through the jalapeo to hold the bacon in place
6. Grill jalapeos on a bbq flipping constantly until bacon is done , usually no more than 5-10 minutes
7. Be careful of large flames
8. Serve immediately or refrigerate and heat up in oven

title: creamy chocolate mint layered fudge
steps:
1. In a heavy saucepan over low heat , melt the chips with 1 cup sweetened condensed milk
2. Add the vanilla extract
3. Combine
4. Spread half of mixture into wax paper-lined 8 or 9-inch square pan
5. Chill for 10 minutes or until firm
6. Hold remaining chocolate mixture at room temperature
7. In heavy saucepan over low heat , melt the white baking pieces with remaining condensed milk
8. Add peppermint extract and the food coloring
9. Spread onto the cold chocolate layer
10. Chill 10 minutes longer or until firm
11. Spread remaining chocolate mixture on mint layer
12. Chill until firm

title: provencal lemon olive chicken
steps:
1. Place onion in 4-quart crock-pot slow cooker
2. Arrange chicken thighs over onion
3. Place lemon slice on each thigh
4. Add olives , brine , herbes de provence , bay leaf , salt and pepper
5. Slowly pour in chicken broth
6. Cover
7. Cook on low 5 to 6 hours or on high 3 to 31 / 2 hours or until chicken is tender
8. Stir in parsley before serving

title: cream corn
steps:
1. Put corn in a skillet over medium heat
2. Add cream cheese , butter and milk
3. Stir continuously so the milk does not burn until all ingredients melt together
4. Add salt and pepper to taste
5. Enjoy !

title: carrabba s pappardelle campagnolo
steps:
1. Remove sausage from the casing and break into coarse pieces
2. Pour olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat
3. Add sausage and cook until the sausage has browned slightly
4. Add onion and red bell pepper and cook until soft and onion turns a rich golden color
5. Add the wine and let evaporate for 3 minutes
6. Add garlic , and cook 1 minute more
7. Add the tomatoes and season lightly with salt and pepper and crushed red pepper flakes
8. Raise heat and bring sauce to a boil , stirring frequently
9. Reduce heat and let simmer until the sauce has thickened
10. Stir in basil and set sauce aside
11. Meanwhile bring 4 qrts water to a boil in a large pot , add 1 tbsp salt and drop in the pasta all at once , stirring well
12. When the pasta is almost done , return the skillet with the sauce to a medium heat
13. When the pasta is al dente , drain it and toss it with the sauce , adding the grated cheese and tossing again
14. Place the pasta in a serving platter and top with the crumbled goat cheese
15. Serve at once with sauteed spinach with lemon juice , and crusty bread

title: duck with ginger and lime
steps:
1. Cook duck
2. I recommend salting the duck and broiling until cooked through
3. Let duck cool for 10-15 minutes
4. For dressing: beat all other ingredients together well
5. Cut cooled duck into slices , adding a bit of dressing to each piece to moisten
6. Arrange duck slices over salad leaves
7. Drizzle dressing over duck and leaves and serve immediately

title: somebunny loves you easter cake
steps:
1. Prepare two rounds of yellow cake per box or recipe instructions
2. Split each cake layer in half with monofilament , so there are four layers total
3. Mash the bananas with the lemon juice and sugar for the filling
4. Assemble the cake with the filling between each of the layers
5. For the frosting , in a mixing bowl that you can later put over boiling water , blend the first 4 ingredients with a mixer at low speed for 30 seconds
6. Noting that the mixing bowl should not touch the water , place the mixing bowl over the boiling water and beat with the mixer on high speed for 7 minutes
7. Remove from the heat and stir in the vanilla
8. Beat the frosting for a few more minutes until it reaches a spreadable consistency
9. Frost the cake with the seven minute frosting and cover all over with the coconut flakes

title: sweet pork barbacoa
steps:
1. Dump peppers into a mesh sieve or strainer , and then holding the sieve over your crock pot , pour the pepsi through them to get all that delicious sauce into the pot
2. Discard peppers
3. Add remaining ingredients and then stir until combined
4. Trim as much visible fat from the pork as you can
5. Add the meat to the crock pot
6. Cook on high for 5 hours
7. Shred the pork with two forks and then lower the temperature to low , and cook an additional 3 - 4 hours , until the meat is a nice mahogany color

title: mae mortensen s butter pecan cookies
steps:
1. Cream the butter and margarine
2. Gradually add 1 / 4 cup plus 2 tbsp sugar , beating well at medium speed of an electric mixer
3. Add the water and vanilla , beating well
4. Gradually add the flour to the creamed mixture , beating well
5. Stir in ground pecans
6. Shape dough into 1-inch balls
7. Place 2 inches apart on a greased cookie sheet
8. Flatten the balls to 1 / 4 inch thickness with the palm of your hand
9. Bake at 350 degrees for 10 to 12 minutes
10. Let cool slightly on the cookie sheet
11. Roll cookies in additional sugar to coat
12. Let cool completely on wire racks

title: coconut cream pound cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Cream butter and shortening
3. Gradually add sugar
4. Beating until light and fluffy
5. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
6. Combine flour and baking powder
7. Add to creamed mixture alternating with cream of coconut , beginning and ending with flour mixture
8. Stir in lemon rind and vanilla
9. Pour batter into greased and floured 10" tube pan
10. Bake at 350 for 1 hour and 15 minutes , or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
11. Cool in pan for 10-15 minutes
12. Remove from pan and cool completely on wire rack

title: sweet potato   parsnip gratin
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c / 160c fan-forced
2. Layer sweet potato , parsnip and carrot in a greased 6cm-deep , 6 cup-capacity ovenproof dish
3. Combine the soup mix , rosemary and cream in a jug
4. Season with pepper
5. Pour mix over the vegetables
6. Bake , covered , for 30 minutes
7. Remove cover and bake for another 25 minutes or until vegetables are tender
8. Serve

title: turkish pilav  rice
steps:
1. Over high heat , add oil and brown rice to pan
2. Cook until rice is browned well
3. Mix in water , white rice , and boulion cube
4. Sprinkle a small amount of vegetable seasonsing over the mixture
5. Stir
6. Turn heat to medium and cover
7. Occasionally stirring the rice , cook until tender

title: linguine with lemon clam sauce
steps:
1. I usually make this in my non-stick wok
2. Heat oil and butter on medium heat and saute onion and garlic until soft and tender , not brown
3. Add basil and bay leaf
4. Pour in wine , lemon rind , lemon juice and reserved clam juice
5. Simmer until reduced a little
6. Add clams and heat through
7. Toss in the cooked linguine a little at a time and lastly add the cheese and parsley
8. Serve with more cheese on the side and red pepper flakes and warm garlic bread

title: bite sized chocolate banana chip muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f butter nonstick miniature muffin pans or line with paper liners
2. In large bowl , combine flours , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
3. In another bowl , whisk together sugar and cocoa
4. Whisk in egg , milk , bananas and melted butter
5. Pour over dry ingredients and sprinkle with chocolate chips
6. Stir until just moistened
7. Spoon into prepared muffin pans , mounding as necessary to fill 24 deep cups or 36 shallow cups
8. Bake , in batches as necessary , for 15-18 minutes or until tops are firm to the touch
9. Let cool in pan for 5 minutes
10. Transfer to rack to cool completely
11. Cooking
12. Wrap cooled muffins in plastic wrap and freeze in a resealable bag or airtight container for up to 1 month

title: hummingbird pie
steps:
1. Mix together first 3 ingredients and brown lightly in a pan
2. Mix condensed milk and cream cheese until well blended
3. Fold in cool whip
4. Place 1 / 2 cream cheese mixture in pie crust
5. Sprinkle 1 / 2 of coconut mixture , then drizzle with 1 / 2 caramel topping
6. Repeat each layer once more

title: dry and spicy curry
steps:
1. Heat the ghee or oil in a pan and stir-fry the onion over moderate heat until crisp and light brown
2. Do not burn
3. Add the curry powder , chili , and the cooked meat or fish and mix well
4. Add the salt and water and cook for 5 minutes as a rich , brown sauce develops
5. Serve warm with rice

title: heavenly country style home fries
steps:
1. Place diced potatoes , onion , paprika , garlic powder , salt and black pepper in a medium mixing bowl
2. Toss to evenly coat the potatoes
3. In a large , non-stick skillet over medium heat , melt butter
4. Increase skillet heat to medium-high and add potato mixture
5. Toss to coat evenly with butter
6. Cover skillet and cook for 10-12 minutes , turning and scraping the potatoes to prevent burning
7. When potatoes are fork-tender , remove skillet cover
8. With the back of your spatula , pat potatoes down into an even layer in skillet
9. Allow to fry untouched for 2 minutes
10. Then turn potatoes over and do the same for another 2 minutes
11. This will nicely brown and crisp the outside of the potatoes
12. Serve immediately

title: spanozaarkopita
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Place the raisins and the apricots and the wine in a small pan and simmer till soft and until almost the liquid is evaporated
3. In a large skillet , heat one tablespoon of the oil and saute the mushrooms , without stirring , for about two minutes
4. Turn the mushrooms and saute , without stirring for another minute
5. Add the scallions and garlic and saute for about five minutes
6. If necessary , add a little more oil
7. Remove from the heat and add the fruit and the remaining ingredients
8. Stir until well combined
9. Grease a 9" x 13" baking pan with olive oil
10. Lay a sheet of phyllo dough in the pan , brushing it with olive oil
11. Repeat this process until you have five sheets of phyllo dough in the pan
12. Spread half the spinach / chicken mixture over the dough
13. Layer three more sheets of phyllo dough over this , brushing each sheet with olive oil
14. Spread the remaining spinach mixture over the dough , smoothing it out to make it even
15. Layer five more sheets of phyllo dough , each brushed with oil , over the spinach
16. With a sharp knife , score diagonally to form diamonds
17. Bake for approximately 40 minutes or until pastry is golden brown

title: herb buttered spaghetti
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti as indicated on pacakge directions
2. Drain
3. Combine cooked spaghetti , butter , basil , parmesan , salt , and pepper in a bowl
4. Heat until hot

title: nana s ritz cracker pie  with walnuts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Prepare an 8" pie pan with cooking spray
3. In a gallon size ziplock bag , crush the 21 ritz crackers until almost powder-like
4. Add the finely chopped walnuts and 1 teaspoon baking powder
5. Toss with a fork and set aside
6. In a stand mixer or medium bowl using a hand mixer , beat the 3 egg whites until fluffy
7. Slowly add 1 cup of sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla
8. Beat until stiff and glossy in appearance
9. Fold the crackers / nuts into the egg whites and pour into the pie pan
10. Bake for 30 minutes
11. Allow to cool completely in refridgerator and top with whipped topping before serving
12. Enjoy !

title: vicki  s rhubarb crunch
steps:
1. Mix flour , oatmeal , brown sugar , melted butter and cinnamon together until crumbly
2. Press 1 / 2 of the mixture into a greased 9x13 pan
3. Cover with rhubarb
4. Combine remaining ingredients in saucepan
5. Cook until thick and clear
6. Pour cooked mixture over rhubarb
7. Top with remaining crumb mixture
8. Bake for 1 hour at 350 degrees fahrenheit
9. Serve with cream

title: rice soup with shrimp and egg
steps:
1. In a large sauce pan , combine broth , soy , ginger and garlic
2. Bring to a boil , reduce heat to low , simmer 5 minutes then remove and discard ginger slices and garlic
3. Add mushrooms , shrimp , spinach and rice , simmer 2 minutes or until mushrooms are tender and spinach is wilted
4. Bring to a boil , drizzle in egg whisking constantly
5. Ladle into soup bowls and top with scallions and tomato

title: cheese and sour cream potatoes
steps:
1. In a 4-quart dutch oven cook potatoes in enough boiling water to cover for 20 to 25 minues or until just tender
2. Drain
3. Cool slightly
4. Peel and coarsely shred or finely chop potatoes
5. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
6. In large bowl stir together sour cream , soup , cheese , melted butter , onion , salt and pepper
7. Gently stir in potatoes
8. Transfer to greased 3-quart rectangular baking dish
9. Sprinkle with cornflakes
10. Bake , covered , for 40 minutes
11. Uncover , bake about 15 minutes more until golden

title: stars and stripes berry trifle
steps:
1. For the stars:
2. Slice each cake lengthwise into 5 equal pieces
3. Spread scant 2 teaspoons jam each on 5 cake slices and top with remaining slices to create jam sandwiches
4. Using 2-inch star cookie cutter , cut out 3 stars from each sandwich
5. Chop remaining sandwich scraps into 1 / 2-inch pieces and set aside
6. For the berries:
7. Toss blueberries , 1 t
8. Sugar and water in bowl
9. In separate bowl , toss raspberries with remaining sugar
10. Let sit until sugar dissolves and berries are glossy , about 5 minutes
11. To assemble:
12. Arrange 7 star sandwiches upright around bottom of 3-quart trifle dish
13. Place 2 cups sandwich scraps in center of dish
14. Arrange 3 cups blueberries around stars , piling up blueberries so that they surround all edges of stars
15. Spread 2 cups custard in even layer on top of blueberry and cake layer
16. Place 1 cup sandwich scraps on center of custard layer
17. Arrange 2 cups raspberries around perimeter of dish
18. Spread remaining custard in even layer on top of raspberries
19. Arrange 7 star sandwiches upright around perimeter of dish
20. Arrange remaining blueberries around stars and pile remaining raspberries in center of dish
21. Spoon whipped cream on top of raspberries and top with remaining star

title: panang beef
steps:
1. Cut beef into thin slices , season with salt and pepper
2. Soak chiles to soften
3. Chop chiles , ginger , shallots and garlic
4. Place them in mortar with lemon grass , coriander root , lime peel , peppercorns , and shrimp paste , pound until smooth
5. Pour coconut milk in wok , bring to boil
6. Add beef , cook until tender , remove , set aside
7. Discard milk
8. Pour coconut cream in wok , bring to boil
9. Reduce heat and simmer until oil separates
10. Add spice paste , cook 4-5 minutes , stirring constantly
11. Add beef , peanuts , 8 basil leaves , fish sauce and sugar , stir well and cook slowly 2 more minutes
12. Transfer to serving dish , garnish with basil , lime leaves and chiles

title: chvre with pistachios and honey
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In a bowl , whisk goat cheese and half-and-half until smooth
3. Spoon into a small , shallow gratin dish , spreading level
4. Bake until cheese is hot in center and beginning to firm up at edges , about 15 minutes
5. Drizzle cheese with honey and sprinkle with pistachios
6. Serve with crackers

title: zucchini and grape tomatoes in pesto with feta
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine pesto , oil and lemon juice
2. Season to taste with salt and pepper
3. Arrange zucchini slices , overlapping slightly , on a platter
4. Top with grape tomatoes and feta and drizzle pesto mixture on top
5. Cover and let stand at least 1 hour for flavors to blend
6. Meanwhile , sit on the porch with a fly swatter and put some grey goose in your lemonade

title: stilton mushrooms  easy microwave fix
steps:
1. Carefully remove the stalks from the mushrooms & chop finely
2. Wipe the caps w / damp kitchen paper
3. Place half the butter in a bowl & microwave on high for 1 minute
4. Then add the mushroom stalks + shallots & cook on high for 2 minutes
5. Cool for 5 minutes
6. Crumble in the cheese
7. Then add breadcrumbs & salt + pepper to taste & mix well
8. Divide mixture among the mushroom caps
9. Place the remaining butter in a lrg shallow dish & microwave on high for 1 minute
10. Place the stuffed mushrooms in the dish , cook for 2 minutes & serve immediately

title: seasoned baked red potatoes
steps:
1. Mix potatoes , soup and salad dressing mix in a large bowl
2. Add olive oil until potatoes are lightly coated
3. Transfer mixture to a large casserole dish
4. Bake 350 for 1 hour to 1 1 / 2 hours , or until done

title: thai chicken fettuccine  southwest style
steps:
1. In saucepan or microwave , combine salsa , peanut butter , orange juice , honey , soy sauce and red pepper flakes
2. Heat until well blended
3. In a large skillet , cook chicken in oil over medium heat for 3-5 minutes until browned
4. Add julienned red pepper and cook and stir until crisp-tender
5. Cook fettuccine according to package directions and fold into chicken mixture
6. Stir in sauce , salt to taste and sprinkle with cilantro
7. Wonderful with spiced fruit salad

title: gruyere and prosciutto oven omelet
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Lightly butter a shallow 1 1 / 2 quart round baking dish , 9 1 / 2" in diameter
3. In a large bowl , beat eggs until blended
4. Stir in milk , salt , nutmeg , prosciutto , and cheese until evenly distributed
5. Pour the egg mixture into the prepared baking dish
6. In a small bowl , toss the bread cubes in the olive oil to coat
7. Scatter the bread cubes evenly over the egg mixture
8. Bake until golden brown on top and slightly puffed , 35-40 minutes
9. Serve hot , cut into wedges

title: garlic crust prime rib
steps:
1. To prepare for crust:
2. Wipe down the roast and place on a roasting rack
3. Heat your oil in a skillet and add the garlic
4. Saut 2 minutes , pressing the juice from the garlic into the oil
5. Take the pan off of the heat
6. Mix in bread crumbs , parsley , seasonings , salt and black pepper , allowing to cool slightly , press the mixture onto the roast , coating well
7. The roast can be sealed tightly and refrigerated at this point
8. When ready to put into oven , preheat oven to 450f
9. Insert meat thermometer into the thickest portion of the muscle
10. When the oven has reached 450f , place the roast in and cook at this temperature for approximately 20 minutes
11. This will sear the meat , keeping the juices inches
12. Reduce the heat to 325f and continue cooking until done to your taste
13. This type of roast does not need to be basted
14. Roast at 325f until meat thermometer registers 140f for rare , 160f for medium or 170f for well done
15. Remove from the oven and place a sheet of aluminum foil and then several kitchen towels over the roast
16. It will continue to cook after being removed from the oven , the juices will settle and the texture will be firmer which will allow easier carving
17. Allow to stand for 15 to 20 minutes before carving

title: cherry loaf pound cake
steps:
1. Combine flour and salt
2. Stir well to blend
3. Mix 1 / 2 cup flour mixture with cherries
4. Cream butter and sugar together until light and fluffy , i use a high speed on my mixer till it is real fluffy
5. Add eggs 1 at a time , beating well after each addition
6. Add remaining flour gradually
7. Stir in extract and floured cherries , mixing until well blended
8. Spread in greased loaf pan
9. Bake at 300degreesf for 90-100 minutes , or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
10. Don't be concerned if cake cracks on top , it is supposed to

title: portabella enchiladas
steps:
1. In a medium pot , saute onion and bell pepper in 1 tbsp canola oil for 2-3 minutes
2. Add smashed black beans , 2 / 3 can of enchilada sauce , and salsa
3. Stir , set aside
4. In a small pan , saute portabello mushrooms 2-3 minutes in 1 tbsp canola oil
5. Add to mixture above
6. Spoon 1 / 4 cup portabello mixture into tortilla
7. Add 3 blocks fontina cheese
8. Roll each enchilada and place seam down in oiled baking dish
9. Cover with remaining enchilada sauce and chopped tomatoes
10. Bake at 350 for 15 minutes
11. Add cheddar cheese , bake an additional 5 minutes

title: roasted red pepper and parmesan biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. In a bowl , whisk together the flour , the baking powder , the salt , the cayenne and a pinch of black pepper
3. Add the butter and blend the mixture until it resembles a coarse meal
4. Add the roasted peppers , the parmesan and the milk and stir the mixture until it just forms a dough
5. Drop the dough in 6 mounds about 2 inches apart onto buttered baking sheet and bake the biscuits in the middle of the oven for 15 to 18 minutes , or until they are cooked through and slightly golden

title: sweet cherry   almond tart
steps:
1. Butter the bottom and sides of a 10" tart pan , line the bottom with buttered parchment paper , and set it aside
2. Preheat the oven to 350f
3. Mix the ground almonds , sugar , flour salt , baking powder and grated orange zest , and set them aside
4. Melt the butter
5. Beat the eggs
6. Beat the orange juice and the butter into them
7. Stir in the dry ingredients
8. Pour into the tart pan
9. Sprinkle the cherries evenly over the batter
10. Bake at 350f for 35-40 minutes

title: berry french toast bake
steps:
1. Grease a 9x13 inch glass baking dish with butter
2. In a large bowl , beat flour , half-and-half , 1 / 4 cup sugar , vanilla , salt , and eggs with wire whisk until smooth
3. Stir in bread and 1 1 / 2 cups mixed berries
4. Spoon into the baking dish , cover tightly and refrigerate 1 - 24 hours
5. Heat oven to 400f
6. Uncover bread mixture , and bake for 25-35 minutes or until golden brown and knife inserted in center comes out clean
7. In a 1 1 / 2 quart saucepan , stir together 1 / 2 cup sugar and the cornstarch
8. Stir in the orange juice until smooth
9. Stir in 1 cup mixed berries , heat to boiling over medium heat , stirring constantly
10. Cook about 4 minutes , stirring constantly , until slightly thickened , remove from heat
11. Just before serving , stir in strawberry halves
12. Serve warm over french toast bake

title: meatloaf roulade
steps:
1. In 1 inch boiling water in large saucepan , cook carrots , covered , 25 minutes , or until tender
2. Drain
3. Mash
4. Measure 3 cups
5. In hot butter in skillet , saut chopped onion , stirring , until golden
6. Combine half of onion with carrot , 1 teaspoon salt , dash pepper
7. Preheat oven to 350f in large bowl , combine eggs , bread crumbs , milk , thyme , 1 tablespoon salt , 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper
8. Mix well
9. Add ground beef , pork , parsley and rest of onion
10. Mix well
11. Roll out between two sheets of waxed paper placed on damp surface
12. Roll to form a rectangle 14 by 10 inches , 1 / 4 inch thick
13. Remove top sheet of waxed paper
14. Spread meat evenly with carrot filling
15. Roll up as for jelly roll , use the bottom of the wax paper to roll up starting with narrow edge
16. Place the meat loaf , seam side down , in shallow roasting pan lined with foil
17. Make glaze: in small bowl , combine catsup , brown sugar and mustard
18. Mix well
19. Brush over meat loaf
20. Bake uncovered , 1 hour
21. Meanwhile in 1 inch boiling water with teaspoon salt in large skillet , cook whole onions , covered , about 25 minutes
22. Drain
23. Wash green beans
24. Trim ends
25. Using string , tie beans into bundles , ten in each
26. In large skillet , in 1 inch boiling water and 1 teaspoon salt , boil beans gently , covered , 12 to 15 minutes , or until tender
27. Drain
28. Remove strings when on serving platter
29. In skillet , melt 2 tablespoons butter with granulated sugar
30. Add onions
31. Over medium heat , saut , turning , until golden-brown-about 5 minutes
32. Arrange meat loaf and vegetables on warm platter
33. Pour 1 / 4 cup melted butter over beans

title: turtle pumpkin pie  from kraft
steps:
1. Pour 1 / 4 cup caramel topping into crust
2. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 cup nuts
3. Beat dry pudding mixes , milk , pumpkin and spices with whisk until well blended
4. Stir in 1-1 / 2 cups cool whip
5. Spoon into crust
6. Refrigerate 1 hour
7. Top with remaining cool whip , caramel topping and nuts just before serving

title: coke a cola bread
steps:
1. Mix soda with pancake mix just till wet
2. Do not over mix
3. Dough will be very lumpy and thick
4. Grease a bundt pan add mix bake at 4oo degrees for 45-60 minute
5. Let cool at least a little bit to make it easier to cut

title: warm chicken caesar wraps
steps:
1. In a large nonstick skillet cook chicken tenderloins until lightly browned
2. Leave chicken in skillet and add water , bring to a boil
3. Stir in rice
4. Cover and remove from heat
5. Let stand 5 minutes or until liquid is absorbed
6. Stir in salad dressing
7. Fill each tortilla with chicken and rice mixture , lettuce , tomatoes , and croutons
8. Fold in sides of tortilla and roll up

title: spicy roasted sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Place diced potatoes and onions in large bowl , toss with olive oil to coat
3. Add all other ingredients , toss to coat
4. Pour into buttered casserole dish
5. Roast in oven for 40-45 minutes or until potatoes are tender and edges are browned and caramelized
6. Adjust spiciness / seasonings to taste
7. Stir gently halfway through cooking time or as needed

title: pickled octopus
steps:
1. If you can buy cleaned octopus you can skip the next stage
2. Gut the octopus and peel the skin from the octopus
3. Remove the beak
4. Place the octopus in large pan with 1 cup water
5. Cook over medium / low heat
6. The octopus will give off a lot of liquid but check ocassionally that there is still enough liquid in the pan
7. Cook for about 1 -1 1 / 2 hours
8. Test with a skew , it should easily pierce the flesh
9. Remove from pan and allow to cool slightly or cool enough to handle
10. Slice tentacles into 3cm lengths and body into pieces
11. Mix up the dressing ingredients
12. Check dressing that it is not too vinegary as vinegar strenght is so variable
13. Pack the octopus in the sterlised jars and pour over the marinade
14. Let sit in the refrigerator for 5 days before eating
15. Serve as part of meze

title: kids orange julius
steps:
1. In a blender add the ingredients but the last cup of ice and blend for 30 seconds
2. Add the ice and blend on high for another 30 seconds
3. Then , give it three blasts , just to make sure the ice has really disappeared
4. Drink with a straw , preferably the kind that kinks

title: what s up doc cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Sift all dry ingredients together into large bowl
3. In medium bowl add oil and eggs , whisk until blended
4. Pour egg mixture into dry ingredients and stir well
5. Mix shredded carrots w / vanilla and fold into mixture
6. Pour batter into 13x9" cake pan and bake for approximately 45 minutes

title: easy breakfast rolls
steps:
1. Stir flour , salt , baking powder and 1 / 2 cup sugar
2. Combine milk , eggs and 1 / 2 cup melted butter
3. Add to dry ingredients and mix well
4. Place on lightly floured board and knead lightly 10 times
5. Roll or pat into rectangular shape 1 / 4 inch thick
6. Mix 1 / 2 cup sugar , cinnamon and 1 / 2 cup melted butter
7. Spread over dough
8. Roll dough as for jelly roll
9. Seal edges and cut into half inch slices
10. Combine remaining butter , brown sugar and nuts
11. Sprinkle lightly over bottoms of greased muffin pans
12. Arrange slices cutside down over this mixture
13. Bake 375f 25-30 minutes
14. Turn pans upside down on cooling rack and lift off rolls
15. Serve hot

title: kheer   indian rice pudding  slow cooker
steps:
1. Coat the bottom and sides of a 5 quart slow cooker with vegetable oil
2. Put the rice , sugar , cardamon seeds , raisins and milk in the slow cooker
3. If using agave nectar , add it towards the end , as it will make the dish pinkish-brown in color
4. Cook on high for 3 hours , stirring once or twice
5. Be careful not to let it overcook , as the milk will separate
6. Sprinkle with chopped nuts and serve , hot or cold
7. It will thicken as it cools

title: oatmeal crispies
steps:
1. Thoroughly cream shortening , brown sugar and granulated sugar
2. Add eggs and vanilla and beat well
3. Add sifted flour , salt , soda , oats and nuts
4. Mix all well and drop by teaspoons full onto greased baking sheet
5. Bake@ 350 degrees f for 10 minutes or until light brown
6. You may make these up into rolls and wrap with wax paper and store in fridge
7. Take out and cut 1 / 4" thick and cook

title: grandma bea s classic lasagna
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions
3. Drain and rinse
4. Heat a large nonstick skilet over medium-high heat
5. Add sausage and onion
6. Stir and cook until sausage is browned
7. Drain liquid
8. Stir in red pepper and garlic
9. Remove from heat
10. In a large bowl , combine eggs , cheeses , and basil
11. Mix until well blended
12. Spread a thin layer of sauce in a 13 x 9" baking pan
13. Add a layer of noodles , then a layer of cheese mixture , then a layer of sausage
14. Repeat
15. The topmost layers should be: sauce , noodles , sauce , tomato slices
16. Cover pan with foil
17. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes , then remove foil , and bake until bubbly
18. Let stand for 5 minutes , then serve

title: pasta with yogurt mint sauce
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions and drain
2. Mix yogurt , crushed garlic , salt , and mint leaves together in a bowl and beat with a wooden spoon until the mixture is very creamy
3. Pour the warm sauce over the prepared pasta and toss

title: award winning zucchini soup
steps:
1. Fry sausage in a soup pan , drain
2. Add all other ingerdients except water
3. Add water in a cup at a time , i add 2 cups , then if after cooking the soup looks a bit thick , i add more
4. Reduce heat and allow the soup to simmer 2-3 hours , or until the zucchini is tender and transparent
5. Serve with a yummy crusty italian bread , or garlic bread !

title: jane   michael stern s old fashioned homemade turkey soup
steps:
1. Prepare broth: cut turkey meat from carcass
2. Chop to measure 3 cups
3. Cover and refrigerate to add to soup
4. Break up turkey carcass and place with skin in large kettle
5. Add celery pieces , quartered carrots and onions , peppercorns , bay leaves and salt , if desired
6. Add 12 to 15 cups water to cover carcass completely
7. Bring to boil over high heat
8. Reduce heat to low
9. Simmer , covered , 4 hours , stirring occasionally
10. Cool broth
11. Using colander , strain broth into large bowl
12. Refrigerate to chill completely
13. Discard turkey bones and cooked vegetables
14. Prepare soup: in 4-quart saucepan over medium heat , melt butter
15. Add diced celery , carrots , onions , zucchini , garlic , rosemary , and thyme
16. Cook 7-10 minutes , stirring frequently until vegetables are golden
17. Remove cooled broth from refrigerator
18. Skim chilled fat from broth surface and discard
19. Measure 8 cups turkey broth , returning surplus to refrigerator for later use
20. Add broth to vegetables
21. Bring to boil
22. Stir in noodles
23. Return to boil
24. Reduce heat to low
25. Simmer , covered , 15 minutes until noodles are tender
26. Add reserved 3 cups chopped cooked turkey meat and parsley , simmer 3 minutes longer to heat through
27. Season with salt and pepper

title: fresh apple cake
steps:
1. Cut apples in cubes , sprinkle with lemon juice to keep from discoloring and mix with 1 cup sugar to make liquid for cake
2. Set aside
3. Cream eggs , butter and remaining sugar
4. Add dry ingredients , and pecans
5. Add the cubed apple mixture
6. Bake in greased floured bundt pan at 350 degrees approximately 1 hour until done or inserted toothpick comes out clean
7. May be eaten warm , or cooled and served with ice cream , if desired

title: cube steaks and excellent gravy
steps:
1. Spray crockpot with cooking spray
2. In a bowl , mix soups and water together
3. Put about 1 / 2 of the soup mixture on bottom of crockpot , add 2 steaks , put another 1 / 2 of the remaining soup mixture on top of steaks , add other two steaks and rest of soup mixture
4. Arrange potatoes on top
5. Cook on low 8-10 hours or high 4-5 hours
6. No need to brown the steaks before putting them in the crockpot

title: garlic roast beef pinwheels
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f heat olive oil in medium nonstick skillet over medium heat
2. Add onion and garlic
3. Cook and stir 3 to 4 minutes or until onion is tender
4. Remove from heat
5. Add beef , basil , marjoram and pepper
6. Toss to mix well
7. Set aside
8. Unroll dough and separate into 2 long rectangles
9. Press each into 12x4-inch rectangle , firmly pressing perforations to seal
10. Spread each half with half of beef mixture
11. Starting at one short side , firmly roll both pieces , crimping seam to seal
12. With serrated knife and sawing motion , gently cut each roll into 8 pieces
13. Place cut side down on baking sheet sprayed with nonstick cooking spray
14. Gently reshape pinwheels after placing on cookie sheet , if necessary
15. Spray pinwheels lightly with nonstick cooking spray and sprinkle with sesame seeds before baking , if desired
16. Bake 13 to 16 minutes or until edges are golden brown

title: pineapple ginger mojito
steps:
1. To make the pineapple-rum: peel , core and slice pineapple and pack into a glass container with a cover
2. Add rum to completely cover pineapple
3. Seal container and store in a cool place for four to five days
4. Taste rum occasionally to check progress
5. When rum has reached the desired flavor , strain it through a sieve , bottle , and refrigerate for up to two weeks
6. Yields one liter
7. To make ginger syrup: in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat , bring water and ginger to a boil
8. Add sugar , stirring until dissolved
9. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 hour
10. Remove from heat and cool to room temperature
11. Strain through a sieve , bottle , and refrigerate for up to one month
12. Yields approximately 3 cups
13. To make mojito: in a 14-oz glass , muddle spearmint , lime juice , and ginger syrup , to release the spearmint oils without tearing the leaves
14. Fill the glass with crushed ice , and add pineapple-infused rum
15. Stir the drink to incorporate the flavors and coat the ice
16. Add more crushed ice , stir again , top with soda water , and stir once
17. Garnish with a sprig of mint and spear of pineapple

title: rachael ray s green beans
steps:
1. Steam beans in an inch of water , covered , for 5 minutes , or until bright green and crisp-tender
2. Drain
3. In a skillet , melt butter in oil , add onion and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes , or under onions are soft
4. Toss with green beans and season with salt and pepper to taste

title: baking spice   copycat pampered chef cinnamon plus mix
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine all ingredients
2. Store in an air tight container
3. Use this mix in recipes that call for the ingredients above
4. I substitute this for all of my cinnamon needs
5. If a recipe calls for the spices add up all of the measurments and just put in the same amount of this blend
6. It tastes great used in cinnamon and sugar for toast and in cinnamon rolls

title: rustic chicken and artichokes  slow cooker
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a crock pot and stir to combine
2. Cover and cook on low 6 to 8 hours
3. Optional: sautee mushrooms and serve on the side , so that those who do not like mushrooms don't have to eat them -- and those who do , can top them on their chicken
4. Serves 6

title: toasted vegemite cheese snacks
steps:
1. Spread toasted muffins with butter and vegemite
2. Combine the eggs , cheese and parsley together and spoon onto toasted muffins
3. Place toasted muffins under a medium griller and cook until cheese melts and bubbles
4. Serve immediately and enjoy

title: crab dabs
steps:
1. Remove any shell or cartilage from crab meat and chop into small pieces
2. Combine all ingredients except bacon , mix thoroughly
3. Chill 30 minutes
4. Portion crab mixture with a tablespoon , shape into small rolls
5. Wrap bacon around crab rolls
6. Secure with toothpicks
7. Broil about 4 inches from heating element 6-7 minutes or until bacon is crisp turn carefully , broil 4-5 minutes longer until bacon is crisp

title: pork chops creole style
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine the first six ingredients
2. Rub over both sides of pork
3. In a large skillet , brown pork chops in oil over medium heat
4. Add the remaining ingredients
5. Cover and cook 15-20 minutes longer , or until meat is tender

title: gravy without the turkey
steps:
1. In a small pan on medium heat mix the 3 cups of water with the chicken and beef bouillon
2. Keep stirring until its all dissolved
3. Don't let it come to a boil
4. Add the sage , thyme and pepper
5. Mix well and set this aside
6. In another pan melt the butter on low heat
7. When its all melted add the flour and gravy mix
8. Keep stirring till it looks like a paste and all flour is dissolved
9. Next add the bouillon mixture into the paste , stir until all the paste has dissolved and you have a gravy consistency
10. If you like your gravy a bit thinner , you can add water to thin it out
11. Enjoy !

title: hot pizza dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Mix together the cream cheese , sour cream , basil , and garlic powder
3. Spread the mixture into a 9-inch pie plate
4. Pour the pizza sauce on top of the cheese mixture
5. Top with the pepperoni , onions and green peppers
6. Bake for 10 minutes , remove and sprinkle with the mozzarella cheese and cook for an additional 5 minutes , or until cheese is melted
7. Serve with bread sticks or crackers

title: zucchini blossoms with boursin and fresh tomato vinaigrette
steps:
1. Rinse blossoms and trim a little of the hard stems
2. Spray a broiler-safe plate with cooking spray
3. Fill blossoms with cheese , gently close and pat into shape
4. Place on broiler-safe plate
5. Brush with olive oil
6. Broil until cheese melts and blossoms turn crisp , 5-10 minutes
7. Serve with tomato vinaigrette in center and between
8. Very very pretty

title: crunchy asian broccoli slaw
steps:
1. For dressing:
2. In a medium mixing bowl , combine the vinegar , sugar , salt and pepper
3. Drizzle in the oil , whisking as you go , until well mixed and set aside
4. For slaw:
5. Heat a dry medium frying pan over low heat and toast the nuts or seeds for about 1 minute until lightly browned and / or fragrant
6. Turn off heat and set aside
7. In a large bowl , combine the slaw mix , onions , nuts or seeds , cranberries and ramen noodles
8. Drizzle with dressing and toss until well coated
9. Refrigerate until serving

title: bugeah s german pancake  dutch baby
steps:
1. Turn on oven to 425
2. Put butter in a 9" round glass pie plate and place in oven while it heats up
3. Combine milk , flour , eggs , nutmeg , and cinnamon in a mixing bowl and mix well
4. When oven has warmed up pour the batter into the pie plate and bake 15-20 minutes
5. Let cool for 5 minutes
6. Sprinkle with lemon juice and powdered sugar , cut into four pieces , and serve

title: mistakes
steps:
1. Brown the beef and sausage until well cooked
2. Drain
3. Add the spices , mix thoroughly
4. Add cheese , simmer with a lid , until cheese melts
5. Mix thoroughly again
6. Spread on party rye and bake in a 350 oven for 15 minutes
7. Servingsare dependant on how thick you like to spread this mixture on the bread

title: kathy s carrot cake
steps:
1. In large bowl beat the eggs , oil and sugar
2. Add flour , baking soda , cinnamon , salt and mix well
3. Add grated carrots and walnuts , mix well , pour into a 13x9x2 inch pan that has been greased and floured
4. Bake at 350 degrees for approx
5. 50 minutes
6. Do not over bake
7. Cool completely
8. Frost
9. Cream cheese frosting: in small bowl: cream cheese , powdered sugar , butter and vanilla
10. Beat until smooth , frost

title: turkey a la veracruz
steps:
1. Cut turkey into 1 / 2" cubes
2. Heat oil in skillet and saute onion until tender
3. Add turkey , garlic , olives , tomatoes , chicken stock , pepper flakes and lemon juice
4. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes
5. Serve over hot rice

title: fudge blossoms
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Cut butter into cake mix until its coarse crumbs
3. Stir in egg and water
4. Shape into 1 / 2 inch balls
5. Roll into nuts , pressing gently into dough
6. Place 2 inches apart on cookie sheets
7. Bake 12 minutes until puffed and almost set
8. Place candy in middle of each cookie , pressing slightly
9. Bake 1 minute more
10. Cool 2 minutes on sheets
11. Remove and cool completly on racks

title: lime  paprika and honey glazed chicken
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425f
2. Mix the flour and paprika and season with salt and pepper
3. Dust the chicken legs in the flour and then put in a large roasting tin with the onions
4. Drizzle with the olive oil and roast for 20 minutes , turning the chicken once during this time
5. Mix together the ginger , garlic , honey and chicken stock
6. Pour over the chicken and add the lime wedges to the tin
7. Roast for another 10 minutes , or until the chicken is golden and glazed
8. Serve with steamed rice , greens and lots of cilantro leaves

title: lemon garlic roasted chicken thighs
steps:
1. Spray a deep baking dish , or roaster with non stick spray
2. Combine 1 tbs of olive oil , the juice and zest of both lemons , plus the additional lemon juice , and the 4 cloves of garlic minced in a small bowl
3. Place the chicken in the roasting pan
4. Sprinkle liberally with the lemon pepper salt
5. Pour the lemon mixture over all- you can throw the lemon rinds into the baking dish too
6. Bake at 400 for about 45 minutes to an hour , turning the chicken over halfway through baking
7. I sometimes make this , and seal it in a ziplock bag in the freezer , then when you are ready , thaw , dump in the roaster and bake- just adding the lemon pepper salt
8. My family likes this when i take the sauce from the chicken , combine it with a small amount of half and half and serve it over pasta

title: swiss chicken   broccoli casserole
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package
2. Drain well and butter lightly to prevent sticking
3. Set aside
4. Cut chicken into bite size pieces
5. In large frying pan , heat 6 tbsp butter
6. Add onions and chicken pieces
7. Cook just until turning white , turn and cook other side
8. Sprinkle with lemon juice
9. Add mushrooms and cook over medium heat for about six minutes , turning once
10. Remove chicken and mushrooms and keep warm
11. To the juices left in the frying pan , add flour
12. Cook and stir about 2 minutes
13. Using whisk , stir in milk and bring to a boil
14. Lower heat and simmer to thicken
15. Add spices and half of the cheese
16. Simmer gently for 5 minutes
17. Using the same pot that you cooked your noodles in , add the cream sauce and gently stir to coat noodles
18. Add broccoli , chicken and mushrooms
19. Fold into the noodles gently
20. Transfer to a greased 2l baking pan and top with remainder of swiss cheese
21. Bake covered at 350f 35-40 minutes

title: cilantro orzo and beef
steps:
1. Pour broth , orzo , corn and chilies in a 2-quart pan
2. Heat to a boiling
3. Reduce heat , cover and simmer for 10 minutes
4. Remove from heat
5. Let stand about 5 minutes
6. While the pasta is cooking , heat oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat
7. Cook beef and bell pepper for about 5 minutes , until beef is brown
8. Stir beef and bell pepper into the pasta mixture and add cilantro

title: peanut butter and chocolate chunk oat cookies  no flour
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper
3. In a large bowl beat the butter with both sugars until fluffy
4. Add in peanut butter , eggs and maple extract
5. Beat until well combined
6. In a bowl combine 4-1 / 4 cups oats with baking soda and salt
7. Add to the creamed mixture
8. Stir until combined
9. Stir in only 1 cup chocolate chunks with the nuts
10. Drop about 1 / 4-cup dough onto the baking sheet
11. Lightly press each cookeie with finger
12. Press 3-4 remaining chocolate chunks into each cookie , then sprinkle the tops of the cookie with some oats
13. Bake for about 13-14 minutes
14. Cool for about 3 minutes on the baking sheet , then remove to wire racks to cool
15. Delicious !

title: super bowl guacamole dip
steps:
1. Halve avocadoes
2. Remove seeds by safely lodging a knife in the seed and twisting to remove and remove from skins using a spoon
3. Place all ingredients in a bowl
4. Using a fork or potato masher , mash all ingredients , leaving a few pea-sized chunks
5. Mix well and chill for at least 30 minutes
6. Serve on a bed of lettuce

title: new mexico style posole   crock pot
steps:
1. Heat oil in a 6-quart crock pot , add pork , onion and garlic and cook until pork is browned
2. Drain excess grease
3. Add the water , chilies , enchilada sauce , tomatoes , taco sauce , bay leaf , salt , pepper and oregano , and cook over low to medium heat about 2 hours , stirring occasionally
4. After 2 hours , add more water if needed
5. Adjust seasonings if desired , and simmer 2 to 3 hours longer

title: greek chicken lemonata
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a shallow pan , add the chicken pieces and fry for 5 mins on each side , until golden brown
2. Add the garlic and fry for another minute , until it is fragrant
3. Add the water , oregano , salt and pepper and bring to the boil
4. Turn down the heat and simmer covered for 45 mins , until the chicken is done and tender
5. Dissolve the flour in the lemon juice and 2 tablespoons of water
6. Add to the liquid in the pan and simmer uncovered for another 2-3 mins until it is thickened
7. Serve over rice

title: texas fruit salad
steps:
1. To make dressing , whisk together in a small bowl the oil , vinegar , nuts , orange juice , lime juice and zest , basil , mustard , salt and pepper
2. For salad , cut avocado in half
3. Cut 1 half into cubes
4. Cut remaining half into 8 wedges and set aside for garnish
5. In a large bowl , combine avocado cubes , greens , kiwi , grapefruit , and strawberries
6. Drizzle with dressing and toss until evenly coated
7. Arrange avocado slices on top and serve

title: chris s favorite cherry jello
steps:
1. Mix jello and water
2. Blend in pie filling and chill until slightly thickened
3. Otherwise cherries will all sink to bottom
4. Make dream whip according to package and then blend in dream whip
5. Place in 9x9-inch pan and refrigerate
6. Can be easily doubled in a 9x13-inch pan

title: my mother shirl s cabbage salad
steps:
1. Grate the cabbage and apple finely
2. Combine the cabbage and apple
3. Mix dressing ingredients , which can be adjusted a bit though i wouldn't add anything or it won't be cabbage salad
4. The dressing should pour
5. Thicker than heavy cream
6. Combine dressing with cabbage and apple
7. If it seems a bit loose
8. Normal
9. Make this about an hour before meal time and refrigerate
10. The next day , if any is left , there will be some water to drain off before eating in most cases
11. This is again not intended to be coleslaw

title: kate s basic crepes
steps:
1. First , combine the flour , eggs , salt and oil in a large bowl so you have plenty of room to whisk and combine these ingredients well
2. Then add about a quarter of the milk and mix till smooth
3. When it is smooth , add the balance of the milk all at once and mix gently until you have achieved a homogenous batter --no lumps
4. Then let the batter sit at room temperature for at least half an hour -- now your batter is ready
5. Heat your skillet or , if you are lucky enough to have one , your crepe pan , add oil or butter or a combination of both--just enough to give the pan's surface a sheen , and add just enough batter to make a very thin veil across the pan
6. Then , using a spatula , carefully turn your crepe once it begins to brown around the edges and cook it on the other side
7. When it is lightly browned on both sides , remove it from the pan and lay it on a warm plate
8. Repeat the process , stacking your crepes one on top of the other

title: summer squash medley
steps:
1. Cut squash and zucchini crosswise into 1 / 4 inch thick slices
2. Saute onion in a large skillet in a small amount of olive oil until translucent , drain on paper towels
3. Add a small amount of water to the skillet and bring to a boil
4. Add zucchini and summer squash , and boil 3-5 minutes or until crisp-tender
5. Drain
6. Add remaining ingredients and onion , and toss

title: vidalia onion cornbread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f
2. Spray a 8-inch bakinf pan with vegetable oil cooking spray
3. In a medium saucepan , melt the butter and saute the onions until tender , but not browned , for about 3 minutes
4. Remove the pan from the heat and add the muffin mix , milk , egg , sour cream , 1 / 2 cup of the cheese , the salt , and dill weed
5. Stir to combine
6. Pour into the prepared pan and top with the 1 / 2 cup remaining cheese
7. Bake for 30 minutes , until set and a toothpick inserted into the center of the cornbread comes out clean
8. Allow to cool slightly before cutting into squares

title: italian eggplant  aubergine  crepes
steps:
1. Cut eggplant lengthwise into thin slices
2. Sprinkle each side lightly with salt
3. Place in a colander weighted with a heavy plate and let stand one hour
4. Dip each slice on both sides in seasoned flour
5. Saut lightly on both sides until golden
6. Add oil as needed
7. Keep warm
8. Mean while grate parmesan or romano cheese in food processor with steel blade
9. Combine with ricotta , eggs , garlic , salt and pepper
10. Add spinach and blend
11. Place several tablespoons of spinach mixture in center of crepe
12. Roll up and place seam sides down in a 13x9 inch baking pan
13. Top with tomato sauce
14. Sprinkle with grated cheese and bake in a preheated 375f oven for 15 minutes or until hot and bubbling
15. To prepare tomato sauce for eggplant crepes: place vegetables in a food processor with steel blade
16. Process until finely chopped
17. In large saucepan , saut vegetables in olive oil with garlic , basil , oregano and thyme until tender
18. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 20 minutes
19. Transfer to food processor or blender and process until smooth
20. Pour over eggplant crepes before heating in oven
21. Makes 2+1 / 2 cups sauce

title: spoom
steps:
1. In a large bowl stir together sherbet and ice cream
2. Add soda
3. Mix well
4. Spoon into glasses and serve immediately

title: smoked sausage with cabbage and apples
steps:
1. Layer the sausage , apples , cabage and onion in crockpot in the order listed above
2. Sprinkle the brown sugar , salt and black pepper on top
3. Pour the apple juice over all the other ingredients
4. Do not stir
5. Cover and cook on low 6-8 hours or high 3-4 hours

title: cabbage stew   basic
steps:
1. Melt butter / marg in pot add meat to slightly brown meat , add diced onions and stir through , add diced bacon and / or bacon bones , soya sauce , add water , add a sprinkle of black pepper and stir through
2. Bring to boil for 10 minutes then let simmer for 20 minutes
3. Add sliced cabbage to pot and leave simmer for another 5 - 10 minutes depending on how well you want your cabbage to be cooked
4. Serve with rice !

title: strawberry cream pie
steps:
1. Beat cream cheese , vanilla and sweetener till fluffy and smooth
2. Spread this in the pie crust
3. Bring the water and cornstarch to boil till thick
4. Add the gelatin and stir till dissolved
5. Let it cool a few minutes while you slice a layer of strawberries over the cream cheese mixture , pour the gelatin mixture over the berries and then garnish with more strawberries
6. Let cool in fridge and serve with whipped cream
7. This is a recipe that the dieters as well as non-dieters in our house really enjoyed !

title: cheddar turkey burgers
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine all the ingredients
2. Mix well , form into 6 equal sized patties
3. Coat a large skillet with nonstick cooking spray and cook the patties over medium heat for 3-4 minutes per side , or until the juices run clear and no pink remains serve immediately

title: always perfect biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f
2. In a large bowl , sift together all dry ingredients
3. Cut in margarine until mixture looks like coarse oatmeal
4. Make a well in the center of the dry mixture and pour the milk in the well
5. Stir dough until it begins to pull together
6. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface
7. Press dough together and roll out until 3 / 4 inch thick
8. Cut into 2-u=inch round biscuits
9. Place on an ungreased baking sheet
10. Bake in preheated oven for 9 minutes , or until golden brown

title: easy vanilla cake
steps:
1. Get a bowl first put the 4 eggs the vanilla and then the sugar
2. Mix in a blender till thick and creamy
3. While the eggs are blending mix flour and baking soda
4. When the mixture is finished take it out of blender and stir the flour with the baking soda in the bowl
5. When that is done take as much of the mixture as possible and put it in the cake pan and then in the oven for 20 minutes on 450f
6. When the cake is done cooking wait 10 minutes for it to cool

title: romano s macaroni grill roasted garlic lemon vinaigrette
steps:
1. Place vinegar , honey , salt and roasted garlic in a food processor
2. Puree until the garlic is chopped very fine
3. With the food processor still running , add olive oil and lemon juice
4. Refrigerate until ready to use

title: grilled salmon with ginger orange glaze
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingredients in a shallow dish
2. Add salmon
3. Cover and chill 30 minutes , turning once
4. Removee salmon from marinade , reserving marinade
5. Bring marinade to a boil in a small saucepan
6. Grill salmon , covered with grill lid , over medium-high heat about 6 minutes on each side or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork , basting frequently with reserved marinade
7. Arrange salmon over rice
8. Drizzle with any remaining marinade
9. Serve with lemon slices , and garnish , if desired

title: farmhouse ham and corn chowder
steps:
1. In a large pan , saute the onion , celery and pepper in the butter until the veggies are crisp-tender
2. Stir in flour and ranch dressing mix until smooth
3. Gradually stir in milk
4. Bring to a boil
5. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
6. Add the corn , potatoes , ham and spices
7. Bring to a boil
8. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 8-10 minutes , or until heated through
9. Sprinkle with cheese before serving
10. I actually use shredded swiss cheese in my soup , personal preference ! and the more the better !

title: mom s apple cobbler
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Melt butter in a 13x9x2 inch baking dish
3. Cut shortening into flour until particles resemble fine crumbs
4. Add milk and stir with a fork only until dough leaves the side of the bowl
5. Turn out dough onto a lightly floured board or pastry cloth , and knead just until smooth
6. Roll dough out into a large rectangle about 1 / 4 inch think
7. Sprinkle cinnamon over chopped apples , then sprinkle apples evenly over the dough
8. Roll up dough like a jelly roll and dampen the edges with water to seal
9. Slice dough into about 16 slices , 1 / 2 inch thick
10. Place slices in baking dish with the melted butter
11. In saucepan , heat water and sugar until dissolved
12. Pour the sugar syrup around the rolls
13. This will look like too much liquid , but dough will absorb it while baking
14. Bake for 55-60 minutes
15. Variation: this cobbler can also be made with other fresh , frozen , or canned fruits such as blackberries , cherries , or peaches
16. If the fruit is packed in liquid , drain and substitute for part of the water in the sugar syrup
17. Add enough water to make two cups of liquid

title: persian sugar pickled garlic
steps:
1. Separate garlic cloves , but do not peel
2. Place all ingredients in a large heavy-bottom saucepan
3. Bring to a boil
4. Cook for 10 minutes , stirring from time to time
5. Reduce heat to medium and cook 5 minutes
6. Cool to room temperature
7. Transfer to a large glass or ceramic jar large enough to hold garlic and the liquid
8. Tightly seal
9. Refrigerate at least 1 month before serving
10. The garlic improves with age for as long as 15 years

title: meatloaf surprise
steps:
1. Prepare meat mixture: melt butter in pot over medium heat
2. Saute onion , pepper& garlic until onion is translucent- about 4 minutes
3. Put meat into a large bowl& mash it with a wooden spoon until it becomes a sticky paste
4. Add the fried vegetables , bread crumbs , cayenne , lemon juice , lemon rind& parsley
5. Season with salt& pepper , combine well and set aside
6. Prepare cheese sauce: melt butter in a pot
7. Stir in flour& cook for 1 minute
8. Gradually pour in milk , stirring constsntly
9. Stir in cream and season with nutmeg , salt& pepper
10. Simmer for 5 minutes to thicken& reduce sauce
11. Lower heat , stir in cheeses and stir until melted
12. Meanwhile , cook pasta in boiling , salted water until el dente
13. Drain well& stir into cheese sauce
14. Lightly grease a 2 lb loaf tin
15. Spoon in half the meat mixture& level the surface
16. Cover with the pasta mixture
17. Spoon in the rest of the meat mixture
18. Cover with tin foil and bake in preheated 350f oven for 45 minutes
19. Remove foil and continue cooking for another 15 minutes

title: cheesy english muffins
steps:
1. After splitting the english muffins , cut them into wedges so each muffin makes 8 wedges
2. Mix the remaining ingredients in a bowl
3. Spread each wedge of muffin with some of the mixture
4. Lay wedges on foil-covered cookie sheet and place under broiler
5. Boil until hot and cheese is melted
